  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')

    sleep 2
  done

    [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m8d 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && break
    sleep 2
  done

  [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m8d 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] || { log "X smo_m8d absent after seed"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m8e2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] || { log "X smo_m8e2 absent after seed"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X seed pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
else
  log "all smo_* present: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m8d $FILES/smo_m8b $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr '\n' '|')"

# ---- switches: 18 cross-round baselines stay 1 (byte-identical to M8B) + smo_m8d=1 (this round's
#      two binder gates) + smo_m8b=1 (M8B gates 104/105) + smo_m7z2=1 (M7Z2 gates 99..103) ----

for s in smo_m8c smo_gpu_write smo_m7a smo_m7b smo_m7s smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7x smo_m7y smo_m7k smo_m7l smo_m7m smo_m7o smo_frz smo_ldrd smo_aud smo_sha_ungated smo_dspool smo_m7d_same; do

  V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "1" ] || { log "X $s not 1, abort"; exit 1; }

V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m8c" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "0" ] || log "!! smo_m8c=$V (expected 0: no injection this round)"

  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m11a_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1

    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi

STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')

  *10106102*) log "X boot aa start blocked 10106102 -> re-entering unlock poll"
              [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ] && { wait_unlock || { log "X locked again; BLOCKED"; exit 2; }; sleep 3; stopapp; STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r'); } ;;

#      somebody else reinstalled/restarted the app under us => this boot is INVALID for conclusions.
MYPID=""

  MYPID=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$MYPID" ] && break
  sleep 1
done
log "boot pid (ours) = ${MYPID:-<none>} at t=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"
for T in 2 10; do
  while [ $(( $(date +%s) - START )) -lt "$T" ]; do sleep 1; done
  PN=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ "$PN" != "$MYPID" ]; then
    CONCURRENT=1
    log "X CONCURRENT INTERFERENCE at t=${T}s: pid ${MYPID:-<none>} -> ${PN:-<none>} => boot INVALID"
    break

  log "pid stable at t=${T}s: $PN (ours)"

TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"; printf 't\tframes\tsubmit\topens\tdraws\tstall\tm7q_wrap\th5\th7\tg1_site\tg2_hits\tg3_hits\tg4_x8\tg5_x58\tm8d_g106\tm8d_g107\tm8b_g104\tm10a_g108h\tm10a_g108f\tm10a_raw\tm10a_ret\tm10a_g112\n' > "$TSV"

F1(){ SU 1 | grep -o 'site_hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F2(){ SU 2 | grep -o ' hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F3(){ SU 3 | grep -o ' hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F4(){ SU 4 | grep -o 'last_x8=[^ ]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }

GH(){ grep -a "\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  if [ "$KEEP_AWAKE" = "1" ] && [ $(( EL - LASTWAKE )) -ge 10 ]; then
    LASTWAKE=$EL; h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  PP=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$PP" ]; then DEADN=$(( ${DEADN:-0} + 1 )); else DEADN=0; fi
  if [ "${DEADN:-0}" -ge 2 ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> - app died during the boot; stopping this run"
    shot "$EL" "tdeath"
    h shell "ls -t /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null | head -3" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    DEATH_T=$EL; break
  fi
  [ -z "$CURPID" ] && { P="$PP"; [ -n "$P" ] && { CURPID=$P; log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; }; }
  RAW=$(h shell "tail -n 4000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[beat\]|\[st\] t=|\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap|\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=h[57]|\[m7z2\] sum[1-5] |\[m7z2\] lr[1-5] |\[m7z2\] g[1-5] |\[m8b\] sum[12] |\[m8b\] ev |\[m8d\] sum[12] |\[m8d\] lr[12] |\[m8d\] probe|\[m8d\] code|\[m8e2\] sum[1-4] |\[m8e2\] lr[1-4] |\[m8e2\] ev[1-4] |\[m8e2\] probe|\[m8e2\] code|\[m8e2\] judge|\[m10a\] probe|\[m10a\] code|\[m10a\] sum |\[m10a\] judge|\[m10a\] ' " | tr -d '\r')
  BT=$(grep -a '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  ST=$(grep -a '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  MQ=$(grep -a '\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  MQW=$(grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' <<<"$MQ" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); MQW=${MQW:-}
  H5=$(GH h5); H7=$(GH h7); A=$(F1); B=$(F2); C=$(F3); XT=$(F4); RN=$(F5)
  D1=$(G8D x 1); D2=$(G8D x 2); BB=$(G8B)
  M0=$(M10ASUM); printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${OP:-}" "${DW:-}" "${STALL:-}" "${MQW:-}" "${H5:-}" "${H7:-}" "${A:-}" "${B:-}" "${C:-}" "${XT:-}" "${RN:-}" "${D1:-}" "${D2:-}" "${BB:-}" "$(echo "$M0"|cut -f1)" "$(echo "$M0"|cut -f2)" "$(echo "$M0"|cut -f3)" "$(echo "$M0"|cut -f4)" "$(echo "$M0"|cut -f5)" >> "$TSV"
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 18 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    SL=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m8d\] probe|\[m8d\] code|\[m8d\] sum[12] |\[m8b\] probe|\[m8b\] code|\[m8b\] sum[12] |\[m7z2\] sum[1-5] ' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -40" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s M8D-READBACK: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$SL")"
    GI=$(h shell "grep -a -E 'obs gate main\+0x(6c7750|4b8d30|4b8cb0|4b7380)|obs gate main\+0x(4b8ea4|4b8e20|4b8e88)' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -12; echo NOTINST=$(grep -a -c 'NOT installed' $LOG 2>/dev/null)" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s gate-install lines: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$GI")"
    RB2=$(for s in smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m8c smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7h; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
    log "t=${EL}s switch readback (in-boot): $RB2"
  fi
  if [ $(( EL % 20 )) -lt 3 ]; then log "t=${EL}s frames=${FR:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?} stall=${STALL:-?} m7q_wrap=${MQW:-?} h5=${H5:-?} h7=${H7:-?} g1_site=${A:-?} g2_hits=${B:-?} g3_hits=${C:-?} g4_x8=${XT:-?} g5_x58=${RN:-?} g106=${D1:-?} g107=${D2:-?} g104=${BB:-?}"; fi
  for T in $PLAN; do if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi; done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 4
done
shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} death_t=${DEATH_T:-none} dur=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done
DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  for K in st beat m7y2 m7x2 m7w2 m7u2 m7t2 m7s2 m7q gst; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  grep -a 'obs gate' "$DL" > "$OUT/gates_install.txt" 2>/dev/null
  log "gate install lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/gates_install.txt" | tr -d ' ') NOTINST=$(grep -ac 'NOT installed' "$DL" || true)"
  for K in m8b m8d m7z2 m8e2 m10a; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  for g in 1 2; do log "m8d sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m8d\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  for g in 1 2 3 4; do log "m8e2 sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m8e2\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  log "m10a probe: $(grep -a "\[m10a\] probe" "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "m10a code: $(grep -a "\[m10a\] code" "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "m10a sum: $(grep -a "\[m10a\] sum t=" "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "m10a judge: $(grep -a "\[m10a\] judge" "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "m10a judgeA: $(grep -a "\[m10a\] judgeA" "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "m10a ev: $(grep -a "\[m10a\] ev " "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 800)"
  log "m8e2 judge lines: $(grep -a "\[m8e2\] judge" "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 1500)"
  for g in 1 2; do log "m8b sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m8b\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  for g in 1 2 3 4 5; do log "m7z2 sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m7z2\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  log "m8d code lines: $(grep -a '\[m8d\] code' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 1200)"
  log "m7z2 code lines: $(grep -a '\[m7z2\] code' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 2200)"
fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG unlock_probes=${UNLOCK_N:-0} concurrent_interference=${CONCURRENT:-?}"

`m12a_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
# M12A (2026-11-08): EMULATOR round -- WHY IS THE FIRST-BOOT (A-scene) FRAME ALL BLACK WHILE 220k DRAWS RUN?
#   Zero new gates, zero new switches, ZERO BUILD: this round only RE-USES the instrumentation that is
#   already compiled into the M10A build. What is harvested, per boot, with no behaviour change:
#     [p] sig      presented-pixel signature of the staging buffer  => deliverable #1 (the on-screen source)
#     [p] present  ledger src=/slot=  + [p] sel / [p] slots / [p] cmp  => 4-slot..30-slot RT inventory at
#                  the present moment (M4ak probe: <=3 per boot, >=120 s apart, "verdict=all_flat" etc.)
#     [wp] rt      every screen-sized RT with mean/colored%/hb5 + src=present-pick|rt-cur|rt-screen
#     [wp] rt sum  pick_slot/pick_texid/worldpick_slot/m7h_src/cur_slot  (60 s cadence, forced on m7g claim)
#     [wp] tgt     per-slot draw+vertex deltas in the window (which RT the draws land on) + HOSTFALLBACK
#     [g] rt table / [g] rt worldpick  (one-shot, first frame with draws>=2000 && lw>=16)
#     [m7g] claim/post, [m7h] src set/dump, [ca] rt282, [c] comp src
#   Two boots: B1 smo_m10a=0 (TitleMenu segment, the known-good >72% white screen) and
#   B2 smo_m10a=1 (first-boot segment, the all-black screen). 200 s each so B2 covers the self-advance
#   that happens around t~116-140 s. Switch set is BYTE-IDENTICAL to M10A (18 baseline ones + m8b/m8d/
#   m8e2 + m8c=0 + gdump_sec=10); the ONLY moving part is smo_m10a. No hdc kill. Emulator only.
# usage: bash m12a_boot_run.sh <tag b1|b2> <target 127.0.0.1:5555> [dur=200] [gdump_sec=10]   M10A=0|1
# M10A (2026-11-08): EMULATOR round -- FLIP THE FORK CRITERION bit0 to 1 and watch the A family grow.
#   New switch smo_m10a (C default 0): 0 = fully off (gate 108 keeps the untouched 27-word tail=3 skeleton
#   => byte-identical to the M9C build), 1 = force (only the FIRST N hits, N=1 by default; second char of the
#   file may give 1..3), 2 = record-only (mask always 0).  The 35-word variant stub replays the real bl
#   0x4d2bd0, then `orr w0,w0,mask` before returning => ONLY w0's bit0 can change.
#   New gate 112 = main+0x4b4bc8 = the tbz fall-through first word (zero branch landings in the whole image):
#   hits = "the A branch was entered", x0 = what the caller actually saw.
#   Two boots: B1 smo_m10a=0 (control, must reproduce M9C), B2 smo_m10a=1 (the experiment).
#   Only target: emulator 127.0.0.1:5555. Real device (192.168.0.111) OFF-LIMITS this round.
# usage: bash m10a_boot_run.sh <tag e1|e2> <target 127.0.0.1:5555> [dur=150] [gdump_sec=10]   M10A=0|1|2
# ---- original M8D header below ----
# M8D (2026-11-08): REAL-DEVICE ROUND 1 -- one build, one install, one <=150 s boot that harvests
#   (a) the DEVICE nerve timeline (M8B's gates id 104 main+0x6c7750 / id 105 main+0x4b8d30, reused
#       unchanged) and (b) the M7Z2 "leg A / leg B" split (M7Z2's G3 id 101 main+0x4b8ea4 LR decides it).
#   New this round (switch smo_m8d, C default 0): the TWO TWIN TABLE-BINDER gates
#     G1 id 106 main+0x4b8cb0 -> binds nerve table 0x12d0fe8 (FirstSequence family)
#     G2 id 107 main+0x4b7380 -> binds nerve table 0x12d06d8 (TitleMenu family)
#   both with ZERO static bl/b callers, so hits>0 proves that family's HostType instance was built.
#   smo_m8c is forced to 0: the M8C conditional-injection code is in this tree, and with 0 the
#   observer returns 0 and x1 keeps its original value (byte-identical to M8B: natural state only).
# usage: bash m8d_boot_run.sh <tag d1> <target 192.168.0.111:42323> [dur=150] [gdump_sec=10]
#   SKIP_INSTALL=1 -> resume a boot without reinstalling   UNLOCK_POLL=0 -> skip unlock poll
#   KEEP_AWAKE=1   -> power-shell wakeup every 10 s during the measured boot (device style)
# Never runs `hdc kill` (it would take the other target down). Every hdc call uses -t.
# Names: m8d / smo_m8d / [m8d] / m8d_boot_run.sh / logs/m8d_* -- five-name check all-clear 15:06.
# Baseline switches: byte-identical to M8B (18 ones + 3 zeros), diff = {smo_m8d: ->1, smo_m8c: ->0}.
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: bash m8d_boot_run.sh <tag> <target> [dur] [gdump_sec]}"
TGT="${2:?target required (all hdc calls use -t)}"
DUR="${3:-200}"
GD="${4:-10}"
M10A="${M10A:-0}"   # 0=off(control) 1=force 2=record-only
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="/tmp/m12a_build/entry.hap"   # M10A: PRIVATE copy, immune to other people rebuilding the tree
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m12a_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
UNLOCK_POLL="${UNLOCK_POLL:-1}"
UNLOCK_MAX="${UNLOCK_MAX:-1200}"        # 20 min cap, per the round rules
KEEP_AWAKE="${KEEP_AWAKE:-1}"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M10A tag=$TAG target=$TGT dur=${DUR}s gdump_sec=$GD out=$OUT unlock_poll=$UNLOCK_POLL(<=${UNLOCK_MAX}s) keep_awake=$KEEP_AWAKE"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target $TGT offline"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"
# ---- M9C anti-collision (0/3): record EVERY placeholder in /tmp (ours + any other round's). ----
log "tmp placeholders: $(for f in /tmp/*_building /tmp/m8*_go /tmp/m9*_go; do [ -e "$f" ] && printf '%s@%s ' "$(basename "$f")" "$(stat -f '%Sm' -t '%H:%M:%S' "$f")"; done)"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }

# ---- unlock poll: a successful `aa start` IS the seed start too (the app constructors create
#      files/smo_m7z2, smo_m8b, smo_m8c, smo_m8d on first launch). 10106102 = locked -> do NOT try
#      to unlock, just poll every 15 s (cap 20 min, then BLOCKED per the round rules).
wait_unlock(){
  local n=0 t0=$(date +%s) out
  h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
  while :; do
    n=$((n+1))
    out=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
    local el=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))
    printf '[%s] probe #%d t=%ds %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$n" "$el" "$(echo "$out" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 160)" >> "$OUT/unlock_probe.log"
    case "$out" in
      *10106102*) : ;;
      *"start ability successfully"*|*"successfully"*) log "unlock poll: probe #$n OK at t=${el}s (of cap ${UNLOCK_MAX}s)"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 0 ;;
      *) : ;;
    esac
    [ "$el" -ge "$UNLOCK_MAX" ] && { log "X unlock poll: ${UNLOCK_MAX}s cap reached after $n probes (still 10106102) -> BLOCKED"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 1; }
    sleep 15
  done
}

# ---- M9C anti-collision (1/3): if ANOTHER round already owns the device, do NOT force-stop it.
#      Wait up to 120 s for that pid to go away by itself; if it does not, abort rather than collide.
P0=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
if [ -n "$P0" ]; then
  log "PRE: foreign pid=$P0 already on device -> waiting up to 120 s for it to vanish (NOT force-stopping it)"
  n=0
  while [ "$n" -lt 24 ]; do
    sleep 5; n=$((n+1))
    P0=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -z "$P0" ] && { log "PRE: foreign pid gone after $((n*5))s"; break; }
  done
  if [ -n "$P0" ]; then log "X PRE: pid=$P0 still alive after 120 s -> ABORT (a concurrent round owns the device)"; exit 3; fi
else
  log "PRE: device idle (no pid) -> clean to install"
fi

stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"

if [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ]; then
  wait_unlock || { log "X device stays locked; not booting (per round rules)"; exit 2; }
  log "after unlock poll: pid=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]') files=[$(h shell "ls $FILES/ 2>/dev/null | grep -a smo_ | tr '\n' ' '" | tr -d '\r')]"
  sleep 3
  stopapp || { log "X probe pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
fi

if [ "${SKIP_INSTALL:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  log "install SKIPPED (SKIP_INSTALL=1)"
else
  T0=$(date +%s)
  OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); INST_S=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))
  log "install(${INST_S}s): $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
  UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
  log "upd_after: $UPD1"
  [ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"
fi

# ---- seed start (~7-8 s, NOT counted in the measured boot): hdc cannot CREATE a file inside the
#      app sandbox, so the app constructors must seed smo_m7z2 / smo_m8b / smo_m8c / smo_m8d once.
NEEDSEED=0
for s in smo_m7z2 smo_m8b smo_m8c smo_m8d smo_m8e2 smo_m10a smo_m12a; do
  [ -z "$(h shell "ls $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && NEEDSEED=1
done
if [ "$NEEDSEED" = "1" ]; then
  log "seed start: letting the app constructors create the smo_* files"
  SEEDOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed aa start: $(echo "$SEEDOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  case "$SEEDOUT" in *10106102*) log "X seed aa start blocked: 10106102 (screen locked)"; exit 2;; esac
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  for i in $(seq 1 15); do
    [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m8d 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && break
    sleep 2
  done
  log "seed check: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m8d $FILES/smo_m8b $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr '\n' '|')"
  [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m8d 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] || { log "X smo_m8d absent after seed"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m8e2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] || { log "X smo_m8e2 absent after seed"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X seed pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
else
  log "all smo_* present: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m8d $FILES/smo_m8b $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr '\n' '|')"
fi

# ---- switches: 18 cross-round baselines stay 1 (byte-identical to M8B) + smo_m8d=1 (this round's
#      two binder gates) + smo_m8b=1 (M8B gates 104/105) + smo_m7z2=1 (M7Z2 gates 99..103) ----
for s in smo_m8e2 smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m7g smo_m7r smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7n smo_m7p smo_m7q smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7s2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7z2; do
  h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
for s in smo_m8c smo_gpu_write smo_m7a smo_m7b smo_m7s smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7x smo_m7y smo_m7k smo_m7l smo_m7m smo_m7o smo_frz smo_ldrd smo_aud smo_sha_ungated smo_dspool smo_m7d_same; do
  h shell "[ -f $FILES/$s ] && echo 0 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $GD > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $M10A > $FILES/smo_m10a" >/dev/null 2>&1   # M10A: THE ONLY diff vs M9C switch set
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_m12a" >/dev/null 2>&1      # M12A: this round's quad ledger + tex readback (read-only probe)
RB=$(for s in smo_m8e2 smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m8c smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7v smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7d_same; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
RB="$RB gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n') smo_m10a=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m10a 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n') smo_m12a=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m12a 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"
log "switch readback (pre-boot): $RB"
for s in smo_m8e2 smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r; do
  V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "1" ] || { log "X $s not 1, abort"; exit 1; }
done
V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m8c" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "0" ] || log "!! smo_m8c=$V (expected 0: no injection this round)"

h shell "printf '' > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "log truncated: bytes=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG" | tr -dc '0-9')"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m12a_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m12a_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
case "$STARTOUT" in
  *10106102*) log "X boot aa start blocked 10106102 -> re-entering unlock poll"
              [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ] && { wait_unlock || { log "X locked again; BLOCKED"; exit 2; }; sleep 3; stopapp; STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r'); } ;;
esac
log "boot aa start: $(echo "$STARTOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
START=$(date +%s); CURPID=""; PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0; LASTWAKE=0; XT_SAVED=""; CONCURRENT=0
# ---- M9C anti-collision (2/3): grab OUR pid, then re-check at t=2 s and t=10 s. A changed pid means
#      somebody else reinstalled/restarted the app under us => this boot is INVALID for conclusions.
MYPID=""
for i in $(seq 1 12); do
  MYPID=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$MYPID" ] && break
  sleep 1
done
log "boot pid (ours) = ${MYPID:-<none>} at t=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"
for T in 2 10; do
  while [ $(( $(date +%s) - START )) -lt "$T" ]; do sleep 1; done
  PN=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ "$PN" != "$MYPID" ]; then
    CONCURRENT=1
    log "X CONCURRENT INTERFERENCE at t=${T}s: pid ${MYPID:-<none>} -> ${PN:-<none>} => boot INVALID"
    break
  fi
  log "pid stable at t=${T}s: $PN (ours)"
done
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"; printf 't\tframes\tsubmit\topens\tdraws\tstall\tm7q_wrap\th5\th7\tg1_site\tg2_hits\tg3_hits\tg4_x8\tg5_x58\tm8d_g106\tm8d_g107\tm8b_g104\tm10a_g108h\tm10a_g108f\tm10a_raw\tm10a_ret\tm10a_g112\n' > "$TSV"
PLAN="30 120 180"
GA(){ grep -a "\[m7u2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
SU(){ grep -a "\[m7z2\] sum$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1; }
F1(){ SU 1 | grep -o 'site_hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F2(){ SU 2 | grep -o ' hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F3(){ SU 3 | grep -o ' hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F4(){ SU 4 | grep -o 'last_x8=[^ ]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F5(){ SU 5 | grep -o 'last_c=[^ ]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
G8D(){ grep -a "\[m8d\] sum$2 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
G8B(){ grep -a "\[m8b\] sum1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
M10ASUM(){ L=$(grep -a "\[m10a\] sum t=" <<<"$RAW" | tail -1); H=$(grep -o 'g108 hits=[0-9]*' <<<"$L" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); F=$(grep -o 'forced=[0-9]*' <<<"$L" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); R=$(grep -o 'last_raw=[^ ]*' <<<"$L" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); T=$(grep -o 'last_ret=[^ ]*' <<<"$L" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); A2=$(grep -o 'g112(A-branch entry) hits=[0-9]*' <<<"$L" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s' "${H:-}" "${F:-}" "${R:-}" "${T:-}" "${A2:-}"; }
GH(){ grep -a "\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  if [ "$KEEP_AWAKE" = "1" ] && [ $(( EL - LASTWAKE )) -ge 10 ]; then
    LASTWAKE=$EL; h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  PP=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$PP" ]; then DEADN=$(( ${DEADN:-0} + 1 )); else DEADN=0; fi
  if [ "${DEADN:-0}" -ge 2 ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> - app died during the boot; stopping this run"
    shot "$EL" "tdeath"
    h shell "ls -t /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null | head -3" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    DEATH_T=$EL; break
  fi
  [ -z "$CURPID" ] && { P="$PP"; [ -n "$P" ] && { CURPID=$P; log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; }; }
  RAW=$(h shell "tail -n 4000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[beat\]|\[st\] t=|\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap|\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=h[57]|\[m7z2\] sum[1-5] |\[m7z2\] lr[1-5] |\[m7z2\] g[1-5] |\[m8b\] sum[12] |\[m8b\] ev |\[m8d\] sum[12] |\[m8d\] lr[12] |\[m8d\] probe|\[m8d\] code|\[m8e2\] sum[1-4] |\[m8e2\] lr[1-4] |\[m8e2\] ev[1-4] |\[m8e2\] probe|\[m8e2\] code|\[m8e2\] judge|\[m10a\] probe|\[m10a\] code|\[m10a\] sum |\[m10a\] judge|\[m10a\] ' " | tr -d '\r')
  BT=$(grep -a '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  ST=$(grep -a '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  MQ=$(grep -a '\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  MQW=$(grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' <<<"$MQ" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); MQW=${MQW:-}
  H5=$(GH h5); H7=$(GH h7); A=$(F1); B=$(F2); C=$(F3); XT=$(F4); RN=$(F5)
  D1=$(G8D x 1); D2=$(G8D x 2); BB=$(G8B)
  M0=$(M10ASUM); printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${OP:-}" "${DW:-}" "${STALL:-}" "${MQW:-}" "${H5:-}" "${H7:-}" "${A:-}" "${B:-}" "${C:-}" "${XT:-}" "${RN:-}" "${D1:-}" "${D2:-}" "${BB:-}" "$(echo "$M0"|cut -f1)" "$(echo "$M0"|cut -f2)" "$(echo "$M0"|cut -f3)" "$(echo "$M0"|cut -f4)" "$(echo "$M0"|cut -f5)" >> "$TSV"
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 18 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    SL=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m8d\] probe|\[m8d\] code|\[m8d\] sum[12] |\[m8b\] probe|\[m8b\] code|\[m8b\] sum[12] |\[m7z2\] sum[1-5] ' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -40" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s M8D-READBACK: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$SL")"
    GI=$(h shell "grep -a -E 'obs gate main\+0x(6c7750|4b8d30|4b8cb0|4b7380)|obs gate main\+0x(4b8ea4|4b8e20|4b8e88)' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -12; echo NOTINST=$(grep -a -c 'NOT installed' $LOG 2>/dev/null)" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s gate-install lines: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$GI")"
    RB2=$(for s in smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m8c smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7h; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
    log "t=${EL}s switch readback (in-boot): $RB2"
  fi
  if [ $(( EL % 20 )) -lt 3 ]; then log "t=${EL}s frames=${FR:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?} stall=${STALL:-?} m7q_wrap=${MQW:-?} h5=${H5:-?} h7=${H7:-?} g1_site=${A:-?} g2_hits=${B:-?} g3_hits=${C:-?} g4_x8=${XT:-?} g5_x58=${RN:-?} g106=${D1:-?} g107=${D2:-?} g104=${BB:-?}"; fi
  for T in $PLAN; do if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi; done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 4
done
shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} death_t=${DEATH_T:-none} dur=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done
DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  for K in st beat m7y2 m7x2 m7w2 m7u2 m7t2 m7s2 m7q gst; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  grep -a 'obs gate' "$DL" > "$OUT/gates_install.txt" 2>/dev/null
  log "gate install lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/gates_install.txt" | tr -d ' ') NOTINST=$(grep -ac 'NOT installed' "$DL" || true)"
  for K in m8b m8d m7z2 m8e2 m10a; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  for g in 1 2; do log "m8d sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m8d\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  for g in 1 2 3 4; do log "m8e2 sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m8e2\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  log "m10a probe: $(grep -a "\[m10a\] probe" "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "m10a code: $(grep -a "\[m10a\] code" "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "m10a sum: $(grep -a "\[m10a\] sum t=" "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "m10a judge: $(grep -a "\[m10a\] judge" "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "m10a judgeA: $(grep -a "\[m10a\] judgeA" "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "m10a ev: $(grep -a "\[m10a\] ev " "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 800)"
  log "m8e2 judge lines: $(grep -a "\[m8e2\] judge" "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 1500)"
  for g in 1 2; do log "m8b sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m8b\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  for g in 1 2 3 4 5; do log "m7z2 sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m7z2\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  log "m8d code lines: $(grep -a '\[m8d\] code' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 1200)"
  log "m7z2 code lines: $(grep -a '\[m7z2\] code' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 2200)"
fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG unlock_probes=${UNLOCK_N:-0} concurrent_interference=${CONCURRENT:-?}"

```

`m13a_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
# M13A (2026-11-08): EMULATOR round -- WHO PAINTS THE FIRST-BOOT (A-scene) FULL-SCREEN OPAQUE BLACK?
#   Zero new gates, ONE new READ-ONLY probe switch (smo_m13a, C default 0).  M12A proved the RT content is
#   (0,0,0,255) while the landed clear colour is grey 0.5, i.e. a draw paints opaque black over everything; it
#   could NOT name that draw because every content group submits a UNIT quad and the screen transform lives in
#   an unlocked cbuf window.  M13A abandons geometry inference and asks the PIXEL instead: inside 8 guest frames
#   (sub 1000..1007) every colour draw to the 800x450 present RT is followed by a batch flush + a 4x 1x1 pixel
#   read-back (centre / red-packet icon / dark-red line / corner).  When a pixel changes, the draw's identity +
#   both stages' UBO head (32 floats) and the cb+224 matrix window are logged.
#   Two boots: B2 smo_m10a=1 (A scene, 200 s) and B1 smo_m10a=0 (control, 120 s).
#   Switch set BYTE-IDENTICAL to M12A (18 baseline ones + m8b/m8d/m8e2 + m8c=0 + gdump_sec=10 + m10a + m12a=1);
#   the ONLY diff is the new smo_m13a=1.  Emulator only (127.0.0.1:5555); real device 192.168.0.111 untouched.
# usage: bash m13a_boot_run.sh <tag a2|b1> <target 127.0.0.1:5555> [dur=200] [gdump_sec=10]   M10A=0|1
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: bash m8d_boot_run.sh <tag> <target> [dur] [gdump_sec]}"
TGT="${2:?target required (all hdc calls use -t)}"
DUR="${3:-200}"
GD="${4:-10}"
M10A="${M10A:-0}"   # 0=off(control) 1=force 2=record-only
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"

OUT="$ROOT/logs/m13a_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"

mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }

log "=== M10A tag=$TAG target=$TGT dur=${DUR}s gdump_sec=$GD out=$OUT unlock_poll=$UNLOCK_POLL(<=${UNLOCK_MAX}s) keep_awake=$KEEP_AWAKE"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target $TGT offline"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"
# ---- M9C anti-collision (0/3): record EVERY placeholder in /tmp (ours + any other round's). ----
log "tmp placeholders: $(for f in /tmp/*_building /tmp/m8*_go /tmp/m9*_go; do [ -e "$f" ] && printf '%s@%s ' "$(basename "$f")" "$(stat -f '%Sm' -t '%H:%M:%S' "$f")"; done)"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }

# ---- unlock poll: a successful `aa start` IS the seed start too (the app constructors create
#      files/smo_m7z2, smo_m8b, smo_m8c, smo_m8d on first launch). 10106102 = locked -> do NOT try
#      to unlock, just poll every 15 s (cap 20 min, then BLOCKED per the round rules).
wait_unlock(){
  local n=0 t0=$(date +%s) out
  h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
  while :; do
    n=$((n+1))
    out=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
    local el=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))
    printf '[%s] probe #%d t=%ds %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$n" "$el" "$(echo "$out" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 160)" >> "$OUT/unlock_probe.log"
    case "$out" in
      *10106102*) : ;;
      *"start ability successfully"*|*"successfully"*) log "unlock poll: probe #$n OK at t=${el}s (of cap ${UNLOCK_MAX}s)"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 0 ;;
      *) : ;;
    esac
    [ "$el" -ge "$UNLOCK_MAX" ] && { log "X unlock poll: ${UNLOCK_MAX}s cap reached after $n probes (still 10106102) -> BLOCKED"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 1; }
    sleep 15
  done
}

# ---- M9C anti-collision (1/3): if ANOTHER round already owns the device, do NOT force-stop it.
#      Wait up to 120 s for that pid to go away by itself; if it does not, abort rather than collide.
P0=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
if [ -n "$P0" ]; then
  log "PRE: foreign pid=$P0 already on device -> waiting up to 120 s for it to vanish (NOT force-stopping it)"
  n=0
  while [ "$n" -lt 24 ]; do
    sleep 5; n=$((n+1))
    P0=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -z "$P0" ] && { log "PRE: foreign pid gone after $((n*5))s"; break; }
  done
  if [ -n "$P0" ]; then log "X PRE: pid=$P0 still alive after 120 s -> ABORT (a concurrent round owns the device)"; exit 3; fi
else
  log "PRE: device idle (no pid) -> clean to install"
fi

stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"

if [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ]; then
  wait_unlock || { log "X device stays locked; not booting (per round rules)"; exit 2; }
  log "after unlock poll: pid=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]') files=[$(h shell "ls $FILES/ 2>/dev/null | grep -a smo_ | tr '\n' ' '" | tr -d '\r')]"
  sleep 3
  stopapp || { log "X probe pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
fi

if [ "${SKIP_INSTALL:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  log "install SKIPPED (SKIP_INSTALL=1)"
else
  T0=$(date +%s)
  OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); INST_S=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))

  grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
  UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
  log "upd_after: $UPD1"
  [ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"
fi

# ---- seed start (~7-8 s, NOT counted in the measured boot): hdc cannot CREATE a file inside the
#      app sandbox, so the app constructors must seed smo_m7z2 / smo_m8b / smo_m8c / smo_m8d once.
NEEDSEED=0
for s in smo_m7z2 smo_m8b smo_m8c smo_m8d smo_m8e2 smo_m10a smo_m12a smo_m13a; do
  [ -z "$(h shell "ls $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && NEEDSEED=1
done
if [ "$NEEDSEED" = "1" ]; then
  log "seed start: letting the app constructors create the smo_* files"
  SEEDOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed aa start: $(echo "$SEEDOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  case "$SEEDOUT" in *10106102*) log "X seed aa start blocked: 10106102 (screen locked)"; exit 2;; esac
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  for i in $(seq 1 15); do
    [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m8d 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && break
    sleep 2
  done
  log "seed check: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m8d $FILES/smo_m8b $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr '\n' '|')"
  [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m8d 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] || { log "X smo_m8d absent after seed"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m8e2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] || { log "X smo_m8e2 absent after seed"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X seed pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
else
  log "all smo_* present: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m8d $FILES/smo_m8b $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr '\n' '|')"
fi

# ---- switches: 18 cross-round baselines stay 1 (byte-identical to M8B) + smo_m8d=1 (this round's
#      two binder gates) + smo_m8b=1 (M8B gates 104/105) + smo_m7z2=1 (M7Z2 gates 99..103) ----
for s in smo_m8e2 smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m7g smo_m7r smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7n smo_m7p smo_m7q smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7s2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7z2; do

log "switch readback (pre-boot): $RB"
for s in smo_m8e2 smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r; do
  V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "1" ] || { log "X $s not 1, abort"; exit 1; }
done
V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m8c" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "0" ] || log "!! smo_m8c=$V (expected 0: no injection this round)"

h shell "printf '' > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

shot(){

  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m13a_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1

STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')

  *10106102*) log "X boot aa start blocked 10106102 -> re-entering unlock poll"

#      somebody else reinstalled/restarted the app under us => this boot is INVALID for conclusions.
MYPID=""

  MYPID=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$MYPID" ] && break
  sleep 1

for T in 2 10; do
  while [ $(( $(date +%s) - START )) -lt "$T" ]; do sleep 1; done
  PN=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ "$PN" != "$MYPID" ]; then
    CONCURRENT=1
    log "X CONCURRENT INTERFERENCE at t=${T}s: pid ${MYPID:-<none>} -> ${PN:-<none>} => boot INVALID"
    break
  fi
  log "pid stable at t=${T}s: $PN (ours)"
done
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"; printf 't\tframes\tsubmit\topens\tdraws\tstall\tm7q_wrap\th5\th7\tg1_site\tg2_hits\tg3_hits\tg4_x8\tg5_x58\tm8d_g106\tm8d_g107\tm8b_g104\tm10a_g108h\tm10a_g108f\tm10a_raw\tm10a_ret\tm10a_g112\n' > "$TSV"

  fi

  MQ=$(grep -a '\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)

  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}

    GI=$(h shell "grep -a -E 'obs gate main\+0x(6c7750|4b8d30|4b8cb0|4b7380)|obs gate main\+0x(4b8ea4|4b8e20|4b8e88)' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -12; echo NOTINST=$(grep -a -c 'NOT installed' $LOG 2>/dev/null)" | tr -d '\r')

    log "t=${EL}s switch readback (in-boot): $RB2"
  fi
  if [ $(( EL % 20 )) -lt 3 ]; then log "t=${EL}s frames=${FR:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?} stall=${STALL:-?} m7q_wrap=${MQW:-?} h5=${H5:-?} h7=${H7:-?} g1_site=${A:-?} g2_hits=${B:-?} g3_hits=${C:-?} g4_x8=${XT:-?} g5_x58=${RN:-?} g106=${D1:-?} g107=${D2:-?} g104=${BB:-?}"; fi
  for T in $PLAN; do if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi; done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 4
done
shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} death_t=${DEATH_T:-none} dur=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done
DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  for K in st beat m7y2 m7x2 m7w2 m7u2 m7t2 m7s2 m7q gst; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  grep -a 'obs gate' "$DL" > "$OUT/gates_install.txt" 2>/dev/null
  log "gate install lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/gates_install.txt" | tr -d ' ') NOTINST=$(grep -ac 'NOT installed' "$DL" || true)"
  for K in m8b m8d m7z2 m8e2 m10a; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  grep -a "\[m13a\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/m13a_lines.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[m13a] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m13a_lines.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[m12a\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/m12a_lines.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[m12a] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m12a_lines.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  for g in 1 2; do log "m8d sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m8d\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  for g in 1 2 3 4; do log "m8e2 sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m8e2\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  log "m10a probe: $(grep -a "\[m10a\] probe" "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "m10a code: $(grep -a "\[m10a\] code" "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "m10a sum: $(grep -a "\[m10a\] sum t=" "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "m10a judge: $(grep -a "\[m10a\] judge" "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "m10a judgeA: $(grep -a "\[m10a\] judgeA" "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "m10a ev: $(grep -a "\[m10a\] ev " "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 800)"
  log "m8e2 judge lines: $(grep -a "\[m8e2\] judge" "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 1500)"
  for g in 1 2; do log "m8b sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m8b\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  for g in 1 2 3 4 5; do log "m7z2 sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m7z2\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  log "m8d code lines: $(grep -a '\[m8d\] code' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 1200)"
  log "m7z2 code lines: $(grep -a '\[m7z2\] code' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 2200)"
fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG unlock_probes=${UNLOCK_N:-0} concurrent_interference=${CONCURRENT:-?}"

```

`m14b_boot_run.sh`:

# M14B (2026-11-08): EMULATOR round -- DECODE THE GUEST NVN BLEND STATE AND (LATER) TURN BLENDING ON.
#   Zero new gates, ONE new READ-ONLY probe switch (smo_m13a, C default 0).  M12A proved the RT content is
#   (0,0,0,255) while the landed clear colour is grey 0.5, i.e. a draw paints opaque black over everything; it
#   could NOT name that draw because every content group submits a UNIT quad and the screen transform lives in
#   an unlocked cbuf window.  M13A abandons geometry inference and asks the PIXEL instead: inside 8 guest frames
#   (sub 1000..1007) every colour draw to the 800x450 present RT is followed by a batch flush + a 4x 1x1 pixel
#   read-back (centre / red-packet icon / dark-red line / corner).  When a pixel changes, the draw's identity +
#   both stages' UBO head (32 floats) and the cb+224 matrix window are logged.
#   Two boots: B2 smo_m10a=1 (A scene, 200 s) and B1 smo_m10a=0 (control, 120 s).
#   Switch set BYTE-IDENTICAL to M12A (18 baseline ones + m8b/m8d/m8e2 + m8c=0 + gdump_sec=10 + m10a + m12a=1);
#   the ONLY diff is the new smo_m13a=1.  Emulator only (127.0.0.1:5555); real device 192.168.0.111 untouched.
# usage: bash m13a_boot_run.sh <tag a2|b1> <target 127.0.0.1:5555> [dur=200] [gdump_sec=10]   M10A=0|1
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: bash m8d_boot_run.sh <tag> <target> [dur] [gdump_sec]}"
TGT="${2:?target required (all hdc calls use -t)}"
DUR="${3:-200}"
GD="${4:-10}"
M10A="${M10A:-0}"
M14B="${M14B:-0}"   # M14B: 0 = old behaviour (blend off, probe silent) 1 = probe (+ fix once build #2 lands)   # 0=off(control) 1=force 2=record-only
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"

OUT="$ROOT/logs/m14b_$TAG"

LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"

mkdir -p "$OUT"

h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target $TGT offline"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"
# ---- M9C anti-collision (0/3): record EVERY placeholder in /tmp (ours + any other round's). ----
log "tmp placeholders: $(for f in /tmp/*_building /tmp/m8*_go /tmp/m9*_go; do [ -e "$f" ] && printf '%s@%s ' "$(basename "$f")" "$(stat -f '%Sm' -t '%H:%M:%S' "$f")"; done)"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }

# ---- unlock poll: a successful `aa start` IS the seed start too (the app constructors create
#      files/smo_m7z2, smo_m8b, smo_m8c, smo_m8d on first launch). 10106102 = locked -> do NOT try
#      to unlock, just poll every 15 s (cap 20 min, then BLOCKED per the round rules).
wait_unlock(){
  local n=0 t0=$(date +%s) out
  h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
  while :; do
    n=$((n+1))
    out=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
    local el=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))
    printf '[%s] probe #%d t=%ds %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$n" "$el" "$(echo "$out" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 160)" >> "$OUT/unlock_probe.log"
    case "$out" in
      *10106102*) : ;;
      *"start ability successfully"*|*"successfully"*) log "unlock poll: probe #$n OK at t=${el}s (of cap ${UNLOCK_MAX}s)"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 0 ;;
      *) : ;;
    esac
    [ "$el" -ge "$UNLOCK_MAX" ] && { log "X unlock poll: ${UNLOCK_MAX}s cap reached after $n probes (still 10106102) -> BLOCKED"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 1; }
    sleep 15
  done
}

# ---- M9C anti-collision (1/3): if ANOTHER round already owns the device, do NOT force-stop it.
#      Wait up to 120 s for that pid to go away by itself; if it does not, abort rather than collide.
P0=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
if [ -n "$P0" ]; then
  log "PRE: foreign pid=$P0 already on device -> waiting up to 120 s for it to vanish (NOT force-stopping it)"
  n=0
  while [ "$n" -lt 24 ]; do
    sleep 5; n=$((n+1))
    P0=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -z "$P0" ] && { log "PRE: foreign pid gone after $((n*5))s"; break; }
  done
  if [ -n "$P0" ]; then log "X PRE: pid=$P0 still alive after 120 s -> ABORT (a concurrent round owns the device)"; exit 3; fi
else
  log "PRE: device idle (no pid) -> clean to install"
fi

stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"

if [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ]; then
  wait_unlock || { log "X device stays locked; not booting (per round rules)"; exit 2; }
  log "after unlock poll: pid=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]') files=[$(h shell "ls $FILES/ 2>/dev/null | grep -a smo_ | tr '\n' ' '" | tr -d '\r')]"
  sleep 3
  stopapp || { log "X probe pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
fi

if [ "${SKIP_INSTALL:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  log "install SKIPPED (SKIP_INSTALL=1)"
else
  T0=$(date +%s)
  OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); INST_S=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))
  log "install(${INST_S}s): $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
  UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
  log "upd_after: $UPD1"
  [ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"
fi

# ---- seed start (~7-8 s, NOT counted in the measured boot): hdc cannot CREATE a file inside the
#      app sandbox, so the app constructors must seed smo_m7z2 / smo_m8b / smo_m8c / smo_m8d once.
NEEDSEED=0
for s in smo_m7z2 smo_m8b smo_m8c smo_m8d smo_m8e2 smo_m10a smo_m12a smo_m13a smo_m14b; do
  [ -z "$(h shell "ls $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && NEEDSEED=1
done
if [ "$NEEDSEED" = "1" ]; then
  log "seed start: letting the app constructors create the smo_* files"
  SEEDOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed aa start: $(echo "$SEEDOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  case "$SEEDOUT" in *10106102*) log "X seed aa start blocked: 10106102 (screen locked)"; exit 2;; esac
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  for i in $(seq 1 15); do
    [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m8d 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && break
    sleep 2
  done
  log "seed check: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m8d $FILES/smo_m8b $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr '\n' '|')"
  [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m8d 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] || { log "X smo_m8d absent after seed"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m8e2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] || { log "X smo_m8e2 absent after seed"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X seed pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
else
  log "all smo_* present: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m8d $FILES/smo_m8b $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr '\n' '|')"
fi

# ---- switches: 18 cross-round baselines stay 1 (byte-identical to M8B) + smo_m8d=1 (this round's
#      two binder gates) + smo_m8b=1 (M8B gates 104/105) + smo_m7z2=1 (M7Z2 gates 99..103) ----
for s in smo_m8e2 smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m7g smo_m7r smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7n smo_m7p smo_m7q smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7s2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7z2; do
  h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
for s in smo_m8c smo_gpu_write smo_m7a smo_m7b smo_m7s smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7x smo_m7y smo_m7k smo_m7l smo_m7m smo_m7o smo_frz smo_ldrd smo_aud smo_sha_ungated smo_dspool smo_m7d_same; do
  h shell "[ -f $FILES/$s ] && echo 0 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $GD > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $M10A > $FILES/smo_m10a" >/dev/null 2>&1   # M10A: THE ONLY diff vs M9C switch set
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_m12a" >/dev/null 2>&1      # M12A: quad ledger + tex readback (kept byte-identical to M12A)
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_m13a" >/dev/null 2>&1      # M13A: last round's pixel attribution probe (kept, read-only)
h shell "echo $M14B > $FILES/smo_m14b" >/dev/null 2>&1   # M14B: THIS round's only diff (probe read-only; fix is gated in nvn_vk.c)
RB=$(for s in smo_m8e2 smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m8c smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7v smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7d_same; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
RB="$RB gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n') smo_m10a=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m10a 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n') smo_m12a=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m12a 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n') smo_m13a=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m13a 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n') smo_m14b=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m14b 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"
log "switch readback (pre-boot): $RB"
for s in smo_m8e2 smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r; do
  V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "1" ] || { log "X $s not 1, abort"; exit 1; }
done
V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m8c" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "0" ] || log "!! smo_m8c=$V (expected 0: no injection this round)"

h shell "printf '' > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "log truncated: bytes=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG" | tr -dc '0-9')"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m14b_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m14b_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')

  *10106102*) log "X boot aa start blocked 10106102 -> re-entering unlock poll"
              [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ] && { wait_unlock || { log "X locked again; BLOCKED"; exit 2; }; sleep 3; stopapp; STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r'); } ;;
