```sh
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 4

ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} death_t=${DEATH_T:-none} dur=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

log "faultlog new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"
```

`m19a_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
# M19A (2026-11-08): EMULATOR round -- GATE 118 (main+0x916a28, fn 0x915dfc +0xc2c = the 2D batch
#   processor's "ldr d0,[x8,#0x700]; ldr w8,[x8,#0x708]; str q0,[x19,#0x320]" point):
#   (a) "the channel was never enabled (+0x8b0..b2 flags == 0 => RGB force-zeroed)"  vs
#   (b) "the element-level color itself was fetched as 0".
#   On ONE record we read: st = x8 = [ctx+0x10]  => +0x700/704/708 (RGB source, u32/float/u8),
#   +0x8b0/b1/b2 (the three per-channel "has color" flags); ctx = x1 = x19 => +0x320 (the q0 the gate
#   stores right after); and the FINAL 12-byte color buffer via ctx+0xb8 -> +0x658 descriptor -> 12 B.
#   Switch set BYTE-IDENTICAL to M18A (18 baseline 1s + m8b/m8d/m8e2 + m8c=0 + gdump_sec=10 + m10a +
#   m12a + m13a + m15a + m16a + m17a + m18a + m14b as needed); the ONLY diff is the new smo_m19a=1.
#   Emulator only (127.0.0.1:5555); real device 192.168.0.111 NEVER touched.
# usage: bash m19a_boot_run.sh <tag b0|b1> <target 127.0.0.1:5555> [dur=130] [gdump_sec=10]   M10A=1 M14B=<0|1> M15A=1 M16A=1 M17A=1 M18A=1 M19A=1
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: bash m19a_boot_run.sh <tag> <target> [dur] [gdump_sec]}"
TGT="${2:?target required (all hdc calls use -t)}"
DUR="${3:-130}"   # M15A: 250 s (must cover the permanent-black segment after sub~1536; known: RSS ~2 GB, may die near t~193 s)
GD="${4:-10}"
M10A="${M10A:-1}"
M14B="${M14B:-0}"   # M14B: KEPT 0 this round (M13A/M12A comparability; x30 identity does not depend on blending)
M15A="${M15A:-1}"
M16A="${M16A:-1}"
M19A="${M19A:-1}"   # M19A: THIS round's only diff (gate 118: RGB source + flags + final 12B buffer per batch)
M17A="${M17A:-1}"   # M17A: 0 = gate 115 installed but silent, 1 = per-draw drain ON (the round's only diff)   # M16A: 0 = gate 114 installed but silent, 1 = payload/frequency/x30 histogram ON   # M15A: 0 = gate 113 installed but observer silent, 1 = x30 histogram + per-draw drain ON
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="/tmp/m19a_build/entry.hap"   # M19A: PRIVATE copy (md5 in /tmp/m19a_build/md5.txt), immune to other people rebuilding the tree
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m19a_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
UNLOCK_POLL="${UNLOCK_POLL:-1}"
UNLOCK_MAX="${UNLOCK_MAX:-1200}"        # 20 min cap, per the round rules
KEEP_AWAKE="${KEEP_AWAKE:-1}"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M15A tag=$TAG target=$TGT dur=${DUR}s gdump_sec=$GD out=$OUT unlock_poll=$UNLOCK_POLL(<=${UNLOCK_MAX}s) keep_awake=$KEEP_AWAKE"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target $TGT offline"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"
# ---- M9C anti-collision (0/3): record EVERY placeholder in /tmp (ours + any other round's). ----
log "tmp placeholders: $(for f in /tmp/*_building /tmp/m8*_go /tmp/m9*_go; do [ -e "$f" ] && printf '%s@%s ' "$(basename "$f")" "$(stat -f '%Sm' -t '%H:%M:%S' "$f")"; done)"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }

# ---- unlock poll: a successful `aa start` IS the seed start too (the app constructors create
#      files/smo_m7z2, smo_m8b, smo_m8c, smo_m8d on first launch). 10106102 = locked -> do NOT try
#      to unlock, just poll every 15 s (cap 20 min, then BLOCKED per the round rules).
wait_unlock(){
  local n=0 t0=$(date +%s) out
  h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
  while :; do
    n=$((n+1))
    out=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
    local el=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))
    printf '[%s] probe #%d t=%ds %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$n" "$el" "$(echo "$out" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 160)" >> "$OUT/unlock_probe.log"
    case "$out" in
      *10106102*) : ;;
      *"start ability successfully"*|*"successfully"*) log "unlock poll: probe #$n OK at t=${el}s (of cap ${UNLOCK_MAX}s)"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 0 ;;
      *) : ;;
    esac
    [ "$el" -ge "$UNLOCK_MAX" ] && { log "X unlock poll: ${UNLOCK_MAX}s cap reached after $n probes (still 10106102) -> BLOCKED"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 1; }
    sleep 15
  done
}

# ---- M9C anti-collision (1/3): if ANOTHER round already owns the device, do NOT force-stop it.
#      Wait up to 120 s for that pid to go away by itself; if it does not, abort rather than collide.
P0=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
if [ -n "$P0" ]; then
  log "PRE: foreign pid=$P0 already on device -> waiting up to 120 s for it to vanish (NOT force-stopping it)"
  n=0
  while [ "$n" -lt 24 ]; do
    sleep 5; n=$((n+1))
    P0=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -z "$P0" ] && { log "PRE: foreign pid gone after $((n*5))s"; break; }
  done
  if [ -n "$P0" ]; then log "X PRE: pid=$P0 still alive after 120 s -> ABORT (a concurrent round owns the device)"; exit 3; fi
else
  log "PRE: device idle (no pid) -> clean to install"
fi

stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"

if [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ]; then
  wait_unlock || { log "X device stays locked; not booting (per round rules)"; exit 2; }
  log "after unlock poll: pid=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]') files=[$(h shell "ls $FILES/ 2>/dev/null | grep -a smo_ | tr '\n' ' '" | tr -d '\r')]"
  sleep 3
  stopapp || { log "X probe pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
fi

if [ "${SKIP_INSTALL:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  log "install SKIPPED (SKIP_INSTALL=1)"
else
  T0=$(date +%s)
  OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); INST_S=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))
  log "install(${INST_S}s): $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
  UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
  log "upd_after: $UPD1"
  [ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"
fi

# ---- seed start (~7-8 s, NOT counted in the measured boot): hdc cannot CREATE a file inside the
#      app sandbox, so the app constructors must seed smo_m7z2 / smo_m8b / smo_m8c / smo_m8d once.
NEEDSEED=0
for s in smo_m7z2 smo_m8b smo_m8c smo_m8d smo_m8e2 smo_m10a smo_m12a smo_m13a smo_m14b smo_m15a smo_m16a smo_m17a smo_m19a; do
  [ -z "$(h shell "ls $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && NEEDSEED=1
done
if [ "$NEEDSEED" = "1" ]; then
  log "seed start: letting the app constructors create the smo_* files"
  SEEDOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed aa start: $(echo "$SEEDOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  case "$SEEDOUT" in *10106102*) log "X seed aa start blocked: 10106102 (screen locked)"; exit 2;; esac
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  for i in $(seq 1 15); do
    [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m8d 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && break
    sleep 2
  done
  log "seed check: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m8d $FILES/smo_m8b $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr '\n' '|')"
  [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m8d 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] || { log "X smo_m8d absent after seed"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m8e2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] || { log "X smo_m8e2 absent after seed"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X seed pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
else
  log "all smo_* present: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m8d $FILES/smo_m8b $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr '\n' '|')"
fi

# ---- switches: 18 cross-round baselines stay 1 (byte-identical to M8B) + smo_m8d=1 (this round's
#      two binder gates) + smo_m8b=1 (M8B gates 104/105) + smo_m7z2=1 (M7Z2 gates 99..103) ----
for s in smo_m8e2 smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m7g smo_m7r smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7n smo_m7p smo_m7q smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7s2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7z2; do
  h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
for s in smo_m8c smo_gpu_write smo_m7a smo_m7b smo_m7s smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7x smo_m7y smo_m7k smo_m7l smo_m7m smo_m7o smo_frz smo_ldrd smo_aud smo_sha_ungated smo_dspool smo_m7d_same; do
  h shell "[ -f $FILES/$s ] && echo 0 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $GD > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $M10A > $FILES/smo_m10a" >/dev/null 2>&1   # M10A: THE ONLY diff vs M9C switch set
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_m12a" >/dev/null 2>&1      # M12A: quad ledger + tex readback (kept byte-identical to M12A)
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_m13a" >/dev/null 2>&1      # M13A: last round's pixel attribution probe (kept, read-only)
h shell "echo $M14B > $FILES/smo_m14b" >/dev/null 2>&1   # M14B: KEPT at 0 (comparability with M13A/M12A)
h shell "echo $M15A > $FILES/smo_m15a" >/dev/null 2>&1   # M15A: kept ON (gate 113 = frame-level bind; cheap, 1 hit/frame, keeps cross-round comparability)
h shell "echo $M16A > $FILES/smo_m16a" >/dev/null 2>&1   # M16A: kept ON (gate 114 = per-frame trampoline; cheap, cross-round comparability)
h shell "echo $M17A > $FILES/smo_m17a" >/dev/null 2>&1   # M17A: kept 1 (byte-identical to M17A switch set)
h shell "echo $M19A > $FILES/smo_m19a" >/dev/null 2>&1   # M19A: THIS round's only diff (gate 118 per-batch RGB/flags/final-buffer)
RB=$(for s in smo_m8e2 smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m8c smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7v smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7d_same; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
RB="$RB gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n') smo_m10a=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m10a 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n') smo_m12a=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m12a 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n') smo_m13a=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m13a 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n') smo_m14b=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m14b 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n') smo_m15a=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m15a 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n') smo_m16a=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m16a 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n') smo_m17a=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m17a 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n') smo_m19a=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m19a 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"
log "switch readback (pre-boot): $RB"
for s in smo_m8e2 smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r; do
  V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "1" ] || { log "X $s not 1, abort"; exit 1; }
done
V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m8c" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "0" ] || log "!! smo_m8c=$V (expected 0: no injection this round)"

h shell "printf '' > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "log truncated: bytes=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG" | tr -dc '0-9')"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m19a_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m19a_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
case "$STARTOUT" in
  *10106102*) log "X boot aa start blocked 10106102 -> re-entering unlock poll"
              [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ] && { wait_unlock || { log "X locked again; BLOCKED"; exit 2; }; sleep 3; stopapp; STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r'); } ;;
esac
log "boot aa start: $(echo "$STARTOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
START=$(date +%s); CURPID=""; PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0; LASTWAKE=0; XT_SAVED=""; CONCURRENT=0
# ---- M9C anti-collision (2/3): grab OUR pid, then re-check at t=2 s and t=10 s. A changed pid means
#      somebody else reinstalled/restarted the app under us => this boot is INVALID for conclusions.
MYPID=""
for i in $(seq 1 12); do
  MYPID=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$MYPID" ] && break
  sleep 1
done
log "boot pid (ours) = ${MYPID:-<none>} at t=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"
for T in 2 10; do
  while [ $(( $(date +%s) - START )) -lt "$T" ]; do sleep 1; done
  PN=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ "$PN" != "$MYPID" ]; then
    CONCURRENT=1
    log "X CONCURRENT INTERFERENCE at t=${T}s: pid ${MYPID:-<none>} -> ${PN:-<none>} => boot INVALID"
    break
  fi
  log "pid stable at t=${T}s: $PN (ours)"
done
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"; printf 't\tframes\tsubmit\topens\tdraws\tstall\tm7q_wrap\th5\th7\tg1_site\tg2_hits\tg3_hits\tg4_x8\tg5_x58\tm8d_g106\tm8d_g107\tm8b_g104\tm10a_g108h\tm10a_g108f\tm10a_raw\tm10a_ret\tm10a_g112\n' > "$TSV"
PLAN="30 120 180"
GA(){ grep -a "\[m7u2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
SU(){ grep -a "\[m7z2\] sum$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1; }
F1(){ SU 1 | grep -o 'site_hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F2(){ SU 2 | grep -o ' hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F3(){ SU 3 | grep -o ' hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F4(){ SU 4 | grep -o 'last_x8=[^ ]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F5(){ SU 5 | grep -o 'last_c=[^ ]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
G8D(){ grep -a "\[m8d\] sum$2 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
G8B(){ grep -a "\[m8b\] sum1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
M10ASUM(){ L=$(grep -a "\[m10a\] sum t=" <<<"$RAW" | tail -1); H=$(grep -o 'g108 hits=[0-9]*' <<<"$L" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); F=$(grep -o 'forced=[0-9]*' <<<"$L" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); R=$(grep -o 'last_raw=[^ ]*' <<<"$L" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); T=$(grep -o 'last_ret=[^ ]*' <<<"$L" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); A2=$(grep -o 'g112(A-branch entry) hits=[0-9]*' <<<"$L" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s' "${H:-}" "${F:-}" "${R:-}" "${T:-}" "${A2:-}"; }
GH(){ grep -a "\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  if [ "$KEEP_AWAKE" = "1" ] && [ $(( EL - LASTWAKE )) -ge 10 ]; then
    LASTWAKE=$EL; h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  PP=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$PP" ]; then DEADN=$(( ${DEADN:-0} + 1 )); else DEADN=0; fi
  if [ "${DEADN:-0}" -ge 2 ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> - app died during the boot; stopping this run"
    shot "$EL" "tdeath"
    h shell "ls -t /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null | head -3" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    DEATH_T=$EL; break
  fi
  [ -z "$CURPID" ] && { P="$PP"; [ -n "$P" ] && { CURPID=$P; log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; }; }
  RAW=$(h shell "tail -n 4000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[beat\]|\[st\] t=|\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap|\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=h[57]|\[m7z2\] sum[1-5] |\[m7z2\] lr[1-5] |\[m7z2\] g[1-5] |\[m8b\] sum[12] |\[m8b\] ev |\[m8d\] sum[12] |\[m8d\] lr[12] |\[m8d\] probe|\[m8d\] code|\[m8e2\] sum[1-4] |\[m8e2\] lr[1-4] |\[m8e2\] ev[1-4] |\[m8e2\] probe|\[m8e2\] code|\[m8e2\] judge|\[m10a\] probe|\[m10a\] code|\[m10a\] sum |\[m10a\] judge|\[m15a\] |\[m17a\] |\[m19a\] ' " | tr -d '\r')
  BT=$(grep -a '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  ST=$(grep -a '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  MQ=$(grep -a '\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  MQW=$(grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' <<<"$MQ" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); MQW=${MQW:-}
  H5=$(GH h5); H7=$(GH h7); A=$(F1); B=$(F2); C=$(F3); XT=$(F4); RN=$(F5)
  D1=$(G8D x 1); D2=$(G8D x 2); BB=$(G8B)
  M0=$(M10ASUM); printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${OP:-}" "${DW:-}" "${STALL:-}" "${MQW:-}" "${H5:-}" "${H7:-}" "${A:-}" "${B:-}" "${C:-}" "${XT:-}" "${RN:-}" "${D1:-}" "${D2:-}" "${BB:-}" "$(echo "$M0"|cut -f1)" "$(echo "$M0"|cut -f2)" "$(echo "$M0"|cut -f3)" "$(echo "$M0"|cut -f4)" "$(echo "$M0"|cut -f5)" >> "$TSV"
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 18 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    SL=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m8d\] probe|\[m8d\] code|\[m8d\] sum[12] |\[m8b\] probe|\[m8b\] code|\[m8b\] sum[12] |\[m7z2\] sum[1-5] ' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -40" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s M8D-READBACK: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$SL")"
    GI=$(h shell "grep -a -E 'obs gate main\+0x(6c7750|4b8d30|4b8cb0|4b7380)|obs gate main\+0x(4b8ea4|4b8e20|4b8e88)' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -12; echo NOTINST=$(grep -a -c 'NOT installed' $LOG 2>/dev/null)" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s gate-install lines: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$GI")"
    RB2=$(for s in smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m8c smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7h smo_m17a smo_m19a; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
    log "t=${EL}s switch readback (in-boot): $RB2"
  fi
  if [ $(( EL % 20 )) -lt 3 ]; then log "t=${EL}s frames=${FR:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?} stall=${STALL:-?} m7q_wrap=${MQW:-?} h5=${H5:-?} h7=${H7:-?} g1_site=${A:-?} g2_hits=${B:-?} g3_hits=${C:-?} g4_x8=${XT:-?} g5_x58=${RN:-?} g106=${D1:-?} g107=${D2:-?} g104=${BB:-?}"; fi
  for T in $PLAN; do if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi; done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 4
done
shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} death_t=${DEATH_T:-none} dur=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done
DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  for K in st beat m7y2 m7x2 m7w2 m7u2 m7t2 m7s2 m7q gst; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  grep -a 'obs gate' "$DL" > "$OUT/gates_install.txt" 2>/dev/null
  log "gate install lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/gates_install.txt" | tr -d ' ') NOTINST=$(grep -ac 'NOT installed' "$DL" || true)"
  log "gate113 install: $(grep -a 'obs gate main+0x988a20' "$DL" | tr -d '\r' | head -2 | tr '\n' '|')"
  log "gate115 install: $(grep -a 'obs gate main+0x98b4b0' "$DL" | tr -d '\r' | head -2 | tr '\n' '|')"
  for K in m8b m8d m7z2 m8e2 m10a; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  grep -a "\[m13a\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/m13a_lines.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[m13a] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m13a_lines.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[m14b\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/m14b_lines.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[m14b] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m14b_lines.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[m15a\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/m15a_lines.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[m15a] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m15a_lines.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[m15a\] sum " "$DL" > "$OUT/m15a_sum.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[m15a] sum lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m15a_sum.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[m15a\] d " "$DL" > "$OUT/m15a_draws.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[m15a] draw lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m15a_draws.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[m15a\] h #" "$DL" > "$OUT/m15a_hist.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[m15a] hist lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m15a_hist.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "m15a last sum: $(grep -a "\[m15a\] sum t=" "$DL" | tail -1)"
  grep -a "\[m16a\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/m16a_lines.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[m16a] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m16a_lines.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[m16a\] sum " "$DL" > "$OUT/m16a_sum.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[m16a] sum lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m16a_sum.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[m16a\] h #" "$DL" > "$OUT/m16a_hist.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[m16a] hist lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m16a_hist.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[m16a\] nm \|\[m16a\] obj " "$DL" > "$OUT/m16a_nm.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[m16a] nm lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m16a_nm.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "m16a last sum: $(grep -a "\[m16a\] sum t=" "$DL" | tail -1)"
  grep -a "\[m17a\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/m17a_lines.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[m17a] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m17a_lines.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[m17a\] sum " "$DL" > "$OUT/m17a_sum.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[m17a] sum lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m17a_sum.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[m17a\] h #" "$DL" > "$OUT/m17a_hist.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[m17a] hist lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m17a_hist.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "m17a last sum: $(grep -a "\[m17a\] sum t=" "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "m17a probe: $(grep -a "\[m17a\] probe" "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "m17a gate install: $(grep -a 'obs gate main+0x98b4b0' "$DL" | tr -d '\r' | head -2 | tr '\n' '|')"
```

`m20a_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
# M20A (2026-11-08): EMULATOR round -- INPUT CHAIN (why a pressed key never advances the game).
#   Picture is already up (m14b=1 -> title menu recognizable). Input never worked: M8A injected A x20 +
#   four directions (t=20 s on) through `smo_testkey`, the channel logged "live now", and NOTHING moved.
#   This round asks the four things that matter, with ZERO new gates (no door number used at all):
#     P4 what our press writes into (keys[]/pending -> NpadState -> the guest's own buffer)
#     P5 did the guest read it: not-read / read-0 / read-and-ignored (the [m20a] probe decides)
#     P6 same-tick table: our set bits vs the bits the guest received, per read, with latency in ms
#     P7 did anything advance: scene ctor family (h7/h8/h9), draws/frames shape, 3+ screenshots
#   Press producer: `smo_m6q_sched` (absolute timeline, 3 s hold every 5 s from 15 s to 110 s) so a
#   press cannot fall between two HID polls; `smo_testkey`=0 (one producer only), `smo_teststick`=0
#   (an A-only pad, so "the scene ignored A" cannot be confused with stick-direction bits).
#   Switch set = M19A base with m14b=1 + m10a=0 (normal title path) + this round's probe.
#   Emulator only (127.0.0.1:5555); real device 192.168.0.111 NEVER touched.
# usage: bash m20a_boot_run.sh <tag b0|b1> <target 127.0.0.1:5555> [dur=125] [gdump_sec=10]
set -uo pipefail

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }

# ---- unlock poll: a successful `aa start` IS the seed start too (the app constructors create
#      files/smo_m7z2, smo_m8b, smo_m8c, smo_m8d on first launch). 10106102 = locked -> do NOT try
#      to unlock, just poll every 15 s (cap 20 min, then BLOCKED per the round rules).
wait_unlock(){
  local n=0 t0=$(date +%s) out
  h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
  while :; do
    n=$((n+1))
    out=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
    local el=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))
    printf '[%s] probe #%d t=%ds %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$n" "$el" "$(echo "$out" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 160)" >> "$OUT/unlock_probe.log"
    case "$out" in
      *10106102*) : ;;
      *"start ability successfully"*|*"successfully"*) log "unlock poll: probe #$n OK at t=${el}s (of cap ${UNLOCK_MAX}s)"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 0 ;;
      *) : ;;
    esac
    [ "$el" -ge "$UNLOCK_MAX" ] && { log "X unlock poll: ${UNLOCK_MAX}s cap reached after $n probes (still 10106102) -> BLOCKED"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 1; }
    sleep 15
  done
}

# ---- M9C anti-collision (1/3): if ANOTHER round already owns the device, do NOT force-stop it.
#      Wait up to 120 s for that pid to go away by itself; if it does not, abort rather than collide.

  n=0
  while [ "$n" -lt 24 ]; do
    sleep 5; n=$((n+1))
    P0=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -z "$P0" ] && { log "PRE: foreign pid gone after $((n*5))s"; break; }
  done
  if [ -n "$P0" ]; then log "X PRE: pid=$P0 still alive after 120 s -> ABORT (a concurrent round owns the device)"; exit 3; fi

  log "PRE: device idle (no pid) -> clean to install"

shot(){
  local k
  for k in 1 2 3; do
    h shell "rm -f /data/local/tmp/m20a_$TAG$2.jpeg; snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m20a_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
    h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m20a_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
    [ -s "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" ] && break
    log "shot retry $k for $2"
    sleep 2
  done
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')

  *10106102*) log "X boot aa start blocked 10106102 -> re-entering unlock poll"
              [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ] && { wait_unlock || { log "X locked again; BLOCKED"; exit 2; }; sleep 3; stopapp; STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r'); } ;;

#      somebody else reinstalled/restarted the app under us => this boot is INVALID for conclusions.

  MYPID=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$MYPID" ] && break
  sleep 1

  while [ $(( $(date +%s) - START )) -lt "$T" ]; do sleep 1; done

    CONCURRENT=1
    log "X CONCURRENT INTERFERENCE at t=${T}s: pid ${MYPID:-<none>} -> ${PN:-<none>} => boot INVALID"
    break
  fi
  log "pid stable at t=${T}s: $PN (ours)"

F4(){ SU 4 | grep -o 'last_x8=[^ ]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F5(){ SU 5 | grep -o 'last_c=[^ ]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }

G8B(){ grep -a "\[m8b\] sum1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }

GH(){ grep -a "\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  if [ "$KEEP_AWAKE" = "1" ] && [ $(( EL - LASTWAKE )) -ge 10 ]; then

  fi
  PP=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$PP" ]; then DEADN=$(( ${DEADN:-0} + 1 )); else DEADN=0; fi

  BT=$(grep -a '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  ST=$(grep -a '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  MQ=$(grep -a '\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  MQW=$(grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' <<<"$MQ" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); MQW=${MQW:-}
  H5=$(GH h5); H7=$(GH h7); A=$(F1); B=$(F2); C=$(F3); XT=$(F4); RN=$(F5)
  D1=$(G8D x 1); D2=$(G8D x 2); BB=$(G8B)
  H8=$(GH h8); H9=$(GH h9); M20=$(M20ASUM)
  M0=$(M10ASUM); printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${OP:-}" "${DW:-}" "${STALL:-}" "${MQW:-}" "${H5:-}" "${H7:-}" "${H8:-}" "${H9:-}" "$(echo "$M20"|cut -f1)" "$(echo "$M20"|cut -f2)" "$(echo "$M20"|cut -f3)" "${A:-}" "${B:-}" "${C:-}" "${XT:-}" "${RN:-}" "${D1:-}" "${D2:-}" "${BB:-}" "$(echo "$M0"|cut -f1)" "$(echo "$M0"|cut -f2)" "$(echo "$M0"|cut -f3)" "$(echo "$M0"|cut -f4)" "$(echo "$M0"|cut -f5)" >> "$TSV"
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 18 ]; then

  for T in $PLAN; do if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi; done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 4
done
```

`m21a_an.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""M21A boot digest: one compact block per logs/m21a_<tag> directory.
Reads only files the run script already produced (no device access)."""
import sys, os, re, glob, hashlib

def read(p):
    try:
        return open(p, 'rb').read().decode('utf-8', 'replace')
    except Exception:
        return ''

def digest(d):
    out = []
    tsv = read(os.path.join(d, 'series.tsv')).strip().splitlines()
    rows = []
    for line in tsv[1:]:
        c = line.split('\t')
        if len(c) < 15: continue
        rows.append(dict(t=c[0], frames=c[1], submit=c[2], opens=c[3], draws=c[4], stall=c[5],
                         cpu=c[6], rss=c[7], h5=c[8], h6=c[9], h7=c[10], alive=c[14]))
    out.append(f"== {d}")
    if rows:
        t0, tl = rows[0], rows[-1]
        def num(v):
            try: return float(v)
            except Exception: return None
        # frames growth windows / stalls
        stalls = [(r['t'], r['stall']) for r in rows if num(r['stall']) and num(r['stall']) >= 7]
        out.append(f"window t={t0['t']}..{tl['t']}s  frames {t0['frames']}->{tl['frames']}  opens {t0['opens']}->{tl['opens']}  draws {t0['draws']}->{tl['draws']}")
        out.append(f"alive_last={tl['alive']}  maxRSS={max((num(r['rss']) or 0) for r in rows):.0f}MB  stall_samples={len(stalls)}")
        # compress curve: every ~20 s + opens changes
        lasto = None
        pts = []
        for r in rows:
            try: t = int(r['t'])
            except Exception: continue
            if t % 20 < 5 or r['opens'] != lasto:
                pts.append(f"t{r['t']}:f{r['frames']}/o{r['opens']}/d{r['draws']}/st{r['stall']}/rss{r['rss']}")
                lasto = r['opens']
        out.append("curve " + " ".join(pts))
    lg = read(os.path.join(d, 'run.log'))
    m = re.search(r'death_t=(\S+) dur=(\S+)', lg)
    if m: out.append(f"run.log death_t={m.group(1)} dur={m.group(2)}")
    for k, pat in (('periodic dumps [probe]', r'\[probe\] dump lines=(\d+)'),
                   ('[load] lines', r'\[load\] lines=(\d+)'),
                   ('[frz]', r'\[frz\] lines=(\d+)'),
                   ('[hang]', r'\[hang\] lines=(\d+)'),
                   ('[gst]', r'\[gst\] lines=(\d+)'),
                   ('faultlog new', r'faultlog new=(\d+)'),
                   ('concurrent', r'concurrent_interference=(\S+)')):
        mm = re.search(pat, lg)
        out.append(f"{k}={mm.group(1) if mm else '?'}")
    # last beat / last st
    b = read(os.path.join(d, 'beat.txt')).strip().splitlines()
    if b: out.append("last beat: " + b[-1][:200])
    s = read(os.path.join(d, 'st.txt')).strip().splitlines()
    if s: out.append("last st: " + s[-1][:260])
    # opens rate from [st] t= lines
    st = read(os.path.join(d, 'st.txt'))
    pairs = [(int(t), int(o)) for t, o in re.findall(r'\[st\] t=(\d+)s opens=(\d+)', st)]
    if len(pairs) >= 2:
        rates = []
        prev = None
        for t, o in pairs:
            if prev:
                dt = t - prev[0]
                if dt > 0: rates.append((t, dt, o - prev[1], round((o - prev[1]) / dt, 2)))
            prev = (t, o)
        out.append("opens rate (t,dt,dopens,per_s): " + " ".join(f"t{t}:{d}/+{do}={r}" for t, d, do, r in rates))
    # thread tables from [gst]
    g = read(os.path.join(d, 'gst.txt'))
    if g:
        blocks, cur = [], []
        for line in g.splitlines():
            if '[gst] threads=' in line:
                if cur: blocks.append(cur)
                cur = [line]
            elif cur: cur.append(line)
        if cur: blocks.append(cur)
        out.append(f"[gst] blocks={len(blocks)}")
        for blk in blocks[:6]:
            hdr = blk[0]
            ts = hdr.split()[0]
            summ = re.search(r'threads=(\d+) exited=(\d+) run=(\d+) lock=(\d+) cond=(\d+) addr=(\d+) sync=(\d+)', hdr)
            out.append(f"  block@{ts} " + (summ.group(0) if summ else ''))
            for line in blk[1:]:
                if ' h=0x1001 ' in line:
                    mm = re.search(r'wk=(\d+) wa=(\S+) key=(\S+) wh=(\S+) nwh=(\d+) svc=(\S+) nsvc=(\d+) lr=(\S+) who=(\S+)', line)
                    out.append("    main: " + (mm.group(0) if mm else line[:160]))
                    break
    # death fault
    fx = [l for l in read(os.path.join(d, 'vk_boot.log')).splitlines() if '[fx] FAULT' in l]
    if fx: out.append("death: " + fx[-1][:220])
    # screenshots
    shots = []
    for p in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(d, 'screen_*.png'))):
        try:
            md5 = hashlib.md5(open(p, 'rb').read()).hexdigest()[:16]
            sz = os.path.getsize(p)
            shots.append(f"{os.path.basename(p)}:{md5}:{sz}")
        except Exception: pass
    out.append("shots " + " ".join(shots))
    return "\n".join(out)

for d in sys.argv[1:]:
    print(digest(d)); print()

```

`m21a_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
# M21A (2026-11-08): EMULATOR round -- LET THE PROCESS SURVIVE THE LOAD.
#   Facts carried in (M20A/M16B): input is good (set==seen, miss=0, 35-90 ms); pressing A really drives
#   the game (h5/h6 first ctor, romfs opens +499/3s, title -> white + red curtain); THEN `frames` freezes
#   at 1572/1954 while main_wk=1, and the process renders-stalls near t~124 s and dies SIGSEGV@0 near t~148 s.
#   This round asks ONE question first: is the stall the periodic dump/readback instrumentation?
#     ★ the only substantive variable = smo_gdump_sec 10 -> 0 (periodic [probe]/[load]/[gst]/[svc]/[io] dump OFF)
#   Zero builds, zero gates (no door number used): everything is a file-driven switch + the already-built
#   M20A hap. Thread evidence comes from the ALREADY-DEFAULT host watchdog (TOTK_HANG_DUMP_SECS default 60:
#   runtime_dump_threads() at t~60/120/180/240 s -> stderr -> GameHost hilog, tag "A00000/GameHost"), captured
#   with `hilog -x -P <pid>` snapshots ~3 s after each dump. No new switch file, no new stub.
#   Press timeline moved to t=40 s on (out of the black segment and out of the HID-stall segment), one A
#   every 5 s, 3 s hold, through t=215 s.
#   Emulator only (127.0.0.1:5555); real device 192.168.0.111 NEVER touched.
# usage: bash m21a_boot_run.sh <tag b0|b1> <target 127.0.0.1:5555> [dur=250] [gdump_sec=0]
set -uo pipefail

M10A="${M10A:-0}"
M14B="${M14B:-1}"
M15A="${M15A:-1}"
M16A="${M16A:-1}"
M17A="${M17A:-1}"
M18A="${M18A:-1}"
M19A="${M19A:-1}"

mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M21A tag=$TAG target=$TGT dur=${DUR}s gdump_sec=$GD m12a=$M12A m13a=$M13A m15a=$M15A m16a=$M16A m17a=$M17A m18a=$M18A m19a=$M19A m20a=$M20A out=$OUT skip_install=$SKIP_INSTALL"

log "tmp placeholders: $(for f in /tmp/*_building /tmp/m21*_go /tmp/m20*_go; do [ -e "$f" ] && printf '%s@%s ' "$(basename "$f")" "$(stat -f '%Sm' -t '%H:%M:%S' "$f")"; done)"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }

wait_unlock(){
  local n=0 t0=$(date +%s) out
  h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
  while :; do
    n=$((n+1))
    out=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
    local el=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))
    printf '[%s] probe #%d t=%ds %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$n" "$el" "$(echo "$out" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 160)" >> "$OUT/unlock_probe.log"
    case "$out" in
      *10106102*) : ;;
      *"start ability successfully"*|*"successfully"*) log "unlock poll: probe #$n OK at t=${el}s"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 0 ;;
      *) : ;;
    esac
    [ "$el" -ge "$UNLOCK_MAX" ] && { log "X unlock poll: cap ${UNLOCK_MAX}s after $n probes -> BLOCKED"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 1; }
    sleep 15
  done
}

P0=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
if [ -n "$P0" ]; then
  log "PRE: foreign pid=$P0 on device -> waiting up to 120 s for it to vanish (NOT force-stopping)"
  n=0
  while [ "$n" -lt 24 ]; do
    sleep 5; n=$((n+1))
    P0=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -z "$P0" ] && { log "PRE: foreign pid gone after $((n*5))s"; break; }
  done
  [ -n "$P0" ] && { log "X PRE: pid=$P0 still alive -> ABORT (concurrent round owns the device)"; exit 3; }
else
  log "PRE: device idle (no pid) -> clean"
fi
stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)

if [ "$SKIP_INSTALL" = "1" ]; then
  log "install SKIPPED (SKIP_INSTALL=1): reusing the M20A hap already on the device (md5 538c53d87af20f08c9ce433018fba75d)"
else
  T0=$(date +%s)
  OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); INST_S=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))
  log "install(${INST_S}s): $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
  UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
  log "upd_after: $UPD1"
fi

NEEDSEED=0
for s in smo_m7z2 smo_m8b smo_m8c smo_m8d smo_m8e2 smo_m10a smo_m12a smo_m13a smo_m14b smo_m15a smo_m16a smo_m17a smo_m18a smo_m19a smo_m20a smo_m6q_sched smo_testkey smo_teststick smo_gdump_sec; do
  [ -z "$(h shell "ls $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && NEEDSEED=1
done
if [ "$NEEDSEED" = "1" ]; then
  log "seed start: letting the app constructors create the smo_* files"
  SEEDOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed aa start: $(echo "$SEEDOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  case "$SEEDOUT" in *10106102*) log "X seed aa start blocked: 10106102 (locked)"; exit 2;; esac
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  for i in $(seq 1 15); do
    [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m8d 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && break
    sleep 2
  done
  [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m8d 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] || { log "X smo_m8d absent after seed"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X seed pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
else
  log "all smo_* present"
fi

# ---- switch set: M20A baseline, byte-identical EXCEPT smo_gdump_sec (10 -> 0) and the press timeline ----
for s in smo_m8e2 smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m7g smo_m7r smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7n smo_m7p smo_m7q smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7s2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7z2; do

for s in smo_m8c smo_gpu_write smo_m7a smo_m7b smo_m7s smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7x smo_m7y smo_m7k smo_m7l smo_m7m smo_m7o smo_frz smo_ldrd smo_aud smo_sha_ungated smo_dspool smo_m7d_same; do
  h shell "[ -f $FILES/$s ] && echo 0 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot" >/dev/null 2>&1

h shell "echo $M12A > $FILES/smo_m12a" >/dev/null 2>&1

h shell "echo $M14B > $FILES/smo_m14b" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $M15A > $FILES/smo_m15a" >/dev/null 2>&1

RB=$(for s in smo_m8e2 smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m8c smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
RB2A=$(for s in smo_m12a smo_m13a smo_m15a smo_m16a smo_m17a smo_m18a smo_m19a smo_m20a; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
log "probe switches: $RB2A"
RB="$RB gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n') smo_m10a=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m10a 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n') smo_m12a=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m12a 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n') smo_m13a=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m13a 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n') smo_m14b=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m14b 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n') smo_m15a=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m15a 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n') smo_m16a=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m16a 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n') smo_m17a=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m17a 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n') smo_m18a=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m18a 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n') smo_m19a=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m19a 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n') smo_m20a=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m20a 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n') smo_testkey=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n') smo_teststick=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"
log "switch readback (pre-boot): $RB"
log "m6q sched readback: $(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m6q_sched" | tr -d '\r\n')"
for s in smo_m8e2 smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r; do
  V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "1" ] || { log "X $s not 1, abort"; exit 1; }

h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

shot(){
  local k
  for k in 1 2 3; do
    h shell "rm -f /data/local/tmp/m21a_$TAG$2.jpeg; snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m21a_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
    h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m21a_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
    [ -s "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" ] && break
    log "shot retry $k for $2"
    sleep 2
  done
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

# thread evidence: the host watchdog (TOTK_HANG_DUMP_SECS default 60) dumps at ~60/120/180/240 s; this
# snapshot grabs everything the app printed to hilog since the last clear, tagged + pid-filtered.
hilog_snap(){
  local tag="$1"
  h shell "hilog -x -P ${MYPID:-0} 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'totk-dump|hang watchdog|freeze|CRASH|SIGSEGV|stub' | tail -400" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_$tag.txt" 2>/dev/null
  local n=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_$tag.txt" | tr -d ' ')
  if [ "${n:-0}" -ge 400 ]; then :; fi
  log "hilog_$tag lines=$n dumps=$(grep -ac 'totk-dump' "$OUT/hilog_$tag.txt" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
}

STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
case "$STARTOUT" in
  *10106102*) log "X boot aa start blocked 10106102 -> unlock poll"
              [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ] && { wait_unlock || { log "X locked again; BLOCKED"; exit 2; }; sleep 3; stopapp; STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r'); } ;;
esac
log "boot aa start: $(echo "$STARTOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
START=$(date +%s); CURPID=""; PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0; LASTWAKE=0; CONCURRENT=0; DEATH_T=""
MYPID=""
for i in $(seq 1 12); do
  MYPID=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$MYPID" ] && break
  sleep 1
done
log "boot pid (ours) = ${MYPID:-<none>} at t=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"
for T in 2 10; do
  while [ $(( $(date +%s) - START )) -lt "$T" ]; do sleep 1; done
  PN=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ "$PN" != "$MYPID" ]; then
    CONCURRENT=1
    log "X CONCURRENT INTERFERENCE at t=${T}s: pid ${MYPID:-<none>} -> ${PN:-<none>} => boot INVALID"
    break
  fi
  log "pid stable at t=${T}s: $PN (ours)"
done
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"; printf 't\tframes\tsubmit\topens\tdraws\tstall\tcpu\trss_mb\th5\th6\th7\tm20a_full\tm20a_set\tm20a_hit\talive\n' > "$TSV"
PLAN="40 60 90 120 150 165 180 195 210 225 240"
HSNAP="63 93 123 153 183 213 243"
GA(){ grep -a "\[m7u2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
GH(){ grep -a "\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
M20ASUM(){ L=$(grep -a "\[m20a\] sum t=" <<<"$RAW" | tail -1); printf '%s\t%s\t%s' "$(grep -o 'n_full=[0-9]*' <<<"$L"|head -1|cut -d= -f2)" "$(grep -o ' set=[0-9]*' <<<"$L"|head -1|cut -d= -f2)" "$(grep -o 'hit=[0-9]*' <<<"$L"|head -1|cut -d= -f2)"; }
open_log(){ h shell "tail -n 6000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[beat\]|\[st\] t=|\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap|\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=h[5-9]|\[m20a\] |\[hang\]|\[probe\] dump|\[load\]|\[frz\]|\[mem\]|\[gst\]' " | tr -d '\r'; }
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  if [ "$KEEP_AWAKE" = "1" ] && [ $(( EL - LASTWAKE )) -ge 10 ]; then
    LASTWAKE=$EL; h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  PP=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$PP" ]; then DEADN=$(( ${DEADN:-0} + 1 )); else DEADN=0; fi
  if [ "${DEADN:-0}" -ge 2 ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> - app died during the boot"
    shot "$EL" "tdeath"
    hilog_snap "death_${EL}s"
    h shell "ls -t /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null | head -3" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    DEATH_T=$EL; break
  fi
  [ -z "$CURPID" ] && { P="$PP"; [ -n "$P" ] && { CURPID=$P; log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; }; }
  RAW=$(open_log)
  BT=$(grep -a '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  ST=$(grep -a '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  CPU=$(grep -o ' cpu=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); CPU=${CPU:-}
  RSS=$(grep -o 'rss=[0-9-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); RSS=${RSS:-}
  RSSM=$([ -n "${RSS:-}" ] && [ "${RSS:-0}" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null && echo $(( RSS / 1024 )) || echo "")
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  H5=$(GH h5); H6=$(GH h6); H7=$(GH h7); M20=$(M20ASUM)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${OP:-}" "${DW:-}" "${STALL:-}" "${CPU:-}" "${RSSM:-}" "${H5:-}" "${H6:-}" "${H7:-}" "$(echo "$M20"|cut -f1)" "$(echo "$M20"|cut -f2)" "$(echo "$M20"|cut -f3)" "${PP:-dead}" >> "$TSV"
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 18 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    RB2=$(for s in smo_gdump_sec smo_m10a smo_m14b smo_m15a smo_m16a smo_m17a smo_m18a smo_m19a smo_m20a smo_testkey smo_teststick; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
    log "t=${EL}s switch readback (in-boot): $RB2"
    log "t=${EL}s m6q sched: $(grep -a '\[i\] m6q sched' <<<"$RAW" | head -1 | tail -c 200)"
  fi
  if [ $(( EL % 20 )) -lt 3 ]; then log "t=${EL}s frames=${FR:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?} stall=${STALL:-?} cpu=${CPU:-?} rss=${RSSM:-?}MB h5=${H5:-?} h6=${H6:-?} h7=${H7:-?} m20a=$(echo "$M20"|tr '\t' '/')"; fi
  for T in $HSNAP; do
    if [ "${LASTHS:-0}" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTHS=$T; hilog_snap "t$T"; fi
  done
  for T in $PLAN; do if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi; done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 4
done
shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} death_t=${DEATH_T:-none} dur=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done
DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[beat\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/beat.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[beat] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/beat.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[st\] t=" "$DL" > "$OUT/st.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[st] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/st.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[st\] CHANGE" "$DL" > "$OUT/st_change.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[st] CHANGE lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/st_change.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[hang\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/hang.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[hang] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hang.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[probe\] dump" "$DL" > "$OUT/probe_dump.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[probe] dump lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/probe_dump.txt" | tr -d ' ') (EXPECT 0 periodic)"
  grep -a "\[load\] io\|\[load\] frame" "$DL" > "$OUT/load.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[load] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/load.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[gst\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/gst.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[gst] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/gst.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[frz\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/frz.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[frz] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/frz.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[mem\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/mem.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[mem] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/mem.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[m20a\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/m20a.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[m20a] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m20a.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[i\] m6q sched" "$DL" > "$OUT/m6q_sched.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[m6q] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m6q_sched.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[m7t2\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/m7t2.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[m7t2] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m7t2.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "last beat: $(grep -a '\[beat\]' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "last st: $(grep -a '\[st\] t=' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "m20a last sum: $(grep -a "\[m20a\] sum t=" "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "h5/h6 first: $(grep -a 'first' "$DL" | grep -a 'g=h[56]' | tail -2 | tr '\n' '|')"
  log "sched first/last: $(grep -a 'm6q sched key=38' "$DL" | head -1 | tail -c 120) / $(grep -a 'm6q sched key=38' "$DL" | tail -1 | tail -c 120)"
fi
# faultlog detail for the newest entry
NEW=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep . | tail -1)
if [ -n "${NEW:-}" ]; then

  h file recv "/data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/$NEW" "$OUT/faultlog_new.txt" >/dev/null 2>&1
  [ -s "$OUT/faultlog_new.txt" ] && log "faultlog head: $(head -25 "$OUT/faultlog_new.txt" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 1200)"
fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG unlock_probes=${UNLOCK_N:-0} concurrent_interference=${CONCURRENT:-?}"
```

```sh
# M23B (2026-11-08): WHY DOES draw_flush HOLD THE GUEST LOCK FOR 46-48 s? (emulator line)
#   Carried in (M21A): the guest mutex owner thread h=0x1004 stalls 46-48 s in t~92->140; main waits on
#   svc 0x1a ArbitrateLock; 0x1004's phase ring sits in draw_flush (op=31) with wk=0 (running, not waiting).
#   M21A could not say WHERE inside draw_flush the time went, nor distinguish:
#     H1 one-off heavy work in the lock (shader compile / vkCreateGraphicsPipelines / SwiftShader JIT)
#     H2 host memory pressure (RSS peak 3.28 GB, rt_slots=256/256 + LRU eviction => paging/thrash)
#     H3 not slow at all but waiting on another sync object (fence / queue / worker threads)
#   THIS ROUND: one build adds switch smo_m23b (C default 0) that timestamps draw_flush in 8 segments
#   (pre/sub/wait/gy/sig/scan/p2/rb) and records, per slow flush, rss+rt_slots, pipeline/shader creation
#   deltas (H1), minflt/majflt + /proc/self/io bytes (H2), nvcsw/nivcsw (H3). Off => behaviour unchanged.
#   Switch set = M21A b2 baseline (gdump_sec=0 + m17a=0) with ONLY smo_m23b added as the new variable.
#   NO door used (instrumentation is entirely host-side) => door 119 stays unoccupied.
#   Emulator only (127.0.0.1:5555); real device 192.168.0.111 NEVER touched. No `hdc kill`.
# usage: bash m23b_boot_run.sh <tag b0> <target 127.0.0.1:5555> [dur=220] [gdump_sec=0]
set -uo pipefail

wait_unlock(){
  local n=0 t0=$(date +%s) out
  h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
  while :; do
    n=$((n+1))
    out=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
    local el=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))
    printf '[%s] probe #%d t=%ds %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$n" "$el" "$(echo "$out" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 160)" >> "$OUT/unlock_probe.log"
    case "$out" in
      *10106102*) : ;;
      *"start ability successfully"*|*"successfully"*) log "unlock poll: probe #$n OK at t=${el}s"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 0 ;;
      *) : ;;
    esac
    [ "$el" -ge "$UNLOCK_MAX" ] && { log "X unlock poll: cap ${UNLOCK_MAX}s after $n probes -> BLOCKED"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 1; }
    sleep 15
  done
}

shot(){
  local k
  for k in 1 2 3; do
    h shell "rm -f /data/local/tmp/m23b_$TAG$2.jpeg; snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m23b_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
    h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m23b_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
    [ -s "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" ] && break
    log "shot retry $k for $2"
    sleep 2
  done
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

# thread evidence: the host watchdog (TOTK_HANG_DUMP_SECS default 60) dumps at ~60/120/180/240 s; this
# snapshot grabs everything the app printed to hilog since the last clear, tagged + pid-filtered.
hilog_snap(){
  local tag="$1"
  h shell "hilog -x -P ${MYPID:-0} 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'totk-dump|hang watchdog|freeze|CRASH|SIGSEGV|stub' | tail -400" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_$tag.txt" 2>/dev/null
  local n=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_$tag.txt" | tr -d ' ')
  if [ "${n:-0}" -ge 400 ]; then :; fi
  log "hilog_$tag lines=$n dumps=$(grep -ac 'totk-dump' "$OUT/hilog_$tag.txt" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
}
```

```sh
#   Carried in from M23B: the 46-48 s freeze is ~2200 "submit -> wait 240 s soft-raster fence"

wait_unlock(){
  local n=0 t0=$(date +%s) out
  h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
  while :; do
    n=$((n+1))
    out=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
    local el=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))
    printf '[%s] probe #%d t=%ds %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$n" "$el" "$(echo "$out" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 160)" >> "$OUT/unlock_probe.log"
    case "$out" in
      *10106102*) : ;;
      *"start ability successfully"*|*"successfully"*) log "unlock poll: probe #$n OK at t=${el}s"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 0 ;;
      *) : ;;
    esac
    [ "$el" -ge "$UNLOCK_MAX" ] && { log "X unlock poll: cap ${UNLOCK_MAX}s after $n probes -> BLOCKED"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 1; }
    sleep 15
  done

shot(){
  local k
  for k in 1 2 3; do
    h shell "rm -f /data/local/tmp/m25a_$TAG$2.jpeg; snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m25a_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
    h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m25a_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
    [ -s "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" ] && break
    log "shot retry $k for $2"
    sleep 2
  done
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

# thread evidence: the host watchdog (TOTK_HANG_DUMP_SECS default 60) dumps at ~60/120/180/240 s; this
# snapshot grabs everything the app printed to hilog since the last clear, tagged + pid-filtered.
hilog_snap(){
  local tag="$1"
  h shell "hilog -x -P ${MYPID:-0} 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'totk-dump|hang watchdog|freeze|CRASH|SIGSEGV|stub' | tail -400" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_$tag.txt" 2>/dev/null
  local n=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_$tag.txt" | tr -d ' ')
  if [ "${n:-0}" -ge 400 ]; then :; fi
  log "hilog_$tag lines=$n dumps=$(grep -ac 'totk-dump' "$OUT/hilog_$tag.txt" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
}

STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
case "$STARTOUT" in
  *10106102*) log "X boot aa start blocked 10106102 -> unlock poll"
              [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ] && { wait_unlock || { log "X locked again; BLOCKED"; exit 2; }; sleep 3; stopapp; STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r'); } ;;
esac
log "boot aa start: $(echo "$STARTOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
START=$(date +%s); CURPID=""; PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0; LASTWAKE=0; CONCURRENT=0; DEATH_T=""
MYPID=""
for i in $(seq 1 12); do
  MYPID=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$MYPID" ] && break
  sleep 1
done
log "boot pid (ours) = ${MYPID:-<none>} at t=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"
for T in 2 10; do
  while [ $(( $(date +%s) - START )) -lt "$T" ]; do sleep 1; done
  PN=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ "$PN" != "$MYPID" ]; then
    CONCURRENT=1
    log "X CONCURRENT INTERFERENCE at t=${T}s: pid ${MYPID:-<none>} -> ${PN:-<none>} => boot INVALID"
    break
  fi
  log "pid stable at t=${T}s: $PN (ours)"
done
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"; printf 't\tframes\tsubmit\topens\tdraws\tstall\tcpu\trss_mb\th5\th6\th7\tm20a_full\tm20a_set\tm20a_hit\talive\n' > "$TSV"
PLAN="15 30 45 60 75 90 105 120 135 150 165 180 195 210"
HSNAP="63 93 123 153 183 213 243"
GA(){ grep -a "\[m7u2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
GH(){ grep -a "\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
M20ASUM(){ L=$(grep -a "\[m20a\] sum t=" <<<"$RAW" | tail -1); printf '%s\t%s\t%s' "$(grep -o 'n_full=[0-9]*' <<<"$L"|head -1|cut -d= -f2)" "$(grep -o ' set=[0-9]*' <<<"$L"|head -1|cut -d= -f2)" "$(grep -o 'hit=[0-9]*' <<<"$L"|head -1|cut -d= -f2)"; }
open_log(){ h shell "tail -n 6000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[beat\]|\[st\] t=|\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap|\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=h[5-9]|\[m20a\] |\[hang\]|\[probe\] dump|\[load\]|\[frz\]|\[mem\]|\[gst\]|\[m23b\]|\[perf\]|\[m25a\]|\[r\] batch flush|\[j\] SLOW FLUSH' " | tr -d '\r'; }
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  if [ "$KEEP_AWAKE" = "1" ] && [ $(( EL - LASTWAKE )) -ge 10 ]; then
    LASTWAKE=$EL; h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  PP=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$PP" ]; then DEADN=$(( ${DEADN:-0} + 1 )); else DEADN=0; fi
  if [ "${DEADN:-0}" -ge 2 ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> - app died during the boot"
    shot "$EL" "tdeath"
    hilog_snap "death_${EL}s"
    h shell "ls -t /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null | head -3" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    DEATH_T=$EL; break
  fi
  [ -z "$CURPID" ] && { P="$PP"; [ -n "$P" ] && { CURPID=$P; log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; }; }
  RAW=$(open_log)
  BT=$(grep -a '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  ST=$(grep -a '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  CPU=$(grep -o ' cpu=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); CPU=${CPU:-}
  RSS=$(grep -o 'rss=[0-9-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); RSS=${RSS:-}
  RSSM=$([ -n "${RSS:-}" ] && [ "${RSS:-0}" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null && echo $(( RSS / 1024 )) || echo "")
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  H5=$(GH h5); H6=$(GH h6); H7=$(GH h7); M20=$(M20ASUM)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${OP:-}" "${DW:-}" "${STALL:-}" "${CPU:-}" "${RSSM:-}" "${H5:-}" "${H6:-}" "${H7:-}" "$(echo "$M20"|cut -f1)" "$(echo "$M20"|cut -f2)" "$(echo "$M20"|cut -f3)" "${PP:-dead}" >> "$TSV"
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 18 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    RB2=$(for s in smo_gdump_sec smo_m10a smo_m14b smo_m15a smo_m16a smo_m17a smo_m18a smo_m19a smo_m20a smo_m23b smo_m25a_c1 smo_m25a_c2 smo_testkey smo_teststick; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
    log "t=${EL}s switch readback (in-boot): $RB2"
    log "t=${EL}s m6q sched: $(grep -a '\[i\] m6q sched' <<<"$RAW" | head -1 | tail -c 200)"
  fi
  if [ $(( EL % 20 )) -lt 3 ]; then log "t=${EL}s frames=${FR:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?} stall=${STALL:-?} cpu=${CPU:-?} rss=${RSSM:-?}MB h5=${H5:-?} h6=${H6:-?} h7=${H7:-?} m20a=$(echo "$M20"|tr '\t' '/')"; fi
  for T in $HSNAP; do
    if [ "${LASTHS:-0}" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTHS=$T; hilog_snap "t$T"; fi
  done
  for T in $PLAN; do if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi; done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 4
done
shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} death_t=${DEATH_T:-none} dur=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done
DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[beat\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/beat.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[beat] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/beat.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[st\] t=" "$DL" > "$OUT/st.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[st] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/st.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[st\] CHANGE" "$DL" > "$OUT/st_change.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[st] CHANGE lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/st_change.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[hang\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/hang.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[hang] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hang.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[probe\] dump" "$DL" > "$OUT/probe_dump.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[probe] dump lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/probe_dump.txt" | tr -d ' ') (EXPECT 0 periodic)"
  grep -a "\[load\] io\|\[load\] frame" "$DL" > "$OUT/load.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[load] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/load.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[gst\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/gst.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[gst] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/gst.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[frz\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/frz.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[frz] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/frz.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[mem\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/mem.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[mem] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/mem.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[m20a\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/m20a.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[m20a] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m20a.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
```

```sh
#   Carried in from M23B: the 46-48 s freeze is ~2200 "submit -> wait 240 s soft-raster fence"
#   round trips (98.8% of the time inside nvk_wait_fences), NOT one long flush (longest 3.32 s).
#   bd=1 batches pay 70.6 ms round-trip; bd>=116 drops to 0.5-0.9 ms/draw => merging is worth ~100x.
#   THIS ROUND: one build adds two file switches (C default 0):
#     smo_m25a_c1 = merge every draw_flush inside one guest submit into one submit+wait window
#     smo_m25a_c2 = async submit (wait moved to the start of the next batch)

#   with ONLY smo_m25a_c1/c2 as the new variables. m24a stays 0 (owned by the concurrent round).

wait_unlock(){
  local n=0 t0=$(date +%s) out
  h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
  while :; do
    n=$((n+1))
    out=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
    local el=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))
    printf '[%s] probe #%d t=%ds %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$n" "$el" "$(echo "$out" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 160)" >> "$OUT/unlock_probe.log"
    case "$out" in
      *10106102*) : ;;
      *"start ability successfully"*|*"successfully"*) log "unlock poll: probe #$n OK at t=${el}s"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 0 ;;
      *) : ;;
    esac
    [ "$el" -ge "$UNLOCK_MAX" ] && { log "X unlock poll: cap ${UNLOCK_MAX}s after $n probes -> BLOCKED"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 1; }
    sleep 15
  done
}

shot(){
  local k
  for k in 1 2 3; do
    h shell "rm -f /data/local/tmp/m28a_$TAG$2.jpeg; snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m28a_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
    h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m28a_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
    [ -s "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" ] && break
    log "shot retry $k for $2"
    sleep 2
  done
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

# thread evidence: the host watchdog (TOTK_HANG_DUMP_SECS default 60) dumps at ~60/120/180/240 s; this
# snapshot grabs everything the app printed to hilog since the last clear, tagged + pid-filtered.
hilog_snap(){
  local tag="$1"
  h shell "hilog -x -P ${MYPID:-0} 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'totk-dump|hang watchdog|freeze|CRASH|SIGSEGV|stub' | tail -400" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_$tag.txt" 2>/dev/null
  local n=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_$tag.txt" | tr -d ' ')
  if [ "${n:-0}" -ge 400 ]; then :; fi
  log "hilog_$tag lines=$n dumps=$(grep -ac 'totk-dump' "$OUT/hilog_$tag.txt" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
}

case "$STARTOUT" in
  *10106102*) log "X boot aa start blocked 10106102 -> unlock poll"
              [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ] && { wait_unlock || { log "X locked again; BLOCKED"; exit 2; }; sleep 3; stopapp; STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r'); } ;;
esac

done

GH(){ grep -a "\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
M20ASUM(){ L=$(grep -a "\[m20a\] sum t=" <<<"$RAW" | tail -1); printf '%s\t%s\t%s' "$(grep -o 'n_full=[0-9]*' <<<"$L"|head -1|cut -d= -f2)" "$(grep -o ' set=[0-9]*' <<<"$L"|head -1|cut -d= -f2)" "$(grep -o 'hit=[0-9]*' <<<"$L"|head -1|cut -d= -f2)"; }
open_log(){ h shell "tail -n 6000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[beat\]|\[st\] t=|\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap|\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=h[5-9]|\[m20a\] |\[hang\]|\[probe\] dump|\[load\]|\[frz\]|\[mem\]|\[gst\]|\[m23b\]|\[perf\]|\[m25a\]|\[r\] batch flush|\[j\] SLOW FLUSH' " | tr -d '\r'; }
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  if [ "$KEEP_AWAKE" = "1" ] && [ $(( EL - LASTWAKE )) -ge 10 ]; then
    LASTWAKE=$EL; h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  PP=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$PP" ]; then DEADN=$(( ${DEADN:-0} + 1 )); else DEADN=0; fi
  if [ "${DEADN:-0}" -ge 2 ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> - app died during the boot"
    shot "$EL" "tdeath"
    hilog_snap "death_${EL}s"
    h shell "ls -t /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null | head -3" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"

  fi
  [ -z "$CURPID" ] && { P="$PP"; [ -n "$P" ] && { CURPID=$P; log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; }; }
  RAW=$(open_log)
  BT=$(grep -a '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  ST=$(grep -a '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  CPU=$(grep -o ' cpu=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); CPU=${CPU:-}
  RSS=$(grep -o 'rss=[0-9-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); RSS=${RSS:-}
  RSSM=$([ -n "${RSS:-}" ] && [ "${RSS:-0}" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null && echo $(( RSS / 1024 )) || echo "")
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  H5=$(GH h5); H6=$(GH h6); H7=$(GH h7); M20=$(M20ASUM)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${OP:-}" "${DW:-}" "${STALL:-}" "${CPU:-}" "${RSSM:-}" "${H5:-}" "${H6:-}" "${H7:-}" "$(echo "$M20"|cut -f1)" "$(echo "$M20"|cut -f2)" "$(echo "$M20"|cut -f3)" "${PP:-dead}" >> "$TSV"
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 18 ]; then

for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done
DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[beat\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/beat.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[beat] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/beat.txt" | tr -d ' ')"

  grep -a "\[load\] io\|\[load\] frame" "$DL" > "$OUT/load.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[load] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/load.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a "\[gst\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/gst.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[gst] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/gst.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
```

`m40m_timeline.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M40M nerve timeline builder (v2, wall-clock): nerve_timeline.csv + nerve_post.csv
#   t (s) = 相对 aa start 的墙钟秒（日志每行 epoch − start_epoch.txt），精度 ±5 s（sum1 采样间隔）。
#   nerve_timeline.csv : 注入前每一次 nerve 切换（ring 里的名字 + sum1 命中阶梯给的 t）
#   nerve_post.csv     : 注入后的 sum1 采样序列（t, hits, Δ, last_token）
set -u
OUT="${1:?out dir}"
EV="$OUT/nerve_ev.txt"; S1="$OUT/nerve_sum1.txt"; SE="$OUT/start_epoch.txt"
[ -s "$EV" ] && [ -s "$S1" ] || { echo "missing inputs"; exit 1; }
START=$(cat "$SE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
export LC_ALL=C
tr -c '[:print:]\n' ' ' < "$EV" | grep -a -E ' t=[0-9]+s #[0-9]+ ns=[0-9]+s token=0x[0-9a-f]+\(' \
  | sed -E 's/^([0-9.]+) .* t=([0-9]+)s #([0-9]+) ns=([0-9]+)s token=0x[0-9a-f]+\(([^)]*)\).*/\1\t\2\t\3\t\4\t\5/' > "$OUT/.ev.tsv"
tr -c '[:print:]\n' ' ' < "$S1" | grep -a -E 'sum1 t=[0-9]+s gate=104 hits=[0-9]+' \
  | sed -E 's/^([0-9.]+) .* sum1 t=([0-9]+)s gate=104 hits=([0-9]+) events=([0-9]+).*last_ns=([0-9]+)s last_token=0x[0-9a-f]+\(([^)]*)\).*/\1\t\2\t\3\t\5\t\6/' > "$OUT/.s1.tsv"
echo "ev_tsv=$(wc -l < "$OUT/.ev.tsv" | tr -d ' ') s1_tsv=$(wc -l < "$OUT/.s1.tsv" | tr -d ' ') start=$START"
awk -F'\t' -v S="$START" '
  NR==FNR {   # .ev.tsv : epoch dt idx ns name
    ep=$1+0; dt=$2+0; idx=$3+0; ns=$4+0; nm=$5
    if (!(idx in seen)) { seen[idx]=1; name[idx]=nm; evns[idx]=ns; at[idx]=dt; cnt++;
      if (cntbydump[dt]=="") { nd++; dts[nd]=dt } cntbydump[dt]++ }
    if (idx>maxidx) maxidx=idx
    next
  }
  {   # .s1.tsv : epoch probe_t hits last_ns last_token
    ep=$1+0; t=$2+0; h=$3+0
    if (t>lastt) { nt++; st[nt]=t; sh[nt]=h; sep[nt]=ep-S; lastt=t }
    lasthits=h; lasttoken=$5; lastt_sample=t
  }
  END {
    for (i=1;i<=nd;i++) cum[i]=cum[i-1]+cntbydump[dts[i]]
    print "seq,t_s,t_lo_s,t_hi_s,name,ns,dump_at,source,post_inject" > "/dev/stderr"
    for (k=0;k<=maxidx;k++) {
      if (!(k in seen)) continue
      d=0; for (i=1;i<=nd;i++) if (k+1 <= cum[i]) { d=i; break }
      lo=(d<=1?0:dts[d-1]); hi=(d==0?"":dts[d])
      te=""; tq=""
      for (j=1;j<=nt;j++) if (sh[j] >= (k+1)) { te=st[j]; tq=sep[j]; break }
      if (tq=="") tq=(k+1<=sh[nt]?sep[nt]:"")
      nm=(name[k]==""?"?":name[k]); gsub(/,/," ",nm)
      printf "%d,%.1f,%s,%s,%s,%d,%d,ring,%s\n", k+1, tq, lo, hi, nm, evns[k], at[k], (tq!="" && tq>=205 ? "yes":"no")
    }
    for (k=maxidx+1; k<lasthits; k++) {
      tq=""
      for (j=1;j<=nt;j++) if (sh[j] >= (k+1)) { tq=sep[j]; break }
      nm=(k==lasthits-1)?lasttoken:"(not-dumped)"
      gsub(/,/," ",nm)
      printf "%d,%.1f,,,%s,,,sum1,%s\n", k+1, tq, nm, (tq!="" && tq>=205 ? "yes":"no")
    }
    printf "#total_hits_last\t%d\n#last_token\t%s\n#last_probe_t\t%s\n#dumped_events\t%d\n#ring_dumps\t%d\n", lasthits, lasttoken, lastt_sample, cnt, nd
  }
' "$OUT/.ev.tsv" "$OUT/.s1.tsv" > "$OUT/nerve_timeline.out" 2> "$OUT/.hdr"
grep -v '^#' "$OUT/nerve_timeline.out" | { cat "$OUT/.hdr"; cat; } > "$OUT/nerve_timeline.csv"
awk -F'\t' -v S="$START" 'BEGIN{print "wall_t_s,probe_t_s,hits,d_hits,last_ns,last_token"}
  { ep=$1+0; t=$2+0; h=$3+0; d=h-ph; ph=h;
    printf "%.1f,%s,%d,%d,%s,%s\n", ep-S, t, h, d, $4, $5 }' "$OUT/.s1.tsv" > "$OUT/nerve_post.csv"
grep '^#' "$OUT/nerve_timeline.out" > "$OUT/nerve_summary.txt"; grep '^#' "$OUT/.hdr" >> "$OUT/nerve_summary.txt"
rm -f "$OUT/.ev.tsv" "$OUT/.s1.tsv" "$OUT/nerve_timeline.out" "$OUT/.hdr"
echo "csv_rows=$(($(wc -l < "$OUT/nerve_timeline.csv")-1)) post_rows=$(($(wc -l < "$OUT/nerve_post.csv")-1))"
```
