```sh
[ -n "$P" ] && { log "X pid $P still running before log handling"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty (pre-flight)"

PRE=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); PRE=${PRE:-0}
log "pre vk_boot.log size=$PRE bytes"
MODE="truncate(:>)"
if ! h shell ": > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  MODE="rm -f (recreate on open)"; h shell "rm -f $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
fi
SZ=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); SZ=${SZ:-0}
[ "$SZ" = "0" ] || { log "X log not reset: mode=$MODE size=$SZ"; exit 1; }
log "log reset ok: mode=$MODE before=$PRE after=$SZ"

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"
OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); log "install: $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 300)"
grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_after: $UPD1"
[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

for i in 1 2 3; do
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$P" ] && break
  h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3
done
P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
[ -n "$P" ] && { log "X pid still $P before boot"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty -> ignite"

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
log "faultlog_before entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST0" | grep -c .)"

h shell "echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_snap_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_present_gain; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_gpres" >/dev/null 2>&1
TKWR=$(h shell "printf '%s' '$TESTKEY' > $FILES/smo_testkey && echo WROTE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
log "testkey write: ${TKWR:-<no output>} value=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')]"
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_movie_kick; echo $GD_SEC > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "movie switches before boot: kick=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_kick" | tr -d '\r') gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" | tr -d '\r') synth_file=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] stick_file=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 1800000" >/dev/null 2>&1

h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
START=$(date +%s)
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 2
done

# The app seeds both switch files at load (SELinux: the shell cannot create them). Overwrite to the
# explicit values now that they exist; the C default already equals them.
h shell "echo $SYNTH > $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null; echo $FRAMES > $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null; echo '$TESTSTICK' > $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "switches after seed: synth=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] frames=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] stick=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] testkey=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m5l_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m5l_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}
PLAN="${PLAN:-140 200 260 300 330 350 365 380 395 410 430 460 500 550 600 650}"
LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; POKE=0; LASTPOKE=0
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$P" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "dmesg 2>/dev/null | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|Kill|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR' | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') dmesg=$(wc -l < "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ')"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$P" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $P at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$P"; fi
  # M5l: 每 60 s 一次 dump 请求（两个时间点要 >=60 s 间隔），不用每 15 s 刷
  if [ $(( EL - LASTPOKE )) -ge 60 ]; then
    LASTPOKE=$EL; POKE=$((POKE+1))
    h shell "echo $POKE > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  LS=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); LS=${LS:-0}
  SNAP=$(h shell "tail -c 300000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[r\] draw totals|\[io\] romfs|\[i\] stick|\[i\] hid read' | tail -2" | tr -d '\r' | tr '\n' ' | ')
  log "t=${EL}s pid=$P log=$(( LS / 1048576 ))MiB :: ${SNAP:0:400}"
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 15
done

h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m5l_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m5l_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_fin.png" >/dev/null 2>&1 && log "screen_fin md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_fin.png") @t=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1
if [ -f "$OUT/vk_boot.log" ]; then
  mv "$OUT/vk_boot.log" "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log"
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log" | tr -d ' ')"
else log "X vk_boot.log pull failed"; fi
DL="$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "io blocks: $(grep -a -c '\[io\] romfs opens=' "$DL")   svc blocks: $(grep -a -c '\[svc\] ipc total' "$DL")"
  log "opens first/last: $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | head -1) $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "beat last: $(grep -a '\[beat\] t=' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-200)"
  log "max rss bytes: $(grep -a '\[beat\] t=' "$DL" | sed -E 's/.*rss=([0-9]+).*/\1/' | sort -n | tail -1)"
  log "K: $(grep -a '\[p2\] K(drawn)' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-400)"
  log "draws samples:"; grep -a '\[r\] draw totals' "$DL" | sed -E 's/^([0-9.]+) .*@submit#([0-9]+).*draws=([0-9]+).*/  t=\1 submit=\2 draws=\3/' | tee -a "$OUT/run.log" | tail -40
  log "draws distinct: $(grep -a -o 'draws=[0-9]*' "$DL" | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')"
  log "stick lines=$(grep -a -c '\[i\] stick ' "$DL") first: $(grep -a '\[i\] stick ' "$DL" | head -1 | cut -c1-200)"
  log "stick last: $(grep -a '\[i\] stick ' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-200)"
  log "stick applied series: $(grep -a -o 'applied=[0-9]*' "$DL" | awk -F= '{print $2}' | awk 'NR==1||NR%60==0' | tr '\n' ' ')"
  log "hid read stick-nonzero lines=$(grep -a 'hid read' "$DL" | grep -avc -E 'lx=0 ly=0 rx=0 ry=0') of $(grep -a -c 'hid read' "$DL")"
  log "hid read first nonzero:"; grep -a 'hid read' "$DL" | grep -av -E 'lx=0 ly=0 rx=0 ry=0' | head -3 | cut -c1-220 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "hid read last:"; grep -a 'hid read' "$DL" | tail -2 | cut -c1-220 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "chain lines=$(grep -a -c '\[gst\] chain' "$DL")"
  log "m5k lines=$(grep -a -c '\[m5k\]' "$DL") dumps=$(grep -a -c '\[m5k\] dump#' "$DL")"
  log "m5l fx lines=$(grep -a -c '\[fx\]' "$DL") sy lines=$(grep -a -c '\[sy\]' "$DL")"
  log "movie ledger:"; grep -a '\[mv\]' "$DL" | tail -10 | cut -c1-400 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "new opens: $(grep -a -o 'open#[^ ]* content:[^ ]*' "$DL" | tail -6 | tr '\n' ' ')"
  log "serv fail: $(grep -a -o 'fails=[0-9]*' "$DL" | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')"
fi

h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|Kill'" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/lmk.txt"
log "lmk lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/lmk.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
NEW=0
for cf in $(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r'); do
  grep -qxF "$cf" <<<"$CFLIST0" && continue
  NEW=$((NEW+1))
  h file recv "/data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/$cf" "$OUT/$cf" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    && log "!! NEW faultlog pulled: $cf" || log "!! NEW faultlog found but recv failed: $cf"
done
log "new_faultlog_count=$NEW"
log "alive=$ALIVE end=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 2
log "post stop pidof=[$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')]"
log "done"

```

```sh
  log "stick applied series: $(grep -a -o 'applied=[0-9]*' "$DL" | awk -F= '{print $2}' | awk 'NR==1||NR%60==0' | tr '\n' ' ')"
  log "hid read stick-nonzero lines=$(grep -a 'hid read' "$DL" | grep -avc -E 'lx=0 ly=0 rx=0 ry=0') of $(grep -a -c 'hid read' "$DL")"
  log "hid read first nonzero:"; grep -a 'hid read' "$DL" | grep -av -E 'lx=0 ly=0 rx=0 ry=0' | head -3 | cut -c1-220 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "hid read last:"; grep -a 'hid read' "$DL" | tail -2 | cut -c1-220 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "chain lines=$(grep -a -c '\[gst\] chain' "$DL")"
  log "m5k lines=$(grep -a -c '\[m5k\]' "$DL") dumps=$(grep -a -c '\[m5k\] dump#' "$DL")"
  log "m5l fx lines=$(grep -a -c '\[fx\]' "$DL") sy lines=$(grep -a -c '\[sy\]' "$DL")"
  log "movie ledger:"; grep -a '\[mv\]' "$DL" | tail -10 | cut -c1-400 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "new opens: $(grep -a -o 'open#[^ ]* content:[^ ]*' "$DL" | tail -6 | tr '\n' ' ')"
  log "serv fail: $(grep -a -o 'fails=[0-9]*' "$DL" | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')"
fi

h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|Kill'" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/lmk.txt"
log "lmk lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/lmk.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
NEW=0
for cf in $(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r'); do
  grep -qxF "$cf" <<<"$CFLIST0" && continue
  NEW=$((NEW+1))
  h file recv "/data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/$cf" "$OUT/$cf" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    && log "!! NEW faultlog pulled: $cf" || log "!! NEW faultlog found but recv failed: $cf"
done
log "new_faultlog_count=$NEW"
log "alive=$ALIVE end=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 2
log "post stop pidof=[$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')]"
log "done"
```

`m5n_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M5m: stick + dumps every 60 s (two [sy] top-10 points); regression fix (svc 0x34 else) (smo_teststick, C default ON) + main-thread guest frame chain (M5j
# runtime_guest_chain_dump, into vk_boot.log). One boot. No git.
# Schedule unchanged from M5i/M5h boot B: 10x A then 20x Plus, 1000 ms down / 5000 ms up.
# Usage: bash m5k_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds=700]
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: m5k_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]}"
DUR="${2:-700}"
TESTKEY="${TESTKEY:-1 225 1000 5000 30 38:10,36:20}"
TESTSTICK="${TESTSTICK:-1 700 2000}"
GD_SEC="${GD_SEC:-60}"
SYNTH="${SYNTH:-1}"
FRAMES="${FRAMES:-8}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
TGT="127.0.0.1:5555"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m5n_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M5n tag=$TAG dur=${DUR}s out=$OUT synth=$SYNTH frames=$FRAMES testkey='$TESTKEY' teststick='$TESTSTICK' gd_sec=$GD_SEC"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target offline ($TGT)"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing: $HAP"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

for i in 1 2 3; do
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$P" ] && break
  log "pre-stop: pid=$P -> aa force-stop"
  h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3
done
P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
[ -n "$P" ] && { log "X pid $P still running before log handling"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty (pre-flight)"

PRE=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); PRE=${PRE:-0}
log "pre vk_boot.log size=$PRE bytes"
MODE="truncate(:>)"
if ! h shell ": > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  MODE="rm -f (recreate on open)"; h shell "rm -f $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
fi
SZ=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); SZ=${SZ:-0}
[ "$SZ" = "0" ] || { log "X log not reset: mode=$MODE size=$SZ"; exit 1; }
log "log reset ok: mode=$MODE before=$PRE after=$SZ"

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"
OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); log "install: $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 300)"
grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_after: $UPD1"
[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

for i in 1 2 3; do
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$P" ] && break
  h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3
done
P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
[ -n "$P" ] && { log "X pid still $P before boot"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty -> ignite"

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
log "faultlog_before entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST0" | grep -c .)"

h shell "echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_snap_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_present_gain; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_gpres" >/dev/null 2>&1
TKWR=$(h shell "printf '%s' '$TESTKEY' > $FILES/smo_testkey && echo WROTE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
log "testkey write: ${TKWR:-<no output>} value=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')]"
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_movie_kick; echo $GD_SEC > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "movie switches before boot: kick=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_kick" | tr -d '\r') gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" | tr -d '\r') synth_file=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] stick_file=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 1800000" >/dev/null 2>&1

h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
START=$(date +%s)
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 2
done

# The app seeds both switch files at load (SELinux: the shell cannot create them). Overwrite to the
# explicit values now that they exist; the C default already equals them.
h shell "echo $SYNTH > $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null; echo $FRAMES > $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null; echo '$TESTSTICK' > $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "switches after seed: synth=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] frames=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] stick=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] testkey=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m5n_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m5n_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}
PLAN="${PLAN:-120 240 330 400}"
LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; POKE=0; LASTPOKE=0
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$P" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "dmesg 2>/dev/null | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|Kill|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR' | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') dmesg=$(wc -l < "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ')"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$P" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $P at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$P"; fi
  # M5l: 每 60 s 一次 dump 请求（两个时间点要 >=60 s 间隔），不用每 15 s 刷
  if [ $(( EL - LASTPOKE )) -ge 60 ]; then
    LASTPOKE=$EL; POKE=$((POKE+1))
    h shell "echo $POKE > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  LS=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); LS=${LS:-0}
  SNAP=$(h shell "tail -c 300000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[r\] draw totals|\[io\] romfs|\[i\] stick|\[i\] hid read' | tail -2" | tr -d '\r' | tr '\n' ' | ')
  log "t=${EL}s pid=$P log=$(( LS / 1048576 ))MiB :: ${SNAP:0:400}"
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 15
done

h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m5n_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m5n_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_fin.png" >/dev/null 2>&1 && log "screen_fin md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_fin.png") @t=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1
if [ -f "$OUT/vk_boot.log" ]; then
  mv "$OUT/vk_boot.log" "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log"
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log" | tr -d ' ')"
else log "X vk_boot.log pull failed"; fi
DL="$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "io blocks: $(grep -a -c '\[io\] romfs opens=' "$DL")   svc blocks: $(grep -a -c '\[svc\] ipc total' "$DL")"
  log "opens first/last: $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | head -1) $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "beat last: $(grep -a '\[beat\] t=' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-200)"
  log "max rss bytes: $(grep -a '\[beat\] t=' "$DL" | sed -E 's/.*rss=([0-9]+).*/\1/' | sort -n | tail -1)"
  log "K: $(grep -a '\[p2\] K(drawn)' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-400)"
  log "draws samples:"; grep -a '\[r\] draw totals' "$DL" | sed -E 's/^([0-9.]+) .*@submit#([0-9]+).*draws=([0-9]+).*/  t=\1 submit=\2 draws=\3/' | tee -a "$OUT/run.log" | tail -40
  log "draws distinct: $(grep -a -o 'draws=[0-9]*' "$DL" | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')"
  log "stick lines=$(grep -a -c '\[i\] stick ' "$DL") first: $(grep -a '\[i\] stick ' "$DL" | head -1 | cut -c1-200)"
  log "stick last: $(grep -a '\[i\] stick ' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-200)"
  log "stick applied series: $(grep -a -o 'applied=[0-9]*' "$DL" | awk -F= '{print $2}' | awk 'NR==1||NR%60==0' | tr '\n' ' ')"
  log "hid read stick-nonzero lines=$(grep -a 'hid read' "$DL" | grep -avc -E 'lx=0 ly=0 rx=0 ry=0') of $(grep -a -c 'hid read' "$DL")"
  log "hid read first nonzero:"; grep -a 'hid read' "$DL" | grep -av -E 'lx=0 ly=0 rx=0 ry=0' | head -3 | cut -c1-220 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "hid read last:"; grep -a 'hid read' "$DL" | tail -2 | cut -c1-220 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "chain lines=$(grep -a -c '\[gst\] chain' "$DL")"
  log "m5k lines=$(grep -a -c '\[m5k\]' "$DL") dumps=$(grep -a -c '\[m5k\] dump#' "$DL")"
  log "m5l fx lines=$(grep -a -c '\[fx\]' "$DL") sy lines=$(grep -a -c '\[sy\]' "$DL")"
  log "movie ledger:"; grep -a '\[mv\]' "$DL" | tail -10 | cut -c1-400 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "new opens: $(grep -a -o 'open#[^ ]* content:[^ ]*' "$DL" | tail -6 | tr '\n' ' ')"
  log "serv fail: $(grep -a -o 'fails=[0-9]*' "$DL" | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')"
fi

h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|Kill'" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/lmk.txt"
log "lmk lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/lmk.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
```

```sh
# only counts. Phase B (t >= FLIP_AT) = after the ledger has named an unfenced-but-waited NVNsync,
# flip the switch and see whether draws move. The switch file is created by the app on first
# heartbeat (SELinux: hdc may only overwrite an existing file), so seed it late and keep retrying.
FLIP_AT="${FLIP_AT:-430}"
FNSEED=0; FNFLIP=0; FNV0=""; FNV1=""
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$P" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "dmesg 2>/dev/null | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|Kill|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR' | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') dmesg=$(wc -l < "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ')"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$P" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $P at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$P"; fi
  # M5o phase switches
  if [ "$FNSEED" = 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 20 ]; then
    V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_fn_adv 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr -dc '0-9')
    if [ -n "$V" ]; then
      h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_fn_adv" >/dev/null 2>&1
      FNV0=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_fn_adv 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
      FNSEED=1; log "M5o phase A: smo_fn_adv seeded/exists -> set 0 (read back [$FNV0])"
    fi
  fi
  if [ "$FNFLIP" = 0 ] && [ "$FNSEED" = 1 ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$FLIP_AT" ]; then
    h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_fn_adv" >/dev/null 2>&1
    FNV1=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_fn_adv 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
    FNFLIP=1; log "M5o phase B @t=${EL}s: smo_fn_adv set 1 (read back [$FNV1]) -- ledger-driven, not a blind unfreeze"
  fi
  # M5l: 每 60 s 一次 dump 请求（两个时间点要 >=60 s 间隔），不用每 15 s 刷
  if [ $(( EL - LASTPOKE )) -ge 60 ]; then
    LASTPOKE=$EL; POKE=$((POKE+1))
    h shell "echo $POKE > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  LS=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); LS=${LS:-0}
  SNAP=$(h shell "tail -c 300000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[r\] draw totals|\[io\] romfs|\[i\] stick|\[i\] hid read|\[fn\] dump#' | tail -2" | tr -d '\r' | tr '\n' ' | ')
  log "t=${EL}s pid=$P log=$(( LS / 1048576 ))MiB :: ${SNAP:0:400}"
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 15
done

h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m5o_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m5o_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_fin.png" >/dev/null 2>&1 && log "screen_fin md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_fin.png") @t=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1
if [ -f "$OUT/vk_boot.log" ]; then
  mv "$OUT/vk_boot.log" "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log"
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log" | tr -d ' ')"
else log "X vk_boot.log pull failed"; fi
DL="$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "io blocks: $(grep -a -c '\[io\] romfs opens=' "$DL")   svc blocks: $(grep -a -c '\[svc\] ipc total' "$DL")"
  log "opens first/last: $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | head -1) $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "beat last: $(grep -a '\[beat\] t=' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-200)"
  log "max rss bytes: $(grep -a '\[beat\] t=' "$DL" | sed -E 's/.*rss=([0-9]+).*/\1/' | sort -n | tail -1)"
  log "K: $(grep -a '\[p2\] K(drawn)' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-400)"
  log "draws samples:"; grep -a '\[r\] draw totals' "$DL" | sed -E 's/^([0-9.]+) .*@submit#([0-9]+).*draws=([0-9]+).*/  t=\1 submit=\2 draws=\3/' | tee -a "$OUT/run.log" | tail -40
  log "draws distinct: $(grep -a -o 'draws=[0-9]*' "$DL" | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')"
  log "stick lines=$(grep -a -c '\[i\] stick ' "$DL") first: $(grep -a '\[i\] stick ' "$DL" | head -1 | cut -c1-200)"
  log "stick last: $(grep -a '\[i\] stick ' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-200)"
  log "stick applied series: $(grep -a -o 'applied=[0-9]*' "$DL" | awk -F= '{print $2}' | awk 'NR==1||NR%60==0' | tr '\n' ' ')"
  log "hid read stick-nonzero lines=$(grep -a 'hid read' "$DL" | grep -avc -E 'lx=0 ly=0 rx=0 ry=0') of $(grep -a -c 'hid read' "$DL")"
  log "hid read first nonzero:"; grep -a 'hid read' "$DL" | grep -av -E 'lx=0 ly=0 rx=0 ry=0' | head -3 | cut -c1-220 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "hid read last:"; grep -a 'hid read' "$DL" | tail -2 | cut -c1-220 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "chain lines=$(grep -a -c '\[gst\] chain' "$DL")"
  log "m5k lines=$(grep -a -c '\[m5k\]' "$DL") dumps=$(grep -a -c '\[m5k\] dump#' "$DL")"
  log "m5l fx lines=$(grep -a -c '\[fx\]' "$DL") sy lines=$(grep -a -c '\[sy\]' "$DL")"
  log "M5o fn ledger lines=$(grep -a -c '\[fn\]' "$DL") wa lines=$(grep -a -c '\[wa\]' "$DL")"
  log "M5o fn totals:"; grep -a '\[fn\] dump#\|\[fn\] rcpt dump#\|\[fn\] suspect_objs' "$DL" | cut -c1-460 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5o fn suspect rows:"; grep -a '\[fn\] SUSPECT' "$DL" | tail -8 | cut -c1-320 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5o fn top rows (tail):"; grep -a '\[fn\] sync obj=\|\[fn\] evt obj=\|\[fn\] cbsig obj=\|\[fn\] repval obj=' "$DL" | tail -10 | cut -c1-360 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5o parked rows (tail):"; grep -a '\[wa\] dump#' "$DL" | tail -8 | cut -c1-360 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "movie ledger:"; grep -a '\[mv\]' "$DL" | tail -10 | cut -c1-400 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "new opens: $(grep -a -o 'open#[^ ]* content:[^ ]*' "$DL" | tail -6 | tr '\n' ' ')"
  log "serv fail: $(grep -a -o 'fails=[0-9]*' "$DL" | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')"
fi

h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|Kill'" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/lmk.txt"
log "lmk lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/lmk.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
NEW=0
for cf in $(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r'); do
  grep -qxF "$cf" <<<"$CFLIST0" && continue
  NEW=$((NEW+1))
  h file recv "/data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/$cf" "$OUT/$cf" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    && log "!! NEW faultlog pulled: $cf" || log "!! NEW faultlog found but recv failed: $cf"
done
log "new_faultlog_count=$NEW"
log "M5o phase: seeded=[$FNV0] flipped=[$FNV1] flip_at=${FLIP_AT}s"
log "alive=$ALIVE end=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 2
log "post stop pidof=[$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')]"
log "done"

```

`m5p_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M5m: stick + dumps every 60 s (two [sy] top-10 points); regression fix (svc 0x34 else) (smo_teststick, C default ON) + main-thread guest frame chain (M5j
# runtime_guest_chain_dump, into vk_boot.log). One boot. No git.
# Schedule unchanged from M5i/M5h boot B: 10x A then 20x Plus, 1000 ms down / 5000 ms up.
# Usage: bash m5p_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds=700]
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: m5p_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]}"
DUR="${2:-700}"
TESTKEY="${TESTKEY:-1 225 1000 5000 30 38:10,36:20}"
TESTSTICK="${TESTSTICK:-1 700 2000}"
GD_SEC="${GD_SEC:-60}"
SYNTH="${SYNTH:-1}"
FRAMES="${FRAMES:-8}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
TGT="127.0.0.1:5555"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"

FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"

h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing: $HAP"; exit 1; }

  MODE="rm -f (recreate on open)"; h shell "rm -f $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
fi
SZ=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); SZ=${SZ:-0}
[ "$SZ" = "0" ] || { log "X log not reset: mode=$MODE size=$SZ"; exit 1; }
log "log reset ok: mode=$MODE before=$PRE after=$SZ"

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"
OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); log "install: $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 300)"
grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_after: $UPD1"
[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

for i in 1 2 3; do
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$P" ] && break
  h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3
done
P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
[ -n "$P" ] && { log "X pid still $P before boot"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty -> ignite"

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
log "faultlog_before entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST0" | grep -c .)"

h shell "echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_snap_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_present_gain; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_gpres" >/dev/null 2>&1
TKWR=$(h shell "printf '%s' '$TESTKEY' > $FILES/smo_testkey && echo WROTE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
log "testkey write: ${TKWR:-<no output>} value=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')]"
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_movie_kick; echo $GD_SEC > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "movie switches before boot: kick=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_kick" | tr -d '\r') gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" | tr -d '\r') synth_file=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] stick_file=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 1800000" >/dev/null 2>&1

h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
START=$(date +%s)
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 60s"; exit 1; }

  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi

PLAN="${PLAN:-120 240 360 500 620}"
LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; POKE=0; LASTPOKE=0

  log "m5l fx lines=$(grep -a -c '\[fx\]' "$DL") sy lines=$(grep -a -c '\[sy\]' "$DL")"
  log "M5p fn ledger lines=$(grep -a -c '\[fn\]' "$DL") wa lines=$(grep -a -c '\[wa\]' "$DL")"

  log "M5p fn suspect rows:"; grep -a '\[fn\] SUSPECT' "$DL" | tail -8 | cut -c1-320 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p fn top rows (tail):"; grep -a '\[fn\] sync obj=\|\[fn\] evt obj=\|\[fn\] cbsig obj=\|\[fn\] repval obj=' "$DL" | tail -10 | cut -c1-360 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p parked rows (tail):"; grep -a '\[wa\] dump#' "$DL" | tail -8 | cut -c1-360 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "movie ledger:"; grep -a '\[mv\]' "$DL" | tail -10 | cut -c1-400 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "new opens: $(grep -a -o 'open#[^ ]* content:[^ ]*' "$DL" | tail -6 | tr '\n' ' ')"
  log "serv fail: $(grep -a -o 'fails=[0-9]*' "$DL" | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')"
fi

  log "M5p RSS GUARD:"; grep -a "\[j\] RSS GUARD" "$DL" | cut -c1-260 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p norec draws (last 6):"; grep -a "\[h\] norec draws" "$DL" | tail -6 | cut -c1-300 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p opcode skipped (last 6):"; grep -a "\[h\] opcode skipped" "$DL" | tail -6 | cut -c1-300 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p draw totals (all):"; grep -a "\[r\] draw totals" "$DL" | cut -c1-320 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p rcpt misses:"; grep -a "\[fn\] rcpt miss#\|\[fn\] rcpt map#" "$DL" | cut -c1-240 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p K/pipes:"; grep -a "pipes_ok" "$DL" | tail -2 | cut -c1-300 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|Kill'" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/lmk.txt"
log "lmk lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/lmk.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
NEW=0
for cf in $(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r'); do
  grep -qxF "$cf" <<<"$CFLIST0" && continue
  NEW=$((NEW+1))
  h file recv "/data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/$cf" "$OUT/$cf" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    && log "!! NEW faultlog pulled: $cf" || log "!! NEW faultlog found but recv failed: $cf"
done
log "new_faultlog_count=$NEW"
log "M5p phase: seeded=[$FNV0] flipped=[$FNV1] flip_at=${FLIP_AT}s"
log "alive=$ALIVE end=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 2
log "post stop pidof=[$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')]"
log "done"
```

`m5q_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M5m: stick + dumps every 60 s (two [sy] top-10 points); regression fix (svc 0x34 else) (smo_teststick, C default ON) + main-thread guest frame chain (M5j
# runtime_guest_chain_dump, into vk_boot.log). One boot. No git.
# Schedule unchanged from M5i/M5h boot B: 10x A then 20x Plus, 1000 ms down / 5000 ms up.
# Usage: bash m5q_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds=700]
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: m5q_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]}"
DUR="${2:-700}"
TESTKEY="${TESTKEY:-1 225 1000 5000 30 38:10,36:20}"
TESTSTICK="${TESTSTICK:-1 700 2000}"
GD_SEC="${GD_SEC:-60}"
SYNTH="${SYNTH:-1}"
FRAMES="${FRAMES:-8}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
TGT="127.0.0.1:5555"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m5q_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M5p tag=$TAG dur=${DUR}s out=$OUT synth=$SYNTH frames=$FRAMES testkey='$TESTKEY' teststick='$TESTSTICK' gd_sec=$GD_SEC"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target offline ($TGT)"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing: $HAP"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

for i in 1 2 3; do
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$P" ] && break
  log "pre-stop: pid=$P -> aa force-stop"
  h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3
done
P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
[ -n "$P" ] && { log "X pid $P still running before log handling"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty (pre-flight)"

PRE=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); PRE=${PRE:-0}
log "pre vk_boot.log size=$PRE bytes"
MODE="truncate(:>)"
if ! h shell ": > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  MODE="rm -f (recreate on open)"; h shell "rm -f $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
fi
SZ=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); SZ=${SZ:-0}
[ "$SZ" = "0" ] || { log "X log not reset: mode=$MODE size=$SZ"; exit 1; }
log "log reset ok: mode=$MODE before=$PRE after=$SZ"

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"
OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); log "install: $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 300)"
grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_after: $UPD1"
[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

for i in 1 2 3; do
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$P" ] && break
  h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3
done
P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
[ -n "$P" ] && { log "X pid still $P before boot"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty -> ignite"

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
log "faultlog_before entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST0" | grep -c .)"

h shell "echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_snap_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_present_gain; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_gpres" >/dev/null 2>&1
TKWR=$(h shell "printf '%s' '$TESTKEY' > $FILES/smo_testkey && echo WROTE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
log "testkey write: ${TKWR:-<no output>} value=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')]"
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_movie_kick; echo $GD_SEC > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "movie switches before boot: kick=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_kick" | tr -d '\r') gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" | tr -d '\r') synth_file=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] stick_file=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 1800000" >/dev/null 2>&1

h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
START=$(date +%s)
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 2
done

# The app seeds both switch files at load (SELinux: the shell cannot create them). Overwrite to the
# explicit values now that they exist; the C default already equals them.
h shell "echo $SYNTH > $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null; echo $FRAMES > $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null; echo '$TESTSTICK' > $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "switches after seed: synth=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] frames=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] stick=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] testkey=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m5q_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m5q_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}
PLAN="${PLAN:-120 240 360 500 620}"
LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; POKE=0; LASTPOKE=0
# M5p: two-phase run. Phase A (t < FLIP_AT) = honest baseline: smo_fn_adv must stay 0, the ledger
# only counts. Phase B (t >= FLIP_AT) = after the ledger has named an unfenced-but-waited NVNsync,
# flip the switch and see whether draws move. The switch file is created by the app on first
# heartbeat (SELinux: hdc may only overwrite an existing file), so seed it late and keep retrying.
FLIP_AT="${FLIP_AT:-999999}"   # M5p: no phase-B flip; keep smo_fn_adv at 0 for an honest baseline
FNSEED=0; FNFLIP=0; FNV0=""; FNV1=""
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$P" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "dmesg 2>/dev/null | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|Kill|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR' | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') dmesg=$(wc -l < "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ')"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$P" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $P at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$P"; fi
  # M5p phase switches
  if [ "$FNSEED" = 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 20 ]; then
    V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_fn_adv 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr -dc '0-9')
    if [ -n "$V" ]; then
      h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_fn_adv" >/dev/null 2>&1
      FNV0=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_fn_adv 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
      FNSEED=1; log "M5p phase A: smo_fn_adv seeded/exists -> set 0 (read back [$FNV0])"
    fi
  fi
  if [ "$FNFLIP" = 0 ] && [ "$FNSEED" = 1 ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$FLIP_AT" ]; then
    h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_fn_adv" >/dev/null 2>&1
    FNV1=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_fn_adv 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
    FNFLIP=1; log "M5p phase B @t=${EL}s: smo_fn_adv set 1 (read back [$FNV1]) -- ledger-driven, not a blind unfreeze"
  fi
  # M5l: 每 60 s 一次 dump 请求（两个时间点要 >=60 s 间隔），不用每 15 s 刷
  if [ $(( EL - LASTPOKE )) -ge 60 ]; then
    LASTPOKE=$EL; POKE=$((POKE+1))
    h shell "echo $POKE > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  LS=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); LS=${LS:-0}
  SNAP=$(h shell "tail -c 300000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[r\] draw totals|\[io\] romfs|\[i\] stick|\[i\] hid read|\[fn\] dump#' | tail -2" | tr -d '\r' | tr '\n' ' | ')
  log "t=${EL}s pid=$P log=$(( LS / 1048576 ))MiB :: ${SNAP:0:400}"
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 15
done

h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m5q_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m5q_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_fin.png" >/dev/null 2>&1 && log "screen_fin md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_fin.png") @t=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1
if [ -f "$OUT/vk_boot.log" ]; then
  mv "$OUT/vk_boot.log" "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log"
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log" | tr -d ' ')"
else log "X vk_boot.log pull failed"; fi
DL="$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "io blocks: $(grep -a -c '\[io\] romfs opens=' "$DL")   svc blocks: $(grep -a -c '\[svc\] ipc total' "$DL")"
  log "opens first/last: $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | head -1) $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "beat last: $(grep -a '\[beat\] t=' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-200)"
  log "max rss bytes: $(grep -a '\[beat\] t=' "$DL" | sed -E 's/.*rss=([0-9]+).*/\1/' | sort -n | tail -1)"
  log "K: $(grep -a '\[p2\] K(drawn)' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-400)"
  log "draws samples:"; grep -a '\[r\] draw totals' "$DL" | sed -E 's/^([0-9.]+) .*@submit#([0-9]+).*draws=([0-9]+).*/  t=\1 submit=\2 draws=\3/' | tee -a "$OUT/run.log" | tail -40
  log "draws distinct: $(grep -a -o 'draws=[0-9]*' "$DL" | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')"
  log "stick lines=$(grep -a -c '\[i\] stick ' "$DL") first: $(grep -a '\[i\] stick ' "$DL" | head -1 | cut -c1-200)"
  log "stick last: $(grep -a '\[i\] stick ' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-200)"
  log "stick applied series: $(grep -a -o 'applied=[0-9]*' "$DL" | awk -F= '{print $2}' | awk 'NR==1||NR%60==0' | tr '\n' ' ')"
  log "hid read stick-nonzero lines=$(grep -a 'hid read' "$DL" | grep -avc -E 'lx=0 ly=0 rx=0 ry=0') of $(grep -a -c 'hid read' "$DL")"
  log "hid read first nonzero:"; grep -a 'hid read' "$DL" | grep -av -E 'lx=0 ly=0 rx=0 ry=0' | head -3 | cut -c1-220 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "hid read last:"; grep -a 'hid read' "$DL" | tail -2 | cut -c1-220 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "chain lines=$(grep -a -c '\[gst\] chain' "$DL")"
  log "m5k lines=$(grep -a -c '\[m5k\]' "$DL") dumps=$(grep -a -c '\[m5k\] dump#' "$DL")"
  log "m5l fx lines=$(grep -a -c '\[fx\]' "$DL") sy lines=$(grep -a -c '\[sy\]' "$DL")"
  log "M5p fn ledger lines=$(grep -a -c '\[fn\]' "$DL") wa lines=$(grep -a -c '\[wa\]' "$DL")"
  log "M5p fn totals:"; grep -a '\[fn\] dump#\|\[fn\] rcpt dump#\|\[fn\] suspect_objs' "$DL" | cut -c1-460 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p fn suspect rows:"; grep -a '\[fn\] SUSPECT' "$DL" | tail -8 | cut -c1-320 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p fn top rows (tail):"; grep -a '\[fn\] sync obj=\|\[fn\] evt obj=\|\[fn\] cbsig obj=\|\[fn\] repval obj=' "$DL" | tail -10 | cut -c1-360 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p parked rows (tail):"; grep -a '\[wa\] dump#' "$DL" | tail -8 | cut -c1-360 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "movie ledger:"; grep -a '\[mv\]' "$DL" | tail -10 | cut -c1-400 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "new opens: $(grep -a -o 'open#[^ ]* content:[^ ]*' "$DL" | tail -6 | tr '\n' ' ')"
  log "serv fail: $(grep -a -o 'fails=[0-9]*' "$DL" | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')"
fi

  log "M5p RSS GUARD:"; grep -a "\[j\] RSS GUARD" "$DL" | cut -c1-260 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p norec draws (last 6):"; grep -a "\[h\] norec draws" "$DL" | tail -6 | cut -c1-300 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p opcode skipped (last 6):"; grep -a "\[h\] opcode skipped" "$DL" | tail -6 | cut -c1-300 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p draw totals (all):"; grep -a "\[r\] draw totals" "$DL" | cut -c1-320 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p rcpt misses:"; grep -a "\[fn\] rcpt miss#\|\[fn\] rcpt map#" "$DL" | cut -c1-240 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p K/pipes:"; grep -a "pipes_ok" "$DL" | tail -2 | cut -c1-300 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|Kill'" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/lmk.txt"
log "lmk lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/lmk.txt" | tr -d ' ')"

for cf in $(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r'); do
  grep -qxF "$cf" <<<"$CFLIST0" && continue
  NEW=$((NEW+1))
  h file recv "/data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/$cf" "$OUT/$cf" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
```

```sh
  h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3
done
P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
[ -n "$P" ] && { log "X pid still $P before boot"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty -> ignite"

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
log "faultlog_before entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST0" | grep -c .)"

h shell "echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_snap_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_present_gain; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_gpres" >/dev/null 2>&1
TKWR=$(h shell "printf '%s' '$TESTKEY' > $FILES/smo_testkey && echo WROTE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
log "testkey write: ${TKWR:-<no output>} value=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')]"
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_movie_kick; echo $GD_SEC > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "movie switches before boot: kick=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_kick" | tr -d '\r') gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" | tr -d '\r') synth_file=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] stick_file=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 1800000" >/dev/null 2>&1

h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
START=$(date +%s)
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 2
done

# The app seeds both switch files at load (SELinux: the shell cannot create them). Overwrite to the
# explicit values now that they exist; the C default already equals them.
h shell "echo $SYNTH > $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null; echo $FRAMES > $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null; echo '$TESTSTICK' > $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "switches after seed: synth=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] frames=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] stick=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] testkey=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m5r_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m5r_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}
PLAN="${PLAN:-120 240 360 500 620 720 840}"
LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; POKE=0; LASTPOKE=0
# M5p: two-phase run. Phase A (t < FLIP_AT) = honest baseline: smo_fn_adv must stay 0, the ledger
# only counts. Phase B (t >= FLIP_AT) = after the ledger has named an unfenced-but-waited NVNsync,
# flip the switch and see whether draws move. The switch file is created by the app on first
# heartbeat (SELinux: hdc may only overwrite an existing file), so seed it late and keep retrying.
FLIP_AT="${FLIP_AT:-999999}"   # M5p: no phase-B flip; keep smo_fn_adv at 0 for an honest baseline
FNSEED=0; FNFLIP=0; FNV0=""; FNV1=""
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$P" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "dmesg 2>/dev/null | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|Kill|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR' | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') dmesg=$(wc -l < "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ')"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$P" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $P at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$P"; fi
  # M5p phase switches
  if [ "$FNSEED" = 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 20 ]; then
    V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_fn_adv 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr -dc '0-9')
    if [ -n "$V" ]; then
      h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_fn_adv" >/dev/null 2>&1
      FNV0=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_fn_adv 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
      FNSEED=1; log "M5p phase A: smo_fn_adv seeded/exists -> set 0 (read back [$FNV0])"
    fi
  fi
  if [ "$FNFLIP" = 0 ] && [ "$FNSEED" = 1 ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$FLIP_AT" ]; then
    h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_fn_adv" >/dev/null 2>&1
    FNV1=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_fn_adv 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
    FNFLIP=1; log "M5p phase B @t=${EL}s: smo_fn_adv set 1 (read back [$FNV1]) -- ledger-driven, not a blind unfreeze"
  fi
  # M5l: 每 60 s 一次 dump 请求（两个时间点要 >=60 s 间隔），不用每 15 s 刷
  if [ $(( EL - LASTPOKE )) -ge 60 ]; then
    LASTPOKE=$EL; POKE=$((POKE+1))
    h shell "echo $POKE > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  LS=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); LS=${LS:-0}
  SNAP=$(h shell "tail -c 300000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[r\] draw totals|\[io\] romfs|\[i\] stick|\[i\] hid read|\[fn\] dump#' | tail -2" | tr -d '\r' | tr '\n' ' | ')
  log "t=${EL}s pid=$P log=$(( LS / 1048576 ))MiB :: ${SNAP:0:400}"
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 15
done

h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m5q_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m5q_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_fin.png" >/dev/null 2>&1 && log "screen_fin md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_fin.png") @t=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1
if [ -f "$OUT/vk_boot.log" ]; then
  mv "$OUT/vk_boot.log" "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log"
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log" | tr -d ' ')"
else log "X vk_boot.log pull failed"; fi
DL="$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "io blocks: $(grep -a -c '\[io\] romfs opens=' "$DL")   svc blocks: $(grep -a -c '\[svc\] ipc total' "$DL")"
  log "opens first/last: $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | head -1) $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "beat last: $(grep -a '\[beat\] t=' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-200)"
  log "max rss bytes: $(grep -a '\[beat\] t=' "$DL" | sed -E 's/.*rss=([0-9]+).*/\1/' | sort -n | tail -1)"
  log "K: $(grep -a '\[p2\] K(drawn)' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-400)"
  log "draws samples:"; grep -a '\[r\] draw totals' "$DL" | sed -E 's/^([0-9.]+) .*@submit#([0-9]+).*draws=([0-9]+).*/  t=\1 submit=\2 draws=\3/' | tee -a "$OUT/run.log" | tail -40
  log "draws distinct: $(grep -a -o 'draws=[0-9]*' "$DL" | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')"
  log "stick lines=$(grep -a -c '\[i\] stick ' "$DL") first: $(grep -a '\[i\] stick ' "$DL" | head -1 | cut -c1-200)"
  log "stick last: $(grep -a '\[i\] stick ' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-200)"
  log "stick applied series: $(grep -a -o 'applied=[0-9]*' "$DL" | awk -F= '{print $2}' | awk 'NR==1||NR%60==0' | tr '\n' ' ')"
  log "hid read stick-nonzero lines=$(grep -a 'hid read' "$DL" | grep -avc -E 'lx=0 ly=0 rx=0 ry=0') of $(grep -a -c 'hid read' "$DL")"
  log "hid read first nonzero:"; grep -a 'hid read' "$DL" | grep -av -E 'lx=0 ly=0 rx=0 ry=0' | head -3 | cut -c1-220 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "hid read last:"; grep -a 'hid read' "$DL" | tail -2 | cut -c1-220 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "chain lines=$(grep -a -c '\[gst\] chain' "$DL")"
  log "m5k lines=$(grep -a -c '\[m5k\]' "$DL") dumps=$(grep -a -c '\[m5k\] dump#' "$DL")"
  log "m5l fx lines=$(grep -a -c '\[fx\]' "$DL") sy lines=$(grep -a -c '\[sy\]' "$DL")"
  log "M5p fn ledger lines=$(grep -a -c '\[fn\]' "$DL") wa lines=$(grep -a -c '\[wa\]' "$DL")"
  log "M5p fn totals:"; grep -a '\[fn\] dump#\|\[fn\] rcpt dump#\|\[fn\] suspect_objs' "$DL" | cut -c1-460 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p fn suspect rows:"; grep -a '\[fn\] SUSPECT' "$DL" | tail -8 | cut -c1-320 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p fn top rows (tail):"; grep -a '\[fn\] sync obj=\|\[fn\] evt obj=\|\[fn\] cbsig obj=\|\[fn\] repval obj=' "$DL" | tail -10 | cut -c1-360 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p parked rows (tail):"; grep -a '\[wa\] dump#' "$DL" | tail -8 | cut -c1-360 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "movie ledger:"; grep -a '\[mv\]' "$DL" | tail -10 | cut -c1-400 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "new opens: $(grep -a -o 'open#[^ ]* content:[^ ]*' "$DL" | tail -6 | tr '\n' ' ')"
  log "serv fail: $(grep -a -o 'fails=[0-9]*' "$DL" | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')"
fi

  log "M5p RSS GUARD:"; grep -a "\[j\] RSS GUARD" "$DL" | cut -c1-260 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p norec draws (last 6):"; grep -a "\[h\] norec draws" "$DL" | tail -6 | cut -c1-300 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p opcode skipped (last 6):"; grep -a "\[h\] opcode skipped" "$DL" | tail -6 | cut -c1-300 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p draw totals (all):"; grep -a "\[r\] draw totals" "$DL" | cut -c1-320 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p rcpt misses:"; grep -a "\[fn\] rcpt miss#\|\[fn\] rcpt map#" "$DL" | cut -c1-240 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p K/pipes:"; grep -a "pipes_ok" "$DL" | tail -2 | cut -c1-300 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|Kill'" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/lmk.txt"
log "lmk lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/lmk.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
NEW=0
for cf in $(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r'); do
  grep -qxF "$cf" <<<"$CFLIST0" && continue
  NEW=$((NEW+1))
  h file recv "/data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/$cf" "$OUT/$cf" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    && log "!! NEW faultlog pulled: $cf" || log "!! NEW faultlog found but recv failed: $cf"
done
log "new_faultlog_count=$NEW"
log "M5p phase: seeded=[$FNV0] flipped=[$FNV1] flip_at=${FLIP_AT}s"
log "alive=$ALIVE end=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 2
log "post stop pidof=[$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')]"
log "done"
```

```sh
# M5s: RT slot image leak fixed (h_rt_ensure recycles per-size instead of leaking on every resize)
# + [mem] attribution line every 30 s (rt alloc / cmd host / tex live / VmRSS). One or two boots. No git.
# Schedule unchanged from M5i/M5h boot B: 10x A then 20x Plus, 1000 ms down / 5000 ms up.
# Usage: bash m5s_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds=700]
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: m5s_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]}"
DUR="${2:-900}"
TESTKEY="${TESTKEY:-1 225 1000 5000 30 38:10,36:20}"
TESTSTICK="${TESTSTICK:-1 700 2000}"
GD_SEC="${GD_SEC:-60}"
SYNTH="${SYNTH:-1}"
FRAMES="${FRAMES:-8}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
TGT="127.0.0.1:5555"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m5s_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M5s tag=$TAG dur=${DUR}s out=$OUT synth=$SYNTH frames=$FRAMES testkey='$TESTKEY' teststick='$TESTSTICK' gd_sec=$GD_SEC"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target offline ($TGT)"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing: $HAP"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

for i in 1 2 3; do
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$P" ] && break
  log "pre-stop: pid=$P -> aa force-stop"
  h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3

MODE="truncate(:>)"

  MODE="rm -f (recreate on open)"; h shell "rm -f $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
fi
SZ=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); SZ=${SZ:-0}
[ "$SZ" = "0" ] || { log "X log not reset: mode=$MODE size=$SZ"; exit 1; }
log "log reset ok: mode=$MODE before=$PRE after=$SZ"

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"
OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); log "install: $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 300)"
grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_after: $UPD1"
[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

for i in 1 2 3; do
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$P" ] && break
  h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3
done
P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
[ -n "$P" ] && { log "X pid still $P before boot"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty -> ignite"

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
log "faultlog_before entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST0" | grep -c .)"

h shell "echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_snap_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_present_gain; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_gpres" >/dev/null 2>&1
TKWR=$(h shell "printf '%s' '$TESTKEY' > $FILES/smo_testkey && echo WROTE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
log "testkey write: ${TKWR:-<no output>} value=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')]"
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_movie_kick; echo $GD_SEC > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "movie switches before boot: kick=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_kick" | tr -d '\r') gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" | tr -d '\r') synth_file=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] stick_file=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"

  LS=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); LS=${LS:-0}

  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break

  NEW=$((NEW+1))

    && log "!! NEW faultlog pulled: $cf" || log "!! NEW faultlog found but recv failed: $cf"

log "alive=$ALIVE end=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 2
log "post stop pidof=[$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')]"
log "done"
```

`m5t_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M5s: RT slot image leak fixed (h_rt_ensure recycles per-size instead of leaking on every resize)
# + [mem] attribution line every 30 s (rt alloc / cmd host / tex live / VmRSS). One or two boots. No git.
# Schedule unchanged from M5i/M5h boot B: 10x A then 20x Plus, 1000 ms down / 5000 ms up.
# Usage: bash m5t_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds=700]
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: m5t_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]}"
DUR="${2:-900}"
TESTKEY="${TESTKEY:-1 225 1000 5000 30 38:10,36:20}"
TESTSTICK="${TESTSTICK:-1 700 2000}"
GD_SEC="${GD_SEC:-60}"
SYNTH="${SYNTH:-1}"
FRAMES="${FRAMES:-8}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
TGT="127.0.0.1:5555"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m5t_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M5s tag=$TAG dur=${DUR}s out=$OUT synth=$SYNTH frames=$FRAMES testkey='$TESTKEY' teststick='$TESTSTICK' gd_sec=$GD_SEC"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target offline ($TGT)"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing: $HAP"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

for i in 1 2 3; do
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$P" ] && break
  log "pre-stop: pid=$P -> aa force-stop"
  h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3
done
P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
[ -n "$P" ] && { log "X pid $P still running before log handling"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty (pre-flight)"

PRE=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); PRE=${PRE:-0}
log "pre vk_boot.log size=$PRE bytes"
MODE="truncate(:>)"
if ! h shell ": > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  MODE="rm -f (recreate on open)"; h shell "rm -f $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
fi
SZ=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); SZ=${SZ:-0}
[ "$SZ" = "0" ] || { log "X log not reset: mode=$MODE size=$SZ"; exit 1; }
log "log reset ok: mode=$MODE before=$PRE after=$SZ"

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"
OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); log "install: $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 300)"
grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_after: $UPD1"
[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

for i in 1 2 3; do
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$P" ] && break
  h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3
done
P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
[ -n "$P" ] && { log "X pid still $P before boot"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty -> ignite"

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
log "faultlog_before entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST0" | grep -c .)"

h shell "echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_snap_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_present_gain; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_gpres" >/dev/null 2>&1
TKWR=$(h shell "printf '%s' '$TESTKEY' > $FILES/smo_testkey && echo WROTE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
log "testkey write: ${TKWR:-<no output>} value=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')]"
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_movie_kick; echo $GD_SEC > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "movie switches before boot: kick=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_kick" | tr -d '\r') gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" | tr -d '\r') synth_file=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] stick_file=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 1800000" >/dev/null 2>&1

h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
START=$(date +%s)
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 2
done

# The app seeds both switch files at load (SELinux: the shell cannot create them). Overwrite to the
# explicit values now that they exist; the C default already equals them.
h shell "echo $SYNTH > $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null; echo $FRAMES > $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null; echo '$TESTSTICK' > $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "switches after seed: synth=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] frames=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] stick=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] testkey=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m5t_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m5t_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}
PLAN="${PLAN:-120 240 360 500 620 720 840}"
LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; POKE=0; LASTPOKE=0
# M5p: two-phase run. Phase A (t < FLIP_AT) = honest baseline: smo_fn_adv must stay 0, the ledger
# only counts. Phase B (t >= FLIP_AT) = after the ledger has named an unfenced-but-waited NVNsync,
# flip the switch and see whether draws move. The switch file is created by the app on first
# heartbeat (SELinux: hdc may only overwrite an existing file), so seed it late and keep retrying.
FLIP_AT="${FLIP_AT:-999999}"   # M5p: no phase-B flip; keep smo_fn_adv at 0 for an honest baseline
FNSEED=0; FNFLIP=0; FNV0=""; FNV1=""
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$P" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "dmesg 2>/dev/null | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|Kill|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR' | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') dmesg=$(wc -l < "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ')"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$P" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $P at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$P"; fi
  # M5p phase switches
  if [ "$FNSEED" = 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 20 ]; then
    V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_fn_adv 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr -dc '0-9')
    if [ -n "$V" ]; then
      h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_fn_adv" >/dev/null 2>&1
      FNV0=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_fn_adv 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
      FNSEED=1; log "M5p phase A: smo_fn_adv seeded/exists -> set 0 (read back [$FNV0])"
    fi
  fi
  if [ "$FNFLIP" = 0 ] && [ "$FNSEED" = 1 ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$FLIP_AT" ]; then
    h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_fn_adv" >/dev/null 2>&1
    FNV1=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_fn_adv 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
    FNFLIP=1; log "M5p phase B @t=${EL}s: smo_fn_adv set 1 (read back [$FNV1]) -- ledger-driven, not a blind unfreeze"
  fi
  # M5l: 每 60 s 一次 dump 请求（两个时间点要 >=60 s 间隔），不用每 15 s 刷
  if [ $(( EL - LASTPOKE )) -ge 60 ]; then
    LASTPOKE=$EL; POKE=$((POKE+1))
    h shell "echo $POKE > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  LS=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); LS=${LS:-0}
  SNAP=$(h shell "tail -c 300000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[r\] draw totals|\[io\] romfs|\[i\] stick|\[i\] hid read|\[fn\] dump#' | tail -2" | tr -d '\r' | tr '\n' ' | ')
  log "t=${EL}s pid=$P log=$(( LS / 1048576 ))MiB :: ${SNAP:0:400}"
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 15
done

h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m5t_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m5t_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_fin.png" >/dev/null 2>&1 && log "screen_fin md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_fin.png") @t=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1
if [ -f "$OUT/vk_boot.log" ]; then

  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log" | tr -d ' ')"
else log "X vk_boot.log pull failed"; fi
DL="$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "io blocks: $(grep -a -c '\[io\] romfs opens=' "$DL")   svc blocks: $(grep -a -c '\[svc\] ipc total' "$DL")"
  log "opens first/last: $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | head -1) $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "beat last: $(grep -a '\[beat\] t=' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-200)"
  log "max rss bytes: $(grep -a '\[beat\] t=' "$DL" | sed -E 's/.*rss=([0-9]+).*/\1/' | sort -n | tail -1)"
  log "K: $(grep -a '\[p2\] K(drawn)' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-400)"
  log "draws samples:"; grep -a '\[r\] draw totals' "$DL" | sed -E 's/^([0-9.]+) .*@submit#([0-9]+).*draws=([0-9]+).*/  t=\1 submit=\2 draws=\3/' | tee -a "$OUT/run.log" | tail -40
  log "draws distinct: $(grep -a -o 'draws=[0-9]*' "$DL" | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')"
  log "stick lines=$(grep -a -c '\[i\] stick ' "$DL") first: $(grep -a '\[i\] stick ' "$DL" | head -1 | cut -c1-200)"
  log "stick last: $(grep -a '\[i\] stick ' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-200)"
  log "stick applied series: $(grep -a -o 'applied=[0-9]*' "$DL" | awk -F= '{print $2}' | awk 'NR==1||NR%60==0' | tr '\n' ' ')"
  log "hid read stick-nonzero lines=$(grep -a 'hid read' "$DL" | grep -avc -E 'lx=0 ly=0 rx=0 ry=0') of $(grep -a -c 'hid read' "$DL")"
  log "hid read first nonzero:"; grep -a 'hid read' "$DL" | grep -av -E 'lx=0 ly=0 rx=0 ry=0' | head -3 | cut -c1-220 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "hid read last:"; grep -a 'hid read' "$DL" | tail -2 | cut -c1-220 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "chain lines=$(grep -a -c '\[gst\] chain' "$DL")"
  log "m5k lines=$(grep -a -c '\[m5k\]' "$DL") dumps=$(grep -a -c '\[m5k\] dump#' "$DL")"
  log "m5l fx lines=$(grep -a -c '\[fx\]' "$DL") sy lines=$(grep -a -c '\[sy\]' "$DL")"
  log "M5p fn ledger lines=$(grep -a -c '\[fn\]' "$DL") wa lines=$(grep -a -c '\[wa\]' "$DL")"
  log "M5p fn totals:"; grep -a '\[fn\] dump#\|\[fn\] rcpt dump#\|\[fn\] suspect_objs' "$DL" | cut -c1-460 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p fn suspect rows:"; grep -a '\[fn\] SUSPECT' "$DL" | tail -8 | cut -c1-320 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p fn top rows (tail):"; grep -a '\[fn\] sync obj=\|\[fn\] evt obj=\|\[fn\] cbsig obj=\|\[fn\] repval obj=' "$DL" | tail -10 | cut -c1-360 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p parked rows (tail):"; grep -a '\[wa\] dump#' "$DL" | tail -8 | cut -c1-360 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"

  log "M5s MEM attrib (all):"; grep -a "\[mem\] vmrss=" "$DL" | cut -c1-400 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
```
