`m6c_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M6c: RT slot 64->256 + miss classification + no fabricated identity + by=order for zero-content sampled textures + deferred LRU destroy + mapping-validated reloc + pre-submit memory veto.
# + [mem] attribution line every 30 s (rt alloc / cmd host / tex live / VmRSS). One or two boots. No git.
# Schedule unchanged from M5i/M5h boot B: 10x A then 20x Plus, 1000 ms down / 5000 ms up.
# Usage: bash m6c_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds=900]
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: m6c_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]}"
DUR="${2:-900}"
TESTKEY="${TESTKEY:-1 225 1000 5000 30 38:10,36:20}"
TESTSTICK="${TESTSTICK:-1 700 2000}"
GD_SEC="${GD_SEC:-60}"
SYNTH="${SYNTH:-1}"
FRAMES="${FRAMES:-8}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
TGT="127.0.0.1:5555"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m6c_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M5x tag=$TAG dur=${DUR}s out=$OUT synth=$SYNTH frames=$FRAMES testkey='$TESTKEY' teststick='$TESTSTICK' gd_sec=$GD_SEC"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target offline ($TGT)"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing: $HAP"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

for i in 1 2 3; do
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$P" ] && break
  log "pre-stop: pid=$P -> aa force-stop"
  h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3
done
P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
[ -n "$P" ] && { log "X pid $P still running before log handling"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty (pre-flight)"

PRE=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); PRE=${PRE:-0}
log "pre vk_boot.log size=$PRE bytes"
MODE="truncate(:>)"
if ! h shell ": > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  MODE="rm -f (recreate on open)"; h shell "rm -f $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
fi
SZ=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); SZ=${SZ:-0}
[ "$SZ" = "0" ] || { log "X log not reset: mode=$MODE size=$SZ"; exit 1; }
log "log reset ok: mode=$MODE before=$PRE after=$SZ"

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"
OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); log "install: $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 300)"
grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_after: $UPD1"
[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

for i in 1 2 3; do
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$P" ] && break
  h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3
done
P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
[ -n "$P" ] && { log "X pid still $P before boot"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty -> ignite"

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
log "faultlog_before entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST0" | grep -c .)"

h shell "echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_snap_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_present_gain; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_gpres" >/dev/null 2>&1
TKWR=$(h shell "printf '%s' '$TESTKEY' > $FILES/smo_testkey && echo WROTE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
log "testkey write: ${TKWR:-<no output>} value=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')]"
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_movie_kick; echo $GD_SEC > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "movie switches before boot: kick=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_kick" | tr -d '\r') gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" | tr -d '\r') synth_file=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] stick_file=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 1800000" >/dev/null 2>&1

h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
START=$(date +%s)
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 2
done

# The app seeds both switch files at load (SELinux: the shell cannot create them). Overwrite to the
# explicit values now that they exist; the C default already equals them.
h shell "echo $SYNTH > $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null; echo $FRAMES > $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null; echo '$TESTSTICK' > $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "switches after seed: synth=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] frames=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] stick=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] testkey=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m6a_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m6a_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}
PLAN="${PLAN:-120 240 360 500 620 720 840}"
LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; POKE=0; LASTPOKE=0; LASTRSS=0
# M5p: two-phase run. Phase A (t < FLIP_AT) = honest baseline: smo_fn_adv must stay 0, the ledger
# only counts. Phase B (t >= FLIP_AT) = after the ledger has named an unfenced-but-waited NVNsync,
# flip the switch and see whether draws move. The switch file is created by the app on first
# heartbeat (SELinux: hdc may only overwrite an existing file), so seed it late and keep retrying.
FLIP_AT="${FLIP_AT:-999999}"   # M5p: no phase-B flip; keep smo_fn_adv at 0 for an honest baseline
FNSEED=0; FNFLIP=0; FNV0=""; FNV1=""
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$P" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "dmesg 2>/dev/null | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|Kill|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR' | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') dmesg=$(wc -l < "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ')"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$P" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $P at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$P"; fi
  # M5p phase switches
  if [ "$FNSEED" = 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 20 ]; then
    V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_fn_adv 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr -dc '0-9')
    if [ -n "$V" ]; then
      h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_fn_adv" >/dev/null 2>&1
      FNV0=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_fn_adv 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
      FNSEED=1; log "M5p phase A: smo_fn_adv seeded/exists -> set 0 (read back [$FNV0])"
    fi
  fi
  if [ "$FNFLIP" = 0 ] && [ "$FNSEED" = 1 ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$FLIP_AT" ]; then
    h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_fn_adv" >/dev/null 2>&1
    FNV1=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_fn_adv 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
    FNFLIP=1; log "M5p phase B @t=${EL}s: smo_fn_adv set 1 (read back [$FNV1]) -- ledger-driven, not a blind unfreeze"
  fi
  # M5l: 每 60 s 一次 dump 请求（两个时间点要 >=60 s 间隔），不用每 15 s 刷
  if [ $(( EL - LASTPOKE )) -ge 60 ]; then
    LASTPOKE=$EL; POKE=$((POKE+1))
    h shell "echo $POKE > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  if [ $(( EL - LASTRSS )) -ge 30 ]; then
    LASTRSS=$EL
    RS=$(h shell "grep VmRSS /proc/$P/status 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr -s ' ')
    log "t=${EL}s RSS[$RS]"
  fi
  LS=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); LS=${LS:-0}
  SNAP=$(h shell "tail -c 300000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[r\] draw totals|\[io\] romfs|\[i\] stick|\[i\] hid read|\[fn\] dump#' | tail -2" | tr -d '\r' | tr '\n' ' | ')
  log "t=${EL}s pid=$P log=$(( LS / 1048576 ))MiB :: ${SNAP:0:400}"
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 15
done

h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m6a_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m6a_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_fin.png" >/dev/null 2>&1 && log "screen_fin md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_fin.png") @t=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1
if [ -f "$OUT/vk_boot.log" ]; then
  mv "$OUT/vk_boot.log" "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log"
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log" | tr -d ' ')"
else log "X vk_boot.log pull failed"; fi
DL="$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "io blocks: $(grep -a -c '\[io\] romfs opens=' "$DL")   svc blocks: $(grep -a -c '\[svc\] ipc total' "$DL")"
  log "opens first/last: $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | head -1) $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "beat last: $(grep -a '\[beat\] t=' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-200)"
  log "max rss bytes: $(grep -a '\[beat\] t=' "$DL" | sed -E 's/.*rss=([0-9]+).*/\1/' | sort -n | tail -1)"
  log "K: $(grep -a '\[p2\] K(drawn)' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-400)"
  log "draws samples:"; grep -a '\[r\] draw totals' "$DL" | sed -E 's/^([0-9.]+) .*@submit#([0-9]+).*draws=([0-9]+).*/  t=\1 submit=\2 draws=\3/' | tee -a "$OUT/run.log" | tail -40
  log "draws distinct: $(grep -a -o 'draws=[0-9]*' "$DL" | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')"
  log "stick lines=$(grep -a -c '\[i\] stick ' "$DL") first: $(grep -a '\[i\] stick ' "$DL" | head -1 | cut -c1-200)"
  log "stick last: $(grep -a '\[i\] stick ' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-200)"
  log "stick applied series: $(grep -a -o 'applied=[0-9]*' "$DL" | awk -F= '{print $2}' | awk 'NR==1||NR%60==0' | tr '\n' ' ')"
  log "hid read stick-nonzero lines=$(grep -a 'hid read' "$DL" | grep -avc -E 'lx=0 ly=0 rx=0 ry=0') of $(grep -a -c 'hid read' "$DL")"
  log "hid read first nonzero:"; grep -a 'hid read' "$DL" | grep -av -E 'lx=0 ly=0 rx=0 ry=0' | head -3 | cut -c1-220 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "hid read last:"; grep -a 'hid read' "$DL" | tail -2 | cut -c1-220 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "chain lines=$(grep -a -c '\[gst\] chain' "$DL")"
  log "m5k lines=$(grep -a -c '\[m5k\]' "$DL") dumps=$(grep -a -c '\[m5k\] dump#' "$DL")"
  log "m5l fx lines=$(grep -a -c '\[fx\]' "$DL") sy lines=$(grep -a -c '\[sy\]' "$DL")"
  log "M5p fn ledger lines=$(grep -a -c '\[fn\]' "$DL") wa lines=$(grep -a -c '\[wa\]' "$DL")"
  log "M5p fn totals:"; grep -a '\[fn\] dump#\|\[fn\] rcpt dump#\|\[fn\] suspect_objs' "$DL" | cut -c1-460 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p fn suspect rows:"; grep -a '\[fn\] SUSPECT' "$DL" | tail -8 | cut -c1-320 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p fn top rows (tail):"; grep -a '\[fn\] sync obj=\|\[fn\] evt obj=\|\[fn\] cbsig obj=\|\[fn\] repval obj=' "$DL" | tail -10 | cut -c1-360 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p parked rows (tail):"; grep -a '\[wa\] dump#' "$DL" | tail -8 | cut -c1-360 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "movie ledger:"; grep -a '\[mv\]' "$DL" | tail -10 | cut -c1-400 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "new opens: $(grep -a -o 'open#[^ ]* content:[^ ]*' "$DL" | tail -6 | tr '\n' ' ')"
  log "serv fail: $(grep -a -o 'fails=[0-9]*' "$DL" | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')"
fi

  log "M5s MEM attrib (all):"; grep -a "\[mem\] vmrss=" "$DL" | cut -c1-400 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5s RT slot creates: $(grep -a -c '\[h\] rt slot #' "$DL")  reuse_sz/reshape rows:"
  grep -a "rt slot reshape\|rt slot reuse #\|rt img budget deny" "$DL" | cut -c1-240 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p RSS GUARD:"; grep -a "\[j\] RSS GUARD" "$DL" | cut -c1-260 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p norec draws (last 6):"; grep -a "\[h\] norec draws" "$DL" | tail -6 | cut -c1-300 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p opcode skipped (last 6):"; grep -a "\[h\] opcode skipped" "$DL" | tail -6 | cut -c1-300 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p draw totals (all):"; grep -a "\[r\] draw totals" "$DL" | cut -c1-320 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p rcpt misses:"; grep -a "\[fn\] rcpt miss#\|\[fn\] rcpt map#" "$DL" | cut -c1-240 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p K/pipes:"; grep -a "pipes_ok" "$DL" | tail -2 | cut -c1-300 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"

  log "M5x RSS curve (beat, every 20th): $(grep -a '\[beat\] t=' "$DL" | sed -E 's/.*t=([0-9]+).*rss=([0-9]+).*/\1:\2/' | awk 'NR%20==1' | tr '\n' ' ')"
```

```sh
# M6d: probes only + keepalive input (see /tmp/m6d_report.md P1). Based on M6c: RT slot 64->256 + miss classification + no fabricated identity + by=order for zero-content sampled textures + deferred LRU destroy + mapping-validated reloc + pre-submit memory veto.

SZ=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); SZ=${SZ:-0}
[ "$SZ" = "0" ] || { log "X log not reset: mode=$MODE size=$SZ"; exit 1; }
log "log reset ok: mode=$MODE before=$PRE after=$SZ"

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"
OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); log "install: $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 300)"
grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_after: $UPD1"
[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

for i in 1 2 3; do
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$P" ] && break
  h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3
done
P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
[ -n "$P" ] && { log "X pid still $P before boot"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty -> ignite"

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
log "faultlog_before entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST0" | grep -c .)"

h shell "echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_snap_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_present_gain; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_gpres" >/dev/null 2>&1
TKWR=$(h shell "printf '%s' '$TESTKEY' > $FILES/smo_testkey && echo WROTE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
log "testkey write: ${TKWR:-<no output>} value=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')]"
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_movie_kick; echo $GD_SEC > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "movie switches before boot: kick=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_kick" | tr -d '\r') gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" | tr -d '\r') synth_file=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] stick_file=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 1800000" >/dev/null 2>&1

h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
START=$(date +%s)
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 2
done

# The app seeds both switch files at load (SELinux: the shell cannot create them). Overwrite to the
# explicit values now that they exist; the C default already equals them.
h shell "echo $SYNTH > $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null; echo $FRAMES > $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null; echo '$TESTSTICK' > $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "switches after seed: synth=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] frames=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] stick=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] testkey=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m6d_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m6d_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}
PLAN="${PLAN:-120 240 330 360 420 500 600 700 800 900}"
LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; POKE=0; LASTPOKE=0; LASTRSS=0
# M5p: two-phase run. Phase A (t < FLIP_AT) = honest baseline: smo_fn_adv must stay 0, the ledger
# only counts. Phase B (t >= FLIP_AT) = after the ledger has named an unfenced-but-waited NVNsync,
# flip the switch and see whether draws move. The switch file is created by the app on first
# heartbeat (SELinux: hdc may only overwrite an existing file), so seed it late and keep retrying.
FLIP_AT="${FLIP_AT:-999999}"   # M5p: no phase-B flip; keep smo_fn_adv at 0 for an honest baseline
FNSEED=0; FNFLIP=0; FNV0=""; FNV1=""
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$P" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "dmesg 2>/dev/null | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|Kill|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR' | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') dmesg=$(wc -l < "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ')"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$P" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $P at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$P"; fi
  # M5p phase switches
  if [ "$FNSEED" = 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 20 ]; then
    V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_fn_adv 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr -dc '0-9')
    if [ -n "$V" ]; then
      h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_fn_adv" >/dev/null 2>&1
      FNV0=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_fn_adv 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
      FNSEED=1; log "M5p phase A: smo_fn_adv seeded/exists -> set 0 (read back [$FNV0])"
    fi
  fi
  if [ "$FNFLIP" = 0 ] && [ "$FNSEED" = 1 ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$FLIP_AT" ]; then
    h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_fn_adv" >/dev/null 2>&1
    FNV1=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_fn_adv 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
    FNFLIP=1; log "M5p phase B @t=${EL}s: smo_fn_adv set 1 (read back [$FNV1]) -- ledger-driven, not a blind unfreeze"
  fi
  # M5l: 每 60 s 一次 dump 请求（两个时间点要 >=60 s 间隔），不用每 15 s 刷
  if [ $(( EL - LASTPOKE )) -ge 60 ]; then
    LASTPOKE=$EL; POKE=$((POKE+1))
    h shell "echo $POKE > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  if [ $(( EL - LASTRSS )) -ge 30 ]; then
    LASTRSS=$EL
    RS=$(h shell "grep VmRSS /proc/$P/status 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr -s ' ')
    log "t=${EL}s RSS[$RS]"
  fi
  LS=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); LS=${LS:-0}
  SNAP=$(h shell "tail -c 300000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[r\] draw totals|\[io\] romfs|\[i\] stick|\[i\] hid read|\[fn\] dump#' | tail -2" | tr -d '\r' | tr '\n' ' | ')
  log "t=${EL}s pid=$P log=$(( LS / 1048576 ))MiB :: ${SNAP:0:400}"
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 15
done

h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m6d_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m6d_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_fin.png" >/dev/null 2>&1 && log "screen_fin md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_fin.png") @t=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1
if [ -f "$OUT/vk_boot.log" ]; then
  mv "$OUT/vk_boot.log" "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log"
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log" | tr -d ' ')"
else log "X vk_boot.log pull failed"; fi
DL="$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "io blocks: $(grep -a -c '\[io\] romfs opens=' "$DL")   svc blocks: $(grep -a -c '\[svc\] ipc total' "$DL")"
  log "opens first/last: $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | head -1) $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "beat last: $(grep -a '\[beat\] t=' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-200)"
  log "max rss bytes: $(grep -a '\[beat\] t=' "$DL" | sed -E 's/.*rss=([0-9]+).*/\1/' | sort -n | tail -1)"
  log "K: $(grep -a '\[p2\] K(drawn)' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-400)"
  log "draws samples:"; grep -a '\[r\] draw totals' "$DL" | sed -E 's/^([0-9.]+) .*@submit#([0-9]+).*draws=([0-9]+).*/  t=\1 submit=\2 draws=\3/' | tee -a "$OUT/run.log" | tail -40
  log "draws distinct: $(grep -a -o 'draws=[0-9]*' "$DL" | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')"
  log "stick lines=$(grep -a -c '\[i\] stick ' "$DL") first: $(grep -a '\[i\] stick ' "$DL" | head -1 | cut -c1-200)"
  log "stick last: $(grep -a '\[i\] stick ' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-200)"
  log "stick applied series: $(grep -a -o 'applied=[0-9]*' "$DL" | awk -F= '{print $2}' | awk 'NR==1||NR%60==0' | tr '\n' ' ')"
  log "hid read stick-nonzero lines=$(grep -a 'hid read' "$DL" | grep -avc -E 'lx=0 ly=0 rx=0 ry=0') of $(grep -a -c 'hid read' "$DL")"
  log "hid read first nonzero:"; grep -a 'hid read' "$DL" | grep -av -E 'lx=0 ly=0 rx=0 ry=0' | head -3 | cut -c1-220 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "hid read last:"; grep -a 'hid read' "$DL" | tail -2 | cut -c1-220 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "chain lines=$(grep -a -c '\[gst\] chain' "$DL")"
  log "m5k lines=$(grep -a -c '\[m5k\]' "$DL") dumps=$(grep -a -c '\[m5k\] dump#' "$DL")"
  log "m5l fx lines=$(grep -a -c '\[fx\]' "$DL") sy lines=$(grep -a -c '\[sy\]' "$DL")"
  log "M5p fn ledger lines=$(grep -a -c '\[fn\]' "$DL") wa lines=$(grep -a -c '\[wa\]' "$DL")"
  log "M5p fn totals:"; grep -a '\[fn\] dump#\|\[fn\] rcpt dump#\|\[fn\] suspect_objs' "$DL" | cut -c1-460 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p fn suspect rows:"; grep -a '\[fn\] SUSPECT' "$DL" | tail -8 | cut -c1-320 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p fn top rows (tail):"; grep -a '\[fn\] sync obj=\|\[fn\] evt obj=\|\[fn\] cbsig obj=\|\[fn\] repval obj=' "$DL" | tail -10 | cut -c1-360 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p parked rows (tail):"; grep -a '\[wa\] dump#' "$DL" | tail -8 | cut -c1-360 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "movie ledger:"; grep -a '\[mv\]' "$DL" | tail -10 | cut -c1-400 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "new opens: $(grep -a -o 'open#[^ ]* content:[^ ]*' "$DL" | tail -6 | tr '\n' ' ')"
  log "serv fail: $(grep -a -o 'fails=[0-9]*' "$DL" | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')"
fi

  log "M5s MEM attrib (all):"; grep -a "\[mem\] vmrss=" "$DL" | cut -c1-400 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5s RT slot creates: $(grep -a -c '\[h\] rt slot #' "$DL")  reuse_sz/reshape rows:"
  grep -a "rt slot reshape\|rt slot reuse #\|rt img budget deny" "$DL" | cut -c1-240 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p RSS GUARD:"; grep -a "\[j\] RSS GUARD" "$DL" | cut -c1-260 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p norec draws (last 6):"; grep -a "\[h\] norec draws" "$DL" | tail -6 | cut -c1-300 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p opcode skipped (last 6):"; grep -a "\[h\] opcode skipped" "$DL" | tail -6 | cut -c1-300 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p draw totals (all):"; grep -a "\[r\] draw totals" "$DL" | cut -c1-320 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p rcpt misses:"; grep -a "\[fn\] rcpt miss#\|\[fn\] rcpt map#" "$DL" | cut -c1-240 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5p K/pipes:"; grep -a "pipes_ok" "$DL" | tail -2 | cut -c1-300 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5x MEM VETO:"; grep -a "\[r\] mem veto" "$DL" | cut -c1-320 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5x GM totls:"; grep -a "\[gm\] totals" "$DL" | cut -c1-420 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5x GM dumps:"; grep -a "\[gm\] cb0 dump" "$DL" | cut -c1-520 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5x GM reloc:"; grep -a "\[gm\] reloc" "$DL" | head -16 | cut -c1-420 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5x GM gdata:"; grep -a "\[gm\] gdata" "$DL" | head -8 | cut -c1-420 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "M5x RSS beat max: $(grep -a '\[beat\] t=' "$DL" | sed -E 's/.*rss=([0-9]+).*/\1/' | sort -n | tail -1)"
  log "M5x RSS curve (beat, every 20th): $(grep -a '\[beat\] t=' "$DL" | sed -E 's/.*t=([0-9]+).*rss=([0-9]+).*/\1:\2/' | awk 'NR%20==1' | tr '\n' ' ')"
h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|Kill'" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/lmk.txt"
log "lmk lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/lmk.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
NEW=0
for cf in $(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r'); do
  grep -qxF "$cf" <<<"$CFLIST0" && continue
  NEW=$((NEW+1))
  h file recv "/data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/$cf" "$OUT/$cf" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    && log "!! NEW faultlog pulled: $cf" || log "!! NEW faultlog found but recv failed: $cf"
done
log "new_faultlog_count=$NEW"
log "M5p phase: seeded=[$FNV0] flipped=[$FNV1] flip_at=${FLIP_AT}s"
log "alive=$ALIVE end=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 2
log "post stop pidof=[$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')]"
log "done"

```

`m6e_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M6e: [perf] probe + fps/opens 30 s series. Based on m6d_boot_run.sh (schedule/flags unchanged).
# Adds: 30 s probe cadence (smo_gdump_sec=30, poke every 30 s) and a TSV with opens/reads/frames/wait.
# Usage: bash m6e_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds=900]
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: m6e_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]}"
DUR="${2:-900}"
TESTKEY="${TESTKEY:-1 225 1000 5000 30 38:10,36:20}"
TESTSTICK="${TESTSTICK:-1 700 2000}"
GD_SEC="${GD_SEC:-30}"
SYNTH="${SYNTH:-1}"
FRAMES="${FRAMES:-8}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
TGT="127.0.0.1:5555"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m6e_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target offline ($TGT)"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing: $HAP"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

for i in 1 2 3; do
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$P" ] && break
  log "pre-stop: pid=$P -> aa force-stop"
  h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3

  MODE="rm -f (recreate on open)"; h shell "rm -f $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1

SZ=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); SZ=${SZ:-0}
[ "$SZ" = "0" ] || { log "X log not reset: mode=$MODE size=$SZ"; exit 1; }
log "log reset ok: mode=$MODE before=$PRE after=$SZ"

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"
OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); log "install: $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 300)"
grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_after: $UPD1"
[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

for i in 1 2 3; do
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$P" ] && break
  h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3
done
P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
[ -n "$P" ] && { log "X pid still $P before boot"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty -> ignite"

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
log "faultlog_before entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST0" | grep -c .)"

h shell "echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_snap_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_present_gain; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_gpres" >/dev/null 2>&1
TKWR=$(h shell "printf '%s' '$TESTKEY' > $FILES/smo_testkey && echo WROTE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
log "testkey write: ${TKWR:-<no output>} value=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')]"
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_movie_kick; echo $GD_SEC > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "movie switches before boot: kick=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_kick" | tr -d '\r') gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" | tr -d '\r')"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 1800000" >/dev/null 2>&1

h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
START=$(date +%s)
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 2
done

h shell "echo $SYNTH > $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null; echo $FRAMES > $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null; echo '$TESTSTICK' > $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "switches after seed: synth=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] frames=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] stick=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] testkey=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m6e_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m6e_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}
PLAN="${PLAN:-240 600 900}"
LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; POKE=0; LASTPOKE=-1; LASTRSS=0
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"
printf 't\topens\treads\tsubmit\tdraws\tload_wait\tfps\n' > "$TSV"
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$P" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "dmesg 2>/dev/null | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|Kill|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR' | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') dmesg=$(wc -l < "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ')"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$P" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $P at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$P"; fi
  # 30 s probe cadence: one gdump request per tick (the C side honours smo_gdump_sec=30 too)
  if [ $(( EL - LASTPOKE )) -ge 28 ]; then
    LASTPOKE=$EL; POKE=$((POKE+1))
    h shell "echo $POKE > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  LS=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); LS=${LS:-0}
  IO=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[load\] io t=' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  LV=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[io\] romfs' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  FR=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[load\] frame t=' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  WK=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[load\] wait' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$IO $LV" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  RD=$(grep -o 'reads=[0-9]*' <<<"$IO $LV" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); RD=${RD:-}
  SB=$(grep -o 'submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$FR" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SB=${SB:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$FR" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  WA=$(tr -d '\r' <<<"$WK" | cut -c1-150)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t-\n' "$EL" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${SB:-}" "${DW:-}" "$WA" >> "$TSV"
  if [ $(( EL - LASTRSS )) -ge 60 ]; then
    LASTRSS=$EL
    RS=$(h shell "grep VmRSS /proc/$P/status 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr -s ' ')
    log "t=${EL}s RSS[$RS] log=$(( LS / 1048576 ))MiB opens=${OP:-?} reads=${RD:-?} submit=${SB:-?} draws=${DW:-?}"
  fi
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 10
done

h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m6e_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m6e_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_fin.png" >/dev/null 2>&1 && log "screen_fin md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_fin.png") @t=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1
if [ -f "$OUT/vk_boot.log" ]; then
  mv "$OUT/vk_boot.log" "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log"
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log" | tr -d ' ')"
else log "X vk_boot.log pull failed"; fi
DL="$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "PERF LINES:"; grep -a '\[perf\]' "$DL" | cut -c1-700 | tee -a "$OUT/perf.txt"
  log "draws samples:"; grep -a '\[r\] draw totals' "$DL" | cut -c1-320 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "io first/last: $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | head -1) $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "load wait last: $(grep -a '\[load\] wait' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-220)"
  log "draw tops: $(grep -a -o 'zero_content [0-9.]*%' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "max rss bytes: $(grep -a '\[beat\] t=' "$DL" | sed -E 's/.*rss=([0-9]+).*/\1/' | sort -n | tail -1)"
  log "m6d counters: $(grep -a 'skip_heavy=' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-400)"
  log "rt fallback: $(grep -a -o 'rt_fallback=[0-9]*' "$DL" | tail -1)"
fi
h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|Kill'" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/lmk.txt"
log "lmk lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/lmk.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
NEW=0
for cf in $(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r'); do
  grep -qxF "$cf" <<<"$CFLIST0" && continue
  NEW=$((NEW+1))
  h file recv "/data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/$cf" "$OUT/$cf" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    && log "!! NEW faultlog pulled: $cf" || log "!! NEW faultlog found but recv failed: $cf"
done
log "new_faultlog_count=$NEW"
log "alive=$ALIVE end=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 2
log "post stop pidof=[$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')]"
log "done"
```

`m6f_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M6f: CPU-starvation A/B. Same cadence as M6e (30 s dump, 900 s run) plus:
#   - smo_sw_threads=<n>  SwiftShader [Processor] ThreadCount for this boot (0 = default, no ini)
#   - [cpu] per-thread table + [load] objsig wake ledger come from the C side
# Usage: bash m6f_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds=900]   (SW=2 for the A/B arm)
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: m6f_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]}"
DUR="${2:-900}"
SW="${SW:-0}"
TESTKEY="${TESTKEY:-1 225 1000 5000 30 38:10,36:20}"
TESTSTICK="${TESTSTICK:-1 700 2000}"
GD_SEC="${GD_SEC:-30}"
SYNTH="${SYNTH:-1}"
FRAMES="${FRAMES:-8}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
TGT="127.0.0.1:5555"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m6f_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M6f tag=$TAG dur=${DUR}s sw_threads=$SW out=$OUT synth=$SYNTH frames=$FRAMES gd_sec=$GD_SEC testkey='$TESTKEY'"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target offline ($TGT)"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing: $HAP"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

for i in 1 2 3; do
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$P" ] && break
  log "pre-stop: pid=$P -> aa force-stop"
  h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3
done
P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
[ -n "$P" ] && { log "X pid $P still running before log handling"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty (pre-flight)"

PRE=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); PRE=${PRE:-0}
log "pre vk_boot.log size=$PRE bytes"
MODE="truncate(:>)"
if ! h shell ": > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  MODE="rm -f (recreate on open)"; h shell "rm -f $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
fi
SZ=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); SZ=${SZ:-0}
[ "$SZ" = "0" ] || { log "X log not reset: mode=$MODE size=$SZ"; exit 1; }
log "log reset ok: mode=$MODE before=$PRE after=$SZ"

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"
OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); log "install: $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 300)"
grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_after: $UPD1"
[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

for i in 1 2 3; do
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$P" ] && break
  h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3
done
P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
[ -n "$P" ] && { log "X pid still $P before boot"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty -> ignite"

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
log "faultlog_before entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST0" | grep -c .)"

h shell "echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_snap_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_present_gain; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_gpres" >/dev/null 2>&1
TKWR=$(h shell "printf '%s' '$TESTKEY' > $FILES/smo_testkey && echo WROTE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
log "testkey write: ${TKWR:-<no output>} value=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')]"
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_movie_kick; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
# M6f A/B switch: worker count rides on the dump-cadence file as "<sec>,sw=<n>" (the app cannot have a
# switch file of its own created from the shell: SELinux allows modify, not create). vb_probe_int() still
# reads the leading integer, so the dump cadence is unchanged in both arms.
if [ "${SW:-0}" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then GDSEC="$GD_SEC,sw=$SW"; else GDSEC="$GD_SEC"; fi
h shell "echo '$GDSEC' > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "rm -f $FILES/SwiftShader.ini" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "gdump_sec file=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" | tr -d '\r')] sw_arm=$SW ini_left=$(h shell "ls $FILES/SwiftShader.ini 2>/dev/null | wc -l" | tr -d '\r')"
log "movie switches before boot: kick=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_kick" | tr -d '\r') gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" | tr -d '\r')"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 1800000" >/dev/null 2>&1

h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
START=$(date +%s)
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 2
done

h shell "echo $SYNTH > $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null; echo $FRAMES > $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null; echo '$TESTSTICK' > $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "switches after seed: synth=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] frames=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] stick=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] testkey=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m6f_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m6f_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}
PLAN="${PLAN:-240 600 900}"
LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; POKE=0; LASTPOKE=-1; LASTRSS=0
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"
printf 't\topens\treads\tsubmit\tdraws\tload_wait\tfps\n' > "$TSV"
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$P" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "dmesg 2>/dev/null | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|Kill|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR' | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') dmesg=$(wc -l < "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ')"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$P" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $P at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$P"; fi
  # 30 s probe cadence: one gdump request per tick (the C side honours smo_gdump_sec=30 too)
  if [ $(( EL - LASTPOKE )) -ge 28 ]; then
    LASTPOKE=$EL; POKE=$((POKE+1))
    h shell "echo $POKE > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  LS=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); LS=${LS:-0}
  IO=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[load\] io t=' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  LV=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[io\] romfs' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  FR=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[load\] frame t=' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  WK=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[load\] wait' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$IO $LV" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  RD=$(grep -o 'reads=[0-9]*' <<<"$IO $LV" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); RD=${RD:-}
  SB=$(grep -o 'submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$FR" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SB=${SB:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$FR" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  WA=$(tr -d '\r' <<<"$WK" | cut -c1-150)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t-\n' "$EL" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${SB:-}" "${DW:-}" "$WA" >> "$TSV"
  if [ $(( EL - LASTRSS )) -ge 60 ]; then
    LASTRSS=$EL
    RS=$(h shell "grep VmRSS /proc/$P/status 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr -s ' ')
    log "t=${EL}s RSS[$RS] log=$(( LS / 1048576 ))MiB opens=${OP:-?} reads=${RD:-?} submit=${SB:-?} draws=${DW:-?}"
  fi
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 10

h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m6f_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m6f_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_fin.png" >/dev/null 2>&1 && log "screen_fin md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_fin.png") @t=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log" | tr -d ' ')"
else log "X vk_boot.log pull failed"; fi

if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "PERF LINES:"; grep -a '\[perf\]' "$DL" | cut -c1-700 | tee -a "$OUT/perf.txt"
  log "draws samples:"; grep -a '\[r\] draw totals' "$DL" | cut -c1-320 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"

  log "load wait last: $(grep -a '\[load\] wait' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-220)"
  log "draw tops: $(grep -a -o 'zero_content [0-9.]*%' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "max rss bytes: $(grep -a '\[beat\] t=' "$DL" | sed -E 's/.*rss=([0-9]+).*/\1/' | sort -n | tail -1)"
  log "m6d counters: $(grep -a 'skip_heavy=' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-400)"
  log "rt fallback: $(grep -a -o 'rt_fallback=[0-9]*' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  # M6f evidence extracts
  grep -a '\[cpu\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/cpu.txt" && log "cpu lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/cpu.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[load\] objsig' "$DL" > "$OUT/objsig.txt" && log "objsig lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/objsig.txt" | tr -d ' ')"

  # 30 s opens/reads/submit series with submit-freeze flags (0-growth window = our loop stalled)
  awk '/\[load\] io t=/ { for (i=1;i<=NF;i++) { if ($i ~ /^opens=/) { sub("opens=","",$i); op=$i } if ($i ~ /^reads=/) { sub("reads=","",$i); rd=$i } } }

         printf "%s\topens=%s\treads=%s\tsubmit=%s\tfrozen=%s\tdraws=%s\n", t, op, rd, sb, flag, dw; psub=sb }' "$DL" > "$OUT/series2.tsv" 2>/dev/null
  log "series2 rows=$(wc -l < "$OUT/series2.tsv" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "sw arm log: $(grep -a -E '\[cfg\]' "$DL" | head -2 | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-300)"
  log "cpu probe first/last: $(grep -a '\[cpu\] t=' "$DL" | grep -v 'threads=' | head -1 | cut -c1-160)"
fi
h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|Kill'" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/lmk.txt"
log "lmk lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/lmk.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
NEW=0

  grep -qxF "$cf" <<<"$CFLIST0" && continue
  NEW=$((NEW+1))
  h file recv "/data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/$cf" "$OUT/$cf" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    && log "!! NEW faultlog pulled: $cf" || log "!! NEW faultlog found but recv failed: $cf"

log "new_faultlog_count=$NEW"
log "alive=$ALIVE end=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 2
log "post stop pidof=[$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')]"
```

`m6g_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M6g: per-wake trace of the main guest thread 0x1001 ([ldr] step / objaddr / loop lines come from
# the C side). Same 30 s dump cadence as M6f; the M6f SwiftShader worker switch is removed.
# Usage: bash m6g_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds=900]
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: m6g_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]}"
DUR="${2:-900}"
TESTKEY="${TESTKEY:-1 225 1000 5000 30 38:10,36:20}"
TESTSTICK="${TESTSTICK:-1 700 2000}"

TGT="127.0.0.1:5555"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"

h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target offline ($TGT)"; exit 1; }

log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

for i in 1 2 3; do
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$P" ] && break
  log "pre-stop: pid=$P -> aa force-stop"
  h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3
done
P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
[ -n "$P" ] && { log "X pid $P still running before log handling"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty (pre-flight)"

PRE=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); PRE=${PRE:-0}
log "pre vk_boot.log size=$PRE bytes"
MODE="truncate(:>)"
if ! h shell ": > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  MODE="rm -f (recreate on open)"; h shell "rm -f $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
fi
SZ=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); SZ=${SZ:-0}
[ "$SZ" = "0" ] || { log "X log not reset: mode=$MODE size=$SZ"; exit 1; }
log "log reset ok: mode=$MODE before=$PRE after=$SZ"

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"
OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); log "install: $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 300)"
grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_after: $UPD1"
[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

for i in 1 2 3; do
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$P" ] && break
  h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3
done
P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
[ -n "$P" ] && { log "X pid still $P before boot"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty -> ignite"

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
log "faultlog_before entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST0" | grep -c .)"

h shell "echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_snap_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_present_gain; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_gpres" >/dev/null 2>&1
TKWR=$(h shell "printf '%s' '$TESTKEY' > $FILES/smo_testkey && echo WROTE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
log "testkey write: ${TKWR:-<no output>} value=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')]"
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_movie_kick; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
# M6g: plain integer cadence only (the M6f "sw=" worker switch has been removed from the code).
h shell "echo '$GD_SEC' > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "rm -f $FILES/SwiftShader.ini" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "gdump_sec file=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" | tr -d '\r')] ini_left=$(h shell "ls $FILES/SwiftShader.ini 2>/dev/null | wc -l" | tr -d '\r')"
log "movie switches before boot: kick=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_kick" | tr -d '\r') gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" | tr -d '\r')"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 1800000" >/dev/null 2>&1

h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
START=$(date +%s)
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 2
done

h shell "echo $SYNTH > $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null; echo $FRAMES > $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null; echo '$TESTSTICK' > $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "switches after seed: synth=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] frames=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] stick=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] testkey=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m6g_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m6g_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}
PLAN="${PLAN:-240 600 900}"
TSV2="$OUT/chain60.tsv"; printf 't\topens\treads\tsubmit\tdraws\tobj\tstatic\n' > "$TSV2"
LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; POKE=0; LASTPOKE=-1; LASTRSS=0
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"
printf 't\topens\treads\tsubmit\tdraws\tload_wait\tfps\n' > "$TSV"
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$P" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "dmesg 2>/dev/null | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|Kill|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR' | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') dmesg=$(wc -l < "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ')"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$P" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $P at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$P"; fi
  # 30 s probe cadence: one gdump request per tick (the C side honours smo_gdump_sec=30 too)
  if [ $(( EL - LASTPOKE )) -ge 28 ]; then
    LASTPOKE=$EL; POKE=$((POKE+1))
    h shell "echo $POKE > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  LS=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); LS=${LS:-0}
  IO=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[load\] io t=' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  LV=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[io\] romfs' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  FR=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[load\] frame t=' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  WK=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[load\] wait' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$IO $LV" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  RD=$(grep -o 'reads=[0-9]*' <<<"$IO $LV" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); RD=${RD:-}
  SB=$(grep -o 'submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$FR" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SB=${SB:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$FR" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  WA=$(tr -d '\r' <<<"$WK" | cut -c1-150)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t-\n' "$EL" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${SB:-}" "${DW:-}" "$WA" >> "$TSV"
  if [ $(( EL - LASTRSS )) -ge 60 ]; then
    LASTRSS=$EL
    RS=$(h shell "grep VmRSS /proc/$P/status 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr -s ' ')
    WM=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\\[load\\] wait' | grep -a thr=0x1001 | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
    OB=$(grep -o 'obj=0x[0-9a-f]*' <<<"$WM" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); OB=${OB:-}
    ST=$(grep -o 'static=[0-9]*dumps' <<<"$WM" | tail -1); ST=${ST:-}; ST=${ST#static=}
    printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${SB:-}" "${DW:-}" "${OB:-}" "${ST:-}" >> "$TSV2"
    log "t=${EL}s RSS[$RS] log=$(( LS / 1048576 ))MiB opens=${OP:-?} reads=${RD:-?} submit=${SB:-?} draws=${DW:-?} main_obj=${OB:-?} static=${ST:-?}"
  fi
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 10
done

h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m6g_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m6g_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_fin.png" >/dev/null 2>&1 && log "screen_fin md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_fin.png") @t=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1
if [ -f "$OUT/vk_boot.log" ]; then
  mv "$OUT/vk_boot.log" "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log"
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log" | tr -d ' ')"
else log "X vk_boot.log pull failed"; fi
DL="$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "PERF LINES:"; grep -a '\[perf\]' "$DL" | cut -c1-700 | tee -a "$OUT/perf.txt"
  log "draws samples:"; grep -a '\[r\] draw totals' "$DL" | cut -c1-320 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "io first/last: $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | head -1) $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "load wait last: $(grep -a '\[load\] wait' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-220)"
  log "draw tops: $(grep -a -o 'zero_content [0-9.]*%' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "max rss bytes: $(grep -a '\[beat\] t=' "$DL" | sed -E 's/.*rss=([0-9]+).*/\1/' | sort -n | tail -1)"
  log "m6d counters: $(grep -a 'skip_heavy=' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-400)"
  log "rt fallback: $(grep -a -o 'rt_fallback=[0-9]*' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  # M6f evidence extracts
  grep -a '\[cpu\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/cpu.txt" && log "cpu lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/cpu.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[load\] objsig' "$DL" > "$OUT/objsig.txt" && log "objsig lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/objsig.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[ldr\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/ldr.txt" && log "ldr lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/ldr.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "ldr kinds: step=$(grep -ac '\[ldr\] step' "$OUT/ldr.txt" || true) objaddr=$(grep -ac '\[ldr\] objaddr' "$OUT/ldr.txt" || true) loop=$(grep -ac '\[ldr\] loop' "$OUT/ldr.txt" || true)"
  grep -a '\[load\] wait' "$DL" | grep -a thr=0x1001 > "$OUT/main_wait.txt"; log "main_wait lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/main_wait.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a -E '\[cfg\]|\[load\] frame|\[load\] io ' "$DL" > "$OUT/series_src.txt" && log "series_src lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/series_src.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  # 30 s opens/reads/submit series with submit-freeze flags (0-growth window = our loop stalled)
  awk '/\[load\] io t=/ { for (i=1;i<=NF;i++) { if ($i ~ /^opens=/) { sub("opens=","",$i); op=$i } if ($i ~ /^reads=/) { sub("reads=","",$i); rd=$i } } }
       /\[load\] frame t=/ { t=$3; for (i=1;i<=NF;i++) { if ($i ~ /^submit=/) { sub("submit=","",$i); sb=$i } if ($i ~ /^draws=/) { sub("draws=","",$i); dw=$i } }
         d=(psub>0)?(sb-psub):0; flag=(psub>0 && sb==psub)?"FROZEN":"-";
         printf "%s\topens=%s\treads=%s\tsubmit=%s\tfrozen=%s\tdraws=%s\n", t, op, rd, sb, flag, dw; psub=sb }' "$DL" > "$OUT/series2.tsv" 2>/dev/null
  log "series2 rows=$(wc -l < "$OUT/series2.tsv" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "cfg lines (expect 0): $(grep -ac '\[cfg\]' "$DL" || true)"
  log "cpu probe first/last: $(grep -a '\[cpu\] t=' "$DL" | grep -v 'threads=' | head -1 | cut -c1-160)"
fi
h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|Kill'" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/lmk.txt"
log "lmk lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/lmk.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
NEW=0
for cf in $(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r'); do
  grep -qxF "$cf" <<<"$CFLIST0" && continue
  NEW=$((NEW+1))
  h file recv "/data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/$cf" "$OUT/$cf" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    && log "!! NEW faultlog pulled: $cf" || log "!! NEW faultlog found but recv failed: $cf"
done
log "new_faultlog_count=$NEW"
log "alive=$ALIVE end=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 2
log "post stop pidof=[$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')]"
log "done"

```

```sh
  LV=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[io\] romfs' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  FR=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[load\] frame t=' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  WK=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[load\] wait' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$IO $LV" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  RD=$(grep -o 'reads=[0-9]*' <<<"$IO $LV" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); RD=${RD:-}
  SB=$(grep -o 'submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$FR" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SB=${SB:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$FR" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  WA=$(tr -d '\r' <<<"$WK" | cut -c1-150)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t-\n' "$EL" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${SB:-}" "${DW:-}" "$WA" >> "$TSV"
  if [ $(( EL - LASTRSS )) -ge 60 ]; then
    LASTRSS=$EL
    RS=$(h shell "grep VmRSS /proc/$P/status 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr -s ' ')
    WM=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\\[load\\] wait' | grep -a thr=0x1001 | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
    OB=$(grep -o 'obj=0x[0-9a-f]*' <<<"$WM" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); OB=${OB:-}
    ST=$(grep -o 'static=[0-9]*dumps' <<<"$WM" | tail -1); ST=${ST:-}; ST=${ST#static=}
    printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${SB:-}" "${DW:-}" "${OB:-}" "${ST:-}" >> "$TSV2"
    log "t=${EL}s RSS[$RS] log=$(( LS / 1048576 ))MiB opens=${OP:-?} reads=${RD:-?} submit=${SB:-?} draws=${DW:-?} main_obj=${OB:-?} static=${ST:-?}"
  fi
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 10
done

h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m6h_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m6h_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1

  log "io first/last: $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | head -1) $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "load wait last: $(grep -a '\[load\] wait' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-220)"
  log "draw tops: $(grep -a -o 'zero_content [0-9.]*%' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "max rss bytes: $(grep -a '\[beat\] t=' "$DL" | sed -E 's/.*rss=([0-9]+).*/\1/' | sort -n | tail -1)"
  log "m6d counters: $(grep -a 'skip_heavy=' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-400)"
  log "rt fallback: $(grep -a -o 'rt_fallback=[0-9]*' "$DL" | tail -1)"

  # M6h evidence extracts (task criteria 3/4/5)

  grep -a '\[ev\] txt'  "$DL" > "$OUT/ev_txt.txt"  && log "ev_txt lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/ev_txt.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[ev\] xfer' "$DL" > "$OUT/ev_xfer.txt" && log "ev_xfer lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/ev_xfer.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[own\]'     "$DL" > "$OUT/own.txt"     && log "own lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/own.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "ev_pair rows for rd=0x1024: $(grep -ac 'rd=0x1024' "$OUT/ev_pair.txt" || true)"
  grep -a '\[load\] objsig' "$DL" > "$OUT/objsig.txt" && log "objsig lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/objsig.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[ldr\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/ldr.txt" && log "ldr lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/ldr.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "ldr kinds: step=$(grep -ac '\[ldr\] step' "$OUT/ldr.txt" || true) objaddr=$(grep -ac '\[ldr\] objaddr' "$OUT/ldr.txt" || true) loop=$(grep -ac '\[ldr\] loop' "$OUT/ldr.txt" || true)"
  grep -a '\[load\] wait' "$DL" | grep -a thr=0x1001 > "$OUT/main_wait.txt"; log "main_wait lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/main_wait.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a -E '\[cfg\]|\[load\] frame|\[load\] io ' "$DL" > "$OUT/series_src.txt" && log "series_src lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/series_src.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  # 30 s opens/reads/submit series with submit-freeze flags (0-growth window = our loop stalled)
  awk '/\[load\] io t=/ { for (i=1;i<=NF;i++) { if ($i ~ /^opens=/) { sub("opens=","",$i); op=$i } if ($i ~ /^reads=/) { sub("reads=","",$i); rd=$i } } }
       /\[load\] frame t=/ { t=$3; for (i=1;i<=NF;i++) { if ($i ~ /^submit=/) { sub("submit=","",$i); sb=$i } if ($i ~ /^draws=/) { sub("draws=","",$i); dw=$i } }
         d=(psub>0)?(sb-psub):0; flag=(psub>0 && sb==psub)?"FROZEN":"-";
         printf "%s\topens=%s\treads=%s\tsubmit=%s\tfrozen=%s\tdraws=%s\n", t, op, rd, sb, flag, dw; psub=sb }' "$DL" > "$OUT/series2.tsv" 2>/dev/null
  log "series2 rows=$(wc -l < "$OUT/series2.tsv" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "cfg lines (expect 0): $(grep -ac '\[cfg\]' "$DL" || true)"
  log "cpu probe first/last: $(grep -a '\[cpu\] t=' "$DL" | grep -v 'threads=' | head -1 | cut -c1-160)"
fi
h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|Kill'" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/lmk.txt"
log "lmk lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/lmk.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
NEW=0
for cf in $(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r'); do
  grep -qxF "$cf" <<<"$CFLIST0" && continue
  NEW=$((NEW+1))
  h file recv "/data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/$cf" "$OUT/$cf" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    && log "!! NEW faultlog pulled: $cf" || log "!! NEW faultlog found but recv failed: $cf"
done
log "new_faultlog_count=$NEW"
log "alive=$ALIVE end=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 2
log "post stop pidof=[$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')]"
log "done"
```

```sh
# the C side). Same 30 s dump cadence as M6g.
# Usage: bash m6i_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds=900]

DUR="${2:-900}"

[ "$SZ" = "0" ] || { log "X log not reset: mode=$MODE size=$SZ"; exit 1; }

UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)

  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$P" ] && break
  h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3
done
P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
[ -n "$P" ] && { log "X pid still $P before boot"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty -> ignite"

while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }

    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') dmesg=$(wc -l < "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ')"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$P" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $P at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$P"; fi

  if [ $(( EL - LASTPOKE )) -ge 28 ]; then

    IOW=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\\[io\\] wait' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')

  log "ldr kinds: step=$(grep -ac '\[ldr\] step' "$OUT/ldr.txt" || true) objaddr=$(grep -ac '\[ldr\] objaddr' "$OUT/ldr.txt" || true) loop=$(grep -ac '\[ldr\] loop' "$OUT/ldr.txt" || true)"
  grep -a '\[load\] wait' "$DL" | grep -a thr=0x1001 > "$OUT/main_wait.txt"; log "main_wait lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/main_wait.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a -E '\[cfg\]|\[load\] frame|\[load\] io ' "$DL" > "$OUT/series_src.txt" && log "series_src lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/series_src.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  # 30 s opens/reads/submit series with submit-freeze flags (0-growth window = our loop stalled)
  awk '/\[load\] io t=/ { for (i=1;i<=NF;i++) { if ($i ~ /^opens=/) { sub("opens=","",$i); op=$i } if ($i ~ /^reads=/) { sub("reads=","",$i); rd=$i } } }
       /\[load\] frame t=/ { t=$3; for (i=1;i<=NF;i++) { if ($i ~ /^submit=/) { sub("submit=","",$i); sb=$i } if ($i ~ /^draws=/) { sub("draws=","",$i); dw=$i } }
         d=(psub>0)?(sb-psub):0; flag=(psub>0 && sb==psub)?"FROZEN":"-";
         printf "%s\topens=%s\treads=%s\tsubmit=%s\tfrozen=%s\tdraws=%s\n", t, op, rd, sb, flag, dw; psub=sb }' "$DL" > "$OUT/series2.tsv" 2>/dev/null
  log "series2 rows=$(wc -l < "$OUT/series2.tsv" | tr -d ' ')"
  # M6i criteria 3/4/5: per-thread I/O + IPC rows, the rank-1 wait line, its SVC histogram
  grep -a '\[io\] thr' "$DL" > "$OUT/io_thr.txt"; log "io thr lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/io_thr.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[io\] wait' "$DL" > "$OUT/io_wait.txt"; log "io wait lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/io_wait.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[io\] svc'  "$DL" > "$OUT/io_svc.txt";  log "io svc lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/io_svc.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "io rank1 wait last: $(tail -1 "$OUT/io_wait.txt" | cut -c1-260)"
  log "cfg lines (expect 0): $(grep -ac '\[cfg\]' "$DL" || true)"
  log "cpu probe first/last: $(grep -a '\[cpu\] t=' "$DL" | grep -v 'threads=' | head -1 | cut -c1-160)"
fi
h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|Kill'" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/lmk.txt"
log "lmk lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/lmk.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
NEW=0
for cf in $(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r'); do
  grep -qxF "$cf" <<<"$CFLIST0" && continue
  NEW=$((NEW+1))
  h file recv "/data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/$cf" "$OUT/$cf" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    && log "!! NEW faultlog pulled: $cf" || log "!! NEW faultlog found but recv failed: $cf"
done
log "new_faultlog_count=$NEW"
log "alive=$ALIVE end=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 2
log "post stop pidof=[$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')]"
log "done"
```

`m6j_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M6j: event pair / write end / owner thread forensics ([ev] pair, [ev] txt, [own] come from
# the C side). Same 30 s dump cadence as M6g.
# Usage: bash m6j_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds=900]
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: m6j_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]}"
DUR="${2:-900}"
TESTKEY="${TESTKEY:-1 225 1000 5000 30 38:10,36:20}"
TESTSTICK="${TESTSTICK:-1 700 2000}"
GD_SEC="${GD_SEC:-30}"
SYNTH="${SYNTH:-1}"
FRAMES="${FRAMES:-8}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
TGT="127.0.0.1:5555"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m6j_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M6j tag=$TAG dur=${DUR}s out=$OUT synth=$SYNTH frames=$FRAMES gd_sec=$GD_SEC testkey='$TESTKEY'"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target offline ($TGT)"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing: $HAP"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

for i in 1 2 3; do
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$P" ] && break
  log "pre-stop: pid=$P -> aa force-stop"
  h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3
done
P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
[ -n "$P" ] && { log "X pid $P still running before log handling"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty (pre-flight)"

PRE=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); PRE=${PRE:-0}
log "pre vk_boot.log size=$PRE bytes"
MODE="truncate(:>)"
if ! h shell ": > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  MODE="rm -f (recreate on open)"; h shell "rm -f $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
fi
SZ=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); SZ=${SZ:-0}
[ "$SZ" = "0" ] || { log "X log not reset: mode=$MODE size=$SZ"; exit 1; }
log "log reset ok: mode=$MODE before=$PRE after=$SZ"

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"
OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); log "install: $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 300)"
grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_after: $UPD1"
[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

for i in 1 2 3; do
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$P" ] && break
  h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3
done
P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
[ -n "$P" ] && { log "X pid still $P before boot"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty -> ignite"

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
log "faultlog_before entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST0" | grep -c .)"

h shell "echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_snap_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_present_gain; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_gpres" >/dev/null 2>&1
TKWR=$(h shell "printf '%s' '$TESTKEY' > $FILES/smo_testkey && echo WROTE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
log "testkey write: ${TKWR:-<no output>} value=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')]"
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_movie_kick; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
# M6g: plain integer cadence only (the M6f "sw=" worker switch has been removed from the code).
h shell "echo '$GD_SEC' > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "rm -f $FILES/SwiftShader.ini" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "gdump_sec file=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" | tr -d '\r')] ini_left=$(h shell "ls $FILES/SwiftShader.ini 2>/dev/null | wc -l" | tr -d '\r')"
log "movie switches before boot: kick=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_kick" | tr -d '\r') gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" | tr -d '\r')"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 1800000" >/dev/null 2>&1

h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
START=$(date +%s)
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 2
done

h shell "echo $SYNTH > $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null; echo $FRAMES > $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null; echo '$TESTSTICK' > $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "switches after seed: synth=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] frames=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] stick=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] testkey=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m6j_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m6j_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}
PLAN="${PLAN:-240 600 900}"
TSV2="$OUT/chain60.tsv"; printf 't\topens\treads\tsubmit\tdraws\tobj\tstatic\n' > "$TSV2"
LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; POKE=0; LASTPOKE=-1; LASTRSS=0
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"
printf 't\topens\treads\tsubmit\tdraws\tload_wait\tfps\n' > "$TSV"
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$P" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "dmesg 2>/dev/null | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|Kill|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR' | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') dmesg=$(wc -l < "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ')"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$P" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $P at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$P"; fi
  # 30 s probe cadence: one gdump request per tick (the C side honours smo_gdump_sec=30 too)
  if [ $(( EL - LASTPOKE )) -ge 28 ]; then
    LASTPOKE=$EL; POKE=$((POKE+1))
    h shell "echo $POKE > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  LS=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); LS=${LS:-0}
  IO=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[load\] io t=' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  LV=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[io\] romfs' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  FR=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[load\] frame t=' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  WK=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[load\] wait' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$IO $LV" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  RD=$(grep -o 'reads=[0-9]*' <<<"$IO $LV" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); RD=${RD:-}
  SB=$(grep -o 'submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$FR" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SB=${SB:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$FR" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  WA=$(tr -d '\r' <<<"$WK" | cut -c1-150)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t-\n' "$EL" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${SB:-}" "${DW:-}" "$WA" >> "$TSV"
  if [ $(( EL - LASTRSS )) -ge 60 ]; then
    LASTRSS=$EL
    RS=$(h shell "grep VmRSS /proc/$P/status 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr -s ' ')
    WM=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\\[load\\] wait' | grep -a thr=0x1001 | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
    OB=$(grep -o 'obj=0x[0-9a-f]*' <<<"$WM" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); OB=${OB:-}
    ST=$(grep -o 'static=[0-9]*dumps' <<<"$WM" | tail -1); ST=${ST:-}; ST=${ST#static=}
    printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${SB:-}" "${DW:-}" "${OB:-}" "${ST:-}" >> "$TSV2"
    IOW=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\\[io\\] wait' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
    IOR=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\\[io\\] thr=' | grep -a 'rank=0 ' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s RSS[$RS] log=$(( LS / 1048576 ))MiB opens=${OP:-?} reads=${RD:-?} submit=${SB:-?} draws=${DW:-?} main_obj=${OB:-?} static=${ST:-?}"
    log "   io_rank1 $(cut -c1-300 <<<"$IOR")"
    log "   io_wait  $(cut -c1-300 <<<"$IOW")"
  fi
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 10
done

h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m6j_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m6j_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_fin.png" >/dev/null 2>&1 && log "screen_fin md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_fin.png") @t=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1
if [ -f "$OUT/vk_boot.log" ]; then
  mv "$OUT/vk_boot.log" "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log"
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log" | tr -d ' ')"
else log "X vk_boot.log pull failed"; fi
DL="$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "PERF LINES:"; grep -a '\[perf\]' "$DL" | cut -c1-700 | tee -a "$OUT/perf.txt"
  log "draws samples:"; grep -a '\[r\] draw totals' "$DL" | cut -c1-320 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "io first/last: $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | head -1) $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "load wait last: $(grep -a '\[load\] wait' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-220)"
  log "draw tops: $(grep -a -o 'zero_content [0-9.]*%' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "max rss bytes: $(grep -a '\[beat\] t=' "$DL" | sed -E 's/.*rss=([0-9]+).*/\1/' | sort -n | tail -1)"
  log "m6d counters: $(grep -a 'skip_heavy=' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-400)"
  log "rt fallback: $(grep -a -o 'rt_fallback=[0-9]*' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  # M6f evidence extracts
  grep -a '\[cpu\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/cpu.txt" && log "cpu lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/cpu.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  # M6j evidence extracts (task criteria 3/4/5)
  grep -a '\[ev\] pair' "$DL" > "$OUT/ev_pair.txt" && log "ev_pair lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/ev_pair.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[ev\] txt'  "$DL" > "$OUT/ev_txt.txt"  && log "ev_txt lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/ev_txt.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[ev\] xfer' "$DL" > "$OUT/ev_xfer.txt" && log "ev_xfer lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/ev_xfer.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[own\]'     "$DL" > "$OUT/own.txt"     && log "own lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/own.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "ev_pair rows for rd=0x1024: $(grep -ac 'rd=0x1024' "$OUT/ev_pair.txt" || true)"
  grep -a '\[load\] objsig' "$DL" > "$OUT/objsig.txt" && log "objsig lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/objsig.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[ldr\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/ldr.txt" && log "ldr lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/ldr.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "ldr kinds: step=$(grep -ac '\[ldr\] step' "$OUT/ldr.txt" || true) objaddr=$(grep -ac '\[ldr\] objaddr' "$OUT/ldr.txt" || true) loop=$(grep -ac '\[ldr\] loop' "$OUT/ldr.txt" || true)"
  grep -a '\[load\] wait' "$DL" | grep -a thr=0x1001 > "$OUT/main_wait.txt"; log "main_wait lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/main_wait.txt" | tr -d ' ')"

  # 30 s opens/reads/submit series with submit-freeze flags (0-growth window = our loop stalled)
```
