```sh
[ -n "$P" ] && { log "X pid $P still running before log handling"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty (pre-flight)"

PRE=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); PRE=${PRE:-0}
log "pre vk_boot.log size=$PRE bytes"
MODE="truncate(:>)"
if ! h shell ": > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  MODE="rm -f (recreate on open)"; h shell "rm -f $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
fi
SZ=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); SZ=${SZ:-0}
[ "$SZ" = "0" ] || { log "X log not reset: mode=$MODE size=$SZ"; exit 1; }
log "log reset ok: mode=$MODE before=$PRE after=$SZ"

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"
OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); log "install: $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 300)"
grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_after: $UPD1"
[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

for i in 1 2 3; do
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$P" ] && break
  h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3
done
P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
[ -n "$P" ] && { log "X pid still $P before boot"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty -> ignite"

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
log "faultlog_before entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST0" | grep -c .)"

h shell "echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_snap_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_present_gain; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_gpres" >/dev/null 2>&1
TKWR=$(h shell "printf '%s' '$TESTKEY' > $FILES/smo_testkey && echo WROTE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
log "testkey write: ${TKWR:-<no output>} value=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')]"
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_movie_kick; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
# M6g: plain integer cadence only (the M6f "sw=" worker switch has been removed from the code).
h shell "echo '$GD_SEC' > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "rm -f $FILES/SwiftShader.ini" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "gdump_sec file=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" | tr -d '\r')] ini_left=$(h shell "ls $FILES/SwiftShader.ini 2>/dev/null | wc -l" | tr -d '\r')"
log "movie switches before boot: kick=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_kick" | tr -d '\r') gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" | tr -d '\r')"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 1800000" >/dev/null 2>&1

h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
START=$(date +%s)
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 2
done

h shell "echo $SYNTH > $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null; echo $FRAMES > $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null; echo '$TESTSTICK' > $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "switches after seed: synth=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] frames=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] stick=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] testkey=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m6k_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m6k_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}
PLAN="${PLAN:-240 600 900}"
TSV2="$OUT/chain60.tsv"; printf 't\topens\treads\tsubmit\tdraws\tobj\tstatic\n' > "$TSV2"
LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; POKE=0; LASTPOKE=-1; LASTRSS=0
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"
printf 't\topens\treads\tsubmit\tdraws\tload_wait\tfps\n' > "$TSV"
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$P" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "dmesg 2>/dev/null | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|Kill|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR' | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') dmesg=$(wc -l < "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ')"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$P" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $P at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$P"; fi
  # 30 s probe cadence: one gdump request per tick (the C side honours smo_gdump_sec=30 too)
  if [ $(( EL - LASTPOKE )) -ge 28 ]; then
    LASTPOKE=$EL; POKE=$((POKE+1))
    h shell "echo $POKE > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  LS=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); LS=${LS:-0}
  IO=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[load\] io t=' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  LV=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[io\] romfs' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  FR=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[load\] frame t=' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  WK=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[load\] wait' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$IO $LV" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  RD=$(grep -o 'reads=[0-9]*' <<<"$IO $LV" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); RD=${RD:-}
  SB=$(grep -o 'submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$FR" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SB=${SB:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$FR" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  WA=$(tr -d '\r' <<<"$WK" | cut -c1-150)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t-\n' "$EL" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${SB:-}" "${DW:-}" "$WA" >> "$TSV"
  if [ $(( EL - LASTRSS )) -ge 60 ]; then
    LASTRSS=$EL
    RS=$(h shell "grep VmRSS /proc/$P/status 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr -s ' ')
    WM=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\\[load\\] wait' | grep -a thr=0x1001 | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
    OB=$(grep -o 'obj=0x[0-9a-f]*' <<<"$WM" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); OB=${OB:-}
    ST=$(grep -o 'static=[0-9]*dumps' <<<"$WM" | tail -1); ST=${ST:-}; ST=${ST#static=}
    printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${SB:-}" "${DW:-}" "${OB:-}" "${ST:-}" >> "$TSV2"
    IOW=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\\[io\\] wait' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
    IOR=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\\[io\\] thr=' | grep -a 'rank=0 ' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s RSS[$RS] log=$(( LS / 1048576 ))MiB opens=${OP:-?} reads=${RD:-?} submit=${SB:-?} draws=${DW:-?} main_obj=${OB:-?} static=${ST:-?}"
    log "   io_rank1 $(cut -c1-300 <<<"$IOR")"
    log "   io_wait  $(cut -c1-300 <<<"$IOW")"
  fi
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 10
done

h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m6k_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m6k_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_fin.png" >/dev/null 2>&1 && log "screen_fin md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_fin.png") @t=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1
if [ -f "$OUT/vk_boot.log" ]; then
  mv "$OUT/vk_boot.log" "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log"
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log" | tr -d ' ')"
else log "X vk_boot.log pull failed"; fi
DL="$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "PERF LINES:"; grep -a '\[perf\]' "$DL" | cut -c1-700 | tee -a "$OUT/perf.txt"
  log "draws samples:"; grep -a '\[r\] draw totals' "$DL" | cut -c1-320 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "io first/last: $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | head -1) $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "load wait last: $(grep -a '\[load\] wait' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-220)"
  log "draw tops: $(grep -a -o 'zero_content [0-9.]*%' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "max rss bytes: $(grep -a '\[beat\] t=' "$DL" | sed -E 's/.*rss=([0-9]+).*/\1/' | sort -n | tail -1)"
  log "m6d counters: $(grep -a 'skip_heavy=' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-400)"
  log "rt fallback: $(grep -a -o 'rt_fallback=[0-9]*' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  # M6f evidence extracts
  grep -a '\[cpu\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/cpu.txt" && log "cpu lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/cpu.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  # M6k evidence extracts (task criteria 3/4/5)
  grep -a '\[ev\] pair' "$DL" > "$OUT/ev_pair.txt" && log "ev_pair lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/ev_pair.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[ev\] txt'  "$DL" > "$OUT/ev_txt.txt"  && log "ev_txt lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/ev_txt.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[ev\] xfer' "$DL" > "$OUT/ev_xfer.txt" && log "ev_xfer lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/ev_xfer.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[own\]'     "$DL" > "$OUT/own.txt"     && log "own lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/own.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "ev_pair rows for rd=0x1024: $(grep -ac 'rd=0x1024' "$OUT/ev_pair.txt" || true)"
  grep -a '\[load\] objsig' "$DL" > "$OUT/objsig.txt" && log "objsig lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/objsig.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[ldr\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/ldr.txt" && log "ldr lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/ldr.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "ldr kinds: step=$(grep -ac '\[ldr\] step' "$OUT/ldr.txt" || true) objaddr=$(grep -ac '\[ldr\] objaddr' "$OUT/ldr.txt" || true) loop=$(grep -ac '\[ldr\] loop' "$OUT/ldr.txt" || true)"
  grep -a '\[load\] wait' "$DL" | grep -a thr=0x1001 > "$OUT/main_wait.txt"; log "main_wait lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/main_wait.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a -E '\[cfg\]|\[load\] frame|\[load\] io ' "$DL" > "$OUT/series_src.txt" && log "series_src lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/series_src.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  # 30 s opens/reads/submit series with submit-freeze flags (0-growth window = our loop stalled)
  awk '/\[load\] io t=/ { for (i=1;i<=NF;i++) { if ($i ~ /^opens=/) { sub("opens=","",$i); op=$i } if ($i ~ /^reads=/) { sub("reads=","",$i); rd=$i } } }
       /\[load\] frame t=/ { t=$3; for (i=1;i<=NF;i++) { if ($i ~ /^submit=/) { sub("submit=","",$i); sb=$i } if ($i ~ /^draws=/) { sub("draws=","",$i); dw=$i } }
         d=(psub>0)?(sb-psub):0; flag=(psub>0 && sb==psub)?"FROZEN":"-";
         printf "%s\topens=%s\treads=%s\tsubmit=%s\tfrozen=%s\tdraws=%s\n", t, op, rd, sb, flag, dw; psub=sb }' "$DL" > "$OUT/series2.tsv" 2>/dev/null
  log "series2 rows=$(wc -l < "$OUT/series2.tsv" | tr -d ' ')"
  # M6k criteria 3/4/5: per-thread I/O + IPC rows, the rank-1 wait line, its SVC histogram
  grep -a '\[io\] thr' "$DL" > "$OUT/io_thr.txt"; log "io thr lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/io_thr.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[io\] wait' "$DL" > "$OUT/io_wait.txt"; log "io wait lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/io_wait.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[io\] svc'  "$DL" > "$OUT/io_svc.txt";  log "io svc lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/io_svc.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "io rank1 wait last: $(tail -1 "$OUT/io_wait.txt" | cut -c1-260)"
  log "cfg lines (expect 0): $(grep -ac '\[cfg\]' "$DL" || true)"
  log "cpu probe first/last: $(grep -a '\[cpu\] t=' "$DL" | grep -v 'threads=' | head -1 | cut -c1-160)"
  # M6k-A extracts: the 0x102f trail, its wait/sig lines, the addr table, its guest frames
  grep -a '\[t102f\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/t102f.txt"; log "t102f lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/t102f.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "t102f kinds: k=$(grep -ac '\[t102f\] k=' "$OUT/t102f.txt" || true) hist=$(grep -ac '\[t102f\] hist t=' "$OUT/t102f.txt" || true) sig=$(grep -ac '\[t102f\] sig ' "$OUT/t102f.txt" || true) wait=$(grep -ac '\[t102f\] wait ' "$OUT/t102f.txt" || true) obj=$(grep -ac '\[t102f\] obj' "$OUT/t102f.txt" || true) inflag=$(grep -ac '\[t102f\] inflag' "$OUT/t102f.txt" || true)"
  grep -a '\[load\] addr' "$DL" > "$OUT/addr.txt"; log "addr lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/addr.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "addr word of 0x6ea8bf3ca8: $(grep -a 'addr=0x6ea8bf3ca8' "$OUT/addr.txt" | tail -1 | cut -c1-220)"
  log "addr chg rows: $(grep -ac 'chg=1' "$OUT/addr.txt" || true)"
  grep -a '\[gst\] chain h=0x102f' "$DL" > "$OUT/chain102f.txt"; log "chain102f lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/chain102f.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "t102f first rows:"; head -3 "$OUT/t102f.txt" | cut -c1-240 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
fi
h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|Kill'" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/lmk.txt"
log "lmk lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/lmk.txt" | tr -d ' ')"

  grep -qxF "$cf" <<<"$CFLIST0" && continue
  NEW=$((NEW+1))
  h file recv "/data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/$cf" "$OUT/$cf" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    && log "!! NEW faultlog pulled: $cf" || log "!! NEW faultlog found but recv failed: $cf"
done
log "new_faultlog_count=$NEW"
log "alive=$ALIVE end=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 2
log "post stop pidof=[$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')]"
log "done"
```

```sh
SYNTH="${SYNTH:-1}"

OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); log "install: $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 300)"
grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_after: $UPD1"
[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

for i in 1 2 3; do
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$P" ] && break
  h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3
done
P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
[ -n "$P" ] && { log "X pid still $P before boot"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty -> ignite"

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
log "faultlog_before entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST0" | grep -c .)"

h shell "echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_snap_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_present_gain; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_gpres" >/dev/null 2>&1
TKWR=$(h shell "printf '%s' '$TESTKEY' > $FILES/smo_testkey && echo WROTE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
log "testkey write: ${TKWR:-<no output>} value=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')]"
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_movie_kick; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
# M6g: plain integer cadence only (the M6f "sw=" worker switch has been removed from the code).
h shell "echo '$GD_SEC' > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "rm -f $FILES/SwiftShader.ini" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "gdump_sec file=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" | tr -d '\r')] ini_left=$(h shell "ls $FILES/SwiftShader.ini 2>/dev/null | wc -l" | tr -d '\r')"
log "movie switches before boot: kick=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_kick" | tr -d '\r') gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" | tr -d '\r')"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1

while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')

  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 2
done

h shell "echo $SYNTH > $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null; echo $FRAMES > $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null; echo '$TESTSTICK' > $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "switches after seed: synth=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] frames=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] stick=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] testkey=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m6l_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m6l_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}
PLAN="${PLAN:-240 600 900}"
TSV2="$OUT/chain60.tsv"; printf 't\topens\treads\tsubmit\tdraws\tobj\tstatic\n' > "$TSV2"
LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; POKE=0; LASTPOKE=-1; LASTRSS=0
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"
printf 't\topens\treads\tsubmit\tdraws\tload_wait\tfps\n' > "$TSV"
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$P" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "dmesg 2>/dev/null | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|Kill|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR' | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') dmesg=$(wc -l < "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ')"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$P" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $P at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$P"; fi
  # 30 s probe cadence: one gdump request per tick (the C side honours smo_gdump_sec=30 too)
  if [ $(( EL - LASTPOKE )) -ge 28 ]; then
    LASTPOKE=$EL; POKE=$((POKE+1))
    h shell "echo $POKE > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  LS=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); LS=${LS:-0}
  IO=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[load\] io t=' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  LV=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[io\] romfs' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  FR=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[load\] frame t=' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  WK=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[load\] wait' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$IO $LV" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  RD=$(grep -o 'reads=[0-9]*' <<<"$IO $LV" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); RD=${RD:-}
  SB=$(grep -o 'submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$FR" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SB=${SB:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$FR" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  WA=$(tr -d '\r' <<<"$WK" | cut -c1-150)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t-\n' "$EL" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${SB:-}" "${DW:-}" "$WA" >> "$TSV"
  if [ $(( EL - LASTRSS )) -ge 60 ]; then
    LASTRSS=$EL
    RS=$(h shell "grep VmRSS /proc/$P/status 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr -s ' ')
    WM=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\\[load\\] wait' | grep -a thr=0x1001 | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
    OB=$(grep -o 'obj=0x[0-9a-f]*' <<<"$WM" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); OB=${OB:-}
    ST=$(grep -o 'static=[0-9]*dumps' <<<"$WM" | tail -1); ST=${ST:-}; ST=${ST#static=}
    printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${SB:-}" "${DW:-}" "${OB:-}" "${ST:-}" >> "$TSV2"
    IOW=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\\[io\\] wait' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
    IOR=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\\[io\\] thr=' | grep -a 'rank=0 ' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s RSS[$RS] log=$(( LS / 1048576 ))MiB opens=${OP:-?} reads=${RD:-?} submit=${SB:-?} draws=${DW:-?} main_obj=${OB:-?} static=${ST:-?}"
    log "   io_rank1 $(cut -c1-300 <<<"$IOR")"
    log "   io_wait  $(cut -c1-300 <<<"$IOW")"
  fi
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 10
done

h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m6l_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m6l_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_fin.png" >/dev/null 2>&1 && log "screen_fin md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_fin.png") @t=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1
if [ -f "$OUT/vk_boot.log" ]; then
  mv "$OUT/vk_boot.log" "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log"
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log" | tr -d ' ')"
else log "X vk_boot.log pull failed"; fi
DL="$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "PERF LINES:"; grep -a '\[perf\]' "$DL" | cut -c1-700 | tee -a "$OUT/perf.txt"
  log "draws samples:"; grep -a '\[r\] draw totals' "$DL" | cut -c1-320 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "io first/last: $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | head -1) $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "load wait last: $(grep -a '\[load\] wait' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-220)"
  log "draw tops: $(grep -a -o 'zero_content [0-9.]*%' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "max rss bytes: $(grep -a '\[beat\] t=' "$DL" | sed -E 's/.*rss=([0-9]+).*/\1/' | sort -n | tail -1)"
  log "m6d counters: $(grep -a 'skip_heavy=' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-400)"
  log "rt fallback: $(grep -a -o 'rt_fallback=[0-9]*' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  # M6f evidence extracts
  grep -a '\[cpu\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/cpu.txt" && log "cpu lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/cpu.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  # M6l evidence extracts (task criteria 3/4/5)
  grep -a '\[ev\] pair' "$DL" > "$OUT/ev_pair.txt" && log "ev_pair lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/ev_pair.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[ev\] txt'  "$DL" > "$OUT/ev_txt.txt"  && log "ev_txt lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/ev_txt.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[ev\] xfer' "$DL" > "$OUT/ev_xfer.txt" && log "ev_xfer lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/ev_xfer.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[own\]'     "$DL" > "$OUT/own.txt"     && log "own lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/own.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "ev_pair rows for rd=0x1024: $(grep -ac 'rd=0x1024' "$OUT/ev_pair.txt" || true)"
  grep -a '\[load\] objsig' "$DL" > "$OUT/objsig.txt" && log "objsig lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/objsig.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[ldr\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/ldr.txt" && log "ldr lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/ldr.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "ldr kinds: step=$(grep -ac '\[ldr\] step' "$OUT/ldr.txt" || true) objaddr=$(grep -ac '\[ldr\] objaddr' "$OUT/ldr.txt" || true) loop=$(grep -ac '\[ldr\] loop' "$OUT/ldr.txt" || true)"
  grep -a '\[load\] wait' "$DL" | grep -a thr=0x1001 > "$OUT/main_wait.txt"; log "main_wait lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/main_wait.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a -E '\[cfg\]|\[load\] frame|\[load\] io ' "$DL" > "$OUT/series_src.txt" && log "series_src lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/series_src.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  # 30 s opens/reads/submit series with submit-freeze flags (0-growth window = our loop stalled)
  awk '/\[load\] io t=/ { for (i=1;i<=NF;i++) { if ($i ~ /^opens=/) { sub("opens=","",$i); op=$i } if ($i ~ /^reads=/) { sub("reads=","",$i); rd=$i } } }
       /\[load\] frame t=/ { t=$3; for (i=1;i<=NF;i++) { if ($i ~ /^submit=/) { sub("submit=","",$i); sb=$i } if ($i ~ /^draws=/) { sub("draws=","",$i); dw=$i } }
         d=(psub>0)?(sb-psub):0; flag=(psub>0 && sb==psub)?"FROZEN":"-";
         printf "%s\topens=%s\treads=%s\tsubmit=%s\tfrozen=%s\tdraws=%s\n", t, op, rd, sb, flag, dw; psub=sb }' "$DL" > "$OUT/series2.tsv" 2>/dev/null
  log "series2 rows=$(wc -l < "$OUT/series2.tsv" | tr -d ' ')"
  # M6l criteria 3/4/5: per-thread I/O + IPC rows, the rank-1 wait line, its SVC histogram
  grep -a '\[io\] thr' "$DL" > "$OUT/io_thr.txt"; log "io thr lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/io_thr.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[io\] wait' "$DL" > "$OUT/io_wait.txt"; log "io wait lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/io_wait.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[io\] svc'  "$DL" > "$OUT/io_svc.txt";  log "io svc lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/io_svc.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "io rank1 wait last: $(tail -1 "$OUT/io_wait.txt" | cut -c1-260)"
  log "cfg lines (expect 0): $(grep -ac '\[cfg\]' "$DL" || true)"
  log "cpu probe first/last: $(grep -a '\[cpu\] t=' "$DL" | grep -v 'threads=' | head -1 | cut -c1-160)"
  # M6l-A extracts: the 0x102f trail, its wait/sig lines, the addr table, its guest frames
  grep -a '\[t102f\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/t102f.txt"; log "t102f lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/t102f.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "t102f kinds: k=$(grep -ac '\[t102f\] k=' "$OUT/t102f.txt" || true) hist=$(grep -ac '\[t102f\] hist t=' "$OUT/t102f.txt" || true) sig=$(grep -ac '\[t102f\] sig ' "$OUT/t102f.txt" || true) wait=$(grep -ac '\[t102f\] wait ' "$OUT/t102f.txt" || true) obj=$(grep -ac '\[t102f\] obj' "$OUT/t102f.txt" || true) inflag=$(grep -ac '\[t102f\] inflag' "$OUT/t102f.txt" || true)"
  grep -a '\[load\] addr' "$DL" > "$OUT/addr.txt"; log "addr lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/addr.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "addr word of 0x6ea8bf3ca8: $(grep -a 'addr=0x6ea8bf3ca8' "$OUT/addr.txt" | tail -1 | cut -c1-220)"
  log "addr chg rows: $(grep -ac 'chg=1' "$OUT/addr.txt" || true)"
  grep -a '\[gst\] chain h=0x102f' "$DL" > "$OUT/chain102f.txt"; log "chain102f lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/chain102f.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "t102f first rows:"; head -3 "$OUT/t102f.txt" | cut -c1-240 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  # M6l extracts: the role-key tables (loader / clipping), the mover table, the lock word window

  grep -a '\[lp\] mover' "$DL" > "$OUT/lp_mover.txt"; log "lp mover lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/lp_mover.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "lp poster last two:"; tail -2 "$OUT/lp_poster.txt" | cut -c1-330 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "lp postkey last:"; tail -4 "$OUT/lp_postkey.txt" | cut -c1-330 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "lp mover last:"; tail -5 "$OUT/lp_mover.txt" | cut -c1-330 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "lp obj last:"; tail -2 "$OUT/lp_obj.txt" | cut -c1-330 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"

  grep -qxF "$cf" <<<"$CFLIST0" && continue
  NEW=$((NEW+1))
  h file recv "/data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/$cf" "$OUT/$cf" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
    && log "!! NEW faultlog pulled: $cf" || log "!! NEW faultlog found but recv failed: $cf"

h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 2
log "post stop pidof=[$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')]"
```

`m6n_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
# the C side). Same 30 s dump cadence as M6g.
# Usage: bash m6n_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds=900]
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: m6n_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]}"
DUR="${2:-900}"
TESTKEY="${TESTKEY:-1 225 1000 5000 30 38:10,36:20}"
TESTSTICK="${TESTSTICK:-1 700 2000}"
GD_SEC="${GD_SEC:-30}"
SYNTH="${SYNTH:-1}"
FRAMES="${FRAMES:-8}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
TGT="127.0.0.1:5555"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m6n_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target offline ($TGT)"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing: $HAP"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

for i in 1 2 3; do
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$P" ] && break
  log "pre-stop: pid=$P -> aa force-stop"
  h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3
done
P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
[ -n "$P" ] && { log "X pid $P still running before log handling"; exit 1; }

grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_after: $UPD1"
[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

for i in 1 2 3; do
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$P" ] && break
  h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3
done
P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
[ -n "$P" ] && { log "X pid still $P before boot"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty -> ignite"

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
log "faultlog_before entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST0" | grep -c .)"

h shell "echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_snap_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_present_gain; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_gpres" >/dev/null 2>&1
TKWR=$(h shell "printf '%s' '$TESTKEY' > $FILES/smo_testkey && echo WROTE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
log "testkey write: ${TKWR:-<no output>} value=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')]"
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_movie_kick; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
# M6g: plain integer cadence only (the M6f "sw=" worker switch has been removed from the code).
h shell "echo '$GD_SEC' > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "rm -f $FILES/SwiftShader.ini" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "gdump_sec file=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" | tr -d '\r')] ini_left=$(h shell "ls $FILES/SwiftShader.ini 2>/dev/null | wc -l" | tr -d '\r')"
log "movie switches before boot: kick=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_kick" | tr -d '\r') gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" | tr -d '\r')"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 1800000" >/dev/null 2>&1

h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
START=$(date +%s)
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 2
done

h shell "echo $SYNTH > $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null; echo $FRAMES > $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null; echo '$TESTSTICK' > $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "switches after seed: synth=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] frames=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] stick=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] testkey=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m6n_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m6n_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}
PLAN="${PLAN:-240 600 900}"
TSV2="$OUT/chain60.tsv"; printf 't\topens\treads\tsubmit\tdraws\tobj\tstatic\n' > "$TSV2"
LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; POKE=0; LASTPOKE=-1; LASTRSS=0
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"
printf 't\topens\treads\tsubmit\tdraws\tload_wait\tfps\n' > "$TSV"
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$P" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "dmesg 2>/dev/null | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|Kill|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR' | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') dmesg=$(wc -l < "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ')"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$P" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $P at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$P"; fi
  # 30 s probe cadence: one gdump request per tick (the C side honours smo_gdump_sec=30 too)
  if [ $(( EL - LASTPOKE )) -ge 28 ]; then
    LASTPOKE=$EL; POKE=$((POKE+1))
    h shell "echo $POKE > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  LS=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); LS=${LS:-0}
  IO=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[load\] io t=' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  LV=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[io\] romfs' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  FR=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[load\] frame t=' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  WK=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[load\] wait' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$IO $LV" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  RD=$(grep -o 'reads=[0-9]*' <<<"$IO $LV" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); RD=${RD:-}
  SB=$(grep -o 'submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$FR" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SB=${SB:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$FR" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  WA=$(tr -d '\r' <<<"$WK" | cut -c1-150)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t-\n' "$EL" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${SB:-}" "${DW:-}" "$WA" >> "$TSV"
  if [ $(( EL - LASTRSS )) -ge 60 ]; then
    LASTRSS=$EL
    RS=$(h shell "grep VmRSS /proc/$P/status 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr -s ' ')
    WM=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\\[load\\] wait' | grep -a thr=0x1001 | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
    OB=$(grep -o 'obj=0x[0-9a-f]*' <<<"$WM" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); OB=${OB:-}
    ST=$(grep -o 'static=[0-9]*dumps' <<<"$WM" | tail -1); ST=${ST:-}; ST=${ST#static=}
    printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${SB:-}" "${DW:-}" "${OB:-}" "${ST:-}" >> "$TSV2"
    IOW=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\\[io\\] wait' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
    IOR=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\\[io\\] thr=' | grep -a 'rank=0 ' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s RSS[$RS] log=$(( LS / 1048576 ))MiB opens=${OP:-?} reads=${RD:-?} submit=${SB:-?} draws=${DW:-?} main_obj=${OB:-?} static=${ST:-?}"
    log "   io_rank1 $(cut -c1-300 <<<"$IOR")"
    log "   io_wait  $(cut -c1-300 <<<"$IOW")"
  fi
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 10
done

h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m6n_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m6n_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_fin.png" >/dev/null 2>&1 && log "screen_fin md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_fin.png") @t=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1
if [ -f "$OUT/vk_boot.log" ]; then
  mv "$OUT/vk_boot.log" "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log"
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log" | tr -d ' ')"
else log "X vk_boot.log pull failed"; fi
DL="$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "PERF LINES:"; grep -a '\[perf\]' "$DL" | cut -c1-700 | tee -a "$OUT/perf.txt"
  log "draws samples:"; grep -a '\[r\] draw totals' "$DL" | cut -c1-320 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "io first/last: $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | head -1) $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "load wait last: $(grep -a '\[load\] wait' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-220)"
  log "draw tops: $(grep -a -o 'zero_content [0-9.]*%' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "max rss bytes: $(grep -a '\[beat\] t=' "$DL" | sed -E 's/.*rss=([0-9]+).*/\1/' | sort -n | tail -1)"
  log "m6d counters: $(grep -a 'skip_heavy=' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-400)"
  log "rt fallback: $(grep -a -o 'rt_fallback=[0-9]*' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  # M6f evidence extracts
  grep -a '\[cpu\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/cpu.txt" && log "cpu lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/cpu.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  # M6n evidence extracts (task criteria 3/4/5)
  grep -a '\[ev\] pair' "$DL" > "$OUT/ev_pair.txt" && log "ev_pair lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/ev_pair.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[ev\] txt'  "$DL" > "$OUT/ev_txt.txt"  && log "ev_txt lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/ev_txt.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[ev\] xfer' "$DL" > "$OUT/ev_xfer.txt" && log "ev_xfer lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/ev_xfer.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[own\]'     "$DL" > "$OUT/own.txt"     && log "own lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/own.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "ev_pair rows for rd=0x1024: $(grep -ac 'rd=0x1024' "$OUT/ev_pair.txt" || true)"
  grep -a '\[load\] objsig' "$DL" > "$OUT/objsig.txt" && log "objsig lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/objsig.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[ldr\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/ldr.txt" && log "ldr lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/ldr.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "ldr kinds: step=$(grep -ac '\[ldr\] step' "$OUT/ldr.txt" || true) objaddr=$(grep -ac '\[ldr\] objaddr' "$OUT/ldr.txt" || true) loop=$(grep -ac '\[ldr\] loop' "$OUT/ldr.txt" || true)"
  grep -a '\[load\] wait' "$DL" | grep -a thr=0x1001 > "$OUT/main_wait.txt"; log "main_wait lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/main_wait.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a -E '\[cfg\]|\[load\] frame|\[load\] io ' "$DL" > "$OUT/series_src.txt" && log "series_src lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/series_src.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  # 30 s opens/reads/submit series with submit-freeze flags (0-growth window = our loop stalled)
  awk '/\[load\] io t=/ { for (i=1;i<=NF;i++) { if ($i ~ /^opens=/) { sub("opens=","",$i); op=$i } if ($i ~ /^reads=/) { sub("reads=","",$i); rd=$i } } }
       /\[load\] frame t=/ { t=$3; for (i=1;i<=NF;i++) { if ($i ~ /^submit=/) { sub("submit=","",$i); sb=$i } if ($i ~ /^draws=/) { sub("draws=","",$i); dw=$i } }
         d=(psub>0)?(sb-psub):0; flag=(psub>0 && sb==psub)?"FROZEN":"-";
         printf "%s\topens=%s\treads=%s\tsubmit=%s\tfrozen=%s\tdraws=%s\n", t, op, rd, sb, flag, dw; psub=sb }' "$DL" > "$OUT/series2.tsv" 2>/dev/null
  log "series2 rows=$(wc -l < "$OUT/series2.tsv" | tr -d ' ')"
  # M6n criteria 3/4/5: per-thread I/O + IPC rows, the rank-1 wait line, its SVC histogram
  grep -a '\[io\] thr' "$DL" > "$OUT/io_thr.txt"; log "io thr lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/io_thr.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[io\] wait' "$DL" > "$OUT/io_wait.txt"; log "io wait lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/io_wait.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[io\] svc'  "$DL" > "$OUT/io_svc.txt";  log "io svc lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/io_svc.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "io rank1 wait last: $(tail -1 "$OUT/io_wait.txt" | cut -c1-260)"
  log "cfg lines (expect 0): $(grep -ac '\[cfg\]' "$DL" || true)"
  log "cpu probe first/last: $(grep -a '\[cpu\] t=' "$DL" | grep -v 'threads=' | head -1 | cut -c1-160)"
  # M6n-A extracts: the 0x102f trail, its wait/sig lines, the addr table, its guest frames
  grep -a '\[t102f\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/t102f.txt"; log "t102f lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/t102f.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "t102f kinds: k=$(grep -ac '\[t102f\] k=' "$OUT/t102f.txt" || true) hist=$(grep -ac '\[t102f\] hist t=' "$OUT/t102f.txt" || true) sig=$(grep -ac '\[t102f\] sig ' "$OUT/t102f.txt" || true) wait=$(grep -ac '\[t102f\] wait ' "$OUT/t102f.txt" || true) obj=$(grep -ac '\[t102f\] obj' "$OUT/t102f.txt" || true) inflag=$(grep -ac '\[t102f\] inflag' "$OUT/t102f.txt" || true)"
  grep -a '\[load\] addr' "$DL" > "$OUT/addr.txt"; log "addr lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/addr.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "addr word of 0x6ea8bf3ca8: $(grep -a 'addr=0x6ea8bf3ca8' "$OUT/addr.txt" | tail -1 | cut -c1-220)"

  grep -a '\[gst\] chain h=0x102f' "$DL" > "$OUT/chain102f.txt"; log "chain102f lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/chain102f.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "t102f first rows:"; head -3 "$OUT/t102f.txt" | cut -c1-240 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  # M6n extracts: the whole-process wait graph + main's work loop
  grep -a '\[wg\] ' "$DL" > "$OUT/wg.txt"; log "wg lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/wg.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "wg rows: thread=$(grep -ac '\[wg\] t=' "$OUT/wg.txt" || true) key=$(grep -ac '\[wg\] key ' "$OUT/wg.txt" || true) sum=$(grep -ac '\[wg\] sum ' "$OUT/wg.txt" || true)"
  log "wg verdicts last: $(grep -a '\[wg\] sum ' "$OUT/wg.txt" | tail -1 | cut -c1-260)"
  log "wg classified keys last: $(grep -a '\[wg\] key ' "$OUT/wg.txt" | grep -aE 'cls=ZERO|cls=RING|cls=PARKED' | tail -4 | cut -c1-300)"
  grep -a '\[mn\] ' "$DL" > "$OUT/mn.txt"; log "mn lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/mn.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "mn kinds: state=$(grep -ac '\[mn\] state' "$OUT/mn.txt" || true) svc8=$(grep -ac '\[mn\] svc8 ' "$OUT/mn.txt" || true) svc8d=$(grep -ac '\[mn\] svc8d' "$OUT/mn.txt" || true) sig174=$(grep -ac '\[mn\] sig174' "$OUT/mn.txt" || true) pc=$(grep -ac '\[mn\] pc' "$OUT/mn.txt" || true)"
  log "mn state last: $(grep -a '\[mn\] state' "$OUT/mn.txt" | tail -1 | cut -c1-260)"
  log "mn svc8 last: $(grep -a '\[mn\] svc8 ' "$OUT/mn.txt" | tail -1 | cut -c1-260)"
  log "mn sig174 last: $(grep -a '\[mn\] sig174' "$OUT/mn.txt" | tail -1 | cut -c1-400)"
  grep -a '\[mn\] pc' "$DL" > "$OUT/mn_pc.txt"; log "mn_pc lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/mn_pc.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "mn pc last two:"; tail -2 "$OUT/mn_pc.txt" | cut -c1-300 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  # M6n extracts: the role-key tables (loader / clipping), the mover table, the lock word window
  grep -a '\[lp\] poster' "$DL" > "$OUT/lp_poster.txt"; log "lp poster lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/lp_poster.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[lp\] postkey' "$DL" > "$OUT/lp_postkey.txt"; log "lp postkey lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/lp_postkey.txt" | tr -d ' ')"

h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 2
log "post stop pidof=[$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')]"
```

`m6o_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
# plus the new [mn] svcbt line (real SVC pc + frame-pointer chain) in the same boot. 30 s dump cadence.
# Usage: bash m6o_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds=900]
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: m6n_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]}"
DUR="${2:-900}"
TESTKEY="${TESTKEY:-1 400 1000 2000 160 38:40,36:40,40:40,203:40 1}"
TESTSTICK="${TESTSTICK:-1 700 2000}"
GD_SEC="${GD_SEC:-30}"
SYNTH="${SYNTH:-1}"
FRAMES="${FRAMES:-8}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
TGT="127.0.0.1:5555"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m6o_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M6o tag=$TAG dur=${DUR}s out=$OUT synth=$SYNTH frames=$FRAMES gd_sec=$GD_SEC testkey='$TESTKEY'"

  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$P" ] && break
  log "pre-stop: pid=$P -> aa force-stop"
  h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3

P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
[ -n "$P" ] && { log "X pid $P still running before log handling"; exit 1; }

  MODE="rm -f (recreate on open)"; h shell "rm -f $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1

SZ=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); SZ=${SZ:-0}

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"

UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_after: $UPD1"
[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

for i in 1 2 3; do
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$P" ] && break
  h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3
done
P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
[ -n "$P" ] && { log "X pid still $P before boot"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty -> ignite"

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
log "faultlog_before entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST0" | grep -c .)"

h shell "echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_snap_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_present_gain; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_gpres" >/dev/null 2>&1
TKWR=$(h shell "printf '%s' '$TESTKEY' > $FILES/smo_testkey && echo WROTE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
log "testkey write: ${TKWR:-<no output>} value=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')]"
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_movie_kick; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
# M6g: plain integer cadence only (the M6f "sw=" worker switch has been removed from the code).
h shell "echo '$GD_SEC' > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "rm -f $FILES/SwiftShader.ini" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "gdump_sec file=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" | tr -d '\r')] ini_left=$(h shell "ls $FILES/SwiftShader.ini 2>/dev/null | wc -l" | tr -d '\r')"
log "movie switches before boot: kick=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_kick" | tr -d '\r') gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" | tr -d '\r')"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 1800000" >/dev/null 2>&1

h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
START=$(date +%s)
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 2

h shell "echo $SYNTH > $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null; echo $FRAMES > $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null; echo '$TESTSTICK' > $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "switches after seed: synth=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] frames=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] stick=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] testkey=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m6o_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m6o_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}
PLAN="${PLAN:-240 420 600 900}"
TSV2="$OUT/chain60.tsv"; printf 't\topens\treads\tsubmit\tdraws\tobj\tstatic\n' > "$TSV2"
LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; POKE=0; LASTPOKE=-1; LASTRSS=0
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"
printf 't\topens\treads\tsubmit\tdraws\tload_wait\tfps\n' > "$TSV"
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$P" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "dmesg 2>/dev/null | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|Kill|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR' | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') dmesg=$(wc -l < "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ')"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$P" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $P at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$P"; fi
  # 30 s probe cadence: one gdump request per tick (the C side honours smo_gdump_sec=30 too)
  if [ $(( EL - LASTPOKE )) -ge 28 ]; then
    LASTPOKE=$EL; POKE=$((POKE+1))
    h shell "echo $POKE > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  LS=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); LS=${LS:-0}
  IO=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[load\] io t=' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  LV=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[io\] romfs' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  FR=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[load\] frame t=' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  WK=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[load\] wait' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$IO $LV" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  RD=$(grep -o 'reads=[0-9]*' <<<"$IO $LV" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); RD=${RD:-}
  SB=$(grep -o 'submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$FR" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SB=${SB:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$FR" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  WA=$(tr -d '\r' <<<"$WK" | cut -c1-150)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t-\n' "$EL" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${SB:-}" "${DW:-}" "$WA" >> "$TSV"
  if [ $(( EL - LASTRSS )) -ge 60 ]; then
    LASTRSS=$EL
    RS=$(h shell "grep VmRSS /proc/$P/status 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr -s ' ')
    WM=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\\[load\\] wait' | grep -a thr=0x1001 | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
    OB=$(grep -o 'obj=0x[0-9a-f]*' <<<"$WM" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); OB=${OB:-}
    ST=$(grep -o 'static=[0-9]*dumps' <<<"$WM" | tail -1); ST=${ST:-}; ST=${ST#static=}
    printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${SB:-}" "${DW:-}" "${OB:-}" "${ST:-}" >> "$TSV2"
    IOW=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\\[io\\] wait' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
    IOR=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\\[io\\] thr=' | grep -a 'rank=0 ' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s RSS[$RS] log=$(( LS / 1048576 ))MiB opens=${OP:-?} reads=${RD:-?} submit=${SB:-?} draws=${DW:-?} main_obj=${OB:-?} static=${ST:-?}"
    log "   io_rank1 $(cut -c1-300 <<<"$IOR")"
    log "   io_wait  $(cut -c1-300 <<<"$IOW")"
  fi
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 10
done
```

`m6p_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M6o: stall-period input injection experiment (A / Plus / B / full stick, >=160 presses from t=400 s)
# plus the new [mn] svcbt line (real SVC pc + frame-pointer chain) in the same boot. 30 s dump cadence.
# Usage: bash m6p_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds=900]
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: m6n_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]}"
DUR="${2:-900}"
TESTKEY="${TESTKEY:-0}"
TESTSTICK="${TESTSTICK:-1 700 2000}"
GD_SEC="${GD_SEC:-30}"
SYNTH="${SYNTH:-1}"
FRAMES="${FRAMES:-8}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
TGT="127.0.0.1:5555"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m6p_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M6p tag=$TAG dur=${DUR}s out=$OUT synth=$SYNTH frames=$FRAMES gd_sec=$GD_SEC testkey='$TESTKEY'"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target offline ($TGT)"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing: $HAP"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

for i in 1 2 3; do
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$P" ] && break
  log "pre-stop: pid=$P -> aa force-stop"
  h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3
done
P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
[ -n "$P" ] && { log "X pid $P still running before log handling"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty (pre-flight)"

PRE=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); PRE=${PRE:-0}
log "pre vk_boot.log size=$PRE bytes"
MODE="truncate(:>)"
if ! h shell ": > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  MODE="rm -f (recreate on open)"; h shell "rm -f $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
fi
SZ=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); SZ=${SZ:-0}
[ "$SZ" = "0" ] || { log "X log not reset: mode=$MODE size=$SZ"; exit 1; }
log "log reset ok: mode=$MODE before=$PRE after=$SZ"

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"
OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); log "install: $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 300)"
grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_after: $UPD1"
[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

for i in 1 2 3; do
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$P" ] && break
  h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3
done
P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
[ -n "$P" ] && { log "X pid still $P before boot"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty -> ignite"

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
log "faultlog_before entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST0" | grep -c .)"

h shell "echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_snap_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_present_gain; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_gpres" >/dev/null 2>&1
TKWR=$(h shell "printf '%s' '$TESTKEY' > $FILES/smo_testkey && echo WROTE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
log "testkey write: ${TKWR:-<no output>} value=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')]"
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_movie_kick; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
# M6g: plain integer cadence only (the M6f "sw=" worker switch has been removed from the code).
h shell "echo '$GD_SEC' > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "rm -f $FILES/SwiftShader.ini" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "gdump_sec file=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" | tr -d '\r')] ini_left=$(h shell "ls $FILES/SwiftShader.ini 2>/dev/null | wc -l" | tr -d '\r')"
log "movie switches before boot: kick=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_kick" | tr -d '\r') gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" | tr -d '\r')"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 1800000" >/dev/null 2>&1

h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
START=$(date +%s)
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 2
done

h shell "echo $SYNTH > $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null; echo $FRAMES > $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null; echo '$TESTSTICK' > $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "switches after seed: synth=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] frames=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] stick=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] testkey=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m6p_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m6p_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}
PLAN="${PLAN:-240 420 600 900}"
TSV2="$OUT/chain60.tsv"; printf 't\topens\treads\tsubmit\tdraws\tobj\tstatic\n' > "$TSV2"
LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; POKE=0; LASTPOKE=-1; LASTRSS=0
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"
printf 't\topens\treads\tsubmit\tdraws\tload_wait\tfps\n' > "$TSV"
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$P" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "dmesg 2>/dev/null | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|Kill|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR' | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') dmesg=$(wc -l < "$OUT/dmesg_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ')"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$P" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $P at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$P"; fi
  # 30 s probe cadence: one gdump request per tick (the C side honours smo_gdump_sec=30 too)
  if [ $(( EL - LASTPOKE )) -ge 28 ]; then
    LASTPOKE=$EL; POKE=$((POKE+1))
    h shell "echo $POKE > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  LS=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); LS=${LS:-0}
  IO=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[load\] io t=' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  LV=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[io\] romfs' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  FR=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[load\] frame t=' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  WK=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[load\] wait' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$IO $LV" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  RD=$(grep -o 'reads=[0-9]*' <<<"$IO $LV" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); RD=${RD:-}
  SB=$(grep -o 'submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$FR" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SB=${SB:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$FR" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  WA=$(tr -d '\r' <<<"$WK" | cut -c1-150)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t-\n' "$EL" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${SB:-}" "${DW:-}" "$WA" >> "$TSV"
  if [ $(( EL - LASTRSS )) -ge 60 ]; then
    LASTRSS=$EL
    RS=$(h shell "grep VmRSS /proc/$P/status 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr -s ' ')
    WM=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\\[load\\] wait' | grep -a thr=0x1001 | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
    OB=$(grep -o 'obj=0x[0-9a-f]*' <<<"$WM" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); OB=${OB:-}
    ST=$(grep -o 'static=[0-9]*dumps' <<<"$WM" | tail -1); ST=${ST:-}; ST=${ST#static=}
    printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${SB:-}" "${DW:-}" "${OB:-}" "${ST:-}" >> "$TSV2"
    IOW=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\\[io\\] wait' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
    IOR=$(h shell "tail -c 400000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\\[io\\] thr=' | grep -a 'rank=0 ' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s RSS[$RS] log=$(( LS / 1048576 ))MiB opens=${OP:-?} reads=${RD:-?} submit=${SB:-?} draws=${DW:-?} main_obj=${OB:-?} static=${ST:-?}"
    log "   io_rank1 $(cut -c1-300 <<<"$IOR")"
    log "   io_wait  $(cut -c1-300 <<<"$IOW")"
  fi
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 10
done

h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m6p_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m6p_${TAG}_fin.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_fin.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_fin.png" >/dev/null 2>&1 && log "screen_fin md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_fin.png") @t=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1
if [ -f "$OUT/vk_boot.log" ]; then
  mv "$OUT/vk_boot.log" "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log"
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log" | tr -d ' ')"

DL="$OUT/vk_boot_delta.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "PERF LINES:"; grep -a '\[perf\]' "$DL" | cut -c1-700 | tee -a "$OUT/perf.txt"
  log "draws samples:"; grep -a '\[r\] draw totals' "$DL" | cut -c1-320 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "io first/last: $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | head -1) $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "load wait last: $(grep -a '\[load\] wait' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-220)"

  log "max rss bytes: $(grep -a '\[beat\] t=' "$DL" | sed -E 's/.*rss=([0-9]+).*/\1/' | sort -n | tail -1)"

  log "rt fallback: $(grep -a -o 'rt_fallback=[0-9]*' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  # M6f evidence extracts
  grep -a '\[cpu\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/cpu.txt" && log "cpu lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/cpu.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  # M6n evidence extracts (task criteria 3/4/5)
  grep -a '\[ev\] pair' "$DL" > "$OUT/ev_pair.txt" && log "ev_pair lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/ev_pair.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[ev\] txt'  "$DL" > "$OUT/ev_txt.txt"  && log "ev_txt lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/ev_txt.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[ev\] xfer' "$DL" > "$OUT/ev_xfer.txt" && log "ev_xfer lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/ev_xfer.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[own\]'     "$DL" > "$OUT/own.txt"     && log "own lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/own.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "ev_pair rows for rd=0x1024: $(grep -ac 'rd=0x1024' "$OUT/ev_pair.txt" || true)"
  grep -a '\[load\] objsig' "$DL" > "$OUT/objsig.txt" && log "objsig lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/objsig.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[ldr\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/ldr.txt" && log "ldr lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/ldr.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "ldr kinds: step=$(grep -ac '\[ldr\] step' "$OUT/ldr.txt" || true) objaddr=$(grep -ac '\[ldr\] objaddr' "$OUT/ldr.txt" || true) loop=$(grep -ac '\[ldr\] loop' "$OUT/ldr.txt" || true)"
  grep -a '\[load\] wait' "$DL" | grep -a thr=0x1001 > "$OUT/main_wait.txt"; log "main_wait lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/main_wait.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a -E '\[cfg\]|\[load\] frame|\[load\] io ' "$DL" > "$OUT/series_src.txt" && log "series_src lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/series_src.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  # 30 s opens/reads/submit series with submit-freeze flags (0-growth window = our loop stalled)
  awk '/\[load\] io t=/ { for (i=1;i<=NF;i++) { if ($i ~ /^opens=/) { sub("opens=","",$i); op=$i } if ($i ~ /^reads=/) { sub("reads=","",$i); rd=$i } } }
       /\[load\] frame t=/ { t=$3; for (i=1;i<=NF;i++) { if ($i ~ /^submit=/) { sub("submit=","",$i); sb=$i } if ($i ~ /^draws=/) { sub("draws=","",$i); dw=$i } }
         d=(psub>0)?(sb-psub):0; flag=(psub>0 && sb==psub)?"FROZEN":"-";
         printf "%s\topens=%s\treads=%s\tsubmit=%s\tfrozen=%s\tdraws=%s\n", t, op, rd, sb, flag, dw; psub=sb }' "$DL" > "$OUT/series2.tsv" 2>/dev/null
  log "series2 rows=$(wc -l < "$OUT/series2.tsv" | tr -d ' ')"
  # M6n criteria 3/4/5: per-thread I/O + IPC rows, the rank-1 wait line, its SVC histogram
  grep -a '\[io\] thr' "$DL" > "$OUT/io_thr.txt"; log "io thr lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/io_thr.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[io\] wait' "$DL" > "$OUT/io_wait.txt"; log "io wait lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/io_wait.txt" | tr -d ' ')"

  log "io rank1 wait last: $(tail -1 "$OUT/io_wait.txt" | cut -c1-260)"

  # M6n-A extracts: the 0x102f trail, its wait/sig lines, the addr table, its guest frames
  grep -a '\[t102f\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/t102f.txt"; log "t102f lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/t102f.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "t102f kinds: k=$(grep -ac '\[t102f\] k=' "$OUT/t102f.txt" || true) hist=$(grep -ac '\[t102f\] hist t=' "$OUT/t102f.txt" || true) sig=$(grep -ac '\[t102f\] sig ' "$OUT/t102f.txt" || true) wait=$(grep -ac '\[t102f\] wait ' "$OUT/t102f.txt" || true) obj=$(grep -ac '\[t102f\] obj' "$OUT/t102f.txt" || true) inflag=$(grep -ac '\[t102f\] inflag' "$OUT/t102f.txt" || true)"
  grep -a '\[load\] addr' "$DL" > "$OUT/addr.txt"; log "addr lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/addr.txt" | tr -d ' ')"

  log "t102f first rows:"; head -3 "$OUT/t102f.txt" | cut -c1-240 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  # M6n extracts: the whole-process wait graph + main's work loop

  log "mn state last: $(grep -a '\[mn\] state' "$OUT/mn.txt" | tail -1 | cut -c1-260)"

  grep -a '\[lp\] last8' "$DL" > "$OUT/lp_last8.txt"; log "lp last8 lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/lp_last8.txt" | tr -d ' ')"

```

`m6q_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M6q: one long boot (~1900 s). A every 60 s from t=400 (24 presses) + the 11 still-untried keys on a
# 5 s grid from t=1400 (8 each, grid slots colliding with an A press are skipped -> 81 presses).
# Schedule is absolute-time ([i] m6q sched producer), pushed to the app's own seed file before the
# measured start. Evidence: [tk] (game clock), [st] (stage table) and [st] CHANGE (2 s detector).
# Usage: bash m6q_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds=1900]
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: m6q_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]}"
DUR="${2:-1900}"
TESTSTICK="${TESTSTICK:-1 700 2000}"
GD_SEC="${GD_SEC:-30}"
SYNTH="${SYNTH:-1}"
FRAMES="${FRAMES:-8}"
SCHED_FILE="${SCHED_FILE:-/tmp/m6q_sched.txt}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
TGT="127.0.0.1:5555"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m6q_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M6q tag=$TAG dur=${DUR}s out=$OUT stick='$TESTSTICK' gd_sec=$GD_SEC sched=$(wc -c < "$SCHED_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING)B"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target offline ($TGT)"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing: $HAP"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$SCHED_FILE" ] || { log "X schedule missing: $SCHED_FILE"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }

stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty (pre-flight)"

# ---- install ----
UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"
OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); log "install: $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 300)"
grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_after: $UPD1"
[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

# ---- seed launch: the app must create smo_m6q_sched once before hdc can overwrite it ----
stopapp || { log "X pid before seed launch"; exit 1; }
h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
SEEDT=$(date +%s)
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 2
done
sleep 20
SX=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m6q_sched 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
log "seed check: ${SX:-<smo_m6q_sched ABSENT>}"
[ -z "$SX" ] && { log "X schedule file was not seeded by the app"; stopapp; exit 1; }
stopapp || { log "X pid before measured boot"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty after seed launch"

# ---- write switches for the measured boot ----
h shell "printf '%s' '$(cat "$SCHED_FILE")' > $FILES/smo_m6q_sched && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_testkey" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "sched file now $(h shell "wc -c < $FILES/smo_m6q_sched" | tr -dc '0-9')B head=[$(h shell "head -c 40 $FILES/smo_m6q_sched" | tr -d '\r')] testkey=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')]"

# ---- log reset + boot ----
PRE=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); PRE=${PRE:-0}
MODE="truncate(:>)"
if ! h shell ": > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then MODE="rm -f"; h shell "rm -f $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi
SZ=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); SZ=${SZ:-0}
[ "$SZ" = "0" ] || { log "X log not reset: $MODE size=$SZ"; exit 1; }
log "log reset ok: mode=$MODE before=$PRE after=$SZ"

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
log "faultlog_before entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST0" | grep -c .)"

h shell "echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_snap_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_present_gain; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_gpres" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_movie_kick; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo '$GD_SEC' > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "rm -f $FILES/SwiftShader.ini" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1

h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
START=$(date +%s)
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 2
done

h shell "echo $SYNTH > $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null; echo $FRAMES > $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null; echo '$TESTSTICK' > $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "switches after seed: synth=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] stick=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] sched=[$(h shell "head -c 40 $FILES/smo_m6q_sched 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m6q_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m6q_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}
PLAN="${PLAN:-240 420 600 900 1200 1500 1800}"
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"
printf 't\topens\treads\tframes\tsubmit\tdraws\tglobal\tcrate\thz\tthreads\n' > "$TSV"
LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; POKE=0; LASTPOKE=-1; LASTRSS=0
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$P" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR' | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ')"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$P" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $P at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$P"; fi

    LASTPOKE=$EL; POKE=$((POKE+1)); h shell "echo $POKE > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  LAST=$(h shell "tail -c 300000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[st\] t=|\[tk\] t=' | tail -4" | tr -d '\r')
  ST=$(grep -a '\[st\] t=' <<<"$LAST" | tail -1)
  TK=$(grep -a '\[tk\] t=' <<<"$LAST" | tail -1)
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  RD=$(grep -o 'reads=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); RD=${RD:-}
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SB=$(grep -o 'submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SB=${SB:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  TH=$(grep -o 'threads=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); TH=${TH:-}
  GL=$(grep -o 'global=[0-9]*' <<<"$TK" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); GL=${GL:-}
  CR=$(grep -o 'crate=[-0-9.]*' <<<"$TK" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); CR=${CR:-}
  HZ=$(grep -o 'hz=[-0-9.]*' <<<"$TK" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); HZ=${HZ:-}
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${FR:-}" "${SB:-}" "${DW:-}" "${GL:-}" "${CR:-}" "${HZ:-}" "${TH:-}" >> "$TSV"
  if [ $(( EL - LASTRSS )) -ge 120 ]; then
    LASTRSS=$EL
    RS=$(h shell "grep VmRSS /proc/$P/status 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr -s ' ')
    log "t=${EL}s RSS[$RS] opens=${OP:-?} reads=${RD:-?} submit=${SB:-?} draws=${DW:-?} thr=${TH:-?} global=${GL:-?} crate=${CR:-?} hz=${HZ:-?}"
    log "   st $(cut -c1-320 <<<"$ST")"
    log "   tk $(cut -c1-260 <<<"$TK")"
  fi
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 10

ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>}"
CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

  DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
  grep -a '\[st\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/st.txt"; log "[st] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/st.txt" | tr -d ' ') change=$(grep -ac '\[st\] CHANGE' "$OUT/st.txt" || true)"

  log "sched per key: $(grep -a ' down=1 ' "$OUT/sched.txt" | grep -o 'key=[0-9]*' | sort | uniq -c | tr '\n' ' ')"
  grep -a '\[load\] io t=' "$DL" | tail -3 | cut -c1-200 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "opens first/last: $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | head -1) .. $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "lmk lines=$(grep -ac 'LowMemoryKill' "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) sigsegv=$(grep -ac 'SIGSEGV' "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
  grep -a '\[st\] CHANGE' "$OUT/st.txt" | cut -c1-320 | head -20 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  head -2 "$OUT/tk.txt" | cut -c1-260 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  tail -2 "$OUT/tk.txt" | cut -c1-260 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
else log "X vk_boot.log pull failed"; fi
log "=== done tag=$TAG"
```

```sh
stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }

while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 2
done
sleep 20
SX=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m6q_sched 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
log "seed check: ${SX:-<smo_m6q_sched ABSENT>}"
[ -z "$SX" ] && { log "X schedule file was not seeded by the app"; stopapp; exit 1; }
stopapp || { log "X pid before measured boot"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty after seed launch"

# ---- write switches for the measured boot ----
h shell "printf '%s' '$(cat "$SCHED_FILE")' > $FILES/smo_m6q_sched && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_testkey" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "sched file now $(h shell "wc -c < $FILES/smo_m6q_sched" | tr -dc '0-9')B head=[$(h shell "head -c 40 $FILES/smo_m6q_sched" | tr -d '\r')] testkey=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')]"

# ---- log reset + boot ----
PRE=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); PRE=${PRE:-0}
MODE="truncate(:>)"
if ! h shell ": > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then MODE="rm -f"; h shell "rm -f $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi
SZ=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); SZ=${SZ:-0}
[ "$SZ" = "0" ] || { log "X log not reset: $MODE size=$SZ"; exit 1; }

h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_movie_kick; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo '$GD_SEC' > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
```

```sh
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"

[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing: $HAP"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$SCHED_FILE" ] || { log "X schedule missing: $SCHED_FILE"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }

stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty (pre-flight)"

# ---- install ----
UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"
OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); log "install: $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 300)"
grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_after: $UPD1"
[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

# ---- seed launch: the app must create smo_m6q_sched once before hdc can overwrite it ----
stopapp || { log "X pid before seed launch"; exit 1; }
h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
SEEDT=$(date +%s)
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 2
done
sleep 20
SX=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m6q_sched 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
log "seed check: ${SX:-<smo_m6q_sched ABSENT>}"
[ -z "$SX" ] && { log "X schedule file was not seeded by the app"; stopapp; exit 1; }
stopapp || { log "X pid before measured boot"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty after seed launch"

# ---- write switches for the measured boot ----
h shell "printf '%s' '$(cat "$SCHED_FILE")' > $FILES/smo_m6q_sched && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1

log "sched file now $(h shell "wc -c < $FILES/smo_m6q_sched" | tr -dc '0-9')B head=[$(h shell "head -c 40 $FILES/smo_m6q_sched" | tr -d '\r')] testkey=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')]"

# ---- log reset + boot ----
PRE=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); PRE=${PRE:-0}
MODE="truncate(:>)"
if ! h shell ": > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then MODE="rm -f"; h shell "rm -f $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi
SZ=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); SZ=${SZ:-0}
[ "$SZ" = "0" ] || { log "X log not reset: $MODE size=$SZ"; exit 1; }
log "log reset ok: mode=$MODE before=$PRE after=$SZ"

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
log "faultlog_before entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST0" | grep -c .)"

h shell "echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_snap_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_present_gain; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_gpres" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_movie_kick; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo '$GD_SEC' > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1

h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
```
