```sh
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 2
done

h shell "echo $SYNTH > $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null; echo $FRAMES > $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null; echo '$TESTSTICK' > $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "switches after seed: synth=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] stick=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] sched=[$(h shell "head -c 40 $FILES/smo_m6q_sched 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m6s_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m6s_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}
PLAN="${PLAN:-240 420 600 900 1100}"
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"
printf 't\topens\treads\tframes\tsubmit\tdraws\tglobal\tcrate\thz\tthreads\n' > "$TSV"
LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; POKE=0; LASTPOKE=-1; LASTRSS=0
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$P" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR' | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ')"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$P" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $P at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$P"; fi
  RSSKB=$(h shell "grep VmRSS /proc/$P/status 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')
  if [ -n "$RSSKB" ] && [ "$RSSKB" -gt $(( RSS_STOP_MB * 1024 )) ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=$((RSSKB/1024))MB > stop=${RSS_STOP_MB}MB -> stopping before LMK (task rule)"
    STOPPED_EARLY=1
    shot "$EL" "tstop"; break
  fi
  if [ $(( EL - LASTPOKE )) -ge 28 ]; then
    LASTPOKE=$EL; POKE=$((POKE+1)); h shell "echo $POKE > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  LAST=$(h shell "tail -c 300000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[st\] t=|\[tk\] t=|\[fa\] t=' | tail -4" | tr -d '\r')
  ST=$(grep -a '\[st\] t=' <<<"$LAST" | tail -1)
  TK=$(grep -a '\[tk\] t=' <<<"$LAST" | tail -1)
  FA=$(grep -a '\[fa\] t=' <<<"$LAST" | tail -1)
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  RD=$(grep -o 'reads=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); RD=${RD:-}
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SB=$(grep -o 'submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SB=${SB:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  TH=$(grep -o 'threads=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); TH=${TH:-}
  GL=$(grep -o 'global=[0-9]*' <<<"$TK" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); GL=${GL:-}
  CR=$(grep -o 'crate=[-0-9.]*' <<<"$TK" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); CR=${CR:-}
  HZ=$(grep -o 'hz=[-0-9.]*' <<<"$TK" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); HZ=${HZ:-}
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${FR:-}" "${SB:-}" "${DW:-}" "${GL:-}" "${CR:-}" "${HZ:-}" "${TH:-}" >> "$TSV"
  if [ $(( EL - LASTRSS )) -ge 120 ]; then
    LASTRSS=$EL
    RS=$(h shell "grep VmRSS /proc/$P/status 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr -s ' ')
    log "t=${EL}s RSS[$RS] opens=${OP:-?} reads=${RD:-?} submit=${SB:-?} draws=${DW:-?} thr=${TH:-?} global=${GL:-?} crate=${CR:-?} hz=${HZ:-?}"
    log "   fa $(cut -c1-300 <<<"$FA")"
    log "   st $(cut -c1-300 <<<"$ST")"
  fi
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 10
done

shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} stopped_early=${STOPPED_EARLY:-0}"
CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog_after entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST1" | grep -c .) new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1
if [ -f "$OUT/vk_boot.log" ]; then
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/vk_boot.log" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$OUT/vk_boot.log" | tr -d ' ')"
  DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
  grep -a '\[st\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/st.txt"; log "[st] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/st.txt" | tr -d ' ') change=$(grep -ac '\[st\] CHANGE' "$OUT/st.txt" || true)"
  grep -a '\[tk\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/tk.txt"; log "[tk] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/tk.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[fa\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/fa.txt"; log "[fa] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/fa.txt" | tr -d ' ') adv=$(grep -ac '\[fa\] ADVANCE' "$OUT/fa.txt" || true) sum=$(grep -ac '\[fa\] t=' "$OUT/fa.txt" || true)"
  grep -a '\[core\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/core.txt"; log "[core] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/core.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[grow\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/grow.txt"; log "[grow] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/grow.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[mem\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/mem.txt"; log "[mem] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/mem.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[cpu\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/cpu.txt"; log "[cpu] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/cpu.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[malloc\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/malloc.txt"; log "[malloc] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/malloc.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a 'm6q sched' "$DL" > "$OUT/sched.txt"; log "sched lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/sched.txt" | tr -d ' ') downs=$(grep -ac ' down=1 ' "$OUT/sched.txt" || true)"
  grep -a '\[svc\]' "$DL" | tail -6 | cut -c1-220 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  log "opens first/last: $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | head -1) .. $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "lmk lines=$(grep -ac 'LowMemoryKill' "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) sigsegv=$(grep -ac 'SIGSEGV' "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
  grep -a '\[fa\] ADVANCE' "$OUT/fa.txt" | cut -c1-260 | head -40 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  tail -3 "$OUT/fa.txt" | cut -c1-260 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
else log "X vk_boot.log pull failed"; fi
log "=== done tag=$TAG"

```

`m6t_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
# convention as M6q so the alignments compare. Evidence: [fa] (failure ledger + ADVANCE),
# [st]/[st] CHANGE (opens/threads advances), [tk] (game clock).
# Usage: bash m6t_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds=1800]
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: m6t_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]}"
DUR="${2:-1200}"
TESTSTICK="${TESTSTICK:-1 700 2000}"
RSS_STOP_MB="${RSS_STOP_MB:-5000}"
GD_SEC="${GD_SEC:-60}"
SYNTH="${SYNTH:-1}"
FRAMES="${FRAMES:-8}"
SCHED_FILE="${SCHED_FILE:-/tmp/m6t_sched.txt}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
TGT="127.0.0.1:5555"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"

  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')

  RD=$(grep -o 'reads=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); RD=${RD:-}
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SB=$(grep -o 'submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SB=${SB:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  TH=$(grep -o 'threads=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); TH=${TH:-}
  GL=$(grep -o 'global=[0-9]*' <<<"$TK" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); GL=${GL:-}
  CR=$(grep -o 'crate=[-0-9.]*' <<<"$TK" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); CR=${CR:-}
  HZ=$(grep -o 'hz=[-0-9.]*' <<<"$TK" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); HZ=${HZ:-}
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${FR:-}" "${SB:-}" "${DW:-}" "${GL:-}" "${CR:-}" "${HZ:-}" "${TH:-}" >> "$TSV"
  if [ $(( EL - LASTRSS )) -ge 120 ]; then
    LASTRSS=$EL
    RS=$(h shell "grep VmRSS /proc/$P/status 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr -s ' ')
    log "t=${EL}s RSS[$RS] opens=${OP:-?} reads=${RD:-?} submit=${SB:-?} draws=${DW:-?} thr=${TH:-?} global=${GL:-?} crate=${CR:-?} hz=${HZ:-?}"
    log "   fa $(cut -c1-300 <<<"$FA")"
    log "   st $(cut -c1-300 <<<"$ST")"
  fi
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 10
done

shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} stopped_early=${STOPPED_EARLY:-0}"
CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog_after entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST1" | grep -c .) new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1
if [ -f "$OUT/vk_boot.log" ]; then
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/vk_boot.log" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$OUT/vk_boot.log" | tr -d ' ')"
  DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
  grep -a '\[st\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/st.txt"; log "[st] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/st.txt" | tr -d ' ') change=$(grep -ac '\[st\] CHANGE' "$OUT/st.txt" || true)"

  tail -3 "$OUT/fa.txt" | cut -c1-260 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
else log "X vk_boot.log pull failed"; fi
log "=== done tag=$TAG"
```

`m6v_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M6v: one long boot (1800 s). A every 60 s from t=400 (24 presses), nothing else -- same
# convention as M6q so the alignments compare. Evidence: [fa] (failure ledger + ADVANCE),
# [st]/[st] CHANGE (opens/threads advances), [tk] (game clock).
# Usage: bash m6v_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds=1800]
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: m6v_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]}"
DUR="${2:-850}"
TESTSTICK="${TESTSTICK:-1 700 2000}"
RSS_STOP_MB="${RSS_STOP_MB:-5000}"
GD_SEC="${GD_SEC:-60}"
SYNTH="${SYNTH:-1}"
FRAMES="${FRAMES:-8}"
SCHED_FILE="${SCHED_FILE:-/tmp/m6v_sched.txt}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
TGT="127.0.0.1:5555"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m6v_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M6v tag=$TAG dur=${DUR}s out=$OUT stick='$TESTSTICK' gd_sec=$GD_SEC sched=$(wc -c < "$SCHED_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING)B"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target offline ($TGT)"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing: $HAP"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$SCHED_FILE" ] || { log "X schedule missing: $SCHED_FILE"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }

stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty (pre-flight)"

# ---- install ----
UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"
OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); log "install: $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 300)"
grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_after: $UPD1"
[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

# ---- seed launch: the app must create smo_m6q_sched once before hdc can overwrite it ----
stopapp || { log "X pid before seed launch"; exit 1; }
h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
SEEDT=$(date +%s)
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 2
done
sleep 20
SX=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m6q_sched 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
log "seed check: ${SX:-<smo_m6q_sched ABSENT>}"
[ -z "$SX" ] && { log "X schedule file was not seeded by the app"; stopapp; exit 1; }
stopapp || { log "X pid before measured boot"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty after seed launch"

# ---- write switches for the measured boot ----
h shell "printf '%s' '$(cat "$SCHED_FILE")' > $FILES/smo_m6q_sched && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_testkey" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "sched file now $(h shell "wc -c < $FILES/smo_m6q_sched" | tr -dc '0-9')B head=[$(h shell "head -c 40 $FILES/smo_m6q_sched" | tr -d '\r')] testkey=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')]"

# ---- log reset + boot ----
PRE=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); PRE=${PRE:-0}
MODE="truncate(:>)"
if ! h shell ": > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then MODE="rm -f"; h shell "rm -f $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi
SZ=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); SZ=${SZ:-0}
[ "$SZ" = "0" ] || { log "X log not reset: $MODE size=$SZ"; exit 1; }
log "log reset ok: mode=$MODE before=$PRE after=$SZ"

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
log "faultlog_before entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST0" | grep -c .)"

h shell "echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_snap_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_present_gain; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_gpres" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_movie_kick; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo '$GD_SEC' > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "rm -f $FILES/SwiftShader.ini" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1

h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
START=$(date +%s)
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 2
done

h shell "echo $SYNTH > $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null; echo $FRAMES > $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null; echo '$TESTSTICK' > $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "switches after seed: synth=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] stick=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] sched=[$(h shell "head -c 40 $FILES/smo_m6q_sched 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m6v_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m6v_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}
PLAN="${PLAN:-240 420 600 780}"
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"
printf 't\topens\treads\tframes\tsubmit\tdraws\tglobal\tcrate\thz\tthreads\n' > "$TSV"
LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; POKE=0; LASTPOKE=-1; LASTRSS=0
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$P" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR' | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ')"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$P" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $P at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$P"; fi
  RSSKB=$(h shell "grep VmRSS /proc/$P/status 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')
  if [ -n "$RSSKB" ] && [ "$RSSKB" -gt $(( RSS_STOP_MB * 1024 )) ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=$((RSSKB/1024))MB > stop=${RSS_STOP_MB}MB -> stopping before LMK (task rule)"
    STOPPED_EARLY=1
    shot "$EL" "tstop"; break
  fi
  if [ $(( EL - LASTPOKE )) -ge 28 ]; then
    LASTPOKE=$EL; POKE=$((POKE+1)); h shell "echo $POKE > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  LAST=$(h shell "tail -c 300000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[st\] t=|\[tk\] t=|\[fa\] t=' | tail -4" | tr -d '\r')
  ST=$(grep -a '\[st\] t=' <<<"$LAST" | tail -1)
  TK=$(grep -a '\[tk\] t=' <<<"$LAST" | tail -1)
  FA=$(grep -a '\[fa\] t=' <<<"$LAST" | tail -1)
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  RD=$(grep -o 'reads=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); RD=${RD:-}
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SB=$(grep -o 'submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SB=${SB:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  TH=$(grep -o 'threads=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); TH=${TH:-}
  GL=$(grep -o 'global=[0-9]*' <<<"$TK" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); GL=${GL:-}
  CR=$(grep -o 'crate=[-0-9.]*' <<<"$TK" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); CR=${CR:-}
  HZ=$(grep -o 'hz=[-0-9.]*' <<<"$TK" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); HZ=${HZ:-}
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${FR:-}" "${SB:-}" "${DW:-}" "${GL:-}" "${CR:-}" "${HZ:-}" "${TH:-}" >> "$TSV"
  if [ $(( EL - LASTRSS )) -ge 120 ]; then
    LASTRSS=$EL
    RS=$(h shell "grep VmRSS /proc/$P/status 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr -s ' ')
    log "t=${EL}s RSS[$RS] opens=${OP:-?} reads=${RD:-?} submit=${SB:-?} draws=${DW:-?} thr=${TH:-?} global=${GL:-?} crate=${CR:-?} hz=${HZ:-?}"
    log "   fa $(cut -c1-300 <<<"$FA")"
    log "   st $(cut -c1-300 <<<"$ST")"
  fi
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 10
done

shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} stopped_early=${STOPPED_EARLY:-0}"
CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

log "faultlog_after entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST1" | grep -c .) new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1
if [ -f "$OUT/vk_boot.log" ]; then
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/vk_boot.log" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$OUT/vk_boot.log" | tr -d ' ')"
  DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
  grep -a '\[st\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/st.txt"; log "[st] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/st.txt" | tr -d ' ') change=$(grep -ac '\[st\] CHANGE' "$OUT/st.txt" || true)"
  grep -a '\[tk\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/tk.txt"; log "[tk] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/tk.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[r\] draw totals' "$DL" > "$OUT/drawtotals.txt"; log "[r] totals lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/drawtotals.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[perf\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/perf.txt"; log "[perf] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/perf.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
```

```sh
# M6w: one long boot. A (key 38) every 20 s from t=300 to t=800 (26 presses, hold 1 s), then run
# past t=800 so the post-advance phase is visible for the first time. No code changes: the probes
# are the ones already in the HAP (sched down/up lines, [fa] ADVANCE#, [st]/[st] CHANGE, [perf],
# [r] draw totals, [io] romfs + open ring).
# Usage: bash m6w_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds=860]

  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')

  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 2

[ "$SZ" = "0" ] || { log "X log not reset: $MODE size=$SZ"; exit 1; }

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1

  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 2

h shell "echo $SYNTH > $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null; echo $FRAMES > $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null; echo '$TESTSTICK' > $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" >/dev/null 2>&1

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m6w_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m6w_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1

    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}
PLAN="${PLAN:-420 480 600 800}"
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"
printf 't\topens\treads\tframes\tsubmit\tdraws\tthreads\trss_mb\n' > "$TSV"
LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; POKE=0; LASTPOKE=-1; LASTRSS=0
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$P" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR' | tail -40" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"|tr -d ' ')"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$P" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $P at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$P"; fi
  RSSKB=$(h shell "grep VmRSS /proc/$P/status 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')
  RSSMB=$(( ${RSSKB:-0} / 1024 ))
  if [ -n "$RSSKB" ] && [ "$RSSKB" -gt $(( RSS_STOP_MB * 1024 )) ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=${RSSMB}MB > stop=${RSS_STOP_MB}MB -> stopping before LMK (task rule)"
    STOPPED_EARLY=1
    shot "$EL" "tstop"; break
  fi
  if [ $(( EL - LASTPOKE )) -ge 28 ]; then
    LASTPOKE=$EL; POKE=$((POKE+1)); h shell "echo $POKE > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  LAST=$(h shell "tail -c 300000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[st\] t=|\[tk\] t=' | tail -3" | tr -d '\r')
  ST=$(grep -a '\[st\] t=' <<<"$LAST" | tail -1)
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  RD=$(grep -o 'reads=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); RD=${RD:-}
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SB=$(grep -o 'submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SB=${SB:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  TH=$(grep -o 'threads=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); TH=${TH:-}
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${FR:-}" "${SB:-}" "${DW:-}" "${TH:-}" "$RSSMB" >> "$TSV"
  # RSS: every 10 s from t=470 (task rule), every 30 s before that
  if [ "$EL" -ge "$RSS_FROM" ] && [ $(( EL - LASTRSS )) -ge "$RSS_EVERY" ]; then
    LASTRSS=$EL
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=${RSSMB}MB opens=${OP:-?} reads=${RD:-?} submit=${SB:-?} draws=${DW:-?} thr=${TH:-?}"
  elif [ $(( EL - LASTRSS )) -ge 30 ]; then
    LASTRSS=$EL
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=${RSSMB}MB opens=${OP:-?} reads=${RD:-?} submit=${SB:-?} draws=${DW:-?} thr=${TH:-?}"
    log "   st $(cut -c1-300 <<<"$ST")"
  fi
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 10
done

shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} stopped_early=${STOPPED_EARLY:-0}"
CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog_after entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST1" | grep -c .) new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1
if [ -f "$OUT/vk_boot.log" ]; then
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/vk_boot.log" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$OUT/vk_boot.log" | tr -d ' ')"
  DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
  grep -a '\[st\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/st.txt"; log "[st] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/st.txt" | tr -d ' ') change=$(grep -ac '\[st\] CHANGE' "$OUT/st.txt" || true)"
  grep -a '\[tk\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/tk.txt"; log "[tk] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/tk.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[r\] draw totals' "$DL" > "$OUT/drawtotals.txt"; log "[r] totals lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/drawtotals.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[perf\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/perf.txt"; log "[perf] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/perf.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[fa\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/fa.txt"; log "[fa] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/fa.txt" | tr -d ' ') adv=$(grep -ac '\[fa\] ADVANCE' "$OUT/fa.txt" || true) sum=$(grep -ac '\[fa\] t=' "$OUT/fa.txt" || true)"
  grep -a '\[core\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/core.txt"; log "[core] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/core.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[gst\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/gst.txt"; log "[gst] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/gst.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[grow\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/grow.txt"; log "[grow] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/grow.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[mem\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/mem.txt"; log "[mem] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/mem.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[mv\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/mv.txt"; log "[mv] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/mv.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a 'm6q sched' "$DL" > "$OUT/sched.txt"; log "sched lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/sched.txt" | tr -d ' ') downs=$(grep -ac ' down=1 ' "$OUT/sched.txt" || true)"
  grep -a '\[io\] romfs\|\[io\]   open#-' "$DL" > "$OUT/io.txt"; log "io lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/io.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "opens first/last: $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | head -1) .. $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "lmk lines=$(grep -ac 'LowMemoryKill' "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) sigsegv=$(grep -ac 'SIGSEGV' "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
  grep -a '\[fa\] ADVANCE' "$OUT/fa.txt" | cut -c1-200 | head -60 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
  tail -3 "$OUT/fa.txt" | cut -c1-200 | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"
else log "X vk_boot.log pull failed"; fi
log "=== done tag=$TAG"

```

`m6x_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M6x: ONE long boot. RSS stop 13.0 GB (LMK is ~14), smo_rss_guard=0, exactly one A press at t=120
# (key 38, hold 1000 ms, up<=5000). Watch window t=120..880 s. Answers: does the stage load finish
# (opens>1245 / thread step / new [fa] kind / submit resumes) and if it resumes, what is on screen.
# Probes: the ones already in the 09:34 HAP ([beat] 2 s pct/rss, [st] 30 s + CHANGE, [grow]/[mem]
# 10 s, [core] 30 s, [fa], [perf], [r] draw totals, [j] RSS GUARD). No code change.
# Usage: bash m6x_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds=880]
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: m6x_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]}"
DUR="${2:-880}"
RSS_STOP_MB="${RSS_STOP_MB:-13000}"
SCHED_FILE="${SCHED_FILE:-/tmp/m6x_sched.txt}"
GD_SEC="${GD_SEC:-60}"
SYNTH="${SYNTH:-1}"
FRAMES="${FRAMES:-8}"
TESTSTICK="${TESTSTICK:-1 700 2000}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
TGT="127.0.0.1:5555"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"

mkdir -p "$OUT"

h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target offline ($TGT)"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing: $HAP"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$SCHED_FILE" ] || { log "X schedule missing: $SCHED_FILE"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }

log "upd_after: $UPD1"
[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

SX=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m6q_sched 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
if [ -z "$SX" ]; then
  log "sched file absent -> seed launch (one app start, pre-flight only)"
  h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  sleep 20
  SX=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m6q_sched 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed check: ${SX:-<ABSENT>}"
  [ -z "$SX" ] && { log "X schedule file still absent"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X pid before measured boot"; exit 1; }
else
  log "sched file present: $SX"
fi

# ---- switches for the measured boot ----
h shell "printf '%s' '$(cat "$SCHED_FILE")' > $FILES/smo_m6q_sched && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_testkey" >/dev/null 2>&1
RS=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m6q_sched" | tr -d '\r')
log "sched readback=[$RS] bytes=$(h shell "wc -c < $FILES/smo_m6q_sched" | tr -dc '0-9') testkey=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')]"

# ---- our own guards OFF (task rule) ----
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "guard files: smo_rss_guard=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_rss_guard" | tr -d '\r')] smo_mem_purge=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_mem_purge 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"

# ---- log reset ----
PRE=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); PRE=${PRE:-0}
MODE="truncate(:>)"
if ! h shell ": > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then MODE="rm -f"; h shell "rm -f $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi

[ "$SZ" = "0" ] || { log "X log not reset: $MODE size=$SZ"; exit 1; }
log "log reset ok: mode=$MODE before=$PRE after=$SZ"

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

h shell "echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_snap_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_present_gain; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_gpres" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_movie_kick; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo '$GD_SEC' > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1

h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1

# ---- observers ----
h file send /tmp/m6x_sampler.sh /data/local/tmp/m6x_sampler.sh >/dev/null 2>&1
h file send /tmp/m6x_probe.sh /data/local/tmp/m6x_probe.sh >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "nohup sh /data/local/tmp/m6x_sampler.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 &" >/dev/null 2>&1

START=$(date +%s)
FIRSTPID=""
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 1
done

h shell "echo $SYNTH > $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null; echo $FRAMES > $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null; echo '$TESTSTICK' > $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "switches after seed: synth=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] stick=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m6x_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m6x_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

PLAN="${PLAN:-120 200 300 450 600 750}"
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"
printf 't\trss_mb\tvmsize_mb\tvmdata_mb\topens\treads\tsubmit\tframes\tdraws\tthr\tpct\tstall\tnflags\n' > "$TSV"
: > "$OUT/probe.raw"
LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; LASTRSSLOG=-100; RN=0
SUB_PREV=0; SUB_T=0; FROZEN_LOGGED=0; RECOVERED=0; NEXT_REC_SHOT=0
MAXTHR=0; OPENFLAG=0; STOPPED_EARLY=0; GUARDSEEN=0; NF0=$NFT0
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  RAW=$(h shell "sh /data/local/tmp/m6x_probe.sh" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')
  printf '### t=%s\n%s\n' "$EL" "$RAW" >> "$OUT/probe.raw"
  STLINE=$(grep -m1 '^STATE' <<<"$RAW")
  if grep -q '^STATE dead' <<<"$STLINE"; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"

    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt" | tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
    h shell "tail -n 5 $LOG" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/log_tail_at_death.txt"
    log "last log lines: $(tr '\n' '|' < "$OUT/log_tail_at_death.txt" | tail -c 400)"
    break
  fi
  PID=$(awk '{print $3}' <<<"$STLINE")
  if [ "$PID" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $PID at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$PID"; fi
  RSSKB=$(grep -m1 'VmRSS' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); RSSKB=${RSSKB:-0}
  RSSMB=$(( RSSKB / 1024 ))
  THRO=$(grep -m1 '^THREADS' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); THRO=${THRO:-0}   # OS threads (ArkTS+native), not the signal
  THR=$(grep -o 'threads=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); THR=${THR:-0}  # guest registry ([st]) = the M6w baseline 25->26
  NFT=$(grep -m1 '^FAULTLOG' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); NFT=${NFT:-0}
  ST=$(grep -m1 '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW")
  CH=$(grep -m1 '\[st\] CHANGE' <<<"$RAW")
  BT=$(grep -m1 '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW")
  GW=$(grep -m1 '\[grow\]' <<<"$RAW")
  MM=$(grep -m1 '\[mem\] t=' <<<"$RAW")
  CR=$(grep -m1 '\[core\] t=' <<<"$RAW")
  FA=$(grep -a '\[fa\]' <<<"$RAW" | tr '\n' '|')
  PF=$(grep -m1 '\[perf\]' <<<"$RAW")
  JD=$(grep -m1 'RSS GUARD' <<<"$RAW")
  MV=$(grep -m1 '\[mv\]' <<<"$RAW")
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  RD=$(grep -o 'reads=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); RD=${RD:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  PCT=$(grep -o 'pct=[0-9-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); PCT=${PCT:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  VMSZ=$(grep -o 'vmsize=[0-9]*' <<<"$MM" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); VMSZ=${VMSZ:-}
  VMDT=$(grep -o 'vmdata=[0-9]*' <<<"$MM" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); VMDT=${VMDT:-}
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' \
    "$EL" "$RSSMB" "${VMSZ:-}" "${VMDT:-}" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${FR:-}" "${DW:-}" "${THR:-}" "${PCT:-}" "${STALL:-}" "-" >> "$TSV"

  # ---- guard verification (first time only) ----
  if [ "$GUARDSEEN" -eq 0 ] && [ -n "$JD" ]; then
    GUARDSEEN=1
    log "GUARD line: $JD"
    if grep -q 'trip=20000MB' <<<"$JD"; then log "GUARD OK: trip=20000MB (above any reachable RSS; hard cap raised too)"
    else log "!! WARNING: guard line does not show trip=20000MB - our guard may still act"; fi
  fi
  # ---- signal 1: opens > 1245 ----
  if [ -n "$OP" ] && [ "$OP" -gt 1245 ] && [ "$OPENFLAG" -eq 0 ]; then
    OPENFLAG=1; log "SIGNAL-1 t=${EL}s opens=$OP > 1245 (new file paths) rss=${RSSMB}MB"
    shot "$EL" "opens$OP"
  fi
  # ---- signal 2: thread step ----
  if [ -n "$THR" ] && [ "$THR" -gt 27 ] && [ "$THR" -gt "$MAXTHR" ]; then
    MAXTHR=$THR; log "SIGNAL-2 t=${EL}s guest_threads=$THR (>27, M6w baseline 25-26) submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} os_thr=$THRO"
  fi
  # ---- signal 4: submit resumes after a >=60 s freeze ----
  if [ -n "$SUB" ]; then
    if [ "$SUB" -gt "$SUB_PREV" ]; then
      GAP=$(( EL - SUB_T ))
      if [ "$FROZEN_LOGGED" -eq 1 ] && [ "$RECOVERED" -eq 0 ] && [ "$GAP" -ge 60 ]; then
        RECOVERED=1; NEXT_REC_SHOT=$(( EL + 30 ))
        log "SIGNAL-4 RECOVERY t=${EL}s submit $SUB_PREV -> $SUB (frozen ${GAP}s) rss=${RSSMB}MB frames=${FR:-?} pct=${PCT:-?}"
        shot "$EL" "recover"
      fi
      SUB_PREV=$SUB; SUB_T=$EL
    else
      GAP=$(( EL - SUB_T ))
      if [ "$FROZEN_LOGGED" -eq 0 ] && [ "$GAP" -ge 60 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 60 ]; then
        FROZEN_LOGGED=1; log "FROZEN t=${EL}s submit=$SUB (no growth for ${GAP}s) rss=${RSSMB}MB opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?}"
      fi
    fi
  fi
  # ---- faultlog grew = possible kill of something ----
  if [ "$NFT" -gt "$NF0" ]; then
    log "!! faultlog grew $NF0 -> $NFT at t=${EL}s"; NF0=$NFT
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_${EL}s.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR|has died' | tail -60" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_${EL}s.txt"
    break
  fi
  # ---- stop line ----
  if [ "$RSSMB" -gt "$RSS_STOP_MB" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=${RSSMB}MB > stop=${RSS_STOP_MB}MB -> stopping before LMK (task rule)"
    STOPPED_EARLY=1; shot "$EL" "tstop"; break
  fi
  # ---- keepalive ----
  if [ $(( EL - LASTRSSLOG )) -ge 16 ]; then
    LASTRSSLOG=$EL; RN=$((RN+1))
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=${RSSMB}MB opens=${OP:-?} reads=${RD:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} frames=${FR:-?} draws=${DW:-?} thr=${THR:-?}/os${THRO:-?} pct=${PCT:-?} stall=${STALL:-?}"
    [ -n "$CH" ] && log "   chg $(cut -c1-260 <<<"$CH")"
    [ -n "$FA" ] && log "   fa  $(cut -c1-240 <<<"$FA")"
    [ -n "$JD" ] && log "   j   $(cut -c1-200 <<<"$JD")"
    [ -n "$MV" ] && log "   mv  $(cut -c1-160 <<<"$MV")"
  fi
  # ---- screenshots ----
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  if [ "$RECOVERED" -eq 1 ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$NEXT_REC_SHOT" ]; then
    NEXT_REC_SHOT=$(( EL + 30 )); shot "$EL" "rec$EL"
  fi
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  # fast poll once we are in the high-water zone (LMK was measured at ~13.6 GB on this box)
  if [ "$RSSMB" -gt 12000 ]; then sleep 1; else sleep 4; fi
done

shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} stopped_early=${STOPPED_EARLY} recovered=${RECOVERED} opens_gt_1245=${OPENFLAG} maxthr=${MAXTHR}"
CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog_after entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST1" | grep -c . ) new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

# ---- pull (twice: the first recv of a live log is often a partial file) ----
for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 4; done
h file recv /data/local/tmp/m6x_samples.txt "$OUT/samples.txt" >/dev/null 2>&1
if [ -f "$OUT/vk_boot.log" ]; then
  DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  for K in st tk beat perf core grow mem mv malloc j sched io gst fa hang; do
    grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
    log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ')"
  done
  grep -a '\[r\] draw totals' "$DL" > "$OUT/drawtotals.txt"; log "[r] totals=$(wc -l < "$OUT/drawtotals.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[st\] CHANGE' "$DL" > "$OUT/st_change.txt"; log "[st] CHANGE=$(wc -l < "$OUT/st_change.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "opens first/last: $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | head -1) .. $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "[fa] ADVANCE=$(grep -ac '\[fa\] ADVANCE' "$OUT/fa.txt" || true) kinds=$(grep -ao '\[fa\][a-zA-Z0-9_#]*' "$OUT/fa.txt" | sort | uniq -c | tr '\n' ' ')"
  log "[perf] tail: $(tail -2 "$OUT/perf.txt" | tr '\n' '|' | cut -c1-400)"
  log "[grow] tail: $(tail -3 "$OUT/grow.txt" | cut -c1-200 | tr '\n' '|')"
  log "[mem] tail: $(tail -2 "$OUT/mem.txt" | cut -c1-260 | tr '\n' '|')"
else log "X vk_boot.log pull failed"; fi
if [ -f "$OUT/samples.txt" ]; then log "samples lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/samples.txt" | tr -d ' ') first=$(head -1 "$OUT/samples.txt") last=$(tail -1 "$OUT/samples.txt")"; fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG"

```

`m6y_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M6y: one boot at a time. RSS stop 12.5 GB (LMK measured ~13.6). smo_rss_guard=0. One A press at
# t=120 (key 38, hold 1000 ms, up<=5000). Adds the M6y [cfg] census probe (pipe/key/blk/br/brc/sw/phi/
# loop/cost) and the cfg-veto switch readback. Early-kill: submit frozen >= KILL_GAP s AND the [cfg]
# pipe table already printed (boot A path, saves memory). Usage: bash m6y_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: m6x_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]}"
DUR="${2:-880}"
RSS_STOP_MB="${RSS_STOP_MB:-12500}"

CFG_VETO="${CFG_VETO:-0}"
CFG_HASHES="${CFG_HASHES:-}"
CFG_COST_THR="${CFG_COST_THR:-0}"

SYNTH="${SYNTH:-1}"

HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"

[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing: $HAP"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$SCHED_FILE" ] || { log "X schedule missing: $SCHED_FILE"; exit 1; }

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }

log "pidof empty (pre-flight)"

# ---- install ----

log "upd_before: $UPD0"
OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); log "install: $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 300)"
grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_after: $UPD1"
[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

# ---- schedule file: must already exist in the app sandbox (created by an earlier launch) ----
SX=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m6q_sched 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
if [ -z "$SX" ]; then
  log "sched file absent -> seed launch (one app start, pre-flight only)"
  h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  sleep 20
  SX=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m6q_sched 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed check: ${SX:-<ABSENT>}"
  [ -z "$SX" ] && { log "X schedule file still absent"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X pid before measured boot"; exit 1; }
else
  log "sched file present: $SX"
fi

# ---- switches for the measured boot ----
h shell "printf '%s' '$(cat "$SCHED_FILE")' > $FILES/smo_m6q_sched && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_testkey" >/dev/null 2>&1
RS=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m6q_sched" | tr -d '\r')
log "sched readback=[$RS] bytes=$(h shell "wc -c < $FILES/smo_m6q_sched" | tr -dc '0-9') testkey=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')]"

# ---- our own guards OFF (task rule) ----
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "guard files: smo_rss_guard=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_rss_guard" | tr -d '\r')] smo_mem_purge=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_mem_purge 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"

# ---- log reset ----
PRE=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); PRE=${PRE:-0}
MODE="truncate(:>)"
if ! h shell ": > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then MODE="rm -f"; h shell "rm -f $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi
SZ=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); SZ=${SZ:-0}
[ "$SZ" = "0" ] || { log "X log not reset: $MODE size=$SZ"; exit 1; }
log "log reset ok: mode=$MODE before=$PRE after=$SZ"

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
NFT0=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST0" | grep -c .); log "faultlog_before entries=$NFT0"

h shell "echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_snap_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_present_gain; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_gpres" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1

h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_movie_kick; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1

h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1

# ---- observers ----
h file send /tmp/m6y_sampler.sh /data/local/tmp/m6y_sampler.sh >/dev/null 2>&1
h file send /tmp/m6y_probe.sh /data/local/tmp/m6y_probe.sh >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "nohup sh /data/local/tmp/m6y_sampler.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 &" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "sampler started (2 s, device-side)"

# ---- boot ----
h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
START=$(date +%s)
FIRSTPID=""
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 1
done

h shell "echo $SYNTH > $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null; echo $FRAMES > $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null; echo '$TESTSTICK' > $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "switches after seed: synth=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')] stick=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m6y_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m6y_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}


TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"
printf 't\trss_mb\tvmsize_mb\tvmdata_mb\topens\treads\tsubmit\tframes\tdraws\tthr\tpct\tstall\tnflags\n' > "$TSV"
: > "$OUT/probe.raw"

SUB_PREV=0; SUB_T=0; FROZEN_LOGGED=0; RECOVERED=0; NEXT_REC_SHOT=0

while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  RAW=$(h shell "sh /data/local/tmp/m6y_probe.sh" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')
  printf '### t=%s\n%s\n' "$EL" "$RAW" >> "$OUT/probe.raw"
  STLINE=$(grep -m1 '^STATE' <<<"$RAW")
  if grep -q '^STATE dead' <<<"$STLINE"; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR|has died' | tail -60" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt" | tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
    h shell "tail -n 5 $LOG" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/log_tail_at_death.txt"
    log "last log lines: $(tr '\n' '|' < "$OUT/log_tail_at_death.txt" | tail -c 400)"
    break
  fi
  PID=$(awk '{print $3}' <<<"$STLINE")
  if [ "$PID" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $PID at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$PID"; fi
  RSSKB=$(grep -m1 'VmRSS' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); RSSKB=${RSSKB:-0}
  RSSMB=$(( RSSKB / 1024 ))
  THRO=$(grep -m1 '^THREADS' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); THRO=${THRO:-0}   # OS threads (ArkTS+native), not the signal
  THR=$(grep -o 'threads=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); THR=${THR:-0}  # guest registry ([st]) = the M6w baseline 25->26
  NFT=$(grep -m1 '^FAULTLOG' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); NFT=${NFT:-0}
  ST=$(grep -m1 '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW")
  CH=$(grep -m1 '\[st\] CHANGE' <<<"$RAW")
  BT=$(grep -m1 '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW")
  GW=$(grep -m1 '\[grow\]' <<<"$RAW")
  MM=$(grep -m1 '\[mem\] t=' <<<"$RAW")
  CR=$(grep -m1 '\[core\] t=' <<<"$RAW")
  FA=$(grep -a '\[fa\]' <<<"$RAW" | tr '\n' '|')
  PF=$(grep -m1 '\[perf\]' <<<"$RAW")
  JD=$(grep -m1 'RSS GUARD' <<<"$RAW")
  MV=$(grep -m1 '\[mv\]' <<<"$RAW")
  CFGPIPE=$(awk '/^CFGPIPE/{print $2}' <<<"$RAW"); CFGPIPE=${CFGPIPE:-0}
  CFGKEY=$(awk '/^CFGKEY/{print $2}' <<<"$RAW"); CFGKEY=${CFGKEY:-0}
  CFGVETO_N=$(awk '/^CFGVETO/{print $2}' <<<"$RAW"); CFGVETO_N=${CFGVETO_N:-0}
  CFGLAST=$(grep -a '\[cfg\] pipe#' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  CFGVLINE=$(grep -a '\[cfg\] veto' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  RD=$(grep -o 'reads=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); RD=${RD:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  PCT=$(grep -o 'pct=[0-9-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); PCT=${PCT:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  VMSZ=$(grep -o 'vmsize=[0-9]*' <<<"$MM" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); VMSZ=${VMSZ:-}
  VMDT=$(grep -o 'vmdata=[0-9]*' <<<"$MM" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); VMDT=${VMDT:-}
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' \
    "$EL" "$RSSMB" "${VMSZ:-}" "${VMDT:-}" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${FR:-}" "${DW:-}" "${THR:-}" "${PCT:-}" "${STALL:-}" "-" >> "$TSV"

  # ---- guard verification (first time only) ----
  if [ "$GUARDSEEN" -eq 0 ] && [ -n "$JD" ]; then
    GUARDSEEN=1
    log "GUARD line: $JD"
    if grep -q 'trip=20000MB' <<<"$JD"; then log "GUARD OK: trip=20000MB (above any reachable RSS; hard cap raised too)"
    else log "!! WARNING: guard line does not show trip=20000MB - our guard may still act"; fi
  fi
  # ---- signal 1: opens > 1245 ----
  if [ -n "$OP" ] && [ "$OP" -gt 1245 ] && [ "$OPENFLAG" -eq 0 ]; then
    OPENFLAG=1; log "SIGNAL-1 t=${EL}s opens=$OP > 1245 (new file paths) rss=${RSSMB}MB"
    shot "$EL" "opens$OP"
  fi
  # ---- signal 2: thread step ----
  if [ -n "$THR" ] && [ "$THR" -gt 27 ] && [ "$THR" -gt "$MAXTHR" ]; then
    MAXTHR=$THR; log "SIGNAL-2 t=${EL}s guest_threads=$THR (>27, M6w baseline 25-26) submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} os_thr=$THRO"
  fi
  # ---- signal 4: submit resumes after a >=60 s freeze ----
  if [ -n "$SUB" ]; then
    if [ "$SUB" -gt "$SUB_PREV" ]; then
      GAP=$(( EL - SUB_T ))
      if [ "$FROZEN_LOGGED" -eq 1 ] && [ "$RECOVERED" -eq 0 ] && [ "$GAP" -ge 60 ]; then
        RECOVERED=1; NEXT_REC_SHOT=$(( EL + 30 ))
        log "SIGNAL-4 RECOVERY t=${EL}s submit $SUB_PREV -> $SUB (frozen ${GAP}s) rss=${RSSMB}MB frames=${FR:-?} pct=${PCT:-?}"
        shot "$EL" "recover"
      fi
      SUB_PREV=$SUB; SUB_T=$EL
    else
      GAP=$(( EL - SUB_T ))
      if [ "$FROZEN_LOGGED" -eq 0 ] && [ "$GAP" -ge 60 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 60 ]; then
        FROZEN_LOGGED=1; log "FROZEN t=${EL}s submit=$SUB (no growth for ${GAP}s) rss=${RSSMB}MB opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?}"
      fi
      if [ "$GAP" -ge "$KILL_GAP" ] && [ "${CFGPIPE:-0}" -ge "${MIN_CFGPIPE:-30}" ] && [ "$EL" -ge 60 ]; then
        log "EARLY-KILL t=${EL}s submit=$SUB frozen ${GAP}s (>=KILL_GAP ${KILL_GAP}) and cfg pipe table printed (n=${CFGPIPE}) -> stop to save memory"
        STOPPED_EARLY=1; FROZEN_LOGGED=1
        log "  cfg last: $(cut -c1-320 <<<"${CFGLAST:-}")"
        log "  veto:     $(cut -c1-320 <<<"${CFGVLINE:-}")"
        shot "$EL" "tfreeze"; break
      fi
      if [ "$GAP" -ge 40 ] && [ "${CFGPIPE:-0}" -lt "${MIN_CFGPIPE:-30}" ] && [ "$EL" -ge 200 ]; then
        log "EARLY-STALL t=${EL}s submit=$SUB frozen ${GAP}s with only ${CFGPIPE:-0} pipelines -> guest never reached the render phase (not the M6x freeze); abort"
        STOPPED_EARLY=1; shot "$EL" "tstall"; break
      fi
    fi
  fi
  # ---- faultlog grew = possible kill of something ----
  if [ "$NFT" -gt "$NF0" ]; then
    log "!! faultlog grew $NF0 -> $NFT at t=${EL}s"; NF0=$NFT
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_${EL}s.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR|has died' | tail -60" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_${EL}s.txt"
    break
  fi
  # ---- stop line ----
  if [ "$RSSMB" -gt "$RSS_STOP_MB" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=${RSSMB}MB > stop=${RSS_STOP_MB}MB -> stopping before LMK (task rule)"
    STOPPED_EARLY=1; shot "$EL" "tstop"; break
  fi
  # ---- keepalive ----
  if [ $(( EL - LASTRSSLOG )) -ge 16 ]; then
    LASTRSSLOG=$EL; RN=$((RN+1))
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=${RSSMB}MB opens=${OP:-?} reads=${RD:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} frames=${FR:-?} draws=${DW:-?} thr=${THR:-?}/os${THRO:-?} pct=${PCT:-?} stall=${STALL:-?}"
    [ -n "$CH" ] && log "   chg $(cut -c1-260 <<<"$CH")"
    [ -n "$FA" ] && log "   fa  $(cut -c1-240 <<<"$FA")"
    [ -n "$JD" ] && log "   j   $(cut -c1-200 <<<"$JD")"
    [ -n "$MV" ] && log "   mv  $(cut -c1-160 <<<"$MV")"
    [ "$CFGPIPE" -gt 0 ] && log "   cfg pipes=$CFGPIPE keys=$CFGKEY veto=$CFGVETO_N last=$(cut -c1-200 <<<"$CFGLAST")"
  fi
  # ---- screenshots ----
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  if [ "$RECOVERED" -eq 1 ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$NEXT_REC_SHOT" ]; then
    NEXT_REC_SHOT=$(( EL + 30 )); shot "$EL" "rec$EL"
  fi
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  # fast poll once we are in the high-water zone (LMK was measured at ~13.6 GB on this box)
  if [ "$RSSMB" -gt 12000 ]; then sleep 1; else sleep 4; fi
done

shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} stopped_early=${STOPPED_EARLY} recovered=${RECOVERED} opens_gt_1245=${OPENFLAG} maxthr=${MAXTHR}"
CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog_after entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST1" | grep -c . ) new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

# ---- pull (twice: the first recv of a live log is often a partial file) ----
for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 4; done
h file recv /data/local/tmp/m6y_samples.txt "$OUT/samples.txt" >/dev/null 2>&1
if [ -f "$OUT/vk_boot.log" ]; then
  DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  for K in st tk beat perf core grow mem mv malloc j sched io gst fa hang cfg; do
    grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
    log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ')"
  done
  grep -a '\[r\] draw totals' "$DL" > "$OUT/drawtotals.txt"; log "[r] totals=$(wc -l < "$OUT/drawtotals.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[st\] CHANGE' "$DL" > "$OUT/st_change.txt"; log "[st] CHANGE=$(wc -l < "$OUT/st_change.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "opens first/last: $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | head -1) .. $(grep -a -o 'opens=[0-9]*' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "[fa] ADVANCE=$(grep -ac '\[fa\] ADVANCE' "$OUT/fa.txt" || true) kinds=$(grep -ao '\[fa\][a-zA-Z0-9_#]*' "$OUT/fa.txt" | sort | uniq -c | tr '\n' ' ')"
  log "[perf] tail: $(tail -2 "$OUT/perf.txt" | tr '\n' '|' | cut -c1-400)"
  log "[grow] tail: $(tail -3 "$OUT/grow.txt" | cut -c1-200 | tr '\n' '|')"
  log "[mem] tail: $(tail -2 "$OUT/mem.txt" | cut -c1-260 | tr '\n' '|')"
else log "X vk_boot.log pull failed"; fi
if [ -f "$OUT/samples.txt" ]; then log "samples lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/samples.txt" | tr -d ' ') first=$(head -1 "$OUT/samples.txt") last=$(tail -1 "$OUT/samples.txt")"; fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG"

```

```sh
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m7u_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m7u_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"
printf 't\trss_mb\topens\treads\tlast\tframes\tsubmit\tclip_nsvc\tclip_n1c\tclip_n1d\tmain_nsvc\tjobs_by_main\tposter_n1d\n' > "$TSV"
: > "$OUT/probe.raw"
PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; LASTRSSLOG=-100; RN=0; LASTDROP=0
SUB_PREV=0; SUB_T=0; FROZEN_LOGGED=0
MAXTHR=0; OPENFLAG=0; STOPPED_EARLY=0; NF0=$NFT0
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  RAW=$(h shell "sh /data/local/tmp/m7u_probe.sh" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')
  # ---- switch readback within 20 s of launch (task rule) ----
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 20 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    PLINE=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m7a\] probe on|\[m7y\] probe on|\[m7u\] probe on|\[m7w\] probe on|\[m7x\] probe on|\[m7t\] aud probe on|\[m7t\] svc8 probe on|\[m7r\] probe on' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -8" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s PROBE-READBACK: ${PLINE:-<ABSENT - probe not enabled, ABORT>}"
    if [ -z "$PLINE" ]; then log "!! probe switch line absent within 20 s -> stopping (wiring wrong)"; STOPPED_EARLY=1; break; fi
  fi
  printf '### t=%s\n%s\n' "$EL" "$RAW" >> "$OUT/probe.raw"
  STLINE=$(grep -m1 '^STATE' <<<"$RAW")
  if grep -q '^STATE dead' <<<"$STLINE"; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR|has died' | tail -60" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt" | tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
    h shell "tail -n 5 $LOG" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/log_tail_at_death.txt"
    log "last log lines: $(tr '\n' '|' < "$OUT/log_tail_at_death.txt" | tail -c 400)"
    break
  fi
  PID=$(awk '{print $3}' <<<"$STLINE")
  if [ "$PID" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $PID at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$PID"; fi
  RSSKB=$(grep -m1 'VmRSS' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); RSSKB=${RSSKB:-0}
  RSSMB=$(( RSSKB / 1024 ))
  THRO=$(grep -m1 '^THREADS' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); THRO=${THRO:-0}
  NFT=$(grep -m1 '^FAULTLOG' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); NFT=${NFT:-0}
  ST=$(grep -m1 '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW")
  BT=$(grep -m1 '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW")
  FA=$(grep -a '\[fa\]' <<<"$RAW" | tr '\n' '|')
  MV=$(grep -m1 '\[mv\]' <<<"$RAW")
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  RD=$(grep -o 'reads=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); RD=${RD:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  MRCLIP=$(grep -m1 '\[m7r\] clip' <<<"$RAW")
  MRMAIN=$(grep -m1 '\[m7r\] main' <<<"$RAW")
  MRLAST=$(grep -o 'last=\S*' <<<"$MRMAIN" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  CV_=$(grep -o 'nsvc=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRCLIP" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  C1C=$(grep -o 'n1c=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRCLIP" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  C1D=$(grep -o 'n1d=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRCLIP" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  MN=$(grep -o 'nsvc=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRMAIN" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  JB=$(grep -o 'jobs=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRMAIN" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  P1D=$(grep -o 'post1d=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRMAIN" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' \
    "$EL" "$RSSMB" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${MRLAST:-}" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" \
    "${CV_:-}" "${C1C:-}" "${C1D:-}" "${MN:-}" "${JB:-}" "${P1D:-}" >> "$TSV"

  # ---- evidence drop every 100 s ----
  if [ -n "$OP" ] && [ $(( EL / 100 )) -gt "$LASTDROP" ]; then
    LASTDROP=$(( EL / 100 )); drop "$LASTDROP"
  fi

  if [ -n "$OP" ] && [ "$OP" -gt 1245 ] && [ "$OPENFLAG" -eq 0 ]; then
    OPENFLAG=1; log "SIGNAL-1 t=${EL}s opens=$OP > 1245 (new file paths) rss=${RSSMB}MB"
    shot "$EL" "opens$OP"
  fi
  if [ -n "$THRO" ] && [ "$THRO" -gt "$MAXTHR" ]; then MAXTHR=$THRO; fi
  if [ -n "$SUB" ] && [ "$FROZEN_LOGGED" -eq 0 ]; then
    if [ "$SUB" -gt "$SUB_PREV" ]; then SUB_PREV=$SUB; SUB_T=$EL
    else
      GAP=$(( EL - SUB_T ))
      if [ "$GAP" -ge 60 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 60 ]; then FROZEN_LOGGED=1; log "FROZEN t=${EL}s submit=$SUB (no growth for ${GAP}s) rss=${RSSMB}MB opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?}"; fi
    fi
  fi
  if [ "$NFT" -gt "$NF0" ]; then
    log "!! faultlog grew $NF0 -> $NFT at t=${EL}s"; NF0=$NFT
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_${EL}s.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR|has died' | tail -60" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_${EL}s.txt"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$RSSMB" -gt "$RSS_STOP_MB" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=${RSSMB}MB > stop=${RSS_STOP_MB}MB -> stopping before LMK (task rule)"
    STOPPED_EARLY=1; shot "$EL" "tstop"; break
  fi
  if [ $(( EL - LASTRSSLOG )) -ge 16 ]; then
    LASTRSSLOG=$EL; RN=$((RN+1))
    MVDEC=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[mv\] dec#' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')
    MOVC=$(h shell "grep -a -c 'MovieData' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')
    INJ=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[i\] hid inject' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=${RSSMB}MB opens=${OP:-?} reads=${RD:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} frames=${FR:-?} draws=${DW:-?} os_thr=${THRO:-?} movie=${MOVC} mvdec=${MVDEC} inj=${INJ}"
    [ -n "$MRCLIP" ] && log "   ${MRCLIP:0:280}"
    [ -n "$MRMAIN" ] && log "   ${MRMAIN:0:280}"
    [ -n "$FA" ] && log "   fa  $(cut -c1-240 <<<"$FA")"
    [ -n "$MV" ] && log "   mv  $(cut -c1-200 <<<"$MV")"
  fi
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  if [ "$RSSMB" -gt 12000 ]; then sleep 1; else sleep 4; fi
done

shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} stopped_early=${STOPPED_EARLY} maxthr=${MAXTHR}"
CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog_after entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST1" | grep -c .) new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

# ---- pull (twice: the first recv of a live log is often a partial file) ----
for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 4; done
h file recv /data/local/tmp/m6y_samples.txt "$OUT/samples.txt" >/dev/null 2>&1
if [ -f "$OUT/vk_boot.log" ]; then
  DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[m7t\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m7t.txt"; log "[m7t] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m7t.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[m7u\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m7u.txt"; log "[m7u] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m7u.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[m7w\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m7w.txt"; log "[m7w] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m7w.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; log "[m7w] tail: $(tail -1 "$OUT/m7w.txt" | cut -c1-400)"
  grep -a '\[m7x\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m7x.txt"; log "[m7x] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m7x.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[m7y\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m7y.txt"; log "[m7y] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m7y.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; log "[m7y] tail: $(tail -1 "$OUT/m7y.txt" | cut -c1-400)"
  grep -a '\[m7a\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m7a.txt"; log "[m7a] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m7a.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; log "[m7a] tail: $(tail -1 "$OUT/m7a.txt" | cut -c1-400)"
  grep -a '\[m7r\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m7r.txt"; log "[m7r] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m7r.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[svc\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/svc.txt"; log "[svc] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/svc.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a 'totk-audio' "$DL" > "$OUT/audio.txt"; log "totk-audio lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/audio.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[st\] t=' "$DL" > "$OUT/st.txt"; log "[st] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/st.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[i\] hid' "$DL" > "$OUT/inj.txt"; log "[i] inj lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/inj.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a 'MovieData' "$DL" > "$OUT/movie.txt"; log "MovieData lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/movie.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "[m7t] tail: $(tail -1 "$OUT/m7t.txt" | cut -c1-400)"
  log "[m7u] tail: $(tail -1 "$OUT/m7u.txt" | cut -c1-500)"
  log "[st] tail: $(tail -1 "$OUT/st.txt" | cut -c1-400)"
  log "[m7r] main tail: $(grep -a '\[m7r\] main' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-300)"
else log "X vk_boot.log pull failed"; fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG"

```

`m7b_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M7b: ONE 400 s boot (m7b task 2026-11-07 16:45) -- answer WHY batch#3 was never sent.
# New [m7b] probes (switch smo_m7b, C default 0): br = poster main+0x7aca60 ENTRY gate
# (first-32 caller-LR ring + first/last {t,x0,flag=[x0+0x18],pump=[x0+8]}), c13 = per-site
# counters on all 13 static bl callers (NEW tail=3 single-bl gate: stub replays the
# relocated bl), g56 = fnA TLS-gate TRUE(0x61570c sync)/FALSE(0x6157f0 submit) counts.
# Carries M7a probes (smo_m7a=1) with the two M7b fixes: fnB null ring = last-16 overwrite,
# request name = find key @slot+0x08. smo_gpu_write=0, smo_m7t_pos=0, M7k~M7o 0 kept.
# Usage: bash m7b_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]
# New [m7t] probes: aud line (audio_renderer.c counters: RequestUpdate callers, returned
# played/consumed, elapsed_frames, event signals) + svc8 line (main 0x1001's top-8 SVCs and
# services per 100 s window). Both behind switch smo_m7t (C default off). The intervention
# lever smo_m7t_pos (monotonic position without real BGM) stays 0 unless POS=1 is passed for
# the second boot. smo_m7r kept ON (opens/clip baseline series); smo_m7s OFF (M7s done).
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: m7u_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]}"
DUR="${2:-400}"
POS="${POS:-0}"
RSS_STOP_MB="${RSS_STOP_MB:-12500}"
SCHED_FILE="${SCHED_FILE:-/tmp/m6x_sched.txt}"
KILL_GAP="${KILL_GAP:-99999}"
CFG_VETO="${CFG_VETO:-0}"
CFG_HASHES="${CFG_HASHES:-}"
CFG_COST_THR="${CFG_COST_THR:-0}"
GPU_WRITE="${GPU_WRITE:-0}"
PLAN="${PLAN:-150 250 350}"
GD_SEC="${GD_SEC:-60}"
SYNTH="${SYNTH:-1}"
FRAMES="${FRAMES:-8}"
TESTSTICK="${TESTSTICK:-1 700 2000}"
TESTKEY="${TESTKEY:-1 160 1000 5000 30 38:10,36:20 1}"
MIN_CFGPIPE="${MIN_CFGPIPE:-0}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
TGT="127.0.0.1:5555"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m7b_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }
drop(){  # evidence drop: copy what exists so far (task rule: first <=250 s, then every 100 s)
  mkdir -p "$OUT/evidence_t$1"
  cp -f "$OUT/run.log" "$OUT/series.tsv" "$OUT/probe.raw" "$OUT/evidence_t$1/" 2>/dev/null || true
  log "evidence drop t=$1 (run.log=$(wc -l < "$OUT/run.log" | tr -d ' ')L series=$(wc -l < "$OUT/series.tsv" | tr -d ' ')L)"
}

log "=== M7t tag=$TAG dur=${DUR}s pos=$POS out=$OUT stop=${RSS_STOP_MB}MB sched=$(cat "$SCHED_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING)"
log "TESTKEY=[$TESTKEY] (faithful M5p: start=160s down=1000ms up=5000ms 30 presses 38x10,36x20 nofreeze=1)"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target offline ($TGT)"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing: $HAP"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$SCHED_FILE" ] || { log "X schedule missing: $SCHED_FILE"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }
stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty (pre-flight)"

# ---- install ----
UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"
OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); log "install: $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 300)"
grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_after: $UPD1"
[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

# ---- app-seeded switch files must exist before hdc can overwrite them ----
SX=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m6q_sched 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
SM7T=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7t 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
SM7TP=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7t_pos 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
SM7R=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7r 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
SM7U=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7u 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
SM7W=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7w 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
SM7X=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7y 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
SM7A=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7a 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
SM7B=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7b 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
if [ -z "$SX" ] || [ -z "$SM7T" ] || [ -z "$SM7TP" ] || [ -z "$SM7R" ] || [ -z "$SM7U" ] || [ -z "$SM7W" ] || [ -z "$SM7X" ] || [ -z "$SM7A" ] || [ -z "$SM7B" ]; then
  log "seed launch needed (sched=[$SX:-absent] smo_m7t=[${SM7T:-absent}] smo_m7t_pos=[${SM7TP:-absent}] smo_m7r=[${SM7R:-absent}] smo_m7u=[${SM7U:-absent}] smo_m7w=[${SM7W:-absent}] smo_m7y=[${SM7X:-absent}] smo_m7a=[${SM7A:-absent}] smo_m7b=[${SM7B:-absent}])"
  h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  sleep 20
  SX=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m6q_sched 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  SM7T=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7t 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  SM7TP=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7t_pos 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  SM7R=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7r 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  SM7U=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7u 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  SM7W=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7w 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  SM7X=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7y 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
SM7A=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7a 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  SM7B=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7b 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed check: sched=${SX:-<ABSENT>} smo_m7t=${SM7T:-<ABSENT>} smo_m7t_pos=${SM7TP:-<ABSENT>} smo_m7r=${SM7R:-<ABSENT>} smo_m7u=${SM7U:-<ABSENT>} smo_m7w=${SM7W:-<ABSENT>} smo_m7y=${SM7X:-<ABSENT>} smo_m7a=${SM7A:-<ABSENT>} smo_m7b=${SM7B:-<ABSENT>}"
  { [ -z "$SX" ] || [ -z "$SM7T" ] || [ -z "$SM7TP" ] || [ -z "$SM7R" ] || [ -z "$SM7U" ] || [ -z "$SM7W" ] || [ -z "$SM7X" ] || [ -z "$SM7A" ] || [ -z "$SM7B" ]; } && { log "X switch files still absent"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X pid before measured boot"; exit 1; }
else
  log "switch files present: sched ok, smo_m7t ok, smo_m7t_pos ok, smo_m7r ok, smo_m7u ok, smo_m7w ok, smo_m7y ok, smo_m7a ok, smo_m7b ok"
fi

# ---- switches for the measured boot ----
h shell "printf '%s' '$(cat "$SCHED_FILE")' > $FILES/smo_m6q_sched && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "printf '%s' '$TESTKEY' > $FILES/smo_testkey && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_m7t && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $POS > $FILES/smo_m7t_pos && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_m7r && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_m7s && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_m7u && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_m7w && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_m7y && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_m7a && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_m7b && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_m7x && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_m7a_kick && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "M7k~M7o knob check (task rule: all 0, no writes to unknown files): $(h shell "cd $FILES && for f in smo_m7k smo_m7l smo_m7m smo_m7n smo_m7o; do [ -f \$f ] && echo -n \"\$f=\$(cat \$f | tr -d '\\r') \" || echo -n \"\$f=absent \"; done; echo" | tr -d '\r')"
RS=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m6q_sched" | tr -d '\r')
log "sched readback=[$RS] bytes=$(h shell "wc -c < $FILES/smo_m6q_sched" | tr -dc '0-9')"
log "testkey readback=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')]"
log "smo_m7t readback=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7t" | tr -d '\r')] smo_m7t_pos readback=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7t_pos" | tr -d '\r')] smo_m7r readback=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7r" | tr -d '\r')] smo_m7s readback=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7s" | tr -d '\r')] smo_m7u readback=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7u" | tr -d '\r')] smo_m7w readback=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7w" | tr -d '\r')] smo_m7y readback=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7y" | tr -d '\r')] smo_m7x readback=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7x" | tr -d '\r')] smo_m7a readback=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7a" | tr -d '\r')] smo_m7b readback=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7b" | tr -d '\r')] smo_m7a_kick readback=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7a_kick" | tr -d '\r')]"
M7TRB=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7t" | tr -d '\r'); M7URB=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7u" | tr -d '\r'); M7WRB=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7w" | tr -d '\r'); M7XRB=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7y" | tr -d '\r')
M7ARB=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7a" | tr -d '\r')
[ "$M7TRB" = "1" ] || { log "X smo_m7t not 1 -> probe would be off, abort before wasting the boot"; exit 1; }
[ "$M7URB" = "1" ] || { log "X smo_m7u not 1 -> m7u probe would be off, abort before wasting the boot"; exit 1; }
[ "$M7WRB" = "1" ] || { log "X smo_m7w not 1 -> m7w probe would be off, abort before wasting the boot"; exit 1; }
[ "$M7XRB" = "1" ] || { log "X smo_m7y not 1 -> m7y probe would be off, abort before wasting the boot"; exit 1; }
[ "$M7ARB" = "1" ] || { log "X smo_m7a not 1 -> m7a probe would be off, abort before wasting the boot"; exit 1; }

[ "$M7BRB" = "1" ] || { log "X smo_m7b not 1 -> m7b probe would be off, abort before wasting the boot"; exit 1; }

# ---- our own guards OFF (task rule) ----
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard" >/dev/null 2>&1

log "guard files: smo_rss_guard=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_rss_guard" | tr -d '\r')] smo_mem_purge=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_mem_purge" | tr -d '\r')]"

# ---- log reset ----
PRE=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); PRE=${PRE:-0}
MODE="truncate(:>)"
if ! h shell ": > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then MODE="rm -f"; h shell "rm -f $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi
SZ=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); SZ=${SZ:-0}
[ "$SZ" = "0" ] || { log "X log not reset: $MODE size=$SZ"; exit 1; }
log "log reset ok: mode=$MODE before=$PRE after=$SZ"

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
NFT0=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST0" | grep -c .); log "faultlog_before entries=$NFT0"

h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1
```
