```sh
# ---- boot ----
h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
START=$(date +%s)
FIRSTPID=""
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 1
done

h shell "echo $SYNTH > $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null; echo $FRAMES > $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null; echo '$TESTSTICK' > $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "switches after seed: synth=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')] stick=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick" | tr -d '\r')]"

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m7h2_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m7h2_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

pull_pngs(){
  local PLIST N=0
  PLIST=$(h shell "ls $FILES 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | grep -a '^m7h_world_.*\.png$' || true)
  N=$(printf '%s' "$PLIST" | grep -ac . || true)
  log "png_on_device count=$N"
  [ -z "$PLIST" ] && return 0
  mkdir -p "$OUT/png"
  printf '%s\n' "$PLIST" | while IFS= read -r p; do
    [ -n "$p" ] || continue
    if h file recv "$FILES/$p" "$OUT/png/$p" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      log "recv $p bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/png/$p" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ') md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/png/$p" 2>/dev/null)"
    else log "X recv $p failed"; fi
  done
}

TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"
printf 't\trss_mb\tvmsize_mb\tvmdata_mb\topens\treads\tsubmit\tframes\tdraws\tthr\tpct\tstall\tnflags\n' > "$TSV"
: > "$OUT/probe.raw"
PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; LASTRSSLOG=-100; RN=0
SUB_PREV=0; SUB_T=0; FROZEN_LOGGED=0; RECOVERED=0; NEXT_REC_SHOT=0
MAXTHR=0; OPENFLAG=0; STOPPED_EARLY=0; GUARDSEEN=0; NF0=$NFT0; LASTDUMPC=-1
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  RAW=$(h shell "sh /data/local/tmp/m7g_probe.sh" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')
  # ---- probe switch readback within 20 s of launch (task rule) ----
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 20 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    PLINE=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\\[m7h\\] probe|\\[m7g\\] probe|\\[wp\\] probe' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -4" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s PROBE-READBACK: ${PLINE:-<ABSENT - probe not enabled, ABORT>}"
    if [ -z "$PLINE" ]; then log "!! probe switch line absent within 20 s -> stopping (wiring wrong)"; STOPPED_EARLY=1; break; fi
  fi
  printf '### t=%s\n%s\n' "$EL" "$RAW" >> "$OUT/probe.raw"
  STLINE=$(grep -m1 '^STATE' <<<"$RAW")
  if grep -q '^STATE dead' <<<"$STLINE"; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR|has died' | tail -60" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt" | tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
    h shell "tail -n 5 $LOG" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/log_tail_at_death.txt"
    log "last log lines: $(tr '\n' '|' < "$OUT/log_tail_at_death.txt" | tail -c 400)"
    break
  fi
  PID=$(awk '{print $3}' <<<"$STLINE")
  if [ "$PID" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $PID at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$PID"; fi
  RSSKB=$(grep -m1 'VmRSS' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); RSSKB=${RSSKB:-0}
  RSSMB=$(( RSSKB / 1024 ))
  THRO=$(grep -m1 '^THREADS' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); THRO=${THRO:-0}
  NFT=$(grep -m1 '^FAULTLOG' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); NFT=${NFT:-0}
  ST=$(grep -m1 '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW")
  BT=$(grep -m1 '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW")
  MM=$(grep -m1 '\[mem\] t=' <<<"$RAW")
  FA=$(grep -a '\[fa\]' <<<"$RAW" | tr '\n' '|')
  PF=$(grep -m1 '\[perf\]' <<<"$RAW")
  JD=$(grep -m1 'RSS GUARD' <<<"$RAW")
  MV=$(grep -m1 '\[mv\]' <<<"$RAW")
  CFGPIPE=$(awk '/^CFGPIPE/{print $2}' <<<"$RAW"); CFGPIPE=${CFGPIPE:-0}
  CFGKEY=$(awk '/^CFGKEY/{print $2}' <<<"$RAW"); CFGKEY=${CFGKEY:-0}
  CFGVETO_N=$(awk '/^CFGVETO/{print $2}' <<<"$RAW"); CFGVETO_N=${CFGVETO_N:-0}
  CFGLAST=$(grep -a '\[cfg\] pipe#' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  CFGVLINE=$(grep -a '\[cfg\] veto' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  RD=$(grep -o 'reads=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); RD=${RD:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  PCT=$(grep -o 'pct=[0-9-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); PCT=${PCT:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  VMSZ=$(grep -o 'vmsize=[0-9]*' <<<"$MM" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); VMSZ=${VMSZ:-}
  VMDT=$(grep -o 'vmdata=[0-9]*' <<<"$MM" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); VMDT=${VMDT:-}
  THR=$(grep -o 'threads=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); THR=${THR:-0}
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' \
    "$EL" "$RSSMB" "${VMSZ:-}" "${VMDT:-}" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${FR:-}" "${DW:-}" "${THR:-}" "${PCT:-}" "${STALL:-}" "-" >> "$TSV"

  if [ "$GUARDSEEN" -eq 0 ] && [ -n "$JD" ]; then
    GUARDSEEN=1
    log "GUARD line: $JD"
    if grep -q 'trip=20000MB' <<<"$JD"; then log "GUARD OK: trip=20000MB (above any reachable RSS; hard cap raised too)"
    else log "!! WARNING: guard line does not show trip=20000MB - our guard may still act"; fi
  fi
  if [ -n "$OP" ] && [ "$OP" -gt 1245 ] && [ "$OPENFLAG" -eq 0 ]; then
    OPENFLAG=1; log "SIGNAL-1 t=${EL}s opens=$OP > 1245 (new file paths) rss=${RSSMB}MB"
    shot "$EL" "opens$OP"
  fi
  if [ -n "$THR" ] && [ "$THR" -gt 27 ] && [ "$THR" -gt "$MAXTHR" ]; then
    MAXTHR=$THR; log "SIGNAL-2 t=${EL}s guest_threads=$THR (>27) submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} os_thr=$THRO"
  fi
  if [ -n "$SUB" ]; then
    if [ "$SUB" -gt "$SUB_PREV" ]; then
      GAP=$(( EL - SUB_T ))
      if [ "$FROZEN_LOGGED" -eq 1 ] && [ "$RECOVERED" -eq 0 ] && [ "$GAP" -ge 60 ]; then
        RECOVERED=1; NEXT_REC_SHOT=$(( EL + 30 ))
        log "SIGNAL-4 RECOVERY t=${EL}s submit $SUB_PREV -> $SUB (frozen ${GAP}s) rss=${RSSMB}MB frames=${FR:-?} pct=${PCT:-?}"
        shot "$EL" "recover"
      fi
      SUB_PREV=$SUB; SUB_T=$EL
    else
      GAP=$(( EL - SUB_T ))
      if [ "$FROZEN_LOGGED" -eq 0 ] && [ "$GAP" -ge 60 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 60 ]; then
        FROZEN_LOGGED=1; log "FROZEN t=${EL}s submit=$SUB (no growth for ${GAP}s) rss=${RSSMB}MB opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?}"
      fi
      if [ "$GAP" -ge "$KILL_GAP" ] && [ "${CFGPIPE:-0}" -ge "${MIN_CFGPIPE:-30}" ] && [ "$EL" -ge 60 ]; then
        log "EARLY-KILL t=${EL}s submit=$SUB frozen ${GAP}s (>=KILL_GAP ${KILL_GAP}) and cfg pipe table printed (n=${CFGPIPE}) -> stop to save memory"
        STOPPED_EARLY=1; FROZEN_LOGGED=1
        log "  cfg last: $(cut -c1-320 <<<"${CFGLAST:-}")"
        shot "$EL" "tfreeze"; break
      fi
      if [ "$GAP" -ge 40 ] && [ "${CFGPIPE:-0}" -lt "${MIN_CFGPIPE:-30}" ] && [ "$EL" -ge 200 ]; then
        log "EARLY-STALL t=${EL}s submit=$SUB frozen ${GAP}s with only ${CFGPIPE:-0} pipelines -> guest never reached the render phase; abort"
        STOPPED_EARLY=1; shot "$EL" "tstall"; break
      fi
    fi
  fi
  if [ "$NFT" -gt "$NF0" ]; then
    log "!! faultlog grew $NF0 -> $NFT at t=${EL}s"; NF0=$NFT
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_${EL}s.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR|has died' | tail -60" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_${EL}s.txt"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$RSSMB" -gt "$RSS_STOP_MB" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=${RSSMB}MB > stop=${RSS_STOP_MB}MB -> stopping before LMK (task rule)"
    STOPPED_EARLY=1; shot "$EL" "tstop"; break
  fi
  if [ $(( EL - LASTRSSLOG )) -ge 16 ]; then
    LASTRSSLOG=$EL; RN=$((RN+1))
    DUMPC=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[m7h\] dump t=' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9'); DUMPC=${DUMPC:-0}
    SRCLINE=$(h shell "grep -a '\[m7h\] src set' $LOG 2>/dev/null | tail -1" | tr -d '\r' | cut -c1-260)
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=${RSSMB}MB opens=${OP:-?} reads=${RD:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} frames=${FR:-?} draws=${DW:-?} thr=${THR:-?}/os${THRO:-?} pct=${PCT:-?} dumps=$DUMPC"
    [ "$DUMPC" != "$LASTDUMPC" ] && log "   [m7h] dumps=$DUMPC (was $LASTDUMPC) fail=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[m7h\] dump fail' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9') skipblack=$(h shell "grep -a -c 'dump_skip' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')"
    [ -n "$SRCLINE" ] && log "   src: $SRCLINE"
    LASTDUMPC=$DUMPC
    CHG=$(grep -m1 '\[st\] CHANGE' <<<"$RAW"); [ -n "$CHG" ] && log "   chg $(cut -c1-260 <<<"$CHG")"
    [ -n "$FA" ] && log "   fa  $(cut -c1-240 <<<"$FA")"
    [ "$CFGPIPE" -gt 0 ] && log "   cfg pipes=$CFGPIPE keys=$CFGKEY veto=$CFGVETO_N last=$(cut -c1-160 <<<"$CFGLAST")"
  fi
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  if [ "$RSSMB" -gt 12000 ]; then sleep 1; else sleep 4; fi
done

shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} stopped_early=${STOPPED_EARLY} recovered=${RECOVERED} maxthr=${MAXTHR}"
CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog_after entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST1" | grep -c .) new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 4; done

  log "[m7h] src lines: $(grep -a '\[m7h\] src set' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-260)"
  log "[m7h] dump count=$(grep -a -c '\[m7h\] dump t=' "$DL") fail=$(grep -a -c '\[m7h\] dump fail' "$DL")"
  log "[m7h] dump lines:"; grep -a '\[m7h\] dump' "$DL" | cut -c1-320 >> "$OUT/run.log" 2>/dev/null || true
  log "[wp] rt tail: $(grep -a '\[wp\] rt sum' "$DL" | tail -2 | tr '\n' '|' | cut -c1-400)"
  log "[perf] tail: $(tail -2 "$OUT/perf.txt" 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' '|' | cut -c1-400)"
  log "[mem] tail: $(tail -2 "$OUT/mem.txt" 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-260 | tr '\n' '|')"
else log "X vk_boot.log pull failed"; fi
if [ -f "$OUT/samples.txt" ]; then log "samples lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/samples.txt" | tr -d ' ') first=$(head -1 "$OUT/samples.txt") last=$(tail -1 "$OUT/samples.txt")"; fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG"
```

`m7i_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M7I: ONE device boot (task 2026-11-08 00:46) -- loader 0x1007 断供现场.
# Device only (192.168.0.111:42323). The emulator 127.0.0.1:5555 is NEVER touched.
# Switch set ALIGNED to M7G's closing round (M7H限定C: the old device/emulator comparison was
# cross-build + cross-switch): smo_m7h/m7g/m7r/m7c/m7e/m7u + sha_ungated + dspool = 1,
# smo_m7d_same=0 (M7H's known polluter), gpu_write=0, plus the two new M7I switches.
# Usage: bash m7i_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: m7i_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]}"
DUR="${2:-600}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
TGT="192.168.0.111:42323"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m7i_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }
stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }

h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target offline"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"
log "upd: $(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)"
stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty (pre-flight)"

# ---- seed launch: only if smo_ldrd did not get created by the install-time constructor run ----
SEED=0
if [ -z "$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_ldrd 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ]; then
  SEED=1
  log "seed launch needed (smo_ldrd absent) -- NOT part of the measured boot"
  h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 120 ] && { log "X seed: no pid in 120s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  sleep 20
  stopapp || { log "X seed: pid alive"; exit 1; }
fi
log "seed_launch=$SEED"
for f in smo_ldrd smo_aud; do log "file $f: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/$f 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')"; done

# ---- switches for the measured boot ----
set1(){ h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; }
set0(){ h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; }
for s in smo_m7h smo_m7g smo_m7r smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_sha_ungated smo_dspool smo_ldrd smo_aud; do set1 "$s"; done
for s in smo_m7d_same smo_m7a smo_m7b smo_m7x smo_m7y smo_m7t smo_m7w smo_m7fix smo_m7f smo_m7d6 smo_dsdiag smo_m7a_kick smo_m7t_pos smo_gpu_write smo_movie_kick smo_gdump; do set0 "$s"; done
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge" >/dev/null 2>&1

RB=""
for s in smo_m7h smo_m7g smo_m7r smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_sha_ungated smo_dspool smo_ldrd smo_aud smo_m7d_same smo_m7a smo_m7b smo_m7x smo_m7y smo_m7t smo_m7w smo_m7fix smo_m7f smo_m7d6 smo_dsdiag smo_m7a_kick smo_gpu_write; do
  RB="$RB $s=$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n');"
done
log "switch readback:$RB"
for s in smo_ldrd smo_aud smo_m7h smo_m7g smo_m7r smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_sha_ungated smo_dspool; do
  V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')
  [ "$V" = "1" ] || { log "X $s=$V, expected 1 -> abort before wasting the boot"; exit 1; }
done
for s in smo_m7d_same smo_m7a smo_m7b smo_m7x smo_m7y smo_m7t smo_m7w smo_gpu_write; do
  V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')
  [ "$V" = "0" ] || { log "!! $s=$V (expected 0)"; }
done

# ---- log reset ----
PRE=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); PRE=${PRE:-0}
MODE="truncate(:>)"
if ! h shell ": > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then MODE="rm -f"; h shell "rm -f $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi
SZ=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); SZ=${SZ:-0}
[ "$SZ" = "0" ] || { log "X log not reset: $MODE size=$SZ"; exit 1; }
log "log reset ok: mode=$MODE before=$PRE after=$SZ"
log "faultlog_before entries=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | grep -c .)"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m7i_$TAG$1.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m7i_$TAG$1.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$1.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if [ -f "$OUT/screen_$1.jpeg" ]; then
    sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$1.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$1.png" >/dev/null 2>&1
    log "screen_$1 @t=$2s md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$1.png" 2>/dev/null || echo NA)"
  else log "X screen_$1 capture failed @t=$2s"; fi
}

# ---- boot ----
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"
printf 't\tpid\topens\treads\tbytes\tlast\tframes\tworldrt\tloader\n' > "$TSV"
h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
START=$(date +%s); FIRSTPID=""
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 120 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 120s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 1
done
# 20 s readback of the switches (task rule)
sleep 20
log "t=20s readback: ldrd=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_ldrd" | tr -d '\r\n') aud=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_aud" | tr -d '\r\n')"
log "t=20s probe lines: $(h shell "grep -ac '^.*\[ldrd\] probe on' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n') ldrd / $(h shell "grep -ac '\[aud\] probe on' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n') aud"

DID150=0; DID400=0
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && { log "reached dur=${DUR}s"; break; }
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$P" ]; then log "X process gone at t=${EL}s (died)"; break; fi
  L=$(h shell "tail -n 600 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[io\] load' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  B=$(h shell "tail -n 300 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[beat\]' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  W=$(h shell "tail -n 400 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a '\[k\] worldrt' | tail -1" | tr -d '\r')
  OPS=$(printf '%s' "$L" | sed -n 's/.*opens=\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p')
  RDS=$(printf '%s' "$L" | sed -n 's/.*reads=\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p')
  BYS=$(printf '%s' "$L" | sed -n 's/.*bytes=\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p')
  LST=$(printf '%s' "$L" | sed -n 's/.*last=\([^ ]*\).*/\1/p')
  FRM=$(printf '%s' "$B" | sed -n 's/.*frames=\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p')
  NR=$(printf '%s' "$W" | wc -c | tr -d ' ')
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "$P" "${OPS:--}" "${RDS:--}" "${BYS:--}" "${LST:--}" "${FRM:--}" "$([ "$NR" -gt 2 ] && echo yes || echo no)" "$L" >> "$TSV"
  log "t=${EL}s pid=$P opens=${OPS:--} reads=${RDS:--} bytes=${BYS:--} frames=${FRM:--} last=${LST:--}"
  if [ "$DID150" = 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 150 ]; then DID150=1; shot t150 "$EL"; fi
  if [ "$DID400" = 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 400 ]; then DID400=1; shot t400 "$EL"; fi
  sleep 28
done
SURV=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
log "survived_secs=$SURV"

# ---- collect ----
h shell "cp $LOG /data/local/tmp/m7i_$TAG.log 2>/dev/null; chmod 644 /data/local/tmp/m7i_$TAG.log 2>/dev/null" >/dev/null 2>&1
h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m7i_$TAG.log" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "vk_boot.log bytes=$(wc -c < "$OUT/vk_boot.log" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ') lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/vk_boot.log" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ')"
for pat in "\[ldrd\] probe on" "\[ldrd\] open #" "\[ldrd\] thr " "\[ldrd\] stk " "\[ldrd\] sstk " "\[ldrd\] obj " "\[aud\] probe on" "\[aud\] thr " "\[wg\] key " "\[lp\] poster " "\[io\] load "; do
  log "count $pat = $(grep -ac "$pat" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
done
log "faultlog_after entries=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | grep -c .)"
h shell "hilog -d -f /data/local/tmp/m7i_hilog.txt >/dev/null 2>&1" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== DONE ==="

```

`m7k_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
  h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  sleep 20
  SX=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m6q_sched 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed check: ${SX:-<ABSENT>}"
  [ -z "$SX" ] && { log "X schedule file still absent"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X pid before measured boot"; exit 1; }
else
  log "sched file present: $SX"
fi

# ---- switches for the measured boot ----
h shell "printf '%s' '$(cat "$SCHED_FILE")' > $FILES/smo_m6q_sched && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1

# ---- our own guards OFF (task rule) ----
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard" >/dev/null 2>&1

log "guard files: smo_rss_guard=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_rss_guard" | tr -d '\r')] smo_mem_purge=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_mem_purge" | tr -d '\r')]"

# ---- log reset ----
PRE=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); PRE=${PRE:-0}
MODE="truncate(:>)"
if ! h shell ": > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then MODE="rm -f"; h shell "rm -f $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi
SZ=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); SZ=${SZ:-0}
[ "$SZ" = "0" ] || { log "X log not reset: $MODE size=$SZ"; exit 1; }
log "log reset ok: mode=$MODE before=$PRE after=$SZ"

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
NFT0=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST0" | grep -c .); log "faultlog_before entries=$NFT0"

h shell "echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_snap_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_present_gain; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_gpres" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1

START=$(date +%s)
FIRSTPID=""
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 1
done

h shell "echo $SYNTH > $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null; echo $FRAMES > $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null; echo '$TESTSTICK' > $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "switches after seed: synth=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')] stick=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick" | tr -d '\r')]"

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m7h2_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m7h2_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

pull_pngs(){
  local PLIST N=0
  PLIST=$(h shell "ls $FILES 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | grep -a '^m7h_world_.*\.png$' || true)
  N=$(printf '%s' "$PLIST" | grep -ac . || true)
  log "png_on_device count=$N"
  [ -z "$PLIST" ] && return 0
  mkdir -p "$OUT/png"
  printf '%s\n' "$PLIST" | while IFS= read -r p; do
    [ -n "$p" ] || continue
    if h file recv "$FILES/$p" "$OUT/png/$p" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      log "recv $p bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/png/$p" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ') md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/png/$p" 2>/dev/null)"
    else log "X recv $p failed"; fi
  done
}

TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"
printf 't\trss_mb\tvmsize_mb\tvmdata_mb\topens\treads\tsubmit\tframes\tdraws\tthr\tpct\tstall\tnflags\n' > "$TSV"
: > "$OUT/probe.raw"
PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; LASTRSSLOG=-100; RN=0
SUB_PREV=0; SUB_T=0; FROZEN_LOGGED=0; RECOVERED=0; NEXT_REC_SHOT=0
MAXTHR=0; OPENFLAG=0; STOPPED_EARLY=0; GUARDSEEN=0; NF0=$NFT0; LASTDUMPC=-1
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  RAW=$(h shell "sh /data/local/tmp/m7g_probe.sh" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')
  # ---- probe switch readback within 20 s of launch (task rule) ----
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 20 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    PLINE=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\\[m7k\\] small-evict|\\[m7h\\] probe|\\[m7g\\] probe|\\[wp\\] probe' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -5" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s PROBE-READBACK: ${PLINE:-<ABSENT - probe not enabled, ABORT>}"
    if [ -z "$PLINE" ]; then log "!! probe switch line absent within 20 s -> stopping (wiring wrong)"; STOPPED_EARLY=1; break; fi
  fi
  printf '### t=%s\n%s\n' "$EL" "$RAW" >> "$OUT/probe.raw"
  STLINE=$(grep -m1 '^STATE' <<<"$RAW")
  if grep -q '^STATE dead' <<<"$STLINE"; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR|has died' | tail -60" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt" | tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
    h shell "tail -n 5 $LOG" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/log_tail_at_death.txt"
    log "last log lines: $(tr '\n' '|' < "$OUT/log_tail_at_death.txt" | tail -c 400)"
    break
  fi
  PID=$(awk '{print $3}' <<<"$STLINE")
  if [ "$PID" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $PID at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$PID"; fi
  RSSKB=$(grep -m1 'VmRSS' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); RSSKB=${RSSKB:-0}
  RSSMB=$(( RSSKB / 1024 ))
  THRO=$(grep -m1 '^THREADS' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); THRO=${THRO:-0}
  NFT=$(grep -m1 '^FAULTLOG' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); NFT=${NFT:-0}
  ST=$(grep -m1 '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW")
  BT=$(grep -m1 '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW")
  MM=$(grep -m1 '\[mem\] t=' <<<"$RAW")
  FA=$(grep -a '\[fa\]' <<<"$RAW" | tr '\n' '|')
  PF=$(grep -m1 '\[perf\]' <<<"$RAW")
  JD=$(grep -m1 'RSS GUARD' <<<"$RAW")
  MV=$(grep -m1 '\[mv\]' <<<"$RAW")
  CFGPIPE=$(awk '/^CFGPIPE/{print $2}' <<<"$RAW"); CFGPIPE=${CFGPIPE:-0}
  CFGKEY=$(awk '/^CFGKEY/{print $2}' <<<"$RAW"); CFGKEY=${CFGKEY:-0}
  CFGVETO_N=$(awk '/^CFGVETO/{print $2}' <<<"$RAW"); CFGVETO_N=${CFGVETO_N:-0}
  CFGLAST=$(grep -a '\[cfg\] pipe#' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  CFGVLINE=$(grep -a '\[cfg\] veto' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  RD=$(grep -o 'reads=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); RD=${RD:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  PCT=$(grep -o 'pct=[0-9-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); PCT=${PCT:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  VMSZ=$(grep -o 'vmsize=[0-9]*' <<<"$MM" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); VMSZ=${VMSZ:-}
  VMDT=$(grep -o 'vmdata=[0-9]*' <<<"$MM" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); VMDT=${VMDT:-}
  THR=$(grep -o 'threads=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); THR=${THR:-0}
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' \
    "$EL" "$RSSMB" "${VMSZ:-}" "${VMDT:-}" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${FR:-}" "${DW:-}" "${THR:-}" "${PCT:-}" "${STALL:-}" "-" >> "$TSV"

  if [ "$GUARDSEEN" -eq 0 ] && [ -n "$JD" ]; then
    GUARDSEEN=1
    log "GUARD line: $JD"
    if grep -q 'trip=20000MB' <<<"$JD"; then log "GUARD OK: trip=20000MB (above any reachable RSS; hard cap raised too)"
    else log "!! WARNING: guard line does not show trip=20000MB - our guard may still act"; fi
  fi
  if [ -n "$OP" ] && [ "$OP" -gt 1245 ] && [ "$OPENFLAG" -eq 0 ]; then
    OPENFLAG=1; log "SIGNAL-1 t=${EL}s opens=$OP > 1245 (new file paths) rss=${RSSMB}MB"
    shot "$EL" "opens$OP"
  fi
  if [ -n "$THR" ] && [ "$THR" -gt 27 ] && [ "$THR" -gt "$MAXTHR" ]; then
    MAXTHR=$THR; log "SIGNAL-2 t=${EL}s guest_threads=$THR (>27) submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} os_thr=$THRO"
  fi
  if [ -n "$SUB" ]; then
    if [ "$SUB" -gt "$SUB_PREV" ]; then
      GAP=$(( EL - SUB_T ))
      if [ "$FROZEN_LOGGED" -eq 1 ] && [ "$RECOVERED" -eq 0 ] && [ "$GAP" -ge 60 ]; then
        RECOVERED=1; NEXT_REC_SHOT=$(( EL + 30 ))
        log "SIGNAL-4 RECOVERY t=${EL}s submit $SUB_PREV -> $SUB (frozen ${GAP}s) rss=${RSSMB}MB frames=${FR:-?} pct=${PCT:-?}"
        shot "$EL" "recover"
      fi
      SUB_PREV=$SUB; SUB_T=$EL
    else
      GAP=$(( EL - SUB_T ))
      if [ "$FROZEN_LOGGED" -eq 0 ] && [ "$GAP" -ge 60 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 60 ]; then
        FROZEN_LOGGED=1; log "FROZEN t=${EL}s submit=$SUB (no growth for ${GAP}s) rss=${RSSMB}MB opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?}"
      fi
      if [ "$GAP" -ge "$KILL_GAP" ] && [ "${CFGPIPE:-0}" -ge "${MIN_CFGPIPE:-30}" ] && [ "$EL" -ge 60 ]; then
        log "EARLY-KILL t=${EL}s submit=$SUB frozen ${GAP}s (>=KILL_GAP ${KILL_GAP}) and cfg pipe table printed (n=${CFGPIPE}) -> stop to save memory"
        STOPPED_EARLY=1; FROZEN_LOGGED=1
        log "  cfg last: $(cut -c1-320 <<<"${CFGLAST:-}")"
        shot "$EL" "tfreeze"; break
      fi
      if [ "$GAP" -ge 40 ] && [ "${CFGPIPE:-0}" -lt "${MIN_CFGPIPE:-30}" ] && [ "$EL" -ge 200 ]; then
        log "EARLY-STALL t=${EL}s submit=$SUB frozen ${GAP}s with only ${CFGPIPE:-0} pipelines -> guest never reached the render phase; abort"
        STOPPED_EARLY=1; shot "$EL" "tstall"; break
      fi
    fi
  fi
  if [ "$NFT" -gt "$NF0" ]; then
    log "!! faultlog grew $NF0 -> $NFT at t=${EL}s"; NF0=$NFT
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_${EL}s.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR|has died' | tail -60" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_${EL}s.txt"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$RSSMB" -gt "$RSS_STOP_MB" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=${RSSMB}MB > stop=${RSS_STOP_MB}MB -> stopping before LMK (task rule)"
    STOPPED_EARLY=1; shot "$EL" "tstop"; break
  fi
  if [ $(( EL - LASTRSSLOG )) -ge 16 ]; then
    LASTRSSLOG=$EL; RN=$((RN+1))
    DUMPC=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[m7h\] dump t=' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9'); DUMPC=${DUMPC:-0}
    SRCLINE=$(h shell "grep -a '\[m7h\] src set' $LOG 2>/dev/null | tail -1" | tr -d '\r' | cut -c1-260)
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=${RSSMB}MB opens=${OP:-?} reads=${RD:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} frames=${FR:-?} draws=${DW:-?} thr=${THR:-?}/os${THRO:-?} pct=${PCT:-?} dumps=$DUMPC"
    [ "$DUMPC" != "$LASTDUMPC" ] && log "   [m7h] dumps=$DUMPC (was $LASTDUMPC) fail=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[m7h\] dump fail' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9') skipblack=$(h shell "grep -a -c 'dump_skip' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')"
    [ -n "$SRCLINE" ] && log "   src: $SRCLINE"
    log "   m7k: small_evict=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[m7k\] small evict' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9') ph_lines=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[m7k\] ph id=' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')"
    LASTDUMPC=$DUMPC
    CHG=$(grep -m1 '\[st\] CHANGE' <<<"$RAW"); [ -n "$CHG" ] && log "   chg $(cut -c1-260 <<<"$CHG")"
    [ -n "$FA" ] && log "   fa  $(cut -c1-240 <<<"$FA")"
    [ "$CFGPIPE" -gt 0 ] && log "   cfg pipes=$CFGPIPE keys=$CFGKEY veto=$CFGVETO_N last=$(cut -c1-160 <<<"$CFGLAST")"
  fi
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  if [ "$RSSMB" -gt 12000 ]; then sleep 1; else sleep 4; fi
done

shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} stopped_early=${STOPPED_EARLY} recovered=${RECOVERED} maxthr=${MAXTHR}"
CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog_after entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST1" | grep -c .) new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

# ---- pull (twice: the first recv of a live log is often a partial file) ----
for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 4; done
h file recv /data/local/tmp/m6y_samples.txt "$OUT/samples.txt" >/dev/null 2>&1
pull_pngs
if [ -f "$OUT/vk_boot.log" ]; then
  DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  for K in st beat perf mem mv sched wp m7c m7g m7h m7i m7k; do
    grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
    log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ')"
  done
  grep -a '\[st\] CHANGE' "$DL" > "$OUT/st_change.txt"; log "[st] CHANGE=$(wc -l < "$OUT/st_change.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "[m7h] probe lines: $(grep -a '\[m7h\] probe' "$DL" | head -1 | cut -c1-220)"
  log "[m7h] src lines: $(grep -a '\[m7h\] src set' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-260)"
  log "[m7h] dump count=$(grep -a -c '\[m7h\] dump t=' "$DL") fail=$(grep -a -c '\[m7h\] dump fail' "$DL")"
  log "[m7h] dump lines:"; grep -a '\[m7h\] dump' "$DL" | cut -c1-320 >> "$OUT/run.log" 2>/dev/null || true
  log "[wp] rt tail: $(grep -a '\[wp\] rt sum' "$DL" | tail -2 | tr '\n' '|' | cut -c1-400)"
  log "[perf] tail: $(tail -2 "$OUT/perf.txt" 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' '|' | cut -c1-400)"
  log "[mem] tail: $(tail -2 "$OUT/mem.txt" 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-260 | tr '\n' '|')"
else log "X vk_boot.log pull failed"; fi
if [ -f "$OUT/samples.txt" ]; then log "samples lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/samples.txt" | tr -d ' ') first=$(head -1 "$OUT/samples.txt") last=$(tail -1 "$OUT/samples.txt")"; fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG"
```

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M7L: the t~150 s freeze scene (emulator only, 127.0.0.1:5555). ONE boot, <=450 s.
# switch smo_frz=1 (+ the M7G set). Screenshot self-check at t=60/90/120 (3 md5 must differ).
# Never touches the device 192.168.0.111/42323 (M7I is running there). No hdc kill anywhere.
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: bash m7l_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]}"
DUR="${2:-450}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"

log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }

OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); log "install: $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }

  h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1

h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gpu_write" >/dev/null 2>&1
for s in smo_m7a smo_m7b smo_m7x smo_m7y smo_m7d_same smo_ldrd smo_aud; do
  h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1

h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1

    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi

h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1

PLAN="60 90 120 156 240 350"
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  PP=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$PP" ]; then DEADN=$(( ${DEADN:-0} + 1 )); else DEADN=0; fi
  if [ "${DEADN:-0}" -ge 2 ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> - app died during the boot (crash); stopping this run"
    shot "$EL" "tdeath"
    h shell "ls -t /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null | head -3" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "cat /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/$(h shell "ls -t /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ | head -1" | tr -d '\r\n') 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,40p'" | tr -d '\r' >> "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    DEATH_T=$EL; break
  fi
  [ -z "$CURPID" ] && { P="$PP"; [ -n "$P" ] && { CURPID=$P; log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; }; }
  RAW=$(h shell "tail -n 600 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[beat\]|\[st\] t=|\[fz\] probe|\[m7h2\] probe|\[fz\] stall'" | tr -d '\r')
  BT=$(grep -a '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  ST=$(grep -a '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  PCT=$(grep -o 'pct=[0-9-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); PCT=${PCT:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${OP:-}" "${DW:-}" "${STALL:-}" "${PCT:-}" >> "$TSV"
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 20 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    PL=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[fz\] probe on|\[m7h2\] probe on|\[m7l\] seeded' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -4" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s PROBE-READBACK: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$PL")"
    RB2=$(for s in smo_frz smo_m7h; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
    log "t=${EL}s switch readback (in-boot): $RB2"
  fi
  if [ $(( EL % 20 )) -lt 4 ]; then log "t=${EL}s frames=${FR:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?} stall=${STALL:-?} pct=${PCT:-?}"; fi
  for T in $PLAN; do if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi; done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 4
done
shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} death_t=${DEATH_T:-none}"

# ---- PAM dump (M7K verification #1): the device already writes 800x450 RGBA ----
PLIST=$(h shell "ls -l /data/storage/el2/base/files/m4ca_rt282_*.pam 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
log "pam list: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$PLIST")"
LASTPAM=$(h shell "ls -t /data/storage/el2/base/files/m4ca_rt282_*.pam 2>/dev/null | head -1" | tr -d '\r\n')

  h file recv "$LASTPAM" "$OUT/$(basename "$LASTPAM")" >/dev/null 2>&1
  log "pam pulled: $(basename "$LASTPAM") bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/$(basename "$LASTPAM")" 2>/dev/null)"
else log "!! no m4ca_rt282_*.pam on the device"; fi

CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 4; done
DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  for K in st beat fz m7h2 gst lp wg cpu mn; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  grep -a '\[st\] CHANGE' "$DL" > "$OUT/st_change.txt" 2>/dev/null
  grep -a '\[fz\] stall' "$DL" > "$OUT/fz_stall.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[fz] stall lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/fz_stall.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a -E 'gates|smo_obs|install' "$DL" | head -20 > "$OUT/gates_install.txt"
fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG"
```

`m7m_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M7m: BC-family texture PNG dump boot ([m7m] tex). Read-only on top of M7l behavior.
# Read-only probes on top of M7k behavior; same guardrails/flow as m7k_boot_run.sh.
# Usage: bash m7l_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: m7m_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]}"
DUR="${2:-700}"
RSS_STOP_MB="${RSS_STOP_MB:-12500}"
SCHED_FILE="${SCHED_FILE:-/tmp/m6x_sched.txt}"
KILL_GAP="${KILL_GAP:-600}"
CFG_VETO="${CFG_VETO:-0}"
CFG_HASHES="${CFG_HASHES:-}"
CFG_COST_THR="${CFG_COST_THR:-0}"
GPU_WRITE="${GPU_WRITE:-0}"
PLAN="${PLAN:-120 300 450 600}"
GD_SEC="${GD_SEC:-60}"
SYNTH="${SYNTH:-1}"
FRAMES="${FRAMES:-8}"
TESTSTICK="${TESTSTICK:-1 700 2000}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
TGT="127.0.0.1:5555"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m7m_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M7m tag=$TAG dur=${DUR}s out=$OUT stop=${RSS_STOP_MB}MB sched=$(cat "$SCHED_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING)"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target offline ($TGT)"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing: $HAP"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$SCHED_FILE" ] || { log "X schedule missing: $SCHED_FILE"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }
stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty (pre-flight)"

# ---- install ----
UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"
OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); log "install: $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 300)"
grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_after: $UPD1"
[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

# ---- schedule file: must already exist in the app sandbox ----
SX=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m6q_sched 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
if [ -z "$SX" ]; then
  log "sched file absent -> seed launch (one app start, pre-flight only)"
  h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  sleep 20
  SX=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m6q_sched 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed check: ${SX:-<ABSENT>}"
  [ -z "$SX" ] && { log "X schedule file still absent"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X pid before measured boot"; exit 1; }
else
  log "sched file present: $SX"
fi

# ---- switches for the measured boot ----
h shell "printf '%s' '$(cat "$SCHED_FILE")' > $FILES/smo_m6q_sched && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_testkey" >/dev/null 2>&1
RS=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m6q_sched" | tr -d '\r')
log "sched readback=[$RS] bytes=$(h shell "wc -c < $FILES/smo_m6q_sched" | tr -dc '0-9') testkey=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')]"

# ---- our own guards OFF (task rule) ----
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "guard files: smo_rss_guard=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_rss_guard" | tr -d '\r')] smo_mem_purge=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_mem_purge" | tr -d '\r')]"

# ---- log reset ----
PRE=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); PRE=${PRE:-0}
MODE="truncate(:>)"
if ! h shell ": > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then MODE="rm -f"; h shell "rm -f $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi
SZ=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); SZ=${SZ:-0}
[ "$SZ" = "0" ] || { log "X log not reset: $MODE size=$SZ"; exit 1; }
log "log reset ok: mode=$MODE before=$PRE after=$SZ"

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
NFT0=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST0" | grep -c .); log "faultlog_before entries=$NFT0"

h shell "echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_snap_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_present_gain; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_gpres" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $CFG_VETO > $FILES/smo_cfg_veto; printf %s '$CFG_HASHES' > $FILES/smo_cfg_veto_hashes; echo $CFG_COST_THR > $FILES/smo_cfg_veto_cost" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "cfg knobs: veto=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_cfg_veto" | tr -d '\r')] hashes=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_cfg_veto_hashes" | tr -d '\r')] cost_thr=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_cfg_veto_cost" | tr -d '\r')]"
h shell "echo $GPU_WRITE > $FILES/smo_gpu_write; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_movie_kick; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "gpu_write knob: smo_gpu_write=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gpu_write" | tr -d '\r')] (boot#2 experiment: execute gated clear/t2t into pool)"
h shell "echo '$GD_SEC' > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "rm -f $FILES/SwiftShader.ini" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1

# ---- observers ----
h file send /tmp/m6y_sampler.sh /data/local/tmp/m7g_sampler.sh >/dev/null 2>&1
h file send /tmp/m6y_probe.sh /data/local/tmp/m7g_probe.sh >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "nohup sh /data/local/tmp/m7g_sampler.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 &" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "sampler started (2 s, device-side)"

# ---- boot ----
h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
START=$(date +%s)
FIRSTPID=""
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 1
done

h shell "echo $SYNTH > $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null; echo $FRAMES > $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null; echo '$TESTSTICK' > $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "switches after seed: synth=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')] stick=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick" | tr -d '\r')]"

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m7h2_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m7h2_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

pull_pngs(){
  local PLIST N=0
  PLIST=$(h shell "ls $FILES 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | grep -aE '^(m7h_world_|m7m_tex_).*\.png$' || true)
  N=$(printf '%s' "$PLIST" | grep -ac . || true)
  log "png_on_device count=$N"
  [ -z "$PLIST" ] && return 0
  mkdir -p "$OUT/png"
  printf '%s\n' "$PLIST" | while IFS= read -r p; do
    [ -n "$p" ] || continue
    if h file recv "$FILES/$p" "$OUT/png/$p" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      log "recv $p bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/png/$p" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ') md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/png/$p" 2>/dev/null)"
    else log "X recv $p failed"; fi
  done
}

TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"
printf 't\trss_mb\tvmsize_mb\tvmdata_mb\topens\treads\tsubmit\tframes\tdraws\tthr\tpct\tstall\tnflags\n' > "$TSV"
: > "$OUT/probe.raw"
PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; LASTRSSLOG=-100; RN=0
SUB_PREV=0; SUB_T=0; FROZEN_LOGGED=0; RECOVERED=0; NEXT_REC_SHOT=0
MAXTHR=0; OPENFLAG=0; STOPPED_EARLY=0; GUARDSEEN=0; NF0=$NFT0; LASTDUMPC=-1
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  RAW=$(h shell "sh /data/local/tmp/m7g_probe.sh" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')
  # ---- probe switch readback within 20 s of launch (task rule) ----
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 20 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    PLINE=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\\[m7l\\] scene-probe|\\[m7k\\] small-evict|\\[m7h\\] probe|\\[m7g\\] probe|\\[wp\\] probe' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -6" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s PROBE-READBACK: ${PLINE:-<ABSENT - probe not enabled, ABORT>}"
    if [ -z "$PLINE" ]; then log "!! probe switch line absent within 20 s -> stopping (wiring wrong)"; STOPPED_EARLY=1; break; fi
  fi
  printf '### t=%s\n%s\n' "$EL" "$RAW" >> "$OUT/probe.raw"
  STLINE=$(grep -m1 '^STATE' <<<"$RAW")
  if grep -q '^STATE dead' <<<"$STLINE"; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR|has died' | tail -60" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt" | tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
    h shell "tail -n 5 $LOG" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/log_tail_at_death.txt"
    log "last log lines: $(tr '\n' '|' < "$OUT/log_tail_at_death.txt" | tail -c 400)"
    break
  fi
  PID=$(awk '{print $3}' <<<"$STLINE")
  if [ "$PID" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $PID at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$PID"; fi
  RSSKB=$(grep -m1 'VmRSS' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); RSSKB=${RSSKB:-0}
  RSSMB=$(( RSSKB / 1024 ))
  THRO=$(grep -m1 '^THREADS' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); THRO=${THRO:-0}
  NFT=$(grep -m1 '^FAULTLOG' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); NFT=${NFT:-0}
  ST=$(grep -m1 '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW")
  BT=$(grep -m1 '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW")
  MM=$(grep -m1 '\[mem\] t=' <<<"$RAW")
  FA=$(grep -a '\[fa\]' <<<"$RAW" | tr '\n' '|')
  PF=$(grep -m1 '\[perf\]' <<<"$RAW")
  JD=$(grep -m1 'RSS GUARD' <<<"$RAW")
  MV=$(grep -m1 '\[mv\]' <<<"$RAW")
  CFGPIPE=$(awk '/^CFGPIPE/{print $2}' <<<"$RAW"); CFGPIPE=${CFGPIPE:-0}
  CFGKEY=$(awk '/^CFGKEY/{print $2}' <<<"$RAW"); CFGKEY=${CFGKEY:-0}
  CFGVETO_N=$(awk '/^CFGVETO/{print $2}' <<<"$RAW"); CFGVETO_N=${CFGVETO_N:-0}
  CFGLAST=$(grep -a '\[cfg\] pipe#' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  CFGVLINE=$(grep -a '\[cfg\] veto' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  RD=$(grep -o 'reads=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); RD=${RD:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  PCT=$(grep -o 'pct=[0-9-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); PCT=${PCT:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  VMSZ=$(grep -o 'vmsize=[0-9]*' <<<"$MM" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); VMSZ=${VMSZ:-}
  VMDT=$(grep -o 'vmdata=[0-9]*' <<<"$MM" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); VMDT=${VMDT:-}
  THR=$(grep -o 'threads=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); THR=${THR:-0}
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' \
    "$EL" "$RSSMB" "${VMSZ:-}" "${VMDT:-}" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${FR:-}" "${DW:-}" "${THR:-}" "${PCT:-}" "${STALL:-}" "-" >> "$TSV"

  if [ "$GUARDSEEN" -eq 0 ] && [ -n "$JD" ]; then
    GUARDSEEN=1
    log "GUARD line: $JD"
    if grep -q 'trip=20000MB' <<<"$JD"; then log "GUARD OK: trip=20000MB (above any reachable RSS; hard cap raised too)"
    else log "!! WARNING: guard line does not show trip=20000MB - our guard may still act"; fi
  fi
  if [ -n "$OP" ] && [ "$OP" -gt 1245 ] && [ "$OPENFLAG" -eq 0 ]; then
    OPENFLAG=1; log "SIGNAL-1 t=${EL}s opens=$OP > 1245 (new file paths) rss=${RSSMB}MB"
    shot "$EL" "opens$OP"
  fi
  if [ -n "$THR" ] && [ "$THR" -gt 27 ] && [ "$THR" -gt "$MAXTHR" ]; then
    MAXTHR=$THR; log "SIGNAL-2 t=${EL}s guest_threads=$THR (>27) submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} os_thr=$THRO"
  fi
  if [ -n "$SUB" ]; then
    if [ "$SUB" -gt "$SUB_PREV" ]; then
      GAP=$(( EL - SUB_T ))
      if [ "$FROZEN_LOGGED" -eq 1 ] && [ "$RECOVERED" -eq 0 ] && [ "$GAP" -ge 60 ]; then
        RECOVERED=1; NEXT_REC_SHOT=$(( EL + 30 ))
        log "SIGNAL-4 RECOVERY t=${EL}s submit $SUB_PREV -> $SUB (frozen ${GAP}s) rss=${RSSMB}MB frames=${FR:-?} pct=${PCT:-?}"
        shot "$EL" "recover"
      fi
      SUB_PREV=$SUB; SUB_T=$EL
    else
      GAP=$(( EL - SUB_T ))
      if [ "$FROZEN_LOGGED" -eq 0 ] && [ "$GAP" -ge 60 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 60 ]; then
        FROZEN_LOGGED=1; log "FROZEN t=${EL}s submit=$SUB (no growth for ${GAP}s) rss=${RSSMB}MB opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?}"
      fi
      if [ "$GAP" -ge "$KILL_GAP" ] && [ "${CFGPIPE:-0}" -ge "${MIN_CFGPIPE:-30}" ] && [ "$EL" -ge 60 ]; then
        log "EARLY-KILL t=${EL}s submit=$SUB frozen ${GAP}s (>=KILL_GAP ${KILL_GAP}) and cfg pipe table printed (n=${CFGPIPE}) -> stop to save memory"
        STOPPED_EARLY=1; FROZEN_LOGGED=1
        log "  cfg last: $(cut -c1-320 <<<"${CFGLAST:-}")"
        shot "$EL" "tfreeze"; break
      fi
      if [ "$GAP" -ge 40 ] && [ "${CFGPIPE:-0}" -lt "${MIN_CFGPIPE:-30}" ] && [ "$EL" -ge 200 ]; then
        log "EARLY-STALL t=${EL}s submit=$SUB frozen ${GAP}s with only ${CFGPIPE:-0} pipelines -> guest never reached the render phase; abort"
        STOPPED_EARLY=1; shot "$EL" "tstall"; break
      fi
    fi
  fi
  if [ "$NFT" -gt "$NF0" ]; then
    log "!! faultlog grew $NF0 -> $NFT at t=${EL}s"; NF0=$NFT
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_${EL}s.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR|has died' | tail -60" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_${EL}s.txt"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$RSSMB" -gt "$RSS_STOP_MB" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=${RSSMB}MB > stop=${RSS_STOP_MB}MB -> stopping before LMK (task rule)"
    STOPPED_EARLY=1; shot "$EL" "tstop"; break
  fi
  if [ $(( EL - LASTRSSLOG )) -ge 16 ]; then
    LASTRSSLOG=$EL; RN=$((RN+1))
    DUMPC=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[m7h\] dump t=' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9'); DUMPC=${DUMPC:-0}
    SRCLINE=$(h shell "grep -a '\[m7h\] src set' $LOG 2>/dev/null | tail -1" | tr -d '\r' | cut -c1-260)
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=${RSSMB}MB opens=${OP:-?} reads=${RD:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} frames=${FR:-?} draws=${DW:-?} thr=${THR:-?}/os${THRO:-?} pct=${PCT:-?} dumps=$DUMPC"
    [ "$DUMPC" != "$LASTDUMPC" ] && log "   [m7h] dumps=$DUMPC (was $LASTDUMPC) fail=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[m7h\] dump fail' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9') skipblack=$(h shell "grep -a -c 'dump_skip' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')"
    [ -n "$SRCLINE" ] && log "   src: $SRCLINE"
    log "   m7k: small_evict=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[m7k\] small evict' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9') ph_lines=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[m7k\] ph id=' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')"
    log "   m7l: up=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[m7l\] up id=' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9') sig=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[m7l\] sig id=' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9') bind=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[m7l\] bind ' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9') dyn=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[m7l\] dyn watch' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9') re=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[m7l\] re id=' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9') zw=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[m7l\] zw ' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9') gexec=$(h shell "grep -a -o 'executed=[0-9]*' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2)"
    LASTDUMPC=$DUMPC
    CHG=$(grep -m1 '\[st\] CHANGE' <<<"$RAW"); [ -n "$CHG" ] && log "   chg $(cut -c1-260 <<<"$CHG")"
    [ -n "$FA" ] && log "   fa  $(cut -c1-240 <<<"$FA")"
    [ "$CFGPIPE" -gt 0 ] && log "   cfg pipes=$CFGPIPE keys=$CFGKEY veto=$CFGVETO_N last=$(cut -c1-160 <<<"$CFGLAST")"
  fi
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  if [ "$RSSMB" -gt 12000 ]; then sleep 1; else sleep 4; fi
done

shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} stopped_early=${STOPPED_EARLY} recovered=${RECOVERED} maxthr=${MAXTHR}"
CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"

for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 4; done

  for K in st beat perf mem mv sched wp m7c m7g m7h m7i m7k m7l m7m; do

    log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ')"
  done
  grep -a '\[st\] CHANGE' "$DL" > "$OUT/st_change.txt"; log "[st] CHANGE=$(wc -l < "$OUT/st_change.txt" | tr -d ' ')"

  log "[m7h] src lines: $(grep -a '\[m7h\] src set' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-260)"

  log "[mem] tail: $(tail -2 "$OUT/mem.txt" 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-260 | tr '\n' '|')"

log "=== done tag=$TAG"

```

`m7n_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M7N: who posted to whom (emulator only, 127.0.0.1:5555). ONE boot, <=120 s.
# New gates: G1 main+0x964260 (worker factory), G2 main+0x9646d0 (PostToken), switch smo_m7n=1.
# Same switch family as the M7F simulator baseline so the [lp]/[wg] role tables stay comparable.
# Never touches the device 192.168.0.111/42323. No hdc kill anywhere.
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: bash m7n_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]}"
DUR="${2:-120}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
TGT="127.0.0.1:5555"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m7n_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M7N tag=$TAG dur=${DUR}s out=$OUT target=$TGT"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target offline"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }
stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"
T0=$(date +%s)
OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); INST_S=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))
log "install(${INST_S}s): $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_after: $UPD1"
[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

# ---- seed start (~8 s): hdc cannot create a file in the sandbox, the app constructor seeds it ----
if [ -z "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7n 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ]; then
  log "seed start: letting the app constructor create smo_m7n"
  h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  for i in $(seq 1 15); do
    [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7n 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && break
    sleep 2
  done
  log "seed check: smo_m7n=[$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7n 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
  [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7n 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] || { log "X smo_m7n absent after seed"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X seed pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
else
  log "smo_m7n already present: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7n" | tr -d '\r')"
fi

# ---- switches: smo_m7n=1 + the M7F baseline family (so [wg]/[lp] stay comparable) ----
for s in smo_m7g smo_m7r smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7n; do
  h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
for s in smo_gpu_write smo_m7a smo_m7b smo_m7s smo_m7t smo_m7w smo_m7x smo_m7y smo_m7k smo_m7l smo_m7m smo_m7o smo_frz smo_ldrd smo_aud smo_sha_ungated smo_dspool smo_m7d_same; do
  h shell "[ -f $FILES/$s ] && echo 0 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
RB=$(for s in smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r smo_gpu_write smo_frz smo_ldrd; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
log "switch readback (pre-boot): $RB"
for s in smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r; do
  V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "1" ] || { log "X $s not 1, abort"; exit 1; }
done

h shell "printf '' > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "log truncated: bytes=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG" | tr -dc '0-9')"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m7n_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m7n_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
START=$(date +%s); CURPID=""; PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"; printf 't\tframes\tsubmit\topens\tdraws\tstall\n' > "$TSV"
PLAN="60"
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  PP=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$PP" ]; then DEADN=$(( ${DEADN:-0} + 1 )); else DEADN=0; fi
  if [ "${DEADN:-0}" -ge 2 ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> - app died during the boot; stopping this run"
    shot "$EL" "tdeath"
    h shell "ls -t /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null | head -3" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    DEATH_T=$EL; break
  fi
  [ -z "$CURPID" ] && { P="$PP"; [ -n "$P" ] && { CURPID=$P; log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; }; }
  RAW=$(h shell "tail -n 400 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[beat\]|\[st\] t=|\[m7n\]'" | tr -d '\r')
  BT=$(grep -a '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  ST=$(grep -a '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${OP:-}" "${DW:-}" "${STALL:-}" >> "$TSV"
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 18 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    PL=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m7n\] probe on|\[m7n\] sum|\[m7n\] code' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -6" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s M7N-READBACK: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$PL")"
    RB2=$(for s in smo_m7n smo_m7g; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
    log "t=${EL}s switch readback (in-boot): $RB2"
    GI=$(h shell "grep -a -c 'obs gate' /dev/null 2>/dev/null; grep -a -E 'obs gate main\+0x9642(6|7)' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -2" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s gate-install lines: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$GI")"
  fi
  if [ $(( EL % 20 )) -lt 3 ]; then log "t=${EL}s frames=${FR:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?} stall=${STALL:-?}"; fi
  for T in $PLAN; do if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi; done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 4
done
shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} death_t=${DEATH_T:-none} dur=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done
DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  for K in st beat m7n lp wg mn gates; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  grep -a 'obs gate' "$DL" > "$OUT/gates_install.txt" 2>/dev/null
  log "gate install lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/gates_install.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG"

```

`m7o_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M7o: scene FS 0c70f5be UV-patch boot ([m7o] fs UV-patch). One behavior change: FS key swap.
# Same guardrails/flow as m7m_boot_run.sh; probe readback includes [m7o].
# Usage: bash m7l_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: m7o_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]}"
DUR="${2:-700}"

h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target offline ($TGT)"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing: $HAP"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$SCHED_FILE" ] || { log "X schedule missing: $SCHED_FILE"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }
stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty (pre-flight)"

# ---- install ----
UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"
OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); log "install: $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 300)"
grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_after: $UPD1"
[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

# ---- schedule file: must already exist in the app sandbox ----
SX=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m6q_sched 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
if [ -z "$SX" ]; then
  log "sched file absent -> seed launch (one app start, pre-flight only)"
  h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  sleep 20
  SX=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m6q_sched 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed check: ${SX:-<ABSENT>}"
  [ -z "$SX" ] && { log "X schedule file still absent"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X pid before measured boot"; exit 1; }
else
  log "sched file present: $SX"
fi

# ---- switches for the measured boot ----
h shell "printf '%s' '$(cat "$SCHED_FILE")' > $FILES/smo_m6q_sched && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_testkey" >/dev/null 2>&1
RS=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m6q_sched" | tr -d '\r')
log "sched readback=[$RS] bytes=$(h shell "wc -c < $FILES/smo_m6q_sched" | tr -dc '0-9') testkey=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')]"

# ---- our own guards OFF (task rule) ----
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "guard files: smo_rss_guard=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_rss_guard" | tr -d '\r')] smo_mem_purge=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_mem_purge" | tr -d '\r')]"

# ---- log reset ----
PRE=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); PRE=${PRE:-0}
MODE="truncate(:>)"
if ! h shell ": > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then MODE="rm -f"; h shell "rm -f $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi
SZ=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); SZ=${SZ:-0}
[ "$SZ" = "0" ] || { log "X log not reset: $MODE size=$SZ"; exit 1; }
log "log reset ok: mode=$MODE before=$PRE after=$SZ"

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
NFT0=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST0" | grep -c .); log "faultlog_before entries=$NFT0"

h shell "echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_snap_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_present_gain; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_gpres" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $CFG_VETO > $FILES/smo_cfg_veto; printf %s '$CFG_HASHES' > $FILES/smo_cfg_veto_hashes; echo $CFG_COST_THR > $FILES/smo_cfg_veto_cost" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "cfg knobs: veto=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_cfg_veto" | tr -d '\r')] hashes=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_cfg_veto_hashes" | tr -d '\r')] cost_thr=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_cfg_veto_cost" | tr -d '\r')]"
h shell "echo $GPU_WRITE > $FILES/smo_gpu_write; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_movie_kick; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "gpu_write knob: smo_gpu_write=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gpu_write" | tr -d '\r')] (boot#2 experiment: execute gated clear/t2t into pool)"
h shell "echo '$GD_SEC' > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "rm -f $FILES/SwiftShader.ini" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1

# ---- observers ----
h file send /tmp/m6y_sampler.sh /data/local/tmp/m7g_sampler.sh >/dev/null 2>&1
h file send /tmp/m6y_probe.sh /data/local/tmp/m7g_probe.sh >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "nohup sh /data/local/tmp/m7g_sampler.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 &" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "sampler started (2 s, device-side)"

# ---- boot ----
h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
START=$(date +%s)
FIRSTPID=""
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 1
done

h shell "echo $SYNTH > $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null; echo $FRAMES > $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null; echo '$TESTSTICK' > $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "switches after seed: synth=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')] stick=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick" | tr -d '\r')]"

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m7h2_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m7h2_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

pull_pngs(){
  local PLIST N=0
  PLIST=$(h shell "ls $FILES 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | grep -aE '^(m7h_world_|m7m_tex_).*\.png$' || true)
  N=$(printf '%s' "$PLIST" | grep -ac . || true)
  log "png_on_device count=$N"
  [ -z "$PLIST" ] && return 0
  mkdir -p "$OUT/png"
  printf '%s\n' "$PLIST" | while IFS= read -r p; do
    [ -n "$p" ] || continue
    if h file recv "$FILES/$p" "$OUT/png/$p" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      log "recv $p bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/png/$p" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ') md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/png/$p" 2>/dev/null)"
    else log "X recv $p failed"; fi
  done
}

TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"
printf 't\trss_mb\tvmsize_mb\tvmdata_mb\topens\treads\tsubmit\tframes\tdraws\tthr\tpct\tstall\tnflags\n' > "$TSV"
: > "$OUT/probe.raw"
PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; LASTRSSLOG=-100; RN=0
SUB_PREV=0; SUB_T=0; FROZEN_LOGGED=0; RECOVERED=0; NEXT_REC_SHOT=0
MAXTHR=0; OPENFLAG=0; STOPPED_EARLY=0; GUARDSEEN=0; NF0=$NFT0; LASTDUMPC=-1
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  RAW=$(h shell "sh /data/local/tmp/m7g_probe.sh" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')
  # ---- probe switch readback within 20 s of launch (task rule) ----
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 20 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    PLINE=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\\[m7o\\] fs UV-patch|\\[m7o\\] probe|\\[m7l\\] scene-probe|\\[m7h\\] probe|\\[wp\\] probe' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -8" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s PROBE-READBACK: ${PLINE:-<ABSENT - probe not enabled, ABORT>}"
    if [ -z "$PLINE" ]; then log "!! probe switch line absent within 20 s -> stopping (wiring wrong)"; STOPPED_EARLY=1; break; fi
  fi
  printf '### t=%s\n%s\n' "$EL" "$RAW" >> "$OUT/probe.raw"
  STLINE=$(grep -m1 '^STATE' <<<"$RAW")
  if grep -q '^STATE dead' <<<"$STLINE"; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR|has died' | tail -60" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt" | tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
    h shell "tail -n 5 $LOG" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/log_tail_at_death.txt"
    log "last log lines: $(tr '\n' '|' < "$OUT/log_tail_at_death.txt" | tail -c 400)"
    break
  fi
  PID=$(awk '{print $3}' <<<"$STLINE")
  if [ "$PID" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $PID at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$PID"; fi
  RSSKB=$(grep -m1 'VmRSS' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); RSSKB=${RSSKB:-0}
  RSSMB=$(( RSSKB / 1024 ))
  THRO=$(grep -m1 '^THREADS' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); THRO=${THRO:-0}
  NFT=$(grep -m1 '^FAULTLOG' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); NFT=${NFT:-0}
  ST=$(grep -m1 '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW")
  BT=$(grep -m1 '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW")
  MM=$(grep -m1 '\[mem\] t=' <<<"$RAW")
  FA=$(grep -a '\[fa\]' <<<"$RAW" | tr '\n' '|')
  PF=$(grep -m1 '\[perf\]' <<<"$RAW")
  JD=$(grep -m1 'RSS GUARD' <<<"$RAW")
  MV=$(grep -m1 '\[mv\]' <<<"$RAW")
  CFGPIPE=$(awk '/^CFGPIPE/{print $2}' <<<"$RAW"); CFGPIPE=${CFGPIPE:-0}
  CFGKEY=$(awk '/^CFGKEY/{print $2}' <<<"$RAW"); CFGKEY=${CFGKEY:-0}
  CFGVETO_N=$(awk '/^CFGVETO/{print $2}' <<<"$RAW"); CFGVETO_N=${CFGVETO_N:-0}
  CFGLAST=$(grep -a '\[cfg\] pipe#' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  CFGVLINE=$(grep -a '\[cfg\] veto' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  RD=$(grep -o 'reads=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); RD=${RD:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  PCT=$(grep -o 'pct=[0-9-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); PCT=${PCT:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  VMSZ=$(grep -o 'vmsize=[0-9]*' <<<"$MM" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); VMSZ=${VMSZ:-}
  VMDT=$(grep -o 'vmdata=[0-9]*' <<<"$MM" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); VMDT=${VMDT:-}
  THR=$(grep -o 'threads=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2); THR=${THR:-0}
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' \
    "$EL" "$RSSMB" "${VMSZ:-}" "${VMDT:-}" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${FR:-}" "${DW:-}" "${THR:-}" "${PCT:-}" "${STALL:-}" "-" >> "$TSV"

  if [ "$GUARDSEEN" -eq 0 ] && [ -n "$JD" ]; then
    GUARDSEEN=1
    log "GUARD line: $JD"
    if grep -q 'trip=20000MB' <<<"$JD"; then log "GUARD OK: trip=20000MB (above any reachable RSS; hard cap raised too)"
    else log "!! WARNING: guard line does not show trip=20000MB - our guard may still act"; fi
  fi
  if [ -n "$OP" ] && [ "$OP" -gt 1245 ] && [ "$OPENFLAG" -eq 0 ]; then
    OPENFLAG=1; log "SIGNAL-1 t=${EL}s opens=$OP > 1245 (new file paths) rss=${RSSMB}MB"
    shot "$EL" "opens$OP"
  fi
  if [ -n "$THR" ] && [ "$THR" -gt 27 ] && [ "$THR" -gt "$MAXTHR" ]; then
    MAXTHR=$THR; log "SIGNAL-2 t=${EL}s guest_threads=$THR (>27) submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} os_thr=$THRO"
  fi
  if [ -n "$SUB" ]; then
    if [ "$SUB" -gt "$SUB_PREV" ]; then
      GAP=$(( EL - SUB_T ))
      if [ "$FROZEN_LOGGED" -eq 1 ] && [ "$RECOVERED" -eq 0 ] && [ "$GAP" -ge 60 ]; then
        RECOVERED=1; NEXT_REC_SHOT=$(( EL + 30 ))
        log "SIGNAL-4 RECOVERY t=${EL}s submit $SUB_PREV -> $SUB (frozen ${GAP}s) rss=${RSSMB}MB frames=${FR:-?} pct=${PCT:-?}"
        shot "$EL" "recover"
      fi
      SUB_PREV=$SUB; SUB_T=$EL
    else
      GAP=$(( EL - SUB_T ))
      if [ "$FROZEN_LOGGED" -eq 0 ] && [ "$GAP" -ge 60 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 60 ]; then
        FROZEN_LOGGED=1; log "FROZEN t=${EL}s submit=$SUB (no growth for ${GAP}s) rss=${RSSMB}MB opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?}"
      fi
      if [ "$GAP" -ge "$KILL_GAP" ] && [ "${CFGPIPE:-0}" -ge "${MIN_CFGPIPE:-30}" ] && [ "$EL" -ge 60 ]; then
        log "EARLY-KILL t=${EL}s submit=$SUB frozen ${GAP}s (>=KILL_GAP ${KILL_GAP}) and cfg pipe table printed (n=${CFGPIPE}) -> stop to save memory"
        STOPPED_EARLY=1; FROZEN_LOGGED=1
        log "  cfg last: $(cut -c1-320 <<<"${CFGLAST:-}")"
        shot "$EL" "tfreeze"; break
      fi
      if [ "$GAP" -ge 40 ] && [ "${CFGPIPE:-0}" -lt "${MIN_CFGPIPE:-30}" ] && [ "$EL" -ge 200 ]; then
        log "EARLY-STALL t=${EL}s submit=$SUB frozen ${GAP}s with only ${CFGPIPE:-0} pipelines -> guest never reached the render phase; abort"
        STOPPED_EARLY=1; shot "$EL" "tstall"; break
      fi
    fi
  fi
  if [ "$NFT" -gt "$NF0" ]; then
    log "!! faultlog grew $NF0 -> $NFT at t=${EL}s"; NF0=$NFT
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_${EL}s.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR|has died' | tail -60" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_${EL}s.txt"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$RSSMB" -gt "$RSS_STOP_MB" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=${RSSMB}MB > stop=${RSS_STOP_MB}MB -> stopping before LMK (task rule)"
    STOPPED_EARLY=1; shot "$EL" "tstop"; break
  fi
  if [ $(( EL - LASTRSSLOG )) -ge 16 ]; then
    LASTRSSLOG=$EL; RN=$((RN+1))
    DUMPC=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[m7h\] dump t=' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9'); DUMPC=${DUMPC:-0}
    SRCLINE=$(h shell "grep -a '\[m7h\] src set' $LOG 2>/dev/null | tail -1" | tr -d '\r' | cut -c1-260)
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=${RSSMB}MB opens=${OP:-?} reads=${RD:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} frames=${FR:-?} draws=${DW:-?} thr=${THR:-?}/os${THRO:-?} pct=${PCT:-?} dumps=$DUMPC"
    [ "$DUMPC" != "$LASTDUMPC" ] && log "   [m7h] dumps=$DUMPC (was $LASTDUMPC) fail=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[m7h\] dump fail' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9') skipblack=$(h shell "grep -a -c 'dump_skip' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')"
    [ -n "$SRCLINE" ] && log "   src: $SRCLINE"
    log "   m7k: small_evict=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[m7k\] small evict' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9') ph_lines=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[m7k\] ph id=' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')"
    log "   m7l: up=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[m7l\] up id=' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9') sig=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[m7l\] sig id=' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9') bind=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[m7l\] bind ' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9') dyn=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[m7l\] dyn watch' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9') re=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[m7l\] re id=' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9') zw=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[m7l\] zw ' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9') gexec=$(h shell "grep -a -o 'executed=[0-9]*' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tail -1 | cut -d= -f2)"
    LASTDUMPC=$DUMPC
    CHG=$(grep -m1 '\[st\] CHANGE' <<<"$RAW"); [ -n "$CHG" ] && log "   chg $(cut -c1-260 <<<"$CHG")"
    [ -n "$FA" ] && log "   fa  $(cut -c1-240 <<<"$FA")"
    [ "$CFGPIPE" -gt 0 ] && log "   cfg pipes=$CFGPIPE keys=$CFGKEY veto=$CFGVETO_N last=$(cut -c1-160 <<<"$CFGLAST")"
  fi
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  if [ "$RSSMB" -gt 12000 ]; then sleep 1; else sleep 4; fi
done

shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} stopped_early=${STOPPED_EARLY} recovered=${RECOVERED} maxthr=${MAXTHR}"
CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog_after entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST1" | grep -c .) new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

# ---- pull (twice: the first recv of a live log is often a partial file) ----
for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 4; done
h file recv /data/local/tmp/m6y_samples.txt "$OUT/samples.txt" >/dev/null 2>&1
pull_pngs
if [ -f "$OUT/vk_boot.log" ]; then
  DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  for K in st beat perf mem mv sched wp m7c m7g m7h m7i m7k m7l m7m m7o; do
    grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
    log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ')"
  done
  grep -a '\[st\] CHANGE' "$DL" > "$OUT/st_change.txt"; log "[st] CHANGE=$(wc -l < "$OUT/st_change.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
```
