```sh
  log "[m7h] src lines: $(grep -a '\[m7h\] src set' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-260)"
  log "[m7h] dump count=$(grep -a -c '\[m7h\] dump t=' "$DL") fail=$(grep -a -c '\[m7h\] dump fail' "$DL")"
  log "[m7h] dump lines:"; grep -a '\[m7h\] dump' "$DL" | cut -c1-320 >> "$OUT/run.log" 2>/dev/null || true

h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG"
```

`m7p_an.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# M7P analysis: per-site table + per-object ledger + obj->thread-handle bridge (gst arg=).
# usage: python3 m7p_an.py <tag>            (reads logs/m7p_<tag>/vk_boot.log)
import re, sys, os, json
ROOT = "/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
tag = sys.argv[1]
p = f"{ROOT}/logs/m7p_{tag}/vk_boot.log"
lines = open(p, 'rb').read().decode('utf-8', 'replace').split('\n')

def last_by(lines, pat):
    """dict key -> (t, parsed) from the LAST occurrence of each key (latest table dump)."""
    out = {}
    for ln in lines:
        m = re.search(pat, ln)
        if not m: continue
        out[m.group(1)] = (int(m.group('t')[:-1]), m.groupdict())
    return out

sites = {}
tot = None; lastt = None
for ln in lines:
    m = re.search(r'\[m7p\] sum t=(?P<t>\d+)s tot=(?P<tot>\d+)', ln)
    if m:
        tot = int(m.group('tot')); lastt = int(m.group('t'))
for ln in lines:
    m = re.search(r'\[m7p\] lr t=(?P<t>\d+)s #(?P<i>\d+) lr=(?P<lr>0x[0-9a-f]+) site=(?P<site>0x[0-9a-f]+) '
                 r'n=(?P<n>\d+) first_ns=(?P<f>\d+)s last_ns=(?P<l>\d+)s desc=(?P<desc>.*)$', ln)
    if not m: continue
    t = int(m.group('t'))
    if t != lastt: continue
    sites[m.group('site')] = dict(site=m.group('site'), lr=m.group('lr'), n=int(m.group('n')),
                                  first=int(m.group('f')), last=int(m.group('l')), desc=m.group('desc').strip())
objs = {}
for ln in lines:
    m = re.search(r'\[m7p\] obj t=(?P<t>\d+)s #(?P<i>\d+) obj=(?P<obj>0x[0-9a-f]+) n=(?P<n>\d+) '
                 r'first_ns=(?P<f>\d+)s ep=(?P<ep>0x[0-9a-f]+) first_lr=(?P<lr>0x[0-9a-f]+) '
                 r'first_site=(?P<site>0x[0-9a-f]+) desc=(?P<desc>.*)$', ln)
    if not m: continue
    t = int(m.group('t'))
    if t != lastt: continue
    objs[m.group('obj')] = dict(obj=m.group('obj'), n=int(m.group('n')), first=int(m.group('f')),
                                ep=m.group('ep'), first_lr=m.group('lr'), first_site=m.group('site'),
                                desc=m.group('desc').strip())
# obj -> thread handle bridge: [gst] h=... arg=<obj>
h2arg, arg2h, wa2h, h2nsvc = {}, {}, {}, {}
for ln in lines:
    m = re.search(r'\[gst\] h=(?P<h>0x[0-9a-f]+) .*wa=(?P<wa>0x[0-9a-f]+) .*nsvc=(?P<nsvc>\d+) .*arg=(?P<arg>0x[0-9a-f]+)\s*$', ln)
    if m:
        h, a, wa = m.group('h'), m.group('arg'), m.group('wa')
        if a != '0x0': arg2h[a] = h          # CreateThread arg bridge (may not equal the Start object)
        wa2h[wa] = h                          # obj+0x70 bridge: pool workers block on their own obj+0x70
        h2nsvc.setdefault(h, int(m.group('nsvc')))
rows = 0
for ln in lines:
    if '[m7p] row' in ln and re.search(r'\[m7p\] row t=\d+s #\d+', ln): rows += 1
gpass = sum(1 for ln in lines if '[m7w] gpass' in ln)
gst_snaps = len(re.findall(r'\[gst\] threads=\d+', '\n'.join(lines)))
print(f"== tag={tag} last_m7p_sum_t={lastt}s tot={tot} row_events={rows} gpass_lines={gpass} gst_snapshots={gst_snaps}")
print("== per-site (模拟器/真机同一张表) ==")
print(f"{'site':>12} {'n':>3} {'first_s':>7} {'last_s':>6}  desc")
for s in sorted(sites.values(), key=lambda x: -x['n']):
    site_main = 'main+' + s['desc'].split('main+')[1] if 'main+' in s['desc'] else s['desc']
    print(f"{site_main:>14} {s['n']:>3} {s['first']:>7} {s['last']:>6}  {s['desc']}")
print(f"== per-object: 每个 worker 对象由哪一站 Start ==")
print(f"{'obj':>14} {'n':>3} {'first_s':>7} {'ep':>10} {'first_site':>12} {'handle':>8} {'nsvc':>6}")
for o in sorted(objs.values(), key=lambda x: (x['first'], x['obj'])):
    ov = int(o['obj'], 16)
    hh = wa2h.get(hex(ov + 0x70), arg2h.get(o['obj'], '-'))
    print(f"{o['obj']:>14} {o['n']:>3} {o['first']:>7} {o['ep']:>10} {o['first_site']:>12} {hh:>8} {h2nsvc.get(hh,'-'):>6}")
json.dump(dict(sites=list(sites.values()), objs=list(objs.values()), arg2h=arg2h, tot=tot, t=lastt),
          open(f"{ROOT}/logs/m7p_{tag}/m7p_an.json", 'w'), indent=1)
print(f"== wrote logs/m7p_{tag}/m7p_an.json")

```

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M7P: ONE gate, both sides. worker Start main+0x963e50 (the single exit of all 15 ctor sites).
# usage: bash m7p_boot_run.sh <tag s1|d1> <target 127.0.0.1:5555|ip:port> [dur=150] [gdump_sec=10]
# Never runs `hdc kill` (it would take the other target down). Same switch set on both sides,
# including smo_m7w=1 (C-A verification) and smo_m7p=1 (this round's gate). Output: logs/m7p_<tag>/.
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: bash m7p_boot_run.sh <tag> <target> [dur] [gdump_sec]}"
TGT="${2:?target required (all hdc calls use -t)}"
DUR="${3:-150}"
GD="${4:-10}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m7p_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M7P tag=$TAG target=$TGT dur=${DUR}s gdump_sec=$GD out=$OUT"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target $TGT offline"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }
stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"
T0=$(date +%s)
OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); INST_S=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))
log "install(${INST_S}s): $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_after: $UPD1"
[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

# ---- seed start (~7-8 s): hdc cannot create a file in the sandbox, the app constructor seeds smo_m7p ----
if [ -z "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7p 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ]; then
  log "seed start: letting the app constructor create smo_m7p"
  h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  for i in $(seq 1 15); do
    [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7p 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && break
    sleep 2
  done
  log "seed check: smo_m7p=[$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7p 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
  [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7p 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] || { log "X smo_m7p absent after seed"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X seed pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
else
  log "smo_m7p already present: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7p" | tr -d '\r')"
fi

# ---- switches: same family as M7G/M7N + smo_m7w=1 (C-A) + smo_m7p=1 (this gate) + smo_m7h=1 (M7H_NG 15) ----
for s in smo_m7g smo_m7r smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7n smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h; do
  h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
for s in smo_gpu_write smo_m7a smo_m7b smo_m7s smo_m7t smo_m7x smo_m7y smo_m7k smo_m7l smo_m7m smo_m7o smo_frz smo_ldrd smo_aud smo_sha_ungated smo_dspool smo_m7d_same; do
  h shell "[ -f $FILES/$s ] && echo 0 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $GD > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
RB=$(for s in smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r smo_m7d_same; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
RB="$RB gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"
log "switch readback (pre-boot): $RB"
for s in smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r; do
  V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "1" ] || { log "X $s not 1, abort"; exit 1; }
done

h shell "printf '' > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "log truncated: bytes=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG" | tr -dc '0-9')"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m7p_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m7p_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
START=$(date +%s); CURPID=""; PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"; printf 't\tframes\tsubmit\topens\tdraws\tstall\tm7p_tot\n' > "$TSV"
PLAN="60"
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  PP=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$PP" ]; then DEADN=$(( ${DEADN:-0} + 1 )); else DEADN=0; fi
  if [ "${DEADN:-0}" -ge 2 ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> - app died during the boot; stopping this run"
    shot "$EL" "tdeath"
    h shell "ls -t /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null | head -3" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    DEATH_T=$EL; break
  fi
  [ -z "$CURPID" ] && { P="$PP"; [ -n "$P" ] && { CURPID=$P; log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; }; }
  RAW=$(h shell "tail -n 500 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[beat\]|\[st\] t=|\[m7p\]'" | tr -d '\r')
  BT=$(grep -a '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  ST=$(grep -a '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  MP=$(grep -a '\[m7p\] sum' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  MT=$(grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' <<<"$MP" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); MT=${MT:-}
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${OP:-}" "${DW:-}" "${STALL:-}" "${MT:-}" >> "$TSV"
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 18 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    PL=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m7p\] probe on|\[m7p\] sum|\[m7p\] code' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -6" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s M7P-READBACK: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$PL")"
    GI=$(h shell "grep -a -E 'obs gate main\+0x963e50|obs gate main\+0x964260' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -4; grep -a -c 'NOT installed' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s gate-install lines: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$GI")"
    RB2=$(for s in smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
    log "t=${EL}s switch readback (in-boot): $RB2"
  fi
  if [ $(( EL % 20 )) -lt 3 ]; then log "t=${EL}s frames=${FR:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?} stall=${STALL:-?} m7p=${MT:-?}"; fi
  for T in $PLAN; do if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi; done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 4
done
shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} death_t=${DEATH_T:-none} dur=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done
DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"

  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  for K in st beat m7p gst wg lp m7w m7h2 m7n mn gates; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  grep -a 'obs gate' "$DL" > "$OUT/gates_install.txt" 2>/dev/null
  log "gate install lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/gates_install.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "m7p: sum=$(grep -ac '\[m7p\] sum' "$DL") lr_rows=$(grep -ac '\[m7p\] lr' "$DL") obj_rows=$(grep -ac '\[m7p\] obj' "$DL") rows=$(grep -ac '\[m7p\] row' "$DL") code=$(grep -ac '\[m7p\] code' "$DL")"
  log "m7w gpass lines=$(grep -ac '\[m7w\] gpass' "$DL") m7h2 named pump lines=$(grep -ac '\[m7h2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=pump' "$DL")"

h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG"
```

`m7q_an.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
# M7Q analysis: one parser for both sides -> comparable tables.
# usage: python3 m7q_an.py logs/m7q_s1 [logs/m7q_d1]
import re, sys, json, os, collections

def rd(p):
    try:
        return open(p, 'r', errors='replace').read().splitlines()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return []

def parse(d):
    L = rd(os.path.join(d, 'vk_boot.log'))
    out = {'m7q_lr': {}, 'm7q_v': {}, 'm7q_sum': {}, 'm7q_code': [], 'm7q_row': [],
           'm7p_lr': {}, 'm7p_obj': {}, 'm7p_sum': [], 'gst': [], 'gst_thr': [], 'install': []}
    for ln in L:
        if '[m7q] lr' in ln:
            m = re.search(r't=(\d+)s g=(\w+) #(\d+) lr=(0x[0-9a-f]+) site=(0x[0-9a-f]+) n=(\d+) first_ns=(\d+)s last_ns=(\d+)s desc=(\S+)', ln)
            if m:
                t, g, i, lr, site, n, f, l, desc = m.groups()
                out['m7q_lr'].setdefault(g, {})[site] = dict(n=int(n), first=int(f), last=int(l), desc=desc, lr=lr)
        elif '[m7q] v' in ln:
            m = re.search(r't=(\d+)s g=(\w+) #(\d+) val=(\d+) \(=(0x[0-9a-f]+)\) n=(\d+) first_ns=(\d+)s', ln)
            if m:
                t, g, i, val, hx, n, f = m.groups()
                out['m7q_v'].setdefault(g, {})[hx] = dict(v=int(val), n=int(n), first=int(f), t=int(t))
        elif '[m7q] sum' in ln:
            m = re.search(r't=(\d+)s g=(\w+) site=(0x[0-9a-f]+) tot=(\d+) first_ns=(\d+)s first_lr=(0x[0-9a-f]+) first_desc=(\S+) first_obj=(0x[0-9a-f]+) first_x1=(0x[0-9a-f]+) last_ns=(\d+)s last_lr=(0x[0-9a-f]+) uniq_lr=(\d+) uniq_v=(\d+)', ln)
            if m:
                g = m.group(2)
                out['m7q_sum'][g] = dict(t=int(m.group(1)), tot=int(m.group(4)), first_ns=int(m.group(5)),
                                         first_lr=m.group(6), first_desc=m.group(7), first_obj=m.group(8),
                                         first_x1=m.group(9), last_ns=int(m.group(10)), uniq_lr=int(m.group(12)), uniq_v=int(m.group(13)))
        elif '[m7q] code' in ln:
            out['m7q_code'].append(ln.strip())
        elif '[m7q] row' in ln and '#0' in ln or ('[m7q] row' in ln and 'tot=' in ln):
            out['m7q_row'].append(ln.strip())
        elif '[m7p] lr' in ln:
            m = re.search(r't=(\d+)s #(\d+) lr=(0x[0-9a-f]+) site=(0x[0-9a-f]+) n=(\d+) first_ns=(\d+)s last_ns=(\d+)s desc=(\S+)', ln)
            if m:
                out['m7p_lr'][m.group(4)] = dict(n=int(m.group(5)), first=int(m.group(6)), last=int(m.group(7)), desc=m.group(8))
        elif '[m7p] obj' in ln:
            m = re.search(r't=(\d+)s #(\d+) obj=(0x[0-9a-f]+) n=(\d+) first_ns=(\d+)s ep=(0x[0-9a-f]+) first_lr=(0x[0-9a-f]+) first_site=(0x[0-9a-f]+) desc=(\S+)', ln)
            if m:
                out['m7p_obj'][m.group(3)] = dict(n=int(m.group(4)), first=int(m.group(5)), ep=m.group(6),
                                                 first_site=m.group(8), desc=m.group(9))
        elif '[m7p] sum' in ln:
            out['m7p_sum'].append(ln.strip())
        elif '[gst] h=' in ln:
            m = re.search(r'h=(0x[0-9a-f]+) tid=(\d+) .*?wa=(0x[0-9a-f]+) .*?nsvc=(\d+) .*?arg=(0x[0-9a-f]+)', ln)
            if m:
                out['gst'].append(dict(h=m.group(1), tid=m.group(2), wa=m.group(3), nsvc=int(m.group(4)), arg=m.group(5)))
        elif '[gst] threads=' in ln:
            m = re.search(r'threads=(\d+)', ln)
            if m: out['gst_thr'].append(int(m.group(1)))
        elif 'obs gate main+0x9645' in ln or 'obs gate main+0x65b4' in ln or 'obs gates:' in ln:
            out['install'].append(ln.strip())
    return out

def bridge(d):
    """Start site -> worker object -> handle via obj+0x70 == wa."""
    gst = {}
    for r in d['gst']:
        gst.setdefault(r['wa'], r)     # first snapshot wins
    rows = []
    for obj, v in sorted(d['m7p_obj'].items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1]['first']):
        o = int(obj, 16); wa = '0x%x' % (o + 0x70)
        h = gst.get(wa)
        rows.append(dict(obj=obj, wa=wa, site=v['first_site'], desc=v['desc'], ns=v['first'],
                         handle=(h['h'] if h else '-'), nsvc=(h['nsvc'] if h else -1),
                         tid=(h['tid'] if h else '-'), arg=(h['arg'] if h else '-')))
    return rows

if __name__ == '__main__':
    sides = {}
    for d in sys.argv[1:]:
        sides[d] = parse(d)
    for d, s in sides.items():
        print('=' * 100)
        print('SIDE', d)
        print(' code:', s['m7q_code'][0] if s['m7q_code'] else 'NONE')
        for g in ('wrap', 'fo', 'fob'):
            su = s['m7q_sum'].get(g)
            print(' SUM %-4s %s' % (g, ('tot=%d uniq_lr=%d uniq_v=%d first_ns=%d first_site/lr=%s first_obj=%s first_x1=%s'
                                       % (su['tot'], su['uniq_lr'], su['uniq_v'], su['first_ns'], su['first_lr'], su['first_obj'], su['first_x1'])) if su else 'NONE'))
            lr = s['m7q_lr'].get(g, {})
            for site, v in sorted(lr.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1]['first']):
                print('   %-4s site=%-12s n=%-3d first=%-7d last=%-7d %s' % (g, site, v['n'], v['first'], v['last'], v['desc']))
            for hx, v in sorted(s['m7q_v'].get(g, {}).items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1]['first']):
                print('   %-4s w1value=%-8s n=%-3d first=%d' % (g, hx, v['n'], v['first']))
        print(' M7P start sites:', ', '.join('%s:%d' % (k, v['n']) for k, v in sorted(s['m7p_lr'].items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1]['first'])))
        print(' gst threads:', s['gst_thr'][:1], 'handles=%d' % len(s['gst']))
        br = bridge(s)

            print('  BRIDGE obj=%s site=%-12s handle=%-7s nsvc=%-3d tid=%-6s wa=%s' % (r['obj'], r['site'], r['handle'], r['nsvc'], r['tid'], r['wa']))
        json.dump(s, open(os.path.join(d, 'm7q_an.json'), 'w'), indent=1)
    if len(sides) >= 2:
        a, b = list(sides.items())[0], list(sides.items())[1]

        print('DIFF (side1 vs side2)')
        for g in ('wrap', 'fo', 'fob'):
            sa = set(a[1]['m7q_lr'].get(g, {})); sb = set(b[1]['m7q_lr'].get(g, {}))
            print(' %-4s only_side1=%s only_side2=%s' % (g, sorted(sa - sb), sorted(sb - sa)))
            for site in sorted(sa | sb):
                na = a[1]['m7q_lr'].get(g, {}).get(site, {}).get('n', 0)
                nb = b[1]['m7q_lr'].get(g, {}).get(site, {}).get('n', 0)
                print('   %-4s %-12s side1=%-3d side2=%-3d' % (g, site, na, nb))
        va = {k: v['n'] for k, v in a[1]['m7q_v'].get('fob', {}).items()}
        vb = {k: v['n'] for k, v in b[1]['m7q_v'].get('fob', {}).items()}
        print(' FOB w1 values side1=%s side2=%s' % (va, vb))
```

`m7q_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M7Q: three gates, both sides. WRAP main+0x964540 (ctor entry) + FO 0x65b468 + FOB 0x65b470 (fanout w1).
# usage: bash m7q_boot_run.sh <tag s1|d1> <target 127.0.0.1:5555|ip:port> [dur=150] [gdump_sec=10]
# Never runs `hdc kill` (it would take the other target down). Same switch set on both sides,
# including smo_m7w=1 (C-A verification) and smo_m7q=1 (this round's gates) + smo_m7p=1 (kept: per-site Start table). Output: logs/m7p_<tag>/.
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: bash m7q_boot_run.sh <tag> <target> [dur] [gdump_sec]}"
TGT="${2:?target required (all hdc calls use -t)}"
DUR="${3:-150}"
GD="${4:-10}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m7q_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M7P tag=$TAG target=$TGT dur=${DUR}s gdump_sec=$GD out=$OUT"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target $TGT offline"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }
stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"
if [ "${SKIP_INSTALL:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  log "install SKIPPED (SKIP_INSTALL=1: same HAP already installed on this target; used only to resume a blocked boot)"
else
  T0=$(date +%s)
  OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); INST_S=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))
  log "install(${INST_S}s): $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
  UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
  log "upd_after: $UPD1"
  [ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"
fi

# ---- seed start (~7-8 s): hdc cannot create a file in the sandbox, the app constructor seeds smo_m7p ----
if [ -z "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7q 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ]; then
  log "seed start: letting the app constructor create smo_m7p"
  SEEDOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed aa start: $(echo "$SEEDOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  case "$SEEDOUT" in *10106102*) log "X seed aa start blocked: 10106102 (screen locked). Unlock the phone and re-run with SKIP_INSTALL=1.";; esac
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  for i in $(seq 1 15); do
    [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7q 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && break
    sleep 2
  done
  log "seed check: smo_m7q=[$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7q 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
  [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7q 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] || { log "X smo_m7q absent after seed"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X seed pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
else
  log "smo_m7p already present: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7q" | tr -d '\r')"
fi

# ---- switches: same family as M7G/M7N + smo_m7w=1 (C-A) + smo_m7p=1 (this gate) + smo_m7h=1 (M7H_NG 15) ----
for s in smo_m7g smo_m7r smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7n smo_m7p smo_m7q smo_m7w smo_m7h; do
  h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
for s in smo_gpu_write smo_m7a smo_m7b smo_m7s smo_m7t smo_m7x smo_m7y smo_m7k smo_m7l smo_m7m smo_m7o smo_frz smo_ldrd smo_aud smo_sha_ungated smo_dspool smo_m7d_same; do
  h shell "[ -f $FILES/$s ] && echo 0 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $GD > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
RB=$(for s in smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r smo_m7d_same; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
RB="$RB gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"
log "switch readback (pre-boot): $RB"
for s in smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r; do
  V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "1" ] || { log "X $s not 1, abort"; exit 1; }
done

h shell "printf '' > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "log truncated: bytes=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG" | tr -dc '0-9')"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m7p_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m7p_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
START=$(date +%s); CURPID=""; PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"; printf 't\tframes\tsubmit\topens\tdraws\tstall\tm7p_tot\tm7q_wrap\n' > "$TSV"
PLAN="60"
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  PP=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$PP" ]; then DEADN=$(( ${DEADN:-0} + 1 )); else DEADN=0; fi
  if [ "${DEADN:-0}" -ge 2 ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> - app died during the boot; stopping this run"
    shot "$EL" "tdeath"
    h shell "ls -t /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null | head -3" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    DEATH_T=$EL; break
  fi
  [ -z "$CURPID" ] && { P="$PP"; [ -n "$P" ] && { CURPID=$P; log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; }; }
  RAW=$(h shell "tail -n 500 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[beat\]|\[st\] t=|\[m7p\]|\[m7q\]'" | tr -d '\r')
  BT=$(grep -a '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  ST=$(grep -a '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  MP=$(grep -a '\[m7p\] sum' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  MQ=$(grep -a '\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  MT=$(grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' <<<"$MP" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); MT=${MT:-}
  MQW=$(grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' <<<"$MQ" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); MQW=${MQW:-}
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${OP:-}" "${DW:-}" "${STALL:-}" "${MT:-}" "${MQW:-}" >> "$TSV"
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 18 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    PL=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m7p\] probe on|\[m7p\] sum|\[m7p\] code' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -6" | tr -d '\r')
    QL=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m7q\] probe on|\[m7q\] code|\[m7q\] sum' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -8" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s M7Q-READBACK: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$QL")"
    log "t=${EL}s M7P-READBACK: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$PL")"
    GI=$(h shell "grep -a -E 'obs gate main\+0x963e50|obs gate main\+0x964260' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -4; grep -a -c 'NOT installed' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s gate-install lines: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$GI")"
    RB2=$(for s in smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
    log "t=${EL}s switch readback (in-boot): $RB2"
  fi
  if [ $(( EL % 20 )) -lt 3 ]; then log "t=${EL}s frames=${FR:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?} stall=${STALL:-?} m7p=${MT:-?}"; fi
  for T in $PLAN; do if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi; done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 4
done
shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} death_t=${DEATH_T:-none} dur=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done
DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  for K in st beat m7p m7q gst wg lp m7w m7h2 m7n mn gates; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  grep -a 'obs gate' "$DL" > "$OUT/gates_install.txt" 2>/dev/null
  log "gate install lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/gates_install.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "m7p: sum=$(grep -ac '\[m7p\] sum' "$DL") lr_rows=$(grep -ac '\[m7p\] lr' "$DL") obj_rows=$(grep -ac '\[m7p\] obj' "$DL") rows=$(grep -ac '\[m7p\] row' "$DL") code=$(grep -ac '\[m7p\] code' "$DL")"
  log "m7q: probe=$(grep -ac '\[m7q\] probe' "$DL") sum=$(grep -ac '\[m7q\] sum' "$DL") lr=$(grep -ac '\[m7q\] lr' "$DL") v=$(grep -ac '\[m7q\] v' "$DL") row=$(grep -ac '\[m7q\] row' "$DL")"
  log "m7q gate install lines=$(grep -ac 'obs gate main+0x964540\|obs gate main+0x65b468\|obs gate main+0x65b470' "$DL")"
  log "m7w gpass lines=$(grep -ac '\[m7w\] gpass' "$DL") m7h2 named pump lines=$(grep -ac '\[m7h2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=pump' "$DL")"
fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG"
```

`m7r_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M7r: ONE 1200 s boot (architect-authorized exception) answering "can time itself advance".
# Faithful M5p testkey with nofreeze (task 3.1): TESTKEY="1 160 1000 5000 30 38:10,36:20 1".
# Everything else identical to m7q_boot_run.sh; early-kill disabled (MIN_CFGPIPE=0 +
# KILL_GAP=99999) because the point is to reach t>=1160 s. New [m7r] probe: 2 lines per 100 s
# (0x102f clip + 0x1001 main), hard cap 24 data lines in C, switch smo_m7r (C default off).
# Usage: bash m7r_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: m7r_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]}"
DUR="${2:-1200}"
RSS_STOP_MB="${RSS_STOP_MB:-12500}"
SCHED_FILE="${SCHED_FILE:-/tmp/m6x_sched.txt}"
KILL_GAP="${KILL_GAP:-99999}"
CFG_VETO="${CFG_VETO:-0}"
CFG_HASHES="${CFG_HASHES:-}"
CFG_COST_THR="${CFG_COST_THR:-0}"
GPU_WRITE="${GPU_WRITE:-0}"
PLAN="${PLAN:-200 400 600 800 1000 1150}"
GD_SEC="${GD_SEC:-60}"
SYNTH="${SYNTH:-1}"
FRAMES="${FRAMES:-8}"
TESTSTICK="${TESTSTICK:-1 700 2000}"
TESTKEY="${TESTKEY:-1 160 1000 5000 30 38:10,36:20 1}"
MIN_CFGPIPE="${MIN_CFGPIPE:-0}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
TGT="127.0.0.1:5555"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m7r_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }
drop(){  # evidence drop: copy what exists so far (task rule: first <=250 s, then every 100 s)
  mkdir -p "$OUT/evidence_t$1"
  cp -f "$OUT/run.log" "$OUT/series.tsv" "$OUT/probe.raw" "$OUT/evidence_t$1/" 2>/dev/null || true
  log "evidence drop t=$1 (run.log=$(wc -l < "$OUT/run.log" | tr -d ' ')L series=$(wc -l < "$OUT/series.tsv" | tr -d ' ')L)"
}

log "=== M7r tag=$TAG dur=${DUR}s out=$OUT stop=${RSS_STOP_MB}MB sched=$(cat "$SCHED_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING)"
log "TESTKEY=[$TESTKEY] (faithful M5p: start=160s down=1000ms up=5000ms 30 presses 38x10,36x20 nofreeze=1)"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target offline ($TGT)"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing: $HAP"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$SCHED_FILE" ] || { log "X schedule missing: $SCHED_FILE"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }
stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty (pre-flight)"

# ---- install ----
UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"
OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); log "install: $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 300)"
grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_after: $UPD1"
[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

# ---- app-seeded switch files must exist before hdc can overwrite them ----
SX=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m6q_sched 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
SM7R=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7r 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
if [ -z "$SX" ] || [ -z "$SM7R" ]; then
  log "seed launch needed (sched=[$SX:-absent] smo_m7r=[${SM7R:-absent}])"
  h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  sleep 20
  SX=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m6q_sched 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  SM7R=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7r 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed check: sched=${SX:-<ABSENT>} smo_m7r=${SM7R:-<ABSENT>}"
  { [ -z "$SX" ] || [ -z "$SM7R" ]; } && { log "X switch files still absent"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X pid before measured boot"; exit 1; }
else
  log "switch files present: sched ok, smo_m7r ok"
fi

# ---- switches for the measured boot ----
h shell "printf '%s' '$(cat "$SCHED_FILE")' > $FILES/smo_m6q_sched && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "printf '%s' '$TESTKEY' > $FILES/smo_testkey && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_m7r && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
RS=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m6q_sched" | tr -d '\r')
M7RRB=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7r" | tr -d '\r')
log "sched readback=[$RS] bytes=$(h shell "wc -c < $FILES/smo_m6q_sched" | tr -dc '0-9')"
log "testkey readback=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')]"
log "smo_m7r readback=[$M7RRB]"
[ "$M7RRB" = "1" ] || { log "X smo_m7r not 1 -> probe would be off, abort before wasting the boot"; exit 1; }

# ---- our own guards OFF (task rule) ----
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "guard files: smo_rss_guard=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_rss_guard" | tr -d '\r')] smo_mem_purge=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_mem_purge" | tr -d '\r')]"

# ---- log reset ----
PRE=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); PRE=${PRE:-0}
MODE="truncate(:>)"
if ! h shell ": > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then MODE="rm -f"; h shell "rm -f $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi
SZ=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); SZ=${SZ:-0}
[ "$SZ" = "0" ] || { log "X log not reset: $MODE size=$SZ"; exit 1; }
log "log reset ok: mode=$MODE before=$PRE after=$SZ"

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
NFT0=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST0" | grep -c .); log "faultlog_before entries=$NFT0"

h shell "echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_snap_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_present_gain; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_gpres" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $CFG_VETO > $FILES/smo_cfg_veto; printf %s '$CFG_HASHES' > $FILES/smo_cfg_veto_hashes; echo $CFG_COST_THR > $FILES/smo_cfg_veto_cost" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "cfg knobs: veto=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_cfg_veto" | tr -d '\r')] hashes=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_cfg_veto_hashes" | tr -d '\r')] cost_thr=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_cfg_veto_cost" | tr -d '\r')]"
h shell "echo $GPU_WRITE > $FILES/smo_gpu_write; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_movie_kick; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "gpu_write knob: smo_gpu_write=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gpu_write" | tr -d '\r')] (M7k~M7o settled config, untouched)"
h shell "echo '$GD_SEC' > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "rm -f $FILES/SwiftShader.ini" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1

# ---- observers ----
h file send /tmp/m6y_sampler.sh /data/local/tmp/m7r_sampler.sh >/dev/null 2>&1
h file send /tmp/m7r_probe.sh /data/local/tmp/m7r_probe.sh >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "nohup sh /data/local/tmp/m7r_sampler.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 &" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "sampler started (2 s, device-side)"

# ---- boot ----
h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
START=$(date +%s)
FIRSTPID=""
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 1
done

h shell "echo $SYNTH > $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null; echo $FRAMES > $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null; echo '$TESTSTICK' > $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "switches after seed: synth=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')] stick=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')] testkey=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')] m7r=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7r" | tr -d '\r')]"

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m7r_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m7r_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"
printf 't\trss_mb\topens\treads\tlast\tframes\tsubmit\tclip_nsvc\tclip_n1c\tclip_n1d\tmain_nsvc\tjobs_by_main\tposter_n1d\n' > "$TSV"
: > "$OUT/probe.raw"
PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; LASTRSSLOG=-100; RN=0; LASTDROP=0
SUB_PREV=0; SUB_T=0; FROZEN_LOGGED=0
MAXTHR=0; OPENFLAG=0; STOPPED_EARLY=0; NF0=$NFT0
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  RAW=$(h shell "sh /data/local/tmp/m7r_probe.sh" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')
  # ---- switch readback within 20 s of launch (task rule) ----
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 20 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    PLINE=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m7r\] probe on|\[m7o\] fs UV-patch|\[m7o\] probe|\[m7p\] probe|\[m7l\] scene-probe|\[m7h\] probe|\[wp\] probe' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -8" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s PROBE-READBACK: ${PLINE:-<ABSENT - probe not enabled, ABORT>}"
    if [ -z "$PLINE" ]; then log "!! probe switch line absent within 20 s -> stopping (wiring wrong)"; STOPPED_EARLY=1; break; fi
  fi
  printf '### t=%s\n%s\n' "$EL" "$RAW" >> "$OUT/probe.raw"
  STLINE=$(grep -m1 '^STATE' <<<"$RAW")
  if grep -q '^STATE dead' <<<"$STLINE"; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR|has died' | tail -60" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt" | tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
    h shell "tail -n 5 $LOG" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/log_tail_at_death.txt"
    log "last log lines: $(tr '\n' '|' < "$OUT/log_tail_at_death.txt" | tail -c 400)"
    break
  fi
  PID=$(awk '{print $3}' <<<"$STLINE")
  if [ "$PID" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $PID at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$PID"; fi
  RSSKB=$(grep -m1 'VmRSS' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); RSSKB=${RSSKB:-0}
  RSSMB=$(( RSSKB / 1024 ))
  THRO=$(grep -m1 '^THREADS' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); THRO=${THRO:-0}
  NFT=$(grep -m1 '^FAULTLOG' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); NFT=${NFT:-0}
  ST=$(grep -m1 '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW")
  BT=$(grep -m1 '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW")
  FA=$(grep -a '\[fa\]' <<<"$RAW" | tr '\n' '|')
  MV=$(grep -m1 '\[mv\]' <<<"$RAW")
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  RD=$(grep -o 'reads=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); RD=${RD:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  MRCLIP=$(grep -m1 '\[m7r\] clip' <<<"$RAW")
  MRMAIN=$(grep -m1 '\[m7r\] main' <<<"$RAW")
  MRLAST=$(grep -o 'last=\S*' <<<"$MRMAIN" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  CV_=$(grep -o 'nsvc=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRCLIP" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  C1C=$(grep -o 'n1c=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRCLIP" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  C1D=$(grep -o 'n1d=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRCLIP" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  MN=$(grep -o 'nsvc=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRMAIN" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  JB=$(grep -o 'jobs=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRMAIN" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  P1D=$(grep -o 'post1d=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRMAIN" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' \
    "$EL" "$RSSMB" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${MRLAST:-}" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" \
    "${CV_:-}" "${C1C:-}" "${C1D:-}" "${MN:-}" "${JB:-}" "${P1D:-}" >> "$TSV"

  # ---- [m7r] lines landed -> append to series.tsv context + evidence drop every 100 s ----
  if [ -n "$MRCLIP" ] && [ $(( EL / 100 )) -gt "$LASTDROP" ]; then
    LASTDROP=$(( EL / 100 )); drop "$LASTDROP"
  fi

  if [ -n "$OP" ] && [ "$OP" -gt 1245 ] && [ "$OPENFLAG" -eq 0 ]; then
    OPENFLAG=1; log "SIGNAL-1 t=${EL}s opens=$OP > 1245 (new file paths) rss=${RSSMB}MB"
    shot "$EL" "opens$OP"
  fi
  if [ -n "$THRO" ] && [ "$THRO" -gt "$MAXTHR" ]; then MAXTHR=$THRO; fi
  if [ -n "$SUB" ] && [ "$FROZEN_LOGGED" -eq 0 ]; then
    if [ "$SUB" -gt "$SUB_PREV" ]; then SUB_PREV=$SUB; SUB_T=$EL
    else
      GAP=$(( EL - SUB_T ))
      if [ "$GAP" -ge 60 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 60 ]; then FROZEN_LOGGED=1; log "FROZEN t=${EL}s submit=$SUB (no growth for ${GAP}s) rss=${RSSMB}MB opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?}"; fi
    fi
  fi
  if [ "$NFT" -gt "$NF0" ]; then
    log "!! faultlog grew $NF0 -> $NFT at t=${EL}s"; NF0=$NFT
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_${EL}s.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR|has died' | tail -60" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_${EL}s.txt"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$RSSMB" -gt "$RSS_STOP_MB" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=${RSSMB}MB > stop=${RSS_STOP_MB}MB -> stopping before LMK (task rule)"
    STOPPED_EARLY=1; shot "$EL" "tstop"; break
  fi
  if [ $(( EL - LASTRSSLOG )) -ge 16 ]; then
    LASTRSSLOG=$EL; RN=$((RN+1))
    MVDEC=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[mv\] dec#' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')
    MOVC=$(h shell "grep -a -c 'MovieData' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')
    INJ=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[i\] hid inject' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=${RSSMB}MB opens=${OP:-?} reads=${RD:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} frames=${FR:-?} draws=${DW:-?} os_thr=${THRO:-?} movie=${MOVC} mvdec=${MVDEC} inj=${INJ}"
    [ -n "$MRCLIP" ] && log "   ${MRCLIP:0:280}"
    [ -n "$MRMAIN" ] && log "   ${MRMAIN:0:280}"
    [ -n "$FA" ] && log "   fa  $(cut -c1-240 <<<"$FA")"
    [ -n "$MV" ] && log "   mv  $(cut -c1-200 <<<"$MV")"
  fi
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  if [ "$RSSMB" -gt 12000 ]; then sleep 1; else sleep 4; fi
done

shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} stopped_early=${STOPPED_EARLY} maxthr=${MAXTHR}"
CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog_after entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST1" | grep -c .) new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

# ---- pull (twice: the first recv of a live log is often a partial file) ----
for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 4; done
h file recv /data/local/tmp/m6y_samples.txt "$OUT/samples.txt" >/dev/null 2>&1
if [ -f "$OUT/vk_boot.log" ]; then
  DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[m7r\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m7r.txt"; log "[m7r] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m7r.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[st\] t=' "$DL" > "$OUT/st.txt"; log "[st] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/st.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[st\] CHANGE' "$DL" > "$OUT/st_change.txt"; log "[st] CHANGE=$(wc -l < "$OUT/st_change.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[tk\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/tk.txt"; log "[tk] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/tk.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[i\] hid' "$DL" > "$OUT/inj.txt"; log "[i] inj lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/inj.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[lp\] poster' "$DL" > "$OUT/lp_poster.txt"; log "[lp] poster lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/lp_poster.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a 'MovieData' "$DL" > "$OUT/movie.txt"; log "MovieData lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/movie.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "[st] tail: $(tail -1 "$OUT/st.txt" | cut -c1-400)"
  log "[tk] tail: $(tail -1 "$OUT/tk.txt" | cut -c1-300)"
  log "[mv] tail: $(grep -a '\[mv\]' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-300)"
else log "X vk_boot.log pull failed"; fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG"

```

`m7s_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M7s: ONE 700 s boot pinning the clip thread wait key + 64 B window (m7s task).
# Faithful M5p testkey with nofreeze (task 3.1): TESTKEY="1 160 1000 5000 30 38:10,36:20 1".
# Everything else identical to m7q_boot_run.sh; early-kill disabled (MIN_CFGPIPE=0 +
# KILL_GAP=99999) because the point is to reach t>=1160 s. New [m7s] probe: 2 lines per 100 s
# (0x102f clip + 0x1001 main), hard cap 24 data lines in C, switch smo_m7s (C default off).
# Usage: bash m7s_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: m7s_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]}"
DUR="${2:-700}"
RSS_STOP_MB="${RSS_STOP_MB:-12500}"
SCHED_FILE="${SCHED_FILE:-/tmp/m6x_sched.txt}"
KILL_GAP="${KILL_GAP:-99999}"
CFG_VETO="${CFG_VETO:-0}"
CFG_HASHES="${CFG_HASHES:-}"
CFG_COST_THR="${CFG_COST_THR:-0}"
GPU_WRITE="${GPU_WRITE:-0}"
PLAN="${PLAN:-200 400 600 690}"
GD_SEC="${GD_SEC:-60}"
SYNTH="${SYNTH:-1}"
FRAMES="${FRAMES:-8}"
TESTSTICK="${TESTSTICK:-1 700 2000}"
TESTKEY="${TESTKEY:-1 160 1000 5000 30 38:10,36:20 1}"
MIN_CFGPIPE="${MIN_CFGPIPE:-0}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
TGT="127.0.0.1:5555"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m7s_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }
drop(){  # evidence drop: copy what exists so far (task rule: first <=250 s, then every 100 s)
  mkdir -p "$OUT/evidence_t$1"
  cp -f "$OUT/run.log" "$OUT/series.tsv" "$OUT/probe.raw" "$OUT/evidence_t$1/" 2>/dev/null || true
  log "evidence drop t=$1 (run.log=$(wc -l < "$OUT/run.log" | tr -d ' ')L series=$(wc -l < "$OUT/series.tsv" | tr -d ' ')L)"
}

log "=== M7r tag=$TAG dur=${DUR}s out=$OUT stop=${RSS_STOP_MB}MB sched=$(cat "$SCHED_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING)"
log "TESTKEY=[$TESTKEY] (faithful M5p: start=160s down=1000ms up=5000ms 30 presses 38x10,36x20 nofreeze=1)"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target offline ($TGT)"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing: $HAP"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$SCHED_FILE" ] || { log "X schedule missing: $SCHED_FILE"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }
stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty (pre-flight)"

# ---- install ----
UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"
OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); log "install: $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 300)"
grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_after: $UPD1"
[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

# ---- app-seeded switch files must exist before hdc can overwrite them ----
SX=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m6q_sched 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
SM7R=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
SM7RB=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7r 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
if [ -z "$SX" ] || [ -z "$SM7R" ] || [ -z "$SM7RB" ]; then
  log "seed launch needed (sched=[$SX:-absent] smo_m7s=[${SM7R:-absent}] smo_m7r=[${SM7RB:-absent}])"
  h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  sleep 20
  SX=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m6q_sched 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  SM7R=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  SM7RB=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7r 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed check: sched=${SX:-<ABSENT>} smo_m7s=${SM7R:-<ABSENT>} smo_m7r=${SM7RB:-<ABSENT>}"
  { [ -z "$SX" ] || [ -z "$SM7R" ] || [ -z "$SM7RB" ]; } && { log "X switch files still absent"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X pid before measured boot"; exit 1; }
else
  log "switch files present: sched ok, smo_m7s ok, smo_m7r ok"
fi

# ---- switches for the measured boot ----
h shell "printf '%s' '$(cat "$SCHED_FILE")' > $FILES/smo_m6q_sched && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "printf '%s' '$TESTKEY' > $FILES/smo_testkey && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_m7s && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_m7r && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
RS=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m6q_sched" | tr -d '\r')
M7RRB=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7s" | tr -d '\r')
log "sched readback=[$RS] bytes=$(h shell "wc -c < $FILES/smo_m6q_sched" | tr -dc '0-9')"
log "testkey readback=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')]"
log "smo_m7s readback=[$M7RRB] smo_m7r readback=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7r" | tr -d '\r')]"
[ "$M7RRB" = "1" ] || { log "X smo_m7s not 1 -> probe would be off, abort before wasting the boot"; exit 1; }

# ---- our own guards OFF (task rule) ----
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "guard files: smo_rss_guard=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_rss_guard" | tr -d '\r')] smo_mem_purge=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_mem_purge" | tr -d '\r')]"

# ---- log reset ----
PRE=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); PRE=${PRE:-0}
MODE="truncate(:>)"
if ! h shell ": > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then MODE="rm -f"; h shell "rm -f $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi
SZ=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); SZ=${SZ:-0}
[ "$SZ" = "0" ] || { log "X log not reset: $MODE size=$SZ"; exit 1; }
log "log reset ok: mode=$MODE before=$PRE after=$SZ"

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
NFT0=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST0" | grep -c .); log "faultlog_before entries=$NFT0"

h shell "echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_snap_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_present_gain; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_gpres" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $CFG_VETO > $FILES/smo_cfg_veto; printf %s '$CFG_HASHES' > $FILES/smo_cfg_veto_hashes; echo $CFG_COST_THR > $FILES/smo_cfg_veto_cost" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "cfg knobs: veto=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_cfg_veto" | tr -d '\r')] hashes=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_cfg_veto_hashes" | tr -d '\r')] cost_thr=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_cfg_veto_cost" | tr -d '\r')]"
h shell "echo $GPU_WRITE > $FILES/smo_gpu_write; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_movie_kick; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "gpu_write knob: smo_gpu_write=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gpu_write" | tr -d '\r')] (M7k~M7o settled config, untouched)"
h shell "echo '$GD_SEC' > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
```
