```sh
# ---- observers ----
h file send /tmp/m6y_sampler.sh /data/local/tmp/m7s_sampler.sh >/dev/null 2>&1
h file send /tmp/m7s_probe.sh /data/local/tmp/m7s_probe.sh >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "nohup sh /data/local/tmp/m7s_sampler.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 &" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "sampler started (2 s, device-side)"

# ---- boot ----
h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
START=$(date +%s)
FIRSTPID=""
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 1
done

h shell "echo $SYNTH > $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null; echo $FRAMES > $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null; echo '$TESTSTICK' > $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "switches after seed: synth=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')] stick=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')] testkey=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')] m7r=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7s" | tr -d '\r')]"

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m7s_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m7s_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"
printf 't\trss_mb\topens\treads\tlast\tframes\tsubmit\tclip_nsvc\tclip_n1c\tclip_n1d\tmain_nsvc\tjobs_by_main\tposter_n1d\n' > "$TSV"
: > "$OUT/probe.raw"
PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; LASTRSSLOG=-100; RN=0; LASTDROP=0
SUB_PREV=0; SUB_T=0; FROZEN_LOGGED=0
MAXTHR=0; OPENFLAG=0; STOPPED_EARLY=0; NF0=$NFT0
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  RAW=$(h shell "sh /data/local/tmp/m7s_probe.sh" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')
  # ---- switch readback within 20 s of launch (task rule) ----
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 20 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    PLINE=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m7s\] probe on|\[m7r\] probe on|\[m7o\] fs UV-patch|\[m7o\] probe|\[m7p\] probe|\[m7l\] scene-probe|\[m7h\] probe|\[wp\] probe' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -8" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s PROBE-READBACK: ${PLINE:-<ABSENT - probe not enabled, ABORT>}"
    if [ -z "$PLINE" ]; then log "!! probe switch line absent within 20 s -> stopping (wiring wrong)"; STOPPED_EARLY=1; break; fi
  fi
  printf '### t=%s\n%s\n' "$EL" "$RAW" >> "$OUT/probe.raw"
  STLINE=$(grep -m1 '^STATE' <<<"$RAW")
  if grep -q '^STATE dead' <<<"$STLINE"; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR|has died' | tail -60" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt" | tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
    h shell "tail -n 5 $LOG" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/log_tail_at_death.txt"
    log "last log lines: $(tr '\n' '|' < "$OUT/log_tail_at_death.txt" | tail -c 400)"
    break
  fi
  PID=$(awk '{print $3}' <<<"$STLINE")
  if [ "$PID" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $PID at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$PID"; fi
  RSSKB=$(grep -m1 'VmRSS' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); RSSKB=${RSSKB:-0}
  RSSMB=$(( RSSKB / 1024 ))
  THRO=$(grep -m1 '^THREADS' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); THRO=${THRO:-0}
  NFT=$(grep -m1 '^FAULTLOG' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); NFT=${NFT:-0}
  ST=$(grep -m1 '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW")
  BT=$(grep -m1 '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW")
  FA=$(grep -a '\[fa\]' <<<"$RAW" | tr '\n' '|')
  MV=$(grep -m1 '\[mv\]' <<<"$RAW")
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  RD=$(grep -o 'reads=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); RD=${RD:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  MRCLIP=$(grep -m1 '\[m7r\] clip' <<<"$RAW")
  MRMAIN=$(grep -m1 '\[m7r\] main' <<<"$RAW")
  MRLAST=$(grep -o 'last=\S*' <<<"$MRMAIN" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  CV_=$(grep -o 'nsvc=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRCLIP" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  C1C=$(grep -o 'n1c=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRCLIP" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  C1D=$(grep -o 'n1d=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRCLIP" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  MN=$(grep -o 'nsvc=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRMAIN" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  JB=$(grep -o 'jobs=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRMAIN" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  P1D=$(grep -o 'post1d=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRMAIN" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' \
    "$EL" "$RSSMB" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${MRLAST:-}" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" \
    "${CV_:-}" "${C1C:-}" "${C1D:-}" "${MN:-}" "${JB:-}" "${P1D:-}" >> "$TSV"

  # ---- [m7s] lines landed -> append to series.tsv context + evidence drop every 100 s ----
  if [ -n "$MRCLIP" ] && [ $(( EL / 100 )) -gt "$LASTDROP" ]; then
    LASTDROP=$(( EL / 100 )); drop "$LASTDROP"
  fi

  if [ -n "$OP" ] && [ "$OP" -gt 1245 ] && [ "$OPENFLAG" -eq 0 ]; then
    OPENFLAG=1; log "SIGNAL-1 t=${EL}s opens=$OP > 1245 (new file paths) rss=${RSSMB}MB"
    shot "$EL" "opens$OP"
  fi
  if [ -n "$THRO" ] && [ "$THRO" -gt "$MAXTHR" ]; then MAXTHR=$THRO; fi
  if [ -n "$SUB" ] && [ "$FROZEN_LOGGED" -eq 0 ]; then
    if [ "$SUB" -gt "$SUB_PREV" ]; then SUB_PREV=$SUB; SUB_T=$EL
    else
      GAP=$(( EL - SUB_T ))
      if [ "$GAP" -ge 60 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 60 ]; then FROZEN_LOGGED=1; log "FROZEN t=${EL}s submit=$SUB (no growth for ${GAP}s) rss=${RSSMB}MB opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?}"; fi
    fi
  fi
  if [ "$NFT" -gt "$NF0" ]; then
    log "!! faultlog grew $NF0 -> $NFT at t=${EL}s"; NF0=$NFT
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_${EL}s.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR|has died' | tail -60" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_${EL}s.txt"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$RSSMB" -gt "$RSS_STOP_MB" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=${RSSMB}MB > stop=${RSS_STOP_MB}MB -> stopping before LMK (task rule)"
    STOPPED_EARLY=1; shot "$EL" "tstop"; break
  fi
  if [ $(( EL - LASTRSSLOG )) -ge 16 ]; then
    LASTRSSLOG=$EL; RN=$((RN+1))
    MVDEC=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[mv\] dec#' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')
    MOVC=$(h shell "grep -a -c 'MovieData' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')
    INJ=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[i\] hid inject' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=${RSSMB}MB opens=${OP:-?} reads=${RD:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} frames=${FR:-?} draws=${DW:-?} os_thr=${THRO:-?} movie=${MOVC} mvdec=${MVDEC} inj=${INJ}"
    [ -n "$MRCLIP" ] && log "   ${MRCLIP:0:280}"
    [ -n "$MRMAIN" ] && log "   ${MRMAIN:0:280}"
    [ -n "$FA" ] && log "   fa  $(cut -c1-240 <<<"$FA")"
    [ -n "$MV" ] && log "   mv  $(cut -c1-200 <<<"$MV")"
  fi
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  if [ "$RSSMB" -gt 12000 ]; then sleep 1; else sleep 4; fi
done

shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} stopped_early=${STOPPED_EARLY} maxthr=${MAXTHR}"
CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog_after entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST1" | grep -c .) new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

# ---- pull (twice: the first recv of a live log is often a partial file) ----
for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 4; done
h file recv /data/local/tmp/m6y_samples.txt "$OUT/samples.txt" >/dev/null 2>&1
if [ -f "$OUT/vk_boot.log" ]; then
  DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[m7s\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m7s.txt"; log "[m7s] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m7s.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[m7r\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m7r.txt"; log "[m7r] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m7r.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[lp\] obj' "$DL" > "$OUT/lp_obj.txt"; log "[lp] obj lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/lp_obj.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[wa\] dump' "$DL" > "$OUT/wa.txt"; log "[wa] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/wa.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[sy\] keysig' "$DL" > "$OUT/sy_keysig.txt"; log "[sy] keysig lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/sy_keysig.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[st\] t=' "$DL" > "$OUT/st.txt"; log "[st] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/st.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[st\] CHANGE' "$DL" > "$OUT/st_change.txt"; log "[st] CHANGE=$(wc -l < "$OUT/st_change.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[tk\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/tk.txt"; log "[tk] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/tk.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[i\] hid' "$DL" > "$OUT/inj.txt"; log "[i] inj lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/inj.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[lp\] poster' "$DL" > "$OUT/lp_poster.txt"; log "[lp] poster lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/lp_poster.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a 'MovieData' "$DL" > "$OUT/movie.txt"; log "MovieData lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/movie.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "[st] tail: $(tail -1 "$OUT/st.txt" | cut -c1-400)"
  log "[tk] tail: $(tail -1 "$OUT/tk.txt" | cut -c1-300)"
  log "[mv] tail: $(grep -a '\[mv\]' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-300)"
else log "X vk_boot.log pull failed"; fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG"

```

`m7sg_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M7S2 (M7S round): three read-only gates, both sides.
#   G1 main+0x681b30 (pool-B ctor entry, tail=0 4-word)
#   G2 main+0x74ca00 (layer above, tail=0 4-word)
#   G3 main+0x74cadc (the word BEFORE bl@0x74cae0, tail=2 plain-word; the bl itself is never touched)
# usage: bash m7sg_boot_run.sh <tag s1|d1> <target 127.0.0.1:5555|ip:port> [dur=150] [gdump_sec=10]
#   SKIP_INSTALL=1  -> resume a boot without reinstalling
#   UNLOCK_POLL=0   -> skip the unlock poll (default 1: device screen may be locked)
# Never runs `hdc kill` (it would take the other target down). Same switch set on both sides.
# NOTE: this file is intentionally NOT named m7s_boot_run.sh -- that name already exists in HEAD
# (an older round) and the round rule says existing scripts must not be overwritten.
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: bash m7sg_boot_run.sh <tag> <target> [dur] [gdump_sec]}"
TGT="${2:?target required (all hdc calls use -t)}"
DUR="${3:-150}"
GD="${4:-10}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m7s_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
UNLOCK_POLL="${UNLOCK_POLL:-1}"
UNLOCK_MAX="${UNLOCK_MAX:-1200}"        # 20 min cap, per the round rules
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M7S2 tag=$TAG target=$TGT dur=${DUR}s gdump_sec=$GD out=$OUT unlock_poll=$UNLOCK_POLL(<=${UNLOCK_MAX}s)"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target $TGT offline"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }

# ---- unlock poll: the only reliable "is the screen usable" probe. A successful `aa start` IS the
#      seed start too (the app constructor creates files/smo_m7s2 on first launch). 10106102 means
#      "screen locked" -> do NOT try to unlock, just keep polling (M7R: 1 probe was enough).
wait_unlock(){
  local n=0 t0=$(date +%s) out
  h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
  while :; do
    n=$((n+1))
    out=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
    local el=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))
    printf '[%s] probe #%d t=%ds %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$n" "$el" "$(echo "$out" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 160)" >> "$OUT/unlock_probe.log"
    case "$out" in
      *10106102*) : ;;                       # locked: keep polling, never try to unlock
      *"start ability successfully"*|*"successfully"*) log "unlock poll: probe #$n OK at t=${el}s (of cap ${UNLOCK_MAX}s)"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 0 ;;
      *) : ;;
    esac
    [ "$el" -ge "$UNLOCK_MAX" ] && { log "X unlock poll: ${UNLOCK_MAX}s cap reached after $n probes (still 10106102) -> BLOCKED"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 1; }
    sleep 15
  done
}

stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"

if [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ]; then
  wait_unlock || { log "X device stays locked; not booting (per round rules: no unlock attempts, no forced retries)"; exit 2; }
  log "after unlock poll: pid=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]') smo_m7s2=[$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7s2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
  sleep 3
  stopapp || { log "X probe pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
fi

if [ "${SKIP_INSTALL:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  log "install SKIPPED (SKIP_INSTALL=1)"
else
  T0=$(date +%s)
  OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); INST_S=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))
  log "install(${INST_S}s): $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
  UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
  log "upd_after: $UPD1"
  [ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"
fi

# ---- seed start (~7-8 s, not counted in the measured boot): hdc cannot CREATE a file in the sandbox,
#      the app constructor seeds smo_m7s2. ----
if [ -z "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7s2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ]; then
  log "seed start: letting the app constructor create smo_m7s2"
  SEEDOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed aa start: $(echo "$SEEDOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  case "$SEEDOUT" in *10106102*) log "X seed aa start blocked: 10106102 (screen locked)"; exit 2;; esac
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  for i in $(seq 1 15); do
    [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7s2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && break
    sleep 2
  done
  log "seed check: smo_m7s2=[$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7s2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
  [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7s2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] || { log "X smo_m7s2 absent after seed"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X seed pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
else
  log "smo_m7s2 already present: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7s2" | tr -d '\r')"
fi

# ---- switches: same family as M7G/M7N/M7P/M7Q + smo_m7s2=1 (this round) + smo_m7q=1 (keep the
#      M7Q WRAP/FO/FOB gates: the cross-round baseline) + smo_m7h=1 (M7H_NG stays 15) ----
for s in smo_m7g smo_m7r smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7n smo_m7p smo_m7q smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7s2; do
  h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
for s in smo_gpu_write smo_m7a smo_m7b smo_m7s smo_m7t smo_m7x smo_m7y smo_m7k smo_m7l smo_m7m smo_m7o smo_frz smo_ldrd smo_aud smo_sha_ungated smo_dspool smo_m7d_same; do
  h shell "[ -f $FILES/$s ] && echo 0 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $GD > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
RB=$(for s in smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r smo_m7d_same; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
RB="$RB gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"
log "switch readback (pre-boot): $RB"
for s in smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r; do
  V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "1" ] || { log "X $s not 1, abort"; exit 1; }
done

h shell "printf '' > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "log truncated: bytes=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG" | tr -dc '0-9')"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m7s_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m7s_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

# a fresh launch right before the measured boot: if the screen locked again during install, retry-poll.
STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
case "$STARTOUT" in
  *10106102*) log "X boot aa start blocked 10106102 -> re-entering unlock poll"
              [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ] && { wait_unlock || { log "X locked again; BLOCKED"; exit 2; }; sleep 3; stopapp; STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r'); } ;;
esac
log "boot aa start: $(echo "$STARTOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
START=$(date +%s); CURPID=""; PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"; printf 't\tframes\tsubmit\topens\tdraws\tstall\tm7q_wrap\tm7s2_g1\tm7s2_g2\tm7s2_g3\n' > "$TSV"
PLAN="30 120"
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  PP=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$PP" ]; then DEADN=$(( ${DEADN:-0} + 1 )); else DEADN=0; fi
  if [ "${DEADN:-0}" -ge 2 ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> - app died during the boot; stopping this run"
    shot "$EL" "tdeath"
    h shell "ls -t /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null | head -3" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    DEATH_T=$EL; break
  fi
  [ -z "$CURPID" ] && { P="$PP"; [ -n "$P" ] && { CURPID=$P; log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; }; }
  RAW=$(h shell "tail -n 600 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[beat\]|\[st\] t=|\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap|\[m7s2\] sum'" | tr -d '\r')
  BT=$(grep -a '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  ST=$(grep -a '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  MQ=$(grep -a '\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  S1=$(grep -a '\[m7s2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=g1' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  S2=$(grep -a '\[m7s2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=g2' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  S3=$(grep -a '\[m7s2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=g3' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  MQW=$(grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' <<<"$MQ" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); MQW=${MQW:-}
  G1=$(grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' <<<"$S1" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); G1=${G1:-}
  G2=$(grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' <<<"$S2" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); G2=${G2:-}
  G3=$(grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' <<<"$S3" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); G3=${G3:-}
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${OP:-}" "${DW:-}" "${STALL:-}" "${MQW:-}" "${G1:-}" "${G2:-}" "${G3:-}" >> "$TSV"
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 18 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    SL=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m7s2\] probe|\[m7s2\] code|\[m7s2\] sum' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -12" | tr -d '\r')
    QL=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m7q\] probe on|\[m7q\] code|\[m7q\] sum' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -6" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s M7S2-READBACK: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$SL")"
    log "t=${EL}s M7Q-READBACK: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$QL")"
    GI=$(h shell "grep -a -E 'obs gate main\+0x681b30|obs gate main\+0x74ca00|obs gate main\+0x74cadc|obs gate main\+0x964540' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -6; echo NOTINST=$(grep -a -c 'NOT installed' $LOG 2>/dev/null)" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s gate-install lines: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$GI")"
    RB2=$(for s in smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7h; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
    log "t=${EL}s switch readback (in-boot): $RB2"
  fi
  if [ $(( EL % 20 )) -lt 3 ]; then log "t=${EL}s frames=${FR:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?} stall=${STALL:-?} m7q_wrap=${MQW:-?} g1=${G1:-?} g2=${G2:-?} g3=${G3:-?}"; fi
  for T in $PLAN; do if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi; done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 4
done
shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} death_t=${DEATH_T:-none} dur=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done
DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  for K in st beat m7p m7q m7s2 gst wg lp m7w m7h2 m7n mn gates; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  grep -a 'obs gate' "$DL" > "$OUT/gates_install.txt" 2>/dev/null
  log "gate install lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/gates_install.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "m7s2: probe=$(grep -ac '\[m7s2\] probe' "$DL") sum=$(grep -ac '\[m7s2\] sum' "$DL") lr=$(grep -ac '\[m7s2\] lr' "$DL") row=$(grep -ac '\[m7s2\] row' "$DL") code=$(grep -ac '\[m7s2\] code' "$DL")"
  log "m7q: sum=$(grep -ac '\[m7q\] sum' "$DL") lr=$(grep -ac '\[m7q\] lr' "$DL")"
  log "m7s2 gate install lines=$(grep -ac 'obs gate main+0x681b30\|obs gate main+0x74ca00\|obs gate main+0x74cadc' "$DL")"
fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG unlock_probes=${UNLOCK_N:-0}"

```

`m7t2_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M7T2 (M7T round): the WHOLE nine-head scene-construction family, both sides.
#   9 read-only gates, all tail=0 four-word windows (every head first word rewrites sp):
#   h1 0x445640 h2 0x447b70 h3 0x449c50 h4 0x44b720 h5 0x46e7a0
#   h6 0x4a1100 h7 0x4a6b10 h8 0x4a8820 h9 0x4af0a0
# usage: bash m7t2_boot_run.sh <tag s1|d1> <target 127.0.0.1:5555|ip:port> [dur=150] [gdump_sec=10]
#   SKIP_INSTALL=1  -> resume a boot without reinstalling
#   UNLOCK_POLL=0   -> skip the unlock poll (default 1: device screen may be locked)
# Never runs `hdc kill` (it would take the other target down). Same switch set on both sides.
# NOTE: this file is intentionally NOT named m7t_boot_run.sh -- that name already exists in the
# repo root (2026-11-07 round) and the round rule says existing scripts must not be overwritten.
# Same for the switch: smo_m7t/smo_m7t_pos/[m7t] belong to that older round -> this round is m7t2.
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: bash m7t2_boot_run.sh <tag> <target> [dur] [gdump_sec]}"
TGT="${2:?target required (all hdc calls use -t)}"
DUR="${3:-150}"
GD="${4:-10}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m7t2_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
UNLOCK_POLL="${UNLOCK_POLL:-1}"
UNLOCK_MAX="${UNLOCK_MAX:-1200}"        # 20 min cap, per the round rules
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M7T2 tag=$TAG target=$TGT dur=${DUR}s gdump_sec=$GD out=$OUT unlock_poll=$UNLOCK_POLL(<=${UNLOCK_MAX}s)"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target $TGT offline"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }

# ---- unlock poll: the only reliable "is the screen usable" probe. A successful `aa start` IS the
#      seed start too (the app constructor creates files/smo_m7t2 on first launch). 10106102 means
#      "screen locked" -> do NOT try to unlock, just keep polling (M7R/M7S: 1 probe was enough).
wait_unlock(){
  local n=0 t0=$(date +%s) out
  h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
  while :; do
    n=$((n+1))
    out=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
    local el=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))
    printf '[%s] probe #%d t=%ds %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$n" "$el" "$(echo "$out" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 160)" >> "$OUT/unlock_probe.log"
    case "$out" in
      *10106102*) : ;;                       # locked: keep polling, never try to unlock
      *"start ability successfully"*|*"successfully"*) log "unlock poll: probe #$n OK at t=${el}s (of cap ${UNLOCK_MAX}s)"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 0 ;;
      *) : ;;
    esac
    [ "$el" -ge "$UNLOCK_MAX" ] && { log "X unlock poll: ${UNLOCK_MAX}s cap reached after $n probes (still 10106102) -> BLOCKED"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 1; }
    sleep 15
  done
}

stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"

if [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ]; then
  wait_unlock || { log "X device stays locked; not booting (per round rules: no unlock attempts, no forced retries)"; exit 2; }
  log "after unlock poll: pid=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]') smo_m7t2=[$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7t2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
  sleep 3
  stopapp || { log "X probe pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
fi

if [ "${SKIP_INSTALL:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  log "install SKIPPED (SKIP_INSTALL=1)"
else
  T0=$(date +%s)
  OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); INST_S=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))
  log "install(${INST_S}s): $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
  UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
  log "upd_after: $UPD1"
  [ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"
fi

# ---- seed start (~7-8 s, not counted in the measured boot): hdc cannot CREATE a file in the sandbox,
#      the app constructor seeds smo_m7t2. ----
if [ -z "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7t2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ]; then
  log "seed start: letting the app constructor create smo_m7t2"
  SEEDOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed aa start: $(echo "$SEEDOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  case "$SEEDOUT" in *10106102*) log "X seed aa start blocked: 10106102 (screen locked)"; exit 2;; esac
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  for i in $(seq 1 15); do
    [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7t2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && break
    sleep 2
  done
  log "seed check: smo_m7t2=[$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7t2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
  [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7t2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] || { log "X smo_m7t2 absent after seed"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X seed pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
else
  log "smo_m7t2 already present: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7t2" | tr -d '\r')"
fi

# ---- switches: same family as M7G/M7N/M7P/M7Q/M7S2 + smo_m7t2=1 (this round, the 9 gates) +
#      smo_m7q=1 (WRAP/FO/FOB cross-round baseline) + smo_m7s2=1 (previous round's 3 gates, cheap,
#      keeps G1/G2/G3 comparable in the same log) + smo_m7h=1 (M7H_NG stays 15) ----
for s in smo_m7g smo_m7r smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7n smo_m7p smo_m7q smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7s2 smo_m7t2; do
  h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
for s in smo_gpu_write smo_m7a smo_m7b smo_m7s smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7x smo_m7y smo_m7k smo_m7l smo_m7m smo_m7o smo_frz smo_ldrd smo_aud smo_sha_ungated smo_dspool smo_m7d_same; do
  h shell "[ -f $FILES/$s ] && echo 0 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $GD > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
RB=$(for s in smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7d_same; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
RB="$RB gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"
log "switch readback (pre-boot): $RB"
for s in smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r; do
  V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "1" ] || { log "X $s not 1, abort"; exit 1; }
done

h shell "printf '' > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "log truncated: bytes=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG" | tr -dc '0-9')"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m7t2_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m7t2_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

# a fresh launch right before the measured boot: if the screen locked again during install, retry-poll.
STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
case "$STARTOUT" in
  *10106102*) log "X boot aa start blocked 10106102 -> re-entering unlock poll"
              [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ] && { wait_unlock || { log "X locked again; BLOCKED"; exit 2; }; sleep 3; stopapp; STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r'); } ;;
esac
log "boot aa start: $(echo "$STARTOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
START=$(date +%s); CURPID=""; PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"; printf 't\tframes\tsubmit\topens\tdraws\tstall\tm7q_wrap\tm7s2_g1\th1\th2\th3\th4\th5\th6\th7\th8\th9\n' > "$TSV"
PLAN="30 120"
GT(){ grep -a "\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  PP=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$PP" ]; then DEADN=$(( ${DEADN:-0} + 1 )); else DEADN=0; fi
  if [ "${DEADN:-0}" -ge 2 ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> - app died during the boot; stopping this run"
    shot "$EL" "tdeath"
    h shell "ls -t /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null | head -3" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    DEATH_T=$EL; break
  fi
  [ -z "$CURPID" ] && { P="$PP"; [ -n "$P" ] && { CURPID=$P; log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; }; }
  RAW=$(h shell "tail -n 1400 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[beat\]|\[st\] t=|\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap|\[m7s2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=g1|\[m7t2\] sum'" | tr -d '\r')
  BT=$(grep -a '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  ST=$(grep -a '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  MQ=$(grep -a '\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  S1=$(grep -a '\[m7s2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=g1' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  MQW=$(grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' <<<"$MQ" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); MQW=${MQW:-}
  G1=$(grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' <<<"$S1" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); G1=${G1:-}
  H1=$(GT h1); H2=$(GT h2); H3=$(GT h3); H4=$(GT h4); H5=$(GT h5); H6=$(GT h6); H7=$(GT h7); H8=$(GT h8); H9=$(GT h9)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${OP:-}" "${DW:-}" "${STALL:-}" "${MQW:-}" "${G1:-}" "${H1:-}" "${H2:-}" "${H3:-}" "${H4:-}" "${H5:-}" "${H6:-}" "${H7:-}" "${H8:-}" "${H9:-}" >> "$TSV"
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 18 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    SL=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m7t2\] probe|\[m7t2\] code|\[m7t2\] sum' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -22" | tr -d '\r')
    S2L=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m7s2\] probe|\[m7s2\] code|\[m7s2\] sum' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -8" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s M7T2-READBACK: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$SL")"
    log "t=${EL}s M7S2-READBACK: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$S2L")"
    GI=$(h shell "grep -a -E 'obs gate main\+0x445640|obs gate main\+0x447b70|obs gate main\+0x449c50|obs gate main\+0x44b720|obs gate main\+0x46e7a0|obs gate main\+0x4a1100|obs gate main\+0x4a6b10|obs gate main\+0x4a8820|obs gate main\+0x4af0a0' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -10; echo NOTINST=$(grep -a -c 'NOT installed' $LOG 2>/dev/null)" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s gate-install lines: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$GI")"
    RB2=$(for s in smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7h; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
    log "t=${EL}s switch readback (in-boot): $RB2"
  fi
  if [ $(( EL % 20 )) -lt 3 ]; then log "t=${EL}s frames=${FR:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?} stall=${STALL:-?} m7q_wrap=${MQW:-?} s2g1=${G1:-?} h=[${H1:-?} ${H2:-?} ${H3:-?} ${H4:-?} ${H5:-?} ${H6:-?} ${H7:-?} ${H8:-?} ${H9:-?}]"; fi
  for T in $PLAN; do if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi; done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 4
done
shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} death_t=${DEATH_T:-none} dur=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done
DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  for K in st beat m7p m7q m7s2 m7t2 gst wg lp m7w m7h2 m7n mn gates; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  grep -a 'obs gate' "$DL" > "$OUT/gates_install.txt" 2>/dev/null
  log "gate install lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/gates_install.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "m7t2: probe=$(grep -ac '\[m7t2\] probe' "$DL") sum=$(grep -ac '\[m7t2\] sum' "$DL") lr=$(grep -ac '\[m7t2\] lr' "$DL") code=$(grep -ac '\[m7t2\] code' "$DL")"
  log "m7s2: sum=$(grep -ac '\[m7s2\] sum' "$DL") lr=$(grep -ac '\[m7s2\] lr' "$DL")"
  log "m7t2 nonzero gates: $(grep -a '\[m7t2\] sum' "$DL" | grep -av 'tot=0 ' | awk '{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i ~ /^g=/) g=$i} {print}' | tail -3 | tr '\n' '|')"
fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG unlock_probes=${UNLOCK_N:-0}"

```

`m7t_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
# services per 100 s window). Both behind switch smo_m7t (C default off). The intervention
# lever smo_m7t_pos (monotonic position without real BGM) stays 0 unless POS=1 is passed for
# the second boot. smo_m7r kept ON (opens/clip baseline series); smo_m7s OFF (M7s done).
# Usage: bash m7t_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]   (env: POS=0|1)

  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }

  SX=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m6q_sched 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  SM7T=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7t 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  SM7TP=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7t_pos 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  SM7R=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7r 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

  { [ -z "$SX" ] || [ -z "$SM7T" ] || [ -z "$SM7TP" ] || [ -z "$SM7R" ]; } && { log "X switch files still absent"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X pid before measured boot"; exit 1; }
else

# ---- our own guards OFF (task rule) ----

h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "guard files: smo_rss_guard=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_rss_guard" | tr -d '\r')] smo_mem_purge=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_mem_purge" | tr -d '\r')]"

MODE="truncate(:>)"
if ! h shell ": > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then MODE="rm -f"; h shell "rm -f $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi
SZ=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); SZ=${SZ:-0}
[ "$SZ" = "0" ] || { log "X log not reset: $MODE size=$SZ"; exit 1; }
log "log reset ok: mode=$MODE before=$PRE after=$SZ"

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
NFT0=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST0" | grep -c .); log "faultlog_before entries=$NFT0"

h shell "echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_snap_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_present_gain; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_gpres" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1

  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m7t_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1

  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"

  RAW=$(h shell "sh /data/local/tmp/m7t_probe.sh" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')

  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 20 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    PLINE=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m7t\] aud probe on|\[m7t\] svc8 probe on|\[m7r\] probe on|\[m7o\] fs UV-patch|\[m7o\] probe|\[m7p\] probe|\[m7l\] scene-probe|\[m7h\] probe|\[wp\] probe' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -8" | tr -d '\r')

  fi

  STLINE=$(grep -m1 '^STATE' <<<"$RAW")
  if grep -q '^STATE dead' <<<"$STLINE"; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR|has died' | tail -60" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt" | tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
    h shell "tail -n 5 $LOG" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/log_tail_at_death.txt"
    log "last log lines: $(tr '\n' '|' < "$OUT/log_tail_at_death.txt" | tail -c 400)"
    break
  fi
  PID=$(awk '{print $3}' <<<"$STLINE")
  if [ "$PID" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $PID at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$PID"; fi
  RSSKB=$(grep -m1 'VmRSS' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); RSSKB=${RSSKB:-0}
  RSSMB=$(( RSSKB / 1024 ))
  THRO=$(grep -m1 '^THREADS' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); THRO=${THRO:-0}
  NFT=$(grep -m1 '^FAULTLOG' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); NFT=${NFT:-0}
  ST=$(grep -m1 '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW")
  BT=$(grep -m1 '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW")
  FA=$(grep -a '\[fa\]' <<<"$RAW" | tr '\n' '|')
  MV=$(grep -m1 '\[mv\]' <<<"$RAW")
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  RD=$(grep -o 'reads=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); RD=${RD:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  MRCLIP=$(grep -m1 '\[m7r\] clip' <<<"$RAW")
  MRMAIN=$(grep -m1 '\[m7r\] main' <<<"$RAW")
  MRLAST=$(grep -o 'last=\S*' <<<"$MRMAIN" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  CV_=$(grep -o 'nsvc=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRCLIP" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  C1C=$(grep -o 'n1c=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRCLIP" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  C1D=$(grep -o 'n1d=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRCLIP" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  MN=$(grep -o 'nsvc=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRMAIN" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  JB=$(grep -o 'jobs=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRMAIN" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  P1D=$(grep -o 'post1d=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRMAIN" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' \
    "$EL" "$RSSMB" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${MRLAST:-}" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" \
    "${CV_:-}" "${C1C:-}" "${C1D:-}" "${MN:-}" "${JB:-}" "${P1D:-}" >> "$TSV"

  # ---- evidence drop every 100 s ----
  if [ -n "$OP" ] && [ $(( EL / 100 )) -gt "$LASTDROP" ]; then
    LASTDROP=$(( EL / 100 )); drop "$LASTDROP"
  fi

  if [ -n "$OP" ] && [ "$OP" -gt 1245 ] && [ "$OPENFLAG" -eq 0 ]; then
    OPENFLAG=1; log "SIGNAL-1 t=${EL}s opens=$OP > 1245 (new file paths) rss=${RSSMB}MB"
    shot "$EL" "opens$OP"
  fi
  if [ -n "$THRO" ] && [ "$THRO" -gt "$MAXTHR" ]; then MAXTHR=$THRO; fi
  if [ -n "$SUB" ] && [ "$FROZEN_LOGGED" -eq 0 ]; then
    if [ "$SUB" -gt "$SUB_PREV" ]; then SUB_PREV=$SUB; SUB_T=$EL
    else
      GAP=$(( EL - SUB_T ))
      if [ "$GAP" -ge 60 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 60 ]; then FROZEN_LOGGED=1; log "FROZEN t=${EL}s submit=$SUB (no growth for ${GAP}s) rss=${RSSMB}MB opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?}"; fi
    fi
  fi
  if [ "$NFT" -gt "$NF0" ]; then
    log "!! faultlog grew $NF0 -> $NFT at t=${EL}s"; NF0=$NFT
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_${EL}s.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR|has died' | tail -60" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_${EL}s.txt"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$RSSMB" -gt "$RSS_STOP_MB" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=${RSSMB}MB > stop=${RSS_STOP_MB}MB -> stopping before LMK (task rule)"
    STOPPED_EARLY=1; shot "$EL" "tstop"; break
  fi
  if [ $(( EL - LASTRSSLOG )) -ge 16 ]; then
    LASTRSSLOG=$EL; RN=$((RN+1))
    MVDEC=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[mv\] dec#' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')
    MOVC=$(h shell "grep -a -c 'MovieData' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')
    INJ=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[i\] hid inject' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=${RSSMB}MB opens=${OP:-?} reads=${RD:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} frames=${FR:-?} draws=${DW:-?} os_thr=${THRO:-?} movie=${MOVC} mvdec=${MVDEC} inj=${INJ}"
    [ -n "$MRCLIP" ] && log "   ${MRCLIP:0:280}"
    [ -n "$MRMAIN" ] && log "   ${MRMAIN:0:280}"
    [ -n "$FA" ] && log "   fa  $(cut -c1-240 <<<"$FA")"
    [ -n "$MV" ] && log "   mv  $(cut -c1-200 <<<"$MV")"
  fi
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  if [ "$RSSMB" -gt 12000 ]; then sleep 1; else sleep 4; fi
done

shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} stopped_early=${STOPPED_EARLY} maxthr=${MAXTHR}"
CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog_after entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST1" | grep -c .) new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

# ---- pull (twice: the first recv of a live log is often a partial file) ----
for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 4; done
h file recv /data/local/tmp/m6y_samples.txt "$OUT/samples.txt" >/dev/null 2>&1
if [ -f "$OUT/vk_boot.log" ]; then
  DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[m7t\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m7t.txt"; log "[m7t] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m7t.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[m7r\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m7r.txt"; log "[m7r] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m7r.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[svc\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/svc.txt"; log "[svc] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/svc.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a 'totk-audio' "$DL" > "$OUT/audio.txt"; log "totk-audio lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/audio.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[st\] t=' "$DL" > "$OUT/st.txt"; log "[st] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/st.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[i\] hid' "$DL" > "$OUT/inj.txt"; log "[i] inj lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/inj.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a 'MovieData' "$DL" > "$OUT/movie.txt"; log "MovieData lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/movie.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "[m7t] tail: $(tail -1 "$OUT/m7t.txt" | cut -c1-400)"
  log "[st] tail: $(tail -1 "$OUT/st.txt" | cut -c1-400)"
  log "[m7r] main tail: $(grep -a '\[m7r\] main' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-300)"
else log "X vk_boot.log pull failed"; fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG"

```

`m7u2_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M7U2 (M7U round): the scene-DISPATCH hub main+0x7acd50 -- did the device enter it, and if so
# what stage name does it dispatch for?  3 read-only gates (ids 83..85):
#   A 0x7acd50 entry                 tail=0 4-word window (first word pre-index stp: rewrites sp)
#   B 0x7acd94 dispatch return addr  tail=2 plain-word gate (ldr x0,[x20] replayed, bl untouched)
#   C 0x7acd70 stage-name use point  tail=2 plain-word gate (ldr x0,[x8] replayed; bl 0x9564f0 untouched)
# usage: bash m7u2_boot_run.sh <tag s1|d1|d2> <target 127.0.0.1:5555|ip:port> [dur=150] [gdump_sec=10]
#   SKIP_INSTALL=1  -> resume a boot without reinstalling
#   UNLOCK_POLL=0   -> skip the unlock poll (emulator)
#   KEEP_AWAKE=1    -> power-shell wakeup every 10 s during the measured boot (device d2 style)
# Never runs `hdc kill` (it would take the other target down). Same switch set on both sides.
# NOTE: this file is intentionally NOT named m7u_boot_run.sh -- that name already exists in the
# repo root (2026-11-07 round, clip-window/0x1D signaller). Same for the switch: smo_m7u /
# runtime_m7u_poll / [m7u] belong to that older round -> this round is m7u2.
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: bash m7u2_boot_run.sh <tag> <target> [dur] [gdump_sec]}"
TGT="${2:?target required (all hdc calls use -t)}"
DUR="${3:-150}"
GD="${4:-10}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m7u_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
UNLOCK_POLL="${UNLOCK_POLL:-1}"
UNLOCK_MAX="${UNLOCK_MAX:-1200}"        # 20 min cap, per the round rules
KEEP_AWAKE="${KEEP_AWAKE:-0}"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M7U2 tag=$TAG target=$TGT dur=${DUR}s gdump_sec=$GD out=$OUT unlock_poll=$UNLOCK_POLL(<=${UNLOCK_MAX}s) keep_awake=$KEEP_AWAKE"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target $TGT offline"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }

# ---- unlock poll: a successful `aa start` IS the seed start too (the app constructor creates
#      files/smo_m7u2 on first launch). 10106102 means "screen locked" -> do NOT try to unlock,
#      just keep polling every 15 s (M7R/M7S/M7T: 1 probe was enough, three times in a row).
wait_unlock(){
  local n=0 t0=$(date +%s) out
  h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
  while :; do
    n=$((n+1))
    out=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
    local el=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))
    printf '[%s] probe #%d t=%ds %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$n" "$el" "$(echo "$out" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 160)" >> "$OUT/unlock_probe.log"
    case "$out" in
      *10106102*) : ;;                       # locked: keep polling, never try to unlock
      *"start ability successfully"*|*"successfully"*) log "unlock poll: probe #$n OK at t=${el}s (of cap ${UNLOCK_MAX}s)"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 0 ;;
      *) : ;;
    esac
    [ "$el" -ge "$UNLOCK_MAX" ] && { log "X unlock poll: ${UNLOCK_MAX}s cap reached after $n probes (still 10106102) -> BLOCKED"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 1; }
    sleep 15
  done
}

stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"

if [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ]; then
  wait_unlock || { log "X device stays locked; not booting (per round rules: no unlock attempts, no forced retries)"; exit 2; }
  log "after unlock poll: pid=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]') smo_m7u2=[$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7u2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
  sleep 3
  stopapp || { log "X probe pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
fi

if [ "${SKIP_INSTALL:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  log "install SKIPPED (SKIP_INSTALL=1)"
else
  T0=$(date +%s)
  OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); INST_S=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))
  log "install(${INST_S}s): $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
  UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
  log "upd_after: $UPD1"
  [ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"
fi

# ---- seed start (~7-8 s, not counted in the measured boot): hdc cannot CREATE a file in the
#      sandbox, the app constructor seeds smo_m7u2. ----
if [ -z "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7u2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ]; then
  log "seed start: letting the app constructor create smo_m7u2"
  SEEDOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed aa start: $(echo "$SEEDOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  case "$SEEDOUT" in *10106102*) log "X seed aa start blocked: 10106102 (screen locked)"; exit 2;; esac
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  for i in $(seq 1 15); do
    [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7u2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && break
    sleep 2
  done
  log "seed check: smo_m7u2=[$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7u2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
  [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7u2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] || { log "X smo_m7u2 absent after seed"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X seed pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
else
  log "smo_m7u2 already present: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7u2" | tr -d '\r')"
fi

# ---- switches: the cheap cross-round baselines stay 1 (m7q WRAP = 0x7acd18 station, m7s2 = the
#      3 pool-B gates, m7t2 = the 9-head family, m7h keeps M7H_NG=15) + smo_m7u2=1 (this round) ----
for s in smo_m7g smo_m7r smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7n smo_m7p smo_m7q smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7s2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7u2; do
  h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
for s in smo_gpu_write smo_m7a smo_m7b smo_m7s smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7x smo_m7y smo_m7k smo_m7l smo_m7m smo_m7o smo_frz smo_ldrd smo_aud smo_sha_ungated smo_dspool smo_m7d_same; do
  h shell "[ -f $FILES/$s ] && echo 0 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $GD > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
RB=$(for s in smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7d_same; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
RB="$RB gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"
log "switch readback (pre-boot): $RB"
for s in smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r; do
  V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "1" ] || { log "X $s not 1, abort"; exit 1; }
done

h shell "printf '' > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "log truncated: bytes=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG" | tr -dc '0-9')"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m7u2_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m7u2_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
case "$STARTOUT" in
  *10106102*) log "X boot aa start blocked 10106102 -> re-entering unlock poll"
              [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ] && { wait_unlock || { log "X locked again; BLOCKED"; exit 2; }; sleep 3; stopapp; STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r'); } ;;
esac
log "boot aa start: $(echo "$STARTOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
START=$(date +%s); CURPID=""; PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0; LASTWAKE=0
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"; printf 't\tframes\tsubmit\topens\tdraws\tstall\tm7q_wrap\th5\th7\ta\tb\tc\n' > "$TSV"
PLAN="30 120"
GT(){ grep -a "\[m7u2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
GH(){ grep -a "\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  if [ "$KEEP_AWAKE" = "1" ] && [ $(( EL - LASTWAKE )) -ge 10 ]; then
    LASTWAKE=$EL; h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  PP=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$PP" ]; then DEADN=$(( ${DEADN:-0} + 1 )); else DEADN=0; fi
  if [ "${DEADN:-0}" -ge 2 ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> - app died during the boot; stopping this run"
    shot "$EL" "tdeath"
    h shell "ls -t /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null | head -3" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    DEATH_T=$EL; break
  fi
  [ -z "$CURPID" ] && { P="$PP"; [ -n "$P" ] && { CURPID=$P; log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; }; }
  RAW=$(h shell "tail -n 2400 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[beat\]|\[st\] t=|\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap|\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=h[57]|\[m7u2\] sum|\[m7u2\] name'" | tr -d '\r')
  BT=$(grep -a '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  ST=$(grep -a '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  MQ=$(grep -a '\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  MQW=$(grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' <<<"$MQ" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); MQW=${MQW:-}
  H5=$(GH h5); H7=$(GH h7); A=$(GT a); B=$(GT b); C=$(GT c)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${OP:-}" "${DW:-}" "${STALL:-}" "${MQW:-}" "${H5:-}" "${H7:-}" "${A:-}" "${B:-}" "${C:-}" >> "$TSV"
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 18 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    SL=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m7u2\] probe|\[m7u2\] code|\[m7u2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=a|\[m7u2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=b|\[m7u2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=c|\[m7u2\] name' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -40" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s M7U2-READBACK: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$SL")"
    GI=$(h shell "grep -a -E 'obs gate main\+0x7acd50|obs gate main\+0x7acd70|obs gate main\+0x7acd94' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -6; echo NOTINST=$(grep -a -c 'NOT installed' $LOG 2>/dev/null)" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s gate-install lines: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$GI")"
    RB2=$(for s in smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7h; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
    log "t=${EL}s switch readback (in-boot): $RB2"
  fi
  if [ $(( EL % 20 )) -lt 3 ]; then log "t=${EL}s frames=${FR:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?} stall=${STALL:-?} m7q_wrap=${MQW:-?} h5=${H5:-?} h7=${H7:-?} A=${A:-?} B=${B:-?} C=${C:-?}"; fi
  for T in $PLAN; do if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi; done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 4
done
shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} death_t=${DEATH_T:-none} dur=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done
DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  for K in st beat m7u2 m7t2 m7s2 m7q gst gates; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  grep -a 'obs gate' "$DL" > "$OUT/gates_install.txt" 2>/dev/null
  log "gate install lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/gates_install.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "m7u2: probe=$(grep -ac '\[m7u2\] probe' "$DL") code=$(grep -ac '\[m7u2\] code' "$DL") sum=$(grep -ac '\[m7u2\] sum' "$DL") lr=$(grep -ac '\[m7u2\] lr' "$DL") name=$(grep -ac '\[m7u2\] name' "$DL")"
  log "m7u2 last sums: $(grep -a '\[m7u2\] sum' "$DL" | tail -3 | sed 's/.*\(g=[a-c]\).*\(tot=[0-9]*\).*/\1 \2/' | tr '\n' '|')"
  log "m7u2 name lines: $(grep -a '\[m7u2\] name' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 600)"
fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG unlock_probes=${UNLOCK_N:-0}"

```

`m7u_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M7u: ONE 400 s boot naming the demo-clip upstream submit path (m7u task).
# New [m7t] probes: aud line (audio_renderer.c counters: RequestUpdate callers, returned
# played/consumed, elapsed_frames, event signals) + svc8 line (main 0x1001's top-8 SVCs and
# services per 100 s window). Both behind switch smo_m7t (C default off). The intervention
# lever smo_m7t_pos (monotonic position without real BGM) stays 0 unless POS=1 is passed for
# the second boot. smo_m7r kept ON (opens/clip baseline series); smo_m7s OFF (M7s done).
# Usage: bash m7u_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]   (env: POS=0|1)
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: m7u_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]}"
DUR="${2:-400}"
POS="${POS:-0}"
RSS_STOP_MB="${RSS_STOP_MB:-12500}"
SCHED_FILE="${SCHED_FILE:-/tmp/m6x_sched.txt}"
KILL_GAP="${KILL_GAP:-99999}"
CFG_VETO="${CFG_VETO:-0}"
CFG_HASHES="${CFG_HASHES:-}"
CFG_COST_THR="${CFG_COST_THR:-0}"
GPU_WRITE="${GPU_WRITE:-0}"
PLAN="${PLAN:-150 250 350}"
GD_SEC="${GD_SEC:-60}"
SYNTH="${SYNTH:-1}"
FRAMES="${FRAMES:-8}"
TESTSTICK="${TESTSTICK:-1 700 2000}"
TESTKEY="${TESTKEY:-1 160 1000 5000 30 38:10,36:20 1}"
MIN_CFGPIPE="${MIN_CFGPIPE:-0}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
TGT="127.0.0.1:5555"
```
