```sh
drop(){  # evidence drop: copy what exists so far (task rule: first <=250 s, then every 100 s)
  mkdir -p "$OUT/evidence_t$1"
  cp -f "$OUT/run.log" "$OUT/series.tsv" "$OUT/probe.raw" "$OUT/evidence_t$1/" 2>/dev/null || true
  log "evidence drop t=$1 (run.log=$(wc -l < "$OUT/run.log" | tr -d ' ')L series=$(wc -l < "$OUT/series.tsv" | tr -d ' ')L)"
}

log "=== M7t tag=$TAG dur=${DUR}s pos=$POS out=$OUT stop=${RSS_STOP_MB}MB sched=$(cat "$SCHED_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING)"
log "TESTKEY=[$TESTKEY] (faithful M5p: start=160s down=1000ms up=5000ms 30 presses 38x10,36x20 nofreeze=1)"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target offline ($TGT)"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing: $HAP"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$SCHED_FILE" ] || { log "X schedule missing: $SCHED_FILE"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }
stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty (pre-flight)"

# ---- install ----
UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"
OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); log "install: $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 300)"
grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_after: $UPD1"
[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

# ---- app-seeded switch files must exist before hdc can overwrite them ----
SX=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m6q_sched 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
SM7T=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7t 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
SM7TP=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7t_pos 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
SM7R=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7r 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
SM7U=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7u 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
if [ -z "$SX" ] || [ -z "$SM7T" ] || [ -z "$SM7TP" ] || [ -z "$SM7R" ] || [ -z "$SM7U" ]; then
  log "seed launch needed (sched=[$SX:-absent] smo_m7t=[${SM7T:-absent}] smo_m7t_pos=[${SM7TP:-absent}] smo_m7r=[${SM7R:-absent}] smo_m7u=[${SM7U:-absent}])"
  h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  sleep 20
  SX=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m6q_sched 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  SM7T=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7t 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  SM7TP=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7t_pos 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  SM7R=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7r 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  SM7U=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7u 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed check: sched=${SX:-<ABSENT>} smo_m7t=${SM7T:-<ABSENT>} smo_m7t_pos=${SM7TP:-<ABSENT>} smo_m7r=${SM7R:-<ABSENT>} smo_m7u=${SM7U:-<ABSENT>}"
  { [ -z "$SX" ] || [ -z "$SM7T" ] || [ -z "$SM7TP" ] || [ -z "$SM7R" ] || [ -z "$SM7U" ]; } && { log "X switch files still absent"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X pid before measured boot"; exit 1; }
else
  log "switch files present: sched ok, smo_m7t ok, smo_m7t_pos ok, smo_m7r ok, smo_m7u ok"
fi

# ---- switches for the measured boot ----
h shell "printf '%s' '$(cat "$SCHED_FILE")' > $FILES/smo_m6q_sched && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "printf '%s' '$TESTKEY' > $FILES/smo_testkey && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_m7t && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $POS > $FILES/smo_m7t_pos && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_m7r && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_m7s && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_m7u && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
RS=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m6q_sched" | tr -d '\r')
log "sched readback=[$RS] bytes=$(h shell "wc -c < $FILES/smo_m6q_sched" | tr -dc '0-9')"
log "testkey readback=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')]"
log "smo_m7t readback=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7t" | tr -d '\r')] smo_m7t_pos readback=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7t_pos" | tr -d '\r')] smo_m7r readback=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7r" | tr -d '\r')] smo_m7s readback=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7s" | tr -d '\r')]"
M7TRB=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7t" | tr -d '\r'); M7URB=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7u" | tr -d '\r')
[ "$M7TRB" = "1" ] || { log "X smo_m7t not 1 -> probe would be off, abort before wasting the boot"; exit 1; }
[ "$M7URB" = "1" ] || { log "X smo_m7u not 1 -> m7u probe would be off, abort before wasting the boot"; exit 1; }

# ---- our own guards OFF (task rule) ----
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "guard files: smo_rss_guard=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_rss_guard" | tr -d '\r')] smo_mem_purge=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_mem_purge" | tr -d '\r')]"

# ---- log reset ----
PRE=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); PRE=${PRE:-0}
MODE="truncate(:>)"
if ! h shell ": > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then MODE="rm -f"; h shell "rm -f $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi
SZ=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); SZ=${SZ:-0}
[ "$SZ" = "0" ] || { log "X log not reset: $MODE size=$SZ"; exit 1; }
log "log reset ok: mode=$MODE before=$PRE after=$SZ"

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
NFT0=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST0" | grep -c .); log "faultlog_before entries=$NFT0"

h shell "echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_snap_present; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_present_gain; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_gpres" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_heavy_skip; printf %s '' > $FILES/smo_heavy_keys" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $CFG_VETO > $FILES/smo_cfg_veto; printf %s '$CFG_HASHES' > $FILES/smo_cfg_veto_hashes; echo $CFG_COST_THR > $FILES/smo_cfg_veto_cost" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "cfg knobs: veto=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_cfg_veto" | tr -d '\r')] hashes=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_cfg_veto_hashes" | tr -d '\r')] cost_thr=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_cfg_veto_cost" | tr -d '\r')]"
h shell "echo $GPU_WRITE > $FILES/smo_gpu_write; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_movie_kick; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "gpu_write knob: smo_gpu_write=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gpu_write" | tr -d '\r')] (M7k~M7o settled config, untouched)"
h shell "echo '$GD_SEC' > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "rm -f $FILES/SwiftShader.ini" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1

# ---- observers ----
h file send /tmp/m6y_sampler.sh /data/local/tmp/m7u_sampler.sh >/dev/null 2>&1
h file send /tmp/m7u_probe.sh /data/local/tmp/m7u_probe.sh >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "nohup sh /data/local/tmp/m7u_sampler.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 &" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "sampler started (2 s, device-side)"

# ---- boot ----
h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
START=$(date +%s)
FIRSTPID=""
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 1
done

h shell "echo $SYNTH > $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null; echo $FRAMES > $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null; echo '$TESTSTICK' > $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "switches after seed: synth=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')] stick=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')] testkey=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')] m7t=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7t" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')] m7t_pos=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7t_pos" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')]"

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m7u_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m7u_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"
printf 't\trss_mb\topens\treads\tlast\tframes\tsubmit\tclip_nsvc\tclip_n1c\tclip_n1d\tmain_nsvc\tjobs_by_main\tposter_n1d\n' > "$TSV"
: > "$OUT/probe.raw"
PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; LASTRSSLOG=-100; RN=0; LASTDROP=0
SUB_PREV=0; SUB_T=0; FROZEN_LOGGED=0
MAXTHR=0; OPENFLAG=0; STOPPED_EARLY=0; NF0=$NFT0
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  RAW=$(h shell "sh /data/local/tmp/m7u_probe.sh" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')
  # ---- switch readback within 20 s of launch (task rule) ----
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 20 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    PLINE=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m7u\] probe on|\[m7t\] aud probe on|\[m7t\] svc8 probe on|\[m7r\] probe on|\[m7o\] fs UV-patch|\[m7o\] probe|\[m7p\] probe|\[m7l\] scene-probe|\[m7h\] probe|\[wp\] probe' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -8" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s PROBE-READBACK: ${PLINE:-<ABSENT - probe not enabled, ABORT>}"
    if [ -z "$PLINE" ]; then log "!! probe switch line absent within 20 s -> stopping (wiring wrong)"; STOPPED_EARLY=1; break; fi
  fi
  printf '### t=%s\n%s\n' "$EL" "$RAW" >> "$OUT/probe.raw"
  STLINE=$(grep -m1 '^STATE' <<<"$RAW")
  if grep -q '^STATE dead' <<<"$STLINE"; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR|has died' | tail -60" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt" | tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
    h shell "tail -n 5 $LOG" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/log_tail_at_death.txt"
    log "last log lines: $(tr '\n' '|' < "$OUT/log_tail_at_death.txt" | tail -c 400)"
    break
  fi
  PID=$(awk '{print $3}' <<<"$STLINE")
  if [ "$PID" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $PID at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$PID"; fi
  RSSKB=$(grep -m1 'VmRSS' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); RSSKB=${RSSKB:-0}
  RSSMB=$(( RSSKB / 1024 ))
  THRO=$(grep -m1 '^THREADS' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); THRO=${THRO:-0}
  NFT=$(grep -m1 '^FAULTLOG' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); NFT=${NFT:-0}
  ST=$(grep -m1 '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW")
  BT=$(grep -m1 '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW")
  FA=$(grep -a '\[fa\]' <<<"$RAW" | tr '\n' '|')
  MV=$(grep -m1 '\[mv\]' <<<"$RAW")
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  RD=$(grep -o 'reads=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); RD=${RD:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  MRCLIP=$(grep -m1 '\[m7r\] clip' <<<"$RAW")
  MRMAIN=$(grep -m1 '\[m7r\] main' <<<"$RAW")
  MRLAST=$(grep -o 'last=\S*' <<<"$MRMAIN" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  CV_=$(grep -o 'nsvc=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRCLIP" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  C1C=$(grep -o 'n1c=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRCLIP" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  C1D=$(grep -o 'n1d=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRCLIP" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  MN=$(grep -o 'nsvc=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRMAIN" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  JB=$(grep -o 'jobs=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRMAIN" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  P1D=$(grep -o 'post1d=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRMAIN" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' \
    "$EL" "$RSSMB" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${MRLAST:-}" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" \
    "${CV_:-}" "${C1C:-}" "${C1D:-}" "${MN:-}" "${JB:-}" "${P1D:-}" >> "$TSV"

  # ---- evidence drop every 100 s ----
  if [ -n "$OP" ] && [ $(( EL / 100 )) -gt "$LASTDROP" ]; then
    LASTDROP=$(( EL / 100 )); drop "$LASTDROP"
  fi

  if [ -n "$OP" ] && [ "$OP" -gt 1245 ] && [ "$OPENFLAG" -eq 0 ]; then
    OPENFLAG=1; log "SIGNAL-1 t=${EL}s opens=$OP > 1245 (new file paths) rss=${RSSMB}MB"
    shot "$EL" "opens$OP"
  fi
  if [ -n "$THRO" ] && [ "$THRO" -gt "$MAXTHR" ]; then MAXTHR=$THRO; fi
  if [ -n "$SUB" ] && [ "$FROZEN_LOGGED" -eq 0 ]; then
    if [ "$SUB" -gt "$SUB_PREV" ]; then SUB_PREV=$SUB; SUB_T=$EL
    else
      GAP=$(( EL - SUB_T ))
      if [ "$GAP" -ge 60 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 60 ]; then FROZEN_LOGGED=1; log "FROZEN t=${EL}s submit=$SUB (no growth for ${GAP}s) rss=${RSSMB}MB opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?}"; fi
    fi
  fi
  if [ "$NFT" -gt "$NF0" ]; then
    log "!! faultlog grew $NF0 -> $NFT at t=${EL}s"; NF0=$NFT
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_${EL}s.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR|has died' | tail -60" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_${EL}s.txt"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$RSSMB" -gt "$RSS_STOP_MB" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=${RSSMB}MB > stop=${RSS_STOP_MB}MB -> stopping before LMK (task rule)"
    STOPPED_EARLY=1; shot "$EL" "tstop"; break
  fi
  if [ $(( EL - LASTRSSLOG )) -ge 16 ]; then
    LASTRSSLOG=$EL; RN=$((RN+1))
    MVDEC=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[mv\] dec#' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')
    MOVC=$(h shell "grep -a -c 'MovieData' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')
    INJ=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[i\] hid inject' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=${RSSMB}MB opens=${OP:-?} reads=${RD:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} frames=${FR:-?} draws=${DW:-?} os_thr=${THRO:-?} movie=${MOVC} mvdec=${MVDEC} inj=${INJ}"
    [ -n "$MRCLIP" ] && log "   ${MRCLIP:0:280}"
    [ -n "$MRMAIN" ] && log "   ${MRMAIN:0:280}"
    [ -n "$FA" ] && log "   fa  $(cut -c1-240 <<<"$FA")"
    [ -n "$MV" ] && log "   mv  $(cut -c1-200 <<<"$MV")"
  fi
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  if [ "$RSSMB" -gt 12000 ]; then sleep 1; else sleep 4; fi
done

shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} stopped_early=${STOPPED_EARLY} maxthr=${MAXTHR}"
CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog_after entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST1" | grep -c .) new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

# ---- pull (twice: the first recv of a live log is often a partial file) ----
for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 4; done
h file recv /data/local/tmp/m6y_samples.txt "$OUT/samples.txt" >/dev/null 2>&1
if [ -f "$OUT/vk_boot.log" ]; then
  DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[m7t\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m7t.txt"; log "[m7t] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m7t.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[m7u\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m7u.txt"; log "[m7u] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m7u.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[m7r\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m7r.txt"; log "[m7r] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m7r.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[svc\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/svc.txt"; log "[svc] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/svc.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a 'totk-audio' "$DL" > "$OUT/audio.txt"; log "totk-audio lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/audio.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[st\] t=' "$DL" > "$OUT/st.txt"; log "[st] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/st.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[i\] hid' "$DL" > "$OUT/inj.txt"; log "[i] inj lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/inj.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a 'MovieData' "$DL" > "$OUT/movie.txt"; log "MovieData lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/movie.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "[m7t] tail: $(tail -1 "$OUT/m7t.txt" | cut -c1-400)"
  log "[m7u] tail: $(tail -1 "$OUT/m7u.txt" | cut -c1-500)"
  log "[st] tail: $(tail -1 "$OUT/st.txt" | cut -c1-400)"
  log "[m7r] main tail: $(grep -a '\[m7r\] main' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-300)"
else log "X vk_boot.log pull failed"; fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG"

```

`m7v_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M7V (2026-11-08): WHO does the device dispatch to?  8 read-only gates (ids 86..93):
#   X8 0x7acd8c  `ldr x8,[x8]` one insn before `blr x8`  tail=2 (only this word; blr untouched)
#                -> the gate's original x8 is the vtable pointer, one more deref = the real target
#   R1..R7 = the seven Rsv sibling instance entries that were NEVER gated before (tail=0 4-word):
#            0x4a6a90 / 0x46e770 / 0x445590 / 0x447ae0 / 0x449bc0 / 0x44b6f0 / 0x4af020
#   name ring v2 (no new gate): 4 raw-hex 32B slots at name_ptr / +0x10 / +0x18 / [name_ptr]+0x10
# usage: bash m7v_boot_run.sh <tag s1|d1|d2> <target 127.0.0.1:5555|ip:port> [dur=150] [gdump_sec=10]
#   SKIP_INSTALL=1  -> resume a boot without reinstalling
#   UNLOCK_POLL=0   -> skip the unlock poll (emulator)
#   KEEP_AWAKE=1    -> power-shell wakeup every 10 s during the measured boot (device d2 style)
# Never runs `hdc kill` (it would take the other target down). Same switch set on both sides.
# Switch/prefix/script/report names are all m7v (checked free before use; m7v / smo_m7v /
# [m7v] stay untouched so both rounds stay comparable).
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: bash m7v_boot_run.sh <tag> <target> [dur] [gdump_sec]}"
TGT="${2:?target required (all hdc calls use -t)}"
DUR="${3:-150}"
GD="${4:-10}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m7v_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
UNLOCK_POLL="${UNLOCK_POLL:-1}"
UNLOCK_MAX="${UNLOCK_MAX:-1200}"        # 20 min cap, per the round rules
KEEP_AWAKE="${KEEP_AWAKE:-0}"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M7V tag=$TAG target=$TGT dur=${DUR}s gdump_sec=$GD out=$OUT unlock_poll=$UNLOCK_POLL(<=${UNLOCK_MAX}s) keep_awake=$KEEP_AWAKE"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target $TGT offline"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }

# ---- unlock poll: a successful `aa start` IS the seed start too (the app constructor creates
#      files/smo_m7v on first launch). 10106102 means "screen locked" -> do NOT try to unlock,
#      just keep polling every 15 s (M7R/M7S/M7T: 1 probe was enough, three times in a row).
wait_unlock(){
  local n=0 t0=$(date +%s) out
  h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
  while :; do
    n=$((n+1))
    out=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
    local el=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))
    printf '[%s] probe #%d t=%ds %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$n" "$el" "$(echo "$out" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 160)" >> "$OUT/unlock_probe.log"
    case "$out" in
      *10106102*) : ;;                       # locked: keep polling, never try to unlock
      *"start ability successfully"*|*"successfully"*) log "unlock poll: probe #$n OK at t=${el}s (of cap ${UNLOCK_MAX}s)"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 0 ;;
      *) : ;;
    esac
    [ "$el" -ge "$UNLOCK_MAX" ] && { log "X unlock poll: ${UNLOCK_MAX}s cap reached after $n probes (still 10106102) -> BLOCKED"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 1; }
    sleep 15
  done
}

stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"

if [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ]; then
  wait_unlock || { log "X device stays locked; not booting (per round rules: no unlock attempts, no forced retries)"; exit 2; }
  log "after unlock poll: pid=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]') smo_m7v=[$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7v 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
  sleep 3
  stopapp || { log "X probe pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
fi

if [ "${SKIP_INSTALL:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  log "install SKIPPED (SKIP_INSTALL=1)"
else
  T0=$(date +%s)
  OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); INST_S=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))
  log "install(${INST_S}s): $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
  UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
  log "upd_after: $UPD1"
  [ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"
fi

# ---- seed start (~7-8 s, not counted in the measured boot): hdc cannot CREATE a file in the
#      sandbox, the app constructor seeds smo_m7v. ----
if [ -z "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7v 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ]; then
  log "seed start: letting the app constructor create smo_m7v"
  SEEDOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed aa start: $(echo "$SEEDOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  case "$SEEDOUT" in *10106102*) log "X seed aa start blocked: 10106102 (screen locked)"; exit 2;; esac
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  for i in $(seq 1 15); do
    [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7v 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && break
    sleep 2
  done
  log "seed check: smo_m7v=[$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7v 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
  [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7v 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] || { log "X smo_m7v absent after seed"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X seed pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
else
  log "smo_m7v already present: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7v" | tr -d '\r')"
fi

# ---- switches: the cheap cross-round baselines stay 1 (m7q WRAP = 0x7acd18 station, m7s2 = the
#      3 pool-B gates, m7t2 = the 9-head family, m7h keeps M7H_NG=15, **m7u2 = the A/B/C hub gates
#      the name ring v2 hangs on**) + smo_m7v=1 (this round's 8 gates) ----
for s in smo_m7g smo_m7r smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7n smo_m7p smo_m7q smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7s2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7v; do
  h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
for s in smo_gpu_write smo_m7a smo_m7b smo_m7s smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7x smo_m7y smo_m7k smo_m7l smo_m7m smo_m7o smo_frz smo_ldrd smo_aud smo_sha_ungated smo_dspool smo_m7d_same; do
  h shell "[ -f $FILES/$s ] && echo 0 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $GD > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
RB=$(for s in smo_m7v smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7d_same; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
RB="$RB gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"
log "switch readback (pre-boot): $RB"
for s in smo_m7v smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r; do
  V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "1" ] || { log "X $s not 1, abort"; exit 1; }
done

h shell "printf '' > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "log truncated: bytes=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG" | tr -dc '0-9')"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m7v_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m7v_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
case "$STARTOUT" in
  *10106102*) log "X boot aa start blocked 10106102 -> re-entering unlock poll"
              [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ] && { wait_unlock || { log "X locked again; BLOCKED"; exit 2; }; sleep 3; stopapp; STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r'); } ;;
esac
log "boot aa start: $(echo "$STARTOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
START=$(date +%s); CURPID=""; PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0; LASTWAKE=0; XT_SAVED=""
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"; printf 't\tframes\tsubmit\topens\tdraws\tstall\tm7q_wrap\th5\th7\ta\tb\tc\tx8_tgt\trsv_nonzero\n' > "$TSV"
PLAN="30 120"
GT(){ grep -a "\[m7v\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
GA(){ grep -a "\[m7u2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
GX(){ grep -a '\[m7v\] x8 #' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | sed 's/.*tgt=\([^ ]*\).*/\1/'; }
GH(){ grep -a "\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  if [ "$KEEP_AWAKE" = "1" ] && [ $(( EL - LASTWAKE )) -ge 10 ]; then
    LASTWAKE=$EL; h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  PP=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$PP" ]; then DEADN=$(( ${DEADN:-0} + 1 )); else DEADN=0; fi
  if [ "${DEADN:-0}" -ge 2 ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> - app died during the boot; stopping this run"
    shot "$EL" "tdeath"
    h shell "ls -t /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null | head -3" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    DEATH_T=$EL; break
  fi
  [ -z "$CURPID" ] && { P="$PP"; [ -n "$P" ] && { CURPID=$P; log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; }; }
  RAW=$(h shell "tail -n 3200 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[beat\]|\[st\] t=|\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap|\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=h[57]|\[m7u2\] sum|\[m7v\] sum|\[m7v\] x8 #|\[m7v\] name #'" | tr -d '\r')
  BT=$(grep -a '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  ST=$(grep -a '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  MQ=$(grep -a '\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  MQW=$(grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' <<<"$MQ" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); MQW=${MQW:-}
  H5=$(GH h5); H7=$(GH h7); A=$(GA a); B=$(GA b); C=$(GA c); XT=$(GX)
  RN=0; for G in r1 r2 r3 r4 r5 r6 r7; do V=$(GT $G); [ "${V:-0}" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null && RN=$((RN+1)); done
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${OP:-}" "${DW:-}" "${STALL:-}" "${MQW:-}" "${H5:-}" "${H7:-}" "${A:-}" "${B:-}" "${C:-}" "${XT:-}" "$RN" >> "$TSV"
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 18 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    SL=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m7v\] probe|\[m7v\] code|\[m7v\] x8 #|\[m7v\] name #|\[m7v\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=x8|\[m7u2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=[abc] ' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -40" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s M7V-READBACK: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$SL")"
    XT_SAVED=$(h shell "grep -a '\[m7v\] x8 #' $LOG 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | sed 's/.*tgt=\([^ ]*\).*/\1/'" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s X8-TARGET(raw, saved for the rest of the run): ${XT_SAVED:-<none>}"
    GI=$(h shell "grep -a -E 'obs gate main\+0x7acd8c|obs gate main\+0x4a6a90|obs gate main\+0x46e770|obs gate main\+0x445590|obs gate main\+0x447ae0|obs gate main\+0x449bc0|obs gate main\+0x44b6f0|obs gate main\+0x4af020' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -10; echo NOTINST=$(grep -a -c 'NOT installed' $LOG 2>/dev/null)" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s gate-install lines: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$GI")"
    RB2=$(for s in smo_m7v smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7h; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
    log "t=${EL}s switch readback (in-boot): $RB2"
  fi
  if [ $(( EL % 20 )) -lt 3 ]; then log "t=${EL}s frames=${FR:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?} stall=${STALL:-?} m7q_wrap=${MQW:-?} h5=${H5:-?} h7=${H7:-?} A=${A:-?} B=${B:-?} C=${C:-?} x8_tgt=${XT_SAVED:-?} rsv_nonzero=${RN}"; fi
  for T in $PLAN; do if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi; done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 4
done
shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} death_t=${DEATH_T:-none} dur=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done
DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  for K in st beat m7v m7u2 m7t2 m7s2 m7q gst gates; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  grep -a 'obs gate' "$DL" > "$OUT/gates_install.txt" 2>/dev/null
  log "gate install lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/gates_install.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "m7v: probe=$(grep -ac '\[m7v\] probe' "$DL") code=$(grep -ac '\[m7v\] code' "$DL") sum=$(grep -ac '\[m7v\] sum' "$DL") lr=$(grep -ac '\[m7v\] lr' "$DL") name=$(grep -ac '\[m7v\] name' "$DL")"
  log "m7v x8 lines: $(grep -a '\[m7v\] x8 #' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 900)"
  log "m7v sums per gate: $(grep -a '\[m7v\] sum' "$DL" | tail -8 | sed 's/.*\(g=[a-z0-9]*\).*\(tot=[0-9]*\).*/\1 \2/' | tr '\n' '|')"
  log "m7u2 A/B/C last: $(grep -a '\[m7u2\] sum' "$DL" | tail -3 | sed 's/.*\(g=[a-c]\).*\(tot=[0-9]*\).*/\1 \2/' | tr '\n' '|')"
  log "m7v name lines: $(grep -a '\[m7v\] name #' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 900)"
fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG unlock_probes=${UNLOCK_N:-0}"
```

`m7w2_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M7W2 (2026-11-08): IN THE ADAPTER, RECOMPUTE THE REAL CTOR   (one read-only gate, id 94)
#   AD main+0x7724d0 = the generic mfp adapter that M7V proved both platforms land on
#     (0x7724d0 ldp x8,x2,[x0,#8] / 0x7724d4 ldr x9,[x0,#0x18] / 0x7724d8 add x8,x8,x9,asr#1 /
#      0x7724dc tbz w9,#0 / 0x7724e0 ldr x9,[x8] / 0x7724e4 ldr x2,[x9,x2] / 0x7724f0 br x2)
#   tail=2 single-word gate: only word0 (ldp) is replaced; word1 (ldr x9,[x0,#0x18]) and
#   0x7724f0 (br x2) are untouched and read back verbatim every boot.
#   The observer recomputes  q=[obj+8]+(tag>>1)  and  tgt=(tag&1)?*(*(q)+[obj+0x10]):[obj+0x10]
#   and logs obj/tag/p/o/q/vt/tgt + describe(tgt) => "who does the device dispatch to" is a
#   reading (an address + a name), not a hypothesis.
# usage: bash m7w2_boot_run.sh <tag s1|d1|d2> <target 127.0.0.1:5555|ip:port> [dur=150] [gdump_sec=10]
#   SKIP_INSTALL=1  -> resume a boot without reinstalling
#   UNLOCK_POLL=0   -> skip the unlock poll (emulator)
#   KEEP_AWAKE=1    -> power-shell wakeup every 10 s during the measured boot (device d2 style)
# Never runs `hdc kill` (it would take the other target down). Same switch set on both sides.
# Names: m7w2 / smo_m7w2 / [m7w2] / logs/m7w2_* -- `smo_m7w` + `[m7w]` + `runtime_m7w_poll` are
# the 2026-11-07 round's LIVE baseline (smo_m7w=1 in every boot), `m7w_boot_run.sh` /
# /tmp/m7w_report.md / logs/m7w_b1 are occupied => this round is m7w2 (same pattern as m7s2/m7t2/m7u2).
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: bash m7w2_boot_run.sh <tag> <target> [dur] [gdump_sec]}"
TGT="${2:?target required (all hdc calls use -t)}"
DUR="${3:-150}"
GD="${4:-10}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m7w2_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
UNLOCK_POLL="${UNLOCK_POLL:-1}"
UNLOCK_MAX="${UNLOCK_MAX:-1200}"        # 20 min cap, per the round rules
KEEP_AWAKE="${KEEP_AWAKE:-0}"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M7W2 tag=$TAG target=$TGT dur=${DUR}s gdump_sec=$GD out=$OUT unlock_poll=$UNLOCK_POLL(<=${UNLOCK_MAX}s) keep_awake=$KEEP_AWAKE"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target $TGT offline"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }

# ---- unlock poll: a successful `aa start` IS the seed start too (the app constructor creates
#      files/smo_m7w2 on first launch). 10106102 means "screen locked" -> do NOT try to unlock,
#      just keep polling every 15 s (M7R/M7S/M7T: 1 probe was enough, three times in a row).
wait_unlock(){
  local n=0 t0=$(date +%s) out
  h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
  while :; do
    n=$((n+1))
    out=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
    local el=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))
    printf '[%s] probe #%d t=%ds %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$n" "$el" "$(echo "$out" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 160)" >> "$OUT/unlock_probe.log"
    case "$out" in
      *10106102*) : ;;                       # locked: keep polling, never try to unlock
      *"start ability successfully"*|*"successfully"*) log "unlock poll: probe #$n OK at t=${el}s (of cap ${UNLOCK_MAX}s)"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 0 ;;
      *) : ;;
    esac
    [ "$el" -ge "$UNLOCK_MAX" ] && { log "X unlock poll: ${UNLOCK_MAX}s cap reached after $n probes (still 10106102) -> BLOCKED"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 1; }
    sleep 15
  done
}

stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"

if [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ]; then
  wait_unlock || { log "X device stays locked; not booting (per round rules: no unlock attempts, no forced retries)"; exit 2; }
  log "after unlock poll: pid=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]') smo_m7w2=[$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7w2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
  sleep 3
  stopapp || { log "X probe pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
fi

if [ "${SKIP_INSTALL:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  log "install SKIPPED (SKIP_INSTALL=1)"
else
  T0=$(date +%s)
  OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); INST_S=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))
  log "install(${INST_S}s): $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
  UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
  log "upd_after: $UPD1"
  [ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"
fi

# ---- seed start (~7-8 s, not counted in the measured boot): hdc cannot CREATE a file in the
#      sandbox, the app constructor seeds smo_m7w2. ----
if [ -z "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7w2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ]; then
  log "seed start: letting the app constructor create smo_m7w2"
  SEEDOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed aa start: $(echo "$SEEDOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  case "$SEEDOUT" in *10106102*) log "X seed aa start blocked: 10106102 (screen locked)"; exit 2;; esac
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  for i in $(seq 1 15); do
    [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7w2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && break
    sleep 2
  done
  log "seed check: smo_m7w2=[$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7w2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
  [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7w2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] || { log "X smo_m7w2 absent after seed"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X seed pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
else
  log "smo_m7w2 already present: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7w2" | tr -d '\r')"
fi

# ---- switches: the cheap cross-round baselines stay 1 (m7q WRAP = 0x7acd18 station, m7s2 = the
#      3 pool-B gates, m7t2 = the 9-head family, m7h keeps M7H_NG=15, **m7u2 = the A/B/C hub gates
#      the name ring v2 hangs on**) + smo_m7w2=1 (this round's ONE gate, id 94) ----
for s in smo_m7g smo_m7r smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7n smo_m7p smo_m7q smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7s2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7w2; do
  h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
for s in smo_gpu_write smo_m7a smo_m7b smo_m7s smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7x smo_m7y smo_m7k smo_m7l smo_m7m smo_m7o smo_frz smo_ldrd smo_aud smo_sha_ungated smo_dspool smo_m7d_same; do
  h shell "[ -f $FILES/$s ] && echo 0 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $GD > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
RB=$(for s in smo_m7w2 smo_m7v smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7d_same; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
RB="$RB gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"
log "switch readback (pre-boot): $RB"
for s in smo_m7w2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r; do
  V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "1" ] || { log "X $s not 1, abort"; exit 1; }
done

h shell "printf '' > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "log truncated: bytes=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG" | tr -dc '0-9')"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m7w2_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m7w2_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
case "$STARTOUT" in
  *10106102*) log "X boot aa start blocked 10106102 -> re-entering unlock poll"
              [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ] && { wait_unlock || { log "X locked again; BLOCKED"; exit 2; }; sleep 3; stopapp; STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r'); } ;;
esac
log "boot aa start: $(echo "$STARTOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
START=$(date +%s); CURPID=""; PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0; LASTWAKE=0; XT_SAVED=""
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"; printf 't\tframes\tsubmit\topens\tdraws\tstall\tm7q_wrap\th5\th7\ta\tb\tc\tad_tgt\tad_ring\n' > "$TSV"
PLAN="30 120"
GA(){ grep -a "\[m7u2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
ADT(){ grep -a '\[m7w2\] ad #' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | sed 's/.* tgt=\([^ ]*\) .*/\1/'; }
ADN(){ grep -a '\[m7w2\] sum ' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | sed 's/.* ring_n=\([0-9]*\).*/\1/'; }
GH(){ grep -a "\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  if [ "$KEEP_AWAKE" = "1" ] && [ $(( EL - LASTWAKE )) -ge 10 ]; then
    LASTWAKE=$EL; h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  PP=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$PP" ]; then DEADN=$(( ${DEADN:-0} + 1 )); else DEADN=0; fi
  if [ "${DEADN:-0}" -ge 2 ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> - app died during the boot; stopping this run"
    shot "$EL" "tdeath"
    h shell "ls -t /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null | head -3" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    DEATH_T=$EL; break
  fi
  [ -z "$CURPID" ] && { P="$PP"; [ -n "$P" ] && { CURPID=$P; log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; }; }
  RAW=$(h shell "tail -n 3200 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[beat\]|\[st\] t=|\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap|\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=h[57]|\[m7u2\] sum|\[m7w2\] sum |\[m7w2\] ad #'" | tr -d '\r')
  BT=$(grep -a '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  ST=$(grep -a '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  MQ=$(grep -a '\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  MQW=$(grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' <<<"$MQ" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); MQW=${MQW:-}
  H5=$(GH h5); H7=$(GH h7); A=$(GA a); B=$(GA b); C=$(GA c); XT=$(ADT); RN=$(ADN); RN=${RN:-0}
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${OP:-}" "${DW:-}" "${STALL:-}" "${MQW:-}" "${H5:-}" "${H7:-}" "${A:-}" "${B:-}" "${C:-}" "${XT:-}" "$RN" >> "$TSV"
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 18 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    SL=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m7w2\] probe|\[m7w2\] code|\[m7w2\] ad #|\[m7w2\] sum |\[m7u2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=[abc] ' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -40" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s M7V-READBACK: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$SL")"
    XT_SAVED=$(h shell "grep -a '\[m7w2\] ad #' $LOG 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | sed 's/.* tgt=\([^ ]*\) .*/\1/'" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s X8-TARGET(raw, saved for the rest of the run): ${XT_SAVED:-<none>}"
    GI=$(h shell "grep -a -E 'obs gate main\+0x7724d0' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo NOTINST=$(grep -a -c 'NOT installed' $LOG 2>/dev/null)" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s gate-install lines: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$GI")"
    RB2=$(for s in smo_m7w2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7h; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
    log "t=${EL}s switch readback (in-boot): $RB2"
  fi
  if [ $(( EL % 20 )) -lt 3 ]; then log "t=${EL}s frames=${FR:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?} stall=${STALL:-?} m7q_wrap=${MQW:-?} h5=${H5:-?} h7=${H7:-?} A=${A:-?} B=${B:-?} C=${C:-?} x8_tgt=${XT_SAVED:-?} rsv_nonzero=${RN}"; fi
  for T in $PLAN; do if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi; done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 4
done
shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} death_t=${DEATH_T:-none} dur=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done
DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  for K in st beat m7w2 m7u2 m7t2 m7s2 m7q gst gates; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  grep -a 'obs gate' "$DL" > "$OUT/gates_install.txt" 2>/dev/null
  log "gate install lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/gates_install.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "m7w2: probe=$(grep -ac '\[m7w2\] probe' "$DL") code=$(grep -ac '\[m7w2\] code' "$DL") ad=$(grep -ac '\[m7w2\] ad #' "$DL") sum=$(grep -ac '\[m7w2\] sum' "$DL") lr=$(grep -ac '\[m7w2\] lr' "$DL")"
  log "m7w2 AD lines (obj/tag/q/tgt + describe): $(grep -a '\[m7w2\] ad #' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 1400)"
  log "m7w2 code line: $(grep -a '\[m7w2\] code' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 700)"
  log "m7w2 last sum: $(grep -a '\[m7w2\] sum' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "m7u2 A/B/C last: $(grep -a '\[m7u2\] sum' "$DL" | tail -3 | sed 's/.*\(g=[a-c]\).*\(tot=[0-9]*\).*/\1 \2/' | tr '\n' '|')"
fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG unlock_probes=${UNLOCK_N:-0}"

```

`m7w_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M7w: ONE 400 s boot -- "really stuck vs just slow" quantitative verdict (m7w task).
# New [m7w] probes (switch smo_m7w, C default 0): w2 census / sendTo gate ledger /
# present ledger / main wait profile / broadcaster identity. smo_gpu_write=0, M7k~M7o 0,
# smo_m7t_pos=0 kept. Usage: bash m7w_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]
# New [m7t] probes: aud line (audio_renderer.c counters: RequestUpdate callers, returned
# played/consumed, elapsed_frames, event signals) + svc8 line (main 0x1001's top-8 SVCs and
# services per 100 s window). Both behind switch smo_m7t (C default off). The intervention
# lever smo_m7t_pos (monotonic position without real BGM) stays 0 unless POS=1 is passed for
# the second boot. smo_m7r kept ON (opens/clip baseline series); smo_m7s OFF (M7s done).
# Usage: bash m7u_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]   (env: POS=0|1)
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: m7u_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]}"
DUR="${2:-400}"
POS="${POS:-0}"
RSS_STOP_MB="${RSS_STOP_MB:-12500}"
SCHED_FILE="${SCHED_FILE:-/tmp/m6x_sched.txt}"
KILL_GAP="${KILL_GAP:-99999}"
CFG_VETO="${CFG_VETO:-0}"
CFG_HASHES="${CFG_HASHES:-}"
CFG_COST_THR="${CFG_COST_THR:-0}"
GPU_WRITE="${GPU_WRITE:-0}"
PLAN="${PLAN:-150 250 350}"
GD_SEC="${GD_SEC:-60}"
SYNTH="${SYNTH:-1}"
FRAMES="${FRAMES:-8}"
TESTSTICK="${TESTSTICK:-1 700 2000}"
TESTKEY="${TESTKEY:-1 160 1000 5000 30 38:10,36:20 1}"
MIN_CFGPIPE="${MIN_CFGPIPE:-0}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
TGT="127.0.0.1:5555"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m7w_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }
drop(){  # evidence drop: copy what exists so far (task rule: first <=250 s, then every 100 s)
  mkdir -p "$OUT/evidence_t$1"
  cp -f "$OUT/run.log" "$OUT/series.tsv" "$OUT/probe.raw" "$OUT/evidence_t$1/" 2>/dev/null || true
  log "evidence drop t=$1 (run.log=$(wc -l < "$OUT/run.log" | tr -d ' ')L series=$(wc -l < "$OUT/series.tsv" | tr -d ' ')L)"
}

log "=== M7t tag=$TAG dur=${DUR}s pos=$POS out=$OUT stop=${RSS_STOP_MB}MB sched=$(cat "$SCHED_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING)"
log "TESTKEY=[$TESTKEY] (faithful M5p: start=160s down=1000ms up=5000ms 30 presses 38x10,36x20 nofreeze=1)"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target offline ($TGT)"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing: $HAP"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$SCHED_FILE" ] || { log "X schedule missing: $SCHED_FILE"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }
stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty (pre-flight)"

# ---- install ----
UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"
OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); log "install: $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 300)"
grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_after: $UPD1"
[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

# ---- app-seeded switch files must exist before hdc can overwrite them ----
SX=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m6q_sched 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
SM7T=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7t 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
SM7TP=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7t_pos 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
SM7R=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7r 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
SM7U=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7u 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
SM7W=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7w 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
if [ -z "$SX" ] || [ -z "$SM7T" ] || [ -z "$SM7TP" ] || [ -z "$SM7R" ] || [ -z "$SM7U" ] || [ -z "$SM7W" ]; then
  log "seed launch needed (sched=[$SX:-absent] smo_m7t=[${SM7T:-absent}] smo_m7t_pos=[${SM7TP:-absent}] smo_m7r=[${SM7R:-absent}] smo_m7u=[${SM7U:-absent}] smo_m7w=[${SM7W:-absent}])"
  h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  sleep 20
  SX=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m6q_sched 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  SM7T=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7t 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  SM7TP=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7t_pos 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  SM7R=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7r 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  SM7U=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7u 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  SM7W=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7w 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed check: sched=${SX:-<ABSENT>} smo_m7t=${SM7T:-<ABSENT>} smo_m7t_pos=${SM7TP:-<ABSENT>} smo_m7r=${SM7R:-<ABSENT>} smo_m7u=${SM7U:-<ABSENT>} smo_m7w=${SM7W:-<ABSENT>}"
  { [ -z "$SX" ] || [ -z "$SM7T" ] || [ -z "$SM7TP" ] || [ -z "$SM7R" ] || [ -z "$SM7U" ] || [ -z "$SM7W" ]; } && { log "X switch files still absent"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X pid before measured boot"; exit 1; }
else
  log "switch files present: sched ok, smo_m7t ok, smo_m7t_pos ok, smo_m7r ok, smo_m7u ok, smo_m7w ok"
fi

# ---- switches for the measured boot ----
h shell "printf '%s' '$(cat "$SCHED_FILE")' > $FILES/smo_m6q_sched && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "printf '%s' '$TESTKEY' > $FILES/smo_testkey && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1

h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_m7u && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1

log "testkey readback=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" | tr -d '\r')]"
log "smo_m7t readback=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7t" | tr -d '\r')] smo_m7t_pos readback=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7t_pos" | tr -d '\r')] smo_m7r readback=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7r" | tr -d '\r')] smo_m7s readback=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7s" | tr -d '\r')] smo_m7u readback=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7u" | tr -d '\r')] smo_m7w readback=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7w" | tr -d '\r')]"
M7TRB=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7t" | tr -d '\r'); M7URB=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7u" | tr -d '\r'); M7WRB=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7w" | tr -d '\r')

# ---- our own guards OFF (task rule) ----

  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 1
done

h shell "echo $SYNTH > $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null; echo $FRAMES > $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null; echo '$TESTSTICK' > $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" >/dev/null 2>&1
```
