```sh
shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m7u_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m7u_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"
printf 't\trss_mb\topens\treads\tlast\tframes\tsubmit\tclip_nsvc\tclip_n1c\tclip_n1d\tmain_nsvc\tjobs_by_main\tposter_n1d\n' > "$TSV"
: > "$OUT/probe.raw"
PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; LASTRSSLOG=-100; RN=0; LASTDROP=0
SUB_PREV=0; SUB_T=0; FROZEN_LOGGED=0
MAXTHR=0; OPENFLAG=0; STOPPED_EARLY=0; NF0=$NFT0
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  RAW=$(h shell "sh /data/local/tmp/m7u_probe.sh" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')
  # ---- switch readback within 20 s of launch (task rule) ----
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 20 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    PLINE=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m7u\] probe on|\[m7t\] aud probe on|\[m7t\] svc8 probe on|\[m7r\] probe on|\[m7o\] fs UV-patch|\[m7o\] probe|\[m7p\] probe|\[m7l\] scene-probe|\[m7h\] probe|\[wp\] probe' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -8" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s PROBE-READBACK: ${PLINE:-<ABSENT - probe not enabled, ABORT>}"
    if [ -z "$PLINE" ]; then log "!! probe switch line absent within 20 s -> stopping (wiring wrong)"; STOPPED_EARLY=1; break; fi
  fi
  printf '### t=%s\n%s\n' "$EL" "$RAW" >> "$OUT/probe.raw"
  STLINE=$(grep -m1 '^STATE' <<<"$RAW")
  if grep -q '^STATE dead' <<<"$STLINE"; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR|has died' | tail -60" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt" | tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
    h shell "tail -n 5 $LOG" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/log_tail_at_death.txt"
    log "last log lines: $(tr '\n' '|' < "$OUT/log_tail_at_death.txt" | tail -c 400)"
    break
  fi
  PID=$(awk '{print $3}' <<<"$STLINE")
  if [ "$PID" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $PID at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$PID"; fi
  RSSKB=$(grep -m1 'VmRSS' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); RSSKB=${RSSKB:-0}
  RSSMB=$(( RSSKB / 1024 ))
  THRO=$(grep -m1 '^THREADS' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); THRO=${THRO:-0}
  NFT=$(grep -m1 '^FAULTLOG' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); NFT=${NFT:-0}
  ST=$(grep -m1 '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW")
  BT=$(grep -m1 '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW")
  FA=$(grep -a '\[fa\]' <<<"$RAW" | tr '\n' '|')
  MV=$(grep -m1 '\[mv\]' <<<"$RAW")
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  RD=$(grep -o 'reads=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); RD=${RD:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  MRCLIP=$(grep -m1 '\[m7r\] clip' <<<"$RAW")
  MRMAIN=$(grep -m1 '\[m7r\] main' <<<"$RAW")
  MRLAST=$(grep -o 'last=\S*' <<<"$MRMAIN" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  CV_=$(grep -o 'nsvc=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRCLIP" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  C1C=$(grep -o 'n1c=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRCLIP" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  C1D=$(grep -o 'n1d=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRCLIP" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  MN=$(grep -o 'nsvc=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRMAIN" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  JB=$(grep -o 'jobs=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRMAIN" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  P1D=$(grep -o 'post1d=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRMAIN" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' \
    "$EL" "$RSSMB" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${MRLAST:-}" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" \
    "${CV_:-}" "${C1C:-}" "${C1D:-}" "${MN:-}" "${JB:-}" "${P1D:-}" >> "$TSV"

  # ---- evidence drop every 100 s ----
  if [ -n "$OP" ] && [ $(( EL / 100 )) -gt "$LASTDROP" ]; then
    LASTDROP=$(( EL / 100 )); drop "$LASTDROP"
  fi

  if [ -n "$OP" ] && [ "$OP" -gt 1245 ] && [ "$OPENFLAG" -eq 0 ]; then
    OPENFLAG=1; log "SIGNAL-1 t=${EL}s opens=$OP > 1245 (new file paths) rss=${RSSMB}MB"
    shot "$EL" "opens$OP"
  fi
  if [ -n "$THRO" ] && [ "$THRO" -gt "$MAXTHR" ]; then MAXTHR=$THRO; fi
  if [ -n "$SUB" ] && [ "$FROZEN_LOGGED" -eq 0 ]; then
    if [ "$SUB" -gt "$SUB_PREV" ]; then SUB_PREV=$SUB; SUB_T=$EL
    else
      GAP=$(( EL - SUB_T ))
      if [ "$GAP" -ge 60 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 60 ]; then FROZEN_LOGGED=1; log "FROZEN t=${EL}s submit=$SUB (no growth for ${GAP}s) rss=${RSSMB}MB opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?}"; fi
    fi
  fi
  if [ "$NFT" -gt "$NF0" ]; then
    log "!! faultlog grew $NF0 -> $NFT at t=${EL}s"; NF0=$NFT
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_${EL}s.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR|has died' | tail -60" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_${EL}s.txt"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$RSSMB" -gt "$RSS_STOP_MB" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=${RSSMB}MB > stop=${RSS_STOP_MB}MB -> stopping before LMK (task rule)"
    STOPPED_EARLY=1; shot "$EL" "tstop"; break
  fi
  if [ $(( EL - LASTRSSLOG )) -ge 16 ]; then
    LASTRSSLOG=$EL; RN=$((RN+1))
    MVDEC=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[mv\] dec#' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')
    MOVC=$(h shell "grep -a -c 'MovieData' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')
    INJ=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[i\] hid inject' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=${RSSMB}MB opens=${OP:-?} reads=${RD:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} frames=${FR:-?} draws=${DW:-?} os_thr=${THRO:-?} movie=${MOVC} mvdec=${MVDEC} inj=${INJ}"
    [ -n "$MRCLIP" ] && log "   ${MRCLIP:0:280}"
    [ -n "$MRMAIN" ] && log "   ${MRMAIN:0:280}"
    [ -n "$FA" ] && log "   fa  $(cut -c1-240 <<<"$FA")"
    [ -n "$MV" ] && log "   mv  $(cut -c1-200 <<<"$MV")"
  fi
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  if [ "$RSSMB" -gt 12000 ]; then sleep 1; else sleep 4; fi
done

shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} stopped_early=${STOPPED_EARLY} maxthr=${MAXTHR}"
CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog_after entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST1" | grep -c .) new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

# ---- pull (twice: the first recv of a live log is often a partial file) ----
for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 4; done
h file recv /data/local/tmp/m6y_samples.txt "$OUT/samples.txt" >/dev/null 2>&1
if [ -f "$OUT/vk_boot.log" ]; then
  DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[m7t\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m7t.txt"; log "[m7t] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m7t.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[m7u\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m7u.txt"; log "[m7u] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m7u.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[m7w\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m7w.txt"; log "[m7w] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m7w.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; log "[m7w] tail: $(tail -1 "$OUT/m7w.txt" | cut -c1-400)"
  grep -a '\[m7r\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m7r.txt"; log "[m7r] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m7r.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[svc\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/svc.txt"; log "[svc] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/svc.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a 'totk-audio' "$DL" > "$OUT/audio.txt"; log "totk-audio lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/audio.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[st\] t=' "$DL" > "$OUT/st.txt"; log "[st] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/st.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[i\] hid' "$DL" > "$OUT/inj.txt"; log "[i] inj lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/inj.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a 'MovieData' "$DL" > "$OUT/movie.txt"; log "MovieData lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/movie.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "[m7t] tail: $(tail -1 "$OUT/m7t.txt" | cut -c1-400)"
  log "[m7u] tail: $(tail -1 "$OUT/m7u.txt" | cut -c1-500)"
  log "[st] tail: $(tail -1 "$OUT/st.txt" | cut -c1-400)"
  log "[m7r] main tail: $(grep -a '\[m7r\] main' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-300)"
else log "X vk_boot.log pull failed"; fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG"

```

`m7x2_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M7X2 (2026-11-08): THE LAST HOP - who is the real worker + who binds +8   (two read-only gates)
#   G1 id 95 main+0x74c9e0 = the 3-instruction slot-3 forwarder thunk M7W2 named on BOTH platforms
#     (0x74c9e0 ldr x8,[x0] / 0x74c9e4 ldr x2,[x8,#0x18] / 0x74c9e8 br x2 / udf)
#     tail=2 single-word gate: only word0 (ldr x8,[x0]) is replaced; 0x74c9e4 and 0x74c9e8 are
#     untouched and read back verbatim every boot. x0 at the gate IS q (the adapter did mov x0,x8),
#     so the observer resolves TWO levels: vt=[q] and tgt3=[[q]+0x18] (plus the literal field
#     [q+0x18] so "one level / two levels" can never be confused) => the real worker gets a name.
#   G2 id 96 main+0x772500 = the descriptor clone (M7W2's write-point candidate A), tail=0 4-word
#     window (word0 'str x19,[sp,#-0x20]!' rewrites sp, so it is replayed after the stub epilogue):
#     0x772500 str x19,[sp,#-0x20]! / stp x29,x30 / add x29,sp,#0x10 / mov x19,x0 / mov w0,#0x28 /
#     bl operator new / [x0]=registry vtbl / ldp 32B from x19 -> stp 32B into the new object.
#     src = entry x0 (the 'mov x19,x0' makes x19 == x0), and the 32B written is exactly src+8..+0x27
#     => this answers "who binds which object into +8".
# usage: bash m7x2_boot_run.sh <tag s1|d1|d2> <target 127.0.0.1:5555|ip:port> [dur=150] [gdump_sec=10]
#   SKIP_INSTALL=1  -> resume a boot without reinstalling
#   UNLOCK_POLL=0   -> skip the unlock poll (emulator)
#   KEEP_AWAKE=1    -> power-shell wakeup every 10 s during the measured boot (device d2 style)
# Never runs `hdc kill` (it would take the other target down). Same switch set on both sides.
# Names: m7x2 / smo_m7x2 / [m7x2] / logs/m7x2_* -- `smo_m7x` + `[m7x]` + `runtime_m7x_poll` +
# m7x_boot_run.sh + /tmp/m7x_report.md + logs/m7x_b1 are the 2026-11-07 round's (ALL occupied),
# and smo_m7w/smo_m7w2 are live baselines => this round is m7x2 (same pattern as m7s2/m7t2/m7u2/m7w2).
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: bash m7x2_boot_run.sh <tag> <target> [dur] [gdump_sec]}"
TGT="${2:?target required (all hdc calls use -t)}"
DUR="${3:-150}"
GD="${4:-10}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m7x2_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
UNLOCK_POLL="${UNLOCK_POLL:-1}"
UNLOCK_MAX="${UNLOCK_MAX:-1200}"        # 20 min cap, per the round rules
KEEP_AWAKE="${KEEP_AWAKE:-0}"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M7X2 tag=$TAG target=$TGT dur=${DUR}s gdump_sec=$GD out=$OUT unlock_poll=$UNLOCK_POLL(<=${UNLOCK_MAX}s) keep_awake=$KEEP_AWAKE"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target $TGT offline"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }

# ---- unlock poll: a successful `aa start` IS the seed start too (the app constructor creates
#      files/smo_m7x2 on first launch). 10106102 means "screen locked" -> do NOT try to unlock,
#      just keep polling every 15 s (M7R/M7S/M7T: 1 probe was enough, three times in a row).
wait_unlock(){
  local n=0 t0=$(date +%s) out
  h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
  while :; do
    n=$((n+1))
    out=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
    local el=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))
    printf '[%s] probe #%d t=%ds %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$n" "$el" "$(echo "$out" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 160)" >> "$OUT/unlock_probe.log"
    case "$out" in
      *10106102*) : ;;                       # locked: keep polling, never try to unlock
      *"start ability successfully"*|*"successfully"*) log "unlock poll: probe #$n OK at t=${el}s (of cap ${UNLOCK_MAX}s)"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 0 ;;
      *) : ;;
    esac
    [ "$el" -ge "$UNLOCK_MAX" ] && { log "X unlock poll: ${UNLOCK_MAX}s cap reached after $n probes (still 10106102) -> BLOCKED"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 1; }
    sleep 15
  done
}

stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"

if [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ]; then
  wait_unlock || { log "X device stays locked; not booting (per round rules: no unlock attempts, no forced retries)"; exit 2; }
  log "after unlock poll: pid=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]') smo_m7x2=[$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7x2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
  sleep 3
  stopapp || { log "X probe pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
fi

if [ "${SKIP_INSTALL:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  log "install SKIPPED (SKIP_INSTALL=1)"
else
  T0=$(date +%s)
  OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); INST_S=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))
  log "install(${INST_S}s): $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
  UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
  log "upd_after: $UPD1"
  [ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"
fi

# ---- seed start (~7-8 s, not counted in the measured boot): hdc cannot CREATE a file in the
#      sandbox, the app constructor seeds smo_m7x2. ----
if [ -z "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7x2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ]; then
  log "seed start: letting the app constructor create smo_m7x2"
  SEEDOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed aa start: $(echo "$SEEDOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  case "$SEEDOUT" in *10106102*) log "X seed aa start blocked: 10106102 (screen locked)"; exit 2;; esac
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  for i in $(seq 1 15); do
    [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7x2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && break
    sleep 2
  done
  log "seed check: smo_m7x2=[$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7x2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
  [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7x2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] || { log "X smo_m7x2 absent after seed"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X seed pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
else
  log "smo_m7x2 already present: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7x2" | tr -d '\r')"
fi

# ---- switches: the cheap cross-round baselines stay 1 (m7q WRAP = 0x7acd18 station, m7s2 = the
#      3 pool-B gates, m7t2 = the 9-head family, m7h keeps M7H_NG=15, **m7u2 = the A/B/C hub gates
#      the name ring v2 hangs on**) + smo_m7w2=1 + smo_m7x2=1 (this round's TWO gates, ids 95/96) ----
for s in smo_m7g smo_m7r smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7n smo_m7p smo_m7q smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7s2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7x2; do
  h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
for s in smo_gpu_write smo_m7a smo_m7b smo_m7s smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7x smo_m7y smo_m7k smo_m7l smo_m7m smo_m7o smo_frz smo_ldrd smo_aud smo_sha_ungated smo_dspool smo_m7d_same; do
  h shell "[ -f $FILES/$s ] && echo 0 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $GD > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
RB=$(for s in smo_m7x2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7v smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7d_same; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
RB="$RB gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"
log "switch readback (pre-boot): $RB"
for s in smo_m7x2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r; do
  V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "1" ] || { log "X $s not 1, abort"; exit 1; }
done

h shell "printf '' > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "log truncated: bytes=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG" | tr -dc '0-9')"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m7x2_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m7x2_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
case "$STARTOUT" in
  *10106102*) log "X boot aa start blocked 10106102 -> re-entering unlock poll"
              [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ] && { wait_unlock || { log "X locked again; BLOCKED"; exit 2; }; sleep 3; stopapp; STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r'); } ;;
esac
log "boot aa start: $(echo "$STARTOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
START=$(date +%s); CURPID=""; PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0; LASTWAKE=0; XT_SAVED=""
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"; printf 't\tframes\tsubmit\topens\tdraws\tstall\tm7q_wrap\th5\th7\ta\tb\tc\tg1_tgt3\tg2_src\n' > "$TSV"
PLAN="30 120"
GA(){ grep -a "\[m7u2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
G1T(){ grep -a '\[m7x2\] g1 #' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | sed 's/.* tgt3=\[\[q\]+0x18\]=\([^ (]*\).*/\1/'; }
G2S(){ grep -a '\[m7x2\] g2 #' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | sed 's/.* src=\([^ ]*\).*/\1/'; }
G1N(){ grep -a '\[m7x2\] sum1 ' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | sed 's/.* ring_n=\([0-9]*\).*/\1/'; }
G2N(){ grep -a '\[m7x2\] sum2 ' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | sed 's/.* ring_n=\([0-9]*\).*/\1/'; }
GH(){ grep -a "\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  if [ "$KEEP_AWAKE" = "1" ] && [ $(( EL - LASTWAKE )) -ge 10 ]; then
    LASTWAKE=$EL; h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  PP=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$PP" ]; then DEADN=$(( ${DEADN:-0} + 1 )); else DEADN=0; fi
  if [ "${DEADN:-0}" -ge 2 ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> - app died during the boot; stopping this run"
    shot "$EL" "tdeath"
    h shell "ls -t /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null | head -3" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    DEATH_T=$EL; break
  fi
  [ -z "$CURPID" ] && { P="$PP"; [ -n "$P" ] && { CURPID=$P; log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; }; }
  RAW=$(h shell "tail -n 3200 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[beat\]|\[st\] t=|\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap|\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=h[57]|\[m7u2\] sum|\[m7x2\] sum1 |\[m7x2\] sum2 |\[m7x2\] g1 #|\[m7x2\] g2 #'" | tr -d '\r')
  BT=$(grep -a '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  ST=$(grep -a '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  MQ=$(grep -a '\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  MQW=$(grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' <<<"$MQ" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); MQW=${MQW:-}
  H5=$(GH h5); H7=$(GH h7); A=$(GA a); B=$(GA b); C=$(GA c); XT=$(G1T); RN=$(G2S); RN=${RN:-none}
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${OP:-}" "${DW:-}" "${STALL:-}" "${MQW:-}" "${H5:-}" "${H7:-}" "${A:-}" "${B:-}" "${C:-}" "${XT:-}" "$RN" >> "$TSV"
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 18 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    SL=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m7w2\] probe|\[m7w2\] code|\[m7w2\] ad #|\[m7w2\] sum |\[m7u2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=[abc] ' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -40" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s M7V-READBACK: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$SL")"
    XT_SAVED=$(h shell "grep -a '\[m7w2\] ad #' $LOG 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | sed 's/.* tgt=\([^ ]*\) .*/\1/'" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s X8-TARGET(raw, saved for the rest of the run): ${XT_SAVED:-<none>}"
    GI=$(h shell "grep -a -E 'obs gate main\+0x7724d0' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo NOTINST=$(grep -a -c 'NOT installed' $LOG 2>/dev/null)" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s gate-install lines: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$GI")"
    RB2=$(for s in smo_m7x2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7h; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
    log "t=${EL}s switch readback (in-boot): $RB2"
  fi
  if [ $(( EL % 20 )) -lt 3 ]; then log "t=${EL}s frames=${FR:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?} stall=${STALL:-?} m7q_wrap=${MQW:-?} h5=${H5:-?} h7=${H7:-?} A=${A:-?} B=${B:-?} C=${C:-?} g1_tgt3=${XT_SAVED:-?} g2_src=${RN}"; fi
  for T in $PLAN; do if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi; done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 4
done
shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} death_t=${DEATH_T:-none} dur=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done
DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  for K in st beat m7x2 m7w2 m7u2 m7t2 m7s2 m7q gst gates; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  grep -a 'obs gate' "$DL" > "$OUT/gates_install.txt" 2>/dev/null
  log "gate install lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/gates_install.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "m7x2: probe=$(grep -ac '\[m7x2\] probe' "$DL") code1=$(grep -ac '\[m7x2\] code1' "$DL") code2=$(grep -ac '\[m7x2\] code2' "$DL") g1=$(grep -ac '\[m7x2\] g1 #' "$DL") g2=$(grep -ac '\[m7x2\] g2 #' "$DL") sum1=$(grep -ac '\[m7x2\] sum1' "$DL") sum2=$(grep -ac '\[m7x2\] sum2' "$DL") lr=$(grep -ac '\[m7x2\] lr[12]' "$DL") m7w2=$(grep -ac '\[m7w2\]' "$DL")"
  log "m7x2 G1 lines (q/vt/tgt3/o18 + describe): $(grep -a '\[m7x2\] g1 #' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 1600)"
  log "m7x2 G2 lines (src + the 32B written): $(grep -a '\[m7x2\] g2 #' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 1600)"
  log "m7x2 code1: $(grep -a '\[m7x2\] code1' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 700)"
  log "m7x2 code2: $(grep -a '\[m7x2\] code2' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 900)"
  log "m7x2 last sum1/sum2: $(grep -a -E '\[m7x2\] sum[12]' "$DL" | tail -2 | tr '\n' '|')"
  log "m7u2 A/B/C last: $(grep -a '\[m7u2\] sum' "$DL" | tail -3 | sed 's/.*\(g=[a-c]\).*\(tot=[0-9]*\).*/\1 \2/' | tr '\n' '|')"
fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG unlock_probes=${UNLOCK_N:-0}"

```

`m7x_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M7x: ONE 400 s boot -- name main's two alternating wait objects (m7x task 2026-11-07).
# New [m7x] probes (switch smo_m7x, C default 0): wobj blocked-wait rows + 32 B window /
# wsrc release sides (0x1B unlock, 0x35, 0x1D signal) / wown owner-resolve / ldr 60 s state /
# sem duration+result series. smo_m7w=1 kept (census/gate/brc), smo_gpu_write=0, M7k~M7o 0,
# smo_m7t_pos=0 kept. Usage: bash m7x_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]
# New [m7t] probes: aud line (audio_renderer.c counters: RequestUpdate callers, returned
# played/consumed, elapsed_frames, event signals) + svc8 line (main 0x1001's top-8 SVCs and
# services per 100 s window). Both behind switch smo_m7t (C default off). The intervention
# lever smo_m7t_pos (monotonic position without real BGM) stays 0 unless POS=1 is passed for
# the second boot. smo_m7r kept ON (opens/clip baseline series); smo_m7s OFF (M7s done).
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: m7u_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]}"
DUR="${2:-400}"
POS="${POS:-0}"
RSS_STOP_MB="${RSS_STOP_MB:-12500}"
SCHED_FILE="${SCHED_FILE:-/tmp/m6x_sched.txt}"
KILL_GAP="${KILL_GAP:-99999}"
CFG_VETO="${CFG_VETO:-0}"
CFG_HASHES="${CFG_HASHES:-}"
CFG_COST_THR="${CFG_COST_THR:-0}"
GPU_WRITE="${GPU_WRITE:-0}"
PLAN="${PLAN:-150 250 350}"
GD_SEC="${GD_SEC:-60}"
SYNTH="${SYNTH:-1}"
FRAMES="${FRAMES:-8}"
TESTSTICK="${TESTSTICK:-1 700 2000}"
TESTKEY="${TESTKEY:-1 160 1000 5000 30 38:10,36:20 1}"
MIN_CFGPIPE="${MIN_CFGPIPE:-0}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
TGT="127.0.0.1:5555"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m7x_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }
drop(){  # evidence drop: copy what exists so far (task rule: first <=250 s, then every 100 s)
  mkdir -p "$OUT/evidence_t$1"
  cp -f "$OUT/run.log" "$OUT/series.tsv" "$OUT/probe.raw" "$OUT/evidence_t$1/" 2>/dev/null || true
  log "evidence drop t=$1 (run.log=$(wc -l < "$OUT/run.log" | tr -d ' ')L series=$(wc -l < "$OUT/series.tsv" | tr -d ' ')L)"
}

log "=== M7t tag=$TAG dur=${DUR}s pos=$POS out=$OUT stop=${RSS_STOP_MB}MB sched=$(cat "$SCHED_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING)"
log "TESTKEY=[$TESTKEY] (faithful M5p: start=160s down=1000ms up=5000ms 30 presses 38x10,36x20 nofreeze=1)"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target offline ($TGT)"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing: $HAP"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$SCHED_FILE" ] || { log "X schedule missing: $SCHED_FILE"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }
stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty (pre-flight)"

# ---- install ----
UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"
OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); log "install: $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 300)"
grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_after: $UPD1"
[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

# ---- app-seeded switch files must exist before hdc can overwrite them ----
SX=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m6q_sched 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
SM7T=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7t 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
SM7TP=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7t_pos 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
SM7R=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7r 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
SM7U=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7u 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
SM7W=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7w 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
SM7X=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7x 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

  SM7U=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7u 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  SM7W=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7w 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  SM7X=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7x 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed check: sched=${SX:-<ABSENT>} smo_m7t=${SM7T:-<ABSENT>} smo_m7t_pos=${SM7TP:-<ABSENT>} smo_m7r=${SM7R:-<ABSENT>} smo_m7u=${SM7U:-<ABSENT>} smo_m7w=${SM7W:-<ABSENT>} smo_m7x=${SM7X:-<ABSENT>}"
  { [ -z "$SX" ] || [ -z "$SM7T" ] || [ -z "$SM7TP" ] || [ -z "$SM7R" ] || [ -z "$SM7U" ] || [ -z "$SM7W" ] || [ -z "$SM7X" ]; } && { log "X switch files still absent"; stopapp; exit 1; }

  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m7u_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m7u_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1

    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"
printf 't\trss_mb\topens\treads\tlast\tframes\tsubmit\tclip_nsvc\tclip_n1c\tclip_n1d\tmain_nsvc\tjobs_by_main\tposter_n1d\n' > "$TSV"
: > "$OUT/probe.raw"
PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; LASTRSSLOG=-100; RN=0; LASTDROP=0
SUB_PREV=0; SUB_T=0; FROZEN_LOGGED=0
MAXTHR=0; OPENFLAG=0; STOPPED_EARLY=0; NF0=$NFT0

  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  RAW=$(h shell "sh /data/local/tmp/m7u_probe.sh" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')

    PROBE_READ=1
    PLINE=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m7x\] probe on|\[m7u\] probe on|\[m7w\] probe on|\[m7t\] aud probe on|\[m7t\] svc8 probe on|\[m7r\] probe on' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -8" | tr -d '\r')

    if [ -z "$PLINE" ]; then log "!! probe switch line absent within 20 s -> stopping (wiring wrong)"; STOPPED_EARLY=1; break; fi
  fi

    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR|has died' | tail -60" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt" | tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
    h shell "tail -n 5 $LOG" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/log_tail_at_death.txt"
    log "last log lines: $(tr '\n' '|' < "$OUT/log_tail_at_death.txt" | tail -c 400)"
    break
  fi
  PID=$(awk '{print $3}' <<<"$STLINE")
  if [ "$PID" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $PID at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$PID"; fi
  RSSKB=$(grep -m1 'VmRSS' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); RSSKB=${RSSKB:-0}
  RSSMB=$(( RSSKB / 1024 ))
  THRO=$(grep -m1 '^THREADS' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); THRO=${THRO:-0}
  NFT=$(grep -m1 '^FAULTLOG' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); NFT=${NFT:-0}
  ST=$(grep -m1 '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW")
  BT=$(grep -m1 '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW")
  FA=$(grep -a '\[fa\]' <<<"$RAW" | tr '\n' '|')
  MV=$(grep -m1 '\[mv\]' <<<"$RAW")
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  RD=$(grep -o 'reads=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); RD=${RD:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  MRCLIP=$(grep -m1 '\[m7r\] clip' <<<"$RAW")
  MRMAIN=$(grep -m1 '\[m7r\] main' <<<"$RAW")
  MRLAST=$(grep -o 'last=\S*' <<<"$MRMAIN" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  CV_=$(grep -o 'nsvc=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRCLIP" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  C1C=$(grep -o 'n1c=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRCLIP" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  C1D=$(grep -o 'n1d=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRCLIP" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  MN=$(grep -o 'nsvc=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRMAIN" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  JB=$(grep -o 'jobs=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRMAIN" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  P1D=$(grep -o 'post1d=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRMAIN" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' \
    "$EL" "$RSSMB" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${MRLAST:-}" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" \
    "${CV_:-}" "${C1C:-}" "${C1D:-}" "${MN:-}" "${JB:-}" "${P1D:-}" >> "$TSV"

  # ---- evidence drop every 100 s ----
  if [ -n "$OP" ] && [ $(( EL / 100 )) -gt "$LASTDROP" ]; then
    LASTDROP=$(( EL / 100 )); drop "$LASTDROP"
  fi

  if [ -n "$OP" ] && [ "$OP" -gt 1245 ] && [ "$OPENFLAG" -eq 0 ]; then
    OPENFLAG=1; log "SIGNAL-1 t=${EL}s opens=$OP > 1245 (new file paths) rss=${RSSMB}MB"
    shot "$EL" "opens$OP"
  fi
  if [ -n "$THRO" ] && [ "$THRO" -gt "$MAXTHR" ]; then MAXTHR=$THRO; fi
  if [ -n "$SUB" ] && [ "$FROZEN_LOGGED" -eq 0 ]; then

    else

    fi
  fi
  if [ "$NFT" -gt "$NF0" ]; then
    log "!! faultlog grew $NF0 -> $NFT at t=${EL}s"; NF0=$NFT
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_${EL}s.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR|has died' | tail -60" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_${EL}s.txt"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$RSSMB" -gt "$RSS_STOP_MB" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=${RSSMB}MB > stop=${RSS_STOP_MB}MB -> stopping before LMK (task rule)"
    STOPPED_EARLY=1; shot "$EL" "tstop"; break
  fi
  if [ $(( EL - LASTRSSLOG )) -ge 16 ]; then
    LASTRSSLOG=$EL; RN=$((RN+1))
    MVDEC=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[mv\] dec#' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')
    MOVC=$(h shell "grep -a -c 'MovieData' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')
    INJ=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[i\] hid inject' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=${RSSMB}MB opens=${OP:-?} reads=${RD:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} frames=${FR:-?} draws=${DW:-?} os_thr=${THRO:-?} movie=${MOVC} mvdec=${MVDEC} inj=${INJ}"
    [ -n "$MRCLIP" ] && log "   ${MRCLIP:0:280}"
    [ -n "$MRMAIN" ] && log "   ${MRMAIN:0:280}"
    [ -n "$FA" ] && log "   fa  $(cut -c1-240 <<<"$FA")"
    [ -n "$MV" ] && log "   mv  $(cut -c1-200 <<<"$MV")"
  fi
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  if [ "$RSSMB" -gt 12000 ]; then sleep 1; else sleep 4; fi
done

shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} stopped_early=${STOPPED_EARLY} maxthr=${MAXTHR}"
CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

log "faultlog_after entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST1" | grep -c .) new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

# ---- pull (twice: the first recv of a live log is often a partial file) ----
for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 4; done
h file recv /data/local/tmp/m6y_samples.txt "$OUT/samples.txt" >/dev/null 2>&1
if [ -f "$OUT/vk_boot.log" ]; then
  DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[m7t\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m7t.txt"; log "[m7t] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m7t.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[m7u\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m7u.txt"; log "[m7u] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m7u.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[m7w\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m7w.txt"; log "[m7w] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m7w.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; log "[m7w] tail: $(tail -1 "$OUT/m7w.txt" | cut -c1-400)"
  grep -a '\[m7x\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m7x.txt"; log "[m7x] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m7x.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; log "[m7x] tail: $(tail -1 "$OUT/m7x.txt" | cut -c1-400)"
  grep -a '\[m7r\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m7r.txt"; log "[m7r] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m7r.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[svc\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/svc.txt"; log "[svc] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/svc.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a 'totk-audio' "$DL" > "$OUT/audio.txt"; log "totk-audio lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/audio.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[st\] t=' "$DL" > "$OUT/st.txt"; log "[st] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/st.txt" | tr -d ' ')"

  log "[st] tail: $(tail -1 "$OUT/st.txt" | cut -c1-400)"

```

`m7y2_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M7X2 (2026-11-08): THE LAST HOP - who is the real worker + who binds +8   (two read-only gates)
#   G1 id 95 main+0x74c9e0 = the 3-instruction slot-3 forwarder thunk M7W2 named on BOTH platforms
#     (0x74c9e0 ldr x8,[x0] / 0x74c9e4 ldr x2,[x8,#0x18] / 0x74c9e8 br x2 / udf)
#     tail=2 single-word gate: only word0 (ldr x8,[x0]) is replaced; 0x74c9e4 and 0x74c9e8 are
#     untouched and read back verbatim every boot. x0 at the gate IS q (the adapter did mov x0,x8),
#     so the observer resolves TWO levels: vt=[q] and tgt3=[[q]+0x18] (plus the literal field
#     [q+0x18] so "one level / two levels" can never be confused) => the real worker gets a name.
#   G2 id 96 main+0x772500 = the descriptor clone (M7W2's write-point candidate A), tail=0 4-word
#     window (word0 'str x19,[sp,#-0x20]!' rewrites sp, so it is replayed after the stub epilogue):
#     0x772500 str x19,[sp,#-0x20]! / stp x29,x30 / add x29,sp,#0x10 / mov x19,x0 / mov w0,#0x28 /
#     bl operator new / [x0]=registry vtbl / ldp 32B from x19 -> stp 32B into the new object.
#     src = entry x0 (the 'mov x19,x0' makes x19 == x0), and the 32B written is exactly src+8..+0x27
#     => this answers "who binds which object into +8".
# usage: bash m7y2_boot_run.sh <tag s1|d1|d2> <target 127.0.0.1:5555|ip:port> [dur=150] [gdump_sec=10]
#   SKIP_INSTALL=1  -> resume a boot without reinstalling
#   UNLOCK_POLL=0   -> skip the unlock poll (emulator)
#   KEEP_AWAKE=1    -> power-shell wakeup every 10 s during the measured boot (device d2 style)
# Never runs `hdc kill` (it would take the other target down). Same switch set on both sides.
# Names: m7y2 / smo_m7y2 / [m7y2] / logs/m7y2_* -- `smo_m7x` + `[m7x]` + `runtime_m7x_poll` +
# m7x_boot_run.sh + /tmp/m7x_report.md + logs/m7x_b1 are the 2026-11-07 round's (ALL occupied),
# and smo_m7w/smo_m7w2 are live baselines => this round is m7y2 (same pattern as m7s2/m7t2/m7u2/m7w2).
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: bash m7y2_boot_run.sh <tag> <target> [dur] [gdump_sec]}"
TGT="${2:?target required (all hdc calls use -t)}"
DUR="${3:-150}"
GD="${4:-10}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m7y2_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
UNLOCK_POLL="${UNLOCK_POLL:-1}"
UNLOCK_MAX="${UNLOCK_MAX:-1200}"        # 20 min cap, per the round rules
KEEP_AWAKE="${KEEP_AWAKE:-0}"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M7X2 tag=$TAG target=$TGT dur=${DUR}s gdump_sec=$GD out=$OUT unlock_poll=$UNLOCK_POLL(<=${UNLOCK_MAX}s) keep_awake=$KEEP_AWAKE"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target $TGT offline"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }

# ---- unlock poll: a successful `aa start` IS the seed start too (the app constructor creates
#      files/smo_m7y2 on first launch). 10106102 means "screen locked" -> do NOT try to unlock,
#      just keep polling every 15 s (M7R/M7S/M7T: 1 probe was enough, three times in a row).
wait_unlock(){
  local n=0 t0=$(date +%s) out
  h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
  while :; do
    n=$((n+1))
    out=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
    local el=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))
    printf '[%s] probe #%d t=%ds %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$n" "$el" "$(echo "$out" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 160)" >> "$OUT/unlock_probe.log"
    case "$out" in
      *10106102*) : ;;                       # locked: keep polling, never try to unlock
      *"start ability successfully"*|*"successfully"*) log "unlock poll: probe #$n OK at t=${el}s (of cap ${UNLOCK_MAX}s)"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 0 ;;
      *) : ;;
    esac
    [ "$el" -ge "$UNLOCK_MAX" ] && { log "X unlock poll: ${UNLOCK_MAX}s cap reached after $n probes (still 10106102) -> BLOCKED"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 1; }
    sleep 15
  done
}

stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"

if [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ]; then
  wait_unlock || { log "X device stays locked; not booting (per round rules: no unlock attempts, no forced retries)"; exit 2; }
  log "after unlock poll: pid=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]') smo_m7y2=[$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7y2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
  sleep 3
  stopapp || { log "X probe pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
fi

if [ "${SKIP_INSTALL:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  log "install SKIPPED (SKIP_INSTALL=1)"
else
  T0=$(date +%s)
  OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); INST_S=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))
  log "install(${INST_S}s): $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
  UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
  log "upd_after: $UPD1"
  [ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"
fi

# ---- seed start (~7-8 s, not counted in the measured boot): hdc cannot CREATE a file in the
#      sandbox, the app constructor seeds smo_m7y2. ----
if [ -z "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7y2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ]; then
  log "seed start: letting the app constructor create smo_m7y2"
  SEEDOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed aa start: $(echo "$SEEDOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  case "$SEEDOUT" in *10106102*) log "X seed aa start blocked: 10106102 (screen locked)"; exit 2;; esac
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  for i in $(seq 1 15); do
    [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7y2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && break
    sleep 2
  done
  log "seed check: smo_m7y2=[$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7y2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
  [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7y2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] || { log "X smo_m7y2 absent after seed"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X seed pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
else
  log "smo_m7y2 already present: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7y2" | tr -d '\r')"
fi

# ---- switches: the cheap cross-round baselines stay 1 (m7q WRAP = 0x7acd18 station, m7s2 = the
#      3 pool-B gates, m7t2 = the 9-head family, m7h keeps M7H_NG=15, **m7u2 = the A/B/C hub gates
#      the name ring v2 hangs on**) + smo_m7w2=1 + smo_m7y2=1 (this round's TWO gates, ids 95/96) ----
for s in smo_m7g smo_m7r smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7n smo_m7p smo_m7q smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7s2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7y2; do
  h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
for s in smo_gpu_write smo_m7a smo_m7b smo_m7s smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7x smo_m7y smo_m7k smo_m7l smo_m7m smo_m7o smo_frz smo_ldrd smo_aud smo_sha_ungated smo_dspool smo_m7d_same; do
  h shell "[ -f $FILES/$s ] && echo 0 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $GD > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
RB=$(for s in smo_m7x2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7v smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7d_same; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
RB="$RB gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"
log "switch readback (pre-boot): $RB"
for s in smo_m7x2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r; do
  V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "1" ] || { log "X $s not 1, abort"; exit 1; }
done

h shell "printf '' > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "log truncated: bytes=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG" | tr -dc '0-9')"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m7y2_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m7y2_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
case "$STARTOUT" in
  *10106102*) log "X boot aa start blocked 10106102 -> re-entering unlock poll"
              [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ] && { wait_unlock || { log "X locked again; BLOCKED"; exit 2; }; sleep 3; stopapp; STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r'); } ;;
esac
log "boot aa start: $(echo "$STARTOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
START=$(date +%s); CURPID=""; PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0; LASTWAKE=0; XT_SAVED=""
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"; printf 't\tframes\tsubmit\topens\tdraws\tstall\tm7q_wrap\th5\th7\ta\tb\tc\tg1_tgt3\tg1_cls\n' > "$TSV"
PLAN="30 120"
GA(){ grep -a "\[m7u2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
G1T(){ grep -a '\[m7y2\] g1 #' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | sed 's/.* tgt3=\[\[q\]+0x18\]=\([^ (]*\).*/\1/'; }
G2S(){ grep -a '\[m7y2\] g1 #' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | sed 's/.* CLS=\([^ ]*\).*/\1/'; }
G1N(){ grep -a '\[m7y2\] sum1 ' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | sed 's/.* ring_n=\([0-9]*\).*/\1/'; }
G2N(){ grep -a '\[m7y2\] sum2 ' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | sed 's/.* ring_n=\([0-9]*\).*/\1/'; }
GH(){ grep -a "\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  if [ "$KEEP_AWAKE" = "1" ] && [ $(( EL - LASTWAKE )) -ge 10 ]; then
    LASTWAKE=$EL; h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  PP=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$PP" ]; then DEADN=$(( ${DEADN:-0} + 1 )); else DEADN=0; fi
  if [ "${DEADN:-0}" -ge 2 ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> - app died during the boot; stopping this run"
    shot "$EL" "tdeath"
    h shell "ls -t /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null | head -3" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    DEATH_T=$EL; break
  fi
  [ -z "$CURPID" ] && { P="$PP"; [ -n "$P" ] && { CURPID=$P; log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; }; }
  RAW=$(h shell "tail -n 3200 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[beat\]|\[st\] t=|\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap|\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=h[57]|\[m7u2\] sum|\[m7y2\] sum1 |\[m7y2\] sum2 |\[m7y2\] g1 #|\[m7y2\] g2 #|\[m7x2\] sum1 |\[m7x2\] g1 #'" | tr -d '\r')
  BT=$(grep -a '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  ST=$(grep -a '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  MQ=$(grep -a '\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  MQW=$(grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' <<<"$MQ" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); MQW=${MQW:-}
  H5=$(GH h5); H7=$(GH h7); A=$(GA a); B=$(GA b); C=$(GA c); XT=$(G1T); RN=$(G2S); RN=${RN:-none}
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${OP:-}" "${DW:-}" "${STALL:-}" "${MQW:-}" "${H5:-}" "${H7:-}" "${A:-}" "${B:-}" "${C:-}" "${XT:-}" "$RN" >> "$TSV"
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 18 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    SL=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m7w2\] probe|\[m7w2\] code|\[m7w2\] ad #|\[m7w2\] sum |\[m7u2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=[abc] ' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -40" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s M7V-READBACK: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$SL")"
    XT_SAVED=$(h shell "grep -a '\[m7w2\] ad #' $LOG 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | sed 's/.* tgt=\([^ ]*\) .*/\1/'" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s X8-TARGET(raw, saved for the rest of the run): ${XT_SAVED:-<none>}"
    GI=$(h shell "grep -a -E 'obs gate main\+0x7724d0' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo NOTINST=$(grep -a -c 'NOT installed' $LOG 2>/dev/null)" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s gate-install lines: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$GI")"
    RB2=$(for s in smo_m7y2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7h; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
    log "t=${EL}s switch readback (in-boot): $RB2"
  fi
  if [ $(( EL % 20 )) -lt 3 ]; then log "t=${EL}s frames=${FR:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?} stall=${STALL:-?} m7q_wrap=${MQW:-?} h5=${H5:-?} h7=${H7:-?} A=${A:-?} B=${B:-?} C=${C:-?} g1_tgt3=${XT_SAVED:-?} g2_src=${RN}"; fi
  for T in $PLAN; do if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi; done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 4
done
shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} death_t=${DEATH_T:-none} dur=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done
DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  for K in st beat m7y2 m7x2 m7w2 m7u2 m7t2 m7s2 m7q gst gates; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  grep -a 'obs gate' "$DL" > "$OUT/gates_install.txt" 2>/dev/null
  log "gate install lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/gates_install.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "m7y2: probe=$(grep -ac '\[m7y2\] probe' "$DL") code1=$(grep -ac '\[m7y2\] code1' "$DL") code2=$(grep -ac '\[m7y2\] code2' "$DL") g1=$(grep -ac '\[m7y2\] g1 #' "$DL") g2=$(grep -ac '\[m7y2\] g2 #' "$DL") sum1=$(grep -ac '\[m7y2\] sum1' "$DL") sum2=$(grep -ac '\[m7y2\] sum2' "$DL") lr=$(grep -ac '\[m7y2\] lr[12]' "$DL") m7w2=$(grep -ac '\[m7w2\]' "$DL")"
  log "m7y2 G1 lines (q/vt/tgt3/CLS=[q+0xb8]): $(grep -a '\[m7y2\] g1 #' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 1800)"
  log "m7y2 G2 lines (src + the 32B written): $(grep -a '\[m7y2\] g2 #' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 1600)"
  log "m7y2 code1: $(grep -a '\[m7y2\] code1' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 700)"
  log "m7y2 code2: $(grep -a '\[m7y2\] code2' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 900)"
  log "m7y2 last sum1/sum2: $(grep -a -E '\[m7y2\] sum[12]' "$DL" | tail -2 | tr '\n' '|')"
  log "m7u2 A/B/C last: $(grep -a '\[m7u2\] sum' "$DL" | tail -3 | sed 's/.*\(g=[a-c]\).*\(tot=[0-9]*\).*/\1 \2/' | tr '\n' '|')"
fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG unlock_probes=${UNLOCK_N:-0}"

```

`m7y_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M7y: ONE 400 s boot -- main's loading-screen loop + who stopped feeding the loader (m7y task 2026-11-07).
# New [m7y] probes (switch smo_m7y, C default 0): guest-PC histogram at svc entry (main full /
# others 1:16) / feeder counts at main+0x61582c + main+0x615cd0 / role-key release tracking
# (0x1B/0x35/0x1D, keys registered dynamically from role 0x1A/1C/34) / main 0x1C individual
# rows + per-key aggregation / 60 s 4-role state dump. smo_m7x=1 kept (ldr/wsrc/sem),
# smo_m7w=1 kept (census/gate/brc), smo_gpu_write=0, M7k~M7o 0, smo_m7t_pos=0 kept.
# Usage: bash m7y_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]
# New [m7t] probes: aud line (audio_renderer.c counters: RequestUpdate callers, returned
# played/consumed, elapsed_frames, event signals) + svc8 line (main 0x1001's top-8 SVCs and
# services per 100 s window). Both behind switch smo_m7t (C default off). The intervention
# lever smo_m7t_pos (monotonic position without real BGM) stays 0 unless POS=1 is passed for
# the second boot. smo_m7r kept ON (opens/clip baseline series); smo_m7s OFF (M7s done).
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: m7u_boot_run.sh <tag> [seconds]}"
DUR="${2:-400}"
POS="${POS:-0}"
RSS_STOP_MB="${RSS_STOP_MB:-12500}"
SCHED_FILE="${SCHED_FILE:-/tmp/m6x_sched.txt}"
KILL_GAP="${KILL_GAP:-99999}"
CFG_VETO="${CFG_VETO:-0}"
CFG_HASHES="${CFG_HASHES:-}"
CFG_COST_THR="${CFG_COST_THR:-0}"
GPU_WRITE="${GPU_WRITE:-0}"
PLAN="${PLAN:-150 250 350}"
GD_SEC="${GD_SEC:-60}"
SYNTH="${SYNTH:-1}"
FRAMES="${FRAMES:-8}"
TESTSTICK="${TESTSTICK:-1 700 2000}"
TESTKEY="${TESTKEY:-1 160 1000 5000 30 38:10,36:20 1}"
MIN_CFGPIPE="${MIN_CFGPIPE:-0}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
TGT="127.0.0.1:5555"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m7y_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }
drop(){  # evidence drop: copy what exists so far (task rule: first <=250 s, then every 100 s)
  mkdir -p "$OUT/evidence_t$1"
  cp -f "$OUT/run.log" "$OUT/series.tsv" "$OUT/probe.raw" "$OUT/evidence_t$1/" 2>/dev/null || true
  log "evidence drop t=$1 (run.log=$(wc -l < "$OUT/run.log" | tr -d ' ')L series=$(wc -l < "$OUT/series.tsv" | tr -d ' ')L)"
}

log "=== M7t tag=$TAG dur=${DUR}s pos=$POS out=$OUT stop=${RSS_STOP_MB}MB sched=$(cat "$SCHED_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING)"
log "TESTKEY=[$TESTKEY] (faithful M5p: start=160s down=1000ms up=5000ms 30 presses 38x10,36x20 nofreeze=1)"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target offline ($TGT)"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing: $HAP"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$SCHED_FILE" ] || { log "X schedule missing: $SCHED_FILE"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }
stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
log "pidof empty (pre-flight)"

UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)

[ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"

# ---- app-seeded switch files must exist before hdc can overwrite them ----
SX=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m6q_sched 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
SM7T=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7t 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

if [ -z "$SX" ] || [ -z "$SM7T" ] || [ -z "$SM7TP" ] || [ -z "$SM7R" ] || [ -z "$SM7U" ] || [ -z "$SM7W" ] || [ -z "$SM7X" ]; then
  log "seed launch needed (sched=[$SX:-absent] smo_m7t=[${SM7T:-absent}] smo_m7t_pos=[${SM7TP:-absent}] smo_m7r=[${SM7R:-absent}] smo_m7u=[${SM7U:-absent}] smo_m7w=[${SM7W:-absent}] smo_m7y=[${SM7X:-absent}])"
  h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  sleep 20
  SX=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m6q_sched 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  SM7T=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7t 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  SM7TP=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7t_pos 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  SM7R=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7r 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  SM7U=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7u 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  SM7W=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7w 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  SM7X=$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7y 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed check: sched=${SX:-<ABSENT>} smo_m7t=${SM7T:-<ABSENT>} smo_m7t_pos=${SM7TP:-<ABSENT>} smo_m7r=${SM7R:-<ABSENT>} smo_m7u=${SM7U:-<ABSENT>} smo_m7w=${SM7W:-<ABSENT>} smo_m7y=${SM7X:-<ABSENT>}"
  { [ -z "$SX" ] || [ -z "$SM7T" ] || [ -z "$SM7TP" ] || [ -z "$SM7R" ] || [ -z "$SM7U" ] || [ -z "$SM7W" ] || [ -z "$SM7X" ]; } && { log "X switch files still absent"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X pid before measured boot"; exit 1; }
else
  log "switch files present: sched ok, smo_m7t ok, smo_m7t_pos ok, smo_m7r ok, smo_m7u ok, smo_m7w ok, smo_m7y ok"

# ---- switches for the measured boot ----
h shell "printf '%s' '$(cat "$SCHED_FILE")' > $FILES/smo_m6q_sched && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1

h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_m7u && echo WROTE" >/dev/null 2>&1

RS=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m6q_sched" | tr -d '\r')

M7TRB=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7t" | tr -d '\r'); M7URB=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7u" | tr -d '\r'); M7WRB=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7w" | tr -d '\r'); M7XRB=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7y" | tr -d '\r')

# ---- our own guards OFF (task rule) ----
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard" >/dev/null 2>&1

# ---- log reset ----
PRE=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG 2>/dev/null || echo 0" | tr -dc '0-9'); PRE=${PRE:-0}

CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

log "sampler started (2 s, device-side)"

# ---- boot ----
h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
START=$(date +%s)
FIRSTPID=""
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$P" ] && { log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; FIRSTPID=$P; break; }
  [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X pid never appeared in 60s"; exit 1; }
  sleep 1
done

h shell "echo $SYNTH > $FILES/smo_movie_synth 2>/dev/null; echo $FRAMES > $FILES/smo_movie_frames 2>/dev/null; echo '$TESTSTICK' > $FILES/smo_teststick 2>/dev/null" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "switches after seed: synth=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_movie_synth" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')] stick=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_teststick" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')] testkey=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_testkey" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')] m7t=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7t" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')] m7t_pos=[$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m7t_pos" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')]"

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m7u_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m7u_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s (wall $(date '+%H:%M:%S'))"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"
printf 't\trss_mb\topens\treads\tlast\tframes\tsubmit\tclip_nsvc\tclip_n1c\tclip_n1d\tmain_nsvc\tjobs_by_main\tposter_n1d\n' > "$TSV"
: > "$OUT/probe.raw"
PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0; CURPID="$FIRSTPID"; LASTRSSLOG=-100; RN=0; LASTDROP=0
SUB_PREV=0; SUB_T=0; FROZEN_LOGGED=0
MAXTHR=0; OPENFLAG=0; STOPPED_EARLY=0; NF0=$NFT0
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  RAW=$(h shell "sh /data/local/tmp/m7u_probe.sh" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')
  # ---- switch readback within 20 s of launch (task rule) ----
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 20 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    PLINE=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m7y\] probe on|\[m7u\] probe on|\[m7w\] probe on|\[m7t\] aud probe on|\[m7t\] svc8 probe on|\[m7r\] probe on' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -8" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s PROBE-READBACK: ${PLINE:-<ABSENT - probe not enabled, ABORT>}"
    if [ -z "$PLINE" ]; then log "!! probe switch line absent within 20 s -> stopping (wiring wrong)"; STOPPED_EARLY=1; break; fi
  fi
  printf '### t=%s\n%s\n' "$EL" "$RAW" >> "$OUT/probe.raw"
  STLINE=$(grep -m1 '^STATE' <<<"$RAW")
  if grep -q '^STATE dead' <<<"$STLINE"; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> (last seen $CURPID)"
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR|has died' | tail -60" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt"
    log "death evidence: faultlog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt" | tr -d ' ') hilog=$(wc -l < "$OUT/hilog_at_death.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
    h shell "tail -n 5 $LOG" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/log_tail_at_death.txt"
    log "last log lines: $(tr '\n' '|' < "$OUT/log_tail_at_death.txt" | tail -c 400)"
    break
  fi
  PID=$(awk '{print $3}' <<<"$STLINE")
  if [ "$PID" != "$CURPID" ]; then log "!! pid changed $CURPID -> $PID at t=${EL}s"; CURPID="$PID"; fi
  RSSKB=$(grep -m1 'VmRSS' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); RSSKB=${RSSKB:-0}
  RSSMB=$(( RSSKB / 1024 ))
  THRO=$(grep -m1 '^THREADS' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); THRO=${THRO:-0}
  NFT=$(grep -m1 '^FAULTLOG' <<<"$RAW" | tr -dc '0-9'); NFT=${NFT:-0}
  ST=$(grep -m1 '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW")
  BT=$(grep -m1 '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW")
  FA=$(grep -a '\[fa\]' <<<"$RAW" | tr '\n' '|')
  MV=$(grep -m1 '\[mv\]' <<<"$RAW")
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  RD=$(grep -o 'reads=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); RD=${RD:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  MRCLIP=$(grep -m1 '\[m7r\] clip' <<<"$RAW")
  MRMAIN=$(grep -m1 '\[m7r\] main' <<<"$RAW")
  MRLAST=$(grep -o 'last=\S*' <<<"$MRMAIN" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  CV_=$(grep -o 'nsvc=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRCLIP" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  C1C=$(grep -o 'n1c=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRCLIP" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  C1D=$(grep -o 'n1d=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRCLIP" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  MN=$(grep -o 'nsvc=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRMAIN" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  JB=$(grep -o 'jobs=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRMAIN" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  P1D=$(grep -o 'post1d=[0-9]*' <<<"$MRMAIN" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' \
    "$EL" "$RSSMB" "${OP:-}" "${RD:-}" "${MRLAST:-}" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" \
    "${CV_:-}" "${C1C:-}" "${C1D:-}" "${MN:-}" "${JB:-}" "${P1D:-}" >> "$TSV"

  # ---- evidence drop every 100 s ----
  if [ -n "$OP" ] && [ $(( EL / 100 )) -gt "$LASTDROP" ]; then
    LASTDROP=$(( EL / 100 )); drop "$LASTDROP"
  fi

  if [ -n "$OP" ] && [ "$OP" -gt 1245 ] && [ "$OPENFLAG" -eq 0 ]; then
    OPENFLAG=1; log "SIGNAL-1 t=${EL}s opens=$OP > 1245 (new file paths) rss=${RSSMB}MB"
    shot "$EL" "opens$OP"
  fi
  if [ -n "$THRO" ] && [ "$THRO" -gt "$MAXTHR" ]; then MAXTHR=$THRO; fi
  if [ -n "$SUB" ] && [ "$FROZEN_LOGGED" -eq 0 ]; then
    if [ "$SUB" -gt "$SUB_PREV" ]; then SUB_PREV=$SUB; SUB_T=$EL
    else
      GAP=$(( EL - SUB_T ))
      if [ "$GAP" -ge 60 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 60 ]; then FROZEN_LOGGED=1; log "FROZEN t=${EL}s submit=$SUB (no growth for ${GAP}s) rss=${RSSMB}MB opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?}"; fi
    fi
  fi
  if [ "$NFT" -gt "$NF0" ]; then
    log "!! faultlog grew $NF0 -> $NFT at t=${EL}s"; NF0=$NFT
    h shell "ls -la /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_${EL}s.txt"
    h shell "hilog -x 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E 'LowMemoryKill|lmkd|SIGSEGV|SIGKILL|watchdog|ANR|has died' | tail -60" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/hilog_at_${EL}s.txt"
    break
  fi
  if [ "$RSSMB" -gt "$RSS_STOP_MB" ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=${RSSMB}MB > stop=${RSS_STOP_MB}MB -> stopping before LMK (task rule)"
    STOPPED_EARLY=1; shot "$EL" "tstop"; break
  fi
  if [ $(( EL - LASTRSSLOG )) -ge 16 ]; then
    LASTRSSLOG=$EL; RN=$((RN+1))
    MVDEC=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[mv\] dec#' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')
    MOVC=$(h shell "grep -a -c 'MovieData' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')
    INJ=$(h shell "grep -a -c '\[i\] hid inject' $LOG 2>/dev/null" | tr -dc '0-9')
    log "t=${EL}s RSS=${RSSMB}MB opens=${OP:-?} reads=${RD:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} frames=${FR:-?} draws=${DW:-?} os_thr=${THRO:-?} movie=${MOVC} mvdec=${MVDEC} inj=${INJ}"
    [ -n "$MRCLIP" ] && log "   ${MRCLIP:0:280}"
    [ -n "$MRMAIN" ] && log "   ${MRMAIN:0:280}"
    [ -n "$FA" ] && log "   fa  $(cut -c1-240 <<<"$FA")"
    [ -n "$MV" ] && log "   mv  $(cut -c1-200 <<<"$MV")"
  fi
  for T in $PLAN; do
    if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi
  done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  if [ "$RSSMB" -gt 12000 ]; then sleep 1; else sleep 4; fi
done

shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} stopped_early=${STOPPED_EARLY} maxthr=${MAXTHR}"
CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog_after entries=$(printf '%s' "$CFLIST1" | grep -c .) new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

# ---- pull (twice: the first recv of a live log is often a partial file) ----
for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 4; done
h file recv /data/local/tmp/m6y_samples.txt "$OUT/samples.txt" >/dev/null 2>&1
if [ -f "$OUT/vk_boot.log" ]; then
  DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[m7t\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m7t.txt"; log "[m7t] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m7t.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[m7u\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m7u.txt"; log "[m7u] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m7u.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[m7w\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m7w.txt"; log "[m7w] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m7w.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; log "[m7w] tail: $(tail -1 "$OUT/m7w.txt" | cut -c1-400)"
  grep -a '\[m7x\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m7x.txt"; log "[m7x] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m7x.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[m7y\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m7y.txt"; log "[m7y] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m7y.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; log "[m7y] tail: $(tail -1 "$OUT/m7y.txt" | cut -c1-400)"
  grep -a '\[m7r\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m7r.txt"; log "[m7r] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m7r.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[svc\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/svc.txt"; log "[svc] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/svc.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a 'totk-audio' "$DL" > "$OUT/audio.txt"; log "totk-audio lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/audio.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[st\] t=' "$DL" > "$OUT/st.txt"; log "[st] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/st.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a '\[i\] hid' "$DL" > "$OUT/inj.txt"; log "[i] inj lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/inj.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  grep -a 'MovieData' "$DL" > "$OUT/movie.txt"; log "MovieData lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/movie.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "[m7t] tail: $(tail -1 "$OUT/m7t.txt" | cut -c1-400)"
  log "[m7u] tail: $(tail -1 "$OUT/m7u.txt" | cut -c1-500)"
  log "[st] tail: $(tail -1 "$OUT/st.txt" | cut -c1-400)"
  log "[m7r] main tail: $(grep -a '\[m7r\] main' "$DL" | tail -1 | cut -c1-300)"
else log "X vk_boot.log pull failed"; fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG"
```

`m7z2_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M7Z2 (2026-11-08): THE BRANCH AT THE SELECTION POINT - [this+0x58] and 0x6c7d30(this,0x21c)
#   (five read-only gates; cbnz itself cannot be a gate, so every gate sits on one of its targets)
#   G1 id 99  main+0x6c7d30 = the predicate called at 0x4b8e90. Offline it is a GENERIC
#     "state_time <= N" helper: state machine = [[this] -> slot0], +0x18 = how many steps the
#     current nerve has run (0x6c7750 resets it to -1 on every nerve switch), cset w0,le.
#     It has 114 call sites and 8 siblings (eq/ne/lt/le/gt/ge/range/mod) => 0x21c (540) is a
#     FRAME THRESHOLD (~9 s @60 Hz), not an enum. tail=0 4-word window.
#   G2 id 100 main+0x4b8e98 = the SKIP path (ldp x29,x30,[sp,#0x10]); tail=2 single word.
#     LR tells the arrival: 0x4b8e94 = the query returned 1, 0x4b8e7c/0x4b8e70 = earlier tbz.
#   G3 id 101 main+0x4b8ea4 = the WORK path (calls [this+0x20]->slot+0x20 then b 0x6c7b20 to
#     HostTypeNrvFirstSequence); LR=0x4b8e94 => let through by the query, else by cbnz. tail=0.
#   G4 id 102 main+0x4b8e88 = the cbnz-not-taken site; x8 there is [this+0x58] as a raw byte
#     (reached only while the flag is 0). tail=2 single word.
#   G5 id 103 main+0x4b8e20 = HostTypeNrvLoadFirstSequence::execute entry; x0 IS the HostType,
#     so the observer reads [this] / [[this]] / [this+0x58] / [this+0x20] / [this+0x60]. tail=0.
#   Verdict rule: G2 nonzero + G3 zero => the device was stopped by the branch; then G4/G5 say
#   whether [this+0x58] was 0 and G2's LR says whether the query returned 1.
#   G1 id 95 main+0x74c9e0 = the 3-instruction slot-3 forwarder thunk M7W2 named on BOTH platforms
#     (0x74c9e0 ldr x8,[x0] / 0x74c9e4 ldr x2,[x8,#0x18] / 0x74c9e8 br x2 / udf)
#     tail=2 single-word gate: only word0 (ldr x8,[x0]) is replaced; 0x74c9e4 and 0x74c9e8 are
#     untouched and read back verbatim every boot. x0 at the gate IS q (the adapter did mov x0,x8),
#     so the observer resolves TWO levels: vt=[q] and tgt3=[[q]+0x18] (plus the literal field
#     [q+0x18] so "one level / two levels" can never be confused) => the real worker gets a name.
#   G2 id 96 main+0x772500 = the descriptor clone (M7W2's write-point candidate A), tail=0 4-word
#     window (word0 'str x19,[sp,#-0x20]!' rewrites sp, so it is replayed after the stub epilogue):
#     0x772500 str x19,[sp,#-0x20]! / stp x29,x30 / add x29,sp,#0x10 / mov x19,x0 / mov w0,#0x28 /
#     bl operator new / [x0]=registry vtbl / ldp 32B from x19 -> stp 32B into the new object.
#     src = entry x0 (the 'mov x19,x0' makes x19 == x0), and the 32B written is exactly src+8..+0x27
#     => this answers "who binds which object into +8".
# usage: bash m7z2_boot_run.sh <tag s1|d1|d2> <target 127.0.0.1:5555|ip:port> [dur=150] [gdump_sec=10]
#   SKIP_INSTALL=1  -> resume a boot without reinstalling
#   UNLOCK_POLL=0   -> skip the unlock poll (emulator)
#   KEEP_AWAKE=1    -> power-shell wakeup every 10 s during the measured boot (device d2 style)
# Never runs `hdc kill` (it would take the other target down). Same switch set on both sides.
# Names: m7z2 / smo_m7z2 / [m7z2] / logs/m7z2_* -- `[m7z]` is LIVE code in platform/threads.c
# (the 2026-11-07 round's m7z probe: 11 logf sites) and the repo-root m7f_boot_run.sh greps for it,
# so the five-name check hits => this round is m7z2 (same pattern as m7s2..m7y2).
# Baseline switches: unchanged from M7Y2 (smo_m7y2 stays 1), only smo_m7z2 is new.
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: bash m7z2_boot_run.sh <tag> <target> [dur] [gdump_sec]}"
TGT="${2:?target required (all hdc calls use -t)}"
DUR="${3:-150}"
GD="${4:-10}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m7z2_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
UNLOCK_POLL="${UNLOCK_POLL:-1}"
UNLOCK_MAX="${UNLOCK_MAX:-1200}"        # 20 min cap, per the round rules
KEEP_AWAKE="${KEEP_AWAKE:-0}"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M7Z2 tag=$TAG target=$TGT dur=${DUR}s gdump_sec=$GD out=$OUT unlock_poll=$UNLOCK_POLL(<=${UNLOCK_MAX}s) keep_awake=$KEEP_AWAKE"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target $TGT offline"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }

# ---- unlock poll: a successful `aa start` IS the seed start too (the app constructor creates
#      files/smo_m7z2 on first launch). 10106102 means "screen locked" -> do NOT try to unlock,
#      just keep polling every 15 s (M7R/M7S/M7T: 1 probe was enough, three times in a row).
wait_unlock(){
  local n=0 t0=$(date +%s) out
  h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
  while :; do
    n=$((n+1))
    out=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
    local el=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))
    printf '[%s] probe #%d t=%ds %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$n" "$el" "$(echo "$out" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 160)" >> "$OUT/unlock_probe.log"
    case "$out" in
      *10106102*) : ;;                       # locked: keep polling, never try to unlock
      *"start ability successfully"*|*"successfully"*) log "unlock poll: probe #$n OK at t=${el}s (of cap ${UNLOCK_MAX}s)"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 0 ;;
      *) : ;;
    esac
    [ "$el" -ge "$UNLOCK_MAX" ] && { log "X unlock poll: ${UNLOCK_MAX}s cap reached after $n probes (still 10106102) -> BLOCKED"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 1; }
    sleep 15
  done
}

stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"

if [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ]; then
  wait_unlock || { log "X device stays locked; not booting (per round rules: no unlock attempts, no forced retries)"; exit 2; }
  log "after unlock poll: pid=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]') smo_m7z2=[$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
  sleep 3
  stopapp || { log "X probe pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
fi

if [ "${SKIP_INSTALL:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  log "install SKIPPED (SKIP_INSTALL=1)"
else
  T0=$(date +%s)
  OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); INST_S=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))
  log "install(${INST_S}s): $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
  UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
  log "upd_after: $UPD1"
  [ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"
fi

# ---- seed start (~7-8 s, not counted in the measured boot): hdc cannot CREATE a file in the
#      sandbox, the app constructor seeds smo_m7z2. ----
if [ -z "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ]; then
  log "seed start: letting the app constructor create smo_m7z2"
  SEEDOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed aa start: $(echo "$SEEDOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  case "$SEEDOUT" in *10106102*) log "X seed aa start blocked: 10106102 (screen locked)"; exit 2;; esac
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  for i in $(seq 1 15); do
    [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && break
    sleep 2
  done
  log "seed check: smo_m7z2=[$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
  [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] || { log "X smo_m7z2 absent after seed"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X seed pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
else
  log "smo_m7z2 already present: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7z2" | tr -d '\r')"
fi

# ---- switches: the cheap cross-round baselines stay 1 (m7q WRAP = 0x7acd18 station, m7s2 = the
#      3 pool-B gates, m7t2 = the 9-head family, m7h keeps M7H_NG=15, **m7u2 = the A/B/C hub gates
#      the name ring v2 hangs on**) + smo_m7w2=1 + smo_m7z2=1 (this round's TWO gates, ids 95/96) ----
for s in smo_m7g smo_m7r smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7n smo_m7p smo_m7q smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7s2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7z2; do
  h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
for s in smo_gpu_write smo_m7a smo_m7b smo_m7s smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7x smo_m7y smo_m7k smo_m7l smo_m7m smo_m7o smo_frz smo_ldrd smo_aud smo_sha_ungated smo_dspool smo_m7d_same; do
  h shell "[ -f $FILES/$s ] && echo 0 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $GD > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
RB=$(for s in smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7v smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7d_same; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
RB="$RB gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"
log "switch readback (pre-boot): $RB"
for s in smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r; do
  V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "1" ] || { log "X $s not 1, abort"; exit 1; }
done

h shell "printf '' > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "log truncated: bytes=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG" | tr -dc '0-9')"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m7z2_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m7z2_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
case "$STARTOUT" in
  *10106102*) log "X boot aa start blocked 10106102 -> re-entering unlock poll"
              [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ] && { wait_unlock || { log "X locked again; BLOCKED"; exit 2; }; sleep 3; stopapp; STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r'); } ;;
esac
log "boot aa start: $(echo "$STARTOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
START=$(date +%s); CURPID=""; PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0; LASTWAKE=0; XT_SAVED=""
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"; printf 't\tframes\tsubmit\topens\tdraws\tstall\tm7q_wrap\th5\th7\tg1_site\tg2_hits\tg3_hits\tg4_x8\tg5_x58\n' > "$TSV"
PLAN="30 120"
GA(){ grep -a "\[m7u2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
SU(){ grep -a "\[m7z2\] sum$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1; }
F1(){ SU 1 | grep -o 'site_hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F2(){ SU 2 | grep -o ' hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F3(){ SU 3 | grep -o ' hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F4(){ SU 4 | grep -o 'last_x8=[^ ]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F5(){ SU 5 | grep -o 'last_c=[^ ]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
GH(){ grep -a "\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  if [ "$KEEP_AWAKE" = "1" ] && [ $(( EL - LASTWAKE )) -ge 10 ]; then
```
