```sh
    LASTWAKE=$EL; h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  PP=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$PP" ]; then DEADN=$(( ${DEADN:-0} + 1 )); else DEADN=0; fi
  if [ "${DEADN:-0}" -ge 2 ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> - app died during the boot; stopping this run"
    shot "$EL" "tdeath"
    h shell "ls -t /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null | head -3" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    DEATH_T=$EL; break
  fi
  [ -z "$CURPID" ] && { P="$PP"; [ -n "$P" ] && { CURPID=$P; log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; }; }
  RAW=$(h shell "tail -n 4000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[beat\]|\[st\] t=|\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap|\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=h[57]|\[m7z2\] sum[1-5] |\[m7z2\] lr[1-5] |\[m7z2\] g[1-5] '" | tr -d '\r')
  BT=$(grep -a '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  ST=$(grep -a '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  MQ=$(grep -a '\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  MQW=$(grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' <<<"$MQ" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); MQW=${MQW:-}
  H5=$(GH h5); H7=$(GH h7); A=$(F1); B=$(F2); C=$(F3); XT=$(F4); RN=$(F5)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${OP:-}" "${DW:-}" "${STALL:-}" "${MQW:-}" "${H5:-}" "${H7:-}" "${A:-}" "${B:-}" "${C:-}" "${XT:-}" "${RN:-}" >> "$TSV"
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 18 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    SL=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m7z2\] probe|\[m7z2\] code|\[m7z2\] sum[1-5] ' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -24" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s M7Z2-READBACK: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$SL")"
    GI=$(h shell "grep -a -E 'obs gate main\+0x(6c7d30|4b8e98|4b8ea4|4b8e88|4b8e20)' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -8; echo NOTINST=$(grep -a -c 'NOT installed' $LOG 2>/dev/null)" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s gate-install lines: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$GI")"
    RB2=$(for s in smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7h; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
    log "t=${EL}s switch readback (in-boot): $RB2"
  fi
  if [ $(( EL % 20 )) -lt 3 ]; then log "t=${EL}s frames=${FR:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?} stall=${STALL:-?} m7q_wrap=${MQW:-?} h5=${H5:-?} h7=${H7:-?} g1_site=${A:-?} g2_hits=${B:-?} g3_hits=${C:-?} g4_x8=${XT:-?} g5_x58=${RN:-?}"; fi
  for T in $PLAN; do if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi; done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 4
done
shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} death_t=${DEATH_T:-none} dur=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done
DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  for K in st beat m7y2 m7x2 m7w2 m7u2 m7t2 m7s2 m7q gst gates; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  grep -a 'obs gate' "$DL" > "$OUT/gates_install.txt" 2>/dev/null
  log "gate install lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/gates_install.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "m7z2: probe=$(grep -ac '\[m7z2\] probe' "$DL") code=$(grep -ac '\[m7z2\] code' "$DL") sum=$(grep -ac '\[m7z2\] sum' "$DL") lr=$(grep -ac '\[m7z2\] lr' "$DL") ring=$(grep -ac '\[m7z2\] g[1-5] t=' "$DL") m7y2=$(grep -ac '\[m7y2\]' "$DL")"
  for g in 1 2 3 4 5; do log "m7z2 sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m7z2\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  log "m7z2 code lines: $(grep -a '\[m7z2\] code' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 2200)"
  log "m7z2 lr lines (last 12): $(grep -a '\[m7z2\] lr' "$DL" | tail -12 | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 2400)"
  log "m7z2 ring lines (last 12): $(grep -a '\[m7z2\] g[1-5] t=' "$DL" | tail -12 | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 2400)"
fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG unlock_probes=${UNLOCK_N:-0}"

```

`m8a_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# M8A (2026-11-08): THE BRANCH AT THE SELECTION POINT - [this+0x58] and 0x6c7d30(this,0x21c)
#   (five read-only gates; cbnz itself cannot be a gate, so every gate sits on one of its targets)
#   G1 id 99  main+0x6c7d30 = the predicate called at 0x4b8e90. Offline it is a GENERIC
#     "state_time <= N" helper: state machine = [[this] -> slot0], +0x18 = how many steps the
#     current nerve has run (0x6c7750 resets it to -1 on every nerve switch), cset w0,le.
#     It has 114 call sites and 8 siblings (eq/ne/lt/le/gt/ge/range/mod) => 0x21c (540) is a
#     FRAME THRESHOLD (~9 s @60 Hz), not an enum. tail=0 4-word window.
#   G2 id 100 main+0x4b8e98 = the SKIP path (ldp x29,x30,[sp,#0x10]); tail=2 single word.
#     LR tells the arrival: 0x4b8e94 = the query returned 1, 0x4b8e7c/0x4b8e70 = earlier tbz.
#   G3 id 101 main+0x4b8ea4 = the WORK path (calls [this+0x20]->slot+0x20 then b 0x6c7b20 to
#     HostTypeNrvFirstSequence); LR=0x4b8e94 => let through by the query, else by cbnz. tail=0.
#   G4 id 102 main+0x4b8e88 = the cbnz-not-taken site; x8 there is [this+0x58] as a raw byte
#     (reached only while the flag is 0). tail=2 single word.
#   G5 id 103 main+0x4b8e20 = HostTypeNrvLoadFirstSequence::execute entry; x0 IS the HostType,
#     so the observer reads [this] / [[this]] / [this+0x58] / [this+0x20] / [this+0x60]. tail=0.
#   Verdict rule: G2 nonzero + G3 zero => the device was stopped by the branch; then G4/G5 say
#   whether [this+0x58] was 0 and G2's LR says whether the query returned 1.
#   G1 id 95 main+0x74c9e0 = the 3-instruction slot-3 forwarder thunk M7W2 named on BOTH platforms
#     (0x74c9e0 ldr x8,[x0] / 0x74c9e4 ldr x2,[x8,#0x18] / 0x74c9e8 br x2 / udf)
#     tail=2 single-word gate: only word0 (ldr x8,[x0]) is replaced; 0x74c9e4 and 0x74c9e8 are
#     untouched and read back verbatim every boot. x0 at the gate IS q (the adapter did mov x0,x8),
#     so the observer resolves TWO levels: vt=[q] and tgt3=[[q]+0x18] (plus the literal field
#     [q+0x18] so "one level / two levels" can never be confused) => the real worker gets a name.
#   G2 id 96 main+0x772500 = the descriptor clone (M7W2's write-point candidate A), tail=0 4-word
#     window (word0 'str x19,[sp,#-0x20]!' rewrites sp, so it is replayed after the stub epilogue):
#     0x772500 str x19,[sp,#-0x20]! / stp x29,x30 / add x29,sp,#0x10 / mov x19,x0 / mov w0,#0x28 /
#     bl operator new / [x0]=registry vtbl / ldp 32B from x19 -> stp 32B into the new object.
#     src = entry x0 (the 'mov x19,x0' makes x19 == x0), and the 32B written is exactly src+8..+0x27
#     => this answers "who binds which object into +8".
# usage: bash m8a_boot_run.sh <tag s1|d1|d2> <target 127.0.0.1:5555|ip:port> [dur=150] [gdump_sec=10]
#   SKIP_INSTALL=1  -> resume a boot without reinstalling
#   UNLOCK_POLL=0   -> skip the unlock poll (emulator)
#   KEEP_AWAKE=1    -> power-shell wakeup every 10 s during the measured boot (device d2 style)
# Never runs `hdc kill` (it would take the other target down). Same switch set on both sides.
# Names: m7z2 / smo_m7z2 / [m7z2] / logs/m8a_* -- `[m7z]` is LIVE code in platform/threads.c
# (the 2026-11-07 round's m7z probe: 11 logf sites) and the repo-root m7f_boot_run.sh greps for it,
# so the five-name check hits => this round is m7z2 (same pattern as m7s2..m7y2).
# Baseline switches: unchanged from M7Y2 (smo_m7y2 stays 1), only smo_m7z2 is new.
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: bash m8a_boot_run.sh <tag> <target> [dur] [gdump_sec]}"
TGT="${2:?target required (all hdc calls use -t)}"
DUR="${3:-150}"
GD="${4:-10}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m8a_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
UNLOCK_POLL="${UNLOCK_POLL:-1}"
UNLOCK_MAX="${UNLOCK_MAX:-1200}"        # 20 min cap, per the round rules
KEEP_AWAKE="${KEEP_AWAKE:-0}"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M8A tag=$TAG target=$TGT dur=${DUR}s gdump_sec=$GD out=$OUT unlock_poll=$UNLOCK_POLL(<=${UNLOCK_MAX}s) keep_awake=$KEEP_AWAKE"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target $TGT offline"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }

# ---- unlock poll: a successful `aa start` IS the seed start too (the app constructor creates
#      files/smo_m7z2 on first launch). 10106102 means "screen locked" -> do NOT try to unlock,
#      just keep polling every 15 s (M7R/M7S/M7T: 1 probe was enough, three times in a row).
wait_unlock(){
  local n=0 t0=$(date +%s) out
  h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
  while :; do
    n=$((n+1))
    out=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
    local el=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))
    printf '[%s] probe #%d t=%ds %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$n" "$el" "$(echo "$out" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 160)" >> "$OUT/unlock_probe.log"
    case "$out" in
      *10106102*) : ;;                       # locked: keep polling, never try to unlock
      *"start ability successfully"*|*"successfully"*) log "unlock poll: probe #$n OK at t=${el}s (of cap ${UNLOCK_MAX}s)"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 0 ;;
      *) : ;;
    esac
    [ "$el" -ge "$UNLOCK_MAX" ] && { log "X unlock poll: ${UNLOCK_MAX}s cap reached after $n probes (still 10106102) -> BLOCKED"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 1; }
    sleep 15
  done
}

stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"

if [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ]; then
  wait_unlock || { log "X device stays locked; not booting (per round rules: no unlock attempts, no forced retries)"; exit 2; }
  log "after unlock poll: pid=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]') smo_m7z2=[$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
  sleep 3
  stopapp || { log "X probe pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
fi

if [ "${SKIP_INSTALL:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  log "install SKIPPED (SKIP_INSTALL=1)"
else
  T0=$(date +%s)
  OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); INST_S=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))
  log "install(${INST_S}s): $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
  UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
  log "upd_after: $UPD1"
  [ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"
fi

# ---- seed start (~7-8 s, not counted in the measured boot): hdc cannot CREATE a file in the
#      sandbox, the app constructor seeds smo_m7z2. ----
if [ -z "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ]; then
  log "seed start: letting the app constructor create smo_m7z2"
  SEEDOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed aa start: $(echo "$SEEDOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  case "$SEEDOUT" in *10106102*) log "X seed aa start blocked: 10106102 (screen locked)"; exit 2;; esac
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  for i in $(seq 1 15); do
    [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && break
    sleep 2
  done
  log "seed check: smo_m7z2=[$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
  [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] || { log "X smo_m7z2 absent after seed"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X seed pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
else
  log "smo_m7z2 already present: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7z2" | tr -d '\r')"
fi

# ---- switches: the cheap cross-round baselines stay 1 (m7q WRAP = 0x7acd18 station, m7s2 = the
#      3 pool-B gates, m7t2 = the 9-head family, m7h keeps M7H_NG=15, **m7u2 = the A/B/C hub gates
#      the name ring v2 hangs on**) + smo_m7w2=1 + smo_m7z2=1 (this round's TWO gates, ids 95/96) ----
for s in smo_m7g smo_m7r smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7n smo_m7p smo_m7q smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7s2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7z2; do
  h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
for s in smo_gpu_write smo_m7a smo_m7b smo_m7s smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7x smo_m7y smo_m7k smo_m7l smo_m7m smo_m7o smo_frz smo_ldrd smo_aud smo_sha_ungated smo_dspool smo_m7d_same; do
  h shell "[ -f $FILES/$s ] && echo 0 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $GD > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
RB=$(for s in smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7v smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7d_same; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
RB="$RB gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"
log "switch readback (pre-boot): $RB"
for s in smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r; do
  V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "1" ] || { log "X $s not 1, abort"; exit 1; }
done

h shell "printf '' > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "log truncated: bytes=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG" | tr -dc '0-9')"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m8a_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m8a_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
case "$STARTOUT" in
  *10106102*) log "X boot aa start blocked 10106102 -> re-entering unlock poll"
              [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ] && { wait_unlock || { log "X locked again; BLOCKED"; exit 2; }; sleep 3; stopapp; STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r'); } ;;
esac
log "boot aa start: $(echo "$STARTOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
START=$(date +%s); CURPID=""; PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0; LASTWAKE=0; XT_SAVED=""
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"; printf 't\tframes\tsubmit\topens\tdraws\tstall\tm7q_wrap\th5\th7\tg1_site\tg2_hits\tg3_hits\tg4_x8\tg5_x58\n' > "$TSV"
PLAN="30 120"
GA(){ grep -a "\[m7u2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
SU(){ grep -a "\[m7z2\] sum$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1; }
F1(){ SU 1 | grep -o 'site_hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F2(){ SU 2 | grep -o ' hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F3(){ SU 3 | grep -o ' hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F4(){ SU 4 | grep -o 'last_x8=[^ ]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F5(){ SU 5 | grep -o 'last_c=[^ ]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
GH(){ grep -a "\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  if [ "$KEEP_AWAKE" = "1" ] && [ $(( EL - LASTWAKE )) -ge 10 ]; then
    LASTWAKE=$EL; h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  PP=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$PP" ]; then DEADN=$(( ${DEADN:-0} + 1 )); else DEADN=0; fi
  if [ "${DEADN:-0}" -ge 2 ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> - app died during the boot; stopping this run"
    shot "$EL" "tdeath"
    h shell "ls -t /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null | head -3" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    DEATH_T=$EL; break
  fi
  [ -z "$CURPID" ] && { P="$PP"; [ -n "$P" ] && { CURPID=$P; log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; }; }
  RAW=$(h shell "tail -n 4000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[beat\]|\[st\] t=|\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap|\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=h[57]|\[m7z2\] sum[1-5] |\[m7z2\] lr[1-5] |\[m7z2\] g[1-5] '" | tr -d '\r')
  BT=$(grep -a '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  ST=$(grep -a '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  MQ=$(grep -a '\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  MQW=$(grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' <<<"$MQ" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); MQW=${MQW:-}
  H5=$(GH h5); H7=$(GH h7); A=$(F1); B=$(F2); C=$(F3); XT=$(F4); RN=$(F5)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${OP:-}" "${DW:-}" "${STALL:-}" "${MQW:-}" "${H5:-}" "${H7:-}" "${A:-}" "${B:-}" "${C:-}" "${XT:-}" "${RN:-}" >> "$TSV"
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 18 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    SL=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m7z2\] probe|\[m7z2\] code|\[m7z2\] sum[1-5] ' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -24" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s M8A-READBACK: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$SL")"
    GI=$(h shell "grep -a -E 'obs gate main\+0x(6c7d30|4b8e98|4b8ea4|4b8e88|4b8e20)' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -8; echo NOTINST=$(grep -a -c 'NOT installed' $LOG 2>/dev/null)" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s gate-install lines: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$GI")"
    RB2=$(for s in smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7h; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
    log "t=${EL}s switch readback (in-boot): $RB2"
  fi
  if [ $(( EL % 20 )) -lt 3 ]; then log "t=${EL}s frames=${FR:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?} stall=${STALL:-?} m7q_wrap=${MQW:-?} h5=${H5:-?} h7=${H7:-?} g1_site=${A:-?} g2_hits=${B:-?} g3_hits=${C:-?} g4_x8=${XT:-?} g5_x58=${RN:-?}"; fi
  for T in $PLAN; do if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi; done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 4
done
shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} death_t=${DEATH_T:-none} dur=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done
DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  for K in st beat m7y2 m7x2 m7w2 m7u2 m7t2 m7s2 m7q gst gates; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  grep -a 'obs gate' "$DL" > "$OUT/gates_install.txt" 2>/dev/null
  log "gate install lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/gates_install.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "m7z2: probe=$(grep -ac '\[m7z2\] probe' "$DL") code=$(grep -ac '\[m7z2\] code' "$DL") sum=$(grep -ac '\[m7z2\] sum' "$DL") lr=$(grep -ac '\[m7z2\] lr' "$DL") ring=$(grep -ac '\[m7z2\] g[1-5] t=' "$DL") m7y2=$(grep -ac '\[m7y2\]' "$DL")"
  for g in 1 2 3 4 5; do log "m7z2 sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m7z2\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  log "m7z2 code lines: $(grep -a '\[m7z2\] code' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 2200)"
  log "m7z2 lr lines (last 12): $(grep -a '\[m7z2\] lr' "$DL" | tail -12 | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 2400)"
  log "m7z2 ring lines (last 12): $(grep -a '\[m7z2\] g[1-5] t=' "$DL" | tail -12 | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 2400)"
fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG unlock_probes=${UNLOCK_N:-0}"

```

`m8b_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
# M8B (2026-11-08): THE NERVE STATE MACHINE (simulator only; no device in the loop).
#   M8A proved 0x4b8e84 / 0x4b8e20 are DEAD CODE on the simulator (gate 5 = 0 hits in 92 s), so the
#   real fork is "which nerve the sequence object currently holds". Its ONE write point is
#   main+0x6c7750 (NerveKeeper::setNerve: [keeper+0x10] = nerve token, [keeper+0x18] = -1).
#   G1 id 104 main+0x6c7750 tail=0 4-word window: per event log x1 (new token), [keeper+0x10] (old
#     token), [keeper+0x18] (old step), LR, tick, plus the nerve NAME read at token+0x10 (SMO nerve
#     objects keep their Itanium type name at +0x20 of the object base; token = base+0x10).
#     First-128 event ring (claim-once, never overwritten) + last-16 rotating ring + 40-slot per-token
#     count table + 16-slot per-LR table => the whole nerve timeline, named.
#   G2 id 105 main+0x4b8d30 (HostTypeNrvBoot::execute entry, the single `b` from exec thunk 0x4b93a0)
#     tail=0 4-word window: count + LR table only => how much the host state machine runs.
#   NOT gated: 0x4b8e84 / 0x4b8e98 / 0x4b8ea4 / 0x4b8e20 (M8A: dead on the simulator) and 0x4b8d20.
# usage: bash m8b_boot_run.sh <tag s1> <target 127.0.0.1:5555> [dur=150] [gdump_sec=10]
#   SKIP_INSTALL=1  -> resume a boot without reinstalling
#   UNLOCK_POLL=0   -> skip the unlock poll (emulator)
#   KEEP_AWAKE=1    -> power-shell wakeup every 10 s during the measured boot (device style)
# Never runs `hdc kill` (it would take the other target down). Same switch set as M8A + smo_m8b.
# Names: m8b / smo_m8b / [m8b] / logs/m8b_* -- the five-name check was all-clear on 2026-11-08.
# Baseline switches: byte-identical to M8A (smo_m7z2 .. smo_m7r all stay 1), only smo_m8b is new.
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: bash m8b_boot_run.sh <tag> <target> [dur] [gdump_sec]}"
TGT="${2:?target required (all hdc calls use -t)}"
DUR="${3:-150}"
GD="${4:-10}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m8b_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
UNLOCK_POLL="${UNLOCK_POLL:-1}"
UNLOCK_MAX="${UNLOCK_MAX:-1200}"        # 20 min cap, per the round rules
KEEP_AWAKE="${KEEP_AWAKE:-0}"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M8A tag=$TAG target=$TGT dur=${DUR}s gdump_sec=$GD out=$OUT unlock_poll=$UNLOCK_POLL(<=${UNLOCK_MAX}s) keep_awake=$KEEP_AWAKE"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target $TGT offline"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }

# ---- unlock poll: a successful `aa start` IS the seed start too (the app constructor creates
#      files/smo_m7z2 on first launch). 10106102 means "screen locked" -> do NOT try to unlock,
#      just keep polling every 15 s (M7R/M7S/M7T: 1 probe was enough, three times in a row).
wait_unlock(){
  local n=0 t0=$(date +%s) out
  h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
  while :; do
    n=$((n+1))
    out=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
    local el=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))
    printf '[%s] probe #%d t=%ds %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$n" "$el" "$(echo "$out" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 160)" >> "$OUT/unlock_probe.log"
    case "$out" in
      *10106102*) : ;;                       # locked: keep polling, never try to unlock
      *"start ability successfully"*|*"successfully"*) log "unlock poll: probe #$n OK at t=${el}s (of cap ${UNLOCK_MAX}s)"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 0 ;;
      *) : ;;
    esac
    [ "$el" -ge "$UNLOCK_MAX" ] && { log "X unlock poll: ${UNLOCK_MAX}s cap reached after $n probes (still 10106102) -> BLOCKED"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 1; }
    sleep 15
  done
}

stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"

if [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ]; then
  wait_unlock || { log "X device stays locked; not booting (per round rules: no unlock attempts, no forced retries)"; exit 2; }
  log "after unlock poll: pid=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]') smo_m7z2=[$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
  sleep 3
  stopapp || { log "X probe pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
fi

if [ "${SKIP_INSTALL:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  log "install SKIPPED (SKIP_INSTALL=1)"
else
  T0=$(date +%s)
  OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); INST_S=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))
  log "install(${INST_S}s): $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
  UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
  log "upd_after: $UPD1"
  [ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"
fi

# ---- seed start (~7-8 s, not counted in the measured boot): hdc cannot CREATE a file in the
#      sandbox, the app constructor seeds smo_m7z2. ----
if [ -z "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ]; then
  log "seed start: letting the app constructor create smo_m7z2"
  SEEDOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed aa start: $(echo "$SEEDOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  case "$SEEDOUT" in *10106102*) log "X seed aa start blocked: 10106102 (screen locked)"; exit 2;; esac
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  for i in $(seq 1 15); do
    [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && break
    sleep 2
  done
  log "seed check: smo_m7z2=[$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
  [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] || { log "X smo_m7z2 absent after seed"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X seed pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
else
  log "smo_m7z2 already present: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7z2" | tr -d '\r')"
fi

# ---- switches: the cheap cross-round baselines stay 1 (m7q WRAP = 0x7acd18 station, m7s2 = the
#      3 pool-B gates, m7t2 = the 9-head family, m7h keeps M7H_NG=15, **m7u2 = the A/B/C hub gates
#      the name ring v2 hangs on**) + smo_m7w2=1 + smo_m7z2=1 (this round's TWO gates, ids 95/96) ----
for s in smo_m8b smo_m7g smo_m7r smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7n smo_m7p smo_m7q smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7s2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7z2; do
  h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
for s in smo_gpu_write smo_m7a smo_m7b smo_m7s smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7x smo_m7y smo_m7k smo_m7l smo_m7m smo_m7o smo_frz smo_ldrd smo_aud smo_sha_ungated smo_dspool smo_m7d_same; do
  h shell "[ -f $FILES/$s ] && echo 0 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $GD > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
RB=$(for s in smo_m8b smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7v smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7d_same; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
RB="$RB gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"
log "switch readback (pre-boot): $RB"
for s in smo_m8b smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r; do
  V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "1" ] || { log "X $s not 1, abort"; exit 1; }
done

h shell "printf '' > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "log truncated: bytes=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG" | tr -dc '0-9')"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m8b_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m8b_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
case "$STARTOUT" in
  *10106102*) log "X boot aa start blocked 10106102 -> re-entering unlock poll"
              [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ] && { wait_unlock || { log "X locked again; BLOCKED"; exit 2; }; sleep 3; stopapp; STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r'); } ;;
esac
log "boot aa start: $(echo "$STARTOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
START=$(date +%s); CURPID=""; PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0; LASTWAKE=0; XT_SAVED=""
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"; printf 't\tframes\tsubmit\topens\tdraws\tstall\tm7q_wrap\th5\th7\tg1_site\tg2_hits\tg3_hits\tg4_x8\tg5_x58\n' > "$TSV"
PLAN="30 120"
GA(){ grep -a "\[m7u2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
SU(){ grep -a "\[m7z2\] sum$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1; }
F1(){ SU 1 | grep -o 'site_hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F2(){ SU 2 | grep -o ' hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F3(){ SU 3 | grep -o ' hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F4(){ SU 4 | grep -o 'last_x8=[^ ]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F5(){ SU 5 | grep -o 'last_c=[^ ]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
GH(){ grep -a "\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  if [ "$KEEP_AWAKE" = "1" ] && [ $(( EL - LASTWAKE )) -ge 10 ]; then
    LASTWAKE=$EL; h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  PP=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$PP" ]; then DEADN=$(( ${DEADN:-0} + 1 )); else DEADN=0; fi
  if [ "${DEADN:-0}" -ge 2 ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> - app died during the boot; stopping this run"
    shot "$EL" "tdeath"
    h shell "ls -t /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null | head -3" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    DEATH_T=$EL; break
  fi
  [ -z "$CURPID" ] && { P="$PP"; [ -n "$P" ] && { CURPID=$P; log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; }; }
  RAW=$(h shell "tail -n 4000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[beat\]|\[st\] t=|\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap|\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=h[57]|\[m7z2\] sum[1-5] |\[m7z2\] lr[1-5] |\[m7z2\] g[1-5] |\[m8b\] sum[12] |\[m8b\] ev '" | tr -d '\r')
  BT=$(grep -a '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  ST=$(grep -a '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  MQ=$(grep -a '\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  MQW=$(grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' <<<"$MQ" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); MQW=${MQW:-}
  H5=$(GH h5); H7=$(GH h7); A=$(F1); B=$(F2); C=$(F3); XT=$(F4); RN=$(F5)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${OP:-}" "${DW:-}" "${STALL:-}" "${MQW:-}" "${H5:-}" "${H7:-}" "${A:-}" "${B:-}" "${C:-}" "${XT:-}" "${RN:-}" >> "$TSV"
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 18 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    SL=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m8b\] probe|\[m8b\] code|\[m8b\] sum[12] |\[m8b\] tok[0-9]+ ' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -30" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s M8B-READBACK: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$SL")"
    GI=$(h shell "grep -a -E 'obs gate main\+0x(6c7750|4b8d30)' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -8; echo NOTINST=$(grep -a -c 'NOT installed' $LOG 2>/dev/null)" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s gate-install lines: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$GI")"
    RB2=$(for s in smo_m8b smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7h; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
    log "t=${EL}s switch readback (in-boot): $RB2"
  fi
  if [ $(( EL % 20 )) -lt 3 ]; then log "t=${EL}s frames=${FR:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?} stall=${STALL:-?} m7q_wrap=${MQW:-?} h5=${H5:-?} h7=${H7:-?} g1_site=${A:-?} g2_hits=${B:-?} g3_hits=${C:-?} g4_x8=${XT:-?} g5_x58=${RN:-?}"; fi
  for T in $PLAN; do if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi; done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 4
done
shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} death_t=${DEATH_T:-none} dur=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done
DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  for K in st beat m7y2 m7x2 m7w2 m7u2 m7t2 m7s2 m7q gst gates; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  grep -a 'obs gate' "$DL" > "$OUT/gates_install.txt" 2>/dev/null
  log "gate install lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/gates_install.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "m7z2: probe=$(grep -ac '\[m7z2\] probe' "$DL") code=$(grep -ac '\[m7z2\] code' "$DL") sum=$(grep -ac '\[m7z2\] sum' "$DL") lr=$(grep -ac '\[m7z2\] lr' "$DL") ring=$(grep -ac '\[m7z2\] g[1-5] t=' "$DL") m7y2=$(grep -ac '\[m7y2\]' "$DL")"
  for g in 1 2 3 4 5; do log "m7z2 sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m7z2\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  log "m7z2 code lines: $(grep -a '\[m7z2\] code' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 2200)"
  log "m7z2 lr lines (last 12): $(grep -a '\[m7z2\] lr' "$DL" | tail -12 | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 2400)"
  log "m7z2 ring lines (last 12): $(grep -a '\[m7z2\] g[1-5] t=' "$DL" | tail -12 | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 2400)"
  grep -a '\[m8b\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m8b.txt" 2>/dev/null
  log "m8b: probe=$(grep -ac '\[m8b\] probe' "$DL") code=$(grep -ac '\[m8b\] code' "$DL") sum=$(grep -ac '\[m8b\] sum' "$DL") lr=$(grep -ac '\[m8b\] lr' "$DL") tok=$(grep -ac '\[m8b\] tok[0-9]' "$DL") ev=$(grep -ac '\[m8b\] ev ' "$DL") lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m8b.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  for g in 1 2; do log "m8b sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m8b\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  log "m8b code lines: $(grep -a '\[m8b\] code' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 1200)"
fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG unlock_probes=${UNLOCK_N:-0}"

```

`m8c2_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
# M8D (2026-11-08): REAL-DEVICE ROUND 1 -- one build, one install, one <=150 s boot that harvests
#   (a) the DEVICE nerve timeline (M8B's gates id 104 main+0x6c7750 / id 105 main+0x4b8d30, reused
#       unchanged) and (b) the M7Z2 "leg A / leg B" split (M7Z2's G3 id 101 main+0x4b8ea4 LR decides it).
#   New this round (switch smo_m8d, C default 0): the TWO TWIN TABLE-BINDER gates
#     G1 id 106 main+0x4b8cb0 -> binds nerve table 0x12d0fe8 (FirstSequence family)
#     G2 id 107 main+0x4b7380 -> binds nerve table 0x12d06d8 (TitleMenu family)
#   both with ZERO static bl/b callers, so hits>0 proves that family's HostType instance was built.
#   smo_m8c is forced to 0: the M8C conditional-injection code is in this tree, and with 0 the
#   observer returns 0 and x1 keeps its original value (byte-identical to M8B: natural state only).
# usage: bash m8c2_boot_run.sh <tag> <target 127.0.0.1:5555> [dur=150] [gdump_sec=10]
#   SKIP_INSTALL=1 -> resume a boot without reinstalling   UNLOCK_POLL=0 -> skip unlock poll
#   KEEP_AWAKE=1   -> power-shell wakeup every 10 s during the measured boot (device style)
# Never runs `hdc kill` (it would take the other target down). Every hdc call uses -t.
# Names: m8d / smo_m8d / [m8d] / m8d_boot_run.sh / logs/m8d_* -- five-name check all-clear 15:06.
# Baseline switches: byte-identical to M8B (18 ones + 3 zeros), diff = {smo_m8d: ->1, smo_m8c: ->0}.
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: bash m8d_boot_run.sh <tag> <target> [dur] [gdump_sec]}"
TGT="${2:?target required (all hdc calls use -t)}"
DUR="${3:-150}"
GD="${4:-10}"
M8C_VAL="${M8C_VAL:-1}"        # M8C2: 1 = contract boot (from 1st keeper match, cap 3)
                              #       21..23 = one-shot (cap 1) from N-20 match; 23 = skip 2 init writes
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m8c2_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
UNLOCK_POLL="${UNLOCK_POLL:-1}"
UNLOCK_MAX="${UNLOCK_MAX:-1200}"        # 20 min cap, per the round rules
KEEP_AWAKE="${KEEP_AWAKE:-1}"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M8C2 tag=$TAG m8c_val=$M8C_VAL target=$TGT dur=${DUR}s gdump_sec=$GD out=$OUT unlock_poll=$UNLOCK_POLL(<=${UNLOCK_MAX}s) keep_awake=$KEEP_AWAKE"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target $TGT offline"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }

# ---- unlock poll: a successful `aa start` IS the seed start too (the app constructors create
#      files/smo_m7z2, smo_m8b, smo_m8c, smo_m8d on first launch). 10106102 = locked -> do NOT try
#      to unlock, just poll every 15 s (cap 20 min, then BLOCKED per the round rules).
wait_unlock(){
  local n=0 t0=$(date +%s) out
  h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
  while :; do
    n=$((n+1))
    out=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
    local el=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))
    printf '[%s] probe #%d t=%ds %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$n" "$el" "$(echo "$out" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 160)" >> "$OUT/unlock_probe.log"
    case "$out" in
      *10106102*) : ;;
      *"start ability successfully"*|*"successfully"*) log "unlock poll: probe #$n OK at t=${el}s (of cap ${UNLOCK_MAX}s)"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 0 ;;
      *) : ;;
    esac
    [ "$el" -ge "$UNLOCK_MAX" ] && { log "X unlock poll: ${UNLOCK_MAX}s cap reached after $n probes (still 10106102) -> BLOCKED"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 1; }
    sleep 15
  done
}

stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"

if [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ]; then
  wait_unlock || { log "X device stays locked; not booting (per round rules)"; exit 2; }
  log "after unlock poll: pid=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]') files=[$(h shell "ls $FILES/ 2>/dev/null | grep -a smo_ | tr '\n' ' '" | tr -d '\r')]"
  sleep 3
  stopapp || { log "X probe pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
fi

if [ "${SKIP_INSTALL:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  log "install SKIPPED (SKIP_INSTALL=1)"
else
  T0=$(date +%s)
  OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); INST_S=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))
  log "install(${INST_S}s): $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
  UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
  log "upd_after: $UPD1"
  [ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"
fi

# ---- seed start (~7-8 s, NOT counted in the measured boot): hdc cannot CREATE a file inside the
#      app sandbox, so the app constructors must seed smo_m7z2 / smo_m8b / smo_m8c / smo_m8d once.
NEEDSEED=0
for s in smo_m7z2 smo_m8b smo_m8c smo_m8d; do
  [ -z "$(h shell "ls $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && NEEDSEED=1
done
if [ "$NEEDSEED" = "1" ]; then
  log "seed start: letting the app constructors create the smo_* files"
  SEEDOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed aa start: $(echo "$SEEDOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  case "$SEEDOUT" in *10106102*) log "X seed aa start blocked: 10106102 (screen locked)"; exit 2;; esac
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  for i in $(seq 1 15); do
    [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m8d 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && break
    sleep 2
  done
  log "seed check: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m8d $FILES/smo_m8b $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr '\n' '|')"
  [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m8d 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] || { log "X smo_m8d absent after seed"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X seed pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
else
  log "all smo_* present: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m8d $FILES/smo_m8b $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr '\n' '|')"
fi

# ---- switches: 18 cross-round baselines stay 1 (byte-identical to M8B) + smo_m8d=1 (this round's
#      two binder gates) + smo_m8b=1 (M8B gates 104/105) + smo_m7z2=1 (M7Z2 gates 99..103) ----
for s in smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m7g smo_m7r smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7n smo_m7p smo_m7q smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7s2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7z2; do
  h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
for s in smo_gpu_write smo_m7a smo_m7b smo_m7s smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7x smo_m7y smo_m7k smo_m7l smo_m7m smo_m7o smo_frz smo_ldrd smo_aud smo_sha_ungated smo_dspool smo_m7d_same; do
  h shell "[ -f $FILES/$s ] && echo 0 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
h shell "echo $M8C_VAL > $FILES/smo_m8c" >/dev/null 2>&1   # M8C2: THE one delta vs M8E baseline
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $GD > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
RB=$(for s in smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m8c smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7v smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7d_same; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
RB="$RB gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"
log "switch readback (pre-boot): $RB"
for s in smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r; do
  V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "1" ] || { log "X $s not 1, abort"; exit 1; }
done
V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m8c" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "$M8C_VAL" ] || { log "X smo_m8c=$V (expected $M8C_VAL) -> abort, injection would NOT happen"; exit 1; }; log "m8c_cval(host-verified)=$V (requested $M8C_VAL)"

h shell "printf '' > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "log truncated: bytes=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG" | tr -dc '0-9')"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m8d_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m8d_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
case "$STARTOUT" in
  *10106102*) log "X boot aa start blocked 10106102 -> re-entering unlock poll"
              [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ] && { wait_unlock || { log "X locked again; BLOCKED"; exit 2; }; sleep 3; stopapp; STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r'); } ;;
esac
log "boot aa start: $(echo "$STARTOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
START=$(date +%s); CURPID=""; PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0; LASTWAKE=0; XT_SAVED=""
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"; printf 't\tframes\tsubmit\topens\tdraws\tstall\tm7q_wrap\th5\th7\tg1_site\tg2_hits\tg3_hits\tg4_x8\tg5_x58\tm8d_g106\tm8d_g107\tm8b_g104\n' > "$TSV"
PLAN="8 30 60 120"
GA(){ grep -a "\[m7u2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
SU(){ grep -a "\[m7z2\] sum$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1; }
F1(){ SU 1 | grep -o 'site_hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F2(){ SU 2 | grep -o ' hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F3(){ SU 3 | grep -o ' hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F4(){ SU 4 | grep -o 'last_x8=[^ ]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F5(){ SU 5 | grep -o 'last_c=[^ ]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
G8D(){ grep -a "\[m8d\] sum$2 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
G8B(){ grep -a "\[m8b\] sum1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
GH(){ grep -a "\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  if [ "$KEEP_AWAKE" = "1" ] && [ $(( EL - LASTWAKE )) -ge 10 ]; then
    LASTWAKE=$EL; h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  PP=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$PP" ]; then DEADN=$(( ${DEADN:-0} + 1 )); else DEADN=0; fi
  if [ "${DEADN:-0}" -ge 2 ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> - app died during the boot; stopping this run"
    shot "$EL" "tdeath"
    h shell "ls -t /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null | head -3" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    DEATH_T=$EL; break
  fi
  [ -z "$CURPID" ] && { P="$PP"; [ -n "$P" ] && { CURPID=$P; log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; }; }
  RAW=$(h shell "tail -n 4000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[beat\]|\[st\] t=|\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap|\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=h[57]|\[m7z2\] sum[1-5] |\[m7z2\] lr[1-5] |\[m7z2\] g[1-5] |\[m8b\] sum[12] |\[m8b\] ev |\[m8d\] sum[12] |\[m8d\] lr[12] |\[m8d\] probe|\[m8d\] code' " | tr -d '\r')
  BT=$(grep -a '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  ST=$(grep -a '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  MQ=$(grep -a '\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  MQW=$(grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' <<<"$MQ" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); MQW=${MQW:-}
  H5=$(GH h5); H7=$(GH h7); A=$(F1); B=$(F2); C=$(F3); XT=$(F4); RN=$(F5)
  D1=$(G8D x 1); D2=$(G8D x 2); BB=$(G8B)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${OP:-}" "${DW:-}" "${STALL:-}" "${MQW:-}" "${H5:-}" "${H7:-}" "${A:-}" "${B:-}" "${C:-}" "${XT:-}" "${RN:-}" "${D1:-}" "${D2:-}" "${BB:-}" >> "$TSV"
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 18 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    SL=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m8d\] probe|\[m8d\] code|\[m8d\] sum[12] |\[m8b\] probe|\[m8b\] code|\[m8b\] sum[12] |\[m7z2\] sum[1-5] ' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -40" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s M8D-READBACK: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$SL")"
    GI=$(h shell "grep -a -E 'obs gate main\+0x(6c7750|4b8d30|4b8cb0|4b7380)|obs gate main\+0x(4b8ea4|4b8e20|4b8e88)' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -12; echo NOTINST=$(grep -a -c 'NOT installed' $LOG 2>/dev/null)" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s gate-install lines: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$GI")"
    RB2=$(for s in smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m8c smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7h; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
    log "t=${EL}s switch readback (in-boot): $RB2"
  fi
  if [ $(( EL % 20 )) -lt 3 ]; then log "t=${EL}s frames=${FR:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?} stall=${STALL:-?} m7q_wrap=${MQW:-?} h5=${H5:-?} h7=${H7:-?} g1_site=${A:-?} g2_hits=${B:-?} g3_hits=${C:-?} g4_x8=${XT:-?} g5_x58=${RN:-?} g106=${D1:-?} g107=${D2:-?} g104=${BB:-?}"; fi
  for T in $PLAN; do if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi; done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 4
done
shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} death_t=${DEATH_T:-none} dur=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done
DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  for K in st beat m7y2 m7x2 m7w2 m7u2 m7t2 m7s2 m7q gst; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  grep -a 'obs gate' "$DL" > "$OUT/gates_install.txt" 2>/dev/null
  log "gate install lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/gates_install.txt" | tr -d ' ') NOTINST=$(grep -ac 'NOT installed' "$DL" || true)"
  for K in m8b m8d m7z2 m8c; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  for g in 1 2; do log "m8d sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m8d\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  for g in 1 2; do log "m8b sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m8b\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  for g in 1 2 3 4 5; do log "m7z2 sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m7z2\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  log "m8d code lines: $(grep -a '\[m8d\] code' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 1200)"
  log "m7z2 code lines: $(grep -a '\[m7z2\] code' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 2200)"
fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG unlock_probes=${UNLOCK_N:-0}"

```

`m8c_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
# M8C (2026-11-08): CONDITIONAL INJECTION of the real-device nerve token (simulator only).
#   M8B drew the nerve state machine: the simulator's sequence HostType walks the TitleMenu family
#   (Boot -> BootLayout -> BootLayoutInitScene -> Menu -> DestroyMenu) and never holds the device's
#   HostTypeNrvLoadFirstSequence (main+0x12d0e08). M8C makes the FIRST "change state" experiment:
#   id 104 (main+0x6c7750, the ONE nerve write point) gets a 30-word stub variant whose observer may
#   return a replacement x1; only the LATCHED sequence HostType keeper is touched, only =1..3 injects
#   per boot, and only x1 is written.  smo_m8c=0 => observer returns 0 => x1 untouched (control boot,
#   byte-identical behaviour to M8B).
#   Usage: bash m8c_boot_run.sh <tag> <target 127.0.0.1:5555> [dur=150] [gdump_sec=10]
#          M8C_VAL=0|1|2|3   (default 1; 0 = control boot)
#   Switch set = the M8B set VERBATIM + smo_m8c only (comparability contract).
# ---- (original M8B header follows) ----
# M8B (2026-11-08): THE NERVE STATE MACHINE (simulator only; no device in the loop).
#   M8A proved 0x4b8e84 / 0x4b8e20 are DEAD CODE on the simulator (gate 5 = 0 hits in 92 s), so the
#   real fork is "which nerve the sequence object currently holds". Its ONE write point is
#   main+0x6c7750 (NerveKeeper::setNerve: [keeper+0x10] = nerve token, [keeper+0x18] = -1).
#   G1 id 104 main+0x6c7750 tail=0 4-word window: per event log x1 (new token), [keeper+0x10] (old
#     token), [keeper+0x18] (old step), LR, tick, plus the nerve NAME read at token+0x10 (SMO nerve
#     objects keep their Itanium type name at +0x20 of the object base; token = base+0x10).
#     First-128 event ring (claim-once, never overwritten) + last-16 rotating ring + 40-slot per-token
#     count table + 16-slot per-LR table => the whole nerve timeline, named.
#   G2 id 105 main+0x4b8d30 (HostTypeNrvBoot::execute entry, the single `b` from exec thunk 0x4b93a0)
#     tail=0 4-word window: count + LR table only => how much the host state machine runs.
#   NOT gated: 0x4b8e84 / 0x4b8e98 / 0x4b8ea4 / 0x4b8e20 (M8A: dead on the simulator) and 0x4b8d20.
# usage: bash m8c_boot_run.sh <tag s1> <target 127.0.0.1:5555> [dur=150] [gdump_sec=10]  (M8C_VAL=0|1|2|3)
#   SKIP_INSTALL=1  -> resume a boot without reinstalling
#   UNLOCK_POLL=0   -> skip the unlock poll (emulator)
#   KEEP_AWAKE=1    -> power-shell wakeup every 10 s during the measured boot (device style)
# Never runs `hdc kill` (it would take the other target down). Same switch set as M8B + smo_m8c.
# Names: m8c / smo_m8c / [m8c] / logs/m8c_* -- the five-name check was all-clear on 2026-11-08.
# Baseline switches: smo_m8b .. smo_m7r all stay 1 (M8B verbatim), only smo_m8c is new.
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: bash m8c_boot_run.sh <tag> <target> [dur] [gdump_sec]}"
TGT="${2:?target required (all hdc calls use -t)}"
DUR="${3:-150}"
GD="${4:-10}"
M8CV="${M8C_VAL:-1}"        # 0 = control boot (no injection), 1..3 = inject from the N-th keeper match
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m8c_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
UNLOCK_POLL="${UNLOCK_POLL:-1}"
UNLOCK_MAX="${UNLOCK_MAX:-1200}"        # 20 min cap, per the round rules
KEEP_AWAKE="${KEEP_AWAKE:-0}"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M8C tag=$TAG m8c_val=$M8CV target=$TGT dur=${DUR}s gdump_sec=$GD out=$OUT unlock_poll=$UNLOCK_POLL(<=${UNLOCK_MAX}s) keep_awake=$KEEP_AWAKE"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target $TGT offline"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }

# ---- unlock poll: a successful `aa start` IS the seed start too (the app constructor creates
#      files/smo_m7z2 on first launch). 10106102 means "screen locked" -> do NOT try to unlock,
#      just keep polling every 15 s (M7R/M7S/M7T: 1 probe was enough, three times in a row).
wait_unlock(){
  local n=0 t0=$(date +%s) out
  h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
  while :; do
    n=$((n+1))
    out=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
    local el=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))
    printf '[%s] probe #%d t=%ds %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$n" "$el" "$(echo "$out" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 160)" >> "$OUT/unlock_probe.log"
    case "$out" in
      *10106102*) : ;;                       # locked: keep polling, never try to unlock
      *"start ability successfully"*|*"successfully"*) log "unlock poll: probe #$n OK at t=${el}s (of cap ${UNLOCK_MAX}s)"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 0 ;;
      *) : ;;
    esac
    [ "$el" -ge "$UNLOCK_MAX" ] && { log "X unlock poll: ${UNLOCK_MAX}s cap reached after $n probes (still 10106102) -> BLOCKED"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 1; }
    sleep 15
  done
}

# M8C: 解锁轮询/种子启动跑的可能是**上一轮的 HAP 与上一轮的开关值**（s2one 那次就是被上一轮
# 残留的 smo_m8c=1 带着注入崩在解锁探针里）。所以一开始就把注入关掉，只在被测 boot 前才写目标值。
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_m8c" >/dev/null 2>&1
stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"

if [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ]; then
  wait_unlock || { log "X device stays locked; not booting (per round rules: no unlock attempts, no forced retries)"; exit 2; }
  log "after unlock poll: pid=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]') smo_m7z2=[$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
  sleep 3
  stopapp || { log "X probe pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
fi

if [ "${SKIP_INSTALL:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  log "install SKIPPED (SKIP_INSTALL=1)"
else
  T0=$(date +%s)
  OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); INST_S=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))
  log "install(${INST_S}s): $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
  UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
  log "upd_after: $UPD1"
  [ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"
fi

# ---- seed start (~7-8 s, not counted in the measured boot): hdc cannot CREATE a file in the
#      sandbox, the app constructor seeds smo_m7z2. ----
if [ -z "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ]; then
  log "seed start: letting the app constructor create smo_m7z2"
  SEEDOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed aa start: $(echo "$SEEDOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  case "$SEEDOUT" in *10106102*) log "X seed aa start blocked: 10106102 (screen locked)"; exit 2;; esac
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  for i in $(seq 1 15); do
    [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && break
    sleep 2
  done
  log "seed check: smo_m7z2=[$(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')]"
  [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] || { log "X smo_m7z2 absent after seed"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X seed pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
else
  log "smo_m7z2 already present: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m7z2" | tr -d '\r')"
fi

# ---- switches: the cheap cross-round baselines stay 1 (m7q WRAP = 0x7acd18 station, m7s2 = the
#      3 pool-B gates, m7t2 = the 9-head family, m7h keeps M7H_NG=15, **m7u2 = the A/B/C hub gates
#      the name ring v2 hangs on**) + smo_m7w2=1 + smo_m7z2=1 (this round's TWO gates, ids 95/96) ----
for s in smo_m8b smo_m7g smo_m7r smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7n smo_m7p smo_m7q smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7s2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7z2; do
  h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
for s in smo_gpu_write smo_m7a smo_m7b smo_m7s smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7x smo_m7y smo_m7k smo_m7l smo_m7m smo_m7o smo_frz smo_ldrd smo_aud smo_sha_ungated smo_dspool smo_m7d_same; do
  h shell "[ -f $FILES/$s ] && echo 0 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
h shell "echo $M8CV > $FILES/smo_m8c" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $GD > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
RB=$(for s in smo_m8c smo_m8b smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7v smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7d_same; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
RB="$RB gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"
log "switch readback (pre-boot): $RB"
for s in smo_m8b smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r; do
  V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "1" ] || { log "X $s not 1, abort"; exit 1; }
done

h shell "printf '' > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "log truncated: bytes=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG" | tr -dc '0-9')"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m8c_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m8c_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
case "$STARTOUT" in
  *10106102*) log "X boot aa start blocked 10106102 -> re-entering unlock poll"
              [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ] && { wait_unlock || { log "X locked again; BLOCKED"; exit 2; }; sleep 3; stopapp; STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r'); } ;;
esac
log "boot aa start: $(echo "$STARTOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
START=$(date +%s); CURPID=""; PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0; LASTWAKE=0; XT_SAVED=""
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"; printf 't\tframes\tsubmit\topens\tdraws\tstall\tm7q_wrap\th5\th7\tg1_site\tg2_hits\tg3_hits\tg4_x8\tg5_x58\n' > "$TSV"
PLAN="30 120"
GA(){ grep -a "\[m7u2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
SU(){ grep -a "\[m7z2\] sum$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1; }
F1(){ SU 1 | grep -o 'site_hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F2(){ SU 2 | grep -o ' hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F3(){ SU 3 | grep -o ' hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F4(){ SU 4 | grep -o 'last_x8=[^ ]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F5(){ SU 5 | grep -o 'last_c=[^ ]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
GH(){ grep -a "\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  if [ "$KEEP_AWAKE" = "1" ] && [ $(( EL - LASTWAKE )) -ge 10 ]; then
    LASTWAKE=$EL; h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  PP=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$PP" ]; then DEADN=$(( ${DEADN:-0} + 1 )); else DEADN=0; fi
  if [ "${DEADN:-0}" -ge 2 ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> - app died during the boot; stopping this run"
    shot "$EL" "tdeath"
    h shell "ls -t /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null | head -3" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    DEATH_T=$EL; break
  fi
  [ -z "$CURPID" ] && { P="$PP"; [ -n "$P" ] && { CURPID=$P; log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; }; }
  RAW=$(h shell "tail -n 4000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[beat\]|\[st\] t=|\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap|\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=h[57]|\[m7z2\] sum[1-5] |\[m7z2\] lr[1-5] |\[m7z2\] g[1-5] |\[m8b\] sum[12] |\[m8b\] ev |\[m8c\] sum |\[m8c\] inj '" | tr -d '\r')
  BT=$(grep -a '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  ST=$(grep -a '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  MQ=$(grep -a '\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  MQW=$(grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' <<<"$MQ" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); MQW=${MQW:-}
  H5=$(GH h5); H7=$(GH h7); A=$(F1); B=$(F2); C=$(F3); XT=$(F4); RN=$(F5)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${OP:-}" "${DW:-}" "${STALL:-}" "${MQW:-}" "${H5:-}" "${H7:-}" "${A:-}" "${B:-}" "${C:-}" "${XT:-}" "${RN:-}" >> "$TSV"
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 18 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    SL=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m8b\] probe|\[m8b\] code|\[m8b\] sum[12] |\[m8b\] tok[0-9]+ ' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -30" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s M8B-READBACK: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$SL")"
    SC=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m8c\] probe|\[m8c\] code|\[m8c\] sum |\[m8c\] inj ' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -20" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s M8C-READBACK: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$SC")"
    GI=$(h shell "grep -a -E 'obs gate main\+0x(6c7750|4b8d30)' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -8; echo NOTINST=$(grep -a -c 'NOT installed' $LOG 2>/dev/null)" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s gate-install lines: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$GI")"
    RB2=$(for s in smo_m8c smo_m8b smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7h; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
    log "t=${EL}s switch readback (in-boot): $RB2"
  fi
  if [ $(( EL % 20 )) -lt 3 ]; then log "t=${EL}s frames=${FR:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?} stall=${STALL:-?} m7q_wrap=${MQW:-?} h5=${H5:-?} h7=${H7:-?} g1_site=${A:-?} g2_hits=${B:-?} g3_hits=${C:-?} g4_x8=${XT:-?} g5_x58=${RN:-?}"; fi
  for T in $PLAN; do if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi; done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 4
done
shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} death_t=${DEATH_T:-none} dur=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done
DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  for K in st beat m7y2 m7x2 m7w2 m7u2 m7t2 m7s2 m7q gst gates; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  grep -a 'obs gate' "$DL" > "$OUT/gates_install.txt" 2>/dev/null
  log "gate install lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/gates_install.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  log "m7z2: probe=$(grep -ac '\[m7z2\] probe' "$DL") code=$(grep -ac '\[m7z2\] code' "$DL") sum=$(grep -ac '\[m7z2\] sum' "$DL") lr=$(grep -ac '\[m7z2\] lr' "$DL") ring=$(grep -ac '\[m7z2\] g[1-5] t=' "$DL") m7y2=$(grep -ac '\[m7y2\]' "$DL")"
  for g in 1 2 3 4 5; do log "m7z2 sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m7z2\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  log "m7z2 code lines: $(grep -a '\[m7z2\] code' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 2200)"
  log "m7z2 lr lines (last 12): $(grep -a '\[m7z2\] lr' "$DL" | tail -12 | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 2400)"
  log "m7z2 ring lines (last 12): $(grep -a '\[m7z2\] g[1-5] t=' "$DL" | tail -12 | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 2400)"
  grep -a '\[m8b\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m8b.txt" 2>/dev/null
  grep -a '\[m8c\]' "$DL" > "$OUT/m8c.txt" 2>/dev/null
  log "m8c: probe=$(grep -ac '\[m8c\] probe' "$DL") code=$(grep -ac '\[m8c\] code' "$DL") sum=$(grep -ac '\[m8c\] sum ' "$DL") inj=$(grep -ac '\[m8c\] inj ' "$DL") lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m8c.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  for g in 1 2; do log "m8b sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m8b\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  log "m8c code: $(grep -a '\[m8c\] code' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "m8c sum(last): $(grep -a '\[m8c\] sum ' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "m8c inj lines: $(grep -a '\[m8c\] inj ' "$DL" | tail -8 | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 1500)"
  log "m8b: probe=$(grep -ac '\[m8b\] probe' "$DL") code=$(grep -ac '\[m8b\] code' "$DL") sum=$(grep -ac '\[m8b\] sum' "$DL") lr=$(grep -ac '\[m8b\] lr' "$DL") tok=$(grep -ac '\[m8b\] tok[0-9]' "$DL") ev=$(grep -ac '\[m8b\] ev ' "$DL") lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/m8b.txt" | tr -d ' ')"
  for g in 1 2; do log "m8b sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m8b\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  log "m8b code lines: $(grep -a '\[m8b\] code' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 1200)"
fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG unlock_probes=${UNLOCK_N:-0}"

```

`m8d2_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
# M8D (2026-11-08): REAL-DEVICE ROUND 1 -- one build, one install, one <=150 s boot that harvests
#   (a) the DEVICE nerve timeline (M8B's gates id 104 main+0x6c7750 / id 105 main+0x4b8d30, reused
#       unchanged) and (b) the M7Z2 "leg A / leg B" split (M7Z2's G3 id 101 main+0x4b8ea4 LR decides it).
#   New this round (switch smo_m8d, C default 0): the TWO TWIN TABLE-BINDER gates
#     G1 id 106 main+0x4b8cb0 -> binds nerve table 0x12d0fe8 (FirstSequence family)
#     G2 id 107 main+0x4b7380 -> binds nerve table 0x12d06d8 (TitleMenu family)
#   both with ZERO static bl/b callers, so hits>0 proves that family's HostType instance was built.
#   smo_m8c is forced to 0: the M8C conditional-injection code is in this tree, and with 0 the
#   observer returns 0 and x1 keeps its original value (byte-identical to M8B: natural state only).
# usage: bash m8d_boot_run.sh <tag d1> <target 192.168.0.111:42323> [dur=150] [gdump_sec=10]
#   SKIP_INSTALL=1 -> resume a boot without reinstalling   UNLOCK_POLL=0 -> skip unlock poll
#   KEEP_AWAKE=1   -> power-shell wakeup every 10 s during the measured boot (device style)
# Never runs `hdc kill` (it would take the other target down). Every hdc call uses -t.
# Names: m8d / smo_m8d / [m8d] / m8d_boot_run.sh / logs/m8d_* -- five-name check all-clear 15:06.
# Baseline switches: byte-identical to M8B (18 ones + 3 zeros), diff = {smo_m8d: ->1, smo_m8c: ->0}.
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: bash m8d_boot_run.sh <tag> <target> [dur] [gdump_sec]}"
TGT="${2:?target required (all hdc calls use -t)}"
DUR="${3:-150}"
GD="${4:-10}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m8d2_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
UNLOCK_POLL="${UNLOCK_POLL:-1}"
UNLOCK_MAX="${UNLOCK_MAX:-1200}"        # 20 min cap, per the round rules
KEEP_AWAKE="${KEEP_AWAKE:-1}"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M8D tag=$TAG target=$TGT dur=${DUR}s gdump_sec=$GD out=$OUT unlock_poll=$UNLOCK_POLL(<=${UNLOCK_MAX}s) keep_awake=$KEEP_AWAKE"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target $TGT offline"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }

# ---- unlock poll: a successful `aa start` IS the seed start too (the app constructors create
#      files/smo_m7z2, smo_m8b, smo_m8c, smo_m8d on first launch). 10106102 = locked -> do NOT try
#      to unlock, just poll every 15 s (cap 20 min, then BLOCKED per the round rules).
wait_unlock(){
  local n=0 t0=$(date +%s) out
  h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
  while :; do
    n=$((n+1))
    out=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
    local el=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))
    printf '[%s] probe #%d t=%ds %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$n" "$el" "$(echo "$out" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 160)" >> "$OUT/unlock_probe.log"
    case "$out" in
      *10106102*) : ;;
      *"start ability successfully"*|*"successfully"*) log "unlock poll: probe #$n OK at t=${el}s (of cap ${UNLOCK_MAX}s)"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 0 ;;
      *) : ;;
    esac
    [ "$el" -ge "$UNLOCK_MAX" ] && { log "X unlock poll: ${UNLOCK_MAX}s cap reached after $n probes (still 10106102) -> BLOCKED"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 1; }
    sleep 15
  done
}

stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"

if [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ]; then
  wait_unlock || { log "X device stays locked; not booting (per round rules)"; exit 2; }
  log "after unlock poll: pid=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]') files=[$(h shell "ls $FILES/ 2>/dev/null | grep -a smo_ | tr '\n' ' '" | tr -d '\r')]"
  sleep 3
  stopapp || { log "X probe pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
fi

if [ "${SKIP_INSTALL:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  log "install SKIPPED (SKIP_INSTALL=1)"
else
  T0=$(date +%s)
  OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); INST_S=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))
  log "install(${INST_S}s): $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
  UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
  log "upd_after: $UPD1"
  [ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"
fi

# ---- seed start (~7-8 s, NOT counted in the measured boot): hdc cannot CREATE a file inside the
#      app sandbox, so the app constructors must seed smo_m7z2 / smo_m8b / smo_m8c / smo_m8d once.
NEEDSEED=0
for s in smo_m7z2 smo_m8b smo_m8c smo_m8d; do
  [ -z "$(h shell "ls $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && NEEDSEED=1
done
if [ "$NEEDSEED" = "1" ]; then
  log "seed start: letting the app constructors create the smo_* files"
  SEEDOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed aa start: $(echo "$SEEDOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  case "$SEEDOUT" in *10106102*) log "X seed aa start blocked: 10106102 (screen locked)"; exit 2;; esac
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  for i in $(seq 1 15); do
    [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m8d 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && break
    sleep 2
  done
  log "seed check: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m8d $FILES/smo_m8b $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr '\n' '|')"
  [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m8d 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] || { log "X smo_m8d absent after seed"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X seed pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
else
  log "all smo_* present: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m8d $FILES/smo_m8b $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr '\n' '|')"
fi

# ---- switches: 18 cross-round baselines stay 1 (byte-identical to M8B) + smo_m8d=1 (this round's
#      two binder gates) + smo_m8b=1 (M8B gates 104/105) + smo_m7z2=1 (M7Z2 gates 99..103) ----
for s in smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m7g smo_m7r smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7n smo_m7p smo_m7q smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7s2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7z2; do
  h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
for s in smo_m8c smo_gpu_write smo_m7a smo_m7b smo_m7s smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7x smo_m7y smo_m7k smo_m7l smo_m7m smo_m7o smo_frz smo_ldrd smo_aud smo_sha_ungated smo_dspool smo_m7d_same; do
  h shell "[ -f $FILES/$s ] && echo 0 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $GD > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
RB=$(for s in smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m8c smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7v smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7d_same; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
RB="$RB gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"
log "switch readback (pre-boot): $RB"
for s in smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r; do
  V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "1" ] || { log "X $s not 1, abort"; exit 1; }
done
V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m8c" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "0" ] || log "!! smo_m8c=$V (expected 0: no injection this round)"

h shell "printf '' > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "log truncated: bytes=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG" | tr -dc '0-9')"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m8d_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m8d_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
case "$STARTOUT" in
  *10106102*) log "X boot aa start blocked 10106102 -> re-entering unlock poll"
              [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ] && { wait_unlock || { log "X locked again; BLOCKED"; exit 2; }; sleep 3; stopapp; STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r'); } ;;
esac
```
