```sh
log "boot aa start: $(echo "$STARTOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
START=$(date +%s); CURPID=""; PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0; LASTWAKE=0; XT_SAVED=""
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"; printf 't\tframes\tsubmit\topens\tdraws\tstall\tm7q_wrap\th5\th7\tg1_site\tg2_hits\tg3_hits\tg4_x8\tg5_x58\tm8d_g106\tm8d_g107\tm8b_g104\n' > "$TSV"
PLAN="30 120"
GA(){ grep -a "\[m7u2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
SU(){ grep -a "\[m7z2\] sum$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1; }
F1(){ SU 1 | grep -o 'site_hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F2(){ SU 2 | grep -o ' hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F3(){ SU 3 | grep -o ' hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F4(){ SU 4 | grep -o 'last_x8=[^ ]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F5(){ SU 5 | grep -o 'last_c=[^ ]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
G8D(){ grep -a "\[m8d\] sum$2 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
G8B(){ grep -a "\[m8b\] sum1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
GH(){ grep -a "\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  if [ "$KEEP_AWAKE" = "1" ] && [ $(( EL - LASTWAKE )) -ge 10 ]; then
    LASTWAKE=$EL; h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  PP=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$PP" ]; then DEADN=$(( ${DEADN:-0} + 1 )); else DEADN=0; fi
  if [ "${DEADN:-0}" -ge 2 ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> - app died during the boot; stopping this run"
    shot "$EL" "tdeath"
    h shell "ls -t /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null | head -3" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    DEATH_T=$EL; break
  fi
  [ -z "$CURPID" ] && { P="$PP"; [ -n "$P" ] && { CURPID=$P; log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; }; }
  RAW=$(h shell "tail -n 4000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[beat\]|\[st\] t=|\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap|\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=h[57]|\[m7z2\] sum[1-5] |\[m7z2\] lr[1-5] |\[m7z2\] g[1-5] |\[m8b\] sum[12] |\[m8b\] ev |\[m8d\] sum[12] |\[m8d\] lr[12] |\[m8d\] probe|\[m8d\] code' " | tr -d '\r')
  BT=$(grep -a '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  ST=$(grep -a '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  MQ=$(grep -a '\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  MQW=$(grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' <<<"$MQ" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); MQW=${MQW:-}
  H5=$(GH h5); H7=$(GH h7); A=$(F1); B=$(F2); C=$(F3); XT=$(F4); RN=$(F5)
  D1=$(G8D x 1); D2=$(G8D x 2); BB=$(G8B)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${OP:-}" "${DW:-}" "${STALL:-}" "${MQW:-}" "${H5:-}" "${H7:-}" "${A:-}" "${B:-}" "${C:-}" "${XT:-}" "${RN:-}" "${D1:-}" "${D2:-}" "${BB:-}" >> "$TSV"
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 18 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    SL=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m8d\] probe|\[m8d\] code|\[m8d\] sum[12] |\[m8b\] probe|\[m8b\] code|\[m8b\] sum[12] |\[m7z2\] sum[1-5] ' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -40" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s M8D-READBACK: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$SL")"
    GI=$(h shell "grep -a -E 'obs gate main\+0x(6c7750|4b8d30|4b8cb0|4b7380)|obs gate main\+0x(4b8ea4|4b8e20|4b8e88)' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -12; echo NOTINST=$(grep -a -c 'NOT installed' $LOG 2>/dev/null)" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s gate-install lines: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$GI")"
    RB2=$(for s in smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m8c smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7h; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
    log "t=${EL}s switch readback (in-boot): $RB2"
  fi
  if [ $(( EL % 20 )) -lt 3 ]; then log "t=${EL}s frames=${FR:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?} stall=${STALL:-?} m7q_wrap=${MQW:-?} h5=${H5:-?} h7=${H7:-?} g1_site=${A:-?} g2_hits=${B:-?} g3_hits=${C:-?} g4_x8=${XT:-?} g5_x58=${RN:-?} g106=${D1:-?} g107=${D2:-?} g104=${BB:-?}"; fi
  for T in $PLAN; do if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi; done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 4
done
shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} death_t=${DEATH_T:-none} dur=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done
DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  for K in st beat m7y2 m7x2 m7w2 m7u2 m7t2 m7s2 m7q gst; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  grep -a 'obs gate' "$DL" > "$OUT/gates_install.txt" 2>/dev/null
  log "gate install lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/gates_install.txt" | tr -d ' ') NOTINST=$(grep -ac 'NOT installed' "$DL" || true)"
  for K in m8b m8d m7z2; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  for g in 1 2; do log "m8d sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m8d\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  for g in 1 2; do log "m8b sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m8b\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  for g in 1 2 3 4 5; do log "m7z2 sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m7z2\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  log "m8d code lines: $(grep -a '\[m8d\] code' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 1200)"
  log "m7z2 code lines: $(grep -a '\[m7z2\] code' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 2200)"
fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG unlock_probes=${UNLOCK_N:-0}"

```

`m8d_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
# M8D (2026-11-08): REAL-DEVICE ROUND 1 -- one build, one install, one <=150 s boot that harvests
#   (a) the DEVICE nerve timeline (M8B's gates id 104 main+0x6c7750 / id 105 main+0x4b8d30, reused
#       unchanged) and (b) the M7Z2 "leg A / leg B" split (M7Z2's G3 id 101 main+0x4b8ea4 LR decides it).
#   New this round (switch smo_m8d, C default 0): the TWO TWIN TABLE-BINDER gates
#     G1 id 106 main+0x4b8cb0 -> binds nerve table 0x12d0fe8 (FirstSequence family)
#     G2 id 107 main+0x4b7380 -> binds nerve table 0x12d06d8 (TitleMenu family)
#   both with ZERO static bl/b callers, so hits>0 proves that family's HostType instance was built.
#   smo_m8c is forced to 0: the M8C conditional-injection code is in this tree, and with 0 the
#   observer returns 0 and x1 keeps its original value (byte-identical to M8B: natural state only).
# usage: bash m8d_boot_run.sh <tag d1> <target 192.168.0.111:42323> [dur=150] [gdump_sec=10]
#   SKIP_INSTALL=1 -> resume a boot without reinstalling   UNLOCK_POLL=0 -> skip unlock poll
#   KEEP_AWAKE=1   -> power-shell wakeup every 10 s during the measured boot (device style)
# Never runs `hdc kill` (it would take the other target down). Every hdc call uses -t.
# Names: m8d / smo_m8d / [m8d] / m8d_boot_run.sh / logs/m8d_* -- five-name check all-clear 15:06.
# Baseline switches: byte-identical to M8B (18 ones + 3 zeros), diff = {smo_m8d: ->1, smo_m8c: ->0}.
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: bash m8d_boot_run.sh <tag> <target> [dur] [gdump_sec]}"
TGT="${2:?target required (all hdc calls use -t)}"
DUR="${3:-150}"
GD="${4:-10}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m8d_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
UNLOCK_POLL="${UNLOCK_POLL:-1}"
UNLOCK_MAX="${UNLOCK_MAX:-1200}"        # 20 min cap, per the round rules
KEEP_AWAKE="${KEEP_AWAKE:-1}"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M8D tag=$TAG target=$TGT dur=${DUR}s gdump_sec=$GD out=$OUT unlock_poll=$UNLOCK_POLL(<=${UNLOCK_MAX}s) keep_awake=$KEEP_AWAKE"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target $TGT offline"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }

# ---- unlock poll: a successful `aa start` IS the seed start too (the app constructors create
#      files/smo_m7z2, smo_m8b, smo_m8c, smo_m8d on first launch). 10106102 = locked -> do NOT try
#      to unlock, just poll every 15 s (cap 20 min, then BLOCKED per the round rules).
wait_unlock(){
  local n=0 t0=$(date +%s) out
  h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
  while :; do
    n=$((n+1))
    out=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
    local el=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))
    printf '[%s] probe #%d t=%ds %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$n" "$el" "$(echo "$out" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 160)" >> "$OUT/unlock_probe.log"
    case "$out" in
      *10106102*) : ;;
      *"start ability successfully"*|*"successfully"*) log "unlock poll: probe #$n OK at t=${el}s (of cap ${UNLOCK_MAX}s)"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 0 ;;
      *) : ;;
    esac
    [ "$el" -ge "$UNLOCK_MAX" ] && { log "X unlock poll: ${UNLOCK_MAX}s cap reached after $n probes (still 10106102) -> BLOCKED"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 1; }
    sleep 15
  done
}

stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"

if [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ]; then
  wait_unlock || { log "X device stays locked; not booting (per round rules)"; exit 2; }
  log "after unlock poll: pid=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]') files=[$(h shell "ls $FILES/ 2>/dev/null | grep -a smo_ | tr '\n' ' '" | tr -d '\r')]"
  sleep 3
  stopapp || { log "X probe pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
fi

if [ "${SKIP_INSTALL:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  log "install SKIPPED (SKIP_INSTALL=1)"
else
  T0=$(date +%s)
  OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); INST_S=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))
  log "install(${INST_S}s): $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
  UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
  log "upd_after: $UPD1"
  [ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"
fi

# ---- seed start (~7-8 s, NOT counted in the measured boot): hdc cannot CREATE a file inside the
#      app sandbox, so the app constructors must seed smo_m7z2 / smo_m8b / smo_m8c / smo_m8d once.
NEEDSEED=0
for s in smo_m7z2 smo_m8b smo_m8c smo_m8d; do
  [ -z "$(h shell "ls $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && NEEDSEED=1
done
if [ "$NEEDSEED" = "1" ]; then
  log "seed start: letting the app constructors create the smo_* files"
  SEEDOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed aa start: $(echo "$SEEDOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  case "$SEEDOUT" in *10106102*) log "X seed aa start blocked: 10106102 (screen locked)"; exit 2;; esac
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  for i in $(seq 1 15); do
    [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m8d 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && break
    sleep 2
  done
  log "seed check: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m8d $FILES/smo_m8b $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr '\n' '|')"
  [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m8d 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] || { log "X smo_m8d absent after seed"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X seed pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
else
  log "all smo_* present: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m8d $FILES/smo_m8b $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr '\n' '|')"
fi

# ---- switches: 18 cross-round baselines stay 1 (byte-identical to M8B) + smo_m8d=1 (this round's
#      two binder gates) + smo_m8b=1 (M8B gates 104/105) + smo_m7z2=1 (M7Z2 gates 99..103) ----
for s in smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m7g smo_m7r smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7n smo_m7p smo_m7q smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7s2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7z2; do
  h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
for s in smo_m8c smo_gpu_write smo_m7a smo_m7b smo_m7s smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7x smo_m7y smo_m7k smo_m7l smo_m7m smo_m7o smo_frz smo_ldrd smo_aud smo_sha_ungated smo_dspool smo_m7d_same; do
  h shell "[ -f $FILES/$s ] && echo 0 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $GD > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
RB=$(for s in smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m8c smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7v smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7d_same; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
RB="$RB gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"
log "switch readback (pre-boot): $RB"
for s in smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r; do
  V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "1" ] || { log "X $s not 1, abort"; exit 1; }
done
V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m8c" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "0" ] || log "!! smo_m8c=$V (expected 0: no injection this round)"

h shell "printf '' > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "log truncated: bytes=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG" | tr -dc '0-9')"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m8d_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m8d_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
case "$STARTOUT" in
  *10106102*) log "X boot aa start blocked 10106102 -> re-entering unlock poll"
              [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ] && { wait_unlock || { log "X locked again; BLOCKED"; exit 2; }; sleep 3; stopapp; STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r'); } ;;
esac
log "boot aa start: $(echo "$STARTOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
START=$(date +%s); CURPID=""; PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0; LASTWAKE=0; XT_SAVED=""
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"; printf 't\tframes\tsubmit\topens\tdraws\tstall\tm7q_wrap\th5\th7\tg1_site\tg2_hits\tg3_hits\tg4_x8\tg5_x58\tm8d_g106\tm8d_g107\tm8b_g104\n' > "$TSV"
PLAN="30 120"
GA(){ grep -a "\[m7u2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
SU(){ grep -a "\[m7z2\] sum$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1; }
F1(){ SU 1 | grep -o 'site_hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F2(){ SU 2 | grep -o ' hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F3(){ SU 3 | grep -o ' hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F4(){ SU 4 | grep -o 'last_x8=[^ ]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F5(){ SU 5 | grep -o 'last_c=[^ ]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
G8D(){ grep -a "\[m8d\] sum$2 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
G8B(){ grep -a "\[m8b\] sum1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
GH(){ grep -a "\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  if [ "$KEEP_AWAKE" = "1" ] && [ $(( EL - LASTWAKE )) -ge 10 ]; then
    LASTWAKE=$EL; h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  PP=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$PP" ]; then DEADN=$(( ${DEADN:-0} + 1 )); else DEADN=0; fi
  if [ "${DEADN:-0}" -ge 2 ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> - app died during the boot; stopping this run"
    shot "$EL" "tdeath"
    h shell "ls -t /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null | head -3" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    DEATH_T=$EL; break
  fi
  [ -z "$CURPID" ] && { P="$PP"; [ -n "$P" ] && { CURPID=$P; log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; }; }
  RAW=$(h shell "tail -n 4000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[beat\]|\[st\] t=|\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap|\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=h[57]|\[m7z2\] sum[1-5] |\[m7z2\] lr[1-5] |\[m7z2\] g[1-5] |\[m8b\] sum[12] |\[m8b\] ev |\[m8d\] sum[12] |\[m8d\] lr[12] |\[m8d\] probe|\[m8d\] code' " | tr -d '\r')
  BT=$(grep -a '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  ST=$(grep -a '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  MQ=$(grep -a '\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  MQW=$(grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' <<<"$MQ" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); MQW=${MQW:-}
  H5=$(GH h5); H7=$(GH h7); A=$(F1); B=$(F2); C=$(F3); XT=$(F4); RN=$(F5)
  D1=$(G8D x 1); D2=$(G8D x 2); BB=$(G8B)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${OP:-}" "${DW:-}" "${STALL:-}" "${MQW:-}" "${H5:-}" "${H7:-}" "${A:-}" "${B:-}" "${C:-}" "${XT:-}" "${RN:-}" "${D1:-}" "${D2:-}" "${BB:-}" >> "$TSV"
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 18 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    SL=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m8d\] probe|\[m8d\] code|\[m8d\] sum[12] |\[m8b\] probe|\[m8b\] code|\[m8b\] sum[12] |\[m7z2\] sum[1-5] ' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -40" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s M8D-READBACK: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$SL")"
    GI=$(h shell "grep -a -E 'obs gate main\+0x(6c7750|4b8d30|4b8cb0|4b7380)|obs gate main\+0x(4b8ea4|4b8e20|4b8e88)' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -12; echo NOTINST=$(grep -a -c 'NOT installed' $LOG 2>/dev/null)" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s gate-install lines: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$GI")"
    RB2=$(for s in smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m8c smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7h; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
    log "t=${EL}s switch readback (in-boot): $RB2"
  fi
  if [ $(( EL % 20 )) -lt 3 ]; then log "t=${EL}s frames=${FR:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?} stall=${STALL:-?} m7q_wrap=${MQW:-?} h5=${H5:-?} h7=${H7:-?} g1_site=${A:-?} g2_hits=${B:-?} g3_hits=${C:-?} g4_x8=${XT:-?} g5_x58=${RN:-?} g106=${D1:-?} g107=${D2:-?} g104=${BB:-?}"; fi
  for T in $PLAN; do if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi; done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 4
done
shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} death_t=${DEATH_T:-none} dur=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done
DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  for K in st beat m7y2 m7x2 m7w2 m7u2 m7t2 m7s2 m7q gst; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  grep -a 'obs gate' "$DL" > "$OUT/gates_install.txt" 2>/dev/null
  log "gate install lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/gates_install.txt" | tr -d ' ') NOTINST=$(grep -ac 'NOT installed' "$DL" || true)"
  for K in m8b m8d m7z2; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  for g in 1 2; do log "m8d sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m8d\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  for g in 1 2; do log "m8b sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m8b\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  for g in 1 2 3 4 5; do log "m7z2 sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m7z2\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  log "m8d code lines: $(grep -a '\[m8d\] code' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 1200)"
  log "m7z2 code lines: $(grep -a '\[m7z2\] code' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 2200)"
fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG unlock_probes=${UNLOCK_N:-0}"

```

`m8e2_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
# M8E2 (2026-11-08): THE FIRST FORK -- who decides DemoOpening vs LoadStage.
#   Static (main.patched.bin md5 89d568fd...): in main+0x4b4230
#     0x4b4bb8 bl 0x6c7b20 setNerve(0x12d0420 BootLoadData)   -> return address 0x4b4bbc (the M8D "fork entry")
#     0x4b4bbc ldr x0,[x19,#0xb8]                             A = [seq+0xb8]
#     0x4b4bc0 bl 0x4d2bd0                                    the word BEFORE the judgment
#     0x4b4bc4 tbz w0,#0,#0x4b4d2c                            THE JUDGMENT
#     0x4b4d1c..0x4b4d28 only the "bit0 == 1" side runs -> setNerve(0x12d0428 DemoOpening)
#     0x4b4d2c epilogue (ret)                                 bit0 == 0 returns here, NO DemoOpening written
#   callee 0x4d2bd0 = `ldr x8,[x0,#0x20]; ldrb w0,[x8,#0x5f8]; ret`
#     => THE JUDGMENT VALUE = bit0 of u8([[A+0x20]]+0x5f8)
#   Gates this round (ids 108..111, continuing after M8D's 107; switch smo_m8e2, C default 0):
#     108 main+0x4b4bc0 (tail=3 single bl)   A / B / raw judgment byte / tick / LR
#     109 main+0x4b4bb8 (tail=3 single bl)   ret addr IS 0x4b4bbc -> count + seq + new token + first/last tick + LR
#     110 main+0x59ac30 (tail=0 four words)  scene-graph create entry: x1 = "Stage" arg (string copied) + LR
#     111 main+0x59accc (tail=1 single ret)  same function's return: x0 = RETURN VALUE + LR
#   Baselines are byte-identical to M8D: smo_m8d=1 + smo_m8b=1 + the 18 cross-round ones + smo_m8c=0,
#   diff = { smo_m8e2 : absent -> 1 } only. smo_m8c=0 keeps the M8C injection code inert (natural state).
# usage: bash m8e2_boot_run.sh <tag e1> <target 192.168.0.111:42323> [dur=150] [gdump_sec=10]
#   SKIP_INSTALL=1 -> resume a boot without reinstalling   UNLOCK_POLL=0 -> skip unlock poll
#   KEEP_AWAKE=1   -> power-shell wakeup every 10 s during the measured boot (device style)
# Never runs `hdc kill` (it would take the other target down). Every hdc call uses -t.
# Names: m8e is ALREADY TAKEN by another round (m8e_boot_run.sh / /tmp/m8e_report.md / logs/m8e_e1|e2|e3,
#        15:09-15:19) -> this round uses the m8e2 set for all five names and never overwrites m8e.
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: bash m8e2_boot_run.sh <tag> <target> [dur] [gdump_sec]}"
TGT="${2:?target required (all hdc calls use -t)}"
DUR="${3:-150}"
GD="${4:-10}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m8e2_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
UNLOCK_POLL="${UNLOCK_POLL:-1}"
UNLOCK_MAX="${UNLOCK_MAX:-1200}"        # 20 min cap, per the round rules
KEEP_AWAKE="${KEEP_AWAKE:-1}"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M8E2 tag=$TAG target=$TGT dur=${DUR}s gdump_sec=$GD out=$OUT unlock_poll=$UNLOCK_POLL(<=${UNLOCK_MAX}s) keep_awake=$KEEP_AWAKE"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target $TGT offline"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }

# ---- unlock poll: a successful `aa start` IS the seed start too (the app constructors create
#      files/smo_m7z2, smo_m8b, smo_m8c, smo_m8d on first launch). 10106102 = locked -> do NOT try
#      to unlock, just poll every 15 s (cap 20 min, then BLOCKED per the round rules).
wait_unlock(){
  local n=0 t0=$(date +%s) out
  h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
  while :; do
    n=$((n+1))
    out=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
    local el=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))
    printf '[%s] probe #%d t=%ds %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$n" "$el" "$(echo "$out" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 160)" >> "$OUT/unlock_probe.log"
    case "$out" in
      *10106102*) : ;;
      *"start ability successfully"*|*"successfully"*) log "unlock poll: probe #$n OK at t=${el}s (of cap ${UNLOCK_MAX}s)"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 0 ;;
      *) : ;;
    esac
    [ "$el" -ge "$UNLOCK_MAX" ] && { log "X unlock poll: ${UNLOCK_MAX}s cap reached after $n probes (still 10106102) -> BLOCKED"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 1; }
    sleep 15
  done
}

stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"

if [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ]; then
  wait_unlock || { log "X device stays locked; not booting (per round rules)"; exit 2; }
  log "after unlock poll: pid=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]') files=[$(h shell "ls $FILES/ 2>/dev/null | grep -a smo_ | tr '\n' ' '" | tr -d '\r')]"
  sleep 3
  stopapp || { log "X probe pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
fi

if [ "${SKIP_INSTALL:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  log "install SKIPPED (SKIP_INSTALL=1)"
else
  T0=$(date +%s)
  OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); INST_S=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))
  log "install(${INST_S}s): $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
  UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
  log "upd_after: $UPD1"
  [ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"
fi

# ---- seed start (~7-8 s, NOT counted in the measured boot): hdc cannot CREATE a file inside the
#      app sandbox, so the app constructors must seed smo_m7z2 / smo_m8b / smo_m8c / smo_m8d once.
NEEDSEED=0
for s in smo_m7z2 smo_m8b smo_m8c smo_m8d smo_m8e2; do
  [ -z "$(h shell "ls $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && NEEDSEED=1
done
if [ "$NEEDSEED" = "1" ]; then
  log "seed start: letting the app constructors create the smo_* files"
  SEEDOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed aa start: $(echo "$SEEDOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  case "$SEEDOUT" in *10106102*) log "X seed aa start blocked: 10106102 (screen locked)"; exit 2;; esac
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  for i in $(seq 1 15); do
    [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m8e2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && break
    sleep 2
  done
  log "seed check: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m8e2 $FILES/smo_m8d $FILES/smo_m8b $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr '\n' '|')"
  [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m8e2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] || { log "X smo_m8e2 absent after seed"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X seed pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
else
  log "all smo_* present: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m8e2 $FILES/smo_m8d $FILES/smo_m8b $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr '\n' '|')"
fi

# ---- switches: 18 cross-round baselines stay 1 (byte-identical to M8D) + smo_m8e2=1 (this round's
#      four gates 108..111) + smo_m8d=1 (M8D gates 106/107) + smo_m8b=1 (M8B gates 104/105)
#      + smo_m7z2=1 (M7Z2 gates 99..103); smo_m8c stays 0 (M8C injection inert) ----
for s in smo_m8e2 smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m7g smo_m7r smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7n smo_m7p smo_m7q smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7s2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7z2; do
  h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
for s in smo_m8c smo_gpu_write smo_m7a smo_m7b smo_m7s smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7x smo_m7y smo_m7k smo_m7l smo_m7m smo_m7o smo_frz smo_ldrd smo_aud smo_sha_ungated smo_dspool smo_m7d_same; do
  h shell "[ -f $FILES/$s ] && echo 0 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $GD > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
RB=$(for s in smo_m8e2 smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m8c smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7v smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7d_same; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
RB="$RB gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"
log "switch readback (pre-boot): $RB"
for s in smo_m8e2 smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r; do
  V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "1" ] || { log "X $s not 1, abort"; exit 1; }
done
V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m8c" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "0" ] || log "!! smo_m8c=$V (expected 0: no injection this round)"

h shell "printf '' > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "log truncated: bytes=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG" | tr -dc '0-9')"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m8e2_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m8e2_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
case "$STARTOUT" in
  *10106102*) log "X boot aa start blocked 10106102 -> re-entering unlock poll"
              [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ] && { wait_unlock || { log "X locked again; BLOCKED"; exit 2; }; sleep 3; stopapp; STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r'); } ;;
esac
log "boot aa start: $(echo "$STARTOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
START=$(date +%s); CURPID=""; PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0; LASTWAKE=0; XT_SAVED=""
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"; printf 't\tframes\tsubmit\topens\tdraws\tstall\tm7q_wrap\th5\th7\tg1_site\tg2_hits\tg3_hits\tg4_x8\tg5_x58\tm8d_g106\tm8d_g107\tm8b_g104\n' > "$TSV"
PLAN="30 120"
GA(){ grep -a "\[m7u2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
SU(){ grep -a "\[m7z2\] sum$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1; }
F1(){ SU 1 | grep -o 'site_hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F2(){ SU 2 | grep -o ' hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F3(){ SU 3 | grep -o ' hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F4(){ SU 4 | grep -o 'last_x8=[^ ]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F5(){ SU 5 | grep -o 'last_c=[^ ]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
G8D(){ grep -a "\[m8d\] sum$2 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
G8B(){ grep -a "\[m8b\] sum1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
G8E(){ grep -a "\[m8e2\] sum$2 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
GH(){ grep -a "\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  if [ "$KEEP_AWAKE" = "1" ] && [ $(( EL - LASTWAKE )) -ge 10 ]; then
    LASTWAKE=$EL; h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  PP=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$PP" ]; then DEADN=$(( ${DEADN:-0} + 1 )); else DEADN=0; fi
  if [ "${DEADN:-0}" -ge 2 ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> - app died during the boot; stopping this run"
    shot "$EL" "tdeath"
    h shell "ls -t /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null | head -3" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    DEATH_T=$EL; break
  fi
  [ -z "$CURPID" ] && { P="$PP"; [ -n "$P" ] && { CURPID=$P; log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; }; }
  RAW=$(h shell "tail -n 4000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[beat\]|\[st\] t=|\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap|\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=h[57]|\[m7z2\] sum[1-5] |\[m7z2\] lr[1-5] |\[m7z2\] g[1-5] |\[m8b\] sum[12] |\[m8b\] ev |\[m8d\] sum[12] |\[m8d\] lr[12] |\[m8d\] probe|\[m8d\] code|\[m8e2\] probe|\[m8e2\] code|\[m8e2\] sum[1-4] |\[m8e2\] judge|\[m8e2\] ev|\[m8e2\] lr[1-4] ' " | tr -d '\r')
  BT=$(grep -a '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  ST=$(grep -a '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  MQ=$(grep -a '\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  MQW=$(grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' <<<"$MQ" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); MQW=${MQW:-}
  H5=$(GH h5); H7=$(GH h7); A=$(F1); B=$(F2); C=$(F3); XT=$(F4); RN=$(F5)
  D1=$(G8D x 1); D2=$(G8D x 2); BB=$(G8B)
  E1=$(G8E x 1); E4=$(G8E x 4); EJ=$(grep -a "\[m8e2\] judge " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o "raw_byte=[^ ]* bit0=[0-9]*" | head -1)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${OP:-}" "${DW:-}" "${STALL:-}" "${MQW:-}" "${H5:-}" "${H7:-}" "${A:-}" "${B:-}" "${C:-}" "${XT:-}" "${RN:-}" "${D1:-}" "${D2:-}" "${BB:-}" >> "$TSV"
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 18 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    SL=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m8e2\] probe|\[m8e2\] code|\[m8e2\] sum[1-4] |\[m8e2\] judge|\[m8d\] probe|\[m8d\] code|\[m8d\] sum[12] |\[m8b\] probe|\[m8b\] code|\[m8b\] sum[12] |\[m7z2\] sum[1-5] ' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -40" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s M8E2-READBACK: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$SL")"
    GI=$(h shell "grep -a -E 'obs gate main\+0x(4b4bc0|4b4bb8|59ac30|59accc|6c7750|4b8d30|4b8cb0|4b7380)|obs gate main\+0x(4b8ea4|4b8e20|4b8e88)' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -12; echo NOTINST=$(grep -a -c 'NOT installed' $LOG 2>/dev/null)" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s gate-install lines: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$GI")"
    RB2=$(for s in smo_m8e2 smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m8c smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7h; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
    log "t=${EL}s switch readback (in-boot): $RB2"
  fi
  if [ $(( EL % 20 )) -lt 3 ]; then log "t=${EL}s frames=${FR:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?} stall=${STALL:-?} m7q_wrap=${MQW:-?} h5=${H5:-?} h7=${H7:-?} g1_site=${A:-?} g2_hits=${B:-?} g3_hits=${C:-?} g4_x8=${XT:-?} g5_x58=${RN:-?} g106=${D1:-?} g107=${D2:-?} g104=${BB:-?} m8e2_g108=${E1:-?} m8e2_g111=${E4:-?} m8e2_judge=${EJ:-?}"; fi
  for T in $PLAN; do if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi; done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 4
done
shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} death_t=${DEATH_T:-none} dur=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done
DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  for K in st beat m7y2 m7x2 m7w2 m7u2 m7t2 m7s2 m7q gst; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  grep -a 'obs gate' "$DL" > "$OUT/gates_install.txt" 2>/dev/null
  log "gate install lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/gates_install.txt" | tr -d ' ') NOTINST=$(grep -ac 'NOT installed' "$DL" || true)"
  for K in m8b m8d m8e2 m7z2; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  for g in 1 2; do log "m8d sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m8d\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  for g in 1 2 3 4; do log "m8e2 sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m8e2\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  log "m8e2 judge: $(grep -a '\[m8e2\] judge ' "$DL" | tail -1)"
  log "m8e2 ev lines: $(grep -ac '\[m8e2\] ev' "$DL" || true)"
  log "m8e2 code lines: $(grep -a '\[m8e2\] code' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 2200)"
  for g in 1 2; do log "m8b sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m8b\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  for g in 1 2 3 4 5; do log "m7z2 sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m7z2\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  log "m8d code lines: $(grep -a '\[m8d\] code' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 1200)"
  log "m7z2 code lines: $(grep -a '\[m7z2\] code' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 2200)"
fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG unlock_probes=${UNLOCK_N:-0}"

```

`m8e_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
# M8D (2026-11-08): REAL-DEVICE ROUND 1 -- one build, one install, one <=150 s boot that harvests
#   (a) the DEVICE nerve timeline (M8B's gates id 104 main+0x6c7750 / id 105 main+0x4b8d30, reused
#       unchanged) and (b) the M7Z2 "leg A / leg B" split (M7Z2's G3 id 101 main+0x4b8ea4 LR decides it).
#   New this round (switch smo_m8d, C default 0): the TWO TWIN TABLE-BINDER gates
#     G1 id 106 main+0x4b8cb0 -> binds nerve table 0x12d0fe8 (FirstSequence family)
#     G2 id 107 main+0x4b7380 -> binds nerve table 0x12d06d8 (TitleMenu family)
#   both with ZERO static bl/b callers, so hits>0 proves that family's HostType instance was built.
#   smo_m8c is forced to 0: the M8C conditional-injection code is in this tree, and with 0 the
#   observer returns 0 and x1 keeps its original value (byte-identical to M8B: natural state only).
# usage: bash m8d_boot_run.sh <tag d1> <target 192.168.0.111:42323> [dur=150] [gdump_sec=10]
#   SKIP_INSTALL=1 -> resume a boot without reinstalling   UNLOCK_POLL=0 -> skip unlock poll
#   KEEP_AWAKE=1   -> power-shell wakeup every 10 s during the measured boot (device style)
# Never runs `hdc kill` (it would take the other target down). Every hdc call uses -t.
# Names: m8d / smo_m8d / [m8d] / m8d_boot_run.sh / logs/m8d_* -- five-name check all-clear 15:06.
# Baseline switches: byte-identical to M8B (18 ones + 3 zeros), diff = {smo_m8d: ->1, smo_m8c: ->0}.
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: bash m8d_boot_run.sh <tag> <target> [dur] [gdump_sec]}"
TGT="${2:?target required (all hdc calls use -t)}"
DUR="${3:-150}"
GD="${4:-10}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m8e_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
UNLOCK_POLL="${UNLOCK_POLL:-1}"
UNLOCK_MAX="${UNLOCK_MAX:-1200}"        # 20 min cap, per the round rules
KEEP_AWAKE="${KEEP_AWAKE:-1}"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M8D tag=$TAG target=$TGT dur=${DUR}s gdump_sec=$GD out=$OUT unlock_poll=$UNLOCK_POLL(<=${UNLOCK_MAX}s) keep_awake=$KEEP_AWAKE"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target $TGT offline"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }

# ---- unlock poll: a successful `aa start` IS the seed start too (the app constructors create
#      files/smo_m7z2, smo_m8b, smo_m8c, smo_m8d on first launch). 10106102 = locked -> do NOT try
#      to unlock, just poll every 15 s (cap 20 min, then BLOCKED per the round rules).
wait_unlock(){
  local n=0 t0=$(date +%s) out
  h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
  while :; do
    n=$((n+1))
    out=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
    local el=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))
    printf '[%s] probe #%d t=%ds %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$n" "$el" "$(echo "$out" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 160)" >> "$OUT/unlock_probe.log"
    case "$out" in
      *10106102*) : ;;
      *"start ability successfully"*|*"successfully"*) log "unlock poll: probe #$n OK at t=${el}s (of cap ${UNLOCK_MAX}s)"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 0 ;;
      *) : ;;
    esac
    [ "$el" -ge "$UNLOCK_MAX" ] && { log "X unlock poll: ${UNLOCK_MAX}s cap reached after $n probes (still 10106102) -> BLOCKED"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 1; }
    sleep 15
  done
}

stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"

if [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ]; then
  wait_unlock || { log "X device stays locked; not booting (per round rules)"; exit 2; }
  log "after unlock poll: pid=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]') files=[$(h shell "ls $FILES/ 2>/dev/null | grep -a smo_ | tr '\n' ' '" | tr -d '\r')]"
  sleep 3
  stopapp || { log "X probe pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
fi

if [ "${SKIP_INSTALL:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  log "install SKIPPED (SKIP_INSTALL=1)"
else
  T0=$(date +%s)
  OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); INST_S=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))
  log "install(${INST_S}s): $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
  UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
  log "upd_after: $UPD1"
  [ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"
fi

# ---- seed start (~7-8 s, NOT counted in the measured boot): hdc cannot CREATE a file inside the
#      app sandbox, so the app constructors must seed smo_m7z2 / smo_m8b / smo_m8c / smo_m8d once.
NEEDSEED=0
for s in smo_m7z2 smo_m8b smo_m8c smo_m8d; do
  [ -z "$(h shell "ls $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && NEEDSEED=1
done
if [ "$NEEDSEED" = "1" ]; then
  log "seed start: letting the app constructors create the smo_* files"
  SEEDOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed aa start: $(echo "$SEEDOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  case "$SEEDOUT" in *10106102*) log "X seed aa start blocked: 10106102 (screen locked)"; exit 2;; esac
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  for i in $(seq 1 15); do
    [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m8d 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && break
    sleep 2
  done
  log "seed check: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m8d $FILES/smo_m8b $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr '\n' '|')"
  [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m8d 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] || { log "X smo_m8d absent after seed"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X seed pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
else
  log "all smo_* present: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m8d $FILES/smo_m8b $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr '\n' '|')"
fi

# ---- switches: 18 cross-round baselines stay 1 (byte-identical to M8B) + smo_m8d=1 (this round's
#      two binder gates) + smo_m8b=1 (M8B gates 104/105) + smo_m7z2=1 (M7Z2 gates 99..103) ----
for s in smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m7g smo_m7r smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7n smo_m7p smo_m7q smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7s2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7z2; do
  h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
for s in smo_m8c smo_gpu_write smo_m7a smo_m7b smo_m7s smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7x smo_m7y smo_m7k smo_m7l smo_m7m smo_m7o smo_frz smo_ldrd smo_aud smo_sha_ungated smo_dspool smo_m7d_same; do
  h shell "[ -f $FILES/$s ] && echo 0 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $GD > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
RB=$(for s in smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m8c smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7v smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7d_same; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
RB="$RB gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"
log "switch readback (pre-boot): $RB"
for s in smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r; do
  V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "1" ] || { log "X $s not 1, abort"; exit 1; }
done
V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m8c" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "0" ] || log "!! smo_m8c=$V (expected 0: no injection this round)"

h shell "printf '' > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "log truncated: bytes=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG" | tr -dc '0-9')"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m8d_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m8d_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
case "$STARTOUT" in
  *10106102*) log "X boot aa start blocked 10106102 -> re-entering unlock poll"
              [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ] && { wait_unlock || { log "X locked again; BLOCKED"; exit 2; }; sleep 3; stopapp; STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r'); } ;;
esac
log "boot aa start: $(echo "$STARTOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
START=$(date +%s); CURPID=""; PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0; LASTWAKE=0; XT_SAVED=""
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"; printf 't\tframes\tsubmit\topens\tdraws\tstall\tm7q_wrap\th5\th7\tg1_site\tg2_hits\tg3_hits\tg4_x8\tg5_x58\tm8d_g106\tm8d_g107\tm8b_g104\n' > "$TSV"
PLAN="30 120"
GA(){ grep -a "\[m7u2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
SU(){ grep -a "\[m7z2\] sum$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1; }

F2(){ SU 2 | grep -o ' hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F3(){ SU 3 | grep -o ' hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F4(){ SU 4 | grep -o 'last_x8=[^ ]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F5(){ SU 5 | grep -o 'last_c=[^ ]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
G8D(){ grep -a "\[m8d\] sum$2 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
G8B(){ grep -a "\[m8b\] sum1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
GH(){ grep -a "\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  if [ "$KEEP_AWAKE" = "1" ] && [ $(( EL - LASTWAKE )) -ge 10 ]; then
    LASTWAKE=$EL; h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  PP=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$PP" ]; then DEADN=$(( ${DEADN:-0} + 1 )); else DEADN=0; fi
  if [ "${DEADN:-0}" -ge 2 ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> - app died during the boot; stopping this run"
    shot "$EL" "tdeath"
    h shell "ls -t /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null | head -3" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    DEATH_T=$EL; break
  fi
  [ -z "$CURPID" ] && { P="$PP"; [ -n "$P" ] && { CURPID=$P; log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; }; }
  RAW=$(h shell "tail -n 4000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[beat\]|\[st\] t=|\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap|\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=h[57]|\[m7z2\] sum[1-5] |\[m7z2\] lr[1-5] |\[m7z2\] g[1-5] |\[m8b\] sum[12] |\[m8b\] ev |\[m8d\] sum[12] |\[m8d\] lr[12] |\[m8d\] probe|\[m8d\] code' " | tr -d '\r')
  BT=$(grep -a '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  ST=$(grep -a '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  MQ=$(grep -a '\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  MQW=$(grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' <<<"$MQ" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); MQW=${MQW:-}
  H5=$(GH h5); H7=$(GH h7); A=$(F1); B=$(F2); C=$(F3); XT=$(F4); RN=$(F5)
  D1=$(G8D x 1); D2=$(G8D x 2); BB=$(G8B)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${OP:-}" "${DW:-}" "${STALL:-}" "${MQW:-}" "${H5:-}" "${H7:-}" "${A:-}" "${B:-}" "${C:-}" "${XT:-}" "${RN:-}" "${D1:-}" "${D2:-}" "${BB:-}" >> "$TSV"
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 18 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    SL=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m8d\] probe|\[m8d\] code|\[m8d\] sum[12] |\[m8b\] probe|\[m8b\] code|\[m8b\] sum[12] |\[m7z2\] sum[1-5] ' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -40" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s M8D-READBACK: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$SL")"
    GI=$(h shell "grep -a -E 'obs gate main\+0x(6c7750|4b8d30|4b8cb0|4b7380)|obs gate main\+0x(4b8ea4|4b8e20|4b8e88)' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -12; echo NOTINST=$(grep -a -c 'NOT installed' $LOG 2>/dev/null)" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s gate-install lines: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$GI")"
    RB2=$(for s in smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m8c smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7h; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
    log "t=${EL}s switch readback (in-boot): $RB2"
  fi
  if [ $(( EL % 20 )) -lt 3 ]; then log "t=${EL}s frames=${FR:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?} stall=${STALL:-?} m7q_wrap=${MQW:-?} h5=${H5:-?} h7=${H7:-?} g1_site=${A:-?} g2_hits=${B:-?} g3_hits=${C:-?} g4_x8=${XT:-?} g5_x58=${RN:-?} g106=${D1:-?} g107=${D2:-?} g104=${BB:-?}"; fi
  for T in $PLAN; do if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi; done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 4
done
shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} death_t=${DEATH_T:-none} dur=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done
DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  for K in st beat m7y2 m7x2 m7w2 m7u2 m7t2 m7s2 m7q gst; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  grep -a 'obs gate' "$DL" > "$OUT/gates_install.txt" 2>/dev/null
  log "gate install lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/gates_install.txt" | tr -d ' ') NOTINST=$(grep -ac 'NOT installed' "$DL" || true)"
  for K in m8b m8d m7z2; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  for g in 1 2; do log "m8d sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m8d\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  for g in 1 2; do log "m8b sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m8b\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  for g in 1 2 3 4 5; do log "m7z2 sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m7z2\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  log "m8d code lines: $(grep -a '\[m8d\] code' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 1200)"
  log "m7z2 code lines: $(grep -a '\[m7z2\] code' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 2200)"
fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG unlock_probes=${UNLOCK_N:-0}"

```

`m9c_boot_run.sh`:

```sh
# M9C (2026-11-08): EMULATOR round -- turn the FORK CRITERION bit0 from inference into an on-machine
#   reading. Gates 108..111 (switch smo_m8e2): 108 = main+0x4b4bc0 (the bl immediately before
#   `tbz w0,#0` at 0x4b4bc4) reads the judgment byte u8([[seq+0xb8]+0x20]+0x5f8); 109 = the fork
#   entry itself (ret addr 0x4b4bbc).  Only target: emulator 127.0.0.1:5555. Real device OFF-LIMITS.
# ---- original M8D header below ----
# M8D (2026-11-08): REAL-DEVICE ROUND 1 -- one build, one install, one <=150 s boot that harvests
#   (a) the DEVICE nerve timeline (M8B's gates id 104 main+0x6c7750 / id 105 main+0x4b8d30, reused
#       unchanged) and (b) the M7Z2 "leg A / leg B" split (M7Z2's G3 id 101 main+0x4b8ea4 LR decides it).
#   New this round (switch smo_m8d, C default 0): the TWO TWIN TABLE-BINDER gates
#     G1 id 106 main+0x4b8cb0 -> binds nerve table 0x12d0fe8 (FirstSequence family)
#     G2 id 107 main+0x4b7380 -> binds nerve table 0x12d06d8 (TitleMenu family)
#   both with ZERO static bl/b callers, so hits>0 proves that family's HostType instance was built.
#   smo_m8c is forced to 0: the M8C conditional-injection code is in this tree, and with 0 the
#   observer returns 0 and x1 keeps its original value (byte-identical to M8B: natural state only).
# usage: bash m8d_boot_run.sh <tag d1> <target 192.168.0.111:42323> [dur=150] [gdump_sec=10]
#   SKIP_INSTALL=1 -> resume a boot without reinstalling   UNLOCK_POLL=0 -> skip unlock poll
#   KEEP_AWAKE=1   -> power-shell wakeup every 10 s during the measured boot (device style)
# Never runs `hdc kill` (it would take the other target down). Every hdc call uses -t.
# Names: m8d / smo_m8d / [m8d] / m8d_boot_run.sh / logs/m8d_* -- five-name check all-clear 15:06.
# Baseline switches: byte-identical to M8B (18 ones + 3 zeros), diff = {smo_m8d: ->1, smo_m8c: ->0}.
set -uo pipefail
TAG="${1:?usage: bash m8d_boot_run.sh <tag> <target> [dur] [gdump_sec]}"
TGT="${2:?target required (all hdc calls use -t)}"
DUR="${3:-150}"
GD="${4:-10}"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="/tmp/m9c_build/entry.hap"   # M9C: PRIVATE copy, immune to other people rebuilding the tree
OUT="$ROOT/logs/m9c_$TAG"
FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
LOG="$FILES/vk_boot.log"
UNLOCK_POLL="${UNLOCK_POLL:-1}"
UNLOCK_MAX="${UNLOCK_MAX:-1200}"        # 20 min cap, per the round rules
KEEP_AWAKE="${KEEP_AWAKE:-1}"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }
h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }

log "=== M8D tag=$TAG target=$TGT dur=${DUR}s gdump_sec=$GD out=$OUT unlock_poll=$UNLOCK_POLL(<=${UNLOCK_MAX}s) keep_awake=$KEEP_AWAKE"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target $TGT offline"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") mtime=$(stat -f%Sm "$HAP")"
# ---- M9C anti-collision (0/3): record EVERY placeholder in /tmp (ours + any other round's). ----
log "tmp placeholders: $(for f in /tmp/*_building /tmp/m8*_go /tmp/m9*_go; do [ -e "$f" ] && printf '%s@%s ' "$(basename "$f")" "$(stat -f '%Sm' -t '%H:%M:%S' "$f")"; done)"

stopapp(){ for i in 1 2 3; do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -z "$P" ] && return 0; h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done; return 1; }

# ---- unlock poll: a successful `aa start` IS the seed start too (the app constructors create
#      files/smo_m7z2, smo_m8b, smo_m8c, smo_m8d on first launch). 10106102 = locked -> do NOT try
#      to unlock, just poll every 15 s (cap 20 min, then BLOCKED per the round rules).
wait_unlock(){
  local n=0 t0=$(date +%s) out
  h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
  while :; do
    n=$((n+1))
    out=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
    local el=$(( $(date +%s) - t0 ))
    printf '[%s] probe #%d t=%ds %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$n" "$el" "$(echo "$out" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 160)" >> "$OUT/unlock_probe.log"
    case "$out" in
      *10106102*) : ;;
      *"start ability successfully"*|*"successfully"*) log "unlock poll: probe #$n OK at t=${el}s (of cap ${UNLOCK_MAX}s)"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 0 ;;
      *) : ;;
    esac
    [ "$el" -ge "$UNLOCK_MAX" ] && { log "X unlock poll: ${UNLOCK_MAX}s cap reached after $n probes (still 10106102) -> BLOCKED"; UNLOCK_N=$n; return 1; }
    sleep 15
  done
}

# ---- M9C anti-collision (1/3): if ANOTHER round already owns the device, do NOT force-stop it.
#      Wait up to 120 s for that pid to go away by itself; if it does not, abort rather than collide.
P0=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
if [ -n "$P0" ]; then
  log "PRE: foreign pid=$P0 already on device -> waiting up to 120 s for it to vanish (NOT force-stopping it)"
  n=0
  while [ "$n" -lt 24 ]; do
    sleep 5; n=$((n+1))
    P0=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -z "$P0" ] && { log "PRE: foreign pid gone after $((n*5))s"; break; }
  done
  if [ -n "$P0" ]; then log "X PRE: pid=$P0 still alive after 120 s -> ABORT (a concurrent round owns the device)"; exit 3; fi
else
  log "PRE: device idle (no pid) -> clean to install"
fi

stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }

UPD0=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
log "upd_before: $UPD0"

if [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ]; then
  wait_unlock || { log "X device stays locked; not booting (per round rules)"; exit 2; }
  log "after unlock poll: pid=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]') files=[$(h shell "ls $FILES/ 2>/dev/null | grep -a smo_ | tr '\n' ' '" | tr -d '\r')]"
  sleep 3
  stopapp || { log "X probe pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
fi

if [ "${SKIP_INSTALL:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  log "install SKIPPED (SKIP_INSTALL=1)"
else
  T0=$(date +%s)
  OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); INST_S=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))
  log "install(${INST_S}s): $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
  UPD1=$(h shell "bm dump -n $BUNDLE 2>/dev/null | grep -i updateTime" | tr -d '\r' | head -1)
  log "upd_after: $UPD1"
  [ "$UPD0" = "$UPD1" ] && log "!! updateTime unchanged - suspicious"
fi

# ---- seed start (~7-8 s, NOT counted in the measured boot): hdc cannot CREATE a file inside the
#      app sandbox, so the app constructors must seed smo_m7z2 / smo_m8b / smo_m8c / smo_m8d once.
NEEDSEED=0
for s in smo_m7z2 smo_m8b smo_m8c smo_m8d smo_m8e2; do
  [ -z "$(h shell "ls $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && NEEDSEED=1
done
if [ "$NEEDSEED" = "1" ]; then
  log "seed start: letting the app constructors create the smo_* files"
  SEEDOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
  log "seed aa start: $(echo "$SEEDOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
  case "$SEEDOUT" in *10106102*) log "X seed aa start blocked: 10106102 (screen locked)"; exit 2;; esac
  SEEDT=$(date +%s)
  while :; do
    EL=$(( $(date +%s) - SEEDT )); P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -n "$P" ] && { log "seed launch pid=$P at t=${EL}s"; break; }
    [ "$EL" -ge 60 ] && { log "X seed launch: no pid in 60s"; exit 1; }
    sleep 2
  done
  for i in $(seq 1 15); do
    [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m8d 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] && break
    sleep 2
  done
  log "seed check: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m8d $FILES/smo_m8b $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr '\n' '|')"
  [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m8d 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] || { log "X smo_m8d absent after seed"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/smo_m8e2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ] || { log "X smo_m8e2 absent after seed"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X seed pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
else
  log "all smo_* present: $(h shell "ls -l $FILES/smo_m8d $FILES/smo_m8b $FILES/smo_m7z2 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r' | tr '\n' '|')"
fi

# ---- switches: 18 cross-round baselines stay 1 (byte-identical to M8B) + smo_m8d=1 (this round's
#      two binder gates) + smo_m8b=1 (M8B gates 104/105) + smo_m7z2=1 (M7Z2 gates 99..103) ----
for s in smo_m8e2 smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m7g smo_m7r smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7n smo_m7p smo_m7q smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7s2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7z2; do
  h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
for s in smo_m8c smo_gpu_write smo_m7a smo_m7b smo_m7s smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7x smo_m7y smo_m7k smo_m7l smo_m7m smo_m7o smo_frz smo_ldrd smo_aud smo_sha_ungated smo_dspool smo_m7d_same; do
  h shell "[ -f $FILES/$s ] && echo 0 > $FILES/$s" >/dev/null 2>&1
done
h shell "echo 1 > $FILES/smo_game_rt; echo 1 > $FILES/smo_our_present; echo -1 > $FILES/smo_present_slot" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo 0 > $FILES/smo_rss_guard; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_mem_purge; echo 0 > $FILES/smo_gdump" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "echo $GD > $FILES/smo_gdump_sec" >/dev/null 2>&1
RB=$(for s in smo_m8e2 smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m8c smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7v smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r smo_m7t smo_m7t_pos smo_m7d_same; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
RB="$RB gdump_sec=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_gdump_sec 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n')"
log "switch readback (pre-boot): $RB"
for s in smo_m8e2 smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7x2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7u2 smo_m7t2 smo_m7s2 smo_m7q smo_m7p smo_m7w smo_m7h smo_m7n smo_m7g smo_m7c smo_m7e smo_m7u smo_m7r; do
  V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "1" ] || { log "X $s not 1, abort"; exit 1; }
done
V=$(h shell "cat $FILES/smo_m8c" | tr -d '\r'); [ "$V" = "0" ] || log "!! smo_m8c=$V (expected 0: no injection this round)"

h shell "printf '' > $LOG" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "log truncated: bytes=$(h shell "wc -c < $LOG" | tr -dc '0-9')"
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1
CFLIST0=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')

shot(){
  h shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/m8d_$TAG$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  h file recv "/data/local/tmp/m8d_$TAG$2.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  if sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$2.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$2.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "screen_$2 md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$2.png") bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/screen_$2.png") @t=$1 s"
  else log "X screen_$2 capture failed @t=$1 s"; fi
}

STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
case "$STARTOUT" in
  *10106102*) log "X boot aa start blocked 10106102 -> re-entering unlock poll"
              [ "$UNLOCK_POLL" = "1" ] && { wait_unlock || { log "X locked again; BLOCKED"; exit 2; }; sleep 3; stopapp; STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r'); } ;;
esac
log "boot aa start: $(echo "$STARTOUT" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 200)"
START=$(date +%s); CURPID=""; PROBE_READ=0; LASTSHOT=0; LASTWAKE=0; XT_SAVED=""; CONCURRENT=0
# ---- M9C anti-collision (2/3): grab OUR pid, then re-check at t=2 s and t=10 s. A changed pid means
#      somebody else reinstalled/restarted the app under us => this boot is INVALID for conclusions.
MYPID=""
for i in $(seq 1 12); do
  MYPID=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -n "$MYPID" ] && break
  sleep 1
done
log "boot pid (ours) = ${MYPID:-<none>} at t=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"
for T in 2 10; do
  while [ $(( $(date +%s) - START )) -lt "$T" ]; do sleep 1; done
  PN=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ "$PN" != "$MYPID" ]; then
    CONCURRENT=1
    log "X CONCURRENT INTERFERENCE at t=${T}s: pid ${MYPID:-<none>} -> ${PN:-<none>} => boot INVALID"
    break
  fi
  log "pid stable at t=${T}s: $PN (ours)"
done
TSV="$OUT/series.tsv"; printf 't\tframes\tsubmit\topens\tdraws\tstall\tm7q_wrap\th5\th7\tg1_site\tg2_hits\tg3_hits\tg4_x8\tg5_x58\tm8d_g106\tm8d_g107\tm8b_g104\n' > "$TSV"
PLAN="30 120"
GA(){ grep -a "\[m7u2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
SU(){ grep -a "\[m7z2\] sum$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1; }
F1(){ SU 1 | grep -o 'site_hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F2(){ SU 2 | grep -o ' hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F3(){ SU 3 | grep -o ' hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F4(){ SU 4 | grep -o 'last_x8=[^ ]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
F5(){ SU 5 | grep -o 'last_c=[^ ]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
G8D(){ grep -a "\[m8d\] sum$2 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
G8B(){ grep -a "\[m8b\] sum1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'hits=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
GH(){ grep -a "\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=$1 " <<<"$RAW" | tail -1 | grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' | head -1 | cut -d= -f2; }
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  if [ "$KEEP_AWAKE" = "1" ] && [ $(( EL - LASTWAKE )) -ge 10 ]; then
    LASTWAKE=$EL; h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  fi
  PP=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$PP" ]; then DEADN=$(( ${DEADN:-0} + 1 )); else DEADN=0; fi
  if [ "${DEADN:-0}" -ge 2 ]; then
    log "t=${EL}s pid=<dead> - app died during the boot; stopping this run"
    shot "$EL" "tdeath"
    h shell "ls -t /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null | head -3" | tr -d '\r' > "$OUT/faultlog_at_death.txt"
    DEATH_T=$EL; break
  fi
  [ -z "$CURPID" ] && { P="$PP"; [ -n "$P" ] && { CURPID=$P; log "t=${EL}s pid=$P (first seen)"; }; }
  RAW=$(h shell "tail -n 4000 $LOG 2>/dev/null | grep -a -E '\[beat\]|\[st\] t=|\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap|\[m7t2\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=h[57]|\[m7z2\] sum[1-5] |\[m7z2\] lr[1-5] |\[m7z2\] g[1-5] |\[m8b\] sum[12] |\[m8b\] ev |\[m8d\] sum[12] |\[m8d\] lr[12] |\[m8d\] probe|\[m8d\] code|\[m8e2\] sum[1-4] |\[m8e2\] lr[1-4] |\[m8e2\] ev[1-4] |\[m8e2\] probe|\[m8e2\] code|\[m8e2\] judge' " | tr -d '\r')
  BT=$(grep -a '\[beat\]' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  ST=$(grep -a '\[st\] t=' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  MQ=$(grep -a '\[m7q\] sum t=[0-9]*s g=wrap' <<<"$RAW" | tail -1)
  FR=$(grep -o 'frames=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); FR=${FR:-}
  SUB=$(grep -o 'nvn_submit=[0-9]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); SUB=${SUB:-}
  STALL=$(grep -o 'stall=[0-9.-]*' <<<"$BT" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); STALL=${STALL:-}
  OP=$(grep -o 'opens=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); OP=${OP:-}
  DW=$(grep -o 'draws=[0-9]*' <<<"$ST" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); DW=${DW:-}
  MQW=$(grep -o 'tot=[0-9]*' <<<"$MQ" | head -1 | cut -d= -f2); MQW=${MQW:-}
  H5=$(GH h5); H7=$(GH h7); A=$(F1); B=$(F2); C=$(F3); XT=$(F4); RN=$(F5)
  D1=$(G8D x 1); D2=$(G8D x 2); BB=$(G8B)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$EL" "${FR:-}" "${SUB:-}" "${OP:-}" "${DW:-}" "${STALL:-}" "${MQW:-}" "${H5:-}" "${H7:-}" "${A:-}" "${B:-}" "${C:-}" "${XT:-}" "${RN:-}" "${D1:-}" "${D2:-}" "${BB:-}" >> "$TSV"
  if [ "$PROBE_READ" -eq 0 ] && [ "$EL" -ge 18 ]; then
    PROBE_READ=1
    SL=$(h shell "grep -a -E '\[m8d\] probe|\[m8d\] code|\[m8d\] sum[12] |\[m8b\] probe|\[m8b\] code|\[m8b\] sum[12] |\[m7z2\] sum[1-5] ' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -40" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s M8D-READBACK: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$SL")"
    GI=$(h shell "grep -a -E 'obs gate main\+0x(6c7750|4b8d30|4b8cb0|4b7380)|obs gate main\+0x(4b8ea4|4b8e20|4b8e88)' $LOG 2>/dev/null | head -12; echo NOTINST=$(grep -a -c 'NOT installed' $LOG 2>/dev/null)" | tr -d '\r')
    log "t=${EL}s gate-install lines: $(tr '\n' '|' <<<"$GI")"
    RB2=$(for s in smo_m8d smo_m8b smo_m8c smo_m7z2 smo_m7y2 smo_m7w2 smo_m7h; do printf '%s=%s ' "$s" "$(h shell "cat $FILES/$s" | tr -d '\r\n')"; done)
    log "t=${EL}s switch readback (in-boot): $RB2"
  fi
  if [ $(( EL % 20 )) -lt 3 ]; then log "t=${EL}s frames=${FR:-?} submit=${SUB:-?} opens=${OP:-?} draws=${DW:-?} stall=${STALL:-?} m7q_wrap=${MQW:-?} h5=${H5:-?} h7=${H7:-?} g1_site=${A:-?} g2_hits=${B:-?} g3_hits=${C:-?} g4_x8=${XT:-?} g5_x58=${RN:-?} g106=${D1:-?} g107=${D2:-?} g104=${BB:-?}"; fi
  for T in $PLAN; do if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL" "t$T"; fi; done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  sleep 4
done
shot "$(( $(date +%s) - START ))" "fin"
ALIVE=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); log "alive at end: ${ALIVE:-<dead>} death_t=${DEATH_T:-none} dur=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

CFLIST1=$(h shell "ls /data/log/faultlog/faultlogger/ 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')
printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" > "$OUT/faultlog_after.txt"
log "faultlog new=$(comm -13 <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST0" | sort) <(printf '%s\n' "$CFLIST1" | sort) | grep -c . || true)"

for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$LOG" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 3; done
DL="$OUT/vk_boot.log"
if [ -f "$DL" ]; then
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$DL" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$DL" | tr -d ' ')"
  for K in st beat m7y2 m7x2 m7w2 m7u2 m7t2 m7s2 m7q gst; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  grep -a 'obs gate' "$DL" > "$OUT/gates_install.txt" 2>/dev/null
  log "gate install lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/gates_install.txt" | tr -d ' ') NOTINST=$(grep -ac 'NOT installed' "$DL" || true)"
  for K in m8b m8d m7z2 m8e2; do grep -a "\[$K\]" "$DL" > "$OUT/$K.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "[$K] lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/$K.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; done
  for g in 1 2; do log "m8d sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m8d\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  for g in 1 2 3 4; do log "m8e2 sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m8e2\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  log "m8e2 judge lines: $(grep -a "\[m8e2\] judge" "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 1500)"
  for g in 1 2; do log "m8b sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m8b\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  for g in 1 2 3 4 5; do log "m7z2 sum$g: $(grep -a "\[m7z2\] sum$g " "$DL" | tail -1)"; done
  log "m8d code lines: $(grep -a '\[m8d\] code' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 1200)"
  log "m7z2 code lines: $(grep -a '\[m7z2\] code' "$DL" | tr '\n' '|' | tail -c 2200)"
fi
h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "=== done tag=$TAG unlock_probes=${UNLOCK_N:-0} concurrent_interference=${CONCURRENT:-?}"

```

`mario-odessy-harmony/entry/src/main/cpp/CMakeLists.txt`:

```txt
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(game C CXX ASM)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
# OHOS CMake 会给目标名加 lib 前缀：NODE_MODULE 必须是 game（产物 libgame.so），
# 与 Index.ets import 'libgame.so'、XComponent libraryname:'game'、nm_modname "game" 对齐。
# 此前写 libgame 产物为 liblibgame.so，导致 MUSL-LDSO: load libgame.so failed errno=2（boot_round1）。
set(NODE_MODULE game)

# 游戏选择单变量：platform/ = 引擎（Switch 系统服务/装载/HLE/兼容层，换游戏零改动），
# games/<tid> = 游戏专属（镜像表/补丁/版本身份/标题自动化 + game_env.c）。
# TOTK 落地时唯一必改行：把目录名换成新 title-id。
set(GAME_DIR games/0100000000010000)

# OHOS Vulkan：NDK 自带 vulkan 头与 libvulkan.so
find_library(VULKAN_LIB vulkan)
find_library(HLOG_LIB hilog_ndk.z)
find_library(ACE_NAPI ace_napi.z)
# round7：虚拟默认输出设备的真机出口（ohos_stub.c AudioUnit 段 → OH_AudioRenderer 写端）
find_library(OHAUDIO_LIB ohaudio)

# 平台引擎源码：Switch 系统服务/装载引擎/HLE/兼容层（游戏无关）；opus_codec 需 libopus，电影音频周末接 oh_audio
# x86_64（模拟器）：游戏本体是 ARM64 重写镜像无法执行，壳层验证专用（runtime_main 返回 2）
file(GLOB HOST_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/platform/*.c)
list(FILTER HOST_SOURCES EXCLUDE REGEX "opus_codec\\.c$")

# 游戏侧实现（autoload/game_patches/odyssey_aspect/game_env），随 GAME_DIR 切换；换游戏时改 GAME_DIR 单变量即可
file(GLOB GAME_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${GAME_DIR}/*.c)

if(OHOS_ARCH STREQUAL "arm64-v8a")
  add_library(${NODE_MODULE} SHARED
    platform/game_napi.cpp
    platform/nvn_vk/nvn_vk_stub.cpp
    platform/nvn_vk/nvn_vk.c
    third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/tex/nvn_deswizzle.c   # round23批2 收编尾巴③：块线性解排布真身（树内 sha256 d8f66514…，donor 989859a8…，以树内为准）；同摘 ohos_stub.c/nvn_vk_stub.cpp 两假桩防重复符号
    platform/ohos_compat/ohos_stub.c
    platform/hle_stack.S
    platform/entry.S
    platform/nvn_replay/cmdbuf.c                  # M2：NVN 命令录制（infra/BOTWRecompAndroid@4bad6dc，MIT）
    platform/nvn_replay/maxwell/translate.c       # M2：Maxwell 命令流翻译（同上）
    platform/nvn_replay/plat_ohos.c               # M2：NVN 层所需 plat_*（OHOS 版）
    platform/nvn_replay/cmd_trace.c               # M2：命令流跟踪器（opcode 直方图）
    platform/nvn_replay/glue_cmdbuf.c             # M2：参数式桩 → Cpu* 式实现的胶水
    platform/nvn_replay/host_stubs.c              # M2：未移植符号的宿主桩（guest_call / nvn_watch_texid）
    ${HOST_SOURCES}
    ${GAME_SOURCES}
  )
  # nvn_replay/ 目前只编译、未接线：gfx_bridge 的符号表仍指向记账桩。
  # 接线（符号表逐项转发 + nvn_cmd_trace 直方图）在真机验证窗口做，见 PORTING.md。
  # nvn_vk.c 只进 arm64：它链接 platform/nvn_tex.c 的布局数学（nvn_fmt_bpb/nvn_tex_layout），
  # 而 platform/*.c glob 只在真机分支生效；x86_64 壳层保持 nvn_vk_stub.cpp 单桩（弱符号回落）。
  # M4 第一批：device/surface/swapchain/纹理上传；窗口接线（game_napi surface_set →
  # nvn_vk_set_native_window）与 gfx_bridge 的 present 清色链已接（round23批1）；
  # mtl_* 全量接线在批 3（docs/round23-nvn-wiring-plan.md）。
  set(HOST_ARCH 1)
else()
  add_library(${NODE_MODULE} SHARED
    platform/game_napi.cpp
    platform/nvn_vk/nvn_vk_stub.cpp
    platform/ohos_compat/ohos_stub.c
  )
endif()

if(HOST_ARCH)
  target_compile_definitions(${NODE_MODULE} PRIVATE HOST_ARCH=1)
endif()

# shim 层：伪造 Apple 头（include 最优先）+ donor nvn 头 + 平台/游戏生成的绑定头
# （platform/generated=shared_fonts 系统资源；games/<tid>/{,generated}=runtime_tables/romfs_config/game_version/game_patches——
#  platform 的 loader.c:21-23、services.c:5、romfs.c:5、fs_host.c:29、swkbd_host.c:200 按名跨目录消费，games 侧经 -I platform 解析 runtime.h）
target_include_directories(${NODE_MODULE} PRIVATE
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/platform/ohos_compat/include
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/include
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/platform/generated
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${GAME_DIR}
```
