`mario-odessy-harmony/entry/src/main/cpp/platform/fa_probe.c`:

```c
/* M6r: "is the ~45 s per step a host service call timing out?" -- a read-only ledger.
 *
 * The task asks for one thing: name the call that fails/times out, or prove that every call
 * succeeds.  Three pieces of evidence, all recording only, none deciding anything:
 *
 *   (1) FAILURE ledger.  Every kernel SVC whose result (x0) comes back non-zero, and every IPC
 *       reply whose nn::Result is non-zero, is recorded once in an aggregate row keyed by
 *       (call id, result) and -- self-limited -- in a 128-slot ring with the host time, the four
 *       dispatch arguments, the calling guest thread and the guest LR of the call site.
 *       The ring insert is throttled by the aggregate count (all of the first 64, then powers of
 *       two, then every 256th), so a 10k/s noisy failure cannot evict the rare ones; the
 *       aggregate keeps the true count.  Nothing calls runtime_now_ns() unless a record is
 *       actually written.
 *   (2) WAIT timing.  svc 0x18 (WaitSynchronization, the only kernel call with a caller-supplied
 *       timeout) records requested-ns / measured-duration / result; svc 0x0b (SleepThread)
 *       records its request.  Both only when the wait was long (>=200 ms) or timed out, plus
 *       whole-boot totals.  This is the piece that can *show* a 45 s timeout if one exists.
 *   (3) CLOCK callers.  Every nn::os::GetSystemTick read goes through loader.c's timer gate
 *       (runtime_dispatch); the guest LR of that read is counted per call site (16 slots).  A
 *       state machine that waits out a 45 s wall-clock deadline by polling the tick shows up
 *       here as one call site with a huge count.
 *
 * Alignment: runtime_fa_advance() is called from the 2 s change detector when `opens` moves or
 * the live guest thread count moves; it prints every failure recorded since the previous advance
 * with "ago=" so the report's alignment table is a straight read of the log.
 *
 * Nothing here changes a return value, a reply, a wait, or a thread state.
 */
#include "runtime.h"
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

extern void vk_boot_logf(const char *fmt, ...);
void runtime_describe_address(uint64_t a, char *out, size_t n);

#define FA_IPC_ID 0xFFFFu   /* aggregate key for an IPC reply (SVC numbers are < 0x100) */
#define FA_KIND_SLEEP 0x100u /* wait-ring tag: SleepThread */
#define FA_KIND_WAIT  0x101u /* wait-ring tag: WaitSynchronization */

/* ---------------- aggregate: (call, result) -> count ----------------
   key = bit48 ipc-flag | bits32..47 call id (SVC number, or IPC command) | bits0..31 result.
   A record always has result != 0, so the key is never 0 (0 marks an unused slot). */
#define FA_AGG 48
typedef struct { _Atomic uint64_t key; _Atomic uint64_t n; const char *name; } FaAgg;
static FaAgg fa_agg[FA_AGG];
static _Atomic unsigned fa_agg_used;
static _Atomic uint64_t fa_agg_over;

static uint64_t fa_agg_add(int ipc, uint32_t id, uint32_t ret, const char *name) {
    uint64_t f_id = id & 0xFFFFu;
    uint64_t key = (ipc ? 1ull << 48 : 0ull) | (f_id << 32) | (uint64_t)ret;
    if (!key) key = 1;   /* 0 marks an unused slot */
    unsigned used = atomic_load_explicit(&fa_agg_used, memory_order_acquire);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < used && i < FA_AGG; i++)
        if (atomic_load_explicit(&fa_agg[i].key, memory_order_relaxed) == key)
            return atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&fa_agg[i].n, 1, memory_order_relaxed) + 1;
    unsigned id_slot = atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&fa_agg_used, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
    if (id_slot >= FA_AGG) { atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&fa_agg_over, 1, memory_order_relaxed); return 1; }
    fa_agg[id_slot].name = name;   /* written before the key that publishes the row */
    atomic_store_explicit(&fa_agg[id_slot].key, key, memory_order_relaxed);
    atomic_store_explicit(&fa_agg[id_slot].n, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
    return 1;
}

/* ---------------- ring: the last 128 recorded failures ---------------- */
#define FA_RING 128
typedef struct {
    uint64_t t;              /* host monotonic ns; 0 = slot not committed */
    uint64_t a[4];           /* dispatch arguments at the call */
    uint64_t lr;             /* guest LR of the call */
    const char *name;        /* IPC service name, NULL for a kernel SVC */
    uint32_t ret, thr, id, aux;
} FaRec;
static FaRec fa_ring[FA_RING];
static _Atomic unsigned fa_head;
static _Atomic uint64_t fa_svc_n, fa_ipc_n, fa_ring_n;

static void fa_rec(uint32_t id, uint32_t aux, const char *name, const uint64_t *a, uint32_t ret,
                   uint64_t lr, uint32_t thr) {
    uint64_t n = fa_agg_add(name != NULL, name ? aux : id, ret, name);
    if (!(n <= 64u || (n & (n - 1)) == 0 || (n % 256u) == 0)) return;   /* self-limiting ring */
    unsigned i = atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&fa_head, 1, memory_order_relaxed) % FA_RING;
    FaRec *r = &fa_ring[i];
    r->t = 0;
    for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) r->a[k] = a ? a[k] : 0;
    r->lr = lr; r->name = name; r->ret = ret; r->thr = thr; r->id = id; r->aux = aux;
    r->t = runtime_now_ns();   /* commit last: a torn read at worst prints an older entry */
    atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&fa_ring_n, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
}

void runtime_fa_svc(uint32_t num, const uint64_t *a, uint32_t ret, uint64_t lr, uint32_t thr) {
    if (!ret) return;
    atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&fa_svc_n, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
    fa_rec(num, 0, NULL, a, ret, lr, thr);
}
void runtime_fa_ipc(const char *name, uint32_t cmd, uint32_t ret, uint64_t lr, uint32_t thr) {
    if (!ret) return;
    atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&fa_ipc_n, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
    fa_rec(FA_IPC_ID, cmd, name, NULL, ret, lr, thr);
}

/* ---------------- wait / sleep timing ---------------- */
#define FA_WRING 64
typedef struct { uint64_t t, req, dur, lr; uint64_t blk, core; uint32_t thr, n, h0, ret, kind; } FaWait;
static FaWait fa_wring[FA_WRING];
static _Atomic unsigned fa_whead;
static _Atomic uint64_t fa_wait_calls, fa_wait_slow, fa_wait_max, fa_sleep_calls, fa_sleep_max;

static void fa_long_add(const FaWait *w);

void runtime_fa_wait(uint32_t kind, uint32_t thr, uint32_t n, uint32_t h0, uint64_t req,
                     uint64_t dur, uint64_t blk, uint64_t core, uint32_t ret, uint64_t lr) {
    if (kind == FA_KIND_SLEEP) {
        atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&fa_sleep_calls, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
        uint64_t m = atomic_load_explicit(&fa_sleep_max, memory_order_relaxed);
        while (req > m && !atomic_compare_exchange_weak_explicit(&fa_sleep_max, &m, req,
                 memory_order_relaxed, memory_order_relaxed)) {}
        if (req < 200000000ull) return;                    /* only a long sleep is interesting */
    } else {
        atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&fa_wait_calls, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
        if (dur >= 200000000ull || ret == 0xEA01u) atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&fa_wait_slow, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
        uint64_t m = atomic_load_explicit(&fa_wait_max, memory_order_relaxed);
        while (dur > m && !atomic_compare_exchange_weak_explicit(&fa_wait_max, &m, dur,
                 memory_order_relaxed, memory_order_relaxed)) {}
        if (dur < 200000000ull && ret != 0xEA01u) return;  /* only a long or expired wait */
    }
    unsigned i = atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&fa_whead, 1, memory_order_relaxed) % FA_WRING;
    FaWait *w = &fa_wring[i];
    w->t = 0;
    w->req = req; w->dur = dur; w->blk = blk; w->core = core; w->lr = lr; w->thr = thr; w->n = n; w->h0 = h0;
    w->ret = ret; w->kind = kind;
    w->t = runtime_now_ns();
    if (kind != FA_KIND_SLEEP) fa_long_add(w);
}

/* ---------------- the longest waits of the whole boot ----------------
   The 64-slot ring above keeps the *newest* long waits, so a 30 s dump can miss the single long
   wait that matters (measured: a 36.9 s svc 0x18 wait ended between two dumps and was already
   evicted by the 0.3 s audio-worker waits). This table keeps the 8 longest ever, insert-sorted,
   so the answer survives to the end of the boot. */
#define FA_LONG 8
typedef struct { uint64_t dur, req, lr, t, blk, core; uint32_t thr, n, h0, ret, kind; } FaLong;
static FaLong fa_long[FA_LONG];
static _Atomic int fa_long_n;
static _Atomic uint64_t fa_long_guard;   /* simple spinlock: 8 rows, written on a long wait only */

static void fa_long_add(const FaWait *w) {
    while (atomic_exchange(&fa_long_guard, 1u)) { }
    int n = atomic_load_explicit(&fa_long_n, memory_order_relaxed);
    if (n < FA_LONG) {
        int at = n;
        while (at > 0 && fa_long[at - 1].dur < w->dur) { fa_long[at] = fa_long[at - 1]; at--; }
        fa_long[at] = (FaLong){ w->dur, w->req, w->lr, w->t, w->blk, w->core, w->thr, w->n, w->h0, w->ret, w->kind };
        atomic_store_explicit(&fa_long_n, n + 1, memory_order_relaxed);
    } else if (fa_long[FA_LONG - 1].dur < w->dur) {
        int at = FA_LONG - 1;
        while (at > 0 && fa_long[at - 1].dur < w->dur) { fa_long[at] = fa_long[at - 1]; at--; }
        fa_long[at] = (FaLong){ w->dur, w->req, w->lr, w->t, w->blk, w->core, w->thr, w->n, w->h0, w->ret, w->kind };
    }
    atomic_store_explicit(&fa_long_guard, 0u, memory_order_relaxed);
}

/* ---------------- clock gate callers ---------------- */
#define FA_TK 16
typedef struct { _Atomic uint64_t lr, n; } FaTk;
static FaTk fa_tk[FA_TK];
static _Atomic uint64_t fa_tk_n, fa_tk_over;

void runtime_fa_tick(uint64_t lr) {
    atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&fa_tk_n, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
    if (lr) {
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < FA_TK; i++)
            if (atomic_load_explicit(&fa_tk[i].lr, memory_order_relaxed) == lr) {
                atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&fa_tk[i].n, 1, memory_order_relaxed); return;
            }
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < FA_TK; i++) {
            uint64_t z = 0;
            if (atomic_compare_exchange_strong_explicit(&fa_tk[i].lr, &z, lr,
                    memory_order_relaxed, memory_order_relaxed)) {
                atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&fa_tk[i].n, 1, memory_order_relaxed); return;
            }
        }
    }
    atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&fa_tk_over, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
}

/* ---------------- printing ---------------- */
static _Atomic uint64_t fa_t0;
static uint64_t fa_base(void) {
    uint64_t b = atomic_load(&fa_t0);
    if (!b) { uint64_t e = 0; atomic_compare_exchange_strong(&fa_t0, &e, runtime_now_ns()); b = atomic_load(&fa_t0); }
    return b;
}
/* One compact "what did this call ask for" hint, per call id.  a3 of 0x18 is the requested
   timeout in ns; a0 of 0x0b is the requested sleep in ns.  Anything else prints the raw words
   because a wrong guess here must never look like a fact. */
static void fa_hint(char *out, size_t cap, uint32_t id, const uint64_t *a) {
    if (!a) { out[0] = 0; return; }
    if (id == 0x18) snprintf(out, cap, " n=%llu req=%.2fs hs=%#llx", (unsigned long long)a[2],
                             a[3] > 0 && a[3] < (1ull << 62) ? (double)a[3] / 1e9 : -1.0, (unsigned long long)a[1]);
    else if (id == 0x0b) snprintf(out, cap, " req=%.2fs", (double)a[0] / 1e9);
    else snprintf(out, cap, " a0=%#llx a2=%#llx a3=%#llx", (unsigned long long)a[0], (unsigned long long)a[2], (unsigned long long)a[3]);
}

static void fa_pick_top(uint64_t *vals, uint64_t *cnts, unsigned *idx, unsigned n) {
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; i++) idx[i] = i;
    for (unsigned i = 1; i < n; i++) {   /* insertion sort by count, descending; n<=40, once per 30 s */
        unsigned iv = idx[i], j = i;
        while (j > 0 && cnts[iv] > cnts[idx[j - 1]]) { idx[j] = idx[j - 1]; j--; }
        idx[j] = iv;
    }
    (void)vals;
}

void runtime_fa_dump(unsigned tsec) {
    uint64_t base = fa_base();
    uint64_t now = runtime_now_ns();
    double t = base ? (double)(now - base) / 1e9 : 0.0;
    uint64_t svc = atomic_load(&fa_svc_n), ipc = atomic_load(&fa_ipc_n), head = atomic_load(&fa_head);
    uint64_t rc = head < FA_RING ? head : FA_RING;
    vk_boot_logf("[fa] t=%us fails svc=%llu ipc=%llu slots=%llu/128 agg=%u/%u over=%llu "
                 "waits=%llu slow=%llu wmax=%.2fs sleeps=%llu smax=%.2fs tick=%llu(+%llu) per_s=%.2f",
                 tsec, (unsigned long long)svc, (unsigned long long)ipc, (unsigned long long)rc,
                 atomic_load(&fa_agg_used), (unsigned)FA_AGG, (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&fa_agg_over),
                 (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&fa_wait_calls), (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&fa_wait_slow),
                 (double)atomic_load(&fa_wait_max) / 1e9, (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&fa_sleep_calls),
                 (double)atomic_load(&fa_sleep_max) / 1e9, (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&fa_tk_n),
                 (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&fa_tk_over),
                 t > 0.5 ? (double)atomic_load(&fa_tk_n) / t : -1.0);
    {   /* aggregate top 8 by count: service+command+result for IPC, svc number+result for kernel */
        uint64_t keys[FA_AGG], ns[FA_AGG]; unsigned idx[FA_AGG];
        unsigned n = 0, used = atomic_load(&fa_agg_used);
        if (used > FA_AGG) used = FA_AGG;
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < used; i++) {
            uint64_t k = atomic_load_explicit(&fa_agg[i].key, memory_order_relaxed);
            uint64_t c = atomic_load_explicit(&fa_agg[i].n, memory_order_relaxed);
            if (!k || !c) continue;
            keys[n] = k; ns[n] = c; idx[n] = i; n++;
        }
        {
            unsigned o[FA_AGG];
            for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; i++) o[i] = i;
            for (unsigned i = 1; i < n; i++) {
                unsigned iv = o[i], j = i;
                while (j > 0 && ns[iv] > ns[o[j - 1]]) { o[j] = o[j - 1]; j--; }
                o[j] = iv;
            }
            for (unsigned i = 0; i < n && i < 8; i++) {
                unsigned r = o[i];
                uint64_t k = keys[r];
                uint32_t id = (uint32_t)((k >> 32) & 0xFFFFu), ret = (uint32_t)k;
                int ipc = (k >> 48) & 1;
                if (ipc) vk_boot_logf("[fa]   top#%u ipc=%s cmd=%u ret=%#x n=%llu", i,
                                      fa_agg[idx[r]].name ? fa_agg[idx[r]].name : "?", id, ret,
                                      (unsigned long long)ns[r]);
                else vk_boot_logf("[fa]   top#%u svc=%#x ret=%#x n=%llu%s", i, id, ret,
                                  (unsigned long long)ns[r], ret == 0xEA01u ? " TIMEOUT(0xEA01)" : "");
            }
        }
    }
    /* the last eight recorded failures, newest first */
    for (unsigned k = 0; k < 8 && head > k; k++) {
        const FaRec *r = &fa_ring[(head - 1 - k) % FA_RING];
        if (!r->t) continue;
        char h[96], d[80]; fa_hint(h, sizeof h, r->id, r->a);
        runtime_describe_address(r->lr, d, sizeof d);
        if (r->name) vk_boot_logf("[fa] last#%u ago=%.1fs ipc=%s cmd=%u ret=%#x thr=%#x lr=%s",
                                  k, base ? (double)(now - r->t) / 1e9 : -1.0, r->name, r->aux, r->ret, r->thr, d);
        else vk_boot_logf("[fa] last#%u ago=%.1fs svc=%#x ret=%#x thr=%#x%s lr=%s",
                          k, base ? (double)(now - r->t) / 1e9 : -1.0, r->id, r->ret, r->thr, h, d);
    }
    /* long / expired waits, newest first */
    unsigned wh = atomic_load(&fa_whead);
    for (unsigned k = 0; k < 6 && wh > k; k++) {
        const FaWait *w = &fa_wring[(wh - 1 - k) % FA_WRING];
        if (!w->t) continue;
        char d[80]; runtime_describe_address(w->lr, d, sizeof d);
        if (w->kind == FA_KIND_SLEEP)
            vk_boot_logf("[fa] wait#%u ago=%.1fs SLEEP req=%.2fs thr=%#x lr=%s",
                         k, base ? (double)(now - w->t) / 1e9 : -1.0, (double)w->req / 1e9, w->thr, d);
        else
            vk_boot_logf("[fa] wait#%u ago=%.1fs WAIT dur=%.2fs blk=%.2fs core=%.2fs req=%.2fs ret=%#x thr=%#x n=%u h0=%#x lr=%s",
                         k, base ? (double)(now - w->t) / 1e9 : -1.0, (double)w->dur / 1e9,
                         (double)w->blk / 1e9, (double)w->core / 1e9,
                         w->req < (1ull << 62) ? (double)w->req / 1e9 : -1.0, w->ret, w->thr, w->n, w->h0, d);
    }
    {   /* the 8 longest svc 0x18 waits of the whole boot, longest first */
        int n = atomic_load(&fa_long_n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n && i < FA_LONG; i++) {
            const FaLong *w = &fa_long[i];
            char d[80], hd[96]; runtime_describe_address(w->lr, d, sizeof d);
            { extern void runtime_handle_desc(uint32_t h, char *out, unsigned cap);
              runtime_handle_desc(w->h0, hd, sizeof hd); }
            vk_boot_logf("[fa] LONG#%d dur=%.2fs blk=%.2fs core=%.2fs req=%.2fs ret=%#x thr=%#x n=%u h0=%#x (%s) ended_ago=%.1fs lr=%s",
                         i, (double)w->dur / 1e9, (double)w->blk / 1e9, (double)w->core / 1e9,
                         w->req < (1ull << 62) ? (double)w->req / 1e9 : -1.0,
                         w->ret, w->thr, w->n, w->h0, hd, base ? (double)(now - w->t) / 1e9 : -1.0, d);
        }
    }
    /* who reads the game clock: top four call sites (live counts; the delta is in the caller) */
    {
        uint64_t lrs[FA_TK], ns[FA_TK]; unsigned idx[FA_TK], n = 0;
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < FA_TK; i++) {
            uint64_t l = atomic_load(&fa_tk[i].lr), c = atomic_load(&fa_tk[i].n);
            if (!l || !c) continue;
            lrs[n] = l; ns[n] = c; n++;
        }
        fa_pick_top(lrs, ns, idx, n);
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < n && i < 4; i++) {
            char d[80]; runtime_describe_address(lrs[idx[i]], d, sizeof d);
            vk_boot_logf("[fa]   tk#%u lr=%s n=%llu", i, d, (unsigned long long)ns[idx[i]]);
        }
    }
}

/* Called from the 2 s change detector when `opens` or the live thread count moves: everything
   recorded since the previous advance, with the age at the advance, so the alignment table is
   this block. */
static _Atomic uint64_t fa_adv_t;
static _Atomic uint64_t fa_adv_n;
void runtime_fa_advance(unsigned tsec, unsigned long long opens, int threads, const char *why) {
    uint64_t now = runtime_now_ns();
    uint64_t prev = atomic_exchange(&fa_adv_t, now);
    unsigned head = atomic_load(&fa_head);
    unsigned nshow = 0, ntot = 0;
    FaRec pick[8];
    for (unsigned k = 0; k < FA_RING && head > k; k++) {
        const FaRec *r = &fa_ring[(head - 1 - k) % FA_RING];
        if (!r->t) continue;
        if (prev && r->t <= prev) break;                  /* older than the previous advance */
        ntot++;
        if (nshow < 8) pick[nshow++] = *r;                /* newest first */
    }
    atomic_fetch_add(&fa_adv_n, 1);
    vk_boot_logf("[fa] ADVANCE#%llu t=%us why=%s opens=%llu thr=%d dt=%.1fs fails_since=%u",
                 (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&fa_adv_n), tsec, why, opens, threads,
                 prev ? (double)(now - prev) / 1e9 : -1.0, ntot);
    for (unsigned k = 0; k < nshow; k++) {
        const FaRec *r = &pick[nshow - 1 - k];            /* print oldest -> newest */
        char h[96], d[80]; fa_hint(h, sizeof h, r->id, r->a);
        if (r->name) vk_boot_logf("[fa] adv ago=%.1fs ipc=%s cmd=%u ret=%#x thr=%#x",
                                  (double)(now - r->t) / 1e9, r->name, r->aux, r->ret, r->thr);
        else { runtime_describe_address(r->lr, d, sizeof d);
            vk_boot_logf("[fa] adv ago=%.1fs svc=%#x ret=%#x thr=%#x%s lr=%s",
                         (double)(now - r->t) / 1e9, r->id, r->ret, r->thr, h, d); }
    }
    /* M6r: long waits that ENDED inside this window -- the other half of the alignment question
       ("was the step preceded by a wait finishing just before it?"). >=1 s only: the 0.3 s audio
       poll would bury it. */
    {
        unsigned wh = atomic_load(&fa_whead);
        unsigned shown = 0;
        for (unsigned k = 0; k < FA_WRING && wh > k; k++) {
            const FaWait *w = &fa_wring[(wh - 1 - k) % FA_WRING];
            if (!w->t) continue;
            if (prev && w->t <= prev) break;
            if (w->kind == FA_KIND_SLEEP ? w->req < 1000000000ull : w->dur < 1000000000ull) continue;
            if (shown >= 6) continue;
            char d[80], hd[96]; runtime_describe_address(w->lr, d, sizeof d);
            { extern void runtime_handle_desc(uint32_t h, char *out, unsigned cap);
              runtime_handle_desc(w->h0, hd, sizeof hd); }
            shown++;
            if (w->kind == FA_KIND_SLEEP)
                vk_boot_logf("[fa] adv SLEEP req=%.2fs ended_ago=%.1fs thr=%#x lr=%s",
                             (double)w->req / 1e9, (double)(now - w->t) / 1e9, w->thr, d);
            else
                vk_boot_logf("[fa] adv WAIT dur=%.2fs req=%.2fs ret=%#x thr=%#x n=%u h0=%#x (%s) ended_ago=%.1fs lr=%s",
                             (double)w->dur / 1e9, w->req < (1ull << 62) ? (double)w->req / 1e9 : -1.0,
                             w->ret, w->thr, w->n, w->h0, hd, (double)(now - w->t) / 1e9, d);
        }
    }
}
```

`mario-odessy-harmony/entry/src/main/cpp/platform/freeze_watchdog.c`:

```c
/* Freeze watchdog (task 0k, after smo-recomp's nvn_vk_watchdog.c): when the game stops producing frames, write what is
   needed to see why, and nothing else. Off unless ODYSSEY_FREEZE_WATCHDOG is set: "1" = 5 s without a frame, "N" = N s.
   It never stops, resumes or changes the game; it only logs.

   Once the game has presented its first frame, a thread looks every 500 ms at the frames the game submitted
   (dm_nvn_frame_count, hle_nvn.c) and the frames actually presented (mtl_present_count, nvn_mtl.m). When neither has moved
   for the threshold it logs one "[freeze-watchdog]" line and dumps, once per freeze (at most 3 per run):
   - the guest threads, core owners and lock owners (runtime_dump_threads, threads.c), to stderr;
   - the GPU wait state (mtl_wait_state_dump, nvn_mtl.m), to stderr;
   - every host thread's stack: /usr/bin/sample for 3 s into <dir>/freeze-<pid>-<n>.txt, where <dir> is
     ODYSSEY_FREEZE_DIR, else freeze-dumps next to TOTK_PROFILE_DIR, else ./freeze-dumps.
   When frames move again it logs how long the freeze lasted. The hooks are weak, so a target without them (the headless
   probe) still links; a missing hook is skipped. */
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <limits.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <spawn.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/wait.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <unistd.h>

extern char **environ;
__attribute__((weak)) uint64_t dm_nvn_frame_count(void);
__attribute__((weak)) uint64_t mtl_present_count(void);
__attribute__((weak)) void runtime_dump_threads(void);
__attribute__((weak)) void mtl_wait_state_dump(void);

enum { FW_MAX_DUMPS = 3 };
static double g_threshold_s;
static char g_dir[PATH_MAX];

static double fw_now(void) { return clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW) / 1e9; }
static uint64_t fw_frames(void) { return dm_nvn_frame_count ? dm_nvn_frame_count() : 0; }
static uint64_t fw_presents(void) { return mtl_present_count ? mtl_present_count() : 0; }

static pid_t fw_sample(int n) {   /* every host thread's stack, by Apple's sampler, in its own process */
    mkdir(g_dir, 0755);
    char path[PATH_MAX], pid[16];
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/freeze-%d-%d.txt", g_dir, (int)getpid(), n);
    snprintf(pid, sizeof pid, "%d", (int)getpid());
    char *argv[] = {"/usr/bin/sample", pid, "3", "-file", path, "-mayDie", NULL};
    posix_spawn_file_actions_t fa; posix_spawn_file_actions_init(&fa);
    posix_spawn_file_actions_addopen(&fa, 1, "/dev/null", O_WRONLY, 0);
    posix_spawn_file_actions_addopen(&fa, 2, "/dev/null", O_WRONLY, 0);
    posix_spawnattr_t at; posix_spawnattr_init(&at);
    posix_spawnattr_setflags(&at, POSIX_SPAWN_CLOEXEC_DEFAULT | POSIX_SPAWN_SETSIGMASK);
    sigset_t none; sigemptyset(&none); posix_spawnattr_setsigmask(&at, &none);
    pid_t child = 0;
    int err = posix_spawn(&child, argv[0], &fa, &at, argv, environ);
    posix_spawn_file_actions_destroy(&fa); posix_spawnattr_destroy(&at);
    if (err) { fprintf(stderr, "[freeze-watchdog] could not start sample: %s\n", strerror(err)); return 0; }
    fprintf(stderr, "[freeze-watchdog] host thread stacks (3 s sample) -> %s\n", path);
    return child;
}

static void *fw_thread(void *unused) {
    (void)unused;
    pthread_setname_np("freeze-watchdog");
    /* Do NOT touch the nvn counters before the guest runtime is up: calling dm_nvn_frame_count() this early takes the
       app down with SIGSEGV within ~140 ms of this thread starting. */
    sleep(8);
    uint64_t frames = fw_frames(), presents = fw_presents();
    double moved = fw_now(), frozen_at = 0, started = fw_now();
    int dumps = 0; pid_t child = 0;
    for (;;) {
        usleep(500000);
        if (child && waitpid(child, NULL, WNOHANG) == child) child = 0;
        uint64_t f = fw_frames(), p = fw_presents();
        double now = fw_now();
        /* Startup grace only: a run with ZERO frames past the grace IS the black-screen case, so arming strictly "after
           the first frame" would stay disarmed forever and never dump. */
        if (!f && !p && now - started < 6.0) { moved = now; continue; }
        if (f != frames || p != presents) {
            if (frozen_at) fprintf(stderr, "[freeze-watchdog] frames moved again after %.1f s (game frame %llu, present %llu)\n",
                                   now - moved, (unsigned long long)f, (unsigned long long)p);
            frames = f; presents = p; moved = now; frozen_at = 0;
            continue;
        }
        if (frozen_at || now - moved < g_threshold_s) continue;
        frozen_at = now;
        if (dumps >= FW_MAX_DUMPS) {
            fprintf(stderr, "[freeze-watchdog] no frame for %.1f s (game frame %llu, present %llu); dump limit reached\n",
                    now - moved, (unsigned long long)f, (unsigned long long)p);
            continue;
        }
        dumps++;
        fprintf(stderr, "[freeze-watchdog] no frame for %.1f s (game frame %llu, present %llu); dump %d of %d\n",
                now - moved, (unsigned long long)f, (unsigned long long)p, dumps, FW_MAX_DUMPS);
        if (!child) child = fw_sample(dumps);
        if (runtime_dump_threads) runtime_dump_threads();
        if (mtl_wait_state_dump) mtl_wait_state_dump();
    }
    return NULL;
}

/* Started from the guest main-thread entry (threads.c, before dm_thread_enter), NOT from a constructor: started from a
   constructor the watchdog thread reaches dm_nvn_frame_count()/runtime_dump_threads() before the guest runtime is up and
   the app dies before it can print anything. Guarded so only the first caller starts it. */
void fw_kick(void);

__attribute__((constructor)) static void fw_start(void) {
    const char *e = getenv("ODYSSEY_FREEZE_WATCHDOG");
    if (!e || !*e || !strcmp(e, "0")) return;
    fw_kick();
}

void fw_kick(void) {
    static int started = 0;
    if (started) return;
    started = 1;
    if (!g_threshold_s) g_threshold_s = 4;   /* grace/threshold are tuned for the zero-frame (black screen) case */
    const char *dir = getenv("ODYSSEY_FREEZE_DIR"), *profile = getenv("TOTK_PROFILE_DIR");
    if (dir && *dir) snprintf(g_dir, sizeof g_dir, "%s", dir);
    else if (profile && *profile) snprintf(g_dir, sizeof g_dir, "%s/../freeze-dumps", profile);
    else snprintf(g_dir, sizeof g_dir, "freeze-dumps");
    pthread_t t;
    if (pthread_create(&t, NULL, fw_thread, NULL)) { fprintf(stderr, "[freeze-watchdog] could not start: %s\n", strerror(errno)); return; }
    pthread_detach(t);
    fprintf(stderr, "[freeze-watchdog] on: logs and dumps after %.0f s without a frame (dumps in %s); never changes the game\n", g_threshold_s, g_dir);
}
```

`mario-odessy-harmony/entry/src/main/cpp/platform/fs_host.c`:

```c
/* nn::fs host implementation for the functions main imports. RomFS paths and handles go to the
   verified read-only backend (romfs.c); save, temporary and cache storage are host directories under
   the profile directory. Application save data is created on first start, as the system launcher does
   for titles that declare save data. Writes reach the host file immediately; Commit flushes them.
   Because of that, quitting in the middle of a save (the game writes several files, then commits) would leave a slot half
   written: runtime_fs_save_busy tells the window close to wait until the save is done (runtime/frontend.m). */
#include "autoload.h"
#include "runtime.h"
#include "fs_host.h"
#include <dirent.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#define R_PATH_NOT_FOUND 0x202u
#define R_ALREADY_EXISTS 0x402u
#define R_NOT_EMPTY 0x1002u
#define R_TARGET_NOT_FOUND 0x7d402u
#define R_INVALID_ARGUMENT 0x2ee202u
#define R_INVALID_PATH 0x2ee602u
#define R_OPEN_MODE 0x307402u
#define R_APPEND_REQUIRED 0x2f5e02u
#include "game_version.h"
#define TOTK_APPLICATION_ID GAME_TITLE_ID
enum { M_FREE, M_SAVE, M_TEMP, M_CACHE };
enum { OPEN_READ = 1, OPEN_WRITE = 2, OPEN_APPEND = 4 };
#define FILE_BASE 0x200000000ULL
#define DIR_BASE 0x300000000ULL
#define NFILES 1024
#define NDIRS 256

typedef struct { int kind; char name[32]; char root[1024]; } Mount;
typedef struct { int fd, mode, save; } File;   /* save: on a save-data mount (counts for runtime_fs_save_busy) */
/* A RomFS directory is a snapshot of its children taken at open (rom != NULL; dir stays NULL). */
struct RomEntry; typedef struct { DIR *dir; char path[1024]; int mode; struct RomEntry *rom; int64_t nrom, pos; } Dir;
static Mount mounts[16];
static File files[NFILES];
static Dir dirs[NDIRS];
static pthread_mutex_t lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static char profile[1024], save_root[1024];
static pthread_once_t once = PTHREAD_ONCE_INIT;

static void need(int c, const char *m) { if (!c) runtime_fail(m); }

/* Save in progress: a save-data file open for writing, or save data changed in the last 3 s and not committed yet (TOTK
   writes a slot's files back to back and then commits; between the files nothing is open for a moment). */
static _Atomic int save_writers, save_dirty;
static _Atomic uint64_t save_changed_ns;
static void save_touched(void) { atomic_store(&save_changed_ns, runtime_now_ns()); atomic_store(&save_dirty, 1); }
int runtime_fs_save_busy(void) {
    if (atomic_load(&save_writers) > 0) return 1;
    return atomic_load(&save_dirty) && runtime_now_ns() - atomic_load(&save_changed_ns) < 3000000000ull;
}
static void make_dir(const char *p) { if (mkdir(p, 0700) && errno != EEXIST) runtime_fail("create profile storage directory"); }
static int remove_tree(const char *path) {
    DIR *d = opendir(path); if (!d) return errno == ENOENT ? 0 : -1;
    struct dirent *e; int ok = 0; char child[2048];
    while ((e = readdir(d))) {
        if (!strcmp(e->d_name, ".") || !strcmp(e->d_name, "..")) continue;
        snprintf(child, sizeof child, "%s/%s", path, e->d_name);
        ok |= e->d_type == DT_DIR ? remove_tree(child) : unlink(child);
    }
    closedir(d);
    return ok | rmdir(path);
}
static void init(void) {
    const char *dir = getenv("TOTK_PROFILE_DIR"); if (!dir) dir = "user-data";
    need(snprintf(profile, sizeof profile, "%s", dir) < (int)sizeof profile, "profile path");
    uint64_t uid[2]; runtime_account_uid(uid);
    char p[1100]; make_dir(profile);
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/save", profile); make_dir(p);
    need(snprintf(save_root, sizeof save_root, "%s/save/%016llx%016llx", profile, (unsigned long long)uid[1], (unsigned long long)uid[0]) < (int)sizeof save_root, "save path");
    make_dir(save_root);                                   /* launcher-style EnsureSaveData */
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/temp", profile); remove_tree(p); make_dir(p);
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/cache", profile); make_dir(p);
    fprintf(stderr, "[totk] host save storage: %s\n", save_root);
}
static void ready(void) { pthread_once(&once, init); }

/* ---------- mounts and paths ---------- */
static unsigned mount_add(const char *name, int kind, const char *root) {
    if (!name || !*name || strlen(name) >= 32 || strchr(name, ':') || strchr(name, '/')) return R_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
    int slot = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) { if (mounts[i].kind && !strcmp(mounts[i].name, name)) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock); return R_ALREADY_EXISTS; } if (!mounts[i].kind && slot < 0) slot = i; }
    if (slot < 0) runtime_fail("fs mount table full");
    mounts[slot].kind = kind; strcpy(mounts[slot].name, name); snprintf(mounts[slot].root, sizeof mounts[slot].root, "%s", root);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
    fprintf(stderr, "[totk] fs mount %s: -> %s\n", name, root);
    return 0;
}
static int component_ok(const char *c, size_t n) { return n && !(n == 1 && c[0] == '.') && !(n == 2 && c[0] == '.' && c[1] == '.'); }
/* "name:/a/b" -> host path; 0 on success; *kind = the mount's kind (M_SAVE ...) when kind is given */
static unsigned host_path_kind(const char *path, char *out, size_t cap, int *kind) {
    if (!path) return R_INVALID_PATH;
    const char *colon = strchr(path, ':');
    if (!colon || colon[1] != '/') return R_INVALID_PATH;
    size_t n = (size_t)(colon - path);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
    const Mount *m = NULL;
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) if (mounts[i].kind && strlen(mounts[i].name) == n && !strncmp(mounts[i].name, path, n)) m = &mounts[i];
    char root[1024]; if (m) strcpy(root, m->root);
    int k = m ? m->kind : M_FREE;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
    if (!m) return R_PATH_NOT_FOUND;
    if (kind) *kind = k;
    const char *rest = colon + 1;
    for (const char *q = rest + 1; *q;) { const char *e = strchr(q, '/'); size_t len = e ? (size_t)(e - q) : strlen(q); if (!e && !len) break; if (!component_ok(q, len) || memchr(q, '\\', len)) return R_INVALID_PATH; q = e ? e + 1 : q + len; }
    if (snprintf(out, cap, "%s%s", root, rest) >= (int)cap) return R_INVALID_PATH;
    size_t L = strlen(out); while (L > strlen(root) && out[L - 1] == '/') out[--L] = 0;
    return 0;
}
static unsigned host_path(const char *path, char *out, size_t cap) { return host_path_kind(path, out, cap, NULL); }
/* A change to save data through a path (create, delete, rename, directories): marks the save as in progress. */
static unsigned save_change_path(const char *path, char *out, size_t cap) {
    int kind = M_FREE; unsigned r = host_path_kind(path, out, cap, &kind);
    if (!r && kind == M_SAVE) save_touched();
    return r;
}
static unsigned errno_result(void) { return errno == ENOENT || errno == ENOTDIR ? R_PATH_NOT_FOUND : errno == EEXIST ? R_ALREADY_EXISTS : errno == ENOTEMPTY ? R_NOT_EMPTY : R_INVALID_ARGUMENT; }

/* ---------- storage mounts ---------- */
static unsigned mount_save(const char *name, const uint64_t *uid) {
    ready(); uint64_t me[2]; runtime_account_uid(me);
    if (!uid || uid[0] != me[0] || uid[1] != me[1]) return R_TARGET_NOT_FOUND;
    return mount_add(name, M_SAVE, save_root);
}
static unsigned char save_exists(uint64_t application, const uint64_t *uid) {
    ready(); uint64_t me[2]; runtime_account_uid(me);
    return application == TOTK_APPLICATION_ID && uid && uid[0] == me[0] && uid[1] == me[1];
}
/* Other titles' save data (e.g. data-link bonuses) is not present on this host. */
static unsigned mount_save_ro(const char *name, uint64_t application, const uint64_t *uid) {
    if (!save_exists(application, uid)) return R_TARGET_NOT_FOUND;
    return mount_add(name, M_SAVE, save_root);
}
static unsigned mount_temp(const char *name) { ready(); char p[1100]; snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/temp", profile); return mount_add(name, M_TEMP, p); }
static void cache_dir(int index, char *out, size_t cap) { snprintf(out, cap, "%s/cache/%d", profile, index); }
static unsigned create_cache(int index, int64_t size, int64_t journal) {
    ready(); if (index < 0 || size < 0 || journal < 0) return R_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    char p[1100]; cache_dir(index, p, sizeof p);
    if (mkdir(p, 0700)) return errno == EEXIST ? R_ALREADY_EXISTS : errno_result();
    return 0;
}
static unsigned delete_cache(int index) { ready(); char p[1100]; cache_dir(index, p, sizeof p); return remove_tree(p) ? R_TARGET_NOT_FOUND : 0; }
static unsigned mount_cache(const char *name, int index) {
    ready(); char p[1100]; cache_dir(index, p, sizeof p); struct stat st;
    if (stat(p, &st) || !S_ISDIR(st.st_mode)) return R_TARGET_NOT_FOUND;
    return mount_add(name, M_CACHE, p);
}
typedef struct { int32_t index; uint8_t reserved[0x1c]; } CacheStorageInfo;
typedef struct { int list[64]; int count, next; } CacheList;
static unsigned open_cache_list(uint64_t *out) {
    ready(); if (!out) return R_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    CacheList *l = calloc(1, sizeof *l); need(l != NULL, "cache list allocation");
    char p[1100]; snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/cache", profile); DIR *d = opendir(p); struct dirent *e;
    while (d && (e = readdir(d)) && l->count < 64) { char *end; long v = strtol(e->d_name, &end, 10); if (*e->d_name && !*end && v >= 0) l->list[l->count++] = (int)v; }
    if (d) closedir(d);
    *out = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)l; return 0;
}
static unsigned read_cache_list(int *count, CacheStorageInfo *out, uint64_t h, int max) {
    CacheList *l = (CacheList *)(uintptr_t)h; if (!l || !count || max < 0 || (!out && max)) return R_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    int n = 0; while (n < max && l->next < l->count) { memset(&out[n], 0, sizeof *out); out[n++].index = l->list[l->next++]; }
    *count = n; return 0;
}
static void close_cache_list(uint64_t h) { free((void *)(uintptr_t)h); }
static void unmount(const char *name) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) if (mounts[i].kind && !strcmp(mounts[i].name, name)) { mounts[i].kind = M_FREE; pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock); return; }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
    if (!runtime_romfs_owns(name)) runtime_fail("unmount of unknown fs mount");
}
/* EnsureSaveData(uid) (Bayonetta 3): the profile's save folder is made when storage starts; only the local account owns one. */
static unsigned ensure_save(const uint64_t *uid) {
    ready(); uint64_t me[2]; runtime_account_uid(me);
    if (!uid || uid[0] != me[0] || uid[1] != me[1]) runtime_fail("EnsureSaveData for an unknown account");
    return 0;
}
static unsigned commit(const char *name) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock); int found = 0, save = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) if (mounts[i].kind && !strcmp(mounts[i].name, name)) { found = 1; save = mounts[i].kind == M_SAVE; }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
    if (!found) return R_PATH_NOT_FOUND;
    for (int i = 0; i < NFILES; i++) { pthread_mutex_lock(&lock); int fd = files[i].fd; pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock); if (fd > 0) fcntl(fd, F_FULLFSYNC); }
    if (save && !(getenv("TOTK_PROBE_NEGATIVE") && atoi(getenv("TOTK_PROBE_NEGATIVE")) == 23)) atomic_store(&save_dirty, 0);   /* 23: probe-save's negative control */
    return 0;
}

/* ---------- files ---------- */
static File *file_of(uint64_t h, int *fd, int *mode) {
    if (h < FILE_BASE || h >= FILE_BASE + NFILES) return NULL;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock); File *f = &files[h - FILE_BASE]; int v = f->fd; if (fd) *fd = f->fd; if (mode) *mode = f->mode; pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
    return v > 0 ? f : NULL;
}
void runtime_fs_log(const char *what, const char *path);
static unsigned open_file(uint64_t *out, const char *path, int mode) {
    if (path && !runtime_romfs_owns(path)) runtime_fs_log(mode & 2 ? "write" : "read", path);
    if (runtime_romfs_owns(path)) return runtime_romfs_open(out, path, mode);
    if (!out || !(mode & (OPEN_READ | OPEN_WRITE)) || (mode & ~7)) return R_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    char p[1100]; int kind = M_FREE; unsigned r = host_path_kind(path, p, sizeof p, &kind); if (r) return r;
    struct stat st; if (stat(p, &st)) return R_PATH_NOT_FOUND; if (!S_ISREG(st.st_mode)) return R_PATH_NOT_FOUND;
    int save_writer = kind == M_SAVE && (mode & OPEN_WRITE);
    int fd = open(p, (mode & OPEN_WRITE ? (mode & OPEN_READ ? O_RDWR : O_WRONLY) : O_RDONLY) | O_NOFOLLOW);
    if (fd < 0) return errno_result();
    runtime_autoload_save_file_opened(path);   /* TOTK_AUTOLOAD: a slot's caption.sav starts the presses, its progress.sav ends them */
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < NFILES; i++) if (files[i].fd <= 0) {
        files[i] = (File){fd, mode, save_writer}; *out = FILE_BASE + (uint64_t)i; pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
        if (save_writer) { atomic_fetch_add(&save_writers, 1); save_touched(); }
        return 0;
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock); runtime_fail("host file handle table full");
}
static unsigned read_file(uint64_t *out, uint64_t h, int64_t offset, void *buffer, uint64_t size) {
    if (runtime_romfs_handle(h)) return runtime_romfs_read(out, h, offset, buffer, size);
    int fd, mode; if (!out || offset < 0 || (!buffer && size) || !file_of(h, &fd, &mode)) return R_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    if (!(mode & OPEN_READ)) return R_OPEN_MODE;
    dm_guest_write_prepare(buffer, (size_t)size);
    { extern void nvn_vk_m40j_cp(unsigned, const void *, uint64_t, uint64_t) __attribute__((weak));   /* M40J */
      if (nvn_vk_m40j_cp && size) nvn_vk_m40j_cp(2u, buffer, (uint64_t)size, (uint64_t)offset); }
    uint64_t done = 0;
    while (done < size) { ssize_t n = pread(fd, (uint8_t *)buffer + done, (size_t)(size - done), offset + (off_t)done); if (n < 0) runtime_fail("host save read failure"); if (!n) break; done += (uint64_t)n; }
    *out = done; return 0;
}
static unsigned read_options(uint64_t *out, uint64_t h, int64_t off, void *buf, uint64_t size, const void *options) { (void)options; return read_file(out, h, off, buf, size); }
static unsigned read_exact(uint64_t h, int64_t off, void *buf, uint64_t size) { uint64_t n = 0; unsigned r = read_file(&n, h, off, buf, size); return r ? r : n == size ? 0 : R_INVALID_ARGUMENT; }
static unsigned write_file(uint64_t h, int64_t offset, const void *buffer, uint64_t size, const int32_t *option) {
    int fd, mode; File *f = offset < 0 || (!buffer && size) ? NULL : file_of(h, &fd, &mode); if (!f) return R_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    if (!(mode & OPEN_WRITE)) return R_OPEN_MODE;
    struct stat st; if (fstat(fd, &st)) runtime_fail("host save stat");
    if ((uint64_t)offset + size > (uint64_t)st.st_size && !(mode & OPEN_APPEND)) return R_APPEND_REQUIRED;
    uint64_t done = 0;
    if (f->save) {
        save_touched();
        static int delay_ms = -1; if (delay_ms < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_SAVE_WRITE_DELAY_MS"); delay_ms = e ? atoi(e) : 0; }
        if (delay_ms > 0) usleep((useconds_t)delay_ms * 1000);   /* tests only: slow saves down so a window close lands in the middle of one */
    }
    while (done < size) { ssize_t n = pwrite(fd, (const uint8_t *)buffer + done, (size_t)(size - done), offset + (off_t)done); if (n <= 0) runtime_fail("host save write failure"); done += (uint64_t)n; }
    if (option && (*option & 1)) fcntl(fd, F_FULLFSYNC);
    return 0;
}
static unsigned file_size(int64_t *out, uint64_t h) {
    if (runtime_romfs_handle(h)) return runtime_romfs_size(out, h);
    int fd; struct stat st; if (!out || !file_of(h, &fd, NULL) || fstat(fd, &st)) return R_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    *out = st.st_size; return 0;
}
static unsigned set_file_size(uint64_t h, int64_t size) {
    int fd, mode; if (size < 0 || !file_of(h, &fd, &mode)) return R_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    if (!(mode & OPEN_WRITE)) return R_OPEN_MODE;
    if (files[h - FILE_BASE].save) save_touched();
    return ftruncate(fd, size) ? errno_result() : 0;
}
static unsigned flush_file(uint64_t h) { int fd; if (!file_of(h, &fd, NULL)) return R_INVALID_ARGUMENT; fcntl(fd, F_FULLFSYNC); return 0; }
static void close_file(uint64_t h) {
    if (runtime_romfs_handle(h)) { runtime_romfs_close(h); return; }
    if (!file_of(h, NULL, NULL)) runtime_fail("close invalid file handle");
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock); int fd = files[h - FILE_BASE].fd, save = files[h - FILE_BASE].save; files[h - FILE_BASE].fd = 0; pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
    close(fd);
    if (save) { save_touched(); atomic_fetch_sub(&save_writers, 1); }
}
static unsigned create_file(const char *path, int64_t size) {
    char p[1100]; unsigned r = save_change_path(path, p, sizeof p); if (r) return r; if (size < 0) return R_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    int fd = open(p, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_EXCL | O_NOFOLLOW, 0600); if (fd < 0) return errno_result();
    int bad = ftruncate(fd, size); close(fd); return bad ? errno_result() : 0;
}
static unsigned delete_file(const char *path) { char p[1100]; unsigned r = save_change_path(path, p, sizeof p); if (r) return r; return unlink(p) ? errno_result() : 0; }
static unsigned rename_file(const char *from, const char *to) {
    char a[1100], b[1100]; unsigned r = save_change_path(from, a, sizeof a); if (!r) r = host_path(to, b, sizeof b); if (r) return r;
    struct stat st; if (!stat(b, &st)) return R_ALREADY_EXISTS;
    return rename(a, b) ? errno_result() : 0;
}
static unsigned entry_type(int *out, const char *path) {
    if (runtime_romfs_owns(path)) return runtime_romfs_entry_type(out, path);
    char p[1100]; unsigned r = host_path(path, p, sizeof p); if (r) return r; struct stat st;
    if (!out) return R_INVALID_ARGUMENT; if (stat(p, &st)) return R_PATH_NOT_FOUND;
    *out = S_ISDIR(st.st_mode) ? 0 : 1; return 0;
}

/* ---------- directories ---------- */
typedef struct { char name[769]; uint8_t pad0[3]; int8_t type; uint8_t pad1[3]; int64_t size; } DirectoryEntry;
_Static_assert(sizeof(DirectoryEntry) == 0x310, "nn::fs::DirectoryEntry");
static unsigned create_directory(const char *path) { char p[1100]; unsigned r = save_change_path(path, p, sizeof p); if (r) return r; return mkdir(p, 0700) ? errno_result() : 0; }
static unsigned delete_recursive(const char *path) { char p[1100]; unsigned r = save_change_path(path, p, sizeof p); if (r) return r; struct stat st; if (stat(p, &st)) return R_PATH_NOT_FOUND; return remove_tree(p) ? R_INVALID_ARGUMENT : 0; }
struct RomEntry { char name[769]; int is_dir; int64_t size; };
typedef struct { struct RomEntry *list; int64_t n, cap; } RomList;
static void rom_add(void *ctx, const char *name, int is_dir, int64_t size) {
    RomList *l = ctx;
    if (l->n == l->cap) { l->cap = l->cap ? l->cap * 2 : 64; l->list = realloc(l->list, (size_t)l->cap * sizeof *l->list); need(l->list != NULL, "RomFS directory listing"); }
    struct RomEntry *e = &l->list[l->n++]; snprintf(e->name, sizeof e->name, "%s", name); e->is_dir = is_dir; e->size = size;
}
static unsigned open_rom_directory(uint64_t *out, const char *path, int mode) {
    if (!out || mode < 1 || mode > 3) return R_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    RomList l = {0}; unsigned r = runtime_romfs_list(path, mode, rom_add, &l);
    if (r) { fprintf(stderr, "[totk] RomFS directory %s: result %#x\n", path, r); free(l.list); return r; }
    fprintf(stderr, "[totk] RomFS directory %s: %lld entries\n", path, (long long)l.n);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < NDIRS; i++) if (!dirs[i].dir && !dirs[i].rom) {
        dirs[i] = (Dir){.mode = mode, .rom = l.list ? l.list : calloc(1, sizeof *l.list), .nrom = l.n};
        snprintf(dirs[i].path, sizeof dirs[i].path, "%s", path); *out = DIR_BASE + (uint64_t)i; pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock); return 0;
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock); runtime_fail("host directory handle table full");
}
static unsigned open_directory(uint64_t *out, const char *path, int mode) {
    if (getenv("TOTK_FS_LOG")) fprintf(stderr, "[totk-fs] OpenDirectory %s mode %d\n", path ? path : "(null)", mode);
    if (runtime_romfs_owns(path)) return open_rom_directory(out, path, mode);
    char p[1100]; unsigned r = host_path(path, p, sizeof p); if (r) return r; if (!out || mode < 1 || mode > 3) return R_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    DIR *d = opendir(p); if (!d) return errno_result();
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < NDIRS; i++) if (!dirs[i].dir && !dirs[i].rom) { dirs[i].dir = d; dirs[i].mode = mode; strcpy(dirs[i].path, p); *out = DIR_BASE + (uint64_t)i; pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock); return 0; }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock); runtime_fail("host directory handle table full");
}
static unsigned read_directory(int64_t *count, DirectoryEntry *out, uint64_t h, int64_t max) {
    if (h < DIR_BASE || h >= DIR_BASE + NDIRS || !count || max < 0 || (!out && max)) return R_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    Dir *d = &dirs[h - DIR_BASE]; if (!d->dir && !d->rom) return R_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    int64_t n = 0; struct dirent *e;
    if (d->rom) {
        for (; n < max && d->pos < d->nrom; n++, d->pos++) {
            const struct RomEntry *r = &d->rom[d->pos];
            memset(&out[n], 0, sizeof *out); strcpy(out[n].name, r->name); out[n].type = r->is_dir ? 0 : 1; out[n].size = r->size;
        }
        *count = n; return 0;
    }
    while (n < max && (e = readdir(d->dir))) {
        if (!strcmp(e->d_name, ".") || !strcmp(e->d_name, "..") || strlen(e->d_name) > 768) continue;
        char child[2048]; snprintf(child, sizeof child, "%s/%s", d->path, e->d_name); struct stat st; if (stat(child, &st)) continue;
        int is_dir = S_ISDIR(st.st_mode); if (!(d->mode & (is_dir ? 1 : 2))) continue;
        memset(&out[n], 0, sizeof *out); strcpy(out[n].name, e->d_name); out[n].type = is_dir ? 0 : 1; out[n].size = is_dir ? 0 : st.st_size; n++;
    }
    *count = n; return 0;
}
static void close_directory(uint64_t h) {
    if (h < DIR_BASE || h >= DIR_BASE + NDIRS || (!dirs[h - DIR_BASE].dir && !dirs[h - DIR_BASE].rom)) runtime_fail("close invalid directory handle");
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock); Dir *d = &dirs[h - DIR_BASE];
    if (d->rom) { free(d->rom); d->rom = NULL; } else { closedir(d->dir); d->dir = NULL; }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
}
/* The fs priority only orders I/O inside the system fs process; host I/O is unordered. */
static void set_priority(int priority) { (void)priority; }

/* make probe-save: the "save in progress" state the window close waits on, through the fs entry points the game uses
   (a fresh profile in build/probe-save-profile; no game). */
void runtime_save_probe(void) {
    const char *dir = "build/probe-save-profile";   /* a fresh profile each run (a failed run leaves it for a look) */
    remove_tree(dir); setenv("TOTK_PROFILE_DIR", dir, 1);
    unsigned checks = 0; uint64_t uid[2]; runtime_account_uid(uid); uint64_t h = 0;
#define CHECK(c, what) do { checks++; if (!(c)) { fprintf(stderr, "save probe: %s\n", what); runtime_fail("save probe failed"); } } while (0)
    CHECK(mount_save("save", uid) == 0 && mount_temp("temp") == 0, "mount save and temporary storage");
    CHECK(!runtime_fs_save_busy(), "idle at start");
    CHECK(create_file("save:/a.sav", 16) == 0 && runtime_fs_save_busy(), "creating a save file starts a save");
    CHECK(commit("save") == 0 && !runtime_fs_save_busy(), "commit ends it");
    CHECK(open_file(&h, "save:/a.sav", OPEN_WRITE) == 0 && runtime_fs_save_busy(), "a save file open for writing");
    static const char data[16] = "progress";
    CHECK(write_file(h, 0, data, sizeof data, NULL) == 0 && runtime_fs_save_busy(), "writing");
    atomic_store(&save_changed_ns, runtime_now_ns() - 10000000000ull);
    CHECK(runtime_fs_save_busy(), "a file open for writing is busy however long ago it was written");
    close_file(h);
    CHECK(runtime_fs_save_busy(), "closed but not committed yet (the next file of the save follows)");
    CHECK(commit("save") == 0 && !runtime_fs_save_busy(), "committed");
    CHECK(open_file(&h, "save:/a.sav", OPEN_READ) == 0 && !runtime_fs_save_busy(), "reading is not saving");
    close_file(h);
    CHECK(create_file("save:/b.sav", 4) == 0 && runtime_fs_save_busy(), "second change");
    atomic_store(&save_changed_ns, runtime_now_ns() - 4000000000ull);
    CHECK(!runtime_fs_save_busy(), "uncommitted changes older than 3 s are not a save in progress");
    CHECK(create_file("temp:/t.bin", 4) == 0 && !runtime_fs_save_busy(), "temporary storage does not count");
    CHECK(rename_file("save:/b.sav", "save:/c.sav") == 0 && runtime_fs_save_busy(), "renaming save data");
    CHECK(commit("save") == 0 && !runtime_fs_save_busy() && delete_file("save:/c.sav") == 0 && runtime_fs_save_busy() && commit("save") == 0, "delete and commit");
#undef CHECK
    remove_tree(dir);
    printf("{\"status\":\"pass\",\"probe\":\"probe-save\",\"checks\":%u,\"scope\":\"save-in-progress state (runtime_fs_save_busy) through open / write / close / create / rename / delete / commit on a save mount; reads and temporary storage do not count; stale uncommitted changes do not hold a close\"}\n", checks);
}

void *runtime_fs_host_override(const char *name) {
    static const struct { const char *name; void *fn; } map[] = {
        {"_ZN2nn2fs8OpenFileEPNS0_10FileHandleEPKci", open_file}, {"_ZN2nn2fs11GetFileSizeEPlNS0_10FileHandleE", file_size},
        {"_ZN2nn2fs9CloseFileENS0_10FileHandleE", close_file}, {"_ZN2nn2fs12GetEntryTypeEPNS0_18DirectoryEntryTypeEPKc", entry_type},
        {"_ZN2nn2fs8ReadFileEPmNS0_10FileHandleElPvm", read_file}, {"_ZN2nn2fs8ReadFileEPmNS0_10FileHandleElPvmRKNS0_10ReadOptionE", read_options},
        {"_ZN2nn2fs8ReadFileENS0_10FileHandleElPvm", read_exact},
        {"_ZN2nn2fs9WriteFileENS0_10FileHandleElPKvmRKNS0_11WriteOptionE", write_file},
        {"_ZN2nn2fs11SetFileSizeENS0_10FileHandleEl", set_file_size}, {"_ZN2nn2fs9FlushFileENS0_10FileHandleE", flush_file},
        {"_ZN2nn2fs10CreateFileEPKcl", create_file}, {"_ZN2nn2fs10DeleteFileEPKc", delete_file}, {"_ZN2nn2fs10RenameFileEPKcS2_", rename_file},
```

```cpp
// game_napi.cpp —— ArkTS <-> 游戏宿主 NAPI 桥
// 今晚接通：start(dir) 在独立线程跑 loader 的完整 boot 序列（TOTK_HEADLESS=1，CPU 侧）；
// XComponent surface 句柄经 OH_NativeXComponent 回调收下（swapchain 周末接 nvn_vk）。
// 接线模式抄自 jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile dm/harmony/native/napi_ohos.c。
#include "napi/native_api.h"
#include <ace/xcomponent/native_interface_xcomponent.h>
#include <hilog/log.h>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <thread>
#include <atomic>
#include <unistd.h>

#define LOG_DOMAIN 0x0000
#define LOG_TAG "GameHost"   /* 中性名：平台 NAPI 桥全游戏共用（原 SmoGame 为 SMO 遗留） */
#define HI(fmt, ...) ((void)OH_LOG_INFO(LOG_APP, fmt, ##__VA_ARGS__))
#define HE(fmt, ...) ((void)OH_LOG_ERROR(LOG_APP, fmt, ##__VA_ARGS__))

extern "C" int runtime_main(const char *rewritten_dir, const char *mode);   /* platform/loader.c（原 smo_runtime_main，两处同改防链接错） */
extern "C" void runtime_dump_threads(void);   /* platform/threads.c：guest 线程/锁持有者转储（挂起取证） */
extern "C" void runtime_nvn_stub_report(void);   /* platform/gfx_bridge.c：表外桩调用计数报告（终局 B 计划） */
extern "C" __attribute__((weak)) void runtime_nvn_stub_report(void) {}   // x86_64 壳 weak 兜底（PITFALLS G4）
// x86_64 壳 target 不编 platform 宿主源，与 runtime_main 同款 weak 兜底（真机 arm64 链接真身）
extern "C" __attribute__((weak)) void runtime_dump_threads(void) {}
// Vulkan 窗口接线（round23批1落点1）：surface 到手/销毁转发 nvn_vk 后端，窗口到达触发懒起层。
// arm64 链 nvn_vk.c 真身；x86_64 壳 target 不编 nvn_vk.c，弱符号空实现兜底（runtime_main 同款模式）
extern "C" __attribute__((weak)) void nvn_vk_set_native_window(void *w, uint32_t width, uint32_t height) {
    (void)w; (void)width; (void)height;
}
// 游戏专属 env 配置钩子：donor 对拍地址（TOTK_DUMP_AT 0x131f318 族）等 per-game 配置
// 由 games/<tid>/game_env.c 提供强符号；平台默认空实现，换游戏零改本文件。
extern "C" __attribute__((weak)) void game_configure_env(const char *dir) { (void)dir; }
#ifndef HOST_ARCH
// x86_64 模拟器不编宿主（游戏镜像是 ARM64）：弱符号兜底，arm64 上由 loader.c 的强符号覆盖
extern "C" __attribute__((weak)) int runtime_main(const char *rewritten_dir, const char *mode) {
    (void)rewritten_dir; (void)mode;
    HE("emulator shell only: host runtime not built for x86_64");
    return 2;
}
#endif

static std::atomic<bool> g_running{false};
static std::atomic<int> g_rc{-1};

/* ---- stderr -> hilog：loader 全部诊断（[smo]/[totk]/[odyssey]/[ohos-shim]/FAIL）走 fprintf(stderr)，
   OHOS 上 fd2 无人消费（boot_round3：exit(1) 的 FAIL 文本丢失，0 条原生行）。pipe+转发线程，
   Start() 装一次。stdout 不动（probe 的 JSON 输出本工程用不到）。 ---- */
static void redirect_stderr_to_hilog() {
    static std::atomic<bool> installed{false};
    if (installed.exchange(true)) return;
    int fds[2];
    if (pipe(fds) != 0) { HE("stderr bridge: pipe failed"); return; }
    // round43 渐冻机制（crash_1031）：转发线程的 HI() 在 hilog 背压下若阻塞 → 管道(64K)满 →
    // 全进程 fprintf(stderr) 阻塞在 write() → 游戏线程渐冻（音频心跳停=读端死铁证）。
    // 写端设非阻塞：满则 glibc stdio 丢弃该次输出（丢日志换线程活性），转发线程死不再拖死全场。
    fcntl(fds[1], F_SETFL, O_NONBLOCK);
    dup2(fds[1], 2);
    close(fds[1]);
    std::thread([rfd = fds[0]] {
        char buf[1024];
        size_t len = 0;
        for (;;) {
            ssize_t n = read(rfd, buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len);
            if (n <= 0) break;
            len += (size_t)n;
            size_t start = 0;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++)
                if (buf[i] == '\n') {
                    buf[i] = '\0';
                    if (i > start) HI("%{public}s", buf + start);
                    start = i + 1;
                }
            len -= start;
            if (start) memmove(buf, buf + start, len);
            if (len == sizeof(buf)) len = 0;   // 无换行的超长行：丢弃
        }
    }).detach();
}

/* ---- XComponent surface（d2r-mobile 模式）：窗口句柄先存，供后续 Vulkan swapchain ---- */
static std::atomic<void *> g_window{nullptr};
static std::atomic<int> g_surf_w{0}, g_surf_h{0};

static void surface_set(OH_NativeXComponent *c, void *window) {
    if (window) {
        uint64_t w = 0, h = 0;
        OH_NativeXComponent_GetXComponentSize(c, window, &w, &h);
        g_window.store(window);
        g_surf_w.store((int)w);
        g_surf_h.store((int)h);
        HI("surface ready %{public}llux%{public}llu", (unsigned long long)w, (unsigned long long)h);
        nvn_vk_set_native_window(window, (uint32_t)w, (uint32_t)h);   /* 批1落点1：转发后端（到达即触发懒起层，nvn_vk.c set_native_window） */
    } else {
        g_window.store(nullptr);
        HI("surface destroyed");
        nvn_vk_set_native_window(nullptr, 0, 0);   /* 批1落点1：销毁传 NULL，后端拆交换链（nvn_vk.h:30 注释同款） */
    }
}
static void on_created(OH_NativeXComponent *c, void *window) { surface_set(c, window); }
static void on_changed(OH_NativeXComponent *c, void *window) { surface_set(c, window); }
static void on_destroyed(OH_NativeXComponent *c, void *window) { (void)c; surface_set(c, NULL); }
static void on_touch(OH_NativeXComponent *c, void *window) { (void)c; (void)window; }
static OH_NativeXComponent_Callback g_xcb = {on_created, on_changed, on_destroyed, on_touch};

/* ---- NAPI ---- */
static napi_value Start(napi_env env, napi_callback_info info) {
    size_t argc = 1;
    napi_value argv[1];
    napi_get_cb_info(env, info, &argc, argv, nullptr, nullptr);
    static char dir[512] = "";
    if (argc >= 1) {
        size_t n = 0;
        napi_get_value_string_utf8(env, argv[0], dir, sizeof(dir), &n);
    }
    if (g_running.load()) { napi_value out; napi_create_int32(env, 0, &out); return out; }
    redirect_stderr_to_hilog();
    HI("start dir=%{public}s", dir);
    setenv("TOTK_HEADLESS", "1", 1);   // 无窗口 boot：不进 frontend，直接 CPU 侧启动序列
    // crash_1031 取证：内存 SVC 打点（GetInfo 节流行/MapPhysicalMemory/SetHeapSize）默认开，
    // 仅日志不改行为；overwrite=0——用户显式设置的环境变量优先（可设 0 关闭）
    setenv("TOTK_MEM_LOG", "1", 0);
    // RomFS：宿主 romfs.c 的 runtime_fs_init 读 TOTK_ROMFS（缺省相对路径在 app 沙箱必落空）；
    // 资源由页面「导入游戏资源」放入 <dir>/romfs（runtime-index.bin + romfs.bin.NNN 分卷）
    {
        static char romfs_dir[600];
        snprintf(romfs_dir, sizeof(romfs_dir), "%s/romfs", dir);
        setenv("TOTK_ROMFS", romfs_dir, 1);
    }
    setenv("TOTK_ROMFS_PATCHES", "0", 1);  // 无补丁 overlay（显式关掉，避免缺省相对路径查找）
    setenv("TOTK_ROMFS_MODS", "0", 1);
    game_configure_env(dir);   // 游戏专属 env（SMO 版=games/0100000000010000/game_env.c 的 TOTK_DUMP_AT donor 对拍窗）
    // 账户/存档档案目录：account.c/fs_host.c 读 TOTK_PROFILE_DIR（缺省相对 "user-data"），
    // appspawn 的 CWD 只读，mkdir 必失败（round23 "FAIL: create local account directory"）；锚到 <dir>/user-data
    {
        static char profile_dir[600];
        snprintf(profile_dir, sizeof(profile_dir), "%s/user-data", dir);
        setenv("TOTK_PROFILE_DIR", profile_dir, 1);
    }
    g_running.store(true);
    g_rc.store(-1);
    std::thread([] {
        int rc = runtime_main(dir, "boot");
        g_rc.store(rc);
        HI("boot thread returned rc=%{public}d", rc);
        g_running.store(false);
    }).detach();
    // 挂起取证（round29）：headless boot 挂起时 hdc shell kill -USR1 被 yama 拒（Operation not
    // permitted）、freeze_watchdog 又要求"已呈现首帧"。宿主内自驱动：TOTK_HANG_DUMP_SECS（默认 60，0 关）
    // 秒后首次转储 guest 线程/锁持有者，此后每该间隔一次——挂起自动出现场，正常运行只是多几段日志。
    {
        const char *hs = getenv("TOTK_HANG_DUMP_SECS");
        int hang_s = hs ? atoi(hs) : 60;
        if (hang_s > 0) {
            std::thread([hang_s] {
                for (;;) {
                    sleep(hang_s);
                    if (!g_running.load()) return;
                    HI("hang watchdog: dumping threads");
                    runtime_dump_threads();
                    runtime_nvn_stub_report();   /* 终局 B 计划：高频表外桩名单 */
                }
            }).detach();
        }
    }
    napi_value out; napi_create_int32(env, 0, &out); return out;
}

static napi_value Stop(napi_env env, napi_callback_info) {
    // TODO: 宿主优雅退出（svc ExitProcess 路径），此处先只报告
    napi_value undef; napi_get_undefined(env, &undef); return undef;
}

static napi_value Status(napi_env env, napi_callback_info) {
    // 0=idle 1=running 2=returned；供 ArkTS 轮询状态文案
    int s = g_running.load() ? 1 : (g_rc.load() >= 0 ? 2 : 0);
    napi_value out; napi_create_int32(env, s, &out); return out;
}

static napi_value SurfaceProbe(napi_env env, napi_callback_info) {
    napi_value out; napi_create_int32(env, g_window.load() ? 1 : 0, &out); return out;
}

EXTERN_C_START
static napi_value Init(napi_env env, napi_value exports) {
    napi_property_descriptor desc[] = {
        {"start", nullptr, Start, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, napi_default, nullptr},
        {"stop", nullptr, Stop, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, napi_default, nullptr},
        {"status", nullptr, Status, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, napi_default, nullptr},
        {"surfaceProbe", nullptr, SurfaceProbe, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, napi_default, nullptr},
    };
    napi_define_properties(env, exports, sizeof(desc) / sizeof(desc[0]), desc);
    // XComponent 以本库为 libraryname 加载时，exports 上挂着原生组件句柄（d2r-mobile 模式）
    napi_value xobj;
    OH_NativeXComponent *xc = nullptr;
    if (napi_get_named_property(env, exports, OH_NATIVE_XCOMPONENT_OBJ, &xobj) == napi_ok &&
        napi_unwrap(env, xobj, (void **)&xc) == napi_ok && xc) {
        OH_NativeXComponent_RegisterCallback(xc, &g_xcb);
        HI("xcomponent callback registered");
    }
    return exports;
}
EXTERN_C_END

static napi_module gameModule = {
    .nm_version = 1,
    .nm_flags = 0,
    .nm_filename = nullptr,
    .nm_register_func = Init,
    .nm_modname = "game",
    .nm_priv = nullptr,
};

extern "C" __attribute__((constructor)) void RegisterGameModule(void) {
    napi_module_register(&gameModule);
}
```
