```md
# NVN 回放层移植（来自 BOTWRecompAndroid@4bad6dc，MIT）

## 许可证
源文件取自 https://github.com/mamcjr/BOTWRecompAndroid commit `4bad6dcb0390ae81d0e5d2e174809422d7198d97`，
MIT License, Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai。LICENSE 全文见 `infra/BOTWRecompAndroid/LICENSE`。

## 本目录内容

| 文件 | 来源 | 改动 |
|---|---|---|
| `cmdbuf.c` | `runtime/nvn/cmdbuf.c`（747 行） | **未改一行** |
| `nvn.h` | `runtime/nvn/nvn.h` | 删掉 `#include "../hle.h"`，改为包含 `compat.h` |
| `tegra.h` | `runtime/nvn/tegra.h` | 未改 |
| `compat.h` | 自写 | 提供 infra 依赖的 5 个宏/类型（见下） |
| `plat_ohos.c` | 自写 | NVN 层需要的 9 个 plat_* 函数（OHOS 版） |

## `compat.h` 替代了什么

infra 用链接段注册（`.hle$m`）+ 一套运行时宏；我们只取函数体，注册走我们自己的 `gfx_bridge.c` 符号表。

| infra 依赖 | 我们的替代 |
|---|---|
| `HLE_FUNC(sym, fn)` | `static void fn(Cpu *c)`（不注册） |
| `Cpu` 结构 | 最小声明（只 `x[32]` / `v[32]`，`cmdbuf.c` 只用到这两个） |
| `GUEST_LO/GUEST_HI` | `0x7000000000` / `0x7320000000`（infra `rt.h:41-42` 同值） |
| `LOG/FATAL/ENV` | `fprintf(stderr,...)` / `abort()` / 缓存式 `getenv` |

## 编译验证（2026-11-02）

## 边界：`exec.c` 为什么停在这里（2026-11-02）

`exec.c`（7,929 行，opcode → Vulkan 调用）**不是**像前两块那样能独立编译的：

| 依赖 | 牵扯 |
|---|---|
| `../../hle.h` | 他们的 HLE 派发层 |
| `../../kernel.h` | 他们的客体内核（线程/句柄） |
| `../renderer.h` | 渲染器接口 |
| `vk.h` + `shaders.h` + `timing_trace.h` | Vulkan 后端主体（含 VMA） |
| `../../settings.h` `../../paths.h` | 设置/路径 |

**SDL 依赖很小（只有 5 个符号）**，可轻易 shim：
```
SDL_GetTicksNS(31 处)        → plat_now_ns()
SDL_GetNumLogicalCPUCores    → sysconf(_SC_NPROCESSORS_ONLN)
SDL_DelayPrecise             → nanosleep()
```
真正的工作量是 `vk.h` / `renderer.h` / `kernel.h` 这条链——即整个 Vulkan 后端。

**结论**：`exec.c` 要跟 `vulkan/` 后端（12,662 行）一起搬，是一个**独立的大块**，不适合在周末前硬塞。
周末的最小验证路径应该是：**只接 `cmdbuf.c` 的录制 + 一个 draw opcode 的最小回放**，不搬整个 exec.c。

## 命令流契约与跟踪器（2026-11-02）

### 契约（`nvn.h:117-141`，录制端与回放端共用）

```c
typedef struct {
    uint32_t op, size;   // size 含头，8 字节对齐
    uint64_t x[7];       // 该次调用的 x1..x7
    float    f[4];       // s0..s3
    uint8_t  extra[];    // 拷贝数据（纹理/缓冲等）
} CmdRec;

enum { CMD_END = 0, CMD_JUMP, CMD_CALL, CMD_BIND_PROGRAM, … CMD_BIND_TEXTURES_DEFERRED, CMD_COUNT };
```

**62 个 opcode**。因为录制端（`cmdbuf.c`）与回放端（`exec.c`）都吃这个头文件，
**格式不存在不匹配风险**——要裁的只是「支持哪些 opcode」。

### `cmd_trace.c`（本目录，自写）

走一遍录制好的命令流，输出 opcode 直方图 + 首条非法记录位置。

```c
int  nvn_cmd_trace(const void *base, uint64_t bytes, CmdTrace *out);
void nvn_cmd_trace_report(const CmdTrace *t);
```

**它的用途**：在**没有 Vulkan 驱动的模拟器**上就能回答「SMO 实际发哪些 opcode、各占多少」，
从而把周末要实现的最小回放集从「按 BOTW 猜」变成「按 SMO 实测裁剪」。

编译：`0 error`（aarch64-linux-ohos）。

## 胶水层 `glue_cmdbuf.c`（2026-11-02，自写）

把我们的**参数式**桩转成 infra 的 **`Cpu*` 式**实现。

参数约定（`nvn.h:10-12`）：`A(i) = c->x[i]`、`AF(i) = *(float*)&c->v[i]`。
所以胶水只做一件事：把普通 C 参数搬进 `Cpu.x[]` / `Cpu.v[]`，再调用 `hle_nvn*`。

已接 23 个入口（`glue_cmdbuf.c`）：
- 录制 15：Initialize、AddCommandMemory、AddControlMemory、Begin/EndRecording、DrawArrays、DrawElements、
  SetRenderTargets、ClearColor、BindProgram、BindVertexBuffers、BindTextures、BindUniformBuffers、SetViewports、SetScissors
- 记账/生命周期 8：Finalize、IsRecording、GetCommandMemory{Size,Used,Free}、GetControlMemory{Size,Used,Free}

参数顺序以**真实 NVN ABI** 为准（`third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/nvn_protos.h:330-345/355-396/434`），
不是 `gfx_bridge.c` 里那些已退化成 `(void *c)` 的记账桩形参。第 1 轮接线时修正了 7 处参数序
（DrawElements 的 count 在第 4 参、ClearColor(index,color*,mask)、BindProgram(+stageMask)、
BindVertexBuffers、BindUniformBuffers、BindTextures、SetRenderTargets 6 参）。

`nvn_rec_dropped_calls()` 返回「参数超过 8 个被丢弃」的调用数——实测时用来判断有没有漏录。

**已参与编译**（`nvn_replay/` 已入 CMakeLists）。

## 接线（2026-11-02）—— 唯一事实：客体偏移 0 = 宿主 `NvnCmdBuf*`

`cmdbuf.c:26-31` 的 `nvnCommandBufferInitialize` 自己 `calloc` 一块宿主 `NvnCmdBuf`，
并把指针 `SET_HOST` 写进客体 `NVNcommandBuffer` 偏移 0（宿主地址==客体地址，既有前提）。
因此**所有**命令缓冲入口都必须走 `cb_of()` 取那块结构，不能再按 `gfx_bridge.c` 的 `cmd_h` 覆盖体读字段。

已接线（`gfx_bridge.c` 符号表；前→后 `nvn_command_buffer_*`/记账桩 → `nvn_rec_*`）：

| 类别 | 项数与去向 |
|---|---|
| 录制 | 15 项 → `nvn_rec_*`（Initialize/AddCommandMemory/AddControlMemory 在 `glue_cmdbuf.c:73-98`，其余 12 在 :107-201） |
| 记账/生命周期 | 9 项：Finalize→`nvn_cb_finalize_wired`；EndRecording→`nvn_cb_end_recording_wired`；IsRecording/GetCommandMemory{Size,Used,Free}/GetControlMemory{Size,Used,Free}→`nvn_rec_*` |

- 用量是**游戏字节**：`cmdbuf.c:168/196` 按 `SHADOW_K` 记账，`Get*`（`cmdbuf.c:134-142`）换回游戏字节；
  游戏正是累加 `GetCommandMemoryUsed` 定 RSTB 堆尺寸（`gfx_bridge.c:640` 注释）。
- `nvn_cb_finalize_wired` 先 `nvn_rcpt_drop` 再 `nvn_rec_command_buffer_finalize`（`cmdbuf.c:32` free + 清偏移 0），
  否则 Finalize 后残留的句柄映射会让旧句柄提交时写错回执。

### 回执契约保留（不静默丢）
回执**是被消费的**，不是纯记账：`nvn_rcpt_retire_locked`（`gfx_bridge.c:766-790`）在提交退休时
把 `ReportCounter` 的 16 字节 `{counter,timestamp}` `memcpy` 进客体内存（`gfx_bridge.c:772`），
`ReportValue`/`SignalEvent` 经 `nvn_cb_event_write`（`gfx_bridge.c:713`）写客体 event 值（:774-779）；
另有 `threads.c:1726-1731` 读 `dm_nvn_receipt_stat` 的调试计数。
由于 `EndRecording` 已改走 cmdbuf（句柄从 `g_nvn_handle_gen` 变成命令流首条记录地址），
补了 `nvn_cb_end_recording_wired`（`gfx_bridge.c:1018-1024`）把「新句柄 → CB 客体」写回 `nvn_rcpt_map`，
并保留 donor 的 `g_nvn_ctl_total += 64`/CB 记账，提交侧 `nvn_rcpt_lookup` 才能继续反查到回执。

### 三个已知限制（本轮未解，设备轮再评估）
1. **`g_cpu` 单线程**：`glue_cmdbuf.c:47` 一个静态 `Cpu`，录制若跨线程会互相覆盖；
   现在游戏录制在主线程（提交也在同一客体线程）可接受，多线程录制要改 `__thread` 或加锁。
2. **跨 shadow 页的 `CMD_JUMP` 不跟跳**：`cmd_trace.c:40-56` 只按 `size` 线性前进，
   列表跨 64KB 页时中间那条 `CMD_JUMP`（`cmdbuf.c:88`）的跳转目标不会被跟随，
   直方图会在那里报「首条非法记录」——是跟踪器的限制，不是录制失败。
3. **4 KiB bound**：`gfx_bridge.c:572` 的 `nvn_cmd_trace((void*)h₀, 0x1000, &tr)` 固定上限；
   正常情况下列表以 `CMD_END` 收尾（`cmdbuf.c:234`）远早于此，但若 4 KiB 内没有 `CMD_END`
   会继续读到该页后续数据（同一次 malloc 内，通常安全；极端越界未验证）。

```

`mario-odessy-harmony/entry/src/main/cpp/platform/nvn_replay/cmd_trace.c`:

```c
/* 命令流跟踪器：把 cmdbuf.c 录下来的 CmdRec 列表走一遍，统计 opcode 直方图。
 *
 * 目的：在不具备 Vulkan 驱动的模拟器上，先回答「SMO 实际发哪些 opcode、比例多少」，
 * 从而把周末要实现的最小回放集从「猜」变成「按实测裁剪」。
 *
 * 契约来自 nvn.h（录制端与回放端共用同一头文件，格式不存在不匹配问题）：
 *   CmdRec { uint32_t op, size; uint64_t x[7]; float f[4]; uint8_t extra[]; }
 *   CMD_END=0 … CMD_COUNT，共 62 个（nvn.h:117-141）
 *
 * 2026-11-02 task A/B/C：
 *   A 跨 chunk —— 走流语义照 infra cmdbuf.c 的 nvn_check_list / copy_list（:679-712）：列表不连续，
 *     chunk 之间由 CMD_JUMP 链接（cmdbuf.c:88/188），JUMP.x[0] 是下一段首条记录的宿主地址，
 *     顺着它走即按命令内存的真实分块走完，不自己发明分块规则。
 *   B 累计 —— nvn_cmd_trace_merge 供调用方把每个 submit 的结果累加成一份直方图。
 *   C 边界安全 —— 每读一条记录（含 JUMP 目标落地处）先问 readable(p)（cmdbuf.c
 *     nvn_port_cmdmem_readable：shadow 页块 / 宿主 chunk；glue_cmdbuf.c 补池存储区间），
 *     可读长度不足即停并计 truncated。size 字段只用来在同一可读区域内前进，且上限 1 MiB。
 *
 * 依赖：nvn.h（已在本目录）、compat.h（HLE_FUNC / Cpu / 日志宏）。
 */
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "nvn.h"
#include "cmd_trace.h"   /* CmdTrace 契约（与 platform/gfx_bridge.c 共用，防布局漂移） */

/* 防漂移：cmd_trace.h:10 给 gfx_bridge 用的 CLEAR_COLOR 号必须与 nvn.h 枚举一致。 */
_Static_assert(NVN_CMD_OP_CLEAR_COLOR == CMD_CLEAR_COLOR, "cmd_trace.h CLEAR_COLOR opcode drifted from nvn.h");
/* M3i：SET_RENDER_TARGETS 同款防漂移（cmdbuf.c 录制端与回放端必须同号）。 */
_Static_assert(NVN_CMD_OP_SET_RENDER_TARGETS == CMD_SET_RENDER_TARGETS, "cmd_trace.h SET_RENDER_TARGETS opcode drifted from nvn.h");
/* M4an：CALL 同款防漂移。 */
_Static_assert(NVN_CMD_OP_CALL == CMD_CALL, "cmd_trace.h CALL opcode drifted from nvn.h");

static const char *const kOpNames[CMD_TRACE_MAX_OPS] = {
    "END", "JUMP", "CALL",
    "BIND_PROGRAM", "BIND_BLEND", "BIND_CHANNEL_MASK", "BIND_COLOR", "BIND_DEPTH_STENCIL",
    "BIND_MULTISAMPLE", "BIND_POLYGON", "BIND_VERTEX_ATTRIB", "BIND_VERTEX_STREAM",
    "BIND_VERTEX_BUFFERS", "BIND_UNIFORM_BUFFERS", "BIND_STORAGE_BUFFERS", "BIND_TEXTURES",
    "BIND_IMAGES", "SET_TEXTURE_POOL", "SET_SAMPLER_POOL", "SET_RENDER_TARGETS",
    "SET_VIEWPORTS", "SET_SCISSORS", "SET_DEPTH_RANGES", "SET_BLEND_COLOR", "SET_STENCIL",
    "SET_PRIMITIVE_RESTART", "SET_ALPHA_REF", "SET_DEPTH_BOUNDS", "SET_POLYGON_OFFSET",
    "SET_LINE_WIDTH", "SET_POINT_SIZE", "SET_SAMPLE_MASK", "SET_RENDER_ENABLE",
    "CLEAR_COLOR", "CLEAR_DEPTH_STENCIL", "CLEAR_TEXTURE", "CLEAR_BUFFER",
    "DRAW_ARRAYS", "DRAW_ELEMENTS", "DRAW_ARRAYS_INDIRECT", "DRAW_ELEMENTS_INDIRECT",
    "DISPATCH", "DISPATCH_INDIRECT",
    "COPY_BUFFER_TO_BUFFER", "COPY_BUFFER_TO_TEXTURE", "COPY_TEXTURE_TO_BUFFER",
    "COPY_TEXTURE_TO_TEXTURE", "DOWNSAMPLE", "UPDATE_UNIFORM_BUFFER", "FENCE_SYNC", "WAIT_SYNC",
    "BARRIER", "SIGNAL_EVENT", "WAIT_EVENT", "REPORT_COUNTER", "DISCARD_COLOR",
    "DISCARD_DEPTH_STENCIL", "SET_COPY_STRIDES", "DRAW_TEXTURE", "RESOLVE_DEPTH", "SET_DEPTH_CLAMP",
    "BIND_TEXTURES_DEFERRED",
};

/* 记录级合法性：与 infra nvn_check_list（cmdbuf.c:678）同一判据——
   op 越界，或非 END/JUMP 记录的 size 不在 [sizeof(CmdRec), 1MiB]。 */
/* M17A（2026-11-08）：逐笔宿主点名。draw 记录把客体 LR/FP 藏在 CmdRec.f[0..3]（cmdbuf.c 录制端），
   这里在调 sink 之前抄出来；nvn_vk 的 draw 台账在 sink 内被调，读这两个全局即得"这一笔是哪个客体
   函数录的"。**只读**，不改回放语义（draw 的 f[] 本来就没有消费者）。 */
uint64_t g_m17a_cur_lr, g_m17a_cur_fp;   /* 当前正在回放的 draw 记录的录制者 */
static void m17a_take_lr(const CmdRec *r)
{
    uint64_t a = 0, b = 0;
    memcpy(&a, &r->f[0], 8);
    memcpy(&b, &r->f[2], 8);
    g_m17a_cur_lr = a; g_m17a_cur_fp = b;
}
static int rec_bad(const CmdRec *r)
{
    return r->op >= CMD_COUNT ||
           (r->op != CMD_END && r->op != CMD_JUMP &&
            (r->size < sizeof(CmdRec) || r->size > 0x100000));
}

/* task A+C：跨 chunk 走完整条命令流。语义照 infra copy_list/nvn_check_list：
   顺着 CMD_JUMP 走到 CMD_END；每一步（含跳转目标）先经 readable 验边界。 */
int nvn_cmd_trace_walk(const void *start, nvn_cmd_readable_fn readable, CmdTrace *out)
{
    memset(out, 0, sizeof *out);
    out->stop_why = "未开始";
    if (!readable) { out->stop_why = "无可读性查询"; out->truncated++; return 0; }
    const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)start;
    uint64_t avail = 0;                       /* 从 p 起在当前区域还能安全读多少（0 = 待查） */
    for (uint64_t steps = 0, jumps = 0; steps < (1u << 20); steps++) {
        if (avail < sizeof(CmdRec)) {         /* 换了区域，或首次：先验边界再碰内存 */
            avail = readable(p);
            if (avail < sizeof(CmdRec)) {
                out->stop_why = "被边界截断（记录头落在未知/耗尽区域）";
                out->truncated++; out->first_bad = out->total; out->first_bad_why = out->stop_why;
                return 0;
            }
        }
        const CmdRec *r = (const CmdRec *)p;
        if (rec_bad(r)) {
            out->stop_why = "非法记录（op 越界或 size 非法）";
            out->bad++; out->first_bad = out->total; out->first_bad_why = out->stop_why;
            return 0;
        }
        if (r->op == CMD_END) { out->total++; out->per_op[CMD_END]++; out->bytes += sizeof(CmdRec); out->stop_why = "END"; return 1; }
        if (r->op == CMD_JUMP) {
            if (r->x[0] <= 0x10000) { out->stop_why = "JUMP 目标非宿主地址"; out->bad++; out->first_bad = out->total; out->first_bad_why = out->stop_why; return 0; }
            if (++jumps > 4096) { out->stop_why = "JUMP 过多（疑似环）"; out->truncated++; out->first_bad = out->total; out->first_bad_why = out->stop_why; return 0; }
            out->jumps++; out->bytes += sizeof(CmdRec);
            p = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)r->x[0];   /* 目标的边界下一轮头部先验 */
            avail = 0;
            continue;
        }
        if ((r->size & 7) || (uint64_t)r->size > avail) {  /* size 只在已验区域内前进 */
            out->stop_why = "被边界截断（记录体超出区域）";
            out->truncated++; out->first_bad = out->total; out->first_bad_why = out->stop_why;
            return 0;
        }
        out->total++;
        out->per_op[r->op]++;
        out->bytes += r->size;
        p += r->size;
        avail -= r->size;
    }
    out->stop_why = "步数守卫（1Mi 条）";
    out->truncated++;
    return 0;
}

/* M3h（2026-11-03）：执行式走流。与上面的 walk 逐行同构（同一 rec_bad/边界/跳转/守卫），
   唯一增加：CMD_CLEAR_COLOR 交给 clear_cb 执行；其余 opcode 只记进 per_op。
   M3i（2026-11-03）：CMD_SET_RENDER_TARGETS 追加交 rt_cb（负载口径见下方 nvn_cmd_exec 注释）。
   CLEAR_COLOR 的负载布局来自录制侧 cmdbuf.c:509 record_copy(c,CMD_CLEAR_COLOR,2,16)：
   record() 把 s.x+1 拷进 r->x ⇒ x[0]=颜色槽 index、x[1]=客体 color4 指针、x[2]=mask，
   16 字节颜色在 r->extra（record_copy 从 x[1] 指的那块内存拷）。 */
const char *nvn_cmd_op_name(int op)
{
    return (op >= 0 && op < CMD_TRACE_MAX_OPS) ? kOpNames[op] : NULL;
}

/* M3i（2026-11-03）：SET_RENDER_TARGETS 也交回调执行；负载布局来自录制侧 cmdbuf.c:413-420：
   record() 把 s.x+1 拷进 r->x ⇒ x[0]=n（录制端随后显式重写为 n），extra = RtRec
   { u64 tex[8]; NvnTextureView views[8]; u8 has_view[8]; u64 depth; NvnTextureView dview; u8 has_dview }。
   本层只把 n 与前 8 字节（tex[0]，NVN_CMD_RT_FIRST_TEX_OFF）交给回调，其余结构不解读。

   M3r（2026-11-03）：本函数变成 nvn_cmd_exec_sink 的薄包装（只挂 clear+rt 两个回调），
   走流语义/边界/跳转逻辑只在 sink 版里有一份，不会再分叉。 */
/* M3s（2026-11-03）：首 draw 前的 opcode 取证。
   目的：如果 attrib/stream 前 20 次全是零，需要确认「这条路径上到底有没有非零顶点状态」——
   把首笔 DRAW_ELEMENTS 之前的记录按顺序打出来（每段流的前 64 条 + 全局最近 8 条），
   含每条的前 4 个 word。只输出一次；出口走 sink->note（gfx_bridge 转发到 vk_boot.log）。 */
typedef struct { uint32_t op; uint64_t x[4]; } M3sRec;
static M3sRec g_m3s_ring[8];
static int g_m3s_ring_i;
static int g_m3s_dumped;

static void m3s_note1(const nvn_cmd_sink *sink, const char *line)
{
    if (sink->note) sink->note(line, sink->user);
}

static void m3s_dump(const nvn_cmd_sink *sink, const M3sRec *first, int first_n)
{
    char b[192];
    snprintf(b, sizeof b, "[v] pre_draw dump (first draw reached): stream_first=%d", first_n);
    m3s_note1(sink, b);
    for (int i = 0; i < first_n; i++) {
        const char *n = nvn_cmd_op_name((int)first[i].op);
        snprintf(b, sizeof b, "[v] pre_draw first#%02d %s x=%#llx,%#llx,%#llx,%#llx", i,
                 n ? n : "?", (unsigned long long)first[i].x[0], (unsigned long long)first[i].x[1],
                 (unsigned long long)first[i].x[2], (unsigned long long)first[i].x[3]);
        m3s_note1(sink, b);
    }
    for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
        const M3sRec *r = &g_m3s_ring[(g_m3s_ring_i - 8 + k) & 7];
        const char *n = nvn_cmd_op_name((int)r->op);
        snprintf(b, sizeof b, "[v] pre_draw prev-%d %s x=%#llx,%#llx,%#llx,%#llx", 8 - k,
                 n ? n : "?", (unsigned long long)r->x[0], (unsigned long long)r->x[1],
                 (unsigned long long)r->x[2], (unsigned long long)r->x[3]);
        m3s_note1(sink, b);
    }
}

int nvn_cmd_exec_sink(const void *start, nvn_cmd_readable_fn readable,
                      const nvn_cmd_sink *sink, CmdExecStat *out)
{
    /* M5c：两个弱钩子（没定义也能跑，本文件不依赖 runtime/）：
       ① runtime_cmd_step_note_(steps)：每 256 条记一次阶段环（op=34）——冻结时能读出「走流走到第几条」；
       ② runtime_rss_guard()：内存护栏，触发即停走流（本体在 nvn_vk.c，只放弃本笔工作，绝不 abort 进程）。 */
    extern void runtime_cmd_step_note_(unsigned long long steps) __attribute__((weak));
    extern int  runtime_rss_guard(void) __attribute__((weak));
    memset(out, 0, sizeof *out);
    out->trace.stop_why = "未开始";
    if (!readable) { out->trace.stop_why = "无可读性查询"; out->trace.truncated++; return 0; }
    const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)start;
    uint64_t avail = 0;
    /* M4ao P1：CALL inline 体的边界栈。录制端在每个 handle 的体前插一条 CMD_CALL 标记，
       并把「该体拷了多少条记录」写进 x[1]（cmdbuf.c call_commands）。这里按记录数把体耗完即弹栈，
       于是每条 draw 都能判「它是不是 M4an 新接进来的那部分（in-call）」——这是把
       55.7k 新增 draw 的拒因拆开的唯一依据。嵌套 call 用栈（体里可能还有标记），深度 8 足够。 */
    #define CALL_STK 8
    uint64_t call_rem[CALL_STK];
    int call_depth = 0;
    M3sRec first[64];
    int first_n = 0;
    if (!g_m3s_dumped) { memset(g_m3s_ring, 0, sizeof g_m3s_ring); g_m3s_ring_i = 0; }
    for (uint64_t steps = 0, jumps = 0; steps < (1u << 20); steps++) {
        /* M5q A'：轮询从每 256 条加密到每 64 条（派活单 P1）——越过 trip 后当前这笔重活要尽快退让，
           把 overshoot 从 23 MB 压下去。r_rss_mb() 自带 100 ms 缓存，读取代价不变，变的只是判定延迟。 */
        if ((steps & 63u) == 0) {
            if (runtime_cmd_step_note_) runtime_cmd_step_note_(steps);
            if (runtime_rss_guard && runtime_rss_guard()) {
                out->trace.stop_why = "RSS 护栏（M5c）"; out->trace.truncated++;
                out->trace.first_bad = out->trace.total; out->trace.first_bad_why = out->trace.stop_why;
                return 0;
            }
        }
        if (avail < sizeof(CmdRec)) {
            avail = readable(p);
            if (avail < sizeof(CmdRec)) {
                out->trace.stop_why = "被边界截断（记录头落在未知/耗尽区域）";
                out->trace.truncated++; out->trace.first_bad = out->trace.total; out->trace.first_bad_why = out->trace.stop_why;
                return 0;
            }
        }
        const CmdRec *r = (const CmdRec *)p;
        if (rec_bad(r)) {
            out->trace.stop_why = "非法记录（op 越界或 size 非法）";
            out->trace.bad++; out->trace.first_bad = out->trace.total; out->trace.first_bad_why = out->trace.stop_why;
            return 0;
        }
        if (r->op == CMD_END) { out->trace.total++; out->trace.per_op[CMD_END]++; out->trace.bytes += sizeof(CmdRec); out->trace.stop_why = "END"; return 1; }
        if (r->op == CMD_JUMP) {
            if (r->x[0] <= 0x10000) { out->trace.stop_why = "JUMP 目标非宿主地址"; out->trace.bad++; out->trace.first_bad = out->trace.total; out->trace.first_bad_why = out->trace.stop_why; return 0; }
            if (++jumps > 4096) { out->trace.stop_why = "JUMP 过多（疑似环）"; out->trace.truncated++; out->trace.first_bad = out->trace.total; out->trace.first_bad_why = out->trace.stop_why; return 0; }
            out->trace.jumps++; out->trace.bytes += sizeof(CmdRec);
            p = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)r->x[0];
            avail = 0;
            continue;
        }
        if ((r->size & 7) || (uint64_t)r->size > avail) {
            out->trace.stop_why = "被边界截断（记录体超出区域）";
            out->trace.truncated++; out->trace.first_bad = out->trace.total; out->trace.first_bad_why = out->trace.stop_why;
            return 0;
        }
        out->trace.total++;
        out->trace.per_op[r->op]++;
        out->trace.bytes += r->size;
        /* M4ao P1：CALL 体归因栈（见循环前的注释）。in_call = **本条记录**是否在某个 inline 体内。
           标记自身算父体的一条记录，所以先减父再压栈；x[1]==0（旧记录/空体）不计入栈。 */
        int in_call = (call_depth > 0);
        if (r->op == CMD_CALL) {
            out->call_markers++;
            if (call_depth > 0 && --call_rem[call_depth - 1] == 0) call_depth--;
            if (r->x[1] > 0) { if (call_depth < CALL_STK) call_rem[call_depth++] = r->x[1]; }
            else out->call_body_missing++;
        } else if (call_depth > 0) {
            if (--call_rem[call_depth - 1] == 0) call_depth--;
        }
        if (!g_m3s_dumped) {   /* M3s：留首 64 条 + 最近 8 条，供首 draw 时 dump */
            M3sRec *d = (first_n < 64) ? &first[first_n] : NULL;
            if (d) { d->op = r->op; d->x[0] = r->x[0]; d->x[1] = r->x[1]; d->x[2] = r->x[2]; d->x[3] = r->x[3]; first_n++; }
            M3sRec *q = &g_m3s_ring[g_m3s_ring_i++ & 7];
            q->op = r->op; q->x[0] = r->x[0]; q->x[1] = r->x[1]; q->x[2] = r->x[2]; q->x[3] = r->x[3];
        }
        const uint32_t payload = r->size - (uint32_t)sizeof(CmdRec);   /* extra 里的字节数（记录体已验 ≥ 头） */
        void *user = sink ? sink->user : NULL;
        if (r->op == CMD_CLEAR_COLOR && sink && sink->clear) {
            float rgba[4];
            if (r->x[1] && r->size >= sizeof(CmdRec) + 16) memcpy(rgba, r->extra, 16);
            else { memset(rgba, 0, sizeof rgba); out->clear_noptr++; }
            int rv = sink->clear(rgba, user);
            if (rv == 0) out->clears++; else out->clear_fail++;
        }
        if (r->op == CMD_SET_RENDER_TARGETS && sink && sink->rt_bind) {
            int n = (int)(int64_t)r->x[0];
            uint64_t tex0 = 0, depth = 0;
            if (r->size >= sizeof(CmdRec) + NVN_CMD_RT_FIRST_TEX_OFF + 8)
                memcpy(&tex0, r->extra + NVN_CMD_RT_FIRST_TEX_OFF, 8);
            /* M4q P1：深度目标一起交出去——此前 n=0 的纯深度 pass 在回放侧等于「没有目标」，
               连它写的是哪张 1024×1024 深度图都无从得知（m4p_b1 的 1024×1024 全 0 就此而来）。 */
            if (r->size >= sizeof(CmdRec) + NVN_CMD_RT_DEPTH_OFF + 8)
                memcpy(&depth, r->extra + NVN_CMD_RT_DEPTH_OFF, 8);
            int rv = sink->rt_bind(n, tex0, depth, user);
            if (rv == 0) out->rt_binds++; else out->rt_fail++;
        }
        /* ---- M3r：状态绑定 + 绘制（负载长度逐条校验，不够就跳过该条并计数，绝不越界读） ---- */
        if (r->op == CMD_BIND_PROGRAM && sink && sink->bind_program) {
            out->programs++;
            sink->bind_program(r->x[0], user);
        }
        /* ---- M14B（2026-11-08）：blend / color state 分派 ----
           回调总是装着（同一份二进制做 B0/B1 对比，走流结构完全相同，唯一变量是 nvn_vk 里的
           smo_m14b 开关）。nvn_vk 侧在 smo_m14b=0 时第一行就返回 ⇒ 不存状态、不打印、不改管线。 */
        /* 注意 x[] 的下标：CmdRec.x[] 存的是**游客 x1..x7**（record() 把 s.x+1 拷进 r->x），
           所以「录制时 record_copy 的 arg=1」= 游客 x1 = 现在的 r->x[0]，不是 r->x[1]。
           （M14B 首版写错成 r->x[1]，探针把 guest 指针打成 0 —— 只有打印受影响，payload 是对的。） */
        if (r->op == CMD_BIND_BLEND && sink && sink->bind_blend_state) {
            out->blends++;
            sink->bind_blend_state(r->x[0], payload >= 8u ? (const void *)r->extra : NULL,
                                   payload >= 8u ? 8u : 0u, user);
        }
        if (r->op == CMD_BIND_COLOR && sink && sink->bind_color_state) {
            out->colors++;
            sink->bind_color_state(r->x[0], payload >= 4u ? (const void *)r->extra : NULL,
                                   payload >= 4u ? 4u : 0u, user);
        }
        if (r->op == CMD_BIND_VERTEX_ATTRIB && sink && sink->bind_vertex_attrib) {
            int cnt = (int)(int64_t)r->x[0];
            if (cnt < 0 || (uint32_t)cnt * 4u > payload) { out->draw_skip++; }
            else { out->attribs++; sink->bind_vertex_attrib(cnt, r->extra, user); }
        }
        if (r->op == CMD_BIND_VERTEX_STREAM && sink && sink->bind_vertex_stream) {
            int cnt = (int)(int64_t)r->x[0];
            if (cnt < 0 || (uint32_t)cnt * 8u > payload) { out->draw_skip++; }
            else { out->streams++; sink->bind_vertex_stream(cnt, r->extra, user); }
        }
        if (r->op == CMD_BIND_VERTEX_BUFFERS && sink && sink->bind_vertex_buffers) {
            int first = (int)(int64_t)r->x[0], cnt = (int)(int64_t)r->x[1];
            if (cnt < 0 || first < 0 || (uint32_t)cnt * 16u > payload) { out->draw_skip++; }
            else { out->vbufs++; sink->bind_vertex_buffers(first, cnt, r->extra, user); }
        }
        if (r->op == CMD_BIND_UNIFORM_BUFFERS && sink && sink->bind_uniform_buffers) {
            int stage = (int)(int64_t)r->x[0], first = (int)(int64_t)r->x[1], cnt = (int)(int64_t)r->x[2];
            if (cnt < 0 || first < 0 || (uint32_t)cnt * 16u > payload) { out->draw_skip++; }
            else { out->ubufs++; sink->bind_uniform_buffers(stage, first, cnt, r->extra, user); }
        }
        if (r->op == CMD_BIND_STORAGE_BUFFERS && sink && sink->bind_storage_buffers) {
            int stage = (int)(int64_t)r->x[0], first = (int)(int64_t)r->x[1], cnt = (int)(int64_t)r->x[2];
            if (cnt < 0 || first < 0 || (uint32_t)cnt * 16u > payload) { out->draw_skip++; }
            else { out->sbufs++; sink->bind_storage_buffers(stage, first, cnt, r->extra, user); }
        }
        if (r->op == CMD_BIND_TEXTURES && sink && sink->bind_textures) {
            int stage = (int)(int64_t)r->x[0], first = (int)(int64_t)r->x[1], cnt = (int)(int64_t)r->x[2];
            if (cnt < 0 || first < 0 || (uint32_t)cnt * 8u > payload) { out->draw_skip++; }
            else { out->textures++; sink->bind_textures(stage, first, cnt, (const uint64_t *)(const void *)r->extra, user); }
        }
        if (r->op == CMD_DRAW_ELEMENTS && sink && sink->draw_elements) {
            int mode = (int)(int64_t)r->x[0], type = (int)(int64_t)r->x[1];
            int cnt = (int)(int64_t)r->x[2];
            if (cnt <= 0) { out->draw_skip++; out->draw_skip_cnt++; }
            else if (r->x[3] <= 0x10000) { out->draw_skip++; out->draw_skip_idx++; }
            else if (cnt > (1 << 20)) { out->draw_skip_big++; /* 只取证：行为与此前一致，仍然放行 */ }
            if (cnt > 0 && r->x[3] > 0x10000) {
                if (!g_m3s_dumped) { g_m3s_dumped = 1; m3s_dump(sink, first, first_n); }
                m17a_take_lr(r);   /* M17A：本笔的录制者 */
                /* M4ae P2：x[5] 高 32 位 = ABI 类别（0 普通 / 1 BaseVertex / 2 Instanced，见 cmdbuf.c 录制端）
                   M4ao P1：传出 dclass bit8 = 本笔在 CMD_CALL inline 体内（nvn_vk 据此把 skip 拆成「新增/原有」）。 */
                int dcls = (int)(r->x[5] >> 32);
                if (in_call) out->draw_incall++;
                /* M4ap P1：baseInstance 取 x[5] 的低 32 位（高 32 位是类别标记）——
                   vkCmdDrawIndexed 的 firstInstance 必须带上，否则 shader 的 instance-id 起点错。 */
                int bi = (int)(int32_t)(uint32_t)(r->x[5] & 0xFFFFFFFFull);
                int rv = sink->draw_elements(mode, type, cnt, r->x[3],
                                             (int)(int64_t)r->x[4], bi, (int)(int64_t)r->x[6],
                                             dcls | (in_call ? (1 << 8) : 0), user);
                if (rv == 0) { out->draws++; if (in_call) out->draw_incall_ok++; }
                else {
                    out->draw_fail++;
                    if (rv == 1) out->draw_fail_skip++;
                    else if (rv < 0) out->draw_fail_err++;
                    else out->draw_fail_other++;
                }
            }
        }
        /* M4ad P2：无索引 draw。此前这里**没有分支**——CMD_DRAW_ARRAYS 只进 per_op 直方图，
           于是 m4ac 的 1582 条 DrawArrays 一条都没到过回放侧（不是 skip，是没接线）。
           口径 = cmdbuf.c:566：x[0]=mode, x[1]=first, x[2]=count, x[4]=instances（0 当 1，同
           vkCmdDraw 语义：0 实例 = 不画，这里按 1 兜底并在下方注释里说明）。 */
        if (r->op == CMD_DRAW_ARRAYS && sink && sink->draw_arrays) {
            int mode = (int)(int64_t)r->x[0];
            int first_i = (int)(int64_t)r->x[1];
            int cnt = (int)(int64_t)r->x[2];
            int inst = (int)(int64_t)r->x[4];
            if (cnt <= 0 || cnt > (1 << 20) || first_i < 0) { out->draw_arrays_skip++; }
            else {
                if (!g_m3s_dumped) { g_m3s_dumped = 1; m3s_dump(sink, first, first_n); }
                m17a_take_lr(r);   /* M17A：本笔的录制者 */
                int rv = sink->draw_arrays(mode, first_i, cnt, inst > 0 ? inst : 1, user);
                if (rv == 0) out->draw_arrays++; else out->draw_arrays_fail++;
            }
        }
        p += r->size;
        avail -= r->size;
    }
    out->trace.stop_why = "步数守卫（1Mi 条）";
    out->trace.truncated++;
    return 0;
}

int nvn_cmd_exec(const void *start, nvn_cmd_readable_fn readable,
                 int (*clear_cb)(const float rgba[4], void *user),
                 nvn_cmd_rt_cb rt_cb, void *user,
                 CmdExecStat *out)
{
    nvn_cmd_sink sink;
    memset(&sink, 0, sizeof sink);
    sink.clear = clear_cb;
    sink.rt_bind = rt_cb;
    sink.user = user;
    return nvn_cmd_exec_sink(start, readable, &sink, out);
}

/* task B：把一次 walk 累加进 dst。 */
void nvn_cmd_trace_merge(CmdTrace *dst, const CmdTrace *src)
{
    dst->total += src->total;
    dst->bytes += src->bytes;
    dst->jumps += src->jumps;
    dst->truncated += src->truncated;
    dst->bad += src->bad;
    for (int i = 0; i < CMD_TRACE_MAX_OPS; i++) dst->per_op[i] += src->per_op[i];
    if (!dst->first_bad_why && src->first_bad_why) { dst->first_bad = src->first_bad; dst->first_bad_why = src->first_bad_why; }
}

/* 旧接口：单段直走、不跟跳转（固定 bytes 预算内）。保留为兼容。 */
int nvn_cmd_trace(const void *base, uint64_t bytes, CmdTrace *out)
{
    memset(out, 0, sizeof *out);
    const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)base, *end = p + bytes;
    for (;;) {
        if (p + sizeof(CmdRec) > end) { out->first_bad_why = "记录头超出命令流"; out->first_bad = out->total; out->stop_why = out->first_bad_why; return 0; }
        const CmdRec *r = (const CmdRec *)p;
        if (r->op >= CMD_COUNT) { out->first_bad_why = "opcode 越界"; out->first_bad = out->total; out->stop_why = out->first_bad_why; return 0; }
        if (r->size < sizeof(CmdRec) || (r->size & 7)) { out->first_bad_why = "size 非法（非 8 对齐或过小）"; out->first_bad = out->total; out->stop_why = out->first_bad_why; return 0; }
        if (p + r->size > end) { out->first_bad_why = "记录体超出命令流"; out->first_bad = out->total; out->stop_why = out->first_bad_why; return 0; }
        out->total++;
        out->per_op[r->op]++;
        out->bytes += r->size;
        if (r->op == CMD_END) { out->stop_why = "END"; return 1; }
        p += r->size;
    }
}

/* 打印直方图（只列非零项，按次数降序）。 */
void nvn_cmd_trace_report(const CmdTrace *t)
{
    fprintf(stderr, "[cmdtrace] 总记录=%llu 字节=%llu 跳转=%llu 截断=%llu 非法=%llu 停因=%s 首条非法=第%llu条(%s)\n",
            (unsigned long long)t->total, (unsigned long long)t->bytes,
            (unsigned long long)t->jumps, (unsigned long long)t->truncated,
            (unsigned long long)t->bad, t->stop_why ? t->stop_why : "?",
            (unsigned long long)t->first_bad, t->first_bad_why ? t->first_bad_why : "无");
    /* 简单选择排序，最多 64 项 */
    int idx[CMD_TRACE_MAX_OPS], n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < CMD_TRACE_MAX_OPS; i++) if (t->per_op[i]) idx[n++] = i;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++)
            if (t->per_op[idx[j]] > t->per_op[idx[i]]) { int tmp = idx[i]; idx[i] = idx[j]; idx[j] = tmp; }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int op = idx[i];
        fprintf(stderr, "[cmdtrace]   %-24s %8llu\n", kOpNames[op] ? kOpNames[op] : "?",
                (unsigned long long)t->per_op[op]);
    }
}

`mario-odessy-harmony/entry/src/main/cpp/platform/nvn_replay/cmd_trace.h`:

/* cmd_trace 契约头：cmd_trace.c 的实现与调用方（platform/gfx_bridge.c）共用，
   避免两侧各写一份 CmdTrace 造成静默 ABI 漂移（直方图会读错偏移）。
   语义见 cmd_trace.c 顶部注释；CmdRec 契约见 nvn.h:117-141。 */
#ifndef NVN_PORT_CMD_TRACE_H
#define NVN_PORT_CMD_TRACE_H
#include <stdint.h>

#define CMD_TRACE_MAX_OPS 64

/* CLEAR_COLOR 的 opcode 号（= nvn.h:133 的 CMD_CLEAR_COLOR）。消费方（platform/gfx_bridge.c）
   只为一个常量不值得 include nvn.h（它的 compat.h 会把 LOG/FATAL 等宏带进 gfx_bridge 的命名域）。
   防漂移：cmd_trace.c 顶部有 _Static_assert 与本值比对。 */
#define NVN_CMD_OP_CLEAR_COLOR 33
/* M3i：SET_RENDER_TARGETS 的 opcode 号（= nvn.h:127 的 CMD_SET_RENDER_TARGETS），同款防漂移。 */
#define NVN_CMD_OP_SET_RENDER_TARGETS 19
/* M4an：CALL 的 opcode 号（= nvn.h 枚举里的 CMD_CALL）。CallCommands 每 inline 一个 handle 插一条，
   直方图里 CALL 从 0 变 >0 就是「二级命令流真的接进命令流」的判据。 */
#define NVN_CMD_OP_CALL 2
/* SET_RENDER_TARGETS 记录体（cmdbuf.c:407 RtRec）的前 8 字节 = 槽 0 贴图句柄（RtRec.tex[0]）。
   回放侧只读这 8 字节，不复制整结构：整结构内嵌 infra 的 NvnTextureView 布局，本头不拉 nvn.h。 */
#define NVN_CMD_RT_FIRST_TEX_OFF 0
/* M4q P1：RtRec.depth 在记录体里的偏移。布局 { u64 tex[8]; NvnTextureView views[8];
   u8 has_view[8]; u64 depth; … }，视图 16B×8=128（nvn_obj.h:46 断言 sizeof(view_t)==16），
   故 64+128+8 = 200（200%8==0，depth 无需补齐）。cmdbuf.c 侧有 offsetof 静态断言对账；
   没有深度目标时该 8 字节为 0（录制端 RtRec 零初始化，rt.depth 只在 s.x[4] 非 0 时写入）。 */
#define NVN_CMD_RT_DEPTH_OFF 200

typedef struct {
    uint64_t total;                     /* 走过的记录总数（不含 JUMP） */
    uint64_t per_op[CMD_TRACE_MAX_OPS]; /* 每个 opcode 的次数（JUMP 计在 jumps，不在表里） */
    uint64_t bytes;                     /* 命令流总字节（含 JUMP/END 条目自身的 size） */
    uint64_t first_bad;                 /* 第一条非法记录的位置（0 = 没遇到） */
    const char *first_bad_why;
    /* 2026-11-02 task A/B/C 新增：跨 chunk 走流 + 边界安全计数 */
    uint64_t jumps;                     /* 跟随过的 CMD_JUMP 数 */
    uint64_t truncated;                 /* 被边界截断 / 目标不可判定的次数 */
    uint64_t bad;                       /* 非法记录（opcode 越界 / size 非法）次数 */
    const char *stop_why;               /* 停因："END"= 走完；其余 = 提前终止原因 */
} CmdTrace;

/* 可读性查询：宿主地址 p 落在我们分配过的命令记录区域内，返回从 p 起可安全读的字节数；
   0 = 未知区域（绝不能读）。实现见 cmdbuf.c nvn_port_cmdmem_readable + glue_cmdbuf.c 池表。 */
typedef uint64_t (*nvn_cmd_readable_fn)(const void *p);

/* 跨 chunk 走完整条命令流（start = EndRecording 句柄 = 首条记录宿主地址）。
   语义照 infra cmdbuf.c 的 nvn_check_list/copy_list（:679-712）：顺着 CMD_JUMP 链走，
   每一步先经 readable 验边界，越界/未知区域即停并计 truncated，绝不越界读。
   走完（遇 CMD_END）返 1；提前终止返 0，停因在 out->stop_why。 */
int nvn_cmd_trace_walk(const void *start, nvn_cmd_readable_fn readable, CmdTrace *out);

/* 把一次 walk 的结果累加进 dst（task B：跨 submit 累计直方图）。 */
void nvn_cmd_trace_merge(CmdTrace *dst, const CmdTrace *src);

/* 旧接口（固定单段、不跟跳转），保留仅为兼容；新代码用 nvn_cmd_trace_walk。 */
int nvn_cmd_trace(const void *base, uint64_t bytes, CmdTrace *out);

/* 打印直方图（总数 + 全部非零 opcode，按次数降序；opcode 名字见 cmd_trace.c:19-36）。 */
void nvn_cmd_trace_report(const CmdTrace *t);

/* opcode 名字（越界返 NULL）——M3h：跳过统计要按名报，名字表只在 cmd_trace.c 里有一份。 */
const char *nvn_cmd_op_name(int op);

/* ---- M3h（2026-11-03）：执行式走流，最小回放只做 CLEAR_COLOR ----
   与 nvn_cmd_trace_walk 共用同一套边界/跳转/合法性语义（先 readable 再读、跟 CMD_JUMP 链、
   size 上限 1MiB），唯一区别：遇到 CMD_CLEAR_COLOR 调 clear_cb 执行，其余 opcode 只计数。 */
typedef struct {
    CmdTrace trace;        /* 本条流的 per_op 直方图（含 CLEAR_COLOR/END，total 已计数） */
    uint64_t clears;       /* 回调返回 0（成功执行）的 CLEAR_COLOR 数 */
    uint64_t clear_fail;   /* 回调返回非 0 的次数 */
    uint64_t clear_noptr;  /* 颜色指针为空（x[1]==0）或记录体不足 16B：按全 0 色处理 */
    /* M3i：SET_RENDER_TARGETS 的执行口径（rt_cb 非空时才有非零值） */
    uint64_t rt_binds;     /* 回调返回 0 的次数（RT 绑定已记录/下发） */
    uint64_t rt_fail;      /* 回调返回非 0 的次数 */
    /* M3r：sink 口径（nvn_cmd_exec_sink；本结构在末尾追加，前 6 个字段布局不变） */
    uint64_t programs;     /* BIND_PROGRAM 交给回调的次数 */
    uint64_t attribs;      /* BIND_VERTEX_ATTRIB 交给回调的次数 */
    uint64_t streams;      /* BIND_VERTEX_STREAM 交给回调的次数 */
    uint64_t vbufs;        /* BIND_VERTEX_BUFFERS 交给回调的次数 */
    uint64_t ubufs;        /* BIND_UNIFORM_BUFFERS 交给回调的次数（只计数，见 nvn_cmd_sink 注释） */
    uint64_t textures;     /* BIND_TEXTURES 交给回调的次数（同上） */
    uint64_t sbufs;        /* M5x: BIND_STORAGE_BUFFERS 交给回调的次数（gmem 地址来源） */
    uint64_t draws;        /* DRAW_ELEMENTS 回调返回 0（真画了）的次数 */
    uint64_t draw_fail;    /* DRAW_ELEMENTS 回调返回非 0 的次数 */
    uint64_t draw_skip;    /* 记录体不足/参数不可用而未交给回调的次数 */
    /* M4ad P2：DRAW_ARRAYS 的处理口径（此前整类没有分支，只进 per_op 直方图） */
    uint64_t draw_arrays;       /* DRAW_ARRAYS 回调返回 0 的次数 */
    uint64_t draw_arrays_fail;  /* DRAW_ARRAYS 回调返回非 0 的次数 */
    uint64_t draw_arrays_skip;  /* count/first 非法而未交给回调的次数 */
    /* ---- M4an（2026-11-04）：sink 级 draw 拒收的**原因拆分** ----
       draw_skip 此前只累加、从没打印（gfx_bridge 里 `g_h_cum.draw_skip+=...` 后再无出口）⇒
       「回放侧 skip」与「nvn_vk 侧 skip」对不上账，属于零证据盲区。boot#1 实测 DRAW_ELEMENTS 记录
       395,605 条、真正执行 50,608 条，而 nvn_vk 的 skip 分项只解释得了 73k ⇒ 有 ~275k 拒绝发生在本 sink。
       这两个字段把「计数<=0」与「索引地址非法」分开，下一轮据此判「内联记录体是不是坏的」。 */
    uint64_t draw_skip_cnt;     /* CMD_DRAW_ELEMENTS: count <= 0 */
    uint64_t draw_skip_idx;     /* CMD_DRAW_ELEMENTS: 索引地址 x[3] <= 0x10000 */
    uint64_t draw_skip_big;     /* CMD_DRAW_ELEMENTS: count > 1<<20 */
    /* ---- M4ao（2026-11-04）：sink 侧 fail 的返回码分档 + CALL 体内归因 ----
       此前 fail=37,155 只有一个总数，说不出「多少是 skip 类、多少是 fail 类」。
       rv 语义（nvn_vk.h 的绘图入口）：1 = 各类 skip（见 [r] skip audit 的理由码）；
       <0 = 真失败（-1 未初始化 / -2 r_common_ensure / -3 管线 / -4 顶点 arena）。 */
    uint64_t draw_fail_skip;    /* DRAW_ELEMENTS 回调返回 1（nvn_vk 的 skip_* 类） */
    uint64_t draw_fail_err;     /* DRAW_ELEMENTS 回调返回 <0（nvn_vk 的 fail 类） */
    uint64_t draw_fail_other;   /* 其它非 0/非 1/非负 的返回（应为 0） */
    uint64_t draw_incall;       /* 来自 CMD_CALL inline 体内的 DRAW_ELEMENTS 记录数（seen 口径） */
    uint64_t draw_incall_ok;    /* 其中回调返回 0（真画了）的笔数 */
    uint64_t call_markers;      /* 走到的 CMD_CALL 标记数（x[1] = 该 handle 体内记录数） */
    uint64_t call_body_missing; /* CMD_CALL 标记的 x[1] == 0（旧记录/空体）次数 —— 归因栈的已知缺口 */
    /* M14B（2026-11-08）：blend / color state 绑定回放计数（sink 回调非 NULL 时才动）。 */
    uint64_t blends;            /* CMD_BIND_BLEND 分派次数 */
    uint64_t colors;            /* CMD_BIND_COLOR 分派次数（blend enable 的唯一来源） */
} CmdExecStat;

/* ---- M3r（2026-11-03）：状态/绘制回调表 ----
   目的：回放不再只认 CLEAR_COLOR / SET_RENDER_TARGETS。所有回调都可为 NULL（则该 opcode 只计数）。
   负载布局取自录制端 cmdbuf.c（record() 把 s.x+1 拷进 r->x，record_copy 再从 x[arg] 拷 len 字节）：
     BIND_PROGRAM          x[0]=program（本移植里就是客体/宿主同值指针，cmdbuf.c:317 已改直存）
     BIND_VERTEX_ATTRIB    x[0]=count，extra = count × 4B（va_st{fmt:8,offset:19,stream:5}）
     BIND_VERTEX_STREAM    x[0]=count，extra = count × 8B（vs_st{u32 stride,u32 divisor}）
     BIND_VERTEX_BUFFERS   x[0]=first, x[1]=count，extra = count × 16B（{u64 addr,u64 size}）
     BIND_UNIFORM_BUFFERS  x[0]=stage, x[1]=first, x[2]=count，extra = count × 16B（同 bufferRange）
     BIND_TEXTURES         x[0]=stage, x[1]=slot, x[2]=count，extra = count × 8B（texture handle）
     DRAW_ELEMENTS         x[0]=mode, x[1]=type, x[2]=count, x[3]=index address,
                           x[4]=baseVertex, x[5]=baseInstance, x[6]=instances（cmdbuf.c:567-579）
     DRAW_ARRAYS           x[0]=mode, x[1]=first, x[2]=count, x[3]=baseInstance,
                           x[4]=instances（cmdbuf.c:566-567）
   idx 是 NVNbufferAddress；本移植 GPU 地址 == CPU 地址（gfx_bridge.c:348 注释），可直接读。 */
typedef struct {
    int (*clear)(const float rgba[4], void *user);
    /* M4q P1：depth = 录制侧 RtRec.depth（NVNtexture*，无深度目标为 0）；n=0 的纯深度 pass 靠它取证。 */
    int (*rt_bind)(int n, uint64_t tex0, uint64_t depth, void *user);
    int (*bind_program)(uint64_t program, void *user);
    int (*bind_vertex_attrib)(int count, const void *states, void *user);
    int (*bind_vertex_stream)(int count, const void *states, void *user);
    int (*bind_vertex_buffers)(int first, int count, const void *ranges, void *user);
    int (*bind_uniform_buffers)(int stage, int first, int count, const void *ranges, void *user);
    int (*bind_textures)(int stage, int first, int count, const uint64_t *handles, void *user);
    int (*draw_elements)(int mode, int type, int count, uint64_t idx,
                         int base_vertex, int base_instance, int instances, int dclass, void *user);
    /* M3s：取证行出口（可为 NULL）。收到的是已经格式化好、不含时间戳的一行；
       调用方（gfx_bridge）只需原样写进 vk_boot.log。用于「首 draw 前 64 条 opcode」dump。 */
    void (*note)(const char *line, void *user);
    void *user;
    /* M4ad P2：无索引 draw。负载见 nvn.h/cmdbuf.c:566-567：
       x[0]=mode, x[1]=first, x[2]=count, x[3]=baseInstance(0), x[4]=instances(≥1)。
       接在结构末尾是为了不动既有字段偏移（两侧同编译，但少一个变量就少一种漂移可能）。 */
    int (*draw_arrays)(int mode, int first, int count, int instances, void *user);
    /* M5x：storage buffer 绑定（gmem 的数据源）。负载与 uniform 同形：count × 16B {addr,size}，
       在 r->extra。语料的 gmem shader 读 cb0[17]，而 c0 是 Maxwell 驱动保留段 —— 地址由这条 bind
       决定，用户 UBO 里本来就没有它（M5x boot#1 的 cb0 dump 已证明）。 */
    int (*bind_storage_buffers)(int stage, int first, int count, const void *ranges, void *user);
    /* ---- M14B（2026-11-08）：blend / color 状态绑定 ----
       录制端 cmdbuf.c:498-500：`record_copy(c, CMD_BIND_BLEND, 1, 8)` / `(CMD_BIND_COLOR, 1, 4)`
       ⇒ x[1] = 客体里的状态对象地址，extra = **录制时刻**从该地址拷下的字节（blend 8B / color 4B）。
       回放侧一律用 extra 这份（录制语义的就是绑定时刻的值），不用 x[1] 现读（客体可能已经改过）。
       bytes = NULL 表示记录体不够长（旧记录），调用方按「未绑定」处理。 */
    int (*bind_blend_state)(uint64_t guest_ptr, const void *bytes, uint32_t nbytes, void *user);
    int (*bind_color_state)(uint64_t guest_ptr, const void *bytes, uint32_t nbytes, void *user);
} nvn_cmd_sink;

/* 与 nvn_cmd_exec 同一条走流语义（同一 rec_bad/边界/跳转/守卫），按 sink 分派各 opcode。 */
int nvn_cmd_exec_sink(const void *start, nvn_cmd_readable_fn readable,
                      const nvn_cmd_sink *sink, CmdExecStat *out);

/* rt_cb：n = 颜色 RT 数（记录体 x[0]，录制侧 cmdbuf.c:418 显式写入），
   tex0 = 记录体前 8 字节（槽 0 贴图句柄，见 NVN_CMD_RT_FIRST_TEX_OFF；无负载时给 0）。
   depth = 记录体 NVN_CMD_RT_DEPTH_OFF 处的 8 字节（NVNtexture*，0 = 无深度目标）。
   返回 0 = 执行成功。 */
typedef int (*nvn_cmd_rt_cb)(int n, uint64_t tex0, uint64_t depth, void *user);

/* clear_cb：rgba = 录制时从客体 color4 拷下的 4 个 float。返回 0 = 执行成功。
   走完（遇 CMD_END）返 1；提前终止返 0，停因在 out->trace.stop_why（同 walk）。 */
int nvn_cmd_exec(const void *start, nvn_cmd_readable_fn readable,
                 int (*clear_cb)(const float rgba[4], void *user),
                 nvn_cmd_rt_cb rt_cb, void *user,
                 CmdExecStat *out);

#endif

`mario-odessy-harmony/entry/src/main/cpp/platform/nvn_replay/cmdbuf.c`:

```c
// NVN command buffers: commands are recorded as CmdRec records into a host shadow of the game's own memory, so the
// game's memory management and out-of-memory callbacks work as designed.
//
// Where: in NVN a command handle refers to the list in *control* memory (nvnCommandBufferAddControlMemory), and that
// is the memory whose lifetime is the list's: BOTW gives a small command buffer its own control memory per object
// (kept as long as the list is called) but the same scratch command memory every time. So records go to the control
// memory when the command buffer has some, else to its command memory. Command memory then is only accounted.
//
// How much: our records are bigger than NVN's own tokens, which the game sizes its memory for, so each byte of the
// game's memory stands for SHADOW_K bytes of a host shadow of it (shadow_at: by 64 KB page of guest address). A
// command buffer reports its use in the game's bytes (ours / SHADOW_K); when the game reuses a piece of its memory,
// the shadow of that piece is reused too. A list never crosses a shadow page in one piece: a jump continues it.
// A command handle is the (host) address of a list's first record.
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stddef.h>   /* M4q P1：offsetof（RtRec 与 cmd_trace.h 的偏移对账） */
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "nvn.h"
#include "cmd_trace.h"   /* M4q P1：NVN_CMD_RT_FIRST_TEX_OFF / NVN_CMD_RT_DEPTH_OFF（录制/回放偏移单一来源） */

#define SHADOW_K 8                                                  // shadow bytes per byte of the game's memory
#define SHADOW_PAGE 0x10000ull                                      // (game bytes)
#define JUMP_RESERVE ((sizeof(CmdRec) + SHADOW_K - 1) / SHADOW_K)  // (game bytes) the chaining jump at a chunk's end

static NvnCmdBuf *cb_of(uint64_t guest) { return HOST(NvnCmdBuf, guest); }

NVN(nvnCommandBufferInitialize) {
    NvnCmdBuf *cb = calloc(1, sizeof *cb);
    cb->guest = A(0);
    SET_HOST(A(0), cb);
    RET(1);
}
NVN(nvnCommandBufferFinalize) { free(cb_of(A(0))); SET_HOST(A(0), 0); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferSetDebugLabel) { (void)c; }

static CmdRec *raw_rec(uint64_t at, uint32_t op, uint32_t size) {
    CmdRec *r = (CmdRec *)(uintptr_t)at;
    memset(r, 0, sizeof *r);
    r->op = op;
    r->size = size;
    return r;
}

// ---- shadow pages: guest page -> host block of SHADOW_PAGE * SHADOW_K bytes (allocated at first use, kept)
// Asked for every record the game's threads write, several at once: a lookup takes no lock - slots are only ever
// added (mem published before page). The lock is only for adding one: under it every record contended (futex wakes and
// bionic's contention trace writes, ~15% of the game's threads, the critical path of the frame; simpleperf
// 2026-10-31). No per-thread cache of the last page: a thread-local costs a dynamic TLS resolve in this library.
enum { SHADOW_SLOTS = 1 << 16 };
static struct { uint64_t page; uint8_t *mem; } g_shadow[SHADOW_SLOTS];
static pthread_mutex_t g_shadow_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
// M5r: the two things that really cost host memory, counted so the CallCommands budget can be a memory
// guard instead of a byte-throughput counter (see CALL_TOTAL_MAX below). A shadow page is kept forever (one
// per 64 KB of game address ever written); add_host_memory chunks are never freed either.
static uint64_t g_shadow_pages;    // * (SHADOW_PAGE*SHADOW_K) bytes
static uint64_t g_hostmem_bytes;   // add_host_memory chunks, host bytes
// M5r: CB begin/end pairing and the last CB as it left EndRecording (its first 32 bytes are what the
// submit walker sees first). Written by the record threads, read by the submit-time report.
static uint64_t g_cb_begin, g_cb_end, g_cb_end_nonempty;
static uint64_t g_last_cb_start, g_last_cb_bytes;
static uint32_t g_last_cb_words[8];
// M5r: the handle handed to nvnQueueSubmitCommands and its first 32 bytes. This is the CB the walker
// actually replays, so it is the honest place to answer "guest did not write" vs "we did not capture".
static uint64_t g_submit_n;
static uint64_t g_last_sub_h;
static uint32_t g_last_sub_words[8];

static uint8_t *shadow_find(uint64_t page, uint32_t *at) {
    uint32_t i = (uint32_t)(page * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull >> 48) & (SHADOW_SLOTS - 1);
    for (uint64_t p; (p = __atomic_load_n(&g_shadow[i].page, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)); i = (i + 1) & (SHADOW_SLOTS - 1))
        if (p == page) return g_shadow[i].mem;
    *at = i;
    return NULL;
}

static uint64_t shadow_at(uint64_t guest) {
    uint64_t page = guest / SHADOW_PAGE + 1;  // (+1: 0 marks an empty slot)
    uint32_t i;
    uint8_t *m = shadow_find(page, &i);
    if (!m) {
        pthread_mutex_lock(&g_shadow_lock);
        if (!(m = shadow_find(page, &i))) {  // (still missing: added at the empty slot it ended on)
            m = malloc(SHADOW_PAGE * SHADOW_K + sizeof(CmdRec));
            if (!m) FATAL("nvn: no memory for a command shadow page\n");
            g_shadow[i].mem = m;
            __atomic_store_n(&g_shadow[i].page, page, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
            __atomic_fetch_add(&g_shadow_pages, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        }
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_shadow_lock);
    }
    return (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)m + guest % SHADOW_PAGE * SHADOW_K;
}

// ---- PORT(port-only, additive; PORTING.md "cmd_trace 边界查询"): host-chunk registry + readable-bounds query
// for the cmd_trace walker (cmd_trace.c). Purely additive: nothing above changes behavior. The walker follows
// CMD_JUMP chains through host shadow pages / host chunks, and must bound every read by a region we allocated —
// a shadow page block (SHADOW_PAGE*SHADOW_K + one spare CmdRec of slack, line ~65) or a host chunk from
// add_host_memory. Pool-storage chunks are registered by glue_cmdbuf.c on top of this.
static struct { uint8_t *mem; uint64_t bytes; } g_host_chunks[4096];
static uint32_t g_host_chunks_n;
static void note_host_chunk(uint8_t *m, uint64_t bytes) {
    if (g_host_chunks_n < sizeof g_host_chunks / sizeof g_host_chunks[0]) {  // (submit thread + record threads;
        g_host_chunks[g_host_chunks_n].mem = m;                             //  entries are only ever added, and a
        g_host_chunks[g_host_chunks_n].bytes = bytes;                       //  torn read at worst sees a stale n)
        g_host_chunks_n++;
    }
}
// How many bytes are safely readable at host address p within one region we allocated for command records?
// 0 = p is in no known region: the caller must stop and count, never read.
uint64_t nvn_port_cmdmem_readable(const void *p) {
    static uint32_t last;  // records cluster inside a page/chunk: cache the last hit (see line 44 note)
    uint8_t *q = (uint8_t *)p;
    uint32_t l = __atomic_load_n(&last, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    if (l) {
        if (__atomic_load_n(&g_shadow[l].page, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) {
            uint8_t *m = g_shadow[l].mem, *hi = m + SHADOW_PAGE * SHADOW_K + sizeof(CmdRec);
            if (q >= m && q < hi) return (uint64_t)(hi - q);
        }
    }
    for (uint32_t i = 1; i < SHADOW_SLOTS; i++) {  // (slot 0 never holds: page numbers start at 1)
        if (!__atomic_load_n(&g_shadow[i].page, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE)) continue;
        uint8_t *m = g_shadow[i].mem, *hi = m + SHADOW_PAGE * SHADOW_K + sizeof(CmdRec);
        if (q >= m && q < hi) { __atomic_store_n(&last, i, __ATOMIC_RELAXED); return (uint64_t)(hi - q); }
    }
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_host_chunks_n; i++) {
        uint8_t *m = g_host_chunks[i].mem, *hi = m + g_host_chunks[i].bytes;
        if (q >= m && q < hi) return (uint64_t)(hi - q);
    }
    return 0;
}

// The chunk records go to: cb->gmem (guest address; 0: host memory at cb->mem), cb->size and cb->used in game bytes.
// (the page last written kept in the command buffer: a page's shadow never moves, so it can't go stale)
static uint64_t write_at(NvnCmdBuf *cb) {
    if (!cb->gmem) return cb->mem + cb->used * SHADOW_K;
    uint64_t guest = cb->gmem + cb->used, page = guest / SHADOW_PAGE + 1;
    if (page != cb->shadow_page) cb->shadow_mem = shadow_at(guest - guest % SHADOW_PAGE), cb->shadow_page = page;
    return cb->shadow_mem + guest % SHADOW_PAGE * SHADOW_K;
}

// The list being recorded goes on at `to` (a jump to it).
static void jump_from_here(NvnCmdBuf *cb, uint64_t to) {
    if (cb->recording && (cb->gmem || cb->mem)) raw_rec(write_at(cb), CMD_JUMP, sizeof(CmdRec))->x[0] = to;
}

static void set_chunk(NvnCmdBuf *cb, uint64_t gmem, uint64_t mem, uint64_t size) {
    if (gmem) {
        uint64_t in_page = gmem % SHADOW_PAGE;
        if (in_page + JUMP_RESERVE > SHADOW_PAGE) {
            uint64_t skip = SHADOW_PAGE - in_page;
            gmem += skip;
            size = size > skip ? size - skip : 0;
        }
    }
    if (cb->recording && ENV("LARECOMP_CHECK_HANDLES")) {
        static int n;
        if (n++ < 40) LOG("[nvn] command buffer %llx: new memory %llx (host %llx) while recording, %llu of %llu used at %llx\n",
                          (unsigned long long)cb->guest, (unsigned long long)gmem, (unsigned long long)mem,
                          (unsigned long long)cb->used, (unsigned long long)cb->size, (unsigned long long)cb->gmem);
    }
    jump_from_here(cb, gmem ? shadow_at(gmem) : mem);
    cb->gmem = gmem;
    cb->mem = mem;
    cb->size = size;
    cb->used = 0;
}

NVN(nvnCommandBufferAddCommandMemory) {
    NvnCmdBuf *cb = cb_of(A(0));
    if (ENV("LARECOMP_CHECK_HANDLES")) {
        static int n;
        if (n++ < 300) LOG("[nvn] AddCommandMemory %llx: pool %llx +%llx size %llx (lr %llx)\n", (unsigned long long)A(0),
                           (unsigned long long)A(1), (unsigned long long)A(2), (unsigned long long)A(3), (unsigned long long)c->x[30]);
    }
    cb->cmd_size = A(3), cb->cmd_used = 0;
    if (!cb->has_ctrl) set_chunk(cb, HOST(NvnPool, A(1))->storage + A(2), 0, A(3));
}
NVN(nvnCommandBufferAddControlMemory) {
    NvnCmdBuf *cb = cb_of(A(0));
    if (ENV("LARECOMP_CHECK_HANDLES")) {
        static int n;
        if (n++ < 300) LOG("[nvn] AddControlMemory %llx: %llx size %llx (lr %llx)\n", (unsigned long long)A(0), (unsigned long long)A(1),
                           (unsigned long long)A(2), (unsigned long long)c->x[30]);
    }
    cb->has_ctrl = true;
    set_chunk(cb, A(1), 0, A(2));
}
static uint64_t chunk_free(const NvnCmdBuf *cb) { return cb->size > cb->used + JUMP_RESERVE ? cb->size - cb->used - JUMP_RESERVE : 0; }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferGetCommandMemorySize) { NvnCmdBuf *cb = cb_of(A(0)); RET(cb->has_ctrl ? cb->cmd_size : cb->size); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferGetCommandMemoryUsed) { NvnCmdBuf *cb = cb_of(A(0)); RET(cb->has_ctrl ? cb->cmd_used : cb->used); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferGetCommandMemoryFree) {
    NvnCmdBuf *cb = cb_of(A(0));
    RET(cb->has_ctrl ? cb->cmd_size - cb->cmd_used : chunk_free(cb));
}
NVN(nvnCommandBufferGetControlMemorySize) { NvnCmdBuf *cb = cb_of(A(0)); RET(cb->has_ctrl ? cb->size : 0x10000); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferGetControlMemoryUsed) { NvnCmdBuf *cb = cb_of(A(0)); RET(cb->has_ctrl ? cb->used : 0); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferGetControlMemoryFree) { NvnCmdBuf *cb = cb_of(A(0)); RET(cb->has_ctrl ? chunk_free(cb) : 0x10000); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferSetMemoryCallback) { cb_of(A(0))->callback = A(1); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferGetMemoryCallback) { RET(cb_of(A(0))->callback); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferSetMemoryCallbackData) { cb_of(A(0))->callback_data = A(1); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferGetMemoryCallbackData) { RET(cb_of(A(0))->callback_data); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferSetCommandMemoryCallbackEnabled) { (void)c; }

// Memory of our own, when the game's runs out and its callback adds none (BOTW: an empty callback on small command
// buffers). Lists live as long as the game keeps calling them, so these chunks are never freed; LARECOMP_LOG_CMDMEM
// logs each one.
static void add_host_memory(NvnCmdBuf *cb, uint32_t need) {
    uint64_t size = need + JUMP_RESERVE > 0x800 ? need + JUMP_RESERVE : 0x800;  // (game bytes)
    uint8_t *mem = malloc(size * SHADOW_K);
    if (!mem) FATAL("nvn: out of command memory (host, %llu bytes)\n", (unsigned long long)(size * SHADOW_K));
    uint64_t total = __atomic_add_fetch(&g_hostmem_bytes, size * SHADOW_K, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);  // M5r: real host bytes
    note_host_chunk(mem, size * SHADOW_K);  // PORT(port-only, additive): bounds registry for cmd_trace (PORTING.md)
    if (ENV("LARECOMP_LOG_CMDMEM"))
        LOG("[nvn] command buffer %llx: %llu bytes of host command memory (%llu KB in all)\n",
            (unsigned long long)cb->guest, (unsigned long long)(size * SHADOW_K), (unsigned long long)(total / 1024));
    set_chunk(cb, 0, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)mem, size);
}

// Reserve a record of `real` bytes (header included). May call back into the guest for more memory, so
// callers snapshot their arguments first. (M4an: split out of rec() so CallCommands can inline a record
// of exactly the size the called list used.)
static CmdRec *rec_alloc(Cpu *c, NvnCmdBuf *cb, uint32_t real) {
    uint32_t size = (real + SHADOW_K - 1) / SHADOW_K;  // (game bytes)
    for (int tries = 0; (!cb->gmem && !cb->mem) || cb->used + size + JUMP_RESERVE > cb->size; tries++) {
        if (!cb->callback || tries == 2) {
            add_host_memory(cb, size);
            break;
        }
        uint64_t saved[8];
        memcpy(saved, c->x, sizeof saved);
        c->x[0] = cb->guest;
        c->x[1] = cb->has_ctrl;  // NVN_COMMAND_BUFFER_MEMORY_EVENT_OUT_OF_COMMAND_MEMORY / _CONTROL_MEMORY
        c->x[2] = size + JUMP_RESERVE;
        c->x[3] = cb->callback_data;
        guest_call(c, cb->callback);
        memcpy(c->x, saved, sizeof saved);
    }
    if (cb->gmem) {  // (a record doesn't cross a shadow page: the rest of the page is skipped)
        uint64_t in_page = (cb->gmem + cb->used) % SHADOW_PAGE;
        if (in_page + size + JUMP_RESERVE > SHADOW_PAGE) {
            uint64_t skip = SHADOW_PAGE - in_page;
            if (cb->used + skip + size + JUMP_RESERVE <= cb->size) {
                raw_rec(write_at(cb), CMD_JUMP, sizeof(CmdRec))->x[0] = shadow_at(cb->gmem + cb->used + skip);
                cb->used += skip;
            } else {
                add_host_memory(cb, size);
            }
        }
    }
    CmdRec *r = raw_rec(write_at(cb), 0, real);
    cb->used += size;
    return r;
}
static CmdRec *rec(Cpu *c, NvnCmdBuf *cb, uint32_t op, uint32_t extra) {
    CmdRec *r = rec_alloc(c, cb, (uint32_t)((sizeof(CmdRec) + extra + 7) & ~7u));
    r->op = op;
    return r;
}

NVN(nvnCommandBufferBeginRecording) {
    NvnCmdBuf *cb = cb_of(A(0));
    cb->recording = true;
    cb->start = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)rec(c, cb, CMD_BARRIER, 0);  // makes sure memory exists; the list starts here
    __atomic_fetch_add(&g_cb_begin, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);         // M5r: begin/end pairing (report P3 #2)
}
// LARECOMP_CHECK_HANDLES: the last lists recorded (where they start and end in the shadow, by whom, from which game
// memory), to tell who recorded over a list that is called later
typedef struct { uint64_t start, end, cb, gmem, gused, lr, seq; } ListRec;
enum { HIST = 1 << 16 };
static ListRec g_hist[HIST];
static _Atomic uint64_t g_hist_n;
static void hist_report(uint64_t h) {
    uint64_t n = g_hist_n, found = ~0ull;
    for (uint64_t k = n; k-- > (n > HIST ? n - HIST : 0);)
        if (g_hist[k % HIST].start == h) { found = k; break; }
    if (found == ~0ull) { LOG("[nvn]   %llx: not among the last lists recorded\n", (unsigned long long)h); return; }
    const ListRec *l = &g_hist[found % HIST];
    LOG("[nvn]   %llx: list #%llu by %llx (lr %llx), game memory %llx+%llx, %llu lists ago; recorded over by:\n",
        (unsigned long long)h, (unsigned long long)found, (unsigned long long)l->cb, (unsigned long long)l->lr,
        (unsigned long long)l->gmem, (unsigned long long)l->gused, (unsigned long long)(n - found));
    int shown = 0;
    for (uint64_t k = found + 1; k < n && shown < 6; k++) {
        const ListRec *o = &g_hist[k % HIST];
        if (o->start < l->end && o->end > l->start) {
            LOG("[nvn]     #%llu by %llx (lr %llx): %llx-%llx, game memory %llx+%llx\n", (unsigned long long)k,
                (unsigned long long)o->cb, (unsigned long long)o->lr, (unsigned long long)o->start, (unsigned long long)o->end,
                (unsigned long long)o->gmem, (unsigned long long)o->gused);
            shown++;
        }
    }
}

NVN(nvnCommandBufferEndRecording) {
    NvnCmdBuf *cb = cb_of(A(0));
    rec(c, cb, CMD_END, 0);
    cb->recording = false;
    if (ENV("LARECOMP_CHECK_HANDLES")) {
        uint64_t k = g_hist_n++;
        ListRec *l = &g_hist[k % HIST];
        l->start = cb->start, l->end = write_at(cb), l->cb = cb->guest, l->gmem = cb->gmem, l->gused = cb->used;
        l->lr = c->x[30], l->seq = k;
    }
    if (ENV("LARECOMP_CHECK_HANDLES")) {
        static int n;
        if (n++ < 400) LOG("[nvn] EndRecording %llx -> %llx (lr %llx)\n", (unsigned long long)cb->guest,
                           (unsigned long long)cb->start, (unsigned long long)c->x[30]);
    }
    __atomic_fetch_add(&g_cb_end, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);              // M5r: begin/end pairing
    {   // M5r: snapshot the CB the walker will see: start, span, and its first 32 bytes (safe-read bounded)
        uint64_t s = cb->start, e = write_at(cb);
        uint64_t span = e > s ? e - s : 0;
        g_last_cb_start = s, g_last_cb_bytes = span;
        if (span > sizeof(CmdRec)) __atomic_fetch_add(&g_cb_end_nonempty, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        uint64_t avail = s ? nvn_port_cmdmem_readable((const void *)(uintptr_t)s) : 0;
        memset(g_last_cb_words, 0, sizeof g_last_cb_words);
        if (avail >= sizeof g_last_cb_words) memcpy(g_last_cb_words, (const void *)(uintptr_t)s, sizeof g_last_cb_words);
    }
    RET(cb->start);
}
NVN(nvnCommandBufferIsRecording) { RET(cb_of(A(0))->recording); }

// ---- M4an (2026-11-04): CallCommands / CopyCommands
//
// Until now both were flat accounting stubs in gfx_bridge.c, so the lists they call (47,648 calls per boot)
// never entered any command stream: nothing they recorded was ever replayed, and CALL did not even appear in
// the opcode histogram. donor semantics (third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/hle_nvn.c:1172-1215): for every handle,
// copy the already-recorded record bodies byte for byte into the caller's stream, stopping at END and skipping
// BEGIN (the loop below is that one). Every read is bounded by nvn_port_cmdmem_readable first; a handle that
// is not a readable list only counts as bad and is skipped, it never takes the process down.
// Per-call inline budget 1 MiB (truncate + count past it); a global budget keeps a runaway call pattern from
// growing command memory without bound (add_host_memory chunks are never freed).
#define CALL_INLINE_MAX (1u << 20)
#define CALL_TOTAL_MAX  (4096ull << 20)  // M4an: boot#1 的 512 MiB 在 #4000 左右打满（capped=26024）遮住了受试尾部
                                         // 注意必须用 ull：`4096u << 20` 在 32 位上溢出成 0（boot#2 因此全量 capped）
/* M5r（2026-11-05）: THE 4 GiB CUMULATIVE CAP WAS THE GATE.
   m5q_b2 hit CALL_TOTAL_MAX at t~541 s and from then on every nvnCommandBufferCallCommands returned 0
   without inlining anything and without writing the CMD_CALL marker: 10.26 M of 11.74 M calls dropped,
   CALL opcode frozen at 179129, draws frozen at 91982, screen stuck on the load screen. The game itself
   never stopped (33 threads, identical wait kinds on both sides, io finished at t~422, 30 k calls/s).
   And the counter is not memory: inlining 2.6 GiB moved RSS by ~0 while 300 MB of RSS appeared with
   inlining switched off (report P0.6). So:
     - the cumulative counter stays as a headline number only (1 TiB: a boot cannot reach it);
     - the budget that can stop inlining now measures host command memory actually allocated
       (shadow pages + add_host_memory chunks), which is the thing that used to run away. */
#define CMDMEM_HOST_MAX (3072ull << 20)  // 3 GiB of real command host memory; RSS guard is 4200 MB
static uint64_t g_cc_calls, g_cc_bytes, g_cc_recs, g_cc_bad, g_cc_end, g_cc_trunc, g_cc_notrec, g_cc_capped;
static uint64_t g_cc_hostcap;   // M5r: calls refused by the REAL memory cap (distinct from g_cc_capped)
static uint64_t g_cc_total_cap = (1ull << 40);
static uint64_t g_cmdmem_host_cap = CMDMEM_HOST_MAX;
static uint64_t g_cc_last[4];  // bytes, recs, bad, stop_end of the last call (the ledger's per-call line)

// M5r: real command-stream host memory, the only honest budget input.
static uint64_t cmdmem_host_bytes(void) {
    return __atomic_load_n(&g_hostmem_bytes, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) +
           __atomic_load_n(&g_shadow_pages, __ATOMIC_RELAXED) * (SHADOW_PAGE * SHADOW_K + sizeof(CmdRec));
}
// M5r: the CB as it leaves EndRecording - its first 32 bytes are what the submit walker sees first.
// (state declared at the top of the file)
// M5r ledger: host_mem_bytes, shadow_pages, host_chunks, hostcap, cb_begin, cb_end, cb_end_nonempty, 0
void nvn_port_cmdmem_stats(uint64_t *o) {
    o[0] = cmdmem_host_bytes();
    o[1] = __atomic_load_n(&g_shadow_pages, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    o[2] = __atomic_load_n(&g_hostmem_bytes, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    o[3] = g_cc_hostcap;
    o[4] = g_cb_begin;
    o[5] = g_cb_end;
    o[6] = g_cb_end_nonempty;
    o[7] = 0;
}
void nvn_port_last_cb(uint64_t *o) {  // submit_n, last_submit_handle, span_of_last_ended_cb, then 8 words
    o[0] = __atomic_load_n(&g_submit_n, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    o[1] = __atomic_load_n(&g_last_sub_h, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    o[2] = g_last_cb_bytes;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) o[3 + i] = g_last_sub_words[i];
}
// M5r: called from nvn_queue_submit_commands with the guest's handle array (read-only, bounded).
void nvn_port_note_submit_h(const void *h, int n) {
    __atomic_fetch_add(&g_submit_n, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    if (n <= 0 || !h) return;
    uint64_t a = ((const uint64_t *)h)[0];
    __atomic_store_n(&g_last_sub_h, a, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    uint64_t avail = a ? nvn_port_cmdmem_readable((const void *)(uintptr_t)a) : 0;
    memset(g_last_sub_words, 0, sizeof g_last_sub_words);
    if (avail >= sizeof g_last_sub_words) memcpy(g_last_sub_words, (const void *)(uintptr_t)a, sizeof g_last_sub_words);
}

void nvn_port_callcmd_totals(uint64_t *o) {  // calls, bytes, recs, bad, stop_end, trunc, notrec, capped
    o[0] = g_cc_calls, o[1] = g_cc_bytes, o[2] = g_cc_recs, o[3] = g_cc_bad;
    o[4] = g_cc_end, o[5] = g_cc_trunc, o[6] = g_cc_notrec, o[7] = g_cc_capped;
}
void nvn_port_callcmd_last(uint64_t *o) {  // bytes, recs, bad, stop_end
    memcpy(o, g_cc_last, sizeof g_cc_last);
}
static void call_list(Cpu *c, NvnCmdBuf *cb, uint64_t h, uint64_t *bytes, uint64_t *recs, uint64_t *bad,
                      uint64_t *end, uint64_t budget) {
    if (h <= 0x10000) { (*bad)++; return; }
    const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)h;
    uint64_t avail = 0;
    for (uint64_t steps = 0; steps < (1u << 16); steps++) {
        if (avail < sizeof(CmdRec)) {  // (a new region, or the first record: bound the read before touching it)
            avail = nvn_port_cmdmem_readable(p);
            if (avail < sizeof(CmdRec)) { (*bad)++; return; }
        }
        const CmdRec *r = (const CmdRec *)p;
        if (r->op >= CMD_COUNT) { (*bad)++; return; }
        if (r->op == CMD_END) { (*end)++; return; }  // (the caller's own END stays the terminator)
        if (r->op == CMD_JUMP) {
            if (r->x[0] <= 0x10000) { (*bad)++; return; }
            p = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)r->x[0];
            avail = 0;
            continue;
        }
        if ((r->size & 7) || r->size < sizeof(CmdRec) || r->size > 0x100000 || (uint64_t)r->size > avail) {
            (*bad)++;
            return;
        }
        if (*bytes + r->size > budget) { g_cc_trunc++; return; }
        CmdRec *d = rec_alloc(c, cb, r->size);
        memcpy(d, r, r->size);
        *bytes += r->size;
        (*recs)++;
        p += r->size;
        avail -= r->size;
    }
    g_cc_trunc++;  // step guard (a cyclic list recorded by the game)
}
static uint64_t call_commands(Cpu *c, int n, const uint64_t *hs) {
    NvnCmdBuf *cb = cb_of(A(0));
    uint64_t bytes = 0, recs = 0, bad = 0, end = 0;
    g_cc_calls++;
    g_cc_last[0] = g_cc_last[1] = g_cc_last[2] = g_cc_last[3] = 0;
    if (!cb || !cb->recording || !hs || n <= 0) {  // (not recording: nothing to inline into; counted, not silent)
        if (cb && !cb->recording) g_cc_notrec++;
        else g_cc_bad++;
        return 0;
    }
    if (g_cc_bytes >= g_cc_total_cap) {  // M5r: headline counter only, 1 TiB (was 4 GiB = the gate)
        g_cc_capped++;
        return 0;
    }
    if (cmdmem_host_bytes() >= g_cmdmem_host_cap) {  // M5r: the real guard (shadow pages + host chunks)
        g_cc_hostcap++;
        return 0;
    }
    if (n > 64) { g_cc_trunc += (uint64_t)(n - 64); n = 64; }  // (infra capped handles[] at 64 too)
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        CmdRec *m = rec(c, cb, CMD_CALL, 0);  // (opcode histogram evidence: CALL must go from 0 to >0)
        m->x[0] = hs[i];
        m->x[1] = 0;
        uint64_t r0 = recs;
        call_list(c, cb, hs[i], &bytes, &recs, &bad, &end, bytes + CALL_INLINE_MAX);
        // M4ao P1: x[1] = how many records this handle's body appended. The walker needs the body length to tell
        // "new" inlined draws from the top-level stream (donor CMD_CALL carries no such field, x[1] was unused).
        // Patched after the body lands: m points into the same host chunk, so the pointer stays valid.
        m->x[1] = recs - r0;
    }
    g_cc_bytes += bytes, g_cc_recs += recs, g_cc_bad += bad, g_cc_end += end;
    g_cc_last[0] = bytes, g_cc_last[1] = recs, g_cc_last[2] = bad, g_cc_last[3] = end;
    return 1;
}
NVN(nvnCommandBufferCallCommands) { RET(call_commands(c, (int)A(1), (const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)A(2))); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferCopyCommands) { RET(call_commands(c, (int)A(1), (const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)A(2))); }

// ---- generic recorders
typedef struct { uint64_t x[8]; float f[4]; } Snap;
static Snap snap(Cpu *c) {
    Snap s;
    memcpy(s.x, c->x, sizeof s.x);
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) s.f[i] = *(float *)&c->v[i];
    return s;
}
static CmdRec *record(Cpu *c, uint32_t op, uint32_t extra, Snap *s) {
    CmdRec *r = rec(c, cb_of(s->x[0]), op, extra);
    memcpy(r->x, s->x + 1, sizeof r->x);
    memcpy(r->f, s->f, sizeof r->f);
    return r;
}
/* M17A（2026-11-08）：**逐笔宿主点名**。draw 录制完成后把客体返回址（LR）与帧指针（FP）塞进
   CmdRec 的 f[0..3] —— 回放侧从不用 draw 的 f[]（cmd_trace.c 只有 x[] 参与语义，grep 全 0 命中），
   所以这是纯观测、不改任何行为。好处：信息**随记录走**，回放时逐笔精确对应，不受
   skip/合并/延迟回放影响，也不需要"每笔领走队列"的对齐假设。
   回放侧（cmd_trace.c）在 CMD_DRAW_ELEMENTS/CMD_DRAW_ARRAYS 分支把它抄到 g_m17a_cur_lr/fp，
   nvn_vk 台账随即打印（宿主函数 = eh_frame_hdr FDE 反查）。 */
extern uint64_t g_m17a_rec_lr, g_m17a_rec_fp;   /* glue_cmdbuf.c：录制前取的客体 LR/FP */
static void m17a_stash_lr(CmdRec *r, Cpu *c)
{
    (void)c;
    memcpy(&r->f[0], &g_m17a_rec_lr, 8);   /* guest LR = 录这笔画面的宿主返回址 */
    memcpy(&r->f[2], &g_m17a_rec_fp, 8);   /* guest FP = 帧链（上游调用者） */
}
// record with a copy of `len` bytes from the guest pointer in argument `arg`
static CmdRec *record_copy(Cpu *c, uint32_t op, int arg, uint32_t len) {
    Snap s = snap(c);
    CmdRec *r = record(c, op, len, &s);
    if (s.x[arg] && len) memcpy(r->extra, (void *)(uintptr_t)s.x[arg], len);
    return r;
}
#define PLAIN(name, op) NVN(name) { Snap s = snap(c); record(c, op, 0, &s); }

// ---- state binding
NVN(nvnCommandBufferBindProgram) {
    Snap s = snap(c);
    CmdRec *r = record(c, CMD_BIND_PROGRAM, 0, &s);
    /* M3r（2026-11-03）：donor 的 HOST(NvnProgram, guest) 读客体偏移 0 的指针；本移植的 Program 对象
       是 gfx_bridge.c 的 prog_h{magic='PROG', nstage} 就地存在客体内存里，偏移 0 是 magic 不是指针，
       解引用会得到 0x50524f47。客体地址 == 宿主地址是既有前提，直接存 s.x[1] 即为程序对象指针，
       也正是 ProgramSetShaders 登记 shader key 时用的同一个指针。 */
    r->x[0] = s.x[1];
}

// SetRenderTargets(cmd, n, colors[], colorViews[], depth, depthView)
// extra: { u64 tex[8]; NvnTextureView views[8]; u8 has_view[8]; u64 depth; NvnTextureView dview; u8 has_dview }
typedef struct {
    uint64_t tex[8];
    NvnTextureView views[8];
    uint8_t has_view[8];
    uint64_t depth;
    NvnTextureView dview;
    uint8_t has_dview;
} RtRec;
/* M4q P1：回放侧按裸偏移读 depth（cmd_trace.h:NVN_CMD_RT_DEPTH_OFF=200），这里把两侧钉死。
   views 是 16B（nvn_obj.h:46 sizeof(view_t)==16），所以 64+128+8=200 且 8 字节对齐。 */
_Static_assert(offsetof(RtRec, depth) == NVN_CMD_RT_DEPTH_OFF,
               "RtRec.depth offset drifted from cmd_trace.h NVN_CMD_RT_DEPTH_OFF");
_Static_assert(offsetof(RtRec, tex) == NVN_CMD_RT_FIRST_TEX_OFF,
               "RtRec.tex offset drifted from cmd_trace.h NVN_CMD_RT_FIRST_TEX_OFF");
NVN(nvnCommandBufferSetRenderTargets) {
    Snap s = snap(c);
    int n = (int)s.x[1];
    if (n > 8) n = 8;
    RtRec rt = {0};
    const uint64_t *colors = (const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)s.x[2], *views = (const uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)s.x[3];
    /* M4o P1：colors[i]/depth 是**游戏自己分配的 NVNtexture 对象指针**（NVN SDK 口径：
       const NVNtexture* const*），不是「句柄槽」。原来这里套了 HOST() 又解引用一次，读到的
       是 tex_h 头 8 字节（magic 0x54455800 | d.target<<32），m4n_b1 的 RT key
       0x154455800/0x254455800/0x854455800/0x454455800 就是这个——导致侧表必 miss、
       所有 RT 退回 1600×900 探针、1024×1024 中间 RT 的后处理画到屏上（整屏白）。 */
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        rt.tex[i] = colors && colors[i] ? colors[i] : 0;
        if (views && views[i]) { rt.has_view[i] = 1; memcpy(&rt.views[i], (void *)(uintptr_t)views[i], sizeof(NvnTextureView)); }
    }
    rt.depth = s.x[4] ? s.x[4] : 0;
    if (s.x[5]) { rt.has_dview = 1; memcpy(&rt.dview, (void *)(uintptr_t)s.x[5], sizeof(NvnTextureView)); }
    CmdRec *r = record(c, CMD_SET_RENDER_TARGETS, sizeof rt, &s);
    r->x[0] = (uint64_t)n;
    memcpy(r->extra, &rt, sizeof rt);
}

// ---- clears
NVN(nvnCommandBufferClearColor) { record_copy(c, CMD_CLEAR_COLOR, 2, 16); }

// ClearTexture(cmd, texture, view, region, color, mask)
typedef struct { uint64_t tex; NvnTextureView view; uint8_t has_view; int32_t region[6]; float color[4]; } ClearTexRec;
static void clear_texture(Cpu *c, int kind) {
    Snap s = snap(c);
    ClearTexRec ct = {0};
    /* M4p P1：同 SetRenderTargets（:429 上方注释）——texture 参数是游戏自己的 NVNtexture*，
       客体内存里那颗对象就是 tex_h（magic 在偏移 0），再套 HOST() 会把 magic|target 当指针。 */
    ct.tex = s.x[1];
    if (s.x[2]) { ct.has_view = 1; memcpy(&ct.view, (void *)(uintptr_t)s.x[2], sizeof ct.view); }
    if (s.x[3]) memcpy(ct.region, (void *)(uintptr_t)s.x[3], sizeof ct.region);
    if (s.x[4]) memcpy(ct.color, (void *)(uintptr_t)s.x[4], 16);
    CmdRec *r = record(c, CMD_CLEAR_TEXTURE, sizeof ct, &s);
    r->x[6] = (uint64_t)kind;
    memcpy(r->extra, &ct, sizeof ct);
}
NVN(nvnCommandBufferClearTexture) { clear_texture(c, 0); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferClearTexturei) { clear_texture(c, 1); }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferClearTextureui) { clear_texture(c, 2); }
PLAIN(nvnCommandBufferClearBuffer, CMD_CLEAR_BUFFER)
// DiscardColor(cmdbuf, index): the target's contents become undefined. On the Switch a discarded (compressed)
// target reads back cleared; areas the game then leaves undrawn (e.g. a pit after a floor tile falls away) stay
// black there. Treated as a clear to (0,0,0,0) (LARECOMP_KEEP_DISCARD=1: old no-op behaviour).
NVN(nvnCommandBufferDiscardColor) {
    static int keep = -1, logged;
    if (keep < 0) keep = getenv("LARECOMP_KEEP_DISCARD") != NULL;
    if (logged < 5) { logged++; LOG("[nvn] DiscardColor index %llu%s\n", (unsigned long long)c->x[1], keep ? " (kept)" : " -> clear"); }
    if (keep) return;
    Snap s = snap(c);
    CmdRec *r = record(c, CMD_CLEAR_COLOR, 16, &s);
    memset(r->extra, 0, 16);
    r->x[2] = 0xF;  // all channels
    r->x[5] = 0;    // float clear
}
NVN(nvnCommandBufferDiscardDepthStencil) { (void)c; }

// ---- draws (all integer arguments fit in x1..x7)
NVN(nvnCommandBufferDrawArrays) { Snap s = snap(c); CmdRec *r = record(c, CMD_DRAW_ARRAYS, 0, &s); r->x[3] = 0; r->x[4] = 1; m17a_stash_lr(r, c); }   /* M17A */
NVN(nvnCommandBufferDrawArraysInstanced) { Snap s = snap(c); CmdRec *r = record(c, CMD_DRAW_ARRAYS, 0, &s); m17a_stash_lr(r, c); }   /* M17A */
// Debug: LARECOMP_TRACE_COUNT=<n> logs the guest call chain of indexed draws with n indices.
static void trace_draw(Cpu *c, uint64_t count) {
    static long want = -2;
    if (want == -2) want = getenv("LARECOMP_TRACE_COUNT") ? atol(getenv("LARECOMP_TRACE_COUNT")) : -1;
    if (want < 0 || (long)count != want) return;
    static int n;
    if (n++ > 40) return;
    LOG("[trace] draw count %llu lr %llx chain:", (unsigned long long)count, (unsigned long long)c->x[30]);
    uint64_t fp = c->x[29];
    for (int i = 0; i < 14 && fp >= GUEST_LO && fp < GUEST_LO + 0x1000000000ull && (fp & 7) == 0; i++) {
        uint64_t next = *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)fp, lr = *(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(fp + 8);
        LOG(" %llx", (unsigned long long)lr);
        if (next <= fp) break;
        fp = next;
    }
    LOG("\n");
}

NVN(nvnCommandBufferDrawElements) {
    trace_draw(c, c->x[3]);
    Snap s = snap(c);
    CmdRec *r = record(c, CMD_DRAW_ELEMENTS, 0, &s);
    r->x[4] = 0; r->x[5] = 0; r->x[6] = 1;  // base vertex, base instance, instances
    m17a_stash_lr(r, c);                    /* M17A */
}
NVN(nvnCommandBufferDrawElementsBaseVertex) {
    trace_draw(c, c->x[3]);
    Snap s = snap(c);
    CmdRec *r = record(c, CMD_DRAW_ELEMENTS, 0, &s);
    /* M4ae P2：x[5] 高 32 位当「ABI 类别」标记（1=BaseVertex / 2=Instanced，0=普通 DrawElements），
       低 32 位仍是 baseInstance。回放侧按这个类别决定是否整类重放（SMO_REPLAY_BASEV/INST）。
       为什么要标记：实测这些 BaseVertex 调用的 baseVertex 大多为 0，只看值分不出「这一类」。 */
    r->x[5] = (1ull << 32); r->x[6] = 1;
    m17a_stash_lr(r, c);                    /* M17A */
}
NVN(nvnCommandBufferDrawElementsInstanced) {
    trace_draw(c, c->x[3]);
    Snap s = snap(c);
    CmdRec *r = record(c, CMD_DRAW_ELEMENTS, 0, &s);
    r->x[5] = (r->x[5] & 0xFFFFFFFFull) | (2ull << 32);   /* class=2，保留 baseInstance 低 32 位 */
    m17a_stash_lr(r, c);                    /* M17A */
}
