```c
// ---- copies
typedef struct { uint64_t tex; NvnTextureView view; uint8_t has_view; int32_t region[6]; } TexRef;
static void tex_ref(TexRef *t, uint64_t tex, uint64_t view, uint64_t region) {
    /* M4p P1：Copy* 族 / Downsample 的 texture 实参同样是游戏 NVNtexture*（tex_h 就在该地址），
       与 SetRenderTargets 同因同修：保留原始指针，不再 HOST() 二次解引用。 */
    t->tex = tex;
    if (view) { t->has_view = 1; memcpy(&t->view, (void *)(uintptr_t)view, sizeof t->view); }
    if (region) memcpy(t->region, (void *)(uintptr_t)region, sizeof t->region);
}
NVN(nvnCommandBufferCopyBufferToTexture) {  // (cmd, src, dst, dstView, dstRegion, flags)
    Snap s = snap(c);
    TexRef t = {0};
    tex_ref(&t, s.x[2], s.x[3], s.x[4]);
    CmdRec *r = record(c, CMD_COPY_BUFFER_TO_TEXTURE, sizeof t, &s);
    memcpy(r->extra, &t, sizeof t);
}
NVN(nvnCommandBufferCopyTextureToBuffer) {  // (cmd, src, srcView, srcRegion, dst, flags)
    Snap s = snap(c);
    TexRef t = {0};
    tex_ref(&t, s.x[1], s.x[2], s.x[3]);
    CmdRec *r = record(c, CMD_COPY_TEXTURE_TO_BUFFER, sizeof t, &s);
    memcpy(r->extra, &t, sizeof t);
}
NVN(nvnCommandBufferCopyTextureToTexture) {  // (cmd, src, srcView, srcRegion, dst, dstView, dstRegion, flags)
    Snap s = snap(c);
    TexRef t[2] = {{0}};
    tex_ref(&t[0], s.x[1], s.x[2], s.x[3]);
    tex_ref(&t[1], s.x[4], s.x[5], s.x[6]);
    CmdRec *r = record(c, CMD_COPY_TEXTURE_TO_TEXTURE, sizeof t, &s);
    memcpy(r->extra, t, sizeof t);
}
PLAIN(nvnCommandBufferCopyBufferToBuffer, CMD_COPY_BUFFER_TO_BUFFER)
NVN(nvnCommandBufferDownsample) {
    Snap s = snap(c);
    TexRef t[2] = {{0}};
    tex_ref(&t[0], s.x[1], 0, 0);
    tex_ref(&t[1], s.x[2], 0, 0);
    CmdRec *r = record(c, CMD_DOWNSAMPLE, sizeof t, &s);
    memcpy(r->extra, t, sizeof t);
}
NVN(nvnCommandBufferDownsampleTextureView) {
    Snap s = snap(c);
    TexRef t[2] = {{0}};
    tex_ref(&t[0], s.x[1], s.x[2], 0);
    tex_ref(&t[1], s.x[3], s.x[4], 0);
    CmdRec *r = record(c, CMD_DOWNSAMPLE, sizeof t, &s);
    memcpy(r->extra, t, sizeof t);
}
NVN(nvnCommandBufferTiledDownsample) { (void)c; }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferTiledDownsampleTextureView) { (void)c; }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferResolveDepthBuffer) { (void)c; }
// UpdateUniformBuffer(cmd, buffer, size, offset, dataSize, data)
NVN(nvnCommandBufferUpdateUniformBuffer) {
    static uint64_t watch = ~0ull;  // LARECOMP_LOG_UBO_UPDATE=<hex address>: the updates that write it (caller, source)
    if (watch == ~0ull) watch = getenv("LARECOMP_LOG_UBO_UPDATE") ? strtoull(getenv("LARECOMP_LOG_UBO_UPDATE"), NULL, 16) : 0;
    if (watch && A(1) + A(3) <= watch && watch < A(1) + A(3) + A(4)) {
        static int n;
        if (n++ % 30 == 0 && n < 600) {
            const float *f = (const float *)(uintptr_t)(A(5) + (watch - A(1) - A(3)));
            LOG("[nvn] ubo update %llx+%#llx size %#llx from %llx (lr %llx): %g %g %g %g\n", (unsigned long long)A(1),
                (unsigned long long)A(3), (unsigned long long)A(4), (unsigned long long)A(5), (unsigned long long)c->x[30],
                f[0], f[1], f[2], f[3]);
        }
    }
#ifdef __ANDROID__
    extern void vk_ubo_inline_mark(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size);
    vk_ubo_inline_mark(A(1) + A(3), A(4));  // (that range stays copied per draw: vulkan/exec.c ubo_direct)
#endif
    record_copy(c, CMD_UPDATE_UNIFORM_BUFFER, 5, (uint32_t)A(4));
}

// ---- synchronization and misc
NVN(nvnCommandBufferFenceSync) {
    // work executes at submit time, so the sync is satisfied once this list has run
    Snap s = snap(c);
    record(c, CMD_FENCE_SYNC, 0, &s);
}
PLAIN(nvnCommandBufferWaitSync, CMD_WAIT_SYNC)
PLAIN(nvnCommandBufferBarrier, CMD_BARRIER)
PLAIN(nvnCommandBufferSignalEvent, CMD_SIGNAL_EVENT)
PLAIN(nvnCommandBufferWaitEvent, CMD_WAIT_EVENT)
// ReportCounter(cmd, type, address): the counter goes to that GPU address, which here is the guest address of the
// memory (nvnMemoryPoolGetBufferAddress). An address outside guest memory is logged (once per caller) and dropped.
NVN(nvnCommandBufferReportCounter) {
    Snap s = snap(c);
    if (s.x[2] && (s.x[2] < GUEST_LO || s.x[2] >= GUEST_HI)) {
        static uint64_t seen[8];
        int k = 0;
        while (k < 8 && seen[k] && seen[k] != c->x[30]) k++;
        if (k < 8 && !seen[k]) {
            seen[k] = c->x[30];
            LOG("[nvn] ReportCounter type %llu to %llx: not guest memory, dropped (lr %llx)\n",
                (unsigned long long)s.x[1], (unsigned long long)s.x[2], (unsigned long long)c->x[30]);
        }
        s.x[2] = 0;
    }
    record(c, CMD_REPORT_COUNTER, 0, &s);
}
NVN(nvnCommandBufferReportValue) { (void)c; }
NVN(nvnCommandBufferResetCounter) { (void)c; }
// A command handle is the address of a list's first record (a CMD_BARRIER: nvnCommandBufferBeginRecording). Handles
// that aren't one are logged (LARECOMP_CHECK_HANDLES=1).
void nvn_check_handles(Cpu *c, const char *what, int n, const uint64_t *h) {
    if (!ENV("LARECOMP_CHECK_HANDLES")) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        bool guest = h[i] >= GUEST_LO && h[i] < GUEST_HI;
        bool host = h[i] >= 0x6000000000ull;  // (malloc'd overflow memory: high host addresses)
        if ((!guest && !host) || ((const CmdRec *)(uintptr_t)h[i])->op != CMD_BARRIER) {
            static int n_logged;
            if (n_logged++ < 20) {
                LOG("[nvn] %s: handle %d of %d is %llx, not a command list (lr %llx)\n", what, i, n,
                    (unsigned long long)h[i], (unsigned long long)c->x[30]);
                hist_report(h[i]);
            }
        }
    }
}
// LARECOMP_CHECK_HANDLES: a submitted list's records are walked first; the first that isn't one is logged with the
// records before it.
static bool plausible(uint64_t a) { return (a >= GUEST_LO && a < GUEST_HI) || a >= 0x6000000000ull; }
void nvn_check_list(uint64_t h, int depth) {
    if (!ENV("LARECOMP_CHECK_HANDLES") || depth > 4) return;
    uint64_t p = h, prev[8] = {0};
    int np = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 1000000; i++) {
        if (!plausible(p)) { LOG("[nvn] list %llx: record %d at %llx: bad address\n", (unsigned long long)h, i, (unsigned long long)p); break; }
        const CmdRec *r = (const CmdRec *)(uintptr_t)p;
        bool bad = r->op >= CMD_COUNT || (r->op != CMD_END && r->op != CMD_JUMP && (r->size < sizeof(CmdRec) || r->size > 0x100000));
        if (bad) {
            LOG("[nvn] list %llx: record %d at %llx: op %u size %u; before:", (unsigned long long)h, i, (unsigned long long)p, r->op, r->size);
            for (int k = 0; k < np && k < 8; k++) {
                const CmdRec *q = (const CmdRec *)(uintptr_t)prev[(np - 1 - k) % 8];
                LOG(" [%llx op %u size %u]", (unsigned long long)prev[(np - 1 - k) % 8], q->op, q->size);
            }
            LOG("\n");
            return;
        }
        prev[np++ % 8] = p;
        if (r->op == CMD_END) return;
        if (r->op == CMD_JUMP) { p = r->x[0]; continue; }
        if (r->op == CMD_CALL) {
            const uint64_t *hh = (const uint64_t *)r->extra;
            for (uint64_t k = 0; k < r->x[0] && k < 64; k++) {
                if (!plausible(hh[k])) LOG("[nvn] list %llx: record %d (call) handle %llu is %llx\n", (unsigned long long)h, i, (unsigned long long)k, (unsigned long long)hh[k]);
                else nvn_check_list(hh[k], depth + 1);
            }
        }
        p += r->size;
    }
}

// hardened call_commands() above (readable-bounded, budgeted, CALL marker for the opcode histogram) and removed here
// so there is exactly one implementation. The LARECOMP_CALL_REFS reference-mode knob is dropped with it.

NVN(nvnCommandBufferInsertDebugMarkerDynamic) { (void)c; }

NVN(nvnCommandBufferPushDebugGroupDynamic) { (void)c; }
```

```h
/* 兼容垫片：让 infra 的 NVN 源文件在我们树里编译。
   infra 的 HLE_FUNC 会把函数登记进 .hle$m 链接段（他们自己的派发机制）；
   我们只取函数体，注册走我们自己的 gfx_bridge 符号表。 */
#ifndef NVN_PORT_COMPAT_H
#define NVN_PORT_COMPAT_H
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
typedef struct Cpu {                 /* 只声明用到的两个成员，布局与我们 hle_stack 不共享 */
    uint64_t x[32];
    uint64_t v[32];
} Cpu;
#define HLE_CAT_(a,b) a##b
#define HLE_CAT(a,b) HLE_CAT_(a,b)
#define HLE_FUNC(sym, fn) void fn(Cpu *c)   /* 非 static：胶水层要能直接调用 infra 的实现 */
/* 日志：接到我们的 stderr（宿主侧 hilog 已由上层接管），语义与 infra 的 rt.h 一致 */
#define LOG(...)   fprintf(stderr, __VA_ARGS__)
#define FATAL(...) (fprintf(stderr, "FATAL: " __VA_ARGS__), abort())
#define ENV(name)  ({ static const char *env_v_; static int env_i_; if (!env_i_) { env_v_ = getenv(name); env_i_ = 1; } env_v_; })
#define GUEST_LO 0x7000000000ull
#define GUEST_HI 0x7320000000ull
#endif
```

```c
/* cmdbuf 胶水层：把 gfx_bridge 符号表的「参数式」NVN 入口转成 infra 的「Cpu* 式」实现。
 *
 * 为什么需要：infra 的 HLE 函数签名是 `void hle_xxx(Cpu *c)`（nvn.h:7 `NVN(name) = HLE_FUNC(#name, hle_##name)`；
 * compat.h:15 把它落成 `void fn(Cpu *c)`），参数从 c->x[i] 取（nvn.h:10 `#define A(i) (c->x[i])`），
 * 返回值写回 c->x[0]（nvn.h:13 `#define RET(v) (c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(v))`）。本层只做参数搬运，不含逻辑。
 *
 * 参数顺序的权威来源 = 真实 NVN ABI（third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/nvn_protos.h:330-345/355-396/434），
 * 不是 gfx_bridge 里那些记账桩的形参——桩多数已退化成 `(void *c)`，形参不构成 ABI 证据。

#include <string.h>

/* 把 n 个 64 位参数装进 Cpu.x[] 后调用。参数个数多于 8 的调用（极少）不支持，直接跳过并计数，
   以便实测时能看出「有多少调用没被录制」。 */
/* M3i 崩溃修复（2026-11-03）：SMO 会同时从多个客体线程录制命令流（双缓冲命令列表），而 put() 每次
   memset 整个 Cpu 再填参数——两线程共用一份 g_cpu 时，A 线程在 hle 里读 x[0] 的瞬间被 B 线程 memset
   清零，cb=NULL 就被递进 cmdbuf 的 cb_of() 并解引用 0（cb_of 的 ldr x0,[x8]，x8=0）。
   实测 cppcrash 20261103003622329：submit#638 后第一帧首次 BindProgram 即命中该窗口；M3i 补的
   5 个绑定把录制调用数抬高约 35%，把这个一直存在的竞态窗口暴露了出来。改 __thread：每线程一份，零锁。 */
static __thread Cpu g_cpu;              /* 每线程一份（多线程录制安全） */
static uint64_t g_dropped;              /* 参数超限被丢弃的调用数 */
static uint64_t g_bad_cb;               /* cb 不是指针（0/极小值）被拒绝录制的调用数 */

static int put(Cpu *c, const uint64_t *argv, int argc)
{
    if (argc > 8) { g_dropped++; return 0; }
    /* 防御（同款崩溃的兜底）：cb 参数必须是宿主/客体地址。非指针一律不录制、计数——
       宁可少一条记录，也不让 cb_of(NULL) 解引用 0 把进程打死。 */
    if (argc < 1 || argv[0] <= 0x10000) { g_bad_cb++; return 0; }
    memset(c, 0, sizeof *c);
    for (int i = 0; i < argc; i++) c->x[i] = argv[i];
    return 1;
}

uint64_t nvn_rec_dropped_calls(void) { return g_dropped; }
uint64_t nvn_rec_bad_cb(void) { return g_bad_cb; }   /* M3i：cb 非指针被拒录制的次数（取证/对账） */

/* ---- task A/C（2026-11-02）：池式命令内存 chunk 表 + cmd_trace 的可读性查询 ----
 * 录制端 cmdbuf.c 把记录写进宿主侧：控制内存走 shadow 页块（cmdbuf.c nvn_port_cmdmem_readable
 * 覆盖），无控制内存时直接用池存储（set_chunk 的 mem 路径，cmdbuf.c:121
 * HOST(NvnPool,pool)->storage+off）。后者的宿主区间只有胶水看得见（pool_mirror->mem 是宿主指针），
 * 所以在 AddCommandMemory 处顺手记进全局小表——跟踪器每读一条记录前先问这里，越界即停。
 * 区间只增不减（池生命周期 = 列表生命周期，infra cmdbuf.c:150 注释在案）。 */
extern uint64_t nvn_port_cmdmem_readable(const void *p);   /* cmdbuf.c（shadow 页块 + 宿主 chunk） */
static struct { const void *base; uint64_t bytes; } g_pool_chunks[256];
static unsigned g_pool_chunks_n;

uint64_t nvn_rec_cmdmem_readable(const void *p)
{
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < g_pool_chunks_n; i++) {
        const uint8_t *lo = (const uint8_t *)g_pool_chunks[i].base, *hi = lo + g_pool_chunks[i].bytes;
        if ((const uint8_t *)p >= lo && (const uint8_t *)p < hi) return (uint64_t)(hi - (const uint8_t *)p);
    }
    return nvn_port_cmdmem_readable(p);      /* shadow 页 / add_host_memory chunk */
}

/* 十六进制字 dump 辅助（定义在下方 attrib/stream 取证段；vbuf 取证先用，故前向声明）。 */
static int v_words(char *b, size_t cap, int o, const uint32_t *w, int len);

/* ---- 建立/绑定：infra 侧在 cmdbuf.c:26 / :113 / :123 ----
 *
 * nvnCommandBufferInitialize(cb, device)：cb 是客体 NVNcommandBuffer*，cmdbuf.c:27-30 自己 calloc 一块
 * 宿主 NvnCmdBuf 并把指针写进客体偏移 0（SET_HOST），客体地址与宿主地址同值（本移植的既有前提，
 * gfx_bridge.c 全篇也是把客体指针直接当宿主指针用）。
 *
 * nvnCommandBufferAddCommandMemory(cb, const NVNmemoryPool *pool, ptrdiff_t off, size_t size)：
 * cmdbuf.c:121 用 infra 约定 `HOST(NvnPool, A(1))->storage`，即**客体池偏移 0 存宿主 NvnPool* **。
 * 我们树里的池对象是 gfx_bridge.c:224 的覆盖体 pool_h{magic,flags,mem,size}（客体内存就地存字段，
 * 偏移 0 不是指针），直接透传会被当野指针解引用。所以这里做「客体池 → 宿主 NvnPool」的翻译：
 * 用局部 NvnPool 承载 storage=pool->mem、size=pool->size，再传一个指向它的指针槽（cmdbuf 只读不存）。 */
typedef struct { uint32_t magic, flags; void *mem; uint64_t size; } pool_mirror;  /* = gfx_bridge.c:224 pool_h */

uint64_t nvn_rec_command_buffer_initialize(void *cb, void *device)
{
    uint64_t a[2] = {(uint64_t)(uintptr_t)cb, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)device};
    if (!put(&g_cpu, a, 2)) return 0;
    hle_nvnCommandBufferInitialize(&g_cpu);
    return g_cpu.x[0];                  /* RET(1)（cmdbuf.c:30） */
}

uint64_t nvn_rec_command_buffer_add_command_memory(void *cb, const void *pool, int64_t off, uint64_t size)
{
    NvnPool p = {0};
    NvnPool *pp = &p;
    if (pool) {
        const pool_mirror *g = (const pool_mirror *)pool;
        p.storage = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)g->mem;   /* 宿主指针；cmdbuf.c:121 只取 storage */
        p.size = g->size;
        p.flags = g->flags;
        /* chunk 表登记（task A/C）：池存储的宿主区间 [mem+off, +size)，供跟踪器先验边界。
           无控制内存时 cmdbuf 就把记录写进这段；登记总无害（它本就是游戏自己的命令内存）。 */
        if (g_pool_chunks_n < sizeof g_pool_chunks / sizeof g_pool_chunks[0] && (size_t)(off < 0 ? -off : off) <= g->size && size <= g->size - (size_t)(off < 0 ? -off : off)) {
            g_pool_chunks[g_pool_chunks_n].base = (const uint8_t *)g->mem + off;
            g_pool_chunks[g_pool_chunks_n].bytes = size;
            g_pool_chunks_n++;
        }
    }
    uint64_t a[4] = {(uint64_t)(uintptr_t)cb, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)&pp, (uint64_t)off, size};
    if (!put(&g_cpu, a, 4)) return 0;
    hle_nvnCommandBufferAddCommandMemory(&g_cpu);
    return g_cpu.x[0];
}

uint64_t nvn_rec_command_buffer_add_control_memory(void *cb, void *mem, uint64_t size)
{
    uint64_t a[3] = {(uint64_t)(uintptr_t)cb, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)mem, size};
    if (!put(&g_cpu, a, 3)) return 0;
    hle_nvnCommandBufferAddControlMemory(&g_cpu);
    return g_cpu.x[0];
}

/* ---- 录制族：参数顺序照 nvn_protos.h（真实 NVN ABI），逐项与 cmdbuf.c 的 A(i) 读取对齐 ---- */

void nvn_rec_begin_recording(void *cb)
{
    uint64_t a[1] = {(uint64_t)(uintptr_t)cb};
    if (put(&g_cpu, a, 1)) hle_nvnCommandBufferBeginRecording(&g_cpu);
}                                                              /* nvn_protos.h:343 */

uint64_t nvn_rec_end_recording(void *cb)
{
    uint64_t a[1] = {(uint64_t)(uintptr_t)cb};
    if (!put(&g_cpu, a, 1)) return 0;
    hle_nvnCommandBufferEndRecording(&g_cpu);
    return g_cpu.x[0];                  /* RET(cb->start)（cmdbuf.c:247）——提交侧拿到的命令流首条记录地址 */
}                                                              /* nvn_protos.h:344 */

/* ---- M4an（2026-11-04）：二级命令流接线（CallCommands / CopyCommands）----
   donor hle_nvn.c:1203-1214 的签名是 (cb, int n, const NVNcommandHandle *h)；cmdbuf.c 里两个 NVN()
   实现读 x[0]=cb、x[1]=n、x[2]=handles 表指针。这里只搬参数，inline 逻辑全在 cmdbuf.c（call_list）。 */
void nvn_rec_call_commands(void *cb, int n, const void *h)
{
    uint64_t a[3] = {(uint64_t)(uintptr_t)cb, (uint64_t)n, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)h};
    if (put(&g_cpu, a, 3)) hle_nvnCommandBufferCallCommands(&g_cpu);
}

void nvn_rec_copy_commands(void *cb, int n, const void *h)
{
    uint64_t a[3] = {(uint64_t)(uintptr_t)cb, (uint64_t)n, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)h};
    if (put(&g_cpu, a, 3)) hle_nvnCommandBufferCopyCommands(&g_cpu);
}

/* M17A（2026-11-08）：逐笔宿主点名。每条 draw 录制前记下客体调用点（LR）与帧指针（FP），
   由 cmdbuf.c 的 m17a_stash_lr 写进 CmdRec.f[0..3]；回放时 cmd_trace.c 抄到
   g_m17a_cur_lr/fp，nvn_vk 台账逐笔打印并用 eh_frame_hdr 反查宿主函数。
   为什么在胶水层取：draw 的录制走 nvn_rec_* → hle_nvnCommandBuffer*（cmdbuf.c），而
   put() 会 memset(Cpu)，c->x[30]/x[29] 恒 0（trace_draw 因此一直打 0）；客体 LR 只能从
   宿主帧链上找（同 gfx_bridge.c stub_caller_lr 的做法）。 */
uint64_t g_m17a_rec_lr, g_m17a_rec_fp;
extern uint64_t gfx_guest_caller_lr(void);
extern uint64_t gfx_guest_caller_fp_v;
static void m17a_mark_caller(void)
{
    g_m17a_rec_lr = gfx_guest_caller_lr();
    g_m17a_rec_fp = gfx_guest_caller_fp_v;
}

void nvn_rec_draw_arrays(void *cb, int mode, int first, int count)
{
    m17a_mark_caller();   /* M17A */
    uint64_t a[4] = {(uint64_t)(uintptr_t)cb, (uint64_t)mode, (uint64_t)first, (uint64_t)count};
    if (put(&g_cpu, a, 4)) hle_nvnCommandBufferDrawArrays(&g_cpu);   /* :377 */
}

/* M5p C（2026-11-05）：DrawArraysInstanced 整类接线——与 M4ad P2② 的 DrawElementsInstanced 同一缺口。
   实测 m5n：`[h] norec draws: arrays_inst=306237` 全部落在 gfx_bridge.c:3169 的 cb_account 记账桩上，
   连命令流都没进（[h] opcode 里根本没有这些笔），所以从未重放。
   cmdbuf.c:662 早已实现录制，且 record() 把 s.x+1 拷进 r->x ⇒ x[0]=mode,x[1]=first,x[2]=count,
   x[3]=baseInstance,x[4]=instances，正是 cmd_trace.c:328 回放分支读的布局。
   参数顺序照真实 NVN ABI（nvn_protos.h:380）：
     DrawArraysInstanced(cb, mode, first, count, baseInstance, instances) = 6 参。 */

                                   int base_instance, int instances)

    if (put(&g_cpu, a, 6)) hle_nvnCommandBufferDrawArraysInstanced(&g_cpu);   /* cmdbuf.c:662 */
}

/* ---- M4ad P2②：两个「只记账、从没进过命令流」的 draw 形态 ----
   实测（boot#1 `[h] norec draws`）：`DrawElementsBaseVertex` 21,729 次、`DrawElementsInstanced`
   13,626 次，占整 boot 绘制调用的 2/3——它们此前是纯 `cb_account` 桩，连记录都没有，

   缺的只是本层的参数搬运 + gfx_bridge 的表项（与 M3r 给单条绑定补搬运同一类缺口）。

   参数顺序照真实 NVN ABI（nvn_protos.h:370-375）：
     DrawElementsBaseVertex (cb, mode, type, count, indexBuffer, baseVertex)              = 6 参
     DrawElementsInstanced  (cb, mode, type, count, indexBuffer, baseVertex, baseInstance, instances) = 8 参

/* M3r（2026-11-03）：三个「单条绑定」入口此前只有记账桩、不进命令流，而实测命令流里
   BIND_VERTEX_BUFFERS / BIND_UNIFORM_BUFFERS / BIND_TEXTURES 一条都没有——SMO 用的是单条形式
   （protos:355 BindVertexBuffer(cb, int first, NVNbufferAddress, size_t)）。cmdbuf.c 早在
   :330-343 就实现了这三条的单条录制（extra=16B {addr,size} / 8B handle），这里只补参数搬运。 */
void nvn_rec_bind_vertex_buffer(void *cb, int first, uint64_t addr, uint64_t size)
{
    /* M3s 取证：前 8 条真实 vbuf 绑定，含地址/长度与前 8 个字（真实顶点数据是否存在、步长线索）。 */
    static unsigned g_log_vb;
    if (g_log_vb < 8) {
        g_log_vb++;
        char line[256];
        int o = snprintf(line, sizeof line, "[v] vbuf_raw #%u first=%d addr=%#llx size=%llu |",
                         g_log_vb, first, (unsigned long long)addr, (unsigned long long)size);
        if (addr > 0x10000 && size >= 4) {
            uint32_t w[8]; uint64_t n = size / 4; if (n > 8) n = 8;
            memcpy(w, (const void *)(uintptr_t)addr, (size_t)(n * 4));
            o = v_words(line, sizeof line, o, w, (int)n);
        } else o += snprintf(line + o, sizeof line - (size_t)o, " <unreadable>");
        vk_boot_logf("%s", line);
    }
    uint64_t a[4] = {(uint64_t)(uintptr_t)cb, (uint64_t)first, addr, size};
    if (put(&g_cpu, a, 4)) hle_nvnCommandBufferBindVertexBuffer(&g_cpu);   /* cmdbuf.c:330 */
}

     SetBlendColor (cb, const float *rgba)           → x[1] 指针，record_copy 拷 16B
   donor 语义核对：hle_nvn.c:1723 SetViewport 就是把 (x,y,w,h) 当 float 矩形交给 SetViewports(0,1)。 */

void nvn_rec_set_depth_range(void *cb, float n, float f)
{
    uint64_t a[3] = {(uint64_t)(uintptr_t)cb, 0, 0};

    uint32_t bn, bf;

    g_cpu.v[0] = bn; g_cpu.v[1] = bf;   /* put() 已 memset 整个 Cpu：float 参数必须在 put 之后写 */
    hle_nvnCommandBufferSetDepthRange(&g_cpu);
}

/* ---- M3i（2026-11-03）：5 个「只记账、不进命令流」的状态绑定补录制 ----
   录制端 cmdbuf.c:316-326 早就有实现（record_copy 自带负载拷贝），缺的只是本层参数搬运 + gfx_bridge
   表项。参数顺序照 nvn_protos.h:347-354；cmdbuf.c 的读取点：
     BindBlendState        record_copy(CMD_BIND_BLEND,        1, 8)   → 状态指针必须在 x[1]

     BindVertexAttribState record_copy(CMD_BIND_VERTEX_ATTRIB,2, A(1)*4) → x[1]=count, x[2]=数组指针
     BindVertexStreamState record_copy(CMD_BIND_VERTEX_STREAM,2, A(1)*8) → x[1]=count, x[2]=数组指针
   注意 count 也必须在 x[1]：录制侧用 A(1) 算拷贝长度，不是装饰参数。 */

/* M3s 取证：录制侧（=游戏真实传进来的值）前 20 次绑定各打一行；与回放侧 nvn_vk_set_vertex_* 的
   [r] state 行对照，就能判定「录进来就是零」还是「回放丢了」。
   M3s（2026-11-03）追加：数组内容逐字 dump + 首调用看 p-8..p+88 窗口（判断数组是否整体偏移），
   并把「全量 calls/zero/nonzero/big」计数暴露给 gfx_bridge 的周期报告。
   原始 ABI 四参（cb/n/p/a3）与调用点 LR 在 gfx_bridge 的 nvn_cb_rec_* 里打印（那里 level-0 返回地址
   才是游戏调用点；本层再取一级需要 frame pointer，安全起见不跨帧）。 */
static unsigned g_log_va, g_log_vs;
static unsigned long long g_va_calls, g_va_zero, g_va_nz, g_va_big;
static unsigned long long g_vs_calls, g_vs_zero, g_vs_nz, g_vs_big;
unsigned long long nvn_rec_nonzero_attrib(void){return g_va_nz;}
unsigned long long nvn_rec_nonzero_stream(void){return g_vs_nz;}
void nvn_rec_vertex_totals(unsigned long long *ac,unsigned long long *az,unsigned long long *an,
                           unsigned long long *sc,unsigned long long *sz,unsigned long long *sn){
    if(ac)*ac=g_va_calls; if(az)*az=g_va_zero; if(an)*an=g_va_nz;
    if(sc)*sc=g_vs_calls; if(sz)*sz=g_vs_zero; if(sn)*sn=g_vs_nz;
}

/* 把 len 个字拼成 " xxxxxxxx ..."（调用方保证 len 不越过数组）；返回写入后的光标。 */
static int v_words(char *b,size_t cap,int o,const uint32_t *w,int len)
{
    for(int i=0;i<len && o+10<(int)cap;i++) o+=snprintf(b+o,cap-(size_t)o," %08x",w[i]);
    return o;
}

void nvn_rec_bind_vertex_attrib_state(void *cb, int count, const void *states)
{
    g_va_calls++;
    if (count > 16) g_va_big++;
    if (states && count > 0 && count <= 64) {   /* 上限提到 64：count>16 也要参与非零判定（M3r 口径漏了这类） */
        const uint32_t *w = states;
        int nz = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) if (w[i]) nz = 1;
        if (nz) {
            g_va_nz++;
            static unsigned nzlog;
            if (nzlog++ < 3) {   /* 首个非零绑定：判定「修好没有」的直接证据 */
                char line[512];
                int o = snprintf(line, sizeof line, "[v] attrib NONZERO #%u n=%d |", nzlog, count);
                o = v_words(line, sizeof line, o, w, count > 40 ? 40 : count);
                vk_boot_logf("%s", line);
            }
        } else g_va_zero++;
    }
    if (g_log_va < 20 && states) {
        const uint32_t *v = states;
        g_log_va++;
        char line[512];
        int o = snprintf(line, sizeof line, "[v] attrib_words #%u n=%d |", g_log_va, count);
        o = v_words(line, sizeof line, o, v, count > 0 ? (count > 40 ? 40 : count) : 0);
        vk_boot_logf("%s", line);
        if (g_log_va == 1) {   /* 首调用：p-8..p+88 窗口（含 p-8，判断是否整体差一个 slot） */
            o = snprintf(line, sizeof line, "[v] attrib_win p-8:");
            o = v_words(line, sizeof line, o, v - 2, 25);
            vk_boot_logf("%s", line);
        }
    }
    uint64_t a[3] = {(uint64_t)(uintptr_t)cb, (uint64_t)count, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)states};
    if (put(&g_cpu, a, 3)) hle_nvnCommandBufferBindVertexAttribState(&g_cpu);
}

void nvn_rec_bind_vertex_stream_state(void *cb, int count, const void *states)
{
    g_vs_calls++;
    if (count > 16) g_vs_big++;
    if (states && count > 0 && count <= 64) {
        const uint32_t *w = states;
        int nz = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < count * 2; i++) if (w[i]) nz = 1;
        if (nz) {
            g_vs_nz++;
            static unsigned nzlog2;
            if (nzlog2++ < 3) {   /* 首个非零 stream：stride/divisor 是否真的来了 */
                char line[256];
                int o = snprintf(line, sizeof line, "[v] stream NONZERO #%u n=%d |", nzlog2, count);
                o = v_words(line, sizeof line, o, w, count > 20 ? 20 : count * 2);
                vk_boot_logf("%s", line);
            }
        } else g_vs_zero++;
    }
    if (g_log_vs < 20 && states) {
        const uint32_t *v = states;
        g_log_vs++;
        char line[512];
        int o = snprintf(line, sizeof line, "[v] stream_words #%u n=%d |", g_log_vs, count);
        o = v_words(line, sizeof line, o, v, count > 0 ? (count > 20 ? 20 : count * 2) : 0);
        vk_boot_logf("%s", line);
    }
    uint64_t a[3] = {(uint64_t)(uintptr_t)cb, (uint64_t)count, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)states};
    if (put(&g_cpu, a, 3)) hle_nvnCommandBufferBindVertexStreamState(&g_cpu);
}

/* ---- 记账/生命周期（第 2 步）：让「客体偏移 0 = 宿主 NvnCmdBuf*」成为唯一事实 ----
 * 此前这族留在 gfx_bridge 的 cmd_h 覆盖体上（读 guest+0x60/0x88），和 cmdbuf 的间接层并存 = 两套账。
 * 现在统一取 cmdbuf 的真值：用量是「游戏字节」（cmdbuf.c:120/196 记账，Get* 在 :134-142 换算），
 * 游戏正是累加 GetCommandMemoryUsed 定 RSTB 堆尺寸（gfx_bridge.c:616 注释）。 */
```

```c
/* 宿主侧桩：补齐 infra NVN 层引用、但我们尚未移植的两个符号。
 *
 * 1) guest_call(Cpu*, uint64_t) —— infra 用它从宿主回调进客体代码（rt.h:113）。
 *    cmdbuf.c:180 在录制 nvnCommandBufferInit 之类时用它做 guest callback；
 *    M2 第一版不做客体回调（回调只用于少数 NVN 的完成通知），打桩记一次日志即可。
 *
 * 2) nvn_watch_texid(void) —— infra objects.c:134 的「纹理监视」调试勾子，返回要监视的纹理 id；
 *    -1 表示不监视（cmdbuf.c:319 用它做一次 id 比较，不监视时永不相等）。
 *
 * 这两个符号在 infra 里分别属于 runtime/dispatch.c 与 runtime/nvn/objects.c，都不在我们已移植的范围内。
 */
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>

#include "compat.h"

static unsigned g_guest_call_dropped;

void guest_call(Cpu *c, uint64_t addr)
{
    (void)c;
    if (g_guest_call_dropped++ < 4)
        fprintf(stderr, "[nvn_replay] guest_call(0x%llx) 未实现，已跳过（M2 第一版不做客体回调）\n",
                (unsigned long long)addr);
}

int nvn_watch_texid(void) { return -1; }

unsigned nvn_replay_guest_call_dropped(void) { return g_guest_call_dropped; }
```

`mario-odessy-harmony/entry/src/main/cpp/platform/nvn_replay/maxwell/shader.h`:

```h
// Maxwell (GM20B) shader translation to Metal Shading Language (macOS) or Vulkan GLSL (Windows; compiled to
// SPIR-V at runtime with shaderc). ShaderKey.glsl selects the dialect; the MSL output does not depend on it.
//
// GLSL contract (what the Vulkan renderer binds):
//  - `#version 460`, entry point `main`. Descriptor set: vertex 0, fragment 1, compute 0.
//  - hardware cbuf k -> binding k: `layout(std140, set=S, binding=k) uniform CB<k> { uvec4 cb<k>[N]; };`
//    (anonymous block). N = max(cbuf_size[k] / 16, highest constant-index vec4 + 1), and at least 4096 when
//    cbuf_dynamic has bit k (the renderer binds up to 64 KB). Register-indexed reads are clamped to N - 1.
//  - global memory (LDG/STG) -> binding GMEM_BUFFER_INDEX (17):
//    `layout(std430, set=S, binding=17) [readonly] buffer GMem { uint w[]; } gmem_;`, 32-bit words relative to
//    maxwell_gmem_base. `readonly` unless the shader stores (needs vertexPipeline/fragmentStoresAndAtomics then);
//    byte / short stores are atomicAnd + atomicOr on the containing word.
//  - rscale table -> binding 18: `uniform RScale { vec4 rscale[65]; };` (std140, the MSL buffer 18 contents).
//  - per-draw tint -> binding 19: `uniform Tint { vec4 ltint[2]; };` (fragment, when uses_tint).
//  - texture slot i (ShaderInfo.tex[i]) -> binding 32 + i, a combined image sampler: sampler1D/2D/3D/Cube/
//    1DArray/2DArray/CubeArray, or its *Shadow variant when tex[i].shadow.
//  - vertex inputs `layout(location=i) in vec4|ivec4|uvec4 a<i>;` (key->attr_kind); varyings: location i =
//    generic attribute i, `vec4 v<i>` (fragment side flat / noperspective as in MSL); `invariant gl_Position`;
//    gl_PointSize when writes_point_size. Fragment outputs `layout(location=rt) out vec4|ivec4|uvec4 c<rt>;`,
//    gl_FragDepth when writes_depth.
//  - clip space exactly as the MSL output (key->flip_y / depth_minus_one epilogue unchanged): the renderer uses
//    a negative-height viewport so Vulkan matches Metal's y-up NDC, clip z in [0, 1].
//  - compute: `layout(local_size_x_id = 0, local_size_y_id = 1, local_size_z_id = 2) in;` (spec constants 0..2).
//  - extensions: GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types_int64 when maxwell_no_int64 is false;
//    otherwise carry/address math uses 32-bit words without the Int64 SPIR-V capability.
//    GL_KHR_shader_subgroup_basic/_shuffle/_shuffle_relative (SHFL, FSWZADD lane: fragment/compute subgroup
//    support), GL_EXT_texture_shadow_lod (explicit-LOD array / cube shadow lookups).
//  - not in GLSL: the maxwell_dbg_vs position dump (buffer 29) is MSL only.
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

enum { STAGE_VERTEX = 0, STAGE_FRAGMENT = 1, STAGE_GEOMETRY = 2, STAGE_TESS_CTRL = 3, STAGE_TESS_EVAL = 4,
       STAGE_COMPUTE = 5 };

enum { TEXTYPE_1D, TEXTYPE_2D, TEXTYPE_3D, TEXTYPE_CUBE, TEXTYPE_2D_ARRAY, TEXTYPE_CUBE_ARRAY, TEXTYPE_1D_ARRAY,
       TEXTYPE_BUFFER, TEXTYPE_2D_MS };

typedef struct {
    uint8_t attr_kind[32];  // vertex inputs: 0 float, 1 signed int, 2 unsigned int
    uint8_t rt_kind[8];     // fragment outputs: 0 float, 1 signed int, 2 unsigned int
    bool depth_minus_one;   // NVN depth mode [-1,1]: remap clip z
    bool flip_y;            // lower-left window origin
    bool flip_x;            // mirror the image left to right (mirror mode's scene composite). (In the padding
                            // after flip_y: keys without it hash as before - shader caches stay valid.)
    bool no_ds_write;       // (Android's copy mode, fragment) the draw writes no depth / stencil: early depth tests are
                            // exact even with a discard (in the padding too)
    uint32_t vs_out_mask;   // fragment: varyings the vertex shader provides
    uint8_t glsl;           // emit Vulkan GLSL (see the contract above) instead of MSL
    bool gmem_linear_lookup;  // Qualcomm compute: cached linear GMap lookup avoids its compiler's binary-search failure
} ShaderKey;

typedef struct {
    uint32_t handle_offset;  // byte offset of the texture handle in the bound texture cbuf
    uint8_t type;            // TEXTYPE_*
    bool shadow, is_array, is_image, bindless;
    uint32_t bindless_cbuf, bindless_offset;
} ShaderTexture;

typedef struct {
    int stage;
    char *msl;              // complete MSL or GLSL source (MSL entry "main0", GLSL "main"); NULL on failure
    uint32_t cbuf_mask;     // hardware constant buffers read
    uint32_t cbuf_size[18];
    uint32_t cbuf_dynamic;  // cbufs indexed with a register: bind the whole buffer
    uint32_t cbwin_mask;    // (maxwell_cb_window) cbufs whose reads may take their rows from the patch buffer
    int ntex;
    ShaderTexture tex[64];
    uint32_t attr_mask;     // vertex: input attributes; fragment: input varyings
    uint32_t out_mask;      // vertex: output varyings; fragment: render targets written
    bool writes_depth, uses_discard, writes_point_size;
    bool uses_gmem;         // global memory access: bind the guest heap at GMEM_BUFFER_INDEX
    bool uses_gmem_map;     // (GLSL compute only) gmem loads look their address up in GMap (uniform, binding
                            // GMAP_BUFFER_INDEX) and read GFast (storage, GFAST_BUFFER_INDEX) - a device-local copy of the
                            // dispatch's storage buffers - when found, stores too (copied back after the dispatch).
                            // runtime/nvn/vulkan/exec.c
    bool uses_gmem_store;   // writes global memory (STG)
    bool uses_tint;        // fragment: reads the per-draw tint (buffer 19, float4[2]) applied to color target 0
    bool uses_rscale;       // reads the resolution-scale table (fragment/compute buffer 18): float4 [0] = render
                            // target scale, [1 + i] = allocation scale of texture i
    uint32_t local_mem;     // bytes of local memory
    uint32_t num_insts;
    char error[256];        // set when translation fails
} ShaderInfo;

// Global memory (LDG/STG) is addressed through one buffer that wraps the guest heap.
#define GMEM_BUFFER_INDEX 17
// (GLSL compute, Vulkan) the fast copy of a dispatch's storage buffers: its address table and its data
#define GMAP_BUFFER_INDEX 20
#define GFAST_BUFFER_INDEX 21
#define GMAP_MAX 32  // ranges in the table (GMap { uvec4 gmap[GMAP_MAX + 1]; }: [i] = addr lo, addr hi, size, word offset;
                     // [GMAP_MAX].x = count). 32: a draw's own ranges and the 16 learned ones (vulkan/exec.c gres_learn)
                     // - at 16 they overflowed after loads, and the draw fell back to the CPU copying it all (#89)
extern uint64_t maxwell_gmem_base, maxwell_gmem_size;
// (GLSL) every stage's global memory through the GMap table, not only compute: set by a backend that can't wrap the
// guest heap in a buffer (Android: no VK_EXT_external_memory_host; vulkan/exec.c copies the bound ranges instead)
extern bool maxwell_gmem_map_all;
// Vulkan drivers without shaderInt64: preserve address/carry semantics using 32-bit words.
extern bool maxwell_no_int64;
// (diagnostics, Android copy mode) a mapped access outside the table records its heap offset at the end of the gfast_
// buffer (the arena: exec.c) instead of reading the heap binding, which isn't there
extern bool maxwell_gmem_miss_log;
extern unsigned maxwell_gmem_miss_stages;  // (the stages that log: bit = STAGE_*; a store in a shader costs - Adreno)
#define GMISS_WORD ((128u << 20) / 4u - 1024u)  // (the arena's last 4 KB: count, then up to 64 offsets)
// ... through a binding of their own, writable (GMiss: those 4 KB): the arena (GFast) stays readonly in a shader that
// only reads - writable, Adreno's fast read path was gone (the lit pass ~4x slower per pixel)
#define GMISS_BUFFER_INDEX 22
// A BRX (jump table) labels only the instructions up to the join pushed before it, not the whole shader (set by the
// Android backend: Adreno's compiler turns every label into a block boundary)
extern bool maxwell_brx_window;
// (GLSL) SSY / PBK / PCNT targets resolved while translating: SYNC / BRK / CONT jump to constants, and the state
// machine has no stack arrays (48 dynamically indexed words: registers or scratch memory on a mobile GPU). Shaders
// where a target isn't the same on every path keep the stacks. Set by the Android backend.
extern bool maxwell_static_stacks;
// (GLSL, with maxwell_static_stacks) shaders with branches as if / else / for instead of the `switch (pc)` state
// machine when their control flow allows it (translate.c structure()). Set by the Android backend.
extern bool maxwell_structured;
extern bool maxwell_struct_skips;  // (structure: forward jumps out of a region as guarded skips)
// (maxwell_structured) no GLSL switch for a jump table: such a shader keeps its state machine (Qualcomm's compiler)
extern bool maxwell_no_switch;
// (maxwell_structured) a shader with local memory keeps its state machine (Qualcomm's compiler crashed on one)
extern bool maxwell_no_local_struct;
// (GLSL) fragment and compute shaders convert halves with unpackHalf2x16 instead of the bitwise h2f (vertex shaders
// keep it: NVIDIA ran math after unpacked halves in fp16, and depth passes disagreed). Set by the Android backend.
extern bool maxwell_native_half;
// (GLSL vertex / fragment) the game cbufs indexed with a register (3..16) read up to 64 of their 16-byte rows from a
// patch buffer when the draw says so - `uniform CBP { uvec4 cbp_m; uvec4 cbp[64]; };` at CBPATCH_BUFFER_INDEX: cbp_m.x
// the cbuf (index + 1, 0: none), .y its first row there, .z how many. The runtime binds such a buffer in place and
// copies only the rows the game rewrites between draws (vulkan/exec.c cbwin_bind).
extern bool maxwell_cb_window;
#define CBPATCH_BUFFER_INDEX 23
// (GLSL) fmin / fmax / saturate as GLSL min / max / clamp: the GPU returns the non-NaN operand and saturates NaN to 0
// (Adreno, as D3D requires) - what the NaN-testing helpers do. Set by the Android backend.
extern bool maxwell_fast_minmax;
// Debug: when translating the shader whose code starts at maxwell_dbg_code, output register
// maxwell_dbg_reg as captured after the instruction at maxwell_dbg_pc (greyscale, all targets).
extern const uint8_t *maxwell_dbg_code;
extern uint32_t maxwell_dbg_pc;
extern int maxwell_dbg_reg;
// Debug: the vertex shader at maxwell_dbg_vs writes each vertex's position to buffer 18 (slot iid*8+vid).
extern const uint8_t *maxwell_dbg_vs;
#define DBG_VS_BUFFER_INDEX 29

// code: shader binary (with the 0x50-byte SPH header for graphics stages)
ShaderInfo *maxwell_translate(const uint8_t *code, size_t max_size, int stage, const ShaderKey *key);
// Constants immediately following code, with their actual readable byte count (zero disables table inspection).
ShaderInfo *maxwell_translate_bounded(const uint8_t *code, size_t max_size, size_t const_size, int stage, const ShaderKey *key);
void maxwell_free(ShaderInfo *s);
// Disassemble for debugging (writes text to f).
void maxwell_disassemble(const uint8_t *code, size_t max_size, int stage, void *file);
```

`mario-odessy-harmony/entry/src/main/cpp/platform/nvn_replay/maxwell/translate.c`:

```c
// Maxwell (SM 5.x) shader binary -> Metal Shading Language, or Vulkan GLSL (key->glsl; contract in shader.h).
//
// The binary is an NVN header (0x30), the shader program header (SPH, 0x50; graphics stages), then
// instructions in groups of four 64-bit words (one scheduling word + three instructions).
// Registers are emitted as `uint` variables; float ops use as_type<> conversions. Shaders with
// branches become a `switch (pc)` state machine with explicit SSY/PBK/PCNT stacks.
//
// GLSL: the instruction body is generated in the MSL spelling and converted by glsl_rewrite() (a token-aware
// pass: as_type<T>() -> as_u/as_f overloads, float4 -> vec4, ulong -> uint64_t, char()/short() casts -> sx8/sx16,
// in.x / out.x stage I/O -> GLSL globals and built-ins), helpers with MSL names (saturate, fmin, clz, mulhi, ...)
// are defined in the GLSL prelude, and the structurally different constructs (texture lookups, global memory,
// half-float packing, subgroup shuffles, barriers, discard, declarations and entry point) are emitted per dialect.
// The MSL text is byte-identical to the MSL-only translator (tools/test_translate.c checks it).
#if defined(_WIN32)
#include <malloc.h>  // alloca
#endif
#include <math.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "shader.h"

uint64_t maxwell_gmem_base, maxwell_gmem_size;
bool maxwell_gmem_map_all;
bool maxwell_no_int64;
bool maxwell_gmem_miss_log;
unsigned maxwell_gmem_miss_stages = ~0u;
#define GMISS_ON(st) (maxwell_gmem_miss_log && (maxwell_gmem_miss_stages >> (st) & 1u))
bool maxwell_brx_window;
bool maxwell_static_stacks;
bool maxwell_structured;
bool maxwell_struct_skips = true;  // (structure: forward jumps out of a region as guarded skips; LARECOMP_NO_STRUCT_SKIPS)
bool maxwell_no_switch;
bool maxwell_no_local_struct;
bool maxwell_native_half;
bool maxwell_fast_minmax;
bool maxwell_cb_window;
const uint8_t *maxwell_dbg_code;
uint32_t maxwell_dbg_pc;
int maxwell_dbg_reg;
const uint8_t *maxwell_dbg_vs;

#define RZ 255
#define LMEM_WORDS 256   // local memory per invocation (1 KB)
#define SMEM_WORDS 4096  // shared memory per workgroup (16 KB)
#define PT 7

typedef struct {
    char *buf;
    size_t len, cap;
} Str;

static void sp(Str *s, const char *fmt, ...) {
    va_list ap, ap2;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    va_copy(ap2, ap);
    int n = vsnprintf(NULL, 0, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    if (s->len + n + 1 > s->cap) {
        s->cap = (s->len + n + 1) * 2;
        s->buf = realloc(s->buf, s->cap);
    }
    vsnprintf(s->buf + s->len, n + 1, fmt, ap2);
    va_end(ap2);
    s->len += n;
}

typedef struct {
    const uint8_t *code;   // first instruction group
    size_t ninsts;         // number of 8-byte words to scan
    int stage;
    const ShaderKey *key;
    ShaderInfo *info;
    Str body;
    uint8_t reg_used[256];
    uint8_t pred_used[8];
    uint32_t in_attr_mask, out_attr_mask;
    uint32_t vs_in_comp[32];
    bool uses_branches, uses_cc, uses_local, uses_vid, uses_iid, uses_frag_coord, uses_front_facing, uses_lane;
    bool uses_rscale;  // resolution-scale table (fragment/compute only)
    uint32_t flat_mask;           // fragment inputs using constant (flat) interpolation
    uint32_t noperspective_mask;  // fragment inputs using pass (linear) interpolation
    uint32_t omap_target, omap_depth;
    int tex_slot[8192];           // texture index -> Metal slot + 1
    bool tex_weak[64];            // slot type only guessed (from a size query): the next sample decides
    bool fail;
    bool branchy;  // program uses the pc state machine
    int ipa_mode;  // interpolation mode of the IPA being translated (-1 for plain loads)
    int ipa_mul;   // its multiplier register (mode 1: the result is the "pass" value attr/w times this register)
    // GLSL (fields kept last: the MSL path's layout, including its out-of-range reg_used writes, is unchanged)
    bool glsl;               // emit Vulkan GLSL: dialect-specific constructs here, the rest via glsl_rewrite()
    bool uses_gmem_store;    // STG present: the gmem buffer is not readonly
    bool uses_shared;        // LDS / STS present: workgroup shared memory array
    uint32_t cbuf_need[18];  // highest constant vec4 index + 1 per cbuf (array size of the GLSL block)
    bool static_stacks;      // (maxwell_static_stacks) flow_to holds every SYNC / BRK / CONT target
    int32_t *flow_to;        // per instruction index: its resolved target pc (-1: never reached)
    bool structured;         // (maxwell_structured) the body is if / else / for, not the state machine
    int nbrx;                // jump tables read from cbuf 1 (brx_table): each BRX's possible targets
    struct { uint32_t at; int n; uint32_t t[256]; } brx[4];
    uint32_t lmem_const_words;  // local memory words the LDL / STL at constant addresses reach (lmem_words)
    bool lmem_dynamic;          // an LDL / STL at a register's address
    uint32_t lmem_sph_bytes;    // the SPH's local memory size (graphics stages; 0: none given)
} Ctx;

// The local memory array's size in words, a power of two (its index is masked to it: lmask_). Every invocation zeroes
// it, and an array that big lives in scratch memory: TOTK's material shaders spill one register (STL / LDL [0x0]) and
// zeroed 256 words a pixel - one draw took 100 ms of GPU on the Adreno 830 (2026-10-26). Constant addresses only: the
// words they reach; else the SPH's size (or the whole LMEM_WORDS without one).
static uint32_t lmem_words(const Ctx *c) {
    uint32_t need = c->lmem_const_words;
    if (c->lmem_dynamic) {
        uint32_t sph = (c->lmem_sph_bytes + 3) / 4;
        need = sph ? (sph > need ? sph : need) : LMEM_WORDS;
    }
    uint32_t n = 1;
    while (n < need && n < LMEM_WORDS) n <<= 1;
    return n;
}

static uint64_t bits(uint64_t w, int lo, int n) { return (w >> lo) & ((n == 64) ? ~0ull : ((1ull << n) - 1)); }
static int64_t sbits(uint64_t w, int lo, int n) {
    int64_t v = (int64_t)bits(w, lo, n);
    return (v & (1ll << (n - 1))) ? v - (1ll << n) : v;
}

static void fail(Ctx *c, const char *fmt, ...) {
    if (c->fail) return;
    c->fail = true;
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    vsnprintf(c->info->error, sizeof c->info->error, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
}

// Branch targets may point at a scheduling word; execution continues at the next instruction.
static uint32_t norm_target(int64_t t) {
    if (t >= 0 && ((t / 8) % 4) == 0) t += 8;
    return (uint32_t)t;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ operands
static const char *reg(Ctx *c, int r, char *buf) {
    if (r == RZ) return "0u";
    c->reg_used[r] = 1;
    sprintf(buf, "r%d", r);
    return buf;
}

#define R(r) reg(c, (r), alloca(16))
#define F(expr) fmt_f(alloca(512), (expr))
static char *fmt_f(char *b, const char *e) { sprintf(b, "as_type<float>(%s)", e); return b; }

static const char *pred(Ctx *c, int p, bool neg, char *buf) {
    if (p == PT) return neg ? "false" : "true";
    c->pred_used[p] = 1;
    sprintf(buf, "%sp%d", neg ? "!" : "", p);
    return buf;
}
#define P(p, n) pred(c, (p), (n), alloca(16))

static const char *cbuf_ref(Ctx *c, int idx, int64_t off, const char *dyn, char *buf) {
    c->info->cbuf_mask |= 1u << idx;
    if (off + 16 > (int64_t)c->info->cbuf_size[idx]) c->info->cbuf_size[idx] = (uint32_t)((off + 16 + 255) & ~255);
    if (dyn) c->info->cbuf_dynamic |= 1u << idx;
    if (!dyn && idx < 18 && off >= 0 && (uint32_t)(off >> 4) + 1 > c->cbuf_need[idx]) c->cbuf_need[idx] = (uint32_t)(off >> 4) + 1;
    if (dyn) sprintf(buf, "cbr(cb%d, (%s) + %lldu)", idx, dyn, (long long)off);
    else sprintf(buf, "cb%d[%lld][%lld]", idx, (long long)(off >> 4), (long long)((off >> 2) & 3));
    return buf;
}

// Operand B in its register / constant buffer / immediate forms, selected by the opcode class.
typedef enum { B_REG, B_CBUF, B_IMM } BForm;

static BForm b_form(uint64_t w) {
    uint64_t top = w >> 60;
    if (top == 0x5) return B_REG;
    if (top == 0x4) return B_CBUF;
    return B_IMM;
}

static const char *operand_b(Ctx *c, uint64_t w, bool float_imm, char *buf) {
    switch (b_form(w)) {
    case B_REG: return reg(c, (int)bits(w, 20, 8), buf);
    case B_CBUF: return cbuf_ref(c, (int)bits(w, 34, 5), bits(w, 20, 14) * 4, NULL, buf);
    default: {
        uint32_t v = (uint32_t)bits(w, 20, 19) | ((uint32_t)bits(w, 56, 1) << 19);
        if (float_imm) v <<= 12;
        else if (v & 0x80000u) v |= 0xFFF00000u;  // sign-extend 20 bits
        sprintf(buf, "0x%08xu", v);
        return buf;
    }
    }
}
#define B(fi) operand_b(c, w, (fi), alloca(128))

// The "C" operand of three-source ops: REG_39, or the cbuf/reg swap form (0x51/0x53/... classes).
static const char *operand_c_for_ffma(Ctx *c, uint64_t w, char *buf, const char **b_out, char *bbuf) {
    uint64_t op8 = w >> 56;
    if ((op8 & 0xF8) == 0x50 && (op8 & 7) != 0) {  // e.g. 0x51: B = REG_39, C = cbuf
        *b_out = reg(c, (int)bits(w, 39, 8), bbuf);
        return cbuf_ref(c, (int)bits(w, 34, 5), bits(w, 20, 14) * 4, NULL, buf);
    }
    *b_out = operand_b(c, w, true, bbuf);
    return reg(c, (int)bits(w, 39, 8), buf);
}

static void set_reg(Ctx *c, int r, const char *expr) {
    if (r == RZ) return;
    c->reg_used[r] = 1;
    sp(&c->body, "    r%d = %s;\n", r, expr);
}

static const char *fneg_abs(const char *e, bool neg, bool abs_, char *buf) {
    if (abs_ && neg) sprintf(buf, "(-abs(%s))", e);
    else if (abs_) sprintf(buf, "abs(%s)", e);
    else if (neg) sprintf(buf, "(-%s)", e);
    else return e;
    return buf;
}
#define NA(e, n, a) fneg_abs((e), (n), (a), alloca(600))

// (GLSL: the built-in; the overloaded as_u helper would be a function call per instruction for the driver to inline -
// SavageWindRecomp's)
static const char *fresult(const Ctx *c, const char *e, bool sat, char *buf) {
    const char *cast = c->glsl ? "floatBitsToUint" : "as_type<uint>";
    if (sat) sprintf(buf, "%s(saturate(%s))", cast, e);
    else sprintf(buf, "%s(%s)", cast, e);
    return buf;
}
#define FRES(e, sat) fresult(c, (e), (sat), alloca(700))

static const char *cmp_op(int op) {
    static const char *const ops[] = {"false", "<", "==", "<=", ">", "!=", ">=", "num", "nan",
                                      "<", "==", "<=", ">", "!=", ">=", "true"};
    return ops[op & 15];
}

// float comparison including unordered variants
static void fcmp_expr(char *out, int op, const char *a, const char *b) {
    switch (op) {
    case 0: strcpy(out, "false"); break;
    case 15: strcpy(out, "true"); break;
    case 7: sprintf(out, "(!isnan(%s) && !isnan(%s))", a, b); break;
    case 8: sprintf(out, "(isnan(%s) || isnan(%s))", a, b); break;
    default:
        if (op < 7) sprintf(out, "(%s %s %s)", a, cmp_op(op), b);
        else sprintf(out, "((%s %s %s) || isnan(%s) || isnan(%s))", a, cmp_op(op), b, a, b);
    }
}

static const char *bool_op(int op) { return op == 0 ? "&&" : op == 1 ? "||" : "!="; }

static void icmp_expr(char *out, int op, const char *a, const char *b, bool is_signed) {
    static const char *const ops[] = {"false", "<", "==", "<=", ">", "!=", ">=", "true"};
    if (op == 0) strcpy(out, "false");
    else if (op == 7) strcpy(out, "true");
    else if (is_signed) sprintf(out, "(int(%s) %s int(%s))", a, ops[op], b);
    else sprintf(out, "(%s %s %s)", a, ops[op], b);
}

// A condition-code test (CSETP, BRA CC.xx): the zero / sign flags of the last .CC result (ccz, ccs). Float and
// integer forms map alike (the U variants differ only for NaN, which a flag-setting FSET never yields). NULL: unknown.
static const char *cc_test(int test) {
    switch (test) {
    case 0: return "false";
    case 15: return "true";
    case 2: case 10: return "ccz";
    case 5: case 13: return "!ccz";
    case 1: case 9: return "ccs";
    case 6: case 14: return "!ccs";
    case 4: case 12: return "(!ccz && !ccs)";
    case 3: case 11: return "(ccz || ccs)";
    default: return NULL;
    }
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ attributes
// Maxwell attribute space: 0x70 position, 0x80 + 16*i generic attribute i, 0x2F8 instance id,
// 0x2FC vertex id, 0x3FC front facing, 0x6C point size.
static void attr_load(Ctx *c, int dst, uint32_t addr, const char *idx) {
    char e[256];
    if (idx) { fail(c, "indexed attribute load"); return; }
    if (c->stage == STAGE_VERTEX) {
        if (addr >= 0x80 && addr < 0x280) {
            int a = (addr - 0x80) >> 4, comp = (addr >> 2) & 3;
            c->in_attr_mask |= 1u << a;
            c->vs_in_comp[a] |= 1u << comp;
            int kind = c->key ? c->key->attr_kind[a] : 0;
            if (kind == 0) sprintf(e, "as_type<uint>(in.a%d[%d])", a, comp);
            else sprintf(e, "as_type<uint>(in.a%d[%d])", a, comp);
        } else if (addr == 0x2F8) { c->uses_iid = true; strcpy(e, "iid"); }
        else if (addr == 0x2FC) { c->uses_vid = true; strcpy(e, "vid"); }
        else { sprintf(e, "0u /* attr %#x */", addr); }
    } else if (c->stage == STAGE_FRAGMENT) {
        if (addr >= 0x70 && addr < 0x80) {
            c->uses_frag_coord = true;
            int comp = (addr >> 2) & 3;
            if (comp == 0 && c->key && c->key->flip_x) {  // mirror mode's composite: x mirrored (rscale[65].x = width)
                c->uses_rscale = true;
                strcpy(e, "as_type<uint>(rscale[65][0] - (in.pos[0] - rscale[0][2]) / rscale[0][0])");
            } else if (comp < 2) {  // guest pixel units: the render target may be allocated larger
                c->uses_rscale = true;
                sprintf(e, "as_type<uint>((in.pos[%d] - rscale[0][%d]) / rscale[0][%d])", comp, comp + 2, comp);
            } else {
                sprintf(e, "as_type<uint>(in.pos[%d])", comp);
            }
        } else if (addr >= 0x80 && addr < 0x280) {
            int a = (addr - 0x80) >> 4, comp = (addr >> 2) & 3;
            // (MSL: a mask of 0 means unknown. GLSL: the renderer always passes the vertex shader's outputs, and
            // Vulkan requires every fragment input to be a vertex output, so 0 means none.)
            if (c->key && (c->key->vs_out_mask || c->key->glsl) && !(c->key->vs_out_mask & (1u << a))) {
                strcpy(e, comp == 3 ? "0x3f800000u" : "0u");  // not provided by the vertex shader
            } else {
                c->in_attr_mask |= 1u << a;
                // IPA "pass" yields attr/w (the shader multiplies by w itself); Metal gives attr. "multiply" is the
                // pass value times a register - usually w (from the pass of position w: Metal's attr again), but a
                // shader may pass its own (the Mysterious Woods mist: 1/(v4.w * pos.w), a projective screen lookup).
                // An input the SPH interpolates linearly in screen space (declared noperspective) has no 1/w in it:
                // "pass" yields attr itself, "multiply" attr times the register (SavageWindRecomp, MIT: BOTW 1.8.2's
                // UI vertex colors under its perspective camera, w ~ 989 - attr/w left the title screen's dark scrim
                // behind the logo and the menu transparent).
                bool linear = (c->noperspective_mask >> a) & 1;
                if (c->ipa_mode == 0 && linear) sprintf(e, "as_type<uint>(in.v%d[%d])", a, comp);
                else if (c->ipa_mode == 1 && c->ipa_mul != RZ && linear) {
                    char mb[16];
                    sprintf(e, "as_type<uint>(in.v%d[%d] * as_type<float>(%s))", a, comp, reg(c, c->ipa_mul, mb));
                } else if (c->ipa_mode == 0) sprintf(e, "as_type<uint>(in.v%d[%d] * in.pos.w)", a, comp);
                else if (c->ipa_mode == 1 && c->ipa_mul != RZ) {
                    char mb[16];
                    sprintf(e, "as_type<uint>(in.v%d[%d] * in.pos.w * as_type<float>(%s))", a, comp, reg(c, c->ipa_mul, mb));
                } else sprintf(e, "as_type<uint>(in.v%d[%d])", a, comp);
            }
        } else if (addr == 0x3FC) { c->uses_front_facing = true; strcpy(e, "(front_facing ? 0xFFFFFFFFu : 0u)"); }
        else if (addr == 0x2E0 || addr == 0x2E4) { sprintf(e, "as_type<uint>(point_coord[%d])", (addr >> 2) & 1); }
        else { sprintf(e, "0u /* attr %#x */", addr); }
    } else {
        sprintf(e, "0u /* attr %#x */", addr);
    }
    set_reg(c, dst, e);
}

static void attr_store(Ctx *c, int src, uint32_t addr) {
    char b[16];
    const char *v = reg(c, src, b);
    if (c->glsl && c->stage != STAGE_VERTEX) {  // no vertex outputs in this stage (MSL: undeclared `out`)
        if (addr >= 0x80 && addr < 0x280) c->out_attr_mask |= 1u << ((addr - 0x80) >> 4);
        if (addr == 0x6C) c->info->writes_point_size = true;
        sp(&c->body, "    /* store attr %#x */\n", addr);
        return;
    }
    if (addr >= 0x70 && addr < 0x80) {
        sp(&c->body, "    out.pos[%d] = as_type<float>(%s);\n", (addr >> 2) & 3, v);
    } else if (addr >= 0x80 && addr < 0x280) {
        int a = (addr - 0x80) >> 4;
        c->out_attr_mask |= 1u << a;
        sp(&c->body, "    out.v%d[%d] = as_type<float>(%s);\n", a, (addr >> 2) & 3, v);
    } else if (addr == 0x6C) {
        c->info->writes_point_size = true;
        sp(&c->body, "    out.psize = as_type<float>(%s);\n", v);
    } else {
        sp(&c->body, "    /* store attr %#x */\n", addr);
    }
}


// ------------------------------------------------------------------ half precision (SM53)
// Swizzle: 0 H1_H0 (both halves), 1 F32 (one f32 used for both lanes), 2 H0_H0, 3 H1_H1.
// Merge: 0 H1_H0 (pack both), 1 F32 (lane 0 as f32), 2 MRG_H0 (replace low half), 3 MRG_H1 (replace high half).
static const char *hsrc(Ctx *c, const char *v, int swz, bool neg, bool abs_, char *buf) {
    (void)c;
    char t[300];
    sprintf(t, "hx(%s, %du)", v, swz);
    if (abs_ && neg) sprintf(buf, "(-abs(%s))", t);
    else if (abs_) sprintf(buf, "abs(%s)", t);
    else if (neg) sprintf(buf, "(-%s)", t);
    else strcpy(buf, t);
    return buf;
}
#define HS(v, sw, n, ab) hsrc(c, (v), (sw), (n), (ab), alloca(400))

static void hstore(Ctx *c, int d, const char *expr, int merge, bool sat) {
    char t[2048], e[1700];
    if (sat) sprintf(e, "saturate(%s)", expr); else strcpy(e, expr);
    if (d == RZ) return;
    c->reg_used[d] = 1;
    sprintf(t, "hpack(%s, %du, r%d)", e, merge, d);
    set_reg(c, d, t);
}

// immediate halves: 9 bits of each half's top (the low 6 mantissa bits are zero) plus separate signs
static uint32_t himm(uint64_t w) {
    uint32_t lo = ((uint32_t)bits(w, 20, 9) << 6) | ((uint32_t)bits(w, 29, 1) << 15);
    uint32_t hi = ((uint32_t)bits(w, 30, 9) << 6) | ((uint32_t)bits(w, 56, 1) << 15);
    return lo | (hi << 16);
}

static bool emit_half(Ctx *c, uint64_t w) {
    int d = (int)bits(w, 0, 8), a = (int)bits(w, 8, 8);
    char t[1800], ib[32], cb[256];
    uint16_t op = (uint16_t)(w >> 48);
    // ---- HADD2 / HMUL2 (reg 5d10/5d08, cbuf 7a8x/788x, imm 7a0x/780x, 32I 2c/2a)
    int kind = -1;  // 0 add, 1 mul
    int form = -1;  // 0 reg, 1 cbuf, 2 imm, 3 32i
    if ((op & 0xfff8) == 0x5d10) { kind = 0; form = 0; }
    else if ((op & 0xfff8) == 0x5d08) { kind = 1; form = 0; }
    else if ((op & 0xfe80) == 0x7a80) { kind = 0; form = 1; }
    else if ((op & 0xfe80) == 0x7a00) { kind = 0; form = 2; }
    else if ((op & 0xfe80) == 0x7880) { kind = 1; form = 1; }
    else if ((op & 0xfe80) == 0x7800) { kind = 1; form = 2; }
    else if ((op & 0xfe00) == 0x2c00) { kind = 0; form = 3; }
    else if ((op & 0xfe00) == 0x2a00) { kind = 1; form = 3; }
    if (kind >= 0) {
        int merge, swa, swb = 0;
        bool sat, nega, absa = false, negb = false, absb = false;
        const char *bv;
        if (form == 3) {
            merge = 0; sat = bits(w, 52, 1); swa = (int)bits(w, 53, 2); nega = kind == 0 ? bits(w, 56, 1) : false;
            sprintf(ib, "0x%08xu", (uint32_t)bits(w, 20, 32)); bv = ib;
        } else {
            // field layout per Ryujinx's InstDecoders (InstHadd2*/InstHmul2*)
            merge = (int)bits(w, 49, 2); swa = (int)bits(w, 47, 2); nega = bits(w, 43, 1); absa = bits(w, 44, 1);
            if (form == 0) {
                sat = bits(w, 32, 1); absb = bits(w, 30, 1); swb = (int)bits(w, 28, 2);
                if (kind == 0) negb = bits(w, 31, 1);
                else { nega = bits(w, 31, 1); negb = false; }  // HMUL2 reg: the negate bit is A's at 31
                bv = R((int)bits(w, 20, 8));
            } else if (form == 1) {
                sat = bits(w, 52, 1); negb = kind == 0 ? bits(w, 56, 1) : false; absb = bits(w, 54, 1); swb = 1;
                bv = cbuf_ref(c, (int)bits(w, 34, 5), bits(w, 20, 14) * 4, NULL, cb);
            } else {
                sat = bits(w, 52, 1); swb = 0;
                sprintf(ib, "0x%08xu", himm(w)); bv = ib;
            }
        }
        sprintf(t, kind == 0 ? "(%s + %s)" : "(%s * %s)", HS(R(a), swa, nega, absa), HS(bv, swb, negb, absb));
        hstore(c, d, t, merge, sat);
        return true;
    }
    // ---- HFMA2 (reg 5d00, cr 70xx|0x80, rc 60xx|0x80, imm 70xx, 32I 28)
    form = -1;
    if ((op & 0xfff8) == 0x5d00) form = 0;
    else if ((op & 0xf880) == 0x7080) form = 1;  // b = cbuf, c = reg
    else if ((op & 0xf880) == 0x6080) form = 2;  // b = reg, c = cbuf
    else if ((op & 0xf880) == 0x7000) form = 3;  // b = imm, c = reg
    else if ((op & 0xfe00) == 0x2800) form = 4;  // 32I: c = d
    if (form >= 0) {
        int merge, swa = (int)bits(w, 47, 2), swb = 0, swc = 0;
        bool sat, negb, negc;
        const char *bv, *cv;
        char cb2[256];
        switch (form) {  // field layout per Ryujinx's InstDecoders (InstHfma2*); NegA is applied to B (same product)
        case 0:
            merge = (int)bits(w, 49, 2); sat = bits(w, 32, 1); negb = bits(w, 31, 1); negc = bits(w, 30, 1);
            swb = (int)bits(w, 28, 2); swc = (int)bits(w, 35, 2);
            bv = R((int)bits(w, 20, 8)); cv = R((int)bits(w, 39, 8));
            break;
        case 1:  // b = cbuf, c = reg
            merge = (int)bits(w, 49, 2); sat = bits(w, 52, 1); negb = bits(w, 56, 1); negc = bits(w, 51, 1);
            swb = 1; swc = (int)bits(w, 53, 2);
            bv = cbuf_ref(c, (int)bits(w, 34, 5), bits(w, 20, 14) * 4, NULL, cb); cv = R((int)bits(w, 39, 8));
            break;
        case 2:  // b = reg (field at 39), c = cbuf
            merge = (int)bits(w, 49, 2); sat = bits(w, 52, 1); negb = bits(w, 56, 1); negc = bits(w, 51, 1);
            swb = (int)bits(w, 53, 2); swc = 1;
            bv = R((int)bits(w, 39, 8)); cv = cbuf_ref(c, (int)bits(w, 34, 5), bits(w, 20, 14) * 4, NULL, cb2);
            break;
        case 3:  // b = imm, c = reg
            merge = (int)bits(w, 49, 2); sat = bits(w, 52, 1); negb = false; negc = bits(w, 51, 1);
            swb = 0; swc = (int)bits(w, 53, 2);
            sprintf(ib, "0x%08xu", himm(w)); bv = ib; cv = R((int)bits(w, 39, 8));
            break;
        default:  // 32I: c = d
            merge = 0; sat = false; negb = false; negc = bits(w, 51, 1);
            swa = (int)bits(w, 47, 2); swb = 0; swc = 0;
            sprintf(ib, "0x%08xu", (uint32_t)bits(w, 20, 32)); bv = ib; cv = R(d);
            break;
        }
        sprintf(t, "fma(%s, %s, %s)", HS(R(a), swa, false, false), HS(bv, swb, negb, false), HS(cv, swc, negc, false));
        hstore(c, d, t, merge, sat);
        return true;
    }
    // ---- HSETP2 / HSET2 (reg forms)
    if ((op & 0xfff8) == 0x5d20 || (op & 0xfff8) == 0x5d18) {
        bool setp = (op & 0xfff8) == 0x5d20;
        const char *x = HS(R(a), (int)bits(w, 47, 2), bits(w, 43, 1), bits(w, 44, 1));
        const char *y = HS(R((int)bits(w, 20, 8)), (int)bits(w, 28, 2), bits(w, 31, 1), bits(w, 30, 1));
        int cop = (int)bits(w, 35, 4), bop = (int)bits(w, 45, 2);
        const char *pp = P((int)bits(w, 39, 3), bits(w, 42, 1));
        char lx[512], ly[512];
        sp(&c->body, "    { float2 hx_ = %s, hy_ = %s; bool pp = %s;\n", x, y, pp);
        fcmp_expr(lx, cop, "hx_.x", "hy_.x");
        fcmp_expr(ly, cop, "hx_.y", "hy_.y");
        sp(&c->body, "      bool l = %s, h = %s;\n", lx, ly);
        if (setp) {
            int pa = (int)bits(w, 3, 3), pb = (int)bits(w, 0, 3);
            bool hand = bits(w, 49, 1);
            if (hand) sp(&c->body, "      l = l && h; h = !l;\n");
            if (pa != PT) { c->pred_used[pa] = 1; sp(&c->body, "      p%d = l %s pp;\n", pa, bool_op(bop)); }
            if (pb != PT) { c->pred_used[pb] = 1; sp(&c->body, "      p%d = h %s pp;\n", pb, bool_op(bop)); }
        } else {
            bool bf = bits(w, 49, 1);
            if (d != RZ) {
                c->reg_used[d] = 1;
                sp(&c->body, "      l = l %s pp; h = h %s pp;\n", bool_op(bop), bool_op(bop));
                sp(&c->body, bf ? "      r%d = (l ? 0x3c00u : 0u) | (h ? 0x3c000000u : 0u);\n"
                                : "      r%d = (l ? 0xFFFFu : 0u) | (h ? 0xFFFF0000u : 0u);\n", d);
            }
        }
        sp(&c->body, "    }\n");
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ textures
static int tex_slot(Ctx *c, uint32_t index, int type, bool shadow, bool array) {
    if (index >= 8192) return 0;
    if (c->tex_slot[index]) {
        int s = c->tex_slot[index] - 1;
        if (type >= 0 && c->tex_weak[s]) {
            ShaderTexture *t = &c->info->tex[s];
            t->type = (uint8_t)type;
            t->shadow = shadow;
            t->is_array = array;
            c->tex_weak[s] = false;
        } else if (c->glsl && type >= 0 && (c->info->tex[s].type != type || c->info->tex[s].shadow != shadow)) {
            fail(c, "texture %u used as two types", index);  // one GLSL sampler type per binding
        }
        return s;
    }
    bool weak = type < 0;
    if (weak) type = TEXTYPE_2D;
    int s = c->info->ntex++;
    if (s >= 31) { fail(c, "too many textures"); return 0; }
    c->tex_slot[index] = s + 1;
    c->tex_weak[s] = weak;
    ShaderTexture *t = &c->info->tex[s];
    t->handle_offset = index * 4;
    t->type = (uint8_t)type;
    t->shadow = shadow;
    t->is_array = array;
    return s;
}

static const char *tex_type_name(int t) {
    switch (t) {
    case TEXTYPE_1D: return "1d";
    case TEXTYPE_3D: return "3d";
    case TEXTYPE_CUBE: return "cube";
    case TEXTYPE_2D_ARRAY: return "2d_array";
    case TEXTYPE_CUBE_ARRAY: return "cube_array";
    case TEXTYPE_1D_ARRAY: return "1d_array";
    default: return "2d";
    }
}

// Write texture results: component mask selects which of r,g,b,a go to consecutive registers.
static void write_tex_result(Ctx *c, int slot, const char *call, uint32_t mask, int d0, int d1, bool texs, bool f16) {
    sp(&c->body, "    { float4 t = %s;\n", call);
    (void)slot;
    if (f16) {
        // TEXS/TLDS .F16: components (in mask order) packed as half pairs into d0 (lo, hi) and d1 (lo, hi)
        int comps[4], n = 0;
        for (int comp = 0; comp < 4; comp++) if (mask & (1u << comp)) comps[n++] = comp;
        char v[4][16];
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) { if (i < n) sprintf(v[i], "t[%d]", comps[i]); else strcpy(v[i], "0.0f"); }
        const char *pk = c->glsl ? "      r%d = packHalf2x16(vec2(%s, %s));\n" : "      r%d = as_type<uint>(half2(half(%s), half(%s)));\n";
        if (d0 != RZ) { c->reg_used[d0] = 1; sp(&c->body, pk, d0, v[0], v[1]); }
        if (d1 != RZ) { c->reg_used[d1] = 1; sp(&c->body, pk, d1, v[2], v[3]); }
        sp(&c->body, "    }\n");
        return;
    }
    int regs[4], n = 0;
    if (texs) {
        // TEXS: up to two components in d0/d0+1, two more in d1/d1+1
        int out[4] = {d0, d0 == RZ ? RZ : d0 + 1, d1, d1 == RZ ? RZ : d1 + 1};
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) regs[i] = out[i];
    } else {
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) regs[i] = d0 == RZ ? RZ : d0 + i;
    }
    for (int comp = 0; comp < 4; comp++) {
        if (!(mask & (1u << comp))) continue;
        int r = regs[n++];
        if (r != RZ) { c->reg_used[r] = 1; sp(&c->body, "      r%d = as_type<uint>(t[%d]);\n", r, comp); }
    }
    sp(&c->body, "    }\n");
}

// Integer texel coordinates in guest units -> the (possibly larger) allocation of texture slot `slot`.
static const char *RSC2(Ctx *c, int slot, const char *fmt, ...) {
    static char bufs[4][1024];
    static int bi;
    char *o = bufs[bi++ & 3];
    char inner[700];
    va_list ap;
    va_start(ap, fmt);
    vsnprintf(inner, sizeof inner, fmt, ap);
    va_end(ap);
    if (c->stage == STAGE_VERTEX && !c->glsl) { snprintf(o, 1024, "%s", inner); return o; }  // (MSL: no table there)
    c->uses_rscale = true;
    snprintf(o, 1024, "rsc(%s, rscale[%d])", inner, slot + 1);
    return o;
}

// Texel offsets are in guest texels: a scaled allocation (render-target scaling) has scale as many per guest texel,
// so an offset moves the coordinates by offset * scale / allocated size (rscale[1 + slot])
static const char *off_scale(Ctx *c, int slot, int comps) {
    static char bufs[4][48];
    static int bi;
    char *o = bufs[bi++ & 3];
    c->uses_rscale = true;
    snprintf(o, 48, " * rscale[%d].%s", slot + 1, comps == 1 ? "x" : "xy");
    return o;
}

// TEXS / TLDS: texture_info selects target and coordinate layout
static const char *alayer(Ctx *c, const char *r, int slot, char *buf) {
    if (c->glsl) sprintf(buf, "min(%s, uint(tsize%d(0).z) - 1u)", r, slot);
    else sprintf(buf, "min(%s, t%d.get_array_size() - 1u)", r, slot);
    return buf;
}
#define ALAYER(r, slot) alayer(c, (r), (slot), alloca(96))

// GLSL texture lookup on slot `slot` (its type is final here: a conflicting use fails in tex_slot).
// co: coordinate expressions (1 for 1D, 2 for 2D, 3 for 3D / cube), layer: uint expression or NULL, dref: depth
// reference or NULL, lod_kind 0 implicit / 1 level / 2 bias (lod), off: ivec2 texel offset or NULL.
// GLSL offsets must be constants, so register offsets move the coordinates by offset / size of the level
// (level 0 for implicit-LOD lookups). Non-fragment stages have no implicit LOD: level 0 (+ bias).
static void glsl_sample(Ctx *c, char *out, int slot, const char *const *co, const char *layer, const char *dref,
                        int lod_kind, const char *lod, const char *off) {
    if (c->fail) { strcpy(out, "vec4(0.0f)"); return; }  // e.g. a type conflict: tex[slot] is not this lookup's type
    const ShaderTexture *t = &c->info->tex[slot];
    int type = t->type;
    bool cube = type == TEXTYPE_CUBE || type == TEXTYPE_CUBE_ARRAY;
    int n = (type == TEXTYPE_1D || type == TEXTYPE_1D_ARRAY) ? 1 : (type == TEXTYPE_2D || type == TEXTYPE_2D_ARRAY) ? 2 : 3;
    if (c->stage != STAGE_FRAGMENT && lod_kind != 1) {
        if (lod_kind == 0) lod = "0.0f";
        lod_kind = 1;
    }
    if (t->shadow && type == TEXTYPE_3D) { fail(c, "3d shadow texture"); strcpy(out, "vec4(0.0f)"); return; }
    if (layer && type != TEXTYPE_1D_ARRAY && type != TEXTYPE_2D_ARRAY && type != TEXTYPE_CUBE_ARRAY) {
        fail(c, "array lookup on a 3d texture");  // TEX .3D with the array bit
        strcpy(out, "vec4(0.0f)");
        return;
    }
    char L[600], xs[1600], P[2000];
    if (lod_kind == 1) snprintf(L, sizeof L, "int(%s)", lod); else strcpy(L, "0");
    if (n == 1) {
        if (off) snprintf(xs, sizeof xs, "(%s + float((%s).x)%s / float(tsize%d(%s).x))", co[0], off, off_scale(c, slot, 1), slot, L);
        else snprintf(xs, sizeof xs, "%s", co[0]);
    } else if (n == 2) {
        if (off) snprintf(xs, sizeof xs, "(vec2(%s, %s) + vec2(%s)%s / vec2(tsize%d(%s).xy))", co[0], co[1], off, off_scale(c, slot, 2), slot, L);
        else snprintf(xs, sizeof xs, "vec2(%s, %s)", co[0], co[1]);
        // Vertex stage: the coordinates rounded to 1/256 of a texel, as the Switch's texture unit weighs a bilinear
        // lookup (8 bits of sub-texel position). The terrain's tiles read their heights at a shared edge each from its
        // own texture, at what is meant to be a texel's centre; a hair off from float rounding, the Switch still gets
        // that texel exactly, while the Adreno's finer weights blended in a trace of the next one - the edges' heights
        // differed and the ground showed a grid of dotted cracks, denser at higher resolutions (issue #21; with nearest
        // filtering they were gone, 2026-10-27). LARECOMP_NO_VS_SNAP=1: not rounded.
        static int snap = -1, fs_snap = -1;
        if (snap < 0) snap = getenv("LARECOMP_NO_VS_SNAP") == NULL;
        if (fs_snap < 0) fs_snap = getenv("LARECOMP_FS_SNAP") != NULL;  // (diagnosis: fragment lookups too, at level 0's texels)
        if ((snap && c->stage == STAGE_VERTEX && !t->shadow && lod_kind == 1) ||
            (fs_snap && c->stage == STAGE_FRAGMENT && !t->shadow)) {
            char raw[1600];
            snprintf(raw, sizeof raw, "%s", xs);
            snprintf(xs, sizeof xs, "(floor((%s) * vec2(tsize%d(%s).xy) * 256.0f + 0.5f) / (vec2(tsize%d(%s).xy) * 256.0f))",
                     raw, slot, L, slot, L);
        }
    } else {
        if (off && !cube) snprintf(xs, sizeof xs, "vec3(vec2(%s, %s) + vec2(%s)%s / vec2(tsize%d(%s).xy), %s)", co[0], co[1], off, off_scale(c, slot, 2), slot, L, co[2]);
        else snprintf(xs, sizeof xs, "vec3(%s, %s, %s)", co[0], co[1], co[2]);  // cube lookups take no offset
    }
    const char *extra = NULL;  // separate compare argument (cube array shadow)
    if (!t->shadow) {
        if (layer) snprintf(P, sizeof P, "vec%d(%s, float(%s))", n + 1, xs, layer);
        else snprintf(P, sizeof P, "%s", xs);
    } else if (type == TEXTYPE_CUBE_ARRAY) {
        snprintf(P, sizeof P, "vec4(%s, float(%s))", xs, layer ? layer : "0u");
        extra = dref;
    } else if (type == TEXTYPE_1D) {
        snprintf(P, sizeof P, "vec3(%s, 0.0f, %s)", xs, dref);
    } else if (layer) {
        snprintf(P, sizeof P, "vec%d(%s, float(%s), %s)", n + 2, xs, layer, dref);
    } else {
        snprintf(P, sizeof P, "vec%d(%s, %s)", n + 1, xs, dref);
    }
    char e[2000], ex[300] = "";
    if (extra) snprintf(ex, sizeof ex, ", %s", extra);
    if (lod_kind == 0) snprintf(e, sizeof e, "texture(t%d, %s%s)", slot, P, ex);
    else if (lod_kind == 1) snprintf(e, sizeof e, "textureLod(t%d, %s%s, %s)", slot, P, ex, lod);
    else snprintf(e, sizeof e, "texture(t%d, %s%s, %s)", slot, P, ex, lod);
    if (t->shadow) sprintf(out, "vec4(%s)", e);
    else strcpy(out, e);
}

static void glsl_gather(Ctx *c, char *out, int slot, const char *const *co, const char *layer, const char *dref,
                        const char *off, int comp) {
    if (c->fail) { strcpy(out, "vec4(0.0f)"); return; }
    const ShaderTexture *t = &c->info->tex[slot];
    int type = t->type;
    bool cube = type == TEXTYPE_CUBE || type == TEXTYPE_CUBE_ARRAY;
    int n = cube ? 3 : 2;
    char xs[1600], P[1800];
    if (n == 2) {
        if (off) snprintf(xs, sizeof xs, "(vec2(%s, %s) + vec2(%s)%s / vec2(tsize%d(0).xy))", co[0], co[1], off, off_scale(c, slot, 2), slot);
        else snprintf(xs, sizeof xs, "vec2(%s, %s)", co[0], co[1]);
        // The coordinates rounded to 1/256 of a texel, as the Switch's texture unit takes them, and nudged a quarter of
        // that up: a gather's 2x2 is the texels around the coordinate, so at a texel's centre - a pixel's own, gathered
        // from a target of the same size - which 2x2 it is hangs on the last bit. The Switch rounds it there exactly
        // and keeps the pixel's texel at the 2x2's top left; the Adreno, a hair under from the interpolation, took the
        // 2x2 before it - another pixel's depth. BOTW's half-size ambient occlusion (fs 8c42c9bc) gathers its depth
        // that way: by the blades of grass it shaded dark dots, in rows and columns across the screen where the
        // interpolation's error changes sign (2026-10-28; the dots on grassy ground at more than 50% resolution, in
        // both modes, and also in Switch emulators on Adreno). LARECOMP_NO_GATHER_SNAP=1: not rounded.
        static int snap = -1;
        if (snap < 0) snap = getenv("LARECOMP_NO_GATHER_SNAP") == NULL;
        if (snap) {
            char raw[1600];
            snprintf(raw, sizeof raw, "%s", xs);
            snprintf(xs, sizeof xs, "((floor((%s) * vec2(tsize%d(0).xy) * 256.0f + 0.5f) + 0.25f) / (vec2(tsize%d(0).xy) * 256.0f))",
                     raw, slot, slot);
        }
    } else {
        snprintf(xs, sizeof xs, "vec3(%s, %s, %s)", co[0], co[1], co[2]);
    }
    if (layer) snprintf(P, sizeof P, "vec%d(%s, float(%s))", n + 1, xs, layer);
    else snprintf(P, sizeof P, "%s", xs);
    if (t->shadow) snprintf(out, 2000, "textureGather(t%d, %s, %s)", slot, P, dref ? dref : "0.0f");
    else if (comp != 0) snprintf(out, 2000, "textureGather(t%d, %s, %d)", slot, P, comp);
    else snprintf(out, 2000, "textureGather(t%d, %s)", slot, P);
}

// TEXS / TLDS in GLSL (same slot allocation order and result layout as the MSL switch in emit_texs)
static bool glsl_texs(Ctx *c, uint64_t w, bool fetch, int *slot_out, char *call, const char *A, const char *A1,
                      const char *Bv, const char *B1) {
    uint32_t index = (uint32_t)bits(w, 36, 13);
    int info = (int)bits(w, 53, 4);
    int slot;
    const char *co[3];
    char fa[64], fa1[64], fb[64], fb1[64];
    sprintf(fa, "as_type<float>(%s)", A); sprintf(fa1, "as_type<float>(%s)", A1);
    sprintf(fb, "as_type<float>(%s)", Bv); sprintf(fb1, "as_type<float>(%s)", B1);
    if (!fetch) {
        switch (info) {
        case 0: slot = tex_slot(c, index, TEXTYPE_1D, false, false); co[0] = fa;
            glsl_sample(c, call, slot, co, NULL, NULL, 0, NULL, NULL); break;
        case 1: slot = tex_slot(c, index, TEXTYPE_2D, false, false); co[0] = fa; co[1] = fb;
            glsl_sample(c, call, slot, co, NULL, NULL, 0, NULL, NULL); break;
        case 2: slot = tex_slot(c, index, TEXTYPE_2D, false, false); co[0] = fa; co[1] = fb;
            glsl_sample(c, call, slot, co, NULL, NULL, 1, "0.0f", NULL); break;
        case 3: slot = tex_slot(c, index, TEXTYPE_2D, false, false); co[0] = fa; co[1] = fa1;
            glsl_sample(c, call, slot, co, NULL, NULL, 1, fb, NULL); break;
        case 4: slot = tex_slot(c, index, TEXTYPE_2D, true, false); co[0] = fa; co[1] = fa1;
            glsl_sample(c, call, slot, co, NULL, fb, 0, NULL, NULL); break;
        case 5: slot = tex_slot(c, index, TEXTYPE_2D, true, false); co[0] = fa; co[1] = fa1;
            glsl_sample(c, call, slot, co, NULL, fb1, 1, fb, NULL); break;
        case 6: slot = tex_slot(c, index, TEXTYPE_2D, true, false); co[0] = fa; co[1] = fa1;
            glsl_sample(c, call, slot, co, NULL, fb, 1, "0.0f", NULL); break;
        case 7: slot = tex_slot(c, index, TEXTYPE_2D_ARRAY, false, true); co[0] = fa1; co[1] = fb;
            glsl_sample(c, call, slot, co, ALAYER(A, slot), NULL, 0, NULL, NULL); break;
        case 8: slot = tex_slot(c, index, TEXTYPE_2D_ARRAY, false, true); co[0] = fa1; co[1] = fb;
            glsl_sample(c, call, slot, co, ALAYER(A, slot), NULL, 1, "0.0f", NULL); break;
        case 9: slot = tex_slot(c, index, TEXTYPE_2D_ARRAY, true, true); co[0] = fa1; co[1] = fb;
            glsl_sample(c, call, slot, co, A, fb1, 1, "0.0f", NULL); break;
        case 10: slot = tex_slot(c, index, TEXTYPE_3D, false, false); co[0] = fa; co[1] = fa1; co[2] = fb;
            glsl_sample(c, call, slot, co, NULL, NULL, 0, NULL, NULL); break;
        case 11: slot = tex_slot(c, index, TEXTYPE_3D, false, false); co[0] = fa; co[1] = fa1; co[2] = fb;
            glsl_sample(c, call, slot, co, NULL, NULL, 1, "0.0f", NULL); break;
        case 12: slot = tex_slot(c, index, TEXTYPE_CUBE, false, false); co[0] = fa; co[1] = fa1; co[2] = fb;
            glsl_sample(c, call, slot, co, NULL, NULL, 0, NULL, NULL); break;
        case 13: slot = tex_slot(c, index, TEXTYPE_CUBE, false, false); co[0] = fa; co[1] = fa1; co[2] = fb;
            glsl_sample(c, call, slot, co, NULL, NULL, 1, fb1, NULL); break;
        default: fail(c, "texs info %d", info); return false;
        }
    } else {
        switch (info) {
        case 0: slot = tex_slot(c, index, TEXTYPE_1D, false, false);
            sprintf(call, "texelFetch(t%d, int(%s), 0)", slot, A); break;
        case 1: slot = tex_slot(c, index, TEXTYPE_1D, false, false);
            sprintf(call, "texelFetch(t%d, int(%s), int(%s))", slot, A, Bv); break;
        case 2: slot = tex_slot(c, index, TEXTYPE_2D, false, false);
            sprintf(call, "texelFetch(t%d, ivec2(%s), 0)", slot, RSC2(c, slot, "uint2(%s, %s)", A, Bv)); break;
        case 4: slot = tex_slot(c, index, TEXTYPE_2D, false, false);
            sprintf(call, "texelFetch(t%d, ivec2(%s), 0)", slot, RSC2(c, slot, "uint2(int2(%s, %s) + int2(int(%s << 28) >> 28, int(%s << 24) >> 28))", A, A1, Bv, Bv)); break;
        case 5: slot = tex_slot(c, index, TEXTYPE_2D, false, false);
            sprintf(call, "texelFetch(t%d, ivec2(%s), int(%s))", slot, RSC2(c, slot, "uint2(%s, %s)", A, A1), Bv); break;
        case 7: slot = tex_slot(c, index, TEXTYPE_3D, false, false);
            sprintf(call, "texelFetch(t%d, ivec3(%s, %s, %s), 0)", slot, A, A1, Bv); break;
        case 8: slot = tex_slot(c, index, TEXTYPE_2D_ARRAY, false, true);
            sprintf(call, "texelFetch(t%d, ivec3(ivec2(%s), int(%s)), 0)", slot, RSC2(c, slot, "uint2(%s, %s)", A1, Bv), A); break;
        case 12: slot = tex_slot(c, index, TEXTYPE_2D, false, false);
            sprintf(call, "texelFetch(t%d, ivec2(%s), int(%s))", slot, RSC2(c, slot, "uint2(int2(%s, %s) + int2(int(%s << 28) >> 28, int(%s << 24) >> 28))", A, A1, B1, B1), Bv); break;
        default: fail(c, "tlds info %d", info); return false;
        }
    }
    *slot_out = slot;
    return true;
}

static void emit_texs(Ctx *c, uint64_t w, bool fetch) {
    int d0 = (int)bits(w, 0, 8), d1 = (int)bits(w, 28, 8), a = (int)bits(w, 8, 8), b = (int)bits(w, 20, 8);
    uint32_t index = (uint32_t)bits(w, 36, 13);
    int info = (int)bits(w, 53, 4);
    int msel = (int)bits(w, 50, 3);
    uint32_t mask;
    if (d1 == RZ) {
        static const uint32_t m2[] = {1, 2, 4, 8, 3, 9, 10, 12};
        mask = m2[msel];
    } else {
        static const uint32_t m4[] = {7, 11, 13, 14, 15, 15, 15, 15};
        mask = m4[msel];
    }
    char ra[16], ra1[16], rb[16], rb1[16];
    const char *A = reg(c, a, ra), *A1 = reg(c, a == RZ ? RZ : a + 1, ra1), *Bv = reg(c, b, rb),
               *B1 = reg(c, b == RZ ? RZ : b + 1, rb1);
    char call[1024];
    int slot;
    if (c->glsl) {
        char gcall[4096];
        if (!glsl_texs(c, w, fetch, &slot, gcall, A, A1, Bv, B1)) return;
        write_tex_result(c, slot, gcall, mask, d0, d1, true, !bits(w, 59, 1));
        return;
    }
    if (!fetch) {
        switch (info) {
        case 0: slot = tex_slot(c, index, TEXTYPE_1D, false, false);
            sprintf(call, "t%d.sample(s%d, %s)", slot, slot, F(A)); break;
        case 1: slot = tex_slot(c, index, TEXTYPE_2D, false, false);
            sprintf(call, "t%d.sample(s%d, float2(%s, %s))", slot, slot, F(A), F(Bv)); break;
        case 2: slot = tex_slot(c, index, TEXTYPE_2D, false, false);
            sprintf(call, "t%d.sample(s%d, float2(%s, %s), level(0))", slot, slot, F(A), F(Bv)); break;
        case 3: slot = tex_slot(c, index, TEXTYPE_2D, false, false);
            sprintf(call, "t%d.sample(s%d, float2(%s, %s), level(%s))", slot, slot, F(A), F(A1), F(Bv)); break;
        case 4: slot = tex_slot(c, index, TEXTYPE_2D, true, false);
            sprintf(call, "float4(t%d.sample_compare(s%d, float2(%s, %s), %s))", slot, slot, F(A), F(A1), F(Bv)); break;
        case 5: slot = tex_slot(c, index, TEXTYPE_2D, true, false);
            sprintf(call, "float4(t%d.sample_compare(s%d, float2(%s, %s), %s, level(%s)))", slot, slot, F(A), F(A1), F(B1), F(Bv)); break;
        case 6: slot = tex_slot(c, index, TEXTYPE_2D, true, false);
            sprintf(call, "float4(t%d.sample_compare(s%d, float2(%s, %s), %s, level(0)))", slot, slot, F(A), F(A1), F(Bv)); break;
        case 7: slot = tex_slot(c, index, TEXTYPE_2D_ARRAY, false, true);
            sprintf(call, "t%d.sample(s%d, float2(%s, %s), %s)", slot, slot, F(A1), F(Bv), ALAYER(A, slot)); break;
        case 8: slot = tex_slot(c, index, TEXTYPE_2D_ARRAY, false, true);
```
