```c
// ------------------------------------------------------------------ program assembly
static bool is_branch_target_op(uint64_t w) {
    return ((w & 0xfff0000000000020ull) == 0xe240000000000000ull);
}

// ------------------------------------------------------------------ GLSL output
static bool id_start(char ch) { return (ch >= 'a' && ch <= 'z') || (ch >= 'A' && ch <= 'Z') || ch == '_'; }
static bool id_char(char ch) { return id_start(ch) || (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9'); }

// Whether p is "(" + a uint operand + ")": a register (rN), a constant buffer word (cbN[i][j]) or a literal ending in u.
static bool uint_operand(const char *p) {
    if (*p++ != '(') return false;
    const char *q = p;
    if (*q == 'r' && q[1] >= '0' && q[1] <= '9') {
        for (q++; *q >= '0' && *q <= '9'; q++) {}
    } else if (!strncmp(q, "cb", 2) && q[2] >= '0' && q[2] <= '9') {
        for (q += 2; *q >= '0' && *q <= '9'; q++) {}
        for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
            if (*q++ != '[') return false;
            if (*q < '0' || *q > '9') return false;
            while (*q >= '0' && *q <= '9') q++;
            if (*q++ != ']') return false;
        }
    } else if (*q >= '0' && *q <= '9') {
        while (id_char(*q)) q++;
        if (q[-1] != 'u') return false;
    } else {
        return false;
    }
    return *q == ')';
}

// MSL-spelled instruction body -> GLSL (token-aware; comments and numbers are copied as they are).
static void glsl_rewrite(Ctx *c, Str *o, const char *src) {
    static const char *const map[][2] = {
        {"float2", "vec2"}, {"float3", "vec3"}, {"float4", "vec4"}, {"int2", "ivec2"}, {"int3", "ivec3"},
        {"int4", "ivec4"}, {"uint2", "uvec2"}, {"uint3", "uvec3"}, {"uint4", "uvec4"}, {"bool2", "bvec2"},
        {"ulong", "uint64_t"}, {"rsqrt", "inversesqrt"}, {"rint", "roundEven"}, {"front_facing", "gl_FrontFacing"},
        {"point_coord", "gl_PointCoord"}, {"lane", "gl_SubgroupInvocationID"}, {"vid", "uint(gl_VertexIndex)"},
        {"iid", "uint(gl_InstanceIndex)"},
    };
    const char *p = src;
    while (*p) {
        if (p[0] == '/' && p[1] == '*') {
            const char *e = strstr(p + 2, "*/");
            e = e ? e + 2 : p + strlen(p);
            sp(o, "%.*s", (int)(e - p), p);
            p = e;
            continue;
        }
        if (p[0] == '/' && p[1] == '/') {
            const char *e = strchr(p, '\n');
            if (!e) e = p + strlen(p);
            sp(o, "%.*s", (int)(e - p), p);
            p = e;
            continue;
        }
        if (*p >= '0' && *p <= '9') {  // number (0x..u, 1.0f, ...)
            const char *e = p;
            while (id_char(*e) || *e == '.') e++;
            if (maxwell_no_int64 && e - p >= 2 && e[-2] == 'u' && e[-1] == 'l') {
                if (strtoull(p, NULL, 0) > 0xFFFFFFFFull) { fail(c, "64-bit literal in 32-bit shader"); return; }
                sp(o, "%.*su", (int)(e - p - 2), p);
            } else sp(o, "%.*s", (int)(e - p), p);
            p = e;
            continue;
        }
        if (!id_start(*p)) { sp(o, "%c", *p); p++; continue; }
        const char *e = p;
        while (id_char(*e)) e++;
        int n = (int)(e - p);
        char id[64];
        if (n >= (int)sizeof id || (p > src && p[-1] == '.')) {  // member / swizzle
            sp(o, "%.*s", n, p);
            p = e;
            continue;
        }
        memcpy(id, p, n);
        id[n] = 0;
        p = e;
        if (!strcmp(id, "as_type") && *p == '<') {
            const char *gt = strchr(p, '>');
            if (!gt) { fail(c, "glsl: bad as_type"); return; }
            int tn = (int)(gt - p - 1);
            // a register, a constant buffer word or an unsigned literal is a uint: the built-in, not the overloaded
            // helper (a function call per use, which the driver then inlines: thousands in a big shader)
            if (tn == 5 && !strncmp(p + 1, "float", 5) && uint_operand(gt + 1)) sp(o, "uintBitsToFloat");
            else if (tn == 5 && !strncmp(p + 1, "float", 5)) sp(o, "as_f");
            else if (tn == 4 && !strncmp(p + 1, "uint", 4)) sp(o, "as_u");
            else if (tn == 3 && !strncmp(p + 1, "int", 3)) sp(o, "as_i");
            else if (tn == 5 && !strncmp(p + 1, "half2", 5)) sp(o, "unpack_h2");
            else { fail(c, "glsl: as_type<%.*s>", tn, p + 1); return; }
            p = gt + 1;
            continue;
        }
        if ((!strcmp(id, "in") || !strcmp(id, "out")) && *p == '.') {  // stage I/O struct members
            const char *m = p + 1, *me = m;
            while (id_char(*me)) me++;
            char mem[32];
            snprintf(mem, sizeof mem, "%.*s", (int)(me - m), m);
            if (!strcmp(mem, "pos")) sp(o, c->stage == STAGE_FRAGMENT ? "gl_FragCoord" : "gl_Position");
            else if (!strcmp(mem, "psize")) sp(o, "gl_PointSize");
            else sp(o, "%s", mem);  // a<i> (vertex input), v<i> (varying)
            p = me;
            continue;
        }
        if ((!strcmp(id, "char") || !strcmp(id, "short")) && *p == '(') { sp(o, id[0] == 'c' ? "sx8" : "sx16"); continue; }
        if (!strcmp(id, "tid") || !strcmp(id, "ctaid")) {
            sp(o, c->stage != STAGE_COMPUTE ? "uvec3(0u)" : id[0] == 't' ? "gl_LocalInvocationID" : "gl_WorkGroupID");
            continue;
        }
        if (id[0] == 'r' && n > 1 && n < 6) {  // registers beyond r255 (RZ) come from out-of-range encodings
            bool num = true;
            for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) num = num && id[i] >= '0' && id[i] <= '9';
            if (num && atoi(id + 1) > 255) { fail(c, "register %s out of range", id); return; }
        }
        if (c->info->cbwin_mask && id[0] == 'c' && id[1] == 'b') {  // (maxwell_cb_window) cbW[v] -> cbwW(vu), cbr(cbW, -> cbrwW(
            const char *q = p;
            bool r = !strcmp(id, "cbr") && *q == '(' && !strncmp(q + 1, "cb", 2);
            if (r) q += 3;
            else q = id + 2;
            int k = 0, nd = 0;
            for (; *q >= '0' && *q <= '9' && nd < 3; q++, nd++) k = k * 10 + (*q - '0');
            if (nd && k < 32 && (c->info->cbwin_mask >> k & 1u)) {
                if (r && *q == ',') {
                    sp(o, "cbrw%d(", k);
                    for (p = q + 1; *p == ' '; p++) {}
                    continue;
                }
                if (!r && !*q && *p == '[') {
                    const char *v = p + 1, *ve = v;
                    while (*ve >= '0' && *ve <= '9') ve++;
                    if (ve > v && *ve == ']') {
                        sp(o, "cbw%d(%.*su)", k, (int)(ve - v), v);
                        p = ve + 1;
                        continue;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        const char *rep = id;
        if (maxwell_no_int64 && !strcmp(id, "ulong")) { fail(c, "unlowered 64-bit shader operation"); return; }
        for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof map / sizeof map[0]; i++)
            if (!strcmp(id, map[i][0])) { rep = map[i][1]; break; }
        sp(o, "%s", rep);
    }
}

static const char glsl_int32_helpers[] =
    "uint shfr32(uint lo, uint hi, uint n) { n &= 31u; return n == 0u ? lo : (lo >> n) | (hi << (32u - n)); }\n"
    "uint shfl32(uint lo, uint hi, uint n) { n &= 31u; return n == 0u ? hi : (hi << n) | (lo >> (32u - n)); }\n";

static const char glsl_prelude[] =
    "#extension GL_KHR_shader_subgroup_basic : require\n"
    "#extension GL_KHR_shader_subgroup_shuffle : require\n"
    "#extension GL_KHR_shader_subgroup_shuffle_relative : require\n"
    "#extension GL_EXT_texture_shadow_lod : require\n"
    "#define cbr(cb, off) cb[min((off) >> 4, uint(cb.length() - 1))][((off) >> 2) & 3u]\n"
    "uint as_u(float x) { return floatBitsToUint(x); }\n"
    "uint as_u(uint x) { return x; }\n"
    "uint as_u(int x) { return uint(x); }\n"
    "float as_f(uint x) { return uintBitsToFloat(x); }\n"
    "float as_f(int x) { return intBitsToFloat(x); }\n"
    "float as_f(float x) { return x; }\n"
    "int as_i(uint x) { return int(x); }\n"
    "int as_i(float x) { return floatBitsToInt(x); }\n"
    "int sx8(uint v) { return bitfieldExtract(int(v), 0, 8); }\n"
    "int sx8(int v) { return bitfieldExtract(v, 0, 8); }\n"
    "int sx16(uint v) { return bitfieldExtract(int(v), 0, 16); }\n"
    "int sx16(int v) { return bitfieldExtract(v, 0, 16); }\n"
    // MSL semantics: saturate(NaN) = 0, fmin/fmax return the non-NaN operand
    "float saturate(float x) { return isnan(x) ? 0.0f : clamp(x, 0.0f, 1.0f); }\n"
    "vec2 saturate(vec2 x) { return vec2(saturate(x.x), saturate(x.y)); }\n"
    "float fmin(float a, float b) { return isnan(a) ? b : (isnan(b) ? a : min(a, b)); }\n"
    "float fmax(float a, float b) { return isnan(a) ? b : (isnan(b) ? a : max(a, b)); }\n"
    "uint clz(uint v) { return v == 0u ? 32u : uint(31 - findMSB(v)); }\n"
    "uint popcount(uint v) { return uint(bitCount(v)); }\n"
    "uint mulhi(uint a, uint b) { uint hi, lo; umulExtended(a, b, hi, lo); return hi; }\n"
    "int mulhi(int a, int b) { int hi, lo; imulExtended(a, b, hi, lo); return hi; }\n"
    "uint bfe_u(uint v, uint ctl) { uint pos = ctl & 0xFFu, len = (ctl >> 8) & 0xFFu; if (len == 0u) return 0u; if (pos >= 32u) return 0u; return bitfieldExtract(v, int(pos), int(min(len, 32u - pos))); }\n"
    "uint bfe_s(uint v, uint ctl) { uint pos = ctl & 0xFFu, len = (ctl >> 8) & 0xFFu; if (len == 0u) return 0u; if (pos >= 32u) return (int(v) < 0) ? 0xFFFFFFFFu : 0u; return uint(bitfieldExtract(int(v), int(pos), int(min(len, 32u - pos)))); }\n"
    "uint bfi(uint ins, uint ctl, uint base) { uint pos = ctl & 0xFFu, len = (ctl >> 8) & 0xFFu; if (len == 0u || pos >= 32u) return base; return bitfieldInsert(base, ins, int(pos), int(min(len, 32u - pos))); }\n"
    "float fswzadd(float a, float b, uint swz, uint lane) { uint m = (swz >> ((lane & 3u) * 2u)) & 3u; float ma = m == 1u ? -1.0f : (m == 3u ? 0.0f : 1.0f); float mb = m == 2u ? -1.0f : 1.0f; return a * ma + b * mb; }\n"
    "uvec2 rsc(uvec2 c, vec4 s) { return (s.x == 1.0f && s.y == 1.0f) ? c : uvec2(floor((vec2(c) + 0.5f) * s.xy)); }\n"
    // half -> float by bits, not unpackHalf2x16: NVIDIA's driver recognises unpacked halves and runs some of the
    // fp32 math after them in native fp16, differently per shader, so a depth pre-pass and its colour pass (EQUAL
    // test) placed wind-animated foliage apart: black slashes / flicker (tools: notes/PLAN.md 2026-10-08)
    "float h2f(uint h) { uint s = (h & 0x8000u) << 16, e = (h >> 10) & 0x1Fu, m = h & 0x3FFu;"
    " if (e == 0u) { float d = float(m) * 5.9604644775390625e-8; return s != 0u ? -d : d; }"
    " if (e == 31u) return uintBitsToFloat(s | 0x7F800000u | (m << 13));"
    " return uintBitsToFloat(s | ((e + 112u) << 23) | (m << 13)); }\n"
    "vec2 unpack_h2(uint v) { return vec2(h2f(v & 0xFFFFu), h2f(v >> 16)); }\n"
    "vec2 hx(uint v, uint swz) { if (swz == 1u) return vec2(uintBitsToFloat(v)); vec2 h = unpack_h2(v); return swz == 2u ? h.xx : (swz == 3u ? h.yy : h); }\n"
    "uint hpack(vec2 r, uint merge, uint old) { if (merge == 1u) return floatBitsToUint(r.x); uint lo = packHalf2x16(vec2(r.x, 0.0f)), hi = packHalf2x16(vec2(r.y, 0.0f)); if (merge == 2u) return (old & 0xFFFF0000u) | lo; if (merge == 3u) return (old & 0xFFFFu) | (hi << 16); return lo | (hi << 16); }\n"
    "uint prmt(uint a, uint b, uint sel) { uint r = 0u; for (uint i = 0u; i < 4u; i++) { uint s = (sel >> (i * 4u)) & 7u; uint bt = s < 4u ? (a >> (s * 8u)) & 0xFFu : (b >> ((s - 4u) * 8u)) & 0xFFu; r |= bt << (i * 8u); } return r; }\n";

// The prelude, a line each: directives (kept) and helpers by name (kept when called).
enum { PRELUDE_MAX = 64 };
typedef struct {
    const char *line[PRELUDE_MAX];
    size_t len[PRELUDE_MAX];
    char name[PRELUDE_MAX][24];  // "" for directives
    bool keep[PRELUDE_MAX];
    int n;
} Prelude;

// Marks the helpers text calls: identifiers followed by '(' that name one (every overload of that name). A name a
// #define of the shader maps elsewhere (h2f -> h2fn, fmin -> min) still counts as a call: kept, unused - harmless.
static void prelude_mark_calls(Prelude *pr, const char *text, const char *end) {
    for (const char *t = text; t < end;) {
        if (!id_start(*t) || (t > text && id_char(t[-1]))) { t++; continue; }
        const char *u = t;
        while (u < end && id_char(*u)) u++;
        if (u < end && *u == '(')
            for (int i = 0; i < pr->n; i++)
                if (!pr->keep[i] && pr->name[i][0] && (size_t)(u - t) == strlen(pr->name[i]) && !memcmp(t, pr->name[i], u - t))
                    for (int j = i; j < pr->n; j++) if (!strcmp(pr->name[j], pr->name[i])) pr->keep[j] = true;
        t = u;
    }
}

// The shader's GLSL with only the prelude's directives and the helpers the rest calls, directly or through another
// helper or a directive: glslang parses every function it is given, ~2 ms a shader for all of them (a quarter of an
// average shader's GLSL -> SPIR-V time; SavageWindRecomp's measure). src holds glsl_prelude once, as written.
static char *glsl_with_prelude(char *src) {
    char *at = strstr(src, glsl_prelude);
    if (!at) return src;
    const char *rest = at + strlen(glsl_prelude);
    Prelude pr = {0};
    for (const char *p = glsl_prelude; *p && pr.n < PRELUDE_MAX; pr.n++) {
        int i = pr.n;
        const char *e = strchr(p, '\n');
        pr.line[i] = p;
        pr.len[i] = e ? (size_t)(e - p + 1) : strlen(p);
        p += pr.len[i];
        const char *par = pr.line[i][0] == '#' ? NULL : memchr(pr.line[i], '(', pr.len[i]);
        if (!par) { pr.keep[i] = true; continue; }  // (directives, and the #define everything uses)
        const char *q = par;
        while (q > pr.line[i] && id_char(q[-1])) q--;
        snprintf(pr.name[i], sizeof pr.name[i], "%.*s", (int)(par - q), q);
    }
    if (pr.n >= PRELUDE_MAX) return src;  // (a prelude grown past the table: all of it, as before)
    prelude_mark_calls(&pr, rest, rest + strlen(rest));
    for (bool more = true; more;) {  // helpers (and directives) that call helpers
        bool before[PRELUDE_MAX];
        memcpy(before, pr.keep, sizeof before);
        for (int i = 0; i < pr.n; i++)
            if (pr.keep[i]) prelude_mark_calls(&pr, pr.line[i], pr.line[i] + pr.len[i]);
        more = memcmp(before, pr.keep, sizeof before) != 0;
    }
    Str s = {0};
    sp(&s, "%.*s", (int)(at - src), src);
    for (int i = 0; i < pr.n; i++) if (pr.keep[i]) sp(&s, "%.*s", (int)pr.len[i], pr.line[i]);
    sp(&s, "%s", rest);
    free(src);
    return s.buf;
}

static const char *glsl_sampler_type(const ShaderTexture *t) {
    static const char *const names[][2] = {
        {"sampler1D", "sampler1DShadow"}, {"sampler2D", "sampler2DShadow"}, {"sampler3D", "sampler3D"},
        {"samplerCube", "samplerCubeShadow"}, {"sampler2DArray", "sampler2DArrayShadow"},
        {"samplerCubeArray", "samplerCubeArrayShadow"}, {"sampler1DArray", "sampler1DArrayShadow"}};
    int ty = t->type <= TEXTYPE_1D_ARRAY ? t->type : TEXTYPE_2D;
    return names[ty][t->shadow ? 1 : 0];
}

// Declarations + entry point around the (rewritten) body; mirrors the MSL assembly in maxwell_translate.
// (maxwell_static_stacks) Follows every path from the entry with the SSY / PBK / PCNT stacks' contents, as the state
// machine runs them per invocation: a SYNC / BRK goes to the target it pops, a CONT to its top (kept), and their
// guarded forms may also fall through with the stack as it was. flow_to[i]: the target of the SYNC / BRK / CONT at i.
// False (keep the stacks) when an instruction is reached with two different stacks, a stack under- or overflows, or
// the program has a jump table or call / return.
// (maxwell_brx_window) A BRX whose register was just loaded from cbuf 1 - the compiler's constants, stored after the
// shader code (blob + max_size) - jumps through a table in it: every target is pc + 8 + imm + one of its words. All
// its words that land on an instruction after the BRX become labels (a superset of the table's), and the list goes to
// resolve_stacks / structure(). Without it every instruction is a label (the light list's compute shader: 354 blocks).
static bool brx_table(Ctx *c, const uint64_t *code, size_t i, size_t end, const uint32_t *cb1, size_t cb_bytes, uint8_t *label) {
    if (!cb1 || cb_bytes < sizeof *cb1 || c->nbrx == 4) return false;
    uint64_t w = code[i];
    int ra = (int)bits(w, 8, 8);
    if (ra == RZ) return false;
    bool from_cb1 = false;
    for (size_t k = i; k-- > 0;) {  // the nearest earlier write of ra, in straight code
        if (k % 4 == 0) continue;
        uint64_t wk = code[k];
        uint32_t top = (uint32_t)(wk >> 52);
        if ((top >= 0xe20 && top <= 0xe3f) || (wk & 0xfff8000000000000ull) == 0xf0f8000000000000ull) break;
        if ((int)bits(wk, 0, 8) != ra) continue;
        from_cb1 = (wk & 0xfff8000000000000ull) == 0xef90000000000000ull && bits(wk, 36, 5) == 1;
        break;
    }
    if (!from_cb1) return false;
    int64_t imm = sbits(w, 20, 24);
    int n = 0;
    uint32_t *t = c->brx[c->nbrx].t;
    size_t words = cb_bytes / sizeof *cb1;
    if (words > 1024) words = 1024;
    for (size_t j = 0; j < words; j++) {
        uint32_t tt = (uint32_t)((int64_t)i * 8 + 8 + (int64_t)cb1[j] + imm);
        if (((tt >> 3) & 3u) == 0u) tt += 8u;
        if (tt & 7u || tt <= i * 8 || tt / 8 >= end) continue;
        bool dup = false;
        for (int q = 0; q < n && !dup; q++) dup = t[q] == tt;
        if (dup) continue;
        if (n == 256) return false;
        int q = n++;
        while (q > 0 && t[q - 1] > tt) { t[q] = t[q - 1]; q--; }  // (ascending)
        t[q] = tt;
    }
    if (!n) return false;
    c->brx[c->nbrx].at = (uint32_t)i, c->brx[c->nbrx].n = n;
    c->nbrx++;
    for (int q = 0; q < n; q++) label[t[q] / 8] = 1;
    return true;
}

static int brx_of(const Ctx *c, size_t i) {
    for (int b = 0; b < c->nbrx; b++) if (c->brx[b].at == i) return b;
    return -1;
}

typedef struct { uint8_t n[3], seen; uint32_t v[3][16]; } FlowSt;
static bool resolve_stacks(const Ctx *c, const uint64_t *code, size_t end, int32_t *flow_to) {
    FlowSt *st = calloc(end, sizeof *st);
    uint32_t *work = malloc(end * 2 * sizeof *work + 16);
    size_t nwork = 0;
    bool ok = true;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < end; i++) flow_to[i] = -1;
#define FLOW_NEXT(i) ((i) + 1 + (((i) + 1) % 4 == 0))
#define FLOW_GO(j, S) do { size_t j_ = (j); if (j_ >= end) break; \
        if (!st[j_].seen) { st[j_] = (S); st[j_].seen = 1; work[nwork++] = (uint32_t)j_; } \
        else if (memcmp(st[j_].n, (S).n, 3) || memcmp(st[j_].v, (S).v, sizeof (S).v)) ok = false; } while (0)
    if (end > 1) { FlowSt e = {{0}}; FLOW_GO(1, e); }
    while (nwork && ok) {
        size_t i = work[--nwork];
        FlowSt S = st[i];
        uint64_t w = code[i];
        uint32_t pc = (uint32_t)(i * 8);
        uint32_t top = (uint32_t)(w >> 52);
        int pr = (int)bits(w, 16, 3);
        bool prn = bits(w, 19, 1);
        bool push = (w & 0xfff0000000000020ull) == 0xe290000000000000ull || (w & 0xfff0000000000020ull) == 0xe2a0000000000000ull ||
                    (w & 0xfff0000000000020ull) == 0xe2b0000000000000ull;
        if (push || (w & 0xfff0000000000000ull) == 0xe270000000000000ull) pr = PT, prn = false;  // (as emit_insn)
        if (pr == PT && prn) { FLOW_GO(FLOW_NEXT(i), S); continue; }  // (never executes)
        bool cond = !(pr == PT && !prn) || ((w & 0xfff0000000000020ull) == 0xe240000000000000ull && bits(w, 0, 5) != 15);
        int64_t t = norm_target((int64_t)pc + 8 + sbits(w, 20, 24));
        if ((w & 0xfff0000000000020ull) == 0xe240000000000000ull) {  // BRA
            if (t >= 0) FLOW_GO((size_t)t / 8, S);
            if (cond) FLOW_GO(FLOW_NEXT(i), S);
        } else if (push) {  // SSY / PBK / PCNT
            int k = top == 0xe29 ? 0 : top == 0xe2a ? 1 : 2;
            if (S.n[k] == 16 || t < 0) { ok = false; break; }
            S.v[k][S.n[k]++] = (uint32_t)t;
            FLOW_GO(FLOW_NEXT(i), S);
        } else if ((w & 0xfff8000000000000ull) == 0xf0f8000000000000ull || top == 0xe34 || top == 0xe35) {  // SYNC BRK CONT
            int k = top == 0xe34 ? 1 : top == 0xe35 ? 2 : 0;
            if (!S.n[k]) { ok = false; break; }
            uint32_t to = S.v[k][S.n[k] - 1];
            flow_to[i] = (int32_t)to;
            if (cond) FLOW_GO(FLOW_NEXT(i), S);
            if (k != 2) S.v[k][--S.n[k]] = 0;  // (cleared: states are compared whole)
            FLOW_GO(to / 8, S);
        } else if (top == 0xe30) {  // EXIT
            if (cond) FLOW_GO(FLOW_NEXT(i), S);
        } else if (top == 0xe25 && brx_of(c, i) >= 0) {  // BRX through a table: each target, with this stack
            int b = brx_of(c, i);
            for (int q = 0; q < c->brx[b].n; q++) FLOW_GO(c->brx[b].t[q] / 8, S);
            if (cond) FLOW_GO(FLOW_NEXT(i), S);
        } else if (top >= 0xe20 && top <= 0xe3f && top != 0xe33) {  // BRX, CAL, RET, PRET, ... (KIL: 0xe33)
            ok = false;
        } else {
            FLOW_GO(FLOW_NEXT(i), S);
        }
    }
#undef FLOW_GO
#undef FLOW_NEXT
    free(work);
    free(st);
    return ok;
}

// (maxwell_structured) The state machine's blocks as if / else / for, once the stacks are resolved: the compiler of a
// mobile GPU keeps every value live across a `for (guard) switch (pc)` (the overworld's lit pass: 24 registers and 8
// waves, structured: 16 and 12). Program order is the structure the shader compiler emitted: a conditional forward
// branch over code is an if (with an else when the skipped part ends by jumping over what follows), a backward
// branch closes a loop, and jumps to a loop's header or exit are continue / break. Anything else (a jump out of
// nested ifs, out of two loops, into the middle of a region) fails, and the shader keeps the state machine.
typedef struct { uint32_t s, e; int term, tgt, brx; bool code; char cond[40]; } SBlk;  // term: 0 none, 1 jump, 2 exit, 3 BRX
typedef struct {
    const Ctx *c;
    const char *src;
    const uint32_t *us, *ue;
    const uint64_t *w;
    uint8_t *skip;  // per instruction: no code of its own here (flow, SSY / PBK / PCNT)
    SBlk *b;
    int nb, *latch, nloops, loops[32][2];
    int nsw, sw_loops[16];  // open GLSL switches (st_switch), each with the loop count when it opened
    uint8_t *consumed;
    Str out;
    bool fail, exit_used;
    // Skips: a forward jump past the region it sits in (or over code inside it) sets sk<id>; the code after it is
    // guarded by `if (!sk<id>)` at each level up to the target block, where the flag drops again.
    int nsk, sk_t[16], sk_id[16], sk_depth[16], nskv;  // pending: target block, flag, depth it was made at; flags made
    int ngd, gd_id[64];                                  // open guards (innermost last), each a flag
} SCtx;

static int st_thread(SCtx *x, int b) {  // through blocks that are only an unconditional jump
    for (int n = 0; b >= 0 && b < x->nb && n < x->nb; n++) {
        SBlk *k = &x->b[b];
        if (k->code || k->term != 1 || strcmp(k->cond, "true")) break;
        b = k->tgt;
    }
    return b;
}

// The statement for a jump to block t (-1: EXIT) inside the current loops, or NULL when t is no loop target.
static const char *st_jump(SCtx *x, int t) {
    if (t < 0) {
        x->exit_used = true;
        return x->nloops || x->nsw ? "exit_now = true; break;" : "break;";
    }
    for (int l = x->nloops - 1; l >= 0; l--) {
        int h = x->loops[l][0], e = x->loops[l][1];
        bool cont = t == h, brk = t == e || st_thread(x, t) == st_thread(x, e);
        if (!cont && !brk) continue;
        if (l != x->nloops - 1) { x->fail = true; return NULL; }  // (out of two loops)
        if (brk && x->nsw && x->sw_loops[x->nsw - 1] > l) { x->fail = true; return NULL; }  // (break: the switch's)
        return cont ? "continue;" : "break;";
    }
    return NULL;
}

static void st_code(SCtx *x, int k) {
    for (uint32_t i = x->b[k].s; i < x->b[k].e; i++)
        if (i % 4 && !x->skip[i]) sp(&x->out, "%.*s", (int)(x->ue[i] - x->us[i]), x->src + x->us[i]);
}

static int st_switch(SCtx *x, int k, int end, int depth);

static void st_range_alt(SCtx *x, int a, int end, int opened, int depth, int alt);
static void st_range(SCtx *x, int a, int end, int opened, int depth) { st_range_alt(x, a, end, opened, depth, -1); }
static void st_range_body(SCtx *x, int a, int end, int opened, int depth, int alt, int g0);
static void st_range_alt(SCtx *x, int a, int end, int opened, int depth, int alt) {
    int g0 = x->ngd;
    st_range_body(x, a, end, opened, depth, alt, g0);
    for (; x->ngd > g0; x->ngd--) sp(&x->out, "  }\n");  // (this level's guards end with its region)
}
// A construct over blocks (k, e) - a loop, an if / else - can't hold a pending skip's target: a jump into it.
static bool st_skip_inside(const SCtx *x, int k, int e) {
    for (int i = 0; i < x->nsk; i++)
        if (x->sk_t[i] > k && x->sk_t[i] < e) return true;
    return false;
}
// Block k reached: skips that end here drop their flag (after closing this level's guards down to theirs), and the
// pending ones made at this depth or deeper get a guard here.
static void st_skip_at(SCtx *x, int k, int depth, int g0) {
    for (int i = 0; i < x->nsk;) {
        if (x->sk_t[i] != k) { i++; continue; }
        int id = x->sk_id[i];
        for (int g = g0; g < x->ngd; g++)
            if (x->gd_id[g] == id) {
                for (; x->ngd > g; x->ngd--) sp(&x->out, "  }\n");
                break;
            }
        sp(&x->out, "  sk%d = false;\n", id);
        x->nsk--;
        for (int j = i; j < x->nsk; j++) x->sk_t[j] = x->sk_t[j + 1], x->sk_id[j] = x->sk_id[j + 1], x->sk_depth[j] = x->sk_depth[j + 1];
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < x->nsk; i++) {
        if (x->sk_depth[i] < depth || x->sk_t[i] <= k) continue;
        bool open = false;
        for (int g = g0; g < x->ngd && !open; g++) open = x->gd_id[g] == x->sk_id[i];
        if (open) continue;
        if (x->ngd == 64) { x->fail = true; return; }
        x->gd_id[x->ngd++] = x->sk_id[i];
        sp(&x->out, "  if (!sk%d) {\n", x->sk_id[i]);
    }
}
static void st_range_body(SCtx *x, int a, int end, int opened, int depth, int alt, int g0) {
    if (depth > 64) { x->fail = true; return; }
    for (int k = a; k < end && !x->fail;) {
        if (x->nsk) { st_skip_at(x, k, depth, g0); if (x->fail) return; }
        if (x->latch[k] >= 0 && k != opened) {  // a loop: [k, its last back edge]
            int le = x->latch[k] + 1;
            if (le > end || x->nloops == 32 || st_skip_inside(x, k, le)) { x->fail = true; return; }
            sp(&x->out, "  for (;;) {\n");
            x->loops[x->nloops][0] = k, x->loops[x->nloops][1] = le, x->nloops++;
            st_range(x, k, le, k, depth + 1);
            x->nloops--;
            sp(&x->out, "  break;\n  }\n");
            if (x->exit_used) sp(&x->out, "  if (exit_now) break;\n");
            k = le;
            continue;
        }
        SBlk *b = &x->b[k];
        st_code(x, k);
        if (!b->term || x->consumed[k]) { k++; continue; }
        if (b->term == 3) {
            if (x->nsk) { x->fail = true; return; }
            k = st_switch(x, k, end, depth);
            if (k < 0 || x->fail) return;
            continue;
        }
        bool always = !strcmp(b->cond, "true");
        const char *j = st_jump(x, b->term == 2 ? -1 : b->tgt);
        if (x->fail) return;
        if (j) {
            if (always) sp(&x->out, "  %s\n", j);
            else sp(&x->out, "  if (%s) { %s }\n", b->cond, j);
            k++;
            continue;
        }
        int t = b->tgt;
        if (t == end || (alt >= 0 && t == alt)) {  // the rest of the region, when not taken
            if (always) {
                if (k + 1 < end) x->fail = true;
                return;
            }
            if (st_skip_inside(x, k, end)) { x->fail = true; return; }
            sp(&x->out, "  if (!(%s)) {\n", b->cond);
            st_range(x, k + 1, end, -1, depth + 1);
            sp(&x->out, "  }\n");
            return;
        }
        if (t > k && (t > end || always) && !x->nsw && x->nsk < 16 && maxwell_struct_skips &&
            (!x->nloops || t < x->loops[x->nloops - 1][1])) {  // past the region (or over code in it): a skip
            int id = x->nskv++;
            if (always) sp(&x->out, "  sk%d = true;\n", id);
            else sp(&x->out, "  if (%s) sk%d = true;\n", b->cond, id);
            x->sk_t[x->nsk] = t, x->sk_id[x->nsk] = id, x->sk_depth[x->nsk] = depth, x->nsk++;
            k++;
            continue;
        }
        if (t <= k || t > end || always) { x->fail = true; return; }
        SBlk *last = &x->b[t - 1];
        int J = last->tgt;
        bool els = t - 1 > k && last->term == 1 && !strcmp(last->cond, "true") && J > t && J <= end && !x->consumed[t - 1];
        if (els) {
            int nl = x->nloops;  // (J must be no loop target: those stay jumps)
            bool ex = x->exit_used;
            const char *jj = st_jump(x, J);
            x->exit_used = ex;
            if (x->fail || jj) { x->fail = false; els = false; }
            x->nloops = nl;
        }
        if (!els && alt >= 0 && t - 1 > k && last->term == 1 && !strcmp(last->cond, "true") && J == alt && !x->consumed[t - 1]) {
            if (st_skip_inside(x, k, end)) { x->fail = true; return; }
            x->consumed[t - 1] = 1;
            sp(&x->out, "  if (!(%s)) {\n", b->cond);
            st_range_alt(x, k + 1, t, -1, depth + 1, alt);
            sp(&x->out, "  } else {\n");
            st_range_alt(x, t, end, -1, depth + 1, alt);
            sp(&x->out, "  }\n");
            return;
        }
        if (st_skip_inside(x, k, els ? J : t)) { x->fail = true; return; }
        sp(&x->out, "  if (!(%s)) {\n", b->cond);
        if (els) {
            x->consumed[t - 1] = 1;
            st_range_alt(x, k + 1, t, -1, depth + 1, J);
            sp(&x->out, "  } else {\n");
            st_range(x, t, J, -1, depth + 1);
            sp(&x->out, "  }\n");
            k = J;
        } else {
            st_range(x, k + 1, t, -1, depth + 1);
            sp(&x->out, "  }\n");
            k = t;
        }
    }
}

// A BRX through a table (block k): `bt` is its computed target, and each target starts a case running to the next
// one (the last: to the region's end); a case must end in a jump or an EXIT, not run into the next. A target that is
// none of them exits, as the state machine's default does.
static int st_switch(SCtx *x, int k, int end, int depth) {
    const Ctx *c = x->c;
    if (maxwell_no_switch) { x->fail = true; return -1; }  // (the whole shader keeps its state machine)
    int bx = x->b[k].brx;
    uint64_t w = x->w[x->c->brx[bx].at];
    int ra = (int)bits(w, 8, 8), n = 0;
    int tb[256];
    for (int q = 0; q < c->brx[bx].n; q++) {  // (blocks; the list is a superset: words of cbuf 1 that land on code)
        int ti = (int)(c->brx[bx].t[q] / 8), b = 0;
        while (b < x->nb && x->b[b].s != (uint32_t)ti) b++;
        if (b <= k || b >= x->nb) { x->fail = true; return -1; }
        tb[n++] = b;
    }
    if (!n || tb[0] != k + 1 || x->nsw == 16) { x->fail = true; return -1; }  // (code between the BRX and its first case)
    // the join: where most cases that end in a jump go, forward past their own start; the table's words past it are
    // no cases (nor past the region's end)
    int J = -1, best = 0;
    for (int q = 0; q + 1 < n; q++) {
        SBlk *last = &x->b[tb[q + 1] - 1];
        if (last->term != 1 || strcmp(last->cond, "true") || last->tgt <= tb[q + 1] - 1) continue;
        int cnt = 0;
        for (int r = 0; r + 1 < n; r++) {
            SBlk *l2 = &x->b[tb[r + 1] - 1];
            cnt += l2->term == 1 && !strcmp(l2->cond, "true") && l2->tgt == last->tgt;
        }
        if (cnt > best) best = cnt, J = last->tgt;
    }
    if (J > end) J = -1;
    int stop = J >= 0 ? J : end;
    while (n && tb[n - 1] >= stop) n--;
    if (!n) { x->fail = true; return -1; }
    char r[8];
    if (ra == RZ) strcpy(r, "0u"); else snprintf(r, sizeof r, "r%d", ra);
    sp(&x->out, "  { uint bt = %uu + %s + 0x%08xu; if (((bt >> 3) & 3u) == 0u) bt += 8u;\n  switch (bt) {\n",
       x->c->brx[bx].at * 8 + 8, r, (uint32_t)sbits(w, 20, 24));
    x->sw_loops[x->nsw++] = x->nloops;
    bool ex0 = x->exit_used;
    for (int q = 0; q < n && !x->fail; q++) {
        int e = q + 1 < n ? tb[q + 1] : stop;
        SBlk *last = &x->b[e - 1];
        // ends in a jump to the join or an EXIT: a break after it (and a jump to the join inside skips the rest);
        // else it runs into the next case (one of the table's extra words: never a value of bt)
        bool to_join = last->term == 1 && !strcmp(last->cond, "true") && last->tgt == stop;
        bool ends = to_join || (last->term == 2 && !strcmp(last->cond, "true")) || (last->term == 1 && !strcmp(last->cond, "true"));
        // the last case runs up to the join: running off its end reaches it, as a break does (it fell into default -
        // exit_now - and skipped the rest of the shader: an alpha test's discard, the outputs; and Qualcomm's compiler
        // crashed on that fall into default)
        if (q == n - 1) ends = true;
        sp(&x->out, "  case %uu: {\n", x->b[tb[q]].s * 8);
        st_range_alt(x, tb[q], e, -1, depth + 1, ends ? stop : -1);
        sp(&x->out, ends ? "  break; }\n" : "  }\n");
    }
    x->nsw--;
    x->exit_used = true;
    sp(&x->out, "  default: exit_now = true; break;\n  }\n  if (exit_now) break;\n  }\n");
    (void)ex0;
    return J;
}

// Rewrites c->body (the state machine's, with per-instruction text in [us[i], ue[i])) as structured code.
static bool structure(Ctx *c, const uint64_t *code, size_t end, const uint8_t *label, const uint32_t *us, const uint32_t *ue) {
    SCtx x = {.c = c, .src = c->body.buf, .us = us, .ue = ue, .w = code};
    x.skip = calloc(end + 1, 1);
    int *blk = malloc((end + 1) * sizeof *blk);
    x.b = calloc(end + 1, sizeof *x.b);
    x.latch = malloc((end + 1) * sizeof *x.latch);
    x.consumed = calloc(end + 1, 1);
    bool ok = x.skip && blk && x.b && x.latch && x.consumed && c->body.buf;
    int nb = 0;
    bool prev_flow = false;
    for (size_t i = 0; ok && i < end; i++) {
        blk[i] = -1;
        if (i % 4 == 0) continue;
        uint64_t w = code[i];
        uint32_t top = (uint32_t)(w >> 52);
        if (nb == 0 || label[i] || prev_flow) {
            if (nb) x.b[nb - 1].e = (uint32_t)i;
            x.b[nb] = (SBlk){.s = (uint32_t)i, .e = (uint32_t)end};
            nb++;
        }
        blk[i] = nb - 1;
        SBlk *b = &x.b[nb - 1];
        int pr = (int)bits(w, 16, 3);
        bool prn = bits(w, 19, 1);
        bool push = (w & 0xfff0000000000020ull) == 0xe290000000000000ull || (w & 0xfff0000000000020ull) == 0xe2a0000000000000ull ||
                    (w & 0xfff0000000000020ull) == 0xe2b0000000000000ull;
        bool bra = (w & 0xfff0000000000020ull) == 0xe240000000000000ull;
        bool pop = (w & 0xfff8000000000000ull) == 0xf0f8000000000000ull || top == 0xe34 || top == 0xe35;
        bool ex = top == 0xe30;
        int bx = top == 0xe25 ? brx_of(c, i) : -1;
        prev_flow = false;
        if (push) { x.skip[i] = 1; continue; }
        if (bx >= 0 && !(pr == PT && prn)) {
            x.skip[i] = 1;
            prev_flow = true;
            if (pr != PT || prn) ok = false;  // (a guarded one: not handled)
            b->term = 3, b->brx = bx, b->tgt = -1;
            strcpy(b->cond, "true");
            continue;
        }
        if (!(bra || pop || ex) || (pr == PT && prn)) { b->code |= ue[i] > us[i]; continue; }  // (@!PT: never runs)
        x.skip[i] = 1;
        prev_flow = true;
        if (pr == PT) strcpy(b->cond, "true");
        else snprintf(b->cond, sizeof b->cond, "%sp%d", prn ? "!" : "", pr);
        if (bra && bits(w, 0, 5) != 15) {  // BRA CC.xx: the flags' test too (emit_insn checked it is a known one)
            const char *cc = cc_test((int)bits(w, 0, 5));
            char t2[40];
            snprintf(t2, sizeof t2, "(%s && %s)", b->cond, cc ? cc : "false");
            strcpy(b->cond, t2);
        }
        int64_t t = bra ? (int64_t)norm_target((int64_t)i * 8 + 8 + sbits(w, 20, 24)) : ex ? -1 : c->flow_to[i];
        b->term = t < 0 || (size_t)(t / 8) >= end ? 2 : 1;  // (past the end, or a SYNC never reached: the default's exit)
        b->tgt = b->term == 1 ? (int)(t / 8) : -1;  // (instruction index for now)
    }
    x.nb = nb;
    for (int k = 0; ok && k < nb; k++) {
        x.latch[k] = -1;
        if (x.b[k].term != 1) continue;
        int ti = x.b[k].tgt;
        if (blk[ti] < 0 || x.b[blk[ti]].s != (uint32_t)ti) ok = false;  // (into the middle of a block)
        else x.b[k].tgt = blk[ti];
    }
    for (int k = 0; ok && k < nb; k++) {  // (a table's targets: block starts too)
        if (x.b[k].term != 3) continue;
        const uint32_t *t = c->brx[x.b[k].brx].t;
        for (int q = 0; q < c->brx[x.b[k].brx].n && ok; q++) {
            size_t ti = t[q] / 8;
            if (blk[ti] < 0 || x.b[blk[ti]].s != (uint32_t)ti) ok = false;
        }
    }
    for (int k = 0; ok && k < nb; k++)
        if (x.b[k].term == 1 && x.b[k].tgt <= k && k > x.latch[x.b[k].tgt]) x.latch[x.b[k].tgt] = k;
    if (ok) st_range(&x, 0, nb, -1, 0);
    ok = ok && !x.fail && !x.nsk;
    if (ok) {
        free(c->body.buf);
        Str body = {0};
        for (int i = 0; i < x.nskv; i++) sp(&body, "  bool sk%d = false;\n", i);
        sp(&body, "%s", x.out.buf ? x.out.buf : "");
        free(x.out.buf);
        c->body = body;
    } else free(x.out.buf);
    free(x.skip); free(blk); free(x.b); free(x.latch); free(x.consumed);
    return ok;
}

static ShaderInfo *glsl_finish(Ctx *c, bool any_branch, bool dbg) {
    ShaderInfo *info = c->info;
    const ShaderKey *key = c->key;
    int stage = c->stage;
    Str body = {0};
    info->cbwin_mask = 0;
    if (maxwell_cb_window && (stage == STAGE_VERTEX || stage == STAGE_FRAGMENT))
        info->cbwin_mask = info->cbuf_dynamic & info->cbuf_mask & 0x1FFF8u;  // (the game's: 3..16)
    glsl_rewrite(c, &body, c->body.buf ? c->body.buf : "");
    if (info->uses_gmem && (info->cbuf_mask & (1u << GMEM_BUFFER_INDEX))) fail(c, "cbuf %d clashes with gmem", GMEM_BUFFER_INDEX);
    if (info->cbuf_mask >> 18) fail(c, "cbuf index out of range");
    for (int i = 0; i < info->ntex; i++)
        if (info->tex[i].shadow && info->tex[i].type == TEXTYPE_3D) fail(c, "3d shadow texture");
    if (c->fail) { free(body.buf); free(c->body.buf); free(c); return info; }
    int set = stage == STAGE_FRAGMENT ? 1 : 0;
    Str s = {0};
    sp(&s, "#version 460\n");
    if (!maxwell_no_int64) sp(&s, "#extension GL_EXT_shader_explicit_arithmetic_types_int64 : require\n");
    sp(&s, "%s", glsl_prelude);
    if (maxwell_no_int64) sp(&s, "%s", glsl_int32_helpers);
    if (maxwell_native_half && stage != STAGE_VERTEX) {
        // (maxwell_native_half) halves by the GPU's own conversion outside vertex shaders: the bitwise h2f (kept for
        // the positions a depth pre-pass and its colour pass must agree on) is a dozen operations with branches per
        // half, and the overworld's lit pass converts ~300 of them, half inside its light loop. For the code after
        // here only (the prelude's own functions keep theirs).
        sp(&s, "float h2fn(uint h) { return unpackHalf2x16(h).x; }\n"
               "vec2 hxn(uint v, uint swz) { if (swz == 1u) return vec2(uintBitsToFloat(v)); vec2 h = unpackHalf2x16(v); "
               "return swz == 2u ? h.xx : (swz == 3u ? h.yy : h); }\n"
               "#define h2f h2fn\n#define unpack_h2 unpackHalf2x16\n#define hx hxn\n");
    }
    if (maxwell_fast_minmax) {
        // (maxwell_fast_minmax) the GPU's own min / max / saturation: on Adreno, as in D3D, min and max return the
        // operand that isn't NaN and a clamp to [0, 1] is the saturate modifier (NaN to 0) - the Maxwell semantics
        // the helpers spell out with NaN tests (two tests and selects per fmin / fmax, ~40 in the lit pass's light
        // loop). For the code after here only.
        sp(&s, "#define fmin min\n#define fmax max\n#define saturate(x) clamp((x), 0.0f, 1.0f)\n");
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
        if (!(info->cbuf_mask & (1u << i))) continue;
        uint32_t n = info->cbuf_size[i] / 16;
        if (c->cbuf_need[i] > n) n = c->cbuf_need[i];
        if ((info->cbuf_dynamic & (1u << i)) && n < 4096) n = 4096;
        if (!n) n = 1;
        sp(&s, "layout(std140, set = %d, binding = %d) uniform CB%d { uvec4 cb%d[%u]; };\n", set, i, i, i, n);
        if (info->cbwin_mask >> i & 1u) {  // (maxwell_cb_window: shader.h)
            if (!(info->cbwin_mask & ((1u << i) - 1u)))
                sp(&s, "layout(std140, set = %d, binding = %d) uniform CBP { uvec4 cbp_m; uvec4 cbp[64]; };\n", set,
                   CBPATCH_BUFFER_INDEX);
            sp(&s, "uvec4 cbw%d(uint i) { uint j = i - cbp_m.y; return cbp_m.x == %du && j < cbp_m.z ? cbp[min(j, 63u)] : cb%d[i]; }\n",
               i, i + 1, i);
            sp(&s, "#define cbrw%d(off) cbw%d(min((off) >> 4, %uu))[((off) >> 2) & 3u]\n", i, i, n - 1);
        }
    }
    if (info->uses_gmem)
        sp(&s, "layout(std430, set = %d, binding = %d) %sbuffer GMem { uint w[]; } gmem_;\n", set, GMEM_BUFFER_INDEX,
           c->uses_gmem_store ? "" : "readonly ");
    if (info->uses_gmem_map) {  // (compute) the dispatch's storage buffers, device-local: gmap[i] = heap offset, size, word
        sp(&s, "layout(std140, set = %d, binding = %d) uniform GMap { uvec4 gmap[%d]; };\n", set, GMAP_BUFFER_INDEX, GMAP_MAX + 1);
        sp(&s, "layout(std430, set = %d, binding = %d) %sbuffer GFast { uint w[]; } gfast_;\n", set, GFAST_BUFFER_INDEX,
           c->uses_gmem_store ? "" : "readonly ");
        if (maxwell_gmem_map_all) {  // (Android's copy mode: the tables are sorted by address and grew with the ranges
                                   // learned from misses - a binary search: the lighting reads the light list in its
                                   // inner loop, every read through here)
            sp(&s, "uvec3 gc_ = uvec3(0u, 0u, 0u);\n"  // (the entry last found: the next read nearly always hits it - the
                                                        // lighting's loop over the light list; the copy mode's lit pass ran
                                                        // ~9x slower per pixel than Turnip's, every read searching the table)
                   "uint gfind(uint g) { uint o = g - gc_.x; if (o < gc_.y) return gc_.z + (o >> 2); ");
            // Qualcomm's compiler rejects BOTW's large compute shader with the binary-search loop (-13).
            // Both searches resolve the same disjoint GMap ranges; retain the last-hit cache for repeated loads.
            if (key && key->gmem_linear_lookup)
                sp(&s, "for (uint i = 0u; i < gmap[%d].x; i++) { uvec4 e = gmap[i]; o = g - e.x; "
                       "if (g >= e.x && o < e.y) { gc_ = e.xyz; return e.z + (o >> 2); } } return 0xFFFFFFFFu; }\n", GMAP_MAX);
            else sp(&s,
                   "uint lo = 0u, hi = gmap[%d].x; while (lo < hi) { uint m = (lo + hi) >> 1; "
                   "if (gmap[m].x <= g) lo = m + 1u; else hi = m; } if (lo == 0u) return 0xFFFFFFFFu; uvec4 e = gmap[lo - 1u]; "
                   "o = g - e.x; if (o >= e.y) return 0xFFFFFFFFu; gc_ = e.xyz; return e.z + (o >> 2); }\n", GMAP_MAX);
        } else  // (the entry last found first, as above: a single-invocation loop storing word by word searched the
                // table for every word - TOTK's list clears, 1.5 ms of the GPU's frame)
        sp(&s, "uvec3 gc_ = uvec3(0u, 0u, 0u);\n"
               "uint gfind(uint g) { uint o = g - gc_.x; if (o < gc_.y) return gc_.z + (o >> 2); "
               "uint n = gmap[%d].x; for (uint i = 0u; i < n; i++) { uvec4 e = gmap[i]; o = g - e.x; "
               "if (g >= e.x && o < e.y) { gc_ = e.xyz; return e.z + (o >> 2); } } return 0xFFFFFFFFu; }\n", GMAP_MAX);
        if (GMISS_ON(stage)) {
            sp(&s, "layout(std430, set = %d, binding = %d) buffer GMiss { uint w[]; } gmiss_;\n", set, GMISS_BUFFER_INDEX);
            sp(&s, "uint gmiss(%s ga) { uint k = atomicAdd(gmiss_.w[0], 1u); if (k < 64u) gmiss_.w[1u + k] = uint(ga); "
                   "return 0u; }\n", maxwell_no_int64 ? "uint" : "uint64_t");
        }
    }
    if (c->uses_rscale) {  // (vertex shaders too: texel fetches from scaled targets)
        sp(&s, "layout(std140, set = %d, binding = 18) uniform RScale { vec4 rscale[%d]; };\n", set,
           key && key->flip_x ? 66 : 65);  // ([65]: mirror mode's render target width)
        info->uses_rscale = true;
    }
    bool tint = stage == STAGE_FRAGMENT && !dbg && (c->omap_target & 0x7) == 0x7 && (!key || key->rt_kind[0] == 0);
    if (tint) {
        sp(&s, "layout(std140, set = %d, binding = 19) uniform Tint { vec4 ltint[2]; };\n", set);
        info->uses_tint = true;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < info->ntex; i++) {
        ShaderTexture *t = &info->tex[i];
        sp(&s, "layout(set = %d, binding = %d) uniform %s t%d;\n", set, 32 + i, glsl_sampler_type(t), i);
        // size of level l as (width, height, depth or layers)
        switch (t->type) {
        case TEXTYPE_1D: sp(&s, "ivec3 tsize%d(int l) { return ivec3(textureSize(t%d, l), 1, 1); }\n", i, i); break;
        case TEXTYPE_1D_ARRAY: sp(&s, "ivec3 tsize%d(int l) { ivec2 s = textureSize(t%d, l); return ivec3(s.x, 1, s.y); }\n", i, i); break;
        case TEXTYPE_3D: case TEXTYPE_2D_ARRAY: case TEXTYPE_CUBE_ARRAY:
            sp(&s, "ivec3 tsize%d(int l) { return textureSize(t%d, l); }\n", i, i); break;
        default: sp(&s, "ivec3 tsize%d(int l) { return ivec3(textureSize(t%d, l), 1); }\n", i, i);
        }
    }
    if (stage == STAGE_VERTEX) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
            if (!(c->in_attr_mask & (1u << i))) continue;
            int kind = key ? key->attr_kind[i] : 0;
            sp(&s, "layout(location = %d) in %s a%d;\n", i, kind == 1 ? "ivec4" : kind == 2 ? "uvec4" : "vec4", i);
        }
        // depth pre-pass + EQUAL test needs identical positions from different shaders: invariant, and precise so no
        // compiler fuses or reorders the math feeding it (MSL gets this from preserveInvariance; without it foliage
        // drawn twice flickered black)
        sp(&s, "invariant gl_Position;\nprecise gl_Position;\n");
        for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++)
            if (c->out_attr_mask & (1u << i)) sp(&s, "layout(location = %d) out vec4 v%d;\n", i, i);
    } else if (stage == STAGE_FRAGMENT) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
            if (!(c->in_attr_mask & (1u << i))) continue;
            const char *interp = (c->flat_mask & (1u << i)) ? "flat " : (c->noperspective_mask & (1u << i)) ? "noperspective " : "";
            sp(&s, "layout(location = %d) %sin vec4 v%d;\n", i, interp, i);
        }
        for (int rt = 0; rt < 8; rt++) {
            if (!((c->omap_target >> (rt * 4)) & 0xF)) continue;
            int kind = key ? key->rt_kind[rt] : 0;
            sp(&s, "layout(location = %d) out %s c%d;\n", rt, kind == 1 ? "ivec4" : kind == 2 ? "uvec4" : "vec4", rt);
        }
        if (c->omap_depth) info->writes_depth = true;
        // (Android's copy mode: the miss log's store, even never run, made the depth test late - every hidden pixel
        // shaded, the lit pass ~2x slower; with no discard, depth write or store of its own the shader's depth test
        // is early anyway - and with a discard too when the draw writes no depth / stencil: the alpha-tested lit
        // shaders, after the depth prepass)
        if (GMISS_ON(stage) && info->uses_gmem_map && !c->uses_gmem_store && !c->omap_depth &&
            (!info->uses_discard || (key && key->no_ds_write)))
            sp(&s, "layout(early_fragment_tests) in;\n");
    } else {
        sp(&s, "layout(local_size_x_id = 0, local_size_y_id = 1, local_size_z_id = 2) in;\n");
        if (c->uses_shared) sp(&s, "shared uint smem[%d];\n", SMEM_WORDS);
    }
    sp(&s, "void main() {\n");
    if (stage == STAGE_VERTEX) {
        sp(&s, "  gl_Position = vec4(0, 0, 0, 1);\n");
        for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++)
            if (c->out_attr_mask & (1u << i)) sp(&s, "  v%d = vec4(0, 0, 0, 1);\n", i);
        if (info->writes_point_size) sp(&s, "  gl_PointSize = 0.0f;\n");
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++)
        if (c->reg_used[i]) sp(&s, "  uint r%d = 0u;\n", i);
    for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++)
        if (c->pred_used[i]) sp(&s, "  bool p%d = false;\n", i);
    if (c->uses_cc) sp(&s, "  uint cc = 0u; bool ccz = false, ccs = false;\n");
    if (c->uses_local)
        sp(&s, "  const uint lmask_ = %uu; uint lmem[%u]; for (int li_ = 0; li_ < %u; li_++) lmem[li_] = 0u;\n",
           lmem_words(c) - 1, lmem_words(c), lmem_words(c));
    if (c->uses_shared && stage != STAGE_COMPUTE) sp(&s, "  uint smem[%d];\n", SMEM_WORDS);
    if (dbg) sp(&s, maxwell_dbg_pc == 0xffffffffu ? "  float dbgv = 1.0f;\n" : "  float dbgv = -1.0f;\n");
    if (any_branch && c->structured) {
        sp(&s, "  bool exit_now = false;\n  do {\n%s  } while (false);\n", body.buf ? body.buf : "");
    } else if (any_branch) {
        if (c->static_stacks) sp(&s, "  uint pc = 8u;\n");
        else sp(&s, "  uint pc = 8u; uint ssy[16]; uint ssy_n = 0u; uint pbk[16]; uint pbk_n = 0u; uint pcnt[16]; uint pcnt_n = 0u;\n");
        sp(&s, "  bool exit_now = false;\n");
        sp(&s, "  for (uint guard = 0u; guard < 100000u; guard++) {\n  switch (pc) {\n");
        sp(&s, "%s", body.buf ? body.buf : "");
        sp(&s, "    exit_now = true; break;\n  default: exit_now = true; break;\n  }\n  if (exit_now) break;\n  }\n");
    } else {
        sp(&s, "  do {\n%s  } while (false);\n", body.buf ? body.buf : "");
    }
    free(body.buf);
    if (stage == STAGE_VERTEX) {
        if (key && key->flip_y) sp(&s, "  gl_Position.y = -gl_Position.y;\n");
        if (key && key->flip_x) sp(&s, "  gl_Position.x = -gl_Position.x;\n");
        if (key && key->depth_minus_one) sp(&s, "  gl_Position.z = (gl_Position.z + gl_Position.w) * 0.5f;\n");
    } else if (stage == STAGE_FRAGMENT) {
        int r = 0;
        for (int rt = 0; rt < 8; rt++) {
            uint32_t m = (c->omap_target >> (rt * 4)) & 0xF;
            if (!m) continue;
            int kind = key ? key->rt_kind[rt] : 0;
            const char *cv = kind == 1 ? "int" : kind == 2 ? "uint" : "";
            for (int comp = 0; comp < 4; comp++) {
                if (!(m & (1u << comp))) continue;
                if (dbg) {
                    if (comp == 3) sp(&s, "  c%d[%d] = %s(1.0f);\n", rt, comp, cv);
                    else sp(&s, "  c%d[%d] = %s(dbgv);\n", rt, comp, cv);
                } else if (r < 256 && c->reg_used[r]) {
                    if (kind == 0) sp(&s, "  c%d[%d] = as_f(r%d);\n", rt, comp, r);
                    else sp(&s, "  c%d[%d] = %s(r%d);\n", rt, comp, cv, r);
                } else {
                    sp(&s, "  c%d[%d] = 0;\n", rt, comp);
                }
                r++;
            }
        }
        if (tint)
            sp(&s, "  if (ltint[0].w > 0.0f) { vec3 g = c0.rgb; float l = dot(g, vec3(0.299f, 0.587f, 0.114f));\n"
                   "    c0.rgb = mix(g, ltint[0].rgb * pow(l, ltint[1].w) + ltint[1].rgb * l, ltint[0].w); }\n");
        if (c->omap_depth) {
            if (c->reg_used[r + 1]) sp(&s, "  gl_FragDepth = as_f(r%d);\n", r + 1);
            else sp(&s, "  gl_FragDepth = gl_FragCoord.z;\n");
        }
    }
    sp(&s, "}\n");
    info->msl = glsl_with_prelude(s.buf);  // (only the helpers it calls)
    info->attr_mask = c->in_attr_mask;
    info->out_mask = stage == STAGE_FRAGMENT ? c->omap_target : c->out_attr_mask;
    free(c->body.buf);
    free(c);
    return info;
}

ShaderInfo *maxwell_translate(const uint8_t *blob, size_t max_size, int stage, const ShaderKey *key) {
    return maxwell_translate_bounded(blob, max_size, 0, stage, key);
}

ShaderInfo *maxwell_translate_bounded(const uint8_t *blob, size_t max_size, size_t const_size, int stage, const ShaderKey *key) {
    ShaderInfo *info = calloc(1, sizeof *info);
    info->stage = stage;
    Ctx *c = calloc(1, sizeof *c);
    c->info = info;
    c->key = key;
    c->stage = stage;
    c->ipa_mode = -1;
    c->glsl = key && key->glsl;
    const uint8_t *sph = blob + 0x30;
    const uint8_t *code = blob + 0x80;
    if (stage != STAGE_COMPUTE)  // (CommonWord1 / 2: ShaderLocalMemoryLowSize / HighSize, bytes, 24 bits each)
        c->lmem_sph_bytes = (*(const uint32_t *)(sph + 4) & 0xFFFFFFu) + (*(const uint32_t *)(sph + 8) & 0xFFFFFFu);
    // compute programs have neither the 0x30-byte NVN header nor an SPH: code starts at the blob
    if (stage == STAGE_COMPUTE) code = blob;
    if (stage == STAGE_FRAGMENT) {
        c->omap_target = *(const uint32_t *)(sph + 0x48);
        c->omap_depth = (*(const uint32_t *)(sph + 0x4C) >> 1) & 1;
        // ImapGenericVector[32] (SPH 0x18): 2 bits per component of each generic input, 1 constant, 2 perspective,
        // 3 screen-linear. An input with a screen-linear component is noperspective (in practice all its used
        // components agree).
        for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++)
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++)
                if (((sph[0x18 + i] >> (k * 2)) & 3) == 3) c->noperspective_mask |= 1u << i;
    }
    // find the end: the last EXIT followed by self-branch padding, or max_size
    size_t n = (max_size - (code - blob)) / 8;
    if (n > 65536) n = 65536;
    size_t end = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        uint64_t w = ((const uint64_t *)code)[i];
        if (i % 4 == 0) continue;
        if ((w & 0xfff0000000000000ull) == 0xe240000000000000ull && sbits(w, 20, 24) == -8 && end) break;  // bra self
        if (w == 0 && i > 4) break;
        end = i + 1;
    }
    c->code = code;
    c->ninsts = end;
    // collect branch targets (labels)
    uint8_t *label = calloc(end + 4, 1);
    label[1] = 1;
    bool any_branch = false;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < end; i++) {
        if (i % 4 == 0) continue;
        uint64_t w = ((const uint64_t *)code)[i];
        uint32_t pc = (uint32_t)(i * 8);
        bool is_flow = (w & 0xfff0000000000020ull) == 0xe240000000000000ull ||
                       (w & 0xfff0000000000020ull) == 0xe290000000000000ull ||
                       (w & 0xfff0000000000020ull) == 0xe2a0000000000000ull ||
                       (w & 0xfff0000000000020ull) == 0xe2b0000000000000ull;
        if (is_flow) {
            int64_t t = norm_target((int64_t)pc + 8 + sbits(w, 20, 24));
            if (t >= 0 && (size_t)(t / 8) < end) label[t / 8] = 1;
            any_branch = true;
        }
        if ((w & 0xfff0000000000000ull) == 0xe250000000000000ull) {  // BRX: any instruction may be a target
            any_branch = true;
            size_t hi = 0;
            // (maxwell_brx_window) a jump table's targets lie between the BRX and the join of the PBK / SSY pushed
            // before it - how the compiler emits switches. Labels everywhere else split the straight code that
            // follows into blocks the GPU's compiler can't schedule (Adreno: an SSAO pass 20 ms instead of ~1)
            bool table = maxwell_brx_window && c->glsl && max_size < 0x10000 &&
                         brx_table(c, (const uint64_t *)code, i, end, (const uint32_t *)(blob + max_size), const_size, label);
            if (maxwell_brx_window && !table)
                for (size_t k = i; k-- > 0;) {
                    if (k % 4 == 0) continue;
                    uint64_t wk = ((const uint64_t *)code)[k];
                    if ((wk & 0xfff0000000000020ull) != 0xe2a0000000000000ull && (wk & 0xfff0000000000020ull) != 0xe290000000000000ull)
                        continue;
                    int64_t t = norm_target((int64_t)k * 8 + 8 + sbits(wk, 20, 24));
                    if (t > (int64_t)pc && (size_t)(t / 8) < end) { hi = (size_t)(t / 8); break; }
                }
            if (table) {}
            else if (hi) for (size_t k = i + 1; k <= hi; k++) label[k] = 1;
            else memset(label, 1, end);
        }
        if ((w & 0xfff8000000000000ull) == 0xf0f8000000000000ull || (w & 0xfff0000000000000ull) == 0xe340000000000000ull ||
            (w & 0xfff0000000000000ull) == 0xe350000000000000ull)
            any_branch = true;
        (void)is_branch_target_op;
    }
    // translate
    bool dbg = maxwell_dbg_code && blob == maxwell_dbg_code && stage == STAGE_FRAGMENT;
    static int annotate = -1;
    if (annotate < 0) annotate = getenv("LARECOMP_SAVE_MSL") != NULL;
    c->branchy = any_branch;
    if (c->glsl && any_branch && maxwell_static_stacks) {
        c->flow_to = malloc(end * sizeof *c->flow_to + 4);
        c->static_stacks = c->flow_to && resolve_stacks(c, (const uint64_t *)code, end, c->flow_to);
    }
    uint32_t *us = NULL, *ue = NULL;  // (maxwell_structured) each instruction's text in the body
    if (c->static_stacks && maxwell_structured) {
        us = calloc(end + 1, sizeof *us);
        ue = calloc(end + 1, sizeof *ue);
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < end && !c->fail; i++) {
        if (i % 4 == 0) continue;
        uint32_t pc = (uint32_t)(i * 8);
        if (any_branch && label[i]) sp(&c->body, "  case %uu:\n", pc);
        if (us) us[i] = (uint32_t)c->body.len;
        if (annotate) sp(&c->body, "    // pc %x: %016llx\n", pc, (unsigned long long)((const uint64_t *)code)[i]);
        emit_insn(c, ((const uint64_t *)code)[i], pc);
        if (dbg && pc == maxwell_dbg_pc) {
            int rr = maxwell_dbg_reg % 1000, half = maxwell_dbg_reg / 1000;  // +1000: low f16, +2000: high f16
            c->reg_used[rr] = 1;
            if (half) sp(&c->body, c->glsl ? "    dbgv = unpackHalf2x16(r%d)[%d];\n" : "    dbgv = float(as_type<half2>(r%d)[%d]);\n", rr, half - 1);
            else sp(&c->body, "    dbgv = as_type<float>(r%d);\n", rr);
        }
        info->num_insts++;
        if (ue) ue[i] = (uint32_t)c->body.len;
    }
    if (us && ue && !c->fail && !(maxwell_no_local_struct && c->uses_local))
        c->structured = structure(c, (const uint64_t *)code, end, label, us, ue);
    free(us);
    free(ue);
    free(label);
    free(c->flow_to);
    c->flow_to = NULL;
    if (c->fail) { free(c->body.buf); free(c); return info; }
    if (c->glsl) return glsl_finish(c, any_branch, dbg);

    // ---------------------------------------------------------- MSL source
    Str s = {0};
    sp(&s, "#include <metal_stdlib>\nusing namespace metal;\n");
    sp(&s, "static inline uint cbr(constant uint4 *cb, uint off) { return cb[off >> 4][(off >> 2) & 3]; }\n");
    sp(&s, "static inline uint bfe_u(uint v, uint ctl) { uint pos = ctl & 0xFFu, len = (ctl >> 8) & 0xFFu; if (len == 0u) return 0u; if (pos >= 32u) return 0u; return extract_bits(v, pos, min(len, 32u - pos)); }\n");
    sp(&s, "static inline uint bfe_s(uint v, uint ctl) { uint pos = ctl & 0xFFu, len = (ctl >> 8) & 0xFFu; if (len == 0u) return 0u; if (pos >= 32u) return (int(v) < 0) ? 0xFFFFFFFFu : 0u; return uint(extract_bits(int(v), pos, min(len, 32u - pos))); }\n");
    sp(&s, "static inline uint bfi(uint ins, uint ctl, uint base) { uint pos = ctl & 0xFFu, len = (ctl >> 8) & 0xFFu; if (len == 0u || pos >= 32u) return base; return insert_bits(base, ins, pos, min(len, 32u - pos)); }\n");
    sp(&s, "static inline float fswzadd(float a, float b, uint swz, uint lane) { uint m = (swz >> ((lane & 3u) * 2u)) & 3u; float ma = m == 1u ? -1.0f : (m == 3u ? 0.0f : 1.0f); float mb = m == 2u ? -1.0f : 1.0f; return a * ma + b * mb; }\n");
    sp(&s, "static inline uint2 rsc(uint2 c, float4 s) { return (s.x == 1.0f && s.y == 1.0f) ? c : uint2(floor((float2(c) + 0.5f) * s.xy)); }\n");
    sp(&s, "static inline float2 hx(uint v, uint swz) { if (swz == 1u) return float2(as_type<float>(v)); float2 h = float2(as_type<half2>(v)); return swz == 2u ? h.xx : swz == 3u ? h.yy : h; }\n");
    // merges on half2 lanes rather than with integer masks: on an M1 (macOS 15.0.1) the Metal compiler miscompiled
    // (old & 0xFFFF0000u) | lo in Link's body shader - the merged low half read back as a constant 512.0 and Link
    // rendered white. Same bits either way.
    sp(&s, "static inline uint hpack(float2 r, uint merge, uint old) { if (merge == 1u) return as_type<uint>(r.x); half2 o = as_type<half2>(old), n = half2(r); if (merge == 2u) o.x = n.x; else if (merge == 3u) o.y = n.y; else o = n; return as_type<uint>(o); }\n");
    sp(&s, "static inline uint prmt(uint a, uint b, uint sel) { uint r = 0; for (uint i = 0; i < 4; i++) { uint s = (sel >> (i * 4)) & 7u; uint byte = s < 4 ? (a >> (s * 8)) & 0xFFu : (b >> ((s - 4) * 8)) & 0xFFu; r |= byte << (i * 8); } return r; }\n");

    // inputs/outputs
    if (stage == STAGE_VERTEX) {
        sp(&s, "struct VIn {\n");
        for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
            if (!(c->in_attr_mask & (1u << i))) continue;
            int kind = key ? key->attr_kind[i] : 0;
            sp(&s, "  %s4 a%d [[attribute(%d)]];\n", kind == 1 ? "int" : kind == 2 ? "uint" : "float", i, i);
        }
        sp(&s, "};\n");
        sp(&s, "struct VOut {\n  float4 pos [[position, invariant]];\n");  // depth pre-pass + EQUAL test needs identical positions
        for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++)
            if (c->out_attr_mask & (1u << i)) sp(&s, "  float4 v%d [[user(locn%d)]];\n", i, i);
        if (info->writes_point_size) sp(&s, "  float psize [[point_size]];\n");
        sp(&s, "};\n");
    } else if (stage == STAGE_FRAGMENT) {
        sp(&s, "struct FIn {\n  float4 pos [[position]];\n");
        for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
            if (!(c->in_attr_mask & (1u << i))) continue;
            const char *interp = (c->flat_mask & (1u << i)) ? " [[flat]]" : (c->noperspective_mask & (1u << i)) ? " [[center_no_perspective]]" : "";
            sp(&s, "  float4 v%d [[user(locn%d)]]%s;\n", i, i, interp);
        }
        sp(&s, "};\n");
        sp(&s, "struct FOut {\n");
        for (int rt = 0; rt < 8; rt++) {
            if (!((c->omap_target >> (rt * 4)) & 0xF)) continue;
            int kind = key ? key->rt_kind[rt] : 0;
            sp(&s, "  %s4 c%d [[color(%d)]];\n", kind == 1 ? "int" : kind == 2 ? "uint" : "float", rt, rt);
        }
        if (c->omap_depth) { sp(&s, "  float depth [[depth(any)]];\n"); info->writes_depth = true; }
        sp(&s, "};\n");
    }

    // entry point
    Str args = {0};
    for (int i = 0; i < 18; i++)
        if (info->cbuf_mask & (1u << i)) sp(&args, ", constant uint4 *cb%d [[buffer(%d)]]", i, i);
    if (info->uses_gmem) {
        if (info->cbuf_mask & (1u << GMEM_BUFFER_INDEX)) {
            free(args.buf);
            args = (Str){0};  // (was a use after free + double free of args.buf)
            fail(c, "cbuf %d clashes with gmem", GMEM_BUFFER_INDEX);
        }
        sp(&args, ", device uchar *gmem [[buffer(%d)]]", GMEM_BUFFER_INDEX);
    }
    if (c->uses_rscale && stage != STAGE_VERTEX) {
        sp(&args, ", constant float4 *rscale [[buffer(18)]]");
        info->uses_rscale = true;
    }
    // Runtime highlight (e.g. golden unchecked pots): fragment shaders writing a float color target 0 get a
    // per-draw tint, float4 [0] = colour.rgb + strength, [1] = added glow.rgb (strength 0 = untouched).
    bool tint = stage == STAGE_FRAGMENT && !dbg && (c->omap_target & 0x7) == 0x7 && (!key || key->rt_kind[0] == 0);
    if (tint) {
        sp(&args, ", constant float4 *ltint [[buffer(19)]]");
        info->uses_tint = true;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < info->ntex; i++) {
        ShaderTexture *t = &info->tex[i];
        const char *tn = tex_type_name(t->type);
        if (t->shadow) sp(&args, ", depth%s<float> t%d [[texture(%d)]], sampler s%d [[sampler(%d)]]", tn, i, i, i, i);
        else sp(&args, ", texture%s<float> t%d [[texture(%d)]], sampler s%d [[sampler(%d)]]", tn, i, i, i, i);
    }
    if (stage == STAGE_VERTEX) {
        sp(&s, "vertex VOut main0(VIn in [[stage_in]], uint vid [[vertex_id]], uint iid [[instance_id]]%s%s) {\n",
           (maxwell_dbg_vs && blob == maxwell_dbg_vs) ? ", device float4 *dbgout [[buffer(29)]]" : "",
           args.buf ? args.buf : "");
        sp(&s, "  VOut out = {};\n  out.pos = float4(0, 0, 0, 1);\n");
        for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++)
            if (c->out_attr_mask & (1u << i)) sp(&s, "  out.v%d = float4(0, 0, 0, 1);\n", i);
    } else if (stage == STAGE_FRAGMENT) {
        sp(&s, "fragment FOut main0(FIn in [[stage_in]], bool front_facing [[front_facing]]%s%s) {\n",
           c->uses_lane ? ", uint lane [[thread_index_in_simdgroup]]" : "", args.buf ? args.buf : "");
    } else {
        sp(&s, "kernel void main0(uint3 tid [[thread_position_in_threadgroup]], uint3 ctaid [[threadgroup_position_in_grid]]%s) {\n",
           args.buf ? args.buf : "");
    }
    free(args.buf);
    for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++)
        if (c->reg_used[i]) sp(&s, "  uint r%d = 0;\n", i);
    for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++)
        if (c->pred_used[i]) sp(&s, "  bool p%d = false;\n", i);
    if (c->uses_cc) sp(&s, "  uint cc = 0; bool ccz = false, ccs = false;\n");
    if (c->uses_local) sp(&s, "  const uint lmask_ = %uu; uint lmem[%u] = {};\n", lmem_words(c) - 1, lmem_words(c));
    if (c->uses_shared) sp(&s, "  threadgroup uint smem[%d];\n", SMEM_WORDS);
    if (dbg) sp(&s, maxwell_dbg_pc == 0xffffffffu ? "  float dbgv = 1.0f;\n" : "  float dbgv = -1.0f;\n");
    if (any_branch) {
        sp(&s, "  uint pc = 8u; uint ssy[16]; uint ssy_n = 0; uint pbk[16]; uint pbk_n = 0; uint pcnt[16]; uint pcnt_n = 0;\n");
        sp(&s, "  bool exit_now = false;\n");
        sp(&s, "  for (uint guard = 0; guard < 100000u; guard++) {\n  switch (pc) {\n");
        sp(&s, "%s", c->body.buf ? c->body.buf : "");
        sp(&s, "    exit_now = true; break;\n  default: exit_now = true; break;\n  }\n  if (exit_now) break;\n  }\n");
    } else {
        sp(&s, "  do {\n%s  } while (false);\n", c->body.buf ? c->body.buf : "");
    }
    if (stage == STAGE_VERTEX) {
        if (key && key->flip_y) sp(&s, "  out.pos.y = -out.pos.y;\n");
        if (key && key->flip_x) sp(&s, "  out.pos.x = -out.pos.x;\n");
        if (key && key->depth_minus_one) sp(&s, "  out.pos.z = (out.pos.z + out.pos.w) * 0.5f;\n");
        if (maxwell_dbg_vs && blob == maxwell_dbg_vs) sp(&s, "  if (iid < 64u && vid < 8u) { dbgout[iid * 8u + vid] = out.pos; dbgout[512u + iid * 8u + vid] = %s; }\n", (c->out_attr_mask & 2u) ? "out.v1" : "float4(0)");
        sp(&s, "  return out;\n}\n");
    } else if (stage == STAGE_FRAGMENT) {
        sp(&s, "  FOut o;\n");
        int r = 0;
        for (int rt = 0; rt < 8; rt++) {
            uint32_t m = (c->omap_target >> (rt * 4)) & 0xF;
            if (!m) continue;
            int kind = key ? key->rt_kind[rt] : 0;
            for (int comp = 0; comp < 4; comp++) {
                if (!(m & (1u << comp))) continue;
                if (dbg) {
                    sp(&s, comp == 3 ? "  o.c%d[%d] = 1.0f;\n" : "  o.c%d[%d] = dbgv;\n", rt, comp);
                } else if (r < 256 && c->reg_used[r]) {
                    if (kind == 0) sp(&s, "  o.c%d[%d] = as_type<float>(r%d);\n", rt, comp, r);
                    else sp(&s, "  o.c%d[%d] = r%d;\n", rt, comp, r);
                } else {
                    sp(&s, "  o.c%d[%d] = 0;\n", rt, comp);
                }
                r++;
            }
        }
        if (tint)
            sp(&s, "  if (ltint[0].w > 0.0f) { float3 g = o.c0.rgb; float l = dot(g, float3(0.299f, 0.587f, 0.114f));\n"
                   "    o.c0.rgb = mix(g, ltint[0].rgb * pow(l, ltint[1].w) + ltint[1].rgb * l, ltint[0].w); }\n");
        if (c->omap_depth) {
            if (c->reg_used[r + 1]) sp(&s, "  o.depth = as_type<float>(r%d);\n", r + 1);
            else sp(&s, "  o.depth = in.pos.z;\n");
        }
        sp(&s, "  return o;\n}\n");
    } else {
        sp(&s, "  return;\n}\n");
    }
    info->msl = s.buf;
    info->attr_mask = c->in_attr_mask;
    info->out_mask = stage == STAGE_FRAGMENT ? c->omap_target : c->out_attr_mask;
    free(c->body.buf);
    free(c);
    return info;
}

void maxwell_free(ShaderInfo *s) {
    if (!s) return;
    free(s->msl);
    free(s);
}

void maxwell_disassemble(const uint8_t *code, size_t max_size, int stage, void *file) {
    (void)code; (void)max_size; (void)stage; (void)file;
}
```

```h
#include "compat.h"
// NVN implemented on the host. Guest NVN objects hold a pointer to a host object at offset 0;
// builders and small state objects store their fields directly in guest memory.
#pragma once
#include "tegra.h"

#define NVN(name) HLE_FUNC(#name, hle_##name)

// argument helpers
#define A(i) (c->x[(i)])
#define AP(i) ((void *)(uintptr_t)c->x[(i)])
#define AF(i) (*(float *)&c->v[(i)])
#define RET(v) (c->x[0] = (uint64_t)(v))
#define RETF(f) do { c->v[0] = 0; *(float *)&c->v[0] = (f); } while (0)
#define HOST(T, guest) ((T *)(uintptr_t)(*(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(guest)))
#define SET_HOST(guest, p) (*(uint64_t *)(uintptr_t)(guest) = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(p))
#define G(T, base, off) (*(T *)((uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)(base) + (off)))

typedef struct NvnPool {
    uint64_t storage, size;
    uint32_t flags;
} NvnPool;

typedef struct NvnTexture {
    TexLayout layout;
    uint32_t target, format, flags, width, height, depth, levels, samples, ds_mode;
    uint8_t swizzle[4];
    uint64_t stride;
    uint64_t addr;  // guest address of texel storage
    NvnPool *pool;
    uint64_t pool_offset;
    void *backend;  // renderer-side texture
    uint64_t debug_id;
    char label[64];
    unsigned refs;  // owners + descriptor slots + deferred releases (objects.c, g_live_lock)
    unsigned owners;  // guest objects initialized to this texture (objects.c); none left: finalized
    bool finalized;
    struct NvnTexture *next, *prev, *hnext;  // (hnext: objects.c's description hash)
} NvnTexture;

typedef struct {
    uint32_t min_filter, mag_filter, wrap[3], compare_mode, compare_func, reduction;
    float lod_min, lod_max, lod_bias, max_aniso;
    float border[4];
    void *backend;
} NvnSamplerDesc;

// Our layout inside the guest NVNtextureView. NVN 55's struct is 16 bytes (its driver's SetDefaults clears exactly
// that; BOTW 1.8.2 keeps views at the end of heap blocks), so ours must fit in it: NVN 53's 0x28 bytes overran the
// next block's heap header. (SavageWindRecomp, MIT; it fits the older versions' larger struct too.)
typedef struct {
    uint16_t min_layer, num_layers, format;
    uint8_t setmask;  // which fields are overridden: 1 levels, 2 layers, 4 format, 8 swizzle, 16 ds mode, 32 target
    uint8_t target, ds_mode, base_level, num_levels;
    uint8_t swizzle[4];
} NvnTextureView;
_Static_assert(sizeof(NvnTextureView) <= 16, "NVNtextureView is 16 bytes in NVN 55");

typedef struct {
    NvnTexture *tex;
    NvnTextureView view;
    bool has_view;
} NvnTexEntry;

typedef struct NvnDescPool {
    uint64_t addr;
    int count;
    void *entries;  // NvnTexEntry[] or NvnSamplerDesc[]
    struct NvnDescPool *next;  // all descriptor allocations of this boot
} NvnDescPool;

typedef struct NvnShaderStage {
    uint32_t stage;           // NVNshaderStage
    uint64_t code_addr;       // GPU (== CPU) address of the code
    const uint8_t *control;   // control section
    uint32_t const_offset, const_size;  // compiler constants (bound as c1), within the code blob
    void *backend;
} NvnShaderStage;

typedef struct NvnProgram {
    NvnShaderStage stages[6];
    uint32_t stage_mask;
    void *backend;
} NvnProgram;

typedef struct NvnWindow {
    uint64_t textures[8];  // guest NVNtexture*
    int num, active, interval, next;
    int crop[4];
} NvnWindow;

typedef struct NvnSync {
    volatile int signaled;
    volatile uint64_t seq;  // GPU submission this fence belongs to (renderer_fence_seq), 0 = none
#ifdef __ANDROID__
    volatile uint64_t lseq;  // (LARECOMP_VK_ASYNC) the render thread's request that sets seq: wait for it first
    uint64_t frame;          // (LARECOMP_LOG_SYNC) the game frame it was placed in
#endif
} NvnSync;

// ---- command recording (stored in guest command memory)
typedef struct {
    uint64_t gmem;   // where records go (runtime/nvn/cmdbuf.c): the guest address of the current chunk, 0: host memory
    uint64_t mem;    // (host memory: its address)
    uint64_t size;   // chunk size (game bytes)
    uint64_t used;   // bytes used in chunk (game bytes)
    bool has_ctrl;   // records go to control memory (the game added some), command memory is only accounted
    uint64_t cmd_size, cmd_used;
    uint64_t start;  // first record of the list being recorded
    uint64_t callback, callback_data;
    bool recording;
    uint64_t guest;  // the guest NVNcommandBuffer*
    uint64_t shadow_page, shadow_mem;  // (cmdbuf.c write_at) the shadow page its records last went to: no lookup per record
} NvnCmdBuf;

// One recorded command: header, the call's integer and float arguments, then copied data.
typedef struct {
    uint32_t op, size;  // size includes the header, multiple of 8
    uint64_t x[7];      // x1..x7 of the call
    float f[4];         // s0..s3 of the call
    uint8_t extra[];
} CmdRec;

enum {
    CMD_END = 0, CMD_JUMP, CMD_CALL,
    CMD_BIND_PROGRAM, CMD_BIND_BLEND, CMD_BIND_CHANNEL_MASK, CMD_BIND_COLOR, CMD_BIND_DEPTH_STENCIL,
    CMD_BIND_MULTISAMPLE, CMD_BIND_POLYGON, CMD_BIND_VERTEX_ATTRIB, CMD_BIND_VERTEX_STREAM,
    CMD_BIND_VERTEX_BUFFERS, CMD_BIND_UNIFORM_BUFFERS, CMD_BIND_STORAGE_BUFFERS, CMD_BIND_TEXTURES,
    CMD_BIND_IMAGES, CMD_SET_TEXTURE_POOL, CMD_SET_SAMPLER_POOL, CMD_SET_RENDER_TARGETS,
    CMD_SET_VIEWPORTS, CMD_SET_SCISSORS, CMD_SET_DEPTH_RANGES, CMD_SET_BLEND_COLOR, CMD_SET_STENCIL,
    CMD_SET_PRIMITIVE_RESTART, CMD_SET_ALPHA_REF, CMD_SET_DEPTH_BOUNDS, CMD_SET_POLYGON_OFFSET,
    CMD_SET_LINE_WIDTH, CMD_SET_POINT_SIZE, CMD_SET_SAMPLE_MASK, CMD_SET_RENDER_ENABLE,
    CMD_CLEAR_COLOR, CMD_CLEAR_DEPTH_STENCIL, CMD_CLEAR_TEXTURE, CMD_CLEAR_BUFFER,
    CMD_DRAW_ARRAYS, CMD_DRAW_ELEMENTS, CMD_DRAW_ARRAYS_INDIRECT, CMD_DRAW_ELEMENTS_INDIRECT,
    CMD_DISPATCH, CMD_DISPATCH_INDIRECT,
    CMD_COPY_BUFFER_TO_BUFFER, CMD_COPY_BUFFER_TO_TEXTURE, CMD_COPY_TEXTURE_TO_BUFFER,
    CMD_COPY_TEXTURE_TO_TEXTURE, CMD_DOWNSAMPLE, CMD_UPDATE_UNIFORM_BUFFER, CMD_FENCE_SYNC, CMD_WAIT_SYNC,
    CMD_BARRIER, CMD_SIGNAL_EVENT, CMD_WAIT_EVENT, CMD_REPORT_COUNTER, CMD_DISCARD_COLOR,
    CMD_DISCARD_DEPTH_STENCIL, CMD_SET_COPY_STRIDES, CMD_DRAW_TEXTURE, CMD_RESOLVE_DEPTH, CMD_SET_DEPTH_CLAMP,
    CMD_BIND_TEXTURES_DEFERRED,
    CMD_COUNT
};



// renderer backend (runtime/nvn/metal.m)
```

`mario-odessy-harmony/entry/src/main/cpp/platform/nvn_replay/plat_ohos.c`:

```c
/* OHOS 侧 plat_* 实现 —— 供 infra/BOTWRecompAndroid 的 NVN 回放层使用（M2 预备，暂不参与编译）。
 *
 * 依据：runtime/nvn 反查出的 9 个必需函数（2026-11-02 实测）：
 *   plat_frame_work_gpu  plat_now_ns  plat_render_work  plat_reset_guest
 *   plat_sleep_until_ns  plat_terminate  plat_thread_unpin
 *   plat_write_tracking_enable  plat_written_pages
 *
 * 参考实现：infra/BOTWRecompAndroid/runtime/platform/android.c（MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Peiikai）
 * 本文件的归属与约束见 notes/05-参考/BOTWRecompAndroid.md。
 *
 * 分类（按移植难度）：
 *   A. 纯 POSIX，逐行可搬           → plat_now_ns / plat_sleep_until_ns / plat_terminate / plat_thread_unpin
 *   B. ADPF（Android 动态性能框架） → plat_frame_work / plat_render_work / plat_frame_work_gpu：OHOS 无对应，空实现
 *   C. 缺页写追踪                   → plat_reset_guest / plat_write_tracking_enable / plat_written_pages：
 *                                     参考实现是 mprotect 只读 + SIGSEGV 标记；OHOS 同样支持，但**第一版先关掉**
 *                                     （参考实现自己也留了 LARECOMP_NO_WRITE_TRACKING=1 的关闭路径）。
 *                                     关掉的代价：每帧多拷顶点/索引缓冲（BOTW 实测 ~90MB / ~7ms），功能正确性不受影响。
 *
 * 编译：M2 接入时把本目录加入 CMakeLists 的 HOST_SOURCES，或单独 target 链接进 libgame.so。
 */
#include <errno.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#ifndef MAP_NORESERVE
#define MAP_NORESERVE 0
#endif

/* ---- A. 纯 POSIX ---- */

uint64_t plat_now_ns(void)
{
    struct timespec ts;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    return (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000000000ull + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec;
}

void plat_sleep_until_ns(uint64_t t)
{
    struct timespec ts = { .tv_sec = (time_t)(t / 1000000000ull), .tv_nsec = (long)(t % 1000000000ull) };
    while (clock_nanosleep(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, TIMER_ABSTIME, &ts, NULL) == EINTR) { }
}

void plat_terminate(void) { _exit(0); }

/* OHOS 上不需要把线程钉在特定核上；保留符号，空实现。 */
void plat_thread_unpin(void) { }

/* ---- B. ADPF 等价物：OHOS 无对应，空实现（只影响调频提示，不影响正确性）---- */

void plat_frame_work(uint64_t work_ns, uint64_t target_ns) { (void)work_ns; (void)target_ns; }
void plat_render_work(uint64_t work_ns, uint64_t target_ns) { (void)work_ns; (void)target_ns; }
void plat_frame_work_gpu(uint64_t cpu_ns, uint64_t gpu_ns, uint64_t target_ns, uint64_t game_ns)
{
    (void)cpu_ns; (void)gpu_ns; (void)target_ns; (void)game_ns;
}

/* ---- C. 客体内存窗口与写追踪 ---- */

static uint64_t wt_lo, wt_hi;
static uint8_t *wt_state;          /* 每 4KB 一字节；NULL = 写追踪关闭 */
static int wt_enabled;

bool plat_reset_guest(uint64_t lo, uint64_t hi)
{
    if (wt_state && lo < wt_hi && hi > wt_lo) {
        uint64_t a = lo < wt_lo ? wt_lo : lo, e = hi > wt_hi ? wt_hi : hi;
        memset(wt_state + ((a - wt_lo) >> 12), 0, (size_t)((e - a) >> 12));
    }
    /* 参考实现：一次性映射整个客体地址窗，MAP_NORESERVE 避免立即占页。 */
    void *p = mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)lo, (size_t)(hi - lo), PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
                   MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS | MAP_NORESERVE, -1, 0);
    return p == (void *)(uintptr_t)lo;
}

/* 第一版：不启用写追踪（等价参考实现的 LARECOMP_NO_WRITE_TRACKING=1）。
   启用后需要配套 SIGSEGV 处理器把页标脏再恢复可写——M2 第二版再做。 */
void plat_write_tracking_enable(uint64_t lo, uint64_t hi)
{
    (void)lo; (void)hi;
    wt_enabled = 0;
    wt_state = NULL;
}

/* 返回写入过的页。写追踪关闭时：调用方约定「未追踪 = 视为已写」，
   所以这里返回 0 并把 *page 置 0，等价于「全部算已写」，正确性优先于性能。 */
int plat_written_pages(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size, uint64_t *pages, int max, uint64_t *page)
{
    (void)addr; (void)size; (void)pages; (void)max;
    if (page) *page = 0;
    return 0;
}
```

```h
// Tegra X1 texture layout: formats and block-linear (GOB) swizzling.
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>

typedef struct {
    uint8_t bpb;     // bytes per block (per texel for uncompressed)
    uint8_t bw, bh;  // block dimensions in texels
    uint8_t kind;    // FMT_COLOR, FMT_DEPTH, ...
    const char *name;
} FormatInfo;

enum { FMT_COLOR = 0, FMT_DEPTH = 1, FMT_STENCIL = 2, FMT_DEPTH_STENCIL = 3, FMT_COMPRESSED = 4 };

const FormatInfo *nvn_format_info(uint32_t nvn_format);

typedef struct {
    uint32_t width, height, depth, layers, levels;  // depth: 3D depth; layers: array layers / cube faces
    const FormatInfo *fmt;
    uint32_t block_height_log2;  // GOBs per block (log2) for level 0
    uint32_t block_depth_log2;
} TexLayout;

typedef struct {
    uint64_t offset;              // from the start of the layer
    uint32_t w, h, d;             // texel dimensions
    uint32_t wb, hb;              // in blocks
    uint32_t block_height_log2, block_depth_log2;
} LevelLayout;

// Default block height for a texture (what the NVN driver picks), and the full storage layout.
uint32_t tegra_default_block_height_log2(uint32_t height_in_blocks);
void tegra_layout_init(TexLayout *t);
LevelLayout tegra_level(const TexLayout *t, uint32_t level);
uint64_t tegra_layer_size(const TexLayout *t);
uint64_t tegra_total_size(const TexLayout *t);

// Copy a block-linear level slice into a linear buffer (row pitch = wb * bpb).
void tegra_deswizzle(const uint8_t *src, uint8_t *dst, uint32_t wb, uint32_t hb, uint32_t d, uint32_t bpb,
                     uint32_t block_height_log2, uint32_t block_depth_log2);
void tegra_swizzle(const uint8_t *src, uint8_t *dst, uint32_t wb, uint32_t hb, uint32_t d, uint32_t bpb,
                   uint32_t block_height_log2, uint32_t block_depth_log2);
```
