            VkPhysicalDeviceVulkan13Features q13 = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_3_FEATURES };
            VkPhysicalDeviceVertexAttributeDivisorFeatures qdiv =
                { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VERTEX_ATTRIBUTE_DIVISOR_FEATURES };
            VkPhysicalDeviceFeatures2 q2 = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_FEATURES_2 };
            q13.pNext = &qdiv;   /* EXT 的 features 结构（sType 与 core 同值） */
            q2.pNext = &q13;
            vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures2(g_pd, &q2);
            have13 = q13.shaderDemoteToHelperInvocation;
            have_div_feat = qdiv.vertexAttributeInstanceRateDivisor ? 1 : 0;
            if (m14b_want) {   /* M14B：只查，不改链（真正挂链在下面的试建循环里，只有 EXT 真被启用才挂） */
                VkPhysicalDeviceExtendedDynamicState3FeaturesEXT qf = {
                    VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_EXTENDED_DYNAMIC_STATE_3_FEATURES_EXT };
                qdiv.pNext = &qf;
                vkGetPhysicalDeviceFeatures2(g_pd, &q2);
                qdiv.pNext = NULL;
                m14b_feat_en = qf.extendedDynamicState3ColorBlendEnable   ? 1 : 0;
                m14b_feat_eq = qf.extendedDynamicState3ColorBlendEquation ? 1 : 0;
                vk_boot_logf("[m14b] eds3 features (query only): colorBlendEnable=%d colorBlendEquation=%d",
                             m14b_feat_en, m14b_feat_eq);
            }
            /* divisor 上限只能挂在 Properties2 链上（EXT 与 core 同 layout/同 sType）。 */
            VkPhysicalDeviceVertexAttributeDivisorProperties dprops =
                { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VERTEX_ATTRIBUTE_DIVISOR_PROPERTIES };
            VkPhysicalDeviceProperties2 p2 = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_PROPERTIES_2 };
            p2.pNext = &dprops;
            vkGetPhysicalDeviceProperties2(g_pd, &p2);
            if (dprops.maxVertexAttribDivisor) maxdiv = dprops.maxVertexAttribDivisor;
        }
        memset(&f13, 0, sizeof f13);
        f13.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VULKAN_1_3_FEATURES;
        f13.shaderDemoteToHelperInvocation = have13 ? VK_TRUE : VK_FALSE;
        if (have13) dci.pNext = &f13;
        memset(&feds3, 0, sizeof feds3);
        feds3.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_EXTENDED_DYNAMIC_STATE_3_FEATURES_EXT;
        memset(&fdiv, 0, sizeof fdiv);
        fdiv.sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PHYSICAL_DEVICE_VERTEX_ATTRIBUTE_DIVISOR_FEATURES;
        g_r_div_support = 0;   /* 真正生效要等「扩展在启用表里 + 设备建成功」，见下面的试建循环 */
        g_r_div_max = maxdiv ? maxdiv : 1;
        vk_boot_logf("m3r features: shaderInt64=%d shaderDemoteToHelperInvocation=%d (api %u.%u)",
                     (int)g_features.shaderInt64, have13,
                     VK_API_VERSION_MAJOR(pp.apiVersion), VK_API_VERSION_MINOR(pp.apiVersion));
        vk_boot_logf("[r] inst feature: vertexAttributeInstanceRateDivisor=%d max_divisor=%u ext=%s "
                     "(nvn stream.divisor -> VK_VERTEX_INPUT_RATE_INSTANCE)",
                     have_div_feat, g_r_div_max,
                     "VK_EXT_vertex_attribute_divisor");
    }
    NVK("[vk] enabled features BC=%{public}u ASTC=%{public}u independentBlend=%{public}u cubeArray=%{public}u",
        g_features.textureCompressionBC, g_features.textureCompressionASTC_LDR,
        g_features.independentBlend, g_features.imageCubeArray);
    // 扩展一条条加：5 条一起开 vkCreateDevice 直接失败且驱动不点名（第 35 轮，:703-706）。
    // 每加一条试建一次，加不上就踢掉并报名；建设备只在开机做，试错免费。
    // M3c：先试 0 扩展的基线——上一版从不试基线，「扩展全挂」和「基线也挂」分不清，
    // 导致把根因误判成扩展不被支持（真因见 vk_boot 顶部的隐式层注记）。
    const char *on[8];
    uint32_t nok = 0;
    {
        dci.enabledExtensionCount = 0;
        dci.ppEnabledExtensionNames = NULL;
        VkDevice d = NULL;
        VkResult brv = vkCreateDevice(g_pd, &dci, NULL, &d);
        NVK("[vk] vkCreateDevice baseline (0 ext) -> %{public}d (%{public}s)", (int)brv, vr(brv));
        vk_boot_logf("vkCreateDevice baseline (0 ext) -> %d (%s)", (int)brv, vr(brv));
        if (brv == VK_SUCCESS) g_dev = d;
    }
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < nc; k++) {
        on[nok] = cand[k];
        dci.enabledExtensionCount = nok + 1;
        dci.ppEnabledExtensionNames = on;
        /* M4ap P1：divisor 的 feature 结构只能在「本次试建确实启用了 EXT」时挂上——
           否则驱动会因未知特性/未启用扩展拒绝 vkCreateDevice（连带把整轮设备试建拖挂）。 */
        {
            int has_div_ext = 0, has_eds3 = 0;
            for (uint32_t j = 0; j <= nok; j++) {
                if (!strcmp(on[j], "VK_EXT_vertex_attribute_divisor")) has_div_ext = 1;
                if (!strcmp(on[j], "VK_EXT_extended_dynamic_state3")) has_eds3 = 1;
            }
            if (have_div_feat && has_div_ext) {
                fdiv.vertexAttributeInstanceRateDivisor = VK_TRUE;
                fdiv.pNext = (void *)dci.pNext;   /* 链尾（f13 之后） */
                dci.pNext = &fdiv;
            }
            /* M14B：只有本次试建真的启用了 EDS3 扩展、且驱动报告这两个特性，才把特性挂上。 */
            if (m14b_want && has_eds3 && m14b_feat_en && m14b_feat_eq) {
                feds3.extendedDynamicState3ColorBlendEnable = VK_TRUE;
                feds3.extendedDynamicState3ColorBlendEquation = VK_TRUE;
                feds3.pNext = (void *)dci.pNext;
                dci.pNext = &feds3;
            }
        }
        VkDevice d = NULL;
        VkResult drv = vkCreateDevice(g_pd, &dci, NULL, &d);
        vk_boot_logf("vkCreateDevice (+%s, total %u) -> %d (%s)", cand[k], nok + 1, (int)drv, vr(drv));
        if (drv == VK_SUCCESS) {
            if (g_dev) vkDestroyDevice(g_dev, NULL);
            g_dev = d; nok++;
            if (dci.pNext == &fdiv) g_r_div_support = 1;   /* 本设备真的开了 divisor 特性 */
            if (dci.pNext == &fdiv) dci.pNext = fdiv.pNext;   /* 还原链，避免下次试建重复挂 */
            continue;
        }
        if (dci.pNext == &feds3) dci.pNext = feds3.pNext;      /* M14B：失败同样还原链 */
        if (dci.pNext == &fdiv) dci.pNext = fdiv.pNext;       /* 失败也要还原 */
        NVK("[vk] drop device extension %{public}s (device creation fails with it)", cand[k]);
    }
    /* M14B：最终设备里到底有没有 EDS3（试建全成功后 on[0..nok-1] 就是启用表）。 */
    g_m14b_eds3_ext_ok = 0;
    if (m14b_want)
        for (uint32_t j = 0; j < nok; j++)
            if (!strcmp(on[j], "VK_EXT_extended_dynamic_state3")) { g_m14b_eds3_ext_ok = 1; break; }
    if (m14b_want)
        vk_boot_logf("[m14b] eds3 ext on final device=%d (kept %u/%u; feat en=%d eq=%d)",
                     g_m14b_eds3_ext_ok, nok, nc, m14b_feat_en, m14b_feat_eq);
    vk_boot_logf("device extensions kept: %u/%u; inst divisor support=%d max_divisor=%u",
                 nok, nc, g_r_div_support, g_r_div_max);
    if (!g_dev) { NVK_RED("vkCreateDevice failed (first candidate %{public}s)", nc ? cand[0] : "none"); vk_boot_logf("FAIL: vkCreateDevice (baseline + %u candidates) all failed", nc); return 0; }
      /* M6f: config no longer needed once the device exists */
    vk_boot_logf("vkCreateDevice -> 0 (device ready), g_qf=%u", g_qf);
    vkGetDeviceQueue(g_dev, g_qf, 0, &g_q);

    VkCommandPoolCreateInfo cpi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_INFO };
    cpi.flags = VK_COMMAND_POOL_CREATE_RESET_COMMAND_BUFFER_BIT;
    cpi.queueFamilyIndex = g_qf;
    GK("vkCreateCommandPool", vkCreateCommandPool(g_dev, &cpi, NULL, &g_cp));

    VkFenceCreateInfo fci = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FENCE_CREATE_INFO };
    GK("vkCreateFence", vkCreateFence(g_dev, &fci, NULL, &g_pfence));
    GK("vkCreateFence(upload)", vkCreateFence(g_dev, &fci, NULL, &g_ufence));
    g_mem_dev_local = mem_type(VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT, 0);
    g_mem_host_visible = mem_type(VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT, 0);
    NVK("[vk] memory types: deviceLocal=%{public}u hostVisibleCoherent=%{public}u surface %{public}u x %{public}u",
        g_mem_dev_local, g_mem_host_visible, g_win_w, g_win_h);
    vk_boot_logf("vk_boot SUCCESS: dev=%p queue=%p g_qf=%u memDevLocal=%u memHostVisible=%u surface=%s",
                 (void *)g_dev, (void *)g_q, g_qf, g_mem_dev_local, g_mem_host_visible,
                 surf_ok ? (have_ohos ? "ohos" : "headless") : "none");
    return 1;
}

// ---------------- 交换链 | swapchain（出处 :738-890；离屏对照图 g_off_img 系诊断设施未移植） ----------------
static void swapchain_destroy(void)
{
    if (!g_sc) return;
    /* M40AL：交换链销毁前的全设备排空也计入同一对计数器（只加计时，不改控制流）。 */
    { struct timespec t0, t1; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t0);
      vkQueueWaitIdle(g_q);
      clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t1);
      m40al_wait_add(t0, t1); }
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_sc_n; i++) {
        if (g_sc_fb[i]) { vkDestroyFramebuffer(g_dev, g_sc_fb[i], NULL); g_sc_fb[i] = NULL; }
        if (g_sc_view[i]) { vkDestroyImageView(g_dev, g_sc_view[i], NULL); g_sc_view[i] = NULL; }
        if (g_acq_sem[i]) { vkDestroySemaphore(g_dev, g_acq_sem[i], NULL); g_acq_sem[i] = NULL; }
        g_sc_img[i] = NULL;
    }
    if (g_sc_rp) { vkDestroyRenderPass(g_dev, g_sc_rp, NULL); g_sc_rp = NULL; }
    vkDestroySwapchainKHR(g_dev, g_sc, NULL);
    g_sc = NULL;
    g_sc_n = 0;
    g_sc_ready = 0;
}

static int swapchain_build(void)
{
    if (!g_surf) return 0;
    VkSurfaceCapabilitiesKHR cap;
    if (vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceCapabilitiesKHR(g_pd, g_surf, &cap) != VK_SUCCESS) { NVK_RED("no surface capabilities"); return 0; }
    uint32_t nf = 0;
    if (vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceFormatsKHR(g_pd, g_surf, &nf, NULL) != VK_SUCCESS || !nf) return 0;
    VkSurfaceFormatKHR fm[16];
    if (nf > 16) nf = 16;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceFormatsKHR(g_pd, g_surf, &nf, fm);
    // 面板实测：compositeAlpha 只认 INHERIT；格式优先 BGRA8/R8G8B8A8 族（:769-777）
    NVK("[vk] surface caps %{public}u x %{public}u supportedTransforms=0x%{public}x currentTransform=0x%{public}x",
        cap.currentExtent.width, cap.currentExtent.height,
        (unsigned)cap.supportedTransforms, (unsigned)cap.currentTransform);
    g_sc_fmt = fm[0].format;
    int pick = -1;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nf; i++)
        if (fm[i].format == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM || fm[i].format == VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM) { pick = (int)i; break; }
    if (pick >= 0) g_sc_fmt = fm[pick].format;
    VkExtent2D ext = cap.currentExtent;
    if (ext.width == 0xFFFFFFFFu) { ext.width = g_win_w; ext.height = g_win_h; }
    uint32_t n = cap.minImageCount + 1;
    if (cap.maxImageCount && n > cap.maxImageCount) n = cap.maxImageCount;
    if (n > 8) n = 8;
    VkSwapchainCreateInfoKHR sci = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SWAPCHAIN_CREATE_INFO_KHR };
    sci.surface = g_surf;
    sci.minImageCount = n;
    sci.imageFormat = g_sc_fmt;
    sci.imageColorSpace = fm[pick >= 0 ? pick : 0].colorSpace;
    sci.imageExtent = ext;
    sci.imageArrayLayers = 1;
    // 只给 COLOR_ATTACHMENT：加 TRANSFER_DST 也不让写（第 47 轮：对交换链图 transfer = 打掉设备，:790）
    sci.imageUsage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_BIT;
    sci.imageSharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE;
    // preTransform：声明转而内容不转 = 合成器把这一层真转 90°（第 110 轮）；驱动给 IDENTITY 就声明 IDENTITY（:793-807）
    sci.preTransform = cap.currentTransform;
    if (cap.currentTransform != VK_SURFACE_TRANSFORM_IDENTITY_BIT_KHR &&
        (cap.supportedTransforms & VK_SURFACE_TRANSFORM_IDENTITY_BIT_KHR)) {
        sci.preTransform = VK_SURFACE_TRANSFORM_IDENTITY_BIT_KHR;
        NVK("[vk] swapchain preTransform=IDENTITY (panel currentTransform=%{public}d)", (int)cap.currentTransform);
    }
    sci.compositeAlpha = VK_COMPOSITE_ALPHA_INHERIT_BIT_KHR;
    sci.presentMode = VK_PRESENT_MODE_FIFO_KHR;
    sci.clipped = VK_TRUE;
    if (vkCreateSwapchainKHR(g_dev, &sci, NULL, &g_sc) != VK_SUCCESS) { NVK_RED("vkCreateSwapchainKHR failed"); return 0; }
    vkGetSwapchainImagesKHR(g_dev, g_sc, &g_sc_n, NULL);
    if (g_sc_n > 8) g_sc_n = 8;
    vkGetSwapchainImagesKHR(g_dev, g_sc, &g_sc_n, g_sc_img);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_sc_n; i++) {
        VkImageViewCreateInfo iv = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO };
        iv.image = g_sc_img[i];
        iv.viewType = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D;
        iv.format = g_sc_fmt;
        iv.subresourceRange = (VkImageSubresourceRange){ VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1 };
        GK("vkCreateImageView(swap)", vkCreateImageView(g_dev, &iv, NULL, &g_sc_view[i]));
        VkSemaphoreCreateInfo s = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_CREATE_INFO };
        GK("vkCreateSemaphore", vkCreateSemaphore(g_dev, &s, NULL, &g_acq_sem[i]));
    }
    // 出图通道：经典 render pass + 每张一个 framebuffer（M2-0 冒烟实测唯一绿的写法，:825-857）
    {
        VkAttachmentDescription a = {0};
        a.format = g_sc_fmt;
        a.samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
        a.loadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_CLEAR;
        a.storeOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_STORE;
        a.stencilLoadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_DONT_CARE;
        a.stencilStoreOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_DONT_CARE;
        a.initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
        a.finalLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_PRESENT_SRC_KHR;
        VkAttachmentReference ar = { 0, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL };
        VkSubpassDescription sp = {0};
        sp.pipelineBindPoint = VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS;
        sp.colorAttachmentCount = 1;
        sp.pColorAttachments = &ar;
        VkSubpassDependency dep = { VK_SUBPASS_EXTERNAL, 0,
            VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT | VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT,
            VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT | VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT,
            0, 0, VK_DEPENDENCY_BY_REGION_BIT };
        VkRenderPassCreateInfo rpc = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDER_PASS_CREATE_INFO };
        rpc.attachmentCount = 1; rpc.pAttachments = &a;
        rpc.subpassCount = 1; rpc.pSubpasses = &sp;
        rpc.dependencyCount = 1; rpc.pDependencies = &dep;
        GK("vkCreateRenderPass(swap)", vkCreateRenderPass(g_dev, &rpc, NULL, &g_sc_rp));
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_sc_n; i++) {
            VkFramebufferCreateInfo fbi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FRAMEBUFFER_CREATE_INFO };
            fbi.renderPass = g_sc_rp;
            fbi.attachmentCount = 1; fbi.pAttachments = &g_sc_view[i];
            fbi.width = ext.width; fbi.height = ext.height; fbi.layers = 1;
            GK("vkCreateFramebuffer(swap)", vkCreateFramebuffer(g_dev, &fbi, NULL, &g_sc_fb[i]));
        }
    }
    if (!g_vis_sem) { VkSemaphoreCreateInfo s = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SEMAPHORE_CREATE_INFO };
        GK("vkCreateSemaphore(vis)", vkCreateSemaphore(g_dev, &s, NULL, &g_vis_sem)); }
    g_sc_ext = ext;
    g_sc_ready = 1;
    NVK("[vk] swapchain %{public}u images %{public}u x %{public}u fmt=%{public}d", g_sc_n, ext.width, ext.height, (int)g_sc_fmt);
    return 1;
}

// ---------------- 压缩格式能力探测（出处 probe_bc :3049-3071） ----------------
// 马良是移动 GPU，很可能只有 ASTC 没有 BC；收不收只能问它自己。
// 饥荒专用的 DM_TEX_ASTC 素材烘焙 / DM_RT_ASTC 设备转码两路未移植（SMO 素材链不同，第三批再议）。
static void probe_bc(void)
{
    static const struct { uint32_t bit; VkFormat f; const char *n; } t[] = {
        { 1, VK_FORMAT_BC1_RGB_UNORM_BLOCK, "BC1" }, { 2, VK_FORMAT_BC1_RGBA_UNORM_BLOCK, "BC1A" },
        { 4, VK_FORMAT_BC2_UNORM_BLOCK, "BC2" }, { 8, VK_FORMAT_BC3_UNORM_BLOCK, "BC3" },
        { 16, VK_FORMAT_BC4_UNORM_BLOCK, "BC4" }, { 32, VK_FORMAT_BC5_UNORM_BLOCK, "BC5" },
        { 64, VK_FORMAT_BC6H_UFLOAT_BLOCK, "BC6H" }, { 128, VK_FORMAT_BC7_UNORM_BLOCK, "BC7" },
        { 256, VK_FORMAT_ASTC_4x4_UNORM_BLOCK, "ASTC4" } };
    memset(g_compressed, 0, sizeof g_compressed);
    for (int f = VK_FORMAT_BC1_RGB_UNORM_BLOCK; f <= VK_FORMAT_ASTC_12x12_SRGB_BLOCK; f++) {
        VkFormatProperties fp;
        vkGetPhysicalDeviceFormatProperties(g_pd, (VkFormat)f, &fp);
        g_compressed[f] = nvn_vk_compressed_supported((VkFormat)f, fp.optimalTilingFeatures, &g_features);
    }
    uint32_t got = 0;
    char line[128]; int q = snprintf(line, sizeof line, "[vk] compressed:");
    for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
        int ok = g_compressed[t[i].f];
        if (ok) got |= t[i].bit;
        if (q < (int)sizeof line - 12) q += snprintf(line + q, sizeof line - q, " %s%d", t[i].n, ok);
    }
    g_bcap = got;
    NVK("%{public}s", line);
}

// ---------------- NVNformat → VkFormat（出处 fmt_of :541-605；NVN_FORMAT_* 数值见
// infra/dontstarve-harmony/dm/gfx/nvn/include/nvn.h:397-496，本工程不引该头故写数值+名注） ----------------
static VkFormat fmt_of(int f, int *depth)
{
    if (depth) *depth = 0;
    VkFormat compressed = nvn_vk_compressed_format(f);
    if (compressed) {
        // 设备认收就按压缩建；不认走未压缩回退（像素要 CPU 软解，第三批接 nvn_bcdec，:544-549）
        return g_compressed[compressed] ? compressed : nvn_vk_bc_fallback(f);
    }
    switch (f) {
    // R / RG 族（:551-576）
    case 0x01: return VK_FORMAT_R8_UNORM;            // NVN_FORMAT_R8
    case 0x02: return VK_FORMAT_R8_SNORM;            // R8SN
    case 0x03: return VK_FORMAT_R8_UINT;             // R8UI
    case 0x04: return VK_FORMAT_R8_SINT;             // R8I
    case 0x05: return VK_FORMAT_R16_SFLOAT;          // R16F
    case 0x06: return VK_FORMAT_R16_UNORM;           // R16
    case 0x07: return VK_FORMAT_R16_SNORM;           // R16SN
    case 0x08: return VK_FORMAT_R16_UINT;            // R16UI
    case 0x09: return VK_FORMAT_R16_SINT;            // R16I
    case 0x0A: return VK_FORMAT_R32_SFLOAT;          // R32F
    case 0x0B: return VK_FORMAT_R32_UINT;            // R32UI
    case 0x0C: return VK_FORMAT_R32_SINT;            // R32I
    case 0x0D: return VK_FORMAT_R8G8_UNORM;          // RG8
    case 0x0E: return VK_FORMAT_R8G8_SNORM;          // RG8SN
    case 0x0F: return VK_FORMAT_R8G8_UINT;           // RG8UI
    case 0x10: return VK_FORMAT_R8G8_SINT;           // RG8I
    case 0x11: return VK_FORMAT_R16G16_SFLOAT;       // RG16F
    case 0x12: return VK_FORMAT_R16G16_UNORM;        // RG16
    case 0x13: return VK_FORMAT_R16G16_SNORM;        // RG16SN
    case 0x14: return VK_FORMAT_R16G16_UINT;         // RG16UI
    case 0x15: return VK_FORMAT_R16G16_SINT;         // RG16I
    case 0x16: return VK_FORMAT_R32G32_SFLOAT;       // RG32F
    case 0x17: return VK_FORMAT_R32G32_UINT;         // RG32UI
    case 0x18: return VK_FORMAT_R32G32_SINT;         // RG32I
    case 0x19: return VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8_UNORM;        // RGB8
    case 0x3F: return VK_FORMAT_B10G11R11_UFLOAT_PACK32;   // R11G11B10F
    case 0x40: return VK_FORMAT_E5B9G9R9_UFLOAT_PACK32;    // RGB9E5F
    case 0x25: return VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;      // RGBA8
    case 0x26: return VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SNORM;      // RGBA8SN
    case 0x27: return VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UINT;       // RGBA8UI
    case 0x28: return VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SINT;       // RGBA8I
    case 0x29: return VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT; // RGBA16F
    case 0x2E: return VK_FORMAT_R32G32B32A32_SFLOAT; // RGBA32F
    case 0x37: return VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB;       // RGBX8_SRGB
    case 0x38: return VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB;       // RGBA8_SRGB
    /* M4aa P3：0x39-0x3B 三个 16bpp 打包色原先整段缺失（fmt_of 返 UNDEFINED ⇒ tex_create 直接失败）。
       先补最确定的 RGBA4；RGB5/RGB5A1 的通道位序未经样本验证，列在报告里、本轮不猜。 */
    case 0x39: return VK_FORMAT_R4G4B4A4_UNORM_PACK16;     // RGBA4（16bpp 4:4:4:4，位序未验证）
    case 0x3C: return VK_FORMAT_R5G6B5_UNORM_PACK16; // RGB565
    case 0x3D: return VK_FORMAT_A2B10G10R10_UNORM_PACK32;  // RGB10A2
    case 0x3E: return VK_FORMAT_A2B10G10R10_UNORM_PACK32;  // RGB10A2UI
    case 0x6D: return VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;      // RGBX8
    case 0x95: return VK_FORMAT_B5G6R5_UNORM_PACK16; // BGR565
    case 0x99: return VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM;      // BGRX8
    case 0x9A: return VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM;      // BGRA8
    case 0x9B: return VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB;       // BGRA8_SRGB
    case 0x9C: return VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB;       // BGRA8_SRGB（RGBX 变体）
    // 深度族（:597-602）：STENCIL8 与深度共用存储，按 D24S8 挂
    case 0x31: if (depth) *depth = 1; return VK_FORMAT_D24_UNORM_S8_UINT;   // STENCIL8
    case 0x32: if (depth) *depth = 1; return VK_FORMAT_D16_UNORM;           // DEPTH16
    case 0x33: if (depth) *depth = 1; return VK_FORMAT_X8_D24_UNORM_PACK32; // DEPTH24
    case 0x34: if (depth) *depth = 1; return VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT;          // DEPTH32F
    case 0x35: if (depth) *depth = 1; return VK_FORMAT_D24_UNORM_S8_UINT;   // DEPTH24_STENCIL8
    case 0x36: if (depth) *depth = 1; return VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT_S8_UINT;  // DEPTH32F_STENCIL8
    default: return VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED;
    }
}

// ---------------- staging（第一批：一块按需长大的 host-visible 缓冲；arena/暂存环第二批） ----------------
/* M4k P0-2：宿主侧阻塞计数（只在超时那一刻 +1，正常路径零开销）。0 提升没有卡在宿主侧。 */
static unsigned long long g_r_stall_upload;
static unsigned long long g_r_stall_destroy;
static int stage_grow(VkDeviceSize need)
{
    if (g_stage && g_stage_sz >= need) return 1;
    if (g_stage) {
        vkDestroyBuffer(g_dev, g_stage, NULL);
        vkFreeMemory(g_dev, g_stage_mem, NULL);
        g_stage = NULL; g_stage_mem = NULL; g_stage_map = NULL; g_stage_sz = 0;
    }
    VkDeviceSize sz = (need + 0xFFFF) & ~(VkDeviceSize)0xFFFF;   // 64KB 档位长大
    VkBufferCreateInfo bi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO };
    bi.size = sz;
    bi.usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT;
    bi.sharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE;
    atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_beat_buf, 1, memory_order_relaxed);   /* M3g 探针 #4b：vkCreateBuffer 调用 */
    if (vkCreateBuffer(g_dev, &bi, NULL, &g_stage) != VK_SUCCESS) { NVK_RED("vkCreateBuffer(staging %llu) failed", (unsigned long long)sz); return 0; }
    VkMemoryRequirements rq;
    vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(g_dev, g_stage, &rq);
    int ti = find_type(rq, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT);
    if (ti < 0) { vkDestroyBuffer(g_dev, g_stage, NULL); g_stage = NULL; NVK_RED("no host-visible memory type for staging"); return 0; }
    VkMemoryAllocateInfo ai = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO };
    ai.allocationSize = rq.size;
    ai.memoryTypeIndex = (uint32_t)ti;
    if (vkAllocateMemory(g_dev, &ai, NULL, &g_stage_mem) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        vkDestroyBuffer(g_dev, g_stage, NULL); g_stage = NULL;
        NVK_RED("vkAllocateMemory(staging %llu) failed", (unsigned long long)rq.size);
        return 0;
    }
    vkBindBufferMemory(g_dev, g_stage, g_stage_mem, 0);
    if (vkMapMemory(g_dev, g_stage_mem, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE, 0, (void **)&g_stage_map) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        vkDestroyBuffer(g_dev, g_stage, NULL); vkFreeMemory(g_dev, g_stage_mem, NULL);
        g_stage = NULL; g_stage_mem = NULL; g_stage_map = NULL;
        NVK_RED("vkMapMemory(staging) failed");
        return 0;
    }
    g_stage_sz = sz;
    return 1;
}

/* NVN 允许 32 个纹理槽；descriptor binding = 32+slot（32+31=63，不撞 17/18/19）。
   M4ac P1：定义前移到纹理层（R_Key 与 nvn_vk_tex 都要用）。 */
#define NVN_TX_SLOTS 32
/* M4ac P1：采样维度（SPIR-V OpTypeImage 的 Dim + Arrayed）→ 绑定期该给哪种视图。
   slot_dim[] 存这套编码；R_DIM_NONE = 未反射 / 该槽不是采样器（保持旧行为）。 */
enum { R_DIM_NONE = 0, R_DIM_1D = 1, R_DIM_2D = 2, R_DIM_3D = 3, R_DIM_CUBE = 4,
       R_DIM_2D_ARRAY = 5, R_DIM_CUBE_ARRAY = 6 };

// ---------------- 纹理 | textures ----------------
struct nvn_vk_tex {
    nvn_texdesc d;                 // 建图时的描述符（身份：池+偏移认图是第二批的回收站语义）
    VkImage img;
    VkImageView view;
    VkDeviceMemory mem;
    VkFormat fmt;                  // 实际 Vk 格式（可能已是回退后的未压缩格式）
    VkImageAspectFlags aspect;
    uint32_t w, h, layers, levels;
    int is_depth;
    int soft_bc;                   // 1 = NVN 是 BC、设备不认 → 按未压缩建，字节须先解码（第三批接 bcdec）
    VkImageLayout layout;
    uint64_t vk_bytes;
    /* M4ac P2：同一张图的「另一种类型」视图（懒建 + 缓存，槽的采样维度与之不符时才建）。
       view_cube = target==4 的 6 层方形图（建图时带 CUBE_COMPATIBLE）的 CUBE 视图；
       view_arr  = target==8/9 立方体图的 2D_ARRAY 视图；
       view_2d   = 多层图第 0 层的 2D 视图。三个 *_tried 保证失败也只试一次。 */
    VkImageView view_cube, view_arr, view_2d;
    unsigned char view_cube_tried, view_arr_tried, view_2d_tried;
    VkImageViewType view_kind;     /* 默认视图的类型（nvn_vk_image_shape 的产物，M4ac P2 决策用） */
    /* M4bm P1（只读）：这张被采样图是否被深度 route②（r_depth_tex_copy）成功抄过。
       判据：`[k] magsrc` 里的 cp=0 说明「洋红 quad 采到的这张对象从没拿到过深度内容」——
       它是池字节 0 上传的独立图，深度常量只是表象。 */
    int dcp_ok;
};

// soft_bc 回退格式的每像素字节（Vk 格式 → 字节）。只覆盖 nvn_vk_bc_fallback 会给的那几种。
/* M4t P2：`[fs] slot=0 id=282 … bpp=0 sig=na` 的根因就在这个 switch：0x3d（RGB10A2）映射到
   VK_FORMAT_A2B10G10R10_UNORM_PACK32，而旧表只认 R8/R8G8/RGBA8/RGBA16F ⇒ 返回 0，签名路径直接
   判「不可采样」。补上 32bpp 打包色格式（仍只用于「有没有内容」的 16×16 签名取样，不参与建图）；
   深度格式**有意不加**：r_tex_signature 走 COLOR aspect 的 copy，对纯深度图是非法用法。 */
static uint32_t vkfmt_bpp_guess(VkFormat f)
{
    switch (f) {
    case VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM: case VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_SRGB: return 4;
    case VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM: case VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB: return 4;
    case VK_FORMAT_A2B10G10R10_UNORM_PACK32: return 4;
    /* M4aa P3：0x3f(R11G11B10F) 建图一直是对的，缺的只是**签名取样的 bpp 表** ⇒ `[fs] … bpp=0 sig=na`。
       补上 32bpp 打包浮点族；0x39(RGBA4) 是本轮新增映射，bpp=2。 */
    case VK_FORMAT_B10G11R11_UFLOAT_PACK32: return 4;
    case VK_FORMAT_E5B9G9R9_UFLOAT_PACK32: return 4;
    case VK_FORMAT_R8_UNORM: case VK_FORMAT_R8_SNORM: return 1;
    case VK_FORMAT_R8G8_UNORM: case VK_FORMAT_R8G8_SNORM: return 2;
    case VK_FORMAT_R16_UNORM: return 2;
    case VK_FORMAT_R16G16_UNORM: return 4;
    case VK_FORMAT_R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT: return 8;
    case VK_FORMAT_R5G6B5_UNORM_PACK16: case VK_FORMAT_B5G6R5_UNORM_PACK16: return 2;
    case VK_FORMAT_R4G4B4A4_UNORM_PACK16: return 2;
    default: return 0;
    }
}

/* ---- M4ac P1/P2 取证计数（与 r_ds_tex_sync 的选择路径同口径；日志一律限流） ---- */
static unsigned long long g_t_dim_keys;          /* 已反射出槽维度的 key 数 */
static unsigned long long g_t_dim_slots_cube, g_t_dim_slots_arr, g_t_dim_slots_2d, g_t_dim_slots_other;
static unsigned long long g_t_view_sel;          /* 视图选择总次数（限流用） */
static unsigned long long g_t_view_sel_cube, g_t_view_sel_arr, g_t_view_sel_2d;
static unsigned long long g_t_view_nodim;        /* 拿不到槽类型 ⇒ 旧行为 */
static unsigned long long g_t_view_raw;          /* 槽是裸 view（RT 影子等），没有 tex 对象 */
static unsigned long long g_t_view_noview;       /* 该维度视图建不出来 ⇒ 回落 */
static unsigned long long g_t_view_fallback;     /* 回落总次数（raw+noview） */
static unsigned long long g_t_cubefail_img;      /* 建图带 CUBE_COMPATIBLE 失败、退回不带 flag */
static unsigned long long g_t_cubefail_view;     /* 备用视图 vkCreateImageView 失败 */

/* M5s P2（归因）：纹理真 VkImage 的活体字节数。create 加、destroy 减，供 [mem] 探针对照 RSS。 */
static unsigned long long g_tex_live_n, g_tex_live_bytes;
/* M5y P2：纹理上传质量（块线性路径每条 level0/layer0 上传记一次）。
   zero_first4k = 解排布后前 4 KiB 全零（= 采样到全零 albedo，白/黑模型的直接嫌疑）；
   rd0 = 客体源地址现场 4 字节读失败（映射问题，与「客体里本来就是零」分开）。 */
static unsigned long long g_tu_total, g_tu_zero, g_tu_rd0;
/* M5z P0：哪些 id 的上送内容「首 4 KiB 全零」（位图，65536 个 id = 8 KiB）。
   draw 侧靠它把「绑了真图但内容为零」单列一类——那不是白占位，修法不同。 */
static unsigned char g_tu_zero_bit[65536 / 8];
static unsigned g_tu_zero_ids;
static int r_tu_is_zero_id(int id)
{
    if (id < 0 || id >= 65536) return 0;
    return (g_tu_zero_bit[id >> 3] >> (id & 7)) & 1;
}
/* M6a A：gfx_bridge 绑定期要先知道「这张 id 上送过且内容全零」才启用 ext/fmt 唯一候选。 */
int nvn_vk_tex_zero_id(int id) { return r_tu_is_zero_id(id); }

/* ================= M40P (2026-11-10)：建图洪流归因（5 点分桶 + 同 id 重复率） ==================
   背景：M40N 证吞吐墙 = 每帧重上传（img/frame 8.1–8.7）；M40O 证 cap_idimg 是事后标签、容量线关闭，
   但同轮观测到建图 15.4 张/s、img/frame 92.6。本轮**只做归因**，不改任何判决/容量：
     5 个 vkCreateImage 点各一个计数器 —— site1=tex_create(nvn_vk.c:1187) site2=h_rt_ensure 的槽新建
     site3=h_off_ensure site4=rcom(1x1 占位) site5=d_dbg_ensure；另计 vkDestroyImage（dst）。
   site1 每次成功建图后由 gfx_bridge 按 tex id 回填次数（≤4096 项，线性探测）⇒ 同 id 重复率 top5。
   开关 smo_m40p（文件 2 s 重读，缺省 0 ⇒ 关态零输出、零副作用；构造期按 m40o 同款建 0666 松手文件）。
   预算：[m40p] ≤300 行：60 s 一行分桶 + 每窗口 top5 + RT key 限流 5 行/窗口。 */
#define M40P_SW_A "/data/storage/el2/base/files/smo_m40p"
#define M40P_SW_B "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files/smo_m40p"
#define M40P_REP_N 4096
typedef struct { int id; unsigned n, w, h, fmt; long last; } m40p_rep;
static m40p_rep g_m40p_rep[M40P_REP_N];
static unsigned long long g_m40p_cr[6];   /* 1=tex 2=h_rt 3=h_off 4=rcom 5=ddbg（累计） */
static unsigned long long g_m40p_dst;     /* vkDestroyImage 累计 */
static int g_m40p_rtlines;                /* 本窗口已打的 RT key 行数（限流） */
static long g_m40p_t0;                    /* 首次开启时刻（t 轴对齐用） */

static int m40p_on(void)
{
 static int cached=-1; static long last;
 long now=(long)time(NULL);
 if(cached>=0&&now<last+2)return cached;
 last=now;cached=0;
 {const char *paths[2]={M40P_SW_A,M40P_SW_B};
  for(int i=0;i<2;i++){FILE *f=fopen(paths[i],"r");
   if(f){char b[16];size_t n=fread(b,1,sizeof b-1,f);fclose(f);if(n>0){b[n]=0;cached=atoi(b);}break;}}}
 return cached;
}
__attribute__((constructor)) static void m40p_seed(void)
{
 static const char *const p[2]={M40P_SW_A,M40P_SW_B};
 for(int i=0;i<2;i++){
  if(access(p[i],F_OK)==0){chmod(p[i],0666);continue;}
  int fd=open(p[i],O_CREAT|O_WRONLY|O_TRUNC,0666);
  if(fd>=0){ssize_t w=write(fd,"0\n",2);(void)w;close(fd);chmod(p[i],0666);}
 }}
static unsigned m40p_tsec(void)
{
 long now=(long)time(NULL);
 if(!g_m40p_t0) g_m40p_t0=now;
 return (unsigned)(now-g_m40p_t0);
}
/* 分桶打点：只读计数，不改判决。RT 点（2/4）额外打 key 行，每窗口 ≤5 行。 */
static void m40p_hit(int site, unsigned long long key, unsigned w, unsigned h, int fmt)
{
 if (site < 1 || site > 5) return;
 if (!m40p_on()) return;
 g_m40p_cr[site]++;
 if ((site == 2 || site == 4) && g_m40p_rtlines < 5) {
  g_m40p_rtlines++;
  vk_boot_logf("[m40p] rt site=%s key=%#llx w=%u h=%u fmt=%d t=%us",
               site == 2 ? "h_rt" : "rcom", key, w, h, fmt, m40p_tsec());
 }
}
/* tex 建图按 id 记次数（gfx_bridge 建图成功后回填）；给「同一 id 是否被反复重建」定量。 */
void nvn_vk_m40p_idrep(int id, unsigned w, unsigned h, unsigned fmt)
{
 if (id < 0) return;
 if (!m40p_on()) return;
 int i = (int)(((unsigned)id * 2654435761u) % M40P_REP_N);
 for (int k = 0; k < 64; k++) {
  m40p_rep *e = &g_m40p_rep[(i + k) % M40P_REP_N];
  if (e->n == 0) { e->id = id; e->n = 1; e->w = w; e->h = h; e->fmt = fmt; e->last = (long)time(NULL); return; }
  if (e->id == id) { e->n++; e->w = w; e->h = h; e->fmt = fmt; e->last = (long)time(NULL); return; }
 }
}
/* 每 60 s 一行（由 vk_boot.c 心跳线程驱动 ⇒ 渲染线程卡死时照打，可对齐 WALL）。 */
void nvn_vk_m40p_stat(void)
{
 static long last; static unsigned long long cr[6], dst, fprev; static int walled;
 if (!m40p_on()) return;
 long now = (long)time(NULL);
 if (!g_m40p_t0) g_m40p_t0 = now;
 if (last && now - last < 60) return;
 last = now;
 unsigned t = (unsigned)(now - g_m40p_t0);
 unsigned long long crn[6], dstn = g_m40p_dst, dcr = 0;
 for (int i = 1; i <= 5; i++) crn[i] = g_m40p_cr[i];
 for (int i = 1; i <= 5; i++) dcr += crn[i] - cr[i];
 unsigned long long fnow = atomic_load_explicit(&g_beat_frames, memory_order_relaxed);
 unsigned long long df = fnow - fprev;
 vk_boot_logf("[m40p] cr t=%us tex=%llu h_rt=%llu h_off=%llu rcom=%llu ddbg=%llu | dst=%llu frames=%llu imgpf=%.2f",
              t, crn[1]-cr[1], crn[2]-cr[2], crn[3]-cr[3], crn[4]-cr[4], crn[5]-cr[5],
              dstn-dst, df, df ? (double)dcr/(double)df : -1.0);
 {   /* 同 id 重复 top5 */
  int top[5]={-1,-1,-1,-1,-1}; unsigned tn[5]={0,0,0,0,0};
  for (int i=0;i<M40P_REP_N;i++){
   unsigned n=g_m40p_rep[i].n; if(!n) continue;
   for (int j=0;j<5;j++) if (n>tn[j]) {
    for (int k=4;k>j;k--){tn[k]=tn[k-1];top[k]=top[k-1];}
    tn[j]=n;top[j]=i;break; }
  }
  for (int j=0;j<5;j++){
   if(top[j]<0) break;
   m40p_rep *e=&g_m40p_rep[top[j]];
   vk_boot_logf("[m40p] rep id=%d n=%u ext=%ux%u fmt=%#x last_t=%us", e->id, e->n, e->w, e->h,
                e->fmt, (unsigned)((e->last>g_m40p_t0)?(e->last-g_m40p_t0):0));
  }
 }
 if (!walled && df < 120ull) {   /* 首次 Δframes/60s < 2 ⇒ WALL（之后 120 s 单独对齐） */
  walled = 1;
  vk_boot_logf("[m40p] WALL t=%us frames=%llu imgpf=%.2f tex=%llu h_rt=%llu h_off=%llu rcom=%llu ddbg=%llu",
               t, df, df ? (double)dcr/(double)df : -1.0,
               crn[1]-cr[1], crn[2]-cr[2], crn[3]-cr[3], crn[4]-cr[4], crn[5]-cr[5]);
 }
 g_m40p_rtlines = 0;
 for (int i = 1; i <= 5; i++) cr[i] = crn[i];
 dst = dstn; fprev = fnow;
}

/* M40AJ：建图计时薄包装（原函数体改名 _impl，签名/返回值/可见性一律不变；多 return 路径原样保留）。 */
static nvn_vk_tex *nvn_vk_tex_create_impl(const nvn_texdesc *d)
{    if (!d || !g_on || !g_dev) return NULL;
    int depth = 0;
    VkFormat f = fmt_of(d->format, &depth);
    if (f == VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED) { NVK_RED("tex_create: unmapped NVN format %{public}#x", d->format); return NULL; }
    // 采样支持不蕴含可渲染；用法位按实测能力取舍（nvn_vulkan.c:1175-1230 同口径）
    VkFormatProperties fp;
    vkGetPhysicalDeviceFormatProperties(g_pd, f, &fp);
    VkImageUsageFlags usage = nvn_vk_image_usage(fp.optimalTilingFeatures, depth);
    if (!usage) { NVK_RED("tex_create: format %{public}d lacks sampled|transfer features", (int)f); return NULL; }

    VkImageCreateInfo ii = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO };
    VkImageViewType vt;
    if (!nvn_vk_image_shape(d->target, d->width, d->height, d->depth, &ii, &vt)) {
        NVK_RED("tex_create: unsupported target %{public}d", d->target);
        return NULL;
    }
    ii.format = f;
    ii.mipLevels = d->levels ? d->levels : 1;
    ii.samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
    ii.tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL;
    ii.usage = usage;
    ii.initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
    nvn_vk_tex *t = calloc(1, sizeof *t);
    if (!t) return NULL;
    t->d = *d;
    atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_beat_img, 1, memory_order_relaxed);   /* M3g 探针 #4a：vkCreateImage 调用 */
    m40p_hit(1, 0, d->width, d->height, (int)f);   /* M40P：tex 桶 */
    VkResult civ = vkCreateImage(g_dev, &ii, NULL, &t->img);
    if (civ != VK_SUCCESS && (ii.flags & VK_IMAGE_CREATE_CUBE_COMPATIBLE_BIT)) {
        /* M4ac P2 退路（派活单要求把错误码打出来，不许静默退 2D_ARRAY）：
           驱动不认 CUBE_COMPATIBLE 时去掉 flag 重建；该图之后只能给 2D_ARRAY 视图，
           槽类型=Cube 的绑定会走 fallback 并计入 cubefail。 */
        g_t_cubefail_img++;
        vk_boot_logf("[t-red] cube-compatible image create failed fmt=%#x %ux%u lay=%u rv=%d (%s) -> retry without flag",
                     (unsigned)d->format, d->width, d->height, ii.arrayLayers, (int)civ, vr(civ));
        ii.flags &= ~VK_IMAGE_CREATE_CUBE_COMPATIBLE_BIT;
        civ = vkCreateImage(g_dev, &ii, NULL, &t->img);
    }
    if (civ != VK_SUCCESS) { NVK_RED("vkCreateImage failed"); free(t); return NULL; }
    VkMemoryRequirements rq;
    vkGetImageMemoryRequirements(g_dev, t->img, &rq);
    int ti = find_type(rq, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT);
    VkMemoryAllocateInfo ai = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO };
    ai.allocationSize = rq.size;
    ai.memoryTypeIndex = ti >= 0 ? (uint32_t)ti : 0;
    if (vkAllocateMemory(g_dev, &ai, NULL, &t->mem) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        NVK_RED("vkAllocateMemory(%{public}llu) failed", (unsigned long long)rq.size);
        vkDestroyImage(g_dev, t->img, NULL); free(t); return NULL;
    }
    vkBindImageMemory(g_dev, t->img, t->mem, 0);
    t->fmt = f;
    t->aspect = nvn_vk_aspect(f);
    t->w = d->width ? d->width : 1;
    t->h = d->height ? d->height : 1;
    t->levels = ii.mipLevels;
    t->layers = ii.arrayLayers;
    t->view_kind = vt;             /* M4ac P2：默认视图类型（CUBE / 2D_ARRAY / 2D …） */
    t->is_depth = depth;
    t->layout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
    t->vk_bytes = rq.size;
    g_tex_live_n++;
    g_tex_live_bytes += rq.size;   /* M5s P2：归因探针：纹理活体字节 */
    t->soft_bc = nvn_vk_compressed_format(d->format) != VK_FORMAT_UNDEFINED &&
                 !g_compressed[nvn_vk_compressed_format(d->format)];
    VkImageViewCreateInfo iv = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO };
    iv.image = t->img;
    iv.viewType = vt;
    iv.format = f;
    uint8_t swz[4] = { (uint8_t)d->swizzle_r, (uint8_t)d->swizzle_g, (uint8_t)d->swizzle_b, (uint8_t)d->swizzle_a };
    iv.components = nvn_vk_components(d->format, swz, 1);
    iv.subresourceRange = (VkImageSubresourceRange){ t->aspect, 0, t->levels, 0, t->layers };
    if (vkCreateImageView(g_dev, &iv, NULL, &t->view) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        NVK_RED("vkCreateImageView failed");
        vkDestroyImage(g_dev, t->img, NULL); vkFreeMemory(g_dev, t->mem, NULL); free(t); return NULL;
    }
    {static unsigned long long n; if (++n == 1 || n % 128 == 0) NVK("[vk] texture #%{public}llu created (real VkImage)", n);}   // 批2 纹理计数（真机验收口径：boot 后非零）
    return t;
}

/* M40AJ：nvn_vk_tex_create 的薄计时包装（对外名字/签名/返回值与声明 nvn_vk.h:198 完全一致）。
   只多两次 clock_gettime 与两次原子加；不读不写任何调用语义相关状态。 */
nvn_vk_tex *nvn_vk_tex_create(const nvn_texdesc *d)
{
    struct timespec a, b; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &a);
    nvn_vk_tex *t = nvn_vk_tex_create_impl(d);
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &b);
    { unsigned long long us = (unsigned long long)((b.tv_sec - a.tv_sec) * 1000000LL + (b.tv_nsec - a.tv_nsec) / 1000);
      if (us > 100000000ull) us = 100000000ull;   /* 防御：>100 s 视为异常，钳住避免污染均值（同 m40ac_create_pipe 口径） */
      atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_m40aj_img_n, 1ull, memory_order_relaxed);
      atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_m40aj_img_us, us, memory_order_relaxed); }
    return t;
}

/* M4ac P2：给同一张 VkImage 造「另一种类型」的视图（与建图时的默认视图同格式/同 swizzle/同 mip 范围）。
   只被 r_tex_view_dim 在「槽的采样维度和默认视图不符」时调用；失败只记一行（每张图最多 3 次尝试）。 */
static VkImageView r_tex_make_view(nvn_vk_tex *t, VkImageViewType vt, uint32_t layers)
{
    if (!t || !t->img) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkImageViewCreateInfo iv = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO };
    iv.image = t->img;
    iv.viewType = vt;
    iv.format = t->fmt;
    uint8_t swz[4] = { (uint8_t)t->d.swizzle_r, (uint8_t)t->d.swizzle_g,
                       (uint8_t)t->d.swizzle_b, (uint8_t)t->d.swizzle_a };
    iv.components = nvn_vk_components(t->d.format, swz, 1);
    iv.subresourceRange = (VkImageSubresourceRange){ t->aspect, 0, t->levels, 0, layers };
    VkImageView v = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkResult rv = vkCreateImageView(g_dev, &iv, NULL, &v);
    if (rv != VK_SUCCESS) {
        g_t_cubefail_view++;
        vk_boot_logf("[t-red] alt view create failed vt=%d fmt=%#x tgt=%d %ux%u lv=%u lay=%u rv=%d (%s)",
                     (int)vt, (unsigned)t->d.format, t->d.target, t->w, t->h, t->levels, layers,
                     (int)rv, vr(rv));
        return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    }
    return v;
}

/* M4ac P2 的纯决策部分（不碰 Vulkan，便于离线回归）：给定图的形状与槽的采样维度，
   回应该用哪种视图类型与 layerCount。返回 0 = 这张图造不出该维度需要的视图 ⇒ 调用方回落旧行为。
   合法性前提（Vulkan）：
     · CUBE 视图要求建图时带 CUBE_COMPATIBLE、width==height、layerCount==6；
       target=4 的方形 6 层图由 nvn_vk_image_shape 统一加 flag（nvn_vk_compat.h）。
     · CUBE_COMPATIBLE 的图也允许 2D / 2D_ARRAY 视图 ⇒ 同一张图可以同时服务两类 shader。 */
static int r_view_for_dim(int target, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint32_t layers, int dim,
                          VkImageViewType *vt, uint32_t *vlayers)
{
    switch (dim) {
    case R_DIM_CUBE:
        if (target == 8) { *vt = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE; *vlayers = 6; return 1; }
        if (target == 4 && w == h && layers == 6) { *vt = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE; *vlayers = 6; return 1; }
        return 0;
    case R_DIM_2D_ARRAY:
        if (target == 4 || target == 8 || target == 9) {
            *vt = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D_ARRAY; *vlayers = layers; return 1;
        }
        return 0;
    case R_DIM_2D:
        if (target == 1 || target == 7) { *vt = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D; *vlayers = 1; return 1; }
        if (target == 4 || target == 8 || target == 9) { *vt = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D; *vlayers = 1; return 1; }
        return 0;
    case R_DIM_3D:
        /* M4ai P4②：target=2 的默认视图**本来就是 3D**（nvn_vk_compat.h 的 nvn_vk_image_shape），
           以前这里直接 return 0 ⇒ 每个 3D 槽都记一次 noview 并回落 g_r_tx_view。
           行为上等价（回落到的正是同一张默认 3D 视图），但 noview 计数长期误导排查。
           这里显式返回 1：r_tex_view_dim 会在 `vt == t->view_kind` 时直接复用 t->view，不另建视图。 */
        if (target == 2) { *vt = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_3D; *vlayers = 1; return 1; }
        return 0;
    default:
        return 0;   /* 1D / CubeArray：不另造视图 */
    }
}

/* M4ac P2：按槽的采样维度取视图（默认视图类型对得上就直接复用，否则懒建并缓存到 tex 对象上）。
   Cube      ← target==4 的 6 层方形图懒建 CUBE 视图（建图时已带 CUBE_COMPATIBLE）；target==8 复用默认视图。
   2DArray   ← target==4 的默认视图就是 2D_ARRAY；target==8/9 的立方体图懒建 2D_ARRAY 视图。
   2D        ← 默认就是 2D 的（target 1/7）复用默认；多层图懒建第 0 层的 2D 视图。
   其余维度不造视图（返回 NULL，调用方回落旧行为并计数）。 */
static VkImageView r_tex_view_dim(nvn_vk_tex *t, int dim)
{
    if (!t) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkImageViewType vt = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D;
    uint32_t vl = 1;
    if (!r_view_for_dim(t->d.target, t->w, t->h, t->layers, dim, &vt, &vl)) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    if (vt == t->view_kind) return t->view;                     /* 默认视图就是它，不另建 */
    VkImageView *slot = NULL;
    unsigned char *tried = NULL;
    if (vt == VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE) { slot = &t->view_cube; tried = &t->view_cube_tried; }
    else if (vt == VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D_ARRAY) { slot = &t->view_arr; tried = &t->view_arr_tried; }
    else if (vt == VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D) { slot = &t->view_2d; tried = &t->view_2d_tried; }
    else return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    if (!*tried) {
        *tried = 1;
        *slot = r_tex_make_view(t, vt, vl);
    }
    return *slot;
}

// 一次同步提交：录一条缓冲（record 回调录中间部分），提交等栅栏后返回。
// 第一批上传全同步（dontstarve 的 arena 异步化是第二批）；栅栏复用前先 reset
//（VUID-vkQueueSubmit-fence-00064，出图同款 :2605-2608）
static int submit_sync(void (*record)(VkCommandBuffer cb, void *arg), void *arg)
{
    VkCommandBuffer cb = NULL;
    VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo ca = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO };
    ca.commandPool = g_cp;
    ca.level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY;
    ca.commandBufferCount = 1;
    if (vkAllocateCommandBuffers(g_dev, &ca, &cb) != VK_SUCCESS) { NVK_RED("vkAllocateCommandBuffers failed"); return 0; }
    VkCommandBufferBeginInfo bi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO };
    bi.flags = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT;
    vkBeginCommandBuffer(cb, &bi);
    record(cb, arg);
    vkEndCommandBuffer(cb);
    VkSubmitInfo si = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO };
    si.commandBufferCount = 1;
    si.pCommandBuffers = &cb;
    if (g_ufence) vkResetFences(g_dev, 1, &g_ufence);
    if (vkQueueSubmit(g_q, 1, &si, g_ufence) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        NVK_RED("upload vkQueueSubmit failed");
        vkFreeCommandBuffers(g_dev, g_cp, 1, &cb);
        return 0;
    }
    /* M4k P0-2：把「无限等栅栏」变成可归因日志。行为不变（超时后继续无限等），
       但 5 s 打一行 [stall]，回答「present 之后是不是我们这侧卡住」。 */
    { VkResult wr = nvk_wait_fences(g_dev, 1, &g_ufence, VK_TRUE, 5000000000ull);
      if (wr == VK_TIMEOUT) {
          g_r_stall_upload++;
          vk_boot_logf("[stall] upload fence >5s submit_sync count=%llu (host-side blocking HERE)",
                       g_r_stall_upload);
          nvk_wait_fences(g_dev, 1, &g_ufence, VK_TRUE, UINT64_MAX);
      } }
    vkFreeCommandBuffers(g_dev, g_cp, 1, &cb);
    return 1;
}

typedef struct {
    nvn_vk_tex *t;
    VkBufferImageCopy reg;
    VkImageLayout from;
} up_arg;

static void up_record(VkCommandBuffer cb, void *p)
{
    up_arg *a = p;
    VkImageMemoryBarrier b;
    b = (VkImageMemoryBarrier){ VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER };
    b.srcAccessMask = 0;
    b.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
    b.oldLayout = a->from;
    b.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL;
    b.srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
    b.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
    b.image = a->t->img;
    b.subresourceRange = (VkImageSubresourceRange){ a->t->aspect, a->reg.imageSubresource.mipLevel, 1, 0, a->t->layers };
    beat_cmd();
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TOP_OF_PIPE_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, 0,
                         0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &b);
    beat_cmd();
    vkCmdCopyBufferToImage(cb, g_stage, a->t->img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, 1, &a->reg);
    // 传完就转可采样：游戏上传完下一帧就采，留在 TRANSFER_DST 会让绑定布局不对
    //（dontstarve 第 85 轮实测 1131 次绑定全错，:5457-5461）
    b = (VkImageMemoryBarrier){ VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER };
    b.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
    b.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT;
    b.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL;
    b.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL;
    b.srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
    b.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
    b.image = a->t->img;
    b.subresourceRange = (VkImageSubresourceRange){ a->t->aspect, a->reg.imageSubresource.mipLevel, 1, 0, a->t->layers };
    beat_cmd();
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT, 0,
                         0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &b);
    a->t->layout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL;
}

int nvn_vk_tex_upload_level(nvn_vk_tex *t, unsigned level, unsigned layer,
                            const void *linear_bytes, uint32_t row_pitch)
{
    if (!t || !g_on || !linear_bytes) return 0;
    if (level >= t->levels || level >= 32) return 0;
    if (t->d.target != 2 && layer >= t->layers) return 0;   // 3D 无层概念，一次拷全部切片
    if (t->is_depth && t->d.format != 0x33 && t->d.format != 0x34) {
        // 只有「深度+模板双面」的 D24S8/D32F_S8 无法用单一 linear 字节还原（深浅面交织），
        // 继续推迟到命令重放。单面 D24(0x33)/D32F(0x34) 与颜色图同构（bpb=4，块线性可解），放行。
        NVK_RED("upload_level: depth+stencil textures upload with command replay (batch 2)");
        return 0;
    }
    uint32_t mip_w = t->w >> level, mip_h = t->h >> level;
    if (!mip_w) mip_w = 1;
    if (!mip_h) mip_h = 1;
    // 块尺寸：按「字节实际是什么」取——soft_bc 回退后 Vk 格式未压缩，字节也是解码像素（块 1x1）
    int bw = 1, bh = 1;
    uint32_t bpb;   // 每「Vk 格式块」字节数；未压缩 = 每像素字节
    if (t->soft_bc) {
        bpb = vkfmt_bpp_guess(t->fmt);
        if (!bpb) return 0;
    } else {
        bpb = (uint32_t)nvn_fmt_bpb(t->d.format, &bw, &bh);   // platform/nvn_tex.c（donor 同源）
        if (!bpb) return 0;
    }
    uint32_t blocks_w = (mip_w + (uint32_t)bw - 1) / (uint32_t)bw;
    uint32_t blocks_h = (mip_h + (uint32_t)bh - 1) / (uint32_t)bh;
    // 行距合法性（重叠行/溢出拒收，出处 nvn_vk_copy_pitch 口径）
    uint64_t min_row = (uint64_t)blocks_w * bpb;
    uint64_t row = row_pitch ? row_pitch : min_row;
    if (row < min_row || row % bpb) { NVK_RED("upload_level: bad pitch %{public}u (min %{public}llu)", row_pitch, (unsigned long long)min_row); return 0; }
    uint32_t mip_d = 1;
    if (t->d.target == 2) {   // 3D：一次传本级全部深度切片
        mip_d = t->d.depth >> level;
        if (!mip_d) mip_d = 1;
    }
    uint64_t total = row * blocks_h * mip_d;

    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    if (!stage_grow(total)) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock); return 0; }
    memcpy(g_stage_map, linear_bytes, total);

    up_arg a;
    memset(&a, 0, sizeof a);
    a.t = t;
    // bufferRowLength/bufferImageHeight 是 texel 口径：压缩块行 → 块数×块宽（直抄 :5493-5494）；
    // 未压缩（含 soft_bc）时 bw=bh=1，即 texel 行数（软解路径 :5450-5451 同式）。
    a.reg = (VkBufferImageCopy){
        .bufferOffset = 0,
        .bufferRowLength = (uint32_t)(row / bpb) * (uint32_t)bw,
        .bufferImageHeight = (uint32_t)blocks_h * (uint32_t)bh,
        .imageSubresource = (VkImageSubresourceLayers){ t->aspect, level, layer, 1 },
        .imageOffset = { 0, 0, 0 },
        .imageExtent = { mip_w, mip_h, mip_d } };
    a.from = t->layout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED ? VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED
                                                    : VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL;
    int ok = submit_sync(up_record, &a);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
    return ok;
}

/* M4ab P2：把源纹理 level0 的某一层（**已 deswizzle 的线性字节**）原样落盘，host 侧解码成 PNG。
   为什么 dump 原始字节而不是回读 VkImage：BC3 在 SwiftShader 里是压缩格式（soft_bc=0，字节就是 BC3 块），
   回读后仍要再解一次；而这里拿到的线性字节就是游戏存储的真实内容——P2 要判的正是它。
   限流：任务点名的 1131/1142 全落；其它 128×128 的 0x3f/0x44 每种格式最多额外 3 个 id（防 id 轮换漏图），
   同一 (id,layer) 只落一次（reup 会重复走到这里）。 */
static void m4ab_tex_dump(uint32_t id, const nvn_vk_tex *t, unsigned layer,
                          const void *lin, size_t bytes, uint32_t rb, uint32_t rows)
{
    int fmt = (int)t->d.format;
    int fsel = (fmt == 0x3f) ? 0 : (fmt == 0x44) ? 1 : -1;
    if (fsel < 0 || t->w != 128 || t->h != 128 || !lin || !bytes) return;
    static uint32_t extra_ids[2][3];
    static unsigned extra_n[2];
    if (id != 1131 && id != 1142) {
        int known = 0;
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < extra_n[fsel]; i++) if (extra_ids[fsel][i] == id) known = 1;
        if (!known) {
            if (extra_n[fsel] >= 3) return;
            extra_ids[fsel][extra_n[fsel]++] = id;
        }
    }
    static unsigned long long seen[64];
    unsigned long long key = ((unsigned long long)id << 8) | (layer & 0xffu);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 64; i++) if (seen[i] == key) return;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 64; i++) if (!seen[i]) { seen[i] = key; break; }
    static const char *dirs[2] = { "/data/storage/el2/base/files", "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files" };
    char path[160] = {0};
    FILE *f = NULL;
    for (int d = 0; d < 2 && !f; d++) {
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/m4ab_tex_%u_fmt%x_f%u.bin", dirs[d], id, (unsigned)t->d.format, layer);
        f = fopen(path, "wb");
    }
    if (!f) { vk_boot_logf("[txd] id=%u f%u fopen fail", id, layer); return; }
    size_t n = fwrite(lin, bytes, 1, f);
    fclose(f);
    vk_boot_logf("[txd] id=%u f%u fmt=%#x %ux%u tgt=%d lv=%u lay=%u rb=%u rows=%u bytes=%zu write_ok=%zu -> %s",
                 id, layer, (unsigned)t->d.format, t->w, t->h, t->d.target, t->levels, t->layers,
                 rb, rows, bytes, n, path);
}

static uint32_t r_guest_copy(uint8_t *dst, uint64_t addr, uint32_t len);   /* 定义在 5890 行（M5w：本函数里做映射校验） */
/* M7l P1：场景族 draw（vs 前缀 24702883）已出现标志 + 读取口。定义前移到 tex_upload_storage
   之前（上传路径的 [m7l] sig 要用它；置位点在 m7k_scenedraw，M7L_ON=0 时恒 0 全静默）。 */
static int g_m7l_seen;
int nvn_vk_scene_seen(void) { return M7L_ON ? g_m7l_seen : 0; }

/* ================= M40J (2026-11-09, read-only 探针 smo_m40j): Mario 大纹理为何不落池 =================
   三问（派活单 /tmp/m40j_task_20261109.md）：
     Q1 画面里 Mario 那个大剪影是哪笔 draw 画的、绑的纹理 id / 池 storage 区间是什么；
     Q2 整轮 boot 有没有任何拷贝（memcpy/memmove/gmem copy/DMA/upload）落到过该区间；
     Q3 基线里 gmem_draws=22650 / copy_bytes=122MB 的拷贝去了哪（目标地址分布 top5）。
   做法（全部只读：不改任何绑定/上传/拷贝语义；smo_m40j=0 时零客体读、零日志）：
     ① 区间登记  gfx_bridge 首次 bind 分支 -> nvn_vk_m40j_reg(id, sn->mem, sn->avail)；
        记录 [store, store+span) 与全局 lo/hi（用来判「拷贝到了池附近但没进图」= C1 的特征）。
     ② draw 抓取  draw body 每笔扫当前 32 个采样槽，取「面积 ≥60% 目标屏」的最大一张，
        前 8 笔落一行（texid/fmt/ext/stor/span/verts）。见下方 m40j_draw。
     ③ 拷贝求交  所有「往客体写」的拷贝喂 nvn_vk_m40j_cp(tag,dst,len,src)：
        tag1=romfs 读入（ROMFS 文件字节 -> 客体 buffer，纹理数据真正的入口）、
        tag2=fs_host 读入、tag3=nvnCommandBufferUpdateUniformBuffer、tag4=gmem reloc（宿主 SSBO）。
        事件环存 dst/len（len≥4 KiB 才存，≤4096 条），每次节拍（每 600 submit）扫一遍环 × 区间表求交，
        每 (id,tag) ≤3 行；另记 near（dst 落在池 ±64 MB 但不在任何图内）——C1/C2 的分界证据。
     ④ cpsum    每 600 submit 一行：guest 侧目标 1 MiB 分桶 top5 + gmem 宿主侧 top5。
   日志预算：≤8 draw 行 + ≤12 iv 行 + ≤12 命中行 + 每 600 submit 一条 cpsum（≈6 条）≈ 40 行。 */
#define M40J_SW_A "/data/storage/el2/base/files/smo_m40j"
#define M40J_SW_B "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files/smo_m40j"
static int m40j_on(void)
{
    static int v = -1; static unsigned tick;
    if (v >= 0 && (tick++ & 63u)) return v;
    v = 0;
    { static const char *const p[2] = { M40J_SW_A, M40J_SW_B };
      for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) { FILE *f = fopen(p[i], "r");
        if (f) { int x = 0; if (fscanf(f, "%d", &x) == 1 && x > 0) v = 1; fclose(f); break; } } }
    return v;
}
__attribute__((constructor)) static void m40j_seed(void)
{
    static const char *const p[2] = { M40J_SW_A, M40J_SW_B };
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        FILE *r = fopen(p[i], "r");
        if (r) { fclose(r); continue; }
        { FILE *f = fopen(p[i], "w"); if (f) { fputs("0\n", f); fclose(f); } }
    }
}
#define M40J_IDS    128
#define M40J_EV     4096
#define M40J_BK     48
static struct { unsigned id; uint64_t store, span; } g_m40j_iv[M40J_IDS];
static unsigned g_m40j_niv;
static struct { uint64_t dst, len, src; unsigned tag, seen; } g_m40j_ev[M40J_EV];
static unsigned g_m40j_nev, g_m40j_ev_drop;
static uint64_t g_m40j_cp_n, g_m40j_cp_bytes, g_m40j_h_n, g_m40j_h_bytes;
static uint64_t g_m40j_lo, g_m40j_hi;
static unsigned g_m40j_hit_lines, g_m40j_near;
static unsigned char g_m40j_hc[M40J_IDS][6];          /* [iv][tag] 已打印命中条数（≤3） */
typedef struct { uint64_t b, bytes; } m40j_bk_t;
static m40j_bk_t g_m40j_bk[M40J_BK]; static unsigned g_m40j_nbk;
static m40j_bk_t g_m40j_hbk[M40J_BK]; static unsigned g_m40j_nhbk;
static unsigned g_m40j_drawn;
static void m40j_scan(void);
static void m40j_bk_add(m40j_bk_t *tab, unsigned *n, uint64_t dst, uint64_t len)
{ uint64_t b = dst >> 20;
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < *n; i++) if (tab[i].b == b) { tab[i].bytes += len; return; }
  if (*n < M40J_BK) { tab[*n].b = b; tab[*n].bytes = len; (*n)++; } }
void nvn_vk_m40j_reg(int id, uint64_t store, uint64_t span)
{
    if (id < 0 || !store || !span || !m40j_on()) return;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < g_m40j_niv; i++) if (g_m40j_iv[i].id == (unsigned)id) return;
    if (g_m40j_niv >= M40J_IDS) return;
    g_m40j_iv[g_m40j_niv].id = (unsigned)id;
    g_m40j_iv[g_m40j_niv].store = store;
    g_m40j_iv[g_m40j_niv].span = span;
    g_m40j_niv++;
    if (!g_m40j_lo || store < g_m40j_lo) g_m40j_lo = store;
    if (store + span > g_m40j_hi) g_m40j_hi = store + span;
    if (g_m40j_niv <= 12)
        vk_boot_logf("[m40j] iv #%u id=%d stor=%#llx span=%llu end=%#llx pool=[%#llx,%#llx)",
                     g_m40j_niv, id, (unsigned long long)store, (unsigned long long)span,
                     (unsigned long long)(store + span),
                     (unsigned long long)g_m40j_lo, (unsigned long long)g_m40j_hi);
}
void nvn_vk_m40j_cp(unsigned tag, const void *dstp, uint64_t len, uint64_t src)
{
    if (!dstp || !len || tag < 1u || !m40j_on()) return;
    uint64_t dst = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)dstp;
    if (tag == 4u) { g_m40j_h_n++; g_m40j_h_bytes += len; m40j_bk_add(g_m40j_hbk, &g_m40j_nhbk, dst, len); return; }
    g_m40j_cp_n++; g_m40j_cp_bytes += len;
    m40j_bk_add(g_m40j_bk, &g_m40j_nbk, dst, len);
    if (len < 4096ull) return;
    if (g_m40j_nev >= M40J_EV) { g_m40j_ev_drop++; return; }
    g_m40j_ev[g_m40j_nev].dst = dst; g_m40j_ev[g_m40j_nev].len = len;
    g_m40j_ev[g_m40j_nev].src = src; g_m40j_ev[g_m40j_nev].tag = tag; g_m40j_ev[g_m40j_nev].seen = 0;
    g_m40j_nev++;
}
static void m40j_scan(void)
{
    if (!g_m40j_niv) return;
    for (unsigned e = 0; e < g_m40j_nev; e++) {
        if (g_m40j_ev[e].seen) continue;
        g_m40j_ev[e].seen = 1;
        uint64_t d = g_m40j_ev[e].dst, n = g_m40j_ev[e].len, sr = g_m40j_ev[e].src;
        unsigned tag = g_m40j_ev[e].tag;
        int hit = 0;
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < g_m40j_niv; i++) {
            uint64_t s = g_m40j_iv[i].store, sp = g_m40j_iv[i].span;
            if (d + n <= s || d >= s + sp) continue;
            hit = 1;
            if (tag >= 6u || g_m40j_hc[i][tag] >= 3u) continue;
            g_m40j_hc[i][tag]++;
            if (g_m40j_hit_lines < 12) {
                g_m40j_hit_lines++;
                vk_boot_logf("[m40j] cp dst=%#llx len=%llu hit_id=%u off=%llu src=%#llx tag=%u iv=[%#llx,%#llx)",
                             (unsigned long long)d, (unsigned long long)n, g_m40j_iv[i].id,
                             (unsigned long long)(d > s ? d - s : 0ull), (unsigned long long)sr, tag,
                             (unsigned long long)s, (unsigned long long)(s + sp));
            }
        }
        if (!hit && d >= (g_m40j_lo > (64ull << 20) ? g_m40j_lo - (64ull << 20) : 0ull) &&
            d < g_m40j_hi + (64ull << 20)) g_m40j_near++;
    }
}
static void m40j_cpsum(unsigned long long sub)
{
    /* guest 侧 top5（桶内字节降序；只排前 5，BF 选择即可） */
    char g5[200] = "", h5[200] = ""; size_t o = 0;
    for (int k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
        unsigned bi = M40J_BK; uint64_t bv = 0;
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < g_m40j_nbk; i++) if (g_m40j_bk[i].bytes > bv) { bv = g_m40j_bk[i].bytes; bi = i; }
        if (bi == M40J_BK) break;
        o += (size_t)snprintf(g5 + o, sizeof g5 - o, "%s%#llx:%llu", o ? "," : "",
                              (unsigned long long)(g_m40j_bk[bi].b << 20), (unsigned long long)g_m40j_bk[bi].bytes);
        g_m40j_bk[bi].bytes = 0;
    }
    o = 0;
    for (int k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
        unsigned bi = M40J_BK; uint64_t bv = 0;
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < g_m40j_nhbk; i++) if (g_m40j_hbk[i].bytes > bv) { bv = g_m40j_hbk[i].bytes; bi = i; }
        if (bi == M40J_BK) break;
        o += (size_t)snprintf(h5 + o, sizeof h5 - o, "%s%#llx:%llu", o ? "," : "",
                              (unsigned long long)(g_m40j_hbk[bi].b << 20), (unsigned long long)g_m40j_hbk[bi].bytes);
        g_m40j_hbk[bi].bytes = 0;
    }
    vk_boot_logf("[m40j] cpsum sub=%llu n=%llu bytes=%llu top5=%s | hgmem n=%llu bytes=%llu htop5=%s "
                 "| iv=%u pool=[%#llx,%#llx) ev=%u drop=%u hits=%u near=%u",
                 sub, (unsigned long long)g_m40j_cp_n, (unsigned long long)g_m40j_cp_bytes, g5[0] ? g5 : "-",
                 (unsigned long long)g_m40j_h_n, (unsigned long long)g_m40j_h_bytes, h5[0] ? h5 : "-",
                 g_m40j_niv, (unsigned long long)g_m40j_lo, (unsigned long long)g_m40j_hi,
                 g_m40j_nev, g_m40j_ev_drop, g_m40j_hit_lines, g_m40j_near);
}
void nvn_vk_m40j_tick(void)
{
    static unsigned long long sub;
    if (!m40j_on()) return;
    sub++;
    if (sub % 600ull) return;
    m40j_scan();
    m40j_cpsum(sub);
}

/* ================= M40K (2026-11-09, read-only 探针 smo_m40k): 谁把数据搬进纹理池 =================
   派活单 /tmp/m40k_task_20261109.md。M40J 的拷贝钩子只抓 ≥4 KiB 的 memcpy/memmove 事件；aarch64
   内联/向量化拷贝（ld/st 循环、NEON）完全绕开 memcpy 符号 ⇒「hits=0」可能只是「钩子看不见」，
   不等于「没人写」。本轮换探测方式：**不看拷贝调用，直接看池字节有没有变**。
   做法（全部只读；smo_m40k=0 时零客体读、零日志）：
     ① 区间登记  gfx_bridge 首次 bind 分支 -> nvn_vk_m40k_reg(id, sn->mem, span)，表 256 条；
     ② 定时轮询  nvn_vk_m40k_tick(sub)（每次 submit 被调，内部按 **2 s** 节流、最多 200 次）：
                 对 ≤16 个目标区间（优先 id=293 + M40J/H 的 15 个观察 id）读「前 4096 B」与
                 「中点 4096 B」，算 64-bit FNV-1a hash + 非零字节数，与上次比 -> 变了打 CHG；
     ③ 写保护    首次发现某区间变化时 runtime_watch_add(store, min(span,65536), 0)，最多挂 2 个；
                 ⚠️ OHOS(musl) 上 gfx_bridge.c:165 的 `#ifdef __MUSL__` 分支是 **log-only**
                 （mprotect 型 watch 会被 DFX 在首个越窗 fault 判死，round3 实测）⇒ 本设备上
                 WATCHHIT **结构上不可能出现**；仍尝试一次以留 DISABLED 行作证（报告记 W3-watch）。
     ④ 汇总      每 20 次一条 `poll` 行 + 收尾一条 FINAL 行。
   轮询为什么放在 submit 线程内节流、而不是另起线程：池区间在 guest 侧可能被解映射，
   旁路线程盲读会 SIGSEGV -> DFX 判死整进程（掉整轮 boot 证据）；submit 线程是 M40H 已经在读
   同一批池地址的上下文，地址此刻必然有效。
   日志预算：≤20 tgt + ≤40 CHG + ≤11 poll + 收尾 ≈ 75 行（硬上限 400）。 */
#define M40K_SW_A "/data/storage/el2/base/files/smo_m40k"
#define M40K_SW_B "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files/smo_m40k"
static int m40k_on(void)
{
    static int v = -1; static unsigned tick;
    if (v >= 0 && (tick++ & 63u)) return v;
    v = 0;
    { static const char *const p[2] = { M40K_SW_A, M40K_SW_B };
      for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) { FILE *f = fopen(p[i], "r");
        if (f) { int x = 0; if (fscanf(f, "%d", &x) == 1 && x > 0) v = 1; fclose(f); break; } } }
    return v;
}
__attribute__((constructor)) static void m40k_seed(void)
{
    static const char *const p[2] = { M40K_SW_A, M40K_SW_B };
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        FILE *r = fopen(p[i], "r");
        if (r) { fclose(r); continue; }
        { FILE *f = fopen(p[i], "w"); if (f) { fputs("0\n", f); fclose(f); } }
    }
}
#define M40K_IDS   256
#define M40K_PT     16
#define M40K_BLK  4096
static struct { int id; uint64_t store, span; } g_m40k_iv[M40K_IDS];
static unsigned g_m40k_niv;
/* 16 个目标：293（Mario 1 MiB 池纹理 1024x1024 fmt=0x49）+ M40J/M40H `[tp1]` 观察过的 15 个 id */
static const int g_m40k_pri[M40K_PT] = {293,287,288,1284,1285,1286,1287,1288,1289,1894,1900,1910,1911,1131,1142,3452};
static struct { int id; uint64_t store, span; uint64_t h[2]; int valid; unsigned chg, lines, watched; } g_m40k_pt[M40K_PT];
static unsigned g_m40k_npt;
static uint64_t g_m40k_poll_n, g_m40k_chg, g_m40k_chg_lines, g_m40k_last_ns, g_m40k_t0_ns;
static unsigned g_m40k_tgt_lines, g_m40k_watch_n;
static uint64_t m40k_h64(const unsigned char *p, size_t n, unsigned *nz)
{ uint64_t h = 1469598103934665603ull; unsigned z = 0;
  for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) { unsigned char c = p[i]; if (c) z++; h ^= c; h *= 1099511628211ull; }
  if (nz) *nz = z; return h; }
static uint64_t m40k_now_ns(void) { struct timespec ts; if (clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts)) return 0; return (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000000000ull + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec; }
void nvn_vk_m40k_reg(int id, uint64_t store, uint64_t span)
{
    if (id < 0 || !store || !span || !m40k_on()) return;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < g_m40k_niv; i++) if (g_m40k_iv[i].id == (unsigned)id) return;
    if (g_m40k_niv >= M40K_IDS) return;
    g_m40k_iv[g_m40k_niv].id = id; g_m40k_iv[g_m40k_niv].store = store; g_m40k_iv[g_m40k_niv].span = span;
    g_m40k_niv++;
}
static void m40k_add_tgt(int id, uint64_t store, uint64_t span)
{
    for (unsigned j = 0; j < g_m40k_npt; j++) if (g_m40k_pt[j].id == id) return;
    if (g_m40k_npt >= M40K_PT) return;
    { unsigned k = g_m40k_npt++;
      g_m40k_pt[k].id = id; g_m40k_pt[k].store = store; g_m40k_pt[k].span = span;
      g_m40k_pt[k].h[0] = g_m40k_pt[k].h[1] = 0; g_m40k_pt[k].valid = 0;
      g_m40k_pt[k].chg = g_m40k_pt[k].lines = g_m40k_pt[k].watched = 0;
      if (g_m40k_tgt_lines < 20) { g_m40k_tgt_lines++;
          vk_boot_logf("[m40k] tgt #%u id=%d stor=%#llx span=%llu mid=%#llx",
                       k, id, (unsigned long long)store, (unsigned long long)span,
                       (unsigned long long)(store + (span >= 8192ull ? ((span >> 1) & ~4095ull) : 0ull))); } }
}
static void m40k_refresh(unsigned n)
{
    for (int k = 0; k < (int)M40K_PT; k++) {
        int want = g_m40k_pri[k];
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < g_m40k_niv; i++)
            if (g_m40k_iv[i].id == (unsigned)want) { m40k_add_tgt(want, g_m40k_iv[i].store, g_m40k_iv[i].span); break; }
    }
    if (n < 30u) return;   /* 前 60 s 只用优先表，给晚注册的 293 族留位（M40J：iv 在 t≈80 s 就满） */
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < g_m40k_niv && g_m40k_npt < M40K_PT; i++)
        m40k_add_tgt(g_m40k_iv[i].id, g_m40k_iv[i].store, g_m40k_iv[i].span);
}
static void m40k_watch_try(unsigned i)
{
    extern void runtime_watch_add(uintptr_t, size_t, int) __attribute__((weak));   /* 定义在 gfx_bridge.c；OHOS 上 log-only */
    if (g_m40k_watch_n >= 2) return;
    if (g_m40k_pt[i].watched) return;   /* 同一区间只挂一次（M40K 复用 M40K_PT 槽，重复挂会白占 2 个槽位上限） */
    { uint64_t len = g_m40k_pt[i].span < 65536ull ? g_m40k_pt[i].span : 65536ull;
      g_m40k_pt[i].watched = 1;
      g_m40k_watch_n++;
      vk_boot_logf("[m40k] WATCH slot=%u id=%d addr=%#llx len=%llu w3=ohos-log-only",
                   g_m40k_watch_n - 1, g_m40k_pt[i].id,
                   (unsigned long long)g_m40k_pt[i].store, (unsigned long long)len);
      if (runtime_watch_add) runtime_watch_add((uintptr_t)g_m40k_pt[i].store, (size_t)len, 0); }
}
static void m40k_poll(unsigned long long sub)
{
    g_m40k_poll_n++;
    { unsigned n = (unsigned)g_m40k_poll_n;
      if (!g_m40k_t0_ns) g_m40k_t0_ns = m40k_now_ns();
      m40k_refresh(n);
      for (unsigned i = 0; i < g_m40k_npt; i++) {
        uint64_t store = g_m40k_pt[i].store, span = g_m40k_pt[i].span;
        uint64_t moff = (span >= 8192ull) ? ((span >> 1) & ~4095ull) : 0ull;
        unsigned nz0 = 0, nz1 = 0;
        uint64_t h0 = m40k_h64((const unsigned char *)(uintptr_t)store, M40K_BLK, &nz0);
        uint64_t h1 = m40k_h64((const unsigned char *)(uintptr_t)(store + moff), M40K_BLK, &nz1);
        if (g_m40k_pt[i].valid && (h0 != g_m40k_pt[i].h[0] || h1 != g_m40k_pt[i].h[1])) {
            g_m40k_chg++;
            g_m40k_pt[i].chg++;
            if (g_m40k_pt[i].lines < 4u && g_m40k_chg_lines < 40) {
                int half = (h0 != g_m40k_pt[i].h[0]) ? 0 : 1;
                g_m40k_pt[i].lines++; g_m40k_chg_lines++;
                vk_boot_logf("[m40k] CHG id=%d half=%d off=%llu hash=%#llx prev=%#llx nz=%u/%u submit=%llu t=%us poll=%u",
                             g_m40k_pt[i].id, half,
                             (unsigned long long)(half ? moff : 0ull),
                             (unsigned long long)(half ? h1 : h0),
                             (unsigned long long)g_m40k_pt[i].h[half], half ? nz1 : nz0,
                             (unsigned)M40K_BLK, sub,
                             (unsigned)((m40k_now_ns() - g_m40k_t0_ns) / 1000000000ull), n);
            }
            m40k_watch_try(i);
        }
        g_m40k_pt[i].h[0] = h0; g_m40k_pt[i].h[1] = h1; g_m40k_pt[i].valid = 1;
      }
      if (n % 20u == 0)
          vk_boot_logf("[m40k] poll n=%u chg=%llu ids=%u reg=%u watch=%u sub=%llu t=%us",
                       n, (unsigned long long)g_m40k_chg, g_m40k_npt, g_m40k_niv,
                       g_m40k_watch_n, sub,
                       (unsigned)((m40k_now_ns() - g_m40k_t0_ns) / 1000000000ull));
      if (n == 200u) {
          /* 收尾：把「每个目标区间累计变了几次」压成一行（无变化的口径 = D1，有变化 = D2/D3） */
          char hl[240]; size_t o = 0; hl[0] = 0;
          for (unsigned i = 0; i < g_m40k_npt && o < sizeof hl - 24; i++)
              if (g_m40k_pt[i].chg)
                  o += (size_t)snprintf(hl + o, sizeof hl - o, "%s%d:%u", o ? "," : "",
                                        g_m40k_pt[i].id, g_m40k_pt[i].chg);
          vk_boot_logf("[m40k] FINAL poll=%u chg=%llu ids=%u reg=%u chglines=%llu watch=%u chgids=%s",
                       n, (unsigned long long)g_m40k_chg, g_m40k_npt, g_m40k_niv,
                       (unsigned long long)g_m40k_chg_lines, g_m40k_watch_n, hl[0] ? hl : "-");
      } }
}
void nvn_vk_m40k_tick(unsigned long long sub)
{
    if (!m40k_on()) return;
    if (g_m40k_poll_n >= 200ull) return;
    { uint64_t now = m40k_now_ns();
      if (!now) return;
      if (g_m40k_last_ns && now - g_m40k_last_ns < 2000000000ull) return;   /* 2 s 节流 */
      g_m40k_last_ns = now; }
    m40k_poll(sub);
}

/* ================= M7m (2026-11-07, read-only): dump judged-content textures as PNG =================
   Task /tmp/m7m_task_20261107.md step 1: M7l proved the BC family (fmt 0x46/0x48/0x49/0x4c,
   nz_src 86..99%) reaches the VkImage, but there is no EYE evidence yet that the deswizzled
   bytes are a proper image (structure / gradients) vs noise (deswizzle or channel-order wrong).
   Hook: tex_upload_storage block-linear branch, lv0/la0 right after nvn_deswizzle -- the exact
   bytes handed to nvn_vk_tex_upload_level, i.e. "as uploaded". Decode BC blocks -> RGBA8 ->
   reuse m7h_write_png. Two families, both gated on scene_seen (targets are post-scene uploads),
   one PNG per id, shared budget:
     A. BC >= 1024x1024 (task named id2221 0x46 / id2232 0x48 / id2264 / id2281 0x4c): 5 PNGs.
     B. BC 128..1023 px  (scene FS slot0 texture id2249 is BC3 0x48 256x256 per [m7k] ph;
        the slot table's "f72" field does not match the registry fmt -- ids are ground truth): 4 PNGs.
   One-key rollback: M7M_ON=0 -> first line returns, behavior bit-identical to M7l. */
#define M7M_ON 1
#define M7M_MAX 9                    /* shared budget: 5 big-BC + 4 small-BC */
static unsigned g_m7m_n, g_m7m_fail, g_m7m_skipnote;
static uint32_t g_m7m_seen[M7M_MAX];
static unsigned long long m7h_write_png(const char *path, unsigned w, unsigned h, const unsigned char *rgba);
static const char *m7h_dir(void);
/* BC1 color block (bytes 0..3): two 565 colors -> 4-entry palette. has4 = (c0>c1) 4-color mode. */
static void m7m_bc1_colors(const unsigned char *b, unsigned char rgb[4][3], int *has4)
{
    unsigned c0 = (unsigned)b[0] | ((unsigned)b[1] << 8);
    unsigned c1 = (unsigned)b[2] | ((unsigned)b[3] << 8);
    unsigned r0 = (c0 >> 11) & 31u, g0 = (c0 >> 5) & 63u, b0 = c0 & 31u;
    unsigned r1 = (c1 >> 11) & 31u, g1 = (c1 >> 5) & 63u, b1 = c1 & 31u;
    rgb[0][0] = (unsigned char)(r0 * 255u / 31u); rgb[0][1] = (unsigned char)(g0 * 255u / 63u); rgb[0][2] = (unsigned char)(b0 * 255u / 31u);
    rgb[1][0] = (unsigned char)(r1 * 255u / 31u); rgb[1][1] = (unsigned char)(g1 * 255u / 63u); rgb[1][2] = (unsigned char)(b1 * 255u / 31u);
    *has4 = (c0 > c1);
    if (c0 > c1) {
        rgb[2][0] = (unsigned char)(((2u * r0 + r1) / 3u) * 255u / 31u);
        rgb[2][1] = (unsigned char)(((2u * g0 + g1) / 3u) * 255u / 63u);
        rgb[2][2] = (unsigned char)(((2u * b0 + b1) / 3u) * 255u / 31u);
        rgb[3][0] = (unsigned char)(((r0 + 2u * r1) / 3u) * 255u / 31u);
        rgb[3][1] = (unsigned char)(((g0 + 2u * g1) / 3u) * 255u / 63u);
        rgb[3][2] = (unsigned char)(((b0 + 2u * b1) / 3u) * 255u / 31u);
    } else {
        rgb[2][0] = (unsigned char)(((r0 + r1) / 2u) * 255u / 31u);
        rgb[2][1] = (unsigned char)(((g0 + g1) / 2u) * 255u / 63u);
        rgb[2][2] = (unsigned char)(((b0 + b1) / 2u) * 255u / 31u);
        rgb[3][0] = rgb[3][1] = rgb[3][2] = 0;   /* punchthrough slot (alpha 0 for BC1_RGBA) */
    }
}
/* BC3/BC4 alpha block (bytes 0..7): a0,a1 + 16 3-bit selectors -> 8 alpha values. */
static void m7m_bc_alpha(const unsigned char *b, unsigned char a[8])
{
    a[0] = b[0]; a[1] = b[1];
    if (a[0] > a[1]) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) a[2 + i] = (unsigned char)(((6 - i) * (unsigned)a[0] + (1 + i) * (unsigned)a[1]) / 7);
    } else {
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) a[2 + i] = (unsigned char)(((4 - i) * (unsigned)a[0] + (1 + i) * (unsigned)a[1]) / 5);
        a[6] = 0; a[7] = 255;
    }
}
static unsigned m7m_bc_asel(const unsigned char *b, unsigned texel)   /* 3-bit selector, texel 0..15 */
{
    unsigned bit = texel * 3u, byi = 2u + bit / 8u, sh = bit % 8u;   /* 48 selector bits live in bytes 2..7 */
    unsigned v = (unsigned)b[byi];
    if (byi + 1u < 8u) v |= (unsigned)b[byi + 1u] << 8;
    if (byi + 2u < 8u) v |= (unsigned)b[byi + 2u] << 16;
    return (v >> sh) & 7u;
}
static void m7m_tex_dump(uint32_t id, const nvn_vk_tex *t, const uint8_t *lin, uint32_t rb, uint32_t rows)
{
    if (!M7M_ON || !t || !lin || !rb || !rows || id == 0xFFFFFFFFu) return;
    if (!nvn_vk_scene_seen()) return;
    int fmt = (int)t->d.format;
    int is_bc = (fmt >= 0x41 && fmt <= 0x4c);        /* BC1..BC5 (+ sRGB variants, same bitstream) */
    if (!is_bc) return;
    int big = ((unsigned)t->w >= 1024u && (unsigned)t->h >= 1024u);
    if (!big && ((unsigned)t->w < 128u || (unsigned)t->h < 128u)) return;
    static unsigned n_big, n_small;
    if (big ? n_big >= 5u : n_small >= 4u) return;
    if (g_m7m_n >= M7M_MAX) return;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < g_m7m_n; i++) if (g_m7m_seen[i] == id) return;
    unsigned long long tot = (unsigned long long)rb * rows, nz = 0;
    for (unsigned long long i = 0; i < tot; i++) if (lin[i]) nz++;
    unsigned nzp = (unsigned)(tot ? 100u * nz / tot : 0);
    unsigned w = (unsigned)t->w, h = (unsigned)t->h;
    if (w > 1024u) w = 1024u;
    if (h > 1024u) h = 1024u;
    if (nzp < 50) {   /* task bar is nz>=80 for the BC family; 50 only filters pure-zero, pct logged */
        if (!g_m7m_skipnote)
            vk_boot_logf("[m7m] tex skip id=%u fmt=0x%x %ux%u nz=%u%% (<50, no dump)", id, (unsigned)fmt, w, h, nzp);
        g_m7m_skipnote = 1;
        return;
    }
    int bw = 1, bh = 1, bpb = nvn_fmt_bpb(fmt, &bw, &bh);
    if (!bpb || (rb % (uint32_t)bpb)) { g_m7m_fail++; return; }
    unsigned char *rgba = (unsigned char *)malloc((size_t)w * h * 4u);
    if (!rgba) { g_m7m_fail++; return; }
    unsigned fam = (fmt == 0x41 || fmt == 0x42 || fmt == 0x45 || fmt == 0x46) ? 1u
                 : (fmt == 0x43 || fmt == 0x47) ? 2u
                 : (fmt == 0x44 || fmt == 0x48) ? 3u
                 : (fmt == 0x49 || fmt == 0x4a) ? 4u : 5u;
    for (unsigned y = 0; y < h; y++) {
        for (unsigned x = 0; x < w; x++) {
            unsigned char *o = rgba + ((size_t)y * w + x) * 4u;
            unsigned bxI = x >> 2, byI = y >> 2, texel = (y & 3u) * 4u + (x & 3u);
            const unsigned char *blk = (const unsigned char *)lin + (size_t)byI * rb + (size_t)bxI * (unsigned)bpb;
            unsigned char col[4][3], alp[8], alp2[8];
            int has4 = 0;
            unsigned sel, v32, a = 255u;
            if (fam == 1) {          /* BC1/BC1A: colors blk[0..3], selectors blk[4..7] */
                m7m_bc1_colors(blk, col, &has4);
                v32 = (unsigned)blk[4] | ((unsigned)blk[5] << 8) | ((unsigned)blk[6] << 16) | ((unsigned)blk[7] << 24);
                sel = (v32 >> (2u * texel)) & 3u;
                if (sel == 3u && !has4) a = (fmt == 0x42 || fmt == 0x46) ? 0u : 255u;
                o[0] = col[sel][0]; o[1] = col[sel][1]; o[2] = col[sel][2]; o[3] = (unsigned char)a;
            } else if (fam == 2) {   /* BC2: 4-bit alpha blk[0..7], colors blk[8..11], sel blk[12..15] */
                m7m_bc1_colors(blk + 8, col, &has4);
                v32 = (unsigned)blk[12] | ((unsigned)blk[13] << 8) | ((unsigned)blk[14] << 16) | ((unsigned)blk[15] << 24);
                sel = (v32 >> (2u * texel)) & 3u;
                { unsigned bitp = 4u * texel, byi = bitp >> 3, nib = bitp & 7u;
                  unsigned v16 = (unsigned)blk[byi] | ((byi < 7u ? (unsigned)blk[byi + 1u] : 0u) << 8);
                  a = ((v16 >> nib) & 15u) * 17u; }
                o[0] = col[sel][0]; o[1] = col[sel][1]; o[2] = col[sel][2]; o[3] = (unsigned char)a;
            } else if (fam == 3) {   /* BC3: alpha block blk[0..7], colors blk[8..15] */
                m7m_bc_alpha(blk, alp);
                m7m_bc1_colors(blk + 8, col, &has4);
                v32 = (unsigned)blk[12] | ((unsigned)blk[13] << 8) | ((unsigned)blk[14] << 16) | ((unsigned)blk[15] << 24);
                sel = (v32 >> (2u * texel)) & 3u;
                o[0] = col[sel][0]; o[1] = col[sel][1]; o[2] = col[sel][2]; o[3] = alp[m7m_bc_asel(blk, texel)];
            } else if (fam == 4) {   /* BC4: single alpha block -> gray */
                m7m_bc_alpha(blk, alp);
                unsigned v = alp[m7m_bc_asel(blk, texel)];
                o[0] = (unsigned char)v; o[1] = (unsigned char)v; o[2] = (unsigned char)v; o[3] = 255;
            } else {                 /* BC5: two alpha blocks -> R,G */
                m7m_bc_alpha(blk, alp);
                m7m_bc_alpha(blk + 8, alp2);
                o[0] = alp[m7m_bc_asel(blk, texel)];
                o[1] = alp2[m7m_bc_asel(blk + 8, texel)];
                o[2] = 0; o[3] = 255;
            }
        }
    }
    g_m7m_seen[g_m7m_n++] = id;
    if (big) n_big++; else n_small++;
    char path[256];
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%sm7m_tex_id%u_fmt%02x_%ux%u.png", m7h_dir(), id, (unsigned)fmt, w, h);
    unsigned long long bytes = m7h_write_png(path, w, h, rgba);
    free(rgba);
    if (bytes)
        vk_boot_logf("[m7m] tex id=%u fmt=0x%x %ux%u lv0 rb=%u rows=%u bpb=%d nz=%u%% png=%ux%u "
                     "path=%s bytes=%llu (%u/%d fam=%u)",
                     id, (unsigned)fmt, (unsigned)t->w, (unsigned)t->h, rb, rows, bpb, nzp, w, h,
                     path, bytes, g_m7m_n, M7M_MAX, fam);
    else {
        g_m7m_fail++;
        vk_boot_logf("[m7m] tex fail id=%u fmt=0x%x path=%s fail=%u", id, (unsigned)fmt, path, g_m7m_fail);
    }
}

/* ================= M40E（2026-11-09）：0x3f 立方体贴图「零内容」源地址取证 =================
   背景（M40D）：fmt 0x3f（R11G11B10F，128×128，tgt=8 CUBE，6 面）的 7 个 id，dump 出 42 面里 29 面
   字节级全 0；且**层 0/1/2 在 7/7 id 上全 0、层 3 在 7/7 id 上有数据**。本探针**纯只读**、不改行为。
   三行（都受开关 smo_m40e 管；关态零客体读、零日志，行为与 M40D 后逐位相同）：
     [m40e] up   id/occ/fmt/tgt/ext/mips/layers/base/bytes/pool/lv0off/lsz + base 处 rd16 + 首 1 KB 非零计数
     [m40e] lay  id/f/lv/addr/off/rb/rows/sl + 客体 rd16/gnz1k/gfull + 解排布后 lin 的 l16/lnz1k/lfull
     [m40e] near id/alt_base/delta/nz4k（base ±256 KB 内第一个非零 64 KB 对齐块；每 id 只一次）
   判据：客体 gnz=0 且 near=none ⇒ G1（游戏侧就是零）；near 有块 ⇒ G2（地址算错、数据在旁边）；
         客体有数据而 lin 全零 ⇒ G3（解排布/层索引/stride 错）。
   开关口径同 M38C：env 无 → 沙箱文件（构造期建 -1/0 默认，1 s 重读）→ 缺省 0。 */
#define M40E_SW_A "/data/storage/el2/base/files/smo_m40e"
#define M40E_SW_B "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files/smo_m40e"
static int m40e_on(void)
{
    static int v = -1; static long last;
    long now = (long)time(NULL);
    if (v >= 0 && now == last) return v;
    last = now; v = 0;
    { const char *p[2] = { M40E_SW_A, M40E_SW_B };
      for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) { FILE *f = fopen(p[i], "r");
        if (f) { int x = 0; if (fscanf(f, "%d", &x) == 1 && x > 0) v = 1; fclose(f); break; } } }
    return v;
}
__attribute__((constructor)) static void m40e_seed(void)
{
    static const char *const p[2] = { M40E_SW_A, M40E_SW_B };
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        FILE *r = fopen(p[i], "r");
        if (r) { fclose(r); continue; }
        FILE *f = fopen(p[i], "w");
        if (f) { fputs("0\n", f); fclose(f); }
    }
}
/* 限流口径：只认 128×128 且 fmt∈{0x3f,0x44}（= M40D dump 的 7 个 id + BC3 对照 1142）。 */
static int m40e_target(int fmt, unsigned w, unsigned h)
{ return w == 128u && h == 128u && (fmt == 0x3f || fmt == 0x44); }
static void m40e_hex(char *o, size_t cap, const uint8_t *p)
{
    int n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 16 && n + 3 < (int)cap; i++)
        n += snprintf(o + n, cap - (size_t)n, "%02x", (unsigned)p[i]);
}
static uint32_t m40e_nz(const uint8_t *p, uint32_t n)
{ uint32_t k = 0; for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) if (p[i]) k++; return k; }
static uint32_t m40e_ids[16], m40e_occ[16], m40e_nid, m40e_near_done[16], m40e_lay_lines;
/* 返回本次上传是该 id 的第几次（1..3）；>3 次或 id 表满 ⇒ 0（不再打）。 */
static int m40e_begin(uint32_t id)
{
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < m40e_nid; i++)
        if (m40e_ids[i] == id) { if (m40e_occ[i] >= 3u) return 0; return (int)++m40e_occ[i]; }
    if (m40e_nid >= 16u) return 0;
    m40e_ids[m40e_nid] = id; m40e_occ[m40e_nid] = 1u; m40e_nid++;
    return 1;
}
static int m40e_near_claim(uint32_t id)
{
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < m40e_nid; i++)
        if (m40e_ids[i] == id) { if (m40e_near_done[i]) return 0; m40e_near_done[i] = 1u; return 1; }
    return 0;
}
static void m40e_up_line(uint32_t id, const nvn_vk_tex *t, uint64_t pool_va, uint64_t len,
                         uint64_t lv0off, uint64_t lsz, int occ)
{
    uint8_t b16[16] = {0}, b1k[1024] = {0}; char hx[40] = {0};
    uint32_t r16 = r_guest_copy(b16, pool_va + lv0off, 16u);
    uint32_t r1k = r_guest_copy(b1k, pool_va + lv0off, 1024u);
    (void)r16;
    m40e_hex(hx, sizeof hx, b16);
    vk_boot_logf("[m40e] up id=%u occ=%d fmt=%#x tgt=%u ext=%ux%u mips=%u layers=%u base=%#llx bytes=%llu pool=%#llx lv0off=%llu lsz=%llu rd16=%s rd=%u/%u nz1k=%u/%u",
                 id, occ, (unsigned)t->d.format, (unsigned)t->d.target,
                 (unsigned)t->w, (unsigned)t->h, (unsigned)t->levels, (unsigned)t->layers,
                 (unsigned long long)(pool_va + lv0off), (unsigned long long)len,
                 (unsigned long long)pool_va, (unsigned long long)lv0off, (unsigned long long)lsz,
                 hx, r16, r1k, m40e_nz(b1k, r1k), r1k);
}
/* 邻域启发：base ±256 KB（夹在池 [pool, pool+len) 内）找第一个「首 4 KB 非零」的 64 KB 对齐块。 */
static void m40e_near(uint32_t id, uint64_t pool_va, uint64_t len, uint64_t off0)
{
    static uint8_t nb[4096];
    if (!m40e_near_claim(id)) return;
    uint64_t cur = pool_va + off0, lo, hi;
    lo = cur > 262144ull ? cur - 262144ull : pool_va;
    hi = pool_va + len;
    if (cur + 262144ull < hi) hi = cur + 262144ull;
    lo = (lo + 0xFFFFull) & ~0xFFFFull;
    if (lo < pool_va) lo = pool_va;
    uint32_t scanned = 0;
    for (uint64_t a = lo; a < hi; a += 65536ull) {
        uint32_t rd = r_guest_copy(nb, a, 4096u);
        scanned++;
        if (rd < 4096u) continue;
        uint32_t nz = m40e_nz(nb, 4096u);
        if (nz && a != (cur & ~0xFFFFull)) {
            vk_boot_logf("[m40e] near id=%u alt_base=%#llx delta=%lld nz4k=%u/4096 scanned=%u self=%#llx",
                         id, (unsigned long long)a, (long long)(a - cur), nz, scanned,
                         (unsigned long long)cur);
            return;
        }
    }
    vk_boot_logf("[m40e] near id=%u alt_base=none nz4k=0/4096 scanned=%u self=%#llx win=[%#llx,%#llx)",
                 id, scanned, (unsigned long long)cur, (unsigned long long)lo, (unsigned long long)hi);
}
/* 每层（= 立方体每个面，lv0 才对得上 dump 的 f<la>）：地址 + 客体/解排布后内容。 */
static void m40e_lay_line(uint32_t id, unsigned la, unsigned lv, int occ, uint64_t addr, uint64_t off,
                          unsigned rb, unsigned rows, unsigned slices, const uint8_t *lin, uint64_t need)
{
    static uint8_t gb[65536];
    uint8_t g16[16] = {0}; char gh[40] = {0}, lh[40] = {0};
    uint32_t rg = r_guest_copy(g16, addr, 16u);
    uint32_t gwant = (uint32_t)(need < 65536ull ? need : 65536ull);
    uint32_t rdg = r_guest_copy(gb, addr, gwant);
    m40e_hex(gh, sizeof gh, g16);
    m40e_hex(lh, sizeof lh, lin);
    m40e_lay_lines++;
