    at.initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL;
    at.finalLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL;
    VkAttachmentReference ar = { 0, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL };
    VkSubpassDescription sp = {0};
    sp.pipelineBindPoint = VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS;
    sp.colorAttachmentCount = 1; sp.pColorAttachments = &ar;
    VkSubpassDependency dep = {0};
    dep.srcSubpass = VK_SUBPASS_EXTERNAL; dep.dstSubpass = 0;
    dep.srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT;
    dep.dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT;
    dep.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT;
    dep.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT;
    VkRenderPassCreateInfo rpi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDER_PASS_CREATE_INFO };
    rpi.attachmentCount = 1; rpi.pAttachments = &at;
    rpi.subpassCount = 1;    rpi.pSubpasses = &sp;
    rpi.dependencyCount = 1; rpi.pDependencies = &dep;
    VkResult rv = vkCreateRenderPass(g_dev, &rpi, NULL, &g_r_rp);
    if (rv != VK_SUCCESS) { vk_boot_logf("[r-red] draw vkCreateRenderPass rv=%d (%s)", (int)rv, vr(rv)); return 0; }
    {   /* 同名离屏视图，但要为本 render pass 单独建一个 framebuffer（framebuffer 与 renderPass 同体）。
           M4c：这里建的是**宿主兜底**那张（1280x720）；游戏 RT 的同类 framebuffer 由 h_rt_fbload_ensure
           在 draw 入口惰性建（尺寸/视图都随当前目标）。 */
        VkFramebufferCreateInfo fbi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FRAMEBUFFER_CREATE_INFO };
        fbi.renderPass = g_r_rp;
        fbi.attachmentCount = 1; fbi.pAttachments = &g_host_view;
        fbi.width = h_off_w(); fbi.height = h_off_h(); fbi.layers = 1;   /* M40AR：跟随兜底图实际尺寸 */
        rv = vkCreateFramebuffer(g_dev, &fbi, NULL, &g_r_fb);
        if (rv != VK_SUCCESS) { vk_boot_logf("[r-red] draw vkCreateFramebuffer rv=%d (%s)", (int)rv, vr(rv)); return 0; }
        if (g_rt_cur) { g_host_fb_load = g_r_fb; g_r_fb = NULL; }   /* 宿主图先存起来，别抢当前目标的 */
        else g_host_fb_load = g_r_fb;
    }

    /* UBO arena 由 r_ubo_ensure() 惰性创建（第一次 BIND_UNIFORM_BUFFERS 就会建，
       因为 bind 早于第一笔 draw，不能等 r_common_ensure）。 */
    if (!r_ubo_ensure()) return 0;

    /* 1x1 占位纹理（白色）+ 线性采样器 */
    VkMemoryRequirements rq;
    int ti;
    VkMemoryAllocateInfo ai;
    VkImageCreateInfo ii = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO };
    ii.imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D;
    ii.format = VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
    ii.extent = (VkExtent3D){ 1, 1, 1 };
    ii.mipLevels = 1; ii.arrayLayers = 1;
    ii.samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
    ii.tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL;
    ii.usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT;
    ii.initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
    atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_beat_img, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
    m40p_hit(4, 0, 1, 1, (int)VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM);   /* M40P：rcom 桶 */
    rv = vkCreateImage(g_dev, &ii, NULL, &g_r_tex);
    if (rv != VK_SUCCESS) { vk_boot_logf("[r-red] placeholder vkCreateImage rv=%d (%s)", (int)rv, vr(rv)); return 0; }
    vkGetImageMemoryRequirements(g_dev, g_r_tex, &rq);
    ti = find_type(rq, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT);
    ai = (VkMemoryAllocateInfo){ VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO };
    ai.allocationSize = rq.size; ai.memoryTypeIndex = ti >= 0 ? (uint32_t)ti : 0;
    rv = vkAllocateMemory(g_dev, &ai, NULL, &g_r_tex_mem);
    if (rv != VK_SUCCESS) { vk_boot_logf("[r-red] placeholder vkAllocateMemory rv=%d (%s)", (int)rv, vr(rv)); return 0; }
    vkBindImageMemory(g_dev, g_r_tex, g_r_tex_mem, 0);
    {   /* 清成白色（1x1 全图 = 一次 clear，不必走 staging） */
        VkCommandBuffer cb = NULL;
        VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo ca = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO };
        ca.commandPool = g_h_cp; ca.level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY; ca.commandBufferCount = 1;
        if (vkAllocateCommandBuffers(g_dev, &ca, &cb) != VK_SUCCESS) { vk_boot_logf("[r-red] placeholder cb alloc failed"); return 0; }
        VkCommandBufferBeginInfo cbi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO };
        cbi.flags = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT;
        vkBeginCommandBuffer(cb, &cbi);
        VkImageSubresourceRange rng = { VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1 };
        VkImageMemoryBarrier b = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER };
        b.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
        b.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
        b.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL;
        b.srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED; b.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
        b.image = g_r_tex; b.subresourceRange = rng;
        beat_cmd();
        vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TOP_OF_PIPE_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, 0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &b);
        VkClearColorValue cv; memset(&cv, 0, sizeof cv);
        cv.float32[0] = 1.0f; cv.float32[1] = 1.0f; cv.float32[2] = 1.0f; cv.float32[3] = 1.0f;
        {   /* M4bj P1：空槽占位 = 1x1 白（不是洋红）—— 落一行，免得把「采样到白」误判成洋红来源 */
            static int k_once;
            if (!k_once) { k_once = 1;
                vk_boot_logf("[k] clear tgt=placeholder key=0 img=%#llx ext=1x1 rgba=1.000,1.000,1.000,1.000 "
                             "src=ours after_draw=0 f=0 (空槽采样源 = 1x1 白)",
                             (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_r_tex); }
        }
        beat_cmd();
        vkCmdClearColorImage(cb, g_r_tex, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, &cv, 1, &rng);
        b = (VkImageMemoryBarrier){ VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER };
        b.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
        b.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT;
        b.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL;
        b.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL;
        b.srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED; b.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
        b.image = g_r_tex; b.subresourceRange = rng;
        beat_cmd();
        vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT, 0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &b);
        vkEndCommandBuffer(cb);
        VkSubmitInfo si = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO };
        si.commandBufferCount = 1; si.pCommandBuffers = &cb;
        vkResetFences(g_dev, 1, &g_h_fence);
        VkResult sr = vkQueueSubmit(g_q, 1, &si, g_h_fence);
        VkResult wrp = VK_NOT_READY;
        if (sr == VK_SUCCESS) wrp = nvk_wait_fences(g_dev, 1, &g_h_fence, VK_TRUE, 5000000000ull);
        else vk_boot_logf("[r-red] placeholder submit rv=%d (%s)", (int)sr, vr(sr));
        cb_free_if_done(g_h_cp, &cb, (sr == VK_SUCCESS) ? wrp : VK_SUCCESS, "placeholder");
    }
    VkImageViewCreateInfo vi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO };
    vi.image = g_r_tex; vi.viewType = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D; vi.format = VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
    vi.components = (VkComponentMapping){ VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_IDENTITY, VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_IDENTITY,
                                          VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_IDENTITY, VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_IDENTITY };
    vi.subresourceRange = (VkImageSubresourceRange){ VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1 };
    rv = vkCreateImageView(g_dev, &vi, NULL, &g_r_tex_view);
    if (rv != VK_SUCCESS) { vk_boot_logf("[r-red] placeholder vkCreateImageView rv=%d", (int)rv); return 0; }
    VkSamplerCreateInfo sci = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SAMPLER_CREATE_INFO };
    sci.magFilter = VK_FILTER_LINEAR; sci.minFilter = VK_FILTER_LINEAR;
    sci.addressModeU = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_REPEAT;
    sci.addressModeV = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_REPEAT;
    sci.addressModeW = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_REPEAT;
    rv = vkCreateSampler(g_dev, &sci, NULL, &g_r_smp);
    if (rv != VK_SUCCESS) { vk_boot_logf("[r-red] placeholder vkCreateSampler rv=%d", (int)rv); return 0; }
    /* M3y P2：真实纹理采样器。策略按派活单「最近邻 + REPEAT」：NEAREST/NEAREST，maxLod=0。
       为什么 maxLod=0：上传只做 level 0（nvn_vk_tex_upload_storage 逐级但池里只填了 level 0 的字节，
       其余 level 未定义），若让 LOD 爬到 mip 层就会采到未初始化内容——不是「真实纹理」。 */
    { VkSamplerCreateInfo ts = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SAMPLER_CREATE_INFO };
      ts.magFilter = VK_FILTER_NEAREST; ts.minFilter = VK_FILTER_NEAREST;
      ts.mipmapMode = VK_SAMPLER_MIPMAP_MODE_NEAREST;
      ts.addressModeU = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_REPEAT;
      ts.addressModeV = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_REPEAT;
      ts.addressModeW = VK_SAMPLER_ADDRESS_MODE_REPEAT;
      ts.minLod = 0.0f; ts.maxLod = 0.0f;
      rv = vkCreateSampler(g_dev, &ts, NULL, &g_r_tx_smp_real);
      if (rv != VK_SUCCESS) { vk_boot_logf("[r-red] tex sampler rv=%d", (int)rv); g_r_tx_smp_real = VK_NULL_HANDLE; } }

    /* M3x P2：512 → 32768 sets。8192 键 × 最多 2 stage ≈ 16384 个描述符集，512 会在头 1 秒耗尽，
       之后所有 vkAllocateDescriptorSets 失败 ⇒ 管线建不出来 ⇒ draws 全 skip。
       描述符计数按「每个 set 最多 32 UBO + 8 sampler + 2 个固定 UBO」的上界给。 */
    VkDescriptorPoolSize ps[4] = {
        { VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER_DYNAMIC, 32768 * 8 },
        { VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER,         32768 * 2 },
        { VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, 32768 * 8 } };
    /* M7D5：smo_dspool=1 时追加 STORAGE_BUFFER（binding 17 / gmem）。关掉时 poolSizeCount 仍是 3，
       池子与旧行为逐字节一致。M7D4 的 [dsd] 已证：setLayout 里有池子没声明的类型 ⇒
       vkAllocateDescriptorSets 直接返 VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_POOL_MEMORY(-1000069000)。 */
    uint32_t nps = 3;
    if (m7d5_pool()) {
        ps[3].type = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER;
        ps[3].descriptorCount = 32768u * 8u;
        nps = 4;
        vk_boot_logf("[m7d5] dspool ON: +STORAGE_BUFFER x%u (binding 17 gmem), maxSets=32768", ps[3].descriptorCount);
    }
    VkDescriptorPoolCreateInfo dpi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_POOL_CREATE_INFO };
    dpi.maxSets = 65536; dpi.poolSizeCount = nps; dpi.pPoolSizes = ps;   /* M40AN：M25A_DS_SLOTS 4→32 ⇒ set 数上限翻倍 */
    rv = vkCreateDescriptorPool(g_dev, &dpi, NULL, &g_r_dpool);
    if (rv != VK_SUCCESS) { vk_boot_logf("[r-red] draw vkCreateDescriptorPool rv=%d (%s)", (int)rv, vr(rv)); return 0; }

    g_r_common_state = 1;
    vk_boot_logf("[r] draw common ok rp=%#llx ubo=%#llx tex=%#llx (UBO zero-fill, tex 1x1 white: placeholders)",
                 (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_r_rp, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_r_ubo,
                 (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_r_tex);
    return 1;
}

/* ---- M4r P1：深度附件 render pass / framebuffer / 管线变体选择 ----
   var 编号（与 r_pipe_var 的管线变体一一对应）：
     0 = 仅颜色（g_r_rp，M4c 原样，**一行不改**）
     1 = 颜色 + D32_SFLOAT        2 = 颜色 + X8_D24_UNORM_PACK32
     3 = 仅 D32_SFLOAT（n=0 纯深度 pass）  4 = 仅 X8_D24_UNORM_PACK32
   深度 loadOp=CLEAR(1.0)/storeOp=STORE：新图 initialLayout=UNDEFINED，清到远平面后
   「没被画过」= 1.0，「被画过」< 1.0 —— 回读探针就靠这个比例证明深度真的被写了。
   颜色附件与 g_r_rp 完全同参（LOAD/STORE/CAO→CAO），所以开深度不会改变颜色语义。 */
static VkRenderPass g_r_rp_d[5];
static unsigned g_h_dp_attach_log;
static int h_rp_depth(int var)
{
    if (var < 1 || var > 4) return 0;
    if (g_r_rp_d[var]) return 1;
    if (!g_dev) return 0;
    VkFormat df = (var == 1 || var == 3) ? VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT : VK_FORMAT_X8_D24_UNORM_PACK32;
    int wc = (var <= 2);
    VkAttachmentDescription at[2]; memset(at, 0, sizeof at);
    uint32_t na = 0;
    if (wc) {
        at[0].format = VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
        at[0].samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
        at[0].loadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_LOAD;
        at[0].storeOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_STORE;
        at[0].stencilLoadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_DONT_CARE;
        at[0].stencilStoreOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_DONT_CARE;
        at[0].initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL;
        at[0].finalLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL;
        na = 1;
    }
    at[na].format = df;
    at[na].samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
    /* M4t P3：CLEAR → LOAD。清屏改由 h_depth_clear_frame 每帧显式做一次（见该函数注释）；
       否则每笔 pass 都会把跨 pass 的深度历史抹掉（dsig #2 的 100% 1.0 就是这么来的）。 */
    at[na].loadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_LOAD;
    at[na].storeOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_STORE;
    at[na].stencilLoadOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_LOAD_OP_DONT_CARE;
    at[na].stencilStoreOp = VK_ATTACHMENT_STORE_OP_DONT_CARE;
    at[na].initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL;
    at[na].finalLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL;
    VkAttachmentReference ar = { 0, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL };
    VkAttachmentReference dr = { na, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL };
    VkSubpassDescription sp = {0};
    sp.pipelineBindPoint = VK_PIPELINE_BIND_POINT_GRAPHICS;
    sp.colorAttachmentCount = wc ? 1u : 0u;
    sp.pColorAttachments = wc ? &ar : NULL;
    sp.pDepthStencilAttachment = &dr;
    VkSubpassDependency dep = {0};
    dep.srcSubpass = VK_SUBPASS_EXTERNAL; dep.dstSubpass = 0;
    dep.srcStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT | VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_EARLY_FRAGMENT_TESTS_BIT;
    dep.dstStageMask = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT | VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_EARLY_FRAGMENT_TESTS_BIT;
    dep.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT | VK_ACCESS_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT;
    dep.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT |
                        VK_ACCESS_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT;
    VkRenderPassCreateInfo rpi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDER_PASS_CREATE_INFO };
    rpi.attachmentCount = na + 1; rpi.pAttachments = at;
    rpi.subpassCount = 1; rpi.pSubpasses = &sp;
    rpi.dependencyCount = 1; rpi.pDependencies = &dep;
    VkResult rv = vkCreateRenderPass(g_dev, &rpi, NULL, &g_r_rp_d[var]);
    if (rv != VK_SUCCESS) {
        g_r_rp_d[var] = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        vk_boot_logf("[r-red] depth renderpass var=%d fmt=%d rv=%d (%s)", var, (int)df, (int)rv, vr(rv));
        return 0;
    }
    vk_boot_logf("[h] rp depth var=%d rp=%#llx attachments=%u color=%d dfmt=%d",
                 var, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_r_rp_d[var], na + 1, wc, (int)df);
    return 1;
}

/* framebuffer 缓存：按 (颜色视图, 深度视图) 取。**不销毁**——M4q boot#1 的教训是会话内销毁
   可能让已提交 CB 引用到已释放对象；这里尺寸集合很小（≤8 种），宁可留着。 */
typedef struct { VkImageView cv, dv; VkFramebuffer fb; } h_fbd_e;
static h_fbd_e g_fbd[48];
static int g_fbd_n;

static VkFramebuffer h_fb_color_depth(h_rt_slot *s, h_d_slot *ds)
{
    if (!s || !ds || !s->view || !ds->view) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    if (s->w != ds->w || s->h != ds->h) {           /* 尺寸不一致：挂上去就是越界，宁可不挂 */
        if (g_h_dp_skip++ < 4)
            vk_boot_logf("[h] rp depth skip ext mismatch color=%ux%u depth=%ux%u",
                         (unsigned)s->w, (unsigned)s->h, (unsigned)ds->w, (unsigned)ds->h);
        return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    }
    int var = 1 + ((ds->vf == VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT) ? 0 : 1);
    if (!h_rp_depth(var)) { g_h_dp_skip++; return VK_NULL_HANDLE; }
    for (int i = 0; i < g_fbd_n; i++)
        if (g_fbd[i].cv == s->view && g_fbd[i].dv == ds->view) return g_fbd[i].fb;
    if (g_fbd_n >= (int)(sizeof g_fbd / sizeof *g_fbd)) { g_h_dp_skip++; return VK_NULL_HANDLE; }
    VkImageView views[2] = { s->view, ds->view };
    VkFramebufferCreateInfo fbi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FRAMEBUFFER_CREATE_INFO };
    fbi.renderPass = g_r_rp_d[var];
    fbi.attachmentCount = 2; fbi.pAttachments = views;
    fbi.width = s->w; fbi.height = s->h; fbi.layers = 1;
    VkFramebuffer fb = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    if (vkCreateFramebuffer(g_dev, &fbi, NULL, &fb) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        g_h_dp_skip++;
        vk_boot_logf("[h-red] rp depth fb create var=%d ext=%ux%u failed", var, (unsigned)s->w, (unsigned)s->h);
        return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    }
    g_fbd[g_fbd_n].cv = s->view; g_fbd[g_fbd_n].dv = ds->view; g_fbd[g_fbd_n].fb = fb;
    g_fbd_n++;
    if (g_h_dp_attach_log++ < 8)
        vk_boot_logf("[h] rp depth attach #%u fmt=%#x(0x%x) w=%u h=%u var=%d fb=%#llx test=LEQUAL write=1 clear=1.0",
                     (unsigned)g_h_dp_attach_log, (unsigned)ds->vf, ds->fmt,
                     (unsigned)s->w, (unsigned)s->h, var, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)fb);
    return fb;
}

static VkFramebuffer h_fb_depth_only(h_d_slot *ds)
{
    if (!ds || !ds->view) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    if (ds->fb_do) return ds->fb_do;
    int var = 3 + ((ds->vf == VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT) ? 0 : 1);
    if (!h_rp_depth(var)) { g_h_dp_skip++; return VK_NULL_HANDLE; }
    VkFramebufferCreateInfo fbi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FRAMEBUFFER_CREATE_INFO };
    fbi.renderPass = g_r_rp_d[var];
    fbi.attachmentCount = 1; fbi.pAttachments = &ds->view;
    fbi.width = ds->w; fbi.height = ds->h; fbi.layers = 1;
    if (vkCreateFramebuffer(g_dev, &fbi, NULL, &ds->fb_do) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        ds->fb_do = VK_NULL_HANDLE; g_h_dp_skip++;
        vk_boot_logf("[h-red] rp depth-only fb create var=%d ext=%ux%u failed", var, (unsigned)ds->w, (unsigned)ds->h);
        return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    }
    if (g_h_dp_attach_log++ < 8)
        vk_boot_logf("[h] rp depth attach #%u fmt=%#x(0x%x) w=%u h=%u var=%d fb=%#llx test=LEQUAL write=1 clear=1.0 (depth-only)",
                     (unsigned)g_h_dp_attach_log, (unsigned)ds->vf, ds->fmt,
                     (unsigned)ds->w, (unsigned)ds->h, var, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)ds->fb_do);
    return ds->fb_do;
}

/* ---------------- M4bm P1（只读）：帧内 CLEAR_* 与 DRAW_* 的提交顺序表 ----------------
   目的：判「深度清零为什么排在 draw 之后」（`[d] depth rp` 的 lastclear_after_draw=1）。
   纯只读：不改任何 Vulkan 命令，只按帧记事件序。
   事件来源：C = 游戏 CLEAR_COLOR（nvn_vk_clear_color_offscreen_frame）、
             Z = 我们补的每帧深度清零（h_depth_clear_frame）、
             D = 真实 draw（nvn_vk_draw_elements；color/depth 由 dvar 区分）。
   帧号 = dm_frame_anchor（WindowAcquireTexture 计数）。打印口径（合计 ≤3 帧，每帧前 24 项）：
     ① 含深度清零且含 draw 的前 2 帧；② 含后处理 FS 75f5ae48（洋红满屏 quad）的第 1 帧。
   另打累计行：帧总数 / 「本帧出现过 clear 晚于 draw」的帧数 / 「同帧多次 clear」的帧数。 */
#define FO_MAX 24
typedef struct {
    unsigned long long fr;
    int n, total;
    int ncc, ncd, nd, ndd;
    int first_after;        /* 本帧第一笔「clear 之前已有 draw」的序号（-1 = 无） */
    int cc_after_draw, cd_after_draw;
    int post;               /* 本帧出现过 FS 75f5ae48 */
    unsigned long long dkey0; int dkey0_n;
    char it[FO_MAX][76];
} fo_t;
static fo_t g_fo;
static int g_fo_have;
static unsigned g_fo_printed, g_fo_printed_post;
static unsigned long long g_fo_frames, g_fo_frames_cad, g_fo_frames_multi;
static void fo_flush(void)
{
    if (!g_fo_have) return;
    g_fo_have = 0;
    if (!g_fo.total) return;
    g_fo_frames++;
    if (g_fo.first_after >= 0) g_fo_frames_cad++;
    if (g_fo.ncc > 1 || g_fo.dkey0_n > 1) g_fo_frames_multi++;
    if (g_fo_frames == 120 || g_fo_frames == 600)
        vk_boot_logf("[t] frame order totals frames=%llu clr_after_draw_frames=%llu multi_clear_frames=%llu printed=%u/%u",
                     g_fo_frames, g_fo_frames_cad, g_fo_frames_multi, g_fo_printed, g_fo_printed_post);
    int want = 0;
    if (g_fo_printed < 2 && g_fo.ncd >= 1 && g_fo.nd >= 1) want = 1;
    else if (g_fo.post && g_fo_printed_post < 1) want = 2;
    if (!want) return;
    if (want == 1) g_fo_printed++; else g_fo_printed_post++;
    char line[2048]; int o = 0;
    o += snprintf(line + o, sizeof line - (size_t)o,
                  "[t] frame order f=%llu ops=%d cc=%d cd=%d draw=%d draw_d=%d "
                  "cc_after_draw=%d cd_after_draw=%d first_after@%d dz_same_key=%d post=%d ::",
                  g_fo.fr, g_fo.total, g_fo.ncc, g_fo.ncd, g_fo.nd, g_fo.ndd,
                  g_fo.cc_after_draw, g_fo.cd_after_draw, g_fo.first_after, g_fo.dkey0_n, g_fo.post);
    for (int i = 0; i < g_fo.n && o < (int)sizeof line - 90; i++)
        o += snprintf(line + o, sizeof line - (size_t)o, " |%d:%s", i, g_fo.it[i]);
    if (g_fo.total > g_fo.n)
        o += snprintf(line + o, sizeof line - (size_t)o, " |+%d more", g_fo.total - g_fo.n);
    vk_boot_logf("%s", line);
}
/* kind: 0=CLEAR_COLOR 1=CLEAR_DEPTH 2=DRAW(color) 3=DRAW(depth) */
static void fo_note(int kind, const char *txt, int is_post, unsigned long long dkey)
{
    unsigned long long fr = dm_frame_anchor_get ? dm_frame_anchor_get() : 0ull;
    if (g_fo_have && fr != g_fo.fr) fo_flush();
    if (!g_fo_have) { memset(&g_fo, 0, sizeof g_fo); g_fo.fr = fr; g_fo.first_after = -1; g_fo_have = 1; }
    int idx = g_fo.total++;
    if (idx < FO_MAX) {
        snprintf(g_fo.it[idx], sizeof g_fo.it[0], "%s", txt);
        g_fo.n = idx + 1;   /* M4bm fix：否则逐项列表恒空（boot#1 实测 |+N more） */
    }
    if (kind == 0) {
        g_fo.ncc++;
        if (g_fo.nd || g_fo.ndd) { g_fo.cc_after_draw++; if (g_fo.first_after < 0) g_fo.first_after = idx; }
    } else if (kind == 1) {
        g_fo.ncd++;
        if (g_fo.ndd) { g_fo.cd_after_draw++; if (g_fo.first_after < 0) g_fo.first_after = idx; }
        if (!g_fo.dkey0) { g_fo.dkey0 = dkey; g_fo.dkey0_n = 1; }
        else if (dkey == g_fo.dkey0) g_fo.dkey0_n++;
    } else {
        g_fo.nd++;
        if (kind == 3) g_fo.ndd++;
    }
    if (is_post) g_fo.post = 1;
}

/* draw 前把深度图切到 DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL（记在本批次 CB 里，先于 renderPass）。
   M4t P3：**不再靠 renderPass 的 loadOp=CLEAR 清深度**。
   为什么改（m4s_b2 的 dsig #2 就是这个现象）：旧实现把深度附件写成
   `loadOp=CLEAR + clearDepth=1.0`（:2838/:5077）⇒ 任何一笔 pass 开始都会把整张深度抹平。
   dsig #1（首笔深度 draw 后）读到 `one=30.9% lt1=69.1%`，21 s 后同 key/ext/fmt 的 dsig #2 读到
   `one=1440000(100%) min=-1.0 max=-1.0`——`-1.0` 只是打印侧哨兵（没有任何非 1.0 像素时 min 保持 2.0），
   真正发生的是「两次取样之间又开过 pass，深度被清成 1.0」。NVN 侧也没有 CLEAR_DEPTH_STENCIL opcode
   （opcode 直方图 15 种里没有它），所以深度本就该跨 pass 保留。
   现在：内容保留（loadOp=LOAD），清零改成 **每帧一次** 的显式 vkCmdClearDepthStencilImage。
   「帧」取 dm_frame_anchor（acquire 计数）；拿不到（x86 壳/weak 未链接，恒 0）就退回旧行为
   （每个 pass 都清），不会留下未定义内容。 */
static unsigned long long g_d_clears, g_d_clear_frames;
/* M4bl P1（只读）：深度清零与深度 draw 的先后关系。供 [d] depth rp 的 lastclear_after_draw 判据。 */
static unsigned long long g_d_drw_since_clear;
static int g_d_last_clear_after_draw;
static void h_depth_clear_frame(VkCommandBuffer cb, h_d_slot *ds, int force)
{
    if (!ds || !ds->img) return;
    unsigned long long fr = dm_frame_anchor_get ? dm_frame_anchor_get() : 0ull;
    if (!force && fr && ds->clr_done && ds->clr_frame == fr) return;   /* 本帧已清：直接进附件态 */
    VkImageSubresourceRange rng = { VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1 };
    VkImageMemoryBarrier b = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER };
    b.srcAccessMask = 0;
    b.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
    b.oldLayout = ds->layout;
    b.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL;
    b.srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED; b.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
    b.image = ds->img; b.subresourceRange = rng;
    beat_cmd();
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT,
                         0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &b);
    VkClearDepthStencilValue cv = { 1.0f, 0 };
    beat_cmd();
    vkCmdClearDepthStencilImage(cb, ds->img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, &cv, 1, &rng);
    b = (VkImageMemoryBarrier){ VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER };
    b.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
    b.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT;
    b.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL;
    b.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL;
    b.srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED; b.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
    b.image = ds->img; b.subresourceRange = rng;
    beat_cmd();
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_EARLY_FRAGMENT_TESTS_BIT,
                         0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &b);
    ds->layout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL;
    if (ds->clr_done && ds->clr_frame != fr) g_d_clear_frames++;
    ds->clr_frame = fr; ds->clr_done = 1;
    g_d_clears++;
    /* M4bm P1（只读）：把这次清零点名进本帧的时序表。 */
    { char t[76];
      snprintf(t, sizeof t, "Z depth key=%#llx ext=%ux%u force=%d",
               (unsigned long long)ds->key, (unsigned)ds->w, (unsigned)ds->h, force);
      fo_note(1, t, 0, (unsigned long long)ds->key); }
    /* M4bl P1：clear 与 draw 的先后（clear 时若本帧已有深度 draw ⇒ 这批深度已被抹掉） */
    g_d_last_clear_after_draw = g_d_drw_since_clear > 0 ? 1 : 0;
    g_d_drw_since_clear = 0;
    if (g_d_clears <= 6)
        vk_boot_logf("[h] depth clear #%llu frame=%llu key=%#llx ext=%ux%u fmt=0x%x persist=%d",
                     g_d_clears, fr, (unsigned long long)ds->key, (unsigned)ds->w, (unsigned)ds->h,
                     ds->fmt, fr ? 1 : 0);
}

/* 本次 draw 的 (renderPass, framebuffer)。返回 0 = 拿不到（调用方回落 var 0）。 */
static int h_draw_target(int var, h_d_slot *ds, VkRenderPass *rp, VkFramebuffer *fb)
{
    if (var == 0) {
        /* M4s 检测器（只取证不改行为）：期望的 framebuffer = 当前目标自己的 fb_load。
           不相等 ⇒ g_r_fb 还是**上一个目标**的（槽首次使用时 fb_load 仍为 NULL 的那一支）。
           这种「跨目标复用」会让本笔 draw 落进别的图，同时 renderArea 是新目标尺寸 ⇒ 越界/裁剪。 */
        VkFramebuffer expect = g_rt_cur ? g_rt_cur->fb_load : g_host_fb_load;
        if (g_r_fb && g_r_fb != expect) {
            g_r_fb_stale++;
            if (g_r_fb_stale <= 8)
                vk_boot_logf("[h] fb stale #%llu cur=%s ext=%ux%u fb_owner_ext=%ux%u (draw 会落进上一个目标的图)",
                             g_r_fb_stale, g_rt_cur ? "gameRT" : "hostRT",
                             (unsigned)g_rt_w, (unsigned)g_rt_h, (unsigned)g_r_fb_w, (unsigned)g_r_fb_h);
        }
        /* M4s boot#1 实测：这条「跨目标复用」在开机前 2 s 内就命中了 8 次以上（只记前 8 条）。
           修法：**无条件**按当前目标取 fb（拿不到就置空，让 h_rt_fbload_ensure 为当前视图建）。
           旧行为只在「当前槽 fb_load 非空」时才拨，槽首次使用时会把上一张目标的 framebuffer 留下来。 */
        if (!g_rt_cur) { g_r_fb = g_host_fb_load; g_r_fb_owner = NULL; g_r_fb_w = h_off_w(); g_r_fb_h = h_off_h(); }   /* M40AR */
        else if (g_rt_cur->fb_load) { g_r_fb = g_rt_cur->fb_load; g_r_fb_owner = g_rt_cur; g_r_fb_w = g_rt_cur->w; g_r_fb_h = g_rt_cur->h; }
        else g_r_fb = VK_NULL_HANDLE;      /* 当前目标还没有 fb_load ⇒ 必须为它新建，不许沿用别人的 */
        if (!h_rt_fbload_ensure()) return 0;
        *rp = g_r_rp; *fb = g_r_fb;
        return 1;
    }
    if (var <= 2) {
        if (!g_rt_cur) return 0;
        VkFramebuffer f = h_fb_color_depth(g_rt_cur, ds);
        if (!f) return 0;
        *rp = g_r_rp_d[var]; *fb = f;
        return 1;
    }
    { VkFramebuffer f = h_fb_depth_only(ds);
      if (!f) return 0;
      *rp = g_r_rp_d[var]; *fb = f;
      return 1; }
}

/* ---- 每个 key 的描述符集：cbuf_mask 的每个 bit = binding b（UNIFORM_BUFFER_DYNAMIC），
        纹理 = binding 32+i（COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER）。与离线翻译器的 GLSL 声明一一对应
        （glsl: layout(std140,set=0|1,binding=<cbuf号>) / layout(set,binding=32+i) sampler2D）。 ---- */
/* ---- M7D4（2026-11-07）：descriptor-set 失败的归因探针（开关 smo_dsdiag，C 默认 0） ----
   `[r] pipe fail step=ds` 只能说明 r_ds_ensure 返 0，回答不了「是哪一条判据 / 要了多少描述符 /
   池子还剩多少」。这里在 r_ds_ensure 的四个出口各记一笔，并在首个失败键上把**布局构成**
   （nb / cbuf 位数 / ntex / rscale / tint / gmem）与 vkAllocateDescriptorSets 的 rv 一起打出来。
   只读计数 + 限流日志（首 16 个键各 1 行、每 512 次调用 1 行汇总），不改变任何返回值。 */
#define DSD_PATH_A "/data/storage/el2/base/files/smo_dsdiag"
#define DSD_PATH_B "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files/smo_dsdiag"
static int dsd_on(void)
{
    static int v = -1; static unsigned long long t0, t;
    struct timespec ts;
    t = (clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts) == 0)
        ? (unsigned long long)ts.tv_sec * 1000ull + (unsigned long long)(ts.tv_nsec / 1000000L) : 0;
    if (v < 0 || t >= t0 + 2000ull) {
        char b[8]; FILE *f; v = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
            if ((f = fopen(i ? DSD_PATH_B : DSD_PATH_A, "r"))) {
                size_t n = fread(b, 1, sizeof b - 1, f); fclose(f);
                v = (n > 0 && b[0] == '1'); break;
            }
        t0 = t;
    }
    return v;
}
/* 开关文件必须由 app 自己先创建（hdc 无法在沙箱里新建文件），构造器只建不覆盖。 */
__attribute__((constructor)) static void dsd_seed(void)
{
    static const char *const p[2] = { DSD_PATH_A, DSD_PATH_B };
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        FILE *r = fopen(p[i], "r");
        if (r) { fclose(r); continue; }
        FILE *f = fopen(p[i], "w");
        if (f) { fputs("0\n", f); fclose(f); }
    }
}
static unsigned long long g_dsd_calls, g_dsd_ok, g_dsd_f_common, g_dsd_f_cached, g_dsd_f_layout, g_dsd_f_alloc;
static unsigned g_dsd_keys;
static struct { char key[17]; int why, rv, stage, nb, ncbuf, ntex; } g_dsd_first[16];
static void dsd_note(R_Key *k, const char *why, int rv, int nb, int ncbuf, int ntex)
{
    if (!dsd_on()) return;
    g_dsd_calls++;
    if (!why) { g_dsd_ok++; return; }
    if (!strcmp(why, "common")) g_dsd_f_common++;
    else if (!strcmp(why, "cached")) g_dsd_f_cached++;
    else if (!strcmp(why, "dsl")) g_dsd_f_layout++;
    else g_dsd_f_alloc++;
    int seen = 0;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < g_dsd_keys && i < 16; i++) if (!strcmp(g_dsd_first[i].key, k->key)) { seen = 1; break; }
    if (!seen && g_dsd_keys < 16) {
        unsigned i = g_dsd_keys++;
        snprintf(g_dsd_first[i].key, sizeof g_dsd_first[i].key, "%s", k->key);
        g_dsd_first[i].why = 1; g_dsd_first[i].rv = rv; g_dsd_first[i].stage = k->stage;
        g_dsd_first[i].nb = nb; g_dsd_first[i].ncbuf = ncbuf; g_dsd_first[i].ntex = ntex;
        vk_boot_logf("[dsd] fail key=%s stage=%d why=%s rv=%d nb=%d ncbuf=%d ntex=%d "
                     "rs=%d tint=%d gmem=%d cbuf_mask=%#x | calls=%llu ok=%llu alloc_ok_sets=%llu",
                     k->key, k->stage, why, rv, nb, ncbuf, ntex,
                     (int)k->uses_rscale, (int)k->uses_tint, (int)k->uses_gmem, k->cbuf_mask,
                     g_dsd_calls, g_dsd_ok, g_dsd_ok);
    }
    if ((g_dsd_calls % 512ull) == 0ull)
        vk_boot_logf("[dsd] totals calls=%llu ok=%llu fail_common=%llu fail_cached=%llu fail_dsl=%llu "
                     "fail_alloc=%llu keys=%u", g_dsd_calls, g_dsd_ok, g_dsd_f_common, g_dsd_f_cached,
                     g_dsd_f_layout, g_dsd_f_alloc, g_dsd_keys);
}
static int r_ds_ensure(R_Key *k)
{
    if (k->ds) { if (dsd_on()) g_dsd_ok++; return 1; }
    if (k->dsl_tried && !k->dsl) { dsd_note(k, "cached", 0, 0, 0, 0); return 0; }
    if (!g_r_common_state) { dsd_note(k, "common", 0, 0, 0, 0); return 0; }
    VkDescriptorSetLayoutBinding b[32 + NVN_TX_SLOTS + 3];
    int nb = 0;
    VkShaderStageFlags sf = (k->stage == 0) ? VK_SHADER_STAGE_VERTEX_BIT : VK_SHADER_STAGE_FRAGMENT_BIT;
    int ncbuf = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
        if (!(k->cbuf_mask & (1u << i))) continue;
        ncbuf++;
        b[nb].binding = (uint32_t)i;
        b[nb].descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER_DYNAMIC;
        b[nb].descriptorCount = 1;
        b[nb].stageFlags = sf;
        b[nb].pImmutableSamplers = NULL;
        nb++;
    }
    int ntex = k->ntex < NVN_TX_SLOTS ? k->ntex : NVN_TX_SLOTS;
    for (int i = 0; i < ntex; i++) {
        b[nb].binding = (uint32_t)(32 + i);
        b[nb].descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER;
        b[nb].descriptorCount = 1;
        b[nb].stageFlags = sf;
        b[nb].pImmutableSamplers = NULL;
        nb++;
    }
    /* M3x P1：翻译器固定资源 binding 18 (RScale) / 19 (Tint)。旧布局只建 cbuf_mask 与纹理，
       这两个不在 cbuf_mask 里 ⇒ 管线声明了 binding 却查不到描述符 ⇒ SwiftShader JIT 空指针崩。
       数据仍是零填充的 g_r_ubo[0..4096)：Tint 全零 ⇒ ltint[0].w=0 ⇒ 着色器自行跳过 tint 分支。 */
    if (k->uses_rscale) {
        b[nb].binding = 18; b[nb].descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER;
        b[nb].descriptorCount = 1; b[nb].stageFlags = sf; b[nb].pImmutableSamplers = NULL; nb++;
    }
    if (k->uses_tint) {
        b[nb].binding = 19; b[nb].descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER;
        b[nb].descriptorCount = 1; b[nb].stageFlags = sf; b[nb].pImmutableSamplers = NULL; nb++;
    }
    /* M5v P1：gmem（binding 17，std430 SSBO）。布局里**必须**有它（shader 声明了就一定被查表），
       能不能绑到真数据由 r_gm_ensure 决定；heap 起不来时下面不写描述符，并且 skip 门照旧拦掉整条管线。 */
    if (k->uses_gmem) {
        b[nb].binding = 17; b[nb].descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER;
        b[nb].descriptorCount = 1; b[nb].stageFlags = sf; b[nb].pImmutableSamplers = NULL; nb++;
    }
    if (!k->dsl_tried) {
        k->dsl_tried = 1;
        VkDescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo li = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_LAYOUT_CREATE_INFO };
        li.bindingCount = (uint32_t)nb; li.pBindings = b;
        VkResult rv = vkCreateDescriptorSetLayout(g_dev, &li, NULL, &k->dsl);
        if (rv != VK_SUCCESS) { vk_boot_logf("[r-red] dsl key=%s rv=%d (%s)", k->key, (int)rv, vr(rv)); k->dsl = VK_NULL_HANDLE; dsd_note(k, "dsl", (int)rv, nb, ncbuf, ntex); return 0; }
    }
    VkDescriptorSetAllocateInfo dai = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_DESCRIPTOR_SET_ALLOCATE_INFO };
    dai.descriptorPool = g_r_dpool;
    dai.descriptorSetCount = 1;
    dai.pSetLayouts = &k->dsl;
    VkResult rv = vkAllocateDescriptorSets(g_dev, &dai, &k->ds);
    if (rv != VK_SUCCESS) { vk_boot_logf("[r-red] ds alloc key=%s rv=%d (%s)", k->key, (int)rv, vr(rv)); k->ds = VK_NULL_HANDLE; dsd_note(k, "alloc", (int)rv, nb, ncbuf, ntex); return 0; }
    VkDescriptorBufferInfo bi = { g_r_ubo, 0, R_UBO_BYTES };
    VkDescriptorBufferInfo gmbi = { g_gm_buf, 0, g_gm_bytes };   /* M5y：范围 = 实际分配的 heap（门大小） */
    VkDescriptorImageInfo im = { g_r_smp, g_r_tex_view, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL };
    VkWriteDescriptorSet w[32 + NVN_TX_SLOTS + 3];
    int nw = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
        if (!(k->cbuf_mask & (1u << i))) continue;
        memset(&w[nw], 0, sizeof w[nw]);
        w[nw].sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WRITE_DESCRIPTOR_SET;
        w[nw].dstSet = k->ds; w[nw].dstBinding = (uint32_t)i; w[nw].descriptorCount = 1;
        w[nw].descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER_DYNAMIC;
        w[nw].pBufferInfo = &bi;
        nw++;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < ntex; i++) {
        memset(&w[nw], 0, sizeof w[nw]);
        w[nw].sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WRITE_DESCRIPTOR_SET;
        w[nw].dstSet = k->ds; w[nw].dstBinding = (uint32_t)(32 + i); w[nw].descriptorCount = 1;
        w[nw].descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER;
        w[nw].pImageInfo = &im;
        nw++;
    }
    for (int bind = 18; bind <= 19; bind++) {
        if ((bind == 18 && !k->uses_rscale) || (bind == 19 && !k->uses_tint)) continue;
        memset(&w[nw], 0, sizeof w[nw]);
        w[nw].sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WRITE_DESCRIPTOR_SET;
        w[nw].dstSet = k->ds; w[nw].dstBinding = (uint32_t)bind; w[nw].descriptorCount = 1;
        w[nw].descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_UNIFORM_BUFFER;
        w[nw].pBufferInfo = &bi;
        nw++;
    }
    /* M5v P1：binding 17 → gmem heap（合成窗口）。heap 起不来就不写（该 key 的管线随后会被 skip 门拦掉）。 */
    if (k->uses_gmem && g_gm_state > 0) {
        memset(&w[nw], 0, sizeof w[nw]);
        w[nw].sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WRITE_DESCRIPTOR_SET;
        w[nw].dstSet = k->ds; w[nw].dstBinding = 17; w[nw].descriptorCount = 1;
        w[nw].descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_STORAGE_BUFFER;
        w[nw].pBufferInfo = &gmbi;
        nw++;
    }
    if (nw) vkUpdateDescriptorSets(g_dev, (uint32_t)nw, w, 0, NULL);
    dsd_note(k, NULL, 0, nb, ncbuf, ntex);
    return 1;
}

/* ================= M4ac P1：每个 key 的「纹理槽采样维度」表 =================
   缺口（M4ab 收口）：出画面的那笔全屏三角 FS=8832429cd37c79fe 两个槽都是 OpTypeImage Cube，
   槽 1 的纹理 id=1142 却是 NVN target=4（2D_ARRAY）、6 层、128×128。我们按 2D_ARRAY 建/绑视图，
   与 shader 的采样类型不一致 ⇒ SwiftShader 不校验、退化成「层内一行/一列」采样 ⇒ 屏幕上的色带。
   修法：在写描述符前，从**该 key 自己的 SPIR-V** 反射出每槽的 OpTypeImage 维度，再按维度选视图。

   反射只扫指令头，不引入新依赖：OpDecorate(binding) → OpVariable(UniformConstant) →
   OpTypePointer →（可选 OpTypeSampledImage）→ OpTypeImage(Dim, Arrayed)。
   结果缓存在 k->slot_dim[]（slot = binding - 32），每个 key 只反射一次。 */
static const char *r_dim_name(int d)
{
    switch (d) {
    case R_DIM_1D: return "1D";
    case R_DIM_2D: return "2D";
    case R_DIM_3D: return "3D";
    case R_DIM_CUBE: return "Cube";
    case R_DIM_2D_ARRAY: return "2DArray";
    case R_DIM_CUBE_ARRAY: return "CubeArray";
    default: return "none";
    }
}
static const char *r_view_name(VkImageViewType vt)
{
    switch (vt) {
    case VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_1D: return "1D";
    case VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D: return "2D";
    case VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_3D: return "3D";
    case VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE: return "CUBE";
    case VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D_ARRAY: return "2D_ARRAY";
    case VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE_ARRAY: return "CUBE_ARRAY";
    default: return "?";
    }
}

#define R_DIM_SLOT_LEDGER_KEYS 24   /* 槽类型台账：前 24 个 key 逐槽打一行 */

static void r_slot_dim_reflect(R_Key *k)
{
    if (!k || k->dim_state) return;
    k->dim_state = -1;
    memset(k->slot_dim, 0, sizeof k->slot_dim);
    size_t n = 0;
    const uint32_t *w = (const uint32_t *)r_bin_spv(k->key, k->stage, &n);
    if (!w || n < 24) return;
    size_t words = n / 4;
    uint32_t bound = w[3];                      /* SPIR-V header：id bound */
    if (bound < 16 || bound > (1u << 18)) return;
    /* id → 各类信息（下标 0 不用）。bound 典型 ~2k，最坏 256k ⇒ 5 张表约 4.7 MB，反射完立刻释放。 */
    uint8_t  *img_dim = calloc(bound, 1);        /* OpTypeImage：Dim+Arrayed 编码（已解析） */
    int32_t  *ptr_to  = calloc(bound, sizeof(int32_t));   /* OpTypePointer → pointee type id */
    int32_t  *si_img  = calloc(bound, sizeof(int32_t));   /* OpTypeSampledImage → image type id */
    int32_t  *var_ty  = calloc(bound, sizeof(int32_t));   /* OpVariable → 指针类型 id */
    int32_t  *var_sc  = calloc(bound, sizeof(int32_t));   /* OpVariable → storage class */
    int32_t  *vbind   = calloc(bound, sizeof(int32_t));   /* 变量 id → Binding decoration */
    if (!img_dim || !ptr_to || !si_img || !var_ty || !var_sc || !vbind) goto out;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < bound; i++) { ptr_to[i] = si_img[i] = var_ty[i] = vbind[i] = -1; var_sc[i] = -1; }
    size_t i = 5;                                /* 跳过 magic/version/generator/bound/schema */
    while (i < words) {
        uint32_t op = w[i] & 0xFFFFu, len = w[i] >> 16;
        if (!len || i + len > words) break;
        switch (op) {
        case 71:   /* OpDecorate：Binding = 33（其他装饰忽略） */
            if (len >= 4 && w[i + 2] == 33u && w[i + 1] < bound) vbind[w[i + 1]] = (int32_t)w[i + 3];
            break;
        case 32:   /* OpTypePointer：result id, storage class, type id */
            if (len >= 4 && w[i + 1] < bound) ptr_to[w[i + 1]] = (int32_t)w[i + 3];
            break;
        case 27:   /* OpTypeSampledImage：result id, image type id */
            if (len >= 3 && w[i + 1] < bound) si_img[w[i + 1]] = (int32_t)w[i + 2];
            break;
        case 25:   /* OpTypeImage：result, sampled type, Dim, Depth, Arrayed, MS, Sampled, Format */
            if (len >= 9 && w[i + 1] < bound) {
                uint32_t dim = w[i + 3]; int arrayed = (int)w[i + 5];
                int d = R_DIM_NONE;
                if (dim == 0) d = R_DIM_1D;
                else if (dim == 1) d = arrayed ? R_DIM_2D_ARRAY : R_DIM_2D;
                else if (dim == 2) d = R_DIM_3D;
                else if (dim == 3) d = arrayed ? R_DIM_CUBE_ARRAY : R_DIM_CUBE;
                img_dim[w[i + 1]] = (uint8_t)d;
            }
            break;
        case 59:   /* OpVariable：result type, result id, storage class */
            if (len >= 4 && w[i + 2] < bound) {
                var_ty[w[i + 2]] = (int32_t)w[i + 1];
                var_sc[w[i + 2]] = (int32_t)w[i + 3];
            }
            break;
        default: break;
        }
        i += len;
    }
    for (uint32_t id = 0; id < bound; id++) {
        if (var_sc[id] != 0) continue;                    /* StorageClass UniformConstant = 0 */
        int32_t b = vbind[id];
        if (b < 32 || b >= 32 + NVN_TX_SLOTS) continue;   /* 只关心纹理槽 binding 32+i */
        int32_t pt = var_ty[id];
        if (pt < 0 || (uint32_t)pt >= bound) continue;
        int32_t t = ptr_to[pt];
        if (t < 0 || (uint32_t)t >= bound) continue;
        int d = img_dim[t];
        if (!d) {   /* 变量类型常是 OpTypeSampledImage（sampler2D/Cube），再解一层 */
            int32_t it = si_img[t];
            if (it >= 0 && (uint32_t)it < bound) d = img_dim[it];
        }
        if (d) k->slot_dim[b - 32] = (uint8_t)d;
    }
out:
    free(img_dim); free(ptr_to); free(si_img); free(var_ty); free(var_sc); free(vbind);
    k->dim_state = 1;   /* 反射"试过"即记 1：失败也只试一次（结果全 0 ⇒ 走旧行为） */
    int nz = 0;
    for (int s = 0; s < NVN_TX_SLOTS; s++) if (k->slot_dim[s]) nz++;
    if (!nz) return;
    g_t_dim_keys++;
    for (int s = 0; s < NVN_TX_SLOTS; s++) {
        int d = k->slot_dim[s];
        if (!d) continue;
        if (d == R_DIM_CUBE || d == R_DIM_CUBE_ARRAY) g_t_dim_slots_cube++;
        else if (d == R_DIM_2D_ARRAY) g_t_dim_slots_arr++;
        else if (d == R_DIM_2D) g_t_dim_slots_2d++;
        else g_t_dim_slots_other++;
        /* 首次见到该 (key,slot) 打一行；限流到前 N 个 key，避免每个 key 都刷屏 */
        if (g_t_dim_keys <= R_DIM_SLOT_LEDGER_KEYS)
            vk_boot_logf("[t] slotdim key=%s slot=%d dim=%s", k->key, s, r_dim_name(d));
    }
    if ((g_t_dim_keys % 64) == 0)
        vk_boot_logf("[t] slotdim totals keys=%llu cube=%llu arr=%llu 2d=%llu other=%llu",
                     g_t_dim_keys, g_t_dim_slots_cube, g_t_dim_slots_arr, g_t_dim_slots_2d, g_t_dim_slots_other);
}

/* M4ac P2：为槽选视图——维度一致就用对应的视图，拿不到维度/视图就回落到旧行为（并计数）。
   why 取值：dim（按维度选中）/ nodim（反射不到槽类型）/ rawview（裸 view 槽，无 tex 对象）/
   noview（该维度视图建不出来）/ empty（槽空，走 1x1 占位）。
   M27A：第 3 参 unit = **实际要采样的 NVN texture unit**（不是 shader 侧稠密序号）。
        取图/取 tex 对象/取 info 全部按 unit；槽维度 k->slot_dim[slot] 仍按稠密序号 slot
        （SPIR-V 的 OpTypeImage 是按 binding=32+slot 反射的）。关态/无映射时调用方传 unit==slot。 */
static VkImageView r_slot_view_pick(R_Key *k, int slot, int unit, const char **why)
{
    VkImageView base = g_r_tx_view[unit];
    *why = "empty";
    if (!base) return base;
    g_t_view_sel++;
    r_slot_dim_reflect(k);
    int dim = k->slot_dim[slot];
    if (!dim) { *why = "nodim"; g_t_view_nodim++; return base; }
    nvn_vk_tex *t = g_r_tx_texobj[unit];
    if (!t) { *why = "rawview"; g_t_view_raw++; g_t_view_fallback++; return base; }
    VkImageView v = r_tex_view_dim(t, dim);
    /* M4ad 零成本项：noview 回落必须能看出「哪张图标量/几层」——否则只剩一个计数，
       判不了是「维度不支持」还是「图本身建错了」。限流 8 条。 */
    if (!v) {
        static int noview_said;
        if (noview_said++ < 8)
            vk_boot_logf("[t] noview slot=%d want=%s id=%d w=%u h=%u layers=%u target=%d vkfmt=%u key=%s",
                         unit, r_dim_name(dim), g_r_tx_info[unit].id, t->w, t->h, t->layers,
                         (int)t->d.target, (unsigned)nvn_vk_tex_vkfmt(t), k->key);
    }
    if (!v) { *why = "noview"; g_t_view_noview++; g_t_view_fallback++; return base; }
    *why = "dim";
    if (dim == R_DIM_CUBE || dim == R_DIM_CUBE_ARRAY) g_t_view_sel_cube++;
    else if (dim == R_DIM_2D_ARRAY) g_t_view_sel_arr++;
    else if (dim == R_DIM_2D) g_t_view_sel_2d++;
    if (g_t_view_sel <= 32 || (g_t_view_sel % 2048) == 0) {
        VkImageViewType vt = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D;
        if (dim == R_DIM_CUBE || dim == R_DIM_CUBE_ARRAY) vt = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_CUBE;
        else if (dim == R_DIM_2D_ARRAY) vt = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D_ARRAY;
        vk_boot_logf("[t] view sel slot=%d dim=%s view=%s id=%d why=%s",
                     unit, r_dim_name(dim), v == t->view ? "default" : r_view_name(vt),
                     g_r_tx_info[unit].id, *why);
    }
    if ((g_t_view_sel % 2048) == 0)
        vk_boot_logf("[t] view totals sel=%llu cube=%llu arr=%llu 2d=%llu nodim=%llu raw=%llu noview=%llu "
                     "cubefail_img=%llu cubefail_view=%llu keys=%llu",
                     g_t_view_sel, g_t_view_sel_cube, g_t_view_sel_arr, g_t_view_sel_2d,
                     g_t_view_nodim, g_t_view_raw, g_t_view_noview, g_t_cubefail_img, g_t_cubefail_view,
                     g_t_dim_keys);
    return v;
}


/* ================= M26A (2026-11-08)：空纹理槽归因 + 占位图标记（只读，缺省 0） =================
   本轮 fork 已由人眼图定到 B（采样/绑定）：[m12a] tex 回读的是上传后的 VkImage，仓库自带
   bit-exact ASTC 解码器解出 id435/436 = 干净宣传图 ⇒ 0x87 解排布/上传无罪。基线（m25a c1=0）实测
   症状不是高熵噪声而是「平涂」（白底 + 纯黑剪影 + 纯红边），且既有仪表给出主线索
   `[tex] miss group3 … created_not_bound=3600(91.2%)` / `[tex] miss top … slot=5 empty=144/144
   why=never_bound id=0` / `[m7i] td … views_real=5/8`。
   要判的两件事（都不改任何真实绑定）：
     ① 空槽是「guest 曾绑过、我们记丢了」还是「从来没绑过」？
        做法：每个 (fs 键, slot) 记一条**只读**绑定史（最近一次非空 view 的指针）；
        空槽处查史：命中 → m26a_hist_hit++，未命中 → m26a_hist_miss++。
        命中多 ⇒ 是我们的绑定/描述符刷新丢的（(b)）；未命中多 ⇒ guest 侧根本没发 bind（(a)）。
     ② 屏幕上那些平涂区到底是不是「采到 1x1 白占位」？
        做法：bit0 时把空槽的绑定量从 1x1 白换成 1x1 洋红标记图。若画面照旧（无洋红）
        ⇒ 平涂不是占位采样造成 ⇒ 往下游（shader/UBO/光照）查。
   开关 smo_m26a（文件开关，缺省 0；0 时三条路径全部短路，行为逐字不变）：bit0=洋红标记。
   预算：报表跟 m5z 同节拍（每 300 submit 一行）；表 512 项；显存只多 1 张 1x1 图。 */
#define M26A_SW_A "/data/storage/el2/base/files/smo_m26a"
#define M26A_SW_B "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files/smo_m26a"
static int m26a_mode(void)
{
    static int v = -1; static unsigned long long t0, t;
    static pthread_mutex_t mu = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&mu);
    {
        struct timespec ts;
        t = (clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts) == 0)
            ? (unsigned long long)ts.tv_sec * 1000ull + (unsigned long long)(ts.tv_nsec / 1000000L) : 0;
    }
    if (v < 0 || t >= t0 + 2000ull) {
        char b[16]; FILE *f; v = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
            if ((f = fopen(i ? M26A_SW_B : M26A_SW_A, "r"))) {
                size_t n = fread(b, 1, sizeof b - 1, f); fclose(f);
                if (n > 0) v = atoi(b);
                break;
            }
        t0 = t;
    }
    { int r = v; pthread_mutex_unlock(&mu); return r; }
}
__attribute__((constructor)) static void m26a_seed(void)
{
    static const char *const p[2] = { M26A_SW_A, M26A_SW_B };
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        FILE *r = fopen(p[i], "r");
        if (r) { fclose(r); continue; }
        FILE *f = fopen(p[i], "w");
        if (f) { fputs("0\n", f); fclose(f); }
    }
}
#define M26A_LG_MAX 512
static struct { unsigned long long h; int slot; VkImageView v; } g_m26a_lg[M26A_LG_MAX];
static unsigned g_m26a_hist_hit, g_m26a_hist_miss, g_m26a_hist_rec, g_m26a_put;
static VkImageView g_m26a_mark_view; static int g_m26a_mark_tried;
static unsigned long long m26a_h(const char *s)
{
    unsigned long long h = 1469598103934665603ull;
    for (; s && *s; s++) { h ^= (unsigned char)*s; h *= 1099511628211ull; }
    return h;
}
static void m26a_lg_remember(const char *key, int slot, VkImageView v)
{
    unsigned long long h = m26a_h(key) ^ ((unsigned long long)slot << 40);
    for (int i = 0; i < M26A_LG_MAX; i++) {
        if (g_m26a_lg[i].v && g_m26a_lg[i].h == h && g_m26a_lg[i].slot == slot) { g_m26a_lg[i].v = v; return; }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < M26A_LG_MAX; i++) {
        if (!g_m26a_lg[i].v) { g_m26a_lg[i].h = h; g_m26a_lg[i].slot = slot; g_m26a_lg[i].v = v; g_m26a_hist_rec++; return; }
    }
}
static int m26a_lg_lookup(const char *key, int slot)
{
    unsigned long long h = m26a_h(key) ^ ((unsigned long long)slot << 40);
    for (int i = 0; i < M26A_LG_MAX; i++)
        if (g_m26a_lg[i].v && g_m26a_lg[i].h == h && g_m26a_lg[i].slot == slot) return 1;
    return 0;
}
/* 1x1 洋红标记图（只在 bit0 且真遇到空槽时建一次；创建失败就退回白占位，不改行为）。 */
static VkImageView m26a_mark_get(void)
{
    if (g_m26a_mark_view || g_m26a_mark_tried) return g_m26a_mark_view;
    g_m26a_mark_tried = 1;
    if (!g_dev) return VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkImage img = VK_NULL_HANDLE; VkDeviceMemory mem = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkImageCreateInfo ii = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO };
    ii.imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D; ii.format = VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
    ii.extent.width = 1; ii.extent.height = 1; ii.extent.depth = 1;
    ii.mipLevels = 1; ii.arrayLayers = 1; ii.samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
    ii.tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL;
    ii.usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT;
    ii.sharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE; ii.initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
    if (vkCreateImage(g_dev, &ii, NULL, &img) != VK_SUCCESS) { vk_boot_logf("[m26a] mark vkCreateImage FAIL"); return VK_NULL_HANDLE; }
    { VkMemoryRequirements rq; vkGetImageMemoryRequirements(g_dev, img, &rq);
      int ti = find_type(rq, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT);
      VkMemoryAllocateInfo ai = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO };
      ai.allocationSize = rq.size; ai.memoryTypeIndex = ti >= 0 ? (uint32_t)ti : 0;
      if (vkAllocateMemory(g_dev, &ai, NULL, &mem) != VK_SUCCESS) { vkDestroyImage(g_dev, img, NULL); vk_boot_logf("[m26a] mark vkAllocateMemory FAIL"); return VK_NULL_HANDLE; }
      vkBindImageMemory(g_dev, img, mem, 0); }
    { VkCommandBuffer cb = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
      VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo ca = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO };
      ca.commandPool = g_h_cp; ca.level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY; ca.commandBufferCount = 1;
      if (vkAllocateCommandBuffers(g_dev, &ca, &cb) != VK_SUCCESS) { vkDestroyImage(g_dev, img, NULL); vkFreeMemory(g_dev, mem, NULL); return VK_NULL_HANDLE; }
      VkCommandBufferBeginInfo cbi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO };
      cbi.flags = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT;
      vkBeginCommandBuffer(cb, &cbi);
      VkImageSubresourceRange rng = { VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1 };
      VkImageMemoryBarrier b = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER };
      b.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
      b.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED; b.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL;
      b.srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED; b.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
      b.image = img; b.subresourceRange = rng;
      vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TOP_OF_PIPE_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, 0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &b);
      VkClearColorValue cv; memset(&cv, 0, sizeof cv);
      cv.float32[0] = 1.0f; cv.float32[1] = 0.0f; cv.float32[2] = 1.0f; cv.float32[3] = 1.0f;
      vkCmdClearColorImage(cb, img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, &cv, 1, &rng);
      b = (VkImageMemoryBarrier){ VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER };
      b.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT; b.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT;
      b.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL; b.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL;
      b.srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED; b.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
      b.image = img; b.subresourceRange = rng;
      vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT, 0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &b);
      vkEndCommandBuffer(cb);
      VkFence fc = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
      VkFenceCreateInfo fci = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FENCE_CREATE_INFO };
      int ok = 0;
      if (vkCreateFence(g_dev, &fci, NULL, &fc) == VK_SUCCESS) {
          VkSubmitInfo si = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO };
          si.commandBufferCount = 1; si.pCommandBuffers = &cb;
          if (vkQueueSubmit(g_q, 1, &si, fc) == VK_SUCCESS && nvk_wait_fences(g_dev, 1, &fc, VK_TRUE, 5000000000ull) == VK_SUCCESS) ok = 1;
          vkDestroyFence(g_dev, fc, NULL);
      }
      vkFreeCommandBuffers(g_dev, g_h_cp, 1, &cb);
      if (!ok) { vkDestroyImage(g_dev, img, NULL); vkFreeMemory(g_dev, mem, NULL); vk_boot_logf("[m26a] mark submit/wait FAIL"); return VK_NULL_HANDLE; } }
    { VkImageViewCreateInfo vi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO };
      vi.image = img; vi.viewType = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D; vi.format = VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
      vi.components = (VkComponentMapping){ VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_IDENTITY, VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_IDENTITY,
                                            VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_IDENTITY, VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_IDENTITY };
      vi.subresourceRange = (VkImageSubresourceRange){ VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1 };
      if (vkCreateImageView(g_dev, &vi, NULL, &g_m26a_mark_view) != VK_SUCCESS) { g_m26a_mark_view = VK_NULL_HANDLE; vk_boot_logf("[m26a] mark vkCreateImageView FAIL"); } }
    vk_boot_logf("[m26a] mark 1x1 magenta view=%#llx (空槽标记，仅在 smo_m26a bit0)", (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_m26a_mark_view);
    return g_m26a_mark_view;
}
static void m26a_report(unsigned sub)
{
    if (!m26a_mode()) return;
    vk_boot_logf("[m26a] bindhist @submit#%u: empty_slot_hist_hit=%u hist_miss=%u rec_keys=%u marks=%u "
                 "(hit ⇒ (b) 我们记丢/刷新丢; miss ⇒ (a) guest 没发 bind)",
                 sub, g_m26a_hist_hit, g_m26a_hist_miss, g_m26a_hist_rec, g_m26a_put);
}

/* ---- M3y P2：纹理槽 → 描述符 ----
   bind_textures 回放时把真实 VkImageView 填进槽（slot = NVN first+i），这里在 draw 前把落后的
   descriptor set 补写。写时机安全前提：draw 批次在 bind_textures 处先 flush（g_rp_bind_tex 调
   nvn_vk_draw_flush，submit+等栅栏），所以此刻没有任何在飞的 CB 引用这些 set。
   未绑/解析失败的槽保持 1x1 白占位——不回退到「黑」也不冒充成功。 */
static void r_ds_tex_sync(R_Key *k)
{
    if (!k || !k->ds) return;
    int ntex = k->ntex < NVN_TX_SLOTS ? k->ntex : NVN_TX_SLOTS;
    /* M4aa P1：采样器换了也是「纹理绑定变了」——换采样器是静态描述符，必须抬代次重写。 */
    if (g_tx_gen_bump_pending) { g_tx_gen_bump_pending = 0; g_r_tx_gen++; }
    if (ntex <= 0 || k->tex_gen == g_r_tx_gen) return;
    /* M25A：合并窗口内，本 set 若已被「录进还没提交的 CB」引用，就不能原地重写 —— 换一只再写。
       （关态：m25a_c1()==0 短路，行为一字不变；pending 为 0 时也无需轮转。） */
    if (m25a_c1() && k->ds_ep == (unsigned)(g_m25a_ep + 1)) m25a_ds_rotate(k);
    VkDescriptorImageInfo im[NVN_TX_SLOTS];
    VkWriteDescriptorSet w[NVN_TX_SLOTS];
    int nw = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ntex; i++) {
        /* M27A：dstBinding 是 shader 侧**稠密**编号 32+i，但"取哪张图/哪个采样器"要按 guest 真实
           unit。关态或该 key 没有 "units" 时 u==i ⇒ 与旧行为逐字等价。
           M4ac P2：视图类型跟着该 key 该槽的采样维度走（Cube ⇒ CUBE 视图，2DArray ⇒ 2D_ARRAY 视图…）。
           拿不到维度时回调旧行为（g_r_tx_view[i]）并把原因计进 nodim/raw/noview。 */
        const char *why = "empty";
        int u = r_unit_of(k, i);
        if (u == i) g_m27a_map_same++; else g_m27a_map_diff++;
        VkImageView v = r_slot_view_pick(k, i, u, &why);
        /* M26A：bit0 时空槽改用 1x1 洋红标记图（缺省 0 ⇒ 本行不执行，绑定值逐字不变）。
           目的：把「平涂是不是采到白占位」变成一次上屏就能读的实验。 */
        if (!v && (m26a_mode() & 1)) {
            VkImageView mv = m26a_mark_get();
            if (mv) { v = mv; why = "m26a_mark"; g_m26a_put++; }
        }
        if (!v) v = g_r_tex_view;
        VkSampler   s = r_smp_for_slot(u);
        if (nvn_vk_view_is_rt(g_r_tx_view[u])) g_r_ds_rt_writes++;   /* M4e：本笔 draw 的槽确实挂的是我们的 RT 图 */
        im[i] = (VkDescriptorImageInfo){ s, v, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL };
        memset(&w[nw], 0, sizeof w[nw]);
        w[nw].sType = VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_WRITE_DESCRIPTOR_SET;
        w[nw].dstSet = k->ds; w[nw].dstBinding = (uint32_t)(32 + i); w[nw].descriptorCount = 1;
        w[nw].descriptorType = VK_DESCRIPTOR_TYPE_COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER;
        w[nw].pImageInfo = &im[i];
        nw++;
    }
    vkUpdateDescriptorSets(g_dev, (uint32_t)nw, w, 0, NULL);
    k->tex_gen = g_r_tx_gen;
    /* M7D6：把 slot0 真正写进描述符的 view latch 下来（只写全局，不改行为）。 */
    if (nw > 0) {
        g_m7d6_ds_view0 = im[0].imageView;
        snprintf(g_m7d6_ds_key0, sizeof g_m7d6_ds_key0, "%s", k->key);
        g_m7d6_ds_gen0 = k->tex_gen;
    }
}

/* 槽绑定：t == NULL 表示回到 1x1 占位。只在视图真的变了时才抬代次（避免每次 bind 都重写所有 set）。 */
void nvn_vk_bind_texture_slot(int slot, nvn_vk_tex *t)
{
    if (slot < 0 || slot >= NVN_TX_SLOTS) return;
    rt_link_from_slot(slot);   /* M4t P1：绑定即补「纹理 id ↔ RT 槽」这条边（幂等，不改状态） */
    VkImageView v = t ? (VkImageView)nvn_vk_tex_view(t) : VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    g_r_tx_texobj[slot] = t;   /* M4n P3：签名要的图对象，先记（即 view 未变也保持最新） */
    if (g_r_tx_view[slot] == v) return;
    g_r_tx_view[slot] = v;
    if (v) g_tx_slots_bound++;
    g_r_tx_gen++;
}

/* M4e：裸 view 绑定（route② 的 RT 图/影子图）。与上面同语义，只换 view 的来源。 */
void nvn_vk_bind_texture_slot_view(int slot, void *view)
{
    if (slot < 0 || slot >= NVN_TX_SLOTS) return;
    rt_link_from_slot(slot);   /* M4t P1：同上（route② 自绑也走这里，已登记的 id 直接返回） */
    VkImageView v = (VkImageView)view;
    g_r_tx_texobj[slot] = NULL;   /* M4n P3：裸 view 槽没有 nvn_vk_tex，签名改走 RT 表反查 */
    if (g_r_tx_view[slot] == v) return;
    g_r_tx_view[slot] = v;
    if (v) g_tx_slots_bound++;
    g_r_tx_gen++;
}

int nvn_vk_texture_slot_matches_view(int slot, void *view)
{
    if (slot < 0 || slot >= NVN_TX_SLOTS) return 1;
    return g_r_tx_view[slot] == (VkImageView)view;
}

/* 纹理销毁前把引用它的槽清掉：游戏每帧 Finalize+Initialize 会销毁重建 VkImage
   （gfx_bridge.c vk_tex_attach/detach 注释在案），描述符里留旧 view 就是悬垂句柄
   —— SwiftShader 在采样时读空指针会直接崩。清槽后该槽回 1x1 占位。 */
void nvn_vk_texture_forget(nvn_vk_tex *t)
{
    if (!t) return;
    VkImageView v = (VkImageView)nvn_vk_tex_view(t);
    if (!v) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < NVN_TX_SLOTS; i++) if (g_r_tx_view[i] == v) { g_r_tx_view[i] = VK_NULL_HANDLE; g_r_tx_gen++; }
}

unsigned long long nvn_vk_texture_slots_bound(void) { return g_tx_slots_bound; }
/* M5z P1：这张 id 的图此刻是否被任何一个采样槽引用（LRU 驱逐的安全判据：在用的图一律不动）。 */
int nvn_vk_tex_id_in_use(int id)
{
    for (int i = 0; i < NVN_TX_SLOTS; i++)
        if (g_r_tx_view[i] && g_r_tx_info[i].id == id) return 1;
    return 0;
}
/* M5z P1：一张纹理图占的显存字节（驱逐时从活体账里扣）。 */
unsigned long long nvn_vk_tex_vkbytes(const nvn_vk_tex *t) { return t ? t->vk_bytes : 0ull; }
int nvn_vk_texture_slot_has(int slot) { return (slot >= 0 && slot < NVN_TX_SLOTS && g_r_tx_view[slot] != VK_NULL_HANDLE); }
/* 槽是否已经是目标纹理（t==NULL 时=是否已是占位）。bind 回放用它判「真的变了没有」，
   否则每帧那十几次重复绑定都会触发一次 submit+wait（60fps 会被打穿）。 */
int nvn_vk_texture_slot_matches(int slot, nvn_vk_tex *t)
{
    if (slot < 0 || slot >= NVN_TX_SLOTS) return 1;
    VkImageView v = t ? (VkImageView)nvn_vk_tex_view(t) : VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    return g_r_tx_view[slot] == v;
}

/* M3y：快照描述符与 VkImage 是否同源。游戏会把同一个 NVNtexture 地址反复 Initialize 成不同纹理
   （boot#1 log: init #3..#11 全是 0x7f46632bf0），侧表里只剩最后一次的 VkImage；id 快照若来自
   更早的一次 Initialize，就拿它上送=尺寸/格式错配（CopyBufferToImage 越界）。这类 id 一律跳过并计数。 */
int nvn_vk_tex_matches_desc(const nvn_vk_tex *t, const nvn_texdesc *d)
{
    if (!t || !d) return 0;
    return t->d.width == d->width && t->d.height == d->height && t->d.depth == d->depth &&
           t->d.levels == d->levels && t->d.format == d->format && t->d.target == d->target;
}

/* ---- program → key 表（P2）。同一 program 的 stage0/stage1 来自两次 SetShaders 调用，
        按 prog 指针配对；配不上的那一路留空，draw 时跳过并计数。 ---- */
typedef struct { uint64_t prog; char vs[17], fs[17]; } R_Prog;
static R_Prog g_rp[R_MAX_PROGS];
static int g_rp_n;
static unsigned g_rp_logged;
static uint64_t g_r_cur_prog;
/* M3u P3：program→key 缺口取证计数（只读；表满即静默丢登记正是本轮要回答的问题） */
static unsigned long long g_rp_cap_hit, g_rp_binds, g_rp_bind_miss;
/* M3v P1：prog → g_rp 下标 的开放寻址索引（槽内存「下标+1」，0=空槽）。
   512 时代每次 bind/draw 都线性扫全表；抬到 32768 项后就是 1.3e5 次查表 × 3.3e4 项 ≈ 4e9 次比较，
   不可接受，所以查表改成 O(1)。槽数是容量的 2 倍，装载率恒 ≤50%，探测必然遇到空槽。 */
static uint16_t g_rp_ix[R_PROG_HASH];

/* M3v P1：若真打满，用去重表回答「是少数几个程序反复撞满，还是确实有一万多个不同程序」。 */
static uint64_t g_rp_drop[R_DROP_MAX];
static uint8_t  g_rp_drop_used[R_DROP_MAX];
static unsigned g_rp_drop_n;

static uint32_t rp_hash(uint64_t p)
{
    p ^= p >> 33; p *= 0xff51afd7ed558ccdull;
    p ^= p >> 33; p *= 0xc4ceb9fe1a85ec53ull;
    p ^= p >> 33;
    return (uint32_t)p;
}

unsigned nvn_vk_programs_registered(void) { return (unsigned)g_rp_n; }
unsigned long long nvn_vk_program_cap_hits(void) { return g_rp_cap_hit; }
unsigned long long nvn_vk_program_binds(void) { return g_rp_binds; }
unsigned long long nvn_vk_program_bind_misses(void) { return g_rp_bind_miss; }
unsigned nvn_vk_programs_paired(void)
{
    unsigned n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_rp_n; i++)
        if (g_rp[i].vs[0] && g_rp[i].fs[0]) n++;
    return n;
}

static void rp_drop_note(uint64_t prog)
{
    uint32_t s = rp_hash(prog);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < R_DROP_MAX; i++) {
        uint32_t slot = (s + i) & (R_DROP_MAX - 1);
        if (!g_rp_drop_used[slot]) {
            if (g_rp_drop_n < R_DROP_MAX) {
                g_rp_drop_used[slot] = 1; g_rp_drop[slot] = prog; g_rp_drop_n++;
            }
            return;
        }
        if (g_rp_drop[slot] == prog) return;
    }
}

/* M3v P1：表满不再静默——首 3 次 + 之后每 1000 次一行（原先只报一次，26156 次丢弃只留了一行）。 */
static unsigned long long g_rp_full_warned;
static void rp_full_warn(void)
{
    if (g_rp_cap_hit <= 3 || g_rp_cap_hit % 1000 == 0)
        vk_boot_logf("[p] program table FULL cap=%d cap_hit=%llu distinct_dropped=%u -> registration dropped",
                     R_MAX_PROGS, g_rp_cap_hit, g_rp_drop_n);
}

static R_Prog *r_prog(uint64_t prog)
{
    uint32_t s = rp_hash(prog);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < R_PROG_HASH; i++) {
        uint32_t slot = (s + i) & (R_PROG_HASH - 1);
        uint16_t v = g_rp_ix[slot];
        if (!v) return NULL;
        if (g_rp[v - 1].prog == prog) return &g_rp[v - 1];
    }
    return NULL;
}

/* ============================ M4b P1：pair_want ============================
   设备实际需要的 (vs_key, fs_key) 配对在这里去重累计，每 60 秒 append 一次到
   files/pair_want.txt。P2 的配对重烘只烘这份清单（全量 spv ≈1.2GB 装不进 HAP）。
   口径：nreg = SetShaders 里同一配对出现的次数；ndraw = 该配对走到 draw_elements 的次数
   （含因 key 缺失被跳过的 draw —— 「想要但没烘」的正是这些）。
   表满只丢弃不静默：g_pw_dropped 计数进 dump 头，避免把「表满」误读成「需求就这些」。 */
#define R_PW_MAX  16384
#define R_PW_HASH 32768
typedef struct {
    char vs[17], fs[17];
    uint64_t prog;
    unsigned nreg, ndraw;
} R_PairWant;
static R_PairWant g_pw[R_PW_MAX];
static int32_t g_pw_ix[R_PW_HASH];      /* 下标+1，0=空槽 */
static int g_pw_n;
static unsigned long long g_pw_dropped;
static time_t g_pw_last;

static uint32_t pw_hash(const char *vs, const char *fs)
{
    uint32_t h = 2166136261u;
    for (const char *p = vs; *p; p++) { h ^= (unsigned char)*p; h *= 16777619u; }
    h ^= 0x3Au; h *= 16777619u;
    for (const char *p = fs; *p; p++) { h ^= (unsigned char)*p; h *= 16777619u; }
    return h;
}

static R_PairWant *pw_slot(const char *vs, const char *fs, int create)
{
    if (!vs || !vs[0] || !fs || !fs[0]) return NULL;
    uint32_t s = pw_hash(vs, fs) & (R_PW_HASH - 1u);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < R_PW_HASH; i++) {
        int32_t v = g_pw_ix[(s + i) & (R_PW_HASH - 1u)];
        if (!v) {
            if (!create) return NULL;
            if (g_pw_n >= R_PW_MAX) { g_pw_dropped++; return NULL; }
            R_PairWant *e = &g_pw[g_pw_n];
            memset(e, 0, sizeof *e);
            snprintf(e->vs, sizeof e->vs, "%s", vs);
            snprintf(e->fs, sizeof e->fs, "%s", fs);
            g_pw_ix[(s + i) & (R_PW_HASH - 1u)] = (int32_t)(g_pw_n + 1);
            g_pw_n++;
            return e;
        }
        R_PairWant *e = &g_pw[v - 1];
        if (!strcmp(e->vs, vs) && !strcmp(e->fs, fs)) return e;
    }
    return NULL;
}

static void pw_note_reg(const char *vs, const char *fs, uint64_t prog)
{
    R_PairWant *e = pw_slot(vs, fs, 1);
    if (!e) return;
    if (e->nreg++ == 0) {
        e->prog = prog;
        /* 新增配对按 1024 的整数倍强制落盘一次：60s 节流在早期崩溃时只能留下 1 条（boot#1 实测）。 */
        if ((g_pw_n & 1023) == 0) nvn_vk_pair_want_dump(1);
    }
}

static void pw_note_draw(const char *vs, const char *fs)
{
    R_PairWant *e = pw_slot(vs, fs, 1);
    if (e) e->ndraw++;
}

#define PW_PATH_A "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files/pair_want.txt"
#define PW_PATH_B "/data/storage/el2/base/files/pair_want.txt"

/* 每 60 秒（或 force）把当前去重快照 append 到 pair_want.txt。行格式：
   <vs_key> <fs_key> <prog_ptr> <nreg> <ndraw>   —— 前 3 列即派活单口径。 */
void nvn_vk_pair_want_dump(int force)
{
    time_t now = time(NULL);
    if (!force && g_pw_last && now - g_pw_last < 60) return;
    if (!force && g_pw_last && now < g_pw_last) g_pw_last = 0;   /* 时钟回退：下一拍重来 */
    g_pw_last = now;
    FILE *f = fopen(PW_PATH_A, "a");
    if (!f) f = fopen(PW_PATH_B, "a");
    if (!f) { vk_boot_logf("[p] pair_want dump FAILED n=%d (no writable path)", g_pw_n); return; }
    fprintf(f, "# M4b pair_want t=%ld pairs=%d dropped=%llu\n", (long)now, g_pw_n, g_pw_dropped);
    for (int i = 0; i < g_pw_n; i++)
        fprintf(f, "%s %s %#llx %u %u\n", g_pw[i].vs, g_pw[i].fs,
                (unsigned long long)g_pw[i].prog, g_pw[i].nreg, g_pw[i].ndraw);
    fclose(f);
    vk_boot_logf("[p] pair_want dump pairs=%d dropped=%llu path=%s", g_pw_n, g_pw_dropped, PW_PATH_A);
}

int nvn_vk_pair_want_count(void) { return g_pw_n; }

/* ================= M4bd P1：着色器自带的 c1 常量段（只登记 + 一行日志，渲染路径零改动） =================
   为什么 FS 的 cb1 不是游戏 UBO：
     · infra/nxnative/dm/gfx/nvn/dmsh_abi.h:37 `DMSH_KIND_CBUF "cbuf" // uniform buffer slot reg (c[3 + reg])`
       —— 硬件 c 段 k ← NVN bind 槽 k−3（VS/FS 同一套）；
     · 同文件 `DMSH_KIND_C1 "c1" // the shader's own constant segment c[1]`
       —— c1 没有 bind 槽，它随 shader 一起编译出来，NVN 控制段 +0x700/+0x704 给出它相对指令区
          起点的 [offset,total)：c1 = code[offset,total)（与 dm/gfx/tools/dmsh_build.py:445 同口径）。
   本轮实测（fs=15a5f3dd）：c1o=4096 c1t=4352 ⇒ 256 B，前 10 个 float =
     [2.661, 0.1939, 0.6045, −5.069, −4.853, 0.9903, 0.04, 1.895, 0.0005, 0.31831]
   与该 FS 反汇编里 10 个 cb1 引用（cb1[0][0..3] cb1[1][0..3] cb1[2][0..1]）逐一对应 ⇒ cb1[2][1]=0.31831。
   所以「cb1[2][1]=0 ⇒ 恒黑」不成立：真正的黑是**绑错了槽**（我们把游戏 UBO1 塞给了 c1）。
   本轮（P1）只把字节记进表里并打一行；P2 才用它喂 binding 1。 */
/* M4bd boot#1/#2 实测：256 与 2048 两条静态表都不够——开机 ≈3 s 就满（本作 [s] shader totals
   uniq=52202，本地 200 份 dump 抽样 114/200 带 c1 段、长度全是 256 B ⇒ 需要 ≈3 万条）。
   M4be P1 改成「动态哈希 + 字节池」：
     · 键 = 16 位十六进制（key 本来就是 64 位哈希的十六进制串）⇒ 直接折叠成 u64，条目只存 u64；
     · 表 = 打开寻址，容量 1<<16 = 65536（期望 3 万条，装载率 ≈0.46），首次登记时 calloc；
     · 字节 = 1 MiB/块的 bump 池（4096 条 × 256 B），最多 32 块（32 MiB 硬上限，超了计数让位）；
     · 登记时**立刻**拷字节（code 指针在 SetShaders 时刻一定可读，M4bd 已实测）；
       「懒」只留在 arena 这一层（r_c1_arena 按 key 每批次拷一次）。
   淘汰策略不需要：容量 ≥2× 期望条目，满了就计数让位（不再静默丢弃，`[c1] table FULL` 保留）。 */
#define R_C1_BYTES      256u
#define R_C1_HASH_BITS  16
#define R_C1_HASH_N     (1u << R_C1_HASH_BITS)
#define R_C1_POOL_ENT   4096u                    /* 每块 4096 条 × 256 B = 1 MiB */
#define R_C1_POOL_MAX   32u                      /* 32 MiB 硬上限 */
typedef struct {
    uint64_t k;          /* 0 = 空槽（内容哈希的十六进制串不会恰好为 0） */
    uint8_t *b;          /* 池里的 256 B（len 之后是零） */
    uint16_t len;
    uint8_t stage;
    uint8_t pad;
} r_c1_ent;
static r_c1_ent *g_c1_tab;
static uint8_t *g_c1_pool[R_C1_POOL_MAX];
static unsigned g_c1_chunks, g_c1_in_chunk;
static unsigned g_c1_n, g_c1_full, g_c1_drop;
static uint64_t r_c1_key64(const char *key)
{
    if (!key) return 0;
    uint64_t v = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        char c = key[i];
        int d = (c >= '0' && c <= '9') ? (c - '0')
              : (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f') ? (c - 'a' + 10)
              : (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F') ? (c - 'A' + 10) : -1;
        if (d < 0) return 0;
        v = (v << 4) | (uint64_t)d;
    }
    return v;
}
static uint32_t r_c1_h(const uint64_t k)
{
    uint64_t x = k;
    x ^= x >> 33; x *= 0xff51afd7ed558ccdull;
    x ^= x >> 33; x *= 0xc4ceb9fe1a85ec53ull;
    x ^= x >> 33;
    return (uint32_t)(x & (uint64_t)(R_C1_HASH_N - 1));
}
static r_c1_ent *r_c1_slot_for(const uint64_t k, int *empty)
{
    uint32_t i = r_c1_h(k);
    for (uint32_t n = 0; n < R_C1_HASH_N; n++) {
        r_c1_ent *e = &g_c1_tab[(i + n) & (R_C1_HASH_N - 1)];
        if (!e->k) { if (empty) *empty = 1; return e; }
        if (e->k == k) { if (empty) *empty = 0; return e; }
    }
    if (empty) *empty = 0;
    return NULL;
}
static r_c1_ent *r_c1_find(const char *key)
{
    if (!g_c1_tab || !key || !*key) return NULL;
    uint64_t k = r_c1_key64(key);
    if (!k) return NULL;
    return r_c1_slot_for(k, NULL);
}
static uint8_t *r_c1_alloc(void)
{
    if (g_c1_chunks == 0 || g_c1_in_chunk >= R_C1_POOL_ENT) {
        if (g_c1_chunks >= R_C1_POOL_MAX) return NULL;
        uint8_t *ch = (uint8_t *)malloc((size_t)R_C1_POOL_ENT * R_C1_BYTES);
        if (!ch) return NULL;
        memset(ch, 0, (size_t)R_C1_POOL_ENT * R_C1_BYTES);
        g_c1_pool[g_c1_chunks++] = ch;
        g_c1_in_chunk = 0;
    }
    return g_c1_pool[g_c1_chunks - 1] + (size_t)(g_c1_in_chunk++) * R_C1_BYTES;
}
void nvn_vk_shader_c1(const char *key, int stage, const void *ctl, uint64_t code_addr)
{
    if (!key || !*key || !ctl || !code_addr) return;
    uint32_t magic = 0, c1o = 0, c1t = 0, clen = 0;
    memcpy(&magic, ctl, 4);
    memcpy(&clen, (const uint8_t *)ctl + 0x20, 4);
    /* 先确认控制段真的覆盖到 +0x708（shader_dump 的判据只保证 ≥0x40）：短控制段一律不碰。 */
    if (magic != 0x98761234u || clen < 0x708u) return;
    memcpy(&c1o, (const uint8_t *)ctl + 0x700, 4);
    memcpy(&c1t, (const uint8_t *)ctl + 0x704, 4);
    /* 无 c1 段（c1t==c1o，本作多数 shader 如此）静默跳过；长度异常同样跳过，绝不越界读。 */
    if (magic != 0x98761234u || c1t <= c1o || c1t - c1o > R_C1_BYTES) return;
    uint64_t k = r_c1_key64(key);
    if (!k) return;
    if (!g_c1_tab) {
        g_c1_tab = (r_c1_ent *)calloc(R_C1_HASH_N, sizeof *g_c1_tab);
        if (!g_c1_tab) return;
        vk_boot_logf("[c1] table alloc %u slots x %u B = %u KB",
                     R_C1_HASH_N, (unsigned)sizeof(r_c1_ent),
                     (unsigned)(R_C1_HASH_N * sizeof(r_c1_ent) >> 10));
    }
    int empty = 0;
    r_c1_ent *e = r_c1_slot_for(k, &empty);
    if (!e) {   /* 表满：计数让位（65536 条 ≈ 4.6 万个 (key,stage) 的 1.4 倍，正常到不了） */
        if (++g_c1_full <= 3) vk_boot_logf("[c1] table FULL n=%u (key=%s 未登记)", g_c1_n, key);
        return;
    }
    if (!empty) return;      /* 同 key 已登记（同一 shader 会被 SetShaders 多次喂进来） */
    uint8_t *dst = r_c1_alloc();
    if (!dst) {
        if (++g_c1_drop <= 3) vk_boot_logf("[c1] pool FULL chunks=%u (key=%s 未登记)", g_c1_chunks, key);
        return;
    }
    e->k = k;
    e->b = dst;
    e->len = (uint16_t)(c1t - c1o);
    e->stage = (uint8_t)stage;
    memcpy(dst, (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)code_addr + c1o, e->len);
    g_c1_n++;
    if (g_c1_n <= 4 || !strcmp(key, "15a5f3dde09b9a02"))
        vk_boot_logf("[c1] reg #%u key=%s st=%d len=%u c1o=%u c1t=%u f0=%g f1=%g f8=%g f9=%g",
                     g_c1_n, key, stage, e->len, c1o, c1t,
                     (double)*(const float *)(const void *)e->b,
                     e->len >= 8 ? (double)*(const float *)(const void *)(e->b + 4) : 0.0,
                     e->len >= 36 ? (double)*(const float *)(const void *)(e->b + 32) : 0.0,
                     e->len >= 40 ? (double)*(const float *)(const void *)(e->b + 36) : 0.0);
}

/* M4bd P2 / M4be P1：把 shader 自带的 c1 段按 key 懒拷进 UBO arena（描述符是 DYNAMIC 的，所以只要偏移对，
   不需要改描述符集）。缓存随「每批次 arena 回卷」（draw_flush 的 fence 之后）一起失效。
   为什么必须进 arena 而不是另建 buffer：draw 与 A/B 变体的动态偏移都从同一张 arena 取，
   换 buffer 意味着改描述符集与 set 布局，收益为零、风险很大。
   M4be P1 补齐两处（M4bd boot#2 的「c1 一次都没进 arena」= 表满，与 arena 无关，但顺手把它做对）：
     ① **独立带区**：c1 槽从 arena 顶部 1 MiB 里分配（`R_C1_BAND_LO` 起），游戏 UBO 的 bump 上限压到带区
        起点 ⇒ 两个 bump 永不互相踩；带区用完就计数让位（回落游戏 UBO1），绝不再挪用游戏槽。
     ② **槽粒度按设备对齐**：`max(256, minUniformBufferOffsetAlignment)`（不再是 4 KiB），
        1 MiB 带区能放 4096 个 c1（4 KiB 只有 256 个）；描述符范围 4096 B ⇒ 最后一个槽要留
        `R_UBO_ARENA - 4096` 以上的余量。 */
#define R_C1_ARENA_SLOTS 64
typedef struct { uint64_t k; uint32_t off; } r_c1_aslot;
static uint32_t r_ubo_offset(int stage, int bank);   /* 定义在本文件后部（M3t 常量区映射） */
static r_c1_aslot g_c1_aslot[2][R_C1_ARENA_SLOTS];
static int g_c1_aslot_n[2];
static uint32_t g_c1_band_used = R_C1_BAND_LO;
static unsigned long long g_c1_arena_hits, g_c1_arena_puts, g_c1_arena_full;
static unsigned g_c1_target_log;
static uint32_t r_c1_slot_sz(void)
{
    uint32_t a = g_min_ubo_align ? g_min_ubo_align : 256u;
    return a > R_C1_BYTES ? a : R_C1_BYTES;
}
static uint32_t r_c1_arena(int stage, const char *key)
{
    if (stage < 0 || stage > 1 || !key || !*key) return 0;
    uint64_t k = r_c1_key64(key);
    if (!k) return 0;
    int n = g_c1_aslot_n[stage];
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
        if (g_c1_aslot[stage][i].k == k) { g_c1_arena_hits++; return g_c1_aslot[stage][i].off; }
    r_c1_ent *e = r_c1_find(key);
    if (!e || !e->len || !g_r_ubo_map) return 0;
    uint32_t sz = r_c1_slot_sz();
    if (g_c1_band_used + sz > R_UBO_ARENA - R_UBO_BYTES) {   /* 带区用完：本批次内让位，回落游戏 UBO */
        if (++g_c1_arena_full <= 3)
            vk_boot_logf("[c1] band FULL used=%u/%u key=%s (本笔回落)", g_c1_band_used, R_UBO_ARENA, key);
        return 0;
    }
    uint32_t off = g_c1_band_used;
    memset((uint8_t *)g_r_ubo_map + off, 0, sz);
    memcpy((uint8_t *)g_r_ubo_map + off, e->b, e->len);
    g_c1_band_used += sz;
    g_c1_arena_puts++;
    if (n < R_C1_ARENA_SLOTS) {   /* 满了不覆盖旧的：旧槽仍然有效，只是新 key 每次重建（正确但慢） */
        g_c1_aslot[stage][n].k = k;
        g_c1_aslot[stage][n].off = off;
        g_c1_aslot_n[stage] = n + 1;
    }
    /* M4be boot#1 自测发现的自己的 bug #4：旧条件 `!strcmp(key, 目标)` 让目标 FS 每批次重建槽都打一行，
       全 boot 841 行（≈0.1 MB 日志噪声）。改成「目标 key 最多 8 行」。 */
    if (g_c1_arena_puts <= 4 ||
        (!strcmp(key, "15a5f3dde09b9a02") && g_c1_target_log < 8)) {
        if (!strcmp(key, "15a5f3dde09b9a02")) g_c1_target_log++;
        vk_boot_logf("[c1] arena st=%d key=%s off=%u len=%u slot=%u f0=%g f8=%g cb1[2][1]=%g reg=%u chunks=%u",
                     stage, key, off, e->len, sz,
                     (double)*(const float *)(const void *)e->b,
                     e->len >= 36 ? (double)*(const float *)(const void *)(e->b + 32) : 0.0,
                     e->len >= 40 ? (double)*(const float *)(const void *)(e->b + 36) : 0.0,
                     g_c1_n, g_c1_chunks);
    }
    return off;
}
/* 取某 (stage, bank) 的动态偏移：bank 1 = shader 自带 c1 段（有则用），其余按 ABI 位移读游戏 UBO。 */
static uint32_t r_ubo_off_key(int stage, int bank, const char *key)
{
    if (bank == 1) {
        uint32_t o = r_c1_arena(stage, key);
        if (o) return o;
    }
    return r_ubo_offset(stage, bank);
}

/* M5u P1（只读取证）：`nvn_vk_program_set_keys` 是 guest 把 vs/fs 两个 key 交给我方的**唯一**入口。
   目的：把「从没来过」与「来过但查不到/没登记」彻底分开，并给同 stage 的成功样本做对照。
     · miss#：至少一路在 r_key 里查不到 ⇒ 再问 r_bin_spv（按 stage）有没有该 stage 的字节，
       一行带出该路的 idx/bin/bytes（bin=1 而 idx=0 才是"登记漏了"，两者都 0 = 语料里没有）；
     · ok#：两路都在 r_key ⇒ 打 5 行对照（字节数/attr/cbuf/ntex/gmem），证明登记链在跑。
   r_bin_spv 是线性扫（1 万条），只在限流窗口内调用，绝不上热路径。 */
static unsigned g_pu_trace_miss, g_pu_trace_ok;
static void pu_trace_keys(const char *vs, const char *fs)
{
    if (!vs || !*vs || !fs || !*fs) return;
    const R_Key *a = r_key(vs), *b = r_key(fs);
    if (!a || !b) {
        if (g_pu_trace_miss < 12) {
            size_t nv = 0, nf = 0;
            int bv = r_bin_spv(vs, 0, &nv) != NULL;
            int bf = r_bin_spv(fs, 1, &nf) != NULL;
            g_pu_trace_miss++;
            vk_boot_logf("[w] keytrace miss#%u vs=%s idx=%d bin0=%d bytes0=%zu | fs=%s idx=%d bin1=%d bytes1=%zu",
                         g_pu_trace_miss, vs, a != NULL, bv, nv, fs, b != NULL, bf, nf);
        }
    } else if (g_pu_trace_ok < 5) {
        size_t nv = 0, nf = 0;
        (void)r_bin_spv(vs, 0, &nv);
        (void)r_bin_spv(fs, 1, &nf);
        g_pu_trace_ok++;
        vk_boot_logf("[w] keytrace ok#%u vs=%s bytes0=%zu attr=%#x cbuf=%#x ncbuf=%u gmem=%d | "
                     "fs=%s bytes1=%zu cbuf=%#x ntex=%d tint=%d gmem=%d",
                     g_pu_trace_ok, vs, nv, a->attr_mask, a->cbuf_mask, a->ncbuf, a->uses_gmem,
                     fs, nf, b->cbuf_mask, b->ntex, b->uses_tint, b->uses_gmem);
    }
}

void nvn_vk_program_set_keys(uint64_t prog, const char *vs_key, const char *fs_key)
{
    if (!prog) return;
    R_Prog *hit = r_prog(prog);
    if (hit) {
        if (vs_key && *vs_key) snprintf(hit->vs, sizeof hit->vs, "%s", vs_key);
        if (fs_key && *fs_key) snprintf(hit->fs, sizeof hit->fs, "%s", fs_key);
        pw_note_reg(hit->vs, hit->fs, prog);
        nvn_vk_pair_want_dump(0);
        pu_trace_keys(hit->vs, hit->fs);
        return;
    }
    if (g_rp_n >= R_MAX_PROGS) { g_rp_cap_hit++; rp_drop_note(prog); rp_full_warn(); return; }
    R_Prog *e = &g_rp[g_rp_n];
    memset(e, 0, sizeof *e);
    e->prog = prog;
    if (vs_key && *vs_key) snprintf(e->vs, sizeof e->vs, "%s", vs_key);
    if (fs_key && *fs_key) snprintf(e->fs, sizeof e->fs, "%s", fs_key);
    {   /* 登记进索引（探测空槽；槽数=2×容量，必然成功） */
        uint32_t s = rp_hash(prog);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < R_PROG_HASH; i++) {
            uint32_t slot = (s + i) & (R_PROG_HASH - 1);
            if (!g_rp_ix[slot]) { g_rp_ix[slot] = (uint16_t)(g_rp_n + 1); break; }
        }
    }
    g_rp_n++;
    if (g_rp_logged < 12) {
        g_rp_logged++;
        vk_boot_logf("[r] program prog=%#llx vs=%s fs=%s", (unsigned long long)prog,
                     e->vs[0] ? e->vs : "-", e->fs[0] ? e->fs : "-");
    }
    pw_note_reg(e->vs, e->fs, prog);
    nvn_vk_pair_want_dump(0);
    (void)r_ci_load();
    pu_trace_keys(e->vs, e->fs);
}

int nvn_vk_bind_program(uint64_t prog)
{
    g_r_cur_prog = prog;
    if (!prog) return 1;
    if (!r_ci_load()) return -1;
    g_rp_binds++;
    R_Prog *p = r_prog(prog);
    int ok = (p && p->vs[0] && p->fs[0]);
    if (!ok) {
        g_rp_bind_miss++;
        /* M3u P3：头 8 次未命中把「prog 指针 + 表内是否登记 + 缺哪一路」落盘——
           区分「SetShaders 没登记这个指针」与「登记了但缺 FS/VS」。 */
        if (g_rp_bind_miss <= 8)
            vk_boot_logf("[p] bind miss prog=%#llx reg=%d vs=%d fs=%d registered=%u paired=%u cap_hit=%llu",
                         (unsigned long long)prog, p ? 1 : 0, p && p->vs[0] ? 1 : 0, p && p->fs[0] ? 1 : 0,
                         (unsigned)nvn_vk_programs_registered(), nvn_vk_programs_paired(), g_rp_cap_hit);
    }
    return ok ? 0 : 1;
}

/* M5c：最近 4 笔 draw 的参数环。批次收口慢（> 2 s）时连同 flush 耗时一起打印——
   「一个 2 笔的批次花了 27 s」必须能点名是**哪两笔**（M5c b1 实测：batch flush draws=2 us=27294251）。 */
typedef struct { char vs[17], fs[17]; int count, nverts, inst, topo, var; } J_Draw;
static J_Draw g_j_dr[4];
static unsigned g_j_dr_i;
static void j_draw_note(const char *vs, const char *fs, int count, int nverts, int inst, int topo, int var)
{
    J_Draw *d = &g_j_dr[g_j_dr_i++ & 3u];
    snprintf(d->vs, sizeof d->vs, "%s", vs); snprintf(d->fs, sizeof d->fs, "%s", fs);
    d->count = count; d->nverts = nverts; d->inst = inst; d->topo = topo; d->var = var;
}

/* ---- 管线缓存 (vs_key, fs_key, topology, inst_mask) ---- */
/* M4r P1：同一 (vs,fs,topo) 现在可能有 5 个管线变体（0=仅颜色；1/2=颜色+深度 D32/D24；
   3/4=仅深度 D32/D24）。变体是对同一套 shader/descriptor 只用不同 renderPass + 深度状态再建一次，
   layout 共享。变体建失败只记 dstate=-1 并回落 var 0（颜色路径不受影响）。
   M4ap P1：实例化输入率是 **Vulkan 管线状态**（NVN 里它只是 stream state，绑在 CB 上），
   所以同一 (vs,fs,topo) 可能要多一份「哪些 location 是 INSTANCE 率」的变体。inst_mask 就是
   这份变体键：只有 divisor>0 的属性位被置上；全 0 = 旧条目，不新增表项。 */
typedef struct { char vs[17], fs[17]; int topo; uint32_t inst_mask; VkPipeline ps; VkPipelineLayout lay; int tried;
                 VkPipeline ps_d[5]; signed char dstate[5]; } R_Pipe;
static R_Pipe g_rpipe[R_MAX_PIPES];
static int g_rpipe_n;
static unsigned long long g_r_pipe_ok, g_r_pipe_fail, g_r_pipe_skip_int64, g_r_pipe_cap_hit, g_r_pipe_skip_gmem;
static unsigned long long g_r_pipe_skip_bigfs;   /* M4k P1③：>256KB FS 按需跳过 */
/* M4r P1：深度管线变体（var 1..4）建成/建失败次数；以及「本笔 draw 走了哪条通道」的计数。 */
static unsigned long long g_r_pipe_dvar_ok, g_r_pipe_dvar_fail, g_r_draws_depth, g_r_draws_donly;
static unsigned g_r_pipe_div_log;   /* M4ap P1：INSTANCE 率管线变体的前 6 条日志（限流） */

/* ---------------- M40AB (2026-11-10)：pipeline 缓存诊断探针（只读，不改任何行为） ----------------
   M40AA 的决定性证据：t=148 起 56 s 零帧，冻结期建 176 条 pipeline（vkCreateGraphicsPipelines
   40 ms/条 = SwiftShader 的 SPIR-V 前端 + Reactor JIT）。
   ⚠ 口径勘误（本轮 Q1 的答案）：M40P 把 `[p] program totals` 的 cap_hit=0 当成「管线零复用」的旁证，
   但那是**错的**。cap_hit 是「program 表撞满被丢弃」的计数（rp_drop_note / r_full_warn：只有
   g_rp_n >= R_MAX_PROGS 才 ++），跟命中率无关；同理 g_r_pipe_cap_hit 是 pipe 表撞满计数。
   真正的复用计数是 g_sh_pipe_hit（[sh] 行的 pipe_hit=+N）。
   本轮只需要一个计量问题：新建的 pipeline 是「同一 key 反复新建（缓存坏 = AB1）」还是
   「每个 key 只出现一次（状态真不同 = AB2）」。探针分两半，刻意互相独立：
     ① 表侧（new/reuse/tbl/full/full_new/fps60）：只读既有原子量，热路径零新增写入；
     ② key 指纹侧：对每次 var==0 查表把 (vs,fs,topo,inst_mask) 做 FNV-1a 进一个 8192 槽开放寻址
        集合（8 步线性探测、全原子）。这一半**不复用 r_pipe 的查表结论** —— 即使查表逻辑坏了，
        「这个 key 见过没有」依然可信。归因落在未命中那一刻：
          miss_rep = 未命中但指纹说「见过」 ⇒ 缓存坏（AB1）；
          miss_new = 未命中且指纹说「没见过」 ⇒ 真的新状态（AB2）。
   ⚠ 开关 smo_m40ab 必须 app 自己种（hdc 是 uid=2000，建不出 app 私有目录的文件，M40AA 已实测）：
     缺省 1 = 开；写 0 = 整块静默（连计数器都不再累加）。 */
#define M40AB_SW_A "/data/storage/el2/base/files/smo_m40ab"
#define M40AB_SW_B "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files/smo_m40ab"
#define M40AB_HS   8192u
#define M40AB_PROBE 8u
static _Atomic int g_m40ab_on = 1;
static _Atomic uint64_t g_m40ab_hs[M40AB_HS];
static _Atomic unsigned long long g_m40ab_uniq, g_m40ab_rep, g_m40ab_samp, g_m40ab_look;
static _Atomic unsigned long long g_m40ab_miss_new, g_m40ab_miss_rep;

__attribute__((constructor)) static void m40ab_seed(void)
{
    static const char *const p[2] = { M40AB_SW_A, M40AB_SW_B };
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        if (access(p[i], F_OK) == 0) { chmod(p[i], 0666); continue; }
        int fd = open(p[i], O_CREAT | O_WRONLY | O_TRUNC, 0666);
