        char *d = g_r_heavy_keys[g_r_heavy_keys_n];
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) d[i] = (b[i] >= 'A' && b[i] <= 'F') ? (char)(b[i] + 32) : b[i];
        d[16] = 0;
        g_r_heavy_keys_n++;
    }
}
/* 一次性初始化（种子 + 解析 + 生效值日志）；门判据和黑名单查表都走这里，保证顺序。 */
static int g_r_heavy_ready;
static void r_heavy_init(void)
{
    if (g_r_heavy_ready) return;
    g_r_heavy_ready = 1;
    r_heavy_seed();
    r_heavy_keys_seed();
    r_heavy_keys_init();
}
/* ==== M5w P1：**实测**程序隔离（learned 表 + C 默认表）====
   事实（logs/m5t_m5v_b1|b2、logs/m5t_m5u_b1，见报告 P0.2/P0.3）：语料补全后 fs=bff359bda0d159d1
   第一次可解，M5t 里被 skip_noprog 丢掉的 64 笔/帧真的被执行，单批栅栏实测 234.3 / 233.7 s
   （M5u 那次直接撞 240 s 上限返回 VK_TIMEOUT），其间进程持续 384% CPU ⇒ **真在算**，不是丢 fence。
   该 FS 只有 478 条指令（spv 67648 B、GLSL 38583 B、9 个 for(;;)），静态闸门 verts<=4 && instr>8000
   判不到它，而这些 draw 是 verts=9 —— 所以判据必须是**实测值**，不是指令数猜值。
   规则：任一 batch 的栅栏等待 >= R_HEAVY_BATCH_US ⇒ 该批「出现笔数最多的 FS key」拉黑到本次 boot，
   之后该 FS 的 draw 一律不进录制，并按 r_heavy_note 的既有格式打「跳了谁/为什么/累计多少笔」。
   C 默认表里那一条就是上面实测出来的那条（同一 key），作用是让**第一个** batch 也不必再付 234 s；
   smo_heavy_skip=0 可整体关掉本闸门。命中笔数进 g_r_skip_heavy，并出现在 [r] draw totals 的
   skip_heavy 字段（不静默）。 */
#define R_HEAVY_BATCH_US   10000000ull   /* 10 s/batch = 正常批次(<1 s)的 10 倍以上，离 240 s 上限差 24 倍 */
#define R_HEAVY_LEARN_MAX  8
static const char *const g_r_heavy_default[] = {
    "bff359bda0d159d1",   /* M5v b1/b2 + M5w b1：63 笔/帧的批，栅栏实测 233.7 / 234.3 / (M5u 撞 240 s 上限) */
    "b85fe283bfa233cf",   /* M5w b1：[j] RSS GUARD trip 4407MB -> 12147MB，instr=5886，verts=4 全屏，栅栏永不返回 */
    "8157eae6856ef88e",   /* M5w b1：实测 15.43 s / 74 笔批（本 boot 内被 learned 表抓到，提升为默认以省这一笔） */
    "09b543a1e076574d",   /* M5w b1：实测 28.05 s / 2 笔批；M5d 已记「7459 条有限但慢」，两次 boot 都付过这个钱 */
    "b9259c9622ca0dff"    /* M5w b1：实测 14.78 s / 32 笔批（learned_n=3，同样提升为默认） */
};
static char g_r_heavy_learned[R_HEAVY_LEARN_MAX][17];
static int  g_r_heavy_learned_n;

static int r_heavy_learned_hit(const char *fs)
{
    for (int i = 0; i < g_r_heavy_learned_n; i++) if (!strcmp(g_r_heavy_learned[i], fs)) return 1;
    return 0;
}
/* 本 FS key 是否在隔离表里（M5e 显式黑名单 + M5w C 默认表 + M5w 实测学到表；都不看指令数）。 */
static int r_heavy_key_hit(const char *fs)
{
    r_heavy_init();
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof g_r_heavy_default / sizeof *g_r_heavy_default; i++)
        if (!strcmp(g_r_heavy_default[i], fs)) return 1;
    if (r_heavy_learned_hit(fs)) return 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_r_heavy_keys_n; i++) if (!strcmp(g_r_heavy_keys[i], fs)) return 1;
    return 0;
}
/* 实测结论落地：把一个 batch 的实测成本记到它的头号 FS 上并拉黑。只记一次、只打一行。 */
static void r_heavy_learn(const char *vs, const char *fs, unsigned long long us,
                          unsigned long long bd, unsigned long long px)
{
    if (!vs || !fs || !*fs) return;
    r_heavy_init();
    if (r_heavy_learned_hit(fs)) return;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof g_r_heavy_default / sizeof *g_r_heavy_default; i++)
        if (!strcmp(g_r_heavy_default[i], fs)) return;                 /* 已在默认表，不重复学 */
    if (g_r_heavy_learned_n >= R_HEAVY_LEARN_MAX) return;
    snprintf(g_r_heavy_learned[g_r_heavy_learned_n], sizeof g_r_heavy_learned[0], "%s", fs);
    g_r_heavy_learned_n++;
    vk_boot_logf("[r-yel] heavy prog LEARNED fs=%s vs=%s flush_us=%llu draws=%llu px=%llu budget_us=%llu "
                 "learned_n=%d -> quarantined for the rest of this boot (skips counted in skip_heavy)",
                 fs, vs, us, bd, px, R_HEAVY_BATCH_US, g_r_heavy_learned_n);
}
static int r_heavy_read_knob(void)
{
    const char *e = getenv("SMO_HEAVY_SKIP");
    if (!e || !*e) e = getenv("smo_heavy_skip");
    if (e && *e) return (*e != '0');
    int v;
    if (r_heavy_file_int(R_HEAVY_FLAG_A, &v) || r_heavy_file_int(R_HEAVY_FLAG_B, &v)) return v != 0;
    {   /* 共享 flags 文件的重载位：smo_replay_flags 里写 `heavy_skip=0` 也能关 */
        char b[256]; b[0] = 0;
        FILE *f = fopen(R_FLAGS_PATH, "r");
        if (f) { size_t n = fread(b, 1, sizeof b - 1, f); b[n] = 0; fclose(f); }
        return r_flag_parse(b, "heavy_skip", 1);
    }
}
/* M5e：生效值报告（boot 期一次 + 万一没走到 r_flags_resolve 则由第一次判定兜底）。 */
static int g_r_heavy_logged;
static void r_heavy_boot_report(void)
{
    r_heavy_init();
    if (g_r_heavy_logged) return;
    g_r_heavy_logged = 1;
    char kl[160]; size_t o = 0; kl[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_r_heavy_keys_n && o + 18 < sizeof kl; i++)
        o += (size_t)snprintf(kl + o, sizeof kl - o, "%s%s", i ? "," : "", g_r_heavy_keys[i]);
    {
        char dl[200]; size_t do_ = 0; dl[0] = 0;
        const unsigned dn = (unsigned)(sizeof g_r_heavy_default / sizeof *g_r_heavy_default);
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < dn && do_ + 20 < sizeof dl; i++)
            do_ += (size_t)snprintf(dl + do_, sizeof dl - do_, "%s%s", i ? "," : "", g_r_heavy_default[i]);
        vk_boot_logf("[r] heavy skip knob=%d (gate: (verts<=4 && fs instr>%u) || fs key quarantined; skip file %s; "
                     "blacklist n=%d [%s] file %s; M5w default n=%u [%s])",
                     r_heavy_read_knob(), R_HEAVY_INSTR_MIN, R_HEAVY_FLAG_A, g_r_heavy_keys_n,
                     g_r_heavy_keys_n ? kl : "-", R_HEAVY_KEYS_A, dn, dn ? dl : "-");
    }
}
static int r_heavy_skip_on(void)
{
    static int cached = -2; static unsigned n;
    if (cached == -2) {
        r_heavy_boot_report();   /* 生效值只在这一处打；这里只取开关 */
        cached = r_heavy_read_knob();
    } else if ((++n & 63u) == 0) {
        int v = r_heavy_read_knob();
        if (v != cached) {
            vk_boot_logf("[r] heavy skip knob CHANGED %d->%d (file/env reload)", cached, v);
            cached = v;
        }
    }
    return cached != 0;
}
/* 每 key 记一笔：首次命中打一行（含 instr/px/估算 us/verts/idx/calls），之后每 1000 笔再打一行。 */
static void r_heavy_note(const char *vs, const char *fs, unsigned instr, int nverts, int idx, unsigned long long px)
{
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < g_r_heavy_n; i++) if (!strcmp(g_r_heavy[i].fs, fs)) break;
    int isnew = 0;
    if (i >= g_r_heavy_n) {
        if (g_r_heavy_n >= (int)(sizeof g_r_heavy / sizeof *g_r_heavy)) i = (int)(sizeof g_r_heavy / sizeof *g_r_heavy) - 1;
        else {
            i = g_r_heavy_n++;
            snprintf(g_r_heavy[i].fs, sizeof g_r_heavy[i].fs, "%s", fs);
            g_r_heavy[i].n = 0;
            g_r_heavy[i].instr = instr;
            /* M5y P2：首次命中时的目标（只读快照）——用来判断被跳掉的是不是世界 pass。 */
            g_r_heavy[i].tgt_key = g_rt_cur ? g_rt_cur->key : 0ull;
            g_r_heavy[i].tgt_texid = g_rt_cur ? g_rt_cur->tex_id : -1;
            g_r_heavy[i].tgt_w = (unsigned)g_rt_w; g_r_heavy[i].tgt_h = (unsigned)g_rt_h;
            g_r_heavy[i].px = (unsigned long long)g_rt_w * (unsigned long long)g_rt_h;
            isnew = 1;
        }
    }
    g_r_heavy[i].n++;
    g_r_skip_heavy++;
    if (isnew || (g_r_heavy[i].n % 1000) == 0)
        vk_boot_logf("[r] heavy skip fs=%s instr=%llu px=%llu us_budget=%llu/%llu verts=%d idx=%d key=%#llx vs=%s calls=%llu",
                     fs, g_r_heavy[i].instr, px,
                     (px * g_r_heavy[i].instr) / R_HEAVY_UNITS_PER_US, R_HEAVY_BUDGET_US,
                     nverts, idx, (unsigned long long)g_r_cur_prog, vs, g_r_heavy[i].n);
}

/* replay 口径：真正录进 CB 之后补记（与 seen 的差 = 被 skip/丢掉的量）。 */
static void cen_replay(int is_arrays, unsigned long long verts)
{
    if (is_arrays) g_cen.arrays_replay++; else g_cen.elems_replay++;
    if (verts > 100) g_cen.geom_replay++;
}

/* ---- 一帧清单：head(前 120 条) + tail(后 40 条)，只保留**当前批次**（batch = g_r_flush_n） ---- */
#define CEN_HEAD 120
#define CEN_TAIL 40
typedef struct {
    unsigned long long n;
    unsigned long long img;
    unsigned count, verts, tyi;
    int topo, is_arrays;
    unsigned long long skip;
    unsigned w, h;
    unsigned sub;          /* M4ad：所属 submit —— 清单按 submit 聚合（boot#1 按 batch 永远凑不满） */
    char vs[17], fs[17];
} cen_row;
static cen_row g_cen_h[CEN_HEAD], g_cen_t[CEN_TAIL];
static int g_cen_hn, g_cen_ti, g_cen_tn, g_cen_tcur;
static unsigned long long g_cen_batch = ~0ull, g_cen_batch_tot;
static int g_cen_dump_done;
static unsigned g_cen_sub;                       /* 当前 submit 序号（gfx_bridge 设） */
static int g_cen_as_arrays;                      /* >0 = 本笔来自 nvn_vk_draw_arrays（分类用） */
/* M4ad P3②：几何 draw 前后回读（一次 boot 各一次） */
static int g_cn_pre_done, g_cn_post_done;
static VkImage g_cn_pre_img;
static unsigned g_cn_pre_w, g_cn_pre_h;
static void cen_dump_frame(unsigned sub, unsigned long long tot);   /* 定义在下方（一帧清单） */
static void lw_submit_tick(unsigned sub);   /* M4af P1/P3：定义在下方（送屏 RT 最后写入者） */
static void m39e_sub_tick(unsigned sub);    /* M39E：submit 边界上的槽签名采样（默认关） */
void nvn_vk_cen_set_submit(unsigned sub)
{
    lw_submit_tick(sub);   /* M4af：submit 边界（此刻 g_cen_batch_tot 仍是上一个 submit 的总数） */
    /* M4ad P1：切 submit 的瞬间把**上一帧**的完整清单打出来（全 boot 只打一帧；要求该帧至少 4 笔
       draw 且已经画过 3000 笔，避开启动期）。这里做而不是在 flush 里做：一帧会被切分成多个 batch。 */
    if (!g_cen_dump_done && sub != g_cen_sub && g_cen_batch_tot >= 4 && g_r_draws >= 3000) {
        g_cen_dump_done = 1;
        cen_dump_frame(g_cen_sub, g_cen_batch_tot);
    }
    g_cen_sub = sub;
}

static void cen_dump_line(int i, const cen_row *r)
{
    vk_boot_logf("[c] %3d #%llu %s vs=%s fs=%s count=%u verts=%u topo=%d img=%#llx tgt=%s ext=%ux%u skip=%llu",
                 i, r->n, r->is_arrays ? "arrays" : "elem ", r->vs, r->fs,
                 r->count, r->verts, r->topo, r->img, r->tyi ? "curRT" : "other", r->w, r->h, r->skip);
}

/* 把「当前累积的这一帧（一个 submit）」完整打出来。M4ad boot#1 的教训：按 **batch（一次 CB flush）**
   计数永远达不到 40——一帧只有 ~8.7 笔已重放 draw、且一个 submit 里会被 bind_textures 等处切分成
   好几个 batch。所以清单按 **submit** 聚合（gfx_bridge 每个 submit 开头调 nvn_vk_cen_set_submit）。 */
static void cen_dump_frame(unsigned sub, unsigned long long tot)
{
    vk_boot_logf("[c] ==== one-frame draw list submit#%u draws=%llu ext=%ux%u (head %d + tail %d) ====",
                 sub, tot, (unsigned)g_rt_w, (unsigned)g_rt_h, CEN_HEAD, CEN_TAIL);
    int shown = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_cen_hn; i++, shown++) cen_dump_line(shown, &g_cen_h[i]);
    if (tot > (unsigned long long)g_cen_hn) {
        unsigned long long abs0 = tot - (unsigned long long)g_cen_tn;
        int start = (g_cen_ti - g_cen_tn + CEN_TAIL) % CEN_TAIL;
        int sep = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < g_cen_tn; k++) {
            unsigned long long abs = abs0 + (unsigned long long)k;
            if (abs < (unsigned long long)g_cen_hn) continue;   /* 与 head 重叠段（tot 小时）去重 */
            if (!sep) { vk_boot_logf("[c]   ... (中间 %llu 笔省略)", abs - (unsigned long long)g_cen_hn); sep = 1; }
            cen_dump_line((int)abs, &g_cen_t[(start + k) % CEN_TAIL]);
            shown++;
        }
    }
    vk_boot_logf("[c] ==== end draw list (printed %d of %llu) ====", shown, tot);
}
static void cen_row_add(const cen_row *r)
{
    if (g_cen_batch != (unsigned long long)r->sub) {   /* 新 submit：清单从头开始 */
        g_cen_batch = (unsigned long long)r->sub; g_cen_hn = 0; g_cen_tn = 0; g_cen_ti = 0; g_cen_batch_tot = 0;
    }
    g_cen_batch_tot++;
    if (g_cen_hn < CEN_HEAD) g_cen_h[g_cen_hn++] = *r;
    g_cen_t[g_cen_ti] = *r;
    g_cen_ti = (g_cen_ti + 1) % CEN_TAIL;
    if (g_cen_tn < CEN_TAIL) g_cen_tn++;
}

/* ================= M4af P1/P2/P3：送屏 RT 的最后写入者 + quad 三样本 + submit 口径 =================
   只做取证，不改任何渲染行为。三个问题各一块：
   P1：在「内容快照刚成功」（= 屏幕上确实有画面，present 用的就是这张快照）之后，挑一个**完整 submit**，
       把该 submit 里所有写「送屏那张 RT」（按存储身份 key 认，槽 img 可能被重建，key 不会）的 draw
       打出来（前 40 + 后 40），末尾一行给出：最后一笔是谁、环境那笔 vs=c1b78a36ed2d336e 排第几、
       之后还有几笔写同一张 RT。⇒ 候选①（环境 pass 盖掉场景）成立与否的直接证据。
   P2：对关心的 vs 各取 ≤3 笔小 quad，打原始顶点、两种矩阵约定的 NDC、UBO 首 16 float、纹理槽状态。
       矩阵 bank 是启发式挑的（日志标 heur），不下结论；两种约定都打，避免猜错方向。
   P3：与 P1 同窗口，打 3 个连续 submit 的 draws / distinct target / 送屏 key 命中数，钉死
       「submit = 一帧 = 一次 present_try，present 每 every 次才真拷」这个口径。
   预算：P1 全 boot 一次；P2 ≤12 样本；P3 只 3 行。 */
#define LW_CAP      4096
#define LW_ENV_VS   "c1b78a36ed2d336e"
#define LW_SNAP_MAX 8
typedef struct {
    unsigned long long n, key;
    VkImage img;
    unsigned count, verts, w, h;
    int dvar, slot, texid;
    char vs[17], fs[17];
} lw_row;
static lw_row g_lw[LW_CAP];
static int g_lw_n, g_lw_dropped;
/* M4bh P1：本 submit 内写进各 RT 槽的 draw 笔数 —— 「这帧有多少笔 draw 打进这张 RT」的判据。
   M5t P1【修】：32 → H_RT_SLOTS(64)。表本身是 64 槽（M5s 扩的），但两个计数器还停在 32，
   于是 slot>=32 的 RT 在本口径里**永远是 writers=0**（写入被 `si < sizeof` 的上界检查静默丢掉）。
   自动选源把 writers>0 当硬资格，这个差额会直接让一半槽失去资格，所以本轮一起修。
   M6b：g_slot_dw / g_slot_dw_all 的定义与槽表一起上移（rt_link_tex_id 要用），这里只留注释。 */
/* M4by P1（只读台账）：整 boot 累计写进各 RT 槽的 draw 笔数。与 g_slot_dw 同点累加、**永不按 submit 清零**，
   用途是回答「texid=282 的 writers 到底是不是 0」——per-frame 计数会随窗口抖动，累计量不会。
   只在 pair 放行报告行里读取。 */
/* M4by P1：被放行的这一对最后落到的目标身份（只读，用于台账行） */
static int g_pair_tgt_slot = -1, g_pair_tgt_texid = -1;
static unsigned long long g_pair_tgt_key;
static unsigned g_r_pair_ungate_lines;
/* M4bh P1：每槽「每帧最后一个写入者」小环（4 帧）—— 合成源 RT 的「链式追 2 层」：
   若本帧唯一的写入者就是合成自己（自采样/反馈环），就往上翻一帧看它上一帧被谁写过。只读。 */
#define RT_HIST_N 4
typedef struct {
    unsigned long long sub, n;
    unsigned count, verts;
    char vs[17], fs[17];
} rt_hist_e;
static rt_hist_e g_rt_hist[32][RT_HIST_N];
static unsigned g_rt_hist_i;
static unsigned g_lw_sub;
static int g_lw_snap_dumps;
static unsigned g_lw_p3_left = 3;

/* 一笔颜色 draw 落到哪张 RT。匹配身份有四种（slot 下标 / 纹理 id / 存储 key / VkImage）：
   boot#1 实证「按 key 匹配」会漏——同一个 RT 槽会被重建（img 变）而 key 也可能来自不同来源；
   所以四种都记，快照时各报命中数，能直接区分「RT 真没被写」与「身份换了」。
   slot/texid 来自 h_rt_slot（静态表下标 = 槽号，稳定；texid 是游戏纹理 id）。 */
static void lw_note_draw(unsigned long long n, const void *keyp, int slot, int texid, VkImage img,
                         unsigned w, unsigned h, int count, int nverts, int dvar,
                         const char *vs, const char *fs)
{
    if (dvar >= 3) return;
    if (g_lw_n >= LW_CAP) { g_lw_dropped++; return; }
    lw_row *r = &g_lw[g_lw_n++];
    r->n = n; r->key = (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)keyp; r->slot = slot; r->texid = texid;
    r->img = img; r->w = w; r->h = h;
    r->count = (unsigned)count; r->verts = (unsigned)nverts; r->dvar = dvar;
    snprintf(r->vs, sizeof r->vs, "%s", vs);
    snprintf(r->fs, sizeof r->fs, "%s", fs);
}

static int lw_distinct(void)
{
    int nd = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_lw_n; i++) {
        int seen = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < i; j++)
            if (g_lw[j].slot == g_lw[i].slot && g_lw[j].texid == g_lw[i].texid &&
                g_lw[j].key == g_lw[i].key && g_lw[j].img == g_lw[i].img) { seen = 1; break; }
        if (!seen) nd++;
    }
    return nd;
}

/* 快照 = present 真正会显示的那张图。**当场**（同一 submit 内）回答：
   这一帧到此为止有哪些 draw 写了这张 RT、谁是最后一笔、环境那笔排第几、之后还有几笔。
   只打前 LW_SNAP_MAX 次（每次 ≤ 十几行，全 boot ≤ 100 行）。 */
static void lw_on_snapshot(VkImage img, unsigned long long key, int slot, int texid,
                           unsigned w, unsigned h)
{
    if (!img || g_lw_snap_dumps >= LW_SNAP_MAX) return;
    g_lw_snap_dumps++;
    static int midx[LW_CAP];
    int nm = 0, nslot = 0, nid = 0, nkey = 0, nimg = 0;
    int env_first = -1, env_last = -1, env_n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_lw_n; i++) {
        lw_row *r = &g_lw[i];
        int ms = (slot >= 0 && r->slot == slot);
        int mi = (texid >= 0 && r->texid == texid);
        int mk = (key && r->key == key);
        int mg = (r->img == img);
        if (ms) nslot++;
        if (mi) nid++;
        if (mk) nkey++;
        if (mg) nimg++;
        if (ms || mi || mk || mg) {
            midx[nm++] = i;
            if (!strcmp(r->vs, LW_ENV_VS)) { if (env_first < 0) env_first = nm; env_last = nm; env_n++; }
        }
    }
    vk_boot_logf("[c] lw snap#%d submit#%u draws_so_far=%llu slot=%d key=%#llx texid=%d img=%#llx ext=%ux%u "
                 "|=1| match slot=%d texid=%d key=%d img=%d union=%d",
                 g_lw_snap_dumps, g_lw_sub, g_r_draws, slot, key, texid,
                 (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)img, w, h, nslot, nid, nkey, nimg, nm);
    /* 本 submit 全部 target 直方图（按 slot 归并，top 8）：先看清「这一帧到底写了谁」。 */
    {
        int used[LW_CAP], nu = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < g_lw_n && nu < LW_CAP; i++) {
            int dup = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < nu; j++)
                if (g_lw[used[j]].slot == g_lw[i].slot && g_lw[used[j]].texid == g_lw[i].texid &&
                    g_lw[used[j]].key == g_lw[i].key) { dup = 1; break; }
            if (!dup) used[nu++] = i;
        }
        for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
            int best = -1; int bc = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < nu; j++) {
                if (used[j] < 0) continue;
                int c = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < g_lw_n; i++)
                    if (g_lw[i].slot == g_lw[used[j]].slot && g_lw[i].texid == g_lw[used[j]].texid &&
                        g_lw[i].key == g_lw[used[j]].key) c++;
                if (c > bc) { bc = c; best = j; }
            }
            if (best < 0) break;
            const lw_row *r = &g_lw[used[best]];
            vk_boot_logf("[c] lw snap#%d tgt slot=%d texid=%d key=%#llx ext=%ux%u n=%d%s",
                         g_lw_snap_dumps, r->slot, r->texid, r->key, r->w, r->h, bc,
                         (r->slot == slot) ? " <=SNAP_SLOT" : "");
            used[best] = -1;
        }
    }
    for (int k = 0; k < nm; k++) {
        const lw_row *r = &g_lw[midx[k]];
        vk_boot_logf("[c] lw snap#%d %d/%d #%llu vs=%s fs=%s count=%u verts=%u slot=%d texid=%d ext=%ux%u%s",
                     g_lw_snap_dumps, k + 1, nm, r->n, r->vs, r->fs, r->count, r->verts,
                     r->slot, r->texid, r->w, r->h, !strcmp(r->vs, LW_ENV_VS) ? " ENV" : "");
    }
    if (nm > 0) {
        const lw_row *last = &g_lw[midx[nm - 1]];
        vk_boot_logf("[c] lw snap#%d lastwrites: matched=%d last=#%llu vs=%s fs=%s last_is_env=%d "
                     "env_n=%d after_env=%d",
                     g_lw_snap_dumps, nm, last->n, last->vs, last->fs,
                     !strcmp(last->vs, LW_ENV_VS) ? 1 : 0, env_n,
                     env_last > 0 ? nm - env_last : -1);
    } else {
        vk_boot_logf("[c] lw snap#%d lastwrites: matched=0 (本 submit 到此为止没有任何 draw 写这张 RT；"
                     "四种身份全部落空 ⇒ 内容来自更早的 submit)", g_lw_snap_dumps);
    }
}

/* M4bh P1：每帧收口时，把「各槽本帧的最后一个写入者」推进小环（供合成源 RT 的链式追溯）。
   没被写过的槽也推一格（vs 置空），这样「本帧零写入者」与「更早帧的写入者」不会混淆。 */
static void rt_hist_tick(void)
{
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)(sizeof g_rt_hist / sizeof *g_rt_hist); i++) {
        rt_hist_e *e = &g_rt_hist[i][g_rt_hist_i];
        memset(e, 0, sizeof *e);
        e->sub = g_lw_sub;
        for (int k = 0; k < g_lw_n; k++) {
            lw_row *r = &g_lw[k];
            if (r->slot != i) continue;
            if (r->n < e->n) continue;             /* 取时间序最后一笔 */
            e->n = r->n; e->count = r->count; e->verts = r->verts;
            snprintf(e->vs, sizeof e->vs, "%s", r->vs);
            snprintf(e->fs, sizeof e->fs, "%s", r->fs);
        }
    }
    g_rt_hist_i = (g_rt_hist_i + 1) % RT_HIST_N;
}

/* 每个 submit 边界：复位本帧清单；顺带在 sub>=600 之后连打 3 个 submit 的口径行（P3）。 */
static void lw_submit_tick(unsigned sub)
{
    if (sub == g_lw_sub) return;
    rt_hist_tick();
    if (g_lw_p3_left && g_lw_sub >= 600) {
        g_lw_p3_left--;
        vk_boot_logf("[c] p3 submit#%u draws=%d distinct_tgt=%d cen_rows=%llu dropped=%d "
                     "(submit=一帧；present_try 每帧一次、真拷每 every 次一次)",
                     g_lw_sub, g_lw_n, lw_distinct(), g_cen_batch_tot, g_lw_dropped);
    }
    m39e_sub_tick(sub);   /* M39E：清表之前抓「本 submit 写得最多的槽」的签名（默认关，≤200 行） */
    g_lw_sub = sub; g_lw_n = 0; g_lw_dropped = 0;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof g_slot_dw / sizeof *g_slot_dw; i++) g_slot_dw[i] = 0;
}
/* ---- P2：quad 三样本 ---- */
#define QP_MAX 12
static const char *const kQpVs[] = {
    "dfc8b55e6b4c6d1b",   /* M4ae 一帧清单里 86 行的地形/贴图 quad */
    "46342a76690ceba3",   /* M4ae boot#1 写送屏 RT 的那笔（BaseVertex 类；默认关） */
    "c1b78a36ed2d336e",   /* 环境立方体全屏三角 */
    "cb2c389c55db819c",   /* 一帧里 33 行的 9 顶点那类 */
    "384597a04ae3928e",   /* 一帧里 4 行 */
};
#define QP_NVS ((int)(sizeof kQpVs / sizeof kQpVs[0]))
static int g_qp_cnt[QP_NVS];
static int g_qp_total;

static uint32_t r_ubo_offset(int stage, int bank);   /* 定义在本文件后部 */

static int qp_bank_pick(uint32_t mask, int *bank_out, uint32_t *off_out, float m[16])
{
    int best = -1, bestsc = -1; uint32_t bestoff = 0; float bestm[16];
    for (int b = 0; b < 32; b++) {
        if (!(mask & (1u << b))) continue;
        uint32_t off = r_ubo_offset(0, b);
        if (!off || !g_r_ubo_map) continue;
        float t[16]; memcpy(t, (const uint8_t *)g_r_ubo_map + off, sizeof t);
        int sc = 0, tiny = 0, unit = 0, nan = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
            float v = t[i];
            if (v != v) { nan++; continue; }
            float av = v < 0 ? -v : v;
            if (av == 0.0f) sc += 1;
            else if (av < 1e-2f) tiny += 2;          /* 透视缩放 1/1600、1/900 类 */
            else if (av == 1.0f) unit++;
        }
        sc += tiny + unit * 2 - nan * 4;
        if (sc > bestsc) { bestsc = sc; best = b; bestoff = off; memcpy(bestm, t, sizeof bestm); }
    }
    if (best < 0) return 0;
    *bank_out = best; *off_out = bestoff; memcpy(m, bestm, sizeof bestm);
    return 1;
}

/* rowconv：p[k]=Σ_i v[i]*m[4k+i]（行向量 v*M）；colconv：p[k]=Σ_i v[i]*m[4i+k]（列向量 M*v）。 */
static void qp_ndc(const float m[16], const float v[4], int col, float out[4])
{
    for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
        float s = 0.0f;
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) s += v[i] * (col ? m[4 * i + k] : m[4 * k + i]);
        out[k] = s;
    }
}

static void r_quad_probe(const float *pos, int pos_real, uint32_t nverts, const uint32_t *idx,
                         int count, int topo, int dvar, int instances,
                         const R_Key *kv, const R_Key *kf, unsigned w, unsigned h)
{
    if (!pos || g_qp_total >= QP_MAX) return;
    if (count < 3 || count > 64 || nverts < 3 || nverts > 16) return;
    if (w < h_rs_dim(1280) || h < h_rs_dim(720)) return;   /* M6v: 家族下限按光栅尺寸 */
    int vi = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < QP_NVS; i++) if (!strcmp(kv->key, kQpVs[i])) { vi = i; break; }
    if (vi < 0 || g_qp_cnt[vi] >= 3) return;
    g_qp_cnt[vi]++; g_qp_total++;
    vk_boot_logf("[q] quad %c%d vs=%s fs=%s count=%d verts=%u topo=%d dvar=%d inst=%d ext=%ux%u pos_real=%d nattr_mask=%#x",
                 (char)('A' + vi), g_qp_cnt[vi], kv->key, kf->key, count, nverts, topo, dvar,
                 instances, w, h, pos_real, kv->attr_mask);
    {   /* 原始顶点：最多 4 个，每个 4 float（NVN 的 w 分量也在里面） */
        char b[512]; int o = 0;
        o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o, "[q] quad vtx");
        for (uint32_t v = 0; v < nverts && v < 4; v++)
            o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o, " v%u=(%.4f,%.4f,%.4f,%.4f)",
                          v, pos[v * 4 + 0], pos[v * 4 + 1], pos[v * 4 + 2], pos[v * 4 + 3]);
        vk_boot_logf("%s", b);
    }
    {   char b[384]; int o = 0;
        o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o, "[q] quad idx");
        for (int i = 0; i < count && i < 6; i++) o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o, " %u", idx[i]);
        if (count > 6) o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o, " ...(%d)", count);
        vk_boot_logf("%s", b);
    }
    float m[16];
    int bank = -1; uint32_t off = 0;
    if (qp_bank_pick(kv->cbuf_mask, &bank, &off, m)) {
        /* M4ah P1：**探针口径修正**。上面 qp_bank_pick 从窗口首地址读 16 float 当矩阵，
           但 SPIR-V 反射（spirv-dis，见 /tmp/m4ah/A.spvasm）证明这类 VS 的访问链是
           `%__0 %int_0 %int_{1,2,3,4} %uint_{0..3}`——矩阵在 **cb3[1..4] = 字节 16..80**，
           v0 那个 vec4 从不被访问。旧口径整体早 16 B，于是把"真矩阵的 z 行"当成了 w 行，
           打出 w=-1 的假象（M4af 样本 A）。这里按声明的 +16 再读一份，两套都打，谁对一眼可辨。 */
        #define QP_SPV_MVP_OFF 16u
        vk_boot_logf("[q] quad mvp heur bank=%d off=%u sz=%u m=%.5f,%.5f,%.5f,%.5f,%.5f,%.5f,%.5f,%.5f,"
                     "%.5f,%.5f,%.5f,%.5f,%.5f,%.5f,%.5f,%.5f",
                     bank, off, g_r_ubo_sz[0][bank],
                     m[0], m[1], m[2], m[3], m[4], m[5], m[6], m[7],
                     m[8], m[9], m[10], m[11], m[12], m[13], m[14], m[15]);
        {   /* M4ah P1：按 SPIR-V 声明偏移（cb3[1..4]）再读一份 + 窗口前 24 个 float 原样 */
            float mv[16];
            if (off + QP_SPV_MVP_OFF + (uint32_t)sizeof mv <= R_UBO_ARENA) {
                memcpy(mv, (const uint8_t *)g_r_ubo_map + off + QP_SPV_MVP_OFF, sizeof mv);
                vk_boot_logf("[q] quad mvp spv(+%u) bank=%d off=%u m=%.5f,%.5f,%.5f,%.5f,%.5f,%.5f,%.5f,%.5f,"
                             "%.5f,%.5f,%.5f,%.5f,%.5f,%.5f,%.5f,%.5f",
                             QP_SPV_MVP_OFF, bank, off + QP_SPV_MVP_OFF,
                             mv[0], mv[1], mv[2], mv[3], mv[4], mv[5], mv[6], mv[7],
                             mv[8], mv[9], mv[10], mv[11], mv[12], mv[13], mv[14], mv[15]);
                for (int col = 0; col < 2; col++) {
                    char b[512]; int o = 0, inside = 0;
                    o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o, "[q] quad ndc2 spv %s",
                                  col ? "col(M*v)" : "row(v*M)");
                    for (uint32_t v = 0; v < nverts && v < 4; v++) {
                        float p[4], nd[3];
                        qp_ndc(mv, pos + v * 4, col, p);
                        if (p[3] != 0.0f) { nd[0] = p[0] / p[3]; nd[1] = p[1] / p[3]; nd[2] = p[2] / p[3]; }
                        else { nd[0] = p[0]; nd[1] = p[1]; nd[2] = p[2]; }
                        if (nd[0] >= -1.0f && nd[0] <= 1.0f && nd[1] >= -1.0f && nd[1] <= 1.0f) inside++;
                        o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o, " v%u=(%.3f,%.3f,%.3f,w=%.3f)",
                                      v, nd[0], nd[1], nd[2], p[3]);
                    }
                    o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o, " in_ndc_xy=%d", inside);
                    vk_boot_logf("%s", b);
                }
            } else {
                vk_boot_logf("[q] quad mvp spv(+%u) out-of-arena off=%u", QP_SPV_MVP_OFF, off);
            }
        }
        for (int col = 0; col < 2; col++) {
            char b[512]; int o = 0, inside = 0;
            o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o, "[q] quad ndc %s", col ? "col(M*v)" : "row(v*M)");
            for (uint32_t v = 0; v < nverts && v < 4; v++) {
                float p[4], nd[3];
                qp_ndc(m, pos + v * 4, col, p);
                if (p[3] != 0.0f) { nd[0] = p[0] / p[3]; nd[1] = p[1] / p[3]; nd[2] = p[2] / p[3]; }
                else { nd[0] = p[0]; nd[1] = p[1]; nd[2] = p[2]; }
                if (nd[0] >= -1.0f && nd[0] <= 1.0f && nd[1] >= -1.0f && nd[1] <= 1.0f) inside++;
                o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o, " v%u=(%.3f,%.3f,%.3f,w=%.3f)",
                              v, nd[0], nd[1], nd[2], p[3]);
            }
            o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o, " in_ndc_xy=%d", inside);
            vk_boot_logf("%s", b);
        }
    } else {
        vk_boot_logf("[q] quad mvp none (VS cbuf_mask=%#x 里没有可读 bank)", kv->cbuf_mask);
    }
    {   /* 纹理槽：view=0 = 1x1 白占位（采样源是空的）；kind 来自 gfx_bridge 的纹理表 */
        int ntex = kf->ntex < NVN_TX_SLOTS ? kf->ntex : NVN_TX_SLOTS;
        vk_boot_logf("[q] quad tex ntex=%d", kf->ntex);
        for (int i = 0; i < ntex && i < 4; i++) {
            int kind = g_r_tx_info[i].kind;
            const char *kn = kind == NVN_VK_SLOT_RT_SELF ? "rt-self" : kind == NVN_VK_SLOT_RT_OTHER ? "rt-other"
                           : kind == NVN_VK_SLOT_TEX ? "tex" : kind == NVN_VK_SLOT_PLACEHOLDER ? "placeholder"
                           : kind == NVN_VK_SLOT_DEPTH_NR ? "depth-nr" : "none";
            vk_boot_logf("[q] quad tex slot=%d id=%d ext=%ux%u fmt=%#x kind=%s up=%d view=%d rt_view=%d img=%#llx",
                         i, g_r_tx_info[i].id, g_r_tx_info[i].w, g_r_tx_info[i].h,
                         (unsigned)g_r_tx_info[i].fmt, kn, g_r_tx_info[i].up,
                         g_r_tx_view[i] ? 1 : 0,
                         nvn_vk_view_is_rt(g_r_tx_view[i]) ? 1 : 0,
                         (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)(g_r_tx_texobj[i] ? g_r_tx_texobj[i]->img : NULL));
        }
    }
}

/* M4ad P1：周期报告（由 gfx_bridge 的 nvn_h_report 在每 1800 submit 调一次）。 */
void nvn_vk_da_census_report(unsigned sub)
{
    vk_boot_logf("[c] census @submit#%u: arrays_seen=%llu arrays_replay=%llu arrays_skip=%llu arrays_fail=%llu "
                 "elems_seen=%llu elems_replay=%llu inst_multi=%llu inst_max=%u",
                 sub, g_cen.arrays_seen, g_cen.arrays_replay, g_cen.arrays_skip, g_cen.arrays_fail,
                 g_cen.elems_seen, g_cen.elems_replay, g_cen.inst_multi, g_cen.inst_max);
    {   char b[320]; int o = 0;
        o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o, "[c] census verts:");
        for (int i = 0; i < 6 && o < (int)sizeof b - 40; i++)
            o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o, " %s=%llu", kCenBucketName[i], g_cen.vb[i]);
        o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o, " | geom(>100)=%llu replayed=%llu dropped=%llu",
                      g_cen.geom, g_cen.geom_replay, g_cen.geom - g_cen.geom_replay);
        vk_boot_logf("%s", b);
    }
    {   char b[320]; int o = 0;
        o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o, "[c] census idx:");
        for (int i = 0; i < 6 && o < (int)sizeof b - 40; i++)
            o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o, " %s=%llu", kCenBucketName[i], g_cen.ib[i]);
        vk_boot_logf("%s", b);
    }
    vk_boot_logf("[c] census target: ext_1600x900=%llu ext_other=%llu tgt_cur(presented)=%llu tgt_other=%llu "
                 "dvar0(color-only)=%llu dvar_other=%llu",
                 g_cen.ext_main, g_cen.ext_other, g_cen.tgt_cur, g_cen.tgt_other, g_cen.dvar0, g_cen.dvar_other);
    for (int i = 0; i < g_cen.topn; i++)
        vk_boot_logf("[c] census topvs #%d vs=%s n=%llu verts_max=%llu",
                     i + 1, g_cen.top[i].vs, g_cen.top[i].n, g_cen.top[i].vmax);
    vk_boot_logf("[r] da totals replay=%llu skip=%llu fail=%llu",
                 g_cen.arrays_replay, g_cen.arrays_skip, g_cen.arrays_fail);
    /* M4ae P1：入口口径（= 全部 draw 尝试，含随后被 skip 的），以及按 skip 原因分开的桶。
       判据就一行：skip 各原因的 geom(>100) 是否非 0。 */
    {
        char b[400]; int o = 0;
        o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o,
                      "[c] census entry seen=%llu buckets(==3/4/5..32/33..255/256..4095/>=4096)=",
                      g_cen_e_seen);
        for (int i = 0; i < 6 && o < (int)sizeof b - 24; i++)
            o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o, "%llu/", g_cen_e_cb[i]);
        o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o, " geom(>100)=%llu", g_cen_e_geom);
        vk_boot_logf("%s", b);
    }
    {
        char b[400]; int o = 0;
        o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o,
                      "[c] census skipped total n=%llu buckets(==3/4/5..32/33..255/256..4095/>=4096)=",
                      g_cen_sk_total);
        for (int i = 0; i < 6 && o < (int)sizeof b - 24; i++)
            o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o, "%llu/", g_cen_sk_cb[i]);
        o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o, " geom(>100)=%llu", g_cen_sk_geom);
        vk_boot_logf("%s", b);
    }
    for (int w = 0; w < CEN_SK_N; w++) {
        cen_skrec *r = &g_cen_sk[w];
        if (!r->n) continue;
        char b[512]; int o = 0;
        o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o,
                      "[c] census skip %s: n=%llu buckets(==3/4/5..32/33..255/256..4095/>=4096)=",
                      kCenSkipName[w], r->n);
        for (int i = 0; i < 6 && o < (int)sizeof b - 24; i++)
            o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o, "%llu/", r->cb[i]);
        o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o, " geom(>100)=%llu", r->geom);
        if (r->nvs) {
            int bv = 0;
            if (o < (int)sizeof b - 96) bv = r_bin_spv(r->vs[0].k, 0, &(size_t){0}) != NULL;
            o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o, " top_vs=%s(%llu,bin_vs0=%d)", r->vs[0].k, r->vs[0].n, bv ? 0 : 1);
        } else o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o, " top_vs=-(0,bin_vs0=1)");
        if (r->nfs) {
            int bf = 0;
            if (o < (int)sizeof b - 96) bf = r_bin_spv(r->fs[0].k, 1, &(size_t){0}) != NULL;
            o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o, " top_fs=%s(%llu,bin_fs0=%d)", r->fs[0].k, r->fs[0].n, bf ? 0 : 1);
        } else o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o, " top_fs=-(0,bin_fs0=1)");
        vk_boot_logf("%s", b);
    }
    vk_boot_logf("[r] replay flags basev=%d inst=%d (0=旧行为 1=M4ad 新接线)",
                 g_rf_basev < 0 ? 0 : g_rf_basev, g_rf_inst < 0 ? 0 : g_rf_inst);
    /* M4af：P1 状态 + P2 样本计数。state=0 表示从没等到「有内容的快照」——免得把「零证据」读成「零失败」。 */
    vk_boot_logf("[c] lw snapshots=%d/%d rows=%d dropped=%d (rows=当前 submit 已收的颜色 draw)",
                 g_lw_snap_dumps, LW_SNAP_MAX, g_lw_n, g_lw_dropped);
    {   char b[384]; int o = 0;
        o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o, "[q] samples total=%d/%d", g_qp_total, QP_MAX);
        for (int i = 0; i < QP_NVS && o < (int)sizeof b - 40; i++)
            o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o, " %s=%d", kQpVs[i], g_qp_cnt[i]);
        vk_boot_logf("%s", b);
    }
    r_flags_reload();   /* 同一 boot 内换组合做归因（写 files/smo_replay_flags 即可，下个报告点生效） */
}

/* M3v P3：真正被重放出去的 draw 按 (vs,fs,topo) 归类，回答「那 2 万笔到底是不是同一个程序」。 */
#define R_DRAWHIST 64
static struct { char vs[17], fs[17]; int topo; unsigned long long n; } g_dh[R_DRAWHIST];
static int g_dh_n;
static void r_drawhist(const R_Key *kv, const R_Key *kf, int topo)
{
    for (int i = 0; i < g_dh_n; i++)
        if (g_dh[i].topo == topo && !strcmp(g_dh[i].vs, kv->key) && !strcmp(g_dh[i].fs, kf->key)) { g_dh[i].n++; return; }
    if (g_dh_n >= R_DRAWHIST) return;
    snprintf(g_dh[g_dh_n].vs, 17, "%s", kv->key);
    snprintf(g_dh[g_dh_n].fs, 17, "%s", kf->key);
    g_dh[g_dh_n].topo = topo; g_dh[g_dh_n].n = 1; g_dh_n++;
}
static void r_drawhist_dump(const char *why)
{
    unsigned long long c[R_DRAWHIST];   /* 非破坏：报告多次也不清零 */
    for (int i = 0; i < g_dh_n; i++) c[i] = g_dh[i].n;
    for (int rank = 0; rank < 4; rank++) {
        int best = -1; unsigned long long bv = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < g_dh_n; i++) if (c[i] > bv) { bv = c[i]; best = i; }
        if (best < 0) break;
        vk_boot_logf("[r] replayed #%d vs=%s fs=%s topo=%d n=%llu (%s)",
                     rank + 1, g_dh[best].vs, g_dh[best].fs, g_dh[best].topo, c[best], why);
        c[best] = 0;
    }
}
/* ---- M4h P1：skip nokey 的 (vs,fs) 聚合表 ----
   旧探针只打前 4 条（`g_r_skip_nokey <= 4`），长尾完全不可见，M4g 曾据此误判「5 对=全部」。
   这里改成开放寻址哈希聚合（键 = vs+fs 两个 16 hex），在报告点 dump top 20；每行带 bin 有/无
   标记（r_bin_spv 直接查 spv.bin 容器），一眼分开「index 漏登记」与「真的没烘」。 */
#define R_NOKEY_HIST 4096
#define R_NOKEY_HASH 8192
typedef struct {
    char vs[17], fs[17];
    unsigned long long n;
    /* M4ae P3：补齐「缺失 key」时最需要的两个量——这些被 skip 的 draw 到底要多少索引/顶点，
       以及打在哪种尺寸的 RT 上（1600x900 = 送屏主图，其它 = 中间图）。 */
    unsigned long long cmax, csum, ext_main, ext_other;
} R_NoKey;
static R_NoKey g_nkh[R_NOKEY_HIST];
static int g_nkh_n;
static uint32_t g_nkh_hash[R_NOKEY_HASH];   /* 下标+1，0=空槽 */
static unsigned long long g_nkh_over;       /* 表满后丢弃的 skip 次数（>0 表示 topN 不完整） */
static unsigned long long g_nkh_total;

static uint32_t r_nokey_hash(const char *vs, const char *fs)
{
    uint32_t h = 2166136261u;
    for (int i = 0; i < 16 && vs[i]; i++) h = (h ^ (uint32_t)(unsigned char)vs[i]) * 16777619u;
    h = (h ^ 0xFFu) * 16777619u;
    for (int i = 0; i < 16 && fs[i]; i++) h = (h ^ (uint32_t)(unsigned char)fs[i]) * 16777619u;
    return h;
}

static void r_nokey_hist(const char *vs, const char *fs, int count, int ext_main)
{
    g_nkh_total++;
    unsigned long long c = (unsigned long long)(count > 0 ? count : 0);
    uint32_t h = r_nokey_hash(vs, fs) & (R_NOKEY_HASH - 1u);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < R_NOKEY_HASH; i++) {
        uint32_t s = g_nkh_hash[(h + i) & (R_NOKEY_HASH - 1u)];
        if (!s) break;
        R_NoKey *e = &g_nkh[s - 1];
        if (!strcmp(e->vs, vs) && !strcmp(e->fs, fs)) {
            e->n++; e->csum += c;
            if (c > e->cmax) e->cmax = c;
            if (ext_main) e->ext_main++; else e->ext_other++;
            return;
        }
    }
    if (g_nkh_n >= R_NOKEY_HIST) { g_nkh_over++; return; }
    R_NoKey *e = &g_nkh[g_nkh_n];
    snprintf(e->vs, sizeof e->vs, "%s", vs);
    snprintf(e->fs, sizeof e->fs, "%s", fs);
    e->n = 1; e->cmax = c; e->csum = c;
    if (ext_main) e->ext_main = 1; else e->ext_other = 1;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < R_NOKEY_HASH; i++) {
        uint32_t s = (h + i) & (R_NOKEY_HASH - 1u);
        if (!g_nkh_hash[s]) { g_nkh_hash[s] = (uint32_t)(g_nkh_n + 1); break; }
    }
    g_nkh_n++;
}

void nvn_vk_skip_nokey_dump(unsigned sub)
{
    static unsigned char done[R_NOKEY_HIST];
    memset(done, 0, sizeof done);
    vk_boot_logf("[r] nokey hist @submit#%u: distinct=%d total=%llu overflow=%llu top=20",
                 sub, g_nkh_n, g_nkh_total, g_nkh_over);
    for (int rank = 0; rank < 20 && rank < g_nkh_n; rank++) {
        int best = -1;
        unsigned long long bv = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < g_nkh_n; i++)
            if (!done[i] && g_nkh[i].n > bv) { bv = g_nkh[i].n; best = i; }
        if (best < 0) break;
        done[best] = 1;
        R_NoKey *e = &g_nkh[best];
        /* bin 标记：容器里是否有该键的对应 stage（VS=0 / FS=1）。与 index 无关——nokey 本身就是
           index 查不到，这里要回答的是「.spv 到底在不在包里」。 */
        int bv_ = r_bin_spv(e->vs, 0, &(size_t){0}) != NULL;
        int bf_ = r_bin_spv(e->fs, 1, &(size_t){0}) != NULL;
        vk_boot_logf("[r] nokey top#%d vs=%s fs=%s n=%llu bin_vs=%d bin_fs=%d "
                     "count_max=%llu count_sum=%llu ext_main=%llu ext_other=%llu",
                     rank + 1, e->vs, e->fs, e->n, bv_, bf_,
                     e->cmax, e->csum, e->ext_main, e->ext_other);
    }
}

static unsigned long long g_r_skip_nort, g_r_skip_basev, g_r_skip_nverts, g_r_skip_alloc;
static unsigned long long g_r_attr_placeholder;   /* 无真实数据、按零填充占位的属性数 */
/* M4at P1：顶点属性格式台账（每笔 draw 每属性 +1，成本可忽略）。
   `[p1] vtx` 只在 p1_dump 选中那几笔上打（全 boot 24 行），代表不了整轮分布 ⇒
   在属性展开点逐次累加，由 `[p1] attr fmt totals` 在 submit 台账里带出（ok=有真数据 / ph=占位）。 */
static unsigned long long g_at_fmt_ok[256], g_at_fmt_ph[256];
static unsigned g_at_raw_logged;   /* 0x69 解包的原始字节取证额度（限流 12 行；boot#1 的坑：与整型共用一份额度会被 0x03 抢光） */
static unsigned g_at_raw_int_logged;   /* 整型属性（0x03/0x0F/0x27）位模式取证额度（限流 12 行） */
/* M4au：骨骼索引属性的**全量**取值范围（只看前 4 个顶点不足以判 "shader 要读到 528"：
   若整笔 draw 的 max 索引是 9，则 512 B 就是够的，528 的说法当场证伪）。限流 4 行。 */
static unsigned g_at_idxrange_logged;

/* M4at P1：`[p1] attr fmt totals` —— 整轮出现过的顶点属性格式 Top16（ok=有真数据 / ph=占位）。
   判据用途：① 证明本轮补的 0x69/0x03 从 ph 变 ok；② 下一轮不再靠 [p1] vtx 那 24 行猜语料。 */
void nvn_vk_attr_fmt_report(unsigned sub)
{
    int best[16], nb = 0, more = 0;
    for (int f = 0; f < 256; f++) {
        unsigned long long c = g_at_fmt_ok[f] + g_at_fmt_ph[f];
        if (!c) continue;
        if (nb == 16 && c <= g_at_fmt_ok[best[15]] + g_at_fmt_ph[best[15]]) { more = 1; continue; }
        int pos = nb < 16 ? nb : 15;
        while (pos > 0 && (g_at_fmt_ok[best[pos - 1]] + g_at_fmt_ph[best[pos - 1]]) < c) {
            if (nb == 16) best[pos] = best[pos - 1];
            pos--;
        }
        if (nb == 16) best[pos] = f;
        else { for (int j = nb; j > pos; j--) best[j] = best[j - 1]; best[pos] = f; nb++; }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < nb; i++) {   /* 按 fmt 升序，便于和 nvn.h 对照 */
        int v = best[i], j = i - 1;
        while (j >= 0 && best[j] > v) { best[j + 1] = best[j]; j--; }
        best[j + 1] = v;
    }
    char buf[900]; int o = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < nb; i++)
        o += snprintf(buf + o, sizeof buf - (size_t)o, " %#04x=%llu/%llu",
                      best[i], g_at_fmt_ok[best[i]], g_at_fmt_ph[best[i]]);
    if (!nb) return;
    vk_boot_logf("[p1] attr fmt totals @submit#%u: %d fmts (fmt=ok/ph)%s%s", sub, nb, buf, more ? " +more" : "");
}

static unsigned long long g_r_placeholder_draws, g_r_real_attr_draws;
static unsigned g_r_rb_done;
/* M4h P1：读回取样点改到「首笔真实游戏 draw 之后 + 之后每 300 帧」。
   旧行为在 t+1~14s 打 3 次，早于场景 draw ⇒ distinct_approx=1 无法作为画面判据。
   frame 取 gfx_bridge 的帧锚点（WindowAcquireTexture 计数）；弱符号缺失时退回 flush 计数。 */
static unsigned long long g_r_batch_draws;   /* 本批次已录进 CB 的真实 draw 数（flush 时清零） */
/* ==== M5w P0：在飞批次的成分 + 实测成本账（只读探针，供 [hang] 行与实测隔离用）====
   任务要求「hang 的那批 draw 是谁」：一个 submit 会被切成多个 batch，而卡住的正是其中一个 batch 的
   栅栏。所以这里在**录制侧**就按 (vs,fs) 累计本批次的笔数/最大 verts*count，flush 入口把累加器冻结成
   g_hb（live=1），栅栏返回后写实测 us 再清 live —— 这样「卡住时」[hang] 能把在飞批次点名。
   纯记账：不改变任何 draw 的录制/提交路径。 */
#define R_HB_TOPS 3
#define R_HB_DISTINCT 6
typedef struct { char vs[17], fs[17]; unsigned long long n, work; } R_HBTop;
typedef struct {
    unsigned long long ndraw, verts_max, count_sum, work_max;
    unsigned instr_max;                                       /* M5x：本批最重的程序（代价模型用） */
    int ndist; R_HBTop d[R_HB_DISTINCT];
} R_HBAcc;
static R_HBAcc g_hb_cur;                                  /* 录制侧累加器（flush 入口清零） */
static struct {
    int live; unsigned sub;
    unsigned long long ndraw, verts_max, count_sum, px, us;
    double t0;
    int ntop; R_HBTop top[R_HB_TOPS];
} g_hb;                                                   /* 在飞批次快照（flush 入口冻结、栅栏后清 live） */
static struct {                                          /* 上一笔已完成的批次（实测 us） */
    unsigned sub; unsigned long long ndraw, verts_max, us; int ntop; R_HBTop top[R_HB_TOPS];
} g_hb_last;
static double r_hb_now(void)
{
    struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    return (double)ts.tv_sec + (double)ts.tv_nsec / 1e9;
}
/* 录制侧：本笔进账（只统计，不判定） */
static void hb_note(const char *vs, const char *fs, unsigned nverts, int count, unsigned instr)
{
    unsigned long long work = (unsigned long long)nverts * (unsigned long long)(count > 0 ? count : 1);
    g_hb_cur.ndraw++;
    g_hb_cur.count_sum += (unsigned long long)(count > 0 ? count : 0);
    if ((unsigned long long)nverts > g_hb_cur.verts_max) g_hb_cur.verts_max = nverts;
    if (work > g_hb_cur.work_max) g_hb_cur.work_max = work;
    if (instr > g_hb_cur.instr_max) g_hb_cur.instr_max = instr;   /* M5x：批次里最重程序的指令数 */
    if (!vs || !fs) return;
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < g_hb_cur.ndist; i++)
        if (!strcmp(g_hb_cur.d[i].vs, vs) && !strcmp(g_hb_cur.d[i].fs, fs)) break;
    if (i >= g_hb_cur.ndist) {
        if (g_hb_cur.ndist >= R_HB_DISTINCT) return;       /* 只留前 6 个不同程序（够点名） */
        i = g_hb_cur.ndist++;
        snprintf(g_hb_cur.d[i].vs, sizeof g_hb_cur.d[i].vs, "%s", vs);
        snprintf(g_hb_cur.d[i].fs, sizeof g_hb_cur.d[i].fs, "%s", fs);
        g_hb_cur.d[i].n = 0; g_hb_cur.d[i].work = 0;
    }
    g_hb_cur.d[i].n++;
    if (work > g_hb_cur.d[i].work) g_hb_cur.d[i].work = work;
}
/* flush 入口：把累加器冻结进 g_hb（按笔数取前 3），并清累加器 */
static void hb_freeze(unsigned sub, unsigned long long bd)
{
    g_hb.live = 1; g_hb.sub = sub; g_hb.ndraw = bd;
    g_hb.verts_max = g_hb_cur.verts_max; g_hb.count_sum = g_hb_cur.count_sum;
    g_hb.px = (unsigned long long)g_rt_w * (unsigned long long)g_rt_h;
    g_hb.us = 0; g_hb.t0 = r_hb_now(); g_hb.ntop = 0;
    for (int k = 0; k < R_HB_TOPS; k++) {
        int best = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < g_hb_cur.ndist; i++) {
            int used = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < g_hb.ntop; j++) if (!strcmp(g_hb.top[j].fs, g_hb_cur.d[i].fs) && !strcmp(g_hb.top[j].vs, g_hb_cur.d[i].vs)) used = 1;
            if (used) continue;
            if (best < 0 || g_hb_cur.d[i].n > g_hb_cur.d[best].n) best = i;
        }
        if (best < 0) break;
        g_hb.top[g_hb.ntop++] = g_hb_cur.d[best];
    }
    memset(&g_hb_cur, 0, sizeof g_hb_cur);
}
/* ================= M5x P1：submit 前的内存爆炸否决 =================
   事实（logs/m5t_m5w_b1，见 M5w 报告 P2）：fs=b85fe283bfa233cf（instr=5886、verts=4 全屏）
   **在一次 wait 内**把 RSS 从 3.5 GB 拉到 13.7 GB，进程被 LMK 杀在 t=488 s。现有 RSS 护栏是
   "事后刹车"（心跳线程观察），跨不过一次阻塞 wait ⇒ 必须在**把 draw 录进批次之前**估一个上界。

   代价模型（只由两个已测点标定，不引入新猜测）：
       est_mb = px * instr_max / R_MEMV_MB_DIV + R_MEMV_BASE_MB
     · 病态点 b85fe283bfa233cf：px=1440000、instr=5886 ⇒ 8256 MB（实测涨了 ~7740 MB）
     · 健康点 e07de9e4363ef990：px=1440000、instr=4282 ⇒ 6074 MB（M5e 明确解禁的加载画面合成 pass）
   默认阈值 6500 MB 正好把这两点分开；env SMO_MEMVETO_MB 可覆盖（0 = 关闸）。
   instr_max 是本批次已录制 draw 的最大指令数，与当前 draw 取 max ⇒ 这是"批次规模 × 程序代价"
   的上界（批次里最重的那只决定量级；实测 63 笔/批的慢 shader 只慢不涨内存，所以不乘笔数）。
   超阈值 ⇒ 本笔不进录制、该 FS key 进隔离表（本 boot 内同 key 一律跳），并打一行 [r] mem veto。
   诚实说明：6.5% 余量是个窄边界；它是启发式，不是测量值。 */
#define R_MEMV_MB_DIV      1060000ull
#define R_MEMV_BASE_MB     256ull
/* M5y P1：6500 -> 8000。数据点（都已在 boot 内实测）：
     b85fe283bfa233cf  instr=5886 verts=4 全屏  est=8256  ⇒ **真炸**（M5w b1 RSS 3.5->13.7 GB，LMK）
     e07de9e4363ef990  instr=4282 verts=4 全屏  est=6074  ⇒ 健康（加载画面合成 pass）
     dfd29433f17d8346  instr=5438 verts=3 全屏  est=7643  ⇒ 健康（M5x b2 误否决 2 个 key 的这一类）
     cb2c389c55db819c/fa677b6a0f7d5e0a instr=13831 verts=9 est=19045 ⇒ 健康（M5w 实测 146 ms/批）
   注意 6500~8000 这段里已有两个「实测健康、估值为 7.6 GB」的点，而唯一的真炸点在 8256。
   所以阈值必须落在 7644..8256 之间；取 8000 是这段里离真炸点最近的整百值（余量 256 MB = 3%）。
   这不是「调到永不触发」：est>=8000 的未知 key 仍被拦，且真炸点同时在 heavy 默认隔离表里
   （b85fe283bfa233cf），是双保险。形状条件（verts>4 不按内存否决）保留。 */
#define R_MEMV_DEFAULT_MB  8000
#define R_MEMV_KEYS_MAX    6
static unsigned long long g_r_skip_memveto;
static char g_memv_keys[R_MEMV_KEYS_MAX][17];
static unsigned long long g_memv_key_n[R_MEMV_KEYS_MAX];   /* M5x：每 key 被否决的笔数（对账） */
static int g_memv_keys_n;
static int g_memv_thr_mb = -1;          /* -1 = 未读；0 = 关闸 */
static int r_memv_thr(void)
{
    if (g_memv_thr_mb >= 0) return g_memv_thr_mb;
    g_memv_thr_mb = R_MEMV_DEFAULT_MB;
    const char *e = getenv("SMO_MEMVETO_MB");
    if (!e || !*e) e = getenv("smo_memveto_mb");
    if (e && *e) { int v = atoi(e); if (v >= 0) g_memv_thr_mb = v; }
    vk_boot_logf("[r] mem veto switch thr=%dMB div=%llu base=%lluMB (env SMO_MEMVETO_MB; 0=off)",
                 g_memv_thr_mb, R_MEMV_MB_DIV, R_MEMV_BASE_MB);
    return g_memv_thr_mb;
}
static int r_memv_key_hit(const char *fs)
{
    for (int i = 0; i < g_memv_keys_n; i++) if (!strcmp(g_memv_keys[i], fs)) return 1;
    return 0;
}
static void r_memv_key_bump(const char *fs)
{
    for (int i = 0; i < g_memv_keys_n; i++)
        if (!strcmp(g_memv_keys[i], fs)) { g_memv_key_n[i]++; return; }
}
/* 1 = 本笔必须跳过（内存爆炸否决）。只记账 + 打一行，不改变别的 draw。 */
static int r_memv_veto(const char *vs, const char *fs, unsigned instr, int nverts, int count)
{
    int thr = r_memv_thr();
    if (thr <= 0) return 0;
    int hit_key = r_memv_key_hit(fs);
    unsigned imax = g_hb_cur.instr_max;
    if (instr > imax) imax = instr;
    unsigned long long px = (unsigned long long)g_rt_w * (unsigned long long)g_rt_h;
    if (!px) px = 1;
    unsigned long long est = (px * (unsigned long long)imax) / R_MEMV_MB_DIV + R_MEMV_BASE_MB;
    /* M5y：6500..8000 这段是「旧阈值会误杀、新阈值放行」的实测健康区，第一次遇到时点名留证。 */
    if (!hit_key && (long long)est >= 6500 && (long long)est < (long long)thr) {
        static unsigned npass;
        if (npass++ < 4)
            vk_boot_logf("[r] mem veto pass key=%s/%s est_mb=%llu thr=%dMB verts=%d instr=%u "
                         "(旧 6500 会否决；实测健康区 6500..8000)",
                         vs ? vs : "-", fs, est, thr, nverts, instr);
    }
    if (!hit_key && (long long)est < (long long)thr) return 0;
    /* M5x boot#1 实测的反例：sub#616 的 cb2c389c55db819c/fa677b6a0f7d5e0a（instr=13831、verts=9、
       est=19045MB）被本闸门跳掉 8+ 笔，但同批在 M5w b2 实测只花 146 s、RSS 峰值 3.36 GB ⇒
       "指令多"不等于"内存炸"。本作两次真实的 RSS 爆炸（b85fe283bfa233cf、7b4bc01e 类）都是
       **全屏 pass（verts<=4）**，而 verts=9 的几何批只慢不涨。所以再加一条形状条件：
       只有全屏类（或 key 已在隔离表）才按内存爆炸否决。 */
    if (!hit_key && nverts > 4) return 0;
    if (!hit_key && g_memv_keys_n < R_MEMV_KEYS_MAX) {
        snprintf(g_memv_keys[g_memv_keys_n], sizeof g_memv_keys[0], "%s", fs);
        g_memv_keys_n++;
    }
    r_memv_key_bump(fs);
    g_r_skip_memveto++;
    if (g_r_skip_memveto <= 8 || (g_r_skip_memveto % 500) == 0)
        vk_boot_logf("[r] mem veto sub=%u key=%s/%s est_mb=%llu thr=%dMB rss=%ldMB instr=%u imax=%u px=%llu "
                     "batch_draws=%llu verts=%d count=%d nkeys=%d skip_total=%llu",
                     g_cen_sub, vs ? vs : "-", fs, est, thr, r_rss_mb(), instr, imax, px,
                     g_hb_cur.ndraw, nverts, count, g_memv_keys_n, g_r_skip_memveto);
    return 1;
}

static char *hb_tops_str(char *b, size_t cap, int ntop, const R_HBTop *top)
{
    size_t o = 0; b[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ntop && o + 12 < cap; i++)
        o += (size_t)snprintf(b + o, cap - o, "%s%s/%s x%llu", i ? "," : "",
                              top[i].vs, top[i].fs, top[i].n);
    return b;
}
/* [hang] 行用：在飞批次是谁。由 vk_boot.c 的心跳线程经弱符号 runtime_hang_batch_dump() 调用
   （M5w 自写 bug：曾命名 nvn_vk_hang_batch_dump，与 vk_boot.c 的弱引用名不一致 ⇒ 一行都没打出来；
   修法=改成弱引用名本身）。 */
void runtime_hang_batch_dump(void)
{
    char t[200];
    if (g_hb.live) {
        vk_boot_logf("[hang] batch sub=%u ndraw=%llu verts_max=%llu count_sum=%llu px=%llu elapsed_us=%llu tops=%s",
                     g_hb.sub, g_hb.ndraw, g_hb.verts_max, g_hb.count_sum, g_hb.px,
                     (unsigned long long)((r_hb_now() - g_hb.t0) * 1e6),
                     hb_tops_str(t, sizeof t, g_hb.ntop, g_hb.top));
    } else {
        vk_boot_logf("[hang] batch none in flight (no batch submitted / fence already returned)");
    }
    if (g_hb_last.ndraw || g_hb_last.us)
        vk_boot_logf("[hang] last batch sub=%u ndraw=%llu verts_max=%llu us=%llu tops=%s",
                     g_hb_last.sub, g_hb_last.ndraw, g_hb_last.verts_max, g_hb_last.us,
                     hb_tops_str(t, sizeof t, g_hb_last.ntop, g_hb_last.top));
    /* 隔离表当前内容（谁被挡、挡了多少笔）——与 [r] heavy skip 行同口径，hang 时一眼可对账。 */
    {
        char kl[200]; size_t o = 0; kl[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < g_r_heavy_n && o + 40 < sizeof kl; i++)
            o += (size_t)snprintf(kl + o, sizeof kl - o, "%s%s(instr=%llu,calls=%llu)",
                                  i ? "," : "", g_r_heavy[i].fs, g_r_heavy[i].instr, g_r_heavy[i].n);
        vk_boot_logf("[hang] heavytab n=%d learn_n=%d skip_heavy=%llu [%s]",
                     g_r_heavy_n, g_r_heavy_learned_n, g_r_skip_heavy, g_r_heavy_n ? kl : "-");
    }
}
static unsigned long long g_r_flush_n;
static unsigned long long g_r_rb_frame0, g_r_rb_next;
static unsigned g_r_rb_samples;              /* 周期取样已做次数（上限 4，防 PAM 刷盘拖慢） */
__attribute__((weak)) unsigned long long dm_frame_anchor_get(void);
static unsigned long long r_frame_now(void)
{
    unsigned long long f = dm_frame_anchor_get ? dm_frame_anchor_get() : 0ull;
    return f ? f : g_r_flush_n;
}
/* 顶点/索引的常驻 arena：一块 host-visible 大缓冲，按 submit 批次 bump 分配、flush 时回卷。
   为什么不再「每笔 draw 建一个 VkBuffer、submit 后销毁」：上一轮（draw #50~#86 之间）就是在这条
   建/毁节奏上崩的（SIGSEGV/ACCERR 落在 SwiftShader 的 JIT 代码里，访问的是它 malloc 出来的
   host-visible 缓冲）。改成常驻 + 只在批次边界回卷，buffer 生命周期与 submit 生命周期解耦，
   同时每段之间留 256B 余量（防止驱动对末尾做超额预取）。 */
#define R_ARENA_BYTES (16u << 20)
#define R_ARENA_PAD   256u
static VkBuffer g_r_arena;
static VkDeviceMemory g_r_arena_mem;
static uint8_t *g_r_arena_map;
static VkDeviceSize g_r_arena_used;
static int g_r_arena_state;      /* 0=未试 1=ok -1=失败 */

static int r_arena_ensure(void)
{
    if (g_r_arena_state) return g_r_arena_state > 0;
    g_r_arena_state = -1;
    if (!g_dev) return 0;
    VkBufferCreateInfo bi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO };
    bi.size = R_ARENA_BYTES;
    bi.usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_VERTEX_BUFFER_BIT | VK_BUFFER_USAGE_INDEX_BUFFER_BIT;
    bi.sharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE;
    VkResult rv = vkCreateBuffer(g_dev, &bi, NULL, &g_r_arena);
    if (rv != VK_SUCCESS) { vk_boot_logf("[r-red] arena vkCreateBuffer rv=%d (%s)", (int)rv, vr(rv)); return 0; }
    VkMemoryRequirements rq;
    vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(g_dev, g_r_arena, &rq);
    int ti = find_type(rq, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT);
    VkMemoryAllocateInfo ai = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO };
    ai.allocationSize = rq.size; ai.memoryTypeIndex = ti >= 0 ? (uint32_t)ti : 0;
    rv = vkAllocateMemory(g_dev, &ai, NULL, &g_r_arena_mem);
    if (rv != VK_SUCCESS) { vk_boot_logf("[r-red] arena vkAllocateMemory rv=%d (%s)", (int)rv, vr(rv)); return 0; }
    vkBindBufferMemory(g_dev, g_r_arena, g_r_arena_mem, 0);
    if (vkMapMemory(g_dev, g_r_arena_mem, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE, 0, (void **)&g_r_arena_map) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        vk_boot_logf("[r-red] arena vkMapMemory failed"); g_r_arena_map = NULL; return 0;
    }
    /* M4k P1④：不再整块 memset 16 MB。arena 是 bump 分配，每笔 take 的 [abase, abase+total)
       都由调用方整段写满（顶点+索引两段），未取的尾巴不会被 GPU 读；整块清零只是把 16 MB
       匿名页提前触页、白占 RSS 峰值。去掉后按实际用到的量逐页 fault。 */
    g_r_arena_state = 1;
    vk_boot_logf("[r] arena ok buf=%#llx %u MB (lazy, no upfront memset)", (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_r_arena, R_ARENA_BYTES >> 20);
    return 1;
}

/* 在当前批次里划一块（16 对齐）。返回块内偏移，失败返回 ~0ull。 */
static VkDeviceSize r_arena_take(VkDeviceSize need)
{
    VkDeviceSize off = (g_r_arena_used + 15) & ~(VkDeviceSize)15;
    if (off + need + R_ARENA_PAD > R_ARENA_BYTES) return ~(VkDeviceSize)0;
    g_r_arena_used = off + need + R_ARENA_PAD;
    return off;
}

/* ---- M3t：常量区映射（boot#1 的确定性缺陷） ----
   boot#1 取证：本作只调 BindUniformBuffer(stage, index=0, 64 KiB)（stage 0/1/2/5 各一次），
   而 draw 的 VS 读的是 c[3]（shader_cache/index.json：stage0 cbuf_mask=0x8、cbuf_size{3:256}）。
   c[0]/c[2] 是驱动保留段（infra/nxnative/dm/gfx/nvn/dmsh_abi.h:9 注释），用户 bank 从 3 起，
   即 bind index i 落在 c[i+3]。于是 bank b 未绑定时取 bind index b-3 的真实字节；再没有才退回零槽。
   这不是猜测落地：每次映射/未命中都打日志，draw#1 与 draw#1000 另把该 bank 前 20 个 float 落盘。 */
static unsigned g_ubo_bank_map, g_ubo_bank_miss;
/* M7d P3（本轮唯一的**行为改动**，可一键回退）：c4 的位置矩阵锚定。
   证据链：M4az 定位到「游戏投影在 stage0 bind idx1 的字节 96..159」；M4ba/M4bb 消融证明
   「把 c4[6..9] 换成 P·V ⇒ 角色整只出图（c7=32.48%、变体 K=69.12%）」。
   但同一个 (stage0, idx1) 在一帧内会被绑成多种块（骨表/相机块/帧常量块；M7d boot#1 的
   `[bi] rew` 6 次全落在 gaddr=0x6eb8b8d500 的 4800 B 帧常量块上，而 `[bi] tbl` 同一笔的
   c4 指向另一个 4800 B 骨表块），而 r_ubo_offset 只认「本 submit 最后一次绑定」⇒ 大 VS 的
   c4 可能读到骨表（M7c 实测 f24..39 = 旋转矩阵，不是投影）。
   本处只在两个条件同时成立时把 c4 指到「本 submit 最近一次位置矩阵块」：
     ① 该 submit 里确实绑过一块命中 M4bb 投影守门的 idx1 块（g_bi_frame_off）；
     ② 当前解析结果**不像**位置矩阵（row9.z 不≈-1 或 row9.w==0）。
   不碰其它 bank / 其它 stage / 其它 submit；SMO_M7D_C4=0 直接回到旧行为（0 行差异）。 */
#ifndef SMO_M7D_C4
#define SMO_M7D_C4 0   /* M7d：默认**关**。它是内容启发式，误伤风险真实（0c70cd5ce92e25e2 这类
                          正在出图的 VS 也声明 c4=512 且读非投影块）；本轮真正的修复是
                          SMO_M7D_STICKY。本开关留作下一 boot 的 A/B 杠杆。 */
#endif
/* 当前 c4 块是不是「位置矩阵样」：row9 = (0,0,-1,near) —— 与 M4bb 的守门同口径（只读 arena）。 */
static int m7d_c4_proj_like(uint32_t off)
{
    if (!off || !g_r_ubo_map) return 0;
    if ((uint64_t)off + 160ull > (uint64_t)R_UBO_ARENA) return 0;
    float f[4];
    memcpy(f, (const uint8_t *)g_r_ubo_map + off + 144u, sizeof f);   /* floats 36..39 */
    return (f[2] < -0.5f && f[2] > -1.5f && f[3] != 0.0f);
}
static int m7d_pin_active(void)
{
    if (!SMO_M7D_C4 || !g_bi_frame_off) return 0;
    if (!g_r_ubo_sz[0][1]) return 0;
    if ((uint64_t)g_bi_frame_off + 160ull > (uint64_t)R_UBO_ARENA) return 0;
    return !m7d_c4_proj_like(g_r_ubo_off[0][1]);
}
static uint32_t r_ubo_offset(int stage, int bank)
{
    if (stage < 0 || stage >= 8 || bank < 0 || bank >= 32) return 0;
    if (stage == 0 && bank == 4 && m7d_pin_active()) {
        g_bi_pin_hits++;
        return (uint32_t)g_bi_frame_off;
    }
    /* M4az P2（唯一行为改动）：把 ABI 位移（游戏 bind index i 落在 shader c[i+3]）提到**直接命中之前**。
       为什么必须改优先级：M4az boot#1 把目标 draw 的全部 bank 落盘后离线扫穿发现，
       VS 要的投影矩阵就在 **stage0 bind idx 1 的字节 96..159**：
         row6=(6.4294,0,0,0) row7=(0,11.4301,0,0) row8=(0,0,-1.00803,-793.133) row9=(0,0,-1,10)
       （x/y 缩放比 6.4294/11.4301 = 0.5625 = 9/16 = 1/aspect，w 行 (0,0,-1,10)），
       而 shader 的 cb4 = bind idx 1（4+3→见下）；cb6 的骨表 = bind idx 3（24 条 3×4，1152 B）。
       旧实现只在「bank 自身没绑过」时才回退到 b-3，于是被**恰好也被绑过的**直接 bank 4（对象矩阵 256 B）
       与 bank 6（512 B 常量模板）遮蔽 ⇒ shader 的 cb4[6..9] 永远拿到零区。
       M4bd P1（本轮）：把 stage 1（FS）也纳入同一位移。理由不再是类比，而是**同一笔 draw 的实测**：
         FS 的 cb4 反汇编最大访问 cb4[298][0] = 字节 4768（需 4784 B），本帧 stage1 只有 bind idx 1 有
         4800 B（同号槽 4 只有 256 B）；cb5 需 428 B，只有 bind idx 2（656 B）够（同号槽 5 = 320 B）。
         两处独立命中 ⇒ FS 与 VS 用同一套 c[3+reg]。
       唯一的例外是 bank 1：它不是游戏 UBO，而是 shader 自带的 c1 常量段（见 nvn_vk_shader_c1 注释），
       由 r_ubo_off_key() 在调用侧单独接管。 */
    if (stage == 0 || stage == 1) {
        int s3 = bank - 3;
        if (s3 >= 0 && g_r_ubo_sz[stage][s3]) {
            if (g_ubo_bank_map < 8) {
                g_ubo_bank_map++;
                vk_boot_logf("[u] cbuf map st=%d bank=%d <- bind idx=%d off=%u sz=%u (M4az/M4bd 位移优先)",
                             stage, bank, s3, g_r_ubo_off[stage][s3], g_r_ubo_sz[stage][s3]);
            }
            return g_r_ubo_off[stage][s3];
        }
    }
    if (g_r_ubo_sz[stage][bank]) return g_r_ubo_off[stage][bank];
    int src = bank - 3;
    if (src >= 0 && g_r_ubo_sz[stage][src]) {
        if (g_ubo_bank_map < 8) {
            g_ubo_bank_map++;
            vk_boot_logf("[u] cbuf map bank=%d <- bind idx=%d off=%u sz=%u", bank, src,
                         g_r_ubo_off[stage][src], g_r_ubo_sz[stage][src]);
        }
        return g_r_ubo_off[stage][src];
    }
    g_ubo_bank_miss++;
    if (g_ubo_bank_miss <= 4)
        vk_boot_logf("[u] cbuf miss bank=%d stage=%d (bind idx b 与 b-3 都空)", bank, stage);
    return 0;
}

/* M5x：bank 最终解析到哪个 bind index（-1 = 无）。分支顺序必须与 r_ubo_offset 完全一致 ——
   draw 时刻的客体重读要用**那个 index** 记下的 addr/size，用错 index 就是读另一个 buffer。 */
static int r_ubo_bind_idx(int stage, int bank)
{
    if (stage < 0 || stage >= 8 || bank < 0 || bank >= 32) return -1;
    /* M7d P3：与 r_ubo_offset 的 c4 锚定保持一致（锚点块就是 stage0 idx1 绑进来的那块）。 */
    if (stage == 0 && bank == 4 && m7d_pin_active()) return 1;
    if (stage == 0 || stage == 1) {
        int s3 = bank - 3;
        if (s3 >= 0 && g_r_ubo_sz[stage][s3]) return s3;
    }
    if (g_r_ubo_sz[stage][bank]) return bank;
    { int src = bank - 3;
      if (src >= 0 && g_r_ubo_sz[stage][src]) return src; }
    return -1;
}

/* M4bd P1：把一个 (stage, bank) bind 槽的「游戏声明 sz + arena 前 4 个 float」拼成文本，
   供 fs15 探针的 id/sh 两列对照（纯只读，不改任何映射）。未绑定写 miss。 */
static int r_c1_col(char *o, size_t cap, int stage, int bank)
{
    if (!o || !cap) return 0;
    if (stage < 0 || stage >= 8 || bank < 0 || bank >= 32) return snprintf(o, cap, "bad");
    uint32_t off = g_r_ubo_off[stage][bank], sz = g_r_ubo_sz[stage][bank];
    if (!off) return snprintf(o, cap, "miss");
    float f[4];
    memset(f, 0, sizeof f);
    if (g_r_ubo_map && (uint64_t)off + (uint64_t)sizeof f <= (uint64_t)R_UBO_ARENA)
        memcpy(f, (const uint8_t *)g_r_ubo_map + off, sizeof f);
    return snprintf(o, cap, "(sz=%u f=%g,%g,%g,%g)", sz,
                    (double)f[0], (double)f[1], (double)f[2], (double)f[3]);
}

/* ================= M4n P2②/P3：全屏 draw 取证 + 采样载荷签名 =================
   要回答的问题：「回读 249 是采样到了什么 × 什么因子」。日志里已有的只有元信息（id/ext/fmt/kind），
   载荷必须自己读。做法与代价：
   ①16 条横带（y = k*h/16，k=0..15）各一次 vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer（整宽 1 行），总拷贝 ≈ w*h/16*4
     （1600×900 = 360KB），不拷整图 5.7MB；
   ②CPU 侧从每条横带等距取 16 个纹素 ⇒ 256 点，算 RGBA 的 mean/min/max + FNV-1a 哈希；
     判「全白/全黑/有内容」足够，且两帧之间同哈希=同内容；
   ③只读：SRO → TRANSFER_SRC → 回 SRO，不改布局记账，也不碰任何渲染状态；
   ④代价 = 一次 submit + 等栅栏，故全 boot 最多 R_SIG_MAX 次、且两次之间至少隔 R_SIG_MIN_US
     （只在时间上稀疏采样，不做「头 8 笔一次性用光额度」——32s 用完额度就看不到 63s 那帧了）。
   支持范围：32bpp 紧排（R8G8B8A8 系 = 我们的 RT/影子图/常规 RGBA8 纹理）。压缩/其它格式只打元信息
   并显式写 sig=na(bpp=…/lay=…)，不猜。 */
#define R_SIG_MAX 12
#define R_SIG_MIN_US 5000000ull   /* 签名冷却 5 s：12 次 ≈ 覆盖到 t≈60 s */
static unsigned long long g_sig_n, g_sig_skip, g_r_fs_lines, g_sig_last_us;
/* M4aa P3：观察 id 的**强制签名**——不为 5 s 冷却和 12 次总预算让路（最多 3 次、两次 ≥20 s）。
   要直接回答「id=1131（128×128 R11G11B10F）的 VkImage 里是不是全 0」，而不是靠 5 s 冷却的运气。 */
#define R_SIG_WATCH_ID 1131
static unsigned g_sig_watch_n;
static unsigned long long g_sig_watch_last;

/* 槽 → (VkImage, layout, w, h, 每像素字节, 来源)。来源：shadow=当前 RT 的影子副本（被采样的是它不是 RT 本身）、
   rt=别的 RT 直采、tex=常规纹理、none=1x1 占位、raw=挂了 view 但解析不到图。 */
static int r_fs_slot_image(int slot, VkImage *img, VkImageLayout *lay, unsigned *w, unsigned *h,
                           unsigned *bpp, const char **what)
{
    VkImageView v = g_r_tx_view[slot];
    *what = "none"; *bpp = 0;
    if (!v) return 0;   /* 空槽 = 1x1 白占位（r_ds_tex_sync 的口径） */
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)(sizeof g_rt_tab / sizeof *g_rt_tab); i++) {
        h_rt_slot *s = &g_rt_tab[i];
        if (!s->key) continue;
        if (v == s->s_view && s->s_img) {
            *img = s->s_img; *lay = s->s_layout; *w = s->w; *h = s->h; *bpp = 4; *what = "shadow"; return 1;
        }
        /* 当前 RT 本身不作读源：它正被这个 pass 写（Vulkan 反馈环，UB）——那种情况描述符挂的是影子图。 */
        if (v == s->view && s->img && s != g_rt_cur) {
            *img = s->img; *lay = s->layout; *w = s->w; *h = s->h; *bpp = 4; *what = "rt"; return 1;
        }
    }
    nvn_vk_tex *t = g_r_tx_texobj[slot];
    if (t && t->img) {
        *img = t->img; *lay = t->layout; *w = t->w; *h = t->h;
        *bpp = vkfmt_bpp_guess(t->fmt); *what = "tex"; return 1;
    }
    *what = "raw";
    return 0;
}

/* M4t P4：top 颜色直方图（8 桶，只有 256 个取样点，线性插入足够）。
   用途：验收要求「gameRT 出现非均匀内容时给 top6 颜色与占比」，mean/min/max 说不了这个。 */
#define R_SIG_TOP 8
typedef struct { unsigned long long sum[4], mn[4], mx[4], hash, npx;
                 unsigned long long nz;   /* M4ak P1：采样点里 RGB 任一非零的个数（present 选源对照用） */
                 uint32_t tk[R_SIG_TOP]; unsigned tn[R_SIG_TOP]; int nt; } r_sig_t;

static void r_sig_top_add(r_sig_t *o, uint32_t key)
{
    for (int i = 0; i < o->nt; i++) if (o->tk[i] == key) { o->tn[i]++; return; }
    if (o->nt < R_SIG_TOP) { o->tk[o->nt] = key; o->tn[o->nt] = 1; o->nt++; return; }
    int mi = 0;                                    /* 满桶：替换最小的一桶（只作近似，占比照实算） */
    for (int i = 1; i < R_SIG_TOP; i++) if (o->tn[i] < o->tn[mi]) mi = i;
    if (o->tn[mi] == 0) { o->tk[mi] = key; o->tn[mi] = 1; }
}

/* 16×16 网格签名（见本节头注释）。成功返回 1 并填 *o；任何前置条件不满足返回 0。 */
static int r_tex_signature(VkImage img, VkImageLayout lay, unsigned w, unsigned h, unsigned bpp, r_sig_t *o)
{
    if (!img || !g_on || !g_dev || !g_q || !o || w == 0 || h == 0) return 0;
    if (bpp != 4) return 0;                                   /* 只支持 32bpp 紧排 */
    /* M4n P4③：读源允许两种态——采样态 SRO（纹理槽签名）与附件态 CAO（当前 RT 的内容时间线）。
       其它布局（UNDEFINED/TRANSFER_*）含义不唯一，一律不猜、直接跳过。
       配额/冷却由调用方管（纹理槽与 RT 各有各的预算，不能互相饿死）。 */
    VkAccessFlags src_acc; VkPipelineStageFlags src_stage;
    if (lay == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL) {
        src_acc = VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT; src_stage = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT;
    } else if (lay == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL) {
        src_acc = VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT | VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT;
        src_stage = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT;
    } else if (lay == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL) {
        /* M4y P1b：内容快照常驻此态（present 的 gsig 要对它取样）。 */
        src_acc = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT;
        src_stage = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT;
    } else return 0;
    const unsigned rows = 16;
    const VkDeviceSize rowb = (VkDeviceSize)w * bpp;
    const VkDeviceSize sz = rowb * rows;
    VkBuffer buf = VK_NULL_HANDLE; VkDeviceMemory mem = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkBufferCreateInfo bi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO };
    bi.size = sz; bi.usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT; bi.sharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE;
    if (vkCreateBuffer(g_dev, &bi, NULL, &buf) != VK_SUCCESS) return 0;
    VkMemoryRequirements rq; vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(g_dev, buf, &rq);
    int ti = find_type(rq, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT);
    VkMemoryAllocateInfo ai = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO };
    ai.allocationSize = rq.size; ai.memoryTypeIndex = ti >= 0 ? (uint32_t)ti : 0;
    if (vkAllocateMemory(g_dev, &ai, NULL, &mem) != VK_SUCCESS) { vkDestroyBuffer(g_dev, buf, NULL); return 0; }
    vkBindBufferMemory(g_dev, buf, mem, 0);
    VkCommandBuffer cb = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo ca = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO };
    ca.commandPool = g_h_cp; ca.level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY; ca.commandBufferCount = 1;
    int ok = 0;
    if (vkAllocateCommandBuffers(g_dev, &ca, &cb) == VK_SUCCESS) {
        VkCommandBufferBeginInfo cbi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO };
        cbi.flags = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT;
        vkBeginCommandBuffer(cb, &cbi);
        VkImageSubresourceRange rng = { VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1 };
        VkImageMemoryBarrier b = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER };
        b.srcAccessMask = src_acc; b.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT;
        b.oldLayout = lay; b.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL;
        b.srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED; b.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
        b.image = img; b.subresourceRange = rng;
        vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, src_stage, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT,
                             0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &b);
        for (unsigned k = 0; k < rows; k++) {
            VkBufferImageCopy reg = {0};
            reg.bufferOffset = rowb * k;
            reg.imageSubresource = (VkImageSubresourceLayers){ VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1 };
            reg.imageOffset = (VkOffset3D){ 0, (int32_t)((uint64_t)h * k / rows), 0 };
            reg.imageExtent = (VkExtent3D){ w, 1, 1 };
            vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer(cb, img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, buf, 1, &reg);
        }
        VkImageMemoryBarrier b2 = b;
        b2.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT; b2.dstAccessMask = src_acc;
        b2.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL; b2.newLayout = lay;
        vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, src_stage,
                             0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &b2);
        vkEndCommandBuffer(cb);
        VkSubmitInfo si = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO };
        si.commandBufferCount = 1; si.pCommandBuffers = &cb;
        vkResetFences(g_dev, 1, &g_h_fence);
        VkResult sr = vkQueueSubmit(g_q, 1, &si, g_h_fence);
        if (sr == VK_SUCCESS && nvk_wait_fences(g_dev, 1, &g_h_fence, VK_TRUE, 5000000000ull) == VK_SUCCESS) ok = 1;
        else vk_boot_logf("[fs-red] sig submit=%d (%s)", (int)sr, vr(sr));
        vkFreeCommandBuffers(g_dev, g_h_cp, 1, &cb);
        if (ok) {
            void *map = NULL;
            if (vkMapMemory(g_dev, mem, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE, 0, &map) == VK_SUCCESS && map) {
                memset(o, 0, sizeof *o);
                for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) { o->mn[c] = 255ull; }
                o->hash = 1469598103934665603ull;   /* FNV-1a 64 偏移基数 */
                for (unsigned k = 0; k < rows; k++) {
                    const uint8_t *row = (const uint8_t *)map + rowb * k;
                    for (unsigned j = 0; j < 16; j++) {
                        unsigned x = (unsigned)((uint64_t)w * (2 * j + 1) / 32);   /* 等距 16 列（每带中点） */
                        if (x >= w) x = w - 1;
                        const uint8_t *px = row + (size_t)x * bpp;
                        for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
                            unsigned v = px[c];
                            o->sum[c] += v;
                            if (v < o->mn[c]) o->mn[c] = v;
                            if (v > o->mx[c]) o->mx[c] = v;
                            o->hash = (o->hash ^ v) * 1099511628211ull;
                        }
                        r_sig_top_add(o, (uint32_t)px[0] | ((uint32_t)px[1] << 8) |
                                         ((uint32_t)px[2] << 16) | ((uint32_t)px[3] << 24));
                        if (px[0] | px[1] | px[2]) o->nz++;
                        o->npx++;
                    }
                }
                vkUnmapMemory(g_dev, mem);
            } else ok = 0;
        }
    }
    vkDestroyBuffer(g_dev, buf, NULL); vkFreeMemory(g_dev, mem, NULL);
    return ok;
}

/* 全屏级 draw 的粗筛：本轮「涂满整张 RT」的那类 draw 是 4 顶点 / 6 索引的 strip 或 list。
   严格覆盖率在重放侧算不出（顶点变换在 GPU 上），所以这里用 idx/verts/topo 粗筛（派活单允许），
   同时把实际下发的 vp/sc/renderArea 打出来——即使筛错，读者也能看出它当时画在哪。
   什么时候落：
   ·首 8 笔全屏 draw；
   ·**槽来源指纹变化时**（id/来源图/kind 变了）——「采样源在第几笔开始变成我们的 RT/影子」靠这个抓；
   ·否则每 1000 笔 draw 一次；
   ·单 boot 上限 60 条 [fs] 主行（每槽的签名行另算，但签名本身有 5s 冷却 + 12 次上限）。 */
static unsigned long long g_fs_slotkey;   /* 上一份槽来源指纹（判「采样源变了」） */
static int r_fs_forensics(unsigned long long n, const R_Key *kv, const R_Key *kf, int topo,
                          int count, int nverts, int instances, int nattr, int attr_ph)
{
    int shape = (topo == VK_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLE_STRIP ||
                 topo == VK_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLE_FAN ||
                 topo == VK_PRIMITIVE_TOPOLOGY_TRIANGLE_LIST);
    if (!shape || count > 8 || nverts > 8) return 0;
    int ntex = kf->ntex < NVN_TX_SLOTS ? kf->ntex : NVN_TX_SLOTS;
    /* 第一遍：槽来源指纹（不碰 GPU，只做解析）。 */
    unsigned long long key = 1469598103934665603ull;
    for (int i = 0; i < ntex; i++) {
        VkImage im; VkImageLayout ly; unsigned w0, h0, b0; const char *wh = "none";
        int have = r_fs_slot_image(i, &im, &ly, &w0, &h0, &b0, &wh);
        unsigned code = !have ? 0u : (wh[0] == 's' ? 1u : wh[0] == 'r' ? 2u : wh[0] == 't' ? 3u : 4u);
        key = (key ^ (unsigned long long)g_r_tx_info[i].id) * 1099511628211ull;
        key = (key ^ (unsigned long long)code) * 1099511628211ull;
        key = (key ^ (unsigned long long)g_r_tx_info[i].kind) * 1099511628211ull;
    }
    int src_changed = (key != g_fs_slotkey);
    if (src_changed) g_fs_slotkey = key;
    if (!src_changed && !(n <= 8 || n % 1000 == 0)) return 0;
    if (g_r_fs_lines >= 60) return 0;
    g_r_fs_lines++;
    vk_boot_logf("[fs] draw #%llu quad=1 prog=%#llx vs=%s fs=%s topo=%d idx=%d verts=%u attrs=%d ph=%d inst=%d "
                 "vp=%.0f,%.0f,%.0fx%.0f sc=%d,%d,%dx%d ra=%d,%d,%dx%d rt=%ux%u ntex=%d skip=%llu src_chg=%d",
                 n, (unsigned long long)g_r_cur_prog, kv->key, kf->key, topo, count, (unsigned)nverts, nattr, attr_ph,
                 instances, (double)g_r_fs_vp[0], (double)g_r_fs_vp[1], (double)g_r_fs_vp[2], (double)g_r_fs_vp[3],
                 g_r_fs_sc[0], g_r_fs_sc[1], g_r_fs_sc[2], g_r_fs_sc[3],
                 g_r_fs_ra[0], g_r_fs_ra[1], g_r_fs_ra[2], g_r_fs_ra[3],
                 (unsigned)g_rt_w, (unsigned)g_rt_h, kf->ntex, g_r_skip, src_changed);
    for (int i = 0; i < ntex; i++) {
        VkImage img = VK_NULL_HANDLE; VkImageLayout lay = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
        unsigned w = 0, h = 0, bpp = 0; const char *what = "none";
        int have = r_fs_slot_image(i, &img, &lay, &w, &h, &bpp, &what);
        int kind = g_r_tx_info[i].kind;
        const char *kname = kind == NVN_VK_SLOT_RT_SELF ? "rt-self" : kind == NVN_VK_SLOT_RT_OTHER ? "rt-other"
                          : kind == NVN_VK_SLOT_TEX ? "tex" : kind == NVN_VK_SLOT_PLACEHOLDER ? "placeholder"
                          : kind == NVN_VK_SLOT_DEPTH_NR ? "depth-nr" : "none";
        if (!have) {
            /* 空槽 = 1x1 白占位：这就是「采样到 255」最容易的来源，必须显式写出来。
               M4p P2：深度纹理且上传失败时 kind=depth-nr，sig 也照实标出（不是「无纹理」）。 */
            vk_boot_logf("[fs] slot=%d id=%d ext=%ux%u fmt=%#x kind=%s up=%d src=%s %s",
                         i, g_r_tx_info[i].id, g_r_tx_info[i].w, g_r_tx_info[i].h,
                         (unsigned)g_r_tx_info[i].fmt, kname, g_r_tx_info[i].up, what,
                         kind == NVN_VK_SLOT_DEPTH_NR ? "sig=depth-not-ready(1x1 white)"
                                                      : "sig=placeholder(1x1 white)");
            continue;
        }
        r_sig_t sg;
        /* 纹理槽自己的预算：≤R_SIG_MAX 次、两次 ≥5s（与 RT 内容时间线的预算分开）。 */
        struct timespec tsig; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &tsig);
        unsigned long long now_us = (unsigned long long)tsig.tv_sec * 1000000ull + (unsigned long long)tsig.tv_nsec / 1000ull;
        int sok = 0;
        int force = (g_r_tx_info[i].id == R_SIG_WATCH_ID) && bpp == 4 && g_sig_watch_n < 3 &&
                    (!g_sig_watch_last || now_us - g_sig_watch_last >= 20000000ull);
        if (force) {
            if ((sok = r_tex_signature(img, lay, w, h, bpp, &sg)) != 0) { g_sig_watch_n++; g_sig_watch_last = now_us; }
            else g_sig_skip++;
        } else if (g_sig_n >= R_SIG_MAX || (g_sig_last_us && now_us - g_sig_last_us < R_SIG_MIN_US)) g_sig_skip++;
        else if ((sok = r_tex_signature(img, lay, w, h, bpp, &sg)) != 0) { g_sig_n++; g_sig_last_us = now_us; }
        if (sok)
            vk_boot_logf("[fs] slot=%d id=%d ext=%ux%u fmt=%#x kind=%s up=%d src=%s img=%#llx sig=ok npx=%llu "
                         "mean=%llu/%llu/%llu/%llu min=%llu/%llu/%llu/%llu max=%llu/%llu/%llu/%llu hash=%#llx",
                         i, g_r_tx_info[i].id, w, h, (unsigned)g_r_tx_info[i].fmt, kname, g_r_tx_info[i].up, what,
                         (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)img, sg.npx,
                         sg.sum[0] / (sg.npx ? sg.npx : 1), sg.sum[1] / (sg.npx ? sg.npx : 1),
                         sg.sum[2] / (sg.npx ? sg.npx : 1), sg.sum[3] / (sg.npx ? sg.npx : 1),
                         sg.mn[0], sg.mn[1], sg.mn[2], sg.mn[3], sg.mx[0], sg.mx[1], sg.mx[2], sg.mx[3],
                         (unsigned long long)sg.hash);
        else
            vk_boot_logf("[fs] slot=%d id=%d ext=%ux%u fmt=%#x kind=%s up=%d src=%s img=%#llx dim=%s bpp=%u lay=%d "
                         "sig=na(cap=%llu skip=%llu)",
                         i, g_r_tx_info[i].id, w, h, (unsigned)g_r_tx_info[i].fmt, kname, g_r_tx_info[i].up, what,
                         (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)img, r_dim_name(kf->slot_dim[i]),
                         bpp, (int)lay, g_sig_n, g_sig_skip);
    }
    return 1;
}

/* M4bj P1：被 [k] mag 点名的那张图上，下一笔 draw 的**采样源清单**——
   判「洋红是不是采到了 1x1 白占位 / 错格式的图」。只读元数据，不碰 GPU，每 boot <=4 行。 */
static void k_magsrc_print(const R_Key *kv, const R_Key *kf, int count, int nverts)
{
    if (!kf || g_k_magsrc_lines >= 4) return;
    int ntex = kf->ntex < NVN_TX_SLOTS ? kf->ntex : NVN_TX_SLOTS;
    char sl[512]; int o = 0; sl[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ntex && o < (int)sizeof sl - 110; i++) {
        VkImage im = VK_NULL_HANDLE; VkImageLayout ly = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
        unsigned w0 = 0, h0 = 0, b0 = 0; const char *wh = "none";
        int have = r_fs_slot_image(i, &im, &ly, &w0, &h0, &b0, &wh);
        int kind = g_r_tx_info[i].kind;
        const char *kn = kind == NVN_VK_SLOT_RT_SELF ? "rt-self" : kind == NVN_VK_SLOT_RT_OTHER ? "rt-other"
                      : kind == NVN_VK_SLOT_TEX ? "tex" : kind == NVN_VK_SLOT_PLACEHOLDER ? "placeholder"
                      : kind == NVN_VK_SLOT_DEPTH_NR ? "depth-nr" : "none";
        o += snprintf(sl + o, sizeof sl - (size_t)o, "%s%d{id=%d %ux%u f%#x kind=%s up=%d src=%s%s cp=%d}",
                      i ? " " : "", i, g_r_tx_info[i].id,
                      have ? w0 : g_r_tx_info[i].w, have ? h0 : g_r_tx_info[i].h,
                      (unsigned)g_r_tx_info[i].fmt, kn, g_r_tx_info[i].up, wh,
                      have ? "" : "(1x1-white)",
                      (g_r_tx_texobj[i] ? g_r_tx_texobj[i]->dcp_ok : -1));
    }
    g_k_magsrc_lines++;
    vk_boot_logf("[k] magsrc draw=%llu vs=%s fs=%s count=%d verts=%d ntex=%d :: %s",
                 g_r_draws, kv ? kv->key : "?", kf->key, count, nverts, ntex, sl);
    if (g_k_magsrc_lines >= 2) g_k_watch = VK_NULL_HANDLE;   /* 两笔足够，别刷屏 */
}

/* ================= M4bl P1：**采样深度纹理的 draw** 点名（只读，0 行为改动）=================
   要回答：100% 洋红那笔满屏 quad 采到的深度，究竟是不是「我们画过的那张深度附件」。
   判据全部落在元数据上（不碰 GPU）：
     · `dm=i`   —— 该槽的池存储 == 深度附件槽 #i 的 key（**同一块存储**）；
     · `dsame=1`—— 该槽采样用的 VkImage 就是深度附件槽 #i 的图（同一张图，内容必然一致）；
     · `dm=-1` —— 采样槽与任何深度附件槽都不是同一存储 ⇒ 它采的是「另一路」（从池字节上传的独立图）。
   另外带上 `cbuf_mask` 与 `cb9[0..3]`（FS 常量 bank 9 首 4 float），判「洋红是不是常量/分支导致」。
   限流：每 boot ≤4 行。 */
static void k_postdepth_print(const R_Key *kv, const R_Key *kf, int count, int nverts)
{
    static unsigned lines;
    if (!kf || lines >= 4) return;
    int ntex = kf->ntex < NVN_TX_SLOTS ? kf->ntex : NVN_TX_SLOTS;
    int ndepth = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ntex; i++)
        if (g_r_tx_info[i].fmt >= 0x31 && g_r_tx_info[i].fmt <= 0x36) ndepth++;
    if (!ndepth) return;                       /* 只打「采样了深度格式」的 draw */
    char sl[640]; int o = 0; sl[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ntex && o < (int)sizeof sl - 140; i++) {
        VkImage im = VK_NULL_HANDLE; VkImageLayout ly = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
        unsigned w0 = 0, h0 = 0, b0 = 0; const char *wh = "none";
        int have = r_fs_slot_image(i, &im, &ly, &w0, &h0, &b0, &wh);
        int dm = -1;
        for (int d = 0; d < H_D_SLOTS; d++)
            if (g_d_tab[d].key && g_d_tab[d].key == g_r_tx_info[i].store) { dm = d; break; }
        int dsame = (dm >= 0 && have && g_d_tab[dm].img == im) ? 1 : 0;
        o += snprintf(sl + o, sizeof sl - (size_t)o, "%s%d{id=%d %ux%u f%#x up=%d src=%s store=%#llx dm=%d dsame=%d}",
                      i ? " " : "", i, g_r_tx_info[i].id,
                      have ? w0 : g_r_tx_info[i].w, have ? h0 : g_r_tx_info[i].h,
                      (unsigned)g_r_tx_info[i].fmt, g_r_tx_info[i].up, wh,
                      g_r_tx_info[i].store, dm, dsame);
    }
    float cb9[4] = { 0, 0, 0, 0 };
    { uint32_t off = r_ubo_off_key(1, 9, kf->key);
      if (off && g_r_ubo_map && (uint64_t)off + 16u <= R_UBO_ARENA)
          memcpy(cb9, (const uint8_t *)g_r_ubo_map + off, 16); }
    lines++;
    vk_boot_logf("[d] post draw draw=%llu ntex=%d ndepth=%d vs=%s fs=%s count=%d verts=%d cbuf_mask=%#x "
                 "cb9=%g,%g,%g,%g :: %s",
                 g_r_draws, ntex, ndepth, kv ? kv->key : "?", kf->key, count, nverts, kf->cbuf_mask,
                 (double)cb9[0], (double)cb9[1], (double)cb9[2], (double)cb9[3], sl);
}

/* ================= M4bk P1：**空槽哨兵**取证（只读，0 行为改动）=================
   要回答的一件事：一个「游戏要采样、但我们没给数据」的槽，最终被采样成什么颜色，以及**为什么**没数据。
   判据落在描述符实际拿到的东西上：`g_r_tx_view[slot] == NULL` ⇒ r_ds_tex_sync 落回 g_r_tex_view
   = 1x1 白（nvn_vk.c 的 `r_common_ensure` 里 `cv.float32[0..3]=1.0f` 那一次 clear）。
   所以 fill 恒为 1.0,1.0,1.0,1.0 —— 这里把它连同归因码一起打出来，供 P2 判断「打通上送」还是「换安全值」。
   限流：每 boot ≤4 行 + 每 20000 笔一行汇总；总量 <2 KB。 */
static unsigned g_m_sent_lines, g_m_sent_draws, g_m_sent_slots;
static int g_m_sent_ids[8]; static unsigned g_m_sent_nid;   /* M4bk P2：已打印过的 texid（去重） */
static const char *m4ar_slot_kind(int kind);   /* 定义在下方（m4ar P1），这里先用 */
static const char *m_sent_why(int c)
{
    switch (c) {
    case 1:  return "up_ok";
    case -2: return "msaa";
    case -3: return "size0_or_gt32MB";
    case -4: return "budget";
    case -5: return "depth_stencil";
    case -6: return "soft_bc";
    case -7: return "layout";
    case -8: return "geom";
    case -9: return "malloc";
    case -10: return "oob";
    case -12: return "heat_gate";
    case -20: return "snap_missing";
    case -30: return "create_heat";
    case -31: return "create_cap";
    case -32: return "create_fail";
    case -33: return "render_down";
    case -34: return "desc_mismatch";
    default: return "unknown";
    }
}

static void k_sentinel_print(const R_Key *kv, const R_Key *kf, int count, unsigned nverts)
{
    if (!kf) return;
    int ntex = kf->ntex < NVN_TX_SLOTS ? kf->ntex : NVN_TX_SLOTS;
    int hit = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ntex; i++) {
        /* M27A：binding 32+i 实际采样 unit u（关态 u==i ⇒ 本函数逐字不变）。空不空要看 u。 */
        int u = r_unit_of(kf, i);
        if (g_r_tx_view[u]) continue;        /* 有真图：与哨兵无关 */
        hit++;
        g_m_sent_slots++;
        /* M4bk P2：从「前 4 条」改成「前 8 个**不同** texid 各一条」——否则前几位热 id 会把
           id=3229（洋红那笔的空槽）挤掉，P2 就没法确认它到底为什么没数据。 */
        int id = g_r_tx_info[u].id;
        int seen = 0;
        for (unsigned k = 0; k < g_m_sent_nid; k++) if (g_m_sent_ids[k] == id) { seen = 1; break; }
        if (seen || g_m_sent_nid >= 8) continue;
        g_m_sent_ids[g_m_sent_nid++] = id;
        g_m_sent_lines++;
        int c = (int)g_r_tx_diag[u].why;
        /* M34A：把「族 id ↔ 池存储 ↔ RT 槽」三件套打进同一行（关态 ext 为空串 ⇒ 该行逐字不变）。
           store 是 join 键（`[h] rt slot #N key=<pool store>` 用的是同一地址）；
           rt_slot 先走 id 别名表，id 未知再按 store+尺寸+格式反查（M4w P1 那条现成的路）。 */
        char m34e[96]; m34e[0] = 0;
        if (m34a_nv_on()) {
            unsigned long long st = g_r_tx_info[u].store;
            int m_slot = -1, m_txid = -1;
