    } else {
        ii.imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D;
        ii.format = VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;       /* 与 c_img_rb 回读格式逐字节对应 */
        ii.extent = (VkExtent3D){ e->w, e->h, 1 };
        ii.mipLevels = 1; ii.arrayLayers = 1; ii.samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
        ii.tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL;
        ii.usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT;
        ii.initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
        if (vkCreateImage(g_dev, &ii, NULL, &g_m7h_snap_img) != VK_SUCCESS) { g_m7h_snap_img = NULL; return; }
        vkGetImageMemoryRequirements(g_dev, g_m7h_snap_img, &rq);
        ti = find_type(rq, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT);
        ai.allocationSize = rq.size; ai.memoryTypeIndex = ti >= 0 ? (uint32_t)ti : 0;
        if (vkAllocateMemory(g_dev, &ai, NULL, &g_m7h_snap_mem) != VK_SUCCESS) {
            vkDestroyImage(g_dev, g_m7h_snap_img, NULL); g_m7h_snap_img = NULL; return;
        }
        vkBindImageMemory(g_dev, g_m7h_snap_img, g_m7h_snap_mem, 0);
        g_m7h_snap_w = e->w; g_m7h_snap_h = e->h;
        sz = (VkDeviceSize)g_m7h_snap_w * g_m7h_snap_h * 4;
        bi0.size = sz; bi0.usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT; bi0.sharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE;
        if (vkCreateBuffer(g_dev, &bi0, NULL, &g_m7h_snap_sb) != VK_SUCCESS) { g_m7h_snap_sb = NULL; return; }
        vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(g_dev, g_m7h_snap_sb, &rq0);
        ti0 = find_type(rq0, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT);
        ai0.allocationSize = rq0.size; ai0.memoryTypeIndex = ti0 >= 0 ? (uint32_t)ti0 : 0;
        if (vkAllocateMemory(g_dev, &ai0, NULL, &g_m7h_snap_sm) != VK_SUCCESS) {
            vkDestroyBuffer(g_dev, g_m7h_snap_sb, NULL); g_m7h_snap_sb = NULL; return;
        }
        vkBindBufferMemory(g_dev, g_m7h_snap_sb, g_m7h_snap_sm, 0);
        if (vkMapMemory(g_dev, g_m7h_snap_sm, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE, 0, &g_m7h_snap_map) != VK_SUCCESS || !g_m7h_snap_map) {
            vkDestroyBuffer(g_dev, g_m7h_snap_sb, NULL); vkFreeMemory(g_dev, g_m7h_snap_sm, NULL);
            g_m7h_snap_sb = NULL; g_m7h_snap_sm = NULL; g_m7h_snap_map = NULL; return;
        }
    }
    memcpy(g_m7h_snap_map, rgba, (size_t)sz);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_vkq_lock);
    ca.commandPool = g_h_cp; ca.level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY; ca.commandBufferCount = 1;
    cbi.flags = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT;
    if (vkAllocateCommandBuffers(g_dev, &ca, &cb) == VK_SUCCESS) {
        vkBeginCommandBuffer(cb, &cbi);
        b.srcAccessMask = 0; b.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
        b.oldLayout = g_m7h_snap_ready ? VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL   /* M7j 刷新：图已在 SRC */
                                       : VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
        b.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL;
        b.srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED; b.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
        b.image = g_m7h_snap_img; b.subresourceRange = rng;
        vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TOP_OF_PIPE_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT,
                             0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &b);
        memset(&reg, 0, sizeof reg);
        reg.imageSubresource = (VkImageSubresourceLayers){ VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1 };
        reg.imageExtent = (VkExtent3D){ g_m7h_snap_w, g_m7h_snap_h, 1 };
        vkCmdCopyBufferToImage(cb, g_m7h_snap_sb, g_m7h_snap_img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, 1, &reg);
        b.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT; b.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT;
        b.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL; b.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL;
        vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT,
                             0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &b);
        vkEndCommandBuffer(cb);
        if (vkCreateFence(g_dev, &fci, NULL, &fc) == VK_SUCCESS) {
            si.commandBufferCount = 1; si.pCommandBuffers = &cb;
            VkResult sr = vkQueueSubmit(g_q, 1, &si, fc);
            if (sr == VK_SUCCESS && nvk_wait_fences(g_dev, 1, &fc, VK_TRUE, 5000000000ull) == VK_SUCCESS) ok = 1;
            else vk_boot_logf("[p-red] m7i snap submit=%d (%s)", (int)sr, vr(sr));
            vkDestroyFence(g_dev, fc, NULL);
        }
        vkFreeCommandBuffers(g_dev, g_h_cp, 1, &cb);
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_vkq_lock);
    if (!ok) return;   /* 拷贝没落地：图里仍是上一帧，present 继续用（如实） */
    if (!g_m7h_snap_ready) {
        g_m7h_snap_ready = 1;
        vk_boot_logf("[m7h] snap up img=%#llx %ux%u mean=%llu/%llu/%llu (M7j: post_rb 活内容 -> 常驻上屏图, 此后每次过门即刷新)",
                     (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_m7h_snap_img, g_m7h_snap_w, g_m7h_snap_h, mr, mg, mb);
    } else {
        g_m7j_snap_up++;
        if (g_m7j_snap_up <= 3 || (g_m7j_snap_up % 10) == 0)
            vk_boot_logf("[m7j] snap rf #%llu img=%#llx mean=%llu/%llu/%llu nz=%llu.%02llu%% (C: 每次 post_rb 成功后重传)",
                         g_m7j_snap_up, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_m7h_snap_img, mr, mg, mb,
                         wp_pct2(st->nz, st->npx * 4ull) / 100ull,
                         wp_pct2(st->nz, st->npx * 4ull) % 100ull);
    }
}

/* ---- M4bf P1（2026-11-04）：上屏源 = **游戏自己的颜色 RT** ----
   M4bb..M4be 上屏的是 phase3 单笔 draw 的 debug RT（洋红清屏 + 一个角色）。本轮把
   p3_our_upload() 的**像素来源**换成「本帧游戏自己画出来的那张颜色 RT」：在 r_rt_sig_tick
   判到「当前 RT 有画面」（cat==3 && has，与快照同一瞬）时整张回读 → 统计 → 走同一条上传路径。
   为什么不放在 present 时刻取：present 时游戏已把 RT clear 掉（m4be_b2 `[p] slots` 实证
   游戏指定上屏纹理 `nz=0.00%`），只有「内容刚画完」那一瞬是活的。
   开关 `smo_game_rt`（缺省 1=开）：推 0 ⇒ 退回旧行为（debug RT 上传，无需重编）。 */
static int p_game_rt_mode(void);
static int g_our_kind;                      /* 0 = debug bisect RT；1 = game RT */
static unsigned long long g_o_grab_n, g_o_grab_fail, g_o_last_us;
static unsigned g_o_src_lines, g_o_grab_lines;   /* 两类日志各自的打印配额 */
static unsigned long long g_o_rej_ident, g_o_rej_black, g_o_rej_lowcov, g_o_best_colored;
static unsigned g_o_rej_lines;

/* M4bp P1：世界 RT 快照的命中计数（定义/实现在 p3_grab_game_rt 之后；这里先声明，
   因为旧抓取要在「旁路已接管」时立刻停手）。 */
static unsigned long long g_w_picks;

static int p3_grab_game_rt(VkImage img, VkImageLayout lay, unsigned w, unsigned h,
                           int slot, unsigned long long key, unsigned long long draws_into)
{
    if (!img || !w || !h || !g_dev || !g_q || !g_h_cp) { g_o_grab_fail++; return 0; }
    /* M4bp P1：**旁路接管** —— 一旦世界 RT 的快照成功上屏（g_w_picks>0），旧抓取（合成 RT /
       当前 RT）就完全停手：它的产物正是洋红后处理层那条链，本轮不采信，也不许它覆盖 g_our_img。 */
    if (g_w_picks > 0) return 0;
    if (lay != VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL &&
        lay != VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL &&
        lay != VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL) { g_o_grab_fail++; return 0; }
    /* M4bf P2：**身份门** —— 只接受「这张 RT 当前这一帧最后一笔是满屏三角合成」的。
       boot#1 同一 boot 内的直接证据：
         · 好帧（上屏就是它，mean=135/65/164，人眼=游戏场景）wrote-by 全是
           vs=c1b78a36ed2d336e fs=8832429cd37c79fe count=3 verts=3（满屏三角）；
         · 坏帧 #4（mean=18/0/18 black=92.58%，另一张 RT 0x…13c8 的中途态）最后写入者是
           vs=e0cf0ef0e3fbfc6b fs=f38b4b2442062c3d count=36 verts=24（普通几何 pass）；
         「最终合成」在 NVN 里就是一次满屏三角 blit ⇒ 用「最后写入者是小三角(≤4 顶点)」把它认出来，
         不硬编码 vs/fs 哈希（换 shaderdump 仍成立）。 */
    {
        int found = 0; unsigned lc = 0, lv = 0; const char *lvs = "-", *lfs = "-";
        for (int k = 0; k < P_WROTE_RING; k++) {
            unsigned wi = (g_p_wrote_i + P_WROTE_RING - 1 - k) % P_WROTE_RING;
            if (g_p_wrote[wi].img == img) {
                found = 1; lc = g_p_wrote[wi].count; lv = g_p_wrote[wi].verts;
                lvs = g_p_wrote[wi].vs; lfs = g_p_wrote[wi].fs;
                break;
            }
        }
        /* M4bg P2：把「满屏三角」放宽到「满屏 quad」——真合成是 idx=6 verts=4（boot#1/派活单实证），
           旧的 ≤4 把真合成挡在门外，只留下 idx=3 的环境三角，于是上屏的一直是环境 RT。
           ⇒ 判据改成 `最后写入者 ≤6 索引 ∧ ≤4 顶点`（三角与 quad 都算「一次满屏 blit」）。 */
        if (!found || lc > 6 || lv > 4) {
            g_o_rej_ident++;
            if (g_o_rej_lines < 6) {
                g_o_rej_lines++;
                vk_boot_logf("[o] grab skip slot=%d key=%#llx why=not-final-composite "
                             "last_writer=%s/%s c=%u v=%u rej_ident=%llu",
                             slot, key, lvs, lfs, lc, lv, g_o_rej_ident);
            }
            return 0;
        }
    }
    {   /* 限流 ≥1 s（内容变化本身不频繁：上一 boot 快照 19 次 / 458 s） */
        struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
        unsigned long long now = (unsigned long long)ts.tv_sec * 1000000ull + (unsigned long long)ts.tv_nsec / 1000ull;
        if (g_o_last_us && now - g_o_last_us < P3_OUR_MIN_US) return 1;
        g_o_last_us = now;
    }
    const VkDeviceSize sz = (VkDeviceSize)w * h * 4;
    /* 回读 buffer：按尺寸复用（内容 tick 不频繁，但避免 5.76 MB 的分配抖动） */
    static VkBuffer gb; static VkDeviceMemory gbm; static VkDeviceSize gbsz;
    if (gb && gbsz != sz) { vkDestroyBuffer(g_dev, gb, NULL); vkFreeMemory(g_dev, gbm, NULL); gb = VK_NULL_HANDLE; gbm = VK_NULL_HANDLE; gbsz = 0; }
    if (!gb) {
        VkBufferCreateInfo bi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO };
        bi.size = sz; bi.usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT; bi.sharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE;
        if (vkCreateBuffer(g_dev, &bi, NULL, &gb) != VK_SUCCESS) { gb = VK_NULL_HANDLE; g_o_grab_fail++; return 0; }
        VkMemoryRequirements rq; vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(g_dev, gb, &rq);
        int ti = find_type(rq, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT);
        VkMemoryAllocateInfo ai = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO };
        ai.allocationSize = rq.size; ai.memoryTypeIndex = ti >= 0 ? (uint32_t)ti : 0;
        if (vkAllocateMemory(g_dev, &ai, NULL, &gbm) != VK_SUCCESS) {
            vkDestroyBuffer(g_dev, gb, NULL); gb = VK_NULL_HANDLE; g_o_grab_fail++; return 0;
        }
        vkBindBufferMemory(g_dev, gb, gbm, 0);
        gbsz = sz;
    }
    VkCommandBuffer cb = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo ca = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO };
    ca.commandPool = g_h_cp; ca.level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY; ca.commandBufferCount = 1;
    int ok = 0;
    if (vkAllocateCommandBuffers(g_dev, &ca, &cb) != VK_SUCCESS) { g_o_grab_fail++; return 0; }
    VkCommandBufferBeginInfo cbi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO };
    cbi.flags = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT;
    vkBeginCommandBuffer(cb, &cbi);
    VkImageSubresourceRange rng = { VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1 };
    VkAccessFlags back_acc = (lay == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL) ? VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT
                            : (lay == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL) ? VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT
                            : (VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT);
    VkImageMemoryBarrier b = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER };
    b.srcAccessMask = back_acc; b.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT;
    b.oldLayout = lay; b.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL;
    b.srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED; b.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
    b.image = img; b.subresourceRange = rng;
    beat_cmd();
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT,
                         0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &b);
    VkBufferImageCopy reg; memset(&reg, 0, sizeof reg);
    reg.imageSubresource = (VkImageSubresourceLayers){ VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1 };
    reg.imageExtent = (VkExtent3D){ w, h, 1 };
    beat_cmd();
    vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer(cb, img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, gb, 1, &reg);
    b = (VkImageMemoryBarrier){ VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER };
    b.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT; b.dstAccessMask = back_acc;
    b.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL; b.newLayout = lay;
    b.srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED; b.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
    b.image = img; b.subresourceRange = rng;
    beat_cmd();
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT,
                         0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &b);
    vkEndCommandBuffer(cb);
    {
        VkFence fc = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        VkFenceCreateInfo fci = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FENCE_CREATE_INFO };
        if (vkCreateFence(g_dev, &fci, NULL, &fc) == VK_SUCCESS) {
            VkSubmitInfo si = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO };
            si.commandBufferCount = 1; si.pCommandBuffers = &cb;
            VkResult sr = vkQueueSubmit(g_q, 1, &si, fc);
            if (sr == VK_SUCCESS && nvk_wait_fences(g_dev, 1, &fc, VK_TRUE, 5000000000ull) == VK_SUCCESS) ok = 1;
            else vk_boot_logf("[o-red] grab submit=%d (%s)", (int)sr, vr(sr));
            vkDestroyFence(g_dev, fc, NULL);
        }
    }
    vkFreeCommandBuffers(g_dev, g_h_cp, 1, &cb);
    if (!ok) { g_o_grab_fail++; return 0; }
    void *map = NULL;
    if (vkMapMemory(g_dev, gbm, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE, 0, &map) != VK_SUCCESS || !map) {
        g_o_grab_fail++;
        if (g_o_grab_lines < 2) { g_o_grab_lines++; vk_boot_logf("[o-red] grab map fail slot=%d", slot); }
        return 0;
    }
    const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)map;
    const unsigned long long npx = (unsigned long long)w * h;
    unsigned long long colored = 0, nonmag = 0, black = 0, sr = 0, sg = 0, sb = 0;
    unsigned mx[3] = { 0, 0, 0 };
    for (unsigned long long i = 0; i < npx; i++) {
        const uint8_t *q = p + i * 4;
        unsigned r = q[0], g = q[1], bl = q[2];
        sr += r; sg += g; sb += bl;
        if (r || g || bl) colored++;
        if (!(r == 255 && g == 0 && bl == 255)) nonmag++;
        if (!r && !g && !bl) black++;
        if (r > mx[0]) mx[0] = r;
        if (g > mx[1]) mx[1] = g;
        if (bl > mx[2]) mx[2] = bl;
    }
    /* M4bf P2：**内容门**（boot#1 实测两档）：
       ① 黑占比 > 40% ⇒ 抓到的是这张 RT 的中途态（grab #4: black=92.58%），不上屏；
       ② colored < 0.8 × 本 boot 最好 ⇒ 比已经在屏上的那张差，不覆盖（同 M4be 的选帧门口径）。 */
    if (black * 10 > npx * 4) {
        g_o_rej_black++;
        if (g_o_rej_lines < 6) {
            g_o_rej_lines++;
            vk_boot_logf("[o] grab skip slot=%d key=%#llx why=black-%.1f%% (mid-frame) rej_black=%llu",
                         slot, key, 100.0 * (double)black / (double)npx, g_o_rej_black);
        }
        vkUnmapMemory(g_dev, gbm);
        return 0;
    }
    if (g_o_best_colored && colored * 5ull < g_o_best_colored * 4ull) {
        g_o_rej_lowcov++;
        if (g_o_rej_lines < 6) {
            g_o_rej_lines++;
            vk_boot_logf("[o] grab skip slot=%d key=%#llx why=low-coverage colored=%llu best=%llu rej_cov=%llu",
                         slot, key, colored, g_o_best_colored, g_o_rej_lowcov);
        }
        vkUnmapMemory(g_dev, gbm);
        return 0;
    }
    if (colored > g_o_best_colored) g_o_best_colored = colored;
    g_o_grab_n++;
    g_our_kind = 1;
    /* 派活单要求的判据行（每 boot ≤4 行） */
    if (g_o_src_lines < 4) {
        g_o_src_lines++;
        vk_boot_logf("[o] present src kind=gameRT slot=%d key=%08x w=%d h=%d draws_into_it=%d "
                     "(key64=%#llx)",
                     slot, (unsigned)(key & 0xffffffffull), (int)w, (int)h, (int)draws_into, key);
    }
    {   /* 该 RT 的内容统计 + 「最后一笔之后有没有被 clear」的直接证据 */
        float cc[4] = { 0, 0, 0, 0 };
        int hc = m4al_last_clear(cc);
        if (g_o_grab_lines < 4) {
            g_o_grab_lines++;
            vk_boot_logf("[o] grab #%llu npx=%llu colored=%llu (%.2f%%) non_magenta=%llu (%.2f%%) "
                         "black=%llu (%.2f%%) mean=%llu/%llu/%llu max=%llu/%llu/%llu clr_have=%d "
                         "rgba=%.3f,%.3f,%.3f,%.3f",
                         g_o_grab_n, npx, colored, 100.0 * (double)colored / (double)npx,
                         nonmag, 100.0 * (double)nonmag / (double)npx,
                         black, 100.0 * (double)black / (double)npx,
                         sr / npx, sg / npx, sb / npx, (unsigned long long)mx[0],
                         (unsigned long long)mx[1], (unsigned long long)mx[2],
                         hc, cc[0], cc[1], cc[2], cc[3]);
            for (int k = 0; k < P_WROTE_RING && k < 3; k++) {
                unsigned wi = (g_p_wrote_i + P_WROTE_RING - 1 - k) % P_WROTE_RING;
                if (g_p_wrote[wi].img != img) continue;
                vk_boot_logf("[o] grab #%llu wrote-by n=%llu vs=%s fs=%s count=%u verts=%u",
                             g_o_grab_n, g_p_wrote[wi].n, g_p_wrote[wi].vs, g_p_wrote[wi].fs,
                             g_p_wrote[wi].count, g_p_wrote[wi].verts);
            }
        }
    }
    int up = p3_our_upload(p, w, h);   /* 同一条上屏路径：解冻 + 限流 + staging 复用 */
    vkUnmapMemory(g_dev, gbm);
    if (!up) g_o_grab_fail++;
    return up;
}

/* ================= M4bq P1（2026-11-04）：**旁路** + **内容签名扳机** =================
   M4bp 两轮结论（/tmp/m4bp_report.md）：旁路机制成立（present 源 = world-snap，31 次），
   但扳机错两次：①「每个 pass 结束」抓到 clear 值；②「大几何那一批的批末」仍是 0/0/0 ——
   同一张图（img+ext = WORLDCAND slot3，key 64272400）的内容在**下一批**才被写进去。
   本轮唯一行为改动：**扳机 = 这张 img 在本批被写过就取样；取回后立刻按「内容签名」判这一刻是否成立**，
   成立即接管（`g_our_kind=2` ⇒ present 的 `src=world-snap`）；跨 pass/跨批持续采样，
   后续更「好」（colored 或 mean 更大）就替换上一份（`[w] world pick replace #n why=better`）。
   签名（M4bs 起 = **三条件同时成立**，见 w_sig_reject）：
     ① spread ≥ 64；② hist8 非空桶 ≥ 3；③ 不是我们自己对照三角的指纹（mean≈180/5/9、max≈255/15..20/25..35）。
   守卫（沿用已确认事实，不是本轮新行为）：整幅抹白（三通道 min≥200）不接管；洋红（mxR/mxB≥64 ∧ mxG≤32）不是内容。
   身份仍只用 img+ext（ASLR 下槽号不是身份）；回读后仍走 p3_our_upload() 老上屏通道。 */
/* ================= M4br P1（2026-11-04）：**逐帧扫描 + 内容签名** =================
   M4bq boot#1 的两条结论（/tmp/m4bq_report.md）：
     · 世界 RT 有内容时是 `colored=100% mean=11/11/11`（很暗），且比我们取样晚 ~5.4 s；
     · 旧「单点身份 + 单点扳机」在 t≈95 s 后再不产生样本（旁路 0 次，`[w] world skip` 三条后再无声）。
   本轮丢掉三样东西：① 单点身份 `g_w_img`；② 「本批被颜色 draw 写过」的批内候选标记 `g_w_bw`；
   ③ 在批次 CB 里录拷贝（取样点被迫绑死在批末）。换成（派活单 P1 第 1~4 条）：
     · 每个 flush（≈每帧，栅栏已等到、GPU 空闲）扫 **g_rt_tab 里所有 1600x900 的游戏 RT**，
       游标 `g_s_rr` 轮转，每 tick 最多探 W_S_PER_TICK=4 张；
     · 探测 = **低成本内容签名**：每张只拷 16 条整行（4 张合一个 CB、一次栅栏、一块 400 KB
       复用 host buffer），得到 colored/mean/max/spread/hist8 —— 不为签名做整幅回读；
     · 签名（M4bs 起 = **三条件同时成立**，见 w_sig_reject：spread≥64 ∧ hist8 非空桶≥3 ∧ 不是我们探针指纹）
       且比已接管那份「更好」⇒ 才付一次**整幅回读**（5.76 MB，每 boot ≤ W_S_MAX_FULL=20 次），精确复核签名
       → 落 PAM 证据 → `p3_our_upload()` 上屏（present 的 `src=world-snap`）；
     · 跨帧持续替换：后来的样本 colored 或 mean 更大就替换（`[w] world pick replace #n why=better`）。
   身份只用 img+ext；槽号只作「不重复扫描」的游标，不参与任何判据。
   另补一条**陈旧门**：某槽自上次被颜色 draw 写过之后已过 W_S_STALE_TICKS 个 tick（flush 计数，≥10 s 量级）就不再
   当候选 —— 否则轮转会反复扫到「很早以前的旧帧」（它的 colored/mean 可能比当前世界 RT 还大，抢屏）。 */
#define W_S_PER_TICK 4u
/* M4bt P1：整幅回读从「换源预算 20 次」改成「刷新预算」。为什么必须改：20 次预算在 t≈8 s 内
   就被「首个好样本 + 抖动」用光，之后 `[w] world stat` 只扫不回读 ⇒ 屏幕自 t≈330 s 起像素不变
   （M4bs 的 screen_t330 与 screen.png 逐位相同）。现在每次「同一张源的新一帧」都要回读一次，
   1615 帧的量级 ⇒ 上限只当防爆阀（平均仍受 W_S_MIN_FULL_US 限流 ≈2.5 次/s）。 */
#define W_S_MAX_FULL 4000u
#define W_S_REFRESH_LOG 3000ull     /* 刷新日志配额（每帧一行，≈1600 行/boot 够用） */
#define W_S_ROWS     16u
#define W_S_MAX_LOG  8u
#define W_S_MAX_SKP  8u
#define W_S_MAX_DUMP 4u
#define W_S_STALE_TICKS 1200ull   /* M4bu P1：10 s → 30 s 量级；慢更新的世界 RT 不再被陈旧门丢掉 */
/* M6v P1：世界源普查的家族判据 = guest 1600x900 的光栅尺寸。 */
#define W_S_W h_rs_dim(1600u)
#define W_S_H h_rs_dim(900u)
#define W_S_MIN_FULL_US 400000ull   /* 两次整幅回读的最小间隔（防 1 秒内 8 次替换烧光预算） */
#define W_S_BETTER_MARGIN 0.03      /* 内容分数要有这个增量才替换（迟滞，防抖动） */
#define W_S_SELF_N 8u               /* 「我们自己画进去的图」ring（对照三角/A~J 等） */
#define W_W_NTAB     ((unsigned)(sizeof g_rt_tab / sizeof *g_rt_tab))
static VkImage g_w_img;                        /* 最近一次整幅回读那张图（不记槽号做判据） */
static unsigned g_w_w, g_w_h;
static unsigned long long g_w_key, g_w_at_draw;
static char g_w_bvs[20], g_w_bfs[20];           /* 大几何证据（M4bq 的身份，现在只留作证据） */
static unsigned long long g_w_nv, g_w_cnt;
static unsigned long long g_w_caps, g_w_rej;    /* caps = 整幅回读次数（预算 W_S_MAX_FULL） */
static unsigned g_w_att, g_w_layskip;           /* 探测次数 / 布局不可读跳过 */
static unsigned g_w_skp_lines, g_w_log_lines;
static unsigned g_w_dumps;
static unsigned long long g_w_last_stat_us;
static unsigned long long g_w_last_dump_us;     /* M4bt P1：dump 的时间间隔（按帧数 dump 会永不落盘） */
static unsigned long long g_w_last_full_us;     /* 上次整幅回读时刻（W_S_MIN_FULL_US 限流） */
static double g_w_best_score;                   /* 已接管那一份的内容分数（比较「更好」用） */
static double g_w_best_col;                     /* 已接管那一份的 colored%（比较「更好」用） */
static unsigned g_w_best_mean;                  /* 已接管那一份的 mean(RGB 三通道均值) */
static unsigned long long g_w_best_key;
static VkImage g_w_best_img;                    /* 只作「本次回读用的是哪张」的证据，**不作身份** */
/* ---- M4bu P1（2026-11-04）：稳定身份 = texid + key + ext，**不是 VkImage 指针** ----
   实证（M4bt b1/b3 日志）：游戏每帧重建池图，同一份世界内容落在**新 img**上
   （b3: img=0x7f84a25cc8 key=63fa9100 → img=0x6dc7821f48 key=63fab4b0，内容同为 mean=135/65/164），
   按 img 认身份必然 cur=-1；而 texid（纹理登记 id）与 key（池存储地址）在这两次里也变了，
   所以身份必须是**三元组**：任一维变化就当成「同一份内容的新实例」，仍按同分替换接受。
   img 只用于本次回读，任何判据都不再看它。 */
typedef struct { int texid; unsigned long long key; unsigned w, h; } w_srcid;
static w_srcid g_w_id;                          /* 已接管上屏源的身份（g_w_id_ok=0 表示还没有源） */
static int g_w_id_ok;
static w_srcid g_big_id;                        /* M4bu P2：被大几何（角色）写过的那张 RT 的身份 */
static int g_big_id_ok;
static unsigned g_big_lines;                    /* 身份变更日志配额 */
static unsigned long long g_big_alt;            /* 非 9804619d/15a5f3dd 指纹的大几何笔数（忽略） */
static int w_srcid_eq(const w_srcid *a, const w_srcid *b)
{
    return a->texid == b->texid && a->key == b->key && a->w == b->w && a->h == b->h;
}
/* 已上屏那一份的「内容轻判据」：mean 三分量 + hist8。同分替换时用它避免无意义重复上传。 */
static unsigned g_w_up_mean[3];
static unsigned long long g_w_up_hist[8];
static int g_w_up_ok;
static unsigned long long g_w_unchg;            /* 内容未变 ⇒ 跳过上传的次数 */
static unsigned long long g_w_lowsc;            /* 候选分数低于已接管源（不敢换）的次数 */
static unsigned long long g_w_rj_ls, g_w_rj_lh, g_w_rj_fp, g_w_rj_fl, g_w_rj_cl,
                        g_w_rj_wp, g_w_rj_mg, g_w_rj_qdim;   /* 稀疏拒收按原因计数 */
static unsigned long long g_w_last_skp_us, g_w_last_cand_us, g_w_cand_lines;
static unsigned g_w_cand_slots;                 /* 本 tick 进入候选集的数量 */
static unsigned g_w_cand_dumps;                 /* 「有结构但被拒」候选的整幅落盘次数（≤2） */
static w_srcid g_w_cand_last;
static unsigned long long g_p_src_wsnap;                  /* 上屏源 = world-snap 的命中次数 */
/* M4bt P1：刷新计数（与 g_w_picks「换源次数」分开记）。 */
static unsigned long long g_w_refresh, g_w_refresh_log, g_w_keep_noop;
static unsigned long long g_w_dim;      /* 因「太暗（mean<W_S_MIN_MEAN）而不作上屏源」的次数 */
static int g_w_src_slot = -1;           /* 上次取到内容的槽（**只用于扫描顺序**，不作身份） */
/* M4bt P3（取证）：本 boot 观察到的「暗但有结构」的 RT（候选角色图）。
   只按内容特征记（mean<60 ∧ colored>5% ∧ spread≥64），不绑槽号/纹理号；仅用于落 PAM 供人眼判读。 */
static VkImage g_dark_img;
static unsigned long long g_dark_seen_us;
static unsigned g_dark_dumps;
static unsigned g_dark_slot;
/* 轮转扫描状态 */
static unsigned g_s_rr;                         /* 槽游标（只用于「不重复扫描」） */
static unsigned long long g_s_ticks, g_s_probes;
static unsigned long long g_s_last_draw[W_W_NTAB];   /* 该槽最近一次被颜色 draw 写时的 tick */
/* 「我们自己画进去的图」：当前 RT / 调试重放只要被我们的合成几何（对照三角、A~J 变体）写过，
   就在 W_S_SELF_TICKS 个 tick 内不当候选 —— boot#1 实证 pick #1 就是自己的对照三角（tri_probe.pam 逐字段相同）。 */
#define W_S_SELF_TICKS 400ull
static VkImage g_s_self_img[W_S_SELF_N];
static unsigned long long g_s_self_until[W_S_SELF_N];
static unsigned g_s_self_i;
static unsigned g_s_self_skips;
/* M4bs P1：对照三角已改画进独立 debug RT（见 d_probe_control_tri），不再有调用点。
   这个「我们自己的 draw 写进了哪张图」登记保留作钩子：将来若某条合成几何不得不画进被扫描的 RT，
   在这里登记 img，扫描就会在 W_S_SELF_TICKS 内跳过它（日志 `self=N` 可见）。 */
static void w_note_self_draw(VkImage img) __attribute__((unused));
static void w_note_self_draw(VkImage img)
{
    if (!img) return;
    g_s_self_img[g_s_self_i] = img;
    g_s_self_until[g_s_self_i] = g_s_ticks + W_S_SELF_TICKS;
    g_s_self_i = (g_s_self_i + 1u) % W_S_SELF_N;
}
static int w_is_self(VkImage img)
{
    if (!img) return 0;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < W_S_SELF_N; i++)
        if (g_s_self_img[i] == img && g_s_ticks <= g_s_self_until[i]) return 1;
    return 0;
}
/* 整幅回读 host buffer（5.76 MB，复用） */
static VkBuffer g_w_rb; static VkDeviceMemory g_w_rbm; static void *g_w_rbmap; static VkDeviceSize g_w_rbsz;
/* 稀疏探测 host buffer（≤4 张 × 16 行 × 1600 × 4B ≈ 400 KB，复用） */
static VkBuffer g_s_sb; static VkDeviceMemory g_s_sm; static void *g_s_smap; static VkDeviceSize g_s_ssz;

typedef struct { unsigned long long nz, npx, sum[3]; unsigned mx[3], mn[3]; unsigned long long hist[8]; } w_sig;

/* ===== M4bs P1（修 A）：内容签名三条件（全部成立才算内容） =====
   为什么不能再只用 `colored>5%`：M4br boot#1 实证「整幅同一个非零值」（mean=128/128/128 与 2/2/2）colored=100%，
   被当内容抢屏；boot#2 起 `spread<4` 已挡掉纯色，但「两档跳变」（如只有暗底+一块亮矩形）仍能过。
   派活单口径，逐条实现：
     ① spread ≥ 64                      —— 有真实动态范围（不是近似均匀）；
     ② hist8 非空桶 ≥ 3                  —— 不是整幅同一个值，也不是两档跳变（用**原始计数**，不用打印的百分比）；
                                           桶值口径 = **亮度 Y**，不是 max(r,g,b)（见下）。
     ③ 不是我们自己探针（对照三角）的指纹 —— 按指纹排（mean≈180/5/9、max≈255/15..20/25..35），不按图名/槽号。
   返回值：0 = 通过；1/2/3 = 第几条不满足（用于日志 why=lowspread/lowhist/probe_fp）。 */
#define W_S_MIN_SPREAD  64u
/* M4bt P1：上屏源的最低平均亮度（RGB 三通道均值）。10/255≈4% 在屏上就是"黑"，不配当画面；
   真实场景这张实测 mean=135/65/164（均值 121）。这条只决定「谁当上屏源」，不影响 PAM/统计口径。 */
#define W_S_MIN_MEAN    24u
#define W_S_MIN_BUCKETS 3
/* M4bs P1【口径】桶值用**亮度** Y=(77R+150G+29B)>>8，不是 max(r,g,b)。
   为什么改（boot#1 实证 + 离线复算）：真实场景 /tmp/m4bs_ev/m4br_world1.pam（天空/云/地平线/沙地/物体）
   在 `max(r,g,b)>>5` 口径下**每个像素的最亮通道都 ≥192**（饱和蓝天空 255、饱和橙沙地 226、饱和红/蓝物体 255），
   整幅几乎全落第 8 桶 ⇒ 稀疏 16×16 只剩 2 个非空桶，被「≥3 桶」判成"两档跳变"而拒（boot#1 `full=0/20 att=0` 的直接原因）。
   同一张图按亮度分档则是稀疏 nb=6 / 整幅 nb=8，真实结构展开得很清楚；而纯色（1 桶）与对照三角（暗蓝+红 = 2 桶）依旧被拒。
   判据本意是「有结构、不是整幅一个值」⇒ 亮度才是正确口径。 */
#define W_S_Y(r, g, b) ((unsigned)((77u * (r) + 150u * (g) + 29u * (b)) >> 8))
static int w_sig_reject(unsigned spread, const unsigned long long *hist, unsigned long long npx,
                        unsigned mean_r, unsigned mean_g, unsigned mean_b,
                        unsigned mx_r, unsigned mx_g, unsigned mx_b)
{
    int nb = 0; unsigned long long hmax = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) { if (hist[i]) nb++; if (hist[i] > hmax) hmax = hist[i]; }
    if (spread < W_S_MIN_SPREAD) return 1;
    if (nb < W_S_MIN_BUCKETS) return 2;
    /* M4bt P1【新增第 4 条】：**整屏近单色**（最大亮度桶占比 > 50%）不是画面。
       b2a 实证：一条白色过场（mean=251/252/251，99% 落第 8 桶）和一条洋红清屏
       （mean=249/54/249，56% 落一桶）都能拿到 0.96~0.99 的"内容分数"——colored=100% + spread=255
       ——把真实场景（0.947，最大桶 40%）挤掉。宽口径（wipe/magenta）都用了 max 值，只要图里有一小块
       白就失效，所以这里用**分布形状**判，而不是颜色。
       真实场景实测 hist8=0,40,20,7,9,15,6,0 ⇒ 最大桶 40%，安全。
       M4bu P1【修】：门再收一道 —— 只在「非空桶 ≤4」时才算 flat。M4bu boot#1 实证：一张
       `mean=188 spread=255 nbuckets=6 colored=97%` 的**有完整动态范围、6 档结构**的 1600×900 RT
       整 boot 反复出现，却被这条门单独拒掉（`world cand … flat`），而所有 rev 里它是最像世界图的一张。
       判据本意是「整屏近单色」⇒ 必须同时满足「结构少」。 */
    if (npx && nb <= 4 && (double)hmax > 0.45 * (double)npx) return 4;
    /* 对照三角 = 清屏色 (0.05,0.07,0.12)→(13,18,31) + 红三角 (255,0,0)：
       整幅统计 mean≈180/5/9、max≈255/18/31。容差按「逐字段」放宽，但要求三通道同时命中，
       以免误伤真正的高红低绿内容。 */
    if (mean_r >= 165u && mean_r <= 195u && mean_g <= 18u && mean_b <= 26u &&
        mx_r >= 240u && mx_g >= 8u && mx_g <= 34u && mx_b >= 16u && mx_b <= 46u) return 3;
    /* M4bt P1【新增】我们自己那条上屏清色/调试填充的指纹（**按均值**，不用 max）。
       b2a/b2b 实证：一张 mean≈194/88/194 → 249/122/249 的静态 1600×900 RT（正是 gfx_bridge
       `nvn_vk_present_clear` 的洋红族，(200,90,180) 系）拿到 0.97 的"内容分数"，把真实场景挤掉，
       并一直占屏。原 magenta 判据用 mx，只要图里有一小块白就永远不成立 —— 这里按均值判：
       R 与 B 都亮、G 明显低于两者的一半 ⇒ 不是画面。真实场景实测 135/65/164（R=135 < 170，不命中）。 */
    if (mean_r >= 170u && mean_b >= 150u && mean_g * 2u <= mean_r && mean_g * 2u <= mean_b) return 5;
    return 0;
}
static const char *w_sig_why(int rej, int wipe, int magenta)
{
    if (rej == 1) return "lowspread";
    if (rej == 2) return "lowhist";
    if (rej == 3) return "probe_fp";
    if (rej == 4) return "flat";
    if (rej == 5) return "ourclear";
    if (wipe) return "wipe";
    if (magenta) return "magenta";
    return "nosig";
}

/* 内容分数：colored% / spread / mean 的加权和（0~1）。为什么不用派活单字面的
   「colored 或 mean 更大」—— boot#1 实证会被"整幅同一个非零值"戏耍：
   pick #4（colored=100%/mean=2，纯黑底）替换掉了 pick #3（58.3%/148，有真结构），
   并在 1 秒内与 #5~#8 来回抖动，把 20 次整幅回读预算烧光。分数把 spread（有没有结构）
   与 mean（亮不亮）都计进去，纯色图拿不到高分。 */
static double w_score(double col_pct, unsigned spread, unsigned mean_rgb)
{
    return 0.45 * (col_pct / 100.0) + 0.45 * ((double)spread / 255.0) + 0.10 * ((double)mean_rgb / 255.0);
}

/* 布局 → (读源 access / stage)。只认这三种「内容确定」的态（与 r_tex_signature 同口径；
   其它布局（UNDEFINED/TRANSFER_DST/DEPTH_*）含义不唯一，一律不猜）。 */
static int w_lay_acc(VkImageLayout lay, VkAccessFlags *acc, VkPipelineStageFlags *stage)
{
    if (lay == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL) {
        *acc = VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT | VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT;
        *stage = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT; return 1;
    }
    if (lay == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL) {
        *acc = VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT; *stage = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT; return 1;
    }
    if (lay == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL) {
        *acc = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT; *stage = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT; return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

/* 每笔颜色 draw 都过这里：① 记「该槽最近被写」的 tick（扫描的陈旧门）；② 留最后一笔大几何做证据。
   不再有任何「身份」含义 —— 扫描不再依赖它。 */
static void w_world_note(VkImage img, unsigned w, unsigned h, unsigned long long key,
                         unsigned nv, unsigned cnt, const char *vs, const char *fs)
{
    (void)key;
    if (!img || !g_rt_cur) return;                       /* 只要游戏 RT（宿主图不算） */
    if (w != W_S_W || h != W_S_H) return;
    int si = (int)(g_rt_cur - g_rt_tab);
    if (si < 0 || si >= (int)W_W_NTAB) return;
    g_s_last_draw[si] = g_s_ticks;
    if (nv >= 512u || cnt >= 1000u) {                    /* 只留最后一笔大几何的 vs/fs 做证据 */
        g_w_nv = nv; g_w_cnt = cnt;
        snprintf(g_w_bvs, sizeof g_w_bvs, "%s", vs ? vs : "-");
        snprintf(g_w_bfs, sizeof g_w_bfs, "%s", fs ? fs : "-");
        /* M4bu P2：**角色 RT 的认法** —— 哪张图被大几何写过，就记它那条笔的 vs/fs 与三元素身份。
           任务单口径：按 key+ext 认，不按槽号。这里额外带上 texid（与 RT 表 dump 的 texid 同源），
           三元素任一变化都重新记；w_try_blend 每次按身份回表里找当前槽（槽号会轮转/驱逐）。 */
        if (g_rt_cur) {
            w_srcid nid; nid.texid = (int)g_rt_cur->tex_id; nid.key = key; nid.w = w; nid.h = h;
            /* 任务单口径：认的是「含 big=9804619d/15a5f3dd 那笔（bc=10440 bv=4218）」写入的 RT。
               M4bu boot#1 实证：同一批里还有一张**兜底图**（texid=-1、key=0x4d344100…）也收到同样
               4218 顶点的几何（vs=7e9c12b6/0a25edc7），它不是角色 RT ⇒ 只认 vs/fs 指纹，其余仅计数。 */
            const int is_char = (vs && strncmp(vs, "9804619d", 8) == 0) ||
                                (fs && strncmp(fs, "15a5f3dd", 8) == 0);
            if (!is_char) g_big_alt++;
            else if (!g_big_id_ok || !w_srcid_eq(&g_big_id, &nid)) {
                g_big_id = nid; g_big_id_ok = 1;
                if (g_big_lines < 8) {
                    g_big_lines++;
                    vk_boot_logf("[w] bigid #%u texid=%d key=%#llx ext=%ux%u vs=%s fs=%s nv=%u cnt=%u "
                                 "(角色几何落点身份，按 texid+key+ext 认；非该指纹的大几何 %llu 笔已忽略)",
                                 g_big_lines, nid.texid, nid.key, w, h,
                                 vs ? vs : "-", fs ? fs : "-", nv, cnt, g_big_alt);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

/* 低成本内容签名：n（≤4）张图各拷 16 条整行进同一块 host buffer —— 一个 CB、一次栅栏、
   零整幅回读。布局原样转回（CAO 的仍回 CAO，别把游戏附件态改掉）。返回 1 = 成功。 */
static int w_probe_sparse(VkImage *imgs, VkImageLayout *lays, unsigned n,
                          unsigned w, unsigned h, w_sig *out)
{
    if (!g_dev || !g_q || !g_h_cp || !n || n > W_S_PER_TICK || w == 0 || h == 0) return 0;
    const VkDeviceSize rowb = (VkDeviceSize)w * 4u;
    const VkDeviceSize slot = rowb * (VkDeviceSize)W_S_ROWS;
    const VkDeviceSize need = slot * (VkDeviceSize)W_S_PER_TICK;
    if (!g_s_sb || g_s_ssz < need) {
        if (g_s_sb) { vkDestroyBuffer(g_dev, g_s_sb, NULL); g_s_sb = VK_NULL_HANDLE; }
        if (g_s_sm) { vkFreeMemory(g_dev, g_s_sm, NULL); g_s_sm = VK_NULL_HANDLE; g_s_smap = NULL; }
        VkBufferCreateInfo bi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO };
        bi.size = need; bi.usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT; bi.sharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE;
        if (vkCreateBuffer(g_dev, &bi, NULL, &g_s_sb) != VK_SUCCESS) { g_s_sb = VK_NULL_HANDLE; return 0; }
        VkMemoryRequirements rq; vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(g_dev, g_s_sb, &rq);
        int ti = find_type(rq, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT);
        VkMemoryAllocateInfo ai = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO };
        ai.allocationSize = rq.size; ai.memoryTypeIndex = ti >= 0 ? (uint32_t)ti : 0;
        if (vkAllocateMemory(g_dev, &ai, NULL, &g_s_sm) != VK_SUCCESS) {
            vkDestroyBuffer(g_dev, g_s_sb, NULL); g_s_sb = VK_NULL_HANDLE; g_s_sm = VK_NULL_HANDLE; return 0;
        }
        vkBindBufferMemory(g_dev, g_s_sb, g_s_sm, 0);
        if (vkMapMemory(g_dev, g_s_sm, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE, 0, &g_s_smap) != VK_SUCCESS || !g_s_smap) {
            vkDestroyBuffer(g_dev, g_s_sb, NULL); vkFreeMemory(g_dev, g_s_sm, NULL);
            g_s_sb = VK_NULL_HANDLE; g_s_sm = VK_NULL_HANDLE; g_s_smap = NULL; return 0;
        }
        g_s_ssz = need;
    }
    VkCommandBuffer cb = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo ca = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO };
    ca.commandPool = g_h_cp; ca.level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY; ca.commandBufferCount = 1;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_vkq_lock);
    if (vkAllocateCommandBuffers(g_dev, &ca, &cb) != VK_SUCCESS) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_vkq_lock); return 0; }
    VkCommandBufferBeginInfo cbi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO };
    cbi.flags = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT;
    vkBeginCommandBuffer(cb, &cbi);
    VkImageSubresourceRange rng = { VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1 };
    unsigned nrec = 0;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        VkAccessFlags acc; VkPipelineStageFlags st;
        if (!w_lay_acc(lays[i], &acc, &st)) continue;
        VkImageMemoryBarrier b = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER };
        b.srcAccessMask = acc; b.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT;
        b.oldLayout = lays[i]; b.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL;
        b.srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED; b.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
        b.image = imgs[i]; b.subresourceRange = rng;
        vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, st, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, 0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &b);
        for (unsigned k = 0; k < W_S_ROWS; k++) {
            VkBufferImageCopy reg; memset(&reg, 0, sizeof reg);
            reg.bufferOffset = slot * (VkDeviceSize)i + rowb * (VkDeviceSize)k;
            reg.imageSubresource = (VkImageSubresourceLayers){ VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1 };
            reg.imageOffset = (VkOffset3D){ 0, (int32_t)((uint64_t)h * k / W_S_ROWS), 0 };
            reg.imageExtent = (VkExtent3D){ w, 1, 1 };
            vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer(cb, imgs[i], VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, g_s_sb, 1, &reg);
        }
        VkImageMemoryBarrier b2 = b;
        b2.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT; b2.dstAccessMask = acc;
        b2.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL; b2.newLayout = lays[i];
        vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, st, 0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &b2);
        nrec++;
    }
    vkEndCommandBuffer(cb);
    int ok = 0;
    if (nrec) {
        VkSubmitInfo si = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO };
        si.commandBufferCount = 1; si.pCommandBuffers = &cb;
        vkResetFences(g_dev, 1, &g_h_fence);
        VkResult sr = vkQueueSubmit(g_q, 1, &si, g_h_fence);
        ok = (sr == VK_SUCCESS && nvk_wait_fences(g_dev, 1, &g_h_fence, VK_TRUE, 5000000000ull) == VK_SUCCESS);
        if (!ok) vk_boot_logf("[fs-red] world probe submit=%d (%s)", (int)sr, vr(sr));
    }
    vkFreeCommandBuffers(g_dev, g_h_cp, 1, &cb);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_vkq_lock);
    if (!ok) return 0;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        w_sig *o = &out[i];
        memset(o, 0, sizeof *o);
        for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) o->mn[c] = 255u;
        { VkAccessFlags a2; VkPipelineStageFlags s2; if (!w_lay_acc(lays[i], &a2, &s2)) continue; }
        const uint8_t *base = (const uint8_t *)g_s_smap + (size_t)slot * i;
        for (unsigned k = 0; k < W_S_ROWS; k++) {
            const uint8_t *row = base + (size_t)rowb * k;
            for (unsigned j = 0; j < 16; j++) {
                unsigned x = (unsigned)((uint64_t)w * (2 * j + 1) / 32);   /* 等距 16 列（每带中点） */
                if (x >= w) x = w - 1;
                const uint8_t *px = row + (size_t)x * 4u;
                for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
                    unsigned v = px[c];
                    o->sum[c] += v;
                    if (v < o->mn[c]) o->mn[c] = v;
                    if (v > o->mx[c]) o->mx[c] = v;
                }
                /* M4bs：稀疏阶段也算 8 档**亮度**桶（Y>>5，与整幅同口径），供「非空桶≥3」判据。 */
                {
                    unsigned r = px[0], gc = px[1], bl = px[2];
                    o->hist[W_S_Y(r, gc, bl) >> 5]++;
                }
                if (px[0] | px[1] | px[2]) o->nz++;
                o->npx++;
            }
        }
    }
    return 1;
}

/* 整幅回读（5.76 MB）：单 CB 单栅栏，布局原样转回。M4bt：buffer 由调用方给
   （场景一份 g_w_*、角色候选一份 g_c_*，互不覆盖），不再写死一块。 */
static int w_read_img_to(VkImage img, VkImageLayout lay, unsigned w, unsigned h,
                         VkBuffer *pbuf, VkDeviceMemory *pmem, void **pmap, VkDeviceSize *psz)
{
    if (!img || !g_dev || !g_q || !g_h_cp || !w || !h) return 0;
    VkAccessFlags acc; VkPipelineStageFlags st;
    if (!w_lay_acc(lay, &acc, &st)) return 0;
    const VkDeviceSize sz = (VkDeviceSize)w * h * 4u;
    if (!*pbuf || *psz != sz) {
        if (*pbuf) { vkDestroyBuffer(g_dev, *pbuf, NULL); *pbuf = VK_NULL_HANDLE; }
        if (*pmem) { vkFreeMemory(g_dev, *pmem, NULL); *pmem = VK_NULL_HANDLE; *pmap = NULL; }
        VkBufferCreateInfo bi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO };
        bi.size = sz; bi.usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT; bi.sharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE;
        if (vkCreateBuffer(g_dev, &bi, NULL, pbuf) != VK_SUCCESS) { *pbuf = VK_NULL_HANDLE; g_w_rej++; return 0; }
        VkMemoryRequirements rq; vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(g_dev, *pbuf, &rq);
        int ti = find_type(rq, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT);
        VkMemoryAllocateInfo ai = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO };
        ai.allocationSize = rq.size; ai.memoryTypeIndex = ti >= 0 ? (uint32_t)ti : 0;
        if (vkAllocateMemory(g_dev, &ai, NULL, pmem) != VK_SUCCESS) {
            vkDestroyBuffer(g_dev, *pbuf, NULL); *pbuf = VK_NULL_HANDLE; *pmem = VK_NULL_HANDLE; g_w_rej++; return 0;
        }
        vkBindBufferMemory(g_dev, *pbuf, *pmem, 0);
        if (vkMapMemory(g_dev, *pmem, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE, 0, pmap) != VK_SUCCESS || !*pmap) {
            vkDestroyBuffer(g_dev, *pbuf, NULL); vkFreeMemory(g_dev, *pmem, NULL);
            *pbuf = VK_NULL_HANDLE; *pmem = VK_NULL_HANDLE; *pmap = NULL; g_w_rej++; return 0;
        }
        *psz = sz;
    }
    VkCommandBuffer cb = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo ca = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO };
    ca.commandPool = g_h_cp; ca.level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY; ca.commandBufferCount = 1;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_vkq_lock);
    if (vkAllocateCommandBuffers(g_dev, &ca, &cb) != VK_SUCCESS) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_vkq_lock); return 0; }
    VkCommandBufferBeginInfo cbi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO };
    cbi.flags = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT;
    vkBeginCommandBuffer(cb, &cbi);
    VkImageSubresourceRange rng = { VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1 };
    VkImageMemoryBarrier b = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER };
    b.srcAccessMask = acc; b.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT;
    b.oldLayout = lay; b.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL;
    b.srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED; b.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
    b.image = img; b.subresourceRange = rng;
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, st, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, 0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &b);
    VkBufferImageCopy reg; memset(&reg, 0, sizeof reg);
    reg.imageSubresource = (VkImageSubresourceLayers){ VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1 };
    reg.imageExtent = (VkExtent3D){ w, h, 1 };
    vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer(cb, img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, *pbuf, 1, &reg);
    VkImageMemoryBarrier b2 = b;
    b2.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT; b2.dstAccessMask = acc;
    b2.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL; b2.newLayout = lay;
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, st, 0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &b2);
    vkEndCommandBuffer(cb);
    VkSubmitInfo si = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO };
    si.commandBufferCount = 1; si.pCommandBuffers = &cb;
    vkResetFences(g_dev, 1, &g_h_fence);
    VkResult sr = vkQueueSubmit(g_q, 1, &si, g_h_fence);
    int ok = (sr == VK_SUCCESS && nvk_wait_fences(g_dev, 1, &g_h_fence, VK_TRUE, 30000000000ull) == VK_SUCCESS);
    vkFreeCommandBuffers(g_dev, g_h_cp, 1, &cb);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_vkq_lock);
    if (!ok) { g_w_rej++; if (g_w_skp_lines < W_S_MAX_SKP) { g_w_skp_lines++;
        vk_boot_logf("[w] world skip why=readfail img=%#llx submit=%d (%s)",
                     (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)img, (int)sr, vr(sr)); } return 0; }
    g_w_caps++;
    return 1;
}

static int w_full_read(VkImage img, VkImageLayout lay, unsigned w, unsigned h)
{
    return w_read_img_to(img, lay, w, h, &g_w_rb, &g_w_rbm, &g_w_rbmap, &g_w_rbsz);
}

/* ---- M4bt P3（2026-11-04）：把「角色所在那张很暗的 RT」按 alpha 叠到场景上 ----
   为什么选 (b) 而不是 (a)（找游戏自己的合成路径）：本轮 P1 已确认场景来自**单个**世界 RT
   （`img+ext` 稳定、每帧刷新），而游戏把角色合到场景上的那一步要么在屏幕空间后处理里（M4bj 已证
   那条链现在产出洋红/渐变，不采信），要么在另一张 RT 上再走一遍我们不认识的 pass。找它需要反汇编
   着色器/常量块，超出「1~2 次 boot 内可验证」的范围；本机 host 侧叠加可立刻验收（判据=人眼同时看到
   场景与角色形状），且**不硬编码坐标**：
     · 源图按内容特征选（mean<60 ∧ colored>5%，与本轮扫描同口径），不绑槽号/纹理号；
     · 叠加位置=两张图逐像素同位（都是 1600×900 全屏 RT，同一 camera 空间），不做任何平移缩放；
     · 混合权重=角色 RT 自己的 **alpha 通道**（a=0 全透明、a=255 全不透明），不做阈值猜测。
   若角色 RT 的 alpha 恒为 255（常见于不写 alpha 的颜色附件），按 alpha 叠加会整张盖住场景 ——
   这种情况会由 `[w] blend` 行的 alpha 直方图**如实暴露**，不许当成"成功"。 */
static VkBuffer g_c_rb; static VkDeviceMemory g_c_rbm; static void *g_c_rbmap; static VkDeviceSize g_c_rbsz;
static unsigned char *g_blend_px;     /* 5.76 MB 合成结果（host），仅在我们自己 malloc 的堆上 */
static int g_blend_ready;             /* 1 = g_blend_px 与 g_w_rbmap 同尺寸且已合成 */
static unsigned long long g_blend_n, g_blend_skip, g_blend_log;
static unsigned long long g_blend_chg_last;   /* 本帧实际改动像素数（日志用） */

/* M4bt P1：证据落盘 —— 按**时间间隔**（≥45 s）而不是按换源次数：刷新后几乎不换源，
   按次数会让 t≈200/330 永远不落盘。每 boot ≤4 张，覆盖 t≈90/200/330。
   上屏的是 P3 合成图时，落盘的也必须是它（"证据 = 观众看到的"）。 */
static void w_maybe_dump(unsigned w, unsigned h, unsigned long long frame, double score)
{
    struct timespec dt; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &dt);
    unsigned long long dnow = (unsigned long long)dt.tv_sec * 1000000ull + (unsigned long long)dt.tv_nsec / 1000ull;
    if (g_w_dumps >= W_S_MAX_DUMP) return;
    if (g_w_last_dump_us && dnow - g_w_last_dump_us <= 45000000ull) return;
    g_w_dumps++;
    g_w_last_dump_us = dnow;
    char path[160];
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "/data/storage/el2/base/files/m4bt_world%u.pam", g_w_dumps);
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "wb");
    if (!f) {
        vk_boot_logf("[w-yel] world dump FAIL %s errno=%d (%s) pick=%llu", path, errno,
                     strerror(errno), g_w_picks);
        return;
    }
    fprintf(f, "P7\nWIDTH %u\nHEIGHT %u\nDEPTH 4\nMAXVAL 255\nTUPLTYPE RGB_ALPHA\nENDHDR\n", w, h);
    const void *dump_px = g_blend_ready ? (const void *)g_blend_px : (const void *)g_w_rbmap;
    size_t nw = fwrite(dump_px, (size_t)w * h * 4, 1, f);
    fclose(f);
    vk_boot_logf("[w] world dump %s (%ux%u ok=%zu f=%llu att=%u score=%.3f blend=%d)", path, w, h,
                 nw, frame, g_w_att, score, g_blend_ready);
}

/* 整幅像素已在 g_w_rbmap：精确统计 → 复核签名/守卫 → 「更好」就接管（dump PAM + 上屏）。
   M4bt P1：refresh=1 表示「同一张源的新一帧」——不做「更好」比较、不换源，签名成立就照原通道上屏；
   签名不成立则**什么都不做**（上一帧留在屏上，不允许回退成黑/洋红）。 */
static void w_world_eval(VkImage img, const w_srcid *id, unsigned long long key, unsigned w, unsigned h,
                         int refresh, unsigned long long frame)
{
    if (!g_w_rbmap || !w || !h) return;
    const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)g_w_rbmap;
    const unsigned long long npx = (unsigned long long)w * h;
    unsigned long long colored = 0, sr = 0, sg = 0, sb = 0;
    unsigned mx[3] = { 0, 0, 0 };
    unsigned mn[3] = { 255, 255, 255 };
    unsigned long long hist[8]; memset(hist, 0, sizeof hist);
    for (unsigned long long i = 0; i < npx; i++) {
        const uint8_t *q = p + i * 4;
        unsigned r = q[0], g = q[1], bl = q[2];
        sr += r; sg += g; sb += bl;
        if (r || g || bl) colored++;
        if (r > mx[0]) mx[0] = r;
        if (g > mx[1]) mx[1] = g;
        if (bl > mx[2]) mx[2] = bl;
        if (r < mn[0]) mn[0] = r;
        if (g < mn[1]) mn[1] = g;
        if (bl < mn[2]) mn[2] = bl;
        unsigned lum = W_S_Y(r, g, bl);
        hist[lum >> 5]++;                    /* 8 档（亮度 Y）：M4bs 起不再用 max(r,g,b)，见 W_S_Y 注释 */
    }
    g_w_att++;
    g_w_img = img; g_w_key = key;
    const double col_pct = 100.0 * (double)colored / (double)npx;
    unsigned spread = 0;
    for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) { unsigned d = mx[c] - mn[c]; if (d > spread) spread = d; }
    const unsigned mean_rgb = (unsigned)((sr / npx + sg / npx + sb / npx) / 3ull);
    /* 守卫（都来自已确认事实）：
       · wipe  —— 整幅被抹白（三通道 min 都 ≥200）；
       · magenta —— 两通道输出（mxR/mxB≥64 ∧ mxG≤32），M4bj 实证不是画面。
       纯色/两档跳变/我们自己的对照三角一律由下面的三条件签名挡（M4bs 修 A）。 */
    const int wipe = (mn[0] >= 200u && mn[1] >= 200u && mn[2] >= 200u);
    const int magenta = (mx[0] >= 64u && mx[2] >= 64u && mx[1] <= 32u);
    char hb[80]; int o = 0; hb[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8 && o < (int)sizeof hb - 8; i++)
        o += snprintf(hb + o, sizeof hb - (size_t)o, "%s%u", i ? "," : "",
                      (unsigned)(100ull * hist[i] / (npx ? npx : 1)));
    int nb = 0; for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) if (hist[i]) nb++;
    /* M4bt P1：内容指纹（每 64 字节取 1 字节，FNV-1a）。用来**直接证明**"读到的确实是新帧"——
       同一 boot 内连续刷新出现不同 hash ⇒ 源在变（不依赖屏幕截图里的调试标记）。 */
    unsigned long long whash = 1469598103934665603ull;
    for (unsigned long long i = 0; i < npx * 4ull; i += 64)
        whash = (whash ^ (unsigned long long)((const uint8_t *)p)[i]) * 1099511628211ull;
    const int rej = w_sig_reject(spread, hist, npx, (unsigned)(sr / npx), (unsigned)(sg / npx),
                                 (unsigned)(sb / npx), mx[0], mx[1], mx[2]);
    if (rej || wipe || magenta) {
        g_w_rej++;
        /* M4bt P1：刷新帧签名不成立 ⇒ 保持上一帧（不换源、不清屏、不上传）。 */
        if (refresh && g_w_refresh_log < 200ull) {
            g_w_refresh_log++;
            vk_boot_logf("[w] world keep f=%llu why=%s img=%#llx colored=%.1f%% mean=%u/%u/%u spread=%u "
                         "(保持上一帧)", frame, w_sig_why(rej, wipe, magenta),
                         (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)img, col_pct,
                         (unsigned)(sr / npx), (unsigned)(sg / npx), (unsigned)(sb / npx), spread);
        }
        if (g_w_skp_lines < W_S_MAX_SKP) {
            g_w_skp_lines++;
            vk_boot_logf("[w] world skip why=%s img=%#llx at_draw=%llu colored=%.1f%% mean=%u/%u/%u "
                         "max=%u/%u/%u spread=%u nbuckets=%d hist8=%s",
                         w_sig_why(rej, wipe, magenta),
                         (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)img, g_w_at_draw, col_pct,
                         (unsigned)(sr / npx), (unsigned)(sg / npx), (unsigned)(sb / npx),
                         mx[0], mx[1], mx[2], spread, nb, hb);
        }
        return;
    }
    const double score = w_score(col_pct, spread, mean_rgb);
    /* M4bu P1：**内容轻判据** —— 同分替换时必须确认内容真的变了才上传（避免无意义重复上传）。
       口径（任务单给的下限）：任一通道 mean 差 > 2，或 hist8 有任何桶计数变化。 */
    int chg = !g_w_up_ok;
    {
        unsigned m3[3] = { (unsigned)(sr / npx), (unsigned)(sg / npx), (unsigned)(sb / npx) };
        for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
            unsigned d = m3[c] > g_w_up_mean[c] ? m3[c] - g_w_up_mean[c] : g_w_up_mean[c] - m3[c];
            if (d > 2u) chg = 1;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) if (hist[i] != g_w_up_hist[i]) chg = 1;
        for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) g_w_up_mean[c] = m3[c];
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) g_w_up_hist[i] = hist[i];
        g_w_up_ok = 1;
    }
    /* 身份：**读到的这一张**（texid+key+ext）从现在起就是已接管源的身份。img 只留在 g_w_best_img 里备查。 */
    if (id) { g_w_id = *id; g_w_id_ok = 1; }
    /* M4bt P1：刷新路径 —— 同一张源的新一帧，不做「更好」比较，直接上屏。 */
    if (refresh) {
        g_w_refresh++;
        g_w_best_col = col_pct; g_w_best_mean = mean_rgb; g_w_best_score = score;
        if (g_w_refresh <= W_S_REFRESH_LOG)
            vk_boot_logf("[w] world pick #%llu refresh f=%llu tick=%llu img=%#llx key=%08x ext=%ux%d "
                         "id=%d:%08x colored=%.1f%% mean=%u/%u/%u max=%u/%u/%u spread=%u nbuckets=%d "
                         "hist8=%s score=%.3f blend=%d chg=%d up=%d hash=%#llx (同源新帧)",
                         g_w_picks, frame, g_s_ticks, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)img,
                         (unsigned)(key & 0xffffffffull), w, h,
                         id ? id->texid : -1, (unsigned)((id ? id->key : 0ull) & 0xffffffffull),
                         col_pct, (unsigned)(sr / npx), (unsigned)(sg / npx), (unsigned)(sb / npx),
                         mx[0], mx[1], mx[2], spread, nb, hb, score, g_blend_ready,
                         chg, chg ? 1 : 0, whash);
        w_maybe_dump(w, h, frame, score);
        if (!chg) {                       /* 内容没变：不重复上传（屏幕保持，不是冻结证据） */
            g_w_unchg++;
            return;
        }
        p3_our_upload(g_blend_ready ? (const void *)g_blend_px : (const void *)p, w, h);
        return;
    }
    /* 「更好」判据已下沉到 w_scan_tick 的选源：调用方只在「同一份内容的新实例 / 分数明显更高」时
       才把新图交进来，所以这里**一律接管**。was_* 只作证据。 */
    const int better = 1;
    const double was_col = g_w_best_col; const unsigned was_mean = g_w_best_mean;
    const double was_score = g_w_best_score;
    const VkImage was_img = g_w_best_img;
    const w_srcid was_id = g_w_id; const int was_id_ok = g_w_id_ok;
    if (!better) {
        g_w_rej++;
        if (g_w_skp_lines < W_S_MAX_SKP) {
            g_w_skp_lines++;
            vk_boot_logf("[w] world skip why=worse img=%#llx colored=%.1f%% mean=%u/%u/%u "
                         "spread=%u score=%.3f best=%.3f", (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)img, col_pct,
                         (unsigned)(sr / npx), (unsigned)(sg / npx), (unsigned)(sb / npx),
                         spread, score, g_w_best_score);
        }
        return;
    }
    const int replaced = (g_w_picks > 0);
    g_w_picks++;
    g_w_best_col = col_pct; g_w_best_mean = mean_rgb; g_w_best_score = score;
    g_w_best_img = img; g_w_best_key = key;
    g_our_kind = 2;                          /* 2 = world-snap（present 的 src 名字） */
    if (g_w_picks <= W_S_MAX_LOG)
        vk_boot_logf("[w] world pick #%llu f=%llu img=%#llx key=%08x ext=%ux%d id=%d:%08x at_draw=%llu "
                     "colored=%.1f%% mean=%u/%u/%u max=%u/%u/%u spread=%u big_vs=%s big_fs=%s nv=%llu cnt=%llu "
                     "sig=3cond nbuckets=%d hist8=%s score=%.3f chg=%d",
                     g_w_picks, frame, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)img, (unsigned)(key & 0xffffffffull),
                     w, h, id ? id->texid : -1, (unsigned)((id ? id->key : 0ull) & 0xffffffffull), g_w_at_draw,
                     col_pct, (unsigned)(sr / npx), (unsigned)(sg / npx), (unsigned)(sb / npx),
                     mx[0], mx[1], mx[2], spread, g_w_bvs, g_w_bfs, g_w_nv, g_w_cnt,
                     nb, hb, score, chg);
    if (replaced)
        vk_boot_logf("[w] world pick replace #%llu why=%s img=%#llx id=%d:%08x colored=%.1f%% mean=%u/%u/%u "
                     "spread=%u score=%.3f (was %.1f%%/%u score=%.3f id=%d:%08x img=%#llx)",
                     g_w_picks, (id && was_id_ok && score > was_score + 0.03) ? "better" : "same",
                     (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)img,
                     id ? id->texid : -1, (unsigned)((id ? id->key : 0ull) & 0xffffffffull),
                     col_pct, (unsigned)(sr / npx), (unsigned)(sg / npx), (unsigned)(sb / npx),
                     spread, score, was_col, was_mean, was_score,
                     was_id_ok ? was_id.texid : -1, (unsigned)(was_id_ok ? (was_id.key & 0xffffffffull) : 0ull),
                     (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)was_img);
    w_maybe_dump(w, h, frame, score);
    if (!chg) { g_w_unchg++; return; }
    p3_our_upload(g_blend_ready ? (const void *)g_blend_px : (const void *)p, w, h);
}

/* M4bu P2（2026-11-04）：源图改成「被**大几何**（角色）写过的那张 RT」，按 **texid+key+ext** 认，
   不按槽号、不按内容特征（M4bt 的"暗但有结构"选法抓到的是一张 UI 遮罩，不是角色）。
   叠加：两张 1600×900 全屏、同位逐像素，权重 = 角色 RT 自己的 **alpha**（不硬编码坐标/阈值）。
   返回 1 = g_blend_px 可用（w_world_eval 会优先上传它）；0 = 没有可用 RT / alpha 不构成掩码 ⇒ 上屏场景原像素。 */
static unsigned g_char_dumps;      /* 角色 RT 整幅落盘次数（≤2） */
/* host 侧 PAM 落盘（证据 = 我们实际统计的那批字节，不经过 GPU 再读一次） */
static void w_dump_host_pam(const void *px, unsigned w, unsigned h, const char *path)
{
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "wb");
    if (!f) { vk_boot_logf("[w-yel] pam dump FAIL %s errno=%d (%s)", path, errno, strerror(errno)); return; }
    fprintf(f, "P7\nWIDTH %u\nHEIGHT %u\nDEPTH 4\nMAXVAL 255\nTUPLTYPE RGB_ALPHA\nENDHDR\n", w, h);
    size_t nw = fwrite(px, (size_t)w * h * 4u, 1, f);
    fclose(f);
    vk_boot_logf("[w] pam dump %s (%ux%u ok=%zu)", path, w, h, nw);
}
/* ---- M39N（2026-11-09）：present 源图 dump 开关 + PAM 落盘包装 ----
   目的：把「present 选源确定之后、真正要拷去上屏的那张图」在指定 draws 门槛上落成 PAM，
   与同刻 gameRT 的 PAM（logs/m39m_b1/smo_w2.pam）与同刻屏幕截图三方对照，判定红底花屏
   到底坏在「渲染产出侧」还是「拷贝/缩放/上屏侧」。
   实现**不新增任何 Vulkan 代码**：直接复用既有回读原语 c_raw_copy()
   （自带 原布局→TRANSFER_SRC→copy→回原布局 的 barrier、一次性 submit + fence 等待，
     在 present 时刻已由 r_tex_signature()/m4ak_probe()/24772 处长期验证可用），
   本函数只补 P7/RGBA 头与自校验日志（bytes/expect/payload）。
   开关语义：`smo_w2_pres=<draws 门槛>`，0/-1 = 关；hdc 只能改值不能新建 ⇒ 文件由 p_file_seed 建出，
   且每 16 次 present 重读一次（只在 init 缓存会读成 -1 永远不触发）。
   ⚠ M39N boot#3 实证：app 侧 fopen("/data/app/el2/100/base/...") = ENOENT（那是 hdc 的看法），
   应用只能写沙箱别名 /data/storage/el2/base/files/...（同一物理目录，hdc 从 /data/app 侧取）。
   故这里**按顺序试两个前缀**，日志回报真正落成的那个（与 d_readback 的 used/alt 回退同思路）。 */
#define W2P_A "/data/storage/el2/base/files/smo_w2_pres"
#define W2P_B "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files/smo_w2_pres"
#define W2P_DIR_SB "/data/storage/el2/base/files"                  /* app 侧可写（沙箱别名） */
#define W2P_DIR_PK "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"    /* hdc 侧取文件用（同一目录） */
static const char *m39n_dump_pam(VkImage img, VkImageLayout lay, unsigned w, unsigned h, const char *base)
{
    static char used[224];
    used[0] = 0;
    if (!img || !w || !h) { vk_boot_logf("[d] rb W2pres FAIL no-img ext=%ux%u", w, h); return used; }
    const VkDeviceSize sz = (VkDeviceSize)w * (VkDeviceSize)h * 4u;
    void *px = c_raw_copy(img, lay, w, h, sz);
    if (!px) { vk_boot_logf("[d] rb W2pres FAIL raw_copy lay=%d ext=%ux%u", (int)lay, w, h); return used; }
    char p1[224], p2[224];
    snprintf(p1, sizeof p1, "%s/%s", W2P_DIR_SB, base);
    snprintf(p2, sizeof p2, "%s/%s", W2P_DIR_PK, base);
    FILE *f = fopen(p1, "wb");
    const char *pick = p1;
    if (!f) { f = fopen(p2, "wb"); pick = p2; }
    if (!f) {
        vk_boot_logf("[d] rb W2pres FAIL fopen both errno=%d (%s) a=%s b=%s",
                     errno, strerror(errno), p1, p2);
        free(px); return used;
    }
    char hdr[96];
    int hlen = snprintf(hdr, sizeof hdr,
                        "P7\nWIDTH %u\nHEIGHT %u\nDEPTH 4\nMAXVAL 255\nTUPLTYPE RGB_ALPHA\nENDHDR\n", w, h);
    size_t wrote = 0;
    if (hlen > 0) wrote += fwrite(hdr, 1, (size_t)hlen, f);
    wrote += fwrite(px, 1, (size_t)sz, f);
    fclose(f);
    snprintf(used, sizeof used, "%s", pick);
    vk_boot_logf("[d] rb W2pres pam bytes=%llu expect=%llu payload=%llu lay=%d ext=%ux%u path=%s",
                 (unsigned long long)wrote, (unsigned long long)((VkDeviceSize)hlen + sz),
                 (unsigned long long)sz, (int)lay, w, h, used);
    free(px);
    return used;
}
static int w_try_blend(VkImage scene, unsigned w, unsigned h,
                       unsigned long long frame, unsigned long long tick)
{
    g_blend_ready = 0;
    if (!g_w_rbmap) return 0;
    /* ① 按**身份**在表里找「大几何写过的那张」当前在哪一槽（槽号会轮转/驱逐，身份不会）。 */
    int idx = -1; VkImage ci_img = VK_NULL_HANDLE; const char *whysrc = "-";
    if (g_big_id_ok) {
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < W_W_NTAB; i++) {
            h_rt_slot *s = &g_rt_tab[i];
            w_srcid sid;
            if (!s->key || !s->img) continue;
            sid.texid = (int)s->tex_id; sid.key = s->key; sid.w = s->w; sid.h = s->h;
            if (w_srcid_eq(&sid, &g_big_id)) { idx = (int)i; ci_img = s->img; whysrc = "bigid"; break; }
        }
    }
    if (idx < 0 && g_dark_img) {          /* 退路：上一轮的"暗"候选（只为日志可比，不优先） */
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < W_W_NTAB; i++)
            if (g_rt_tab[i].key && g_rt_tab[i].img == g_dark_img &&
                g_rt_tab[i].w == W_S_W && g_rt_tab[i].h == W_S_H) { idx = (int)i; ci_img = g_dark_img; whysrc = "dark"; break; }
    }
    if (idx < 0 || !ci_img || ci_img == scene) {
        g_blend_skip++;
        if (g_blend_skip <= 6)
            vk_boot_logf("[w] blend skip why=%s frame=%llu bigid=%s (角色 RT 不在表里/就是场景本身)",
                         idx < 0 ? "noimg" : "same", frame, g_big_id_ok ? "have" : "none");
        return 0;
    }
    if (!w_read_img_to(ci_img, g_rt_tab[idx].layout, w, h,
                       &g_c_rb, &g_c_rbm, &g_c_rbmap, &g_c_rbsz)) { g_blend_skip++; return 0; }
    const unsigned char *c = (const unsigned char *)g_c_rbmap;
    const unsigned char *s = (const unsigned char *)g_w_rbmap;
    if (!c || !s) { g_blend_skip++; return 0; }
    const size_t npx = (size_t)w * h;
    /* ② alpha 分布（8 档）+ 中间值占比 + 掩码 bbox。**先统计再决定**，不猜阈值。 */
    unsigned long long ah[8]; memset(ah, 0, sizeof ah);
    unsigned long long a0 = 0, af = 0, ap = 0;
    unsigned long long bx0 = w, by0 = h, bx1 = 0, by1 = 0, amask = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < npx; i++) {
        unsigned a = c[i * 4u + 3u];
        ah[a >> 5]++;
        if (!a) a0++; else if (a == 255) af++; else ap++;
        if (a) {
            amask++;
            unsigned x = (unsigned)(i % w), y = (unsigned)(i / w);
            if (x < bx0) bx0 = x; if (x > bx1) bx1 = x;
            if (y < by0) by0 = y; if (y > by1) by1 = y;
        }
    }
    /* 角色 RT 每 boot 落 ≤2 张（证据：人眼能直接看这张到底画了什么） */
    if (g_char_dumps < 2) {
        char cp[160];
        g_char_dumps++;
        snprintf(cp, sizeof cp, "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files/m4bu_char%u.pam", g_char_dumps);
        vk_boot_logf("[w] char dump #%u src=%s texid=%d key=%#llx slot=%d ext=%ux%u a0=%.1f%% a255=%.1f%% apart=%.1f%%",
                     g_char_dumps, whysrc, g_big_id.texid,
                     (unsigned long long)g_big_id.key, idx, w, h,
                     100.0 * (double)a0 / (double)npx, 100.0 * (double)af / (double)npx,
                     100.0 * (double)ap / (double)npx);
        w_dump_host_pam(c, w, h, cp);
    }
    /* ③ 诚实门（M4bu 修正）：**只**在「全不透明」或「全透明」时拒绝。
       M4bt 的门写成「0 与 255 两端合计 ≥99.5% ⇒ 无掩码」，会把**二值掩码**（一部分 0、一部分 255）
       也误判成无掩码。二值掩码本身就是合法权重。 */
    if (af >= npx - npx / 200u) {
        if (g_blend_log < 3000) {
            g_blend_log++;
            vk_boot_logf("[w] blend skip why=nomasks f=%llu src=%s texid=%d key=%#llx a255=%.1f%% "
                         "a0=%.2f%% (alpha 全不透明 ⇒ 按 alpha 叠加=整张替换，不做)",
                         frame, whysrc, g_big_id.texid, (unsigned long long)g_big_id.key,
                         100.0 * (double)af / (double)npx, 100.0 * (double)a0 / (double)npx);
        }
        g_blend_skip++;
        return 0;
    }
    if (a0 >= npx - npx / 200u) { g_blend_skip++; return 0; }
    if (!g_blend_px && !(g_blend_px = (unsigned char *)malloc(npx * 4u))) { g_blend_skip++; return 0; }
    unsigned long long changed = 0, cs[3] = { 0, 0, 0 }, cn = 0;
    unsigned long long cx0 = w, cy0 = h, cx1 = 0, cy1 = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < npx; i++) {
        const unsigned char *cq = c + i * 4u;
        const unsigned char *sq = s + i * 4u;
        unsigned a = cq[3];
        if (a) { cs[0] += cq[0]; cs[1] += cq[1]; cs[2] += cq[2]; cn++; }
        unsigned char *dq = g_blend_px + i * 4u;
        int diff = 0;
        for (int ch = 0; ch < 3; ch++) {
            unsigned v = ((unsigned)sq[ch] * (255u - a) + (unsigned)cq[ch] * a) / 255u;
            unsigned char o = (unsigned char)(v > 255u ? 255u : v);
            if (o != sq[ch]) { changed++; diff = 1; }
            dq[ch] = o;
        }
        dq[3] = 255;
        if (diff) {
            unsigned x = (unsigned)(i % w), y = (unsigned)(i / w);
            if (x < cx0) cx0 = x; if (x > cx1) cx1 = x;
            if (y < cy0) cy0 = y; if (y > cy1) cy1 = y;
        }
    }
    g_blend_ready = 1; g_blend_n++; g_blend_chg_last = changed;
    if (g_blend_log < 3000) {
        char hb[80]; int o = 0; hb[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 8 && o < (int)sizeof hb - 8; i++)
            o += snprintf(hb + o, sizeof hb - (size_t)o, "%s%.0f", i ? "," : "",
                          100.0 * (double)ah[i] / (double)npx);
        g_blend_log++;
        vk_boot_logf("[w] blend f=%llu tick=%llu src=%s texid=%d key=%#llx slot=%d img=%#llx "
                     "mask=%.2f%% a0=%.1f%% a255=%.1f%% apart=%.2f%% ah8=%s changed=%.2f%% "
                     "bbox(mask)=%llu,%llu..%llu,%llu bbox(changed)=%llu,%llu..%llu,%llu "
                     "rgb_in_a=%.0f/%.0f/%.0f (#%llu skip=%llu)",
                     frame, tick, whysrc, g_big_id.texid, (unsigned long long)g_big_id.key, idx,
                     (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)ci_img,
                     100.0 * (double)amask / (double)npx,
                     100.0 * (double)a0 / (double)npx, 100.0 * (double)af / (double)npx,
                     100.0 * (double)ap / (double)npx, hb,
                     100.0 * (double)changed / (double)(npx * 3u),
                     bx0, by0, bx1, by1, cx0, cy0, cx1, cy1,
                     cn ? (double)cs[0] / (double)cn : 0.0, cn ? (double)cs[1] / (double)cn : 0.0,
                     cn ? (double)cs[2] / (double)cn : 0.0, g_blend_n, g_blend_skip);
    }
    return 1;
}

/* 每个 flush 调一次（≈每帧，栅栏已等到）：轮转扫 4 张 1600x900 游戏 RT → 稀疏签名 →
   成立且更好才整幅回读。无任何单点身份。 */
static void w_scan_tick(void)
{
    if (!g_on || !g_dev || !g_q || !g_h_cp) return;
    struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    unsigned long long now = (unsigned long long)ts.tv_sec * 1000000ull + (unsigned long long)ts.tv_nsec / 1000ull;
    g_s_ticks++;
    VkImage imgs[W_S_PER_TICK]; VkImageLayout lays[W_S_PER_TICK]; unsigned sidx[W_S_PER_TICK];
    w_srcid ids[W_S_PER_TICK];
    unsigned n = 0, i = g_s_rr % W_W_NTAB, looked = 0;
    /* ① M4bu P1：先找**已接管源的身份**（texid+key+ext）在表里的哪一槽 —— 找的是身份不是 img，
       所以池图重建（新 img/新槽位）也能命中；它也不受陈旧门约束（内容我们已经信任过一次）。 */
    {
        int a = -1;
        if (g_w_id_ok) {
            for (unsigned q = 0; q < W_W_NTAB; q++) {
                h_rt_slot *sq = &g_rt_tab[q];
                w_srcid sid;
                if (!sq->key || !sq->img) continue;
                sid.texid = (int)sq->tex_id; sid.key = sq->key; sid.w = sq->w; sid.h = sq->h;
                if (w_srcid_eq(&sid, &g_w_id)) { a = (int)q; break; }
            }
        }
        if (a >= 0) {
            h_rt_slot *s = &g_rt_tab[a];
            VkAccessFlags acc; VkPipelineStageFlags st;
            if (s->w != W_S_W || s->h != W_S_H) { g_w_layskip++; }
            else if (!w_lay_acc(s->layout, &acc, &st)) { g_w_layskip++; }
            else if (w_is_self(s->img)) { g_s_self_skips++; }
            else { imgs[n] = s->img; lays[n] = s->layout; sidx[n] = (unsigned)a; n++; }
        }
    }
    while (looked < W_W_NTAB && n < W_S_PER_TICK) {
        h_rt_slot *s = &g_rt_tab[i];
        int dup = 0;
        for (unsigned q = 0; q < n; q++) if (imgs[q] == s->img && s->img) { dup = 1; break; }
        if (!dup && s->key && s->img && s->w == W_S_W && s->h == W_S_H &&
            g_s_ticks - g_s_last_draw[i] <= W_S_STALE_TICKS) {
            VkAccessFlags acc; VkPipelineStageFlags st;
            if (!w_lay_acc(s->layout, &acc, &st)) { g_w_layskip++; }
            else if (w_is_self(s->img)) { g_s_self_skips++; }   /* 我们自己的合成几何写过它 */
            else { imgs[n] = s->img; lays[n] = s->layout; sidx[n] = i; n++; }
        }
        i = (i + 1u) % W_W_NTAB;
        looked++;
    }
    g_s_rr = i;
    for (unsigned k = 0; k < n; k++) {
        h_rt_slot *s = &g_rt_tab[sidx[k]];
        ids[k].texid = (int)s->tex_id; ids[k].key = s->key; ids[k].w = s->w; ids[k].h = s->h;
    }
    g_w_cand_slots = n;
    double col[W_S_PER_TICK]; double sc[W_S_PER_TICK]; unsigned meanr[W_S_PER_TICK];
    unsigned meanc[W_S_PER_TICK][3];
    unsigned sprd[W_S_PER_TICK]; unsigned brgt[W_S_PER_TICK];
    int okv[W_S_PER_TICK]; const char *whyk[W_S_PER_TICK]; unsigned nbk[W_S_PER_TICK];
    int best = -1; double bcol = 0; unsigned bmean = 0;   /* bcol = 本 tick 最高内容分数 */
    if (!n) { g_w_keep_noop++; return; }
    {
        w_sig sig_w[W_S_PER_TICK];
        if (!w_probe_sparse(imgs, lays, n, W_S_W, W_S_H, sig_w)) return;
        g_s_probes += n;
        for (unsigned k = 0; k < n; k++) {
            w_sig *g = &sig_w[k];
            const unsigned long long np = g->npx ? g->npx : 1ull;
            sc[k] = 0.0; okv[k] = 0; whyk[k] = "?";
            col[k] = 100.0 * (double)g->nz / (double)np;
            meanc[k][0] = (unsigned)(g->sum[0] / np);
            meanc[k][1] = (unsigned)(g->sum[1] / np);
            meanc[k][2] = (unsigned)(g->sum[2] / np);
            meanr[k] = (meanc[k][0] + meanc[k][1] + meanc[k][2]) / 3u;
            unsigned sp = 0;
            for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) { unsigned d = g->mx[c] - g->mn[c]; if (d > sp) sp = d; }
            sprd[k] = sp;
            brgt[k] = g->mx[0] > g->mx[1] ? (g->mx[0] > g->mx[2] ? g->mx[0] : g->mx[2])
                                          : (g->mx[1] > g->mx[2] ? g->mx[1] : g->mx[2]);
            const int wipe = (g->mn[0] >= 200u && g->mn[1] >= 200u && g->mn[2] >= 200u);
            const int magenta = (g->mx[0] >= 64u && g->mx[2] >= 64u && g->mx[1] <= 32u);
            /* M4bs 修 A：三条件签名（spread≥64 ∧ hist8 非空桶≥3 ∧ 不是我们探针的指纹）。 */
            const int mr = (unsigned)(g->sum[0] / np), mg = (unsigned)(g->sum[1] / np),
                      mb = (unsigned)(g->sum[2] / np);
            const int rej = w_sig_reject(sp, g->hist, np, (unsigned)mr, (unsigned)mg, (unsigned)mb,
                                         g->mx[0], g->mx[1], g->mx[2]);
            int nb = 0; for (int q = 0; q < 8; q++) if (g->hist[q]) nb++;
            nbk[k] = (unsigned)nb;
            const int okc = (rej == 0) && !wipe && !magenta;
            whyk[k] = w_sig_why(rej, wipe, magenta);
            /* M4bu P1【诊断】：按原因累计拒收（M4bt b3 的 8 条 skip 配额被开局一张灰图吃光，
               之后 400 s 里"到底哪条门在拒"完全没有证据）。这条只计数，不改判据。 */
            if (rej == 1) g_w_rj_ls++; else if (rej == 2) g_w_rj_lh++; else if (rej == 3) g_w_rj_fp++;
            else if (rej == 4) g_w_rj_fl++; else if (rej == 5) g_w_rj_cl++;
            else if (wipe) g_w_rj_wp++; else if (magenta) g_w_rj_mg++;
            /* M4bt P3 取证：暗但有结构（mean<60 ∧ colored>5% ∧ spread≥16）的 RT 记下来 ——
               这条**不要求**通过三条件签名（角色 RT 常因"暗 + 桶少"过不了三条件），只用于落 PAM 人眼判读。 */
            if (meanr[k] < 60u && col[k] > 5.0 && sp >= 16u) {
                g_dark_img = imgs[k]; g_dark_slot = sidx[k];
                g_dark_seen_us = now;
            }
            if (!okc) {
                /* M4bu P1【取证】：**有结构但被拒**的候选整幅落盘（≤2 张/boot，同一身份不重复）。
                   M4bt 的教训是"屏幕已经错了才拿到判据"；这条让我们在还没接管时就能人眼看到
                   「被拒的那张到底是什么」。 */
                if (g_w_cand_dumps < 2 && sp >= W_S_MIN_SPREAD && nb >= W_S_MIN_BUCKETS &&
                    (!g_w_cand_dumps || !w_srcid_eq(&ids[k], &g_w_cand_last))) {
                    char cp[160];
                    g_w_cand_dumps++; g_w_cand_last = ids[k];
                    snprintf(cp, sizeof cp, "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files/m4bu_cand%u.pam",
                             g_w_cand_dumps);
                    vk_boot_logf("[w] cand dump #%u slot=%u id=%d:%08x mean=%u/%u/%u sp=%u nb=%u why=%s "
                                 "(有结构但被拒 ⇒ 整幅落盘供人眼判读)",
                                 g_w_cand_dumps, sidx[k], ids[k].texid,
                                 (unsigned)(ids[k].key & 0xffffffffull),
                                 meanc[k][0], meanc[k][1], meanc[k][2], sp, nb, whyk[k]);
                    p_dump_slot_pam((int)sidx[k], cp);
                }
                /* 跳过行：第 1 个 tick 全打，之后**按时间**限流（≥8 s 一条，总配额 24）——
                   旧口径（总数 8 条）在开局就被全黑槽吃光，后半程无证据。 */
                const int interesting = (col[k] > 5.0 || sp >= W_S_MIN_SPREAD);
                if (g_w_skp_lines < 24 && (interesting || g_s_ticks <= 1) &&
                    (!g_w_last_skp_us || now - g_w_last_skp_us > 8000000ull || g_s_ticks <= 1)) {
                    g_w_skp_lines++;
                    g_w_last_skp_us = now;
                    vk_boot_logf("[w] world skip why=%s img=%#llx slot=%u id=%d:%08x colored=%.1f%% "
                                 "mean=%u/%u/%u max=%u/%u/%u spread=%u nbuckets=%d (sparse 16x16)",
                                 w_sig_why(rej, wipe, magenta),
                                 (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)imgs[k], sidx[k],
                                 ids[k].texid, (unsigned)(ids[k].key & 0xffffffffull),
                                 col[k], (unsigned)mr, (unsigned)mg, (unsigned)mb,
                                 g->mx[0], g->mx[1], g->mx[2], sp, nb);
                }
                continue;
            }
            const double sco = w_score(col[k], sp, meanr[k]);
            sc[k] = sco;
            /* M4bt P1【修】上屏候选必须"看得见"（mean ≥ W_S_MIN_MEAN）。boot#1 实证：
               那张 mean=11/11/11 的暗 RT 分数只比世界图低 ~0.04（colored=100% + spread 满），
               池图一换就会被它顶上屏 ⇒ 整片近黑。暗 RT 只作 P3 的叠加层，不作上屏源。 */
            if (meanr[k] < W_S_MIN_MEAN) { g_w_dim++; g_w_rj_qdim++; whyk[k] = "dim"; continue; }
            okv[k] = 1;
            if (best < 0 || sco > bcol) { best = (int)k; bcol = sco; bmean = meanr[k]; }
        }
    }
    /* M4bu P1【诊断】：周期性候选表（≥30 s 一条、每 boot ≤14 条）—— 直接回答「4 张候选各是什么、
       为什么过/不过」，不再靠猜。同时打「表里还活着多少张 RT / 其中多少是 1600x900」，
       用来判「世界 RT 是不是换了分辨率或被驱逐」。 */
    if (g_w_cand_lines < 14 && (!g_w_last_cand_us || now - g_w_last_cand_us > 30000000ull)) {
        char ln[640]; int lo = 0; ln[0] = 0;
        unsigned live_all = 0, live_16 = 0, live_16_drawn = 0;
        for (unsigned q = 0; q < W_W_NTAB; q++) {
            h_rt_slot *s = &g_rt_tab[q];
            if (!s->key || !s->img) continue;
            live_all++;
            if (s->w == W_S_W && s->h == W_S_H) {
                live_16++;
                if (g_s_ticks - g_s_last_draw[q] <= W_S_STALE_TICKS) live_16_drawn++;
            }
        }
        for (unsigned k = 0; k < n && lo < (int)sizeof ln - 130; k++) {
            lo += snprintf(ln + lo, sizeof ln - (size_t)lo,
                           "%s[%u t%d k%08x %ux%u mean=%u/%u/%u avg=%u sp=%u nb=%u col=%.0f %s%s]",
                           k ? " " : "", sidx[k], ids[k].texid,
                           (unsigned)(ids[k].key & 0xffffffffull), ids[k].w, ids[k].h,
                           meanc[k][0], meanc[k][1], meanc[k][2], meanr[k],
                           sprd[k], nbk[k], col[k], okv[k] ? "OK" : whyk[k],
                           (g_big_id_ok && w_srcid_eq(&ids[k], &g_big_id)) ? " BIG" : "");
        }
        g_w_last_cand_us = now; g_w_cand_lines++;
        vk_boot_logf("[w] world cand n=%u adopted=%s best=%d score=%.3f live=%u/16=%u/16drawn=%u :: %s",
                     n, g_w_id_ok ? "have" : "none", best, bcol,
                     live_all, live_16, live_16_drawn, ln);
    }
    if (g_w_log_lines < W_S_MAX_LOG && (best >= 0 || (g_s_ticks % 60u) == 0u)) {
        g_w_log_lines++;
        vk_boot_logf("[w] world scan f=%llu tried=%u best_img=%#llx slot=%u id=%d:%08x colored=%.1f%% "
                     "mean=%u/%u/%u spread=%u score=%.3f full=%llu picks=%llu (ticks=%llu probes=%llu "
                     "layskip=%u self=%u)",
                     r_frame_now(), n,
                     (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)(best >= 0 ? imgs[best] : imgs[0]),
                     best >= 0 ? sidx[best] : sidx[0],
                     ids[best >= 0 ? best : 0].texid,
                     (unsigned)(ids[best >= 0 ? best : 0].key & 0xffffffffull),
                     best >= 0 ? col[best] : col[0],
                     best >= 0 ? meanr[best] : meanr[0], best >= 0 ? meanr[best] : meanr[0],
                     best >= 0 ? meanr[best] : meanr[0],
                     best >= 0 ? sprd[best] : sprd[0],
                     best >= 0 ? sc[best] : sc[0],
                     g_w_caps, g_w_picks, g_s_ticks, g_s_probes, g_w_layskip, g_s_self_skips);
    }
    /* 每 60 s 一条自检：扫描链走到哪、预算用了多少。M4bu：新增按原因的拒收计数与「内容未变跳过上传」。 */
    if (!g_w_last_stat_us || now - g_w_last_stat_us > 60000000ull) {
        g_w_last_stat_us = now;
        vk_boot_logf("[w] world stat ticks=%llu probes=%llu full=%llu/%u att=%u rej=%llu layskip=%u "
                     "self=%u picks=%llu refresh=%llu clamps=%llu dim=%llu blend=%llu bskip=%llu "
                     "unchg=%llu lowsc=%llu rj=%llu/%llu/%llu/%llu/%llu/%llu/%llu/%llu "
                     "best=%.1f%%/%u score=%.3f (t=%.0fs)",
                     g_s_ticks, g_s_probes, g_w_caps, (unsigned)W_S_MAX_FULL, g_w_att, g_w_rej,
                     g_w_layskip, g_s_self_skips, g_w_picks, g_w_refresh, g_w_keep_noop, g_w_dim,
                     g_blend_n, g_blend_skip, g_w_unchg, g_w_lowsc,
                     g_w_rj_ls, g_w_rj_lh, g_w_rj_fp, g_w_rj_fl, g_w_rj_cl, g_w_rj_wp, g_w_rj_mg, g_w_rj_qdim,
                     g_w_best_col, g_w_best_mean, g_w_best_score,
                     (double)(now / 1000000ull));
    }
    /* M4bt P3（取证，不改上屏内容）：暗 RT 每 boot 落 ≤3 张，间隔 ≥40 s，看它是不是整幅单色。
       走 p_dump_slot_pam（自带 buffer/一次性 submit），只在扫描线程调用。 */
    if (g_dark_img && g_dark_dumps < 3 && now - g_dark_seen_us < 2000000ull) {
        static unsigned long long last_dark_dump_us;
        if (!last_dark_dump_us || now - last_dark_dump_us > 40000000ull) {
            char dp[160];
            last_dark_dump_us = now;
            g_dark_dumps++;
            snprintf(dp, sizeof dp, "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files/m4bu_dark%u.pam", g_dark_dumps);
            vk_boot_logf("[w] dark dump #%u img=%#llx slot=%u (暗但有结构，整幅落盘供人眼判读)",
                         g_dark_dumps, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_dark_img, g_dark_slot);
            p_dump_slot_pam((int)g_dark_slot, dp);
        }
    }
    /* ---- 选「本 tick 要回读的那张」（M4bu P1 新口径）----
       ① 已接管源的**身份**在本 tick 候选里 ⇒ 无条件刷新：不看 img、不看分数、不看迟滞；
       ② 否则取本 tick 分数最高的可见候选，按**同分替换**接受（score ≥ 已接管分数 − 1e-3）；
       ③ 明显更好（> +0.03）才当「换源」（pick #n+1，日志里 why=better）；
       ④ 都不满足 ⇒ 保持上一帧 + 记 lowsc（证据：是不是"分数低于已接管源"卡住）。 */
    int want = -1, refresh = 0, idhit = 0;
    for (unsigned k = 0; k < n; k++) {
        if (g_w_id_ok && okv[k] && w_srcid_eq(&ids[k], &g_w_id)) { want = (int)k; refresh = 1; idhit = 1; break; }
    }
    if (want < 0 && best >= 0) {
        if (!g_w_id_ok) { want = best; refresh = 0; }
        else if (bcol >= g_w_best_score - 1e-3) { want = best; refresh = 1; }
        else if (bcol > g_w_best_score + 0.03) { want = best; refresh = 0; }
        else { g_w_lowsc++; if (g_w_lowsc <= 6) vk_boot_logf("[w] world keep why=lowscore n=%u best=%.3f "
                                                             "adopted=%.3f (不换源也不刷新)", n, bcol, g_w_best_score); }
    }
    if (want < 0) { g_w_keep_noop++; return; }
    if (g_w_caps >= W_S_MAX_FULL) return;                 /* 防爆阀：只扫不回读 */
    if (g_w_last_full_us && now - g_w_last_full_us < W_S_MIN_FULL_US) return;   /* 限流：≈2.5 次/s */
    g_w_last_full_us = now;
    {
        const int k = want;
        g_w_src_slot = (int)sidx[k];
        g_w_at_draw = g_r_draws;
        if (!w_full_read(imgs[k], lays[k], W_S_W, W_S_H)) return;
        /* P2：整幅场景已在 g_w_rbmap ⇒ 若有「大几何（角色）写过的 RT」，按**它自己的 alpha** 叠上去。
           叠加成功时 w_world_eval 上传的是 g_blend_px（否则上传场景原像素）。 */
        w_try_blend(imgs[k], W_S_W, W_S_H, r_frame_now(), g_s_ticks);
        w_world_eval(imgs[k], &ids[k], g_rt_tab[sidx[k]].key, W_S_W, W_S_H, refresh, r_frame_now());
    }
}

/* ---- M4ag P1/P2 状态（2026-11-04）----
   g_p_tex_key = 游戏在 nvnQueuePresentTexture 里指定的那张窗口纹理的**存储身份**（池数据地址，
   与 h_rt_slot.key 同口径），由 gfx_bridge 每次 present 前写入；
   g_p_dump_n = 「游戏指定槽」落盘次数（每 boot ≤2 张，5.76MB/张）。
   定义放在 r_rt_sig_tick 之前：快照那一刻内容才活着，落盘钩子必须在快照里打。 */
static unsigned long long g_p_tex_key;
static unsigned g_p_tex_w, g_p_tex_h;
static int g_p_tex_id = -1, g_p_tex_idx = -1;
static unsigned long long g_p_dump_n;
static int p_slot_by_key(unsigned long long key, h_rt_slot **out);
static void p_dump_slot_pam(int idx, const char *path);
static int p_file_int(const char *a, const char *b, int def);
/* 诊断文件路径（应用启动时先建出 -1 的缺省文件，hdc 才能覆盖它做 A/B）。 */
#define P_SLOT_DIR_A "/data/storage/el2/base/files"
#define P_SLOT_DIR_B "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files"
#define P_OVR_A P_SLOT_DIR_A "/smo_present_slot"
#define P_OVR_B P_SLOT_DIR_B "/smo_present_slot"
#define P_DMP_A P_SLOT_DIR_A "/smo_dump_slot"
#define P_DMP_B P_SLOT_DIR_B "/smo_dump_slot"
#define P_P2_A P_SLOT_DIR_A "/smo_p2_slot"
#define P_P2_B P_SLOT_DIR_B "/smo_p2_slot"
/* M4al P2：`smo_snap_present` —— 「present 送内容快照」的总开关（缺省开；推 0 退回旧链做 A/B）。 */
#define P_SNAP_A P_SLOT_DIR_A "/smo_snap_present"
#define P_SNAP_B P_SLOT_DIR_B "/smo_snap_present"
/* M4bc P3：`smo_our_present` —— present 优先送「**我们自己渲染**的那张图」（phase3 B 变体回读上传的
   1600×900）。缺省开；推 0 即退回 snap/旧链做 A/B，无需重编。 */
#define P_OUR_A P_SLOT_DIR_A "/smo_our_present"
#define P_OUR_B P_SLOT_DIR_B "/smo_our_present"
/* M4bi P2：`smo_present_gain` —— 上屏那一份像素的合成曝光系数（缺省 1=关；>1 只改屏幕，不改游戏 RT）。 */
#define P_GAIN_A P_SLOT_DIR_A "/smo_present_gain"
#define P_GAIN_B P_SLOT_DIR_B "/smo_present_gain"
/* M4bf P1：`smo_game_rt` —— `ours` 的像素来源（1=游戏本帧颜色 RT，0=旧的单笔 debug RT）。 */
#define P_GAMERT_A P_SLOT_DIR_A "/smo_game_rt"
#define P_GAMERT_B P_SLOT_DIR_B "/smo_game_rt"
/* M4bv P1：`smo_gpres` —— present 源 = **游戏自己 present 的那张纹理**（缺省 1=开）。
   推 0 完整退回 M4bu 的旁路链（ours/world-snap/snap/…）做 A/B，无需重编。 */
#define P_GPRES_A P_SLOT_DIR_A "/smo_gpres"
#define P_GPRES_B P_SLOT_DIR_B "/smo_gpres"
static int p2_slot_file(void);

/* M4z：阶段 2 的扳机 —— 由 r_rt_sig_tick 在「内容 RT 第一次判到有画面」时置位，
   下一次「写进那张内容 RT 的全屏 quad」被捕获并重放 A~H。
   为什么不能在首笔 draw 上做：M4y 实测首笔时刻源纹理还是空的（D=全黑），色带是在之后若干帧才出现的。 */
static int g_p2_arm;
static int g_p2_want;   /* 1 = 等下一笔「写内容 RT 的 quad」 */
/* M4ai P4①：**g_drawcap 是单槽**——M4ah 实测 `arm-by-slot` 每笔 slot 9 的 draw 都重写 cap
   （#636/#637/#638…），紧接着 phase2 的 want2 又把它覆盖成别的 draw，于是真正跑 A~J 的
   不是「写指定槽的那一笔」。这里在按槽扳机**一旦命中**就置位，后续 phase2/按槽都不再覆盖 cap。 */
static int g_p2_armed;
static VkImage g_p2_tgt;/* 置位时的内容 RT 图（只为日志/判读留证） */

static void r_rt_sig_tick(unsigned long long frame, unsigned long long batch_draws)
{
    if (!g_on || !g_dev || !g_q || !g_h_img) return;
    if (g_h_layout != VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL) return;   /* 只有附件态才代表「画完的 RT」 */
    if (g_rt_w == 0 || g_rt_h == 0) return;
    struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    unsigned long long now = (unsigned long long)ts.tv_sec * 1000000ull + (unsigned long long)ts.tv_nsec / 1000ull;
    if (g_rt_sig_last_us && now - g_rt_sig_last_us < R_RT_SIG_MIN_US) return;
    r_sig_t sg;
