    vk_boot_logf("[m37a] t0 draws=%llu decl=%llu banks=%llu off0=%llu (%.2f%%) | fs_banks=%llu fs_off0=%llu "
                 "(%.2f%%) | whole_draw_off0=%llu/%llu | whole_fs_off0=%llu/%llu | t1=%u t2=%u t3=%u",
                 g_m37a_draws_seen, g_m37a_draw_decl, g_m37a_bank_decl, g_m37a_bank_off0,
                 g_m37a_bank_decl ? 100.0 * (double)g_m37a_bank_off0 / (double)g_m37a_bank_decl : 0.0,
                 g_m37a_fsbank_decl, g_m37a_fsbank_off0,
                 g_m37a_fsbank_decl ? 100.0 * (double)g_m37a_fsbank_off0 / (double)g_m37a_fsbank_decl : 0.0,
                 g_m37a_draw_off0_all, g_m37a_draw_decl,
                 g_m37a_draw_fs_off0_all, g_m37a_draw_fsdecl, g_m37a_t1, g_m37a_t2, g_m37a_t3);
}
/* ================= M38C C（2026-11-09，纯只读取证）：上游 RT #29（id 1937）为什么恒白 =================
   背景（M36A/M37A 已证的事实）：slot#29 = 800x450，被 76–78 笔 × 3 顶点全屏 blit 写，回读恒 255/255/255；
   slot#32 的唯一写者（3 顶点全屏 blit，vs=59956154be1471b8 / fs=8eb0707f2643f3a5）采样的就是它，
   于是「#29 白」被原封不动搬到 #32，成为本帧**最后写者**盖掉整帧真几何。
   本函数要回答的是「#29 那 76 笔的源是什么、里面是什么、为什么输出恒白」，判据只有三条互斥可能：
     ① ntex==0（FS 不采任何纹理）⇒ FS 输出的是常量染色 ⇒ 白只能来自常量；
     ② 采样的槽 up==0（未上送 ⇒ 白占位 fill=1,1,1,1）⇒ 白来自占位图（M36A 已证族 8 个就是这种）；
     ③ 采样的是真视图 ⇒ 白来自更上游的 RT（链条继续）。
   每条明细行给：nv/cnt/dvar + fs 键 + ntex + 每个采样槽的 (unit, id, up, store, ext, fmt, 真视图/占位)
   + FS 声明 bank 的 arena 前 4 float（染色常量）。累计行每 256 笔一条。
   关态（smo_m38c=0）：一行不打、一个分支都不动。 */
static unsigned long long g_m38c_c29_n, g_m38c_c29_l, g_m38c_c29_nv3, g_m38c_c29_ntex0,
                          g_m38c_c29_up0, g_m38c_c29_real, g_m38c_c29_tx,
                          g_m38c_c32_n, g_m38c_c32_l;
static char g_m38c_c29k[8][17]; static unsigned g_m38c_c29kn;
static void m38c_c29_key(const char *k)
{
    if (!k || !*k) return;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < g_m38c_c29kn; i++) if (!strcmp(g_m38c_c29k[i], k)) return;
    if (g_m38c_c29kn >= 8) return;
    snprintf(g_m38c_c29k[g_m38c_c29kn], sizeof g_m38c_c29k[0], "%s", k);
    g_m38c_c29kn++;
}
static void m38c_draw(const R_Key *kv, const R_Key *kf, int si, int dvar,
                      unsigned nverts, int count, int topo, unsigned rtw, unsigned rth)
{
    if (!m38c_on()) return;
    if (!kv || !kf || dvar >= 3 || si < 0 || si >= H_RT_SLOTS) return;
    const int is29 = (si == 29), is32 = (si == 32);
    if (!is29 && !is32) return;
    int real = 0, up0 = 0;
    const int lim = kf->ntex < 8 ? kf->ntex : 8;
    for (int i = 0; i < lim; i++) {
        const int u = r_unit_of(kf, i);
        if (u >= 0 && u < NVN_TX_SLOTS && g_r_tx_view[u] != VK_NULL_HANDLE) real++;
        else up0++;
    }
    if (is29) {
        g_m38c_c29_n++;
        if (nverts <= 4u && count <= 6) g_m38c_c29_nv3++;
        if (kf->ntex <= 0) g_m38c_c29_ntex0++;
        g_m38c_c29_up0 += (unsigned long long)up0;
        g_m38c_c29_real += (unsigned long long)real;
        g_m38c_c29_tx += (unsigned long long)lim;
        m38c_c29_key(kf->key);
        if (g_m38c_c29_l < 40) {
            g_m38c_c29_l++;
            char tl[600]; int o = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < lim; i++) {
                const int u = r_unit_of(kf, i);
                const int rv = (u >= 0 && u < NVN_TX_SLOTS && g_r_tx_view[u] != VK_NULL_HANDLE);
                o += snprintf(tl + o, sizeof tl - (size_t)o, "%s%d=%s,u%d,id%d,f%#x,%ux%u,up%d,store=%#llx",
                              i ? " " : "", i, rv ? "R" : "PH", u, g_r_tx_info[u].id, g_r_tx_info[u].fmt,
                              g_r_tx_info[u].w, g_r_tx_info[u].h, g_r_tx_info[u].up,
                              (unsigned long long)g_r_tx_info[u].store);
                if (o >= (int)sizeof tl - 110) break;
            }
            vk_boot_logf("[m38c] c29 #%llu d=%llu nv=%u cnt=%d topo=%d dvar=%d ext=%ux%u vs=%s fs=%s "
                         "ntex=%d fs_cbuf=%#x key=%#llx texid=%d :: %s",
                         g_m38c_c29_n, g_r_draws, nverts, count, topo, dvar, rtw, rth, kv->key, kf->key,
                         kf->ntex, kf->cbuf_mask, (unsigned long long)(g_rt_cur ? g_rt_cur->key : 0ull),
                         g_rt_cur ? g_rt_cur->tex_id : -1, tl[0] ? tl : "(ntex=0: FS 不采样任何纹理)");
            /* FS 声明 bank 的 arena 前 4 float：判「常量染色是不是白」。最多 4 个 bank。 */
            int shown = 0;
            for (int b = 0; b < 32 && shown < 4; b++) {
                if (!(kf->cbuf_mask & (1u << b))) continue;
                const int bidx = r_ubo_bind_idx(1, b);
                if (bidx < 0) continue;
                const uint32_t off = r_ubo_off_key(1, b, kf->key);
                float f4[4]; memset(f4, 0, sizeof f4);
                int got = 0;
                if (off && g_r_ubo_map && (uint64_t)off + 16ull <= (uint64_t)R_UBO_ARENA) {
                    memcpy(f4, (const uint8_t *)g_r_ubo_map + off, sizeof f4); got = 1;
                }
                vk_boot_logf("[m38c] c29c #%llu bank=%d bidx=%d off=%u sz=%u got=%d f4=%g,%g,%g,%g",
                             g_m38c_c29_n, b, bidx, off, (unsigned)g_r_ubo_sz[1][bidx], got,
                             (double)f4[0], (double)f4[1], (double)f4[2], (double)f4[3]);
                shown++;
            }
        }
    }
    if (is32) {
        g_m38c_c32_n++;
        if (g_m38c_c32_l < 12) {
            g_m38c_c32_l++;
            vk_boot_logf("[m38c] c32 #%llu d=%llu nv=%u cnt=%d dvar=%d ext=%ux%u vs=%s fs=%s ntex=%d "
                         "real=%d up0=%d key=%#llx",
                         g_m38c_c32_n, g_r_draws, nverts, count, dvar, rtw, rth, kv->key, kf->key,
                         kf->ntex, real, up0, (unsigned long long)(g_rt_cur ? g_rt_cur->key : 0ull));
        }
    }
    if ((g_m38c_c29_n % 256ull) == 0ull && is29)
        vk_boot_logf("[m38c] s29 n=%llu nv3=%llu ntex0=%llu samples=%llu up0=%llu real=%llu fskeys=%u "
                     "k0=%s k1=%s | s32 n=%llu",
                     g_m38c_c29_n, g_m38c_c29_nv3, g_m38c_c29_ntex0, g_m38c_c29_tx,
                     g_m38c_c29_up0, g_m38c_c29_real, g_m38c_c29kn,
                     g_m38c_c29kn > 0 ? g_m38c_c29k[0] : "-",
                     g_m38c_c29kn > 1 ? g_m38c_c29k[1] : "-", g_m38c_c32_n);
}
/* ================= M38D（2026-11-09，纯只读取证）：RT#29 恒白 —— 源 / 常量 / 目标 三层同时落地 =====
   已证事实（M36A/M37A/M38C，证据在盘上）：
     · slot#29 = 800x450 / id=1937，76 笔 nv=3 全屏三角写它，回读恒 255/255/255（M36A 记 px0 α=0）；
     · #32 的唯一写者（vs=59956154be1471b8）采样的就是它 ⇒ 白被原封搬到 #32 盖掉整帧；
     · 写 #29 的笔采样 `id994 f0x2e(=RGBA32F) 128x128 up1 store=0x6ea8e1d000`；
     · **M38C 日志 `[tex] missing id=994 … why=no_rt_of_this_shape` 只在 `nvn_vk_tex_zero_id(994)==1`
       时打印**（gfx_bridge.c:3348，位图由本文件 :1714 按「解排布后前 4 KiB 全零」置位）
       ⇒ id994 上送内容首 4 KiB 全零 ⇒ GPU 采到的是 (0,0,0,0)，**源纹理不可能是白**。
   于是白只剩两种可能：(b) FS 常量/运算/混合，(b') 「76 笔其实没写进去、RT 保留 guest clear 值」。
   本探针把三层各自变成可复核的证据（只读；关态零输出、零落盘）：
     ① 源：被采样 unit 的**真实 VkImage**（r_fs_slot_image）→ c_img_stats + 首张落 PNG；
        并读**池字节**（上传源，guest 地址走 r_guest_copy）落 .bin，与 GPU 镜像对账
        （池已非零而镜像仍全零 ⇒ 上传时机/陈旧，不是着色问题）。
     ② 常量：FS 每个声明 bank 的 arena 副本前 8 float（r_ubo_off_key，**禁按 guest 地址逐字节**）
        + 整 bank(≤4096 B) 落 .bin。
     ③ 目标：#29 自己的像素在 present 时刻（被清掉前）回读落 PNG（m4ak 探针内）。
   关态（smo_m38d=0）：一行不打、一个分支不动、不落盘。 */
#define M38D_SW_A "/data/storage/el2/base/files/smo_m38d"
#define M38D_SW_B "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files/smo_m38d"
static int m38d_on(void)
{
    static int v = -1; static long last;
    long now = (long)time(NULL);
    if (v >= 0 && now == last) return v;
    last = now; v = 0;
    { const char *p[2] = { M38D_SW_A, M38D_SW_B };
      for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) { FILE *f = fopen(p[i], "r");
        if (f) { int x = 0; if (fscanf(f, "%d", &x) == 1 && x > 0) v = 1; fclose(f); break; } } }
    return v;
}
__attribute__((constructor)) static void m38d_seed(void)
{
    static const char *const p[2] = { M38D_SW_A, M38D_SW_B };
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        FILE *r = fopen(p[i], "r");
        if (r) { fclose(r); continue; }
        FILE *f = fopen(p[i], "w");
        if (f) { fputs("0\n", f); fclose(f); }
    }
}
static unsigned long long g_m38d_draws, g_m38d_pool_n, g_m38d_png_n, g_m38d_slot29_png;
static int g_m38d_pool_ids[8], g_m38d_npool_id;
static unsigned long long m38d_fnv(const unsigned char *d, unsigned long long n)
{
    unsigned long long h = 1469598103934665603ull;
    for (unsigned long long i = 0; i < n; i++) { h ^= (unsigned long long)d[i]; h *= 1099511628211ull; }
    return h;
}
/* 池字节（上传源）：对账「池有没有内容」与「GPU 镜像有没有内容」。guest 地址一律走 r_guest_copy
   （越界/未映射返回 0，不裸解引用）。字节统计对 swizzle 不敏感（只问「是不是全零/全 FF」）。 */
static void m38d_pool(const char *dir, int id, int fmt, unsigned w, unsigned h,
                      unsigned long long store, int up)
{
    if (!store || !w || !h || id < 0) return;
    for (int k = 0; k < g_m38d_npool_id; k++) if (g_m38d_pool_ids[k] == id) return;   /* 每 id 一次 */
    unsigned bpp = (fmt == 0x2E) ? 16u : (fmt == 0x29 || fmt == 0x11 || fmt == 0x12) ? 8u : 4u;
    unsigned long long need = (unsigned long long)w * (unsigned long long)h * bpp;
    if (need > (2ull << 20)) { vk_boot_logf("[m38d] pool id=%d fmt=%#x %ux%u need=%llu skip>2MB",
                                           id, fmt, w, h, need); return; }
    if (g_m38d_npool_id < 8) g_m38d_pool_ids[g_m38d_npool_id++] = id;
    unsigned char *buf = (unsigned char *)malloc((size_t)need);
    if (!buf) { vk_boot_logf("[m38d] pool id=%d malloc %llu fail", id, need); return; }
    if (!r_guest_copy(buf, store, (unsigned)need)) {
        vk_boot_logf("[m38d] pool id=%d store=%#llx r_guest_copy fail n=%llu", id, store, need);
        free(buf); return;
    }
    unsigned long long n0 = 0, nff = 0, nz = 0;
    unsigned char seen[32]; memset(seen, 0, sizeof seen);
    for (unsigned long long i = 0; i < need; i++) {
        unsigned char b = buf[i];
        if (!b) n0++; else { nz++; if (b == 0xFF) nff++; }
        seen[b >> 3] |= (unsigned char)(1u << (b & 7u));
    }
    int ndis = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) if (seen[i] & (1u << k)) ndis++;
    float f0 = 0, f1 = 0, f2 = 0, f3 = 0, f4 = 0, f5 = 0, f6 = 0, f7 = 0;
    if (need >= 32) {
        const float *fp = (const float *)(const void *)buf;
        f0 = fp[0]; f1 = fp[1]; f2 = fp[2]; f3 = fp[3];
        f4 = fp[4]; f5 = fp[5]; f6 = fp[6]; f7 = fp[7];
    }
    char pth[256];
    snprintf(pth, sizeof pth, "%sm38d_pool_id%d.bin", dir, id);
    FILE *fo = fopen(pth, "wb");
    unsigned long long wb = 0;
    if (fo) { wb = (unsigned long long)fwrite(buf, 1, (size_t)need, fo); fclose(fo); }
    vk_boot_logf("[m38d] pool id=%d up=%d fmt=%#x %ux%u bpp=%u store=%#llx bytes=%llu n0=%llu nz=%llu "
                 "nFF=%llu ndist=%d hash=%#llx f0..7=%g,%g,%g,%g,%g,%g,%g,%g file=%s wb=%llu",
                 id, up, fmt, w, h, bpp, store, need, n0, nz, nff, ndis, m38d_fnv(buf, need),
                 (double)f0, (double)f1, (double)f2, (double)f3,
                 (double)f4, (double)f5, (double)f6, (double)f7, pth, wb);
    free(buf);
    g_m38d_pool_n++;
}
static void m38d_draw(const R_Key *kv, const R_Key *kf, int si, int dvar,
                      unsigned nverts, int count, int topo)
{
    if (si != 29) return;
    if (!m38d_on()) return;
    g_m38d_draws++;
    if (g_m38d_draws > 6 || !kv || !kf) return;      /* 预算：前 6 笔写 #29 的 draw */
    const char *dir = m7h_dir();
    const int lim = kf->ntex < 4 ? kf->ntex : 4;
    vk_boot_logf("[m38d] s29 #%llu d=%llu nv=%u cnt=%d topo=%d dvar=%d ntex=%d fs=%s cbuf=%#x",
                 g_m38d_draws, g_r_draws, nverts, count, topo, dvar, kf->ntex, kf->key, kf->cbuf_mask);
    for (int i = 0; i < lim; i++) {
        const int u = r_unit_of(kf, i);
        const int ok_u = (u >= 0 && u < NVN_TX_SLOTS);
        const int tid  = ok_u ? g_r_tx_info[u].id : -1;
        const int fmt  = ok_u ? g_r_tx_info[u].fmt : 0;
        const unsigned dw = ok_u ? g_r_tx_info[u].w : 0u;
        const unsigned dh = ok_u ? g_r_tx_info[u].h : 0u;
        const int up = ok_u ? g_r_tx_info[u].up : -1;
        const unsigned long long store = ok_u ? g_r_tx_info[u].store : 0ull;
        VkImage im = VK_NULL_HANDLE; VkImageLayout ly = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
        unsigned w0 = 0, h0 = 0, b0 = 0; const char *wh = "none";
        int have = r_fs_slot_image(i, &im, &ly, &w0, &h0, &b0, &wh);
        vk_boot_logf("[m38d] slot i=%d u=%d id=%d fmt=%#x decl=%ux%u up=%d store=%#llx have=%d "
                     "src=%s img=%#llx lay=%d img_ext=%ux%u bpp=%u",
                     i, u, tid, fmt, dw, dh, up, store, have, wh ? wh : "?",
                     (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)im, (int)ly, w0, h0, b0);
        if (have && im && b0 == 4 && w0 && h0) {
            c_stat_t st; memset(&st, 0, sizeof st);
            if (c_img_stats(im, ly, w0, h0, 4, &st)) {
                vk_boot_logf("[m38d] img i=%d %ux%u npx=%llu nz=%.1f%% mean=%llu/%llu/%llu "
                             "max=%llu/%llu/%llu colored=%.1f%% black=%.1f%% rgba0=%u,%u,%u,%u",
                             i, w0, h0, st.npx, 100.0 * (double)st.nz / (double)(st.npx ? st.npx * 4 : 1),
                             st.sr / (st.npx ? st.npx : 1), st.sg / (st.npx ? st.npx : 1),
                             st.sb / (st.npx ? st.npx : 1), st.mxr, st.mxg, st.mxb,
                             100.0 * (double)st.colored / (double)(st.npx ? st.npx : 1),
                             100.0 * (double)st.black / (double)(st.npx ? st.npx : 1),
                             st.px0[0], st.px0[1], st.px0[2], st.px0[3]);
            } else vk_boot_logf("[m38d] img i=%d rb_fail", i);
            if (g_m38d_draws == 1 && g_m38d_png_n < 4) {      /* 首笔 dump 一张 = 采样源的真身 */
                VkDeviceSize sz = (VkDeviceSize)w0 * (VkDeviceSize)h0 * 4ull;
                unsigned char *px = (unsigned char *)c_raw_copy(im, ly, w0, h0, sz);
                if (px) {
                    char pp[256]; snprintf(pp, sizeof pp, "%sm38d_fs_slot%d_id%d.png", dir, i, tid);
                    unsigned long long by = m7h_write_png(pp, w0, h0, px);
                    g_m38d_png_n++;
                    vk_boot_logf("[m38d] png i=%d id=%d path=%s bytes=%llu %ux%u", i, tid, pp, by, w0, h0);
                    free(px);
                } else vk_boot_logf("[m38d] png i=%d copy_fail", i);
            }
        }
        m38d_pool(dir, tid, fmt, dw ? dw : w0, dh ? dh : h0, store, up);
    }
    /* ② 常量：FS 每个声明 bank 的 arena 副本（禁按 guest 地址）+ 整 bank 落盘（首笔） */
    for (int b = 0; b < 32; b++) {
        if (!(kf->cbuf_mask & (1u << b))) continue;
        const int bidx = r_ubo_bind_idx(1, b);
        if (bidx < 0) { vk_boot_logf("[m38d] cb bank=%d bidx<0 (unbound)", b); continue; }
        const uint32_t off = r_ubo_off_key(1, b, kf->key);
        const unsigned gsz = (unsigned)g_r_ubo_gsz[1][bidx];
        float f8[8]; memset(f8, 0, sizeof f8);
        int got = 0;
        if (off && g_r_ubo_map && (uint64_t)off + sizeof f8 <= (uint64_t)R_UBO_ARENA) {
            memcpy(f8, (const uint8_t *)g_r_ubo_map + off, sizeof f8); got = 1;
        }
        vk_boot_logf("[m38d] cb bank=%d bidx=%d off=%u gsz=%u got=%d f0..7=%g,%g,%g,%g,%g,%g,%g,%g",
                     b, bidx, off, gsz, got,
                     (double)f8[0], (double)f8[1], (double)f8[2], (double)f8[3],
                     (double)f8[4], (double)f8[5], (double)f8[6], (double)f8[7]);
        if (g_m38d_draws == 1 && got) {
            unsigned cp = gsz < 4096u ? gsz : 4096u;
            if (cp > 16u && (uint64_t)off + cp <= (uint64_t)R_UBO_ARENA) {
                char pp[256]; snprintf(pp, sizeof pp, "%sm38d_fs_cb%d.bin", dir, b);
                FILE *fo = fopen(pp, "wb");
                if (fo) {
                    size_t wb = fwrite((const uint8_t *)g_r_ubo_map + off, 1, (size_t)cp, fo);
                    fclose(fo);
                    vk_boot_logf("[m38d] cb dump bank=%d path=%s cp=%u wb=%zu", b, pp, cp, wb);
                } else vk_boot_logf("[m38d] cb dump bank=%d fopen fail", b);
            }
        }
    }
}
/* ====== M38E（2026-11-09，只读，log-only，零行为改动）A/C ==============================
   M38D 只抓了「前 6 笔写 #29 的 draw」，6 笔全落在同一个微秒窗口（1794192595.6858~.6886），
   回答不了派活单的核心问题：progress 是**每帧被重新触发**、**恒停在 1.0**、还是**帧间有变化**。
   本探针把每帧收成一行（不是每笔一行）：
     [m38e] f=<帧号> t=<秒> w29=<本帧写 #29 笔数> prog=<min..max> nprog=<不同取值的步数>
            p0=<首笔> pN=<末笔> span_us=<本帧 #29 首末笔时间差> s32=<本帧写 #32 笔数>
   progress 口径与 M38D 严格一致：FS 常量 **bank=5** 的 arena 副本第一个 float
   （`r_ubo_bind_idx(1,5)` + `r_ubo_off_key(1,5,kf->key)`，禁按 guest 地址逐字节）。
   「步进几次」= nprog（同一帧内出现过的不同 prog 取值个数）；「一帧多久」= span_us 与 [beat] 的 t=。
   关态（smo_m38e=0）：一行不打、零落盘、零行为改动。 */
#define M38E_SW_A "/data/storage/el2/base/files/smo_m38e"
#define M38E_SW_B "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files/smo_m38e"
static int m38e_on(void)
{
    static int v = -1; static long last;
    long now = (long)time(NULL);
    if (v >= 0 && now == last) return v;
    last = now; v = 0;
    { const char *p[2] = { M38E_SW_A, M38E_SW_B };
      for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) { FILE *f = fopen(p[i], "r");
        if (f) { int x = 0; if (fscanf(f, "%d", &x) == 1 && x > 0) v = 1; fclose(f); break; } } }
    return v;
}
__attribute__((constructor)) static void m38e_seed(void)
{
    static const char *const p[2] = { M38E_SW_A, M38E_SW_B };
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        FILE *r = fopen(p[i], "r");
        if (r) { fclose(r); continue; }
        FILE *f = fopen(p[i], "w");
        if (f) { fputs("0\n", f); fclose(f); }
    }
}
static unsigned long long m38e_now_us(void)
{
    struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    return (unsigned long long)ts.tv_sec * 1000000ull + (unsigned long long)ts.tv_nsec / 1000ull;
}
static unsigned long long g_m38e_t0, g_m38e_tfirst, g_m38e_tlast;
static unsigned long long g_m38e_fcur;              /* 当前统计的帧号 */
static unsigned long long g_m38e_n29, g_m38e_n32;   /* 本帧写 #29 / #32 的笔数 */
static unsigned long long g_m38e_lines, g_m38e_all29, g_m38e_all32, g_m38e_noprog;
static float g_m38e_pmin, g_m38e_pmax, g_m38e_p0, g_m38e_plast;
static float g_m38e_ps[64]; static int g_m38e_nps;  /* 本帧出现过的不同 prog 值（去重，≤64） */
static void m38e_frame_reset(void)
{
    g_m38e_n29 = g_m38e_n32 = 0; g_m38e_nps = 0;
    g_m38e_pmin = 1e30f; g_m38e_pmax = -1e30f; g_m38e_p0 = g_m38e_plast = 0.0f;
    g_m38e_tfirst = g_m38e_tlast = 0;
}
/* 该笔 draw 的转场进度（FS bank=5 f0）。取不到返回 0（prog 打 na）。 */
static int m38e_prog(const R_Key *kf, float *out)
{
    if (!kf || !(kf->cbuf_mask & (1u << 5))) return 0;
    const int bidx = r_ubo_bind_idx(1, 5);
    if (bidx < 0) return 0;
    const uint32_t off = r_ubo_off_key(1, 5, kf->key);
    if (!off || !g_r_ubo_map || (uint64_t)off + 4ull > (uint64_t)R_UBO_ARENA) return 0;
    float f0 = 0.0f;
    memcpy(&f0, (const uint8_t *)g_r_ubo_map + off, sizeof f0);
    *out = f0; return 1;
}
/* 把「正在统计的这一帧」收成一行。fnew = 下一帧号（调用方已经看到帧切换）。 */
static void m38e_flush(unsigned long long fnew)
{
    if (g_m38e_n29 || g_m38e_n32) {
        const double t = g_m38e_t0 ? (double)(m38e_now_us() - g_m38e_t0) / 1e6 : 0.0;
        const double span = (g_m38e_tfirst && g_m38e_tlast >= g_m38e_tfirst)
                          ? (double)(g_m38e_tlast - g_m38e_tfirst) : 0.0;
        char pb[96];
        if (g_m38e_nps) snprintf(pb, sizeof pb, "%.4f..%.4f", (double)g_m38e_pmin, (double)g_m38e_pmax);
        else            snprintf(pb, sizeof pb, "na");
        vk_boot_logf("[m38e] f=%llu t=%.3f w29=%llu prog=%s nprog=%d p0=%.4f pN=%.4f s32=%llu span_us=%.0f",
                     g_m38e_fcur, t, g_m38e_n29, pb, g_m38e_nps,
                     (double)g_m38e_p0, (double)g_m38e_plast, g_m38e_n32, span);
        g_m38e_lines++;
    }
    g_m38e_fcur = fnew;
    m38e_frame_reset();
}
static void m38e_draw(const R_Key *kv, const R_Key *kf, int si, int dvar,
                      unsigned nverts, int count, int topo)
{
    (void)kv; (void)dvar; (void)nverts; (void)count; (void)topo;
    if (si != 29 && si != 32) return;
    if (!m38e_on()) return;
    const unsigned long long us = m38e_now_us();
    if (!g_m38e_t0) { g_m38e_t0 = us; m38e_frame_reset(); g_m38e_fcur = r_frame_now(); }
    const unsigned long long f = r_frame_now();
    if (f != g_m38e_fcur) m38e_flush(f);
    if (si == 32) { g_m38e_n32++; g_m38e_all32++; return; }
    g_m38e_n29++; g_m38e_all29++;
    if (!g_m38e_tfirst) g_m38e_tfirst = us;
    g_m38e_tlast = us;
    float p = 0.0f;
    if (!m38e_prog(kf, &p)) { g_m38e_noprog++; return; }
    if (p < g_m38e_pmin) g_m38e_pmin = p;
    if (p > g_m38e_pmax) g_m38e_pmax = p;
    if (g_m38e_n29 == 1) g_m38e_p0 = p;
    g_m38e_plast = p;
    int dup = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_m38e_nps; i++) {
        float d = g_m38e_ps[i] - p; if (d < 0) d = -d;
        if (d < 1e-6f) { dup = 1; break; }
    }
    if (!dup && g_m38e_nps < (int)(sizeof g_m38e_ps / sizeof *g_m38e_ps)) g_m38e_ps[g_m38e_nps++] = p;
}
/* ====== M38F（2026-11-09，只读，log-only，零行为改动）====================================
   M38E 留下的唯一未决点：**741 笔/帧落进 slot109（id 11802, 720×405）而该槽恒纯白**
   —— 白到底是 ①每帧 (1,1,1,0) 的 clear 给的、②741 笔一个片元都没产生（深度/视口剪刀）、
   还是 ③draw 真写了但 FS 输出/混合就是白。两个探针点：
     A 清屏侧 `nvn_vk_m38f_clear_note()`：gfx_bridge.c:2419 的清屏调用**前一刻**打「即将被清的目标
       身份」（slot/id/ext/lay/深度附件）+ 该图此刻的**自有回读签名**（= 上一帧 741 笔之后的内容）。
       每个 (slot,id,rgba) 组合首个出现各一行，另每 300 帧一行累计。
     B draw 侧 `m38f_draw_pre/post()`：对所有 draw 记账（本帧落进目标槽的笔数 / dvar 分布 / 无 RT 分组）；
       对目标槽（si==109 或 id∈{11802,9457,1939,1937}）的**前 8 笔 + 每 64 笔**（≤40 笔）各取一对
       before/after：pre 在录制前 flush 掉本批再回读 = 这笔之前的内容；post 在本笔录进 CB 后 flush
       再回读 = 这笔之后的内容。before==after ⇒ 这笔一个像素没落；不等 ⇒ 落了（再问写的是不是白）。
       签名一律走 r_tex_signature（**自有 GPU 回读**，禁按 guest 地址逐字节；256 点等距采样）。
     关态（smo_m38f=0）：两处立即 return，零输出、零 flush、零行为改动。
   预算：整 boot ≤40 笔采样、≤8 次帧明细（之后每 300 帧一次）、清屏行 ≤16 组合 + ≤8 条累计。
*/
#define M38F_SW_A "/data/storage/el2/base/files/smo_m38f"
#define M38F_SW_B "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files/smo_m38f"
static int m38f_on(void)
{
    static int v = -1; static long last;
    long now = (long)time(NULL);
    if (v >= 0 && now == last) return v;
    last = now; v = 0;
    { const char *p[2] = { M38F_SW_A, M38F_SW_B };
      for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) { FILE *f = fopen(p[i], "r");
        if (f) { int x = 0; if (fscanf(f, "%d", &x) == 1 && x > 0) v = 1; fclose(f); break; } } }
    return v;
}
__attribute__((constructor)) static void m38f_seed(void)
{
    static const char *const p[2] = { M38F_SW_A, M38F_SW_B };
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        FILE *r = fopen(p[i], "r");
        if (r) { fclose(r); continue; }
        FILE *f = fopen(p[i], "w");
        if (f) { fputs("0\n", f); fclose(f); }
    }
}
#define M38F_TGT_SLOT 109
#define M38F_IDS 4
static const int m38f_ids[M38F_IDS] = { 11802, 9457, 1939, 1937 };
static int m38f_is_tgt(int si, int id)
{
    if (si == M38F_TGT_SLOT) return 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < M38F_IDS; i++) if (id == m38f_ids[i]) return 1;
    return 0;
}
static unsigned long long m38f_now_us(void)
{
    struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    return (unsigned long long)ts.tv_sec * 1000000ull + (unsigned long long)ts.tv_nsec / 1000ull;
}
/* 目标槽此刻的自有回读签名（禁 guest 地址；256 点等距采样，见 r_tex_signature）。 */
static int m38f_sig(h_rt_slot *s, r_sig_t *o)
{
    memset(o, 0, sizeof *o);
    if (!s || !s->img || !s->w || !s->h) return 0;
    const VkImageLayout lay = (s == g_rt_cur) ? g_h_layout : s->layout;
    return r_tex_signature(s->img, lay, s->w, s->h, 4, o);
}
/* 签名文本：hash8 / meanR,meanG,meanB / minR,maxR,maxB */
static void m38f_sig_txt(char *b, int cap, const r_sig_t *o, int ok)
{
    if (!ok) { snprintf(b, cap, "na"); return; }
    const unsigned long long np = o->npx ? o->npx : 1ull;
    snprintf(b, cap, "%08llx/%llu,%llu,%llu/%llu,%llu,%llu",
             (unsigned long long)(o->hash & 0xffffffffull),
             o->sum[0] / np, o->sum[1] / np, o->sum[2] / np,
             (unsigned long long)o->mn[0], (unsigned long long)o->mx[0], (unsigned long long)o->mx[2]);
}
/* ---- A：清屏侧。gfx_bridge.c:2419 的 nvn_vk_clear_color_offscreen_frame 调用**前一刻**调。
   语义：此刻 g_h_img = 即将被清的目标；g_rt_cur=NULL ⇒ 宿主兜底图（不是任何槽）。
   判据：目标是不是 slot109 / id 11802 的 720×405，rgba 是不是 (1,1,1,0)，清之前它的签名是什么。 */
#define M38F_CLR_MAX 16
static struct { int slot, id; float rgba[4]; unsigned long n; } g_m38f_clr[M38F_CLR_MAX];
static unsigned g_m38f_clr_n, g_m38f_clr_lines, g_m38f_clr_sum_lines;
static unsigned long g_m38f_clr_all, g_m38f_clr_white109;
static unsigned long long g_m38f_clr_f0;
void nvn_vk_m38f_clear_note(unsigned long long frame, const float rgba[4])
{
    if (!m38f_on()) return;
    if (g_m38f_clr_f0 == 0) { g_m38f_clr_f0 = m38f_now_us(); }
    h_rt_slot *s = g_rt_cur;
    const int slot = s ? (int)(s - g_rt_tab) : -1;
    const int id = s ? s->tex_id : -1;
    const unsigned w = (unsigned)g_rt_w, h = (unsigned)g_rt_h;
    const int is_white = (rgba[0] > 0.99f && rgba[1] > 0.99f && rgba[2] > 0.99f);
    g_m38f_clr_all++;
    if (slot == M38F_TGT_SLOT && is_white) g_m38f_clr_white109++;
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i < (int)g_m38f_clr_n; i++)
        if (g_m38f_clr[i].slot == slot && g_m38f_clr[i].id == id &&
            !memcmp(g_m38f_clr[i].rgba, rgba, sizeof(float) * 4)) break;
    if (i == (int)g_m38f_clr_n) {
        if (g_m38f_clr_n < M38F_CLR_MAX) {
            g_m38f_clr[g_m38f_clr_n].slot = slot; g_m38f_clr[g_m38f_clr_n].id = id;
            memcpy(g_m38f_clr[g_m38f_clr_n].rgba, rgba, sizeof(float) * 4);
            g_m38f_clr[g_m38f_clr_n].n = 1; g_m38f_clr_n++;
        } else { g_m38f_clr[M38F_CLR_MAX - 1].n++; }
        if (g_m38f_clr_lines < 16) {
            g_m38f_clr_lines++;
            char sg[96]; r_sig_t so; int sok = 0;
            if (g_m38f_clr_lines <= 6) { sok = m38f_sig(s, &so); m38f_sig_txt(sg, sizeof sg, &so, sok); }
            else snprintf(sg, sizeof sg, "na(quota)");
            vk_boot_logf("[m38f] clr f=%llu rgba=%.3f,%.3f,%.3f,%.3f slot=%d id=%d ext=%ux%u "
                         "lay=%d host=%d ds_ext=%ux%u dk_ok=%d sig_before_clear=%s",
                         frame, (double)rgba[0], (double)rgba[1], (double)rgba[2], (double)rgba[3],
                         slot, id, w, h, (int)g_h_layout, s ? 0 : 1,
                         s && s->ds ? (unsigned)s->ds->w : 0u, s && s->ds ? (unsigned)s->ds->h : 0u,
                         s ? s->dk_ok : -1, sg);
        }
    } else g_m38f_clr[i].n++;
    /* 每 300 帧一行累计：回答「slot109 是不是**每帧**被白清」（次数 / 帧数 = 每帧次数）。 */
    if (frame % 300ull == 0ull && frame != 0ull && g_m38f_clr_sum_lines < 8) {
        g_m38f_clr_sum_lines++;
        const double t = g_m38f_clr_f0 ? (double)(m38f_now_us() - g_m38f_clr_f0) / 1e6 : 0.0;
        vk_boot_logf("[m38f] clrsum f=%llu t=%.1f clears=%lu white109=%lu combos=%u "
                     "(c0:slot=%d id=%d rgba=%.2f,%.2f,%.2f,%.2f n=%lu)",
                     frame, t, g_m38f_clr_all, g_m38f_clr_white109, g_m38f_clr_n,
                     g_m38f_clr[0].slot, g_m38f_clr[0].id,
                     (double)g_m38f_clr[0].rgba[0], (double)g_m38f_clr[0].rgba[1],
                     (double)g_m38f_clr[0].rgba[2], (double)g_m38f_clr[0].rgba[3], g_m38f_clr[0].n);
    }
}
/* ---- B：draw 侧 ---- */
static unsigned long long g_m38f_t0us, g_m38f_fcur;
static unsigned g_m38f_f_all, g_m38f_f_tgt, g_m38f_f_d0, g_m38f_f_dD, g_m38f_f_host;
static unsigned long long g_m38f_f_nv, g_m38f_tgt_total, g_m38f_sampled, g_m38f_flines, g_m38f_fsum;
static int g_m38f_hit;                     /* 本笔是否在 pre 里开始了 before/after 采样 */
static r_sig_t g_m38f_before;
static int g_m38f_before_ok;
static char g_m38f_bfs[20];                /* 本帧落进目标槽最多的 FS（诊断用） */
static unsigned g_m38f_bfs_n;
static struct { int dvar; char fs[20]; unsigned n; } g_m38f_ht[6];   /* 无 RT 的 (dvar,fs) 分组 */
static unsigned g_m38f_htn;
static void m38f_ht_add(int dvar, const char *fs)
{
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < g_m38f_htn; i++)
        if (g_m38f_ht[i].dvar == dvar && !strncmp(g_m38f_ht[i].fs, fs ? fs : "-", 19)) { g_m38f_ht[i].n++; return; }
    if (g_m38f_htn < 6) {
        g_m38f_ht[g_m38f_htn].dvar = dvar;
        snprintf(g_m38f_ht[g_m38f_htn].fs, sizeof g_m38f_ht[0].fs, "%s", fs ? fs : "-");
        g_m38f_ht[g_m38f_htn].n = 1; g_m38f_htn++;
    } else {   /* 表满：并到最小的那一组，保证「有一个兜底」 */
        unsigned k = 0;
        for (unsigned i = 1; i < 6; i++) if (g_m38f_ht[i].n < g_m38f_ht[k].n) k = i;
        g_m38f_ht[k].n++;
    }
}
static void m38f_frame_reset(void)
{
    g_m38f_f_all = g_m38f_f_tgt = g_m38f_f_d0 = g_m38f_f_dD = g_m38f_f_host = 0;
    g_m38f_f_nv = 0; g_m38f_bfs_n = 0; g_m38f_bfs[0] = 0;
    g_m38f_htn = 0;
}
/* 帧收口：上一帧落进目标槽多少笔 / dvar 分布 / 无 RT 分组 / 目标槽此刻内容签名。
   sig 是「上一帧那批 draw 提交之后」的自有回读 ⇒ 与 A 侧 clear 前的 sig 互为交叉验证。 */
static void m38f_flush(unsigned long long fnew)
{
    if (!g_m38f_f_all) { g_m38f_fcur = fnew; m38f_frame_reset(); return; }
    if (g_m38f_fsum < 8 || (g_m38f_fcur % 300ull) == 0ull) {
        g_m38f_fsum++;
        const double t = g_m38f_t0us ? (double)(m38f_now_us() - g_m38f_t0us) / 1e6 : 0.0;
        char sg[96] = "na", ht[300]; ht[0] = 0;
        h_rt_slot *s = &g_rt_tab[M38F_TGT_SLOT];
        r_sig_t so;
        int sok = s->img ? m38f_sig(s, &so) : 0;
        m38f_sig_txt(sg, sizeof sg, &so, sok);
        int o = 0;
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < g_m38f_htn && o < (int)sizeof ht - 40; i++)
            o += snprintf(ht + o, sizeof ht - (size_t)o, "%s|dv%d:%u ", g_m38f_ht[i].fs, g_m38f_ht[i].dvar, g_m38f_ht[i].n);
        vk_boot_logf("[m38f] f=%llu t=%.1f all=%u tgt=%u tgt_nv=%llu dvar0=%u dvarD=%u host=%u "
                     "fs109=%s ext109=%ux%u sig109=%s host_top=%s",
                     g_m38f_fcur, t, g_m38f_f_all, g_m38f_f_tgt, g_m38f_f_nv,
                     g_m38f_f_d0, g_m38f_f_dD, g_m38f_f_host,
                     g_m38f_bfs[0] ? g_m38f_bfs : "-", (unsigned)s->w, (unsigned)s->h, sg,
                     ht[0] ? ht : "-");
    }
    g_m38f_fcur = fnew;
    m38f_frame_reset();
}
/* pre：录制**之前**（本批已录的 draw 先 flush 提交），取「这笔之前」的签名。 */
static void m38f_draw_pre(void)
{
    g_m38f_hit = 0;
    if (!m38f_on()) return;
    const int si = g_rt_cur ? (int)(g_rt_cur - g_rt_tab) : -1;
    const int id = g_rt_cur ? g_rt_cur->tex_id : -1;
    if (!m38f_is_tgt(si, id)) return;
    const unsigned long long n = g_m38f_tgt_total;
    if (!(n < 8ull || (n % 64ull) == 0ull)) return;
    if (g_m38f_sampled >= 40ull) return;
    g_m38f_sampled++;
    nvn_vk_draw_flush();                     /* 回读必须在无在飞 CB 时取内容（同 M4ad 口径） */
    g_m38f_before_ok = m38f_sig(g_rt_cur, &g_m38f_before);
    g_m38f_hit = 1;
}
/* post：draw 收口之后（同名收口点，与 m38e_draw 同一处语义）。 */
static void m38f_draw_post(const R_Key *kv, const R_Key *kf, int dvar, unsigned nverts, int count, int topo)
{
    if (!m38f_on()) return;
    const unsigned long long us = m38f_now_us();
    if (!g_m38f_t0us) { g_m38f_t0us = us;}
    const unsigned long long f = r_frame_now();
    if (f != g_m38f_fcur) m38f_flush(f);
    const int si = g_rt_cur ? (int)(g_rt_cur - g_rt_tab) : -1;
    const int id = g_rt_cur ? g_rt_cur->tex_id : -1;
    const int tgt = m38f_is_tgt(si, id);
    g_m38f_f_all++;
    if (si < 0) { g_m38f_f_host++; m38f_ht_add(dvar, kf ? kf->key : "-"); }
    if (tgt) {
        g_m38f_f_tgt++; g_m38f_f_nv += nverts;
        if (dvar == 0) g_m38f_f_d0++; else g_m38f_f_dD++;
        if (kf && kf->key[0] && !g_m38f_bfs[0]) snprintf(g_m38f_bfs, sizeof g_m38f_bfs, "%s", kf->key);
    }
    if (g_m38f_hit) {
        g_m38f_hit = 0;
        if (g_m38f_flines < 48) {
            nvn_vk_draw_flush();             /* 本笔已录进 CB ⇒ 提交后回读 = 这笔之后的内容 */
            r_sig_t af; int aok = m38f_sig(g_rt_cur, &af);
            char sb[96], sa[96];
            m38f_sig_txt(sb, sizeof sb, &g_m38f_before, g_m38f_before_ok);
            m38f_sig_txt(sa, sizeof sa, &af, aok);
            const int same = (aok && g_m38f_before_ok && af.hash == g_m38f_before.hash);
            h_d_slot *ds = g_rt_cur ? g_rt_cur->ds : NULL;
            g_m38f_flines++;
            vk_boot_logf("[m38f] d=%llu nv=%u cnt=%d topo=%d dvar=%d fs=%s dk_ok=%d ds=%s(%#llx) "
                         "depth_test=%d depth_write=%d blend=%d viewport=%.0f,%.0f,%.0fx%.0f "
                         "scissor=%d,%d,%dx%d ra=%d,%d,%dx%d cull=0 slot=%d id=%d ext=%ux%u "
                         "ds_ext=%ux%u ds_img=%d before=%s after=%s same=%d",
                         g_m38f_tgt_total, nverts, count, topo, dvar, kf ? kf->key : "-",
                         g_rt_cur ? g_rt_cur->dk_ok : -1, ds ? "d" : "none",
                         (unsigned long long)(ds ? ds->key : 0ull),
                         (dvar >= 1 && dvar <= 2) ? 1 : 0, (dvar >= 1 && dvar <= 2) ? 1 : 0,
                         g_m14b_fix,
                         (double)g_r_fs_vp[0], (double)g_r_fs_vp[1], (double)g_r_fs_vp[2], (double)g_r_fs_vp[3],
                         (int)g_r_fs_sc[0], (int)g_r_fs_sc[1], (int)g_r_fs_sc[2], (int)g_r_fs_sc[3],
                         (int)g_r_fs_ra[0], (int)g_r_fs_ra[1], (int)g_r_fs_ra[2], (int)g_r_fs_ra[3],
                         si, id, (unsigned)g_rt_w, (unsigned)g_rt_h,
                         ds ? (unsigned)ds->w : 0u, ds ? (unsigned)ds->h : 0u, ds && ds->img ? 1 : 0,
                         sb, sa, same);
        }
    }
    g_m38f_tgt_total += (unsigned long long)(tgt ? 1 : 0);
}
static void m7c_ub_draw(const R_Key *kv, const R_Key *kf, VkPipeline ps, int topo, int nverts, int count,
                        int dvar, int si, unsigned rtw, unsigned rth)
{
    if (!SMO_M7C_UB || dvar >= 3 || si < 0 || si >= H_RT_SLOTS) return;
    if (g_m7c_lines >= M7C_UB_MAX_LINES) return;
    const int world = g_m7c_scr_key[si] != 0;
    if (!world) {
        /* CTRL：非 scratch 的屏幕尺寸槽，且整 boot 已写过 >=64 笔（证明它在出内容，不是空槽） */
        const unsigned sw = h_rs_dim(1600u), sh = h_rs_dim(900u);
        if (g_m7c_ctrl >= 1 || rtw != sw || rth != sh) return;
        if (g_slot_dw_all[si] < 64) return;
        g_m7c_ctrl++;
    } else {
        if (!kv) return;
        int vi = -1;
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < g_m7c_nvs; i++) if (!strcmp(g_m7c_vs[i], kv->key)) { vi = (int)i; break; }
        if (vi < 0) {
            if (g_m7c_nvs >= M7C_UB_MAX_VS) return;
            vi = (int)g_m7c_nvs++;
            snprintf(g_m7c_vs[vi], sizeof g_m7c_vs[0], "%s", kv->key);
            g_m7c_vs_n[vi] = 0;
        }
        if (g_m7c_vs_n[vi] >= M7C_UB_PER_VS) return;
        g_m7c_vs_n[vi]++;
        g_m7c_world_n++;
    }
    g_m7c_lines++;
    vk_boot_logf("[ub] draw mode=%s pipe=%#llx vs=%s fs=%s slot=%d key=%#llx ext=%ux%u nverts=%d nidx=%d "
                 "prim=%d dvar=%d world_n=%llu ctrl=%u",
                 world ? "WORLD" : "CTRL", (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)ps,
                 kv ? kv->key : "-", kf ? kf->key : "-", si,
                 (unsigned long long)g_m7c_scr_key[si], rtw, rth, nverts, count, topo, dvar,
                 g_m7c_world_n, g_m7c_ctrl);
    vk_boot_logf("[ub] vp x=%.1f y=%.1f w=%.1f h=%.1f sc=%d,%d,%dx%d ra=%d,%d,%dx%d (last vkCmdSet, same pass)",
                 (double)g_r_fs_vp[0], (double)g_r_fs_vp[1], (double)g_r_fs_vp[2], (double)g_r_fs_vp[3],
                 (int)g_r_fs_sc[0], (int)g_r_fs_sc[1], (int)g_r_fs_sc[2], (int)g_r_fs_sc[3],
                 (int)g_r_fs_ra[0], (int)g_r_fs_ra[1], (int)g_r_fs_ra[2], (int)g_r_fs_ra[3]);
    if (!kv) return;
    char b[900];
    {   /* VS 的常量 = 投影问题的所在；FS 常量不进这一轮判据（省行数）。 */
        const int st = 0;
        int printed = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 32 && printed < 4; i++) {
            if (!(g_m7c_bmask[st] & (1u << i))) continue;
            const uint32_t off = g_m7c_boff[st][i];
            float f[40]; memset(f, 0, sizeof f);
            int got = 0;
            if (off && g_r_ubo_map && (uint64_t)off + sizeof f <= R_UBO_ARENA) {
                memcpy(f, (const uint8_t *)g_r_ubo_map + off, sizeof f);
                got = 1;
            }
            int o = snprintf(b, sizeof b, "[ub] ubo st=%d bank=%d off=%u arena=%d sz=%u gaddr=%#llx gsz=%llu f0_15=",
                             st, i, off, got, (unsigned)g_r_ubo_sz[st][i],
                             (unsigned long long)g_m7c_bgaddr[st][i], (unsigned long long)g_m7c_bgsz[st][i]);
            o = m7c_pf(b, o, (int)sizeof b, f, 16);
            vk_boot_logf("%s", b);
            printed++;
            if (m7c_mat_like(f, 32)) {
                int o2 = snprintf(b, sizeof b, "[ub] ubo st=%d bank=%d f16_31=", st, i);
                o2 = m7c_pf(b, o2, (int)sizeof b, f + 16, 16);
                vk_boot_logf("%s", b);
            }
            if (i == 1 || m7c_mat_like(f + 24, 16)) {
                int o3 = snprintf(b, sizeof b, "[ub] proj st=%d bank=%d f24_39=", st, i);
                o3 = m7c_pf(b, o3, (int)sizeof b, f + 24, 16);
                vk_boot_logf("%s", b);
            }
        }
        if (!printed) vk_boot_logf("[ub] ubo st=%d mask=%#x (no bank bound)", st, g_m7c_bmask[st]);
    }
    if (g_m4bb_praw_ok) {
        int o4 = snprintf(b, sizeof b, "[ub] rawpre proj f0_15 (合成前游戏原文, M4bb 全局最近一次)=");
        o4 = m7c_pf(b, o4, (int)sizeof b, g_m4bb_praw, 16);
        vk_boot_logf("%s", b);
    }
    if (g_m7c_lines >= M7C_UB_MAX_LINES)
        vk_boot_logf("[ub] quota reached (%d lines) -> silence; world_n=%llu ctrl=%u scr_oob=%u",
                     M7C_UB_MAX_LINES, g_m7c_world_n, g_m7c_ctrl, g_m7c_scr_oob);
}

/* ---- M7d P1：把 n 个 float（从 arena 的 off+i0 起）拼进一行；读不到写 "unreadable"。
   纯只读：越界/空映射都不碰（数组按 64 定长，调用方给 n<=64）。 ---- */
static int bi_fl(char *b, int o, int cap, const uint8_t *arena, uint32_t off, int i0, int n)
{
    float f[64];
    if (n > (int)(sizeof f / sizeof *f)) n = (int)(sizeof f / sizeof *f);
    if (n < 0) n = 0;
    memset(f, 0, sizeof f);
    if (!arena || !off || (uint64_t)off + (uint64_t)i0 * 4ull + (uint64_t)n * 4ull > (uint64_t)R_UBO_ARENA) {
        if (o < cap - 16) o += snprintf(b + o, (size_t)(cap - o), "unreadable");
        return o;
    }
    memcpy(f, arena + off + (size_t)i0 * 4u, (size_t)n * 4u);
    for (int i = 0; i < n && o < cap - 24; i++)
        o += snprintf(b + o, (size_t)(cap - o), "%s%.6g", i ? "," : "", (double)f[i]);
    return o;
}

/* M7d P1（只读）：一条 draw 的 bind 解析链。见文件顶 g_bi_* 的说明。
   M7d P2：触发口径改成「先抓大几何」——boot#1 的 6 笔额度被 nv=3/4/9/18 的小 draw 在 t≈16 s
   就用光，等到 t≈52 s 的大 VS（nv=4218）出现时已经静默。现在 nv<512 的 WORLD draw 必须等到
   至少一笔大几何之后才允许（且全 boot 最多 2 笔），保证大 VS 一定被记录。 */
static unsigned g_bi_big_seen, g_bi_small_drawn;
static void m7d_bi_draw(const R_Key *kv, const R_Key *kf, int dvar, int si, unsigned rtw, unsigned rth,
                        int nverts)
{
    if (!SMO_M7D_BI || !kv || dvar >= 3 || si < 0 || si >= H_RT_SLOTS) return;
    if (g_bi_draws >= M7D_BI_MAX_DRAWS) return;
    const int world = g_m7c_scr_key[si] != 0;
    if (!world) {
        const unsigned sw = h_rs_dim(1600u), sh = h_rs_dim(900u);
        if (g_bi_ctrl >= 1 || rtw != sw || rth != sh) return;
        if (g_slot_dw_all[si] < 64) return;
        g_bi_ctrl++;
    } else {
        if (nverts < 512) {                       /* 小几何：让位给大 VS，且最多 2 笔 */
            if (!g_bi_big_seen || g_bi_small_drawn >= 2) return;
            g_bi_small_drawn++;
        } else g_bi_big_seen = 1;
        int vi = -1;
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < g_bi_nvs; i++) if (!strcmp(g_bi_vs[i], kv->key)) { vi = (int)i; break; }
        if (vi < 0) {
            if (g_bi_nvs >= M7D_BI_MAX_VS) return;
            vi = (int)g_bi_nvs++;
            snprintf(g_bi_vs[vi], sizeof g_bi_vs[0], "%s", kv->key);
            g_bi_vs_n[vi] = 0;
        }
        if (g_bi_vs_n[vi] >= M7D_BI_PER_VS) return;
        g_bi_vs_n[vi]++;
    }
    g_bi_draws++;
    char b[1200];
    vk_boot_logf("[bi] draw #%u tag=%s vs=%s fs=%s slot=%d ext=%ux%u dvar=%d ubo_binds=%llu st0=%llu st1=%llu",
                 g_bi_draws, world ? "WORLD" : "CTRL", kv->key, kf ? kf->key : "-", si, rtw, rth, dvar,
                 (unsigned long long)g_ubo_binds, (unsigned long long)g_ubo_stage[0],
                 (unsigned long long)g_ubo_stage[1]);
    for (int st = 0; st < 2; st++) {   /* 0=VS, 1=FS：每个 shader cbuf 槽解析到哪个 bind idx */
        const R_Key *k = st ? kf : kv;
        if (!k) continue;
        int shown = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 32 && shown < 8; i++) {
            if (!(k->cbuf_mask & (1u << i))) continue;
            shown++;
            const int ri = r_ubo_bind_idx(st, i);
            if (ri < 0 || ri >= 32) {
                vk_boot_logf("[bi] tbl st=%d c=%d ridx=-1 (c 与 c-3 都未绑定)", st, i);
                continue;
            }
            const uint32_t off = g_r_ubo_off[st][ri];
            int o = snprintf(b, sizeof b,
                             "[bi] tbl st=%d c=%d ridx=%d off=%u sz=%u gsz=%llu gaddr=%#llx bseq=%llu rew=%d f0_3=",
                             st, i, ri, off, (unsigned)g_r_ubo_sz[st][ri],
                             (unsigned long long)g_r_ubo_gsz[st][ri],
                             (unsigned long long)g_r_ubo_gaddr[st][ri],
                             (unsigned long long)g_bi_bseq[st][ri],
                             (int)(off != 0 && ((uint64_t)off == g_bi_rew_off || (uint64_t)off == g_bi_rew_soff)));
            o = bi_fl(b, o, (int)sizeof b, (const uint8_t *)g_r_ubo_map, off, 0, 4);
            o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o, " f24_27=");
            o = bi_fl(b, o, (int)sizeof b, (const uint8_t *)g_r_ubo_map, off, 24, 4);
            vk_boot_logf("%s", b);
        }
        if (!shown) vk_boot_logf("[bi] tbl st=%d mask=%#x (该 stage 的 cbuf_mask 为空)", st, k->cbuf_mask);
    }
    for (int q = 0; q < 2; q++) {   /* 关掉 M7c 保留项①：f0..f63 */
        const int bank = q ? 6 : 4;
        const int ri = r_ubo_bind_idx(0, bank);
        if (ri < 0 || ri >= 32) { vk_boot_logf("[bi] c%d ridx=-1 (未绑定)", bank); continue; }
        const uint32_t off = g_r_ubo_off[0][ri];
        int o = snprintf(b, sizeof b,
                         "[bi] c%d ridx=%d off=%u sz=%u gsz=%llu gaddr=%#llx bseq=%llu rew=%d f0_63=",
                         bank, ri, off, (unsigned)g_r_ubo_sz[0][ri],
                         (unsigned long long)g_r_ubo_gsz[0][ri],
                         (unsigned long long)g_r_ubo_gaddr[0][ri],
                         (unsigned long long)g_bi_bseq[0][ri],
                         (int)(off != 0 && ((uint64_t)off == g_bi_rew_off || (uint64_t)off == g_bi_rew_soff)));
        o = bi_fl(b, o, (int)sizeof b, (const uint8_t *)g_r_ubo_map, off, 0, 64);
        vk_boot_logf("%s", b);
    }
    {   /* r_ubo_bind_idx() 的实际返回值（关掉 M7c 保留项②）；b4/b6 与上面两行必须一致 */
        const int r0 = r_ubo_bind_idx(0, 0), r1 = r_ubo_bind_idx(0, 1), r2 = r_ubo_bind_idx(0, 2);
        const int r3 = r_ubo_bind_idx(0, 3), r4 = r_ubo_bind_idx(0, 4), r5 = r_ubo_bind_idx(0, 5);
        const int r6 = r_ubo_bind_idx(0, 6), r7 = r_ubo_bind_idx(0, 7);
        const int f4 = r_ubo_bind_idx(1, 4), f6 = r_ubo_bind_idx(1, 6);
        vk_boot_logf("[bi] ridx st=0 b0=%d b1=%d b2=%d b3=%d b4=%d b5=%d b6=%d b7=%d | st=1 b4=%d b6=%d",
                     r0, r1, r2, r3, r4, r5, r6, r7, f4, f6);
        (void)r0; (void)r1; (void)r2; (void)r3; (void)r5; (void)r7; (void)f6;
        {   /* M7d P2：(stage0, idx1) 绑定环，按时间正序 —— 「本笔 c4 之前 idx1 到底绑过哪些块」 */
            const unsigned n = g_bi_h1_n < M7D_H1_RING ? g_bi_h1_n : (unsigned)M7D_H1_RING;
            for (unsigned k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                const bi_h1 *e = &g_bi_h1[(g_bi_h1_n - n + k) % M7D_H1_RING];
                vk_boot_logf("[bi] h1 #%u/%u seq=%llu off=%u sz=%u gsz=%llu gaddr=%#llx proj=%u "
                             "f24=%g f27=%g f29=%g f38=%g f39=%g",
                             k + 1, n, (unsigned long long)e->seq, e->off, e->sz,
                             (unsigned long long)e->gsz, (unsigned long long)e->gaddr,
                             (unsigned)e->proj, (double)e->f24, (double)e->f27,
                             (double)e->f29, (double)e->f38, (double)e->f39);
            }
        }
        {   /* M7d P3：锚定是否生效（c4_pin=1 = 本笔 c4 被指到 frame_off 那块位置矩阵） */
            const int pin = m7d_pin_active();
            const int curp = m7d_c4_proj_like(g_r_ubo_off[0][1]);
            vk_boot_logf("[bi] pin c4_pin=%d hits=%u frame_off=%llu idx1_off=%u idx1_sz=%u idx1_proj=%d",
                         pin, g_bi_pin_hits, (unsigned long long)g_bi_frame_off,
                         (unsigned)g_r_ubo_off[0][1], (unsigned)g_r_ubo_sz[0][1], curp);
        }
        {   /* M4bb 投影改写：有没有发生 / 改了哪块 / 这块是不是本笔 c4 读的那块 */
            const uint32_t c4off = (r4 >= 0 && r4 < 32) ? g_r_ubo_off[0][r4] : 0;
            int o = snprintf(b, sizeof b,
                             "[bi] m4bb praw_ok=%d hits=%u rew_seq=%llu rew_off=%llu rew_sz=%u rew_gsz=%u "
                             "rew_gaddr=%#llx c4_is_rew=%d praw=",
                             g_m4bb_praw_ok, g_bi_rew_n, (unsigned long long)g_bi_rew_seq,
                             (unsigned long long)g_bi_rew_off, (unsigned)g_bi_rew_sz,
                             (unsigned)g_bi_rew_gsz, (unsigned long long)g_bi_rew_gaddr,
                             (int)(c4off != 0 && ((uint64_t)c4off == g_bi_rew_off || (uint64_t)c4off == g_bi_rew_soff)));
            o = m7c_pf(b, o, (int)sizeof b, g_m4bb_praw, 16);
            vk_boot_logf("%s", b);
        }
    }
}

/* ================= M7D6：present-quad 的 slot0 纹理取证（只读） =================
   派活单要求对 fs=9b13e5d9ac99442e（cbuf_mask=0 && ntex==1）的满屏 quad 回答三件事：
     (1) slot0 实际绑定的纹理身份：key(id) / 池地址(store) / 尺寸 / 格式 / 采样数；
     (2) 内容签名：mean rgb / 首个 texel / 非零率 / 4×4 块摘要。
         两侧都做：CPU 池字节（游戏上传了什么）+ GPU 回读（shader 实际采到什么）；
     (3) 三种情况互斥可判：白占位(应 1.0) / 真图内容 0.5 / 不可解析回落。
   另附 RT 归属 + 清屏时间线（谁在什么时候清成 0.5）与 800×450 vs 1600×900 的尺寸判决。
   预算：前 12 笔 print；GPU 回读 ≤4 次（每次 33 个 copy region + 一次 submit/fence）。 */
typedef struct {
    unsigned long long npx, sum[3], nz, blk[16][3], blkn[16];
    unsigned char first[4];
    int first_ok;
} m7d6_sig_t;

static void m7d6_acc(m7d6_sig_t *o, const uint8_t *px, unsigned blk)
{
    for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) { o->sum[c] += px[c]; o->blk[blk][c] += px[c]; }
    o->blkn[blk]++;
    if (px[0] | px[1] | px[2]) o->nz++;
    o->npx++;
}

/* GPU 回读：32 个等距行 × 32 个等距列 + 显式 (0,0) 单点。bpp 只支持 4（与 r_tex_signature 同口径）。 */
static int m7d6_gpu_sig(VkImage img, VkImageLayout lay, unsigned w, unsigned h, unsigned bpp, m7d6_sig_t *o)
{
    if (!img || !g_on || !g_dev || !g_q || !o || w == 0 || h == 0 || bpp != 4) return 0;
    VkAccessFlags src_acc; VkPipelineStageFlags src_stage;
    if (lay == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL) {
        src_acc = VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT; src_stage = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT;
    } else if (lay == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL) {
        src_acc = VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT | VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT;
        src_stage = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT;
    } else if (lay == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL) {
        src_acc = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT; src_stage = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT;
    } else return 0;
    const unsigned rows = 32;
    const VkDeviceSize rowb = (VkDeviceSize)w * bpp;
    const VkDeviceSize sz = rowb * rows + 16;
    VkBuffer buf = VK_NULL_HANDLE; VkDeviceMemory mem = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkBufferCreateInfo bi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO };
    bi.size = sz; bi.usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT; bi.sharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE;
    if (vkCreateBuffer(g_dev, &bi, NULL, &buf) != VK_SUCCESS) return 0;
    VkMemoryRequirements rq; vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(g_dev, buf, &rq);
    int ti = find_type(rq, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT);
    VkMemoryAllocateInfo ai = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO };
    ai.allocationSize = rq.size; ai.memoryTypeIndex = ti >= 0 ? (uint32_t)ti : 0;
    if (vkAllocateMemory(g_dev, &ai, NULL, &mem) != VK_SUCCESS) { vkDestroyBuffer(g_dev, buf, NULL); return 0; }
    vkBindBufferMemory(g_dev, buf, mem, 0);
    VkCommandBuffer cb = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo ca = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO };
    ca.commandPool = g_h_cp; ca.level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY; ca.commandBufferCount = 1;
    int ok = 0;
    if (vkAllocateCommandBuffers(g_dev, &ca, &cb) == VK_SUCCESS) {
        VkCommandBufferBeginInfo cbi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO };
        cbi.flags = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT;
        vkBeginCommandBuffer(cb, &cbi);
        VkImageSubresourceRange rng = { VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1 };
        VkImageMemoryBarrier b = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER };
        b.srcAccessMask = src_acc; b.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT;
        b.oldLayout = lay; b.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL;
        b.srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED; b.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
        b.image = img; b.subresourceRange = rng;
        vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, src_stage, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, 0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &b);
        {   /* (0,0) 单点：派活单要的「第一个 texel」 */
            VkBufferImageCopy reg = {0};
            reg.bufferOffset = 0;
            reg.imageSubresource = (VkImageSubresourceLayers){ VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1 };
            reg.imageOffset = (VkOffset3D){ 0, 0, 0 };
            reg.imageExtent = (VkExtent3D){ 1, 1, 1 };
            vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer(cb, img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, buf, 1, &reg);
        }
        for (unsigned k = 0; k < rows; k++) {
            VkBufferImageCopy reg = {0};
            reg.bufferOffset = 16 + rowb * k;
            reg.imageSubresource = (VkImageSubresourceLayers){ VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1 };
            reg.imageOffset = (VkOffset3D){ 0, (int32_t)((uint64_t)h * k / rows), 0 };
            reg.imageExtent = (VkExtent3D){ w, 1, 1 };
            vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer(cb, img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, buf, 1, &reg);
        }
        VkImageMemoryBarrier b2 = b;
        b2.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT; b2.dstAccessMask = src_acc;
        b2.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL; b2.newLayout = lay;
        vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, src_stage, 0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &b2);
        vkEndCommandBuffer(cb);
        VkSubmitInfo si = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO };
        si.commandBufferCount = 1; si.pCommandBuffers = &cb;
        vkResetFences(g_dev, 1, &g_h_fence);
        VkResult sr = vkQueueSubmit(g_q, 1, &si, g_h_fence);
        if (sr == VK_SUCCESS && nvk_wait_fences(g_dev, 1, &g_h_fence, VK_TRUE, 5000000000ull) == VK_SUCCESS) ok = 1;
        else vk_boot_logf("[m7d6] gpu sig submit=%d (%s)", (int)sr, vr(sr));
        vkFreeCommandBuffers(g_dev, g_h_cp, 1, &cb);
        if (ok) {
            void *map = NULL;
            if (vkMapMemory(g_dev, mem, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE, 0, &map) == VK_SUCCESS && map) {
                memset(o, 0, sizeof *o);
                memcpy(o->first, map, 4); o->first_ok = 1;
                for (unsigned k = 0; k < rows; k++) {
                    const uint8_t *row = (const uint8_t *)map + 16 + rowb * k;
                    for (unsigned j = 0; j < 32; j++) {
                        unsigned x = (unsigned)((uint64_t)w * (2 * j + 1) / 64);
                        if (x >= w) x = w - 1;
                        m7d6_acc(o, row + (size_t)x * bpp, (k / 8) * 4 + j / 8);
                    }
                }
                vkUnmapMemory(g_dev, mem);
            } else ok = 0;
        }
    }
    vkDestroyBuffer(g_dev, buf, NULL); vkFreeMemory(g_dev, mem, NULL);
    return ok;
}

/* CPU 池字节：guest 上传源（本后端 GPU 地址=CPU 指针）。只按字节统计，不做格式解释——
   「是不是均匀 0.5」与格式无关；RGB10A2 之类的字节序差异写在报告里，不在这里猜。 */
static int m7d6_pool_sig(unsigned long long store, unsigned w, unsigned h, unsigned bpp, m7d6_sig_t *o)
{
    if (store < 0x10000ull || w == 0 || h == 0 || w > 16384 || h > 16384) return 0;
    if (bpp < 2 || bpp > 4) return 0;
    if ((unsigned long long)w * h * bpp > (1ull << 30)) return 0;
    const uint8_t *base = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)store;
    memset(o, 0, sizeof *o);
    const size_t stride = (size_t)w * bpp;
    for (unsigned k = 0; k < 32; k++) {
        const uint8_t *row = base + stride * (size_t)((uint64_t)h * k / 32);
        for (unsigned j = 0; j < 32; j++) {
            unsigned x = (unsigned)((uint64_t)w * (2 * j + 1) / 64);
            if (x >= w) x = w - 1;
            m7d6_acc(o, row + (size_t)x * bpp, (k / 8) * 4 + j / 8);
        }
    }
    if (o->npx) {
        size_t avail = stride;                    /* 首行可用字节 */
        memcpy(o->first, base, avail >= 4 ? 4 : avail);
        o->first_ok = 1;
    }
    return o->npx > 0;
}

static void m7d6_blk_str(const m7d6_sig_t *o, char *b, size_t n)
{
    int off = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 16 && off < (int)n - 4; i++) {
        unsigned long long r = o->blkn[i] ? o->blk[i][0] / o->blkn[i] : 0;
        unsigned long long g = o->blkn[i] ? o->blk[i][1] / o->blkn[i] : 0;
        unsigned long long bl = o->blkn[i] ? o->blk[i][2] / o->blkn[i] : 0;
        unsigned luma = (unsigned)((r * 77 + g * 150 + bl * 29) >> 8);
        off += snprintf(b + off, n - (size_t)off, "%02x", luma & 0xffu);
    }
    if (off == 0) snprintf(b, n, "-");
}

/* 16 个块的亮度是否一致（±1）⇒ 整张图均匀。0.5 灰在 8bit 下 = 128；10bit 打包见报告口径。 */
static int m7d6_uniform(const m7d6_sig_t *o, unsigned *luma_out)
{
    if (!o->npx) return 0;
    unsigned lo = 255, hi = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        if (!o->blkn[i]) return 0;
        unsigned long long r = o->blk[i][0] / o->blkn[i];
        unsigned long long g = o->blk[i][1] / o->blkn[i];
        unsigned long long bl = o->blk[i][2] / o->blkn[i];
        unsigned luma = (unsigned)((r * 77 + g * 150 + bl * 29) >> 8);
        if (luma < lo) lo = luma;
        if (luma > hi) hi = luma;
    }
    if (luma_out) *luma_out = lo;
    return (hi <= lo + 1) ? 1 : 0;
}

static unsigned long long g_m7d6_seen, g_m7d6_full, g_m7d6_gpu_n, g_m7d6_gpu_last_us;

static const char *m7d6_kname(int kind)
{
    return kind == NVN_VK_SLOT_RT_SELF ? "rt-self" : kind == NVN_VK_SLOT_RT_OTHER ? "rt-other"
         : kind == NVN_VK_SLOT_TEX ? "tex" : kind == NVN_VK_SLOT_PLACEHOLDER ? "placeholder"
         : kind == NVN_VK_SLOT_DEPTH_NR ? "depth-nr" : "none";
}

static void m7d6_probe(unsigned long long n, const R_Key *kv, const R_Key *kf,
                       int count, unsigned nverts, int topo, int dvar, int inst)
{
    if (!kf) return;
    g_m7d6_seen++;
    if (g_m7d6_full >= 12) {
        if ((g_m7d6_seen % 2000) == 0)
            vk_boot_logf("[m7d6] seen=%llu (12-line cap reached; the FS keeps drawing)", g_m7d6_seen);
        return;
    }
    g_m7d6_full++;

    vk_boot_logf("[m7d6] draw#%llu vs=%s fs=%s topo=%d idx=%d verts=%u dvar=%d inst=%d "
                 "tgt=%s ext=%ux%u cur_slot=%d cur_key=%#llx cur_id=%d | cbuf_mask=%#x ntex=%d",
                 n, kv ? kv->key : "?", kf->key, topo, count, nverts, dvar, inst,
                 g_rt_cur ? "gameRT" : "hostRT", (unsigned)g_rt_w, (unsigned)g_rt_h,
                 g_rt_cur ? (int)(g_rt_cur - g_rt_tab) : -1,
                 (unsigned long long)(g_rt_cur ? g_rt_cur->key : 0ull),
                 g_rt_cur ? (int)g_rt_cur->tex_id : -1,
                 (unsigned)kf->cbuf_mask, kf->ntex);

    /* ---- slot0 身份 ---- */
    VkImageView v = g_r_tx_view[0];
    nvn_vk_tex *t = g_r_tx_texobj[0];
    VkImage img = VK_NULL_HANDLE; VkImageLayout lay = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
    unsigned iw = 0, ih = 0, bpp = 0; const char *what = "none";
    int have = (kf->ntex > 0) ? r_fs_slot_image(0, &img, &lay, &iw, &ih, &bpp, &what) : 0;
    vk_boot_logf("[m7d6] slot0 id=%d guest=%ux%u fmt=%#x kind=%s up=%d store=%#llx | view=%#llx "
                 "src=%s img=%#llx ext=%ux%u lay=%d bpp=%u | texobj img=%#llx ext=%ux%u lay=%d lv=%u vkfmt=%u samples=%d",
                 g_r_tx_info[0].id, g_r_tx_info[0].w, g_r_tx_info[0].h, (unsigned)g_r_tx_info[0].fmt,
                 m7d6_kname(g_r_tx_info[0].kind), g_r_tx_info[0].up,
                 (unsigned long long)g_r_tx_info[0].store,
                 (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)v, what,
                 (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)img, have ? iw : 0u, have ? ih : 0u, (int)lay, bpp,
                 t ? (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)t->img : 0ull,
                 t ? t->w : 0u, t ? t->h : 0u, t ? (int)t->layout : -1,
                 t ? t->levels : 0u, t ? (unsigned)nvn_vk_tex_vkfmt(t) : 0u,
                 t ? (int)t->d.samples : -1);

    /* ---- 描述符里真正写进去的 view（绑定是否生效的铁证） ---- */
    int ds_ok = (g_m7d6_ds_key0[0] != 0) && (strcmp(g_m7d6_ds_key0, kf->key) == 0) &&
                (g_m7d6_ds_gen0 == kf->tex_gen);
    vk_boot_logf("[m7d6] ds0 key=%s gen=%u cur_gen=%u view=%#llx white=%#llx slotview=%#llx "
                 "ds_ok=%d eq_slot=%d eq_white=%d",
                 g_m7d6_ds_key0[0] ? g_m7d6_ds_key0 : "<never>", g_m7d6_ds_gen0, kf->tex_gen,
                 (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_m7d6_ds_view0,
                 (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_r_tex_view,
                 (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_r_tx_view[0], ds_ok,
                 (int)(g_m7d6_ds_view0 == g_r_tx_view[0]),
                 (int)(g_m7d6_ds_view0 == g_r_tex_view));

    /* ---- 内容签名（CPU 池 + GPU 回读） ---- */
    m7d6_sig_t sp, sg; memset(&sp, 0, sizeof sp); memset(&sg, 0, sizeof sg);
    int pok = m7d6_pool_sig(g_r_tx_info[0].store, g_r_tx_info[0].w, g_r_tx_info[0].h, bpp, &sp);
    char bp[64], bg[64];
    if (pok) {
        m7d6_blk_str(&sp, bp, sizeof bp);
        vk_boot_logf("[m7d6] cpu_pool npx=%llu bytes_mean=%llu/%llu/%llu first=%u,%u,%u,%u nz=%llu.%02llu%% blk4x4=%s",
                     sp.npx, sp.sum[0] / sp.npx, sp.sum[1] / sp.npx, sp.sum[2] / sp.npx,
                     sp.first[0], sp.first[1], sp.first[2], sp.first[3],
                     sp.nz * 100ull / sp.npx, (sp.nz * 10000ull / sp.npx) % 100ull, bp);
    } else {
        vk_boot_logf("[m7d6] cpu_pool n/a (store=%#llx bpp=%u guest=%ux%u) — 池地址不可读或格式非 32bpp",
                     (unsigned long long)g_r_tx_info[0].store, bpp,
                     g_r_tx_info[0].w, g_r_tx_info[0].h);
    }
    struct timespec tsg; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &tsg);
    unsigned long long now_us = (unsigned long long)tsg.tv_sec * 1000000ull + (unsigned long long)tsg.tv_nsec / 1000ull;
    int gok = 0;
    if (have && bpp == 4 && g_m7d6_gpu_n < 4 &&
        (g_m7d6_gpu_n == 0 || now_us - g_m7d6_gpu_last_us >= 3000000ull) &&
        (g_m7d6_full <= 3 || g_m7d6_seen >= 1000)) {
        gok = m7d6_gpu_sig(img, lay, iw, ih, bpp, &sg);
        if (gok) { g_m7d6_gpu_n++; g_m7d6_gpu_last_us = now_us; }
    }
    unsigned gluma = 0, guni = 0;
    if (gok) {
        m7d6_blk_str(&sg, bg, sizeof bg);
        guni = m7d6_uniform(&sg, &gluma);
        vk_boot_logf("[m7d6] gpu_img npx=%llu mean=%llu/%llu/%llu first=%u,%u,%u,%u nz=%llu.%02llu%% "
                     "blk4x4=%s uniform=%d luma=%u",
                     sg.npx, sg.sum[0] / sg.npx, sg.sum[1] / sg.npx, sg.sum[2] / sg.npx,
                     sg.first[0], sg.first[1], sg.first[2], sg.first[3],
                     sg.nz * 100ull / sg.npx, (sg.nz * 10000ull / sg.npx) % 100ull, bg, guni, gluma);
    } else {
        vk_boot_logf("[m7d6] gpu_img n/a (have=%d bpp=%u gpu_n=%llu lay=%d)", have, bpp, g_m7d6_gpu_n, (int)lay);
    }

    /* ---- 三选一判决 ---- */
    const char *vc;
    if (!ds_ok)
        vc = "CASE1-BINDING-NEVER-TOOK-EFFECT(ds0 key/gen mismatch => descriptor for this FS was never written; sampling undefined/hw default)";
    else if (g_m7d6_ds_view0 == VK_NULL_HANDLE || g_m7d6_ds_view0 == g_r_tex_view)
        vc = "CASE1-WHITE-PLACEHOLDER(1x1 white => shader must output 1.0; if screen is 0.5 the tint/attr path is the writer, not the texture)";
    else if (!have)
        vc = "CASE3-UNRESOLVABLE(view bound but no VkImage resolvable => fallback path; content unknown by construction)";
    else if (gok && guni && gluma >= 120 && gluma <= 136)
        vc = "CASE2-REAL-IMAGE-CONTENT-IS-0.5(uniform grey 128 found => find the clear that produced it, see owner line)";
    else if (gok && guni)
        vc = "CASE2-REAL-IMAGE-UNIFORM-BUT-NOT-0.5(uniform, see luma => output should equal this luma, not 0.5)";
    else if (gok)
        vc = "CASE2-REAL-IMAGE-WITH-CONTENT(uniform=0 => output must vary spatially; flat 0.5 would contradict the sample)";
    else
        vc = "CASE2-REAL-IMAGE(content readback skipped; identity is a real view, not the white placeholder)";
    vk_boot_logf("[m7d6] verdict=%s", vc);

    /* ---- RT 归属 + 清屏时间线 ---- */
    int rts = -1, shadow = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < H_RT_SLOTS; i++) {
        h_rt_slot *s = &g_rt_tab[i];
        if (!s->key) continue;
        if (img && s->img == img) { rts = i; shadow = 0; break; }
        if (img && s->s_img == img) { rts = i; shadow = 1; break; }
    }
    if (rts >= 0) {
        h_rt_slot *s = &g_rt_tab[rts];
        VkImage ki = shadow ? s->s_img : s->img;
        k_img_t *ke = NULL;
        for (int i = 0; i < g_k_img_n; i++) if (g_k_img[i].img == ki) { ke = &g_k_img[i]; break; }
        vk_boot_logf("[m7d6] owner rt_slot=%d shadow=%d key=%#llx tex_id=%d ext=%ux%u fmt=%#x last_use=%llu "
                     "| kimg=%d clears=%llu lastclear=%.3f,%.3f,%.3f,%.3f src=%s lastclear_f=%llu lastclear_d=%llu "
                     "draws=%llu big=%llu",
                     rts, shadow, (unsigned long long)s->key, (int)s->tex_id,
                     (unsigned)s->w, (unsigned)s->h, (unsigned)s->fmt,
                     (unsigned long long)s->last_use,
                     ke ? 1 : 0, ke ? ke->clears : 0ull,
                     ke ? ke->lastclear[0] : 0.0f, ke ? ke->lastclear[1] : 0.0f,
                     ke ? ke->lastclear[2] : 0.0f, ke ? ke->lastclear[3] : 0.0f,
                     (ke && ke->clears) ? (ke->lastclear_src ? "game" : "ours") : "none",
                     ke ? ke->lastclear_f : 0ull, ke ? ke->lastclear_d : 0ull,
                     ke ? ke->draws : 0ull, ke ? ke->big : 0ull);
    } else {
        vk_boot_logf("[m7d6] owner rt_slot=-1 (sampled image is not in the RT table; src=%s texobj=%d) "
                     "=> sampling a guest texture/upload, not our RT", what, t ? 1 : 0);
    }

    /* ---- 尺寸判决（800x450 vs 1600x900） ---- */
    { int rt1600 = 0, same_key = 0, tgt_same = 0;
      for (int i = 0; i < H_RT_SLOTS; i++) {
          h_rt_slot *s = &g_rt_tab[i];
          if (!s->key) continue;
          if (s->w == 1600u && s->h == 900u) rt1600++;
          if (g_r_tx_info[0].store && s->key == g_r_tx_info[0].store) same_key++;
          if (img && (s->img == img || s->s_img == img) && s == g_rt_cur) tgt_same = 1;
      }
      vk_boot_logf("[m7d6] size quad_tgt=%ux%u sampled=%ux%u guest_slot=%ux%u SMO_RT_DIV=%d half1600=%ux%u "
                   "rt1600_slots=%d same_store_as_rt=%d sampled_is_current_tgt=%d",
                   (unsigned)g_rt_w, (unsigned)g_rt_h, have ? iw : 0u, have ? ih : 0u,
                   g_r_tx_info[0].w, g_r_tx_info[0].h, (int)h_rt_div(),
                   h_rs_dim(1600u), h_rs_dim(900u), rt1600, same_key, tgt_same); }
}

/* ================= M7D7：RT 目标路由表（每张 RT 的 draws/verts/selfread + 内容摘要 + present 相关性） =================
   问题：present quad 采样的是 RT282，而场景 draw 落在哪张、两者是否同一张、是否自采样（feedback）。
   三种事实一次打全：
     (1) 每张被当颜色目标绑过的 RT：slot / tex_id / ext / fmt / draws / verts / selfread / donly；
     (2) 最大接收者的内容摘要（复用 M7D6 的 32×32 回读 + 4×4 块），以及它「是否在同一帧被 present quad
         当作 slot0 采样」的计数（pq_samples / pq_same_frame）；
     (3) 选择点：目标 = nvn_vk_rt_bind()（SET_RENDER_TARGETS），采样 = nvn_vk_bind_texture_slot()
         （bind_textures 回放）。两者若指向同一张即 feedback。
   开销：每笔一个数组自增 + ntex 次指针比较；表每 10000 笔打一次（首表 2000 笔）；GPU 摘要 ≤3 次。 */
static unsigned long long g_c_frame;   /* 定义在下方 clear 段；此处前置声明（tentative，C 允许） */
typedef struct {
    unsigned long long draws, verts, selfread, donly, pq_samples, pq_same;
    int tex_id; unsigned w, h, fmt; uint64_t key;
} m7d7_led_t;
static m7d7_led_t g_m7d7_led[H_RT_SLOTS];
static unsigned long long g_m7d7_draws, g_m7d7_next_print = 2000, g_m7d7_gpu_n, g_m7d7_gpu_t;
static unsigned long long g_m7d7_fr_targets[4], g_m7d7_fr_id = ~0ull;

static void m7d7_frame_note(int slot)
{
    if (g_c_frame != g_m7d7_fr_id) {
        g_m7d7_fr_id = g_c_frame;
        memset(g_m7d7_fr_targets, 0, sizeof g_m7d7_fr_targets);
    }
    if (slot >= 0 && slot < H_RT_SLOTS)
        g_m7d7_fr_targets[slot >> 6] |= 1ull << (slot & 63);
}

static void m7d7_print(void)
{
    int idx[H_RT_SLOTS], n = 0;
    unsigned long long tot = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < H_RT_SLOTS; i++) {
        if (!g_m7d7_led[i].draws) continue;
        idx[n++] = i; tot += g_m7d7_led[i].draws;
    }
    /* 插入排序取前 10（n<=256） */
    for (int a = 1; a < n; a++) {
        int v = idx[a], b = a - 1;
        while (b >= 0 && g_m7d7_led[idx[b]].draws < g_m7d7_led[v].draws) { idx[b + 1] = idx[b]; b--; }
        idx[b + 1] = v;
    }
    vk_boot_logf("[m7d7] rt table color_draws=%llu slots=%d", tot, n);
    int top = n > 0 ? idx[0] : -1;
    for (int a = 0; a < n && a < 10; a++) {
        m7d7_led_t *e = &g_m7d7_led[idx[a]];
        vk_boot_logf("[m7d7] rt slot=%d key=%#llx tex_id=%d ext=%ux%u fmt=%#x draws=%llu verts=%llu "
                     "selfread=%llu donly=%llu pq_samples=%llu pq_same_frame=%llu",
                     idx[a], (unsigned long long)e->key, e->tex_id, e->w, e->h, (unsigned)e->fmt,
                     e->draws, e->verts, e->selfread, e->donly, e->pq_samples, e->pq_same);
    }
    if (top < 0) return;
    /* (2) 最大接收者的内容摘要（GPU 回读，预算 3 次 / ≥5 s） */
    struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    unsigned long long now_us = (unsigned long long)ts.tv_sec * 1000000ull + (unsigned long long)ts.tv_nsec / 1000ull;
    h_rt_slot *s = &g_rt_tab[top];
    m7d6_sig_t sg; memset(&sg, 0, sizeof sg);
    int gok = 0;
    if (s->img && g_m7d7_gpu_n < 3 && (g_m7d7_gpu_n == 0 || now_us - g_m7d7_gpu_t >= 5000000ull) &&
        (s->layout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL ||
         s->layout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL ||
         s->layout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL)) {
        gok = m7d6_gpu_sig(s->img, s->layout, s->w, s->h, 4, &sg);
        if (gok) { g_m7d7_gpu_n++; g_m7d7_gpu_t = now_us; }
    }
    if (gok) {
        char bl[64]; m7d6_blk_str(&sg, bl, sizeof bl);
        unsigned luma = 0, uni = m7d6_uniform(&sg, &luma);
        vk_boot_logf("[m7d7] top slot=%d tex_id=%d ext=%ux%u mean=%llu/%llu/%llu first=%u,%u,%u,%u "
                     "nz=%llu.%02llu%% uniform=%d luma=%u blk4x4=%s | present_quad_samples_it=%llu same_frame=%llu",
                     top, s->tex_id, (unsigned)s->w, (unsigned)s->h,
                     sg.sum[0] / (sg.npx ? sg.npx : 1), sg.sum[1] / (sg.npx ? sg.npx : 1),
                     sg.sum[2] / (sg.npx ? sg.npx : 1),
                     sg.first[0], sg.first[1], sg.first[2], sg.first[3],
                     sg.nz * 100ull / (sg.npx ? sg.npx : 1), (sg.nz * 10000ull / (sg.npx ? sg.npx : 1)) % 100ull,
                     uni, luma, bl, g_m7d7_led[top].pq_samples, g_m7d7_led[top].pq_same);
    } else {
        vk_boot_logf("[m7d7] top slot=%d tex_id=%d ext=%ux%u digest=n/a(gpu_n=%llu lay=%d) "
                     "present_quad_samples_it=%llu same_frame=%llu",
                     top, s->tex_id, (unsigned)s->w, (unsigned)s->h, g_m7d7_gpu_n, (int)s->layout,
                     g_m7d7_led[top].pq_samples, g_m7d7_led[top].pq_same);
    }
}

/* 每笔颜色 draw 记一次；is_pq = fs 是 present quad 的合成程序。 */
static void m7d7_record(const R_Key *kf, int nverts, int dvar, int is_pq)
{
    if (!g_rt_cur) return;
    int i = (int)(g_rt_cur - g_rt_tab);
    if (i < 0 || i >= H_RT_SLOTS) return;
    m7d7_led_t *e = &g_m7d7_led[i];
    e->key = g_rt_cur->key; e->tex_id = (int)g_rt_cur->tex_id;
    e->w = g_rt_cur->w; e->h = g_rt_cur->h; e->fmt = g_rt_cur->fmt;
    if (dvar) { e->donly++; return; }
    e->draws++;
    e->verts += (unsigned long long)nverts;
    m7d7_frame_note(i);
    int ntex = kf ? (kf->ntex < NVN_TX_SLOTS ? kf->ntex : NVN_TX_SLOTS) : 0;
    int self = 0;
    for (int sl = 0; sl < ntex; sl++) {
        VkImageView v = g_r_tx_view[sl];
        if (!v) continue;
        if (v == g_rt_cur->view || (g_rt_cur->s_view && v == g_rt_cur->s_view)) self = 1;
    }
    if (self) e->selfread++;
    if (is_pq) {
        /* present quad：它 slot0 的图属于哪个 RT 槽（同帧被画过 = pq_same） */
        int si = -1;
        for (int j = 0; j < H_RT_SLOTS; j++) {
            h_rt_slot *s = &g_rt_tab[j];
            if (!s->key) continue;
            if (g_r_tx_view[0] == s->view || (s->s_view && g_r_tx_view[0] == s->s_view)) { si = j; break; }
        }
        if (si >= 0) {
            g_m7d7_led[si].pq_samples++;
            if (g_m7d7_fr_targets[si >> 6] & (1ull << (si & 63))) g_m7d7_led[si].pq_same++;
        }
    }
    if (++g_m7d7_draws >= g_m7d7_next_print) {
        g_m7d7_next_print = g_m7d7_draws + 10000;
        m7d7_print();
    }
}

static int draw_elements_body(int mode, int type, int count, uint64_t idx, int base_vertex, int base_instance,
                              int instances, int dclass);

/* ================= M7f P1：`[vf]` 世界几何顶点/矩阵原文 + CPU 复算裁剪 =================
   派活单的问题：**世界几何到底落在裁剪空间的哪里**。这里只读、只打日志：
     · `[vf] draw=…`  头行：mode/vs/fs/slot/texid/ext/nverts/nidx/topo/dvar/nattr/inst/cbmask；
     · `[vf] a<k> …`  逐属性：loc/fmt/stream/off/stride/base/real + 展开后前 8 个 vec4（GPU 将读到的确切 float）；
     · `[vf] m4 …` / `m6 …`  本笔 shader 真正读的那块 c4（bank4→bind idx1，sticky 槽）与 c6（bank6→bind idx3）
                       各 64 个 float（m6 再补最后一根骨 f276_287，供离线验骨表长度）；
     · `[vf] ibo …`   原始索引前 16 个（+baseVertex 单列，不混进原值）；
     · `[vf] clip …`  CPU 复算 clip = M4·(skin ? Σ w_i·M6_i·v : v)：每顶点 x/y/z/w + 任务判据
                       |x|<=|w| && |y|<=|w| && 0<=z<=w 的通过位 + 映射到的帧缓冲像素；
     · `[rs] …`        这笔真正用的光栅状态（cull/front/depthTest/depthWrite/cmp/drange/vp/sc/ra/ext）。
   分类沿用 [ub] 的既有口径：WORLD = scratch 槽（g_m7c_scr_key[si]!=0），CTRL = 非 scratch 的 1600x900 槽
   且整 boot 已写 >=64 笔。额度：WORLD 大几何 2 笔（nv>=512）+ 小几何 2 笔（仅在大几何还没出现时用）+
   CTRL 1 笔，另有总行数硬上限 ⇒ 分类写错也灌不爆日志。
   开关：只走编译期常量（规则：沙箱 shell 建不了新文件 ⇒ 不用文件开关）。回退 = 把 M7F_VF_ON 改 0。 */
#define M7F_VF_ON       1
#define M7F_VF_VERTS    8
#define M7F_MAX_LINES   260
/* M7f P2 计划（boot#2 用）：第一笔大几何总是在装载期，量到的是装载模型的裁剪结果。
   M7F_LATE_MS 之后（= 世界舞台装载开始后的窗口）再放开 2 个额度，让「世界里的几何」也有自己的快照。
   boot#1 实测世界装载在 t≈160 s 开始（opens 464→1244），故取 180 s。 */
#define M7F_LATE_MS     180000ull
static unsigned g_m7f_wbig, g_m7f_wsmall, g_m7f_ctrl, g_m7f_lines;
static unsigned long long g_m7f_t0;

/* loc → 展开数组下标（-1 = 该 loc 没绑）。展开数组按属性声明顺序排，不保证 loc 连续。 */
static int m7f_attr_by_loc(const uint32_t *attrloc, int nattr, int loc)
{
    for (int k = 0; k < nattr; k++) if ((int)attrloc[k] == loc) return k;
    return -1;
}

/* 任务给的裁剪判据原样：|x|<=|w| && |y|<=|w| && 0<=z<=w（Vulkan 零到一深度）。
   不做任何宽容修正：w<=0 的点靠这一位 + 后面打印的 w 一起被人看出来，而不是被悄悄算成"通过"。 */
static int m7f_in_clip(const float q[4])
{
    const float ax = q[0] < 0.0f ? -q[0] : q[0];
    const float ay = q[1] < 0.0f ? -q[1] : q[1];
    const float aw = q[3] < 0.0f ? -q[3] : q[3];
    return (ax <= aw && ay <= aw && q[2] >= 0.0f && q[2] <= q[3]) ? 1 : 0;
}

/* ================= M5v P1：gmem 运行期搬迁 =================
   见 R_GM_* 段的长注释。这里的纪律：
   ① 只对 uses_gmem 的 key 调用（调用点在 draw 的 dynamic offset 构造处）；
   ② 只改**私有 arena 副本**（新 bump 一个 4 KiB slot），游戏原槽一个字节都不动；
   ③ 找不到客体地址就返回 0 ⇒ 调用方沿用原偏移（等价旧行为：shader 读 0），不做任何猜测；
   ④ 搬迁跨度由调用方按「实例数×64B」给上界，超过 R_GM_MAX_SPAN 就不搬（只记账），
      保证 shader 落点仍在 SSBO 内。 */
/* ================= M5x P1：gmem 搬迁改成「draw 时刻从客体重读」 =================
   M5v 的搬迁只扫 bind 时刻的 arena 副本，实测 relocs 恒 0（M5w b2 三个 probe：字节 68/72
   是 0 / 1.0f）。离线解 SPIR-V（/tmp/m5x_d9097b8aba3a7080.0.spv）确认了语义：
       low = cb0[17].x, high = cb0[17].y  ⇒ 64 位 buffer 基址在**字节 68/72**；
       ga = low - 0x80000000, gh = high - borrow, ok = (gh==0 && ga < 0x40000000)。
   而游戏每 submit 一次 `nvnCommandBufferUpdateUniformBuffer(buf, off=16, n=64)`
   （[u] upd dst=0x6e287d3010）正好覆盖 16..79 ⇒ 绑定副本必然比 draw 时刻旧。
   所以这里：① 按 resolved bind index 的客体地址重读 4096 B；② 逐值做映射校验
   （/proc/self/maps 区间 + 真实可读探测，**不用任何硬编码窗口**）；③ 只改私有 arena 副本。 */
extern int runtime_range_of(uint64_t a, uint64_t *lo, uint64_t *hi);   /* loader.c M5x */
extern unsigned runtime_maps_dropped(void);
extern unsigned runtime_maps_entries(void);
static unsigned long long g_gm_fresh_reads, g_gm_fresh_bytes, g_gm_fresh_bad, g_gm_map_miss, g_gm_noreloc;
static unsigned long long g_gm_noreloc_cap;   /* M5y：heap 拿不到门大小 ⇒ 只清指针的笔数（与「找不到指针」分开） */
static unsigned long long g_gm_oob_skip;      /* M5y：instance 索引上界超过 1 MiB slot ⇒ 不搬的笔数（安全侧） */

/* ================= M5y P2：画面归因（只读，不改任何判定） =================
   回答三个数字问题：
   ① 世界 pass 到底画进了哪张 RT（按 (rt key, texid, ext) 累积 draw 数 + top (vs,fs)）；
   ② 这些 draw 的 FS 声明了几个纹理槽、其中多少槽的描述符落到 1x1 白占位（= 未绑定/解析失败 ⇒ 白模型）；
   ③ 传送器上传了多少纹理、有多少「首 4 KiB 全零」（= 采样到全零 albedo）。
   统计口径只在真正下发 vkCmdDrawIndexed 之后调用（与 g_slot_dw 同点），不含 skip。 */
#define R_TC_MAX 10
#define R_TC_TOP 4
typedef struct { char vs[17], fs[17]; unsigned long long n; } R_CenPair;
typedef struct { uint64_t key; int texid; unsigned w, h; unsigned long long n;
                 R_CenPair top[R_TC_TOP]; int ntop; } R_TgtCen;
static R_TgtCen g_tc[R_TC_MAX];
static int g_tc_n;
static unsigned long long g_tc_host;      /* 颜色 draw 落到宿主兜底图（无游戏 RT 身份）的笔数 */
static unsigned long long g_tc_ovf;
static unsigned long long g_tx_exp, g_tx_empty, g_tx_rt, g_tx_real;

/* ================= M5z P0：空纹理槽归因（只读，不改任何判定） =================
   目的：把 `[b] tex bind` 的 empty_white 拆成**可执行的类别**，并给出「按 fs 键 / 按 binding 号」
   的 Top 表。类别口径（判据全部来自槽上已记的状态，不新增任何猜测）：
     never_bound   —— 该槽从来没被任何一次 bind_textures 覆盖过（diag.binds==0）；
     cap_idimg     —— 绑过，但被我们自己的 id 图上限挡下（-31/-32/-33）；
     heat_gate     —— 绑过，但被热度门槛/大图配额挡下（-30/-12）；
     budget        —— 绑过，但被共享字节/笔数预算挡下（-4）；
     no_snapshot   —— 绑过，但句柄解析不到快照（-20）；
     upload_fail   —— 绑过，但上送/建图失败（-2..-12 其余：MSAA/越界/格式/布局/几何/内存）；
     cleared       —— 绑过且当时成功（why>0），但此刻槽里没有 view（被 forget/换绑清掉）；
     other         —— 其余（why=0 且 binds>0 等）。
   另记两列与「修得动修不动」直接相关的数：
     zero_content  —— 有真图但上送时首 4 KiB 全零（= 采样到 0，不是白占位，另一类问题）；
     fixable       —— 空槽，但该槽的 id 有可用快照（挡它的只有我们自己的配额/门槛）⇒ 给图就能修。 */
#define R_TM_KEYS 512
#define R_TM_WHY 8
#define R_TM_TOPSLOT 8
enum { TM_NEVER_BOUND = 0, TM_CAP_IDIMG, TM_HEAT_GATE, TM_BUDGET, TM_UPLOAD_FAIL,
       TM_NO_SNAPSHOT, TM_CLEARED, TM_OTHER, TM_NWHY };
static const char *const g_tm_why_name[R_TM_WHY] = {
    "never_bound", "cap_idimg(-31/-32)", "heat_gate(-30)", "budget(-4)",
    "upload_fail(-2..-12)", "no_snapshot(-20)", "cleared_after_bind", "other"
};
typedef struct {
    char fs[17];
    unsigned long long exp, empty, zero, fixable;
    unsigned long long se[NVN_TX_SLOTS];       /* 每 binding 槽的空次数 */
    unsigned long long sx[NVN_TX_SLOTS];       /* 每 binding 槽的期望次数 */
    unsigned long long why[R_TM_WHY];
    int top_slot[R_TM_TOPSLOT], top_n;
    unsigned char top_unit[R_TM_TOPSLOT];      /* M27A：该 top 项 binding 实际采样的 unit */
    unsigned long long top_empty[R_TM_TOPSLOT];
    int top_fmt[R_TM_TOPSLOT], top_id[R_TM_TOPSLOT];
    int top_cls[R_TM_TOPSLOT];                 /* 该 (key,slot) 首次记空时的归因码 */
    unsigned top_w[R_TM_TOPSLOT], top_h[R_TM_TOPSLOT];
} R_TmKey;
static R_TmKey g_tm[R_TM_KEYS];
static int g_tm_n;
static unsigned long long g_tm_ovf;
/* 全局类别计数（不经 per-key 表 ⇒ 不受表满影响，类别占比是精确的）。 */
static unsigned long long g_tm_all[R_TM_WHY];
static unsigned long long g_tm_all_exp, g_tm_all_empty;
static unsigned long long g_tx_zero;       /* 绑了真图但内容首 4 KiB 全零的槽 */
static unsigned long long g_tx_fixable;    /* 空槽 + id 有可用快照 ⇒ 只差「给不给图」 */
/* fixable 由 bind 路径喂（gfx_bridge 的 final 块）：只有它知道快照存不存在。 */
static unsigned char g_r_tx_fixfl[NVN_TX_SLOTS];
/* M5z P1：该槽的图是「LRU 让位换来的」⇒ 修前口径下它是白占位（同 run 反事实，供 was= 用）。 */
static unsigned char g_r_tx_fixsrc[NVN_TX_SLOTS];
static unsigned long long g_tx_was, g_tx_fixslots;
void nvn_vk_tex_slot_fixsrc(int slot, int ok)
{
    if (slot < 0 || slot >= NVN_TX_SLOTS) return;
    g_r_tx_fixsrc[slot] = (unsigned char)(ok ? 1 : 0);
}
void nvn_vk_tex_slot_fixable(int slot, int ok)
{
    if (slot < 0 || slot >= NVN_TX_SLOTS) return;
    g_r_tx_fixfl[slot] = (unsigned char)(ok ? 1 : 0);
}
/* 槽此刻空不空的归因码（与 g_r_tx_diag 同源；本函数只读）。 */
static int r_tm_class(int slot)
{
    int w = (int)g_r_tx_diag[slot].why;
    unsigned b = g_r_tx_diag[slot].binds;
    if (!b) return TM_NEVER_BOUND;
    if (w > 0) return TM_CLEARED;
    if (w == -31 || w == -32 || w == -33) return TM_CAP_IDIMG;
    if (w == -30 || w == -12) return TM_HEAT_GATE;
    if (w == -4) return TM_BUDGET;
    if (w == -20) return TM_NO_SNAPSHOT;
    if (w < 0) return TM_UPLOAD_FAIL;
    return TM_OTHER;
}
/* 按 fs 键找/建条目（指针身份缓存，热路径只做一次比较）。 */
static int r_tm_slot_for(const R_Key *kf)
{
    static const R_Key *last_kf; static int last_i = -1;
    if (kf == last_kf) return last_i;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_tm_n; i++)
        if (!strcmp(g_tm[i].fs, kf->key)) { last_kf = kf; last_i = i; return i; }
    if (g_tm_n >= R_TM_KEYS) { g_tm_ovf++; last_kf = kf; last_i = -1; return -1; }
    {
        int i = g_tm_n++;
        memset(&g_tm[i], 0, sizeof g_tm[i]);
        snprintf(g_tm[i].fs, sizeof g_tm[i].fs, "%s", kf->key);
        last_kf = kf; last_i = i;
        return i;
    }
}

static void m5y_tgt_census(int dvar, const R_Key *kv, const R_Key *kf, int nverts, int count)
{
    (void)nverts; (void)count;
    if (dvar >= 3) return;                                  /* 只要颜色通道 */
    if (!g_rt_cur) { g_tc_host++; }
    else {
        int i;
        for (i = 0; i < g_tc_n; i++)
            if (g_tc[i].key == g_rt_cur->key && g_tc[i].texid == g_rt_cur->tex_id) break;
        if (i == g_tc_n) {
            if (g_tc_n >= R_TC_MAX) { g_tc_ovf++; }
            else {
                memset(&g_tc[i], 0, sizeof g_tc[i]);
                g_tc[i].key = g_rt_cur->key; g_tc[i].texid = g_rt_cur->tex_id;
                g_tc[i].w = g_rt_w; g_tc[i].h = g_rt_h;
                g_tc_n++;
            }
        }
        if (i < g_tc_n) {
            g_tc[i].n++;
            int k; 
            for (k = 0; k < g_tc[i].ntop; k++)
                if (!strcmp(g_tc[i].top[k].vs, kv->key) && !strcmp(g_tc[i].top[k].fs, kf->key)) break;
            if (k == g_tc[i].ntop && g_tc[i].ntop < R_TC_TOP) {
                snprintf(g_tc[i].top[k].vs, sizeof g_tc[i].top[k].vs, "%s", kv->key);
                snprintf(g_tc[i].top[k].fs, sizeof g_tc[i].top[k].fs, "%s", kf->key);
                g_tc[i].top[k].n = 0; g_tc[i].ntop++;
            }
            if (k < g_tc[i].ntop) g_tc[i].top[k].n++;
        }
    }
    /* ② 本笔 FS 期望的纹理槽：描述符最终拿到 1x1 白占位的算 empty。 */
    {
        int ntex = kf->ntex < NVN_TX_SLOTS ? kf->ntex : NVN_TX_SLOTS;
        int ti = r_tm_slot_for(kf);          /* M5z P0：按 fs 键空槽归因 */
        R_TmKey *tm = (ti >= 0) ? &g_tm[ti] : NULL;
        for (int j = 0; j < ntex; j++) {
            /* M27A：同一口径——binding 32+j 实际采样 unit u；空不空要看 u（关态 u==j ⇒ 逐字不变）。
               per-binding 的期望/空计数仍记在 j 上（binding 是 shader 侧索引，便于和 SPIR-V 对账），
               而该槽的 id/fmt/ext/归因码/是否 RT 一律取 u。 */
            int u = r_unit_of(kf, j);
            g_tx_exp++;
            if (tm) { tm->exp++; tm->sx[j]++; }
            if (!g_r_tx_view[u]) {
                g_tx_empty++;
                /* M26A：空槽时查 (fs 键, slot) 绑定史 —— 只读，不改绑定。 */
                if (m26a_mode()) { if (m26a_lg_lookup(kf->key, j)) g_m26a_hist_hit++; else g_m26a_hist_miss++; }
                int cls = r_tm_class(u);
                g_tm_all[cls]++;              /* 全局类别计数：不受 per-key 表容量影响 */
                if (tm) {
                    tm->empty++;
                    tm->se[j]++;
                    tm->why[cls]++;
                    if (g_r_tx_fixfl[u]) { tm->fixable++; g_tx_fixable++; }
                    /* 该 (key,slot) 的空次数进 Top 小表（按次数插入排序，最多 8 项）。 */
                    int p = -1;
                    for (int q = 0; q < tm->top_n; q++)
                        if (tm->top_slot[q] == j) { p = q; break; }
                    if (p < 0 && tm->top_n < R_TM_TOPSLOT) {
                        p = tm->top_n++;
                        tm->top_slot[p] = j; tm->top_empty[p] = 0; tm->top_cls[p] = cls;
                    }
                    if (p >= 0) {
