       为什么放这里：源 :3778 的 `g_d_draws >= tri_rb_at()` 触发点在 `#if !SMO_TRI_DRAW` 的 #else 段里，
       本构建 SMO_TRI_DRAW 缺省 0 ⇒ 那段被预处理掉（clang -E 实证：tri_rb_at 只剩定义、调用点消失），
       所以门槛只能由**活着的**取样器消费。 */
    {
        static int m39m_rb_done, m39m_seeded, m39m_thr, m39m_seen = -1;
        static unsigned long long m39m_call;
        if (!m39m_seeded) { m39m_seeded = 1; p_file_seed(TRI_RB_A, TRI_RB_B); }   /* 先让 app 把文件建出来，hdc 才能改写 */
        if (!m39m_rb_done) {
        m39m_call++;
        /* 启动后 hdc 才写门槛 ⇒ 不能只读一次：每 16 次检查重读一次（≈700 draws/s 下 ≤50 次/s，fopen 可忽略）。 */
        if (m39m_call == 1ull || (m39m_call & 15ull) == 0ull) {
            const int r = p_file_int(TRI_RB_A, TRI_RB_B, 0);
            if (r != m39m_seen) {   /* 值变化才打：第一次 v=0（等待 hdc），写完打 v=140000 */
                m39m_seen = r;
                vk_boot_logf("[d] rb W2 gate read v=%d call=%llu draws=%llu", r, m39m_call, g_r_draws);
            }
            m39m_thr = r;
        }
        if (m39m_thr > 0 && g_r_draws >= (unsigned long long)m39m_thr) {
            m39m_rb_done = 1;
            g_d_rb_path = "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files/smo_w2.pam";
            vk_boot_logf("[d] rb W2(draws gate) draws=%llu w=%u h=%u path=%s threshold=%d frame=%llu target=%s",
                         g_r_draws, (unsigned)g_rt_w, (unsigned)g_rt_h,
                         "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files/smo_w2.pam",
                         m39m_thr, fr, g_rt_cur ? "gameRT" : "hostRT");
            d_readback(fr);
            g_d_rb_path = NULL;
        }
        }
    }
    /* M24A 摘点 6：d_readback 取样（首笔 + 每 150 帧 ≤8 份；UINT64_MAX 等待 + 5.76 MB PAM 落盘）。 */
    if (!m24a_on && !g_r_rb_done && bd > 0) {
        g_r_rb_done = 1;
        g_r_rb_frame0 = fr;
        g_r_rb_next = fr + 150;
        g_d_rb_path = "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files/rt_first.pam";
        vk_boot_logf("[d] rb sample#1(first game draw) frame=%llu draws=%llu batch_draws=%llu pipes_ok=%llu target=%s ext=%ux%u",
                     fr, g_r_draws, bd, g_r_pipe_ok, g_rt_cur ? "gameRT" : "hostRT", (unsigned)g_rt_w, (unsigned)g_rt_h);
        d_readback(fr);
        g_d_rb_path = NULL;
    } else if (!m24a_on && g_r_rb_done && bd > 0 && g_r_rb_samples < 8 && fr >= g_r_rb_next) {
        char pbuf[128];
        g_r_rb_samples++;
        g_r_rb_next = fr + 150;
        if (g_r_rb_samples == 1)
            g_d_rb_path = "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files/tri_late.pam";
        else {
            snprintf(pbuf, sizeof pbuf, "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files/tri_f%05llu.pam", fr);
            g_d_rb_path = pbuf;
        }
        vk_boot_logf("[d] rb sample#%u(periodic +150f) frame=%llu draws=%llu batch_draws=%llu pipes_ok=%llu target=%s",
                     g_r_rb_samples + 1, fr, g_r_draws, bd, g_r_pipe_ok, g_rt_cur ? "gameRT" : "hostRT");
        d_readback(fr);
        g_d_rb_path = NULL;
        if (g_r_rb_samples == 1) {
            /* 对照实验（自带红三角）只做一次。M4bs P1（修 B）：产物落在**专用 debug RT**
               并就地回读/落盘 tri_probe.pam —— 不再画进 gameRT、不再调 d_readback（那条读的是 g_h_img）。
               深度自检已挪到「首次深度 draw 之后」（见本函数上方 P0①）。 */
            d_probe_control_tri();
        }
    }
    if (m23b_f) m23b_f->rb = pf_now_us() - m23b_sg0;   /* M23B 段 rb：回读/深度探针/PAM 取样 */
    pf_dt(&g_pf_df_post, pf_post0);
    if (m23b_f) {
        m23b_f->bd = bd; m23b_f->er = (int)er; m23b_f->sr = (int)sr; m23b_f->wr = (int)wr;
        m23b_emit(m23b_f);
    }
    m24a_maybe_dump(m24a_on);   /* M24A：每 10 s 一行取证计数（两个 boot 都打，A/B 才有对账口径） */
    return 0;
}

/* 取证：真实 draw 计数（gfx_bridge 的周期报告行引用）。 */
/* M4ag P3：绑定区间不足、但客体可读因而放行的属性数（与 attr_ph 对账：attr_over 涨 ⇒ 修好的是 size 口径）。 */
unsigned long long nvn_vk_attr_over(void) { return g_r_attr_over; }
void nvn_vk_real_draw_stats(unsigned long long *draws, unsigned long long *fail, unsigned long long *skip,
                            unsigned long long *pipes_ok, unsigned long long *pipes_fail,
                            unsigned long long *skip_noprog, unsigned long long *skip_nopipe,
                            unsigned long long *skip_attr, unsigned long long *skip_topo,
                            unsigned long long *skip_nort, unsigned long long *skip_basev,
                            unsigned long long *skip_nverts, unsigned long long *skip_alloc,
                            unsigned long long *pipe_skip_int64, unsigned long long *attr_ph)
{
    if (draws) *draws = g_r_draws;
    if (fail) *fail = g_r_fail;
    if (skip) *skip = g_r_skip;
    if (pipes_ok) *pipes_ok = g_r_pipe_ok;
    if (pipes_fail) *pipes_fail = g_r_pipe_fail;
    if (skip_noprog) *skip_noprog = g_r_skip_noprog;
    if (skip_nopipe) *skip_nopipe = g_r_skip_nopipe;
    if (skip_attr) *skip_attr = g_r_skip_attr;
    if (skip_topo) *skip_topo = g_r_skip_topo;
    if (skip_nort) *skip_nort = g_r_skip_nort;
    if (skip_basev) *skip_basev = g_r_skip_basev;
    if (skip_nverts) *skip_nverts = g_r_skip_nverts;
    if (skip_alloc) *skip_alloc = g_r_skip_alloc;
    if (pipe_skip_int64) *pipe_skip_int64 = g_r_pipe_skip_int64;
    if (attr_ph) *attr_ph = g_r_attr_placeholder;
}

/* M4ao P1：skip 归属审计。
   total = g_r_skip（sink 看到的拒收笔数口径）；sum = 所有理由码之和；unattributed = total - sum
   （**必须为 0**；非 0 就说明还有站点绕过了 r_skip()）。reasons/reasons_call 由调用方提供
   nvn_vk_skip_reason_count() 长的数组；rejects[0..2] = 不累加 g_r_skip 的三类拒收（cap/占位/ensure）；
   incall[0/1] = CALL inline 体里到达的 draw 数 / 其中画成的笔数。 */
int nvn_vk_skip_reason_count(void) { return RS_COUNT; }
const char *nvn_vk_skip_reason_name(int i) { return (i >= 0 && i < RS_COUNT) ? g_r_skip_rname[i] : "?"; }
unsigned long long nvn_vk_skip_idx_total(void) { return g_r_skip_idx; }
unsigned long long nvn_vk_skip_pair_total(void) { return g_r_skip_reason[RS_PAIR]; }
void nvn_vk_skip_detail(unsigned long long *total, unsigned long long *sum, long long *unattr,
                        unsigned long long *reasons, unsigned long long *reasons_call,
                        unsigned long long *rejects, unsigned long long *incall)
{
    unsigned long long s = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < RS_COUNT; i++) s += g_r_skip_reason[i];
    if (total) *total = g_r_skip;
    if (sum) *sum = s;
    if (unattr) *unattr = (long long)g_r_skip - (long long)s;
    for (int i = 0; i < RS_COUNT; i++) {
        if (reasons) reasons[i] = g_r_skip_reason[i];
        if (reasons_call) reasons_call[i] = g_r_skip_reason_call[i];
    }
    if (rejects) { rejects[0] = g_r_reject_cap; rejects[1] = g_r_reject_ph; rejects[2] = g_r_reject_ensure; }
    if (incall) { incall[0] = g_r_incall_seen; incall[1] = g_r_incall_ok; }
}

/* M3v P1：管线表撞满次数（skip_nopipe 的成因拆分用） */
unsigned long long nvn_vk_pipe_cap_hits(void) { return g_r_pipe_cap_hit; }/* M4r P1：深度通道使用面（验收口径）：
   attach = 颜色 RT 绑定里挂上深度的次数；only = n=0 纯深度 pass 绑定数；skip = 想挂但挂不上；
   dcolor/donly = 真正录进 CB 的「颜色+深度」/「仅深度」draw 笔数；
   pipe_ok/pipe_fail = 深度管线变体建成/建失败数。 */
void nvn_vk_depth_use_stats(unsigned long long *attach, unsigned long long *only, unsigned long long *skip,
                            unsigned long long *dcolor, unsigned long long *donly,
                            unsigned long long *pipe_ok, unsigned long long *pipe_fail)
{
    if (attach) *attach = g_h_dp_attach;
    if (only) *only = g_h_dp_only;
    if (skip) *skip = g_h_dp_skip;
    if (dcolor) *dcolor = g_r_draws_depth;
    if (donly) *donly = g_r_draws_donly;
    if (pipe_ok) *pipe_ok = g_r_pipe_dvar_ok;
    if (pipe_fail) *pipe_fail = g_r_pipe_dvar_fail;
}
/* M4s P3：纯深度 pass 期间被 skip 的 draw 笔数 */

/* M4s P3：纯深度 pass 期间到达的 DrawArrays 数（这些 opcode 从未被重放） */
unsigned long long nvn_vk_depth_dpass_arrays(void) { return g_p3_dpass_arrays; }
/* M3x P1：因 binding 17 (GMem) 未接线而整条跳过的管线数 */

/* M4k P1③：>256KB FS 按需跳过数 + 宿主侧阻塞计数（P0-2 归因用） */
unsigned long long nvn_vk_pipe_skip_bigfs(void) { return g_r_pipe_skip_bigfs; }

/* M5w：隔离闸门累计跳掉的笔数（[r] draw totals 的 skip_heavy 字段）。 */

void nvn_vk_memveto_report(unsigned sub)
{

    last = g_r_skip_memveto;

        o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - (size_t)o, "%s%s x%llu", i ? "," : "",
                      g_memv_keys[i], g_memv_key_n[i]);

                 sub, g_r_skip_memveto, g_memv_keys_n, g_memv_keys_n ? b : "-");
}



/* ---------------- M3o（2026-11-03）：离屏 RT → 窗口（软件上屏） ----------------
   为什么不用 swapchain：VK_LAYER_OHOS_surface 要求 VK_OHOS_native_buffer，SwiftShader 没有，
   vkAcquireNextImageKHR 在层里空指针崩（M3e 实证）。像素已经能画进离屏 RT（M3n：红三角 69.1%），
   所以只把这块图搬到 XComponent 窗口的 buffer 上：vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer → 宿主内存 →
   RequestBuffer/mmap/memcpy/Flush（win_fill.c 的 nvn_win_present_rgba）——与 gfx_bridge 既有
   CPU 填色同一条已验证可用的窗口通道，Vulkan swapchain/present 代码路径一行不改。

   线程：调用点 = gfx_bridge 的 nvnQueuePresentTexture（游戏渲染线程，既有线程）。历史判别实验的
   结论是「只有既有线程能调原生 UI API」；本函数不新起线程，只用一把自己的锁保护自己的 staging。
   频率：默认每 8 次 present 换一次屏（SMO_PRESENT_EVERY 可覆盖），前 3 次必上（早期证据）。
   代价：多一次 copy submit + fence（约 3.7MB），故必须降采样，否则把帧率打穿。 */
static VkBuffer g_p_buf;
static VkDeviceMemory g_p_mem;
static void *g_p_map;
static VkFence g_p_fence;
static unsigned long long g_p_calls, g_p_ok, g_p_skip, g_p_vkfail, g_p_winfail;
/* M4cc P1：staging 里**这一帧真正装进去的拷贝区域**（源像素坐标 = 0,0..g_p_cp_w,g_p_cp_h）。
   以前这个口径写死成 H_OFF_W x H_OFF_H（因为总是裁 1280x720）；现在拷整幅，签名/落盘/gain
   都必须按这个真值读，否则探针读的只是图像左上角的一块。 */
static uint32_t g_p_cp_w = H_OFF_W, g_p_cp_h = H_OFF_H;
/* M4x P1：g_p_skip 拆成三个口径（降采样 / 尺寸门 / 源不可用），否则「skip 远多于 ok」无法判读。 */
static unsigned long long g_p_skip_ds, g_p_skip_small, g_p_skip_nosrc;

/* M4x P1：上屏 buffer（staging = 真正送屏的像素）内容签名。抽样 1/4 像素，只在 #1~3 与每 120 次
   落一行，代价 < 1 ms。口径与 [rt] 行对齐（mean/min/max 各通道 + 非零像素占比）。 */
/* M4ak P3：`[p] sig` 与 `[p] sel` 的**同帧配对**。present 选源确定后写这三个值，
   签名行把 sel_call/sel_slot/sel_why 一起打出来 ⇒ 直接按 call 号对上，不用再从时序猜。
   `g_p_m4ak_sig_pair`：本轮探针触发的那一 call 强制落一行 verbose 签名（否则两次探针之间
   可能没有 %120 的落点，配不成对）。 */
static unsigned long long g_p_sel_call;
static int g_p_sel_slot = -1;
static const char *g_p_sel_why = "none";
static int g_p_m4ak_sig_pair;

static void p_sig_line(unsigned long long call, const char *src, VkImage simg,
                       uint32_t sw, uint32_t sh, int ox, int oy, int winok, int verbose)
{
    const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)g_p_map;
    if (!p) return;
    /* M4cc P1：口径 = 本帧真正拷进 staging 的区域（整幅源），不再是固定的 1280x720。 */
    const unsigned long long npx = (unsigned long long)g_p_cp_w * g_p_cp_h;
    unsigned long long sr = 0, sg = 0, sb = 0, snz = 0, ns = 0;
    unsigned mn[3] = { 255, 255, 255 }, mx[3] = { 0, 0, 0 };
    for (unsigned long long i = 0; i < npx; i += 4) {
        const uint8_t *q = p + i * 4;
        unsigned r = q[0], g = q[1], b = q[2];
        sr += r; sg += g; sb += b; ns++;
        if (r || g || b) snz++;
        if (r < mn[0]) mn[0] = r; if (g < mn[1]) mn[1] = g; if (b < mn[2]) mn[2] = b;
        if (r > mx[0]) mx[0] = r; if (g > mx[1]) mx[1] = g; if (b > mx[2]) mx[2] = b;
    }
    if (!ns) return;
    /* M4y P1：present 时刻「画面还在不在」——staging 就是这一刻真正送屏的像素。
       源是 content 时：RGB 通道内 spread < 16 ⇒ 画面已被 clear 掉或被别的 pass 覆盖成单色，
       计 content lost 并留一条（人眼看到的就是这一张，不用再猜）。
       注意只算 RGB：上屏的 alpha 不参与显示（win_fill 按 RGBA 送，但屏幕只看 RGB）。 */
    unsigned sp = 0;
    for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++)
        if (mx[c] > mn[c]) { unsigned d = mx[c] - mn[c]; if (d > sp) sp = d; }
    if (!strcmp(src, "content")) {
        g_p_content_seen++;
        if (sp < R_CONTENT_MIN_SPREAD) {
            g_p_content_lost++;
            if (g_p_content_lost <= 8 || (g_p_content_lost % 100) == 0)
                vk_boot_logf("[p] content lost #%llu call=%llu simg=%#llx src_ext=%ux%u crop=%d,%d "
                             "spread=%u mean=%llu/%llu/%llu nz=%.2f%% (源图在 present 时刻已是单色)",
                             g_p_content_lost, call, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)simg, sw, sh, ox, oy,
                             sp, sr / ns, sg / ns, sb / ns, 100.0 * (double)snz / (double)ns);
        }
    }
    if (!verbose) return;
    vk_boot_logf("[p] sig #%llu src=%s simg=%#llx src_ext=%ux%u crop=%d,%d dst=%dx%d "
                 "mean=%llu/%llu/%llu min=%llu/%llu/%llu max=%llu/%llu/%llu nz=%.2f%% spread=%u win=%s "
                 "sel_call=%llu sel_slot=%d sel_why=%s "
                 "cur=%s cur_img=%#llx cur_ext=%ux%u cand_hit=%llu cand_cur=%llu cand_miss=%llu "
                 "content=%llu lost=%llu/%llu rej=%llu snap=%llu",
                 call, src, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)simg, sw, sh, ox, oy, (int)g_p_cp_w, (int)g_p_cp_h,
                 sr / ns, sg / ns, sb / ns, (unsigned long long)mn[0], (unsigned long long)mn[1],
                 (unsigned long long)mn[2], (unsigned long long)mx[0], (unsigned long long)mx[1],
                 (unsigned long long)mx[2],
                 100.0 * (double)snz / (double)ns, sp, winok ? "ok" : "fail",
                 g_p_sel_call, g_p_sel_slot, g_p_sel_why,
                 g_rt_cur ? "gameRT" : "hostRT", (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_h_img,
                 (unsigned)g_rt_w, (unsigned)g_rt_h, g_p_src_hit, g_p_src_cur, g_p_src_fallback,
                 g_p_src_content, g_p_content_lost, g_p_content_seen, g_p_content_rej, g_p_src_snap);
}


/* ---- M4ag P1（2026-11-04）：上屏源 = **游戏自己指定的那张窗口纹理** ----
   权威信号链：`nvnWindowBuilderSetTextures(builder,n,tex[])` 把 n 张 NVNtexture 交给窗口
   （gfx_bridge.c:849 登记 → nvn_window_initialize:858 拷进 win->tex[]），每帧
   `nvnWindowAcquireTexture` 轮转给出 idx，`nvnQueuePresentTexture(q,w,idx)` 用的就是同一个 idx
   ⇒ **win->tex[idx] 就是这一帧游戏要给人看的那张**。gfx_bridge 把它解析成**存储身份**
   （池数据地址，与 h_rt_slot.key 同口径；解析不到退回对象指针）后调 nvn_vk_present_src()。
   本文件只做两件事：①按 key 找到我们的 RT 槽；②源选择顺序改成「游戏指定 > 旧链（快照/内容/
   最后 draw/当前目标）」。拿不到映射 ⇒ 计 texmiss 并**原样回落**旧逻辑（不硬指、不猜）。 */
static unsigned long long g_p_src_tex, g_p_tex_miss, g_p_tex_nolay, g_p_src_ovr, g_p_tex_null;
/* M4bv P1：新路线台账 —— gpres = 游戏 present 引用的那张被我们当真源上屏的次数；
   gpres_miss = 游戏给了身份但我们这边没有可用 RT 槽 / 没给身份的 present 次数。 */
static unsigned long long g_p_src_gpres, g_p_gpres_miss;
/* M4cb P1：present source = the composite RT whose tex_id is 282 (the game's own final
   composite quad lands there). picks = times this branch actually drove the screen;
   miss = frames where no usable 282 slot existed (old chain used); stat = content probe. */
static unsigned long long g_p_src_rt282, g_p_rt282_miss, g_p_rt282_stat;
static unsigned long long g_p_src_auto;   /* M5t P1：上屏源 = 实测自动挑选（带迟滞） */
static unsigned long long g_p_rt282_stat_us;
/* M4bv P2：**「游戏 present 引用的那张」会不会被游戏自己当 RT 绑** —— 本轮 boot#1 的铁证是
   `writers=0`（整 boot 只有 1 笔 draw 落进 present 槽），于是上屏永远是空的。这里记两件事：
   ① g_win_key[idx] = present 报给我们的三张窗口纹理身份（idx 轮转，与 win->tex[] 同序）；
   ② 每次 nvn_vk_rt_bind 都按 key 比一下：命中就计 g_winbind_n（= 游戏把这张当渲染目标绑了几次），
      并把「绑定时能不能解析成我们的槽」一起打出来（NULL ⇒ 该帧回落宿主图，draw 落在 g_h_img 上）。
   另外维护一个「最近 8 个被绑定的 RT 身份」直方图，present 时打印 —— 直接回答「游戏到底把哪张当 RT」。 */
#define BINDK_N 8
static unsigned long long g_win_key[4];
static unsigned long long g_winbind_n;
static unsigned long long g_bindk[BINDK_N], g_bindk_cnt[BINDK_N];
static unsigned g_bindk_rr;
static void p_bindk_note(unsigned long long key)
{
    if (!key) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < BINDK_N; i++) if (g_bindk[i] == key) { g_bindk_cnt[i]++; return; }
    g_bindk[g_bindk_rr % BINDK_N] = key; g_bindk_cnt[g_bindk_rr % BINDK_N] = 1; g_bindk_rr++;
}
static int p_win_key_hit(unsigned long long key)
{
    if (!key) return 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) if (g_win_key[i] == key) return 1;
    return 0;
}
/* 台账（每 300 次 present 一行）用的「上一张真拷源」。 */
static const char *g_p_last_src = "none";
static int g_p_last_slot = -1;
static unsigned g_p_last_w, g_p_last_h;
/* 诊断开关：文件第一行整数 = RT 槽下标（-1/缺省 = 关）。**默认 -1**，正常路径只信游戏指定；
   非 -1 时强行以该槽为源，用于「游戏指定的槽映射不到 / 想逐槽试」时的人眼对照。
   路径宏 P_OVR_A/P_OVR_B/P_DMP_A/P_DMP_B 与读文件助手在 r_rt_sig_tick 之前定义（快照处要读）。 */

static int p_file_int(const char *a, const char *b, int def)
{
    const char *p[2] = { a, b };
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        FILE *f = fopen(p[i], "r");
        if (!f) continue;
        int v = def;
        if (fscanf(f, "%d", &v) != 1) v = def;
        fclose(f);
        return v;
    }
    return def;
}
/* 缺省文件只建一次：hdc 只能覆盖已有文件，必须先让应用把文件建出来。 */
static void p_file_seed(const char *a, const char *b)
{
    const char *p[2] = { a, b };
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) { FILE *f = fopen(p[i], "r"); if (f) { fclose(f); return; } }
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        FILE *f = fopen(p[i], "w");
        if (f) { fputs("-1\n", f); fclose(f); vk_boot_logf("[p] seeded %s = -1", p[i]); return; }
    }
}
/* M4ag P2b：`smo_p2_slot` —— 让「代表 draw 端到端二分」在**指定槽**上的下一笔 draw 上触发
   （缺省 -1 = 只走旧的「内容 RT」扳机）。boot#1 的二分只抓到了环境三角那一笔，
   场景类（写 slot 9 的 dfc8b55e）从未被二分过 ⇒ 用这个开关补上。每 256 次查询重读一次文件。 */
static int p2_slot_file(void)
{
    static int cached = -2; static unsigned n;
    if (cached == -2) { p_file_seed(P_P2_A, P_P2_B); cached = p_file_int(P_P2_A, P_P2_B, -1); n = 0; }
    else if ((++n & 255) == 0) cached = p_file_int(P_P2_A, P_P2_B, -1);
    return cached;
}

static int p_slot_override(void)   /* 每 64 次调用重读一次，避免每次 present 都开文件 */
{
    static int cached = -2; static unsigned long long last;
    if (cached == -2) { p_file_seed(P_OVR_A, P_OVR_B); cached = p_file_int(P_OVR_A, P_OVR_B, -1); last = g_p_calls; }
    else if (g_p_calls - last >= 64) { cached = p_file_int(P_OVR_A, P_OVR_B, -1); last = g_p_calls; }
    return cached;
}
/* ---- M38H（2026-11-09）：`smo_m38h_present=<slot>` —— 强制 present 指定槽（缺省 -1 = 关）----
   关态：一行不打、一个分支不动（selector 语义、深度、纹理身份全不变）。
   开态（≥0 且该槽有 img/w/h）：present 选源**确定之后**用该槽自己的 img/ext 顶替选中的源。
   与既有 `smo_present_slot`(p_slot_override) 的区别：那条在 ovr_lock 下会改送「帧内快照」
   (ovr-snap)；本开关要的正是**该槽在上屏那一刻的原始内容**，用来判
   「画面其实渲染好了、只是 present 选错源」vs「场景 RT 确实空」。
   尺寸不在这里缩放：源按原尺寸拷进 staging，由 win_fill.c 的最近邻等比 fit 铺到呈现面
   （720x405 → 800x450 时 dw=800/dh=450，正好铺满）。
   每 64 次 present 重读一次文件（与 p_slot_override 同节奏）；缺省文件由应用种成 -1。 */
#define M38H_A "/data/storage/el2/base/files/smo_m38h_present"
#define M38H_B "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files/smo_m38h_present"
static int g_m38h_logged = -1;   /* 已打过日志的槽号（-2 = 打过「不可用」）；只做去重 */
static int m38h_slot(void)
{
    static int cached = -2; static unsigned long long last;
    if (cached == -2) { p_file_seed(M38H_A, M38H_B); cached = p_file_int(M38H_A, M38H_B, -1); last = g_p_calls; }
    else if (g_p_calls - last >= 64) { cached = p_file_int(M38H_A, M38H_B, -1); last = g_p_calls; }
    return cached;
}
/* ---- M39A（2026-11-09）：guest 720x405 场景 RT 直送**转正为默认 present 源** ----
   M38H 用 `smo_m38h_present=<slot>` 强制后画面通了（logs/m38h_b1/screen_198.png 人眼=礼帽角色/
   帽子/面部）⇒「present 时刻活图已被清、只能送我们自己的 m7h-world 快照」这条绕法的前提至少不全面。
   本轮把它变成**不需要任何环境变量**的默认行为：
   · 槽号**不硬编码**：每 64 次 present（与 p_slot_override 同节奏）在本 boot 的槽表里重扫一次，
     取「当前帧 dw_frm 最大且 ext==720x405 且有图」的那个槽；dw_frm==0（本帧没人写）不算候选，
     此时本帧保持原选源，不送陈旧内容。
   · 逃生阀：`smo_m39a_off`。**只有显式 1 才是关**（缺省文件由 p_file_seed 种成 -1 = 直送）；
     关态整块不执行 ⇒ 与 M38H 之前逐字相同（present 源回到 m7h-world 老路径）。
   · 白帧保护：上屏那一刻对选中槽做一次 16x16 签名回读；若是**常量白**（三通道 mean==255 且
     采样色桶数==1，M38H 里 t243+ 那种），**本帧**恢复原选源（缺省即 m7h-world）并打
     `[m39a] fallback why=uniform_white slot=<n>`。目的：转正不能把画面变成纯白，同时把
     「哪些帧本来就白」如实暴露出来。
   不改 selector 语义、不动深度挂载、不动纹理身份（那三件是后续轮次的事）。
   缩放不在这里做：源按原尺寸拷进 staging，win_fill.c 的最近邻等比 fit 铺满呈现面
   （720x405 -> 800x450 时 dw=800/dh=450）。 */
/* ==== M40C（2026-11-09）：强制 PSO 状态实验开关 `smo_m40c` ====
   语义：**只有显式 1 才是开**；缺省（p_file_seed 种的 -1）/ 0 都 = 关 ⇒ 关态 4 处覆盖块整块不执行。
   为什么需要 poll：cull/depth 是**烘进 VkPipeline** 的状态。本构建管线在 title 前就基本建完
   （M40B 日志实测最后一次 `[r] pipe try` t≈191s，之后 110 s 零新建），boot 中途改文件若不作废
   管线表，ON 永远不会生效（会得到假 B 结论）。poll 检到取值变化就把管线表计数清零：旧条目句柄
   **故意不销毁**（避免在飞 command buffer 引用），只是不再被查到 ⇒ 下一次 draw 走新建路径、按
   新状态重建（全量 110 条管线编译成本实测 ≈4.5 s）。诊断构建只翻 1~2 次，句柄泄漏可接受。 */
#define M40C_A  "/data/storage/el2/base/files/smo_m40c"
#define M40C_B  "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files/smo_m40c"
static int g_m40c_v, g_m40c_seeded;
static int m40c_sw(void)
{
    if (!g_m40c_seeded) {
        g_m40c_seeded = 1;
        p_file_seed(M40C_A, M40C_B);
        g_m40c_v = (p_file_int(M40C_A, M40C_B, 0) == 1) ? 1 : 0;
        vk_boot_logf("[m40c] init sw=%d file=%s (only explicit 1 = ON; seed -1/0 = OFF)", g_m40c_v, M40C_B);
    }
    return g_m40c_v;
}
static void m40c_poll(void)
{
    static unsigned long long last;
    if (!g_m40c_seeded) { (void)m40c_sw(); last = g_p_calls; return; }
    if (g_p_calls - last < 64) return;   /* 7 fps 下 ≈9 s 一次（与 m39a/w2p 同节奏） */
    last = g_p_calls;
    { const int v = (p_file_int(M40C_A, M40C_B, 0) == 1) ? 1 : 0;
      if (v != g_m40c_v) {
          const int old = g_m40c_v; g_m40c_v = v;
          vk_boot_logf("[m40c] sw %d -> %d at present call=%llu: pipeline table invalidated (entries=%d)",
                       old, v, g_p_calls, g_rpipe_n);
          g_rpipe_n = 0;
      } }
}
#define M39A_A  "/data/storage/el2/base/files/smo_m39a_off"
#define M39A_B  "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files/smo_m39a_off"
#define M39A_W  720u
#define M39A_H  405u
static int g_m39a_dbg = -1;   /* 已打过日志的槽号（-2 = 打过一次 fallback）；只做去重 */
/* 1 = 直送关（退回 m7h-world）。只有文件里显式 1 才算关：缺省 -1 / 0 都 = 直送。 */
static int m39a_off(void)
{
    static int cached = -2; static unsigned long long last;
    if (cached == -2) { p_file_seed(M39A_A, M39A_B); cached = p_file_int(M39A_A, M39A_B, -1); last = g_p_calls; }
    else if (g_p_calls - last >= 64) { cached = p_file_int(M39A_A, M39A_B, -1); last = g_p_calls; }
    return cached == 1;
}
/* M39C（2026-11-09）诊断结论：M39A 的候选判据 `w==720 && h==405 && dw_frm>0` 在这台机上是**空集** ——
   三次 boot 里 720x405 槽（slot 127/129/178/182/218/223）dw_all≈0、dw_frm 恒 0、回读 mean=0/0/0，
   是没人写的死槽；真正被 draw 写的是 800x450（slot0 id282 dw_frm=10..20 NONFLAT）。
   ⇒ 候选池分两档：① 720x405 && dw_frm>0（原始设计，实测永不命中）；② dw_frm>0 且尺寸 == 当前
   选源尺寸 refw/refh、面积 >= M39A_MIN_AREA（滤掉 64x64/128x128/512x512 这类 UI RT）。 */
#define M39A_MIN_AREA ((unsigned)(M39A_W * M39A_H * 3u / 4u))   /* 218700 */
static int m39a_pick(unsigned *dwo, unsigned *alo, unsigned *c72o, unsigned *ctoto,
                     unsigned refw, unsigned refh)
{
    const int ns = (int)(sizeof g_rt_tab / sizeof *g_rt_tab);
    static int prev = -1;
    int best = -1, b72 = -1; unsigned bd = 0, ba = 0, b72d = 0;
    unsigned c72 = 0, ctot = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ns; i++) {
        h_rt_slot *s = &g_rt_tab[i];
        if (!s->img) continue;
        const unsigned d = g_slot_dw[i];             /* 本帧（submit 边界清零）被 draw 写的笔数 */
        if (d == 0) continue;                        /* 本帧没人写 ⇒ 不作候选（不送陈旧内容） */
        ctot++;                                      /* gate 诊断：本帧有写入且带图的槽数（任意尺寸） */
        if (s->w == M39A_W && s->h == M39A_H) { c72++; if (b72 < 0 || d > b72d) { b72 = i; b72d = d; } }
        if ((unsigned)s->w * (unsigned)s->h < M39A_MIN_AREA) continue;
        if (refw && refh && (s->w != refw || s->h != refh)) continue;   /* ② 只认当前选源那一档尺寸 */
        if (best < 0 || d > bd || (d == bd && i == prev)) { best = i; bd = d; ba = g_slot_dw_all[i]; }
    }
    if (b72 >= 0) { best = b72; bd = b72d; ba = g_slot_dw_all[b72]; }   /* ① 720x405 优先（规格路径） */
    prev = best;
    if (dwo) *dwo = bd;
    if (alo) *alo = ba;
    if (c72o) *c72o = c72;
    if (ctoto) *ctoto = ctot;
    return best;
}
/* M39C（2026-11-09）：门判定诊断行，限频 = 每 60 次 present 或 (槽号/why) 变化才打一次。
   why: hit=本帧真的直送了 / uniform=选中槽是常量白(已回退原选源) / dim_mismatch=本帧有写入的槽但
   没有候选尺寸 / no_cand=本帧没有任何被 draw 写过的槽 / no_img=候选槽 img 为空 / off=开关显式 1。 */
static void m39a_gate(unsigned long long call, unsigned ctot, unsigned c72, int slot,
                      const char *srcname, unsigned srcw, unsigned srch,
                      const char *why)
{
    static unsigned long long last_call;
    static int last_slot = -2;
    static char last_why[24];
    if (last_why[0] && call - last_call < 60 && slot == last_slot && !strcmp(why, last_why)) return;
    last_call = call; last_slot = slot;
    snprintf(last_why, sizeof last_why, "%s", why);
    if (slot >= 0 && slot < (int)(sizeof g_rt_tab / sizeof *g_rt_tab)) {
        h_rt_slot *s = &g_rt_tab[slot];
        vk_boot_logf("[m39a] gate cand=%u c720=%u best=%d/%d/%ux%u/%u src=%s/%ux%u hit=%d why=%s call=%llu",
                     ctot, c72, slot, (int)s->tex_id, (unsigned)s->w, (unsigned)s->h, g_slot_dw[slot],
                     srcname, srcw, srch, !strcmp(why, "hit"), why, call);
    } else {
        vk_boot_logf("[m39a] gate cand=%u c720=%u best=-/-/-/- src=%s/%ux%u hit=0 why=%s call=%llu",
                     ctot, c72, srcname, srcw, srch, why, call);
    }
}
/* M4al P2：present 是否允许送快照。缺省（无文件）= 开；文件存在时「非 0 = 开」，推 0 退回旧链。
   文件由应用种成 -1（p_file_seed），hdc 可覆盖成 0/1 做 A/B，无需重编。 */
static int p_snap_present(void)
{
    static int cached = -2; static unsigned long long last;
    if (cached == -2) { p_file_seed(P_SNAP_A, P_SNAP_B); cached = p_file_int(P_SNAP_A, P_SNAP_B, 1); last = g_p_calls; }
    else if (g_p_calls - last >= 64) { cached = p_file_int(P_SNAP_A, P_SNAP_B, 1); last = g_p_calls; }
    return cached != 0;
}
static int p_slot_by_key(unsigned long long key, h_rt_slot **out)
{
    *out = NULL;
    if (!key) return -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)(sizeof g_rt_tab / sizeof *g_rt_tab); i++)
        if (g_rt_tab[i].img && g_rt_tab[i].key == key) { *out = &g_rt_tab[i]; return i; }
    return -1;
}
/* M4bc P3：present 是否优先送「我们自己渲染的那张图」。缺省（无文件）= 开；推 0 退回 snap/旧链。 */
static int p_our_present(void)
{
    static int cached = -2; static unsigned long long last;
    if (cached == -2) { p_file_seed(P_OUR_A, P_OUR_B); cached = p_file_int(P_OUR_A, P_OUR_B, 1); last = g_p_calls; }
    else if (g_p_calls - last >= 64) { cached = p_file_int(P_OUR_A, P_OUR_B, 1); last = g_p_calls; }
    return cached != 0;
}
/* M4bf P1：`ours` 的像素来源开关。缺省（无文件/种子 -1）= 1 = 游戏本帧颜色 RT；推 0 退回 debug RT。 */
static int p_game_rt_mode(void)
{
    static int cached = -2; static unsigned long long last;
    if (cached == -2) { p_file_seed(P_GAMERT_A, P_GAMERT_B); cached = p_file_int(P_GAMERT_A, P_GAMERT_B, 1); last = g_p_calls; }
    else if (g_p_calls - last >= 64) { cached = p_file_int(P_GAMERT_A, P_GAMERT_B, 1); last = g_p_calls; }
    return cached != 0;
}
/* M4bv P1：present 源 = 游戏自己 present 的那张纹理。缺省（种子 -1）= 开；推 0 退回旁路链。 */
static int p_gpres(void)
{
    static int cached = -2; static unsigned long long last;
    if (cached == -2) { p_file_seed(P_GPRES_A, P_GPRES_B); cached = p_file_int(P_GPRES_A, P_GPRES_B, 1); last = g_p_calls; }
    else if (g_p_calls - last >= 64) { cached = p_file_int(P_GPRES_A, P_GPRES_B, 1); last = g_p_calls; }
    return cached != 0;
}
static int p_src_copyable(h_rt_slot *s)
{
    if (!s || !s->img || !s->w || !s->h) return 0;
    /* M6v P1：槽尺寸现在是**光栅**尺寸 ⇒ 家族下限也要 ÷D，否则半分辨率源被当成「小图」判拒，
       present 落回旧链（黑屏）。这是派活单 §3#1.2 明确要求同步放宽的那一处。 */
    if (s->w < h_rs_dim(H_OFF_W) || s->h < h_rs_dim(H_OFF_H)) return 0;
    if (s == g_rt_cur) return 1;
    return s->layout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL ||
           s->layout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL ||
           s->layout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL;
}
static VkImageLayout p_slot_layout(h_rt_slot *s) { return s == g_rt_cur ? g_h_layout : s->layout; }
/* ===== M39E（2026-11-09）：submit 时刻 vs present 时刻的同槽签名对照（取证用，默认关）=====
   问题：present 时刻活 RT 常已被 guest 清成常量/近黑 ⇒ 直送只能送死内容。
   若 submit 边界上该槽还有内容（nt>1 / nz 高），则内容是在 submit 之后被清的 ⇒ 正确修法是
   「submit 时刻抓一次到我们自己的快照」，而不是 present 时刻读 guest RT。 */
#define M39E_A "/data/storage/el2/base/files/smo_m39e_pair"
#define M39E_B "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files/smo_m39e_pair"
static int m39e_pair_on(void)
{
    static int cached = -2; static unsigned long long last;
    if (cached == -2) { p_file_seed(M39E_A, M39E_B); cached = p_file_int(M39E_A, M39E_B, 0); last = g_p_calls; }
    else if (g_p_calls - last >= 64) { cached = p_file_int(M39E_A, M39E_B, 0); last = g_p_calls; }
    return cached != 0;
}
static unsigned g_m39e_lines;              /* 两种行合计预算（≤200） */
static int g_m39e_sub_slot = -1;           /* submit 边界上被写得最多的槽 */
static unsigned long long g_m39e_sub_call, g_m39e_sub_nz, g_m39e_sub_mean;
static int g_m39e_sub_nt;
static void m39e_sub_tick(unsigned sub)
{
    (void)sub;
    if (!m39e_pair_on() || g_m39e_lines >= 200) return;
    const int ns = (int)(sizeof g_rt_tab / sizeof *g_rt_tab);
    int best = -1; unsigned bd = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ns; i++) {
        if (!g_rt_tab[i].img) continue;
        const unsigned d = g_slot_dw[i];
        if (d > bd) { bd = d; best = i; }
    }
    if (best < 0 || bd == 0) return;
    h_rt_slot *fh = &g_rt_tab[best];
    const VkImageLayout flay = p_slot_layout(fh);
    r_sig_t sg; memset(&sg, 0, sizeof sg);
    if (!r_tex_signature(fh->img, flay, fh->w, fh->h, 4, &sg)) return;
    const unsigned long long np = sg.npx ? sg.npx : 1ull;
    const unsigned long long nzp = sg.nz * 1000ull / np;
    const unsigned mean3 = (unsigned)((sg.sum[0] + sg.sum[1] + sg.sum[2]) / (3ull * np));
    g_m39e_sub_slot = best; g_m39e_sub_call = g_p_calls; g_m39e_sub_nz = nzp;
    g_m39e_sub_nt = sg.nt; g_m39e_sub_mean = mean3;
    g_m39e_lines++;
    vk_boot_logf("[m39e] sub slot=%d id=%d ext=%ux%u dw=%u nz=%llu%% nt=%d mean=%u call=%llu",
                 best, (int)fh->tex_id, (unsigned)fh->w, (unsigned)fh->h, bd,
                 nzp, sg.nt, mean3, g_p_calls);
}

/* M4bv P2：present 时刻回答「游戏 present 的那个对象，在我们这边到底被谁写过」。
   ① 返回值 = lw 环（boot 累计的「谁写进哪张 RT」记录）里写进这张 slot 的 draw 笔数；
   ② best_sib/best_w = **同一 texid 的其他槽**里写入最多的那个。>0 就说明「同一张纹理在我们这边
      有两份身份」（一个 key 来自池数据地址、一个退回对象指针）——游戏画进 A 身份、present 解析成
      B 身份，上屏就永远是空的那份。只读，不改任何选源判据。 */
static unsigned p_slot_lw(const h_rt_slot *s, int *best_sib, unsigned *best_w)
{
    if (best_sib) *best_sib = -1;
    if (best_w) *best_w = 0;
    if (!s) return 0;
    unsigned w = 0;
    for (int k = 0; k < g_lw_n; k++) {
        const lw_row *r = &g_lw[k];
        if (r->img == s->img || (r->slot >= 0 && r->key == s->key)) w++;
    }
    if (best_sib && s->tex_id >= 0) {
        const int ns = (int)(sizeof g_rt_tab / sizeof *g_rt_tab);
        for (int i = 0; i < ns; i++) {
            const h_rt_slot *o = &g_rt_tab[i];
            if (!o->img || o == s || o->tex_id != s->tex_id) continue;
            unsigned ow = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k < g_lw_n; k++) {
                const lw_row *r = &g_lw[k];
                if (r->img == o->img || (r->slot >= 0 && r->key == o->key)) ow++;
            }
            if (ow > *best_w) { *best_w = ow; *best_sib = i; }
        }
    }
    return w;
}

/* ---- M4ak P1（2026-11-04）：present 时刻**逐帧对照** ----
   要回答的问题只有一个：**present 选中的源是不是单色（白/黑），而同一帧有没有一张非单色的
   ≥1280×720 RT 槽被漏掉**。M4aj 已证 1900/1910/1911 全零（没人写），boot#1 又确实产出过
   一张非白 1600×900（view_content.pam mean=135/65/164）却送屏纯白 ⇒ 该判「选源」还是「内容」。
   判据（全来自本函数一次采样）：
     slots_nonflat > 0 && selected_nonflat == 0 ⇒ sel_flat_but_nonflat_exists（选源链错）；
     slots_nonflat == 0                        ⇒ all_flat（没人写内容 RT）；
     selected_nonflat == 1                     ⇒ selected_ok。
   预算：每 boot ≤3 次、间隔 ≥120 s（每次 ≤32 个槽回读，与既有 [p] gsig 同一条 submit/fence 路径）。
   零行为改动：只读签名 + 打日志；每次回读都把布局恢复原状（r_tex_signature 内保证）。 */
/* ====== M38E（2026-11-09，只读，log-only）B：present 时刻**全部槽**的记账 + 非常量槽落 PNG ==========
   派活单 B 是决定性一步：「白盖住的到底是几何，还是几何根本没画进来」。M4ak 的 `[p] slots` 只打
   12 行、且只挑 ≥1280×720 的槽（M6v 过滤），装不下这个判断。这里不问尺寸、不问 do 没 do：
     · 遍历 g_rt_tab[0..H_RT_SLOTS) 里**所有有 img 的槽**，逐槽打
       (slot, id, fmt, ext, lay, nz%, mean, min, max, nt, spread, hash, dw_all, dw_frame)；
     · 内容不是常量（r_sig_has_content：spread≥16 且色桶≥3）的槽落 `m38e_slot<NN>.png`；
     · 同时给「本帧/整 boot 的 draws 去向」：sum(g_slot_dw_all) 与 g_r_draws 的差 = 宿主兜底
       （g_rt_cur==NULL，没落到任何槽）。
   只在 t≈22/80/130/190 s 各做一次（≤4 次），关态（smo_m38e=0）立即 return。 */
static unsigned long long g_m38e_dumps, g_m38e_pngtot;
static void m38e_present(unsigned long long call)
{
    if (!m38e_on()) return;
    const unsigned long long now = m38e_now_us();
    if (!g_m38e_t0) { g_m38e_t0 = now; m38e_frame_reset(); g_m38e_fcur = r_frame_now(); }
    if (g_m38e_dumps >= 4) return;
    static const double plan[4] = { 22.0, 80.0, 130.0, 190.0 };
    const double t = (double)(now - g_m38e_t0) / 1e6;
    if (t < plan[g_m38e_dumps]) return;
    g_m38e_dumps++;
    m38e_flush(r_frame_now());          /* present = 帧边界：先把上一帧的 A 摘要落掉 */
    const char *dir = m7h_dir();
    unsigned long long sumall = 0;
    int nimg = 0, probed = 0, unread = 0, nonflat = 0, npng = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < H_RT_SLOTS; i++) sumall += g_slot_dw_all[i];
    for (int i = 0; i < H_RT_SLOTS; i++) {
        h_rt_slot *s = &g_rt_tab[i];
        if (!s->img) continue;
        nimg++;
        const VkImageLayout lay = p_slot_layout(s);
        r_sig_t sg; memset(&sg, 0, sizeof sg);
        const int ok = r_tex_signature(s->img, lay, s->w, s->h, 4, &sg);
        char body[320];
        if (!ok) {
            unread++;
            snprintf(body, sizeof body, "nz=na mean=na min=na max=na nt=-1 spread=-1 hash=0");
        } else {
            const int nf = r_sig_has_content(&sg);
            const unsigned long long np = sg.npx ? sg.npx : 1ull;
            probed++;
            if (nf) nonflat++;
            snprintf(body, sizeof body,
                     "nz=%.2f%% mean=%llu/%llu/%llu min=%llu/%llu/%llu max=%llu/%llu/%llu "
                     "nt=%d spread=%u hash=%#llx%s",
                     100.0 * (double)sg.nz / (double)np,
                     sg.sum[0] / np, sg.sum[1] / np, sg.sum[2] / np,
                     (unsigned long long)sg.mn[0], (unsigned long long)sg.mn[1], (unsigned long long)sg.mn[2],
                     (unsigned long long)sg.mx[0], (unsigned long long)sg.mx[1], (unsigned long long)sg.mx[2],
                     sg.nt, r_sig_spread(&sg), sg.hash, nf ? " NONFLAT" : "");
            /* 非常量槽出 PNG：本帧的几何到底在哪一张图上，人眼一看就知道。 */
            if (nf && npng < 12 && g_m38e_pngtot < 40
                && (unsigned long long)s->w * s->h <= 2100000ull) {
                const VkDeviceSize dsz = (VkDeviceSize)s->w * (VkDeviceSize)s->h * 4ull;
                unsigned char *px = (unsigned char *)c_raw_copy(s->img, lay, s->w, s->h, dsz);
                if (px) {
                    char pp[256];
                    snprintf(pp, sizeof pp, "%sm38e_slot%03d.png", dir, i);
                    const unsigned long long by = m7h_write_png(pp, s->w, s->h, px);
                    vk_boot_logf("[m38e] png slot=%d id=%d path=%s bytes=%llu ext=%ux%u",
                                 i, s->tex_id, pp, by, (unsigned)s->w, (unsigned)s->h);
                    free(px); npng++; g_m38e_pngtot++;
                }
            }
        }
        vk_boot_logf("[m38e] slot=%d id=%d fmt=%#x ext=%ux%u lay=%d dw_all=%u dw_frm=%u %s",
                     i, s->tex_id, s->fmt, (unsigned)s->w, (unsigned)s->h, (int)lay,
                     g_slot_dw_all[i], g_slot_dw[i], body);
    }
    const long long host = (long long)g_r_draws - (long long)sumall;
    vk_boot_logf("[m38e] dump #%llu call=%llu t=%.2f f=%llu nimg=%d probed=%d unread=%d nonflat=%d png=%d "
                 "draws_all=%llu in_slots=%llu host=%lld glw=%d",
                 g_m38e_dumps, call, t, r_frame_now(), nimg, probed, unread, nonflat, npng,
                 g_r_draws, sumall, host, g_lw_n);
}
#define M4AK_PROBES      3
#define M4AK_SLOT_LINES  12
static unsigned long long m4ak_n, m4ak_last_us, m4ak_t0;
static void m4ak_probe(unsigned long long call, const char *why, int sel_slot,
                       VkImage simg, VkImageLayout slay, unsigned sw, unsigned sh)
{
    if (m4ak_n >= M4AK_PROBES) return;
    struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    unsigned long long now = (unsigned long long)ts.tv_sec * 1000000ull + (unsigned long long)ts.tv_nsec / 1000ull;
    if (!m4ak_t0) m4ak_t0 = now;
    /* 首次探针压到开机 20 s 之后：t=0 那几帧还没画内容，采它等于浪费额度（#1 会假 all_flat）。 */
    if (!m4ak_last_us && now - m4ak_t0 < 20000000ull) return;
    if (m4ak_last_us && now - m4ak_last_us < 120000000ull) return;
    m4ak_last_us = now;
    m4ak_n++;
    const int pn = (int)m4ak_n;

    /* 每个候选槽在本帧 submit 的 draw 笔数 + 最后一笔 vs/fs（lw 环在 submit 边界复位）。
       M4bc P2：补 last_fs —— 派活单要「本帧真正往颜色 RT 写非黑内容的是哪几笔 draw」，
       只给 vs 无法把「谁写的」对到 FS 上（同一个 VS 会配很多 FS）。 */
    const int nsl = (int)(sizeof g_rt_tab / sizeof *g_rt_tab);
    /* M7b P4（修本轮实测的 SIGSEGV）：这三张表按**候选序号**索引，`no` 来自「≥ H_OFF 尺寸的槽数」，
       上限其实是 H_RT_SLOTS，而这里写死 [32]。
       m7b_b1 实测：M7b P2 把「身份解不出」的槽从 1x1 改成 800x450 后屏形槽从 15 → 40
       （`[wp] rt sum … screen_slots=40`），于是 `order[no]` 越界写栈 ⇒ `[p] slots #2 … draws=1659895489`
       （垃圾值）⇒ `&g_rt_tab[order[a]]` 成为野指针 ⇒ `p_slot_layout` 读 0xc368df7e20 触发
       SIGSEGV(SEGV_MAPERR)，进程在 t=212 s 死掉。这里按表长分配 + 显式封顶，超出的只计数。 */
    int order[H_RT_SLOTS], drw[H_RT_SLOTS], no = 0, nover = 0;
    const char *lvs[H_RT_SLOTS], *lfs[H_RT_SLOTS];
    for (int i = 0; i < nsl; i++) {
        h_rt_slot *s = &g_rt_tab[i];
        if (!s->img || s->w < h_rs_dim(H_OFF_W) || s->h < h_rs_dim(H_OFF_H)) continue;   /* M6v */
        if (no >= (int)(sizeof order / sizeof *order)) { nover++; continue; }
        int nd = 0; const char *lv = "-", *lf = "-";
        for (int k = 0; k < g_lw_n; k++)
            if (g_lw[k].slot == i) { nd++; lv = g_lw[k].vs; lf = g_lw[k].fs; }
        order[no] = i; drw[no] = nd; lvs[no] = lv; lfs[no] = lf; no++;
    }
    /* 有 draw 的槽先探（内容最可能在那边）；同笔数按槽号。 */
    for (int a = 0; a < no; a++)
        for (int b = a + 1; b < no; b++)
            if (drw[b] > drw[a]) {
                int t0 = order[a]; order[a] = order[b]; order[b] = t0;
                t0 = drw[a]; drw[a] = drw[b]; drw[b] = t0;
                const char *t1 = lvs[a]; lvs[a] = lvs[b]; lvs[b] = t1;
                t1 = lfs[a]; lfs[a] = lfs[b]; lfs[b] = t1;
            }

    /* ① 被选中的源（可能不是槽：snap/cur/host）。 */
    r_sig_t ss; int sok = r_tex_signature(simg, slay, sw, sh, 4, &ss);
    const unsigned ssp = sok ? r_sig_spread(&ss) : 0;
    const int snf = sok && r_sig_has_content(&ss);
    const unsigned long long snp = (sok && ss.npx) ? ss.npx : 1;
    vk_boot_logf("[p] sel #%d call=%llu slot=%d id=%d ext=%ux%u nz=%.2f%% spread=%u "
                 "mean=%llu/%llu/%llu why=%s img=%#llx lay=%d key=%#llx cslot=%d csimg=%#llx sig=%s",
                 pn, call, sel_slot,
                 (sel_slot >= 0 && sel_slot < nsl) ? g_rt_tab[sel_slot].tex_id : (why[0] == 't' ? g_p_tex_id : -1),
                 sw, sh, sok ? 100.0 * (double)ss.nz / (double)snp : -1.0, ssp,
                 sok ? ss.sum[0] / snp : 0ull, sok ? ss.sum[1] / snp : 0ull, sok ? ss.sum[2] / snp : 0ull,
                 why, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)simg, (int)slay,
                 (sel_slot >= 0 && sel_slot < nsl) ? g_rt_tab[sel_slot].key : g_p_tex_key,
                 g_p_content_slot ? (int)(g_p_content_slot - g_rt_tab) : -1,
                 (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_p_content_img,
                 sok ? "ok" : "na");

    /* ② 同帧全部 ≥1280×720 槽（≤12 行明细，其余只计数）。 */
    int probed = 0, nonflat = 0, unprobed = 0, printed = 0;
    for (int a = 0; a < no; a++) {
        h_rt_slot *s = &g_rt_tab[order[a]];
        VkImageLayout lay = p_slot_layout(s);
        r_sig_t sg;
        int ok = r_tex_signature(s->img, lay, s->w, s->h, 4, &sg);
        if (!ok) { unprobed++; continue; }
        probed++;
        int nf = r_sig_has_content(&sg);
        if (nf) nonflat++;
        /* M38D（只读）：把 slot#29 自己的像素在 present 时刻（被清掉前）落一张 PNG。
           这是「白到底写没写进去」的直接判据：#29 若仍是 guest clear 值 ⇒ 76 笔没写进去。 */
        if (m38d_on() && order[a] == 29 && !g_m38d_slot29_png && s->w && s->h) {
            g_m38d_slot29_png = 1;
            VkDeviceSize dsz = (VkDeviceSize)s->w * (VkDeviceSize)s->h * 4ull;
            unsigned char *dpx = (unsigned char *)c_raw_copy(s->img, lay, s->w, s->h, dsz);
            if (dpx) {
                char dpp[256]; snprintf(dpp, sizeof dpp, "%sm38d_rt29_slot.png", m7h_dir());
                unsigned long long dby = m7h_write_png(dpp, s->w, s->h, dpx);
                vk_boot_logf("[m38d] rt29 png=%s bytes=%llu %ux%u lay=%d id=%d draws=%d",
                             dpp, dby, (unsigned)s->w, (unsigned)s->h, (int)lay, s->tex_id, drw[a]);
                free(dpx);
            } else vk_boot_logf("[m38d] rt29 png copy_fail");
        }
        if (printed < M4AK_SLOT_LINES) {
            printed++;
            const unsigned long long np = sg.npx ? sg.npx : 1;
            vk_boot_logf("[p] slots #%d slot=%d key=%#llx img=%#llx id=%d ext=%ux%u lay=%d nz=%.2f%% spread=%u "
                         "mean=%llu/%llu/%llu min=%llu/%llu/%llu max=%llu/%llu/%llu nt=%d draws=%d last_vs=%s last_fs=%s%s",
                         pn, order[a], s->key, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)s->img, s->tex_id,
                         (unsigned)s->w, (unsigned)s->h, (int)lay,
                         100.0 * (double)sg.nz / (double)np, r_sig_spread(&sg),
                         sg.sum[0] / np, sg.sum[1] / np, sg.sum[2] / np,
                         (unsigned long long)sg.mn[0], (unsigned long long)sg.mn[1], (unsigned long long)sg.mn[2],
                         (unsigned long long)sg.mx[0], (unsigned long long)sg.mx[1], (unsigned long long)sg.mx[2],
                         sg.nt, drw[a], lvs[a], lfs[a],
                         nf ? " NONFLAT" : "");
        }
    }
    if (printed < no)
        vk_boot_logf("[p] slots #%d more=%d (只打前 %d 行；全部 %d 个候选都已采样计入 cmp)",
                     pn, no - printed, M4AK_SLOT_LINES, no);

    /* ③ 判决汇总。 */
    const char *v = !sok ? "sel_unreadable"
                   : snf ? "selected_ok"
                   : (nonflat > 0) ? "sel_flat_but_nonflat_exists"
                                   : "all_flat";
    vk_boot_logf("[p] cmp #%d call=%llu cand=%d probed=%d unprobed=%d slots_nonflat=%d "
                 "selected_nonflat=%d sel_spread=%u sel_slot=%d sel_why=%s sub=%u over=%d verdict=%s",
                 pn, call, no, probed, unprobed, nonflat, snf ? 1 : 0, ssp, sel_slot, why,
                 g_lw_sub, nover, v);
    /* P3：本次 call 强制落一行 [p] sig（sel_call/sel_slot/sel_why 与 [p] sel 对上）。 */
    g_p_m4ak_sig_pair = 1;
}

/* M4ag P2：把**某个 RT 槽**整张回读落 P7/RGBA PAM。
   独立 buffer/自有 fence（不碰 g_h_fence / g_p_buf，避免和 present/draw 两条链抢同一个栅栏），
   布局临时 CAO/SRO/TRANSFER_SRC → TRANSFER_SRC → **回到原状**（不写 g_h_layout，调用方记账不变）。
   调用点只在「内容签名判到有画面」的那一瞬（r_rt_sig_tick 快照处）：present 时刻这些 RT 早已被清，
   那时候拍到的只是被清掉的图（M4y 实测 content lost = 100%），对判读没用。 */
static void p_dump_slot_pam(int idx, const char *path)
{
    int nsl = (int)(sizeof g_rt_tab / sizeof *g_rt_tab);
    if (idx < 0 || idx >= nsl) return;
    h_rt_slot *s = &g_rt_tab[idx];
    if (!s->img || !s->w || !s->h) { vk_boot_logf("[p] dump slot=%d skip (no img)", idx); return; }
    VkImageLayout lay = p_slot_layout(s);
    if (lay != VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL && lay != VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL &&
        lay != VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL) {
        vk_boot_logf("[p] dump slot=%d skip (layout=%d)", idx, (int)lay);
        return;
    }
    const VkDeviceSize sz = (VkDeviceSize)s->w * s->h * 4;
    VkBuffer buf = VK_NULL_HANDLE; VkDeviceMemory mem = VK_NULL_HANDLE; void *map = NULL;
    VkBufferCreateInfo bi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO };
    bi.size = sz; bi.usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT; bi.sharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE;
    if (vkCreateBuffer(g_dev, &bi, NULL, &buf) != VK_SUCCESS) { vk_boot_logf("[p-red] dump buf fail slot=%d", idx); return; }
    VkMemoryRequirements rq; vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(g_dev, buf, &rq);
    int ti = find_type(rq, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT);
    VkMemoryAllocateInfo ai = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO };
    ai.allocationSize = rq.size; ai.memoryTypeIndex = ti >= 0 ? (uint32_t)ti : 0;
    if (vkAllocateMemory(g_dev, &ai, NULL, &mem) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        vk_boot_logf("[p-red] dump mem fail slot=%d (%llu)", idx, (unsigned long long)rq.size);
        vkDestroyBuffer(g_dev, buf, NULL); return;
    }
    vkBindBufferMemory(g_dev, buf, mem, 0);
    VkCommandBuffer cb = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo ca = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO };
    ca.commandPool = g_h_cp; ca.level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY; ca.commandBufferCount = 1;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_vkq_lock);   /* M4bt P1：与 present 的拷贝串行 */
    if (vkAllocateCommandBuffers(g_dev, &ca, &cb) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        vk_boot_logf("[p-red] dump cb fail slot=%d", idx);
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_vkq_lock);
        vkDestroyBuffer(g_dev, buf, NULL); vkFreeMemory(g_dev, mem, NULL); return;
    }
    VkCommandBufferBeginInfo cbi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO };
    cbi.flags = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT;
    vkBeginCommandBuffer(cb, &cbi);
    VkImageSubresourceRange rng = { VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1 };
    VkImageMemoryBarrier b = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER };
    b.srcAccessMask = (lay == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL) ? VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT
                    : (lay == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL) ? VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT
                    : (VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT);
    b.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT;
    b.oldLayout = lay; b.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL;
    b.srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED; b.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
    b.image = s->img; b.subresourceRange = rng;
    beat_cmd();
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT,
                         0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &b);
    VkBufferImageCopy reg = {0};
    reg.imageSubresource = (VkImageSubresourceLayers){ VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1 };
    reg.imageExtent = (VkExtent3D){ s->w, s->h, 1 };
    beat_cmd();
    vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer(cb, s->img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, buf, 1, &reg);
    VkAccessFlags back_acc = (lay == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL) ? VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT
                           : (lay == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL) ? VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT
                           : (VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT);
    b = (VkImageMemoryBarrier){ VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER };
    b.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT; b.dstAccessMask = back_acc;
    b.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL; b.newLayout = lay;
    b.srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED; b.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
    b.image = s->img; b.subresourceRange = rng;
    beat_cmd();
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT,
                         0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &b);
    vkEndCommandBuffer(cb);
    VkFence fc = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkFenceCreateInfo fci = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FENCE_CREATE_INFO };
    int ok = 0;
    if (vkCreateFence(g_dev, &fci, NULL, &fc) == VK_SUCCESS) {
        VkSubmitInfo si = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO };
        si.commandBufferCount = 1; si.pCommandBuffers = &cb;
        VkResult sr = vkQueueSubmit(g_q, 1, &si, fc);
        if (sr == VK_SUCCESS && nvk_wait_fences(g_dev, 1, &fc, VK_TRUE, 60000000000ull) == VK_SUCCESS) ok = 1;
        else vk_boot_logf("[p-red] dump slot=%d submit=%d wait=%s", idx, (int)sr, vr(sr));
        vkDestroyFence(g_dev, fc, NULL);
    }
    vkFreeCommandBuffers(g_dev, g_h_cp, 1, &cb);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_vkq_lock);
    if (ok && vkMapMemory(g_dev, mem, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE, 0, &map) == VK_SUCCESS && map) {
        const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)map;
        unsigned long long sr2 = 0, sg2 = 0, sb2 = 0, nz = 0, npx = (unsigned long long)s->w * s->h;
        unsigned mn[3] = { 255, 255, 255 }, mx[3] = { 0, 0, 0 };
        for (unsigned long long i = 0; i < npx; i += 7) {   /* 抽样 1/7，够判「是不是单色/有没有结构」 */
            const uint8_t *q = p + i * 4;
            sr2 += q[0]; sg2 += q[1]; sb2 += q[2];
            if (q[0] || q[1] || q[2]) nz++;
            for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) { if (q[c] < mn[c]) mn[c] = q[c]; if (q[c] > mx[c]) mx[c] = q[c]; }
        }
        unsigned long long ns = (npx + 6) / 7;
        const char *used = path; char alt[160];
        FILE *f = fopen(used, "wb");
        if (!f) {
            const char *bn = strrchr(path, '/');
            snprintf(alt, sizeof alt, "/data/storage/el2/base/files/%s", bn && bn[1] ? bn + 1 : "dump.pam");
            f = fopen(alt, "wb"); used = alt;
        }
        unsigned long long wrote = 0;
        if (f) {
            fprintf(f, "P7\nWIDTH %u\nHEIGHT %u\nDEPTH 4\nMAXVAL 255\nTUPLTYPE RGB_ALPHA\nENDHDR\n",
                    (unsigned)s->w, (unsigned)s->h);
            wrote = (unsigned long long)fwrite(p, 1, (size_t)sz, f);
            fclose(f);
        }
        vk_boot_logf("[p] dump slot=%d key=%#llx img=%#llx ext=%ux%u lay=%d -> %s bytes=%llu "
                     "mean=%llu/%llu/%llu min=%llu/%llu/%llu max=%llu/%llu/%llu nz=%.2f%%",
                     idx, (unsigned long long)s->key, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)s->img,
                     (unsigned)s->w, (unsigned)s->h, (int)lay, used, wrote,
                     sr2 / (ns ? ns : 1), sg2 / (ns ? ns : 1), sb2 / (ns ? ns : 1),
                     (unsigned long long)mn[0], (unsigned long long)mn[1], (unsigned long long)mn[2],
                     (unsigned long long)mx[0], (unsigned long long)mx[1], (unsigned long long)mx[2],
                     100.0 * (double)nz / (double)(ns ? ns : 1));
        vkUnmapMemory(g_dev, mem);
    } else if (ok) {
        vk_boot_logf("[p-red] dump slot=%d map fail", idx);
    }
    vkDestroyBuffer(g_dev, buf, NULL);
    vkFreeMemory(g_dev, mem, NULL);
}

void nvn_vk_present_src(unsigned long long key, unsigned w, unsigned h, int texid, int idx)
{
    g_p_tex_key = key; g_p_tex_w = w; g_p_tex_h = h; g_p_tex_id = texid; g_p_tex_idx = idx;
    nw_note_win_key(key);   /* M4bw P1：累计「被 present 引用过的身份集合」（轮转的窗口纹理不止一张） */
    if (key && idx >= 0 && idx < 4) g_win_key[idx] = key;   /* M4bv P2：窗口纹理身份（present 侧权威口径） */
}
void nvn_vk_present_tex_stats(unsigned long long *src_tex, unsigned long long *miss,
                              unsigned long long *nolay, unsigned long long *ovr)
{
    if (src_tex) *src_tex = g_p_src_tex;
    if (miss) *miss = g_p_tex_miss;
    if (nolay) *nolay = g_p_tex_nolay;
    if (ovr) *ovr = g_p_src_ovr;
}

static unsigned present_every(void)
{
    static unsigned v;
    static int init;
    if (!init) {
        init = 1;
        const char *e = getenv("SMO_PRESENT_EVERY");
        v = (e && *e) ? (unsigned)strtoul(e, NULL, 10) : 0u;
        if (!v) v = 8u;
        vk_boot_logf("[p] present every=%u (SMO_PRESENT_EVERY)", v);
    }
    return v;
}

static int p_ensure(void)
{
    if (g_p_map) return 1;
    static int failed;
    if (failed) return 0;
    /* M4cc P1：按**整幅源**的上界分配（与 reg.imageExtent 的夹取盒子同），不再按 1280x720 上屏口。 */
    const VkDeviceSize sz = (VkDeviceSize)H_PRES_MAX_W * H_PRES_MAX_H * 4;
    VkBufferCreateInfo bi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO };
    bi.size = sz;
    bi.usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT;
    bi.sharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE;
    VkResult rv = vkCreateBuffer(g_dev, &bi, NULL, &g_p_buf);
    if (rv != VK_SUCCESS) { failed = 1; vk_boot_logf("[p-red] present vkCreateBuffer rv=%d (%s)", (int)rv, vr(rv)); return 0; }
    VkMemoryRequirements rq;
    vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(g_dev, g_p_buf, &rq);
    int ti = find_type(rq, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT);
    VkMemoryAllocateInfo ai = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO };
    ai.allocationSize = rq.size;
    ai.memoryTypeIndex = ti >= 0 ? (uint32_t)ti : 0;
    rv = vkAllocateMemory(g_dev, &ai, NULL, &g_p_mem);
    if (rv != VK_SUCCESS) {
        failed = 1;
        vk_boot_logf("[p-red] present vkAllocateMemory(%llu) rv=%d (%s)", (unsigned long long)rq.size, (int)rv, vr(rv));
        vkDestroyBuffer(g_dev, g_p_buf, NULL); g_p_buf = NULL; return 0;
    }
    vkBindBufferMemory(g_dev, g_p_buf, g_p_mem, 0);
    rv = vkMapMemory(g_dev, g_p_mem, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE, 0, &g_p_map);
    if (rv != VK_SUCCESS) {
        failed = 1;
        vk_boot_logf("[p-red] present vkMapMemory rv=%d (%s)", (int)rv, vr(rv));
        g_p_map = NULL; vkFreeMemory(g_dev, g_p_mem, NULL); g_p_mem = NULL;
        vkDestroyBuffer(g_dev, g_p_buf, NULL); g_p_buf = NULL; return 0;
    }
    VkFenceCreateInfo fci = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FENCE_CREATE_INFO };
    rv = vkCreateFence(g_dev, &fci, NULL, &g_p_fence);
    if (rv != VK_SUCCESS) {
        failed = 1;
        vk_boot_logf("[p-red] present vkCreateFence rv=%d (%s)", (int)rv, vr(rv));
        vkUnmapMemory(g_dev, g_p_mem); g_p_map = NULL;
        vkFreeMemory(g_dev, g_p_mem, NULL); g_p_mem = NULL;
        vkDestroyBuffer(g_dev, g_p_buf, NULL); g_p_buf = NULL; return 0;
    }
    vk_boot_logf("[p] staging buf=%#llx mem=%#llx map=%p max=%dx%d host-visible ti=%d rq=%llu size=%llu",
                 (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_p_buf, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_p_mem,
                 g_p_map, (int)H_PRES_MAX_W, (int)H_PRES_MAX_H, ti, (unsigned long long)rq.size,
                 (unsigned long long)sz);
    return 1;
}

/* M4bi P1：把「**本次真正要上屏的那份像素**」落盘成 PAM 并打五档直方图。
   为什么不用 p_dump_slot_pam：那条路要另起一张图→buffer 拷贝，并借 g_h_cp（present 线程与 draw 线程
   共用同一个 command pool，Vulkan 要求外部同步，跨线程用有崩的风险）。而 present 本来就已经把源图
   拷进 staging（g_p_map）并等过 fence ⇒ 这里只读那块 host-visible 内存，
   **零 GPU 工作、零同步风险**，且口径就是屏幕上那张图本身。
   M4cc P1：区域口径改成 g_p_cp_w/g_p_cp_h（= 本帧真正拷进来的源区域，整幅），不再写死 1280x720。
   PAM 落盘每 boot ≤2 张（5.8 MB/张 @1600x900），调用方限流。 */
static void m4bi_dump_present(const char *path, unsigned long long call)
{
    if (!g_p_map) return;
    const unsigned w = g_p_cp_w, h = g_p_cp_h;
    const unsigned long long npx = (unsigned long long)w * h;
    const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)g_p_map;
    unsigned long long sr = 0, sg = 0, sb = 0, nz = 0, hb[5] = { 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 };
    unsigned mn[3] = { 255, 255, 255 }, mx[3] = { 0, 0, 0 };
    for (unsigned long long i = 0; i < npx; i++) {
        const uint8_t *q = p + i * 4;
        sr += q[0]; sg += q[1]; sb += q[2];
        if (q[0] || q[1] || q[2]) nz++;
        for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) { if (q[c] < mn[c]) mn[c] = q[c]; if (q[c] > mx[c]) mx[c] = q[c]; }
        unsigned lum = (q[0] > q[1]) ? (q[0] > q[2] ? q[0] : q[2]) : (q[1] > q[2] ? q[1] : q[2]);
        hb[lum < 16 ? 0 : lum < 64 ? 1 : lum < 128 ? 2 : lum < 192 ? 3 : 4]++;
    }
    const char *used = path; char alt[160]; FILE *f = fopen(path, "wb");
    if (!f) {
        const char *bn = strrchr(path, '/');
        snprintf(alt, sizeof alt, "/data/storage/el2/base/files/%s", bn && bn[1] ? bn + 1 : "m4bi.pam");
        f = fopen(alt, "wb"); used = alt;
    }
    unsigned long long wrote = 0;
    if (f) {
        fprintf(f, "P7\nWIDTH %u\nHEIGHT %u\nDEPTH 4\nMAXVAL 255\nTUPLTYPE RGB_ALPHA\nENDHDR\n", w, h);
        wrote = (unsigned long long)fwrite(p, 1, (size_t)(npx * 4), f);
        fclose(f);
    }
    vk_boot_logf("[g] m4bi present pix call=%llu %ux%u -> %s bytes=%llu mean=%llu/%llu/%llu "
                 "min=%llu/%llu/%llu max=%llu/%llu/%llu nz=%.2f%% "
                 "hist[<16,16-64,64-128,128-192,>192]=%.2f%%,%.2f%%,%.2f%%,%.2f%%,%.2f%%",
                 call, w, h, used, wrote, sr / npx, sg / npx, sb / npx,
                 (unsigned long long)mn[0], (unsigned long long)mn[1], (unsigned long long)mn[2],
                 (unsigned long long)mx[0], (unsigned long long)mx[1], (unsigned long long)mx[2],
                 100.0 * (double)nz / (double)npx,
                 100.0 * (double)hb[0] / (double)npx, 100.0 * (double)hb[1] / (double)npx,
                 100.0 * (double)hb[2] / (double)npx, 100.0 * (double)hb[3] / (double)npx,
                 100.0 * (double)hb[4] / (double)npx);
    /* 顺手记「亮度」口径下的分位数，判「是整体暗还是几乎全黑」用（0 = 全黑）。 */
}

/* M4bi P1/P2：`smo_present_gain` —— 只影响**上屏那份像素**的合成曝光（synthetic exposure），
   不动游戏自己的 RT。缺省 1 = 关（零行为改动）；>1 时把 staging 里 RGB 直接乘系数（饱和到 255），
   用作 P2「把暗槽提到可视范围」的一处修。每 64 次 present 重读一次文件。 */
static int p_present_gain(void)
{
    static int cached = -2; static unsigned long long last;
    if (cached == -2) { p_file_seed(P_GAIN_A, P_GAIN_B); cached = p_file_int(P_GAIN_A, P_GAIN_B, 1); last = g_p_calls; }
    else if (g_p_calls - last >= 64) { cached = p_file_int(P_GAIN_A, P_GAIN_B, 1); last = g_p_calls; }
    if (cached < 1) cached = 1;
    if (cached > 64) cached = 64;
    return cached;
}
static void p_apply_gain(int g)
{
    if (g <= 1 || !g_p_map) return;
    uint8_t *p = (uint8_t *)g_p_map;
    const unsigned long long n = (unsigned long long)g_p_cp_w * g_p_cp_h;
    for (unsigned long long i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        uint8_t *q = p + i * 4;
        for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
            unsigned v = (unsigned)q[c] * (unsigned)g;
            q[c] = (uint8_t)(v > 255u ? 255u : v);
        }
    }
}

/* M4bi P1：present 时刻的「实况像素」取样（**上屏那一份**，未提亮）。
   M4bt P2：改成 3 张、间隔 ≥100 s（≈t105/205/305），用来同时证明「原色亮度」与「画面在变」。 */
static void m4bi_probe(unsigned long long call, int ovr, int ovr_lock)
{
    /* M4bj P1：不再只跟 ovr_lock —— 本轮的取证要的是「正常上屏链在放什么」，取样照旧。 */
    if (call < 200) return;
    (void)ovr_lock;
    static int n; static unsigned long long t0, last;
    if (n >= 3) return;
    struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    const unsigned long long now = (unsigned long long)ts.tv_sec * 1000000ull + (unsigned long long)ts.tv_nsec / 1000ull;
    if (!t0) { t0 = now; return; }
    if (now - t0 < 105000000ull) return;
    if (last && now - last < 100000000ull) return;
    last = now; n++;
    char path[160];
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/m4bi_ovr%d_%d.pam", P_SLOT_DIR_B, ovr, n);
    vk_boot_logf("[g] m4bi probe #%d slot=%d t=%llus (source = 硬指定上屏槽)", n, ovr,
                 (unsigned)((now - t0) / 1000000ull));
    m4bi_dump_present(path, call);
}

/* M4cb P1: locate the composite RT slot by identity (tex_id==282 and ext==1600x900).
   Slot index and VkImage pointer are NOT identity (ASLR / pool rebuild); they are only the
   lookup result for this frame. If several slots carry tex_id 282, prefer the one written by
   this submit (g_slot_dw); otherwise the first usable one. Returns -1 = no usable slot, in
   which case the caller falls back to the previous source chain (never hard-coded, never guessed). */
static int p_find_rt282(void)
{
    const int ns = (int)(sizeof g_rt_tab / sizeof *g_rt_tab);
    int first = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < ns; i++) {
        h_rt_slot *s = &g_rt_tab[i];
        if (!s->key || !s->img || s->tex_id != 282) continue;
        /* M6v P1：ext 现在是光栅尺寸（1600x900 ÷ D），身份仍按 guest 的 1600x900 判。 */
        if (s->w != h_rs_dim(1600u) || s->h != h_rs_dim(900u)) continue;
        if (!p_src_copyable(s)) continue;
        if (i < (int)(sizeof g_slot_dw / sizeof *g_slot_dw) && g_slot_dw[i]) return i;
        if (first < 0) first = i;
    }
    return first;
}

/* ================= M5t P1: present source = measured auto pick + hysteresis =================
   派活单 M5t：把上屏源从「常量 texid=282」改成**每帧在候选 RT 里按实测分数挑，带迟滞**；
   282 不再是特权源，只作为普通候选参与（它唯一的优势是 ext=1600x900 与 writers，靠实测拿分）。

   候选资格（全部满足才合格）：
     ① 尺寸族 —— 优先 1600x900；本帧若 1600x900 一个都不合格，才允许别的尺寸（>=1280x720，
        受 p_src_copyable 约束），并打 `sizedown`；
     ② 本帧 writers > 0（g_slot_dw，submit 边界清零，== 本帧真有人写这张 RT）；
     ③ 整幅实测 mean > 10/255（RGB 三通道总均值）且 spread > 0。
        spread = 五档亮度直方图里「最高占用桶 - 最低占用桶」（0..4）：纯黑/纯白/单色填充/
        我们自己的洋红清屏色都只占一个桶 ⇒ spread=0 ⇒ 不合格。这一条就是修 M4bh 的近黑误判：
        当时判据是 colored>5%，而近黑图 colored=100%。
   打分：score = writers*1000 + mean*1000/255 —— writers 主序，mean 只做次序（权重 < 1 笔 writer）。
   迟滞：候选须**连续 P_AUTO_N=8 帧**分数 >= 当前源 1.5 倍（2*new >= 3*old）才切；切换后
         P_AUTO_DWELL=30 帧内不再换；同一帧只做一次判决（present 每帧一次），构造上不会同帧抖动。
   无合格候选：保持上一源（若它仍可用）；连上一源都没了才 return -1，交回旧的 if/else 链
         （gpres/snap/ours/worldRT/...），**不改动那条链的任何判据**。

   成本控制（SwiftShader 软渲，一次整幅回读 = 5.76 MB + 一次 submit + fence）：
     · 每帧免费量：g_slot_dw writers、尺寸、槽身份；
     · 整幅回读只给「writers 前几名的候选」，每次扫描 ≤ P_AUTO_MAX_RB=3 张，每
       P_AUTO_SCAN_EVERY=8 次 present 才刷新一轮，读到的 mean/spread 按 (slot,img,key) 缓存 ——
       槽重建（img/key 变）自动失效。所以 writer 分数每帧都是新的，mean/spread 最多 8 帧旧，
       日志里把读数年龄一起打出来，不藏。 */
#define P_AUTO_FILE_A P_SLOT_DIR_A "/smo_present_auto"
#define P_AUTO_FILE_B P_SLOT_DIR_B "/smo_present_auto"
#define P_AUTO_N           8      /* 连续领先帧数（present 帧） */
#define P_AUTO_DWELL      30      /* 切换后的最小停留帧数 */
#define P_AUTO_SCAN_EVERY  3      /* mean/spread 读数刷新周期（**判决帧**数，不是 present 调用数） */
#define P_AUTO_MAX_RB      2      /* 每次扫描的整幅回读上限（boot#1：3 张/帧时 draw 少 4.4%） */
#define P_AUTO_LOG_PICK    4      /* 判决帧每 4 帧打一行 pick */
#define P_AUTO_LOG_CAND   12      /* 判决帧每 12 帧打一行候选 top5 */
#define P_AUTO_TOPK        5      /* 候选 top-K 日志 */
#define P_AUTO_MAXC       H_RT_SLOTS   /* M6b：候选数组上限必须跟槽表一起扩（否则 256 槽时会越界写 idx[]） */

/* 每槽最近一次实测（身份不符即失效）。 */
static struct {
    VkImage            img;
    unsigned long long key;
    unsigned long long mean;      /* 0..255（r,g,b 总均值） */
    unsigned           spread;    /* 0..4 */
    unsigned long long at;        /* 判决帧号（g_pa_dec） */
    int                valid;
} g_pa_mem[H_RT_SLOTS];

/* 本帧判决结果（给调用方打日志 + 选源用）。 */
static int            g_pa_pick_slot;
static int            g_pa_pick_tex;
static unsigned       g_pa_pick_wr, g_pa_pick_spread, g_pa_pick_ncand;
static unsigned       g_pa_pick_sw, g_pa_pick_sizedown, g_pa_pick_age;
static unsigned long long g_pa_dec;      /* 判决帧计数（= 真拷帧；迟滞与日志节流都以它为单位） */
static unsigned long long g_pa_pick_mean, g_pa_pick_score;
/* 跨帧状态。 */
static int            g_pa_cur_slot = -1, g_pa_cur_texid = -1;
static VkImage        g_pa_cur_img;
static unsigned long long g_pa_cur_key, g_pa_cur_score, g_pa_dwell;
static int            g_pa_chal_slot = -1, g_pa_chal_frames;
static unsigned long long g_pa_chal_key;
static unsigned long long g_pa_scans, g_pa_rbs, g_pa_switches, g_pa_none;

/* 开关 `smo_present_auto`：C 里缺省 1=开（不依赖任何外部文件；文件存在则按其值做 A/B）。 */
static int p_auto_on(void)
{
    /* M7i P1：M7H_PRES_ON=1 时 auto 必须让位 —— present 分支链里 auto 排在 m7h-world 之前，
       M7h2 实测 auto 整 boot 抱着 slot 0（texid=282, mean=12）⇒ 不关它，m7h 分支永远绑不上
       （这正是派活单判据「pick_slot 应切到 m7h_src」的拦路石）。关掉后 [wp] rt sum 的
       pick_slot 恒 -1 =「auto 按设计让位」，真实上屏源看 `[o] present ... src=m7h-world slot=..`。
       回退：M7H_PRES_ON 改回 0 本行自动失效（编译期常量，无运行时开销）。 */
    if (M7H_PRES_ON) return 0;
    static int cached = -2; static unsigned long long last;
    if (cached == -2) { cached = p_file_int(P_AUTO_FILE_A, P_AUTO_FILE_B, 1); last = g_p_calls; }
    else if (g_p_calls - last >= 64) { cached = p_file_int(P_AUTO_FILE_A, P_AUTO_FILE_B, 1); last = g_p_calls; }
    return cached != 0;
}

/* 整幅回读一张候选（调用方持有 g_vkq_lock：c_img_stats 用同一个 g_q / g_h_cp / g_h_fence）。 */
static int p_auto_read(int slot, unsigned long long dec)
{
    h_rt_slot *s = &g_rt_tab[slot];
    if (!s->key || !s->img) { g_pa_mem[slot].valid = 0; return 0; }
    c_stat_t st;
    const VkImageLayout lay = p_slot_layout(s);
    if (!c_img_stats(s->img, lay, (unsigned)s->w, (unsigned)s->h, 4, &st) || !st.npx) {
        g_pa_mem[slot].valid = 0; return 0;
    }
    const unsigned long long npx = st.npx;
    unsigned lo = 5, hi = 0;
    for (unsigned b = 0; b < 5; b++) if (st.hb[b]) { if (b < lo) lo = b; if (b > hi) hi = b; }
    g_pa_mem[slot].img    = s->img;
    g_pa_mem[slot].key    = s->key;
    g_pa_mem[slot].mean   = (st.sr + st.sg + st.sb) / (3ull * npx);
    g_pa_mem[slot].spread = (lo <= hi) ? (hi - lo) : 0u;
    g_pa_mem[slot].at     = dec;
    g_pa_mem[slot].valid  = 1;
    g_pa_rbs++;
    return 1;
}

/* 本帧选源。返槽号（>=0）或 -1（无源可用 ⇒ 调用方走旧链）。只读 + 自己的跨帧状态。 */
static int p_auto_select(unsigned long long call)
{
    const int ns = (int)(sizeof g_rt_tab / sizeof *g_rt_tab);
    static int idx[P_AUTO_MAXC];
    g_pa_pick_slot = -1; g_pa_pick_tex = -1; g_pa_pick_wr = 0; g_pa_pick_spread = 0;
    g_pa_pick_ncand = 0; g_pa_pick_sw = 0; g_pa_pick_sizedown = 0; g_pa_pick_age = 0;
    g_pa_pick_mean = 0; g_pa_pick_score = 0;
    const unsigned long long dec = ++g_pa_dec;   /* 判决帧号：present 每 N 次才真拷一次，只有这些帧才选源 */
    g_pa_dwell++;

    /* ---- 1. 免费候选：本帧被写过 + 可拷 + 尺寸 >=1280x720（p_src_copyable 口径一致） ---- */
    int n = 0, npref = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < ns; i++) {
        h_rt_slot *s = &g_rt_tab[i];
        if (!s->key || !s->img || !p_src_copyable(s)) continue;
        if (i >= (int)(sizeof g_slot_dw / sizeof *g_slot_dw)) continue;
        const unsigned wr = g_slot_dw[i];
        if (!wr) continue;
        int dup = 0;                                  /* 同一张图多身份：只留一个 */
        for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) if (g_rt_tab[idx[k]].img == s->img) { dup = 1; break; }
        if (dup) continue;
        /* 1600x900 优先：插入到 pref 段之后、按 writers 降序（M6v：按光栅尺寸比，guest 1600x900） */
        int pos = n;
        for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
            const h_rt_slot *o = &g_rt_tab[idx[k]];
            const int op = (o->w == h_rs_dim(1600u) && o->h == h_rs_dim(900u));
            const int np = (s->w == h_rs_dim(1600u) && s->h == h_rs_dim(900u));
            const unsigned ow = g_slot_dw[idx[k]];
            if ((np && !op) || (np == op && wr > ow)) { pos = k; break; }
        }
        for (int k = n; k > pos; k--) idx[k] = idx[k - 1];
        idx[pos] = i; n++;
    }
    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
        const h_rt_slot *o = &g_rt_tab[idx[k]];
        if (o->w == h_rs_dim(1600u) && o->h == h_rs_dim(900u)) npref = k + 1;
    }
    g_pa_pick_ncand = (unsigned)n;

    /* ---- 2. 实测（限流 + 缓存），按 writers 顺序量；预算外只放行「1 张非 1600x900」 ---- */
    int best = -1, rb = 0, lock_taken = 0, rb_other = 0;
    unsigned long long best_score = 0ull;
    unsigned long long cur_score_fresh = 0ull;
    int cur_seen = 0;
    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
        const int i = idx[k];
        h_rt_slot *s = &g_rt_tab[i];
        int fresh = g_pa_mem[i].valid && g_pa_mem[i].img == s->img && g_pa_mem[i].key == s->key;
        int uptodate = fresh && (dec - g_pa_mem[i].at) <= (unsigned long long)P_AUTO_SCAN_EVERY;
        /* 预算：正常 ≤ P_AUTO_MAX_RB 张；若 1600x900 一个都没合格，再放 1 张别的尺寸去试
           （否则「pref 全黑 ⇒ 永远轮不到 sizedown」），这一张也只在没合格候选时才花。 */
        const int allow = (rb < P_AUTO_MAX_RB) ||
                          (best < 0 && k >= npref && !rb_other && rb < P_AUTO_MAX_RB + 1);
        if (!uptodate && allow) {
            if (!lock_taken) { pthread_mutex_lock(&g_vkq_lock); lock_taken = 1; }
            p_auto_read(i, dec); rb++; g_pa_scans++;
            if (k >= npref) rb_other = 1;
            fresh = g_pa_mem[i].valid && g_pa_mem[i].img == s->img && g_pa_mem[i].key == s->key;
        }
        if (!fresh) continue;                          /* 没测到就不算合格（不猜） */
        const unsigned long long mean = g_pa_mem[i].mean;
        const unsigned spread = g_pa_mem[i].spread;
        const unsigned long long score = (unsigned long long)g_slot_dw[i] * 1000ull + mean * 1000ull / 255ull;
        if (i == g_pa_cur_slot) { cur_seen = 1; cur_score_fresh = score; }
        if (!(mean > 10ull && spread > 0)) continue;   /* 资格 ③ */
        if (score > best_score) { best = i; best_score = score; }
    }
    if (lock_taken) pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_vkq_lock);
    if (cur_seen) g_pa_cur_score = cur_score_fresh;

    /* ---- 3. 当前源是否还活着（身份 + 可拷 + 尺寸） ---- */
    const int before_tex = g_pa_cur_texid;   /* 进本帧之前的源（日志 prev=） */
    int cur_alive = 0;
    if (g_pa_cur_slot >= 0 && g_pa_cur_slot < ns) {
        h_rt_slot *c = &g_rt_tab[g_pa_cur_slot];
        if (c->key && c->img && c->img == g_pa_cur_img && c->key == g_pa_cur_key && p_src_copyable(c)) cur_alive = 1;
    }
    if (!cur_alive) {
        /* 源已死（槽被重建/不可拷）：立刻放弃它，别让 pick 指着一张已经不存在的图。 */
        g_pa_cur_score = 0ull; g_pa_cur_texid = -1; g_pa_cur_slot = -1;
    } else if (!cur_seen && g_pa_mem[g_pa_cur_slot].valid &&
               g_pa_mem[g_pa_cur_slot].img == g_rt_tab[g_pa_cur_slot].img) {
        /* 当前源本帧没被写（不在候选表里）⇒ 它的 writers 项就是 0，分数只剩 mean 项。
           不这么做的话，一个「停了但分数很高」的旧源会永久挡住后来者（1.5x 永远够不着）。 */
        g_pa_cur_score = g_pa_mem[g_pa_cur_slot].mean * 1000ull / 255ull;
    }

    /* ---- 4. 迟滞判决 ---- */
    if (best == g_pa_cur_slot) { g_pa_chal_frames = 0; g_pa_chal_slot = -1; }
    else if (best >= 0) {
        if (g_pa_chal_slot == best && g_pa_chal_key == g_rt_tab[best].key) g_pa_chal_frames++;
        else { g_pa_chal_slot = best; g_pa_chal_key = g_rt_tab[best].key; g_pa_chal_frames = 1; }
        const unsigned long long cs = cur_alive ? g_pa_cur_score : 0ull;
        const int strong = (cs == 0ull) || (best_score * 2ull >= cs * 3ull);
        if (strong && g_pa_chal_frames >= P_AUTO_N && g_pa_dwell >= P_AUTO_DWELL) {
            vk_boot_logf("[w] present SWITCH from=%d to=%d why=%llu>=%llu*1.5 score_x1000 call=%llu "
                         "slot=%d->%d dwell=%llu lead=%d rb=%d/%d",
                         cur_alive ? g_pa_cur_texid : -1, g_rt_tab[best].tex_id,
                         best_score, cs, call, g_pa_cur_slot, best, g_pa_dwell, g_pa_chal_frames, rb, n);
            g_pa_cur_slot = best; g_pa_cur_img = g_rt_tab[best].img; g_pa_cur_key = g_rt_tab[best].key;
            g_pa_cur_texid = g_rt_tab[best].tex_id; g_pa_cur_score = best_score;
            g_pa_dwell = 0; g_pa_switches++; g_pa_pick_sw = 1;
            g_pa_chal_frames = 0; g_pa_chal_slot = -1;
            cur_alive = 1;
        }
    }

    /* ---- 5. 选源 + 日志（限流） ---- */
    int pick = -1;
    if (g_pa_cur_slot >= 0) {
        h_rt_slot *c = &g_rt_tab[g_pa_cur_slot];
        pick = g_pa_cur_slot;
        g_pa_pick_wr = g_slot_dw[g_pa_cur_slot];
        if (g_pa_mem[g_pa_cur_slot].valid && g_pa_mem[g_pa_cur_slot].img == c->img) {
            g_pa_pick_mean = g_pa_mem[g_pa_cur_slot].mean;
            g_pa_pick_spread = g_pa_mem[g_pa_cur_slot].spread;
            g_pa_pick_age = (unsigned)(dec - g_pa_mem[g_pa_cur_slot].at);
        }
        g_pa_pick_tex = c->tex_id;
        g_pa_pick_score = (unsigned long long)g_pa_pick_wr * 1000ull +
                          g_pa_pick_mean * 1000ull / 255ull;
    }
    if ((dec % P_AUTO_LOG_PICK) == 0) {
        if (pick >= 0 && best < 0) {
            /* 本帧没有任何合格候选 ⇒ 保持上一源（派活单要求这一行单独打）。 */
            g_pa_none++;
            vk_boot_logf("[w] present src=auto none keep=%d (cand=%d rb=%d/%d none=%llu sw=%llu call=%llu dec=%llu)",
                         g_pa_pick_tex, n, rb, n, g_pa_none, g_pa_switches, call, dec);
        } else if (pick >= 0) {
            const h_rt_slot *c = &g_rt_tab[pick];
            vk_boot_logf("[w] present src=auto pick=texid=%d slot=%d writers=%u mean=%llu spread=%u "
                         "score=%llu prev=%d switched=%d cand=%d ext=%ux%u age=%u rb=%d/%d sw=%llu",
                         c->tex_id, pick, g_pa_pick_wr, g_pa_pick_mean, g_pa_pick_spread,
                         g_pa_pick_score, before_tex, (int)g_pa_pick_sw, (int)g_pa_pick_ncand,
                         (unsigned)c->w, (unsigned)c->h, g_pa_pick_age, rb, n, g_pa_switches);
        } else {
            g_pa_none++;
            vk_boot_logf("[w] present src=auto none keep=none (cand=%d rb=%d/%d none=%llu sw=%llu call=%llu dec=%llu) -> 旧链",
                         n, rb, n, g_pa_none, g_pa_switches, call, dec);
        }
    } else if (g_pa_pick_sw && pick >= 0) {
        const h_rt_slot *c = &g_rt_tab[pick];
        vk_boot_logf("[w] present src=auto pick=texid=%d slot=%d writers=%u mean=%llu spread=%u "
                     "score=%llu prev=%d switched=1 cand=%d ext=%ux%u age=%u",
                     c->tex_id, pick, g_pa_pick_wr, g_pa_pick_mean, g_pa_pick_spread,
                     g_pa_pick_score, before_tex, (int)g_pa_pick_ncand, (unsigned)c->w, (unsigned)c->h,
                     g_pa_pick_age);
    }
    /* 候选 top5：每 300 次 present 一行（全部取缓存，不额外回读）。 */
    if ((dec % P_AUTO_LOG_CAND) == 0 && n > 0) {
        char ln[900]; int lo = 0; ln[0] = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < n && k < P_AUTO_TOPK && lo < (int)sizeof ln - 120; k++) {
            const int i = idx[k];
            const h_rt_slot *s = &g_rt_tab[i];
            const int val = g_pa_mem[i].valid && g_pa_mem[i].img == s->img && g_pa_mem[i].key == s->key;
            const unsigned long long mean = val ? g_pa_mem[i].mean : 0ull;
            const unsigned spread = val ? g_pa_mem[i].spread : 0u;
            const unsigned long long score = (unsigned long long)g_slot_dw[i] * 1000ull + mean * 1000ull / 255ull;
            lo += snprintf(ln + lo, sizeof ln - (size_t)lo,
                           "%s%df[%u]slot=%d texid=%d ext=%ux%u writers=%u mean=%llu spread=%u score=%llu%s",
                           k ? " | " : "", k, val,
                           i, s->tex_id, (unsigned)s->w, (unsigned)s->h, g_slot_dw[i], mean, spread, score,
                           (val && mean > 10ull && spread > 0) ? "" : "!elig");
        }
        vk_boot_logf("[w] rt cand call=%llu dec=%llu ncand=%d pref=%d rbs_total=%llu :: %s",
                     call, dec, n, npref, g_pa_rbs, ln);
    }
    if (pick >= 0 && !(g_rt_tab[pick].w == h_rs_dim(1600u) && g_rt_tab[pick].h == h_rs_dim(900u)) && g_pa_pick_sizedown < 3) {
        /* 本帧 1600x900 没有一个合格 ⇒ 用别的尺寸。每 boot 最多 3 行。 */
        g_pa_pick_sizedown++;
        vk_boot_logf("[w] present src=auto sizedown pick=texid=%d ext=%ux%u cand=%d (1600x900 无合格候选)",
                     g_pa_pick_tex, (unsigned)g_rt_tab[pick].w, (unsigned)g_rt_tab[pick].h, n);
    }
    g_pa_pick_slot = pick;
    return pick;
}

/* ================= M7a P1: `SMO_WORLD_PROBE` -- read-only world-RT / world-draw probe =================
   Task section B: separate "is the world RT empty" from "did present pick the wrong source".
   Two line groups every WP_PERIOD_MS:
     (1) `[wp] rt ...`   every screen-sized RT (1600x900 / SMO_RT_DIV = 800x450), plus the current
        present pick and the current render target: slot / texid / ext / writers(all boot) /
        mean(r,g,b) / max(r,g,b) / nz% / colored% / 5-bucket luminance hist / cls=black|dark|bright.
     (2) `[wp] tgt ...`  per-slot draw+vertex delta for the window since the last tick -- this is
        the line that answers "which tgt do the world geometry draws land on".
   Constraints (task 0/B): no behaviour change; readback goes through c_img_stats (same path the
   auto picker already uses, layout restored by it); a failed readback prints cls=n/a, nothing is
   estimated. No extra copy on the hot path (verts are accumulated at the existing g_slot_dw[si]++).
   Switch: file smo_world_probe (the app seeds it to -1 = ON). C default 1; write 0 to silence the
   whole block (one-key revert). WP_MAX_RB = max full-frame readbacks per tick (each 800x450 is
   1.44 MB host-visible + one submit/fence). */
#define WP_PERIOD_MS 60000ull
#define WP_MAX_SLOTS 12
#define WP_MAX_RB     8
static unsigned long long g_wp_pv[H_RT_SLOTS], g_wp_pd[H_RT_SLOTS];   /* previous tick's (verts, draws) */
static unsigned long long g_wp_ticks, g_wp_last_ms, g_wp_rb_err;
static unsigned long long g_wp_pv_host, g_wp_pd_host;   /* previous tick's host-bucket (verts, draws) */
/* M7a fix: r_now_ms() is CLOCK_MONOTONIC, i.e. system uptime -- printing it directly produced
   "t=30921s" on a 700 s boot. Anchor to the first tick so t= is boot-relative as the task expects. */
static unsigned long long g_wp_t0_ms;

static int wp_on(void)   /* default 1 = ON; file value 0 turns it off (p_file_seed creates the file). */
{
    if (g_wp_on < 0) {
        p_file_seed(P_SLOT_DIR_A "/smo_world_probe", P_SLOT_DIR_B "/smo_world_probe");
        g_wp_on = p_file_int(P_SLOT_DIR_A "/smo_world_probe", P_SLOT_DIR_B "/smo_world_probe", 1) != 0;
        vk_boot_logf("[wp] probe %s (switch smo_world_probe, C default 1, log-only)",
                     g_wp_on ? "ON" : "OFF");
        /* M7g：图像身份/生命周期探针没有文件开关，只有编译期默认值（沙箱建不了文件）⇒ 在这里回读一次。 */
        vk_boot_logf("[m7g] probe %s (C default M7G_ON=%d, log-only: claim / ident / clr / foreign / id / post)",
                     M7G_ON ? "ON" : "OFF", M7G_ON);
        /* M7h：PNG dump + 上屏源切换探针的开关回读（同上，只有编译期默认值）。 */
        vk_boot_logf("[m7h] probe %s pres=%s (C default M7H_ON=%d M7H_PRES_ON=%d: post_rb dump PNG / present by img)",
                     M7H_ON ? "ON" : "OFF", M7H_PRES_ON ? "ON" : "OFF", M7H_ON, M7H_PRES_ON);
        /* M7k：小图 LRU 让位直通（场景族贴图 PH+up0 修复）的开关回读（编译期默认值，nvn_vk.h）。 */
        vk_boot_logf("[m7k] small-evict %s (C default M7K_SMALL_EVICT_ON=%d: <=1MB id-img LRU evict bypass binds>=8 gate)",
                     M7K_SMALL_EVICT_ON ? "ON" : "OFF", M7K_SMALL_EVICT_ON);
        /* M7l：零归属取证（上传点源字节 nz + 场景族解排布签名 + 动态观察名单）的开关回读。 */
        vk_boot_logf("[m7l] scene-probe %s (C default M7L_ON=%d: [m7l] up nz_src + [m7l] sig for post-scene uploads)",
                     M7L_ON ? "ON" : "OFF", M7L_ON);
        /* M7m: texture PNG dump switch readback (compile-time default only, no file knob). */
        vk_boot_logf("[m7m] probe %s (C default M7M_ON=%d: BC-family + scene-slot0 small-BC PNG dump, budget 9/boot)",
                     M7M_ON ? "ON" : "OFF", M7M_ON);
        /* M7o: scene FS UV-patch switch readback (compile-time default only, no file knob). */
        vk_boot_logf("[m7o] probe %s (C default M7O_ON=%d: FS key 0c70f5be9430cba7 -> loc1-UV + tex.rgb passthrough spv)",
                     M7O_ON ? "ON" : "OFF", M7O_ON);
        /* M7p: reserved scene-draw dump slots readback (compile-time default only, no file knob). */
        vk_boot_logf("[m7p] probe %s (C default M7P_ON=%d M7P_MAX=%d: vs=24702883 draw -> latch target img, force PNG m7p_scene_*.png before menu claims)",
                     M7P_ON ? "ON" : "OFF", M7P_ON, M7P_MAX);
    }
    return g_wp_on;
}

/* Luminance definition identical to c_stat_t.hb: lum = max(r,g,b). cls uses only the max value;
   the histogram is printed too so the verdict can be re-derived instead of trusted. */
static const char *wp_cls(const c_stat_t *st)
{
    unsigned mx;
    if (!st->npx) return "n/a";
    mx = st->mxr; if (st->mxg > mx) mx = st->mxg; if (st->mxb > mx) mx = st->mxb;
    if (mx == 0) return "black";
    if (mx < 32) return "dark";
    return "bright";
}

/* v/npx as "N.NN" -> prints with %llu.%02llu; pct2 receives the value scaled by 100. */
static unsigned long long wp_pct2(unsigned long long v, unsigned long long npx)
{
    return npx ? (v * 10000ull / npx) : 0ull;
}

/* ====== M7g P2（只读）: 回读时刻的图像身份 vs draw 时刻的 claim 身份 ======
   判据（派活单 §3A）：
     same_slot=1 && same_key=1 ⇒ 同一张图、同一身份 ⇒ 矛盾在「之后被 clear/覆盖」（看 clr/foreign/post 行）；
     same_key=0               ⇒ `[wp]` 读的 VkImage 已不是世界这笔 draw 写的身份（槽被 restamp/回收）。
   同时把 claim 之后的累计量（draws/verts/clears/foreign/restamp/retire）一起打出来，方便对时序。 */
static void m7g_id_log(unsigned long long call, unsigned long long el, unsigned long long tick,
                       int slot, const h_rt_slot *s, int ok, const c_stat_t *st)
{
    m7g_img *e;
    if (!M7G_ON || !s) return;
    e = m7g_find(s->img);
    if (!e) return;
    vk_boot_logf("[m7g] id pipe=%llu t=%llus tick=%llu slot=%d texid=%d ext=%ux%u lay=%d "
                 "img=%#llx cl_slot=%d cl_key=%#llx cl_draw=#%llu cl_t=%llums cl_nv=%llu "
                 "now_key=%#llx same_slot=%d same_key=%d same_img=%d "
                 "draws=%llu verts=%llu lastdraw=#%llu last_t=%llums "
                 "clears=%llu lastclr=%.3f,%.3f,%.3f,%.3f@%llums restamp=%llu retire=%llu foreign=%llu "
                 "rb=%s mean=%llu/%llu/%llu colored=%llu.%02llu%% nz=%llu.%02llu%% rgba0=%u,%u,%u,%u",
                 call, el, tick, slot, s->tex_id, (unsigned)s->w, (unsigned)s->h,
                 (int)((s == g_rt_cur) ? g_h_layout : s->layout),
                 (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)s->img, e->claim_slot, (unsigned long long)e->key,
                 e->claim_draw, e->claim_t, e->claim_verts, (unsigned long long)s->key,
                 (slot == e->claim_slot), (s->key == e->key), (s->img == e->img),
                 e->writes, e->wverts, e->last_draw, e->last_t,
                 e->clears, e->last_clear_rgba[0], e->last_clear_rgba[1], e->last_clear_rgba[2],
                 e->last_clear_rgba[3], e->last_clear_t, e->restamps, e->retires, e->foreign,
                 ok ? "y" : "n",
                 ok && st->npx ? st->sr / st->npx : 0ull, ok && st->npx ? st->sg / st->npx : 0ull,
                 ok && st->npx ? st->sb / st->npx : 0ull,
