                 ok ? wp_pct2(st->colored, st->npx ? st->npx : 1ull) / 100ull : 0ull,
                 ok ? wp_pct2(st->colored, st->npx ? st->npx : 1ull) % 100ull : 0ull,
                 ok ? wp_pct2(st->nz, (st->npx ? st->npx : 1ull) * 4ull) / 100ull : 0ull,
                 ok ? wp_pct2(st->nz, (st->npx ? st->npx : 1ull) * 4ull) % 100ull : 0ull,
                 ok ? st->px0[0] : 0u, ok ? st->px0[1] : 0u, ok ? st->px0[2] : 0u, ok ? st->px0[3] : 0u);
}

/* ====== M7p：场景族专属 dump 的执行点（m7g_post_rb 的**前置**步骤，优先级高于菜单 claim 图）。
   m7p_scene_latch 锁存的目标图在这里读回 + 落 PNG（m7h 同源管线：c_img_rb 一次回读，
   统计行与 PNG 同一份像素）。名字额 M7P_MAX=4，与 m7g 的 8 个 claim 名额/m7h 的 6 张/图互不侵占。 */
static void m7p_scene_flush(void)
{
    int slot_now = -1, ok, host_fb = 0;
    VkImageLayout lay = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL;
    c_stat_t st;
    void *rgba = NULL;
    unsigned long long now, npx;
    char path[256];
    if (!M7P_ON || !g_m7p_req || !g_dev || !g_q || !g_h_cp) return;
    if (g_m7p_try_t && m7g_ms() - g_m7p_try_t < 1000ull) return;   /* 重试节流 1s（rt-flush submit ~100/s） */
    if (g_m7p_last_t && m7g_ms() - g_m7p_last_t < M7P_MIN_GAP_MS) return;   /* 落盘节流 */
    for (int si = 0; si < (int)(sizeof g_rt_tab / sizeof *g_rt_tab); si++) {
        if (g_rt_tab[si].img != g_m7p_img) continue;
        slot_now = si;   /* 布局口径与 m7g_post_rb 相同：当前目标用 g_h_layout，其余用槽记的 layout */
        lay = (&g_rt_tab[si] == g_rt_cur) ? g_h_layout : g_rt_tab[si].layout;
        break;
    }
    /* boot#1 教训：场景族 occ>=30 的目标是**宿主兜底图**（1280x720，不在 RT 表）——layout 记在
       g_host_layout（h_rt_switch :2732 的 else 分支），usage 含 TRANSFER_SRC，c_img_rb 可读。 */
    if (slot_now < 0 && g_host_img && g_m7p_img == g_host_img &&
        g_host_layout != VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED) {
        host_fb = 1; lay = g_host_layout;
    }
    if ((slot_now < 0 && !host_fb) || lay == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED) {
        /* 图不在任何 RT 槽（已销毁）或槽已 retire：这张读不了，释放锁存等下一个触发点。 */
        g_m7p_skip++; g_m7p_req = 0;
        vk_boot_logf("[m7p] scene skip t=%llums img=%#llx ext=%ux%u slot_now=%d lay=%d "
                     "skip=%llu done=%d/%d (锁存图不可读: 不在任何槽或 layout=UNDEFINED)",
                     m7g_ms(), (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_m7p_img, g_m7p_w, g_m7p_h,
                     slot_now, (int)lay, g_m7p_skip, g_m7p_done, M7P_MAX);
        return;
    }
    now = m7g_ms();
    g_m7p_try_t = now;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_vkq_lock);
    ok = c_img_rb(g_m7p_img, lay, g_m7p_w, g_m7p_h, 4, &st, &rgba);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_vkq_lock);
    if (!ok) {
        /* 读失败（含 fence 超时）：保持锁存下一 submit 重试；只记前 3 次防刷屏。 */
        g_m7p_rb_fail++;
        if (g_m7p_rb_fail <= 3)
            vk_boot_logf("[m7p] scene rb fail t=%llums img=%#llx slot=%d fail=%llu (保持锁存, 下个 submit 重试)",
                         now, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_m7p_img, slot_now, g_m7p_rb_fail);
        return;
    }
    npx = st.npx ? st.npx : 1ull;
    if (rgba && st.sr / npx >= 254ull && st.sg / npx >= 254ull && st.sb / npx >= 254ull) {
        /* boot#1 教训：occ=2 的图在回读时还是清屏白（场景那批 CB 还没 submit）——全白说明
           「内容还没画上」，不消费名额/锁存，1s 后重试；上限 M7P_WHITE_MAX 次后放弃本回合。 */
        free(rgba);
        g_m7p_white++; g_m7p_white_all++;
        if (g_m7p_white <= 3 || (g_m7p_white % 10) == 0)
            vk_boot_logf("[m7p] scene white t=%llums img=%#llx %s=%d ext=%ux%u occ=%llu white=%llu/%d "
                         "(全白: 内容未提交, 保持锁存重试)",
                         now, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_m7p_img,
                         host_fb ? "hostfb" : "slot", host_fb ? -2 : slot_now,
                         g_m7p_w, g_m7p_h, g_m7p_latch_occ, g_m7p_white, M7P_WHITE_MAX);
        if (g_m7p_white >= M7P_WHITE_MAX) {
            g_m7p_req = 0;
            vk_boot_logf("[m7p] scene white give-up t=%llums img=%#llx occ=%llu "
                         "white=%llu (本回合放弃, 等下一触发点重新锁存)",
                         now, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_m7p_img, g_m7p_latch_occ, g_m7p_white);
        }
        return;
    }
    g_m7p_req = 0;   /* 回读已消费这次锁存（PNG 写失败也不再重试同一张，避免死循环烧回读） */
    if (rgba) {
        const unsigned long long pnz = wp_pct2(st.nz, npx * 4ull);
        const unsigned long long pco = wp_pct2(st.colored, npx);
        unsigned long long bytes;
        if (host_fb)
            snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%sm7p_scene_hostfb_img%llx_t%llu.png",
                     m7h_dir(), (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_m7p_img, now);
        else
            snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%sm7p_scene_slot%d_img%llx_t%llu.png",
                     m7h_dir(), slot_now, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_m7p_img, now);
        bytes = m7h_write_png(path, g_m7p_w, g_m7p_h, (const unsigned char *)rgba);
        free(rgba);
        if (bytes) {
            g_m7p_done++; g_m7p_dumps++; g_m7p_last_t = now;
            vk_boot_logf("[m7p] scene dump t=%llums img=%#llx %s=%d latch_occ=%llu latch_draw=#%llu "
                         "up0=%d ext=%ux%u mean=%llu/%llu/%llu max=%llu/%llu/%llu colored=%llu.%02llu%% "
                         "nz=%llu.%02llu%% hb=[%llu.%02llu,%llu.%02llu,%llu.%02llu,%llu.%02llu,%llu.%02llu] "
                         "rgba0=%u,%u,%u,%u path=%s bytes=%llu (%d/%d)",
                         now, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_m7p_img,
                         host_fb ? "hostfb" : "slot", host_fb ? -2 : slot_now,
                         g_m7p_latch_occ, g_m7p_latch_n, g_m7p_latch_r0, g_m7p_w, g_m7p_h,
                         st.sr / npx, st.sg / npx, st.sb / npx, st.mxr, st.mxg, st.mxb,
                         pco / 100ull, pco % 100ull, pnz / 100ull, pnz % 100ull,
                         wp_pct2(st.hb[0], npx) / 100ull, wp_pct2(st.hb[0], npx) % 100ull,
                         wp_pct2(st.hb[1], npx) / 100ull, wp_pct2(st.hb[1], npx) % 100ull,
                         wp_pct2(st.hb[2], npx) / 100ull, wp_pct2(st.hb[2], npx) % 100ull,
                         wp_pct2(st.hb[3], npx) / 100ull, wp_pct2(st.hb[3], npx) % 100ull,
                         wp_pct2(st.hb[4], npx) / 100ull, wp_pct2(st.hb[4], npx) % 100ull,
                         st.px0[0], st.px0[1], st.px0[2], st.px0[3], path, bytes,
                         g_m7p_done, M7P_MAX);
        } else {
            g_m7p_rb_fail++;
            vk_boot_logf("[m7p] scene png fail t=%llums path=%s fail=%llu", now, path, g_m7p_rb_fail);
        }
    } else {
        g_m7p_rb_fail++;
        vk_boot_logf("[m7p] scene px fail t=%llums img=%#llx (回读成功但像素拷贝失败) fail=%llu",
                     now, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_m7p_img, g_m7p_rb_fail);
    }
}

/* ====== M7g P3（只读）: 「世界 pass 的 CB 刚 submit 完」立刻回读 claim 图 ======
   目的：把两种可能分开——(a) 这一笔根本没产生片元（提交后立刻读也是白/黑）(b) 产生了但之后被抹掉
   （提交后立刻读有内容，`[wp] rt` 看到的却是白/黑）。
   预算：每镜像 ≤ M7G_POST_RB_MAX 次、间隔 ≥4 s、且必须有新写入（e->writes 变了）才读。
   只在 nvn_vk_rt_flush 成功提交之后调用（同一队列，读命令排在绘制之后；带 fence 等）。 */
static void m7g_post_rb(void)
{
    m7g_img *e = NULL;
    VkImageLayout lay = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL;
    int slot_now = -1;
    c_stat_t st;
    unsigned long long now;
    int ok;
    if (!M7G_ON || !g_dev || !g_q || !g_h_cp) return;
    m7p_scene_flush();   /* M7p：场景族专属名额先行（优先级高于下面的菜单/加载 claim 图）。 */
    /* M7g fix：不再要求「本批的目标就是世界图」。两条路径都成立：
       ①本批目标 == 世界图 ⇒ 本批刚提交完（读的是提交后内容）；
       ②本批目标 != 世界图 ⇒ 世界那批在切目标时已经提交过（内容同样有效）。
       取「有新写入（writes 变了）」且未超预算/间隔的第一张；槽已 retire（无 layout）就跳过。 */
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < g_m7g_n; i++) {
        m7g_img *c = &g_m7g[i];
        if (!c->used) continue;
        /* M7j：上屏候选图延长回读额度（喂常驻快照刷新），其余图维持 6 次取证预算。 */
        if (c->post_rb >= ((M7H_PRES_ON && c->img == g_m7h_src_img) ? M7J_PRES_RB_MAX
                                                                    : M7G_POST_RB_MAX)) continue;
        if (c->writes == c->post_seen) continue;
        if (c->post_t && m7g_ms() - c->post_t < 4000ull) continue;
        slot_now = -1; lay = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL;
        /* 找这张图现在挂在哪个槽（可能已被 restamp 成别的 key，layout 仍记在槽上） */
        for (int si = 0; si < (int)(sizeof g_rt_tab / sizeof *g_rt_tab); si++) {
            if (g_rt_tab[si].img != c->img) continue;
            slot_now = si;
            if (&g_rt_tab[si] == g_rt_cur) lay = g_h_layout;
            else lay = g_rt_tab[si].layout;
            break;
        }
        if (slot_now < 0) continue;                       /* 图不在任何槽里：布局未知，不读 */
        if (lay == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED) continue;   /* 槽被 retire：内容作废，读也没意义 */
        e = c;
        break;
    }
    if (!e) return;
    now = m7g_ms();
    e->post_t = now; e->post_seen = e->writes; e->post_rb++;
    {
        /* M7h：只要本图还有落盘预算且过了间隔，就顺手要一份像素（同一次回读，保证 PNG 与统计行同源）。
           M7j：候选图 post_rb>6 后 PNG 预算已停，但常驻快照刷新仍需要像素 —— 候选图无条件要。 */
        int want_px = M7H_ON &&
                      ((e->post_rb <= M7H_MAX_PER_IMG &&
                        (!e->dump_t || m7g_ms() - e->dump_t >= 4000ull)) ||
                       (M7H_PRES_ON && e->img == g_m7h_src_img));
        void *rgba = NULL;
        pthread_mutex_lock(&g_vkq_lock);
        ok = c_img_rb(e->img, lay, e->w, e->h, 4, &st, want_px ? &rgba : NULL);
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_vkq_lock);
        if (rgba) {
            m7h_post_dump(e, slot_now, &st, (const unsigned char *)rgba);
            m7i_snap_upload(e, &st, rgba);   /* M7i P2：活内容那一瞬的像素 -> 常驻上屏图（一次性） */
            free(rgba);
        }
    }
    if (!ok) {
        vk_boot_logf("[m7g] post t=%llums img=%#llx rb=%llu/%d state=rb-fail (提交后回读失败)",
                     now, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)e->img, e->post_rb, M7G_POST_RB_MAX);
        return;
    }
    {
        const unsigned long long npx = st.npx ? st.npx : 1ull;
        const unsigned long long pco = wp_pct2(st.colored, npx);
        const unsigned long long pnz = wp_pct2(st.nz, npx * 4ull);
        vk_boot_logf("[m7g] post t=%llums img=%#llx cl_slot=%d cl_key=%#llx now_slot=%d now_key=%#llx "
                     "same_slot=%d same_key=%d rb=%llu/%d lay=%d flush_ok=%llu fail=%llu "
                     "draws=%llu lastdraw=#%llu clears=%llu mean=%llu/%llu/%llu max=%llu/%llu/%llu "
                     "colored=%llu.%02llu%% nz=%llu.%02llu%% hb=[%llu.%02llu,%llu.%02llu,%llu.%02llu] "
                     "rgba0=%u,%u,%u,%u cls=%s",
                     now, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)e->img, e->claim_slot,
                     (unsigned long long)e->key, slot_now, (unsigned long long)g_rt_tab[slot_now].key,
                     (slot_now == e->claim_slot), (g_rt_tab[slot_now].key == e->key),
                     e->post_rb, M7G_POST_RB_MAX, (int)lay,
                     g_h_rt_flush_ok, g_h_rt_flush_fail, e->writes, e->last_draw, e->clears,
                     st.sr / npx, st.sg / npx, st.sb / npx, st.mxr, st.mxg, st.mxb,
                     pco / 100ull, pco % 100ull, pnz / 100ull, pnz % 100ull,
                     wp_pct2(st.hb[0], npx) / 100ull, wp_pct2(st.hb[0], npx) % 100ull,
                     wp_pct2(st.hb[1], npx) / 100ull, wp_pct2(st.hb[1], npx) % 100ull,
                     wp_pct2(st.hb[2], npx) / 100ull, wp_pct2(st.hb[2], npx) % 100ull,
                     st.px0[0], st.px0[1], st.px0[2], st.px0[3], wp_cls(&st));
    }
}

static void wp_tick(unsigned long long call)
{
    const int ns = (int)(sizeof g_rt_tab / sizeof *g_rt_tab);
    const unsigned sw = h_rs_dim(1600u), sh = h_rs_dim(900u);
    unsigned long long el;
    if (g_wp_on < 0 && !wp_on()) return;
    if (g_wp_on <= 0) return;
    {
        const unsigned long long now = (unsigned long long)r_now_ms();
        /* M7g：世界 claim 那一刻强制跳过一次周期门（只多读一次，仍然是只读回读）。 */
        if (g_m7g_tick_force) g_m7g_tick_force = 0;
        else if (g_wp_last_ms && (now - g_wp_last_ms) < WP_PERIOD_MS) return;
        g_wp_last_ms = now;
    }
    g_wp_ticks++;
    el = (unsigned long long)((double)r_now_ms() / 1000.0);

    /* ---- (2) per-target delta. Counters only, costs no readback budget. ---- */
    {
        unsigned long long dv[H_RT_SLOTS], dd[H_RT_SLOTS];
        int ord[H_RT_SLOTS], no = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < ns; i++) {
            dv[i] = g_wp_verts[i]  - g_wp_pv[i];
            dd[i] = (unsigned long long)g_slot_dw_all[i] - g_wp_pd[i];
            g_wp_pv[i] = g_wp_verts[i];
            g_wp_pd[i] = (unsigned long long)g_slot_dw_all[i];
            if (dv[i] || dd[i]) ord[no++] = i;
        }
        for (int a = 0; a < no; a++)            /* selection sort, dv descending */
            for (int b = a + 1; b < no; b++)
                if (dv[ord[b]] > dv[ord[a]]) { const int t = ord[a]; ord[a] = ord[b]; ord[b] = t; }
        for (int a = 0; a < no && a < WP_MAX_SLOTS; a++) {
            const int i = ord[a];
            const h_rt_slot *s = &g_rt_tab[i];
            vk_boot_logf("[wp] tgt pipe=%llu t=%llus tick=%llu slot=%d texid=%d ext=%ux%u "
                         "draws_win=%llu verts_win=%llu verts_cum=%llu draws_cum=%llu%s%s%s",
                         call, el, g_wp_ticks, i, s->tex_id, (unsigned)s->w, (unsigned)s->h,
                         dd[i], dv[i], g_wp_verts[i], (unsigned long long)g_slot_dw_all[i],
                         (i == g_pa_cur_slot) ? " PICK" : "",
                         (s == g_rt_cur) ? " CUR" : "",
                         (i == g_world_slot) ? " WORLDPICK" : "");
        }
        if (!no)
            vk_boot_logf("[wp] tgt pipe=%llu t=%llus tick=%llu (no draw landed on any RT slot in window)",
                         call, el, g_wp_ticks);
        /* host fallback bucket: colour draws whose target was not an RT slot at all */
        {
            const unsigned long long hv = g_wp_verts_host - g_wp_pv_host;
            const unsigned long long hd = g_wp_draws_host - g_wp_pd_host;
            g_wp_pv_host = g_wp_verts_host; g_wp_pd_host = g_wp_draws_host;
            if (hv || hd)
                vk_boot_logf("[wp] tgt pipe=%llu t=%llus tick=%llu slot=-1 texid=-1 ext=host "
                             "draws_win=%llu verts_win=%llu verts_cum=%llu draws_cum=%llu HOSTFALLBACK",
                             call, el, g_wp_ticks, hd, hv, g_wp_verts_host, g_wp_draws_host);
        }
    }

    /* ---- (1) content: screen-sized RTs + present pick + current target ---- */
    {
        int ord[H_RT_SLOTS], no = 0, rb = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < ns; i++) {
            const h_rt_slot *s = &g_rt_tab[i];
            if (!s->key || !s->img) continue;
            if (!((unsigned)s->w == sw && (unsigned)s->h == sh)) continue;   /* screen-sized only */
            ord[no++] = i;
        }
        /* rank: M7g 世界 claim 槽优先（必须被读到），then present pick, then current target, then writers desc */
        for (int a = 0; a < no; a++)
            for (int b = a + 1; b < no; b++) {
                const int x = ord[a], y = ord[b];
                const unsigned wx = (m7g_is_claim_slot(x) ? 4u : 0u) +
                                    ((x == g_pa_cur_slot) ? 2u : 0u) + ((&g_rt_tab[x] == g_rt_cur) ? 1u : 0u);
                const unsigned wy = (m7g_is_claim_slot(y) ? 4u : 0u) +
                                    ((y == g_pa_cur_slot) ? 2u : 0u) + ((&g_rt_tab[y] == g_rt_cur) ? 1u : 0u);
                if (wy > wx || (wy == wx && g_slot_dw_all[y] > g_slot_dw_all[x])) { ord[a] = y; ord[b] = x; }
            }
        for (int a = 0; a < no && a < WP_MAX_SLOTS; a++) {
            const int i = ord[a];
            h_rt_slot *s = &g_rt_tab[i];
            const char *why = (i == g_pa_cur_slot) ? "present-pick"
                            : (s == g_rt_cur) ? "rt-cur"
                            : "rt-screen";
            c_stat_t st;
            int ok = 0;
            if (rb < WP_MAX_RB) {
                pthread_mutex_lock(&g_vkq_lock);
                ok = c_img_stats(s->img, p_slot_layout(s), (unsigned)s->w, (unsigned)s->h, 4, &st);
                pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_vkq_lock);
                rb++;
                if (!ok) g_wp_rb_err++;
            }
            if (!ok) {
                vk_boot_logf("[wp] rt pipe=%llu t=%llus tick=%llu slot=%d texid=%d ext=%ux%u lay=%d "
                             "writers_all=%u src=%s cls=n/a (no readback: budget %d/%d or failure, err=%llu)",
                             call, el, g_wp_ticks, i, s->tex_id, (unsigned)s->w, (unsigned)s->h,
                             (int)p_slot_layout(s), g_slot_dw_all[i], why, rb, WP_MAX_RB, g_wp_rb_err);
                m7g_id_log(call, el, g_wp_ticks, i, s, 0, &st);   /* M7g：身份对比照打，只是没内容 */
                continue;
            }
            const unsigned long long npx = st.npx ? st.npx : 1ull;
            const unsigned long long pnz = wp_pct2(st.nz, npx * 4ull);
            const unsigned long long pco = wp_pct2(st.colored, npx);
            const unsigned long long h0 = wp_pct2(st.hb[0], npx), h1 = wp_pct2(st.hb[1], npx);
            const unsigned long long h2 = wp_pct2(st.hb[2], npx), h3 = wp_pct2(st.hb[3], npx);
            const unsigned long long h4 = wp_pct2(st.hb[4], npx);
            vk_boot_logf("[wp] rt pipe=%llu t=%llus tick=%llu slot=%d texid=%d ext=%ux%u lay=%d "
                         "writers_all=%u mean=%llu/%llu/%llu max=%llu/%llu/%llu nz=%llu.%02llu%% "
                         "colored=%llu.%02llu%% hb=[%llu.%02llu,%llu.%02llu,%llu.%02llu,%llu.%02llu,%llu.%02llu] "
                         "rgba0=%u,%u,%u,%u cls=%s src=%s",
                         call, el, g_wp_ticks, i, s->tex_id, (unsigned)s->w, (unsigned)s->h,
                         (int)p_slot_layout(s), g_slot_dw_all[i],
                         st.sr / npx, st.sg / npx, st.sb / npx, st.mxr, st.mxg, st.mxb,
                         pnz / 100ull, pnz % 100ull, pco / 100ull, pco % 100ull,
                         h0 / 100ull, h0 % 100ull, h1 / 100ull, h1 % 100ull,
                         h2 / 100ull, h2 % 100ull, h3 / 100ull, h3 % 100ull,
                         h4 / 100ull, h4 % 100ull,
                         st.px0[0], st.px0[1], st.px0[2], st.px0[3], wp_cls(&st), why);
            m7g_id_log(call, el, g_wp_ticks, i, s, 1, &st);   /* M7g：draw 时刻身份 vs 回读时刻身份 */
        }
        vk_boot_logf("[wp] rt sum pipe=%llu t=%llus tick=%llu screen_slots=%d rb=%d/%d err=%llu "
                     "pick_slot=%d pick_texid=%d pick_mean=%llu pick_spread=%u worldpick_slot=%d "
                     "cur_slot=%d screen_ext=%ux%u ext_unknown=%llu small_rej=%llu "
                     "m7h_src=%d m7h_pres=%d m7h_dumps=%llu",
                     call, el, g_wp_ticks, no, rb, WP_MAX_RB, g_wp_rb_err,
                     g_pa_cur_slot, g_pa_pick_tex, g_pa_pick_mean, g_pa_pick_spread,
                     g_world_slot, g_rt_cur ? (int)(g_rt_cur - g_rt_tab) : -1, sw, sh,
                     g_h_rt_screen_scratch, g_world_small_rej,
                     m7h_pres_slot(), M7H_PRES_ON, g_m7h_dumps);
    }
}

/* 返 1 = 本帧屏幕内容归我们管（已上屏，或按降采样主动跳过——两种情况都不要再走纯色兜底）；
   0 = 本帧没接（后端没起/还没画过/无窗口/拷贝失败），调用方自行回落。 */
int nvn_vk_present_offscreen(void)
{
    static pthread_mutex_t lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
    /* M4x P1：候选只在「本帧最后一笔颜色 draw」到「本次 present」之间有效，取走即清，
       下一帧重新记账（present 每帧调一次，降采样帧也会走到这里清空）。 */
    h_rt_slot *cand = g_p_cand_slot;
    VkImage cand_img = g_p_cand_img;
    uint32_t cand_w = g_p_cand_w, cand_h = g_p_cand_h;
    g_p_cand_slot = NULL; g_p_cand_img = VK_NULL_HANDLE; g_p_cand_w = g_p_cand_h = 0;
    if (!g_on || !g_dev || !g_q || !g_h_img || (g_d_draws + g_r_draws) == 0 || !g_win) return 0;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
    unsigned long long call = ++g_p_calls;
    m40c_poll();   /* M40C：present 侧重读 smo_m40c；值变化 ⇒ 作废管线表（详见 m40c_poll 定义） */
    unsigned every = present_every();
    /* M4ag P1 台账：每 300 次 present 一行（含降采样帧，反映「上一张真拷源」与 miss 累计）。
       texmiss 的口径 = 游戏指定了纹理但我们映射不到可用 RT 槽 ⇒ 回落旧链的次数。 */
    if ((call % 300) == 0)
        vk_boot_logf("[p] present ledger call=%llu src=%s slot=%d ext=%ux%u texmiss=%llu src_tex=%llu "
                     "ovr=%llu ovr_req=%d nolay=%llu texnull=%llu gpres=%llu gpres_miss=%llu ok=%llu skip=%llu",
                     call, g_p_last_src, g_p_last_slot, g_p_last_w, g_p_last_h,
                     g_p_tex_miss, g_p_src_tex, g_p_src_ovr, p_slot_override(), g_p_tex_nolay,
                     g_p_tex_null, g_p_src_gpres, g_p_gpres_miss, g_p_ok, g_p_skip);
    /* M4bv P2：游戏最近把哪些身份当 RT 绑过（直方图）+ 「present 那张」被绑过几次。
       这是回答「present 引用的对象为什么一直是空的」的唯一直接证据：若这里的键全都不是
       g_win_key 里那三张，说明游戏整帧都在离屏 RT 上画、从没往要上屏的那张写过。 */
    if ((call % 300) == 0 && g_bindk_rr) {
        char bb[400]; int o = 0;
        o = snprintf(bb, sizeof bb, "[o] bindk call=%llu winbind=%llu wkey=%#llx/%#llx/%#llx/%#llx |",
                     call, g_winbind_n, g_win_key[0], g_win_key[1], g_win_key[2], g_win_key[3]);
        for (int i = 0; i < BINDK_N && o < (int)sizeof bb - 48; i++)
            if (g_bindk[i]) o += snprintf(bb + o, sizeof bb - (size_t)o, " %#llx=%llu%s",
                                          g_bindk[i], g_bindk_cnt[i], p_win_key_hit(g_bindk[i]) ? "(WIN)" : "");
        vk_boot_logf("%s", bb);
    }
    if (call > 3 && every > 1 && (call % every)) {   /* 降采样：不换屏，但本帧仍归我们管 */
        g_p_skip++; g_p_skip_ds++;
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
        return 1;
    }
    /* M4x P1：上屏源选择。
       优先级：①「最近被判为有内容（非均匀）」的 RT → ②「本帧最后一笔颜色 draw」的图 → ③当前目标。
       为什么不是直接拷 g_h_img：boot#1 实证 present 时刻的当前目标是一张全黑 1600x900 RT
       （[p] sig nz=0.00%），而那帧的画面在另一张 1600x900 上（[rt] mean=140/36/143/27）。
       每个候选都校验「槽 img/w/h 未变 + 布局在 CAO/SRO + 尺寸 ≥1280×720」，不满足就降级。 */
    VkImage simg = g_h_img;
    uint32_t sw = g_rt_w, sh = g_rt_h;
    VkImageLayout slay = g_h_layout;
    const char *srcname = g_rt_cur ? "cur" : "host";
    int snap_used = 0;   /* M4al P2：本帧最终源是不是快照（台账/配对用） */
    /* M4ag P1：源选择顺序改为「游戏指定 > 旧链」。旧链（快照/内容/最后 draw/当前目标）一行不改，
       只在拿不到映射时接管。 */
    int src_locked = 0;
    int pslot_i = -1;
    h_rt_slot *pslot = NULL;
    /* M4bi P1：`ovr_lock` = 「诊断开关点名了某个槽且该槽可用」⇒ 它压过一切选源判据（ours/worldRT/snap）。
       M4al 的原意是「游戏指定 > 旧链」，但 M4bc/M4bh 往链首插了 ours/worldRT/snap 三条且**不查
       src_locked**，于是写 `smo_present_slot=3` 也只改 pslot、simg 随后被 ours 覆盖 ⇒ 开关形同虚设。
       这一处只加锁，不改任何一条判据本身。 */
    int ovr_lock = 0;
    const int ovr = p_slot_override();
    if (ovr >= 0) {
        int nsl = (int)(sizeof g_rt_tab / sizeof *g_rt_tab);
        if (ovr < nsl && p_src_copyable(&g_rt_tab[ovr])) {
            pslot_i = ovr; pslot = &g_rt_tab[ovr]; g_p_src_ovr++; ovr_lock = 1;
        }
        else {
            g_p_tex_nolay++;
            if (g_p_tex_nolay <= 6 || (g_p_tex_nolay % 500) == 0)
                vk_boot_logf("[p] present ovr slot=%d unusable (img=%d ext=%ux%u lay=%d) -> old chain",
                             ovr, (ovr < nsl && g_rt_tab[ovr].img) ? 1 : 0,
                             ovr < nsl ? (unsigned)g_rt_tab[ovr].w : 0u, ovr < nsl ? (unsigned)g_rt_tab[ovr].h : 0u,
                             ovr < nsl ? (int)g_rt_tab[ovr].layout : -1);
        }
    } else if (!g_p_tex_key) {
        g_p_tex_null++;   /* 游戏侧解析失败（key=0）：不是「映射不到槽」，单列一个口径 */
    } else {
        pslot_i = p_slot_by_key(g_p_tex_key, &pslot);
        if (pslot_i >= 0 && p_src_copyable(pslot)) {
            g_p_src_tex++;
            if (g_p_src_tex <= 4)
                vk_boot_logf("[p] present src=tex slot=%d key=%#llx id=%d ext=%ux%u idx=%d",
                             pslot_i, g_p_tex_key, g_p_tex_id, (unsigned)pslot->w, (unsigned)pslot->h, g_p_tex_idx);
        } else {
            g_p_tex_miss++;
            if (g_p_tex_miss <= 6 || (g_p_tex_miss % 300) == 0)
                vk_boot_logf("[p] present texmiss key=%#llx id=%d ext=%ux%u slot=%d lay=%d (无可用 RT 槽) -> 旧链",
                             g_p_tex_key, g_p_tex_id, g_p_tex_w, g_p_tex_h, pslot_i,
                             pslot_i >= 0 ? (int)pslot->layout : -1);
            pslot = NULL; pslot_i = -1;
        }
    }
    if (pslot) {
        simg = pslot->img; sw = pslot->w; sh = pslot->h; slay = p_slot_layout(pslot);
        srcname = ovr >= 0 ? "ovr" : "tex";
        src_locked = 1;
        g_p_last_src = srcname; g_p_last_slot = pslot_i; g_p_last_w = sw; g_p_last_h = sh;
    }
#define P_SRC_OK(S, SI, SW, SH) \
    ((S) && (S)->img == (SI) && (S)->w == (SW) && (S)->h == (SH) && (SW) >= h_rs_dim(H_OFF_W) && (SH) >= h_rs_dim(H_OFF_H) && \
     ((S) == g_rt_cur || (S)->layout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL || \
      (S)->layout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL))
    /* M4al P2：**快照优先**（派活单口径：快照 > 游戏指定纹理 > 内容判据 > 当前目标）。
       门控换成 g_snap_ready（不再用 g_snap_layout 记账，见 5788 注释）。
       开关 `smo_snap_present`：缺省文件由应用种成 -1（p_file_seed），语义「非 0 = 开」，推 0 即退回旧链。 */
    if (g_p_snapchk < 2 && g_snap_img) {
        g_p_snapchk++;
        vk_boot_logf("[p] snapchk #%u call=%llu img=%#llx lay=%d ready=%d n=%llu fail=%llu pslot=%d "
                     "(旧判据 lay==6 -> %s)",
                     g_p_snapchk, call, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_snap_img, (int)g_snap_layout,
                     g_snap_ready, g_snap_n, g_snap_fail, pslot_i,
                     (g_snap_layout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL) ? "true" : "FALSE");
    }
    /* M4bv P1（2026-11-04 新路线）：**游戏自己 present 的那张纹理**当唯一真源，压过一切旁路
       （ours/world-snap/snap/worldRT/content）。理由：前 6 轮「扫描所有 1600×900 RT → 按内容签名挑一张」
       结构性不稳（身份一次性、同分替换、t≈66 s 源内容消失）；而游戏每帧都会 present 一张它认定的最终
       画面，这张的身份由 gfx_bridge 的 nvnQueuePresentTexture 给出（不用槽号、不用 img 指针）。
       这里只做两件事：按身份找 RT 槽（pslot 已在上面的分支链前置算好）→ 命中就**当场**（同一 present 内
       vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer）回读上屏。拿不到（没给身份 / 我们没有这个槽 / 槽不可拷）⇒ 记 miss
       并整条回落旧链（不硬指、不猜）。 */
    const int gpres_on = p_gpres();
    /* ===== M4cb P1 (this round's only behaviour change): present source = tex_id==282 RT =====
       Why: the game's own final composite quad (vs=46342a76690ceba3 / fs=b9f0ca8022fbf9c2,
       cnt=6 verts=4) lands 100% of its 11144 draws in texid=282 ext=1600x900, and after M4ca
       fixed the FS interpolation input that RT holds the real title screen ([ca] rt282 #2:
       mean=74/1/1 colored=66.6%, human eye = SMO logo + red radial background). Present still
       read src=gpres (window texture, gsig mean=15/0/0) so the screen never showed it.
       How: pick the slot by identity (tex_id + ext) after the frame's submit is done, and use the
       slot's own img/w/h/layout -- exactly the same read the [g] rt table / [ca] rt282 probes do,
       so the existing barrier + CopyImageToBuffer path needs no change.
       Gates: the three upload gates (identity / black>40% / coverage) live in p3_grab_game_rt(),
       which feeds the `ours` bypass; this branch reads the RT slot directly and does not go through
       them. 282 is black-backgrounded by design, so the mid-frame (black) gate is explicitly
       exempted here and the exemption is logged as gate=exempt-black together with the measured
       black/colored/mean, so it can be checked instead of trusted.
       Fallback: no usable slot this frame => g_p_rt282_miss++ and the previous chain runs untouched. */
    int rt282_i = p_find_rt282();
    if (!ovr_lock && rt282_i < 0) g_p_rt282_miss++;
    /* ===== M5t P1: source = measured auto pick with hysteresis (282 is just a candidate) =====
       Runs before every other branch; when it returns a slot, the 282 branch and the rest of the
       old chain keep their code and their conditions untouched -- they simply do not bind
       (`pa_i < 0`). When it returns -1 (no eligible candidate ever, or the kept source died)
       the old chain runs exactly as in M5s. */
    const int pa_i = (!ovr_lock && p_auto_on()) ? p_auto_select(call) : -1;
    /* M7a P1: read-only probe. Runs after the pick decision and before every branch, so it cannot
       change which branch binds (it only logs and does its own readbacks). No-op unless
       smo_world_probe is on; self-throttled to one tick per WP_PERIOD_MS. */
    wp_tick(call);
    if (!ovr_lock && gpres_on && !pslot && rt282_i < 0 && pa_i < 0) {
        g_p_gpres_miss++;
        if (g_p_gpres_miss <= 4 || (g_p_gpres_miss % 300) == 0)
            vk_boot_logf("[o] gpres call=%llu intercept_ok=0 key=%#llx texid=%d ext=%ux%u idx=%d why=%s "
                         "hit=%llu miss=%llu -> 旧链",
                         call, g_p_tex_key, g_p_tex_id, g_p_tex_w, g_p_tex_h, g_p_tex_idx,
                         !g_p_tex_key ? "no-identity(游戏侧解析失败)" : "no-rt-slot(我们没这个槽/不可拷)",
                         g_p_src_gpres, g_p_gpres_miss);
    }
    if (!ovr_lock && pa_i >= 0) {
        h_rt_slot *pas = &g_rt_tab[pa_i];
        simg = pas->img; sw = pas->w; sh = pas->h; slay = p_slot_layout(pas);
        srcname = "auto"; src_locked = 1; g_p_src_auto++;
    }
    else if (!ovr_lock && M7H_PRES_ON && m7h_pres_slot() >= 0) {
        /* ===== M7h B（派活单 §3B，仅 PNG 人眼确认有内容后才把 M7H_PRES_ON 改 1）=====
           上屏源 = m7g/m7h 的 post_rb 证明"刚被世界 pass 写过"的那张图，按 **img 句柄**在 RT 表里
           找槽（M7g 已证槽号/key 都不是稳定身份）。判据复用 P_SRC_OK（尺寸 >= 光栅下限、
           layout 在 COLOR_ATTACHMENT/SHADER_READ_ONLY 或 == g_rt_cur），拷贝/回读链路与世界分支
           （M4bh worldRT）完全同一条。候选没设/图已不在表里 => 整条回落旧链（miss 计数）。 */
        int mi = m7h_pres_slot();
        h_rt_slot *ms = &g_rt_tab[mi];
        if (g_m7h_snap_ready && g_m7h_snap_img) {
            /* M7i P2：活图在 present 时刻已被清（boot#1 实证：post_rb rb=1 有角色、rb=2..6 全黑、
               [p] sig src=m7h-world mean=0/0/0），改送 post_rb 活内容那一刻上传的常驻快照
               （TRANSFER_SRC、只被我们写、无人清它）。 */
            simg = g_m7h_snap_img; sw = g_m7h_snap_w; sh = g_m7h_snap_h;
            slay = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL;
        } else {
            simg = ms->img; sw = ms->w; sh = ms->h;
            slay = (ms == g_rt_cur) ? g_h_layout : p_slot_layout(ms);
        }
        srcname = "m7h-world"; src_locked = 1; g_m7h_pres_hits++;
        if (g_m7h_pres_hits <= 3 || (g_m7h_pres_hits % 300) == 0)
            vk_boot_logf("[o] present call=%llu src=m7h-world slot=%d img=%#llx key=%#llx ext=%ux%u "
                         "lay=%d (M7h B: post_rb 证明刚被世界 pass 写过的图, 按句柄选中) hits=%llu snap=%d",
                         call, mi, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)simg, g_m7h_src_key,
                         (unsigned)sw, (unsigned)sh, (int)slay, g_m7h_pres_hits, g_m7h_snap_ready);
    }
    else if (!ovr_lock && M7H_PRES_ON && g_m7h_src_img) {
        g_m7h_pres_miss++;   /* 候选已设但句柄不在表里（retire/回收）：只计数，回落旧链 */
    }
    else if (!ovr_lock && rt282_i >= 0) {
        h_rt_slot *s282 = &g_rt_tab[rt282_i];
        simg = s282->img; sw = s282->w; sh = s282->h; slay = p_slot_layout(s282);
        srcname = "rt282"; src_locked = 1; g_p_src_rt282++;
        /* Content probe for evidence only (rate limited: first pick + every ~10 s).
           It does not take part in source selection -- 282 is exempted, see comment above. */
        struct timespec r2ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &r2ts);
        unsigned long long r2now = (unsigned long long)r2ts.tv_sec * 1000000ull +
                                   (unsigned long long)r2ts.tv_nsec / 1000ull;
        int r2stat = (g_p_rt282_stat < 2 || !g_p_rt282_stat_us || r2now - g_p_rt282_stat_us > 10000000ull);
        if (g_p_src_rt282 <= 6 || (g_p_src_rt282 % 300) == 0 || r2stat) {
            unsigned wr = 0, wra = 0;
            if (rt282_i < (int)(sizeof g_slot_dw_all / sizeof *g_slot_dw_all)) {
                wr = g_slot_dw[rt282_i]; wra = g_slot_dw_all[rt282_i];
            }
            if (r2stat) {
                c_stat_t s2;
                g_p_rt282_stat_us = r2now;
                if (s282->w && s282->h && c_img_stats(s282->img, slay, s282->w, s282->h, 4, &s2)) {
                    g_p_rt282_stat++;
                    vk_boot_logf("[w] present tex282 picks=%llu (src=rt282) call=%llu slot=%d key=%#llx "
                                 "texid=282 ext=%ux%u lay=%d writers=%u writers_all=%u "
                                 "black=%.1f%% colored=%.1f%% mean=%llu/%llu/%llu max=%llu/%llu/%llu "
                                 "nz=%.1f%% gate=exempt-black miss=%llu",
                                 g_p_src_rt282, call, rt282_i, (unsigned long long)s282->key,
                                 (unsigned)s282->w, (unsigned)s282->h, (int)slay, wr, wra,
                                 100.0 * (double)s2.black / (double)(s2.npx ? s2.npx : 1),
                                 100.0 * (double)s2.colored / (double)(s2.npx ? s2.npx : 1),
                                 s2.sr / (s2.npx ? s2.npx : 1), s2.sg / (s2.npx ? s2.npx : 1),
                                 s2.sb / (s2.npx ? s2.npx : 1), s2.mxr, s2.mxg, s2.mxb,
                                 100.0 * (double)s2.nz / (double)(s2.npx ? s2.npx * 4 : 1),
                                 g_p_rt282_miss);
                }
            }
            if (g_p_src_rt282 <= 6 || (g_p_src_rt282 % 300) == 0)
                vk_boot_logf("[w] present tex282 picks=%llu (src=rt282) call=%llu slot=%d key=%#llx "
                             "texid=282 ext=%ux%u lay=%d writers=%u writers_all=%u "
                             "gate=exempt-black miss=%llu",
                             g_p_src_rt282, call, rt282_i, (unsigned long long)s282->key,
                             (unsigned)s282->w, (unsigned)s282->h, (int)slay, wr, wra,
                             g_p_rt282_miss);
        }
    }
    else if (!ovr_lock && gpres_on && pslot) {
        simg = pslot->img; sw = pslot->w; sh = pslot->h; slay = p_slot_layout(pslot);
        srcname = "gpres"; src_locked = 1; g_p_src_gpres++;
        if (g_p_src_gpres <= 6 || (g_p_src_gpres % 200) == 0) {
            int sib = -1; unsigned sw_ = 0;
            const unsigned w_ = p_slot_lw(pslot, &sib, &sw_);
            /* M4by P1：这张源 RT 的写入者计数（派活单判据①）。writers = 本 submit，writers_all = 整 boot 累计。 */
            unsigned wr = 0, wra = 0;
            if (pslot_i >= 0 && pslot_i < (int)(sizeof g_slot_dw_all / sizeof *g_slot_dw_all)) {
                wr = g_slot_dw[pslot_i]; wra = g_slot_dw_all[pslot_i];
            }
            vk_boot_logf("[o] gpres call=%llu intercept_ok=1 key=%#llx texid=%d idx=%d ext=%ux%u slot=%d lay=%d "
                         "img=%#llx w=%u sib=%d/%u hit=%llu miss=%llu writers=%u writers_all=%u "
                         "(源=游戏 present 引用的那张，present 时刻当场回读)",
                         call, g_p_tex_key, g_p_tex_id, g_p_tex_idx, (unsigned)sw, (unsigned)sh, pslot_i,
                         (int)slay, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)simg, w_, sib, sw_,
                         g_p_src_gpres, g_p_gpres_miss, wr, wra);
        }
    } else if (!ovr_lock && g_our_ok && p_our_present()) {
        /* M4bc P3：**我们自己的渲染结果优先**（来源图恒在 TRANSFER_SRC，只被我们写）。
           放在 snap 之前 —— snap 里是游戏环境快照（mean=132/72/172），那才是「屏幕不反映我们渲染」的根因。 */
        simg = g_our_img; sw = g_our_w; sh = g_our_h;
        slay = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL;
        /* M4bp P1：kind=2 ⇒ 这张 `ours` 装的是**世界 RT 的快照**（旁路），源名打 world-snap。 */
        srcname = (g_our_kind == 2) ? "world-snap" : "ours";
        src_locked = 1;
        g_p_src_ours++;
        if (g_our_kind == 2) {
            g_p_src_wsnap++;
            if (g_p_src_wsnap <= 3 || (g_p_src_wsnap % 300) == 0)
                vk_boot_logf("[w] present call=%llu src=world-snap img=%#llx %ux%u picks=%llu "
                             "(旁路：后处理层未参与)",
                             call, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_our_img, g_our_w, g_our_h, g_w_picks);
        }
        /* M4bf P1：屏幕上这张到底装的是什么（gameRT = 游戏本帧颜色 RT；debugRT = 旧单笔二分图）。 */
        if (g_our_kind != 2 && (g_p_src_ours <= 2 || (g_p_src_ours % 300) == 0))
            vk_boot_logf("[o] present call=%llu src=ours kind=%s img=%#llx %ux%u (grab=%llu fail=%llu)",
                         call, g_our_kind ? "gameRT" : "debugRT",
                         (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_our_img, g_our_w, g_our_h,
                         g_o_grab_n, g_o_grab_fail);
    } else if (!ovr_lock && g_snap_ready && p_snap_present()) {
        /* M4bj P2【修 2/2】：快照**提到 worldRT 之前**。
           为什么换位：boot#1 实测 present 链先用 `worldRT`（c_rt_table_dump 按 writers/colored 选），
           而它选中的那张在 present 时刻已经是纯黑（`[p] sig #1560..#1800 src=worldRT mean=0/0/0 spread=0`），
           真正有画面的那张只活在帧内 —— 这正是快照存在的理由（M4y P1b）。M4bh 当年把 worldRT 排在
           snap 之前，是为了绕开「snap 里是洋红/渐变」；洋红现在由修 1/2 挡在快照之外了，所以换回来。
           同时 `smo_snap_present=0` 仍可一键退回旧顺序（保留 A/B 能力）。 */
        simg = g_snap_img; sw = R_SNAP_W; sh = R_SNAP_H;
        slay = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL; srcname = "snap";
        snap_used = 1; src_locked = 1;
        g_p_src_snap++;
        if (g_p_src_snap <= 3 || (g_p_src_snap % 300) == 0)
            vk_boot_logf("[o] present call=%llu src=snap img=%#llx snaps=%llu dark=%u gain=%d",
                         call, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_snap_img, g_snap_n, g_m4bi_dark_n, p_present_gain());
    } else if (!ovr_lock && g_world_slot >= 0 &&
               P_SRC_OK(&g_rt_tab[g_world_slot], g_world_img, g_world_w, g_world_h)) {
        /* M4bh P2：**按全 RT 表的实测判据切源** ——
           本帧 writers 最多且整幅 colored>5% 的那张 RT 就是世界/角色所在，直接送它上屏。
           `g_world_*` 只在 c_rt_table_dump() 真正测到时置位；没测到 ⇒ 这条永不成立 ⇒ 旧行为不变。
           M4bj P2 起排在 snap 之后（见上一条）。 */
        h_rt_slot *ws = &g_rt_tab[g_world_slot];
        simg = ws->img; sw = ws->w; sh = ws->h;
        slay = (ws == g_rt_cur) ? g_h_layout : p_slot_layout(ws);
        srcname = "worldRT"; src_locked = 1; g_p_src_world++;
        if (g_p_src_world <= 3 || (g_p_src_world % 300) == 0)
            vk_boot_logf("[o] present call=%llu src=worldRT slot=%d key=%#llx texid=%d ext=%ux%u "
                         "writers=%u colored=%.1f%% lay=%d",
                         call, g_world_slot, g_world_key, ws->tex_id, (unsigned)ws->w, (unsigned)ws->h,
                         g_world_writers, (double)g_world_colored_pm / 10.0, (int)slay);
    } else if (ovr_lock && g_snap_ready) {
        /* M4bi P2（本轮唯一的行为修）：硬指定槽的内容**只在帧内活着** —— boot#1 实测 present 时刻它
           恒为清屏底（39/39 次 `[p] sig src=ovr spread=0`，早段全黑、后段全白）。
           而帧内那张世界图是暗的（mean=11/1/1、max=255/35/40）且被旧判据当噪声丢掉。
           这里改送「帧内那一刻拷下的快照图」：快照由 r_sig_dark_content 放宽后开始收，
           只在 1600×900、内容真的变化时拷（≤ R_SNAP_MAX 次），present 直接拷它。
           屏幕亮度由 `smo_present_gain` 控制（合成曝光，只改上屏像素）。 */
        simg = g_snap_img; sw = R_SNAP_W; sh = R_SNAP_H;
        slay = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL; srcname = "ovr-snap";
        snap_used = 1; src_locked = 1; g_p_src_snap++;
        if (g_p_src_snap <= 3 || (g_p_src_snap % 300) == 0)
            vk_boot_logf("[o] present call=%llu src=ovr-snap slot=%d snaps=%llu dark=%u gain=%d",
                         call, ovr, g_snap_n, g_m4bi_dark_n, p_present_gain());
    } else if (pslot) {
        simg = pslot->img; sw = pslot->w; sh = pslot->h; slay = p_slot_layout(pslot);
        srcname = ovr >= 0 ? "ovr" : "tex";
    } else if (P_SRC_OK(g_p_content_slot, g_p_content_img, g_p_content_w, g_p_content_h)) {
        simg = g_p_content_img; sw = g_p_content_w; sh = g_p_content_h;
        slay = (g_p_content_slot == g_rt_cur) ? g_h_layout : g_p_content_slot->layout;
        srcname = "content"; g_p_src_content++;
    } else if (P_SRC_OK(cand, cand_img, cand_w, cand_h)) {
        if (cand == g_rt_cur) { slay = g_h_layout; g_p_src_cur++; }   /* 与当前目标同一张 */
        else { simg = cand_img; sw = cand_w; sh = cand_h; slay = cand->layout; srcname = "lastdraw"; g_p_src_hit++; }
    } else if (cand) g_p_src_fallback++;
#undef P_SRC_OK
    /* ===== M39A（2026-11-09）：720x405 场景 RT 直送（**缺省开**；`smo_m39a_off=1` 退回老链）=====
       位置：所有选源分支之后 ⇒ 无论 selector 选了谁（m7h-world/ours/snap/worldRT/gpres/tex），
       默认都用「本帧写得最多的 720x405 槽」顶替。逃生阀关态整块不执行（老行为逐字不变）。
       选中槽若在上屏时刻读回是常量白 ⇒ 本帧恢复原选源（白帧保护）。 */
    int m39a_sel = -1;
    const char *m39a_osrc = srcname; const unsigned m39a_osw = sw, m39a_osh = sh;
    if (m39a_off()) {
        /* M39C 诊断：开关显式 1（关）时也留一行，否则关态和"没命中"在日志里无法区分。 */
        m39a_gate(call, 0, 0, -1, m39a_osrc, m39a_osw, m39a_osh, "off");
    } else {
        static int cached_slot = -2; static unsigned long long last_scan;
        static unsigned c72 = 0, ctot = 0;
        if (cached_slot == -2 || g_p_calls - last_scan >= 64) {
            cached_slot = m39a_pick(NULL, NULL, &c72, &ctot, m39a_osw, m39a_osh);
            last_scan = g_p_calls;
        }
        const int fs = cached_slot;
        const int nslm = (int)(sizeof g_rt_tab / sizeof *g_rt_tab);
        const char *why = ctot ? "dim_mismatch" : "no_cand";
        if (fs >= 0 && fs < nslm) {
            h_rt_slot *fh = &g_rt_tab[fs];
            if (!fh->img) {
                why = "no_img";
            } else {
                const VkImageLayout flay = p_slot_layout(fh);
                r_sig_t sg; memset(&sg, 0, sizeof sg);
                const int sok = r_tex_signature(fh->img, flay, fh->w, fh->h, 4, &sg);
                const unsigned long long np = (sok && sg.npx) ? sg.npx : 1ull;
                /* M39D（2026-11-09）：常量色保护（含黑/纯色，不只纯白）。present 时刻活 RT 常已被 guest
                   清成常量色，此时直送只会把 m7h-world 的 mean=105/nz=43.5% 换成黑帧 ⇒ 本帧回退原选源。 */
                const unsigned mr = (unsigned)(sg.sum[0] / np);
                const unsigned mg = (unsigned)(sg.sum[1] / np);
                const unsigned mb = (unsigned)(sg.sum[2] / np);
                const unsigned long long nzp = (sg.nz * 1000ull) / np;
                /* M39E：nt>1 但整体近黑同样回退（否则"纯黑"被换成"非均匀近黑"，字节变好、画面没变好）。 */
                const int luma = (int)((mr * 299u + mg * 587u + mb * 114u) / 1000u);
                const int flat = sok && sg.nt <= 1;
                /* M39F（2026-11-09）：M39E 实测 nz 双峰 0%/31%（102/80），31% 那档 mean=2/nt=8 是**真实暗场景**
                   （黑底白角色）；旧判据 luma<12 会误伤它。改为只挡"几乎没有非零像素"的死帧。 */
                const int dark = (nzp < 100ull);
                const int uniform = flat || dark;
                if (m39e_pair_on() && g_m39e_lines < 200 && g_m39e_sub_slot == fs && sok) {
                    const unsigned pres_mean = (unsigned)((sg.sum[0] + sg.sum[1] + sg.sum[2]) / (3ull * np));
                    g_m39e_lines++;
                    vk_boot_logf("[m39e] pres slot=%d id=%d nz=%llu%% nt=%d luma=%d mean=%u "
                                 "sub_nz=%llu%% sub_nt=%d sub_mean=%lu dcall=%llu",
                                 fs, (int)fh->tex_id, nzp, sg.nt, luma, pres_mean,
                                 g_m39e_sub_nz, g_m39e_sub_nt, (unsigned long)g_m39e_sub_mean,
                                 (g_p_calls > g_m39e_sub_call) ? (g_p_calls - g_m39e_sub_call) : 0ull);
                }
                if (uniform) {
                    /* 常量色保护：不覆盖 simg/sw/sh/slay/srcname ⇒ 本帧就是原选源（缺省 m7h-world）。 */
                    why = flat ? "uniform" : "dark";
                    if (g_m39a_dbg != -2) {
                        g_m39a_dbg = -2;
                        vk_boot_logf("[m39e] fallback why=%s tt=%02x%02x%02x nt=%d nz=%llu.%llu%% luma=%d "
                                     "slot=%d id=%d ext=%ux%u dw_frm=%u call=%llu (本帧回退原选源 src=%s %ux%u)",
                                     flat ? "uniform" : "dark", mr, mg, mb, sg.nt, nzp / 10ull, nzp % 10ull, luma,
                                     fs, fh->tex_id, (unsigned)fh->w, (unsigned)fh->h, g_slot_dw[fs],
                                     call, m39a_osrc, m39a_osw, m39a_osh);
                    }
                } else {
                    why = "hit";
                    m39a_sel = fs;
                    if (g_m39a_dbg != fs) {
                        g_m39a_dbg = fs;
                        vk_boot_logf("[m39a] present direct slot=%d id=%d ext=%ux%u dw_frm=%u why=auto "
                                     "(was src=%s %ux%u) call=%llu (缩放由 win_fill 最近邻 fit 完成)",
                                     fs, fh->tex_id, (unsigned)fh->w, (unsigned)fh->h, g_slot_dw[fs],
                                     m39a_osrc, m39a_osw, m39a_osh, call);
                    }
                    simg = fh->img; sw = fh->w; sh = fh->h; slay = flay;
                    srcname = "m39a"; snap_used = 0; src_locked = 1;
                }
            }
        }
        m39a_gate(call, ctot, c72, fs, m39a_osrc, m39a_osw, m39a_osh, why);
    }
    /* ===== M38H（2026-11-09）：强制 present 指定槽（`smo_m38h_present`，缺省 -1 = 关）=====
       位置：**所有选源分支都走完之后**、台账与拷贝之前 ⇒ 不论 selector 选了谁（tex/ours/snap/
       worldRT/gpres/282），都被这一槽顶替。只替换「选中的源」，不改 selector 语义、不动深度、
       不动纹理身份。关态（-1）整块不执行 ⇒ 与旧行为逐字相同。
       缩放不在这里做：源按原尺寸拷进 staging，win_fill.c 的最近邻等比 fit 铺到呈现面
       （720x405 → 800x450 时 dw=800 / dh=450，正好铺满）。 */
    int m38h_sel = -1;
    {   const int fs = m38h_slot();
        const int nslh = (int)(sizeof g_rt_tab / sizeof *g_rt_tab);
        if (fs >= 0 && fs < nslh) {
            h_rt_slot *fh = &g_rt_tab[fs];
            if (fh->img && fh->w && fh->h) {
                m38h_sel = fs;
                if (g_m38h_logged != fs) {
                    g_m38h_logged = fs;
                    vk_boot_logf("[m38h] present forced slot=%d id=%d ext=%ux%u (was src=%s %ux%u) call=%llu "
                                 "(缩放由 win_fill 最近邻 fit 完成)",
                                 fs, fh->tex_id, (unsigned)fh->w, (unsigned)fh->h,
                                 srcname, sw, sh, call);
                }
                simg = fh->img; sw = fh->w; sh = fh->h;
                slay = (fh == g_rt_cur) ? g_h_layout : p_slot_layout(fh);
                srcname = "m38h"; snap_used = 0;
            } else if (g_m38h_logged != -2) {
                g_m38h_logged = -2;
                vk_boot_logf("[m38h] present forced slot=%d unusable (img=%d ext=%ux%u) — 保持原选源",
                             fs, fh->img ? 1 : 0, (unsigned)fh->w, (unsigned)fh->h);
            }
        }
    }
    /* M4al P2：台账按**最终**选中的源记（快照会覆盖上面 pslot 已写下的 tex 选择）。 */
    g_p_last_src = srcname; g_p_last_slot = snap_used ? -1 : pslot_i;
    /* M4cc P2 (log-only, optional second change; M4cb P4-bug#1): when the source is the 282 RT the
       ledger used to print the *gpres* slot (pslot_i, often -1) while sw/sh came from the 282 slot,
       so `slot=` and `ext=` disagreed. Print the slot that actually served the frame. No behaviour. */
    if (!strcmp(srcname, "rt282")) g_p_last_slot = rt282_i;
    if (!strcmp(srcname, "auto")) g_p_last_slot = pa_i;   /* M5t：台账记真正供帧的那个槽 */
    if (!strcmp(srcname, "m7h-world")) g_p_last_slot = m7h_pres_slot();   /* M7h：同上（句柄反查槽号） */
    if (!strcmp(srcname, "m38h")) g_p_last_slot = m38h_sel;   /* M38H：强制槽 ⇒ 台账记真正供帧的槽 */
    if (!strcmp(srcname, "m39a")) g_p_last_slot = m39a_sel;   /* M39A：默认直送槽 ⇒ 同上（否则日志 slot/ext 对不上） */
    g_p_last_w = sw; g_p_last_h = sh;
    /* M4ak P3：本帧选源身份（[p] sig 行会带出去配对）。快照不是槽 ⇒ sel_slot=-1（修掉 M4ak 记的标注 bug）。 */
    g_p_sel_call = call;
    g_p_sel_slot = (m38h_sel >= 0) ? m38h_sel : (m39a_sel >= 0) ? m39a_sel : (snap_used ? -1 : pslot_i);
    g_p_sel_why = srcname;
    /* M39N（2026-11-09）：把「真正要拷去上屏的那张图」在指定 draws 门槛上 dump 一次。
       用途：与同刻 gameRT 的 PAM、与屏幕截图三方对照，判定红底花屏是在渲染产出侧还是拷贝/上屏侧。
       关态（v<=0）只做一次 seed + 每 16 次 present 一次文件读，不碰任何 Vulkan 状态。 */
    {
        static int w2p_seeded, w2p_done, w2p_last, w2p_n;
        static unsigned long long w2p_last_call, w2p_thr;
        if (!w2p_seeded) { w2p_seeded = 1; p_file_seed(W2P_A, W2P_B); }
        if (!w2p_done && (g_p_calls - w2p_last_call) >= 16) {   /* 每 16 次 present 重读一次（不能只 init 缓存） */
            w2p_last_call = g_p_calls;
            /* 门槛口径必须是**活着的**计数器：g_d_draws 只在 SMO_TRI_DRAW=1 的三角形对照段里 ++，
               本构建 SMO_TRI_DRAW 缺省 0 ⇒ 那段被预处理掉、g_d_draws 恒 0（M39N boot#1 实证：
               门槛已读到 135000 但从不触发 = 静默失活）。真 draw 口径是 g_r_draws（M39M 活门槛同款）。 */
            const unsigned long long dr = g_r_draws + g_d_draws;
            const int v = p_file_int(W2P_A, W2P_B, 0);
            if (v != w2p_last) {
                w2p_last = v;
                vk_boot_logf("[d] rb W2pres gate read v=%d call=%llu draws=%llu", v, call, dr);
            }
            if (v > 0) {
                /* 只给一次上屏机会，而「W2 红窗」按 boot 有 ±10 s 漂移 ⇒ 门槛之上再按 +4000 draws
                   （≈5 s）补打 5 张，共 6 张覆盖 ~25 s 窗口。首张 smo_w2_pres.pam，其余 smo_w2_pres1..5.pam。 */
                if (!w2p_thr) w2p_thr = (unsigned long long)v;
                if ((w2p_last_call & 127ull) == 0ull)
                    vk_boot_logf("[d] rb W2pres wait n=%d thr=%llu draws=%llu call=%llu", w2p_n, w2p_thr, dr, call);
                if (dr >= w2p_thr) {
                    char base[64];
                    if (w2p_n == 0) snprintf(base, sizeof base, "smo_w2_pres.pam");
                    else snprintf(base, sizeof base, "smo_w2_pres%d.pam", w2p_n);
                    if (simg) {
                        const char *wp = m39n_dump_pam(simg, slay, sw, sh, base);
                        vk_boot_logf("[d] rb W2pres n=%d draws=%llu src=%s ext=%ux%u img=%#llx lay=%d path=%s call=%llu",
                                     w2p_n, dr, srcname, sw, sh, (unsigned long long)simg, (int)slay,
                                     wp[0] ? wp : "<none>", call);
                    } else {
                        vk_boot_logf("[d] rb W2pres n=%d draws=%llu src=%s ext=%ux%u img=NULL lay=%d path=<none> call=%llu",
                                     w2p_n, dr, srcname, sw, sh, (int)slay, call);
                    }
                    w2p_n++;
                    w2p_thr = (unsigned long long)v + (unsigned long long)w2p_n * 4000ull;
                    if (w2p_n >= 6) w2p_done = 1;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    /* M38E B（只读，log-only）：present 时刻全部槽的记账 + 非常量槽 PNG（≤4 次）。 */
    m38e_present(call);
    /* M4ak P1：每 boot ≤3 次、间隔 ≥120 s 的逐帧对照（只读签名，不改选源/拷贝行为）。 */
    m4ak_probe(call, srcname, (m38h_sel >= 0) ? m38h_sel : (m39a_sel >= 0) ? m39a_sel : pslot_i, simg, slay, sw, sh);
    /* M4c：源更小时跳过，防越界读。M6v P1：槽尺寸已是光栅尺寸（guest 1600x900 ÷ D）⇒ 门限同步 ÷D，
       否则每一帧都被判「源太小」直接跳过 = 黑屏（派活单 §3#1.2「必须同时放宽 present 最小尺寸判据」）。 */
    if (sw < h_rs_dim(H_OFF_W) || sh < h_rs_dim(H_OFF_H)) { g_p_skip++; g_p_skip_small++; pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock); return 1; }
    /* ===== M4cc P1: NO CROP. Copy the whole source frame (0,0..sw,sh) and let win_fill.c do the
       uniform aspect-preserving fit into the runtime target face (letterbox bars on the short axis).
       Old behaviour (removed): crox=(sw-1280)/2, croy=(sh-720)/2, extent 1280x720 -- that cut 160 px
       off each side and 90 px off top/bottom of the 1600x900 composite, which is exactly what sliced
       the SMO logo's left/top edge. */
    uint32_t cp_w = sw, cp_h = sh;
    int cp_clamped = 0;
    if (cp_w > (uint32_t)H_PRES_MAX_W) { cp_w = (uint32_t)H_PRES_MAX_W; cp_clamped = 1; }
    if (cp_h > (uint32_t)H_PRES_MAX_H) { cp_h = (uint32_t)H_PRES_MAX_H; cp_clamped = 1; }
    g_p_cp_w = cp_w; g_p_cp_h = cp_h;
    const int crox = 0, croy = 0;   /* 源矩形左上角恒为 (0,0)：本轮口径 crop=none */
    if (cp_clamped && (call <= 3 || (call % 120) == 0))
        vk_boot_logf("[p-warn] present copy clamped src=%ux%u -> %ux%u (staging box %ux%u) call=%llu",
                     sw, sh, cp_w, cp_h, (unsigned)H_PRES_MAX_W, (unsigned)H_PRES_MAX_H, call);
    /* M4x P2 取证：同刻对**源图**做一次 GPU 回读签名。staging 全 0 时用它区分两种病根：
       · gsig 有内容 + staging 全 0 ⇒ 拷贝/内存可见性坏了（同一张图 GPU 里有东西）；
       · gsig 也是黑/均匀 ⇒ 选错了图（present 时刻的当前目标本就没有画面内容）。
       只在本来就要打 staging 签名的那些 call 上做，避免额外 submit。
       M4y P1b：源是快照时不打 gsig——快照每次内容变化都会被重拷，present 再 submit 一次没有新信息，
       还会把 g_h_cp/g_h_fence 从 present 线程和 draw 线程同时用，得不偿失。staging 签名已足够。 */
    if ((call <= 3 || (call % 120) == 0) && strcmp(srcname, "snap") != 0) {
        r_sig_t gs;
        VkImageLayout glay = slay;   /* 与拷贝用的旧布局同口径 */
        int gok = r_tex_signature(simg, glay, sw, sh, 4, &gs);
        unsigned long long gg = (gok && gs.npx) ? gs.npx : 1;
        vk_boot_logf("[p] gsig #%llu src=%s img=%#llx lay=%d ok=%d mean=%llu/%llu/%llu "
                     "min=%llu/%llu/%llu/%llu max=%llu/%llu/%llu/%llu hash=%#llx "
                     "rt_open=%d draw_open=%d key=%#llx id=%d tex=%d",
                     call, srcname, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)simg, (int)glay, gok,
                     gok ? gs.sum[0] / gg : 0ull, gok ? gs.sum[1] / gg : 0ull, gok ? gs.sum[2] / gg : 0ull,
                     gok ? gs.mn[0] : 0ull, gok ? gs.mn[1] : 0ull, gok ? gs.mn[2] : 0ull, gok ? gs.mn[3] : 0ull,
                     gok ? gs.mx[0] : 0ull, gok ? gs.mx[1] : 0ull, gok ? gs.mx[2] : 0ull, gok ? gs.mx[3] : 0ull,
                     gok ? gs.hash : 0ull, g_h_rt_open, g_r_open,
                     (unsigned long long)(g_rt_cur ? g_rt_cur->key : 0),
                     g_rt_cur ? g_rt_cur->tex_id : -1, g_rt_cur ? g_rt_cur->fmt : 0);
    }
    {   /* ===== M4ca P1（只读）：合成 RT 的**上屏时刻**取证 =====
           为什么必须在这里：`[c] comp rts` 读的是 g_h_img，而它是在「本帧那几笔合成 draw **之前**」
           取的——实测那一刻整幅 (0,0,0,0)（游戏每帧先清）；而 [g] rt table 在别的时刻读到同一张
           RT 是 mean=174/160/141、colored=99.6%。所以「验收要看的那张图」只能在 submit 完成后的
           上屏口读。这里按 tex_id==282 找槽，用**槽自己的 img/layout**（与 rt table 同口径）出
           mean/nz/colored + 整幅 PAM；每 boot ≤4 次、间隔 ≥100 s，不改任何上屏/渲染行为。 */
        static unsigned long long ca_n, ca_last_us;
        struct timespec cts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &cts);
        unsigned long long cnow = (unsigned long long)cts.tv_sec * 1000000ull + (unsigned long long)cts.tv_nsec / 1000ull;
        if (ca_n < 4 && (!ca_last_us || cnow - ca_last_us > 100000000ull)) {
            int sidx = -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++)
                if (g_rt_tab[i].key && g_rt_tab[i].img && g_rt_tab[i].tex_id == 282) { sidx = i; break; }
            if (sidx >= 0) {
                h_rt_slot *s = &g_rt_tab[sidx];
                ca_last_us = cnow; ca_n++;
                c_stat_t st;
                if (s->w && s->h && c_img_stats(s->img, s->layout, s->w, s->h, 4, &st)) {
                    vk_boot_logf("[ca] rt282 #%llu call=%llu slot=%d key=%#llx ext=%ux%u lay=%d npx=%llu "
                                 "nz=%.1f%% colored=%.1f%% black=%.1f%% mean=%llu/%llu/%llu "
                                 "max=%llu/%llu/%llu rgba0=%u,%u,%u,%u hb5=[%.0f,%.0f,%.0f,%.0f,%.0f]%%",
                                 ca_n, call, sidx, (unsigned long long)s->key, (unsigned)s->w, (unsigned)s->h,
                                 (int)s->layout, st.npx,
                                 100.0 * (double)st.nz / (double)(st.npx ? st.npx * 4 : 1),
                                 100.0 * (double)st.colored / (double)(st.npx ? st.npx : 1),
                                 100.0 * (double)st.black / (double)(st.npx ? st.npx : 1),
                                 st.sr / (st.npx ? st.npx : 1), st.sg / (st.npx ? st.npx : 1), st.sb / (st.npx ? st.npx : 1),
                                 st.mxr, st.mxg, st.mxb,
                                 st.px0[0], st.px0[1], st.px0[2], st.px0[3],
                                 100.0 * (double)st.hb[0] / (double)(st.npx ? st.npx : 1),
                                 100.0 * (double)st.hb[1] / (double)(st.npx ? st.npx : 1),
                                 100.0 * (double)st.hb[2] / (double)(st.npx ? st.npx : 1),
                                 100.0 * (double)st.hb[3] / (double)(st.npx ? st.npx : 1),
                                 100.0 * (double)st.hb[4] / (double)(st.npx ? st.npx : 1));
                }
                VkDeviceSize sz = (VkDeviceSize)s->w * (VkDeviceSize)s->h * 4ull;
                uint8_t *px = (uint8_t *)c_raw_copy(s->img, s->layout, s->w, s->h, sz);
                if (px) {
                    char path[160];
                    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "/data/storage/el2/base/files/m4ca_rt282_%llu.pam", ca_n);
                    FILE *fp = fopen(path, "wb");
                    if (fp) {
                        fprintf(fp, "P7\nWIDTH %u\nHEIGHT %u\nDEPTH 4\nMAXVAL 255\nTUPLTYPE RGB_ALPHA\nENDHDR\n",
                                (unsigned)s->w, (unsigned)s->h);
                        fwrite(px, (size_t)sz, 1, fp);
                        fclose(fp);
                        vk_boot_logf("[ca] rt282 pam #%llu -> %s bytes=%llu", ca_n, path, (unsigned long long)sz);
                    } else vk_boot_logf("[ca] rt282 pam #%llu FAIL errno=%d", ca_n, errno);
                    free(px);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    {   /* ===== M7D5：主 1600x900 目标的上屏时刻回读（开关 smo_m7d5，默认 0）=====
           M7D4 只回读了 tex_id==282（800x450）。这一轮补「有没有一张真正 1600x900 的目标」——
           若存在且 mean/colored 与 rt282 不同，说明 0.5 灰只是 282 那条链的产物。只读，不改行为。 */
        static unsigned long long m5n, m5last;
        struct timespec m5ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &m5ts);
        unsigned long long m5now = (unsigned long long)m5ts.tv_sec * 1000000ull
                                 + (unsigned long long)m5ts.tv_nsec / 1000ull;
        if (m7d5_on() && m5n < 4 && (!m5last || m5now - m5last > 100000000ull)) {
            int m5i = -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++)
                if (g_rt_tab[i].key && g_rt_tab[i].img &&
                    g_rt_tab[i].w >= 1600u && g_rt_tab[i].h >= 900u) { m5i = i; break; }
            if (m5i >= 0) {
                h_rt_slot *m5s = &g_rt_tab[m5i];
                c_stat_t m5st;
                m5last = m5now; m5n++;
                if (c_img_stats(m5s->img, m5s->layout, m5s->w, m5s->h, 4, &m5st))
                    vk_boot_logf("[m7d5] rtbig #%llu call=%llu slot=%d key=%#llx ext=%ux%u lay=%d npx=%llu "
                                 "nz=%.1f%% colored=%.1f%% black=%.1f%% mean=%llu/%llu/%llu max=%llu/%llu/%llu "
                                 "rgba0=%u,%u,%u,%u hb5=[%.0f,%.0f,%.0f,%.0f,%.0f]%%",
                                 m5n, call, m5i, (unsigned long long)m5s->key, (unsigned)m5s->w, (unsigned)m5s->h,
                                 (int)m5s->layout, m5st.npx,
                                 100.0 * (double)m5st.nz / (double)(m5st.npx ? m5st.npx * 4 : 1),
                                 100.0 * (double)m5st.colored / (double)(m5st.npx ? m5st.npx : 1),
                                 100.0 * (double)m5st.black / (double)(m5st.npx ? m5st.npx : 1),
                                 m5st.sr / (m5st.npx ? m5st.npx : 1), m5st.sg / (m5st.npx ? m5st.npx : 1),
                                 m5st.sb / (m5st.npx ? m5st.npx : 1), m5st.mxr, m5st.mxg, m5st.mxb,
                                 m5st.px0[0], m5st.px0[1], m5st.px0[2], m5st.px0[3],
                                 100.0 * (double)m5st.hb[0] / (double)(m5st.npx ? m5st.npx : 1),
                                 100.0 * (double)m5st.hb[1] / (double)(m5st.npx ? m5st.npx : 1),
                                 100.0 * (double)m5st.hb[2] / (double)(m5st.npx ? m5st.npx : 1),
                                 100.0 * (double)m5st.hb[3] / (double)(m5st.npx ? m5st.npx : 1),
                                 100.0 * (double)m5st.hb[4] / (double)(m5st.npx ? m5st.npx : 1));
            } else if (m5n == 0) { m5n++; vk_boot_logf("[m7d5] rtbig: no 1600x900 RT slot found (call=%llu)", call); }
        }
    }
    if (!p_ensure()) { g_p_vkfail++; pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock); return 0; }

    struct timespec ts;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    const long long t0 = (long long)ts.tv_sec * 1000000 + ts.tv_nsec / 1000;

    VkCommandBuffer cb = NULL;
    VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo ca = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO };
    ca.commandPool = g_h_cp;
    ca.level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY;
    ca.commandBufferCount = 1;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_vkq_lock);   /* M4bt P1：与扫描线程的整幅回读/上传串行（同一个 g_q / g_h_cp） */
    if (vkAllocateCommandBuffers(g_dev, &ca, &cb) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        g_p_vkfail++;
        vk_boot_logf("[p-red] present vkAllocateCommandBuffers failed");
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_vkq_lock);
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
        return 0;
    }
    if (g_h_layout != VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL) {
        static int warned;
        if (!warned) { warned = 1; vk_boot_logf("[p-warn] present layout=%d (expected CAO)", (int)g_h_layout); }
    }
    VkCommandBufferBeginInfo cbi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO };
    cbi.flags = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT;
    vkBeginCommandBuffer(cb, &cbi);
    VkImageSubresourceRange rng = { VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1 };
    /* M4x：源的布局不一定是附件态（内容源可能正好被当纹理采样着）——barrier 的 oldLayout / srcAccess
       跟着 slay 走，回程也回到 slay，别把别的目标的状态记账改坏。 */
    const int slay_sro = (slay == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL);
    const int slay_tx  = (slay == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL);   /* M4y P1b：内容快照 */
    VkAccessFlags src_acc = slay_sro ? VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT
                          : slay_tx ? VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT
                                     : (VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT);
    VkPipelineStageFlags src_stage = slay_sro ? VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT
                                   : slay_tx ? VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT
                                             : VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT;
    VkImageMemoryBarrier b = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER };
    b.srcAccessMask = src_acc;
    b.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT;
    b.oldLayout = slay;
    b.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL;
    b.srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
    b.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
    b.image = simg;
    b.subresourceRange = rng;
    beat_cmd();
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, src_stage, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT,
                         0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &b);
    VkBufferImageCopy reg = {0};
    reg.bufferOffset = 0;
    reg.bufferRowLength = 0;
    reg.bufferImageHeight = 0;
    reg.imageSubresource = (VkImageSubresourceLayers){ VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1 };
    reg.imageOffset = (VkOffset3D){ crox, croy, 0 };          /* M4cc：恒 0,0 —— 全幅，不裁 */
    reg.imageExtent = (VkExtent3D){ cp_w, cp_h, 1 };          /* M4cc：整幅源（不再是 1280x720） */
    beat_cmd();
    vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer(cb, simg, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, g_p_buf, 1, &reg);
    b = (VkImageMemoryBarrier){ VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER };
    b.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT;
    b.dstAccessMask = src_acc;
    b.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL;
    b.newLayout = slay;
    b.srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
    b.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
    b.image = simg;
    b.subresourceRange = rng;
    beat_cmd();
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, src_stage,
                         0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &b);
    vkEndCommandBuffer(cb);
    VkSubmitInfo si = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO };
    si.commandBufferCount = 1;
    si.pCommandBuffers = &cb;
    vkResetFences(g_dev, 1, &g_p_fence);
    VkResult sr = vkQueueSubmit(g_q, 1, &si, g_p_fence);
    VkResult wr = VK_NOT_READY;
    if (sr == VK_SUCCESS) wr = nvk_wait_fences(g_dev, 1, &g_p_fence, VK_TRUE, 5000000000ull);
    cb_free_if_done(g_h_cp, &cb, (sr == VK_SUCCESS) ? wr : VK_SUCCESS, "present copy");
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_vkq_lock);
    if (simg == g_h_img) g_h_layout = slay;   /* 拷自己的当前目标：布局回程值同步记账；别的图不动 g_h_layout */

    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    const long long t1 = (long long)ts.tv_sec * 1000000 + ts.tv_nsec / 1000;
    if (sr != VK_SUCCESS || wr != VK_SUCCESS) {
        g_p_vkfail++;
        vk_boot_logf("[p-red] present copy submit rv=%d wait rv=%d (%s)", (int)sr, (int)wr, vr(sr));
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
        return 0;
    }

    __attribute__((weak)) int nvn_win_present_rgba(void *, const void *, int, int, int);
    /* M4bi P1：拷贝与 fence 都已过去 ⇒ staging 里现在装的就是本帧要上屏的像素。
       先落盘/统计**原始值**（判「暗到什么程度」必须用未提亮的），再按需 apply gain 给屏幕看。 */
    m4bi_probe(call, ovr, ovr_lock);
    const int gain = p_present_gain();
    if (gain > 1) {
        p_apply_gain(gain);
        if (call <= 3 || (call % 120) == 0)
            vk_boot_logf("[p] gain=%d applied (synthetic exposure, 只改上屏像素) src=%s call=%llu",
                         gain, srcname, call);
    }
    int ok = 0;
    if (nvn_win_present_rgba) ok = nvn_win_present_rgba(g_win, g_p_map, (int)cp_w, (int)cp_h, (int)cp_w * 4);
    if (!ok) g_p_winfail++; else g_p_ok++;
    if (g_p_ok + g_p_winfail <= 3 || (call % 60) == 0)
        vk_boot_logf("[p] present #%llu vk copy us=%lld win=%s ok=%llu skip=%llu fail=%llu src=%s src_ext=%ux%u",
                     call, t1 - t0, ok ? "ok" : "fail", g_p_ok, g_p_skip, g_p_winfail, srcname, sw, sh);
    /* M4x P1：真正送屏的像素（staging）签名，与 [rt] 行同口径；#1~3 全落、之后每 120 次一条。
       M4y P1：content 源每次上屏都统计（只算均值/极值，<1ms），用于 content lost 计数；行本身仍限流。 */
    {
        int psig_verbose = (call <= 3 || (call % 120) == 0);
        int psig_want = psig_verbose || !strcmp(srcname, "content") || g_p_m4ak_sig_pair;
        if (psig_want)
            p_sig_line(call, srcname, simg, sw, sh, crox, croy, ok, psig_verbose || g_p_m4ak_sig_pair);
        g_p_m4ak_sig_pair = 0;
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
    return ok ? 1 : 0;
}

/* 取证：软件上屏计数（calls/ok/skip/vk 失败+窗口失败）。 */
void nvn_vk_present_stats(unsigned long long *calls, unsigned long long *ok,
                          unsigned long long *skipped, unsigned long long *fail)
{
    if (calls) *calls = g_p_calls;
    if (ok) *ok = g_p_ok;
    if (skipped) *skipped = g_p_skip;
    if (fail) *fail = g_p_vkfail + g_p_winfail;
}

/* M4x P1：上屏链路拆解（skip 三口径 + 上屏源命中）。
   ds=降采样跳过（本帧不刷但屏幕仍归我管）；small=源太小（<1280x720）跳过；
   nosrc=保留位（当前未用，恒 0）；hit=用了「本帧最后一笔颜色 draw」的图；
   cur=该图正好就是当前目标；miss=候选存在但校验失败已退回。 */
void nvn_vk_present_skip_split(unsigned long long *ds, unsigned long long *small,
                               unsigned long long *nosrc, unsigned long long *hit,
                               unsigned long long *cur, unsigned long long *miss)
{
    if (ds) *ds = g_p_skip_ds;
    if (small) *small = g_p_skip_small;
    if (nosrc) *nosrc = g_p_skip_nosrc;
    if (hit) *hit = g_p_src_hit;
    if (cur) *cur = g_p_src_cur;
    if (miss) *miss = g_p_src_fallback;
}

/* M4f P1 —— clear 收到每帧一次。
   锚点由调用方给（gfx_bridge 的 WindowAcquireTexture 计数）：同一 frame 内对同一张目标图，
   只有**第一次** clear 真正落地；之后的 clear 一律不提交（vkCmdClearColorImage 一行不发），
   因此同一帧内多条 submit 的绘制按顺序累积，不会被后面的 clear 抹掉。跨帧语义不变：
   新帧的第一笔 clear 照旧清屏，且帧内生效色 = 首清色（后续差异只计数，不改语义）。
   目标图必须一起比：一帧内游戏可能切多张 RT（per-RT VkImage），每张各清一次是正确行为。 */
static unsigned long long g_c_frame = ~0ull;   /* 当前统计所属帧（帧锚点） */
static unsigned long long g_c_img;             /* 本帧已落地的目标图 */
static int g_c_cleared;                        /* 本帧是否已清过（失败不算） */
static unsigned long long g_c_att, g_c_supp;   /* 本帧尝试/抑制次数 */
static float g_c_color[4];                     /* 本帧生效清屏色（= 首清） */
static unsigned long long g_c_supp_total, g_c_dup_color;
static unsigned long long g_c_last_ns;         /* 最近一次真的落地 (CLOCK_MONOTONIC)，见 100ms 保底 */

/* M4al P1：[w] wipe 行要的「最近生效清屏色」。g_c_color 在本文件后面才定义，故在此处落地
   （r_rt_sig_tick 里已有前置声明）。返 1 = 有过清屏，0 = 还没清过（颜色未知）。 */
static int m4al_last_clear(float out[4])
{
    if (!g_c_cleared) return 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) out[i] = g_c_color[i];
    return 1;
}

/* ---- M4n P2①：每帧 clear 颜色的重采样 ----
   为什么不能每帧刷：本作每帧两笔 clear（先清黑再清白）⇒ 每帧 2 行 × 434 s 已经够压垮日志通道。
   为什么不能只靠每 600 帧那条 [c] frame=（gfx_bridge 侧）：983 帧那种「只出现一次的白 clear」会被漏掉
   （上一轮就是靠回读才反推出它，日志里没有）。折中（判据是「新颜色」而不是「这一笔变了」——
   每帧黑/白两笔天然交替，按笔判会退化成每帧 2 行的刷屏）：
   ·首 4 帧全落（看清启动序列）；
   ·**首次出现的「落地色」各落一条** —— 983 帧的白 clear 属于这一类，必然被抓到（最多记 8 种）；
   ·无新颜色时每 6000 帧一条心跳（≈55 s @110fps，与 [c]/[h] 的 600 帧口径错开，不打架）；
   ·失败（state=failed）无条件落；单 boot 上限 512 行（再异常也不刷屏）。
   字段：landed=真的 vkQueueSubmit 成功；suppressed=同帧同目标被抑制（不提交）；failed=提交失败。
   eff=本帧生效色（= 首清色；100ms 保底放行后可能被改写，以本条为准）。 */
static unsigned long long g_cl_log_n, g_cl_hb_f;
static float g_cl_seen[8][4];   /* 已见过的「落地色」（判新颜色用；颜色是游戏给的常量，精确比较即可） */
static int g_cl_seen_n;
static void c_log_line(unsigned long long frame, unsigned long long img, const float rgba[4],
                       int state, int rc, unsigned long long att, unsigned long long supp,
                       unsigned long long dup, const float eff[4])
{
    int want = (frame <= 3);
    if (state == 1) {
        int known = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < g_cl_seen_n; i++)
            if (!memcmp(g_cl_seen[i], rgba, sizeof(float) * 4)) { known = 1; break; }
        if (!known) {
            if (g_cl_seen_n < (int)(sizeof g_cl_seen / sizeof *g_cl_seen))
                memcpy(g_cl_seen[g_cl_seen_n++], rgba, sizeof(float) * 4);
            want = 1;   /* 新颜色：一次性白 clear 就在这里被抓到 */
        }
    }
    if (state < 0) want = 1;                 /* 提交失败：无条件落 */
    if (!want && frame % 6000ull == 0 && frame != g_cl_hb_f) { g_cl_hb_f = frame; want = 1; }
    /* M4bj P1：**落地的清屏**逐笔记账 + 扫码（判据表：洋红是 clear 来的还是 draw 画的）。
       after_draw = 这条 clear 之前已经写进同一张图的 draw 笔数（>0 ⇒ clear 会抹掉已画的内容）。
       本函数的 rgba 全部来自游戏下发（nvn_vk_clear_color_offscreen_frame 的入参），故 src=game。 */
    if (state == 1) {
        k_img_t *ke = k_img_slot((VkImage)(uintptr_t)img, (unsigned)g_rt_w, (unsigned)g_rt_h, 0ull);
        unsigned long long ad = ke ? ke->draws : 0;
        if (g_k_clr_lines < 8) {
            g_k_clr_lines++;
            vk_boot_logf("[k] clear tgt=%#llx ext=%ux%u rgba=%.3f,%.3f,%.3f,%.3f src=game after_draw=%llu f=%llu",
                         img, (unsigned)g_rt_w, (unsigned)g_rt_h,
                         rgba[0], rgba[1], rgba[2], rgba[3], ad, frame);
        }
        if (ke) {
            ke->clears++;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) ke->lastclear[i] = rgba[i];
            ke->lastclear_src = 1;
            ke->lastclear_f = frame;   /* M7D6：清屏发生在第几帧 */
            ke->lastclear_d = ad;      /* M7D6：清之前该图已有几笔 draw */
        }
    }
    if (!want || g_cl_log_n >= 512) return;
    g_cl_log_n++;
    vk_boot_logf("[clr] f=%llu img=%#llx rgba=%.3f,%.3f,%.3f,%.3f %s rc=%d eff=%.3f,%.3f,%.3f,%.3f att=%llu sup=%llu dup=%llu n=%llu",
                 frame, img, rgba[0], rgba[1], rgba[2], rgba[3],
                 state == 1 ? "landed" : (state == 0 ? "suppressed" : "failed"), rc,
                 eff[0], eff[1], eff[2], eff[3], att, supp, dup, g_cl_log_n);
}

int nvn_vk_clear_color_offscreen_frame(unsigned long long frame, const float rgba[4],
                                       unsigned long long *out_img, int *suppressed)
{
    if (suppressed) *suppressed = 0;
    if (!g_on || !g_dev || !g_q) return -1;
    if (!h_off_ensure()) return -2;
    unsigned long long img = (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_h_img;   /* rt_flush 已由调用方兑现，此处即最终目标 */
    if (out_img) *out_img = img;
    if (frame != g_c_frame) {   /* 新帧：上一帧计数随 nvn_vk_clear_stats 交付，这里清零 */
        g_c_frame = frame; g_c_att = 0; g_c_supp = 0; g_c_cleared = 0;
    }
    g_c_att++;
    /* 保底：帧锚点若卡住不涨（无窗口 acquire 的路径），100ms 后强制放行一笔——防止「一次清屏之后永不清」。 */
    struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    unsigned long long now_ns = (unsigned long long)ts.tv_sec * 1000000000ull + (unsigned long long)ts.tv_nsec;
    if (g_c_cleared && img == g_c_img && now_ns - g_c_last_ns < 100000000ull) {
        g_c_supp++; g_c_supp_total++;
        if (rgba[0] != g_c_color[0] || rgba[1] != g_c_color[1] ||
            rgba[2] != g_c_color[2] || rgba[3] != g_c_color[3]) g_c_dup_color++;
        if (suppressed) *suppressed = 1;
        c_log_line(frame, img, rgba, 0, 0, g_c_att, g_c_supp, g_c_dup_color, g_c_color);
        /* M4bm P1（只读）：被抑制的清屏也记进时序表（不提交 = 没有抹掉内容）。 */
        { char t[76];
          snprintf(t, sizeof t, "C color img=%#llx rgba=%.2f,%.2f,%.2f,%.2f sup=1",
                   img, rgba[0], rgba[1], rgba[2], rgba[3]);
          fo_note(0, t, 0, 0); }
        return 0;
    }
    VkCommandBuffer cb = NULL;
    VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo ca = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO };
    ca.commandPool = g_h_cp;
    ca.level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY;
    ca.commandBufferCount = 1;
    if (vkAllocateCommandBuffers(g_dev, &ca, &cb) != VK_SUCCESS) return -3;
    VkCommandBufferBeginInfo bi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO };
    bi.flags = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT;
    vkBeginCommandBuffer(cb, &bi);
    VkImageSubresourceRange rng = { VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1 };
    if (g_h_layout != VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL) {   /* 首次清屏 / RT 绑定后（CAO）都要转回来 */
        int from_rt = (g_h_layout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL);   /* M3i */
        VkImageMemoryBarrier b = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER };
        b.srcAccessMask = from_rt ? VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT : 0;
        b.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
        b.oldLayout = g_h_layout;
        b.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL;
        b.srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
        b.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
        b.image = g_h_img;
        b.subresourceRange = rng;
        beat_cmd();
        vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, from_rt ? VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT : VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TOP_OF_PIPE_BIT,
                             VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, 0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &b);
        g_h_layout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL;
    }
    VkClearColorValue cv;
    cv.float32[0] = rgba[0]; cv.float32[1] = rgba[1]; cv.float32[2] = rgba[2]; cv.float32[3] = rgba[3];
    beat_cmd();
    vkCmdClearColorImage(cb, g_h_img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, &cv, 1, &rng);
    if (g_h_rt_seen) {   /* M3i：清完回到 COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL——RT 作为附件状态常驻，下一帧绑定零 barrier */
        VkImageMemoryBarrier b = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER };
        b.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
        b.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT;
        b.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL;
        b.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL;
        b.srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
        b.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
        b.image = g_h_img;
        b.subresourceRange = rng;
        beat_cmd();
        vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT,
                             0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &b);
        g_h_layout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL;
    }
    /* M3m：draw 不再记在 clear 的 CB 里——由 gfx_bridge 在本函数返回后调 nvn_vk_draw_tri()
       单独成 CB/单独 submit/单独 fence。本函数因此必然能返回，"[h] vkQueueSubmit rv=" 必落盘。 */
    vkEndCommandBuffer(cb);
    VkSubmitInfo si = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO };
    si.commandBufferCount = 1;
    si.pCommandBuffers = &cb;
    vkResetFences(g_dev, 1, &g_h_fence);
    VkResult rv = vkQueueSubmit(g_q, 1, &si, g_h_fence);
    VkResult wrv = VK_NOT_READY;
    if (rv == VK_SUCCESS) {
        wrv = nvk_wait_fences(g_dev, 1, &g_h_fence, VK_TRUE, 5000000000ull);
        if (wrv != VK_SUCCESS)
            vk_boot_logf("[h-red] clear WaitForFences rv=%d (%s)", (int)wrv, vr(wrv));
    }
    else { NVK_RED("offscreen clear submit = %{public}d (%{public}s)", (int)rv, vr(rv));
           g_h_layout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED; }   /* 未落地：内容/布局不可信，下次从 UNDEFINED 重来 */
    cb_free_if_done(g_h_cp, &cb, (rv == VK_SUCCESS) ? wrv : VK_SUCCESS, "offscreen clear");
    if (rv == VK_SUCCESS) {   /* M3u P2：只有真落地的 clear 才更新基线（M4f：抑制后 = 本帧首清色） */
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) g_clr_last[i] = rgba[i];
        g_clr_seen++;
        m7g_clear(g_h_img, rgba);   /* M7g P1：只读——若这是世界 claim 图，记「谁在 claim 之后把它清了」 */
        g_c_cleared = 1; g_c_img = img;   /* M4f P1：本帧该目标的第一次清屏已落地 */
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) g_c_color[i] = rgba[i];
        g_c_last_ns = now_ns;
    }
    /* M4n P2①：本条 = 真提交结果（landed/failed）。放在 g_c_color 更新之后 ⇒ eff 就是本帧生效色。 */
    c_log_line(frame, img, rgba, rv == VK_SUCCESS ? 1 : -1, (int)rv,
               g_c_att, g_c_supp, g_c_dup_color, g_c_color);
    /* M4bm P1（只读）：本帧 CLEAR_COLOR 提交点 + 是否真落地。 */
    { char t[76];
      snprintf(t, sizeof t, "C color img=%#llx rgba=%.2f,%.2f,%.2f,%.2f landed=%d rv=%d",
               img, rgba[0], rgba[1], rgba[2], rgba[3], rv == VK_SUCCESS ? 1 : 0, (int)rv);
      fo_note(0, t, 0, 0); }
    return (int)rv;
}

/* 兼容入口（不抑制，逐次 clear）——当前无调用方，保留给诊断路径。 */
int nvn_vk_clear_color_offscreen(const float rgba[4], unsigned long long *out_img)
{
    return nvn_vk_clear_color_offscreen_frame(~0ull, rgba, out_img, NULL);
}

void nvn_vk_clear_stats(unsigned long long *frame, unsigned long long *att, unsigned long long *supp,
                        unsigned long long *supp_total, unsigned long long *dup_color, float color[4])
{
    if (frame) *frame = g_c_frame;
    if (att) *att = g_c_att;
    if (supp) *supp = g_c_supp;
    if (supp_total) *supp_total = g_c_supp_total;
    if (dup_color) *dup_color = g_c_dup_color;
    if (color) for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) color[i] = g_c_color[i];
}

/* M3i：SET_RENDER_TARGETS 真绑定（记录进按 submit 批次的命令缓冲，不在此处 submit）。
   顺序契约：调用方必须在任何 clear 之前先 nvn_vk_rt_flush()——clear 的 barrier oldLayout 依赖
   g_h_layout 已被本批次改成 COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL 且真的提交过。 */
int nvn_vk_rt_bind(int n, unsigned long long key, unsigned rw, unsigned rh, int tex_id, unsigned fmt,
                   unsigned long long dkey,
                   unsigned long long *out_img, unsigned *out_w, unsigned *out_h)
{
    if (!g_on || !g_dev || !g_q) return -1;
    if (!h_off_ensure()) return -2;
    if (!h_rt_objects_ensure()) return -2;
    /* M7c P1：开关回读（编译期默认值的唯一证据；只在第一次 rt_bind 打一行）。 */
    if (SMO_M7C_UB && !g_m7c_cfg_logged) {
        g_m7c_cfg_logged = 1;
        vk_boot_logf("[m7c] cfg world_scratch=%d wp_min_ext=%d ub_probe=%d rt_div=%d scr_max=%d "
                     "ub_max_lines=%d per_vs=%d",
                     (int)SMO_WORLD_SCRATCH, (int)SMO_WP_MIN_EXT, (int)SMO_M7C_UB, (int)h_rt_div(),
                     (int)M7B_SCR_MAX, (int)M7C_UB_MAX_LINES, (int)M7C_UB_PER_VS);
        /* M7d P1：bind 解析链探针的开关回读（与上面同一处，只多一行）。 */
        vk_boot_logf("[m7d] cfg bi_probe=%d bi_max_draws=%d bi_per_vs=%d bi_max_vs=%d c4_pin=%d "
                     "sticky=%d sticky_lo=%u sticky_bytes=%u",
                     (int)SMO_M7D_BI, (int)M7D_BI_MAX_DRAWS, (int)M7D_BI_PER_VS, (int)M7D_BI_MAX_VS,
                     (int)SMO_M7D_C4, (int)SMO_M7D_STICKY, (unsigned)R_STICKY_LO, (unsigned)R_STICKY_BYTES);
    }
    /* M6v P1：光栅尺寸 = guest 尺寸 ÷ SMO_RT_DIV。**在 API 边界一次性完成**——下面每一处
       （[n]/[h] 日志口径、h_rt_ensure 的槽身份、h_d_lookup 的深度尺寸匹配、framebuffer、
       renderArea/viewport、present 拷贝）拿到的都是光栅尺寸，彼此仍然自洽。
       深度必须同步（nvn_vk_rt_depth_bind 里做同样的 ÷D），否则 h_d_lookup 对不上、深度附件被丢。 */
    /* M7b P1（修 m7a_b1 的根因）：h_rs_dim(0)==1 会把「这次绑定身份解不出、尺寸未知」
       （gfx_bridge 的 miss 分支写死 ci.w=ci.h=0）悄悄变成一张 **1x1 的真图**。
       实证：`[h] rt bind n=1 … snap=0x0 ext=1x1 fmt=0x0 id=-1`，这类占 40% 的绑定
       （boot 末 stk_ptr=30970/76868、probe_miss=23910），而 [wp] tgt 表显示 11~27% 的
       顶点（每 60 s 190 万~1320 万）被画进 ext=1x1 的幽灵槽 —— 800x450 的世界 RT
       一个顶点都没收到。0 必须保持 0：h_rt_ensure 收 0 尺寸返 NULL 才是原设计的护栏。 */
    if (h_rt_div() > 1) { rw = rw ? h_rs_dim(rw) : 0u; rh = rh ? h_rs_dim(rh) : 0u; }
    int m7c_scr = 0;   /* M7c：本笔是否走了「补屏幕尺寸」分支（探针用，只读） */
    /* M7b P2（补 m7a_b1）：身份**和尺寸**都解不出的颜色目标（rw/rh==0，boot 末 23910/76868
       ≈31%，另有 40% 只解出指针）以前会变成 1x1 幽灵槽；这批 draw 恰恰是真的世界/角色几何
       （perf：`top1=10cce91b0a86ff58@1x1 tgt=1x1 us=141132 n=2308`）。现在按**屏幕尺寸**
       （guest 1600x900 ÷D = 800x450）建一张真的 RT，**key 仍用本笔自己的身份**
       （每个不同栈地址各得一张，不做合并 —— 合并会让后一个 pass 覆盖前一个）。
       好处：framebuffer/viewport/[rt]/[wp] 回读全部按真实尺寸工作，能诚实回答「画出来是不是黑的」。
       不碰 present 选源（上屏仍只按内容判据挑，绝不硬钉到这张）。
       SMO_WORLD_SCRATCH=0 ⇒ 完全回到 1x1（最坏情况等同 m7a_b1）。 */
    if (SMO_WORLD_SCRATCH && n > 0 && key && (!rw || !rh) && h_rt_scr_admit(key)) {
        rw = h_rs_dim(1600u); rh = h_rs_dim(900u);
        m7c_scr = 1;
        g_h_rt_screen_scratch++;
        if (g_h_rt_screen_scratch <= 8 || (g_h_rt_screen_scratch % 5000) == 0)
            vk_boot_logf("[h] rt ext unknown #%llu key=%#llx -> screen %ux%u (was 1x1 before M7b P2)",
                         g_h_rt_screen_scratch, (unsigned long long)key, rw, rh);
    }
    atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_pf_rtbind.n, 1, memory_order_relaxed);   /* M6e：SET_RENDER_TARGETS 次数 */
    /* M4ar P1：把「这次绑定说了什么」记下来，供 [n] newdraw 分类（n=0 / 有目标 / 回落）。 */
    g_h_rt_last_n = n; g_h_rt_last_w = rw; g_h_rt_last_h = rh; g_h_rt_last_fb = 0;
    /* M4r P1：n=0 的纯深度 pass。此前一律回落宿主 1280×720 图（M4q 计数 143,739 次），
       现在若同一次调用带回了可解析的 depth ⇒ **不动当前颜色目标**，只把深度槽记为「本段 draw 的
       唯一目标」，draw 走「仅深度」renderPass（var 3/4）。解析不到才保留旧的宿主回落行为。 */
    if (n <= 0) {
