        g_r_donly = NULL;
        h_d_slot *ds = h_d_lookup(dkey, 0, 0);
        if (ds) {
            g_r_donly = ds;
            g_h_dp_only++;
            if (g_h_dp_only <= 8)
                vk_boot_logf("[h] rt dpass n=0 dkey=%#llx ext=%ux%u fmt=0x%x -> depth-only pass (no host fallback)",
                             (unsigned long long)dkey, (unsigned)ds->w, (unsigned)ds->h, ds->fmt);
            if (out_img) *out_img = (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_h_img;
            if (out_w) *out_w = g_rt_w;
            if (out_h) *out_h = g_rt_h;
            g_h_rt_binds++;
            return 0;
        }
    } else g_r_donly = NULL;
    /* M4c：按 RT 句柄取/建 per-RT 目标；任何一步拿不到 ⇒ 回落宿主图（计数，不静默）。 */
    h_rt_slot *s = NULL;
    if (!h_rt_host_forced()) s = h_rt_ensure(key, rw, rh);
    /* M7c P1（只读）：把「这一槽是 scratch 补尺寸得来的」贴上 key，供 draw 侧 [ub] 探针识别世界那批。
       槽被 LRU 复用时 key 不同 ⇒ 自动失效（不会误判）。越界只计数。 */
    if (SMO_M7C_UB && m7c_scr && s && key) {
        const int si7 = (int)(s - g_rt_tab);
        if (si7 >= 0 && si7 < H_RT_SLOTS) g_m7c_scr_key[si7] = key;
        else g_m7c_scr_oob++;
    }
    /* M4bv P2：这次绑定是不是「游戏 present 引用的那张」？（present 侧给的三张窗口纹理之一）
       命中 = 游戏确实把要上屏的那张当渲染目标绑了 → 若同时 present 时 writers 仍是 0，问题就在
       draw 侧（绑定后被谁覆盖/丢弃）；不命中 = 整帧都在离屏 RT 上画，从没写过要上屏的那张。 */
    p_bindk_note(key);
    if (p_win_key_hit(key)) {
        g_winbind_n++;
        if (g_winbind_n <= 10 || (g_winbind_n % 1000) == 0)
            vk_boot_logf("[o] winbind #%llu key=%#llx ext=%ux%u fmt=%#x texid=%d s=%s",
                         g_winbind_n, (unsigned long long)key, rw, rh, fmt, tex_id,
                         s ? "ok" : "NULL(回落宿主图)");
    }
    if (s && fmt) s->fmt = fmt;   /* M4t P1：反向登记（尺寸+格式）要靠它区分同尺寸的不同 RT */
    if (s && tex_id >= 0 && s->tex_id != tex_id) {
        if (s->tex_id < 0 && tex_id >= 0 && g_h_rt_switch < 64)
            vk_boot_logf("[t] rt id map key=%#llx id=%d ext=%ux%u (route2 replace enabled)",
                         (unsigned long long)key, tex_id, (unsigned)rw, (unsigned)rh);
        s->tex_id = tex_id;   /* M4e：同一 key 的 id 视为不变；变了以最新为准 */
    }
    /* M4r P1：挂深度（同一次 SET_RENDER_TARGETS 里的 depth；尺寸必须一致，否则不挂并计数）。
       没带 depth 的调用点 ⇒ 清空挂载，避免沿用上一笔的深度图（那是另一个目标的记忆）。 */
    if (s) {
        h_d_slot *ds = h_d_lookup(dkey, rw, rh);
        if (ds && s->ds != ds) { s->ds = ds; s->fb_load_d = VK_NULL_HANDLE; s->fb_d_view = VK_NULL_HANDLE; }
        else if (!ds) {
            /* M4bn P1（只读）：本来挂着深度、这次被清空 —— 这就是「我们把深度附件丢了」的现场。 */
            if (s->ds) {
                g_dk_detach++;
                if (g_dk_detach <= 4)
                    vk_boot_logf("[n] dk detach slot=%#llx ext=%ux%u n=%d game_raw=%#llx ok=%d dkey=%#llx "
                                 "ours_was=%#llx why=%s",
                                 (unsigned long long)s->key, (unsigned)rw, (unsigned)rh, n,
                                 (unsigned long long)g_dk_raw, g_dk_ok, (unsigned long long)dkey,
                                 (unsigned long long)s->ds->key,
                                 !dkey ? (g_dk_ok == 2 ? "game_null" : "unresolved")
                                       : "size_or_slot_mismatch");
            }
            if (dkey && !s->ds && g_h_dp_skip++ < 4)
                vk_boot_logf("[h] rt depth unattached dkey=%#llx (no matching slot / ext mismatch) color=%ux%u",
                             (unsigned long long)dkey, (unsigned)rw, (unsigned)rh);
            s->ds = NULL;
        }
        /* M4bn P1：把游戏这次的深度声明贴到槽上（只记 n>0 的颜色目标声明；n=0 是纯深度 pass）。 */
        if (n > 0) { s->dk_raw = g_dk_raw; s->dk_ok = g_dk_ok; s->dk_n = g_dk_n;
                     s->dk_w = g_dk_w; s->dk_h = g_dk_h; s->dk_fmt = g_dk_fmt; }
        if (s->ds) g_h_dp_attach++;
        /* M4bn P2（只读）：深度携带绑定的逐笔对账（前 12 条），用来看「解出的深度到底挂上没有」。 */
        if (g_dk_raw && g_dk_bind_log < 12) {
            g_dk_bind_log++;
            vk_boot_logf("[n] dk bind#%u n=%d color=%#llx ext=%ux%u game_raw=%#llx ok=%d dkey=%#llx -> "
                         "ds=%s(%#llx)",
                         g_dk_bind_log, n, (unsigned long long)s->key, (unsigned)rw, (unsigned)rh,
                         (unsigned long long)g_dk_raw, g_dk_ok, (unsigned long long)dkey,
                         s->ds ? "yes" : "no", s->ds ? (unsigned long long)s->ds->key : 0ull);
        }
    }
    if (!s) {
        /* M4ar P2（本轮唯一的行为修改）：**解不出身份的 RT 绑定不再回落 1280×720 宿主图**。
           M4ar boot A 的决定性证据：新 key 的 draw（占 69%，17,258/25,000）全部 tgt=hostRT ext=1280x720，
           而同一笔在 1280×720 的 debug RT 上重放 A 变体时覆盖 2.48%（bbox 588,32..856,289）、
           写出 (0,0,0,255) —— 几何是对的、颜色是常量黑 FS 的固有输出；
           宿主图的读回却是 0/0/0/0 且它既不上屏也不被采样 ⇒ 这批 draw 的落笔被扔进了一张**没人读的
           宿主 scratch，而且是错误尺寸（请求 1600×900，实际 1280×720，视口/几何全部按错尺寸投影）**。
           修法：按**请求尺寸**建/复用一个「名义槽」（合成 key = 'M4A1' | w | h），走既有 RT 槽机制
           （自带 framebuffer/layout/[rt] 回读/槽采样）。表满或尺寸不可信时保持旧行为（回落宿主图），
           所以最坏情况等于今天。 */
        if (rw >= h_rs_dim(H_OFF_W) && rh >= h_rs_dim(H_OFF_H) && rw <= H_RT_MAXDIM && rh <= H_RT_MAXDIM && !h_rt_host_forced()) {
            unsigned long long nk = 0x4D34410000000000ull |
                                    ((unsigned long long)(rw & 0xFFFFu) << 16) |
                                    (unsigned long long)(rh & 0xFFFFu);
            h_rt_slot *ns = h_rt_ensure(nk, rw, rh);
            if (ns) {
                s = ns;
                g_h_rt_nominal++;
                if (g_h_rt_nominal <= 8 || (g_h_rt_nominal % 2000) == 0)
                    vk_boot_logf("[h] rt nominal #%llu key=%#llx(none) req=%ux%u -> slot=%d key=%#llx img=%#llx "
                                 "(按请求尺寸建名义槽，不再回落宿主 %dx%d)",
                                 g_h_rt_nominal, (unsigned long long)key, rw, rh,
                                 (int)(ns - g_rt_tab), (unsigned long long)ns->key,
                                 (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)ns->img, (int)H_OFF_W, (int)H_OFF_H);
            }
        }
        if (!s) {
            g_h_rt_fallback++;
            g_h_rt_last_fb = 1;
            /* M4p P1：前 16 条（原 4 条）——4 槽时代看不清「到底有几个 RT 对象在轮换」，
               16 槽后要能一次看全 key 集合，否则又会把表满误判成别的。 */
            if (g_h_rt_fallback <= 16 || (g_h_rt_fallback % 5000) == 0)
                vk_boot_logf("[h] rt fallback #%llu key=%#llx w=%u h=%u forced_host=%d -> host %dx%d",
                             g_h_rt_fallback, (unsigned long long)key, rw, rh, h_rt_host_forced(), (int)H_OFF_W, (int)H_OFF_H);
        }
    }
    if (s != g_rt_cur) {
        int had_open = g_h_rt_open;
        atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_pf_rtswitch.n, 1, memory_order_relaxed);   /* M6e：真的换目标 */
        if (had_open) nvn_vk_rt_flush();          /* 旧目标上的批次先落地（barrier 依赖旧 layout） */
        h_rt_switch(s);
        g_h_rt_switch++;
    }
    if (out_img) *out_img = (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_h_img;
    if (out_w) *out_w = g_rt_w;
    if (out_h) *out_h = g_rt_h;
    if (!g_h_rt_open) {
        VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo ca = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO };
        ca.commandPool = g_h_cp;
        ca.level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY;
        ca.commandBufferCount = 1;
        if (vkAllocateCommandBuffers(g_dev, &ca, &g_h_rt_cb) != VK_SUCCESS) { g_h_rt_fail++; return -4; }
        VkCommandBufferBeginInfo bi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO };
        bi.flags = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT;
        vkBeginCommandBuffer(g_h_rt_cb, &bi);
        g_h_rt_open = 1;
        if (g_h_layout != VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL) {
            int from_xfer = (g_h_layout == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL);
            VkImageMemoryBarrier b = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER };
            b.srcAccessMask = from_xfer ? VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT : 0;
            b.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT;
            b.oldLayout = g_h_layout;
            b.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL;
            b.srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
            b.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
            b.image = g_h_img;
            b.subresourceRange = (VkImageSubresourceRange){ VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1 };
            beat_cmd();
            vkCmdPipelineBarrier(g_h_rt_cb, from_xfer ? VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT : VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TOP_OF_PIPE_BIT,
                                 VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT, 0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &b);
            g_h_layout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL;   /* flush 成功后才算落地 */
        }
        /* M4c：viewport/scissor 尺寸取自**当前 RT**（游戏 RT 1600x900 时不再是 1280x720） */
        VkViewport vp = { 0.0f, 0.0f, (float)g_rt_w, (float)g_rt_h, 0.0f, 1.0f };
        beat_cmd();
        vkCmdSetViewport(g_h_rt_cb, 0, 1, &vp);
        VkRect2D sc = { { 0, 0 }, { (int32_t)g_rt_w, (int32_t)g_rt_h } };
        beat_cmd();
        vkCmdSetScissor(g_h_rt_cb, 0, 1, &sc);
    }
    g_h_rt_seen = 1;
    g_h_rt_binds++;
    if (n > 0) g_h_rt_nonempty++;
    if (s) { s->last_use = ++g_rt_use_seq;   /* M4q P1：LRU 驱逐用 */
             if (m36a_on()) { int si = (int)(s - g_rt_tab);
                 if (si >= 0 && si < H_RT_SLOTS) g_slot_bind_frame[si] = r_frame_now(); } }
    return 0;
}

/* ---- M4q P1：深度目标槽（M4r P1 起真正接进 draw 通道，结构体定义在文件上方 h_rt_slot 之前） ----
   m4p_b1 的证据链断在这里：SET_RENDER_TARGETS 的 depth（NVNtexture*）从来没被交给回放层
   （cmd_trace.c 只读 RtRec.tex[0]），于是「n=0 的纯深度 pass」在宿主侧**没有任何目标身份**，
   而 1024×1024 深度图（`[t] depth upload fmt=0x34 1024x1024`）到底是谁写的、写没写，日志里判不了。
   本入口：解析出来的深度纹理（尺寸来自游戏 descriptor）各建一张深度 VkImage，并打一行
   `[h] rt depth slot`。M4r 起该图会作为 renderPass 的深度附件参与 draw（见 h_rp_depth / fb 构建）。
   容量 8 槽（实测同一时刻 ≤3 张：1600×900、1280×720、1024×1024），满了就不再建、只计数。 */
static int vkfmt_of_nvn_depth(unsigned fmt, VkFormat *out)
{
    switch (fmt) {
    case 0x33: *out = VK_FORMAT_X8_D24_UNORM_PACK32; return 1;   /* NVN D24 */
    case 0x34: *out = VK_FORMAT_D32_SFLOAT;          return 1;   /* NVN DEPTH32F */
    default:   return 0;                                        /* 双面深度/模板、MS：本轮不建 */
    }
}
int nvn_vk_rt_depth_bind(unsigned long long key, unsigned rw, unsigned rh, unsigned fmt, int tex_id)
{
    if (!g_on || !g_dev) return -1;
    if (!key || !rw || !rh || rw > H_RT_MAXDIM || rh > H_RT_MAXDIM) return 0;
    /* M6v P1：深度光栅尺寸必须与颜色目标同步 ÷D —— 颜色/深度两张图尺寸不一致时
       h_d_lookup(dkey,rw,rh) 会直接判「不匹配」，深度附件就被丢（M4bn 的 detach 现场）。 */
    if (h_rt_div() > 1) { rw = h_rs_dim(rw); rh = h_rs_dim(rh); }
    g_d_binds++;
    VkFormat vf;
    if (!vkfmt_of_nvn_depth(fmt, &vf)) { g_d_badfmt++; return 0; }
    h_d_slot *s = NULL;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)(sizeof g_d_tab / sizeof *g_d_tab); i++)
        if (g_d_tab[i].key == key) {
            s = &g_d_tab[i];
            if (s->w == rw && s->h == rh && s->fmt == fmt) {   /* 已建，尺寸格式不变 */
                s->last_use = ++g_rt_use_seq; g_d_last = s;
                return 0;
            }
            s = NULL;   /* 尺寸/格式变了：旧图作废，走新建（槽复用） */
        }
    if (!s)
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)(sizeof g_d_tab / sizeof *g_d_tab); i++)
            if (!g_d_tab[i].key) { s = &g_d_tab[i]; break; }
    if (!s) { g_d_full++; return 1; }
    if (s->img) { vkDestroyImageView(g_dev, s->view, NULL); vkDestroyImage(g_dev, s->img, NULL);
                  vkFreeMemory(g_dev, s->mem, NULL); memset(s, 0, sizeof *s); }
    VkImageCreateInfo ii = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO };
    ii.imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D;
    ii.format = vf;
    ii.extent = (VkExtent3D){ rw, rh, 1 };
    ii.mipLevels = 1; ii.arrayLayers = 1;
    ii.samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
    ii.tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL;
    ii.usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_DEPTH_STENCIL_ATTACHMENT_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT |
               VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_SRC_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT;
    ii.sharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE;
    ii.initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
    if (vkCreateImage(g_dev, &ii, NULL, &s->img) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        s->img = NULL; g_d_fail++;
        vk_boot_logf("[h-red] rt depth slot vkCreateImage key=%#llx %ux%u fmt=%#x failed",
                     (unsigned long long)key, (unsigned)rw, (unsigned)rh, (unsigned)fmt);
        return -2;
    }
    VkMemoryRequirements rq;
    vkGetImageMemoryRequirements(g_dev, s->img, &rq);
    int ti = find_type(rq, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT);
    VkMemoryAllocateInfo ai = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO };
    ai.allocationSize = rq.size;
    ai.memoryTypeIndex = ti >= 0 ? (uint32_t)ti : 0;
    if (vkAllocateMemory(g_dev, &ai, NULL, &s->mem) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        g_m40p_dst++; vkDestroyImage(g_dev, s->img, NULL); s->img = NULL; s->mem = NULL; g_d_fail++;
        vk_boot_logf("[h-red] rt depth slot vkAllocateMemory(%llu) failed", (unsigned long long)rq.size);
        return -3;
    }
    vkBindImageMemory(g_dev, s->img, s->mem, 0);
    VkImageViewCreateInfo vi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO };
    vi.image = s->img; vi.viewType = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D; vi.format = vf;
    vi.components = (VkComponentMapping){ VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_IDENTITY, VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_IDENTITY,
                                          VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_IDENTITY, VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_IDENTITY };
    vi.subresourceRange = (VkImageSubresourceRange){ VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_DEPTH_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1 };
    if (vkCreateImageView(g_dev, &vi, NULL, &s->view) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        g_m40p_dst++; vkDestroyImage(g_dev, s->img, NULL); vkFreeMemory(g_dev, s->mem, NULL);
        s->img = NULL; s->mem = NULL; s->view = NULL; g_d_fail++;
        vk_boot_logf("[h-red] rt depth slot vkCreateImageView key=%#llx failed", (unsigned long long)key);
        return -4;
    }
    s->key = key; s->w = rw; s->h = rh; s->fmt = fmt; s->tex_id = tex_id;
    s->vf = vf; s->layout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED; s->fb_do = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    s->last_use = ++g_rt_use_seq; g_d_last = s;
    /* M4r P1：该槽曾被当深度附件挂到某个颜色槽上时，旧 fb 指向已销毁的 view ⇒ 全部作废 */
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)(sizeof g_rt_tab / sizeof *g_rt_tab); i++)
        if (g_rt_tab[i].ds == s) { g_rt_tab[i].ds = NULL; g_rt_tab[i].fb_load_d = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
                                   g_rt_tab[i].fb_d_view = VK_NULL_HANDLE; }
    g_d_slots++;
    vk_boot_logf("[h] rt depth slot #%lld key=%#llx img=%#llx view=%#llx id=%d ext=%ux%u fmt=0x%x nvn=%#x bytes=%llu",
                 (long long)(s - g_d_tab), (unsigned long long)key, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)s->img,
                 (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)s->view, tex_id, (unsigned)rw, (unsigned)rh,
                 (unsigned)vf, fmt, (unsigned long long)rq.size);
    return 0;
}

void nvn_vk_rt_depth_stats(unsigned long long *binds, unsigned long long *slots,
                           unsigned long long *fail, unsigned long long *badfmt)
{
    if (binds) *binds = g_d_binds;
    if (slots) *slots = g_d_slots;
    if (fail) *fail = g_d_fail;
    if (badfmt) *badfmt = g_d_badfmt;
}

/* M6e 段 2 优化①：RT 绑定 CB 的在飞环。
   为什么安全：本 CB 只含「布局 barrier + viewport/scissor」，不含任何像素工作；队列是 FIFO，
   提交序就保证了 barrier 落在后续 draw 批次之前 —— **只有宿主真要读这张图时才必须等**。
   旧代码在每次目标切换处 `vkWaitForFences(UINT64_MAX)`，等于每帧几十次把流水线排干。
   现在：提交即返回，CB 由自己的 fence 守护，在后续 flush 里非阻塞回收（环满才等最老的一个）。 */
#define PF_RT_RING 8
static struct { VkCommandBuffer cb; VkFence fence; int live; } g_pf_rtring[PF_RT_RING];
static int g_pf_rtring_ri;
static void pf_rtring_reap(void)
{
    for (int i = 0; i < PF_RT_RING; i++) {
        if (!g_pf_rtring[i].live) continue;
        if (vkGetFenceStatus(g_dev, g_pf_rtring[i].fence) != VK_SUCCESS) continue;
        vkFreeCommandBuffers(g_dev, g_h_cp, 1, &g_pf_rtring[i].cb);
        g_pf_rtring[i].live = 0; g_pf_rtring[i].cb = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    }
}
/* M6e：把在飞环排干（销毁/切后端前调用；保持「等干净再放行」的旧语义）。 */
void nvn_vk_perf_rt_drain(void)
{
    if (!g_dev) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < PF_RT_RING; i++) {
        if (!g_pf_rtring[i].live) continue;
        nvk_wait_fences(g_dev, 1, &g_pf_rtring[i].fence, VK_TRUE, UINT64_MAX);
        vkFreeCommandBuffers(g_dev, g_h_cp, 1, &g_pf_rtring[i].cb);
        g_pf_rtring[i].live = 0; g_pf_rtring[i].cb = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    }
}

int nvn_vk_rt_flush(void)
{
    /* M25A：合并窗口里若已有「已录未提交」的 draw，先把它真收口 —— 否则 RT 的 barrier CB 会排到
       这些 draw 之前（布局转换提前）。收口之后本函数照常提交，顺序与关态一致（关态恒不触发）。 */
    if ((m25a_c1() || m25a_c2()) && g_m25a_pending) {
        g_m25a_pending = 0;
        nvn_vk_draw_flush();
    }
    if (!g_h_rt_open) return 1;                       /* 无待提交内容 */    VkCommandBuffer cb = g_h_rt_cb;
    g_h_rt_open = 0;
    g_h_rt_cb = NULL;
    vkEndCommandBuffer(cb);
    VkSubmitInfo si = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO };
    si.commandBufferCount = 1;
    si.pCommandBuffers = &cb;
    VkResult rv = VK_ERROR_INITIALIZATION_FAILED;
    unsigned long long pf_t0 = pf_now_us();                 /* M6e：submit/等待分段记账 */
    if (pf_opt_rt_async()) {
        pf_rtring_reap();
        int sl = g_pf_rtring_ri; g_pf_rtring_ri = (g_pf_rtring_ri + 1) % PF_RT_RING;
        if (g_pf_rtring[sl].live) {                 /* 环满：只等最老的那一个（有界） */
            unsigned long long w0 = pf_now_us();
            nvk_wait_fences(g_dev, 1, &g_pf_rtring[sl].fence, VK_TRUE, UINT64_MAX);
            pf_dt(&g_pf_rt_wait, w0);
            vkFreeCommandBuffers(g_dev, g_h_cp, 1, &g_pf_rtring[sl].cb);
            g_pf_rtring[sl].live = 0; g_pf_rtring[sl].cb = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        }
        if (!g_pf_rtring[sl].fence) {
            VkFenceCreateInfo fci = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_FENCE_CREATE_INFO };
            if (vkCreateFence(g_dev, &fci, NULL, &g_pf_rtring[sl].fence) != VK_SUCCESS)
                g_pf_rtring[sl].fence = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
        }
        if (g_pf_rtring[sl].fence) {
            vkResetFences(g_dev, 1, &g_pf_rtring[sl].fence);
            rv = vkQueueSubmit(g_q, 1, &si, g_pf_rtring[sl].fence);
            if (rv == VK_SUCCESS) { g_pf_rtring[sl].cb = cb; g_pf_rtring[sl].live = 1; }
        }
    } else {
        vkResetFences(g_dev, 1, &g_h_fence);
        rv = vkQueueSubmit(g_q, 1, &si, g_h_fence);
    }
    pf_dt(&g_pf_rt_submit, pf_t0);
    if (rv == VK_SUCCESS) {
        if (!pf_opt_rt_async()) {
            pf_t0 = pf_now_us();
            nvk_wait_fences(g_dev, 1, &g_h_fence, VK_TRUE, UINT64_MAX);
            pf_dt(&g_pf_rt_wait, pf_t0);
        }
        g_h_rt_flush_ok++;
        if (g_h_rt_flush_ok == 1)
            vk_boot_logf("[h] rt flush #1 rv=0 img=%#llx async=%d", (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)g_h_img, pf_opt_rt_async());
    } else {
        g_h_rt_flush_fail++;
        g_h_rt_fail++;
        NVK_RED("rt bind submit = %{public}d (%{public}s)", (int)rv, vr(rv));
        vk_boot_logf("[h-red] rt flush rv=%d", (int)rv);
        g_h_layout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
    }
    /* 同步路径：提交完就等过了 ⇒ 立刻可回收。异步路径：CB 由环里的 fence 守护，这里不碰。 */
    if (rv != VK_SUCCESS || !pf_opt_rt_async()) vkFreeCommandBuffers(g_dev, g_h_cp, 1, &cb);
    /* M7g P3（只读）：本批刚提交完 ⇒ 立刻回读世界 claim 图（低频、有预算）；把「没产生片元」
       与「产生了但之后被抹掉」分开。提交顺序在本批之后（同一队列），不影响本批内容。 */
    if (rv == VK_SUCCESS) m7g_post_rb();
    return (rv == VK_SUCCESS) ? 0 : -5;
}

/* ---------------- M4e（2026-11-03）route②：源图替换的采样侧 ----------------
   语义：某笔 draw 绑的纹理 id 若能对上「我们画过的 RT」，就把采样源换成我们自己的图
   （游戏池里那张恒为 0，M4d 证据 up sig diff=0/1440000），其它情况一律走原路径。
   边界（P1）：
     · 只有 id 确切相等才替换（id 来自 SET_RENDER_TARGETS 的侧表反查/探针，未知则 tex_id<0 不参与）；
     · 若命中的 RT **正是本笔 draw 的渲染目标**，同一张图不能既作附件又被采样（反馈环，UB 且
       驱动可崩）⇒ 先 vkCmdCopyImage 到影子图，再采样影子（内容 = 该 RT 当前像素）；
     · 影子副本按 200ms / 600 次节流（上限内不复制的帧继续采旧影子，内容只会更旧，不会更错）；
     · 不改回读、不改上屏、不动游戏池内存。 */
static int rt_shadow_ensure(h_rt_slot *s)
{
    if (s->s_img) return 1;
    VkImageCreateInfo ii = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_CREATE_INFO };
    ii.imageType = VK_IMAGE_TYPE_2D;
    ii.format = VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
    ii.extent = (VkExtent3D){ s->w, s->h, 1 };
    ii.mipLevels = 1; ii.arrayLayers = 1;
    ii.samples = VK_SAMPLE_COUNT_1_BIT;
    ii.tiling = VK_IMAGE_TILING_OPTIMAL;
    ii.usage = VK_IMAGE_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT | VK_IMAGE_USAGE_SAMPLED_BIT;
    ii.sharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE;
    ii.initialLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
    if (vkCreateImage(g_dev, &ii, NULL, &s->s_img) != VK_SUCCESS) { s->s_img = NULL; return 0; }
    VkMemoryRequirements rq;
    vkGetImageMemoryRequirements(g_dev, s->s_img, &rq);
    int ti = find_type(rq, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT);
    VkMemoryAllocateInfo ai = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO };
    ai.allocationSize = rq.size;
    ai.memoryTypeIndex = ti >= 0 ? (uint32_t)ti : 0;
    if (vkAllocateMemory(g_dev, &ai, NULL, &s->s_mem) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        vkDestroyImage(g_dev, s->s_img, NULL); s->s_img = NULL; s->s_mem = NULL; return 0;
    }
    vkBindImageMemory(g_dev, s->s_img, s->s_mem, 0);
    VkImageViewCreateInfo vi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_VIEW_CREATE_INFO };
    vi.image = s->s_img; vi.viewType = VK_IMAGE_VIEW_TYPE_2D; vi.format = VK_FORMAT_R8G8B8A8_UNORM;
    vi.components = (VkComponentMapping){ VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_IDENTITY, VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_IDENTITY,
                                          VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_IDENTITY, VK_COMPONENT_SWIZZLE_IDENTITY };
    vi.subresourceRange = (VkImageSubresourceRange){ VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1 };
    if (vkCreateImageView(g_dev, &vi, NULL, &s->s_view) != VK_SUCCESS) {
        vkDestroyImage(g_dev, s->s_img, NULL); vkFreeMemory(g_dev, s->s_mem, NULL);
        s->s_img = NULL; s->s_mem = NULL; s->s_view = NULL; return 0;
    }
    s->s_layout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED;
    vk_boot_logf("[t] rt shadow img=%#llx view=%#llx ext=%ux%u bytes=%llu",
                 (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)s->s_img, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)s->s_view,
                 (unsigned)s->w, (unsigned)s->h, (unsigned long long)rq.size);
    return 1;
}

/* 一次 submit 内完成：RT(旧布局→TRANSFER_SRC) → copy → RT(→CAO) + 影子(→SHADER_READ_ONLY)。
   copy=0 时只做「转成可采样布局」（非当前目标的那条路）。返回 1 成功。 */
static int rt_xfer_run(h_rt_slot *s, int do_copy)
{
    VkCommandBuffer cb = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo ca = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO };
    ca.commandPool = g_h_cp; ca.level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY; ca.commandBufferCount = 1;
    if (vkAllocateCommandBuffers(g_dev, &ca, &cb) != VK_SUCCESS) return 0;
    VkCommandBufferBeginInfo cbi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO };
    cbi.flags = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT;
    vkBeginCommandBuffer(cb, &cbi);
    VkImageSubresourceRange rng = { VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1 };
    int is_cur = (s == g_rt_cur);
    VkImageLayout old = is_cur ? g_h_layout : s->layout;
    /* M36A（2026-11-09）：账上 UNDEFINED 的图，旧行为把屏障的 oldLayout 谎报成 CAO（Vulkan 要求
       oldLayout 与实际布局一致；UNDEFINED 时正确做法就是写 UNDEFINED，内容本来就作废）。
       smo_m36a_fix=1 才改（缺省 0 ⇒ 与旧行为逐字相同）。 */
    if (old == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_UNDEFINED && !m36a_fix_on()) old = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL;
    VkImageLayout dst = do_copy ? VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL : VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL;
    VkImageMemoryBarrier b = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER };
    b.srcAccessMask = (old == VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL)
                      ? VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT : 0;
    b.dstAccessMask = do_copy ? VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT : VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT;
    b.oldLayout = old; b.newLayout = dst;
    b.srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED; b.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
    b.image = s->img; b.subresourceRange = rng;
    beat_cmd();
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT,
                         do_copy ? VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT : VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT,
                         0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &b);
    if (do_copy) {
        VkImageMemoryBarrier sb = b;
        sb.srcAccessMask = 0; sb.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT;
        sb.oldLayout = s->s_layout; sb.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL;
        sb.image = s->s_img;
        beat_cmd();
        vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_ALL_COMMANDS_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT,
                             0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &sb);
        VkImageCopy cp = {0};
        cp.srcSubresource = (VkImageSubresourceLayers){ VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1 };
        cp.dstSubresource = cp.srcSubresource;
        cp.extent = (VkExtent3D){ s->w, s->h, 1 };
        beat_cmd();
        vkCmdCopyImage(cb, s->img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL,
                       s->s_img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL, 1, &cp);
        VkImageMemoryBarrier rb2 = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER };
        rb2.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT;
        rb2.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_READ_BIT | VK_ACCESS_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_WRITE_BIT;
        rb2.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL;
        rb2.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL;
        rb2.srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED; rb2.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
        rb2.image = s->img; rb2.subresourceRange = rng;
        beat_cmd();
        vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT,
                             0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &rb2);
        VkImageMemoryBarrier sb2 = sb;
        sb2.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_WRITE_BIT; sb2.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT;
        sb2.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_DST_OPTIMAL;
        sb2.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL;
        beat_cmd();
        vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT,
                             0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &sb2);
    }
    vkEndCommandBuffer(cb);
    VkSubmitInfo si = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO };
    si.commandBufferCount = 1; si.pCommandBuffers = &cb;
    vkResetFences(g_dev, 1, &g_h_fence);
    VkResult rv = vkQueueSubmit(g_q, 1, &si, g_h_fence);
    if (rv == VK_SUCCESS) nvk_wait_fences(g_dev, 1, &g_h_fence, VK_TRUE, UINT64_MAX);
    vkFreeCommandBuffers(g_dev, g_h_cp, 1, &cb);
    if (rv != VK_SUCCESS) return 0;
    if (do_copy) { s->layout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OPTIMAL; s->s_layout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL; }
    else { s->layout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL; }
    if (is_cur) g_h_layout = s->layout;   /* 当前目标的布局记账跟着走（copy 完已回到 CAO） */
    return 1;
}

/* 取证：影子图内容直方图（前 3 次副本 + 回读时刻各一次）。回答「替换命中了，但采到的到底是什么」：
   distinct=1 且 top 是黑/白 ⇒ 采样源本身均匀（RT 那一步就没内容），不是绑定/描述符的问题。
   只读影子图（SRO → TRANSFER_SRC → 回 SRO），不改任何渲染状态。 */
static int g_rt_sh_probe_n;
static void rt_shadow_probe(const char *tag, h_rt_slot *s)
{
    if (!s || !s->s_img) return;
    const VkDeviceSize sz = (VkDeviceSize)s->w * s->h * 4;
    VkBuffer buf = VK_NULL_HANDLE; VkDeviceMemory mem = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkBufferCreateInfo bi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_BUFFER_CREATE_INFO };
    bi.size = sz; bi.usage = VK_BUFFER_USAGE_TRANSFER_DST_BIT; bi.sharingMode = VK_SHARING_MODE_EXCLUSIVE;
    if (vkCreateBuffer(g_dev, &bi, NULL, &buf) != VK_SUCCESS) return;
    VkMemoryRequirements rq; vkGetBufferMemoryRequirements(g_dev, buf, &rq);
    int ti = find_type(rq, VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_VISIBLE_BIT | VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_HOST_COHERENT_BIT);
    VkMemoryAllocateInfo ai = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_MEMORY_ALLOCATE_INFO };
    ai.allocationSize = rq.size; ai.memoryTypeIndex = ti >= 0 ? (uint32_t)ti : 0;
    if (vkAllocateMemory(g_dev, &ai, NULL, &mem) != VK_SUCCESS) { vkDestroyBuffer(g_dev, buf, NULL); return; }
    vkBindBufferMemory(g_dev, buf, mem, 0);
    VkCommandBuffer cb = VK_NULL_HANDLE;
    VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo ca = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO };
    ca.commandPool = g_h_cp; ca.level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY; ca.commandBufferCount = 1;
    VkResult rv = vkAllocateCommandBuffers(g_dev, &ca, &cb);
    if (rv != VK_SUCCESS) { vkDestroyBuffer(g_dev, buf, NULL); vkFreeMemory(g_dev, mem, NULL); return; }
    VkCommandBufferBeginInfo cbi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO };
    cbi.flags = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT;
    vkBeginCommandBuffer(cb, &cbi);
    VkImageSubresourceRange rng = { VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 1, 0, 1 };
    VkImageMemoryBarrier b = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_IMAGE_MEMORY_BARRIER };
    b.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT; b.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT;
    b.oldLayout = s->s_layout; b.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL;
    b.srcQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED; b.dstQueueFamilyIndex = VK_QUEUE_FAMILY_IGNORED;
    b.image = s->s_img; b.subresourceRange = rng;
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT,
                         0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &b);
    VkBufferImageCopy reg = {0};
    reg.imageSubresource = (VkImageSubresourceLayers){ VK_IMAGE_ASPECT_COLOR_BIT, 0, 0, 1 };
    reg.imageExtent = (VkExtent3D){ s->w, s->h, 1 };
    vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer(cb, s->s_img, VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL, buf, 1, &reg);
    VkImageMemoryBarrier b2 = b;
    b2.srcAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_TRANSFER_READ_BIT; b2.dstAccessMask = VK_ACCESS_SHADER_READ_BIT;
    b2.oldLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL; b2.newLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL;
    vkCmdPipelineBarrier(cb, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_TRANSFER_BIT, VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_FRAGMENT_SHADER_BIT,
                         0, 0, NULL, 0, NULL, 1, &b2);
    vkEndCommandBuffer(cb);
    VkSubmitInfo si = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO };
    si.commandBufferCount = 1; si.pCommandBuffers = &cb;
    vkResetFences(g_dev, 1, &g_h_fence);
    rv = vkQueueSubmit(g_q, 1, &si, g_h_fence);
    if (rv == VK_SUCCESS) nvk_wait_fences(g_dev, 1, &g_h_fence, VK_TRUE, UINT64_MAX);
    vkFreeCommandBuffers(g_dev, g_h_cp, 1, &cb);
    void *map = NULL;
    if (rv == VK_SUCCESS && vkMapMemory(g_dev, mem, 0, VK_WHOLE_SIZE, 0, &map) == VK_SUCCESS && map) {
        const uint32_t *p = (const uint32_t *)map;
        size_t npx = (size_t)s->w * s->h;
        enum { HS = 1024 }; static uint32_t hk[HS]; static uint32_t hn[HS]; static unsigned char hu[HS];
        memset(hu, 0, sizeof hu);
        unsigned distinct = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < npx; i++) {
            uint32_t k = p[i] & 0xFFFFFFFFu;
            if (hu[k & (HS - 1)] && hk[k & (HS - 1)] != k) continue;   /* 粗哈希，只作上界估计 */
            if (!hu[k & (HS - 1)]) distinct++;
            hu[k & (HS - 1)] = 1; hk[k & (HS - 1)] = k; hn[k & (HS - 1)]++;
        }
        for (int r = 0; r < 3; r++) {
            int best = -1; uint32_t bv = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < HS; i++) if (hu[i] && hn[i] > bv) { bv = hn[i]; best = i; }
            if (best < 0) break;
            uint32_t k = hk[best];
            vk_boot_logf("[t] sh hist tag=%s #%d rgba=(%u,%u,%u,%u) n=%u (%.3f%%)",
                         tag, r + 1, k & 0xff, (k >> 8) & 0xff, (k >> 16) & 0xff, (k >> 24) & 0xff,
                         hn[best], 100.0 * (double)hn[best] / (double)npx);
            hn[best] = 0;
        }
        vk_boot_logf("[t] sh hist tag=%s distinct_approx=%u ext=%ux%u", tag, distinct, (unsigned)s->w, (unsigned)s->h);
        vkUnmapMemory(g_dev, mem);
    }
    vkDestroyBuffer(g_dev, buf, NULL); vkFreeMemory(g_dev, mem, NULL);
}

/* M4e：该 view 是否是我们自己的 RT 图/影子图（描述符落地取证）。 */
int nvn_vk_view_is_rt(void *view)
{
    VkImageView v = (VkImageView)view;
    if (!v) return 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)(sizeof g_rt_tab / sizeof *g_rt_tab); i++)
        if (g_rt_tab[i].key && (v == g_rt_tab[i].view || v == g_rt_tab[i].s_view)) return 1;
    return 0;
}

unsigned long long nvn_vk_rt_ds_writes(void) { return g_r_ds_rt_writes; }

void nvn_vk_rt_shadow_probe_cur(const char *tag)
{
    if (g_rt_cur && g_rt_cur->s_img) rt_shadow_probe(tag, g_rt_cur);
}

int nvn_vk_rt_tex_kind(int tex_id){
    if (tex_id < 0) return 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)(sizeof g_rt_tab / sizeof *g_rt_tab); i++) {
        if (g_rt_tab[i].key && g_rt_tab[i].tex_id == tex_id)
            return (&g_rt_tab[i] == g_rt_cur) ? 1 : 2;
    }
    { int s = -1; if (rt_alias_get(tex_id, &s)) return (&g_rt_tab[s] == g_rt_cur) ? 1 : 2; }  /* M6a A */
    return 0;
}
/* M6a A：零内容被采样纹理的身份解析。命中就**登记**别名（只写映射，不改渲染状态）。
   判据顺序：① 已有 id 链接（含别名）② store 精确（同一池地址，尺寸/格式守卫）③ 唯一 ext+fmt 候选。
   ③ 只在 allow_extfmt=1（调用方已确认这张 id 上送内容首 4 KiB 全零）时启用，且候选必须唯一。 */
int nvn_vk_rt_tex_kind_zero(int id, unsigned w, unsigned h, int fmt, unsigned long long store,
                            int allow_extfmt, int *src, int *cand_slot, int *cand_texid,
                            int *cand_img, int *cand_n)
{
    if (src) *src = 0;
    if (cand_slot) *cand_slot = -1;
    if (cand_texid) *cand_texid = -1;
    if (cand_img) *cand_img = 0;
    if (cand_n) *cand_n = 0;
    if (id < 0) return 0;
    const int ns = (int)(sizeof g_rt_tab / sizeof *g_rt_tab);
    int k = nvn_vk_rt_tex_kind(id);
    if (k) {
        int s = -1;
        if (rt_alias_get(id, &s)) {
            if (cand_slot) *cand_slot = s;
            if (cand_texid) *cand_texid = g_rt_tab[s].tex_id;
            if (cand_img) *cand_img = g_rt_tab[s].img ? 1 : 0;
        }
        if (src) *src = 1;
        return k;
    }
    /* ② store 精确：同一块池存储就是同一张图。尺寸/格式必须自洽（同 M4w 守卫）。
       M35A：÷2 分辨率账 —— 槽 ext 是光栅口径（guest÷SMO_RT_DIV），采样 ext 是 guest 真值，
       同一 store 上必然差 ÷2。开态（smo_m35a=1）在精确档之后补扫 h_rs_match 档（÷2），
       并优先精确档（避免半尺寸槽遮住同 store 的全尺寸槽）；关态与旧行为逐字一致。 */
    if (store) {
        int pick2 = -1, pick2_div = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < ns; i++) {
            h_rt_slot *s = &g_rt_tab[i];
            if (!s->key || s->key != store || !s->img) continue;
            int dv = 0;
            if (w && (s->w != w || s->h != h)) {
                if (!(m35a_on() && h_rs_match(s->w, s->h, w, h))) continue;
                dv = 1;                                  /* M35A：靠 ÷2 口径才对上 */
            }
            if (fmt > 0 && s->fmt > 0 && (int)s->fmt != fmt) continue;
            if (!dv) { pick2 = i; pick2_div = 0; break; }   /* 精确档：立即采纳（旧行为） */
            if (pick2 < 0) { pick2 = i; pick2_div = 1; }    /* ÷2 档：先记下，等精确档扫完 */
        }
        if (pick2 >= 0) {
            h_rt_slot *s = &g_rt_tab[pick2];
            if (pick2_div) g_m35a_store_div2++;
            g_m35a_store_hit++;
            rt_alias_put(id, pick2);
            g_rt_zero_links++;
            if (cand_slot) *cand_slot = pick2;
            if (cand_texid) *cand_texid = s->tex_id;
            if (cand_img) *cand_img = 1;
            if (src) *src = 2;
            return (s == g_rt_cur) ? 1 : 2;
        }
    }
    /* ③ 唯一 ext+fmt 候选（仅零内容）。多个候选 ⇒ 不猜，计数后放弃（宁可留黑，不顶替）。
       M6a a 实测教训：这里**必须要求 fmt 精确相等**。fmt==0 的槽是「格式未知」（M4q 之前
       用 texid=1930 那批对象指针 key 的槽），把它们算成候选会让每个 1600x900 查询都变成
       7 个候选 ⇒ 唯一性永远不成立（boot a: zero_multi=17437、bound 只有 18）。
       拿一个「格式未知」的槽当同一张图就是拿别的图顶替，明确禁止。 */
    if (allow_extfmt && w && h && fmt > 0) {
        int nc = 0, bi = -1, wi = -1, nw = 0, bi_div = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < ns; i++) {
            h_rt_slot *s = &g_rt_tab[i];
            if (!s->key || !s->img) continue;
            /* M35A：同形判据在开态按光栅口径（÷2）。关态仍是精确相等 ⇒ 旧行为逐字不变。
               "÷2 也算同形"会让候选数变大，唯一性不足时下面照旧拒绑（宁可留黑不顶替）。 */
            int dv = 0;
            if (s->w != w || s->h != h) {
                if (!(m35a_on() && h_rs_match(s->w, s->h, w, h))) continue;
                dv = 1;
            }
            if ((int)s->fmt != fmt) continue;            /* M6a a→b：fmt 必须精确相等 */
            nc++;
            if (bi < 0) { bi = i; bi_div = dv; }
            /* M6b B：顺序证据 —— 本 submit 内真被 draw 写过的候选（g_slot_dw，submit 边界清零）。 */
            if (g_slot_dw[i]) { nw++; if (nw == 1) wi = i; }
        }
        if (cand_n) *cand_n = nc;
        if (nc == 1) {
            /* M38C A（2026-11-09，唯一行为改动）：弱身份守卫。
               M36A/M37A 的结构性事实：这条 extfmt 路 35/35、42/42 命中全是 `store≠slot_key`
               ⇒ 我们拿「形状相同的另一块 guest 存储的槽」去顶替采到的黑图；slot#32 上表现为
               1939/3239 两块存储轮流顶替。守卫语义：store 已知时，只有「RT 表里已有同 store 的槽」
               才算同一张图（身份自洽），否则**只计数不绑**（返回 0，调用方回退原图/占位，宁可留黑）。
               关态（smo_m38c=0）整段不执行 ⇒ 与旧行为逐字相同。 */
            if (m38c_on() && store) {
                int sib = -1, sibtx = -1;
                if (!nvn_vk_rt_store_sibling(store, &sib, &sibtx)) {
                    g_m38c_ext_deny++;
                    m38c_note("deny", 0, id, store, w, h, fmt, nc, bi);
                    /* 只把「本来会绑的槽」报给调用方做日志，不建别名、不改任何渲染状态。 */
                    if (cand_slot) *cand_slot = bi;
                    if (cand_texid) *cand_texid = g_rt_tab[bi].tex_id;
                    if (cand_img) *cand_img = 1;
                    return 0;
                }
                g_m38c_ext_hit++;
                m38c_note("hit", 0, id, store, w, h, fmt, nc, bi);
            } else if (m38c_on()) {
                g_m38c_ext_store0++;   /* store 未知：无法验身份 ⇒ 保持旧行为（允许按形状绑定） */
            }
            if (bi_div) g_m35a_extfmt_div2++;
            g_m35a_extfmt_hit++;
            rt_alias_put(id, bi);
            g_rt_zero_extfmt++;
            if (cand_slot) *cand_slot = bi;
            if (cand_texid) *cand_texid = g_rt_tab[bi].tex_id;
            if (cand_img) *cand_img = 1;
            if (src) *src = 3;
            return (&g_rt_tab[bi] == g_rt_cur) ? 1 : 2;
        }
        /* M6b B：多个同 ext+fmt 候选时，**只按顺序证据**消歧：本 submit 里恰好只有一个候选
           被前面的 pass 写过（g_slot_dw>0）才认它。0 个或多个 ⇒ 仍然拒绑（不按形状猜）。
           这就是任务要的「该次采样之前最后一个把那槽写成渲染目标的 pass」。 */
        if (RT_ORDER_ACCEPT && nc > 1 && nw == 1) {
            /* M38C A：order 路也是「按形状（顺序）顶替」，同一道弱身份守卫。 */
            if (m38c_on() && store) {
                int sib = -1, sibtx = -1;
                if (!nvn_vk_rt_store_sibling(store, &sib, &sibtx)) {
                    g_m38c_ord_deny++;
                    m38c_note("deny", 1, id, store, w, h, fmt, nc, wi);
                    if (cand_slot) *cand_slot = wi;
                    if (cand_texid) *cand_texid = g_rt_tab[wi].tex_id;
                    if (cand_img) *cand_img = 1;
                    return 0;
                }
                g_m38c_ord_hit++;
                m38c_note("hit", 1, id, store, w, h, fmt, nc, wi);
            }
            rt_alias_put(id, wi);
            g_rt_zero_order++;
            if (cand_slot) *cand_slot = wi;
            if (cand_texid) *cand_texid = g_rt_tab[wi].tex_id;
            if (cand_img) *cand_img = 1;
            if (src) *src = 4;
            return (&g_rt_tab[wi] == g_rt_cur) ? 1 : 2;
        }
        if (nc > 1) g_rt_zero_multi++;
        if (cand_slot && nc > 0) *cand_slot = bi;
        if (cand_texid && bi >= 0) *cand_texid = g_rt_tab[bi].tex_id;
        if (cand_img) *cand_img = (bi >= 0 && g_rt_tab[bi].img) ? 1 : 0;
    }
    return 0;
}

static void *rt_sample_prepare_slot(h_rt_slot *s, int *why)
{
    if (!s) { if (why) *why = -3; return NULL; }
    if (s == g_rt_cur) {
        if (!rt_shadow_ensure(s)) { if (why) *why = -4; return NULL; }
        if (g_rt_sh_copy_ok >= RT_SHADOW_MAX) { g_rt_sh_throttle++; return s->s_view; }   /* 达上限：采旧影子 */
        static unsigned long long last_us;
        struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
        unsigned long long now = (unsigned long long)ts.tv_sec * 1000000ull + (unsigned long long)ts.tv_nsec / 1000ull;
        if (last_us && now - last_us < RT_SHADOW_MIN_US) { g_rt_sh_throttle++; return s->s_view; }
        if (!rt_xfer_run(s, 1)) { g_rt_sh_copy_fail++; if (why) *why = -5; return s->s_view ? s->s_view : NULL; }
        last_us = now;
        g_rt_sh_copy_ok++;
        if (g_rt_sh_probe_n < 3) { g_rt_sh_probe_n++; rt_shadow_probe("copy", s); }   /* M4e 取证：前 3 次副本的内容 */
        return s->s_view;
    }
    if (s->layout != VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_SHADER_READ_ONLY_OPTIMAL) {
        if (!rt_xfer_run(s, 0)) { g_rt_sh_direct_fail++; if (why) *why = -6; return NULL; }
    }
    g_rt_sh_direct++;
    return s->view;
}

void *nvn_vk_rt_sample_prepare(int tex_id, int *why)
{
    if (why) *why = 0;
    if (tex_id < 0) { if (why) *why = -1; return NULL; }
    if (!g_on || !g_dev || !g_q) { if (why) *why = -2; return NULL; }
    h_rt_slot *s = NULL;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)(sizeof g_rt_tab / sizeof *g_rt_tab); i++)
        if (g_rt_tab[i].key && g_rt_tab[i].tex_id == tex_id) { s = &g_rt_tab[i]; break; }
    if (!s) { int a = -1; if (rt_alias_get(tex_id, &a)) s = &g_rt_tab[a]; }   /* M6a A：many-to-one 别名 */
    return rt_sample_prepare_slot(s, why);
}

/* M4w P1：store 版（绑定期反查用）。id 可能压根没有（-1），但池地址一定有。 */
void *nvn_vk_rt_sample_prepare_store(unsigned long long store, int *why)
{
    if (why) *why = 0;
    if (!store) { if (why) *why = -1; return NULL; }
    if (!g_on || !g_dev || !g_q) { if (why) *why = -2; return NULL; }
    h_rt_slot *s = NULL;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)(sizeof g_rt_tab / sizeof *g_rt_tab); i++)
        if (g_rt_tab[i].key == store && g_rt_tab[i].img) { s = &g_rt_tab[i]; break; }
    return rt_sample_prepare_slot(s, why);
}

void nvn_vk_rt_repl_stats(unsigned long long *copy_ok, unsigned long long *copy_fail,
                          unsigned long long *throttle, unsigned long long *direct,
                          unsigned long long *direct_fail)
{
    if (copy_ok) *copy_ok = g_rt_sh_copy_ok;
    if (copy_fail) *copy_fail = g_rt_sh_copy_fail;
    if (throttle) *throttle = g_rt_sh_throttle;
    if (direct) *direct = g_rt_sh_direct;
    if (direct_fail) *direct_fail = g_rt_sh_direct_fail;
}

/* 取证：宿主侧计数（绑定/批次/提交成功失败），报告行直接引用，不重复写日志。 */
void nvn_vk_rt_targets(int *slots, unsigned long long *fallback, unsigned long long *switches)
{
    int n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)(sizeof g_rt_tab / sizeof *g_rt_tab); i++) if (g_rt_tab[i].key) n++;
    if (slots) *slots = n;
    if (fallback) *fallback = g_h_rt_fallback;
    if (switches) *switches = g_h_rt_switch;
}

void nvn_vk_rt_stats(unsigned long long *binds, unsigned long long *nonempty,
                     unsigned long long *flush_ok, unsigned long long *flush_fail)
{
    if (binds) *binds = g_h_rt_binds;
    if (nonempty) *nonempty = g_h_rt_nonempty;
    if (flush_ok) *flush_ok = g_h_rt_flush_ok;
    if (flush_fail) *flush_fail = g_h_rt_flush_fail + g_h_rt_fail;
}

/* M4ar P1/P2：最近一次 RT 绑定的口径 + 名义槽计数。 */
void nvn_vk_rt_last_bind(int *n, unsigned *w, unsigned *h, int *fallback)
{
    if (n) *n = g_h_rt_last_n;
    if (w) *w = g_h_rt_last_w;
    if (h) *h = g_h_rt_last_h;
    if (fallback) *fallback = g_h_rt_last_fb;
}

unsigned long long nvn_vk_rt_nominal(void) { return g_h_rt_nominal; }

// ---------------- 出图冒烟 | present smoke（出处 mtl_present 骨架 :2498-2652，只清色不 blit） ----------------
void *nvn_vk_native_window(void) { return g_win; }

/* Display thread — CPU present fallback.
   Native window calls must NOT happen on a guest thread (filling from the NVN submit path killed the process within a
   second), so the fill lives on its own host thread started from nvn_vk_set_native_window (the NAPI thread). It only
   touches the window; it never reads or writes emulator state, so it cannot perturb the guest. */
static void *win_fill_thread(void *unused)
{
    (void)unused;
    __attribute__((weak)) int nvn_win_fill(void *, unsigned, unsigned, unsigned);
    if (!nvn_win_fill) return NULL;
    unsigned ph = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 1000000; i++) {
        void *w = g_win;
        if (!w) break;                       /* surface destroyed */
        unsigned r = ph == 0 ? 0x20 : 0xE0, g = ph == 1 ? 0x40 : 0x60, b = ph == 2 ? 0xC0 : 0x30;
        static int reported;
        int ok = nvn_win_fill(w, r, g, b);
        if (!reported) { reported = 1; NVK("[vk] win-fill thread: first fill -> %{public}s", ok ? "ok" : "refused (no buffer)"); }
        ph = (ph + 1) & 3;
        usleep(33000);                       /* ~30 fps */
    }
    return NULL;
}
static void win_fill_start(void)
{
    static int started;
    if (started) return;
    started = 1;
    pthread_t t;
    if (pthread_create(&t, NULL, win_fill_thread, NULL)) { NVK_RED("win-fill thread create failed"); return; }
    pthread_detach(t);
}   /* CPU present 回落用：拿 XComponent 窗口句柄 */

/* ---------------- M7d (2026-11-07)：真机 present 探针 + 三实验开关（全部默认 0，只做验证、不改默认行为） ----------------
   背景（P0 读料结论）：真机 Maleoon 935 有 VK_OHOS_native_buffer，present_clear 冒烟清色路径每帧都
   成功 ⇒ present_offscreen（真图路径）从不运行，屏幕只有 gfx_bridge 每 16 帧交替的清色
   (200,90,40)/(26,90,180)；且若 swapchain 格式是 BGRA，VkClearColorValue.float32 按格式的分量序
   (B,G,R,A) 解释 ⇒ R/B 互换：橙(200,90,40) 显成蓝(40,90,200)、蓝(26,90,180) 显成橙红(180,90,26)，
   正是用户看到的"红蓝交替"；加载期唯一一次 win_fill(224,96,48) 同理显成蓝(48,96,224)="纯蓝"。
   开关（files/smo_m7d_*，无文件=0=关；`echo 0 > <同路径>` 即回退；每 64 次 present 重读）：
     smo_m7d_pres  =1  每次 present 记 {t, swapchain idx, image 句柄, 清色, fmt, 窗口 tex idx, 游戏侧 draw 增量}
                       环形留 20 条；每 100 s 打一行汇总 + 最近 20 条；首条 present 打 swapchain 元信息
     smo_m7d_fmt   =1  把清色 r/b 对调（gfx_bridge 调用端），验证「红蓝=通道互换」假说
     smo_m7d_same  =1  跳过清色路径、强制走 present_offscreen（验证「present 的不是画的那张图」假说）
     smo_m7d_clear =1  清色强制纯绿 (0,255,0)（验证「纯色=清色」假说） */
static unsigned long long g_m7d_calls;
#define M7D_RING 20
typedef struct { unsigned long long t; unsigned idx; uintptr_t img; unsigned fmt, rn, gn, bn, widx, dr, ok; } m7d_ent_t;
static m7d_ent_t g_m7d_ring[M7D_RING];
static unsigned g_m7d_ring_n, g_m7d_sc_logged, g_m7d_coln;
static unsigned long long g_m7d_win_n, g_m7d_win_fail, g_m7d_win_t0, g_m7d_win_idx[8];
static unsigned long long g_m7d_colv[8], g_m7d_colc[8];
static int m7d_read(const char *leaf)
{
    char pa[96], pb[96];
    snprintf(pa, sizeof pa, "/data/storage/el2/base/files/%s", leaf);
    snprintf(pb, sizeof pb, "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files/%s", leaf);
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        FILE *f = fopen(i ? pb : pa, "r");
        if (!f) continue;
        int v = 0;
        if (fscanf(f, "%d", &v) != 1) v = 0;
        fclose(f);
        return v;
    }
    {   /* 两边都没有：app 自己种 0。种子写 pa（/data/storage 沙箱内可创建；/data/app 路径 app 侧不可建）。
           hdc shell 覆盖用 /data/app 路径（shell 无创建权、对既有文件可写，已实测 smo_m7a）。 */
        FILE *f = fopen(pa, "w");
        if (f) { fputs("0\n", f); fclose(f); vk_boot_logf("[m7d] seeded %s = 0", pa); }
    }
    return 0;
}
static int m7d_sw(int which)   /* 0=pres 1=fmt 2=same 3=clear；g_m7d_calls 每 present 推进一次 */
{
    static int cached[4] = { -1, -1, -1, -1 };
    static unsigned long long last[4];
    static const char *leaf[4] = { "smo_m7d_pres", "smo_m7d_fmt", "smo_m7d_same", "smo_m7d_clear" };
    if (cached[which] < 0 || g_m7d_calls - last[which] >= 64) {
        cached[which] = m7d_read(leaf[which]) ? 1 : 0;
        last[which] = g_m7d_calls;
    }
    return cached[which];
}
/* gfx_bridge 每 present 调一次：拿实验开关位（2=fmt 4=same 8=clear），顺带推进开关重读节拍 */
int nvn_vk_m7d_flags(void)
{
    g_m7d_calls++;
    return (m7d_sw(1) ? 2 : 0) | (m7d_sw(2) ? 4 : 0) | (m7d_sw(3) ? 8 : 0);
}
static void m7d_pres_record(uint32_t idx, uint32_t r, uint32_t g, uint32_t b, int ok)
{
    struct timespec ts;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &ts);
    unsigned long long t = (unsigned long long)ts.tv_sec * 1000000ull + (unsigned long long)ts.tv_nsec / 1000ull;
    static unsigned long long dr_last;
    unsigned long long dr = g_d_draws + g_r_draws;
    m7d_ent_t *e = &g_m7d_ring[g_m7d_ring_n % M7D_RING];
    e->t = t; e->idx = idx;
    e->img = (idx < g_sc_n) ? (uintptr_t)g_sc_img[idx] : 0;
    e->fmt = (unsigned)g_sc_fmt; e->rn = r; e->gn = g; e->bn = b;
    e->widx = (g_p_tex_idx < 0) ? 0xFFFFFFFFu : (unsigned)g_p_tex_idx;
    e->dr = (unsigned)(dr - (dr_last <= dr ? dr_last : dr));
    dr_last = dr;
    e->ok = ok ? 1 : 0;
    g_m7d_ring_n++;
    g_m7d_win_n++;
    if (idx < 8) g_m7d_win_idx[idx]++;
    if (!ok) g_m7d_win_fail++;
    unsigned long long col = ((unsigned long long)(r & 255) << 16) | ((unsigned long long)(g & 255) << 8) | (unsigned long long)(b & 255);
    { int found = -1;
      for (int i = 0; i < (int)g_m7d_coln; i++) if (g_m7d_colv[i] == col) { found = i; break; }
      if (found < 0 && g_m7d_coln < 8) { g_m7d_colv[g_m7d_coln] = col; found = (int)g_m7d_coln++; }
      if (found >= 0) g_m7d_colc[found]++; }
    if (!g_m7d_win_t0) g_m7d_win_t0 = t;
    if (t - g_m7d_win_t0 < 100000000ull) return;   /* 100 s 一汇总 */
    if (!g_m7d_sc_logged) {
        g_m7d_sc_logged = 1;
        vk_boot_logf("[m7d] sc fmt=%d(%s) n=%u ext=%ux%u", (int)g_sc_fmt,
                     (g_sc_fmt == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_UNORM || g_sc_fmt == VK_FORMAT_B8G8R8A8_SRGB) ? "BGRA" : "RGBA",
                     g_sc_n, g_sc_ext.width, g_sc_ext.height);
    }
    vk_boot_logf("[m7d] pres-sum win=100s n=%llu ok=%llu fail=%llu idx0..7=%llu %llu %llu %llu %llu %llu %llu %llu colors=%llu#%06llx %llu#%06llx %llu#%06llx %llu#%06llx",
                 g_m7d_win_n, g_m7d_win_n - g_m7d_win_fail, g_m7d_win_fail,
                 g_m7d_win_idx[0], g_m7d_win_idx[1], g_m7d_win_idx[2], g_m7d_win_idx[3],
                 g_m7d_win_idx[4], g_m7d_win_idx[5], g_m7d_win_idx[6], g_m7d_win_idx[7],
                 g_m7d_colc[0], g_m7d_colv[0], g_m7d_colc[1], g_m7d_colv[1],
                 g_m7d_colc[2], g_m7d_colv[2], g_m7d_colc[3], g_m7d_colv[3]);
    unsigned first = g_m7d_ring_n > M7D_RING ? g_m7d_ring_n - M7D_RING : 0;
    for (unsigned i = first; i < g_m7d_ring_n; i++) {
        m7d_ent_t *q = &g_m7d_ring[i % M7D_RING];
        vk_boot_logf("[m7d] pres t=%llu.%03u idx=%u img=%#x fmt=%u rgb=%u,%u,%u widx=%u dr=%u ok=%d",
                     q->t / 1000000ull, (unsigned)(q->t % 1000000ull) / 1000u, q->idx,
                     (unsigned)(q->img & 0xFFFFFFFFu), q->fmt, q->rn, q->gn, q->bn, q->widx, q->dr, q->ok);
    }
    g_m7d_win_t0 = t; g_m7d_win_n = 0; g_m7d_win_fail = 0; g_m7d_coln = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) { g_m7d_win_idx[i] = 0; g_m7d_colc[i] = 0; }
}

int nvn_vk_present_clear(uint32_t r, uint32_t g, uint32_t b)
{
    /* M3g 探针 #2：present 尝试计数。放在 g_on 判断之前——后端没起来时的「尝试」也要记，
       否则 present_try 与 g_on 混在一个信号里。 */
    atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_beat_present_try, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
    if (!g_on) return 0;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    /* M3e 未验：驱动无 VK_OHOS_native_buffer 时，交换链能建成，但 vkAcquireNextImageKHR 进
       libvulkan_swapchain.so 后会调一个 NULL 函数指针（cppcrash: present_clear+244 → 层+0xf9b0 → pc=0）。
       层不校验能力也不返回错误码，只能整段绕开：走已有的 device-only 模式，保住进程。 */
    if (g_ohos_nb_stripped) {
        static int reported;
        if (!reported) { reported = 1; vk_boot_logf("swapchain/present skipped: driver lacks " PROX_EXT " (OHOS layer derefs NULL in acquire)"); }
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
        return 0;
    }
    if (!g_sc && !swapchain_build()) { atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_pf_pres_skip.n, 1, memory_order_relaxed); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock); return 0; }
    if (!g_sc_rp) { atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_pf_pres_skip.n, 1, memory_order_relaxed); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock); return 0; }
    uint32_t idx = 0;
    unsigned long long pf_p0 = pf_now_us();   /* M6e：present 全段（acquire->submit->present->栅栏） */
    VkResult ar = vkAcquireNextImageKHR(g_dev, g_sc, UINT64_MAX, g_acq_sem[0], NULL, &idx);
    if (ar == VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DATE_KHR || ar == VK_SUBOPTIMAL_KHR) {
        NVK("[vk] acquire = %{public}s -> rebuild swapchain", vr(ar));
        swapchain_destroy();
        if (!swapchain_build()) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock); return 0; }
        ar = vkAcquireNextImageKHR(g_dev, g_sc, UINT64_MAX, g_acq_sem[0], NULL, &idx);
    }
    if (ar != VK_SUCCESS) { atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_pf_pres_skip.n, 1, memory_order_relaxed); NVK_RED("acquire = %{public}d (%{public}s)", (int)ar, vr(ar));
        if (m7d_sw(0)) m7d_pres_record(0xFFFFFFFFu, r, g, b, 0);   /* M7d：acquire 失败也记（idx=0xFFFFFFFF 哨兵） */
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock); return 0; }
    if (idx >= g_sc_n || !g_sc_fb[idx]) { NVK_RED("framebuffer missing (idx %{public}u / %{public}u)", idx, g_sc_n); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock); return 0; }

    // 出图专属命令缓冲：一次提交一条，录完即弃（:2533-2542）。
    // 通道里只做清色（M2-0 冒烟配方）：布局转换交给经典通道自己做（UNDEFINED → PRESENT_SRC），
    // 不手发交换链屏障——通道外对交换链图发 transfer 写会打掉设备（第 47/48 轮，:2508-2527）。
    VkCommandBuffer pcb = NULL;
    VkCommandBufferAllocateInfo pca = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_ALLOCATE_INFO };
    pca.commandPool = g_cp;
    pca.level = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_LEVEL_PRIMARY;
    pca.commandBufferCount = 1;
    if (vkAllocateCommandBuffers(g_dev, &pca, &pcb) != VK_SUCCESS) { NVK_RED("alloc present cb failed"); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock); return 0; }
    VkCommandBufferBeginInfo pbi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_COMMAND_BUFFER_BEGIN_INFO };
    pbi.flags = VK_COMMAND_BUFFER_USAGE_ONE_TIME_SUBMIT_BIT;
    vkBeginCommandBuffer(pcb, &pbi);
    VkClearValue cv = { .color = { .float32 = { r / 255.0f, g / 255.0f, b / 255.0f, 1.0f } } };
    VkRenderPassBeginInfo rpb = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_RENDER_PASS_BEGIN_INFO };
    rpb.renderPass = g_sc_rp;
    rpb.framebuffer = g_sc_fb[idx];
    rpb.renderArea = (VkRect2D){ { 0, 0 }, g_sc_ext };
    rpb.clearValueCount = 1;
    rpb.pClearValues = &cv;
    beat_cmd();
    vkCmdBeginRenderPass(pcb, &rpb, VK_SUBPASS_CONTENTS_INLINE);
    beat_cmd();
    vkCmdEndRenderPass(pcb);
    vkEndCommandBuffer(pcb);

    VkSubmitInfo si = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_SUBMIT_INFO };
    VkPipelineStageFlags stage = VK_PIPELINE_STAGE_COLOR_ATTACHMENT_OUTPUT_BIT;
    si.waitSemaphoreCount = 1;
    // 必须给等待阶段：waitSemaphoreCount=1 而 pWaitDstStageMask=NULL ⇒ 驱动空指针（第 37 轮，:2597-2601）
    si.pWaitDstStageMask = &stage;
    si.commandBufferCount = 1;
    si.pCommandBuffers = &pcb;
    si.pWaitSemaphores = &g_acq_sem[0];       // acquire 用的就是 0 号：一次信号配一次等待（:2604）
    si.signalSemaphoreCount = 1;
    si.pSignalSemaphores = &g_vis_sem;
    if (g_pfence) vkResetFences(g_dev, 1, &g_pfence);   // 复用前 reset（VUID-fence-00064，:2608）
    VkResult sr = vkQueueSubmit(g_q, 1, &si, g_pfence);
    if (sr != VK_SUCCESS) NVK_RED("present submit = %{public}d (%{public}s)", (int)sr, vr(sr));

    VkPresentInfoKHR pi = { VK_STRUCTURE_TYPE_PRESENT_INFO_KHR };
    pi.swapchainCount = 1;
    pi.pImageIndices = &idx;
    pi.pSwapchains = &g_sc;
    VkResult pr = VK_SUCCESS;
    if (sr == VK_SUCCESS) { pi.waitSemaphoreCount = 1; pi.pWaitSemaphores = &g_vis_sem; }   // 冒烟同款：present 等渲染的信号（:2637）
    if (sr == VK_SUCCESS) pr = vkQueuePresentKHR(g_q, &pi);
    if (pr != VK_SUCCESS && pr != VK_SUBOPTIMAL_KHR && pr != VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DATE_KHR)
        NVK_RED("present = %{public}d (%{public}s)", (int)pr, vr(pr));
    if (pr == VK_ERROR_OUT_OF_DATE_KHR) swapchain_destroy();
    // 出图等自己的栅栏再回收缓冲（缓冲还在飞就 free = 把驱动在用的内存放回池，:2645-2648）
    if (g_pfence && sr == VK_SUCCESS) nvk_wait_fences(g_dev, 1, &g_pfence, VK_TRUE, UINT64_MAX);
    vkFreeCommandBuffers(g_dev, g_cp, 1, &pcb);
    g_presents++;
    if (m7d_sw(0)) m7d_pres_record(idx, r, g, b, sr == VK_SUCCESS && pr == VK_SUCCESS);   /* M7d 探针（默认 0） */
    pf_dt(&g_pf_present, pf_p0);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
    return sr == VK_SUCCESS && pr == VK_SUCCESS;
}

// ---------------- 起层/停层 | boot/shutdown ----------------
static int m14b_sw(void);     /* M14B：开关读取（定义在 17260 附近）；这里只借它「缺文件就自己建」*/

int nvn_vk_init(void)
{
    /* M14B：开关文件必须在 app 自己的 uid 下建出来（hdc shell 在私有目录建不了新文件，SELinux）。
       nvn_vk_init 是 native 模块最早的一次 Vulkan 初始化，在这里落盘一次，之后的 boot 循环
       （以及用户/脚本 `echo 1 > .../smo_m14b`）就能改它。只建一个 8 字节文件，缺省 "0" = 旧行为。 */
    (void)m14b_sw();
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    if (g_on) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock); return 1; }
    if (g_tried || g_dead_for_good) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock); return 0; }
    g_tried = 1;
    const char *e = getenv("SMO_VK");
    if (e && e[0] == '0') {
        NVK("[vk] SMO_VK=0: Vulkan backend disabled (stub mode)");   // stub 模式一行标明
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
        return 0;
    }
    if (!vk_boot()) {
        NVK("[vk] Vulkan backend down: fallback to stub mode (host behavior unchanged)");   // stub 模式一行标明
        vk_boot_logf("RESULT: Vulkan backend down -> stub mode");
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
        return 0;
    }
    probe_bc();
    g_on = 1;
    { int i; for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) m7d_sw(i); }   /* M7d：起层即种 0（hdc shell 无创建权，只能覆盖既有文件） */
    vk_boot_logf("RESULT: Vulkan backend up (device ready, not stub)");
    NVK("[vk] NVN->Vulkan backend up (batch 1: device/surface/swapchain/texture upload), surface %{public}u x %{public}u",
        g_win_w, g_win_h);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
    return 1;
}

void nvn_vk_shutdown(void)
{
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    if (!g_on && !g_inst) { g_dead_for_good = 1; pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock); return; }
    nvn_vk_perf_rt_drain();   /* M6e：先回收在飞的 RT 绑定 CB（异步等待模式） */
    if (g_dev) vkDeviceWaitIdle(g_dev);
    swapchain_destroy();
    if (g_vis_sem) { vkDestroySemaphore(g_dev, g_vis_sem, NULL); g_vis_sem = NULL; }
    if (g_stage) { vkDestroyBuffer(g_dev, g_stage, NULL); g_stage = NULL; }
    if (g_stage_mem) {
        if (g_stage_map) vkUnmapMemory(g_dev, g_stage_mem);
        vkFreeMemory(g_dev, g_stage_mem, NULL); g_stage_mem = NULL; g_stage_map = NULL; g_stage_sz = 0;
    }
    if (g_pfence) { vkDestroyFence(g_dev, g_pfence, NULL); g_pfence = NULL; }
    if (g_ufence) { vkDestroyFence(g_dev, g_ufence, NULL); g_ufence = NULL; }
    if (g_cp) { vkDestroyCommandPool(g_dev, g_cp, NULL); g_cp = NULL; }
    if (g_dev) { vkDestroyDevice(g_dev, NULL); g_dev = NULL; }
    if (g_surf) { vkDestroySurfaceKHR(g_inst, g_surf, NULL); g_surf = NULL; }
    if (g_inst) { vkDestroyInstance(g_inst, NULL); g_inst = NULL; }
    g_pd = NULL; g_q = NULL; g_on = 0; g_bcap = 0;
    g_dead_for_good = 1;
    NVK("[vk] NVN->Vulkan backend shut down");
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
}

int nvn_vk_is_up(void) { return g_on; }
uint32_t nvn_vk_bc_caps(void) { return g_bcap; }

void nvn_vk_set_native_window(void *native_window, uint32_t width, uint32_t height)
{
    { __attribute__((weak)) int nvn_win_fill(void *, unsigned, unsigned, unsigned);
      if (nvn_win_fill) { int ok = nvn_win_fill(g_win, 0xE0, 0x60, 0x30); NVK("[vk] one-shot fill at surface create -> %{public}s", ok ? "ok" : "refused"); } }
    int boot_now = 0;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    g_win = native_window;
    g_win_w = width;
    g_win_h = height;
    NVK("[vk] native window %{public}s %{public}u x %{public}u",
        native_window ? "set" : "cleared", width, height);
    // 窗口销毁：旧 surface 随之失效，交换链必须拆掉（下次 present/init 重建）
    if (g_on && g_sc && !native_window) swapchain_destroy();
    // 懒起层（round23批1落点2）：窗口首次到达且层未起时触发 boot。g_tried 是「起层只试一次」
    // 的一次性闩（nvn_vk_init）；若 mtl_init 在窗口到来前已试过一轮（vk_boot 因 !g_win 失败），
    // 闩已落下，必须清掉才有机会重试。SMO_VK=0 / g_dead_for_good 的拒绝逻辑仍在 init 内保留。
    if (native_window && !g_on) {
        g_tried = 0;
        boot_now = 1;
    }
    // 死锁纪律（round23 方案陷阱12）：g_lock 是非递归锁，nvn_vk_init 入口再锁同一把锁——
    // 持锁段内直接调 init 必死锁。锁内只置位 boot_now，先解锁再调；Vulkan 全套创建放在
    // 锁外，与 donor vulkan_present.cpp「UI 锁只护窗口快照，不跨 GPU 等待」(:41-43) 同款纪律。
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
    if (boot_now) nvn_vk_init();
}

const char *nvn_vk_status_line(void)
{
    static char line[160];
    if (!g_on) return "vk down (stub mode)";
    snprintf(line, sizeof line, "vk up surface=%ux%u swap=%ux%u fmt=%d images=%u bc_caps=0x%x presents=%llu",
             g_win_w, g_win_h, g_sc_ext.width, g_sc_ext.height, (int)g_sc_fmt, g_sc_n,
             g_bcap, (unsigned long long)g_presents);
    return line;
}

/* ================= M5s P2（只读归因探针，0 行为改动）=================
   派活单要求「每 30 s 打一行自建计数器 + RSS，指出哪个计数器和 RSS 同斜率」。
   这里的每一项都是**我们自己分配的 host 内存**，加上 /proc/self/status 的内核口径：
     rt    = RT 槽的 VkImage/VkDeviceMemory（M5s 修的就是这条；alloc_mb 只增不减 ⇒ 它就是泄漏上限）
     cmd   = 命令录制宿主内存（shadow pages + add_host_memory 块），M5r 的 4 GiB 上限已改口径到这儿
     tex   = 纹理真 VkImage 的活体字节（create +、destroy -）
     vmsize/vmdata/vmrss = 内核侧总量，用来验证「我们的计数器确实解释了 RSS」
   只在心跳线程里调（与 runtime_rss_guard 同一条路），不碰任何渲染状态、不持锁。 */
extern void nvn_port_cmdmem_stats(uint64_t *o);   /* nvn_replay/cmdbuf.c */
void runtime_mem_attrib_dump(void)
{
    long vmrss = -1, vmsize = -1, vmdata = -1;
    FILE *f = fopen("/proc/self/status", "r");
    if (f) {
        char ln[192];
        while (fgets(ln, sizeof ln, f)) {
            if (!strncmp(ln, "VmRSS:", 6)) vmrss = atol(ln + 6);
            else if (!strncmp(ln, "VmSize:", 7)) vmsize = atol(ln + 7);
            else if (!strncmp(ln, "VmData:", 7)) vmdata = atol(ln + 7);
        }
        fclose(f);
    }
    unsigned long long rt_slots = 0, rt_img_slots = 0, rt_bytes = 0;
    const int nslot = (int)(sizeof g_rt_tab / sizeof *g_rt_tab);
    for (int i = 0; i < nslot; i++) {
        if (g_rt_tab[i].key) rt_slots++;
        if (g_rt_tab[i].img) { rt_img_slots++; rt_bytes += g_rt_tab[i].img_bytes; }
    }
    uint64_t S[8] = { 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 };
    nvn_port_cmdmem_stats(S);
    vk_boot_logf("[mem] vmrss=%ld vmsize=%ld vmdata=%ld | rt_slots=%llu/%d rt_img_slots=%llu "
                 "rt_alloc_mb=%llu rt_create=%llu rt_reuse_sz=%llu rt_lru=%llu rt_deny=%llu "
                 "rt_fallback=%llu | cmd_host_mb=%llu shadow_pages=%llu chunks_mb=%llu | "
                 "tex_img=%llu tex_mb=%llu | pipe_ok=%llu pipe_fail=%llu",
                 vmrss, vmsize, vmdata, rt_slots, nslot, rt_img_slots,
                 rt_bytes >> 20, g_rt_img_creates, g_rt_img_reuse_sz, g_rt_img_lru, g_rt_budget_deny,
                 g_h_rt_fallback, (unsigned long long)(S[0] >> 20), S[1], (unsigned long long)(S[2] >> 20),
                 g_tex_live_n, g_tex_live_bytes >> 20, g_r_pipe_ok, g_r_pipe_fail);
}

/* ================= M6s：10 s 内存归因 + 护栏盲区点名（只读） =================
   M6r 留下的唯一空洞：RSS 3.9 -> 11.2 GB 期间 rt/cmd/tex 三组自建计数器一动不动，日志里没有
   任何一行说「哪个映射在长」。这条探针只补这个洞，四块，全部只读、不持锁、不碰渲染状态：
     ① [mem] 内核口径（RSS/VmSize/VmData/anon/file/shmem）+ 任务数 + 映射数 + 自建计数器；
     ② [grow] /proc/self/maps 按「映射名」聚合的总字节，与前一次比，打增长最大的 3 类
        （这是点名：native_heap:jemalloc = 分配器活体/脏页，[anon] = 裸 mmap，[heap] = brk）；
     ③ [malloc] jemalloc 的 stats.allocated/active/resident（mallctl 只读；拿不到就报一次不可用，
        绝不改任何分配器参数——M5c 的 alloc_tune_once 仍然保持死代码状态）；
     ④ [cpu] 每线程 CPU 增量 top3 + 该线程的客体 handle/op/nsvc（谁在烧 CPU 的同时分配）。
   由 vk_boot.c 心跳线程每 10 s 调用一次；maps 扫描在映射数 >20000 时自动降到每 30 s 一次。 */
extern int runtime_tid_info(int tid, unsigned *handle, int *op, int *wk, unsigned long long *waddr,
                            int *core, int *prio, unsigned long long *nsvc) __attribute__((weak));
static int  g_mc_state;                       /* 0 = 未探测；1 = 有 mallctl；2 = 没有 */
static int (*g_mc_fn)(const char *, void *, size_t *, void *, size_t);
#define R_VMAC 64
typedef struct { char nm[44]; unsigned long long sz; } r_vmac;
static r_vmac g_vmaprev[R_VMAC];
static int    g_vmaprev_n;
static unsigned g_maps_lines, g_maps_skip, g_maps_lines_prev;

static int r_mc_probe(void)
{
    if (g_mc_state) return g_mc_state == 1;
    g_mc_state = 2;
    void *f = dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT, "mallctl");
    if (!f) { void *h = dlopen("libc.so", RTLD_NOW | RTLD_NOLOAD); if (h) f = dlsym(h, "mallctl"); }
    if (!f) { void *h = dlopen("libjemalloc.so", RTLD_NOW | RTLD_NOLOAD); if (h) f = dlsym(h, "mallctl"); }
    if (f) { g_mc_fn = (int (*)(const char *, void *, size_t *, void *, size_t))f; g_mc_state = 1; }
    vk_boot_logf("[malloc] mallctl %s (jemalloc stats %s)", f ? "found" : "NOT exported",
                 f ? "available" : "unavailable");
    return g_mc_state == 1;
}
/* smo_mem_purge：止血阀开关（文件开关，口径同 smo_rss_guard：不存在时用 C 默认 0=关）。 */
static int r_purge_switch(void)
{
    static int on = -1;
    if (on >= 0) return on;
    on = 0;
    const char *paths[2] = { "/data/storage/el2/base/files/smo_mem_purge",
                             "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files/smo_mem_purge" };
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        FILE *f = fopen(paths[i], "r");
        if (!f) continue;
        int ch = fgetc(f); fclose(f);
        if (ch >= 0) { on = (ch == '0') ? 0 : 1; break; }
    }
    return on;
}
static int r_mc_u64(const char *name, unsigned long long *out)
{
    if (!g_mc_fn) return 0;
    size_t v = 0, l = sizeof v;
    if (g_mc_fn(name, &v, &l, NULL, 0) != 0) return 0;
    *out = (unsigned long long)v; return 1;
}
/* maps 聚合：按名字累计 VMA 大小。名字取行尾路径的 basename，无路径用 [anon]，
   方括号名（[heap]/[stack]/[anon:native_heap:jemalloc]）原样保留（截到 43 字节）。 */
static void r_vma_scan(r_vmac *out, int *out_n, unsigned *lines)
{
    int n = 0; unsigned nl = 0;
    FILE *f = fopen("/proc/self/maps", "r");
    if (!f) { *out_n = 0; *lines = 0; return; }
    char line[320];
    while (fgets(line, sizeof line, f)) {
        nl++;
        char *sp = strchr(line, ' ');
        char *dash = strchr(line, '-');
        if (!sp || !dash || dash > sp) continue;
        unsigned long long a = strtoull(line, NULL, 16), b = strtoull(dash + 1, NULL, 16);
        unsigned long long sz = b > a ? b - a : 0;
        if (!sz) continue;
        /* 第 6 列起是名字；先把前 5 列跳掉 */
        char *p = line; int col = 0;
        while (p && *p && col < 5) { char *q = strchr(p, ' '); if (!q) { p = NULL; break; } p = q; while (*p == ' ') p++; col++; }
        char nm[44];
        if (p) { while (*p == ' ') p++; char *nlp = strchr(p, '\n'); if (nlp) *nlp = 0; }
        if (!p || !*p) snprintf(nm, sizeof nm, "[anon]");
        else if (p[0] == '[') snprintf(nm, sizeof nm, "%s", p);
        else { char *sl = strrchr(p, '/'); snprintf(nm, sizeof nm, "%s", sl ? sl + 1 : p); }
        int i = 0;
        for (; i < n; i++) if (!strcmp(out[i].nm, nm)) break;
        if (i == n) {
            if (n >= R_VMAC) {   /* 满了：并入最后一个桶 */
                out[R_VMAC - 1].sz += sz;
                continue;
            }
            snprintf(out[n].nm, sizeof out[n].nm, "%s", nm);
            out[n].sz = 0; n++;
        }
        out[i].sz += sz;
    }
    fclose(f);
    *out_n = n; *lines = nl;
}
/* 原始设备/文件映射很多时 maps 行数可能上万；>20000 行就降到每 30 s 扫一次（3 次调用 1 次扫）。 */
extern int  runtime_stack_probe_req(int tid) __attribute__((weak));
extern void runtime_stack_probe_dump(unsigned tsec) __attribute__((weak));
extern unsigned runtime_stack_probe_gen(void) __attribute__((weak));
/* 每线程 CPU 增量 top3 + 身份 + 该线程的缺页增量。M6s boot 1 的教训：只报 handle 不够——60 MB/s 的
   分配者是一个**没有客体 handle** 的宿主线程（tid=17214，st=R wch=0 cpu=100%），所以这里同时把
   pid/tid、comm、状态、wchan 打出来，并对持续 >60% 的那个 tid 发 SIGURG 采样它的栈。 */
#define R_TASKP 256
static struct { int tid; unsigned long long u, s; } g_cpuprev[R_TASKP];
static int g_cpupr_n;
static int g_stk_req_tid, g_stk_req_t;
static void r_cpu10_dump(unsigned tsec)
{
    static uint64_t last_ns;
    uint64_t nowts = (uint64_t)r_now_ms() * 1000000ull;
    double win = last_ns ? (double)(nowts - last_ns) / 1e9 : 10.0;
    if (win < 0.5) win = 0.5;
    last_ns = nowts;
    DIR *d = opendir("/proc/self/task");
    if (!d) return;
    int n = 0, ntask = 0;
    static int tid[16]; static unsigned long long dticks[16], dflt[16];
    struct dirent *e;
    long hz = sysconf(_SC_CLK_TCK); if (hz <= 0) hz = 100;
    while ((e = readdir(d))) {
        if (e->d_name[0] == '.') continue;
        ntask++;
        int tid_v = atoi(e->d_name);
        if (tid_v <= 0) continue;
        char path[64]; snprintf(path, sizeof path, "/proc/self/task/%d/stat", tid_v);
        FILE *f = fopen(path, "r");
        if (!f) continue;
        char buf[512]; size_t got = fread(buf, 1, sizeof buf - 1, f); fclose(f);
        buf[got] = 0;
        char *rp = strrchr(buf, ')');
        if (!rp) continue;
        unsigned long long ut = 0, st = 0, mf = 0;
        /* after ')': state ppid pgrp session tty tpgid flags minflt cminflt majflt cmajflt utime stime */
        if (sscanf(rp + 2, "%*c %*d %*d %*d %*d %*d %*u %llu %*u %*u %*u %llu %llu", &mf, &ut, &st) != 3) continue;
        unsigned long long ticks = ut + st;
        int pi = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < g_cpupr_n; i++) if (g_cpuprev[i].tid == tid_v) { pi = i; break; }
        unsigned long long delta = 0, dfl = 0;
        if (pi < 0) {
            if (g_cpupr_n < R_TASKP) {
                pi = g_cpupr_n++;
                g_cpuprev[pi].tid = tid_v;
                g_cpuprev[pi].u = ut; g_cpuprev[pi].s = st;   /* baseline = now: a new thread starts at 0%, not at its lifetime */
            }
        }
        if (pi >= 0) { delta = ticks > (g_cpuprev[pi].u + g_cpuprev[pi].s) ? ticks - (g_cpuprev[pi].u + g_cpuprev[pi].s) : 0;
                       g_cpuprev[pi].u = ut; g_cpuprev[pi].s = st; }
        dfl = mf;   /* absolute faults owned by this thread; only the top row's absolute value is printed */
        if (delta && n < 16) { tid[n] = tid_v; dticks[n] = delta; dflt[n] = dfl; n++; }
    }
    closedir(d);
    char buf[300]; unsigned off = 0;
    for (int k = 0; k < 3 && n > 0; k++) {
        int best = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (!dticks[i]) continue;
            if (best < 0 || dticks[i] > dticks[best]) best = i;
        }
        if (best < 0) break;
        unsigned h = 0; int op = -1, wk = -1, core = -1, prio = -1; unsigned long long waddr = 0, nsvc = 0;
        if (runtime_tid_info) runtime_tid_info(tid[best], &h, &op, &wk, &waddr, &core, &prio, &nsvc);
        char comm[24] = "?"; char cp[64];
        snprintf(cp, sizeof cp, "/proc/self/task/%d/comm", tid[best]);
        FILE *cf = fopen(cp, "r");
        if (cf) { if (fgets(comm, sizeof comm, cf)) { char *nlp = strchr(comm, '\n'); if (nlp) *nlp = 0; } fclose(cf); }
        off += (unsigned)snprintf(buf + off, sizeof buf - off, " #%d tid=%d %s cpu=%.0f%% minflt=%llu h=%#x op=%d nsvc=%llu",
                                  k + 1, tid[best], comm,
                                  (double)dticks[best] / (double)hz * 100.0 / win, dflt[best], h, op, nsvc);
        /* 100% 级别的持续占用 = 可能就是那只分配者：采样它的栈（10 s 一次请求，打印上一次的捕获）。 */
        if (k == 0 && (double)dticks[best] / (double)hz * 100.0 / win >= 40.0 && runtime_stack_probe_req
            && (g_stk_req_tid != tid[best] || (tsec - g_stk_req_t) >= 10)) {
            if (runtime_stack_probe_req(tid[best]) == 0) { g_stk_req_tid = tid[best]; g_stk_req_t = (int)tsec; }
        }
        dticks[best] = 0;
    }
    vk_boot_logf("[cpu] t=%us threads=%d pid=%d%s", tsec, ntask, (int)getpid(), off ? buf : " (all idle)");
    {   /* print the newest stack capture once (it belongs to the tid requested last time) */
        static unsigned last_gen;
        unsigned g = runtime_stack_probe_gen ? runtime_stack_probe_gen() : 0;
        if (g != last_gen) { last_gen = g; if (runtime_stack_probe_dump) runtime_stack_probe_dump(tsec); }
    }
}
void runtime_mem_probe10(unsigned tsec)
{
    long vmrss = -1, vmsize = -1, vmdata = -1, anon = -1, rfile = -1, shmem = -1;
    FILE *f = fopen("/proc/self/status", "r");
    if (f) {
        char ln[192];
        while (fgets(ln, sizeof ln, f)) {
            if (!strncmp(ln, "VmRSS:", 6)) vmrss = atol(ln + 6);
            else if (!strncmp(ln, "VmSize:", 7)) vmsize = atol(ln + 7);
            else if (!strncmp(ln, "VmData:", 7)) vmdata = atol(ln + 7);
            else if (!strncmp(ln, "RssAnon:", 8)) anon = atol(ln + 8);
            else if (!strncmp(ln, "RssFile:", 8)) rfile = atol(ln + 8);
            else if (!strncmp(ln, "RssShmem:", 9)) shmem = atol(ln + 9);
        }
        fclose(f);
    }
    unsigned long long rt_slots = 0, rt_img_slots = 0, rt_bytes = 0;
    const int nslot = (int)(sizeof g_rt_tab / sizeof *g_rt_tab);
    for (int i = 0; i < nslot; i++) {
        if (g_rt_tab[i].key) rt_slots++;
        if (g_rt_tab[i].img) { rt_img_slots++; rt_bytes += g_rt_tab[i].img_bytes; }
    }
    uint64_t S[8] = { 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 };
    nvn_port_cmdmem_stats(S);
    vk_boot_logf("[mem] t=%us vmrss=%ldMB vmsize=%ldMB vmdata=%ldMB anon=%ldMB file=%ldMB shmem=%ldKB maps=%u | "
                 "rt_slots=%llu/%d rt_alloc_mb=%llu rt_create=%llu rt_lru=%llu | cmd_host_mb=%llu shadow=%llu | "
                 "tex_img=%llu tex_mb=%llu | pipe_ok=%llu pipe_fail=%llu",
                 tsec, vmrss >> 10, vmsize >> 10, vmdata >> 10, anon >> 10, rfile >> 10, shmem,
                 g_maps_lines, rt_slots, nslot, rt_bytes >> 20, g_rt_img_creates, g_rt_img_lru,
                 (unsigned long long)(S[0] >> 20), S[1], g_tex_live_n, g_tex_live_bytes >> 20,
                 g_r_pipe_ok, g_r_pipe_fail);
    if (r_mc_probe()) {
        unsigned long long alc = 0, act = 0, res = 0, map_ = 0;
        size_t one = 1; g_mc_fn("epoch", NULL, NULL, &one, sizeof one);   /* refresh cached stats */
        r_mc_u64("stats.allocated", &alc); r_mc_u64("stats.active", &act);
        r_mc_u64("stats.resident", &res);  r_mc_u64("stats.mapped", &map_);
        vk_boot_logf("[malloc] t=%us allocated=%lluMB active=%lluMB resident=%lluMB mapped=%lluMB",
                     tsec, alc >> 20, act >> 20, res >> 20, map_ >> 20);
        /* M6s 止血阀（默认关，smo_mem_purge=1 才开）：RSS 越过硬顶时让 jemalloc 把**空闲脏页**还给
           内核。它只作用于已释放的内存，所以对「活体泄漏」无效——这正是它的诊断价值：purge 之后
           RSS 不降 = 增长全部是活分配。绝不丢弃仍在使用的资源，绝不 abort。 */
        if ((vmrss >> 10) > R_RSS_HARD_MB && r_purge_switch()) {
            unsigned na = 0; size_t l = sizeof na;
            if (g_mc_fn("arenas.narenas", &na, &l, NULL, 0) == 0 && na) {
                unsigned lim = na > 16 ? 16 : na;
                for (unsigned i = 0; i < lim; i++) { char k[64]; snprintf(k, sizeof k, "arena.%u.purge", i); g_mc_fn(k, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0); }
                vk_boot_logf("[malloc] t=%us PURGE valve=1 arenas=%u (RSS was %ldMB)", tsec, lim, vmrss >> 10);
            }
        }
    }
    /* ② VMA 聚合增量 */
    if (g_maps_skip) { g_maps_skip--; }
    else {
        r_vmac now[R_VMAC];
        int nn = 0; unsigned lines = 0;
        r_vma_scan(now, &nn, &lines);
        if (lines > 20000) g_maps_skip = 2;   /* 大地址空间：降到每 30 s 一次 */
        g_maps_lines = lines;
        if (g_vmaprev_n) {
            int pick[3] = { -1, -1, -1 };
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
                long long best = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < nn; i++) {
                    long long prev = 0; int found = 0;
                    for (int j = 0; j < g_vmaprev_n; j++) if (!strcmp(now[i].nm, g_vmaprev[j].nm)) { prev = (long long)g_vmaprev[j].sz; found = 1; break; }
                    (void)found;
                    long long d = (long long)now[i].sz - prev;
                    int dup = 0;
                    for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) if (pick[j] == i) dup = 1;
                    if (dup) continue;
                    if (d > best) { best = d; pick[k] = i; }
                }
                if (pick[k] < 0) break;
            }
            /* 总增量（所有类的正增量之和）才是「地址空间长了多少」；单类增量用来说明是谁。
               dsum 与 RSS 增量一起看：dsum 涨而 RSS 不涨 = 只占地址空间（惰性提交），两者同涨 = 真常驻。 */
            long long dsum = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < nn; i++) {
                long long prev = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < g_vmaprev_n; j++) if (!strcmp(now[i].nm, g_vmaprev[j].nm)) { prev = (long long)g_vmaprev[j].sz; break; }
                if ((long long)now[i].sz > prev) dsum += (long long)now[i].sz - prev;
            }
            char buf[300]; unsigned off = 0;
            off += (unsigned)snprintf(buf + off, sizeof buf - off, "maps=%u dmaps=%+d dsum=%+lldMB",
                                      lines, (int)lines - (int)g_maps_lines_prev, dsum >> 20);
            for (int k = 0; k < 3 && pick[k] >= 0; k++) {
                long long prev = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < g_vmaprev_n; j++) if (!strcmp(now[pick[k]].nm, g_vmaprev[j].nm)) { prev = (long long)g_vmaprev[j].sz; break; }
                if ((long long)now[pick[k]].sz <= prev) continue;
                off += (unsigned)snprintf(buf + off, sizeof buf - off, " | %s +%lldMB/now%lluMB",
                                          now[pick[k]].nm, ((long long)now[pick[k]].sz - prev) >> 20,
                                          now[pick[k]].sz >> 20);
            }
            vk_boot_logf("[grow] t=%us %s", tsec, buf);
            g_maps_lines_prev = lines;
        }
        memcpy(g_vmaprev, now, sizeof g_vmaprev);
        g_vmaprev_n = nn;
    }
    r_cpu10_dump(tsec);
}

/* ================= M6e：[perf] 行（每 60 s，由 vk_boot.c 心跳线程调用） =================
   口径（全部来自本文件的实测记账，窗口 = 上一次 dump 到现在）：
     frame_us   = 窗口墙钟 / 窗口内 submit 数（submit = 一帧 = 一次 present_try，见 [r] draw totals 口径）
     gpu_wait_us= rt_wait + draw_wait + present 三段实测等待之和 / 帧
     guest_us   = frame_us - gpu_wait_us（不足 0 记 0）= 客人在等我们之外的时间
     topN       = 本窗口笔数最多的 (vs,fs,tgt) 三元组；us 由「本窗口实测等待」按笔数分摊（不是逐笔 GPU 时间戳）
   纯只读：不改任何判据、不改任何 draw/绑定/上屏路径。 */
static unsigned long long pf_prev_n[8], pf_prev_us[8], pf_prev_t0;
static unsigned pf_prev_tsec;   /* M6e 修：窗口用 tsec 差算，首条不再把 60 s 当 1 s */
void runtime_perf_dump(unsigned tsec)
{
    unsigned long long n[8], us[8];
    pf_ctr *c[8] = { &g_pf_rt_submit, &g_pf_rt_wait, &g_pf_df_submit, &g_pf_df_wait,
                     &g_pf_df_post, &g_pf_present, &g_pf_texinit, &g_pf_pres_skip };
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) us[i] = pf_load(c[i], &n[i]);
    unsigned long long t1 = pf_now_us();
    double win = 60.0;
    if (pf_prev_tsec && tsec > pf_prev_tsec) win = (double)(tsec - pf_prev_tsec);
    else if (pf_prev_t0 > 0) win = (double)(t1 - pf_prev_t0) / 1e6;
    if (win < 1.0) win = 1.0;
    unsigned long long sub = atomic_load_explicit(&g_beat_nvn_submit, memory_order_relaxed);
    unsigned long long rtn = atomic_load_explicit(&g_pf_rtbind.n, memory_order_relaxed);
    unsigned long long rsw = atomic_load_explicit(&g_pf_rtswitch.n, memory_order_relaxed);
    unsigned long long fps10 = 0;
    /* 帧率：submit 是「一帧」的口径（M3g 起一直如此），窗口内 delta / 窗口秒数。 */
    static unsigned long long psub;
    double fps = (sub >= psub) ? (double)(sub - psub) / win : 0.0;
    unsigned long long d_us[8], d_n[8];
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        d_n[i] = n[i] - pf_prev_n[i]; d_us[i] = us[i] - pf_prev_us[i];
        pf_prev_n[i] = n[i]; pf_prev_us[i] = us[i];
    }
    fps10 = (unsigned long long)(fps * 100.0);
    unsigned long long dsub = (sub >= psub) ? sub - psub : 0;
    psub = sub;
    /* M6e 修：全部换算成「每帧」再比较（旧版把窗口总量和每帧量放在一行里，guest_us 恒 0）。 */
    unsigned long long frame_us = dsub ? (unsigned long long)(win * 1e6 / (double)dsub) : 0;
    unsigned long long gpu_wait_tot = d_us[1] + d_us[3] + d_us[5];   /* rt_wait + draw_wait + present */
    unsigned long long gpu_wait = dsub ? gpu_wait_tot / dsub : 0;
    unsigned long long guest_us = (frame_us > gpu_wait) ? frame_us - gpu_wait : 0;
    unsigned long long bpf10 = dsub ? (unsigned long long)((double)d_n[3] * 10.0 / (double)dsub) : 0;
    /* top3：本窗口笔数排行，us 按笔数分摊本窗口实测等待。 */
    char topbuf[3][112];
    unsigned long long share_us = gpu_wait;
    unsigned long long total_n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_pf_hot_n; i++) total_n += g_pf_hot[i].n;
    for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
        int best = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < g_pf_hot_n; i++) {
            if (!g_pf_hot[i].n) continue;
            int used = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
                char tb[17]; snprintf(tb, sizeof tb, "%s", topbuf[j]);
                if (strstr(tb, g_pf_hot[i].fs)) used = 1;
            }
            if (used) continue;
            if (best < 0 || g_pf_hot[i].n > g_pf_hot[best].n) best = i;
        }
        if (best < 0) { snprintf(topbuf[k], sizeof topbuf[k], "-"); continue; }
        unsigned long long kn = g_pf_hot[best].n;
        unsigned long long kus = total_n ? (unsigned long long)((double)share_us * (double)kn / (double)total_n) : 0ull;
        snprintf(topbuf[k], sizeof topbuf[k], "%s@%ux%u tgt=%ux%u us=%llu n=%llu",
                 g_pf_hot[best].fs, g_pf_hot[best].w, g_pf_hot[best].h,
                 g_pf_hot[best].w, g_pf_hot[best].h, kus, kn);
    }
    vk_boot_logf("[perf] t=%us fps=%llu.%02llu frame_us=%llu sub=%llu bpf=%llu.%llu rt_async=%d | rt_bind=%llu rt_sw=%llu "
                 "rt_submit_us=%llu rt_wait_us=%llu | draw_n=%llu draw_submit_us=%llu draw_wait_us=%llu "
                 "draw_post_us=%llu | present_n=%llu present_us=%llu pres_skip=%llu | tex_init_n=%llu tex_init_us=%llu "
                 "| gpu_wait_us=%llu guest_us=%llu (per frame) | top1=%s | top2=%s | top3=%s",
                 tsec, fps10 / 100ull, fps10 % 100ull, frame_us, dsub, bpf10 / 10ull, bpf10 % 10ull, pf_opt_rt_async(),
                 rtn, rsw, d_us[0], d_us[1],
