```c
static uint64_t runtime_svc_dispatch(unsigned num,uint64_t *r,const char *module,uint64_t offset);
/* M6o: the pc of the SVC instruction itself, for the per-thread svc8 ring (threads.c). `offset` is the
   gate's ORIGINAL site inside the module (sdk.gates.tsv column 4, e.g. 0x37ec34 for svc 0x34), while the
   LR at the gate is only the patch-area stub (sdk+0xd3f3f4) and carries no call-site information.
   Per-thread because SVCs run on the guest thread; saved/restored so a nested dispatch cannot leak. */
__thread uint64_t runtime_svc_pc_tls;
__thread const char *runtime_svc_mod_tls;
uint64_t runtime_svc(unsigned num,uint64_t *r,const char *module,uint64_t offset) {

    be delivered (hdc shell is not allowed to signal the app). Dump once from here instead: this runs on the guest thread
    itself, which is the one context where runtime_dump_threads() is proven safe (the abort path already calls it). */
 { static int dumped; if (!dumped) { static long t0; struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC,&ts);
     if (!t0) t0 = ts.tv_sec;

   WaitSynchronization 的 r[1]=index），所以先抄 4 个字。纯寄存器搬运，无 I/O 无时钟。 */
 uint64_t fa_a[4] = { r[0], r[1], r[2], r[3] };
 uint64_t res = runtime_svc_dispatch(num,r,module,offset);

   0x0b SleepThread 的 r[0] 原样保留请求的纳秒数（不是返回码），0x10 GetCurrentProcessorNumber
   的 r[0] 是当前核号（0..2）——两者都是「值」不是「结果」，记进去只会造噪声。 */

 g_svc_ctx.num = 0;   /* 已返回：此后 abort 落在 SVC 间隙 */

}
```

```c
/* M3p：真实 shader 语料落盘（为离线预烘 SPIR-V 备料）。
 * 布局事实（notes 04-轮次/evidence_m2/m3k_shader_route.md:22-29，离线 shader_split.py/nvn_mtl.m 同源）：

#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <time.h>

/* M3w P3：语料扩容（200 / 8192 / 64MB 在 boot1 已打满：dumped=200 full=7993 loseen=21083）。
   上限仍必须存在且计数，别把设备写爆：4096 键 / 256MB 硬顶，超限只进 full / loseen 计数。 */
#define SD_MAX_KEYS   4096ull                             /* 唯一键上限：超出只计数（[s] dump full） */
#define SD_MAX_BYTES  (256ull<<20)                        /* 总字节上限 */
#define SD_SEEN_MAX   65536u                              /* 判重表容量；槽位 = 2 倍，开放寻址 */
#define SD_SEEN_SLOTS (SD_SEEN_MAX * 2u)                  /* 线性扫 65536 会退化（6e9 次比较），改哈希 */
#define SD_CTL_MAX    0x2000u                             /* 控制段上限（实测 0x760..0x880，留冗余） */
#define SD_CODE_MAX   0x10000u                            /* 代码段上限（实测 max 15056B，派活单口径 <64KB） */

static char g_dir[512];
static int  g_init;                        /* 0=未试 1=可用 -1=不可用（不重试，避免每次调用都 mkdir） */
static unsigned g_seen_n;
static uint64_t g_seen[SD_SEEN_SLOTS];     /* 0 = 空槽（键 0 映射成 1，2^-64 可忽略） */
/* M3w P3：落盘语料的形状统计（平均/最大 code 长度、stage 分布），只统计真正落盘的键 */
static unsigned long long g_code_sum;
static unsigned g_code_max;
static unsigned long long g_stage_n[3];    /* 0=vert 1=frag 2=compute(原 stage=5 归到这一桶) */
static unsigned long g_calls, g_uniq, g_dumped, g_bad, g_bytes, g_full, g_loseen, g_exists;
static unsigned g_logged_ok, g_logged_bad;
static pthread_mutex_t g_mu = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;


/* 目录：与 vk_boot.log 同域（已证实可写，且 hdc file recv 拉得回——PPM/log 已证）。 */
static void sd_dir_init(void)
{
    const char *lp = vk_boot_log_path();
    if (!lp) { g_init = -1; return; }
    snprintf(g_dir, sizeof g_dir, "%s", lp);
    char *slash = strrchr(g_dir, '/');
    if (!slash) { g_init = -1; return; }
    snprintf(slash, sizeof g_dir - (size_t)(slash - g_dir), "/shaderdump");
    if (mkdir(g_dir, 0777) != 0 && errno != EEXIST) {
        vk_boot_logf("[s] dump dir mkdir failed path=%s errno=%d", g_dir, errno);
        g_init = -1;
        return;
    }
    chmod(g_dir, 0777);   /* app 私有目录默认 0700 也能 recv（同 log/PPM），这里放宽便于取证 */
    g_init = 1;
}

static void hex16(const uint8_t *d, char out[17])
{
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) snprintf(out + i * 2, 3, "%02x", d[i]);
    out[16] = '\0';
}

/* 判重：开放寻址哈希（键 = sha256 前 8 字节）。原线性扫在 8192 时已是 O(n)，65536 会到 1e9 量级比较，
   直接拖慢渲染线程，所以容量放大必须同时换实现。容量语义不变：超过 SD_SEEN_MAX 个唯一键后计 loseen。 */
static int sd_seen(uint64_t k)
{
    if (!k) k = 1;                                   /* 0 是空槽标记 */
    uint64_t h = k * 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull;
    const unsigned mask = SD_SEEN_SLOTS - 1u;
    unsigned base = (unsigned)(h >> 17);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < SD_SEEN_SLOTS; i++) {
        uint64_t *s = &g_seen[(base + i) & mask];
        if (*s == k) return 1;
        if (*s == 0) {
            if (g_seen_n >= SD_SEEN_MAX) { g_loseen++; return 1; }   /* 表满：按已见处理，不重复落盘 */
            *s = k;
            g_seen_n++;
            return 0;
        }
    }
    g_loseen++;
    return 1;
}

static int sd_write(const char *path, const void *p, size_t n)
{
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "wb");
    if (!f) return -1;
    size_t w = fwrite(p, 1, n, f);
    int closed = fclose(f);
    return (w == n && closed == 0) ? 0 : -1;
}

static void sd_totals(const char *why)
{
    unsigned long long avg = g_dumped ? g_code_sum / g_dumped : 0ull;
    vk_boot_logf("[s] shader totals n=%lu uniq=%lu dumped=%lu bad=%lu bytes=%lu full=%lu loseen=%lu "
                 "exists=%lu avg_code=%llu max_code=%u s0=%llu s1=%llu s5=%llu seen=%u (%s)",
                 g_calls, g_uniq, g_dumped, g_bad, g_bytes, g_full, g_loseen, g_exists,
                 avg, g_code_max, g_stage_n[0], g_stage_n[1], g_stage_n[2], g_seen_n, why);
}

/* M3r（2026-11-03）：校验抽成一处，落盘侧（sd_one）与运行时查表侧（shader_key）共用同一判据，
   防止两边判据漂移导致「dump 有、查表没有」。 */
/* M3v P2：why = 首个不满足的判据（sd_validate 按原 `&&` 链的顺序逐个判，第一个失败就停），
   让 key_bad 能按原因归因，而不是只知道「1011 条不好」。 */
enum { SD_OK = 0, SD_BAD_PTR, SD_BAD_MAGIC, SD_BAD_CTL_LEN, SD_BAD_CODE_LEN, SD_BAD_STAGE, SD_BAD_HDR };
typedef struct { uint32_t magic, ctl_len, code_len, stage, hdr; int why; int no_sha; } sd_hdr;
static unsigned long long g_cs_nohdr;   /* M3v P2：stage=5 无图形 magic 头而放行的笔数 */
static unsigned g_mapgate_logged;       /* M5m：只记不判的映射结论样本数（前 8 笔） */

/* M5n：shader-key 这条路径读 guest 内存是**为了算 key**，所以一次假"读不动"就等于丢一条管线。
   统一走 runtime_safe_read_ungated（硬边界 + SIGSEGV 兜底，不把截断/冻结的 maps 表当判据）：
   m5m 实测该表把 104216 次可读访问判成不可读、真 fault 0 次，结果 52030 次 stage key 全 -1。
   取证侧（threads.c 的 fx_read64）仍用带闸门的 runtime_safe_read，那里少一个样本无所谓。 */
static int sd_read(void *dst, uint64_t a, size_t n) { return runtime_safe_read_ungated(dst, a, n); }

/* ---- M7D3（2026-11-07）：真机 key=0 的取证与单点修（两个文件开关，C 默认 0） ----
   · smo_m7f = 探针：每 stage 一条 `[m7f] set` + `[m7f] key`（各硬上限 64 行），
     外加每 5 s 一次 `[m7f] badwhy stage=… reason=… n=…`（key_bad 的 stage×reason 直方图）。
   · smo_sha_ungated = 单点修（旧名 smo_m7fix 仍被认作别名）：`no_sha` 不再由
     /proc/self/maps 预测表（最多 768 条、首次快照，loader.c:396/411/457）决定，
     改成**真读**（M5n 的 runtime_safe_read_ungated）决定：读得动 ⇒ no_sha=0 ⇒ 算真 SHA；
     真读不动 ⇒ no_sha=1。整段 SHA 也走分块安全读，任一块读不动才退化成零 key。
     0 = 逐字恢复旧行为（旧表判据 + 整段裸 CC_SHA256_Update + 未映射时填空零 key）。
   回退：`echo 0 > …/smo_m7f` / `smo_sha_ungated`（≤2 s 生效），不重建也能关。 */
#define D3F_PATH_A "/data/storage/el2/base/files/smo_m7f"
#define D3F_PATH_B "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files/smo_m7f"
#define D3SHA_PATH_A "/data/storage/el2/base/files/smo_sha_ungated"
#define D3SHA_PATH_B "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files/smo_sha_ungated"
#define D3FIX_PATH_A "/data/storage/el2/base/files/smo_m7fix"     /* 旧名，别名 */
#define D3FIX_PATH_B "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files/smo_m7fix"
static unsigned long long d3_now_ms(void)
{
    struct timespec ts;
    if (clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts) != 0) return 0;
    return (unsigned long long)ts.tv_sec * 1000ull + (unsigned long long)(ts.tv_nsec / 1000000L);
}
/* -1 = 两个路径都没有这个文件；否则读第一个字符（'1' = on）。 */
static int d3_file_tri(const char *pa, const char *pb)
{
    char b[8]; FILE *f;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        if ((f = fopen(i ? pb : pa, "r"))) {
            size_t n = fread(b, 1, sizeof b - 1, f);
            fclose(f);
            return (n > 0 && b[0] == '1') ? 1 : 0;
        }
    }
    return -1;
}
static int d3_file_on(const char *pa, const char *pb) { return d3_file_tri(pa, pb) == 1; }
/* 2 s 缓存：hot path 上只有一次单调时钟读，稳态零 I/O。 */
static int d3_cache(int (*raw)(void), int *v, unsigned long long *stamp)
{
    unsigned long long t = d3_now_ms();
    if (*v < 0 || t >= *stamp + 2000ull) { *v = raw() ? 1 : 0; *stamp = t; }
    return *v;
}
static int g_d3f = -1, g_d3sha = -1;
static unsigned long long g_d3f_stamp, g_d3sha_stamp;
static int d3_f_raw(void) { return d3_file_on(D3F_PATH_A, D3F_PATH_B); }
static int d3_sha_raw(void)
{
    int v = d3_file_tri(D3SHA_PATH_A, D3SHA_PATH_B);
    if (v < 0) v = d3_file_tri(D3FIX_PATH_A, D3FIX_PATH_B);   /* 旧名别名 */
    return v == 1;
}
static int d3_vf(void) { return d3_cache(d3_f_raw, &g_d3f, &g_d3f_stamp); }
static int d3_vsha(void) { return d3_cache(d3_sha_raw, &g_d3sha, &g_d3sha_stamp); }
__attribute__((constructor)) static void d3_seed(void)
{
    static const char *const p[6] = { D3F_PATH_A, D3F_PATH_B, D3SHA_PATH_A, D3SHA_PATH_B,
                                      D3FIX_PATH_A, D3FIX_PATH_B };
    for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        FILE *r = fopen(p[i], "r");
        if (r) { fclose(r); continue; }
        FILE *f = fopen(p[i], "w");
        if (f) { fputs("0\n", f); fclose(f); }
    }
}
/* 分块安全读 → SHA256。返回 0 = 某一段真读不动（此时调用方填零 key，与旧行为同口径）。 */
static int sd_sha_seg(CC_SHA256_CTX *c, uint64_t a, size_t n)
{
    uint8_t buf[512];
    while (n) {
        size_t k = n > sizeof buf ? sizeof buf : n;
        if (!runtime_safe_read_ungated(buf, a, k)) return 0;
        CC_SHA256_Update(c, buf, k);
        a += (uint64_t)k; n -= k;
    }
    return 1;
}

static int sd_validate(const void *ctl, uint64_t code_addr, sd_hdr *h)
{
    h->why = SD_BAD_PTR;
    h->hdr = 0;
    h->no_sha = 0;
    if (!ctl || (uintptr_t)ctl < 0x1000 || code_addr < 0x1000) return 0;
    /* M5m：闸门改「只记不判」。M5l 曾把 /proc/self/maps 表当**判据**（表只收 768 条，截断就会把合法
       shader 判成 SD_BAD_PTR）。现在判据恢复 pre-M5l 原口径（只有上面三个条件 + 下面逐字段检查）：
         · 映射表结论只打日志（前 8 笔 [s] mapgate，绝不改 h->why）；
         · 读仍走 runtime_safe_read —— 这是读法不是判据，读不动返回 0 不 fault（pre-M5l 是裸读=崩）。 */
    if (g_mapgate_logged < 8 && !runtime_addr_range_mapped((uintptr_t)ctl, 0x718)) {
        g_mapgate_logged++;
        vk_boot_logf("[s] mapgate ctl=%p code=%#llx range=0x718 mapped=0 (log only; criterion unchanged)",
                     ctl, (unsigned long long)code_addr);
    }
    uint32_t f0 = 0, f1 = 0, f2 = 0, f3 = 0;
    if (!sd_read(&f0, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)ctl, 4) ||
        !sd_read(&f1, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)ctl + 0x20, 4) ||
        !sd_read(&f2, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)ctl + 0x704, 4) ||
        !sd_read(&f3, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)ctl + 0x714, 4)) {
        /* 读不动 = 指针真的不可读（pre-M5l 这里直接 SEGV 打死进程）。只记一笔，判据仍是 SD_BAD_PTR。 */
        if (g_mapgate_logged < 8) { g_mapgate_logged++; vk_boot_logf("[s] sd readfail ctl=%p (would have faulted pre-M5l)", ctl); }
        return 0;
    }
    h->magic = f0;
    h->ctl_len = f1;
    h->code_len = f2;
    h->stage = f3;
    /* 先只验控制段，全过了才去碰 code 指针——不然一个坏 data 指针就是段错误，坏数据只该计数。
       判据本身与本轮之前逐字等价（同一条链、同一顺序），只是把「第一个不过的」记进 h->why。 */
    if (h->magic != 0x98761234u)                          h->why = SD_BAD_MAGIC;
    else if (h->ctl_len < 0x40u || h->ctl_len > SD_CTL_MAX)  h->why = SD_BAD_CTL_LEN;
    else if (h->code_len < 0x30u || h->code_len > SD_CODE_MAX) h->why = SD_BAD_CODE_LEN;
    else if (!(h->stage == 0 || h->stage == 1 || h->stage == 5)) h->why = SD_BAD_STAGE;
    else {
        uint32_t hd = 0;
        if (!sd_read(&hd, code_addr, 4)) { h->hdr = 0; h->why = SD_BAD_HDR; return 0; }
        h->hdr = hd;
        /* M3v P2（取证后修）：stage=5（compute）的 code 段**没有**图形那两枚 magic 头。
           boot1 的 3 条样本一致：magic=98761234 / ctl_len=2120 / code_len=11520|12032 / stage=5 /
           code 首字 = 0xe22007f0（真实 SASS 首指令，不是 0x1234567x），判据却在 hdr 这关把 100%
           的计算 shader 判成坏数据（key_bad 1011 全部来自 stage=5，s0/s1 都是 0）。
           所以计算段只验已通过的控制段 + 长度，不再要求图形 magic 头；命中的笔数单独计数。 */
        if (h->stage == 5) { h->why = SD_OK; g_cs_nohdr++; }
        else h->why = (h->hdr == 0x12345678u || h->hdr == 0x12345679u) ? SD_OK : SD_BAD_HDR;
    }
    /* M5m：控制段过判据之后还有两段整块读（sd_sha_key / sd_one 的 SHA256 会整段 touch）。这里只把
       「整段是否映射」记进 h->no_sha，**不改判据**；no_sha=1 时两处 SHA256 都跳过（那是我们自己的
       取证计算，不是 shader 的合法性判据），这样既不会误判合法 shader，也不会自己撞进未映射页。
       M7D3（smo_sha_ungated=1）：no_sha 改由**真读**决定 —— 各段尾字节走一遍 M5n ungated 读，
       读得动就是 mapped（旧表只用来预报，不再当判据）；真读不动才置 1。0 = 旧行为逐字不变。 */
    if (h->why == SD_OK) {
        if (d3_vsha()) {
            uint8_t pb = 0;
            if (!sd_read(&pb, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)ctl + (uint64_t)h->ctl_len - 1u, 1) ||
                !sd_read(&pb, code_addr + (uint64_t)h->code_len - 1u, 1))
                h->no_sha = 1;
        } else if (!(runtime_addr_range_mapped((uintptr_t)ctl, h->ctl_len) &&
                     runtime_addr_range_mapped(code_addr, h->code_len))) {
            h->no_sha = 1;
        }
    }
    return h->why == SD_OK;
}

static unsigned long long g_d3_zero_key, g_d3_real_key;   /* M7D3：占位零 key vs 真 SHA key 的计数 */

static void sd_zero_key(char out[17]) { memset(out, '0', 16); out[16] = 0; g_d3_zero_key++; }

static void sd_sha_key(const void *ctl, uint64_t code_addr, const sd_hdr *h, char out[17])
{
    if (h->no_sha) { sd_zero_key(out); return; }   /* M5m: whole-segment unmapped -> skip our own hash, never touch it */
    if (d3_vsha()) {   /* M7D3：真读分块（不信任 maps 预测表），读不动才退化成零 key */
        CC_SHA256_CTX c;
        uint8_t d[32];
        CC_SHA256_Init(&c);
        if (!sd_sha_seg(&c, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)ctl, h->ctl_len) ||
            !sd_sha_seg(&c, code_addr, h->code_len)) { sd_zero_key(out); return; }
        CC_SHA256_Final(d, &c);
        hex16(d, out);
        g_d3_real_key++;
        return;
    }
    CC_SHA256_CTX c;
    uint8_t d[32];
    CC_SHA256_Init(&c);
    CC_SHA256_Update(&c, ctl, h->ctl_len);
    CC_SHA256_Update(&c, (const void *)(uintptr_t)code_addr, h->code_len);
    CC_SHA256_Final(d, &c);
    hex16(d, out);
    g_d3_real_key++;
}

/* M3v P2：运行时查表侧（= gfx_bridge 的 key_bad）的失败归因。两维：
   ① 按 sd_validate 读到的原始 stage 字段分桶（0/1/5/其它/指针不可读）；
   ② 按首个不满足的判据分桶。样本：前 3 条带全字段落盘，够回答「magic/长度/stage/hdr 哪一条」。 */
static unsigned long long g_kb_reason[8];    /* 下标 = SD_BAD_* */
static unsigned long long g_kb_stage[5];     /* 0/1/5/其它/指针不可读 */
static unsigned long long g_kb_x[5][8];      /* M7D3：stage 桶 × reason 桶交叉表（[m7f] badwhy） */
static unsigned g_kb_samples;

static void sd_keybad_note(const sd_hdr *h)
{
    if (h->why >= 0 && h->why < 8) g_kb_reason[h->why]++;
    int sb;
    if (h->why == SD_BAD_PTR) sb = 4;
    else if (h->stage == 0) sb = 0;
    else if (h->stage == 1) sb = 1;
    else if (h->stage == 5) sb = 2;
    else sb = 3;
    g_kb_stage[sb]++;
    if (h->why >= 0 && h->why < 8) g_kb_x[sb][h->why]++;
    if (g_kb_samples < 3) {
        g_kb_samples++;
        vk_boot_logf("[s] key_bad sample #%u why=%s magic=%08x ctl_len=%u code_len=%u stage=%u hdr=%08x",
                     g_kb_samples,
                     h->why == SD_BAD_PTR ? "ptr" : h->why == SD_BAD_MAGIC ? "magic" :
                     h->why == SD_BAD_CTL_LEN ? "ctl_len" : h->why == SD_BAD_CODE_LEN ? "code_len" :
                     h->why == SD_BAD_STAGE ? "stage" : "hdr",
                     h->magic, h->ctl_len, h->code_len, h->stage, h->hdr);
    }
}

/* 运行时用：校验并算出 key。返 stage(0/1/5)，失败返 -1（out 不写）。 */
static int shader_key_h(const void *ctl, uint64_t code_addr, char out[17], sd_hdr *hout)
{
    sd_hdr h;
    memset(&h, 0, sizeof h);
    if (!out || !sd_validate(ctl, code_addr, &h)) {
        sd_keybad_note(&h);
        if (hout) *hout = h;
        return -1;
    }
    sd_sha_key(ctl, code_addr, &h, out);
    if (hout) *hout = h;
    return (int)h.stage;
}
int shader_key(const void *ctl, uint64_t code_addr, char out[17])
{
    return shader_key_h(ctl, code_addr, out, NULL);
}

/* M7D3：`[m7f] badwhy stage=… reason=… n=…` —— key_bad 的 stage×reason 直方图，5 s 一次。
   同一行末尾带 zero_key/real_key（sd_sha_key 的两条出口计数），这是"key 到底是占位零还是真 SHA"的
   直接读数。只读、无参数、无 I/O（除开关文件 2 s 缓存）。 */
static void d3_badwhy_tick(void)
{
    static unsigned long long last;
    static int seeded;
    if (!d3_vf()) return;
    unsigned long long t = d3_now_ms();
    if (seeded && t < last + 5000ull) return;
    last = t; seeded = 1;
    static const char *const stn[5] = { "0", "1", "5", "other", "unread" };
    static const char *const rsn[8] = { "ok", "ptr", "magic", "ctl_len", "code_len", "stage", "hdr", "?" };
    int lines = 0;
    for (int s = 0; s < 5 && lines < 12; s++)
        for (int r = 1; r < 8 && lines < 12; r++)
            if (g_kb_x[s][r]) {
                lines++;
                vk_boot_logf("[m7f] badwhy stage=%s reason=%s n=%llu", stn[s], rsn[r], g_kb_x[s][r]);
            }
    vk_boot_logf("[m7f] badwhy stage=all reason=all n=%llu zero_key=%llu real_key=%llu no_sha_gate=%d sha_ungated=%d",
                 g_kb_reason[1] + g_kb_reason[2] + g_kb_reason[3] + g_kb_reason[4] +
                 g_kb_reason[5] + g_kb_reason[6] + g_kb_reason[7],
                 g_d3_zero_key, g_d3_real_key, d3_vsha() ? 0 : 1, d3_vsha());
}

/* M3v P2：key_bad 分解报告（由 gfx_bridge 的 [p] program totals 之后调用）。 */
void shader_dump_keybad_report(void)
{
    unsigned long long tot = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) tot += g_kb_reason[i];
    d3_badwhy_tick();   /* M7D3：即使 key_bad=0 也要打（zero_key/real_key 是主读数） */
    if (!tot && !g_cs_nohdr) return;
    vk_boot_logf("[s] key_bad by stage: s0=%llu s1=%llu s5=%llu other=%llu unreadable=%llu total=%llu",
                 g_kb_stage[0], g_kb_stage[1], g_kb_stage[2], g_kb_stage[3], g_kb_stage[4], tot);
    vk_boot_logf("[s] key_bad by reason: ptr=%llu magic=%llu ctl_len=%llu code_len=%llu stage=%llu hdr=%llu cs_no_header_ok=%llu",
                 g_kb_reason[SD_BAD_PTR], g_kb_reason[SD_BAD_MAGIC], g_kb_reason[SD_BAD_CTL_LEN],
                 g_kb_reason[SD_BAD_CODE_LEN], g_kb_reason[SD_BAD_STAGE], g_kb_reason[SD_BAD_HDR], g_cs_nohdr);
}

/* 单条 shader：校验 → 算键 → 首见落盘。返回 0 = 已处理（落盘或去重命中），-1 = 判为 bad。 */
static int sd_one(const void *ctl, uint64_t code_addr, int idx)
{
    sd_hdr h = {0};
    int valid = sd_validate(ctl, code_addr, &h);
    if (!valid) {
        g_bad++;
        /* 指针本身不可信时不读任何字段（sd_validate 已在碰 ctl 前做过地址闸门，这里只是防日志崩） */
        /* M5l：这里的 raw16 原来也是裸读，闸门同样只有下界（`ctl=0xffffffffffffffff` 能过）——
           既判为 bad，就只在**整段映射**时才读样本，且读也走 runtime_safe_read。 */
        if (g_logged_bad < 8 && ctl && runtime_addr_range_mapped((uintptr_t)ctl, 16)) {
            uint8_t raw[16] = {0};
            if (runtime_safe_read(raw, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)ctl, sizeof raw)) {
                g_logged_bad++;
                vk_boot_logf("[s] layout BAD idx=%d ctl=%p magic=%08x ctl_len=%u code_len=%u stage=%u hdr=%08x raw16=%02x%02x%02x%02x%02x%02x%02x%02x%02x%02x%02x%02x%02x%02x%02x%02x",
                             idx, ctl, h.magic, h.ctl_len, h.code_len, h.stage, h.hdr,
                             raw[0], raw[1], raw[2], raw[3], raw[4], raw[5], raw[6], raw[7],
                             raw[8], raw[9], raw[10], raw[11], raw[12], raw[13], raw[14], raw[15]);
            } else {
                g_logged_bad++;
                vk_boot_logf("[s] layout BAD idx=%d ctl=%p (unreadable, no raw sample) why=%d", idx, ctl, (int)h.why);
            }
        }
        return -1;
    }
    /* P1 闸门证据：前 6 条通过校验的实读值（行号=本文件 sd_validate 的 +0x20/+0x704/+0x714）。 */
    if (g_logged_ok < 6) {
        g_logged_ok++;
        vk_boot_logf("[s] layout ok idx=%d ctl=%p magic=%08x ctl_len=%u code_len=%u stage=%u hdr=%08x",
                     idx, ctl, h.magic, h.ctl_len, h.code_len, h.stage, h.hdr);
    }

    uint8_t d[32];
    {   /* 键：沿用既有口径（此处与 sd_sha_key 等价；保留 d[] 是因为下面既要用 hex 又要用前 8 字节判重） */
        if (h.no_sha) {   /* M5m: valid but whole segment unmapped -> do not touch it (log once) */
            static int n_sha; if (!n_sha) { n_sha = 1; vk_boot_logf("[s] sha skip idx=%d ctl=%p (segment unmapped; criterion said OK)", idx, ctl); }
            return 0;
        }
        CC_SHA256_CTX c;
        CC_SHA256_Init(&c);
        /* M7D3：落盘侧同样改分块安全读（旧版是整段裸 Update，未映射时会真的 SEGV）。 */
        if (!sd_sha_seg(&c, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)ctl, h.ctl_len) ||
            !sd_sha_seg(&c, code_addr, h.code_len)) {
            static int n_sf; if (!n_sf) { n_sf = 1; vk_boot_logf("[s] sha skip idx=%d ctl=%p (chunked read failed)", idx, ctl); }
            return 0;
        }
        CC_SHA256_Final(d, &c);
    }
    char key[17], path[640], path2[640];
    hex16(d, key);
    uint64_t k;
    memcpy(&k, d, sizeof k);

    g_uniq++;                                   /* 口径：通过校验的不同键数（含超出上限未落盘的） */
    if (sd_seen(k)) return 0;
    if (g_dumped >= SD_MAX_KEYS) {
        if (!g_full) { vk_boot_logf("[s] dump full (keys=%lu) -> counting only", g_dumped); g_full = 1; }
        g_full++;
        return 0;
    }
    if (g_bytes + h.ctl_len + h.code_len > SD_MAX_BYTES) {
        if (!g_full) { vk_boot_logf("[s] dump full (bytes=%lu) -> counting only", g_bytes); g_full = 1; }
        g_full++;
        return 0;
    }

    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/%s.%u.ctl", g_dir, key, h.stage);
    snprintf(path2, sizeof path2, "%s/%s.%u.code", g_dir, key, h.stage);
    /* M3w P3：跨进程去重。判重表只在本次进程内有效，而语料目录是跨 boot 累积的；
       已有同名文件就只计数（g_exists），不再重写、也不再往 index.txt 追一行——
       否则每次 boot 都把 index.txt 灌一遍重复键，下一轮烘焙会把同一条翻两遍。 */
    if (access(path, F_OK) == 0 && access(path2, F_OK) == 0) { g_exists++; return 0; }

    int e1 = sd_write(path, ctl, h.ctl_len);
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/%s.%u.code", g_dir, key, h.stage);
    int e2 = sd_write(path, (const void *)(uintptr_t)code_addr, h.code_len);
    if (e1 || e2) {
        g_bad++;
        vk_boot_logf("[s] dump write FAILED key=%s stage=%u e1=%d e2=%d errno=%d", key, h.stage, e1, e2, errno);
        return -1;
    }
    g_dumped++;
    g_bytes += h.ctl_len + h.code_len;
    g_code_sum += h.code_len;
    if (h.code_len > g_code_max) g_code_max = h.code_len;
    g_stage_n[h.stage == 5 ? 2 : (h.stage < 3 ? h.stage : 0)]++;
    vk_boot_logf("[s] shader key=%s stage=%u ctl=%u code=%u", key, h.stage, h.ctl_len, h.code_len);

    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/index.txt", g_dir);
    FILE *ix = fopen(path, "a");
    if (ix) {
        fprintf(ix, "%s %u ctl=%u code=%u magic=%08x hdr=%08x\n", key, h.stage, h.ctl_len, h.code_len, h.magic, h.hdr);
        fclose(ix);
    }
    return 0;
}

/* M7D3：`prog` 只用于探针行（谁在 SetShaders 里算 key）。宽高上限：
   `[m7f] set` 与 `[m7f] key` 各 64 行 —— 够覆盖前 32 次 SetShaders 的两阶段，
   之后静默（只留 badwhy 汇总），不会把 boot 日志刷爆。 */
static unsigned g_d3_set_lines, g_d3_key_lines;
int shader_dump_key_at(const void *sd, int i, uint64_t prog, char out[17])
{
    if (!sd || i < 0) return -1;
    const uint8_t *e = (const uint8_t *)sd + (size_t)i * 16;   /* NVNshaderData = {u64 data; const void *control;} */
    uint64_t a = 0, b = 0;
    /* M5l：描述符数组本身是 guest 指针（NVNshaderData[]），原来两个 rd64 是裸读。 */
    if (!sd_read(&a, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(e + 8), 8)) { if (d3_vf() && g_d3_set_lines < 64) { g_d3_set_lines++; vk_boot_logf("[m7f] set ptr=%#llx idx=%d ctl=unreadable result=-1", (unsigned long long)prog, i); } return -1; }
    if (!sd_read(&b, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(e + 0), 8)) { if (d3_vf() && g_d3_set_lines < 64) { g_d3_set_lines++; vk_boot_logf("[m7f] set ptr=%#llx idx=%d code=unreadable result=-1", (unsigned long long)prog, i); } return -1; }
    sd_hdr h;
    int st = shader_key_h((const void *)(uintptr_t)a, b, out, &h);
    if (d3_vf()) {
        if (g_d3_set_lines < 64) {
            g_d3_set_lines++;
            vk_boot_logf("[m7f] set ptr=%#llx idx=%d ctl=%p magic=%08x ctl_len=%u code_len=%u stage=%u hdr=%08x no_sha=%d result=%d",
                         (unsigned long long)prog, i, (const void *)(uintptr_t)a, h.magic, h.ctl_len,
                         h.code_len, h.stage, h.hdr, h.no_sha, st);
        }
        if (g_d3_key_lines < 64) {
            g_d3_key_lines++;
            vk_boot_logf("[m7f] key ptr=%#llx idx=%d vs=%s fs=%s ok=%d why=%s no_sha=%d key=%s",
                         (unsigned long long)prog, i, st == 0 ? out : "-", st == 1 ? out : "-",
                         st >= 0, st >= 0 ? "ok" : (h.why == SD_BAD_PTR ? "ptr" : h.why == SD_BAD_MAGIC ? "magic" :
                         h.why == SD_BAD_CTL_LEN ? "ctl_len" : h.why == SD_BAD_CODE_LEN ? "code_len" :
                         h.why == SD_BAD_STAGE ? "stage" : "hdr"), h.no_sha, st >= 0 ? out : "-");
        }
    }
    return st;
}

void shader_dump_program(int n, const void *sd)
{
    if (!sd || n <= 0) return;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mu);
    g_calls++;
    if (!g_init) sd_dir_init();
    static unsigned g_desc_bad;   /* M5l：描述符数组读不动的笔数（前 3 笔留地址样本） */
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const uint8_t *e = (const uint8_t *)sd + (size_t)i * 16;   /* NVNshaderData = {u64 data; const void *control;} */
        uint64_t data = 0, ctl = 0;
        if (!sd_read(&data, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)e, 8) ||
            !sd_read(&ctl, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(e + 8), 8)) {
            g_desc_bad++;
            if (g_desc_bad <= 3)
                vk_boot_logf("[s] desc unreadable sd=%p i=%d/%d (skip; mapped=%d) — M5l safe-read, not a crash",
                             sd, i, n, runtime_addr_mapped((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)e));
            continue;
        }
        sd_one((const void *)(uintptr_t)ctl, data, i);
    }
    if (g_calls % 100 == 0) sd_totals("periodic");
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mu);
}

void shader_dump_report(void)
{
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mu);
    if (g_calls) sd_totals("final");
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mu);
}
```

```c
/* nn::pl shared fonts: the verified system BFTTF files laid out back to back as in the pl shared memory.
   GetSharedFontAddress points 8 bytes past each file start (after the BFTTF header), as the SDK adds the
   service-provided offset to the shared memory base; the size is the decoded font size. */
#include "runtime.h"
#include "shared_fonts_config.h"
#include "shared_fonts_data.h"
#include <CommonCrypto/CommonDigest.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
typedef struct{const char *path;uint64_t file_bytes,font_bytes;const char *sha256;} FontRow;
static const FontRow rows[SHARED_FONT_COUNT]={SHARED_FONT_ROWS};
static uint8_t *region;static uint64_t offsets[SHARED_FONT_COUNT];
static pthread_once_t once=PTHREAD_ONCE_INIT;
static void need(int c,const char *m){if(!c)runtime_fail(m);}
static void load(void){
 /* Bayonetta 3: the NSPs do not carry the system fonts; scripts/prepare_runtime.py leaves the rows empty without them. */
 if(!rows[0].path[0])runtime_fail("the game asked for the system shared fonts: extract them from your own Switch firmware to Odyssey_build/extracted/firmware/shared-fonts (scripts/extract_shared_fonts.py) and run scripts/prepare_runtime.py again");
 uint64_t total=0;for(int i=0;i<SHARED_FONT_COUNT;i++)total+=rows[i].file_bytes;
 region=malloc(total);need(region!=NULL,"shared font memory");
 uint64_t at=0;
 for(int i=0;i<SHARED_FONT_COUNT;i++){
  if(rows[i].path[0]==':'){   /* ":embedded:N": Windows-TTF stand-ins baked in by game-work/make_shared_fonts.py */
   memcpy(region+at,SHARED_FONT_DATA+SHARED_FONT_DATA_OFF[i],(size_t)rows[i].file_bytes);
  }else{
  /* TOTK_SHARED_FONTS=<dir>: the same verified files in another directory (iOS: copied into the app's Documents). */
  char path[4096];const char *dir=getenv("TOTK_SHARED_FONTS"),*base=strrchr(rows[i].path,'/');
  if(dir)need(snprintf(path,sizeof path,"%s/%s",dir,base?base+1:rows[i].path)<(int)sizeof path,"shared font path");
  FILE *f=fopen(dir?path:rows[i].path,"rb");need(f!=NULL,"open shared font");
  need(fread(region+at,1,rows[i].file_bytes,f)==rows[i].file_bytes&&fgetc(f)==EOF,"shared font size");fclose(f);
  }
  uint8_t d[32];char hex[65];CC_SHA256(region+at,(CC_LONG)rows[i].file_bytes,d);for(int k=0;k<32;k++)snprintf(hex+k*2,3,"%02x",d[k]);
  need(!strcmp(hex,rows[i].sha256),"shared font integrity mismatch");
  /* BFTTF stores each big-endian payload word XORed with the key encoded in
     its first word. The Switch pl service exposes decoded sfnt bytes. */
  uint8_t *font=region+at+8,*header=region+at;
  uint32_t encoded=((uint32_t)header[0]<<24)|((uint32_t)header[1]<<16)|((uint32_t)header[2]<<8)|header[3];
  uint32_t key=encoded^0x7f9a0218u;
  need(rows[i].font_bytes+8==rows[i].file_bytes,"shared font BFTTF length");
  for(uint64_t j=0;j<rows[i].font_bytes;j++)font[j]^=(uint8_t)(key>>(24-8*(j&3)));
  need((font[0]==0&&font[1]==1&&font[2]==0&&font[3]==0)||
       (font[0]=='O'&&font[1]=='T'&&font[2]=='T'&&font[3]=='O'),"shared font decoded sfnt header");
  offsets[i]=at+8;at+=rows[i].file_bytes;
 }
 fprintf(stderr,"[totk] shared fonts loaded: %d fonts, %llu bytes\n",SHARED_FONT_COUNT,(unsigned long long)total);
}
static int valid(int type){if(type<0||type>=SHARED_FONT_COUNT)runtime_fail("invalid shared font type");pthread_once(&once,load);return type;}
static int load_state(int type){valid(type);return 1;}   /* SharedFontLoadState_Loaded */
static const void *address(int type){return region+offsets[valid(type)];}
static size_t size(int type){return (size_t)rows[valid(type)].font_bytes;}
void *runtime_font_override(const char *name){
 static const struct{const char *name;void *fn;} entries[]={
  {"_ZN2nn2pl22GetSharedFontLoadStateENS0_14SharedFontTypeE",load_state},
  {"_ZN2nn2pl20GetSharedFontAddressENS0_14SharedFontTypeE",address},
  {"_ZN2nn2pl17GetSharedFontSizeENS0_14SharedFontTypeE",size}};
 for(unsigned i=0;i<sizeof(entries)/sizeof(*entries);i++)if(!strcmp(name,entries[i].name))return entries[i].fn;return NULL;
}
```

`mario-odessy-harmony/entry/src/main/cpp/platform/swkbd_host.c`:

```c
/* Text entry for the game (nn::swkbd::ShowKeyboard) with the Mac keyboard.

   On the Switch the call starts the software-keyboard library applet, which takes the screen until the player confirms
   or cancels. Here the player types on the Mac keyboard in a bar inside the game window (runtime_front_text_input in
   runtime/frontend.m; input methods work, Return confirms, Escape cancels). User, 2026-10-17: "no software keyboard,
   just support the user's keyboard". TOTK calls it in one place: naming a horse (main+0x1e5cb58 -> main+0x1adb720:
   user-name preset, at most 9 characters, '@' '%' '\' disabled, UTF-16 output; an empty name counts as cancelled).

   ABI of TOTK 1.0.0's SDK, read from the original sdk+0x3cbd40 (ShowKeyboard with a trigger) and the setters
   MakePreset / SetHeaderText / SetSubText / SetGuideText / SetOkText / SetInitialText (analysis/swkbd/sdk-swkbd-named.c):
   ShowKeyboardArg = KeyboardConfig (0x4d0 bytes), then the work buffer {pointer, size} at +0x4d0 / +0x4d8 (the initial
   text lives there), then the text-check and customize-dictionary buffers. String = {pointer, byte size}
   (GetRequiredStringBufferSize: 0x7d4). The result is 0, or 0x29f when the player cancels (the SDK's value for a cancel
   close result). The disabled-key bits follow the applet's: 1 space, 2 '@', 3 '%', 4 '/', 5 '\', 6 digits (7 download
   code and 8 user name are character sets the applet knows; not applied here).

   TOTK_SWKBD_ANSWER=<text> answers without showing the bar (tests; "<cancel>" cancels, "<initial>" keeps the initial text).
   make probe-swkbd builds the arguments with the guest SDK and calls through main's own PLT stub. */
#include "runtime.h"
#include "totk_ui_lang.h"
#include <TargetConditionals.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

enum {
    KB_TYPE = 0x00, KB_OK_TEXT = 0x04, KB_DISABLED = 0x1c, KB_HEADER = 0x24, KB_SUB = 0xa6, KB_GUIDE = 0x1a8,
    KB_MAX_LEN = 0x3ac, KB_MIN_LEN = 0x3b0, KB_MASKED = 0x3b4 /* hidden-text entry */, KB_UTF8 = 0x3bd, KB_INIT_OFF = 0x3c0, KB_INIT_LEN = 0x3c4,
    ARG_WORK = 0x4d0, ARG_WORK_SIZE = 0x4d8, ARG_SIZE = 0x500,
    KB_TYPE_NUMPAD = 1, KB_LIMIT = 500, SWKBD_CANCELED = 0x29f,
};

static uint32_t rd32(const uint8_t *p) { uint32_t v; memcpy(&v, p, 4); return v; }
static uint64_t rd64(const uint8_t *p) { uint64_t v; memcpy(&v, p, 8); return v; }
static size_t u16_len(const uint16_t *s, size_t max) { size_t n = 0; while (n < max && s[n]) n++; return n; }

/* UTF-16 (n units) -> NUL-terminated UTF-8 in cap bytes, cut at a character boundary. Returns the bytes written. */
static size_t utf16_to_utf8(const uint16_t *s, size_t n, char *out, size_t cap) {
    size_t o = 0;
    if (!cap) return 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        uint32_t c = s[i];
        if (c >= 0xd800 && c < 0xdc00 && i + 1 < n && s[i + 1] >= 0xdc00 && s[i + 1] < 0xe000)
            c = 0x10000 + ((c - 0xd800) << 10) + (s[++i] - 0xdc00);
        else if (c >= 0xd800 && c < 0xe000) c = 0xfffd;
        char b[4]; size_t k;
        if (c < 0x80) { b[0] = (char)c; k = 1; }
        else if (c < 0x800) { b[0] = (char)(0xc0 | c >> 6); b[1] = (char)(0x80 | (c & 0x3f)); k = 2; }
        else if (c < 0x10000) { b[0] = (char)(0xe0 | c >> 12); b[1] = (char)(0x80 | ((c >> 6) & 0x3f)); b[2] = (char)(0x80 | (c & 0x3f)); k = 3; }
        else { b[0] = (char)(0xf0 | c >> 18); b[1] = (char)(0x80 | ((c >> 12) & 0x3f)); b[2] = (char)(0x80 | ((c >> 6) & 0x3f)); b[3] = (char)(0x80 | (c & 0x3f)); k = 4; }
        if (o + k + 1 > cap) break;
        memcpy(out + o, b, k); o += k;
    }
    out[o] = 0;
    return o;
}

/* UTF-8 -> UTF-16, at most cap units (a character that does not fit whole is dropped); bad bytes become U+FFFD. */
static size_t utf8_to_utf16(const char *s, uint16_t *out, size_t cap) {
    const unsigned char *p = (const unsigned char *)s; size_t n = 0;
    while (*p) {
        uint32_t c; int k;
        if (*p < 0x80) { c = *p; k = 0; }
        else if ((*p & 0xe0) == 0xc0) { c = *p & 0x1f; k = 1; }
        else if ((*p & 0xf0) == 0xe0) { c = *p & 0x0f; k = 2; }
        else if ((*p & 0xf8) == 0xf0) { c = *p & 0x07; k = 3; }
        else { c = 0xfffd; k = 0; }
        p++;
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++, p++) {
            if ((*p & 0xc0) != 0x80) { c = 0xfffd; break; }
            c = c << 6 | (*p & 0x3f);
        }
        if (c > 0x10ffff || (c >= 0xd800 && c < 0xe000)) c = 0xfffd;
        if (c >= 0x10000) {
            if (n + 2 > cap) break;
            out[n++] = (uint16_t)(0xd800 + ((c - 0x10000) >> 10)); out[n++] = (uint16_t)(0xdc00 + ((c - 0x10000) & 0x3ff));
        } else {
            if (n + 1 > cap) break;
            out[n++] = (uint16_t)c;
        }
    }
    return n;
}

/* Whether the applet would let this character through (single UTF-16 units; pairs are always allowed). */
static int allowed(uint16_t c, uint32_t disabled, int digits_only) {
    int digit = c >= '0' && c <= '9';
    if (digits_only && !digit) return 0;
    if (c < 0x20 || c == 0x7f) return 0;
    if ((disabled & 1u << 1 && c == ' ') || (disabled & 1u << 2 && c == '@') || (disabled & 1u << 3 && c == '%')) return 0;
    if ((disabled & 1u << 4 && c == '/') || (disabled & 1u << 5 && c == '\\') || (disabled & 1u << 6 && digit)) return 0;
    return 1;
}

/* Drop disallowed characters and keep at most max units without splitting a surrogate pair. */
static size_t clean(uint16_t *t, size_t n, size_t max, uint32_t disabled, int digits_only) {
    size_t o = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int pair = t[i] >= 0xd800 && t[i] < 0xdc00 && i + 1 < n;
        size_t k = pair ? 2 : 1;
        if (!pair && !allowed(t[i], disabled, digits_only)) continue;
        if (o + k > max) break;
        t[o++] = t[i]; if (pair) t[o++] = t[++i];
    }
    return o;
}

static int negative(void) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_PROBE_NEGATIVE"); return e ? atoi(e) : 0; }

static unsigned show_keyboard(void *out_string, const void *arg_ptr) {
    const uint8_t *arg = arg_ptr; uint64_t *str = out_string;
    if (!arg || !str) runtime_fail("software keyboard: null argument");
    uint32_t type = rd32(arg + KB_TYPE), disabled = rd32(arg + KB_DISABLED), masked = rd32(arg + KB_MASKED);
    int32_t max_len = (int32_t)rd32(arg + KB_MAX_LEN), min_len = (int32_t)rd32(arg + KB_MIN_LEN);
    int utf8 = arg[KB_UTF8] != 0;
    if (max_len <= 0 || max_len > KB_LIMIT || negative() == 22) max_len = KB_LIMIT;   /* 22: probe's negative control */
    if (min_len < 0) min_len = 0;
    if (min_len > max_len) min_len = max_len;
    char header[0x41 * 4], sub[0x81 * 4], guide[0x101 * 4], ok[9 * 4], initial[KB_LIMIT * 4 + 1] = "";
    utf16_to_utf8((const uint16_t *)(arg + KB_HEADER), u16_len((const uint16_t *)(arg + KB_HEADER), 0x40), header, sizeof header);
    utf16_to_utf8((const uint16_t *)(arg + KB_SUB), u16_len((const uint16_t *)(arg + KB_SUB), 0x80), sub, sizeof sub);
    utf16_to_utf8((const uint16_t *)(arg + KB_GUIDE), u16_len((const uint16_t *)(arg + KB_GUIDE), 0x100), guide, sizeof guide);
    utf16_to_utf8((const uint16_t *)(arg + KB_OK_TEXT), u16_len((const uint16_t *)(arg + KB_OK_TEXT), 8), ok, sizeof ok);
    uint64_t work = rd64(arg + ARG_WORK), work_size = rd64(arg + ARG_WORK_SIZE);
    int32_t init_off = (int32_t)rd32(arg + KB_INIT_OFF), init_len = (int32_t)rd32(arg + KB_INIT_LEN);
    if (init_len > 0 && work && init_off >= 0 && (uint64_t)init_off + (uint64_t)init_len * 2 <= work_size)
        utf16_to_utf8((const uint16_t *)(uintptr_t)(work + (uint64_t)init_off), (size_t)(init_len > KB_LIMIT ? KB_LIMIT : init_len), initial, sizeof initial);
    char prompt[sizeof header + sizeof guide + 8];
    snprintf(prompt, sizeof prompt, "%s%s%s", *header ? header : *guide ? guide : *sub ? sub : TOTK_UI("输入文字","Enter text"),
             *header && (*guide || *sub) ? " — " : "", *header ? (*guide ? guide : sub) : "");

    char text[KB_LIMIT * 4 + 1] = ""; int confirmed = 0;
    const char *forced = getenv("TOTK_SWKBD_ANSWER");
    if (forced) {
        confirmed = strcmp(forced, "<cancel>") != 0;
        snprintf(text, sizeof text, "%s", strcmp(forced, "<initial>") ? forced : initial);
    } else {
#if TARGET_OS_OSX
        RuntimeTextRequest req = { prompt, initial, max_len, min_len, masked != 0, type == KB_TYPE_NUMPAD, disabled };
        int away = runtime_core_away();   /* the other guest threads keep running while the player types */
        confirmed = runtime_front_text_input(&req, text, sizeof text);
        runtime_core_back(&away);
#else
        fprintf(stderr, "[totk] keyboard: text entry is not available on this platform; cancelled\n");
#endif
    }
    uint16_t u[KB_LIMIT * 2];
    size_t n = confirmed ? clean(u, utf8_to_utf16(text, u, KB_LIMIT * 2), (size_t)max_len, disabled, type == KB_TYPE_NUMPAD) : 0;
    if (confirmed && (int32_t)n < min_len) { confirmed = 0; n = 0; }
    uint64_t buf = str[0], size = str[1];
    if (buf && size) {
        if (utf8) utf16_to_utf8(u, n, (char *)(uintptr_t)buf, size);
        else {
            size_t cap = size / 2;   /* units, one kept for the terminator */
            if (cap) {
                if (n > cap - 1) { n = cap - 1; if (n && u[n - 1] >= 0xd800 && u[n - 1] < 0xdc00) n--; }
                memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)buf, u, n * 2); ((uint16_t *)(uintptr_t)buf)[n] = 0;
            }
        }
    }
    char shown[sizeof text]; utf16_to_utf8(u, n, shown, sizeof shown);
    if (masked) snprintf(shown, sizeof shown, "(password, %zu characters, not logged)", n);
    fprintf(stderr, "[totk] keyboard: \"%s\" (type %u, %d-%d characters, disabled keys %#x, %s out)%s -> %s%s%s\n", prompt, type, min_len,
            max_len, disabled, utf8 ? "UTF-8" : "UTF-16", forced ? " [TOTK_SWKBD_ANSWER]" : "", confirmed ? "\"" : "cancelled",
            confirmed ? shown : "", confirmed ? "\"" : "");
    return confirmed ? 0 : SWKBD_CANCELED;
}

void *runtime_swkbd_override(const char *name) {
    if (!strcmp(name, "_ZN2nn5swkbd12ShowKeyboardEPNS0_6StringERKNS0_15ShowKeyboardArgE")) return show_keyboard;
    return NULL;
}

/* Diagnostic command "kbtest" (TOTK_INPUT_FILE, runtime/input.c): asks for text the way TOTK names a horse (user-name
   limits: 9 characters, '@' '%' '\' disabled), on a thread of its own so that "kbtype" / "kbenter" / "kbesc" can answer
   the bar while it waits. Logs what the game would get. */
static void *selftest_thread(void *unused) {
    (void)unused;
    uint8_t *arg = calloc(1, ARG_SIZE); uint16_t *out = calloc(1, 0x7d4); uint8_t *work = calloc(1, 0x1000);
    if (!arg || !out || !work) runtime_fail("keyboard self-test allocation");
    uint32_t max = 9, disabled = 0x12c; uint64_t w = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)work, ws = 0x1000;
    static const uint16_t title[] = {0x6d4b, 0x8bd5, 0xff1a, 0x7ed9, 0x9a6c, 0x53d6, 0x540d, 0};   /* 测试：给马取名 */
    memcpy(arg + KB_HEADER, title, sizeof title); memcpy(arg + KB_MAX_LEN, &max, 4); memcpy(arg + KB_DISABLED, &disabled, 4);
    memcpy(arg + ARG_WORK, &w, 8); memcpy(arg + ARG_WORK_SIZE, &ws, 8);
    uint64_t str[2] = { (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)out, 0x7d4 };
    unsigned r = show_keyboard(str, arg);
    char text[64]; utf16_to_utf8(out, u16_len(out, 0x3e9), text, sizeof text);
    fprintf(stderr, "[totk] keyboard self-test: result %#x, text \"%s\"\n", r, text);
    free(arg); free(out); free(work);
    return NULL;
}
void runtime_swkbd_selftest(void) {
    pthread_t t;
    if (pthread_create(&t, NULL, selftest_thread, NULL)) runtime_fail("keyboard self-test thread");
    pthread_detach(t);
}

/* ---------- probe (make probe-swkbd): guest SDK arguments, main's PLT stub, no window ---------- */
#include "game_version.h"
enum { MAIN_PLT_SHOW_KEYBOARD = 0, MAIN_GOT_SHOW_KEYBOARD = 0 };   /* Bayonetta 3: main's ShowKeyboard PLT/GOT not mapped yet; the probe refuses to run */
static unsigned checks;
static void need(int ok, const char *what) { checks++; if (!ok) { fprintf(stderr, "swkbd probe: %s\n", what); runtime_fail("software keyboard probe failed"); } }
static void *sym(const char *name) { void *p = runtime_symbol(name); if (!p) { fprintf(stderr, "swkbd probe: no %s\n", name); runtime_fail("software keyboard probe: guest symbol"); } return p; }
static int u16eq(const uint16_t *a, const char *utf8) {
    uint16_t b[64]; size_t n = utf8_to_utf16(utf8, b, 63); b[n] = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i <= n; i++) if (a[i] != b[i]) return 0;
    return 1;
}
static void *probe_thread(void *unused) {
    (void)unused; runtime_thread_init();
    typedef void (*MakePreset)(void *, int);
    typedef void (*SetText)(void *, const uint16_t *);
    typedef uint64_t (*Size)(void);
    typedef uint64_t (*WorkSize)(int);
    typedef unsigned (*Show)(void *, const void *);
    MakePreset make = (MakePreset)sym("_ZN2nn5swkbd10MakePresetEPNS0_14KeyboardConfigENS0_6PresetE");
    SetText header = (SetText)sym("_ZN2nn5swkbd13SetHeaderTextEPNS0_14KeyboardConfigEPKDs");
    SetText guide = (SetText)sym("_ZN2nn5swkbd12SetGuideTextEPNS0_14KeyboardConfigEPKDs");
    SetText initial = (SetText)sym("_ZN2nn5swkbd14SetInitialTextEPNS0_15ShowKeyboardArgEPKDs");
    Size string_size = (Size)sym("_ZN2nn5swkbd27GetRequiredStringBufferSizeEv");
    WorkSize work_size = (WorkSize)sym("_ZN2nn5swkbd25GetRequiredWorkBufferSizeEb");
    if (!MAIN_PLT_SHOW_KEYBOARD) runtime_fail("software keyboard probe: Bayonetta 3 PLT addresses are not mapped");
    uint8_t *main_base = runtime_module_base("main");
    need(main_base != NULL, "main module base");
    void *got; memcpy(&got, main_base + MAIN_GOT_SHOW_KEYBOARD, 8);
    need(got == runtime_hle_wrap((void *)show_keyboard), "main's ShowKeyboard GOT slot holds the host keyboard");
    Show show = (Show)(void *)(main_base + MAIN_PLT_SHOW_KEYBOARD);
    need(string_size() == 0x7d4 && work_size(0) == 0x1000, "SDK buffer sizes");

    uint8_t *arg = calloc(1, ARG_SIZE); uint64_t str[2] = { (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)malloc(0x7d4), 0x7d4 };
    uint8_t *wbuf = calloc(1, 0x1000);
    need(arg && str[0] && wbuf, "allocations");
    uint16_t *out = (uint16_t *)(uintptr_t)str[0];
    struct { int preset; uint32_t type, max, min, disabled; int utf8; const char *initial, *answer, *want; unsigned result; } cases[] = {
        {2, 0, 9, 0, 0x12c, 0, NULL, "Epona", "Epona", 0},                       /* TOTK's horse naming */
        {2, 0, 9, 0, 0x12c, 0, NULL, "ABCDEFGHIJKL", "ABCDEFGHI", 0},             /* at most 9 */
        {2, 0, 9, 0, 0x12c, 0, NULL, "a@b%c\\d e/f", "abcd e/f", 0},             /* '@' '%' '\' disabled */
        {2, 0, 9, 0, 0x12c, 0, NULL, "<cancel>", "", SWKBD_CANCELED},
        {0, 2, 0, 0, 0, 1, NULL, "小马Ab", "小马Ab", 0},                          /* UTF-8 out (checked below) */
        {0, 2, 3, 0, 0, 0, NULL, "小马🐴", "小马", 0},                            /* no half surrogate pair */
        {0, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0, "Zelda", "<initial>", "Zelda", 0},                     /* initial text from the work buffer */
        {0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, NULL, "a1b2c3", "123", 0},                            /* number pad */
        {0, 2, 9, 3, 0, 0, NULL, "ab", "", SWKBD_CANCELED},                       /* shorter than the minimum */
    };
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof cases / sizeof *cases; i++) {
        memset(arg, 0, ARG_SIZE); memset(wbuf, 0, 0x1000); memset(out, 0x55, 0x7d4);
        make(arg, cases[i].preset);
        static const uint16_t title[] = {0x540d, 0x5b57, 0};   /* 名字 */
        static const uint16_t hint[] = {'h', 'i', 'n', 't', 0};
        header(arg, title); guide(arg, hint);
        memcpy(arg + KB_TYPE, &cases[i].type, 4); memcpy(arg + KB_MAX_LEN, &cases[i].max, 4); memcpy(arg + KB_MIN_LEN, &cases[i].min, 4);
        if (cases[i].disabled) memcpy(arg + KB_DISABLED, &cases[i].disabled, 4);
        arg[KB_UTF8] = (uint8_t)cases[i].utf8;
        uint64_t w = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)wbuf, ws = 0x1000;
        memcpy(arg + ARG_WORK, &w, 8); memcpy(arg + ARG_WORK_SIZE, &ws, 8);
        if (cases[i].initial) { uint16_t t[16]; size_t n = utf8_to_utf16(cases[i].initial, t, 15); t[n] = 0; initial(arg, t); }
        setenv("TOTK_SWKBD_ANSWER", cases[i].answer, 1);
        unsigned r = show(str, arg);
        char what[160]; snprintf(what, sizeof what, "case %zu (%s): result %#x", i, cases[i].answer, r);
        need(r == cases[i].result, what);
        if (cases[i].utf8) need(!strcmp((const char *)out, cases[i].want), "UTF-8 output");
        else need(u16eq(out, cases[i].want), "UTF-16 output");
    }
    unsetenv("TOTK_SWKBD_ANSWER");
    printf("{\"status\":\"pass\",\"probe\":\"probe-swkbd\",\"checks\":%u,\"scope\":\"arguments built by the guest SDK (MakePreset, SetHeaderText, SetGuideText, SetInitialText), call through main's PLT stub and GOT slot: TOTK's horse-name preset, length limit, disabled keys, cancel, UTF-8 output, surrogate pairs, initial text from the work buffer, number pad, minimum length; answers from TOTK_SWKBD_ANSWER (the window bar is not exercised)\"}\n", checks);
    return NULL;
}
void runtime_swkbd_probe(void) {
    pthread_t t;
    if (pthread_create(&t, NULL, probe_thread, NULL) || pthread_join(t, NULL)) runtime_fail("software keyboard probe thread");
}
```

```c
/* Horizon services Bayonetta 3 reaches that TotK never did, answered in-process over IPC (ipc.c). Command numbers and
   layouts follow the public switchbrew descriptions. Unknown commands still stop the runtime with their id. */
#include "runtime.h"

#include <string.h>

/* ---------- set: nn::settings ISettingsServer ---------- */
/* nn::settings::Language order -> language code (switchbrew "Settings services", LanguageCode). */
static const char *const language_codes[] = {
    "ja", "en-US", "fr", "de", "it", "es", "zh-CN", "ko", "nl", "pt", "ru", "zh-TW", "en-GB", "fr-CA", "es-419",
    "zh-Hans", "zh-Hant", "pt-BR",
};
enum { LANGUAGES = sizeof language_codes / sizeof *language_codes, REGION_USA = 1 };

static uint64_t code_of(unsigned language) {
    uint64_t v = 0;
    memcpy(&v, language_codes[language], strlen(language_codes[language]));
    return v;
}
/* Writes up to `room` codes into a guest out buffer; returns how many. */
static int32_t write_codes(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) {
    uint64_t *out = ipc_guest(addr, size);
    int32_t n = 0;
    for (; n < LANGUAGES && (uint64_t)(n + 1) * 8 <= size; n++) out[n] = code_of((unsigned)n);
    return n;
}
static void settings_handler(IpcSession *s, const IpcRequest *rq, IpcResponse *rs) {
    switch (rq->cmd) {
    case 0: { uint64_t v = runtime_desired_language(); IPC_OUT(rs, v); return; }   /* GetLanguageCode */
    case 1: {                                                                    /* GetAvailableLanguageCodes (C buffer) */
        if (!rq->nc) runtime_fail("set GetAvailableLanguageCodes: no output buffer");
        int32_t n = write_codes(rq->c[0].addr, rq->c[0].size);
        rs->xout[rs->nxout++] = (IpcBuffer){rq->c[0].addr, (uint64_t)n * 8, 0};
        IPC_OUT(rs, n); return;
    }
    case 2: {                                                                    /* MakeLanguageCode(Language) */
        uint32_t language = IPC_ARG(rq, uint32_t, 0);
        if (language >= LANGUAGES) { fprintf(stderr, "[totk-set] MakeLanguageCode(%u)\n", language); runtime_fail("set MakeLanguageCode: unknown language"); }
        uint64_t v = code_of(language); IPC_OUT(rs, v); return;
    }
    case 3: case 6: { int32_t n = LANGUAGES; IPC_OUT(rs, n); return; }          /* GetAvailableLanguageCodeCount(2) */
    case 4: { int32_t v = REGION_USA; IPC_OUT(rs, v); return; }                   /* GetRegionCode */
    case 5: {                                                                    /* GetAvailableLanguageCodes2 (B buffer) */
        if (!rq->nb) runtime_fail("set GetAvailableLanguageCodes2: no output buffer");
        int32_t n = write_codes(rq->b[0].addr, rq->b[0].size); IPC_OUT(rs, n); return;
    }
    case 8: { uint8_t v = 0; IPC_OUT(rs, v); return; }                            /* GetQuestFlag: not a kiosk unit */
    default: ipc_unimplemented(s, rq);
    }
}

/* ---------- bsd:u: nn::socket, offline ---------- */
/* The game is played offline, as a Switch without a connection: the client registers and its monitor starts, but every
   socket it asks for fails with ENETDOWN. Commands return {s32 ret, u32 errno} (switchbrew "Sockets services"). */
enum { BSD_ENETDOWN = 50 };
static void bsd_result(IpcResponse *rs, int32_t ret, uint32_t err) { IPC_OUT(rs, ret); IPC_OUT(rs, err); }
static void bsd_handler(IpcSession *s, const IpcRequest *rq, IpcResponse *rs) {
    switch (rq->cmd) {
    case 0: { uint64_t pid = 0; IPC_OUT(rs, pid); return; }                         /* RegisterClient(config, tmem) */
    case 1: return;                                                               /* StartMonitoring(pid) */
    case 2: case 3:                                                               /* Socket / SocketExempt */
        fprintf(stderr, "[totk-net] socket(%u, %u, %u) refused: offline\n", IPC_ARG(rq, uint32_t, 0), IPC_ARG(rq, uint32_t, 4), IPC_ARG(rq, uint32_t, 8));

    }

    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof entries / sizeof *entries; i++) if (!strcmp(name, entries[i].name)) return entries[i].fn;
    return NULL;
}

__attribute__((constructor)) static void register_system_services(void) {
    /* Bayonetta 3 makes one 1348 MiB NVN memory pool at start; the shared graphics layer refuses zero-copy GPU buffers
       above 1 GiB unless told otherwise (nvn_mtl.m pool_buffer_max). A value the user set wins. */
    setenv("DM_POOL_BUFFER_MAX_MIB", "2048", 0);
    /* Present pacing as on the Switch: a 60 Hz base, the game's present interval on top (1 = 60 fps, 2 = 30 fps). The
       TotK host follows the display (120 Hz on ProMotion) and runs uncapped, which relies on TotK's real-time frame step
       patch; without it a game that advances per frame would run twice as fast. */
    setenv("DM_PRESENT_HZ", "60", 0);
    setenv("TOTK_UNCAPPED", "0", 0);
    /* It draws a depth pre-pass, then the colour pass with a LEQUAL test: positions must match bit for bit between the two
       (nvn_mtl.m totk_precise_opts, preserveInvariance). */
    setenv("DM_PRESERVE_INVARIANCE", "1", 0);
    /* Its shader binaries mix GLSLC GPU code versions (1.15 and 1.16 seen first); the graphics layer's measured driver
       table stops at 1.14. The layer reads only three control-section fields (code length, stage, compute group size)
       and stops on implausible values, so a newer layout would show at once. */
    setenv("DM_NVN_GPU_CODE_MAX_MINOR", "31", 0);
    runtime_ipc_register("set", settings_handler, NULL, NULL);
    runtime_ipc_register("bsd:u", bsd_handler, NULL, NULL);
}
```

```c
/* Adapted from pinned D2R Mobile host/hle_thread.c, MIT.
 * Game-specific diagnostics and optional timing accounting removed.
 * Core affinity is virtual bookkeeping; Darwin schedules pthreads. */
// Horizon 内核的线程与同步 SVC，原生实现：每个客体线程 = 一个宿主 pthread，跑在 SDK 给的客体栈上。
// SDK 的 nn::os 原样运行，只把它下面的「内核」换成宿主：
//   线程   0x08 CreateThread 0x09 StartThread 0x0A ExitThread 0x0B SleepThread 0x0C/0x0D 优先级 0x0E/0x0F 核掩码
//          0x10 GetCurrentProcessorNumber 0x25 GetThreadId 0x19 CancelSynchronization
//   锁     0x1A ArbitrateLock 0x1B ArbitrateUnlock（标签字 = 持有者句柄 | 0x40000000 有等待者）
//   条件   0x1C WaitProcessWideKeyAtomic 0x1D SignalProcessWideKey
//   地址   0x34 WaitForAddress 0x35 SignalToAddress
//   事件   0x45 CreateEvent 0x11 SignalEvent 0x12 ClearEvent 0x17 ResetSignal 0x18 WaitSynchronization 0x16 CloseHandle
// 语义按公开 Horizon 内核行为（Atmosphère mesosphère 的 KConditionVariable / KAddressArbiter / KSynchronization）。
// 所有等待挂在一把全局锁 G 上，每线程一个条件变量；先求正确，性能后量。
// Thread and synchronization SVCs of the Horizon kernel, implemented natively: each guest thread = one host pthread, running on the guest stack given by the SDK.
// The SDK's nn::os runs as is; only the "kernel" underneath it is replaced by the host:
//   Threads    0x08 CreateThread 0x09 StartThread 0x0A ExitThread 0x0B SleepThread 0x0C/0x0D priority 0x0E/0x0F core mask
//              0x10 GetCurrentProcessorNumber 0x25 GetThreadId 0x19 CancelSynchronization
//   Locks      0x1A ArbitrateLock 0x1B ArbitrateUnlock (tag word = owner handle | 0x40000000 has waiters)
//   Condition  0x1C WaitProcessWideKeyAtomic 0x1D SignalProcessWideKey
//   Address    0x34 WaitForAddress 0x35 SignalToAddress
//   Events     0x45 CreateEvent 0x11 SignalEvent 0x12 ClearEvent 0x17 ResetSignal 0x18 WaitSynchronization 0x16 CloseHandle
// Semantics follow the public Horizon kernel behavior (KConditionVariable / KAddressArbiter / KSynchronization of Atmosphère mesosphère).

enum { O_FREE, O_THREAD, O_EVENT_R, O_EVENT_W, O_SESSION, O_TMEM };   // O_SESSION / O_TMEM: IPC objects owned by ipc.c
/* M6h: the pair a readable event actually comes from. Until now an event_t was just {signaled, refs},
   so "who owns the write end of 0x1024" was unanswerable from the record. hw/hr are the two handles the
   kernel call returned (game side); a service-side event (runtime_event_new) has hw only, and a readable
   copy handed to the client (runtime_event_readable) fills hr. cre_* is the creator's identity. */
typedef struct event { int signaled; int refs;
                       uint32_t hw, hr;                 /* write-end / read-end handle as created (0 = none) */
                       uint32_t cre_thr;                /* guest thread handle that created it (0 = host/HLE) */
                       uint64_t cre_lr, born_ns;        /* creator LR + birth time */
                       int src;                         /* 0 = svc 0x45, 1 = HLE service write end, 2 = HLE readable copy */
} event_t;
typedef struct { uint32_t num; unsigned k; uint64_t a0, a1, a2, a3, lr; } ps_svc8_t;   /* M6m: one SVC as seen at entry */
/* M6o: the same record plus where the SVC actually was and how it was reached. `lr` above is useless as a
   call site (it is the patch-area gate stub, sdk+0xd3f3f4 for every 0x34 on this build); `pc` is the real
   module offset of the svc instruction (gates.tsv column 4) and bt[] is the frame-pointer chain read at
   entry, so "who called this syscall" no longer needs the SIGUSR2 sampler (which cannot hit main: signal
   masked, 5 of 13898 deliveries landed and none on main in M6n). */

typedef struct thr {

    int started, exited, cancel;

    uint64_t wseq;             // 登记等待的先后序号：同优先级先到先醒（与 Horizon 内核 KThread 等待树同序） | Sequence number of wait registration: at equal priority first come, first woken (same order as the Horizon kernel's KThread wait tree)

    uint64_t nsvc;             // SVC 次数（现场导出用） | SVC count (for the state dump)
    mach_port_t mport;         // 宿主线程端口（取 CPU 时间） | Host thread port (to get CPU time)
    uint32_t qos;
    _Atomic int qos_pending;   // 他线程 SetThreadPriority 改了 prio：目标线程下次 SVC 入口自套用（OH_QoS 只能设自身线程；donor hle_thread.c:77）
    _Atomic int cur_core;              // virtual core held while running guest code, -1 while blocked / not started
    _Atomic int preempt;               // a higher-priority thread waits for this thread's core
    _Atomic int kicked;
    uint64_t preempt_ns, cwait_ns;
    uint64_t cseq, core_since; struct thr *cnext;
    /* M6s: time this thread spent inside core_take's handoff wait, and how many times. Written only by
       the thread itself on the slow path (it was already parked there); a wait session reads the delta,
       so the fast path gets no extra timestamp. */
    uint64_t cw_n, cw_ns;
    uint64_t rel_t0;           /* M6t A1: now_ns() when this thread gave its core up around a blocking host wait */
    uint32_t cre_h; uint64_t cre_lr;   /* M6t C7: who created this thread (handle + guest LR), for the exit evidence */
    uint32_t wh[4]; int nwh;   // handles of the current WaitSynchronization (state dump)
    int last_hle;              // 1 + wrapper index of the last host call made while "hletrace" was on (state dump)
    int spin_pin;              // round3 自旋采样器选中且尚未放回：thr_free 跳过回收（防放锁后 use-after-free，泄露=取证可接受） | Pinned by the spin sampler between G sections: thr_free must not free it yet
    int htid;                  // 宿主 tid（/proc/self/task 对应用；round3 采样失败诊断） | Host tid for /proc/self/task lookups
    uint64_t yrun_ns, yrun_svc;   // the current run of yields: when it started, and nsvc at its last yield (yield_backoff_ns)
    int op; uint64_t op_ns;    // M5b：本线程最后进入的那个宿主 NVN 重活（1 submit / 2 pipeline / 3 tex upload），只记入口；卡住时「是哪个 + 多久没换」就是卡在哪个宿主调用里的证据 | M5b: last heavy host NVN call this thread entered (1 submit, 2 pipeline, 3 tex upload); entry only, so while a thread is stuck inside one this stays put and its age says how long
    int mvs;                   // M6l: index into the [lp] mover table (0..4), -1 = not one of the observed threads. Set once when the handle is assigned, so the per-SVC cost is one compare | M6l: slot index for the [lp] mover table, -1 = not observed
    /* M6m: the newest eight SVCs this thread issued (num, x0..x3, guest LR, dump#). A rolling ring, so a
       thread that stops keeps its last eight forever -- that is what "what was the poster doing just
       before it stopped" needs. Written only by the thread itself, read by the dump without a lock. */
    ps_svc8_t svc8[8];
    unsigned svc8i;
    /* M6o: the same ring slots with the SVC pc and the frame-pointer backtrace. Filled for main (0x1001)
       only: main issues ~26 SVC/s so the three stack reads cost nothing, while a 700k-SVC/min poller
       would turn a forensic probe into a slowdown. Same index as svc8. */
    ps_svc8x_t svc8x[8];
    /* M6n: total SVCs ever written into svc8 (monotonic). svc8i is a wrapped ring index, so a dump that
       printed min(svc8i,8) entries could print fewer than eight and misread it as "the ring is not full".
       Readers use min(svc8t,8) instead; svc8i stays the write position. */
    unsigned svc8t;
    // M5c：阶段环。op 只有「最后一个」一个值，分不清「卡在这一段里」与「早就出了这一段、卡在下一个没打点的地方」。
    // 环记最近 16 个 {op, arg, 时刻}；冻结 dump 打出末 6 个 ⇒ 停在哪一步 + 停之前走过哪几步一目了然。
    // 只本线程写、无锁；dump 侧容忍撕裂（诊断用）。seq 单调增：两次 dump 之间 seq 不变 = 卡在一个调用里，
    // seq 在涨 = 在「很多次小调用」里循环，两者是完全不同的病。
    struct { int op; uint64_t arg, ns; } phev[16];
    unsigned phe_i; uint64_t phe_seq;
    /* M6i：I/O 与 IPC 归属账。调用者自己是唯一写者（每次 open/read/IPC 请求约四个原子加），
       心跳线程 dump 时无锁读；撕裂只会印错一个诊断数值，不参与任何判定。
       M6i: per-thread I/O + IPC ledger. The calling guest thread is the only writer (about four
       atomics per open/read/IPC request); the heartbeat thread reads it without a lock, so a torn
       value can only misprint a diagnostic number and never decides anything. */
    _Atomic uint64_t io_open, io_read, io_bytes, io_ipc;
    _Atomic uint64_t io_last_io_ns;     /* 该线程最后一次 open/read 的时刻 | last open/read by this thread */
    _Atomic uint64_t io_last_lr;        /* 那次 I/O 所在 SVC 的客体返回地址 | guest LR of the SVC in flight then */
    _Atomic uint32_t io_last_svc;       /* 那次 I/O 所在的 SVC 号 | SVC number then */
    char io_path[96];                   /* 该线程最近一次打开的路径（无锁拷贝，撕裂可接受） | newest path opened here */
    /* M7i: the guest (sp, fp, lr) at the svc that parked this thread. entry.S already hands the svc
       handler regs[29]/[30]/[31] (guest x29/x30 and the guest sp before its frame, M7u's +248 pad
       slot); storing them at the park lets a dump walk the guest frame chain instead of stopping at
       the svc trampoline -- M6k proved the 0x1C/0x1D LR is always sdk+0xd3f14c, the trampoline, so
       "who called this wait" was unanswerable until now. */
    uint64_t gsp, gfp, glr;
} thr_t;
static thr_t *g_all;
/* M6i: retired-thread ledger. A guest thread that ends is freed from g_all (thr_free), and its I/O
   counters would vanish with it - exactly the wrong blind spot when the question is "did the loader
   thread die". thr_free copies the counts here first, together with the guest entry point and the
   last LR, so a short-lived loader is still named after it is gone. */
#define IO_RETIRED 8
typedef struct { uint32_t h; uint64_t open, rd, bytes, ipc, entry, llr, exit_ns; } io_ret_t;
static io_ret_t g_io_ret[IO_RETIRED];
static _Atomic unsigned g_io_ret_n;      /* monotonically counts retired threads with I/O */
static _Atomic uint64_t g_io_ret_open, g_io_ret_read, g_io_ret_bytes, g_io_ret_ipc;

static pthread_mutex_t G = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
/* M6l: which of the observed threads a handle belongs to (definition of the table is below, next
   to the rest of the M6l block). Declared here because the two thr_t constructors set the field. */
static int lp_mv_slot(uint32_t h);
#define MAX_H 4096
static struct { int type; void *obj; uint64_t creator; } g_h[MAX_H];   // creator：登记时的调用者 LR——客体 SVC（线程/事件）=客体 LR，IPC 服务对象=宿主 ipc.c 返回址；dump 全景指认 0x1003/0x101f 这类句柄的身世 | creator: the caller's LR at registration
static pthread_key_t g_keythr;
static uint64_t g_next_id = 0x51;
static thr_t *g_wait;          // 全部在等的线程（锁 / 条件 / 地址 / 同步） | All waiting threads (lock / condition / address / synchronization)

static uint32_t h_new(int type, void *obj, uint64_t creator) {     // 调用方持 G | Caller holds G
    for (int i = 1; i < MAX_H; i++) if (!g_h[i].type) { g_h[i].type = type; g_h[i].obj = obj; g_h[i].creator = creator; return 0x1000 + i; }
    die("句柄表满");
}
static void *h_peek(uint32_t h, int type) {      // 只查不报 | Lookup only, no report
    if (h == H_CUR_THREAD && type == O_THREAD) return (g_keythr ? pthread_getspecific(g_keythr) : NULL);
    unsigned i = h - 0x1000;
    if (i == 0 || i >= MAX_H || g_h[i].type != type) return NULL;
    return g_h[i].obj;
}
static void *h_get(uint32_t h, int type) {       // 查不到即报（句柄错是真错误） | Reports if not found (a wrong handle is a real error)
    void *o = h_peek(h, type);
    if (!o) LOG("句柄无效 %#x（要类型 %d）", h, type);
    return o;
}
static thr_t *cur(void) {
    thr_t *t = (g_keythr ? pthread_getspecific(g_keythr) : NULL);
    if (!t) die("非客体线程调用了线程 SVC");
    return t;
}
/* M6r：给「最长等待」那几行点名句柄的身世（类型 + 创建者 LR）。只读；dump 线程调用，
   trylock 拿不到就报 unknown，绝不阻塞心跳。 */
void runtime_describe_address(uint64_t a, char *out, size_t n);
void runtime_handle_desc(uint32_t h, char *out, unsigned cap) {
    static const char *const kinds[] = { "free", "thread", "event_r", "event_w", "session", "tmem" };
    char d[80]; d[0] = 0;
    out[0] = 0;
    if (h == H_CUR_THREAD) { snprintf(out, cap, "cur_thread"); return; }
    unsigned i = h - 0x1000;
    if (i == 0 || i >= MAX_H) { snprintf(out, cap, "h=%#x out-of-range", h); return; }
    int locked = 0;
    for (int k = 0; k < 50 && !(locked = pthread_mutex_trylock(&G) == 0); k++) usleep(1000);
    if (!locked) { snprintf(out, cap, "h=%#x (G busy)", h); return; }
    int ty = g_h[i].type; uint64_t cr = g_h[i].creator;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&G);
    if (cr) runtime_describe_address(cr, d, sizeof d);
    snprintf(out, cap, "%s creator=%s", (ty > 0 && ty <= 5) ? kinds[ty] : "?", d[0] ? d : "-");
}

// ---------- 等待原语（持 G 调用）----------
// ---------- Wait primitives (called holding G) ----------
static void wait_unlink(thr_t *t) {
    for (thr_t **p = &g_wait; *p; p = &(*p)->next) if (*p == t) { *p = t->next; break; }
    t->next = NULL;
}
// 按内核顺序挑等待者：优先级数值小者优先，同优先级先登记者优先（持 G）。kind 1 按锁地址、2 按条件键、3 按地址匹配
// Pick a waiter in kernel order: numerically lower priority first, at equal priority the earlier registered first (holding G). kind 1 matches by lock address, 2 by condition key, 3 by address
static uint64_t g_wseq;
static thr_t *pick(int kind, uint64_t a) {
    thr_t *b = NULL;
    for (thr_t *t = g_wait; t; t = t->next) {
        if (t->wkind != kind || (kind == 2 ? t->wkey : t->waddr) != a) continue;
        if (!b || t->prio < b->prio || (t->prio == b->prio && t->wseq < b->wseq)) b = t;
    }
    return b;
}
static void ldr_note_wake(thr_t *t);   /* M6g: per-wake window, defined next to svc_thread */
static void wake(thr_t *t, int64_t res) { ldr_note_wake(t); wait_unlink(t); t->wkind = 0; t->woke = 1; t->wres = res; pthread_cond_signal(&t->cv); }
// 挂起直到被唤醒或超时（ns<0 无限、0 立即超时）；返回 wres 或 R_TIMEOUT
// Suspend until woken or timed out (ns<0 infinite, 0 immediate timeout); returns wres or R_TIMEOUT
static int64_t block_inner(thr_t *t, int kind, int64_t ns);
// ---------- Virtual cores ----------
// Horizon runs at most one thread per core, and TOTK keys per-core data (allocators, job queues) by
// GetCurrentCoreNumber without locks. Guest threads therefore hold one of the three application cores while they
// run guest code; a core is given up only where Horizon would switch threads (waits, sleep, yield, exit, blocking
// host services) and handed to the best waiting thread (lowest priority value, then first come). A thread that a
// higher-priority waiter wants to preempt gives its core up at its next SVC. TOTK_FREE_CORES=1 disables this.
#define NCORE 3
static thr_t *g_core_owner[NCORE];
static thr_t *g_core_wait;
static int g_cores_on = -1;
static int cores_enabled(void) { if (g_cores_on < 0) g_cores_on = getenv("TOTK_FREE_CORES") ? 0 : 1; return g_cores_on; }
static int core_allowed(const thr_t *t, int c) { return (int)((t->mask >> c) & 1); }
/* M6t A2: soft affinity. `mask` was a hard binding: a thread whose mask held only core1 waited for core1
   even while core0 and core2 sat idle (M6s: `[core] busy=[1.8% 99.1% 1.1%]` while h=0x1023 accumulated
   29.3 s of handoff wait per 30 s window). Horizon's mask is not a hard binding either -- it says which
   cores the thread *may* run on, and the scheduler migrates onto an idle core. Here every application core
   runs the same code and the guest only reads GetCurrentProcessorNumber, which this shim answers from the
   core actually held, so falling back to a free core is safe. mask keeps its meaning as a *preference*:
   the preferred core and then the mask's free cores are tried first, the rest of the cores only after.
   TOTK_CORE_SOFT=0 restores the old hard binding for A/B comparison. */
static int g_core_soft = -1;
static int core_soft(void) { if (g_core_soft < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_CORE_SOFT"); g_core_soft = e ? atoi(e) : 1; } return g_core_soft; }
/* M6t A1/A2 counters: how many times a core was given up around a blocking host wait and for how long,
   and how many times a thread had to run off-mask (soft fallback). Read by the [core] line, no lock. */
static _Atomic unsigned long long g_core_rel_n, g_core_rel_ns, g_core_soft_n;
/* Adapted from the MIT LM3 port (#218, 714e4f3): bounded starvation and guest-only signal preemption.
   Anti-starvation (Odyssey): a thread that has waited CORE_STARVE_NS for a core gets the next free one before
   higher-priority waiters, and core_watch preempts an owner for it. Horizon has no such rule, but the guest's busier-than-
   hardware threads kept a priority-45 job worker off its only core while the main thread waited for its job. */
#define CORE_STARVE_NS 30000000
static void core_grant(int c) {   // holding G: give free core c to the best waiter
    thr_t *b = NULL, **bp = NULL;
    /* M6m: nobody is waiting for a core -> nothing to grant, and the timestamp is not needed. This is
       the common case on the blocking path (block -> core_put -> here), where the guest stack may be
       within a few dozen bytes of its guard page: runtime_now_ns alone needs 48 bytes of it. */
    if (!g_core_wait) return;
    uint64_t now = now_ns();
    /* M6t A2: two passes. Pass A honours the mask (the old behaviour, and the preference order); pass B
       only runs when soft affinity is on and pass A found nobody, so an off-mask waiter can use this
       core instead of leaving it idle. Both keep the anti-starvation rule first. */
    for (int pass = 0; pass < 2 && !b; pass++) {
        int any = pass == 0 || core_soft();
        if (!any) break;
        for (thr_t **p = &g_core_wait; *p; p = &(*p)->cnext)
            if ((pass == 1 || core_allowed(*p, c)) && now - (*p)->cwait_ns > CORE_STARVE_NS && (!b || (*p)->cwait_ns < b->cwait_ns)) { b = *p; bp = p; }
        if (!b) for (thr_t **p = &g_core_wait; *p; p = &(*p)->cnext)
            if ((pass == 1 || core_allowed(*p, c)) && (!b || (*p)->prio < b->prio || ((*p)->prio == b->prio && (*p)->cseq < b->cseq))) { b = *p; bp = p; }
    }
    if (!b) return;
    if (b->cur_core < 0 && !core_allowed(b, c)) atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_core_soft_n, 1ull, memory_order_relaxed);
    *bp = b->cnext; b->cnext = NULL; b->cur_core = c; b->core_since = now_ns(); g_core_owner[c] = b; pthread_cond_signal(&b->cv);
}
static void core_put(thr_t *t) {   // holding G
    if (t->cur_core < 0) return;
    int c = t->cur_core; t->cur_core = -1; t->preempt = 0; t->kicked = 0; g_core_owner[c] = NULL; core_grant(c);
}
static void core_watch_start(void);
static void cw_add(uint32_t h, uint64_t ns);   /* M6s: global core-wait table, defined with the [core] dump */
static void core_take(thr_t *t) {   // holding G; waits until a core in t's mask is handed over
    if (!cores_enabled() || t->cur_core >= 0) return;
    if (!(t->mask & ((1u << NCORE) - 1))) die("thread %#x core mask %#llx has no application core", t->handle, (unsigned long long)t->mask);
    int c = t->core >= 0 && t->core < NCORE && core_allowed(t, t->core) && !g_core_owner[t->core] ? t->core : -1;
    for (int i = 0; c < 0 && i < NCORE; i++) if (core_allowed(t, i) && !g_core_owner[i]) c = i;
    /* M6t A2: nothing free inside the mask -- soft affinity lets it sit on any idle application core
       rather than wait for the one core its mask names. */
    if (c < 0 && core_soft()) {
        for (int i = 0; c < 0 && i < NCORE; i++) if (!g_core_owner[i]) c = i;
        if (c >= 0) atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_core_soft_n, 1ull, memory_order_relaxed);
    }
    if (c >= 0) { t->cur_core = c; t->core_since = now_ns(); g_core_owner[c] = t; return; }
    core_watch_start();
    t->cseq = ++g_wseq; t->cwait_ns = now_ns(); t->cnext = g_core_wait; g_core_wait = t;
    /* Higher priority preempts; at equal priority a thread running away from its ideal core gives that core back to a
       waiter whose ideal core it is (Horizon migrates a thread only onto an idle core). Both at the owner's next SVC. */
    for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
        int set = 0;
        if (pass == 1 && !core_soft()) break;
        for (int i = 0; i < NCORE; i++) { thr_t *o = g_core_owner[i];
            if ((pass == 1 || core_allowed(t, i)) && o && !o->preempt && (o->prio > t->prio || (o->prio == t->prio && o->core != i && t->core == i))) { o->preempt = 1; o->preempt_ns = now_ns(); set = 1; } }
        if (set) break;
    }
    while (t->cur_core < 0) pthread_cond_wait(&t->cv, &G);
    /* M6s: the handoff wait is the "core starvation" half of every instrumented wait. One extra
       timestamp here, on a path that already took two (cwait_ns above, core_since in core_grant). */
    {   uint64_t d = now_ns() - t->cwait_ns;
        t->cw_n++; t->cw_ns += d;
        if (t->handle) cw_add(t->handle, d); }
}
/* ---------- M6s: stack probe for a thread that will not stop running (diagnostic) ----------
   M6s boot 1 named the 60 MB/s category (jemalloc) and the victim (0x1004 in vkWaitForFences) but not
   the *code* that allocates: the grower is a host thread (no guest handle) sitting at 100% CPU with no
   syscall, so no guest ledger can name it. This samples that thread's own stack: the heartbeat thread
   sends SIGURG to one tid, the handler records pc/lr/sp/fp and walks the frame chain into a static
   buffer, and the next [cpu] line prints it symbolised. SIGURG's default action is "ignore" and this
   process never used it, so a delivery without a handler is harmless.
   Every stack read goes through process_vm_readv (EFAULT instead of SIGSEGV), so a bogus frame pointer
   can only shorten the chain. The handler allocates nothing, takes no lock and writes only statics. */
#define STK_SIG SIGURG
#define STK_FR 12
#define STK_SCAN 256
typedef struct { int tid; uint64_t pc, lr, sp, fp; uint64_t fr[STK_FR]; int n;
                 uint64_t scan[STK_SCAN]; int nscan; } stk_cap_t;
static stk_cap_t g_stk;
static _Atomic unsigned g_stk_gen;
static _Atomic int g_stk_ready;
static long stk_pvread(uint64_t a, void *dst, unsigned n) {
    struct iovec l = { dst, n }, r = { (void *)(uintptr_t)a, n };
    long k = syscall(__NR_process_vm_readv, getpid(), &l, 1ul, &r, 1ul, 0ul);
    return k;
}
static void stk_handler(int sig, siginfo_t *si, void *ctx) {
    (void)sig; (void)si; int saved = errno;
    uint64_t pc = 0, lr = 0, sp = 0, fp = 0;
#ifdef __MUSL__
    ucontext_t *u = (ucontext_t *)ctx;
    pc = u->uc_mcontext.pc; lr = u->uc_mcontext.regs[30];
    sp = u->uc_mcontext.sp; fp = u->uc_mcontext.regs[29];
#else
    ucontext_t *u = (ucontext_t *)ctx;
    pc = arm_thread_state64_get_pc(u->uc_mcontext->__ss);
    lr = arm_thread_state64_get_lr(u->uc_mcontext->__ss);
    sp = arm_thread_state64_get_sp(u->uc_mcontext->__ss);
    fp = arm_thread_state64_get_fp(u->uc_mcontext->__ss);
#endif
    g_stk.tid = (int)syscall(SYS_gettid);
    g_stk.pc = pc; g_stk.lr = lr; g_stk.sp = sp; g_stk.fp = fp; g_stk.n = 0;
    uint64_t cur = fp;
    for (int i = 0; i < STK_FR && cur; i++) {
        if ((cur & 7u) || cur < sp || cur > sp + (4u << 20)) break;   /* outside this thread's own frame area */
        uint64_t fr[2];
        if (stk_pvread(cur, fr, 16) != 16) break;
        g_stk.fr[g_stk.n++] = fr[1];
        if (fr[0] <= cur) break;
        cur = fr[0];
    }
    /* Poor man's unwinder for code built without frame pointers: copy the first 2 KB of the stack as
       raw words and let the *dump* (a normal thread context) decide which of them are code addresses.
       pvread makes this safe even if [sp, sp+2KB) crosses the top of the stack. */
    g_stk.nscan = 0;
    if (sp) {
        int words = (int)(stk_pvread(sp, g_stk.scan, sizeof g_stk.scan) / 8);
        if (words > 0) {
            int k = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < words; i++)
                if (g_stk.scan[i] > 0x1000ull) g_stk.scan[k++] = g_stk.scan[i];   /* drop obvious non-pointers */
            g_stk.nscan = k;
        }
    }
    atomic_store_explicit(&g_stk_gen, atomic_load_explicit(&g_stk_gen, memory_order_relaxed) + 1u,
                          memory_order_relaxed);
    errno = saved;
}
void runtime_stack_probe_init(void) {
    if (atomic_exchange_explicit(&g_stk_ready, 1, memory_order_relaxed)) return;
    struct sigaction a = {0};
    a.sa_sigaction = stk_handler; a.sa_flags = SA_SIGINFO | SA_RESTART; sigemptyset(&a.sa_mask);
    if (sigaction(STK_SIG, &a, NULL)) { atomic_store_explicit(&g_stk_ready, 0, memory_order_relaxed); return; }
}
int runtime_stack_probe_req(int tid) {
    if (tid <= 0) return -1;
    runtime_stack_probe_init();
    if (!atomic_load_explicit(&g_stk_ready, memory_order_relaxed)) return -1;
    long r = syscall(SYS_tgkill, getpid(), tid, STK_SIG);
    return (int)r;
}
unsigned runtime_stack_probe_gen(void) { return atomic_load_explicit(&g_stk_gen, memory_order_relaxed); }
/* Called from the heartbeat thread: prints the newest capture (never from a signal context). */
static void stk_sym(char *out, size_t cap, uint64_t pc) {
    if (!pc) { snprintf(out, cap, "-"); return; }
    Dl_info di;
    if (dladdr((void *)(uintptr_t)pc, &di) && di.dli_fname) {
        const char *b = strrchr(di.dli_fname, '/'); b = b ? b + 1 : di.dli_fname;
        snprintf(out, cap, "%s+%#llx", b, (unsigned long long)(pc - (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)di.dli_fbase));
    } else snprintf(out, cap, "host%#llx", (unsigned long long)pc);
}
void runtime_stack_probe_dump(unsigned tsec) {
    extern void vk_boot_logf(const char *fmt, ...);
    char pc[64], lr[64];
    stk_sym(pc, sizeof pc, g_stk.pc);
    stk_sym(lr, sizeof lr, g_stk.lr);
    vk_boot_logf("[stk] t=%us tid=%d pc=%s lr=%s sp=%#llx fp=%#llx frames=%d",
                 tsec, g_stk.tid, pc, lr, (unsigned long long)g_stk.sp,
                 (unsigned long long)g_stk.fp, g_stk.n);
    for (int i = 0; i < g_stk.n; i++) {
        char b[64];
        stk_sym(b, sizeof b, g_stk.fr[i]);
        vk_boot_logf("[stk]   #%d %s", i, b);
    }
}
static thr_t *me_or_null(void) { return g_keythr ? pthread_getspecific(g_keythr) : NULL; }
/* Odyssey's audio thread can spin on IsMemoryPoolAttached without an SVC while the renderer update that completes
   the detach waits for its virtual core. Horizon's scheduler preempts at once; here a watcher interrupts a
   core owner that a higher-priority waiter has been waiting on for 2 ms. The signal handler gives the core up only when
   the thread was interrupted in guest code (inside a loaded module), where it holds no host lock; elsewhere it gives it
   up at its next SVC as before. Guest threads run their handlers on their own signal stack (loader.c). */
#define CORE_PREEMPT_NS 2000000
#define CORE_PREEMPT_SIGNAL SIGUSR2
int runtime_module_offset(uint64_t pc, const char **name, uint64_t *off);
extern void dm_nvn_fn_dump(int dno) __attribute__((weak));   /* M5o: nvn sync/event ledger (gfx_bridge.c) */
static void core_preempt_handler(int sig, siginfo_t *info, void *ctx) {
    (void)sig; (void)info; int saved = errno;
    thr_t *t = me_or_null(); const char *name; uint64_t off;
#ifdef __MUSL__   /* OHOS: musl aarch64 mcontext 值类型，pc = regs[32] */
    uint64_t pc = ((ucontext_t *)ctx)->uc_mcontext.pc;
#else             /* macOS: Apple __ss 指针风格 */
    uint64_t pc = arm_thread_state64_get_pc(((ucontext_t *)ctx)->uc_mcontext->__ss);
#endif
    if (t && t->cur_core >= 0 && runtime_module_offset(pc, &name, &off)) {
        pthread_mutex_lock(&G); if (t->preempt && t->cur_core >= 0) { t->preempt = 0; core_put(t); core_take(t); } else t->kicked = 0; pthread_mutex_unlock(&G);
    } else if (t) t->kicked = 0;   /* host code: the next SVC checkpoint gives the core up */
    errno = saved;
}
/* ---------- M6s: virtual-core occupancy profile (pure sampling, read-only) ----------
   Who holds the three virtual cores, and how often. One sample every 10 watcher iterations (~10 ms)
   taken while G is already held, so no lock, no timestamp and nothing on any guest path. The tables
   are atomics only because the beat thread reads them without G; a torn read can misprint a
   percentage and never decides anything. Handles, not thr_t*, are stored: a slot keyed by a live
   pointer would be a use-after-free after thr_free. */
#define CSMP_SLOTS 12
static _Atomic unsigned g_csmp_tot;                 /* samples taken (all cores) */
static _Atomic unsigned g_csmp_idle[NCORE];         /* samples with no owner */
static _Atomic unsigned g_csmp_cnt[NCORE][CSMP_SLOTS];
static _Atomic unsigned g_csmp_h[NCORE][CSMP_SLOTS];   /* 0 = empty slot (handles start at 0x1001) */
static void csmp_take(void) {   /* holding G */
```
