            // TOTK: NVNcounterData = {counter, timestamp}; TIMESTAMP / TIMESTAMP_TOP reports write counter 0 (the timestamp is the second word).
            // The game's conditional clears depend on that 0 (see cond_eval); other unimplemented counter types also report 0.
            else { uint64_t t = gpu_ticks(), rec[2] = {0, t}; memcpy((void *)ops[i].addr, rec, sizeof rec); }
        }
        free(ops);
        /* TOTK_OCCL_AUTODUMP=<dir>: when every occlusion query of a frame reported 0 (the game then culls all queried
           objects: NPCs vanished), capture the following frames on the spot: their query results, a full pass dump and
           the texture dump (with DM_NVN_TEXSNAP_DEPTH=256x144 also the occluder depth). A few captures per session. */
        { static const char *dir; static int init, done; static uint64_t last_f;
          if (!init) { init = 1; dir = getenv("TOTK_OCCL_AUTODUMP"); }
          if (dir && nq >= 5 && nzero == nq && done < 3 && (!last_f || gpu_f > last_f + 600)) {
              done++; last_f = gpu_f; char path[1024]; snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/z%d-%%d.png", dir, done);
              MLOG("[occl] all %d occlusion queries of frame %llu reported 0: capture %d of the next frames -> %s", nq, (unsigned long long)gpu_f, done, path);
              dm_gfx_querylog_next(60); dm_gfx_passdump_next(1); dm_gfx_texdump_next(path);
          } }
        /* TOTK: occlusion statistics every 1200 frames -- frames whose queries all reported 0 (the game then culls every
           queried object: NPCs vanish) and the share of results that were 0 -- to compare runs without captures. */
        { static uint64_t f0, nf, nall0, nres, nres0;
          if (nq) { nf++; nres += (uint64_t)nq; nres0 += (uint64_t)nzero; nall0 += nq >= 5 && nzero == nq; }
          if (!f0) f0 = gpu_f;
          if (gpu_f >= f0 + 1200) {
              if (nf) MLOG("[occl] frames %llu-%llu: %llu with occlusion queries, %llu with all of them 0; %.1f%% of %llu results 0", (unsigned long long)f0,
                           (unsigned long long)gpu_f, (unsigned long long)nf, (unsigned long long)nall0, 100.0 * (double)nres0 / (double)nres, (unsigned long long)nres);
              f0 = gpu_f; nf = nall0 = nres = nres0 = 0;
          } }
        cpend_done(fence);
        pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mu); if (fence > g_done) g_done = fence; pthread_cond_broadcast(&g_cv); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mu);
        defer_drain();
    }];
    void arena_commit(uint64_t fence); arena_commit(fence);
    pt_finish(g_cb, o, gpu_f);
    res_commit();
    if (totk_tl_on()) { uint64_t tlid = totk_tl_commit_id(); totk_tl(TL_COMMIT, tlid, 1); totk_tl(TL_FENCE, tlid, fence);
        [o addFeedbackHandler:^(id<MTL4CommitFeedback> fb) { totk_tl_at(TL_GPU, (uint64_t)(fb.GPUStartTime * 1e9), tlid, (uint64_t)(fb.GPUEndTime * 1e9)); }]; }
    [g_cb endCommandBuffer];
    q4_commit(g_cb, o);
    if (nogpu()) g_ev.signaledValue = fence; else [g_q4 signalEvent:g_ev value:fence];
    dead_put_flush();   // textures created for finalized serials: released once this submission completes
    stor_sweep(fence);   // TOTK: storage-shared textures nobody held for a while
    treg_sweep_replaced();   // descriptor caches must not retain replaced CPU-uploaded storage indefinitely
    type_views_sweep_retired();
    pkg_evict_sweep();   // TOTK (iPhone): drop long-unused copies of CPU-pool textures under memory pressure
    pkg_orphan_report();
    g_alloc_fence[g_alloc_cur] = fence;
    g_cb = nil;
    g_commit_blocks = nil;
    objc_autoreleasePoolPop(g_sub_pool); g_sub_pool = NULL;
    return fence;
}

uint64_t mtl_last_fence(void) { return g_fence; }
int mtl_last_commit_error(void) { return atomic_load(&g_last_commit_error); }

int mtl_wait(uint64_t fence, uint64_t timeout_ns) {
    struct timespec dl; clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &dl);
    uint64_t ns = (uint64_t)dl.tv_nsec + (timeout_ns > 3600000000000ull ? 3600000000000ull : timeout_ns);
    dl.tv_sec += ns / 1000000000ull; dl.tv_nsec = ns % 1000000000ull;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mu);
    int r = 0;
    while (g_done < fence) if ((r = pthread_cond_timedwait(&g_cv, &g_mu, &dl))) break;
    int ok = g_done >= fence;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mu);
    return ok;
}

static void mtl_finish_gpu(void) {
    if (g_fence) mtl_wait(g_fence, UINT64_MAX);
    while (atomic_load(&g_up_pending)) usleep(1000);
}
void mtl_present_flush(void);
void mtl_finish(void) { mtl_present_flush(); mtl_finish_gpu(); }   // 队列语义：已入队的出图也算队列工作 | Queue semantics: already-enqueued presents also count as queue work
static void present_drop_for_suspend(void);
void mtl_drain(void) { present_drop_for_suspend(); mtl_present_flush(); mtl_init(); id<MTLCommandBuffer> cb = q_cb(); cb_commit(cb); cb_wait(cb); mtl_finish_gpu(); }

#include "../../host/front.h"
static int g_red_once[128];
#define RED_ONCE(k, ...) do { if (!g_red_once[k]++) MLOG("【红】" __VA_ARGS__); } while (0)

// ---------- 贴图 → MTLTexture ----------
// ---------- Texture → MTLTexture ----------
static int fmt_compressed(int f) { return (f >= 0x41 && f <= 0x50) || (f >= 0x79 && f <= 0x94); }
static int fmt_depth(int f) { return f >= 0x31 && f <= 0x36; }
typedef struct { MTLPixelFormat a, b; } pfv_pair;
static const pfv_pair g_pfv_srgb[] = {
    {MTLPixelFormatRGBA8Unorm, MTLPixelFormatRGBA8Unorm_sRGB},
    {MTLPixelFormatBGRA8Unorm, MTLPixelFormatBGRA8Unorm_sRGB},
    {MTLPixelFormatBC1_RGBA, MTLPixelFormatBC1_RGBA_sRGB},
    {MTLPixelFormatBC2_RGBA, MTLPixelFormatBC2_RGBA_sRGB},
    {MTLPixelFormatBC3_RGBA, MTLPixelFormatBC3_RGBA_sRGB},
    {MTLPixelFormatBC7_RGBAUnorm, MTLPixelFormatBC7_RGBAUnorm_sRGB},
};
static int tex_need_pfv(MTLPixelFormat base, MTLPixelFormat view) {
    if (base == view) return 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof g_pfv_srgb / sizeof *g_pfv_srgb; i++)
        if ((base == g_pfv_srgb[i].a && view == g_pfv_srgb[i].b) || (base == g_pfv_srgb[i].b && view == g_pfv_srgb[i].a)) return 0;
    return 1;
}
// 回放热路径的缓存表一律用 nvn_hmap（C 哈希，键不装箱）；表里存 CFBridgingRetain 过的对象，替换 / 删除时 CFRelease
// Cache tables on the replay hot path always use nvn_hmap (C hash, keys not boxed); the table stores CFBridgingRetain'ed objects, CFRelease'd on replace / delete
static void hm_rel(void *v) { CFRelease(v); }
static __unsafe_unretained id hm_get_id(const nvn_hmap *m, const void *k) { return (__bridge id)nvn_hm_get(m, k); }
static void hm_put_id(nvn_hmap *m, const void *k, id o) { void *old = nvn_hm_put(m, k, (void *)CFBridgingRetain(o)); if (old) CFRelease(old); }
static void hm_del_id(nvn_hmap *m, const void *k) { void *old = nvn_hm_del(m, k); if (old) CFRelease(old); }
static nvn_hmap g_by_serial = {.klen = 8};     // 序号 → MTLTexture / NvPkg / NvProg | Serial → MTLTexture / NvPkg / NvProg
static pthread_mutex_t g_smu = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
// 序号表代号：表项增删、预排布贴图换新时 +1。下游缓存（贴图视图、程序）记下取用时的代号，代号未变即可直接用、不必再查表
// Serial table generation: +1 when entries are added / removed or a packaged texture is replaced. Downstream caches (texture views, programs) record the generation at fetch time; if it is unchanged they can be used directly without another table lookup
static _Atomic uint64_t g_ser_gen = 1;
static uint64_t g_treg_same, g_treg_changed;   // TOTK: identical / changed texture registrations (memory readout line)
/* TOTK: which serial each generation step was for (g_ser_chg[gen % SER_CHG_N]; 0 = not one serial, every cache must
   look again). A texture-ID view cache whose own serial is not among the steps since it was validated stays valid: the
   ~34 per-frame re-uploads of small CPU-written textures used to send every bound texture of every following draw down
   the slow path (about 13% of the replay). Written under g_smu before the generation is published. */
#define SER_CHG_N 1024
static _Atomic uint64_t g_ser_chg[SER_CHG_N];
static void ser_bump_locked(uint64_t serial) {
    uint64_t g = atomic_load_explicit(&g_ser_gen, memory_order_relaxed) + 1;
    atomic_store_explicit(&g_ser_chg[g % SER_CHG_N], serial, memory_order_relaxed);
    atomic_store_explicit(&g_ser_gen, g, memory_order_release);
}
static void ser_bump(uint64_t serial);
/* 1 when none of the generation steps (from, to] was for this serial (or for "everything"). */
static int ser_unaffected(uint64_t from, uint64_t to, uint64_t serial) {
    if (!serial || to - from >= SER_CHG_N) return 0;
    for (uint64_t g = from + 1; g <= to; g++) { uint64_t s = atomic_load_explicit(&g_ser_chg[g % SER_CHG_N], memory_order_relaxed); if (!s || s == serial) return 0; }
    return atomic_load_explicit(&g_ser_gen, memory_order_acquire) - from < SER_CHG_N;   // no slot was overwritten while scanning
}
// ---------- TOTK: storage-shared GPU textures ----------
/* Several live NVNtexture objects can describe the same pool memory with the same layout: the game registers a
   persistent sampling object in the texture pool (e.g. serial 75485, the normals G-buffer) and re-initialises the
   render-target object at the same storage every frame (serial 75569). On hardware both descriptors read the same
   bytes; here every serial used to get its own private MTLTexture, so what was rendered through one serial was
   invisible through the other (the deferred lighting read all-zero normals: black geometry). GPU-owned textures are
   now keyed by (storage, layout): the same pixel format shares the MTLTexture, a different uncompressed format of the
   same texel size gets a texture view on it, and a usage the base lacks recreates the base with the union (content
   copied on the GPU timeline). An entry keeps its content while any serial holds it and for STOR_IDLE_SUBMITS
   submissions after the last holder left (previous-frame buffers are re-initialised every frame), and is dropped
   when its memory pool is finalised. TOTK_TEX_SHARE=0 restores one texture per serial. */
int nvn_fmt_bpb(int format, int *bw, int *bh);
typedef struct { uint64_t mem, size; uint32_t w, h, d, levels, target, samples, bpb, depth_fmt; } stor_key;   // 48 bytes, no padding
typedef struct { stor_key k; void *tex; uint64_t idle_fence; uint64_t *ser; int nser, cser; } stor_ent;      // tex: CFBridgingRetain'ed base texture; ser: serials holding it or a view on it
static nvn_hmap g_by_storage = {.klen = sizeof(stor_key)};   // stor_key -> stor_ent *
static nvn_hmap g_stor_of_obj = {.klen = 8};                  // base texture / view pointer -> stor_ent *
static uint64_t g_stor_entries, g_stor_shared, g_stor_viewed, g_stor_recreated, g_stor_swept, g_stor_dropped;
/* Texture preparation runs before a draw captures its encoder. An upgrade discovered under the
   registry lock requests a pass split; the caller ends the pass outside that lock and retries. */
static int g_tex_preparing, g_tex_prepare_split;
#define STOR_IDLE_SUBMITS 600
static int stor_on(void) { static int on = -1; if (on < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_TEX_SHARE"); on = !e || atoi(e); } return on; }
static int stor_key_of(const tex_t *t, stor_key *k) {
    if (!t->mem || !t->L.size) return 0;
    int bw = 1, bh = 1, bpb = nvn_fmt_bpb(t->d.format, &bw, &bh);
    if (!bpb || bw != 1 || bh != 1) return 0;   // block-compressed formats keep one texture per serial (no cross-format views)
    memset(k, 0, sizeof *k);
    k->mem = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)t->mem; k->size = t->L.size; k->w = t->d.width ? t->d.width : 1; k->h = t->d.height ? t->d.height : 1; k->d = t->d.depth ? t->d.depth : 1; k->levels = t->d.levels ? t->d.levels : 1;
    k->target = (uint32_t)t->d.target; k->samples = t->d.samples > 1 ? (uint32_t)t->d.samples : 1; k->bpb = (uint32_t)bpb; k->depth_fmt = (uint32_t)fmt_depth(t->d.format);
    return 1;
}
static inline uint64_t obj_key(id o) { return (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(__bridge void *)o; }
/* g_smu held: a serial starts / stops holding a storage-owned object. stor_unref_locked returns 1 for a storage-owned
   object, which the caller must only unref (the entry keeps it resident); a dropped view leaves the object table. */
static void stor_ref_locked(id o, uint64_t serial) {
    uint64_t ok = obj_key(o); stor_ent *e = nvn_hm_get(&g_stor_of_obj, &ok); if (!e) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < e->nser; i++) if (e->ser[i] == serial) return;
    if (e->nser == e->cser) { e->cser = e->cser ? e->cser * 2 : 4; e->ser = realloc(e->ser, (size_t)e->cser * sizeof *e->ser); if (!e->ser) MDIE("storage serial list"); }
    e->ser[e->nser++] = serial;
}
static int stor_unref_locked(id o, uint64_t serial) {
    uint64_t ok = obj_key(o); stor_ent *e = nvn_hm_get(&g_stor_of_obj, &ok); if (!e) return 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < e->nser; i++) if (e->ser[i] == serial) { e->ser[i] = e->ser[--e->nser]; break; }
    if (!e->nser) e->idle_fence = g_fence;
    if ((__bridge void *)o != e->tex) nvn_hm_del(&g_stor_of_obj, &ok);
    return 1;
}
static int stor_key_lookup(id o, stor_key *k);
static id<MTLTexture> stor_recreate(const stor_key *k, MTLTextureUsage usage);
static id<MTLTexture> tex_mtl(const tex_t *ct);
static int rp_active(void);
/* TOTK: plain pointers for the replay hot paths. The functions above return id, and the __unsafe_unretained on their
   return types is ignored by ARC, so every lookup was a retain / autorelease pair. Table entries are only freed through
   the deferred-release queue, which the replay thread drains, so the replay may hold these unretained. */
static inline void *hm_get_ptr(const nvn_hmap *m, const void *k) { return nvn_hm_get(m, k); }
static void *serial_ptr(uint64_t k) { pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu); void *o = nvn_hm_get(&g_by_serial, &k); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu); return o; }
static __unsafe_unretained id serial_get(uint64_t k) { pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu); __unsafe_unretained id o = hm_get_id(&g_by_serial, &k); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu); return o; }
static void serial_put(uint64_t k, id o) { pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu); id old = hm_get_id(&g_by_serial, &k); if (old) { if (stor_unref_locked(old, k)) defer_obj_unref(old); else defer_obj_release(old); } hm_put_id(&g_by_serial, &k, o); stor_ref_locked(o, k); ser_bump_locked(k); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu); }
static void serial_del(uint64_t k) { pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu); id old = hm_get_id(&g_by_serial, &k); if (old) { if (stor_unref_locked(old, k)) defer_obj_unref(old); else defer_obj_release(old); } hm_del_id(&g_by_serial, &k); ser_bump_locked(k); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu); BOTW_SERIAL_NOTE(k, "serial_del") }
static void ser_bump(uint64_t serial) { pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu); ser_bump_locked(serial); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu); }
/* Dead serials (TOTK): the game finalizes temporary NVNtexture objects after recording and before the submission runs,
   so a replay may meet a serial that was already finalized. Previously the replay created a Metal texture for it and
   stored it under the serial, where nothing ever deleted it: about 4.6 textures (~18 MB) leaked per frame, the
   residency set grew without bound and the GPU driver ran out of wired memory (kernel panics). A texture created
   for a dead serial is now deleted again when the submission that used it completes. */
static totk_serial_set g_dead_serial;   // serial -> (void *)1 once finalized
/* TOTK: serials the GPU has rendered into. A mirrored (CPU-pool) texture that the game then uses as a render target is owned by
   the GPU from that point: dirty-page re-uploads from the (stale) pool memory would wipe the rendered content. */
static totk_serial_set g_gpu_owned;
static _Atomic uint64_t g_owned_gen = 1;   // TOTK: bumped whenever a serial joins g_gpu_owned (entries are never removed)
static void pkg_owned_locked(uint64_t k);
static void gpu_owned_mark(uint64_t k) { pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu); int had = totk_serial_has(&g_gpu_owned, k); if (!had) { totk_serial_add(&g_gpu_owned, k); atomic_fetch_add(&g_owned_gen, 1); pkg_owned_locked(k); } pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu);
}
static int gpu_owned(uint64_t k) { pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu); int d = totk_serial_has(&g_gpu_owned, k); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu); return d; }

static uint64_t *g_dead_put; static int g_dead_put_n, g_dead_put_cap; static uint64_t g_dead_put_total;
static int serial_is_dead(uint64_t k) { pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu); int d = totk_serial_has(&g_dead_serial, k); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu); return d; }
/* 2026-10-20: a finalised serial is forgotten (dropped from g_dead_serial and g_gpu_owned) once nothing can bring it back:
   no recording copy names it (dm_nvn_pin_has_serial: only a recording's texture copy brings a serial to the replay) and
   no texture-pool slot is registered with it (g_treg_refs, kept by mtl_reg_tex and tex_by_id's redirect: such a slot still
   follows the serial to the live texture at its memory). Before, both sets only grew: Breath of the Wild finalises about
   80 textures a frame and had 17.4 million entries after 30 minutes on a static screen, TOTK about 130 MB in 27 minutes. */
static nvn_hmap g_treg_refs = {.klen = 8};   /* serial -> pool slots registered with it (g_rmu) */
static uint64_t g_serial_forgotten;
static void treg_ref_locked(uint64_t serial, int delta) {   /* g_rmu held */
    if (!serial) return;
    uintptr_t n = (uintptr_t)nvn_hm_get(&g_treg_refs, &serial);
    n = delta > 0 ? n + 1 : n ? n - 1 : 0;
    if (n) nvn_hm_put(&g_treg_refs, &serial, (void *)n); else nvn_hm_del(&g_treg_refs, &serial);
}
static void serial_forget_locked_rmu(uint64_t k) {   /* g_rmu held (g_rmu -> g_pin_mu and g_rmu -> g_smu are the allowed orders) */
    extern int dm_nvn_pin_has_serial(uint64_t serial);
    if (!k || nvn_hm_get(&g_treg_refs, &k) || dm_nvn_pin_has_serial(k)) return;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu);
    if (totk_serial_del(&g_dead_serial, k)) g_serial_forgotten++;
    totk_serial_del(&g_gpu_owned, k);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu);
}
static inline int registry_lock(void); static inline void registry_unlock(void);
static void serial_forget_if_unreferenced(uint64_t k) { registry_lock(); serial_forget_locked_rmu(k); registry_unlock(); }
static void dead_put_note(uint64_t k) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu);
    if (g_dead_put_n == g_dead_put_cap) { g_dead_put_cap = g_dead_put_cap ? g_dead_put_cap * 2 : 256; g_dead_put = realloc(g_dead_put, g_dead_put_cap * sizeof *g_dead_put); if (!g_dead_put) MDIE("dead-serial list"); }
    g_dead_put[g_dead_put_n++] = k; g_dead_put_total++;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu);
}
/* Called at the end of every submission: textures created for already-finalized serials are released after it completes. */
static void dead_put_flush(void) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu); int n = g_dead_put_n; uint64_t *l = n ? malloc(n * sizeof *l) : NULL; if (n) memcpy(l, g_dead_put, n * sizeof *l); g_dead_put_n = 0; pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { BOTW_DEAD_KEEP(l[i]) BOTW_SERIAL_NOTE(l[i], "dead_put_flush") serial_del(l[i]); treg_drop_serial(l[i]); }
    free(l);
}
uint64_t mtl_dead_serial_textures(void) { return g_dead_put_total; }
// 预排布贴图的宿主记录：当前 MTLTexture、上传戳、上次检查时的全局写代号
// Host record of a packaged texture: the current MTLTexture, the upload stamp, and the global write generation at the last check
typedef struct { uint64_t pf, type, w, h, z, levels, layers, samples, usage, storage; uint8_t swz[4]; } reup_key;   // TOTK: what tex_desc varies between mirrored textures (re-upload recycling, see reup_take)
/* Same-shader argument blocks may survive intervening program changes only
   while every binding/resource generation still matches. Default off. */
static _Atomic int g_arg_epoch_on = -1, g_arg_epoch_check;
static _Atomic uint64_t g_arg_epoch_hits, g_arg_epoch_extra, g_arg_epoch_verified;
static int g_arg_epoch_negative;
static int arg_epoch_on(void) {
    int v = atomic_load_explicit(&g_arg_epoch_on, memory_order_relaxed);
    if (v < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_ARG_EPOCH"); v = e && atoi(e); atomic_store(&g_arg_epoch_on, v);
        e = getenv("TOTK_ARG_EPOCH_CHECK"); atomic_store(&g_arg_epoch_check, e && atoi(e)); }
    return v;
}
typedef struct {
    uint64_t pass, arena, bindings, registry, serial, dirty, snapshot_drops, config;
} arg_epoch_key;
/* Texture/sampler slots can remain identical when only uniform bindings change.

static _Atomic int g_pkg_final_cache = -1;
static _Atomic uint64_t g_pkg_final_kept;
static int reup_offer(id<MTLTexture> old, const reup_key *key);
static int pkg_final_cache_on(void) {
    int v = atomic_load(&g_pkg_final_cache);
    if (v < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_PKG_FINAL_CACHE"); v = e && atoi(e); atomic_store(&g_pkg_final_cache, v); }
    return v;
}
@interface NvPkg : NSObject { @public id<MTLTexture> tex; uint64_t stamp, seen, hash, owned_gen; int tracked, owned, hashed; reup_key key; uint64_t chash, csub, used; uintptr_t lo, hi; uint8_t *edge; uint32_t eh, et; int edge_want; } @end   // lo / hi (TOTK): the texture's memory (pkg_orphan_report)   // tracked (TOTK): result of the last nvn_dirty_tracked   // hash：DM_NVN_DIRTYCHECK 时上传内容的全量哈希 | hash: full hash of the uploaded content under DM_NVN_DIRTYCHECK
/* TOTK: a mirrored texture the GPU starts rendering into is told directly (g_smu held), so tex_mtl no longer asks the owned
   set again every time any other serial joins it (a locked lookup per CPU-pool texture per new render target). */
static void pkg_owned_locked(uint64_t k) { id o = hm_get_id(&g_by_serial, &k); if ([o isKindOfClass:[NvPkg class]]) ((NvPkg *)o)->owned = 1; }
@implementation NvPkg
- (void)dealloc {
    free(edge);   // TOTK (#90): the shared first / last page bytes (pkg_edge_snap)
    // The wrapper is released after its GPU readers finish. Recycle its allocation
    // with the same descriptor key as a re-upload, retaining residency. The next
    // owner overwrites every mip/layer; cached views are retired by the normal path.
    if (!owned && pkg_final_cache_on() && reup_offer(tex, &key)) atomic_fetch_add(&g_pkg_final_kept, 1);
    else res_remove(tex);
}
@end
/* TOTK: GPU renderings into CPU-visible memory pools reach that memory when the CPU invalidates it.
   On hardware the GPU writes the texture's memory, and the game reads it back with the CPU after
   nvnMemoryPoolInvalidateMappedRange (CPU-cached pools). Here a mirrored texture the GPU renders into keeps the result
   only in its MTLTexture, so the game read the bytes it had uploaded before. The game bakes terrain tile normals on the
   GPU into such a pool and copies them with the CPU into new tiles: after moving, new tiles got stale normals and the
   ground turned black block by block (2026-10-15). Each rendering of a mirrored texture is noted here (with a reference,
   so the result outlives a temporary texture object finalized before the submission runs); an invalidate over its
   memory waits for the GPU and writes every level back in the NVN layout, unless the CPU has written the memory since
   the rendering (then the CPU's bytes are newer). Runtime switch: TOTK_INPUT_FILE "flag writeback 0|1" (default 1). */
typedef struct { tex_t t; uint64_t stamp, fence, prev_fence; void *obj; uint8_t *snap; uint32_t snap_n; } wb_ent;   // fence: the submission that renders it (g_fence + 1 while it is encoded); prev_fence: the one before, while the newest is still being recorded
static nvn_hmap g_wb = {.klen = 8};   // serial -> wb_ent * (g_smu): rendered since the last write-back
static _Atomic int g_wb_on = 1;
/* TOTK: fill the driver segment c0 for vertex and compute shaders (thread-group counts, uniform / storage address tables,
   point size limit; see drv_scan). TOTK_DRV_FILL=0 or "flag drvfill 0" gives them the old all-zero segment (A/B only). */
static _Atomic int g_drvfill_on = -1;
static int drvfill_on(void) { int v = atomic_load(&g_drvfill_on); if (v < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_DRV_FILL"); v = !(e && !strcmp(e, "0")); atomic_store(&g_drvfill_on, v); } return v; }
static uint64_t g_wb_done, g_wb_skip_cpu, g_wb_skip_fmt, g_wb_bytes;
/* TOTK diagnostics for the game's occlusion culling (a 256x144 occluder depth pass, then one SAMPLES_PASSED query per
   candidate object with a bounding-sphere proxy; an object whose query reports 0 is not drawn): "flag occl_visible 1"
   reports every query as visible (if a vanished object comes back, the culling decided it); "querylog <frames>" logs
   each query's result with the sphere the proxy draw had in its vertex uniform block 1 (x, y, z, radius). */
void dm_gfx_querylog_next(long n) { long f = (long)atomic_load(&g_cur_frame); atomic_store(&g_ql_until, f + (n > 0 ? n : 1)); MLOG("[query] logging occlusion queries until frame %ld", f + n); }
static void driver_cache_set(int v);
static void driver_cache_check_set(int v);
// One shader class can be hidden for geometry fault isolation without restarting.
// Diagnostic only: measurements with this enabled are never valid performance results.
static _Atomic uint64_t g_diag_skip_fs;
static _Atomic uint64_t g_diag_texpng_fs, g_diag_geometry_fs;
static int diag_shader_prefix_matches(const char *key, uint64_t value) {
    char prefix[17]; snprintf(prefix, sizeof prefix, "%016llx", (unsigned long long)value);
    return key && !strncmp(key, prefix, 16);
}
void dm_gfx_set_flag(const char *name, int v) {
    if (!strcmp(name, "arg_epoch")) { (void)arg_epoch_on(); atomic_store(&g_arg_epoch_on, v != 0); MLOG("[flag] arg_epoch = %d", v != 0); return; }
    if (!strcmp(name, "arg_epoch_check")) { (void)arg_epoch_on(); atomic_store(&g_arg_epoch_check, v != 0); MLOG("[flag] arg_epoch_check = %d verified=%llu extra=%llu", v != 0, (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&g_arg_epoch_verified), (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&g_arg_epoch_extra)); return; }
    if (!strcmp(name, "tex_slots")) { (void)tex_slots_on(); atomic_store(&g_tex_slots_on, v != 0); MLOG("[flag] tex_slots = %d", v != 0); return; }
    if (!strcmp(name, "tex_slots_check")) { (void)tex_slots_on(); atomic_store(&g_tex_slots_check, v != 0); MLOG("[flag] tex_slots_check = %d verified=%llu hits=%llu", v != 0, (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&g_tex_slots_verified), (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&g_tex_slots_hits)); return; }
    if (!strcmp(name, "render_stream")) { atomic_store(&g_rs_on, v != 0); MLOG("[flag] render_stream = %d (next render pass)", v != 0); return; }
    if (!strcmp(name, "cube_merge")) { atomic_store(&g_cg_on, v != 0); MLOG("[flag] cube_merge = %d", v != 0); return; }
    if (!strcmp(name, "skip_invisible")) { skv_set(v); return; }
    if (!strncmp(name, "gfx_", 4)) { for (int w = 0; w < GX_N; w++) if (!strcmp(name + 4, gx_key[w])) { dm_gfx_opt_set(w, v); return; } }   // flag gfx_aa / gfx_cas / gfx_upscaler / gfx_textures / gfx_resolution <value>, -1 cycles (odyssey_gfx.h)
    if (!strcmp(name, "mfx_upscale")) { mfxup_set(v < 0 ? !mfxup_enabled() : v); return; }   // TOTK_MFX_UPSCALE at run time (manual key 3 picture mode)
    if (!strcmp(name, "mfx_interp")) { mfx_set(v); return; }
    if (!strcmp(name, "draw_log")) { extern _Atomic long g_draw_log; atomic_store(&g_draw_log, v); MLOG("[flag] draw_log: every draw and dispatch of the next %d frames", v); return; }
    if (!strcmp(name, "uw_log")) { extern _Atomic long g_uw_log; atomic_store(&g_uw_log, v); MLOG("[flag] uw_log: canvas draws of the next %d frames", v); return; }   // key 4 UI squeeze diagnostic
    if (!strcmp(name, "mfx_output")) { mfxup_output_set(v < 0 ? !mfxup_output_enabled() : v); return; }   // TOTK_MFX_OUTPUT at run time (the window output stage)
    if (!strcmp(name, "pass_gpu")) {
        if (v < 0 || v > 120) { MLOG("[flag] pass_gpu requires 0..120 frames"); return; }
        atomic_store_explicit(&g_pt_request, v, memory_order_relaxed);
        MLOG("[flag] pass_gpu = %d (next submission; diagnostic frames must be excluded from FPS)", v); return;
    }
    if (!strcmp(name, "diag_env_once")) { extern void nvn_diag_env_once_set(int); nvn_diag_env_once_set(v); return; }
    if (!strcmp(name, "inline_bulk")) { extern void dm_nvn_inline_bulk_set(int); dm_nvn_inline_bulk_set(v); return; }
    if (!strcmp(name, "keepalive_us")) {
        if (v && (v < 100 || v > 1000)) { MLOG("[flag] keepalive_us requires 0 or 100..1000"); return; }
        atomic_store(&g_ka_target_us, v); MLOG("[flag] keepalive_us = %d", v); return;
    }
    if (!strcmp(name, "chunk_first") || !strcmp(name, "chunk_draws")) {
        if (v < 0 || v > 1000) { MLOG("[flag] chunk controls require 0..1000"); return; }
        atomic_store(!strcmp(name, "chunk_first") ? &g_chunk_first_request : &g_chunk_size_request, v);
        MLOG("[flag] %s = %d (next submission)", name, v); return;
    }
    if (!strcmp(name, "usnap_index")) { atomic_store(&g_usnap_index_on, v != 0); MLOG("[flag] usnap_index = %d", v != 0); return; }
    if (!strcmp(name, "usnap_index_check")) { atomic_store(&g_usnap_index_check, v != 0); MLOG("[flag] usnap_index_check = %d", v != 0); return; }
    if (!strcmp(name, "vertex_streams")) { atomic_store(&g_vertex_streams_on, v != 0); MLOG("[flag] vertex_streams = %d", v != 0); return; }
    if (!strcmp(name, "arg_bind_cache")) { atomic_store(&g_arg_bind_cache_on, v != 0); MLOG("[flag] arg_bind_cache = %d", v != 0); return; }
    if (!strcmp(name, "pool_query_cache")) { atomic_store(&g_pool_query_on, v != 0); MLOG("[flag] pool_query_cache = %d", v != 0); return; }
    if (!strcmp(name, "pool_tls")) { (void)pool_tls_on(); atomic_store(&g_pool_tls_on, v != 0); MLOG("[flag] pool_tls = %d", v != 0); return; }
    if (!strcmp(name, "pool_tls_check")) { atomic_store(&g_pool_tls_check, v != 0); MLOG("[flag] pool_tls_check = %d", v != 0); return; }
    if (!strcmp(name, "pool_query_check")) { atomic_store(&g_pool_query_check, v != 0); MLOG("[flag] pool_query_check = %d", v != 0); return; }
    if (!strcmp(name, "texture_plan")) { (void)texture_plan_on(); atomic_store(&g_texture_plan_on, v != 0); MLOG("[flag] texture_plan = %d", v != 0); return; }
    if (!strcmp(name, "texture_plan_check")) { (void)texture_plan_on(); atomic_store(&g_texture_plan_check, v != 0); MLOG("[flag] texture_plan_check = %d", v != 0); return; }
    if (!strcmp(name, "anomaly_capture")) {
        const char *dir = getenv("TOTK_ANOMALY");
        if (!dir || !*dir) { MLOG("[flag] anomaly_capture unavailable: start with TOTK_ANOMALY directory"); return; }
        atomic_store(&g_anom_requested, v != 0); MLOG("[flag] anomaly_capture = %d", v != 0); return;
    }
    if (!strcmp(name, "shadow_index")) { atomic_store(&g_shadow_index_on, v != 0); MLOG("[flag] shadow_index = %d", v != 0); return; }
    if (!strcmp(name, "shadow_index_check")) { atomic_store(&g_shadow_index_check, v != 0); MLOG("[flag] shadow_index_check = %d", v != 0); return; }
    if (!strcmp(name, "pkg_final_cache")) { atomic_store(&g_pkg_final_cache, v != 0); MLOG("[flag] pkg_final_cache = %d", v != 0); return; }
    if (!strcmp(name, "pend_arena_pin")) { atomic_store(&g_pend_arena_pin, v != 0); MLOG("[flag] pend_arena_pin = %d", v != 0); return; }
    if (!strncmp(name, "skipfs_", 7)) {
        const char *p = name + 7;
        if (strlen(p) != 16 || strspn(p, "0123456789abcdefABCDEF") != 16) { MLOG("[flag] skipfs needs exactly 16 hex digits"); return; }
        atomic_store(&g_diag_skip_fs, v ? strtoull(p, NULL, 16) : 0);
        MLOG("[flag] diagnostic skipfs %.16s = %d (incomplete geometry; invalid FPS)", p, v != 0); return;
    }
    if (!strncmp(name, "texpngfs_", 9) || !strncmp(name, "geodumpfs_", 10)) {
        int geometry = !strncmp(name, "geodumpfs_", 10);

        if (strlen(p) != 16 || strspn(p, "0123456789abcdefABCDEF") != 16) {
            MLOG("[flag] shader capture needs exactly 16 hex digits"); return;
        }
        atomic_store(geometry ? &g_diag_geometry_fs : &g_diag_texpng_fs,
                     v ? strtoull(p, NULL, 16) : 0);
        MLOG("[flag] diagnostic %s = %d (capture on requested dump; invalid FPS)", name, v != 0); return;
    }
    if (!strcmp(name, "drv_cache")) { driver_cache_set(v); return; }
    if (!strcmp(name, "drv_cache_check")) { driver_cache_check_set(v); return; }
    if (!strcmp(name, "writeback")) { atomic_store(&g_wb_on, v); MLOG("[flag] writeback = %d", v); return; }
    if (!strcmp(name, "deferred")) { extern void nvn_set_deferred_binds(int on); nvn_set_deferred_binds(v); return; }
    if (!strcmp(name, "framewait")) { extern void nvn_set_framewait(int on); nvn_set_framewait(v); return; }

    if (!strcmp(name, "occl_visible")) { atomic_store(&g_occl_vis, v); MLOG("[flag] occl_visible = %d", v); return; }
    if (!strcmp(name, "drvfill")) { atomic_store(&g_drvfill_on, v != 0); MLOG("[flag] drvfill = %d", v != 0); return; }
    if (!strcmp(name, "ubo_snapshot")) { (void)usnap_on(); atomic_store(&g_usnap_on, v != 0); MLOG("[flag] ubo_snapshot = %d", v != 0); return; }
    MLOG("【红】unknown runtime flag %s", name);
}
/* TOTK diagnostic DM_NVN_TILELOG=WxH: every event on textures of that size (render, CPU texel read / write, invalidate,
   upload), to see the order of operations on one piece of memory; with it nvn_dirty.c also records who unprotects pages. */
static int tilelog_match(const tex_t *t) {
    static int on = -1; static unsigned w, h; if (on < 0) { const char *e = getenv("DM_NVN_TILELOG"); on = e && sscanf(e, "%ux%u", &w, &h) == 2; }
    return on && t && t->d.width == w && t->d.height == h;
}
#define TILELOG(t, fmt, ...) do { BOTW_TILELOG_NOTE(t) if (tilelog_match(t)) MLOG("[tile] f%llu ser=%llu mem=%p nvnfmt=%#x lv%u " fmt, (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&g_cur_frame), (unsigned long long)(t)->serial, (void *)(t)->mem, (t)->d.format, (t)->d.levels, ##__VA_ARGS__); } while (0)
static void wb_ent_free(wb_ent *e) { if (!e) return; if (e->obj) { defer_obj_release((__bridge id)e->obj); CFRelease(e->obj); } free(e->snap); free(e); }
/* A memory pool is finalized: its pending GPU renderings will never be read back. Drop their write-back records, which
   hold the texture objects (wb_note's retain kept them resident for ever: soak-60-a, 23 October, ~96 textures / 55 MB
   per "Throw Cap" movie play). It is also a correctness fix: a record left behind would match a later invalidate of a
   new pool reusing the address range and write the old rendering over the game's new data. */
static void wb_drop_range(uintptr_t lo, uintptr_t hi) {
    uint64_t dropped = 0, bytes = 0;
    for (;;) {
        wb_ent *list[64]; int nl = 0;
        pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu);
        for (uint32_t i = 0; g_wb.n && g_wb.vals && i < g_wb.cap && nl < 64; i++) {
            wb_ent *e = g_wb.vals[i];
            if (!e || (uintptr_t)e->t.mem >= hi || (uintptr_t)e->t.mem + e->t.L.size <= lo) continue;
            uint64_t k = e->t.serial; nvn_hm_del(&g_wb, &k); list[nl++] = e; i = (uint32_t)-1;   // deletion shifts entries: rescan
        }
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu);
        for (int i = 0; i < nl; i++) { bytes += list[i]->t.L.size; wb_ent_free(list[i]); }
        dropped += nl;
        if (nl < 64) break;
    }
    static _Atomic unsigned shown;
    if (dropped && atomic_fetch_add(&shown, 1) < 16)
        MLOG("[writeback] pool freed: dropped %llu pending write-back records (%llu MB)", (unsigned long long)dropped, (unsigned long long)(bytes >> 20));
}
static void pre_note(const tex_t *t, id o);
/* From games/totk (8a29e0a, limit raised to 256 KiB later): a small target's few bytes can share a 16 KiB page with data
   the CPU writes every frame, so the page-granular dirty tracking reports "CPU wrote since the render" and the rendering
   never reaches the game. Small targets keep a copy of their own bytes when the rendering is noted; if those bytes are
   unchanged at write-back time the CPU did not write this texture, and the rendering is written back. Odyssey's R32F
   256x128 target (128 KiB) was skipped as "CPU wrote since" on about half of its write-backs (24 October, 151,020 of
   302,010 in a 90-minute session); TOTK_WB_EXACT=0 restores the page-only decision. */
enum { WB_SNAP_MAX = 256 * 1024 };
static int wb_exact_on(void) { static int v = -1; if (v < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_WB_EXACT"); v = !(e && !strcmp(e, "0")); } return v; }
static uint64_t g_wb_exact_rescued;
static void wb_snap(wb_ent *e) {
    if (!wb_exact_on() || !e->t.mem || e->t.L.size > WB_SNAP_MAX) { free(e->snap); e->snap = NULL; e->snap_n = 0; return; }
    uint32_t n = (uint32_t)e->t.L.size; if (e->snap_n != n) { free(e->snap); e->snap = malloc(n); e->snap_n = e->snap ? n : 0; }
    if (e->snap) memcpy(e->snap, e->t.mem, n);
}
static void wb_note(const tex_t *t) {
    TILELOG(t, "GPU render (owned %d)", gpu_owned(t->serial));
    if (!atomic_load(&g_wb_on) || !t->mem || !t->L.size) return;
    id o = serial_get(t->serial); if (!o) return;
    /* CPU writes after this rendering show up in nvn_dirty_since. TOTK (#90): the stamp comes first; a write that faults while
       the pages are being protected then counts as after it (taken after, it covered that page, writable from then on). */
    uint64_t stamp = nvn_dirty_now(), k = t->serial;
    nvn_dirty_protect(t->mem, t->L.size);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu);
    wb_ent *e = nvn_hm_get(&g_wb, &k);
    uint64_t fence = g_fence + 1;   // replay thread: the submission being encoded commits with ++g_fence (mtl_sub_commit)
    if (e) { if (e->fence != fence) e->prev_fence = e->fence; e->stamp = stamp; e->fence = fence; e->t = *t; wb_snap(e); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu); pre_note(t, o); return; }
    e = calloc(1, sizeof *e); if (!e) MDIE("write-back record");
    e->t = *t; wb_snap(e); e->stamp = stamp; e->fence = fence; e->obj = (void *)CFBridgingRetain(o);
    nvn_hm_put(&g_wb, &k, e);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu);
    pre_note(t, o);
}
static int wb_level_back(const tex_t *t, id<MTLTexture> mt, unsigned level, unsigned layer) {
    int bw, bh, bpb = nvn_fmt_bpb(t->d.format, &bw, &bh);
    uint32_t lw = MAX(t->d.width >> level, 1u), lh = MAX(t->d.height >> level, 1u);
    size_t lp = (size_t)((lw + bw - 1) / bw) * bpb, lr = (lh + bh - 1) / bh;
    /* This runs on the game's thread (nvnMemoryPoolInvalidateMappedRange), which has no autorelease pool: without one the
       autoreleased command buffer kept its blit encoder and this read-back buffer for ever (one 16 KiB buffer and one
       blit context per written-back level: Breath of the Wild writes back about 130 a second, 3.7 GB of GPU memory in 30
       minutes; TOTK's AGXG16GFamilyBuffer / BlitContext pairs growing by the thousands per lap were the same). */
    @autoreleasepool {
    id<MTLBuffer> buf = [g_dev newBufferWithLength:lp * lr options:MTLResourceStorageModeShared];
    if (!buf) return 0;
    id<MTLCommandBuffer> cb = q_cb(); id<MTLBlitCommandEncoder> b = enc_b_begin(cb);
    [b copyFromTexture:mt sourceSlice:layer sourceLevel:level sourceOrigin:MTLOriginMake(0, 0, 0) sourceSize:MTLSizeMake(lw, lh, 1)
              toBuffer:buf destinationOffset:0 destinationBytesPerRow:lp destinationBytesPerImage:lp * lr];
    enc_b_end(b); cb_commit(cb); cb_wait(cb);
    if (nvn_swizzle(&t->d, level, layer, (const uint8_t *)buf.contents, lp, t->mem)) return 0;
    g_wb_bytes += lp * lr;
    }
    return 1;
}
/* 0m, preemptive download (22 October; Ryujinx's flush balance / FlushIntoBuffer): a texture the game keeps reading back
   (Odyssey: an R32F 256x128 and an RGBA16F 128x128 target, several reads a frame) is copied into a shared staging buffer
   at the end of every submission that renders it, in that same command buffer (pre_emit, behind the copy encoder's queue
   barrier), so the read only waits for that submission's fence and converts from the buffer on the CPU, with no command
   buffer of its own and no waitUntilCompleted (wb_level_back was ~95% of the time left in invalidate). Each texture keeps
   the copies of its last renderings in a ring of PRE_RING buffers, for reads of the previous one while the newest is
   still recorded. A texture is hot after PRE_HOT reads and cools after PRE_COOL frames without one. TOTK_WB_PREFETCH=0:
   off.
   The ring is fixed: a buffer stays in the residency set for the texture's life and is only rewritten once the GPU has
   finished its copy, and never while it holds one of the two newest copies (the ones a read waits for). With no such
   slot the copy is skipped and the read falls back to wb_level_back. (The first version kept two buffers and allocated a
   new one whenever the older was still in flight, dropping a buffer without res_remove each time: the residency set
   grew by thousands, and residency commits stalled frames for seconds.) */
enum { PRE_HOT = 2, PRE_COOL = 120, PRE_PEND = 32, PRE_RING = 4 };
@interface NvPre : NSObject { @public uint32_t reads; uint64_t last_read; id<MTLBuffer> buf[PRE_RING]; uint64_t fence[PRE_RING]; tex_t t[PRE_RING]; } @end
@implementation NvPre @end
static NSMutableDictionary<NSNumber *, NvPre *> *g_pre;
static os_unfair_lock g_pre_lock = OS_UNFAIR_LOCK_INIT;
static struct { tex_t t; void *obj; } g_pre_pend[PRE_PEND];   // replay thread: hot renderings of the submission being encoded
static int g_pre_npend;
static _Atomic uint64_t g_pre_copies, g_pre_hits, g_pre_misses, g_pre_bufs, g_pre_skips;
static int pre_on(void) { static int v = -1; if (v < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_WB_PREFETCH"); v = !(e && !strcmp(e, "0")); } return v; }
static size_t pre_level_offset(const tex_t *t, unsigned level, unsigned layer, size_t *pitch, size_t *bytes) {
    int bw, bh, bpb = nvn_fmt_bpb(t->d.format, &bw, &bh); size_t off = 0;
    unsigned layers = t->L.layers ? t->L.layers : 1;
    for (unsigned l = 0; l < t->d.levels; l++) {
        uint32_t lw = MAX(t->d.width >> l, 1u), lh = MAX(t->d.height >> l, 1u);
        size_t lp = (size_t)((lw + bw - 1) / bw) * bpb, sz = lp * ((lh + bh - 1) / bh);
        for (unsigned y = 0; y < layers; y++) {
            if (l == level && y == layer) { if (pitch) *pitch = lp; if (bytes) *bytes = sz; return off; }
            off += sz;
        }
    }
    if (bytes) *bytes = 0;
    return off;   // level == levels: the total size
}
static int pre_same_layout(const tex_t *a, const tex_t *b) {
    return a->d.width == b->d.width && a->d.height == b->d.height && a->d.format == b->d.format && a->d.levels == b->d.levels &&
           (a->L.layers ? a->L.layers : 1) == (b->L.layers ? b->L.layers : 1);
}
static void pre_note(const tex_t *t, id o) {   // wb_note, replay thread
    if (!pre_on()) return;
    uint64_t now = atomic_load(&g_cur_frame);
    os_unfair_lock_lock(&g_pre_lock);
    NvPre *p = g_pre[@(t->serial)];
    int hot = p && p->reads >= PRE_HOT && now - p->last_read <= PRE_COOL;
    os_unfair_lock_unlock(&g_pre_lock);
    if (!hot || bc_unpack(t->d.format, NULL, NULL) || t->d.target == 2 || t->d.samples > 1) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_pre_npend; i++) if (g_pre_pend[i].t.serial == t->serial) { g_pre_pend[i].t = *t; return; }
    if (g_pre_npend == PRE_PEND) return;
    g_pre_pend[g_pre_npend].t = *t; g_pre_pend[g_pre_npend].obj = (void *)CFBridgingRetain(o); g_pre_npend++;
}
/* Entries of textures no longer read back (cold, or the texture is gone: its serial is never seen again) release their
   ring buffers once the GPU is done with them; an entry without buffers is dropped. Without this the ring buffers of
   every texture ever read back stayed resident (soak-60-a, 23 October: 86 buffers after 23 minutes and rising). */
enum { PRE_RELEASE = 4 * PRE_COOL };
static void pre_sweep(void) {   // replay thread, at most every PRE_COOL frames
    static uint64_t last;
    uint64_t now = atomic_load(&g_cur_frame), done = g_done;
    if (now - last < PRE_COOL) return;
    last = now;
    os_unfair_lock_lock(&g_pre_lock);
    NSMutableArray<NSNumber *> *drop = [NSMutableArray array];
    for (NSNumber *key in g_pre) {
        NvPre *p = g_pre[key];
        if (now - p->last_read <= PRE_RELEASE) continue;
        int left = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < PRE_RING; k++) if (p->buf[k]) {
            if (p->fence[k] > done) { left++; continue; }   // still being written by the GPU: next sweep
            res_remove(p->buf[k]); p->buf[k] = nil; p->fence[k] = 0; atomic_fetch_sub(&g_pre_bufs, 1);
        }
        if (!left) [drop addObject:key];
    }
    [g_pre removeObjectsForKeys:drop];
    os_unfair_lock_unlock(&g_pre_lock);
}
static void pre_emit(void) {   // mtl_sub_commit, before the copy encoder closes: this submission commits with fence g_fence + 1
    if (pre_on() && g_pre) pre_sweep();
    if (!g_pre_npend) return;
    uint64_t fence = g_fence + 1, done = g_done;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_pre_npend; i++) {
        tex_t *t = &g_pre_pend[i].t; id o = CFBridgingRelease(g_pre_pend[i].obj);
        id<MTLTexture> mt = [o isKindOfClass:[NvPkg class]] ? ((NvPkg *)o)->tex : o;
        if (!mt) continue;
        size_t total = pre_level_offset(t, t->d.levels, 0, NULL, NULL);
        os_unfair_lock_lock(&g_pre_lock);
        NvPre *p = g_pre[@(t->serial)];
        if (!p) { os_unfair_lock_unlock(&g_pre_lock); continue; }
        /* Slot: an empty one, else the oldest finished copy outside the two newest (a reader holds g_pre_lock while it
           converts, and the fence changes here under the lock, so a read never converts a slot being rewritten). */
        int n1 = -1, n2 = -1, s = -1;
        for (int k = 0; k < PRE_RING; k++) if (p->buf[k]) {
            if (n1 < 0 || p->fence[k] > p->fence[n1]) { n2 = n1; n1 = k; } else if (n2 < 0 || p->fence[k] > p->fence[n2]) n2 = k;
        }
        for (int k = 0; k < PRE_RING; k++) {
            if (!p->buf[k]) { s = k; break; }
            if (k != n1 && k != n2 && p->fence[k] <= done && (s < 0 || p->fence[k] < p->fence[s])) s = k;
        }
        if (s < 0) { os_unfair_lock_unlock(&g_pre_lock); atomic_fetch_add(&g_pre_skips, 1); continue; }
        id<MTLBuffer> b = p->buf[s];
        if (b && b.length < total) { res_remove(b); b = nil; atomic_fetch_sub(&g_pre_bufs, 1); }   // finished, so safe to remove
        if (!b) {
            b = [g_dev newBufferWithLength:total options:MTLResourceStorageModeShared];
            if (!b) { p->buf[s] = nil; os_unfair_lock_unlock(&g_pre_lock); continue; }
            res_add(b); atomic_fetch_add(&g_pre_bufs, 1);
        }
        p->buf[s] = b; p->fence[s] = fence; p->t[s] = *t;
        os_unfair_lock_unlock(&g_pre_lock);
        id<MTL4ComputeCommandEncoder> e = blit_kind(0);
        unsigned layers = t->L.layers ? t->L.layers : 1;
        for (unsigned l = 0; l < t->d.levels; l++) for (unsigned y = 0; y < layers; y++) {
            size_t lp, sz, off = pre_level_offset(t, l, y, &lp, &sz);
            uint32_t lw = MAX(t->d.width >> l, 1u), lh = MAX(t->d.height >> l, 1u);
            [e copyFromTexture:mt sourceSlice:y sourceLevel:l sourceOrigin:MTLOriginMake(0, 0, 0) sourceSize:MTLSizeMake(lw, lh, 1)
                      toBuffer:b destinationOffset:off destinationBytesPerRow:lp destinationBytesPerImage:sz];
        }
        atomic_fetch_add(&g_pre_copies, 1);
    }
    g_pre_npend = 0;
}
/* wb_write_list: one read of this texture (hotness), and if a copy of the rendering at `fence` exists, convert it into
   memory from that copy. Returns 1 when written back from the copy. The caller has waited for `fence`. */
static int pre_read(const tex_t *t, uint64_t fence, int convert) {   // convert 0: only count the read (a stale entry)
    if (!pre_on()) return 0;
    os_unfair_lock_lock(&g_pre_lock);
    if (!g_pre) g_pre = [NSMutableDictionary dictionary];
    NvPre *p = g_pre[@(t->serial)];
    if (!p) { p = [NvPre new]; g_pre[@(t->serial)] = p; }
    uint64_t now = atomic_load(&g_cur_frame);
    if (now - p->last_read > PRE_COOL) p->reads = 0;
    p->reads++; p->last_read = now;
    int s = -1;
    for (int k = 0; k < PRE_RING && s < 0; k++) if (p->buf[k] && p->fence[k] == fence) s = k;
    int ok = 0;
    if (convert && s >= 0 && fence <= g_done && pre_same_layout(&p->t[s], t)) {
        const uint8_t *base = (const uint8_t *)p->buf[s].contents; unsigned layers = t->L.layers ? t->L.layers : 1; ok = 1;
        for (unsigned l = 0; l < t->d.levels && ok; l++) for (unsigned y = 0; y < layers && ok; y++) {
            size_t lp, sz, off = pre_level_offset(t, l, y, &lp, &sz);
            ok = !nvn_swizzle(&t->d, l, y, base + off, lp, t->mem);
            if (ok) g_wb_bytes += sz;
        }
    }
    os_unfair_lock_unlock(&g_pre_lock);
    if (convert) atomic_fetch_add(ok ? &g_pre_hits : &g_pre_misses, 1);
    return ok;
}
static void wb_write_list(wb_ent **list, int nl, int force);
/* Diagnostic TOTK_WB_EAGER=<w>x<h>: at every present, renderings of mirrored textures of that size are written back to
   memory without waiting for the game's invalidate (to see whether the CPU reads them from an uncached pool). */
void mtl_wb_eager(void) {
    static int on = -1; static unsigned w, h; if (on < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_WB_EAGER"); on = e && sscanf(e, "%ux%u", &w, &h) == 2; if (on) MLOG("TOTK_WB_EAGER: %ux%u renderings written back every frame", w, h); }
    if (!on || !atomic_load(&g_wb_on)) return;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu);
    wb_ent *list[512]; int nl = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_wb.cap && nl < 512 && g_wb.n; i++) {
        wb_ent *e = g_wb.vals ? g_wb.vals[i] : NULL;
        if (!e || e->t.d.width != w || e->t.d.height != h) continue;
        uint64_t k = e->t.serial; nvn_hm_del(&g_wb, &k); list[nl++] = e; i = (uint32_t)-1;
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu);
    wb_write_list(list, nl, 1);
}
void mtl_pool_invalidate(const pool_t *p, uint64_t off, uint64_t n) {
    if (!p || !p->mem || !atomic_load(&g_wb_on)) return;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu);
    if (!g_wb.n) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu); return; }
    const uint8_t *a = p->mem + off, *z = a + n;
    wb_ent *list[512]; int nl = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_wb.cap && nl < 512; i++) {
        wb_ent *e = g_wb.vals ? g_wb.vals[i] : NULL;
        if (!e || e->t.mem >= z || e->t.mem + e->t.L.size <= a) continue;
        uint64_t k = e->t.serial; nvn_hm_del(&g_wb, &k); list[nl++] = e; i = (uint32_t)-1;   // deletion shifts entries: rescan
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu);
    wb_write_list(list, nl, 0);
}
/* Writes the listed renderings back to memory (the entries are freed); force: even over CPU writes since the render. */
static void wb_write_list(wb_ent **list, int nl, int force) {
    if (!nl) return;
    { extern void nvn_x_drain(void) __attribute__((weak)); if (nvn_x_drain) nvn_x_drain(); }   // translation thread: nothing queued overtakes this read-back (as for ReadTexels)
    /* Freshness is decided for every entry before anything is written back (a write-back marks its pages written), and
       of several renderings of the same memory (texture objects over it) only the newest is written back. It reads only
       the CPU dirty tracking, so it comes before the GPU wait: Odyssey's R32F 256x128 target is rewritten by the CPU after
       most renderings (264 of 382 skipped), and the whole GPU used to be drained only to discard the result (22 October;
       the drain was ~35% of the time the game thread spent in invalidate). */
    int fresh[512], any = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < nl; i++) fresh[i] = force || !nvn_dirty_since(list[i]->t.mem, list[i]->t.L.size, list[i]->stamp);
    for (int i = 0; i < nl; i++)
        if (!fresh[i] && list[i]->snap && list[i]->snap_n == list[i]->t.L.size && !memcmp(list[i]->snap, list[i]->t.mem, list[i]->snap_n)) {   // page dirty, texture's own bytes not
            fresh[i] = 1; uint64_t r = ++g_wb_exact_rescued;
            if (r <= 8 || r % 5000 == 0) MLOG("[writeback] small target ser=%llu %ux%u: page written by the CPU but not this texture, written back (%llu so far)", (unsigned long long)list[i]->t.serial, (unsigned)list[i]->t.d.width, (unsigned)list[i]->t.d.height, (unsigned long long)r);
        }
    for (int i = 0; i < nl; i++) for (int j = 0; j < nl; j++)
        if (i != j && fresh[i] && fresh[j] && list[j]->t.mem == list[i]->t.mem && list[j]->stamp > list[i]->stamp) { fresh[i] = 2; break; }   // 2: superseded
    for (int i = 0; i < nl; i++) any |= fresh[i] == 1;
    static _Atomic uint64_t waited, avoided;
    /* Wait for the renderings that will be written back, not for the newest GPU work (0b part B, lead researcher's
       citations): uploads go to the same Metal 4 queue before the render that uses them, and every encoder opens with a
       queue barrier (bar_start_on), so the render's fence implies its uploads ran. Without that barrier (TOTK_BARRIER_START=0)
       the in-flight uploads are still waited for. A fence not committed yet (none expected after the drain above) is
       bounded by the newest committed one, as before. */
    /* A target the game renders every frame is read while this frame's rendering into it is being recorded (its fence
       not committed; about a third of Odyssey's writebacks in Bonneton): the bytes the game waited for are the previous
       rendering's, so that one is waited for. The copy runs on another queue, after this wait, before the new one runs. */
    uint64_t want = 0, committed = g_fence, waited_for[512];
    static _Atomic uint64_t previous_used;
    for (int i = 0; i < nl; i++) { waited_for[i] = 0; if (fresh[i] == 1) {
        uint64_t f = list[i]->fence;
        if (f > committed) { f = list[i]->prev_fence ? list[i]->prev_fence : committed; atomic_fetch_add(&previous_used, 1); }   // no earlier rendering recorded: the old, conservative wait
        waited_for[i] = f;
        if (f > want) want = f;
    } }
    if (want > committed) {   // not expected: two renderings of it after the last commit; the newest committed one bounds it, as before
        static _Atomic uint64_t early;
        uint64_t n = atomic_fetch_add(&early, 1) + 1;
        if (n <= 8 || n % 100 == 0) MLOG("【红】[writeback] no committed rendering to wait for (fence %llu > committed %llu): waiting for the newest committed submission, as before (%llu times)", (unsigned long long)want, (unsigned long long)committed, (unsigned long long)n);
        want = committed;
    }
    if (any) {
        if (want) mtl_wait(want, UINT64_MAX);
        if (!bar_start_on()) while (atomic_load(&g_up_pending)) usleep(1000);
        atomic_fetch_add(&waited, 1);
    } else atomic_fetch_add(&avoided, 1);
    { uint64_t a = atomic_load(&avoided), w = atomic_load(&waited); if ((a + w) % 200 == 0) MLOG("[writeback] invalidates with renderings: %llu waited for the GPU, %llu needed no wait (nothing fresh); %llu waited for the previous rendering (the newest still being recorded); staging copies %llu (skipped, ring busy: %llu; buffers %llu), reads from a copy %llu, without one %llu", (unsigned long long)w, (unsigned long long)a, (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&previous_used), (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&g_pre_copies), (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&g_pre_skips), (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&g_pre_bufs), (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&g_pre_hits), (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&g_pre_misses)); }
    for (int i = 0; i < nl; i++) {
        wb_ent *e = list[i]; const tex_t *t = &e->t;
        id o = (__bridge id)e->obj; id<MTLTexture> mt = [o isKindOfClass:[NvPkg class]] ? ((NvPkg *)o)->tex : o;
        uint32_t upf; int ubpp;
        if (fresh[i] == 2 || !mt) { wb_ent_free(e); continue; }   // !mt: copy evicted (pkg_evict_sweep) before the GPU rendered into it
        TILELOG(t, "write-back request: %s", !fresh[i] ? "CPU wrote since the render, skip" : "write back");
        if (tilelog_match(t) && !fresh[i]) {   // who wrote it
            extern int runtime_module_offset(uint64_t pc, const char **name, uint64_t *off);
            nvn_dirty_rec rec[64]; int nr = nvn_dirty_recent((uintptr_t)t->mem & ~(uintptr_t)16383, (uintptr_t)t->mem + t->L.size, rec, 64);
            char line[900]; size_t o2 = 0; int shown = 0; uint64_t seen[8]; int ns = 0;
            for (int q = nr - 1; q >= 0 && shown < 6 && o2 < sizeof line - 120; q--) {
                uint64_t pc = rec[q].pc; int dup = 0; for (int w = 0; w < ns; w++) if (seen[w] == pc) dup = 1; if (dup) continue; if (ns < 8) seen[ns++] = pc;
                const char *mn = "?", *ln = "?"; uint64_t mo = 0, lo2 = 0; int okp = runtime_module_offset(pc, &mn, &mo), okl = rec[q].lr && runtime_module_offset(rec[q].lr, &ln, &lo2);
                Dl_info di; if (!okp && dladdr((void *)(uintptr_t)pc, &di) && di.dli_fbase) { mn = di.dli_sname ? di.dli_sname : "host"; mo = pc - (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)di.dli_fbase + 0x100000000ull; okp = 1; }
                o2 += snprintf(line + o2, sizeof line - o2, " [%s pc=%s+%#llx lr=%s+%#llx page+%#llx]", rec[q].src ? "host" : "guest", okp ? mn : "?", (unsigned long long)(okp ? mo : pc),
                               okl ? ln : "-", (unsigned long long)(okl ? lo2 : 0), (unsigned long long)(rec[q].page - (uintptr_t)t->mem)); shown++;
            }
            TILELOG(t, "writers since the render (%d records):%s", nr, line);
        }
        if (fresh[i] == 0) pre_read(t, 0, 0);   // 0m: a stale read still counts towards hotness (fresh ones count in the conversion below)
        if (!fresh[i]) {   // the CPU wrote it since: its bytes are newer
            if (++g_wb_skip_cpu <= 24) MLOG("[writeback] skipped (CPU wrote since the render) ser=%llu %ux%u nvnfmt=%#x lv%u", (unsigned long long)t->serial, t->d.width, t->d.height, t->d.format, t->d.levels);
            wb_ent_free(e); continue;
        }
        if (!mt || bc_unpack(t->d.format, &upf, &ubpp) || t->d.target == 2 || t->d.samples > 1) { if (++g_wb_skip_fmt <= 8) MLOG("【红】GPU 写回内存：不支持的贴图 ser=%llu 格式 %#x 目标 %d", (unsigned long long)t->serial, t->d.format, t->d.target); wb_ent_free(e); continue; }
        /* the GPU's bytes landing in memory: not a CPU write (with dm_guest_write_prepare the page this texture shares
           with a neighbour counted as written, and the neighbour's own write-back was skipped as "CPU wrote since") */
        void *tok = nvn_dirty_tracked(t->mem, t->L.size) ? nvn_dirty_gpu_write_begin(t->mem, t->L.size) : NULL;
        if (!tok) dm_guest_write_prepare(t->mem, t->L.size);
        unsigned layers = t->L.layers ? t->L.layers : 1, ok = 1;
        if (!pre_read(t, waited_for[i], 1))   // 0m: from this rendering's staging copy when there is one
            for (unsigned l = 0; l < t->d.levels && ok; l++) for (unsigned y = 0; y < layers && ok; y++) ok = wb_level_back(t, mt, l, y);
        nvn_dirty_gpu_write_end(tok);
        if (ok) { uint64_t d = ++g_wb_done; if (d <= 8 || d % 500 == 0) MLOG("[writeback] ser=%llu %ux%u nvnfmt=%#x lv%u：GPU 渲染结果写回内存（累计 %llu 张 / %llu MB，CPU 已改写而跳过 %llu 张）", (unsigned long long)t->serial, t->d.width, t->d.height, t->d.format, t->d.levels, (unsigned long long)d, (unsigned long long)(g_wb_bytes >> 20), (unsigned long long)g_wb_skip_cpu); }
        else MLOG("【红】GPU 写回内存失败 ser=%llu 格式 %#x", (unsigned long long)t->serial, t->d.format);
        wb_ent_free(e);
    }
}
static uint64_t g_pkg_uploads, g_pkg_reuploads, g_pkg_miss, g_pkg_restored;
static uint64_t g_pfv_upgrades;
// DM_NVN_DIRTYCHECK=1（诊断，对照真值）：每次使用都全量哈希池内容，变了却没被脏页跟踪检出 = 漏检
// DM_NVN_DIRTYCHECK=1 (diagnostic, compared against ground truth): fully hash the pool content on every use; changed but not detected by dirty-page tracking = a missed detection
static int dirtycheck(void) { static int v = -1; if (v < 0) v = getenv("DM_NVN_DIRTYCHECK") != NULL; return v; }
static uint64_t full_hash(const uint8_t *m, uint64_t n) { uint64_t h = 1469598103934665603ull; for (uint64_t i = 0; i < n; i++) h = (h ^ m[i]) * 1099511628211ull; return h; }
// 显卡不支持 BC 压缩格式（A15 / A16 等）：BC 贴图建成解压后的格式，上传 / 缓冲→贴图拷贝时在 CPU 上解压（nvn_bcdec.c）。
// 游戏贴图里的 BC3 由老机型补充包离线换成了 ASTC（dm/tools/astc_pack.py），走到这里的是剩下的少量 BC。测试开关 DM_TEST_NO_BC=1 在任何机器上强制走这条路
// The GPU does not support BC compressed formats (A15 / A16 etc.): BC textures are created in the decompressed format and decompressed on the CPU at upload / buffer→texture copy time (nvn_bcdec.c).
// BC3 among the game textures was converted to ASTC offline by the Legacy Device Pack (dm/tools/astc_pack.py); what reaches here is the small remainder of BC. The test switch DM_TEST_NO_BC=1 forces this path on any machine
static int no_bc(void) {
    static int v = -1;
    if (v < 0) { const char *e = getenv("DM_TEST_NO_BC"); v = (e && *e && strcmp(e, "0")) || ![g_dev supportsBCTextureCompression];
        if (v) MLOG("显卡不支持 BC 压缩格式%s：BC 贴图建成解压格式（BC1–5 在 GPU 上解压，BC6H / BC7 / 3D 在 CPU 上）", e && *e && strcmp(e, "0") ? "（测试开关 DM_TEST_NO_BC）" : ""); }
    return v;
}
static int bc_unpack(uint32_t nvn_fmt, uint32_t *pf, int *bpp) { return no_bc() && nvn_bc_unpacked(nvn_fmt, pf, bpp); }
/* TOTK, no BC (A15/A16): BC1 textures (most of TOTK's colour textures) become ASTC 4x4 instead of RGBA8: a quarter of the
   memory. Uploads transcode on the GPU (bc1astc kernel, tex/nvn_bc1astc_msl.h) after the deswizzle; CPU paths use the C
   transcoder (tex/nvn_bc1astc.c). 3D, 1D and multisample BC1 textures keep the decompressed path. TOTK_BC1_ASTC=0 turns
   it off. probe-bc1astc checks the transcoding through Metal's ASTC decoder. */
static int bc1_fmt(uint32_t f) { return f == 0x41 || f == 0x42 || f == 0x45 || f == 0x46; }
static int bc1_rgba(uint32_t f) { return f == 0x42 || f == 0x46; }
static MTLPixelFormat bc1_astc_pf(uint32_t f) { return (f == 0x45 || f == 0x46) ? MTLPixelFormatASTC_4x4_sRGB : MTLPixelFormatASTC_4x4_LDR; }
static int pf_astc4(NSUInteger pf) { return pf == MTLPixelFormatASTC_4x4_LDR || pf == MTLPixelFormatASTC_4x4_sRGB; }
static int astc_on(void) {
    static int v = -1;
    if (v < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_BC1_ASTC"); v = no_bc() && (!e || atoi(e)); if (v) MLOG("无 BC：BC1 贴图转成 ASTC 4x4（TOTK_BC1_ASTC=0 改回解压成 RGBA8）"); }
    return v;
}
static int tex_astc(const tex_t *t) { uint32_t g = t->d.target; return astc_on() && bc1_fmt(t->d.format) && (g == 1 || g == 4 || g == 7 || g == 8 || g == 9); }
/* TOTK, no BC: CPU-pool (mirrored) BC2/BC3/BC7 textures become ASTC 4x4 and unsigned BC4/BC5 EAC R11/RG11 instead of
   RGBA8 / R8 / RG8 (a quarter / half of the memory), transcoded on the GPU after the deswizzle (tex/nvn_bctc.metal,
   probe-gpu-bctc). Only uploads that take the GPU deswizzle path (pool-backed block-linear storage); others, GPU-owned
   textures and a copy the GPU starts rendering into keep the decompressed format. TOTK_BC_TRANSCODE=0 turns it off. */
static MTLPixelFormat tc_pf(uint32_t f) {
    switch (f) {
    case 0x43: case 0x44: case 0x4d: return MTLPixelFormatASTC_4x4_LDR;
    case 0x47: case 0x48: case 0x4e: return MTLPixelFormatASTC_4x4_sRGB;
    case 0x49: return MTLPixelFormatEAC_R11Unorm;
    case 0x4b: return MTLPixelFormatEAC_RG11Unorm;
    default: return MTLPixelFormatInvalid;
    }
}
static int tex_mirrored(const tex_t *t);
static id<MTLComputePipelineState> bctc_pso(void);
int mtl_addr(uint64_t addr, uint64_t len, void **buf, uint64_t *off);
static int g_mip_nodrop;   // set while re-uploading a copy at full size and in the decompressed format (the GPU renders into it)
static int tex_tc(const tex_t *t) {
    static int on = -1; if (on < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_BC_TRANSCODE"); on = no_bc() && (!e || atoi(e)); if (on) MLOG("无 BC：素材里的 BC2/BC3/BC7 转成 ASTC 4x4、BC4/BC5 转成 EAC（TOTK_BC_TRANSCODE=0 改回解压）"); }
    uint32_t g = t->d.target; void *mb; uint64_t mo;
    return on && !g_mip_nodrop && tc_pf(t->d.format) != MTLPixelFormatInvalid && (g == 1 || g == 4 || g == 7 || g == 8 || g == 9) && tex_mirrored(t)
        && g_nvn_deswz_gpu && !nvn_tex_is_linear(&t->d) && mtl_addr((uint64_t)t->mem, t->L.size, &mb, &mo) && bctc_pso();
}
// TOTK: NVN texture swizzle selectors (0/1 = constants, 2..5 = R..A) composed with the format remap of nvn_fmt_to_mtl.
// Returns 1 when the result is not the identity.
// A view with its own swizzle (view selectors non-NULL) replaces the texture's selectors.
static int tex_swizzle_sel(const tex_t *t, const uint8_t *view_sel, int format, MTLTextureSwizzleChannels *out) {
    uint32_t pf = 0; uint8_t swz[4] = {MTLTextureSwizzleRed, MTLTextureSwizzleGreen, MTLTextureSwizzleBlue, MTLTextureSwizzleAlpha};
    if (!nvn_fmt_to_mtl(format, &pf, swz)) return 0;
    unsigned sel[4] = {t->d.swizzle_r, t->d.swizzle_g, t->d.swizzle_b, t->d.swizzle_a};
    if (view_sel) for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; i++) sel[i] = view_sel[i];
    MTLTextureSwizzle c[4];
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; i++) c[i] = (MTLTextureSwizzle)(sel[i] < 2 ? sel[i] : swz[sel[i] - 2]);
    *out = MTLTextureSwizzleChannelsMake(c[0], c[1], c[2], c[3]);
    return c[0] != MTLTextureSwizzleRed || c[1] != MTLTextureSwizzleGreen || c[2] != MTLTextureSwizzleBlue || c[3] != MTLTextureSwizzleAlpha;
}
static int tex_swizzle(const tex_t *t, int format, MTLTextureSwizzleChannels *out) { return tex_swizzle_sel(t, NULL, format, out); }
static int swizzle_eq(MTLTextureSwizzleChannels a, MTLTextureSwizzleChannels b) { return a.red == b.red && a.green == b.green && a.blue == b.blue && a.alpha == b.alpha; }
// From games/totk (f864eb0): a texture that comes from a mod can carry descriptor fields the guest never validates and Metal refuses to
// build - it aborts the process from -[MTLTextureDescriptorInternal validateWithDevice:] (seen with The Second Quest:
// "requests 9 mipmap levels, but the dimensions (1, 1, 1) can only support 1"). Cap every guest-controlled field at
// what the hardware allows; the game's own data is always inside these bounds, so nothing changes for it.
static void tex_desc_fixup(const tex_t *t, MTLTextureDescriptor *d) {
    static uint64_t capped;
    char why[160] = "";
    NSUInteger w = d.width, h = d.height, z = d.depth;
    NSUInteger arr0 = d.arrayLength, smp0 = d.sampleCount, lv0 = d.mipmapLevelCount, w0 = d.width, h0 = d.height, z0 = d.depth;
    int is_msaa = d.textureType == MTLTextureType2DMultisample || d.textureType == MTLTextureType2DMultisampleArray;
    if (w < 1 || w > 16384) { d.width = w = w < 1 ? 1 : 16384; strlcat(why, "宽, ", sizeof why); }
    if (h < 1 || h > 16384) { d.height = h = h < 1 ? 1 : 16384; strlcat(why, "高, ", sizeof why); }
    if (z < 1 || z > 2048) { d.depth = z = z < 1 ? 1 : 2048; strlcat(why, "深, ", sizeof why); }
    NSUInteger biggest = w > h ? w : h;
    if (d.textureType == MTLTextureType3D && z > biggest) biggest = z;
    unsigned allowed = 1;
    for (NSUInteger v = biggest; v > 1; v >>= 1) allowed++;
    if (d.mipmapLevelCount > allowed) { d.mipmapLevelCount = allowed; strlcat(why, "mip 级数, ", sizeof why); }
    if (d.mipmapLevelCount < 1) { d.mipmapLevelCount = 1; strlcat(why, "mip 级数, ", sizeof why); }
    if (d.arrayLength < 1 || d.arrayLength > 2048) { d.arrayLength = d.arrayLength < 1 ? 1 : 2048; strlcat(why, "数组长度, ", sizeof why); }
    if (!(d.sampleCount == 1 || d.sampleCount == 2 || d.sampleCount == 4 || d.sampleCount == 8)) {
        d.sampleCount = 1; strlcat(why, "采样数, ", sizeof why);
    }
    if (d.sampleCount > 1 && !is_msaa) { d.sampleCount = 1; strlcat(why, "采样数, ", sizeof why); }   // only the multisample types may sample more than once
    if (d.sampleCount > 1) d.mipmapLevelCount = 1;
    if (!why[0]) return;
    if (capped++ < 6 || capped % 500 == 0) {
        size_t n = strlen(why); if (n > 2) why[n - 2] = 0;      // drop the trailing ", "
        MLOG("[tex] ser=%llu %ux%ux%u 目标 %d 声明 %lux%lux%lu arr=%lu smp=%lu 级数=%lu：%s 超出硬件允许，按 %lux%lux%lu arr=%lu smp=%lu 级数=%lu 创建（累计 %llu 张；Metal 否则会终止进程）",
             (unsigned long long)t->serial, (uint32_t)t->d.width, (uint32_t)t->d.height, (uint32_t)t->d.depth, (int)t->d.target,
             (unsigned long)w0, (unsigned long)h0, (unsigned long)z0, (unsigned long)arr0, (unsigned long)smp0, (unsigned long)lv0,
             why, (unsigned long)d.width, (unsigned long)d.height, (unsigned long)d.depth, (unsigned long)d.arrayLength,
             (unsigned long)d.sampleCount, (unsigned long)d.mipmapLevelCount, (unsigned long long)capped);
    }
}

static MTLTextureDescriptor *tex_desc(const tex_t *t, int packaged) {
    uint32_t pf = 0; uint8_t swz[4];
    if (!nvn_fmt_to_mtl(t->d.format, &pf, swz) || !pf) { RED_ONCE(0, "贴图格式 %#x Metal 无对应（首例）", t->d.format); return nil; }
    int unp = 0; { uint32_t upf; int ubpp; if (tex_astc(t)) pf = (uint32_t)bc1_astc_pf(t->d.format); else if (tex_tc(t)) pf = (uint32_t)tc_pf(t->d.format); else if (bc_unpack(t->d.format, &upf, &ubpp)) { pf = upf; unp = 1; } }
    MTLTextureDescriptor *d = [MTLTextureDescriptor new];
    d.pixelFormat = (MTLPixelFormat)pf;
    d.width = t->d.width ? t->d.width : 1; d.height = t->d.height ? t->d.height : 1; d.depth = 1; d.arrayLength = 1;
    d.mipmapLevelCount = t->d.levels ? t->d.levels : 1;
    switch (t->d.target) {
        case 0: d.textureType = MTLTextureType1D; d.height = 1; break;
        case 2: d.textureType = MTLTextureType3D; d.depth = t->d.depth; break;
        case 3: d.textureType = MTLTextureType1DArray; d.arrayLength = t->d.height; d.height = 1; break;
        case 4: d.textureType = MTLTextureType2DArray; d.arrayLength = t->d.depth; break;
        case 5: d.textureType = MTLTextureType2DMultisample; d.sampleCount = t->d.samples; d.mipmapLevelCount = 1; break;
        case 6: d.textureType = MTLTextureType2DMultisampleArray; d.sampleCount = t->d.samples; d.arrayLength = t->d.depth; d.mipmapLevelCount = 1; break;
        case 8: d.textureType = MTLTextureTypeCube; break;
        case 9: d.textureType = MTLTextureTypeCubeArray; d.arrayLength = t->d.depth; break;
        case 10: RED_ONCE(1, "缓冲贴图（TARGET_BUFFER）未实现"); return nil;
        default: d.textureType = MTLTextureType2D; break;
    }
    tex_desc_fixup(t, d);
    d.storageMode = MTLStorageModePrivate;   // 渲染目标与素材都放 GPU 私有存储（可用无损压缩） | Render targets and assets both go in GPU private storage (lossless compression available)
    d.usage = MTLTextureUsageShaderRead | (fmt_compressed(t->d.format) || packaged ? 0 : MTLTextureUsageRenderTarget)
            | (t->d.flags & NVN_TEXTURE_FLAGS_IMAGE ? MTLTextureUsageShaderWrite : 0)   // 图像用途：着色器可写（计算核生成 3D 调色表等） | Image usage: shader-writable (compute kernels generating the 3D color lookup table, etc.)
            | (t->d.target == 8 && t->d.width <= 64 && !fmt_compressed(t->d.format) && !packaged ? MTLTextureUsageShaderWrite : 0)   // TOTK: small cube render targets: the cube-merge copy-out kernel writes them (nvn_cube_group.h)
            | (unp ? MTLTextureUsageShaderWrite | MTLTextureUsagePixelFormatView : 0);
    // TOTK: Metal rejects descriptor swizzle on render targets and on shader-writable textures (image use, and BC textures
    // decoded by the bcd kernel on GPUs without BC support); those get the swizzle on their sampling view (tex_by_id).
    MTLTextureSwizzleChannels sw;
    if (tex_swizzle(t, t->d.format, &sw) && !(d.usage & (MTLTextureUsageRenderTarget | MTLTextureUsageShaderWrite))) d.swizzle = sw;
    return d;
}
// 就地升级：原贴图没开 PixelFormatView（缺省不开，保住苹果显卡无损压缩）却要建换格式视图时，按原规格 + PixelFormatView 新建、逐 slice × level 拷过去并替换登记。
// 计数：选角 / 营地 / 野外 / 战斗 4 页 17473 张贴图换格式视图 0 次，所以这里是兜底，不靠预测哪些贴图需要
// In-place upgrade: when the original texture was not created with PixelFormatView (off by default, to keep Apple GPU lossless compression) but a different-format view is needed, create a new one with the original spec + PixelFormatView, copy over every slice × level, and replace the registration.
// Count: across the 4 screens character select / camp / wilderness / combat, 17473 textures needed a different-format view 0 times, so this is a fallback and does not rely on predicting which textures need it
static id<MTLTexture> tex_upgrade_pfv(const tex_t *t, id<MTLTexture> base, MTLPixelFormat view_pf) {
    if (g_tex_preparing && rp_active()) { g_tex_prepare_split = 1; return base; }
    { stor_key k;   // TOTK: a storage-shared base is recreated for every serial holding it, then this serial re-resolves
      if (stor_key_lookup(base, &k)) { if (!stor_recreate(&k, base.usage | MTLTextureUsagePixelFormatView)) return base; id<MTLTexture> nb = tex_mtl(t); return nb ? nb : base; } }
    MTLTextureDescriptor *d = [MTLTextureDescriptor new];
    d.textureType = base.textureType; d.pixelFormat = base.pixelFormat; d.width = base.width; d.height = base.height; d.depth = base.depth;   // 保留原格式，只加换格式视图用途 | Keep the original format, only add the format-view usage
    d.swizzle=base.swizzle;
    d.arrayLength = base.arrayLength; d.mipmapLevelCount = base.mipmapLevelCount; d.sampleCount = base.sampleCount;
    d.storageMode = base.storageMode; d.cpuCacheMode = base.cpuCacheMode; d.hazardTrackingMode = base.hazardTrackingMode;
    d.resourceOptions = base.resourceOptions; d.usage = base.usage | MTLTextureUsagePixelFormatView;
    id<MTLTexture> upgraded = [g_dev newTextureWithDescriptor:d];
    if (!upgraded) { RED_ONCE(45, "贴图升级失败 ser=%llu 格式 %lu → %lu", t->serial, (unsigned long)base.pixelFormat, (unsigned long)view_pf); return base; }
    res_add(upgraded);
    id<MTL4ComputeCommandEncoder> b = blit();
    NSUInteger slices = base.textureType == MTLTextureType3D ? 1 : base.arrayLength * (base.textureType == MTLTextureTypeCube || base.textureType == MTLTextureTypeCubeArray ? 6 : 1);
    for (NSUInteger l = 0; l < base.mipmapLevelCount; l++) {
        NSUInteger w = MAX(base.width >> l, 1u), h = MAX(base.height >> l, 1u), z = base.textureType == MTLTextureType3D ? MAX(base.depth >> l, 1u) : 1;
        if (base.textureType == MTLTextureType3D)
            enc_b_copy_texture(b, base, 0, l, MTLOriginMake(0, 0, 0), MTLSizeMake(w, h, z), upgraded, 0, l, MTLOriginMake(0, 0, 0));
        else for (NSUInteger s = 0; s < slices; s++)
            enc_b_copy_texture(b, base, s, l, MTLOriginMake(0, 0, 0), MTLSizeMake(w, h, 1), upgraded, s, l, MTLOriginMake(0, 0, 0));
    }
    id holder = serial_get(t->serial);
    if ([holder isKindOfClass:[NvPkg class]]) { id<MTLTexture> old = ((NvPkg *)holder)->tex; ((NvPkg *)holder)->tex = upgraded; memset(&((NvPkg *)holder)->key, 0, sizeof(reup_key)); defer_obj_release(old); ser_bump(t->serial); }   // key 0: the upgraded texture is not recycled
    else serial_put(t->serial, upgraded);
    MLOG("贴图升级为可换格式视图 ser=%llu 基格式 %lu → 视图格式 %lu（升级次数=%llu）", t->serial, (unsigned long)base.pixelFormat, (unsigned long)view_pf, ++g_pfv_upgrades);
    return upgraded;
}
static int stor_key_lookup(id o, stor_key *k) {
    if (!o) return 0; uint64_t ok = obj_key(o);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu); stor_ent *e = nvn_hm_get(&g_stor_of_obj, &ok); if (e) *k = e->k; pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu);
    return e != NULL;
}
/* g_smu held. Serials still holding the entry lose their table entries (they re-resolve on next use); the base is
   retired once the submissions using it complete. */
static void stor_release_holders_locked(stor_ent *e) {
    for (int i = 0; i < e->nser; i++) {
        uint64_t s = e->ser[i]; id o = hm_get_id(&g_by_serial, &s); if (!o) continue;
        uint64_t ok = obj_key(o); if (ok != (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)e->tex) nvn_hm_del(&g_stor_of_obj, &ok);
        defer_obj_unref(o); hm_del_id(&g_by_serial, &s); BOTW_SERIAL_NOTE(s, "storage entry dropped")
    }
    e->nser = 0; ser_bump_locked(0);
}
static void stor_drop_locked(stor_ent *e) {
    stor_release_holders_locked(e);
    uint64_t bk = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)e->tex; nvn_hm_del(&g_stor_of_obj, &bk); nvn_hm_del(&g_by_storage, &e->k);
    defer_obj_release((__bridge id)e->tex); CFRelease(e->tex);
    free(e->ser); free(e);
}
/* Replaces the entry's base by one with the requested usage, content copied on the GPU timeline (submit thread only). */
static id<MTLTexture> stor_recreate(const stor_key *k, MTLTextureUsage usage) {
    if (g_tex_preparing && rp_active()) { g_tex_prepare_split = 1; return nil; }
    if (!on_sub_thread() || rp_active()) {   // the copy is a blit, which would end the open render pass under its draw; the serial then keeps a texture of its own
        static uint64_t n; if (++n <= 4) MLOG("storage-shared texture recreate refused (%s): the serial keeps a texture of its own", on_sub_thread() ? "inside a render pass" : "not on the submit thread");
        return nil; }
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu); stor_ent *e = nvn_hm_get(&g_by_storage, k); id<MTLTexture> base = e ? (__bridge id<MTLTexture>)e->tex : nil; pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu);
    if (!base) return nil;
    MTLTextureDescriptor *d = [MTLTextureDescriptor new];
    d.textureType = base.textureType; d.pixelFormat = base.pixelFormat; d.width = base.width; d.height = base.height; d.depth = base.depth;
    d.swizzle = base.swizzle; d.arrayLength = base.arrayLength; d.mipmapLevelCount = base.mipmapLevelCount; d.sampleCount = base.sampleCount;
    d.storageMode = base.storageMode; d.cpuCacheMode = base.cpuCacheMode; d.hazardTrackingMode = base.hazardTrackingMode;
    d.resourceOptions = base.resourceOptions; d.usage = usage;
    id<MTLTexture> nt = [g_dev newTextureWithDescriptor:d];
    if (!nt) { RED_ONCE(120, "storage-shared texture recreate failed %lux%lu format %lu usage %#lx", (unsigned long)base.width, (unsigned long)base.height, (unsigned long)base.pixelFormat, (unsigned long)usage); return nil; }
    res_add(nt);
    if (base.sampleCount <= 1) {
        id<MTL4ComputeCommandEncoder> b = blit();
        NSUInteger slices = base.textureType == MTLTextureType3D ? 1 : base.arrayLength * (base.textureType == MTLTextureTypeCube || base.textureType == MTLTextureTypeCubeArray ? 6 : 1);
        for (NSUInteger l = 0; l < base.mipmapLevelCount; l++) {
            NSUInteger w = MAX(base.width >> l, 1u), h = MAX(base.height >> l, 1u), z = base.textureType == MTLTextureType3D ? MAX(base.depth >> l, 1u) : 1;
            if (base.textureType == MTLTextureType3D) enc_b_copy_texture(b, base, 0, l, MTLOriginMake(0, 0, 0), MTLSizeMake(w, h, z), nt, 0, l, MTLOriginMake(0, 0, 0));
            else for (NSUInteger s = 0; s < slices; s++) enc_b_copy_texture(b, base, s, l, MTLOriginMake(0, 0, 0), MTLSizeMake(w, h, 1), nt, s, l, MTLOriginMake(0, 0, 0));
        }
    }
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu);
    e = nvn_hm_get(&g_by_storage, k);
    if (!e || (__bridge void *)base != e->tex) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu); defer_obj_release(nt); return nil; }   // the entry went away meanwhile (pool finalised)
    stor_release_holders_locked(e);
    uint64_t bk = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)e->tex; nvn_hm_del(&g_stor_of_obj, &bk);
    defer_obj_release(base); CFRelease(e->tex);
    e->tex = (void *)CFBridgingRetain(nt); bk = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)e->tex; nvn_hm_put(&g_stor_of_obj, &bk, e);
    uint64_t n = ++g_stor_recreated;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu);
    if (n <= 8) MLOG("storage-shared texture recreated with usage %#lx (%lux%lu format %lu, %llu so far)", (unsigned long)usage, (unsigned long)base.width, (unsigned long)base.height, (unsigned long)base.pixelFormat, (unsigned long long)n);
    return nt;
}
/* NVN compression: a compressible texture in a compressible pool keeps its contents in compressed form, and a clear only
   sets the compression state - the bytes under it stay as they were. A descriptor that reads the same storage in another
   format therefore does not see such writes on hardware. 2026-10-15, the frame-wide flashes: when the game moved the
   linear depth to new memory, the deferred lighting kept reading the old depth descriptor for two frames, while the old
   memory already belonged to an RGBA8 target cleared to white; with one shared Metal texture every depth texel read
   0xFFFFFFFF = NaN, the lighting turned NaN and bloom / exposure spread it over the frame.
   So compressible textures share storage only with the same format or its sRGB / linear twin. When one of another format
   arrives, the storage changes hands: the current entry is detached (kept, with its content, for the serials and stale
   descriptors still holding it) and the newcomer's format owns the storage; a detached entry of the newcomer's format is
   taken back instead of creating a new texture, so a buffer re-initialised every frame keeps last frame's content.
   Detached entries go when nobody has held them for STOR_IDLE_SUBMITS submissions or their pool is finalised.
   TOTK_COMPRESSED_ALIAS=1 shares across formats as before (A/B). */
static uint64_t g_stor_handover, g_stor_taken_back;
