        for(unsigned i=0;i<15;i++)enc_r_vbuf(en,16+i,pgpu);
        uint64_t bound=g_vertex_streams_bound;bind_vertex_streams(en,vs);
        unsigned expected_bind=mode?(scenario==2?1:2):15;
        if(g_vertex_streams_bound-bound!=expected_bind && !g_vertex_streams_negative)MDIE("vertex stream probe unexpected binding count");checked++;
        uint64_t skips=g_arg_bind_skips;bind_vertex_streams(en,vs);
        if(cache_mode && !g_arg_bind_cache_negative && g_arg_bind_skips==skips)MDIE("argument binding probe did not skip repeated addresses");checked++;
        enc_r_draw(en,MTLPrimitiveTypeTriangle,0,3);enc_r_end(en);
        enc_b_copy_texture_buffer(blit(),texture,0,0,MTLOriginMake(0,0,0),MTLSizeMake(16,16,1),rb,0,64,1024);mtl_sub_commit();mtl_finish();
        for(unsigned i=0;i<1024;i++){int expected=scenario==2?0:(int[]){64,128,191,255}[i%4];if(abs((int)((uint8_t *)rb.contents)[i]-expected)>1)MDIE("vertex stream probe GPU mismatch mode%d scenario%d byte%u",mode,scenario,i);checked++;}
    }
    /* The two shader stages both use buffer(0), with distinct addresses. Change
       both inside one pass, then start a new encoder using unchanged addresses. */
    NSString *arg_source=@"#include <metal_stdlib>\nusing namespace metal;\nstruct V { float4 p [[position]]; float4 c; }; vertex V va(uint i [[vertex_id]], constant float4 &c [[buffer(0)]]) { float2 p[3]={float2(-1,-1),float2(3,-1),float2(-1,3)};return {float4(p[i],0,1),c}; } fragment float4 fa(V i [[stage_in]], constant float4 &c [[buffer(0)]]) { return float4(i.c.r,c.g,i.c.b,1); }\n";
    id<MTLLibrary> arg_lib=[g_dev newLibraryWithSource:arg_source options:nil error:&error];if(!arg_lib)MDIE("argument binding probe shader: %s",error.localizedDescription.UTF8String);
    MTLRenderPipelineDescriptor *arg_pd=[MTLRenderPipelineDescriptor new];arg_pd.vertexFunction=[arg_lib newFunctionWithName:@"va"];arg_pd.fragmentFunction=[arg_lib newFunctionWithName:@"fa"];arg_pd.colorAttachments[0].pixelFormat=MTLPixelFormatRGBA8Unorm;
    id<MTLRenderPipelineState> arg_ps=[g_dev newRenderPipelineStateWithDescriptor:arg_pd error:&error];if(!arg_ps)MDIE("argument binding probe pipeline: %s",error.localizedDescription.UTF8String);
    id<MTLBuffer> arg_data=probe_buf(64);float arg_colors[16]={.25,0,.75,1,0,.5,0,1,.75,0,.25,1,0,.25,0,1};memcpy(arg_data.contents,arg_colors,sizeof arg_colors);
    g_arg_bind_cache_negative=0;
    for(int cache_mode=0;cache_mode<2;cache_mode++) {
        atomic_store(&g_arg_bind_cache_on,cache_mode);mtl_sub_begin();mtl_exec((const uint8_t *)&end);
        for(int pass=0;pass<2;pass++) {
            MTL4RenderPassDescriptor *rp=[MTL4RenderPassDescriptor new];rp.colorAttachments[0].texture=texture;rp.colorAttachments[0].loadAction=pass?MTLLoadActionLoad:MTLLoadActionClear;rp.colorAttachments[0].storeAction=MTLStoreActionStore;rp.renderTargetWidth=rp.renderTargetHeight=16;
            id<MTL4RenderCommandEncoder> en=enc_r_begin(rp);enc_r_pso(en,arg_ps);enc_r_cull(en,MTLCullModeNone);enc_r_viewport(en,(MTLViewport){0,0,16,16,0,1});
            for(int side=pass?1:0;side<2;side++) {
                enc_r_scissor(en,(MTLScissorRect){side?8:0,0,8,16});uint64_t sets=g_arg_bind_sets,skips=g_arg_bind_skips;
                for(int repeat=0;repeat<2;repeat++) {
                    enc_r_args(en,MTLRenderStageVertex,arg_data.gpuAddress+side*32,0);
                    enc_r_args(en,MTLRenderStageFragment,arg_data.gpuAddress+side*32+16,0);
                }
                if(g_arg_bind_sets-sets!=(cache_mode?2:4) || g_arg_bind_skips-skips!=(cache_mode?2:0))MDIE("argument binding probe stage/reset count mismatch");checked++;
                enc_r_draw(en,MTLPrimitiveTypeTriangle,0,3);
            }
            enc_r_end(en);
        }
        enc_b_copy_texture_buffer(blit(),texture,0,0,MTLOriginMake(0,0,0),MTLSizeMake(16,16,1),rb,0,64,1024);mtl_sub_commit();mtl_finish();
        for(unsigned i=0;i<1024;i++){int right=(i/4)%16>=8;int expected=right?(int[]){191,64,64,255}[i%4]:(int[]){64,128,191,255}[i%4];if(abs((int)((uint8_t *)rb.contents)[i]-expected)>1)MDIE("argument binding probe stage GPU mismatch mode%d byte%u",cache_mode,i);checked++;}
    }
    if (rs_enabled() && !g_rs_passes) MDIE("render stream probe never exercised the worker; use threshold 1");
    if (rs_enabled()) MLOG("render stream probe: %llu passes, %llu packets completed", (unsigned long long)g_rs_passes, (unsigned long long)g_rs_packets);
    g_vertex_streams_negative=0;atomic_store(&g_vertex_streams_on,saved);atomic_store(&g_arg_bind_cache_on,saved_arg);memset(&S.vbuf,0,sizeof S.vbuf);mtl_pool_del(mem);res_remove(texture);res_remove(rb);res_remove(arg_data);free(mem);return checked;
}

/* Exercise production state_op + encode_args on real GPU draws. Distinct shader
   objects alternate with unchanged bindings, then UBO/storage/registry/serial
   changes invalidate them. Separate submissions/passes and snapshot retirement
   must also invalidate. Negative 18 ignores binding generations, 19 snapshots. */
int mtl_probe_arg_epoch(void) {
    mtl_init(); int checked = 0;
    const char *ne = getenv("TOTK_PROBE_NEGATIVE"); int negative = ne ? atoi(ne) : 0;
    const size_t size = 16384; void *mem = NULL;
    if (posix_memalign(&mem, size, size) || !mem) MDIE("argument epoch probe memory");
    memset(mem, 0, size); mtl_pool_add(mem, size);
    const float colors[8] = {.25,.5,.75,1, .75,.25,.5,1};
    memcpy(mem, colors, sizeof colors);
    NSError *error = nil;
    NSString *source = @"#include <metal_stdlib>\nusing namespace metal;\nstruct A { constant float4 *c [[id(0)]]; constant uint *d [[id(1)]]; }; vertex float4 vs(uint i [[vertex_id]]) { float2 p[3]={float2(-1,-1),float2(3,-1),float2(-1,3)};return float4(p[i],0,1); } fragment float4 fa(constant A &a [[buffer(0)]]) { return float4(a.c->rgb,a.d[324]==0x1234u?1.0:0.0); } fragment float4 fb(constant A &a [[buffer(0)]]) { return float4(a.c->rgb,a.d[324]==0x1234u?1.0:0.0); }\n";
    id<MTLLibrary> lib = [g_dev newLibraryWithSource:source options:nil error:&error];
    if (!lib) MDIE("argument epoch probe shader: %s", error.localizedDescription.UTF8String);
    NvShader *shaders[2]; id<MTLRenderPipelineState> pipelines[2]; prog_t programs[2] = {0};
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        NvShader *sh = [NvShader new]; shaders[i] = sh; sh->fn = [lib newFunctionWithName:i ? @"fb" : @"fa"]; sh->stage = 1;
        snprintf(sh->key, sizeof sh->key, "probe-arg-epoch-%d", i);
        sh->rf.nb = 2; sh->rf.b[0] = (nvn_rbind){.kind=NVN_RB_CBUF,.aid=0,.reg=0};
        sh->rf.b[1] = (nvn_rbind){.kind=NVN_RB_DRV0,.aid=1}; sh->rf.drv_read[0] = 1;
        sh->ae = [sh->fn newArgumentEncoderWithBufferIndex:0]; sh->arg_len = sh->ae.encodedLength;
        if (sh->arg_len != 16) MDIE("argument epoch probe layout");
        MTLRenderPipelineDescriptor *pd = [MTLRenderPipelineDescriptor new]; pd.vertexFunction = [lib newFunctionWithName:@"vs"]; pd.fragmentFunction = sh->fn;
        pd.colorAttachments[0].pixelFormat = MTLPixelFormatRGBA8Unorm;
        pipelines[i] = [g_dev newRenderPipelineStateWithDescriptor:pd error:&error];
        if (!pipelines[i]) MDIE("argument epoch probe pipeline: %s", error.localizedDescription.UTF8String);
    }
    MTLTextureDescriptor *td = [MTLTextureDescriptor texture2DDescriptorWithPixelFormat:MTLPixelFormatRGBA8Unorm width:32 height:8 mipmapped:NO];
    td.storageMode = MTLStorageModePrivate; td.usage = MTLTextureUsageRenderTarget;
    id<MTLTexture> texture = [g_dev newTextureWithDescriptor:td]; res_add(texture); id<MTLBuffer> rb = probe_buf(2048);
    op_hdr end = {OP_END,8};
    for (int mode = 0; mode < 3; mode++) {
        atomic_store(&g_arg_epoch_on, mode != 0); atomic_store(&g_arg_epoch_check, mode == 2);
        g_arg_epoch_negative = mode && negative == 18;
        for (int submission = 0; submission < 2; submission++) {
            mtl_sub_begin(); mtl_exec((const uint8_t *)&end);
            for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++) {
                g_pass.serial++; args_dirty_all();
                p_bind_buf u = {1,0,(uint64_t)(uintptr_t)mem,16}, storage = {1,0,0x1234,16};
                state_op(OP_BIND_UBO, &u); state_op(OP_BIND_SSBO, &storage);
                MTL4RenderPassDescriptor *rp = [MTL4RenderPassDescriptor new]; rp.colorAttachments[0].texture = texture;
                rp.colorAttachments[0].loadAction = MTLLoadActionClear; rp.colorAttachments[0].storeAction = MTLStoreActionStore;
                rp.renderTargetWidth = 32; rp.renderTargetHeight = 8;
                id<MTL4RenderCommandEncoder> en = enc_r_begin(rp); enc_r_cull(en,MTLCullModeNone); enc_r_viewport(en,(MTLViewport){0,0,32,8,0,1});
                for (int stripe = 0; stripe < 16; stripe++) {
                    int shader = stripe == 1 || stripe == 4 ? 1 : 0;
                    p_bind_program program = {&programs[shader], 0x1f}; state_op(OP_BIND_PROGRAM, &program);
                    if (stripe == 3) { u.addr += 16; state_op(OP_BIND_UBO, &u); }
                    if (stripe == 6) args_dirty_all();
                    if (stripe == 7) g_reg_gen++;
                    if (stripe == 8) ser_bump(0);
                    if (stripe == 9 || stripe == 10) { storage.addr = stripe == 9 ? 0x5678 : 0x1234; state_op(OP_BIND_SSBO, &storage); }
                    if (stripe == 11) state_op(OP_BIND_SSBO, &storage); // identical binding must keep the epoch
                    uint64_t encodes = g_stat_args_enc, extra = g_arg_epoch_extra, hits = g_arg_epoch_hits;
                    enc_r_pso(en, pipelines[shader]); enc_r_scissor(en,(MTLScissorRect){stripe*2,0,2,8});
                    encode_args((id<MTLCommandEncoder>)en, shaders[shader], 1, 0); enc_r_draw(en,MTLPrimitiveTypeTriangle,0,3);
                    if (!negative && mode && (stripe == 2 || stripe == 5) && g_arg_epoch_extra != extra+1) MDIE("argument epoch probe did not reuse across programs");
                    if (!negative && mode && stripe >= 3 && stripe <= 10 && stripe != 5 && g_stat_args_enc != encodes+1) MDIE("argument epoch probe failed to rebuild stripe %d", stripe);
                    if (!negative && mode && stripe == 11 && g_arg_epoch_hits != hits+1) MDIE("argument epoch probe rebuilt identical binding");
                    checked++;
                }
                enc_r_end(en);
                enc_b_copy_texture_buffer(blit(),texture,0,0,MTLOriginMake(0,0,0),MTLSizeMake(32,8,1),rb,pass*1024,128,1024);
            }
            mtl_sub_commit(); mtl_finish();
            for (int byte = 0; byte < 2048; byte++) {
                int stripe = (byte/4)%32/2, channel = byte%4;
                int want = stripe < 3 ? (int[]){64,128,191,255}[channel] : (int[]){191,64,128,255}[channel];
                if (stripe == 9 && channel == 3) want = 0;
                if (abs((int)((uint8_t *)rb.contents)[byte]-want)>1) MDIE("argument epoch probe GPU mismatch mode %d stripe %d byte %d",mode,stripe,byte);
                checked++;
            }
        }
        // A real captured uniform is invalidated while a cached shader block still exists.
        memcpy(mem,colors,16); mtl_sub_begin(); mtl_exec((const uint8_t *)&end);
        p_bind_buf u = {1,0,(uint64_t)(uintptr_t)mem,16}, storage = {1,0,0x1234,16};
        uint8_t commands[128]; uint8_t *w = lp_rec(commands,OP_BIND_UBO,&u,sizeof u); lp_end(w);
        uint64_t handle = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)commands; mtl_sub_snapshot_ubos(&handle,1);
        if (!usnap_find(u.addr,16)) MDIE("argument epoch probe missing snapshot");
        memcpy(mem,colors+4,16); state_op(OP_BIND_UBO,&u); state_op(OP_BIND_SSBO,&storage); args_dirty_all(); g_pass.serial++;
        MTL4RenderPassDescriptor *rp = [MTL4RenderPassDescriptor new]; rp.colorAttachments[0].texture = texture;
        rp.colorAttachments[0].loadAction = MTLLoadActionClear; rp.colorAttachments[0].storeAction = MTLStoreActionStore;
        rp.renderTargetWidth = 32; rp.renderTargetHeight = 8;
        id<MTL4RenderCommandEncoder> en = enc_r_begin(rp); enc_r_cull(en,MTLCullModeNone); enc_r_viewport(en,(MTLViewport){0,0,32,8,0,1});
        for (int stripe = 0; stripe < 4; stripe++) {
            int shader = stripe == 1 ? 1 : 0;
            p_bind_program program = {&programs[shader],0x1f}; state_op(OP_BIND_PROGRAM,&program);
            if (stripe == 2) usnap_drop(u.addr,16);
            if (mode && negative == 19 && stripe == 2) shaders[0]->ab_epoch.snapshot_drops = g_usnap_drops;
            enc_r_pso(en,pipelines[shader]); enc_r_scissor(en,(MTLScissorRect){stripe*8,0,8,8});
            encode_args((id<MTLCommandEncoder>)en,shaders[shader],1,0); enc_r_draw(en,MTLPrimitiveTypeTriangle,0,3);
        }
        enc_r_end(en); enc_b_copy_texture_buffer(blit(),texture,0,0,MTLOriginMake(0,0,0),MTLSizeMake(32,8,1),rb,0,128,1024); mtl_sub_commit(); mtl_finish();
        for (int byte = 0; byte < 1024; byte++) {
            int stripe = (byte/4)%32/8, channel = byte%4;
            int want = stripe < 2 ? (int[]){64,128,191,255}[channel] : (int[]){191,64,128,255}[channel];
            if (abs((int)((uint8_t *)rb.contents)[byte]-want)>1) MDIE("argument epoch snapshot GPU mismatch mode %d stripe %d byte %d",mode,stripe,byte);
            checked++;
        }
        memcpy(mem,colors,sizeof colors);
    }
    if (!g_arg_epoch_extra || !g_arg_epoch_verified) MDIE("argument epoch probe missed reuse/check paths");
    NvShader *unsafe = [NvShader new]; unsafe->rf.nb=1; unsafe->rf.b[0].kind=NVN_RB_SBUFU;
    if (arg_epoch_safe(unsafe)) MDIE("argument epoch accepted indirect storage"); checked++;
    unsafe=[NvShader new]; unsafe->rf.nb=1; unsafe->rf.b[0].kind=NVN_RB_SBUFP;unsafe->rf.b[0].rw=1;
    if (arg_epoch_safe(unsafe)) MDIE("argument epoch accepted writable storage"); checked++;
    MLOG("argument epoch probe: %llu extra reuses, %llu shadow comparisons",(unsigned long long)g_arg_epoch_extra,(unsigned long long)g_arg_epoch_verified);
    g_arg_epoch_negative=0; atomic_store(&g_arg_epoch_on,0);atomic_store(&g_arg_epoch_check,0);
    memset(&S,0,sizeof S);args_dirty_all();mtl_pool_del(mem);res_remove(texture);res_remove(rb);free(mem);return checked;
}

#include "nvn_tex_slots_probe.h"

#ifdef GAME_BOTW
/* "ashot <path>" (botw.md, game-speed checks; at the end of the file so TOTK's line numbers stay as they were): the next
   game frame like "shot", but only the read-back runs on the game's present thread (wait for the GPU, one blit: a few
   ms); the picture is scaled to 480 wide and written as PNG on a background queue, so a sequence of them barely moves the
   frame timing, and it is taken whether the window is visible or not. The log line "[ashot] F<frame> t=<ns> <path> ok"
   carries the frame's present time (CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW), which the alignment uses instead of when the command was read
   (the command file is polled every 100 ms). */
static struct { uint64_t frame; char path[1024]; } g_ashotq[SHOTQ_MAX]; static int g_nashotq;
void dm_gfx_ashot(const char *path) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_shotq_mu);
    if (g_nashotq < SHOTQ_MAX) { g_ashotq[g_nashotq].frame = atomic_load(&g_cur_frame) + 1; strlcpy(g_ashotq[g_nashotq].path, path, sizeof g_ashotq[0].path); g_nashotq++; }
    else MLOG("【红】ashot 请求超过 %d 个，丢弃 %s", SHOTQ_MAX, path);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_shotq_mu);
}
static void ashot_take(id<MTLTexture> src, const char *path, long frame) { @autoreleasepool {
    uint64_t t = clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW);
    MTLPixelFormat pf = src.pixelFormat;
    if (pf != MTLPixelFormatRGBA8Unorm && pf != MTLPixelFormatRGBA8Unorm_sRGB && pf != MTLPixelFormatBGRA8Unorm && pf != MTLPixelFormatBGRA8Unorm_sRGB) {
        MLOG("【红】ashot：不支持格式 %lu", (unsigned long)pf); return;
    }
    size_t w = src.width, h = src.height, row = w * 4;
    id<MTLBuffer> buf = [g_dev newBufferWithLength:row * h options:MTLResourceStorageModeShared];
    mtl_finish_gpu();
    id<MTLCommandBuffer> cb = q_cb();
    id<MTLBlitCommandEncoder> b = [cb blitCommandEncoder];
    [b copyFromTexture:src sourceSlice:0 sourceLevel:0 sourceOrigin:MTLOriginMake(0, 0, 0) sourceSize:MTLSizeMake(w, h, 1)
              toBuffer:buf destinationOffset:0 destinationBytesPerRow:row destinationBytesPerImage:row * h];
    [b endEncoding]; cb_commit(cb); cb_wait(cb);
    NSData *pixels = [NSData dataWithBytes:buf.contents length:row * h];
    int bgra = pf == MTLPixelFormatBGRA8Unorm || pf == MTLPixelFormatBGRA8Unorm_sRGB;
    char *p = strdup(path);
    dispatch_async(dispatch_get_global_queue(QOS_CLASS_UTILITY, 0), ^{ @autoreleasepool {
        CGColorSpaceRef cs = CGColorSpaceCreateWithName(kCGColorSpaceSRGB);
        CGBitmapInfo bi = bgra ? (kCGImageAlphaNoneSkipFirst | kCGBitmapByteOrder32Little) : (CGBitmapInfo)kCGImageAlphaNoneSkipLast;
        CGDataProviderRef dp = CGDataProviderCreateWithCFData((__bridge CFDataRef)pixels);
        CGImageRef img = dp ? CGImageCreate(w, h, 8, 32, row, cs, bi, dp, NULL, false, kCGRenderingIntentDefault) : NULL;
        size_t ow = 480, oh = h * ow / (w ? w : 1);
        CGContextRef small = img ? CGBitmapContextCreate(NULL, ow, oh, 8, 0, cs, kCGImageAlphaNoneSkipLast) : NULL;
        CGImageRef out = NULL;
        if (small) { CGContextSetInterpolationQuality(small, kCGInterpolationMedium); CGContextDrawImage(small, CGRectMake(0, 0, ow, oh), img); out = CGBitmapContextCreateImage(small); }
        CFURLRef url = CFURLCreateFromFileSystemRepresentation(NULL, (const UInt8 *)p, (CFIndex)strlen(p), false);
        CGImageDestinationRef dst = url && out ? CGImageDestinationCreateWithURL(url, (__bridge CFStringRef)UTTypePNG.identifier, 1, NULL) : NULL;
        int ok = 0;
        if (dst) { CGImageDestinationAddImage(dst, out, NULL); ok = CGImageDestinationFinalize(dst); CFRelease(dst); }
        if (url) CFRelease(url);
        CGImageRelease(out); CGContextRelease(small); CGImageRelease(img); if (dp) CGDataProviderRelease(dp); CGColorSpaceRelease(cs);
        MLOG("[ashot] F%ld t=%llu %s %s", frame, (unsigned long long)t, p, ok ? "ok" : "failed");
        free(p);
    } });
} }
void botw_ashot_poll(const void *tv, long cur) {
    const tex_t *t = tv;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_nashotq;) if ((uint64_t)cur >= g_ashotq[i].frame) {
        id<MTLTexture> src = tex_mtl(t);
        if (src) ashot_take(src, g_ashotq[i].path, cur); else MLOG("【红】ashot：出图纹理不可用，丢弃 %s", g_ashotq[i].path);
        g_ashotq[i] = g_ashotq[--g_nashotq];
    } else i++;
}
#endif
#ifdef GAME_BOTW
/* TOTK_T2B_LOG=1 (botw.md, the black save thumbnail: the game copies a texture into a buffer on a CPU-visible pool with
   nvnCommandBufferCopyTextureToBuffer and JPEG-encodes the pool bytes): each copy's source texture and destination, and
   once the GPU is done, how many destination bytes are not zero (first 4 MiB). Zero: the source was black; not zero
   but a black JPEG: the bytes were overwritten or read too early. */
void botw_t2b_note(const void *cv, const void *texv, const void *mbv, uint64_t mo, size_t n) {
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_T2B_LOG"); on = e && *e && strcmp(e, "0"); }
    if (!on) return;
    const p_copy_b2t *c = cv; id<MTLTexture> t = (__bridge id<MTLTexture>)texv; id<MTLBuffer> mb = (__bridge id<MTLBuffer>)mbv;
    static _Atomic unsigned seq; unsigned k = atomic_fetch_add(&seq, 1);
    MLOG("[t2b] #%u F%llu ser=%llu %ux%u nvnfmt=%#x region %d,%d %dx%d -> %#llx (%zu bytes); Metal %lux%lu format %lu; gpu_owned %d mirrored %d; buffer %s",
         k, (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&g_cur_frame), (unsigned long long)c->tex->serial, c->tex->d.width, c->tex->d.height, c->tex->d.format,
         c->r.xoffset, c->r.yoffset, c->r.width, c->r.height, (unsigned long long)c->src, n, (unsigned long)t.width, (unsigned long)t.height,
         (unsigned long)t.pixelFormat, gpu_owned(c->tex->serial), tex_mirrored(c->tex), mb.storageMode == MTLStorageModeShared ? "shared" : "not shared");
    if (mb.storageMode != MTLStorageModeShared) return;
    const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)mb.contents + mo; size_t m = n < (4u << 20) ? n : (4u << 20);
    static const char *dump; static int dump_init; if (!dump_init) { dump_init = 1; dump = getenv("TOTK_T2B_DUMP"); }
    unsigned w = c->r.width, h = c->r.height;
    [g_commit_blocks addObject:^{ size_t z = 0; for (size_t i = 0; i < m; i++) z += p[i] != 0; MLOG("[t2b] #%u done: %zu of %zu destination bytes not zero", k, z, m);
        if (dump && *dump) { char path[1024]; snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/t2b-%u-%ux%u.rgba", dump, k, w, h); FILE *f = fopen(path, "wb"); if (f) { fwrite(p, 1, m, f); fclose(f); } } }];
}
/* botw.md, the black save thumbnail: a GPU copy into a buffer (nvnCommandBufferCopyTextureToBuffer) is newer than every
   earlier GPU rendering of a texture over the same memory that waits for write-back (wb_note). The game copies its
   256x144 caption into a CPU-visible pool, waits for the queue and invalidates the pool before JPEG-encoding it; the
   invalidate wrote such an older rendering back over the copied bytes. Those records are dropped here (in GPU order:
   this runs where the replay encodes the copy; a later rendering of that memory is recorded again). */
void botw_gpu_copy_supersedes(const void *mbv, uint64_t mo, size_t n) {
    id<MTLBuffer> mb = (__bridge id<MTLBuffer>)mbv;
    if (!mb || !n || mb.storageMode != MTLStorageModeShared) return;
    const uint8_t *a = (const uint8_t *)mb.contents + mo, *z = a + n;
    wb_ent *list[64]; int nl = 0;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; g_wb.n && g_wb.vals && i < g_wb.cap && nl < 64; i++) {
        wb_ent *e = g_wb.vals[i];
        if (!e || e->t.mem >= z || e->t.mem + e->t.L.size <= a) continue;
        uint64_t k = e->t.serial; nvn_hm_del(&g_wb, &k); list[nl++] = e; i = (uint32_t)-1;   // deletion shifts entries: rescan
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu);
    static _Atomic unsigned shown;
    for (int i = 0; i < nl; i++) {
        const tex_t *t = &list[i]->t;
        if (atomic_fetch_add(&shown, 1) < 16)
            MLOG("[t2b] a GPU copy into %p (%zu bytes) replaces the earlier GPU rendering of ser=%llu %ux%u nvnfmt=%#x at %p (%llu bytes): not written back",
                 (const void *)a, n, (unsigned long long)t->serial, t->d.width, t->d.height, t->d.format, (const void *)t->mem, (unsigned long long)t->L.size);
        wb_ent_free(list[i]);
    }
}
/* botw.md, the black save thumbnail: the game records the caption rendering and its copy into a buffer once and replays
   the recording at every save, while it finalises and re-initialises the 256x144 NVNtexture between saves. The recording's
   texture copy kept the finalised serial, so each use made a texture for a dead serial that was deleted when the
   submission completed (dead_put_flush): the copy of the next submission read a fresh upload of the stale pool bytes
   (zeros). As the texture-pool slots do (tex_by_id), a command's texture whose serial was finalised now follows its
   storage to the texture living there with the same layout: the pinned copy is re-keyed in place (dm_nvn_pin_rekey),
   so every recording holding it, and the owned / write-back bookkeeping by serial, see the live texture. */
int botw_serial_noted(uint64_t serial);
void botw_tex_follow(const void *tv) {
    tex_t *t = (tex_t *)tv;
    if (!t || !t->serial || !t->mem || !serial_is_dead(t->serial)) return;
    tex_t live; extern int nvn_tex_live_at(const void *mem, tex_t *out); extern int dm_nvn_pin_rekey(const tex_t *copy, const tex_t *live);
    int watched = botw_serial_noted(t->serial), have = nvn_tex_live_at(t->mem, &live);
    if (!have || live.serial == t->serial || serial_is_dead(live.serial)) {
        if (watched) MLOG("[tile] f%llu ser=%llu not followed: %s", (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&g_cur_frame), (unsigned long long)t->serial,
                          !have ? "no live texture at its storage" : live.serial == t->serial ? "the live texture is itself" : "the live texture is finalised too");
        return;
    }
    if (live.L.size != t->L.size || live.d.format != t->d.format || live.d.width != t->d.width || live.d.height != t->d.height ||
        live.d.depth != t->d.depth || live.d.target != t->d.target || live.d.levels != t->d.levels) {
        if (watched) MLOG("[tile] f%llu ser=%llu not followed: live ser=%llu %ux%ux%u lv%u nvnfmt=%#x target %d size %llu differs from %ux%ux%u lv%u nvnfmt=%#x target %d size %llu",
                          (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&g_cur_frame), (unsigned long long)t->serial, (unsigned long long)live.serial, live.d.width, live.d.height, live.d.depth, live.d.levels, live.d.format, live.d.target,
                          (unsigned long long)live.L.size, t->d.width, t->d.height, t->d.depth, t->d.levels, t->d.format, t->d.target, (unsigned long long)t->L.size);
        return;
    }
    uint64_t from = t->serial; int pinned = dm_nvn_pin_rekey(t, &live);
    if (!pinned) *t = live;
    static uint64_t n; if (n++ < 8 || n % 1000 == 0)
        MLOG("[tex-follow] %s ser=%llu -> %llu at %p (%ux%u nvnfmt=%#x; %llu so far)", pinned ? "recording copy" : "texture", (unsigned long long)from,
             (unsigned long long)live.serial, (void *)t->mem, t->d.width, t->d.height, t->d.format, (unsigned long long)n);
}
/* botw.md, the black save thumbnail (the second half): the game renders the pause menu's 854x480 screen copy, finalises
   that NVNtexture object the next frame (the object is only a handle; the memory keeps the rendering) and then replays
   the recorded caption draw, which samples it; the caption texture itself is finalised after the first save and never
   initialised again while its recording keeps addressing its memory. On hardware a command addresses memory, so the
   host texture made for a finalised serial must live as long as a recording copy names the serial (dm_nvn_pin_has_serial),
   not until the finalize (mtl_tex_release) or the end of the submission (dead_put_flush). Such serials are kept and
   released when the pin sweep frees their copies (mtl_dead_forget -> botw_dead_forget). */
static nvn_hmap g_bdead_kept = {.klen = 8};   /* finalised serials whose textures are kept for their recording copies (g_smu) */
static uint64_t g_bdead_kept_n, g_bdead_freed_n;
int botw_dead_keep(uint64_t serial) {
    extern int dm_nvn_pin_has_serial(uint64_t serial);
    if (!dm_nvn_pin_has_serial(serial)) return 0;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu);
    if (!nvn_hm_get(&g_bdead_kept, &serial)) { nvn_hm_put(&g_bdead_kept, &serial, (void *)1); g_bdead_kept_n++; }
    uint64_t k = g_bdead_kept_n, live = g_bdead_kept.n;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu);
    if (k <= 4 || k % 1000 == 0) MLOG("[dead-keep] finalised serial %llu stays while a recording copy names it (%llu kept so far, %llu now)", (unsigned long long)serial, (unsigned long long)k, (unsigned long long)live);
    return 1;
}
void botw_dead_forget(const uint64_t *serials, size_t n) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        uint64_t k = serials[i];
        pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu); int kept = nvn_hm_get(&g_bdead_kept, &k) != NULL; if (kept) { nvn_hm_del(&g_bdead_kept, &k); g_bdead_freed_n++; } pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu);
        if (kept) { BOTW_SERIAL_NOTE(k, "dead copy swept: texture released") serial_del(k); treg_drop_serial(k); }
    }
}
/* Key 2 (MetalFX frame interpolation): the scene copy is taken before the first UI draw into the canvas, and in this game
   the canvas is also drawn into early in the frame, before the scene (cleared, a few draws); only a draw after the upscale
   draw 0af88d51 (or after MetalFX replaced it, mfxup_dock) counts as UI. Reset every game frame (BOTW_MFX_FRAME_RESET). */
static int g_botw_scene_ready;
void botw_mfx_scene_ready(void) { g_botw_scene_ready = 1; }
void botw_mfx_frame_reset(void) { g_botw_scene_ready = 0; }
int botw_mfx_ui_draw(void *prog) {
    NvProg *pr = (__bridge NvProg *)prog;
    if (!pr->sh[1]) return 0;
    if (!strncmp(pr->sh[1]->key, "0af88d51bb12a2346b03bb2586d131def5a631271df192779b701efba6eb7f70-", 65)) { g_botw_scene_ready = 1; return 0; }
    return g_botw_scene_ready;
}
/* DM_NVN_TILELOG diagnostics: serials a [tile] line was logged for are remembered (what == NULL), and the serial table's
   deletions of them are logged with the reason (what), to see who drops a watched texture's host record. */
static uint64_t g_bsn_seen[64]; static _Atomic int g_bsn_n;
int botw_serial_noted(uint64_t serial) { int c = atomic_load(&g_bsn_n); for (int i = 0; i < c; i++) if (g_bsn_seen[i] == serial) return 1; return 0; }
void botw_serial_note(uint64_t serial, const char *what) {
    uint64_t *seen = g_bsn_seen; _Atomic int *np = &g_bsn_n;
    int c = atomic_load(np);
    if (!what) { for (int i = 0; i < c; i++) if (seen[i] == serial) return; if (c < 64) { seen[c] = serial; atomic_store(np, c + 1); } return; }
    for (int i = 0; i < c; i++) if (seen[i] == serial) { MLOG("[tile] f%llu ser=%llu %s", (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&g_cur_frame), (unsigned long long)serial, what); return; }
}
#endif

```

#ifdef GAME_BOTW
/* The same texture level / layer attached at more than one colour slot: only the first slot is attached (botw.md; the
   finding and fix come from nxnative, MIT, github.com/seedds/nxnative, rt_dup_slot). Breath of the Wild's G-buffer passes
   attach the albedo and another buffer twice each (c1 = c2, c3 = c4) with channel write masks 0 on the second ones. The
   Switch's ROP writes only masked channels, so the slots do not interfere; on Apple's tile-based GPUs each attachment has
   its own tile memory, stored back whole at the end of the pass, so the copy stored later (loaded, never written)
   overwrote the other's writes in a different order per tile: the albedo kept scattered squares. Returns the earlier slot
   holding the same image, or -1. Slots are compared by serial: records hold copies of the texture objects.
   The macros below are the call sites in nvn_mtl.m: they sit at the end of existing lines and expand to nothing for TOTK,
   so TOTK's code and line numbers (res_add_at) stay as they were. */
static inline int rt_dup_of(const p_set_rt *r, int i) {
    if (!r->color[i]) return -1;
    int lv = r->has_cview[i] && r->cview[i].set_levels ? r->cview[i].base_level : 0, ly = r->has_cview[i] && r->cview[i].set_layers ? r->cview[i].min_layer : 0;
    for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
        if (!r->color[j] || r->color[j]->serial != r->color[i]->serial) continue;
        int lj = r->has_cview[j] && r->cview[j].set_levels ? r->cview[j].base_level : 0, yj = r->has_cview[j] && r->cview[j].set_layers ? r->cview[j].min_layer : 0;
        if (lj == lv && yj == ly) return j;
    }
    return -1;
}
/* a clear of a slot left unattached goes to the slot holding the same image */
#define BOTW_RT_DUP_CLEARS() { for (int i_ = 1; i_ < R.rt.n && i_ < 8; i_++) { int j_ = rt_dup_of(&R.rt, i_); \
        if (j_ >= 0 && R.clear_c[i_]) { if (!R.clear_c[j_]) { R.clear_c[j_] = 1; R.cc[j_] = R.cc[i_]; } R.clear_c[i_] = 0; } } }

```h
// 出图节拍器（纯函数，Mac / iOS 共用；单测 tests/t_pace.c）。
// 语义同垂直同步：节拍点 = 上一节拍点 + 周期。早到 → 等到节拍点；迟到不足一个周期 → 立即出图、保持原相位；
// 落后一个周期以上（卡顿）→ 从当前时刻重新起拍，不连发追帧。周期 0 = 不等（节拍点跟随当前时刻）。
// Present pacer (pure function, shared by Mac / iOS; unit test tests/t_pace.c).
// Semantics as vsync: present slot = previous present slot + period. Early → wait until the present slot; late by less than one period → present immediately and keep the original phase;
// behind by one period or more (stutter) → restart the cadence from the current time, no burst of presents to catch up. Period 0 = no wait (the present slot follows the current time).
#pragma once
#include <stdint.h>

typedef struct { uint64_t target; } nvn_pacer;

// now：单调时钟（ns）；period：本帧周期（ns，0 = 不等）。返回需要等待的 ns（0 = 立即出图），并更新内部目标时刻。
// now: monotonic clock (ns); period: this frame's period (ns, 0 = no wait). Returns the ns to wait (0 = present immediately) and updates the internal target time.
static inline uint64_t nvn_pace(nvn_pacer *p, uint64_t now, uint64_t period) {
    if (!period || !p->target) { p->target = now; return 0; }
    uint64_t next = p->target + period;
    if (now <= next) { p->target = next; return next - now; }
    p->target = now - next < period ? next : now;
    return 0;
}

`mario-odessy-harmony/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/nvn_pool_index.h`:

```h
#pragma once
/* TOTK: memory pools sorted by guest address.
   The world scene keeps about 3,200 pools alive, and the replay resolves several dozen buffer addresses per draw
   (vertex / index / uniform / storage bindings). A linear scan of all pools for each of them was the largest part of
   the ~87k instructions per draw. Lookups are now a binary search on the range start plus a backwards walk that is
   bounded by a running maximum of the range ends, so a pool nested inside or overlapping another is still found.
   Not thread-safe: the caller holds the pool mutex for every call. */
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

typedef struct { uintptr_t lo, hi, base; void *buf; uint64_t gpu; const void *key; int res; } pidx_ent;   // res: buffer is in the residency set (nvn_mtl.m pool_res)
typedef struct { pidx_ent *e; uintptr_t *maxhi; int n, cap; } pidx;   // maxhi[i] = largest hi among e[0..i]

static inline void pidx_fix_maxhi(pidx *x, int from) {
    for (int i = from > 0 ? from : 0; i < x->n; i++) {
        uintptr_t prev = i ? x->maxhi[i - 1] : 0;
        x->maxhi[i] = x->e[i].hi > prev ? x->e[i].hi : prev;
    }
}
// Number of entries whose range starts at or below addr (index of the first start above it).
static inline int pidx_upper(const pidx *x, uintptr_t addr) {
    int a = 0, b = x->n;
    while (a < b) { int m = (a + b) >> 1; if (x->e[m].lo <= addr) a = m + 1; else b = m; }
    return a;
}
// Returns 0 when memory runs out (the index is left unchanged).
static inline int pidx_insert(pidx *x, const pidx_ent *v) {
    if (x->n == x->cap) {
        int cap = x->cap ? x->cap * 2 : 64;
        pidx_ent *e = realloc(x->e, (size_t)cap * sizeof *e); if (!e) return 0; x->e = e;
        uintptr_t *mh = realloc(x->maxhi, (size_t)cap * sizeof *mh); if (!mh) return 0; x->maxhi = mh;
        x->cap = cap;
    }
    int at = pidx_upper(x, v->lo);
    memmove(x->e + at + 1, x->e + at, (size_t)(x->n - at) * sizeof *x->e);
    x->e[at] = *v; x->n++;
    pidx_fix_maxhi(x, at);
    return 1;
}
// Removes the entry registered for key; returns 0 when there is none.
static inline int pidx_remove(pidx *x, const void *key, pidx_ent *out) {
    for (int i = 0; i < x->n; i++) {
        if (x->e[i].key != key) continue;
        if (out) *out = x->e[i];
        memmove(x->e + i, x->e + i + 1, (size_t)(x->n - i - 1) * sizeof *x->e); x->n--;
        pidx_fix_maxhi(x, i);
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}
// A pool whose range [lo, hi] contains [addr, addr + len], or NULL (same containment test as the old linear scan).
static inline const pidx_ent *pidx_find(const pidx *x, uintptr_t addr, uint64_t len) {
    uintptr_t end = addr + (uintptr_t)len;
    if (end < addr) return NULL;
    for (int i = pidx_upper(x, addr) - 1; i >= 0 && x->maxhi[i] >= end; i--)
        if (x->e[i].hi >= end) return &x->e[i];
    return NULL;
}
// The same lookup for callers that update the entry they find (they hold the pool mutex as well).
static inline pidx_ent *pidx_find_mut(pidx *x, uintptr_t addr, uint64_t len) { return (pidx_ent *)pidx_find(x, addr, len); }
// 1 when [lo, hi) overlaps a registered range (diagnostic: real NVN pools do not normally overlap).
static inline int pidx_overlaps(const pidx *x, uintptr_t lo, uintptr_t hi) {
    int at = pidx_upper(x, lo);
    if (at > 0 && x->maxhi[at - 1] > lo) return 1;
    return at < x->n && x->e[at].lo < hi;
}

/* Exact-query memoization, protected by the SAME mutex as the index. The caller
   must invalidate after every successful insertion/removal, including while the
   experiment is disabled. It stores indices, not retained resource pointers.
   Overlapping ranges retain pidx_find's exact selection and zero-length semantics. */
#define PIDX_QUERY_SLOTS 256
typedef struct { uintptr_t address; uint64_t length, epoch; int index; } pidx_query;
typedef struct { pidx_query queries[PIDX_QUERY_SLOTS]; uint64_t epoch, hits, misses; } pidx_query_cache;
static inline void pidx_query_invalidate(pidx_query_cache *cache) {
    if (++cache->epoch == 0) { memset(cache->queries, 0, sizeof cache->queries); cache->epoch = 1; }
}
static inline pidx_ent *pidx_find_cached(pidx *x, pidx_query_cache *cache, uintptr_t address, uint64_t length) {
    if (!cache->epoch) cache->epoch = 1;
    uint64_t hash = (address >> 4) ^ (address >> 20) ^ (length * UINT64_C(0x9e3779b97f4a7c15));
    pidx_query *q = &cache->queries[hash & (PIDX_QUERY_SLOTS - 1)];
    if (q->epoch == cache->epoch && q->address == address && q->length == length && q->index < x->n) {
        cache->hits++;
        return q->index < 0 ? NULL : &x->e[q->index];
    }
    pidx_ent *found = pidx_find_mut(x, address, length);
    *q = (pidx_query){address, length, cache->epoch, found ? (int)(found - x->e) : -1};
    cache->misses++;
    return found;
}

/* Included by nvn_mtl.m. Diagnose wrapper lifetime without a full-game run. */
static uint64_t probe_pool_alive(void) {
    uint64_t n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < RES_SITES; i++) n += atomic_load(&g_res_site[i].alive);
    return n;
}
int mtl_probe_pool_retire(void) {
    @autoreleasepool { mtl_init(); res_commit(); }
    const char *ne = getenv("TOTK_PROBE_NEGATIVE");
    g_res_remove_no_pool = ne && atoi(ne) == 22;
    const size_t size = 1 << 20; void *mem = NULL;
    if (posix_memalign(&mem, 16384, size) || !mem) MDIE("pool retirement probe memory");
    memset(mem, 0, size);
    uint64_t base = probe_pool_alive(); int checked = 0;
    for (int mode = 0; mode < 7; mode++) {
        @autoreleasepool {
            for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
                void *outer = mode == 1 ? objc_autoreleasePoolPush() : NULL;
                void *inner = mode == 2 ? objc_autoreleasePoolPush() : NULL;
                mtl_pool_add(mem, size);
                if (inner) objc_autoreleasePoolPop(inner);
                inner = mode == 3 ? objc_autoreleasePoolPush() : NULL;
                void *buf = NULL; uint64_t off = 0;
                if (!mtl_addr((uintptr_t)mem, size, &buf, &off) || off) MDIE("pool retirement probe lookup");
                if (inner) objc_autoreleasePoolPop(inner);
                inner = mode == 4 || mode == 5 ? objc_autoreleasePoolPush() : NULL;
                mtl_pool_del(mem);
                if (mode == 5) { objc_autoreleasePoolPop(inner); inner = NULL; }
                if (mode == 6) inner = objc_autoreleasePoolPush();
                res_commit();
                if (inner) objc_autoreleasePoolPop(inner);
                if (outer) objc_autoreleasePoolPop(outer);
                checked++;
            }
            MLOG("pool retirement diagnosis: mode=%d alive_delta=%lld keep=%lu pools=%d allocated_mib=%llu", mode,
                (long long)(probe_pool_alive()-base),(unsigned long)g_keep.count,g_pools.n,(unsigned long long)(g_dev.currentAllocatedSize>>20));
            if (probe_pool_alive() != base || g_keep.count || g_pools.n)
                MDIE("pool retirement probe retained removed wrappers mode%d", mode);
            checked++;
        }
        MLOG("pool retirement diagnosis: mode=%d drained_alive_delta=%lld",mode,(long long)(probe_pool_alive()-base));
        if (probe_pool_alive() != base) MDIE("pool retirement probe failed outer drain");
        checked++;
    }
    // Use each wrapper on the GPU before retiring it, while the outer scope
    // stays alive for the whole loop as it does on a guest thread.
    @autoreleasepool {
        id<MTLBuffer> readback = probe_buf(4096);
        op_hdr end = {OP_END, 8};
        for (int cycle = 0; cycle < 64; cycle++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < 1024; i++) ((uint32_t *)mem)[i] = (uint32_t)(i*65537u ^ cycle*1234567u);
            mtl_pool_add(mem, size);
            mtl_sub_begin(); mtl_exec((const uint8_t *)&end);
            void *buf = NULL; uint64_t off = 0;
            if (!mtl_addr((uintptr_t)mem, 4096, &buf, &off)) MDIE("pool retirement GPU lookup");
            enc_b_copy_buffer(blit(), (__bridge id<MTLBuffer>)buf, off, readback, 0, 4096);
            mtl_sub_commit(); mtl_finish();
            mtl_pool_del(mem); res_commit();
            if (g_keep.count || g_pools.n) MDIE("pool retirement GPU pool table");
            for (int i = 0; i < 1024; i++) {
                if (((uint32_t *)readback.contents)[i] != ((uint32_t *)mem)[i])
                    MDIE("pool retirement GPU byte mismatch cycle%d word%d",cycle,i);
                checked++;
            }
        }
        res_remove(readback);
    }
    g_res_remove_no_pool = 0;
    free(mem); return checked;
}

`mario-odessy-harmony/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/nvn_pso_skey.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "nvn_obj.h"

typedef struct {
    const void *vs, *fs; uint32_t cfmt[8], dfmt, sfmt, samples, blend_en, chmask, a2c; blend_st blend[8];
    va_st attr[16]; vs_st stream[16];
    uint8_t lmap[8]; const void *fsfn;
} pso_key;
// pso_key.a2c: bit 0 alpha-to-coverage; bit 1 (TOTK) layered pass, the vertex function writes the render target array index;
// bits 2-3 (TOTK_MFX) MetalFX copy role of the draw: 1 scene to attachment 6, 2 / 3 UI (blended / opaque) to attachment 7;
// bit 4 (TOTK) the vertex function emulates a sampler border colour Metal lacks (vs_fn_for, border_key).
#define PSO_LAYERED 2u
#define PSO_VBORDER 16u

typedef struct {
    uint8_t kind, fbmask;
    int8_t fx[32];
} pso_fz_desc;

// Runtime-translated TOTK variant keys are up to 79 bytes (SHA-256 plus answer hash and _b).
// The old 24-byte fields silently truncated them and made recorded render PSOs impossible to warm.
typedef struct { char vs[80], fs[80]; uint8_t vs_stage, fs_stage, merged, fz; pso_fz_desc fz_desc; pso_key k; } pso_skey;

static inline void pso_skey_from(const pso_key *k, NvShader *vs, NvShader *fs, int merged, const pso_fz_desc *fz, pso_skey *out) {
    memset(out, 0, sizeof *out);
    memcpy(&out->k, k, sizeof out->k);
    out->k.vs = out->k.fs = out->k.fsfn = NULL;
    if (vs) { memcpy(out->vs, vs->key, sizeof out->vs); out->vs_stage = (uint8_t)vs->stage; }
    if (fs) { memcpy(out->fs, fs->key, sizeof out->fs); out->fs_stage = (uint8_t)fs->stage; }
    out->merged = merged != 0;
    out->fz = k->fsfn != NULL;
    if (fz) memcpy(&out->fz_desc, fz, sizeof out->fz_desc);
}

static inline void pso_skey_hex(const pso_skey *key, char *out) {
    static const char hex[] = "0123456789abcdef";
    const uint8_t *p = (const uint8_t *)key;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof *key; i++) { out[i * 2] = hex[p[i] >> 4]; out[i * 2 + 1] = hex[p[i] & 15]; }
    out[sizeof *key * 2] = 0;
}

static inline int pso_skey_parse(const char *hex, pso_skey *out) {
    size_t n = sizeof *out * 2;
    if (!hex || strlen(hex) != n) return -1;
    uint8_t *p = (uint8_t *)out;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i += 2) {
        int a = hex[i] >= '0' && hex[i] <= '9' ? hex[i] - '0' : hex[i] >= 'a' && hex[i] <= 'f' ? hex[i] - 'a' + 10 : hex[i] >= 'A' && hex[i] <= 'F' ? hex[i] - 'A' + 10 : -1;
        int b = hex[i + 1] >= '0' && hex[i + 1] <= '9' ? hex[i + 1] - '0' : hex[i + 1] >= 'a' && hex[i + 1] <= 'f' ? hex[i + 1] - 'a' + 10 : hex[i + 1] >= 'A' && hex[i + 1] <= 'F' ? hex[i + 1] - 'A' + 10 : -1;
        if (a < 0 || b < 0) return -1;
        p[i / 2] = (uint8_t)(a << 4 | b);
    }
    return 0;
}

```h
// 着色器反射 json → 定长 C 数组（A：PC 链反射；B：Switch 原版翻译的反射，route = "B"，tools/dmsh_build.py 出）。
// B 新增种类：SBUFP = 存储缓冲设备指针（NVN 存储缓冲槽）；SUPPORT = Ryujinx 辅助常量；C1 = 着色器自带常数段（c[1]）；
//            DRV0 / DRV2 = NVN 驱动常量段 c[0]（存储缓冲地址表）/ c[2]（贴图与采样器句柄表）
// PC 着色器反射 json → 定长 C 数组（取着色器时转一次；每次绘制只遍历数组，不碰 NSDictionary / NSString）。
// 单测 tests/t_refl.m 拿真实反射手算期望。
// Shader reflection json → fixed-length C arrays (A: PC chain reflection; B: reflection produced by translating the original Switch shaders, route = "B", output of tools/dmsh_build.py).
// Kinds added by B: SBUFP = storage buffer device pointer (NVN storage buffer slot); SUPPORT = Ryujinx auxiliary constants; C1 = the shader's own constant segment (c[1]);
//            DRV0 / DRV2 = NVN driver constant segments c[0] (storage buffer address table) / c[2] (texture and sampler handle table)
// PC shader reflection json → fixed-length C arrays (converted once when the shader is fetched; each draw only walks the arrays and does not touch NSDictionary / NSString).
// Unit test tests/t_refl.m computes the expectations by hand from real reflection.
#pragma once
#include <stdint.h>

/* TEXU / SAMPU: combined texture/sampler handle at byte offset off of user uniform slot reg. */
enum { NVN_RB_CBUF = 1, NVN_RB_SAMP, NVN_RB_TEX, NVN_RB_IMG, NVN_RB_TBUF,
       NVN_RB_SBUFP, NVN_RB_SUPPORT, NVN_RB_C1, NVN_RB_DRV0, NVN_RB_DRV2, NVN_RB_SAMPT, NVN_RB_UBOP, NVN_RB_SBUFU, NVN_RB_TEXU, NVN_RB_SAMPU };   // SBUFU（TOTK）：存储缓冲地址由着色器自己从用户 uniform 槽 reg 的偏移 off 处读出 | SBUFU (TOTK): the storage buffer address is loaded by the shader from byte offset off of user uniform slot reg   // UBOP：计算阶段 uniform 槽 r 的设备指针（Maxwell 计算阶段经 c0 地址表 + 全局内存读 uniform）   // SAMPT：采样器取自贴图槽 r 的合并句柄（高位 = 采样器号）   // 绑定种类（json 的 type）；IMG = 可写贴图（D3D u_r，NVN 图像槽 r）；TBUF = 类型化缓冲（D3D t_r Buffer<T>，NVN 贴图槽 r 的缓冲贴图） | UBOP: device pointer of compute-stage uniform slot r (the Maxwell compute stage reads uniforms via the c0 address table + global memory)   // SAMPT: the sampler is taken from the combined handle of texture slot r (high bits = sampler ID)   // Binding kind (type in the json); IMG = writable texture (D3D u_r, NVN image slot r); TBUF = typed buffer (D3D t_r Buffer<T>, buffer texture in NVN texture slot r)
enum { NVN_DPF_FLOAT = 0, NVN_DPF_UINT, NVN_DPF_SINT, NVN_DPF_DEPTH };            // 哑贴图像素类（由 msl_type 定） | Dummy texture pixel class (determined by msl_type)
enum { NVN_CT_FLOAT = 0, NVN_CT_UINT, NVN_CT_INT };                               // 顶点输入分量类型 | Vertex input component type
#define NVN_REFL_MAXB 64
#define NVN_REFL_MAXV 32

typedef struct {
    uint8_t kind, rw;        // rw：存储缓冲 access 为 read_write / write / device | rw: storage buffer access is read_write / write / device
    uint8_t dtt, dpf;        // 贴图槽未绑时的哑贴图：MTLTextureType 数值、像素类 | Dummy texture when the texture slot is unbound: MTLTextureType value, pixel class
    uint16_t reg, aid;       // D3D 寄存器号、参数缓冲内序号 | D3D register number, index within the argument buffer
    uint16_t off;            // SBUFU：uniform 块内的指针字节偏移 | SBUFU: byte offset of the pointer inside the uniform block
} nvn_rbind;
typedef struct {
    int nb, abi, nv;         // 绑定数、参数缓冲槽、顶点输入数 | Binding count, argument buffer slot, vertex input count
    nvn_rbind b[NVN_REFL_MAXB];
    struct { uint8_t loc, ct, nvn; } v[NVN_REFL_MAXV];   // loc：Metal 顶点属性槽（DXBC 输入寄存器）；nvn：NVN 顶点属性号（HLSL 语义 ATTRn 的 n） | loc: Metal vertex attribute slot (DXBC input register); nvn: NVN vertex attribute number (the n of HLSL semantic ATTRn)
    uint16_t tg[3];          // 计算线程组大小（无 = 0） | Compute thread group size (none = 0)
    uint8_t route_b, has_c1; // B 路线；有 c1 常数段 | Route B; has a c1 constant segment
    uint8_t drv_read[3];     // B：运行时读驱动段 c0 / c2（下标 0、2；出包时由 MSL 静态统计，tools/dmsh_build.py drv_reads） | B: reads driver segments c0 / c2 at runtime (indices 0, 2; gathered statically from the MSL at packaging time, tools/dmsh_build.py drv_reads)
    uint16_t c1_len;         // c1 常数段长度（B；全库 0 / 256 / 512 / 768） | Length of the c1 constant segment (B; 0 / 256 / 512 / 768 across the whole library)
    // 全覆盖首绘证明用（dmsh_build.py raster_facts；缺字段 = 不可证）：顶点——位置 xyz 原样取自属性 pos_attr（-1 = 否），w 为常数 1（pos_w1）或取同属性 .w；
    // 片元——可能丢弃、写 sample_mask、写出的颜色号位图
    // For the fully-covering-first-draw proof (dmsh_build.py raster_facts; missing field = not provable): vertex - position xyz taken as-is from attribute pos_attr (-1 = no), w is the constant 1 (pos_w1) or taken from the same attribute's .w;
    // fragment - may discard, writes sample_mask, bitmap of the color numbers written
    int8_t pos_attr; uint8_t pos_w1, may_discard, writes_smask, color_mask;
    // 合并 B 第 2 步（可读 tile 版本 <键>_bf，dmsh_fetch.py）：片元——可改采样 nfc 次（第 i 次：贴图槽 fc_reg、插值输出 fc_locn）、
    // 混用的贴图槽位图 fc_mixed（这些槽不得改读 tile）、输出 nfo 个（各自的颜色号 fo_color）；顶点——插值输出 locn 的 .xy 原样取自属性 uv_attr[locn]（-1 = 否）
    // Merge B step 2 (readable-tile version <key>_bf, dmsh_fetch.py): fragment - nfc redirectable samples (the i-th: texture slot fc_reg, interpolated output fc_locn),
    // bitmap fc_mixed of texture slots with mixed use (these slots must not be redirected to read the tile), nfo outputs (each with color number fo_color); vertex - .xy of interpolated output locn is taken as-is from attribute uv_attr[locn] (-1 = no)
    uint8_t nfc, fc_reg[32], fc_locn[32], nfo, fo_color[4]; uint64_t fc_mixed[2]; int8_t uv_attr[32];
    // 顶点——插值输出 locn 的 .x / .y = fma(属性 uv_aff_attr[locn] 的 .x / .y, 缩放, 偏移)，缩放 / 偏移引用 uniform：(槽 << 8) | (向量 << 2) | 分量
    // Vertex - .x / .y of interpolated output locn = fma(.x / .y of attribute uv_aff_attr[locn], scale, offset), where scale / offset reference a uniform: (slot << 8) | (vector << 2) | component
    int8_t uv_aff_attr[32]; uint16_t uv_aff[32][4];   // [sx, ox, sy, oy]
    uint8_t c1[4096];        // c1 常数段原样（B） | c1 constant segment as-is (B)
} nvn_refl;

#ifdef __OBJC__
#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>
// 成功 0；失败返回非 0 并把原因写进 err（未知绑定类型、超定长上限、字段缺失）
// 0 on success; on failure returns non-0 and writes the reason into err (unknown binding type, fixed-length limit exceeded, missing field)
int nvn_refl_from_json(NSDictionary *j, nvn_refl *out, char *err, int errlen);
#endif

`mario-odessy-harmony/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/nvn_refl.m`:

```m
// 着色器反射 json（B：Switch 原版翻译，tools/dmsh_build.py 出）→ 定长 C 数组（nvn_refl.h）
// Shader reflection json (B: produced by translating the original Switch shaders, output of tools/dmsh_build.py) → fixed-length C arrays (nvn_refl.h)
#import "nvn_refl.h"
#import <Metal/Metal.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

// 哑贴图类型：与原 dummy_tex 同一套前缀判定（未绑贴图槽按 D3D 语义读出 0）
// Dummy texture type: same prefix rules as the original dummy_tex (an unbound texture slot reads 0 per D3D semantics)
static void dummy_kind(NSString *t, uint8_t *tt, uint8_t *pf) {
    MTLTextureType y = MTLTextureType2D;
    if ([t hasPrefix:@"texture2d_array"] || [t hasPrefix:@"depth2d_array"]) y = MTLTextureType2DArray;
    else if ([t hasPrefix:@"texturecube_array"] || [t hasPrefix:@"depthcube_array"]) y = MTLTextureTypeCubeArray;
    else if ([t hasPrefix:@"texturecube"] || [t hasPrefix:@"depthcube"]) y = MTLTextureTypeCube;
    else if ([t hasPrefix:@"texture3d"]) y = MTLTextureType3D;
    else if ([t hasPrefix:@"texture1d_array"]) y = MTLTextureType1DArray;
    else if ([t hasPrefix:@"texture1d"]) y = MTLTextureType1D;
    *tt = (uint8_t)y;
    *pf = [t hasPrefix:@"depth"] ? NVN_DPF_DEPTH : [t containsString:@"<uint"] ? NVN_DPF_UINT : [t containsString:@"<int"] ? NVN_DPF_SINT : NVN_DPF_FLOAT;
}

/* TOTK 2026-10-16: the json's rw came from the translator's BufferUsageFlags tested with the wrong bit (& 2; Write is
   1 << 0), so every cached reflection says read-only -- while the deferred-lighting quads (dbe0acd9 ...) store per-tile
   feedback into the stats buffer. The loader (nvn_mtl.m refl_mark_stores) sets rw from the MSL's actual stores / atomics;
   here only the json flag and a write-access image type count. (A non-const `device` pointer is not enough: spirv-cross
   emits it for 1,140 fragment variants that never store, and treating them as writers disables argument-block reuse.) */
static int refl_rw(NSDictionary *b) {
    if ([b[@"rw"] isKindOfClass:[NSNumber class]] && [b[@"rw"] boolValue]) return 1;
    NSString *t = b[@"msl_type"]; if (![t isKindOfClass:[NSString class]]) return 0;
    return [t containsString:@"access::write"] || [t containsString:@"access::read_write"];
}
int nvn_refl_from_json(NSDictionary *j, nvn_refl *o, char *err, int errlen) {
    memset(o, 0, sizeof *o);
    #define FAIL(...) do { snprintf(err, errlen, __VA_ARGS__); return 1; } while (0)
    if (![j[@"route"] isEqual:@"B"]) FAIL("不是 B 反射（route ≠ B；A 路线 / PC 链反射已退役）");
    {   // Switch 原版翻译：种类与 NVN 槽号已由 dmsh_build.py 从 MSL 成员名解出 | Translated original Switch shaders: kind and NVN slot number are already parsed from the MSL member names by dmsh_build.py
        NSArray *bs = j[@"bindings"];
        if (![bs isKindOfClass:[NSArray class]]) FAIL("缺 bindings");
        if (bs.count > NVN_REFL_MAXB) FAIL("绑定 %lu 个，超上限 %d", (unsigned long)bs.count, NVN_REFL_MAXB);
        o->route_b = 1; o->abi = 0;   // spirv-cross 第 0 组 → [[buffer(0)]] | spirv-cross set 0 → [[buffer(0)]]
        for (NSDictionary *b in bs) {
            NSString *k = b[@"kind"]; nvn_rbind *r = &o->b[o->nb];
            id rg = b[@"reg"]; int reg = [rg isKindOfClass:[NSNumber class]] ? [rg intValue] : -1, aid = [b[@"arg_id"] intValue];
            r->aid = (uint16_t)aid; r->reg = reg < 0 ? 0 : (uint16_t)reg;
            if ([k isEqualToString:@"cbuf"]) r->kind = NVN_RB_CBUF;
            else if ([k isEqualToString:@"samp"]) r->kind = NVN_RB_SAMP;
            else if ([k isEqualToString:@"samp_tex"]) r->kind = NVN_RB_SAMPT;
            else if ([k isEqualToString:@"tex"]) { r->kind = NVN_RB_TEX; dummy_kind(b[@"msl_type"], &r->dtt, &r->dpf); }
            else if ([k isEqualToString:@"img"]) { r->kind = NVN_RB_IMG; dummy_kind(b[@"msl_type"], &r->dtt, &r->dpf); r->rw = refl_rw(b); }
            else if ([k isEqualToString:@"tbuf"]) { r->kind = NVN_RB_TBUF; uint8_t tt; dummy_kind(b[@"msl_type"], &tt, &r->dpf); }
            else if ([k isEqualToString:@"sbuf"]) { r->kind = NVN_RB_SBUFP; r->rw = refl_rw(b); }
            else if ([k isEqualToString:@"ubo_ptr"]) r->kind = NVN_RB_UBOP;
            else if ([k isEqualToString:@"sbuf_ubo"]) { r->kind = NVN_RB_SBUFU; r->rw = refl_rw(b); r->off = (uint16_t)[b[@"off"] intValue]; }
            else if ([k isEqualToString:@"support"]) r->kind = NVN_RB_SUPPORT;
            else if ([k isEqualToString:@"c1"]) r->kind = NVN_RB_C1;
            else if ([k isEqualToString:@"drvcb"]) r->kind = [b[@"bank"] intValue] == 2 ? NVN_RB_DRV2 : NVN_RB_DRV0;
            else FAIL("B 绑定种类 %s 未实现（%s）", k.UTF8String, [b[@"msl_name"] UTF8String]);
            /* A combined handle in a user constant buffer has no fixed NVN texture register. Maxwell c3..c16
               are NVN user uniform slots 0..13; the name's hexadecimal offset is in 32-bit words. */
            if (reg < 0 && (r->kind == NVN_RB_TEX || r->kind == NVN_RB_SAMPT)) {
                const char *name = [b[@"msl_name"] UTF8String], *at = name ? strstr(name, "_t_cb") : NULL;
                if (at) {
                    char *end; errno = 0;
                    unsigned long bank = strtoul(at + 5, &end, 10);
                    if (errno || end == at + 5 || *end != '_') FAIL("invalid uniform texture binding %s", name);
                    const char *word_start = end + 1; unsigned long word = strtoul(word_start, &end, 16);
                    const char *suffix = r->kind == NVN_RB_SAMPT ? "Smplr" : "";
                    if (errno || end == word_start || strcmp(end, suffix) || bank < 3 || bank > 16 || word > 0x3fff)
                        FAIL("uniform texture binding out of range or unsupported: %s", name);
                    reg = (int)bank - 3; r->reg = (uint16_t)reg; r->off = (uint16_t)(word * 4);
                    r->kind = r->kind == NVN_RB_TEX ? NVN_RB_TEXU : NVN_RB_SAMPU;
                }
            }
            if ((r->kind == NVN_RB_CBUF || r->kind == NVN_RB_SAMP || r->kind == NVN_RB_SAMPT || r->kind == NVN_RB_TEX || r->kind == NVN_RB_IMG || r->kind == NVN_RB_TBUF || r->kind == NVN_RB_SBUFP || r->kind == NVN_RB_UBOP || r->kind == NVN_RB_SBUFU) && reg < 0)
                FAIL("B 绑定 %s 没解出槽号", [b[@"msl_name"] UTF8String]);
            o->nb++;
        }
        NSDictionary *dr = j[@"drv_reads"];
        if ([dr isKindOfClass:[NSDictionary class]]) { o->drv_read[0] = dr[@"0"] != nil; o->drv_read[2] = dr[@"2"] != nil; }
        NSArray *uf = j[@"drv_unfillable"];
        if ([uf isKindOfClass:[NSArray class]] && uf.count) FAIL("运行时读驱动段的回放层填不了的位置：%s", [[uf componentsJoinedByString:@" "] UTF8String]);
        NSString *c1 = j[@"c1"];
        if (c1.length % 2 || c1.length / 2 > sizeof o->c1) FAIL("c1 长 %lu 字节，超上限或不成对", (unsigned long)c1.length / 2);
        if (c1.length) { o->has_c1 = 1; o->c1_len = (uint16_t)(c1.length / 2); for (unsigned i = 0; i < o->c1_len; i++) o->c1[i] = (uint8_t)strtoul([[c1 substringWithRange:NSMakeRange(2 * i, 2)] UTF8String], NULL, 16); }
        for (NSDictionary *v in j[@"vertex_inputs"]) {   // [[attribute(n)]]：n 即 NVN 顶点属性号 | [[attribute(n)]]: n is the NVN vertex attribute number
            int loc = [v[@"location"] intValue]; NSString *t = v[@"msl_type"];
            if (loc < 0 || loc >= NVN_REFL_MAXV || o->nv >= NVN_REFL_MAXV) FAIL("B 顶点输入 %d 越界", loc);
            o->v[o->nv].loc = o->v[o->nv].nvn = (uint8_t)loc;
            o->v[o->nv].ct = [t hasPrefix:@"uint"] ? NVN_CT_UINT : [t hasPrefix:@"int"] ? NVN_CT_INT : NVN_CT_FLOAT;
            o->nv++;
        }
        NSDictionary *ra = j[@"raster"];
        o->pos_attr = -1; o->may_discard = 1; o->writes_smask = 1;
        if ([ra isKindOfClass:[NSDictionary class]]) {
            if (ra[@"pos_attr"]) { int pa = [ra[@"pos_attr"] intValue]; o->pos_attr = (int8_t)(pa >= 0 && pa < 16 ? pa : -1); o->pos_w1 = [ra[@"pos_w"] isEqual:@"one"]; }
            if (ra[@"discard"]) o->may_discard = [ra[@"discard"] intValue] != 0;
            if (ra[@"sample_mask"]) o->writes_smask = [ra[@"sample_mask"] intValue] != 0;
            for (NSNumber *c in ra[@"colors"]) if (c.intValue >= 0 && c.intValue < 8) o->color_mask |= (uint8_t)(1u << c.intValue);
        }
        memset(o->uv_attr, -1, sizeof o->uv_attr); memset(o->uv_aff_attr, -1, sizeof o->uv_aff_attr);
        NSDictionary *ua = [ra isKindOfClass:[NSDictionary class]] ? ra[@"uv_affine"] : nil;
        if ([ua isKindOfClass:[NSDictionary class]]) for (NSString *k in ua) { int l = k.intValue; NSDictionary *e = ua[k]; int a = [e[@"attr"] intValue];
            if (l < 0 || l >= 32 || a < 0 || a >= 16) continue;
            NSArray *refs[4] = {e[@"sx"], e[@"ox"], e[@"sy"], e[@"oy"]}; int ok = 1;
            for (int q = 0; q < 4; q++) { NSArray *r = refs[q]; if (![r isKindOfClass:[NSArray class]] || r.count != 3) { ok = 0; break; }
                int sl = [r[0] intValue], vec = [r[1] intValue], cmp = [r[2] intValue]; if (sl < 0 || sl > 15 || vec < 0 || vec > 63 || cmp < 0 || cmp > 3) { ok = 0; break; }
                o->uv_aff[l][q] = (uint16_t)(sl << 8 | vec << 2 | cmp); }
            if (ok) o->uv_aff_attr[l] = (int8_t)a; }
        NSDictionary *uv = [ra isKindOfClass:[NSDictionary class]] ? ra[@"uv_from_attr"] : nil;
        if ([uv isKindOfClass:[NSDictionary class]]) for (NSString *k in uv) { int l = k.intValue, a = [uv[k] intValue]; if (l >= 0 && l < 32 && a >= 0 && a < 16) o->uv_attr[l] = (int8_t)a; }
        NSDictionary *fe = j[@"fetch"];
        if ([fe isKindOfClass:[NSDictionary class]]) {
            for (NSDictionary *c in fe[@"calls"]) { int i = [c[@"fc"] intValue], r = [c[@"tex_reg"] intValue], l = [c[@"varying_locn"] intValue];
                if (i != o->nfc || i >= 32 || r < 0 || r >= 128 || l < 0 || l >= 32) FAIL("fetch 调用表不连续或越界（第 %d 条）", i);
                o->fc_reg[o->nfc] = (uint8_t)r; o->fc_locn[o->nfc] = (uint8_t)l; o->nfc++; }
            for (NSNumber *r in fe[@"mixed_regs"]) if (r.intValue >= 0 && r.intValue < 128) o->fc_mixed[r.intValue >> 6] |= 1ull << (r.intValue & 63);
            for (NSDictionary *u in fe[@"outputs"]) { if (o->nfo >= 4) FAIL("fetch 输出超过 4 个"); o->fo_color[o->nfo++] = (uint8_t)[u[@"color"] intValue]; }
        }
        NSArray *tg = j[@"threadgroup_size"];
        if ([tg isKindOfClass:[NSArray class]] && tg.count == 3) for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) o->tg[i] = (uint16_t)[tg[i] intValue];
        return 0;
    }
    #undef FAIL
}

`mario-odessy-harmony/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/nvn_registry_lock.h`:

```h
#pragma once
/* A lock with explicit per-thread ownership depth. All entry/exit paths
   for this lock must use these helpers and the same thread-local depth counter.
   A failed trylock can never distinguish nesting from another thread's ownership.
   An os_unfair_lock, not a pthread mutex: its waiters lend their priority to the owner (upstream 5f5de5e: the game's
   recording threads, priority 46, were preempted while holding it and the submit thread, 97, waited 1.8 ms a frame). */
#include <os/lock.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

static inline int nvn_registry_enter(os_unfair_lock_t lock, unsigned *thread_depth) {
    int outer = *thread_depth == 0;
    if (outer) os_unfair_lock_lock(lock);
    if (++*thread_depth == 0) abort();
    return outer;
}
static inline void nvn_registry_leave(os_unfair_lock_t lock, unsigned *thread_depth) {
    if (!*thread_depth) abort();
    if (!--*thread_depth) os_unfair_lock_unlock(lock);
}

`mario-odessy-harmony/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/nvn_render_stream.h`:

```h
/* Included only by nvn_mtl.m. Encode stage (TOTK_RENDER_STREAM=1, runtime `flag render_stream 0|1`): the Metal render
   encoder of every render pass is created, fed and ended by one persistent worker thread ("B"); the replay thread ("A")
   keeps the NVN state, the resource resolution, the argument-block writes, blits, dispatches and commits, and only
   joins B (rs_sync) where it must touch the command buffer itself. 2026-10-16, replacing the 2026-10-16 morning version
   (S017) that handed the encoder over from the 16th draw of a pass, woke the worker with a condition variable at every
   pass and joined it at every pass end: measured replay 4.90 -> 5.28 ms, i.e. the waits cost more than the driver calls
   they moved (analysis/s0a-*).
   - A sees a sentinel object as `g_enc` while B owns a pass; the enc_r_* wrappers turn calls on the sentinel into packets.
   - Packets travel through the single-producer / single-consumer FIFO; draws publish, so B sees whole draws.
   - B spins while packets keep coming and sleeps on a semaphore after RS_SPIN_NS of nothing; A signals it when it
     publishes to a sleeping B (store / fence / load on both sides, so a wake-up cannot be lost).
   - rs_sync() (A) waits until B consumed everything: before any encoder A opens on the command buffer itself, before a
     command buffer is ended / committed, and at the end of the submission. It spins; B is awake by then.
   - Objects: pipeline / depth-stencil states and the pass descriptor are retained for the packet and released by B
     after use (probes build pipeline states that go away right after the pass; the game's live in caches).
   No GPU ordering, resource retirement or uniform snapshot policy changes: B only encodes what A decided, in A's order. */
#include "nvn_encode_fifo.h"
#include <TargetConditionals.h>
#include <sched.h>
#include <dispatch/dispatch.h>

enum {
    RS_PSO, RS_DSS, RS_VIEWPORT, RS_SCISSOR, RS_CULL, RS_WINDING, RS_FILL,
    RS_BIAS, RS_CLIP, RS_STENCIL, RS_BLEND, RS_VISIBILITY, RS_ADDRESS,
    RS_DRAW, RS_INSTANCED, RS_INDEXED, RS_STORE,
    RS_BEGIN,   /* u[0] = retained MTL4RenderPassDescriptor, u[1] = vertex table, u[2] = fragment table, u[3] = command buffer, u[4] = barrier at start, u[5] = visibility options */
    RS_END,     /* end the encoder (barrier at end if u[0], visibility options u[1]) */
};
enum { RS_SPIN_NS = 200000 };   /* B waits (wfe) this long on an empty queue before sleeping on the semaphore. During a replay A never pauses
                                   for that long, so B sleeps in the frame gap and wakes (~30 us) at the next submission. The waits are wfe / sev,
                                   not a hot spin: with a hot spin (2 ms yield loop) the visible-mode GPU time rose 8.9 -> 9.3 ms (analysis/rs3v-*,
                                   rs4v-* with 200 us): CPU power taken from the GPU's budget. */
static nvn_encode_fifo g_rs_fifo;
static _Atomic int g_rs_on = -1;
static _Atomic int g_rs_sleeping;          /* B announced it is about to sleep (seq_cst handshake with the publisher) */
static dispatch_semaphore_t g_rs_sem;
static int g_rs_created, g_rs_configured, g_rs_active;
static id g_rs_sentinel;                   /* what A sees as the encoder while B owns the pass */
static uint64_t g_rs_passes, g_rs_packets, g_rs_syncs, g_rs_sync_ns, g_rs_sync_max_ns, g_rs_full_waits, g_rs_full_ns, g_rs_subs;
static _Atomic uint64_t g_rs_b_sleeps, g_rs_b_passes, g_rs_b_busy_ns;   /* busy: from the first packet after an idle spell to the next idle spell */
static int g_rs_probe_negative;
static int tbdr_on(void);
static int enc_label_on(void);
int mfx_enabled(void);
static int rs_enabled(void) {
    int v = atomic_load_explicit(&g_rs_on, memory_order_relaxed);
    if (v < 0) {
        const char *e = getenv("TOTK_RENDER_STREAM"); int expected = -1;
        /* Mac default on (2026-10-16: replay -18%, frame -3..5%, 30-minute soak clean); iOS off (A15: two performance cores). */
        atomic_compare_exchange_strong(&g_rs_on, &expected, e ? !strcmp(e, "1") : !TARGET_OS_IPHONE);
        v = atomic_load_explicit(&g_rs_on, memory_order_relaxed);
    }
    return v;
}
static inline uint64_t rs_now(void) { return clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW); }
static void rs_apply(id<MTL4RenderCommandEncoder> *enc, id<MTL4ArgumentTable> *vt, id<MTL4ArgumentTable> *ft, const nvn_encode_packet *p) {
    const uint64_t *u = p->u; id<MTL4RenderCommandEncoder> e = *enc;
    if (g_rs_probe_negative && (p->op == RS_DRAW || p->op == RS_INSTANCED || p->op == RS_INDEXED)) return;
    if (p->op != RS_BEGIN && !e) MDIE("render stream packet %llu without an encoder", (unsigned long long)p->op);
    switch (p->op) {
        case RS_BEGIN: {
            if (e) MDIE("render stream: pass begun while the previous one is open");
            MTL4RenderPassDescriptor *d = (__bridge MTL4RenderPassDescriptor *)(void *)(uintptr_t)u[0];
            id<MTL4CommandBuffer> cb = (__bridge id<MTL4CommandBuffer>)(void *)(uintptr_t)u[3];
            *vt = (__bridge id<MTL4ArgumentTable>)(void *)(uintptr_t)u[1]; *ft = (__bridge id<MTL4ArgumentTable>)(void *)(uintptr_t)u[2];
            e = [cb renderCommandEncoderWithDescriptor:d];
            if (!e) MDIE("render stream: renderCommandEncoderWithDescriptor failed");
            if (u[4] == 2) {   /* TOTK_BARRIER_NARROW: copies / compute order before every stage; earlier render work only before our fragment stage (the vertex stage overlaps the previous pass's fragment work) */
                [e barrierAfterQueueStages:MTLStageBlit | MTLStageDispatch beforeStages:MTLStageVertex | MTLStageFragment visibilityOptions:(MTL4VisibilityOptions)u[5]];
                [e barrierAfterQueueStages:MTLStageVertex | MTLStageFragment beforeStages:MTLStageFragment visibilityOptions:(MTL4VisibilityOptions)u[5]];
            } else if (u[4]) [e barrierAfterQueueStages:MTLStageAll beforeStages:MTLStageAll visibilityOptions:(MTL4VisibilityOptions)u[5]];
            [e setArgumentTable:*vt atStages:MTLRenderStageVertex]; [e setArgumentTable:*ft atStages:MTLRenderStageFragment];
            CFRelease((CFTypeRef)(uintptr_t)u[0]);
            *enc = e; atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_rs_b_passes, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
            break; }
        case RS_END:
            if (u[0] == 2) [e barrierAfterStages:MTLStageVertex | MTLStageFragment beforeQueueStages:MTLStageFragment | MTLStageBlit | MTLStageDispatch visibilityOptions:(MTL4VisibilityOptions)u[1]];   /* TOTK_BARRIER_NARROW: later vertex stages do not wait */
            else if (u[0]) [e barrierAfterStages:MTLStageAll beforeQueueStages:MTLStageAll visibilityOptions:(MTL4VisibilityOptions)u[1]];
            [e endEncoding]; *enc = nil; break;
        case RS_PSO: [e setRenderPipelineState:(__bridge id<MTLRenderPipelineState>)(void *)(uintptr_t)u[0]]; if (u[0]) CFRelease((CFTypeRef)(uintptr_t)u[0]); break;
        case RS_DSS: [e setDepthStencilState:(__bridge id<MTLDepthStencilState>)(void *)(uintptr_t)u[0]]; if (u[0]) CFRelease((CFTypeRef)(uintptr_t)u[0]); break;
        case RS_VIEWPORT: { MTLViewport v; memcpy(&v, u, sizeof v); [e setViewport:v]; break; }
        case RS_SCISSOR: { MTLScissorRect v; memcpy(&v, u, sizeof v); [e setScissorRect:v]; break; }
        case RS_CULL: [e setCullMode:(MTLCullMode)u[0]]; break;
        case RS_WINDING: [e setFrontFacingWinding:(MTLWinding)u[0]]; break;
        case RS_FILL: [e setTriangleFillMode:(MTLTriangleFillMode)u[0]]; break;
        case RS_BIAS: { float v[3]; memcpy(v, u, sizeof v); [e setDepthBias:v[0] slopeScale:v[1] clamp:v[2]]; break; }
        case RS_CLIP: [e setDepthClipMode:(MTLDepthClipMode)u[0]]; break;
        case RS_STENCIL: [e setStencilReferenceValue:(uint32_t)u[0]]; break;
        case RS_BLEND: { float v[4]; memcpy(v, u, sizeof v); [e setBlendColorRed:v[0] green:v[1] blue:v[2] alpha:v[3]]; break; }
        case RS_VISIBILITY: [e setVisibilityResultMode:(MTLVisibilityResultMode)u[0] offset:(NSUInteger)u[1]]; break;
        case RS_ADDRESS: [(u[0] ? *ft : *vt) setAddress:u[2] atIndex:(NSUInteger)u[1]]; break;
        case RS_DRAW: [e drawPrimitives:(MTLPrimitiveType)u[0] vertexStart:(NSUInteger)u[1] vertexCount:(NSUInteger)u[2]]; break;
        case RS_INSTANCED: [e drawPrimitives:(MTLPrimitiveType)u[0] vertexStart:(NSUInteger)u[1] vertexCount:(NSUInteger)u[2] instanceCount:(NSUInteger)u[3] baseInstance:(NSUInteger)u[4]]; break;
        case RS_INDEXED: [e drawIndexedPrimitives:(MTLPrimitiveType)u[0] indexCount:(NSUInteger)u[1] indexType:(MTLIndexType)u[2] indexBuffer:u[3] indexBufferLength:(NSUInteger)u[4] instanceCount:(NSUInteger)u[5] baseVertex:(NSInteger)u[6] baseInstance:(NSUInteger)u[7]]; break;
        case RS_STORE:
            if (u[0] == 1) [e setDepthStoreAction:(MTLStoreAction)u[1]];
            else if (u[0] == 2) [e setStencilStoreAction:(MTLStoreAction)u[1]];
            else [e setColorStoreAction:(MTLStoreAction)u[1] atIndex:(NSUInteger)u[2]];
            break;
        default: MDIE("render stream invalid operation %llu", (unsigned long long)p->op);
    }
}
static void *rs_worker(void *unused) {
    (void)unused;
    pthread_setname_np("TOTK encode stage");
    pthread_set_qos_class_self_np(QOS_CLASS_USER_INTERACTIVE, 0);
    id<MTL4RenderCommandEncoder> enc = nil; id<MTL4ArgumentTable> vt = nil, ft = nil;
    uint64_t idle_since = 0, busy_since = 0;
    for (;;) {
        const nvn_encode_packet *p = nvn_encode_fifo_peek(&g_rs_fifo);
        if (!p) {
            uint64_t now = rs_now();
            if (busy_since) { atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_rs_b_busy_ns, now - busy_since, memory_order_relaxed); busy_since = 0; }
            if (!idle_since) idle_since = now;
            if (now - idle_since < RS_SPIN_NS) { __builtin_arm_wfe(); continue; }   /* low-power wait; A does sev after every publish */
            atomic_store_explicit(&g_rs_sleeping, 1, memory_order_seq_cst);
            atomic_thread_fence(memory_order_seq_cst);
            if (!nvn_encode_fifo_peek(&g_rs_fifo)) { dispatch_semaphore_wait(g_rs_sem, DISPATCH_TIME_FOREVER); atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_rs_b_sleeps, 1, memory_order_relaxed); }
            atomic_store_explicit(&g_rs_sleeping, 0, memory_order_seq_cst);
            idle_since = 0; continue;
        }
        if (!busy_since) busy_since = rs_now();
        idle_since = 0;
        @autoreleasepool { rs_apply(&enc, &vt, &ft, p); }
        nvn_encode_fifo_consume(&g_rs_fifo);
        __builtin_arm_sev();
    }
    return NULL;
}
/* Publish what A queued and wake B if it went to sleep (seq_cst store / fence / load pairs with B's sleep handshake). */
static inline void rs_publish(void) {
    nvn_encode_fifo_publish(&g_rs_fifo);
    atomic_thread_fence(memory_order_seq_cst);
    __builtin_arm_sev();
    if (atomic_load_explicit(&g_rs_sleeping, memory_order_seq_cst)) dispatch_semaphore_signal(g_rs_sem);
}
static void rs_put(nvn_encode_packet p, int publish) {
    if (!nvn_encode_fifo_push(&g_rs_fifo, &p)) {   /* ring full: B is behind; wait for it (counted: this is A time lost to B) */
        uint64_t t0 = rs_now(); g_rs_full_waits++;
        do { rs_publish(); __builtin_arm_wfe(); } while (!nvn_encode_fifo_push(&g_rs_fifo, &p));
        g_rs_full_ns += rs_now() - t0;
    }
    if (publish) rs_publish();
    g_rs_packets++;
}
static inline void rs_object(unsigned op, id object) { rs_put((nvn_encode_packet){.op = op, .u = {(uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(object ? CFBridgingRetain(object) : NULL)}}, 0); }
static void rs_copy(unsigned op, const void *data, size_t size) {
    nvn_encode_packet p = {.op = op};
    if (size > sizeof p.u) MDIE("render stream payload too large");
    memcpy(p.u, data, size); rs_put(p, 0);
}
/* A: wait until B has consumed everything queued so far. */
static void rs_sync(void) {
    if (!g_rs_created) return;
    if (g_rs_active) MDIE("render stream: sync inside a streamed pass");
    rs_publish();
    uint64_t t0 = rs_now(), produced = g_rs_fifo.produced;
    while (atomic_load_explicit(&g_rs_fifo.consumed, memory_order_acquire) != produced) {
        __builtin_arm_wfe();
        if ((rs_now() - t0) > 2000000000ull) MDIE("render stream: the encode stage did not drain in 2 s");
    }
    uint64_t dt = rs_now() - t0; g_rs_syncs++; g_rs_sync_ns += dt; if (dt > g_rs_sync_max_ns) g_rs_sync_max_ns = dt;
    if (totk_tl_on()) totk_tl(TL_RS_JOIN, dt, g_rs_syncs);
}
/* Whether the next render pass is encoded by B. Diagnostics that encode on the command buffer themselves, the TBDR
   rewrites and MetalFX stay on the replay thread. */
static int rs_stream_pass(void) {
    if (!rs_enabled() || pt_active() || tbdr_on() || enc_label_on() || mfx_enabled()) return 0;
    if (!g_rs_configured) {
        const char *negative = getenv("TOTK_PROBE_NEGATIVE");
        g_rs_probe_negative = negative && atoi(negative) == 17;
        g_rs_sentinel = [NSObject new];
        g_rs_sem = dispatch_semaphore_create(0);
        g_rs_configured = 1;
    }
    if (!g_rs_created) {
        nvn_encode_fifo_reset(&g_rs_fifo);
        pthread_t thread; pthread_attr_t attr; pthread_attr_init(&attr); pthread_attr_setstacksize(&attr, 1 << 20);
        if (pthread_create(&thread, &attr, rs_worker, NULL)) MDIE("render stream worker creation failed");
        pthread_detach(thread); g_rs_created = 1;
        MLOG("[nvn] 编码线程：渲染通道的 Metal 编码在独立线程上（TOTK_RENDER_STREAM=1；flag render_stream 0 关）");
    }
    return 1;
}
/* A: hand a pass to B. Returns the sentinel the replay uses as its encoder. */
static id rs_pass_begin(MTL4RenderPassDescriptor *d, id<MTL4ArgumentTable> vt, id<MTL4ArgumentTable> ft, id<MTL4CommandBuffer> cb, int bar_start, uint64_t vis) {
    if (g_rs_active) MDIE("render stream: pass begun while another streamed pass is open");
    g_rs_active = 1; g_rs_passes++;
    rs_put((nvn_encode_packet){.op = RS_BEGIN, .u = {(uint64_t)(uintptr_t)CFBridgingRetain(d), (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(__bridge void *)vt, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(__bridge void *)ft,
                                                     (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(__bridge void *)cb, (uint64_t)bar_start, vis}}, 1);
    return g_rs_sentinel;
}
static int rs_using(id e) {
    if (!g_rs_active) return 0;
    if (e != g_rs_sentinel) MDIE("render stream encoder ownership mismatch");
    return 1;
}
static void rs_pass_end(id e, int bar_end, uint64_t vis) {
    if (!rs_using(e)) MDIE("render stream: ending a pass it does not own");
    rs_put((nvn_encode_packet){.op = RS_END, .u = {(uint64_t)bar_end, vis}}, 1);
    g_rs_active = 0;
}
/* End of a submission: B drained; a statistics line every 1800 submissions. */
static void rs_sub_end(void) {
    if (!g_rs_created) return;
    rs_sync();
    if (++g_rs_subs % 1800 == 0) {
        static uint64_t last_busy, last_full, last_packets, last_sync;
        uint64_t busy = atomic_load(&g_rs_b_busy_ns);
        MLOG("[nvn] 编码线程 至提交 %llu：通道 %llu，包 %llu（近 1800 次提交每次 %.0f 个），等待 %llu 次 / 平均 %.1f µs / 最长 %.1f µs / 近 1800 次每次 %.3f ms，"
             "环满 %llu 次 / 近 1800 次每次等 %.3f ms，线程入睡 %llu 次，编码线程忙 近 1800 次每次 %.3f ms",
             (unsigned long long)g_rs_subs, (unsigned long long)g_rs_passes, (unsigned long long)g_rs_packets, (double)(g_rs_packets - last_packets) / 1800.0,
             (unsigned long long)g_rs_syncs, g_rs_syncs ? (double)g_rs_sync_ns / (double)g_rs_syncs / 1e3 : 0.0, (double)g_rs_sync_max_ns / 1e3,
             (double)(g_rs_sync_ns - last_sync) / 1800.0 / 1e6, (unsigned long long)g_rs_full_waits, (double)(g_rs_full_ns - last_full) / 1800.0 / 1e6,
             (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&g_rs_b_sleeps), (double)(busy - last_busy) / 1800.0 / 1e6);
        last_busy = busy; last_full = g_rs_full_ns; last_packets = g_rs_packets; last_sync = g_rs_sync_ns;
        g_rs_sync_max_ns = 0;
    }
}

```
