```c
/* One-frame-chain timeline (see totk_timeline.h). */
#include "totk_timeline.h"
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>

typedef struct { uint64_t t, a, b; uint32_t kind, tid; uint64_t frame; } tl_ev;
enum { TL_CAP = 1 << 20 };
static tl_ev *g_ev;
static _Atomic uint64_t g_n, g_commit, g_frame;
static _Atomic int g_state = -1;   /* -1 unread, 0 off, 1 waiting for the window, 2 recording, 3 written */
static uint64_t g_first, g_count;
static char g_path[1024];

static void tl_init(void) {
    const char *e = getenv("TOTK_TIMELINE");
    int st = 0;
    if (e && *e) {
        const char *c1 = strrchr(e, ':');
        const char *c0 = c1 ? c1 - 1 : NULL;
        while (c0 && c0 > e && *c0 != ':') c0--;
        if (c1 && c0 && c0 > e && *c0 == ':' && (size_t)(c0 - e) < sizeof g_path) {
            memcpy(g_path, e, (size_t)(c0 - e)); g_path[c0 - e] = 0;
            g_first = strtoull(c0 + 1, NULL, 10); g_count = strtoull(c1 + 1, NULL, 10);
            g_ev = calloc(TL_CAP, sizeof *g_ev);
            if (g_ev && g_count) st = 1;
        }
        if (!st) fprintf(stderr, "[timeline] TOTK_TIMELINE=%s 读不懂（要 <文件>:<首帧>:<帧数>），不记录\n", e);
        else fprintf(stderr, "[timeline] 记录第 %llu 帧起 %llu 帧的时间线到 %s\n", (unsigned long long)g_first, (unsigned long long)g_count, g_path);
    }
    int want = -1; atomic_compare_exchange_strong(&g_state, &want, st);
}
int totk_tl_on(void) {
    int s = atomic_load_explicit(&g_state, memory_order_relaxed);
    if (s < 0) { tl_init(); s = atomic_load(&g_state); }
    return s == 2;
}
void totk_tl_at(int kind, uint64_t t_ns, uint64_t a, uint64_t b) {
    if (!totk_tl_on()) return;
    uint64_t i = atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_n, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
    if (i >= TL_CAP) return;
    uint64_t tid; pthread_threadid_np(NULL, &tid);
    g_ev[i] = (tl_ev){t_ns, a, b, (uint32_t)kind, (uint32_t)tid, atomic_load_explicit(&g_frame, memory_order_relaxed)};
}
void totk_tl(int kind, uint64_t a, uint64_t b) {
    if (!totk_tl_on()) return;
    totk_tl_at(kind, clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW), a, b);
}
uint64_t totk_tl_commit_id(void) { return atomic_fetch_add(&g_commit, 1) + 1; }

static void tl_write(void) {
    FILE *f = fopen(g_path, "w");
    if (!f) { fprintf(stderr, "[timeline] 写不了 %s\n", g_path); return; }
    uint64_t n = atomic_load(&g_n); if (n > TL_CAP) n = TL_CAP;
    fprintf(f, "# t_ns\tkind\ttid\tframe\ta\tb\n");
    static const char *names[] = {"?", "sub_in", "sub_out", "rep_begin", "rep_end", "commit", "gpu", "wait_in", "wait_out",
                                  "acq_in", "acq_out", "pres_in", "pres_out", "finish_in", "finish_out", "fence", "rs_join",
                                  "pass_begin", "pass_end", "margin"};
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const tl_ev *e = &g_ev[i];
        fprintf(f, "%llu\t%s\t%u\t%llu\t%llu\t%llu\n", (unsigned long long)e->t, e->kind < sizeof names / sizeof *names ? names[e->kind] : "?",
                e->tid, (unsigned long long)e->frame, (unsigned long long)e->a, (unsigned long long)e->b);
    }
    fclose(f);
    fprintf(stderr, "[timeline] 写出 %llu 个事件到 %s\n", (unsigned long long)n, g_path);
}
void totk_tl_frame(uint64_t presents) {
    totk_tl_on();
    atomic_store(&g_frame, presents);
    int s = atomic_load(&g_state);
    if (s == 1 && presents >= g_first) atomic_store(&g_state, 2);
    /* GPU feedback of the last frames arrives after their presents: keep recording 30 more frames, then write */
    else if (s == 2 && presents >= g_first + g_count + 30) { atomic_store(&g_state, 3); tl_write(); }
}

`mario-odessy-harmony/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/totk_timeline.h`:

```h
/* TOTK_TIMELINE=<file>:<first frame>:<frames> (diagnostic, off by default): one timeline of a run of frames on one clock,
   to see which link of the chain "game logic -> submit -> replay -> GPU -> the game waiting for that frame" sets the frame
   time. Host events are CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW nanoseconds; GPU start / end of each committed command buffer come from Metal's
   commit feedback (seconds on the same mach clock). Frames are counted by the game's presents (nvnQueuePresentTexture).
   The events go to a preallocated buffer and are written to <file> once, a few frames after the window
   (scripts/diag/timeline.py reads it). */
#pragma once
#include <stdint.h>

enum {
    TL_SUB_IN = 1, TL_SUB_OUT,      /* nvnQueueSubmitCommands enter / return (a = draws so far is not known: 0) */
    TL_REP_BEGIN, TL_REP_END,       /* replay of a submission (submit_exec), on the game thread or the translation thread */
    TL_COMMIT,                      /* a command buffer committed: a = commit id, b = 1 last of its submission, 0 mid-submission */
    TL_GPU,                         /* GPU span of commit a: t = start, b = end (ns) */
    TL_WAIT_IN, TL_WAIT_OUT,        /* nvnSyncWait that blocks: a = fence value waited for, b = 1 fence of the newest commit */
    TL_ACQ_IN, TL_ACQ_OUT,          /* nvnWindowAcquireTexture */
    TL_PRES_IN, TL_PRES_OUT,        /* nvnQueuePresentTexture */
    TL_FINISH_IN, TL_FINISH_OUT,    /* nvnQueueFinish */
    TL_FENCE,                       /* fence value of commit a: b */
    TL_RS_JOIN,                     /* the replay thread waited a ns for the encode stage (b = join count) */
    TL_PASS_BEGIN, TL_PASS_END,     /* a render pass opened / ended on the replay thread: a = pass serial, b = draws in it (end) */
    TL_MARGIN,                      /* (task 0n) a present committed on the display link: a = microseconds before its target
                                       refresh (the margin), b = microseconds from the game's enqueue to that refresh (0 if unknown) */
};

int totk_tl_on(void);                                   /* the window is open (cheap after the first call) */
void totk_tl(int kind, uint64_t a, uint64_t b);         /* event now, on this thread */
void totk_tl_at(int kind, uint64_t t_ns, uint64_t a, uint64_t b);
void totk_tl_frame(uint64_t presents);                  /* the game presented: counts frames, opens / closes the window, writes the file */
uint64_t totk_tl_commit_id(void);                       /* id for a command buffer about to be committed */

```

```c
// TOTK: NVN physical / virtual memory pools.
// A virtual pool is a host VM range whose 64 KiB pages alias pages of physical pools via mach_vm_remap
// (copy=FALSE), so CPU and GPU writes through either view hit the same physical pages.
// Physical pools marked CPU_NO_ACCESS cannot be observed except through virtual mappings, so they get
// 16 KiB-aligned host storage (game storage may be only 4/8 KiB aligned, which Darwin cannot remap).
// CPU-visible physical pools must alias the game storage itself and therefore must be 16 KiB aligned.
#include "totk_vpool.h"
#include "nvn_mtl.h"
#include "nvn_dirty.h"
#include "../../host/hle.h"
#include <mach/mach.h>
#include "mach_vm_compat.h"
#include <pthread.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#define F_CPU_NO_ACCESS NVN_MEMORY_POOL_FLAGS_CPU_NO_ACCESS
#define F_GPU_NO_ACCESS NVN_MEMORY_POOL_FLAGS_GPU_NO_ACCESS
#define F_PHYSICAL NVN_MEMORY_POOL_FLAGS_PHYSICAL
#define F_VIRTUAL NVN_MEMORY_POOL_FLAGS_VIRTUAL
#define POOL_MAGIC MAGIC('P', 'O', 'O', 'L')

static pthread_mutex_t g_map_mu = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;

static uint64_t host_page(void) { return (uint64_t)getpagesize(); }
static uint64_t round_up(uint64_t v, uint64_t a) { return (v + a - 1) & ~(a - 1); }

static uint8_t *vm_fresh(uint64_t span) {
    mach_vm_address_t a = 0;
    kern_return_t kr = mach_vm_allocate(mach_task_self(), &a, span, VM_FLAGS_ANYWHERE);
    if (kr != KERN_SUCCESS) { LOG("【红】vpool: mach_vm_allocate(%#llx) failed kr=%d", span, kr); return NULL; }
    return (uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)a;
}

int totk_vpool_init(pool_t *o) {
    int phys = (o->flags & F_PHYSICAL) != 0, virt = (o->flags & F_VIRTUAL) != 0;
    o->game_mem = o->mem; o->host = NULL; o->span = 0;
    if (phys == virt) { LOG("【红】vpool: pool flags %#x must be exactly one of PHYSICAL/VIRTUAL", o->flags); return 0; }
    if (!o->size || o->size % TOTK_VPOOL_PAGE) { LOG("【红】vpool: pool size %#llx not a multiple of 64 KiB", o->size); return 0; }
    if (virt && o->mem) { LOG("【红】vpool: virtual pool given storage %p", (void *)o->mem); return 0; }
    if (phys && !o->mem) { LOG("【红】vpool: physical pool without storage"); return 0; }
    if (phys && !(o->flags & F_CPU_NO_ACCESS)) {
        if ((uintptr_t)o->mem % host_page()) { LOG("【红】vpool: CPU-visible physical pool %p not %#llx aligned; cannot alias", (void *)o->mem, host_page()); return 0; }
        return 1;   // aliases the game storage directly
    }
    o->span = round_up(o->size, host_page());
    o->host = vm_fresh(o->span);
    if (!o->host) return 0;
    o->mem = o->host;
    return 1;
}

int totk_vpool_fini(pool_t *o) {
    if (!o->host) return 0;
    mach_vm_deallocate(mach_task_self(), (mach_vm_address_t)(uintptr_t)o->host, o->span);
    o->host = NULL; o->mem = o->game_mem; o->span = 0;
    return 1;
}

static int check_request(const pool_t *v, const totk_mapping_request *r, int i) {
    uint64_t end = (uint64_t)r->virtual_offset + r->size;
    if (r->virtual_offset < 0 || r->physical_offset < 0 || !r->size) { LOG("【红】vpool: request %d negative/empty range", i); return 0; }
    if ((r->virtual_offset | r->physical_offset | r->size) % TOTK_VPOOL_PAGE) { LOG("【红】vpool: request %d not 64 KiB aligned (v=%#llx p=%#llx n=%#llx)", i, r->virtual_offset, r->physical_offset, r->size); return 0; }
    if (end < r->size || end > v->size) { LOG("【红】vpool: request %d exceeds virtual pool (%#llx > %#llx)", i, end, v->size); return 0; }
    if (!r->physical_pool) return 1;   // unmap
    const pool_t *p = (const pool_t *)(const void *)r->physical_pool;
    if (p->magic != POOL_MAGIC || !(p->flags & F_PHYSICAL)) { LOG("【红】vpool: request %d source %p is not a physical pool", i, (const void *)p); return 0; }
    uint64_t pend = (uint64_t)r->physical_offset + r->size;
    if (pend < r->size || pend > p->size) { LOG("【红】vpool: request %d exceeds physical pool (%#llx > %#llx)", i, pend, p->size); return 0; }
    return 1;
}

// TOTK diagnostics: mapping table (virtual range -> CPU address of the physical backing) so a watch on a GPU
// address can protect the pages the CPU actually touches (the game reads/writes physical pools through their own view).
typedef struct { uintptr_t va, cpu; uint64_t size; } vmap_ent;
static vmap_ent g_vmap[512]; static int g_nvmap;
static void vmap_note(uintptr_t va, uint64_t size, uintptr_t cpu) {
    for (int i = 0; i < g_nvmap; i++) if (g_vmap[i].va == va) { g_vmap[i] = (vmap_ent){va, cpu, size}; return; }
    if (g_nvmap < 512) g_vmap[g_nvmap++] = (vmap_ent){va, cpu, size};
}
int totk_vpool_backing(uintptr_t va, uint64_t len, uintptr_t *cpu) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_map_mu); int r = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_nvmap; i++) { const vmap_ent *e = &g_vmap[i]; if (e->cpu && va >= e->va && va + len <= e->va + e->size) { *cpu = e->cpu + (va - e->va); r = 1; break; } }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_map_mu); return r;
}
static int apply_request(pool_t *v, const totk_mapping_request *r) {
    mach_vm_address_t dst = (mach_vm_address_t)(uintptr_t)(v->mem + r->virtual_offset);
    kern_return_t kr;
    if (!r->physical_pool) {
        kr = mach_vm_allocate(mach_task_self(), &dst, r->size, VM_FLAGS_FIXED | VM_FLAGS_OVERWRITE);
    } else {
        const pool_t *p = (const pool_t *)(const void *)r->physical_pool;
        vm_prot_t cur, max;
        kr = mach_vm_remap(mach_task_self(), &dst, r->size, 0, VM_FLAGS_FIXED | VM_FLAGS_OVERWRITE, mach_task_self(),
                           (mach_vm_address_t)(uintptr_t)(p->mem + r->physical_offset), FALSE, &cur, &max, VM_INHERIT_NONE);
        if (kr == KERN_SUCCESS && (cur & (VM_PROT_READ | VM_PROT_WRITE)) != (VM_PROT_READ | VM_PROT_WRITE)) { LOG("【红】vpool: alias lost RW (prot=%d)", cur); return 0; }
        if (kr == KERN_SUCCESS) vmap_note((uintptr_t)(v->mem + r->virtual_offset), r->size, (uintptr_t)(p->mem + r->physical_offset));
    }
    if (!r->physical_pool && kr == KERN_SUCCESS) vmap_note((uintptr_t)(v->mem + r->virtual_offset), r->size, 0);
    if (kr != KERN_SUCCESS || dst != (mach_vm_address_t)(uintptr_t)(v->mem + r->virtual_offset)) {
        LOG("【红】vpool: remap at %#llx size %#llx failed kr=%d", (unsigned long long)dst, r->size, kr);
        return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

int totk_vpool_map(pool_t *v, int count, const totk_mapping_request *r) {
    if (!v || v->magic != POOL_MAGIC || !(v->flags & F_VIRTUAL) || !v->mem) { LOG("【红】vpool: MapVirtual target %p is not a virtual pool", (void *)v); return 0; }
    if (count < 0 || (count && !r)) { LOG("【红】vpool: invalid request count %d", count); return 0; }
    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) if (!check_request(v, &r[i], i)) return 0;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_map_mu);
    // GPU page tables of the old zero-copy buffer and dirty-page protections refer to the replaced pages.
    nvn_dirty_remove_range(v->mem);
    mtl_pool_del(v->mem);
    int ok = 1;
    for (int i = 0; ok && i < count; i++) ok = apply_request(v, &r[i]);
    mtl_pool_add(v->mem, v->size);
    nvn_dirty_add_range(v->mem, v->size);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_map_mu);
    if (!ok) die("vpool: mapping failed after validation; virtual pool %p is inconsistent", (void *)v);
    return 1;
}

```

```md
# dm/gfx/tex — texture format mapping, block-linear deswizzling, BC decompression

中文：[README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md)

The part of the graphics layer that deals with texture data, called by the replay layer `../nvn/nvn_mtl.m`. It does three things:

1. converts NVN texture format numbers to Metal pixel formats;
2. unpacks the Switch's "block-linear" layout into an ordinary row-by-row layout;
3. decompresses BC textures on GPUs that do not support BC compressed textures.

Block linear is how the Tegra X1 GPU stores textures: the data is not one row after another, but interleaved in small blocks of 64 bytes × 8 rows (GOBs), and several GOBs are then stacked into larger blocks according to a "block height" and a "block depth". The game's packaged texture files are in exactly this layout, and it must be undone before uploading to Metal.

## Files

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `nvn_fmt_mtl.h`, `nvn_fmt_mtl.c` | `nvn_fmt_to_mtl()`: NVN format (0x01–0x9C) → Metal pixel format + component remapping. Returns 1 for an exact match, 2 for a substitute (precision, bit order or interpretation differs and a conversion is needed), 0 when Metal has no corresponding format. How each format is handled is written in the comments inside the table. Pure C, no dependency on Metal headers |
| `nvn_deswizzle.h`, `nvn_deswizzle.c` | `nvn_deswizzle()`: deswizzles one level and one layer from block linear to linear; `nvn_swizzle()`: the reverse, used for round trips in unit tests; `nvn_bl_offset()`: the block-linear address of a single point. Pure C |
| `nvn_deswizzle_gpu.h`, `nvn_deswizzle_gpu.m` | A Metal compute shader version of the same deswizzling algorithm, used by the replay layer when uploading packaged textures; when initialization fails or an unsupported format is encountered, the replay layer falls back to the CPU version |
| `nvn_bcdec.h`, `nvn_bcdec.c` | `nvn_bc_unpacked()` / `nvn_bc_decode()`: decompress BC textures on the CPU into uncompressed formats; decoding uses `dm/third_party/bcdec` |
| `tests/` | Unit tests |

The offsets of each level and layer within the storage, and the block height and block depth actually used by each level, are all taken from `../nvn/nvn_tex.c` (`nvn_tex_layout`, `nvn_tex_level_offset`, `nvn_tex_level_tiles`); this directory only does addressing and moving within a level. The game's packaged textures carry their own layout parameters, whose byte 0 is the log2 of the level 0 block height; when it is present it takes precedence (the `pkg_block_h` field of `nvn_texdesc`).

## Devices without BC support

Some older Apple GPUs do not support BC compressed textures (determined by `supportsBCTextureCompression` of `MTLDevice`). On these devices:

- the game's textures can be converted to ASTC format offline in advance with an optional supplementary pack (`dm/tools/astc_pack.py`; for dependencies see the "Optional" section of `docs/DEPENDENCIES.md`);
- the remaining BC textures are created by the replay layer in their decompressed format and decompressed at upload; decompression on the CPU goes through `nvn_bcdec.c` in this directory.

The environment variable `DM_TEST_NO_BC=1` forces this path on any machine.

## Tests

```sh
make -C dm/gfx/tex/tests samples   # fetch real-data samples (see below)
make -C dm/gfx/tex/tests run       # run t_fmt_mtl and t_tex
```

- **`t_fmt_mtl`**: takes the mapping for every NVN format in 0x01–0x9C and, for every one whose mapping is not 0, actually creates a texture on the local Metal device; all of them must be created successfully. It also checks that every NVN format with sRGB in its name lands on a Metal sRGB format. No game files needed.
- **`t_tex`**: the deswizzling tests, in several groups:

  | Group | Criterion |
  |---|---|
  | A round trip | Writes random data into each level and layer and reads it back out; must be byte-for-byte equal. Covers 2D, 2D array and 3D, several bytes-per-block values and non-power-of-two sizes |
  | B address formula | The result of `nvn_bl_offset()` equals the address computed by hand from the public layout rules |
  | E hand-made 3D | Places markers at hand-computed addresses, checks where they land after deswizzling, and checks block height, block depth and storage size |
  | C real data | The Switch version (block linear) of a texture, after deswizzling, is compared with the PC version (linear) of the same texture: those at the same resolution must be byte-for-byte equal; those whose Switch version was reduced in resolution were recompressed, so the comparison is instead that the PSNR after decoding (peak signal-to-noise ratio, a measure of how alike two images are) is not below 22 dB. It also checks that the per-level offsets in the file agree with `nvn_tex_level_offset` |
  | D negative control | Deliberately deswizzles with the block height off by one step; the result must no longer be byte-for-byte equal and the PSNR must be below 22 dB, proving that the criterion of group C can tell a wrong layout apart |

  The A round trip can only prove "one-to-one and within bounds"; it cannot prove that the layout formula is right. What really backs it up is the hand-computed addresses of group B and the byte-for-byte equality of the same-resolution samples of group C.

**About the real-data samples**: groups C and D need one copy each of the Switch version and the PC version of the same texture. `tests/fetch_samples.py` takes samples from the game files in your workspace: the Switch version is read from `$DM_ROOT/data/switch/3.3.94012/Update/RomFS/data`, the PC version from `$DM_ROOT/data/assets-src/raw`, and the output goes to `$DM_ROOT/build/cache/dm/tex_samples`. When there are no samples, the real-data items of `t_tex` count as failed and are not skipped; groups A, B and E need no game files. The samples do not go into the repository.

## Layout-related fields in the texture file header

Facts used by `t_tex.c` when parsing the game's `.texture` files:

- The file begins with `<DE(`; the Switch version and the PC version use the same container.
- In files that went through the Switch conversion, the four bytes starting at offset 0x14 are `00 00 00 07` (0 in the PC version), which indicates that the pixel area is in block-linear layout; offset 0x13 is the log2 of the level 0 block height, with the same meaning as byte 0 of the layout parameters the game passes to `SetPackagedTextureLayout` at run time.
- Files without this marker are stored linearly and are byte-for-byte identical to the PC version.

## Limitations

- `nvn_deswizzle()` does not support multisampled textures, textures with the LINEAR flag (which are linear to begin with) or the BUFFER target; it returns -1 when it encounters them.
- Cubes and cube arrays are handled as layered textures and have not been separately checked with real data.
- 3D textures have only the round-trip and hand-computed address checks; there are no real-data samples.
- The component bit order of the 16-bit packed formats (565 / 5551 / 4444) is mapped according to the format names and has not been checked with real data; they are marked as "substitute" in the format table.
- The real-data sample set is small, covering the four formats RGBA8, BC1, BC3 and BC4.

```

```md
# dm/gfx/tex — 贴图格式映射、块线性解排布、BC 解压

English: [README.md](README.md)

图形层里和贴图数据打交道的部分，供回放层 `../nvn/nvn_mtl.m` 调用。做三件事：

1. 把 NVN 的贴图格式号换成 Metal 的像素格式；
2. 把 Switch 的「块线性」排布解成普通的逐行排布；
3. 在不支持 BC 压缩贴图的显卡上把 BC 贴图解压。

块线性（block linear）是 Tegra X1 显卡存贴图的方式：数据不是一行接一行，而是按 64 字节 × 8 行的小块（GOB）交错排列，再按「块高」「块深」把若干 GOB 叠成更大的块。游戏打包好的贴图文件里就是这种排布，上传给 Metal 之前必须先解开。

## 文件

| 文件 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `nvn_fmt_mtl.h`、`nvn_fmt_mtl.c` | `nvn_fmt_to_mtl()`：NVN 格式（0x01–0x9C）→ Metal 像素格式 + 分量重映射。返回 1 表示精确对应，2 表示替代（精度、位序或读法不同，需要转换），0 表示 Metal 没有对应格式。每个格式的处理办法写在表内注释里。纯 C，不依赖 Metal 头文件 |
| `nvn_deswizzle.h`、`nvn_deswizzle.c` | `nvn_deswizzle()`：把某一级、某一层从块线性解到线性；`nvn_swizzle()`：反向，单测往返用；`nvn_bl_offset()`：单点的块线性地址。纯 C |
| `nvn_deswizzle_gpu.h`、`nvn_deswizzle_gpu.m` | 同一个解排布算法的 Metal 计算着色器版本，回放层上传打包贴图时用；初始化失败或遇到不支持的格式时回放层退回 CPU 版 |
| `nvn_bcdec.h`、`nvn_bcdec.c` | `nvn_bc_unpacked()` / `nvn_bc_decode()`：BC 贴图在 CPU 上解压成不压缩格式，解码用 `dm/third_party/bcdec` |
| `tests/` | 单元测试 |

各级、各层在存储里的偏移，以及每一级实际使用的块高、块深，一律取自 `../nvn/nvn_tex.c`（`nvn_tex_layout`、`nvn_tex_level_offset`、`nvn_tex_level_tiles`），这里只做级内的寻址与搬运。游戏的打包贴图自带布局参数，其第 0 字节是第 0 级块高的 log2，有它时以它为准（`nvn_texdesc` 的 `pkg_block_h` 字段）。

## 不支持 BC 的设备

一部分较老的苹果显卡不支持 BC 压缩贴图（由 `MTLDevice` 的 `supportsBCTextureCompression` 判断）。在这些设备上：

- 游戏贴图可以用可选的补充包事先离线换成 ASTC 格式（`dm/tools/astc_pack.py`，依赖见 `docs/DEPENDENCIES.zh-CN.md` 的「可选」一节）；
- 剩下的 BC 贴图由回放层建成解压后的格式，上传时解压，CPU 上的解压走本目录的 `nvn_bcdec.c`。

环境变量 `DM_TEST_NO_BC=1` 可以在任何机器上强制走这条路径。

## 测试

```sh
make -C dm/gfx/tex/tests samples   # 取真数据样本（见下）
make -C dm/gfx/tex/tests run       # 跑 t_fmt_mtl 与 t_tex
```

- **`t_fmt_mtl`**：对 0x01–0x9C 每个 NVN 格式取映射，凡映射不为 0 的，都在本机的 Metal 设备上真建一张贴图，必须全部建成；另核名字带 sRGB 的 NVN 格式都落到 Metal 的 sRGB 格式。不需要游戏文件。
- **`t_tex`**：解排布的测试，分几组：

  | 组 | 判据 |
  |---|---|
  | A 往返 | 往各级、各层写入随机数据再解出，逐字节相等。覆盖 2D、2D 数组、3D，多种每块字节数与非 2 的幂尺寸 |
  | B 地址公式 | `nvn_bl_offset()` 的结果与按公开排布规则手算的地址相等 |
  | E 手工 3D | 在手算地址放标记，解排布后核对落点，并核块高、块深与存储尺寸 |
  | C 真数据 | 同一张贴图的 Switch 版（块线性）解排布后与 PC 版（线性）比：同分辨率的逐字节相等；Switch 版降了分辨率的是重新压缩过的，改比解码后的 PSNR（峰值信噪比，衡量两张图有多像）不低于 22 dB。同时核文件里的逐级偏移与 `nvn_tex_level_offset` 一致 |
  | D 负对照 | 故意把块高错一级再解，结果必须不再逐字节相等、PSNR 低于 22 dB，证明 C 组的判据能分辨错误的排布 |

  A 往返只能证明「一一对应、不越界」，证明不了排布公式是对的；真正兜底的是 B 组的手算地址与 C 组同分辨率样本的逐字节相等。

**关于真数据样本**：C、D 两组需要同一张贴图的 Switch 版与 PC 版各一份。`tests/fetch_samples.py` 从你工作区里的游戏文件取样，Switch 版读 `$DM_ROOT/data/switch/3.3.94012/Update/RomFS/data`，PC 版读 `$DM_ROOT/data/assets-src/raw`，输出到 `$DM_ROOT/build/cache/dm/tex_samples`。没有样本时 `t_tex` 的真数据项算失败，不会跳过；A、B、E 三组不需要游戏文件。样本不进仓库。

## 贴图文件头里与排布有关的字段

`t_tex.c` 解析游戏的 `.texture` 文件时用到的事实：

- 文件以 `<DE(` 开头，Switch 版与 PC 版是同一种容器。
- 经过 Switch 转换的文件，偏移 0x14 起的四个字节是 `00 00 00 07`（PC 版为 0），表示像素区是块线性排布；偏移 0x13 是第 0 级块高的 log2，与游戏运行时传给 `SetPackagedTextureLayout` 的布局参数第 0 字节含义相同。
- 没有这个标记的文件是线性存放的，与 PC 版逐字节相同。

## 局限

- `nvn_deswizzle()` 不支持多重采样贴图、带 LINEAR 标志的贴图（本来就是线性的）和 BUFFER 目标，遇到返回 -1。
- 立方体与立方体数组按分层贴图处理，没有单独用真数据核对。
- 3D 贴图只有往返与手算地址的核对，没有真数据样本。
- 16 位打包格式（565 / 5551 / 4444）的分量位序是按格式名对应的，没有用真数据核过，在格式表里标为「替代」。
- 真数据样本集小，覆盖 RGBA8、BC1、BC3、BC4 四种格式。

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Wrap nvn_bctc.metal into nvn_bctc_msl.h (a C string the runtime compiles with newLibraryWithSource).
usage: python3 gen_bctc_msl.py   (run after editing nvn_bctc.metal; the Makefile does not run it)"""
from pathlib import Path
here = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
src = (here / 'nvn_bctc.metal').read_text()
lines = [l.replace('\\', '\\\\').replace('"', '\\"') for l in src.splitlines()]
out = ['// Generated from nvn_bctc.metal by gen_bctc_msl.py -- edit the .metal file, then rerun the script.', '#pragma once',
       'static const char k_bctc_msl[] =']
out += [f'"{l}\\n"' for l in lines]
out[-1] += ';'
(here / 'nvn_bctc_msl.h').write_text('\n'.join(out) + '\n')

`mario-odessy-harmony/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/tex/nvn_bc1astc.c`:

```c
// See nvn_bc1astc.h. ASTC layout used (one partition, 4x4 weight grid, endpoints always 8-bit, so the integer sequence
// encoding is plain bits):
//   bits 0-10   block mode: 0x042 = 2-bit weights, 0x053 = 3-bit weights, 0x441 = dual plane with 1-bit weights
//   bits 11-12  partition count - 1 = 0
//   bits 13-16  colour endpoint mode: 8 = LDR RGB direct, 12 = LDR RGBA direct
//   bits 17-    endpoint values v0, v1, ... (r0 r1 g0 g1 b0 b1 [a0 a1]), 8 bits each
//   top bits    weights, stored bit-reversed from bit 127 down; dual plane: interleaved plane0/plane1 per texel and the
//               2-bit colour component selector (3 = alpha) just below them
// ASTC swaps the endpoints (blue contraction) when the second endpoint's r+g+b is smaller; endpoints are ordered so
// that this never happens, inverting the weights when they are swapped.
#include "nvn_bc1astc.h"
#include <string.h>

static void put(uint8_t *b, unsigned pos, unsigned n, uint32_t v) {
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; i++) if (v >> i & 1) b[(pos + i) >> 3] |= (uint8_t)(1u << ((pos + i) & 7));
}
static void put_weight_bits(uint8_t *b, unsigned pos, unsigned n, uint32_t v) {   // weight stream bit j lives at block bit 127 - j
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; i++) if (v >> i & 1) { unsigned bit = 127 - (pos + i); b[bit >> 3] |= (uint8_t)(1u << (bit & 7)); }
}
static int expand5(int v) { return v << 3 | v >> 2; }
static int expand6(int v) { return v << 2 | v >> 4; }

// Writes the block. e0/e1: RGBA endpoints (alpha used only when cem == 12); w: weights (dual plane: plane 0 then plane 1
// per texel); wbits: bits per weight.
static void emit(uint8_t *out, int cem, int dual, int wbits, int e0[4], int e1[4], int w[32]) {
    int nw = dual ? 32 : 16, wmax = (1 << wbits) - 1;
    if (e1[0] + e1[1] + e1[2] < e0[0] + e0[1] + e0[2]) {   // keep r+g+b of the second endpoint >= the first: no blue contraction
        for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) { int t = e0[c]; e0[c] = e1[c]; e1[c] = t; }
        for (int i = 0; i < nw; i++) w[i] = wmax - w[i];
    }
    memset(out, 0, 16);
    unsigned mode = dual ? 0x441u : wbits == 2 ? 0x042u : 0x053u;
    put(out, 0, 11, mode);
    put(out, 13, 4, (uint32_t)cem);
    unsigned pos = 17;
    int nc = cem == 12 ? 4 : 3;
    for (int c = 0; c < nc; c++) { put(out, pos, 8, (uint32_t)e0[c]); put(out, pos + 8, 8, (uint32_t)e1[c]); pos += 16; }
    for (int i = 0; i < nw; i++) put_weight_bits(out, (unsigned)(i * wbits), (unsigned)wbits, (uint32_t)w[i]);
    if (dual) put(out, 128 - (unsigned)(nw * wbits) - 2, 2, 3u);   // colour component selector: alpha on plane 1
}

static int clamp255(int v) { return v < 0 ? 0 : v > 255 ? 255 : v; }

void nvn_bc1_to_astc(const uint8_t bc[8], uint8_t out[16], int rgba_formats) {
    int c0 = bc[0] | bc[1] << 8, c1 = bc[2] | bc[3] << 8;
    uint32_t ix = (uint32_t)bc[4] | (uint32_t)bc[5] << 8 | (uint32_t)bc[6] << 16 | (uint32_t)bc[7] << 24;
    int p0[3] = {expand5(c0 >> 11), expand6(c0 >> 5 & 63), expand5(c0 & 31)};
    int p1[3] = {expand5(c1 >> 11), expand6(c1 >> 5 & 63), expand5(c1 & 31)};
    int idx[16], used = 0;
    for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) { idx[k] = (int)(ix >> (2 * k) & 3); used |= 1 << idx[k]; }
    int e0[4] = {p0[0], p0[1], p0[2], 255}, e1[4] = {p1[0], p1[1], p1[2], 255}, w[32];
    if (c0 > c1) {   // four colours: c0, c1, 2/3 c0 + 1/3 c1, 1/3 c0 + 2/3 c1  ->  weights 0, 3, 1, 2
        static const int map[4] = {0, 3, 1, 2};
        for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) w[k] = map[idx[k]];
        emit(out, 8, 0, 2, e0, e1, w);
        return;
    }
    if (!(used & 8)) {   // three colours, none transparent: c0, c1, midpoint
        // Weight triple (c0, midpoint, c1) from the 2-bit or 3-bit weight set, endpoints solved so that c0 and c1 land on
        // their weights; the triple and rounding with the smallest squared error over the block's texels wins.
        static const int unq[2][8] = {{0, 21, 43, 64}, {0, 9, 18, 27, 37, 46, 55, 64}};
        int cnt[3] = {0, 0, 0}; for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) cnt[idx[k]]++;
        int mid[3] = {(p0[0] + p1[0] + 1) / 2, (p0[1] + p1[1] + 1) / 2, (p0[2] + p1[2] + 1) / 2};
        long best = -1; int bb = 2, bwa = 0, bwb = 1, bwc = 3, be0[3] = {0}, be1[3] = {0};
        for (int bits = 2; bits <= 3; bits++) {
            int n = 1 << bits; const int *u = unq[bits - 2];
            for (int wa = 0; wa < n; wa++) for (int wb = wa + 1; wb < n; wb++) for (int wc = wb + 1; wc < n; wc++) {
                int f0[3], f1[3], ok = 1; long err = 0;
                for (int c = 0; c < 3 && ok; c++) {
                    // E0 + u[wa]/64 L = c0, E0 + u[wc]/64 L = c1  ->  L = 64 d / (u[wc] - u[wa])
                    int d = p1[c] - p0[c], span = u[wc] - u[wa];
                    int L = (64 * d + (d >= 0 ? span / 2 : -span / 2)) / span;
                    f0[c] = p0[c] - (u[wa] * L + (L >= 0 ? 32 : -32)) / 64; f1[c] = f0[c] + L;
                    if (f0[c] < 0 || f0[c] > 255 || f1[c] < 0 || f1[c] > 255) ok = 0;
                    int want[3] = {p0[c], p1[c], mid[c]}, wt[3] = {u[wa], u[wc], u[wb]};
                    for (int i = 0; ok && i < 3; i++) { int r = ((f0[c] * 257 * (64 - wt[i]) + f1[c] * 257 * wt[i] + 32) >> 6) >> 8; long e = r - want[i]; err += e * e * cnt[i]; }
                }
                if (ok && (best < 0 || err < best)) { best = err; bb = bits; bwa = wa; bwb = wb; bwc = wc; memcpy(be0, f0, sizeof f0); memcpy(be1, f1, sizeof f1); }
            }
        }
        int f0[4] = {be0[0], be0[1], be0[2], 255}, f1[4] = {be1[0], be1[1], be1[2], 255};
        if (best < 0) { memcpy(f0, e0, sizeof f0); memcpy(f1, e1, sizeof f1); bb = 3; bwa = 0; bwb = 3; bwc = 7; }   // cannot happen: (0, *, max) always fits
        const int map[3] = {bwa, bwc, bwb};
        for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) w[k] = map[idx[k]];
        emit(out, 8, 0, bb, f0, f1, w);
        return;
    }
    // Three colours with index 3: transparent black (RGBA formats) or opaque black (RGB formats).
    int pal[4][3] = {{p0[0], p0[1], p0[2]}, {p1[0], p1[1], p1[2]}, {(p0[0] + p1[0] + 1) / 2, (p0[1] + p1[1] + 1) / 2, (p0[2] + p1[2] + 1) / 2}, {0, 0, 0}};
    int colours = used & (rgba_formats ? 7 : 15);   // palette entries the colour plane has to show
    // Two endpoints out of the used colours, chosen for the smallest squared error over the block's texels.
    int best_a = 0, best_b = 1; long best = -1;
    for (int a = 0; a < 4; a++) for (int b = a; b < 4; b++) {
        if (!(colours >> a & 1) || !(colours >> b & 1)) continue;
        long err = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) {
            int i = idx[k]; if (!(colours >> i & 1)) continue;
            long da = 0, db = 0;
            for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) { int x = pal[i][c] - pal[a][c], y = pal[i][c] - pal[b][c]; da += x * x; db += y * y; }
            err += da < db ? da : db;
        }
        if (best < 0 || err < best) { best = err; best_a = a; best_b = b; }
    }
    int f0[4] = {pal[best_a][0], pal[best_a][1], pal[best_a][2], 255}, f1[4] = {pal[best_b][0], pal[best_b][1], pal[best_b][2], rgba_formats ? 0 : 255};
    if (!rgba_formats) f0[3] = 255;
    for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) {
        int i = idx[k], cw = 0;
        if (colours >> i & 1) {
            long da = 0, db = 0;
            for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) { int x = pal[i][c] - f0[c], y = pal[i][c] - f1[c]; da += x * x; db += y * y; }
            cw = db < da;
        }
        w[2 * k] = cw;                                     // plane 0: colour
        w[2 * k + 1] = rgba_formats && i == 3;            // plane 1: alpha (endpoint alpha 255 -> 0)
    }
    if (!rgba_formats) { f1[3] = 255; }
    emit(out, 12, 1, 1, f0, f1, w);
    (void)clamp255;
}

void nvn_bc1_to_astc_image(const uint8_t *src, uint64_t src_pitch, uint32_t bw, uint32_t bh, uint8_t *dst, int rgba_formats) {
    for (uint32_t y = 0; y < bh; y++) for (uint32_t x = 0; x < bw; x++)
        nvn_bc1_to_astc(src + y * src_pitch + x * 8, dst + ((uint64_t)y * bw + x) * 16, rgba_formats);
}

```h
// TOTK: BC1 -> ASTC 4x4 block transcoding for GPUs without BC (A15/A16). Most of TOTK's colour textures are BC1;
// decompressed to RGBA8 they take 8x their size, as ASTC 4x4 2x (a quarter of RGBA8).
//  - four-colour blocks (c0 > c1, 89% in TOTK): RGB direct endpoints, 2-bit weights. The BC1 palette (0, 1/3, 2/3, 1)
//    is exactly the 2-bit ASTC weight set, so these blocks are reproduced to within interpolation rounding.
//  - three-colour blocks without transparent texels: endpoints stretched by 1.5x so that (0, 1/2, 1) land on 2-bit
//    weights (exact up to endpoint rounding); if that would leave 0..255, 3-bit weights approximate the midpoint.
//  - three-colour blocks with transparent texels (index 3 of the RGBA formats): dual-plane RGBA with 1-bit weights;
//    alpha is exact (0 or 255), the opaque colours use the best two of the block's colours.
// The GPU upload path runs the same algorithm in MSL (nvn_mtl.m, k_bc1astc_msl); probe-gpu-bc1astc compares both with a
// reference BC1 decode through Metal's own ASTC decoder.
#pragma once
#include <stdint.h>

// rgba_formats: 1 for the BC1 formats with alpha (index 3 of a three-colour block is transparent black), 0 for RGB-only
// formats (opaque black). Writes one 16-byte ASTC 4x4 block.
void nvn_bc1_to_astc(const uint8_t bc1[8], uint8_t astc[16], int rgba_formats);
// Whole image: rows of BC1 blocks (src_pitch bytes apart) into tightly packed ASTC blocks (bw x bh blocks).
void nvn_bc1_to_astc_image(const uint8_t *src, uint64_t src_pitch, uint32_t bw, uint32_t bh, uint8_t *dst, int rgba_formats);

```

// MSL port of nvn_bc1astc.c (same block layouts, same choices; probe-bc1astc checks the two are byte-identical).
// kernel bc1astc: one thread per 4x4 block. buffer(0) BC1 blocks, buffer(1) parameters, buffer(2) ASTC blocks.
#pragma once
static const char k_bc1astc_msl[] =
"#include <metal_stdlib>\nusing namespace metal;\n"
"struct BP { uint src_off, src_pitch, w, h, rgba, dst_off; };\n"
"static void put(thread uchar *b, uint pos, uint n, uint v) { for (uint i = 0; i < n; i++) if ((v >> i) & 1) b[(pos + i) >> 3] |= uchar(1u << ((pos + i) & 7)); }\n"
"static void putw(thread uchar *b, uint pos, uint n, uint v) { for (uint i = 0; i < n; i++) if ((v >> i) & 1) { uint bit = 127 - (pos + i); b[bit >> 3] |= uchar(1u << (bit & 7)); } }\n"
"static int x5(int v) { return (v << 3) | (v >> 2); }\n"
"static int x6(int v) { return (v << 2) | (v >> 4); }\n"
"static void emit(thread uchar *o, int cem, int dual, int wbits, thread int *e0, thread int *e1, thread int *w) {\n"
"  int nw = dual ? 32 : 16, wmax = (1 << wbits) - 1;\n"
"  if (e1[0] + e1[1] + e1[2] < e0[0] + e0[1] + e0[2]) { for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) { int t = e0[c]; e0[c] = e1[c]; e1[c] = t; } for (int i = 0; i < nw; i++) w[i] = wmax - w[i]; }\n"
"  for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) o[i] = 0;\n"
"  put(o, 0, 11, dual ? 0x441u : (wbits == 2 ? 0x042u : 0x053u)); put(o, 13, 4, uint(cem));\n"
"  uint pos = 17; int nc = cem == 12 ? 4 : 3;\n"
"  for (int c = 0; c < nc; c++) { put(o, pos, 8, uint(e0[c])); put(o, pos + 8, 8, uint(e1[c])); pos += 16; }\n"
"  for (int i = 0; i < nw; i++) putw(o, uint(i * wbits), uint(wbits), uint(w[i]));\n"
"  if (dual) put(o, 128 - uint(nw * wbits) - 2, 2, 3u);\n"
"}\n"
"kernel void bc1astc(device const uchar *src [[buffer(0)]], device const BP &p [[buffer(1)]], device uchar *dst [[buffer(2)]], uint2 g [[thread_position_in_grid]]) {\n"
"  uint bw = (p.w + 3) / 4, bh = (p.h + 3) / 4; if (g.x >= bw || g.y >= bh) return;\n"
"  device const uchar *bc = src + p.src_off + g.y * p.src_pitch + g.x * 8;\n"
"  int c0 = bc[0] | (bc[1] << 8), c1 = bc[2] | (bc[3] << 8); uint ix = uint(bc[4]) | (uint(bc[5]) << 8) | (uint(bc[6]) << 16) | (uint(bc[7]) << 24);\n"
"  int p0[3] = {x5(c0 >> 11), x6((c0 >> 5) & 63), x5(c0 & 31)}, p1[3] = {x5(c1 >> 11), x6((c1 >> 5) & 63), x5(c1 & 31)};\n"
"  int idx[16], used = 0; for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) { idx[k] = int((ix >> (2 * k)) & 3); used |= 1 << idx[k]; }\n"
"  int e0[4] = {p0[0], p0[1], p0[2], 255}, e1[4] = {p1[0], p1[1], p1[2], 255}, w[32]; uchar o[16];\n"
"  if (c0 > c1) { const int map[4] = {0, 3, 1, 2}; for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) w[k] = map[idx[k]]; emit(o, 8, 0, 2, e0, e1, w); }\n"
"  else if (!(used & 8)) {\n"
"    const int unq[2][8] = {{0, 21, 43, 64, 0, 0, 0, 0}, {0, 9, 18, 27, 37, 46, 55, 64}};\n"
"    int cnt[3] = {0, 0, 0}; for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) cnt[idx[k]]++;\n"
"    int mid[3] = {(p0[0] + p1[0] + 1) / 2, (p0[1] + p1[1] + 1) / 2, (p0[2] + p1[2] + 1) / 2};\n"
"    long best = -1; int bb = 2, bwa = 0, bwb = 1, bwc = 3, be0[3] = {0, 0, 0}, be1[3] = {0, 0, 0};\n"
"    for (int bits = 2; bits <= 3; bits++) { int n = 1 << bits;\n"
"      for (int wa = 0; wa < n; wa++) for (int wb = wa + 1; wb < n; wb++) for (int wc = wb + 1; wc < n; wc++) {\n"
"        int f0[3], f1[3]; bool ok = true; long err = 0;\n"
"        for (int c = 0; c < 3 && ok; c++) {\n"
"          int d = p1[c] - p0[c], span = unq[bits - 2][wc] - unq[bits - 2][wa];\n"
"          int L = (64 * d + (d >= 0 ? span / 2 : -span / 2)) / span;\n"
"          f0[c] = p0[c] - (unq[bits - 2][wa] * L + (L >= 0 ? 32 : -32)) / 64; f1[c] = f0[c] + L;\n"
"          if (f0[c] < 0 || f0[c] > 255 || f1[c] < 0 || f1[c] > 255) ok = false;\n"
"          int want[3] = {p0[c], p1[c], mid[c]}, wt[3] = {unq[bits - 2][wa], unq[bits - 2][wc], unq[bits - 2][wb]};\n"
"          for (int i = 0; ok && i < 3; i++) { int r = ((f0[c] * 257 * (64 - wt[i]) + f1[c] * 257 * wt[i] + 32) >> 6) >> 8; long e = r - want[i]; err += e * e * cnt[i]; }\n"
"        }\n"
"        if (ok && (best < 0 || err < best)) { best = err; bb = bits; bwa = wa; bwb = wb; bwc = wc; for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) { be0[c] = f0[c]; be1[c] = f1[c]; } }\n"
"      } }\n"
"    int f0[4] = {be0[0], be0[1], be0[2], 255}, f1[4] = {be1[0], be1[1], be1[2], 255};\n"
"    if (best < 0) { for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) { f0[c] = e0[c]; f1[c] = e1[c]; } bb = 3; bwa = 0; bwb = 3; bwc = 7; }\n"
"    const int map[3] = {bwa, bwc, bwb}; for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) w[k] = map[idx[k]]; emit(o, 8, 0, bb, f0, f1, w);\n"
"  } else {\n"
"    int rgba = int(p.rgba);\n"
"    int pal[4][3] = {{p0[0], p0[1], p0[2]}, {p1[0], p1[1], p1[2]}, {(p0[0] + p1[0] + 1) / 2, (p0[1] + p1[1] + 1) / 2, (p0[2] + p1[2] + 1) / 2}, {0, 0, 0}};\n"
"    int colours = used & (rgba ? 7 : 15); int ba = 0, bb = 1; long best = -1;\n"
"    for (int a = 0; a < 4; a++) for (int b = a; b < 4; b++) {\n"
"      if (!((colours >> a) & 1) || !((colours >> b) & 1)) continue; long err = 0;\n"
"      for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) { int i = idx[k]; if (!((colours >> i) & 1)) continue; long da = 0, db = 0;\n"
"        for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) { int x = pal[i][c] - pal[a][c], y = pal[i][c] - pal[b][c]; da += x * x; db += y * y; } err += da < db ? da : db; }\n"
"      if (best < 0 || err < best) { best = err; ba = a; bb = b; } }\n"
"    int f0[4] = {pal[ba][0], pal[ba][1], pal[ba][2], 255}, f1[4] = {pal[bb][0], pal[bb][1], pal[bb][2], rgba ? 0 : 255};\n"
"    for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) { int i = idx[k], cw = 0;\n"
"      if ((colours >> i) & 1) { long da = 0, db = 0; for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) { int x = pal[i][c] - f0[c], y = pal[i][c] - f1[c]; da += x * x; db += y * y; } cw = db < da ? 1 : 0; }\n"
"      w[2 * k] = cw; w[2 * k + 1] = (rgba && i == 3) ? 1 : 0; }\n"
"    emit(o, 12, 1, 1, f0, f1, w);\n"
"  }\n"
"  device uchar *d = dst + p.dst_off + (g.y * bw + g.x) * 16; for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) d[i] = o[i];\n"
"}\n";

`mario-odessy-harmony/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/tex/nvn_bcdec.c`:

```c
// 见 nvn_bcdec.h。解码用 bcdec（dm/third_party/bcdec，单头文件，MIT / 公有领域）。
// See nvn_bcdec.h. Decoding uses bcdec (dm/third_party/bcdec, single header, MIT / public domain).
#define BCDEC_IMPLEMENTATION
#define BCDEC_BC4BC5_PRECISE   // BC4 / BC5 带有符号版本的接口 | interface with signed variants of BC4 / BC5
#include "../../third_party/bcdec/bcdec.h"
#include "nvn_bcdec.h"
#include <string.h>

enum { R8Unorm = 10, R8Snorm = 12, RG8Unorm = 30, RG8Snorm = 32, RGBA8Unorm = 70, RGBA8Unorm_sRGB = 71, RGBA16Float = 115 };
// NVN：0x41 RGB_DXT1、0x42 RGBA_DXT1、0x43 DXT3、0x44 DXT5、0x45–0x48 同上 sRGB、0x49 / 0x4a BC4 无 / 有符号、0x4b / 0x4c BC5、0x4d / 0x4e BC7（sRGB）、0x4f / 0x50 BC6H 有 / 无符号
// NVN: 0x41 RGB_DXT1, 0x42 RGBA_DXT1, 0x43 DXT3, 0x44 DXT5, 0x45–0x48 the same in sRGB, 0x49 / 0x4a BC4 unsigned / signed, 0x4b / 0x4c BC5, 0x4d / 0x4e BC7 (sRGB), 0x4f / 0x50 BC6H signed / unsigned
int nvn_bc_unpacked(uint32_t f, uint32_t *pf, int *bpp) {
    switch (f) {
    case 0x41: case 0x42: case 0x43: case 0x44: case 0x4d: *pf = RGBA8Unorm; *bpp = 4; return 1;
    case 0x45: case 0x46: case 0x47: case 0x48: case 0x4e: *pf = RGBA8Unorm_sRGB; *bpp = 4; return 1;
    case 0x49: *pf = R8Unorm; *bpp = 1; return 1;
    case 0x4a: *pf = R8Snorm; *bpp = 1; return 1;
    case 0x4b: *pf = RG8Unorm; *bpp = 2; return 1;
    case 0x4c: *pf = RG8Snorm; *bpp = 2; return 1;
    case 0x4f: case 0x50: *pf = RGBA16Float; *bpp = 8; return 1;
    default: return 0;
    }
}

static void block(uint32_t f, const uint8_t *b, uint8_t *o, int op) {   // 一块 → 4×4 像素（o 每行 op 字节） | one block → 4×4 pixels (o has op bytes per row)
    switch (f) {
    case 0x41: case 0x42: case 0x45: case 0x46: bcdec_bc1(b, o, op); break;
    case 0x43: case 0x47: bcdec_bc2(b, o, op); break;
    case 0x44: case 0x48: bcdec_bc3(b, o, op); break;
    case 0x49: bcdec_bc4(b, o, op, 0); break;
    case 0x4a: bcdec_bc4(b, o, op, 1); break;
    case 0x4b: bcdec_bc5(b, o, op, 0); break;
    case 0x4c: bcdec_bc5(b, o, op, 1); break;
    case 0x4d: case 0x4e: bcdec_bc7(b, o, op); break;
    case 0x4f: case 0x50: {   // bcdec 出 RGB 半精度，补 alpha = 1.0 | bcdec outputs RGB half-float; add alpha = 1.0
        uint16_t rgb[16 * 3]; bcdec_bc6h_half(b, rgb, 4 * 3, f == 0x4f);
        for (int y = 0; y < 4; y++) for (int x = 0; x < 4; x++) {
            uint16_t *d = (uint16_t *)(o + y * op) + x * 4; const uint16_t *s = rgb + (y * 4 + x) * 3;
            d[0] = s[0]; d[1] = s[1]; d[2] = s[2]; d[3] = 0x3c00;
        }
        break; }
    }
}

int nvn_bc_decode(uint32_t f, const uint8_t *src, size_t pitch, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint8_t *dst, size_t dpitch) {
    uint32_t pf; int bpp; if (!nvn_bc_unpacked(f, &pf, &bpp)) return -1;
    int bb = (f == 0x41 || f == 0x42 || f == 0x45 || f == 0x46 || f == 0x49 || f == 0x4a) ? 8 : 16;   // 每块字节 | bytes per block
    uint8_t tmp[4 * 4 * 8];
    for (uint32_t by = 0; by * 4 < h; by++) for (uint32_t bx = 0; bx * 4 < w; bx++) {
        const uint8_t *b = src + by * pitch + bx * bb;
        uint32_t cw = w - bx * 4 < 4 ? w - bx * 4 : 4, ch = h - by * 4 < 4 ? h - by * 4 : 4;
        uint8_t *o = dst + (size_t)by * 4 * dpitch + (size_t)bx * 4 * bpp;
        if (cw == 4 && ch == 4) { block(f, b, o, (int)dpitch); continue; }
        block(f, b, tmp, 4 * bpp);   // 边上不满 4×4 的块：先解到临时块再拷需要的部分 | blocks at the edge that are not a full 4×4: decode into a temporary block first, then copy the needed part
        for (uint32_t y = 0; y < ch; y++) memcpy(o + y * dpitch, tmp + y * 4 * bpp, cw * bpp);
    }
    return 0;
}

`mario-odessy-harmony/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/tex/nvn_bcdec.h`:

```h
// 不支持 BC 压缩格式的显卡（A15 / A16 等，苹果 GPU 族 Apple8 及以下）：BC 贴图在 CPU 上解压成不压缩格式。
// 游戏贴图里的 BC3 由老机型补充包离线换成 ASTC（dm/tools/astc_pack.py）；剩下的 BC（精灵图里的 BC3、少量 BC1 / BC4 / BC5 / BC6H）走这里。
// GPUs without BC compressed format support (A15 / A16 etc., Apple GPU family Apple8 and below): BC textures are decompressed on the CPU into uncompressed formats.
// BC3 in game textures is converted offline to ASTC by the Legacy Device Pack (dm/tools/astc_pack.py); the remaining BC (BC3 in sprites, a few BC1 / BC4 / BC5 / BC6H) goes through here.
#pragma once
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

// NVN 格式是 BC → 返回 1，*mtl_pf = 解压后的 Metal 像素格式、*bpp = 解压后每像素字节；不是 BC 返回 0
// NVN format is BC → returns 1, *mtl_pf = Metal pixel format after decompression, *bpp = bytes per pixel after decompression; returns 0 if not BC
int nvn_bc_unpacked(uint32_t nvn_fmt, uint32_t *mtl_pf, int *bpp);
// 解一片 w×h 像素：src 按块行排（每块行 pitch 字节），dst 每像素行 dpitch 字节。成功 0
// Decode a w×h pixel region: src is laid out by block rows (pitch bytes per block row), dst has dpitch bytes per pixel row. Returns 0 on success

static ulong ld64(device const uchar *b) { ulong v = 0; for (int i = 7; i >= 0; i--) v = (v << 8) | ulong(b[i]); return v; }

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- decoders (texel k = y * 4 + x)
static int x5(int v) { return (v << 3) | (v >> 2); }
static int x6(int v) { return (v << 2) | (v >> 4); }
static void dec_color4(device const uchar *b, thread int4 *px) {   // BC2/BC3 colour block: always the four-colour palette
  int c0 = b[0] | (b[1] << 8), c1 = b[2] | (b[3] << 8);
  int3 p0 = int3(x5(c0 >> 11), x6((c0 >> 5) & 63), x5(c0 & 31)), p1 = int3(x5(c1 >> 11), x6((c1 >> 5) & 63), x5(c1 & 31));
  int3 pal[4] = {p0, p1, (2 * p0 + p1 + 1) / 3, (p0 + 2 * p1 + 1) / 3};
  uint ix = uint(b[4]) | (uint(b[5]) << 8) | (uint(b[6]) << 16) | (uint(b[7]) << 24);
  for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) { int3 c = pal[(ix >> (2 * k)) & 3]; px[k].xyz = c; }
}
// BC4 palette scaled by 2047 / 255 (fractions kept), for the EAC encoder; also the BC3 alpha (0..255 via >> 3 scaling)
static void dec_bc4(device const uchar *b, thread float *v, float scale) {
  int a0 = b[0], a1 = b[1]; float pal[8]; pal[0] = a0; pal[1] = a1;
  if (a0 > a1) for (int k = 2; k < 8; k++) pal[k] = (float((8 - k) * a0 + (k - 1) * a1)) / 7.0f;
  else { for (int k = 2; k < 6; k++) pal[k] = (float((6 - k) * a0 + (k - 1) * a1)) / 5.0f; pal[6] = 0; pal[7] = 255; }
  ulong ix = 0; for (int i = 7; i >= 2; i--) ix = (ix << 8) | ulong(b[i]);
  for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) v[k] = pal[(ix >> (3 * k)) & 7] * scale;
}
struct BS { ulong lo, hi; };
static int rd(thread BS &s, int n) {
  ulong m = (1ul << n) - 1; int r = int(s.lo & m);
  s.lo = (s.lo >> n) | ((s.hi & m) << (64 - n)); s.hi >>= n; return r;
}
static int interp(int a, int b, int w) { return (a * (64 - w) + b * w + 32) >> 6; }
static int wt(int bits, int i) { return bits == 2 ? w2u[i] : bits == 3 ? w3u[i] : w4u[i]; }
static void dec_bc7(device const uchar *blk, thread int4 *px) {   // port of bcdec_bc7
  BS s; s.lo = ld64(blk); s.hi = ld64(blk + 8);
  int mode = 0; while (mode < 8 && rd(s, 1) == 0) mode++;
  if (mode >= 8) { for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) px[k] = int4(0); return; }
  const int cbits[8] = {4, 6, 5, 7, 5, 7, 7, 5}, abits[8] = {0, 0, 0, 0, 6, 8, 7, 5};
  const int pbm = 0xCB;   // modes with p-bits
  int np = 1, part = 0, rot = 0, isb = 0;
  if (mode == 0 || mode == 1 || mode == 2 || mode == 3 || mode == 7) { np = (mode == 0 || mode == 2) ? 3 : 2; part = rd(s, mode == 0 ? 4 : 6); }
  int ne = np * 2;
  if (mode == 4 || mode == 5) { rot = rd(s, 2); if (mode == 4) isb = rd(s, 1); }
  int ep[6][4];
  for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) ep[j][c] = 0;
  for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) for (int j = 0; j < ne; j++) ep[j][c] = rd(s, cbits[mode]);
  if (abits[mode]) for (int j = 0; j < ne; j++) ep[j][3] = rd(s, abits[mode]);
  if (mode == 0 || mode == 1 || mode == 3 || mode == 6 || mode == 7) {
    for (int j = 0; j < ne; j++) for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) ep[j][c] <<= 1;
    if (mode == 1) { int i0 = rd(s, 1), j0 = rd(s, 1); for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) { ep[0][c] |= i0; ep[1][c] |= i0; ep[2][c] |= j0; ep[3][c] |= j0; } }
    else if ((pbm >> mode) & 1) for (int j = 0; j < ne; j++) { int p = rd(s, 1); for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) ep[j][c] |= p; }
  }
  for (int j = 0; j < ne; j++) {
    int n = cbits[mode] + ((pbm >> mode) & 1);
    for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) { int e = ep[j][c] << (8 - n); ep[j][c] = (e | (e >> n)) & 255; }
    n = abits[mode] + ((pbm >> mode) & 1);
    if (n > 0) { int e = ep[j][3] << (8 - n); ep[j][3] = (e | (e >> n)) & 255; }
  }
  if (!abits[mode]) for (int j = 0; j < ne; j++) ep[j][3] = 255;
  int ib = (mode == 0 || mode == 1) ? 3 : (mode == 6 ? 4 : 2), ib2 = mode == 4 ? 3 : (mode == 5 ? 2 : 0);
  int idx[16], sub[16];
  for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) {
    int ps = np == 1 ? (k ? 0 : 128) : int(bc7_part[(np - 2) * 64 + part][k]);
    sub[k] = ps & 3; idx[k] = rd(s, ib - ((ps & 0x80) ? 1 : 0));
  }
  for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) {
    int e = sub[k] * 2, r, g, b, a;
    if (!ib2) {
      r = interp(ep[e][0], ep[e + 1][0], wt(ib, idx[k])); g = interp(ep[e][1], ep[e + 1][1], wt(ib, idx[k]));
      b = interp(ep[e][2], ep[e + 1][2], wt(ib, idx[k])); a = interp(ep[e][3], ep[e + 1][3], wt(ib, idx[k]));
    } else {
      int i2 = rd(s, k ? ib2 : ib2 - 1);
      if (!isb) {
        r = interp(ep[e][0], ep[e + 1][0], wt(ib, idx[k])); g = interp(ep[e][1], ep[e + 1][1], wt(ib, idx[k]));
        b = interp(ep[e][2], ep[e + 1][2], wt(ib, idx[k])); a = interp(ep[e][3], ep[e + 1][3], wt(ib2, i2));
      } else {
        r = interp(ep[e][0], ep[e + 1][0], wt(ib2, i2)); g = interp(ep[e][1], ep[e + 1][1], wt(ib2, i2));
        b = interp(ep[e][2], ep[e + 1][2], wt(ib2, i2)); a = interp(ep[e][3], ep[e + 1][3], wt(ib, idx[k]));
      }
    }
    if (rot == 1) { int t = a; a = r; r = t; } else if (rot == 2) { int t = a; a = g; g = t; } else if (rot == 3) { int t = a; a = b; b = t; }
    px[k] = int4(r, g, b, a);
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- ASTC encoder
static void put(thread uchar *o, uint pos, uint n, uint v) { for (uint i = 0; i < n; i++) if ((v >> i) & 1) o[(pos + i) >> 3] |= uchar(1u << ((pos + i) & 7)); }
static void putw(thread uchar *o, uint pos, uint n, uint v) { for (uint i = 0; i < n; i++) if ((v >> i) & 1) { uint bit = 127 - (pos + i); o[bit >> 3] |= uchar(1u << (bit & 7)); } }
static int unq48(int v) {   // colour endpoint unquantisation, range 48 (trit + 4 bits dcba): B = dcb000dcb, C = 22
  int t = v >> 4, m = v & 15, a = (m & 1) ? 0x1FF : 0, bb = (m >> 1) & 1, cc = (m >> 2) & 1, dd = (m >> 3) & 1;
  int B = (dd << 8) | (cc << 7) | (bb << 6) | (dd << 2) | (cc << 1) | bb;
  int T = t * 22 + B; T ^= a; return (a & 0x80) | (T >> 2);
}
static int q48(int x) { int best = 0, be = 1 << 20; for (int v = 0; v < 48; v++) { int d = unq48(v) - x; d *= d; if (d < be) { be = d; best = v; } } return best; }
// principal axis of the block's colours (or of all four channels, c4) by power iteration; returns the mean
static float4 fit_axis(thread const float4 *p, int c4, thread float4 &axis) {
  float4 mean = 0; for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) mean += p[k]; mean /= 16.0f;
  if (!c4) mean.w = 0;
  float m[4][4]; for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) m[i][j] = 0;
  for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) { float4 d = p[k] - mean; if (!c4) d.w = 0; for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) m[i][j] += d[i] * d[j]; }
  float4 v = float4(1, 1, 1, c4 ? 1 : 0); float mx = 0;
  for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) if (m[i][i] > mx) { mx = m[i][i]; v = float4(0); v[i] = 1; }
  for (int it = 0; it < 8; it++) { float4 n = 0; for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) n[i] += m[i][j] * v[j]; float l = length(n); if (l < 1e-6f) break; v = n / l; }
  axis = v; return mean;
}
// endpoints along the axis, then one least-squares refit for the chosen weights; nch channels starting at ch0
static void fit_line(thread const float4 *p, int ch0, int nch, int wbits, thread float4 &e0, thread float4 &e1) {
  float4 axis; float4 sel = 0; for (int c = ch0; c < ch0 + nch; c++) sel[c] = 1;
  float4 q[16]; for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) q[k] = p[k] * sel;
  float4 mean = fit_axis(q, nch == 4 || ch0 == 3, axis); axis *= sel; mean *= sel;
  float lo = 1e9f, hi = -1e9f; for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) { float t = dot(q[k] - mean, axis); lo = min(lo, t); hi = max(hi, t); }
  e0 = mean + axis * lo; e1 = mean + axis * hi;
  int n = 1 << wbits;
  for (int iter = 0; iter < 2; iter++) {   // assign weights on the line, refit the endpoints
    float4 d = e1 - e0; float dd = dot(d, d);
    float a00 = 0, a01 = 0, a11 = 0; float4 b0 = 0, b1 = 0;
    for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) {
      float t = dd > 1e-6f ? clamp(dot(q[k] - e0, d) / dd, 0.0f, 1.0f) : 0; float w = round(t * (n - 1)) / (n - 1);
      a00 += (1 - w) * (1 - w); a01 += (1 - w) * w; a11 += w * w; b0 += (1 - w) * q[k]; b1 += w * q[k];
    }
    float det = a00 * a11 - a01 * a01;
    if (fabs(det) < 1e-6f) break;
    e0 = (b0 * a11 - b1 * a01) / det; e1 = (b1 * a00 - b0 * a01) / det;
  }
  e0 = clamp(e0, 0.0f, 255.0f) * sel; e1 = clamp(e1, 0.0f, 255.0f) * sel;
}
// best weight per texel for the (unquantised) integer endpoints over channels ch0..ch0+nch-1
static void pick_weights(thread const int4 *px, int ch0, int nch, int wbits, int4 E0, int4 E1, thread int *w, int stride, int off) {
  int n = 1 << wbits;
  for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) {
    int best = 0, be = 1 << 30;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      int u = wt(wbits, i), e = 0;
      for (int c = ch0; c < ch0 + nch; c++) { int d = interp(E0[c], E1[c], u) - px[k][c]; e += d * d; }
      if (e < be) { be = e; best = i; }
    }
    w[k * stride + off] = best;
  }
}
static void astc_encode(thread const int4 *px, thread uchar *o) {
  for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) o[i] = 0;
  int amin = 255, amax = 0; for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) { amin = min(amin, px[k].w); amax = max(amax, px[k].w); }
  float4 p[16]; for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) p[k] = float4(px[k]);
  int w[32];
  if (amin == amax) {   // single plane
    int opaque = amin == 255, wbits = opaque ? 3 : 2, cem = opaque ? 8 : 12;
    float4 f0, f1; fit_line(p, 0, 3, wbits, f0, f1);
    int4 E0 = int4(round(f0)), E1 = int4(round(f1)); E0.w = E1.w = amin;
    if (E1.x + E1.y + E1.z < E0.x + E0.y + E0.z) { int4 t = E0; E0 = E1; E1 = t; }   // no blue contraction
    pick_weights(px, 0, 3, wbits, E0, E1, w, 1, 0);
    put(o, 0, 11, opaque ? 0x053u : 0x042u); put(o, 13, 4, uint(cem));
    uint pos = 17; int nc = opaque ? 3 : 4;
    for (int c = 0; c < nc; c++) { put(o, pos, 8, uint(E0[c])); put(o, pos + 8, 8, uint(E1[c])); pos += 16; }
    for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) putw(o, uint(k * wbits), uint(wbits), uint(w[k]));
    return;
  }
  // dual plane: RGB on plane 0, alpha on plane 1; endpoints in the 48-level range
  float4 f0, f1, g0, g1; fit_line(p, 0, 3, 2, f0, f1); fit_line(p, 3, 1, 2, g0, g1);   // colour line, alpha line (least squares)
  if (g0.w > g1.w) { float4 t = g0; g0 = g1; g1 = t; }
  int v[8] = {q48(int(round(f0.x))), q48(int(round(f1.x))), q48(int(round(f0.y))), q48(int(round(f1.y))),
              q48(int(round(f0.z))), q48(int(round(f1.z))), q48(int(round(g0.w))), q48(int(round(g1.w)))};
  int4 E0 = int4(unq48(v[0]), unq48(v[2]), unq48(v[4]), unq48(v[6])), E1 = int4(unq48(v[1]), unq48(v[3]), unq48(v[5]), unq48(v[7]));
  if (E1.x + E1.y + E1.z < E0.x + E0.y + E0.z) {   // decoder would swap (and blue-contract): swap all four channels ourselves
    for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) { int t = v[2 * c]; v[2 * c] = v[2 * c + 1]; v[2 * c + 1] = t; }
    int4 t = E0; E0 = E1; E1 = t;
  }
  pick_weights(px, 0, 3, 2, E0, E1, w, 2, 0);
  pick_weights(px, 3, 1, 2, E0, E1, w, 2, 1);
  put(o, 0, 11, 0x442u); put(o, 13, 4, 12u);
  // ISE: values 0-4 then 5-7 (trits padded with 0); per block m0 T[1:0] m1 T[3:2] m2 T[4] m3 T[6:5] m4 T[7]
  uint pos = 17;
  for (int blk = 0; blk < 2; blk++) {
    int b0 = blk * 5, cnt = blk ? 3 : 5, t[5] = {0, 0, 0, 0, 0}, m[5] = {0, 0, 0, 0, 0};
    for (int i = 0; i < cnt; i++) { t[i] = v[b0 + i] >> 4; m[i] = v[b0 + i] & 15; }
    uint T = trit_enc[t[0] + 3 * t[1] + 9 * t[2] + 27 * t[3] + 81 * t[4]];
    const int tb[5] = {2, 2, 1, 2, 1}; int ts = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < cnt; i++) { put(o, pos, 4, uint(m[i])); pos += 4; put(o, pos, uint(tb[i]), (T >> ts) & ((1u << tb[i]) - 1)); pos += uint(tb[i]); ts += tb[i]; }
  }
  for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) putw(o, uint(i * 2), 2u, uint(w[i]));
  put(o, 128 - 64 - 2, 2, 3u);   // colour component selector: alpha on plane 1
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- EAC R11 encoder (targets in 0..2047)
static int eac_dec(int base, int mul, int tab, int i) {
  int mod = eac_mod[tab][i]; int v = base * 8 + 4 + (mul ? mod * mul * 8 : mod); return clamp(v, 0, 2047);
}
static void eac_encode(thread const float *t, thread uchar *o) {
  float mn = 2047, mx = 0; for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) { mn = min(mn, t[k]); mx = max(mx, t[k]); }
  float best = 1e30f; int bb = 0, bm = 1, bt = 0;
  for (int tab = 0; tab < 16; tab++) {
    int lo = eac_mod[tab][3], hi = eac_mod[tab][7];
    float me = (mx - mn) / (8.0f * float(hi - lo));
    int m0 = clamp(int(floor(me)), 1, 15);
    for (int mul = max(m0 - 1, 1); mul <= min(m0 + 2, 15); mul++) {
      float be = ((mx + mn) * 0.5f - 4.0f - float(mul * 8) * float(lo + hi) * 0.5f) / 8.0f;
      int b0 = clamp(int(round(be)), 0, 255);
      for (int base = max(b0 - 1, 0); base <= min(b0 + 1, 255); base++) {
        float err = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < 16 && err < best; k++) { float e = 1e30f; for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) { float d = float(eac_dec(base, mul, tab, i)) - t[k]; e = min(e, d * d); } err += e; }
        if (err < best) { best = err; bb = base; bm = mul; bt = tab; }
      }
    }
  }
  ulong bits = (ulong(bb) << 56) | (ulong(bm) << 52) | (ulong(bt) << 48);
  for (int x = 0; x < 4; x++) for (int y = 0; y < 4; y++) {
    float tk = t[y * 4 + x]; int bi = 0; float e = 1e30f;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) { float d = float(eac_dec(bb, bm, bt, i)) - tk; if (d * d < e) { e = d * d; bi = i; } }
    bits |= ulong(bi) << (45 - 3 * (x * 4 + y));
  }
  for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) o[i] = uchar(bits >> (56 - 8 * i));   // big-endian
}

kernel void bctc(device const uchar *src [[buffer(0)]], device const TP &p [[buffer(1)]], device uchar *dst [[buffer(2)]], uint2 g [[thread_position_in_grid]]) {
  uint bw = (p.w + 3) / 4, bh = (p.h + 3) / 4; if (g.x >= bw || g.y >= bh) return;
  uint f = p.fmt & 0xff, raw = p.fmt & 0x100;
  int sbytes = (f == 0x49) ? 8 : 16;
  device const uchar *b = src + p.src_off + g.y * p.src_pitch + g.x * uint(sbytes);
  uchar o[16]; for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) o[i] = 0;
  int obytes = 16;
  if (f == 0x49 || f == 0x4b) {   // BC4 / BC5 unsigned -> EAC R11 / RG11
    float t[16];
    dec_bc4(b, t, 2047.0f / 255.0f); eac_encode(t, o);
    if (f == 0x49) obytes = 8;
    else { uchar o2[16]; dec_bc4(b + 8, t, 2047.0f / 255.0f); eac_encode(t, o2); for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) o[8 + i] = o2[i]; }
  } else {
    int4 px[16];
    if (f == 0x4d || f == 0x4e) dec_bc7(b, px);
    else {
      dec_color4(b + 8, px);
      if (f == 0x43 || f == 0x47) { for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) { int a = (b[k >> 1] >> ((k & 1) * 4)) & 15; px[k].w = a * 17; } }   // BC2: explicit 4-bit alpha
      else { float a[16]; dec_bc4(b, a, 1.0f); for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) px[k].w = int(a[k] + 0.5f); }
    }
    if (raw) {   // probe: decoded texels, 64 bytes per block
      device uchar *d = dst + p.dst_off + (g.y * bw + g.x) * 64;
      for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) { d[4 * k] = uchar(px[k].x); d[4 * k + 1] = uchar(px[k].y); d[4 * k + 2] = uchar(px[k].z); d[4 * k + 3] = uchar(px[k].w); }
      return;
    }
    astc_encode(px, o);
  }
  device uchar *d = dst + p.dst_off + (g.y * bw + g.x) * uint(obytes);
  for (int i = 0; i < obytes; i++) d[i] = o[i];
}

```

"constant uchar trit_enc[243] = {   // ASTC trit-block encoding: index t0 + 3 t1 + 9 t2 + 27 t3 + 81 t4 -> 8 packed bits\n"
"  0,1,2,4,5,6,8,9,10,16,17,18,20,21,22,24,25,26,3,7,11,19,23,27,12,13,14,32,33,34,36,37,38,40,41,42,48,49,50,52,53,54,56,57,58,35,39,43,51,55,59,44,45,46,64,65,66,68,69,70,72,73,74,80,81,82,84,85,86,88,89,90,67,71,75,83,87,91,76,77,78,128,129,130,132,133,134,136,137,138,144,145,146,148,149,150,152,153,154,131,135,139,147,151,155,140,141,142,160,161,162,164,165,166,168,169,170,176,177,178,180,181,182,184,185,186,163,167,171,179,183,187,172,173,174,192,193,194,196,197,198,200,201,202,208,209,210,212,213,214,216,217,218,195,199,203,211,215,219,204,205,206,96,97,98,100,101,102,104,105,106,112,113,114,116,117,118,120,121,122,99,103,107,115,119,123,108,109,110,224,225,226,228,229,230,232,233,234,240,241,242,244,245,246,248,249,250,227,231,235,243,247,251,236,237,238,28,29,30,60,61,62,92,93,94,156,157,158,188,189,190,220,221,222,31,63,95,159,191,223,124,125,126\n"

"constant int eac_mod[16][8] = {\n"
"  {-3,-6,-9,-15,2,5,8,14}, {-3,-7,-10,-13,2,6,9,12}, {-2,-5,-8,-13,1,4,7,12}, {-2,-4,-6,-13,1,3,5,12},\n"
"  {-3,-6,-8,-12,2,5,7,11}, {-3,-7,-9,-11,2,6,8,10}, {-4,-7,-8,-11,3,6,7,10}, {-3,-5,-8,-11,2,4,7,10},\n"
"  {-2,-6,-8,-10,1,5,7,9},  {-2,-5,-8,-10,1,4,7,9},  {-2,-4,-8,-10,1,3,7,9},  {-2,-5,-7,-10,1,4,6,9},\n"
"  {-3,-4,-7,-10,2,3,6,9},  {-1,-2,-3,-10,0,1,2,9},  {-4,-6,-8,-9,3,5,7,8},   {-3,-5,-7,-9,2,4,6,8}};\n"
"constant int w2u[4] = {0, 21, 43, 64};\n"
"constant int w3u[8] = {0, 9, 18, 27, 37, 46, 55, 64};\n"
"constant int w4u[16] = {0, 4, 9, 13, 17, 21, 26, 30, 34, 38, 43, 47, 51, 55, 60, 64};\n"
"\n"
"static ulong ld64(device const uchar *b) { ulong v = 0; for (int i = 7; i >= 0; i--) v = (v << 8) | ulong(b[i]); return v; }\n"
"\n"
"// ---------------------------------------------------------------- decoders (texel k = y * 4 + x)\n"
"static int x5(int v) { return (v << 3) | (v >> 2); }\n"
"static int x6(int v) { return (v << 2) | (v >> 4); }\n"
"static void dec_color4(device const uchar *b, thread int4 *px) {   // BC2/BC3 colour block: always the four-colour palette\n"
"  int c0 = b[0] | (b[1] << 8), c1 = b[2] | (b[3] << 8);\n"
"  int3 p0 = int3(x5(c0 >> 11), x6((c0 >> 5) & 63), x5(c0 & 31)), p1 = int3(x5(c1 >> 11), x6((c1 >> 5) & 63), x5(c1 & 31));\n"
"  int3 pal[4] = {p0, p1, (2 * p0 + p1 + 1) / 3, (p0 + 2 * p1 + 1) / 3};\n"
"  uint ix = uint(b[4]) | (uint(b[5]) << 8) | (uint(b[6]) << 16) | (uint(b[7]) << 24);\n"
"  for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) { int3 c = pal[(ix >> (2 * k)) & 3]; px[k].xyz = c; }\n"
"}\n"
"// BC4 palette scaled by 2047 / 255 (fractions kept), for the EAC encoder; also the BC3 alpha (0..255 via >> 3 scaling)\n"
"static void dec_bc4(device const uchar *b, thread float *v, float scale) {\n"
"  int a0 = b[0], a1 = b[1]; float pal[8]; pal[0] = a0; pal[1] = a1;\n"
"  if (a0 > a1) for (int k = 2; k < 8; k++) pal[k] = (float((8 - k) * a0 + (k - 1) * a1)) / 7.0f;\n"
"  else { for (int k = 2; k < 6; k++) pal[k] = (float((6 - k) * a0 + (k - 1) * a1)) / 5.0f; pal[6] = 0; pal[7] = 255; }\n"
"  ulong ix = 0; for (int i = 7; i >= 2; i--) ix = (ix << 8) | ulong(b[i]);\n"
"  for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) v[k] = pal[(ix >> (3 * k)) & 7] * scale;\n"
"}\n"
"struct BS { ulong lo, hi; };\n"
"static int rd(thread BS &s, int n) {\n"
"  ulong m = (1ul << n) - 1; int r = int(s.lo & m);\n"
"  s.lo = (s.lo >> n) | ((s.hi & m) << (64 - n)); s.hi >>= n; return r;\n"
"}\n"
"static int interp(int a, int b, int w) { return (a * (64 - w) + b * w + 32) >> 6; }\n"
"static int wt(int bits, int i) { return bits == 2 ? w2u[i] : bits == 3 ? w3u[i] : w4u[i]; }\n"
"static void dec_bc7(device const uchar *blk, thread int4 *px) {   // port of bcdec_bc7\n"
"  BS s; s.lo = ld64(blk); s.hi = ld64(blk + 8);\n"
"  int mode = 0; while (mode < 8 && rd(s, 1) == 0) mode++;\n"
"  if (mode >= 8) { for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) px[k] = int4(0); return; }\n"
"  const int cbits[8] = {4, 6, 5, 7, 5, 7, 7, 5}, abits[8] = {0, 0, 0, 0, 6, 8, 7, 5};\n"
"  const int pbm = 0xCB;   // modes with p-bits\n"
"  int np = 1, part = 0, rot = 0, isb = 0;\n"
"  if (mode == 0 || mode == 1 || mode == 2 || mode == 3 || mode == 7) { np = (mode == 0 || mode == 2) ? 3 : 2; part = rd(s, mode == 0 ? 4 : 6); }\n"
"  int ne = np * 2;\n"
"  if (mode == 4 || mode == 5) { rot = rd(s, 2); if (mode == 4) isb = rd(s, 1); }\n"
"  int ep[6][4];\n"
"  for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++) for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) ep[j][c] = 0;\n"
"  for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) for (int j = 0; j < ne; j++) ep[j][c] = rd(s, cbits[mode]);\n"
"  if (abits[mode]) for (int j = 0; j < ne; j++) ep[j][3] = rd(s, abits[mode]);\n"
"  if (mode == 0 || mode == 1 || mode == 3 || mode == 6 || mode == 7) {\n"
"    for (int j = 0; j < ne; j++) for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) ep[j][c] <<= 1;\n"
"    if (mode == 1) { int i0 = rd(s, 1), j0 = rd(s, 1); for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) { ep[0][c] |= i0; ep[1][c] |= i0; ep[2][c] |= j0; ep[3][c] |= j0; } }\n"
"    else if ((pbm >> mode) & 1) for (int j = 0; j < ne; j++) { int p = rd(s, 1); for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) ep[j][c] |= p; }\n"
"  }\n"
"  for (int j = 0; j < ne; j++) {\n"
"    int n = cbits[mode] + ((pbm >> mode) & 1);\n"
"    for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) { int e = ep[j][c] << (8 - n); ep[j][c] = (e | (e >> n)) & 255; }\n"
"    n = abits[mode] + ((pbm >> mode) & 1);\n"
"    if (n > 0) { int e = ep[j][3] << (8 - n); ep[j][3] = (e | (e >> n)) & 255; }\n"
"  }\n"
"  if (!abits[mode]) for (int j = 0; j < ne; j++) ep[j][3] = 255;\n"
"  int ib = (mode == 0 || mode == 1) ? 3 : (mode == 6 ? 4 : 2), ib2 = mode == 4 ? 3 : (mode == 5 ? 2 : 0);\n"
"  int idx[16], sub[16];\n"
"  for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) {\n"
"    int ps = np == 1 ? (k ? 0 : 128) : int(bc7_part[(np - 2) * 64 + part][k]);\n"
"    sub[k] = ps & 3; idx[k] = rd(s, ib - ((ps & 0x80) ? 1 : 0));\n"
"  }\n"
"  for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) {\n"
"    int e = sub[k] * 2, r, g, b, a;\n"
"    if (!ib2) {\n"
"      r = interp(ep[e][0], ep[e + 1][0], wt(ib, idx[k])); g = interp(ep[e][1], ep[e + 1][1], wt(ib, idx[k]));\n"
"      b = interp(ep[e][2], ep[e + 1][2], wt(ib, idx[k])); a = interp(ep[e][3], ep[e + 1][3], wt(ib, idx[k]));\n"
"    } else {\n"
"      int i2 = rd(s, k ? ib2 : ib2 - 1);\n"
"      if (!isb) {\n"
"        r = interp(ep[e][0], ep[e + 1][0], wt(ib, idx[k])); g = interp(ep[e][1], ep[e + 1][1], wt(ib, idx[k]));\n"
"        b = interp(ep[e][2], ep[e + 1][2], wt(ib, idx[k])); a = interp(ep[e][3], ep[e + 1][3], wt(ib2, i2));\n"
"      } else {\n"
"        r = interp(ep[e][0], ep[e + 1][0], wt(ib2, i2)); g = interp(ep[e][1], ep[e + 1][1], wt(ib2, i2));\n"
"        b = interp(ep[e][2], ep[e + 1][2], wt(ib2, i2)); a = interp(ep[e][3], ep[e + 1][3], wt(ib, idx[k]));\n"
"      }\n"
"    }\n"
"    if (rot == 1) { int t = a; a = r; r = t; } else if (rot == 2) { int t = a; a = g; g = t; } else if (rot == 3) { int t = a; a = b; b = t; }\n"
"    px[k] = int4(r, g, b, a);\n"
"  }\n"
"}\n"
"\n"
"// ---------------------------------------------------------------- ASTC encoder\n"
"static void put(thread uchar *o, uint pos, uint n, uint v) { for (uint i = 0; i < n; i++) if ((v >> i) & 1) o[(pos + i) >> 3] |= uchar(1u << ((pos + i) & 7)); }\n"
"static void putw(thread uchar *o, uint pos, uint n, uint v) { for (uint i = 0; i < n; i++) if ((v >> i) & 1) { uint bit = 127 - (pos + i); o[bit >> 3] |= uchar(1u << (bit & 7)); } }\n"
"static int unq48(int v) {   // colour endpoint unquantisation, range 48 (trit + 4 bits dcba): B = dcb000dcb, C = 22\n"
"  int t = v >> 4, m = v & 15, a = (m & 1) ? 0x1FF : 0, bb = (m >> 1) & 1, cc = (m >> 2) & 1, dd = (m >> 3) & 1;\n"
"  int B = (dd << 8) | (cc << 7) | (bb << 6) | (dd << 2) | (cc << 1) | bb;\n"
"  int T = t * 22 + B; T ^= a; return (a & 0x80) | (T >> 2);\n"
"}\n"
"static int q48(int x) { int best = 0, be = 1 << 20; for (int v = 0; v < 48; v++) { int d = unq48(v) - x; d *= d; if (d < be) { be = d; best = v; } } return best; }\n"
"// principal axis of the block's colours (or of all four channels, c4) by power iteration; returns the mean\n"
"static float4 fit_axis(thread const float4 *p, int c4, thread float4 &axis) {\n"
"  float4 mean = 0; for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) mean += p[k]; mean /= 16.0f;\n"
"  if (!c4) mean.w = 0;\n"
"  float m[4][4]; for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) m[i][j] = 0;\n"
"  for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) { float4 d = p[k] - mean; if (!c4) d.w = 0; for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) m[i][j] += d[i] * d[j]; }\n"
"  float4 v = float4(1, 1, 1, c4 ? 1 : 0); float mx = 0;\n"
"  for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) if (m[i][i] > mx) { mx = m[i][i]; v = float4(0); v[i] = 1; }\n"
"  for (int it = 0; it < 8; it++) { float4 n = 0; for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) n[i] += m[i][j] * v[j]; float l = length(n); if (l < 1e-6f) break; v = n / l; }\n"
"  axis = v; return mean;\n"
"}\n"
"// endpoints along the axis, then one least-squares refit for the chosen weights; nch channels starting at ch0\n"
"static void fit_line(thread const float4 *p, int ch0, int nch, int wbits, thread float4 &e0, thread float4 &e1) {\n"
"  float4 axis; float4 sel = 0; for (int c = ch0; c < ch0 + nch; c++) sel[c] = 1;\n"
"  float4 q[16]; for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) q[k] = p[k] * sel;\n"
"  float4 mean = fit_axis(q, nch == 4 || ch0 == 3, axis); axis *= sel; mean *= sel;\n"
"  float lo = 1e9f, hi = -1e9f; for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) { float t = dot(q[k] - mean, axis); lo = min(lo, t); hi = max(hi, t); }\n"
"  e0 = mean + axis * lo; e1 = mean + axis * hi;\n"
"  int n = 1 << wbits;\n"
"  for (int iter = 0; iter < 2; iter++) {   // assign weights on the line, refit the endpoints\n"
"    float4 d = e1 - e0; float dd = dot(d, d);\n"
"    float a00 = 0, a01 = 0, a11 = 0; float4 b0 = 0, b1 = 0;\n"
"    for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) {\n"
"      float t = dd > 1e-6f ? clamp(dot(q[k] - e0, d) / dd, 0.0f, 1.0f) : 0; float w = round(t * (n - 1)) / (n - 1);\n"
"      a00 += (1 - w) * (1 - w); a01 += (1 - w) * w; a11 += w * w; b0 += (1 - w) * q[k]; b1 += w * q[k];\n"
"    }\n"
"    float det = a00 * a11 - a01 * a01;\n"
"    if (fabs(det) < 1e-6f) break;\n"
"    e0 = (b0 * a11 - b1 * a01) / det; e1 = (b1 * a00 - b0 * a01) / det;\n"
"  }\n"
"  e0 = clamp(e0, 0.0f, 255.0f) * sel; e1 = clamp(e1, 0.0f, 255.0f) * sel;\n"
"}\n"
"// best weight per texel for the (unquantised) integer endpoints over channels ch0..ch0+nch-1\n"
"static void pick_weights(thread const int4 *px, int ch0, int nch, int wbits, int4 E0, int4 E1, thread int *w, int stride, int off) {\n"
"  int n = 1 << wbits;\n"
"  for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) {\n"
"    int best = 0, be = 1 << 30;\n"
"    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n"
"      int u = wt(wbits, i), e = 0;\n"
"      for (int c = ch0; c < ch0 + nch; c++) { int d = interp(E0[c], E1[c], u) - px[k][c]; e += d * d; }\n"
"      if (e < be) { be = e; best = i; }\n"
"    }\n"
"    w[k * stride + off] = best;\n"
"  }\n"
"}\n"
"static void astc_encode(thread const int4 *px, thread uchar *o) {\n"
"  for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) o[i] = 0;\n"
"  int amin = 255, amax = 0; for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) { amin = min(amin, px[k].w); amax = max(amax, px[k].w); }\n"
"  float4 p[16]; for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) p[k] = float4(px[k]);\n"
"  int w[32];\n"
"  if (amin == amax) {   // single plane\n"
"    int opaque = amin == 255, wbits = opaque ? 3 : 2, cem = opaque ? 8 : 12;\n"
"    float4 f0, f1; fit_line(p, 0, 3, wbits, f0, f1);\n"
"    int4 E0 = int4(round(f0)), E1 = int4(round(f1)); E0.w = E1.w = amin;\n"
"    if (E1.x + E1.y + E1.z < E0.x + E0.y + E0.z) { int4 t = E0; E0 = E1; E1 = t; }   // no blue contraction\n"
"    pick_weights(px, 0, 3, wbits, E0, E1, w, 1, 0);\n"
"    put(o, 0, 11, opaque ? 0x053u : 0x042u); put(o, 13, 4, uint(cem));\n"
"    uint pos = 17; int nc = opaque ? 3 : 4;\n"
"    for (int c = 0; c < nc; c++) { put(o, pos, 8, uint(E0[c])); put(o, pos + 8, 8, uint(E1[c])); pos += 16; }\n"
"    for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) putw(o, uint(k * wbits), uint(wbits), uint(w[k]));\n"
"    return;\n"
"  }\n"
"  // dual plane: RGB on plane 0, alpha on plane 1; endpoints in the 48-level range\n"
"  float4 f0, f1, g0, g1; fit_line(p, 0, 3, 2, f0, f1); fit_line(p, 3, 1, 2, g0, g1);   // colour line, alpha line (least squares)\n"
"  if (g0.w > g1.w) { float4 t = g0; g0 = g1; g1 = t; }\n"
"  int v[8] = {q48(int(round(f0.x))), q48(int(round(f1.x))), q48(int(round(f0.y))), q48(int(round(f1.y))),\n"
"              q48(int(round(f0.z))), q48(int(round(f1.z))), q48(int(round(g0.w))), q48(int(round(g1.w)))};\n"
"  int4 E0 = int4(unq48(v[0]), unq48(v[2]), unq48(v[4]), unq48(v[6])), E1 = int4(unq48(v[1]), unq48(v[3]), unq48(v[5]), unq48(v[7]));\n"
"  if (E1.x + E1.y + E1.z < E0.x + E0.y + E0.z) {   // decoder would swap (and blue-contract): swap all four channels ourselves\n"
"    for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) { int t = v[2 * c]; v[2 * c] = v[2 * c + 1]; v[2 * c + 1] = t; }\n"
"    int4 t = E0; E0 = E1; E1 = t;\n"
"  }\n"
"  pick_weights(px, 0, 3, 2, E0, E1, w, 2, 0);\n"
"  pick_weights(px, 3, 1, 2, E0, E1, w, 2, 1);\n"
"  put(o, 0, 11, 0x442u); put(o, 13, 4, 12u);\n"
"  // ISE: values 0-4 then 5-7 (trits padded with 0); per block m0 T[1:0] m1 T[3:2] m2 T[4] m3 T[6:5] m4 T[7]\n"
"  uint pos = 17;\n"
"  for (int blk = 0; blk < 2; blk++) {\n"
"    int b0 = blk * 5, cnt = blk ? 3 : 5, t[5] = {0, 0, 0, 0, 0}, m[5] = {0, 0, 0, 0, 0};\n"
"    for (int i = 0; i < cnt; i++) { t[i] = v[b0 + i] >> 4; m[i] = v[b0 + i] & 15; }\n"
"    uint T = trit_enc[t[0] + 3 * t[1] + 9 * t[2] + 27 * t[3] + 81 * t[4]];\n"
"    const int tb[5] = {2, 2, 1, 2, 1}; int ts = 0;\n"
"    for (int i = 0; i < cnt; i++) { put(o, pos, 4, uint(m[i])); pos += 4; put(o, pos, uint(tb[i]), (T >> ts) & ((1u << tb[i]) - 1)); pos += uint(tb[i]); ts += tb[i]; }\n"
"  }\n"
"  for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) putw(o, uint(i * 2), 2u, uint(w[i]));\n"
"  put(o, 128 - 64 - 2, 2, 3u);   // colour component selector: alpha on plane 1\n"
"}\n"
"\n"
"// ---------------------------------------------------------------- EAC R11 encoder (targets in 0..2047)\n"
"static int eac_dec(int base, int mul, int tab, int i) {\n"
"  int mod = eac_mod[tab][i]; int v = base * 8 + 4 + (mul ? mod * mul * 8 : mod); return clamp(v, 0, 2047);\n"
"}\n"
"static void eac_encode(thread const float *t, thread uchar *o) {\n"
"  float mn = 2047, mx = 0; for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) { mn = min(mn, t[k]); mx = max(mx, t[k]); }\n"
"  float best = 1e30f; int bb = 0, bm = 1, bt = 0;\n"
"  for (int tab = 0; tab < 16; tab++) {\n"
"    int lo = eac_mod[tab][3], hi = eac_mod[tab][7];\n"
"    float me = (mx - mn) / (8.0f * float(hi - lo));\n"
"    int m0 = clamp(int(floor(me)), 1, 15);\n"
"    for (int mul = max(m0 - 1, 1); mul <= min(m0 + 2, 15); mul++) {\n"
"      float be = ((mx + mn) * 0.5f - 4.0f - float(mul * 8) * float(lo + hi) * 0.5f) / 8.0f;\n"
"      int b0 = clamp(int(round(be)), 0, 255);\n"
"      for (int base = max(b0 - 1, 0); base <= min(b0 + 1, 255); base++) {\n"
"        float err = 0;\n"
"        for (int k = 0; k < 16 && err < best; k++) { float e = 1e30f; for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) { float d = float(eac_dec(base, mul, tab, i)) - t[k]; e = min(e, d * d); } err += e; }\n"
"        if (err < best) { best = err; bb = base; bm = mul; bt = tab; }\n"
"      }\n"
"    }\n"
"  }\n"
"  ulong bits = (ulong(bb) << 56) | (ulong(bm) << 52) | (ulong(bt) << 48);\n"
"  for (int x = 0; x < 4; x++) for (int y = 0; y < 4; y++) {\n"
"    float tk = t[y * 4 + x]; int bi = 0; float e = 1e30f;\n"
"    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) { float d = float(eac_dec(bb, bm, bt, i)) - tk; if (d * d < e) { e = d * d; bi = i; } }\n"
"    bits |= ulong(bi) << (45 - 3 * (x * 4 + y));\n"
"  }\n"
"  for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) o[i] = uchar(bits >> (56 - 8 * i));   // big-endian\n"
"}\n"
"\n"
"kernel void bctc(device const uchar *src [[buffer(0)]], device const TP &p [[buffer(1)]], device uchar *dst [[buffer(2)]], uint2 g [[thread_position_in_grid]]) {\n"
"  uint bw = (p.w + 3) / 4, bh = (p.h + 3) / 4; if (g.x >= bw || g.y >= bh) return;\n"
"  uint f = p.fmt & 0xff, raw = p.fmt & 0x100;\n"
"  int sbytes = (f == 0x49) ? 8 : 16;\n"
"  device const uchar *b = src + p.src_off + g.y * p.src_pitch + g.x * uint(sbytes);\n"
"  uchar o[16]; for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) o[i] = 0;\n"
"  int obytes = 16;\n"
"  if (f == 0x49 || f == 0x4b) {   // BC4 / BC5 unsigned -> EAC R11 / RG11\n"
"    float t[16];\n"
"    dec_bc4(b, t, 2047.0f / 255.0f); eac_encode(t, o);\n"
"    if (f == 0x49) obytes = 8;\n"
"    else { uchar o2[16]; dec_bc4(b + 8, t, 2047.0f / 255.0f); eac_encode(t, o2); for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) o[8 + i] = o2[i]; }\n"
"  } else {\n"
"    int4 px[16];\n"
"    if (f == 0x4d || f == 0x4e) dec_bc7(b, px);\n"
"    else {\n"
"      dec_color4(b + 8, px);\n"
"      if (f == 0x43 || f == 0x47) { for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) { int a = (b[k >> 1] >> ((k & 1) * 4)) & 15; px[k].w = a * 17; } }   // BC2: explicit 4-bit alpha\n"
"      else { float a[16]; dec_bc4(b, a, 1.0f); for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) px[k].w = int(a[k] + 0.5f); }\n"
"    }\n"
"    if (raw) {   // probe: decoded texels, 64 bytes per block\n"
"      device uchar *d = dst + p.dst_off + (g.y * bw + g.x) * 64;\n"
"      for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) { d[4 * k] = uchar(px[k].x); d[4 * k + 1] = uchar(px[k].y); d[4 * k + 2] = uchar(px[k].z); d[4 * k + 3] = uchar(px[k].w); }\n"
"      return;\n"
"    }\n"
"    astc_encode(px, o);\n"
"  }\n"
"  device uchar *d = dst + p.dst_off + (g.y * bw + g.x) * uint(obytes);\n"
"  for (int i = 0; i < obytes; i++) d[i] = o[i];\n"
"}\n";
