`mario-odessy-harmony/entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets`:

```ets
import game from 'libgame.so';
import { fileIo } from '@kit.CoreFileKit';
import { http } from '@kit.NetworkKit';
import { BusinessError } from '@kit.BasicServicesKit';

@Entry
@Component
struct Index {
  @StorageLink('filesDir') filesDir: string = '';
  @StorageLink('smoReady') smoReady: boolean = false;
  @StorageLink('smoErr') smoErr: string = '';
  @State status: string = '就绪';
  @State started: boolean = false;
  @State surfaceReady: boolean = false;
  @State romfsReady: boolean = false;
  @State pulling: string = '';
  private pcAddr: string = '192.168.0.110:8000';   // Mac 侧 deploy_emu.sh 在 lo0 挂的别名直连地址
  private timerId: number = -1;
  private statusTimerId: number = -1;

  aboutToAppear() {
    this.checkRomfs();
    // 自动链默认开（EntryAbility 写入，--ps autopath 0 可关）：RomFS 未就绪时自动开拉
    if (AppStorage.get<string>('autopath') !== '0' && !this.romfsReady) {
      setTimeout(() => { this.pullFromPc(); }, 800);
    }
    // 自动点火默认开（--ps boot 0 可关）：等 smo 镜像解包完 + RomFS 就绪后自动启动游戏
    if (AppStorage.get<string>('boot') !== '0') {
      this.timerId = setInterval(() => {
        if (this.smoReady && this.romfsReady && !this.started) {
          clearInterval(this.timerId);
          this.timerId = -1;
          this.startGame();
        }
      }, 2000) as number;
    }
  }

  aboutToDisappear() {
    if (this.timerId >= 0) clearInterval(this.timerId);
    if (this.statusTimerId >= 0) clearInterval(this.statusTimerId);
  }

  // RomFS 就绪判定（boot 门禁用）：7 件齐全才放行点火，缺任何一件都算未就绪
  private checkRomfs(): void {
    try {
      const dir = `${this.filesDir}/smo/romfs`;
      let n = 0;
      const all: string[] = ['runtime-index.bin',
        'romfs.bin.000', 'romfs.bin.001', 'romfs.bin.002', 'romfs.bin.003', 'romfs.bin.004', 'romfs.bin.005'];
      for (let i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
        if (fileIo.accessSync(`${dir}/${all[i]}`)) { n++; }
      }
      this.romfsReady = n === all.length;
    } catch (e) {
      this.romfsReady = false;
    }
  }

  // 从电脑拉取（自动链通道，无按钮）：HTTP 分块下载直写沙箱。两条路：
  //  1) 直连（默认 192.168.0.110:8000）：Mac 侧 deploy_emu.sh 在 lo0 挂别名 + 起 http.server
  //  2) 隧道（直连失败自动回落）：PC 侧 `hdc rport tcp:8000 tcp:8000` 后走 127.0.0.1:8000
  private async pullFromPc(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.pulling !== '' || this.pcAddr === '') { return; }
    const dst = `${this.filesDir}/smo/romfs`;
    const wanted: string[] = ['runtime-index.bin',
      'romfs.bin.000', 'romfs.bin.001', 'romfs.bin.002', 'romfs.bin.003', 'romfs.bin.004', 'romfs.bin.005'];
    try {
      if (!fileIo.accessSync(dst)) { fileIo.mkdirSync(dst, true); }
      for (let i = 0; i < wanted.length; i++) {
        const name = wanted[i];
        this.pulling = `拉取 ${name} …`;
        await this.downloadOne(`http://${this.pcAddr}/${name}`, `${dst}/${name}`, name);
      }
      this.checkRomfs();
      this.pulling = this.romfsReady ? '拉取完成 ✓' : '拉取不完整（缺 runtime-index.bin 或首卷）';
    } catch (e) {
      // 直连失败（多半是 PC 防火墙）→ 自动改走 hdc rport 隧道（127.0.0.1:8000）重试一次
      if (this.pcAddr !== '127.0.0.1:8000') {
        this.pcAddr = '127.0.0.1:8000';
        this.pulling = '直连失败，改走 hdc 隧道重试…';
        setTimeout(() => { this.pulling = ''; this.pullFromPc(); }, 500);
        return;
      }
      this.pulling = `拉取失败：${(e as BusinessError).message ?? JSON.stringify(e)} · 检查电脑侧服务/地址`;
    }
  }

  // 单文件流式下载：requestInStream → dataReceive 顺序写 .part → dataEnd 校验 200 后 moveFile 成品
  private downloadOne(url: string, target: string, name: string): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      const part = `${target}.part`;
      const session = http.createHttp();
      let fd = -1;
      let received = 0;
      let total = 0;
      let respCode = 0;
      let settled = false;
      const fail = (msg: string): void => {
        if (settled) { return; }
        settled = true;
        if (fd >= 0) { try { fileIo.closeSync(fd); } catch (e) { } }
        try { fileIo.unlinkSync(part); } catch (e) { }
        session.destroy();
        reject(new Error(msg));
      };
      try { fileIo.unlinkSync(part); } catch (e) { }
      fd = fileIo.openSync(part,
        fileIo.OpenMode.READ_WRITE | fileIo.OpenMode.CREATE | fileIo.OpenMode.TRUNC).fd;
      session.on('headersReceive', (h: Object) => {
        const rec = h as Record<string, string>;
        const cl = rec['content-length'];
        if (cl) { total = parseInt(cl, 10); }
      });
      session.on('dataReceive', (chunk: ArrayBuffer) => {
        if (fd < 0) { return; }
        fileIo.writeSync(fd, chunk);
        received += chunk.byteLength;
        this.pulling = total > 0
          ? `${name}：${Math.floor(received / 1048576)} / ${Math.floor(total / 1048576)} MB`
          : `${name}：${Math.floor(received / 1048576)} MB`;
      });
      session.on('dataEnd', () => {
        if (settled) { return; }
        // requestInStream 的回调（err, code）可能比 dataEnd 晚到：快响应下 code 还没落地，
        // dataEnd 先按 respCode===0 误杀成「HTTP 0」。dataEnd 后轮询最多 2s 等回调补码再裁决。
        let waits = 0;
        const judge = (): void => {
          if (respCode === 0 && waits < 20) { waits++; setTimeout(judge, 100); return; }
          if (settled) { return; }
          settled = true;
          if (fd >= 0) { try { fileIo.closeSync(fd); } catch (e) { } }
          session.destroy();
          if (respCode !== 200) {
            try { fileIo.unlinkSync(part); } catch (e) { }
            reject(new Error(`HTTP ${respCode}（地址/服务不对？）`));
            return;
          }
          try { fileIo.unlinkSync(target); } catch (e) { }
          fileIo.moveFileSync(part, target);
          resolve();
        };
        judge();
      });
      const opts: http.HttpRequestOptions = {
        usingCache: false, connectTimeout: 15000, readTimeout: 300000
      };
      session.requestInStream(url, opts, (err: BusinessError, code: number) => {
        if (err) { fail(`连接失败：${err.message}`); return; }
        respCode = code;
      });
    });
  }

  // 启动游戏（CPU boot）：boot 自动链点火入口（无按钮）
  private startGame(): void {
    if (this.started) { return; }
    const dir = `${this.filesDir}/smo`;
    const rc: number = game.start(dir);
    this.status = rc === 0 ? 'boot 线程已启动，看日志推进' : `启动失败 rc=${rc}`;
    this.started = true;
    this.statusTimerId = setInterval(() => {
      const s: number = game.status();
      if (s === 2) {
        this.status = 'boot 线程已退出（看 hilog 定位卡点）';
        this.started = false;
        clearInterval(this.statusTimerId);
        this.statusTimerId = -1;
      }
    }, 1000) as number;
  }

  build() {
    Stack({ alignContent: Alignment.TopStart }) {
      // 游戏画面：XComponent(surface) 铺满全屏，native 侧收窗口句柄（后续接 Vulkan swapchain）
      XComponent({ id: 'game', type: XComponentType.SURFACE, libraryname: 'game' })
        .width('100%')
        .height('100%')
        .backgroundColor('#000000')
        .onLoad(() => {
          this.surfaceReady = game.surfaceProbe() === 1;
          this.status = this.surfaceReady ? 'surface 已就绪' : 'surface 未上报';
        })

      // 启动前的小字提示（就绪状态/拉取进度）；游戏一旦点火立即整体隐藏，不挡画面
      if (!this.started) {
        Column({ space: 6 }) {
          Text(this.status).fontSize(12).fontColor('#4fc3f7')
          if (this.smoErr !== '') {
            Text(this.smoErr).fontSize(11).fontColor('#ff5252')
          }
          if (this.pulling !== '') {
            Text(this.pulling).fontSize(11).fontColor('#b0bec5')
          }
          Text(`surface=${this.surfaceReady ? 'OK' : '...'} · RomFS=${this.romfsReady ? 'OK' : '未就绪'} · 就绪后自动启动`)
            .fontSize(11).opacity(0.55)
        }
        .align(Alignment.TopStart)
        .padding({ top: 18, left: 12, right: 12 })
      }
    }
    .width('100%').height('100%')
    .backgroundColor('#000000')
  }
}

`minimal-test/entry/src/main/ets/entryability/EntryAbility.ets`:

```ets
import { AbilityConstant, ConfigurationConstant, UIAbility, Want } from '@kit.AbilityKit';
import { hilog } from '@kit.PerformanceAnalysisKit';
import { window } from '@kit.ArkUI';

const DOMAIN = 0x0000;

export default class EntryAbility extends UIAbility {
  onCreate(want: Want, launchParam: AbilityConstant.LaunchParam): void {
    this.context.getApplicationContext().setColorMode(ConfigurationConstant.ColorMode.COLOR_MODE_NOT_SET);
    hilog.info(DOMAIN, 'testTag', '%{public}s', 'Ability onCreate');
  }

  onDestroy(): void {
    hilog.info(DOMAIN, 'testTag', '%{public}s', 'Ability onDestroy');
  }

  onWindowStageCreate(windowStage: window.WindowStage): void {
    // Main window is created, set main page for this ability
    hilog.info(DOMAIN, 'testTag', '%{public}s', 'Ability onWindowStageCreate');

    windowStage.loadContent('pages/Index', (err) => {
      if (err.code) {
        hilog.error(DOMAIN, 'testTag', 'Failed to load the content. Cause: %{public}s', JSON.stringify(err));
        return;
      }
      hilog.info(DOMAIN, 'testTag', 'Succeeded in loading the content.');
    });
  }

  onWindowStageDestroy(): void {
    // Main window is destroyed, release UI related resources
    hilog.info(DOMAIN, 'testTag', '%{public}s', 'Ability onWindowStageDestroy');
  }

  onForeground(): void {
    // Ability has brought to foreground
    hilog.info(DOMAIN, 'testTag', '%{public}s', 'Ability onForeground');
  }

  onBackground(): void {
    // Ability has back to background
    hilog.info(DOMAIN, 'testTag', '%{public}s', 'Ability onBackground');
  }
}

`nxnative-ohos/README.md`:

```md
# nxnative-ohos

Play your own Nintendo Switch games natively on HarmonyOS phones and tablets. Bring your game (its NSP files) and your `prod.keys`; one script turns them into a signed HAP you install with hdc.

It is not an emulator: the game's own code runs directly on the phone's ARM cores, with Switch graphics rebuilt on Vulkan. Nothing from any game is in this repository, and the project is not affiliated with Nintendo or any game publisher.

> 血统：d2r-mobile → nxnative (iOS/Metal) / MacNativeGames (Mac/Metal) → **本项目 (鸿蒙/Vulkan)**。
> 设计决策见 `../game-work/nxnative_ohos_design.md`，调研依据见 `../game-work/logs/nxnative_ohos_survey.md`。

## Status（2026-10-31）

| 里程碑 | 状态 |
|---|---|
| M1 模板工程抽取（mario 工程参数化 + smo 档案） | **完成（2026-10-31）**：`scripts/build_hap_from_profile.py games/0100000000010000 --work <smo_build>` 一键出 63.3MB 签名 HAP（生产线等价；generated 三头与生产线逐字节一致） |
| M2 一条脚本 build_hap_from_nsp.py | **完成（2026-10-31）**：真实 smo NSP（5.6GB 本体+397MB 更新）全流程 32s → 签名 HAP；**从原始 NSP 字节级复现既有转译产物**（patched 24 文件 sha256 全一致）；指纹缓存复跑 0.2s；`new_game.py` 从未知 NSP 自动起草档案（build ID/romfs_marker/模块序自动识别） |
| M3 第二游戏（TotK 1.1.2 derived profile） | **前半完成（2026-10-31）**：`games/0100F2C0115B6000/` 档案（25 键落值，1.1.2 derived；ExeFS 五件与 MacNativeGames expected-v1.1.2.json 哈希全同）+ `tools/make_romfs_runtime.py` 档案化分卷（17,045,762,015 B → 16 卷，marker 校验过）+ M1 管线构建 **BUILD SUCCESSFUL，未签名 HAP 130,943,339 B**（本机调试签名 p7b 绑定 com.vibecc.smo，com.vibecc.totk 需 DevEco Signing Configs → Fix 后重跑；smo 回归仍出签名包）。真机点火待设备（清单见档案 README） |
| M4 图形后端 nvn_vk（Vulkan 实装） | 与主线合并推进 |
| M5 文档定稿（README/PITFALLS/frontends） | 持续 |

**快速上手（M2 已可用）**：

```bash
# 已支持的游戏（games/ 里有档案的）
python scripts/build_hap_from_nsp.py <NSP目录> -k <prod.keys> --archive-root games
# → .build/<titleID>/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap

# 新游戏（首次）: 先起草档案，人工补内存/图形键，再走上行
python scripts/new_game.py <NSP目录> -k <prod.keys> -o games/<titleID>-draft
```

主线进展（奥德赛真机 boot 逐轮推进）见 `../game-work/logs/round*.log` 与 `../game-work/logs/crash_1031_font_round.md`。

## Layout

```
scripts/   build_hap_from_nsp.py（总入口，M2）· new_game.py
template/  鸿蒙宿主模板工程（M1 从 mario-odessy-harmony 泛化）
games/     每游戏档案（game.tsv + patches.py + 着色器表）；键表见 games/README.md
tools/     prepare_runtime / make_romfs_runtime / make_shared_fonts / run_cycle（从 game-work 泛化迁入）
docs/      frontends.md（JSON progress 协议 + env 链）
```

大文件（patched.bin / RomFS 分卷 / HAP）一律不入库，走 `<titleID>_build/` 工作区（指纹缓存，输入不变即复用）。

## Architecture rule（继承 nxnative）

**Everything game-specific belongs in `games/<titleID>/`. Code reads the profile; it does not hard-code a game.**

游戏差异的三种表达，按优先级：
1. `game.tsv` 键值（内存布局/呈现行为/纹理策略/字体模式…）
2. `patches.py` per-build 指令补丁（CUTS/OBS/FRAME_STEP，按 NSO build ID 键控）
3. `host_override/` 整文件覆盖（逃生门：runtime 分叉度 ~65%，模板不可能参数化覆盖全部）

```

`nxnative-ohos/docs/frontends.md`:

```md
# Front ends（对齐 nxnative docs/frontends.md 语义）

不动 nxnative-ohos 一行即可二次封装（GUI/CI/bot）的三件套。

## 1. 构建驱动：`--progress json`

`build_hap_from_nsp.py --progress json`（`build_hap_from_profile.py` 同）：stdout 每行一个 JSON 事件，人类可读输出全部走 stderr。

事件（对齐 nxnative schema）：

| type | 字段 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `stage` | `stage`, `i`, `n`, `say` | 阶段开始（identify/extract/rewrite/prepare/hap…），i/n 为阶段序 |
| `step` | `stage`, `step`, `say`, `fraction?` | 阶段内步骤（模块重写、卷转换…） |
| `progress` | `stage`, `fraction` | 0..1（大文件拷贝/哈希） |
| `stage_end` | `stage`, `ok` | 阶段结束 |
| `say` | `say` | 自由文本进度提示 |

退出码：`0` 成功（最后一行 `stage_end ok=true` + stderr HAP 路径）；`1` 失败（事件含 `error` 字段）；`2` 未知游戏（已生成 survey，需 new_game + 人工补键）。

各工具原始输出在 `<work>/logs/`；指纹缓存（`<work>/keys/*.key`）命中时阶段整体跳过并发 `stage` 事件带 `reused=true`。

## 2. 档案与设置

- 档案键表（唯一权威）：`games/README.md`（43 键 + host_override 逃生门 + derived profile 机制）
- 每游戏运行时开关沿用宿主 `TOTK_*` 环境变量面（鸿蒙侧由点火参数/game_napi 传递；统一设置面板属 M5+，暂不做 GUI 层承诺）

## 3. 装机与运行（真机调试期）

`tools/run_cycle.sh`（源：`../../game-work/run_cycle.sh`，随主线演进同步）：

```
构建 → hdc install -r（相对路径！）→ aa force-stop → 流式 hilog
→ aa start --ps autopath 1 --ps boot 1 → pidof 存活监测 → 轮日志自动归档+验尸摘要
```

验尸摘要自动抓：死法（exit code/CRASH 行）、关键停点（FAIL/guest Break/shared font/unimplemented SVC/poison/host abort）、里程（SmoGame 行数）。

## 4. 已知缺口（与 nxnative 对齐中）

- 宿主运行期事件无人机可读接口（同 nxnative frontends.md:73-75——只有人类日志行）
- 设置清单（launcher.json/JSON Schema）未实现——M5+ 视需求

```

`nxnative-ohos/games/0100000000010000/host_override/entry/src/main/cpp/host/game_patches.c`:

```c
#include "game_patches.h"
#include "game_version.h"
#include "totk_ui_lang.h"
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

/* Odyssey 1.3.0 / 1.4.1 (the same executables): the render size patches below (key 3). Each site is checked against the
   original instruction before it is written, as CONTRIBUTING.md asks. Key 4 writes camera fields at the present instead
   (odyssey_aspect.c). */
void odyssey_aspect_install(const Module *main_module);
void odyssey_aspect_present(void);

/* Docked render size (TOTK_RENDER_RES=<w>x<h>; unset: render-res.txt of the overlay folder, else 1600x900 as shipped).
   Three places hold the docked size (disassembly 2026-10-22): main+0x4bf2a4 puts 1600 | 900 << 32 into the configuration
   of the object made at main+0x624460, from which the window and its three 1600x900 swapchain textures take their size
   (main+0x4bf32c -> main+0x94175c -> nvnTextureBuilderSetSize2D); main+0x4bf34c passes 1600 x 900 and 1280 x 720 to
   main+0x624ad0; main+0x4e27bc gives the window crop (main+0x94dfe0: 0, 0, w, h) 1600 x 900 when docked, 1280 x 720
   otherwise. Patching the last two alone laid the UI out for 1920x1080 on 1600x900 textures: the right of the picture was
   cut off. All docked values are replaced; each instruction is checked before any is written. */
static unsigned g_render_w, g_render_h;
/* Without TOTK_RENDER_RES the size comes from the overlay folder: scripts/make_render_res_overlay.py writes render-res.txt
   next to the scaled ProjectGraphicsQuality.szs, so the code sizes below and the data table always agree (the app carries
   both in its romfs-patches folder, TOTK_ROMFS_PATCHES; 0: neither). */
static const char *render_res_from_overlay(char *buf, size_t n, const char **from) {
    const char *dir = getenv("TOTK_ROMFS_PATCHES");
    if (dir && !strcmp(dir, "0")) return NULL;
    static char path[4096];
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/render-res.txt", dir && *dir ? dir : "extracted/" TOTK_GAME_DIR "/romfs-patches");
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "r"); if (!f) return NULL;
    char *r = fgets(buf, (int)n, f); fclose(f);
    if (!r) return NULL;
    buf[strcspn(buf, "\r\n")] = 0; *from = path;
    return buf;
}
/* The docked render size asked for, read once (0 = as shipped): patch_render_res and the memory sizes below use it, and
   services.c asks for the memory before the main module is patched. */
static int render_size(unsigned *w, unsigned *h, const char **from) {
    static int done; static unsigned sw, sh; static const char *src = "TOTK_RENDER_RES";
    if (!done) {
        done = 1;
        const char *e = getenv("TOTK_RENDER_RES"); static char buf[32];
        if (!e) e = render_res_from_overlay(buf, sizeof buf, &src);
        if (e && *e && strcmp(e, "0") && strcmp(e, "1600x900")) {
            char tail;
            if (sscanf(e, "%ux%u%c", &sw, &sh, &tail) != 2 || sw < 640 || sh < 360 || sw > 3840 || sh > 2160)
                runtime_fail("TOTK_RENDER_RES must be <w>x<h> between 640x360 and 3840x2160");
        }
    }
    *w = sw; *h = sh; if (from) *from = src;
    return sw != 0;
}
/* Render targets come from a 100 MiB compressible pool (main+0x624b7c, inside a 170 MiB heap made at main+0x624b4c, both
   handed to main+0x983ab0). Its allocator (main+0x9a5440) returns NULL when no free block fits, and the frame buffer that
   wanted it then crashes reading +0x128 (main+0x9917f8). Measured on the title: a 3D scene of 2112x1188 fits, 2176x1224
   does not. Above 1920x1080 the pool grows with the scene area and the heap by the same amount; the application pool
   reported to the game grows with them (services.c). */
#define RT_POOL 0x6400000u
#define RT_HEAP 0xaa00000u
static uint32_t rt_pool_size(void) {
    unsigned w, h;
    if (!render_size(&w, &h, NULL) || (uint64_t)w * h <= 1920u * 1080u) return RT_POOL;
    /* 100 MiB holds a 2112x1188 scene and not 2176x1224, so the pool grows from that point with 8 % on top (2560x1440:
       160 MiB, which ran the Wooded Kingdom). Growing more costs memory elsewhere: with 256 MiB (+156) loading the Wooded
       Kingdom failed an allocation in another fixed heap and stopped with an SDK Break, also with the memory heap grown by
       the same amount; +60 left enough. */
    uint64_t pool = (uint64_t)RT_POOL * w * h * 108 / (2112u * 1188u * 100u);
    if (pool < RT_POOL) pool = RT_POOL;
    return (uint32_t)((pool + 0xffffff) & ~0xffffffULL);   /* 16 MiB steps; a movz with lsl 16 holds it */
}
uint64_t runtime_render_pool_extra(void) { return rt_pool_size() - RT_POOL; }
static void patch_rt_pool(Module *m) {
    uint32_t pool = rt_pool_size();
    if (pool == RT_POOL) return;
    uint32_t heap = RT_HEAP + (pool - RT_POOL);
    /* The game's whole memory heap is fixed too: nninitStartup asks for 0xc3000000 (main+0x4e321c, then
       nn::os::SetMemoryHeapSize), whatever the application pool is. Growing only the render target heap inside it left
       156 MiB less for the rest, and loading the Wooded Kingdom then failed an allocation (main+0x6af5dc) and stopped with
       an SDK Break; a bigger application pool alone did not change that. So it grows by the same amount, in the 2 MiB
       steps SetMemoryHeapSize takes. */
    uint32_t memheap = 0xc3000000u + ((pool - RT_POOL + 0x1fffffu) & ~0x1fffffu);
    const struct { uint32_t off, shipped, value; } site[] = {
        {0x624b4c, 0x52a15400, 0x52a00000 | (heap >> 16) << 5 | 0},      /* mov w0, #heap */
        {0x624b7c, 0x52a0c808, 0x52a00000 | (pool >> 16) << 5 | 8},      /* mov w8, #pool */
        {0x4e321c, 0x52b86000, 0x52a00000 | (memheap >> 16) << 5 | 0},   /* mov w0, #memory heap size */
    };
    for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        uint32_t word; memcpy(&word, m->base + site[i].off, 4);
        if (word != site[i].shipped) {
            fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] render target pool main+%#x: found %08x expected %08x\n", site[i].off, word, site[i].shipped);
            runtime_fail("the render target pool size needs the instructions it replaces");
        }
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < 3; i++) memcpy(m->base + site[i].off, &site[i].value, 4);
    fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] render target pool %u MiB (shipped 100), its heap %u MiB (shipped 170), memory heap %#x (shipped 0xc3000000)\n",
            pool >> 20, heap >> 20, memheap);
}
static void patch_render_res(Module *m) {
    const char *from; unsigned w, h;
    if (!render_size(&w, &h, &from)) return;
    enum { MOVZ_W, MOVZ_X, MOVK_X32 };
    static const struct { uint32_t off; unsigned rd, shipped, kind; int is_w; } site[] = {
        {0x4bf2a4, 9, 1600, MOVZ_X, 1}, {0x4bf2a8, 9, 900, MOVK_X32, 0},   // configuration: docked width | height << 32
        {0x4bf34c, 4, 1600, MOVZ_W, 1}, {0x4bf350, 5, 900, MOVZ_W, 0},     // main+0x624ad0: docked width, height
        {0x4e27bc, 3, 1600, MOVZ_W, 1}, {0x4e27c0, 4, 900, MOVZ_W, 0},     // window crop when docked
    };
    #define ENC(kind, rd, imm) ((kind) == MOVZ_W ? 0x52800000u : (kind) == MOVZ_X ? 0xd2800000u : 0xf2c00000u) | ((uint32_t)(imm) << 5) | (rd)
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof site / sizeof *site; i++) {
        uint32_t word, want = ENC(site[i].kind, site[i].rd, site[i].shipped); memcpy(&word, m->base + site[i].off, 4);
        if (word != want) {
            fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] render size main+%#x: found %08x expected %08x\n", site[i].off, word, want);
            runtime_fail("TOTK_RENDER_RES needs the instructions it replaces");
        }
    }
    /* The 3D scene is not set here: the game's dynamic resolution takes its largest docked size (1600x900) and its steps
       from SystemData/ProjectGraphicsQuality.szs, which scripts/make_render_res_overlay.py scales into a RomFS overlay.
       Setting the scene size in code instead (main+0x5efbb0 fixed, or main+0x5efc20 taking the requested side) drew light
       in blocks on the ground, because buffers sized for the largest step stayed 1600x900. */
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof site / sizeof *site; i++) {
        uint32_t word = ENC(site[i].kind, site[i].rd, site[i].is_w ? w : h);
        memcpy(m->base + site[i].off, &word, 4);
    }
    #undef ENC
    g_render_w = w; g_render_h = h;
    fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] docked render size %ux%u (shipped: 1600x900; from %s)\n", w, h, from);
}

/* Key 3 at a bigger render size: the 3D scene back to 1600x900 while playing, without a restart. The game's dynamic
   resolution picks the scene size each frame at main+0x5efc20 (called once, from main+0x6f144c): the smaller of the
   requested size (x2) and the limit (x0), written to x1, width then height. That leaf function is replaced by a call into
   odyssey_scene_pick, which does the same and then holds the result under a cap. A smaller scene inside the buffers
   sized for the largest step is how the game's own lower steps draw, so it stays clean. The window and the HUD stay at
   the patched size. */
static _Atomic uint32_t g_scene_cap, g_scene_pick;   /* width | height << 16; cap 0 = none */
/* Key 3's states: original 1600x900, the same with MetalFX, then native 1920x1080 and, at a bigger render size, native at
   that size. The game starts as shipped (3D 1600x900); window and HUD keep the patched size in every state, because they
   are only set when the game starts. */
enum { SCENE_ORIGINAL, SCENE_ORIGINAL_MFX, SCENE_1080, SCENE_MAX };
static int g_scene_mode = SCENE_ORIGINAL;
static int scene_states(void) { return g_render_w * g_render_h > 1920u * 1080u ? 4 : 3; }   /* SCENE_1080 is the max at 1080p */
static uint32_t scene_size(int mode) {
    return mode == SCENE_1080 && scene_states() == 4 ? 1920u | 1080u << 16 : mode >= SCENE_1080 ? g_render_w | g_render_h << 16 : 1600u | 900u << 16;
}
/* The shortcut box's key 3 line (frontend.m); NULL without a bigger render size (key 3 is then MetalFX on / off). */
const char *runtime_picture_name(void) {
    if (!g_render_w) return NULL;
    static char native[64];
    uint32_t s = scene_size(g_scene_mode);
    switch (g_scene_mode) {
    case SCENE_ORIGINAL: return TOTK_UI("原版 1600×900", "original 1600×900");
    case SCENE_ORIGINAL_MFX: return TOTK_UI("1600×900，MetalFX 放大到窗口", "1600×900, MetalFX to the window");
    default: snprintf(native, sizeof native, TOTK_UI("原生 %u×%u", "native %u×%u"), s & 0xffff, s >> 16); return native;
    }
}
static void odyssey_scene_pick(const int32_t *limit, int32_t *out, const int32_t *want) {
    int32_t w = want[0] < limit[0] ? want[0] : limit[0], h = want[1] < limit[1] ? want[1] : limit[1];
    uint32_t cap = atomic_load_explicit(&g_scene_cap, memory_order_relaxed);
    if (cap) { if (w > (int32_t)(cap & 0xffff)) w = (int32_t)(cap & 0xffff); if (h > (int32_t)(cap >> 16)) h = (int32_t)(cap >> 16); }
    out[0] = w; out[1] = h;
    atomic_store_explicit(&g_scene_pick, (uint32_t)w | (uint32_t)h << 16, memory_order_relaxed);
}
static void patch_scene_pick(Module *m) {
    static const uint32_t shipped[] = {   /* ldr w8,[x2]; ldr w9,[x0]; cmp; csel lt; str w8,[x1]; the same at +4; ret */
        0xb9400048, 0xb9400009, 0x6b09011f, 0x1a89b108, 0xb9000028, 0xb9400448, 0xb9400409, 0x6b09011f, 0x1a89b108, 0xb9000428, 0xd65f03c0};
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof shipped / sizeof *shipped; i++) {
        uint32_t word; memcpy(&word, m->base + 0x5efc20 + 4 * i, 4);
        if (word != shipped[i]) {
            fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] scene size pick main+%#zx: found %08x expected %08x\n", (size_t)(0x5efc20 + 4 * i), word, shipped[i]);
            runtime_fail("key 3 scene size needs the instructions it replaces");
        }
    }
    uint64_t target = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)runtime_hle_wrap_named((void *)odyssey_scene_pick, "odyssey_scene_pick");
    const uint32_t veneer[2] = {0x58000051, 0xd61f0220};   /* ldr x17, #8; br x17 (the 8-byte target follows) */
    memcpy(m->base + 0x5efc20, veneer, sizeof veneer);
    memcpy(m->base + 0x5efc28, &target, sizeof target);
    /* SCENE_ORIGINAL until key 3; a render size picked in the settings window (the launcher sets ODYSSEY_SCENE_START=max,
       after PR #910) starts at that size instead */
    const char *start = getenv("ODYSSEY_SCENE_START");
    if (start && !strcmp(start, "max")) { g_scene_mode = scene_states() - 1; atomic_store(&g_scene_cap, 0); }
    else atomic_store(&g_scene_cap, 1600u | 900u << 16);
}
/* Present thread: one line when the picked scene size changes (the first 40 changes, then every 500th), so a test log says
   which size the game draws after key 3. */
static void scene_log(void) {
    static uint32_t last; static unsigned changes;
    uint32_t now = atomic_load_explicit(&g_scene_pick, memory_order_relaxed);
    if (!now || now == last) return;
    last = now; changes++;
    if (changes <= 40 || changes % 500 == 0)
        fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] 3D scene %ux%u (change %u)\n", now & 0xffff, now >> 16, changes);
}

void runtime_game_patches(Module *main_module) {
    patch_render_res(main_module);
    if (g_render_w) { patch_scene_pick(main_module); patch_rt_pool(main_module); }
    fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] game patches: %s\n", g_render_w ? "docked render size, key 3 scene size" : "none");
    odyssey_aspect_install(main_module);
}
void runtime_frame_step_pin(double ms) { (void)ms; }
void runtime_frame_step_update(uint64_t now_ns) { (void)now_ns; odyssey_aspect_present(); scene_log(); }   /* key 4, every present */
int runtime_output_res(unsigned *w, unsigned *h) { (void)w; (void)h; return 0; }
uint64_t runtime_output_res_extra_bytes(void) { return 0; }
uint64_t runtime_output_size_current(void) { return (uint64_t)1080 << 32 | 1920; }
int runtime_output_res_toggle(void) { return 0; }
/* Key 3 (runtime/input.c). At a bigger render size: original 1600x900 -> with MetalFX -> native 1920x1080 -> native at that
   size. Without one: MetalFX upscaling of the picture to the window, on / off (the app starts it on, Odyssey Data/no-metalfx
   off). Odyssey draws its docked picture straight into the canvas the present shows: MetalFX works at the output stage
   (nvn_mtl.m output_upscale; nothing happens while the window is not bigger than the picture). */
int runtime_output_mode_cycle(void) {
    extern int mfxup_enabled(void);
    extern void dm_gfx_set_flag(const char *name, int value);
    if (g_render_w) {
        g_scene_mode = (g_scene_mode + 1) % scene_states();
        atomic_store(&g_scene_cap, g_scene_mode == scene_states() - 1 ? 0 : scene_size(g_scene_mode));   /* the largest: no cap */
        dm_gfx_set_flag("mfx_output", g_scene_mode == SCENE_ORIGINAL_MFX);
        dm_gfx_set_flag("mfx_upscale", g_scene_mode == SCENE_ORIGINAL_MFX);
        fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] key 3: %s\n", runtime_picture_name());
        return 1;
    }
    int next = !mfxup_enabled();
    dm_gfx_set_flag("mfx_output", next);
    dm_gfx_set_flag("mfx_upscale", next);
    fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] key 3: %s\n", next ? "MetalFX upscales the picture to the window" : "MetalFX off");
    return 1;
}

```

`nxnative-ohos/games/0100000000010000/host_override/entry/src/main/cpp/host/odyssey_aspect.c`:

```c
/* Super Mario Odyssey 1.3.0 / 1.4.1 (the same executables), key 4 (runtime/input.c): 16:9 -> fitting the window / display
   -> 21:9 -> 16:9, the steps of Zelda's key 4 (aspect_math.h; TOTK_ASPECT=21:9, 32:9, 3440x1440, 2.39 or display starts on
   that step). The game keeps drawing into its 16:9 canvas with the camera's aspect ratio set to the other one; the present
   stretches the picture over the window (nvn_mtl.m present_stretch asks runtime_aspect_now) and the HUD is squeezed back
   to 16:9 (uw_ui_squeeze).

   Odyssey has no code patch for it. Every camera projection of the game is a sead::PerspectiveProjection, vtable
   main+0x13540f8, with the layout Breath of the Wild 1.9.0 has (games/totk game_patches_botw.c): dirty +8, near +0x98, far
   +0x9c, fovy +0xa0, sin, cos and tan of half the fovy, aspect +0xb0. Found by reading the guest heap for that layout
   (2026-10-22, Wooded Kingdom: 95 such objects, two of them 40 deg / 16:9 / near 25 / far 500000 as the camera block of
   the frame says; 21:9 written into both widened the picture). So while key 4 is on, the ratio is written into
   every projection of that class that holds 16:9 and the projection is marked dirty, at every present: the game puts
   16:9 back into one of them every frame. Off puts 16:9 back where this code wrote.

   A thread finds the objects: it copies the guest heap through the kernel (mach_vm_read_overwrite, so a page the game
   makes inaccessible meanwhile is an error, not a crash; reading such a page directly stopped the game once) and looks
   for the vtable with the fovy signature behind it (a 1 MiB copy that fails is read again page by page; skipping it
   whole missed the camera once). It runs when key 4 leaves 16:9, when a found object stops looking like a projection,
   and every 10 s while key 4 is on (a new scene makes new cameras); about 1.5 s of one core per run, off the game
   thread. runtime_aspect_now answers the ratio only while a found projection holds it, so after a scene change the
   picture is not stretched until the new scene's cameras are found (about 1.5 s; the old ones fail the check at once).
   A camera made later inside the same scene is found by the next periodic run, up to 10 s, and drawn at 16:9 inside
   the stretched picture until then. A check of the frame's camera block (vertex uniform 5) cannot tell: its rows hold
   the view as well as the projection (the ratio read from them was 0.87 at 16:9, 2026-10-22). */
#include "runtime.h"
#include "aspect_math.h"
#include <TargetConditionals.h>
#include <mach/mach.h>
#include <mach/mach_vm.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>

#define ODYSSEY_PROJ_VTABLE 0x13540f8   /* sead::PerspectiveProjection's vtable, main+ (1.3.0 and 1.4.1) */
#define ODYSSEY_PROJ_MAX 128
#define ODYSSEY_RESCAN_NS 10000000000ull

static const Module *g_aspect_main;
static float g_wide;                       /* key 4's wide step: TOTK_ASPECT's ratio, or 21:9 */
static int g_named;                        /* TOTK_ASPECT gave it */
static atomic_int g_step;                  /* ASPECT_STEP_GAME, _FIT or _WIDE */
static _Atomic(uint32_t) g_view;           /* the window's width / height (frontend.m), float bits */
static _Atomic(uint32_t) g_want;           /* the ratio key 4 wants now, float bits (0 = the game's own) */
static _Atomic(uint32_t) g_shown;          /* the ratio a found camera holds (runtime_aspect_now), float bits */

static pthread_mutex_t g_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static pthread_cond_t g_wake = PTHREAD_COND_INITIALIZER;
static uint8_t *g_found[ODYSSEY_PROJ_MAX];     /* the scanner's list (g_lock) */
static int g_nfound, g_scan_req, g_scans;
static uint8_t *g_mine[ODYSSEY_PROJ_MAX];      /* present thread: objects that hold a ratio this code wrote */
static int g_nmine;
static float g_mine_ratio;

static float bits_float(uint32_t b) { float v; memcpy(&v, &b, 4); return v; }
static uint32_t float_bits(float v) { uint32_t b; memcpy(&b, &v, 4); return b; }

/* The object's first 0xb8 bytes through the kernel: 0 when they cannot be read. */
static int proj_read(const uint8_t *o, uint8_t out[0xb8]) {
    mach_vm_size_t got = 0;
    return mach_vm_read_overwrite(mach_task_self(), (mach_vm_address_t)(uintptr_t)o, 0xb8, (mach_vm_address_t)(uintptr_t)out, &got) == KERN_SUCCESS && got == 0xb8;
}
/* A sead::PerspectiveProjection of this game: the vtable, and a fovy with the sin, cos and tan of its half. */
static int proj_valid(const uint8_t *b) {
    uint64_t vt; memcpy(&vt, b, 8);
    if (!g_aspect_main || vt != (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(g_aspect_main->base + ODYSSEY_PROJ_VTABLE)) return 0;
    float f[4]; memcpy(f, b + 0xa0, sizeof f);
    if (!(f[0] > 0.1f && f[0] < 3.0f)) return 0;
    float h = f[0] * 0.5f;
    return fabsf(f[1] - sinf(h)) < 1e-5f && fabsf(f[2] - cosf(h)) < 1e-5f && fabsf(f[3] - tanf(h)) < 1e-4f;
}

/* The scanner: the heap in 1 MiB copies (overlapping by the object size, so none is cut at a seam). */
static void scan_heap(void) {
    extern void runtime_heap_range(uint8_t **base, size_t *size);
    uint8_t *heap; size_t size; runtime_heap_range(&heap, &size);
    uint8_t *found[ODYSSEY_PROJ_MAX]; int n = 0;
    enum { CHUNK = 1 << 20, OBJ = 0xb8 };
    static uint8_t buf[CHUNK + OBJ];
    uint64_t want_vt = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(g_aspect_main->base + ODYSSEY_PROJ_VTABLE);
    uint64_t t0 = clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW), unread = 0;
    for (size_t at = 0; heap && at < size && n < ODYSSEY_PROJ_MAX; at += CHUNK) {
        size_t len = size - at < CHUNK + OBJ ? size - at : CHUNK + OBJ;
        mach_vm_size_t got = 0;
        if (mach_vm_read_overwrite(mach_task_self(), (mach_vm_address_t)(uintptr_t)(heap + at), len, (mach_vm_address_t)(uintptr_t)buf, &got) != KERN_SUCCESS || got != len) {
            /* a page in it cannot be read (the game keeps some inaccessible): page by page, unreadable ones as zeros
               (no vtable there). Skipping the whole MiB missed the camera on the first try. */
            for (size_t pg = 0; pg < len; pg += 0x4000) {
                size_t l = len - pg < 0x4000 ? len - pg : 0x4000;
                got = 0;
                if (mach_vm_read_overwrite(mach_task_self(), (mach_vm_address_t)(uintptr_t)(heap + at + pg), l, (mach_vm_address_t)(uintptr_t)(buf + pg), &got) != KERN_SUCCESS || got != l) {
                    memset(buf + pg, 0, l);
                    if (pg < CHUNK) unread += l;
                }
            }
        }
        for (size_t i = 0; i + OBJ <= len && i < CHUNK && n < ODYSSEY_PROJ_MAX; i += 8) {
            uint64_t v; memcpy(&v, buf + i, 8);
            if (v != want_vt || !proj_valid(buf + i)) continue;
            float a; memcpy(&a, buf + i + 0xb0, 4);   // only the 16:9 views (and the ones holding the wanted ratio)
            if (a == (float)ASPECT_GAME || a == bits_float(atomic_load(&g_want))) found[n++] = heap + at + i;
        }
    }
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    memcpy(g_found, found, sizeof found); g_nfound = n; g_scans++;
    int scans = g_scans;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
    if (scans <= 3 || scans % 60 == 0) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] key 4: %d 16:9 camera projections found (scan %d, %.0f ms, %llu KiB not readable)\n", n, scans,
                (clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW) - t0) / 1e6, (unsigned long long)(unread >> 10));
        for (int i = 0; i < n && scans <= 3; i++) {
            uint8_t b[0xb8]; float f[3]; if (!proj_read(found[i], b)) continue;
            memcpy(f, b + 0x98, sizeof f);
            fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] key 4:   heap+%#lx near %g far %g fovy %.2f deg dirty %u\n", (unsigned long)(found[i] - heap), f[0], f[1], f[2] * 57.29578f, b[8]);
        }
    }
}
static void *scanner(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    for (;;) {
        while (!g_scan_req && !bits_float(atomic_load(&g_want))) pthread_cond_wait(&g_wake, &g_lock);
        if (!g_scan_req) {   // on, nothing asked: wait out the rescan period
            struct timespec t; clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &t); t.tv_sec += ODYSSEY_RESCAN_NS / 1000000000ull;
            pthread_cond_timedwait(&g_wake, &g_lock, &t);
            if (!bits_float(atomic_load(&g_want))) continue;
        }
        g_scan_req = 0;
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
        scan_heap();
        pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    }
    return NULL;
}
static void scanner_start(void) { pthread_t t; if (!pthread_create(&t, NULL, scanner, NULL)) pthread_detach(t); }
static void scan_request(void) {
    static pthread_once_t once = PTHREAD_ONCE_INIT;
    pthread_once(&once, scanner_start);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock); g_scan_req = 1; pthread_cond_signal(&g_wake); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
}

/* Present thread (runtime_frame_step_update): put the wanted ratio into the found projections that hold 16:9 (or the
   ratio written before), or 16:9 back into the ones this code wrote. */
static void aspect_present(void) {
    float want = bits_float(atomic_load(&g_want));
    uint8_t snap[0xb8];
    if (!want) {
        for (int i = 0; i < g_nmine; i++) {
            float a; if (!proj_read(g_mine[i], snap) || !proj_valid(snap)) continue;
            memcpy(&a, snap + 0xb0, 4);
            if (a == g_mine_ratio) { float g = (float)ASPECT_GAME; memcpy(g_mine[i] + 0xb0, &g, 4); g_mine[i][8] = 1; }
        }
        g_nmine = 0; atomic_store(&g_shown, 0);
        return;
    }
    uint8_t *list[ODYSSEY_PROJ_MAX]; int n = 0;
    if (pthread_mutex_trylock(&g_lock) == 0) { n = g_nfound; memcpy(list, g_found, sizeof list); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock); }
    else return;   // the scanner is publishing; the next present writes
    int held = 0, gone = 0, nmine = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        float a;
        if (!proj_read(list[i], snap) || !proj_valid(snap)) { gone++; continue; }
        memcpy(&a, snap + 0xb0, 4);
        if (a == want) held++;
        else if (a == (float)ASPECT_GAME || (g_mine_ratio && a == g_mine_ratio)) {
            memcpy(list[i] + 0xb0, &want, 4); list[i][8] = 1; held++;
        } else continue;   // another ratio (4:3, 1:1): not the game's 16:9 view, left as it is
        if (nmine < ODYSSEY_PROJ_MAX) g_mine[nmine++] = list[i];
    }
    g_nmine = nmine; g_mine_ratio = want;
    atomic_store(&g_shown, held ? float_bits(want) : 0);
    if (gone) scan_request();
}

/* Puts the ratio of key 4's step in force; logs a change. */
static void aspect_apply(void) {
    double r = aspect_step_ratio(atomic_load(&g_step), bits_float(atomic_load(&g_view)), g_wide);
    float a = aspect_effective(r);
    uint32_t old = atomic_exchange(&g_want, float_bits(a));
    if (old == float_bits(a)) return;
    if (a) { fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] aspect ratio %.4f\n", a); scan_request(); }
    else fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] aspect ratio 16:9 (the game's own)\n");
}

/* game_patches.c: the main module, and TOTK_ASPECT. Not on iPhone / iPad (no window to fit, no wide display). */
void odyssey_aspect_install(const Module *main_module) {
    if (TARGET_OS_IPHONE) return;
    double a = aspect_parse(getenv("TOTK_ASPECT"));
    if (a == ASPECT_BAD) runtime_fail("TOTK_ASPECT must be <w>:<h>, <w>x<h>, a ratio between 0.5 and 8, or display");
    g_aspect_main = main_module;
    g_named = a > 0;
    g_wide = a > 0 ? (float)a : (float)ASPECT_WIDE;
    atomic_store(&g_step, a == ASPECT_DISPLAY ? ASPECT_STEP_FIT : a > 0 ? ASPECT_STEP_WIDE : ASPECT_STEP_GAME);
    fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] key 4: 16:9 -> fit to the window -> %s %.4f -> 16:9 (camera projections, vtable main+%#x)\n",
            g_named ? "TOTK_ASPECT" : "21:9", g_wide, ODYSSEY_PROJ_VTABLE);
    aspect_apply();
}
void odyssey_aspect_present(void) { if (g_aspect_main) aspect_present(); }

/* The ratio in force (0 = the game's own 16:9): only once a camera holds it, so the picture is never stretched over a
   16:9 view. */
float runtime_aspect_now(void) { return bits_float(atomic_load(&g_shown)); }
/* The panel (frontend.m): key 4's step, -1 where key 4 is not available. */
int runtime_aspect_step(void) { return g_aspect_main ? atomic_load(&g_step) : -1; }
/* frontend.m: the window's drawable is w x h pixels (on every change). While key 4 fits the window, the view follows. */
void runtime_aspect_view(double w, double h) {
    if (!(w > 0 && h > 0)) return;
    atomic_store(&g_view, float_bits((float)(w / h)));
    if (g_aspect_main && atomic_load(&g_step) == ASPECT_STEP_FIT) aspect_apply();
}
int runtime_aspect_toggle(void) {
    if (!g_aspect_main) return 0;
    int step = aspect_next_step(atomic_load(&g_step), bits_float(atomic_load(&g_view)), g_wide);
    atomic_store(&g_step, step);
    aspect_apply();
    float a = bits_float(atomic_load(&g_want));
    const char *name = step == ASPECT_STEP_FIT ? "fit to the window / display" : step == ASPECT_STEP_WIDE ? g_named ? "TOTK_ASPECT" : "21:9" : "16:9";
    if (step == ASPECT_STEP_GAME) fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] key 4: 16:9 (the game's own)\n");
    else if (a) fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] key 4: %s, aspect ratio %.4f\n", name, a);
    else fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] key 4: %s, which is 16:9 here\n", name);
    return 1;
}

```

```md
# 0100F2C0115B6000 —— The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom（鸿蒙档案笔记）

塞尔达王国之泪。**本档案是 1.1.2（v262144）derived profile**：nxnative 上游注册 1.4.3（v720896），
本机转译产物是 1.1.2。键值出处与核对记录见 `game.tsv` 各组注释；本 README 记：为什么档案长这样、
host_override 放了什么/没放什么、以及待真机阶段验证清单（M3 后半）。

## 版本事实（2026-10-31 核验）

- 本地 `game-work/totk_0100F2C0115B6000/ExeFS/` 五件（main/rtld/sdk/subsdk0/main.npdm）SHA256 与
  MacNativeGames `games/totk/assets/expected-v1.1.2.json`（已拷入本目录）**逐一相符**——本地 1.1.2
  与 Mac 侧已验证的 1.1.2 逐字节同源，Mac 的 TOTK_GAME_V112 位点表对本镜像直接成立。
- 本地 RomFS.img 17,045,762,015 B（16 卷 @1GiB）**小于** Mac pin 记录的 17,051,988,992 B（差 ~6MB；
  ExeFS 却全同）。两者谁的抽取更完整未查——待真机 RomFS 校验阶段对齐（prepare 侧 IMAGE_SHA 以本地镜像为准）。
- 重写状态：`game-work/totk_build/patched/` 四模块 cuts/obs 全为空表头——1.1.2 零指令裁剪。
  nxnative 1.4.3 的 FRAME_STEP 按 build ID 键控，未命中 1.1.2；sdk（b9046c31…）也不在
  dm/tools/sdk_patches.py 的 CUTS 表。

## host_override 清单（放入 4 件，均为数据/参数类）

## 暂缓清单（代码类差异，"待 OHOS 化"，勿盲拷 Mac 版进构建）

MacNativeGames totk runtime 72 文件 vs odyssey runtime 59：55 同名中仅 19 逐字节相同。
**鸿蒙宿主模板是 odyssey 血统的 OHOS 移植**，Mac 侧 totk 差异文件含 macOS 专属调用
（TargetConditionals、frontend.m 设置面板、iOS 导出分支等），逐文件人工 OHOS 化后才能进 override。

- **totk 独有 17 文件**：`game_patches_v143.c`/`game_patches_botw.c`（非本版本，不需要）、
  `game_patches.c`（已取可移植子集，其余见下）、`world_survey.c`+`world_survey.h`（测试剖面，
  含 runtime_bench_cam——模板 world_survey.h 无此符号，随 world_survey 一起移植）、
  `aspect_patch.h`+`aspect_math.h`（超宽屏；上游 1.1.2 本就不支持，优先级低）、
  `aoc_romfs.c`（DLC RomFS 挂载）、`game_data.c/h`（存档数据布局）、`settings_service.c`/
  `settings_panel.h`（Mac 设置面板服务）、`game_language.h`、`bow_state.h`、`contrib_submit.h`、
  `feedback_settings.h`、`hid_imu.h`、`mem_scan.h`、`switch_left_fallback.h`、`text_keyboard.h`。
- **36 个同名差异文件**（totk vs odyssey，按影响排序）：`services.c`（内存布局/GetInfo 面，~152 行差异——
  内存键已进 game.tsv，M4+ 参数化注入后宿主侧收敛）、`loader.c`（~199 行，含 per-version 数据页/补丁区）、
  `threads.c`（~659 行，调度差异）、`runtime.h`（~74 行，钩子面差异——模板钩子面是 odyssey 版）、
  `romfs.c`（~106 行，overlay/aoc）、`fs_host.c`、`account.c`、`applet_host.c`、`input.c`、`ipc.c/h`、
  `movie_host.c/h`、`swkbd_host.c`、`time_host.c`、`shared_font.c`、`game_version.h`（已按数据类先行）、
  `game_patches.c`（已取子集）、`world_survey.c/h`、`gamepad.m/.h` 系、`frontend*.m`、`gfx_probe.c`、
  `gpu_path_probe.m`、`hid_feedback.c`、`motion_fusion.c`、`audio_mixer/renderer`、`autoload.c`、
  `controller_map.h`、`gamepad_layout.h`、`mouse_look.h`、`aspect_math.h`。
- **game_patches.c 内未移植的特性块**（依赖上述文件或 Mac 语义）：patch_realtime+patch_cloth_clock
  （真实帧步进 + 布料/毛发时钟；需 loader 数据页集成——OHOS loader 已留 0x4000 页，M3 真机阶段移植）、
  patch_render_res/patch_output_res（TOTK_RENDER_RES/TOTK_OUTPUT_RES）、patch_pchtxt、
  1.2.1 的 cursor_speed/bench_cam（非本版本）。

## 待真机阶段（M3 后半）验证清单

0. **签名**：DevEco Signing Configs → Fix 为 com.vibecc.totk 生成调试签名材料后重跑构建（见文末签名说明）。
1. **boot 序列**：rawfile 四件 + runtime_tables（gates 862 条 spin）能否过 nninitStartup——重点看
   `SetHeapSize(0x86000000)` 后的 alias 布局（mem_reserve 0x140000000 / mem_alias 0x98000000 是 1.4.3
   heap check 产物，1.1.2 未实测）。
2. **sdk node area 未裁剪**：1.1.2 sdk 无 1GB→62MB 裁剪，若初期下洞遇 MSF/血月回位（内存不足），
   为 sdk b9046c31… 定位 AddressRegionManager 构造子同型裁剪（1.4.3 在 sdk+0x145d0c/0x145d78，
   1.1.2 偏移需在镜像里找 `08fca752`/`09fca752` 型 mov 对）。
3. **60fps 运行时补丁**：fps60_sites 7 条 + 蹦床 veneer 的指令字校验是否全过（本地 ExeFS 与 Mac 同源，
   理论必过；若重写器将来动了这些位点的字节则停机报告）；TOTK_FPS60=0 可关闭对照。
4. **RomFS 16 卷导入**：DocumentViewPicker 整包 + HTTP 拉取清单（模板已按 ROMFS_VOLUMES 泛化）；
   romfs_config 的 IMAGE/INDEX SHA 校验。
5. **字体**：embedded 伪造 BFTTF 六槽（与游戏无关、smo 同源）；TOTK_SHARED_FONTS=<dir> 真固件通道备用
   （expected-v1.1.2.json 里另有固件字体哈希，fonts_mode=firmware 时用）。
6. **着色器/图形**：M4 nvn_vk 实装后（render_cond/tex_flush_upload/tex_dirty_upload 三键在真机才见效果；
   Vulkan 侧 BC 纹理格式支持待验）。
7. RomFS 与 Mac pin 的 ~6MB 差异归属（可 diff 两侧索引）。

## 怎么构建（M1 管线，PC 侧）

`nxnative-ohos/games/0100F2C0115B6000/host_override/entry/src/main/cpp/host/game_patches.c`:

```c
/* game_patches.c —— Tears of the Kingdom 1.1.2 (v262144) 运行时游戏补丁，鸿蒙最小移植版（档案 host_override）。
   覆盖模板 game_patches.tmpl.c（弱符号兜底）——本文件必须提供宿主引用的全部钩子符号，故下方其余钩子
   全部以无操作实现收口。
   血统：MacNativeGames games/totk/runtime/game_patches.c（766 行）。本文件只移植**数据表驱动、自校验**
   的三块，其余特性列入"待 OHOS 化"清单（见档案 README）：
     已移植（位点出自 game_version.h 的 TOTK_GAME_V112 表；本机 ExeFS 与 Mac 1.1.2 逐字节同源）：
       - fps60_sites       7 条指令字替换：present-interval 下限 2（30fps）→1（60fps），逐条先校验原字
       - patch_slowmo_bounce  >100fps 蹦床慢动作误判修正（veneer 写入 main text padding +128，自含 branch）
       - patch_trap        诊断：TOTK_TRAP_AT=<off> 写 brk #0（真机验尸用）
     待 OHOS 化（不在本文件，勿盲拷 Mac 版）：
       - patch_realtime + patch_cloth_clock（真实帧步进 + 布料/毛发时钟；依赖 loader 在 main 后保留的
         0x4000 数据页——OHOS loader.c 已有该页（size=page_up(file_size)+0x4000），但整块补丁含 ADRP/
         veneer 与 present 线程集成，M3 真机阶段移植）
       - patch_render_res / patch_output_res（TOTK_RENDER_RES/TOTK_OUTPUT_RES 输出分辨率面）
       - patch_pchtxt（模拟器 pchtxt 补丁加载，Mac 文件系统路径语义）
       - aspect_patch.h 超宽屏（上游 1.1.2 本就不支持：仅 1.2.1/1.4.3）
       - world_survey.c（totk 变体的测试剖面）
   注意：fps60 运行时补丁与档案 patches.py 的重写器 FRAME_STEP 是**两条并行机制**（后者仅登记 1.4.3）；
   若未来为 1.1.2 登记了重写器帧步进，须删掉这里的 fps60 或用 TOTK_FPS60=0 关闭，勿双份叠加。 */
#include "game_patches.h"
#include "game_version.h"
#include "world_survey.h"
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

typedef struct { uint64_t offset; uint32_t original, replacement; const char *what; } GamePatch;

/* 60 FPS（Mac 上游 PR #61 前身 / FPSLocker 同族）：TOTK 的自适应 present-interval 控制器把主线程实测
   帧工作量换算成 60Hz tick 数并钳到 [min,max]，同时交给 nvnWindowSetPresentInterval 与变帧步进。
   出厂 min=2（30fps）。补丁把下限降到 1：控制器仍会在单帧工作量放不下时自动升到 2/3（30/20fps，带
   自家迟滞），慢场景以正确速度回落。位点经 GAME_ADDR() 取 1.1.2 偏移；每条先校验原指令字，任何一条
   不匹配即停机（不盲写）。TOTK_FPS60=0 关闭（保持出厂 2..3）。 */
static const GamePatch fps60_sites[] = {
    {GAME_ADDR(0x8f6c60), 0x6b08015f, 0x7100055f, "clamp: cmp w10, #1 (was cmp w10, w8 = minimum)"},
    {GAME_ADDR(0x8f6c64), 0x1a89b10a, 0x1a9fa52a, "clamp: csinc w10, w9, wzr, ge (desired = max(desired, 1))"},
    {GAME_ADDR(0x8f6c88), 0xb9401a8a, 0xd503201f, "lower trigger: nop the stored-candidate load (try lower when desired < current)"},
    {GAME_ADDR(0x8f6d18), 0x6b08015f, 0x7100055f, "raise path: cmp w10, #1"},
    {GAME_ADDR(0x8f6d28), 0x1a88c1ac, 0x1a9fc5ac, "raise path: csinc w12, w13, wzr, gt (next lower candidate floors at 1)"},
    {GAME_ADDR(0x8f6d7c), 0xb9400288, 0x52800028, "lower path: mov w8, #1 (minimum interval 1)"},
    {GAME_ADDR(0x8f6d98), 0x2a0a03f5, 0x1a9fa555, "lower path: csinc w21, w10, wzr, ge (result never below 1)"},
};

static int fps60_enabled(void) {
    const char *e = getenv("TOTK_FPS60");
    return !(e && !strcmp(e, "0"));
}

static uint32_t branch_to(uint64_t site, uint64_t target) {   /* b <target>, both offsets in main */
    int64_t delta = (int64_t)target - (int64_t)site;
    if ((delta & 3) || delta < -(1 << 27) || delta >= (1 << 27)) runtime_fail("patch branch outside range");
    return 0x14000000u | ((uint32_t)(delta >> 2) & 0x3ffffffu);
}

/* 高帧率修正（#61，天空岛蹦床）：出厂检查 X+0x28>100 在 >100fps 时把正常运行误判成时间减速，
   蹦床不弹。veneer 改比 X+0x28*X+0x38（=30/时间倍率，30Hz 下同值、与帧率无关）。
   veneer 放 main text padding +128（上游 1.2.1 ultrawide veneers 之后的位置；1.1.2 无 ultrawide，
   padding 从 text_end 起空）。TOTK_HIGHFPS_FIX=0 关闭。 */
static void patch_slowmo_bounce(Module *m) {
    const char *e = getenv("TOTK_HIGHFPS_FIX");
    if (e && !strcmp(e, "0")) return;
    const uint64_t site = GAME_ADDR(0xce3fec), stub = ((m->text_end + 15) & ~15ULL) + 128;
    if (stub + 20 > ((m->text_end + 15) & ~15ULL) + 0x400) runtime_fail("bounce veneer layout");
    static const uint32_t original[3] = {0xbd402900,   /* ldr s0, [x8, #0x28] */
                                         0x52a85908,   /* mov w8, #0x42c80000 (100.0) */
                                         0x1e270101};  /* fmov s1, w8 */
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        uint32_t w; memcpy(&w, m->base + site + 4 * i, 4);
        if (w != original[i]) runtime_fail("bounce check: original instruction mismatch");
    }
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 20; i++) if (m->base[stub + i]) runtime_fail("bounce veneer padding not empty");
    const uint32_t veneer[5] = {0xbd402900,   /* ldr s0, [x8, #0x28]: X+0x28 */
                                0xbd403901,   /* ldr s1, [x8, #0x38]: the 30 Hz ratio (the next original instruction sets s1 again) */
                                0x1e210800,   /* fmul s0, s0, s1 */
                                0x52a85908,   /* mov w8, #0x42c80000: the original 100.0 */
                                branch_to(stub + 16, site + 8)};
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 5; i++) memcpy(m->base + stub + 4 * i, &veneer[i], 4);
    uint32_t jump = branch_to(site, stub);
    memcpy(m->base + site, &jump, 4);
    fprintf(stderr, "[totk] %s high-FPS fix: trampoline slow-motion check uses the time scale, veneer +%#llx\n",
            TOTK_GAME_VERSION, (unsigned long long)stub);
}

/* 诊断：TOTK_TRAP_AT=<main offset> 写 brk #0，崩在现场吐寄存器/调用链后退出（真机验尸用） */
static void patch_trap(Module *m) {
    const char *e = getenv("TOTK_TRAP_AT");
    if (!e || !*e) return;
    uint64_t off = strtoull(e, NULL, 0);
    if (off & 3 || off + 4 > m->text_end) runtime_fail("TOTK_TRAP_AT must be a 4-byte aligned offset in main's text");
    uint32_t brk = 0xd4200000, was;
    memcpy(&was, m->base + off, 4);
    memcpy(m->base + off, &brk, 4);
    fprintf(stderr, "[totk] TOTK_TRAP_AT: brk at main+%#llx (was %08x); the game stops there with a register dump\n", (unsigned long long)off, was);
}

void runtime_game_patches(Module *m) {
    if (strcmp(m->name, "main")) runtime_fail("game patches expect the main module");
    patch_slowmo_bounce(m);
    patch_trap(m);
    if (!fps60_enabled()) {
        fprintf(stderr, "[totk] 60 FPS patch off (TOTK_FPS60=0): shipping present interval range 2..3\n");
        return;
    }
    const size_t n = sizeof fps60_sites / sizeof fps60_sites[0];
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {   /* verify all before writing any */
        const GamePatch *p = &fps60_sites[i];
        if (p->offset + 4 > m->text_end) runtime_fail("60 FPS patch site outside the main text segment");
        uint32_t word; memcpy(&word, m->base + p->offset, sizeof word);
        if (word != p->original) {
            fprintf(stderr, "[totk] 60 FPS patch main+%#llx: found %08x, expected %08x (%s)\n",
                    (unsigned long long)p->offset, word, p->original, p->what);
            runtime_fail("60 FPS patch: main does not match the selected game version");
        }
    }
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) memcpy(m->base + fps60_sites[i].offset, &fps60_sites[i].replacement, 4);
    fprintf(stderr, "[totk] %s 60 FPS patch: %zu instructions (interval range 1..3)\n", TOTK_GAME_VERSION, n);
}

/* ---- 其余钩子面：无操作收口（待 OHOS 化清单里的特性落位时逐个替换；语义见模板 game_patches.tmpl.c） ---- */
void runtime_frame_step_pin(double ms) { (void)ms; }                 /* real-time frame step 未移植（见文件头） */
void runtime_frame_step_update(uint64_t now_ns) { (void)now_ns; }
int runtime_output_res(unsigned *w, unsigned *h) { (void)w; (void)h; return 0; }   /* TOTK_OUTPUT_RES 未移植 */
uint64_t runtime_output_res_extra_bytes(void) { return 0; }
uint64_t runtime_render_pool_extra(void) { return 0; }
const char *runtime_picture_name(void) { return 0; }
int runtime_output_res_toggle(void) { return 0; }
int runtime_output_mode_cycle(void) { return 0; }
uint64_t runtime_output_size_current(void) { return (uint64_t)1080 << 32 | 1920; }
int runtime_aspect_toggle(void) { return 0; }                        /* 1.1.2 无 ultrawide（上游同） */
_Atomic int runtime_survey_pending;                                  /* world_survey 未移植：默认全拒绝 */
const int32_t runtime_survey_sync[2] = {0, -1};
void runtime_survey_init(Module *main_module) { (void)main_module; }
int runtime_survey_command(const char *line) { (void)line; return 0; }
void runtime_survey_tick(uint64_t frame) { (void)frame; }
void runtime_survey_cancel_user(void) {}

```

`nxnative-ohos/games/0100F2C0115B6000/patches.py`:

```py
# The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom (0100F2C0115B6000): the rewriter's patches of this game's own builds.
# dm/tools/patch_nso.py loads every profile's patches.py and applies those of a module's NSO build ID;
# CUTS, OBS and FRAME_STEP as described there ("Registered patches"). Patches of Nintendo SDK module builds are in
# dm/tools/sdk_patches.py.
#
# —— 鸿蒙档案状态（2026-10-31，M3 前半）——
# 本档案当前为 **1.1.2（v262144，main build ID 9a10ed9435c06733da597d8094d9000a）derived profile**；
# nxnative 注册的是 1.4.3（main 277178b7dba1b6d4949a84778d4abc58）。FRAME_STEP 只按 1.4.3 build ID 键控，
# **对 1.1.2 的 main 不生效**（重写已验证：game-work/totk_build/patched/main/main.cuts.tsv 为空表头，
# 本 1.1.2 产物零指令裁剪）。下方 frame_step 的全部 main 偏移是 1.4.3 的，**1.1.2 地址未验证/未登记**——
# 补丁地址按版本变，真机阶段（M3 后半）再校，接入路线二选一：
#   a) MATCH_CUTS 指纹登记（nxnative 键表 §3：按函数指纹在未注册 build 里定位已验证位点），或
#   b) 从 MacNativeGames totk runtime 的 TOTK_GAME_V112 已验证位点表移植（本机 ExeFS 与其
#      expected-v1.1.2.json 逐字节同源；host_override/game_version.h 的 GAME_ADDR 表 + game_patches.c 的
#      运行时 FPS60 表已按该路线先行落位——运行时补丁与重写补丁是两条并行机制，取其一即可，勿双份叠加）。
# 另：1.1.2 的 sdk（b9046c31eb5d31271be970fe732d38df）不在 dm/tools/sdk_patches.py 的 CUTS 表，
# 1.4.3 依赖的 node area 1GB→62MB 裁剪未落——待真机如遇内存不足（MSF/血月）先补该 sdk 的裁剪点位。
import struct
from nso_asm import ADRP, B, NOP, STP_PRE

# Tears of the Kingdom picks a present interval each frame (main+0x2db174: 2 = 30 fps, 3 under load) and steps its game time by 60 / fps (int fps at timing +0x50, read at main+0x2daa54
# and main+0x3e562c). The stub replaces that logic: int fps = 60 / step, and the float fps (timing +0x24, unused, per masagrator's FPSLocker config for this build, which found the
# sites) the same, which the consumers read. Until the host has decided a step (the first frames) the step is the measured frame time (timing frame +0xd8, 19.2 MHz
# ticks), clamped to [1 / cap, 1 / 15 s]; game time that ran ahead after a short frame (the "lead", at most 0.25 s; totk-mobile) is paid back by later frames. Prerendered movies set a 30 cap (flag set and cleared around main+0x2b36100 /
# main+0x2b33918), the D-pad menu fade starts at full rate (FPSLocker's fix at main+0x1fbc80) and the swapchain argument at main+0xbe14a8 becomes 1 as in FPSLocker
def frame_step(ctx):
    here, emit, fs_site, fs_put, FS_STATE_OFF = ctx.here, ctx.emit, ctx.site, ctx.put, ctx.state
    # frame step (replaces ldrb w9,[x0,#0x58], the first instruction after the prologue)
    fs_site(0x2db18c, '09604139')
    start = here(); emit(ADRP(16, here(), FS_STATE_OFF))
    for w in (0xbd400200,   # ldr s0,[x16]           target fps
              0x1e202008,   # fcmp s0,#0.0
              0x54000640,   # b.eq off (+50)        target 0: original path
              0xb9402202,   # ldr w2,[x16,#0x20]     step in vsyncs
              0x340001a2,   # cbz w2,elapsed (+13)   not decided yet: by the measured frame time
              0x1e230041,   # ucvtf s1,w2
              0x1e27d003,   # fmov s3,#30.0
              0x1e211872,   # fdiv s18,s3,s1
              0x1e322a52,   # fadd s18,s18,s18       fps = 60 / step
              0xbd002412,   # str s18,[x0,#0x24]     float fps
              0x52800785,   # mov w5,#60
              0x1ac208a5,   # udiv w5,w5,w2
              0xb9005005,   # str w5,[x0,#0x50]      integer fps
              0xf9401a04,   # ldr x4,[x16,#0x30]
              0x8b224084,   # add x4,x4,w2,uxtw
              0xf9001a04):  # str x4,[x16,#0x30]     vsyncs stepped
        emit(w)
    emit(B(here(), 0x2db284))                                       # the original epilogue
    for w in (0xf9406c22,   # elapsed: ldr x2,[x1,#0xd8]  last frame time in 19.2 MHz ticks
              0x9e630041,   # ucvtf d1,x2
              0x529f0003,   # mov w3,#0xf800
              0x72a02483,   # movk w3,#0x124,lsl #16 (19,200,000)
              0x1e630062,   # ucvtf d2,w3
              0x1e621821,   # fdiv d1,d1,d2          elapsed seconds
              0xb9400604,   # ldr w4,[x16,#4]        movie flag
              0x1e27d003,   # fmov s3,#30.0
              0x7100009f,   # cmp w4,#0
              0x1e201c60,   # fcsel s0,s3,s0,ne      cap = movie ? 30 : target
              0x1e22c000,   # fcvt d0,s0
              0x1e6e1003,   # fmov d3,#1.0
              0x1e601864,   # fdiv d4,d3,d0          shortest step 1 / cap
              0x1e65d005,   # fmov d5,#15.0
              0x1e651865,   # fdiv d5,d3,d5          longest step 1 / 15
              0xfd400606,   # ldr d6,[x16,#8]        lead
              0x1e663827,   # fsub d7,d1,d6
              0x1e6448e7,   # fmax d7,d7,d4
              0x1e6558e7,   # fmin d7,d7,d5          step = clamp(elapsed - lead)
              0x1e6728c6,   # fadd d6,d6,d7
              0x1e6138c6,   # fsub d6,d6,d1          lead += step - elapsed
              0x2f00e410,   # movi d16,#0
              0x1e7048c6,   # fmax d6,d6,d16
              0x1e6a1011,   # fmov d17,#0.25
              0x1e7158c6,   # fmin d6,d6,d17         lead in [0, 0.25]
              0xfd000606,   # str d6,[x16,#8]
              0x1e671872,   # fdiv d18,d3,d7         fps = 1 / step
              0x1e624252,   # fcvt s18,d18
              0xbd002412,   # str s18,[x0,#0x24]     float fps
              0x1e380245,   # fcvtzs w5,s18
              0xb9005005,   # str w5,[x0,#0x50]      integer fps
              0xfd400e13,   # ldr d19,[x16,#0x18]
              0x1e672a73,   # fadd d19,d19,d7
              0xfd000e13):  # str d19,[x16,#0x18]    game seconds stepped
        emit(w)
    emit(B(here(), 0x2db284))                                       # the original epilogue
    emit(0x39416009); emit(B(here(), 0x2db190))                     # off: ldrb w9,[x0,#0x58]; back
    fs_put(0x2db18c, [B(0x2db18c, start)], 'frame step from the host in whole vsyncs, by elapsed time until it has decided one (state page target fps; 0 = original interval logic)')
    # the two readers of the integer fps: float fps when on; the scvtf a few instructions later moves into the stub (s0 is not touched in between)
    for site, cvt, r in ((0x2daa54, 0x2daa6c, 19), (0x3e562c, 0x3e5638, 22)):
        fs_site(site, struct.pack('<I', 0xbd425000 | r << 5).hex()); fs_site(cvt, '00d8215e')
        start = here(); emit(STP_PRE(16, 17, 31, -16)); emit(ADRP(16, here(), FS_STATE_OFF))
        for w in (0xb9400211,                # ldr w17,[x16]
                  0x34000071,                # cbz w17,off (+12)
                  0xbd422400 | r << 5,       # ldr s0,[xR,#0x224]  float fps
                  0x14000003,                # b done (+12)
                  0xbd425000 | r << 5,       # off: ldr s0,[xR,#0x250]  integer fps
                  0x5e21d800,                # scvtf s0,s0
                  0xa8c147f0):               # done: ldp x16,x17,[sp],#16
            emit(w)
        emit(B(here(), site + 4))
        fs_put(site, [B(site, start)], 'game step reads the float fps (original integer fps and scvtf when off)')
        fs_put(cvt, [NOP], 'scvtf moved into the stub at the load')
    # D-pad menu fade (w8 is overwritten right after the site)
    fs_site(0x1fbc80, '0820201e0a04081f')
    start = here(); emit(ADRP(8, here(), FS_STATE_OFF))
    for w in (0xb9400108, 0x340001a8,       # ldr w8,[x8]; cbz w8,off (+52)
              0x1e202028, 0x54000101,       # fcmp s1,#0.0; b.ne go
              0x785fa308, 0x7100151f, 0x540000a1,   # ldurh w8,[x24,#-6]; cmp w8,#5; b.ne go
              0x785f8308, 0x7100151f, 0x54000041,   # ldurh w8,[x24,#-8]; cmp w8,#5; b.ne go
              0x1e2e1008,                   # fmov s8,#1.0
              0x1f08040a, 0x1e202008, 0x14000003,   # go: fmadd s10,s0,s8,s1; fcmp s0,#0.0; b end
              0x1e202008, 0x1f08040a):      # off: the original fcmp s0,#0.0; fmadd s10,s0,s8,s1
        emit(w)
    emit(B(here(), 0x1fbc88))
    fs_put(0x1fbc80, [B(0x1fbc80, start), NOP], 'D-pad menu fade starts at full rate under fractional steps (FPSLocker)')
    # swapchain argument (x16 is dead before the bl that follows)
    fs_site(0xbe14a8, '61a24039')
    start = here(); emit(ADRP(16, here(), FS_STATE_OFF))
    for w in (0xb9400210, 0x34000070, 0x52800021, 0x14000002, 0x3940a261):   # ldr w16,[x16]; cbz w16,off; mov w1,#1; b end; off: ldrb w1,[x19,#0x28]
        emit(w)
    emit(B(here(), 0xbe14ac))
    fs_put(0xbe14a8, [B(0xbe14a8, start)], 'swapchain argument 1 when on (FPSLocker)')
    # prerendered movie start and end set and clear the flag (x16 / x17 are free at a call)
    fs_site(0x2b36100, 'b6f37097'); fs_site(0x2b33918, 'de170214')
    start = here(); emit(ADRP(16, here(), FS_STATE_OFF)); emit(0x52800031); emit(0xb9000611); emit(B(here(), 0x772fd8))   # mov w17,#1; str w17,[x16,#4]; tail call
    fs_put(0x2b36100, [B(0x2b36100, start) | 0x80000000], 'movie starts: 30 fps cap')
    start = here(); emit(ADRP(16, here(), FS_STATE_OFF)); emit(0xb900061f); emit(B(here(), 0x2bb9890))                     # str wzr,[x16,#4]; tail call
    fs_put(0x2b33918, [B(0x2b33918, start)], 'movie ends')
    # Render scale (state +0x10, float written by the loader: DM_RENDER_SCALE, 1.0 by default). main+0xd5c24 sizes each view: screen size x the view's scale (5/6 for the scene: 1600x896
    # docked) x the dynamic-resolution multiplier, clamped to 8..16384 and floored to the view's alignment. The stub multiplies both extents by the factor (s6, w8 and the flags are dead
    # at main+0xd5cc0: s6 is set to 8.0 right after); any factor but 1.0 also replaces the dynamic multiplier (main+0xd5d80) with 1, so the size is fixed. 1.0 = bit-exact original
    fs_site(0xd5cc0, '08d0a8524008251e6108241e0401271e'); fs_site(0xd5d80, '062940bd')
    start = here(); emit(ADRP(8, here(), FS_STATE_OFF))
    for w in (0xbd401106,   # ldr s6,[x8,#0x10]   render scale
              0x1e250840,   # fmul s0,s2,s5       (original)
              0x1e240861,   # fmul s1,s3,s4       (original)
              0x1e2020c8,   # fcmp s6,#0.0
              0x5400006d,   # b.le skip (+12)     not set
              0x1e260800,   # fmul s0,s0,s6
              0x1e260821,   # fmul s1,s1,s6
              0x52a8d008,   # skip: mov w8,#0x46800000 (original)
              0x1e270104):  # fmov s4,w8          (original)
        emit(w)
    emit(B(here(), 0xd5cd0))
    fs_put(0xd5cc0, [B(0xd5cc0, start)], 'view render size x the host render scale (1.0 = original)'); ctx.render_scale = 1
    start = here(); emit(0xbd402906); emit(ADRP(8, here(), FS_STATE_OFF))   # ldr s6,[x8,#0x28] (original: the dynamic multiplier); x8 is dead after it
    for w in (0xbd401107,   # ldr s7,[x8,#0x10]
              0x1e2e1010,   # fmov s16,#1.0
              0x1e3020e0,   # fcmp s7,s16
              0x54000080,   # b.eq done (+16)     scale 1: the game's dynamic resolution
              0x1e2020e8,   # fcmp s7,#0.0
              0x5400004d,   # b.le done (+8)      not set
              0x1e204206):  # fmov s6,s16         a fixed scale: no dynamic multiplier
        emit(w)
    emit(B(here(), 0xd5d84))
    fs_put(0xd5d80, [B(0xd5d80, start)], 'dynamic resolution only at render scale 1.0')

# 1.4.3 (v720896) 的 main build ID —— 1.1.2（9a10ed9435c06733da597d8094d9000a）**未登记**（地址不同，勿盲目套用；
# 见文件头。当前 1.1.2 的 60fps 走 host_override/game_patches.c 运行时补丁路线）。
FRAME_STEP = {'277178b7dba1b6d4949a84778d4abc58': frame_step}

```

`nxnative-ohos/games/README.md`:

```md
# nxnative-ohos 游戏档案：键表（game.tsv schema，权威文档）

每款游戏一个档案目录 `games/<titleID>/`（以基础版 title ID 命名，与 nxnative `dm/games/` 同构；出处：`infra/nxnative/dm/games/README.md` 开篇、`game-work/nxnative_ohos_design.md` §1）。本文是**游戏参数面 schema 的唯一权威描述**：键的完整语义以 nxnative 键表（`infra/nxnative/dm/games/README.md` L125–165 "Keys"）为准，本文在其上做鸿蒙视角的**增删与落点**标注，不重复其长注。

- 键表增删原则：`game-work/nxnative_ohos_design.md` §2（鸿蒙版键面已定）。
- 实值示例：odyssey = `0100000000010000`（Super Mario Odyssey 1.4.1），totk = `0100F2C0115B6000`（Tears of the Kingdom；nxnative 注册 1.4.3，本机转译为 1.1.2 → derived profile，见 §derived）。
- 鸿蒙侧落点 = 当前鸿蒙工程（`mario-odessy-harmony` 泛化为 `nxnative-ohos/template/`）中消费该键的生成头 / 脚本 / setenv。

## 0. 档案目录结构

```
games/<titleID>/
├── game.tsv                      # 游戏常量键值表：每行 key<TAB>value，注释独占一行（nxnative 同格式）
├── patches.py                    # 可选：本游戏自有 build 的重写器补丁（CUTS/OBS/FRAME_STEP，按 NSO build ID 键控）；
│                                 #   odyssey 当前为空（设计 §1），totk 有 143 行手写（survey L65）
├── host_override/                # 可选：整文件覆盖逃生门——runtime 宿主分叉度 ~65%，模板不可能参数化覆盖全部
│                                 #   （设计 §7；文件相对 template/ 同名路径原样替换）
├── 着色器表 TSV 族                # shader_split.py 产物 + 手工事实（详见「着色器表」组）
│   ├── shader_map.tsv (+ .conflicts.tsv)
│   ├── shader_facts.tsv / shader_facts_manual.tsv（可选，手工事实）
│   ├── shader_pairs.tsv / pso_pairs.tsv（顶点输出 padding + 管线预热的配对表）
│   ├── pso_manifest.tsv          # 预热种子清单
│   └── bf_want.tsv
├── 测试资产
│   ├── smoke.tsv / bench.tsv / usage.tsv（可选）
│   └── expected-v<版本>.json     # “expected 钉”：已验证版本的字节级验证记录（见下）
└── README.md                     # 该游戏的笔记：档案为什么长这样、怎么到达某个场景、还有什么开着
```

**expected 钉**（MacNativeGames 血统，样例 `infra/MacNativeGames/games/totk/assets/expected-v1.4.3.json`）：每个验证过的版本一份，钉住 ExeFS 源 SHA256（main/main.npdm/rtld/sdk/subsdk0）、重写产物 SHA256（`*.patched.bin`）、RomFS size+SHA256、六槽共享字体 SHA256。鸿蒙侧 `game-work/prepare_runtime_ohos.py` 当前**跳过** expected 校验（其 docstring 自述），`build_hap_from_nsp.py`（M2）恢复该纪律；构建工作区的 `.key` 指纹缓存（输入不变即跳过阶段，设计 §3）是 expected 钉的运行时形态，不入库。

**不入库**的大文件（patched.bin / RomFS 分卷 / HAP / c1_full.tsv / cb_extent.tsv）一律走 `<titleID>_build/` 工作区（`nxnative-ohos/README.md` Layout）。

## 0.1 三种游戏差异表达（优先级，铁律）

> **Everything game-specific belongs in `games/<titleID>/`. Code reads the profile; it does not hard-code a game.**
> —— `nxnative-ohos/README.md`「Architecture rule」（继承 nxnative `dm/games/README.md`）

游戏差异一律按以下优先级表达，从上往下用，能用 1 就不用 2，能用 2 就不用 3（`nxnative-ohos/README.md`）：

1. **`game.tsv` 键值**——内存布局 / 呈现行为 / 纹理策略 / 字体模式等一切可参数化的差异（本文键表全集）。
2. **`patches.py` per-build 指令补丁**——CUTS（字节裁剪，每条断言原字节）/ OBS（观察门）/ FRAME_STEP（帧步进桩），按 NSO build ID 键控；一个 build 被两个档案声明即重写报错；Nintendo `sdk` 模块的公共裁剪在 `dm/tools/sdk_patches.py`（nxnative 语义）。
3. **`host_override/` 整文件覆盖**——逃生门：odyssey↔totk 宿主 runtime 55 个同名文件仅 19 个逐字节相同（survey L76），模板不可能纯参数化覆盖全部。

运行时开关沿用宿主现有 `TOTK_*`/`ODYSSEY_*` env 面（近期不重命名，保持宿主稳定；统一化列 M4+。出处：设计 §2 尾注、`mario-odessy-harmony/entry/src/main/cpp/game_napi.cpp` 的 setenv 块）。

---

## 1. 键表

共 **43 个 game.tsv 键** = 继承 nxnative 37（43 − 删除 6，删除清单见 §2）+ 鸿蒙新增 6（§1.16）。键序沿用 nxnative Keys 表。列：`键 | 语义 | odyssey 实值 | totk 实值 | 鸿蒙侧落点 | 备注`。"—"= 档案未写该键，用默认（默认值列在备注）。

### 1.1 身份

| 键 | 语义 | odyssey 实值 | totk 实值 | 鸿蒙侧落点 | 备注 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `title_id` | 游戏 title ID | `0100000000010000` | `0100F2C0115B6000` | 档案目录名；template 实例化：rawfile 镜像目录名、game_napi 解包子目录、CMake `GAME_{{ID}}` 宏（设计 §4） | 必填；文件夹名即此值 |
| `program_id` | `svcGetInfo(ProgramId)` 应答值 | `0100000000010000` | `0100F2C0115B6000` | 生成 `game_version.h` 的 `GAME_TITLE_ID`（当前 odyssey 值 `0x0100000000010000ULL`） | 必填；可与 title_id 不同 |
| `name` | 游戏名，仅作 `game.py list`/报错/窗口标题的标签；真正的名字 NSP 脚本从 control 数据（NACP）读 | `Super Mario Odyssey` | `The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom` | `hap_label` 的默认值；hilog 日志文案 | 必填；玩家可见名字以 NACP 为准 |

### 1.2 版本

| 键 | 语义 | odyssey 实值 | totk 实值 | 鸿蒙侧落点 | 备注 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `build` | 每个被带起来的版本一行：`build <ver> <display> <模块>=<build ID>…` | `v393216 1.4.1 main=b424be150a8e7d78701cbe7a439d9ebf subsdk0=93ff8252d975adf07230cb86c83301c5 sdk=fcf93a41b08c5193a1410d262602dc62` | `v720896 1.4.3 main=277178b7dba1b6d4949a84778d4abc58 subsdk0=f39f4c431234c72eb520cfdd1001bbcf sdk=574284b40c06cf1821a44857939083be` | 重写步骤按 build ID 匹配产物；`prepare_runtime`（泛化自 `game-work/prepare_runtime_ohos.py`）读 `<id>_build/patched/<模块>/`（patched.bin + fixups.tsv + gates.tsv）；生成 `game_version.h` 版本串 | build ID 是 32 位 hex；`game_version.h` 当前注释 "1.3.0" 但 main build ID `b424be15…` 即 1.4.1 的 main，以 build ID 为准 |
| `package` | 档案的表 / 预热清单 / 笔记制作时所用的版本；NSP 脚本打包文件夹里最新版（`-p` 可另选） | `v393216` | `v720896` | `build_hap_from_nsp.py` 选版本 | 必填 |
| `shader_versions` | 着色器表是哪些版本的并集（基础版在前）；不在文件夹内的版本 → derived profile | `v393216` | `v720896` | 着色器拆分步骤（shader_split.py） | 决定"注册版本 vs derived"的判据，见 §3 |

### 1.3 模块

| 键 | 语义 | odyssey 实值 | totk 实值 | 鸿蒙侧落点 | 备注 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `modules` | 重写并加载的代码模块，按加载序 | `main subsdk0 sdk` | `main subsdk0 sdk` | `prepare_runtime` 的模块表 → `generated/runtime_tables.h` 的 `Module modules[]`（当前脚本硬编码 `["main","subsdk0","sdk"]`，泛化后读本键；`rtld` 由宿主替换） | 必填；rtld 不列 |
| `romfs_marker` | 必须存在于 RomFS 的一个路径（归属校验）；空值 = 程序无数据段时直接查目录本身 | `SoundData/SeResourceStd2nd.aras` | `Pack/ZsDic.pack.zs` | 提取步骤（nx_extract 之后）校验 RomFS 归属 | 必填；survey 取最大 RomFS 文件 |

### 1.4 内存（客机体地址空间与配额）

消费方：宿主 `host/services.c` 的客体内存布局（当前为 TOTK_* env + 编译期常量；M1 参数化后由档案经 setenv / 生成头注入）。

| 键 | 语义 | odyssey 实值 | totk 实值 | 鸿蒙侧落点 | 备注 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mem_reserve` | 客体地址空间总预留 | `0x100000000`（4 GiB） | `0x140000000`（5 GiB） | `services.c` 预留策略（当前 `GUEST_ADDRESS_LIMIT 2^39` + iOS/搜洞逻辑，`TOTK_ALIAS_GIB` 钉大小） | 十六进制字节；totk 5 GiB = 256MB 前置 + 2.375GB alias + 256MB 栈 + 2.125GB 堆（totk game.tsv 注释） |
| `mem_alias` | alias 区大小 | `0x10000000`（256 MiB） | `0x98000000`（2.375 GiB） | `services.c` `alias_requested()`；env `TOTK_ALIAS_GIB`（默认按平台 64/16 GiB 搜缩） | totk 值来自 heap check：`SetHeapSize(0x86000000)` 逼出的手调 |
| `mem_stack` | 栈区大小 | `0x10000000`（256 MiB） | `0x10000000`（256 MiB） | `services.c` `STACK_SIZE`（当前硬编码 0x10000000，与两档案一致） | |
| `app_pool` | 应用内存池（`GetInfo` 应答） | `0xCD500000`（3.24 GiB） | `0xCD500000` | `services.c` `app_pool()`：`TOTK_APP_POOL` env，缺省 `0xcd500000` + 输出分辨率附加 | 零售 Switch 池 3.2 GiB 量级 |
| `mem_used` | `GetInfo(UsedMemorySize)` 在堆之外应答的已用量 | —（默认 `0x4000000`） | —（默认 `0x4000000`） | `services.c` `GetInfo` case 7/22 应答 | 默认 64 MiB；模块超过 64 MiB 的游戏必须调大（Age of Calamity 72MB / Cuphead 84MB，nxnative 例） |
| `sys_resource` | NPDM 声明的系统资源（main.npdm META +0x14），`GetInfo(TotalSystemResourceSize)` 应答；非 0 ⇒ `IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled` 为真 | —（宿主旧答案 `0x2000000`/32 MiB） | —（NPDM 实为 24 MiB，totk 注释说明；档案未写则宿主答 32 MiB） | `services.c` `SYSTEM_RESOURCE_BUDGET`（当前 32 MiB 常量）；survey 从 NPDM 自动写入 | 可省但 survey 会补；影响游戏自选内存形态（totk 因此走 alias 区） |
| `mem_map_limit` | `MapPhysicalMemory` 越过应用池时按 Horizon 报 ResultLimitReached | —（默认 off） | —（默认 off） | `services.c` `MapPhysicalMemory` 路径 | on/off；Pokémon Z-A 类"放完再收"的游戏需要 on |

### 1.5 启动与运行时行为

| 键 | 语义 | odyssey 实值 | totk 实值 | 鸿蒙侧落点 | 备注 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `game_args` | 命令行无参时传给游戏的参数（空格切分） | —（无） | —（无） | 宿主 loader 的 argv 缺省（`dmhost <dir> -- …` 覆盖） | 可省；如 Octopath 0 的 `-SwitchVirtualAddressSpaceSize=2048` |
| `game_env` | 游戏 `getenv` 应答的 `KEY=VALUE` 对（空格分隔） | —（无） | —（无） | 宿主 hle_os 的 getenv 面 | 可省；如 Absolum 的 `DOTNET_GCRegionRange=60000000` |
| `core_preempt` | 每次 SVC 后额外检查钉在同核的高优 runnable 线程 | —（默认 off） | —（默认 off） | `host/threads.c` 调度近似 | on/off；`DM_PREEMPT` 覆盖 |
| `alloc_big_align` | `StandardAllocator::Allocate` 把 ≥64KB 的块对齐到 64KB | —（默认 off） | —（默认 off） | 宿主 hle_os 分配器行为 | on/off；Vanillaware 系必需，否则环堆基址 0 → 空指针写 |

### 1.6 图形行为（呈现 / 深度 / 回放）

| 键 | 语义 | odyssey 实值 | totk 实值 | 鸿蒙侧落点 | 备注 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `present_interval` | `game`（默认）：按游戏设置的 present interval 配帧；`display`：每个显示 tick 一帧 | —（默认 `game`） | —（默认 `game`） | 宿主 present 层（M4 nvn_vk 实装后的呈现节奏） | `DM_PRESENT_INTERVAL` 覆盖 |
| `device_api` | `nvnDeviceGetInteger` 应答的 NVN API `major.minor` | —（按 SDK 推导：SDK≥11 → 55.15，≤10 → 53.313） | —（同左，SDK 20.5 ⇒ 55.15） | `nvn_vk` 层 API 版本应答 | 可省；`DM_NVN_API` 覆盖；不进着色器链版本 |
| `depth_mode` | 管线预构建用的深度模式：`gl`（默认，near=−w）/ `zero`（near=0） | —（默认 `gl`） | —（默认 `gl`） | M4 Vulkan 管线预构建（对齐 nxnative 离线管线档案语义） | 主机侧运行时跟随游戏设置；错值只损失预构建 |
| `render_base` | 3D 视图基准尺寸（dock 然后掌机，如 `1600x900 1280x720`）：渲染缩放所缩的基准 | —（无渲染缩放桩） | —（无渲染缩放桩） | 设置面：渲染缩放行的 `base`（像素显示）；env `TOTK_RENDER_RES` 配合 | 仅带渲染缩放桩（重写表 `RENDER_SCALE`）的 build 才有；只写档案笔记记载过的尺寸 |
| `render_cond` | 条件渲染在回放时求值；时间戳报文 counter 字段按 GPU 置 0 | —（默认 off） | `on`（不加则清屏全跑、3D 场景黑） | 回放层条件渲染路径 | on/off；动物森友会同需 on |
| `gpu_timestamps` | 时间戳报文记录什么：`submission`（默认）/ `segment`（GPU 段起止） | —（默认 `submission`） | —（默认 `submission`；BotW 需 `segment`） | 回放层 report counter 路径 | `DM_NVN_GPU_TS` 覆盖 |
| `vconv_range` | CPU 侧转换的顶点属性只按每 draw 实际读到的顶点范围转换 | —（默认 off） | —（默认 off） | 回放层顶点转换（`vconv_bind` 语义） | on/off；Age of Calamity 类整池 bind 的游戏必需 |
| `feedback_snap` | 采样自己 render pass 颜色附着 的片元键（前缀），须读快照 | —（无） | —（无） | 回放层 pass 拆分 + 拷贝（Metal 限制的起因；Vulkan 侧为 feedback loop 约束的对应决策点，M4 复核） | 8–16 位小写 hex 键前缀列表；只列实测会坏的着色器 |

### 1.7 纹理

| 键 | 语义 | odyssey 实值 | totk 实值 | 鸿蒙侧落点 | 备注 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tex_flush_upload` | CPU 原地写入、用 `nvnMemoryPoolFlushMappedRange` 发布的纹理按打包纹理上传，页变重传 | —（默认 off） | `on`（流送纹理全走此路，不加 3D 黑屏） | `host/nvn_tex.c` 上传路径 | on/off |

| `tex_dyn_slots` | 句柄追不到单槽位的着色器走 fallback 数组 + c2 槽位表绑定 | —（默认 off） | —（默认 off） | 回放层纹理/采样器绑定表 | on/off；仅对句柄确实来自 c2 表的游戏正确；不进链版本 |

### 1.15 设置（玩家面）

nxnative 的玩家设置是 `dm/games/settings.tsv` 共享表（一行一设置：env 变量 / 类型 / 默认 / 显示条件 / 分区 Game|Controls|Performance；默认可用 `DM_GAME_<NAME>` 宏解析到档案键，`<ios>|<mac>` 选平台值），由 `settings.py` 按游戏裁进 app 的 `launcher.json`。鸿蒙侧 **M5 前不建 launcher**：玩家可调项由 `game_napi.cpp` 的 setenv 块 + `run_cycle.sh` 顶替，诊断开关一律 env-only（对齐 nxnative "diagnostic switches stay environment-only" 语义）。

| 设置面（nxnative settings.tsv 行） | 解析到的档案键 | odyssey 默认 | totk 默认 | 鸿蒙当前落点 | 备注 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `DM_FPS_TARGET`（Frame rate） | `fps_target` | 0 | 60 | env 面（`TOTK_UNCAPPED*` 系） | 30/60/0 |
| `DM_OPMODE`（Console mode） | `op_mode` | 1（dock） | 1 | env `TOTK_OPERATION_MODE` | |
| `DM_RENDER_SCALE`（Render scale，base= `render_base`） | `render_base` | —（无渲染缩放桩） | — | env `TOTK_RENDER_RES` | `render_base` 是 3D 视图基准尺寸（如 `1600x900 1280x720`），只有带渲染缩放桩的 build 才有 |
| `DM_LANG`（Game language） | 无（来自 control 数据语言表） | 多语 | 多语 | env `TOTK_LANG/TOTK_LOCALE` | languages>1 才显示 |

（nxnative 设置表中的 `DM_PRESENT_SNAP`/`DM_PSO_MTL4`/`DM_PSO_PREBUILD`/`DM_NVN_ENC_THREAD` 等 Metal 侧行随其键一并删除，见 §2。）

### 1.16 鸿蒙新增组（hap_* / romfs_* / fonts_mode / nvn_backend）

出处：设计 §2 新增键表。这一组是 `game.tsv` 键（非文件）。

| 键 | 语义 | odyssey 实值 | totk 实值 | 鸿蒙侧落点 | 备注 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hap_bundle` | 应用 bundleName | `com.vibecc.smo`（`AppScope/app.json5` 现值） | 待 M3 起草（模式 `com.vibecc.<id>`） | template `AppScope/app.json5.tmpl` 的 `{{GAME_ID}}` 占位（设计 §4.1） | 默认按游戏 |
| `hap_label` | 应用名（桌面图标下与Ability 标签） | `马里奥奥德赛`（`string.json` `ability_label`；AppScope label 走 `$string:app_name`） | 待 M3 | `app.json5` label / `entry/src/main/module.json5` ability_label + `resources/.../element/string.json` | 默认取 NACP 游戏名 |

| `fonts_mode` | 共享字体来源：`embedded`（Windows TTF 伪造 BFTTF 内嵌）/ `firmware`（真机固件 BFTTF，校验后外置） | `embedded`（`make_shared_fonts.py`：6 槽位、3,440,036 B 唯一数据、自校验通过） | 待定（`TOTK_SHARED_FONTS=<dir>` 调试通道已留） | `tools/make_shared_fonts.py`（embedded 生成 `shared_fonts_data.h`/`shared_fonts_config.h`；firmware 校验真 BFTTF，设计 §3 步骤 5） | 默认 embedded；与 `shared_font` 键正交（那个管格式语义，这个管来源） |
| `nvn_backend` | 图形后端选择（预留） | `vulkan`（`nvn_vk/` 目录在位，M4 实装） | `vulkan` | M4：宿主图形层后端选择；当前唯一合法值 `vulkan` | 默认 vulkan |
