```
## 2. 鸿蒙删除的 nxnative 键

设计 §2：删除"pso_mtl4、ipa、zip_store、pad_layout(Apple) **等 Metal/iOS 专属**"键。逐键清单与原因：

| 删除键 | nxnative 语义 | 删除原因 |
|---|---|---|
| `ipa` | iOS 应用默认 IPA 文件名（`org.nxnative.<titleID>` bundle ID 等） | iOS 打包面；鸿蒙出包是 HAP，由 `hap_bundle`/`hap_label`/`hap_icon` 取代 |
| `app_category` | App Store 分类 | Apple 商店元数据，鸿蒙无对应面 |
| `zip_store` | IPA 内不压缩存储的扩展名（odyssey `.aras:.bfsar:.bfstm:.mp4:.szs:.metallib`；totk `.zs:.bwav:.mc:.webm:.metallib`） | IPA 打包选项；鸿蒙 RomFS 走外置分卷（不进 HAP，4GB 上限，设计 §3 步骤 6），无 zip 面 |
| `pso_mtl4` | iOS 上经 MTL4Compiler 的管线编译 + 离线管线档案 + 拉取库 | Metal 4 专属编译器面；鸿蒙 Vulkan 侧管线策略待 M4 另立新键 |
| `present_snap` | present 快照环（`nvn_mtl.m`，拷贝每帧 present 让游戏 swapchain 纹理立即可复用，消除 GPU 帧间空转；iOS launcher Frame buffering 设置） | Metal 交换链机制；Vulkan 呈现模型不同。M4 若 Vulkan 路径需要同语义（present 后立即释放游戏 swapchain 纹理），以新键回流 |
| `pad_layout` | iPhone 虚拟手柄首发布局（simple/full/touch；`DmGamepad.m`） | Apple 触壳专属；鸿蒙触壳是 ArkTS/XComponent 面，布局由宿主 `gamepad_layout.h` 的 env（`TOTK_FACE_BUTTONS`/`TOTK_MINIMAL_LAYOUT`）承担 |

共删 6 键（43 → 37）。`feedback_snap` **保留**：其动因（同 render pass 写+采样同一附着）在 Vulkan 侧同样有 feedback loop 约束，是回放层的真实决策点，M4 复核。

---

## 3. derived profile（未注册版本）

对齐 `infra/nxnative/docs/development.md` 第 143 步语义：

- 档案未注册的版本（档案只注册了 update 而只给基础版、另一个 update、或文件 build ID 不同），或着色器表需要的版本不全在文件夹里，**照常可构建**：从该档案派生一个 profile 到 `<id>_build/profile/<id>/`——同样的键 + 该版本自己的 build 行 + 该版本自己文件做出的着色器表、链头、`c1_full.tsv`、`cb_extent.tsv`（同 provisional profile，**不做 heap check**）。
- 红线：注册 build 的重写裁剪与宿主修复**触及不到**另一个 build 的模块；脚本会点名哪些模块未注册。
- build 查找链：无档案的 title ID 先按 main build ID 反查（同 build 的区售版 → `same_build` 派生，用文件夹的 title ID 与 npdm 的 program ID），查不到才进 survey。
- 鸿蒙侧的现成案例：**totk 1.1.2**。nxnative 档案注册 1.4.3（`v720896`），本机转译产物是 1.1.2（`game-work/totk_0100F2C0115B6000/`，survey L118/127）→ M3 走 derived profile；1.4.3 的 patches.py（FRAME_STEP 等）不落 1.1.2 的 main，需 `MATCH_CUTS` 指纹登记或为 1.1.2 补 build 行与补丁（设计 §7 风险第 2 条）。

---

## 4. 新游戏接入 checklist（NSP → HAP，按序）

> 每步产物有 `.key` 指纹缓存（sha256 of 输入），输入不变即跳过（设计 §3；对齐 nxnative 阶段复用）。

1. **备料**：游戏的 NSP（基础版 + 可选 update）+ `prod.keys`。放入工作区。
2. **识别**：跑 `scripts/build_hap_from_nsp.py`（M2）。有档案 → 直接用；无档案 → survey（`<NSP>/<titleID>_survey/survey.md`：模块与 build ID / SDK / 引擎 / 图形 API 标记 / RomFS 容器 / 重写点位普查 / 与宿主钩子的导入对比）+ `new_game.py` 起草档案（身份、build 行、`modules` 按导入猜、内存分区猜测、`shader_groups` 按 RomFS 顶层、Hagi 类引擎预设 `op_mode handheld`）。版本不在注册内 → derived profile（§3）。
3. **game.tsv 定稿**：按本文键表分组填键——身份 3 / 版本 3 / 模块 2 / 内存 7 / 启动 4 / 图形行为 8 / 纹理 3 / 帧率 2 / 输入壳 2 / 字体 1 / 着色器拆分 2（继承 37）+ 鸿蒙组 6 = 43；带起时实测修正内存键（heap check 产物），短期跑不定的键（render_cond、tex_flush_upload、tex_dirty_upload、core_preempt、gpu_timestamps、feedback_snap、vconv_range、present_interval 及预设外的 op_mode）保默认。
4. **patches.py**：本游戏 build 的 CUTS/OBS/FRAME_STEP（先跑不加补丁的重写，按 boot 尸检逐个补）；sdk 模块裁剪走 sdk_patches；未注册 build 用 MATCH_CUTS 指纹登记。
5. **重写**：`patch_nso`（复用 nxnative）→ `<id>_build/patched/<模块>/`（patched.bin + cuts/obs/fixups/gates/sites TSV）。
6. **着色器表**：`DM_GAME=<id> shader_split.py` 生成 shader_map/facts/pairs/pso_pairs；补空 `shader_map.tsv.conflicts.tsv`、`bf_want.tsv`、`pso_manifest.tsv`（拷 Mario 头）；机器看不出的手工事实进 `shader_facts_manual.tsv`。（Vulkan/GL/GLSLC/Unreal pak/Trinity pack 类运行时生成着色器的捕获流程按 nxnative "What the game files decide at every build" 节走。）
7. **生成头三件**：`tools/prepare_runtime.py`（档案驱动）→ `generated/runtime_tables.h`（模块表/符号/重定位/gates，吃 §1.2/§1.3 键）+ `romfs_config.h`（占位）+ `shared_fonts_config.h`。
8. **字体**：`fonts_mode` 决定——`embedded`：`tools/make_shared_fonts.py` 用 Windows TTF 伪造 BFTTF 内嵌（生成 `shared_fonts_data.h` + 六行 rows，幂等可复现）；`firmware`：校验真 BFTTF（不可分发，外置）。
9. **RomFS**：`tools/make_romfs_runtime.py` → DMROMFS1 → TOTKRFS1 `runtime-index.bin` + `romfs_volume_mib` 等大分卷（末卷短），写实 `romfs_config.h`（SIZE/IMAGE_SHA256/INDEX_SHA256）。分卷外置导入，不进 HAP（4GB 上限）。
10. **出包**：template 实例化——`app.json5`（hap_bundle/label/versionName）、module.json5（hap_icon/ability_label）、CMake `GAME_{{ID}}`、`game_hooks.tmpl`（game_patches.c / game_aspect.c / game_version.h；`host_override/` 有文件则原样覆盖）→ `hvigor assembleHap` → 签名 HAP。
11. **装机验证**：`tools/run_cycle.sh` 真机构建-装机-点火-验尸循环；boot 推进的坑记 `PITFALLS.md`。
12. **固化**：跑通的版本补 `expected-v<ver>.json` 钉（ExeFS 源/重写产物/RomFS/字体 SHA256）+ `smoke.tsv` 冒烟路线 + 档案 README 笔记；`usage.tsv` 由 harness 生成自证键面。
```

`nxnative-ohos/scripts/build_hap_from_nsp.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""build_hap_from_nsp.py —— M2 总入口：NSP + prod.keys → 签名 HAP（纯 PC 侧，绝不碰设备/hdc）。

七步流（nxnative-ohos 设计 §3，对齐 nxnative scripts/build_ipa_from_nsp.py 的端到端语义）：

  NSP(+update) + prod.keys
   1 identify  读 NSP 票据/文件名 titleID → games/<id>/ 档案；
              无档案 → survey 摘要（模块 build ID 表）并退出码 2（提示 new_game.py 起草）
   2 extract   nx_extract（infra/nxnative dm/tools，LibHac）→ ExeFS/ + RomFS.img（--romfs-image）
   3 rewrite   patch_nso.py 逐模块 → patched/<模块>/<模块>.patched.bin + TSV 五件套
              （游戏模块补丁 = 档案 patches.py，经 DM_GAMES_DIR 注入；sdk = nxnative sdk_patches）
   4-7 hap     转调 M1 build_hap_from_profile.py（instantiate/prepare/build/report，档案驱动出包）

指纹缓存（对齐 nxnative development.md:153-157 机制）：extract / rewrite_<模块> / hap 三类
.key 文件放 <work>/keys/，内容 = 输入指纹 sha256 + 完成时写的 note 行；输入不变 → 该步
跳过并报 reused。删 .key 即强制重跑（--force 全部无视）。

退出码：0 成功；1 错误（progress 协议带 reason）；2 未知游戏（survey 已写，需 new_game.py）。

用法（M2 验收）：
  python scripts/build_hap_from_nsp.py "E:/Yuzu/游戏/马里奥奥德赛 [版本1.4.1]/nsp主体" \
      --update ../game-work/nsp/[UPD][v1.4.1][0100000000010800][v393216].nsp --progress
  （nsp 参数可以是装 NSP 的文件夹，也可以是单个 NSP 文件；update 缺省取文件夹里版本号最高的）
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]              # switch2hos/
NXN = REPO / "nxnative-ohos"
NXNATIVE = REPO / "infra" / "nxnative"                  # 只读：提取/重写工具链
DM_TOOLS = NXNATIVE / "dm" / "tools"

DEFAULT_KEYS = "E:/Yuzu/user/keys/prod.keys"            # PROJECT_ENV.md 记载的本机 keys 位置

PROGRESS = False
FAILED = None                                           # fail 事件的 stage，供 finally 兜底


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- progress ----
def ev(kind, **kw):
    """--progress json：stdout 每行一个 JSON 事件（对齐 M1 build_hap_from_profile.py 协议）。"""
    if PROGRESS:
        print(json.dumps({"event": kind, "ts": round(time.time(), 3), **kw}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)


def log(stage, step, detail):
    if PROGRESS:
        ev("step", stage=stage, step=step, detail=detail)
    else:
        print(f"[{stage}] {step}: {detail}", flush=True)


class Stage:
    """一个阶段的计时与 stage/stage_end 事件；with 块异常退出时发 fail。"""
    def __init__(self, name, note=""):
        self.name, self.note, self.t0 = name, note, time.time()

    def __enter__(self):
        ev("stage", stage=self.name, status="start")
        if not PROGRESS:
            print(f"[{self.name}] …{(' ' + self.note) if self.note else ''}", flush=True)
        return self

    def __exit__(self, et, e, tb):
        global FAILED
        if et is None:
            ev("stage_end", stage=self.name, ok=True, secs=round(time.time() - self.t0, 1))
            if not PROGRESS:
                print(f"[{self.name}] done ({time.time() - self.t0:.1f}s)", flush=True)
        else:
            FAILED = self.name
        return False


def die(reason, code=1):
    """失败出口：progress 模式发 fail 事件（带 reason），普通模式打印后退出。"""
    if PROGRESS:
        ev("fail", stage=FAILED or "-", reason=reason)
    else:
        print(f"FATAL: {reason}", file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
    sys.exit(code)


# ------------------------------------------------------------- 指纹缓存 ----
def file_digest(p: Path) -> str:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with open(p, "rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()


def fingerprint(*items):
    """sha256 over 输入。item 形如：
       ('files', [paths])  文件名+内容（缺失记 'missing'）
       ('stat',  [paths])  文件名+大小+mtime（大文件：NSP/镜像/工具二进制）
       ('repr',  obj)      任意可 repr 值（flag、路径布局）
    对齐 nxnative build_ipa_from_nsp.py fingerprint() 的分形。"""
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    for kind, v in items:
        h.update(f"\0{kind}\0".encode())
        if kind == "files":
            for p in v:
                p = Path(p)
                h.update(p.name.encode() + b"\0")
                try:
                    h.update(file_digest(p).encode())
                except OSError:
                    h.update(b"missing")
        elif kind == "stat":
            for p in v:
                p = Path(p)
                try:
                    st = p.stat()
                    h.update(f"{p.name}\0{st.st_size}\0{st.st_mtime_ns}\n".encode())
                except OSError:
                    h.update(f"{p.name}\0missing\n".encode())
        else:
            h.update(repr(v).encode())
    return h.hexdigest()


def reused(keyfile: Path, key: str):
    """指纹匹配 → 返回上次成功时写的 note（无 note 则 ''）；不匹配/缺文件 → None。"""
    try:
        k, _, note = keyfile.read_text(encoding="utf-8").partition("\n")
    except OSError:
        return None
    return note.strip() if k == key else None


def mark_done(keyfile: Path, key: str, note=""):
    keyfile.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    keyfile.write_text(f"{key}\n{note}\n", encoding="utf-8")


# ------------------------------------------------------------ NSP 识别 ----
def pfs0_names(path: Path):
    """NSP = PFS0：列出内部文件名（照抄 nxnative build_ipa_from_nsp.pfs0_names）。"""
    with open(path, "rb") as f:
        h = f.read(16)
        if h[:4] != b"PFS0":
            return []
        n, st = struct.unpack_from("<II", h, 4)
        ent, strs = f.read(n * 0x18), f.read(st)
    return [strs[o:strs.index(b"\0", o)].decode(errors="replace")
            for o in (struct.unpack_from("<I", ent, i * 0x18 + 0x10)[0] for i in range(n))]


def title_of(path: Path):
    """titleID：票据名前 16 位十六进制（rights ID 的一半），否则文件名里的 [titleID]。"""
    for n in pfs0_names(path):
        if re.match(r"[0-9A-Fa-f]{32}\.tik$", n):
            return int(n[:16], 16)
    m = re.search(r"\[([0-9A-Fa-f]{16})\]", path.name)
    return int(m.group(1), 16) if m else None


def version_of(path: Path):
    m = re.search(r"\[v(\d+)\]", path.name)
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else None


def scan_nsps(nsp_arg: Path, update_arg: Path):
    """归组一个游戏：返回 (app_titleID, base_path, update_path_or_None)。
    规则对齐 nxnative scan_nsps：低位 …000=本体、…800=更新、其余=DLC（M2 不打 DLC，仅提示）。
    nsp_arg 是文件时视作本体；--update 显式给更新（可与本体不同目录）。"""
    fam = {"base": None, "updates": [], "dlc": []}
    cands = sorted([*nsp_arg.glob("*.nsp"), *nsp_arg.glob("*.xci")]) if nsp_arg.is_dir() else [nsp_arg]
    for p in cands:
        if p.stat().st_size == 0:
            log("identify", "skip", f"空文件 {p.name}")
            continue
        tid = title_of(p)
        if tid is None:
            log("identify", "skip", f"{p.name} 读不出 titleID（无票据、文件名无 [id]）")
            continue
        low = tid & 0xFFF
        if low == 0:
            fam["base"] = p
        elif low == 0x800:
            fam["updates"].append((version_of(p), p))
        else:
            fam["dlc"].append(p)
    if update_arg is not None:
        fam["updates"].append((version_of(update_arg), update_arg))
    if fam["base"] is None:
        die(f"未找到本体 NSP（…000）：{nsp_arg}（更新 NSP 不能单独提取，ExeFS 层叠需要本体）")
    if len(fam["dlc"]):
        log("identify", "dlc", f"{len(fam['dlc'])} 个 DLC NSP 暂不打包（M2 范围外），已忽略")
    app = title_of(fam["base"])
    ups = sorted(fam["updates"], key=lambda u: u[0] or 0)
    upd = ups[-1][1] if ups else None                     # 文件夹里版本号最高的更新
    return app, fam["base"], upd


def build_id(nso: Path) -> str:
    with open(nso, "rb") as f:
        f.seek(0x40)
        return f.read(16).hex()


def exefs_modules(exefs: Path):
    """ExeFS 模块清单：按 nxnative 加载语义排序（main, subsdk*, sdk, rtld），排除 *.npdm。"""
    mods = sorted(p.name for p in exefs.iterdir() if p.is_file() and not p.name.endswith(".npdm"))
    def rank(n):
        if n == "main":
            return (0, n)
        if n.startswith("subsdk"):
            return (1, n)
        if n == "sdk":
            return (2, n)
        return (3, n)
    return sorted(mods, key=rank)


def parse_game_tsv(path: Path) -> dict:
    keys = {}
    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        if not line or line.startswith("#"):
            continue
        parts = line.split("\t")
        if len(parts) >= 2:
            keys[parts[0]] = parts[1]
    return keys


def build_rows(path: Path) -> dict:
    """game.tsv 的 build 行 → {package: {module: build_id, '_display': 显示版本}}。"""
    rows = {}
    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        if not line.startswith("build\t"):
            continue
        c = line.split("\t")
        row = {"_display": c[2] if len(c) > 2 else ""}
        for kv in c[3:]:
            if "=" in kv:
                m, b = kv.split("=", 1)
                row[m] = b
        rows[c[1]] = row
    return rows


# ------------------------------------------------------------ 工具准备 ----
def ensure_nx_extract(work: Path, logs: Path) -> Path:
    """nx_extract 可执行：优先仓库预编译产物（bin/Release/net10.0），缺则 dotnet build 到 work/tools。
    对齐 nxnative build_nx_extract 的产物布局（nx_extract.exe + LibHac.dll 同目录）。"""
    pre = DM_TOOLS / "nx_extract" / "bin" / "Release" / "net10.0"
    dst = work / "tools" / "nx_extract"
    if (pre / "nx_extract.exe").is_file():
        if not (dst / "nx_extract.exe").is_file():
            shutil.copytree(pre, dst, dirs_exist_ok=True)
            log("extract", "nx_extract", f"使用仓库预编译 {pre.name}")
        return dst / "nx_extract.exe"
    if not (dst / "nx_extract.exe").is_file():
        log("extract", "nx_extract", "dotnet build（首次，约 10-30s）")
        import tempfile
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="nx_extract_") as t:
            r = subprocess.run(["dotnet", "build", str(DM_TOOLS / "nx_extract"), "-c", "Release",
                                "-o", t, "-v", "quiet", "-nologo"],
                               capture_output=True, text=True)
            (logs / "nx_extract_build.log").write_text(r.stdout + r.stderr, encoding="utf-8")
            if r.returncode != 0 or not (Path(t) / "nx_extract.exe").is_file():
                die(f"dotnet build nx_extract 失败，见 {logs / 'nx_extract_build.log'}")
            shutil.rmtree(dst, ignore_errors=True)
            shutil.copytree(t, dst)
    return dst / "nx_extract.exe"


def run_logged(cmd, log_path: Path, on_line=None):
    """跑子进程，全量输出写 log；非零退出返回 returncode（调用方决定 die）。"""
    cmd = [str(c) for c in cmd]
    log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    tail = []
    with open(log_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as lf, \
            subprocess.Popen(cmd, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                             text=True, errors="replace", bufsize=1) as p:
        for line in p.stdout:
            lf.write(line)
            tail.append(line)
            if on_line:
                try:
                    on_line(line.rstrip("\n"))
                except Exception:
                    pass
    if p.returncode:
        ev("say", msg="---- 工具输出尾部 ----\n" + "".join(tail[-15:]).rstrip())
    return p.returncode


def poll_tree(root: Path, total: int, stop: threading.Event, stage_name: str):
    """后台线程：每 2s 统计 root 已写字节数 → progress 事件（总量为 NSP 大小估计，标 est）。"""
    while not stop.wait(2):
        done = 0
        todo = [root]
        while todo:
            try:
                it = os.scandir(todo.pop())
            except OSError:
                continue
            with it:
                for e in it:
                    try:
                        if e.is_dir(follow_symlinks=False):
                            todo.append(e.path)
                        else:
                            done += e.stat(follow_symlinks=False).st_size
                    except OSError:
                        pass
        ev("progress", stage=stage_name, done=done, total=total, unit="B", est=True,
           frac=min(done / total, 0.99) if total else None)


# ------------------------------------------------------------ 步骤实现 ----
def step_identify(args):
    """步骤1：NSP → (app, base, upd)；查档案；校验 build 行。返回档案目录。"""
    nsp_arg = Path(args.nsp).resolve()
    if not nsp_arg.exists():
        die(f"NSP 路径不存在：{nsp_arg}")
    app, base, upd = scan_nsps(nsp_arg, Path(args.update).resolve() if args.update else None)
    tid = f"{app:016X}"
    log("identify", "nsp", f"本体 {base.name}" + (f" + 更新 {upd.name}" if upd else "（无更新，v0）"))

    archive = Path(args.archive_root).resolve() / tid
    if not (archive / "game.tsv").is_file():
        return app, base, upd, None                       # 未知游戏 → survey（由 main 处理）

    tsv = parse_game_tsv(archive / "game.tsv")
    if tsv.get("title_id") != tid:
        die(f"档案 {archive} 的 title_id={tsv.get('title_id')} 与 NSP {tid} 不一致")
    rows = build_rows(archive / "game.tsv")
    pkg = tsv.get("package")
    if upd is not None and pkg and pkg != "v0" and rows and version_of(upd) is not None \
            and f"v{version_of(upd)}" != pkg:
        log("identify", "package", f"警告：档案 package={pkg}，文件夹内更新为 v{version_of(upd)}，按文件夹版本继续")
    log("identify", "profile", f"{tid} {tsv.get('name', '?')}（档案 {archive.name}）")
    return app, base, upd, archive


def survey(app, base, upd, keys, work, logs, nx_exe, allow_damaged):
    """未知游戏：manifest 模式提取（不写游戏文件）→ survey.md（模块 build ID 表）。"""
    tid = f"{app:016X}"
    ex = work / "survey_extract"
    tmp = work / "survey_extract.partial"
    shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)
    log("survey", "extract", "ExeFS + RomFS 清单（--manifest，不写游戏文件）")
    rc = run_logged([nx_exe, keys, base, upd or "-", tmp, "--manifest"]
                    + (["--allow-damaged"] if allow_damaged else []), logs / "survey_extract.log")
    if rc != 0:
        die(f"nx_extract survey 提取失败 rc={rc}，见 {logs / 'survey_extract.log'}")
    shutil.rmtree(ex, ignore_errors=True)
    tmp.rename(ex)

    mods, disp, name = [], "?", tid
    nacp = ex / "control.nacp"
    if nacp.is_file():
        sys.path.insert(0, str(DM_TOOLS))
        import nacp as nacp_mod                              # nxnative 只读复用
        name, disp = nacp_mod.name(nacp) or tid, nacp_mod.version(nacp) or "?"
    for m in exefs_modules(ex / "ExeFS"):
        p = ex / "ExeFS" / m
        mods.append((m, build_id(p) if p.stat().st_size >= 0x50 else "?",
                     f"{p.stat().st_size / 2**20:.1f}"))

    lines = [f"# Survey：{name}（{tid}，display {disp}）",
             "", f"- 本体：`{base.name}`（{base.stat().st_size / 2**30:.2f} GB）",
             f"- 更新：`{upd.name}`" if upd else "- 更新：无（v0）",
             "", "## 模块 build ID（供 games/<id>/game.tsv 的 build 行）", "",
             "| 模块 | build ID | 大小 (MB) |", "|---|---|---|"]
    lines += [f"| {m} | `{b}` | {s} |" for m, b, s in mods]
    lines += ["", "下一步：`python scripts/new_game.py <NSP> -k <prod.keys>` 起草档案（内存/图形键人工补）。"]
    (work / "survey.md").write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    log("survey", "report", str(work / "survey.md"))
    return work / "survey.md"


def step_extract(app, base, upd, keys, work, logs, args) -> Path:
    """步骤2：nx_extract --romfs-image → work/extract/{ExeFS, RomFS.img, control.nacp, icon.jpg}。"""
    ex, tmp = work / "extract", work / "extract.partial"
    nx_exe = ensure_nx_extract(work, logs)
    # 指纹：NSP（名字+大小+mtime，避免整包哈希）+ 提取器二进制 + keys 文件 stat + 损坏豁免开关
    key = fingerprint(("stat", [base] + ([upd] if upd else []) +
                       sorted(nx_exe.parent.glob("*.dll")) + [nx_exe, Path(keys)]),
                      ("repr", ["romfs-image", args.allow_damaged]))
    kf = work / "keys" / "extract.key"
    note = f"{base.name}" + (f" + {upd.name}" if upd else "")
    if not args.force and reused(kf, key) is not None and (ex / "ExeFS" / "main").is_file() \
            and (ex / "RomFS.img").is_file():
        log("extract", "reuse", f"输入未变，沿用 {ex}")
        return ex
    kf.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)
    total = base.stat().st_size + (upd.stat().st_size if upd else 0)
    stop = threading.Event()
    th = threading.Thread(target=poll_tree, args=(tmp, total, stop, "extract"), daemon=True)
    if PROGRESS:
        th.start()
    try:
        rc = run_logged([nx_exe, keys, base, upd or "-", tmp, "--romfs-image"]
                        + (["--allow-damaged"] if args.allow_damaged else []),
                        logs / "extract.log",
                        on_line=lambda l: log("extract", "nx_extract", l) if not PROGRESS else None)
    finally:
        stop.set()
    if rc != 0:
        die(f"nx_extract 失败 rc={rc}，见 {logs / 'extract.log'}")
    for need in ("ExeFS/main", "RomFS.img"):
        if not (tmp / need).is_file():
            die(f"nx_extract 未产出 {need}，见 {logs / 'extract.log'}")
    shutil.rmtree(ex, ignore_errors=True)
    tmp.rename(ex)
    size = (ex / "RomFS.img").stat().st_size
    mark_done(kf, key, f"{note}: RomFS.img {size:,}B")
    log("extract", "done", f"ExeFS {len(exefs_modules(ex / 'ExeFS'))} 模块 + RomFS.img {size:,}B → {ex}")
    return ex


def step_rewrite(ex: Path, archive: Path, work: Path, logs: Path, args):
    """步骤3：逐模块 patch_nso.py → work/patched/<模块>/；build 行校验 + 逐模块指纹缓存。"""
    # 先决依赖（与既有 smo 构建同解释器语义：lz4 + capstone）
    try:
        import lz4.block  # noqa: F401
        import capstone  # noqa: F401
    except ImportError as e:
        die(f"patch_nso 需要 lz4/capstone（{sys.executable} 缺 {e.name}；pip install lz4 capstone）")

    tsv = parse_game_tsv(archive / "game.tsv")
    pkg = tsv.get("package", "v0")
    row = build_rows(archive / "game.tsv").get(pkg, {})
    modules = exefs_modules(ex / "ExeFS")
    bad = [(m, build_id(ex / "ExeFS" / m), row.get(m)) for m in modules
           if row.get(m) not in (None, build_id(ex / "ExeFS" / m))]
    if bad:
        detail = "; ".join(f"{m}: 提取={got} 档案={want}" for m, got, want in bad)
        die(f"模块 build ID 与档案 build 行不符（package {pkg}）：{detail}。"
            f"需派生档案（derived profile）或换对应版本 NSP——M2 不自动派生")
    log("rewrite", "verify", f"{len(modules)} 模块 build ID 与档案 {pkg} 行一致")

    # 重写器输入面（对齐既有产物 build_src.sha256 的记录面）+ 档案 patches.py 注入
    tool_files = [DM_TOOLS / f for f in ("patch_nso.py", "nso_asm.py", "nso_code.py",
                                         "nso_match.py", "sdk_patches.py")]
    patch_glob = sorted((DM_TOOLS / ".." / "games").glob("*/patches.py")) + \
                 sorted((NXN / "games").glob("*/patches.py"))
    env = dict(os.environ,
               DM_GAMES_DIR=str(NXN / "games"),     # 档案 patches.py 参与（nxnative os.pathsep 语义）
               DM_GAME=archive.name)                # MATCH_CUTS 的档案选择键
    for m in modules:
        nso = ex / "ExeFS" / m
        out = work / "patched" / m
        key = fingerprint(("files", [nso] + tool_files + patch_glob),
                          ("repr", [str(NXN / "games"), archive.name]))
        kf = work / "keys" / f"rewrite_{m}.key"
        if not args.force and reused(kf, key) is not None and (out / f"{m}.patched.bin").is_file():
            log("rewrite", m, "输入未变，跳过（reused）")
            continue
        kf.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        shutil.rmtree(out, ignore_errors=True)
        out.mkdir(parents=True)
        t0 = time.time()
        rc = run_logged([sys.executable, str(DM_TOOLS / "patch_nso.py"), nso, out, m],
                        logs / f"rewrite_{m}.log")
        if rc != 0 or not (out / f"{m}.patched.bin").is_file():
            die(f"patch_nso {m} 失败 rc={rc}，见 {logs / f'rewrite_{m}.log'}")
        # 产物来源记录（对齐既有 build_src.sha256 语义：工具链哈希随产物留档）
        (out / "build_src.sha256").write_text(
            "".join(f"{file_digest(p)}  {p}\n" for p in tool_files + patch_glob), encoding="utf-8")
        mark_done(kf, key, f"{m} {build_id(nso)}")
        log("rewrite", m, f"{m}.patched.bin {(out / f'{m}.patched.bin').stat().st_size:,}B"
                          f"（{time.time() - t0:.0f}s）")
    return work / "patched"


def step_hap(archive: Path, work: Path, ex: Path, args):
    """步骤4-7：转调 M1 build_hap_from_profile.py（instantiate/prepare/build/report）。"""
    hap_area = Path(args.out).resolve() if args.out else NXN / ".build" / archive.name
    hap = hap_area / "entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
    # M1 调用指纹：档案全文件 + patched.bin 内容 + RomFS stat + M1 脚本/工具/模板 stat
    fonts_src = Path(args.fonts_src).resolve() if args.fonts_src else \
        REPO / "mario-odessy-harmony" / "entry/src/main/cpp/generated"
    key = fingerprint(("files", sorted(p for p in archive.rglob("*") if p.is_file())),
                      ("files", sorted(work.glob("patched/*/*.patched.bin"))),
                      ("stat", [ex / "RomFS.img", fonts_src / "shared_fonts_config.h",
                                fonts_src / "shared_fonts_data.h",
                                NXN / "scripts/build_hap_from_profile.py",
                                NXN / "tools/prepare_runtime.py"]
                               + [p for p in (NXN / "template").rglob("*") if p.is_file()]),
                      ("repr", [str(hap_area), args.keep]))
    kf = work / "keys" / "hap.key"
    if not args.force and reused(kf, key) is not None and hap.is_file():
        log("hap", "reuse", f"输入未变，沿用 {hap}（{hap.stat().st_size:,}B）")
        return hap
    kf.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    cmd = [sys.executable, str(NXN / "scripts/build_hap_from_profile.py"), str(archive),
           "--work", str(work), "--romfs", str(ex / "RomFS.img"), "--out", str(hap_area)]
    if args.fonts_src:
        cmd += ["--fonts-src", str(fonts_src)]
    if args.keep:
        cmd += ["--keep"]
    if PROGRESS:
        cmd += ["--progress"]                              # M1 事件同协议直通 stdout
    t0 = time.time()
    rc = subprocess.run(cmd).returncode
    if rc != 0 or not hap.is_file():
        die(f"M1 build_hap_from_profile 失败 rc={rc}（HAP 未产出；上方有其日志）")
    mark_done(kf, key, f"{hap.name} {hap.stat().st_size:,}B")
    log("hap", "done", f"{hap}（{hap.stat().st_size:,}B，{time.time() - t0:.0f}s）")
    return hap


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- main ----
def main():
    global PROGRESS
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("nsp", help="NSP 文件夹（一个游戏）或本体 NSP 文件路径")
    ap.add_argument("-k", "--keys", default=os.environ.get("NX_PROD_KEYS", DEFAULT_KEYS),
                    help=f"prod.keys（缺省 $NX_PROD_KEYS 或 {DEFAULT_KEYS}）")
    ap.add_argument("--update", help="更新 NSP 显式路径（缺省取文件夹内版本号最高者）")
    ap.add_argument("--archive-root", default=str(NXN / "games"),
                    help="档案根目录（缺省 nxnative-ohos/games；测试 survey/new_game 时指到空目录）")
    ap.add_argument("--work", help="工作区根，缺省 nxnative-ohos/.build/<titleID>_nsp/")
    ap.add_argument("--out", help="HAP 构建区（转传 M1 --out），缺省 .build/<titleID>/")
    ap.add_argument("--fonts-src", help="转传 M1 --fonts-src（embedded 字体对目录）")
    ap.add_argument("--survey-only", action="store_true", help="只做 survey（等价于未知游戏路径），不出 HAP")
    ap.add_argument("--no-hap", action="store_true", help="步骤 1-3 后停（不出 HAP，快速验证提取/重写）")
    ap.add_argument("--keep", action="store_true", help="转传 M1 --keep（HAP 构建区复用而非整体重建）")
    ap.add_argument("--allow-damaged", action="store_true", help="NSP 哈希不过的文件按只读继续（转传 nx_extract）")
    ap.add_argument("--force", action="store_true", help="无视指纹缓存全部重跑")
    ap.add_argument("--progress", action="store_true", help="每阶段一行 JSON 事件")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    PROGRESS = args.progress

    keys = Path(args.keys)
    if not keys.is_file():
        die(f"prod.keys 不存在：{keys}（-k 指定）")
    t0 = time.time()
    global FAILED

    # ---- 步骤1 identify ----
    with Stage("identify", "titleID → 档案"):
        app, base, upd, archive = step_identify(args)
        tid = f"{app:016X}"
        work = Path(args.work).resolve() if args.work else NXN / ".build" / f"{tid}_nsp"
        logs = work / "logs"
        logs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        nx_exe = ensure_nx_extract(work, logs)              # survey 与正式提取共用
        if archive is None or args.survey_only:
            survey(app, base, upd, keys, work, logs, nx_exe, args.allow_damaged)
            ev("result", outcome="survey", title_id=tid, survey=str(work / "survey.md"))
            print(f"SURVEY: {work / 'survey.md'}")
            sys.exit(2 if archive is None else 0)           # 2 = 无档案，需 new_game.py

    # ---- 步骤2 extract ----
    with Stage("extract", "nx_extract → ExeFS + RomFS.img"):
        ex = step_extract(app, base, upd, keys, work, logs, args)

    # ---- 步骤3 rewrite ----
    with Stage("rewrite", "patch_nso → patched.bin + TSV"):
        patched = step_rewrite(ex, archive, work, logs, args)

    if args.no_hap:
        ev("result", outcome="rewritten", title_id=tid, patched=str(patched), secs=round(time.time() - t0, 1))
        print(f"PATCHED: {patched}")
        return

    # ---- 步骤4-7 hap（转调 M1）----
    with Stage("hap", "M1 build_hap_from_profile（instantiate/prepare/build/report）"):
        hap = step_hap(archive, work, ex, args)

    ev("result", outcome="hap", title_id=tid, hap=str(hap), bytes=hap.stat().st_size,
       secs=round(time.time() - t0, 1))
    print(f"HAP: {hap}")
    print(f"BYTES: {hap.stat().st_size:,}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        main()
    except SystemExit:
        raise
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        die("中断", 130)
    except Exception as e:                                  # 兜底：意外异常也走 fail 事件
        import traceback
        die(f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}\n{traceback.format_exc(limit=5)}")
```

`nxnative-ohos/scripts/build_hap_from_profile.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""build_hap_from_profile.py —— M1 一键：游戏档案 + 既有 patched 产物 → 签名 HAP。

M1 范围（nxnative-ohos 设计 §3 七步流的 4→7 子集）：不做 NSP 提取/重写（--work 指向
既有 <titleID>_build 工作区），从 template/ 实例化参数化工程并出包。

流程：
  1 profile      读 games/<titleID>/game.tsv（键表：../games/README.md）
  2 instantiate  template/ → 构建区：{{...}} 占位替换 + game_patches.tmpl.c 启用 + host_override 覆盖
                 + rawfile 镜像硬链（patched.bin 不入库，从 work 区链入）+ game_version.h 生成兜底
                 + shared_fonts_{config,data}.h 拷入（fonts_mode=embedded，M1 用现成内嵌字体对）
  3 prepare      tools/prepare_runtime.py → generated/runtime_tables.h + romfs_config.h
                 （shared_fonts_config.h 守卫：字体头已存在则不动）
  4 build        hvigorw --mode module -p product=default assembleHap（命令复用 game-work/run_cycle.sh）
  5 report       HAP 路径 + 字节数

--progress：每阶段一行 JSON 事件（{"event":"stage"|"step"|...}，对齐设计 §3 / docs/frontends.md）。
用法（M1 验收）：
  python scripts/build_hap_from_profile.py games/0100000000010000 --work ../game-work/smo_build --progress
"""
import argparse
import json
import math
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]          # switch2hos/
NXN = REPO / "nxnative-ohos"

# DevEco 工具链（与 game-work/run_cycle.sh 同源；--node/--hvigorw/--sdk 可覆盖）。
# 注意：不读环境 DEVECO_SDK_HOME——本机该 env 指向 D: 盘 command-line-tools 的残缺 SDK，
# run_cycle.sh 的做法就是无条件 export Studio 自带 SDK 路径（PITFALLS 同源）。
NODE = os.environ.get("DEVECO_NODE", "C:/Program Files/Huawei/DevEco Studio/tools/node/node.exe")
HVIGORW = os.environ.get("DEVECO_HVIGORW", "C:/Program Files/Huawei/DevEco Studio/tools/hvigor/bin/hvigorw.js")
DEVECO_SDK_HOME = "C:/Program Files/Huawei/DevEco Studio/sdk"

PROGRESS = False


def ev(kind, **kw):
    """--progress json 事件：一行一个。"""
    print(json.dumps({"event": kind, "ts": round(time.time(), 3), **kw}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)


def log(stage, step, detail):
    if PROGRESS:
        ev("step", stage=stage, step=step, detail=detail)
    else:
        print(f"[{stage}] {step}: {detail}")


def stage(name, status):
    if PROGRESS:
        ev("stage", stage=name, status=status)


def parse_game_tsv(path: Path) -> dict:
    keys = {}
    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        if not line or line.startswith("#"):
            continue
        parts = line.split("\t")
        if len(parts) >= 2:
            keys[parts[0]] = parts[1]
    return keys


def link_or_copy(src: Path, dst: Path):
    """大文件优先硬链（同盘零拷贝），失败退拷贝。红线：大文件不进 nxnative-ohos 档案/模板，只进构建区。"""
    dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if dst.exists():
        dst.unlink()
    try:
        dst.hardlink_to(src)
        return "link"
    except OSError:
        shutil.copy2(src, dst)
        return "copy"


def rmtree_retry(path: Path, tries: int = 5):
    """Windows：hvigor daemon/杀毒/索引器可能短暂握住构建区句柄或延迟删目录
    （WinError 32/145），重试兜底；仍失败则改名隔离后尽力删。"""
    for i in range(tries):
        try:
            shutil.rmtree(path)
            return
        except OSError:
            if i == tries - 1:
                alt = path.with_name(f"{path.name}.stale-{int(time.time())}")
                try:
                    path.rename(alt)
                    shutil.rmtree(alt, ignore_errors=True)
                except OSError:
                    pass
                shutil.rmtree(path, ignore_errors=True)
                return
            time.sleep(2)


def substitute(text: str, subs: dict) -> str:
    out = text
    for k, v in subs.items():
        out = out.replace("{{" + k + "}}", str(v))
    left = re.findall(r"\{\{[A-Z0-9_]+\}\}", out)
    if left:
        sys.exit(f"build_hap: unresolved placeholders {sorted(set(left))}")
    return out


def main():
    global PROGRESS
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("archive", help="档案目录 games/<titleID>/（或其 game.tsv 路径）")
    ap.add_argument("--work", required=True, help="既有 <titleID>_build 工作区根（含 patched/<模块>/）")
    ap.add_argument("--out", help="构建区（实例化工程根），缺省 nxnative-ohos/.build/<titleID>/")
    ap.add_argument("--romfs", help="RomFS.img 路径（缺省 work 同级 *<titleID>/RomFS.img 搜索）")
    ap.add_argument("--fonts-src", help="现成 shared_fonts_{config,data}.h 所在目录（embedded 模式；"
                                        "缺省生产线 mario-odessy-harmony/…/generated，只读）")
    ap.add_argument("--node", default=NODE)
    ap.add_argument("--hvigorw", default=HVIGORW)
    ap.add_argument("--sdk", default=DEVECO_SDK_HOME)
    ap.add_argument("--keep", action="store_true", help="构建区已存在时复用（默认整体重建）")
    ap.add_argument("--progress", action="store_true", help="每阶段一行 JSON 事件")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    PROGRESS = args.progress

    archive = Path(args.archive).resolve()
    if archive.name == "game.tsv":
        archive = archive.parent
    work = Path(args.work).resolve()
    t0 = time.time()

    # ---- 1 profile：读档案 ----
    stage("profile", "start")
    tsv = parse_game_tsv(archive / "game.tsv")
    for need in ("title_id", "program_id", "name", "modules", "hap_bundle", "hap_label",
                 "romfs_volume_mib", "fonts_mode", "nvn_backend", "package"):
        if need not in tsv:
            sys.exit(f"build_hap: game.tsv missing key {need}")
    title_id = tsv["title_id"]
    if archive.name != title_id:
        sys.exit(f"build_hap: 档案目录名 {archive.name} != title_id {title_id}（nxnative 铁律：目录名即 title ID）")
    package = tsv["package"]
    display = next((ln.split("\t")[2] for ln in (archive / "game.tsv").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
                    if ln.startswith("build\t") and ln.split("\t")[1] == package), "1.0.0")
    modules = tsv["modules"].split()                       # 加载序 main subsdk0 sdk
    rawfile_modules = ["rtld"] + modules[::-1]             # rawfile 分发序：rtld + 逆加载序（smo: rtld sdk subsdk0 main）
    # hilog 标签：hap_bundle 尾段 PascalCase + "Game"（com.vibecc.smo → SmoGame，兼容 run_cycle.sh 验尸 grep）
    short = tsv["hap_bundle"].rsplit(".", 1)[-1]
    log_tag = short[0].upper() + short[1:] + "Game"
    log("profile", "game.tsv", f"{title_id} {tsv['name']} {display} tag={log_tag}")

    # RomFS.img：分卷数由实际镜像大小算
    romfs_img = Path(args.romfs) if args.romfs else None
    if romfs_img is None:
        for p in sorted(work.parent.glob(f"*{title_id}/RomFS.img")):
            romfs_img = p
            break
    if not romfs_img or not romfs_img.is_file():
        sys.exit(f"build_hap: RomFS.img not found near {work} (or --romfs)")
    vol_mib = int(tsv["romfs_volume_mib"])
    romfs_volumes = max(1, math.ceil(romfs_img.stat().st_size / (vol_mib * 1024 * 1024)))
    out_dir = Path(args.out).resolve() if args.out else NXN / ".build" / title_id
    log("profile", "romfs", f"{romfs_img.name} {romfs_img.stat().st_size:,}B → {romfs_volumes} 卷 × {vol_mib}MiB")
    stage("profile", "done")

    # ---- 2 instantiate：模板 → 构建区 ----
    stage("instantiate", "start")
    # romfs_parts 是本目录里唯一的大产物（tools/make_romfs_runtime.py 输出，16GB 级）：
    # 整体重建时把它改名隔离、清完再放回，避免重跑一次构建就重写十几 GB 分卷
    parts = out_dir / "romfs_parts"
    parts_aside = None
    if out_dir.exists() and not args.keep and parts.is_dir():
        parts_aside = out_dir.with_name(out_dir.name + ".romfs_parts-aside")
        rmtree_retry(parts_aside)
        parts.rename(parts_aside)
    if out_dir.exists() and not args.keep:
        rmtree_retry(out_dir)
    if parts_aside:
        parts.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)   # rmtree 已删 out_dir，先立父目录再放回
        parts_aside.rename(parts)
    shutil.copytree(NXN / "template", out_dir, dirs_exist_ok=True)
    subs = {
        "GAME_ID_DIR": title_id,
        "GAME_TITLE_ID": "0x" + tsv["program_id"],
        "GAME_LOG_TAG": log_tag,
        "RAWFILE_MODULES": ", ".join(f"'{m}'" for m in rawfile_modules),
        "ROMFS_VOLUMES": romfs_volumes,
        "HAP_BUNDLE": tsv["hap_bundle"],
        "HAP_LABEL": tsv["hap_label"],
        "HAP_VERSION": display,
    }
    # 占位替换白名单（不碰 third_party 大树）
    (out_dir / "AppScope" / "app.json5.tmpl").rename(out_dir / "AppScope" / "app.json5")
    for rel in ("AppScope/app.json5",
                "entry/src/main/cpp/game_id.h",
                "entry/src/main/ets/entryability/EntryAbility.ets",
                "entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets",
                "entry/src/main/resources/base/element/string.json",
                "AppScope/resources/base/element/string.json"):
        p = out_dir / rel
        p.write_text(substitute(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), subs), encoding="utf-8")
    log("instantiate", "placeholders", f"{len(subs)} vars, romfs volumes={romfs_volumes}")
    # 签名配置与 bundle 绑定：模板 build-profile.json5 的调试签名材料（DevEco auto-sign，p7b 内嵌
    # bundle-name）只对本机生成它的那个 bundle 有效。档案 hap_bundle 与 p7b 不符时剥离 signingConfigs，
    # 出未签名 HAP（装机需在 DevEco Project Structure → Signing Configs 点一次 Fix 生成新材料后重跑）。
    bp = out_dir / "build-profile.json5"
    bp_text = bp.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    m = re.search(r'"profile"\s*:\s*"([^"]+\.p7b)"', bp_text)
    p7b_bundle = None
    if m and Path(m.group(1)).is_file():
        p7b_bundles = set(re.findall(rb"com\.[a-z0-9_.]+", Path(m.group(1)).read_bytes()))
        p7b_bundle = next((b.decode() for b in p7b_bundles if b.decode().count(".") >= 2), None)
    signed_ok = p7b_bundle == tsv["hap_bundle"]
    if not signed_ok:
        bp_text = re.sub(r'"signingConfigs"\s*:\s*\[.*?\]\s*,\s*\n\s*"products"',
                         '"signingConfigs": [],\n    "products"', bp_text, flags=re.S)
        bp_text = re.sub(r',?\s*"signingConfig"\s*:\s*"default"', "", bp_text)
        bp.write_text(bp_text, encoding="utf-8")
        log("instantiate", "signing", f"p7b 绑定 {p7b_bundle} != {tsv['hap_bundle']}：剥离签名配置，出未签名 HAP"
                                       f"（装机前需 DevEco Signing Configs → Fix 再重跑）")
    # 游戏钩子：模板空实现启用；档案 host_override 整文件覆盖（逃生门，设计 §7）
    (out_dir / "entry/src/main/cpp/host/game_patches.tmpl.c").rename(
        out_dir / "entry/src/main/cpp/host/game_patches.c")
    override = archive / "host_override"
    n_over = 0
    if override.is_dir():
        for f in override.rglob("*"):
            if f.is_file():
                dst = out_dir / f.relative_to(override)
                dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                shutil.copy2(f, dst)
                n_over += 1
    log("instantiate", "host_override", f"{n_over} files overridden")
    # game_version.h 兜底：host_override 没带就按档案生成（GAME_ODYSSEY 类分叉宏由 override 表达）
    gv = out_dir / "entry/src/main/cpp/host/game_version.h"
    if not gv.exists():
        gv.write_text(f'/* Generated by build_hap_from_profile.py from {archive.name}/game.tsv. */\n'
                      f'#pragma once\n#define TOTK_GAME_VERSION "{display}"\n'
                      f'#define TOTK_GAME_DIR "{title_id}"\n#define GAME_TITLE_ID 0x{tsv["program_id"]}ULL\n',
                      encoding="utf-8")
        log("instantiate", "game_version.h", "generated from profile")
    # rawfile 游戏镜像：从 work 区硬链（不入库红线）
    raw_dir = out_dir / "entry/src/main/resources/rawfile" / title_id
    raw_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for m in rawfile_modules:
        src = work / "patched" / m / f"{m}.patched.bin"
        if not src.is_file():
            sys.exit(f"build_hap: {src} not found（--work 需指向既有 patched 产物）")
        link_or_copy(src, raw_dir / f"{m}.patched.bin")
    log("instantiate", "rawfile", f"{len(rawfile_modules)} patched.bin linked from {work}")
    # 内嵌字体对（fonts_mode=embedded）：先拷入，prepare 的守卫就不会踩掉
    if tsv["fonts_mode"] != "embedded":
        sys.exit(f"build_hap: fonts_mode={tsv['fonts_mode']} 未支持（M1 仅 embedded）")
    fonts_src = Path(args.fonts_src).resolve() if args.fonts_src else \
        REPO / "mario-odessy-harmony" / "entry" / "src" / "main" / "cpp" / "generated"
    gen = out_dir / "entry" / "src" / "main" / "cpp" / "generated"
    gen.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for h in ("shared_fonts_config.h", "shared_fonts_data.h"):
        if not (fonts_src / h).is_file():
            sys.exit(f"build_hap: {h} not found in {fonts_src}（embedded 模式需现成内嵌字体对，--fonts-src 指定）")
        shutil.copy2(fonts_src / h, gen / h)
    log("instantiate", "shared_fonts", f"copied pair from {fonts_src}")
    stage("instantiate", "done")

    # ---- 3 prepare：生成头（runtime_tables + romfs_config） ----
    stage("prepare", "start")
    # 构建区若有 make_romfs_runtime 的分卷产物，把 runtime-index.bin 喂给 prepare（真 INDEX SHA）；
    # 没有则 prepare 只记 "0"（运行时 romfs 校验会失败——先跑 tools/make_romfs_runtime.py）
    romfs_index = out_dir / "romfs_parts" / "runtime-index.bin"
    prep_argv = [sys.executable, str(NXN / "tools" / "prepare_runtime.py"),
                 "--archive", str(archive), "--work", str(work), "--out", str(gen),
                 "--romfs", str(romfs_img)]
    if romfs_index.is_file():
        prep_argv += ["--romfs-index", str(romfs_index)]
    prep = subprocess.run(prep_argv, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if prep.returncode != 0:
        sys.exit("build_hap: prepare_runtime failed\n" + prep.stdout + prep.stderr)
    log("prepare", "prepare_runtime", prep.stdout.strip().replace("\n", " | "))
    stage("prepare", "done")

    # ---- 4 build：hvigor ----
    stage("build", "start")
    env = dict(os.environ, DEVECO_SDK_HOME=args.sdk)
    build_log = out_dir / "build-log.txt"
    with build_log.open("w", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as lf:
        # --no-daemon：本脚本每次重建构建区，常驻 daemon 会握住已删目录的句柄（WinError 32）。
        # --no-incremental：构建区虽每次重建，hvigor 全局 project_caches 仍会把旧任务的产物原样搬回来
        #（实测 totk 构建把 smo 时代的 icon 中间件从缓存恢复进 HAP）——关掉增量保证档案输入即产物。
        rc = subprocess.run([args.node, args.hvigorw, "--no-daemon", "--no-incremental", "--mode", "module",
                             "-p", "product=default", "assembleHap"],
                            cwd=out_dir, env=env, stdout=lf, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).returncode
    hap_signed = out_dir / "entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
    hap = hap_signed if hap_signed.is_file() else out_dir / "entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-unsigned.hap"
    text = build_log.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    if rc != 0 or "BUILD SUCCESSFUL" not in text or not hap.is_file():
        tail = "\n".join(text.splitlines()[-25:])
        sys.exit(f"build_hap: hvigor FAILED (rc={rc})，尾部日志：\n{tail}\n完整日志：{build_log}")
    log("build", "hvigor", f"BUILD SUCCESSFUL ({'signed' if hap.name.endswith('-signed.hap') else 'UNSIGNED'})")
    stage("build", "done")

    # ---- 5 report ----
    stage("report", "start")
    size = hap.stat().st_size
    log("report", "hap", f"{hap} ({size:,} bytes)")
    stage("report", "done")
    if PROGRESS:
        ev("result", hap=str(hap), bytes=size, secs=round(time.time() - t0, 1))
    print(f"HAP: {hap}")
    print(f"BYTES: {size:,}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`nxnative-ohos/scripts/new_game.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""new_game.py —— 从 NSP 起草新游戏档案（M2：survey → games/<titleID>/ 草稿）。

做什么：
  1 扫 NSP（复用 build_hap_from_nsp 的识别逻辑）→ titleID / 本体 / 最新更新
  2 nx_extract --manifest 轻量提取（ExeFS + RomFS 清单，不写游戏文件）
  3 读 control.nacp（名称/显示版本）+ 逐模块 build ID + RomFS 规模统计
  4 落草稿：games/<titleID>/{game.tsv, patches.py}
     - build 行自动填识别到的模块 build ID；内存/图形/字体等键留 TODO 由人补
     - 已有档案目录则拒绝（--force 覆盖），不误伤既有档案

用法：
  python scripts/new_game.py "<NSP 文件夹>" -k E:/Yuzu/user/keys/prod.keys [--update <upd.nsp>]
"""
import argparse
import re
import shutil
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
from build_hap_from_nsp import (NXN, DEFAULT_KEYS, DM_TOOLS, exefs_modules, build_id,
                                scan_nsps, run_logged, ensure_nx_extract)  # noqa: E402

ROMFS_TOPS = 12                                          # survey 里列出的顶层目录数


def draft_game_tsv(tid, name, disp, ver, mods, bid, marker, vol_gib):
    """档案草稿：自动值尽量填实，人工键 TODO（键面见 ../games/README.md）。"""
    modules = [m for m in mods if m != "rtld"]           # modules 不含 rtld（宿主替换）
    load = " ".join(modules)
    short = "g" + tid[-6:].lower()
    L = [f"# {name}（{tid}，display {disp}）—— new_game.py 起草草稿，内存/图形键人工补齐后生效。",
         "# 键表权威：../games/README.md；参考既有档案 ../0100000000010000/game.tsv（smo）。",
         "",
         "# ---- 身份 ----",
         f"title_id\t{tid}",
         f"program_id\t{tid}\t# TODO 人工确认（本体 main.npdm 里的 program ID，多与 title_id 相同，需核对）",
         "",
         "# ---- 应用（鸿蒙组）----",
         f"name\t{name}",
         f"hap_bundle\tcom.vibecc.{short}\t# TODO 人工确认",
         f"hap_label\t{name}\t# TODO 人工确认（中文应用名）",
         "hap_icon\t$media:icon",
         "",
         "# ---- 版本 ----",
         f"build\t{ver}\t{disp}\t" + "\t".join(f"{m}={bid[m]}" for m in mods),
         f"package\t{ver}",
         f"shader_versions\t{ver}",
         "",
         "# ---- 模块 ----",
         f"modules\t{load}",
         f"romfs_marker\t{marker}",
         "",
         "# ---- 内存（TODO：对照宿主 services.c 与 nxnative 同档案键；smo 参考值见注释）----",
         "mem_reserve\t0x100000000\t# TODO（smo 参考值）",
         "mem_alias\t0x10000000\t# TODO（smo 参考值 256MiB）",
         "mem_stack\t0x10000000\t# TODO（smo 参考值）",
         "app_pool\t0xCD500000\t# TODO（smo 参考值）",
         "",
         "# ---- 着色器拆分（TODO：按 RomFS 顶层目录人工分组；smo 样例见其档案）----",
         "shader_groups\t/=romfs\t# TODO",
         f"shader_note\t{name} shaders",
         "",
         "# ---- 鸿蒙组 ----",
         f"romfs_volume_mib\t1024\t# RomFS {vol_gib:.2f} GiB → {max(1, int(vol_gib / 1.024) + 1)} 卷 × 1024MiB（四舍五入可调）",
         "fonts_mode\tembedded\t# TODO：embedded（Windows TTF 伪造）/ firmware（真 BFTTF，需固件提取）",
         "nvn_backend\tvulkan",
         "",
    ]
    return "\n".join(L)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("nsp", help="NSP 文件夹（一个游戏）或本体 NSP 文件路径")
    ap.add_argument("-k", "--keys", default=DEFAULT_KEYS, help=f"prod.keys（缺省 {DEFAULT_KEYS}）")
    ap.add_argument("--update", help="更新 NSP 显式路径（缺省取文件夹内版本号最高者）")
    ap.add_argument("--out", default=str(NXN / "games"), help="档案根目录（缺省 nxnative-ohos/games）")
    ap.add_argument("--force", action="store_true", help="档案目录已存在时覆盖重建")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    keys = Path(args.keys)
    if not keys.is_file():
        sys.exit(f"prod.keys 不存在：{keys}")

    app, base, upd = scan_nsps(Path(args.nsp).resolve(), Path(args.update).resolve() if args.update else None)
    tid = f"{app:016X}"
    out_root = Path(args.out).resolve()
    archive = out_root / tid
    if (archive / "game.tsv").is_file() and not args.force:
        sys.exit(f"档案已存在：{archive}（--force 覆盖重建）")
    work = NXN / ".build" / f"{tid}_nsp"
    logs = work / "logs"
    logs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    # manifest 模式轻量提取（已做过则沿用）
    ex = work / "survey_extract"
    if args.force or not (ex / "ExeFS" / "main").is_file():
        nx_exe = ensure_nx_extract(work, logs)
        tmp = work / "survey_extract.partial"
        shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)
        print(f"[survey] nx_extract --manifest → {ex}")
        rc = run_logged([nx_exe, keys, base, upd or "-", tmp, "--manifest"], logs / "survey_extract.log")
        if rc != 0:
            sys.exit(f"nx_extract 失败 rc={rc}，见 {logs / 'survey_extract.log'}")
        shutil.rmtree(ex, ignore_errors=True)
        tmp.rename(ex)
    else:
        print(f"[survey] 沿用 {ex}")

    # 事实收集
    sys.path.insert(0, str(DM_TOOLS))
    import nacp as nacp_mod
    nc = ex / "control.nacp"
    name = nacp_mod.name(nc) if nc.is_file() else tid
    disp = nacp_mod.version(nc) if nc.is_file() else "?"
    m = re.search(r"\[v(\d+)\]", upd.name) if upd else None
    ver = f"v{m.group(1)}" if m else "v0"
    mods = exefs_modules(ex / "ExeFS")
    bid = {m: build_id(ex / "ExeFS" / m) for m in mods}

    rom_n, rom_b, biggest, tops = 0, 0, (0, ""), {}
    man = ex / "romfs_manifest.tsv"
    if man.is_file():
        for line in man.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines():
            c = line.split("\t")
            if len(c) < 2 or not c[1].isdigit():
                continue
            sz = int(c[1])
            rom_n += 1
            rom_b += sz
            top = c[0].strip("/").split("/", 1)[0]
            tops[top] = tops.get(top, [0, 0])
            tops[top][0] += 1
            tops[top][1] += sz
            if sz > biggest[0]:
                biggest = (sz, c[0])
    vol_gib = rom_b / 2**30
    marker = biggest[1] or "TODO"

    # 落草稿
    if args.force:
        shutil.rmtree(archive, ignore_errors=True)
    archive.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (archive / "game.tsv").write_text(
        draft_game_tsv(tid, name, disp, ver, mods, bid, marker, vol_gib),
        encoding="utf-8")
    (archive / "patches.py").write_text(
        f"# patches.py —— {name}（{ver} / {disp}）per-build 指令补丁（new_game.py 起草）。\n"
        "# 格式对齐 nxnative：按 NSO build ID 键控的 CUTS / OBS / FRAME_STEP；一个 build 被两个档案声明即重写报错。\n"
        "# sdk 模块公共裁剪走 dm/tools/sdk_patches.py（nxnative 语义），此处只写本游戏自有模块。\n"
        "# 本档案各模块 build ID：\n" + "".join(f"#   {m} = {bid[m]}\n" for m in mods), encoding="utf-8")

    print(f"[draft] {archive / 'game.tsv'}")
    print(f"[draft] {archive / 'patches.py'}")
    print(f"[facts] 模块 {len(mods)}：{' '.join(mods)}；RomFS {rom_n:,} 文件 / {vol_gib:.2f} GiB；最大文件 {marker}")
    print("[next ] 人工补：program_id / 内存四键 / shader_groups / hap_bundle&label / fonts_mode，"
          "然后 build_hap_from_nsp.py 走七步流")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`nxnative-ohos/template/AppScope/app.json5.tmpl`:

```tmpl
{
  "app": {
    // {{...}} 占位由 scripts/build_hap_from_profile.py 从 games/<titleID>/game.tsv 实例化：
    //   HAP_BUNDLE  ← hap_bundle 键（bundleName）
    //   HAP_LABEL   ← hap_label 键（经 AppScope/resources/.../string.json 的 app_name 落地）
    //   HAP_VERSION ← package 行的 display 版本（versionName）
    "bundleName": "{{HAP_BUNDLE}}",
    "vendor": "vibecc",
```

```txt
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(game C CXX ASM)

set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
# OHOS CMake 会给目标名加 lib 前缀：NODE_MODULE 必须是 game（产物 libgame.so），
# 与 Index.ets import 'libgame.so'、XComponent libraryname:'game'、nm_modname "game" 对齐。

set(NODE_MODULE game)
```

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/game_napi.cpp`:

```cpp
// game_napi.cpp —— ArkTS <-> 游戏宿主 NAPI 桥
// 今晚接通：start(dir) 在独立线程跑 loader 的完整 boot 序列（TOTK_HEADLESS=1，CPU 侧）；
// XComponent surface 句柄经 OH_NativeXComponent 回调收下（swapchain 周末接 nvn_vk）。
// 接线模式抄自 jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile dm/harmony/native/napi_ohos.c。
#include "napi/native_api.h"
#include <ace/xcomponent/native_interface_xcomponent.h>
#include <hilog/log.h>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <thread>
#include <atomic>
#include <unistd.h>
#include "game_id.h"   // 游戏身份单一常量（{{GAME_ID_DIR}} 等，build_hap_from_profile.py 实例化）

#define LOG_DOMAIN 0x0000
#define LOG_TAG GAME_LOG_TAG
#define HI(fmt, ...) ((void)OH_LOG_INFO(LOG_APP, fmt, ##__VA_ARGS__))
#define HE(fmt, ...) ((void)OH_LOG_ERROR(LOG_APP, fmt, ##__VA_ARGS__))

extern "C" int smo_runtime_main(const char *rewritten_dir, const char *mode);
extern "C" void runtime_dump_threads(void);   /* host/threads.c：guest 线程/锁持有者转储（挂起取证） */
extern "C" void runtime_nvn_stub_report(void);   /* host/gfx_bridge.c：表外桩调用计数报告（终局 B 计划） */
extern "C" __attribute__((weak)) void runtime_nvn_stub_report(void) {}   // x86_64 壳 weak 兜底（PITFALLS G4）
// x86_64 壳 target 不编 host 源，与 smo_runtime_main 同款 weak 兜底（真机 arm64 链接真身）
extern "C" __attribute__((weak)) void runtime_dump_threads(void) {}
#ifndef HOST_ARCH
// x86_64 模拟器不编宿主（游戏镜像是 ARM64）：弱符号兜底，arm64 上由 loader.c 的强符号覆盖
extern "C" __attribute__((weak)) int smo_runtime_main(const char *rewritten_dir, const char *mode) {
    (void)rewritten_dir; (void)mode;
    HE("emulator shell only: host runtime not built for x86_64");
    return 2;
}
#endif

static std::atomic<bool> g_running{false};
static std::atomic<int> g_rc{-1};

/* ---- stderr -> hilog：loader 全部诊断（[smo]/[totk]/[odyssey]/[ohos-shim]/FAIL）走 fprintf(stderr)，
   OHOS 上 fd2 无人消费（boot_round3：exit(1) 的 FAIL 文本丢失，0 条原生行）。pipe+转发线程，
   Start() 装一次。stdout 不动（probe 的 JSON 输出本工程用不到）。 ---- */
static void redirect_stderr_to_hilog() {
    static std::atomic<bool> installed{false};
    if (installed.exchange(true)) return;
    int fds[2];
    if (pipe(fds) != 0) { HE("stderr bridge: pipe failed"); return; }
    dup2(fds[1], 2);
    close(fds[1]);
    std::thread([rfd = fds[0]] {
        char buf[1024];
        size_t len = 0;
        for (;;) {
            ssize_t n = read(rfd, buf + len, sizeof(buf) - len);
            if (n <= 0) break;
            len += (size_t)n;
            size_t start = 0;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++)
                if (buf[i] == '\n') {
                    buf[i] = '\0';
                    if (i > start) HI("%{public}s", buf + start);
                    start = i + 1;
                }
            len -= start;
            if (start) memmove(buf, buf + start, len);
            if (len == sizeof(buf)) len = 0;   // 无换行的超长行：丢弃
        }
    }).detach();
}

/* ---- XComponent surface（d2r-mobile 模式）：窗口句柄先存，供后续 Vulkan swapchain ---- */
static std::atomic<void *> g_window{nullptr};
static std::atomic<int> g_surf_w{0}, g_surf_h{0};

static void surface_set(OH_NativeXComponent *c, void *window) {
    if (window) {
        uint64_t w = 0, h = 0;
        OH_NativeXComponent_GetXComponentSize(c, window, &w, &h);
        g_window.store(window);
        g_surf_w.store((int)w);
        g_surf_h.store((int)h);
        HI("surface ready %{public}llux%{public}llu", (unsigned long long)w, (unsigned long long)h);
    } else {
        g_window.store(nullptr);
        HI("surface destroyed");
    }
}
static void on_created(OH_NativeXComponent *c, void *window) { surface_set(c, window); }
static void on_changed(OH_NativeXComponent *c, void *window) { surface_set(c, window); }
static void on_destroyed(OH_NativeXComponent *c, void *window) { (void)c; surface_set(c, NULL); }
static void on_touch(OH_NativeXComponent *c, void *window) { (void)c; (void)window; }
static OH_NativeXComponent_Callback g_xcb = {on_created, on_changed, on_destroyed, on_touch};

/* ---- NAPI ---- */
static napi_value Start(napi_env env, napi_callback_info info) {
    size_t argc = 1;
    napi_value argv[1];
    napi_get_cb_info(env, info, &argc, argv, nullptr, nullptr);
    static char dir[512] = "";
    if (argc >= 1) {
        size_t n = 0;
        napi_get_value_string_utf8(env, argv[0], dir, sizeof(dir), &n);
    }
    if (g_running.load()) { napi_value out; napi_create_int32(env, 0, &out); return out; }
    redirect_stderr_to_hilog();
    if (!dir[0]) snprintf(dir, sizeof(dir), "%s", GAME_ID_DIR);   // 缺省目录 = 档案 id（ets 侧总是显式传）
    HI("start game=%{public}s dir=%{public}s", GAME_ID_DIR, dir);
    setenv("TOTK_HEADLESS", "1", 1);   // 无窗口 boot：不进 frontend，直接 CPU 侧启动序列
    // crash_1031 取证：内存 SVC 打点（GetInfo 节流行/MapPhysicalMemory/SetHeapSize）默认开，
    // 仅日志不改行为；overwrite=0——用户显式设置的环境变量优先（可设 0 关闭）
    setenv("TOTK_MEM_LOG", "1", 0);
    // RomFS：宿主 romfs.c 的 runtime_fs_init 读 TOTK_ROMFS（缺省相对路径在 app 沙箱必落空）；
    // 资源由页面「导入游戏资源」放入 <dir>/romfs（runtime-index.bin + romfs.bin.NNN 分卷）
    {
        static char romfs_dir[600];
        snprintf(romfs_dir, sizeof(romfs_dir), "%s/romfs", dir);
        setenv("TOTK_ROMFS", romfs_dir, 1);
    }
    setenv("TOTK_ROMFS_PATCHES", "0", 1);  // 无补丁 overlay（显式关掉，避免缺省相对路径查找）
    setenv("TOTK_ROMFS_MODS", "0", 1);
    setenv("TOTK_DUMP_AT", "0x136de50,0x136de60,0x136e000", 0);   // 终局四段清单：句柄族槽(0x136de50/58/60/68 取 3 窗口)+crop 槽基线
    // 账户/存档档案目录：account.c/fs_host.c 读 TOTK_PROFILE_DIR（缺省相对 "user-data"），
    // appspawn 的 CWD 只读，mkdir 必失败（round23 "FAIL: create local account directory"）；锚到 <dir>/user-data
    {
        static char profile_dir[600];
        snprintf(profile_dir, sizeof(profile_dir), "%s/user-data", dir);
        setenv("TOTK_PROFILE_DIR", profile_dir, 1);
    }
    g_running.store(true);
    g_rc.store(-1);
    std::thread([] {
        int rc = smo_runtime_main(dir, "boot");
        g_rc.store(rc);
        HI("boot thread returned rc=%{public}d", rc);
        g_running.store(false);
    }).detach();
    // 挂起取证（round29）：headless boot 挂起时 hdc shell kill -USR1 被 yama 拒（Operation not
    // permitted）、freeze_watchdog 又要求"已呈现首帧"。宿主内自驱动：TOTK_HANG_DUMP_SECS（默认 60，0 关）
    // 秒后首次转储 guest 线程/锁持有者，此后每该间隔一次——挂起自动出现场，正常运行只是多几段日志。
    {
        const char *hs = getenv("TOTK_HANG_DUMP_SECS");
        int hang_s = hs ? atoi(hs) : 60;
        if (hang_s > 0) {
            std::thread([hang_s] {
                for (;;) {
                    sleep(hang_s);
                    if (!g_running.load()) return;
                    HI("hang watchdog: dumping threads");
                    runtime_dump_threads();
                    runtime_nvn_stub_report();   /* 终局 B 计划：高频表外桩名单 */
                }
            }).detach();
        }
    }
    napi_value out; napi_create_int32(env, 0, &out); return out;
}

static napi_value Stop(napi_env env, napi_callback_info) {
    // TODO: 宿主优雅退出（svc ExitProcess 路径），此处先只报告
    napi_value undef; napi_get_undefined(env, &undef); return undef;
}

static napi_value Status(napi_env env, napi_callback_info) {
    // 0=idle 1=running 2=returned；供 ArkTS 轮询状态文案
    int s = g_running.load() ? 1 : (g_rc.load() >= 0 ? 2 : 0);
    napi_value out; napi_create_int32(env, s, &out); return out;
}

static napi_value SurfaceProbe(napi_env env, napi_callback_info) {
    napi_value out; napi_create_int32(env, g_window.load() ? 1 : 0, &out); return out;
}

EXTERN_C_START
static napi_value Init(napi_env env, napi_value exports) {
    napi_property_descriptor desc[] = {
        {"start", nullptr, Start, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, napi_default, nullptr},
        {"stop", nullptr, Stop, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, napi_default, nullptr},
        {"status", nullptr, Status, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, napi_default, nullptr},
        {"surfaceProbe", nullptr, SurfaceProbe, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, napi_default, nullptr},
    };
    napi_define_properties(env, exports, sizeof(desc) / sizeof(desc[0]), desc);
    // XComponent 以本库为 libraryname 加载时，exports 上挂着原生组件句柄（d2r-mobile 模式）
    napi_value xobj;
    OH_NativeXComponent *xc = nullptr;
    if (napi_get_named_property(env, exports, OH_NATIVE_XCOMPONENT_OBJ, &xobj) == napi_ok &&
        napi_unwrap(env, xobj, (void **)&xc) == napi_ok && xc) {
        OH_NativeXComponent_RegisterCallback(xc, &g_xcb);
        HI("xcomponent callback registered");
    }
    return exports;
}
EXTERN_C_END

static napi_module gameModule = {
    .nm_version = 1,
    .nm_flags = 0,
    .nm_filename = nullptr,
    .nm_register_func = Init,
    .nm_modname = "game",
    .nm_priv = nullptr,
};

extern "C" __attribute__((constructor)) void RegisterGameModule(void) {
    napi_module_register(&gameModule);
}

```

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/host/account.c`:

```c
/* Offline local user identity. Handles are validated; profile survives restarts. */
#include "runtime.h"
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/file.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
typedef struct{uint64_t lo,hi;} Uid;
typedef struct{Uid uid;uint64_t token;} UserHandle;
static Uid local;
/* Canaries around the lock: an intermittent hang showed this mutex's internal words changed while nobody held it. */
#define GUARD 0x6163636f756e7447ULL
static struct{uint64_t pre[8];pthread_mutex_t m;uint64_t post[8];} guarded={{GUARD,GUARD,GUARD,GUARD,GUARD,GUARD,GUARD,GUARD},PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER,{GUARD,GUARD,GUARD,GUARD,GUARD,GUARD,GUARD,GUARD}};
#define lock_ guarded.m
static _Atomic(uint64_t) lock_owner;
static void check_guard(void){for(unsigned i=0;i<8;i++)if(guarded.pre[i]!=GUARD||guarded.post[i]!=GUARD){fprintf(stderr,"[totk] account lock guard %s[%u] overwritten: %#llx\n",guarded.pre[i]!=GUARD?"pre":"post",i,(unsigned long long)(guarded.pre[i]!=GUARD?guarded.pre[i]:guarded.post[i]));runtime_fail("host memory near the account lock was overwritten");}}
static void lock_acquire(void){check_guard();pthread_mutex_lock(&lock_);uint64_t t;pthread_threadid_np(NULL,&t);lock_owner=t;}
static void lock_release(void){lock_owner=0;pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock_);check_guard();}
uint64_t runtime_account_lock_owner(void){const uint32_t *w=(const uint32_t *)(const void *)&guarded;fprintf(stderr,"[totk-dump] account lock with guards @%p:",(void *)&guarded);for(unsigned i=0;i<sizeof(guarded)/4;i++)fprintf(stderr," %08x",w[i]);fputc('\n',stderr);return lock_owner;}
static uint64_t tokens[64],nextToken=1;
/* mkdir -p: the profile directory can sit on missing parents (the OHOS launcher anchors
   TOTK_PROFILE_DIR inside the app sandbox, where the first run builds the whole chain). */

}
```

```c
/* Host side of applet, telemetry, NFC and error-display services that main reaches through IPC.
   Client-side SDK code (PlayReport encoding, keyboard presets, diag logging) runs unchanged; only the
   calls that would talk to system services are taken here. */
#include "runtime.h"
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

/* ---------- nn::oe ---------- */
static float balance[2] = {1.0f, 1.0f};
static pthread_mutex_t lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static pthread_cond_t message_cv = PTHREAD_COND_INITIALIZER;
static uint32_t messages[32]; static unsigned head, tail;
static uint64_t start_ns;
__attribute__((constructor)) static void started(void) { start_ns = runtime_now_ns(); }

void runtime_oe_push_message(uint32_t message) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
    if (tail - head < 32) { messages[tail++ % 32] = message; pthread_cond_broadcast(&message_cv); }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
}
static void get_balance(float *l, float *r) { pthread_mutex_lock(&lock); if (l) *l = balance[0]; if (r) *r = balance[1]; pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock); }
static void set_balance(float l, float r) {
    if (l < 0 || l > 1 || r < 0 || r > 1) runtime_fail("volume balance out of range");
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock); balance[0] = l; balance[1] = r; pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
}

 * in an applet ExecuteProgram chain. -1 keeps the game's normal user-open path. */

    (void)buffer;(void)capacity;if(size)*size=0;return 0;

    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock); int ok = head != tail; if (ok && out) *out = messages[head++ % 32]; pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock); return (unsigned char)ok;
}

static uint32_t pop(void) {
    __attribute__((cleanup(runtime_core_back))) int away = runtime_core_away();   /* blocks like a Horizon wait */
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock); while (head == tail) pthread_cond_wait(&message_cv, &lock);
    uint32_t m = messages[head++ % 32]; pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock); return m;
}

/* ---------- nn::web: the host has no browser applet ----------
   Layouts from the 1.3.0 sdk: ShowOfflineHtmlPageArg starts with a 0x2000-byte list (u16 count at +0, entries from +8,
   each u16 kind, u16 size, u32 0, then size bytes; the document path is kind 6, SetDocumentPath at sdk+0x3b5f10).
   OfflineHtmlPageReturnValue is 0x1010 bytes: exit reason at +0 (constructor stores 20, GetOfflineExitReason reads a
   32-bit value), last URL at +8 and its size at +0x1008. main's one caller (main+0x6cb5b4) treats a nonzero Result as
   failure and reads the last URL only for exit reason 3, so the page reports success, closed by the player (1). */
#define WEB_ARG_SIZE 0x2000u
#define WEB_DOCUMENT_PATH 6
#define WEB_EXIT_BACK_BUTTON 1
static unsigned show_offline_html_page(void *out, const void *arg) {
    const uint8_t *a = arg; const char *path = NULL; int path_len = 0;
    unsigned count = a ? (unsigned)(a[0] | a[1] << 8) : 0;
    for (size_t at = 8; count-- && at + 8 <= WEB_ARG_SIZE;) {
        unsigned kind = a[at] | a[at + 1] << 8, size = a[at + 2] | a[at + 3] << 8;
        if (at + 8 + size > WEB_ARG_SIZE) break;
        if (kind == WEB_DOCUMENT_PATH) { path = (const char *)a + at + 8; path_len = (int)strnlen(path, size); break; }
        at += 8 + size;
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "[totk] offline web page \"%.*s\" requested; no browser applet on the host, reported closed\n", path_len, path ? path : "");
    if (!out) runtime_fail("offline web page without a return value");
    uint8_t *r = out; memset(r, 0, 0x1010); uint64_t reason = WEB_EXIT_BACK_BUTTON; memcpy(r, &reason, sizeof reason);
    return 0;
}
```

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/host/aspect_math.h`:

```h
/* The arithmetic and machine code of aspect_patch.h, without the runtime, so tests/test_aspect.c can check it: TOTK_ASPECT
   parsing, key 4's steps, the Vert+ factor for ratios below 16:9, and the stubs put behind the camera sites. The UI
   squeeze that goes with them is the graphics layer's (gfx/nvn/totk_ui_squeeze.h).
   Vert+: the game keeps its vertical field of view and the aspect ratio decides how much is seen at the sides, so a ratio
   below 16:9 (a MacBook's 16:10) would show less at the sides. 1.4.3 inlines sead's PerspectiveProjection::setFovy in
   both camera sites: the camera's fovy is loaded, stored at +0xa0, and the sine, cosine and tangent of half of it go to
   +0xa4, +0xa8 and +0xac, just before the aspect ratio (+0xb0) that the sites patch. The Vert+ stub sits on that fovy
   load and widens it to 2 atan(k tan(fovy / 2)), k = (16/9) / ratio, with the game's own tanf and atanf, so the 16:9
   horizontal view stays, more is seen above and below, and every value sead derives (fovy, sine, cosine, tangent) agrees.
   Opt-in (TOTK_ASPECT_VERT=1) until its known issues are fixed: the TODO(Vert+) in aspect_patch.h. */
#pragma once
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

#define ASPECT_GAME (16.0 / 9.0)
#define ASPECT_DATA_SLOT 56   /* the ratio's float on the data page after main; 0.0 = the game's own */
#define ASPECT_VERT_SLOT 60   /* the Vert+ factor beside it; 0.0 = none */
#define ASPECT_TANF_SLOT 64   /* the game's tanf and atanf (8 bytes each), for the Vert+ stubs */
#define ASPECT_ATANF_SLOT 72
#define ASPECT_STUB 32        /* bytes per plain stub */
#define ASPECT_VSTUB 304      /* bytes per Vert+ stub (74 words, padded) */

enum { ASPECT_BAD = -1, ASPECT_DISPLAY = -2 };

/* TOTK_ASPECT as a ratio: 0 when unset or "0", ASPECT_DISPLAY for "display" (the window's shape), ASPECT_BAD when it is
   not <w>:<h>, <w>x<h> or a ratio between 0.5 and 8. */
static inline double aspect_parse(const char *e) {
    if (!e || !*e || !strcmp(e, "0")) return 0;
    if (!strcmp(e, "display")) return ASPECT_DISPLAY;
    double a = 0, w, h; char rest;
    if ((sscanf(e, "%lf:%lf%c", &w, &h, &rest) == 2 || sscanf(e, "%lfx%lf%c", &w, &h, &rest) == 2) && w > 0 && h > 0) a = w / h;
    else if (sscanf(e, "%lf%c", &w, &rest) == 1) a = w;
    return a >= 0.5 && a <= 8 ? a : ASPECT_BAD;
}

/* Is ratio a within 1% of b. */
static inline int aspect_near(double a, double b) { return a > 0 && b > 0 && a / b > 0.99 && a / b < 1.01; }

/* The ratio to put in for a wanted one: 0 (the game's own, no stretch) within 1% of 16:9 or outside 0.5..8. */
static inline float aspect_effective(double a) {
    if (!(a >= 0.5 && a <= 8) || aspect_near(a, ASPECT_GAME)) return 0;
    return (float)a;
}

/* Key 4's steps: 16:9 -> fit to the window / display -> wide -> 16:9. wide is 21:9, or TOTK_ASPECT's ratio when set. */
#define ASPECT_WIDE (21.0 / 9.0)
enum { ASPECT_STEP_GAME, ASPECT_STEP_FIT, ASPECT_STEP_WIDE };

/* The step after `step` for a window of shape view: fitting is skipped when it would show the same as 16:9 or wide
   (the window within 1% of either, or no window shape yet). */
static inline int aspect_next_step(int step, double view, double wide) {
    if (step == ASPECT_STEP_GAME)
        return !(view > 0) || aspect_near(view, ASPECT_GAME) || aspect_near(view, wide) ? ASPECT_STEP_WIDE : ASPECT_STEP_FIT;
    return step == ASPECT_STEP_FIT ? ASPECT_STEP_WIDE : ASPECT_STEP_GAME;
}

/* The ratio a step wants (0 = the game's own); aspect_effective turns it into the one put in. */
static inline double aspect_step_ratio(int step, double view, double wide) {
    return step == ASPECT_STEP_FIT ? view : step == ASPECT_STEP_WIDE ? wide : 0;
}

/* Vert+ is opt-in: TOTK_ASPECT_VERT=1 only (otherwise the vertical view is kept and a little less is seen at the sides). */
static inline int aspect_vert_wanted(const char *e) { return e && !strcmp(e, "1"); }

/* The Vert+ factor for ratio a (the half-angle tangent is multiplied by it): (16/9) / a below 16:9, 0 (none) otherwise. */
static inline float aspect_vert_factor(float a) {
    return a > 0 && a < ASPECT_GAME ? (float)(ASPECT_GAME / a) : 0;
}

/* b from -> to, or 0 when out of range. */
static inline uint32_t aspect_b(uint64_t from, uint64_t to) {
    int64_t d = (int64_t)to - (int64_t)from;
    if ((d & 3) || d < -(1 << 27) || d >= (1 << 27)) return 0;
    return 0x14000000u | ((uint32_t)(d >> 2) & 0x3ffffff);
}
/* adrp x<r> at `at` for the page of `to` (offsets from a page aligned base), or 0 when out of range. */
static inline uint32_t aspect_adrp(unsigned r, uint64_t at, uint64_t to) {
    int64_t pages = (int64_t)(to >> 12) - (int64_t)(at >> 12);
    if (pages < -(1 << 20) || pages >= (1 << 20)) return 0;
    uint32_t imm = (uint32_t)pages & 0x1fffff;
    return 0x90000000u | ((imm & 3) << 29) | ((imm >> 2) << 5) | r;
}

/* Is ins one a site may hold: fdiv s<d>, ... or ldr s<d>, [x<n>, #imm]. */
static inline int aspect_site_ok(uint32_t ins) {
    return (ins & 0xffe0fc00) == 0x1e201800 || (ins & 0xffc00000) == 0xbd400000;
}
static inline int aspect_str_s(uint32_t w, unsigned off) { return (w & 0xffc00000) == 0xbd000000 && ((w >> 10) & 0xfff) * 4 == off; }

/* The projection register of a camera site: words[0..7] are site-16 .. site+12, the site at words[4]. 1.4.3:
   str s0, [x<p>, #0xac] (the tangent) shortly before, str s<d>, [x<p>, #0xb0] (the ratio the site loads) shortly after.
   -1 when the pattern is not there or the register collides with the stub's own. */
static inline int aspect_vert_reg(const uint32_t words[8]) {
    unsigned d = words[4] & 31;
    if (!aspect_site_ok(words[4]) || (d >= 16 && d <= 18)) return -1;
    for (int a = 5; a < 8; a++) {
        if (!aspect_str_s(words[a], 0xb0) || (words[a] & 31) != d) continue;
        unsigned p = (words[a] >> 5) & 31;
        if (p == 10 || p == 11 || p == 31) return -1;
        for (int b = 0; b < 4; b++) if (aspect_str_s(words[b], 0xac) && ((words[b] >> 5) & 31) == p) return (int)p;
    }
    return -1;
}

/* The camera's fovy load for a camera site whose projection is x<p>: words[0..15] are site-64 .. site-4. 1.4.3:
   ldr s<f>, [x<c>, #imm] (the camera's fovy), fmul (half of it), str s<f>, [x<p>, #0xa0]. The index of the load, or -1. */
static inline int aspect_fovy_at(const uint32_t words[16], unsigned p) {
    for (int j = 0; j + 2 < 16; j++) {
        uint32_t f = words[j] & 31;
        if ((words[j] & 0xffc00000) == 0xbd400000 && (words[j + 1] & 0xff20fc00) == 0x1e200800 && ((words[j + 1] >> 5) & 31) == f &&
            aspect_str_s(words[j + 2], 0xa0) && (words[j + 2] & 31) == f && ((words[j + 2] >> 5) & 31) == p) return j;
    }
    return -1;
}

/* The plain stub (8 words) at offset s for the site's instruction ins: run it and, while a ratio sits in the data page's
   slot, put that instead. It keeps its scratch register on the stack, so no liveness is assumed. NULL or what failed. */
static inline const char *aspect_stub(uint32_t ins, uint64_t s, uint64_t site, uint64_t data_off, uint32_t out[8]) {
    uint32_t adrp = aspect_adrp(10, s + 8, data_off), back = aspect_b(s + 28, site + 4);
    if (!adrp) return "aspect patch: data page out of ADRP range";
    if (!back) return "aspect patch: branch out of range";
    uint32_t stub[8] = {
        ins,                                                              /* the game's own ratio into s<d> */
        0xf81f0fea,                                                       /* str x10, [sp, #-16]! */
        adrp,                                                             /* adrp x10, <data page> */
        0xb9400000u | ((uint32_t)(ASPECT_DATA_SLOT / 4) << 10) | (10 << 5) | 10, /* ldr w10, [x10, #slot] */
        0x3400004au,                                                      /* cbz w10, +8: off, keep it */
        0x1e270000u | (10 << 5) | (ins & 31),                             /* fmov s<d>, w10: the ratio */
        0xf84107ea,                                                       /* ldr x10, [sp], #16 */
        back};                                                            /* b <after the instruction> */
    memcpy(out, stub, sizeof stub);
    return NULL;
}

/* The Vert+ stub (74 words) at offset s for the fovy load ins of a camera site: run it and, while the Vert+ factor k is
   set, widen s<f> to 2 atanf(k tanf(s<f> / 2)), calling the game's tanf and atanf (data page +64, +72). The game's
   code runs on as if nothing had happened: x0-x17, x30, q0-q31 and the flags are kept on the stack (672 bytes), and
   s<f> comes back from its slot there. */
static inline const char *aspect_vstub(uint32_t ins, uint64_t s, uint64_t site, uint64_t data_off, uint32_t out[74]) {
    uint32_t adrp1 = aspect_adrp(16, s + 29 * 4, data_off), adrp2 = aspect_adrp(16, s + 37 * 4, data_off), back = aspect_b(s + 73 * 4, site + 4);
    if (!adrp1 || !adrp2) return "aspect patch: data page out of ADRP range";
    if (!back) return "aspect patch: branch out of range";
    const uint32_t QF = 160 + 16 * (ins & 31);   /* s<f>'s slot */
    uint32_t w[74], n = 0;
    w[n++] = ins;                                                            /*  0 the camera's fovy into s<f> */
    w[n++] = 0xd10a83ff;                                                     /*  1 sub sp, sp, #672 */
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 18; i += 2) w[n++] = 0xa9000000u | (i << 15) | ((i + 1) << 10) | (31 << 5) | i;   /* stp x<i>, x<i+1>, [sp, #8i] */
    w[n++] = 0xd53b4210;                                                     /* 11 mrs x16, nzcv */
    w[n++] = 0xa9000000u | (18u << 15) | (16 << 10) | (31 << 5) | 30;        /* 12 stp x30, x16, [sp, #144] */
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 32; i += 2) w[n++] = 0xad000000u | (((160 + 16 * i) / 16) << 15) | ((i + 1) << 10) | (31 << 5) | i;   /* stp q<i>, q<i+1> */
    w[n++] = adrp1;                                                          /* 29 adrp x16, <data page> */
    w[n++] = 0xb9400000u | ((ASPECT_VERT_SLOT / 4) << 10) | (16 << 5) | 17;  /* 30 ldr w17, [x16, #k] */
    w[n++] = 0x34000000u | ((45 - 31) << 5) | 17;                            /* 31 cbz w17, 45: no Vert+ */
    w[n++] = 0xbd400000u | ((QF / 4) << 10) | (31 << 5) | 0;                 /* 32 ldr s0, [sp, #s<f>] */
    w[n++] = 0x1e2c1001;                                                     /* 33 fmov s1, #0.5 */
    w[n++] = 0x1e210800;                                                     /* 34 fmul s0, s0, s1 */
    w[n++] = 0xf9400000u | ((ASPECT_TANF_SLOT / 8) << 10) | (16 << 5) | 16;  /* 35 ldr x16, [x16, #tanf] */
    w[n++] = 0xd63f0200;                                                     /* 36 blr x16 */
    w[n++] = adrp2;                                                          /* 37 adrp x16, <data page> */
    w[n++] = 0xb9400000u | ((ASPECT_VERT_SLOT / 4) << 10) | (16 << 5) | 17;  /* 38 ldr w17, [x16, #k] */
    w[n++] = 0x1e270221;                                                     /* 39 fmov s1, w17 */
    w[n++] = 0x1e210800;                                                     /* 40 fmul s0, s0, s1 */
    w[n++] = 0xf9400000u | ((ASPECT_ATANF_SLOT / 8) << 10) | (16 << 5) | 16; /* 41 ldr x16, [x16, #atanf] */
    w[n++] = 0xd63f0200;                                                     /* 42 blr x16 */
    w[n++] = 0x1e202800;                                                     /* 43 fadd s0, s0, s0 */
    w[n++] = 0xbd000000u | ((QF / 4) << 10) | (31 << 5) | 0;                 /* 44 str s0, [sp, #s<f>]: the wider fovy */
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 32; i += 2) w[n++] = 0xad400000u | (((160 + 16 * i) / 16) << 15) | ((i + 1) << 10) | (31 << 5) | i;   /* 45 ldp q<i>, q<i+1> */
    w[n++] = 0xa9400000u | (18u << 15) | (16 << 10) | (31 << 5) | 30;        /* 61 ldp x30, x16, [sp, #144] */
    w[n++] = 0xd51b4210;                                                     /* 62 msr nzcv, x16 */
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 18; i += 2) w[n++] = 0xa9400000u | (i << 15) | ((i + 1) << 10) | (31 << 5) | i;   /* ldp x<i>, x<i+1> */
    w[n++] = 0x910a83ff;                                                     /* 72 add sp, sp, #672 */
    w[n++] = back;                                                           /* 73 b <after the load> */
    if (n != 74) return "aspect patch: Vert+ stub size";
    memcpy(out, w, sizeof w);
    return NULL;
}
```
