`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/host/controller_map.h`:

```h
/* Controller button layout: each physical button of a controller (named by its position, the same on a DualSense, an Xbox
   and a Nintendo controller: runtime/gamepad_layout.h gamepad_face_positions) drives one Switch Pro Controller button, or
   none. The default is the Switch's own layout by position: east -> A, south -> B, north -> X, west -> Y (issue #10); the
   other buttons i < 16 are FullKey bit i. The touchpad click (DualSense, DualShock 4) is physical button 16 and drives
   nothing by default. The mouse's buttons (Mac, mouse mode on key 7: runtime/gamepad.m) are physical buttons 17-21:
   left attacks (Y), right draws the bow (ZR, "aim mouse_left": a left click while it is held shoots instead of
   attacking), middle targets (ZL), the two side buttons drive nothing.
   A layout file has one "physical = switch [mode]" line per change; '#' starts a comment; names are case-insensitive;
   "none" leaves a button unused; lines not given keep the default. The optional mode says how long the Switch button is
   held: "hold" (default) while the physical button is down, "tap" for 400 ms after each press (tap again to keep
   running), "toggle" on and off at each press (cleared when the stick returns to center), "aim <fire button>" while
   the button is down, except while the fire button is also down (hold L2 to draw the bow, press R2 to shoot it; the
   fire button's own line applies only while the aim button is up). A mode byte keeps the kind in its low 3 bits and,
   for aim, the fire button's index in its high 5 bits.
   A "reach <lstick|rstick> <up|down|left|right> = <0.3..1>" line says how far a worn stick actually gets in that
   direction (measured 24 October: an Xbox controller's left stick reached only 0.67 downward); that half-axis is scaled
   up so its full travel gives full input (controller_reach_parse).
   Pure C: app/launcher.m checks the file before the game starts (an alert names the bad line), runtime/gamepad.m
   applies it, tests/test_controller_map.c covers the parser. */
#ifndef TOTK_CONTROLLER_MAP_H
#define TOTK_CONTROLLER_MAP_H
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <strings.h>

enum { CONTROLLER_BUTTONS = 22, CONTROLLER_SWITCH_BUTTONS = 16, CONTROLLER_MOUSE_FIRST = 17, CONTROLLER_MOUSE_BUTTONS = 5 };
static const char *const controller_physical_names[CONTROLLER_BUTTONS] = {
    "south", "east", "west", "north", "l3", "r3", "l1", "r1", "l2", "r2", "menu", "view", "left", "up", "right", "down",
    "touchpad", "mouse_left", "mouse_right", "mouse_middle", "mouse4", "mouse5"};
static const char *const controller_switch_names[CONTROLLER_SWITCH_BUTTONS] = {
    "a", "b", "x", "y", "lstick", "rstick", "l", "r", "zl", "zr", "plus", "minus", "left", "up", "right", "down"};

enum { CONTROLLER_HOLD = 0, CONTROLLER_TAP = 1, CONTROLLER_TOGGLE = 2, CONTROLLER_AIM = 3 };
static inline int controller_mode_kind(uint8_t mode) { return mode & 7; }
static inline int controller_mode_fire(uint8_t mode) { return mode >> 3; }

static inline void controller_map_default(uint16_t map[CONTROLLER_BUTTONS], uint8_t modes[CONTROLLER_BUTTONS]) {
    for (int i = 0; i < CONTROLLER_BUTTONS; i++) { map[i] = i < CONTROLLER_SWITCH_BUTTONS ? (uint16_t)(1u << i) : 0; modes[i] = CONTROLLER_HOLD; }
    map[0] = 1u << 1; map[1] = 1u << 0; map[2] = 1u << 3; map[3] = 1u << 2;   /* south B, east A, west Y, north X */
    enum { LEFT = CONTROLLER_MOUSE_FIRST, RIGHT, MIDDLE };
    map[LEFT] = 1u << 3;                                                    /* attack (Y) */
    map[RIGHT] = 1u << 9; modes[RIGHT] = (uint8_t)(CONTROLLER_AIM | LEFT << 3);   /* draw the bow (ZR); a left click shoots */
    map[MIDDLE] = 1u << 8;                                                  /* target (ZL) */
}

/* Index of name [s, s + n) in the count names, or -1. */
static inline int controller_name_index(const char *const names[], int count, const char *s, size_t n) {
    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
        if (strlen(names[i]) == n && !strncasecmp(names[i], s, n)) return i;
    return -1;
}

/* Applies a layout file's text to map and modes (start from controller_map_default). Returns 0, or the 1-based number of
   the first bad line with *error naming the problem; both arrays are then unchanged. */
static inline int controller_map_parse(const char *text, uint16_t map[CONTROLLER_BUTTONS],
                                       uint8_t modes[CONTROLLER_BUTTONS], const char **error) {
    uint16_t next[CONTROLLER_BUTTONS]; uint8_t nextMode[CONTROLLER_BUTTONS];
    memcpy(next, map, sizeof next); memcpy(nextMode, modes, sizeof nextMode);
    int line = 0;
    for (const char *p = text; p && *p;) {
        line++;
        const char *end = strchr(p, '\n'), *stop = end ? end : p + strlen(p), *hash = memchr(p, '#', (size_t)(stop - p));
        if (hash) stop = hash;
        while (p < stop && (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t' || *p == '\r')) p++;
        while (stop > p && (stop[-1] == ' ' || stop[-1] == '\t' || stop[-1] == '\r')) stop--;
        if (p < stop && !(stop - p > 6 && !strncasecmp(p, "reach", 5) && (p[5] == ' ' || p[5] == '\t'))) {   /* reach lines: controller_reach_parse */
            const char *eq = memchr(p, '=', (size_t)(stop - p));
            if (!eq) { *error = "expected \"button = Switch button [hold|tap|toggle]\""; return line; }
            const char *key_end = eq, *value = eq + 1;
            while (key_end > p && (key_end[-1] == ' ' || key_end[-1] == '\t')) key_end--;
            while (value < stop && (*value == ' ' || *value == '\t')) value++;
            const char *value_end = value, *mode = NULL, *mode_end = NULL;
            while (value_end < stop && *value_end != ' ' && *value_end != '\t') value_end++;
            for (const char *q = value_end; q < stop; q++) if (*q != ' ' && *q != '\t') { mode = q; break; }
            if (mode) { mode_end = mode; while (mode_end < stop && *mode_end != ' ' && *mode_end != '\t') mode_end++; }
            int physical = controller_name_index(controller_physical_names, CONTROLLER_BUTTONS, p, (size_t)(key_end - p));
            if (physical < 0) { *error = "unknown controller button (south east west north l1 r1 l2 r2 l3 r3 menu view up down left right touchpad mouse_left mouse_right mouse_middle mouse4 mouse5)"; return line; }
            size_t n = (size_t)(value_end - value);
            int target = n == 4 && !strncasecmp(value, "none", 4) ? CONTROLLER_SWITCH_BUTTONS : controller_name_index(controller_switch_names, CONTROLLER_SWITCH_BUTTONS, value, n);
            if (target < 0) { *error = "unknown Switch button (a b x y l r zl zr plus minus lstick rstick up down left right none)"; return line; }
            uint8_t how = CONTROLLER_HOLD;
            if (mode) {
                size_t m = (size_t)(mode_end - mode);
                if (m == 4 && !strncasecmp(mode, "hold", 4)) how = CONTROLLER_HOLD;
                else if (m == 3 && !strncasecmp(mode, "tap", 3)) how = CONTROLLER_TAP;
                else if (m == 6 && !strncasecmp(mode, "toggle", 6)) how = CONTROLLER_TOGGLE;
                else if (m == 3 && !strncasecmp(mode, "aim", 3)) how = CONTROLLER_AIM;
                else { *error = "unknown mode (hold tap toggle aim)"; return line; }
                const char *extra = mode_end; while (extra < stop && (*extra == ' ' || *extra == '\t')) extra++;
                if (how == CONTROLLER_AIM) {
                    const char *fire_end = extra; while (fire_end < stop && *fire_end != ' ' && *fire_end != '\t') fire_end++;
                    int fire = extra < stop ? controller_name_index(controller_physical_names, CONTROLLER_BUTTONS, extra, (size_t)(fire_end - extra)) : -1;
                    if (fire < 0) { *error = "aim needs a fire button, e.g. \"l2 = zr aim r2\""; return line; }
                    if (fire == physical) { *error = "the fire button must be another button"; return line; }
                    how = (uint8_t)(CONTROLLER_AIM | fire << 3);
                    extra = fire_end; while (extra < stop && (*extra == ' ' || *extra == '\t')) extra++;
                }
                if (extra < stop) { *error = "too many words after the Switch button"; return line; }
                if (target == CONTROLLER_SWITCH_BUTTONS && how != CONTROLLER_HOLD) { *error = "none takes no mode"; return line; }
            }
            next[physical] = target == CONTROLLER_SWITCH_BUTTONS ? 0 : (uint16_t)(1u << target);
            nextMode[physical] = how;
        }
        p = end ? end + 1 : NULL;
    }
    memcpy(map, next, sizeof next); memcpy(modes, nextMode, sizeof nextMode);
    return 0;
}

/* Stick reach lines (see the top): reach[stick * 4 + direction], stick 0 lstick / 1 rstick, direction 0 up / 1 down /
   2 left / 3 right; 1 = full travel (the default). Returns 0, or the 1-based number of the first bad line with *error. */
static inline int controller_reach_parse(const char *text, float reach[8], const char **error) {
    float next[8]; for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) next[i] = 1.0f;
    static const char *const sticks[] = {"lstick", "rstick"}, *const dirs[] = {"up", "down", "left", "right"};
    int line = 0;
    for (const char *p = text; p && *p;) {
        line++;
        const char *end = strchr(p, '\n'), *stop = end ? end : p + strlen(p), *hash = memchr(p, '#', (size_t)(stop - p));
        if (hash) stop = hash;
        while (p < stop && (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t' || *p == '\r')) p++;
        if (stop - p > 6 && !strncasecmp(p, "reach", 5) && (p[5] == ' ' || p[5] == '\t')) {
            char stick[16] = "", dir[16] = "", rest[64] = ""; float value = 0; char tail[8] = "";
            size_t n = (size_t)(stop - p); char buf[128]; if (n >= sizeof buf) { *error = "reach line too long"; return line; }
            memcpy(buf, p, n); buf[n] = 0;
            if (sscanf(buf, "%*s %15s %15[^= \t] = %63s %7s", stick, dir, rest, tail) != 3 || sscanf(rest, "%f", &value) != 1) {
                *error = "expected \"reach lstick down = 0.67\""; return line; }
            int s = controller_name_index(sticks, 2, stick, strlen(stick)), d = controller_name_index(dirs, 4, dir, strlen(dir));
            if (s < 0 || d < 0) { *error = "reach needs lstick or rstick, then up, down, left or right"; return line; }
            if (!(value >= 0.3f && value <= 1.0f)) { *error = "reach must be between 0.3 and 1"; return line; }
            next[s * 4 + d] = value;
        }
        p = end ? end + 1 : NULL;
    }
    memcpy(reach, next, sizeof next);
    return 0;
}

/* The Switch buttons held, from the physical buttons held (bit i = physical button i). */
static inline uint64_t controller_map_apply(const uint16_t map[CONTROLLER_BUTTONS], uint64_t physical) {
    uint64_t buttons = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < CONTROLLER_BUTTONS; i++)
        if (physical >> i & 1) buttons |= map[i];
    return buttons;
}
#endif
```

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/host/entry.S`:

```S
/* Guest-call gate and thread entry/leave trampolines (OHOS/ELF port).
   来源：infra/MacNativeGames/games/by3/runtime/gate.S 与 thread_enter.S，符号去 Mach-O 下划线，
   风格与同目录 hle_stack.S 对齐（ELF/PIC：局部标号 adr，外部函数 bl，不引用 C 全局变量故无 GOT 取数）。
   gate.S 的 by3 原版在门内先切宿主栈并保存 q 寄存器/nzcv/fpsr/fpcr；本移植按设计契约改为最小帧：
   门运行在客体小栈上，只存取 x0..x30，不许碰 q 寄存器（宿主栈切换由 hle_stack.S 的
   runtime_hle_switch 负责，与本门不重叠）。dm_thread_enter / runtime_thread_leave 与 by3 原版
   语义逐条对齐：host_context[0]=宿主 sp，host_context[1]=宿主 fp。 */
.text

/* runtime_gate: patched guest code calls this via blr, so x30 on entry is the patch return address
   that runtime_dispatch (host/loader.c) matches against the gate table. x0..x30 are saved in an
   array on the (guest) stack, passed to runtime_dispatch(ret, regs), and written back afterwards.
   注意：全程在客体小栈上，帧只有 256 字节寄存器数组；不碰 q 寄存器（契约要求）。 */
    .globl runtime_gate
    .p2align 2
runtime_gate:
    sub sp, sp, #256            // regs[31]：x0..x29 成对存放，x30 单独在 +240
    stp x0, x1, [sp, #0]
    stp x2, x3, [sp, #16]
    stp x4, x5, [sp, #32]
    stp x6, x7, [sp, #48]
    stp x8, x9, [sp, #64]
    stp x10, x11, [sp, #80]
    stp x12, x13, [sp, #96]
    stp x14, x15, [sp, #112]
    stp x16, x17, [sp, #128]
    stp x18, x19, [sp, #144]
    stp x20, x21, [sp, #160]
    stp x22, x23, [sp, #176]
    stp x24, x25, [sp, #192]
    stp x26, x27, [sp, #208]
    stp x28, x29, [sp, #224]
    str x30, [sp, #240]         // 补丁点返回地址（blr 进来时的 lr）＝门标识
    mov x0, x30                 // runtime_dispatch(ret, regs)
    mov x1, sp
    bl runtime_dispatch
    ldp x0, x1, [sp, #0]
    ldp x2, x3, [sp, #16]
    ldp x4, x5, [sp, #32]
    ldp x6, x7, [sp, #48]
    ldp x8, x9, [sp, #64]
    ldp x10, x11, [sp, #80]
    ldp x12, x13, [sp, #96]
    ldp x14, x15, [sp, #112]
    ldp x16, x17, [sp, #128]
    ldp x18, x19, [sp, #144]
    ldp x20, x21, [sp, #160]
    ldp x22, x23, [sp, #176]
    ldp x24, x25, [sp, #192]
    ldp x26, x27, [sp, #208]
    ldp x28, x29, [sp, #224]
    ldr x30, [sp, #240]
    add sp, sp, #256
    ret

/* dm_thread_enter(entry, arg, sp, host_context, tcb): x0=entry, x1=arg, x2=sp, x3=host_context, x4=tcb。
   把宿主 sp 与 fp 记进 host_context（布局与 by3 原版一致：[0]=sp，[1]=fp，threads.c 的
   thread_exit 用它回宿主栈），装 x18=合成 TCB（OHOS 封 tpidrro 写，TLS 走 x18 方案），
   然后转到客体入口在客体栈上执行。不返回：客体须经 ExitThread 退出（host/threads.c）。 */
    .globl dm_thread_enter
    .p2align 2
dm_thread_enter:
    mov x5, sp
    stp x5, x29, [x3]
    mov x18, x4
    mov sp, x2
    mov x29, #0
    mov x16, x0
    mov x0, x1
    adr x30, 1f
    br x16
1:  bl dm_thread_returned       // host/threads.c：客体入口返回即 die（Horizon 要求 ExitThread）
    brk #0

/* runtime_guest_call_tcb(tcb, fn, a0, a1, a2, a3)：boot 线程进客体用。C 调用会踩 x18，
   装 TCB 与跳转必须在同一段裸汇编里完成；fn 不返回（nn::init::Start）。 */
    .globl runtime_guest_call_tcb
    .p2align 2
runtime_guest_call_tcb:
    mov x18, x0
    mov x16, x1            // fn 先存 IP 暂存寄存器（同 dm_thread_enter 的 mov x16/br x16 范式），避免被参数洗牌覆盖
    mov x0, x2
    mov x1, x3
    mov x2, x4
    mov x3, x5
    br x16

/* runtime_thread_leave(host_context, arg, fn): 从 host_context 取回 dm_thread_enter 记下的宿主
   sp/fp，切回宿主栈后在上面调用 fn(arg)。不返回（threads.c thread_exit_on_host 以 pthread_exit
   结束）。 */
    .globl runtime_thread_leave
    .p2align 2
runtime_thread_leave:
    ldp x4, x29, [x0]
    mov sp, x4
    mov x0, x1
    br x2

```

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/host/freeze_watchdog.c`:

```c
/* Freeze watchdog (task 0k, after smo-recomp's nvn_vk_watchdog.c): when the game stops producing frames, write what is
   needed to see why, and nothing else. Off unless ODYSSEY_FREEZE_WATCHDOG is set: "1" = 5 s without a frame, "N" = N s.
   It never stops, resumes or changes the game; it only logs.

   Once the game has presented its first frame, a thread looks every 500 ms at the frames the game submitted
   (dm_nvn_frame_count, hle_nvn.c) and the frames actually presented (mtl_present_count, nvn_mtl.m). When neither has moved
   for the threshold it logs one "[freeze-watchdog]" line and dumps, once per freeze (at most 3 per run):
   - the guest threads, core owners and lock owners (runtime_dump_threads, threads.c), to stderr;
   - the GPU wait state (mtl_wait_state_dump, nvn_mtl.m), to stderr;
   - every host thread's stack: /usr/bin/sample for 3 s into <dir>/freeze-<pid>-<n>.txt, where <dir> is
     ODYSSEY_FREEZE_DIR, else freeze-dumps next to TOTK_PROFILE_DIR, else ./freeze-dumps.
   When frames move again it logs how long the freeze lasted. The hooks are weak, so a target without them (the headless
   probe) still links; a missing hook is skipped. */
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <limits.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <spawn.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/wait.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <unistd.h>

extern char **environ;
__attribute__((weak)) uint64_t dm_nvn_frame_count(void);
__attribute__((weak)) uint64_t mtl_present_count(void);
__attribute__((weak)) void runtime_dump_threads(void);
__attribute__((weak)) void mtl_wait_state_dump(void);

enum { FW_MAX_DUMPS = 3 };
static double g_threshold_s;
static char g_dir[PATH_MAX];

static double fw_now(void) { return clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW) / 1e9; }
static uint64_t fw_frames(void) { return dm_nvn_frame_count ? dm_nvn_frame_count() : 0; }
static uint64_t fw_presents(void) { return mtl_present_count ? mtl_present_count() : 0; }

static pid_t fw_sample(int n) {   /* every host thread's stack, by Apple's sampler, in its own process */
    mkdir(g_dir, 0755);
    char path[PATH_MAX], pid[16];
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/freeze-%d-%d.txt", g_dir, (int)getpid(), n);
    snprintf(pid, sizeof pid, "%d", (int)getpid());
    char *argv[] = {"/usr/bin/sample", pid, "3", "-file", path, "-mayDie", NULL};
    posix_spawn_file_actions_t fa; posix_spawn_file_actions_init(&fa);
    posix_spawn_file_actions_addopen(&fa, 1, "/dev/null", O_WRONLY, 0);
    posix_spawn_file_actions_addopen(&fa, 2, "/dev/null", O_WRONLY, 0);
    posix_spawnattr_t at; posix_spawnattr_init(&at);
    posix_spawnattr_setflags(&at, POSIX_SPAWN_CLOEXEC_DEFAULT | POSIX_SPAWN_SETSIGMASK);
    sigset_t none; sigemptyset(&none); posix_spawnattr_setsigmask(&at, &none);
    pid_t child = 0;
    int err = posix_spawn(&child, argv[0], &fa, &at, argv, environ);
    posix_spawn_file_actions_destroy(&fa); posix_spawnattr_destroy(&at);
    if (err) { fprintf(stderr, "[freeze-watchdog] could not start sample: %s\n", strerror(err)); return 0; }
    fprintf(stderr, "[freeze-watchdog] host thread stacks (3 s sample) -> %s\n", path);
    return child;
}

static void *fw_thread(void *unused) {
    (void)unused;
    pthread_setname_np("freeze-watchdog");
    uint64_t frames = fw_frames(), presents = fw_presents();
    double moved = fw_now(), frozen_at = 0;
    int dumps = 0; pid_t child = 0;
    for (;;) {
        usleep(500000);
        if (child && waitpid(child, NULL, WNOHANG) == child) child = 0;
        uint64_t f = fw_frames(), p = fw_presents();
        double now = fw_now();
        if (!f && !p) { moved = now; continue; }   /* not armed before the first frame (startup, shader warm-up) */
        if (f != frames || p != presents) {
            if (frozen_at) fprintf(stderr, "[freeze-watchdog] frames moved again after %.1f s (game frame %llu, present %llu)\n",
                                   now - moved, (unsigned long long)f, (unsigned long long)p);
            frames = f; presents = p; moved = now; frozen_at = 0;
            continue;
        }
        if (frozen_at || now - moved < g_threshold_s) continue;
        frozen_at = now;
        if (dumps >= FW_MAX_DUMPS) {
            fprintf(stderr, "[freeze-watchdog] no frame for %.1f s (game frame %llu, present %llu); dump limit reached\n",
                    now - moved, (unsigned long long)f, (unsigned long long)p);
            continue;
        }
        dumps++;
        fprintf(stderr, "[freeze-watchdog] no frame for %.1f s (game frame %llu, present %llu); dump %d of %d\n",
                now - moved, (unsigned long long)f, (unsigned long long)p, dumps, FW_MAX_DUMPS);
        if (!child) child = fw_sample(dumps);
        if (runtime_dump_threads) runtime_dump_threads();
        if (mtl_wait_state_dump) mtl_wait_state_dump();
    }
    return NULL;
}

__attribute__((constructor)) static void fw_start(void) {
    const char *e = getenv("ODYSSEY_FREEZE_WATCHDOG");
    if (!e || !*e || !strcmp(e, "0")) return;
    double s = atof(e); g_threshold_s = s > 1 ? s : 5;
    const char *dir = getenv("ODYSSEY_FREEZE_DIR"), *profile = getenv("TOTK_PROFILE_DIR");
    if (dir && *dir) snprintf(g_dir, sizeof g_dir, "%s", dir);
    else if (profile && *profile) snprintf(g_dir, sizeof g_dir, "%s/../freeze-dumps", profile);
    else snprintf(g_dir, sizeof g_dir, "freeze-dumps");
    pthread_t t;
    if (pthread_create(&t, NULL, fw_thread, NULL)) { fprintf(stderr, "[freeze-watchdog] could not start: %s\n", strerror(errno)); return; }
    pthread_detach(t);
    fprintf(stderr, "[freeze-watchdog] on: logs and dumps after %.0f s without a frame (dumps in %s); never changes the game\n", g_threshold_s, g_dir);
}

```

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/host/fs_host.c`:

```c
/* nn::fs host implementation for the functions main imports. RomFS paths and handles go to the
   verified read-only backend (romfs.c); save, temporary and cache storage are host directories under
   the profile directory. Application save data is created on first start, as the system launcher does
   for titles that declare save data. Writes reach the host file immediately; Commit flushes them.
   Because of that, quitting in the middle of a save (the game writes several files, then commits) would leave a slot half
   written: runtime_fs_save_busy tells the window close to wait until the save is done (runtime/frontend.m). */
#include "autoload.h"
#include "runtime.h"
#include "fs_host.h"
#include <dirent.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#define R_PATH_NOT_FOUND 0x202u
#define R_ALREADY_EXISTS 0x402u
#define R_NOT_EMPTY 0x1002u
#define R_TARGET_NOT_FOUND 0x7d402u
#define R_INVALID_ARGUMENT 0x2ee202u
#define R_INVALID_PATH 0x2ee602u
#define R_OPEN_MODE 0x307402u

#include "game_version.h"

enum { M_FREE, M_SAVE, M_TEMP, M_CACHE };
enum { OPEN_READ = 1, OPEN_WRITE = 2, OPEN_APPEND = 4 };
#define FILE_BASE 0x200000000ULL
#define DIR_BASE 0x300000000ULL
#define NFILES 1024
#define NDIRS 256

typedef struct { int kind; char name[32]; char root[1024]; } Mount;
typedef struct { int fd, mode, save; } File;   /* save: on a save-data mount (counts for runtime_fs_save_busy) */
/* A RomFS directory is a snapshot of its children taken at open (rom != NULL; dir stays NULL). */
struct RomEntry; typedef struct { DIR *dir; char path[1024]; int mode; struct RomEntry *rom; int64_t nrom, pos; } Dir;
static Mount mounts[16];
static File files[NFILES];
static Dir dirs[NDIRS];
static pthread_mutex_t lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;

static pthread_once_t once = PTHREAD_ONCE_INIT;

static void need(int c, const char *m) { if (!c) runtime_fail(m); }

/* Save in progress: a save-data file open for writing, or save data changed in the last 3 s and not committed yet (TOTK
   writes a slot's files back to back and then commits; between the files nothing is open for a moment). */
static _Atomic int save_writers, save_dirty;
static _Atomic uint64_t save_changed_ns;
static void save_touched(void) { atomic_store(&save_changed_ns, runtime_now_ns()); atomic_store(&save_dirty, 1); }
int runtime_fs_save_busy(void) {
    if (atomic_load(&save_writers) > 0) return 1;
    return atomic_load(&save_dirty) && runtime_now_ns() - atomic_load(&save_changed_ns) < 3000000000ull;
}
static void make_dir(const char *p) { if (mkdir(p, 0700) && errno != EEXIST) runtime_fail("create profile storage directory"); }
static int remove_tree(const char *path) {
    DIR *d = opendir(path); if (!d) return errno == ENOENT ? 0 : -1;
    struct dirent *e; int ok = 0; char child[2048];
    while ((e = readdir(d))) {
        if (!strcmp(e->d_name, ".") || !strcmp(e->d_name, "..")) continue;
        snprintf(child, sizeof child, "%s/%s", path, e->d_name);
        ok |= e->d_type == DT_DIR ? remove_tree(child) : unlink(child);
    }
    closedir(d);
    return ok | rmdir(path);
}
static void init(void) {
    const char *dir = getenv("TOTK_PROFILE_DIR"); if (!dir) dir = "user-data";
    need(snprintf(profile, sizeof profile, "%s", dir) < (int)sizeof profile, "profile path");
    uint64_t uid[2]; runtime_account_uid(uid);
    char p[1100]; make_dir(profile);
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/save", profile); make_dir(p);
    need(snprintf(save_root, sizeof save_root, "%s/save/%016llx%016llx", profile, (unsigned long long)uid[1], (unsigned long long)uid[0]) < (int)sizeof save_root, "save path");
    make_dir(save_root);                                   /* launcher-style EnsureSaveData */
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/temp", profile); remove_tree(p); make_dir(p);
    snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/cache", profile); make_dir(p);
    fprintf(stderr, "[totk] host save storage: %s\n", save_root);
}
static void ready(void) { pthread_once(&once, init); }

/* ---------- mounts and paths ---------- */
static unsigned mount_add(const char *name, int kind, const char *root) {
    if (!name || !*name || strlen(name) >= 32 || strchr(name, ':') || strchr(name, '/')) return R_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
    int slot = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) { if (mounts[i].kind && !strcmp(mounts[i].name, name)) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock); return R_ALREADY_EXISTS; } if (!mounts[i].kind && slot < 0) slot = i; }
    if (slot < 0) runtime_fail("fs mount table full");
    mounts[slot].kind = kind; strcpy(mounts[slot].name, name); snprintf(mounts[slot].root, sizeof mounts[slot].root, "%s", root);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
    fprintf(stderr, "[totk] fs mount %s: -> %s\n", name, root);
    return 0;
}
static int component_ok(const char *c, size_t n) { return n && !(n == 1 && c[0] == '.') && !(n == 2 && c[0] == '.' && c[1] == '.'); }
/* "name:/a/b" -> host path; 0 on success; *kind = the mount's kind (M_SAVE ...) when kind is given */
static unsigned host_path_kind(const char *path, char *out, size_t cap, int *kind) {
    if (!path) return R_INVALID_PATH;
    const char *colon = strchr(path, ':');
    if (!colon || colon[1] != '/') return R_INVALID_PATH;
    size_t n = (size_t)(colon - path);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
    const Mount *m = NULL;
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) if (mounts[i].kind && strlen(mounts[i].name) == n && !strncmp(mounts[i].name, path, n)) m = &mounts[i];
    char root[1024]; if (m) strcpy(root, m->root);
    int k = m ? m->kind : M_FREE;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
    if (!m) return R_PATH_NOT_FOUND;
    if (kind) *kind = k;
    const char *rest = colon + 1;
    for (const char *q = rest + 1; *q;) { const char *e = strchr(q, '/'); size_t len = e ? (size_t)(e - q) : strlen(q); if (!e && !len) break; if (!component_ok(q, len) || memchr(q, '\\', len)) return R_INVALID_PATH; q = e ? e + 1 : q + len; }
    if (snprintf(out, cap, "%s%s", root, rest) >= (int)cap) return R_INVALID_PATH;
    size_t L = strlen(out); while (L > strlen(root) && out[L - 1] == '/') out[--L] = 0;
    return 0;
}
static unsigned host_path(const char *path, char *out, size_t cap) { return host_path_kind(path, out, cap, NULL); }
/* A change to save data through a path (create, delete, rename, directories): marks the save as in progress. */
static unsigned save_change_path(const char *path, char *out, size_t cap) {
    int kind = M_FREE; unsigned r = host_path_kind(path, out, cap, &kind);
    if (!r && kind == M_SAVE) save_touched();
    return r;
}
static unsigned errno_result(void) { return errno == ENOENT || errno == ENOTDIR ? R_PATH_NOT_FOUND : errno == EEXIST ? R_ALREADY_EXISTS : errno == ENOTEMPTY ? R_NOT_EMPTY : R_INVALID_ARGUMENT; }

/* ---------- storage mounts ---------- */
static unsigned mount_save(const char *name, const uint64_t *uid) {
    ready(); uint64_t me[2]; runtime_account_uid(me);
    if (!uid || uid[0] != me[0] || uid[1] != me[1]) return R_TARGET_NOT_FOUND;
    return mount_add(name, M_SAVE, save_root);
}
static unsigned char save_exists(uint64_t application, const uint64_t *uid) {
    ready(); uint64_t me[2]; runtime_account_uid(me);
    return application == TOTK_APPLICATION_ID && uid && uid[0] == me[0] && uid[1] == me[1];
}
/* Other titles' save data (e.g. data-link bonuses) is not present on this host. */
static unsigned mount_save_ro(const char *name, uint64_t application, const uint64_t *uid) {
    if (!save_exists(application, uid)) return R_TARGET_NOT_FOUND;
    return mount_add(name, M_SAVE, save_root);
}
static unsigned mount_temp(const char *name) { ready(); char p[1100]; snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/temp", profile); return mount_add(name, M_TEMP, p); }
static void cache_dir(int index, char *out, size_t cap) { snprintf(out, cap, "%s/cache/%d", profile, index); }
static unsigned create_cache(int index, int64_t size, int64_t journal) {
    ready(); if (index < 0 || size < 0 || journal < 0) return R_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    char p[1100]; cache_dir(index, p, sizeof p);
    if (mkdir(p, 0700)) return errno == EEXIST ? R_ALREADY_EXISTS : errno_result();
    return 0;
}
static unsigned delete_cache(int index) { ready(); char p[1100]; cache_dir(index, p, sizeof p); return remove_tree(p) ? R_TARGET_NOT_FOUND : 0; }
static unsigned mount_cache(const char *name, int index) {
    ready(); char p[1100]; cache_dir(index, p, sizeof p); struct stat st;
    if (stat(p, &st) || !S_ISDIR(st.st_mode)) return R_TARGET_NOT_FOUND;
    return mount_add(name, M_CACHE, p);
}
typedef struct { int32_t index; uint8_t reserved[0x1c]; } CacheStorageInfo;
typedef struct { int list[64]; int count, next; } CacheList;
static unsigned open_cache_list(uint64_t *out) {
    ready(); if (!out) return R_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    CacheList *l = calloc(1, sizeof *l); need(l != NULL, "cache list allocation");
    char p[1100]; snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/cache", profile); DIR *d = opendir(p); struct dirent *e;
    while (d && (e = readdir(d)) && l->count < 64) { char *end; long v = strtol(e->d_name, &end, 10); if (*e->d_name && !*end && v >= 0) l->list[l->count++] = (int)v; }
    if (d) closedir(d);
    *out = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)l; return 0;
}
static unsigned read_cache_list(int *count, CacheStorageInfo *out, uint64_t h, int max) {
    CacheList *l = (CacheList *)(uintptr_t)h; if (!l || !count || max < 0 || (!out && max)) return R_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    int n = 0; while (n < max && l->next < l->count) { memset(&out[n], 0, sizeof *out); out[n++].index = l->list[l->next++]; }
    *count = n; return 0;
}
static void close_cache_list(uint64_t h) { free((void *)(uintptr_t)h); }
static void unmount(const char *name) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) if (mounts[i].kind && !strcmp(mounts[i].name, name)) { mounts[i].kind = M_FREE; pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock); return; }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
    if (!runtime_romfs_owns(name)) runtime_fail("unmount of unknown fs mount");
}
/* EnsureSaveData(uid) (Bayonetta 3): the profile's save folder is made when storage starts; only the local account owns one. */
static unsigned ensure_save(const uint64_t *uid) {
    ready(); uint64_t me[2]; runtime_account_uid(me);
    if (!uid || uid[0] != me[0] || uid[1] != me[1]) runtime_fail("EnsureSaveData for an unknown account");
    return 0;
}
static unsigned commit(const char *name) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock); int found = 0, save = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) if (mounts[i].kind && !strcmp(mounts[i].name, name)) { found = 1; save = mounts[i].kind == M_SAVE; }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
    if (!found) return R_PATH_NOT_FOUND;
    for (int i = 0; i < NFILES; i++) { pthread_mutex_lock(&lock); int fd = files[i].fd; pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock); if (fd > 0) fcntl(fd, F_FULLFSYNC); }
    if (save && !(getenv("TOTK_PROBE_NEGATIVE") && atoi(getenv("TOTK_PROBE_NEGATIVE")) == 23)) atomic_store(&save_dirty, 0);   /* 23: probe-save's negative control */
    return 0;
}

/* ---------- files ---------- */
static File *file_of(uint64_t h, int *fd, int *mode) {
    if (h < FILE_BASE || h >= FILE_BASE + NFILES) return NULL;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock); File *f = &files[h - FILE_BASE]; int v = f->fd; if (fd) *fd = f->fd; if (mode) *mode = f->mode; pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
    return v > 0 ? f : NULL;
}
void runtime_fs_log(const char *what, const char *path);
static unsigned open_file(uint64_t *out, const char *path, int mode) {
    if (path && !runtime_romfs_owns(path)) runtime_fs_log(mode & 2 ? "write" : "read", path);
    if (runtime_romfs_owns(path)) return runtime_romfs_open(out, path, mode);
    if (!out || !(mode & (OPEN_READ | OPEN_WRITE)) || (mode & ~7)) return R_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    char p[1100]; int kind = M_FREE; unsigned r = host_path_kind(path, p, sizeof p, &kind); if (r) return r;
    struct stat st; if (stat(p, &st)) return R_PATH_NOT_FOUND; if (!S_ISREG(st.st_mode)) return R_PATH_NOT_FOUND;
    int save_writer = kind == M_SAVE && (mode & OPEN_WRITE);
    int fd = open(p, (mode & OPEN_WRITE ? (mode & OPEN_READ ? O_RDWR : O_WRONLY) : O_RDONLY) | O_NOFOLLOW);
    if (fd < 0) return errno_result();
    runtime_autoload_save_file_opened(path);   /* TOTK_AUTOLOAD: a slot's caption.sav starts the presses, its progress.sav ends them */
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < NFILES; i++) if (files[i].fd <= 0) {
        files[i] = (File){fd, mode, save_writer}; *out = FILE_BASE + (uint64_t)i; pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
        if (save_writer) { atomic_fetch_add(&save_writers, 1); save_touched(); }
        return 0;
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock); runtime_fail("host file handle table full");
}
static unsigned read_file(uint64_t *out, uint64_t h, int64_t offset, void *buffer, uint64_t size) {
    if (runtime_romfs_handle(h)) return runtime_romfs_read(out, h, offset, buffer, size);
    int fd, mode; if (!out || offset < 0 || (!buffer && size) || !file_of(h, &fd, &mode)) return R_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    if (!(mode & OPEN_READ)) return R_OPEN_MODE;
    dm_guest_write_prepare(buffer, (size_t)size);
    uint64_t done = 0;
    while (done < size) { ssize_t n = pread(fd, (uint8_t *)buffer + done, (size_t)(size - done), offset + (off_t)done); if (n < 0) runtime_fail("host save read failure"); if (!n) break; done += (uint64_t)n; }
    *out = done; return 0;
}
static unsigned read_options(uint64_t *out, uint64_t h, int64_t off, void *buf, uint64_t size, const void *options) { (void)options; return read_file(out, h, off, buf, size); }
static unsigned read_exact(uint64_t h, int64_t off, void *buf, uint64_t size) { uint64_t n = 0; unsigned r = read_file(&n, h, off, buf, size); return r ? r : n == size ? 0 : R_INVALID_ARGUMENT; }
static unsigned write_file(uint64_t h, int64_t offset, const void *buffer, uint64_t size, const int32_t *option) {
    int fd, mode; File *f = offset < 0 || (!buffer && size) ? NULL : file_of(h, &fd, &mode); if (!f) return R_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    if (!(mode & OPEN_WRITE)) return R_OPEN_MODE;
    struct stat st; if (fstat(fd, &st)) runtime_fail("host save stat");
    if ((uint64_t)offset + size > (uint64_t)st.st_size && !(mode & OPEN_APPEND)) return R_APPEND_REQUIRED;
    uint64_t done = 0;
    if (f->save) {
        save_touched();
        static int delay_ms = -1; if (delay_ms < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_SAVE_WRITE_DELAY_MS"); delay_ms = e ? atoi(e) : 0; }
        if (delay_ms > 0) usleep((useconds_t)delay_ms * 1000);   /* tests only: slow saves down so a window close lands in the middle of one */
    }
    while (done < size) { ssize_t n = pwrite(fd, (const uint8_t *)buffer + done, (size_t)(size - done), offset + (off_t)done); if (n <= 0) runtime_fail("host save write failure"); done += (uint64_t)n; }
    if (option && (*option & 1)) fcntl(fd, F_FULLFSYNC);
    return 0;
}
static unsigned file_size(int64_t *out, uint64_t h) {
    if (runtime_romfs_handle(h)) return runtime_romfs_size(out, h);
    int fd; struct stat st; if (!out || !file_of(h, &fd, NULL) || fstat(fd, &st)) return R_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    *out = st.st_size; return 0;
}
static unsigned set_file_size(uint64_t h, int64_t size) {
    int fd, mode; if (size < 0 || !file_of(h, &fd, &mode)) return R_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    if (!(mode & OPEN_WRITE)) return R_OPEN_MODE;
    if (files[h - FILE_BASE].save) save_touched();
    return ftruncate(fd, size) ? errno_result() : 0;
}
static unsigned flush_file(uint64_t h) { int fd; if (!file_of(h, &fd, NULL)) return R_INVALID_ARGUMENT; fcntl(fd, F_FULLFSYNC); return 0; }
static void close_file(uint64_t h) {
    if (runtime_romfs_handle(h)) { runtime_romfs_close(h); return; }
    if (!file_of(h, NULL, NULL)) runtime_fail("close invalid file handle");
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock); int fd = files[h - FILE_BASE].fd, save = files[h - FILE_BASE].save; files[h - FILE_BASE].fd = 0; pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
    close(fd);
    if (save) { save_touched(); atomic_fetch_sub(&save_writers, 1); }
}
static unsigned create_file(const char *path, int64_t size) {
    char p[1100]; unsigned r = save_change_path(path, p, sizeof p); if (r) return r; if (size < 0) return R_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    int fd = open(p, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_EXCL | O_NOFOLLOW, 0600); if (fd < 0) return errno_result();
    int bad = ftruncate(fd, size); close(fd); return bad ? errno_result() : 0;
}
static unsigned delete_file(const char *path) { char p[1100]; unsigned r = save_change_path(path, p, sizeof p); if (r) return r; return unlink(p) ? errno_result() : 0; }
static unsigned rename_file(const char *from, const char *to) {
    char a[1100], b[1100]; unsigned r = save_change_path(from, a, sizeof a); if (!r) r = host_path(to, b, sizeof b); if (r) return r;
    struct stat st; if (!stat(b, &st)) return R_ALREADY_EXISTS;
    return rename(a, b) ? errno_result() : 0;
}
static unsigned entry_type(int *out, const char *path) {
    if (runtime_romfs_owns(path)) return runtime_romfs_entry_type(out, path);
    char p[1100]; unsigned r = host_path(path, p, sizeof p); if (r) return r; struct stat st;
    if (!out) return R_INVALID_ARGUMENT; if (stat(p, &st)) return R_PATH_NOT_FOUND;
    *out = S_ISDIR(st.st_mode) ? 0 : 1; return 0;
}

/* ---------- directories ---------- */
typedef struct { char name[769]; uint8_t pad0[3]; int8_t type; uint8_t pad1[3]; int64_t size; } DirectoryEntry;
_Static_assert(sizeof(DirectoryEntry) == 0x310, "nn::fs::DirectoryEntry");
static unsigned create_directory(const char *path) { char p[1100]; unsigned r = save_change_path(path, p, sizeof p); if (r) return r; return mkdir(p, 0700) ? errno_result() : 0; }
static unsigned delete_recursive(const char *path) { char p[1100]; unsigned r = save_change_path(path, p, sizeof p); if (r) return r; struct stat st; if (stat(p, &st)) return R_PATH_NOT_FOUND; return remove_tree(p) ? R_INVALID_ARGUMENT : 0; }
struct RomEntry { char name[769]; int is_dir; int64_t size; };
typedef struct { struct RomEntry *list; int64_t n, cap; } RomList;
static void rom_add(void *ctx, const char *name, int is_dir, int64_t size) {
    RomList *l = ctx;
    if (l->n == l->cap) { l->cap = l->cap ? l->cap * 2 : 64; l->list = realloc(l->list, (size_t)l->cap * sizeof *l->list); need(l->list != NULL, "RomFS directory listing"); }
    struct RomEntry *e = &l->list[l->n++]; snprintf(e->name, sizeof e->name, "%s", name); e->is_dir = is_dir; e->size = size;
}
static unsigned open_rom_directory(uint64_t *out, const char *path, int mode) {
    if (!out || mode < 1 || mode > 3) return R_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    RomList l = {0}; unsigned r = runtime_romfs_list(path, mode, rom_add, &l);
    if (r) { fprintf(stderr, "[totk] RomFS directory %s: result %#x\n", path, r); free(l.list); return r; }
    fprintf(stderr, "[totk] RomFS directory %s: %lld entries\n", path, (long long)l.n);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < NDIRS; i++) if (!dirs[i].dir && !dirs[i].rom) {
        dirs[i] = (Dir){.mode = mode, .rom = l.list ? l.list : calloc(1, sizeof *l.list), .nrom = l.n};
        snprintf(dirs[i].path, sizeof dirs[i].path, "%s", path); *out = DIR_BASE + (uint64_t)i; pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock); return 0;
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock); runtime_fail("host directory handle table full");
}
static unsigned open_directory(uint64_t *out, const char *path, int mode) {
    if (getenv("TOTK_FS_LOG")) fprintf(stderr, "[totk-fs] OpenDirectory %s mode %d\n", path ? path : "(null)", mode);
    if (runtime_romfs_owns(path)) return open_rom_directory(out, path, mode);
    char p[1100]; unsigned r = host_path(path, p, sizeof p); if (r) return r; if (!out || mode < 1 || mode > 3) return R_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    DIR *d = opendir(p); if (!d) return errno_result();
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < NDIRS; i++) if (!dirs[i].dir && !dirs[i].rom) { dirs[i].dir = d; dirs[i].mode = mode; strcpy(dirs[i].path, p); *out = DIR_BASE + (uint64_t)i; pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock); return 0; }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock); runtime_fail("host directory handle table full");
}
static unsigned read_directory(int64_t *count, DirectoryEntry *out, uint64_t h, int64_t max) {
    if (h < DIR_BASE || h >= DIR_BASE + NDIRS || !count || max < 0 || (!out && max)) return R_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    Dir *d = &dirs[h - DIR_BASE]; if (!d->dir && !d->rom) return R_INVALID_ARGUMENT;
    int64_t n = 0; struct dirent *e;
    if (d->rom) {
        for (; n < max && d->pos < d->nrom; n++, d->pos++) {
            const struct RomEntry *r = &d->rom[d->pos];
            memset(&out[n], 0, sizeof *out); strcpy(out[n].name, r->name); out[n].type = r->is_dir ? 0 : 1; out[n].size = r->size;
        }
        *count = n; return 0;
    }
    while (n < max && (e = readdir(d->dir))) {
        if (!strcmp(e->d_name, ".") || !strcmp(e->d_name, "..") || strlen(e->d_name) > 768) continue;
        char child[2048]; snprintf(child, sizeof child, "%s/%s", d->path, e->d_name); struct stat st; if (stat(child, &st)) continue;
        int is_dir = S_ISDIR(st.st_mode); if (!(d->mode & (is_dir ? 1 : 2))) continue;
        memset(&out[n], 0, sizeof *out); strcpy(out[n].name, e->d_name); out[n].type = is_dir ? 0 : 1; out[n].size = is_dir ? 0 : st.st_size; n++;
    }
    *count = n; return 0;
}
static void close_directory(uint64_t h) {
    if (h < DIR_BASE || h >= DIR_BASE + NDIRS || (!dirs[h - DIR_BASE].dir && !dirs[h - DIR_BASE].rom)) runtime_fail("close invalid directory handle");
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock); Dir *d = &dirs[h - DIR_BASE];
    if (d->rom) { free(d->rom); d->rom = NULL; } else { closedir(d->dir); d->dir = NULL; }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
}
/* The fs priority only orders I/O inside the system fs process; host I/O is unordered. */
static void set_priority(int priority) { (void)priority; }

/* make probe-save: the "save in progress" state the window close waits on, through the fs entry points the game uses
   (a fresh profile in build/probe-save-profile; no game). */
void runtime_save_probe(void) {
    const char *dir = "build/probe-save-profile";   /* a fresh profile each run (a failed run leaves it for a look) */
    remove_tree(dir); setenv("TOTK_PROFILE_DIR", dir, 1);
    unsigned checks = 0; uint64_t uid[2]; runtime_account_uid(uid); uint64_t h = 0;
#define CHECK(c, what) do { checks++; if (!(c)) { fprintf(stderr, "save probe: %s\n", what); runtime_fail("save probe failed"); } } while (0)
    CHECK(mount_save("save", uid) == 0 && mount_temp("temp") == 0, "mount save and temporary storage");
    CHECK(!runtime_fs_save_busy(), "idle at start");
    CHECK(create_file("save:/a.sav", 16) == 0 && runtime_fs_save_busy(), "creating a save file starts a save");
    CHECK(commit("save") == 0 && !runtime_fs_save_busy(), "commit ends it");
    CHECK(open_file(&h, "save:/a.sav", OPEN_WRITE) == 0 && runtime_fs_save_busy(), "a save file open for writing");
    static const char data[16] = "progress";
    CHECK(write_file(h, 0, data, sizeof data, NULL) == 0 && runtime_fs_save_busy(), "writing");
    atomic_store(&save_changed_ns, runtime_now_ns() - 10000000000ull);
    CHECK(runtime_fs_save_busy(), "a file open for writing is busy however long ago it was written");
    close_file(h);
    CHECK(runtime_fs_save_busy(), "closed but not committed yet (the next file of the save follows)");
    CHECK(commit("save") == 0 && !runtime_fs_save_busy(), "committed");
    CHECK(open_file(&h, "save:/a.sav", OPEN_READ) == 0 && !runtime_fs_save_busy(), "reading is not saving");
    close_file(h);
    CHECK(create_file("save:/b.sav", 4) == 0 && runtime_fs_save_busy(), "second change");
    atomic_store(&save_changed_ns, runtime_now_ns() - 4000000000ull);
    CHECK(!runtime_fs_save_busy(), "uncommitted changes older than 3 s are not a save in progress");
    CHECK(create_file("temp:/t.bin", 4) == 0 && !runtime_fs_save_busy(), "temporary storage does not count");
    CHECK(rename_file("save:/b.sav", "save:/c.sav") == 0 && runtime_fs_save_busy(), "renaming save data");
    CHECK(commit("save") == 0 && !runtime_fs_save_busy() && delete_file("save:/c.sav") == 0 && runtime_fs_save_busy() && commit("save") == 0, "delete and commit");
#undef CHECK
    remove_tree(dir);
    printf("{\"status\":\"pass\",\"probe\":\"probe-save\",\"checks\":%u,\"scope\":\"save-in-progress state (runtime_fs_save_busy) through open / write / close / create / rename / delete / commit on a save mount; reads and temporary storage do not count; stale uncommitted changes do not hold a close\"}\n", checks);
}

    static const struct { const char *name; void *fn; } map[] = {

        {"_ZN2nn2fs8ReadFileENS0_10FileHandleElPvm", read_exact},

        {"_ZN2nn2fs13OpenDirectoryEPNS0_15DirectoryHandleEPKci", open_directory},

        {"_ZN2nn2fs18IsSaveDataExistingENS_13ApplicationIdERKNS_7account3UidE", save_exists},

        {"_ZN2nn2fs14CommitSaveDataEPKc", commit}, {"_ZN2nn2fs14EnsureSaveDataERKNS_7account3UidE", ensure_save},   /* Bayonetta 3 */

        {"_ZN2nn2fs17MountCacheStorageEPKci", mount_cache},

        {"_ZN2nn2fs20ReadCacheStorageListEPiPNS0_16CacheStorageInfoENS0_22CacheStorageListHandleEi", read_cache_list},
        {"_ZN2nn2fs21CloseCacheStorageListENS0_22CacheStorageListHandleE", close_cache_list},
        {"_ZN2nn2fs26SetPriorityOnCurrentThreadENS0_8PriorityE", set_priority},
    };
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof map / sizeof *map; i++) if (!strcmp(name, map[i].name)) return map[i].fn;
    return NULL;
}
```

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/host/game_slot.c`:

```c
/* Game slot: at most one game (or GPU probe) runs at a time on this Mac.
   One game takes about 6.6 GB of the 16 GB; two need about 13 GB, and exhausted memory is what made the GPU driver
   panic the kernel four times on 2026-10-12. Two games would also share one GPU, so neither one's frame times mean
   anything. Several agents (Claude, Codex) and the user's own desktop launcher start games, so the rule is enforced
   here, in every `boot` and `probe-gpu-*` run, rather than in each script.

   The holder keeps an exclusive flock(2) on <slot dir>/lock for the life of its game; the kernel drops the lock when
   the process exits or crashes, so a dead holder never blocks anyone. Waiters line up first come first served. A game
   started for the user (TOTK_SLOT_OWNER=user, the desktop launcher) goes ahead of the queue and stops an agent's game
   that holds the slot: it first records the preemption, then sends SIGTERM, so the agent's script knows to rerun that
   test once the slot is free again. A wrapper that already holds the lock (scripts/dev/game_slot.py) passes it down
   as TOTK_GAME_SLOT_FD. Files in the slot directory (shared with scripts/dev/game_slot.py; change both together):
     lock               flock(2) target
     holder             key=value lines about the current holder; stale once the lock is free
     queue/<ns>-<pid>   waiters (key=value: pid, start, owner, purpose, since)
     user-request       the user's game while it waits for the slot
     preempted/<token>  written just before a holder is stopped for the user
     history.log        one line per acquire / start / preempt / exit
   The slot directory is TOTK_GAME_SLOT_DIR, else analysis/game-slot next to this binary's build/ directory; every
   worktree links analysis/ to the main checkout (scripts/dev/new_worktree.sh), so all checkouts share one slot. */
#include <TargetConditionals.h>
#if TARGET_OS_IPHONE || defined(__OHOS__)   /* __OHOS__ 由 OHOS NDK clang 预定义（-dM 实测；__MUSL__ 并未定义） */
#include "runtime.h"
/* One app per phone: the slot only exists to keep several games off one Mac.
   OHOS 同理：单应用沙箱一次只跑一个游戏；槽位目录逻辑（exe 旁 analysis/ + flock 排队）
   在只读安装目录下 mkdir 必然失败 → runtime_fail → exit(1)（boot_round3 卡点，SmoGame start 后 2ms）。 */
void runtime_game_slot_acquire(const char *mode) { (void)mode; }
#else
#include "runtime.h"
#include <dirent.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <libproc.h>
#include <limits.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/file.h>
#include <sys/proc.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <unistd.h>

static char slot_dir[PATH_MAX], lock_path[PATH_MAX], my_queue[PATH_MAX];
static char owner[33], purpose[200], token[48], mode_name[64];
static int lock_fd = -1, acquired;
static time_t acquired_at;

_Noreturn static void slot_fail(const char *what, const char *path) {
    fprintf(stderr, "[game-slot] %s %s: %s\n", what, path ? path : "", strerror(errno));
    runtime_fail("game slot: see the [game-slot] line above");
}

static void path_in(char *out, const char *name) {
    if (snprintf(out, PATH_MAX, "%s/%s", slot_dir, name) >= PATH_MAX) runtime_fail("game slot path too long");
}

static void clean_copy(char *dst, size_t n, const char *src) {   /* one line, no control characters */
    size_t i = 0;
    for (; src && src[i] && i + 1 < n; i++) dst[i] = (unsigned char)src[i] < 0x20 ? ' ' : src[i];
    dst[i] = 0;
}

static int kv_get(const char *path, const char *key, char *out, size_t n) {
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "r");
    if (!f) return 0;
    char line[1024]; size_t kl = strlen(key); int found = 0;
    while (!found && fgets(line, sizeof line, f))
        if (!strncmp(line, key, kl) && line[kl] == '=') {
            char *v = line + kl + 1; v[strcspn(v, "\n")] = 0;
            snprintf(out, n, "%s", v); found = 1;
        }
    fclose(f);
    return found;
}

static long long kv_num(const char *path, const char *key) {
    char b[32];
    return kv_get(path, key, b, sizeof b) ? atoll(b) : 0;
}

static void write_atomic(const char *path, const char *text) {
    char tmp[PATH_MAX];
    if (snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%s.%d.tmp", path, getpid()) >= (int)sizeof tmp) runtime_fail("game slot path too long");
    int fd = open(tmp, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT | O_TRUNC | O_CLOEXEC, 0644);
    if (fd < 0) slot_fail("cannot write", tmp);
    size_t len = strlen(text);
    if (write(fd, text, len) != (ssize_t)len) slot_fail("cannot write", tmp);
    close(fd);
    if (rename(tmp, path)) slot_fail("cannot rename", path);
}

static void history(const char *event, const char *extra) {
    char p[PATH_MAX]; path_in(p, "history.log");
    int fd = open(p, O_WRONLY | O_APPEND | O_CREAT | O_CLOEXEC, 0644);
    if (fd < 0) return;   /* the log is a convenience; the lock is what matters */
    time_t t = time(NULL); struct tm tm; localtime_r(&t, &tm);
    char ts[32]; strftime(ts, sizeof ts, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S", &tm);
    char line[1024];
    int n = snprintf(line, sizeof line, "%s %s owner=%s pid=%d mode=%s purpose=%s%s%s\n", ts, event, owner, getpid(),
                     mode_name, purpose, extra ? " " : "", extra ? extra : "");
    if (n > 0) (void)!write(fd, line, (size_t)(n < (int)sizeof line ? n : (int)sizeof line - 1));
    close(fd);
}

/* Process start time (seconds) or 0 if the pid is gone or a zombie; with the pid it names one process exactly. */
static uint64_t pid_start(pid_t pid) {
    struct proc_bsdinfo bi;
    if (pid <= 0 || proc_pidinfo(pid, PROC_PIDTBSDINFO, 0, &bi, sizeof bi) != (int)sizeof bi || bi.pbi_status == SZOMB) return 0;
    return bi.pbi_start_tvsec;
}
static int pid_same(pid_t pid, uint64_t start) { return start && pid_start(pid) == start; }
static int pid_is_game(pid_t pid) {
    char path[PROC_PIDPATHINFO_MAXSIZE];
    if (proc_pidpath(pid, path, sizeof path) <= 0) return 0;
    const char *b = strrchr(path, '/'); b = b ? b + 1 : path;
    return !strncmp(b, "totk-native", 11);   /* also renamed copies such as totk-native.base */
}

/* Live waiters in the queue (dead ones are removed). Returns how many; *head gets the oldest one's file name. */
static int queue_scan(char *head, size_t head_n, pid_t *pids, int max_pids) {
    char qdir[PATH_MAX]; path_in(qdir, "queue");
    DIR *d = opendir(qdir);
    if (!d) slot_fail("cannot open", qdir);
    int count = 0; if (head) head[0] = 0;
    struct dirent *e;
    while ((e = readdir(d))) {
        if (e->d_name[0] == '.' || strstr(e->d_name, ".tmp")) continue;
        char p[PATH_MAX];
        if (snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/%s", qdir, e->d_name) >= (int)sizeof p) continue;
        pid_t pid = (pid_t)kv_num(p, "pid");
        if (!pid_same(pid, (uint64_t)kv_num(p, "start"))) { unlink(p); continue; }
        if (pids && count < max_pids) pids[count] = pid;
        count++;
        if (head && (!head[0] || strcmp(e->d_name, head) < 0)) snprintf(head, head_n, "%s", e->d_name);
    }
    closedir(d);
    return count;
}

static pid_t user_request_pid(void) {   /* a live user game waiting for the slot, or 0 */
    char p[PATH_MAX]; path_in(p, "user-request");
    pid_t pid = (pid_t)kv_num(p, "pid");
    return pid_same(pid, (uint64_t)kv_num(p, "start")) ? pid : 0;
}

/* A totk-native process that is neither queued nor this one: a game from before the slot existed (or one using another
   slot directory). Only called while holding the lock, so no game that follows the protocol can be running. */
static pid_t legacy_game(void) {
    pid_t queued[64]; int nq = queue_scan(NULL, 0, queued, 64);
    pid_t user = user_request_pid();
    int n = proc_listallpids(NULL, 0);
    if (n <= 0) return 0;
    int cap = n + 64;
    pid_t *pids = calloc((size_t)cap, sizeof *pids);
    if (!pids) runtime_fail("game slot: out of memory");
    n = proc_listallpids(pids, cap * (int)sizeof *pids);
    pid_t found = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n && i < cap && !found; i++) {
        pid_t p = pids[i];
        if (p <= 0 || p == getpid() || p == user || !pid_is_game(p) || !pid_start(p)) continue;
        int q = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < nq && k < 64; k++) q |= queued[k] == p;
        if (!q) found = p;
    }
    free(pids);
    return found;
}

static void describe_holder(char *out, size_t n) {
    char p[PATH_MAX]; path_in(p, "holder");
    char who[40] = "?", what[200] = "?";
    kv_get(p, "owner", who, sizeof who); kv_get(p, "purpose", what, sizeof what);
    long long since = kv_num(p, "since"), expect = kv_num(p, "expect_s"), gp = kv_num(p, "game_pid");
    long long held = since ? (long long)time(NULL) - since : 0;
    char left[64] = "";
    if (expect > held) snprintf(left, sizeof left, "，预计还要约 %lld 分钟", (expect - held + 59) / 60);
    snprintf(out, n, "%s（%s）占用中，已 %lld 分 %lld 秒%s，游戏 pid %lld", who, what, held / 60, held % 60, left, gp);
}

/* The user's game: stop an agent's game that holds the slot. The marker comes first, so the agent's script can tell a
   preemption from a crash; SIGKILL follows if the game has not gone 15 s after SIGTERM. */
static void preempt_holder(void) {
    static char done_token[48]; static time_t sent_at; static int killed;
    char p[PATH_MAX]; path_in(p, "holder");
    char who[40] = "", tok[48] = "", what[200] = "";
    kv_get(p, "owner", who, sizeof who); kv_get(p, "token", tok, sizeof tok); kv_get(p, "purpose", what, sizeof what);
    if (!tok[0] || !strcmp(who, "user")) return;   /* the user's own other game: wait for it */
    pid_t gp = (pid_t)kv_num(p, "game_pid");
    int live = pid_same(gp, (uint64_t)kv_num(p, "game_start")) && pid_is_game(gp);
    if (strcmp(done_token, tok)) {
        char m[PATH_MAX], name[80], text[200];
        snprintf(name, sizeof name, "preempted/%s", tok); path_in(m, name);
        snprintf(text, sizeof text, "by_pid=%d\nat=%lld\n", getpid(), (long long)time(NULL));
        write_atomic(m, text);
        char extra[300]; snprintf(extra, sizeof extra, "target_owner=%s target_pid=%d target_purpose=%s", who, gp, what);
        history("preempt", extra);
        if (live) kill(gp, SIGTERM);
        fprintf(stderr, "[game-slot] 用户要玩：停止 %s 的游戏（%s，pid %d），它的测试稍后会自动重跑\n", who, what, gp);
        snprintf(done_token, sizeof done_token, "%s", tok); sent_at = time(NULL); killed = 0;
    } else if (live && !killed && time(NULL) - sent_at > 15) {
        kill(gp, SIGKILL); killed = 1;
        fprintf(stderr, "[game-slot] pid %d 15 秒内没有退出，强制结束\n", gp);
    }
}

static void slot_dir_init(void) {
    char def[PATH_MAX] = "", exe[PROC_PIDPATHINFO_MAXSIZE];
    const char *env = getenv("TOTK_GAME_SLOT_DIR");
    /* Packaged launchers always supply an external slot. Do not create even
       an empty analysis directory inside a sealed or read-only app bundle. */
    if ((!env || !*env) && proc_pidpath(getpid(), exe, sizeof exe) > 0) {   /* <native-port>/build/totk-native -> <native-port>/analysis */
        char *s = strrchr(exe, '/'); if (s) *s = 0;
        s = strrchr(exe, '/'); if (s) *s = 0;
        char analysis[PATH_MAX], real[PATH_MAX];
        snprintf(analysis, sizeof analysis, "%s/analysis", exe);
        if (mkdir(analysis, 0755) && errno != EEXIST) slot_fail("cannot create", analysis);
        if (!realpath(analysis, real)) slot_fail("cannot resolve", analysis);
        snprintf(def, sizeof def, "%s/game-slot", real);
    }
    const char *want = env && *env ? env : def;
    if (!*want) runtime_fail("game slot: no slot directory (set TOTK_GAME_SLOT_DIR)");
    if (mkdir(want, 0755) && errno != EEXIST) slot_fail("cannot create", want);
    if (!realpath(want, slot_dir)) slot_fail("cannot resolve", want);
    char sub[PATH_MAX];
    path_in(sub, "queue"); if (mkdir(sub, 0755) && errno != EEXIST) slot_fail("cannot create", sub);
    path_in(sub, "preempted"); if (mkdir(sub, 0755) && errno != EEXIST) slot_fail("cannot create", sub);
    path_in(lock_path, "lock");
}

static int test_ignores_legacy(void) {   /* tests use their own slot directory; never the shared one */
    const char *e = getenv("TOTK_GAME_SLOT_TEST_IGNORE_LEGACY"), *d = getenv("TOTK_GAME_SLOT_DIR");
    if (!e || strcmp(e, "1")) return 0;
    if (!d || !*d || strstr(slot_dir, "/analysis/game-slot")) runtime_fail("TOTK_GAME_SLOT_TEST_IGNORE_LEGACY needs a test TOTK_GAME_SLOT_DIR");
    return 1;
}

static void holder_write(void) {
    char exe[PROC_PIDPATHINFO_MAXSIZE] = "", cwd[PATH_MAX] = "", log[PATH_MAX] = "", text[4096];
    proc_pidpath(getpid(), exe, sizeof exe);
    if (!getcwd(cwd, sizeof cwd)) cwd[0] = 0;
    if (fcntl(2, F_GETPATH, log) == -1) log[0] = 0;
    const char *w = getenv("TOTK_SLOT_WRAPPER_PID"), *ex = getenv("TOTK_SLOT_EXPECT_S"), *si = getenv("TOTK_SLOT_SINCE");
    snprintf(text, sizeof text,
             "owner=%s\npurpose=%s\ntoken=%s\ngame_pid=%d\ngame_start=%llu\nwrapper_pid=%s\nsince=%lld\nexpect_s=%s\nmode=%s\nexe=%s\ncwd=%s\nlog=%s\n",
             owner, purpose, token, getpid(), (unsigned long long)pid_start(getpid()), w ? w : "", si ? atoll(si) : (long long)acquired_at,
             ex ? ex : "0", mode_name, exe, cwd, log);
    char p[PATH_MAX]; path_in(p, "holder");
    write_atomic(p, text);
}

static void at_exit(void) {
    if (my_queue[0]) unlink(my_queue);
    if (!strcmp(owner, "user") && user_request_pid() == getpid()) { char p[PATH_MAX]; path_in(p, "user-request"); unlink(p); }
    if (acquired) { char extra[64]; snprintf(extra, sizeof extra, "held_s=%lld", (long long)(time(NULL) - acquired_at)); history("exit", extra); }
}

static void dry_run(void) {   /* tests: hold the slot like a game would, without booting */
    const char *e = getenv("TOTK_GAME_SLOT_DRYRUN");
    if (!e) return;
    double s = atof(e);
    fprintf(stderr, "[game-slot] dry run: holding the slot %.1f s\n", s);
    for (double t = 0; t < s; t += 0.05) usleep(50000);
    exit(0);
}

void runtime_game_slot_acquire(const char *mode) {
    clean_copy(mode_name, sizeof mode_name, mode);
    const char *o = getenv("TOTK_SLOT_OWNER"), *pu = getenv("TOTK_SLOT_PURPOSE");
    clean_copy(owner, sizeof owner, o && *o ? o : "unknown");
    for (const char *c = owner; *c; c++)
        if (!((*c >= 'a' && *c <= 'z') || (*c >= '0' && *c <= '9') || *c == '-' || *c == '_'))
            runtime_fail("TOTK_SLOT_OWNER: use lower-case letters, digits, - or _ (user, claude, codex ...)");
    clean_copy(purpose, sizeof purpose, pu && *pu ? pu : mode);
    slot_dir_init();
    atexit(at_exit);

    const char *fd_env = getenv("TOTK_GAME_SLOT_FD");
    if (fd_env) {   /* a wrapper took the slot for us: check that this descriptor really holds the lock */
        int fd = atoi(fd_env); struct stat a, b;
        if (fd < 3 || fstat(fd, &a) || stat(lock_path, &b) || a.st_dev != b.st_dev || a.st_ino != b.st_ino)
            runtime_fail("TOTK_GAME_SLOT_FD is not the game slot lock of this slot directory");
        if (flock(fd, LOCK_EX | LOCK_NB)) runtime_fail("TOTK_GAME_SLOT_FD does not hold the game slot (another game has it)");
        fcntl(fd, F_SETFD, FD_CLOEXEC);
        const char *t = getenv("TOTK_SLOT_TOKEN");
        if (!t || !*t) runtime_fail("TOTK_GAME_SLOT_FD without TOTK_SLOT_TOKEN");
        clean_copy(token, sizeof token, t);
        lock_fd = fd; acquired = 1; acquired_at = time(NULL);
        unsetenv("TOTK_GAME_SLOT_FD");
        holder_write();
        history("start", "slot=inherited");
        fprintf(stderr, "[game-slot] 游戏位置由启动脚本持有（%s，%s）\n", owner, purpose);
        dry_run();
        return;
    }

    lock_fd = open(lock_path, O_RDWR | O_CREAT | O_CLOEXEC, 0644);
    if (lock_fd < 0) slot_fail("cannot open", lock_path);
    int user = !strcmp(owner, "user"), ignore_legacy = test_ignores_legacy();
    const char *mw = getenv("TOTK_GAME_SLOT_WAIT");
    double max_wait = mw ? atof(mw) : -1;
    struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &ts);
    char name[80], text[600];
    snprintf(name, sizeof name, "queue/%019llu-%d", (unsigned long long)ts.tv_sec * 1000000000ull + (unsigned long long)ts.tv_nsec, getpid());
    path_in(my_queue, name);
    snprintf(text, sizeof text, "pid=%d\nstart=%llu\nowner=%s\npurpose=%s\nsince=%lld\n", getpid(),
             (unsigned long long)pid_start(getpid()), owner, purpose, (long long)ts.tv_sec);
    write_atomic(my_queue, text);
    if (user) { char p[PATH_MAX]; path_in(p, "user-request"); write_atomic(p, text); }

    time_t start = time(NULL), last_log = 0;
    char reason[600] = "", key[128] = "", last_key[128] = "";   /* key: who blocks us, without the running time */
    for (;;) {
        char head[80]; queue_scan(head, sizeof head, NULL, 0);
        pid_t upid = user ? 0 : user_request_pid();
        const char *mine = strrchr(my_queue, '/') + 1;
        if (upid) { snprintf(reason, sizeof reason, "用户的游戏（pid %d）正在等，让它先", upid); snprintf(key, sizeof key, "user %d", upid); }
        else if (!user && strcmp(head, mine)) {
            snprintf(reason, sizeof reason, "排队中，前面还有别的测试（queue/%s）", head); snprintf(key, sizeof key, "queue %s", head);
        }
        else if (!flock(lock_fd, LOCK_EX | LOCK_NB)) {
            pid_t old = ignore_legacy ? 0 : legacy_game();
            if (!old) break;
            flock(lock_fd, LOCK_UN);
            snprintf(reason, sizeof reason, "pid %d 的游戏没有接入游戏锁（旧版程序？），等它退出", old);
            snprintf(key, sizeof key, "legacy %d", old);
        } else {
            if (errno != EWOULDBLOCK) slot_fail("flock", lock_path);
            describe_holder(reason, sizeof reason);
            char hp[PATH_MAX], tok[48] = ""; path_in(hp, "holder"); kv_get(hp, "token", tok, sizeof tok);
            snprintf(key, sizeof key, "holder %s", tok);
            if (user) preempt_holder();
        }
        time_t now = time(NULL);
        if (max_wait >= 0 && now - start >= max_wait) {
            fprintf(stderr, "[game-slot] 等了 %lld 秒还没轮到（%s）；TOTK_GAME_SLOT_WAIT=%s，退出 75\n", (long long)(now - start), reason, mw);
            exit(75);
        }
        if (strcmp(key, last_key) || now - last_log >= 30) {
            fprintf(stderr, "[game-slot] 等待游戏位置：%s\n", reason);
            snprintf(last_key, sizeof last_key, "%s", key); last_log = now;
        }
        usleep(user ? 200000 : 1000000);
    }
    unlink(my_queue); my_queue[0] = 0;
    if (user) { char p[PATH_MAX]; path_in(p, "user-request"); if (kv_num(p, "pid") == getpid()) unlink(p); }
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &ts);
    snprintf(token, sizeof token, "%llx-%d", (unsigned long long)ts.tv_sec * 1000000000ull + (unsigned long long)ts.tv_nsec, getpid());
    acquired = 1; acquired_at = time(NULL);
    holder_write();
    char extra[64]; snprintf(extra, sizeof extra, "waited_s=%lld", (long long)(acquired_at - start));
    history("acquire", extra);
    fprintf(stderr, "[game-slot] 取得游戏位置（%s，%s）%s\n", owner, purpose, acquired_at > start ? "，等待结束" : "");
    dry_run();
}
#endif   /* !TARGET_OS_IPHONE */
```

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/host/gamepad_layout.h`:

```h
/* Face buttons of a controller as the Switch's A / B / X / Y (issue #10).
   GameController names the face buttons by the Xbox layout: buttonA at the bottom, buttonB on the right, buttonX on the
   left, buttonY at the top (PlayStation: Cross, Circle, Square, Triangle). A Switch controller has A on the right, B at
   the bottom, X at the top and Y on the left. PlayStation, Xbox and other controllers are mapped by position, so each
   button sits where the game's Switch prompt shows it; Nintendo controllers keep GameController's own mapping.
   TOTK_FACE_BUTTONS=label maps every controller by label (the earlier behaviour), =position every one by position.
   Plain C, shared by runtime/gamepad.m (Mac and iOS) and tests/gamepad_layout/probe.c. */
#pragma once
#include <ctype.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

enum { GAMEPAD_SWITCH_A = 1, GAMEPAD_SWITCH_B = 2, GAMEPAD_SWITCH_X = 4, GAMEPAD_SWITCH_Y = 8 };

static inline int gamepad_names_any(const char *text, const char *const *words, size_t count) {   /* case-insensitive */
    if (!text) return 0;
    char lower[128]; size_t n = 0;
    for (; text[n] && n < sizeof lower - 1; n++) lower[n] = (char)tolower((unsigned char)text[n]);
    lower[n] = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < count; i++) if (strstr(lower, words[i])) return 1;
    return 0;
}

static inline int gamepad_names_nintendo(const char *text) {   /* "Nintendo", "Switch", "Joy-Con" */
    static const char *const words[] = {"nintendo", "switch", "joy-con", "joycon"};
    return gamepad_names_any(text, words, sizeof words / sizeof *words);
}

static inline int gamepad_names_playstation(const char *text) {   /* "DualSense", "DualShock", "PlayStation" */
    static const char *const words[] = {"dualsense", "dualshock", "playstation"};
    return gamepad_names_any(text, words, sizeof words / sizeof *words);
}

/* 1: map this controller's face buttons by position. category / vendor: GCController productCategory / vendorName. */
static inline int gamepad_face_by_position(const char *category, const char *vendor) {
    const char *e = getenv("TOTK_FACE_BUTTONS");
    if (e && !strcmp(e, "label")) return 0;
    if (e && !strcmp(e, "position")) return 1;
    return !gamepad_names_nintendo(category) && !gamepad_names_nintendo(vendor);
}

/* Controller type, key 6 on the Mac (runtime/input.c -> runtime/gamepad.m): auto, as gamepad_face_by_position decides
   from the name; Xbox and PlayStation map the face buttons by position; Switch maps them by label, GameController's
   buttonA being Switch A (on a Nintendo controller the right button, on an Xbox controller the bottom one, Xbox A). Xbox
   and PlayStation map the same way; they differ in name only, for the player to say which controller it is. The pick
   applies to every GameController controller and is saved as one word (gamepad_type_name); the generic HID pads of
   runtime/gamepad.m are Switch-style and always read by position. */
enum { GAMEPAD_TYPE_AUTO, GAMEPAD_TYPE_XBOX, GAMEPAD_TYPE_PLAYSTATION, GAMEPAD_TYPE_SWITCH, GAMEPAD_TYPE_COUNT };

static inline const char *gamepad_type_name(int type) {
    static const char *const names[GAMEPAD_TYPE_COUNT] = {"auto", "xbox", "playstation", "switch"};
    return type >= 0 && type < GAMEPAD_TYPE_COUNT ? names[type] : "auto";
}

/* The type a saved word names (surrounding white space ignored), or -1. */
static inline int gamepad_type_parse(const char *text) {
    if (!text) return -1;
    while (isspace((unsigned char)*text)) text++;
    size_t n = strlen(text);
    while (n && isspace((unsigned char)text[n - 1])) n--;
    for (int t = 0; t < GAMEPAD_TYPE_COUNT; t++) {
        const char *name = gamepad_type_name(t);
        if (n && strlen(name) == n && !strncmp(text, name, n)) return t;
    }
    return -1;
}

static inline int gamepad_type_next(int type) {   /* auto -> Xbox -> PlayStation -> Switch -> auto */
    return type >= 0 && type < GAMEPAD_TYPE_COUNT - 1 ? type + 1 : GAMEPAD_TYPE_AUTO;
}

/* What auto takes a controller for (shown on the HUD): Nintendo names Switch, PlayStation names PlayStation, any other
   controller Xbox, as GameController names its buttons. */
static inline int gamepad_type_detect(const char *category, const char *vendor) {
    if (gamepad_names_nintendo(category) || gamepad_names_nintendo(vendor)) return GAMEPAD_TYPE_SWITCH;
    if (gamepad_names_playstation(category) || gamepad_names_playstation(vendor)) return GAMEPAD_TYPE_PLAYSTATION;
    return GAMEPAD_TYPE_XBOX;
}

/* 1: map the face buttons by position under the picked type; auto keeps gamepad_face_by_position (and TOTK_FACE_BUTTONS). */
static inline int gamepad_type_face_by_position(int type, const char *category, const char *vendor) {
    if (type == GAMEPAD_TYPE_XBOX || type == GAMEPAD_TYPE_PLAYSTATION) return 1;
    if (type == GAMEPAD_TYPE_SWITCH) return 0;
    return gamepad_face_by_position(category, vendor);
}

/* The physical positions of GameController's buttonA, buttonB, buttonX, buttonY (bits 0 south, 1 east, 2 west, 3 north:
   runtime/controller_map.h). By position they sit as on an Xbox controller (A bottom, B right, X left, Y top); by label
   they name a Nintendo layout (A right, B bottom, X top, Y left). controller_map.h's default layout turns positions into
   the Switch's (A right, B bottom, X top, Y left), which gives gamepad_face_bits. */
static inline uint64_t gamepad_face_positions(int a, int b, int x, int y, int by_position) {
    enum { SOUTH = 1, EAST = 2, WEST = 4, NORTH = 8 };
    if (by_position) return (a ? SOUTH : 0) | (b ? EAST : 0) | (x ? WEST : 0) | (y ? NORTH : 0);
    return (a ? EAST : 0) | (b ? SOUTH : 0) | (x ? NORTH : 0) | (y ? WEST : 0);
}

/* The Switch button bits for GameController's buttonA (bottom), buttonB (right), buttonX (left), buttonY (top). */
static inline uint64_t gamepad_face_bits(int bottom, int right, int left, int top, int by_position) {
    if (by_position)
        return (right ? GAMEPAD_SWITCH_A : 0) | (bottom ? GAMEPAD_SWITCH_B : 0) | (top ? GAMEPAD_SWITCH_X : 0) | (left ? GAMEPAD_SWITCH_Y : 0);
    return (bottom ? GAMEPAD_SWITCH_A : 0) | (right ? GAMEPAD_SWITCH_B : 0) | (left ? GAMEPAD_SWITCH_X : 0) | (top ? GAMEPAD_SWITCH_Y : 0);
}
```

```c
void runtime_watch_tick(uint64_t frame){
 if(!watch_init){watch_init=1;const char *e=getenv("TOTK_WATCH_ADDR");if(e){uintptr_t a=(uintptr_t)strtoull(e,NULL,16);const char *l=getenv("TOTK_WATCH_LEN");runtime_watch_set(a,l?(size_t)strtoull(l,NULL,0):256);}const char *f=getenv("TOTK_WATCH_FRAME");if(f)watch_from=atol(f);watch_read=getenv("TOTK_WATCH_READ")!=NULL;}
 if(watch_lo&&(long)frame>=watch_from){ unsigned char cur[32];memcpy(cur,(const void *)watch_addr,32);
  if(!watch_snap_valid||memcmp(cur,watch_snap,32)){char b[256];size_t n=0;watch_hex(b,&n,"[watch] content at present frame=",frame);for(int i=0;i<32;i+=4){uint32_t w;memcpy(&w,cur+i,4);b[n++]=' ';for(int k=7;k>=0;k--)b[n++]="0123456789abcdef"[(w>>(k*4))&15];}b[n++]=10;write(2,b,n);memcpy(watch_snap,cur,32);watch_snap_valid=1;} }
 if(!watch_lo||(long)frame<watch_from||watch_hits>=200)return;
 { static int started;if(!started){started=1;pthread_t t;pthread_create(&t,NULL,watch_rearm_thread,NULL);} atomic_store(&watch_armed,1); }
 if(mprotect((void *)watch_lo,watch_hi-watch_lo,watch_read?PROT_NONE:PROT_READ)!=0){char b[96];size_t n=0;watch_hex(b,&n,"[watch] mprotect failed page=",watch_lo);b[n++]=10;write(2,b,n);}
}
static int watch_fault(void *addr,int is_write,void *context){
 uintptr_t a=(uintptr_t)addr;if(!watch_lo||a<watch_lo||a>=watch_hi)return 0;
 if(a<watch_addr||a>=watch_end){mprotect((void *)watch_lo,watch_hi-watch_lo,PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE);return 1;}   /* other data in the pages: silently unprotect (re-armed at the next present) */
 ucontext_t *u=context;char b[1024];size_t n=0;
 { extern uint64_t g_frame_pub; extern _Atomic int dm_submit_busy; uint64_t th=0; pthread_threadid_np(NULL,&th);
   watch_hex(b,&n,"[watch] F",g_frame_pub);watch_hex(b,&n," t_us=",clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW)/1000);watch_hex(b,&n," th=",th);watch_hex(b,&n," submit_busy=",(uint64_t)atomic_load(&dm_submit_busy)); }
 watch_hex(b,&n,is_write?" write hit addr=":" read hit addr=",a);watch_hex(b,&n," off=",a-watch_addr);
#ifdef __MUSL__   /* OHOS: musl aarch64 mcontext 为值类型，regs[31]/sp/pc */
 watch_sym(b,&n," pc=",u->uc_mcontext.pc);watch_sym(b,&n," lr=",u->uc_mcontext.regs[30]);
 uint64_t fp=u->uc_mcontext.regs[29];
#else             /* macOS: Apple arm64 mcontext 指针风格 __ss */
 watch_sym(b,&n," pc=",u->uc_mcontext->__ss.__pc);watch_sym(b,&n," lr=",u->uc_mcontext->__ss.__lr);
 uint64_t fp=u->uc_mcontext->__ss.__fp;
#endif
for(int d=0;d<8&&fp&&!(fp&15);d++){uint64_t fr[2];mach_vm_size_t got=0;if(mach_vm_read_overwrite(mach_task_self(),fp,16,(uintptr_t)fr,&got)!=KERN_SUCCESS||got!=16)break;watch_sym(b,&n," <",fr[1]);fp=fr[0];}
 b[n++]='\n';write(2,b,n);watch_hits++;
 mprotect((void *)watch_lo,watch_hi-watch_lo,PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE);return 1;
}

/* nvnBootstrapLoader 拦截（游戏唯一 nvn 导入；gfx_probe.c:91 探针同机制）：SDK 内部 nvn/nvdrv
   路径彻底不跑（nv::InitializeGraphics 断言即由它触发）。按名查宿主小实现表；表外一律给包装后的
   返-0 桩（记名）。round8/round9 教训：游戏把 bootstrap / GetProcAddress 的返回值直接 blr 且
   461 槽填完无空检查——回 NULL 即 pc=0，GetProcAddress 表外也必须给可调桩（返 0 桩可被调用，
   只是结果为 0）。后续轮次按日志逐个补关键项。
   真实渲染后端仍是 Vulkan（nvn_vk_stub.cpp 占位），boot 推进与渲染接线是两件事。 */
static uint64_t g_nvn_stub_area[64] __attribute__((used));   /* 后续小实现的共享暂存区 */
/* round19-B：返-0 桩按调用者一次性探针。包装层（hle_stack.c 按函数指针去重）把所有 stub 折叠成同一
   thunk、名字不可区分；改在桩内取调用点：包装栈路径（hle_stack.S runtime_hle_switch 的 blr）下
   __builtin_return_address(0) 是 thunk 内地址，沿帧记录上走一级即客体调用点（runtime_hle_switch 的
   stp x29,x30 存的是客体 fp/lr）；嵌套 br 尾跳路径 LR 已是客体地址，上走一级得其调用者（仍定位区域）。
   16 项去重首见打一行，一轮日志即知纹理路径还踩了哪些返-0 桩。 */
static uintptr_t stub_caller_lr(void){
 /* round21-D：round20 分槽桩比 round19 多一层桩函数帧，固定上走一级落在宿主 thunk（hle_stack.S blr
    后地址，round20.log 实测 0x5ed7084xxx）。改为沿帧链（至多 6 级）取首个能被 runtime_module_offset
    解析成客体模块的返回地址；嵌套 br 尾跳路径（LR 已是客体地址）同样命中；全不解析则退回首见候选。 */
 uintptr_t fp=(uintptr_t)__builtin_frame_address(0),lr=0;
 for(int d=0;d<6&&fp&&!(fp&15);d++){
  uintptr_t up=*(uintptr_t *)fp;if(!up||(up&15))break;
  uintptr_t cand=*(uintptr_t *)(up+8);const char *nm;uint64_t off;
  if(cand&&!lr)lr=cand;
  if(cand&&runtime_module_offset(cand,&nm,&off))return cand;
  fp=up;
 }
 return lr;
}
static uint64_t nvn_unimplemented(void){
 static uintptr_t stub_seen[16];static unsigned stub_n;
 uintptr_t lr=stub_caller_lr();
 for(unsigned i=0;i<stub_n;i++)if(stub_seen[i]==lr)return 0;
 if(stub_n<16)stub_seen[stub_n++]=lr;
 {const char *nm;uint64_t off;char loc[96];
  if(runtime_module_offset(lr,&nm,&off))snprintf(loc,sizeof loc,"%s+%#llx",nm,(unsigned long long)off);
  else snprintf(loc,sizeof loc,"%p",(void *)lr);
  fprintf(stderr,"[nvn] stub-call lr=%p (%s)\n",(void *)lr,loc);}
 return 0;
}
/* round20-A：按名分槽桩——包装层按函数指针去重，共用一个 nvn_unimplemented 时 384 个表外名（round19.log
   去重实测）全折叠进同一 thunk、名字丢失。登记时给每个名字一个互不相同的 X-macro 桩（500 槽 ≥ 384），
   桩内首调打 [nvn] stub#i name=… lr=…（模块+偏移），下轮日志直接给 0x9a3da8/0x9a5d60 链上每桩名字。
   溢出/无名路径退回上面的 nvn_unimplemented（LR 探针仍在）。同名→同槽→同 thunk，指针比较语义不变。 */
#define NVN_MAX_STUBS 500
static char *nvn_stub_names[NVN_MAX_STUBS];static unsigned n_nvn_stubs;
static void nvn_stub_log(unsigned i){
 static unsigned char logged[NVN_MAX_STUBS];
 uintptr_t lr=stub_caller_lr();   /* round21-D：沿帧链找客体调用点（round20 固定一级落在宿主 thunk） */
 if(logged[i])return;logged[i]=1;
 {const char *nm;uint64_t off;char loc[96];
  if(runtime_module_offset(lr,&nm,&off))snprintf(loc,sizeof loc,"%s+%#llx",nm,(unsigned long long)off);
  else snprintf(loc,sizeof loc,"%p",(void *)lr);
  fprintf(stderr,"[nvn] stub#%u name=%s lr=%p (%s)\n",i,nvn_stub_names[i]?nvn_stub_names[i]:"?",(void *)lr,loc);}
}
/* 终局 B 计划（crash_1031 终局四段）：表外桩按名调用计数——hang dump 时输出高频桩名单，
   ">100 次的桩"即下一嫌疑（48k map pool 的伴生高频桩）。counts 只增不减，无锁竞态可接受。 */
static uint32_t nvn_stub_counts[NVN_MAX_STUBS];
static uint64_t nvn_stub_hit(unsigned i){nvn_stub_log(i);if(i<NVN_MAX_STUBS)nvn_stub_counts[i]++;return 0;}
void runtime_nvn_stub_report(void){
 unsigned n=0;for(unsigned i=0;i<NVN_MAX_STUBS&&n<NVN_MAX_STUBS;i++)if(nvn_stub_counts[i])n++;
 fprintf(stderr,"[totk-dump] nvn stub calls, %u distinct:\n",n);
 for(;;){unsigned best=NVN_MAX_STUBS;uint32_t bv=0;
  for(unsigned i=0;i<NVN_MAX_STUBS;i++)if(nvn_stub_counts[i]>bv){bv=nvn_stub_counts[i];best=i;}
  if(best==NVN_MAX_STUBS||!bv)break;
  fprintf(stderr,"[totk-dump] stub %5u x%-8u %s\n",best,bv,nvn_stub_names[best]?nvn_stub_names[best]:"?");
  nvn_stub_counts[best]=0;}   /* 打完清零：下次 dump 只报增量 */
}
/* round20-A 修编译：数字各位分参传递（h,t,u），只在标识符处 ## 粘接，数值用 h*100+t*10+u 算——
   旧版 P2(0) 粘出 008/009/018…089 等前导零八进制字面量，遇 8/9 直接 invalid digit 编译失败。 */
#define P1(h,t) X(h,t,0)X(h,t,1)X(h,t,2)X(h,t,3)X(h,t,4)X(h,t,5)X(h,t,6)X(h,t,7)X(h,t,8)X(h,t,9)

}

/* MemoryPool 层（round10 悬崖：main+0x9a3f60 把 Map 返回值当 CPU 基址写；donor hle_nvn.c:226-268，
   布局=nvn_obj.h:23/25 前半，本地定义免头纠缠。存储由游戏经 SetStorage 自备，宿主不分配） */
typedef struct{void *dev,*mem;uint64_t size;uint32_t flags;} pool_builder_h;   /* 0x20，=pool_builder_t */

/* crash_1031 毒化源判定：nvn 池账本（容量 256，溢出覆盖最旧）。Initialize 时记 {mem,size,flags}
   （host-alloc 分支之后写入，游戏自备/宿主分配两类存储都覆盖；VIRTUAL 池 ctor 时 mem=NULL、
   map-virtual 后才有效，NULL 槽位永不匹配）。读侧（crash handler）只读+算术、无锁，
   async-signal-safe。 */
#define NVN_POOL_LEDGER 256
typedef struct{uintptr_t mem;uint64_t size;unsigned flags;} NvnPoolRec;
static NvnPoolRec nvn_pool_ledger[NVN_POOL_LEDGER];static unsigned nvn_pool_ledger_head;
int runtime_nvn_pool_hit(uint64_t addr,uint64_t *lo,uint64_t *hi,unsigned *flags_out){
 for(unsigned i=0;i<NVN_POOL_LEDGER;i++){const NvnPoolRec *r=&nvn_pool_ledger[i];
  if(r->mem&&addr>=r->mem-0x4000&&addr<r->mem+r->size+0x4000){if(lo)*lo=r->mem;if(hi)*hi=r->mem+r->size;if(flags_out)*flags_out=r->flags;return 1;}}

}
static void nvn_pool_builder_set_defaults(void *b){memset(b,0,sizeof(pool_builder_h));}   /* =memset 0x20 */

static void nvn_pool_builder_set_storage(void *b,void *m,uint64_t n){((pool_builder_h *)b)->mem=m;((pool_builder_h *)b)->size=n;if(!n)fprintf(stderr,"[nvn] pool builder SetStorage size=0 (mem=%p)：查询桩喂 0 或游戏真要 0，计数变化指示 0 尺寸源\n",m);}   /* round16 插桩：区分"游戏真要 0"与"查询桩喂 0" */
static void nvn_pool_builder_set_flags(void *b,int f){((pool_builder_h *)b)->flags=(uint32_t)f;}
static uint64_t nvn_pool_initialize(void *p,const void *b){
 pool_h *o=p;const pool_builder_h *s=b;memset(o,0,0x20);o->magic=0x504f4f4c;o->flags=s->flags;o->mem=s->mem;o->size=s->size;   /* 'POOL'；清 0x20（含 donor 的 game_mem 槽位）在游戏 0x38 分配内安全 */
 if(!o->mem&&o->size){   /* 驱动自备存储：游戏对 VIRTUAL 池 SetStorage(NULL)（round13 实测 flags=0x2a1=VIRTUAL|COMPRESSIBLE|GPU_CACHED|CPU_NO_ACCESS），真机由驱动分配，donor 同位走 totk_vpool_init（hle_nvn.c:241）；boot 期宿主匿名页即可，后续 Vulkan 后端接线再换真 GPU 存储 */
  size_t n=(o->size+0xfff)&~0xfffULL;o->mem=mmap(NULL,n,PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE,MAP_ANON|MAP_PRIVATE,-1,0);
  if(o->mem==MAP_FAILED)o->mem=NULL;
  fprintf(stderr,"[nvn] pool %p host-alloc %#llx -> %p\n",p,(unsigned long long)n,o->mem);
 }
 fprintf(stderr,"[nvn] pool %p mem=%p size=%#llx flags=%#x\n",p,o->mem,(unsigned long long)o->size,o->flags);   /* 自带诊断：mem=0 即 ctor 没走 SetStorage 且宿主分配失败 */
```
