```c
}
static void *nvn_pool_map(const void *p){const pool_h *o=p;fprintf(stderr,"[nvn] map pool=%p magic=%#x mem=%p size=%#llx\n",p,o->magic,o->mem,(unsigned long long)o->size);return o->mem;}   /* round14 插桩：magic≠0x504f4f4c 即 foreign 对象（从未过宿主 Initialize）；行为不变仍无条件返 mem——有意不学 donor hle_nvn.c:262-264 对 CPU_NO_ACCESS 返 NULL：round13 双证游戏拿 Map 结果当写基址（main+0x9a3f38/0x9a3f60），宿主无 vpool 层返 NULL 必崩 */
typedef struct{const void *physical_pool;int64_t physical_offset,virtual_offset;uint64_t size;int32_t storage_class;uint32_t padding;} nvn_map_req_h;   /* =totk_vpool.h:7-15 NVNmappingRequest，0x28 实测布局 */
static uint64_t nvn_pool_map_virtual(void *p,int n,const void *req){

/* round11：线程栈地址空间分配器宿主替换。sdk ThreadManager::CreateThread（sdk+0x329af0）循环调
   AddressSpaceAllocator::AllocateSpace(size=[info+0x58],align=0x1000)，cbz x0 → guest Break（本轮停点）。
   loader.c:229-236 kind 1026 重定位按名查本表换宿主实现；读 this+8/+0x10/+0x18（start/end/guard，单位页），
   首次适应自建静态区间表选址（分配含两侧 guard 一并记账；装不下 size_p+2*guard 返 0，同 SDK 失败情形①）。
   round12 实测定单位：region/guard=页，入参 size/align=字节（16KB 线程栈 / 0x1000 对齐；round11 版混用
   页字节导致每次预留 ~64MB 三次烧光 256MB 区、且返回页号被当字节地址）——入参先 (x+0xfff)>>12 归一到页
   再算，返回值照 SDK（sdk+0x32c194-1a0 lsl #12）换算回字节地址，日志两单位都打防再犯。
   副作用：SDK 自身区间树不再有表项、其 free 路径变空操作——boot 期可接受，后续再回收。
   （GetStackGuardEndAddress 不加透传版：override 换的是 GOT 槽、拿不到 SDK 原函数指针，瞎返值会污染
   分配器边界；其唯一目的"验证栈区上界"由 region=[start,end) 日志直接给出。round12 实测 end=0x6f01fbf 页
   超宿主真实栈上界 0x6f01c3b000 约 3.5MB：仅顶部分配会被 services.c:134 拒，自底首次适应碰不到，暂不钳。） */
typedef struct{uint64_t lo,hi;} as_range_h;
static as_range_h as_used_h[4096];static unsigned as_used_h_n;
static uint64_t os_as_allocate_space(void *self,uint64_t size,uint64_t align){
 uint64_t start=*(const uint64_t *)((const char *)self+8),end=*(const uint64_t *)((const char *)self+0x10),guard=*(const uint64_t *)((const char *)self+0x18),cand=start+guard,ret=0;
 uint64_t size_p=(size+0xfff)>>12,align_p=(align+0xfff)>>12;   /* 入参字节→页（round12 实测），region/guard 本就是页 */
 if(!align_p)align_p=1;
 if(size_p+2*guard<=end-start)   /* 同 SDK：边界装不下 size_p+2*guard（页）直接失败（guard=4 页） */
  for(unsigned step=0;step<=as_used_h_n+1;step++){
   cand=(cand+align_p-1)/align_p*align_p;
   if(cand+size_p+guard>end)break;
   const as_range_h *hit=0;
   for(unsigned i=0;i<as_used_h_n;i++)if(!(as_used_h[i].hi<=cand||as_used_h[i].lo>=cand+size_p)){hit=&as_used_h[i];break;}
   if(!hit){if(as_used_h_n>=4096)break;as_used_h[as_used_h_n++]=(as_range_h){cand-guard,cand+size_p+guard};ret=cand<<12;break;}   /* 预留含两侧 guard；返回字节地址（SDK lsl#12 原样） */
   cand=hit->hi;
  }
 fprintf(stderr,"[os] AllocateSpace region=[%llx,%llx) guard=%#llx size=%#llx align=%#llx -> %llx used=%u | pages size_p=%llu align_p=%llu ret=%#llx\n",(unsigned long long)start,(unsigned long long)end,(unsigned long long)guard,(unsigned long long)size,(unsigned long long)align,(unsigned long long)ret,as_used_h_n,(unsigned long long)size_p,(unsigned long long)align_p,(unsigned long long)ret);
 return ret;
}
__attribute__((used,section("__DATA,totkgfx"))) static const GfxEntry as_alloc_entry={"_ZN2nn2os6detail21AddressSpaceAllocator13AllocateSpaceEmm",os_as_allocate_space,"thread-stack address space allocator (round11 probe)"};
```

```c
static void probe_texture_plan(void) {
 nvn_refl rf = {0};
 struct { uint64_t before; uint16_t slots[NVN_REFL_MAXB]; uint64_t after; } output;
 memset(&output, 0xa5, sizeof output);
 if(nvn_texture_plan(&rf,output.slots))runtime_fail("texture plan empty shader");
 rf.nb=8;
 rf.b[0]=(nvn_rbind){.kind=NVN_RB_TEX,.reg=127};
 rf.b[1]=(nvn_rbind){.kind=NVN_RB_CBUF,.reg=0};
 rf.b[2]=(nvn_rbind){.kind=NVN_RB_TBUF,.reg=9};
 rf.b[3]=(nvn_rbind){.kind=NVN_RB_IMG,.reg=31};
 rf.b[4]=(nvn_rbind){.kind=NVN_RB_TEX,.reg=128};
 rf.b[5]=(nvn_rbind){.kind=NVN_RB_IMG,.reg=32};
 rf.b[6]=(nvn_rbind){.kind=NVN_RB_TEX,.reg=127};
 rf.b[7]=(nvn_rbind){.kind=NVN_RB_IMG,.reg=0};

 unsigned count=nvn_texture_plan(&rf,output.slots);
 if(getenv("TOTK_PROBE_NEGATIVE") && atoi(getenv("TOTK_PROBE_NEGATIVE"))==12)output.slots[2]=31;

 if(output.before!=0xa5a5a5a5a5a5a5a5ull || output.after!=0xa5a5a5a5a5a5a5a5ull)runtime_fail("texture plan output canary");

static void probe_linear_layout(void) {

/* Expected footprints/tile modes obtained by executing v0 SDK 0x4429c8 /
   0x442de4 in Unicorn (analysis/terrain-layout-oracle.json). This is an
   independent oracle, including the equal-size case that must keep H=4. */
static void probe_minimal_layout(void) {
 struct layout_case { unsigned w,h,z,target,levels; uint64_t normal,minimal; unsigned th,td; } cases[] = {
  {320,320,1,1,1,245760,204800,4,0}, {256,256,1,1,1,131072,131072,4,0},
  {260,260,1,1,1,221184,152064,4,0}, {260,260,1,1,9,332800,214528,4,0},
  {320,320,4,4,1,245760,204800,4,0}, {320,320,5,2,1,1638400,1024000,0,2},
  {37,69,1,1,1,16384,9216,3,0}, {37,69,1,1,7,24576,15360,3,0}
 };
 /* Reproduce terrain corruption: a 320x320 RGB565 texture followed immediately
    by packed geometry. A wrong H=4 writes into every other 4 KiB of the latter. */
 const size_t bytes=320u*320u*2u, capacity=245760+4096;
 unsigned char *src=malloc(bytes),*pool=malloc(capacity),*readback=malloc(bytes);
 if(!src||!pool||!readback)runtime_fail("minimal layout allocation");
 for(size_t i=0;i<bytes;i++)src[i]=(unsigned char)(i*29+i/13+17);
 memset(pool,0xcd,capacity);
 nvn_texdesc d={.width=320,.height=320,.depth=1,.levels=1,.target=1,.format=0x3c,.flags=0x200};
 if(nvn_swizzle(&d,0,0,src,640,pool))runtime_fail("minimal texture upload");
 for(size_t i=bytes;i<capacity;i++)if(pool[i]!=0xcd)runtime_fail("minimal texture overwrote adjacent geometry");
 for(unsigned y=0;y<320;y++)for(unsigned x=0;x<640;x++) {
  size_t address=(y/8)*10*512+(x/64)*512+(x%64/32)*256+(y%8/2)*64+(x%32/16)*32+(y%2)*16+x%16;
  if(pool[address]!=src[y*640+x])runtime_fail("minimal one-GOB address differs from reference");
```

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/host/hid_feedback.c`:

```c
/* Controller rumble and motion on the game's side (2026-10-17): the hid functions TOTK uses for HD rumble and for the
   six-axis sensor (motion aiming).
   Chosen at start, because the game asks for its vibration and six-axis handles only when a controller's style is set
   up (main+0x29b45cc, from the per-frame controller update main+0x29b442c), so they cannot appear later:
     TOTK_RUMBLE    the controller has its two vibration devices (left, right); what the game plays goes to the Mac
                    controller's haptics (runtime/gamepad_feedback.m);
     TOTK_GYRO      the controller has its six-axis sensor; the game gets the Mac controller's motion.
   Both are on by default (env_on below); =0 turns one off, and the game then does not get that device, exactly as before
   (no handles for it, its code below is not called).
   While the game runs, "flag rumble 0|1" / "flag gyro 0|1" mute and unmute them (muted motion = a controller lying still).
   The handles are the SDK's own: nn::hid::utility computes them without the hid service (byte 0 = style index, 3 full-key,
   4 handheld; byte 1 = controller id; byte 2 = device index: vibration 0 left / 1 right, six-axis 2). Everything under
   them (nn::hid::detail, which the SDK calls through its PLT, including the batches VibrationTarget sends through
   detail::EnqueueVibrationValue -> detail::SendVibrationValues) is answered here instead of by the hid service.
   Layouts: VibrationValue {amplitude low, frequency low, amplitude high, frequency high} (0..1 and Hz; neutral 0/160/0/320,
   sdk+0x4a2df8); VibrationDeviceInfo {type, position} (8 bytes, sdk+0x49da78); SixAxisSensorState 0x60 bytes. */
#include "runtime.h"
#include <math.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

typedef struct { float amp_low, freq_low, amp_high, freq_high; } VibrationValue;
typedef struct { uint32_t type, position; } VibrationDeviceInfo;       /* type 1 = linear resonant actuator; position 1 left, 2 right */
typedef struct { int64_t delta_ns, sampling; float acc[3], gyro[3], angle[3], dir[9]; uint32_t attributes, reserved; } SixAxisState;
_Static_assert(sizeof(VibrationValue) == 16 && sizeof(VibrationDeviceInfo) == 8 && sizeof(SixAxisState) == 0x60, "hid ABI");
enum { STYLE_FULL_KEY = 3, STYLE_HANDHELD = 4, SIX_AXIS_CONNECTED = 1 };

/* On unless =0 (2026-10-17: default on, the user's request). An agent's test session (TOTK_SLOT_OWNER claude / codex) leaves
   them off unless set, so a test does not rumble the user's controller and tests stay as measured before. */
static bool env_on(const char *name) {
    const char *e = getenv(name); if (e) return strcmp(e, "0") != 0;
    const char *o = getenv("TOTK_SLOT_OWNER");
    return !(o && (!strcmp(o, "claude") || !strcmp(o, "codex")));
}
int runtime_rumble_enabled(void) { return env_on("TOTK_RUMBLE"); }
int runtime_gyro_enabled(void) { return env_on("TOTK_GYRO"); }
static _Atomic int rumble_muted, gyro_muted;
static pthread_mutex_t lastLock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static VibrationValue last[2] = {{0, 160, 0, 320}, {0, 160, 0, 320}};   /* lastLock */
static _Atomic uint64_t values_in, reads;

static void note_once(_Atomic int *flag, const char *text, uint32_t handle) {
    if (!atomic_exchange(flag, 1)) fprintf(stderr, "[hid] %s (handle %#x)\n", text, handle);
}
/* The device a handle names, or -1 (a style this runtime never reports, logged once). */
static int vibration_side(const uint32_t *h) {
    if (!h) runtime_fail("vibration device handle pointer");
    unsigned style = *h & 0xff, index = (*h >> 16) & 0xff;
    if ((style == STYLE_FULL_KEY || style == STYLE_HANDHELD) && index < 2) return (int)index;
    static _Atomic int warned; note_once(&warned, "vibration call with a handle this controller does not have; ignored", *h);
    return -1;
}
static void play(int side, const VibrationValue *v) {
    if (!v) runtime_fail("vibration value pointer");
    if (side < 0) return;
    VibrationValue c = *v;
    if (!isfinite(c.amp_low) || !isfinite(c.amp_high) || !isfinite(c.freq_low) || !isfinite(c.freq_high)) c = (VibrationValue){0, 160, 0, 320};
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lastLock); last[side] = c; pthread_mutex_unlock(&lastLock); atomic_fetch_add(&values_in, 1);
    static _Atomic int first; if (!atomic_exchange(&first, 1)) fprintf(stderr, "[hid] first vibration value from the game: %s %.2f@%.0f Hz %.2f@%.0f Hz\n",
                                                                         side ? "right" : "left", c.amp_low, c.freq_low, c.amp_high, c.freq_high);
    if (atomic_load(&rumble_muted)) c.amp_low = c.amp_high = 0;
    runtime_rumble_set((unsigned)side, c.amp_low, c.freq_low, c.amp_high, c.freq_high);
}
static uint32_t vib_init(const uint32_t *h) {
    int side = vibration_side(h); static _Atomic int once;
    if (side >= 0) note_once(&once, "the game initialized its vibration devices", *h);
    return 0;
}
static uint32_t vib_send(const uint32_t *h, const VibrationValue *v) { play(vibration_side(h), v); return 0; }
static uint32_t vib_send_many(const uint32_t *h, const VibrationValue *v, int n) {
    if (n < 0 || (n && (!h || !v))) runtime_fail("vibration batch");
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) play(vibration_side(&h[i]), &v[i]);
    return 0;
}
static uint32_t vib_actual(VibrationValue *out, const uint32_t *h) {
    if (!out) runtime_fail("vibration value output pointer");
    int side = vibration_side(h); *out = (VibrationValue){0, 160, 0, 320};
    if (side >= 0) { pthread_mutex_lock(&lastLock); *out = last[side]; pthread_mutex_unlock(&lastLock); }
    return 0;
}
static uint32_t vib_info(VibrationDeviceInfo *out, const uint32_t *h) {
    if (!out) runtime_fail("vibration device info pointer");
    int side = vibration_side(h); *out = (VibrationDeviceInfo){side >= 0 ? 1u : 0u, side >= 0 ? (uint32_t)side + 1 : 0}; return 0;
}
static uint32_t vib_mounted(bool *out, const uint32_t *h) { if (!out) runtime_fail("vibration mounted pointer"); *out = vibration_side(h) >= 0; return 0; }
static uint32_t vib_permitted(bool *out) { if (!out) runtime_fail("vibration permitted pointer"); *out = true; return 0; }

static void six_axis_check(const uint32_t *h) {
    if (!h) runtime_fail("six-axis handle pointer");
    unsigned style = *h & 0xff;
    if (style != STYLE_FULL_KEY && style != STYLE_HANDHELD) { static _Atomic int warned; note_once(&warned, "six-axis call with a handle this controller does not have", *h); }
}
static uint32_t six_start(const uint32_t *h) {
    six_axis_check(h); static _Atomic int once; note_once(&once, "the game started the six-axis sensor", *h);
    runtime_motion_start(); return 0;
}
static uint32_t six_stop(const uint32_t *h) { six_axis_check(h); return 0; }
/* Newest first, like the hid service's ring. No motion (no controller with sensors, or muted): one state of a controller
   lying still, not marked connected. */
static uint32_t six_states(int *out, SixAxisState *s, int max, const uint32_t *h) {
    if (!out || (max > 0 && !s)) runtime_fail("six-axis state output");
    six_axis_check(h); atomic_fetch_add(&reads, 1);
    if (max <= 0) { *out = 0; return 0; }
    RuntimeMotionState m[RUNTIME_MOTION_MAX];
    int n = atomic_load(&gyro_muted) ? 0 : runtime_motion_read(m, max < RUNTIME_MOTION_MAX ? max : RUNTIME_MOTION_MAX);
    if (n <= 0) {
        s[0] = (SixAxisState){.acc = {0, 0, -1}, .dir = {1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1}};
        *out = 1; return 0;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        SixAxisState *d = &s[i]; *d = (SixAxisState){.delta_ns = (int64_t)m[i].delta_ns, .sampling = (int64_t)m[i].sampling, .attributes = SIX_AXIS_CONNECTED};
        memcpy(d->acc, m[i].acc, sizeof d->acc); memcpy(d->gyro, m[i].gyro, sizeof d->gyro);
        memcpy(d->angle, m[i].angle, sizeof d->angle); memcpy(d->dir, m[i].dir, sizeof d->dir);
    }
    *out = n; return 0;
}
static uint32_t six_state(SixAxisState *s, const uint32_t *h) { int n; return six_states(&n, s, 1, h); }
static int no_handles(void *out, int max, const uint32_t *id, uint32_t style) { (void)out; (void)max; (void)id; (void)style; return 0; }

/* "flag rumble 0|1", "flag gyro 0|1": 1 if the name was one of these. */
int runtime_hid_feedback_flag(const char *name, int v) {
    _Atomic int *muted = !strcmp(name, "rumble") ? &rumble_muted : !strcmp(name, "gyro") ? &gyro_muted : NULL;
    if (!muted) return 0;
    if (v != 0 && v != 1) runtime_fail("flag rumble / gyro takes 0 or 1");
    int on = muted == &rumble_muted ? runtime_rumble_enabled() : runtime_gyro_enabled();
    atomic_store(muted, !v);
    if (!v && muted == &rumble_muted) { runtime_rumble_set(0, 0, 160, 0, 320); runtime_rumble_set(1, 0, 160, 0, 320); }
    fprintf(stderr, "[hid] %s %s%s\n", name, v ? "on" : "muted", on ? "" : " (no effect: the game has no such device in this run; start it with TOTK_RUMBLE=1 / TOTK_GYRO=1)");
    return 1;
}
void runtime_hid_feedback_stats(uint64_t *values, uint64_t *motion_reads) { *values = atomic_load(&values_in); *motion_reads = atomic_load(&reads); }

void *runtime_hid_feedback_override(const char *name) {
    const bool rumble = runtime_rumble_enabled(), gyro = runtime_gyro_enabled();
    if (!strcmp(name, "_ZN2nn3hid25GetVibrationDeviceHandlesEPNS0_21VibrationDeviceHandleEiRKjNS_4util10BitFlagSetILi32ENS0_12NpadStyleTagEEE"))
        return rumble ? NULL : (void *)no_handles;   /* on: the SDK's own (nn::hid::utility) */
    if (!strcmp(name, "_ZN2nn3hid23GetSixAxisSensorHandlesEPNS0_19SixAxisSensorHandleEiRKjNS_4util10BitFlagSetILi32ENS0_12NpadStyleTagEEE"))
        return gyro ? NULL : (void *)no_handles;
    static const struct { const char *name; void *fn; bool gyro; } entries[] = {
        {"_ZN2nn3hid6detail25InitializeVibrationDeviceERKNS0_21VibrationDeviceHandleE", (void *)vib_init, false},
        {"_ZN2nn3hid6detail18SendVibrationValueERKNS0_21VibrationDeviceHandleERKNS0_14VibrationValueE", (void *)vib_send, false},
        {"_ZN2nn3hid6detail19SendVibrationValuesEPKNS0_21VibrationDeviceHandleEPKNS0_14VibrationValueEi", (void *)vib_send_many, false},
        {"_ZN2nn3hid6detail23GetActualVibrationValueEPNS0_14VibrationValueERKNS0_21VibrationDeviceHandleE", (void *)vib_actual, false},
        {"_ZN2nn3hid6detail22GetVibrationDeviceInfoEPNS0_19VibrationDeviceInfoERKNS0_21VibrationDeviceHandleE", (void *)vib_info, false},
        {"_ZN2nn3hid6detail24IsVibrationDeviceMountedEPbRKNS0_21VibrationDeviceHandleE", (void *)vib_mounted, false},
        {"_ZN2nn3hid6detail20IsVibrationPermittedEPb", (void *)vib_permitted, false},
        {"_ZN2nn3hid6detail18StartSixAxisSensorERKNS0_19SixAxisSensorHandleE", (void *)six_start, true},
        {"_ZN2nn3hid6detail17StopSixAxisSensorERKNS0_19SixAxisSensorHandleE", (void *)six_stop, true},
        {"_ZN2nn3hid6detail22GetSixAxisSensorStatesEPiPNS0_18SixAxisSensorStateEiRKNS0_19SixAxisSensorHandleE", (void *)six_states, true},
        {"_ZN2nn3hid6detail21GetSixAxisSensorStateEPNS0_18SixAxisSensorStateERKNS0_19SixAxisSensorHandleE", (void *)six_state, true}};
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof entries / sizeof *entries; i++)
        if (!strcmp(name, entries[i].name)) return (entries[i].gyro ? gyro : rumble) ? entries[i].fn : NULL;
    return NULL;
}
```

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/host/hle_stack.S`:

```S
/* Host-stack switch for host implementations called from guest code (OHOS/ELF port).
   来源：infra/MacNativeGames/games/by3/runtime/hle_stack.S，符号去 Mach-O 下划线、
   thunk 表 4096→65536（TOTK 全模块导入数超 4096，见 hle_stack.c 的 HLE_THUNKS）。
   Horizon services run on kernel/sysmodule stacks, but the host functions that replace them would otherwise run
   on the calling guest thread's stack, and TOTK creates threads with stacks as small as 4 KiB. Each guest thread
   has a host stack top in a TLS slot (offset runtime_hle_tsd_off from TPIDRRO_EL0); the slot is cleared
   while that stack is in use, so nested guest->host calls made from it stay on it. */
.text

/* x16 = host function, x17 = its wrapper index. Called at a guest call site: x0..x8 and v0..v7 carry arguments,
   x9..x17 are free. No host replacement takes stack-passed arguments (checked against all NVN prototypes and host
   overrides). While runtime_hle_trace is set every call is first counted by runtime_hle_note on the host stack,
   with the argument registers kept. */
    .globl runtime_hle_switch
    .hidden runtime_hle_switch      /* 防 ELF/OHOS 下 b 经本模块 PLT 间接跳：PLT 桩会洗掉 x16 契约寄存器 */
    .p2align 2
runtime_hle_switch:
    mov x9, x18
    adrp x10, :got:runtime_hle_tsd_off
    ldr x10, [x10, :got_lo12:runtime_hle_tsd_off]
    ldr x10, [x10]
    ldr x11, [x9, x10]
    cbz x11, 1f
    str xzr, [x9, x10]
mov x12, sp
    sub sp, x11, #48
    stp x29, x30, [sp]          // frame record links the host frames back to the guest caller
    stp x12, x11, [sp, #16]
    str x18, [sp, #32]          // guest x18 = synthetic TCB: host calls must not clobber it
    mov x29, sp
    adrp x13, :got:runtime_hle_trace
    ldr x13, [x13, :got_lo12:runtime_hle_trace]
    ldr w13, [x13]
    cbnz w13, 2f
3:  blr x16
    ldr x18, [sp, #32]
    ldp x12, x11, [sp, #16]
    ldp x29, x30, [sp]
    mov sp, x12
    mov x9, x18
    adrp x10, :got:runtime_hle_tsd_off
    ldr x10, [x10, :got_lo12:runtime_hle_tsd_off]
    ldr x10, [x10]
    str x11, [x9, x10]
    ret
1:  adrp x13, :got:runtime_hle_trace      // already on a host stack (nested call, or a host thread)
    ldr x13, [x13, :got_lo12:runtime_hle_trace]
    ldr w13, [x13]
    cbnz w13, 4f
    br x16
2:  bl hle_note_kept                        // x30 is in the frame record and is reloaded from it after the call
    b 3b
4:  stp x29, x30, [sp, #-16]!
    mov x29, sp
    bl hle_note_kept
    ldp x29, x30, [sp], #16
    br x16

/* runtime_hle_note(x17) with x0..x8, x16 and q0..q7 kept. */
    .p2align 2
hle_note_kept:
    stp x29, x30, [sp, #-224]!
    mov x29, sp
    stp x0, x1, [sp, #16]
    stp x2, x3, [sp, #32]
    stp x4, x5, [sp, #48]
    stp x6, x7, [sp, #64]
    stp x8, x16, [sp, #80]
    stp q0, q1, [sp, #96]
    stp q2, q3, [sp, #128]
    stp q4, q5, [sp, #160]
    stp q6, q7, [sp, #192]
    mov x0, x17
    bl runtime_hle_note
    ldp q6, q7, [sp, #192]
    ldp q4, q5, [sp, #160]
    ldp q2, q3, [sp, #128]
    ldp q0, q1, [sp, #96]
    ldp x8, x16, [sp, #80]
    ldp x6, x7, [sp, #64]
    ldp x4, x5, [sp, #48]
    ldp x2, x3, [sp, #32]
    ldp x0, x1, [sp, #16]
    ldp x29, x30, [sp], #224
    ret

/* x17 = wrapper index: x16 = runtime_hle_targets[x17], then the switch. */
    .p2align 2
hle_dispatch:
    adrp x16, :got:runtime_hle_targets
    ldr x16, [x16, :got_lo12:runtime_hle_targets]
    ldr x16, [x16, x17, lsl #3]
    b runtime_hle_switch

/* Fixed wrapper thunks (16 bytes each): thunk i enters the dispatch with x17 = i. */
    .globl runtime_hle_thunks
    .p2align 4
runtime_hle_thunks:
.set hle_i, 0
.rept 65536
    mov x17, #hle_i
    b hle_dispatch
    brk #0xb5
    brk #0xb5
.set hle_i, hle_i+1
.endr

```

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/host/hle_stack.c`:

```c
/* Host functions handed to guest code are wrapped so they run on the guest thread's host stack (hle_stack.S).
   Diagnostics (TOTK_INPUT_FILE "hletrace <0|1|2>"): while tracing, every wrapped call is counted per function; in mode 2
   the first call of each function since tracing began is also logged with the time and the calling guest thread (so a
   window that starts on an idle screen shows, in order, what the game starts calling after an input); "hletrace 0"
   prints the functions called since tracing began, most called first. 2026-10-17 this is how a hang with every thread idle is narrowed to the last
   host call the game made (the game over "retry" that never reloads). */
#include "runtime.h"
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#define HLE_THUNKS 65536
#define HLE_THUNK_BYTES 16
extern char runtime_hle_thunks[];
void *runtime_hle_targets[HLE_THUNKS];
uint64_t runtime_hle_tsd_off;
int runtime_hle_trace;                                   /* read by hle_stack.S on every wrapped call */
static const char *names[HLE_THUNKS];
static _Atomic uint64_t counts[HLE_THUNKS];
static uint64_t since[HLE_THUNKS];
static _Atomic unsigned char seen[HLE_THUNKS];
static uint64_t trace_t0;
static unsigned used;
static pthread_mutex_t lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;

void runtime_hle_stack_init(uint64_t tsd_offset) { runtime_hle_tsd_off = tsd_offset; }

/* 2026-10-30 the table was filled during relocation on device; before failing, dump who filled it.  Dedup is by fn, so
   the usual suspect is one name asked in again and again, each time with a different host fn: list the most repeated
   names, then the first slot where a name already had a different fn. */
typedef struct { unsigned count, first, last; } dump_dup_t;
static unsigned dump_order[HLE_THUNKS];
static dump_dup_t dump_dups[HLE_THUNKS];
static int dump_by_name(const void *a, const void *b) {
    unsigned x = *(const unsigned *)a, y = *(const unsigned *)b;
    const char *nx = names[x], *ny = names[y];
    if (!nx || !ny) return nx == ny ? (int)x - (int)y : nx ? -1 : 1;      /* unnamed slots sort last */
    int c = strcmp(nx, ny);
    return c ? c : (int)x - (int)y;                                       /* equal names in registration order */
}
static int dump_by_count(const void *a, const void *b) {
    const dump_dup_t *x = a, *y = b;
    return x->count < y->count ? 1 : x->count > y->count ? -1 : (int)x->first - (int)y->first;
}
static void dump_wrappers(void) {
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < used; i++) dump_order[i] = i;
    qsort(dump_order, used, sizeof *dump_order, dump_by_name);
    unsigned distinct = 0, unnamed = 0, ndup = 0, clash = used;
    const char *clash_name = NULL; void *clash_first = NULL, *clash_next = NULL;
    for (unsigned j = 0; j < used; ) {
        const char *n = names[dump_order[j]];
        if (!n) { unnamed = used - j; break; }
        unsigned k = j;
        while (k < used && !strcmp(names[dump_order[k]], n)) k++;
        distinct++;
        if (k - j > 1) { dump_dup_t d = { k - j, dump_order[j], dump_order[k - 1] }; dump_dups[ndup++] = d; }
        void *first = runtime_hle_targets[dump_order[j]];                 /* the fn this name was first seen with */
        for (unsigned m = j + 1; m < k; m++)
            if (runtime_hle_targets[dump_order[m]] != first) {
                if (dump_order[m] < clash) { clash = dump_order[m]; clash_name = n; clash_first = first;
                                              clash_next = runtime_hle_targets[dump_order[m]]; }
                break;                                                    /* run is index-sorted: first mismatch is earliest */
            }
        j = k;
    }
    qsort(dump_dups, ndup, sizeof *dump_dups, dump_by_count);
    fprintf(stderr, "[totk][wrapdump] wrapper table full: used=%u distinct names=%u unnamed=%u\n", used, distinct, unnamed);
    for (unsigned r = 0; r < ndup && r < 20; r++)
        fprintf(stderr, "[totk][wrapdump] %2u. x%-5u %s  first=%p last=%p\n", r + 1, dump_dups[r].count, names[dump_dups[r].first],
                runtime_hle_targets[dump_dups[r].first], runtime_hle_targets[dump_dups[r].last]);
    if (clash < used) fprintf(stderr, "[totk][wrapdump] first same-name/different-fn at index %u: %s %p then %p\n",
                              clash, clash_name, clash_first, clash_next);
    else fprintf(stderr, "[totk][wrapdump] no name was wrapped with two different fns\n");
}

/* Same host function -> same wrapper, so pointers the game compares stay consistent. The first name given is kept
   (the import or NVN entry the wrapper was made for; diagnostics only). */
void *runtime_hle_wrap_named(void *fn, const char *name) {
    if (!fn) return NULL;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
    unsigned i = 0;
    while (i < used && runtime_hle_targets[i] != fn) i++;
    if (i == used) {
        if (used == HLE_THUNKS) { dump_wrappers(); runtime_fail("host-stack wrapper table full"); }
        __atomic_store_n(&runtime_hle_targets[used++], fn, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    }
    if (!names[i] && name) names[i] = strdup(name);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
    return runtime_hle_thunks + (size_t)i * HLE_THUNK_BYTES;
}
void *runtime_hle_wrap(void *fn) { return runtime_hle_wrap_named(fn, NULL); }

/* A readable name: the demangled import, else the host symbol. */
static void name_of(unsigned i, char *out, size_t cap) {
    const char *n = i < HLE_THUNKS ? names[i] : NULL;
    if (n) {
        typedef char *(*demangle_t)(const char *, char *, size_t *, int *);
        static demangle_t demangle; static int looked;
        if (!looked) { demangle = (demangle_t)dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT, "__cxa_demangle"); looked = 1; }
        int status = -1; char *d = demangle && n[0] == '_' && n[1] == 'Z' ? demangle(n, NULL, NULL, &status) : NULL;
        snprintf(out, cap, "%s", d && !status ? d : n); free(d); return;
    }
    Dl_info info; void *fn = i < HLE_THUNKS ? runtime_hle_targets[i] : NULL;
    if (fn && dladdr(fn, &info) && info.dli_sname) snprintf(out, cap, "%s (host)", info.dli_sname);
    else snprintf(out, cap, "wrapper %u -> %p", i, fn);
}
const char *runtime_hle_raw_name(unsigned i) { return i < HLE_THUNKS ? names[i] : NULL; }
void runtime_hle_describe(unsigned i, char *out, size_t cap) { name_of(i, out, cap); }

/* hle_stack.S calls this before each wrapped call while tracing (on the host stack, arguments kept). */
void runtime_hle_note(uint64_t i) {
    if (i >= HLE_THUNKS) return;
    atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&counts[i], 1, memory_order_relaxed);
    runtime_thread_note_hle((unsigned)i);
    if (runtime_hle_trace != 2 || atomic_exchange_explicit(&seen[i], 1, memory_order_relaxed)) return;
    char text[256]; name_of((unsigned)i, text, sizeof text);
    fprintf(stderr, "[hle] %8.3f h=%#x %s\n", (runtime_now_ns() - trace_t0) / 1e9, runtime_thread_current_handle(), text);
}

typedef struct { uint64_t n; unsigned i; } hit_t;
static int by_count(const void *a, const void *b) {
    const hit_t *x = a, *y = b; return x->n < y->n ? 1 : x->n > y->n ? -1 : (int)x->i - (int)y->i;
}
void runtime_hle_trace_set(int mode) {
    if (mode < 0 || mode > 2) runtime_fail("hletrace takes 0, 1 or 2");
    if (mode) {
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < HLE_THUNKS; i++) since[i] = atomic_load_explicit(&counts[i], memory_order_relaxed);
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < HLE_THUNKS; i++) atomic_store_explicit(&seen[i], 0, memory_order_relaxed);
        trace_t0 = runtime_now_ns();
        __atomic_store_n(&runtime_hle_trace, mode, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        fprintf(stderr, "[hle] tracing on: counting every host call%s\n", mode == 2 ? ", logging the first call of each function" : "");
        return;
    }
    __atomic_store_n(&runtime_hle_trace, 0, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    static hit_t hits[HLE_THUNKS]; unsigned k = 0; uint64_t total = 0;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < HLE_THUNKS; i++) {
        uint64_t d = atomic_load_explicit(&counts[i], memory_order_relaxed) - since[i];
        if (d) { hits[k].n = d; hits[k].i = i; k++; total += d; }
    }
    qsort(hits, k, sizeof *hits, by_count);
    fprintf(stderr, "[hle] tracing off after %.1f s: %llu calls to %u functions\n", (runtime_now_ns() - trace_t0) / 1e9, (unsigned long long)total, k);
    for (unsigned j = 0; j < k; j++) {
        char text[256]; name_of(hits[j].i, text, sizeof text);
        fprintf(stderr, "[hle] %10llu  %s\n", (unsigned long long)hits[j].n, text);
    }
}

/* Called on a guest thread's own host stack before it enters guest code; top must leave room for the caller's frame. */
void runtime_hle_stack_set(uintptr_t top) {
    /* OHOS 封 tpidrro：TCB 常驻 x18（客体期）；此处从宿主 C 上下文调用，经 pthread TSD 取 */
    void *tcb = runtime_current_tcb();
    if (!tcb || !runtime_hle_tsd_off) runtime_fail("host-stack slot not initialised");
    *(volatile uintptr_t *)((uint8_t *)tcb + runtime_hle_tsd_off) = top & ~(uintptr_t)15;
}
```

```c
/* TOTK_INPUT_SCRIPT="sec:keycode:ms,...": press Mac key codes at given seconds after start (diagnostics without a
   picture: does the game react to a button). Key codes are the frontend's (J=38 is A, Return=36 is Plus). */
#include <unistd.h>
static void *input_script(void *arg) {
    const char *p = arg; uint64_t t0 = runtime_now_ns();
    while (p && *p) {
        double at = strtod(p, (char **)&p); if (*p++ != ':') break;
        unsigned code = (unsigned)strtoul(p, (char **)&p, 10); if (*p++ != ':') break;
        unsigned ms = (unsigned)strtoul(p, (char **)&p, 10); if (*p == ',') p++;
        while ((runtime_now_ns() - t0) / 1e9 < at) usleep(10000);
        fprintf(stderr, "[totk-input] script: key %u down for %u ms at %.1f s\n", code, ms, at);
        runtime_input_key_synthetic(code, 1); usleep(ms * 1000); runtime_input_key_synthetic(code, 0);
    }
    return NULL;
}
__attribute__((constructor)) static void input_script_start(void) {
    const char *e = getenv("TOTK_INPUT_SCRIPT"); if (!e) return;
    pthread_t t; pthread_create(&t, NULL, input_script, (void *)e); pthread_detach(t);
}

/* Optional local integration-test command stream. Appending complete lines lets tests inspect each
   actual frame before choosing the next input, instead of guessing load/menu timings. Disabled normally.
   Commands: key <Mac keycode> <milliseconds>, down/up <Mac keycode>, shot <path>, wshot <path>, passdump <frames>, gpucapture <path>.gputrace, querylog <frames>, anomdump,
   kbtest / kbtype <text> / kbenter / kbesc / kbshot <path> (the text entry bar), threads (dump every guest thread's wait), hletrace <0|1|2> (host calls the game makes), framestep <ms> (pin the frame step), close. */
extern void dm_gfx_shot_at(long frames, const char *path);
extern void runtime_front_request_close(void);
static void *input_file(void *arg) {
    FILE *f = fopen((const char *)arg, "r"); if (!f) runtime_fail("cannot open TOTK_INPUT_FILE");
    char line[1200];
    for (;;) {
        if (!fgets(line, sizeof line, f)) { if (ferror(f)) runtime_fail("diagnostic input read"); clearerr(f); usleep(100000); continue; }
        if (runtime_survey_command(line)) continue;
        unsigned code, ms; int used = 0;
        if (sscanf(line, "down %u %n", &code, &used) == 1 && used && !line[used] && code < 128) {
            fprintf(stderr,"[totk-input] file: key %u down\n",code);runtime_input_key_synthetic(code,1);
        } else if (sscanf(line, "up %u %n", &code, &used) == 1 && used && !line[used] && code < 128) {
            fprintf(stderr,"[totk-input] file: key %u up\n",code);runtime_input_key_synthetic(code,0);
        } else if (sscanf(line, "key %u %u %n", &code, &ms, &used) == 2 && used && !line[used] && code < 128 && ms > 0 && ms <= 5000) {
            fprintf(stderr, "[totk-input] file: key %u for %u ms\n", code, ms);
            runtime_input_key_synthetic(code, 1); usleep(ms * 1000); runtime_input_key_synthetic(code, 0);
        } else if (sscanf(line, "passdump %u %n", &code, &used) == 1 && used && !line[used] && code > 0 && code < 16) {
            extern void dm_gfx_passdump_next(long n); dm_gfx_passdump_next((long)code);
        } else if (!strncmp(line, "gpucapture ", 11) && line[11]) {   /* "gpucapture <path>.gputrace": a Metal capture of the next frame (needs MTL_CAPTURE_ENABLED=1) */
            char *e = line + strlen(line); while (e > line + 11 && (e[-1] == '\n' || e[-1] == '\r')) *--e = 0;
            extern void dm_gfx_gpucapture_next(const char *path); dm_gfx_gpucapture_next(line + 11);
        } else if (!strncmp(line, "anomdump", 8) && (line[8] == '\n' || line[8] == '\r' || !line[8])) {   /* TOTK_ANOMALY=<dir>: write the per-draw records (with GPU sample counts) of the last frames now */
            extern void dm_gfx_anomdump(void); dm_gfx_anomdump();
        } else if (sscanf(line, "querylog %u %n", &code, &used) == 1 && used && !line[used] && code > 0 && code <= 600) {
            extern void dm_gfx_querylog_next(long n); dm_gfx_querylog_next((long)code);   /* occlusion query results of the next n frames */
        } else if (!strncmp(line, "flag ", 5)) {
            /* "flag <name> <0|1>": switch a graphics behaviour while the game runs (A/B without restarting); rumble / gyro mute and unmute those */
            char name[64]; int v; if (sscanf(line + 5, "%63s %d", name, &v) != 2) runtime_fail("diagnostic flag needs <name> <0|1>");
            extern void dm_gfx_set_flag(const char *name, int v); if (!runtime_hid_feedback_flag(name, v)) dm_gfx_set_flag(name, v);
        } else if (!strncmp(line, "texdump ", 8)) {
            extern void dm_gfx_texdump_next(const char *path);
            line[strcspn(line, "\r\n")] = 0; if (!line[8] || !strstr(line + 8, "%d")) runtime_fail("diagnostic texdump path needs %d");
            dm_gfx_texdump_next(line + 8);
        } else if (sscanf(line, "shotn %u %n", &code, &used) == 1 && used && code > 0 && code <= 60) {
            /* "shotn <n> <path with %d>": screenshots of n consecutive game frames (frame flicker); %d = 0..n-1 */
            line[strcspn(line, "\r\n")] = 0; const char *fmt = line + used;
            if (!*fmt || !strstr(fmt, "%d") || strchr(strstr(fmt, "%d") + 2, '%')) runtime_fail("diagnostic shotn path needs one %d");
            for (unsigned i = 0; i < code; i++) { char p[1200]; snprintf(p, sizeof p, fmt, (int)i); dm_gfx_shot_at(2 + (long)i, p); }
        } else if (!strncmp(line, "shot ", 5)) {
            line[strcspn(line, "\r\n")] = 0; if (!line[5]) runtime_fail("diagnostic screenshot path");
            dm_gfx_shot_at(2, line + 5);
        } else if (!strncmp(line, "wshot ", 6)) {   /* "wshot <path>": the next shown picture as the window shows it (FPS box and the bottom-left box included) */
            line[strcspn(line, "\r\n")] = 0; if (!line[6]) runtime_fail("diagnostic window screenshot path");
            extern void dm_gfx_window_shot(const char *path); dm_gfx_window_shot(line + 6);
        } else if (!strcmp(line, "kbtest\n")) {   /* text entry bar the way the game names a horse (runtime/swkbd_host.c) */
            runtime_swkbd_selftest();
        } else if (!strncmp(line, "kbtype ", 7)) {   /* "kbtype <text>": typed into the open bar */
            line[strcspn(line, "\r\n")] = 0; runtime_front_text_test("type", line + 7);
        } else if (!strncmp(line, "kbshot ", 7)) {   /* "kbshot <path>": the open bar as a PNG */
            line[strcspn(line, "\r\n")] = 0; runtime_front_text_test("shot", line + 7);
        } else if (!strcmp(line, "kbenter\n") || !strcmp(line, "kbesc\n")) {
            runtime_front_text_test(line[2] == 'e' && line[3] == 'n' ? "enter" : "esc", NULL);
        } else if (sscanf(line, "hletrace %u %n", &code, &used) == 1 && used && !line[used] && code <= 2) {
            runtime_hle_trace_set((int)code);   /* 1 count host calls, 2 also log the first call of each, 0 stop and print the counts */
        } else if (!strncmp(line, "framestep ", 10)) {   /* "framestep <ms>": pin the real-time frame step, 0 = back to real time */
            char *end; double ms = strtod(line + 10, &end); if (end == line + 10 || ms < 0 || ms > 100) runtime_fail("framestep takes milliseconds (0 = real time)");
            runtime_frame_step_pin(ms);
        } else if (!strcmp(line, "threads\n")) {   /* every guest thread's wait state and guest return chain, now (a hang: what is each thread waiting for) */
            runtime_dump_threads();
        } else if (!strcmp(line, "close\n")) { runtime_front_request_close(); break; }
        else runtime_fail("invalid diagnostic input command");
    }
    fclose(f); return NULL;
}
__attribute__((constructor)) static void input_file_start(void) {
    const char *e = getenv("TOTK_INPUT_FILE"); if (!e || !*e) return;
    pthread_t t; if (pthread_create(&t, NULL, input_file, (void *)e)) runtime_fail("diagnostic input thread"); pthread_detach(t);
}

```

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/host/ipc.c`:

```c
/* In-process Horizon IPC server. Message framing follows the public HIPC/CMIF/TIPC description
   (libnx sf/hipc.h, cmif.h, tipc.h; ISC licence). The SDK client code runs unchanged: requests are
   read from the calling thread's TLS message buffer and answered in place. Unknown services and
   commands stop the runtime with their name and id instead of returning a fake success. */
#include "runtime.h"
#include "ipc.h"
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#define CMIF_IN_MAGIC 0x49434653u   /* "SFCI" */
#define CMIF_OUT_MAGIC 0x4f434653u  /* "SFCO" */
#define MSG_BYTES 0x100
#define POINTER_BUFFER_SIZE 0x8000

enum { T_CLOSE = 2, T_REQUEST = 4, T_CONTROL = 5, T_REQUEST_CTX = 6, T_CONTROL_CTX = 7, T_TIPC_BASE = 16, T_TIPC_CLOSE = 15 };

typedef struct { const char *name; IpcHandler handler; IpcOpen open; void (*close)(void *); } Service;
static Service services[32];
static unsigned nservices;
static __thread uint64_t trace_fp, trace_lr;   /* guest frame of the current request, for failure reports */
static pthread_mutex_t registry = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;

void runtime_ipc_register(const char *name, IpcHandler handler, IpcOpen open, void (*close)(void *)) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&registry);
    if (nservices == sizeof services / sizeof *services) runtime_fail("IPC service registry full");
    services[nservices++] = (Service){name, handler, open, close};
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&registry);
}

static IpcSession *session_new(const char *name, IpcHandler handler, void *state, void (*close)(void *)) {
    IpcSession *s = calloc(1, sizeof *s);
    if (!s) runtime_fail("IPC session allocation");
    *s = (IpcSession){name, handler, state, close, NULL};
    return s;
}
uint32_t runtime_ipc_new_session(const char *name, IpcHandler handler, void *state, void (*close)(void *)) {
    return runtime_handle_new(1, session_new(name, handler, state, close));
}
/* ---------- CMIF domains ----------
   A domain multiplexes objects over one session (libnx cmif.h): object ids address them, objects made by a request
   come back as ids instead of handles, and the client closes an object with a domain close request. Object 1 is the
   session that was converted; each object is an IpcSession of its own, whose close runs when the object is closed. */
#define DOMAIN_OBJECTS 256
typedef struct IpcDomain { pthread_mutex_t lock; unsigned sessions; IpcSession *objects[DOMAIN_OBJECTS]; } IpcDomain;   /* sessions: the domain session and its clones */
static uint32_t domain_add(IpcDomain *d, IpcSession *o) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&d->lock);
    for (uint32_t id = 1; id < DOMAIN_OBJECTS; id++) if (!d->objects[id]) { d->objects[id] = o; pthread_mutex_unlock(&d->lock); return id; }
    runtime_fail("IPC domain full");
}
static IpcSession *domain_get(IpcDomain *d, uint32_t id) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&d->lock); IpcSession *o = id < DOMAIN_OBJECTS ? d->objects[id] : NULL; pthread_mutex_unlock(&d->lock);
    if (!o) { fprintf(stderr, "[totk-ipc] domain object %u does not exist\n", id); runtime_fail("IPC domain object"); }
    return o;
}
static void domain_close(IpcDomain *d, uint32_t id) {
    IpcSession *o = domain_get(d, id);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&d->lock); d->objects[id] = NULL; pthread_mutex_unlock(&d->lock);
    runtime_ipc_session_closed(o);
}
void runtime_ipc_session_closed(void *p) {
    IpcSession *s = p;
    if (s->domain) {
        pthread_mutex_lock(&s->domain->lock); unsigned left = --s->domain->sessions; pthread_mutex_unlock(&s->domain->lock);
        if (!left) {   /* the last session to the domain: close its objects */
            for (uint32_t id = 1; id < DOMAIN_OBJECTS; id++) if (s->domain->objects[id]) runtime_ipc_session_closed(s->domain->objects[id]);
            pthread_mutex_destroy(&s->domain->lock); free(s->domain);
        }
    }
    if (s->close) s->close(s->state);
    free(s);
}
void runtime_ipc_tmem_closed(void *p) { free(p); }

void *ipc_guest(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size) {
    if (!addr && size) runtime_fail("IPC null buffer");
    if (addr + size < addr) runtime_fail("IPC buffer overflow");
    return (void *)(uintptr_t)addr;
}
const void *ipc_arg(const IpcRequest *rq, uint32_t off, uint32_t n) {
    if (off + n > rq->data_size) { fprintf(stderr, "[totk-ipc] cmd %u argument %u+%u beyond %u bytes\n", rq->cmd, off, n, rq->data_size); runtime_fail("IPC argument out of range"); }
    return rq->data + off;
}
void ipc_out(IpcResponse *rs, const void *p, uint32_t n) {
    if (rs->data_size + n > sizeof rs->data) runtime_fail("IPC response too large");
    memcpy(rs->data + rs->data_size, p, n); rs->data_size += n;
}
_Noreturn void ipc_unimplemented(const IpcSession *s, const IpcRequest *rq) {
    fprintf(stderr, "[totk-ipc] %s: command %u not implemented (type %u, data %u bytes, x%u a%u b%u w%u c%u)\n",
            s->name, rq->cmd, rq->type, rq->data_size, rq->nx, rq->na, rq->nb, rq->nw, rq->nc);
    runtime_trace_guest(trace_fp, trace_lr);
    runtime_fail("IPC command not implemented");
}

/* ---------- HIPC framing ---------- */
static uint64_t static_addr(const uint32_t *d) { return d[1] | ((uint64_t)((d[0] >> 12) & 0xf) << 32) | ((uint64_t)((d[0] >> 6) & 0x3f) << 36); }
static uint64_t buffer_addr(const uint32_t *d) { return d[1] | ((uint64_t)((d[2] >> 28) & 0xf) << 32) | ((uint64_t)((d[2] >> 2) & 0x3fffff) << 36); }
static uint64_t buffer_size(const uint32_t *d) { return d[0] | ((uint64_t)((d[2] >> 24) & 0xf) << 32); }

static void parse(const uint32_t *m, IpcRequest *rq, const uint32_t **data_words, unsigned *ndata) {
    memset(rq, 0, sizeof *rq);
    rq->type = m[0] & 0xffff;
    rq->nx = (m[0] >> 16) & 0xf; rq->na = (m[0] >> 20) & 0xf; rq->nb = (m[0] >> 24) & 0xf; rq->nw = (m[0] >> 28) & 0xf;
    *ndata = m[1] & 0x3ff;
    unsigned recv_mode = (m[1] >> 10) & 0xf, special = m[1] >> 31;
    if (rq->nx > IPC_MAX_BUF || rq->na > IPC_MAX_BUF || rq->nb > IPC_MAX_BUF || rq->nw > IPC_MAX_BUF) runtime_fail("IPC too many buffers");
    const uint32_t *p = m + 2;
    if (special) {
        uint32_t h = *p++;
        rq->has_pid = h & 1; rq->ncopy = (h >> 1) & 0xf; rq->nmove = (h >> 5) & 0xf;
        if (rq->ncopy > 8 || rq->nmove > 8) runtime_fail("IPC too many handles");
        if (rq->has_pid) { memcpy(&rq->pid, p, 8); p += 2; }
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < rq->ncopy; i++) rq->copy[i] = *p++;
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < rq->nmove; i++) rq->move[i] = *p++;
    }
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < rq->nx; i++, p += 2) rq->x[i] = (IpcBuffer){static_addr(p), p[0] >> 16, p[0] & 0x3f};
    IpcBuffer *lists[3] = {rq->a, rq->b, rq->w}; unsigned counts[3] = {rq->na, rq->nb, rq->nw};
    for (unsigned k = 0; k < 3; k++) for (unsigned i = 0; i < counts[k]; i++, p += 3) lists[k][i] = (IpcBuffer){buffer_addr(p), buffer_size(p), i};
    *data_words = p;
    const uint32_t *recv = p + *ndata;
    rq->nc = recv_mode == 2 ? 1 : recv_mode > 2 ? recv_mode - 2 : 0;
    if (rq->nc > IPC_MAX_BUF) runtime_fail("IPC too many receive buffers");
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < rq->nc; i++, recv += 2) rq->c[i] = (IpcBuffer){recv[0] | ((uint64_t)(recv[1] & 0xffff) << 32), recv[1] >> 16, i};
    if ((const uint8_t *)recv - (const uint8_t *)m > MSG_BYTES) runtime_fail("IPC request exceeds message buffer");
}

static void respond(uint32_t *m, int tipc, int domain, const IpcResponse *rs) {
    uint32_t out[MSG_BYTES / 4]; memset(out, 0, sizeof out);
    unsigned special = rs->ncopy || rs->nmove;
    uint32_t *p = out + 2;
    if (special) {
        *p++ = (rs->ncopy << 1) | (rs->nmove << 5);
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < rs->ncopy; i++) *p++ = rs->copy[i];
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < rs->nmove; i++) *p++ = rs->move[i];
    }
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < rs->nxout; i++, p += 2) {
        uint64_t a = rs->xout[i].addr;
        p[0] = (rs->xout[i].index & 0x3f) | (uint32_t)(((a >> 36) & 0x3f) << 6) | (uint32_t)(((a >> 32) & 0xf) << 12) | (uint32_t)(rs->xout[i].size << 16);
        p[1] = (uint32_t)a;
    }
    uint8_t *words = (uint8_t *)p, *payload;
    unsigned header = tipc ? 4 : domain ? 32 : 16;   /* a domain reply puts its own header before the CMIF one */
    if (tipc) payload = words;
    else payload = (uint8_t *)out + (((words - (uint8_t *)out) + 15) & ~15);
    unsigned used = (unsigned)(payload - words) + header + rs->data_size + 4 * rs->nobjects;
    unsigned nwords = tipc ? (used + 3) / 4 : (used + 16 + 3) / 4;   /* CMIF keeps alignment slack like libnx */
    if ((size_t)(words - (uint8_t *)out) + nwords * 4 > MSG_BYTES) runtime_fail("IPC response exceeds message buffer");
    if (tipc) memcpy(payload, &rs->result, 4);
    else {
        uint32_t h[4] = {CMIF_OUT_MAGIC, 0, rs->result, 0};
        if (domain) { uint32_t d[4] = {rs->nobjects, 0, 0, 0}; memcpy(payload, d, 16); }
        memcpy(payload + header - 16, h, 16);
    }
    memcpy(payload + header, rs->data, rs->data_size);
    memcpy(payload + header + rs->data_size, rs->objects, 4 * rs->nobjects);   /* out object ids follow the data */
    out[0] = (rs->nxout & 0xf) << 16;
    out[1] = (nwords & 0x3ff) | (special ? 1u << 31 : 0);
    memcpy(m, out, MSG_BYTES);
}

/* ---------- Control requests (CMIF) ---------- */
static void control(IpcSession *s, const IpcRequest *rq, IpcResponse *rs) {
    switch (rq->cmd) {
    case 3: { uint16_t n = POINTER_BUFFER_SIZE; IPC_OUT(rs, n); return; }   /* QueryPointerBufferSize */
    case 0: {                                                                 /* ConvertCurrentObjectToDomain */
        if (s->domain) runtime_fail("IPC session is already a domain");
        IpcDomain *d = calloc(1, sizeof *d);
        if (!d) runtime_fail("IPC domain allocation");
        pthread_mutex_init(&d->lock, NULL);
        uint32_t id = domain_add(d, session_new(s->name, s->handler, s->state, s->close));
        s->close = NULL; s->domain = d; d->sessions = 1;                      /* object 1 owns the state now */
        IPC_OUT(rs, id); return;
    }
    case 1: {                                                                 /* CopyFromCurrentDomain(object id) */
        if (!s->domain) runtime_fail("IPC CopyFromCurrentDomain outside a domain");
        IpcSession *o = domain_get(s->domain, IPC_ARG(rq, uint32_t, 0));
        rs->move[rs->nmove++] = runtime_ipc_new_session(o->name, o->handler, o->state, NULL);
        return;
    }
    case 2: case 4:                                                           /* CloneCurrentObject(Ex) */
        if (s->domain) {                                                      /* a clone reaches the same domain */
            IpcSession *c = session_new(s->name, s->handler, s->state, NULL);
            pthread_mutex_lock(&s->domain->lock); s->domain->sessions++; pthread_mutex_unlock(&s->domain->lock);
            c->domain = s->domain; rs->move[rs->nmove++] = runtime_handle_new(1, c);
            return;
        }
        rs->move[rs->nmove++] = runtime_ipc_new_session(s->name, s->handler, s->state, NULL);
        return;
    default:
        fprintf(stderr, "[totk-ipc] %s: control command %u not implemented\n", s->name, rq->cmd);
        runtime_fail("IPC control command not implemented");
    }
}

static void dispatch(IpcSession *s, uint32_t *m) {
    IpcRequest rq; const uint32_t *words; unsigned ndata;
    parse(m, &rq, &words, &ndata);
    if (getenv("TOTK_IPC_DUMP") && rq.na + rq.nb) { fprintf(stderr, "[totk-ipc] raw %s:", s->name); for (unsigned i = 0; i < 20; i++) fprintf(stderr, " %08x", m[i]); fputc('\n', stderr); }
    IpcResponse rs; memset(&rs, 0, sizeof rs);
    if (rq.type == T_CLOSE || rq.type == T_TIPC_CLOSE) return;
    int tipc = rq.type >= T_TIPC_BASE;
    const uint8_t *bytes = (const uint8_t *)words, *end = bytes + ndata * 4;
    if (tipc) { rq.cmd = rq.type - T_TIPC_BASE; rq.data = bytes; rq.data_size = (uint32_t)(end - bytes); }
    else if (s->domain && (rq.type == T_REQUEST || rq.type == T_REQUEST_CTX)) {
        /* CmifDomainInHeader {u8 type, u8 input objects, u16 data size, u32 object id, u32 pad, u32 token}, then the CMIF
           request of that object. Type 1 sends a message, type 2 closes the object. */
        const uint8_t *payload = (const uint8_t *)m + (((bytes - (const uint8_t *)m) + 15) & ~15);
        uint8_t kind = payload[0], nin = payload[1]; uint16_t size; uint32_t id, h[4];
        memcpy(&size, payload + 2, 2); memcpy(&id, payload + 4, 4);
        if (kind == 2) { domain_close(s->domain, id); respond(m, 0, 1, &rs); return; }
        if (kind != 1 || size < 16 || payload + 16 + size > end) { fprintf(stderr, "[totk-ipc] %s: domain request type %u size %u\n", s->name, kind, size); runtime_fail("IPC bad domain request"); }
        if (nin) { fprintf(stderr, "[totk-ipc] %s: domain request with %u input objects\n", s->name, nin); runtime_fail("IPC domain input objects not implemented"); }
        memcpy(h, payload + 16, 16);
        if (h[0] != CMIF_IN_MAGIC) { fprintf(stderr, "[totk-ipc] %s: bad CMIF magic %#x in a domain request\n", s->name, h[0]); runtime_fail("IPC bad CMIF header"); }
        IpcSession *target = domain_get(s->domain, id);
        rq.cmd = h[2]; rq.data = payload + 32; rq.data_size = size - 16u;
        target->handler(target, &rq, &rs);
        /* Interfaces a domain object returns are objects of the same domain, not handles. */
        unsigned kept = 0;
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < rs.nmove; i++) {
            IpcSession *made = runtime_handle_take_session(rs.move[i]);
            if (!made) { rs.move[kept++] = rs.move[i]; continue; }
            if (rs.nobjects == sizeof rs.objects / sizeof *rs.objects) runtime_fail("IPC too many domain objects out");
            rs.objects[rs.nobjects++] = domain_add(s->domain, made);
        }
        rs.nmove = kept;
        respond(m, 0, 1, &rs); return;
    }
    else if (rq.type == T_REQUEST || rq.type == T_REQUEST_CTX || rq.type == T_CONTROL || rq.type == T_CONTROL_CTX) {
        const uint8_t *payload = (const uint8_t *)m + (((bytes - (const uint8_t *)m) + 15) & ~15);
        uint32_t h[4]; memcpy(h, payload, 16);
        if (h[0] != CMIF_IN_MAGIC) { fprintf(stderr, "[totk-ipc] %s: bad CMIF magic %#x (domain sessions are not implemented)\n", s->name, h[0]); runtime_fail("IPC bad CMIF header"); }
        rq.cmd = h[2]; rq.data = payload + 16; rq.data_size = payload + 16 <= end ? (uint32_t)(end - payload - 16) : 0;
    } else {
        fprintf(stderr, "[totk-ipc] %s: message type %u at %p:", s->name, rq.type, (void *)m);
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < 16; i++) fprintf(stderr, " %08x", m[i]);
        fputc('\n', stderr); runtime_fail("IPC message type not implemented");
    }
    if (rq.type == T_CONTROL || rq.type == T_CONTROL_CTX) control(s, &rq, &rs);
    else s->handler(s, &rq, &rs);
    respond(m, tipc, 0, &rs);
}

/* ---------- sm: service manager ---------- */
static void sm(IpcSession *s, const IpcRequest *rq, IpcResponse *rs) {
    switch (rq->cmd) {
    case 0: return;                                          /* RegisterClient / Initialize */
    case 1: {                                                /* GetServiceHandle(name) */
        char name[9] = {0}; memcpy(name, ipc_arg(rq, 0, 8), 8);
        pthread_mutex_lock(&registry);
        const Service *found = NULL;
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < nservices; i++) if (!strcmp(services[i].name, name)) found = &services[i];
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&registry);
        if (!found) { fprintf(stderr, "[totk-ipc] sm: service \"%s\" not implemented\n", name); runtime_trace_guest(trace_fp, trace_lr); runtime_fail("IPC service not implemented"); }
        rs->move[rs->nmove++] = runtime_ipc_new_session(found->name, found->handler, found->open ? found->open() : NULL, found->close);
        fprintf(stderr, "[totk-ipc] opened service %s\n", found->name);
        return;
    }
    default: ipc_unimplemented(s, rq);
    }
}

/* ---------- SVCs ---------- */
int runtime_ipc_svc(unsigned num, uint64_t *r) {
    switch (num) {
    case 0x1f: {                                             /* ConnectToNamedPort(x1 name) -> w1 */
        char name[13] = {0}; memcpy(name, (const void *)(uintptr_t)r[1], 12);
        if (strcmp(name, "sm:")) { fprintf(stderr, "[totk-ipc] named port \"%s\"\n", name); runtime_fail("IPC named port not implemented"); }
        r[0] = 0; r[1] = runtime_ipc_new_session("sm:", sm, NULL, NULL); return 1;
    }
    case 0x21: case 0x22: {                                  /* SendSyncRequest(w0) / WithUserBuffer(x0, x1, w2) */
        uint32_t h = (uint32_t)(num == 0x21 ? r[0] : r[2]);
        IpcSession *s = runtime_handle_get(h, 1);
        if (!s) { r[0] = 0xe401; return 1; }
        uint32_t *m = num == 0x21 ? pthread_getspecific(runtime_keys[2]) : (uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)r[0];
        if (!m || (num == 0x22 && r[1] < MSG_BYTES)) runtime_fail("IPC message buffer");
        trace_fp = r[29]; trace_lr = r[30];
        dispatch(s, m); r[0] = 0; return 1;
    }
    case 0x15: {                                             /* CreateTransferMemory(x1 addr, x2 size, w3 perm) -> w1 */
        IpcTransferMemory *t = malloc(sizeof *t);
        if (!t) runtime_fail("transfer memory allocation");
        *t = (IpcTransferMemory){r[1], r[2], (uint32_t)r[3]};
        r[0] = 0; r[1] = runtime_handle_new(0, t); return 1;
    }
    default: return 0;
    }
}
```

```h
/* Host-side Horizon IPC: HIPC message framing with CMIF/TIPC payloads, served in-process.
   The SDK client libraries run unchanged; services are host implementations registered by name. */
#pragma once
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stddef.h>

#define IPC_MAX_BUF 8
typedef struct { uint64_t addr, size; unsigned index; } IpcBuffer;

typedef struct {
    unsigned type, cmd;               // HIPC type (4/5/6/7 CMIF, >=16 TIPC) and command id
    int has_pid; uint64_t pid;
    uint32_t copy[8], move[8]; unsigned ncopy, nmove;
    IpcBuffer x[IPC_MAX_BUF], a[IPC_MAX_BUF], b[IPC_MAX_BUF], w[IPC_MAX_BUF], c[IPC_MAX_BUF];
    unsigned nx, na, nb, nw, nc;
    const uint8_t *data; uint32_t data_size;    // command arguments after the CMIF header
} IpcRequest;

typedef struct {
    uint32_t result;
    uint8_t data[0x100]; uint32_t data_size;
    uint32_t copy[8], move[8]; unsigned ncopy, nmove;
    IpcBuffer xout[IPC_MAX_BUF]; unsigned nxout;  // out-pointer data placed by the service into client C buffers
    uint32_t objects[8]; unsigned nobjects;       // domain object ids out (ipc.c fills them from moved sessions)
} IpcResponse;

struct IpcSession;
typedef void (*IpcHandler)(struct IpcSession *s, const IpcRequest *rq, IpcResponse *rs);
struct IpcDomain;
/* domain: set once the client converts the session into a CMIF domain (ipc.c); its objects are sessions of their own. */
typedef struct IpcSession { const char *name; IpcHandler handler; void *state; void (*close)(void *state); struct IpcDomain *domain; } IpcSession;

/* Service registry: open(state out) creates per-session state for a named service. */
typedef void *(*IpcOpen)(void);
void runtime_ipc_register(const char *name, IpcHandler handler, IpcOpen open, void (*close)(void *));
uint32_t runtime_ipc_new_session(const char *name, IpcHandler handler, void *state, void (*close)(void *));
int runtime_ipc_svc(unsigned num, uint64_t *regs);   /* returns 1 when handled */

/* Response helpers */
void ipc_out(IpcResponse *rs, const void *p, uint32_t n);
#define IPC_OUT(rs, v) ipc_out((rs), &(v), sizeof(v))
#define IPC_ARG(rq, T, off) (*(const T *)ipc_arg((rq), (off), sizeof(T)))
const void *ipc_arg(const IpcRequest *rq, uint32_t off, uint32_t n);
void *ipc_guest(uint64_t addr, uint64_t size);   /* validated guest pointer */
_Noreturn void ipc_unimplemented(const IpcSession *s, const IpcRequest *rq);

/* threads.c */
uint32_t runtime_handle_new(int session, void *obj);
void *runtime_handle_get(uint32_t h, int session);
void *runtime_handle_take_session(uint32_t h);   /* removes the handle, keeps the session */
uint32_t runtime_event_new(void);
uint32_t runtime_event_readable(uint32_t writable);
void runtime_event_signal(uint32_t writable);
void runtime_ipc_session_closed(void *session);
void runtime_ipc_tmem_closed(void *tmem);

/* Transfer memory created by svcCreateTransferMemory */
typedef struct { uint64_t addr, size; uint32_t perm; } IpcTransferMemory;

#define IPC_RESULT_UNKNOWN_COMMAND 0xf601u   /* sf: unknown command (module 10, description 123) */
```

```c
static void make_hash(Module *m) {
 unsigned cap=16;while(cap<m->nsym*2)cap<<=1;

static void *module_symbol(Module *m,const char *name) {

 }

}

uint8_t *runtime_module_base(const char *name){for(unsigned i=0;i<NM;i++)if(!strcmp(modules[i].name,name))return modules[i].base;return NULL;}
/* RELRO in newer SDKs protects relocated data after linking. Keep permissions at
 * the guest's 4 KiB granularity. A Darwin 16 KiB page receives the union of its
 * four guest permissions, so protecting an edge never removes access from an
 * adjacent writable object. Whole interior pages are actually made read-only. */
static pthread_mutex_t module_permission_lock=PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static unsigned char *module_permissions[NM];
static unsigned module_page_permission(unsigned i,uint64_t off){
 Module *m=&modules[i];
 if(off<m->data_off)return off<page_up(m->text_end)?5:1;
 if(off>=m->key_off)return off>=m->patch_off?5:1;
 return module_permissions[i]?module_permissions[i][(off-m->data_off)/4096]:3;
}
uint64_t runtime_module_permission(uint64_t address,uint64_t size,unsigned permission){
 if(address&4095)return 0xcc01;
 if(!size||(size&4095))return 0xca01;
 if(permission!=0&&permission!=1&&permission!=3)return 0xd801;
 for(unsigned i=0;i<NM;i++){
  Module *m=&modules[i];uint64_t base=(uintptr_t)m->base;
  if(address<base||address-base<m->data_off||address-base>=m->key_off||size>m->key_off-(address-base))continue;
  uint64_t off=address-base;
  pthread_mutex_lock(&module_permission_lock);
  if(!module_permissions[i]){size_t count=(m->key_off-m->data_off+4095)/4096;module_permissions[i]=malloc(count);need(module_permissions[i]!=NULL,"module permission table");memset(module_permissions[i],3,count);}
  for(uint64_t p=0;p<size/4096;p++)if(module_permissions[i][(off-m->data_off)/4096+p]&16){pthread_mutex_unlock(&module_permission_lock);return 0xd401;}
  memset(module_permissions[i]+(off-m->data_off)/4096,permission,size/4096);
  uint64_t lo=off&~0x3fffULL,hi=page_up(off+size);
  for(uint64_t page=lo;page<hi;page+=0x4000){
   unsigned combined=0;for(unsigned p=0;p<4;p++)combined|=module_page_permission(i,page+p*4096);
   int prot=(combined&1?PROT_READ:0)|(combined&2?PROT_WRITE:0);
   need(!(combined&4),"module permission overlaps executable page");
   need(mprotect(m->base+page,0x4000,prot)==0,"module data permission");
  }
  pthread_mutex_unlock(&module_permission_lock);
  fprintf(stderr,"[totk] %s data permission +%#llx size=%#llx perm=%u\n",m->name,(unsigned long long)off,(unsigned long long)size,permission);
  return 0;
 }
 return 0xd401;
}
uint64_t runtime_module_lock_permission(uint64_t address,uint64_t size,unsigned mask,unsigned attribute){
 if(address&4095)return 0xcc01;
 if(!size||(size&4095))return 0xca01;
 /* The only module attribute used by the SDK is the irreversible RELRO lock. */
 if(mask!=16||attribute!=16)return 0xd801;
 for(unsigned i=0;i<NM;i++){
  Module *m=&modules[i];uint64_t start=(uintptr_t)m->base;
  if(address<start||address-start<m->data_off||address-start>=m->key_off||size>m->key_off-(address-start))continue;
  pthread_mutex_lock(&module_permission_lock);
  if(!module_permissions[i]){size_t count=(m->key_off-m->data_off+4095)/4096;module_permissions[i]=malloc(count);need(module_permissions[i]!=NULL,"module attribute table");memset(module_permissions[i],3,count);}
  size_t first=(address-start-m->data_off)/4096;
  for(uint64_t p=0;p<size/4096;p++)module_permissions[i][first+p]|=16;
  pthread_mutex_unlock(&module_permission_lock);return 0;
 }
 return 0xd401;
}
int runtime_module_query(uint64_t address,uint64_t *base,uint64_t *size,unsigned *state,unsigned *permission,unsigned *attribute){
 for(unsigned i=0;i<NM;i++){
  Module *m=&modules[i];uint64_t start=(uintptr_t)m->base;
  if(address<start||address-start>=m->key_off)continue;
  uint64_t off=(address-start)&~4095ULL,lo=off,hi=off+4096;
  pthread_mutex_lock(&module_permission_lock);
  unsigned perm=module_page_permission(i,off);int data=off>=m->data_off;
  uint64_t limit=data?m->data_off:0,end=data?m->key_off:m->data_off;
  while(lo>limit&&module_page_permission(i,lo-4096)==perm)lo-=4096;
  while(hi<end&&module_page_permission(i,hi)==perm)hi+=4096;
  pthread_mutex_unlock(&module_permission_lock);
  *base=start+lo;*size=hi-lo;*state=data?4:3;*permission=perm&7;*attribute=perm&16;return 1;
 }
 return 0;
}
void runtime_describe_address(uint64_t a,char *out,size_t n){for(unsigned i=0;i<NM;i++)if(a>=(uintptr_t)modules[i].base&&a<(uintptr_t)modules[i].base+modules[i].size){snprintf(out,n,"%s+0x%llx",modules[i].name,(unsigned long long)(a-(uintptr_t)modules[i].base));return;}Dl_info di;if(dladdr((void *)(uintptr_t)a,&di)&&di.dli_sname){snprintf(out,n,"%s+0x%llx",di.dli_sname,(unsigned long long)(a-(uintptr_t)di.dli_saddr));return;}snprintf(out,n,"0x%llx",(unsigned long long)a);}
/* Guest frame-pointer chain. Guest threads run on guest stacks (not the host pthread stack), so frames are read with
   mach_vm_read_overwrite (a bad pointer ends the walk instead of faulting); the chain must grow upwards. */
void runtime_trace_guest(uint64_t fp,uint64_t lr) {
 for(unsigned n=0;n<16;n++) {
  for(unsigned i=0;i<NM;i++)if(lr>=(uintptr_t)modules[i].base&&lr<(uintptr_t)modules[i].base+modules[i].size)fprintf(stderr,"[totk] caller %s+0x%llx\n",modules[i].name,(unsigned long long)(lr-(uintptr_t)modules[i].base));

  if(mach_vm_read_overwrite(mach_task_self(),fp,16,(uintptr_t)f,&got)!=KERN_SUCCESS||got!=16)break;
  lr=f[1];if(f[0]<=fp||f[0]-fp>(64u<<20))break;fp=f[0];
 }
}
static void *required(const char *name) { void *p=runtime_symbol(name);if(!p){fprintf(stderr,"missing %s\n",name);runtime_fail("required symbol");}return p; }
#if TARGET_OS_IPHONE
/* iOS: code written into memory at run time cannot execute, so ios/tools/gen_embed.py compiles each rewritten image into
   this executable: the text (with the game patches already applied on the Mac, TOTK_EXPORT_IOS) and the patch area go
   into the r-x segment __TOTKX, everything between them (rodata, data, bss, key page) into the rw segment __TOTK<name>W.
   Here one contiguous range is reserved and the three parts are vm_remap'ed back to their original relative offsets:
   code pages shared with the signed executable (copy=FALSE, r-x), the data part copy-on-write. Main's extra private
   page after the image (real-time frame step) stays plain zero-filled memory from the reservation. */

static void remap_at(Module *m,uintptr_t to,const void *from,size_t size,boolean_t copy,vm_prot_t need_prot) {

 need((cur&need_prot)==need_prot,"embedded module permissions after remap");
}

}
#else
static void map_module(Module *m,const char *dir) {
 char path[4096];need(snprintf(path,sizeof(path),"%s/%s.patched.bin",dir,m->name)<(int)sizeof(path),"image path");

    real-time frame-step patch reads its two floats from this page via ADRP. */
```
