```c
#ifdef __MUSL__
 /* OHOS 封 tpidrro_el0 写，把 mrs Xn,tpidrro_el0 (0xd53bd060|Rt) 原位补丁成 mov Xn,x18 (0xAA1203E0|Rt)。
    实测 TLS 存根不在原 text（[0,text_end)），而在重写工具生成的补丁区 [patch_off,file_size)（每 0x28 一条）；
    两段都扫，data 区（text_end..patch_off）不碰，避免误伤 rodata 常量。 */
 {unsigned patched=0;uint32_t *insns=(void *)m->base;
  for(uint32_t off=0;off+4<=m->text_end;off+=4){uint32_t w=insns[off/4];
   if((w&0xffffffe0u)==0xd53bd060u){insns[off/4]=0xAA1203E0u|(w&31u);patched++;}}
  for(uint32_t off=m->patch_off&~(uint32_t)3;off+4<=m->file_size;off+=4){uint32_t w=insns[off/4];
   if((w&0xffffffe0u)==0xd53bd060u){insns[off/4]=0xAA1203E0u|(w&31u);patched++;}}
  fprintf(stderr,"[totk] patched %u tpidrro reads -> x18 in %s (text_end=%#llx patch_off=%#llx file=%#llx)\n",patched,m->name,(unsigned long long)m->text_end,(unsigned long long)m->patch_off,(unsigned long long)m->file_size);}
#endif
 need(m->key_off%0x4000==0&&m->key_off+0x4000<=m->patch_off&&m->patch_off<m->size,"key and patch layout");
 uint64_t *key=(void *)(m->base+m->key_off);
 for(unsigned i=0;i<8;i++)key[i]=runtime_keys[i]*8;
 make_hash(m);
 fprintf(stderr,"[totk] mapped %s base=%p size=%zu symbols=%u\n",m->name,m->base,m->size,m->nsym);
}
/* TOTK_EXPORT_IOS=<dir>: after the game patches, write each module's text [0, page_up(TEXT_END)) for ios/tools/gen_embed.py.
   Relocations never reach the text (they start at DATA_OFF), so the exported bytes differ from the verified image only at
   the patch sites; the count is printed and checked by the generator. */
static void export_ios_text(const char *rewritten,const char *out) {
 for(unsigned i=0;i<NM;i++){Module *m=&modules[i];char path[4096];size_t n=page_up(m->text_end);
  need(snprintf(path,sizeof path,"%s/%s.patched.bin",rewritten,m->name)<(int)sizeof path,"image path");
  FILE *f=fopen(path,"rb");need(f!=NULL,"open patched module");uint8_t *orig=malloc(n);need(orig&&fread(orig,1,n,f)==n,"read original text");fclose(f);
  unsigned diff=0;for(size_t k=0;k<n;k+=4)if(memcmp(orig+k,m->base+k,4))diff++;free(orig);
  need(snprintf(path,sizeof path,"%s/%s.x0.bin",out,m->name)<(int)sizeof path,"export path");
  f=fopen(path,"wb");need(f&&fwrite(m->base,1,n,f)==n&&fclose(f)==0,"write exported text");
  printf("%s text_bytes=%zu patched_words=%u\n",m->name,n,diff);}
}
#endif
static void relocate(Module *m) {
 for(unsigned i=0;i<m->nreloc;i++) {
  if(i%10000==0)fprintf(stderr,"[odyssey] relocate %s %u/%u\n",m->name,i,m->nreloc);
  const Reloc *r=&m->relocs[i];
  need(r->where>=m->data_off&&r->where+8<=m->key_off&&r->symbol<m->nsym,"relocation bounds");
  uintptr_t v;
  if(r->kind==1027) { need(r->addend>=0&&(uint64_t)r->addend<m->key_off,"relative addend");v=(uintptr_t)m->base+r->addend;m->relative++; }
  else {
   need(r->kind==257||r->kind==1025||r->kind==1026,"relocation kind");
   const Symbol *s=&m->symbols[r->symbol];void *p=r->kind==1026?runtime_observer(s->name):NULL;
   if(!p)p=runtime_override(s->name);
   if(p)p=runtime_hle_wrap_named(p,s->name);   /* host replacements run on the thread's host stack */
   if(!p)p=s->defined?(s->value<m->key_off?m->base+s->value:NULL):runtime_symbol(s->name);
   if(!p&&s->binding!=2){fprintf(stderr,"%s unresolved %s\n",m->name,s->name);runtime_fail("strong import unresolved");}
   if(!p)m->weak++;
   if(p&&!s->defined)m->cross++;
   v=(uintptr_t)p+(r->kind==1026?0:r->addend);m->symbolic++;
  }
  memcpy(m->base+r->where,&v,8);
 }
 fprintf(stderr,"[odyssey] relocated %s %u entries\n",m->name,m->nreloc);
}
static void verify_identity(int negative) {
 unsigned checked=0;void *original=required("nnMain");
 for(unsigned i=0;i<NM;i++)for(unsigned j=0;j<modules[i].nreloc;j++) {
  Module *m=&modules[i];const Reloc *r=&m->relocs[j];
  if(r->kind==1027||r->kind==1026||strcmp(m->symbols[r->symbol].name,"nnMain"))continue;
  uintptr_t actual;memcpy(&actual,m->base+r->where,8);
  if(negative){actual=(uintptr_t)runtime_observer("nnMain");memcpy(m->base+r->where,&actual,8);}
  need(actual==(uintptr_t)original,"guest nnMain address identity changed");checked++;
 }
 need(checked>0,"nnMain identity reference missing");
}
static void seal(Module *m) {
 size_t rx=page_up(m->text_end),ro_end=m->data_off&~(size_t)0x3fff;
 need(rx<=ro_end,"text/data overlap");
#if TARGET_OS_IPHONE
 if(ro_end>rx)need(mprotect(m->base+rx,ro_end-rx,PROT_READ)==0,"rodata R");   /* code parts are already r-x shared pages */
 need(mprotect(m->base+m->key_off,0x4000,PROT_READ)==0,"key page R");
 return;
#endif
 need(mprotect(m->base,rx,PROT_READ|PROT_EXEC)==0,"text RX");
 if(ro_end>rx)need(mprotect(m->base+rx,ro_end-rx,PROT_READ)==0,"rodata R");
 need(mprotect(m->base+m->key_off,0x4000,PROT_READ)==0,"key page R");
 size_t patch_end=page_up(m->file_size);
 need(mprotect(m->base+m->patch_off,patch_end-m->patch_off,PROT_READ|PROT_EXEC)==0,"patch RX");
 sys_icache_invalidate(m->base,rx);sys_icache_invalidate(m->base+m->patch_off,patch_end-m->patch_off);
}
static void check_permissions(Module *m) {
 mach_vm_address_t a=(uintptr_t)m->base,end=a+m->size;
 while(a<end) {
  mach_vm_size_t size=0;vm_region_basic_info_data_64_t info;mach_msg_type_number_t count=VM_REGION_BASIC_INFO_COUNT_64;mach_port_t obj=0;
  mach_vm_address_t requested=a;
  /* Linux 会把权限相同且相邻的 VMA 合并成一条（模块基址可落在更大 region 中间，与 Darwin 逐 region
     对齐不同）：接受"包含即命中"，region 与模块的交集部分逐页核对期望权限。 */
  need(mach_vm_region(mach_task_self(),&a,&size,VM_REGION_BASIC_INFO_64,(vm_region_info_t)&info,&count,&obj)==KERN_SUCCESS&&a<=requested&&requested<a+size&&size>0,"mapped region query");
  if(obj)mach_port_deallocate(mach_task_self(),obj);
  mach_vm_address_t lo=a>(uintptr_t)m->base?a:(uintptr_t)m->base,hi=a+size<end?a+size:end;
  for(mach_vm_address_t p=lo;p<hi;p+=4096) {
   uint64_t off=p-(uintptr_t)m->base;
   vm_prot_t expected=off>=page_up(m->file_size)?(VM_PROT_READ|VM_PROT_WRITE):
    (off<page_up(m->text_end)||off>=m->patch_off)?(VM_PROT_READ|VM_PROT_EXECUTE):
    ((off>=page_up(m->text_end)&&off<(m->data_off&~0x3fffULL))||(off>=m->key_off&&off<m->key_off+0x4000ULL))?VM_PROT_READ:(VM_PROT_READ|VM_PROT_WRITE);
   if(info.protection!=expected){char pmsg[176];snprintf(pmsg,sizeof pmsg,"module permission mismatch %s off=%#llx region=[%#llx,%#llx) prot=%u expected=%u",m->name,(unsigned long long)off,(unsigned long long)a,(unsigned long long)(a+size),info.protection,expected);runtime_fail(pmsg);}
   need(info.protection==expected,"module permission mismatch");
  }
  a+=size;
 }
}
typedef struct {void *tls;void *tlr;void *dummy;void *signal_stack;void *tcb;} ThreadEnvironment;
static pthread_key_t environment_key;
#define SIGNAL_STACK_SIZE (256u<<10)
static void environment_destroy(void *p) {
 ThreadEnvironment *e=p;if(!e)return;
 if(e->signal_stack){stack_t off={.ss_flags=SS_DISABLE};sigaltstack(&off,NULL);free(e->signal_stack);}
#ifndef __MUSL__
 __asm__ volatile("msr tpidrro_el0,xzr":::"memory");   /* 先摘掉指向合成 TCB 的 guest TP，再释放，防释放后经 tp 误访问 */
#else
 /* OHOS/Huawei 内核：EL0 写 tpidrro_el0 一律 SIGILL（见下方 runtime_thread_init 同款注释）。
    且真机 tpidrro_el0 恒为 0、合成 TCB 并不经该寄存器安装（runtime_thread_init），此处无需也无法清。 */
#endif
 free(e->dummy);free(e->tlr);free(e->tls);free(e->tcb);free(e);
}
void runtime_thread_init(void) {
 need(!pthread_getspecific(environment_key),"duplicate guest thread environment");
 ThreadEnvironment *e=calloc(1,sizeof(*e));need(e!=NULL,"thread environment");
 e->tls=calloc(1,8192);e->tlr=calloc(1,0x200);e->dummy=calloc(1,0x400);
 need(e->tls&&e->tlr&&e->dummy,"thread environment allocation");
 /* Faults and emulated instructions are handled off the guest stack, which can be as small as 4 KiB. */
 e->signal_stack=malloc(SIGNAL_STACK_SIZE);need(e->signal_stack!=NULL,"signal stack allocation");
 stack_t ss={.ss_sp=e->signal_stack,.ss_size=SIGNAL_STACK_SIZE,.ss_flags=0};need(sigaltstack(&ss,NULL)==0,"install signal stack");memcpy((uint8_t *)e->tlr+0x1f8,&e->dummy,8);
 need(pthread_setspecific(environment_key,e)==0&&pthread_setspecific(runtime_keys[0],NULL)==0,"thread ownership");
 need(pthread_setspecific(runtime_keys[1],e->tls)==0&&pthread_setspecific(runtime_keys[2],e->tlr)==0&&pthread_setspecific(runtime_keys[3],(void *)runtime_gate)==0,"thread slots");
 uintptr_t tp;__asm__ volatile("mrs %0,tpidrro_el0":"=r"(tp));
 /* OHOS/musl：pthread TSD 不在 tp+key*8（那是 Darwin 布局）。校验降级为观测：
    guest 侧 tp+off 直读会得到 musl struct pthread 的原生字段（含 dtv/self 等），
    线程垫片是下一个移植任务；先放行以探明 nn::init::Start 后的链路。 */
#ifdef __MUSL__
 /* OHOS/musl：pthread TSD 不在 tp+key*8（那是 Darwin 布局），且真机 tpidrro_el0=0，
    游戏读 [tp+0x120] 即 SIGSEGV。合成 1024 字节 TCB 充当 guest TP：
    槽位与上面 Darwin 侧 pthread_setspecific 完全同值（key*8），所以 entry.S 的 runtime_gate、
    ipc.c 的 pthread_getspecific 查询两侧取到同一份 tls/tlr/gate。 */
 e->tcb=calloc(1,0x400);need(e->tcb!=NULL,"thread tcb");
 {uint8_t *t=e->tcb;
  *(void**)(t+runtime_keys[0]*8)=NULL;
  *(void**)(t+runtime_keys[1]*8)=e->tls;
  *(void**)(t+runtime_keys[2]*8)=e->tlr;
  *(void**)(t+runtime_keys[3]*8)=(void*)runtime_gate;}
 /* OHOS 实测：EL0 写 tpidrro_el0 被 SIGILL（Huawei 内核细粒度陷阱），寄存器路线死路。
    改走 x18：合成 TCB 常驻 x18，模块 text 的 mrs Xn,tpidrro_el0 在 map 时补丁为 mov Xn,x18。 */
 fprintf(stderr,"[totk] note: tcb ready %p slots=%llu/%llu/%llu (x18 scheme)\n",e->tcb,(unsigned long long)(runtime_keys[1]*8),(unsigned long long)(runtime_keys[2]*8),(unsigned long long)(runtime_keys[3]*8));
#else
 need((tp&7)==0,"unaligned raw Darwin TSD incompatible with patches");
 for(unsigned i=0;i<4;i++){void *raw;memcpy(&raw,(void *)(tp+runtime_keys[i]*8),8);need(raw==pthread_getspecific(runtime_keys[i]),"Darwin TSD layout");}
#endif
}
void *runtime_current_tcb(void) {
 ThreadEnvironment *e=pthread_getspecific(environment_key);
 return e?e->tcb:NULL;
}
static void thread_cleanup(void) {
 ThreadEnvironment *e=pthread_getspecific(environment_key);pthread_setspecific(environment_key,NULL);
 for(unsigned i=0;i<4;i++)pthread_setspecific(runtime_keys[i],NULL);environment_destroy(e);
}
uint64_t runtime_now_ns(void) {mach_timebase_info_data_t tb;mach_timebase_info(&tb);return (uint64_t)((__uint128_t)mach_absolute_time()*tb.numer/tb.denom);}
void runtime_dispatch(uint64_t ret,uint64_t *regs) {
 for(unsigned i=0;i<NM;i++)for(unsigned j=0;j<modules[i].ngate;j++) {
  const Gate *g=&modules[i].gates[j];if((uintptr_t)modules[i].base+g->ret!=ret)continue;
  if(g->timer){mach_timebase_info_data_t tb;mach_timebase_info(&tb);__uint128_t ns=(__uint128_t)mach_absolute_time()*tb.numer/tb.denom;
   need(g->arg<31&&g->arg!=18,"timer target register");regs[g->arg]=(uint64_t)(ns*12/625);__atomic_fetch_add(&timer_calls,1,__ATOMIC_RELAXED);return;}
  __atomic_fetch_add(&svc_calls,1,__ATOMIC_RELAXED);runtime_svc(g->arg,regs,modules[i].name,g->original);return;
 }
 runtime_fail("unknown gate return address");
}
/* Signal diagnostics use only stack buffers + write; no guest continuation. */
__thread sigjmp_buf *runtime_fault_guard;
static void signal_hex(const char *label,uint64_t value) {
 char b[128];size_t n=0;while(*label)b[n++]=*label++;b[n++]='0';b[n++]='x';
 for(int i=15;i>=0;i--)b[n++]="0123456789abcdef"[(value>>(i*4))&15];b[n++]='\n';write(2,b,n);
}
/* crash_1031 毒化源判定查询（定义在 services.c / gfx_bridge.c，两侧构建均无条件提供）：
   只读+算术、无锁，crash handler 在信号栈上直查最近栈迁移与 nvn 池范围，自动指认 H1/H2。 */
int runtime_stack_move_hit(uint64_t addr,uint64_t *lo,uint64_t *hi);
int runtime_nvn_pool_hit(uint64_t addr,uint64_t *lo,uint64_t *hi,unsigned *flags_out);
/* CTR_EL0 for 128-byte host cache lines: DminLine=IminLine=5 (32 words), ERG=CWG=5, PIPT I-cache, IDC/DIC clear. */
#define HOST_CTR_EL0 0x8555c005ULL
static void crash(int num,siginfo_t *info,void *context) {
 ucontext_t *u=context;
#ifdef __MUSL__
 /* 单行紧凑转储先落一笔：processdump 竞速会随机截断后续长转储，这一行必须最先出。
    round@1031：pc/lr 现场归属（客体模块 or 宿主 so 基址）一并带上，宿主段可对本地 addr2line 对账 */
 {char b[384],pd[96],ld[96];runtime_describe_address(u->uc_mcontext.pc,pd,sizeof pd);runtime_describe_address(u->uc_mcontext.regs[30],ld,sizeof ld);
  Dl_info di;const char *so="?";uint64_t fb=0;
  if(dladdr((void *)(uintptr_t)u->uc_mcontext.pc,&di)&&di.dli_fname){const char *s=strrchr(di.dli_fname,'/');so=s?s+1:di.dli_fname;fb=(uint64_t)(uintptr_t)di.dli_fbase;}
  int n=snprintf(b,sizeof b,"[totk] CRASH sig=%d pc=%p[%s] host=%s@0x%llx lr=%p[%s] sp=%p fault=%p x18=%p\n",
   num,(void *)u->uc_mcontext.pc,pd,so,(unsigned long long)fb,(void *)u->uc_mcontext.regs[30],ld,(void *)u->uc_mcontext.sp,
   info->si_addr,(void *)u->uc_mcontext.regs[18]);write(2,b,n);}
#endif
#ifdef __MUSL__
 /* 毒化源自动指认（crash_1031 §5.1）：x0..x28+sp+fault 共 31 值（下标 29=sp、30=fault），每个像
    指针的值比对最近 32 次栈迁移 src/dst（services.c）与 256 条 nvn 池账本（gfx_bridge.c），均含
    ±0x4000 部分页余量——任一命中即现场指认 H1(stack-move 拷回窗)/H2(nvn 池越界)。
    signal_hex/write 风格，无 malloc/printf；两查询只读+算术、无锁 async-signal-safe。
    指针下限取 0x100000000(2^32) 而非既有 c22 段的 0x10000000000(2^40)：客体区全部落在
    [LOW_SEARCH_FROM=0x300000000, 2^39) 内，x0=0x6f497abda8 这类待指认客体堆指针低于 2^40，
    用 2^40 下限会把全部可命中值滤掉、诊断失效。 */
 {
  uint64_t pv[31];unsigned pn=0;
  for(int _i=0;_i<29;_i++)pv[pn++]=(uint64_t)u->uc_mcontext.regs[_i];
  pv[pn++]=(uint64_t)u->uc_mcontext.sp;pv[pn++]=(uintptr_t)info->si_addr;
  for(unsigned _i=0;_i<pn;_i++){uint64_t v=pv[_i];
   if(v<0x100000000ULL)continue;uint64_t lo,hi;unsigned fl;
   if(runtime_stack_move_hit(v,&lo,&hi)){signal_hex("[totk] poison reg=",_i);signal_hex(" val=",v);signal_hex(" stack-move src=",lo);signal_hex("-",hi);}
   if(runtime_nvn_pool_hit(v,&lo,&hi,&fl)){signal_hex("[totk] poison reg=",_i);signal_hex(" val=",v);signal_hex(" pool=",lo);signal_hex("-",hi);signal_hex(" flags=",(uint64_t)fl);}}
  for(int _d=-1;_d<=1;_d++){uint64_t v=(uintptr_t)info->si_addr+(uint64_t)(int64_t)_d*0x4000;   /* fault 本体与 ±16KB 再各比一次：块头 size 毒化时 fault 常在邻近堆页/截断野指针 */
   if(v<0x100000000ULL)continue;uint64_t lo,hi;unsigned fl;
   if(runtime_stack_move_hit(v,&lo,&hi)){signal_hex("[totk] poison fault=",v);signal_hex(" stack-move src=",lo);signal_hex("-",hi);}
   if(runtime_nvn_pool_hit(v,&lo,&hi,&fl)){signal_hex("[totk] poison fault=",v);signal_hex(" pool=",lo);signal_hex("-",hi);signal_hex(" flags=",(uint64_t)fl);}}
 }
#endif
#ifdef __MUSL__
 /* 统一寄存器镜像：musl aarch64 mcontext.regs[0..30]/sp/pc */
 struct { uint64_t x[29], fp, lr, sp, pc, esr; } mc_img;
 for(int _i=0;_i<29;_i++) mc_img.x[_i]=u->uc_mcontext.regs[_i];
 mc_img.fp=u->uc_mcontext.regs[29]; mc_img.lr=u->uc_mcontext.regs[30];
 mc_img.sp=u->uc_mcontext.sp; mc_img.pc=u->uc_mcontext.pc; mc_img.esr=0;
#else
 struct { uint64_t x[29], fp, lr, sp, pc, esr; } mc_img;
#endif
 /* (The TotK fault workaround for an invalid optional menu reference is TotK-only and not carried over.) */
 /* EL0 cache maintenance that Darwin traps but Horizon allows: emulate exactly two encodings (SDK only). */
#ifdef __MUSL__   /* OHOS: aarch64 Linux 用户态可直接执行 mrs CTR_EL0/dc civac（内核不 trap），无需指令模拟 */
 if((num==SIGBUS||num==SIGSEGV)&&runtime_fault_guard){sigjmp_buf *g=runtime_fault_guard;runtime_fault_guard=NULL;siglongjmp(*g,1);}
 if(runtime_gfx_fault(info->si_addr,0,context))return;   /* 读写判定周末用页权限细化 */
 uint64_t pc=mc_img.pc,fp=mc_img.fp;
#else
 if(num==SIGILL){uint32_t insn=*(const uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)u->uc_mcontext->__ss.__pc;unsigned rt=insn&31;
  if((insn&~31u)==0xd53b0020u){if(rt!=31)u->uc_mcontext->__ss.__x[rt]=HOST_CTR_EL0;u->uc_mcontext->__ss.__pc+=4;return;}   /* mrs Xt, CTR_EL0 */
  if((insn&~31u)==0xd50b7e20u){uintptr_t a=rt==31?0:(uintptr_t)u->uc_mcontext->__ss.__x[rt];sys_dcache_flush((void *)(a&~(uintptr_t)127),128);u->uc_mcontext->__ss.__pc+=4;return;}   /* dc civac, Xt */
 }
 if((num==SIGBUS||num==SIGSEGV)&&runtime_fault_guard){sigjmp_buf *g=runtime_fault_guard;runtime_fault_guard=NULL;siglongjmp(*g,1);}   /* guarded host read of guest memory (uniform snapshot copies) */
 if(runtime_gfx_fault(info->si_addr,(u->uc_mcontext->__es.__esr>>6)&1,context))return;uint64_t pc=u->uc_mcontext->__ss.__pc,fp=u->uc_mcontext->__ss.__fp;
 for(int _i=0;_i<29;_i++) mc_img.x[_i]=u->uc_mcontext->__ss.__x[_i];
 mc_img.fp=arm_thread_state64_get_fp(u->uc_mcontext->__ss); mc_img.lr=arm_thread_state64_get_lr(u->uc_mcontext->__ss);
 mc_img.sp=u->uc_mcontext->__ss.__sp; mc_img.pc=arm_thread_state64_get_pc(u->uc_mcontext->__ss); mc_img.esr=u->uc_mcontext->__es.__esr;
#endif
 signal_hex("[totk] signal=",num);signal_hex("fault=",(uintptr_t)info->si_addr);signal_hex("esr=",mc_img.esr);
 {mach_vm_address_t ra=(uintptr_t)info->si_addr;mach_vm_size_t rs=0;vm_region_basic_info_data_64_t ri;mach_msg_type_number_t rc=VM_REGION_BASIC_INFO_COUNT_64;mach_port_t ro=0;
  if(mach_vm_region(mach_task_self(),&ra,&rs,VM_REGION_BASIC_INFO_64,(vm_region_info_t)&ri,&rc,&ro)==KERN_SUCCESS){signal_hex("region=",ra);signal_hex("region size=",rs);signal_hex("region prot=",(uint64_t)ri.protection|((uint64_t)ri.max_protection<<8));}}signal_hex("pc=",pc);signal_hex("lr=",mc_img.lr);signal_hex("fp=",fp);
```

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/host/motion_fusion.c`:

```c
/* Six-axis states from the Mac controller's motion samples (2026-10-17; fed by runtime/gamepad_feedback.m, read by the
   game through runtime/hid_feedback.c, only with TOTK_GYRO=1).
   Input per sample: acceleration in G including gravity and rotation rate in rad/s, in the controller's frame (GCMotion:
   x to the right, y toward the top edge, z out of the face; lying face up it reads z = -1 G). That is the Switch's
   six-axis frame, so by default nothing is remapped; TOTK_GYRO_AXES="-x,y,-z" style remaps (a reflection also flips the
   rotation's sense). Output per sample, like the Switch: acceleration in G, angular velocity in revolutions per second,
   angle = the integrated revolutions per axis, direction = the controller's three axes in a reference frame whose z is
   up. The orientation is integrated from the gyro and, while the controller is not being accelerated (|a| within 15 %
   of 1 G), pulled toward the measured gravity (Mahony, gain 0.5/s: about 2 s), as the Switch's sensor fusion does; yaw
   has no reference and drifts with the gyro's bias (well under a degree a minute on a DualSense at rest). The newest 64
   samples are kept; the game reads up to 16, newest first, and goes by their sampling numbers.
   Dead zone (2026-10-19): rotation slower than TOTK_GYRO_DEADZONE deg/s counts as none, and the dead zone is taken off
   faster rotation, so the rate never jumps at its edge. Default 0, except 1.2 while a controller's motion comes from its
   HID reports (runtime_motion_deadzone_default, gamepad_feedback.m): an 8BitDo Pro Controller lying on the desk read
   0.83 deg/s on average (bias 0.05, 0.73, 0.38 deg/s after its factory calibration), at most 1.07 deg/s, in 616 samples,
   enough for the aim to creep; a DualSense through GameController needs none.
   Mouse mode (Mac, key 7: runtime/gamepad.m, runtime/mouse_look.h): the mouse takes the sensor over. Its samples come in
   this frame already (runtime_motion_feed_mouse: no TOTK_GYRO_AXES remap, no dead zone), the controller's are dropped
   meanwhile, and with mouse mode off the controller has it back (from a fresh start). */
#include "runtime.h"
#include <math.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

enum { MOTION_RING = 64 };
static pthread_mutex_t lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static RuntimeMotionState ring[MOTION_RING];
static uint64_t produced, last_ns, logged, log_at, reads_logged;
static double R[3][3];          /* controller -> reference; row i = reference axis i in controller coordinates */
static double angle[3];
static int restart = 1, live;
static int from[3] = {0, 1, 2};
static double sign[3] = {1, 1, 1}, det = 1;
static double deadzone = -1;   /* rad/s; -1 until read from TOTK_GYRO_DEADZONE */
static double deadzone_default;   /* deg/s, when TOTK_GYRO_DEADZONE is unset */
static int mouse_owns, controller_live;

/* TOTK_GYRO_AXES: reference axis i = sign * controller axis from[i]. 0 if unset, -1 if malformed. */
int runtime_motion_axes(const char *spec) {
    int f[3], used[3] = {0}; double s[3], parity = 1; const char *p = spec;
    if (!spec) return 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        s[i] = 1; if (*p == '-') { s[i] = -1; p++; } else if (*p == '+') p++;
        if (*p < 'x' || *p > 'z' || used[*p - 'x']) return -1;
        f[i] = *p - 'x'; used[f[i]] = 1; p++;
        if (i < 2 && *p++ != ',') return -1;
    }
    if (*p) return -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) for (int j = i + 1; j < 3; j++) if (f[i] > f[j]) parity = -parity;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) { from[i] = f[i]; sign[i] = s[i]; }
    det = parity * s[0] * s[1] * s[2];
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
    return 1;
}
static double norm3(const double v[3]) { return sqrt(v[0] * v[0] + v[1] * v[1] + v[2] * v[2]); }
static void cross3(const double a[3], const double b[3], double out[3]) {
    out[0] = a[1] * b[2] - a[2] * b[1]; out[1] = a[2] * b[0] - a[0] * b[2]; out[2] = a[0] * b[1] - a[1] * b[0];
}
static void orthonormalize(void) {   /* rows, from the up row (the one the gravity correction keeps right) */
    double n = norm3(R[2]); for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) R[2][j] /= n;
    double d = R[0][0] * R[2][0] + R[0][1] * R[2][1] + R[0][2] * R[2][2];
    for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) R[0][j] -= d * R[2][j];
    n = norm3(R[0]); for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) R[0][j] /= n;
    cross3(R[2], R[0], R[1]);
}
/* A fresh orientation: z up against the measured gravity, x as close to the controller's x as that allows. */
static void align_to(const double acc[3]) {
    double n = norm3(acc), up[3] = {0, 0, 1}, x[3] = {1, 0, 0};
    if (n > 0.5) for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) up[j] = -acc[j] / n;
    if (fabs(up[0]) > 0.9) { x[0] = 0; x[1] = 1; }
    memcpy(R[2], up, sizeof up); memcpy(R[0], x, sizeof x); orthonormalize();
}
static void integrate(const double gyro[3], const double acc[3], double dt) {
    double w[3] = {gyro[0], gyro[1], gyro[2]}, n = norm3(acc);
    if (fabs(n - 1) < 0.15) {   /* not being accelerated: turn the estimated down toward the measured one */
        const double kp = 0.5;
        double measured[3] = {acc[0] / n, acc[1] / n, acc[2] / n}, estimated[3] = {-R[2][0], -R[2][1], -R[2][2]}, e[3];
        cross3(measured, estimated, e);
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) w[j] += kp * e[j];
    }
    double rate = norm3(w), theta = rate * dt;
    if (theta < 1e-12) return;
    double k[3] = {w[0] / rate, w[1] / rate, w[2] / rate}, s = sin(theta), c = 1 - cos(theta);
    double K[3][3] = {{0, -k[2], k[1]}, {k[2], 0, -k[0]}, {-k[1], k[0], 0}}, E[3][3], out[3][3];
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) {
        double kk = 0; for (int m = 0; m < 3; m++) kk += K[i][m] * K[m][j];
        E[i][j] = (i == j) + s * K[i][j] + c * kk;
    }
    static int negative = -1; if (negative < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_PROBE_NEGATIVE"); negative = e && atoi(e) == 20; }
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) {   /* body-frame rate: R * E (probe negative 20: E * R, a reference-frame rate) */
        double v = 0; for (int m = 0; m < 3; m++) v += negative ? E[i][m] * R[m][j] : R[i][m] * E[m][j];
        out[i][j] = v;
    }
    memcpy(R, out, sizeof R); orthonormalize();
}
static void feed_locked(const double acc[3], const double gyro[3], uint64_t now);
void runtime_motion_feed(const double raw_acc[3], const double raw_gyro[3], uint64_t now) {
    double acc[3], gyro[3];
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) { acc[i] = sign[i] * raw_acc[from[i]]; gyro[i] = det * sign[i] * raw_gyro[from[i]]; }
    if (deadzone < 0) {
        const char *e = getenv("TOTK_GYRO_DEADZONE"); double v = deadzone_default;
        if (e) { char *end; v = strtod(e, &end); if (end == e || *end || !(v >= 0) || v > 20) runtime_fail("TOTK_GYRO_DEADZONE must be a number of degrees a second in [0, 20]"); }
        deadzone = v * M_PI / 180;
        if (e) fprintf(stderr, "[gyro] dead zone %.2f deg/s (TOTK_GYRO_DEADZONE)\n", v);
    }
    double rate = norm3(gyro), keep = rate > deadzone ? (rate - deadzone) / rate : 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) gyro[i] *= keep;
    if (mouse_owns) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock); return; }
    feed_locked(acc, gyro, now);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
}
/* One sample in the reference controller frame (lock held). */
static void feed_locked(const double acc[3], const double gyro[3], uint64_t now) {
    double dt = last_ns && now > last_ns ? (now - last_ns) / 1e9 : 0.004;
    if (dt > 0.05) dt = 0.004;   /* a gap (sensors were off, the app was in the background): no integration across it */
    last_ns = now; live = 1;
    if (restart) { align_to(acc); memset(angle, 0, sizeof angle); restart = 0; }
    else integrate(gyro, acc, dt);
    RuntimeMotionState *s = &ring[produced % MOTION_RING];
    *s = (RuntimeMotionState){.sampling = produced + 1, .delta_ns = (uint64_t)(dt * 1e9)};
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        double rps = gyro[i] / (2 * M_PI); angle[i] += rps * dt;
        s->acc[i] = (float)acc[i]; s->gyro[i] = (float)rps; s->angle[i] = (float)angle[i];
        for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) s->dir[i * 3 + j] = (float)R[j][i];   /* direction i = controller axis i in the reference frame */
    }
    produced++;
    if (!log_at) log_at = now;
    if (now - log_at >= 30000000000ull) {
        uint64_t values, reads; runtime_hid_feedback_stats(&values, &reads);
        fprintf(stderr, "[gyro] last 30 s: %llu samples (%.0f a second), the game read the states %llu times; now acc (%+.2f %+.2f %+.2f) G, gyro (%+.3f %+.3f %+.3f) rev/s\n",
                (unsigned long long)(produced - logged), (produced - logged) / ((now - log_at) / 1e9), (unsigned long long)(reads - reads_logged),
                s->acc[0], s->acc[1], s->acc[2], s->gyro[0], s->gyro[1], s->gyro[2]);
        logged = produced; reads_logged = reads; log_at = now;
    }
}
void runtime_motion_feed_mouse(const double acc[3], const double gyro[3], uint64_t now) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
    if (mouse_owns) feed_locked(acc, gyro, now);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
}
int runtime_motion_read(RuntimeMotionState *out, int max) {
    if (max <= 0) return 0;
    int n = 0;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
    if (live && runtime_now_ns() - last_ns < 200000000ull) {   /* no sample for 200 ms: no motion */
        uint64_t have = produced < MOTION_RING ? produced : MOTION_RING;
        n = (int)(have < (uint64_t)max ? have : (uint64_t)max);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) out[i] = ring[(produced - 1 - (uint64_t)i) % MOTION_RING];
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
    return n;
}
void runtime_motion_start(void) { pthread_mutex_lock(&lock); restart = 1; pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock); }
/* The dead zone in deg/s when TOTK_GYRO_DEADZONE is unset: the HID reader sets 1.2, a GameController controller 0. */
void runtime_motion_deadzone_default(double deg) { pthread_mutex_lock(&lock); deadzone_default = deg; deadzone = -1; pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock); }
void runtime_motion_live(int on) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock); controller_live = on; live = on || mouse_owns; if (on && !mouse_owns) restart = 1; pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
}
void runtime_motion_mouse(int on) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock); mouse_owns = on; live = on || controller_live; restart = 1; last_ns = 0; pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
}
```

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/host/mouse_look.h`:

```h
/* Mouse movement as the right stick and as the controller's gyro (Mac mouse mode, key 7: runtime/gamepad.m).
   The idea is yuzu's "mouse panning" (written anew here, no code taken): every movement adds to a held stick deflection;
   a tick every 10 ms (MOUSE_LOOK_TICK_NS) shows the deflection to the game and then lets it decay, so the camera keeps
   turning while the mouse moves and settles smoothly when it stops, whatever the mouse's report rate and the game's
   frame rate. The decay grows with the deflection (1 - length^2 * decay%), but is at least min_decay% a tick; the held
   length is cut to 1.5 (it may run past the stick's edge, which makes a steady turn easier to hold) and shown at most 1.
   A movement that leaves a deflection shorter than counterweight% is lifted to it, past the game's own stick dead zone.
   Units: one point of mouse movement (AppKit's deltaX / deltaY; deltaY grows downwards) moves the stick by
   sensitivity / 1000 of its range: at the default 50, 20 points is a full deflection.
   The same movement also turns a controller lying face up (x right, y top edge, z out of the face: runtime/
   motion_fusion.c's frame): mouse right turns it clockwise seen from above (-z), mouse up tilts its top edge up (+x);
   per tick, sensitivity / 1000 * 2.5 revolutions a second per point, at most 2 revolutions a second. The gravity it
   reports follows the pitch (stopped at 80 degrees), so the sensor fusion keeps the aim where the mouse put it.
   Plain C, no clock and no lock: the caller ticks it (gamepad.m, one timer while mouse mode is on) and serializes the
   calls; tests/mouse_look/probe.c covers it. */
#pragma once
#include <math.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

enum { MOUSE_LOOK_TICK_NS = 10000000 };
#define MOUSE_LOOK_MAX_LENGTH 1.5
#define MOUSE_LOOK_GYRO_GAIN 2.5        /* revolutions a second, per unit of stick movement in one tick */
#define MOUSE_LOOK_MAX_REV_S 2.0
#define MOUSE_LOOK_MAX_PITCH (80 * M_PI / 180)

typedef struct { int sensitivity, invert_y, counterweight, decay, min_decay; } MouseLookSettings;
typedef struct { double x, y; double pitch_move, yaw_move; double pitch; } MouseLook;   /* stick in units of its range */

/* From the environment's text (NULL or out of range: the default). sensitivity 1-100 (50), invert_y 0/1 (0),
   counterweight / decay / min_decay 0-100 (20, 18, 6). */
static inline int mouse_look_setting(const char *text, int lo, int hi, int fallback) {
    if (!text || !*text) return fallback;
    char *end; long v = strtol(text, &end, 10);
    return *end || v < lo || v > hi ? fallback : (int)v;
}
static inline MouseLookSettings mouse_look_settings(const char *sensitivity, const char *invert_y, const char *counterweight,
                                                     const char *decay, const char *min_decay) {
    return (MouseLookSettings){
        .sensitivity = mouse_look_setting(sensitivity, 1, 100, 50), .invert_y = mouse_look_setting(invert_y, 0, 1, 0),
        .counterweight = mouse_look_setting(counterweight, 0, 100, 20), .decay = mouse_look_setting(decay, 0, 100, 18),
        .min_decay = mouse_look_setting(min_decay, 0, 100, 6)};
}

static inline void mouse_look_reset(MouseLook *m) { *m = (MouseLook){0}; }

static inline void mouse_look_move(MouseLook *m, double dx, double dy, const MouseLookSettings *s) {
    if (!isfinite(dx) || !isfinite(dy)) return;
    const double kx = s->sensitivity / 1000.0, ky = s->invert_y ? -kx : kx;
    m->x += dx * kx; m->y += dy * ky;
    m->yaw_move -= dx * kx; m->pitch_move -= dy * ky;
    const double length = hypot(m->x, m->y), least = s->counterweight / 100.0;
    if (length > 0 && length < least) { m->x *= least / length; m->y *= least / length; }
}

/* One tick: the stick to show (rx, ry in -32767..32767, up positive), the gyro in rad/s and the gravity in G for this
   tick (a controller lying face up reads z = -1 G); then the held deflection decays. */
static inline void mouse_look_tick(MouseLook *m, const MouseLookSettings *s, int32_t *rx, int32_t *ry, double gyro[3], double acc[3]) {
    double length = hypot(m->x, m->y);
    if (length > MOUSE_LOOK_MAX_LENGTH) { m->x *= MOUSE_LOOK_MAX_LENGTH / length; m->y *= MOUSE_LOOK_MAX_LENGTH / length; length = MOUSE_LOOK_MAX_LENGTH; }
    double ox = m->x, oy = -m->y, shown = hypot(ox, oy);
    if (shown > 1) { ox /= shown; oy /= shown; }
    *rx = (int32_t)lround(ox * 32767); *ry = (int32_t)lround(oy * 32767);
    const double c = length < 1 ? length : 1, decay = 1 - c * c * s->decay / 100.0, most = 1 - s->min_decay / 100.0;
    const double keep = decay < most ? decay : most;
    m->x *= keep > 0 ? keep : 0; m->y *= keep > 0 ? keep : 0;
    if (fabs(m->x) < 1e-6 && fabs(m->y) < 1e-6) m->x = m->y = 0;

    double pitch = m->pitch_move * MOUSE_LOOK_GYRO_GAIN, yaw = m->yaw_move * MOUSE_LOOK_GYRO_GAIN, rate = hypot(pitch, yaw);
    if (rate > MOUSE_LOOK_MAX_REV_S) { pitch *= MOUSE_LOOK_MAX_REV_S / rate; yaw *= MOUSE_LOOK_MAX_REV_S / rate; }
    m->pitch_move = m->yaw_move = 0;
    gyro[0] = pitch * 2 * M_PI; gyro[1] = 0; gyro[2] = yaw * 2 * M_PI;
    m->pitch += gyro[0] * (MOUSE_LOOK_TICK_NS / 1e9);
    if (m->pitch > MOUSE_LOOK_MAX_PITCH) m->pitch = MOUSE_LOOK_MAX_PITCH;
    if (m->pitch < -MOUSE_LOOK_MAX_PITCH) m->pitch = -MOUSE_LOOK_MAX_PITCH;
    acc[0] = 0; acc[1] = -sin(m->pitch); acc[2] = -cos(m->pitch);
}

```

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/host/movie_host.c`:

```c
/* movie::Decoder for VP9 video on the host with libvpx.
   TOTK's pre-rendered cutscenes (the .webm files in Event/Movie, 28 of them: VP9 profile 0, 1920x1080, 30 fps, video only) play through
   the SDK movie library in subsdk0, which is Android's MediaCodec over NVIDIA's NvMM. Its video decoder opens Tegra's
   NVDEC through nvdrv (NvMMLiteOpenVideo -> NvRmChannelOpen -> NvOsDrvOpen), which this port does not have, so the SDK
   aborted at the first cutscene (the blood moon at midnight).
   main imports the constructor and calls the 17 virtual methods through the vtable for movie::Decoder, whose slots are
   relocated by symbol name: overriding the names replaces the slots. A VP9 buffer-mode decoder (type 3, mode 1) built by
   the constructor is a host object, +0 the library's vtable and +8 a host Movie where the library keeps its DecoderImpl;
   every other decoder goes to the original code. Behaviour follows DecoderImpl (analysis/movie-decoder-impl-named.c):
   - output format 4 is packed NV12 (Y plane, then interleaved UV; stride = width), written into the client's Buffer;
   - input and output buffers are indices handed out FIFO, as MediaCodec does; input flag 4 / output flag 4 = end of stream;
   - client events {input available, output available, format changed, error} (DecoderEvents, 4 EventType pointers) are
     signalled with nn::os::SignalEvent; the game waits on the first three (main+0x240d570).
   Decoding is synchronous in SendInputBufferForDecode. While the game holds every output slot, inputs wait and are decoded
   when it releases one (ReleaseOutputBufferIndex).
   Pacing: the game shows one decoded frame per game frame (main+0x240266c draws the movie texture every frame and puts a
   new frame into it whenever one is queued), which plays a 30 fps movie at 30 fps only at the original 30 fps. At our
   60-100 fps a cutscene ran 3x too fast. So decoded frames are handed to the game when their presentation time is due,
   counted from the first frame (movie_host_tick, called at every present on the game's thread); in between the movie
   texture keeps the last frame. At most one frame is handed over per game frame (the game takes one per frame, so more
   would pile up in its own queue), and when the game falls behind (a loading hitch: ~15 fps for a few seconds under the
   blood moon) a frame more than 1.5 frame periods late is dropped if the next one is due too: the picture stays in time
   with the cutscene's sound instead of lagging and then running fast to catch up. TOTK_MOVIE_PACE=0 hands every frame
   over as soon as it is decoded.
   Odyssey (2026-10-22): its 44 movies (the .mp4 files in MovieData, 41 with an AAC track: the PlayGuide clips Cappy shows, the world postcards) are H.264
   (Baseline / Main / High, 480x272 to 640x360, 4-byte NAL lengths, most with B-frames). The game asks for decoder
   type 1 ("video/avc"), which aborted in NvMMLiteOpenBlock -> NvRmChannelOpen -> NvOsDrvOpen right after the skipped
   intro. Type 1 in buffer mode runs here on VideoToolbox: SPS / PPS come from the format's csd-0 / csd-1 or from the
   stream, samples may be Annex B or length-prefixed, and decoded pictures wait in `held` until they can leave in
   presentation order (AVC_REORDER pictures behind, all at end of stream). */

enum { ST_OK = 0, ST_ERROR = 0x1000, ST_NULL = 0x100b, ST_NOT_READY = 0x100c, ST_NO_OUTPUT = 0x100e, ST_NO_INPUT = 0x1011,
       ST_UNSUPPORTED = 0x2001, ST_NOT_CONFIGURED = 0x2002 };

static MovieGuest G; static int g_ready;
static int g_negative = -1;   /* probe-movie negative controls only: 1 = U and V swapped, 2 = no format-changed event */

static uint64_t now_ns(void);

    "_ZN5movie7Decoder24ReleaseOutputBufferIndexEi", "_ZN5movie7Decoder12GetLastErrorEv",
    "_ZN5movie7Decoder15GetOutputBufferEiPNS_6BufferEPNS_9MediaDataE", "_ZN5movie7Decoder21GetOutputBufferFormatEiPNS_9MediaDataE"};

#define LOG(...) do { fprintf(stderr, "[movie] " __VA_ARGS__); fputc('\n', stderr); } while (0)

static void need_symbol(void **slot, const char *name) {
    *slot = runtime_symbol(name);
    if (!*slot) { fprintf(stderr, "[movie] missing guest symbol %s\n", name); runtime_fail("movie decoder: guest symbol missing"); }

/* The guest functions are resolved the first time any entry runs (the modules are loaded and relocated by then). */
static void guest_init(void) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    if (!g_ready) {
        need_symbol((void **)&G.signal_event, "_ZN2nn2os11SignalEventEPNS0_9EventTypeE");
        need_symbol((void **)&G.buf_set_range, "_ZN5movie6Buffer8SetRangeEii");
        need_symbol((void **)&G.buf_set_data, "_ZN5movie6Buffer18SetDataAndCapacityEPvm");
        need_symbol((void **)&G.buf_base, "_ZNK5movie6Buffer4BaseEv");

void movie_host_set_guest(const MovieGuest *api) { pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock); G = *api; g_ready = 1; pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock); }

static Movie *find(const void *guest) {
    if (!g_ready) guest_init();
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock); Movie *m = NULL;
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_MOVIES; i++) if (g_movies[i] && g_movies[i]->guest == guest) m = g_movies[i];
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
    return m;
}

/* Events are signalled after the decoder's lock is released: the woken game thread calls straight back in. */
typedef struct { void *ev[8]; int n; } Signals;
static void note(Movie *m, Signals *s, int which) { if (m->events && m->events[which] && s->n < 8) s->ev[s->n++] = m->events[which]; }
static void fire(const Signals *s) { for (int i = 0; i < s->n; i++) G.signal_event(s->ev[i]); }

static int frame_bytes(const Movie *m) { return m->w * m->h + (m->w / 2) * (m->h / 2) * 2; }

/* I420 (libvpx) -> packed NV12: Y rows, then rows of interleaved U, V. */
static void to_nv12(const vpx_image_t *img, uint8_t *dst, int w, int h) {
    for (int y = 0; y < h; y++) memcpy(dst + (size_t)y * w, img->planes[VPX_PLANE_Y] + (size_t)y * img->stride[VPX_PLANE_Y], (size_t)w);
    uint8_t *uv = dst + (size_t)w * h;
    for (int y = 0; y < h / 2; y++) {
        const uint8_t *u = img->planes[VPX_PLANE_U] + (size_t)y * img->stride[VPX_PLANE_U];
        const uint8_t *v = img->planes[VPX_PLANE_V] + (size_t)y * img->stride[VPX_PLANE_V];
        uint8_t *o = uv + (size_t)y * w; int x = 0;
        if (negative() == 1) { const uint8_t *t = u; u = v; v = t; }
#if defined(__aarch64__)
        for (; x + 16 <= w / 2; x += 16) { uint8x16x2_t p = {{vld1q_u8(u + x), vld1q_u8(v + x)}}; vst2q_u8(o + 2 * x, p); }
#else
        for (; x + 16 <= w / 2; x += 16) { memcpy(o + 2 * x, u + x, 16); memcpy(o + 2 * x + 16, v + x, 16); }
#endif
        for (; x < w / 2; x++) { o[2 * x] = u[x]; o[2 * x + 1] = v[x]; }
    }
}
static int free_out(const Movie *m) { for (int i = 0; i < OUT_BUFS; i++) if (!m->out_held[i]) return i; return -1; }
static void push_ready(Movie *m, Signals *s, int slot, unsigned flags, int64_t time, int bytes) {
    m->out_held[slot] = 1; m->out_bytes[slot] = bytes;
    if (pace_on()) { m->decoded[m->ndecoded++] = (Ready){slot, flags, time}; return; }
    m->ready[m->nready++] = (Ready){slot, flags, time};
    note(m, s, EV_OUTPUT);
}
/* Host time a decoded frame is due (ns); end of stream is due as soon as it is first in line. */
static uint64_t due_at(Movie *m, const Ready *d) {
    int64_t ahead = d->time - m->pts0; if (ahead < 0) ahead = 0;
    return m->t0 + (uint64_t)ahead * 1000;
}
/* One game frame (a present): drop leading frames that are more than 1.5 frame periods late while the next one is due
   too, then hand over at most one due frame (end of stream right after the last frame). */
static void release_due(Movie *m, Signals *s, uint64_t now) {
    while (m->ndecoded > 1 && !(m->decoded[0].flags & FLAG_EOS) && !(m->decoded[1].flags & FLAG_EOS) && m->t0) {
        uint64_t due = due_at(m, &m->decoded[0]), next = due_at(m, &m->decoded[1]);
        if (now < next || now - due <= (next - due) * 3 / 2) break;
        m->out_held[m->decoded[0].index] = 0; m->dropped++;
        memmove(m->decoded, m->decoded + 1, (size_t)--m->ndecoded * sizeof m->decoded[0]);
    }
    if (!m->ndecoded) return;
    Ready d = m->decoded[0];
    if (!(d.flags & FLAG_EOS)) {
        if (!m->t0) { m->t0 = now; m->pts0 = d.time; }
        if (now < due_at(m, &d)) return;
    }
    memmove(m->decoded, m->decoded + 1, (size_t)--m->ndecoded * sizeof m->decoded[0]);
    m->ready[m->nready++] = d; note(m, s, EV_OUTPUT);
}
void movie_host_tick(void) {   /* lock order g_lock -> Movie.mu, as in destroy; events fire after both are released */
    Signals s = {0};
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_MOVIES; i++) {
        Movie *m = g_movies[i]; if (!m) continue;
        pthread_mutex_lock(&m->mu); if (m->started) release_due(m, &s, g_clock()); pthread_mutex_unlock(&m->mu);
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
    fire(&s);
}
/* ---- H.264 on VideoToolbox (Odyssey) ---- */
static void avc_drop_held(Movie *m) { for (int i = 0; i < m->nheld; i++) CVPixelBufferRelease(m->held[i].px); m->nheld = 0; }
static void avc_release(Movie *m) {
    if (m->vt) { VTDecompressionSessionWaitForAsynchronousFrames(m->vt); VTDecompressionSessionInvalidate(m->vt); CFRelease(m->vt); m->vt = NULL; }
    if (m->vfmt) { CFRelease(m->vfmt); m->vfmt = NULL; }
    avc_drop_held(m); free(m->sample); m->sample = NULL; m->nsample = m->sample_cap = 0;
}
static void avc_param(uint8_t *dst, size_t *n, const uint8_t *nal, size_t len, int *changed) {
    if (len > AVC_PARAM || (len == *n && !memcmp(dst, nal, len))) return;
    memcpy(dst, nal, len); *n = len; *changed = 1;
}
/* One NAL unit: parameter sets are kept for the format description, delimiters dropped, the rest appended to the sample
   as a 4-byte big-endian length and the unit (the layout VideoToolbox's AVC format description expects). */
static void avc_nal(Movie *m, const uint8_t *nal, size_t len) {
    if (!len) return;
    int type = nal[0] & 0x1f;
    if (type == 7) { avc_param(m->sps, &m->nsps, nal, len, &m->params_new); return; }
    if (type == 8) { avc_param(m->pps, &m->npps, nal, len, &m->params_new); return; }
    if (type == 9) return;
    if (m->nsample + 4 + len > m->sample_cap) {
        size_t cap = (m->nsample + 4 + len) * 2; uint8_t *s = realloc(m->sample, cap);
        if (!s) runtime_fail("movie H.264 sample buffer"); m->sample = s; m->sample_cap = cap;
    }
    uint8_t *o = m->sample + m->nsample;
    o[0] = (uint8_t)(len >> 24); o[1] = (uint8_t)(len >> 16); o[2] = (uint8_t)(len >> 8); o[3] = (uint8_t)len;
    memcpy(o + 4, nal, len); m->nsample += 4 + len;
}
/* Length-prefixed when 4-byte lengths chain exactly to the end, otherwise Annex B (start codes). */
static void avc_parse(Movie *m, const uint8_t *d, size_t n) {
    size_t off = 0;
    while (off + 4 <= n) {
        size_t len = (size_t)d[off] << 24 | (size_t)d[off + 1] << 16 | (size_t)d[off + 2] << 8 | d[off + 3];
        if (!len || len > n - off - 4 || d[off + 4] & 0x80) break;
        off += 4 + len;
    }
    if (off == n && n) {
        for (off = 0; off < n;) { size_t len = (size_t)d[off] << 24 | (size_t)d[off + 1] << 16 | (size_t)d[off + 2] << 8 | d[off + 3]; avc_nal(m, d + off + 4, len); off += 4 + len; }
        return;
    }
    size_t start = SIZE_MAX;
    for (size_t i = 0; i + 3 <= n; i++) {
        if (d[i] || d[i + 1] || d[i + 2] != 1) continue;
        if (start != SIZE_MAX) { size_t end = i; while (end > start && !d[end - 1]) end--; avc_nal(m, d + start, end - start); }
        start = i + 3; i += 2;
    }
    if (start != SIZE_MAX && start < n) avc_nal(m, d + start, n - start);
}
/* csd-0 / csd-1 as an Android extractor gives them (Annex B parameter sets), or an avcC record. */
static void avc_csd(Movie *m, const uint8_t *d, size_t n) {
    if (n > 7 && d[0] == 1) {
        size_t off = 6; int nsps = d[5] & 0x1f;
        for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
            int count = k ? (off < n ? d[off++] : 0) : nsps;
            for (int i = 0; i < count && off + 2 <= n; i++) {
                size_t len = (size_t)d[off] << 8 | d[off + 1]; off += 2;
                if (len > n - off) return;
                avc_nal(m, d + off, len); off += len;
            }
        }
        return;
    }
    avc_parse(m, d, n);
}
static void avc_output(void *refcon, void *frame, OSStatus st, VTDecodeInfoFlags flags, CVImageBufferRef img, CMTime pts, CMTime dur) {
    (void)frame; (void)flags; (void)dur;
    Movie *m = refcon;
    if (st != noErr || !img) { if (++m->errors <= 4) LOG("【红】H.264 picture not decoded (VideoToolbox %d)", (int)st); return; }
    if (m->nheld == AVC_HELD) { if (++m->errors <= 4) LOG("【红】H.264 reorder queue full: picture dropped"); return; }
    m->held[m->nheld++] = (Held){CVPixelBufferRetain(img), pts.value};
}
static int avc_session(Movie *m) {
    if (!m->params_new && m->vt) return 1;
    if (!m->nsps || !m->npps) return 0;
    if (m->vt) { VTDecompressionSessionWaitForAsynchronousFrames(m->vt); VTDecompressionSessionInvalidate(m->vt); CFRelease(m->vt); m->vt = NULL; }
    if (m->vfmt) { CFRelease(m->vfmt); m->vfmt = NULL; }
    const uint8_t *sets[2] = {m->sps, m->pps}; const size_t sizes[2] = {m->nsps, m->npps};
    OSStatus st = CMVideoFormatDescriptionCreateFromH264ParameterSets(kCFAllocatorDefault, 2, sets, sizes, 4, &m->vfmt);
    if (st != noErr) { LOG("【红】H.264 parameter sets rejected by CoreMedia (%d)", (int)st); return 0; }
    int fmt = kCVPixelFormatType_420YpCbCr8BiPlanarVideoRange;
    CFNumberRef pf = CFNumberCreate(NULL, kCFNumberIntType, &fmt);
    const void *keys[] = {kCVPixelBufferPixelFormatTypeKey}, *vals[] = {pf};
    CFDictionaryRef attrs = CFDictionaryCreate(NULL, keys, vals, 1, &kCFTypeDictionaryKeyCallBacks, &kCFTypeDictionaryValueCallBacks);
    VTDecompressionOutputCallbackRecord cb = {avc_output, m};
    st = VTDecompressionSessionCreate(kCFAllocatorDefault, m->vfmt, NULL, attrs, &cb, &m->vt);
    CFRelease(attrs); CFRelease(pf);
    if (st != noErr) { LOG("【红】VideoToolbox H.264 session not created (%d)", (int)st); m->vt = NULL; return 0; }
    CMVideoDimensions dim = CMVideoFormatDescriptionGetDimensions(m->vfmt);
    LOG("VideoToolbox H.264 session %dx%d (configured %dx%d)", dim.width, dim.height, m->w, m->h);
    m->params_new = 0; return 1;
}
/* VideoToolbox NV12 picture -> packed NV12 at the configured size (rows / columns beyond the picture left black). */
static void px_to_nv12(CVPixelBufferRef px, uint8_t *dst, int w, int h) {
    CVPixelBufferLockBaseAddress(px, kCVPixelBufferLock_ReadOnly);
    int pw = (int)CVPixelBufferGetWidthOfPlane(px, 0), ph = (int)CVPixelBufferGetHeightOfPlane(px, 0);
    int cw = pw < w ? pw : w, ch = ph < h ? ph : h;
    if (cw < w || ch < h) { memset(dst, 16, (size_t)w * h); memset(dst + (size_t)w * h, 128, (size_t)w * (h / 2)); }
    const uint8_t *y = CVPixelBufferGetBaseAddressOfPlane(px, 0), *uv = CVPixelBufferGetBaseAddressOfPlane(px, 1);
    size_t ys = CVPixelBufferGetBytesPerRowOfPlane(px, 0), uvs = CVPixelBufferGetBytesPerRowOfPlane(px, 1);
    for (int r = 0; r < ch; r++) memcpy(dst + (size_t)r * w, y + r * ys, (size_t)cw);
    uint8_t *o = dst + (size_t)w * h;
    for (int r = 0; r < ch / 2; r++) memcpy(o + (size_t)r * w, uv + r * uvs, (size_t)(cw & ~1));
    CVPixelBufferUnlockBaseAddress(px, kCVPixelBufferLock_ReadOnly);
}
/* Hand held pictures over in presentation order while more than `keep` are held and output slots are free. */
static void avc_emit(Movie *m, Signals *s, int keep) {
    while (m->nheld > keep) {
        int slot = free_out(m); if (slot < 0) return;
        int first = 0; for (int i = 1; i < m->nheld; i++) if (m->held[i].time < m->held[first].time) first = i;
        Held h = m->held[first]; m->held[first] = m->held[--m->nheld];
        if (!m->format_sent) { m->format_sent = 1; if (negative() != 2) note(m, s, EV_FORMAT); }
        px_to_nv12(h.px, m->out[slot], m->w, m->h); CVPixelBufferRelease(h.px);
        push_ready(m, s, slot, 0, h.time, frame_bytes(m)); m->frames++;
    }
}
static int avc_decode_one(Movie *m, Signals *s, Pending *p) {
    if (p->size > 0 && !p->decoded) {
        if (m->nheld >= AVC_HELD - 4) return 0;   /* wait until the game takes pictures */
        uint64_t t0 = now_ns();
        m->nsample = 0; avc_parse(m, m->in[p->index] + p->offset, (size_t)p->size);
        if (m->nsample && avc_session(m)) {
            CMBlockBufferRef block = NULL; CMSampleBufferRef sample = NULL;
            CMSampleTimingInfo timing = {kCMTimeInvalid, CMTimeMake(p->time, 1000000), kCMTimeInvalid};
            OSStatus st = CMBlockBufferCreateWithMemoryBlock(NULL, m->sample, m->nsample, kCFAllocatorNull, NULL, 0, m->nsample, 0, &block);
            if (st == noErr) st = CMSampleBufferCreateReady(NULL, block, m->vfmt, 1, 1, &timing, 1, &m->nsample, &sample);
            if (st == noErr) st = VTDecompressionSessionDecodeFrame(m->vt, sample, 0, NULL, NULL);
            if (st != noErr && ++m->errors <= 4) LOG("【红】H.264 decode of a %d-byte sample at %lld us failed (%d)", p->size, (long long)p->time, (int)st);
            if (sample) CFRelease(sample);
            if (block) CFRelease(block);
        } else if (m->nsample && ++m->errors <= 4) LOG("【红】H.264 sample at %lld us before its parameter sets: skipped", (long long)p->time);
        p->decoded = 1; m->decode_ns += now_ns() - t0;
    }
    int eos = p->flags & FLAG_EOS && !m->eos_in;
    if (eos && m->vt) VTDecompressionSessionWaitForAsynchronousFrames(m->vt);
    avc_emit(m, s, eos ? 0 : AVC_REORDER);
    if (eos) {
        int slot = free_out(m);
        if (m->nheld || slot < 0) return 0;   /* the rest leaves as the game releases output slots */
        m->eos_in = 1; push_ready(m, s, slot, FLAG_EOS, p->time, 0);
        LOG("H.264 end of stream after %llu frames (%.2f ms per input, %llu errors)", (unsigned long long)m->frames, m->frames ? m->decode_ns / 1e6 / (double)m->frames : 0.0, (unsigned long long)m->errors);
    }
    m->in_free[m->nin_free++] = p->index; note(m, s, EV_INPUT);
    return 1;
}

/* Decode one input into output slots; returns 0 when it had to wait for a free output slot. */
static int decode_one(Movie *m, Signals *s, Pending *p) {
    if (m->codec == TYPE_AVC) return avc_decode_one(m, s, p);
    int need = p->size > 0 ? 1 : 0;
    if (p->flags & FLAG_EOS && !m->eos_in) need++;
    int freeslots = 0; for (int i = 0; i < OUT_BUFS; i++) freeslots += !m->out_held[i];
    if (freeslots < need) return 0;
    if (p->size > 0) {
        uint64_t t0 = now_ns();
        vpx_codec_err_t e = vpx_codec_decode(&m->vpx, m->in[p->index] + p->offset, (unsigned)p->size, NULL, 0);
        if (e != VPX_CODEC_OK) {
            m->errors++; m->last_error = ST_ERROR; note(m, s, EV_ERROR);
            if (m->errors <= 4) LOG("【红】VP9 decode error on a %d-byte frame at %lld us: %s", p->size, (long long)p->time, vpx_codec_error_detail(&m->vpx) ? vpx_codec_error_detail(&m->vpx) : vpx_codec_err_to_string(e));
        } else {
            vpx_codec_iter_t it = NULL; const vpx_image_t *img;
            while ((img = vpx_codec_get_frame(&m->vpx, &it)) != NULL) {
                if (img->fmt != VPX_IMG_FMT_I420 || (int)img->d_w != m->w || (int)img->d_h != m->h) {
                    LOG("【红】VP9 frame %ux%u format %d differs from the configured %dx%d I420", img->d_w, img->d_h, img->fmt, m->w, m->h);
                    runtime_fail("movie decoder: unexpected VP9 frame layout");
                }
                int slot = free_out(m); if (slot < 0) runtime_fail("movie decoder: output slots counted wrong");
                if (!m->format_sent) { m->format_sent = 1; if (negative() != 2) note(m, s, EV_FORMAT); }
                to_nv12(img, m->out[slot], m->w, m->h);
                push_ready(m, s, slot, 0, p->time, frame_bytes(m));
                m->frames++;
            }
        }
        m->decode_ns += now_ns() - t0;
        if (m->frames && m->frames % 300 == 0) LOG("%llu frames, decode %.2f ms per frame", (unsigned long long)m->frames, m->decode_ns / 1e6 / (double)m->frames);
    }
    if (p->flags & FLAG_EOS && !m->eos_in) {
        m->eos_in = 1; int slot = free_out(m); if (slot < 0) runtime_fail("movie decoder: no slot for end of stream");
        push_ready(m, s, slot, FLAG_EOS, p->time, 0);
        LOG("end of stream after %llu frames (%.2f ms per frame, %llu errors)", (unsigned long long)m->frames, m->frames ? m->decode_ns / 1e6 / (double)m->frames : 0.0, (unsigned long long)m->errors);
    }
    m->in_free[m->nin_free++] = p->index; note(m, s, EV_INPUT);
    return 1;
}
static void drain_pending(Movie *m, Signals *s) {
    while (m->npending && decode_one(m, s, &m->pending[0])) { memmove(m->pending, m->pending + 1, (size_t)--m->npending * sizeof m->pending[0]); }
}
static void release_codec(Movie *m) {
    if (m->vpx_live) { vpx_codec_destroy(&m->vpx); m->vpx_live = 0; }
    avc_release(m);
    for (int i = 0; i < IN_BUFS; i++) { free(m->in[i]); m->in[i] = NULL; }
    for (int i = 0; i < OUT_BUFS; i++) { free(m->out[i]); m->out[i] = NULL; }
    m->configured = m->started = 0; m->nin_free = m->npending = m->nready = m->ndecoded = 0; m->t0 = 0;
}
static void reset_queues(Movie *m) {
    m->nin_free = 0; for (int i = 0; i < IN_BUFS; i++) m->in_free[m->nin_free++] = i;
    memset(m->out_held, 0, sizeof m->out_held); m->npending = m->nready = m->ndecoded = 0; m->eos_in = 0; m->t0 = 0;
}

/* ---- entries ---- */
typedef void (*ctor_fn)(void *, int, int, int, int);
static void h_ctor(void *obj, int type, int format, int mode, int priority) {
    if (!g_ready) guest_init();
    if ((type != TYPE_VP9 && type != TYPE_AVC) || mode != MODE_BUFFER) {
        LOG("decoder type %d mode %d format %d: left to the library (only VP9 / H.264 in buffer mode run on the host)", type, mode, format);
        ((ctor_fn)G.orig[MOVIE_CTOR])(obj, type, format, mode, priority); return;
    }
    Movie *m = calloc(1, sizeof *m); if (!m) runtime_fail("movie decoder allocation");
    m->guest = obj; m->format = format; m->codec = type; pthread_mutex_init(&m->mu, NULL);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock); int i = 0;
    while (i < MAX_MOVIES && g_movies[i] && g_movies[i]->guest != obj) i++;
    if (i == MAX_MOVIES) runtime_fail("movie decoder table full");
    if (g_movies[i]) { LOG("【红】decoder object %p reused without destruction", obj); release_codec(g_movies[i]); free(g_movies[i]); }
    g_movies[i] = m; pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
    ((void **)obj)[0] = G.vptr; ((void **)obj)[1] = m;
    if (type == TYPE_AVC) LOG("H.264 decoder %p on the host (VideoToolbox), output format %d", obj, format);
    else LOG("VP9 decoder %p on the host (libvpx %s), output format %d", obj, vpx_codec_version_str(), format);
}
static void destroy(void *obj) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock); Movie *m = NULL;
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_MOVIES; i++) if (g_movies[i] && g_movies[i]->guest == obj) { m = g_movies[i]; g_movies[i] = NULL; }
    if (m) { pthread_mutex_lock(&m->mu); pthread_mutex_unlock(&m->mu); }   /* wait for an operation in progress (movie_host_tick) */
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
    if (!m) return;
    LOG("decoder %p destroyed after %llu frames", obj, (unsigned long long)m->frames);
    release_codec(m); pthread_mutex_destroy(&m->mu); free(m);
    ((void **)obj)[0] = G.vptr; ((void **)obj)[1] = NULL;   /* what the library's destructor leaves (no DecoderImpl) */
}
typedef void (*obj_fn)(void *);
static void h_d2(void *obj) { if (!find(obj)) { ((obj_fn)G.orig[MOVIE_D2])(obj); return; } destroy(obj); }
/* Deleting destructor: free the host state, then the library's own deleting destructor frees the object (impl now 0). */
static void h_d0(void *obj) { if (find(obj)) destroy(obj); ((obj_fn)G.orig[MOVIE_D0])(obj); }

typedef int (*md_fn)(void *, void *);
static int h_configure(void *obj, void *format) {
    Movie *m = find(obj); if (!m) return ((md_fn)G.orig[MOVIE_CONFIGURE])(obj, format);
    if (!format) return ST_NULL;
    if (m->format != FORMAT_NV12) { LOG("【红】output format %d not implemented on the host (NV12 = 4 only)", m->format); return ST_UNSUPPORTED; }
    const char *mime = NULL; int w = 0, h = 0;
    G.md_find_string(format, "mime", &mime); G.md_find_int32(format, "width", &w); G.md_find_int32(format, "height", &h);
    const char *want = m->codec == TYPE_AVC ? "video/avc" : "video/x-vnd.on2.vp9";
    if (!mime || strcmp(mime, want) || w <= 0 || h <= 0 || w > 8192 || h > 8192 || (w | h) & 1) {
        LOG("【红】configure: mime %s %dx%d not supported", mime ? mime : "(none)", w, h); return ST_UNSUPPORTED;
    }
    pthread_mutex_lock(&m->mu);
    release_codec(m); m->w = w; m->h = h;
    if (m->codec == TYPE_AVC) {
        m->nsps = m->npps = 0; m->params_new = 0;
        /* The library's MP4 reader keeps the avcC record under "avcc" (the NVIDIA decoder derived csd-0 / csd-1 from it);
           an Android-style extractor gives csd-0 / csd-1. Take whichever is there. */
        static const char *const keys[] = {"csd-0", "csd-1", "avcc", "avcC", "csd"};
        for (int k = 0; k < 5 && G.md_find_buffer && G.buf_data && G.buf_size; k++) {
            void *b = NULL;
            if (!G.md_find_buffer(format, keys[k], &b) || !b) continue;
            const uint8_t *d = G.buf_data(b); size_t n = G.buf_size(b);
            LOG("H.264 format buffer \"%s\": %zu bytes%s", keys[k], n, d && n ? (d[0] == 1 ? " (avcC record)" : "") : " (empty)");
            if (d && n && n < 4096) avc_csd(m, d, n);
        }
        m->nsample = 0;   /* csd carries parameter sets only */
        LOG("H.264 csd: SPS %zu bytes, PPS %zu bytes%s", m->nsps, m->npps, m->nsps && m->npps ? "" : " (waiting for in-band parameter sets)");
    } else {
        vpx_codec_dec_cfg_t cfg = {.threads = 4, .w = (unsigned)w, .h = (unsigned)h};
        if (vpx_codec_dec_init(&m->vpx, vpx_codec_vp9_dx(), &cfg, 0) != VPX_CODEC_OK) runtime_fail("libvpx VP9 decoder initialisation");
        m->vpx_live = 1;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < IN_BUFS; i++) if (!(m->in[i] = malloc(IN_CAP))) runtime_fail("movie input buffers");
    for (int i = 0; i < OUT_BUFS; i++) if (!(m->out[i] = malloc((size_t)frame_bytes(m)))) runtime_fail("movie output buffers");
    reset_queues(m); m->format_sent = 0; m->configured = 1; m->last_error = 0;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&m->mu);
    LOG("configured %dx%d %s, %d input buffers of %d KiB, %d output frames of %d bytes", w, h, m->codec == TYPE_AVC ? "H.264" : "VP9", IN_BUFS, IN_CAP >> 10, OUT_BUFS, frame_bytes(m));
    return ST_OK;
}
static int h_register_events(void *obj, void *events) {
    Movie *m = find(obj); if (!m) return ((md_fn)G.orig[MOVIE_REGISTER_EVENTS])(obj, events);
    m->events = events; return ST_OK;
}
static void set_format(Movie *m, void *md) {
    G.md_set_string(md, "mime", "video/raw");
    G.md_set_int32(md, "width", m->w); G.md_set_int32(md, "height", m->h);
    G.md_set_int32(md, "stride", m->w); G.md_set_int32(md, "slice-height", m->h);
    G.md_set_int32(md, "color-format", 21);   /* COLOR_FormatYUV420SemiPlanar */
    G.md_set_rect(md, "crop", 0, 0, m->w - 1, m->h - 1);
    G.md_set_int32(md, "crop-width", m->w); G.md_set_int32(md, "crop-height", m->h);
    G.md_set_int32(md, "nv12-y-stride", m->w); G.md_set_int32(md, "nv12-uv-stride", m->w);
    G.md_set_int32(md, "nv12-y-offset", 0); G.md_set_int32(md, "nv12-uv-offset", m->w * m->h);
}
static int h_get_output_format(void *obj, void *md) {
    Movie *m = find(obj); if (!m) return ((md_fn)G.orig[MOVIE_GET_OUTPUT_FORMAT])(obj, md);
    if (!md) return ST_NULL;
    if (!m->configured) return ST_ERROR;
    set_format(m, md); return ST_OK;
}
typedef int (*int_fn)(void *);
static int h_start(void *obj) {
    Movie *m = find(obj); if (!m) return ((int_fn)G.orig[MOVIE_START])(obj);
    Signals s = {0};
    pthread_mutex_lock(&m->mu);
    if (!m->configured) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&m->mu); return ST_NOT_CONFIGURED; }
    m->started = 1; note(m, &s, EV_INPUT);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&m->mu); fire(&s);
    return ST_OK;
}
static int h_stop(void *obj) {
    Movie *m = find(obj); if (!m) return ((int_fn)G.orig[MOVIE_STOP])(obj);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&m->mu); LOG("stop after %llu frames (%llu dropped to keep time)", (unsigned long long)m->frames, (unsigned long long)m->dropped); release_codec(m); pthread_mutex_unlock(&m->mu);
    return ST_OK;
}
static int h_reset(void *obj) {
    Movie *m = find(obj); if (!m) return ((int_fn)G.orig[MOVIE_RESET])(obj);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&m->mu); release_codec(m); m->last_error = 0; pthread_mutex_unlock(&m->mu);
    return ST_OK;
}
static int h_flush(void *obj) {
    Movie *m = find(obj); if (!m) return ((int_fn)G.orig[MOVIE_FLUSH])(obj);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&m->mu);
    if (m->configured && m->codec == TYPE_AVC) {   /* parameter sets and session stay; held pictures belong to the old position */
        if (m->vt) VTDecompressionSessionWaitForAsynchronousFrames(m->vt);
        avc_drop_held(m); reset_queues(m);
    } else if (m->configured) {   /* drop queued work; the next input starts a new decode (after a seek: a key frame) */
        vpx_codec_destroy(&m->vpx); m->vpx_live = 0;
        vpx_codec_dec_cfg_t cfg = {.threads = 4, .w = (unsigned)m->w, .h = (unsigned)m->h};
        if (vpx_codec_dec_init(&m->vpx, vpx_codec_vp9_dx(), &cfg, 0) != VPX_CODEC_OK) runtime_fail("libvpx VP9 decoder re-initialisation");
        m->vpx_live = 1; reset_queues(m);
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&m->mu);
    return ST_OK;
}
typedef int (*pp_fn)(void *, int *, int *);
static int h_acquire_input(void *obj, int *index, int *remaining) {
    Movie *m = find(obj); if (!m) return ((pp_fn)G.orig[MOVIE_ACQUIRE_INPUT])(obj, index, remaining);
    if (!index || !remaining) return ST_NULL;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&m->mu);
    *index = -1; *remaining = 0; int st = ST_NO_INPUT;
    if (m->started && m->nin_free > 0) {
        *index = m->in_free[0]; memmove(m->in_free, m->in_free + 1, (size_t)--m->nin_free * sizeof m->in_free[0]);
        *remaining = m->nin_free; st = ST_OK;
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&m->mu); return st;
}
typedef int (*ib_fn)(void *, int, void *);
static int h_get_input(void *obj, int index, void *buf) {
    Movie *m = find(obj); if (!m) return ((ib_fn)G.orig[MOVIE_GET_INPUT])(obj, index, buf);
    if (!buf) return ST_NULL;
    if (index < 0 || index >= IN_BUFS || !m->in[index]) { G.buf_set_range(buf, 0, 0); G.buf_set_data(buf, NULL, 0); return ST_ERROR; }
    G.buf_set_range(buf, 0, IN_CAP); G.buf_set_data(buf, m->in[index], IN_CAP);
    return ST_OK;
}
typedef int (*send_fn)(void *, int, int, int, int64_t, unsigned);
static int h_send_input(void *obj, int index, int offset, int size, int64_t time, unsigned flags) {
    Movie *m = find(obj); if (!m) return ((send_fn)G.orig[MOVIE_SEND_INPUT])(obj, index, offset, size, time, flags);
    if (index < 0 || index >= IN_BUFS || offset < 0 || size < 0 || (int64_t)offset + size > IN_CAP) return ST_ERROR;
    Signals s = {0};
    pthread_mutex_lock(&m->mu);
    if (!m->started) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&m->mu); return ST_ERROR; }
    Pending p = {index, offset, size, time, flags, 0};
    if (m->eos_in) { m->in_free[m->nin_free++] = index; note(m, &s, EV_INPUT); }   /* after end of stream: hand the buffer back */
    else if (m->npending || !decode_one(m, &s, &p)) m->pending[m->npending++] = p;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&m->mu); fire(&s);
    return ST_OK;
}
typedef int (*acq_fn)(void *, int *, int64_t *, unsigned *, int *);
static int h_acquire_output(void *obj, int *index, int64_t *time, unsigned *flags, int *remaining) {
    Movie *m = find(obj); if (!m) return ((acq_fn)G.orig[MOVIE_ACQUIRE_OUTPUT])(obj, index, time, flags, remaining);
    if (!index || !time || !flags || !remaining) return ST_NULL;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&m->mu);   /* paced frames become ready only at presents (movie_host_tick): one per game frame */
    *index = -1; *time = 0; *flags = 0; *remaining = 0; int st = ST_NO_OUTPUT;
    if (m->nready > 0) {
        Ready r = m->ready[0]; memmove(m->ready, m->ready + 1, (size_t)--m->nready * sizeof m->ready[0]);
        *index = r.index; *time = r.time; *flags = r.flags; *remaining = m->nready; st = ST_OK;
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&m->mu);
    return st;
}
static int h_get_output(void *obj, int index, void *buf) {
    Movie *m = find(obj); if (!m) return ((ib_fn)G.orig[MOVIE_GET_OUTPUT])(obj, index, buf);
    if (!buf) return ST_NULL;
    G.buf_set_range(buf, 0, 0);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&m->mu);
    int st = ST_ERROR;
    if (index >= 0 && index < OUT_BUFS && m->out_held[index]) {
        int bytes = m->out_bytes[index]; uint8_t *dst = G.buf_base(buf);
        if (!bytes) st = ST_OK;
        else if (dst && G.buf_capacity(buf) >= (size_t)bytes) { memcpy(dst, m->out[index], (size_t)bytes); G.buf_set_range(buf, 0, bytes); st = ST_OK; }
        else LOG("【红】output buffer of %zu bytes for a %d-byte frame", G.buf_capacity(buf), bytes);
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&m->mu); return st;
}
static int h_get_output_size(void *obj, int *size, int *count) {
    Movie *m = find(obj); if (!m) return ((pp_fn)G.orig[MOVIE_GET_OUTPUT_SIZE])(obj, size, count);
    if (!size || !count) return ST_NULL;
    *count = 1; *size = m->configured ? frame_bytes(m) : 0;
    return ST_OK;
}
typedef int (*i_fn)(void *, int);
static int h_release_output(void *obj, int index) {
    Movie *m = find(obj); if (!m) return ((i_fn)G.orig[MOVIE_RELEASE_OUTPUT])(obj, index);
    Signals s = {0};
    pthread_mutex_lock(&m->mu);
    int st = ST_ERROR;
    if (index >= 0 && index < OUT_BUFS && m->out_held[index]) {
        int queued = 0; for (int i = 0; i < m->nready; i++) queued |= m->ready[i].index == index;
        for (int i = 0; i < m->ndecoded; i++) queued |= m->decoded[i].index == index;
        if (!queued) { m->out_held[index] = 0; if (m->codec == TYPE_AVC && !m->npending) avc_emit(m, &s, AVC_REORDER); drain_pending(m, &s); st = ST_OK; }
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&m->mu); fire(&s);
    return st;
}
static int h_get_last_error(void *obj) {
    Movie *m = find(obj); if (!m) return ((int_fn)G.orig[MOVIE_GET_LAST_ERROR])(obj);
    return m->last_error;
}
typedef int (*ibm_fn)(void *, int, void *, void *);
static int h_get_output_buffer_format(void *obj, int index, void *md) {
    Movie *m = find(obj); if (!m) return ((ib_fn)G.orig[MOVIE_GET_OUTPUT_BUFFER_FORMAT])(obj, index, md);
    if (!md) return ST_NULL;
    if (index < 0 || index >= OUT_BUFS || !m->out_held[index]) return ST_ERROR;
    set_format(m, md); return ST_OK;
}
static int h_get_output_md(void *obj, int index, void *buf, void *md) {
    Movie *m = find(obj); if (!m) return ((ibm_fn)G.orig[MOVIE_GET_OUTPUT_MD])(obj, index, buf, md);
    if (!buf && !md) return ST_NULL;
    int st = md ? h_get_output_buffer_format(obj, index, md) : ST_OK;
    return st == ST_OK && buf ? h_get_output(obj, index, buf) : st;
}

static void *const ENTRIES[MOVIE_ENTRIES] = {
    h_ctor, h_d2, h_d0, h_configure, h_register_events, h_get_output_format, h_start, h_stop, h_reset, h_flush,
    h_acquire_input, h_get_input, h_send_input, h_acquire_output, h_get_output, h_get_output_size, h_release_output,
    h_get_last_error, h_get_output_md, h_get_output_buffer_format};
void *movie_host_entry(int which) { return which >= 0 && which < MOVIE_ENTRIES ? ENTRIES[which] : NULL; }

void *runtime_movie_override(const char *name) {
    static int off = -1;
    if (off < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_MOVIE_HOST"); off = e && !strcmp(e, "0"); }
    if (off || strncmp(name, "_ZN5movie7Decoder", 17)) return NULL;
    for (int i = 0; i < MOVIE_ENTRIES; i++) if (!strcmp(name, NAMES[i])) return ENTRIES[i];
    /* aliases: the base-object constructor and the complete-object destructor share code with the entries above */
    if (!strcmp(name, "_ZN5movie7DecoderC2ENS_11DecoderTypeENS_19DecoderOutputFormatENS_11DecoderModeEi")) return h_ctor;
    if (!strcmp(name, "_ZN5movie7DecoderD1Ev")) return h_d2;
    return NULL;
}
#endif   /* libvpx */
```

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/host/nvn_tex.c`:

```c
// round15 起参与编译：自 third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/nvn_tex.c 逐字节拷贝（host/*.c glob 收编，donor 原件未入构建；
// 此前 nvn_tex_layout 是 lazy 未定义符号，gfx_probe.c 引用从不触发）。改动请回写 donor 再拷贝，勿在此分叉。
// NVN 贴图的存储尺寸 / 对齐 / 各级偏移（Tegra X1 块线性布局）。
// 基于 deko3d source/dk_image.cpp（zlib 许可，Copyright (C) 2018-2020 fincs），自动块高按 NVN SDK 的整除规则修正：
//   一个 GOB = 64 字节 × 8 行 = 512 字节；块高（tileH，单位 GOB）按「高度×1.5」挑；各级按块对齐累加。
// 游戏的预排布贴图（SetPackagedTextureLayout）带 8 字节布局参数：第 0 字节 = 块高 log2（真游戏 16 例对照得出，
// 其中 4 例与自动算法不同），有它时以它为准。
// Storage size / alignment / per-level offsets of NVN textures (Tegra X1 block-linear layout).
// Based on deko3d source/dk_image.cpp (zlib license, Copyright (C) 2018-2020 fincs), with NVN SDK integer rounding for automatic tile height:
//   one GOB = 64 bytes × 8 rows = 512 bytes; the block height (tileH, in GOBs) is picked by 'height×1.5'; levels are accumulated with block alignment.
// The game's packaged textures (SetPackagedTextureLayout) carry 8 bytes of layout parameters: byte 0 = log2 of the block height (derived by comparing 16 cases from the real game,
// 4 of which differ from the automatic algorithm); when present it takes precedence.
#include "nvn_tex.h"
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

typedef struct { uint8_t bpb, bw, bh; } fmt_t;   // 每块字节、块宽、块高（非压缩格式块宽高 = 1） | Bytes per block, block width, block height (for uncompressed formats block width and height = 1)

static fmt_t fmt_of(int f) {
    static const uint8_t astc[14][2] = {{4,4},{5,4},{5,5},{6,5},{6,6},{8,5},{8,6},{8,8},{10,5},{10,6},{10,8},{10,10},{12,10},{12,12}};
    if (f >= 0x79 && f <= 0x94) { int k = (f - 0x79) % 14; return (fmt_t){16, astc[k][0], astc[k][1]}; }
    if (f >= 0x41 && f <= 0x50) {                         // DXT / RGTC / BPTC：4×4 块 | DXT / RGTC / BPTC: 4×4 blocks
        int b8 = (f <= 0x42) || (f == 0x45 || f == 0x46) || (f == 0x49 || f == 0x4A);
        return (fmt_t){b8 ? 8 : 16, 4, 4};
    }
    static const struct { uint8_t lo, hi, bpb; } r[] = {
        {0x01,0x04,1},{0x05,0x09,2},{0x0A,0x0C,4},{0x0D,0x10,2},{0x11,0x15,4},{0x16,0x18,8},
        {0x19,0x1C,3},{0x1D,0x21,6},{0x22,0x24,12},{0x25,0x28,4},{0x29,0x2D,8},{0x2E,0x30,16},
        {0x31,0x31,1},{0x32,0x32,2},{0x33,0x35,4},{0x36,0x36,8},{0x37,0x38,4},{0x39,0x3C,2},{0x3D,0x40,4},
        {0x51,0x52,1},{0x53,0x54,2},{0x55,0x56,4},{0x57,0x58,2},{0x59,0x5A,4},{0x5B,0x5C,8},
        {0x5D,0x5E,3},{0x5F,0x60,6},{0x61,0x62,12},{0x63,0x64,4},{0x65,0x66,8},{0x67,0x68,16},
        {0x69,0x6C,4},{0x6D,0x70,4},{0x71,0x75,8},{0x76,0x78,16},{0x95,0x98,2},{0x99,0x9C,4},
    };
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof r / sizeof *r; i++)
        if (f >= r[i].lo && f <= r[i].hi) return (fmt_t){r[i].bpb, 1, 1};
    return (fmt_t){0, 1, 1};
}

int nvn_fmt_bpb(int f, int *bw, int *bh) { fmt_t t = fmt_of(f); if (bw) *bw = t.bw; if (bh) *bh = t.bh; return t.bpb; }

static uint32_t mip(uint32_t s, unsigned l) { s >>= l; return s ? s : 1; }
static uint32_t blk(uint32_t s, uint32_t b) { return (s + b - 1) / b; }
static unsigned pick_tile(uint32_t gobs) { return gobs >= 16 ? 4 : gobs >= 8 ? 3 : gobs >= 4 ? 2 : gobs >= 2 ? 1 : 0; }
static unsigned adj_tile(unsigned shift, uint32_t unit, uint32_t dim) {
    if (!shift) return 0;
    uint32_t x = unit << (shift - 1);
    if (x >= dim) while (--shift) { x >>= 1; if (x < dim) break; }
    return shift;
}

// target：NVNtextureTarget；dims 维数、是否分层由 target 决定
// target: NVNtextureTarget; the number of dims and whether it is layered are determined by target
static void shape(const nvn_texdesc *d, unsigned *dpl, int *layered, uint32_t *w, uint32_t *h, uint32_t *z) {
    *w = d->width; *h = d->height; *z = d->depth; *layered = 0;
    switch (d->target) {
        case 0: *dpl = 1; *h = 1; *z = 1; break;                       // 1D
        case 3: *dpl = 1; *z = d->height; *h = 1; *layered = 1; break; // 1D_ARRAY（层数在 height） | 1D_ARRAY (layer count is in height)
        case 2: *dpl = 3; break;                                        // 3D
        case 4: case 6: *dpl = 2; *layered = 1; break;                  // 2D_ARRAY / MS_ARRAY
        case 8: *dpl = 2; *z = 6; *layered = 1; break;                  // CUBEMAP
        case 9: *dpl = 2; *z = d->depth * 6; *layered = 1; break;       // CUBEMAP_ARRAY
        default: *dpl = 2; *z = 1; break;                               // 2D / MS / RECTANGLE
    }
    if (*z == 0) *z = 1;
}

static void samples_xy(int s, uint32_t *sx, uint32_t *sy) {
    *sx = *sy = 1;
    if (s == 2) *sx = 2; else if (s == 4) *sx = *sy = 2; else if (s == 8) { *sx = 4; *sy = 2; }
}

static uint64_t level_offset(const nvn_texdesc *d, unsigned level, unsigned dpl, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint32_t z,
                             unsigned tileH, unsigned tileD, fmt_t t) {
    uint32_t sx, sy; samples_xy(d->samples, &sx, &sy);
    uint64_t off = 0;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < level; i++) {
        uint32_t lw = blk(mip(w * sx, i), t.bw);
        uint32_t lh = dpl >= 2 ? blk(mip(h * sy, i), t.bh) : 1;
        uint32_t ld = dpl >= 3 ? mip(z, i) : 1;
        uint32_t lwb = lw * t.bpb;
        unsigned th = adj_tile(tileH, 8, lh), td = adj_tile(tileD, 1, ld);
        uint32_t wg = (lwb + 63) / 64, hg = (lh + 7) / 8;
        uint32_t wt = wg, ht = (hg + (1u << th) - 1) >> th, dt = (ld + (1u << td) - 1) >> td;
        off += (uint64_t)wt * ht * dt << (9 + th + td);
    }
    return off;
}

/* NVN v55 sdk+0x4429c8 compares the default footprint against one-GOB tiles
   for MINIMAL_LAYOUT. Keep the default if equal; otherwise use tile H=D=0.
   Packaged layouts override this choice. Layout cannot be switched on live
   resources: the startup-only knob is a negative control for fresh sessions. */
static int minimal_layout_on(void) {
    static _Atomic int enabled = -1;
    int value = atomic_load(&enabled);
    if (value < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_MINIMAL_LAYOUT"); value = !(e && !strcmp(e, "0")); atomic_store(&enabled, value); }
    return value;
}
static uint64_t layer_bytes(const nvn_texdesc *d, unsigned dpl, int layered,
                            uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint32_t z, unsigned tileH, unsigned tileD, fmt_t t) {
    uint64_t ls = level_offset(d, d->levels ? d->levels : 1, dpl, w, h, z, tileH, tileD, t);
    if (layered) {
        uint32_t hh = blk(h, t.bh); unsigned th = tileH, td = tileD;
        while (th && hh <= (8u << (th - 1))) th--;
        while (td && z <= (1u << (td - 1))) td--;
        uint64_t align = 1ull << (th + td + 9);
        ls = (ls + align - 1) & ~(align - 1);
    }
    return ls;
}

void nvn_tex_layout(const nvn_texdesc *d, nvn_texlayout *o) {
    fmt_t t = fmt_of(d->format);
    unsigned dpl; int layered; uint32_t w, h, z;
    shape(d, &dpl, &layered, &w, &h, &z);
    uint32_t sx, sy; samples_xy(d->samples, &sx, &sy);
    o->bpb = t.bpb; o->tileH = o->tileD = 0; o->layers = layered ? z : 1;
    if (!t.bpb) { o->size = 0; o->align = 512; o->layer_size = 0; return; }
    if (d->target == 10) {                                            // BUFFER
        o->layer_size = o->size = (uint64_t)t.bpb * d->width;
        o->align = t.bpb == 12 ? 4 : t.bpb; return;
    }
    if (nvn_tex_is_linear(d)) {                                            // Pitch storage: explicit stride, otherwise 32-byte (LINEAR) / 128-byte (LINEAR_RENDER_TARGET) alignment
        o->align = (d->flags & 0x40) ? 128 : 32;
        uint32_t stride = nvn_tex_linear_stride(d);
        o->layer_size = o->size = (uint64_t)stride * blk(h, t.bh);
        return;
    }
    unsigned tileH = 0, tileD = 0;
    /* NVN truncates height*1.5 to whole GOB rows before choosing the power of
       two. Rounding up here changes e.g. 40 BC rows from H2 to H3 even when
       the total allocation size is unchanged, so padding becomes black texels. */
    if (dpl == 2) { uint32_t ah = blk(h * sy, t.bh); tileH = d->pkg_block_h ? (unsigned)d->pkg_block_h - 1 : pick_tile((ah + ah / 2) / 8); }
    else if (dpl == 3) tileD = pick_tile(z + z / 2);
    uint64_t ls = layer_bytes(d, dpl, layered, w, h, z, tileH, tileD, t);
    if ((d->flags & 0x200) && !d->pkg_block_h && minimal_layout_on()) {
        uint64_t minimal = layer_bytes(d, dpl, layered, w, h, z, 0, 0, t);
        if (minimal != ls) { tileH = tileD = 0; ls = minimal; }
    }
    o->tileH = tileH; o->tileD = tileD;
    o->layer_size = ls;
    o->size = layered ? ls * z : ls;
    o->align = 512;
}

uint64_t nvn_tex_level_offset(const nvn_texdesc *d, unsigned level) {
    fmt_t t = fmt_of(d->format);
    unsigned dpl; int layered; uint32_t w, h, z;
    shape(d, &dpl, &layered, &w, &h, &z);
    if (!t.bpb || nvn_tex_is_linear(d) || d->target == 10) return 0;
    nvn_texlayout L; nvn_tex_layout(d, &L);
    return level_offset(d, level, dpl, w, h, z, L.tileH, L.tileD, t);
}

void nvn_tex_level_tiles(const nvn_texdesc *d, unsigned level, unsigned *tileH, unsigned *tileD) {
    fmt_t t = fmt_of(d->format);
    unsigned dpl; int layered; uint32_t w, h, z;
    shape(d, &dpl, &layered, &w, &h, &z);
    uint32_t sx, sy; samples_xy(d->samples, &sx, &sy);
    nvn_texlayout L; nvn_tex_layout(d, &L);
    uint32_t lh = dpl >= 2 ? blk(mip(h * sy, level), t.bh) : 1;
    uint32_t ld = dpl >= 3 ? mip(z, level) : 1;
    *tileH = adj_tile(L.tileH, 8, lh);
    *tileD = adj_tile(L.tileD, 1, ld);
}
```
