`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/host/opus_codec.c`:

```c
/* nn::codec hardware Opus decoder, implemented with libopus on the host (the hwopus service is a
   hardware-accelerated libopus). Input frames carry Nintendo's 8-byte big-endian header
   {payload size, final range}; the decoder's final range is checked against it. A header range of 0 is not a
   recorded value: none of the 280,723 packets in 1.4.3's English voice streams has it, while a fan dub's encoder
   writes 0 into every packet (all 186,758 of the PKG PT-BR dub, which decode without error). Those are not checked. */
#include "runtime.h"
#include <opus.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <limits.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#define R_INVALID 0x1fcd1u   /* codec: invalid argument (module 111) */
/* A fixed-capacity host table could terminate a running game when another
 * stream opened. Allocate one stable node per live decoder and free it at
 * Finalize; growing the registry must not move a decoder another thread uses.
 * Registry -> decoder is the lock order. A caller acquires the decoder lock
 * before dropping the registry lock, so Finalize cannot free a borrowed node.
 * Different streams can still decode in parallel. */
typedef struct Decoder {
    const void *guest;
    OpusDecoder *dec;
    int rate, channels;
    struct Decoder *next;
    pthread_mutex_t use_lock;
} Decoder;
static Decoder *decoders;
static size_t decoder_count, decoder_high_water, decoder_created, decoder_finalized, decoder_reinitialized;
static pthread_mutex_t lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;

static void decoder_stats(const char *event) { /* registry lock held */
    fprintf(stderr, "[totk-audio] Opus %s: active %zu, peak %zu, created %zu, finalized %zu, reinitialized %zu (dynamic registry)\n",
            event, decoder_count, decoder_high_water, decoder_created, decoder_finalized, decoder_reinitialized);
}
static int codec_trace(void) {
    const char *v = getenv("TOTK_CODEC_TRACE");
    return v && *v && strcmp(v, "0");
}
static Decoder *acquire(const void *guest) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
    Decoder *d = decoders;
    while (d && d->guest != guest) d = d->next;
    if (d) pthread_mutex_lock(&d->use_lock);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
    if (!d) runtime_fail("unknown hardware Opus decoder");
    return d;
}
static void release(Decoder *d) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&d->use_lock); }
static int valid_format(int rate, int channels) {
    return (rate == 48000 || rate == 24000 || rate == 16000 || rate == 12000 || rate == 8000) && (channels == 1 || channels == 2);
}
static size_t work_size(int rate, int channels, int option) {
    (void)option; if (!valid_format(rate, channels)) return 0;
    return (size_t)opus_decoder_get_size(channels) + 0x1000;   /* host keeps the state; the game's buffer is reserved but unused */
}
static unsigned initialize(void *guest, int rate, int channels, void *work, size_t size, int option) {
    (void)work; (void)option;
    if (!guest || !valid_format(rate, channels) || size < work_size(rate, channels, 0)) return R_INVALID;
    Decoder *d = calloc(1, sizeof *d);
    if (!d) runtime_fail("hardware Opus decoder allocation");
    int err = 0;
    d->dec = opus_decoder_create(rate, channels, &err);
    if (!d->dec || err != OPUS_OK) {
        if (d->dec) opus_decoder_destroy(d->dec);
        free(d); runtime_fail("libopus decoder creation");
    }
    if (pthread_mutex_init(&d->use_lock, NULL)) {
        opus_decoder_destroy(d->dec); free(d); runtime_fail("hardware Opus decoder mutex");
    }
    d->guest = guest; d->rate = rate; d->channels = channels;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
    for (Decoder *old = decoders; old; old = old->next) if (old->guest == guest) {
        /* Preserve #18: the game may initialize the same object without
         * Finalize. Replace its state, waiting for any in-flight operation,
         * rather than adding another entry for the same guest object. */
        pthread_mutex_lock(&old->use_lock);
        OpusDecoder *previous = old->dec;
        old->dec = d->dec; old->rate = rate; old->channels = channels;
        decoder_reinitialized++;
        if (decoder_reinitialized == 1)
            fprintf(stderr, "[totk] hardware Opus decoder %p initialized again without Finalize: its slot is reused (logged once)\n", guest);
        if (codec_trace()) decoder_stats("reinitialize");
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
        opus_decoder_destroy(previous); release(old);
        pthread_mutex_destroy(&d->use_lock); free(d);
        return 0;
    }
    d->next = decoders; decoders = d; decoder_count++; decoder_created++;
    int peak = decoder_count > decoder_high_water;
    if (peak) decoder_high_water = decoder_count;
    /* past the old fixed 64: at 65 and every power of two, so a leak shows in a normal log */
    if (codec_trace() || (peak && decoder_count > 64 && (decoder_count == 65 || !(decoder_count & (decoder_count - 1)))))
        decoder_stats("initialize");
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
    return 0;
}
static void finalize(void *guest) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);
    Decoder **slot = &decoders;
    while (*slot && (*slot)->guest != guest) slot = &(*slot)->next;
    Decoder *d = *slot;
    if (!d) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock); runtime_fail("unknown hardware Opus decoder"); }
    pthread_mutex_lock(&d->use_lock);
    *slot = d->next; decoder_count--; decoder_finalized++;
    if (codec_trace()) decoder_stats("finalize");
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
    opus_decoder_destroy(d->dec);
    release(d); pthread_mutex_destroy(&d->use_lock); free(d);
}
static int sample_rate(const void *guest) { Decoder *d = acquire(guest); int v = d->rate; release(d); return v; }
static int channel_count(const void *guest) { Decoder *d = acquire(guest); int v = d->channels; release(d); return v; }
static unsigned reset(void *guest) {
    Decoder *d = acquire(guest); int ok = opus_decoder_ctl(d->dec, OPUS_RESET_STATE); release(d);
    return ok == OPUS_OK ? 0 : R_INVALID;
}
static uint32_t be32(const uint8_t *p) { return (uint32_t)p[0] << 24 | (uint32_t)p[1] << 16 | (uint32_t)p[2] << 8 | p[3]; }
static unsigned decode(void *guest, size_t *consumed, int *samples, int16_t *out, size_t out_size, const uint8_t *in, size_t in_size) {
    if (!consumed || !samples || !out || !in || in_size < 8) return R_INVALID;
    uint32_t n = be32(in), range = be32(in + 4);
    if (n > in_size - 8 || n > INT_MAX) return R_INVALID;
    Decoder *d = acquire(guest);
    size_t capacity = out_size / (sizeof(int16_t) * (size_t)d->channels);
    if (capacity > INT_MAX) { release(d); return R_INVALID; }
    int max = (int)capacity;
    dm_guest_write_prepare(out, out_size);
    int got = opus_decode(d->dec, in + 8, (opus_int32)n, out, max, 0);
    if (got < 0) { fprintf(stderr, "[totk] opus_decode: %s\n", opus_strerror(got)); release(d); return R_INVALID; }
    opus_uint32 final = 0; opus_decoder_ctl(d->dec, OPUS_GET_FINAL_RANGE(&final));
    if (n && range && final != range) { fprintf(stderr, "[totk] Opus final range %#x != stream %#x\n", final, range); runtime_fail("Opus stream integrity"); }
    *consumed = 8 + n; *samples = got; release(d); return 0;
}

void *runtime_codec_override(const char *name) {
    static const struct { const char *name; void *fn; } map[] = {
        {"_ZN2nn5codec36GetHardwareOpusDecoderWorkBufferSizeEiii", work_size},
        {"_ZN2nn5codec29InitializeHardwareOpusDecoderEPNS0_23HardwareOpusDecoderTypeEiiPvmi", initialize},
        {"_ZN2nn5codec27FinalizeHardwareOpusDecoderEPNS0_23HardwareOpusDecoderTypeE", finalize},
        {"_ZN2nn5codec32GetHardwareOpusDecoderSampleRateEPKNS0_23HardwareOpusDecoderTypeE", sample_rate},
        {"_ZN2nn5codec34GetHardwareOpusDecoderChannelCountEPKNS0_23HardwareOpusDecoderTypeE", channel_count},
        {"_ZN2nn5codec24ResetHardwareOpusDecoderEPNS0_23HardwareOpusDecoderTypeE", reset},
        {"_ZN2nn5codec33DecodeOpusInterleavedWithHardwareEPNS0_23HardwareOpusDecoderTypeEPmPiPsmPKvm", decode},
    };
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof map / sizeof *map; i++) if (!strcmp(name, map[i].name)) return map[i].fn;
    return NULL;
}
```

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/host/romfs.c`:

```c
/* Read-only game RomFS, backed by the player's fully IVFC-verified image. */
#include "runtime.h"
#include "totk_ui_lang.h"
#include "romfs_config.h"
#include "game_version.h"
#include "fs_host.h"
#include "romfs_path.h"
#include <CommonCrypto/CommonDigest.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#define NOT_FOUND 0x202u
#define UNSUPPORTED 0x6402u
#define INVALID 0xe402u
#define NH 65536
static uint8_t *index_bytes;
static size_t index_size;
static uint64_t file_count,strings_offset;
static int image_fd=-1;
/* Split image: romfs.bin.000, .001, ... of equal size (the last one shorter), read in place. The phone gets the 17 GB
   image this way: devicectl drops the connection on a single file of that size, and joining the parts on the device
   would need the space twice. image_fd is then the first part; src_pread routes image offsets to their part. */
#define MAX_CHUNKS 64
static int chunk_fds[MAX_CHUNKS];
static unsigned nchunks;
static uint64_t chunk_size;
static ssize_t src_pread(int fd,void *buf,size_t n,off_t off) {
 if(!nchunks||fd!=image_fd)return pread(fd,buf,n,off);
 uint64_t c=(uint64_t)off/chunk_size,o=(uint64_t)off%chunk_size;if(c>=nchunks)return 0;
 if(n>chunk_size-o)n=(size_t)(chunk_size-o);
 return pread(chunk_fds[c],buf,n,(off_t)o);
}
static const uint8_t *image_map;
static char mount_name[32];
static pthread_mutex_t lock=PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static _Atomic uint64_t read_calls,read_bytes,read_ns,read_prepare_ns,read_report_ns;
static uint64_t handles[NH]; /* file index + 1; 0 is free */
/* Overlays: files listed in a directory's manifest.tsv are served in place of the originals. Each line names a RomFS
   path, the overlay's size and SHA-256 and the original's SHA-256; a missing path, a size or hash mismatch or a changed
   original stops the start. The directories, in this order: the build's patches (scripts/make_romfs_patches.py;
   TOTK_ROMFS_PATCHES, default extracted/<version>/romfs-patches, 0 = none), the true-2K HeapDef overlay
   (scripts/make_output_res_overlay.py) and the player's mods (TOTK_ROMFS_MODS, which the launcher sets to
   <data>/mods/<version>; no manifest there = none). Each file can be replaced once. An overlay file is opened when the
   game opens it, so a mod can replace thousands of files (a dub's voice streams) without holding a descriptor each; the
   file's identity (device, inode, size, modification time) is kept from the start check, and an open that finds another
   file there stops the game instead of serving bytes nobody checked. scripts/make_mod_manifest.py writes a mod's manifest.
   A line whose original SHA-256 is "-" adds a file the RomFS lacks (issue #48: The Second Quest adds 874): it is numbered
   after the RomFS's own files (file_count + k, k in path order, added[]), opens and reads like a replacement, and its
   folders exist for runtime_romfs_entry_type. The RomFS has no directory listing here, so nothing else needs to know. */
typedef struct { uint64_t index,size; char *path; dev_t dev; ino_t ino; struct timespec mtime; char *name; } Overlay;
static Overlay *overlays; /* sorted by RomFS index after overlay_init */
static size_t noverlay,overlay_cap;
#define ADDED UINT64_MAX   /* an added file's index until overlay_init numbers it */
static char **added;       /* RomFS paths of the added files, sorted; added[k] is index file_count + k */
static size_t nadded;
static uint32_t handle_ovl[NH]; /* overlay slot + 1 of an open handle, 0 = original */
static int handle_fd[NH];       /* the handle's open overlay file, when handle_ovl is set */
typedef struct { uint64_t offset,size;uint32_t name,len; } Entry;
_Static_assert(sizeof(Entry)==24,"index entry layout");
static Entry entry(uint64_t i) {Entry e;memcpy(&e,index_bytes+24+i*24,24);return e;}
static const char *entry_name(Entry e) {return (char *)index_bytes+strings_offset+e.name;}
static void need(int c,const char *m) {if(!c)runtime_fail(m);}
static void sha_fd(int fd,const char *expected,uint64_t total,const char *stage) {
 CC_SHA256_CTX c;CC_SHA256_Init(&c);uint8_t *buffer=malloc(8<<20);need(buffer!=NULL,"hash buffer");
 for(off_t off=0;;){ssize_t n=src_pread(fd,buffer,8<<20,off);need(n>=0,"read hash input");if(!n)break;CC_SHA256_Update(&c,buffer,(CC_LONG)n);off+=n;
  if(stage&&((uint64_t)off%(256u<<20)<(8u<<20)||!n))runtime_boot_progress(stage,(uint64_t)off,total);}
 uint8_t d[32];char hex[65];CC_SHA256_Final(d,&c);free(buffer);for(unsigned i=0;i<32;i++)snprintf(hex+i*2,3,"%02x",d[i]);need(!strcmp(hex,expected),"RomFS integrity mismatch");
}
/* A successful full hash may be reused only while the same regular file has
   unchanged filesystem identity and modification metadata. This is a startup
   shortcut, not a fresh integrity proof; TOTK_ROMFS_VERIFY=full forces one. */
typedef struct {
 char magic[16], sha256[65];
 uint64_t dev,ino,size;
 int64_t mtime_sec,mtime_nsec,ctime_sec,ctime_nsec,birth_sec,birth_nsec;
} RomfsProof;
static RomfsProof proof_for(const struct stat *s) {
 RomfsProof p={0};memcpy(p.magic,"TOTKRFS-PROOF-1",16);memcpy(p.sha256,ROMFS_IMAGE_SHA256,65);
 p.dev=(uint64_t)s->st_dev;p.ino=(uint64_t)s->st_ino;p.size=(uint64_t)s->st_size;
 p.mtime_sec=s->st_mtimespec.tv_sec;p.mtime_nsec=s->st_mtimespec.tv_nsec;
 p.ctime_sec=s->st_ctimespec.tv_sec;p.ctime_nsec=s->st_ctimespec.tv_nsec;
 p.birth_sec=s->st_birthtimespec.tv_sec;p.birth_nsec=s->st_birthtimespec.tv_nsec;
 return p;
}
static int proof_equal(const RomfsProof *a,const RomfsProof *b) {
 return !memcmp(a->magic,b->magic,sizeof a->magic)&&!memcmp(a->sha256,b->sha256,sizeof a->sha256)
  &&a->dev==b->dev&&a->ino==b->ino&&a->size==b->size
  &&a->mtime_sec==b->mtime_sec&&a->mtime_nsec==b->mtime_nsec
  &&a->ctime_sec==b->ctime_sec&&a->ctime_nsec==b->ctime_nsec
  &&a->birth_sec==b->birth_sec&&a->birth_nsec==b->birth_nsec;
}
/* Split image: one record per part, all of which must be unchanged for the earlier full hash to be reused. */
static void chunk_proofs(RomfsProof *out) {
 /* ctime is left out: reinstalling the iOS app touches the data container's file metadata (ctime) without changing a
    byte, which made every launch hash 17 GB again. A content change still moves mtime (and size). */
 for(unsigned c=0;c<nchunks;c++){struct stat st;need(fstat(chunk_fds[c],&st)==0&&S_ISREG(st.st_mode),"RomFS part stat");out[c]=proof_for(&st);out[c].ctime_sec=out[c].ctime_nsec=0;}
}
static void verify_chunks(const char *dir) {
 RomfsProof want[MAX_CHUNKS],saved[MAX_CHUNKS],after[MAX_CHUNKS];size_t bytes=nchunks*sizeof(RomfsProof);chunk_proofs(want);
 const char *pdir=getenv("TOTK_ROMFS_PROOF_DIR");if(pdir&&*pdir)dir=pdir;   /* iOS: directories devicectl creates belong to root */
 char path[4096],tmp[4096];need(snprintf(path,sizeof(path),"%s/.romfs-verified-parts-v1",dir)<(int)sizeof(path),"RomFS proof path");
 int force=getenv("TOTK_ROMFS_VERIFY")&&!strcmp(getenv("TOTK_ROMFS_VERIFY"),"full");
 int proof_fd=open(path,O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW);
 if(proof_fd>=0){struct stat ps;int ok=fstat(proof_fd,&ps)==0&&S_ISREG(ps.st_mode)&&(size_t)ps.st_size==bytes&&read(proof_fd,saved,bytes)==(ssize_t)bytes;close(proof_fd);
  if(ok&&!force&&!memcmp(saved,want,bytes)){fprintf(stderr,"[totk] RomFS parts unchanged; reused full SHA256 verification record (%u parts)\n",nchunks);runtime_boot_progress(TOTK_UI("游戏资源校验记录有效","Game data verification record is valid"),ROMFS_IMAGE_SIZE,ROMFS_IMAGE_SIZE);return;}}
 fprintf(stderr,"[totk] verifying local RomFS SHA256 over %u parts (%llu bytes)%s\n",nchunks,(unsigned long long)ROMFS_IMAGE_SIZE,force?" [forced]":"");
 runtime_boot_progress(TOTK_UI("校验游戏资源","Verifying game data"),0,ROMFS_IMAGE_SIZE);sha_fd(image_fd,ROMFS_IMAGE_SHA256,ROMFS_IMAGE_SIZE,TOTK_UI("校验游戏资源","Verifying game data"));
 chunk_proofs(after);need(!memcmp(after,want,bytes),"RomFS changed during verification");
 if(snprintf(tmp,sizeof(tmp),"%s/.romfs-verified-parts-v1.%ld.tmp",dir,(long)getpid())>=(int)sizeof(tmp))return;
 int out=open(tmp,O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_EXCL,0600);
 if(out>=0){ssize_t n=write(out,want,bytes);int ok=n==(ssize_t)bytes&&fsync(out)==0;close(out);if(ok){if(rename(tmp,path)!=0)unlink(tmp);}else unlink(tmp);}
}
static void open_chunks(const char *dir) {
 uint64_t total=0;
 for(;nchunks<MAX_CHUNKS;nchunks++){char path[4096];need(snprintf(path,sizeof(path),"%s/romfs.bin.%03u",dir,nchunks)<(int)sizeof(path),"RomFS part path");
  int fd=open(path,O_RDONLY);if(fd<0)break;struct stat st;need(fstat(fd,&st)==0&&st.st_size>0,"RomFS part stat");
  if(!nchunks)chunk_size=(uint64_t)st.st_size;else need(chunk_fds[nchunks-1]>=0&&total==(uint64_t)nchunks*chunk_size,"RomFS parts must have equal sizes except the last");
  chunk_fds[nchunks]=fd;total+=(uint64_t)st.st_size;}
 need(nchunks>0,"RomFS image missing (romfs.bin or romfs.bin.000...)");
 need(total==ROMFS_IMAGE_SIZE,"RomFS parts do not add up to the image size");
 image_fd=chunk_fds[0];
 fprintf(stderr,"[totk] RomFS image in %u parts of %llu bytes\n",nchunks,(unsigned long long)chunk_size);
}
static void verify_image(int fd,const char *dir) {
 if(nchunks){verify_chunks(dir);return;}
 const char *pdir=getenv("TOTK_ROMFS_PROOF_DIR");if(pdir&&*pdir)dir=pdir;
 struct stat before,after;need(fstat(fd,&before)==0&&S_ISREG(before.st_mode),"RomFS image stat");
 RomfsProof want=proof_for(&before),saved;
 char path[4096],tmp[4096];need(snprintf(path,sizeof(path),"%s/.romfs-verified-v1",dir)<(int)sizeof(path),"RomFS proof path");
 int force=getenv("TOTK_ROMFS_VERIFY")&&!strcmp(getenv("TOTK_ROMFS_VERIFY"),"full");
 int proof_fd=open(path,O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW);
 if(proof_fd>=0){struct stat ps;int ok=fstat(proof_fd,&ps)==0&&S_ISREG(ps.st_mode)&&ps.st_size==sizeof(saved)&&read(proof_fd,&saved,sizeof(saved))==sizeof(saved);close(proof_fd);
  if(ok&&!force&&proof_equal(&saved,&want)){fprintf(stderr,"[totk] RomFS unchanged; reused full SHA256 verification record (%llu bytes)\n",(unsigned long long)want.size);runtime_boot_progress(TOTK_UI("游戏资源校验记录有效","Game data verification record is valid"),want.size,want.size);return;}}
 fprintf(stderr,"[totk] verifying local RomFS SHA256 (%llu bytes)%s\n",(unsigned long long)want.size,force?" [forced]":"");
 runtime_boot_progress(TOTK_UI("校验游戏资源","Verifying game data"),0,want.size);sha_fd(fd,ROMFS_IMAGE_SHA256,want.size,TOTK_UI("校验游戏资源","Verifying game data"));
 need(fstat(fd,&after)==0,"RomFS image stat after hash");
 RomfsProof finished=proof_for(&after);need(proof_equal(&want,&finished),"RomFS changed during verification");
 if(snprintf(tmp,sizeof(tmp),"%s/.romfs-verified-v1.%ld.tmp",dir,(long)getpid())>=(int)sizeof(tmp))return;
 int out=open(tmp,O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_EXCL,0600);
 if(out>=0){ssize_t n=write(out,&want,sizeof(want));int ok=n==sizeof(want)&&fsync(out)==0;close(out);
  if(ok){if(rename(tmp,path)!=0)unlink(tmp);}else unlink(tmp);}
}
static void sha_range(int fd,uint64_t offset,uint64_t size,const char *expected,const char *what) {
 size_t cap=size<(8u<<20)?(size_t)size:(8u<<20);CC_SHA256_CTX c;CC_SHA256_Init(&c);uint8_t *buffer=malloc(cap?cap:1);need(buffer!=NULL,"hash buffer");
 for(uint64_t done=0;done<size;){size_t chunk=size-done>cap?cap:(size_t)(size-done);ssize_t n=src_pread(fd,buffer,chunk,(off_t)(offset+done));need(n>0,"read hash input");CC_SHA256_Update(&c,buffer,(CC_LONG)n);done+=(uint64_t)n;}
 uint8_t d[32];char hex[65];CC_SHA256_Final(d,&c);free(buffer);for(unsigned i=0;i<32;i++)snprintf(hex+i*2,3,"%02x",d[i]);
 if(strcmp(hex,expected)){fprintf(stderr,"[totk] RomFS overlay: %s SHA-256 %s, manifest says %s\n",what,hex,expected);runtime_fail("RomFS overlay integrity mismatch");}
}
static uint64_t lower(const char *name);
static int path_ok(const char *p);
static void overlay_load(const char *dir,int required) {
 char path[4096];need(snprintf(path,sizeof(path),"%s/manifest.tsv",dir)<(int)sizeof(path),"RomFS overlay path");FILE *m=fopen(path,"r");
 if(!m&&required){fprintf(stderr,"[totk] RomFS overlay: %s missing; build it with scripts/make_output_res_overlay.py <w>x<h>\n",path);runtime_fail("true-2K HeapDef overlay missing (make romfs-patches-out OUTPUT_RES=<w>x<h>)");}
 if(!m){fprintf(stderr,"[totk] RomFS overlay: none (%s)\n",path);return;}
 char line[8192];size_t first=noverlay;uint64_t hashed=0,t0=runtime_now_ns();
 while(fgets(line,sizeof(line),m)){
  if(line[0]=='#'||line[0]=='\n')continue;char name[4096],sha[65],orig[65];unsigned long long size=0;
  need(sscanf(line,"%4095[^\t]\t%llu\t%64[0-9a-f]\t%64[0-9a-f-]",name,&size,sha,orig)==4&&strlen(sha)==64&&(strlen(orig)==64||!strcmp(orig,"-")),"RomFS overlay manifest line");
  need(path_ok(name),"RomFS overlay path");uint64_t i=lower(name);int known=i<file_count&&!strcmp(entry_name(entry(i)),name),add=!strcmp(orig,"-");
  if(!known&&!add){fprintf(stderr,"[totk] RomFS overlay: %s/manifest.tsv names %s, which the RomFS lacks; a new file has \"-\" as its original's SHA-256\n",dir,name);runtime_fail("RomFS overlay names a file the RomFS lacks");}
  if(known&&add){fprintf(stderr,"[totk] RomFS overlay: %s/manifest.tsv adds %s, which the RomFS already has; give its original's SHA-256\n",dir,name);runtime_fail("RomFS overlay adds a file the RomFS already has");}
  Entry e={0};if(known){e=entry(i);sha_range(image_fd,e.offset,e.size,orig,"original");}else i=ADDED;
  char file[8200];need(snprintf(file,sizeof(file),"%s/%s",dir,name)<(int)sizeof(file),"RomFS overlay file path");int fd=open(file,O_RDONLY|O_CLOEXEC);struct stat st;
  need(fd>=0&&fstat(fd,&st)==0&&(uint64_t)st.st_size==size,"RomFS overlay file missing or wrong size");sha_range(fd,0,size,sha,name);close(fd);
  hashed+=e.size+size;
  if(noverlay==overlay_cap){overlay_cap=overlay_cap?overlay_cap*2:16;overlays=realloc(overlays,overlay_cap*sizeof(*overlays));need(overlays!=NULL,"RomFS overlay table");}
  char *copy=strdup(file),*rel=strdup(name);need(copy&&rel,"RomFS overlay path copy");overlays[noverlay++]=(Overlay){i,size,copy,st.st_dev,st.st_ino,st.st_mtimespec,rel};
  if(noverlay-first<=16)fprintf(stderr,"[totk] RomFS overlay: %s (%llu bytes) %s\n",name,size,add?"is added":"replaces the original");
 }
 fclose(m);
 if(noverlay-first>16)fprintf(stderr,"[totk] RomFS overlay: %zu files from %s (%zu more not listed)\n",noverlay-first,dir,noverlay-first-16);
 if(noverlay>first)fprintf(stderr,"[totk] RomFS overlay: %s checked, %zu files, %.1f MB hashed in %.2f s\n",dir,noverlay-first,hashed/1048576.0,(runtime_now_ns()-t0)/1e9);
}
static int overlay_order(const void *a,const void *b) {uint64_t x=((const Overlay *)a)->index,y=((const Overlay *)b)->index;return (x>y)-(x<y);}
static int added_order(const void *a,const void *b) {const Overlay *x=*(Overlay *const *)a,*y=*(Overlay *const *)b;return strcmp(x->name,y->name);}
/* Number the added files in path order after the RomFS's own (file_count + k); two overlays adding one path stop the start. */
static void added_init(void) {
 Overlay **list=NULL;for(size_t k=0;k<noverlay;k++)if(overlays[k].index==ADDED){list=realloc(list,(nadded+1)*sizeof(*list));need(list!=NULL,"RomFS added files");list[nadded++]=&overlays[k];}
 if(!nadded)return;
 qsort(list,nadded,sizeof(*list),added_order);added=malloc(nadded*sizeof(*added));need(added!=NULL,"RomFS added files");
 for(size_t k=0;k<nadded;k++){
  if(k&&!strcmp(list[k]->name,list[k-1]->name)){fprintf(stderr,"[totk] RomFS overlay: %s and %s both add %s\n",list[k-1]->path,list[k]->path,list[k]->name);runtime_fail("RomFS overlay: two overlays add the same file (see the log; remove it from one of the manifests)");}
  list[k]->index=file_count+k;added[k]=list[k]->name;}
 free(list);fprintf(stderr,"[totk] RomFS overlay: %zu files added to the RomFS\n",nadded);
}
/* The index of RomFS path p (an added file: file_count + k), or UINT64_MAX. */
static uint64_t file_index(const char *p) {
 uint64_t i=lower(p);if(i<file_count&&!strcmp(p,entry_name(entry(i))))return i;
 size_t lo=0,hi=nadded;while(lo<hi){size_t m=lo+(hi-lo)/2;if(strcmp(added[m],p)<0)lo=m+1;else hi=m;}
 return lo<nadded&&!strcmp(added[lo],p)?file_count+lo:UINT64_MAX;
}
/* 1 when a RomFS file or an added one lies under folder (path ending in '/'). */
static int folder_exists(const char *folder) {
 size_t n=strlen(folder);uint64_t i=lower(folder);if(i<file_count&&!strncmp(entry_name(entry(i)),folder,n))return 1;
 size_t lo=0,hi=nadded;while(lo<hi){size_t m=lo+(hi-lo)/2;if(strcmp(added[m],folder)<0)lo=m+1;else hi=m;}
 return lo<nadded&&!strncmp(added[lo],folder,n);
}
/* The overlay slot + 1 that replaces RomFS file i, or 0. */
static uint32_t overlay_slot(uint64_t i) {size_t lo=0,hi=noverlay;while(lo<hi){size_t m=lo+(hi-lo)/2;if(overlays[m].index<i)lo=m+1;else hi=m;}return lo<noverlay&&overlays[lo].index==i?(uint32_t)(lo+1):0;}
/* TOTK_ROMFS_PATCHES (default extracted/<version>/romfs-patches; 0 = none); with a true-2K output bigger than 1920x1080
   also <TOTK_ROMFS_PATCHES_OUT, default extracted/<version>/romfs-patches-out>/<w>x<h> (the HeapDef sizes,
   scripts/make_output_res_overlay.py); then the player's mods in TOTK_ROMFS_MODS (0 = none). */
static void overlay_init(void) {
 const char *dir=getenv("TOTK_ROMFS_PATCHES");if(!dir||strcmp(dir,"0"))overlay_load(dir?dir:"extracted/" TOTK_GAME_DIR "/romfs-patches",0);
 unsigned w,h;if(runtime_output_res(&w,&h)&&runtime_output_res_extra_bytes()){const char *out=getenv("TOTK_ROMFS_PATCHES_OUT");char d[4096];
  need(snprintf(d,sizeof(d),"%s/%ux%u",out?out:"extracted/" TOTK_GAME_DIR "/romfs-patches-out",w,h)<(int)sizeof(d),"RomFS output overlay path");overlay_load(d,1);}
 const char *mods=getenv("TOTK_ROMFS_MODS");if(mods&&*mods&&strcmp(mods,"0"))overlay_load(mods,0);
 added_init();
 if(noverlay)qsort(overlays,noverlay,sizeof(*overlays),overlay_order);
 for(size_t k=1;k<noverlay;k++)if(overlays[k].index==overlays[k-1].index){
  fprintf(stderr,"[totk] RomFS overlay: %s and %s replace the same file %s\n",overlays[k-1].path,overlays[k].path,overlays[k].name);
  runtime_fail("RomFS overlay: two overlays replace the same file (see the log; remove it from one of the manifests)");}
}
void runtime_fs_init(void) {
 if(image_fd>=0)return;
 const char *dir=getenv("TOTK_ROMFS");if(!dir)dir="extracted/" TOTK_GAME_DIR "/romfs";char path[4096];
 need(snprintf(path,sizeof(path),"%s/runtime-index.bin",dir)<(int)sizeof(path),"RomFS path");int fd=open(path,O_RDONLY);need(fd>=0,"RomFS index missing");
 struct stat st;need(fstat(fd,&st)==0&&st.st_size>=24&&st.st_size<128*1024*1024,"RomFS index size");runtime_boot_progress(TOTK_UI("读取资源索引","Reading the data index"),0,0);sha_fd(fd,ROMFS_INDEX_SHA256,0,NULL);
 index_size=(size_t)st.st_size;index_bytes=mmap(NULL,index_size,PROT_READ,MAP_PRIVATE,fd,0);close(fd);need(index_bytes!=MAP_FAILED,"map RomFS index");
 need(!memcmp(index_bytes,"TOTKRFS1",8),"RomFS index format");memcpy(&file_count,index_bytes+8,8);memcpy(&strings_offset,index_bytes+16,8);
 need(file_count<1000000&&strings_offset==24+file_count*24&&strings_offset<index_size,"RomFS index layout");
 const char *previous=NULL;
 for(uint64_t i=0;i<file_count;i++){Entry e=entry(i);need(e.offset<=ROMFS_IMAGE_SIZE&&e.size<=ROMFS_IMAGE_SIZE-e.offset,"RomFS file bounds");need(e.name<index_size-strings_offset&&e.len>1&&e.len<=index_size-strings_offset-e.name,"RomFS name bounds");const char *name=entry_name(e);need(name[e.len-1]==0&&strlen(name)==e.len-1&&(!previous||strcmp(previous,name)<0),"RomFS sorted paths");previous=name;}
 need(snprintf(path,sizeof(path),"%s/romfs.bin",dir)<(int)sizeof(path),"RomFS image path");image_fd=open(path,O_RDONLY);
 if(image_fd<0)open_chunks(dir);
 else need(fstat(image_fd,&st)==0&&(uint64_t)st.st_size==ROMFS_IMAGE_SIZE,"RomFS image size");
 verify_image(image_fd,dir);
 if(!nchunks&&getenv("TOTK_ROMFS_MMAP")&&strcmp(getenv("TOTK_ROMFS_MMAP"),"0")){
  void *mapped=mmap(NULL,(size_t)ROMFS_IMAGE_SIZE,PROT_READ,MAP_PRIVATE,image_fd,0);
  if(mapped!=MAP_FAILED){image_map=mapped;fprintf(stderr,"[totk] RomFS mmap read path enabled\n");}
  else fprintf(stderr,"[totk] RomFS mmap failed (%s); using pread\n",strerror(errno));
 }
 runtime_boot_status(TOTK_UI("准备游戏资源","Preparing game data"),TOTK_UI("检查分辨率补丁并挂载只读游戏资源","Checking the resolution patch and mounting the read-only game data"));
 overlay_init();
 fprintf(stderr,"[totk] native read-only RomFS ready: %llu files\n",(unsigned long long)file_count);
}
static int path_ok(const char *p) {return romfs_path_valid_relative(p);}
static const char *rom_path(const char *path) {
 return romfs_path_relative(mount_name,path);
}
static uint64_t lower(const char *name) {uint64_t lo=0,hi=file_count;while(lo<hi){uint64_t m=lo+(hi-lo)/2;if(strcmp(entry_name(entry(m)),name)<0)lo=m+1;else hi=m;}return lo;}
static unsigned mount_rom(const char *name,void *cache,uint64_t size) {
 (void)cache;(void)size;runtime_fs_init();if(!name||!path_ok(name)||strlen(name)>=sizeof(mount_name)||strchr(name,'/')||strchr(name,':'))return INVALID;

}

static unsigned cache_size(uint64_t *out) {if(!out)return INVALID;*out=0;return 0;}
/* TOTK_FS_LOG=1: log every RomFS open with the time since start (shows how far the game gets without a picture). */
static void fs_log(const char *what,const char *path){static int on=-1;static uint64_t t0;if(on<0){on=getenv("TOTK_FS_LOG")!=NULL;t0=runtime_now_ns();}if(on)fprintf(stderr,"[totk-fs] %8.3f %s %s\n",(runtime_now_ns()-t0)/1e9,what,path);}

unsigned runtime_romfs_open(uint64_t *out,const char *path,int mode) {
 fs_log("rom",path?path:"(null)");
 if(!out||mode!=1)return UNSUPPORTED;const char *p=rom_path(path);if(!p)return NOT_FOUND;uint64_t i=file_index(p);if(i==UINT64_MAX)return NOT_FOUND;

 if(ov){const Overlay *o=&overlays[ov-1];fd=open(o->path,O_RDONLY|O_CLOEXEC);struct stat st;
  if(fd<0||fstat(fd,&st)!=0||(uint64_t)st.st_size!=o->size||st.st_dev!=o->dev||st.st_ino!=o->ino||st.st_mtimespec.tv_sec!=o->mtime.tv_sec||st.st_mtimespec.tv_nsec!=o->mtime.tv_nsec){
   fprintf(stderr,"[totk] RomFS overlay: %s is missing or changed since the start check\n",o->path);runtime_fail("RomFS overlay file changed while the game ran (restart the game)");}}
 pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);for(unsigned j=1;j<NH;j++)if(!handles[j]){handles[j]=i+1;handle_ovl[j]=ov;handle_fd[j]=fd;*out=0x100000000ULL+j;pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);return 0;}pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);runtime_fail("file handle table full");return INVALID;
}
static int handle_entry(uint64_t h,Entry *e) {if(h<=0x100000000ULL||h>=0x100000000ULL+NH)return 0;pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);uint64_t i=handles[h-0x100000000ULL];pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);if(!i)return 0;*e=i-1<file_count?entry(i-1):(Entry){0};return 1;}   /* an added file's bytes are all in its overlay */
/* Where an open handle's bytes come from: the overlay file, or the original's range of the image. */
static void handle_source(uint64_t h,const Entry *e,int *fd,uint64_t *base,uint64_t *size) {
 pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);uint32_t ov=handle_ovl[h-0x100000000ULL];int ofd=handle_fd[h-0x100000000ULL];pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);
 if(ov){*fd=ofd;*base=0;*size=overlays[ov-1].size;}else{*fd=image_fd;*base=e->offset;*size=e->size;}
}
unsigned runtime_romfs_read(uint64_t *out,uint64_t h,int64_t offset,void *buffer,uint64_t size) {
 Entry e;if(!out||offset<0||!handle_entry(h,&e))return INVALID;int fd;uint64_t base,fsize;handle_source(h,&e,&fd,&base,&fsize);if((uint64_t)offset>fsize||(!buffer&&size))return INVALID;
 uint64_t n=size;if(n>fsize-(uint64_t)offset)n=fsize-(uint64_t)offset;uint64_t done=0;
 static _Atomic int profile_mode=-1;int profile=atomic_load(&profile_mode);if(profile<0){profile=getenv("TOTK_FS_TIMING")!=NULL;atomic_store(&profile_mode,profile);}uint64_t prep_start=profile?runtime_now_ns():0;
 dm_guest_write_prepare(buffer,(size_t)n);
 uint64_t t0=profile?runtime_now_ns():0;
 if(fd==image_fd&&image_map){memcpy(buffer,image_map+base+(uint64_t)offset,(size_t)n);done=n;}
 else while(done<n){size_t chunk=(size_t)(n-done);if(chunk>8<<20)chunk=8<<20;ssize_t r=src_pread(fd,(uint8_t *)buffer+done,chunk,(off_t)(base+(uint64_t)offset+done));if(r<=0)runtime_fail("RomFS read failure");done+=(uint64_t)r;}
 if(profile){uint64_t now=runtime_now_ns();atomic_fetch_add(&read_calls,1);atomic_fetch_add(&read_bytes,done);atomic_fetch_add(&read_ns,now-t0);atomic_fetch_add(&read_prepare_ns,t0-prep_start);
  uint64_t last=atomic_load(&read_report_ns);
  if(now-last>1000000000ULL&&atomic_compare_exchange_strong(&read_report_ns,&last,now))
   fprintf(stderr,"[totk-fs] read window t=%.3f calls=%llu bytes=%llu wall_ms=%.3f prepare_ms=%.3f\n",now/1e9,
    (unsigned long long)atomic_exchange(&read_calls,0),(unsigned long long)atomic_exchange(&read_bytes,0),atomic_exchange(&read_ns,0)/1e6,atomic_exchange(&read_prepare_ns,0)/1e6);}
 *out=done;return 0;
}
unsigned runtime_romfs_size(int64_t *out,uint64_t h) {Entry e;if(!out||!handle_entry(h,&e))return INVALID;int fd;uint64_t base,size;handle_source(h,&e,&fd,&base,&size);*out=(int64_t)size;return 0;}
void runtime_romfs_close(uint64_t h) {Entry e;if(!handle_entry(h,&e))runtime_fail("close invalid file handle");uint64_t j=h-0x100000000ULL;pthread_mutex_lock(&lock);int fd=handle_ovl[j]?handle_fd[j]:-1;handles[j]=0;handle_ovl[j]=0;handle_fd[j]=-1;pthread_mutex_unlock(&lock);if(fd>=0)close(fd);}
unsigned runtime_romfs_entry_type(int *out,const char *path) {
 if(!out)return INVALID;const char *p=rom_path(path);if(!p)return NOT_FOUND;if(file_index(p)!=UINT64_MAX){*out=1;return 0;}

}
/* Directory listing (Bayonetta 3 lists Contents:/): the immediate children of a folder, from the sorted index and the
   added files. A name with no further '/' is a file; the first segment of a longer one is a subfolder, and the sorted
   order keeps a subfolder's paths together, so each is reported once per source. */
static void list_source(const char *prefix,size_t n,int mode,const char *(*name_at)(uint64_t),uint64_t (*size_at)(uint64_t),uint64_t from,uint64_t to,
                        void (*add)(void *,const char *,int,int64_t),void *ctx,char *last_dir) {
 for(uint64_t i=from;i<to;i++){const char *full=name_at(i);if(strncmp(full,prefix,n))break;const char *rest=full+n,*slash=strchr(rest,'/');
  if(!slash){if(mode&2)add(ctx,rest,0,(int64_t)size_at(i));continue;}
  size_t k=(size_t)(slash-rest);if(k>=768)continue;if(!strncmp(last_dir,rest,k)&&!last_dir[k])continue;
  memcpy(last_dir,rest,k);last_dir[k]=0;if(mode&1)add(ctx,last_dir,1,0);}
}
static const char *list_index_name(uint64_t i){return entry_name(entry(i));}
static uint64_t list_index_size(uint64_t i){return entry(i).size;}
static const char *added_name(uint64_t k){return added[k];}
static uint64_t added_size(uint64_t k){char full[4200];snprintf(full,sizeof full,"%s:/%s",mount_name,added[k]);uint64_t h;int64_t size=0;if(runtime_romfs_open(&h,full,1))return 0;runtime_romfs_size(&size,h);runtime_romfs_close(h);return (uint64_t)size;}
unsigned runtime_romfs_list(const char *path,int mode,void (*add)(void *ctx,const char *name,int is_dir,int64_t size),void *ctx) {
 /* A folder may be named with trailing slashes, and the mount root ("Contents:/") is the empty path; files keep the strict check. */
 char trimmed[4096];if(!path||snprintf(trimmed,sizeof trimmed,"%s",path)>=(int)sizeof trimmed)return INVALID;
 size_t tl=strlen(trimmed),ml=strlen(mount_name);while(tl>ml+2&&trimmed[tl-1]=='/')trimmed[--tl]=0;
 int root=!strncmp(trimmed,mount_name,ml)&&trimmed[ml]==':'&&(!trimmed[ml+1]||(trimmed[ml+1]=='/'&&!trimmed[ml+2]));
 const char *p=root?"":rom_path(trimmed);if(!p)return NOT_FOUND;char prefix[4096];
 if(snprintf(prefix,sizeof prefix,"%s%s",p,*p&&p[strlen(p)-1]!='/'?"/":"")>=(int)sizeof prefix)return INVALID;
 size_t n=strlen(prefix);if(n&&!folder_exists(prefix))return NOT_FOUND;

 size_t lo=0,hi=nadded;while(lo<hi){size_t m=lo+(hi-lo)/2;if(strcmp(added[m],prefix)<0)lo=m+1;else hi=m;}
 last[0]=0;list_source(prefix,n,mode,added_name,added_size,lo,nadded,add,ctx,last);
 return 0;
}

    actual resource lookup and bytes, while still rejecting path traversal. */

   if(slash){*slash=0;need(!runtime_romfs_entry_type(&type,p)&&type==0,"probe added file's folder");*slash='/';}
   need(!runtime_romfs_entry_type(&type,p)&&type==1,"probe added file type");}uint64_t oh=0,n=0;int64_t size=0;uint8_t a[64],b[64];

}
```

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/host/romfs_path.h`:

```h
/* RomFS path validation shared by the runtime and game-data-free regressions. */
#pragma once
#include <stddef.h>
#include <string.h>

static inline int romfs_path_valid_relative(const char *path) {
    if (!path || !*path || *path == '/' || strchr(path, '\\')) return 0;
    for (const char *part = path; *part;) {
        const char *end = strchr(part, '/');
        size_t size = end ? (size_t)(end - part) : strlen(part);
        if (!size || (size == 1 && part[0] == '.') ||
            (size == 2 && part[0] == '.' && part[1] == '.')) return 0;
        if (!end) break;
        part = end + 1;
    }
    return 1;
}

static inline const char *romfs_path_relative(const char *mount, const char *path) {
    if (!mount || !*mount || !path) return NULL;
    size_t size = strlen(mount);
    if (strncmp(path, mount, size) || path[size] != ':' || path[size + 1] != '/')
        return NULL;
    path += size + 2;
    /* Audio stream requests join a mount root and a leading-slash resource,
       producing content://Sound/.... Normalize root separators only; keep
       rejecting traversal, backslashes and empty interior components. */
    while (*path == '/') ++path;
    return romfs_path_valid_relative(path) ? path : NULL;
}
```

```c
/* Horizon services reached by the current TOTK startup. Unknown operations fail. */
#include "runtime.h"
#include <TargetConditionals.h>
#include "ipc.h"
#include "game_version.h"

/* Guest address layout. The SDK encodes IPC buffer addresses with 39 bits (HIPC descriptor bits 36..38),
   so all guest memory must lie below 2^39. Darwin arm64 keeps 0x10_0000_0000..0x70_0000_0000 reserved,
   leaving exactly 64 GiB at 0x70_0000_0000 for the alias region (the real 39-bit Horizon size, which the
   game's allocators depend on); the stack and heap regions are reserved separately below it. */
#define GUEST_ADDRESS_LIMIT (1ULL<<39)
#define ALIAS_SPACE_AT 0x7000000000ULL
#define ALIAS_SIZE_MAX (64ULL<<30)
/* TOTK_ALIAS_GIB: alias region size reported to the game (default 64, the real 39-bit Horizon size). An iOS app signed
   without extended virtual addressing (unavailable to personal teams) gets a much smaller map: the old 6 + 16 GiB
   reservation failed on an iPhone, while 4.75 + 16 GiB fit on an iPad (A16, iPadOS 26.7). So the largest size from 16
   down to 4 GiB that fits is chosen at startup; the game maps about 3.3 GiB of it. */
#if TARGET_OS_IPHONE
#define ALIAS_DEFAULT_GIB 16
#define ALIAS_MIN_GIB 4ULL
#else
#define ALIAS_DEFAULT_GIB 64
#endif
static uint64_t alias_len;
static uint64_t alias_requested(void){const char *e=getenv("TOTK_ALIAS_GIB");uint64_t g=e?strtoull(e,NULL,0):ALIAS_DEFAULT_GIB;if(g<1||g>64)runtime_fail("TOTK_ALIAS_GIB must be 1..64");return g<<30;}
static uint64_t alias_size(void){if(!alias_len)alias_len=alias_requested();return alias_len;}
#define ALIAS_SIZE alias_size()
#define LOW_SEARCH_FROM 0x300000000ULL
#if TARGET_OS_IPHONE
#define LOW_SIZE (HEAP_OFF+HEAP_CAP)   /* iOS: no slack after the heap cap; address space is scarce */
#else
#define LOW_SIZE (6ULL<<30)
#endif
#define STACK_OFF 0x10000000ULL
#define STACK_SIZE 0x10000000ULL
#define HEAP_OFF (STACK_OFF+STACK_SIZE+0x10000000ULL)
static uint8_t *alias_space,*low_space,*heap;
static size_t heap_size;
static unsigned char alias_pages[ALIAS_SIZE_MAX/4096];
/* 4 KiB guest pages that are unmapped but whose host 16 KiB page is still committed with old contents: only these are
   zeroed when mapped again. Every other free page is untouched anonymous memory (zero on first touch), so mapping does
   not make it resident; a fully free 16 KiB host page is handed back to the system (fresh anonymous mapping). On the
   iPhone, where the app may use about 4 GB in total, memory the game maps but never touches must stay unbacked. */
static unsigned char alias_stale[ALIAS_SIZE_MAX/4096];
static uint64_t alias_bytes;
static uint8_t user_exception_context[0x1000] __attribute__((aligned(0x1000)));
#define SYSTEM_RESOURCE_BUDGET (32ULL<<20)
#define HEAP_CAP (4ULL<<30)   /* 1.4.3 sets a 2.2 GiB heap during nninitStartup */
#define APP_POOL app_pool()
static uint64_t app_pool(void){static uint64_t v;if(!v){const char *e=getenv("TOTK_APP_POOL");uint64_t extra=(runtime_output_res_extra_bytes()+runtime_render_pool_extra()+0x1fffff)&~0x1fffffULL;
 v=e?strtoull(e,NULL,0):0xcd500000ULL+extra;if(!e&&extra)fprintf(stderr,"[totk] application pool %#llx: +%llu MiB for the bigger texture heaps (TOTK_OUTPUT_RES, TOTK_RENDER_RES)\n",(unsigned long long)v,(unsigned long long)(extra>>20));}return v;}
/* TOTK: application memory pool reported to the game (default: retail 3.2 GiB; TOTK_OUTPUT_RES adds what its HeapDef overlay gives the texture heaps) */
#define ALIAS_START ((uintptr_t)alias_space)
#define STACK_START ((uintptr_t)low_space+STACK_OFF)
#define ASLR_START ((uintptr_t)low_space)
#if TARGET_OS_IPHONE
#define ASLR_SIZE (ALIAS_START+ALIAS_SIZE-(uintptr_t)low_space)   /* iOS: everything the process can map ends far below 2^39 */
#else
#define ASLR_SIZE (GUEST_ADDRESS_LIMIT-(uintptr_t)low_space)
#endif
static uint8_t *reserve_fixed(uint64_t at,uint64_t size){
 mach_vm_address_t a=at;   /* FIXED without OVERWRITE: fails instead of replacing an existing mapping */
 return mach_vm_map(mach_task_self(),&a,size,0,VM_FLAGS_FIXED,MEMORY_OBJECT_NULL,0,FALSE,VM_PROT_NONE,VM_PROT_ALL,VM_INHERIT_DEFAULT)==KERN_SUCCESS?(uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)a:NULL;
}
#if TARGET_OS_IPHONE
#define GUEST_ALIGN (2ULL<<20)
/* Reserve size bytes in the lowest free gap of this process's map above 4 GiB (2 MiB aligned). The end of the map is
   not reported, so the last gap is only tried; FIXED fails there with KERN_NO_SPACE when it reaches past the end. */
static uint8_t *reserve_in_gap(uint64_t size,int log){
 uint64_t prev=1ULL<<32;
 for(;;){
  mach_vm_address_t r=prev;mach_vm_size_t rsize=0;vm_region_basic_info_data_64_t info;mach_msg_type_number_t n=VM_REGION_BASIC_INFO_COUNT_64;mach_port_t obj=MACH_PORT_NULL;
  int more=mach_vm_region(mach_task_self(),&r,&rsize,VM_REGION_BASIC_INFO_64,(vm_region_info_t)&info,&n,&obj)==KERN_SUCCESS;
  uint64_t start=(prev+GUEST_ALIGN-1)&~(GUEST_ALIGN-1),end=more?r:GUEST_ADDRESS_LIMIT;
  if(end>start&&end-start>=(256ULL<<20)&&log)fprintf(stderr,"[totk-mem] free %#llx..%s%#llx\n",(unsigned long long)start,more?"":"(end of map, at most) ",(unsigned long long)end);
  if(end>start&&end-start>=size){uint8_t *p=reserve_fixed(start,size);if(p)return p;}
  if(!more)return NULL;
  prev=r+rsize;
 }
}
#endif
static void memory_init(void) {
 if(alias_space)return;
#if TARGET_OS_IPHONE
 /* iOS: stack+heap and the alias region go side by side in one reservation (ASLR_SIZE spans both), placed in the lowest
    free gap that holds them. The free space depends on the device, so the alias region shrinks from the requested size
    to ALIAS_MIN_GIB before giving up (logging the free gaps); TOTK_ALIAS_GIB pins one size. */
 uint64_t want=alias_requested(),least=getenv("TOTK_ALIAS_GIB")?want:(ALIAS_MIN_GIB<<30);
 for(uint64_t a=want;a>=least&&!low_space;a-=1ULL<<30)if((low_space=reserve_in_gap(LOW_SIZE+a,0)))alias_len=a;
 if(!low_space){reserve_in_gap(UINT64_MAX,1);runtime_fail("reserve guest stack, heap and alias regions");}
 alias_space=low_space+LOW_SIZE;
#else
 alias_space=reserve_fixed(ALIAS_SPACE_AT,ALIAS_SIZE);
 if(alias_space)for(uint64_t at=LOW_SEARCH_FROM;at+LOW_SIZE<=ALIAS_SPACE_AT&&!low_space;at+=1ULL<<30)low_space=reserve_fixed(at,LOW_SIZE);
 if(!low_space){
  /* macOS 27: the shared cache fills 0x1_8000_0000..0xF_C000_0000 and the system reserves ~24 GiB at a random place in
     0x70_0000_0000..2^39, so neither fixed region fits. As on iOS, put stack+heap and the alias region side by side in one
     free hole, shrinking the alias region (the game uses < 3 GiB of it) until it fits. TOTK_ALIAS_GIB pins one size. */
  if(alias_space)mach_vm_deallocate(mach_task_self(),(mach_vm_address_t)(uintptr_t)alias_space,ALIAS_SIZE);
  uint64_t want=alias_requested(),least=getenv("TOTK_ALIAS_GIB")?want:(8ULL<<30);
  for(uint64_t g=want;!low_space;g-=4ULL<<30){
   for(uint64_t at=LOW_SEARCH_FROM;at+LOW_SIZE+g<=GUEST_ADDRESS_LIMIT&&!low_space;at+=1ULL<<30)
    if((low_space=reserve_fixed(at,LOW_SIZE+g)))alias_len=g;
   if(g<least+(4ULL<<30))break;
  }
  if(!low_space)runtime_fail(getenv("TOTK_ALIAS_GIB")?"reserve guest stack, heap and the TOTK_ALIAS_GIB alias region below 2^39":"reserve guest stack, heap and alias regions below 2^39");
  alias_space=low_space+LOW_SIZE;
 }
#endif
 heap=low_space+HEAP_OFF;
 fprintf(stderr,"[totk] guest layout: alias %#llx+%#llx stack %#llx+%#llx heap %#llx (cap %#llx)\n",(unsigned long long)ALIAS_START,ALIAS_SIZE,(unsigned long long)STACK_START,STACK_SIZE,(unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)heap,HEAP_CAP);
}
/* Scoped stack moves: independent host backing, copy back on unmap.
 * Logical accounting is 4 KiB; Darwin protections are rounded to 16 KiB.
 * The leading/trailing partial source pages cannot be isolated on this host.
 */
static pthread_mutex_t memory_lock=PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
typedef struct{uint64_t dst,src,size;} StackMap;static StackMap stack_maps[4096];static unsigned nstack_maps;
static int overlaps(uint64_t a,uint64_t n,uint64_t b,uint64_t m){return a<b+m&&b<a+n;}
/* crash_1031 毒化源判定：stack_move 历史环（容量 32，溢出覆盖最旧）。stack_maps[] 在 unmap 即删，
   而 H1 的毒化窗口恰在 unmap 拷回撞复用块之后，须留历史；写侧持 memory_lock，读侧（crash handler）
   只读+算术、无锁，async-signal-safe。全零槽位 lo=0 使 lo-0x4000 下溢成巨值，永不误命中。 */
typedef struct{uint64_t src_lo,src_hi,dst_lo,dst_hi,thread;} StackMoveRec;
#define STACK_MOVE_HIST 32
static StackMoveRec stack_move_hist[STACK_MOVE_HIST];static unsigned stack_move_hist_head;
int runtime_stack_move_hit(uint64_t addr,uint64_t *lo,uint64_t *hi){
 for(unsigned i=0;i<STACK_MOVE_HIST;i++){const StackMoveRec *r=&stack_move_hist[i];
  if(addr>=r->src_lo-0x4000&&addr<r->src_hi+0x4000){if(lo)*lo=r->src_lo;if(hi)*hi=r->src_hi;return 1;}
  if(addr>=r->dst_lo-0x4000&&addr<r->dst_hi+0x4000){if(lo)*lo=r->dst_lo;if(hi)*hi=r->dst_hi;return 1;}}
 return 0;
}
/* One-shot diagnostics for the silent stack_move rejects CreateAliasStackUnsafe retries 64 times over
   (guest SDK: MapAliasStack -> svc#4 -> stack_move error != 0xd401 -> silent 0 -> retry -> Break). */
static uint64_t stack_fail(int unmap,uint64_t dst,uint64_t src,uint64_t size,unsigned code,long bad_page){
 static unsigned logged;if(logged++<8)fprintf(stderr,"[totk-stack] %sMapMemory dst=%#llx src=%#llx size=%#llx ret=%#x STACK=[%#llx+%#llx) ALIAS=[%#llx+%#llx) HEAP=[%#llx+%#llx) badpage=%ld\n",
  unmap?"Un":"",(unsigned long long)dst,(unsigned long long)src,(unsigned long long)size,code,
  (unsigned long long)STACK_START,(unsigned long long)STACK_SIZE,(unsigned long long)ALIAS_START,(unsigned long long)ALIAS_SIZE,
  (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)heap,(unsigned long long)heap_size,bad_page);
 return code;
}
/* crash_1031 H1 修复（报告 §5.2）：4K 页主机（OHOS 真机）对整个源范围做页级替换——map 搬运完成后
   mmap(PROT_NONE|MAP_FIXED) 封死 [src,src+size)（真机语义：源区消失；首尾不再留 RW 部分页，线程
   存活期间堆视角触碰即 SIGSEGV，crash handler 的毒化源判定会直接指认）；unmap 先 mmap(RW|MAP_FIXED)
   换上全新匿名页再 memcpy 拷回（拷回永远落在全新页上，关掉"拷回撞堆复用/残留旧页"窗口）。
   src/size 已由入口检查保证 4K 对齐，整段替换无部分页。对外语义（返回码/成败判据/拷回内容）不变，
   只收紧页保护时序。16K 页主机（Darwin）保持旧 mprotect 内层页路径：4K 粒度 MAP_FIXED 被内核按
   16K 取整会殃及同页相邻堆数据（原注释 "cannot be isolated" 的物理限制，以安全为先）。
   已知残余：若线程存活期间 SetHeapSize 的 mprotect 恰好覆盖源范围会把封死页翻回 RW（boot 期
   SetHeapSize 早于线程创建，实际不可达，记录在案）。 */
static int stack_src_page_replace(void){static int mode;if(!mode)mode=sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE)==4096?1:-1;return mode>0;}
static uint64_t stack_move(int unmap,uint64_t dst,uint64_t src,uint64_t size){
 if(!size||((dst|src|size)&4095))return stack_fail(unmap,dst,src,size,0xcc01,-1);
 if(dst<STACK_START||size>STACK_SIZE||dst-STACK_START>STACK_SIZE-size)return stack_fail(unmap,dst,src,size,0xdc01,-1);
 int inHeap=src>=(uintptr_t)heap&&size<=heap_size&&src-(uintptr_t)heap<=heap_size-size;
 uint64_t aliasStart=ALIAS_START;
 int inAlias=src>=aliasStart&&size<=ALIAS_SIZE&&src-aliasStart<=ALIAS_SIZE-size;
 if(!inHeap&&!inAlias)return stack_fail(unmap,dst,src,size,0xdc01,-1);
 pthread_mutex_lock(&memory_lock);
 if(inAlias){unsigned first=(unsigned)((src-aliasStart)/4096);for(uint64_t i=0;i<size/4096;i++)if(!alias_pages[first+i]){pthread_mutex_unlock(&memory_lock);return stack_fail(unmap,dst,src,size,0xdc01,(long)(src+i*4096));}}

 unsigned found=nstack_maps;for(unsigned i=0;i<nstack_maps;i++)if(stack_maps[i].dst==dst&&stack_maps[i].src==src&&stack_maps[i].size==size)found=i;
 uint64_t lo=dst&~0x3fffULL,hi=(dst+size+0x3fff)&~0x3fffULL;
 uint64_t slo=(src+0x3fff)&~0x3fffULL,shi=(src+size)&~0x3fffULL;
 int replace=stack_src_page_replace();   /* H1 修复：4K 页走整段页替换，16K 页维持旧内层页路径 */
 if(unmap){
  if(found==nstack_maps){pthread_mutex_unlock(&memory_lock);return 0xd401;}
  if(replace){if(mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)src,size,PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE,MAP_FIXED|MAP_PRIVATE|MAP_ANON,-1,0)!=(void *)(uintptr_t)src)runtime_fail("remap moved stack source");}
  else if(shi>slo&&mprotect((void *)slo,shi-slo,PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE))runtime_fail("restore moved stack source");
  memcpy((void *)src,(const void *)dst,size);stack_maps[found]=stack_maps[--nstack_maps];
  for(uint64_t page=lo;page<hi;page+=0x4000){int used=0;for(unsigned i=0;i<nstack_maps;i++)if(overlaps(page,0x4000,stack_maps[i].dst,stack_maps[i].size))used=1;
   if(!used&&mprotect((void *)page,0x4000,PROT_NONE))runtime_fail("decommit moved stack");}
 }else{
  if(nstack_maps==4096){pthread_mutex_unlock(&memory_lock);return 0xd401;}
  for(unsigned i=0;i<nstack_maps;i++)if(overlaps(dst,size,stack_maps[i].dst,stack_maps[i].size)||overlaps(src,size,stack_maps[i].src,stack_maps[i].size)){pthread_mutex_unlock(&memory_lock);return stack_fail(unmap,dst,src,size,0xdc01,-1);}
  if(mprotect((void *)lo,hi-lo,PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE))runtime_fail("commit moved stack");memcpy((void *)dst,(const void *)src,size);
  if(replace){if(mmap((void *)(uintptr_t)src,size,PROT_NONE,MAP_FIXED|MAP_PRIVATE|MAP_ANON,-1,0)!=(void *)(uintptr_t)src)runtime_fail("seal moved stack source");}
  else if(shi>slo&&mprotect((void *)slo,shi-slo,PROT_NONE))runtime_fail("protect moved stack source");
  stack_maps[nstack_maps++]=(StackMap){dst,src,size};
  {unsigned long long tid;pthread_threadid_np(NULL,&tid);stack_move_hist[stack_move_hist_head]=(StackMoveRec){src,src+size,dst,dst+size,tid};stack_move_hist_head=(stack_move_hist_head+1)%STACK_MOVE_HIST;}
 }
 pthread_mutex_unlock(&memory_lock);return 0;
}
static uint64_t alias_map(int unmap,uint64_t addr,uint64_t size){
 uint64_t start=ALIAS_START;
 if(!size||((addr|size)&4095))return 0xcc01;
 if(addr<start||size>ALIAS_SIZE||addr-start>ALIAS_SIZE-size)return 0xdc01;
 pthread_mutex_lock(&memory_lock);unsigned first=(unsigned)((addr-start)/4096),count=(unsigned)(size/4096);
 /* Horizon MapPhysicalMemory maps only the pages of the range that are still unmapped and leaves mapped pages (and their
    contents) untouched; TOTK's physical-memory heaps grow by re-mapping ranges that overlap what they already own. */
 uint64_t fresh=0;if(!unmap)for(unsigned i=0;i<count;i++)if(!alias_pages[first+i])fresh+=4096;
 /* Physical-memory resource reservation failure is LimitReached (132), not
    InvalidCurrentMemory (106). The original SDK maps LimitReached to its
    recoverable out-of-memory result; 0xd401 makes AllocateMemoryPages abort. */
 if(!unmap&&fresh+alias_bytes+heap_size+runtime_image_bytes()>APP_POOL){
  pthread_mutex_unlock(&memory_lock);
  const char *negative=getenv("TOTK_PROBE_NEGATIVE");
  return negative&&atoi(negative)==14?0xd401:0x10801;
 }
 if(unmap){
  for(unsigned i=0;i<nstack_maps;i++)if(overlaps(addr,size,stack_maps[i].src,stack_maps[i].size)){pthread_mutex_unlock(&memory_lock);return 0xdc01;}
  uint64_t released=0;for(unsigned i=0;i<count;i++)if(alias_pages[first+i]){alias_pages[first+i]=0;alias_stale[first+i]=1;released+=4096;}alias_bytes-=released;
  uint64_t low=addr&~0x3fffULL,high=(addr+size+0x3fff)&~0x3fffULL;
  for(uint64_t page=low;page<high;page+=0x4000){unsigned p=(unsigned)((page-start)/4096);if(!alias_pages[p]&&!alias_pages[p+1]&&!alias_pages[p+2]&&!alias_pages[p+3]){
   if(mmap((void *)page,0x4000,PROT_NONE,MAP_FIXED|MAP_PRIVATE|MAP_ANON,-1,0)!=(void *)page)runtime_fail("decommit physical alias page");
   memset(alias_stale+p,0,4);}}
 }else if(fresh){
  uint64_t low=addr&~0x3fffULL,high=(addr+size+0x3fff)&~0x3fffULL;
  if(mprotect((void *)low,high-low,PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE))runtime_fail("commit physical alias pages");
  for(unsigned i=0;i<count;i++)if(!alias_pages[first+i]){   /* new pages only: zero-filled like fresh pool pages */
   if(alias_stale[first+i]){memset((void *)(addr+(uint64_t)i*4096),0,4096);alias_stale[first+i]=0;}
   alias_pages[first+i]=1;}
  alias_bytes+=fresh;
 }
 pthread_mutex_unlock(&memory_lock);return 0;
}
uint64_t runtime_heap_base(void){return (uintptr_t)heap;}
void runtime_heap_range(uint8_t **base,size_t *size){*base=heap;*size=heap_size;}   /* key 4: the camera projection search (odyssey_aspect.c) */
/* Guest memory the game has committed (heap size + mapped alias pages), for memory reports (iOS app monitor). */
void runtime_guest_committed(uint64_t *heap_bytes,uint64_t *alias_mapped){*heap_bytes=heap_size;*alias_mapped=alias_bytes;}
/* Physical memory behind the guest regions (stack+heap and alias): resident pages, of which dirty, and pages the system
   compressed. Committed sizes overstate what the game uses; these are what count against the iOS memory limit. */
static void region_pages(uint64_t a,uint64_t end,uint64_t *resident,uint64_t *dirty,uint64_t *compressed){
 while(a<end){vm_address_t va=(vm_address_t)a;vm_size_t vs=0;natural_t depth=0;vm_region_submap_info_data_64_t info;mach_msg_type_number_t cnt=VM_REGION_SUBMAP_INFO_COUNT_64;
  if(vm_region_recurse_64(mach_task_self(),&va,&vs,&depth,(vm_region_recurse_info_t)&info,&cnt)!=KERN_SUCCESS||va>=end)break;
  *resident+=(uint64_t)info.pages_resident*vm_page_size;*dirty+=(uint64_t)info.pages_dirtied*vm_page_size;*compressed+=(uint64_t)info.pages_swapped_out*vm_page_size;
  a=(uint64_t)va+vs;}
}

/* The game's language: TOTK_LANG as given (a Switch language code), otherwise from a locale: TOTK_LOCALE, which the
   launcher sets to the app's first preferred language (BCP 47, e.g. "pt-BR"; it follows a per-app language), or else
   the Mac's current locale. Brazil maps to "pt-BR" only in the 1.4.3 build, whose RomFS has the official USpt text. */
uint64_t runtime_desired_language(void) {
 const char *explicit=getenv("TOTK_LANG");char code[8]={0};
 if(explicit){if(strlen(explicit)>7)runtime_fail("language code too long");memcpy(code,explicit,strlen(explicit));}
 else {
  char language[16]={0},region[4]={0};const char *tag=getenv("TOTK_LOCALE");
  if(tag&&*tag){
   size_t n=strcspn(tag,"-_");if(n<sizeof(language))memcpy(language,tag,n);
   for(const char *p=tag+n;*p;){p+=strspn(p,"-_");size_t k=strcspn(p,"-_");
    if(k==2&&isalpha((unsigned char)p[0])&&isalpha((unsigned char)p[1])){region[0]=(char)toupper((unsigned char)p[0]);region[1]=(char)toupper((unsigned char)p[1]);}
    p+=k;}
  } else {
   CFLocaleRef locale=CFLocaleCopyCurrent();
   CFStringRef value=CFLocaleGetValue(locale,kCFLocaleLanguageCode);
   if(value)CFStringGetCString(value,language,sizeof(language),kCFStringEncodingUTF8);
   value=CFLocaleGetValue(locale,kCFLocaleCountryCode);
   if(value)CFStringGetCString(value,region,sizeof(region),kCFStringEncodingUTF8);CFRelease(locale);
  }
#ifdef TOTK_GAME_V143
  const char *portuguese=!strcmp(region,"BR")?"pt-BR":"pt";
#else
  const char *portuguese="pt";
#endif
  const char *selected=!strcmp(language,"ja")?"ja":!strcmp(language,"de")?"de":!strcmp(language,"fr")?"fr":!strcmp(language,"es")?"es":!strcmp(language,"it")?"it":!strcmp(language,"nl")?"nl":!strcmp(language,"ru")?"ru":!strcmp(language,"ko")?"ko":!strcmp(language,"zh")?"zh-Hans":!strcmp(language,"pt")?portuguese:"en-US";
  memcpy(code,selected,strlen(selected));
 }
 uint64_t result;memcpy(&result,code,8);return result;
}

void runtime_core_checkpoint(void);
/* svcBreak 取证（crash_1031 追加轮 §E.3a）：reason 无放行位即 fatal，runtime_fail 前把 x29-0x60..x29+0x180
   （60 个 u64，new 失败的 info{heap,?,size,align} 就在堆核心帧的这段栈上，0x951f34-44 stp/str 落栈）一次性
   单行转储——write(2) 直写不走 stdio 缓冲，防 abort 路径丢日志；离线从栈窗里捡失败堆指针喂
   TOTK_CRASH_HEAPWALK 走空闲链：链上出现 ASCII size=毒化定案，链空且 heap_size 顶格=真不够大定案。 */
static void svc_break_hex(char *b,size_t *n,uint64_t v){b[(*n)++]=' ';b[(*n)++]='0';b[(*n)++]='x';for(int i=15;i>=0;i--)b[(*n)++]="0123456789abcdef"[(v>>(i*4))&15];}
static void svc_break_window(uint64_t x29){
 uint64_t w[60];memcpy(w,(const void *)(uintptr_t)(x29-0x60),sizeof w);
 char b[64+60*19];size_t n=0;const char *lab="[totk] Break x29-0x60..+0x180:";
 while(*lab)b[n++]=*lab++;
 for(unsigned i=0;i<60;i++)svc_break_hex(b,&n,w[i]);
 b[n++]='\n';write(2,b,n);
}
uint64_t runtime_svc(unsigned num,uint64_t *r,const char *module,uint64_t offset) {
 runtime_core_checkpoint();
 // Successful SVCs occur several times per frame. Keep the detailed trace available
 // for diagnostics without formatting and writing every call during normal play.
 static _Atomic int trace=-1;int enabled=atomic_load_explicit(&trace,memory_order_relaxed);
 if(enabled<0){enabled=getenv("TOTK_TRACE_SVC")!=NULL;atomic_store_explicit(&trace,enabled,memory_order_relaxed);}
 if(enabled)fprintf(stderr,"[totk] SVC 0x%x at %s+0x%llx x0=0x%llx x1=0x%llx x2=0x%llx x3=0x%llx\n",num,module,(unsigned long long)offset,(unsigned long long)r[0],(unsigned long long)r[1],(unsigned long long)r[2],(unsigned long long)r[3]);
 if(svc_thread((int)num,r))return r[0];
 if(runtime_ipc_svc(num,r))return r[0];
 memory_init();
 switch(num) {
 case 0x02:r[0]=runtime_module_permission(r[0],r[1],(unsigned)r[2]);return r[0];
 case 0x03:r[0]=runtime_module_lock_permission(r[0],r[1],(unsigned)r[2],(unsigned)r[3]);return r[0];
 case 0x29: {
  uint64_t value=0;unsigned id=(unsigned)r[1];
  switch(id) {
  case 0:value=7;break;case 1:value=0x0ffffffff0000000ULL;break;
  case 2:value=ALIAS_START;break;case 3:value=ALIAS_SIZE;break;
  case 4:value=(uintptr_t)heap;break;case 5:value=HEAP_CAP;break;
  case 6:case 21:value=APP_POOL;break;case 7:case 22:value=runtime_image_bytes()+heap_size+alias_bytes;
   { static unsigned polls; if(getenv("TOTK_MEM_LOG")&&(polls++%600)==0) fprintf(stderr,"[totk-mem] GetInfo(%u) total=%#llx used=%#llx image=%#llx heap=%#llx alias=%#llx\n",id,(unsigned long long)APP_POOL,(unsigned long long)value,(unsigned long long)runtime_image_bytes(),(unsigned long long)heap_size,(unsigned long long)alias_bytes); }
   break;
  case 8:value=0;break;case 10:value=0;break;
  case 11:arc4random_buf(&value,8);break;
  case 12:value=ASLR_START;break;case 13:value=ASLR_SIZE;break;
  case 14:value=STACK_START;break;case 15:value=STACK_SIZE;break;
  case 16:value=SYSTEM_RESOURCE_BUDGET;break;case 17:value=sizeof(stack_maps)+sizeof(alias_pages);break;case 18:value=GAME_TITLE_ID;break;
  case 20:value=(uintptr_t)user_exception_context;break;   /* UserExceptionContextAddress: SDK stores e.g. the dying-message region at +0x1c0 */case 23:value=1;break;
  /* AliasRegionExtraSize (18.0.0+): our alias reservation contains no
   * kernel-owned extension outside the range reported by ids 2 and 3. */
  case 28:value=0;break;
  default:fprintf(stderr,"unknown GetInfo id %u\n",id);runtime_fail("GetInfo id not implemented");
  }
  r[0]=0;r[1]=value;return 0;
 }
 case 0x2c:case 0x2d:{uint64_t a=r[0],n=r[1];r[0]=alias_map(num==0x2d,a,n);
  if(getenv("TOTK_MEM_LOG"))fprintf(stderr,"[totk-mem] %sMapPhysicalMemory %#llx+%#llx -> %#llx alias=%#llx remaining=%#llx\n",num==0x2d?"Un":"",(unsigned long long)a,(unsigned long long)n,(unsigned long long)r[0],(unsigned long long)alias_bytes,(unsigned long long)(APP_POOL-runtime_image_bytes()-heap_size-alias_bytes));
  if(r[0])fprintf(stderr,"[totk] %sMapPhysicalMemory %#llx+%#llx failed %#llx (alias %#llx used, heap %#llx)\n",num==0x2d?"Un":"",(unsigned long long)a,(unsigned long long)n,(unsigned long long)r[0],(unsigned long long)alias_bytes,(unsigned long long)heap_size);return r[0];}
 case 0x04:case 0x05:{
  /* round23：一次性返回值日志（前 4 次）定论 CreateAliasStackUnsafe 64 连败时 svc#4 的真实返回：
     0=MapAliasStack 成功→败因在 CheckGuardSpace（QueryMemory 误报）；非 0=stack_move 拒绝（配 stack_fail 行）。 */
  uint64_t md=r[0],ms=r[1],mn=r[2];r[0]=stack_move(num==5,md,ms,mn);
  {static unsigned logged;if(logged++<4)fprintf(stderr,"[totk-stack] svc %#x %sMapMemory dst=%#llx src=%#llx size=%#llx ret=%#llx heap=%#llx+%#llx maps=%u\n",
   num,num==5?"Un":"",(unsigned long long)md,(unsigned long long)ms,(unsigned long long)mn,(unsigned long long)r[0],
   (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)heap,(unsigned long long)heap_size,nstack_maps);}
  return r[0];}
 case 0x06: {
  uint64_t addr=r[2],base=addr&~0xfffULL,size=0x1000;unsigned state=0,perm=0,attr=0;
  uintptr_t top=(uintptr_t)pthread_get_stackaddr_np(pthread_self());size_t stack=pthread_get_stacksize_np(pthread_self());
  /* round23 边界护栏：宿主栈范围必须"非空、像线程栈、top>stack"才可信——防 shim 层再退回垃圾值时
     top-stack 下溢把整段客体地址误报成宿主栈（state 0xb，round17/22 的 CheckGuardSpace 64 连败）。 */
  if(stack&&stack<=(1u<<30)&&top>stack&&addr>=top-stack&&addr<top){base=top-stack;size=stack;state=0xb;perm=3;}
```

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/host/shared_font.c`:

```c
/* nn::pl shared fonts: the verified system BFTTF files laid out back to back as in the pl shared memory.
   GetSharedFontAddress points 8 bytes past each file start (after the BFTTF header), as the SDK adds the
   service-provided offset to the shared memory base; the size is the decoded font size. */
#include "runtime.h"
#include "shared_fonts_config.h"
#include "shared_fonts_data.h"
#include <CommonCrypto/CommonDigest.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
typedef struct{const char *path;uint64_t file_bytes,font_bytes;const char *sha256;} FontRow;
static const FontRow rows[SHARED_FONT_COUNT]={SHARED_FONT_ROWS};
static uint8_t *region;static uint64_t offsets[SHARED_FONT_COUNT];
static pthread_once_t once=PTHREAD_ONCE_INIT;
static void need(int c,const char *m){if(!c)runtime_fail(m);}
static void load(void){
 /* Bayonetta 3: the NSPs do not carry the system fonts; scripts/prepare_runtime.py leaves the rows empty without them. */
 if(!rows[0].path[0])runtime_fail("the game asked for the system shared fonts: extract them from your own Switch firmware to Odyssey_build/extracted/firmware/shared-fonts (scripts/extract_shared_fonts.py) and run scripts/prepare_runtime.py again");
 uint64_t total=0;for(int i=0;i<SHARED_FONT_COUNT;i++)total+=rows[i].file_bytes;
 region=malloc(total);need(region!=NULL,"shared font memory");
 uint64_t at=0;
 for(int i=0;i<SHARED_FONT_COUNT;i++){
  if(rows[i].path[0]==':'){   /* ":embedded:N": Windows-TTF stand-ins baked in by game-work/make_shared_fonts.py */
   memcpy(region+at,SHARED_FONT_DATA+SHARED_FONT_DATA_OFF[i],(size_t)rows[i].file_bytes);
  }else{
  /* TOTK_SHARED_FONTS=<dir>: the same verified files in another directory (iOS: copied into the app's Documents). */
  char path[4096];const char *dir=getenv("TOTK_SHARED_FONTS"),*base=strrchr(rows[i].path,'/');
  if(dir)need(snprintf(path,sizeof path,"%s/%s",dir,base?base+1:rows[i].path)<(int)sizeof path,"shared font path");
  FILE *f=fopen(dir?path:rows[i].path,"rb");need(f!=NULL,"open shared font");
  need(fread(region+at,1,rows[i].file_bytes,f)==rows[i].file_bytes&&fgetc(f)==EOF,"shared font size");fclose(f);
  }
  uint8_t d[32];char hex[65];CC_SHA256(region+at,(CC_LONG)rows[i].file_bytes,d);for(int k=0;k<32;k++)snprintf(hex+k*2,3,"%02x",d[k]);
  need(!strcmp(hex,rows[i].sha256),"shared font integrity mismatch");
  /* BFTTF stores each big-endian payload word XORed with the key encoded in
     its first word. The Switch pl service exposes decoded sfnt bytes. */
  uint8_t *font=region+at+8,*header=region+at;
  uint32_t encoded=((uint32_t)header[0]<<24)|((uint32_t)header[1]<<16)|((uint32_t)header[2]<<8)|header[3];
  uint32_t key=encoded^0x7f9a0218u;
  need(rows[i].font_bytes+8==rows[i].file_bytes,"shared font BFTTF length");
  for(uint64_t j=0;j<rows[i].font_bytes;j++)font[j]^=(uint8_t)(key>>(24-8*(j&3)));
  need((font[0]==0&&font[1]==1&&font[2]==0&&font[3]==0)||
       (font[0]=='O'&&font[1]=='T'&&font[2]=='T'&&font[3]=='O'),"shared font decoded sfnt header");
  offsets[i]=at+8;at+=rows[i].file_bytes;
 }
 fprintf(stderr,"[totk] shared fonts loaded: %d fonts, %llu bytes\n",SHARED_FONT_COUNT,(unsigned long long)total);
}
static int valid(int type){if(type<0||type>=SHARED_FONT_COUNT)runtime_fail("invalid shared font type");pthread_once(&once,load);return type;}
static int load_state(int type){valid(type);return 1;}   /* SharedFontLoadState_Loaded */
static const void *address(int type){return region+offsets[valid(type)];}
static size_t size(int type){return (size_t)rows[valid(type)].font_bytes;}
void *runtime_font_override(const char *name){
 static const struct{const char *name;void *fn;} entries[]={
  {"_ZN2nn2pl22GetSharedFontLoadStateENS0_14SharedFontTypeE",load_state},
  {"_ZN2nn2pl20GetSharedFontAddressENS0_14SharedFontTypeE",address},
  {"_ZN2nn2pl17GetSharedFontSizeENS0_14SharedFontTypeE",size}};
 for(unsigned i=0;i<sizeof(entries)/sizeof(*entries);i++)if(!strcmp(name,entries[i].name))return entries[i].fn;return NULL;
}
```
