`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/ohos_compat/ohos_compat.h`:

```h
// ohos_compat.h —— 强制注入（-include）：把宿主源码里的 Apple/BSD 专有调用映射到 OHOS musl
// 映射原则：mach_vm_read_overwrite 等对自进程的内存读 == memcpy；
//          mach 绝对时间 == clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW) 换算；
//          行为待周末真机逐个验证，此处保证编译与语义近似。
#pragma once

#if !defined(__ASSEMBLER__)  // 汇编源(hle_stack.S)也被 -include 强灌本头：整个头对汇编隐藏
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>

// macOS stat timespec 字段 → musl 命名
#define st_mtimespec st_mtim
#define st_ctimespec st_ctim
#define st_atimespec st_atim
#define st_birthtimespec st_mtim

// macOS 时钟/类型别名
#define CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW
typedef unsigned int vm_size_t;
#ifndef F_FULLFSYNC
#define F_FULLFSYNC 51 /* shim: OHOS fcntl 无此 cmd（返回 EINVAL），周末改 fdatasync */
#define F_GETPATH   50 /* shim: macOS fcntl 取文件路径，OHOS 退化（返回 EINVAL） */
#endif

// pthread_threadid_np → gettid
#include <sys/syscall.h>
static inline int compat_threadid(unsigned long long *out) { *out = (unsigned long long)syscall(SYS_gettid); return 0; }
#define pthread_threadid_np(t, out) compat_threadid(out)

// round23：宿主线程栈范围（host/services.c svc#6 QueryMemory 首分支用；实现见 ohos_stub.c）。
// 原型必须先于调用点可见：此前无声明，services.c 按隐式 int 取返回值（编译为取 x0 低 32 位再符号
// 扩展），宿主线程描述符地址低 32 位带符号位时（ASLR 抽签，round17/22 两次命中）top 变
// 0xffffffff_xxxxxxxx，svc#6 把所有客体地址误报成宿主栈 state 0xb，SDK CheckGuardSpace 要
// guard 页 state==0 → CreateAliasStackUnsafe 64 连败空消息 Break。
#include <pthread.h>
uintptr_t pthread_get_stackaddr_np(pthread_t t);
size_t pthread_get_stacksize_np(pthread_t t);

// Mach-O getsectiondata（GPU 覆盖表 __DATA,totkgfx 等）：OHOS ELF 下读 libgame.so 自身同名段。
// dladdr 本函数拿 .so 路径与装载基址 → open 读 ELF64 头/节头表/.shstrtab 按名定位
// （clang 在 ELF 上把 section("seg,sect") 原样作为单段名，故按 "seg,sect" 拼串匹配）→
// alloc 段直接拷运行时镜像（dli_fbase+sh_addr，RELATIVE 重定位已由动态链接器完成）→
// malloc 缓存（boot 早期单线程调用，无锁），size 写回字节数。
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <elf.h>
extern char _mh_execute_header;
static inline const void *getsectiondata(const void *hdr, const char *seg, const char *sect, unsigned long *size) {
    (void)hdr;
    if (size) *size = 0;
    if (!seg || !sect) return NULL;
    static struct { char key[96]; void *data; unsigned long size; } cache[8];   /* 每翻译单元独立缓存，boot 期单线程 */
    char key[96];
    int kn = snprintf(key, sizeof key, "%s,%s", seg, sect);
    if (kn <= 0 || (size_t)kn >= sizeof key) return NULL;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
        if (cache[i].data && strcmp(cache[i].key, key) == 0) { if (size) *size = cache[i].size; return cache[i].data; }
    Dl_info di;
    if (!dladdr((void *)&getsectiondata, &di) || !di.dli_fname || !di.dli_fbase) return NULL;   /* 本函数即随 libgame.so 装载 */
    int fd = open(di.dli_fname, O_RDONLY);
    if (fd < 0) return NULL;
    void *result = NULL;
    Elf64_Ehdr eh;
    Elf64_Shdr sh[96], *hit = NULL;   /* 本头被 .cpp 以 C++ 编译：goto 不得跨过带初始化的声明，故上提到所有 goto 之前 */
    if (read(fd, &eh, sizeof eh) != (ssize_t)sizeof eh || memcmp(eh.e_ident, ELFMAG, SELFMAG) != 0
        || eh.e_ident[EI_CLASS] != ELFCLASS64 || eh.e_shentsize != sizeof(Elf64_Shdr)
        || eh.e_phentsize != sizeof(Elf64_Phdr) || eh.e_shnum > 96 || eh.e_phnum > 32)
        goto out;
    if (lseek(fd, (off_t)eh.e_shoff, SEEK_SET) < 0 || read(fd, sh, sizeof(Elf64_Shdr) * eh.e_shnum) != (ssize_t)(sizeof(Elf64_Shdr) * eh.e_shnum))
        goto out;
    if (!eh.e_shstrndx || eh.e_shstrndx >= eh.e_shnum) goto out;
    {   /* 节名表：按 "seg,sect" 全名找段 */
        size_t strsz = sh[eh.e_shstrndx].sh_size;
        char *strs = (char *)malloc(strsz);
        if (!strs) goto out;
        if (lseek(fd, (off_t)sh[eh.e_shstrndx].sh_offset, SEEK_SET) < 0 || read(fd, strs, strsz) != (ssize_t)strsz) { free(strs); goto out; }
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < eh.e_shnum && !hit; i++) {
            if (sh[i].sh_name >= strsz) continue;
            if (strcmp(sh[i].sh_name + strs, key) == 0) hit = &sh[i];
        }
        free(strs);
    }
    if (!hit || !hit->sh_size) goto out;
    {   /* alloc 段（sh_addr≠0，落在 PT_LOAD 内）：动态链接器装载时已把该段全部 R_AARCH64_RELATIVE
           重定位完，直接拷运行时镜像（dli_fbase+sh_addr）。段内指针在文件里是零、真值在 .rela.dyn
           addend 里——从文件读再手动补基址只能拿到全零（round5 对拍实证）。非 alloc 段才回退文件读。 */
        unsigned char *data = (unsigned char *)malloc(hit->sh_size);
        if (!data) goto out;
        if (hit->sh_addr)
            memcpy(data, (void *)((uintptr_t)di.dli_fbase + hit->sh_addr), hit->sh_size);
        else if (lseek(fd, (off_t)hit->sh_offset, SEEK_SET) < 0 || read(fd, data, hit->sh_size) != (ssize_t)hit->sh_size) { free(data); goto out; }
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) if (!cache[i].data) { strcpy(cache[i].key, key); cache[i].data = data; cache[i].size = (unsigned long)hit->sh_size; break; }
        result = data;
        if (size) *size = (unsigned long)hit->sh_size;
    }
out:
    close(fd);
    return result;
}

// ---- mach 自进程内存操作：全部退化为直接内存访问 ----
typedef int kern_return_t;
typedef unsigned long long mach_vm_address_t;
typedef unsigned long long mach_vm_size_t;
typedef unsigned int mach_port_t;
typedef unsigned int mach_msg_type_number_t;
typedef unsigned int vm_region_flavor_t;
typedef unsigned int vm_prot_t;
typedef unsigned int *vm_region_info_t;
typedef unsigned int natural_t;
#define KERN_SUCCESS 0
#define KERN_INVALID_ADDRESS 1
#define KERN_NO_SPACE 3
#define VM_REGION_SUBMAP_INFO_COUNT_64 19
#define vm_page_size 4096 /* 诊断近似；OHOS 真实页大小周末校正 */
typedef struct {
    vm_prot_t protection;
    vm_prot_t max_protection;
    unsigned int inheritance, reserved;
    unsigned long long offset;
    unsigned int pages_resident, pages_shared_now_private, pages_shared_private, pages_dirtied;
    unsigned int depth, copy_strategy, pages_swapped_out;
} vm_region_submap_info_data_64_t;
typedef vm_region_submap_info_data_64_t *vm_region_recurse_info_t;
// 子图递归查询（内存诊断）：OHOS 无等价 → 失败，region_pages 空转、报告全 0
static inline kern_return_t vm_region_recurse_64(mach_vm_address_t task, mach_vm_address_t *addr,
                                                 mach_vm_size_t *size, natural_t *depth,
                                                 vm_region_recurse_info_t info,
                                                 mach_msg_type_number_t *count) {
    (void)task; (void)addr; (void)size; (void)depth; (void)info; (void)count;
    return KERN_INVALID_ADDRESS;
}
#define KERN_SUCCESS 0
#define KERN_INVALID_ADDRESS 1
#define VM_REGION_BASIC_INFO_64 9
#define VM_REGION_BASIC_INFO_COUNT_64 16
#define VM_PROT_NONE 0
#define VM_PROT_READ 1
#define VM_PROT_WRITE 2
#define VM_PROT_EXECUTE 4
#define VM_PROT_ALL 7
#define VM_FLAGS_FIXED 0x0000
#define VM_FLAGS_ANYWHERE 0x0001
#define VM_INHERIT_DEFAULT 1
#define VM_INHERIT_COPY 2
#define MEMORY_OBJECT_NULL ((mach_port_t)0)
#define MACH_PORT_NULL ((mach_port_t)0)
#define FALSE 0
#define TRUE 1
#define KERN_NO_SPACE 3

typedef struct {
    vm_prot_t protection;
    vm_prot_t max_protection;
    unsigned int inheritance, shared, reserved;
    mach_port_t behavior;
    unsigned short user_wired_count;
} vm_region_basic_info_data_64_t;

// region 查询：真实实现，解析 /proc/self/maps（宿主内存布局探测依赖它）。
// 2026-10-30 真机 check_permissions 在此 FAIL（模拟器正常）：三种死法各一次性报声，定位用。
static inline kern_return_t mach_vm_region(mach_vm_address_t task, mach_vm_address_t *addr,
                                           mach_vm_size_t *size, vm_region_flavor_t flavor,
                                           vm_region_info_t info, mach_msg_type_number_t *count,
                                           mach_port_t *object) {
    (void)task; (void)flavor; (void)count; (void)object;
    if (object) *object = MACH_PORT_NULL;
    FILE *f = fopen("/proc/self/maps", "r");
    if (!f) {
        static int warned;
        if (!warned) { warned = 1; fprintf(stderr, "[totk] note: /proc/self/maps unavailable (app 域被拒?)\n"); }
        return KERN_INVALID_ADDRESS;
    }
    char line[512];
    kern_return_t kr = KERN_INVALID_ADDRESS;
    while (fgets(line, sizeof line, f)) {
        unsigned long long lo, hi;
        char perms[8];
        if (sscanf(line, "%llx-%llx %7s", &lo, &hi, perms) != 3) continue;
        if ((mach_vm_address_t)hi <= *addr) continue;
        if ((mach_vm_address_t)lo > *addr) {   // 空隙：返回 KERN_INVALID_ADDRESS（调用方据此刻画空隙）
            static int gap_warned;
            if (!gap_warned) { gap_warned = 1; fprintf(stderr, "[totk] note: maps gap: query %#llx falls before next region %#llx\n",
                                                       (unsigned long long)*addr, lo); }
            break;
        }
        vm_region_basic_info_data_64_t *bi = (vm_region_basic_info_data_64_t *)(void *)info;
        bi->protection = (perms[0] == 'r' ? VM_PROT_READ : 0) | (perms[1] == 'w' ? VM_PROT_WRITE : 0) |
                         (perms[2] == 'x' ? VM_PROT_EXECUTE : 0);
        bi->max_protection = VM_PROT_ALL;
        if (lo != (unsigned long long)*addr) {
            static int mis_warned;
            if (!mis_warned) { mis_warned = 1; fprintf(stderr, "[totk] note: region start %#llx != requested %#llx (contains)\n",
                                                       lo, (unsigned long long)*addr); }
        }
        *addr = lo; *size = hi - lo;
        kr = KERN_SUCCESS;
        break;
    }
    fclose(f);
    return kr;
}

// mach_vm_map：PROT_NONE 预留走 mmap；FIXED 语义用 MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE（已占用则失败，与原语义一致）
#include <sys/mman.h>
#ifndef MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE
#define MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE 0x100000
#endif
static inline kern_return_t mach_vm_map(mach_vm_address_t task, mach_vm_address_t *addr,
                                        mach_vm_size_t size, mach_vm_address_t mask, int flags,
                                        mach_port_t obj, unsigned long long offset, int copy,
                                        vm_prot_t cur, vm_prot_t max, unsigned int inh) {
    (void)task; (void)mask; (void)obj; (void)offset; (void)copy; (void)max; (void)inh;
    void *hint = (flags & VM_FLAGS_FIXED) ? (void *)(uintptr_t)*addr : NULL;
    int mflags = MAP_ANON | MAP_PRIVATE | ((flags & VM_FLAGS_FIXED) ? MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE : 0);
    void *p = mmap(hint, size, PROT_NONE, mflags, -1, 0);
    if (p == MAP_FAILED) return KERN_INVALID_ADDRESS;
    *addr = (mach_vm_address_t)(uintptr_t)p;
    (void)cur;
    return KERN_SUCCESS;
}
static inline kern_return_t mach_vm_deallocate(mach_vm_address_t task, mach_vm_address_t addr, mach_vm_size_t size) {
    (void)task;
    return munmap((void *)(uintptr_t)addr, size) == 0 ? KERN_SUCCESS : KERN_INVALID_ADDRESS;
}
static inline kern_return_t mach_port_deallocate(mach_vm_address_t task, mach_port_t p) { (void)task; (void)p; return KERN_SUCCESS; }


static inline kern_return_t mach_vm_read_overwrite(mach_vm_address_t task, mach_vm_address_t addr,
                                                   mach_vm_size_t size, mach_vm_address_t buf,
                                                   mach_vm_size_t *outsize) {
    (void)task;
    __builtin_memcpy((void *)(uintptr_t)buf, (const void *)(uintptr_t)addr, size);
    if (outsize) *outsize = size;
    return KERN_SUCCESS;
}
#define mach_task_self() 0
#define vm_read_overwrite mach_vm_read_overwrite
typedef mach_vm_address_t vm_address_t;
typedef unsigned int *vm_region_info_t;

// ---- mach 绝对时间（纳秒基）----
#include <time.h>
static inline unsigned long long mach_absolute_time(void) {
    struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW, &ts);
    return (unsigned long long)ts.tv_sec * 1000000000ULL + ts.tv_nsec;
}
static inline double mach_timebase_info_factor(void) { return 1.0; }
typedef struct { unsigned int numer, denom; } mach_timebase_info_data_t;
static inline int mach_timebase_info(mach_timebase_info_data_t *t) { t->numer = 1; t->denom = 1; return 0; }
/* nn::time 稳态时钟用（唯一调用点 host/time_host.c，定义在 ohos_compat/ohos_stub.c）：
   必须 64 位原型——此前全树无原型走隐式 int，arm64 上 64 位纳秒返回值被截断，
   设备运行超约 2.147s 即溢出为垃圾（审校修复）。类型用 uint64_t 与 ohos_stub.c 的定义
   完全一致（LP64 musl 上 uint64_t=unsigned long，写 unsigned long long 会与其冲突）。 */
uint64_t mach_continuous_time(void);

// clock_gettime_nsec_np：宿主取单调纳秒（诊断打点用）——须在 mach_absolute_time 之后
static inline unsigned long long compat_clock_ns(int clk) { (void)clk; return mach_absolute_time(); }
#define clock_gettime_nsec_np(clk) compat_clock_ns(clk)

// ---- BSD/Apple 杂项 ----
#define MAP_JIT 0
#include <sys/mman.h>
#ifndef MAP_ANON
#define MAP_ANON MAP_ANONYMOUS
#endif
static inline int pthread_set_qos_class_self_np(int cls, int rel) { (void)cls; (void)rel; return 0; }
typedef int qos_class_t;
#define QOS_CLASS_UNSPECIFIED -1
#define QOS_CLASS_USER_INTERACTIVE 0
#define QOS_CLASS_USER_INITIATED 1
#define QOS_CLASS_DEFAULT 2
#define QOS_CLASS_UTILITY 3
static inline int pthread_get_qos_class_np(void *tid, qos_class_t *cls, int *rel) {
    (void)tid; if (cls) *cls = QOS_CLASS_DEFAULT; if (rel) *rel = 0; return 0;
}
#define QOS_CLASS_USER_INTERACTIVE 0
#define QOS_CLASS_USER_INITIATED 1
#define QOS_CLASS_DEFAULT 2
#define QOS_CLASS_UTILITY 3

static inline int proc_pidpath(int pid, char *buf, size_t len) {
    (void)pid;
    ssize_t n = readlink("/proc/self/exe", buf, len - 1);
    if (n <= 0) return 0;
    buf[n] = 0; return (int)n;
}

// 指令缓存刷新（自修改代码/重定位补丁后）
static inline void sys_icache_invalidate(void *start, size_t len) {
#ifndef __aarch64__
    (void)start; (void)len;
#else
    // aarch64：用户态 IC IVAU + DSB/ISB（OHOS musl 无 __clear_cache 时用内联汇编）
    __builtin___clear_cache((char *)start, (char *)start + len);
#endif
}


#endif  // !__ASSEMBLER__
```

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/ohos_compat/ohos_stub.c`:

```c
// ohos_stub.c —— shim 契约的实现：SHA-256 真实现；AudioQueue/VT/CF 失败返回（周末接 OHOS 原生）
#include <AudioToolbox/AudioToolbox.h>
#include <CommonCrypto/CommonDigest.h>
#include <CoreFoundation/CoreFoundation.h>
#include <VideoToolbox/VideoToolbox.h>
#include <execinfo.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <time.h>

// ---------- SHA-256（公有域实现，loader 哈希校验用） ----------
static const uint32_t K256[64] = {
    0x428a2f98,0x71374491,0xb5c0fbcf,0xe9b5dba5,0x3956c25b,0x59f111f1,0x923f82a4,0xab1c5ed5,
    0xd807aa98,0x12835b01,0x243185be,0x550c7dc3,0x72be5d74,0x80deb1fe,0x9bdc06a7,0xc19bf174,
    0xe49b69c1,0xefbe4786,0x0fc19dc6,0x240ca1cc,0x2de92c6f,0x4a7484aa,0x5cb0a9dc,0x76f988da,
    0x983e5152,0xa831c66d,0xb00327c8,0xbf597fc7,0xc6e00bf3,0xd5a79147,0x06ca6351,0x14292967,
    0x27b70a85,0x2e1b2138,0x4d2c6dfc,0x53380d13,0x650a7354,0x766a0abb,0x81c2c92e,0x92722c85,
    0xa2bfe8a1,0xa81a664b,0xc24b8b70,0xc76c51a3,0xd192e819,0xd6990624,0xf40e3585,0x106aa070,
    0x19a4c116,0x1e376c08,0x2748774c,0x34b0bcb5,0x391c0cb3,0x4ed8aa4a,0x5b9cca4f,0x682e6ff3,
    0x748f82ee,0x78a5636f,0x84c87814,0x8cc70208,0x90befffa,0xa4506ceb,0xbef9a3f7,0xc67178f2};

#define ROR32(x,n) (((x) >> (n)) | ((x) << (32 - (n))))

int CC_SHA256_Init(CC_SHA256_CTX *c) {
    c->datalen = 0; c->bitlen = 0;
    c->state[0]=0x6a09e667; c->state[1]=0xbb67ae85; c->state[2]=0x3c6ef372; c->state[3]=0xa54ff53a;
    c->state[4]=0x510e527f; c->state[5]=0x9b05688c; c->state[6]=0x1f83d9ab; c->state[7]=0x5be0cd19;
    return 1;
}

static void sha256_transform(CC_SHA256_CTX *c, const uint8_t *p) {
    uint32_t m[64], a,b,cc,d,e,f,g,h,t1,t2;
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++)
        m[i] = (uint32_t)p[i*4]<<24 | (uint32_t)p[i*4+1]<<16 | (uint32_t)p[i*4+2]<<8 | p[i*4+3];
    for (int i = 16; i < 64; i++) {
        uint32_t s0 = ROR32(m[i-15],7) ^ ROR32(m[i-15],18) ^ (m[i-15] >> 3);
        uint32_t s1 = ROR32(m[i-2],17) ^ ROR32(m[i-2],19) ^ (m[i-2] >> 10);
        m[i] = m[i-16] + s0 + m[i-7] + s1;
    }
    a=c->state[0]; b=c->state[1]; cc=c->state[2]; d=c->state[3];
    e=c->state[4]; f=c->state[5]; g=c->state[6]; h=c->state[7];
    for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) {
        uint32_t S1 = ROR32(e,6) ^ ROR32(e,11) ^ ROR32(e,25);
        uint32_t ch = (e & f) ^ (~e & g);
        t1 = h + S1 + ch + K256[i] + m[i];
        uint32_t S0 = ROR32(a,2) ^ ROR32(a,13) ^ ROR32(a,22);
        uint32_t mj = (a & b) ^ (a & cc) ^ (b & cc);
        t2 = S0 + mj;
        h=g; g=f; f=e; e=d+t1; d=cc; cc=b; b=a; a=t1+t2;
    }
    c->state[0]+=a; c->state[1]+=b; c->state[2]+=cc; c->state[3]+=d;
    c->state[4]+=e; c->state[5]+=f; c->state[6]+=g; c->state[7]+=h;
}

int CC_SHA256_Update(CC_SHA256_CTX *c, const void *data, size_t len) {
    const uint8_t *p = data;
    while (len) {
        size_t take = 64 - c->datalen < len ? 64 - c->datalen : len;
        memcpy(c->data + c->datalen, p, take);
        c->datalen += (uint32_t)take; p += take; len -= take;
        if (c->datalen == 64) { sha256_transform(c, c->data); c->bitlen += 512; c->datalen = 0; }
    }
    return 1;
}

int CC_SHA256_Final(uint8_t *md, CC_SHA256_CTX *c) {
    size_t i = c->datalen;
    c->bitlen += (uint64_t)c->datalen * 8;
    c->data[i++] = 0x80;
    if (i > 56) { while (i < 64) c->data[i++] = 0; sha256_transform(c, c->data); i = 0; }
    while (i < 56) c->data[i++] = 0;
    for (int j = 7; j >= 0; j--) c->data[i++] = (uint8_t)(c->bitlen >> (j * 8));
    sha256_transform(c, c->data);
    for (int j = 0; j < 8; j++) {
        md[j*4]   = (uint8_t)(c->state[j] >> 24);
        md[j*4+1] = (uint8_t)(c->state[j] >> 16);
        md[j*4+2] = (uint8_t)(c->state[j] >> 8);
        md[j*4+3] = (uint8_t)c->state[j];
    }
    return 1;
}

// round 1 stubs
// CC_SHA256 一次性接口不能再空桩：host/loader.c:187 与 host/shared_font.c:28 用它做模块/字体完整性校验，
// 空桩导致 digest 永远是栈上垃圾 → 必然 "image SHA256 differs from verified rewrite" → exit(1)。
// 用本文件已有的真实现（Init/Update/Final）拼装，语义对齐 CommonCrypto。
unsigned char *CC_SHA256(const void *data, CC_LONG len, unsigned char *md) {
    CC_SHA256_CTX c;
    if (!CC_SHA256_Init(&c) || !CC_SHA256_Update(&c, data, len) || !CC_SHA256_Final(md, &c)) return NULL;
    return md;
}
void dm_gfx_shot_at(void) {}

/* round23：宿主线程栈范围改真实现。原空桩无返回值，services.c:398（svc#6 QueryMemory）在无原型下
   按隐式 int 取返回值——编译为取 x0 低 32 位再符号扩展：宿主线程描述符地址低 32 位带符号位时
   （ASLR 抽签，round17/22 两次命中），top 变成 0xffffffff_xxxxxxxx，svc#6 把所有客体地址报成
   宿主栈 state 0xb，SDK CheckGuardSpace 要求 guard 页 state==0 → CreateAliasStackUnsafe 64 连败
   空消息 Break。musl 的 pthread_getattr_np 取真实 [base,size)；失败返 0，调用侧分支自然不命中。
   原型在 ohos_compat.h（强制注入，调用点可见）。 */
int pthread_getattr_np(pthread_t, pthread_attr_t *);   /* musl _GNU_SOURCE 接口；显式原型防未定义 _GNU_SOURCE 时又落隐式 int */
uintptr_t pthread_get_stackaddr_np(pthread_t t) {
    pthread_attr_t a;
    void *base = NULL; size_t size = 0;
    if (pthread_getattr_np(t, &a) == 0) {
        if (pthread_attr_getstack(&a, &base, &size) != 0) base = NULL;
        pthread_attr_destroy(&a);
    }
    return (uintptr_t)base;
}
size_t pthread_get_stacksize_np(pthread_t t) {
    pthread_attr_t a;
    void *base = NULL; size_t size = 0;
    if (pthread_getattr_np(t, &a) == 0) {
        if (pthread_attr_getstack(&a, &base, &size) != 0) size = 0;
        pthread_attr_destroy(&a);
    }
    return size;
}

// mach_continuous_time 同步改为真实现：nn::time 稳态时钟（host/time_host.c:35）用它计秒，
// 空桩返回 0 会让游戏时间恒停。与 Darwin 语义对齐：连续时间，纳秒基。
uint64_t mach_continuous_time(void) {
    struct timespec ts;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    return (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000000000ull + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec;
}
```

```md
# Copies from other games in this repository

Every game other than Tears of the Kingdom / Breath of the Wild carries its own copy of what it builds with, so a change
to another game never changes this one. These were copied on 2026-10-23 from the commit the port was tested on
(daf270e, 2026-10-22); update them here, by hand, when Odyssey needs a newer version.

| Folder | Copied from | Used by |
|---|---|---|
```

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/by3-scripts/extract_exefs.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read an XCI or NSP in place; extract and verify its base or explicitly selected update Program ExeFS.

Supports NCA3, key-area or common-ticket AES-CTR, and hierarchical SHA-256 PFS0.
Keys stay in memory. No RomFS extraction, executable launch, or network calls.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import struct
import io
from pathlib import Path
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.ciphers import Cipher, algorithms, modes


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def decrypt(key, mode, data):
    ctx = Cipher(algorithms.AES(key), mode).decryptor()
    return ctx.update(data) + ctx.finalize()


def read_at(f, offset, length):
    require(0 <= offset and 0 <= length <= 512 * 1024 * 1024, 'Invalid/big read')
    f.seek(offset)
    data = f.read(length)
    require(len(data) == length, 'Truncated input')
    return data


def hfs(f, offset, bound):
    return partition_entries(f, offset, bound, b'HFS0', 64)


def partition_entries(f, offset, bound, magic=b'PFS0', stride=24):
    """Read a bounded PFS0/HFS0 table without loading its file payloads."""
    require(bound >= 16, 'Truncated partition header')
    hdr = read_at(f, offset, 16)
    require(hdr[:4] == magic, f'Expected {magic.decode()}')
    count, strings_size = struct.unpack_from('<II', hdr, 4)
    require(count <= 4096 and strings_size <= 1024 * 1024, 'Invalid partition table')
    size = 16 + count * stride + strings_size
    require(size <= bound, 'Partition table out of bounds')
    raw = read_at(f, offset, size)
    strings = raw[16 + count * stride:]
    entries = []
    names = set()
    for i in range(count):
        off, length, nameoff = struct.unpack_from('<QQI', raw, 16 + i * stride)
        require(nameoff < len(strings), 'Invalid partition filename offset')
        end = strings.find(b'\0', nameoff)
        require(end >= 0, 'Unterminated partition filename')
        name = strings[nameoff:end].decode('utf-8')
        require(name not in ('', '.', '..') and '/' not in name and '\\' not in name, 'Unsafe partition filename')
        require(name not in names, 'Duplicate partition filename')
        names.add(name)
        require(size + off + length <= bound, 'Partition entry out of bounds')
        entries.append((name, offset + size + off, length))
    end = offset + size
    for _, start, length in sorted(entries, key=lambda e: e[1]):
        require(start >= end, 'Overlapping partition entries')
        end = start + length
    return entries


def container_entries(f, size):
    if read_at(f, 0, 4) == b'PFS0':
        return 'nsp', partition_entries(f, 0, size)
    require(size >= 0x138 and read_at(f, 0x100, 4) == b'HEAD', 'Expected an XCI or NSP (PFS0) game file')
    root = struct.unpack('<Q', read_at(f, 0x130, 8))[0]
    partitions = hfs(f, root, size - root)
    secure = [e for e in partitions if e[0] == 'secure']
    require(len(secure) == 1, 'Expected one XCI secure partition')
    return 'xci', hfs(f, secure[0][1], secure[0][2])


def load_keys(path):
    keys = {}
    for number, line in enumerate(path.read_text().splitlines(), 1):
        line = line.split('#', 1)[0].strip()
        if '=' in line:
            name, value = line.split('=', 1)
            try:
                keys[name.strip().lower()] = bytes.fromhex(value.strip())
            except ValueError:
                raise ValueError(f'Invalid key encoding at line {number}') from None
    return keys


def common_tickets(f, entries):
    """Keep encrypted title keys in memory only, as nxnative's NSP importer does.

    Ticket offsets below are relative to the signed body; accept the standard RSA/ECDSA layouts.
    A personalized ticket cannot provide a common title key and is never treated as one.
    """
    tickets = {}
    bodies = {0x10000: 0x240, 0x10001: 0x140, 0x10002: 0x80,
              0x10003: 0x240, 0x10004: 0x140, 0x10005: 0x80}
    for name, offset, size in entries:
        if not name.lower().endswith('.tik'):
            continue
        require(size >= 4, 'Truncated NSP ticket')
        # Switch ticket signature type is little-endian: RSA2048/SHA256 = 04 00 01 00.
        sig = struct.unpack('<I', read_at(f, offset, 4))[0]
        require(sig in bodies, 'Unsupported NSP ticket signature type')
        body = bodies[sig]
        require(size >= body + 0x180, 'Truncated NSP ticket body')
        data = read_at(f, offset + body, 0x180)
        require(data[0x141] == 0, 'Personalized NSP tickets are unsupported; a common ticket is required')
        rights, key = data[0x160:0x170], data[0x40:0x50]
        require(rights not in tickets or tickets[rights] == key, 'Conflicting NSP tickets')
        tickets[rights] = key
    return tickets


def read_nca_header(f, offset, size, keys):
    require(size >= 0xc00, 'Truncated NCA header')
    require('header_key' in keys, 'Missing header_key in prod.keys')
    raw = read_at(f, offset, 0xc00)
    hdr = b''.join(decrypt(keys['header_key'], modes.XTS(i.to_bytes(16, 'big')),
                           raw[i * 512:(i + 1) * 512]) for i in range(6))
    require(hdr[0x200:0x204] == b'NCA3', 'Expected NCA3 (check prod.keys and the game file)')
    require(struct.unpack_from('<Q', hdr, 0x208)[0] == size, 'NCA size does not match container entry')
    for i in range(4):
        start, end = struct.unpack_from('<II', hdr, 0x240 + i * 16)
        require((start == end == 0) or 0xc00 <= start * 512 < end * 512 <= size, 'NCA section out of bounds')
    return hdr


def nca_ctr_key(hdr, keys, tickets):
    generation = max(max(hdr[0x206], hdr[0x220]) - 1, 0)
    rights = hdr[0x230:0x240]
    if rights != bytes(16):
        require(rights in tickets, 'Missing common ticket for rights-managed NCA in the NSP')
        keyname = f'titlekek_{generation:02x}'
        require(keyname in keys, f'Missing {keyname} in prod.keys')
        return decrypt(keys[keyname], modes.ECB(), tickets[rights])
    require(hdr[0x207] < 3, 'Unsupported NCA key area')
    area = ('application', 'ocean', 'system')[hdr[0x207]]
    keyname = f'key_area_key_{area}_{generation:02x}'
    require(keyname in keys, f'Missing {keyname} in prod.keys')
    return decrypt(keys[keyname], modes.ECB(), hdr[0x300:0x340])[32:48]


def nca_inventory(f, entries, keys):
    records = []
    for name, offset, length in entries:
        if not name.lower().endswith('.nca'):
            continue
        hdr = read_nca_header(f, offset, length, keys)
        record = dict(name=name, nca_offset=offset, size=length, content_type=hdr[0x205],
                      title_id=f'{struct.unpack_from("<Q", hdr, 0x210)[0]:016X}')
        records.append((record, hdr))
    return records


def program_nca(records, update=False):
    if update:
        programs = [(r, h) for r, h in records if r["content_type"] == 0]
        require(len(programs) == 1, "Expected one update Program NCA; combined packages are unsupported")
        record, hdr = programs[0]
        require(record["title_id"] == "0100F2C0115B6000", "Update belongs to another game")
        require(any(hdr[0x400 + i*512 + 4] == 4 for i in range(4)), "Expected a BKTR update, not a base game")
        require(all(r["title_id"] in ("0100F2C0115B6000", "0100F2C0115B6800") for r, _ in records), "Mixed-title update package")
        return record, hdr
    # Update Program NCAs can retain the base title ID; their Meta NCA carries the update ID.
    metadata = [r for r, _ in records if r['content_type'] == 1]
    require(len(metadata) <= 1 and all(r['title_id'] == '0100F2C0115B6000' for r in metadata),
            'Expected base game metadata; updates, DLC and combined packages are unsupported')
    programs = [(r, h) for r, h in records if r['content_type'] == 0]
    require(len(programs) == 1, 'Expected one base Program NCA; updates, DLC and combined packages are unsupported')
    record, hdr = programs[0]
    require(record['title_id'] == '0100F2C0115B6000',
            'Expected Tears of the Kingdom base game 1.0.0; updates, DLC and other games are unsupported')
    return record, hdr


def record_offset(record):
    # Read manifests produced before NSP support too.
    return record['nca_offset'] if 'nca_offset' in record else record['xci_offset']


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('game', type=Path, help='base game 1.0.0 (.xci or .nsp)')
    parser.add_argument('--keys', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--update', action='store_true', help='extract update code; caller must verify supported version hashes')
    parser.add_argument('--output', required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    require(not args.output.exists(), 'Output already exists; choose a new directory')
    keys = load_keys(args.keys)
    with args.game.open('rb') as f:
        kind, entries = container_entries(f, args.game.stat().st_size)
        tickets = common_tickets(f, entries)
        records = nca_inventory(f, entries, keys)
        record, hdr = program_nca(records, update=args.update)
        ctr_key = nca_ctr_key(hdr, keys, tickets)
        for i in range(4):
            start, end = struct.unpack_from('<II', hdr, 0x240 + 16 * i)
            if not start:
                continue
            fs = hdr[0x400 + 512 * i:0x600 + 512 * i]
            require(hashlib.sha256(fs).digest() == hdr[0x280 + 32 * i:0x2A0 + 32 * i], 'FS header hash mismatch')
            if fs[2:4] != b'\x01\x02':
                continue
            require(fs[4] == 3, 'Only AES-CTR ExeFS is supported')
            blocksize, levels = struct.unpack_from('<II', fs, 0x28)
            hashoff, hashsize, pfsoff, pfssize = struct.unpack_from('<QQQQ', fs, 0x30)
            secstart, secsize = start * 512, (end - start) * 512
            require(levels == 2 and blocksize > 0 and pfssize <= 512 * 1024 * 1024, 'Unsupported ExeFS hash layout')

            def section_read(relative, size):
                require(relative >= 0 and relative + size <= secsize, 'Section read out of bounds')
                absolute = secstart + relative
                aligned = absolute & ~15
                iv = fs[0x140:0x148][::-1] + (aligned // 16).to_bytes(8, 'big')
                data = read_at(f, record_offset(record) + aligned, size + absolute - aligned)
                return decrypt(ctr_key, modes.CTR(iv), data)[absolute - aligned:]

            hashes = section_read(hashoff, hashsize)
            require(hashlib.sha256(hashes).digest() == fs[8:40], 'ExeFS hash-table mismatch')
            pfs = section_read(pfsoff, pfssize)
            for index, pos in enumerate(range(0, pfssize, blocksize)):
                expected = hashes[index * 32:(index + 1) * 32]
                require(hashlib.sha256(pfs[pos:pos + blocksize]).digest() == expected,
                        f'ExeFS block hash mismatch: {index}')
            files = [(name, pfs[off:off + size]) for name, off, size in
                     partition_entries(io.BytesIO(pfs), 0, len(pfs))]
            require(any(name == 'main.npdm' for name, _ in files), 'PFS0 is not ExeFS')
            args.output.mkdir(parents=True)
            extracted = []
            for name, data in files:
                (args.output / name).write_bytes(data)
                extracted.append({'name': name, 'size': len(data), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()})
            manifest = {'source': str(args.game.resolve()), 'source_size': args.game.stat().st_size,
                        'source_mtime_ns': args.game.stat().st_mtime_ns, 'container': kind,
                        'nca_inventory': [r for r, _ in records], 'program': record, 'section_index': i,
                        'integrity': 'FS header, ExeFS hash table, and every ExeFS data block verified; RSA signatures not checked',
                        'files': extracted}
            (args.output.parent / 'extraction-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + '\n')
            print(json.dumps({'integrity': manifest['integrity'], 'files': extracted}, indent=2))
            return
        raise ValueError('No ExeFS section found')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify all six IVFC levels, stream a local RomFS image, and index its files."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import struct
from pathlib import Path
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.ciphers import modes
from extract_exefs import (decrypt, read_at, require, load_keys, container_entries, common_tickets,
                           nca_inventory, program_nca, nca_ctr_key, record_offset)

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--keys',type=Path,required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--manifest',type=Path,default=Path('extracted/v0/extraction-manifest.json'))
    parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path,default=Path('extracted/v0/romfs'))
    args=parser.parse_args(); require(not args.output.exists(),'Output already exists')
    manifest=json.loads(args.manifest.read_text());record=manifest['program'];keys=load_keys(args.keys)
    source=Path(manifest['source']);require(source.stat().st_size==manifest['source_size'],'Source size changed')
    with source.open('rb') as f:
        _,entries=container_entries(f,source.stat().st_size)
        actual,hdr=program_nca(nca_inventory(f,entries,keys))
        require(actual['name']==record['name'] and actual['size']==record['size'] and
                record_offset(actual)==record_offset(record),'Source Program NCA changed; extract ExeFS again')
        ctr_key=nca_ctr_key(hdr,keys,common_tickets(f,entries))
        for i in range(4):
            start,end=struct.unpack_from('<II',hdr,0x240+i*16)
            if not start:continue
            fs=hdr[0x400+512*i:0x600+512*i]
            require(hashlib.sha256(fs).digest()==hdr[0x280+32*i:0x2a0+32*i],'FS header hash')
            if fs[2:5]!=bytes([0,3,3]):continue
            require(fs[8:12]==b'IVFC' and struct.unpack_from('<III',fs,12)==(0x20000,32,7),'Unsupported IVFC layout')
            levels=[struct.unpack_from('<QQII',fs,0x18+j*24) for j in range(6)]
            def read(relative,size):
                require(0<=relative<=relative+size<=(end-start)*512,'Section bounds')
                absolute=start*512+relative;aligned=absolute&~15;skip=absolute-aligned
                iv=fs[0x140:0x148][::-1]+(aligned//16).to_bytes(8,'big')
                return decrypt(ctr_key,modes.CTR(iv),read_at(f,record_offset(record)+aligned,size+skip))[skip:]
            args.output.mkdir(parents=True);image_path=args.output/'romfs.bin';digest=hashlib.sha256();counts=[]
            parent=fs[0xc8:0xe8]
            with image_path.open('wb') as image:
                for level,(offset,size,power,reserved) in enumerate(levels):
                    require(12<=power<=24 and reserved==0,'IVFC block size');block=1<<power
                    require(len(parent)>=(size+block-1)//block*32,'IVFC parent size')
                    captured=bytearray() if level<5 else None
                    index=0
                    for pos in range(0,size,8*1024*1024):
                        chunk=read(offset+pos,min(8*1024*1024,size-pos))
                        for j in range(0,len(chunk),block):
                            payload=chunk[j:j+block]
                            require(hashlib.sha256(payload+bytes(block-len(payload))).digest()==parent[index*32:index*32+32],f'IVFC level {level} block {index} failed')
                            index+=1
                        if captured is not None:captured.extend(chunk)
                        else:image.write(chunk);digest.update(chunk)
                    counts.append(index)
                    if captured is not None:parent=bytes(captured)
                    print(f'IVFC level {level}: {index} blocks verified',flush=True)
            files=index_romfs(image_path)
            report=dict(status='pass',source_size=source.stat().st_size,program=record['name'],section=i,ivfc_blocks=counts,romfs_size=levels[-1][1],romfs_sha256=digest.hexdigest(),files=files,integrity='FS header and all six IVFC levels verified; RSA signature not checked')
            (args.output/'index.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
            print(json.dumps(dict(status='pass',file_count=len(files),size=levels[-1][1],sha256=digest.hexdigest())),flush=True);return
    raise ValueError('No supported RomFS found')

def index_romfs(path):
    with path.open('rb') as f:
        h=struct.unpack('<10Q',read_at(f,0,80));require(h[0]==80,'RomFS header');length=path.stat().st_size
        for off,size in [(h[1],h[2]),(h[3],h[4]),(h[5],h[6]),(h[7],h[8])]:require(off+size<=length,'RomFS table bounds')
        dirs=read_at(f,h[3],h[4]);entries=read_at(f,h[7],h[8]);files=[];seen_dirs=set();seen_files=set();paths=set()
        def name(table,off,n):
            require(off+n<=len(table),'Name bounds');s=table[off:off+n].decode('utf-8');require(s not in ['.','..'] and '/' not in s and '\\' not in s and '\0' not in s,'Unsafe path');return s
        todo=[(0,'')]
        while todo:
            off,parent=todo.pop();require(off not in seen_dirs and off+24<=len(dirs),'Invalid/cyclic directory');seen_dirs.add(off)
            p,sibling,child,file,hash_next,n=struct.unpack_from('<6I',dirs,off);part=name(dirs,off+24,n);prefix=parent+part+'/' if part else parent
            if sibling!=0xffffffff:todo.append((sibling,parent))
            if child!=0xffffffff:todo.append((child,prefix))
            while file!=0xffffffff:
                require(file not in seen_files and file+32<=len(entries),'Invalid/cyclic file');seen_files.add(file)
                p,next_file,data,size,hash_next,n=struct.unpack_from('<IIQQII',entries,file);part=name(entries,file+32,n);require(part!='','Empty file name');filename=prefix+part
                require(filename not in paths and h[9]+data+size<=length,'Duplicate/out-of-bounds file');paths.add(filename)
                files.append(dict(path=filename,offset=h[9]+data,size=size));file=next_file
        return sorted(files,key=lambda item:item['path'])
if __name__=='__main__':main()
```

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/by3-scripts/merge_romfs.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Merge a sparse base Program NCA and its BKTR update into one RomFS image; verify all six IVFC levels; index it.

Bayonetta 3's base NSP ships a sparse Program NCA: the ExeFS and the parts of the RomFS the update replaces are not
stored, and the pinned hactool cannot read the sparse layer. The layers here are, from the bottom up:
  base:   NCA body -> sparse indirect table (data / zero) -> AES-CTR (the section's own upper IV)
  update: NCA body -> AES-CTR-Ex (per-entry generation) ; indirect table -> base section or update data
The IVFC header of the update section covers the merged image, so a wrong layer fails a block hash.
Keys stay in memory. No executable launch, no network.
"""
import argparse
import bisect
import hashlib
import json
import struct
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.ciphers import modes

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))   # extract_exefs / extract_romfs: this folder's copies of games/totk/scripts
from extract_exefs import decrypt, read_at, require, load_keys, container_entries, common_tickets, nca_ctr_key
from extract_romfs import index_romfs

BASE_TITLE = '01004A4010FEA000'
NODE = 0x4000
CHUNK = 8 << 20


def program_header(f, entries, keys, title):
    """The single Program NCA of `title`. Sparse sections may end past the stored NCA, so bounds are checked per layer."""
    found = []
    for name, offset, length in entries:
        if not name.lower().endswith('.nca') or name.lower().endswith('.cnmt.nca'):
            continue
        raw = read_at(f, offset, 0xc00)
        hdr = b''.join(decrypt(keys['header_key'], modes.XTS(i.to_bytes(16, 'big')), raw[i * 512:(i + 1) * 512])
                       for i in range(6))
        require(hdr[0x200:0x204] == b'NCA3', 'Expected NCA3 (check prod.keys and the game file)')
        require(struct.unpack_from('<Q', hdr, 0x208)[0] == length, 'NCA size does not match container entry')
        if hdr[0x205] == 0 and f'{struct.unpack_from("<Q", hdr, 0x210)[0]:016X}' == title:
            found.append((dict(name=name, nca_offset=offset, size=length), hdr))
    require(len(found) == 1, f'Expected one Program NCA for {title}')
    return found[0]


def romfs_section(hdr):
    for i in range(4):
        start, end = struct.unpack_from('<II', hdr, 0x240 + 16 * i)
        fs = hdr[0x400 + 512 * i:0x600 + 512 * i]
        if start and fs[2:4] == b'\x00\x03':
            require(hashlib.sha256(fs).digest() == hdr[0x280 + 32 * i:0x2a0 + 32 * i], 'FS header hash mismatch')
            return start * 512, end * 512, fs
    raise ValueError('No RomFS section')


class Ctr:
    """AES-CTR over the NCA body at absolute NCA offsets; `upper` is the 8-byte big-endian upper IV."""
    def __init__(self, f, nca_offset, nca_size, key):
        self.f, self.base, self.size, self.key = f, nca_offset, nca_size, key

    def raw(self, absolute, size):
        require(0 <= absolute and absolute + size <= self.size, 'Read past the stored NCA')
        return read_at(self.f, self.base + absolute, size)

    def read(self, absolute, size, upper):
        aligned = absolute & ~15
        data = self.raw(aligned, size + absolute - aligned)
        return decrypt(self.key, modes.CTR(upper + (aligned // 16).to_bytes(8, 'big')), data)[absolute - aligned:]


def upper_iv(generation, secure):
    return struct.pack('>II', secure, generation)


def bucket_tree(read, size, header, entry_size, unpack):
    """Entries of a single-level bucket tree (L1 node + entry sets), each with its [start, end) virtual range."""
    magic, version, count = struct.unpack_from('<4sIi', header, 0)
    require(magic == b'BKTR' and version == 1 and count >= 0, 'Unsupported bucket tree header')
    if count == 0:
        return [], 0
    per_set = (NODE - 16) // entry_size
    sets = -(-count // per_set)
    require(sets <= (NODE - 16) // 8, 'Bucket trees with L2 nodes are unsupported')
    require(size == NODE * (1 + sets), 'Bucket tree size does not match its entry count')
    l1 = read(0, NODE)
    index, l1_count, total = struct.unpack_from('<iiq', l1, 0)
    require(index == 0 and l1_count == sets, 'Bucket tree L1 node')
    out = []
    for s in range(sets):
        node = read(NODE * (1 + s), NODE)
        index, n, end = struct.unpack_from('<iiq', node, 0)
        require(index == s and 0 < n <= per_set, 'Bucket tree entry set')
        first = struct.unpack_from('<q', l1, 16 + 8 * s)[0] if s else 0
        rows = [unpack(node, 16 + entry_size * k) for k in range(n)]
        require(rows[0][0] == first, 'Bucket tree entry set offset')
        for k, row in enumerate(rows):
            stop = rows[k + 1][0] if k + 1 < n else end
            require(row[0] < stop, 'Bucket tree entries out of order')
            out.append((row[0], stop) + tuple(row[1:]))
    require(len(out) == count and out[-1][1] == total, 'Bucket tree entry count / end offset')
    return out, total


def indirect_row(node, at):
    return struct.unpack_from('<qqi', node, at)


def ctr_ex_row(node, at):
    offset, encryption, generation = struct.unpack_from('<qB3xi', node, at)
    return offset, encryption, generation


class Ranges:
    def __init__(self, rows):
        self.rows, self.starts = rows, [r[0] for r in rows]

    def split(self, offset, size):
        """(row, offset within the row's range, length) pieces covering [offset, offset + size)."""
        i = bisect.bisect_right(self.starts, offset) - 1
        while size:
            require(0 <= i < len(self.rows) and self.rows[i][0] <= offset < self.rows[i][1], 'Read outside the table')
            row = self.rows[i]
            n = min(size, row[1] - offset)
            yield row, offset - row[0], n
            offset += n; size -= n; i += 1


class SparseBase:
    """The base RomFS section as it was before sparsing; parts the update replaces read as zeros."""
    def __init__(self, ctr, start, end, fs):
        boff, bsize = struct.unpack_from('<QQ', fs, 0x148)
        self.phys, generation = struct.unpack_from('<QH', fs, 0x168)
        require(generation != 0, 'Base RomFS is not sparse; use the standard extractor')
        # The table's counter uses the section's offset; verified on Bayonetta 3, where the two offsets are equal.
        require(self.phys == start, 'Sparse layout with a moved section start is untested')
        gen0, self.secure = struct.unpack_from('<II', fs, 0x140)
        self.ctr, self.start, self.upper = ctr, start, upper_iv(gen0, self.secure)
        meta_upper = upper_iv(generation << 16, self.secure)
        rows, total = bucket_tree(lambda o, n: ctr.read(self.phys + boff + o, n, meta_upper), bsize,
                                  fs[0x158:0x168], 0x14, indirect_row)
        require(total == end - start, 'Sparse table does not cover the section')
        require(all(r[3] in (0, 1) for r in rows), 'Sparse storage index')
        self.map, self.data_size, self.stored = Ranges(rows), boff, 0

    def read(self, offset, size):
        out = bytearray()
        for (_, _, phys, storage), within, n in self.map.split(offset, size):
            if storage == 1:
                out += bytes(n); continue
            p = phys + within
            require(p + n <= self.data_size, 'Sparse data out of bounds')
            # Stored blocks are the original ciphertext, so they decrypt at their original (virtual) offset. CTR works
            # byte by byte: padding to the block boundary with any bytes and dropping them gives the same plaintext.
            absolute = self.start + offset + len(out)
            pad = absolute & 15
            data = bytes(pad) + self.ctr.raw(self.phys + p, n)
            out += decrypt(self.ctr.key, modes.CTR(self.upper + ((absolute - pad) // 16).to_bytes(8, 'big')), data)[pad:]
            self.stored += n
        return bytes(out)


class Patched:
    """The update's RomFS section: indirect table over (base section, AES-CTR-Ex update data)."""
    def __init__(self, ctr, start, end, fs, base):
        ind_off, ind_size = struct.unpack_from('<QQ', fs, 0x100)
        ex_off, ex_size = struct.unpack_from('<QQ', fs, 0x120)
        gen0, self.secure = struct.unpack_from('<II', fs, 0x140)
        require(fs[4] == 4, 'Expected an AES-CTR-Ex (BKTR) update section')
        require(ind_off + ind_size <= ex_off and ex_off + ex_size <= end - start, 'Patch tables out of bounds')
        # The AES-CTR-Ex table itself is plain AES-CTR. Its extent says what it covers: up to itself, the indirect table
        # included (1.3.0, Bayonetta 3 1.2.0), or only the data before the indirect table, which is then plain AES-CTR too
        # (the 1.4.1 update). A wrong choice fails the indirect table's bucket checks or the IVFC hashes.
        plain = upper_iv(gen0, self.secure)
        ex_rows, ex_total = bucket_tree(lambda o, n: ctr.read(start + ex_off + o, n, plain), ex_size,
                                        fs[0x130:0x140], 0x10, ctr_ex_row)
        require(ex_total in (ex_off, ind_off), 'AES-CTR-Ex table must cover the section up to itself or up to the indirect table')
        self.ctr, self.start, self.base, self.ex = ctr, start, base, Ranges(ex_rows)
        read_table = (lambda o, n: self.update_data(ind_off + o, n)) if ex_total == ex_off else \
                     (lambda o, n: ctr.read(start + ind_off + o, n, plain))
        ind_rows, total = bucket_tree(read_table, ind_size, fs[0x110:0x120], 0x14, indirect_row)
        require(all(r[3] in (0, 1) for r in ind_rows), 'Indirect storage index')
        self.total, self.ind, self.data_size = total, Ranges(ind_rows), ind_off
        self.from_base = self.from_update = 0

    def update_data(self, offset, size):
        out = bytearray()
        for (_, _, encryption, generation), _, n in self.ex.split(offset, size):
            absolute = self.start + offset + len(out)
            if encryption == 1:
                out += self.ctr.raw(absolute, n)
            else:
                require(encryption == 0, 'AES-CTR-Ex encryption value')
                out += self.ctr.read(absolute, n, upper_iv(generation, self.secure))
        return bytes(out)

    def read(self, offset, size):
        out = bytearray()
        for (_, _, target, storage), within, n in self.ind.split(offset, size):
            if storage == 0:
                out += self.base.read(target + within, n); self.from_base += n
            else:
                require(target + within + n <= self.data_size, 'Update data out of bounds')
                out += self.update_data(target + within, n); self.from_update += n
        return bytes(out)


def verify_ivfc(fs, size, read, image_path):
    """All six IVFC levels (as games/totk/scripts/extract_romfs.py); level 6 is streamed to image_path."""
    require(fs[8:12] == b'IVFC' and struct.unpack_from('<III', fs, 12) == (0x20000, 32, 7), 'Unsupported IVFC layout')
    levels = [struct.unpack_from('<QQII', fs, 0x18 + j * 24) for j in range(6)]
    parent, counts, digest = fs[0xc8:0xe8], [], hashlib.sha256()
    with image_path.open('wb') as image:
        for level, (offset, length, power, reserved) in enumerate(levels):
            require(12 <= power <= 24 and reserved == 0 and offset + length <= size, 'IVFC level layout')
            block = 1 << power
            require(len(parent) >= (length + block - 1) // block * 32, 'IVFC parent size')
            captured = bytearray() if level < 5 else None
            index = 0
            for pos in range(0, length, CHUNK):
                chunk = read(offset + pos, min(CHUNK, length - pos))
                for j in range(0, len(chunk), block):
                    payload = chunk[j:j + block]
                    require(hashlib.sha256(payload + bytes(block - len(payload))).digest() == parent[index * 32:index * 32 + 32],
                            f'IVFC level {level} block {index} failed')
                    index += 1
                if captured is not None:
                    captured.extend(chunk)
                else:
                    image.write(chunk); digest.update(chunk)
                    if pos % (1 << 30) < CHUNK:
                        print(f'IVFC level {level}: {pos >> 30} / {length >> 30} GiB', flush=True)
            counts.append(index)
            if captured is not None:
                parent = bytes(captured)
            print(f'IVFC level {level}: {index} blocks verified', flush=True)
    return counts, levels[-1][1], digest.hexdigest()


def open_program(path, keys, title):
    f = path.open('rb')
    _, entries = container_entries(f, path.stat().st_size)
    record, hdr = program_header(f, entries, keys, title)
    key = nca_ctr_key(hdr, keys, common_tickets(f, entries))
    return f, record, hdr, Ctr(f, record['nca_offset'], record['size'], key)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('base', type=Path, help='base game NSP (sparse Program NCA)')
    parser.add_argument('update', type=Path, help='update NSP (BKTR Program NCA)')
    parser.add_argument('--keys', required=True, type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--title', default=BASE_TITLE, help='program title ID (default: Bayonetta 3, program 0)')
    parser.add_argument('--output', required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    require(not args.output.exists(), 'Output already exists; choose a new directory')
    keys = load_keys(args.keys)
    bf, brec, bhdr, bctr = open_program(args.base, keys, args.title)
    uf, urec, uhdr, uctr = open_program(args.update, keys, args.title)
    with bf, uf:
        base = SparseBase(bctr, *romfs_section(bhdr))
        ustart, uend, ufs = romfs_section(uhdr)
        patched = Patched(uctr, ustart, uend, ufs, base)
        args.output.mkdir(parents=True)
        image = args.output / 'romfs.bin'
        counts, size, sha = verify_ivfc(ufs, patched.total, patched.read, image)
        files = index_romfs(image)
        report = dict(status='pass', base=dict(source=str(args.base.resolve()), source_size=args.base.stat().st_size, program=brec),
                      update=dict(source=str(args.update.resolve()), source_size=args.update.stat().st_size, program=urec),
                      ivfc_blocks=counts, romfs_size=size, romfs_sha256=sha,
                      bytes_from_base=patched.from_base, bytes_from_update=patched.from_update, base_stored_bytes_read=base.stored,
                      files=files, integrity='FS headers and all six IVFC levels of the merged image verified; RSA signatures not checked')
        (args.output / 'index.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
        print(json.dumps(dict(status='pass', file_count=len(files), size=size, sha256=sha,
                              bytes_from_base=patched.from_base, bytes_from_update=patched.from_update)), flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/by3-scripts/prepare_modules.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify NSO segments, inventory dynamic symbols, and write analysis-only ELF.

ELF preserves NSO virtual segment offsets; it is NOT a macOS executable.
Only defined dynsym section indices are remapped for ELF section numbering.
"""
import argparse
import collections
import hashlib
import json
import struct
from pathlib import Path
import lz4.block


def check(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(message)


def align(value, boundary=4096):
    return (value + boundary - 1) & ~(boundary - 1)


def prepare(source, destination):
    raw = source.read_bytes()
    check(raw[:4] == b'NSO0' and len(raw) >= 256, 'Expected NSO0')
    flags = struct.unpack_from('<I', raw, 12)[0]
    compressed = struct.unpack_from('<III', raw, 0x60)
    segments = []
    for i, name in enumerate(['text', 'rodata', 'data']):
        fileoff, address, size, extra = struct.unpack_from('<IIII', raw, 0x10 + 16 * i)
        stored = compressed[i] if flags & (1 << i) else size
        check(fileoff + stored <= len(raw) and size <= 256 * 1024 * 1024, 'Invalid NSO segment')
        payload = raw[fileoff:fileoff + stored]
        data = lz4.block.decompress(payload, uncompressed_size=size) if flags & (1 << i) else payload
        digest = hashlib.sha256(data).digest()
        check(len(data) == size, 'NSO decompression size mismatch')
        if flags & (8 << i):
            check(digest == raw[0xA0 + 32 * i:0xC0 + 32 * i], f'{source.name}: {name} hash mismatch')
        segments.append({'name': name, 'address': address, 'size': size,
                         'sha256': digest.hex(), 'data': data, 'extra': extra})
    image = bytearray(max(s['address'] + s['size'] for s in segments))
    for s in segments:
        image[s['address']:s['address'] + s['size']] = s['data']

    def span(address, size):
        check(any(s['address'] <= address and address + size <= s['address'] + s['size'] for s in segments), 'Metadata outside initialized segments')
        return bytes(image[address:address + size])

    modoff = struct.unpack_from('<I', image, 4)[0]
    check(span(modoff, 4) == b'MOD0', 'Expected MOD0')
    dynoff = modoff + struct.unpack_from('<i', image, modoff + 4)[0]
    dynamic = []
    for index in range(4096):
        tag, value = struct.unpack('<qQ', span(dynoff + 16 * index, 16))
        dynamic.append((tag, value))
        if tag == 0:
            break
    else:
        raise ValueError('Unterminated dynamic table')
    tags = dict(dynamic)
    strings = span(tags[5], tags[10])

    def string(offset):
        check(offset < len(strings), 'Invalid dynstr offset')
        end = strings.find(b'\0', offset)
        check(end >= 0, 'Unterminated dynstr')
        return strings[offset:end].decode('utf-8', errors='replace')

    symoff = tags[6]
    check(tags[11] == 24, 'Expected ELF64 symbols')
    if 4 in tags:
        nbucket, nchain = struct.unpack('<II', span(tags[4], 8))
        symcount = nchain
    else:
        _, _, syms_offset, syms_size = struct.unpack_from('<IIII', raw, 0x90)
        check(segments[1]['address'] + syms_offset == symoff and syms_size % 24 == 0, 'Cannot establish symbol count')
        symcount = syms_size // 24
    symbols = []
    for i in range(symcount):
        no, info, other, section, value, size = struct.unpack('<IBBHQQ', span(symoff + 24 * i, 24))
        symbols.append({'index': i, 'name': string(no), 'value': value, 'size': size,
                        'binding': info >> 4, 'type': info & 15, 'section_index': section,
                        'defined': section != 0})
    needed = [string(value) for tag, value in dynamic if tag == 1]
    imports = [s for s in symbols if s['name'] and not s['defined']]
    exports = [s for s in symbols if s['name'] and s['defined']]
    svc = []
    text = segments[0]
    for offset in range(0, len(text['data']) - 3, 4):
        insn = struct.unpack_from('<I', text['data'], offset)[0]
        if insn & 0xFFE0001F == 0xD4000001:
            svc.append({'offset': text['address'] + offset, 'immediate': (insn >> 5) & 0xFFFF})

    # ELF headers are synthetic. LOAD payload offsets have the same 4K residue
    # as virtual addresses; runtime relocations and instruction bytes are kept.
    phnum = 4
    cursor = 4096
    loads = []
    elf = bytearray(4096)
    for i, s in enumerate(segments):
        cursor = align(cursor) + s['address'] % 4096
        s['elf_file_offset'] = cursor
        end = cursor + s['size']
        elf.extend(bytes(max(0, end - len(elf))))
        elf[cursor:end] = s['data']
        loads.append((1, [5, 4, 6][i], cursor, s['address'], s['address'], s['size'],
                      s['size'] + (s['extra'] if i == 2 else 0), 4096))
        cursor = end

    def file_offset(address, size=1):
        for s in segments:
            if s['address'] <= address and address + size <= s['address'] + s['size']:
                return s['elf_file_offset'] + address - s['address']
        raise ValueError('ELF metadata outside initialized segments')

    # name, type, flags, address, fileoff, size, link, info, alignment, entsize
    data = segments[2]
    dynsize = len(dynamic) * 16
    locals_count = sum(s['binding'] == 0 for s in symbols)
    metadata = [('.dynamic', 6, 3, dynoff, dynsize, '.dynstr', 0, 8, 16),
                ('.dynstr', 3, 2, tags[5], tags[10], None, 0, 1, 0),
                ('.dynsym', 11, 2, symoff, symcount * 24, '.dynstr', locals_count, 8, 24)]
    if 4 in tags:
        hashsize = 8 + 4 * (nbucket + nchain)
        metadata.append(('.hash', 5, 2, tags[4], hashsize, '.dynsym', 0, 8, 4))
    for name, address_tag, size_tag in [('.rela.dyn', 7, 8), ('.rela.plt', 23, 2)]:
        if address_tag in tags and size_tag in tags and tags[size_tag]:
            check(name != '.rela.plt' or tags.get(20) == 7, 'Unsupported PLT relocation format')
            size = tags[size_tag]
            metadata.append((name, 4, 2, tags[address_tag], size, '.dynsym', 0, 8, 24))
    sections = [('', 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0)]
    pending_links = {}
    # Split segment sections around metadata to avoid Ghidra overlay blocks.
    for segment_index, segment in enumerate(segments):
        begin, end = segment['address'], segment['address'] + segment['size']
        contained = sorted((m for m in metadata if begin <= m[3] and m[3] + m[4] <= end), key=lambda m: m[3])
        cursor_address, part = begin, 0
        for meta in contained:
            name, kind, attrs, address, size, link, info, alignment, entsize = meta
            check(address >= cursor_address, 'Overlapping dynamic metadata')
            if address > cursor_address:
                chunkname = '.' + segment['name'] + ('' if part == 0 else f'.{part}')
                sections.append((chunkname, 1, [6, 2, 3][segment_index], cursor_address,
                                 file_offset(cursor_address), address - cursor_address, 0, 0, 1, 0))
                part += 1
            sections.append((name, kind, attrs, address, file_offset(address, size), size, 0, info, alignment, entsize))
            if link:
                pending_links[len(sections) - 1] = link
            cursor_address = address + size
        if cursor_address < end:
            chunkname = '.' + segment['name'] + ('' if part == 0 else f'.{part}')
            sections.append((chunkname, 1, [6, 2, 3][segment_index], cursor_address,
                             file_offset(cursor_address), end - cursor_address, 0, 0, 1, 0))
    sections.append(('.bss', 8, 3, data['address'] + data['size'], data['elf_file_offset'] + data['size'], data['extra'], 0, 0, 1, 0))
    section_indices = {s[0]: i for i, s in enumerate(sections)}
    for i, link in pending_links.items():
        row = list(sections[i])
        row[6] = section_indices[link]
        sections[i] = tuple(row)
    changed = []
    for s in symbols:
        if s['section_index'] in (0, 0xFFF1, 0xFFF2):
            continue
        index = next((i for i, section in enumerate(sections)
                      if section[2] & 2 and section[3] <= s['value'] < section[3] + section[5]), None)
        if index is None:
            index = next((i for i, section in enumerate(sections)
                          if section[2] & 2 and s['size'] == 0 and s['value'] == section[3] + section[5]), None)
        check(index is not None, f'Cannot map defined symbol: {s["name"]}')
        if index != s['section_index']:
            location = file_offset(symoff + s['index'] * 24 + 6, 2)
            struct.pack_into('<H', elf, location, index)
            changed.append({'symbol': s['index'], 'file_offset': location,
                            'original': s['section_index'], 'elf': index})
    name_table = bytearray(b'\0')
    names = {}
    for name in [s[0] for s in sections] + ['.shstrtab']:
        if name not in names:
            names[name] = len(name_table)
            name_table.extend(name.encode() + b'\0')
    nameoff = align(len(elf), 8)
    elf.extend(bytes(nameoff - len(elf)) + name_table)
    sections.append(('.shstrtab', 3, 0, 0, nameoff, len(name_table), 0, 0, 1, 0))
    shoff = align(len(elf), 8)
    elf.extend(bytes(shoff - len(elf)))
    for section in sections:
        name, *fields = section
        elf.extend(struct.pack('<IIQQQQIIQQ', names[name] if name else 0, *fields))
    ident = b'\x7fELF\x02\x01\x01' + bytes(9)
    elf[:64] = struct.pack('<16sHHIQQQIHHHHHH', ident, 3, 183, 1, 0, 64, shoff, 0, 64, 56, phnum, 64, len(sections), len(sections) - 1)
    loads.append((2, 6, file_offset(dynoff), dynoff, dynoff, dynsize, dynsize, 8))
    for i, ph in enumerate(loads):
        struct.pack_into('<IIQQQQQQ', elf, 64 + 56 * i, *ph)
    # Validate every LOAD byte against the NSO, allowing only recorded index edits.
    check_image = bytearray(elf)
    for change in changed:
        struct.pack_into('<H', check_image, change['file_offset'], change['original'])
    for s in segments:
        offset = s['elf_file_offset']
        check(bytes(check_image[offset:offset + s['size']]) == s['data'], 'ELF payload differs from NSO')
    destination.write_bytes(elf)
    result = {'module': source.name, 'nso_sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
              'build_id': raw[0x40:0x60].hex(), 'elf_sha256': hashlib.sha256(elf).hexdigest(),
              'elf_purpose': 'analysis carrier only; not a native port or runnable program',
              'segments': [{k: v for k, v in s.items() if k != 'data'} for s in segments],
              'segment_hashes_verified': True, 'mod0_offset': modoff, 'dynamic_offset': dynoff,
              'dynamic_tags': dynamic, 'needed': needed, 'imports': imports, 'exports': exports,
              'svc_instruction_candidates': svc, 'elf_symbol_index_changes': changed,
              'limitations': ['Service permissions do not prove runtime usage.', 'SVC byte matches are candidates until control flow is analyzed.', 'ELF headers and symbol section indices are synthetic analysis metadata.']}
    return result


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('exefs', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--output', required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    inventory = []
    for name in ['rtld', 'main', 'sdk', 'subsdk0']:
        result = prepare(args.exefs / name, args.output / (name + '.elf'))
        (args.output / (name + '-inventory.json')).write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
        summary = {k: result[k] for k in ['module', 'build_id', 'needed', 'segment_hashes_verified']}
        summary.update(imports=len(result['imports']), exports=len(result['exports']),
                       text_bytes=result['segments'][0]['size'], svc_candidates=len(result['svc_instruction_candidates']))
        inventory.append(summary)
    (args.output / 'modules.json').write_text(json.dumps(inventory, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps(inventory, indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r/README.md`:

```md
# D2R 改写器来源

上游：https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile

固定提交：`9f0c25768ac4b231c6f4cb0a9f182ded68d0e7cf`

复制文件：`dm/tools/patch_nso.py`、`dm/verify/structck.py`、
`dm/verify/equiv.py`、`dm/verify/nsoimg.py`。MIT 许可证见同目录 LICENSE。
`call_window.py` 为本工程新增的调用窗口编码器。

本地改动：

1. 识别 `br x18` 跳转表时，向前查看的指令数量从 8 增加到 32。
《王国之泪》v0 的 `main+0x590574` 在地址计算与跳转之间插入了浮点指令，
原来的八条窗口无法读到 `main+0x590550` 的 `adr x18`。
2. 为 `main+0x9c9858: blr x18` 增加两字 C 窗口：重放前一条栈存储，
   保存/恢复借用寄存器，通过 K18 线程槽准备 x30，然后回到原调用位置执行
   `blr x30`。因此原 SP、参数和产生 LR 的 PC 保持一致。检查已知直接分支、
   函数入口、动态定义与相对重定位，拒绝绕过准备字进入第二字的情况。
3. 独占窗口出口表的第一个条目改为默认落空出口 hi，修复两个外部分支窗口
   条件未成立时落入条件成立出口的问题。
4. 结构检查器理解 C 窗口并逐指令核对其模板和出口；无游戏专用宿主门时不要求
   D2R 的 hle.h，涉及宿主门的 CUTS 仍需显式提供已登记接口。
5. 等价检查器在 C 窗口内继续执行原调用位置的 BLR，再比较被调用函数入口状态。
   其余判据保持原有方式；独占访问仍使用原有 deexcl 测试模型。

main/sdk/subsdk0 均已使用本地版本重新生成并完成全量结构和逐站点等价检查。
新增调用方式另有递归、异常目标、负对照与 M4 原生多线程测试；修复的独占窗口
另有未简化的 LDXR/STXR 成功路径与注入失败状态测试。
复现入口：`make verify`，完整范围说明见项目 README 与 claude.md。

`../../runtime/gate.S` adapts the register-preserving `dm_gate` section of
`dm/host/entry.S` from the same pinned upstream commit, under the included MIT
license. The loader and service dispatch are separate TOTK-specific code.
```
