`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r/relr.py`:

```py
"""Bounded ELF64 DT_RELR decoding for locally supplied NSO modules.

Encoding: https://github.com/xinuos/gabi/issues/2 (Relative Relocation Table).
Return explicit (where, implicit_addend) pairs for the existing RELATIVE loader.
"""
import struct


def decode_relr(image, tags, lower, upper):
    if not any(key in tags for key in (35, 36, 37)):
        return []
    if not all(key in tags for key in (35, 36, 37)) or tags[37] != 8 or tags[35] % 8:
        raise ValueError('Invalid ELF64 RELR dynamic tags')
    table, size = tags[36], tags[35]
    if not 0 <= table <= table + size <= len(image):
        raise ValueError('RELR table outside image')
    addresses, seen, cursor = [], set(), None

    def append(address):
        if address % 8 or not lower <= address <= upper - 8 or address + 8 > len(image):
            raise ValueError(f'RELR relocation outside writable image: {address:#x}')
        if address in seen:
            raise ValueError(f'Duplicate RELR relocation: {address:#x}')
        seen.add(address)
        addend = struct.unpack_from('<Q', image, address)[0]
        if addend >= upper:
            raise ValueError(f'RELR addend outside module: {address:#x}')
        addresses.append((address, addend))

    for offset in range(table, table + size, 8):
        entry = struct.unpack_from('<Q', image, offset)[0]
        if entry & 1 == 0:
            append(entry)
            cursor = entry + 8
        else:
            if cursor is None:
                raise ValueError('RELR bitmap before initial address')
            for bit in range(1, 64):
                if entry & (1 << bit):
                    append(cursor + (bit - 1) * 8)
            cursor += 63 * 8
    return addresses

```

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r/structck.py`:

```py
# 改写结构核对：不跑代码，逐字核对改写器产物。分母用独立反汇编器（llvm-objdump）重数，不依赖改写器自己的 capstone 扫描。
# 用法：structck.py <改写产物目录> <模块> <NSO>     输出末行 STRUCT <模块> OK|FAIL ...，退出码 0/1
# 核对项：
#  ⓪ 已登记剪口（cuts.tsv）：构建号对得上，原映像该处 == 原字节、改写映像 == 新字节、理由非空，不与改写点 / 窗口重叠；剪口引入的宿主调用门（svc #N≥0x80）按 hle.h 登记行核号、偏移与形态（入口形 svc;ret 在函数入口 / 调用点形原指令是 bl 且目标符登记）
#  ① 非 text 段除剪口外与原映像逐字节相同，映像尾到补丁区之间全 0
#  ② text 改动的字 == 改写点头（sites.tsv 非 J 行 + 窗口起点）∪ text 内剪口，改写点头都是跳进补丁区的 B
#  ③ 独立分母：llvm-objdump 读原 text，x18/w18 操作数、tpidr_el0 读写、tpidrro_el0 读、svc、cntpct/cntvct
#     全部落在改写点或窗口内；反向，每个改写点都在独立集合里（窗口起点除外）
#  ④ 补丁区里不再有 x18/w18、tpidr_el0、svc、cntpct/cntvct
#  ⑤ 宿主门（svc / 计时）块逐字等于模板，gates.tsv 一一对上（返回点、种类、svc 号 / 目标寄存器、原地址）
#  ⑧ 参数门（params.tsv）：原两字为 64 位 movz/movk 造常数、新两字 = mrs tpidrro / ldr 键槽、中间不碰该寄存器、区间无分支目标、键号登记、同键原值唯一
#  ⑦ 已登记观测门（obs.tsv）：原映像该处 == 登记原指令字；原指令可搬（非 PC 相对 / 非分支 / 不涉 x18 / 不读写系统寄存器，capstone 判）；
#     可在函数中间（门 ABI 全存回，gatefn 核）；不与改写点 / 窗口 / 剪口重叠；门块逐字 = 模板（svc 门同构前半 + 原指令 + b 回 off+4），gates.tsv 记 obs 行
#  ⑩ 跳板出口：每个跳进补丁区的 b，补丁块回 text 的出口只能是 原处+4 / 吸收段尾 / 窗口尾 / 段内原指令的分支目标（已登记剪口放行并列出）
#  ⑪ 剪口引入的分支门（hle.h 登记「分支门」行）：块逐字 = 模板、两路恢复 x8、gates.tsv 对上
#  ⑥ 线程槽：表头四个键号互不相同且 < 512；补丁区每条 mrs xN, tpidrro_el0 之后（跳过不写 xN 的 adrp/add）都是 ldr/str xM,[xN,#键号×8]
# Rewrite structural check: no code is run, the rewriter's build output is checked word by word. Denominators are recounted with an independent disassembler (llvm-objdump), not relying on the rewriter's own capstone scan.
# Usage: structck.py <rewrite build output dir> <module> <NSO>     last output line STRUCT <module> OK|FAIL ..., exit code 0/1
# Checks:
#  ⓪ Registered cuts (cuts.tsv): build ID matches, original image at that site == original bytes, rewritten image == new bytes, reason non-empty, no overlap with rewrite sites / windows; host-call gates introduced by cuts (svc #N≥0x80) have number, offset and form checked against the hle.h registry row (entry form svc;ret at a function entry / call-site form where the original instruction is bl and the target matches the registration)
#  ① Non-text segments are byte-for-byte identical to the original image except for cuts; everything from the end of the image to the patch area is 0
#  ② Changed words in text == rewrite site heads (non-J rows of sites.tsv + window starts) ∪ cuts inside text; all rewrite site heads are a B into the patch area
#  ③ Independent denominator: llvm-objdump reads the original text; x18/w18 operands, tpidr_el0 reads/writes, tpidrro_el0 reads, svc, cntpct/cntvct
#     all fall within rewrite sites or windows; conversely, every rewrite site is in the independent set (except window starts)
#  ④ The patch area no longer contains x18/w18, tpidr_el0, svc, cntpct/cntvct
#  ⑤ Host gate (svc / timer) blocks equal the template word for word, and match gates.tsv one to one (return point, kind, svc number / destination register, original address)
#  ⑧ Parameter gates (params.tsv): the two original words build a constant with 64-bit movz/movk, the two new words = mrs tpidrro / ldr key slot, the register is not touched in between, no branch target in the range, key number registered, a unique original value per key
#  ⑦ Registered observation gates (obs.tsv): original image at that site == the registered original instruction word; the original instruction is relocatable (not PC-relative / not a branch / does not involve x18 / does not read or write system registers, judged by capstone);
#     may be in the middle of a function (the gate ABI saves and restores everything, checked by gatefn); no overlap with rewrite sites / windows / cuts; the gate block = the template word for word (the same first half as an svc gate + original instruction + b back to off+4), gates.tsv records an obs row
#  ⑩ Trampoline exits: for every b jumping into the patch area, the patch block's exits back to text may only be original site+4 / end of the absorbed span / end of the window / a branch target of an original instruction within the span (registered cuts are let through and listed)
#  ⑪ Branch gates introduced by cuts (hle.h registry 「分支门」(branch gate) rows): block = template word for word, x8 restored on both paths, matches gates.tsv
#  ⑥ Thread slots: the four key numbers in the header are mutually distinct and < 512; every mrs xN, tpidrro_el0 in the patch area is followed (skipping adrp/add that do not write xN) by ldr/str xM,[xN,#key number×8]
import sys, os, re, struct, subprocess, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
import nsoimg
DM_ROOT = os.environ.get('DM_ROOT') or os.path.expanduser('~/dm-work')   # 工作区根目录（游戏文件、产物、运行现场都在它下面） | Workspace root (game files, build outputs and run artifacts are all under it)

LLVM = os.environ.get('LLVM_BIN', '/opt/homebrew/opt/llvm@23/bin')
out_dir, mod, nso = sys.argv[1:4]
orig = nsoimg.load(nso)
h = nsoimg.header(out_dir, mod)
PO, TE = h['PATCH_OFF'], h['TEXT_END']
pat = open(f'{out_dir}/{mod}.patched.bin', 'rb').read()
W = lambda b, o: struct.unpack_from('<I', b, o)[0]
fails = []
def bad(msg):
    fails.append(msg)
    if len(fails) <= 30: print('FAIL', msg)

def llvm_dis(blob, base):
    """按原始字节反汇编，返回相关行 {偏移: 小写指令文本}。 | Disassemble from raw bytes and return the relevant lines {offset: lowercase instruction text}."""
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        b, e = os.path.join(td, 'x.bin'), os.path.join(td, 'x.elf')
        open(b, 'wb').write(blob)
        subprocess.run([f'{LLVM}/llvm-objcopy', '-I', 'binary', '-O', 'elf64-littleaarch64',
                        '--rename-section', '.data=.text,code', b, e], check=True)
        # 只留可能相关的行（x18/w18、tpidr、svc、cnt?ct），几百万行的筛选交给 grep
        # Keep only potentially relevant lines (x18/w18, tpidr, svc, cnt?ct); filtering millions of lines is left to grep
        od = subprocess.Popen([f'{LLVM}/llvm-objdump', '-d', '--no-show-raw-insn', e], stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
        r = subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/grep', '-iE', r'[xw]18|tpidr|svc|cnt[pv]ct'], stdin=od.stdout, capture_output=True, text=True)
        od.stdout.close(); assert od.wait() == 0
    out = {}
    for line in r.stdout.splitlines():
        m = re.match(r'\s*([0-9a-f]+):\s+(.*)$', line)
        if m: out[base + int(m.group(1), 16)] = m.group(2).split('//')[0].split('<')[0].strip().lower()
    return out

RX18 = re.compile(r'\b[xw]18\b')
def sysk(t):
    if re.match(r'svc\s', t): return 'svc'
    if re.match(r'mrs\s', t) and 'tpidr_el0' in t: return 'tpidr_r'
    if re.match(r'msr\s', t) and 'tpidr_el0' in t: return 'tpidr_w'
    if re.match(r'mrs\s', t) and 'tpidrro_el0' in t: return 'tpidrro_r'
    if re.match(r'mrs\s', t) and 'cntpct_el0' in t: return 'cntpct'
    if re.match(r'mrs\s', t) and 'cntvct_el0' in t: return 'cntvct'
    return None

# ---- sites.tsv ----
sites = {}; wins = []; jumps = 0; calls = {}
for l in open(f'{out_dir}/{mod}.sites.tsv'):
    f = l.split(); a = int(f[0], 16)
    if f[1] == 'J': jumps += 1; continue
    if f[1] == 'W': wins.append((a, int(f[2], 16))); sites[a] = 'W'
    elif f[1] == 'C':
        end = int(f[2], 16)
        if end != a + 8: bad(f'call window must have two words {a:#x}')
        calls[a] = end - 4; wins.append((a, end)); sites[a] = 'C'
    else: sites[a] = f[1]
inwin = set(o for lo, hi in wins for o in range(lo, hi, 4))
atomic_groups = nsoimg.exclusive_groups(orig, [(lo, hi) for lo, hi in wins if lo not in calls])

# ⓪ 已登记剪口
# ⓪ Registered cuts
cuts = []; bid = None
for l in open(f'{out_dir}/{mod}.cuts.tsv'):
    if l.startswith('# BUILD_ID'): bid = l.split()[-1]; continue
    f = l.rstrip('\n').split('\t')
    if len(f) == 4: f = f[:3] + ['全'] + f[3:]                      # 旧 4 列格式：作用域缺省「全」 | Old 4-column format: scope defaults to 「全」(all)
    off, ob, nb, scope, why = f[:5]
    if scope not in ('全', '仅宿主'): bad(f'剪口 {off} 作用域不认识：{scope}')
    cuts.append((int(off, 16), bytes.fromhex(ob), bytes.fromhex(nb), why))
if bid != open(nso, 'rb').read(0x50)[0x40:0x50].hex(): bad(f'cuts.tsv 构建号 {bid} 与 NSO 不符')
cutb = set()
for off, ob, nb, why in cuts:
    if orig[off:off + len(ob)] != ob: bad(f'剪口 {off:#x} 原字节不符')
    for k in range(0, len(nb), 4):                               # 新字节里的 svc 字随后被改写成门（头是 B），按改写点核，这里跳过 | The svc words in the new bytes are subsequently rewritten into gates (head is B) and checked as rewrite sites; skipped here
        if int.from_bytes(nb[k:k + 4], 'little') & 0xFFE0001F == 0xD4000001: continue
        if pat[off + k:off + k + len(nb[k:k + 4])] != nb[k:k + 4]: bad(f'剪口 {off:#x}+{k} 改写映像不是新字节'); break
    if not why.strip() or len(ob) != len(nb): bad(f'剪口 {off:#x} 理由为空或长度不等')
    cutb |= set(range(off, off + len(ob)))
# 剪口产生的宿主调用门：剪口新字节里解出 svc #N 的那个字（N ≥ 0x80，须在 hle.h 宿主调用号登记表 SVC_HOST_*）
# Host-call gates produced by cuts: the word in the cut's new bytes that decodes to svc #N (N ≥ 0x80, must be in the hle.h host-call number registry SVC_HOST_*)
_hostcall = {}
registry_path = os.environ.get('DM_HOST_REGISTRY', os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), '..', 'host', 'hle.h'))
registry_text = open(registry_path).read() if os.path.isfile(registry_path) else ''
_reg = {int(v, 16) for v in re.findall(r'SVC_HOST_\w+\s*=\s*(0x[0-9a-fA-F]+)', registry_text)}
for off, ob, nb, why in cuts:
    for k in range(0, len(nb), 4):
        w = int.from_bytes(nb[k:k + 4], 'little')
        if w & 0xFFE0001F == 0xD4000001:
            n = (w >> 5) & 0xFFFF; a = off + k
            if n < 0x80: bad(f'剪口 {off:#x} 引入 svc #{n:#x}：0x80 以下是 Horizon 号段，剪口不得占用')
            elif n not in _reg: bad(f'剪口 {off:#x} 引入 svc #{n:#x}：未在 hle.h 宿主调用号登记表')
            elif sites.get(a) != 'svc': bad(f'剪口 {off:#x} 引入的 svc #{n:#x} 没被改写成宿主门（sites.tsv 无 {a:#x} svc）')
            _hostcall[a] = n
# 宿主调用门的形态按 hle.h 登记表那一行核（「号 … 剪口（main 偏移）」列）：
#   入口形（「…入口」）：新字节 = svc #N ; ret，偏移是 eh_frame 函数入口——门保存恢复 x30，ret 回原调用者；
#   调用点形（「bl 0x目标 …」）：原指令必须是 bl 且目标 = 登记目标，新字节 = 单条 svc #N，门返回 off+4（⑤ 模板的末条 b 核）。
#   调用点形的寄存器理由：bl 处按 AAPCS 被调函数本可破坏 x9..x17、x16/x17、x30 与 NZCV，所以门在这些上的副作用不改变调用方可见行为；
#   x0..x7 返回值与 x19..x28 / sp 由宿主门契约保持（gatefn 逐门核）。
# The form of a host-call gate is checked against its row in the hle.h registry (the 「号 … 剪口（main 偏移）」(number ... cut (main offset)) column):
#   entry form (「…入口」(... entry)): new bytes = svc #N ; ret, the offset is an eh_frame function entry - the gate saves and restores x30, ret returns to the original caller;
#   call-site form (「bl 0x目标 …」(bl 0x<target> ...)): the original instruction must be bl with target = the registered target, new bytes = a single svc #N, the gate returns to off+4 (checked by the final b of the ⑤ template).
#   Register rationale for the call-site form: at a bl, per AAPCS the callee could clobber x9..x17, x16/x17, x30 and NZCV anyway, so the gate's side effects on these do not change caller-visible behavior;
#   the x0..x7 return values and x19..x28 / sp are preserved by the host gate contract (checked gate by gate by gatefn).
_hreg = {}
for l in registry_text.splitlines():
    m = re.match(r'//\s+(0x[0-9a-fA-F]+)\s.*?\s(0x[0-9a-fA-F]+)（([^）]*)', l)
    if m: _hreg[int(m[1], 16)] = (int(m[2], 16), m[3])
def _bl(w, o): return o + 4 * (((w & 0x3FFFFFF) ^ 0x2000000) - 0x2000000) if w & 0xFC000000 == 0x94000000 else None
for a, n in _hostcall.items():
    if n not in _hreg: bad(f'宿主调用 svc #{n:#x}：hle.h 登记表没有对应行'); continue
    roff, form = _hreg[n]
    if mod != 'main' or roff != a: bad(f'宿主调用 svc #{n:#x} 在 {mod} {a:#x}，登记表写 main {roff:#x}'); continue
    nbw = next(c[2] for c in cuts if c[0] <= a < c[0] + len(c[2]))
    mt = re.search(r'\bbl (0x[0-9a-fA-F]+)', form)
    if mt:
        t = _bl(W(orig, a), a)
        if t is None: bad(f'宿主调用 svc #{n:#x} {a:#x}：登记为调用点形，原指令 {W(orig, a):#010x} 不是 bl')
        elif t != int(mt[1], 16): bad(f'宿主调用 svc #{n:#x} {a:#x}：原 bl 目标 {t:#x} ≠ 登记 {mt[1]}')
        if len(nbw) != 4: bad(f'宿主调用 svc #{n:#x} {a:#x}：调用点形剪口只许换这一条指令')
    elif '入口' in form:
        if a not in set(nsoimg.func_starts(orig, TE)): bad(f'宿主调用 svc #{n:#x} {a:#x}：登记为入口形，不是 eh_frame 函数入口')
        if nbw[4:8] != (0xD65F03C0).to_bytes(4, 'little'): bad(f'宿主调用 svc #{n:#x} {a:#x}：入口形新字节不是 svc ; ret')
    else: bad(f'宿主调用 svc #{n:#x}：登记表形态认不出（须含「bl 0x目标」或「入口」）：{form}')
if cutb & {a + i for a in list(sites) + list(inwin) if a not in _hostcall for i in range(4)}: bad('剪口与改写点 / 窗口重叠')
ncut_code = sum(1 for c in cuts if c[0] < TE); ncut_data = len(cuts) - ncut_code
obs = []
obs_p = f'{out_dir}/{mod}.obs.tsv'
if os.path.exists(obs_p):
    for l in open(obs_p, encoding='utf-8'):
        if l.startswith('# BUILD_ID'):
            if l.split()[-1] != open(nso, 'rb').read(0x50)[0x40:0x50].hex(): bad('obs.tsv 构建号与 NSO 不符')
            continue
        off, oid, ow, why = l.rstrip('\n').split('\t', 3); obs.append((int(off, 16), int(oid), int(ow, 16), why))
obs_heads = {o for o, *_ in obs}
params = []                                                          # 参数门（params.tsv，r11 起）：(A 偏移, B 偏移, 寄存器号, 键名) | Parameter gates (params.tsv, since r11): (A offset, B offset, register number, key name)
par_p = f'{out_dir}/{mod}.params.tsv'
if os.path.exists(par_p):
    for l in open(par_p, encoding='utf-8'):
        if l.startswith('# BUILD_ID'):
            if l.split()[-1] != open(nso, 'rb').read(0x50)[0x40:0x50].hex(): bad('params.tsv 构建号与 NSO 不符')
            continue
        a, b, r, k, why = l.rstrip('\n').split('\t', 4)
        if not why.strip(): bad(f'参数门 {a} 理由为空')
        params.append((int(a, 16), int(b, 16), int(r.lstrip('x')), k))
par_words = {o for a, b, r, k in params for o in (a, b)}

# ① 非 text 段：先整块比，块不同再逐字节，差异只许落在剪口里（剪口字节已在 ⓪ 按应有值核过）
# ① Non-text segments: compare whole blocks first, then byte by byte where blocks differ; differences may only fall inside cuts (cut bytes were already checked against their expected values in ⓪)
nd = []
for blk in range(TE, len(orig), 4096):
    e = min(blk + 4096, len(orig))
    if pat[blk:e] != orig[blk:e]: nd += [o for o in range(blk, e) if pat[o] != orig[o] and o not in cutb]
if nd: bad(f'非 text 段与原映像不同（剪口以外）{len(nd)} 字节 例 {[hex(x) for x in nd[:5]]}')
if any(pat[len(orig):PO]): bad('映像尾到补丁区之间非 0')

# ② text 改动 == 改写点头
# ② text changes == rewrite site heads
diff = set()
for blk in range(0, TE & ~3, 4096):                    # 先整块比，块不同再逐字 | Compare whole blocks first, then word by word where blocks differ
    e = min(blk + 4096, TE & ~3)
    if orig[blk:e] != pat[blk:e]: diff |= {o for o in range(blk, e, 4) if W(orig, o) != W(pat, o)}
heads = set(sites)
cutw = {o & ~3 for o in cutb if o < TE}
_exp = (heads | set(calls.values()) | obs_heads | par_words) - cutw; _got = diff - cutw
if _got != _exp: bad(f'text 改动与改写点不一致：多改 {len(_got - _exp)} 漏改 {len(_exp - _got)} 例 {[hex(x) for x in sorted(_got ^ _exp)[:5]]}')
def btarget(o):
    w = W(pat, o)
    if w & 0xFC000000 != 0x14000000: return None
    imm = w & 0x3FFFFFF
    if imm & 0x2000000: imm -= 0x4000000
    return o + 4 * imm
nb = [a for a in heads | obs_heads if not (btarget(a) is not None and PO <= btarget(a) < len(pat))]
if nb: bad(f'改写点头不是跳进补丁区的 B：{len(nb)} 例 {[hex(x) for x in nb[:5]]}')

# ③ 独立分母
# ③ Independent denominator
def cached_dis(blob):
    """原映像是固定数据：相关行按 sha 缓存（llvm 换版本另起键），只在首次付反汇编的十来秒。 | The original image is fixed data: relevant lines are cached by sha (a new llvm version gets a new key), so the ten-odd seconds of disassembly are paid only the first time."""
    import hashlib, json
    cd = os.environ.get('DM_VCACHE', os.path.join(DM_ROOT, 'build/cache/dm/verify'))
    ver = os.path.basename(os.path.dirname(LLVM.rstrip('/')))
    p = os.path.join(cd, f'{mod}.{hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest()[:16]}.{ver}.json')
    if os.path.exists(p): return {int(k): v for k, v in json.load(open(p)).items()}
    d = llvm_dis(blob, 0)
    os.makedirs(cd, exist_ok=True); tmp = f'{p}.new.{os.getpid()}'; json.dump(d, open(tmp, 'w')); os.replace(tmp, p)
    return d
D = cached_dis(orig[:TE])
ind = {}
for o, t in D.items():
    if RX18.search(t): ind[o] = 'x18'
    k = sysk(t)
    if k: ind[o] = k
miss = sorted(o for o in ind if o not in sites and o not in inwin)
if miss: bad(f'独立反汇编有、改写点没覆盖：{len(miss)} 例 {[(hex(x), D[x]) for x in miss[:5]]}')
extra = sorted(a for a, k in sites.items() if k not in ('W', 'C') and a not in ind and a not in _hostcall)
if extra: bad(f'改写点不在独立集合里：{len(extra)} 例 {[(hex(x), D.get(x)) for x in extra[:5]]}')
kmis = sorted(a for a, k in sites.items() if k not in ('W', 'C') and a in ind and ind[a] != k)
if kmis: bad(f'改写点种类与独立判读不同：{len(kmis)} 例 {[(hex(x), sites[x], D[x]) for x in kmis[:5]]}')
nwin_ref = sum(1 for o in ind if o in inwin)

# ④ 补丁区干净
# ④ Patch area is clean
P = llvm_dis(pat[PO:], PO)
left = sorted(o for o, t in P.items() if RX18.search(t) or sysk(t) not in (None, 'tpidrro_r'))
if left: bad(f'补丁区残留 x18/系统寄存器/svc：{len(left)} 例 {[(hex(x), P[x]) for x in left[:5]]}')

# ⑤ 宿主门
# ⑤ Host gates
KEY = {k[4:-4]: v for k, v in h.items() if k.startswith('KEY_') and k.endswith('_IDX')}
from capstone import Cs, CS_ARCH_ARM64, CS_MODE_ARM
_md = Cs(CS_ARCH_ARM64, CS_MODE_ARM); _md.detail = True
def keyseq(at):
    q = list(_md.disasm(pat[at:at + 20], at))
    if len(q) < 5 or q[0].mnemonic != 'mrs' or 'tpidrro_el0' not in q[0].op_str \
            or q[1].mnemonic != 'adrp' or q[1].operands[1].imm != h['KEY_PAGE_OFF'] \
            or q[2].mnemonic != 'ldr' or q[2].operands[1].mem.base != q[1].operands[0].reg \
            or q[3].mnemonic != 'add' or q[3].operands[0].reg != q[0].operands[0].reg \
            or q[3].operands[1].reg != q[0].operands[0].reg:
        return None
    d = q[2].operands[1].mem.disp
    return (q[3].address + 4, d // 8) if d % 8 == 0 and 0 <= d // 8 < 8 else None
# C windows intentionally change the call word as well as the preceding head.
# Inspect the actual decoded sequence, including the original link-producing PC.
for prefix, call in calls.items():
    start = btarget(prefix)
    if start is None or not PO <= start < len(pat):
        bad(f'call preparation has no trampoline {prefix:#x}'); continue
    decoded = list(_md.disasm(pat[start:start + 36], start))
    first = next(_md.disasm(orig[prefix:prefix + 4], prefix), None)
    safe = first and first.mnemonic in ('str', 'stp', 'stur', 'ldr', 'ldp', 'ldur') and not first.writeback \
        and first.reg_name(first.operands[-1].mem.base) in ('sp', 'fp') and not first.operands[-1].mem.index \
        and (first.reg_name(first.operands[-1].mem.base) != 'sp' or first.operands[-1].mem.disp >= 0) and not RX18.search(first.op_str)
    slot = keyseq(start + 8)
    if len(decoded) != 9 or not safe or W(pat, start) != W(orig, prefix) \
            or W(orig, call) != 0xD63F0240 or W(pat, call) != 0xD63F03C0 \
            or W(pat, start + 4) != 0xF81F03E0 or W(pat, start + 8) != 0xD53BD07E \
            or not slot or slot[1] != KEY['K18'] \
            or W(pat, start + 20) != 0x8B0003DE or W(pat, start + 24) != 0xF94003DE \
            or W(pat, start + 28) != 0xF85F03E0 or btarget(start + 32) != call:
        bad(f'call window does not preserve store/scratch/link PC {prefix:#x}')
    elif decoded[3].reg_name(decoded[3].operands[0].reg) != 'x0' \
            or decoded[4].reg_name(decoded[4].operands[0].reg) != 'x0':
        bad(f'call window key scratch mismatch {prefix:#x}')

def paramseq(at, r):
    q = list(_md.disasm(pat[at:at + 40], at))
    tmp = 17 if r == 16 else 16
    rn = lambda ins, i: ins.reg_name(ins.operands[i].reg)
    if len(q) < 8 or q[0].mnemonic not in ('stur', 'str') or rn(q[0], 0) != f'x{tmp}' \
            or q[0].operands[1].mem.base != capstone.arm64_const.ARM64_REG_SP or q[0].operands[1].mem.disp not in (-16, -24) \
            or q[1].mnemonic != 'mrs' or rn(q[1], 0) != f'x{r}' \
            or 'tpidrro_el0' not in q[1].op_str or q[2].mnemonic != 'adrp' \
            or q[2].operands[1].imm != h['KEY_PAGE_OFF'] or q[3].mnemonic != 'ldr' \
            or q[3].operands[1].mem.base != q[2].operands[0].reg or q[4].mnemonic != 'add' \
            or q[4].operands[0].reg != q[1].operands[0].reg or q[4].operands[1].reg != q[1].operands[0].reg \
            or q[5].mnemonic != 'ldr' or q[5].operands[0].reg != q[1].operands[0].reg \
            or q[5].operands[1].mem.base != q[4].operands[0].reg or q[6].mnemonic not in ('ldur', 'ldr') \
            or rn(q[6], 0) != f'x{tmp}' \
            or q[6].operands[1].mem.base != capstone.arm64_const.ARM64_REG_SP \
            or q[6].operands[1].mem.disp != q[0].operands[1].mem.disp or q[7].mnemonic != 'b':
        return None
    d = q[3].operands[1].mem.disp
    return (q[6].address + 4, d // 8)
gates = {}
for l in open(f'{out_dir}/{mod}.gates.tsv'):
    r, k, arg, oa = l.split(); gates[int(r, 16)] = (k, int(arg), int(oa, 16))
def B(frm, to): return 0x14000000 | (((to - frm) >> 2) & 0x3FFFFFF)
# 门块 blr 前须有 ldr x29,[sp]：键页取槽借用的 x29 还原成客体原值，宿主读到的 x29 才是真帧指针（r26，见 patch_nso emit_gate_call）
# The gate block must have ldr x29,[sp] before blr: the x29 borrowed for fetching the slot via the key page is restored to the guest's original value, so the x29 the host reads is the real frame pointer (r26, see patch_nso emit_gate_call)
LDR_X29_SP = 0xF94003FD
gsites = sorted(a for a, k in sites.items() if k in ('svc', 'cntpct', 'cntvct'))

    ks = keyseq(s + 4)
    if W(pat, s) != 0xA9BF7BFD or not ks or ks[1] != KEY.get('KGATE') \
            or W(pat, ks[0]) & 0xFFC00000 != 0xF9400000 or W(pat, ks[0] + 4) != LDR_X29_SP or W(pat, ks[0] + 8) != 0xD63F03C0 \
            or W(pat, ks[0] + 12) != 0xA8C17BFD or W(pat, ks[0] + 16) != B(ks[0] + 16, a + 4):
        bad(f'门块不符键页模板 {a:#x}'); continue
    arg = (ow >> 5) & 0xFFFF if sites[a] == 'svc' else ow & 31
    g = gates.get(ks[0] + 12)
    if g != (sites[a], arg, a): bad(f'gates.tsv 不符 {a:#x}：表 {g} 期望 {(sites[a], arg, a)}')
    seen.add(ks[0] + 12)

_starts = set(nsoimg.func_starts(orig, TE))

for off, oid, ow, why in obs:
    if W(orig, off) != ow: bad(f'观测门 {off:#x} 原指令字不符：映像 {W(orig, off):08x} 登记 {ow:08x}'); continue
    ins = next(_md.disasm(struct.pack('<I', ow), off), None)
    m = ins.mnemonic if ins else '?'
    if ins is None or m in ('adr', 'adrp', 'b', 'bl', 'br', 'blr', 'ret', 'cbz', 'cbnz', 'tbz', 'tbnz', 'svc', 'mrs', 'msr', 'eret') or m.startswith('b.') \
       or (m.startswith('ldr') and '[' not in ins.op_str) or RX18.search(ins.op_str or ''):
        bad(f'观测门 {off:#x} 原指令不可搬：{m} {ins.op_str if ins else ""}')
    # 不再要求函数入口：_dm_gate 存回 x0–x17、x19–x30、q0–q31 与 NZCV/FPSR/FPCR，函数中间的活寄存器不受影响；
    # 这条 ABI 由 gatefn 功能核（桩故意破坏 x9–x17 与 NZCV，核全部恢复），不在这里按位置近似
    # Function entry is no longer required: _dm_gate saves and restores x0–x17, x19–x30, q0–q31 and NZCV/FPSR/FPCR, so live registers in the middle of a function are unaffected;
    # this ABI is checked functionally by gatefn (the stub deliberately clobbers x9–x17 and NZCV, and full restoration is checked), not approximated here by position
    if set(range(off, off + 4)) & _busy: bad(f'观测门 {off:#x} 与改写点 / 窗口 / 剪口重叠')

    if W(pat, s_) != 0xA9BF7BFD or not ks or ks[1] != KEY.get('KGATE') \
            or W(pat, ks[0]) & 0xFFC00000 != 0xF9400000 or W(pat, ks[0] + 4) != LDR_X29_SP or W(pat, ks[0] + 8) != 0xD63F03C0 \

# ⑪ 剪口引入的分支门（hle.h 登记表形态「分支门：x8≠0 跳 0x目标，否则执行原指令回 0x原处+4」）：原处换成 B 进补丁区，块逐字 =
#   stp x8,xzr,[sp,#-16]! ; stp x29,x30,[sp,#-16]! ; 键页取 KGATE ; ldr x30,[x30] ; ldr x29,[sp] ; blr x30 ; ldp x29,x30 ; cbz w8,+12 ;
#   ldp x8,xzr ; b 目标 ; ldp x8,xzr ; 原指令 ; b 原处+4 —— x8 两路都恢复为原值，宿主结果只用于选路；gates.tsv 记 (svc, 号, 原处)
# ⑪ Branch gates introduced by cuts (hle.h registry form 「分支门：x8≠0 跳 0x目标，否则执行原指令回 0x原处+4」(branch gate: x8≠0 jumps to 0x<target>, otherwise executes the original instruction and returns to 0x<original site>+4)): the original site is replaced with a B into the patch area, and the block equals word for word
#   stp x8,xzr,[sp,#-16]! ; stp x29,x30,[sp,#-16]! ; fetch KGATE via key page ; ldr x30,[x30] ; ldr x29,[sp] ; blr x30 ; ldp x29,x30 ; cbz w8,+12 ;
#   ldp x8,xzr ; b target ; ldp x8,xzr ; original instruction ; b original site+4 - x8 is restored to its original value on both paths, the host result is only used to pick the path; gates.tsv records (svc, number, original site)

_base = {'K18', 'KTLS', 'KTLR', 'KGATE'}; _extra = set(KEY) - _base   # 额外键 = 参数门键（KRES* / KASPECT* …；改写器全局键表，三模块表头都列）：须是 K 开头大写名、键号低于基础四键 | Extra keys = parameter-gate keys (KRES* / KASPECT* ...; the rewriter's global key table, listed in the headers of all three modules): must be uppercase names starting with K, with key numbers below the four base keys

# ⑧ 参数门（PARAMS，仅宿主）：原处 movz xR,#lo / movk xR,#hi,lsl #32 造的 64 位常数，等长换成 mrs xR,tpidrro_el0 / ldr xR,[xR,#键*8]
#   核：A 原字是 64 位 movz（hw=0）写 xR、B 原字是 64 位 movk（hw=2）写 xR；新字逐位 = 模板；A、B 之间的指令不读写 xR；
#   (A, B] 不是任何直接分支的目标、也不是函数入口（否则从中间进来的路径会拿到槽指针而不是常数）；键号在表头登记；不与改写点 / 剪口 / 观测门重叠。
#   宿主给槽原值（宽高打包 = 下列常数）时语义与原两条逐位等价：B 之后 xR 同值，A、B 之间无人读 xR。
# ⑧ Parameter gates (PARAMS, host only): a 64-bit constant originally built by movz xR,#lo / movk xR,#hi,lsl #32 is replaced at equal length by mrs xR,tpidrro_el0 / ldr xR,[xR,#key*8]
#   Checks: original word A is a 64-bit movz (hw=0) writing xR, original word B is a 64-bit movk (hw=2) writing xR; the new words = the template bit for bit; instructions between A and B do not read or write xR;
#   (A, B] is not the target of any direct branch nor a function entry (otherwise a path entering in the middle would get the slot pointer instead of the constant); the key number is registered in the header; no overlap with rewrite sites / cuts / observation gates.
#   When the host gives the slot the original value (packed width/height = the constants below), the semantics are bit-for-bit equivalent to the original two instructions: xR has the same value after B, and nobody reads xR between A and B.
par_const = {}
if params:
    import capstone
    _cs = capstone.Cs(capstone.CS_ARCH_ARM64, capstone.CS_MODE_ARM); _cs.detail = True
    _tg = set()
    for o in range(0, TE & ~3, 4):                                  # 全 text 直接分支目标 | Direct branch targets across all of text
        w = W(orig, o)
        if w & 0x7C000000 == 0x14000000: d = ((w & 0x3FFFFFF) ^ 0x2000000) - 0x2000000; _tg.add(o + 4 * d)
        elif w & 0xFF000010 == 0x54000000 or w & 0x7E000000 == 0x34000000: d = (((w >> 5) & 0x7FFFF) ^ 0x40000) - 0x40000; _tg.add(o + 4 * d)
        elif w & 0x7E000000 == 0x36000000: d = (((w >> 5) & 0x3FFF) ^ 0x2000) - 0x2000; _tg.add(o + 4 * d)
    _fs = set(nsoimg.func_starts(orig, TE))
    _busy8 = {a for a in sites} | set(inwin) | obs_heads | {o & ~3 for o in cutb}
    for a, b, r, k in params:
        wa, wb = W(orig, a), W(orig, b)
        # 两种原指令对：64 位 movz xR,#lo / movk xR,#hi,lsl #32（KRES*）；32 位 movz wR,#lo / movk wR,#hi,lsl #16（KASPECT*，原值 = hi<<16|lo，
        # 写 w 寄存器高 32 位清零 ⇒ 宿主槽须按 u32 位模式存、高 32 位为 0（运行期约束，静态核不到，见 platform thread.c）
        # Two kinds of original instruction pair: 64-bit movz xR,#lo / movk xR,#hi,lsl #32 (KRES*); 32-bit movz wR,#lo / movk wR,#hi,lsl #16 (KASPECT*, original value = hi<<16|lo,
        # writing a w register zeroes the upper 32 bits ⇒ the host slot must be stored as a u32 bit pattern with the upper 32 bits 0 (a runtime constraint that cannot be checked statically, see platform thread.c)
        w64 = wa & 0xFFE00000 == 0xD2800000 and wb & 0xFFE00000 == 0xF2C00000
        w32 = wa & 0xFFE00000 == 0x52800000 and wb & 0xFFE00000 == 0x72A00000
        if not (w64 or w32) or wa & 31 != r or wb & 31 != r:
            bad(f'参数门 {a:#x}/{b:#x}：原指令 {wa:#010x}/{wb:#010x} 不是 movz/movk 造常数对（64 位 lsl #32 或 32 位 lsl #16）写 x{r}')
        if not a < b: bad(f'参数门 {a:#x}/{b:#x} 顺序不对')
        if k not in KEY: bad(f'参数门 {a:#x} 键 {k} 未在表头登记'); continue
        s = btarget(a); ks = paramseq(s, r) if s is not None else None
        ok = ks and ks[1] == KEY[k] and W(pat, b) == 0xD503201F
        if not ok: bad(f'参数门 {a:#x}/{b:#x}：键页间接模板不符')
        for o in range(a + 4, b, 4):
            ins = next(_cs.disasm(orig[o:o + 4], o), None)
            if ins is None: bad(f'参数门 {a:#x}：中间 {o:#x} 解不出'); continue
            rr, ww = ins.regs_access()
            names = {ins.reg_name(x) for x in rr + ww}
            if f'x{r}' in names or f'w{r}' in names: bad(f'参数门 {a:#x}：中间 {o:#x} {ins.mnemonic} {ins.op_str} 读写 x{r}')
        bt = sorted(t for t in _tg if a < t <= b) + sorted(t for t in _fs if a < t <= b)
        if bt: bad(f'参数门 {a:#x}..{b:#x}：区间内有分支目标 / 函数入口 {[hex(x) for x in bt[:4]]}')
        if {a, b} & _busy8: bad(f'参数门 {a:#x}/{b:#x} 与改写点 / 窗口 / 观测门 / 剪口重叠')
        par_const[(a, k)] = ((wb >> 5) & 0xFFFF) << (16 if w32 else 32) | ((wa >> 5) & 0xFFFF)
    _kc = {}
    for (a, k), v in par_const.items(): _kc.setdefault(k, set()).add(v)
    for k, vs in _kc.items():
        if len(vs) != 1: bad(f'参数门键 {k} 对应多个原常数 {[hex(v) for v in vs]}（同一槽给不出唯一原值）')
    print('参数门 ' + ', '.join(f'{a:#x}={k}:原值 {v:#x}' for (a, k), v in par_const.items()))
    # 参数寄存器的下游不得再被常数掩码：编译器会把「值只可能是这几个常数」折进后续指令——运行模式通知处理 0xe10e48 的
    # mov w9,#0x740; and x9,x25,x9 就是 1280|1600 推出的掩码，换成参数后宽度被掩成 768 / 64。从每个参数位起按函数内线性顺序做污点传播
    # （mov / csel 类传递，其余写入清除；不跟分支，属保守近似），被污染的寄存器遇到 and / ands / bic 且另一操作数是立即数或 mov 立即数造的寄存器即报
    # Downstream of a parameter register there must be no further masking by a constant: the compiler folds "the value can only be one of these constants" into later instructions - in the operation mode notification handler at 0xe10e48,
    # mov w9,#0x740; and x9,x25,x9 is exactly a mask derived from 1280|1600, and once replaced by a parameter the width gets masked to 768 / 64. From each parameter site, do taint propagation in linear order within the function
    # (mov / csel kinds propagate, other writes clear; branches are not followed, a conservative approximation); report when a tainted register meets and / ands / bic whose other operand is an immediate or a register built by a mov immediate
    _fsl = sorted(_fs)
    def _rn(ins, x): return re.sub(r'^[wx]', '', ins.reg_name(x)) if re.match(r'^[wx]\d+$', ins.reg_name(x) or '') else None
    _donef = set()
    for a, b, r, k in params:
        import bisect as _bi
        i = _bi.bisect_right(_fsl, a); f0 = _fsl[i - 1]; f1 = _fsl[i] if i < len(_fsl) else TE
        if f0 in _donef: continue
        _donef.add(f0)
        seeds = {(pa, str(pr)) for pa, pb, pr, pk in params if f0 <= pa < f1}
        taint, const = set(), {}
        for o in range(f0, f1, 4):
            for pa, pr in seeds:
                if o == pa: taint.add(pr)
            if any(o == pa for pa, _ in seeds): continue
            ins = next(_cs.disasm(pat[o:o + 4], o), None)
            if ins is None: continue
            rr, ww = ins.regs_access(); rd = {x for x in (_rn(ins, q) for q in rr) if x}; wr = {x for x in (_rn(ins, q) for q in ww) if x}
            m = ins.mnemonic
            if m in ('and', 'ands', 'bic', 'bics') and rd & taint:
                imm = any(op.type == capstone.arm64.ARM64_OP_IMM for op in ins.operands)
                if imm or (rd - taint) & set(const): bad(f'参数门下游常数掩码 {o:#x}：{m} {ins.op_str}（函数 {f0:#x}，被参数寄存器污染的值再被常数掩码）')
            if m in ('mov', 'csel', 'csinc', 'csinv', 'csneg') and rd & taint: taint |= wr; [const.pop(x, None) for x in wr]
            else:
                taint -= wr
                isimm = m in ('mov', 'movz') and len(ins.operands) == 2 and ins.operands[1].type == capstone.arm64.ARM64_OP_IMM
                for x in wr:
                    if isimm: const[x] = ins.operands[1].imm
                    else: const.pop(x, None)

# ⑨ 临时寄存器静态检查：每个补丁块的非原指令目的寄存器必须有同偏移红区存取配对。
# ⑨ Static check of temporary registers: every non-original-instruction destination register in a patch block must have a matching red-zone save/restore pair at the same offset.
import capstone
def _writes(ins):
    _, ww = ins.regs_access()
    return {'x29' if ins.reg_name(r) == 'fp' else 'x30' if ins.reg_name(r) == 'lr' else re.sub(r'^[wx]', 'x', ins.reg_name(r))
            for r in ww if ins.reg_name(r) not in ('sp', 'pc')}
def _mem_sp(ins, load, alias=None):
    """alias: a register holding the block's unchanged entry sp (mov xT, sp before any sp write; see site_spset)."""
    if (load and not ins.mnemonic.startswith('ld')) or (not load and not ins.mnemonic.startswith('st')):
        return None
    for op in ins.operands:
        if op.type == capstone.arm64_const.ARM64_OP_MEM and ins.reg_name(op.mem.base) in ('sp', alias):
            if op.mem.disp < 0: return op.mem.disp
            if load and ins.mnemonic == 'ldp' and op.mem.disp == 0: return -16
    return None
def _block(start):
    out = []
    for ins in _md.disasm(pat[start:start + 256], start):
        out.append(ins)
        if ins.mnemonic == 'b':
            t = ins.operands[0].imm
            if not (PO <= t < len(pat)): break
    return out
static_entries = [(a, set()) for a in sites]
for a, b, r, _ in params:
    static_entries.append((a, {f'x{r}'}))
static_seen = 0
for a, allowed in static_entries:
    s = btarget(a)
    if s is None: continue
    block = _block(s); static_seen += 1
    if not allowed:
        end = next((hi for lo, hi in wins if lo == a), a + 4)
        for lo, hi in atomic_groups.get(a, [(a, end)]):
            for ins in _md.disasm(orig[lo:hi], lo): allowed |= _writes(ins)
        if next(_md.disasm(orig[a:a + 4], a), None).mnemonic in ('stp', 'ldp'):
            allowed.update(('x0', 'x1'))
    saved = {}
    restored = {}
    alias, sp_written, restore_at = None, False, set()
    for i, ins in enumerate(block):
        if alias and alias in _writes(ins) and _mem_sp(ins, True, alias) is None: alias = None
        if ins.mnemonic == 'mov' and re.fullmatch(r'x\d+, sp', ins.op_str) and not sp_written:
            alias = ins.op_str.split(',')[0]
        if 'sp' in {ins.reg_name(r) for r in ins.regs_access()[1]} and _mem_sp(ins, False) is None: sp_written = True
        d = _mem_sp(ins, False)
        if d is not None:
            regs = [op.reg for op in ins.operands[:2] if op.type == capstone.arm64_const.ARM64_OP_REG]
            for reg in regs:
                name = ins.reg_name(reg); name = 'x29' if name == 'fp' else 'x30' if name == 'lr' else re.sub(r'^[wx]', 'x', name)
                saved.setdefault(name, []).append((d, i))
        d = _mem_sp(ins, True, alias)
        if d is not None:
            restore_at.add(i)
            regs = [op.reg for op in ins.operands[:2] if op.type == capstone.arm64_const.ARM64_OP_REG]
            for reg in regs:
                name = ins.reg_name(reg); name = 'x29' if name == 'fp' else 'x30' if name == 'lr' else re.sub(r'^[wx]', 'x', name)
                restored.setdefault(name, []).append((d, i))
    writes = set().union(*(_writes(ins) for ins in block)) if block else set()
    for reg in sorted(writes - allowed):
        wi = [i for i, ins in enumerate(block) if reg in _writes(ins) and not (i > 0 and i in restore_at)]
        dead = any(ins.mnemonic in ('br', 'blr') and ins.operands and ins.reg_name(ins.operands[0].reg) in (reg, reg[1:]) for ins in block)
        ok = dead or any(sd == rd and si < min(wi, default=10**9) and ri > max(wi, default=-1)
                 for sd, si in saved.get(reg, []) for rd, ri in restored.get(reg, []))
        if not ok: bad(f'临时寄存器 {a:#x}：块写 {reg}，原目的寄存器外且无同偏移存取配对')
print(f'STATIC {mod} scanned={static_seen} violations={sum(1 for x in fails if x.startswith("临时寄存器"))}')

# ⑩ 跳板出口（切掌机崩溃：参数门跳板回到 B+4，越过 A、B 之间未改的原指令和另一个跳板头）：
#   text 里每条跳进补丁区的 b（跳板头 a）沿补丁块走遍全部回 text 的出口（顺序 b 与条件分支，bl 视为返回，ret / br 不算回 text）。
#   合法出口：a+4；越过的字全是被改写吸收的字（≠ 原字且不是别的跳板头，如参数门 B 处的 nop）后的地址；
#   窗口（W 行 [lo, hi)）头：hi 与窗口内原指令自己的分支目标；非窗口头：连续吸收段内原指令自己的分支目标。
# ⑩ Trampoline exits (the handheld-switch crash: the parameter-gate trampoline returned to B+4, skipping the unmodified original instructions between A and B and another trampoline head):
#   for every b in text that jumps into the patch area (trampoline head a), follow the patch block through all exits back to text (sequential b and conditional branches; bl is treated as returning; ret / br do not count as returning to text).
#   Legal exits: a+4; the address after skipped words that are all words absorbed by the rewrite (≠ the original word and not another trampoline head, e.g. the nop at parameter-gate B);
#   window (W row [lo, hi)) heads: hi and the branch targets of the original instructions inside the window; non-window heads: the branch targets of the original instructions inside the contiguous absorbed span.
_heads = {o for o in range(0, TE & ~3, 4) if W(pat, o) & 0xFC000000 == 0x14000000 and btarget(o) is not None and btarget(o) >= PO}
_wend = dict(wins)
def _bt(w, o):
    if w & 0x7C000000 == 0x14000000: return o + 4 * (((w & 0x3FFFFFF) ^ 0x2000000) - 0x2000000)
    if w & 0xFF000010 == 0x54000000 or w & 0x7E000000 == 0x34000000: return o + 4 * ((((w >> 5) & 0x7FFFF) ^ 0x40000) - 0x40000)
    if w & 0x7E000000 == 0x36000000: return o + 4 * ((((w >> 5) & 0x3FFF) ^ 0x2000) - 0x2000)
    return None
if calls:
    second_words = set(calls.values())
    for address in range(0, TE, 4):
        if _bt(W(orig, address), address) in second_words:
            bad(f'known branch enters call without preparation {address:#x}')
    if second_words & set(nsoimg.func_starts(orig, TE)):
        bad('function entry enters call without preparation')
    for _, typ, _, value, addend in nsoimg.relocs(orig):
        if (typ == 1027 and addend in second_words) or value in second_words:
            bad('relocation enters call without preparation')

def _exits(start):
    ex, seen, st = set(), set(), [start]
    while st:
        o = st.pop()
        while o not in seen and o + 4 <= len(pat):
            seen.add(o); w = W(pat, o)
            if w & 0xFC000000 == 0x14000000:
                t = _bt(w, o)
                if t < PO: ex.add(t); break
                o = t; continue
            if w & 0xFC000000 == 0x94000000: o += 4; continue
            if w == 0xD65F03C0 or w & 0xFFFFFC1F == 0xD61F0000: break
            t = _bt(w, o)
            if t is not None:
                if t < PO: ex.add(t)
                else: st.append(t)
            o += 4
    return ex
nexit = 0; _cutoff = {c[0] for c in cuts}; _cutex = []
for a in sorted(_heads):
    if a in _wend:
        group = atomic_groups.get(a, [(a, _wend[a])])
        seg = [o for lo, hi in group for o in range(lo, hi, 4)]
        legal = {calls[a]} if a in calls else {hi for lo, hi in group}
    else:
        e = a + 4
        while e < TE and W(pat, e) != W(orig, e) and e not in _heads: e += 4
        seg = range(a, e, 4); legal = {a + 4 * k for k in range(1, len(seg) + 1)}
    legal |= {t for o in seg for t in [_bt(W(orig, o), o)] if t is not None}
    for t in _exits(btarget(a)):
        nexit += 1
        if t not in legal and a in _cutoff: _cutex.append(f'{a:#x}→{t:#x}'); continue   # 已登记剪口（带理由，故意改控制流）：放行并列出 | Registered cuts (with a reason, deliberately changing control flow): let through and listed
        if t not in legal: bad(f'跳板出口 {a:#x} → {t:#x}：既不是 {a + 4:#x} / 吸收段尾 / 窗口尾，也不是段内原指令的分支目标（越过未改原指令或别的跳板头）')
print(f'EXITS {mod} 跳板头={len(_heads)} 出口={nexit} 已登记剪口改控制流出口={_cutex}')

cnt = {}
if _hostcall: print(f'剪口引入宿主调用门 {len(_hostcall)} 个：' + ', '.join(f"{a:#x}=svc#{n:#x}" for a, n in _hostcall.items()))
for k in sites.values(): cnt[k] = cnt.get(k, 0) + 1
print(f'STRUCT {mod} {"OK" if not fails else "FAIL"} 改写点={len(sites)} {cnt} 跳转表={jumps} 窗口内x18引用={nwin_ref} '
      f'已登记剪口={len(cuts)}(代码{ncut_code}/数据{ncut_data}) 观测门={len(obs)} 参数门={len(params)} '
      f'独立分母={len(ind)} text改动字={len(diff)} 门={len(gsites)} 槽访问={nk} 失败项={len(fails)}')
sys.exit(1 if fails else 0)

```

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/README.md`:

```md
# Experimental NVN/Metal adapter

Copied gfx/nvn, gfx/tex and bcdec from D2R Mobile commit
9f0c25768ac4b231c6f4cb0a9f182ded68d0e7cf, retaining MIT/embedded licenses.
D2R shader/PSO TSV files were deliberately excluded: they cannot identify TOTK
shaders. This copy is an integration experiment; no game frame is verified.

Local host headers bind the native TOTK runtime. Unknown NVN calls stop instead
of returning success. TOTK needs its own shader identity and reflection mapping.

Local changes: fail on unimplemented calls/properties, separate TOTK shader cache
and control+code map, remove D2R built-in compute kernels, target the game's 55.15
ABI check, fit textures into the game's verified 128-byte allocation, add actual
reached buffer/swapchain APIs. The target version does not imply full API coverage.
Metal 4 protocol warnings and unverified optimizations still require review before
rendering claims. nvn_tex.c adapts deko3d; its original notice is in LICENSE.deko3d.

```

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/dm_signpost.h`:

```h
// Odyssey (22 October 2026): os_signpost markers for stall attribution, subsystem "org.projectidea.odyssey".
// Interval names: shader-translate, shader-library, pipeline-render, pipeline-compute, texture-upload. Events: present,
// long-frame. Verified 22 Oct (see TECHNIQUES.md "Stall markers"):
//   unset / 0  off: one check per marker (~50 ns), nothing written to the log store.
//   1          on, category PointsOfInterest: ~1 us per interval + event, about 360 entries/s persisted to the unified log
//              in Cap Kingdom. Seen by Instruments (Game Performance, attach or launch) and by
//              `/usr/bin/log stream --signpost --predicate 'subsystem == "org.projectidea.odyssey"'`.
//   The DynamicTracing category was tried as a zero-cost default: neither xctrace attach nor launch enabled it.
//   xctrace: /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/usr/bin/xctrace record --template "Game Performance" --attach <pid>
//            --time-limit 20s --output t.trace
#pragma once
#include <os/log.h>
#include <os/signpost.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <dispatch/dispatch.h>

static inline os_log_t dm_sp_log(void) {
    static os_log_t log; static dispatch_once_t once;
    dispatch_once(&once, ^{
        const char *e = getenv("DM_SIGNPOST");
        log = e && !strcmp(e, "1") ? os_log_create("org.projectidea.odyssey", OS_LOG_CATEGORY_POINTS_OF_INTEREST) : OS_LOG_DISABLED;
    });
    return log;
}
// Begin / end one interval in the same scope. name must be a string literal (os_signpost requirement).
#define DM_SP_BEGIN(var, name, ...) os_signpost_id_t var = OS_SIGNPOST_ID_NULL; \
    if (os_signpost_enabled(dm_sp_log())) { var = os_signpost_id_generate(dm_sp_log()); os_signpost_interval_begin(dm_sp_log(), var, name, __VA_ARGS__); }
#define DM_SP_END(var, name) do { if (var != OS_SIGNPOST_ID_NULL) os_signpost_interval_end(dm_sp_log(), var, name); } while (0)
#define DM_SP_EVENT(name, ...) do { if (os_signpost_enabled(dm_sp_log())) os_signpost_event_emit(dm_sp_log(), OS_SIGNPOST_ID_EXCLUSIVE, name, __VA_ARGS__); } while (0)
```

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/fps_overlay.c`:

```c
#include "fps_overlay.h"
#ifdef __APPLE__
#include <TargetConditionals.h>
#endif
#include <CoreGraphics/CoreGraphics.h>
#include <CoreText/CoreText.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "include/totk_ui_lang.h"

enum { GLYPH_W = 5, GLYPH_H = 7, ADVANCE = 6, PAD = 2, BOX_ROWS = GLYPH_H + 2 * PAD, MAX_CHARS = 80 };
static const uint8_t TEXT_BGRA[4] = {120, 255, 80, 255}, BOX_BGRA[4] = {12, 12, 12, 255}, HIGHLIGHT_BGRA[4] = {40, 230, 255, 255};   // green / dark / yellow

typedef struct { char c; uint8_t rows[GLYPH_H]; } Glyph;   /* each row: 5 bits, bit 4 = leftmost pixel */
static const Glyph FONT[] = {
    {'0', {0x0e, 0x11, 0x13, 0x15, 0x19, 0x11, 0x0e}}, {'1', {0x04, 0x0c, 0x04, 0x04, 0x04, 0x04, 0x0e}},
    {'2', {0x0e, 0x11, 0x01, 0x02, 0x04, 0x08, 0x1f}}, {'3', {0x1e, 0x01, 0x01, 0x0e, 0x01, 0x01, 0x1e}},
    {'4', {0x02, 0x06, 0x0a, 0x12, 0x1f, 0x02, 0x02}}, {'5', {0x1f, 0x10, 0x1e, 0x01, 0x01, 0x11, 0x0e}},
    {'6', {0x06, 0x08, 0x10, 0x1e, 0x11, 0x11, 0x0e}}, {'7', {0x1f, 0x01, 0x02, 0x04, 0x08, 0x08, 0x08}},
    {'8', {0x0e, 0x11, 0x11, 0x0e, 0x11, 0x11, 0x0e}}, {'9', {0x0e, 0x11, 0x11, 0x0f, 0x01, 0x02, 0x0c}},
    {'F', {0x1f, 0x10, 0x10, 0x1e, 0x10, 0x10, 0x10}}, {'P', {0x1e, 0x11, 0x11, 0x1e, 0x10, 0x10, 0x10}},
    {'S', {0x0f, 0x10, 0x10, 0x0e, 0x01, 0x01, 0x1e}}, {'-', {0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x1f, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00}},
    {'x', {0x00, 0x00, 0x11, 0x0a, 0x04, 0x0a, 0x11}}, {'>', {0x08, 0x04, 0x02, 0x01, 0x02, 0x04, 0x08}},
    {'M', {0x11, 0x1b, 0x15, 0x15, 0x11, 0x11, 0x11}}, {'X', {0x11, 0x11, 0x0a, 0x04, 0x0a, 0x11, 0x11}},
    {'H', {0x11, 0x11, 0x11, 0x1f, 0x11, 0x11, 0x11}}, {'A', {0x0e, 0x11, 0x11, 0x1f, 0x11, 0x11, 0x11}},
    {'D', {0x1e, 0x11, 0x11, 0x11, 0x11, 0x11, 0x1e}}, {'E', {0x1f, 0x10, 0x10, 0x1e, 0x10, 0x10, 0x1f}},
    {'R', {0x1e, 0x11, 0x11, 0x1e, 0x14, 0x12, 0x11}}, {'+', {0x00, 0x04, 0x04, 0x1f, 0x04, 0x04, 0x00}},
    {'/', {0x01, 0x01, 0x02, 0x04, 0x08, 0x10, 0x10}}, {'O', {0x0e, 0x11, 0x11, 0x11, 0x11, 0x11, 0x0e}},
    {'G', {0x0e, 0x11, 0x10, 0x17, 0x11, 0x11, 0x0f}}, {'U', {0x11, 0x11, 0x11, 0x11, 0x11, 0x11, 0x0e}},
    {'%', {0x18, 0x19, 0x02, 0x04, 0x08, 0x13, 0x03}}, {'(', {0x02, 0x04, 0x08, 0x08, 0x08, 0x04, 0x02}},
    {')', {0x08, 0x04, 0x02, 0x02, 0x02, 0x04, 0x08}}, {'T', {0x1f, 0x04, 0x04, 0x04, 0x04, 0x04, 0x04}},
    {'K', {0x11, 0x12, 0x14, 0x18, 0x14, 0x12, 0x11}},
    {' ', {0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0}},
};

static _Atomic int g_hints_visible = 1;
int fps_overlay_hints_enabled(void) { return atomic_load_explicit(&g_hints_visible, memory_order_relaxed); }
int fps_overlay_toggle_hints(void) { return !atomic_fetch_xor_explicit(&g_hints_visible, 1, memory_order_relaxed); }

int fps_overlay_enabled(void) {
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_FPS_OVERLAY"); on = !(e && !strcmp(e, "0")); }
    return on;
}

int fps_overlay_scale(double view_h) {
    int s = (int)lround(view_h * 0.03 / BOX_ROWS);
    return s < 1 ? 1 : s > FPS_OVERLAY_MAX_SCALE ? FPS_OVERLAY_MAX_SCALE : s;
}

static const Glyph *glyph(char c) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof FONT / sizeof FONT[0]; i++) if (FONT[i].c == c) return &FONT[i];
    return &FONT[sizeof FONT / sizeof FONT[0] - 1];
}
int fps_overlay_has_glyph(char c) { return c == ' ' || glyph(c) != &FONT[sizeof FONT / sizeof FONT[0] - 1]; }

static void fill(uint8_t *out, int stride, int x0, int y0, int w, int h, const uint8_t bgra[4]) {
    for (int y = y0; y < y0 + h; y++)
        for (int x = x0; x < x0 + w; x++) memcpy(out + 4 * ((size_t)y * stride + x), bgra, 4);
}

static void size_text(char *out, size_t n, int w, int h) {
    if (w > 0 && h > 0) snprintf(out, n, "%dx%d", w > 9999 ? 9999 : w, h > 9999 ? 9999 : h);
    else snprintf(out, n, "--");
}

static void draw_text(uint8_t *out, int stride, const char *text, int n, int scale, const uint8_t color[4]) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const Glyph *g = glyph(text[i]);
        for (int r = 0; r < GLYPH_H; r++)
            for (int c = 0; c < GLYPH_W; c++)
                if (g->rows[r] & (0x10 >> c))
                    fill(out, stride, (PAD + i * ADVANCE + c) * scale, (PAD + r) * scale, scale, scale, color);
    }
}

/* A line with characters the 5x7 font does not have (Chinese labels, user 2026-10-17: "MetalFX已开启", "新着色器 N / 总计 M")
   in the system font (CoreText), with the same box height, padding and colours as the pixel font at this scale; the
   scale drops until the line fits the texture. */
static void raster_line_ct(const char *text, int highlight, int scale, uint8_t *out, int tex_w, int tex_h, int *box_w, int *box_h) {
    memset(out, 0, (size_t)tex_w * tex_h * 4);
    *box_w = *box_h = 0;
    CFStringRef str = CFStringCreateWithCString(NULL, text, kCFStringEncodingUTF8);
    if (!str) return;
    const uint8_t *c = highlight ? HIGHLIGHT_BGRA : TEXT_BGRA;
    CGColorSpaceRef cs = CGColorSpaceCreateDeviceRGB();
    const CGFloat comps[4] = {c[2] / 255.0, c[1] / 255.0, c[0] / 255.0, 1.0};
    CGColorRef color = CGColorCreate(cs, comps);
    for (scale = scale < 1 ? 1 : scale > FPS_OVERLAY_MAX_SCALE ? FPS_OVERLAY_MAX_SCALE : scale; scale >= 1; scale--) {
        CTFontRef font = CTFontCreateUIFontForLanguage(kCTFontUIFontSystem, 8.0 * scale, CFSTR("zh-Hans"));
        const void *keys[2] = {kCTFontAttributeName, kCTForegroundColorAttributeName}, *vals[2] = {font, color};
        CFDictionaryRef attrs = CFDictionaryCreate(NULL, keys, vals, 2, &kCFTypeDictionaryKeyCallBacks, &kCFTypeDictionaryValueCallBacks);
        CFAttributedStringRef as = CFAttributedStringCreate(NULL, str, attrs);
        CTLineRef line = CTLineCreateWithAttributedString(as);
        CGFloat ascent = 0, descent = 0;
        double tw = CTLineGetTypographicBounds(line, &ascent, &descent, NULL);
        int w = (int)ceil(tw) + 2 * PAD * scale, h = BOX_ROWS * scale;
        int fits = w <= tex_w && h <= tex_h;
        if (fits || scale == 1) {
            if (w > tex_w) w = tex_w;
            if (h > tex_h) h = tex_h;
            fill(out, tex_w, 0, 0, w, h, BOX_BGRA);
            CGContextRef ctx = CGBitmapContextCreate(out, (size_t)tex_w, (size_t)tex_h, 8, (size_t)tex_w * 4, cs,
                                                     kCGImageAlphaPremultipliedFirst | kCGBitmapByteOrder32Little);   // B, G, R, A in memory
            if (ctx) {   // memory row 0 is the top of the texture; Core Graphics counts y up from the bottom row
                CGContextClipToRect(ctx, CGRectMake(0, tex_h - h, w, h));
                CGContextSetTextPosition(ctx, PAD * scale, tex_h - h / 2.0 - (ascent - descent) / 2.0);
                CTLineDraw(line, ctx);
                CGContextRelease(ctx);
            }
            *box_w = w; *box_h = h;
        }
        CFRelease(line); CFRelease(as); CFRelease(attrs); CFRelease(font);
        if (fits || scale == 1) break;
    }
    CGColorRelease(color); CGColorSpaceRelease(cs); CFRelease(str);
}

/* The 5x7 font has only the letters the original labels use: any other character (Chinese, or English words such as
   "New shaders ... / total ...") sends the whole line to the system font instead of drawing blanks. */
int fps_overlay_line_pixel_font(const char *s) {
    for (; *s; s++) if (!fps_overlay_has_glyph(*s)) return 0;
    return 1;
}

void fps_overlay_raster_line_tex(const char *text, int highlight, int scale, uint8_t *out, int tex_w, int tex_h, int *box_w, int *box_h) {
    if (!fps_overlay_line_pixel_font(text)) { raster_line_ct(text, highlight, scale, out, tex_w, tex_h, box_w, box_h); return; }
    int n = (int)strnlen(text, MAX_CHARS);
    if (scale < 1) scale = 1;
    if (scale > FPS_OVERLAY_MAX_SCALE) scale = FPS_OVERLAY_MAX_SCALE;
    while (scale > 1 && ((n * ADVANCE - 1 + 2 * PAD) * scale > tex_w || BOX_ROWS * scale > tex_h)) scale--;   // never past the texture
    while (n > 1 && (n * ADVANCE - 1 + 2 * PAD) > tex_w) n--;   // scale 1 and still too long: cut the line
    int w = (n * ADVANCE - 1 + 2 * PAD) * scale, h = BOX_ROWS * scale;
    memset(out, 0, (size_t)tex_w * tex_h * 4);
    fill(out, tex_w, 0, 0, w, h, BOX_BGRA);
    draw_text(out, tex_w, text, n, scale, highlight ? HIGHLIGHT_BGRA : TEXT_BGRA);
    *box_w = w; *box_h = h;
}
void fps_overlay_raster_line(const char *text, int highlight, int scale, uint8_t *out, int *box_w, int *box_h) {
    fps_overlay_raster_line_tex(text, highlight, scale, out, FPS_OVERLAY_TEX_W, FPS_OVERLAY_TEX_H, box_w, box_h);
}

void fps_overlay_text(const fps_overlay_info *info, char *text, size_t n) {
    char fps[8], ss[12];
    if (info->fps < 0) snprintf(fps, sizeof fps, "--");
    else snprintf(fps, sizeof fps, "%d", info->fps > 999 ? 999 : info->fps);
    size_text(ss, sizeof ss, info->screen_w, info->screen_h);
    char gen[8] = "";
    if (info->gen > 0 && info->fps >= 0) snprintf(gen, sizeof gen, "+%d", info->gen > 999 ? 999 : info->gen);   // interpolated frames a second (key 2)
    // MetalFX did the upscale in the last frames (key 3 selects the manual MetalFX mode); 2K: true 2K output.
    // The whole line in the system font, so switching MetalFX does not switch the font.
    static int render = -1; if (render < 0) { const char *e = getenv("BY3_HUD_RENDER"); render = e && !strcmp(e, "1"); }
    char rs[16] = "";
    if (render && info->render_w > 0) { size_text(rs, sizeof rs - 3, info->render_w, info->render_h); strcat(rs, " > "); }
    snprintf(text, n, "FPS %s%s  %s%s%s%s", fps, gen, rs, ss, info->mfx ? TOTK_UI("  MetalFX已开启", "  MetalFX on") : "", info->big ? "  2K" : "");
}

void fps_overlay_raster(const fps_overlay_info *info, int scale, uint8_t *out, int *box_w, int *box_h) {
    char text[MAX_CHARS + 1];
    fps_overlay_text(info, text, sizeof text);
    raster_line_ct(text, 0, scale, out, FPS_OVERLAY_TEX_W, FPS_OVERLAY_TEX_H, box_w, box_h);
}

int hud_compact(void) {
    static int on = -1;
#if defined(TARGET_OS_IPHONE) && TARGET_OS_IPHONE
    const int def = 0;   // the iOS frontend has no corner panel
#else
    const int def = 1;
#endif
    if (on < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_HUD"); on = e ? strcmp(e, "corners") != 0 : def; }
    return on;
}

static pthread_mutex_t g_hud_mu = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static char g_hud_text[HUD_LINES][128];
static int g_hud_hl[HUD_LINES], g_hud_set[HUD_LINES];
void hud_publish(int line, const char *text, int highlight) {
    if (line < 0 || line >= HUD_LINES) return;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_hud_mu);
    snprintf(g_hud_text[line], sizeof g_hud_text[line], "%s", text); g_hud_hl[line] = highlight; g_hud_set[line] = 1;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_hud_mu);
}
int hud_snapshot(int line, char *out, size_t n, int *highlight) {
    if (line < 0 || line >= HUD_LINES) return 0;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_hud_mu);
    int set = g_hud_set[line];
    if (set) { snprintf(out, n, "%s", g_hud_text[line]); if (highlight) *highlight = g_hud_hl[line]; }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_hud_mu);
    return set;
}

int shader_overlay_enabled(void) {
    static int on = -1;
#if defined(TARGET_OS_IPHONE) && TARGET_OS_IPHONE
    const int def = 0;   // the phone translates nothing (misses go to shader-requests/)
#else
    const int def = 1;
#endif
    if (on < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_SHADER_OVERLAY"); on = e ? strcmp(e, "0") != 0 : def; }
    return on;
}

void shader_overlay_text(char *out, size_t n, uint64_t fresh, int64_t total, uint64_t pipelines) {
    char t[16];
    (void)pipelines;   // user 2026-10-17: the pipeline count is not shown
    if (total < 0) snprintf(t, sizeof t, "--"); else snprintf(t, sizeof t, "%lld", (long long)(total > 999999 ? 999999 : total));
    snprintf(out, n, TOTK_UI("新着色器 %llu / 总计 %s", "New shaders %llu / total %s"), (unsigned long long)(fresh > 99999 ? 99999 : fresh), t);
}

/* A count's rate, re-measured every half second (game presents; interpolated frames shown). stale_s > 0: a gap longer
   than that starts a new window (interpolation switched off and on again must not average over the time it was off). */
typedef struct { pthread_mutex_t mu; double t0, stale_s; uint64_t k0; _Atomic int value; } rate_meter;
static rate_meter g_game = {PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER, -1, 0, 0, -1}, g_gen = {PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER, -1, 1.0, 0, -1};
static void rate_note(rate_meter *m, uint64_t k, double now_s) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&m->mu);
    if (m->t0 < 0 || k < m->k0 || (m->stale_s > 0 && now_s - m->t0 > m->stale_s)) { m->t0 = now_s; m->k0 = k; }
    else if (now_s - m->t0 >= 0.5) {
        atomic_store(&m->value, (int)lround((double)(k - m->k0) / (now_s - m->t0)));
        m->t0 = now_s; m->k0 = k;
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&m->mu);
}

void fps_overlay_note(uint64_t ticket, double now_s) { rate_note(&g_game, ticket, now_s); }
int fps_overlay_value(void) { return atomic_load(&g_game.value); }
void fps_overlay_note_gen(uint64_t n, double now_s) { rate_note(&g_gen, n, now_s); }
int fps_overlay_gen_value(void) { return atomic_load(&g_gen.value); }
```

```h
/* TOTK: frames per second and the size of the game picture on screen (pixels) in its top-right corner, one line
   ("FPS 97  2560x1440"; the top-left holds the hearts). The game's internal render resolution is
   deliberately not shown (user, 2026-10-16). The game image itself (frame screenshots, texture dumps) never contains it. TOTK_FPS_OVERLAY=0 hides it. */

   big: the game itself outputs more than 1920x1080 (true 2K) -> " 2K" at the end. */
```

```c
#include "dm_signpost.h"   // Odyssey: os_signpost stall markers
#include <malloc/malloc.h>
// NVN 接口层：接管 main 导入的 nvnBootstrapLoader，sdk 里的 NVN 驱动整块不执行。
// 523 个 NVN 名字一律返回计数跳板（nvn_thunks.S），跳板再转到这里的实现：
//   · 有语义的（设备 / 内存池 / 贴图与采样器 / 队列 / 窗口 / 同步 / 事件 / 命令缓冲内存）按 NVN 语义实现，对象是真的；
//   · 只改 GPU 状态、没有 CPU 可见结果的（状态对象、绑定、绘制、清除…）录成命令，提交时回放；
//   · 其余（main 只加载不调用的 307 个 + 头文件无原型的）接 nvn_unimpl_entry：被调到即报红打印名字。
// GPU 地址 = CPU 地址（内存池用游戏给的真内存，同时建成零拷贝 MTLBuffer）。命令录进游戏给的命令内存，提交时回放成
// Metal 命令缓冲（nvn_mtl.m）：缓冲拷贝 / uniform 更新走 blit（GPU 时序），事件写值 / 计数器在 GPU 完成后写；
// 同步对象 = 提交栅栏值，等待只在 GPU 完成后放行。
// 每个实现都按 nvn_protos.h 的原型做编译期签名检查（NVNboolean 参数按 uint32_t 收、只看低 8 位）。
// 环境开关：DM_NVN_FRAMES=N 前 N 帧逐帧打印调用表（默认 3）；DM_NVN_TSV=路径 每帧调用表与计时写 TSV（DM_NVN_TSV_CALLS=0 只写计时）；DM_SLOWFRAME=1 只把掉帧的逐帧分项写进日志；DM_NVN_LOG=1 记对象创建。
// NVN interface layer: takes over the nvnBootstrapLoader imported by main; the NVN driver in sdk is not executed at all.
// All 523 NVN names return counting thunks (nvn_thunks.S), and the thunks forward to the implementations here:
//   - those with semantics (device / memory pools / textures and samplers / queue / window / sync / events / command buffer memory) are implemented per NVN semantics, and the objects are real;
//   - those that only change GPU state and have no CPU-visible result (state objects, bindings, draws, clears...) are recorded as commands and replayed at submit;
//   - the rest (the 307 that main only loads but never calls + those without a prototype in the header) go to nvn_unimpl_entry: reports a failure and prints the name when called.
// GPU address = CPU address (memory pools use the real memory given by the game, also built as zero-copy MTLBuffer). Commands are recorded into the command memory given by the game and replayed at submit into a
// Metal command buffer (nvn_mtl.m): buffer copies / uniform updates go through blit (GPU ordering), event value writes / counters are written after the GPU completes;
// sync object = submit fence value, and waits are released only after the GPU completes.
// Every implementation gets a compile-time signature check against the prototypes in nvn_protos.h (NVNboolean parameters are received as uint32_t, only the low 8 bits are looked at).
// Environment switches: DM_NVN_FRAMES=N prints the call table per frame for the first N frames (default 3); DM_NVN_TSV=path writes the per-frame call table and timing to a TSV (DM_NVN_TSV_CALLS=0 writes timing only); DM_SLOWFRAME=1 writes only the per-frame breakdown of dropped frames to the log; DM_NVN_LOG=1 logs object creation.

static void nvn_init_slots(void) {
    static int done; if (done) return; done = 1;
    g_log = getenv("DM_NVN_LOG") != NULL;
    unsigned long sz;
    const nvn_impl *im = (const nvn_impl *)getsectiondata(&_mh_execute_header, "__DATA", "swnvn", &sz);
    unsigned nim = im ? (unsigned)(sz / sizeof *im) : 0, hit = 0;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < NVN_NFUNC; i++) nvn_slot[i].fn = (void *)nvn_unimpl_entry;
    for (unsigned k = 0; k < nim; k++) {
        unsigned i = 0;
        while (i < NVN_NFUNC && strcmp(nvn_names[i], im[k].name)) i++;
        if (i == NVN_NFUNC) die("NVN 实现 %s 不在 main 的名字表里", im[k].name);
        nvn_slot[i].fn = im[k].fn; hit++;
    }
    g_nsem = hit;
}

// TOTK: resolve an implemented entry by name (for NVN_EXTRA fallbacks that forward to regular entries).
void *nvn_slot_fn(const char *name) {
    nvn_init_slots();
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < NVN_NFUNC; i++) if (!strcmp(nvn_names[i], name)) return nvn_slot[i].fn;
    die("nvn_slot_fn: unknown %s", name);
}

static void *nvn_lookup(const char *name) {
    nvn_init_slots();
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < NVN_NFUNC; i++)
        if (!strcmp(nvn_names[i], name)) return nvn_thunk[i];
    unsigned long sz = 0;
    const nvn_impl *ex = (const nvn_impl *)getsectiondata(&_mh_execute_header, "__DATA", "totknvnx", &sz);
    for (unsigned k = 0; ex && name && k < sz / sizeof *ex; k++) if (!strcmp(ex[k].name, name)) return ex[k].fn;
    LOG("【红】NVN 取址未知名字：%s（未实现：若被调用会跳到空地址）", name ? name : "(null)");
    return NULL;
}

    [0x1B] = 16, [0x1C] = 1536, [0x1D] = 1024, [0x1E] = 64, [0x1F] = 1536, [0x20] = 65535, [0x21] = 65535, [0x22] = 65535,
    [0x23] = 8, [0x24] = 1048576, [0x25] = 4096, [0x26] = 16, [0x27] = 4096, [0x28] = 1, [0x29] = 1, [0x2A] = 1,
    [0x2B] = 262144, [0x2C] = 15, [0x2D] = 2048, [0x2E] = 1, [0x2F] = 1, [0x30] = 14, [0x31] = 5, [0x32] = 1, [0x33] = 8,
    [0x34] = 8, [0x35] = 4, [0x36] = 32, [0x37] = 128, [0x38] = 32, [0x39] = 128, [0x3A] = 65536, [0x3B] = 1, [0x3C] = 4,
    [0x3D] = 16384, [0x3E] = 134217728, [0x3F] = 2048, [0x40] = 16384, [0x41] = 16384, [0x42] = 1, [0x43] = 1, [0x44] = 1,
    [0x45] = 1, [0x46] = 5, [0x47] = 1, [0x48] = 1, [0x49] = 1, [0x4A] = 1, [0x4B] = 1, [0x4C] = 1, [0x4D] = 16,
    [0x4E] = 1024, [0x4F] = 32, [0x50] = 4096, [0x51] = 65536, [0x52] = 65536, [0x53] = 256, [0x54] = 16384,
    [0x55] = 262144, [0x56] = 4096, [0x57] = 1, [0x58] = 4, [0x59] = 2, [0x5A] = 0, [0x5B] = 4096, [0x5C] = 16384,
    [0x5D] = 4096, [0x5E] = 128, [0x5F] = 4096,
};
NVN(nvnDeviceGetInteger, void, const NVNdevice *d, NVNdeviceInfo what, int *out) {
    (void)d;
    unsigned w = (unsigned)what;
    // 0x5F 分离采样器绑定数、0x60/0x61 在 SMO 实测表里没有：0x5F 按采样器池上限给 4096 未核，0x60/0x61 报红给 0
    // 0x5F separate sampler binding count and 0x60/0x61 are not in the table measured on SMO: 0x5F is given 4096 per the sampler pool limit, unverified; 0x60/0x61 report a failure and return 0
    if (w >= sizeof g_devinfo / sizeof *g_devinfo) { die("unsupported NVN device property %#x", w); }
    *out = g_devinfo[w];
    /* DM_NVN_GPU_CODE_MAX_MINOR (14..31): the newest GLSLC GPU code minor version accepted. The measured driver says 14;
       Bayonetta 3 mixes 1.15, 1.16 and maybe newer binaries, and its runtime sets 31. TOTK keeps the measured value. */
    if (w == NVN_DEVICE_INFO_GLSLC_MAX_SUPPORTED_GPU_CODE_MINOR_VERSION) {
        const char *e = getenv("DM_NVN_GPU_CODE_MAX_MINOR");
        if (e) { int v = atoi(e); if (v < 14 || v > 31) die("DM_NVN_GPU_CODE_MAX_MINOR must be 14..31"); *out = v; }
    }
    OLOG("DeviceGetInteger %#x -> %d", w, *out);
}

// 分离贴图 / 采样器句柄：值 = 描述符号（采样器号放 20 位以上，与组合句柄的位布局一致）
// Separate texture / sampler handles: value = descriptor index (the sampler index goes in bit 20 and above, consistent with the bit layout of combined handles)
// TOTK: combined handle = texture id (20 bits) | sampler id << 20, the encoding the replay layer decodes.
NVN(nvnDeviceGetTextureHandle, NVNtextureHandle, const NVNdevice *d, int tid, int sid) {
    (void)d; if (tid < 0 || tid >= (1 << 20) || sid < 0 || sid >= (1 << 12)) die("texture handle ids out of range %d/%d", tid, sid);
    return (NVNtextureHandle)((uint64_t)tid | (uint64_t)sid << 20);
}
NVN(nvnDeviceGetTexelFetchHandle, NVNtextureHandle, const NVNdevice *d, int tid) {
    (void)d; if (tid < 0 || tid >= (1 << 20)) die("texel fetch id out of range %d", tid); return (NVNtextureHandle)tid;
}

NVN(nvnDeviceGetSeparateSamplerHandle, NVNseparateSamplerHandle, const NVNdevice *d, int id) { (void)d; return (NVNseparateSamplerHandle){(uint64_t)id << 20}; }

#if defined(GAME_BOTW) || defined(GAME_ODYSSEY)
/* NVN's default depth mode is NEAR_IS_MINUS_W (enum value 0, the OpenGL convention): a device the game never calls
   nvnDeviceSetDepthMode on keeps it. TOTK sets it explicitly; Breath of the Wild never does, and its full-screen copy
   to the swapchain has clip z = -1 (the near plane), which the 0..w convention clipped away: the window stayed magenta
   (botw.md). */
static _Atomic int g_depth_near_minus_w = 1;
#else
static _Atomic int g_depth_near_minus_w;
#endif
int totk_depth_near_minus_w(void) { return atomic_load(&g_depth_near_minus_w); }
NVN(nvnDeviceSetDepthMode, void, NVNdevice *d, NVNdepthMode m) { ((dev_t_ *)d)->depth_mode = m; atomic_store(&g_depth_near_minus_w, m == NVN_DEPTH_MODE_NEAR_IS_MINUS_W); LOG("[nvn] 深度模式 %s", m ? "近=0（同 D3D / Metal）" : "近=-w（GL）：顶点着色器翻译时做 z=(z+w)/2 转换"); }

// TOTK: logging switches checked on per-call paths (command memory, recording, submits) are read once.
static int cmdlog_env(void) { static int on = -1; if (on < 0) on = getenv("TOTK_CMD_LOG") != NULL; return on; }
static int chainlog_env(void) { static int on = -1; if (on < 0) on = getenv("TOTK_CHAIN_LOG") != NULL; return on; }   // once: EndRecording and Submit run per command buffer (upstream 9517487)
static int poollog_env(void) { static int on = -1; if (on < 0) on = getenv("TOTK_POOL_LOG") != NULL; return on; }
#ifdef GAME_BOTW
static void guest_chain(const char *what);
#endif
NVN(nvnMemoryPoolInitialize, NVNboolean, NVNmemoryPool *p, const NVNmemoryPoolBuilder *b) {
    const pool_builder_t *s = (const pool_builder_t *)b; pool_t *o = (pool_t *)p;
    memset(o, 0, sizeof *o);
    o->magic = MAGIC('P', 'O', 'O', 'L'); o->flags = s->flags; o->mem = s->mem; o->size = s->size;
    if ((o->flags & (NVN_MEMORY_POOL_FLAGS_PHYSICAL | NVN_MEMORY_POOL_FLAGS_VIRTUAL)) && !totk_vpool_init(o)) { o->magic = 0; return 0; }
    int gpu_visible = !(o->flags & NVN_MEMORY_POOL_FLAGS_GPU_NO_ACCESS);
    if (o->mem && gpu_visible) { mtl_pool_add(o->mem, o->size); nvn_dirty_add_range(o->mem, o->size); }
    if (!o->mem) LOG("【红】MemoryPoolInitialize 池没有存储 flags=%#x size=%#llx", o->flags, o->size);
    OLOG("MemoryPool %p mem=%p size=%#llx flags=%#x", (void *)p, (void *)o->mem, o->size, o->flags);
    if (poollog_env()) LOG("[pool] %p mem=%p..%p size=%#llx flags=%#x game=%p", (void *)p, (void *)o->mem, (void *)(o->mem + o->size), o->size, o->flags, (void *)o->game_mem);
#ifdef GAME_BOTW
    { static long want = -2; if (want == -2) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_POOL_CHAIN"); want = e ? strtol(e, NULL, 0) : -1; }   /* diagnostics: TOTK_POOL_CHAIN=<size> logs who makes pools of that size */
      if (want >= 0 && (long)o->size == want) { LOG("[pool] %p mem=%p size=%#llx flags=%#x", (void *)p, (void *)o->mem, o->size, o->flags); guest_chain("pool of the watched size"); } }
#endif
    return o->mem != NULL;
}
NVN(nvnMemoryPoolFinalize, void, NVNmemoryPool *p) {
    pool_t *o = (pool_t *)p;
    if (o->mem && !(o->flags & NVN_MEMORY_POOL_FLAGS_GPU_NO_ACCESS)) { x_drain(); nvn_dirty_remove_range(o->mem); mtl_pool_del(o->mem); }
    totk_vpool_fini(o); o->magic = 0;
}
NVN(nvnMemoryPoolFlushMappedRange, void, const NVNmemoryPool *p, ptrdiff_t off, size_t n) { (void)p; (void)off; (void)n; }
NVN(nvnMemoryPoolGetFlags, NVNmemoryPoolFlags, const NVNmemoryPool *p){return (NVNmemoryPoolFlags)((const pool_t *)p)->flags;}
NVN(nvnMemoryPoolMap, void *, const NVNmemoryPool *p){const pool_t *v=(const void *)p;
#ifdef GAME_BOTW
 if(v->magic!=MAGIC('P','O','O','L')||(v->flags&NVN_MEMORY_POOL_FLAGS_CPU_NO_ACCESS)||!v->mem){static int n;if(n++<12)LOG("【红】nvnMemoryPoolMap(%p) -> NULL: magic %#x flags %#x mem %p size %#llx",(void *)p,v->magic,v->flags,(void *)v->mem,(unsigned long long)v->size);}
#endif
 if(v->magic!=MAGIC('P','O','O','L'))return NULL;return (v->flags&NVN_MEMORY_POOL_FLAGS_CPU_NO_ACCESS)?NULL:v->mem;}

// Buffer objects reference their pool; they do not own the backing allocation.
typedef struct{NVNdevice *dev;pool_t *pool;int64_t off;uint64_t size;} totk_buffer_builder;
typedef struct{uint32_t magic;pool_t *pool;int64_t off;uint64_t size;} totk_buffer;
FITS(totk_buffer_builder,NVNbufferBuilder);FITS(totk_buffer,NVNbuffer);

NVN(nvnBufferBuilderSetStorage, void, NVNbufferBuilder *b,NVNmemoryPool *p,ptrdiff_t off,size_t size){totk_buffer_builder *v=(void *)b;v->pool=(void *)p;v->off=off;v->size=size;}
NVN(nvnBufferInitialize, NVNboolean, NVNbuffer *b,const NVNbufferBuilder *builder){const totk_buffer_builder *v=(const void *)builder;
#ifdef GAME_BOTW
 /* Breath of the Wild creates a 256 KiB buffer at the start of a 144 KiB pool and never checks the result: the driver does
    not compare the two (the buffer is an address and a size), so the buffer is made as asked and only its first part is
    backed by the pool (botw.md). Refusing it left the game's NVNbuffer uninitialized; the first GetAddress read garbage. */
 if(v->pool&&v->pool->magic==MAGIC('P','O','O','L')&&v->off>=0&&(uint64_t)v->off<=v->pool->size&&v->size>v->pool->size-(uint64_t)v->off){
  static int n;if(n++<8){LOG("[nvn] buffer of %llu bytes at offset %lld of a %llu-byte pool %p (mem %p, flags %#x): made as asked (the driver does not check)",(unsigned long long)v->size,(long long)v->off,(unsigned long long)v->pool->size,(void *)v->pool,(void *)v->pool->mem,v->pool->flags);guest_chain("oversized buffer");}
  *(totk_buffer *)b=(totk_buffer){MAGIC('B','U','F',0),v->pool,v->off,v->size};return 1;}
#endif
 if(!v->pool||v->pool->magic!=MAGIC('P','O','O','L')||v->off<0||(uint64_t)v->off>v->pool->size||v->size>v->pool->size-(uint64_t)v->off)return 0;*(totk_buffer *)b=(totk_buffer){MAGIC('B','U','F',0),v->pool,v->off,v->size};return 1;}
NVN(nvnBufferFinalize, void, NVNbuffer *b){memset(b,0,sizeof(totk_buffer));}
NVN(nvnBufferMap, void *, const NVNbuffer *b){const totk_buffer *v=(const void *)b;
#ifdef GAME_BOTW
 if(!(v->pool&&v->pool->mem)){static int n;if(n++<12)LOG("【红】nvnBufferMap(%p) -> NULL: magic %#x pool %p offset %lld size %llu",(void *)b,v->magic,(void *)v->pool,(long long)v->off,(unsigned long long)v->size);}
#endif
 return v->pool&&v->pool->mem?v->pool->mem+v->off:NULL;}
NVN(nvnBufferGetAddress, NVNbufferAddress, const NVNbuffer *b){return (uintptr_t)h_nvnBufferMap(b);}
NVN(nvnBufferGetMemoryPool, NVNmemoryPool *, const NVNbuffer *b){return (void *)((const totk_buffer *)b)->pool;}
NVN(nvnBufferGetMemoryOffset, ptrdiff_t, const NVNbuffer *b){return ((const totk_buffer *)b)->off;}
NVN(nvnBufferGetSize, size_t, const NVNbuffer *b){return ((const totk_buffer *)b)->size;}
NVN(nvnBufferFlushMappedRange, void, const NVNbuffer *b,ptrdiff_t off,size_t size){const totk_buffer *v=(const void *)b;if(off<0||(uint64_t)off>v->size||size>v->size-(uint64_t)off)die("invalid NVN buffer flush range");dm_guest_write_prepare((uint8_t *)h_nvnBufferMap(b)+off,size);}

extern uint64_t g_frame_pub;
NVN(nvnTexturePoolRegisterTexture, void, const NVNtexturePool *tp, int id, const NVNtexture *t, const NVNtextureView *v) { (void)tp;
    { static long want = -2; if (want == -2) { const char *e = getenv("DM_NVN_REGLOG"); want = e ? atol(e) : -1; }   // TOTK diagnostic: DM_NVN_REGLOG=<id> logs every registration of that texture id
        static long rf0 = -2, rf1; if (rf0 == -2) { const char *e = getenv("DM_NVN_REGLOG_FRAMES"); rf0 = e ? atol(e) : -1; rf1 = e && strchr(e, '-') ? atol(strchr(e, '-') + 1) : rf0; }   // DM_NVN_REGLOG_FRAMES=a-b: log every registration in those frames
        if ((want >= 0 && id == want) || (rf0 >= 0 && (long)g_frame_pub >= rf0 && (long)g_frame_pub <= rf1)) { const tex_t *x = (const tex_t *)t; const view_t *vv = (const view_t *)v;
            LOG("[reglog] F%llu id=%d ser=%llu fmt=%#x %ux%u lv%u flags=%#x mem=%p pool=%p off=%lld view=%s vfmt=%#x vlv=%d+%d", (unsigned long long)g_frame_pub, id, (unsigned long long)x->serial, x->d.format, x->d.width, x->d.height, x->d.levels, x->d.flags, (void *)x->mem, (void *)x->pool, (long long)x->off,
                vv ? "yes" : "no", vv && vv->set_format ? vv->format : 0, vv && vv->set_levels ? vv->base_level : -1, vv && vv->set_levels ? vv->nlevels : 0); } }
    totk_life_reg(id, (const tex_t *)t);
    mtl_reg_tex(id, (const tex_t *)t, (const view_t *)v); }

    /* TOTK_SIZE_CHAIN=<w>x<h> (diagnostic): the game call chain of the first 60 textures given this size (where render target sizes come from) */
    size_chain(w, h); }
static void size_chain(int w, int h) {
    static int sw = -1, sh, n; if (sw < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_SIZE_CHAIN"); if (!e || sscanf(e, "%dx%d", &sw, &sh) != 2) sw = 0; }
    if (sw && w == sw && h == sh && n++ < 60) { char m[64]; snprintf(m, sizeof m, "texture size %dx%d", w, h); guest_chain(m); }
}
```
