`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/nvn_cube_group.h`:

```h
/* TOTK: cube-face-set pass groups ("cube merge", TOTK_CUBE_MERGE, default on; runtime `flag cube_merge 0|1`).
   Included by nvn_mtl.m before draw_inner; the globals it needs (g_cg, g_cg_on, g_cg_force_layers, g_cg_cur) are
   declared near the top of nvn_mtl.m because rp_begin_ex and dm_gfx_set_flag use them.

   The environment-probe filter (fragment f3fc460c) renders the six faces of one cube level through six colour attachments
   with one triangle, in its own pass: 6 cubes x 2 levels = 12 passes per frame, each paying the ~50 us per-pass cost of
   the M4 for 16x16 / 8x8 pixels of work. Here consecutive passes of that shape are taken off the replay (the draw's
   state S, scissor and draw record are snapshotted, like the TBDR deferral) and landed as ONE layered pass per
   (format, level size): attachment f is a six-layer temp 2D array for face f, the draw of cube c writes layer c (the
   per-draw layer constant of the existing layered passes, vs_fn_for), and 36 single-slice copies move the faces from the
   cubes into the temps before the pass (the pass loads the cube contents exactly, whatever the draw does) and back after
   it. The six attachments must be six different textures: the Metal validation layer refuses six slice windows of one
   texture even when the written layers are disjoint (scripts/diag/metal_cube_group_probe.m: layout A).

   Safety: a group pends only across consecutive cube-face-set passes. Any other SetRenderTargets, any op that is not a
   pure state / binding op (copies, dispatches, clears, counters, events, inline uniform updates), the end of the
   submission, a second draw in a taken pass, and any draw that is not taken itself land the pending groups first, in
   record order, so nothing can observe the cubes between the game's pass and the merged one. A member that reads a cube
   another member already wrote is preceded by a flush (it would read the pre-pass copy otherwise). A group of one, or
   a group whose attachments cannot be matched to the temps, is replayed as plain passes in order. */
#define CG_MAX 6          // members (cubes) per group = temp layers
#define CG_GROUPS 4       // groups pending at once (the game interleaves the two levels of each cube: two groups)
#define CG_TEMPS 8        // cached temp sets (one per attachment format and level size)

static int cg_on(void) {
    int v = atomic_load(&g_cg_on);
    if (v < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_CUBE_MERGE"); v = !(e && !strcmp(e, "0")); atomic_store(&g_cg_on, v); if (!v) MLOG("TOTK_CUBE_MERGE=0：立方体面通道合并关闭"); }
    return v && lay_on();
}
// A SetRenderTargets that is the six faces of one cube level: the same cube in all six slots, slot i viewing layer i,
// one common level, no depth. Gives the level and its size.
static int cg_match(const p_set_rt *r, int *lv, uint32_t *w, uint32_t *h) {
    if (r->n != 6 || r->depth || !r->color[0] || r->color[0]->d.target != 8 || r->color[0]->d.samples > 1 || !r->has_cview[0]) return 0;
    const view_t *v0 = &r->cview[0];
    if (!v0->set_layers || v0->nlayers != 1 || v0->min_layer != 0 || (v0->set_levels && v0->nlevels != 1)) return 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < 6; i++) {
        if (!r->color[i] || r->color[i]->serial != r->color[0]->serial || !r->has_cview[i]) return 0;
        view_t v = r->cview[i]; if (!v.set_layers || v.nlayers != 1 || v.min_layer != (uint16_t)i) return 0;
        v.min_layer = 0; if (memcmp(&v, v0, sizeof v)) return 0;
    }
    int l = v0->set_levels ? v0->base_level : 0, levels = r->color[0]->d.levels ? (int)r->color[0]->d.levels : 1;
    if (l >= levels) return 0;
    *lv = l; *w = (uint32_t)mip_extent(r->color[0]->d.width, (NSUInteger)l); *h = (uint32_t)mip_extent(r->color[0]->d.height, (NSUInteger)l);
    return *w <= LAY_MAX_EXTENT && *h <= LAY_MAX_EXTENT;
}
static int cg_rt_match(const p_set_rt *r) { int lv; uint32_t w, h; return cg_match(r, &lv, &w, &h); }
static uint32_t cg_vfmt(const p_set_rt *r) { return r->cview[0].set_format ? r->cview[0].format : 0; }
// Ops that may run while groups pend: state and bindings only (snapshotted per member), list structure, render-enable.
static int cg_op_safe(unsigned op) {
    switch (op) {
        case OP_END: case OP_JUMP: case OP_BEGIN: case OP_CALL: case OP_VIEWPORTS: case OP_SCISSOR: case OP_DEPTH_RANGE: case OP_BIND_PROGRAM:
        case OP_BIND_STATE: case OP_BIND_VATTR: case OP_BIND_VSTREAM: case OP_BIND_VBUF: case OP_BIND_UBO: case OP_BIND_SSBO: case OP_BIND_TEX:
        case OP_BIND_SAMP: case OP_BIND_IMG: case OP_STENCIL: case OP_POLY_OFFSET: case OP_BLEND_COLOR: case OP_DEPTH_CLAMP: case OP_RASTER_DISCARD:
        case OP_SET_TEX_POOL: case OP_SET_SAMP_POOL: case OP_RENDER_ENABLE: case OP_RENDER_COND: case OP_DRAW: case OP_DRAW_IDX: case OP_SET_RT: return 1;
        default: return 0;
    }
}
// Lookahead from the op after the taken draw: -1 = this pass draws again (not mergeable as a one-draw pass), 1 = another
// cube-face-set pass of the same key follows within the safe window, 0 = neither.
static int cg_scan(const uint8_t *start, uint32_t nvnfmt, uint32_t vfmt, uint32_t w, uint32_t h) {
    fz_cursor cur = {.p = start}; int in_this = 1, found = 0;
    for (int guard = 0; guard < 2048 && !found; guard++) {
        const uint8_t *q; op_hdr oh; const void *a;
        if (!fz_next(&cur, &q, &oh, &a)) break;
        if (oh.op == OP_SET_RT) { int lv; uint32_t ww, hh; const p_set_rt *r = a;
            if (!cg_match(r, &lv, &ww, &hh)) break;
            in_this = 0;
            if (ww == w && hh == h && r->color[0]->d.format == nvnfmt && cg_vfmt(r) == vfmt) found = 1;
        } else if (oh.op == OP_DRAW || oh.op == OP_DRAW_IDX) { if (in_this) return -1; }
        else if (!cg_op_safe(oh.op)) break;
    }
    return found;
}
// Does the bound program read a cube a pending member already wrote?
static int cg_reads_pending(void) {
    for (int gi = 0; gi < g_cg.ng; gi++) for (int c = 0; c < g_cg.g[gi].n; c++)
        if (prog_samples_ser(S.prog, S.tex, S.img, g_cg.g[gi].m[c].ser)) return 1;
    return 0;
}
static cg_temp *cg_temps(MTLPixelFormat pf, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, const cg_member *m0) {
    for (int i = 0; i < g_cg.ntemps; i++) { cg_temp *t = &g_cg.temps[i]; if (t->pf == pf && t->w == w && t->h == h) return t; }
    if (g_cg.ntemps >= CG_TEMPS) { static int once; if (!once++) MLOG("[cube-merge] 临时贴图组已满（%d 种格式 / 尺寸），更多的组按原样回放", CG_TEMPS); return NULL; }
    cg_temp *t = &g_cg.temps[g_cg.ntemps]; memset(t, 0, sizeof *t); t->pf = pf; t->w = w; t->h = h;
    MTLTextureDescriptor *d = [MTLTextureDescriptor new]; d.textureType = MTLTextureType2DArray; d.pixelFormat = pf; d.width = w; d.height = h; d.arrayLength = CG_MAX;
    d.mipmapLevelCount = 1; d.usage = MTLTextureUsageRenderTarget | MTLTextureUsageShaderRead; d.storageMode = MTLStorageModePrivate;
    for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) {
        id<MTLTexture> tex = [g_dev newTextureWithDescriptor:d]; if (!tex) { MLOG("【红】[cube-merge] 建不出 %ux%u 格式 %lu 的临时贴图，更多的组按原样回放", w, h, (unsigned long)pf); return NULL; }
        if (!g_cg_hold) g_cg_hold = [NSMutableArray array]; [g_cg_hold addObject:tex];   // the struct holds an unretained pointer: the array keeps the temps alive
        tex.label = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"cube-merge temp %ux%u f%d", w, h, f]; res_add(tex); t->t[f] = tex;
        tex_t *fk = &t->fake[f]; memset(fk, 0, sizeof *fk); fk->serial = 0xffffff00ull + (uint64_t)g_cg.ntemps * 8 + (uint64_t)f;   // reserved serials, below the probes' 0xffffffb0
        fk->d = m0->rt.color[0]->d; fk->d.target = 4; fk->d.depth = CG_MAX; fk->d.levels = 1; fk->d.width = w; fk->d.height = h; fk->d.flags = 0; fk->d.samples = 1;
        serial_put(fk->serial, t->t[f]);
    }
    g_cg.ntemps++;
    MLOG("[cube-merge] 临时贴图组 %d：%ux%u 格式 %lu，6 x %d 层", g_cg.ntemps, w, h, (unsigned long)pf, CG_MAX);
    return t;
}
/* The copies between the cube levels and the temps: one compute dispatch per direction and group (12 textures through an
   argument table) instead of 36 single-slice blits each way -- a blit costs about 1 us of replay CPU on Metal 4, the 144 of
   a frame were 0.15 ms, more than the 12 merged passes cost to begin with. The copy-out writes the cubes, so they need
   ShaderWrite (small cube render targets get it at creation, nvn_mtl.m tex creation); without it, blits. */
static const char *k_cg_copy_msl =
    "#include <metal_stdlib>\nusing namespace metal;\n"
    "struct cg_par { uint n; uint dir; uint pad0, pad1; uint lv[6]; uint pad[6]; };\n"
    "kernel void cg_in(array<texturecube<float, access::read>, 6> cubes [[texture(0)]], array<texture2d_array<float, access::write>, 6> temps [[texture(6)]],\n"
    "                  constant cg_par &p [[buffer(0)]], uint3 id [[thread_position_in_grid]]) {\n"
    "    uint c = id.z / 6u, f = id.z % 6u; if (c >= p.n) return; temps[f].write(cubes[c].read(id.xy, f, p.lv[c]), id.xy, c); }\n"
    "kernel void cg_out(array<texturecube<float, access::write>, 6> cubes [[texture(0)]], array<texture2d_array<float, access::read>, 6> temps [[texture(6)]],\n"
    "                   constant cg_par &p [[buffer(0)]], uint3 id [[thread_position_in_grid]]) {\n"
    "    uint c = id.z / 6u, f = id.z % 6u; if (c >= p.n) return; cubes[c].write(temps[f].read(id.xy, c), id.xy, f, p.lv[c]); }\n";
static id<MTLComputePipelineState> cg_pso(int out) {
    static id<MTLComputePipelineState> ps[2]; static int failed;
    if (failed) return nil;
    if (!ps[out]) { NSError *e = nil; id<MTLLibrary> lib = [g_dev newLibraryWithSource:@(k_cg_copy_msl) options:nil error:&e];
        id<MTLFunction> fn = lib ? [lib newFunctionWithName:out ? @"cg_out" : @"cg_in"] : nil; ps[out] = fn ? [g_dev newComputePipelineStateWithFunction:fn error:&e] : nil;
        if (!ps[out]) { failed = 1; MLOG("【红】[cube-merge] 拷贝计算核建不出：%s（改用 blit 拷贝）", e.localizedDescription.UTF8String); return nil; } }
    return ps[out];
}
static id<MTL4ArgumentTable> cg_table(void) {
    static id<MTL4ArgumentTable> t;
    if (!t) { MTL4ArgumentTableDescriptor *d = [MTL4ArgumentTableDescriptor new]; d.maxTextureBindCount = 12; d.maxBufferBindCount = 1; NSError *e = nil;
        t = [g_dev newArgumentTableWithDescriptor:d error:&e]; if (!t) MDIE("cube-merge argument table: %s", e.localizedDescription.UTF8String); }
    return t;
}
// 1 = done by the kernel, 0 = the caller blits (no kernel, or a cube the copy-out could not write)
static int cg_copy_kernel(int out, const cg_group *g, const cg_temp *tp, __strong id<MTLTexture> *ct) {
    id<MTLComputePipelineState> ps = cg_pso(out); if (!ps) return 0;
    if (out) for (int c = 0; c < g->n; c++) if (!(ct[c].usage & MTLTextureUsageShaderWrite)) { g_cg.blit_out++; return 0; }
    id<MTL4ComputeCommandEncoder> b = blit(); id<MTL4ArgumentTable> at = cg_table();
    for (int c = 0; c < 6; c++) [at setTexture:ct[c < g->n ? c : 0].gpuResourceID atIndex:(NSUInteger)c];   // unused slots repeat cube 0 (never touched: c < n)
    for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) [at setTexture:tp->t[f].gpuResourceID atIndex:(NSUInteger)(6 + f)];
    id<MTLBuffer> pb; size_t off = arena_alloc(64, &pb); uint32_t *p = (uint32_t *)((uint8_t *)pb.contents + off); memset(p, 0, 64);
    p[0] = (uint32_t)g->n; p[1] = (uint32_t)out; for (int c = 0; c < g->n; c++) p[4 + c] = (uint32_t)g->m[c].lv;
    [at setAddress:pb.gpuAddress + off atIndex:0];
    [b setArgumentTable:at]; [b setComputePipelineState:ps];
    [b dispatchThreads:MTLSizeMake(g->w, g->h, 6 * (NSUInteger)g->n) threadsPerThreadgroup:MTLSizeMake(8, 8, 1)];
    [b setArgumentTable:g_ct]; args_dirty_all();   // the replay's own dispatches re-bind their table and arguments
    g_cg.kcopies++; return 1;
}
static void cg_member_state(const cg_member *m) {   // the member's state, as at its draw
    memcpy(&S, m->S_, sizeof S); R.sc = m->sc; R.has_sc = m->has_sc; args_dirty_all(); g_pso_dirty = g_dss_dirty = 1;
}
static void cg_member_draw(const cg_member *m) { draw(m->idx ? NULL : &m->dw, m->idx ? &m->di : NULL); }
static void cg_flush_plain(cg_group *g) {   // each member in its own pass, in record order
    for (int c = 0; c < g->n; c++) { const cg_member *m = &g->m[c];
        R.rt = m->rt; R.has_rt = 1; memset(R.clear_c, 0, sizeof R.clear_c); R.clear_d = R.clear_s = 0;
        cg_member_state(m); cg_member_draw(m); rp_end(); g_cg.plain_members++; }
}
static void cg_flush_group(cg_group *g) {
    id<MTLTexture> ct[CG_MAX]; cg_temp *tp = NULL; int ok = g->n >= 2;
    for (int c = 0; ok && c < g->n; c++) { const cg_member *m = &g->m[c];
        ct[c] = attachment_texture(m->rt.color[0], &m->rt.cview[0], m->rt.has_cview[0]);   // may recreate a storage-shared cube (a blit): before the copies
        if (!ct[c] || ct[c].textureType != MTLTextureTypeCube || mip_extent(ct[c].width, (NSUInteger)m->lv) != g->w || mip_extent(ct[c].height, (NSUInteger)m->lv) != g->h) ok = 0;
        else if (!c) { tp = cg_temps(ct[0].pixelFormat, g->w, g->h, m); if (!tp) ok = 0; }
        else if (ct[c].pixelFormat != tp->pf) ok = 0;
    }
    if (!ok) { cg_flush_plain(g); return; }
    MTLSize sz = MTLSizeMake(g->w, g->h, 1); MTLOrigin o0 = MTLOriginMake(0, 0, 0);
    uint64_t t0 = clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW);
    if (g_cg_probe_neg != 18 && !cg_copy_kernel(0, g, tp, ct)) {   // copy in: the pass loads exactly what the cube levels hold now
        id<MTL4ComputeCommandEncoder> b = blit();
        for (int c = 0; c < g->n; c++) for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) { enc_b_copy_texture(b, ct[c], (NSUInteger)f, (NSUInteger)g->m[c].lv, o0, sz, tp->t[f], (NSUInteger)c, 0, o0); g_cg.copies++; }
    }
    uint64_t t1 = clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW); g_cg.ns_in += t1 - t0;
    p_set_rt rt; memset(&rt, 0, sizeof rt); rt.n = 6;
    for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) { rt.color[f] = &tp->fake[f]; rt.has_cview[f] = 1; view_t v = g->m[0].rt.cview[0];   // the member's view (format) on layer 0 level 0 of temp f
        v.set_levels = v.set_layers = 1; v.base_level = 0; v.nlevels = 1; v.min_layer = 0; v.nlayers = 1; rt.cview[f] = v; }
    R.rt = rt; R.has_rt = 1; memset(R.clear_c, 0, sizeof R.clear_c); R.clear_d = R.clear_s = 0;
    g_cg_force_layers = g->n;
    for (int c = 0; c < g->n; c++) { const cg_member *m = &g->m[c];
        cg_member_state(m); g_cg_cur = g_cg_probe_neg == 19 ? 0 : c; if (g_enc && g_lay.active) g_lay.cur = g_lay.base + g_cg_cur;
        cg_member_draw(m); }
    g_cg_force_layers = 0; rp_end();
    uint64_t t2 = clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW); g_cg.ns_draw += t2 - t1;
    if (!cg_copy_kernel(1, g, tp, ct)) {   // copy out
        id<MTL4ComputeCommandEncoder> b = blit();
        for (int c = 0; c < g->n; c++) for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) { enc_b_copy_texture(b, tp->t[f], (NSUInteger)c, 0, o0, sz, ct[c], (NSUInteger)f, (NSUInteger)g->m[c].lv, o0); g_cg.copies++; }
    }
    g_cg.ns_out += clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW) - t2;
    for (int c = 0; c < g->n; c++) { const tex_t *t = g->m[c].rt.color[0]; gpu_owned_mark(t->serial); if (t->mem && tex_mirrored(t)) wb_note(t); }   // what rp_begin_ex notes for a rendered-into texture
    g_cg.merged_passes++; g_cg.merged_members += (uint64_t)g->n;
    if (!g_cg.merged_passes_logged++) MLOG("[cube-merge] 首个合并通道：%d 个 %ux%u 立方体级（格式 %lu）并成一个分层通道", g->n, g->w, g->h, (unsigned long)tp->pf);
    PD("G %llu 立方体面通道合并：%d 个成员 %ux%u", g_stat_pass, g->n, g->w, g->h);
}
static void cg_flush_reason(int why) { if (why >= 0 && why < 8) g_cg.reason[why]++; }
static void cg_flush(void) {
    if (!g_cg.ng || g_cg.replaying) return;
    g_cg.replaying = 1;
    const uint8_t *en0 = g_exec_next; g_exec_next = NULL;
    static uint8_t *saveS; if (!saveS) { saveS = malloc(sizeof S); if (!saveS) MDIE("cube-merge state"); }
    memcpy(saveS, &S, sizeof S); typeof(R) saveR = R;
    rp_end();
    uint64_t t0 = clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW);
    for (int i = 0; i < g_cg.ng; i++) cg_flush_group(&g_cg.g[i]);
    g_cg.ns_flush += clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW) - t0;
    g_cg.ng = 0; g_cg_pending = 0; g_cg.take_seq = ~0ull;
    memcpy(&S, saveS, sizeof S); R = saveR; args_dirty_all(); g_pso_dirty = g_dss_dirty = 1;
    g_exec_next = en0; g_cg.replaying = 0;
}
// The first draw of a cube-face-set pass: snapshot it into its group. 0 = not taken (the caller draws it, after landing
// the pending groups).
static int cg_take_(NvProg *pr, const p_draw *dw, const p_draw_idx *di);
static int cg_take(NvProg *pr, const p_draw *dw, const p_draw_idx *di) {
    uint64_t t0 = clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW); int r = cg_take_(pr, dw, di); g_cg.ns_take += clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW) - t0; return r;
}
static int cg_take_(NvProg *pr, const p_draw *dw, const p_draw_idx *di) {
    int lv; uint32_t w, h;
    if (g_cg.replaying || !cg_match(&R.rt, &lv, &w, &h)) return 0;
    if (R.clear_d || R.clear_s) return 0; for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) if (R.clear_c[i]) return 0;
    if (!pr || !lay_draw_ok(pr, dw, di)) return 0;
    if (g_cg.take_seq == g_cg.rt_seq) { cg_flush_reason(3); return 0; }   // a second draw of a taken pass: the caller lands the groups first
    if (!g_exec_next) return 0;
    uint32_t nvnfmt = R.rt.color[0]->d.format, vfmt = cg_vfmt(&R.rt);
    int ahead = cg_scan(g_exec_next, nvnfmt, vfmt, w, h);
    if (ahead < 0) return 0;
    if (g_cg.ng && cg_reads_pending()) { cg_flush_reason(2); cg_flush(); }
    cg_group *g = NULL;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_cg.ng; i++) if (g_cg.g[i].nvnfmt == nvnfmt && g_cg.g[i].vfmt == vfmt && g_cg.g[i].w == w && g_cg.g[i].h == h) { g = &g_cg.g[i]; break; }
    if (g && g->n >= CG_MAX) { cg_flush_reason(5); cg_flush(); g = NULL; }
    if (!g) {
        if (!ahead) return 0;   // alone: a group of one gains nothing
        if (g_cg.ng >= CG_GROUPS) { cg_flush_reason(5); cg_flush(); }
        g = &g_cg.g[g_cg.ng++]; uint8_t *keep[CG_MAX]; for (int c = 0; c < CG_MAX; c++) keep[c] = g->m[c].S_;
        memset(g, 0, sizeof *g); for (int c = 0; c < CG_MAX; c++) g->m[c].S_ = keep[c];
        g->nvnfmt = nvnfmt; g->vfmt = vfmt; g->w = w; g->h = h;
    }
    cg_member *m = &g->m[g->n++];
    m->rt = R.rt; m->lv = lv; m->ser = R.rt.color[0]->serial; m->idx = di != NULL; if (dw) m->dw = *dw; if (di) m->di = *di; m->sc = R.sc; m->has_sc = R.has_sc;
    if (!m->S_) { m->S_ = malloc(sizeof S); if (!m->S_) MDIE("cube-merge member state"); }
    memcpy(m->S_, &S, sizeof S);
    g_cg.take_seq = g_cg.rt_seq; g_cg.taken++; g_cg_pending = 1;
    PD("G %llu 立方体面通道暂存：ser=%llu lv%d %ux%u（组 %d 第 %d 个）", g_stat_pass + 1, (unsigned long long)m->ser, lv, w, h, (int)(g - g_cg.g), g->n);
    return 1;
}
static void cg_stats_line(void) {
    if (!g_cg.taken && !g_cg.ntemps) return;
    MLOG("[nvn] 立方体面通道合并 至提交 %llu：暂存 %llu 次绘制，合成 %llu 个分层通道（%llu 次绘制），单独回放 %llu 次，计算核拷贝 %llu 次、blit 拷贝 %llu 次（拷出退回 blit %llu 组）；落地于 目标 %llu / 命令 %llu / 读取 %llu / 第二次绘制 %llu / 提交结束 %llu / 组满 %llu",
         (unsigned long long)g_sub_serial, (unsigned long long)g_cg.taken, (unsigned long long)g_cg.merged_passes, (unsigned long long)g_cg.merged_members, (unsigned long long)g_cg.plain_members,
         (unsigned long long)g_cg.kcopies, (unsigned long long)g_cg.copies, (unsigned long long)g_cg.blit_out, (unsigned long long)g_cg.reason[0], (unsigned long long)g_cg.reason[1], (unsigned long long)g_cg.reason[2], (unsigned long long)g_cg.reason[3],
         (unsigned long long)g_cg.reason[4], (unsigned long long)g_cg.reason[5]);
    MLOG("[nvn] 立方体面通道合并 CPU（每次提交平均，ms）：判定与暂存 %.3f / 落地 %.3f（拷入 %.3f / 成员绘制 %.3f / 拷出 %.3f）",
         (double)g_cg.ns_take / 1800 / 1e6, (double)g_cg.ns_flush / 1800 / 1e6, (double)g_cg.ns_in / 1800 / 1e6, (double)g_cg.ns_draw / 1800 / 1e6, (double)g_cg.ns_out / 1800 / 1e6);
    g_cg.taken = g_cg.merged_passes = g_cg.merged_members = g_cg.plain_members = g_cg.copies = g_cg.kcopies = g_cg.blit_out = 0; memset(g_cg.reason, 0, sizeof g_cg.reason);
    g_cg.ns_take = g_cg.ns_flush = g_cg.ns_in = g_cg.ns_draw = g_cg.ns_out = 0;
}
void mtl_cube_merge_stats(uint64_t v[4]) { v[0] = g_cg.taken; v[1] = g_cg.merged_passes; v[2] = g_cg.merged_members; v[3] = g_cg.plain_members; }

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/nvn_cube_group_probe.h`:

```h
/* probe-gpu-cube-merge: the cube-face-set pass groups of nvn_cube_group.h through the production replay (mtl_exec,
   draw_inner, rp_begin_ex, the layered vertex variant, the copies), under the Metal validation layer.
   Scenarios: A three cubes x two levels in the game's order (two merged passes); B the same with a half-level scissor
   (the other half must keep A's content: the copy-in); C a pass with two draws (not taken, and the cube pass after it
   is alone); D another target between two cube passes (nothing taken); E seven cubes of one level (a full group of
   six and one plain). Every cube face of every level is read back and compared.
   TOTK_PROBE_NEGATIVE=18: no copy-in (B's untouched halves come out wrong); =19: every member drawn at layer 0 (the
   faces of the second and third cube come out wrong). */
#define CGP_N 7
static uint8_t *cgp_rt(uint8_t *w, const tex_t *t, int level) {
    p_set_rt r; memset(&r, 0, sizeof r); r.n = 6;
    for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) { r.color[i] = t; r.has_cview[i] = 1; r.cview[i].set_levels = r.cview[i].set_layers = 1; r.cview[i].base_level = (uint8_t)level; r.cview[i].nlevels = 1;
        r.cview[i].min_layer = (uint16_t)i; r.cview[i].nlayers = 1; }
    return lp_rec(w, OP_SET_RT, &r, sizeof r);
}
static uint32_t cgp_px(int k, int f) { return (uint32_t)lroundf(255.f * (float)(k + 1) / 64.f) | (uint32_t)lroundf(255.f * (float)f / 8.f) << 8 | 128u << 16 | 255u << 24; }
static uint32_t cgp_want[CGP_N][2][6][256];
static void cgp_fill(int c, int lv, int f, int x0, int x1, uint32_t v) { int sz = 16 >> lv; for (int y = 0; y < sz; y++) for (int x = x0; x < x1 && x < sz; x++) cgp_want[c][lv][f][y * sz + x] = v; }
static void cgp_run(const char *name, const uint8_t *ops, uint64_t passes, uint64_t merged, uint64_t members, uint64_t plain, uint64_t taken) {
    uint64_t p0 = g_stat_pass, v0[4], v1[4]; mtl_cube_merge_stats(v0);
    mtl_exec(ops); rp_end(); cg_flush();   // the list ends without a submit: land what pends, as mtl_sub_commit would
    mtl_cube_merge_stats(v1);
    uint64_t dp = g_stat_pass - p0, dm = v1[1] - v0[1], dmm = v1[2] - v0[2], dpl = v1[3] - v0[3], dt = v1[0] - v0[0];
    MLOG("cube-merge probe %s: %llu passes, %llu merged (%llu members), %llu plain, %llu taken", name, (unsigned long long)dp, (unsigned long long)dm, (unsigned long long)dmm, (unsigned long long)dpl, (unsigned long long)dt);
    if (dp != passes || dm != merged || dmm != members || dpl != plain || dt != taken)
        MDIE("cube-merge probe %s: %llu passes / %llu merged / %llu members / %llu plain / %llu taken, expected %llu / %llu / %llu / %llu / %llu", name, (unsigned long long)dp, (unsigned long long)dm,
             (unsigned long long)dmm, (unsigned long long)dpl, (unsigned long long)dt, (unsigned long long)passes, (unsigned long long)merged, (unsigned long long)members, (unsigned long long)plain, (unsigned long long)taken);
}
int mtl_probe_cube_merge(void) {
    mtl_init(); setenv("TOTK_GPU_MIDCLEAR", "1", 1); g_cg_probe_neg = getenv("TOTK_PROBE_NEGATIVE") ? atoi(getenv("TOTK_PROBE_NEGATIVE")) : 0;
    if (!cg_on()) MDIE("cube-merge probe: cube merge is off (TOTK_CUBE_MERGE=0, TOTK_LAYER_MERGE=0 or DM_NVN_TBDR=1)");
    NSString *vsrc = @"#include <metal_stdlib>\nusing namespace metal;\n\nstruct main0_out\n{\n    float4 m_0 [[user(locn0)]];\n    float4 gl_Position [[position, invariant]];\n    float gl_PointSize [[point_size]];\n};\n\n"
        "vertex main0_out main0(uint gl_VertexIndex [[vertex_id]])\n{\n    main0_out out = {};\n    out.gl_PointSize = 1.0;\n    uint k = gl_VertexIndex / 3u, i = gl_VertexIndex % 3u;\n"
        "    out.gl_Position = float4(float((i << 1u) & 2u) * 2.0 - 1.0, float(i & 2u) * 2.0 - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0);\n"
        "    out.m_0 = float4(float(k + 1u) / 64.0, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0);\n    if (k >= 64u)\n    {\n        return out;\n    }\n    return out;\n}\n";

        "struct main0_in\n{\n    float4 m_0 [[user(locn0)]];\n};\n\n"
        "fragment main0_out main0(main0_in in [[stage_in]])\n{\n    main0_out out = {};\n    out.c0 = float4(in.m_0.x, 0.0, 0.5, 1.0);\n    out.c1 = float4(in.m_0.x, 0.125, 0.5, 1.0);\n    out.c2 = float4(in.m_0.x, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0);\n"
        "    out.c3 = float4(in.m_0.x, 0.375, 0.5, 1.0);\n    out.c4 = float4(in.m_0.x, 0.5, 0.5, 1.0);\n    out.c5 = float4(in.m_0.x, 0.625, 0.5, 1.0);\n    return out;\n}\n";
    NSError *e = nil; id<MTLLibrary> vl = [g_dev newLibraryWithSource:vsrc options:totk_precise_opts() error:&e], fl = vl ? [g_dev newLibraryWithSource:fsrc options:totk_precise_opts() error:&e] : nil;
    if (!vl || !fl) MDIE("cube-merge probe shaders: %s", e.localizedDescription.UTF8String);
    NvShader *vs = [NvShader new], *fs = [NvShader new];

    fs->fn = [fl newFunctionWithName:@"main0"]; fs->src = fsrc; fs->stage = 1; strcpy(fs->key, "probe-cube-fs");
    NvProg *pr = [NvProg new]; pr->sh[0] = vs; pr->sh[1] = fs;
    prog_t p1; memset(&p1, 0, sizeof p1); p1.serial = 0xffffffc0; serial_put(p1.serial, pr);
    MTLTextureDescriptor *d = [MTLTextureDescriptor new]; d.pixelFormat = MTLPixelFormatRGBA8Unorm; d.usage = MTLTextureUsageRenderTarget | MTLTextureUsageShaderRead; d.storageMode = MTLStorageModePrivate;
    d.textureType = MTLTextureTypeCube; d.width = d.height = 16; d.mipmapLevelCount = 2;
    id<MTLTexture> cubes[CGP_N]; tex_t ct[CGP_N];
    for (int c = 0; c < CGP_N; c++) {
        d.usage = MTLTextureUsageRenderTarget | MTLTextureUsageShaderRead | (c == 5 ? 0 : MTLTextureUsageShaderWrite);   // cube 5: no shader write, its groups' copy-out falls back to blits
        cubes[c] = [g_dev newTextureWithDescriptor:d]; if (!cubes[c]) MDIE("cube-merge probe textures"); res_add(cubes[c]);
        memset(&ct[c], 0, sizeof ct[c]); ct[c].serial = 0xffffffc1 + (uint64_t)c; ct[c].d.format = 0x25; ct[c].d.width = ct[c].d.height = 16; ct[c].d.depth = 1; ct[c].d.levels = 2; ct[c].d.target = 8; ct[c].d.samples = 1;
        serial_put(ct[c].serial, cubes[c]);
    }
    d.textureType = MTLTextureType2D; d.mipmapLevelCount = 1; d.usage = MTLTextureUsageRenderTarget | MTLTextureUsageShaderRead; id<MTLTexture> other = [g_dev newTextureWithDescriptor:d]; if (!other) MDIE("cube-merge probe texture"); res_add(other);
    tex_t ot; memset(&ot, 0, sizeof ot); ot.serial = 0xffffffd0; ot.d.format = 0x25; ot.d.width = ot.d.height = 16; ot.d.depth = 1; ot.d.levels = 1; ot.d.target = 1; ot.d.samples = 1; serial_put(ot.serial, other);
    mtl_sub_begin(); { op_hdr end = {OP_END, 8}; mtl_exec((const uint8_t *)&end); }   // replay state and an open submission
    for (int c = 0; c < CGP_N; c++) for (int lv = 0; lv < 2; lv++) {   // every face of every level starts transparent black
        MTL4RenderPassDescriptor *rp = [MTL4RenderPassDescriptor new]; rp.colorAttachments[0].texture = cubes[c]; rp.colorAttachments[0].level = (NSUInteger)lv;
        rp.colorAttachments[0].loadAction = MTLLoadActionClear; rp.colorAttachments[0].clearColor = MTLClearColorMake(0, 0, 0, 0); rp.colorAttachments[0].storeAction = MTLStoreActionStore;
        rp.renderTargetArrayLength = 6; ser_gate(); enc_r_end(enc_r_begin(rp));
    }
    memset(cgp_want, 0, sizeof cgp_want);
    static uint8_t ops[65536]; uint8_t *w;
    // A: three cubes x two levels in the game's order (lv0, lv1 of each cube): one merged pass per level
    w = lp_prog(ops, &p1); w = lp_sc(w, 0, 0, 16, 16);
    for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) for (int lv = 0; lv < 2; lv++) { w = cgp_rt(w, &ct[c], lv); w = lp_draw(w, 2 * c + lv); for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) cgp_fill(c, lv, f, 0, 16, cgp_px(2 * c + lv, f)); }
    lp_end(w); cgp_run("A three cubes, two levels", ops, 2, 2, 6, 0, 6);
    // A2: new content in the cubes through plain passes (another target between them keeps them apart), so that the
    // temps of A no longer match the cubes: B's copy-in is then the only way to keep the untouched halves right
    w = ops;
    for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) for (int lv = 0; lv < 2; lv++) { w = cgp_rt(w, &ct[c], lv); w = lp_draw(w, 50 + 2 * c + lv); w = lp_rt(w, &ot, 0, 0); w = lp_draw(w, 63); for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) cgp_fill(c, lv, f, 0, 16, cgp_px(50 + 2 * c + lv, f)); }
    lp_end(w); cgp_run("A2 plain passes refill the cubes", ops, 12, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    // B: a scissor on the left half of each level: the right half must keep A2's content (the copy-in)
    w = ops;
    for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) for (int lv = 0; lv < 2; lv++) { w = lp_sc(w, 0, 0, 8 >> lv, 16 >> lv); w = cgp_rt(w, &ct[c], lv); w = lp_draw(w, 10 + 2 * c + lv); for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) cgp_fill(c, lv, f, 0, 8 >> lv, cgp_px(10 + 2 * c + lv, f)); }
    w = lp_sc(w, 0, 0, 16, 16); lp_end(w); cgp_run("B half-level scissor (copy-in)", ops, 2, 2, 6, 0, 6);
    // C: a pass with two draws is not taken (the lookahead sees the second draw), so the cube pass after it is alone: nothing merges
    w = cgp_rt(ops, &ct[0], 0); w = lp_draw(w, 20); w = lp_draw(w, 21); w = cgp_rt(w, &ct[1], 0); w = lp_draw(w, 22); lp_end(w);
    for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) { cgp_fill(0, 0, f, 0, 16, cgp_px(21, f)); cgp_fill(1, 0, f, 0, 16, cgp_px(22, f)); }
    cgp_run("C two draws in a pass", ops, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    // D: another target between two cube passes: nothing is taken
    w = cgp_rt(ops, &ct[0], 1); w = lp_draw(w, 30); w = lp_rt(w, &ot, 0, 0); w = lp_draw(w, 31); w = cgp_rt(w, &ct[1], 1); w = lp_draw(w, 32); lp_end(w);
    for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) { cgp_fill(0, 1, f, 0, 8, cgp_px(30, f)); cgp_fill(1, 1, f, 0, 8, cgp_px(32, f)); }
    cgp_run("D other target between", ops, 3, 0, 0, 0, 0);
    // E: seven cubes of level 0: a full group of six, the seventh alone
    w = ops; for (int c = 0; c < CGP_N; c++) { w = cgp_rt(w, &ct[c], 0); w = lp_draw(w, 40 + c); for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) cgp_fill(c, 0, f, 0, 16, cgp_px(40 + c, f)); }
    lp_end(w); cgp_run("E seven cubes", ops, 2, 1, 6, 0, 6);
    // read back every face of every level
    id<MTLBuffer> rb[CGP_N]; for (int c = 0; c < CGP_N; c++) rb[c] = probe_buf(6 * 1024 + 6 * 256);
    for (int c = 0; c < CGP_N; c++) for (int lv = 0; lv < 2; lv++) for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) { NSUInteger sz = (NSUInteger)(16 >> lv), off = lv ? 6 * 1024 + (NSUInteger)f * 256 : (NSUInteger)f * 1024;
        enc_b_copy_texture_buffer(blit(), cubes[c], (NSUInteger)f, (NSUInteger)lv, MTLOriginMake(0, 0, 0), MTLSizeMake(sz, sz, 1), rb[c], off, sz * 4, sz * sz * 4); }
    mtl_sub_commit(); mtl_finish();
    int checked = 0;
    for (int c = 0; c < CGP_N; c++) for (int lv = 0; lv < 2; lv++) for (int f = 0; f < 6; f++) { int sz = 16 >> lv; size_t off = lv ? 6 * 1024 + (size_t)f * 256 : (size_t)f * 1024;
        for (int p = 0; p < sz * sz; p++) { const uint8_t *got = (const uint8_t *)rb[c].contents + off + (size_t)p * 4; uint32_t want = cgp_want[c][lv][f][p];
            for (int ch = 0; ch < 4; ch++) { int wc = (int)(want >> (8 * ch) & 255);
                if (abs((int)got[ch] - wc) > 1) MDIE("cube-merge probe: cube %d level %d face %d pixel %d,%d channel %d = %u, expected %d", c, lv, f, p % sz, p / sz, ch, got[ch], wc);
                checked++; } } }
    uint64_t st[4]; mtl_cube_merge_stats(st);
    MLOG("cube-merge probe: %d pixel channels right; temps %d sets; %llu kernel copies and %llu blit copies in this probe (cube 5 is not shader-writable: its groups' copy-out blits)", checked, g_cg.ntemps, (unsigned long long)g_cg.kcopies, (unsigned long long)g_cg.copies);
    memset(&R, 0, sizeof R); state_reset(); g_cg_probe_neg = 0;
    serial_del(p1.serial); serial_del(ot.serial); for (int c = 0; c < CGP_N; c++) serial_del(ct[c].serial);
    for (int c = 0; c < CGP_N; c++) { defer_obj_release(rb[c]); defer_obj_release(cubes[c]); } defer_obj_release(other);
    return checked + 6 * 5;
}

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/nvn_depth_clear.h`:

```h
/* Match a D16 attachment load-clear to a fragment's depth conversion.
 * Metal's load-clear truncates on Apple GPUs, while a fragment write rounds.
 * In particular 0.5 clears to 32767 but a fragment writes 32768. An EQUAL
 * classification pass then exposes its coarse tile boundaries.
 * Pick the nearest D16 value, then a point inside both its truncation and
 * rounding bins. Dividing by 65535 alone can round below the integer when
 * Metal converts the descriptor value to float, so keep a quarter-unit margin.
 * Other depth formats and fragment-based masked clears do not need this. */
#pragma once
#include <math.h>

static inline double nvn_depth16_clear_value(double depth) {
    if (!isfinite(depth) || depth <= 0.0 || depth >= 1.0) return depth;
    double q = round(depth * 65535.0);
    return q >= 65535.0 ? 1.0 : (q + 0.25) / 65535.0;
}

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/nvn_diag_range.h`:

```h
#ifndef NVN_DIAG_RANGE_H
#define NVN_DIAG_RANGE_H
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <sched.h>

typedef struct { long lo, hi; } nvn_diag_range_value;
typedef struct { _Atomic int ready; nvn_diag_range_value value; } nvn_diag_range_cache;

static inline nvn_diag_range_value nvn_diag_range_parse(const char *text) {
    nvn_diag_range_value v = {-2, -2};
    if (!text || sscanf(text, "%ld-%ld", &v.lo, &v.hi) != 2) v.lo = v.hi = -2;
    return v;
}

/* The immutable environment range is published once to all recording threads.
   Legacy mode intentionally repeats the disabled-range lookup for in-process A/B.
   The old lo < 0 initialization test also matched its initialized -2 sentinel. */
static inline nvn_diag_range_value nvn_diag_range_get(nvn_diag_range_cache *c,
        int cache_disabled, const char *(*read_env)(void)) {
    if (atomic_load_explicit(&c->ready, memory_order_acquire) != 2) {
        int initial = 0;
        if (atomic_compare_exchange_strong_explicit(&c->ready, &initial, 1,
                memory_order_acq_rel, memory_order_acquire)) {
            c->value = nvn_diag_range_parse(read_env());
            atomic_store_explicit(&c->ready, 2, memory_order_release);
        } else {
            while (atomic_load_explicit(&c->ready, memory_order_acquire) != 2) sched_yield();
        }
    }
    return !cache_disabled && c->value.lo < 0 ? nvn_diag_range_parse(read_env()) : c->value;
}
#endif

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/nvn_dirty.c`:

```c
// 客体内存写保护脏页跟踪：预排布贴图（CPU 写、GPU 读）的池页上传后设只读，游戏一写即缺页 → 标脏、解保护；
// 使用前查覆盖页的写代号，比上传时新就重传。NVN 语义：贴图描述符指向池内存，GPU 每次读的是当前内容
// （实测游戏会把流式素材写进仍被采样的贴图存储，不重新登记）。
// 信号处理约束：缺页路径只用原子操作与 mprotect，不分配、不加锁。
// Write-protect dirty-page tracking for guest memory: pool pages of packaged textures (CPU writes, GPU reads) are set read-only after upload, and as soon as the game writes it faults -> mark dirty, unprotect;
// before use, check the write generation of the covered pages and re-upload if newer than at upload time. NVN semantics: a texture descriptor points to pool memory, and the GPU reads the current content every time
// (measured: the game writes streamed assets into texture storage that is still being sampled, without re-registering).
// Signal handler constraint: the page-fault path uses only atomic operations and mprotect, no allocation, no locks.
#include "nvn_dirty.h"
#include "../../host/dm.h"
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <mach/mach_time.h>
#include <sched.h>

// 页状态与 mprotect 的次序（改保护的一方先把状态改成 BUSY，mprotect 落地后才改成终态；别的线程见 BUSY 就等）：
//   设只读：NONE → BUSY → mprotect(只读) → PROT；解保护：PROT → BUSY → mprotect(可写) → NONE。
// 不变式：状态是 NONE 的页一定可写、是 PROT 的页一定只读。原先设只读是「先记 PROT、攒一段再 mprotect」，这段时间里另一线程的写前解保护
// 会把状态改回 NONE，随后攒批的 mprotect 落地 ⇒ 页只读而状态 NONE：游戏线程写它时缺页处理只回「重执行」永远空转；
// 宿主用系统调用往里读文件时 prep_write 看状态 NONE 跳过，系统调用不走缺页处理，直接 EFAULT、数据读不全。
// BUSY 最长持续 = 一次 mprotect 的时间（设只读时再加上给这一段逐页改状态的几次原子写）。等待有上限 BUSY_WAIT_MS，超限报红：
// 缺页处理里超限按「不是我们的页」返回，交给崩溃处理如实报崩，不静默空转。等待只读原子量、不拿任何锁。
// Order of page state and mprotect (the side changing protection first sets the state to BUSY and sets the final state only after mprotect has landed; other threads wait when they see BUSY):
//   set read-only: NONE -> BUSY -> mprotect(read-only) -> PROT; unprotect: PROT -> BUSY -> mprotect(writable) -> NONE.
// Invariant: a page whose state is NONE is always writable, and one whose state is PROT is always read-only. Setting read-only used to be "record PROT first, batch up a run, then mprotect"; during that time another thread's unprotect-before-write
// could set the state back to NONE, and then the batched mprotect landed => the page read-only with state NONE: when the game thread wrote to it the page-fault handler only returned "re-execute" and spun forever;
// when the host read a file into it with a system call, prep_write saw state NONE and skipped, the system call did not go through the page-fault handler and failed with EFAULT, leaving the data incomplete.
// BUSY lasts at most one mprotect (plus, when setting read-only, the few atomic writes that change the state of the pages in the run). The wait has an upper limit BUSY_WAIT_MS and reports red beyond it:
// in the page-fault handler, exceeding it returns "not our page" and lets the crash handler report the crash truthfully instead of spinning silently. The wait only reads atomics and takes no lock.
enum { PG_NONE = 0, PG_PROT = 1, PG_BUSY = 2 };
enum { BUSY_WAIT_MS = 2000 };
// 跟踪区间 = 各内存池（MemoryPoolInitialize 登记）。池销毁后复用 live=0 的槽，信号处理里无锁扫描。
// Tracked ranges = the memory pools (registered by MemoryPoolInitialize). After a pool is destroyed its live=0 slot is reused; the signal handler scans without locks.
#define MAX_RANGE 16384 // 原为 256：内存池多于它时超出的池不跟踪，里面的贴图每次取用都当成脏的重传（暗黑实测峰值见内存读数行的「内存池」；塞尔达约 300 个，踩过）。扫描只到已用的槽数，容量大不增加开销 | was 256: with more memory pools than that the excess pools are untracked and their textures are treated as dirty and re-uploaded on every use (for Diablo's measured peak see "memory pools" in the memory readout line; Zelda has about 300 and hit this). The scan only covers slots in use, so a larger capacity costs nothing. TOTK (2026-10-17): 4096 was full in the user's own games and most long test games (about 3,900 live pools in the world, more when moving between regions); now 16384
typedef struct { uintptr_t base, end; _Atomic uint8_t *state; _Atomic uint64_t *gen; size_t cap; _Atomic int live; _Atomic uint64_t latest; } range_t;   // latest (TOTK): highest page generation in the range
static range_t g_r[MAX_RANGE];
static _Atomic int g_nr;
static uintptr_t g_pg, g_shift;
static _Atomic uint64_t g_now = 1;
static _Atomic uint64_t g_faults, g_preps;
static _Atomic uint64_t g_adds_total;
static _Atomic int g_live, g_live_peak;   // 在册的池数与峰值（内存读数行用） | number of registered pools and peak (for the memory readout line)
void nvn_dirty_stat(int *live, int *peak, int *cap) { *live = atomic_load(&g_live); *peak = atomic_load(&g_live_peak); *cap = MAX_RANGE; }
static _Atomic int g_overflow_logged;
static pthread_mutex_t g_slot_mu = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;   // 建池 / 销池（客体线程，可能并发）互斥选槽；缺页处理路径不碰它 | Pool creation / destruction (guest threads, possibly concurrent) pick slots under a mutex; the page-fault handling path does not touch it
static _Atomic uint64_t g_mp_calls, g_mp_pages, g_mp_ticks;   // 本模块的 mprotect：调用次数、覆盖页数、耗时（mach 时基，缺页路径里也安全） | This module's mprotect: call count, pages covered, time spent (mach timebase, safe in the page-fault path too)
static void mp(uintptr_t a, size_t len, int prot) {
    uint64_t t = mach_absolute_time(); mprotect((void *)a, len, prot);
    atomic_fetch_add(&g_mp_ticks, mach_absolute_time() - t); atomic_fetch_add(&g_mp_calls, 1); atomic_fetch_add(&g_mp_pages, len >> g_shift);
}

static mach_timebase_info_data_t g_tb;   // 首次登记池时取好（缺页路径里只做乘除） | Obtained when a pool is first registered (the fault path only multiplies and divides)
static _Atomic int g_busy_red;
// 等这一页离开 BUSY。返回 1 = 已离开；0 = 等过了上限（报红一次）。信号处理里可用：只有原子读、mach_absolute_time、sched_yield
// Wait for this page to leave BUSY. Returns 1 = it has left; 0 = waited past the limit (reported red once). Usable in a signal handler: only atomic reads, mach_absolute_time and sched_yield
static int busy_wait(range_t *r, uintptr_t p) {
    uint64_t t0 = 0;
    for (unsigned n = 1; atomic_load(&r->state[p]) == PG_BUSY; n++) {
        if (n & 0x3ff) continue;
        uint64_t now = mach_absolute_time(); if (!t0) t0 = now;
        if ((now - t0) * g_tb.numer / g_tb.denom > (uint64_t)BUSY_WAIT_MS * 1000000ull) {
            if (!atomic_exchange(&g_busy_red, 1)) LOG("【红】脏页跟踪：页 %p 停在「忙」超过 %d 毫秒（改保护的线程没走完），不再等", (void *)(r->base + (p << g_shift)), BUSY_WAIT_MS);
            return 0; }
        sched_yield();
    }
    return 1;
}
static range_t *find(uintptr_t a) {
    /* TOTK: the replay asks about the same few pools over and over; the last hits per thread (8, round robin) are checked
       first (a slot reused for another pool fails the bounds or live test and falls through to the scan), so the scan over
       the ~4,000 live pools of the world mostly runs for the first touch of a pool. */
    static __thread range_t *recent[8]; static __thread unsigned next;
    for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) {
        range_t *l = recent[k];
        if (l && atomic_load_explicit(&l->live, memory_order_acquire) && a >= l->base && a < l->end) return l;
    }
    int n = atomic_load(&g_nr);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if (atomic_load_explicit(&g_r[i].live, memory_order_acquire) && a >= g_r[i].base && a < g_r[i].end) { recent[next++ & 7] = &g_r[i]; return &g_r[i]; }
    return NULL;
}
/* TOTK diagnostic (on with DM_NVN_TILELOG): a ring of the latest page unprotections with the writer, read by
   nvn_dirty_recent: game writes (fault: pc / lr of the faulting code) and host writes (dm_guest_write_prepare caller). */
#include <sys/ucontext.h>
static nvn_dirty_rec g_drec[4096]; static _Atomic uint64_t g_drec_n; static int g_drec_on;
uint64_t dm_host_write_pc;   // set by dm_guest_write_prepare (runtime/gfx_bridge.c) before calling prep_write
static void drec_add(uintptr_t page, uint64_t pc, uint64_t lr, uint32_t src) {
    if (!g_drec_on) return;
    uint64_t i = atomic_fetch_add(&g_drec_n, 1) % 4096; g_drec[i] = (nvn_dirty_rec){ page, pc, lr, src };
}
int nvn_dirty_recent(uintptr_t lo, uintptr_t hi, nvn_dirty_rec *out, int max) {
    uint64_t n = atomic_load(&g_drec_n); int k = 0;
    for (uint64_t j = n > 4096 ? n - 4096 : 0; j < n && k < max; j++) { nvn_dirty_rec r = g_drec[j % 4096]; if (r.page >= lo && r.page < hi) out[k++] = r; }
    return k;
}
static void unprotect_page(range_t *r, uintptr_t p) {   // 调用方已把状态从 PROT 改成 BUSY | The caller has already changed the state from PROT to BUSY
    mp(r->base + (p << g_shift), g_pg, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE);
    uint64_t g = atomic_fetch_add(&g_now, 1) + 1, l = atomic_load(&r->latest);
    atomic_store(&r->gen[p], g);
    while (l < g && !atomic_compare_exchange_weak(&r->latest, &l, g)) {}
    /* TOTK (#90): "now" moves on once more after the page's generation is stored. A checker that read "now" between the
       first step and the stores found the page clean and kept that "now" as its last look (tex_mtl's now == seen); the page
       is writable from here on, so without a newer "now" every later write went unseen until something else faulted. */
    atomic_fetch_add(&g_now, 1);
    atomic_store(&r->state[p], PG_NONE);
}
static int on_fault(void *addr, int is_write, void *uc) {
    (void)uc;
    range_t *r = is_write ? find((uintptr_t)addr) : NULL;
    if (!r) return 0;
    uintptr_t p = ((uintptr_t)addr - r->base) >> g_shift;
    uint8_t st = PG_PROT;
    if (atomic_compare_exchange_strong(&r->state[p], &st, PG_BUSY)) { unprotect_page(r, p); atomic_fetch_add(&g_faults, 1);
        if (g_drec_on && uc) { _STRUCT_MCONTEXT64 *mc = ((ucontext_t *)uc)->uc_mcontext; drec_add(r->base + (p << g_shift), mc->__ss.__pc, mc->__ss.__lr, 0); }
        return 1; }
    if (st == PG_BUSY) return busy_wait(r, p);   // 别的线程正在改这页的保护：等它改完重执行（改成了只读就再缺页一次、走上面那一支） | Another thread is changing this page's protection: wait for it to finish and re-execute (if it became read-only, it faults once more and takes the branch above)
    return atomic_load(&r->gen[p]) != 0;   // 刚被别的线程解掉（本次缺页发生在解之前）：重执行；从未保护过的页不是我们的 | Just unprotected by another thread (this fault happened before the unprotect): re-execute; pages that were never protected are not ours
}
static void prep_write(void *addr, size_t len) {
    uintptr_t a = (uintptr_t)addr, e = a + len;
    while (len && a < e) {
        range_t *r = find(a);
        if (!r) { a = (a + g_pg) & ~(g_pg - 1); continue; }
        uintptr_t stop = e < r->end ? e : r->end;
        for (uintptr_t p = (a - r->base) >> g_shift, q = (stop - 1 - r->base) >> g_shift; p <= q; p++) {
            for (;;) { uint8_t st = PG_PROT;   // 见 BUSY 等完要重看：对方可能是在设只读，等完这页是 PROT，照样得解 | After waiting out BUSY, look again: the other side may have been setting read-only, in which case the page is PROT after the wait and still has to be unprotected
                if (atomic_compare_exchange_strong(&r->state[p], &st, PG_BUSY)) { unprotect_page(r, p); atomic_fetch_add(&g_preps, 1); drec_add(r->base + (p << g_shift), dm_host_write_pc, 0, 1); break; }
                if (st != PG_BUSY || !busy_wait(r, p)) break; }
        }
        a = stop;
    }
}

/* Writes on behalf of the GPU (a rendering written back into CPU-visible memory): the bytes change without counting as
   a CPU write. Protected pages are taken to BUSY (a guest write meanwhile waits in the fault handler, then faults again
   and is recorded as usual), made writable, and protected again by nvn_dirty_gpu_write_end with their generation kept.
   Pages already unprotected are left as they are. Returns a token for nvn_dirty_gpu_write_end (NULL: nothing tracked). */
typedef struct { range_t *r; uintptr_t p0, p1; uint8_t *was; } gpu_write_tok;
void *nvn_dirty_gpu_write_begin(void *addr, size_t len) {
    if (!len) return NULL;
    range_t *r = find((uintptr_t)addr); if (!r || (uintptr_t)addr + len > r->end) return NULL;
    uintptr_t a = (uintptr_t)addr, p0 = (a - r->base) >> g_shift, p1 = (a + len - 1 - r->base) >> g_shift;
    gpu_write_tok *t = malloc(sizeof *t); uint8_t *was = calloc(p1 - p0 + 1, 1); if (!t || !was) { free(t); free(was); return NULL; }
    *t = (gpu_write_tok){ r, p0, p1, was };
    for (uintptr_t p = p0; p <= p1; p++) {
        for (;;) { uint8_t st = PG_PROT;
            if (atomic_compare_exchange_strong(&r->state[p], &st, PG_BUSY)) { mp(r->base + (p << g_shift), g_pg, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE); was[p - p0] = 1; break; }
            if (st != PG_BUSY || !busy_wait(r, p)) break; }
    }
    return t;
}
void nvn_dirty_gpu_write_end(void *tok) {
    gpu_write_tok *t = tok; if (!t) return;
    for (uintptr_t p = t->p0; p <= t->p1; p++) if (t->was[p - t->p0]) { mp(t->r->base + (p << g_shift), g_pg, PROT_READ); atomic_store(&t->r->state[p], PG_PROT); }
    free(t->was); free(t);
}

void nvn_dirty_add_range(const void *mem, size_t size) {
    static int inited;
    if (!inited) { inited = 1; g_pg = (uintptr_t)getpagesize(); g_shift = __builtin_ctzl(g_pg); mach_timebase_info(&g_tb); dm_fault_hook_register(on_fault); dm_guest_write_prep_register(prep_write); g_drec_on = getenv("DM_NVN_TILELOG") != NULL; }
    atomic_fetch_add(&g_adds_total, 1);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_slot_mu);
    int n = atomic_load(&g_nr);
    int slot = -1;
    {   /* TOTK: a pool created over memory that another live pool already covers must not get a second tracking range: find() returns
           the first live range for an address, so a fault on a page protected under the older range would be looked up in the newer one
           (state NONE, generation 0) and reported as a crash. Inside an existing range the pages are tracked already; any other overlap
           leaves the new pool untracked (its textures are treated as always dirty, which is safe). */
        uintptr_t nb = (uintptr_t)mem & ~(g_pg - 1), ne = ((uintptr_t)mem + size + g_pg - 1) & ~(g_pg - 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (!atomic_load_explicit(&g_r[i].live, memory_order_acquire) || ne <= g_r[i].base || nb >= g_r[i].end) continue;
            static _Atomic int said; int expected = 0;
            if (atomic_compare_exchange_strong(&said, &expected, 1))
                LOG("脏页跟踪：池 %p+%#zx 与已跟踪区间 %#lx-%#lx 重叠，%s", mem, size, (unsigned long)g_r[i].base, (unsigned long)g_r[i].end,
                    nb >= g_r[i].base && ne <= g_r[i].end ? "已由该区间跟踪" : "不另行跟踪");
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_slot_mu); return;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if (!atomic_load_explicit(&g_r[i].live, memory_order_acquire)) { slot = i; break; }
    if (slot < 0) {
        if (n >= MAX_RANGE) {
            int expected = 0;
            if (atomic_compare_exchange_strong(&g_overflow_logged, &expected, 1)) LOG("【红】脏页跟踪区间已满（%d），池 %p 不跟踪", MAX_RANGE, mem);
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_slot_mu); return;
        }
        slot = n;
    }
    { int lv = atomic_fetch_add(&g_live, 1) + 1, pk = atomic_load(&g_live_peak); while (lv > pk && !atomic_compare_exchange_weak(&g_live_peak, &pk, lv)) {} }
    range_t *r = &g_r[slot];
    uintptr_t base = (uintptr_t)mem & ~(g_pg - 1), end = ((uintptr_t)mem + size + g_pg - 1) & ~(g_pg - 1);
    size_t np = (end - base) >> g_shift;
    _Atomic uint8_t *state = r->state;
    _Atomic uint64_t *gen = r->gen;
    if (r->cap < np) {
        state = calloc(np, 1); gen = calloc(np, sizeof *gen);
        if (!state || !gen) die("脏页表分配失败（%zu 页）", np);
        // 旧数组不 free：信号处理里可能仍有极短暂的陈旧读者，泄漏量 = 每页 9 字节。
        // The old array is not freed: the signal handler may still have a very brief stale reader; leak = 9 bytes per page.
        r->cap = np;
    } else {
        memset((void *)state, 0, np); memset((void *)gen, 0, np * sizeof *gen);
    }
    r->base = base; r->end = end; r->state = state; r->gen = gen; atomic_store(&r->latest, 0);
    if (slot == n) atomic_store(&g_nr, n + 1);
    atomic_store_explicit(&r->live, 1, memory_order_release);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_slot_mu);
}
// 池销毁：先把仍受保护的页还原成可写（池内存归还游戏后可能另作他用），再标失效
// Pool destruction: first restore still-protected pages to writable (the pool memory may be reused for something else once returned to the game), then mark invalid
void nvn_dirty_remove_range(const void *mem) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_slot_mu);
    range_t *r = find((uintptr_t)mem);
    if (r) { prep_write((void *)r->base, r->end - r->base); atomic_store_explicit(&r->live, 0, memory_order_release); atomic_fetch_sub(&g_live, 1); }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_slot_mu);
}
int nvn_dirty_tracked(const void *addr, size_t len) {
    range_t *r = find((uintptr_t)addr); return r && (uintptr_t)addr + len <= r->end;
}
// 设只读：先把页标成 BUSY，mprotect 落地后才标 PROT（次序与不变式见文件头的状态说明）
// Set read-only: mark the page BUSY first, and mark it PROT only after mprotect has landed (for the order and the invariant see the state notes at the top of the file)
void nvn_dirty_protect(const void *addr, size_t len) {
    if (!len || !nvn_dirty_tracked(addr, len)) return;
    range_t *r = find((uintptr_t)addr);
    uintptr_t a = (uintptr_t)addr, p = (a - r->base) >> g_shift, q = (a + len - 1 - r->base) >> g_shift;
    // 连续置成 PROT 的页合成一次 mprotect（逐页调用在首传大贴图时一帧上千次；选角页启动帧 5：4888 次）。
    // 已是 PROT / BUSY 的页断开连续段：不重复保护，也不碰别的线程正在改的页
    // Consecutive pages set to PROT are merged into one mprotect (per-page calls ran to over a thousand per frame when large textures were first uploaded; character select, startup frame 5: 4888 calls).
    // Pages already PROT / BUSY break a run: they are not protected again, and pages another thread is changing are left alone
    // TOTK (#90): a BUSY page is waited out (the run so far is protected first, so nothing of ours is BUSY meanwhile) and
    // looked at again. An unprotect in progress leaves the page writable with a generation the caller's stamp may already
    // cover: skipped, later writes to it never faulted and the texture stayed stale (letters missing in the glyph cache).
    uintptr_t run = 0; int open = 0;
    for (uintptr_t i = p; i <= q + 1; i++) {
        uint8_t st = PG_NONE;
        int took = i <= q && atomic_compare_exchange_strong(&r->state[i], &st, PG_BUSY);
        if (took && !open) { run = i; open = 1; }
        if (!took && open) { mp(r->base + (run << g_shift), (i - run) << g_shift, PROT_READ); for (uintptr_t k = run; k < i; k++) atomic_store(&r->state[k], PG_PROT); open = 0; }
        if (!took && st == PG_BUSY && busy_wait(r, i)) i--;   // this page again
    }
}
uint64_t nvn_dirty_now(void) { return atomic_load(&g_now); }
int nvn_dirty_since(const void *addr, size_t len, uint64_t stamp) {
    if (!len) return 0;
    if (!nvn_dirty_tracked(addr, len)) return 1;   // 未跟踪时保守视为脏，宁可多传也不显示旧内容 | When untracked, conservatively treat as dirty: better to upload more than to show stale content
    range_t *r = find((uintptr_t)addr);
    if (atomic_load(&r->latest) <= stamp) return 0;   // TOTK: nothing in the whole pool was written since the stamp (no per-page scan)
    uintptr_t a = (uintptr_t)addr, p = (a - r->base) >> g_shift, q = (a + len - 1 - r->base) >> g_shift;
    for (uintptr_t i = p; i <= q; i++) if (atomic_load(&r->gen[i]) > stamp) return 1;   // 上传前最后一次写的代号 ≤ 戳；之后的写必 > 戳 | The generation of the last write before upload is <= the stamp; any later write must be > the stamp
    return 0;
}
void nvn_dirty_slot_stats(int *live, int *used_slots, uint64_t *adds_total) {
    int n = atomic_load(&g_nr), active = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) active += atomic_load_explicit(&g_r[i].live, memory_order_acquire) != 0;
    *live = active; *used_slots = n; *adds_total = atomic_load(&g_adds_total);
}
void nvn_dirty_stats(uint64_t *faults, uint64_t *preps) { *faults = atomic_load(&g_faults); *preps = atomic_load(&g_preps); }
void nvn_dirty_mp_stats(uint64_t *calls, uint64_t *pages, uint64_t *ns) {
    static mach_timebase_info_data_t tb; if (!tb.denom) mach_timebase_info(&tb);
    *calls = atomic_load(&g_mp_calls); *pages = atomic_load(&g_mp_pages); *ns = atomic_load(&g_mp_ticks) * tb.numer / tb.denom;
}

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/nvn_encode_fifo.h`:

```h
#ifndef NVN_ENCODE_FIFO_H
#define NVN_ENCODE_FIFO_H
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>

/* One producer, one consumer. Neither side reuses a slot until the other
   publishes ownership. Reset only with both threads outside the queue. */
enum { NVN_ENCODE_FIFO_CAP = 4096 };   /* 2026-10-16: 512 filled about 210 times per submission in the world (A then waits for B); 4096 absorbs the bursts */
typedef struct { uint64_t op, u[8]; } nvn_encode_packet;
typedef struct {
    _Alignas(64) _Atomic uint64_t published;
    _Alignas(64) _Atomic uint64_t consumed;
    _Alignas(64) uint64_t produced, cached_consumed;
    _Alignas(64) uint64_t read, cached_published;
    _Alignas(64) nvn_encode_packet packets[NVN_ENCODE_FIFO_CAP];
} nvn_encode_fifo;
static inline void nvn_encode_fifo_reset(nvn_encode_fifo *q) {
    atomic_store_explicit(&q->published, 0, memory_order_relaxed);
    atomic_store_explicit(&q->consumed, 0, memory_order_relaxed);
    q->produced = q->cached_consumed = q->read = q->cached_published = 0;
}
static inline int nvn_encode_fifo_push(nvn_encode_fifo *q, const nvn_encode_packet *p) {
    if (q->produced - q->cached_consumed == NVN_ENCODE_FIFO_CAP) {
        q->cached_consumed = atomic_load_explicit(&q->consumed, memory_order_acquire);
        if (q->produced - q->cached_consumed == NVN_ENCODE_FIFO_CAP) return 0;
    }
    q->packets[q->produced++ & (NVN_ENCODE_FIFO_CAP - 1)] = *p;
    return 1;
}
static inline void nvn_encode_fifo_publish(nvn_encode_fifo *q) {
    atomic_store_explicit(&q->published, q->produced, memory_order_release);
}
static inline const nvn_encode_packet *nvn_encode_fifo_peek(nvn_encode_fifo *q) {
    if (q->read == q->cached_published) {
        q->cached_published = atomic_load_explicit(&q->published, memory_order_acquire);
        if (q->read == q->cached_published) return NULL;
    }
    return &q->packets[q->read & (NVN_ENCODE_FIFO_CAP - 1)];
}
static inline void nvn_encode_fifo_consume(nvn_encode_fifo *q) {
    atomic_store_explicit(&q->consumed, ++q->read, memory_order_release);
}
#endif

    .arch_extension lse
// 未实现 NVN 函数的公共入口：跳板进来时 x16 = 本函数的槽地址（nvn_slot[i]）。
// 调 nvn_unimpl_c(slot, x0, x1, x2) 报红记名，返回 0。
// Common entry for unimplemented NVN functions: when the thunk comes in, x16 = this function's slot address (nvn_slot[i]).
// Calls nvn_unimpl_c(slot, x0, x1, x2) to report a failure and log the name, returns 0.
    .text
    .globl _nvn_unimpl_entry
    .p2align 2
_nvn_unimpl_entry:
    stp x29, x30, [sp, #-16]!
    mov x29, sp
    mov x3, x2
    mov x2, x1
    mov x1, x0
    mov x0, x16
    bl _nvn_unimpl_c
    ldp x29, x30, [sp], #16
    ret

// 计时包装入口（DM_NVN_PROF=1 时槽表指向这里）：跳板进来时 x16 = 本函数槽地址。
// 保存 x0-x7 / q0-q7（NVN 函数无栈传参，生成器已核），取 mach_absolute_time → 调真实现（nvn_real[i]）→ 再取，
// 差值原子累加到 nvn_prof_ticks[i]（mach 时基单位）；返回值 x0/x1、q0-q3 原样带回。
// 不用 cntvct_el0：本机实测它与系统时基不成固定比例（cntfrq 报 1 GHz，同区间增量比 98.9），不能换算成时间。
// Timing wrapper entry (the slot table points here when DM_NVN_PROF=1): when the thunk comes in, x16 = this function's slot address.
// Save x0-x7 / q0-q7 (NVN functions pass no arguments on the stack, verified by the generator), take mach_absolute_time -> call the real implementation (nvn_real[i]) -> take it again,
// atomically add the difference to nvn_prof_ticks[i] (mach timebase units); return values x0/x1, q0-q3 are passed back unchanged.
// cntvct_el0 is not used: measured on this machine it is not in a fixed ratio to the system timebase (cntfrq reports 1 GHz, increment ratio over the same interval 98.9), so it cannot be converted to time.
    .globl _nvn_prof_entry
    .p2align 2
_nvn_prof_entry:
    sub sp, sp, #240
    stp x29, x30, [sp]
    mov x29, sp
    stp x0, x1, [sp, #16]
    stp x2, x3, [sp, #32]
    stp x4, x5, [sp, #48]
    stp x6, x7, [sp, #64]
    stp q0, q1, [sp, #96]
    stp q2, q3, [sp, #128]
    stp q4, q5, [sp, #160]
    stp q6, q7, [sp, #192]
    adrp x9, _nvn_slot@PAGE
    add x9, x9, _nvn_slot@PAGEOFF
    sub x16, x16, x9
    lsr x16, x16, #4                 // 槽号 i | Slot index i
    str x16, [sp, #80]
    bl _mach_absolute_time
    str x0, [sp, #88]
    ldr x16, [sp, #80]
    adrp x9, _nvn_real@PAGE
    add x9, x9, _nvn_real@PAGEOFF
    ldr x17, [x9, x16, lsl #3]
    ldp x0, x1, [sp, #16]
    ldp x2, x3, [sp, #32]
    ldp x4, x5, [sp, #48]
    ldp x6, x7, [sp, #64]
    ldp q0, q1, [sp, #96]
    ldp q2, q3, [sp, #128]
    ldp q4, q5, [sp, #160]
    ldp q6, q7, [sp, #192]
    blr x17
    stp x0, x1, [sp, #16]
    stp q0, q1, [sp, #96]
    stp q2, q3, [sp, #128]
    bl _mach_absolute_time
    mov x9, x0
    ldr x10, [sp, #88]
    sub x9, x9, x10
    ldr x16, [sp, #80]
    adrp x10, _nvn_prof_ticks@PAGE
    add x10, x10, _nvn_prof_ticks@PAGEOFF
    add x10, x10, x16, lsl #3
    stadd x9, [x10]
    ldp x0, x1, [sp, #16]
    ldp q0, q1, [sp, #96]
    ldp q2, q3, [sp, #128]
    ldp x29, x30, [sp]
    add sp, sp, #240
    ret

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/nvn_hmap.h`:

```h
// 定长字节键 → 指针 的开放寻址哈希表（线性探测 + 删除时回移，无墓碑）。
// 回放热路径用它替代 NSDictionary：键不装箱、不分配，查找只做一次哈希 + memcmp。
// 不加锁：调用方按各自的锁保护。值的所有权归调用方（put / del 返回被替换 / 删除的旧值）。单测 tests/t_hmap.c。
// Open-addressing hash table from fixed-length byte keys -> pointers (linear probing + backward shift on deletion, no tombstones).
// The replay hot path uses it instead of NSDictionary: keys are not boxed, no allocation, a lookup does only one hash + memcmp.
// No locking: callers protect it with their own locks. Ownership of values belongs to the caller (put / del return the replaced / deleted old value). Unit test tests/t_hmap.c.
#pragma once
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

typedef struct { uint8_t *keys; void **vals; uint32_t klen, cap, n; } nvn_hmap;   // vals[i] == NULL 即空位 | vals[i] == NULL means an empty slot

static inline uint64_t nvn_hm_hash(const void *k, uint32_t len) {
    const uint8_t *p = k; uint64_t h = 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ull ^ len;
    for (; len >= 8; p += 8, len -= 8) { uint64_t w; memcpy(&w, p, 8); h = (h ^ w) * 0xff51afd7ed558ccdull; h ^= h >> 32; }
    if (len) { uint64_t w = 0; memcpy(&w, p, len); h = (h ^ w) * 0xff51afd7ed558ccdull; }
    h ^= h >> 33; h *= 0xc4ceb9fe1a85ec53ull; h ^= h >> 33;
    return h;
}
static inline void nvn_hm_init(nvn_hmap *m, uint32_t klen) { memset(m, 0, sizeof *m); m->klen = klen; }
static inline void *nvn_hm_get(const nvn_hmap *m, const void *k) {
    if (!m->n) return NULL;
    for (uint32_t i = (uint32_t)nvn_hm_hash(k, m->klen) & (m->cap - 1);; i = (i + 1) & (m->cap - 1)) {
        if (!m->vals[i]) return NULL;
        if (!memcmp(m->keys + (size_t)i * m->klen, k, m->klen)) return m->vals[i];
    }
}
static inline void *nvn_hm_put(nvn_hmap *m, const void *k, void *v);
static inline void nvn_hm_grow(nvn_hmap *m) {
    nvn_hmap o = *m;
    m->cap = o.cap ? o.cap * 2 : 64; m->n = 0;
    m->keys = malloc((size_t)m->cap * m->klen); m->vals = calloc(m->cap, sizeof *m->vals);
    if (!m->keys || !m->vals) abort();
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < o.cap; i++) if (o.vals[i]) nvn_hm_put(m, o.keys + (size_t)i * o.klen, o.vals[i]);
    free(o.keys); free(o.vals);
}
// v 不得为 NULL；返回同键的旧值（无则 NULL）
// v must not be NULL; returns the old value for the same key (NULL if none)
static inline void *nvn_hm_put(nvn_hmap *m, const void *k, void *v) {
    if ((m->n + 1) * 4 > m->cap * 3) nvn_hm_grow(m);   // 装载率 ≤ 3/4 | Load factor <= 3/4
    for (uint32_t i = (uint32_t)nvn_hm_hash(k, m->klen) & (m->cap - 1);; i = (i + 1) & (m->cap - 1)) {
        uint8_t *ki = m->keys + (size_t)i * m->klen;
        if (!m->vals[i]) { memcpy(ki, k, m->klen); m->vals[i] = v; m->n++; return NULL; }
        if (!memcmp(ki, k, m->klen)) { void *old = m->vals[i]; m->vals[i] = v; return old; }
    }
}
// 删除后把同一探测链上后面的项回移补洞，保证查找遇空位即可停
// After deletion, shift back later entries on the same probe chain to fill the hole, so that a lookup can stop at the first empty slot
static inline void *nvn_hm_del(nvn_hmap *m, const void *k) {
    if (!m->n) return NULL;
    uint32_t mask = m->cap - 1, i = (uint32_t)nvn_hm_hash(k, m->klen) & mask;
    for (;; i = (i + 1) & mask) {
        if (!m->vals[i]) return NULL;
        if (!memcmp(m->keys + (size_t)i * m->klen, k, m->klen)) break;
    }
    void *old = m->vals[i];
    for (uint32_t j = i;;) {
        m->vals[i] = NULL;
        for (;;) {
            j = (j + 1) & mask;
            if (!m->vals[j]) { m->n--; return old; }
            uint32_t h = (uint32_t)nvn_hm_hash(m->keys + (size_t)j * m->klen, m->klen) & mask;
            if (i <= j ? (i < h && h <= j) : (i < h || h <= j)) continue;   // 理想位在 (i, j] 内：不能前移 | Ideal position is within (i, j]: cannot move forward
            break;
        }
        memcpy(m->keys + (size_t)i * m->klen, m->keys + (size_t)j * m->klen, m->klen); m->vals[i] = m->vals[j];
        i = j;
    }
}
// 清空；rel 非空时对每个值调用一次（释放所有权）
// Clear; when rel is non-null, call it once for each value (releasing ownership)
static inline void nvn_hm_clear(nvn_hmap *m, void (*rel)(void *)) {
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < m->cap; i++) if (m->vals[i]) { if (rel) rel(m->vals[i]); m->vals[i] = NULL; }
    m->n = 0;
}

// NVN implementation registration macros shared by hle_nvn.c and TOTK extension files.
#pragma once
#include "nvn_protos.h"

// TOTK: NVN entry points that wait for the GPU, the display or other threads give up the caller's virtual core for
// their duration (runtime/threads.c), as the Horizon thread would block there.
int runtime_core_away(void);
void runtime_core_back(int *away);
#define NVN_BLOCKING() __attribute__((cleanup(runtime_core_back))) int totk_core_away_ = runtime_core_away()

typedef struct { const char *name; void *fn; } nvn_impl;
#define NVN(name, ret, ...)                                                                       \
    static ret h_##name(__VA_ARGS__);                                                             \
    static const NVNT_##name chk_##name __attribute__((unused)) = h_##name;                       \
    __attribute__((used, section("__DATA,swnvn"))) static const nvn_impl e_##name = {#name, (void *)h_##name}; \
    static ret h_##name(__VA_ARGS__)
// 无原型的新版接口：不做签名检查
// Newer interfaces without prototypes: no signature check
#define NVN_NOPROTO(name, ret, ...)                                                               \
    static ret h_##name(__VA_ARGS__);                                                             \
    __attribute__((used, section("__DATA,swnvn"))) static const nvn_impl e_##name = {#name, (void *)h_##name}; \
    static ret h_##name(__VA_ARGS__)


// TOTK: entry points the game asks nvnDeviceGetProcAddress / nvnBootstrapLoader for that are not in main's
// name table (no counting thunk). They are returned directly by nvn_lookup.
#define NVN_EXTRA(name, ret, ...)                                                                 \
    static ret x_##name(__VA_ARGS__);                                                             \
    __attribute__((used, section("__DATA,totknvnx"))) static const nvn_impl ex_##name = {#name, (void *)x_##name}; \
    static ret x_##name(__VA_ARGS__)

// NVN 空设备的 Metal 执行层（C 接口）：内存池 = 零拷贝 MTLBuffer，提交 = MTLCommandBuffer，同步 = MTLSharedEvent。
// 时序约定（防 x86 路线 GO_MAP_SHARE 花屏的覆辙）：一切「GPU 完成」的可见效果（同步对象就绪、事件值、计数器）
// 只在 Metal 命令缓冲真正完成之后才发生；CPU 侧等待只看 MTLSharedEvent 的已完成值。
// Metal execution layer of the NVN null device (C interface): memory pool = zero-copy MTLBuffer, submit = MTLCommandBuffer, sync = MTLSharedEvent.
// Ordering convention (to avoid repeating the GO_MAP_SHARE corrupted-picture mistake of the x86 route): every visible effect of "GPU completion" (sync object ready, event values, counters)
// happens only after the Metal command buffer has actually completed; CPU-side waits look only at the completed value of the MTLSharedEvent.

/* TOTK containment (TOTK_GPU_NOCOMMIT=1): after full-game runs kernel-panicked macOS in the GPU driver, the replay can
   encode everything but submit nothing. Completion handlers run at once so fences, queries and pacing still advance;
   GPU-written results (render targets, counters, compute output) are absent, and nothing is shown. */
static int nogpu(void) {
    static int v = -1;
    /* Full-game runs submitted GPU work and kernel-panicked macOS four times (IOGPUFamily, identical registers), so the game
       never submits unless TOTK_GPU_ALLOW_SUBMIT=1. Standalone probes (no game) keep submitting: they set TOTK_PROBE_GPU. */
    if (v < 0) {
        const char *allow = getenv("TOTK_GPU_ALLOW_SUBMIT"), *probe = getenv("TOTK_PROBE_GPU"), *e = getenv("TOTK_GPU_NOCOMMIT");
        v = (e && !strcmp(e, "1")) || !((allow && !strcmp(allow, "1")) || (probe && !strcmp(probe, "1")));
        if (v) fprintf(stderr, "[dm] [nvn-mtl] 【红】GPU submission disabled: work is encoded but never submitted (no picture, no GPU results); TOTK_GPU_ALLOW_SUBMIT=1 re-enables it\n");
    }
    return v;
}

static dispatch_semaphore_t g_ka_idle;   // signalled when g_q4_inflight drops to 0
/* iOS 拒收后台 App 的 GPU 提交（kIOGPUCommandBufferCallbackErrorBackgroundExecutionNotPermitted）：命令缓冲被丢，渲染目标和上传内容随之丢失。
   App 失去活跃状态时（切后台、拉下控制中心、锁屏）所有提交在这里等，回到前台再继续；游戏线程随之停在栅栏上。
   iOS refuses GPU work from a background app; while the app is not active every commit waits here and resumes in the foreground. */
static pthread_mutex_t g_bg_mu = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static pthread_cond_t g_bg_cv = PTHREAD_COND_INITIALIZER;
static _Atomic int g_app_inactive;
void mtl_app_active(int active) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_bg_mu); atomic_store(&g_app_inactive, !active); pthread_cond_broadcast(&g_bg_cv); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_bg_mu);
}
static void bg_gate(void) {
    if (!atomic_load_explicit(&g_app_inactive, memory_order_relaxed)) return;
    uint64_t t0 = clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_bg_mu); while (atomic_load(&g_app_inactive)) pthread_cond_wait(&g_bg_cv, &g_bg_mu); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_bg_mu);
    MLOG("App 不在前台：GPU 提交暂停了 %.1f s，现在继续", (clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW) - t0) / 1e9);
}
static void q4_commit(id<MTL4CommandBuffer> cb, TotkCommitOptions *o) {
    bg_gate();
    gpu_budget_check("提交命令缓冲");
    atomic_fetch_add(&g_q4_inflight, 1);
    [o addFeedbackHandler:^(id<MTL4CommitFeedback> f) { (void)f; if (atomic_fetch_sub(&g_q4_inflight, 1) == 1 && g_ka_idle) dispatch_semaphore_signal(g_ka_idle); }];
    if (!nogpu()) { id<MTL4CommandBuffer> buffers[] = {cb}; [g_q4 commit:buffers count:1 options:o]; return; }
    for (MTL4CommitFeedbackHandler h in o->handlers) h(nil);
}
static void cb_commit(id<MTLCommandBuffer> cb) { bg_gate(); if (!nogpu()) [cb commit]; }
static void cb_wait(id<MTLCommandBuffer> cb) { if (!nogpu()) [cb waitUntilCompleted]; }
