static void blit_note(void);   // 逐通道转储：拷贝 / 缓冲更新结束了渲染通道（定义在 PD 之后） | Per-pass dump: a copy / buffer update ended the render pass (defined after PD)
static void pd_update_bytes(const void *data, uint64_t dst, uint64_t n, uint64_t seq);
static void pd_xfer(const char *what, uint64_t src, uint64_t dst, uint64_t n);   // TOTK pass dump: 'X' lines for GPU copies / inline uniform updates (defined after PD)
static id<MTL4RenderCommandEncoder> g_enc;   // tentative declaration, defined with the render pass state
static uint64_t g_blit_opens, g_blit_splits, g_upd_n, g_upd_split, g_copy_n, g_copy_split;   // TOTK: copy encoders per cause (stats)
/* Reusing the open copy encoder needs a barrier between copies too: Metal 4 does not run the commands of one encoder in
   recording order, so a write then a read (or two writes) of the same range can swap (D2R Mobile 44a6770: without it a
   test read a stale value 1 time in 3). The barrier when the encoder opens only orders it against earlier encoders. On
   Metal 4 the copy encoder is a compute encoder, so both blit and dispatch stages are ordered. TOTK_BLIT_BAR=0: off. */
static int blit_bar_on(void) { static int v = -1; if (v < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_BLIT_BAR"); v = !e || atoi(e); } return v; }
static id<MTL4ComputeCommandEncoder> blit_kind(int buffer_alias) { blit_note(); if (!g_blit) { g_blit_opens++; g_blit_splits += g_enc != nil; } rp_end();
    if (buffer_alias && !g_copy_probe_no_alias) g_blit_alias = 1; // rp_end may itself open and close a copy encoder
    if (!g_blit) { rs_sync(); ser_gate(); pt_mark(g_cb, 'B', nil); g_blit = enc_b_begin(g_cb); [g_blit barrierAfterQueueStages:MTLStageAll beforeStages:MTLStageAll visibilityOptions:blit_vis()]; }
    else if (blit_bar_on()) [g_blit barrierAfterEncoderStages:MTLStageBlit | MTLStageDispatch beforeEncoderStages:MTLStageBlit | MTLStageDispatch visibilityOptions:blit_vis()];
    return g_blit; }
static id<MTL4ComputeCommandEncoder> blit(void) { return blit_kind(0); }
/* Buffer copies (mtl_sub_copy, the copy fallback of inline uniform updates). The same memory can be reached through two Metal
   buffers, each with its own GPU virtual address: a virtual pool's remapped view of a physical pool, or two pools over the same
   CPU memory. Device visibility alone does not make a write through one visible to a read through the other: a chain of copies
   through two no-copy buffers over one allocation read stale bytes on every run (probe-gpu-copy-alias). So every buffer-copy
   segment carries alias visibility in the barriers it keeps and at the encoder end (original port d309e62, Codex). The ranges
   are unused here; the original port's copy-batch experiment (off by default) takes the same call. */
static id<MTL4ComputeCommandEncoder> blit_buffer(id<MTLBuffer> src, NSUInteger so, id<MTLBuffer> dst, NSUInteger d, NSUInteger n) {
    (void)src; (void)so; (void)dst; (void)d; (void)n; return blit_kind(1); }

/* TOTK: collect and copy the uniform ranges a submission binds (see usnap_t). */
static size_t arena_alloc(size_t n, id<MTLBuffer> *buf);
static void pend_materialize(uint64_t a, uint8_t *out, size_t n, int depth);
static void pend_overlay(uint64_t a, uint8_t *out, size_t n, int depth);
static void pend_materialize_x(uint64_t a, uint8_t *out, size_t n, int depth, int wait);
static void pend_overlay_x(uint64_t a, uint8_t *out, size_t n, int depth, int wait);
typedef struct { uint64_t lo, hi; } usnap_rng;
typedef struct { usnap_rng *r; int n, cap; } usnap_rngs;
static usnap_rngs g_usr;   // replay side (the capture on the game thread uses its own list)
static void usnap_collect(usnap_rngs *v, const uint8_t *p, int depth) {
    for (;;) {
        op_hdr h; memcpy(&h, p, sizeof h);
        if (h.size < 8 || (h.size & 7) || h.op >= OP_COUNT_) MDIE("corrupt recording at %p while copying uniforms (op %u size %u)", (const void *)p, h.op, h.size);
        if (h.op == OP_END) return;
        if (h.op == OP_JUMP) { memcpy(&p, p + 8, 8); continue; }
        if (h.op == OP_CALL) { uint64_t t; memcpy(&t, p + 8, 8); if (depth < 16) usnap_collect(v, (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)t, depth + 1); }
        else if (h.op == OP_BIND_UBO) {
            const p_bind_buf *b = (const p_bind_buf *)(p + 8);
            if (b->addr && b->size && b->size <= 65536) {
                if (v->n == v->cap) { v->cap = v->cap ? v->cap * 2 : 4096; v->r = realloc(v->r, v->cap * sizeof *v->r); if (!v->r) MDIE("uniform copy ranges"); }
                v->r[v->n++] = (usnap_rng){b->addr, b->addr + b->size};
            }
        }
        p += h.size;
    }
}
static int usnap_cmp(const void *x, const void *y) { const usnap_rng *a = x, *b = y; return a->lo < b->lo ? -1 : a->lo > b->lo; }
/* TOTK: sort ranges by start. A frame binds a few thousand uniform ranges; qsort with a compare callback took about 5% of
   the replay (0.4 ms a frame on the M4). LSD radix sort on the 64-bit start, 8 bits per pass, skipping bytes every key
   shares (guest addresses differ only in their low few bytes); stable, so equal starts keep their order. */
static void rng_sort(usnap_rng *a, int n) {
    if (n < 2) return;
    if (n <= 32) { qsort(a, (size_t)n, sizeof *a, usnap_cmp); return; }
    static usnap_rng *tmp; static int cap;
    if (n > cap) { cap = n + n / 2; tmp = realloc(tmp, (size_t)cap * sizeof *tmp); if (!tmp) MDIE("range sort"); }
    uint64_t lo_or = 0, lo_and = ~0ull;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { lo_or |= a[i].lo; lo_and &= a[i].lo; }
    uint64_t vary = lo_or ^ lo_and;
    usnap_rng *src = a, *dst = tmp;
    for (int sh = 0; sh < 64; sh += 8) {
        if (!((vary >> sh) & 0xff)) continue;
        int cnt[257] = {0};
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) cnt[((src[i].lo >> sh) & 0xff) + 1]++;
        for (int b = 0; b < 256; b++) cnt[b + 1] += cnt[b];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) dst[cnt[(src[i].lo >> sh) & 0xff]++] = src[i];
        usnap_rng *t = src; src = dst; dst = t;
    }
    if (src != a) memcpy(a, src, (size_t)n * sizeof *a);
}
static int gw_cmp(const void *x, const void *y) { const gw_t *a = x, *b = y; return a->lo < b->lo ? -1 : a->lo > b->lo; }
/* With the translation thread (TOTK_ASYNC_REPLAY=1) nvnQueueSubmitCommands returns before the replay, as on the console,
   and the game rebuilds its constant pools right away: the uniform bytes are captured in the submit call (game thread)
   and the replay builds its copies from them. done: fence completion at the capture; a GPU write of an earlier submission
   whose fence is above it was not in memory then, so ranges it overlaps are read on the GPU timeline instead (with the
   replay inside the submit call the capture is the replay's own start, as before). */
typedef struct { uint64_t done; int n; usnap_rng *r; size_t *off; uint8_t *bytes; uint64_t ns; } usnap_cap;
static _Atomic uint64_t g_ucap_ns, g_ucap_bytes;
void *mtl_sub_capture_ubos(const uint64_t *h, int n) {
    static int on = -1;   // TOTK_UBO_CAPTURE=0 (A/B only): the translation thread copies at the start of the replay instead
    if (on < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_UBO_CAPTURE"); on = !(e && !strcmp(e, "0")); if (!on) MLOG("TOTK_UBO_CAPTURE=0：翻译线程模式下 uniform 在回放开始时才拷（对照用）"); }
    if (!on || !usnap_on()) return NULL;
    uint64_t t0 = clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW);
    usnap_cap *c = calloc(1, sizeof *c); if (!c) MDIE("uniform capture");
    c->done = __atomic_load_n(&g_done, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);   // before the bytes: a write completing meanwhile only makes this conservative
    usnap_rngs v = {0};
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) usnap_collect(&v, (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)h[i], 0);
    if (v.n) {
        rng_sort(v.r, v.n);
        int k = -1;   // merge overlapping / touching bindings that lie in one memory pool; drop bindings outside every pool
        for (int i = 0; i < v.n; i++) {
            void *mb; uint64_t mo;
            if (k >= 0 && v.r[i].lo <= v.r[k].hi) {
                if (v.r[i].hi <= v.r[k].hi) continue;
                if (mtl_addr(v.r[k].lo, v.r[i].hi - v.r[k].lo, &mb, &mo)) { v.r[k].hi = v.r[i].hi; continue; }
            }
            if (!mtl_addr(v.r[i].lo, v.r[i].hi - v.r[i].lo, &mb, &mo)) continue;
            v.r[++k] = v.r[i];
        }
        c->n = k + 1;
        size_t total = 0;
        c->off = malloc(sizeof *c->off * (size_t)(c->n ? c->n : 1)); if (!c->off) MDIE("uniform capture");
        for (int i = 0; i < c->n; i++) { c->off[i] = total; total += (size_t)(v.r[i].hi - v.r[i].lo); }
        c->bytes = malloc(total ? total : 1); if (!c->bytes) MDIE("uniform capture bytes");
        for (int i = 0; i < c->n; i++) memcpy(c->bytes + c->off[i], (const void *)(uintptr_t)v.r[i].lo, (size_t)(v.r[i].hi - v.r[i].lo));
        c->r = v.r; v.r = NULL;
        atomic_fetch_add(&g_ucap_bytes, total);
    }
    free(v.r);
    c->ns = clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW) - t0; atomic_fetch_add(&g_ucap_ns, c->ns);
    return c;
}
static void ucap_free(usnap_cap *c) { if (c) { free(c->r); free(c->off); free(c->bytes); free(c); } }
/* The bytes of [a, a+n) as captured: memory at the capture where a captured range covers them (they are memory now
   elsewhere: no binding of this submission reads there). */
static void ucap_read(const usnap_cap *c, uint64_t a, uint8_t *out, size_t n) {
    memcpy(out, (const void *)(uintptr_t)a, n);
    int lo = 0, hi = c->n;   // first captured range ending above a (ranges are disjoint and sorted)
    while (lo < hi) { int m = (lo + hi) / 2; if (c->r[m].hi <= a) lo = m + 1; else hi = m; }
    for (int i = lo; i < c->n && c->r[i].lo < a + n; i++) {
        uint64_t s0 = c->r[i].lo > a ? c->r[i].lo : a, e0 = c->r[i].hi < a + n ? c->r[i].hi : a + n;
        memcpy(out + (s0 - a), c->bytes + c->off[i] + (s0 - c->r[i].lo), (size_t)(e0 - s0));
    }
}
static int g_ucap_probe_now;   // probe-gpu-ubo-snapshot negative control only: judge GPU writes at the replay, not the capture
static void usnap_take(const uint64_t *h, int n, const usnap_cap *cap);
/* Helper threads for phase 2 of usnap_take: each claims entries through an atomic cursor and copies them; the replay
   thread signals them after phase 1 and goes on replaying. usnap_finish waits for them before the entries or the capture
   are reused / freed (end of the submission; long after they are done in practice). */
#define USH_MAX 2
static dispatch_semaphore_t g_ush_sem; static _Atomic int g_ush_next, g_ush_busy, g_ush_n; static int g_ush_count = -1;
static const usnap_cap *g_usnap_cap;   // the translation-thread mode's capture, the source of the copies until the helpers are done
static void *ush_main(void *arg) {
    (void)arg; pthread_set_qos_class_self_np(QOS_CLASS_USER_INTERACTIVE, 0);
    for (;;) {
        dispatch_semaphore_wait(g_ush_sem, DISPATCH_TIME_FOREVER);
        int n = atomic_load_explicit(&g_ush_n, memory_order_acquire); uint64_t did = 0;
        for (;;) {
            int i = atomic_fetch_add(&g_ush_next, 1); if (i >= n) break;
            int exp = US_PENDING; if (atomic_compare_exchange_strong(&g_usnap[i].st, &exp, US_COPYING)) { usnap_copy_one(&g_usnap[i]); did++; }
        }
        atomic_fetch_add(&g_usnap_helped, did);
        atomic_fetch_sub_explicit(&g_ush_busy, 1, memory_order_release);
    }
    return NULL;
}
static int ush_count(void) {
    if (g_ush_count < 0) {
        const char *e = getenv("TOTK_USNAP_HELPERS"); int k = e ? atoi(e) : USH_MAX; if (k < 0) k = 0; if (k > USH_MAX) k = USH_MAX;
        if (k) { g_ush_sem = dispatch_semaphore_create(0); for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) { pthread_t th; if (pthread_create(&th, NULL, ush_main, NULL)) MDIE("uniform copy helper thread"); pthread_detach(th); } }
        g_ush_count = k; MLOG("[nvn] uniform 提交时快照：%d 个辅助线程并行拷贝%s", k, k ? "，回放不等它们" : "（TOTK_USNAP_HELPERS=0：回放线程自己拷）");
    }
    return g_ush_count;
}
static void usnap_finish(void) {   // this submission's copies are about to be reused: the helpers must be done with them
    while (atomic_load_explicit(&g_ush_busy, memory_order_acquire)) sched_yield();
    if (g_usnap_cap) { ucap_free((usnap_cap *)g_usnap_cap); g_usnap_cap = NULL; }
}
void mtl_sub_snapshot_ubos_cap(const uint64_t *h, int n, void *capv) {
    usnap_cap *cap = capv;
    usnap_finish();
    g_nusnap = 0;
    if (!usnap_on()) { g_ngw = 0; ucap_free(cap); g_fc_snap_end = clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW); return; }
    uint64_t t0 = clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW);
    usnap_take(h, n, cap);   // keeps cap in g_usnap_cap until the copies are done (usnap_finish)
    g_fc_snap_end = clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW);
    g_usnap_ns += g_fc_snap_end - t0;
    g_usnap_n += (uint64_t)g_nusnap;
    if (++g_usnap_subs % 1800 == 0) {
        uint64_t cns = atomic_exchange(&g_ucap_ns, 0), cby = atomic_exchange(&g_ucap_bytes, 0);
        MLOG("[nvn] uniform 提交时快照：每次提交平均 %.0f 段 / %.1f KB / 回放线程 %.3f ms（收集排序 %.3f / 合并 %.3f / 分配并派发 %.3f）；辅助线程拷 %llu 段、回放自取 %llu 段、等辅助线程 %llu 次；本次提交里 GPU 写入使快照失效共 %llu 段，因前次提交的 GPU 写入未完成而不拷贝共 %llu 段%s",
             (double)g_usnap_n / 1800, (double)g_usnap_bytes / 1800 / 1024, (double)g_usnap_ns / 1800 / 1e6,
             (double)g_usnap_t[0] / 1800 / 1e6, (double)g_usnap_t[1] / 1800 / 1e6, (double)g_usnap_t[2] / 1800 / 1e6,
             (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&g_usnap_helped), (unsigned long long)g_usnap_self, (unsigned long long)g_usnap_waits,
             (unsigned long long)g_usnap_drops, (unsigned long long)g_usnap_skip_gpu,
             cby ? [NSString stringWithFormat:@"；翻译线程模式：提交调用里先拷 %.1f KB / %.3f ms（游戏线程）", (double)cby / 1800 / 1024, (double)cns / 1800 / 1e6].UTF8String : "");
        g_usnap_n = g_usnap_bytes = g_usnap_ns = 0; g_usnap_t[0] = g_usnap_t[1] = g_usnap_t[2] = 0; atomic_store(&g_usnap_helped, 0); g_usnap_self = g_usnap_waits = 0;
        cg_stats_line();
        { uint64_t f = atomic_load(&g_usnap_faults); if (f) MLOG("【红】uniform 快照拷贝读到不可访问地址累计 %llu 次（那些段改读内存）", (unsigned long long)f); }
        if (g_fc_n) MLOG("[nvn] 首段提交（每次提交平均，ms）：开始 %.3f / 快照 %.3f / 首段回放 %.3f / 等编码线程 %.3f / 上传冲刷 %.3f / 驻留提交 %.3f / 提交 %.3f%s",
                         (double)g_fc_t[0] / 1800 / 1e6, (double)g_usnap_ns / 1800 / 1e6, (double)g_fc_t[1] / g_fc_n / 1e6, (double)g_fc_t[2] / g_fc_n / 1e6,
                         (double)g_fc_t[3] / g_fc_n / 1e6, (double)g_fc_t[4] / g_fc_n / 1e6, (double)g_fc_t[5] / g_fc_n / 1e6,
                         g_exp_skip_fs_n ? [NSString stringWithFormat:@"；【实验】按片元着色器跳过的绘制 %llu", (unsigned long long)g_exp_skip_fs_n].UTF8String : "");
        memset(g_fc_t, 0, sizeof g_fc_t); g_fc_n = 0; g_exp_skip_fs_n = 0;
    }
}
void mtl_sub_snapshot_ubos(const uint64_t *h, int n) { mtl_sub_snapshot_ubos_cap(h, n, NULL); }
static void usnap_take(const uint64_t *h, int n, const usnap_cap *cap) {
    uint64_t tq0 = clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW);
    uint64_t done = cap && !g_ucap_probe_now ? cap->done : __atomic_load_n(&g_done, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    int ng = 0; uint64_t gw_maxlen = 0;   // GPU writes not finished at the capture, sorted by start
    for (int i = 0; i < g_ngw; i++) if (g_gw[i].fence > done) { g_gw[ng++] = g_gw[i]; if (g_gw[i].hi - g_gw[i].lo > gw_maxlen) gw_maxlen = g_gw[i].hi - g_gw[i].lo; }
    g_ngw = ng;
    if (ng > 1) qsort(g_gw, (size_t)ng, sizeof *g_gw, gw_cmp);
    g_usr.n = 0;
    if (cap) {   // the bindings as captured (merged, inside pools); the merge below works on them as on fresh ones
        if (cap->n > g_usr.cap) { g_usr.cap = cap->n + 256; g_usr.r = realloc(g_usr.r, g_usr.cap * sizeof *g_usr.r); if (!g_usr.r) MDIE("uniform copy ranges"); }
        memcpy(g_usr.r, cap->r, sizeof *cap->r * (size_t)cap->n); g_usr.n = cap->n;
    } else for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) usnap_collect(&g_usr, (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)h[i], 0);
    if (!g_usr.n) return;
    usnap_rng *u = g_usr.r;
    if (!cap) rng_sort(u, g_usr.n);
    uint64_t tq1 = clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW); g_usnap_t[0] += tq1 - tq0;
    /* merge ranges up to 256 bytes apart that lie in one memory pool, at most 1 MiB each (arena blocks are 4 MiB); the copies
       stay disjoint and sorted (usnap_first): a range overlapping a full copy keeps only its part beyond it, so a binding
       that no single copy holds reads memory as before */
    int k = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < g_usr.n; i++) {
        void *mb; uint64_t mo; uint64_t hi = u[i].hi > u[k].hi ? u[i].hi : u[k].hi;
        if (hi <= u[k].hi) continue;   // inside the current copy
        if (u[i].lo <= u[k].hi + 256 && hi - u[k].lo <= (1u << 20) && mtl_addr(u[k].lo, hi - u[k].lo, &mb, &mo)) u[k].hi = hi;
        else { usnap_rng r = u[i]; if (r.lo < u[k].hi) r.lo = u[k].hi; u[++k] = r; }
    }
    int nr = k + 1;
    if (nr > g_capusnap) { g_capusnap = nr + 256; g_usnap = realloc(g_usnap, g_capusnap * sizeof *g_usnap); if (!g_usnap) MDIE("uniform copies"); }
    uint64_t tq2 = clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW); g_usnap_t[1] += tq2 - tq1;
    for (int i = 0; i < nr; i++) {
        void *mb; uint64_t mo; uint64_t sz = u[i].hi - u[i].lo;
        if (!mtl_addr(u[i].lo, sz, &mb, &mo)) continue;   // not in one pool: read live memory
        if (ng) {   // a GPU write not finished at the capture overlaps it: read on the GPU timeline
            uint64_t from = u[i].lo > gw_maxlen ? u[i].lo - gw_maxlen : 0; int a = 0, b = ng;
            while (a < b) { int m = (a + b) >> 1; if (g_gw[m].lo < from) a = m + 1; else b = m; }
            int hit = 0; for (int j = a; j < ng && g_gw[j].lo < u[i].hi; j++) if (g_gw[j].hi > u[i].lo) { hit = 1; break; }
            if (hit) { g_usnap_skip_gpu++; continue; }
        }
        id<MTLBuffer> ab; size_t off = arena_alloc((size_t)sz, &ab);
        usnap_t *c = &g_usnap[g_nusnap++];
        c->lo = u[i].lo; c->hi = u[i].hi; c->gpu = ab.gpuAddress + off; c->cpu = (uint8_t *)ab.contents + off;
        atomic_store_explicit(&c->st, US_PENDING, memory_order_relaxed);
        g_usnap_bytes += sz;
    }
    // phase 2: the bytes. Helpers claim entries through the cursor; the replay goes on and copies what it needs first itself.
    g_usnap_cap = cap;
    g_usnap_pend_n = g_npend;   // the copies (helpers or the replay itself) overlay only the pending writes known now
    int helpers = ush_count();
    if (helpers && g_nusnap) { atomic_store(&g_ush_next, 0); atomic_store_explicit(&g_ush_n, g_nusnap, memory_order_release); atomic_store_explicit(&g_ush_busy, helpers, memory_order_release); for (int k = 0; k < helpers; k++) dispatch_semaphore_signal(g_ush_sem); }
    else for (int i = 0; i < g_nusnap; i++) { int exp = US_PENDING; if (atomic_compare_exchange_strong(&g_usnap[i].st, &exp, US_COPYING)) usnap_copy_one(&g_usnap[i]); }
    g_usnap_t[2] += clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW) - tq2;
}
static void usnap_copy_one(usnap_t *c) {   // the entry is COPYING and ours; lookups inside never wait (memory, as before)
    size_t sz = (size_t)(c->hi - c->lo);
    /* The reads below touch guest memory and the sources of pending GPU copies; a page the game unmapped meanwhile faults.
       Guarded: the fault drops this entry (its readers use memory, as for a GPU-written range) instead of ending the process
       (2026-10-16: a helper thread died with SIGBUS once in ~12 sessions). */
    sigjmp_buf jb;
    if (sigsetjmp(jb, 1) == 0) {
        runtime_fault_guard = &jb;
        if (g_usnap_cap) ucap_read(g_usnap_cap, c->lo, c->cpu, sz);   // captured bytes plus earlier submissions' writes not yet executed
        else memcpy(c->cpu, (const void *)(uintptr_t)c->lo, sz);     // memory plus writes of earlier submissions not yet executed
        pend_overlay_x(c->lo, c->cpu, sz, 0, 0);
        runtime_fault_guard = NULL;
        int exp = US_COPYING; atomic_compare_exchange_strong_explicit(&c->st, &exp, US_READY, memory_order_release, memory_order_relaxed);   // stays DROPPED if a GPU write hit it meanwhile
    } else {
        runtime_fault_guard = NULL;
        atomic_store_explicit(&c->st, US_DROPPED, memory_order_release);
        uint64_t k = atomic_fetch_add(&g_usnap_faults, 1);
        if (k < 4) MLOG("【红】uniform 快照拷贝读到不可访问的地址（段 %#llx+%zu，第 %llu 次）：这一段改读内存", (unsigned long long)c->lo, sz, (unsigned long long)k + 1);
    }
}
void mtl_sub_copy(uint64_t src, uint64_t dst, uint64_t n) {
    g_copy_n++; g_copy_split += g_enc != nil;
    upd_guard(src, src + n); upd_guard(dst, dst + n);
    pend_note(dst, n, (const void *)(uintptr_t)src, 1); pd_xfer("copy", src, dst, n);
    usnap_drop(dst, n);   // TOTK: later readers see the copied bytes (memory, on the GPU timeline)
    anom_note_xfer('Y', src, dst, n, NULL);   // TOTK_ANOMALY
    void *sb, *db; uint64_t so, dof;
    if (!mtl_addr(src, n, &sb, &so) || !mtl_addr(dst, n, &db, &dof))
        MDIE("缓冲拷贝地址不在任何内存池内 src=%#llx dst=%#llx n=%#llx", (unsigned long long)src, (unsigned long long)dst, (unsigned long long)n);
    enc_b_copy_buffer(blit_buffer((__bridge id<MTLBuffer>)sb, so, (__bridge id<MTLBuffer>)db, dof, n), (__bridge id<MTLBuffer>)sb, so, (__bridge id<MTLBuffer>)db, dof, n);
}

// TOTK: uniform updates carry their data inline in the (host-owned) recording; stage it in this submit's
// argument arena (shared Metal memory) and copy on the GPU timeline like any other buffer copy.
static size_t arena_alloc(size_t n, id<MTLBuffer> *buf);
/* TOTK: inline uniform updates without splitting the render pass (renaming).
   The game updates small uniform ranges between draws about 200 times per frame (nvnCommandBufferUpdateUniformBuffer).
   Each one used to be a GPU copy, which ended the render pass: a copy encoder in between and the pass reopened with every
   attachment loaded again (~80 copy encoders and ~23 split passes per frame in the East Reservoir scene). Now an update
   stages its bytes in the submission arena and is logged. A draw or dispatch that binds a uniform range overlapping
   logged updates gets a private copy of that range: memory plus every pending write in order (pend_materialize), so
   draws before an update read the old bytes and draws after it the new ones. The logged updates reach memory at the end
   of the submission, or earlier when anything other than a uniform binding (vertex / index / storage / texture buffer,
   buffer copy, built-in kernel) touches an updated range; that check runs before the draw opens its encoder.
   Overlapping updates are merged and written once per merged range, so copies in one encoder never race.
   TOTK_UB_RENAME=0 keeps the per-update GPU copies. */
static inline void args_dirty_all(void);
static void upd_dirty_stages(uint64_t lo, uint64_t hi);
typedef struct { uint64_t lo, hi, seq; } upd_ent;
static upd_ent *g_upd; static int g_nupd, g_updcap; static uint64_t g_upd_lo = UINT64_MAX, g_upd_hi, g_upd_seq;
/* g_upd is kept sorted by lo (insertion with memmove; a few hundred entries per submission) with g_upd_maxhi[i] = largest hi
   in g_upd[0..i], so an overlap query is a binary search plus a backwards walk over actual overlaps: every uniform binding
   of the frame (over ten thousand) is checked, and most overlap nothing. */
static uint64_t *g_upd_maxhi;
static void upd_insert(uint64_t lo, uint64_t hi) {
    if (g_nupd == g_updcap) {
        g_updcap = g_updcap ? g_updcap * 2 : 256;
        g_upd = realloc(g_upd, (size_t)g_updcap * sizeof *g_upd); g_upd_maxhi = realloc(g_upd_maxhi, (size_t)g_updcap * sizeof *g_upd_maxhi);
        if (!g_upd || !g_upd_maxhi) MDIE("uniform update log");
    }
    int a = 0, b = g_nupd; while (a < b) { int m = (a + b) >> 1; if (g_upd[m].lo <= lo) a = m + 1; else b = m; }
    memmove(g_upd + a + 1, g_upd + a, (size_t)(g_nupd - a) * sizeof *g_upd);
    g_upd[a] = (upd_ent){lo, hi, ++g_upd_seq}; g_nupd++;
    for (int i = a; i < g_nupd; i++) { uint64_t prev = i ? g_upd_maxhi[i - 1] : 0; g_upd_maxhi[i] = g_upd[i].hi > prev ? g_upd[i].hi : prev; }
    if (lo < g_upd_lo) g_upd_lo = lo; if (hi > g_upd_hi) g_upd_hi = hi;
}
// Newest seq among logged updates overlapping [lo, hi), 0 when none.
static uint64_t upd_overlap_seq(uint64_t lo, uint64_t hi) {
    if (!g_nupd || hi <= g_upd_lo || lo >= g_upd_hi) return 0;
    int a = 0, b = g_nupd; while (a < b) { int m = (a + b) >> 1; if (g_upd[m].lo < hi) a = m + 1; else b = m; }   // entries [0, a) start below hi
    uint64_t last = 0;
    for (int i = a - 1; i >= 0 && g_upd_maxhi[i] > lo; i--) if (g_upd[i].hi > lo && g_upd[i].seq > last) last = g_upd[i].seq;
    return last;
}
typedef struct { uint64_t lo, size, seq, gpu; } ubo_shadow;
#define UBO_SHADOW_MAX 512
static ubo_shadow g_shadow[UBO_SHADOW_MAX]; static int g_nshadow;
/* Small direct-mapped index into the authoritative shadow list. Always compare the
   complete range and update sequence, so collisions, flushes and list wraparound
   fall back to the original search. No old GPU address is stored in the index. */
#define SHADOW_INDEX_N 1024
static uint16_t g_shadow_index[SHADOW_INDEX_N];
static _Atomic int g_shadow_index_on = -1, g_shadow_index_check;
static uint64_t g_shadow_index_hits, g_shadow_index_misses, g_shadow_index_verified;
static int g_shadow_index_stale_probe;
static int shadow_index_on(void) {
    int v = atomic_load(&g_shadow_index_on);
    if (v < 0) { const char *e=getenv("TOTK_SHADOW_INDEX"); v=e && atoi(e); atomic_store(&g_shadow_index_on,v); }
    return v;
}
static unsigned shadow_index_slot(uint64_t lo, uint64_t size) {
    uint64_t h=(lo >> 4) ^ (lo >> 19) ^ (size * UINT64_C(0x9e3779b97f4a7c15));
    return (unsigned)(h ^ (h >> 32)) & (SHADOW_INDEX_N-1);
}
static uint64_t g_ren_updates, g_ren_shadows, g_ren_bytes, g_ren_flushes, g_ren_late, g_ren_fallback;
static int ub_rename_on(void) {
    static int v = -1;
    if (v < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_UB_RENAME"); v = !(e && !strcmp(e, "0")); MLOG("TOTK: inline uniform updates %s", v ? "renamed per binding (render passes stay open)" : "copied on the GPU timeline (TOTK_UB_RENAME=0)"); }
    return v;
}
void mtl_ren_stats(uint64_t v[6]) { v[0] = g_ren_updates; v[1] = g_ren_shadows; v[2] = g_ren_bytes; v[3] = g_ren_flushes; v[4] = g_ren_late; v[5] = g_ren_fallback; }
/* Bytes [a, a+n) as the GPU will see them at this point of the submission: memory, then every pending write that the GPU
   has not completed yet, oldest first (inline updates carry their bytes; GPU copies read their source the same way). */
static void pend_materialize_x(uint64_t a, uint8_t *out, size_t n, int depth, int wait) {
    usnap_read_x(a, out, n, wait);
    pend_overlay_x(a, out, n, depth, wait);
}
static void pend_materialize(uint64_t a, uint8_t *out, size_t n, int depth) { pend_materialize_x(a, out, n, depth, 1); }
static void pend_overlay_x(uint64_t a, uint8_t *out, size_t n, int depth, int wait) {   // the pending writes over out (= [a, a+n) before them)
    uint64_t done = __atomic_load_n(&g_done, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    int npend = wait ? g_npend : g_usnap_pend_n;   // wait = 0: the copy routine (possibly on a helper thread)
    for (int i = 0; i < npend; i++) {
        uint64_t lo = g_pend_lo[i], hi = g_pend_hi[i];
        if (hi <= a || lo >= a + n || g_pend_fence[i] <= done) continue;   // completed writes are already in memory (which may hold newer CPU writes)
        uint64_t s0 = lo > a ? lo : a, e0 = hi < a + n ? hi : a + n;
        if (g_pend_kind[i] == 0) memcpy(out + (s0 - a), (const uint8_t *)g_pend_src[i] + (s0 - lo), e0 - s0);
        else if (depth < 2) pend_materialize_x((uint64_t)(uintptr_t)g_pend_src[i] + (s0 - lo), out + (s0 - a), e0 - s0, depth + 1, wait);
        else memcpy(out + (s0 - a), (const uint8_t *)g_pend_src[i] + (s0 - lo), e0 - s0);
    }
}
static void pend_overlay(uint64_t a, uint8_t *out, size_t n, int depth) { pend_overlay_x(a, out, n, depth, 1); }
// Write the logged updates into memory on the GPU timeline (ends a render pass if one is open).
static void upd_flush(void) {
    if (!g_nupd) return;
    /* Own encoder: copies inside one encoder may run concurrently, so earlier copies to these bytes and later readers of
       them (a buffer copy right after this flush) must sit in other encoders, ordered by the encoder barriers. */
    if (g_blit) { enc_b_end(g_blit); g_blit = nil; }
    id<MTL4ComputeCommandEncoder> b = nil;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_nupd;) {
        uint64_t lo = g_upd[i].lo, hi = g_upd[i].hi; int j = i + 1;
        for (; j < g_nupd && g_upd[j].lo <= hi; j++) if (g_upd[j].hi > hi) hi = g_upd[j].hi;   // merge overlapping / touching ranges
        void *db; uint64_t dof;
        if (!mtl_addr(lo, hi - lo, &db, &dof)) MDIE("renamed uniform update %#llx+%#llx is no longer in one memory pool", (unsigned long long)lo, (unsigned long long)(hi - lo));
        usnap_drop(lo, hi - lo);   // TOTK: from here on the update is in memory (GPU timeline): later readers read it there
        id<MTLBuffer> sb; size_t so = arena_alloc((size_t)(hi - lo), &sb);
        pend_materialize(lo, (uint8_t *)sb.contents + so, (size_t)(hi - lo), 0);   // every byte here is covered by a logged update: the newest one wins
        if (!b) b = blit();
        enc_b_copy_buffer(b, sb, so, (__bridge id<MTLBuffer>)db, dof, hi - lo);
        i = j;
    }
    if (b) { enc_b_end(g_blit); g_blit = nil; }
    g_nupd = 0; g_upd_lo = UINT64_MAX; g_upd_hi = 0; g_nshadow = 0;
}
// Before a non-uniform access to [lo, hi): logged updates overlapping it must be in memory first.
static int g_upd_guard_off;   // probe-gpu-ub-rename negative control only
static inline int upd_guard(uint64_t lo, uint64_t hi) {
    if (!g_nupd || g_upd_guard_off || !upd_overlap_seq(lo, hi)) return 0;
    g_ren_flushes++; upd_flush(); return 1;
}
// GPU address of a private copy of the uniform range [lo, lo+size) holding the logged updates, or 0 when none overlaps it.
static uint64_t upd_shadow(uint64_t lo, uint64_t size) {
    uint64_t last = size ? upd_overlap_seq(lo, lo + size) : 0;
    if (!last) return 0;
    int indexed=shadow_index_on(); unsigned slot=0;
    if (indexed) {
        slot=shadow_index_slot(lo,size); int idx=(int)g_shadow_index[slot]-1;
        if (idx>=0 && idx<g_nshadow && g_shadow[idx].lo==lo && g_shadow[idx].size==size &&
            (g_shadow_index_stale_probe || g_shadow[idx].seq==last)) {
            if (atomic_load(&g_shadow_index_check)) {
                uint64_t reference=0;
                for(int i=0;i<g_nshadow;i++) if(g_shadow[i].lo==lo && g_shadow[i].size==size && g_shadow[i].seq==last){reference=g_shadow[i].gpu;break;}
                if(reference!=g_shadow[idx].gpu)MDIE("shadow index mismatch: %#llx + %llu seq %llu",(unsigned long long)lo,(unsigned long long)size,(unsigned long long)last);
                g_shadow_index_verified++;
            }
            g_shadow_index_hits++; return g_shadow[idx].gpu;
        }
        g_shadow_index_misses++;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < g_nshadow; i++) if (g_shadow[i].lo == lo && g_shadow[i].size == size && g_shadow[i].seq == last) {
        if(indexed)g_shadow_index[slot]=(uint16_t)(i+1);
        return g_shadow[i].gpu;
    }
    id<MTLBuffer> sb; size_t so = arena_alloc((size_t)size, &sb);
    pend_materialize(lo, (uint8_t *)sb.contents + so, (size_t)size, 0);
    uint64_t gpu = sb.gpuAddress + so;
    if (g_nshadow == UBO_SHADOW_MAX) g_nshadow = 0;
    g_shadow[g_nshadow++] = (ubo_shadow){lo, size, last, gpu};
    if(indexed)g_shadow_index[slot]=(uint16_t)g_nshadow;
    g_ren_shadows++; g_ren_bytes += size;
    return gpu;
}
static void mtl_sub_update(const void *data, uint64_t dst, uint64_t n) {
    void *db; uint64_t dof;
    g_upd_n++;
    pd_update_bytes(data, dst, n, g_upd_n);
    if (!mtl_addr(dst, n, &db, &dof)) MDIE("uniform update target not in any memory pool dst=%#llx n=%#llx", (unsigned long long)dst, (unsigned long long)n);
    id<MTLBuffer> sb; size_t so = arena_alloc((size_t)n, &sb);
    memcpy((uint8_t *)sb.contents + so, data, (size_t)n);
    pend_note(dst, n, (const uint8_t *)sb.contents + so, 0);   // the arena copy outlives this submission's replay
    pd_xfer("update", 0, dst, n);
    anom_note_xfer('U', 0, dst, n, data);   // TOTK_ANOMALY
    if (ub_rename_on() && g_npend < PEND_MAX && __atomic_load_n(&g_done, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE) >= g_pend_over_fence) {
        upd_insert(dst, dst + n);
        g_ren_updates++;
        upd_dirty_stages(dst, dst + n);   // argument buffers reused inside the pass would still point at the previous version
        return;
    }
    if (ub_rename_on()) { g_ren_fallback++; upd_flush(); }   // pending table full: keep the order with a real copy
    usnap_drop(dst, n);   // TOTK: the update reaches memory on the GPU timeline; later readers read it there
    enc_b_copy_buffer(blit_buffer(sb, so, (__bridge id<MTLBuffer>)db, dof, n), sb, so, (__bridge id<MTLBuffer>)db, dof, n);
}
static void post(post_op o) {
    if (g_npost == g_postcap) { g_postcap = g_postcap ? g_postcap * 2 : 64; g_post = realloc(g_post, g_postcap * sizeof *g_post); }
    g_post[g_npost++] = o;
}
void mtl_sub_event(volatile uint32_t *val, uint32_t mode, uint32_t v) { post((post_op){1, val, mode, v, 0, 0, NULL}); }
void mtl_sub_counter(uint64_t addr, uint32_t type) { post((post_op){2, NULL, 0, 0, addr, type, NULL}); }
// ---------- TOTK: conditional rendering evaluated in GPU order ----------
// Counter reports replayed earlier in GPU order whose memory write has not happened yet (it happens in the completion
// handler of their submit) are kept in a ring with the value they will write: 0 for timestamp / unimplemented types,
// unknown for samples passed. cond_eval consults the ring first, then the pool memory, so a conditional sees the same
// counter values the GPU would. Results are cached per op pointer per frame so the lookahead scanners and the replay agree.
typedef struct { uint64_t addr, fence, val; int known; } cpend_ent;
#define CPEND_N 4096
static cpend_ent g_cpend[CPEND_N]; static unsigned g_cpend_head, g_cpend_tail; static pthread_mutex_t g_cpend_mu = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;   // TOTK: [tail, head) may still be pending (fences rise with the index, so completions clear a prefix)
static void cpend_push(uint64_t addr, uint64_t fence, uint64_t val, int known) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_cpend_mu); g_cpend[g_cpend_head % CPEND_N] = (cpend_ent){addr, fence, val, known}; g_cpend_head++; pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_cpend_mu);
}
static void cpend_done(uint64_t fence) {   // the records of this submit are now in memory
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_cpend_mu);
    if (g_cpend_head - g_cpend_tail > CPEND_N) g_cpend_tail = g_cpend_head - CPEND_N;
    for (unsigned i = g_cpend_tail; i != g_cpend_head; i++) if (g_cpend[i % CPEND_N].addr && g_cpend[i % CPEND_N].fence <= fence) g_cpend[i % CPEND_N].addr = 0;
    while (g_cpend_tail != g_cpend_head && !g_cpend[g_cpend_tail % CPEND_N].addr) g_cpend_tail++;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_cpend_mu);
}
// 1 = value known (written to *val), 0 = pending but unknown, -1 = no pending write (read memory)
static int cpend_lookup(uint64_t addr, uint64_t *val) {
    int r = -1; pthread_mutex_lock(&g_cpend_mu);
    unsigned n = g_cpend_head - g_cpend_tail; if (n > CPEND_N) n = CPEND_N;   // only the part that may still be pending (it was all 4,096 slots twice per conditional)
    for (unsigned k = 0; k < n; k++) { const cpend_ent *e = &g_cpend[(g_cpend_head - 1 - k) % CPEND_N]; if (e->addr == addr) { r = e->known; *val = e->val; break; } }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_cpend_mu); return r;
}
extern uint64_t g_draw_skip[16];
static _Atomic uint64_t g_cur_frame;
typedef struct { const void *op; uint64_t frame; int result; } cond_cache_ent;
static cond_cache_ent g_cond_cache[1024];
static int cond_eval(const void *payload, const void *op) {
    const p_render_cond *c = payload; uint64_t frame = atomic_load(&g_cur_frame);
    cond_cache_ent *ce = &g_cond_cache[((uintptr_t)op >> 3) & 1023];
    if (ce->op == op && ce->frame == frame) return ce->result;
    uint64_t x = 0, y = 0; int kx = cpend_lookup(c->addr, &x), ky = cpend_lookup(c->addr + 16, &y), enabled = 1, unknown = 0;
    if (kx == 0 || ky == 0) unknown = 1;
    else {
        void *bf; uint64_t off;
        if (!mtl_addr(c->addr, 32, &bf, &off)) { static int once; if (!once++) MLOG("【红】conditional render counters at %#llx are not in any memory pool", (unsigned long long)c->addr); unknown = 1; }
        else {
            if (kx < 0) memcpy(&x, (const void *)(uintptr_t)c->addr, 8);
            if (ky < 0) memcpy(&y, (const void *)(uintptr_t)(c->addr + 16), 8);
            enabled = c->mode == 0 ? x == y : x != y;
        }
    }
    if (unknown) { enabled = 1; g_draw_skip[14]++; } else if (!enabled) g_draw_skip[13]++;
    *ce = (cond_cache_ent){op, frame, enabled};
    return enabled;
}
void mtl_counter_stats(uint64_t rep[32], uint64_t rst[32]) { memcpy(rep, g_cnt_report, sizeof g_cnt_report); memcpy(rst, g_cnt_reset, sizeof g_cnt_reset); }

/* TOTK: counter timestamps in the Tegra 19.2 MHz tick base of nn::os::GetSystemTick (runtime_dispatch: mach_absolute_time
   in ns * 12 / 625). The game turns the GPU timestamps of its frame (main+0x2a7b630, via nvnDeviceGetTimestampInNanoseconds
   and ConvertToTick) into "GPU done, ticks after the CPU frame start" and raises its present interval when that is long
   (main+0x8f6bec). CLOCK_MONOTONIC counts sleep while mach_absolute_time does not: the reported GPU end was later than the
   frame start by the machine's whole sleep time since boot (24 days on the Mac, 20 on the iPhone), so the game sat at
   interval 3 (20 frames) everywhere once the device had slept. */
static uint64_t gpu_ticks(void) { static mach_timebase_info_data_t tb; if (!tb.denom) mach_timebase_info(&tb); __uint128_t ns = (__uint128_t)mach_absolute_time() * tb.numer / tb.denom; return (uint64_t)(ns * 12 / 625); }

// ---------- 启动埋点（DM_BOOTPROF=1）：metallib 载入、管线创建（均在提交线程回放中同步发生）、贴图上传、首帧出图 ----------
// ---------- Boot instrumentation (DM_BOOTPROF=1): metallib loading, pipeline creation (both happen synchronously during replay on the submit thread), texture upload, first-frame present ----------
static uint64_t bp_now(void) { struct timespec t; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t); return (uint64_t)t.tv_sec * 1000000000ull + t.tv_nsec; }
static int survey_shader_log(void) { static int on = -1; if (on < 0) on = getenv("TOTK_SURVEY_SHADER_LOG") != NULL; return on; }
static uint64_t g_bp_t0;   // 进程启动（本模块装入）时刻 | Time of process start (when this module is loaded)
__attribute__((constructor)) static void bp_t0(void) { g_bp_t0 = bp_now(); }
static int bootprof(void) { static int v = -1; if (v < 0) v = getenv("DM_BOOTPROF") != NULL; return v; }
static uint64_t g_bp_lib_n, g_bp_lib_ns, g_bp_pso_n, g_bp_pso_ns, g_bp_up_bytes, g_bp_first_present;
static uint64_t g_up_total_ns;   // 上传累计耗时（与逐帧 @upload_ms 同源） | Cumulative upload time (same source as the per-frame @upload_ms)
// ---------- 按帧归集 GPU 时间 ----------
// ---------- Per-frame GPU time aggregation ----------
#define GRING 1024
static struct { _Atomic uint64_t frame, ns, t0, t1; _Atomic int pending; } g_gpu[GRING];   // t0 / t1：该帧最早 GPUStart / 最晚 GPUEnd（mach 绝对时间 ns） | t0 / t1: the frame's earliest GPUStart / latest GPUEnd (mach absolute time, ns)
/* g_cur_frame is defined above (conditional rendering) */
// ---------- 同进程交替测量（DM_NVN_UB，缺省无：不设环境变量时下面只多一次「是否启用」的判断） ----------
// 真机热态下系统持续调功率 / 频率，分段对比（A 段、B 段各跑一分钟）分不清 <10% 的差；在同一局里按相轮流开关、相邻相配对取差，漂移对消。
// DM_NVN_UB="名字=项,项;名字=项"，每 DM_NVN_UB_N 帧（缺省 180，下限 60）一相：偶数相 = 基准（什么都不改），奇数相轮流取一类。一类里的每一项：
//   @set:<全局变量名>=<值>   进相时把这个 int 全局变量设成该值、出相时还原（按符号名找地址；真机上要用的开关须在下面的登记表里加一行）
//   <片元着色器键前缀> 或 *   该相丢掉这些片元着色器的全部绘制（画面会错，只量「这类绘制值多少」；近乎空载的类别要单独成轮）
// 读数：每相丢掉前 45 帧（过渡 + 上屏滞后），其余帧的实际上屏间隔（与 perf.txt 同源）均值与 16.7 / 25 / ≥33 ms 三档帧数，日志一行「UB 上屏」。
// 出表：$DM_ROOT/run/ruler/ub_table.py；真机脚本：$DM_ROOT/run/ruler/ub_alt.sh。
// ---------- Same-process alternating measurement (DM_NVN_UB, off by default: without the environment variable the code below only adds one 'is it enabled' check) ----------
// On a hot real device the system keeps adjusting power / frequency, and segment comparison (segments A and B each run for a minute) cannot resolve differences of <10%; within the same run, toggle by phase in turn and take differences of adjacent phase pairs, so the drift cancels.
// DM_NVN_UB="name=item,item;name=item", one phase every DM_NVN_UB_N frames (default 180, minimum 60): even phases = baseline (nothing changed), odd phases take one category in turn. Each item of a category:
//   @set:<global variable name>=<value>   on entering the phase set this int global variable to the value, on leaving restore it (address found by symbol name; switches to be used on a real device must have a line added to the registration table below)
//   <fragment shader key prefix> or *   the phase drops all draws of these fragment shaders (the picture will be wrong; it only measures 'how much this kind of draw is worth'; a nearly idle category needs a round of its own)
// Readings: each phase discards its first 45 frames (transition + present lag); for the remaining frames, the mean of the actual present interval (same source as perf.txt) and the frame counts in the three buckets 16.7 / 25 / ≥33 ms, one log line 「UB 上屏」(UB present).
// Table output: $DM_ROOT/run/ruler/ub_table.py; real-device script: $DM_ROOT/run/ruler/ub_alt.sh.
static int g_ub_n = -1, g_ub_N = 180; static _Atomic int g_ub_cur = -1; static char g_ub_name[16][16], g_ub_keys[16][16][48]; static int g_ub_nk[16];
static _Atomic int g_ubp_on, g_ubp_c[4]; static _Atomic uint64_t g_ubp_sum_us;
void mtl_ub_present(double iv) {   // 出图线程每帧调一次：实际上屏间隔 ms（−1 = 被丢弃，0 = 无读数） | Called once per frame by the present thread: actual present interval in ms (−1 = dropped, 0 = no reading)
    if (!atomic_load(&g_ubp_on) || iv == 0) return;
    if (iv < 0) { atomic_fetch_add(&g_ubp_c[3], 1); return; }
    atomic_fetch_add(&g_ubp_c[iv <= 20.8 ? 0 : iv <= 29.2 ? 1 : 2], 1); atomic_fetch_add(&g_ubp_sum_us, (uint64_t)(iv * 1000));
}
// 登记过的运行时开关：名字 → 地址。iOS 发布包的主程序符号不进动态符号表，dlsym 找不到（真机首轮四类全部「找不到全局变量」、整轮白跑），
// 所以真机要量的开关必须在这里加一行；Mac / 单测里没登记的仍按符号名找。
// Registered runtime switches: name → address. Main-program symbols of an iOS release build are not in the dynamic symbol table and dlsym cannot find them (in the first real-device round all four categories were 「找不到全局变量」(global variable not found) and the whole round was wasted),
// so a switch to be measured on a real device must have a line added here; on Mac / in unit tests unregistered ones are still looked up by symbol name.
static int *ub_var(const char *nm) {
    extern int g_bloom_q, g_dm_present_link;
    static const struct { const char *n; int *p; } t[] = { {"g_bloom_q", &g_bloom_q}, {"g_dm_present_link", &g_dm_present_link}, {"g_frz_on", &g_frz_on} };
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof t / sizeof t[0]; i++) if (!strcmp(nm, t[i].n)) return t[i].p;
    return dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT, nm);
}
static void ub_frame(uint64_t f) {
    if (g_ub_n < 0) { g_ub_n = 0; const char *e = getenv("DM_NVN_UB"), *n = getenv("DM_NVN_UB_N"); if (n && atoi(n) >= 60) g_ub_N = atoi(n);
        for (const char *q = e; q && *q && g_ub_n < 16; ) { const char *eq = strchr(q, '='), *end = strchr(q, ';'); if (!end) end = q + strlen(q); if (!eq || eq > end) break;
            int c = g_ub_n++; size_t l = (size_t)(eq - q); if (l > 15) l = 15; memcpy(g_ub_name[c], q, l);
            for (const char *k = eq + 1; k < end && g_ub_nk[c] < 16; ) { size_t kl = 0; while (k + kl < end && k[kl] != ',') kl++; size_t cl = kl > 47 ? 47 : kl; memcpy(g_ub_keys[c][g_ub_nk[c]++], k, cl); k += kl; if (k < end) k++; }
            q = *end ? end + 1 : end; }
        if (g_ub_n) MLOG("DM_NVN_UB：%d 类，每相 %d 帧（同进程交替测量；丢绘制的相画面不对）", g_ub_n, g_ub_N); }
    if (!g_ub_n) return;
    uint64_t ph = f / (uint64_t)g_ub_N, r = f % (uint64_t)g_ub_N;
    if (r == 45) { for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) atomic_store(&g_ubp_c[i], 0); atomic_store(&g_ubp_sum_us, 0); atomic_store(&g_ubp_on, 1); }
    if (r != 0) return;
    if (f && atomic_load(&g_ubp_on)) { atomic_store(&g_ubp_on, 0); uint64_t pp = ph - 1; int pc = (pp & 1) ? (int)((pp / 2) % (uint64_t)g_ub_n) : -1;
        int c0 = atomic_load(&g_ubp_c[0]), c1 = atomic_load(&g_ubp_c[1]), c2 = atomic_load(&g_ubp_c[2]), c3 = atomic_load(&g_ubp_c[3]), n_ = c0 + c1 + c2;
        MLOG("UB 上屏 %llu %s 帧 %d 均 %.3f ms 2拍 %d 3拍 %d 4拍以上 %d 丢弃 %d", (unsigned long long)pp, pc < 0 ? "base" : g_ub_name[pc], n_, n_ ? atomic_load(&g_ubp_sum_us) / 1000.0 / n_ : 0.0, c0, c1, c2, c3); }
    int nc = (ph & 1) ? (int)((ph / 2) % (uint64_t)g_ub_n) : -1;
    static int *sp[16]; static int sv[16], ns;   // 上一相设过的变量：先还原 | Variables set by the previous phase: restore first
    for (int i = 0; i < ns; i++) *sp[i] = sv[i]; ns = 0;
    for (int i = 0; nc >= 0 && i < g_ub_nk[nc] && ns < 16; i++) { const char *k = g_ub_keys[nc][i]; if (strncmp(k, "@set:", 5)) continue;
        char nm[48]; const char *eq = strchr(k, '='); if (!eq) continue; size_t l = (size_t)(eq - (k + 5)); if (l >= sizeof nm) continue; memcpy(nm, k + 5, l); nm[l] = 0;
        int *a_ = ub_var(nm); static int bad, ok;
        if (!a_) { if (bad++ < 8) MLOG("【红】DM_NVN_UB：找不到全局变量 %s（真机上要先在 ub_var 的表里登记）", nm); continue; }
        sp[ns] = a_; sv[ns] = *a_; ns++; *a_ = atoi(eq + 1); if (ok++ < 8) MLOG("DM_NVN_UB：%s = %d（原值 %d）", nm, atoi(eq + 1), sv[ns - 1]); }
    atomic_store(&g_ub_cur, nc);
}
static int ub_skip(const char *key) {   // 本相要不要丢掉这个片元着色器的绘制 | Whether this phase should drop draws of this fragment shader
    int uc = atomic_load(&g_ub_cur); if (uc < 0) return 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_ub_nk[uc]; i++) { const char *k = g_ub_keys[uc][i]; if (k[0] == '@') continue; if (k[0] == '*' || !strncmp(key, k, strlen(k))) return 1; }
    return 0;
}
void mtl_set_frame(uint64_t f) { atomic_store(&g_cur_frame, f); if (g_ub_n) ub_frame(f); }
// GPU 计时登记：提交前 gpu_tag_begin(帧)，完成时 gpu_tag_done(帧, GPU 起, GPU 止)（CACurrentMediaTime 基准秒）。
// 旧队列命令缓冲走 gpu_tag_f；Metal 4 主提交在 mtl_sub_commit 的 feedback 里回填（换 Metal 4 时调用点全丢，「计时」行的 GPU 一栏成了空）
// GPU timing registration: gpu_tag_begin(frame) before commit, gpu_tag_done(frame, GPU start, GPU end) on completion (seconds on the CACurrentMediaTime base).
// Old-queue command buffers go through gpu_tag_f; the Metal 4 main submission backfills in the feedback of mtl_sub_commit (when switching to Metal 4 all the call sites were lost and the GPU column of the 「计时」(timing) line became empty)
static void gpu_tag_begin(uint64_t f) {
    unsigned k = f % GRING;
    if (atomic_load(&g_gpu[k].frame) != f) { atomic_store(&g_gpu[k].frame, f); atomic_store(&g_gpu[k].ns, 0); atomic_store(&g_gpu[k].pending, 0); atomic_store(&g_gpu[k].t0, UINT64_MAX); atomic_store(&g_gpu[k].t1, 0); }
    atomic_fetch_add(&g_gpu[k].pending, 1);
}
static void gpu_tag_done(uint64_t f, double g0, double g1) {
    sysload_note_gpu(g0, g1);   // the load line's game GPU share
    unsigned k = f % GRING;
    if (atomic_load(&g_gpu[k].frame) != f) return;
    double d = g1 - g0;
    if (d > 0) {
        atomic_fetch_add(&g_gpu[k].ns, (uint64_t)(d * 1e9));
        uint64_t s0 = (uint64_t)(g0 * 1e9), s1 = (uint64_t)(g1 * 1e9), v;
        for (v = atomic_load(&g_gpu[k].t0); s0 < v && !atomic_compare_exchange_weak(&g_gpu[k].t0, &v, s0);) {}
        for (v = atomic_load(&g_gpu[k].t1); s1 > v && !atomic_compare_exchange_weak(&g_gpu[k].t1, &v, s1);) {}
    }
    atomic_fetch_sub(&g_gpu[k].pending, 1);
}
static void gpu_tag_f(id<MTLCommandBuffer> cb, uint64_t f) { gpu_tag_begin(f); [cb addCompletedHandler:^(id<MTLCommandBuffer> c) { gpu_tag_done(f, c.GPUStartTime, c.GPUEndTime); }]; }
void gpu_tag(id<MTLCommandBuffer> cb) { gpu_tag_f(cb, atomic_load(&g_cur_frame)); }
double mtl_gpu_ms(uint64_t f) {
    unsigned k = f % GRING;
    if (atomic_load(&g_gpu[k].frame) != f || atomic_load(&g_gpu[k].pending)) return -1;
    return atomic_load(&g_gpu[k].ns) / 1e6;
}
int mtl_gpu_span(uint64_t f, uint64_t *t0, uint64_t *t1) {
    unsigned k = f % GRING;
    if (atomic_load(&g_gpu[k].frame) != f || atomic_load(&g_gpu[k].pending)) return 0;
    *t0 = atomic_load(&g_gpu[k].t0); *t1 = atomic_load(&g_gpu[k].t1);
    return *t1 >= *t0 && *t1;
}
static void rp_flush(void);
static const char *cctx_snap(void);   // 这次提交里有什么（出错时打进红行；定义在 mtl_exec 之前） | What is in this submission (printed into the failure line on error; defined before mtl_exec)
/* TOTK: mid-submission commits. The game puts a whole frame into one nvnQueueSubmitCommands and waits for that frame's
   fence before it submits the next one, so replaying the frame and executing it on the GPU were strictly serial. Between
   encoders the work encoded so far is committed as its own command buffer and the submission continues in a fresh one
   from the same allocator, so the GPU starts on the first passes while the replay encodes the rest. Every encoder starts
   with a queue barrier (enc_r_begin / enc_c_begin), which orders it after all earlier work on the queue, across command
   buffers too; this submission's uploads are flushed first so they stay ahead of the draws that use them. The fence,
   counter / query write-backs, arena and deferred releases stay on the final command buffer (mtl_sub_commit).
   TOTK_CHUNK_DRAWS=<n> (default 40, 0 = off) and TOTK_CHUNK_FIRST=<n> (default 30) set the draws per chunk; uncapped world-scene
   frame means: 150/500 12.50 ms, 60/150 11.85 ms, 60/100 11.73 ms, 60/75 11.66 ms (the GPU waits less for the next chunk).
   1.4.3 on the Mac (2026-10-21, one game per scene, alternating): shrine (12k draws) 60/75 10.77 -> 30/40 10.60 ms (off 14.93,
   20/25 10.63, 120/150 10.97), field 11.13 -> 11.02, Lookout Landing 11.22 -> 11.03; GPU time unchanged. */
static id<MTL4RenderCommandEncoder> g_enc;   // tentative declarations: defined with the render pass state further down
static uint64_t g_stat_draw;
static uint64_t g_pass_draw0;   // g_stat_draw when the current render pass opened (TOTK_TIMELINE)
static int g_chunk_first = -1, g_chunk_size, g_sub_chunks;
static _Atomic int g_chunk_first_request = -1, g_chunk_size_request = -1;
static uint64_t g_chunk_mark, g_chunk_commits;
static void chunk_cfg(void) {
    // Apply control-thread requests only at submission boundaries. Encoder,
    // allocator, barriers and final fence lifetime remain on the replay thread.
    static int base_first = -1, base_size;
    if (base_first < 0) {
        const char *e = getenv("TOTK_CHUNK_DRAWS"), *f = getenv("TOTK_CHUNK_FIRST");
        base_size = e ? atoi(e) : 40; base_first = f ? atoi(f) : 30;
        if (base_size <= 0 || base_first <= 0) base_size = base_first = 0;
    }
    int size = atomic_load(&g_chunk_size_request), first = atomic_load(&g_chunk_first_request);
    if (size < 0) size = base_size;
    if (first < 0) first = base_first;
    if (!size || !first) size = first = 0;
    if (size != g_chunk_size || first != g_chunk_first)
        MLOG("TOTK: mid-submission commits %s (first after %d draws, then every %d draws)", size ? "on" : "off", first, size);
    g_chunk_size = size; g_chunk_first = first;
}
uint64_t mtl_chunk_commits(void) { return g_chunk_commits; }
void mtl_blit_stats(uint64_t v[6]) { v[0] = g_blit_opens; v[1] = g_blit_splits; v[2] = g_upd_n; v[3] = g_upd_split; v[4] = g_copy_n; v[5] = g_copy_split; }
static void mtl_sub_split(void) {
    uint64_t fc0 = clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW); int fc_first = g_sub_chunks == 0;
    rs_sync();   // TOTK: the encode stage must have finished every pass of this command buffer
    uint64_t fc1 = clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW);
    up_flush();
    uint64_t fc2 = clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW);
    res_commit();
    uint64_t fc3 = clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW);
    uint64_t gpu_f = atomic_load(&g_cur_frame), fence_next = g_fence + 1; gpu_tag_begin(gpu_f);
    TotkCommitOptions *o = [TotkCommitOptions new];
    [o addFeedbackHandler:^(id<MTL4CommitFeedback> f) {
        gpu_tag_done(gpu_f, f.GPUStartTime, f.GPUEndTime);
        if (f.error) { atomic_store(&g_last_commit_error, 1); static int n; if (n++ < 8) MLOG("【红】分段命令缓冲错误 fence=%llu：%s", (unsigned long long)fence_next, f.error.description.UTF8String); }
    }];
    if (totk_tl_on()) { uint64_t tlid = totk_tl_commit_id(); totk_tl(TL_COMMIT, tlid, 0);
        [o addFeedbackHandler:^(id<MTL4CommitFeedback> fb) { totk_tl_at(TL_GPU, (uint64_t)(fb.GPUStartTime * 1e9), tlid, (uint64_t)(fb.GPUEndTime * 1e9)); }]; }
    [g_cb endCommandBuffer];
    q4_commit(g_cb, o);
    g_cb = [g_dev newCommandBuffer];
    cb4_begin(g_cb, g_alloc4[g_alloc_cur]);
    g_sub_chunks++; g_chunk_commits++; g_chunk_mark = g_stat_draw;
    if (fc_first) { uint64_t fc4 = clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW); g_fc_t[1] += fc0 - g_fc_snap_end; g_fc_t[2] += fc1 - fc0; g_fc_t[3] += fc2 - fc1; g_fc_t[4] += fc3 - fc2; g_fc_t[5] += fc4 - fc3; g_fc_n++; }
}
// Called where a new encoder is about to be opened and none is open.
static void chunk_maybe_split(void) {
    if (!g_chunk_size || !g_cb || g_enc || g_frz_on || tbdr_on() || pt_active()) return;
    if (g_stat_draw - g_chunk_mark < (uint64_t)(g_sub_chunks ? g_chunk_size : g_chunk_first)) return;
    if (g_blit) { enc_b_end(g_blit); g_blit = nil; }
    mtl_sub_split();
}
static void pre_emit(void);
uint64_t mtl_sub_commit(void) {
    cg_flush();   // TOTK: cube-face-set groups still pending at the end of the submission (reason 4 in the stats line)
    defer_fallback();   // 推迟合并通道：提交结束仍有未回放的 P 绘制（正常路径不会到这里） | Deferred merged pass: at the end of the submission there are still P draws not replayed (the normal path never gets here)
    rp_flush();
    usnap_finish();   // TOTK: the helper threads must be done with the copies (they are, long before this)
    g_nusnap = 0;   // TOTK: the replay is done; the uniform copies stay in this submission's arena until it completes
    upd_flush();   // TOTK: renamed uniform updates reach memory here, after every draw that read them through private copies
    pre_emit();   // 0m: copies of renderings the game keeps reading back, after every pass of this submission
    if (g_blit) { enc_b_end(g_blit); g_blit = nil; }
    rs_sub_end();   // TOTK: encode stage drained before the command buffer is ended
    up_flush();
    uint64_t fence = ++g_fence;
    if (g_vis_ring_i >= 0) g_vis_ring[g_vis_ring_i].fence = fence;
    // 完成后的 CPU 可见效果：拷贝一份操作表进回调
    // CPU-visible effects after completion: copy the op table into the callback
    int n = g_npost; post_op *ops = n ? malloc(n * sizeof *ops) : NULL;
    if (n) memcpy(ops, g_post, n * sizeof *ops);
    if (g_skv_n) {   // TOTK_EXP_SKIP_INVISIBLE: read this submission's per-draw counters on completion
        skv_item *l = g_skv_list; int n = g_skv_n; uint32_t fr = (uint32_t)atomic_load(&g_cur_frame); g_skv_list = NULL; g_skv_n = g_skv_cap = 0;
        [g_commit_blocks addObject:^{ skv_done(l, n, fr); }];
        static uint64_t subs; if (++subs % 300 == 0) MLOG("跳过不可见绘制 至提交 %llu：绘制 %llu，跳过 %llu（%.1f%%），测了 %llu，重测 %llu（重测后又可见 %llu），表满 %llu，着色器会写内存不跳 %llu%s%s", (unsigned long long)subs, (unsigned long long)g_skv_draws, (unsigned long long)g_skv_skipped, 100.0 * (double)g_skv_skipped / (double)(g_skv_draws ? g_skv_draws : 1), (unsigned long long)g_skv_tested, (unsigned long long)g_skv_retests, (unsigned long long)g_skv_revived, (unsigned long long)g_skv_full, (unsigned long long)g_skv_effects, skv_skip_storers() ? "" : "（严格：会写内存的几何也不跳）", skv_retest() ? "" : "（不重测，只量开销）");
    }
    if (g_anom_nvis) {   // TOTK_ANOMALY per-draw counters: read once this submission completes
        int cnt = g_anom_nvis; anom_vis_ent *copy = malloc((size_t)cnt * sizeof *copy); if (!copy) MDIE("anomaly counters");
        memcpy(copy, g_anom_vis, (size_t)cnt * sizeof *copy); g_anom_nvis = 0;
        [g_commit_blocks addObject:^{ anom_vis_done(copy, cnt); free(copy); }];
    }
    NSArray<dispatch_block_t> *commit_blocks = [g_commit_blocks copy];
    TotkCommitOptions *o = [TotkCommitOptions new];
    [o addFeedbackHandler:^(id<MTL4CommitFeedback> f) { (void)f; for (dispatch_block_t block in commit_blocks) block(); }];
    uint64_t gpu_f = atomic_load(&g_cur_frame); gpu_tag_begin(gpu_f);
    NSString *cctx = @(cctx_snap());
    [o addFeedbackHandler:^(id<MTL4CommitFeedback> cb) {
        gpu_tag_done(gpu_f, cb.GPUStartTime, cb.GPUEndTime);
        if (cb.error) { atomic_store(&g_last_commit_error, 1); static int n, nv; int victim = [cb.error.description containsString:@"InnocentVictim"]; if (victim ? nv++ < 1 : n++ < 8) MLOG("【红】命令缓冲错误详情 fence=%llu：%s | GPU %.3f→%.3f", (unsigned long long)fence, cb.error.description.UTF8String, cb.GPUStartTime, cb.GPUEndTime); if (!victim) MLOG("【红】出错那次提交的现场 fence=%llu：%s", (unsigned long long)fence, cctx.UTF8String); MLOG("【红】命令缓冲执行出错：%s", cb.error.localizedDescription.UTF8String); }
        int nq = 0, nzero = 0;   // TOTK_OCCL_AUTODUMP: occlusion queries of this submission and how many reported 0
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (ops[i].kind == 1) { if (ops[i].mode == 1) *ops[i].val += ops[i].v; else *ops[i].val = ops[i].v; }
            else if (ops[i].kind == 3) {   // 通过采样数：自清零以来各槽之和 | Samples passed: the sum of all slots since the reset
                vis_list *l = ops[i].vis; uint64_t sum = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < l->n; k++) { const uint64_t *c = ((__bridge id<MTLBuffer>)l->s[k].buf).contents; for (uint32_t q = 0; q <= l->s[k].n; q++) sum += c[l->s[k].slot + q]; CFRelease(l->s[k].buf); }
                static int qlog = -1; if (qlog < 0) qlog = getenv("TOTK_QUERY_LOG") != NULL;
                if (qlog) MLOG("[query] frame=%llu fence=%llu addr=%#llx slots=%d samples=%llu", (unsigned long long)gpu_f, (unsigned long long)fence, (unsigned long long)ops[i].addr, l->n, (unsigned long long)sum);
                if (ops[i].qlog) MLOG("[query] F%llu dst=%#llx samples=%llu sphere=%g,%g,%g,%g%s", (unsigned long long)gpu_f, (unsigned long long)ops[i].addr, (unsigned long long)sum,
                                      ops[i].sph[0], ops[i].sph[1], ops[i].sph[2], ops[i].sph[3], atomic_load(&g_occl_vis) ? " (reported as visible: occl_visible)" : "");
                if (atomic_load(&g_occl_vis)) sum = 1u << 20;
                nq++; nzero += sum == 0;
                free(l); uint64_t rec[2] = {sum, gpu_ticks()}; memcpy((void *)ops[i].addr, rec, sizeof rec);
            }
            // TOTK: NVNcounterData = {counter, timestamp}; TIMESTAMP / TIMESTAMP_TOP reports write counter 0 (the timestamp is the second word).
            // The game's conditional clears depend on that 0 (see cond_eval); other unimplemented counter types also report 0.
            else { uint64_t t = gpu_ticks(), rec[2] = {0, t}; memcpy((void *)ops[i].addr, rec, sizeof rec); }
        }
        free(ops);
        /* TOTK_OCCL_AUTODUMP=<dir>: when every occlusion query of a frame reported 0 (the game then culls all queried
           objects: NPCs vanished), capture the following frames on the spot: their query results, a full pass dump and
           the texture dump (with DM_NVN_TEXSNAP_DEPTH=256x144 also the occluder depth). A few captures per session. */
        { static const char *dir; static int init, done; static uint64_t last_f;
          if (!init) { init = 1; dir = getenv("TOTK_OCCL_AUTODUMP"); }
          if (dir && nq >= 5 && nzero == nq && done < 3 && (!last_f || gpu_f > last_f + 600)) {
              done++; last_f = gpu_f; char path[1024]; snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/z%d-%%d.png", dir, done);
              MLOG("[occl] all %d occlusion queries of frame %llu reported 0: capture %d of the next frames -> %s", nq, (unsigned long long)gpu_f, done, path);
              dm_gfx_querylog_next(60); dm_gfx_passdump_next(1); dm_gfx_texdump_next(path);
          } }
        /* TOTK: occlusion statistics every 1200 frames -- frames whose queries all reported 0 (the game then culls every
           queried object: NPCs vanish) and the share of results that were 0 -- to compare runs without captures. */
        { static uint64_t f0, nf, nall0, nres, nres0;
          if (nq) { nf++; nres += (uint64_t)nq; nres0 += (uint64_t)nzero; nall0 += nq >= 5 && nzero == nq; }
          if (!f0) f0 = gpu_f;
          if (gpu_f >= f0 + 1200) {
              if (nf) MLOG("[occl] frames %llu-%llu: %llu with occlusion queries, %llu with all of them 0; %.1f%% of %llu results 0", (unsigned long long)f0,
                           (unsigned long long)gpu_f, (unsigned long long)nf, (unsigned long long)nall0, 100.0 * (double)nres0 / (double)nres, (unsigned long long)nres);
              f0 = gpu_f; nf = nall0 = nres = nres0 = 0;
          } }
        cpend_done(fence);
        pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mu); if (fence > g_done) g_done = fence; pthread_cond_broadcast(&g_cv); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mu);
        defer_drain();
    }];
    void arena_commit(uint64_t fence); arena_commit(fence);
    pt_finish(g_cb, o, gpu_f);
    res_commit();
    if (totk_tl_on()) { uint64_t tlid = totk_tl_commit_id(); totk_tl(TL_COMMIT, tlid, 1); totk_tl(TL_FENCE, tlid, fence);
        [o addFeedbackHandler:^(id<MTL4CommitFeedback> fb) { totk_tl_at(TL_GPU, (uint64_t)(fb.GPUStartTime * 1e9), tlid, (uint64_t)(fb.GPUEndTime * 1e9)); }]; }
    [g_cb endCommandBuffer];
    q4_commit(g_cb, o);
    if (nogpu()) g_ev.signaledValue = fence; else [g_q4 signalEvent:g_ev value:fence];
    dead_put_flush();   // textures created for finalized serials: released once this submission completes
    stor_sweep(fence);   // TOTK: storage-shared textures nobody held for a while
    treg_sweep_replaced();   // descriptor caches must not retain replaced CPU-uploaded storage indefinitely
    type_views_sweep_retired();
    pkg_evict_sweep();   // TOTK (iPhone): drop long-unused copies of CPU-pool textures under memory pressure
    pkg_orphan_report();
    g_alloc_fence[g_alloc_cur] = fence;
    g_cb = nil;
    g_commit_blocks = nil;
    objc_autoreleasePoolPop(g_sub_pool); g_sub_pool = NULL;
    return fence;
}

uint64_t mtl_last_fence(void) { return g_fence; }
int mtl_last_commit_error(void) { return atomic_load(&g_last_commit_error); }

int mtl_wait(uint64_t fence, uint64_t timeout_ns) {
    struct timespec dl; clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &dl);
    uint64_t ns = (uint64_t)dl.tv_nsec + (timeout_ns > 3600000000000ull ? 3600000000000ull : timeout_ns);
    dl.tv_sec += ns / 1000000000ull; dl.tv_nsec = ns % 1000000000ull;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mu);
    int r = 0;
    while (g_done < fence) if ((r = pthread_cond_timedwait(&g_cv, &g_mu, &dl))) break;
    int ok = g_done >= fence;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mu);
    return ok;
}

static void mtl_finish_gpu(void) {
    if (g_fence) mtl_wait(g_fence, UINT64_MAX);
    while (atomic_load(&g_up_pending)) usleep(1000);
}
void mtl_present_flush(void);
void mtl_finish(void) { mtl_present_flush(); mtl_finish_gpu(); }   // 队列语义：已入队的出图也算队列工作 | Queue semantics: already-enqueued presents also count as queue work
static void present_drop_for_suspend(void);
void mtl_drain(void) { present_drop_for_suspend(); mtl_present_flush(); mtl_init(); id<MTLCommandBuffer> cb = q_cb(); cb_commit(cb); cb_wait(cb); mtl_finish_gpu(); }

// ================= 渲染回放 =================
// ================= Render replay =================
#include "../../host/front.h"
static int g_red_once[128];
#define RED_ONCE(k, ...) do { if (!g_red_once[k]++) MLOG("【红】" __VA_ARGS__); } while (0)

// ---------- 贴图 → MTLTexture ----------
// ---------- Texture → MTLTexture ----------
static int fmt_compressed(int f) { return (f >= 0x41 && f <= 0x50) || (f >= 0x79 && f <= 0x94); }
static int fmt_depth(int f) { return f >= 0x31 && f <= 0x36; }
typedef struct { MTLPixelFormat a, b; } pfv_pair;
static const pfv_pair g_pfv_srgb[] = {
    {MTLPixelFormatRGBA8Unorm, MTLPixelFormatRGBA8Unorm_sRGB},
    {MTLPixelFormatBGRA8Unorm, MTLPixelFormatBGRA8Unorm_sRGB},
    {MTLPixelFormatBC1_RGBA, MTLPixelFormatBC1_RGBA_sRGB},
    {MTLPixelFormatBC2_RGBA, MTLPixelFormatBC2_RGBA_sRGB},
    {MTLPixelFormatBC3_RGBA, MTLPixelFormatBC3_RGBA_sRGB},
    {MTLPixelFormatBC7_RGBAUnorm, MTLPixelFormatBC7_RGBAUnorm_sRGB},
};
static int tex_need_pfv(MTLPixelFormat base, MTLPixelFormat view) {
    if (base == view) return 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof g_pfv_srgb / sizeof *g_pfv_srgb; i++)
        if ((base == g_pfv_srgb[i].a && view == g_pfv_srgb[i].b) || (base == g_pfv_srgb[i].b && view == g_pfv_srgb[i].a)) return 0;
    return 1;
}
// 回放热路径的缓存表一律用 nvn_hmap（C 哈希，键不装箱）；表里存 CFBridgingRetain 过的对象，替换 / 删除时 CFRelease
// Cache tables on the replay hot path always use nvn_hmap (C hash, keys not boxed); the table stores CFBridgingRetain'ed objects, CFRelease'd on replace / delete
static void hm_rel(void *v) { CFRelease(v); }
static __unsafe_unretained id hm_get_id(const nvn_hmap *m, const void *k) { return (__bridge id)nvn_hm_get(m, k); }
static void hm_put_id(nvn_hmap *m, const void *k, id o) { void *old = nvn_hm_put(m, k, (void *)CFBridgingRetain(o)); if (old) CFRelease(old); }
static void hm_del_id(nvn_hmap *m, const void *k) { void *old = nvn_hm_del(m, k); if (old) CFRelease(old); }
static nvn_hmap g_by_serial = {.klen = 8};     // 序号 → MTLTexture / NvPkg / NvProg | Serial → MTLTexture / NvPkg / NvProg
static pthread_mutex_t g_smu = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
// 序号表代号：表项增删、预排布贴图换新时 +1。下游缓存（贴图视图、程序）记下取用时的代号，代号未变即可直接用、不必再查表
// Serial table generation: +1 when entries are added / removed or a packaged texture is replaced. Downstream caches (texture views, programs) record the generation at fetch time; if it is unchanged they can be used directly without another table lookup
static _Atomic uint64_t g_ser_gen = 1;
static uint64_t g_treg_same, g_treg_changed;   // TOTK: identical / changed texture registrations (memory readout line)
/* TOTK: which serial each generation step was for (g_ser_chg[gen % SER_CHG_N]; 0 = not one serial, every cache must
   look again). A texture-ID view cache whose own serial is not among the steps since it was validated stays valid: the
   ~34 per-frame re-uploads of small CPU-written textures used to send every bound texture of every following draw down
   the slow path (about 13% of the replay). Written under g_smu before the generation is published. */
#define SER_CHG_N 1024
static _Atomic uint64_t g_ser_chg[SER_CHG_N];
static void ser_bump_locked(uint64_t serial) {
    uint64_t g = atomic_load_explicit(&g_ser_gen, memory_order_relaxed) + 1;
    atomic_store_explicit(&g_ser_chg[g % SER_CHG_N], serial, memory_order_relaxed);
    atomic_store_explicit(&g_ser_gen, g, memory_order_release);
}
static void ser_bump(uint64_t serial);
/* 1 when none of the generation steps (from, to] was for this serial (or for "everything"). */
static int ser_unaffected(uint64_t from, uint64_t to, uint64_t serial) {
    if (!serial || to - from >= SER_CHG_N) return 0;
    for (uint64_t g = from + 1; g <= to; g++) { uint64_t s = atomic_load_explicit(&g_ser_chg[g % SER_CHG_N], memory_order_relaxed); if (!s || s == serial) return 0; }
    return atomic_load_explicit(&g_ser_gen, memory_order_acquire) - from < SER_CHG_N;   // no slot was overwritten while scanning
}
// ---------- TOTK: storage-shared GPU textures ----------
/* Several live NVNtexture objects can describe the same pool memory with the same layout: the game registers a
   persistent sampling object in the texture pool (e.g. serial 75485, the normals G-buffer) and re-initialises the
   render-target object at the same storage every frame (serial 75569). On hardware both descriptors read the same
   bytes; here every serial used to get its own private MTLTexture, so what was rendered through one serial was
   invisible through the other (the deferred lighting read all-zero normals: black geometry). GPU-owned textures are
   now keyed by (storage, layout): the same pixel format shares the MTLTexture, a different uncompressed format of the
   same texel size gets a texture view on it, and a usage the base lacks recreates the base with the union (content
   copied on the GPU timeline). An entry keeps its content while any serial holds it and for STOR_IDLE_SUBMITS
   submissions after the last holder left (previous-frame buffers are re-initialised every frame), and is dropped
   when its memory pool is finalised. TOTK_TEX_SHARE=0 restores one texture per serial. */
int nvn_fmt_bpb(int format, int *bw, int *bh);
typedef struct { uint64_t mem, size; uint32_t w, h, d, levels, target, samples, bpb, depth_fmt; } stor_key;   // 48 bytes, no padding
typedef struct { stor_key k; void *tex; uint64_t idle_fence; uint64_t *ser; int nser, cser; } stor_ent;      // tex: CFBridgingRetain'ed base texture; ser: serials holding it or a view on it
static nvn_hmap g_by_storage = {.klen = sizeof(stor_key)};   // stor_key -> stor_ent *
static nvn_hmap g_stor_of_obj = {.klen = 8};                  // base texture / view pointer -> stor_ent *
static uint64_t g_stor_entries, g_stor_shared, g_stor_viewed, g_stor_recreated, g_stor_swept, g_stor_dropped;
/* Texture preparation runs before a draw captures its encoder. An upgrade discovered under the
   registry lock requests a pass split; the caller ends the pass outside that lock and retries. */
static int g_tex_preparing, g_tex_prepare_split;
#define STOR_IDLE_SUBMITS 600
static int stor_on(void) { static int on = -1; if (on < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_TEX_SHARE"); on = !e || atoi(e); } return on; }
static int stor_key_of(const tex_t *t, stor_key *k) {
    if (!t->mem || !t->L.size) return 0;
    int bw = 1, bh = 1, bpb = nvn_fmt_bpb(t->d.format, &bw, &bh);
    if (!bpb || bw != 1 || bh != 1) return 0;   // block-compressed formats keep one texture per serial (no cross-format views)
    memset(k, 0, sizeof *k);
    k->mem = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)t->mem; k->size = t->L.size; k->w = t->d.width ? t->d.width : 1; k->h = t->d.height ? t->d.height : 1; k->d = t->d.depth ? t->d.depth : 1; k->levels = t->d.levels ? t->d.levels : 1;
    k->target = (uint32_t)t->d.target; k->samples = t->d.samples > 1 ? (uint32_t)t->d.samples : 1; k->bpb = (uint32_t)bpb; k->depth_fmt = (uint32_t)fmt_depth(t->d.format);
    return 1;
}
static inline uint64_t obj_key(id o) { return (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(__bridge void *)o; }
/* g_smu held: a serial starts / stops holding a storage-owned object. stor_unref_locked returns 1 for a storage-owned
   object, which the caller must only unref (the entry keeps it resident); a dropped view leaves the object table. */
static void stor_ref_locked(id o, uint64_t serial) {
    uint64_t ok = obj_key(o); stor_ent *e = nvn_hm_get(&g_stor_of_obj, &ok); if (!e) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < e->nser; i++) if (e->ser[i] == serial) return;
    if (e->nser == e->cser) { e->cser = e->cser ? e->cser * 2 : 4; e->ser = realloc(e->ser, (size_t)e->cser * sizeof *e->ser); if (!e->ser) MDIE("storage serial list"); }
    e->ser[e->nser++] = serial;
}
static int stor_unref_locked(id o, uint64_t serial) {
    uint64_t ok = obj_key(o); stor_ent *e = nvn_hm_get(&g_stor_of_obj, &ok); if (!e) return 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < e->nser; i++) if (e->ser[i] == serial) { e->ser[i] = e->ser[--e->nser]; break; }
    if (!e->nser) e->idle_fence = g_fence;
    if ((__bridge void *)o != e->tex) nvn_hm_del(&g_stor_of_obj, &ok);
    return 1;
}
static int stor_key_lookup(id o, stor_key *k);
static id<MTLTexture> stor_recreate(const stor_key *k, MTLTextureUsage usage);
static id<MTLTexture> tex_mtl(const tex_t *ct);
static int rp_active(void);
/* TOTK: plain pointers for the replay hot paths. The functions above return id, and the __unsafe_unretained on their
   return types is ignored by ARC, so every lookup was a retain / autorelease pair. Table entries are only freed through
   the deferred-release queue, which the replay thread drains, so the replay may hold these unretained. */
static inline void *hm_get_ptr(const nvn_hmap *m, const void *k) { return nvn_hm_get(m, k); }
static void *serial_ptr(uint64_t k) { pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu); void *o = nvn_hm_get(&g_by_serial, &k); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu); return o; }
static __unsafe_unretained id serial_get(uint64_t k) { pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu); __unsafe_unretained id o = hm_get_id(&g_by_serial, &k); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu); return o; }
static void serial_put(uint64_t k, id o) { pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu); id old = hm_get_id(&g_by_serial, &k); if (old) { if (stor_unref_locked(old, k)) defer_obj_unref(old); else defer_obj_release(old); } hm_put_id(&g_by_serial, &k, o); stor_ref_locked(o, k); ser_bump_locked(k); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu); }
static void serial_del(uint64_t k) { pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu); id old = hm_get_id(&g_by_serial, &k); if (old) { if (stor_unref_locked(old, k)) defer_obj_unref(old); else defer_obj_release(old); } hm_del_id(&g_by_serial, &k); ser_bump_locked(k); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu); BOTW_SERIAL_NOTE(k, "serial_del") }
static void ser_bump(uint64_t serial) { pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu); ser_bump_locked(serial); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu); }
/* Dead serials (TOTK): the game finalizes temporary NVNtexture objects after recording and before the submission runs,
   so a replay may meet a serial that was already finalized. Previously the replay created a Metal texture for it and
   stored it under the serial, where nothing ever deleted it: about 4.6 textures (~18 MB) leaked per frame, the
   residency set grew without bound and the GPU driver ran out of wired memory (kernel panics). A texture created
   for a dead serial is now deleted again when the submission that used it completes. */
static totk_serial_set g_dead_serial;   // serial -> (void *)1 once finalized
/* TOTK: serials the GPU has rendered into. A mirrored (CPU-pool) texture that the game then uses as a render target is owned by
   the GPU from that point: dirty-page re-uploads from the (stale) pool memory would wipe the rendered content. */
static totk_serial_set g_gpu_owned;
static _Atomic uint64_t g_owned_gen = 1;   // TOTK: bumped whenever a serial joins g_gpu_owned (entries are never removed)
static void pkg_owned_locked(uint64_t k);
static void gpu_owned_mark(uint64_t k) { pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu); int had = totk_serial_has(&g_gpu_owned, k); if (!had) { totk_serial_add(&g_gpu_owned, k); atomic_fetch_add(&g_owned_gen, 1); pkg_owned_locked(k); } pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu);
}
static int gpu_owned(uint64_t k) { pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu); int d = totk_serial_has(&g_gpu_owned, k); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu); return d; }

static uint64_t *g_dead_put; static int g_dead_put_n, g_dead_put_cap; static uint64_t g_dead_put_total;
static int serial_is_dead(uint64_t k) { pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu); int d = totk_serial_has(&g_dead_serial, k); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu); return d; }
/* 2026-10-20: a finalised serial is forgotten (dropped from g_dead_serial and g_gpu_owned) once nothing can bring it back:
   no recording copy names it (dm_nvn_pin_has_serial: only a recording's texture copy brings a serial to the replay) and
   no texture-pool slot is registered with it (g_treg_refs, kept by mtl_reg_tex and tex_by_id's redirect: such a slot still
   follows the serial to the live texture at its memory). Before, both sets only grew: Breath of the Wild finalises about
   80 textures a frame and had 17.4 million entries after 30 minutes on a static screen, TOTK about 130 MB in 27 minutes. */
static nvn_hmap g_treg_refs = {.klen = 8};   /* serial -> pool slots registered with it (g_rmu) */
static uint64_t g_serial_forgotten;
static void treg_ref_locked(uint64_t serial, int delta) {   /* g_rmu held */
    if (!serial) return;
    uintptr_t n = (uintptr_t)nvn_hm_get(&g_treg_refs, &serial);
    n = delta > 0 ? n + 1 : n ? n - 1 : 0;
    if (n) nvn_hm_put(&g_treg_refs, &serial, (void *)n); else nvn_hm_del(&g_treg_refs, &serial);
}
static void serial_forget_locked_rmu(uint64_t k) {   /* g_rmu held (g_rmu -> g_pin_mu and g_rmu -> g_smu are the allowed orders) */
    extern int dm_nvn_pin_has_serial(uint64_t serial);
    if (!k || nvn_hm_get(&g_treg_refs, &k) || dm_nvn_pin_has_serial(k)) return;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu);
    if (totk_serial_del(&g_dead_serial, k)) g_serial_forgotten++;
    totk_serial_del(&g_gpu_owned, k);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu);
}
static inline int registry_lock(void); static inline void registry_unlock(void);
static void serial_forget_if_unreferenced(uint64_t k) { registry_lock(); serial_forget_locked_rmu(k); registry_unlock(); }
static void dead_put_note(uint64_t k) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu);
    if (g_dead_put_n == g_dead_put_cap) { g_dead_put_cap = g_dead_put_cap ? g_dead_put_cap * 2 : 256; g_dead_put = realloc(g_dead_put, g_dead_put_cap * sizeof *g_dead_put); if (!g_dead_put) MDIE("dead-serial list"); }
    g_dead_put[g_dead_put_n++] = k; g_dead_put_total++;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu);
}
/* Called at the end of every submission: textures created for already-finalized serials are released after it completes. */
static void dead_put_flush(void) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu); int n = g_dead_put_n; uint64_t *l = n ? malloc(n * sizeof *l) : NULL; if (n) memcpy(l, g_dead_put, n * sizeof *l); g_dead_put_n = 0; pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { BOTW_DEAD_KEEP(l[i]) BOTW_SERIAL_NOTE(l[i], "dead_put_flush") serial_del(l[i]); treg_drop_serial(l[i]); }
    free(l);
}
uint64_t mtl_dead_serial_textures(void) { return g_dead_put_total; }
// 预排布贴图的宿主记录：当前 MTLTexture、上传戳、上次检查时的全局写代号
// Host record of a packaged texture: the current MTLTexture, the upload stamp, and the global write generation at the last check
typedef struct { uint64_t pf, type, w, h, z, levels, layers, samples, usage, storage; uint8_t swz[4]; } reup_key;   // TOTK: what tex_desc varies between mirrored textures (re-upload recycling, see reup_take)
/* Same-shader argument blocks may survive intervening program changes only

        e = getenv("TOTK_ARG_EPOCH_CHECK"); atomic_store(&g_arg_epoch_check, e && atoi(e)); }
    return v;
}

static _Atomic int g_pkg_final_cache = -1;

    int v = atomic_load(&g_pkg_final_cache);

@interface NvPkg : NSObject { @public id<MTLTexture> tex; uint64_t stamp, seen, hash, owned_gen; int tracked, owned, hashed; reup_key key; uint64_t chash, csub, used; uintptr_t lo, hi; uint8_t *edge; uint32_t eh, et; int edge_want; } @end   // lo / hi (TOTK): the texture's memory (pkg_orphan_report)   // tracked (TOTK): result of the last nvn_dirty_tracked   // hash：DM_NVN_DIRTYCHECK 时上传内容的全量哈希 | hash: full hash of the uploaded content under DM_NVN_DIRTYCHECK
/* TOTK: a mirrored texture the GPU starts rendering into is told directly (g_smu held), so tex_mtl no longer asks the owned
   set again every time any other serial joins it (a locked lookup per CPU-pool texture per new render target). */
static void pkg_owned_locked(uint64_t k) { id o = hm_get_id(&g_by_serial, &k); if ([o isKindOfClass:[NvPkg class]]) ((NvPkg *)o)->owned = 1; }
@implementation NvPkg
- (void)dealloc {
    free(edge);   // TOTK (#90): the shared first / last page bytes (pkg_edge_snap)
    // The wrapper is released after its GPU readers finish. Recycle its allocation
    // with the same descriptor key as a re-upload, retaining residency. The next
    // owner overwrites every mip/layer; cached views are retired by the normal path.
    if (!owned && pkg_final_cache_on() && reup_offer(tex, &key)) atomic_fetch_add(&g_pkg_final_kept, 1);
    else res_remove(tex);
}
@end
/* TOTK: GPU renderings into CPU-visible memory pools reach that memory when the CPU invalidates it.
   On hardware the GPU writes the texture's memory, and the game reads it back with the CPU after
   nvnMemoryPoolInvalidateMappedRange (CPU-cached pools). Here a mirrored texture the GPU renders into keeps the result
   only in its MTLTexture, so the game read the bytes it had uploaded before. The game bakes terrain tile normals on the
   GPU into such a pool and copies them with the CPU into new tiles: after moving, new tiles got stale normals and the
   ground turned black block by block (2026-10-15). Each rendering of a mirrored texture is noted here (with a reference,
   so the result outlives a temporary texture object finalized before the submission runs); an invalidate over its
