// 预热项：后台建好、等提交线程领用。vs / fs 强引用（pso 里只是裸指针，后台字典随任务结束释放）
// Warm-up entry: built in the background, waiting to be taken by the submit thread. vs / fs are strong references (in pso they are only raw pointers, and the background dictionary is released when the task ends)
@interface WarmItem : NSObject { @public int kind; NSString *key, *vs_key, *fs_key; NvShader *shader, *vs, *fs; pso_key pso; id<MTLFunction> fsfn; id object; } @end
@implementation WarmItem @end
static NSMutableDictionary<NSString *, NvShader *> *g_shcache;

/* TOTK (2026-10-17): every c1 read of the shader stays inside its own data, so it can share a bank (c1_store). D2R decides
   this offline (c1_full.tsv from tools/c1_guard.py); TOTK never had that list, so every shader got its own 64 KiB of zeros
   (5,257 of them, 328 MB of GPU memory and as many residency-set objects after a long session), and an offline list would
   also miss the variants translated while playing. Decided from the MSL at load instead: shareable only if every
   "<stage>_c1)._m0[<index>]" index is a plain integer naming a float4 inside the data rounded up to 256 bytes plus the 256
   zero bytes that follow it in the bank (reads there give zero, as the exclusive buffer would). The translated MSL reads c1
   no other way (the cache, 7,546 variants: 5,248 have c1 data, 65 of them with a computed index). No source -> own 64 KiB. */
static int c1_reads_bounded(NSString *src, size_t len) {
    if (!src) return 0;
    const size_t limit = (((len + 255u) & ~(size_t)255u) + 256u) / 16u;   /* float4s readable as own data or zeros */
    for (const char *p = src.UTF8String; (p = strstr(p, "_c1)._m0[")); ) {
        p += 9;
        char *end; unsigned long idx = strtoul(p, &end, 10);
        if (end == p || *p < '0' || *p > '9') return 0;   /* a computed index */
        if (*end == 'u') end++;
        if (*end != ']' || idx >= limit) return 0;
        p = end;
    }
    return 1;
}
static void c1_store(NvShader *o, NSString *src) {
    size_t len = o->rf.c1_len;
    NSString *guardKey = [NSString stringWithUTF8String:o->key];
    if ([guardKey hasSuffix:@"_b"]) guardKey = [guardKey substringToIndex:guardKey.length - 2];
    static int share = -1;   /* TOTK_C1_SHARE=0: every c1 its own 64 KiB again (the behaviour before 2026-10-17, for A/B) */
    if (share < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_C1_SHARE"); share = !(e && !strcmp(e, "0")); if (!share) MLOG("TOTK_C1_SHARE=0：常数段 c1 一律独占 64 KiB（不按 MSL 扫描共享）"); }
    const int bounded = share && c1_reads_bounded(src, len);
    os_unfair_lock_lock(&g_c1_lock);   // 预热线程与提交线程都会载入着色器 | Both the warm-up thread and the submit thread load shaders
    if ((g_c1_full_valid && [g_c1_full containsObject:guardKey]) || !bounded) {   // 运行时下标未证有界：独占 64 KiB 全零（同原实现） | Runtime index not proven bounded: exclusive 64 KiB of all zeros (same as the original implementation)
        o->c1buf = [g_dev newBufferWithLength:C1_DECL_SIZE options:MTLResourceStorageModeShared]; o->c1_gpu = o->c1buf.gpuAddress;
        if (!o->c1buf) { os_unfair_lock_unlock(&g_c1_lock); MDIE("c1 独占缓冲分配失败"); }
        res_add(o->c1buf);
        memset(o->c1buf.contents, 0, C1_DECL_SIZE); memcpy(o->c1buf.contents, o->rf.c1, len);
        g_c1_alloc_bytes += C1_DECL_SIZE; g_c1_data_bytes += len; g_c1_count++; g_c1_exclusive++;
        os_unfair_lock_unlock(&g_c1_lock);
        return;
    }
    size_t need = (len + 255u) & ~((size_t)255u);
    if (!g_c1_banks) g_c1_banks = [NSMutableArray array];
    if (!g_c1_banks.count || g_c1_bank_off + need + 256u + C1_DECL_SIZE > C1_BANK_SIZE) {
        id<MTLBuffer> b = [g_dev newBufferWithLength:C1_BANK_SIZE options:MTLResourceStorageModeShared];
        if (!b) { os_unfair_lock_unlock(&g_c1_lock); MDIE("c1 缓冲块分配失败"); }
        res_add(b);
        memset(b.contents, 0, C1_BANK_SIZE);
        [g_c1_banks addObject:b];
        g_c1_bank_off = 0;
        g_c1_alloc_bytes += C1_BANK_SIZE;
    }
    id<MTLBuffer> b = g_c1_banks.lastObject;
    size_t off = g_c1_bank_off;
    memcpy((uint8_t *)b.contents + off, o->rf.c1, len);
    g_c1_bank_off += need + 256u;
    g_c1_data_bytes += len;
    g_c1_count++;
    o->c1buf = b;
    o->c1_gpu = b.gpuAddress;
    o->c1off = off;
    os_unfair_lock_unlock(&g_c1_lock);
}

static NSMutableArray<WarmItem *> *g_warm_items;
static os_unfair_lock g_warm_lock = OS_UNFAIR_LOCK_INIT;
static _Atomic int g_warm_ready;
static int g_warm_started;
static uint64_t g_warm_t0;
static _Atomic int g_warm_running;   // 后台预热还没跑完（进局读取画面据此多等一会儿，见 mtl_warm_wait） | Background warm-up has not finished yet (the loading screen on entering a run waits a little longer based on this, see mtl_warm_wait)
static _Atomic int g_warm_priority_done;
static _Atomic uint64_t g_warm_library_ns,g_warm_library_count,g_warm_pipeline_ns,g_warm_pipeline_count;
static uint64_t g_warm_rps, g_warm_cps, g_warm_skip_fz;
static uint64_t g_warm_claim_shaders, g_warm_claim_rps, g_warm_claim_cps;
static id<MTLFunction> bf_fn(NvShader *fs, const int *fx, uint8_t fbmask, const uint8_t *lmap);
static int rt_range_bindings_ro(NSDictionary *j);
static FILE *g_pso_record; static int g_pso_record_checked;
static FILE *pso_record_file(void) {
    if (g_pso_record_checked) return g_pso_record;
    g_pso_record_checked = 1;
    const char *path = getenv("DM_PSO_RECORD");
    if (path && *path) g_pso_record = fopen(path, "a");
    return g_pso_record;
}
static void pso_record(const char *fmt, ...) {
    FILE *f = pso_record_file();
    if (!f) return;
    va_list ap; va_start(ap, fmt); vfprintf(f, fmt, ap); va_end(ap); fflush(f);
}
// 用户清单：本机运行中提交线程同步新建的着色器 / 管线，下次启动与种子清单一起预热。
// 路径 = DM_PSO_USER，或 DM_SAVE 的父目录，或 TOTK_PROFILE_DIR 下的 pso_user.tsv；每个本机档案独立记录。
// User manifest: shaders / pipelines created synchronously on the submit thread while running on this machine, warmed up at the next launch together with the seed manifest.
// Path = DM_PSO_USER, the parent of DM_SAVE, or TOTK_PROFILE_DIR/pso_user.tsv; each local profile records its own additions.
static NSString *pso_user_path(void) {
    const char *u = getenv("DM_PSO_USER"), *save = getenv("DM_SAVE"), *profile = getenv("TOTK_PROFILE_DIR");
    if (u && *u) return @(u);
    if (save && *save) return [[@(save) stringByDeletingLastPathComponent] stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"pso_user.tsv"];
    return [(profile && *profile ? @(profile) : @"user-data") stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"pso_user.tsv"];
}
static FILE *g_pso_user; static int g_pso_user_checked;
static NSMutableSet<NSString *> *g_pso_user_seen;
static FILE *pso_user_file(void) {
    if (g_pso_user_checked) return g_pso_user;
    g_pso_user_checked = 1;
    NSString *path = pso_user_path();
    if (path) g_pso_user = fopen(path.fileSystemRepresentation, "a");
    return g_pso_user;
}
/* TOTK automatic shader collection (user, 2026-10-16 night: "新着色器发现后自动预热、自动使用、自动放入缓存"): a new shader variant
   is translated, used and written to the translation cache at once (totk_rt_variant), every cached variant is compiled
   by the next start's warm-up, and every shader / pipeline built on the submit thread goes into the warm lists. Besides
   the per-profile list, those lines also go into one shared list next to the translation cache, so what any session
   finds (the user's game, an agent's test session on a save copy) is warmed by every later start of either checkout
   (the cache directory is shared). g_collect_new: lines added this run (S shaders, R render, C compute pipelines);
   the bottom-left box shows them (shader_overlay_prepare). */
static NSString *pso_shared_path(void) { return [totk_rt_dir() stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"pso_collected.tsv"]; }
static FILE *g_pso_shared; static int g_pso_shared_checked;
static _Atomic uint64_t g_collect_new[3], g_collect_last_ns;
static void pso_user_record(const char *fmt, ...) {
    FILE *f = pso_user_file();
    if (!g_pso_shared_checked) { g_pso_shared_checked = 1; g_pso_shared = fopen(pso_shared_path().fileSystemRepresentation, "a"); }
    if (!f && !g_pso_shared) return;
    char line[8192]; va_list ap; va_start(ap, fmt); vsnprintf(line, sizeof line, fmt, ap); va_end(ap);
    if (!g_pso_user_seen) {
        g_pso_user_seen = [NSMutableSet set];
        NSString *seed = g_shmap_path ? [g_shmap_path.stringByDeletingLastPathComponent stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"pso_manifest.tsv"] : nil;
        NSMutableArray<NSString *> *paths = [NSMutableArray array]; if (seed) [paths addObject:seed]; NSString *user = pso_user_path(); if (user) [paths addObject:user];
        [paths addObject:pso_shared_path()];
        for (NSString *path in paths) { NSString *txt = [NSString stringWithContentsOfFile:path encoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding error:nil];
            for (NSString *old in [txt componentsSeparatedByString:@"\n"]) if (old.length && ![old hasPrefix:@"#"]) [g_pso_user_seen addObject:old]; }
    }
    size_t ll = strlen(line); NSString *s = [[NSString alloc] initWithBytes:line length:ll && line[ll - 1] == '\n' ? ll - 1 : ll encoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding];   // 与清单文件按行（不含换行）比 | Compared with the manifest file line by line (without the newline)
    if (!s || [g_pso_user_seen containsObject:s]) return;
    [g_pso_user_seen addObject:s];
    if (f) { fputs(line, f); fflush(f); }
    if (g_pso_shared) { fputs(line, g_pso_shared); fflush(g_pso_shared); }
    int kind = line[0] == 'S' ? 0 : line[0] == 'R' ? 1 : line[0] == 'C' ? 2 : -1;
    if (kind >= 0) { atomic_fetch_add(&g_collect_new[kind], 1); atomic_store(&g_collect_last_ns, clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW)); }
}
// 从 .metallib 文件建库，不常驻占文件描述符：newLibraryWithURL 在库对象活着期间一直开着那个文件（每个游戏着色器一个——iOS 包进局常驻 258 个描述符里 213 个是它，
// 而 iOS 进程缺省软上限 256；别的幕新建着色器还会涨）。这里把文件映射进内存后立刻关掉，用内存数据建库；映射随库的数据对象释放时解除
// Build the library from a .metallib file without permanently occupying a file descriptor: newLibraryWithURL keeps that file open for as long as the library object lives (one per game shader - of the 258 descriptors the iOS app permanently holds in a run, 213 are these,
// while the default soft limit of an iOS process is 256; new shaders created in other acts raise it further). Here the file is mapped into memory and closed immediately, and the library is built from the in-memory data; the mapping is released when the library's data object is freed
static id<MTLLibrary> lib_from_file(NSString *path, NSError **err) {
    int fd = open(path.fileSystemRepresentation, O_RDONLY); struct stat st;
    if (fd < 0 || fstat(fd, &st) || st.st_size <= 0) { if (fd >= 0) close(fd); if (err) *err = [NSError errorWithDomain:NSPOSIXErrorDomain code:errno userInfo:@{NSLocalizedDescriptionKey: [NSString stringWithFormat:@"打不开 %@", path]}]; return nil; }
    size_t len = (size_t)st.st_size; void *m = mmap(NULL, len, PROT_READ, MAP_PRIVATE, fd, 0); close(fd);
    if (m == MAP_FAILED) { if (err) *err = [NSError errorWithDomain:NSPOSIXErrorDomain code:errno userInfo:@{NSLocalizedDescriptionKey: [NSString stringWithFormat:@"映射失败 %@", path]}]; return nil; }
#ifdef DM_SHELL
    // 壳：使用者的电脑上没有苹果的着色器编译器时（tools/d2rm_pack.py 的不调编译器模式，gfx/tools/nometal_run.py），「库文件」里放的是
    // 着色器源码而不是编好的库（编好的库以 MTLB 开头）。这里就地现编；系统会把编好的结果缓存，同一个着色器第二次启动起不再花这个时间。
    // 真机实测（冷）：平均约 80 毫秒一个、单个最长约 450 毫秒；一局用到几百个。
    // Shell: when the user's computer has no Apple shader compiler (the no-compiler mode of tools/d2rm_pack.py, gfx/tools/nometal_run.py), the "library files" contain
    // shader source rather than compiled libraries (a compiled library starts with MTLB). They are compiled here on the spot; the system caches the compiled result, and from the second launch on the same shader no longer costs this time.
    // Measured on a real device (cold): about 80 ms each on average, about 450 ms for the longest single one; one session uses several hundred.
    if (len < 4 || memcmp(m, "MTLB", 4)) { NSString *src = [[NSString alloc] initWithBytes:m length:len encoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding]; munmap(m, len);
        if (!src) { if (err) *err = [NSError errorWithDomain:NSPOSIXErrorDomain code:EILSEQ userInfo:@{NSLocalizedDescriptionKey: [NSString stringWithFormat:@"既不是编好的库也不是源码 %@", path]}]; return nil; }
        static _Atomic int n; static _Atomic long long us; CFAbsoluteTime t0 = CFAbsoluteTimeGetCurrent();
        id<MTLLibrary> l = [g_dev newLibraryWithSource:src options:totk_precise_opts() error:err]; long long dt = (long long)((CFAbsoluteTimeGetCurrent() - t0) * 1e6);
        int k = atomic_fetch_add(&n, 1) + 1; long long tot = atomic_fetch_add(&us, dt) + dt;
        if (k == 1 || k % 100 == 0 || dt >= 300000) MLOG("着色器现编：第 %d 个 %.0f ms，累计 %.1f 秒", k, dt / 1e3, tot / 1e6);
        return l; }
#endif
#if TARGET_OS_IPHONE
    // iOS：映射也占一个 vnode，而整机 vnode 表只有 11400 项（iPad A16，2026-10-18）；全量预热留着约 8800 个库时表满，系统按 vnode-limit 杀掉游戏。
    // 这里复制进内存后立刻解除映射（全部库约 110 MB）。
    // iOS: a mapping also holds a vnode, and the whole device has 11,400 (iPad A16, 2026-10-18); with the full warm-up keeping about
    // 8,800 libraries the table filled and the system killed the game (jetsam reason vnode-limit). Copy and unmap at once (about 110 MB for all).
    void *copy = malloc(len);
    if (copy) { memcpy(copy, m, len); munmap(m, len);
                return [g_dev newLibraryWithData:dispatch_data_create(copy, len, NULL, DISPATCH_DATA_DESTRUCTOR_FREE) error:err]; }
#endif
    dispatch_data_t d = dispatch_data_create(m, len, dispatch_get_global_queue(QOS_CLASS_UTILITY, 0), ^{ munmap(m, len); });
    return [g_dev newLibraryWithData:d error:err];
}
/* TOTK: the translated Switch shaders rely on exactly rounded IEEE float arithmetic (integer-division idioms built from
   float bit patterns, invariant positions, depth compares); Metal's default fast math breaks them. */
static MTLCompileOptions *totk_precise_opts(void) {
    /* Made once and published only when complete: the warm-up compiles on several threads (2026-10-18), and a thread must
       never get the options before mathMode is set (that would compile with fast math). */
    static MTLCompileOptions *o; static dispatch_once_t once;
    dispatch_once(&once, ^{
        MTLCompileOptions *x = [MTLCompileOptions new];
        if (@available(macOS 15.0, *)) x.mathMode = MTLMathModeSafe; else x.fastMathEnabled = NO;
        if (gpu_log_on()) { if (@available(macOS 15.0, *)) x.enableLogging = YES; }   // Odyssey DM_GPU_LOG=1: shader os_log reaches the MTLLogState
        /* DM_PRESERVE_INVARIANCE=1 (Bayonetta 3 sets it): the translated vertex shaders mark gl_Position [[invariant]], which
           Metal honours only with preserveInvariance. A game that draws a depth pre-pass and then its colour pass with a
           LEQUAL / EQUAL test needs the two positions bit-identical, as on the Switch: without it, part of the colour pass
           fails the depth test and keeps the previous frame (ghostly characters, trails, blocks). Default off (TOTK). */
        { const char *e = getenv("DM_PRESERVE_INVARIANCE"); if (e && atoi(e)) { x.preserveInvariance = YES; MLOG("vertex positions compiled invariant (DM_PRESERVE_INVARIANCE=1)"); } }
        /* TOTK_FAST_MATH=1 (measurement only): fast math for every translated shader. Known to break the tile-light vertex
           shader's integer-division idiom, so pictures from such runs are not evidence of correctness. */
        if (getenv("TOTK_FAST_MATH") && atoi(getenv("TOTK_FAST_MATH"))) { if (@available(macOS 15.0, *)) x.mathMode = MTLMathModeFast; else x.fastMathEnabled = YES; MLOG("【实验】TOTK_FAST_MATH=1：着色器用快速数学"); }
        o = x;
    });
    return o;
}
/* Compile translated MSL with the precise options. The system compiler service (MTLCompilerService) can be stopped under
   memory pressure in the middle of a compile (iPad, 2026-10-18: "Compilation failed due to an interrupted connection:
   XPC_ERROR_CONNECTION_INTERRUPTED" while the shader warm-up was running); it restarts on the next request, so such a
   failure is retried instead of being taken as a broken shader. */
static id<MTLLibrary> totk_msl_library_(NSString *src, NSError **err);
static id<MTLLibrary> totk_msl_library(NSString *src, NSError **err) {   // Odyssey: signpost around every library compiled from MSL
    DM_SP_BEGIN(sp, "shader-library", "%lu bytes", (unsigned long)src.length);
    id<MTLLibrary> lib = totk_msl_library_(src, err);
    DM_SP_END(sp, "shader-library");
    return lib;
}
static id<MTLLibrary> totk_msl_library_(NSString *src, NSError **err) {
    NSError *e = nil;
    for (int attempt = 1;; attempt++) {
        id<MTLLibrary> lib = [g_dev newLibraryWithSource:src options:totk_precise_opts() error:&e];
        BOOL interrupted = !lib && [e.localizedDescription containsString:@"XPC_ERROR_CONNECTION_INTERRUPTED"];
        if (lib || !interrupted || attempt == 4) { if (err) *err = e; return lib; }
        MLOG("【红】着色器编译服务连接中断（第 %d 次），%d ms 后重试", attempt, attempt * 100);
        usleep((useconds_t)attempt * 100000);
    }
}
/* TOTK (2026-10-15): which words of the NVN driver constant segments c0 / c2 a translated shader reads, scanned from its MSL
   at load (spirv-cross names them <stage>p_c0 / <stage>p_c2: vp_, fp_, cp_). The translation-time scan
   (scripts/shader_service.py drv_reads) matched only fragment shaders (fp_c0) until 2026-10-15, so every vertex and compute
   shader that reads c0 was given the all-zero segment: compute shaders saw 0 thread groups (the occlusion-culling kernel
   ce4993a0 then put all its cells into the first row and left the other 17 rows 0 -- every occlusion query failed and NPCs
   vanished), vertex shaders a point-size limit of 0, and both 0 for the base addresses they add offsets to. Words the replay
   fills (encode_args): c0 storage-buffer table at 0x110 (vertex) / 0x310 (compute) / 0x510 (fragment), 16 bytes per slot
   {address, size}; compute thread-group counts {x, y, z} at 0x200 and uniform-buffer table at 0x210; vertex point-size
   limit at 0x610; c2 texture / sampler handle tables. Anything else reads 0 and is reported. */
static int drv_fillable(int stage, int bank, unsigned off) {
    if (bank == 2) return (off >= 0x20 && off < 0x120) || (off >= 0x168 && off < 0x968);
    switch (stage) {
    case 0: return (off >= 0x110 && off < 0x210) || off == 0x610;
    case 1: return off >= 0x510 && off < 0x610;
    case 5: return off >= 0x200 && off < 0x410;
    default: return 0;
    }
}
/* TOTK 2026-10-16: does the function store through storage binding `name` (spirv-cross names: `(*spvDescriptorSet0.fp_s0)._m0[...] = ...`
   for stores, `&(*spvDescriptorSet0.fp_s1)` for atomics)? The reflection's rw was never set (shader_service.py tested the wrong
   flag bit), and the MSL address space over-approximates (1,140 fragment variants hold a non-const `device` pointer they only
   read), so the stores themselves are looked for. The deferred-lighting quads store a per-tile feedback word the next frame's
   class marker reads; skipping them as "0 samples passed" blacked out the title mural (claude.md "标题壁画丢失"). */
static int msl_stores_through(NSString *src, NSString *name) {
    const char *s = src.UTF8String; if (!s || !name) return 0;
    char pat[160];
    snprintf(pat, sizeof pat, "&(*spvDescriptorSet0.%s)", name.UTF8String);
    if (strstr(s, pat)) return 1;
    snprintf(pat, sizeof pat, "(*spvDescriptorSet0.%s)._m0[", name.UTF8String);
    size_t pl = strlen(pat);
    for (const char *p = strstr(s, pat); p; p = strstr(p, pat)) {
        p += pl; int depth = 1;
        while (*p && depth) { if (*p == '[') depth++; else if (*p == ']') depth--; p++; }
        if (*p == '.') { p++; while (*p == 'x' || *p == 'y' || *p == 'z' || *p == 'w') p++; }
        while (*p == ' ') p++;
        if (p[0] == '=' && p[1] != '=') return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}
static void refl_mark_stores(NvShader *o, NSArray *bs, NSString *src) {
    if (![bs isKindOfClass:[NSArray class]] || (int)bs.count != o->rf.nb) return;   // nvn_refl_from_json keeps the json order 1:1
    for (int i = 0; i < o->rf.nb; i++) {
        nvn_rbind *b = &o->rf.b[i]; if (b->rw || (b->kind != NVN_RB_SBUFP && b->kind != NVN_RB_SBUFU)) continue;
        NSDictionary *d = bs[(NSUInteger)i]; if (![d isKindOfClass:[NSDictionary class]]) continue;
        if (msl_stores_through(src, d[@"msl_name"])) b->rw = 1;
    }
}
static int drv_scan(NvShader *o, NSString *src) {   // src: the full MSL (iOS does not keep it in o->src)
    const char *s = src.UTF8String; if (!s) return 0;
    int nunfill = 0;
    char bad[200] = ""; size_t nbad = 0;
    for (const char *p = strstr(s, "p_c"); p; p = strstr(p + 3, "p_c")) {
        if (p - s < 2 || p[-2] != '.' || (p[-1] != 'v' && p[-1] != 'f' && p[-1] != 'c')) continue;
        int bank = p[3] - '0';
        if ((bank != 0 && bank != 2) || strncmp(p + 4, ")._m0[", 6)) continue;
        const char *q = p + 10; char *end; unsigned long idx = strtoul(q, &end, 10);
        int dyn = end == q || !(*end == ']' || (*end == 'u' && end[1] == ']'));
        if (!o->rf.drv_read[bank]) o->drv_scanned[bank] = 1;
        o->rf.drv_read[bank] = 1;
        if (!(dyn || !drv_fillable(o->stage, bank, (unsigned)idx * 16))) continue;
        nunfill++;
        if (nbad < sizeof bad - 24) nbad += (size_t)snprintf(bad + nbad, sizeof bad - nbad, dyn ? " c%d+dynamic" : " c%d+%#lx", bank, idx * 16);
    }
    if (nbad) MLOG("【红】着色器 %s（阶段 %d）读驱动段的这些位置回放层不填，读到 0：%s", o->key, o->stage, bad);
    return nunfill;
}
static _Atomic uint64_t g_rt_prebuilt, g_rt_compiled;   // TOTK: translated variants loaded precompiled (iOS) / compiled from MSL here (atomic: the warm-up loads on several threads)
#if !TARGET_OS_IPHONE
/* TOTK: the startup shaders compiled when the app was built (build_app.py step_shader_libs), named by the SHA-256 of their
   MSL, so only an exact match is used. Metal's own cache of libraries compiled here does not follow the app to a folder
   whose path has another length (measured: a full 4.5-minute warm-up again); these files move with the app. */
static NSString *shader_lib_prebuilt_path(NSData *src) {
    if (getenv("TOTK_FAST_MATH") && atoi(getenv("TOTK_FAST_MATH"))) return nil;   // built with safe math (totk_precise_opts)
    static NSString *dir; static dispatch_once_t once; dispatch_once(&once, ^{ dir = exe_rel("shader-libs"); });
    unsigned char md[CC_SHA256_DIGEST_LENGTH]; CC_SHA256(src.bytes, (CC_LONG)src.length, md);
    char hex[2 * sizeof md + 1]; for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof md; i++) snprintf(hex + 2 * i, 3, "%02x", md[i]);
    NSString *path = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%@/%s.metallib", dir, hex];
    return dir && [NSFileManager.defaultManager fileExistsAtPath:path] ? path : nil;
}
static id<MTLLibrary> shader_lib_prebuilt(NSData *src) {
    NSString *path = shader_lib_prebuilt_path(src); if (!path) return nil;
    NSError *e = nil; id<MTLLibrary> lib = lib_from_file(path, &e);
    if (!lib) MLOG("【红】预编译着色器库加载失败 %s：%s（改为现编）", path.lastPathComponent.UTF8String, e.localizedDescription.UTF8String);
    return lib;
}
#endif
static NvShader *shader_load(NSString *pc, int stage) {
    NSError *e = nil;
    // TOTK: runtime translations are MSL source compiled here (macOS allows runtime compilation); the OS caches compiled code.
    NSString *rt_src = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%@/%@.metal", totk_rt_dir(), pc];
    int rt = [NSFileManager.defaultManager fileExistsAtPath:rt_src];
    NSString *lp = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%@/%@.metallib", g_msl_dir, pc];
    id<MTLLibrary> lib = nil;
    if (rt) {
#if TARGET_OS_IPHONE
        // iOS: the variant precompiled on the Mac (ios/tools/build_metallibs.sh, same options) if it came in shaders.pack
        NSString *rt_lib = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%@/%@.metallib", totk_rt_dir(), pc];
        if ([NSFileManager.defaultManager fileExistsAtPath:rt_lib]) { lib = lib_from_file(rt_lib, &e); if (!lib) MLOG("【红】预编译着色器库加载失败 %s：%s（改为现编）", pc.UTF8String, e.localizedDescription.UTF8String); else atomic_fetch_add(&g_rt_prebuilt, 1); }
#endif
        if (!lib) { NSData *raw = [NSData dataWithContentsOfFile:rt_src options:0 error:&e];
#if !TARGET_OS_IPHONE
                    if (raw && (lib = shader_lib_prebuilt(raw))) atomic_fetch_add(&g_rt_prebuilt, 1);
#endif
                    NSString *src = raw && !lib ? [[NSString alloc] initWithData:raw encoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding] : nil;
                    if (src) { lib = totk_msl_library(src, &e); atomic_fetch_add(&g_rt_compiled, 1); } }
    } else lib = lib_from_file(lp, &e);
    if (rt) { uint64_t pre = atomic_load(&g_rt_prebuilt), com = atomic_load(&g_rt_compiled);
              if ((pre + com) % 200 == 1) MLOG("着色器库：预编译加载 %llu 个，现编 %llu 个", (unsigned long long)pre, (unsigned long long)com); }
    NSData *jd = [NSData dataWithContentsOfFile:[NSString stringWithFormat:@"%@/%@.json", rt ? totk_rt_dir() : g_msl_dir, pc]];
    NSDictionary *j = jd ? [NSJSONSerialization JSONObjectWithData:jd options:0 error:nil] : nil;
    if (!lib || !j) { MLOG("【红】加载着色器失败 %s：%s", pc.UTF8String, e ? e.localizedDescription.UTF8String : "无反射 json"); return nil; }
    if (![j[@"chain"] isEqual:@DMSH_CHAIN]) { MLOG("【红】着色器 %s 的翻译链版本 %s 与本宿主期望的 %s 不符", pc.UTF8String, [[j[@"chain"] description] UTF8String], DMSH_CHAIN); return nil; }
    NvShader *o = [NvShader new];
    char err[160];
    if (nvn_refl_from_json(j, &o->rf, err, sizeof err)) { MLOG("【红】着色器 %s 反射转换失败：%s", pc.UTF8String, err); return nil; }
    if (rt_range_on()) o->range_ro=rt_range_bindings_ro(j);
    o->fn = [lib newFunctionWithName:j[@"entry"]]; o->stage = stage; strlcpy(o->key, pc.UTF8String, sizeof o->key);
    NSString *full = rt ? [NSString stringWithContentsOfFile:rt_src encoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding error:nil] : nil;
    o->writes_depth = full && [full rangeOfString:@"[[depth("].location != NSNotFound;
    if (full) { o->src_path = rt_src; drv_scan(o, full); refl_mark_stores(o, j[@"bindings"], full); }   // TOTK: scan before iOS drops the source (NPC-culling fix needs it there too); rw from the MSL's stores
    /* TOTK (2026-10-17): the MSL is read again from its file when a variant needs it (sh_src), on the Mac too -- keeping
       every source cost 255 MB of strings (7,691 of them) in a long session (analysis/long18 heap). TOTK_KEEP_MSL=1 keeps
       them in memory (the Mac's behaviour before). */
    static int keep_src = -1; if (keep_src < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_KEEP_MSL"); keep_src = e && !strcmp(e, "1"); }
    if (keep_src) o->src = full;
    if (o->rf.nb) {
        o->ae = [o->fn newArgumentEncoderWithBufferIndex:o->rf.abi];
        int max_aid = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < o->rf.nb; i++) max_aid = MAX(max_aid, o->rf.b[i].aid);
        o->arg_len = o->ae.encodedLength;
        if (o->arg_len != (NSUInteger)(8 * (max_aid + 1)) || (o->arg_len & 7))
            MDIE("着色器 %s 参数块布局异常：encodedLength=%lu maxAid=%d", o->key, (unsigned long)o->arg_len, max_aid);
    }
    if (o->rf.has_c1) c1_store(o, full);
    return o;
}

static int stage_of(NSString *zh) {
    if ([zh isEqualToString:@"顶点"]) return 0; if ([zh isEqualToString:@"像素"]) return 1; if ([zh isEqualToString:@"计算"]) return 5;
    if ([zh isEqualToString:@"外壳"]) return 3; if ([zh isEqualToString:@"域"]) return 4; return -1;
}
#define NVN_RT_RANGE_RO_IMPL 1
// 私有续用只接受明确RO的B反射，sbuf缺rw不把默认0当证明；不改变既有反射/翻译链。
// Private continuation accepts only B reflection that is explicitly RO; a missing rw on sbuf does not let the default 0 count as proof; does not change the existing reflection / translation chain.
static int rt_range_bindings_ro(NSDictionary *j) {
    if (![j[@"route"] isEqual:@"B"] || ![j[@"bindings"] isKindOfClass:[NSArray class]] ||
        ![j[@"drv_reads"] isKindOfClass:[NSDictionary class]] || [j[@"drv_reads"] count]) return 0;
    for (NSDictionary *b in j[@"bindings"]) {
        if (![b isKindOfClass:[NSDictionary class]] || ![b[@"kind"] isKindOfClass:[NSString class]] || ![b[@"msl_type"] isKindOfClass:[NSString class]]) return 0;
        NSString *k=b[@"kind"], *t=b[@"msl_type"];
        if (b[@"rw"] && (![b[@"rw"] isKindOfClass:[NSNumber class]] || [b[@"rw"] boolValue])) return 0;
        if ([k isEqual:@"cbuf"] || [k isEqual:@"c1"]) { if (![t hasPrefix:@"constant "]) return 0; }
        else if ([k isEqual:@"sbuf"]) { if (![b[@"rw"] isKindOfClass:[NSNumber class]] || [b[@"rw"] boolValue] || ![t hasPrefix:@"const device "]) return 0; }
        else if ([k isEqual:@"samp"] || [k isEqual:@"sampt"]) { if (![t isEqual:@"sampler"]) return 0; }
        else if ([k isEqual:@"tex"] || [k isEqual:@"tbuf"]) {
            if (![t hasPrefix:@"texture"] || ([t containsString:@"access::"] && ![t containsString:@"access::sample>"] && ![t containsString:@"access::read>"])) return 0; }
        else return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}
static int rt_range_pr_ro(NvProg *p) {
    if (!p || !p->sh[0] || !p->sh[1]) return 0;
    for (int k=0;k<6;k++) if (p->sh[k] && (k>1 || p->sh[k]->stage != k || !p->sh[k]->range_ro || p->sh[k]->rf.drv_read[0] || p->sh[k]->rf.drv_read[2])) return 0;
    return 1;
}
static NvShader *shader_get(NSString *pc, int stage) {
    if (!g_shcache) g_shcache = [NSMutableDictionary dictionary];
    NvShader *o = g_shcache[pc];
    if (o) return o;
    uint64_t bt = bp_now(); o = shader_load(pc, stage);
    if (!o) { if (survey_shader_log()) MLOG("[survey-shader] frame %llu Metal library FAILED stage %d %s after %.2f ms", (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&g_cur_frame), stage, pc.UTF8String, (bp_now() - bt) / 1e6); return nil; }
    g_shcache[pc] = o;
    pso_record("S\t%s\t%d\n", pc.UTF8String, stage);
    pso_user_record("S\t%s\t%d\n", pc.UTF8String, stage);
    g_bp_lib_n++; g_bp_lib_ns += bp_now() - bt;
    if (survey_shader_log()) MLOG("[survey-shader] frame %llu Metal library stage %d %s in %.2f ms", (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&g_cur_frame), stage, pc.UTF8String, (bp_now() - bt) / 1e6);
    return o;
}
static NSDictionary *rt_answers(int st);
static uint64_t stage_sig(int st);
/* TOTK: texture slots of each stage above g_tex_hi have never been bound (BindTextures is the only writer of handles; state
   restores copy earlier states), so they are 0 and stage_sig compares only the slots below it (it compared all 128). */
static int g_tex_hi[6] = {1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1};
static NSArray *rt_local(const uint8_t *control, int st);
/* How much of a control section the shader key hashes: the section's own size, the word at +0x20 (0x880 in TOTK's
   archives and in its agl packages; 0x7d1 and 0x848 in Breath of the Wild, whose game keeps each section in its own
   allocation, so the bytes after it are not the shader's and differ from the archive's), never more than 0x880.
   scripts/prepare_shader_seed.py control_key_len computes the same offline. */
static inline uint32_t ctl_key_len(const uint8_t *control) { uint32_t n; memcpy(&n, control + 0x20, 4); return n >= 0x7cc && n < 0x880 ? n : 0x880; }
/* Async shaders (totk_shader_rt.m; ported from upstream bfdd085, 22 October): only a draw whose result is redrawn every
   frame may be skipped while its shader is translated in the background. Work whose result outlives the draw never is:
   compute, programs that store to memory or stream out (sph_keeps_memory), draws while an occlusion counter counts,
   draws with no colour output, and colour into cube / array / 3D targets (draw_state_may_skip). Those translate now. */
static int async_shaders(void) { static int on = -1; if (on < 0) on = totk_rt_async_on() && !tbdr_on(); return on; }
/* The Maxwell shader program header (after the 0x30-byte NVN header of graphics code): word 0 bit 16 DoesGlobalStore
   (surfaces included), bits 28-31 stream out. Upstream checked it against every MSL that stores, on 20,129 variants.
   Compute is always treated as storing. */
static int sph_keeps_memory(const uint8_t *code, int st) {
    if (st != 0 && st != 1) return 1;
    uint32_t w0; memcpy(&w0, code + 0x30, 4);
    return (w0 >> 16 & 1) || (w0 >> 28 & 0xf);
}
static int draw_state_may_skip(void);
static int g_prog_for_draw;   // prog_get for the draw itself (draw_inner), whose skip state is known
static __unsafe_unretained NvProg *prog_get(const prog_t *cp) {   // 只在提交线程调用 | Called only on the submit thread
    prog_t *p = (prog_t *)cp;
    static const prog_t *lp; static uint64_t lser, lgen; static NvProg *lpr;   // 上次结果：同一对象、同一序号且序号表未变即直接用 | Last result: same object, same serial and unchanged serial table means it is used directly
    uint64_t gen = g_ser_gen;
    if (p == lp && p->serial == lser && lpr && (gen == lgen || ser_unaffected(lgen, gen, lser))) { lgen = gen; return lpr; }
    __unsafe_unretained NvProg *have = p->serial ? (__bridge NvProg *)serial_ptr(p->serial) : nil;
    if (have) { lp = p; lser = p->serial; lgen = gen; lpr = have; return have; }
    shmap_load();
    NvProg *o = [NvProg new];
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < p->nstage; i++) {   // a stage that stores or streams out keeps every draw of the program
        uint32_t nvn_stage = 0; if (!p->sd[i].control || !p->sd[i].data) MDIE("null TOTK shader binary");
        memcpy(&nvn_stage, (const uint8_t *)p->sd[i].control + 0x714, 4);
        o->keeps |= sph_keeps_memory((const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)p->sd[i].data, (int)nvn_stage);
    }
    int defer = async_shaders() && !o->keeps && (!g_prog_for_draw || draw_state_may_skip());
    o->miss_seen = totk_rt_completed();
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < p->nstage; i++) {
        const uint8_t *control=p->sd[i].control;uint32_t length=0,nvn_stage=0;
        if (!control || !p->sd[i].data) MDIE("null TOTK shader binary");
        memcpy(&length,control+0x704,4);memcpy(&nvn_stage,control+0x714,4);
        if (!length || length>16*1024*1024) MDIE("invalid TOTK shader code length %u",length);
        // Host NVN GPU addresses are CPU addresses (MemoryPoolGetBufferAddress).
        uint8_t md[32];CC_SHA256_CTX ctx;CC_SHA256_Init(&ctx);CC_SHA256_Update(&ctx,control,ctl_key_len(control));
        CC_SHA256_Update(&ctx,(const void *)(uintptr_t)p->sd[i].data,length);CC_SHA256_Final(md,&ctx);
        char key[65];for(unsigned j=0;j<32;j++)snprintf(key+2*j,3,"%02x",md[j]);
        // TOTK: stage from control+0x714 (0 vertex, 1 fragment, 5 compute); translation answered from the bound state.
        int st=(int)nvn_stage;if(st!=0&&st!=1&&st!=5)MDIE("TOTK shader %s: unsupported NVN stage %u",key,nvn_stage);
        if (getenv("TOTK_CTL_DUMP")) {   // diagnostic: the control section the game hands NVN, per shader (offline shader discovery is checked against it)
            static FILE *df; if (!df) df = fopen(getenv("TOTK_CTL_DUMP"), "a");
            if (df) { uint8_t cm[32]; char ch[65]; const uint8_t *cd = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)p->sd[i].data; size_t skip = st == 5 ? 0 : 0x30;
                CC_SHA256(cd + skip, (CC_LONG)(length > skip ? length - skip : 0), cm); for (unsigned j = 0; j < 32; j++) snprintf(ch + 2*j, 3, "%02x", cm[j]);
                fprintf(df, "%s\t%d\t%s\t", key, st, ch); for (int k = 0; k < 0x880; k++) fprintf(df, "%02x", control[k]); fputc('\n', df); fflush(df); } }
        if (getenv("TOTK_CS_PROBE")) { static int nd; if (nd++ < 6) { char b[4096]; size_t o = 0; const uint8_t *cd = (const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)p->sd[i].data;
            for (int k = 0x6c0; k < 0x880; k += 4) { uint32_t w; memcpy(&w, control + k, 4); if (w) o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - o, " %03x:%x", k, w); }
            o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - o, " | code:"); for (int k = 0; k < 0x30; k += 4) { uint32_t w; memcpy(&w, cd + k, 4); o += snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - o, " %x", w); }
            MLOG("[ctl st%d]%s", st, b); } }
        NSString *variant=totk_rt_variant(@(key),st,control,(const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)p->sd[i].data,rt_answers(st),rt_local(control,st),defer);
        if(!variant){o->missing|=1<<st;o->ctl[st]=control;o->code[st]=(const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)p->sd[i].data;o->key[st]=@(key);continue;}   // iOS: not translated yet; Mac (async shaders): in the background. Its draws are skipped
        NvShader *sh=shader_get([variant stringByAppendingString:@"_b"],st);
        if(!sh)MDIE("TOTK shader translation/reflection unavailable for %s",variant.UTF8String);
        o->sh[st]=sh; o->ctl[st]=control; o->code[st]=(const uint8_t *)(uintptr_t)p->sd[i].data; o->key[st]=@(key);
        o->sig[st]=stage_sig(st); o->alt[st]=[NSMutableDictionary dictionaryWithObject:sh forKey:@(o->sig[st])];
    }
    if (p->serial) serial_put(p->serial, o);
    return o;
}
/* A program with a stage in the background (async shaders): when the draw may be skipped, look again only once another
   background job has been recorded; when it may not, translate now (or wait for the running job). Returns 1 when a stage
   was filled in. */
static int prog_resolve(NvProg *o, int may_skip) {
    uint64_t done = totk_rt_completed();
    if (may_skip && done == o->miss_seen) return 0;
    o->miss_seen = done;
    int filled = 0;
    for (int st = 0; st < 6; st++) {
        if (!(o->missing & 1 << st)) continue;
        NSString *variant = totk_rt_variant(o->key[st], st, o->ctl[st], o->code[st], rt_answers(st), rt_local(o->ctl[st], st), may_skip);
        if (!variant) continue;
        NvShader *sh = shader_get([variant stringByAppendingString:@"_b"], st);
        if (!sh) MDIE("TOTK shader translation/reflection unavailable for %s", variant.UTF8String);
        o->sh[st] = sh; o->sig[st] = stage_sig(st); o->alt[st] = [NSMutableDictionary dictionaryWithObject:sh forKey:@(o->sig[st])];
        o->missing &= ~(1 << st); filled = 1;
    }
    return filled;
}
void mtl_prog_release(prog_t *p) { if (p->serial) serial_del(p->serial); }

// ---------- 描述符池：贴图号 / 采样器号 → 对象 ----------
// 登记时快照整个贴图对象（NVN 语义：描述符已写进池）；view：该号对应的 MTLTexture（视图或基贴图，CFBridgingRetain 持有）及取得时的序号表 / 客体写代号
// ---------- Descriptor pool: texture ID / sampler ID → object ----------
// At registration the whole texture object is snapshotted (NVN semantics: the descriptor has been written into the pool); view: the MTLTexture for that ID (a view or the base texture, held via CFBridgingRetain) and the serial-table / guest-write generations at the time it was obtained
// view_pkg: the texture mirrors CPU pool memory (only then do guest writes matter); dead_pending: the serial was finalised
// and no live texture was found at its storage yet, so every serial-table step re-checks it (see tex_by_id).
typedef struct { tex_t t; int ok; view_t v; int has_v; void *view; uint64_t view_id, view_rid, view_ser, view_dirty;
    uint64_t indexed_serial, used; int view_prev, view_next; uint8_t view_pkg, dead_pending; } treg_t;   // used (TOTK): last submission that resolved this id
static treg_t *g_treg; static int g_ntreg;
/* Only slots with a cached Metal view need work when an NVN texture is finalized. A linear
   scan of the entire descriptor pool on every finalize dominated the game's render thread. */
static nvn_hmap g_view_heads = {.klen = 8};   // serial -> slot id + 1; protected by g_rmu
static void treg_unlink_locked(int tid) {
    treg_t *r = &g_treg[tid]; uint64_t serial = r->indexed_serial;
    if (!serial) return;
    int next = r->view_next, prev = r->view_prev;
    if (prev) g_treg[prev - 1].view_next = next;
    else if (next) nvn_hm_put(&g_view_heads, &serial, (void *)(uintptr_t)next);
    else nvn_hm_del(&g_view_heads, &serial);
    if (next) g_treg[next - 1].view_prev = prev;
    r->indexed_serial = 0; r->view_prev = r->view_next = 0;
}
static void treg_link_locked(int tid) {
    treg_t *r = &g_treg[tid]; uint64_t serial = r->t.serial;
    if (!r->view || !serial) return;
    int head = (int)(uintptr_t)nvn_hm_get(&g_view_heads, &serial);
    r->indexed_serial = serial; r->view_prev = 0; r->view_next = head;
    if (head) g_treg[head - 1].view_prev = tid + 1;
    nvn_hm_put(&g_view_heads, &serial, (void *)(uintptr_t)(tid + 1));
}
static void treg_clear_view_locked(int tid) {
    treg_t *r = &g_treg[tid];
    treg_unlink_locked(tid);
    if (r->view) { defer_obj_unref((__bridge id)r->view); CFRelease(r->view); r->view = NULL; }
    r->view_id = r->view_rid = r->view_ser = r->view_dirty = 0; r->view_pkg = r->dead_pending = 0;
}
// 贴图号 → 序号的无锁副本（回放热路径只要序号：写回前瞻索引、纯清除前提的绑定集合）：贴图号 20 位，固定 1M 项（BSS，只占碰过的页），
// 登记时 release 写、读端 relaxed 原子读，不进 g_rmu（原 h_ser 每次查表加解锁，营地每帧数千次）
// Lock-free copy of texture ID → serial (the replay hot path only needs the serial: store lookahead index, binding set of the clear-only hoist): texture IDs are 20 bits, fixed 1M entries (BSS, only touched pages are used),
// release write at registration, relaxed atomic read on the reader side, without entering g_rmu (the former h_ser locked and unlocked on every lookup, thousands of times per frame in the camp)
static _Atomic uint64_t g_tser[1 << 20];
static samp_par *g_sreg; static uint8_t *g_sreg_ok; static void **g_sview; static uint64_t *g_srid; static int g_nsreg;   // g_sview：采样器号 → MTLSamplerState（持有） | g_sview: sampler ID → MTLSamplerState (retained)
void mtl_reg_tex(int tid, const tex_t *t, const view_t *v) {
    int id_ = tid; if (id_ < 0) return;
    registry_lock();
    if (id_ >= g_ntreg) { int n = id_ + 1024; g_treg = realloc(g_treg, n * sizeof *g_treg); memset(g_treg + g_ntreg, 0, (n - g_ntreg) * sizeof *g_treg); g_ntreg = n; }
    /* TOTK: the game writes the same descriptor into a slot again and again; an identical registration changes nothing, so
       the slot keeps its view and no argument buffer has to be encoded again (g_reg_gen). */
    { treg_t *r = &g_treg[id_];
      if (t && r->ok && r->has_v == (v != NULL) && !memcmp(&r->t, t, sizeof *t) && (!v || !memcmp(&r->v, v, sizeof *v))) { g_treg_same++; registry_unlock(); return; } }
    g_treg_changed++;
    g_reg_gen++;
    if (g_treg[id_].view) treg_clear_view_locked(id_);
    uint64_t was = g_treg[id_].ok ? g_treg[id_].t.serial : 0;   // the serial this slot named before: one reference less (serial_forget_locked_rmu)
    if (t && t->serial != was) treg_ref_locked(t->serial, 1);
    if (was && (!t || t->serial != was)) { treg_ref_locked(was, -1); serial_forget_locked_rmu(was); }
    g_treg[id_].ok = t != NULL; if (t) g_treg[id_].t = *t; g_treg[id_].has_v = v != NULL;
    if (v) g_treg[id_].v = *v; else memset(&g_treg[id_].v, 0, sizeof g_treg[id_].v);   // TOTK: a registration without a view must not keep the slot's previous view (depth texture once got a stale BC3 9-level view)
    if (id_ < (1 << 20)) atomic_store_explicit(&g_tser[id_], t ? t->serial : 0, memory_order_release);
    registry_unlock();
}
/* TOTK: Metal has three border colours (transparent black, opaque black, opaque white). A sampler that clamps to any
   other colour is emulated in the shader (fs_fn_border). The game's grass interaction map (two 256x256 targets updated
   from each other every frame, scrolled with the player) clamps to (0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5), its "untouched" value: with
   transparent black every area entering the map read as grass bent all the way, so grass lay flat away from the player,
   stood up where Link walked and showed no cut (#49). */
static int samp_border_custom(const samp_par *p) {
    if (!(p->ws == 4 || p->ws == 5 || p->wt == 4 || p->wt == 5 || p->wr == 4 || p->wr == 5)) return 0;
    const float *b = p->border;
    int grey = b[0] == b[1] && b[1] == b[2];
    if (grey && b[0] == 0 && (b[3] == 0 || b[3] == 1)) return 0;   // transparent / opaque black
    if (grey && b[0] == 1 && b[3] == 1) return 0;                   // opaque white
    return 1;
}
static _Atomic int g_border_custom_any;   // set once such a sampler is registered: border_key runs only then
void mtl_reg_samp(int sid, const samp_par *sp) {
    int id_ = sid; if (id_ < 0) return;
    registry_lock();
    if (id_ >= g_nsreg) { int n = id_ + 256; g_sreg = realloc(g_sreg, n * sizeof *g_sreg); g_sreg_ok = realloc(g_sreg_ok, n); g_sview = realloc(g_sview, n * sizeof *g_sview); g_srid = realloc(g_srid, n * sizeof *g_srid);
        memset(g_sreg_ok + g_nsreg, 0, n - g_nsreg); memset(g_sview + g_nsreg, 0, (n - g_nsreg) * sizeof *g_sview); memset(g_srid + g_nsreg, 0, (n - g_nsreg) * sizeof *g_srid); g_nsreg = n; }
    if (g_sview[id_]) { CFRelease(g_sview[id_]); g_sview[id_] = NULL; g_srid[id_] = 0; }
    g_reg_gen++;
    g_sreg[id_] = *sp; g_sreg_ok[id_] = 1;
    if (samp_border_custom(sp)) atomic_store(&g_border_custom_any, 1);
    registry_unlock();
}
/* Texture-pool slots whose cached view still holds a texture of a finalized serial (diagnostic for the readout line). */
static void treg_stale_report(void) {
    unsigned long stale = 0, views = 0; unsigned long long stale_mb = 0;
    registry_lock();
    for (int i = 0; i < g_ntreg; i++) if (g_treg[i].view) { views++; if (serial_is_dead(g_treg[i].t.serial)) { stale++; id<MTLTexture> v = (__bridge id<MTLTexture>)g_treg[i].view; id<MTLTexture> b = v.parentTexture ?: v; stale_mb += b.allocatedSize >> 20; } }
    registry_unlock();
    MLOG("贴图池槽位视图 %lu 个，其中持有已销毁序号纹理的 %lu 个（约 %llu MB）", views, stale, stale_mb);
}
/* Finalized serial: drop every texture-pool slot view that still holds its texture. Before this, slots kept the view of a
   finalized texture until the slot was re-registered (over 17,000 slots holding ~11 GB after 20 s of the prologue). */
static void treg_drop_serial(uint64_t serial) {
    registry_lock();
    for (int head; (head = (int)(uintptr_t)nvn_hm_get(&g_view_heads, &serial)); )
        treg_clear_view_locked(head - 1);
    registry_unlock();
}
/* A slot that is no longer sampled never takes tex_by_id's invalidation path. After a CPU upload
   replaces NvPkg storage, that slot can retain its old base (or a view of it) for the entire session.
   Scan after 64 submissions only when replacements occurred. Keep logical descriptors and current
   views; defer dropping old references until commands that could have sampled them finish. */
static void treg_sweep_replaced(void) {
    static uint64_t seen_reuploads;
    if ((g_sub_serial & 63) || seen_reuploads == g_pkg_reuploads) return;
    seen_reuploads = g_pkg_reuploads;
    registry_lock();
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu);
    for (int i = 0; i < g_ntreg; i++) {
        treg_t *r = &g_treg[i]; if (!r->view) continue;
        __unsafe_unretained id holder = hm_get_id(&g_by_serial, &r->t.serial);
        if (![holder isKindOfClass:[NvPkg class]]) continue;
        id<MTLTexture> base = (__bridge id<MTLTexture>)r->view;
        while (base.parentTexture) base = base.parentTexture;
        if (base == ((NvPkg *)holder)->tex) continue;
        treg_clear_view_locked(i);
        g_treg_replaced_views++;
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu);
    registry_unlock();
}
/* TOTK (iPhone): Metal copies of CPU-pool textures are kept as long as the game keeps the NVNtexture, i.e. for every
   asset loaded around the player. Turning the camera resolves all of them once, and on a 4 GB iPhone the copies alone
   (530 -> 730 MB) pushed the app past its memory limit (killed with SIGKILL after a few camera turns). The pool bytes
   are still in guest memory, so a copy that no submission resolved for a while can be dropped and uploaded again when it
   is used next. Only mirrored copies the GPU never rendered into (pk->owned: the pool bytes are stale) and that are
   larger than the content-hashed small textures are dropped, least recently used first.
   When: iOS, the app's remaining allowance (os_proc_available_memory) below TOTK_TEX_EVICT_LOW_MB (600): drop until
   TOTK_TEX_EVICT_HIGH_MB (850) would be available; copies idle for EVICT_IDLE submissions, or EVICT_IDLE_CRIT below
   TOTK_TEX_EVICT_CRIT_MB (300). Any platform: TOTK_TEX_EVICT_MB=<n> keeps the copies under n MB (tests on the Mac).
   TOTK_TEX_EVICT=0 turns it off. Runs between submissions on the replay thread, every 4 submissions. */
#define EVICT_IDLE 90
#define EVICT_IDLE_CRIT 8
typedef struct { void *pk; uint64_t used, bytes, serial; } evict_cand;
static uint64_t g_pkg_evicted, g_pkg_evicted_mb_x, g_evict_sweeps;
static int evict_cmp(const void *a, const void *b) { uint64_t x = ((const evict_cand *)a)->used, y = ((const evict_cand *)b)->used; return x < y ? -1 : x > y; }
static uint64_t env_mb(const char *name, uint64_t dflt) { const char *e = getenv(name); return (e && *e ? strtoull(e, NULL, 10) : dflt) << 20; }
static uint64_t evict_available(void) {
#if TARGET_OS_IPHONE
    return os_proc_available_memory();
#else
    return 0;
#endif
}
/* TOTK (2026-10-17, long-session memory): how many copies of CPU-pool textures are alive, and how many of them belong to a
   memory pool that is already gone (the game deleted the pool but never finalized the texture object, so mtl_tex_release
   never ran for it). Every 6,000 submits on the replay thread; the ranges are copied under g_smu, the pools looked up
   under g_mu afterwards (the two locks are never held together here). */
static void pkg_orphan_report(void) {
    if (g_sub_serial % 6000) return;
    size_t n = 0, cap = 0; struct { uintptr_t lo, hi; uint64_t bytes; } *v = NULL;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_by_serial.cap; i++) {
        __unsafe_unretained id o = (__bridge id)g_by_serial.vals[i];
        if (!o || ![o isKindOfClass:[NvPkg class]]) continue;
        NvPkg *pk = (NvPkg *)o; if (!pk->tex || pk->hi <= pk->lo) continue;
        if (n == cap) { cap = cap ? cap * 2 : 4096; v = realloc(v, cap * sizeof *v); if (!v) MDIE("orphan report"); }
        v[n].lo = pk->lo; v[n].hi = pk->hi; v[n].bytes = pk->tex.allocatedSize; n++;
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu);
    uint64_t total = 0, orphan_n = 0, orphan_b = 0;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mu);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) { total += v[i].bytes; if (!pidx_find_mut(&g_pools, v[i].lo, v[i].hi - v[i].lo)) { orphan_n++; orphan_b += v[i].bytes; } }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mu);
    free(v);
    MLOG("素材贴图副本 至提交 %llu：在册 %zu 个 / %llu MB，其中所在内存池已删 %llu 个 / %llu MB", (unsigned long long)g_sub_serial, n, (unsigned long long)(total >> 20),
         (unsigned long long)orphan_n, (unsigned long long)(orphan_b >> 20));
}
static void pkg_evict_sweep(void) {
    static int mode = -1; static uint64_t budget, low, high, crit;
    if (mode < 0) {
        const char *e = getenv("TOTK_TEX_EVICT");
        budget = env_mb("TOTK_TEX_EVICT_MB", 0); low = env_mb("TOTK_TEX_EVICT_LOW_MB", 600); high = env_mb("TOTK_TEX_EVICT_HIGH_MB", 850); crit = env_mb("TOTK_TEX_EVICT_CRIT_MB", 300);
        mode = e && !atoi(e) ? 0 : budget ? 2 : TARGET_OS_IPHONE ? 1 : 0;
        if (mode == 1) MLOG("贴图副本淘汰：开（可用内存低于 %llu MB 时淘汰久未使用的副本，直到 %llu MB；TOTK_TEX_EVICT=0 关）", (unsigned long long)(low >> 20), (unsigned long long)(high >> 20));
        if (mode == 2) MLOG("贴图副本淘汰：开（副本总量上限 %llu MB）", (unsigned long long)(budget >> 20));
    }
    if (!mode || (g_sub_serial & 3)) return;
    uint64_t avail = 0, want = 0;
    if (mode == 1) { avail = evict_available(); if (!avail || avail >= low) return; want = high - avail; }
    registry_lock();
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_smu);
    /* texture-pool ids resolved on the fast path count as uses of their serial's copy */
    for (int i = 0; i < g_ntreg; i++) {
        treg_t *r = &g_treg[i]; if (!r->ok || r->view_pkg != 1 || !r->used) continue;
        __unsafe_unretained id o = hm_get_id(&g_by_serial, &r->t.serial);
        if ([o isKindOfClass:[NvPkg class]] && r->used > ((NvPkg *)o)->used) ((NvPkg *)o)->used = r->used;
    }
    size_t n = 0, cap = 0; evict_cand *c = NULL; uint64_t total = 0, total_n = 0;
    NSUInteger fmt_pf[16]; uint64_t fmt_b[16], fmt_n[16]; int nfmt = 0;   // copies by Metal pixel format (log)
    uint64_t idle = mode == 1 && avail < crit ? EVICT_IDLE_CRIT : EVICT_IDLE;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_by_serial.cap; i++) {
        __unsafe_unretained id o = (__bridge id)g_by_serial.vals[i];
        if (!o || ![o isKindOfClass:[NvPkg class]]) continue;
        NvPkg *pk = (NvPkg *)o; if (!pk->tex || pk->owned || pk->hashed) continue;
        uint64_t bytes = pk->tex.allocatedSize; total += bytes; total_n++;
        { NSUInteger pf = pk->tex.pixelFormat; int j = 0; for (; j < nfmt && fmt_pf[j] != pf; j++) {} if (j == nfmt && nfmt < 16) { fmt_pf[nfmt] = pf; fmt_b[nfmt] = 0; fmt_n[nfmt++] = 0; } if (j < 16) { fmt_b[j] += bytes; fmt_n[j]++; } }
        if (pk->used + idle > g_sub_serial) continue;
        if (n == cap) { cap = cap ? cap * 2 : 1024; c = realloc(c, cap * sizeof *c); if (!c) MDIE("evict candidates"); }
        uint64_t ser; memcpy(&ser, g_by_serial.keys + (size_t)i * g_by_serial.klen, 8);
        c[n++] = (evict_cand){(__bridge void *)pk, pk->used, bytes, ser};
    }
    if (mode == 2) want = total > budget ? total - budget / 10 * 9 : 0;
    uint64_t freed = 0, k = 0;
    if (want && n) {
        qsort(c, n, sizeof *c, evict_cmp);
        for (; k < n && freed < want; k++) {
            NvPkg *pk = (__bridge NvPkg *)c[k].pk;
            id<MTLTexture> t = pk->tex; pk->tex = nil;
            defer_obj_release(t);   // leaves the residency set once the submissions that may sample it completed
            ser_bump_locked(c[k].serial);
            freed += c[k].bytes;
        }
        /* texture-pool slot views hold the dropped copies (or views on them): clear them like treg_sweep_replaced */
        if (k) for (int i = 0; i < g_ntreg; i++) {
            treg_t *r = &g_treg[i]; if (!r->view || r->view_pkg != 1) continue;
            __unsafe_unretained id holder = hm_get_id(&g_by_serial, &r->t.serial);
            if ([holder isKindOfClass:[NvPkg class]] && !((NvPkg *)holder)->tex) treg_clear_view_locked(i);
        }
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_smu);
    registry_unlock();
    free(c);
    if (k) {
        g_pkg_evicted += k; g_pkg_evicted_mb_x += freed >> 20; g_evict_sweeps++;
        if (g_evict_sweeps <= 5 || g_evict_sweeps % 20 == 0)
            MLOG("贴图副本淘汰（第 %llu 次）：可用 %llu MB，淘汰 %llu 张 / %llu MB（闲置 ≥%llu 次提交），之前副本 %llu 张 / %llu MB；累计淘汰 %llu 张 / %llu MB，重传回来 %llu 张",
                 (unsigned long long)g_evict_sweeps, (unsigned long long)(avail >> 20), (unsigned long long)k, (unsigned long long)(freed >> 20), (unsigned long long)idle,
                 (unsigned long long)total_n, (unsigned long long)(total >> 20), (unsigned long long)g_pkg_evicted, (unsigned long long)g_pkg_evicted_mb_x, (unsigned long long)g_pkg_restored);
    }
    { static uint64_t last_fmt; if (nfmt && g_sub_serial - last_fmt >= 600) { last_fmt = g_sub_serial; char b[512]; size_t o = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < nfmt; j++) if (fmt_b[j] >> 20) o += (size_t)snprintf(b + o, sizeof b - o, " 格式%lu:%llu张/%lluMB", (unsigned long)fmt_pf[j], (unsigned long long)fmt_n[j], (unsigned long long)(fmt_b[j] >> 20));
        MLOG("贴图副本按格式：%s", b); } }
    if (k) {} else if (want) {
        static uint64_t last; if (g_sub_serial - last >= 300) { last = g_sub_serial;
            MLOG("贴图副本淘汰：可用 %llu MB，想释放 %llu MB，但没有闲置的副本（副本 %llu 张 / %llu MB）", (unsigned long long)(avail >> 20), (unsigned long long)(want >> 20), (unsigned long long)total_n, (unsigned long long)(total >> 20)); }
    }
}
static MTLTextureType ttype(int target, int fallback) {
    switch (target) { case 0: return MTLTextureType1D; case 1: case 7: return MTLTextureType2D; case 2: return MTLTextureType3D;
        case 3: return MTLTextureType1DArray; case 4: return MTLTextureType2DArray; case 5: return MTLTextureType2DMultisample;
        case 6: return MTLTextureType2DMultisampleArray; case 8: return MTLTextureTypeCube; case 9: return MTLTextureTypeCubeArray; }
    return (MTLTextureType)fallback;
}
// 池外贴图号 = 空槽：游戏自己用 GetSeparateTextureHandle(0xFFFFF) 取句柄绑到不用的槽（实测调用点 main+0x1746820，
// 贴图池容量 15256），从不登记该号。按 D3D / 空槽语义读出 0（与未绑同一套全零哑贴图），不报红；池内未登记的号仍报红
// Out-of-pool texture ID = empty slot: the game itself uses GetSeparateTextureHandle(0xFFFFF) to get a handle and bind it to unused slots (measured call site main+0x1746820,
// texture pool capacity 15256) and never registers that ID. Read 0 per D3D / empty-slot semantics (the same all-zero dummy textures as unbound), no failure; unregistered IDs inside the pool are still reported a failure
static int g_tpool_n; static uint64_t g_stat_tex_oob;
void mtl_set_tex_pool_n(int n) { g_tpool_n = n; }
/* DM_NVN_LIFELOG (see totk_lifelog.h): the texture the replay resolves for a followed texture-pool id, once per frame and id. */
static void life_use(int tid, const tex_t *t, const char *how) {
    static uint64_t frame = ~0ull; static int seen[64]; static int nseen;
    uint64_t f = atomic_load(&g_cur_frame); if (f != frame) { frame = f; nseen = 0; }
    for (int i = 0; i < nseen; i++) if (seen[i] == tid) return;
    if (nseen < 64) seen[nseen++] = tid;
    totk_life_log("use fc=%llu id=%d ser=%llu mem=%p %s%s", (unsigned long long)f, tid, (unsigned long long)t->serial, (void *)t->mem, how, serial_is_dead(t->serial) ? " (dead)" : "");
}
/* What a texture-ID view of this kind was validated against: 1 = CPU-pool texture tracked by page protection (guest-write
   generation), 2 = small CPU-pool texture checked by content once per submission (pkg_hashed). */
static int tex_check_once(void);
static inline uint64_t treg_stamp(int kind) { return kind == 2 || (kind == 1 && tex_check_once()) ? g_sub_serial : nvn_dirty_now(); }
static uint8_t treg_kind(const tex_t *t) { return tex_mirrored(t) ? (pkg_hashed(t) ? 2 : 1) : 0; }
static id<MTLTexture> tex_by_id(int tid) {   // 调用方持 g_rmu | Caller holds g_rmu
    if (g_tpool_n && tid >= g_tpool_n) { if (!g_stat_tex_oob++) MLOG("池外贴图号 %d（池容量 %d）按空槽处理：读出 0", tid, g_tpool_n); return nil; }
    if (tid < 0 || tid >= g_ntreg || !g_treg[tid].ok) { RED_ONCE(10, "贴图号 %d 未登记", tid); return nil; }
    treg_t *rp = &g_treg[tid];
    rp->used = g_sub_serial;   // TOTK: the fast path below never reaches tex_mtl; pkg_evict_sweep reads this
    if (totk_life_on() && totk_life_match(&rp->t)) life_use(tid, &rp->t, "registered");
    uint64_t sg = g_ser_gen, dg = nvn_dirty_now();   // 先取代号再查：期间若有变更，下次必走慢路 | Take the generations first and then look up: if a change happens in between, the next time must take the slow path
    /* TOTK: serial-table steps since validation that were all for other serials leave this view as it was; then only a
       CPU-mirrored texture still has to look at guest writes (tex_mtl below). */
    int ser_same = rp->view && !rp->dead_pending && (rp->view_ser == sg || ser_unaffected(rp->view_ser, sg, rp->t.serial));
    if (ser_same && (!rp->view_pkg || rp->view_dirty == treg_stamp(rp->view_pkg))) { rp->view_ser = sg; return (__bridge id<MTLTexture>)rp->view; }
    /* TOTK: the registered texture was finalised and re-initialised at the same storage (per-frame transient textures):
       follow the memory to the live texture, as the NVN descriptor does on hardware. */
    int dead = !ser_same && rp->t.mem && serial_is_dead(rp->t.serial);
    if (dead) {
        tex_t live; extern int nvn_tex_live_at(const void *mem, tex_t *out);
        if (nvn_tex_live_at(rp->t.mem, &live) && live.serial != rp->t.serial && live.L.size == rp->t.L.size && live.d.format == rp->t.d.format &&
            live.d.width == rp->t.d.width && live.d.height == rp->t.d.height && live.d.depth == rp->t.d.depth && live.d.target == rp->t.d.target && live.d.levels == rp->t.d.levels) {
            static uint64_t n; if (n++ < 4 || n % 100000 == 0) MLOG("texture id %d: registration followed its storage from finalised serial %llu to live serial %llu (%u redirects so far)", tid, (unsigned long long)rp->t.serial, (unsigned long long)live.serial, (unsigned)n);
            if (rp->view) treg_clear_view_locked(tid);
            if (totk_life_on() && totk_life_match(&live)) totk_life_log("use fc=%llu id=%d redirect %llu -> %llu mem=%p", (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&g_cur_frame), tid, (unsigned long long)rp->t.serial, (unsigned long long)live.serial, (void *)live.mem);
            treg_ref_locked(live.serial, 1); treg_ref_locked(rp->t.serial, -1); uint64_t was_ = rp->t.serial;
            rp->t = live; if (tid < (1 << 20)) atomic_store_explicit(&g_tser[tid], live.serial, memory_order_release);
            serial_forget_locked_rmu(was_);
            dead = 0;
        }
    }
    rp->dead_pending = (uint8_t)dead;
    id<MTLTexture> v = (__bridge id<MTLTexture>)rp->view;
    if (v) {   // 序号表或客体内存有过变动：核基贴图是否被重传换新，换了则视图作废 | The serial table or guest memory has changed: check whether the base texture was re-uploaded and replaced; if so the view is invalidated
        id<MTLTexture> cur = tex_mtl(&rp->t);
        if (g_tex_prepare_split) return nil;
        if (cur == v || v.parentTexture == cur) { rp->view_ser = sg; rp->view_pkg = treg_kind(&rp->t); rp->view_dirty = rp->view_pkg == 2 || (rp->view_pkg == 1 && tex_check_once()) ? g_sub_serial : dg; return v; }
        treg_clear_view_locked(tid); v = nil;
    }
    treg_t r = *rp;
    if (!r.has_v) memset(&r.v, 0, sizeof r.v);   // only a registered view may change format, levels, layers or target
    id<MTLTexture> base = tex_mtl(&rp->t);
    if (!base) return nil;
    v = base;
    MTLTextureSwizzleChannels vsw = MTLTextureSwizzleChannelsDefault;
    int need_swz = tex_swizzle_sel(&r.t, r.has_v && r.v.set_swizzle ? r.v.swz : NULL, r.has_v && r.v.set_format ? r.v.format : r.t.d.format, &vsw) || !swizzle_eq(base.swizzle, MTLTextureSwizzleChannelsDefault);
    if (need_swz || (r.has_v && (r.v.set_format || r.v.set_levels || r.v.set_layers || r.v.set_target || r.v.set_stencil))) {
        uint32_t pf = (uint32_t)base.pixelFormat; uint8_t swz[4];
        if (r.v.set_format && !(nvn_fmt_to_mtl(r.v.format, &pf, swz) && pf)) pf = (uint32_t)base.pixelFormat;
        if (r.v.set_stencil) {   // Bayonetta 3: the stencil plane of a depth-stencil texture, read as an unsigned integer texture
            if (base.pixelFormat == MTLPixelFormatDepth32Float_Stencil8) pf = MTLPixelFormatX32_Stencil8;
            else if (base.pixelFormat != MTLPixelFormatStencil8) MDIE("texture id %d: stencil view of Metal format %lu", tid, (unsigned long)base.pixelFormat);
            if (pf != base.pixelFormat && !(base.usage & MTLTextureUsagePixelFormatView)) {
                base = tex_upgrade_pfv(&rp->t, base, (MTLPixelFormat)pf);
                if (g_tex_prepare_split) return nil;
                sg = g_ser_gen;
            }
        }
        { uint32_t upf; int ubpp; if (r.v.set_format && bc1_fmt(r.v.format) && pf_astc4(base.pixelFormat)) pf = (uint32_t)bc1_astc_pf(r.v.format);   // TOTK: BC1 view of a transcoded (ASTC) texture
          else if (r.v.set_format && tc_pf(r.v.format) != MTLPixelFormatInvalid && tc_pf(r.t.d.format) == base.pixelFormat) pf = (uint32_t)tc_pf(r.v.format);   // TOTK: view of a BC2/3/4/5/7 texture stored transcoded (tex_tc)
          else if (r.v.set_format && bc_unpack(r.v.format, &upf, &ubpp)) pf = upf; }   // 无 BC：BC 视图跟底图一样换成解压后的格式 | No BC: a BC view is switched to the decompressed format just like the base texture
        if (r.v.set_format && tex_need_pfv(base.pixelFormat, (MTLPixelFormat)pf) && !(base.usage & MTLTextureUsagePixelFormatView)) {
            base = tex_upgrade_pfv(&rp->t, base, (MTLPixelFormat)pf);
            if (g_tex_prepare_split) return nil;
            sg = g_ser_gen;
        }
        NSUInteger l0 = r.v.set_levels ? r.v.base_level : 0, nl = r.v.set_levels && r.v.nlevels ? r.v.nlevels : base.mipmapLevelCount - l0;
        { NSUInteger full = r.t.d.levels ? r.t.d.levels : 1;   // TOTK: a copy without its top level(s) (mip_drop_of): shift the view's level range
          if (r.v.set_levels && base.mipmapLevelCount < full && tex_mirrored(&r.t)) { NSUInteger dl = full - base.mipmapLevelCount; l0 = l0 > dl ? l0 - dl : 0; if (l0 >= base.mipmapLevelCount) l0 = base.mipmapLevelCount - 1; nl = MIN(nl, base.mipmapLevelCount - l0); } }
        NSUInteger s0 = r.v.set_layers ? r.v.min_layer : 0;
        NSUInteger ns = base.textureType == MTLTextureType3D ? 1 : (r.v.set_layers && r.v.nlayers ? r.v.nlayers : base.arrayLength * (base.textureType == MTLTextureTypeCube || base.textureType == MTLTextureTypeCubeArray ? 6 : 1) - s0);
        MTLTextureType tt = r.v.set_target ? ttype(r.v.target, base.textureType) : base.textureType;
        if (tt == MTLTextureType2D && ns > 1) ns = 1;
        /* TOTK containment: an invalid view must never reach the GPU (full-game runs kernel-panicked macOS; a run with
           submission disabled then hit Metal rejecting an R32Float 1-level texture viewed as BC3 sRGB with 9 levels).
           Such registrations are reported with details and bound as empty. */
        { int bw = 0, bh = 0, vbw = 0, vbh = 0, bpb = nvn_fmt_bpb(r.t.d.format, &bw, &bh), vbpb = r.v.set_format ? nvn_fmt_bpb(r.v.format, &vbw, &vbh) : bpb;
          if (!r.v.set_format) { vbw = bw; vbh = bh; }
          NSUInteger slices = base.textureType == MTLTextureType3D ? 1 : base.arrayLength * (base.textureType == MTLTextureTypeCube || base.textureType == MTLTextureTypeCubeArray ? 6 : 1);
          if (vbpb != bpb || vbw != bw || vbh != bh || !nl || l0 + nl > base.mipmapLevelCount || s0 + ns > slices) {
              static uint64_t bad; bad++;
              if (bad <= 16 || bad % 1000 == 0)
                  MLOG("【红】texture id %d: invalid view refused (%llu so far): texture serial %llu format %#x %ux%ux%u levels %u target %d | view format %s%#x levels %s%u+%u layers %s%u+%u target %s%d | Metal base format %lu levels %lu slices %lu",
                       tid, (unsigned long long)bad, (unsigned long long)r.t.serial, r.t.d.format, r.t.d.width, r.t.d.height, r.t.d.depth, r.t.d.levels, r.t.d.target,
                       r.v.set_format ? "" : "(unset)", r.v.format, r.v.set_levels ? "" : "(unset)", r.v.base_level, r.v.nlevels, r.v.set_layers ? "" : "(unset)", r.v.min_layer, r.v.nlayers,
                       r.v.set_target ? "" : "(unset)", r.v.target, (unsigned long)base.pixelFormat, (unsigned long)base.mipmapLevelCount, (unsigned long)slices);
              return nil;
          } }
        v = need_swz ? [base newTextureViewWithPixelFormat:(MTLPixelFormat)pf textureType:tt levels:NSMakeRange(l0, nl) slices:NSMakeRange(s0, ns) swizzle:vsw]
                     : [base newTextureViewWithPixelFormat:(MTLPixelFormat)pf textureType:tt levels:NSMakeRange(l0, nl) slices:NSMakeRange(s0, ns)];
        if (!v) { RED_ONCE(11, "贴图视图建不出 id %d", tid); v = base; }
    }
    rp->view = (void *)CFBridgingRetain(v); rp->view_rid = v.gpuResourceID._impl; rp->view_ser = sg; rp->view_pkg = treg_kind(&rp->t); rp->view_dirty = rp->view_pkg == 2 || (rp->view_pkg == 1 && tex_check_once()) ? g_sub_serial : dg;
    treg_link_locked(tid);
    return v;
}
// 热路径取对象：表里有效就直接返回表持有的指针（不经 ARC 的 retain / autorelease），否则走慢路建 / 校验。调用方持 g_rmu。
// Hot-path object fetch: if the table entry is valid, return the table-held pointer directly (without ARC retain / autorelease), otherwise take the slow path to build / validate. Caller holds g_rmu.
static inline __attribute__((always_inline)) void *tex_fast(int tid) {
    if (tid > 0 && tid < g_ntreg && g_treg[tid].ok && g_treg[tid].view && g_treg[tid].view_ser == g_ser_gen && (!g_treg[tid].view_pkg || g_treg[tid].view_dirty == treg_stamp(g_treg[tid].view_pkg))) return g_treg[tid].view;
    return (__bridge void *)tex_by_id(tid);
}
static inline __attribute__((always_inline)) uint64_t tex_fast_rid(int tid, void **out) {
    if (tid > 0 && tid < g_ntreg && g_treg[tid].ok && g_treg[tid].view && g_treg[tid].view_ser == g_ser_gen && (!g_treg[tid].view_pkg || g_treg[tid].view_dirty == treg_stamp(g_treg[tid].view_pkg))) { if (out) *out = g_treg[tid].view; return g_treg[tid].view_rid; }
    id<MTLTexture> t = tex_by_id(tid); if (out) *out = (__bridge void *)t; return t ? t.gpuResourceID._impl : 0;
}
static MTLSamplerAddressMode wrapm(int w) {
    switch (w) { case 0: case 7: return MTLSamplerAddressModeClampToEdge; case 1: return MTLSamplerAddressModeRepeat;
        case 3: case 2: return MTLSamplerAddressModeMirrorClampToEdge; case 5: case 4: return MTLSamplerAddressModeClampToBorderColor;
        case 6: return MTLSamplerAddressModeMirrorRepeat; }
    return MTLSamplerAddressModeRepeat;
}
static id<MTLSamplerState> samp_by_id(int sid) {   // 调用方持 g_rmu | Caller holds g_rmu
    if (sid < 0 || sid >= g_nsreg || !g_sreg_ok[sid]) { RED_ONCE(12, "采样器号 %d 未登记", sid); return nil; }
    if (g_sview[sid]) return (__bridge id<MTLSamplerState>)g_sview[sid];
    samp_par p = g_sreg[sid];
    MTLSamplerDescriptor *d = [MTLSamplerDescriptor new];
    d.magFilter = p.magf ? MTLSamplerMinMagFilterLinear : MTLSamplerMinMagFilterNearest;
    d.minFilter = (p.minf == 1 || p.minf == 3 || p.minf == 5) ? MTLSamplerMinMagFilterLinear : MTLSamplerMinMagFilterNearest;
    d.mipFilter = p.minf <= 1 ? MTLSamplerMipFilterNotMipmapped : (p.minf == 2 || p.minf == 3) ? MTLSamplerMipFilterNearest : MTLSamplerMipFilterLinear;
    d.sAddressMode = wrapm(p.ws); d.tAddressMode = wrapm(p.wt); d.rAddressMode = wrapm(p.wr);
    if (samp_border_custom(&p)) {   // the shader returns the border colour outside the texture (fs_fn_border); inside it, edge texels must not blend with a wrong border
        if (d.sAddressMode == MTLSamplerAddressModeClampToBorderColor) d.sAddressMode = MTLSamplerAddressModeClampToEdge;
        if (d.tAddressMode == MTLSamplerAddressModeClampToBorderColor) d.tAddressMode = MTLSamplerAddressModeClampToEdge;
        if (d.rAddressMode == MTLSamplerAddressModeClampToBorderColor) d.rAddressMode = MTLSamplerAddressModeClampToEdge;
    }
    d.lodMinClamp = p.lod_min < 0 ? 0 : p.lod_min; d.lodMaxClamp = p.lod_max;
    d.maxAnisotropy = p.aniso < 1 ? 1 : p.aniso > 16 ? 16 : (NSUInteger)p.aniso;
    {   // key 6 (odyssey_gfx.h): at least this much anisotropic filtering on the game's mipmapped, linearly filtered samplers
        NSUInteger ga = (NSUInteger)gx_aniso();
        if (ga > d.maxAnisotropy && d.mipFilter != MTLSamplerMipFilterNotMipmapped && d.minFilter == MTLSamplerMinMagFilterLinear && !p.cmp_mode) d.maxAnisotropy = ga;
    }
    if (p.cmp_mode) d.compareFunction = (MTLCompareFunction)(p.cmp_func - 1);
    d.borderColor = p.border[3] > 0.5f ? (p.border[0] > 0.5f ? MTLSamplerBorderColorOpaqueWhite : MTLSamplerBorderColorOpaqueBlack) : MTLSamplerBorderColorTransparentBlack;
    if (p.reduction > 2) die("sampler reduction filter %u unsupported", p.reduction);
    d.reductionMode = (MTLSamplerReductionMode)p.reduction;   // TOTK: NVN AVERAGE/MIN/MAX = Metal WeightedAverage/Minimum/Maximum
    d.supportArgumentBuffers = YES;
    id<MTLSamplerState> s = [g_dev newSamplerStateWithDescriptor:d];
    if (s) { g_sview[sid] = (void *)CFBridgingRetain(s); g_srid[sid] = s.gpuResourceID._impl; }
    return s;
}
/* Key 6: the cached samplers are rebuilt with the new filtering. The old ones stay alive until the flush after next (a
   frame in flight may still name them); the caller holds g_rmu, the registry lock (the same lock, re-entered). */
static void samp_flush_all(void) {
    static void **old[2]; static int nold[2], gen;
    registry_lock();
    if (atomic_exchange(&g_samp_flush, 0)) {
        int k = gen++ & 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < nold[k]; i++) if (old[k][i]) CFRelease(old[k][i]);
        free(old[k]); old[k] = calloc((size_t)g_nsreg + 1, sizeof **old); nold[k] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < g_nsreg; i++) if (g_sview[i]) { if (old[k]) old[k][nold[k]++] = g_sview[i]; else CFRelease(g_sview[i]); g_sview[i] = NULL; g_srid[i] = 0; }
        g_reg_gen++;
        MLOG("[gfx] texture filtering: %d samplers rebuilt at %dx", nold[k], gx_aniso());
    }
    registry_unlock();
}
static inline __attribute__((always_inline)) void *samp_fast(int sid) {
    if (__builtin_expect(atomic_load_explicit(&g_samp_flush, memory_order_relaxed), 0)) samp_flush_all();
    if (sid > 0 && sid < g_nsreg && g_sreg_ok[sid] && g_sview[sid]) return g_sview[sid];
    return (__bridge void *)samp_by_id(sid);
}

// ---------- 参数缓冲区块：每次提交一块，GPU 完成后回收 ----------
// ---------- Argument buffer blocks: one block per submission, reclaimed after the GPU completes ----------
@interface NvArena : NSObject { @public id<MTLBuffer> buf; uint64_t gpu, fence; size_t used; } @end
@implementation NvArena @end
static NSMutableArray<NvArena *> *g_arenas; static NvArena *g_cur_arena; static NSMutableArray<NvArena *> *g_sub_arenas;
static NvArena *arena_new(void) {
    // for-in 循环变量不持有对象：先取强引用再从数组删，否则数组释放后返回的是野指针
    // The for-in loop variable does not retain the object: take a strong reference first and then remove it from the array, otherwise what is returned after the array releases it is a dangling pointer
    uint64_t done = __atomic_load_n(&g_done, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    for (NvArena *it in g_arenas) if (it->fence && it->fence <= done) {
        if (it->fence > g_pend_reuse_done) {
            static int audit = -1; if (audit < 0) audit = getenv("TOTK_PEND_ARENA_AUDIT") != NULL;
            if (audit) { uintptr_t lo = (uintptr_t)it->buf.contents, hi = lo + it->used;
                for (int i = 0; i < g_npend; i++) if (!g_pend_kind[i] && (uintptr_t)g_pend_src[i] >= lo && (uintptr_t)g_pend_src[i] < hi) {
                    if (++g_pend_arena_hazards <= 12) MLOG("[pend-arena] CPU still references retired arena: fence=%llu cutoff=%llu dst=%#llx pin=%d",
                        (unsigned long long)it->fence, (unsigned long long)g_pend_reuse_done, (unsigned long long)g_pend_lo[i], atomic_load(&g_pend_arena_pin));
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (atomic_load(&g_pend_arena_pin)) continue;
        }
        NvArena *r = it; [g_arenas removeObject:r]; r->fence = 0; r->used = 0; return r;
    }
    NvArena *a = [NvArena new]; a->buf = [g_dev newBufferWithLength:4 << 20 options:MTLResourceStorageModeShared]; a->gpu = a->buf.gpuAddress; res_add(a->buf); return a;
}
static uint64_t g_arena_epoch; // A cached GPU address is valid only for its submission.
void arena_begin(void) { g_arena_epoch++; if (!g_arenas) { g_arenas = [NSMutableArray array]; g_sub_arenas = [NSMutableArray array]; } g_cur_arena = nil; }
void arena_commit(uint64_t fence) { for (NvArena *a in g_sub_arenas) { a->fence = fence; [g_arenas addObject:a]; } [g_sub_arenas removeAllObjects]; g_cur_arena = nil; }
static size_t arena_alloc(size_t n, id<MTLBuffer> *buf) {
    n = (n + 255) & ~(size_t)255;
    if (!g_cur_arena || g_cur_arena->used + n > (size_t)(4 << 20)) {   // every arena is 4 MiB (arena_new); was a buf.length message per allocation
        pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mu); g_cur_arena = arena_new(); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mu);
        [g_sub_arenas addObject:g_cur_arena];
    }
    size_t off = g_cur_arena->used; g_cur_arena->used += n; *buf = g_cur_arena->buf; return off;
}

// ---------- 绘制状态 ----------
// ---------- Draw state ----------
static struct {
    const prog_t *prog;
    const prog_t *stage_prog[5];   // graphics stage -> the program bound for it (NVN binds programs per stage mask)
    blend_st blend[8]; color_st color; chmask_st chmask; ms_st ms; poly_st poly; ds_st ds;
    va_st attr[16]; int nattr; vs_st stream[16]; int nstream;
    NVNbufferRange vbuf[16];
    p_bind_buf ubo[6][16], ssbo[6][16];
    uint64_t tex[6][128], samp[6][128], img[6][32];
    uint64_t tex_gen[6];   // TOTK: a fresh value of g_tex_gen_seq whenever tex[stage] changes (TEX_CHANGED); saved / restored with S
    uint32_t st_vmask[2], st_wmask[2], st_ref[2];
    p_poly_offset po; float vp[16][4]; float dr[2]; int has_vp; int depth_clamp; int render_disabled; int raster_discard;
    float blend_color[4]; int64_t copy_stride;
} S;
/* TOTK: stage_sig compared 128 texture handles of the stage with its last copy on every draw (a 1 KiB memcmp, 0.13 ms a
   frame in a shrine). Every write to S.tex now gives that stage a fresh, never reused number, so equal numbers mean equal
   handles also after S is saved and restored. TOTK_TEX_GEN_CHECK=1 compares the handles as well and stops on a difference. */
static uint64_t g_tex_gen_seq;
#define TEX_CHANGED(st) (S.tex_gen[st] = ++g_tex_gen_seq)
static int tex_gen_check(void) { static int v = -1; if (v < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_TEX_GEN_CHECK"); v = e && atoi(e); } return v; }
// No render target set: no colour target and no depth / stencil (a pass of rasterization only, see rp_begin_ex)
static int rt_none(void) {
    if (!R.has_rt || R.rt.depth) return 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < R.rt.n && i < 8; i++) if (R.rt.color[i]) return 0;
    return 1;
}
// The size of such a pass: the extent of viewport 0, else of the scissor (1..16384)
static void noatt_dims(NSUInteger *w, NSUInteger *h) {
    double x1 = 0, y1 = 0;
    if (S.has_vp) { x1 = ceil(fmax(S.vp[0][0], S.vp[0][0] + S.vp[0][2])); y1 = ceil(fmax(S.vp[0][1], S.vp[0][1] + S.vp[0][3])); }
    if ((x1 < 1 || y1 < 1) && R.has_sc) { x1 = (double)R.sc.x + R.sc.w; y1 = (double)R.sc.y + R.sc.h; }
    *w = x1 < 1 ? 1 : x1 > 16384 ? 16384 : (NSUInteger)x1; *h = y1 < 1 ? 1 : y1 > 16384 ? 16384 : (NSUInteger)y1;
}
static void udc_note_draw(NvProg *pr) {
    if (R.has_rt) for (int i = 0; i < R.rt.n && i < 8; i++) if (R.rt.color[i]) { zskip_del(R.rt.color[i]->serial); g_zskip_cand_ok[i] = 0; }   // 零源集合：真画了就不再是全零 | Zero-source set: once really drawn it is no longer all zeros
    /* TOTK (after D2R Mobile 44a6770): the program's image bindings and fragment colour mask are worked out once per program
       and kept on it (two loops over every binding of every stage on every draw before). */
    if (pr && pr->udc_ok) for (int st = 0; st < 6; st++) if (pr->udc_sh[st] != (__bridge void *)pr->sh[st]) { pr->udc_ok = 0; break; }
    if (pr && !pr->udc_ok) {
        int img = 0, imgw = 0; uint32_t cm = 0;
        for (int st = 0; st < 6; st++) { __unsafe_unretained NvShader *sh = pr->sh[st]; pr->udc_sh[st] = (__bridge void *)sh; if (!sh) continue;
            if (st == 1) cm = sh->rf.color_mask;
            for (int i = 0; i < sh->rf.nb; i++) if (sh->rf.b[i].kind == NVN_RB_IMG) { img = 1; if (sh->rf.b[i].rw) imgw = 1; } }
        pr->udc_img = (uint8_t)img; pr->udc_imgw = (uint8_t)imgw; pr->udc_cmask = cm; pr->udc_ok = 1;
    }
    if (pr && pr->udc_img) zskip_clear();   // 图像槽可写：保守清空 | Image slots are writable: conservatively clear
    int image_write = pr ? pr->udc_imgw : 0;
    uint32_t shader_color_mask = pr ? pr->udc_cmask : 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_nsd; i++) {
        sd_att *t = &g_sd[i];
        if (image_write) { t->wrote = 1; t->wwhy = 1; }
        else if (t->depth == 0 && t->idx >= 0 && (((S.chmask.mask >> (4 * t->idx)) & 0xf) || (shader_color_mask >> t->idx & 1))) { t->wrote = 1; t->wwhy = (S.chmask.mask >> (4 * t->idx)) & 0xf ? 2 : 3; }
        else if (t->depth == 1 && S.ds.dw) { t->wrote = 1; t->wwhy = 4; }
        else if (t->depth == 2 && S.ds.st && (S.st_wmask[0] || S.st_wmask[1])
                && (S.ds.fail_f != NVN_STENCIL_OP_KEEP || S.ds.zfail_f != NVN_STENCIL_OP_KEEP || S.ds.zpass_f != NVN_STENCIL_OP_KEEP
                    || S.ds.fail_b != NVN_STENCIL_OP_KEEP || S.ds.zfail_b != NVN_STENCIL_OP_KEEP || S.ds.zpass_b != NVN_STENCIL_OP_KEEP)) { t->wrote = 1; t->wwhy = 5; }
    }
}
/* Per-stage program binding (NVN: BindProgram(p, stages) replaces only the stages in the mask; a stage p lacks becomes
   unbound). Bayonetta 3 binds a vertex-only and a fragment-only program; TOTK binds whole graphics programs and compute
   programs on their own. The replay draws with one program, so:
   - a compute-only bind makes that program current, as before (the graphics stages stay bound for later draws);
   - a graphics bind whose program covers every bound graphics stage makes it current, as before (TOTK's case);
   - otherwise the bound stages are combined into a host program, one per distinct combination (cached by the component
     programs and their serials; a component's new SetShaders gives a new serial and so a new combination). */
static int prog_stage_index(const prog_t *p, int stage) {
    for (unsigned i = 0; p && i < p->nstage; i++) { uint32_t st; memcpy(&st, (const uint8_t *)p->sd[i].control + 0x714, 4); if ((int)st == stage) return (int)i; }
    return -1;
}
extern uint64_t nvn_new_serial(void);
static const prog_t *prog_combined(void) {
    typedef struct { const prog_t *part[5]; uint64_t ser[5]; prog_t *prog; } combo_t;
    static combo_t *tab; static size_t n, cap;
