    uint64_t ser[5]; for (int s = 0; s < 5; s++) ser[s] = S.stage_prog[s] ? S.stage_prog[s]->serial : 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) if (!memcmp(tab[i].part, S.stage_prog, sizeof tab[i].part) && !memcmp(tab[i].ser, ser, sizeof ser)) return tab[i].prog;
    prog_t *c = calloc(1, sizeof *c); if (!c) MDIE("combined program allocation");
    c->magic = 0x474f5250;   /* "PROG", as nvnProgramInitialize writes it */
    for (int s = 0; s < 5; s++) { int k = prog_stage_index(S.stage_prog[s], s); if (k >= 0) c->sd[c->nstage++] = S.stage_prog[s]->sd[k]; }
    c->serial = nvn_new_serial();
    if (n == cap) { cap = cap ? cap * 2 : 64; tab = realloc(tab, cap * sizeof *tab); if (!tab) MDIE("combined program table"); }
    combo_t *e = &tab[n++]; memcpy(e->part, S.stage_prog, sizeof e->part); memcpy(e->ser, ser, sizeof ser); e->prog = c;
    if (n <= 4 || n % 1000 == 0) MLOG("[prog] combined program %zu: %u stages from per-stage binds", n, c->nstage);
    return c;
}
static const prog_t *prog_bind(const prog_t *np, int stages) {
    if (!(stages & NVN_SHADER_STAGE_ALL_GRAPHICS_BITS)) return np;   // compute only
    for (int s = 0; s < 5; s++) if (stages & (1 << s)) S.stage_prog[s] = prog_stage_index(np, s) >= 0 ? np : NULL;
    int mixed = 0; for (int s = 0; s < 5; s++) mixed |= S.stage_prog[s] && S.stage_prog[s] != np;
    return mixed ? prog_combined() : np;
}
static void state_reset(void) {
    memset(&S, 0, sizeof S);
    g_pso_dirty = g_dss_dirty = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) S.blend[i] = (blend_st){i, NVN_BLEND_FUNC_ONE, NVN_BLEND_FUNC_ZERO, NVN_BLEND_FUNC_ONE, NVN_BLEND_FUNC_ZERO, NVN_BLEND_EQUATION_ADD, NVN_BLEND_EQUATION_ADD};
    S.color = (color_st){0, NVN_LOGIC_OP_COPY, NVN_ALPHA_FUNC_ALWAYS}; S.chmask.mask = 0xffffffffu;
    S.poly = (poly_st){NVN_FACE_NONE, NVN_FRONT_FACE_CCW, NVN_POLYGON_MODE_FILL, 0};
    S.ds = (ds_st){0, 1, NVN_DEPTH_FUNC_LESS, 0, NVN_STENCIL_FUNC_ALWAYS, NVN_STENCIL_FUNC_ALWAYS, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1};
    S.st_vmask[0] = S.st_vmask[1] = S.st_wmask[0] = S.st_wmask[1] = 0xff; S.dr[1] = 1;
}

// TOTK: translator answers from the bound state (texture types per slot, image formats, vertex input and
// colour output component classes). Unbound slots are left out; the translator then uses its defaults.
static NSString *fmt_class(int f) {
    switch (f) {
        case 0x03: case 0x08: case 0x0B: case 0x0F: case 0x14: case 0x17: case 0x1B: case 0x20: case 0x23: case 0x27: case 0x2C: case 0x2F: return @"uint";
        case 0x04: case 0x09: case 0x0C: case 0x10: case 0x15: case 0x18: case 0x1C: case 0x21: case 0x24: case 0x28: case 0x2D: case 0x30: return @"sint";
        default: return @"float";
    }
}
static NSString *target_name(int t) {
    switch (t) { case 0: return @"1d"; case 2: return @"3d"; case 3: return @"1darray"; case 4: return @"2darray"; case 5: return @"2dms";
                 case 6: return @"2dmsarray"; case 8: return @"cube"; case 9: return @"cubearray"; case 10: return @"buffer"; default: return @"2d"; }
}
static NSString *image_format(int f) {
    switch (f) {
        case 0x01: return @"R8Unorm"; case 0x0D: return @"R8G8Unorm"; case 0x25: return @"R8G8B8A8Unorm"; case 0x27: return @"R8G8B8A8Uint";
        case 0x05: return @"R16Float"; case 0x11: return @"R16G16Float"; case 0x29: return @"R16G16B16A16Float"; case 0x08: return @"R16Uint"; case 0x2C: return @"R16G16B16A16Uint";
        case 0x0A: return @"R32Float"; case 0x16: return @"R32G32Float"; case 0x2E: return @"R32G32B32A32Float"; case 0x0B: return @"R32Uint"; case 0x0C: return @"R32Sint";
        case 0x17: return @"R32G32Uint"; case 0x2F: return @"R32G32B32A32Uint"; case 0x3D: return @"R10G10B10A2Unorm"; case 0x3F: return @"R11G11B10Float";
        default: return nil;
    }
}
static const treg_t *bound_tex(uint64_t h) { int tid = (int)(h & 0xfffff); return tid > 0 && tid < g_ntreg && g_treg[tid].ok ? &g_treg[tid] : NULL; }
static int bound_target(const treg_t *r) { return r->has_v && r->v.set_target ? r->v.target : r->t.d.target; }
static NSDictionary *rt_answers(int st) {
    NSMutableDictionary *tex = [NSMutableDictionary dictionary], *img = [NSMutableDictionary dictionary], *attr = [NSMutableDictionary dictionary], *fout = [NSMutableDictionary dictionary];
    registry_lock();   /* nested on this thread or wait for a different owner */
    for (int r = 0; r < 128; r++) if (S.tex[st][r]) { const treg_t *t = bound_tex(S.tex[st][r]); if (!t) continue;
        /* TOTK: a depth-format texture (NVN 0x32..0x36) sampled through a plain texture slot must be declared depth2d in MSL
           (Metal gives no data for a depth texture read as texture2d, and depth formats cannot be viewed as colour);
           the answer carries a _depth suffix so the translation is a separate variant and the MSL is rewritten. */
        int f = t->has_v && t->v.set_format ? t->v.format : t->t.d.format; NSString *name = target_name(bound_target(t));
        tex[@(r).stringValue] = f >= 0x32 && f <= 0x36 ? [name stringByAppendingString:@"_depth"] : name; }
    for (int r = 0; r < 32; r++) if (S.img[st][r]) { const treg_t *t = bound_tex(S.img[st][r]); if (!t) continue;
        int f = t->has_v && t->v.set_format ? t->v.format : t->t.d.format; NSString *fn = image_format(f);
        img[@(r).stringValue] = fn ? @{@"type": target_name(bound_target(t)), @"fmt": fn} : @{@"type": target_name(bound_target(t))}; }
    registry_unlock();
    if (st == 0) for (int i = 0; i < S.nattr && i < 16; i++) attr[@(i).stringValue] = fmt_class(S.attr[i].fmt);
    if (st == 1 && R.has_rt) for (int i = 0; i < R.rt.n && i < 8; i++) if (R.rt.color[i]) fout[@(i).stringValue] = fmt_class(R.rt.has_cview[i] && R.rt.cview[i].set_format ? R.rt.cview[i].format : R.rt.color[i]->d.format);
    return @{@"tex": tex, @"img": img, @"attr": attr, @"fout": fout};
}
// TOTK: value class of the bound state a translation depends on (fragment outputs per render target, vertex attributes).
static int cls_of(int f) { switch (f) {
    case 0x03: case 0x08: case 0x0B: case 0x0F: case 0x14: case 0x17: case 0x1B: case 0x20: case 0x23: case 0x27: case 0x2C: case 0x2F: return 1;
    case 0x04: case 0x09: case 0x0C: case 0x10: case 0x15: case 0x18: case 0x1C: case 0x21: case 0x24: case 0x28: case 0x2D: case 0x30: return 2;
    default: return 0; } }
static const treg_t *bound_tex(uint64_t h);
static uint64_t stage_sig(int st) {
    uint64_t sg = 0;
    if (st == 1 && R.has_rt) for (int i = 0; i < R.rt.n && i < 8; i++) if (R.rt.color[i])
        sg |= (uint64_t)(1 + cls_of(R.rt.has_cview[i] && R.rt.cview[i].set_format ? R.rt.cview[i].format : R.rt.color[i]->d.format)) << (3 * i);
    if (st == 0) for (int i = 0; i < S.nattr && i < 16; i++) sg |= (uint64_t)cls_of(S.attr[i].fmt) << (2 * i);
    /* TOTK: which texture slots hold depth-format textures is part of the signature too (the MSL declares them depth2d),
       so a program first translated with other bindings is re-fitted at draw time. */
    /* The depth-slot mask only changes with this stage's bound handles or a descriptor registration (g_reg_gen): it is
       kept per stage and recomputed when either changed (it was a lookup per bound slot on every draw, about 7%). */
    { static uint64_t last_tex[6][128], last_gen[6] = {~0ull, ~0ull, ~0ull, ~0ull, ~0ull, ~0ull}, last_tg[6] = {~0ull, ~0ull, ~0ull, ~0ull, ~0ull, ~0ull}, last_dm[6];
      uint64_t dm; uint64_t gen = g_reg_gen;
      int hi = st >= 0 && st < 6 ? g_tex_hi[st] : 128;
      if (st >= 0 && st < 6 && gen == last_gen[st] && S.tex_gen[st] == last_tg[st]) {
          if (tex_gen_check() && memcmp(last_tex[st], S.tex[st], sizeof(uint64_t) * hi)) MDIE("texture slot generation %llu of stage %d kept, handles changed", (unsigned long long)S.tex_gen[st], st);
          dm = last_dm[st]; }
      else {
          dm = 0; int locked = registry_lock();
          for (int r = 0; r < hi; r++) if (S.tex[st][r]) { const treg_t *t = bound_tex(S.tex[st][r]); if (!t) continue;
              int f = t->has_v && t->v.set_format ? t->v.format : t->t.d.format; if (f >= 0x32 && f <= 0x36) dm ^= 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15ull * (uint64_t)(r + 1); }
          registry_unlock();
          if (st >= 0 && st < 6 && locked) { if (tex_gen_check()) memcpy(last_tex[st], S.tex[st], sizeof(uint64_t) * hi); last_gen[st] = gen; last_tg[st] = S.tex_gen[st]; last_dm[st] = dm; }
      }
      if (dm) sg ^= dm | 1ull << 63; }
    return sg;
}
// The same program can draw into float and integer targets or read differently typed attributes: pick (or translate)
// the variant for the current signature. Returns 1 when a stage changed.
/* Whether this draw may be skipped while its shader is translated in the background: colour (its own channel mask) into
   a plain 2D target, which scene passes redraw every frame, and no occlusion counter counting (the game culls by the
   samples it reads back). A draw the replay drops anyway (rendering disabled, rasterizer discard) never waits. */
static int draw_state_may_skip(void) {
    if (!async_shaders() || g_vis_counting || !R.has_rt) return 0;
    if (S.render_disabled || S.raster_discard) return 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < R.rt.n && i < 8; i++) {
        const tex_t *t = R.rt.color[i]; uint32_t g = t ? t->d.target : 0;
        if (t && (S.chmask.mask >> (4 * i) & 0xf) && (g == NVN_TEXTURE_TARGET_2D || g == NVN_TEXTURE_TARGET_2D_MULTISAMPLE || g == NVN_TEXTURE_TARGET_RECTANGLE)) return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}
static int draw_may_skip(const NvProg *pr) { return !pr->keeps && draw_state_may_skip(); }
/* A skipped draw still does to its colour targets what opening its pass would: their Metal textures are made and owned by
   the GPU, since the game counts them as rendered (upstream: otherwise they are uploaded again from pool bytes on every
   use). */
static void async_skip_targets(void) {
    if (!async_shaders() || !R.has_rt) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < R.rt.n && i < 8; i++) if (R.rt.color[i]) {
        (void)attachment_texture(R.rt.color[i], &R.rt.cview[i], R.rt.has_cview[i]);
        gpu_owned_mark(R.rt.color[i]->serial);
    }
}
static int prog_fit(NvProg *pr) {
    int changed = 0;
    for (int st = 0; st < 2; st++) {
        if (!pr->sh[st] || !pr->key[st]) continue;
        uint64_t sg = stage_sig(st); if (sg == pr->sig[st]) continue;
        NvShader *v = pr->alt[st][@(sg)];
        int may_skip = v ? 0 : draw_may_skip(pr); uint64_t done = totk_rt_completed();
        if (!v && pr->miss_has[st] && sg == pr->miss_sig[st] && (!async_shaders() || (may_skip && done == pr->fit_seen))) return -1;
        if (!v) {
            NSString *variant = totk_rt_variant(pr->key[st], st, pr->ctl[st], pr->code[st], rt_answers(st), nil, may_skip);
            if (!variant) { pr->miss_sig[st] = sg; pr->miss_has[st] = 1; pr->fit_seen = done; return -1; }   // iOS: not translated yet; Mac (async shaders): in the background
            if (pr->miss_has[st] && sg == pr->miss_sig[st]) pr->miss_has[st] = 0;
            v = shader_get([variant stringByAppendingString:@"_b"], st);
            if (!v) MDIE("TOTK shader translation/reflection unavailable for %s", variant.UTF8String);
            pr->alt[st][@(sg)] = v;
        }
        if (v != pr->sh[st]) changed = 1;
        pr->sh[st] = v; pr->sig[st] = sg;
    }
    return changed;
}
// TOTK_PROBE_NEGATIVE for the prediction checks of probe-gfx (24-27: each breaks one rule below; the probe must fail).
static int pred_negative(void) { static int neg = -1; if (neg < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_PROBE_NEGATIVE"); neg = e ? atoi(e) : 0; } return neg; }
// Prediction must not translate/compile, or mutate a program's active binding.
// Only the exact already-resolved variant is safe to predict. Unknown variants
// are left for the authoritative draw path, without changing active bindings.
// A program with a stage not translated yet (pr->missing, iOS) is skipped too: its draws are skipped (draw_inner), and
// its fragment stage can be absent, which would predict a pipeline without a fragment function.
// Negative 24 takes the active variant whatever the state; 26 ignores untranslated stages.
static int prog_prediction_stages(const prog_t *p, NvShader **vs, NvShader **fs) {
    NvProg *pr = p && p->serial ? (__bridge NvProg *)serial_ptr(p->serial) : nil;
    if (!pr || (pr->missing && pred_negative() != 26)) return 0;
    NvShader *stages[2] = {nil, nil};
    for (int st = 0; st < 2; st++) {
        if (!pr->sh[st]) { if (!st) return 0; continue; }
        uint64_t sig = stage_sig(st);
        stages[st] = sig == pr->sig[st] || pred_negative() == 24 ? pr->sh[st] : pr->alt[st][@(sig)];
        if (!stages[st]) return 0;
    }
    *vs = stages[0]; *fs = stages[1]; return 1;
}
// Attach modes pso_predict_rest guesses for one draw: v = 0 the pass's own depth / stencil, 1 neither, 2 stencil only,
// 3 depth only (ds_scan drops the planes no draw uses, which is only known at replay).
static const uint8_t PRED_DEPTH[4] = {1, 0, 0, 1}, PRED_STENCIL[4] = {1, 0, 1, 0};
// A fragment function that exports depth makes ds_scan attach the pass's depth buffer, so a guess without it is never
// used -- and pso_desc would compile that variant's library (fs_fn_without_depth) on the submit thread for nothing.
// Negative 27 guesses it anyway.
static int pred_guess_wanted(int v, uint32_t dfull, uint32_t sfull, __unsafe_unretained NvShader *fs) {
    uint32_t d = PRED_DEPTH[v] ? dfull : 0, s = PRED_STENCIL[v] ? sfull : 0;
    if (v && d == dfull && s == sfull) return 0;   // same as the pass's own
    if (v == 2 && !sfull) return 0;
    if (v == 3 && (!dfull || !sfull)) return 0;
    if (dfull && !d && fs && fs->writes_depth && pred_negative() != 27) return 0;
    return 1;
}
// Compute thread group size lives in the control section; not located yet, so compute shaders stop with this message.
/* Compute thread group size: control+0x748/0x74c/0x750. Evidence (12 TOTK kernels): the triple exists only in compute
   control sections; every kernel with 1,1,1 reads no thread-in-group id, and every kernel that reads it carries a
   larger size (8x8x1 twice, 9x5x1). New sizes are logged once. */
static NSArray *rt_local(const uint8_t *control, int st) {
    if (st != 5) return nil;
    uint32_t l[3]; memcpy(l, control + 0x748, 12);
    if (!l[0] || !l[1] || !l[2] || l[0] > 1024 || l[1] > 1024 || l[2] > 64 || (uint64_t)l[0] * l[1] * l[2] > 1024)
        MDIE("TOTK compute shader: implausible thread group size %u x %u x %u at control+0x748", l[0], l[1], l[2]);
    { static uint32_t seen[64][3]; static int ns; int k = 0; for (; k < ns; k++) if (!memcmp(seen[k], l, 12)) break;
      if (k == ns && ns < 64) { memcpy(seen[ns++], l, 12); MLOG("[shader] compute thread group size %u x %u x %u (control+0x748)", l[0], l[1], l[2]); } }
    return @[@(l[0]), @(l[1]), @(l[2])];
}
static MTLVertexFormat vfmt(int f) {
    switch (f) {
        case 0x01: return MTLVertexFormatUCharNormalized; case 0x02: return MTLVertexFormatCharNormalized; case 0x03: return MTLVertexFormatUChar; case 0x04: return MTLVertexFormatChar;
        case 0x05: return MTLVertexFormatHalf; case 0x06: return MTLVertexFormatUShortNormalized; case 0x07: return MTLVertexFormatShortNormalized;
        case 0x08: return MTLVertexFormatUShort; case 0x09: return MTLVertexFormatShort; case 0x0A: return MTLVertexFormatFloat; case 0x0B: return MTLVertexFormatUInt; case 0x0C: return MTLVertexFormatInt;
        case 0x0D: return MTLVertexFormatUChar2Normalized; case 0x0E: return MTLVertexFormatChar2Normalized; case 0x0F: return MTLVertexFormatUChar2; case 0x10: return MTLVertexFormatChar2;
        case 0x11: return MTLVertexFormatHalf2; case 0x12: return MTLVertexFormatUShort2Normalized; case 0x13: return MTLVertexFormatShort2Normalized; case 0x14: return MTLVertexFormatUShort2;
        case 0x15: return MTLVertexFormatShort2; case 0x16: return MTLVertexFormatFloat2; case 0x17: return MTLVertexFormatUInt2; case 0x18: return MTLVertexFormatInt2;
        case 0x19: return MTLVertexFormatUChar3Normalized; case 0x1A: return MTLVertexFormatChar3Normalized; case 0x1B: return MTLVertexFormatUChar3; case 0x1C: return MTLVertexFormatChar3;
        case 0x1D: return MTLVertexFormatHalf3; case 0x1E: return MTLVertexFormatUShort3Normalized; case 0x1F: return MTLVertexFormatShort3Normalized; case 0x20: return MTLVertexFormatUShort3;
        case 0x21: return MTLVertexFormatShort3; case 0x22: return MTLVertexFormatFloat3; case 0x23: return MTLVertexFormatUInt3; case 0x24: return MTLVertexFormatInt3;
        case 0x25: return MTLVertexFormatUChar4Normalized; case 0x26: return MTLVertexFormatChar4Normalized; case 0x27: return MTLVertexFormatUChar4; case 0x28: return MTLVertexFormatChar4;
        case 0x29: return MTLVertexFormatHalf4; case 0x2A: return MTLVertexFormatUShort4Normalized; case 0x2B: return MTLVertexFormatShort4Normalized; case 0x2C: return MTLVertexFormatUShort4;
        case 0x2D: return MTLVertexFormatShort4; case 0x2E: return MTLVertexFormatFloat4; case 0x2F: return MTLVertexFormatUInt4; case 0x30: return MTLVertexFormatInt4;
        case 0x3D: return MTLVertexFormatUInt1010102Normalized; case 0x69: return MTLVertexFormatInt1010102Normalized; /* TOTK: RGB10A2SN */ case 0x3F: return MTLVertexFormatFloatRG11B10; case 0x9A: return MTLVertexFormatUChar4Normalized_BGRA;
        /* NVN *_UI2F / *_I2F: Metal converts unnormalized integer vertex
           formats numerically when the vertex function declares float input. */
        case 0x51: return MTLVertexFormatUChar; case 0x52: return MTLVertexFormatChar;
        case 0x53: return MTLVertexFormatUShort; case 0x54: return MTLVertexFormatShort;
        case 0x55: return MTLVertexFormatUInt; case 0x56: return MTLVertexFormatInt;
        case 0x57: return MTLVertexFormatUChar2; case 0x58: return MTLVertexFormatChar2;
        case 0x59: return MTLVertexFormatUShort2; case 0x5A: return MTLVertexFormatShort2;
        case 0x5B: return MTLVertexFormatUInt2; case 0x5C: return MTLVertexFormatInt2;
        case 0x5D: return MTLVertexFormatUChar3; case 0x5E: return MTLVertexFormatChar3;
        case 0x5F: return MTLVertexFormatUShort3; case 0x60: return MTLVertexFormatShort3;
        case 0x61: return MTLVertexFormatUInt3; case 0x62: return MTLVertexFormatInt3;
        case 0x63: return MTLVertexFormatUChar4; case 0x64: return MTLVertexFormatChar4;
        case 0x65: return MTLVertexFormatUShort4; case 0x66: return MTLVertexFormatShort4;
        case 0x67: return MTLVertexFormatUInt4; case 0x68: return MTLVertexFormatInt4;
    }
    return MTLVertexFormatInvalid;
}
static MTLBlendFactor bfac(int f) {
    switch (f) { case 1: return MTLBlendFactorZero; case 2: return MTLBlendFactorOne; case 3: return MTLBlendFactorSourceColor; case 4: return MTLBlendFactorOneMinusSourceColor;
        case 5: return MTLBlendFactorSourceAlpha; case 6: return MTLBlendFactorOneMinusSourceAlpha; case 7: return MTLBlendFactorDestinationAlpha; case 8: return MTLBlendFactorOneMinusDestinationAlpha;
        case 9: return MTLBlendFactorDestinationColor; case 10: return MTLBlendFactorOneMinusDestinationColor; case 11: return MTLBlendFactorSourceAlphaSaturated;
        case 0x10: return MTLBlendFactorSource1Color; case 0x11: return MTLBlendFactorOneMinusSource1Color; case 0x12: return MTLBlendFactorSource1Alpha; case 0x13: return MTLBlendFactorOneMinusSource1Alpha;
        case 0x61: return MTLBlendFactorBlendColor; case 0x62: return MTLBlendFactorOneMinusBlendColor; case 0x63: return MTLBlendFactorBlendAlpha; case 0x64: return MTLBlendFactorOneMinusBlendAlpha; }
    return MTLBlendFactorOne;
}
static MTLBlendOperation bop(int e) { switch (e) { case 2: return MTLBlendOperationSubtract; case 3: return MTLBlendOperationReverseSubtract; case 4: return MTLBlendOperationMin; case 5: return MTLBlendOperationMax; } return MTLBlendOperationAdd; }

// 管线：按（程序, 目标格式, 混合 / 写掩码, 顶点布局, 采样数）缓存
// Pipeline: cached by (program, target formats, blend / write mask, vertex layout, sample count)
static const uint8_t *g_pso_lmap; static id<MTLFunction> g_pso_fsfn; static pso_fz_desc g_pso_fz, g_fz_desc;
static os_unfair_lock g_fz_fn_lock = OS_UNFAIR_LOCK_INIT;
static NSMutableDictionary<NSString *, id<MTLFunction>> *g_bf_fn_cache;
static NSMutableDictionary<NSString *, id<MTLLibrary>> *g_bf_lib_cache;
static nvn_hmap g_pso = {.klen = sizeof(pso_key)}, g_dss;
// TOTK: stages are translated separately, so a fragment shader may read user varyings the vertex shader never writes
// (undefined values on the Switch GPU). Metal rejects such pairs; the vertex function gets the missing outputs added
// (left zero) in a patched copy of its MSL, cached per missing set.
static NSDictionary<NSNumber *, NSString *> *msl_varyings(NvShader *sh) {
    if (sh->io || !sh_has_src(sh)) return sh->io;
    NSString *st = sh->stage == 0 ? @"main0_out" : @"main0_in";
    NSString *src0 = sh_src(sh);
    NSRange r = [src0 rangeOfString:[NSString stringWithFormat:@"struct %@\n{", st]];
    NSMutableDictionary *d = [NSMutableDictionary dictionary];
    if (r.location != NSNotFound) {
        NSRange e = [src0 rangeOfString:@"};" options:0 range:NSMakeRange(r.location, src0.length - r.location)];
        NSString *body = [src0 substringWithRange:NSMakeRange(r.location, e.location - r.location)];
        NSRegularExpression *re = [NSRegularExpression regularExpressionWithPattern:@"^\\s*(\\w+)\\s+\\w+\\s*\\[\\[user\\(locn(\\d+)\\)" options:NSRegularExpressionAnchorsMatchLines error:nil];
        for (NSTextCheckingResult *m in [re matchesInString:body options:0 range:NSMakeRange(0, body.length)])
            d[@([[body substringWithRange:[m rangeAtIndex:2]] intValue])] = [body substringWithRange:[m rangeAtIndex:1]];
    }
    sh->io = d; return d;
}
/* TOTK: in a layered pass the vertex function also writes the render target array index. The translated entry gets a
   constant at buffer LAY_BUF_INDEX holding the draw's layer within the pass, stored to the output before every return
   of the entry point (SPIRV-Cross names the entry output `out`). Its point-size output is kept in a local instead:
   Metal rejects a vertex function that writes point size under the triangle topology class a layer output requires. */
static int vs_layerable(NvShader *vs) {
    if (!vs) return 0;
    NSString *vsrc0 = vs->lay_ok ? nil : sh_src(vs);
    if (!vs->lay_ok) vs->lay_ok = sh_has_src(vs) && [vsrc0 rangeOfString:@"struct main0_out\n{\n"].location != NSNotFound
        && [vsrc0 rangeOfString:@"vertex main0_out main0("].location != NSNotFound && [vsrc0 rangeOfString:@"return out;"].location != NSNotFound
        && [vsrc0 rangeOfString:@"main0_out out = {};"].location != NSNotFound && [vsrc0 rangeOfString:@"render_target_array_index"].location == NSNotFound ? 1 : -1;
    return vs->lay_ok > 0;
}
static NSString *fs_src_without_depth(NvShader *fs);
/* Read at replay time, including inline/GPU copies queued before this draw. Retain no pointer across draws. */
static uint32_t ubo_tex_handle(int stage, const nvn_rbind *b) {
    if (stage < 0 || stage >= 6 || b->reg >= 16) return 0;
    const p_bind_buf *u = &S.ubo[stage][b->reg];
    if (!u->addr || u->size < (uint64_t)b->off + sizeof(uint32_t)) return 0;
    uint32_t handle = 0; pend_materialize(u->addr + b->off, (uint8_t *)&handle, sizeof handle, 0);
    return handle;
}
static int uniform_textures(NvShader *sh) {
    for (int i = 0; i < sh->rf.nb; i++) if (sh->rf.b[i].kind == NVN_RB_TEXU || sh->rf.b[i].kind == NVN_RB_SAMPU) return 1;
    return 0;
}
/* TOTK: samplers that clamp to a border colour Metal does not have (samp_border_custom) are emulated in the shader: the
   stage's sample calls on them return that colour when the coordinate is outside [0, 1]. border_key lists the stage's
   bound samplers that need it (argument id and colour; nil when none), border_src rewrites the MSL. */
static NSString *border_key(NvShader *sh, int stage, float colours[][4], int aids[], int *n) {
    *n = 0;
    if (!atomic_load_explicit(&g_border_custom_any, memory_order_relaxed)) return nil;
    NSMutableString *key = nil;
    registry_lock();
    for (int i = 0; i < sh->rf.nb && *n < 8; i++) {
        const nvn_rbind *b = &sh->rf.b[i];
        if ((b->kind != NVN_RB_SAMP && b->kind != NVN_RB_SAMPT && b->kind != NVN_RB_SAMPU) || b->reg >= 128) continue;
        int sid = (int)((b->kind == NVN_RB_SAMPU ? ubo_tex_handle(stage, b) : b->kind == NVN_RB_SAMPT ? S.tex[stage][b->reg] : S.samp[stage][b->reg]) >> 20);
        if (sid <= 0 || sid >= g_nsreg || !g_sreg_ok[sid] || !samp_border_custom(&g_sreg[sid])) continue;
        memcpy(colours[*n], g_sreg[sid].border, sizeof colours[*n]); aids[*n] = b->aid;
        if (!key) key = [NSMutableString string];
        [key appendFormat:@"%d:%a,%a,%a,%a;", b->aid, colours[*n][0], colours[*n][1], colours[*n][2], colours[*n][3]];
        ++*n;
    }
    registry_unlock();
    if (key) sh->border_seen = 1;
    return key;
}
static NSString *border_src(NvShader *sh, NSString *src0, float colours[][4], const int aids[], int n) {
    NSString *src = src0; int patched = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {   // SPIRV-Cross: "sampler <name> [[id(<aid>)]]" in the argument struct, used as tex.sample(spvDescriptorSet0.<name>, coord, ...)
        NSString *decl = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"sampler\\s+(\\w+)\\s*\\[\\[id\\(%d\\)\\]\\]", aids[i]];
        NSTextCheckingResult *m = [[NSRegularExpression regularExpressionWithPattern:decl options:0 error:nil] firstMatchInString:src options:0 range:NSMakeRange(0, src.length)];
        if (!m) continue;
        NSString *name = [src substringWithRange:[m rangeAtIndex:1]];
        NSRegularExpression *re = [NSRegularExpression regularExpressionWithPattern:[NSString stringWithFormat:@"([\\w.]+)\\.sample\\((\\s*spvDescriptorSet0\\.%@\\s*,)", name] options:0 error:nil];
        patched += (int)[re numberOfMatchesInString:src options:0 range:NSMakeRange(0, src.length)];
        src = [re stringByReplacingMatchesInString:src options:0 range:NSMakeRange(0, src.length)
                                      withTemplate:[NSString stringWithFormat:@"totk_border_sample(float4(%a, %a, %a, %a), $1,$2", colours[i][0], colours[i][1], colours[i][2], colours[i][3]]];
    }
    if (!patched) { static int warned; if (!warned++) MLOG("[totk] shader %s: a sampler clamps to a border colour Metal lacks, but no sample call to emulate it was found", sh->key); return nil; }
    NSString *helper =   // 2D, 2D array and 3D textures test the normalized coordinate; other kinds (cube, depth) sample as before
        @"template<typename T, typename... A> static inline vec<T, 4> totk_border_sample(float4 border, texture2d<T> t, sampler s, float2 uv, A... a)\n"
        @"{ return any(uv < 0.0) || any(uv > 1.0) ? vec<T, 4>(border) : t.sample(s, uv, a...); }\n"
        @"template<typename T, typename... A> static inline vec<T, 4> totk_border_sample(float4 border, texture2d_array<T> t, sampler s, float2 uv, A... a)\n"
        @"{ return any(uv < 0.0) || any(uv > 1.0) ? vec<T, 4>(border) : t.sample(s, uv, a...); }\n"
        @"template<typename T, typename... A> static inline vec<T, 4> totk_border_sample(float4 border, texture3d<T> t, sampler s, float3 uv, A... a)\n"
        @"{ return any(uv < 0.0) || any(uv > 1.0) ? vec<T, 4>(border) : t.sample(s, uv, a...); }\n"
        @"template<typename Tex, typename C, typename... A> static inline auto totk_border_sample(float4 border, Tex t, sampler s, C uv, A... a) -> decltype(t.sample(s, uv, a...))\n"
        @"{ return t.sample(s, uv, a...); }\n";
    NSRange r = [src rangeOfString:@"using namespace metal;\n"];
    if (r.location == NSNotFound) MDIE("shader %s: no 'using namespace metal;' for the border colour helper", sh->key);
    static int logged; if (logged++ < 16) MLOG("[totk] shader %s: sampler border colour %g %g %g %g emulated in the shader (%d samples; Metal has no such border colour)",
                                              sh->key, colours[0][0], colours[0][1], colours[0][2], colours[0][3], patched);
    return [src stringByReplacingCharactersInRange:NSMakeRange(NSMaxRange(r), 0) withString:helper];
}
/* The fragment function for the draw's samplers (border_key), nil when none needs the emulation. */
static id<MTLFunction> fs_fn_border(NvShader *fs, int nodepth) {
    if (!fs || !sh_has_src(fs)) return nil;
    float colours[8][4]; int aids[8], n;
    NSString *key = border_key(fs, 1, colours, aids, &n);
    if (!key) return nil;
    if (nodepth && fs->writes_depth) key = [@"nodepth;" stringByAppendingString:key];
    static os_unfair_lock lock = OS_UNFAIR_LOCK_INIT; os_unfair_lock_lock(&lock);
    id<MTLFunction> fn = fs->bpatch[key];
    if (!fn) {
        NSString *src = border_src(fs, nodepth && fs->writes_depth ? fs_src_without_depth(fs) : sh_src(fs), colours, aids, n);
        if (!src) { os_unfair_lock_unlock(&lock); return nil; }
        NSError *err = nil; id<MTLLibrary> lib = totk_msl_library(src, &err);
        fn = lib ? [lib newFunctionWithName:fs->fn.name] : nil;
        if (!fn) MDIE("fragment shader %s with emulated sampler border colour: %s", fs->key, err.localizedDescription.UTF8String);
        if (!fs->bpatch) fs->bpatch = [NSMutableDictionary dictionary];
        fs->bpatch[key] = fn;
    }
    os_unfair_lock_unlock(&lock);
    return fn;
}
static id<MTLFunction> vs_fn_for(NvShader *vs, NvShader *fs, int layered, int border) {
    static os_unfair_lock lk = OS_UNFAIR_LOCK_INIT;
    if (layered && !vs_layerable(vs)) MDIE("vertex shader %s cannot write the render target array index", vs->key);
    float bc[8][4]; int ba[8], bn = 0;   // TOTK: vertex-stage samplers with a border colour Metal lacks (PSO_VBORDER)
    NSString *bkey = border && sh_has_src(vs) ? border_key(vs, 0, bc, ba, &bn) : nil;
    if (!sh_has_src(vs) || (!layered && !bkey && (!fs || !sh_has_src(fs)))) return vs->fn;
    os_unfair_lock_lock(&lk);
    NSDictionary *in = fs && sh_has_src(fs) ? msl_varyings(fs) : nil, *out = in ? msl_varyings(vs) : nil;
    NSMutableArray *miss = [NSMutableArray array];
    for (NSNumber *l in [in.allKeys sortedArrayUsingSelector:@selector(compare:)]) if (!out[l]) [miss addObject:l];
    if (!miss.count && !layered && !bkey) { os_unfair_lock_unlock(&lk); return vs->fn; }
    NSString *key = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%@%@%@", layered ? @"layer;" : @"", bkey ? [NSString stringWithFormat:@"border:%@", bkey] : @"", [miss componentsJoinedByString:@","]];
    id<MTLFunction> f = vs->vpatch[key];
    if (!f) {
        NSMutableString *add = [NSMutableString string];
        for (NSNumber *l in miss) [add appendFormat:@"    %@ totk_unwritten_locn%@ [[user(locn%@)]];\n", in[l], l, l];
        if (layered) [add appendString:@"    uint totk_layer [[render_target_array_index]];\n"];
        NSString *head = @"struct main0_out\n{\n";
        NSString *vsrc0 = sh_src(vs);
        if (bkey) { NSString *b = border_src(vs, vsrc0, bc, ba, bn); if (b) vsrc0 = b; }
        NSRange r = [vsrc0 rangeOfString:head];
        if (r.location == NSNotFound) MDIE("vertex shader %s: no main0_out to extend", vs->key);
        NSString *src = [vsrc0 stringByReplacingCharactersInRange:r withString:[head stringByAppendingString:add]];
        if (layered) {
            NSRegularExpression *psz = [NSRegularExpression regularExpressionWithPattern:@"\\n\\s*float\\s+(\\w+)\\s*\\[\\[point_size\\]\\];" options:0 error:nil];
            NSTextCheckingResult *m = [psz firstMatchInString:src options:0 range:NSMakeRange(0, src.length)];
            if (m) {
                NSString *field = [src substringWithRange:[m rangeAtIndex:1]], *local = [@"totk_unused_" stringByAppendingString:field];
                src = [src stringByReplacingCharactersInRange:m.range withString:@""];
                src = [src stringByReplacingOccurrencesOfString:[@"out." stringByAppendingString:field] withString:local];
                src = [src stringByReplacingOccurrencesOfString:@"main0_out out = {};" withString:[NSString stringWithFormat:@"main0_out out = {}; float %@ = 0.0;", local]];
            }
            NSString *entry = @"vertex main0_out main0(";
            src = [src stringByReplacingCharactersInRange:[src rangeOfString:entry] withString:[entry stringByAppendingFormat:@"constant uint& totk_layer_in [[buffer(%d)]], ", LAY_BUF_INDEX]];
            src = [src stringByReplacingOccurrencesOfString:@"return out;" withString:@"{ out.totk_layer = totk_layer_in; return out; }"];
        }
        NSError *e = nil; id<MTLLibrary> lib = totk_msl_library(src, &e);
        f = lib ? [lib newFunctionWithName:vs->fn.name] : nil;
        if (!f) MDIE("vertex shader %s (variant %s): %s", vs->key, key.UTF8String, e.localizedDescription.UTF8String);
        if (!vs->vpatch) vs->vpatch = [NSMutableDictionary dictionary];
        vs->vpatch[key] = f;
        static int once, lonce;
        if (miss.count && once++ < 64) MLOG("[totk] fragment shader %s reads varyings the vertex shader %s leaves unwritten (locn %s): added as zero outputs", fs ? fs->key : "-", vs->key, [miss componentsJoinedByString:@","].UTF8String);
        if (layered && !lonce++) MLOG("[totk] layered pass: vertex shader %s writes the render target array index", vs->key);
    }
    os_unfair_lock_unlock(&lk);
    return f;
}
// MSL of a depth-exporting fragment function with the depth output kept as a local (see fs_fn_without_depth).
static NSString *fs_src_without_depth(NvShader *fs) {
    NSRegularExpression *decl = [NSRegularExpression regularExpressionWithPattern:@"float\\s+(\\w+)\\s*\\[\\[depth\\([^)]*\\)\\]\\]\\s*;" options:0 error:nil];
    NSTextCheckingResult *match = [decl firstMatchInString:sh_src(fs) options:0 range:NSMakeRange(0, sh_src(fs).length)];
    if (!match) MDIE("fragment shader %s: missing depth output declaration", fs->key);
    NSString *field = [sh_src(fs) substringWithRange:[match rangeAtIndex:1]];
    NSString *local = [@"totk_ignored_" stringByAppendingString:field];
    NSString *src = [sh_src(fs) stringByReplacingCharactersInRange:match.range withString:@""];
    src = [src stringByReplacingOccurrencesOfString:[@"out." stringByAppendingString:field] withString:local];
    NSString *init = @"main0_out out = {};";
    if ([src rangeOfString:init].location == NSNotFound) MDIE("fragment shader %s: missing output initialization", fs->key);
    return [src stringByReplacingOccurrencesOfString:init withString:[NSString stringWithFormat:@"%@ float %@ = 0.0;", init, local]];
}
/* A framebuffer without a depth attachment discards fragment depth on NVN. Metal instead rejects a pipeline whose
   fragment entry exports depth without a matching attachment. Keep its calculation local in that case; color
   outputs and side effects are unchanged. The pipeline key already includes the depth attachment format. */
static id<MTLFunction> fs_fn_without_depth(NvShader *fs) {
    if (!fs || !fs->writes_depth) return fs ? fs->fn : nil;
    static os_unfair_lock lock = OS_UNFAIR_LOCK_INIT; os_unfair_lock_lock(&lock);
    if (!fs->no_depth_fn) {
        NSString *src = fs_src_without_depth(fs);
        NSError *err = nil; id<MTLLibrary> lib = totk_msl_library(src, &err);
        fs->no_depth_fn = lib ? [lib newFunctionWithName:fs->fn.name] : nil;
        if (!fs->no_depth_fn) MDIE("fragment shader %s without depth export: %s", fs->key, err.localizedDescription.UTF8String);
        MLOG("[totk] fragment depth export omitted for a color-only pass: %s", fs->key);
    }
    id<MTLFunction> fn = fs->no_depth_fn; os_unfair_lock_unlock(&lock); return fn;
}
/* TOTK_MFX: the fragment function with its colour 0 output copied to attachment 7, the UI layer (role 3 makes the copy
   opaque). Returns nil when the source cannot take the copy (no float colour 0, attachment 7 already written); the
   caller then masks the attachment. */
static id<MTLFunction> fs_fn_mfx(NvShader *fs, int role, int nodepth) {
    if (!fs || !sh_has_src(fs) || role < MFX_ROLE_UI || role > MFX_ROLE_UI_OPAQUE) return nil;
    int idx = role * 2 + (nodepth && fs->writes_depth);
    static os_unfair_lock lock = OS_UNFAIR_LOCK_INIT; os_unfair_lock_lock(&lock);
    if (!fs->mfx_tried[idx]) {
        fs->mfx_tried[idx] = 1;
        NSString *src = nodepth && fs->writes_depth ? fs_src_without_depth(fs) : sh_src(fs);
        NSRegularExpression *c0 = [NSRegularExpression regularExpressionWithPattern:@"\\n\\s*(\\w+)\\s+(\\w+)\\s*\\[\\[color\\(0\\)\\]\\]\\s*;" options:0 error:nil];
        NSTextCheckingResult *m = [c0 firstMatchInString:src options:0 range:NSMakeRange(0, src.length)];
        NSString *head = @"struct main0_out\n{\n";
        NSString *type = m ? [src substringWithRange:[m rangeAtIndex:1]] : nil, *name = m ? [src substringWithRange:[m rangeAtIndex:2]] : nil, *e = nil;
        if ([type isEqualToString:@"float4"] || [type isEqualToString:@"half4"]) e = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"float4(out.%@)", name];
        else if ([type isEqualToString:@"float3"] || [type isEqualToString:@"half3"]) e = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"float4(float3(out.%@), 1.0)", name];
        else if ([type isEqualToString:@"float2"] || [type isEqualToString:@"half2"]) e = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"float4(float2(out.%@), 0.0, 1.0)", name];
        else if ([type isEqualToString:@"float"] || [type isEqualToString:@"half"]) e = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"float4(float(out.%@), 0.0, 0.0, 1.0)", name];
        if (e && role == MFX_ROLE_UI_OPAQUE) e = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"float4((%@).rgb, 1.0)", e];
        if (e && [src rangeOfString:head].location != NSNotFound && [src rangeOfString:@"[[color(7)]]"].location == NSNotFound) {
            src = [src stringByReplacingCharactersInRange:[src rangeOfString:head] withString:[head stringByAppendingString:@"    float4 totk_mfx_copy [[color(7)]];\n"]];
            src = [src stringByReplacingOccurrencesOfString:@"return out;" withString:[NSString stringWithFormat:@"{ out.totk_mfx_copy = %@; return out; }", e]];
            NSError *err = nil; id<MTLLibrary> lib = totk_msl_library(src, &err);
            fs->mfx_fn[idx] = lib ? [lib newFunctionWithName:fs->fn.name] : nil;
            if (!fs->mfx_fn[idx]) MDIE("fragment shader %s, MetalFX copy (role %d): %s", fs->key, role, err.localizedDescription.UTF8String);
        } else MLOG("【红】[mfx] fragment shader %s: colour 0 (%s) cannot be copied to the UI layer; this draw is left out of it", fs->key, type ? type.UTF8String : "none");
    }
    id<MTLFunction> fn = fs->mfx_fn[idx]; os_unfair_lock_unlock(&lock); return fn;
}
/* Diagnostic TOTK_NAN_TRACE=<fragment key prefix> (log TOTK_NAN_TRACE_LOG, default analysis/nan-trace.tsv): those fragment
   shaders are rebuilt so that every float temporary is checked right after it is computed, and the number of the first
   temporary that is Inf or NaN is remembered. When a colour output ends up non-finite, the pixel counts that number in a
   per-frame histogram (buffer 29, 64 frame slots), so one run names the operation where the bad values start. */
#define NT_SLOTS 64
#define NT_SLOT_WORDS 4096   /* [0] bad pixels, [1..3] first pixel x, y, temporary; [16..] histogram by temporary number */
static const char *nan_trace_prefix(void) { static const char *p; static int init; if (!init) { init = 1; p = getenv("TOTK_NAN_TRACE"); if (p && !*p) p = NULL; } return p; }
static int nan_trace_match(const NvShader *fs) { const char *p = nan_trace_prefix(); return p && fs && fs->stage == 1 && sh_has_src(fs) && !strncmp(fs->key, p, strlen(p)); }
static id<MTLFunction> nan_trace_fn(NvShader *fs) {
    static NSMutableDictionary<NSValue *, id<MTLFunction>> *done; static os_unfair_lock lock = OS_UNFAIR_LOCK_INIT;
    NSValue *k = [NSValue valueWithPointer:(__bridge const void *)fs];
    os_unfair_lock_lock(&lock); if (!done) done = [NSMutableDictionary dictionary]; id<MTLFunction> have = done[k]; os_unfair_lock_unlock(&lock);
    if (have) return have;
    NSMutableArray<NSString *> *outs = [NSMutableArray array];
    NSRegularExpression *colre = [NSRegularExpression regularExpressionWithPattern:@"\\b(float[234]?|half[234]?) (\\w+) \\[\\[color\\(\\d+\\)\\]\\]" options:0 error:nil];
    for (NSTextCheckingResult *m in [colre matchesInString:sh_src(fs) options:0 range:NSMakeRange(0, sh_src(fs).length)]) [outs addObject:[sh_src(fs) substringWithRange:[m rangeAtIndex:2]]];
    NSRegularExpression *decl = [NSRegularExpression regularExpressionWithPattern:@"^(\\s+)(float|float2|float3|float4) _(\\d+) = .*;\\s*$" options:0 error:nil];
    NSRegularExpression *asgn = [NSRegularExpression regularExpressionWithPattern:@"^(\\s+)_(\\d+) = .*;\\s*$" options:0 error:nil];
    NSMutableDictionary<NSString *, NSString *> *types = [NSMutableDictionary dictionary];
    NSMutableArray<NSString *> *lines = [[sh_src(fs) componentsSeparatedByString:@"\n"] mutableCopy];
    NSMutableString *o = [NSMutableString string]; int in_entry = 0, depth = 0, instrumented = 0;
    for (NSString *line in lines) {
        NSString *l = line;
        if (!in_entry && [l containsString:@"fragment main0_out main0("]) {
            l = [l stringByReplacingOccurrencesOfString:@"[[buffer(0)]])" withString:@"[[buffer(0)]], device atomic_uint *totk_nt [[buffer(29)]], float4 totk_pos [[position]])"];
            if ([l isEqualToString:line]) MDIE("TOTK_NAN_TRACE: entry signature of %s not recognised", fs->key);
            in_entry = 1; [o appendFormat:@"%@\n", l]; continue;
        }
        if (in_entry == 1 && [[l stringByTrimmingCharactersInSet:NSCharacterSet.whitespaceCharacterSet] isEqualToString:@"{"]) {
            in_entry = 2; depth = 1; [o appendFormat:@"%@\n    uint totk_first = 0u;\n", l]; continue;
        }
        if (in_entry == 2) {
            NSString *t = [l stringByTrimmingCharactersInSet:NSCharacterSet.whitespaceCharacterSet];
            if ([t isEqualToString:@"return out;"] && depth == 1) {
                NSMutableString *bad = [NSMutableString string];
                for (NSString *v in outs) [bad appendFormat:@"%@!all(isfinite(float4(out.%@)))", bad.length ? @" || " : @"", v];
                if (!bad.length) [bad appendString:@"false"];
                [o appendFormat:@"    if (%@) {\n        uint totk_n = atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&totk_nt[0], 1u, memory_order_relaxed);\n"
                                "        if (totk_n == 0u) { atomic_store_explicit(&totk_nt[1], uint(totk_pos.x), memory_order_relaxed); atomic_store_explicit(&totk_nt[2], uint(totk_pos.y), memory_order_relaxed); atomic_store_explicit(&totk_nt[3], totk_first, memory_order_relaxed); }\n"
                                "        atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&totk_nt[16u + min(totk_first, %du)], 1u, memory_order_relaxed);\n    }\n", bad, NT_SLOT_WORDS - 17];
                [o appendFormat:@"%@\n", l]; in_entry = 3; continue;
            }
            for (NSUInteger c = 0; c < t.length; c++) { unichar ch = [t characterAtIndex:c]; if (ch == '{') depth++; else if (ch == '}') depth--; }
            NSTextCheckingResult *m = [decl firstMatchInString:l options:0 range:NSMakeRange(0, l.length)];
            NSString *var = nil, *type = nil, *ind = nil;
            if (m) { ind = [l substringWithRange:[m rangeAtIndex:1]]; type = [l substringWithRange:[m rangeAtIndex:2]]; var = [l substringWithRange:[m rangeAtIndex:3]]; types[var] = type; }
            else if ((m = [asgn firstMatchInString:l options:0 range:NSMakeRange(0, l.length)])) { ind = [l substringWithRange:[m rangeAtIndex:1]]; var = [l substringWithRange:[m rangeAtIndex:2]]; type = types[var]; }
            [o appendFormat:@"%@\n", l];
            if (var && type) {
                NSString *test = [type isEqualToString:@"float"] ? [NSString stringWithFormat:@"!isfinite(_%@)", var] : [NSString stringWithFormat:@"!all(isfinite(_%@))", var];
                [o appendFormat:@"%@if (totk_first == 0u && %@) totk_first = %@u;\n", ind, test, var]; instrumented++;
            }
            continue;
        }
        [o appendFormat:@"%@\n", l];
    }
    if (in_entry != 3) MDIE("TOTK_NAN_TRACE: could not instrument %s (state %d)", fs->key, in_entry);
    NSError *err = nil; id<MTLLibrary> lib = totk_msl_library(o, &err);
    id<MTLFunction> fn = lib ? [lib newFunctionWithName:fs->fn.name] : nil;
    if (!fn) MDIE("TOTK_NAN_TRACE: %s does not compile: %s", fs->key, err.localizedDescription.UTF8String);
    MLOG("TOTK_NAN_TRACE: %s rebuilt with %d checked temporaries, outputs %s", fs->key, instrumented, [outs componentsJoinedByString:@","].UTF8String);
    os_unfair_lock_lock(&lock); done[k] = fn; os_unfair_lock_unlock(&lock);
    return fn;
}
/* Per draw of a traced shader: the frame's slot in buffer 29. The histogram of frame f is read when frame f + 1 first
   uses the trace (its command buffer completes after f's), and is logged when the frame had bad pixels. */
static void nan_trace_bind(id<MTL4RenderCommandEncoder> en) {
    static id<MTLBuffer> buf; static long cur = -1; static FILE *f;
    long fr = (long)atomic_load(&g_cur_frame);
    if (!buf) {
        buf = [g_dev newBufferWithLength:NT_SLOTS * NT_SLOT_WORDS * 4 options:MTLResourceStorageModeShared]; res_add(buf); memset(buf.contents, 0, buf.length);
        const char *path = getenv("TOTK_NAN_TRACE_LOG"); if (!(f = fopen(path ? path : "analysis/nan-trace.tsv", "w"))) MDIE("TOTK_NAN_TRACE_LOG: cannot open");
        fprintf(f, "frame\tbad_pixels\tx\ty\tfirst_temp\thistogram (temporary:pixels, most first)\n"); fflush(f);
    }
    if (fr != cur) {
        long prev = cur; cur = fr;
        uint32_t *slot = (uint32_t *)buf.contents + (size_t)(fr % NT_SLOTS) * NT_SLOT_WORDS;
        memset(slot, 0, NT_SLOT_WORDS * 4);   /* last used NT_SLOTS frames ago, long finished */
        if (prev >= 0) {
            const uint32_t *ps = (const uint32_t *)buf.contents + (size_t)(prev % NT_SLOTS) * NT_SLOT_WORDS; FILE *lf = f;
            [g_commit_blocks addObject:^{
                if (!ps[0]) return;
                uint32_t idx[NT_SLOT_WORDS - 16]; int n = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < NT_SLOT_WORDS - 16; i++) if (ps[16 + i]) idx[n++] = (uint32_t)i;
                for (int a = 0; a < n; a++) for (int b = a + 1; b < n; b++) if (ps[16 + idx[b]] > ps[16 + idx[a]]) { uint32_t t = idx[a]; idx[a] = idx[b]; idx[b] = t; }
                char h[512]; size_t o = 0; h[0] = 0;
                for (int a = 0; a < n && a < 12 && o < sizeof h - 32; a++) o += (size_t)snprintf(h + o, sizeof h - o, "%s_%u:%u", a ? " " : "", idx[a], ps[16 + idx[a]]);
                fprintf(lf, "%ld\t%u\t%u\t%u\t_%u\t%s\n", prev, ps[0], ps[1], ps[2], ps[3], h); fflush(lf); }];
        }
    }
    enc_r_args(en, MTLRenderStageFragment, buf.gpuAddress + (uint64_t)(fr % NT_SLOTS) * NT_SLOT_WORDS * 4, 29);
}
#include "totk_pipeline_archive.h"
/* Odyssey (22 October 2026), from upstream MacNativeGames 27baca0 / 6446e09 / ea6c5a7 / 1eff989: the game's pipelines are
   made with the pipeline archive (totk_pipeline_archive.h). A pipeline is first asked of its own archive file alone
   (MTLPipelineOptionFailOnBinaryArchiveMiss). Found: done. Not found: it is compiled as usual and written to its file
   when the game is idle. key: pso_archive_key / cs_archive_key; nil = not archived. TOTK_PIPELINE_ARCHIVE=0 turns it off. */
static _Atomic uint64_t g_par_hits, g_par_misses;
static void par_count(int hit) {
    uint64_t h = hit ? atomic_fetch_add(&g_par_hits, 1) + 1 : atomic_load(&g_par_hits), m = hit ? atomic_load(&g_par_misses) : atomic_fetch_add(&g_par_misses, 1) + 1;
    if ((h + m) % 1000 == 0) MLOG("管线存档：建管线 %llu 次，从存档取 %llu 次，现编 %llu 次", (unsigned long long)(h + m), (unsigned long long)h, (unsigned long long)m);
}
static NSString *pso_archive_key(const pso_key *k, NvShader *vs, NvShader *fs, int merged) {
    pso_skey sk; pso_skey_from(k, vs, fs, merged, NULL, &sk); return par_hash(&sk, sizeof sk);
}
static NSString *cs_archive_key(NvShader *cs) { return cs ? [@"c" stringByAppendingString:par_hash(cs->key, strnlen(cs->key, sizeof cs->key))] : nil; }
static id<MTLRenderPipelineState> pso_new_(MTLRenderPipelineDescriptor *d, NSString *key, NSError **e);
static id<MTLRenderPipelineState> pso_new(MTLRenderPipelineDescriptor *d, NSString *key, NSError **e) {
    DM_SP_BEGIN(sp, "pipeline-render", "%{public}s", key ? key.UTF8String : "-");
    id<MTLRenderPipelineState> ps = pso_new_(d, key, e);
    DM_SP_END(sp, "pipeline-render");
    return ps;
}
static id<MTLRenderPipelineState> pso_new_(MTLRenderPipelineDescriptor *d, NSString *key, NSError **e) {
    id<MTLRenderPipelineState> ps = nil;
    id<MTLBinaryArchive> a = par_archive_for(g_dev, key);
    if (a) {
        d.binaryArchives = @[a];
        ps = [g_dev newRenderPipelineStateWithDescriptor:d options:MTLPipelineOptionFailOnBinaryArchiveMiss reflection:nil error:nil];
        d.binaryArchives = nil;
        if (ps) { par_count(1); return ps; }
    }
    if (key && g_par_on) par_count(0);
    ps = [g_dev newRenderPipelineStateWithDescriptor:d error:e];
    atomic_store(&g_par_last_compile_ns, clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW));
    if (ps) par_add(g_dev, key, d);
    return ps;
}
static id<MTLComputePipelineState> cs_new_(NvShader *cs, NSError **e);
static id<MTLComputePipelineState> cs_new(NvShader *cs, NSError **e) {
    DM_SP_BEGIN(sp, "pipeline-compute", "%{public}s", cs ? cs->key : "-");
    id<MTLComputePipelineState> ps = cs_new_(cs, e);
    DM_SP_END(sp, "pipeline-compute");
    return ps;
}
static id<MTLComputePipelineState> cs_new_(NvShader *cs, NSError **e) {
    if (!cs || !cs->fn) return nil;
    NSString *key = cs_archive_key(cs);
    MTLComputePipelineDescriptor *d = [MTLComputePipelineDescriptor new]; d.computeFunction = cs->fn;
    id<MTLComputePipelineState> ps = nil;
    id<MTLBinaryArchive> a = par_archive_for(g_dev, key);
    if (a) {
        d.binaryArchives = @[a];
        ps = [g_dev newComputePipelineStateWithDescriptor:d options:MTLPipelineOptionFailOnBinaryArchiveMiss reflection:nil error:nil];
        d.binaryArchives = nil;
        if (ps) { par_count(1); return ps; }
    }
    if (g_par_on) par_count(0);
    ps = [g_dev newComputePipelineStateWithDescriptor:d options:MTLPipelineOptionNone reflection:nil error:e];
    atomic_store(&g_par_last_compile_ns, clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW));
    if (ps) par_add(g_dev, key, d);
    return ps;
}
static MTLRenderPipelineDescriptor *pso_desc(const pso_key *k, NvShader *vs, NvShader *fs, id<MTLFunction> fsfn, int merged) {
    MTLRenderPipelineDescriptor *d = [MTLRenderPipelineDescriptor new];
    d.vertexFunction = vs_fn_for(vs, fs, (k->a2c & PSO_LAYERED) != 0, (k->a2c & PSO_VBORDER) != 0); d.fragmentFunction = fsfn ? fsfn : fs ? (k->dfmt ? fs->fn : fs_fn_without_depth(fs)) : nil;
    if (!fsfn && nan_trace_match(fs) && !fs->writes_depth) d.fragmentFunction = nan_trace_fn(fs);   // diagnostic TOTK_NAN_TRACE
    // 诊断 DM_NVN_HILITE=片元着色器键,…：这些绘制改用纯色片元（第 1–6 个键依次 品红 / 绿 / 青 / 黄 / 蓝 / 白），看几何落在哪里
    // Diagnostic DM_NVN_HILITE=fragment shader key,...: these draws use a solid-color fragment instead (keys 1–6 in order magenta / green / cyan / yellow / blue / white), to see where the geometry lands
    if (fs) { static char keys[6][24]; static int nk = -1; static id<MTLLibrary> hl;
        if (nk < 0) { nk = 0; const char *e = getenv("DM_NVN_HILITE");
            for (const char *q = e; q && *q && nk < 6; q = strchr(q, ',') ? strchr(q, ',') + 1 : q + strlen(q)) { size_t n = strcspn(q, ","); if (n > 23) n = 23; memcpy(keys[nk], q, n); keys[nk++][n] = 0; } }
        for (int i = 0; i < nk; i++) if (!strncmp(fs->key, keys[i], strlen(keys[i]))) {
            if (!hl) { NSError *e = nil; hl = [g_dev newLibraryWithSource:@"#include <metal_stdlib>\nusing namespace metal;\nstruct O { float4 c0 [[color(0)]]; float4 c1 [[color(1)]]; float4 c2 [[color(2)]]; };\n"
                "fragment O hl0() { return {float4(1,0,1,1),float4(1,0,1,1),float4(1,0,1,1)}; } fragment O hl1() { return {float4(0,1,0,1),float4(0,1,0,1),float4(0,1,0,1)}; }\n"
                "fragment O hl2() { return {float4(0,1,1,1),float4(0,1,1,1),float4(0,1,1,1)}; } fragment O hl3() { return {float4(1,1,0,1),float4(1,1,0,1),float4(1,1,0,1)}; }\n"
                "fragment O hl4() { return {float4(0,0,1,1),float4(0,0,1,1),float4(0,0,1,1)}; } fragment O hl5() { return {float4(1,1,1,1),float4(1,1,1,1),float4(1,1,1,1)}; }\n" options:nil error:&e];
                if (!hl) MLOG("【红】HILITE 着色器编译失败 %s", e.localizedDescription.UTF8String); }
            if (hl) d.fragmentFunction = [hl newFunctionWithName:[NSString stringWithFormat:@"hl%d", i]];
            break; } }
    /* TOTK diagnostic TOTK_GPU_HILITE1=<fragment shader key prefix>,...: draws of these fragment shaders write a solid
       colour to colour attachment 0 only (green / cyan / yellow / blue), to tell whether their geometry rasterises at all. */
    int hilited = 0;
    if (fs) { static char keys[4][24]; static int nk = -1; static id<MTLLibrary> hl;
        if (nk < 0) { nk = 0; const char *e = getenv("TOTK_GPU_HILITE1");
            for (const char *q = e; q && *q && nk < 4; q = strchr(q, ',') ? strchr(q, ',') + 1 : q + strlen(q)) { size_t n = strcspn(q, ","); if (n > 23) n = 23; memcpy(keys[nk], q, n); keys[nk++][n] = 0; } }
        for (int i = 0; i < nk; i++) if (keys[i][0] && !strncmp(fs->key, keys[i], strlen(keys[i]))) {
            if (!hl) { NSError *e = nil; hl = [g_dev newLibraryWithSource:@"#include <metal_stdlib>\nusing namespace metal;\n"
                "fragment float4 h0() { return float4(0,1,0,1); } fragment float4 h1() { return float4(0,1,1,1); }\n"
                "fragment float4 h2() { return float4(1,1,0,1); } fragment float4 h3() { return float4(0,0,1,1); }\n" options:nil error:&e];
                if (!hl) MDIE("TOTK_GPU_HILITE1 shader library failed: %s", e.localizedDescription.UTF8String); }
            d.fragmentFunction = [hl newFunctionWithName:[NSString stringWithFormat:@"h%d", i]]; hilited = 1;
            /* TOTK_GPU_HILITE_VS=1: also replace the vertex shader with a 25x15 screen-tile grid driven only by vertex_id / instance_id
               (same quad order 0,2,1,1,2,3 as the game's tile-light draw), to tell draw-path problems from shader-input problems */
            if (getenv("TOTK_GPU_HILITE_VS")) { static id<MTLLibrary> vl; if (!vl) { NSError *e2 = nil; vl = [g_dev newLibraryWithSource:@"#include <metal_stdlib>\nusing namespace metal;\n"
                "struct V { float4 p [[position]]; };\nvertex V vtile(uint vid [[vertex_id]], uint iid [[instance_id]]) { float2 c = float2(vid & 1, vid >> 1); uint tx = iid % 25, ty = iid / 25;"
                " float2 q = (float2(tx, ty) + c) * float2(2.0 / 25.0, 2.0 / 15.0); V o; o.p = float4(q.x - 1.0, 1.0 - q.y, 0.5, 1.0); return o; }\n" options:nil error:&e2]; if (!vl) MDIE("HILITE_VS library: %s", e2.localizedDescription.UTF8String); }
                d.vertexFunction = [vl newFunctionWithName:@"vtile"]; d.vertexDescriptor = nil; static int said2; if (!said2++) MLOG("TOTK_GPU_HILITE_VS: vertex shader of %s replaced by the grid VS", keys[i]); }
            static int said[4]; if (!said[i]++) MLOG("TOTK_GPU_HILITE1: fragment shader %s drawn as solid colour %d", keys[i], i);
            break; } }
    d.rasterSampleCount = k->samples ? k->samples : 1;
    d.alphaToCoverageEnabled = (k->a2c & 1) != 0;
    if (k->a2c & PSO_LAYERED) d.inputPrimitiveTopology = MTLPrimitiveTopologyClassTriangle;   // TOTK: required with a layer output; layered passes take triangle draws only (lay_draw_ok)
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        if (!k->cfmt[i]) continue;
        MTLRenderPipelineColorAttachmentDescriptor *c = d.colorAttachments[i];
        c.pixelFormat = (MTLPixelFormat)k->cfmt[i];
        int l = merged ? k->lmap[i] : i;
        uint32_t m = l == 0xff ? 0 : (k->chmask >> (4 * l)) & 0xf;
        c.writeMask = (m & 1 ? MTLColorWriteMaskRed : 0) | (m & 2 ? MTLColorWriteMaskGreen : 0) | (m & 4 ? MTLColorWriteMaskBlue : 0) | (m & 8 ? MTLColorWriteMaskAlpha : 0);
        if (l != 0xff && k->blend_en >> l & 1 && !(hilited && getenv("TOTK_GPU_HILITE_NOBLEND"))) {   /* TOTK diagnostic: highlighted draws can be drawn without blending */
            c.blendingEnabled = YES;
            c.sourceRGBBlendFactor = bfac(k->blend[l].src_rgb); c.destinationRGBBlendFactor = bfac(k->blend[l].dst_rgb);
            c.sourceAlphaBlendFactor = bfac(k->blend[l].src_a); c.destinationAlphaBlendFactor = bfac(k->blend[l].dst_a);
            c.rgbBlendOperation = bop(k->blend[l].eq_rgb); c.alphaBlendOperation = bop(k->blend[l].eq_a);
        }
    }
    int mr = (int)(k->a2c >> 2) & 3;   // TOTK_MFX role (see g_mfx): attachment 7 takes the UI layer
    if (mr) {
        id<MTLFunction> mf = fs_fn_mfx(fs, mr, k->dfmt == 0);
        d.colorAttachments[7].blendingEnabled = NO; d.colorAttachments[7].writeMask = MTLColorWriteMaskNone;
        if (mf) {
            d.fragmentFunction = mf;
            {   // premultiplied UI layer: the game's colour blend; alpha accumulates coverage of "over" draws, additive ones leave it
                MTLRenderPipelineColorAttachmentDescriptor *c = d.colorAttachments[7]; uint32_t m0 = k->chmask & 0xf;
                c.writeMask = (m0 & 1 ? MTLColorWriteMaskRed : 0) | (m0 & 2 ? MTLColorWriteMaskGreen : 0) | (m0 & 4 ? MTLColorWriteMaskBlue : 0) | MTLColorWriteMaskAlpha;
                if (mr == MFX_ROLE_UI && (k->blend_en & 1)) {
                    const blend_st *b = &k->blend[0]; int over = b->dst_rgb == NVN_BLEND_FUNC_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA;
                    c.blendingEnabled = YES;
                    c.sourceRGBBlendFactor = bfac(b->src_rgb); c.destinationRGBBlendFactor = bfac(b->dst_rgb); c.rgbBlendOperation = bop(b->eq_rgb);
                    c.sourceAlphaBlendFactor = over ? MTLBlendFactorOne : MTLBlendFactorZero; c.destinationAlphaBlendFactor = over ? MTLBlendFactorOneMinusSourceAlpha : MTLBlendFactorOne;
                    c.alphaBlendOperation = MTLBlendOperationAdd;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    d.depthAttachmentPixelFormat = (MTLPixelFormat)k->dfmt; d.stencilAttachmentPixelFormat = (MTLPixelFormat)k->sfmt;
    MTLVertexDescriptor *vd = [MTLVertexDescriptor vertexDescriptor];
    const nvn_refl *rf = &vs->rf;
    for (int v = 0; v < rf->nv; v++) {
        int loc = rf->v[v].loc, a = rf->v[v].nvn;   // Metal 槽 loc ← NVN 属性 a | Metal slot loc ← NVN attribute a
        MTLVertexFormat vf = a < 16 ? vfmt(k->attr[a].fmt) : MTLVertexFormatInvalid;
        // a >= S.nattr 时 k.attr[a] 保持 memset 的 0，vfmt(0) 为 Invalid，走同一回退分支且 fmt 非 0 的 RED_ONCE 条件不成立。
        // When a >= S.nattr, k.attr[a] keeps the 0 from memset, vfmt(0) is Invalid, the same fallback branch is taken and the RED_ONCE condition of fmt being non-0 does not hold.
        if (a < 16 && k->attr[a].fmt && vf == MTLVertexFormatInvalid) RED_ONCE(15, "顶点属性格式 %#x 未映射", k->attr[a].fmt);
        if (vf == MTLVertexFormatInvalid) {
            int ct = rf->v[v].ct;
            vd.attributes[loc].format = ct == NVN_CT_UINT ? MTLVertexFormatUInt4 : ct == NVN_CT_INT ? MTLVertexFormatInt4 : MTLVertexFormatFloat4;
            vd.attributes[loc].offset = 0; vd.attributes[loc].bufferIndex = 30;
            vd.layouts[30].stride = 16; vd.layouts[30].stepFunction = MTLVertexStepFunctionConstant; vd.layouts[30].stepRate = 0;
            continue;
        }
        int st = k->attr[a].stream;
        vd.attributes[loc].format = vf; vd.attributes[loc].offset = k->attr[a].offset; vd.attributes[loc].bufferIndex = 16 + st;
        vd.layouts[16 + st].stride = k->stream[st].stride ? k->stream[st].stride : 4;
        vd.layouts[16 + st].stepFunction = k->stream[st].stride == 0 ? MTLVertexStepFunctionConstant : k->stream[st].divisor ? MTLVertexStepFunctionPerInstance : MTLVertexStepFunctionPerVertex;
        vd.layouts[16 + st].stepRate = k->stream[st].stride == 0 ? 0 : k->stream[st].divisor ? k->stream[st].divisor : 1;
    }
    d.vertexDescriptor = vd;
    return d;
}
// 管线键：当前状态 S + 通道格式（普通通道；合并通道另带 lmap / 特化函数，由 pso_get 填）
// Pipeline key: current state S + pass formats (normal pass; a merged pass additionally carries lmap / specialized function, filled in by pso_get)
static void pso_key_fill(pso_key *k, NvShader *vs, NvShader *fs, const uint32_t cfmt[8], uint32_t dfmt, uint32_t sfmt, uint32_t samples, int lmap) {
    memset(k, 0, sizeof *k);
    k->vs = (__bridge void *)vs; k->fs = (__bridge void *)fs;
    memcpy(k->cfmt, cfmt, sizeof k->cfmt); k->dfmt = dfmt; k->sfmt = sfmt; k->samples = samples;
    k->blend_en = S.color.blend_en; k->chmask = S.chmask.mask; k->a2c = S.ms.a2c;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) if (k->cfmt[i] || lmap) k->blend[i] = S.blend[i];
    const nvn_refl *rf = &vs->rf;
    for (int v = 0; v < rf->nv; v++) { int a = rf->v[v].nvn; if (a < 16 && a < S.nattr) { k->attr[a] = S.attr[a]; int st = S.attr[a].stream; if (st < 16) k->stream[st] = S.stream[st]; } }
}
// ---- 并行预编：首次遇到的管线原先在提交线程一条条同步编，一帧里连着缺 9 条 = 284 ms（真机重场面）。
// 现在：一次提交里第一次缺管线时，顺着余下的命令往前扫一遍（只重放状态，不画），把后面还会缺的普通通道管线一并丢给后台并行编；
// 提交线程走到那次绘制时只等「还没编完的剩余时间」。编出来的管线与同步编的完全相同（同一份描述符）。合并通道 / 特化片元的管线键依赖回放时的规划结果，不预测，照旧同步编。
// ---- Parallel precompile: pipelines met for the first time used to be compiled synchronously one by one on the submit thread; 9 misses in a row in one frame = 284 ms (heavy scene on a real device).
// Now: on the first pipeline miss in a submission, scan ahead once along the remaining commands (replaying state only, no drawing) and kick all the normal-pass pipelines that will also miss later to the background to compile in parallel;
// when the submit thread reaches that draw it only waits for 'the remaining time not yet compiled'. The compiled pipelines are identical to synchronously compiled ones (same descriptor). Pipeline keys of merged passes / specialized fragments depend on the planning result at replay time, are not predicted, and are compiled synchronously as before.
#define PSO_PEND_MAX 768
static struct { pso_key k; id<MTLRenderPipelineState> ps; uint64_t submit; int used, done; } g_pp[PSO_PEND_MAX];
static pthread_mutex_t g_pp_mu = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER; static pthread_cond_t g_pp_cv = PTHREAD_COND_INITIALIZER;
static uint64_t g_pp_submit_mark, g_pp_kicked, g_pp_taken;   // 本次提交是否已预测过（按提交序号）；累计丢出 / 领用条数 | Whether this submission has already been predicted (by submission serial); cumulative kicked / taken counts
/* TOTK: a scan that stopped at a budget leaves the rest of the submission unscanned; the next miss of the submission scans
   again from there (keys already compiling are skipped, so each scan moves on), up to PSO_RESCANS times. A burst of new
   pipelines (265 in one frame on entering a new area) then compiles in parallel instead of mostly one after another.
   TOTK_PSO_RESCANS sets the limit (0: one scan per submission, as before). */
static int pso_rescans(void) { static int v = -1; if (v < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_PSO_RESCANS"); v = e ? atoi(e) : 32; if (v < 0) v = 0; } return v; }
static int g_pp_more, g_pp_rescans; static uint64_t g_pp_sync;   // last scan stopped at a budget; scans after the first; pipelines compiled on the submission thread
// Statistics line (pso_predict_rest, every 100 scans): guesses refused because the table was full, stale guesses freed,
// time draws waited for a background compile, scans and which budget ended them.
static uint64_t g_pp_full, g_pp_reclaimed, g_pp_waits, g_pp_wait_ns, g_pp_scans, g_pp_scan_ns, g_pp_stop[3];
static void pso_predict_rest(void);
static int pso_pend_find(const pso_key *k) { for (int i = 0; i < PSO_PEND_MAX; i++) if (g_pp[i].used && !memcmp(&g_pp[i].k, k, sizeof *k)) return i; return -1; }
// Called only with g_pp_mu held. An in-flight worker still owns its slot:
// completion must be published before that slot can ever be reused. Negative 25 frees every slot.
static void pso_pend_reclaim(uint64_t submit) {
    for (int i = 0; i < PSO_PEND_MAX; i++) if (g_pp[i].used && ((g_pp[i].done && submit - g_pp[i].submit > 2) || pred_negative() == 25)) {
        g_pp[i].ps = nil; g_pp[i].used = 0; g_pp_reclaimed++;
    }
}
static void pso_pend_kick(const pso_key *k, NvShader *vs, NvShader *fs) {   // 提交线程调：没在缓存、没在表里才丢 | Called by the submit thread: kick only if it is neither in the cache nor in the table
    if (hm_get_id(&g_pso, k)) return;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_pp_mu);
    pso_pend_reclaim(g_sub_serial);
    int at = pso_pend_find(k), slot = -1;
    if (at < 0) for (int i = 0; i < PSO_PEND_MAX; i++) if (!g_pp[i].used) { slot = i; break; }
    if (at < 0 && slot >= 0) { g_pp[slot].k = *k; g_pp[slot].ps = nil; g_pp[slot].done = 0; g_pp[slot].used = 1; g_pp[slot].submit = g_sub_serial; }
    if (at < 0 && slot < 0) g_pp_full++;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_pp_mu);
    if (at >= 0 || slot < 0) return;
    MTLRenderPipelineDescriptor *d = pso_desc(k, vs, fs, nil, 0); g_pp_kicked++; NSString *key = pso_archive_key(k, vs, fs, 0);
    dispatch_async(dispatch_get_global_queue(QOS_CLASS_USER_INITIATED, 0), ^{
        NSError *e = nil; id<MTLRenderPipelineState> ps = pso_new(d, key, &e);
        pthread_mutex_lock(&g_pp_mu); g_pp[slot].ps = ps; g_pp[slot].done = 1; pthread_cond_broadcast(&g_pp_cv); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_pp_mu);
    });
}
static id<MTLRenderPipelineState> pso_pend_take(const pso_key *k) {   // 提交线程调：表里有就等它编完并取走；没有返回 nil | Called by the submit thread: if it is in the table, wait for it to finish compiling and take it; otherwise return nil
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_pp_mu);
    int at = pso_pend_find(k); id<MTLRenderPipelineState> ps = nil;
    if (at >= 0) { uint64_t t0 = bp_now(); int waited = !g_pp[at].done;
        while (!g_pp[at].done) pthread_cond_wait(&g_pp_cv, &g_pp_mu);
        if (waited) { g_pp_waits++; g_pp_wait_ns += bp_now() - t0; }
        ps = g_pp[at].ps; g_pp[at].ps = nil; g_pp[at].used = 0; }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_pp_mu);
    return ps;
}
static __unsafe_unretained id<MTLRenderPipelineState> pso_get(NvProg *pr, MTLRenderPassDescriptor *unused) {
    (void)unused;
    __unsafe_unretained NvShader *vs = pr->sh[0], *fs = pr->sh[1];
    if (!vs) { RED_ONCE(13, "程序没有顶点着色器（或未映射）"); return nil; }
    pso_key k; pso_key_fill(&k, vs, fs, g_pass.cfmt, g_pass.dfmt, g_pass.sfmt, g_pass.samples, g_pso_lmap != NULL);
    if (g_pass.layered) k.a2c |= PSO_LAYERED;   // TOTK: layered pass (see g_lay)
    if (g_mfx.role) k.a2c |= (uint32_t)g_mfx.role << 2;   // TOTK_MFX: scene / UI copy variant (see pso_desc)
    if (g_pso_lmap) { memcpy(k.lmap, g_pso_lmap, 8); k.fsfn = (__bridge void *)g_pso_fsfn; }
    __unsafe_unretained id<MTLFunction> bfn = !g_pso_lmap && !g_mfx.role ? fs_fn_border(fs, k.dfmt == 0) : nil;   // TOTK: sampler border colour emulation
    if (bfn) k.fsfn = (__bridge void *)bfn;
    { float bc[8][4]; int ba[8], bn; if (border_key(vs, 0, bc, ba, &bn)) k.a2c |= PSO_VBORDER; }
    __unsafe_unretained id<MTLRenderPipelineState> cached = (__bridge id<MTLRenderPipelineState>)hm_get_ptr(&g_pso, &k);
    if (cached) return cached;
    id<MTLRenderPipelineState> ps;
    NSError *e = nil; uint64_t bt = bp_now();
    ps = g_pso_lmap ? nil : pso_pend_take(&k);
    if (ps) g_pp_taken++;
    else {
        if (g_pp_submit_mark != g_sub_serial) { g_pp_submit_mark = g_sub_serial; g_pp_rescans = 0; g_pp_more = 0; pso_predict_rest(); }   // 本次提交第一次缺：先把后面的丢出去并行编，再同步编眼前这条 | First miss in this submission: first kick the later ones out to compile in parallel, then synchronously compile the one at hand
        else if (g_pp_more && g_pp_rescans < pso_rescans()) { g_pp_rescans++; pso_predict_rest(); }   // TOTK: the last scan stopped early: go on from here
        MTLRenderPipelineDescriptor *d = pso_desc(&k, vs, fs, bfn ? bfn : g_pso_fsfn, g_pso_lmap != NULL);
        ps = pso_new(d, pso_archive_key(&k, vs, fs, g_pso_lmap != NULL), &e); g_pp_sync++;
    }
    g_bp_pso_n++; g_bp_pso_ns += bp_now() - bt;
    if (!ps) { static int said; if (said++ < 12) MLOG("【红】建渲染管线失败：%s（vs %s ps %s dfmt %d sfmt %d cfmt0 %d samples %d）", e.localizedDescription.UTF8String, vs->key, fs ? fs->key : "-", (int)k.dfmt, (int)k.sfmt, (int)k.cfmt[0], (int)k.samples); else if (said == 12) MLOG("【红】建渲染管线失败：后续不再逐条打印"); return nil; }
    pso_key rk = k; rk.a2c &= ~PSO_VBORDER; if (bfn) rk.fsfn = NULL;   // the warm-up list records the plain pipeline: a border variant is built from the draw's samplers
    pso_skey sk; char shex[sizeof sk * 2 + 1]; pso_skey_from(&rk, vs, fs, g_pso_lmap != NULL, g_pso_lmap ? &g_pso_fz : NULL, &sk); pso_skey_hex(&sk, shex);
    if (survey_shader_log()) MLOG("[survey-shader] frame %llu render pipeline %s in %.2f ms", (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&g_cur_frame), shex, (bp_now() - bt) / 1e6);
    pso_record("R\t%s\n", shex);
    pso_user_record("R\t%s\n", shex);
    hm_put_id(&g_pso, &k, ps);
    return ps;
}
static NSString *warm_key(const char *s, size_t n) {
    size_t z = strnlen(s, n);
    return [[NSString alloc] initWithBytes:s length:z encoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding];
}
static _Atomic uint64_t g_warm_missing;   // shaders named in the warm lists that are not in the translation cache (yet)
static int warm_available(NSString *key) {
    if (!key.length) return 1;
    NSFileManager *fm = NSFileManager.defaultManager;
    NSString *rt = totk_rt_dir();
    int have = [fm fileExistsAtPath:[rt stringByAppendingFormat:@"/%@.metal", key]] ||
               [fm fileExistsAtPath:[rt stringByAppendingFormat:@"/%@.metallib", key]] ||
               [fm fileExistsAtPath:[g_msl_dir stringByAppendingFormat:@"/%@.metallib", key]];
    if (!have) {
        static NSMutableSet *missing; static dispatch_once_t once;
        dispatch_once(&once, ^{ missing = [NSMutableSet set]; });
        @synchronized (missing) { if (![missing containsObject:key]) { [missing addObject:key]; g_warm_missing++; } }
    }
    return have;
}
/* One shader of the warm-up, without the per-run dictionary (safe on several threads at once). */
static NvShader *warm_shader_load(NSString *key, int stage) {
    /* A warm list may name a variant this cache does not hold (collected by another session, the cache trimmed): it is
       translated on first use like any new shader, so the warm-up skips it quietly and counts it (one line at the end)
       instead of a red "cannot open" per pipeline that names it (2026-10-16 night: 42 such lines in one session). */
    static NSMutableSet<NSString *> *missing; static dispatch_once_t once; dispatch_once(&once, ^{ missing = [NSMutableSet set]; });
    @synchronized (missing) { if ([missing containsObject:key]) return nil; }
    NSString *msl = [NSString stringWithContentsOfFile:[totk_rt_dir() stringByAppendingFormat:@"/%@.metal", key]
                                                encoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding error:nil];
    if (!msl && ![NSFileManager.defaultManager fileExistsAtPath:[totk_rt_dir() stringByAppendingFormat:@"/%@.metallib", key]] &&
        ![NSFileManager.defaultManager fileExistsAtPath:[NSString stringWithFormat:@"%@/%@.metallib", g_msl_dir, key]]) {
        @synchronized (missing) { if (![missing containsObject:key]) { [missing addObject:key]; g_warm_missing++; } }
        return nil;
    }
    if (msl && ([msl containsString:@"double "] || [msl containsString:@"unsupported_GLSLstd450"])) return nil;
    uint64_t started = bp_now();
    NvShader *sh = shader_load(key, stage);
    atomic_fetch_add(&g_warm_library_ns, bp_now() - started);
    atomic_fetch_add(&g_warm_library_count, 1);
    return sh;
}
/* Shaders whose warm-up load failed: tried once, not again for every row that names them. */
static NSMutableSet<NSString *> *g_warm_failed;
static os_unfair_lock g_warm_failed_lock = OS_UNFAIR_LOCK_INIT;
static int warm_failed(NSString *key) {
    os_unfair_lock_lock(&g_warm_failed_lock); int f = [g_warm_failed containsObject:key]; os_unfair_lock_unlock(&g_warm_failed_lock);
    return f;
}
static void warm_fail(NSString *key) {
    os_unfair_lock_lock(&g_warm_failed_lock);
    if (!g_warm_failed) g_warm_failed = [NSMutableSet set];
    [g_warm_failed addObject:key];
    os_unfair_lock_unlock(&g_warm_failed_lock);
}
static NvShader *warm_shader(NSMutableDictionary<NSString *, NvShader *> *dict, NSString *key, int stage) {
    NvShader *sh = dict[key];
    if (sh || warm_failed(key)) return sh;
    sh = warm_shader_load(key, stage);
    if (sh) dict[key] = sh; else warm_fail(key);
    return sh;
}
/* TOTK (2026-10-18): the warm-up compiles the shader libraries of each block of rows on several threads, then builds the
   pipelines of those rows one after another in list order, as before. A cold library takes about 48-92 ms, almost all of it
   in the system Metal compiler (one thread: 9,268 libraries 856 s, 3,459 pipelines under 1 s), and the compiler service runs
   requests side by side (8 threads: 188 s). That matters on a Mac whose Metal cache has never seen the prepared shaders: a
   new Mac, after the system purged the cache, or after the app moved. (Programs without an app bundle -- the game binary is
   one -- share one store, keyed by the source, the options and the length of the path of the folder the program runs
   from: rebuilding the app in the same place keeps it, moving it does not. The store evicts heavily when any such program
   compiles many new libraries, and what one compiles while another that opened it first is running is lost when that
   one quits. build_app.py compiles the seed once at packaging time from the game binary's folder, with no other program
   using the store: tools/warm_metal_cache.m.) Once the player is in the world (mtl_warm_wait returned) at most 2 threads go on, so the
   rest of the warm-up does not take the game's cores. TOTK_WARM_THREADS=<n> (1 = one thread as before); default 8 on the
   Mac (at most the core count minus 2), 1 on iOS (prebuilt libraries, nothing to compile). */
enum { WARM_BLOCK = 512 };   // rows per block: the shaders of a block load in parallel, then its rows run in order
static _Atomic int g_warm_in_play;
static int warm_threads(void) {
    static int n; static dispatch_once_t once;
    dispatch_once(&once, ^{
        const char *e = getenv("TOTK_WARM_THREADS");
#if TARGET_OS_IPHONE
        int d = 1;
#else
        int d = (int)NSProcessInfo.processInfo.activeProcessorCount - 2; if (d > 8) d = 8; if (d < 1) d = 1;
#endif
        n = e && *e ? atoi(e) : d; if (n < 1) n = 1; if (n > 32) n = 32;
    });
    return n;
}
static int warm_threads_now(void) { int n = warm_threads(); return n > 2 && atomic_load(&g_warm_in_play) ? 2 : n; }
typedef struct { _Atomic size_t next; os_unfair_lock lock; } warm_par;
/* Load the shaders named by keys / stages into dict, each once, on warm_threads_now() threads. */
static void warm_load_keys(NSArray<NSString *> *keys, NSArray<NSNumber *> *stages, NSMutableDictionary<NSString *, NvShader *> *dict) {
    NSMutableArray<NSString *> *todo = [NSMutableArray array]; NSMutableArray<NSNumber *> *st = [NSMutableArray array];
    NSMutableSet<NSString *> *want = [NSMutableSet set];
    for (NSUInteger i = 0; i < keys.count; i++) {
        NSString *k = keys[i];
        if (!k.length || dict[k] || [want containsObject:k] || warm_failed(k)) continue;
        [want addObject:k]; [todo addObject:k]; [st addObject:stages[i]];
    }
    size_t n = todo.count, workers = (size_t)warm_threads_now();
    if (!n) return;
    if (workers <= 1 || n == 1) { for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) @autoreleasepool { warm_shader(dict, todo[i], st[i].intValue); } return; }
    if (workers > n) workers = n;
    warm_par *wp = calloc(1, sizeof *wp); if (!wp) MDIE("预热：内存不足");
    wp->lock = OS_UNFAIR_LOCK_INIT;
    dispatch_apply(workers, dispatch_get_global_queue(QOS_CLASS_USER_INITIATED, 0), ^(size_t w) {
        for (;;) @autoreleasepool {
            if (w && w >= (size_t)warm_threads_now()) break;   // fewer threads once playing; thread 0 always goes on
            size_t i = atomic_fetch_add(&wp->next, 1);
            if (i >= n) break;
            NSString *key = todo[i];
            NvShader *sh = warm_shader_load(key, st[i].intValue);
            if (!sh) { warm_fail(key); continue; }
            os_unfair_lock_lock(&wp->lock); dict[key] = sh; os_unfair_lock_unlock(&wp->lock);
        }
    });
    free(wp);
}
/* The shaders a block of warm-list rows names (S: the shader, R: its vertex and fragment shaders, C: the compute shader). */
static void warm_load_rows(NSArray<NSString *> *rows, NSMutableDictionary<NSString *, NvShader *> *dict) {
    NSMutableArray<NSString *> *keys = [NSMutableArray array]; NSMutableArray<NSNumber *> *stages = [NSMutableArray array];
    for (NSString *line in rows) {
        NSArray<NSString *> *c = [line componentsSeparatedByString:@"\t"];
        if ([c[0] isEqualToString:@"S"] && c.count >= 3) { [keys addObject:c[1]]; [stages addObject:@(c[2].intValue)]; }
        else if ([c[0] isEqualToString:@"R"] && c.count >= 2) {
            pso_skey sk; if (pso_skey_parse(c[1].UTF8String, &sk)) continue;
            NSString *vkey = warm_key(sk.vs, sizeof sk.vs), *fkey = warm_key(sk.fs, sizeof sk.fs);
            if (vkey.length) { [keys addObject:vkey]; [stages addObject:@(sk.vs_stage)]; }
            if (fkey.length) { [keys addObject:fkey]; [stages addObject:@(sk.fs_stage)]; }
        } else if ([c[0] isEqualToString:@"C"] && c.count >= 2 && c[1].length) { [keys addObject:c[1]]; [stages addObject:@5]; }
    }
    warm_load_keys(keys, stages, dict);
}
static void warm_enqueue(WarmItem *item) {
    os_unfair_lock_lock(&g_warm_lock);
    if (!g_warm_items) g_warm_items = [NSMutableArray array];
    [g_warm_items addObject:item];
    atomic_store_explicit(&g_warm_ready, 1, memory_order_release);
    os_unfair_lock_unlock(&g_warm_lock);
}
/* TOTK_SHADER_PREFETCH=1 (off by default): when the game hands a program its shaders (nvnProgramSetShaders, usually while
   it loads, before the first draw), the variants of those shaders that the translation cache already holds are compiled
   into Metal libraries on background threads and handed to the submission thread like the warm-up's (warm_claim at the
   next submission). The first draw then finds the library instead of compiling it itself: on the starting sky island
   the frames that stalled for a new library (65 of them, 181 libraries, 29 s in a 21-minute run) were all variants
   already in the cache, compiled from their MSL at the draw. Variants not in the cache, and pipelines, are still made
   at the draw as before. Nothing is translated here and no draw is skipped. */
static int prefetch_on(void) { static int on = -1; if (on < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_SHADER_PREFETCH"); on = e && !strcmp(e, "1"); } return on; }
static _Atomic uint64_t g_pf_progs, g_pf_queued, g_pf_built, g_pf_ns, g_pf_last;
/* Odyssey: Odyssey hands ~26,600 programs their shaders during boot. Hashing them on the game thread delayed the first
   frame from ~14 s to 27.6 s, and 289 background compiles at boot competed with the draws' own compiles. Here the
   hashing runs on a utility-QoS serial queue that starts only after the first game frame, and at most
   TOTK_PREFETCH_SLOTS (default 2) libraries compile at once. The control section is interned (stable); a guest code
   buffer reused before it is hashed only gives a key with no cached variants. */
void mtl_prog_prefetch(const prog_t *p) {
    if (!prefetch_on() || !p || !p->nstage) return;
    static NSMutableSet<NSString *> *seen; static dispatch_queue_t q, hq; static dispatch_semaphore_t slots; static os_unfair_lock lk = OS_UNFAIR_LOCK_INIT;
    static dispatch_once_t once; dispatch_once(&once, ^{
        seen = [NSMutableSet set];
        q = dispatch_queue_create("totk.shader-prefetch", dispatch_queue_attr_make_with_qos_class(DISPATCH_QUEUE_CONCURRENT, QOS_CLASS_UTILITY, 0));
        hq = dispatch_queue_create("totk.shader-prefetch-hash", dispatch_queue_attr_make_with_qos_class(DISPATCH_QUEUE_SERIAL, QOS_CLASS_UTILITY, 0));
        const char *e = getenv("TOTK_PREFETCH_SLOTS"); long n = e ? atol(e) : 2; if (n < 1) n = 1; if (n > 8) n = 8;
        slots = dispatch_semaphore_create(n);
