`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/nvn_render_stream.h`:

```h
/* Included only by nvn_mtl.m. Encode stage (TOTK_RENDER_STREAM=1, runtime `flag render_stream 0|1`): the Metal render
   encoder of every render pass is created, fed and ended by one persistent worker thread ("B"); the replay thread ("A")
   keeps the NVN state, the resource resolution, the argument-block writes, blits, dispatches and commits, and only
   joins B (rs_sync) where it must touch the command buffer itself. 2026-10-16, replacing the 2026-10-16 morning version
   (S017) that handed the encoder over from the 16th draw of a pass, woke the worker with a condition variable at every
   pass and joined it at every pass end: measured replay 4.90 -> 5.28 ms, i.e. the waits cost more than the driver calls
   they moved (analysis/s0a-*).
   - A sees a sentinel object as `g_enc` while B owns a pass; the enc_r_* wrappers turn calls on the sentinel into packets.
   - Packets travel through the single-producer / single-consumer FIFO; draws publish, so B sees whole draws.
   - B spins while packets keep coming and sleeps on a semaphore after RS_SPIN_NS of nothing; A signals it when it
     publishes to a sleeping B (store / fence / load on both sides, so a wake-up cannot be lost).
   - rs_sync() (A) waits until B consumed everything: before any encoder A opens on the command buffer itself, before a
     command buffer is ended / committed, and at the end of the submission. It spins; B is awake by then.
   - Objects: pipeline / depth-stencil states and the pass descriptor are retained for the packet and released by B
     after use (probes build pipeline states that go away right after the pass; the game's live in caches).
   No GPU ordering, resource retirement or uniform snapshot policy changes: B only encodes what A decided, in A's order. */
#include "nvn_encode_fifo.h"
#include <TargetConditionals.h>
#include <sched.h>
#include <dispatch/dispatch.h>

enum {
    RS_PSO, RS_DSS, RS_VIEWPORT, RS_SCISSOR, RS_CULL, RS_WINDING, RS_FILL,
    RS_BIAS, RS_CLIP, RS_STENCIL, RS_BLEND, RS_VISIBILITY, RS_ADDRESS,
    RS_DRAW, RS_INSTANCED, RS_INDEXED, RS_STORE,
    RS_BEGIN,   /* u[0] = retained MTL4RenderPassDescriptor, u[1] = vertex table, u[2] = fragment table, u[3] = command buffer, u[4] = barrier at start, u[5] = visibility options */
    RS_END,     /* end the encoder (barrier at end if u[0], visibility options u[1]) */
};
enum { RS_SPIN_NS = 200000 };   /* B waits (wfe) this long on an empty queue before sleeping on the semaphore. During a replay A never pauses
                                   for that long, so B sleeps in the frame gap and wakes (~30 us) at the next submission. The waits are wfe / sev,
                                   not a hot spin: with a hot spin (2 ms yield loop) the visible-mode GPU time rose 8.9 -> 9.3 ms (analysis/rs3v-*,
                                   rs4v-* with 200 us): CPU power taken from the GPU's budget. */
static nvn_encode_fifo g_rs_fifo;
static _Atomic int g_rs_on = -1;
static _Atomic int g_rs_sleeping;          /* B announced it is about to sleep (seq_cst handshake with the publisher) */
static dispatch_semaphore_t g_rs_sem;
static int g_rs_created, g_rs_configured, g_rs_active;
static id g_rs_sentinel;                   /* what A sees as the encoder while B owns the pass */
static uint64_t g_rs_passes, g_rs_packets, g_rs_syncs, g_rs_sync_ns, g_rs_sync_max_ns, g_rs_full_waits, g_rs_full_ns, g_rs_subs;
static _Atomic uint64_t g_rs_b_sleeps, g_rs_b_passes, g_rs_b_busy_ns;   /* busy: from the first packet after an idle spell to the next idle spell */
static int g_rs_probe_negative;
static int tbdr_on(void);
static int enc_label_on(void);
int mfx_enabled(void);
static int rs_enabled(void) {
    int v = atomic_load_explicit(&g_rs_on, memory_order_relaxed);
    if (v < 0) {
        const char *e = getenv("TOTK_RENDER_STREAM"); int expected = -1;
        /* Mac default on (2026-10-16: replay -18%, frame -3..5%, 30-minute soak clean); iOS off (A15: two performance cores). */
        atomic_compare_exchange_strong(&g_rs_on, &expected, e ? !strcmp(e, "1") : !TARGET_OS_IPHONE);
        v = atomic_load_explicit(&g_rs_on, memory_order_relaxed);
    }
    return v;
}
static inline uint64_t rs_now(void) { return clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW); }
static void rs_apply(id<MTL4RenderCommandEncoder> *enc, id<MTL4ArgumentTable> *vt, id<MTL4ArgumentTable> *ft, const nvn_encode_packet *p) {
    const uint64_t *u = p->u; id<MTL4RenderCommandEncoder> e = *enc;
    if (g_rs_probe_negative && (p->op == RS_DRAW || p->op == RS_INSTANCED || p->op == RS_INDEXED)) return;
    if (p->op != RS_BEGIN && !e) MDIE("render stream packet %llu without an encoder", (unsigned long long)p->op);
    switch (p->op) {
        case RS_BEGIN: {
            if (e) MDIE("render stream: pass begun while the previous one is open");
            MTL4RenderPassDescriptor *d = (__bridge MTL4RenderPassDescriptor *)(void *)(uintptr_t)u[0];
            id<MTL4CommandBuffer> cb = (__bridge id<MTL4CommandBuffer>)(void *)(uintptr_t)u[3];
            *vt = (__bridge id<MTL4ArgumentTable>)(void *)(uintptr_t)u[1]; *ft = (__bridge id<MTL4ArgumentTable>)(void *)(uintptr_t)u[2];
            e = [cb renderCommandEncoderWithDescriptor:d];
            if (!e) MDIE("render stream: renderCommandEncoderWithDescriptor failed");
            if (u[4] == 2) {   /* TOTK_BARRIER_NARROW: copies / compute order before every stage; earlier render work only before our fragment stage (the vertex stage overlaps the previous pass's fragment work) */
                [e barrierAfterQueueStages:MTLStageBlit | MTLStageDispatch beforeStages:MTLStageVertex | MTLStageFragment visibilityOptions:(MTL4VisibilityOptions)u[5]];
                [e barrierAfterQueueStages:MTLStageVertex | MTLStageFragment beforeStages:MTLStageFragment visibilityOptions:(MTL4VisibilityOptions)u[5]];
            } else if (u[4]) [e barrierAfterQueueStages:MTLStageAll beforeStages:MTLStageAll visibilityOptions:(MTL4VisibilityOptions)u[5]];
            [e setArgumentTable:*vt atStages:MTLRenderStageVertex]; [e setArgumentTable:*ft atStages:MTLRenderStageFragment];
            CFRelease((CFTypeRef)(uintptr_t)u[0]);
            *enc = e; atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_rs_b_passes, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
            break; }
        case RS_END:
            if (u[0] == 2) [e barrierAfterStages:MTLStageVertex | MTLStageFragment beforeQueueStages:MTLStageFragment | MTLStageBlit | MTLStageDispatch visibilityOptions:(MTL4VisibilityOptions)u[1]];   /* TOTK_BARRIER_NARROW: later vertex stages do not wait */
            else if (u[0]) [e barrierAfterStages:MTLStageAll beforeQueueStages:MTLStageAll visibilityOptions:(MTL4VisibilityOptions)u[1]];
            [e endEncoding]; *enc = nil; break;
        case RS_PSO: [e setRenderPipelineState:(__bridge id<MTLRenderPipelineState>)(void *)(uintptr_t)u[0]]; if (u[0]) CFRelease((CFTypeRef)(uintptr_t)u[0]); break;
        case RS_DSS: [e setDepthStencilState:(__bridge id<MTLDepthStencilState>)(void *)(uintptr_t)u[0]]; if (u[0]) CFRelease((CFTypeRef)(uintptr_t)u[0]); break;
        case RS_VIEWPORT: { MTLViewport v; memcpy(&v, u, sizeof v); [e setViewport:v]; break; }
        case RS_SCISSOR: { MTLScissorRect v; memcpy(&v, u, sizeof v); [e setScissorRect:v]; break; }
        case RS_CULL: [e setCullMode:(MTLCullMode)u[0]]; break;
        case RS_WINDING: [e setFrontFacingWinding:(MTLWinding)u[0]]; break;
        case RS_FILL: [e setTriangleFillMode:(MTLTriangleFillMode)u[0]]; break;
        case RS_BIAS: { float v[3]; memcpy(v, u, sizeof v); [e setDepthBias:v[0] slopeScale:v[1] clamp:v[2]]; break; }
        case RS_CLIP: [e setDepthClipMode:(MTLDepthClipMode)u[0]]; break;
        case RS_STENCIL: [e setStencilReferenceValue:(uint32_t)u[0]]; break;
        case RS_BLEND: { float v[4]; memcpy(v, u, sizeof v); [e setBlendColorRed:v[0] green:v[1] blue:v[2] alpha:v[3]]; break; }
        case RS_VISIBILITY: [e setVisibilityResultMode:(MTLVisibilityResultMode)u[0] offset:(NSUInteger)u[1]]; break;
        case RS_ADDRESS: [(u[0] ? *ft : *vt) setAddress:u[2] atIndex:(NSUInteger)u[1]]; break;
        case RS_DRAW: [e drawPrimitives:(MTLPrimitiveType)u[0] vertexStart:(NSUInteger)u[1] vertexCount:(NSUInteger)u[2]]; break;
        case RS_INSTANCED: [e drawPrimitives:(MTLPrimitiveType)u[0] vertexStart:(NSUInteger)u[1] vertexCount:(NSUInteger)u[2] instanceCount:(NSUInteger)u[3] baseInstance:(NSUInteger)u[4]]; break;
        case RS_INDEXED: [e drawIndexedPrimitives:(MTLPrimitiveType)u[0] indexCount:(NSUInteger)u[1] indexType:(MTLIndexType)u[2] indexBuffer:u[3] indexBufferLength:(NSUInteger)u[4] instanceCount:(NSUInteger)u[5] baseVertex:(NSInteger)u[6] baseInstance:(NSUInteger)u[7]]; break;
        case RS_STORE:
            if (u[0] == 1) [e setDepthStoreAction:(MTLStoreAction)u[1]];
            else if (u[0] == 2) [e setStencilStoreAction:(MTLStoreAction)u[1]];
            else [e setColorStoreAction:(MTLStoreAction)u[1] atIndex:(NSUInteger)u[2]];
            break;
        default: MDIE("render stream invalid operation %llu", (unsigned long long)p->op);
    }
}
static void *rs_worker(void *unused) {
    (void)unused;
    pthread_setname_np("TOTK encode stage");
    pthread_set_qos_class_self_np(QOS_CLASS_USER_INTERACTIVE, 0);
    id<MTL4RenderCommandEncoder> enc = nil; id<MTL4ArgumentTable> vt = nil, ft = nil;
    uint64_t idle_since = 0, busy_since = 0;
    for (;;) {
        const nvn_encode_packet *p = nvn_encode_fifo_peek(&g_rs_fifo);
        if (!p) {
            uint64_t now = rs_now();
            if (busy_since) { atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_rs_b_busy_ns, now - busy_since, memory_order_relaxed); busy_since = 0; }
            if (!idle_since) idle_since = now;
            if (now - idle_since < RS_SPIN_NS) { __builtin_arm_wfe(); continue; }   /* low-power wait; A does sev after every publish */
            atomic_store_explicit(&g_rs_sleeping, 1, memory_order_seq_cst);
            atomic_thread_fence(memory_order_seq_cst);
            if (!nvn_encode_fifo_peek(&g_rs_fifo)) { dispatch_semaphore_wait(g_rs_sem, DISPATCH_TIME_FOREVER); atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_rs_b_sleeps, 1, memory_order_relaxed); }
            atomic_store_explicit(&g_rs_sleeping, 0, memory_order_seq_cst);
            idle_since = 0; continue;
        }
        if (!busy_since) busy_since = rs_now();
        idle_since = 0;
        @autoreleasepool { rs_apply(&enc, &vt, &ft, p); }
        nvn_encode_fifo_consume(&g_rs_fifo);
        __builtin_arm_sev();
    }
    return NULL;
}
/* Publish what A queued and wake B if it went to sleep (seq_cst store / fence / load pairs with B's sleep handshake). */
static inline void rs_publish(void) {
    nvn_encode_fifo_publish(&g_rs_fifo);
    atomic_thread_fence(memory_order_seq_cst);
    __builtin_arm_sev();
    if (atomic_load_explicit(&g_rs_sleeping, memory_order_seq_cst)) dispatch_semaphore_signal(g_rs_sem);
}
static void rs_put(nvn_encode_packet p, int publish) {
    if (!nvn_encode_fifo_push(&g_rs_fifo, &p)) {   /* ring full: B is behind; wait for it (counted: this is A time lost to B) */
        uint64_t t0 = rs_now(); g_rs_full_waits++;
        do { rs_publish(); __builtin_arm_wfe(); } while (!nvn_encode_fifo_push(&g_rs_fifo, &p));
        g_rs_full_ns += rs_now() - t0;
    }
    if (publish) rs_publish();
    g_rs_packets++;
}
static inline void rs_object(unsigned op, id object) { rs_put((nvn_encode_packet){.op = op, .u = {(uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(object ? CFBridgingRetain(object) : NULL)}}, 0); }
static void rs_copy(unsigned op, const void *data, size_t size) {
    nvn_encode_packet p = {.op = op};
    if (size > sizeof p.u) MDIE("render stream payload too large");
    memcpy(p.u, data, size); rs_put(p, 0);
}
/* A: wait until B has consumed everything queued so far. */
static void rs_sync(void) {
    if (!g_rs_created) return;
    if (g_rs_active) MDIE("render stream: sync inside a streamed pass");
    rs_publish();
    uint64_t t0 = rs_now(), produced = g_rs_fifo.produced;
    while (atomic_load_explicit(&g_rs_fifo.consumed, memory_order_acquire) != produced) {
        __builtin_arm_wfe();
        if ((rs_now() - t0) > 2000000000ull) MDIE("render stream: the encode stage did not drain in 2 s");
    }
    uint64_t dt = rs_now() - t0; g_rs_syncs++; g_rs_sync_ns += dt; if (dt > g_rs_sync_max_ns) g_rs_sync_max_ns = dt;
    if (totk_tl_on()) totk_tl(TL_RS_JOIN, dt, g_rs_syncs);
}
/* Whether the next render pass is encoded by B. Diagnostics that encode on the command buffer themselves, the TBDR
   rewrites and MetalFX stay on the replay thread. */
static int rs_stream_pass(void) {
    if (!rs_enabled() || pt_active() || tbdr_on() || enc_label_on() || mfx_enabled()) return 0;
    if (!g_rs_configured) {
        const char *negative = getenv("TOTK_PROBE_NEGATIVE");
        g_rs_probe_negative = negative && atoi(negative) == 17;
        g_rs_sentinel = [NSObject new];
        g_rs_sem = dispatch_semaphore_create(0);
        g_rs_configured = 1;
    }
    if (!g_rs_created) {
        nvn_encode_fifo_reset(&g_rs_fifo);
        pthread_t thread; pthread_attr_t attr; pthread_attr_init(&attr); pthread_attr_setstacksize(&attr, 1 << 20);
        if (pthread_create(&thread, &attr, rs_worker, NULL)) MDIE("render stream worker creation failed");
        pthread_detach(thread); g_rs_created = 1;
        MLOG("[nvn] 编码线程：渲染通道的 Metal 编码在独立线程上（TOTK_RENDER_STREAM=1；flag render_stream 0 关）");
    }
    return 1;
}
/* A: hand a pass to B. Returns the sentinel the replay uses as its encoder. */
static id rs_pass_begin(MTL4RenderPassDescriptor *d, id<MTL4ArgumentTable> vt, id<MTL4ArgumentTable> ft, id<MTL4CommandBuffer> cb, int bar_start, uint64_t vis) {
    if (g_rs_active) MDIE("render stream: pass begun while another streamed pass is open");
    g_rs_active = 1; g_rs_passes++;
    rs_put((nvn_encode_packet){.op = RS_BEGIN, .u = {(uint64_t)(uintptr_t)CFBridgingRetain(d), (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(__bridge void *)vt, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(__bridge void *)ft,
                                                     (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(__bridge void *)cb, (uint64_t)bar_start, vis}}, 1);
    return g_rs_sentinel;
}
static int rs_using(id e) {
    if (!g_rs_active) return 0;
    if (e != g_rs_sentinel) MDIE("render stream encoder ownership mismatch");
    return 1;
}
static void rs_pass_end(id e, int bar_end, uint64_t vis) {
    if (!rs_using(e)) MDIE("render stream: ending a pass it does not own");
    rs_put((nvn_encode_packet){.op = RS_END, .u = {(uint64_t)bar_end, vis}}, 1);
    g_rs_active = 0;
}
/* End of a submission: B drained; a statistics line every 1800 submissions. */
static void rs_sub_end(void) {
    if (!g_rs_created) return;
    rs_sync();
    if (++g_rs_subs % 1800 == 0) {
        static uint64_t last_busy, last_full, last_packets, last_sync;
        uint64_t busy = atomic_load(&g_rs_b_busy_ns);
        MLOG("[nvn] 编码线程 至提交 %llu：通道 %llu，包 %llu（近 1800 次提交每次 %.0f 个），等待 %llu 次 / 平均 %.1f µs / 最长 %.1f µs / 近 1800 次每次 %.3f ms，"
             "环满 %llu 次 / 近 1800 次每次等 %.3f ms，线程入睡 %llu 次，编码线程忙 近 1800 次每次 %.3f ms",
             (unsigned long long)g_rs_subs, (unsigned long long)g_rs_passes, (unsigned long long)g_rs_packets, (double)(g_rs_packets - last_packets) / 1800.0,
             (unsigned long long)g_rs_syncs, g_rs_syncs ? (double)g_rs_sync_ns / (double)g_rs_syncs / 1e3 : 0.0, (double)g_rs_sync_max_ns / 1e3,
             (double)(g_rs_sync_ns - last_sync) / 1800.0 / 1e6, (unsigned long long)g_rs_full_waits, (double)(g_rs_full_ns - last_full) / 1800.0 / 1e6,
             (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&g_rs_b_sleeps), (double)(busy - last_busy) / 1800.0 / 1e6);
        last_busy = busy; last_full = g_rs_full_ns; last_packets = g_rs_packets; last_sync = g_rs_sync_ns;
        g_rs_sync_max_ns = 0;
    }
}

```

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/nvn_rtex.inc`:

```inc
// nvn_rtex.inc —— 运行时外推的着色器（由 nvn_mtl.m 在 rp_end / m4_end / res_add / args_dirty_all / blit 等定义之后 #include）
//
// int rt_ex_encode(dst_hdr, dst_ds, src_hdr, src_ds, vp_prev[16], vp_cur[16], unit_bits, ui_bits)
//   在当前 MTL4 命令缓冲 g_cb 上编一个渲染通道（全屏一个三角形），把上一全画帧的不透明 HDR 与深度按本帧相机外推进 dst_hdr / dst_ds：
//   反向映射：目标像素 q → 源像素 p，用源深度做 2 次不动点迭代；M = inv(vp_prev) · vp_cur 在 CPU 上双精度算（1e4 量级平移下单精度逆矩阵会差出 0.01 像素）。
//   非洞：五抽头 Catmull-Rom，按 2×2 核心纹素的最小 / 最大值夹住防振铃，再按位移的小数相位补锐化（相位 0.5 最强、整数相位为 0，强度 k = 0.5）。
//   洞（源 2×2 核心的模板含 unit_bits | ui_bits：旧单位位置 / 界面挖空）：沿 8 个方向每 4 像素往外找第一个非洞、非纯黑的像素（最远 24 步），
//   按 1/距离² 加权平均；深度取其中最近那个。洞和屏边新露出（源越界）的像素由片元导出模板 0x80，之后的区域后处理据此重算。
//   本帧界面挡住的像素（界面模板趟已写 0x2）按模板测试跳过。
// 返回 1 = 编了；0 = 尺寸不齐 / 建不出管线（调用方 rt_copy_prev 先用 rx_setup 预检，建不出就整局退回原画法）。
// 调用前后：本函数先 rp_end() 收掉当前渲染通道与拷贝编码器；编完置 args_dirty_all() / g_pso_dirty / g_dss_dirty，游戏下一个绘制按「读入」重开它的通道。
// 资源：src_hdr / src_ds 由调用方建并 res_add；src_ds 要能开 X32_Stencil8 视图（建时带 MTLTextureUsagePixelFormatView）。
// nvn_rtex.inc - shaders for runtime extrapolation (#included by nvn_mtl.m after the definitions of rp_end / m4_end / res_add / args_dirty_all / blit etc.)
// int rt_ex_encode(dst_hdr, dst_ds, src_hdr, src_ds, vp_prev[16], vp_cur[16], unit_bits, ui_bits)
//   Encodes one render pass (a single fullscreen triangle) on the current MTL4 command buffer g_cb, extrapolating the opaque HDR and depth of the previous fully drawn frame into dst_hdr / dst_ds by this frame's camera:
//   Backward mapping: destination pixel q → source pixel p, with 2 fixed-point iterations using the source depth; M = inv(vp_prev) · vp_cur is computed on the CPU in double precision (with translations on the order of 1e4 a single-precision inverse matrix would be off by 0.01 pixel).
//   Non-hole: five-tap Catmull-Rom, clamped to the min / max of the 2×2 core texels against ringing, then sharpening compensation by the fractional phase of the displacement (strongest at phase 0.5, 0 at integer phase, strength k = 0.5).
//   Hole (the stencil of the source 2×2 core contains unit_bits | ui_bits: old unit position / UI cut-out): along 8 directions search outward every 4 pixels for the first pixel that is neither a hole nor pure black (at most 24 steps),
//   weighted average by 1/distance²; depth takes the nearest of them. Holes and pixels newly exposed at the screen edge (source out of bounds) get stencil 0x80 exported by the fragment, and the later regional post-processing is recomputed accordingly.
//   Pixels covered by this frame's UI (the UI stencil pass already wrote 0x2) are skipped by the stencil test.
// Returns 1 = encoded; 0 = size mismatch / pipeline cannot be built (the caller rt_copy_prev prechecks with rx_setup first, and if it cannot be built the whole run falls back to the original drawing method).
// Before and after the call: this function first calls rp_end() to close the current render pass and copy encoder; after encoding it sets args_dirty_all() / g_pso_dirty / g_dss_dirty, and the game's next draw reopens its pass with 'load'.
// Resources: src_hdr / src_ds are created and res_add'ed by the caller; src_ds must be able to open an X32_Stencil8 view (created with MTLTextureUsagePixelFormatView).
static id<MTLRenderPipelineState> g_rx_pso1; static MTLPixelFormat g_rx_fmt_c, g_rx_fmt_ds;
static id<MTLDepthStencilState> g_rx_dss; static id<MTL4ArgumentTable> g_rx_args;
static id<MTLBuffer> g_rx_const[3]; static int g_rx_ci;
static id<MTLTexture> g_rx_stv; static __unsafe_unretained id<MTLTexture> g_rx_stv_src;
static const char *k_rx_msl =
"#include <metal_stdlib>\n"
"using namespace metal;\n"
"struct VO { float4 p [[position]]; };\n"
"vertex VO rx_vs(uint id [[vertex_id]]) { float2 uv = float2((id << 1) & 2, id & 2); VO o; o.p = float4(uv * float2(2, -2) + float2(-1, 1), 0, 1); return o; }\n"
"struct K { float4x4 M; uint hole; float amount; float2 pad; };\n"
"static float4 cr_w(float t) { return float4(((-0.5 * t + 1.0) * t - 0.5) * t, (1.5 * t - 2.5) * t * t + 1.0, ((-1.5 * t + 2.0) * t + 0.5) * t, (0.5 * t - 0.5) * t * t); }\n"
"static uint stv(texture2d<uint> s, int2 p) { uint4 v = s.read(uint2(p)); return v.r | v.g; }\n"   // X32_Stencil8 视图：模板值在哪个分量随实现，r | g 两处都取（另一处为 0） | X32_Stencil8 view: which component holds the stencil value is implementation-dependent, take both r | g (the other one is 0)
"static float zproj(float4x4 M, float2 p, float z, int W, int H) { float4 c = M * float4((p.x + 0.5) / W * 2 - 1, 1 - (p.y + 0.5) / H * 2, z, 1); return c.z / c.w; }\n"
"struct O1 { float4 c [[color(0)]]; float d [[depth(any)]]; uint s [[stencil]]; };\n"
"fragment O1 rx_fs1(VO in [[stage_in]], texture2d<float> hdr [[texture(0)]], depth2d<float> dep [[texture(1)]], texture2d<uint> stc [[texture(2)]], constant K& k [[buffer(0)]]) {\n"
"  constexpr sampler ls(filter::linear, address::clamp_to_edge, coord::pixel);\n"
"  int W = hdr.get_width(), H = hdr.get_height(); int2 hi = int2(W - 1, H - 1);\n"
"  float2 q = floor(in.p.xy); float2 p = q;\n"
"  for (int it = 0; it < 2; it++) {\n"
"    int2 pi = clamp(int2(rint(p)), int2(0), hi); float z = dep.read(uint2(pi));\n"
"    float4 c = k.M * float4((p.x + 0.5) / W * 2 - 1, 1 - (p.y + 0.5) / H * 2, z, 1);\n"
"    float2 qq = float2((c.x / c.w + 1) * 0.5 * W - 0.5, (1 - c.y / c.w) * 0.5 * H - 0.5); p += q - qq; }\n"
"  bool oob = p.x < -0.5 || p.y < -0.5 || p.x > float(hi.x) + 0.5 || p.y > float(hi.y) + 0.5;\n"
"  p = clamp(p, float2(0), float2(hi));\n"
"  int2 b0 = clamp(int2(floor(p)), int2(0), hi - 1);\n"
"  uint s4 = stv(stc, b0) | stv(stc, b0 + int2(1, 0)) | stv(stc, b0 + int2(0, 1)) | stv(stc, b0 + int2(1, 1));\n"
"  int2 cp = clamp(int2(rint(p)), int2(0), hi);\n"
"  O1 o; o.s = ((s4 & k.hole) || oob) ? 0x80u : 0u;\n"
"  if (!(s4 & k.hole)) {\n"
"    float3 t00 = hdr.read(uint2(b0)).rgb, t10 = hdr.read(uint2(b0 + int2(1, 0))).rgb, t01 = hdr.read(uint2(b0 + int2(0, 1))).rgb, t11 = hdr.read(uint2(b0 + int2(1, 1))).rgb;\n"
"    float3 lo = min(min(t00, t10), min(t01, t11)), hc = max(max(t00, t10), max(t01, t11)), avg = (t00 + t10 + t01 + t11) * 0.25;\n"
"    float2 sp = p + 0.5; float2 tp1 = floor(sp - 0.5) + 0.5; float2 f = sp - tp1;\n"   // 五抽头 Catmull-Rom（双线性取样合并中间两抽头、丢四角） | Five-tap Catmull-Rom (bilinear sampling merges the two middle taps, the four corners are dropped)
"    float2 w0 = f * (-0.5 + f * (1.0 - 0.5 * f)), w1 = 1.0 + f * f * (-2.5 + 1.5 * f), w2 = f * (0.5 + f * (2.0 - 1.5 * f)), w3 = f * f * (-0.5 + 0.5 * f);\n"
"    float2 w12 = w1 + w2, t12 = tp1 + w2 / w12, t0 = tp1 - 1.0, t3 = tp1 + 2.0;\n"
"    float3 acc = hdr.sample(ls, float2(t12.x, t0.y)).rgb * (w12.x * w0.y) + hdr.sample(ls, float2(t0.x, t12.y)).rgb * (w0.x * w12.y) + hdr.sample(ls, t12).rgb * (w12.x * w12.y)\n"
"               + hdr.sample(ls, float2(t3.x, t12.y)).rgb * (w3.x * w12.y) + hdr.sample(ls, float2(t12.x, t3.y)).rgb * (w12.x * w3.y);\n"
"    float wt = w12.x * w0.y + w0.x * w12.y + w12.x * w12.y + w3.x * w12.y + w12.x * w3.y; float3 cr = clamp(acc / wt, lo, hc);\n"
"    o.c = float4(max(cr + k.amount * (cr - avg), 0.0), 1); o.d = zproj(k.M, p, dep.read(uint2(cp)), W, H); return o; }\n"   // 按小数相位补锐化并进同一趟（邻域取 2×2 核心的均值） | Sharpening compensation by fractional phase is folded into the same pass (the neighborhood takes the mean of the 2×2 core)
"  const int2 dirs[8] = { int2(1, 0), int2(-1, 0), int2(0, 1), int2(0, -1), int2(1, 1), int2(-1, 1), int2(1, -1), int2(-1, -1) };\n"
"  float3 sum = 0; float wsum = 0; int bestr = 1000; int2 bests = cp;\n"
"  for (int d = 0; d < 8; d++) for (int r = 1; r <= 24; r++) { int2 s = cp + dirs[d] * (4 * r);\n"
"    if (s.x < 0 || s.y < 0 || s.x > hi.x || s.y > hi.y) break;\n"
"    if (stv(stc, s) & k.hole) continue;\n"
"    float3 v = hdr.read(uint2(s)).rgb; if (max(v.r, max(v.g, v.b)) <= 0) continue;\n"
"    float w = 1.0 / float(r * r); sum += v * w; wsum += w; if (r < bestr) { bestr = r; bests = s; } break; }\n"
"  if (wsum > 0) { o.c = float4(sum / wsum, 1); o.d = zproj(k.M, float2(bests), dep.read(uint2(bests)), W, H); return o; }\n"
"  o.c = float4(hdr.read(uint2(cp)).rgb, 1); o.d = zproj(k.M, p, dep.read(uint2(cp)), W, H); return o;\n"
"}\n";
static int rx_setup(MTLPixelFormat fc, MTLPixelFormat fds) {
    if (getenv("DM_RT_TEST_NOPSO")) return 0;   // 测试：当作这台设备建不出外推管线（验整局退回原画法） | Test: pretend this device cannot build the extrapolation pipeline (verifies the whole run falls back to the original drawing method)
    if (g_rx_pso1 && g_rx_fmt_c == fc && g_rx_fmt_ds == fds) return 1;
    static int failed; if (failed) return 0;
    NSError *e = nil; id<MTLLibrary> lib = [g_dev newLibraryWithSource:@(k_rx_msl) options:nil error:&e];
    if (!lib) { MLOG("【红】运行时外推：着色器编译失败 %s", e.localizedDescription.UTF8String); failed = 1; return 0; }
    MTLRenderPipelineDescriptor *pd = [MTLRenderPipelineDescriptor new]; pd.vertexFunction = [lib newFunctionWithName:@"rx_vs"]; pd.fragmentFunction = [lib newFunctionWithName:@"rx_fs1"];
    pd.colorAttachments[0].pixelFormat = fc; pd.depthAttachmentPixelFormat = fds;
    if (fds == MTLPixelFormatDepth32Float_Stencil8) pd.stencilAttachmentPixelFormat = fds;
    g_rx_pso1 = [g_dev newRenderPipelineStateWithDescriptor:pd error:&e];
    if (!g_rx_pso1) { MLOG("【红】运行时外推：管线建不出 %s", e.localizedDescription.UTF8String); g_rx_pso1 = nil; failed = 1; return 0; }
    MTLDepthStencilDescriptor *dd = [MTLDepthStencilDescriptor new]; dd.depthCompareFunction = MTLCompareFunctionAlways; dd.depthWriteEnabled = YES;
    if (fds == MTLPixelFormatDepth32Float_Stencil8) { MTLStencilDescriptor *sd = [MTLStencilDescriptor new]; sd.stencilCompareFunction = MTLCompareFunctionEqual; sd.readMask = 0x2; sd.writeMask = 0x80; sd.depthStencilPassOperation = MTLStencilOperationReplace;   // 洞 / 屏外新进来的像素由片元导出 0x80，后面 LDR 区域据此重算   // 本帧被界面挡住的像素（界面模板趟已写 0x2）不算 | Hole pixels / pixels newly entering from off-screen get 0x80 exported by the fragment, and the later LDR region is recomputed accordingly   // Pixels covered by this frame's UI (the UI stencil pass already wrote 0x2) do not count
        dd.frontFaceStencil = sd; dd.backFaceStencil = sd; }
    g_rx_dss = [g_dev newDepthStencilStateWithDescriptor:dd];
    if (!g_rx_args) { MTL4ArgumentTableDescriptor *ad = [MTL4ArgumentTableDescriptor new]; ad.maxTextureBindCount = 3; ad.maxBufferBindCount = 1;
        g_rx_args = [g_dev newArgumentTableWithDescriptor:ad error:&e];
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) { g_rx_const[i] = [g_dev newBufferWithLength:256 options:MTLResourceStorageModeShared]; res_add(g_rx_const[i]); } }
    if (!g_rx_args || !g_rx_dss) { MLOG("【红】运行时外推：参数表 / 深度状态建不出"); g_rx_pso1 = nil; failed = 1; return 0; }
    g_rx_fmt_c = fc; g_rx_fmt_ds = fds; MLOG("运行时外推：着色器建好（颜色格式 %lu，深度格式 %lu）", (unsigned long)fc, (unsigned long)fds);
    return 1;
}
static void rx_inv4(const double *m, double *o) {   // 4×4 求逆（伴随矩阵法，双精度） | 4×4 inverse (adjugate method, double precision)
    double inv[16];
    inv[0] = m[5]*m[10]*m[15] - m[5]*m[11]*m[14] - m[9]*m[6]*m[15] + m[9]*m[7]*m[14] + m[13]*m[6]*m[11] - m[13]*m[7]*m[10];
    inv[4] = -m[4]*m[10]*m[15] + m[4]*m[11]*m[14] + m[8]*m[6]*m[15] - m[8]*m[7]*m[14] - m[12]*m[6]*m[11] + m[12]*m[7]*m[10];
    inv[8] = m[4]*m[9]*m[15] - m[4]*m[11]*m[13] - m[8]*m[5]*m[15] + m[8]*m[7]*m[13] + m[12]*m[5]*m[11] - m[12]*m[7]*m[9];
    inv[12] = -m[4]*m[9]*m[14] + m[4]*m[10]*m[13] + m[8]*m[5]*m[14] - m[8]*m[6]*m[13] - m[12]*m[5]*m[10] + m[12]*m[6]*m[9];
    inv[1] = -m[1]*m[10]*m[15] + m[1]*m[11]*m[14] + m[9]*m[2]*m[15] - m[9]*m[3]*m[14] - m[13]*m[2]*m[11] + m[13]*m[3]*m[10];
    inv[5] = m[0]*m[10]*m[15] - m[0]*m[11]*m[14] - m[8]*m[2]*m[15] + m[8]*m[3]*m[14] + m[12]*m[2]*m[11] - m[12]*m[3]*m[10];
    inv[9] = -m[0]*m[9]*m[15] + m[0]*m[11]*m[13] + m[8]*m[1]*m[15] - m[8]*m[3]*m[13] - m[12]*m[1]*m[11] + m[12]*m[3]*m[9];
    inv[13] = m[0]*m[9]*m[14] - m[0]*m[10]*m[13] - m[8]*m[1]*m[14] + m[8]*m[2]*m[13] + m[12]*m[1]*m[10] - m[12]*m[2]*m[9];
    inv[2] = m[1]*m[6]*m[15] - m[1]*m[7]*m[14] - m[5]*m[2]*m[15] + m[5]*m[3]*m[14] + m[13]*m[2]*m[7] - m[13]*m[3]*m[6];
    inv[6] = -m[0]*m[6]*m[15] + m[0]*m[7]*m[14] + m[4]*m[2]*m[15] - m[4]*m[3]*m[14] - m[12]*m[2]*m[7] + m[12]*m[3]*m[6];
    inv[10] = m[0]*m[5]*m[15] - m[0]*m[7]*m[13] - m[4]*m[1]*m[15] + m[4]*m[3]*m[13] + m[12]*m[1]*m[7] - m[12]*m[3]*m[5];
    inv[14] = -m[0]*m[5]*m[14] + m[0]*m[6]*m[13] + m[4]*m[1]*m[14] - m[4]*m[2]*m[13] - m[12]*m[1]*m[6] + m[12]*m[2]*m[5];
    inv[3] = -m[1]*m[6]*m[11] + m[1]*m[7]*m[10] + m[5]*m[2]*m[11] - m[5]*m[3]*m[10] - m[9]*m[2]*m[7] + m[9]*m[3]*m[6];
    inv[7] = m[0]*m[6]*m[11] - m[0]*m[7]*m[10] - m[4]*m[2]*m[11] + m[4]*m[3]*m[10] + m[8]*m[2]*m[7] - m[8]*m[3]*m[6];
    inv[11] = -m[0]*m[5]*m[11] + m[0]*m[7]*m[9] + m[4]*m[1]*m[11] - m[4]*m[3]*m[9] - m[8]*m[1]*m[7] + m[8]*m[3]*m[5];
    inv[15] = m[0]*m[5]*m[10] - m[0]*m[6]*m[9] - m[4]*m[1]*m[10] + m[4]*m[2]*m[9] + m[8]*m[1]*m[6] - m[8]*m[2]*m[5];
    double det = m[0]*inv[0] + m[1]*inv[4] + m[2]*inv[8] + m[3]*inv[12]; det = det != 0 ? 1.0 / det : 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) o[i] = inv[i] * det;
}
int rt_ex_encode(id<MTLTexture> dst_hdr, id<MTLTexture> dst_ds, id<MTLTexture> src_hdr, id<MTLTexture> src_ds,
                 const float vp_prev[16], const float vp_cur[16], uint32_t unit_bits, uint32_t ui_bits) {
    if (!dst_hdr || !dst_ds || !src_hdr || !src_ds || !vp_prev || !vp_cur || !g_cb) return 0;
    if (src_hdr.width != dst_hdr.width || src_hdr.height != dst_hdr.height || src_ds.width != src_hdr.width || src_ds.height != src_hdr.height
        || dst_ds.width != dst_hdr.width || dst_ds.height != dst_hdr.height) return 0;   // 换了分辨率（读取画面 / 动态比例）：这帧不外推 | Resolution changed (loading screen / dynamic scale): no extrapolation this frame
    if (!rx_setup(dst_hdr.pixelFormat, dst_ds.pixelFormat)) return 0;
    if (g_rx_stv_src != src_ds) {
        if (g_rx_stv) defer_obj_release(g_rx_stv);
        g_rx_stv = [src_ds newTextureViewWithPixelFormat:MTLPixelFormatX32_Stencil8];
        if (!g_rx_stv) { static int n; if (!n++) MLOG("【红】运行时外推：开不出模板视图（src_ds 要带 PixelFormatView 用途）"); return 0; }
        res_add(g_rx_stv); g_rx_stv_src = src_ds;
    }
    // 常量：M = inv(vp_prev) · vp_cur（行向量：clip_cur = (ndc_prev, z, 1) · M）；Metal 的 float4x4 按列存，行向量矩阵的第 i 行正好当第 i 列 ⇒ 着色器里写 M * v
    // Constant: M = inv(vp_prev) · vp_cur (row vectors: clip_cur = (ndc_prev, z, 1) · M); Metal's float4x4 is stored by column, and row i of the row-vector matrix serves exactly as column i ⇒ write M * v in the shader
    double a[16], b[16], ia[16], m[16];
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) { a[i] = vp_prev[i]; b[i] = vp_cur[i]; }
    rx_inv4(a, ia);
    for (int r = 0; r < 4; r++) for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) { double s = 0; for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) s += ia[r * 4 + k] * b[k * 4 + c]; m[r * 4 + c] = s; }
    // 小数相位：世界原点（任一点皆可，正交 + 平移全屏一致）在两帧屏幕上的像素位移 d = 目标 − 源；反向映射的源 = 目标 − d
    // Fractional phase: pixel displacement on screen between the two frames of the world origin (any point works; orthographic + translation is uniform across the screen), d = destination − source; the source of the backward mapping = destination − d
    double W = dst_hdr.width, H = dst_hdr.height;
    double c0x = m[12] / m[15], c0y = m[13] / m[15];   // 源 NDC 原点 (0, 0, 0, 1) 投到本帧 | Source NDC origin (0, 0, 0, 1) projected into this frame
    double dx = c0x / 2 * W, dy = -c0y / 2 * H, sx = -dx, sy = -dy;   // 源相对目标的偏移（像素） | Offset of the source relative to the destination (pixels)
    double fx = sx - floor(sx), fy = sy - floor(sy), amount = 0.5 * 2 * (fx * (1 - fx) + fy * (1 - fy));
    float *k = g_rx_const[g_rx_ci].contents;
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) k[i] = (float)m[i];
    ((uint32_t *)k)[16] = unit_bits | ui_bits; k[17] = (float)amount;
    id<MTLBuffer> cbuf = g_rx_const[g_rx_ci]; g_rx_ci = (g_rx_ci + 1) % 3;
    rp_end(); if (g_blit) { enc_b_end(g_blit); g_blit = nil; }
    // 单趟：外推 + 补洞 + 按小数相位补锐化 → dst_hdr；深度写进 dst_ds；本帧界面挡住的像素按模板跳过（模板不写）
    // Single pass: extrapolation + hole filling + sharpening compensation by fractional phase → dst_hdr; depth is written into dst_ds; pixels covered by this frame's UI are skipped by stencil (stencil not written)
    MTL4RenderPassDescriptor *rp = [MTL4RenderPassDescriptor new];
    rp.colorAttachments[0].texture = dst_hdr; rp.colorAttachments[0].loadAction = MTLLoadActionLoad; rp.colorAttachments[0].storeAction = MTLStoreActionStore;
    rp.depthAttachment.texture = dst_ds; rp.depthAttachment.loadAction = MTLLoadActionLoad; rp.depthAttachment.storeAction = MTLStoreActionStore;
    if (dst_ds.pixelFormat == MTLPixelFormatDepth32Float_Stencil8) { rp.stencilAttachment.texture = dst_ds; rp.stencilAttachment.loadAction = MTLLoadActionLoad; rp.stencilAttachment.storeAction = MTLStoreActionStore; }
    id<MTL4RenderCommandEncoder> en = [g_cb renderCommandEncoderWithDescriptor:rp]; if (!en) return 0;
    [en barrierAfterQueueStages:MTLStageAll beforeStages:MTLStageAll visibilityOptions:MTL4VisibilityOptionDevice];
    [en setArgumentTable:g_rx_args atStages:MTLRenderStageFragment];
    [g_rx_args setTexture:src_hdr.gpuResourceID atIndex:0]; [g_rx_args setTexture:src_ds.gpuResourceID atIndex:1]; [g_rx_args setTexture:g_rx_stv.gpuResourceID atIndex:2];
    [g_rx_args setAddress:cbuf.gpuAddress atIndex:0];
    [en setViewport:(MTLViewport){0, 0, W, H, 0, 1}]; [en setRenderPipelineState:g_rx_pso1]; [en setDepthStencilState:g_rx_dss]; [en setStencilReferenceValue:0];
    [en drawPrimitives:MTLPrimitiveTypeTriangle vertexStart:0 vertexCount:3]; m4_end(en);
    args_dirty_all(); g_pso_dirty = g_dss_dirty = 1;
    return 1;
}

// 正交相机下两帧之间整幅平移的像素量（取整）：目标 = 源 + (dx, dy)
// Whole-image translation in pixels between two frames under an orthographic camera (rounded): destination = source + (dx, dy)
static void rt_shift_px(const float vp_prev[16], const float vp_cur[16], double W, double H, int *dx, int *dy) {
    double a[16], b[16], ia[16], m[16];
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) { a[i] = vp_prev[i]; b[i] = vp_cur[i]; }
    rx_inv4(a, ia);
    for (int r = 0; r < 4; r++) for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) { double s = 0; for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) s += ia[r * 4 + k] * b[k * 4 + c]; m[r * 4 + c] = s; }
    *dx = (int)lround(m[12] / m[15] / 2 * W); *dy = (int)lround(-m[13] / m[15] / 2 * H);
}

```

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/nvn_tex.c`:

```c
// NVN 贴图的存储尺寸 / 对齐 / 各级偏移（Tegra X1 块线性布局）。
// 基于 deko3d source/dk_image.cpp（zlib 许可，Copyright (C) 2018-2020 fincs），自动块高按 NVN SDK 的整除规则修正：
//   一个 GOB = 64 字节 × 8 行 = 512 字节；块高（tileH，单位 GOB）按「高度×1.5」挑；各级按块对齐累加。
// 游戏的预排布贴图（SetPackagedTextureLayout）带 8 字节布局参数：第 0 字节 = 块高 log2（真游戏 16 例对照得出，
// 其中 4 例与自动算法不同），有它时以它为准。
// Storage size / alignment / per-level offsets of NVN textures (Tegra X1 block-linear layout).
// Based on deko3d source/dk_image.cpp (zlib license, Copyright (C) 2018-2020 fincs), with NVN SDK integer rounding for automatic tile height:
//   one GOB = 64 bytes × 8 rows = 512 bytes; the block height (tileH, in GOBs) is picked by 'height×1.5'; levels are accumulated with block alignment.
// The game's packaged textures (SetPackagedTextureLayout) carry 8 bytes of layout parameters: byte 0 = log2 of the block height (derived by comparing 16 cases from the real game,
// 4 of which differ from the automatic algorithm); when present it takes precedence.
#include "nvn_tex.h"
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

typedef struct { uint8_t bpb, bw, bh; } fmt_t;   // 每块字节、块宽、块高（非压缩格式块宽高 = 1） | Bytes per block, block width, block height (for uncompressed formats block width and height = 1)

static fmt_t fmt_of(int f) {
    static const uint8_t astc[14][2] = {{4,4},{5,4},{5,5},{6,5},{6,6},{8,5},{8,6},{8,8},{10,5},{10,6},{10,8},{10,10},{12,10},{12,12}};
    if (f >= 0x79 && f <= 0x94) { int k = (f - 0x79) % 14; return (fmt_t){16, astc[k][0], astc[k][1]}; }
    if (f >= 0x41 && f <= 0x50) {                         // DXT / RGTC / BPTC：4×4 块 | DXT / RGTC / BPTC: 4×4 blocks
        int b8 = (f <= 0x42) || (f == 0x45 || f == 0x46) || (f == 0x49 || f == 0x4A);
        return (fmt_t){b8 ? 8 : 16, 4, 4};
    }
    static const struct { uint8_t lo, hi, bpb; } r[] = {
        {0x01,0x04,1},{0x05,0x09,2},{0x0A,0x0C,4},{0x0D,0x10,2},{0x11,0x15,4},{0x16,0x18,8},
        {0x19,0x1C,3},{0x1D,0x21,6},{0x22,0x24,12},{0x25,0x28,4},{0x29,0x2D,8},{0x2E,0x30,16},
        {0x31,0x31,1},{0x32,0x32,2},{0x33,0x35,4},{0x36,0x36,8},{0x37,0x38,4},{0x39,0x3C,2},{0x3D,0x40,4},
        {0x51,0x52,1},{0x53,0x54,2},{0x55,0x56,4},{0x57,0x58,2},{0x59,0x5A,4},{0x5B,0x5C,8},
        {0x5D,0x5E,3},{0x5F,0x60,6},{0x61,0x62,12},{0x63,0x64,4},{0x65,0x66,8},{0x67,0x68,16},
        {0x69,0x6C,4},{0x6D,0x70,4},{0x71,0x75,8},{0x76,0x78,16},{0x95,0x98,2},{0x99,0x9C,4},
    };
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof r / sizeof *r; i++)
        if (f >= r[i].lo && f <= r[i].hi) return (fmt_t){r[i].bpb, 1, 1};
    return (fmt_t){0, 1, 1};
}

int nvn_fmt_bpb(int f, int *bw, int *bh) { fmt_t t = fmt_of(f); if (bw) *bw = t.bw; if (bh) *bh = t.bh; return t.bpb; }

static uint32_t mip(uint32_t s, unsigned l) { s >>= l; return s ? s : 1; }
static uint32_t blk(uint32_t s, uint32_t b) { return (s + b - 1) / b; }
static unsigned pick_tile(uint32_t gobs) { return gobs >= 16 ? 4 : gobs >= 8 ? 3 : gobs >= 4 ? 2 : gobs >= 2 ? 1 : 0; }
static unsigned adj_tile(unsigned shift, uint32_t unit, uint32_t dim) {
    if (!shift) return 0;
    uint32_t x = unit << (shift - 1);
    if (x >= dim) while (--shift) { x >>= 1; if (x < dim) break; }
    return shift;
}

// target：NVNtextureTarget；dims 维数、是否分层由 target 决定
// target: NVNtextureTarget; the number of dims and whether it is layered are determined by target
static void shape(const nvn_texdesc *d, unsigned *dpl, int *layered, uint32_t *w, uint32_t *h, uint32_t *z) {
    *w = d->width; *h = d->height; *z = d->depth; *layered = 0;
    switch (d->target) {
        case 0: *dpl = 1; *h = 1; *z = 1; break;                       // 1D
        case 3: *dpl = 1; *z = d->height; *h = 1; *layered = 1; break; // 1D_ARRAY（层数在 height） | 1D_ARRAY (layer count is in height)
        case 2: *dpl = 3; break;                                        // 3D
        case 4: case 6: *dpl = 2; *layered = 1; break;                  // 2D_ARRAY / MS_ARRAY
        case 8: *dpl = 2; *z = 6; *layered = 1; break;                  // CUBEMAP
        case 9: *dpl = 2; *z = d->depth * 6; *layered = 1; break;       // CUBEMAP_ARRAY
        default: *dpl = 2; *z = 1; break;                               // 2D / MS / RECTANGLE
    }
    if (*z == 0) *z = 1;
}

static void samples_xy(int s, uint32_t *sx, uint32_t *sy) {
    *sx = *sy = 1;
    if (s == 2) *sx = 2; else if (s == 4) *sx = *sy = 2; else if (s == 8) { *sx = 4; *sy = 2; }
}

static uint64_t level_offset(const nvn_texdesc *d, unsigned level, unsigned dpl, uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint32_t z,
                             unsigned tileH, unsigned tileD, fmt_t t) {
    uint32_t sx, sy; samples_xy(d->samples, &sx, &sy);
    uint64_t off = 0;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < level; i++) {
        uint32_t lw = blk(mip(w * sx, i), t.bw);
        uint32_t lh = dpl >= 2 ? blk(mip(h * sy, i), t.bh) : 1;
        uint32_t ld = dpl >= 3 ? mip(z, i) : 1;
        uint32_t lwb = lw * t.bpb;
        unsigned th = adj_tile(tileH, 8, lh), td = adj_tile(tileD, 1, ld);
        uint32_t wg = (lwb + 63) / 64, hg = (lh + 7) / 8;
        uint32_t wt = wg, ht = (hg + (1u << th) - 1) >> th, dt = (ld + (1u << td) - 1) >> td;
        off += (uint64_t)wt * ht * dt << (9 + th + td);
    }
    return off;
}

/* NVN v55 sdk+0x4429c8 compares the default footprint against one-GOB tiles
   for MINIMAL_LAYOUT. Keep the default if equal; otherwise use tile H=D=0.
   Packaged layouts override this choice. Layout cannot be switched on live
   resources: the startup-only knob is a negative control for fresh sessions. */
static int minimal_layout_on(void) {
    static _Atomic int enabled = -1;
    int value = atomic_load(&enabled);
    if (value < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_MINIMAL_LAYOUT"); value = !(e && !strcmp(e, "0")); atomic_store(&enabled, value); }
    return value;
}
static uint64_t layer_bytes(const nvn_texdesc *d, unsigned dpl, int layered,
                            uint32_t w, uint32_t h, uint32_t z, unsigned tileH, unsigned tileD, fmt_t t) {
    uint64_t ls = level_offset(d, d->levels ? d->levels : 1, dpl, w, h, z, tileH, tileD, t);
    if (layered) {
        uint32_t hh = blk(h, t.bh); unsigned th = tileH, td = tileD;
        while (th && hh <= (8u << (th - 1))) th--;
        while (td && z <= (1u << (td - 1))) td--;
        uint64_t align = 1ull << (th + td + 9);
        ls = (ls + align - 1) & ~(align - 1);
    }
    return ls;
}

void nvn_tex_layout(const nvn_texdesc *d, nvn_texlayout *o) {
    fmt_t t = fmt_of(d->format);
    unsigned dpl; int layered; uint32_t w, h, z;
    shape(d, &dpl, &layered, &w, &h, &z);
    uint32_t sx, sy; samples_xy(d->samples, &sx, &sy);
    o->bpb = t.bpb; o->tileH = o->tileD = 0; o->layers = layered ? z : 1;
    if (!t.bpb) { o->size = 0; o->align = 512; o->layer_size = 0; return; }
    if (d->target == 10) {                                            // BUFFER
        o->layer_size = o->size = (uint64_t)t.bpb * d->width;
        o->align = t.bpb == 12 ? 4 : t.bpb; return;
    }
    if (nvn_tex_is_linear(d)) {                                            // Pitch storage: explicit stride, otherwise 32-byte (LINEAR) / 128-byte (LINEAR_RENDER_TARGET) alignment
        o->align = (d->flags & 0x40) ? 128 : 32;
        uint32_t stride = nvn_tex_linear_stride(d);
        o->layer_size = o->size = (uint64_t)stride * blk(h, t.bh);
        return;
    }
    unsigned tileH = 0, tileD = 0;
    /* NVN truncates height*1.5 to whole GOB rows before choosing the power of
       two. Rounding up here changes e.g. 40 BC rows from H2 to H3 even when
       the total allocation size is unchanged, so padding becomes black texels. */
    if (dpl == 2) { uint32_t ah = blk(h * sy, t.bh); tileH = d->pkg_block_h ? (unsigned)d->pkg_block_h - 1 : pick_tile((ah + ah / 2) / 8); }
    else if (dpl == 3) tileD = pick_tile(z + z / 2);
    uint64_t ls = layer_bytes(d, dpl, layered, w, h, z, tileH, tileD, t);
    if ((d->flags & 0x200) && !d->pkg_block_h && minimal_layout_on()) {
        uint64_t minimal = layer_bytes(d, dpl, layered, w, h, z, 0, 0, t);
        if (minimal != ls) { tileH = tileD = 0; ls = minimal; }
    }
    o->tileH = tileH; o->tileD = tileD;
    o->layer_size = ls;
    o->size = layered ? ls * z : ls;
    o->align = 512;
}

uint64_t nvn_tex_level_offset(const nvn_texdesc *d, unsigned level) {
    fmt_t t = fmt_of(d->format);
    unsigned dpl; int layered; uint32_t w, h, z;
    shape(d, &dpl, &layered, &w, &h, &z);
    if (!t.bpb || nvn_tex_is_linear(d) || d->target == 10) return 0;
    nvn_texlayout L; nvn_tex_layout(d, &L);
    return level_offset(d, level, dpl, w, h, z, L.tileH, L.tileD, t);
}

void nvn_tex_level_tiles(const nvn_texdesc *d, unsigned level, unsigned *tileH, unsigned *tileD) {
    fmt_t t = fmt_of(d->format);
    unsigned dpl; int layered; uint32_t w, h, z;
    shape(d, &dpl, &layered, &w, &h, &z);
    uint32_t sx, sy; samples_xy(d->samples, &sx, &sy);
    nvn_texlayout L; nvn_tex_layout(d, &L);
    uint32_t lh = dpl >= 2 ? blk(mip(h * sy, level), t.bh) : 1;
    uint32_t ld = dpl >= 3 ? mip(z, level) : 1;
    *tileH = adj_tile(L.tileH, 8, lh);
    *tileD = adj_tile(L.tileD, 1, ld);
}

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/nvn_tex.h`:

```h
// NVN 贴图存储布局（Tegra X1 块线性），见 nvn_tex.c。
// NVN texture storage layout (Tegra X1 block-linear), see nvn_tex.c.
#pragma once
#include <stdint.h>

typedef struct {
    int target, format, flags, samples;   // NVNtextureTarget / NVNformat / NVNtextureFlags / 采样数（0 或 1 = 单采样） | NVNtextureTarget / NVNformat / NVNtextureFlags / sample count (0 or 1 = single-sampled)
    uint32_t width, height, depth, levels, stride;
    signed int pkg_block_h:8; unsigned int swizzle_r:3,swizzle_g:3,swizzle_b:3,swizzle_a:3,swizzle_pad:12;                      // 预排布贴图布局参数第 0 字节（块高 log2）+ 1；0 = 按自动算法 | Byte 0 of the packaged texture layout parameters (log2 of block height) + 1; 0 = use the automatic algorithm
} nvn_texdesc;

typedef struct {
    uint64_t size, layer_size;            // 总存储字节、每层字节 | Total storage bytes, bytes per layer
    uint32_t align, layers, bpb;          // 对齐、层数、每块字节 | Alignment, layer count, bytes per block
    unsigned tileH, tileD;                // 块高 / 块深（log2 GOB 数） | Block height / block depth (log2 of the GOB count)
} nvn_texlayout;

void nvn_tex_layout(const nvn_texdesc *d, nvn_texlayout *o);
uint64_t nvn_tex_level_offset(const nvn_texdesc *d, unsigned level);
int nvn_fmt_bpb(int format, int *bw, int *bh);   // 每块字节（0 = 未知格式），块宽高 | Bytes per block (0 = unknown format), block width and height
// 第 level 级实际使用的块高 / 块深（log2 GOB 数）：贴图级块高按该级行数（块行）收缩，解排布逐级用它
// Block height / block depth actually used by level `level` (log2 of the GOB count): the per-level block height shrinks with that level's row count (block rows), and deswizzling uses it level by level
void nvn_tex_level_tiles(const nvn_texdesc *d, unsigned level, unsigned *tileH, unsigned *tileD);

/* LINEAR_RENDER_TARGET (0x40) uses pitch storage even without LINEAR (0x10).
   TOTK's CPU-loaded water height/mask textures use that flag alone. */
static inline int nvn_tex_is_linear(const nvn_texdesc *d) { return (d->flags & 0x50) != 0; }
static inline uint32_t nvn_tex_linear_stride(const nvn_texdesc *d) {
    if (d->stride) return d->stride;
    int bw, bh; int bpb = nvn_fmt_bpb(d->format, &bw, &bh);
    uint32_t align = (d->flags & 0x40) ? 128 : 32;
    return (((d->width + bw - 1) / bw) * bpb + align - 1) & ~(align - 1);
}

/* Included by nvn_mtl.m: production encode_args, descriptor publication and GPU
   pixel checks. Inputs are immutable until mtl_finish. Probe caches stay isolated. */
int mtl_probe_tex_slots(void) {
    mtl_init(); int checked = 0;
    const char *ne = getenv("TOTK_PROBE_NEGATIVE"); int negative = ne ? atoi(ne) : 0;
    void *mem = NULL;
    if (posix_memalign(&mem, 16384, 16384) || !mem) MDIE("texture slots probe memory");
    memset(mem, 0, 16384); mtl_pool_add(mem, 16384);
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) ((float *)((uint8_t *)mem + 16*i))[0] = i & 1 ? .75f : .25f;
    const uint8_t pixels[3][8] = {{64,128,192,255,192,64,128,255},
        {32,96,160,255,160,32,96,255}, {96,160,32,255,32,96,160,255}};
    samp_par clamp = {.lod_max=16,.aniso=1}, repeat = clamp; repeat.ws = 1;

    td.storageMode = MTLStorageModePrivate; td.usage = MTLTextureUsageRenderTarget;
    output = [g_dev newTextureWithDescriptor:td]; res_add(output);
    op_hdr end = {OP_END,8};
    for (int kind = 0; kind < 3; kind++) {
        tex_t textures[2] = {0};
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            if (kind == 2) {
                memcpy((uint8_t *)typed.contents + i*256, pixels[i], 8);
                MTLTextureDescriptor *d = [MTLTextureDescriptor textureBufferDescriptorWithPixelFormat:MTLPixelFormatRGBA8Unorm width:2 resourceOptions:MTLResourceStorageModeShared usage:MTLTextureUsageShaderRead];
                sources[i] = [typed newTextureWithDescriptor:d offset:i*256 bytesPerRow:256];
            } else {
                MTLTextureDescriptor *d = [MTLTextureDescriptor texture2DDescriptorWithPixelFormat:MTLPixelFormatRGBA8Unorm width:2 height:1 mipmapped:NO];
                d.storageMode = MTLStorageModeShared; d.usage = MTLTextureUsageShaderRead | MTLTextureUsagePixelFormatView;

                [sources[i] replaceRegion:MTLRegionMake2D(0,0,2,1) mipmapLevel:0 withBytes:pixels[i] bytesPerRow:8];
            }
            if (!sources[i]) MDIE("texture slots probe resource"); res_add(sources[i]);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            textures[i].serial = 0xffffe100 + kind*4 + i;
            textures[i].d = (nvn_texdesc){.width=2,.height=1,.depth=1,.levels=1,.format=0x25,.target=kind==2?10:1,
                .swizzle_r=2,.swizzle_g=3,.swizzle_b=4,.swizzle_a=5};
        }
        NSString *fields = kind == 2 ? @"texture_buffer<float> t [[id(0)]]; constant float *u [[id(1)]];" :
            [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%@<float> t [[id(0)]]; sampler a [[id(1)]]; sampler b [[id(2)]]; constant float *u [[id(3)]];",kind ? @"texture2d_array" : @"texture2d"];
        NSString *body = kind == 2 ? @"return float4(a.t.read(0u).rgb,a.u[0]);" :
            [NSString stringWithFormat:@"return float4(a.t.sample(a.a,float2(1.25,0.5)%@).r,a.t.sample(a.b,float2(1.25,0.5)%@).g,a.t.read(uint2(0,0)%@).b,a.u[0]);",kind?@",0":@"",kind?@",0":@"",kind?@",0":@""];
        NSString *source = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"#include <metal_stdlib>\nusing namespace metal; struct A {%@}; vertex float4 vs(uint i [[vertex_id]]){float2 p[3]={float2(-1,-1),float2(3,-1),float2(-1,3)};return float4(p[i],0,1);} fragment float4 fa(constant A &a [[buffer(0)]]){%@} fragment float4 fb(constant A &a [[buffer(0)]]){%@}",fields,body,body];
        id<MTLLibrary> lib = [g_dev newLibraryWithSource:source options:nil error:&error];
        if (!lib) MDIE("texture slots probe shader: %s",error.localizedDescription.UTF8String);
        NvShader *shaders[2]; id<MTLRenderPipelineState> pipelines[2]; prog_t programs[2] = {0};
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            NvShader *sh = [NvShader new]; shaders[i] = sh; sh->fn = [lib newFunctionWithName:i?@"fb":@"fa"]; sh->stage=1;
            snprintf(sh->key,sizeof sh->key,"probe-tex-slots-%d-%d",kind,i);
            sh->rf.nb = kind==2?2:4;
            sh->rf.b[0]=(nvn_rbind){.kind=kind==2?NVN_RB_TBUF:NVN_RB_TEX,.aid=0,.reg=0,.dtt=kind?MTLTextureType2DArray:MTLTextureType2D};
            if(kind!=2) {
                sh->rf.b[1]=(nvn_rbind){.kind=NVN_RB_SAMPT,.aid=1,.reg=0};
                sh->rf.b[2]=(nvn_rbind){.kind=NVN_RB_SAMP,.aid=2,.reg=0};
            }
            sh->rf.b[sh->rf.nb-1]=(nvn_rbind){.kind=NVN_RB_CBUF,.aid=sh->rf.nb-1,.reg=0};
            sh->ae=[sh->fn newArgumentEncoderWithBufferIndex:0]; sh->arg_len=sh->ae.encodedLength;
            if(sh->arg_len != (NSUInteger)sh->rf.nb*8) MDIE("texture slots probe argument ABI");

            pipelines[i]=[g_dev newRenderPipelineStateWithDescriptor:pd error:&error];

        }
        for(int mode=0;mode<3;mode++) for(int submission=0;submission<2;submission++) {

            id<MTL4RenderCommandEncoder> en=enc_r_begin(rp);enc_r_cull(en,MTLCullModeNone);enc_r_viewport(en,(MTLViewport){0,0,64,8,0,1});
            p_bind_handles tex={.stage=1,.n=1,.h={51|(UINT64_C(61)<<20)}},samp={.stage=1,.n=1,.h={UINT64_C(61)<<20}};
            for(int stripe=0;stripe<16;stripe++) {
                int shader=stripe==2?1:0;
                if(stripe==4){tex.h[0]=52|(UINT64_C(61)<<20);current=1;}

                if(stripe==7){mtl_reg_tex(52,&textures[0],NULL);current=0;}
                if(stripe==9){serial_put(textures[0].serial,sources[2]);current=2;}
                if(stripe==10){mtl_reg_samp(62,&clamp);combined=separate=0;}
                if(stripe==11){tex.h[0]=0;unbound=1;}
                if(stripe==12){tex.h[0]=51|(UINT64_C(61)<<20);unbound=0;}

                p_bind_program program={&programs[shader],0x1f};state_op(OP_BIND_PROGRAM,&program);
                p_bind_buf u={1,0,(uint64_t)(uintptr_t)mem+16*stripe,16};state_op(OP_BIND_UBO,&u);
                state_op(OP_BIND_TEX,&tex);state_op(OP_BIND_SAMP,&samp);

                enc_r_pso(en,pipelines[shader]);enc_r_scissor(en,(MTLScissorRect){stripe*4,0,4,8});
                encode_args((id<MTLCommandEncoder>)en,shaders[shader],1,0);enc_r_draw(en,MTLPrimitiveTypeTriangle,0,3);
                if(mode && !negative && (stripe==1||stripe==3||stripe==8||stripe==15) && g_tex_slots_hits<=hits) MDIE("texture slots probe did not exercise reuse kind%d stripe%d",kind,stripe);
                if(mode && !negative && (stripe==7||stripe==9||stripe==10||stripe==14) && g_tex_slots_hits!=hits) MDIE("texture slots probe failed invalidation kind%d stripe%d",kind,stripe);
                for(int y=0;y<8;y++)for(int x=stripe*4;x<stripe*4+4;x++) {
                    uint8_t *p=expected+(y*64+x)*4;
                    p[0]=unbound?0:pixels[current][kind==2||combined?0:4];

                }
                checked++;
            }
            enc_r_end(en);enc_b_copy_texture_buffer(blit(),output,0,0,MTLOriginMake(0,0,0),MTLSizeMake(64,8,1),rb,0,256,2048);mtl_sub_commit();mtl_finish();
            for(int i=0;i<2048;i++){if(abs((int)((uint8_t *)rb.contents)[i]-expected[i])>1) MDIE("texture slots probe GPU mismatch kind%d mode%d stripe%d channel%d got%d want%d",kind,mode,(i/4)%64/4,i%4,((uint8_t *)rb.contents)[i],expected[i]);checked++;}
            (void)sampler0;(void)sampler1;
        }
        for(int i=0;i<2;i++){mtl_reg_tex(51+i,NULL,NULL);serial_del(textures[i].serial);}
        for(int i=0;i<3;i++)res_remove(sources[i]);
    }
    if(!g_tex_slots_hits||!g_tex_slots_verified) MDIE("texture slots probe missed cache/shadow paths");
    MLOG("texture slots probe: hits=%llu verified=%llu",(unsigned long long)g_tex_slots_hits,(unsigned long long)g_tex_slots_verified);
    atomic_store(&g_tex_slots_on,0);atomic_store(&g_tex_slots_check,0);g_tex_slots_negative=0;
    memset(&S,0,sizeof S);args_dirty_all();mtl_pool_del(mem);free(mem);res_remove(typed);res_remove(rb);res_remove(output);
    return checked;
}

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/nvn_texture_plan.h`:

```h
#pragma once
#include "nvn_refl.h"

/* Immutable shader metadata only. Slots 0..127 are texture handles and 128..159
   are image handles. Preserve order and duplicates: resolving a texture may
   upload it or request an encoder split. Never cache the handle or its view. */
static inline unsigned nvn_texture_plan(const nvn_refl *rf, uint16_t slots[NVN_REFL_MAXB]) {
    unsigned n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < rf->nb; i++) {
        const nvn_rbind *b = &rf->b[i];
        if ((b->kind == NVN_RB_TEX || b->kind == NVN_RB_TBUF) && b->reg < 128)
            slots[n++] = b->reg;
        else if (b->kind == NVN_RB_IMG && b->reg < 32)
            slots[n++] = 128 + b->reg;
    }
    return n;
}
