// Per game frame, from the replay: the scene copy (the canvas copied before the first UI draw, in the canvas format),
// the UI layer (colour attachment 7 of the later canvas passes), the G-buffer depth and the camera block (84 floats of
// the 2368-byte block at vertex uniform 1).
id<MTLTexture> mfx_scene_target(id<MTLDevice> dev, NSUInteger w, NSUInteger h, MTLPixelFormat format);
id<MTLTexture> mfx_ui_target(id<MTLDevice> dev, NSUInteger w, NSUInteger h);
void mfx_note_scene(void);
void mfx_note_depth(id<MTLTexture> depth);
void mfx_note_camera(const float *cam, int n);
id<MTLResidencySet> mfx_residency(void);   // our textures; the queue adds it once
// At the game's present. prepare: checks this frame's inputs and returns the output slot of the interpolated frame
// between the previous and this frame, or -1 (first frame, missing input, scene cut; state already advanced). frame_s:
// the pacing period (two display refreshes; 0 in unpaced measurement runs). encode: motion vectors and the interpolation into cb (Metal 4, own command buffer, GPU order after this
// frame). abort: a prepared frame that cannot be encoded (no free command buffer); drops the history.
int mfx_frame_prepare(double frame_s);
// Keep the returned resources alive until this command buffer's GPU completion.
// Cached interpolators drop their public texture bindings after encoding.
NSArray *mfx_frame_encode(id<MTL4CommandBuffer> cb, int slot, id<MTL4CounterHeap> heap, NSUInteger stamp);   // heap: timestamps at stamp / stamp+1 around MetalFX (may be nil)
void mfx_note_gpu(double ms);   // GPU time of one interpolation, for the statistics line
void mfx_frame_abort(void);
id<MTLTexture> mfx_output(int slot);   // RGBA8Unorm view of the sRGB output, like the swapchain textures
void mfx_stats(char *out, size_t n);
void mfx_mv_log(void);
int mfx_dump_due(void);
void mfx_dump(long frame, id<MTLTexture> swap_prev, id<MTLTexture> swap_cur);   // TOTK_MFX_DUMP=<dir>: scenes, depth, motion and output of three frames while the camera turns (diagnostic)   // TOTK_MFX_MVLOG=<n>: motion texture median every n interpolated frames (diagnostic)

```

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/totk_mfx.m`:

```m
// Odyssey: optional 60+60 MetalFX interpolation on a 120 Hz screen (key 2 or TOTK_MFX=interp).
// Other refresh rates keep the 60 Hz guest clock and suspend generation. Disabled by default.
// The replay (nvn_mtl.m) hands over per game frame:
//  - the scene before the UI: the canvas copied before the first UI draw (docked the upscaled 1600x900 scene, handheld the
//    1280x720 scene drawn in the canvas itself);
//  - the UI drawn over it: attachment 7 of the later canvas passes, premultiplied (the game's colour blend, alpha
//    accumulating coverage);
//  - the G-buffer depth (D32F, not reversed, infinite far plane) and the camera block.
// Motion vectors come from the camera only: depth plus this and the previous frame's view-projection. MetalFX refines
// motion itself (tests/metalfx_interp: zero motion still 36 dB), but what moves with the camera (Link) gets the
// background's camera motion. Conventions measured by the probe: motion in pixels of the motion texture, pointing to the
// previous position; the UI given apart and premultiplied (the "composited" mode returns a black frame).
#import <MetalFX/MetalFX.h>
#import <QuartzCore/QuartzCore.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "totk_mfx.h"
#include "odyssey_mfx.h"
extern int mtl_display_hz(void);

#define MLOG(...) do { fprintf(stderr, "[dm] [nvn-mtl] [mfx] " __VA_ARGS__); fputc('\n', stderr); } while (0)
#define MDIE(...) do { MLOG("FATAL " __VA_ARGS__); abort(); } while (0)

#define MFX_OUT 3
static struct {
    id<MTLDevice> dev;
    id<MTL4FXFrameInterpolator> fi;
    NSUInteger in_w, in_h, out_w, out_h; MTLPixelFormat scene_fmt;
    id<MTLTexture> scene[2], ui, mv, out[MFX_OUT], outv[MFX_OUT];
    id<MTLResidencySet> rs;
    id<MTLComputePipelineState> mv_ps;
    id<MTL4ArgumentTable> mv_args[MFX_OUT];
    id<MTLBuffer> mv_par[MFX_OUT];
    id<MTLFence> fence;
    int cur;                       // scene[cur] is written by this frame
    int scene_ok, cam_ok;          // this frame
    __weak id<MTLTexture> depth;   // this frame's G-buffer depth (owned by the game's texture table)
    double cam[84], prev_cam[84];
    int prev_ok, hist_ok, slot;    // prev_ok: scene[cur ^ 1] / prev_cam hold the previous frame; hist_ok: MetalFX saw it
    double yflip;                  // clip-space y of the game: +1 = top row (TOTK_MFX_YFLIP=-1 tries the other way)
    id<MTLTexture> enc_depth;      // depth of a prepared frame, until it is encoded
    int scene_ok_was, cam_ok_was;
    double mv_prev_yaw;
    id<MTLTexture> last_depth;     // for mfx_dump
    int last_slot;
    uint64_t frames, made, skip_input, skip_first, skip_cut, skip_busy, miss[4];   // miss: scene, camera, depth, UI
    double gpu_ms[300]; int ngpu;   // GPU time of the last interpolations (MetalFX part)
    double last_prepare_s, dt;      // time of the previous game frame's prepare; this pair's interval (MetalFX deltaTime)
} g;

/* Reconstructing identical MetalFX interpolators repeatedly grows device
 * allocations on the tested Mac, even after the old Objective-C object dies.
 * Keep a bounded set of exact configurations without eviction/rebuild churn.
 * In-flight frames retain their own resource payload independently of the
 * cache. Once full, new configurations use the previous uncached path. This does not establish or
 * fix every source of long-session memory growth. Diagnostic opt-out below. */
#define MFX_FI_CACHE 4
static id<MTL4FXFrameInterpolator> g_fi_cache[MFX_FI_CACHE];
static unsigned g_fi_cache_count;
static int fi_cache_on(void) {
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_MFX_FI_CACHE"); on = !e || strcmp(e, "0"); }
    return on;
}
static id<MTL4FXFrameInterpolator> fi_cached(NSUInteger iw, NSUInteger ih) {
    if (!fi_cache_on()) return nil;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < g_fi_cache_count; i++) {
        id<MTL4FXFrameInterpolator> fi = g_fi_cache[i];
        if (fi.inputWidth == iw && fi.inputHeight == ih && fi.outputWidth == g.out_w &&
            fi.outputHeight == g.out_h && fi.colorTextureFormat == g.scene_fmt) {
            MLOG("reuse cached interpolator %u: %lux%lu -> %lux%lu; reset history", i,
                 (unsigned long)iw, (unsigned long)ih, (unsigned long)g.out_w, (unsigned long)g.out_h);
            return fi;
        }
    }
    return nil;
}

/* g_on: the mode of this game frame (read by the replay, the present path and the pacing in hle_nvn.c); g_req: what the
   user asked for (key 2 / flag mfx_interp), taken over at the next present. */
static _Atomic int g_on, g_req;
static pthread_once_t g_once = PTHREAD_ONCE_INIT;
const char *mfx_mode_name(int m) {
    static const char *const names[MFX_NMODES] = {"off", "30+30 (the game at 30 fps)", "60+60 (120 Hz display)", "uncapped (every game frame interpolated)"};
    return m >= 0 && m < MFX_NMODES ? names[m] : "?";
}
static void mfx_init(void) {
    const char *e = getenv("TOTK_MFX"); int v;
    if (!e || !*e || !strcmp(e, "0")) v = MFX_OFF;
    else if (!strcmp(e, "interp30")) v = MFX_30;
    else if (!strcmp(e, "interp")) v = MFX_HALF;
    else if (!strcmp(e, "interpmax")) v = MFX_MAX;
    else MDIE("TOTK_MFX must be interp30, interp, interpmax or 0, got %s", e);
    /* All nonzero legacy requests mean 60+60 here; never 30 Hz or uncapped logic. */
    atomic_store(&g_req, v ? MFX_HALF : MFX_OFF); atomic_store(&g_on, MFX_OFF);
    if (v) MLOG("TOTK_MFX=%s: request 60+60; waiting for a 120 Hz window screen", e);
}
int mfx_enabled(void) { pthread_once(&g_once, mfx_init); return atomic_load_explicit(&g_on, memory_order_relaxed); }
void mfx_set(int m) {
    pthread_once(&g_once, mfx_init);
    if (m >= MFX_NMODES) { MLOG("[flag] mfx_interp takes 0..%d (-1 cycles), got %d", MFX_NMODES - 1, m); return; }
    int v = m < 0 ? (atomic_load(&g_req) ? MFX_OFF : MFX_HALF) : m ? MFX_HALF : MFX_OFF;
    atomic_store(&g_req, v);
    MLOG("[flag] mfx_interp = %d: %s (from the next game frame)", v, mfx_mode_name(v));
}
int mfx_latch(void) {
    pthread_once(&g_once, mfx_init);
    int r = odyssey_mfx_mode(atomic_load(&g_req), mtl_display_hz()), was = atomic_load(&g_on);
    if (r) {
        static int supported = -1;
        if (supported < 0) supported = [MTLFXFrameInterpolatorDescriptor supportsMetal4FX:MTLCreateSystemDefaultDevice()];
        if (!supported) r = MFX_OFF;
    }
    if (r == was) return 0;
    g.prev_ok = g.hist_ok = 0; g.scene_ok = g.cam_ok = 0; g.depth = nil; g.last_prepare_s = 0;   // the next interpolated pair starts fresh
    atomic_store(&g_on, r);
    MLOG("frame interpolation %s -> %s", mfx_mode_name(was), mfx_mode_name(r));
    return 1;
}

static id<MTLTexture> mk(MTLPixelFormat f, NSUInteger w, NSUInteger h, MTLTextureUsage u) {
    MTLTextureDescriptor *d = [MTLTextureDescriptor texture2DDescriptorWithPixelFormat:f width:w height:h mipmapped:NO];
    d.usage = u; d.storageMode = MTLStorageModePrivate;
    id<MTLTexture> t = [g.dev newTextureWithDescriptor:d];
    if (!t) MDIE("texture %lux%lu format %lu", (unsigned long)w, (unsigned long)h, (unsigned long)f);
    if (!g.rs) { NSError *e = nil; g.rs = [g.dev newResidencySetWithDescriptor:[MTLResidencySetDescriptor new] error:&e]; if (!g.rs) MDIE("residency set: %s", e.localizedDescription.UTF8String); }
    [g.rs addAllocation:t]; [g.rs commit];
    return t;
}
static void drop(id<MTLTexture> __strong *t) { if (*t) { [g.rs removeAllocation:*t]; *t = nil; } }

// Scene / UI / output textures follow the canvas size; the interpolator also depends on the depth size.
static void ensure_out(id<MTLDevice> dev, NSUInteger w, NSUInteger h, MTLPixelFormat fmt) {
    if (!g.dev) g.dev = dev;
    if (g.out_w == w && g.out_h == h && g.scene[0] && (!fmt || fmt == g.scene_fmt)) return;
    if (!fmt) fmt = g.scene_fmt ? g.scene_fmt : MTLPixelFormatRG11B10Float;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) drop(&g.scene[i]);
    drop(&g.ui);
    for (int i = 0; i < MFX_OUT; i++) { drop(&g.out[i]); g.outv[i] = nil; }
    MTLTextureUsage rt = MTLTextureUsageRenderTarget | MTLTextureUsageShaderRead;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) g.scene[i] = mk(fmt, w, h, MTLTextureUsageShaderRead);   // blit copies of the canvas
    g.scene_fmt = fmt;
    g.ui = mk(MTLPixelFormatRGBA16Float, w, h, rt);
    for (int i = 0; i < MFX_OUT; i++) {
        g.out[i] = mk(MTLPixelFormatRGBA8Unorm_sRGB, w, h, MTLTextureUsageShaderWrite | MTLTextureUsageShaderRead | MTLTextureUsageRenderTarget | MTLTextureUsagePixelFormatView);
        g.outv[i] = [g.out[i] newTextureViewWithPixelFormat:MTLPixelFormatRGBA8Unorm];
    }
    g.out_w = w; g.out_h = h; g.fi = nil; g.prev_ok = g.hist_ok = 0;
    MLOG("scene (format %lu) / UI / output textures %lux%lu", (unsigned long)fmt, (unsigned long)w, (unsigned long)h);
}
id<MTLTexture> mfx_scene_target(id<MTLDevice> dev, NSUInteger w, NSUInteger h, MTLPixelFormat fmt) { ensure_out(dev, w, h, fmt); return g.scene[g.cur]; }
id<MTLTexture> mfx_ui_target(id<MTLDevice> dev, NSUInteger w, NSUInteger h) { ensure_out(dev, w, h, 0); return g.ui; }
id<MTLResidencySet> mfx_residency(void) { return g.rs; }
void mfx_note_scene(void) { g.scene_ok = 1; }
void mfx_note_depth(id<MTLTexture> d) { if (d && d.pixelFormat == MTLPixelFormatDepth32Float && d.textureType == MTLTextureType2D) g.depth = d; }
void mfx_note_camera(const float *c, int n) {
    if (n < 84) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < 84; i++) g.cam[i] = c[i];
    g.cam_ok = c[56] > 0 && c[57] > c[56] && c[62] > 0 && c[70] > 0;   // near, far, aspect, vertical field of view (radians)
}

static void ensure_fi(NSUInteger iw, NSUInteger ih) {
    if (g.fi && g.in_w == iw && g.in_h == ih && g.fi.colorTextureFormat == g.scene_fmt && g.fi.outputWidth == g.out_w && g.fi.outputHeight == g.out_h) return;
    NSError *e = nil;
    g.fi = fi_cached(iw, ih);
    if (!g.fi) {
        MTLFXFrameInterpolatorDescriptor *d = [MTLFXFrameInterpolatorDescriptor new];
        d.colorTextureFormat = g.scene_fmt; d.outputTextureFormat = MTLPixelFormatRGBA8Unorm_sRGB;
        d.depthTextureFormat = MTLPixelFormatDepth32Float; d.motionTextureFormat = MTLPixelFormatRG16Float; d.uiTextureFormat = MTLPixelFormatRGBA16Float;
        d.inputWidth = iw; d.inputHeight = ih; d.outputWidth = g.out_w; d.outputHeight = g.out_h;
        id<MTL4Compiler> comp = [g.dev newCompilerWithDescriptor:[MTL4CompilerDescriptor new] error:&e];
        if (!comp) MDIE("MTL4 compiler: %s", e.localizedDescription.UTF8String);
        if (![MTLFXFrameInterpolatorDescriptor supportsMetal4FX:g.dev]) MDIE("this GPU has no Metal 4 MetalFX frame interpolation");
        g.fi = [d newFrameInterpolatorWithDevice:g.dev compiler:comp];
        if (!g.fi) MDIE("frame interpolator %lux%lu -> %lux%lu not created", (unsigned long)iw, (unsigned long)ih, (unsigned long)g.out_w, (unsigned long)g.out_h);
        if (fi_cache_on() && g_fi_cache_count < MFX_FI_CACHE) g_fi_cache[g_fi_cache_count++] = g.fi;
    }
    drop(&g.mv); g.mv = mk(MTLPixelFormatRG16Float, iw, ih, MTLTextureUsageShaderWrite | MTLTextureUsageShaderRead);
    if (!g.mv_ps) {
        static const char *src =
            "#include <metal_stdlib>\nusing namespace metal;\n"
            "struct P { float4x4 reproj; float2 size; float2 inv_size; float yflip; float pad0, pad1, pad2; };\n"
            // camera motion of each depth pixel: where it was in the previous frame, in pixels of this texture
            "kernel void mfx_mv(depth2d<float, access::read> d [[texture(0)]], texture2d<float, access::write> mv [[texture(1)]],\n"
            "                   constant P &p [[buffer(0)]], uint2 g [[thread_position_in_grid]]) {\n"
            "  if (g.x >= uint(p.size.x) || g.y >= uint(p.size.y)) return;\n"
            "  float2 uv = (float2(g) + 0.5) * p.inv_size;\n"
            "  float4 c = p.reproj * float4(uv.x * 2.0 - 1.0, p.yflip * (1.0 - uv.y * 2.0), d.read(g) * 2.0 - 1.0, 1.0);\n"
            "  float2 m = 0.0;\n"
            "  if (c.w > 1e-7) { float2 n = c.xy / c.w; m = (float2(n.x * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.5 - 0.5 * p.yflip * n.y) - uv) * p.size; }\n"
            "  if (any(isnan(m)) || any(isinf(m))) m = 0.0;\n"
            "  mv.write(float4(m, 0.0, 0.0), g);\n"
            "}\n";
        MTLCompileOptions *o = [MTLCompileOptions new]; o.mathMode = MTLMathModeSafe;
        id<MTLLibrary> lib = [g.dev newLibraryWithSource:@(src) options:o error:&e];
        id<MTLFunction> fn = lib ? [lib newFunctionWithName:@"mfx_mv"] : nil;
        g.mv_ps = fn ? [g.dev newComputePipelineStateWithFunction:fn error:&e] : nil;
        if (!g.mv_ps) MDIE("motion vector kernel: %s", e.localizedDescription.UTF8String);
        MTL4ArgumentTableDescriptor *ad = [MTL4ArgumentTableDescriptor new]; ad.maxBufferBindCount = 1; ad.maxTextureBindCount = 2;
        for (int i = 0; i < MFX_OUT; i++) {
            g.mv_args[i] = [g.dev newArgumentTableWithDescriptor:ad error:&e]; if (!g.mv_args[i]) MDIE("argument table: %s", e.localizedDescription.UTF8String);
            g.mv_par[i] = [g.dev newBufferWithLength:256 options:MTLResourceStorageModeShared]; [g.rs addAllocation:g.mv_par[i]];
        }
        [g.rs commit];
        g.fence = [g.dev newFence];
        const char *yf = getenv("TOTK_MFX_YFLIP"); g.yflip = yf ? atof(yf) : 1.0;   // diagnostic: -1 tries the other clip-space y convention
    }
    g.in_w = iw; g.in_h = ih; g.prev_ok = g.hist_ok = 0;
    MLOG("frame interpolator: depth / motion %lux%lu -> %lux%lu (scene format %lu, output RGBA8 sRGB, UI RGBA16F premultiplied)", (unsigned long)iw, (unsigned long)ih, (unsigned long)g.out_w, (unsigned long)g.out_h, (unsigned long)g.scene_fmt);
}

// 4x4 inverse (Gauss-Jordan, partial pivoting) and product, row-major, in double: the view-projection matrices hold
// world coordinates in the thousands, and only the combined reprojection goes to the GPU in float.
static int inv4(const double a_[16], double r[16]) {
    double a[16]; memcpy(a, a_, sizeof a);
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) r[i] = i % 5 == 0;
    for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
        int p = c; for (int k = c + 1; k < 4; k++) if (fabs(a[k * 4 + c]) > fabs(a[p * 4 + c])) p = k;
        if (fabs(a[p * 4 + c]) < 1e-12) return 0;
        if (p != c) for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) { double t = a[c * 4 + k]; a[c * 4 + k] = a[p * 4 + k]; a[p * 4 + k] = t; t = r[c * 4 + k]; r[c * 4 + k] = r[p * 4 + k]; r[p * 4 + k] = t; }
        double s = 1.0 / a[c * 4 + c];
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) { a[c * 4 + k] *= s; r[c * 4 + k] *= s; }
        for (int q = 0; q < 4; q++) if (q != c) { double f = a[q * 4 + c]; if (f != 0) for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) { a[q * 4 + k] -= f * a[c * 4 + k]; r[q * 4 + k] -= f * r[c * 4 + k]; } }
    }
    return 1;
}
static void mul4(const double a[16], const double b[16], double r[16]) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) { double s = 0; for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) s += a[i * 4 + k] * b[k * 4 + j]; r[i * 4 + j] = s; }
}
// A camera jump (teleport, cutscene cut) or a turn of more than 25 degrees in one game frame is not interpolated.
static int dcmp_mfx(const void *a, const void *b) { double x = *(const double *)a, y = *(const double *)b; return (x > y) - (x < y); }
/* Diagnostic (PR #568 review: the evidence for 800 cm): the camera's step and turn per game frame, p50 / p99 / max over
   600 frames, and every cut found (the first 20), so the threshold can be set from play rather than assumed. */
static void camera_step_note(int cut) {
    enum { N = 600 };
    static double step[N], turn[N]; static int n, cuts_said;
    double x = g.cam[47] - g.prev_cam[47], y = g.cam[51] - g.prev_cam[51], z = g.cam[55] - g.prev_cam[55];
    double f = g.cam[8] * g.prev_cam[8] + g.cam[9] * g.prev_cam[9] + g.cam[10] * g.prev_cam[10];
    double d = sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z), a = acos(f < -1 ? -1 : f > 1 ? 1 : f) * 180 / M_PI;
    if (cut && cuts_said < 20) { cuts_said++; MLOG("camera cut at game frame %llu: step %.0f cm, turn %.1f deg", (unsigned long long)g.frames, d, a); }
    if (!isfinite(d + a)) return;
    step[n] = d; turn[n] = a;
    if (++n < N) return;
    n = 0; qsort(step, N, sizeof *step, dcmp_mfx); qsort(turn, N, sizeof *turn, dcmp_mfx);
    MLOG("camera per game frame (last %d): step p50 %.1f / p99 %.1f / max %.1f cm; turn p50 %.2f / p99 %.2f / max %.2f deg",
         N, step[N / 2], step[N * 99 / 100], step[N - 1], turn[N / 2], turn[N * 99 / 100], turn[N - 1]);
}
static int camera_cut(void) {
    int cut = odyssey_mfx_cut(g.cam, g.prev_cam);
    camera_step_note(cut);
    return cut;
}

int mfx_frame_prepare(double frame_s) {
    g.frames++;
    id<MTLTexture> depth = g.depth;
    int ok = g.scene_ok && g.cam_ok && depth && g.ui;
    /* MetalFX deltaTime: the real interval between the two game frames (20 ms at 100 Hz when the game keeps up), else the
       pacing period. The pacing itself is held at two display refreshes by present_ticks (hle_nvn.c). */
    double now = CACurrentMediaTime(), dt = g.last_prepare_s > 0 ? now - g.last_prepare_s : frame_s;
    g.last_prepare_s = now; g.dt = dt > 1.0 / 250 && dt < 0.1 ? dt : frame_s > 0 ? frame_s : 1.0 / 30;
    g.scene_ok_was = g.scene_ok; g.cam_ok_was = g.cam_ok; g.scene_ok = g.cam_ok = 0; g.depth = nil;
    if (!ok) {
        g.skip_input++; g.miss[0] += !g.scene_ok_was; g.miss[1] += !g.cam_ok_was; g.miss[2] += !depth; g.miss[3] += !g.ui;
        g.prev_ok = g.hist_ok = 0; return -1;
    }
    ensure_fi(depth.width, depth.height);
    if (!g.prev_ok || camera_cut()) {
        if (g.prev_ok) g.skip_cut++; else g.skip_first++;
        memcpy(g.prev_cam, g.cam, sizeof g.cam); g.cur ^= 1; g.prev_ok = 1; g.hist_ok = 0;
        return -1;
    }
    double vc[16], vp[16], ic[16], m[16];
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) { vc[i] = g.cam[12 + i]; vp[i] = g.prev_cam[12 + i]; }
    if (!inv4(vc, ic)) { g.skip_input++; g.prev_ok = g.hist_ok = 0; return -1; }
    mul4(vp, ic, m);
    int s = g.slot = (g.slot + 1) % MFX_OUT;
    float *par = g.mv_par[s].contents;
    for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) for (int r = 0; r < 4; r++) par[c * 4 + r] = (float)m[r * 4 + c];   // float4x4 is column-major
    par[16] = (float)depth.width; par[17] = (float)depth.height; par[18] = 1.0f / depth.width; par[19] = 1.0f / depth.height; par[20] = (float)g.yflip;
    g.enc_depth = depth;
    return s;
}
void mfx_frame_abort(void) { g.enc_depth = nil; g.prev_ok = g.hist_ok = 0; g.skip_busy++; }
NSArray *mfx_frame_encode(id<MTL4CommandBuffer> cb, int s, id<MTL4CounterHeap> heap, NSUInteger stamp) {
    id<MTLTexture> depth = g.enc_depth; g.enc_depth = nil; g.last_depth = depth; g.last_slot = s;
    [g.mv_args[s] setTexture:depth.gpuResourceID atIndex:0]; [g.mv_args[s] setTexture:g.mv.gpuResourceID atIndex:1]; [g.mv_args[s] setAddress:g.mv_par[s].gpuAddress atIndex:0];
    id<MTL4ComputeCommandEncoder> e = [cb computeCommandEncoder];
    [e barrierAfterQueueStages:MTLStageAll beforeStages:MTLStageDispatch visibilityOptions:MTL4VisibilityOptionDevice];   // the game's frame is done
    [e setComputePipelineState:g.mv_ps]; [e setArgumentTable:g.mv_args[s]];
    [e dispatchThreads:MTLSizeMake(depth.width, depth.height, 1) threadsPerThreadgroup:MTLSizeMake(16, 16, 1)];
    [e updateFence:g.fence afterEncoderStages:MTLStageDispatch];
    [e endEncoding];
    if (heap) [cb writeTimestampIntoHeap:heap atIndex:stamp];   // after the motion vectors (which waited for the frame)
    id<MTL4FXFrameInterpolator> fi = g.fi;
    fi.colorTexture = g.scene[g.cur]; fi.prevColorTexture = g.scene[g.cur ^ 1]; fi.depthTexture = depth; fi.motionTexture = g.mv;
    fi.uiTexture = g.ui; fi.uiTextureComposited = NO; fi.outputTexture = g.out[s]; fi.fence = g.fence;
    fi.motionVectorScaleX = 1; fi.motionVectorScaleY = 1; fi.jitterOffsetX = 0; fi.jitterOffsetY = 0;
    fi.deltaTime = (float)g.dt; fi.nearPlane = (float)g.cam[56]; fi.farPlane = (float)g.cam[57];
    fi.fieldOfView = (float)(g.cam[70] * 180.0 / M_PI); fi.aspectRatio = (float)g.cam[62]; fi.depthReversed = NO;
    fi.shouldResetHistory = !g.hist_ok;
    [fi encodeToCommandBuffer:cb];
    // Metal 4 work needs explicit resource lifetime. Hold this exact frame's
    // bindings through completion, while the configuration cache retains only
    // the interpolator, not old scene/pool textures between configurations.
    NSArray *resources = @[fi, fi.colorTexture, fi.prevColorTexture, depth,
                           g.mv, g.ui, g.out[s], g.mv_par[s]];
    fi.colorTexture = nil; fi.prevColorTexture = nil; fi.depthTexture = nil;
    fi.motionTexture = nil; fi.uiTexture = nil; fi.outputTexture = nil;
    if (heap) [cb writeTimestampIntoHeap:heap atIndex:stamp + 1];
    g.mv_prev_yaw = atan2(g.prev_cam[2], g.prev_cam[0]) * 180 / M_PI;   // yaw of the previous frame, for mfx_mv_log
    memcpy(g.prev_cam, g.cam, sizeof g.cam); g.cur ^= 1; g.hist_ok = 1; g.made++;
    return resources;
}
/* TOTK_MFX_MVLOG=<every n frames>: read the motion texture back after the interpolation and log its median and the
   camera step (diagnostic; waits for the GPU). */
void mfx_mv_log(void) {
    static int every = -1; if (every < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_MFX_MVLOG"); every = e ? atoi(e) : 0; }
    if (every <= 0 || !g.mv || g.made % (uint64_t)every) return;
    static id<MTLCommandQueue> q; if (!q) q = [g.dev newCommandQueue];
    NSUInteger w = g.mv.width, h = g.mv.height;
    id<MTLBuffer> b = [g.dev newBufferWithLength:w * h * 4 options:MTLResourceStorageModeShared];
    id<MTLCommandBuffer> cb = [q commandBuffer]; id<MTLBlitCommandEncoder> e = [cb blitCommandEncoder];
    [e copyFromTexture:g.mv sourceSlice:0 sourceLevel:0 sourceOrigin:MTLOriginMake(0, 0, 0) sourceSize:MTLSizeMake(w, h, 1) toBuffer:b destinationOffset:0 destinationBytesPerRow:w * 4 destinationBytesPerImage:w * h * 4];
    [e endEncoding]; [cb commit]; [cb waitUntilCompleted];
    const _Float16 *v = b.contents; enum { N = 4096 }; static float xs[N], ys[N]; int n = 0;
    for (NSUInteger y = h / 8; y < h * 7 / 8 && n < N; y += h / 64) for (NSUInteger x = w / 8; x < w * 7 / 8 && n < N; x += w / 64) { xs[n] = (float)v[(y * w + x) * 2]; ys[n] = (float)v[(y * w + x) * 2 + 1]; n++; }
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) { float t = xs[i]; int j = i - 1; while (j >= 0 && xs[j] > t) { xs[j + 1] = xs[j]; j--; } xs[j + 1] = t; }
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) { float t = ys[i]; int j = i - 1; while (j >= 0 && ys[j] > t) { ys[j + 1] = ys[j]; j--; } ys[j + 1] = t; }
    double yaw = atan2(g.cam[2], g.cam[0]) * 180 / M_PI, pyaw = atan2(g.prev_cam[2], g.prev_cam[0]) * 180 / M_PI;   // prev_cam is this frame's camera after encode
    MLOG("motion (input px, median of %d samples): x %.2f (p10 %.2f p90 %.2f) y %.2f; camera yaw %.3f deg, step to previous %.3f deg; position %.2f %.2f %.2f",
         n, xs[n / 2], xs[n / 10], xs[n * 9 / 10], ys[n / 2], yaw, yaw - g.mv_prev_yaw, g.cam[47], g.cam[51], g.cam[55]);
    (void)pyaw;
}
/* TOTK_MFX_DUMP=<dir>: while the camera turns (more than 1 degree between the two frames), save the previous and this
   frame's scene, the depth, the motion vectors and the interpolated output of the 30th, 60th and 90th such frame as raw
   files (scene RGBA16F, depth float32, motion 2 x float16, output RGBA8 sRGB), with a line in the log. Diagnostic: it
   waits for the GPU and is meant for unpaced runs. */
static void dump_tex(id<MTLCommandQueue> q, id<MTLTexture> t, NSUInteger bpp, const char *dir, const char *name, uint64_t n) {
    NSUInteger w = t.width, h = t.height;
    id<MTLBuffer> b = [g.dev newBufferWithLength:w * h * bpp options:MTLResourceStorageModeShared];
    id<MTLCommandBuffer> cb = [q commandBuffer]; id<MTLBlitCommandEncoder> e = [cb blitCommandEncoder];
    [e copyFromTexture:t sourceSlice:0 sourceLevel:0 sourceOrigin:MTLOriginMake(0, 0, 0) sourceSize:MTLSizeMake(w, h, 1) toBuffer:b destinationOffset:0 destinationBytesPerRow:w * bpp destinationBytesPerImage:w * h * bpp];
    [e endEncoding]; [cb commit]; [cb waitUntilCompleted];
    char path[1024]; snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/mfx-%llu-%s-%lux%lu.bin", dir, (unsigned long long)n, name, (unsigned long)w, (unsigned long)h);
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "wb"); if (f) { fwrite(b.contents, 1, w * h * bpp, f); fclose(f); } else MLOG("【红】dump: cannot write %s", path);
}
static const char *g_dump_dir; static uint64_t g_turning; static double g_dump_step;
int mfx_dump_due(void) {   // called after each encode; 1 = dump this frame (the caller first waits for the GPU)
    static int init; if (!init) { init = 1; g_dump_dir = getenv("TOTK_MFX_DUMP"); }
    if (!g_dump_dir || !g.last_depth || !g.mv || g.last_slot < 0) return 0;
    g_dump_step = fabs(remainder(atan2(g.prev_cam[2], g.prev_cam[0]) * 180 / M_PI - g.mv_prev_yaw, 360.0));
    if (g_dump_step < 1.0) return 0;
    g_turning++;
    return 1;
}
/* After the GPU has finished: compare the centre of the previous and this frame's scene; a very different pair (or the
   30th turning frame as a reference) is dumped with the presented images of both frames. Returns 1 when dumped. */
static float uf11(uint32_t v) { uint32_t e = (v >> 6) & 31, m = v & 63; return e == 0 ? ldexpf(m / 64.0f, -14) : e == 31 ? 65504.0f : ldexpf(1 + m / 64.0f, (int)e - 15); }
static float uf10(uint32_t v) { uint32_t e = (v >> 5) & 31, m = v & 31; return e == 0 ? ldexpf(m / 32.0f, -14) : e == 31 ? 65504.0f : ldexpf(1 + m / 32.0f, (int)e - 15); }
static void scene_rgb(const void *base, NSUInteger i, float c[3]) {   // one pixel of a scene copy (RG11B10F or RGBA16F)
    if (g.scene_fmt == MTLPixelFormatRGBA16Float) { const _Float16 *p = (const _Float16 *)base + i * 4; for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) c[k] = (float)p[k]; return; }
    uint32_t v = ((const uint32_t *)base)[i]; c[0] = uf11(v & 0x7ff); c[1] = uf11((v >> 11) & 0x7ff); c[2] = uf10(v >> 22);
}
static double centre_diff(id<MTLCommandQueue> q) {
    NSUInteger w = 320, h = 180, x0 = (g.out_w - w) / 2, y0 = (g.out_h - h) / 2, bpp = g.scene_fmt == MTLPixelFormatRGBA16Float ? 8 : 4;
    id<MTLBuffer> b = [g.dev newBufferWithLength:w * h * bpp * 2 options:MTLResourceStorageModeShared];
    id<MTLCommandBuffer> cb = [q commandBuffer]; id<MTLBlitCommandEncoder> e = [cb blitCommandEncoder];
    for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) [e copyFromTexture:g.scene[g.cur ^ k] sourceSlice:0 sourceLevel:0 sourceOrigin:MTLOriginMake(x0, y0, 0) sourceSize:MTLSizeMake(w, h, 1) toBuffer:b destinationOffset:k * w * h * bpp destinationBytesPerRow:w * bpp destinationBytesPerImage:w * h * bpp];
    [e endEncoding]; [cb commit]; [cb waitUntilCompleted];
    const uint8_t *p = b.contents; double se = 0;
    for (NSUInteger i = 0; i < w * h; i++) { float a[3], c[3]; scene_rgb(p, i, a); scene_rgb(p + w * h * bpp, i, c);
        for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) { double d = fmin(fmax(a[k], 0), 4) - fmin(fmax(c[k], 0), 4); se += d * d; } }
    return se / (w * h * 3);
}
void mfx_dump(long frame, id<MTLTexture> swap_prev, id<MTLTexture> swap_cur) {
    const char *dir = g_dump_dir; uint64_t turning = g_turning; double step = g_dump_step;
    static id<MTLCommandQueue> q; if (!q) q = [g.dev newCommandQueue];
    // every 10th turning frame from the 10th to the 160th (sixteen samples); very different pairs are logged and kept too
    double mse = centre_diff(q);
    if (turning % 10 || turning < 10 || turning > 160) return;
    MLOG("frame pair %llu (game frame %ld): centre mean squared difference %.4f%s", (unsigned long long)turning, frame, mse, mse > 0.05 ? " -- very different" : "");
    if (swap_prev) dump_tex(q, swap_prev, 4, dir, "swapprev", turning);
    if (swap_cur) dump_tex(q, swap_cur, 4, dir, "swapcur", turning);
    // after encode, cur was flipped: scene[cur ^ 1] is this frame, scene[cur] the previous one
    NSUInteger sb = g.scene_fmt == MTLPixelFormatRGBA16Float ? 8 : 4;   // RG11B10F canvas copies: 4 bytes
    dump_tex(q, g.scene[g.cur], sb, dir, "prev", turning); dump_tex(q, g.scene[g.cur ^ 1], sb, dir, "cur", turning);
    dump_tex(q, g.last_depth, 4, dir, "depth", turning); dump_tex(q, g.mv, 4, dir, "motion", turning); dump_tex(q, g.out[g.last_slot], 4, dir, "out", turning);
    MLOG("dump %llu (game frame %ld): yaw step %.3f deg, camera %.3f %.3f %.3f -> %s", (unsigned long long)turning, frame, step, g.cam[47], g.cam[51], g.cam[55], dir);
}
id<MTLTexture> mfx_output(int slot) { return slot >= 0 && slot < MFX_OUT ? g.outv[slot] : nil; }
void mfx_note_gpu(double ms) { if (ms > 0 && ms < 100) g.gpu_ms[g.ngpu++ % 300] = ms; }
static double gpu_pct(double q) {
    int n = g.ngpu < 300 ? g.ngpu : 300; if (!n) return -1;
    double a[300]; memcpy(a, g.gpu_ms, sizeof a);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) { double v = a[i]; int j = i - 1; while (j >= 0 && a[j] > v) { a[j + 1] = a[j]; j--; } a[j + 1] = v; }
    return a[(int)(q * (n - 1))];
}
void mfx_stats(char *out, size_t n) {
    snprintf(out, n, "插值帧 %llu / 游戏帧 %llu（MetalFX GPU p50 %.2f / p95 %.2f ms；两帧间隔 %.1f ms）；未插：缺输入 %llu（画面 %llu 相机 %llu 深度 %llu UI %llu）、首帧 / 历史重置 %llu、镜头切换 %llu、命令缓冲忙 %llu",
             (unsigned long long)g.made, (unsigned long long)g.frames, gpu_pct(0.5), gpu_pct(0.95), g.dt * 1e3, (unsigned long long)g.skip_input, (unsigned long long)g.miss[0], (unsigned long long)g.miss[1],
             (unsigned long long)g.miss[2], (unsigned long long)g.miss[3],
             (unsigned long long)g.skip_first, (unsigned long long)g.skip_cut, (unsigned long long)g.skip_busy);
}

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/totk_mfx_up.h`:

```h
// TOTK: MetalFX spatial upscaling (TOTK_MFX_UPSCALE; not in D2R). See totk_mfx_up.m.
#pragma once
#import <Metal/Metal.h>

/* One scaler context per use; each context is used from one thread only. */
enum {
    MFXUP_SCENE = 0,    // iOS, handheld: the scene below the canvas size (TOTK_RENDER_RES) before the compose shader samples it
    MFXUP_DOCKED = 1,   // Mac, docked: the game's own upscale of the finished picture into the 1080p canvas, replaced
    MFXUP_OUTPUT = 2,   // Mac, the present: the finished 1080p picture into a bigger window / full screen (2K output), used from the present thread
    MFXUP_NCTX
};
/* Colour processing modes: the values of MTLFXSpatialScalerColorProcessingMode, without importing MetalFX here. */
enum { MFXUP_PERCEPTUAL = 0, MFXUP_LINEAR = 1, MFXUP_HDR = 2 };

int mfxup_enabled(void);   // TOTK_MFX_UPSCALE: default off; key 3 enables it in the manual MetalFX picture mode
int mfxup_output_enabled(void);   // TOTK_MFX_OUTPUT: default off; key 3 enables the window output stage in the manual MetalFX picture mode
void mfxup_output_set(int on);    // runtime: "flag mfx_output 0|1" (the output stage alone, for A/B)
void mfxup_set(int on);    // runtime: "flag mfx_upscale 0|1"
/* Encodes a MetalFX spatial upscale of the top-left in_w x in_h region of src into cb (Metal 4; the caller has ended its
   render / compute encoders). dst nil: into the context's own out_w x out_h texture; otherwise into dst itself (its format
   and usage must suit MetalFX; out_w / out_h are dst's size). mode: an MTLFXSpatialScalerColorProcessingMode. Returns the
   texture written, or nil when this configuration cannot be built or is still being built in the background (the caller
   keeps its own path for this frame). */
id<MTLTexture> mfxup_encode_ex(int ctx, id<MTL4CommandBuffer> cb, id<MTLTexture> src, NSUInteger in_w, NSUInteger in_h,
                               id<MTLTexture> dst, NSUInteger out_w, NSUInteger out_h, int mode);
/* Whether the scaler for this configuration is ready (1); otherwise it is being built on a background queue (about 70 ms) and
   the caller keeps its own path for now. A caller that must end its encoders before encoding asks first. */
int mfxup_prepare(int ctx, id<MTLTexture> src, id<MTLTexture> dst, NSUInteger out_w, NSUInteger out_h, int mode);
// The iOS hook's form: all of src into the scene context's own texture, HDR colour processing (the scene before tone mapping).
id<MTLTexture> mfxup_encode(id<MTL4CommandBuffer> cb, id<MTLTexture> src, NSUInteger out_w, NSUInteger out_h);
id<MTLResidencySet> mfxup_residency(void);   // the contexts' own output textures (nil until one exists); the queue adds it once
void mfxup_stats(int ctx, char *out, size_t n);

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/totk_mfx_up.m`:

```m
// TOTK: MetalFX spatial upscaling (TOTK_MFX_UPSCALE; not in D2R).
// MFXUP_SCENE (iOS, handheld): with a scene render size below the canvas (TOTK_RENDER_RES=960x540 on the phone, canvas
// 1280x720) the game's compose shader (0ac9a549: tone mapping, bloom, into the canvas) samples the scene bilinearly. The
// replay (nvn_mtl.m, mfxup_draw) runs a MetalFX spatial upscale of the scene to the canvas size just before that draw and
// binds the result instead; the shader samples with normalised coordinates, so it reads the same picture at the canvas
// resolution. The scene there is linear HDR (tone mapping happens in that shader), hence the HDR colour processing mode.
// MFXUP_DOCKED (Mac, docked): tone mapping and FXAA run at 1600x900, then the game's own upscale a3a570eb (FSR 1-style,
// twelve texel reads) writes the 1080p canvas. The replay lets MetalFX write the canvas instead and skips that draw
// (perceptual mode: the canvas holds display values, copied to the swapchain unchanged).
// MFXUP_OUTPUT (Mac, the present; 2026-10-16 night, the user's "2K output with MetalFX"): when the window or the full
// screen shows the 1920x1080 picture bigger (2560x1440 full screen on the user's 3440x1440 display), the present upscales
// it with MetalFX (perceptual: display values) instead of stretching it bilinearly; the FPS / load boxes are drawn after.
// Each context belongs to one thread (the replay thread; the output context the present thread); the device-wide
// objects and the residency set are shared.
#import <MetalFX/MetalFX.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "totk_mfx_up.h"

#define ULOG(...) do { fprintf(stderr, "[dm] [nvn-mtl] [mfx-up] " __VA_ARGS__); fputc('\n', stderr); } while (0)

enum { MFXUP_OLD = 8, MFXUP_OLD_AFTER = 8, MFXUP_CACHE = 3, MFXUP_BAD = 4, MFXUP_RETRY_MS = 10000 };   // replaced objects kept for this many later encodes (the GPU is done with them by then)
/* One scaler configuration. Building a scaler takes about 70 ms (2026-10-17), so a new one is built on a background queue
   while the caller keeps its fallback (the game's own upscale, the bilinear present) for those frames, and the last few
   are kept: switching back (key 3, a window going in and out of full screen) is instant. */
typedef struct { NSUInteger in_w, in_h, out_w, out_h; MTLPixelFormat in_fmt, out_fmt; int mode, own; } cfg_t;   // out_fmt: dst's (own output: invalid)
typedef struct { cfg_t cfg; id<MTL4FXSpatialScaler> sc; id<MTLTexture> out; uint64_t used; } built_t;
typedef struct {
    built_t cache[MFXUP_CACHE]; int ncache, cur;   // cur: the cache entry in use, -1 none yet
    struct { cfg_t cfg; uint64_t at_ms; } bad[MFXUP_BAD]; int nbad;   // builds that failed: the caller's own path stays, retried after MFXUP_RETRY_MS
    _Atomic int building;                           // a background build in flight; its result waits in ready
    built_t ready; int has_ready, ready_ok;         // under g_build_mu
    id<MTLFence> fence;
    uint64_t done, refused, waited, tick;
    struct { id obj; id<MTLTexture> tex; uint64_t at; } old[MFXUP_OLD]; int nold;
} ctx_t;
static ctx_t g_c[MFXUP_NCTX] = {{.cur = -1}, {.cur = -1}, {.cur = -1}};
static const char *g_name[MFXUP_NCTX] = {"scene", "docked", "output"};
static id<MTLDevice> g_dev;
static id<MTL4Compiler> g_comp;
static id<MTLResidencySet> g_rs;
static pthread_mutex_t g_mu = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;         // g_dev / g_comp / g_rs
static pthread_mutex_t g_build_mu = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;   // the contexts' ready slots
static dispatch_queue_t g_build_q;                               // background scaler builds, one at a time
static _Atomic int g_on = -1;
static int g_unavailable;                                        // no MetalFX here (device, residency set, compiler): never retried

int mfxup_enabled(void) {
    int v = atomic_load_explicit(&g_on, memory_order_relaxed);
    if (v < 0) {
        const char *e = getenv("TOTK_MFX_UPSCALE");
        v = e ? strcmp(e, "0") != 0 : 0;
        atomic_store(&g_on, v);
        ULOG("MetalFX spatial upscaling (TOTK_MFX_UPSCALE): %s", v ? "on" : "off");
    }
    return v;
}
void mfxup_set(int on) { atomic_store(&g_on, on != 0); ULOG("[flag] mfx_upscale = %d", on != 0); }
static _Atomic int g_out_on = -1;
int mfxup_output_enabled(void) {
    int v = atomic_load_explicit(&g_out_on, memory_order_relaxed);
    if (v < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_MFX_OUTPUT"); v = e ? strcmp(e, "0") != 0 : 0; atomic_store(&g_out_on, v); ULOG("MetalFX output upscaling (TOTK_MFX_OUTPUT, the window output stage): %s", v ? "on" : "off"); }
    return v;
}
void mfxup_output_set(int on) { atomic_store(&g_out_on, on != 0); ULOG("[flag] mfx_output = %d", on != 0); }

id<MTLResidencySet> mfxup_residency(void) { pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mu); id<MTLResidencySet> r = g_rs; pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mu); return r; }

static void rs_change(id<MTLTexture> add, id<MTLTexture> remove) {
    if (!add && !remove) return;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mu);
    if (g_rs) { if (add) [g_rs addAllocation:add]; if (remove) [g_rs removeAllocation:remove]; [g_rs commit]; }   // committed before the GPU can use it (lesson 55)
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mu);
}
static void old_push(ctx_t *c, id obj, id<MTLTexture> tex);
static void old_pop(ctx_t *c) {   // drop the oldest replaced scaler / output
    rs_change(nil, c->old[0].tex);
    c->old[0].obj = nil; c->old[0].tex = nil;
    for (int i = 1; i < c->nold; i++) c->old[i - 1] = c->old[i];
    c->old[c->nold - 1].obj = nil; c->old[c->nold - 1].tex = nil; c->nold--;
}
static void old_push(ctx_t *c, id obj, id<MTLTexture> tex) {   // encoded work may still use it: keep it a while
    if (!obj && !tex) return;
    if (c->nold == MFXUP_OLD) old_pop(c);
    c->old[c->nold].obj = obj; c->old[c->nold].tex = tex; c->old[c->nold].at = c->done + MFXUP_OLD_AFTER; c->nold++;
}
static void sweep(ctx_t *c) { while (c->nold && c->old[0].at <= c->done) old_pop(c); }
static int cfg_eq(const cfg_t *a, const cfg_t *b) {
    return a->in_w == b->in_w && a->in_h == b->in_h && a->out_w == b->out_w && a->out_h == b->out_h && a->in_fmt == b->in_fmt &&
           a->out_fmt == b->out_fmt && a->mode == b->mode && a->own == b->own;
}
static int shared_objects(id<MTLDevice> dev) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mu);
    int ok = 1; NSError *e = nil;
    if (!g_dev) g_dev = dev;
    if (g_dev != dev) { ULOG("textures of another device: game's own upscale stays"); ok = 0; }
    if (ok && !g_rs) { g_rs = [g_dev newResidencySetWithDescriptor:[MTLResidencySetDescriptor new] error:&e]; if (!g_rs) { ULOG("residency set: %s", e.localizedDescription.UTF8String); ok = 0; } }
    if (ok && ![MTLFXSpatialScalerDescriptor supportsMetal4FX:g_dev]) { ULOG("this GPU has no Metal 4 MetalFX spatial scaler: game's own upscale stays"); ok = 0; }
    if (ok && !g_comp) { g_comp = [g_dev newCompilerWithDescriptor:[MTL4CompilerDescriptor new] error:&e]; if (!g_comp) { ULOG("MTL4 compiler: %s", e.localizedDescription.UTF8String); ok = 0; } }
    if (ok && !g_build_q) g_build_q = dispatch_queue_create("totk.mfxup.build", DISPATCH_QUEUE_SERIAL);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mu);
    return ok;
}
static uint64_t now_ms(void) { return clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW) / 1000000; }
/* A failed build (e.g. no memory for the output texture on iOS) is retried after a while; a full list drops its oldest entry. */
static void mark_bad(ctx_t *c, cfg_t cfg) {
    int slot = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < c->nbad; i++) if (cfg_eq(&c->bad[i].cfg, &cfg)) slot = i;
    if (slot < 0 && c->nbad < MFXUP_BAD) slot = c->nbad++;
    if (slot < 0) { slot = 0; for (int i = 1; i < MFXUP_BAD; i++) if (c->bad[i].at_ms < c->bad[slot].at_ms) slot = i; }
    c->bad[slot].cfg = cfg; c->bad[slot].at_ms = now_ms();
}
static int is_bad(const ctx_t *c, const cfg_t *cfg) {
    for (int i = 0; i < c->nbad; i++) if (cfg_eq(&c->bad[i].cfg, cfg)) return now_ms() - c->bad[i].at_ms < MFXUP_RETRY_MS;
    return 0;
}
/* Background queue: build the scaler (and the own output texture) for one configuration, hand it to the owning thread. */
static void build(int ci, cfg_t cfg, NSUInteger src_usage, NSUInteger dst_usage, int dst_memoryless) {
    uint64_t t0 = now_ms(); built_t b = {.cfg = cfg}; const char *why = NULL;
    /* Own output: the source's format when MetalFX takes it, else RGBA16Float (the game only samples it). Into dst: its format. */
    MTLPixelFormat outs[2] = {cfg.own ? cfg.in_fmt : cfg.out_fmt, MTLPixelFormatRGBA16Float};
    for (int i = 0; i < (cfg.own ? 2 : 1) && !b.sc; i++) {
        MTLFXSpatialScalerDescriptor *d = [MTLFXSpatialScalerDescriptor new];
        d.colorTextureFormat = cfg.in_fmt; d.outputTextureFormat = outs[i];
        d.inputWidth = cfg.in_w; d.inputHeight = cfg.in_h; d.outputWidth = cfg.out_w; d.outputHeight = cfg.out_h;
        d.colorProcessingMode = (MTLFXSpatialScalerColorProcessingMode)cfg.mode;
        b.sc = [d newSpatialScalerWithDevice:g_dev compiler:g_comp];
    }
    if (!b.sc) why = "spatial scaler not created";
    else if ((src_usage & b.sc.colorTextureUsage) != b.sc.colorTextureUsage) why = "the source's usage lacks what MetalFX needs";
    else if (!cfg.own && ((dst_usage & b.sc.outputTextureUsage) != b.sc.outputTextureUsage || dst_memoryless)) why = "the target's usage lacks what MetalFX needs";
    else if (cfg.own) {
        MTLTextureDescriptor *td = [MTLTextureDescriptor texture2DDescriptorWithPixelFormat:b.sc.outputTextureFormat width:cfg.out_w height:cfg.out_h mipmapped:NO];
        td.usage = b.sc.outputTextureUsage | MTLTextureUsageShaderRead; td.storageMode = MTLStorageModePrivate;
        b.out = [g_dev newTextureWithDescriptor:td];
        if (!b.out) why = "output texture not created"; else rs_change(b.out, nil);
    }
    static const char *modes[] = {"perceptual", "linear", "HDR"};
    if (why) ULOG("%s: %s for %lux%lu (format %lu) -> %lux%lu: the caller's own path stays", g_name[ci], why,
                  (unsigned long)cfg.in_w, (unsigned long)cfg.in_h, (unsigned long)cfg.in_fmt, (unsigned long)cfg.out_w, (unsigned long)cfg.out_h);
    else ULOG("%s: spatial scaler %lux%lu (format %lu) -> %lux%lu (format %lu), %s colour processing, %s; built in the background in %llu ms", g_name[ci],
              (unsigned long)cfg.in_w, (unsigned long)cfg.in_h, (unsigned long)cfg.in_fmt, (unsigned long)cfg.out_w, (unsigned long)cfg.out_h,
              (unsigned long)(cfg.own ? b.out.pixelFormat : cfg.out_fmt), cfg.mode >= 0 && cfg.mode < 3 ? modes[cfg.mode] : "?",
              cfg.own ? "own output" : "into the game's target", (unsigned long long)(now_ms() - t0));
    if (why) { b.sc = nil; b.out = nil; }
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_build_mu); g_c[ci].ready = b; g_c[ci].ready_ok = !why; g_c[ci].has_ready = 1; pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_build_mu);
    atomic_store(&g_c[ci].building, 0);
}
/* Owning thread: take a finished background build into the cache (the least recently used entry other than the current
   one makes room; its objects wait in the old list until the GPU is done with them). */
static void adopt(ctx_t *c) {
    built_t b; int has, ok;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_build_mu); has = c->has_ready; ok = c->ready_ok; b = c->ready; c->ready = (built_t){0}; c->has_ready = 0; pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_build_mu);
    if (!has) return;
    if (!ok) { mark_bad(c, b.cfg); return; }
    int slot = c->ncache;
    if (slot == MFXUP_CACHE) {
        slot = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < MFXUP_CACHE; i++) if (i != c->cur && (slot < 0 || c->cache[i].used < c->cache[slot].used)) slot = i;
        old_push(c, c->cache[slot].sc, c->cache[slot].out);
    } else c->ncache++;
    c->cache[slot] = b; c->cache[slot].used = 0;
}
/* Takes a finished build, then makes the cached scaler for this configuration current if there is one. */
static int use_cached(int ci, ctx_t *c, const cfg_t *want) {
    adopt(c);
    for (int i = 0; i < c->ncache; i++) if (cfg_eq(&c->cache[i].cfg, want)) {
        if (c->cur >= 0) ULOG("%s: %s %lux%lu -> %lux%lu", g_name[ci], c->cache[i].used ? "back to the kept scaler" : "switched to the scaler just built",
                              (unsigned long)want->in_w, (unsigned long)want->in_h, (unsigned long)want->out_w, (unsigned long)want->out_h);
        c->cur = i; c->cache[i].used = ++c->tick; return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}
/* 1 when the scaler for this configuration is current; otherwise starts building it (in the background) and returns 0. */
static int ensure(int ci, id<MTLTexture> src, id<MTLTexture> dst, NSUInteger ow, NSUInteger oh, int mode) {
    ctx_t *c = &g_c[ci]; int own = dst == nil;
    cfg_t want = {src.width, src.height, ow, oh, src.pixelFormat, own ? MTLPixelFormatInvalid : dst.pixelFormat, mode, own};
    if (c->cur >= 0 && cfg_eq(&c->cache[c->cur].cfg, &want)) { c->cache[c->cur].used = ++c->tick; return 1; }
    if (use_cached(ci, c, &want)) return 1;
    if (g_unavailable || is_bad(c, &want)) return 0;
    if (!shared_objects(src.device)) { g_unavailable = 1; return 0; }
    if (!c->fence) c->fence = [g_dev newFence];
    if (!atomic_exchange(&c->building, 1)) {
        /* A build that finished after the adopt in use_cached left its result in ready: take it now, or the next build's
           result would replace it and its own output texture would stay resident for good. It may be the one wanted. */
        if (use_cached(ci, c, &want)) { atomic_store(&c->building, 0); return 1; }
        if (is_bad(c, &want)) { atomic_store(&c->building, 0); return 0; }
        NSUInteger su = src.usage, du = own ? 0 : dst.usage; int ml = !own && dst.storageMode == MTLStorageModeMemoryless;
        dispatch_async(g_build_q, ^{ build(ci, want, su, du, ml); });
    }
    c->waited++;
    return 0;
}
int mfxup_prepare(int ci, id<MTLTexture> src, id<MTLTexture> dst, NSUInteger ow, NSUInteger oh, int mode) {
    if (ci < 0 || ci >= MFXUP_NCTX || !src) return 0;
    if (dst) { ow = dst.width; oh = dst.height; }
    return ensure(ci, src, dst, ow, oh, mode);
}

id<MTLTexture> mfxup_encode_ex(int ci, id<MTL4CommandBuffer> cb, id<MTLTexture> src, NSUInteger in_w, NSUInteger in_h,
                               id<MTLTexture> dst, NSUInteger ow, NSUInteger oh, int mode) {
    if (ci < 0 || ci >= MFXUP_NCTX) return nil;
    ctx_t *c = &g_c[ci];
    if (dst) { ow = dst.width; oh = dst.height; }
    if (!cb || !src || src.textureType != MTLTextureType2D || (dst && dst.textureType != MTLTextureType2D) || !in_w || !in_h ||
        in_w > src.width || in_h > src.height || !ow || !oh || !ensure(ci, src, dst, ow, oh, mode)) { c->refused++; return nil; }
    built_t *b = &c->cache[c->cur];
    id<MTLTexture> out = dst ? dst : b->out;
    /* MetalFX waits on the fence before reading: signal it after everything before (the producer of src, earlier users of
       the target). The next replay encoder starts with a queue barrier on all stages, which orders it after MetalFX. */
    id<MTL4ComputeCommandEncoder> e = [cb computeCommandEncoder];
    [e barrierAfterQueueStages:MTLStageAll beforeStages:MTLStageDispatch visibilityOptions:MTL4VisibilityOptionDevice];
    [e updateFence:c->fence afterEncoderStages:MTLStageDispatch];
    [e endEncoding];
    b->sc.colorTexture = src; b->sc.outputTexture = out; b->sc.inputContentWidth = in_w; b->sc.inputContentHeight = in_h; b->sc.fence = c->fence;
    [b->sc encodeToCommandBuffer:cb];
    c->done++;
    sweep(c);
    return out;
}

id<MTLTexture> mfxup_encode(id<MTL4CommandBuffer> cb, id<MTLTexture> src, NSUInteger out_w, NSUInteger out_h) {
    return src ? mfxup_encode_ex(MFXUP_SCENE, cb, src, src.width, src.height, nil, out_w, out_h, MTLFXSpatialScalerColorProcessingModeHDR) : nil;
}

void mfxup_stats(int ci, char *out, size_t n) {
    if (ci < 0 || ci >= MFXUP_NCTX) { snprintf(out, n, "?"); return; }
    const ctx_t *c = &g_c[ci];
    cfg_t z = {0}; const cfg_t *k = c->cur >= 0 ? &c->cache[c->cur].cfg : &z;
    snprintf(out, n, "MetalFX 空间放大（%s）：%llu 次，未放大 %llu 次（其中等后台建放大器 %llu 次）（%lux%lu → %lux%lu）", g_name[ci], (unsigned long long)c->done,
             (unsigned long long)c->refused, (unsigned long long)c->waited, (unsigned long)k->in_w, (unsigned long)k->in_h, (unsigned long)k->out_w, (unsigned long)k->out_h);
}

NVN(nvnTextureViewCompare, NVNboolean, const NVNtextureView *a, const NVNtextureView *b) {
    const view_t *x = CVW(a), *y = CVW(b);
    if (x->set_levels != y->set_levels || x->set_layers != y->set_layers || x->set_format != y->set_format || x->set_target != y->set_target || x->set_swizzle != y->set_swizzle || x->set_stencil != y->set_stencil) return 0;
    if (x->set_levels && (x->base_level != y->base_level || x->nlevels != y->nlevels)) return 0;
    if (x->set_layers && (x->min_layer != y->min_layer || x->nlayers != y->nlayers)) return 0;
    if (x->set_format && x->format != y->format) return 0;
    if (x->set_target && x->target != y->target) return 0;

}


// ---------- Sampler queries ----------

NVN_NOPROTO(nvnSamplerBuilderGetDevice, NVNdevice *, const NVNsamplerBuilder *b) { return ((const samp_builder_t *)b)->dev; }

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/totk_pipeline_archive.h`:

```h
// TOTK: the pipeline archive (2026-10-20/21). Pipelines are compiled once into GPU code and kept in Metal binary archives
// in the translation cache; later pipeline creations take their code from them instead of compiling.
// Why: iOS warmed every prepared pipeline at start and kept them all (about 450 MB of a 3.84 GB footprint on an
// iPhone 14, whose limit is 4 GB), because a pipeline met for the first time in play compiles on the device (50-700 ms
// hitches), and the system's own shader cache is cleared by reboots and updates.
// One file per pipeline, named by the pipeline's key (pipelines/<key>.metalarchive), and a pipeline is looked up only in
// its own file. Measured on an M4 (2026-10-21):
//  - one file holding many pipelines costs memory about quadratic in their number, never given back (32 per file 1 MB,
//    1,024 per file 777 MB: Metal clones every pipeline description into one flatbuffer when it opens the file);
//  - Metal searches every archive given to a pipeline (102 new pipelines with 142 files attached took 3.1 s);
//  - an archive opened from a file and written again keeps only what was added after opening;
//  - a one-pipeline file: 0.08 ms and about 35 KB to open, the pipeline from it 0.04 ms;
//  - every archive a pipeline is added to leaves a build folder in the user cache folder (com.apple.gpuarchiver/
//    gpuarchiver-*, about 380 KB, PersistentState and its parts) that Metal never removes, not even when the process exits:
//    432 folders in a one-minute first run, 65,536 folders and 25 GB overnight until no folder could be made any more
//    (reported by the other session, 2026-10-21). Nothing holds them open once the archive is written, so par_write
//    removes the one its own write made (par_ga_*). The folder sits under the app's bundle id when it has one
//    (iPhone 14, 2026-10-21: 239 folders left in Library/Caches/<bundle id>/com.apple.gpuarchiver while the first
//    version of this looked one level up).
// The key only finds the file: Metal checks the functions and state, so a wrong file is a miss, never a wrong pipeline.
// On everywhere; TOTK_PIPELINE_ARCHIVE=0 turns it off. Valid for one OS version, GPU and translation chain
// (pipelines/identity.json); otherwise the folder is removed. Included by nvn_mtl.m after MLOG and g_dev.
#pragma once
#import <Metal/Metal.h>
#include <CommonCrypto/CommonDigest.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include "dmsh_chain.h"
#include "totk_shader_rt.h"

static pthread_mutex_t g_par_mu = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static NSMutableSet<NSString *> *g_par_have;                              // keys with a file
static NSMutableDictionary<NSString *, id<MTLBinaryArchive>> *g_par_open; // opened (kept: Metal keeps their memory anyway)
static int g_par_on, g_par_valid;                                        // valid: files of this OS / GPU / chain exist
static _Atomic uint64_t g_par_written, g_par_write_failed;
static _Atomic int par_filling;                                          // the background fill (warm_fill_archive)
static __thread int par_on_fill_thread;                                  // set on that fill's own thread: it writes in place

static int par_enabled(void) {
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_PIPELINE_ARCHIVE"); on = !(e && !strcmp(e, "0")); }
    return on;
}
// The first run without valid archives: fill them in the background without keeping the pipelines (iOS; the full
// warm-up and the archive together passed the 4 GB limit). TOTK_PIPELINE_ARCHIVE_FILL=1 does the same on a Mac.
static int par_fill_light(void) {
#if TARGET_OS_IPHONE
    return 1;
#else
    const char *e = getenv("TOTK_PIPELINE_ARCHIVE_FILL"); return e && !strcmp(e, "1");
#endif
}
static NSString *par_dir(void) { return [totk_rt_dir() stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"pipelines"]; }
static NSString *par_file(NSString *key) { return [par_dir() stringByAppendingFormat:@"/%@.metalarchive", key]; }
static NSDictionary *par_identity(id<MTLDevice> dev) {
    return @{@"schema": @3, @"chain": @DMSH_CHAIN, @"gpu": dev.name ?: @"?",
             @"os": NSProcessInfo.processInfo.operatingSystemVersionString ?: @"?"};
}
static NSString *par_hash(const void *bytes, size_t n) {
    uint8_t d[CC_SHA256_DIGEST_LENGTH]; CC_SHA256(bytes, (CC_LONG)n, d);
    NSMutableString *s = [NSMutableString stringWithCapacity:40];
    for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) [s appendFormat:@"%02x", d[i]];   // 160 bits name a file
    return s;
}
/* The folder Metal's archive builder works in (see the top) is com.apple.gpuarchiver under a cache folder, inside a folder
   named after the bundle id when the program has one (iPhone 14: Library/Caches/<bundle id>/com.apple.gpuarchiver; a bare
   Mac binary such as build/totk-native-v143: <user cache folder>/com.apple.gpuarchiver; a packaged Mac app:
   <user cache folder>/<bundle id>/...). The first version took only confstr's user cache folder, which the iPhone app does
   not get, and removed nothing there (2026-10-21). So every candidate is watched: confstr's folder and the Caches folder,
   each with and without the bundle id. Folders under the bundle id are this app's own (own: 1); the others are shared with
   other programs. par_write removes only folders that appeared while it wrote, and writes one at a time (g_par_wmu), so a
   folder that appears then is its own. */
static pthread_mutex_t g_par_wmu = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static _Atomic uint64_t g_par_ga_removed;
static NSArray<NSDictionary *> *par_ga_dirs(void) {   // @{path, own}
    static NSArray *dirs; static dispatch_once_t once;
    dispatch_once(&once, ^{
        NSMutableArray *bases = [NSMutableArray array];
        char b[PATH_MAX]; if (confstr(_CS_DARWIN_USER_CACHE_DIR, b, sizeof b)) [bases addObject:@(b)];
        NSString *caches = NSSearchPathForDirectoriesInDomains(NSCachesDirectory, NSUserDomainMask, YES).firstObject;
        if (caches) [bases addObject:caches];
        NSString *bundle = NSBundle.mainBundle.bundleIdentifier;
        NSMutableArray *out = [NSMutableArray array]; NSMutableSet *seen = [NSMutableSet set];
        for (NSString *base in bases) for (int own = bundle.length ? 1 : 0; own >= 0; own--) {
            NSString *dir = [(own ? [base stringByAppendingPathComponent:bundle] : base) stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"com.apple.gpuarchiver"];
            dir = dir.stringByResolvingSymlinksInPath.stringByStandardizingPath;
            if (![seen containsObject:dir]) { [seen addObject:dir]; [out addObject:@{@"path": dir, @"own": @(own)}]; }
        }
        dirs = out;
    });
    return dirs;
}
static NSSet<NSString *> *par_ga_list(int own_only) {   // full paths of the build folders there now
    NSMutableSet *s = [NSMutableSet set];
    for (NSDictionary *d in par_ga_dirs()) {
        if (own_only && ![d[@"own"] boolValue]) continue;
        for (NSString *name in [NSFileManager.defaultManager contentsOfDirectoryAtPath:d[@"path"] error:nil] ?: @[])
            if ([name hasPrefix:@"gpuarchiver-"]) [s addObject:[d[@"path"] stringByAppendingPathComponent:name]];
    }
    return s;
}
static void par_ga_remove_new(NSSet<NSString *> *before) {
    NSMutableSet<NSString *> *made = [par_ga_list(0) mutableCopy]; [made minusSet:before];
    for (NSString *path in made) {
        NSError *e = nil;
        if ([NSFileManager.defaultManager removeItemAtPath:path error:&e]) atomic_fetch_add(&g_par_ga_removed, 1);
        else { static _Atomic int said; if (atomic_fetch_add(&said, 1) < 4) MLOG("【红】管线存档：删不掉 Metal 留下的工作目录 %s（%s）", path.UTF8String, e.localizedDescription.UTF8String); }
    }
}
// Once: the folder of this OS version, GPU and chain, and the keys it has files for.
static void par_open_dir(id<MTLDevice> dev) {
    static dispatch_once_t once;
    dispatch_once(&once, ^{
        if (!par_enabled()) return;
        NSFileManager *fm = NSFileManager.defaultManager;
        /* The app's own folders (under its bundle id) hold only build folders left by earlier runs (a crash in a write;
           before par_ga_remove_new, every write). Removed in the background, holding the write lock so no write is under
           way. Shared folders (a bare binary's) keep everything but what par_write itself made. */
        dispatch_async(dispatch_get_global_queue(QOS_CLASS_UTILITY, 0), ^{
            pthread_mutex_lock(&g_par_wmu); NSUInteger n = 0;
            for (NSString *path in par_ga_list(1)) if ([NSFileManager.defaultManager removeItemAtPath:path error:nil]) n++;
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_par_wmu);
            NSMutableArray *where = [NSMutableArray array];
            for (NSDictionary *d in par_ga_dirs()) [where addObject:[NSString stringWithFormat:@"%@（%@）", d[@"path"], [d[@"own"] boolValue] ? @"本 App 的" : @"共用"]];
            MLOG("管线存档：Metal 的工作目录查这些：%s；启动时删掉以前留下的 %lu 个", [where componentsJoinedByString:@"，"].UTF8String, (unsigned long)n);
        });
        NSString *stamp_path = [par_dir() stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"identity.json"];
        NSData *sd = [NSData dataWithContentsOfFile:stamp_path];
        NSDictionary *stamp = sd ? [NSJSONSerialization JSONObjectWithData:sd options:0 error:nil] : nil;
        [fm removeItemAtPath:[totk_rt_dir() stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"pipelines.metalarchive"] error:nil];   // layouts of earlier tests
        [fm removeItemAtPath:[totk_rt_dir() stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"pipelines.json"] error:nil];
        if (![stamp isEqual:par_identity(dev)] && [fm fileExistsAtPath:par_dir()]) {
            if (stamp) MLOG("管线存档：系统版本、GPU 或翻译链变了，删掉重建");
            [fm removeItemAtPath:par_dir() error:nil];
        }
        [fm createDirectoryAtPath:par_dir() withIntermediateDirectories:YES attributes:nil error:nil];
        [[NSJSONSerialization dataWithJSONObject:par_identity(dev) options:NSJSONWritingSortedKeys error:nil] writeToFile:stamp_path atomically:YES];
        g_par_have = [NSMutableSet set]; g_par_open = [NSMutableDictionary dictionary]; uint64_t bytes = 0;
        for (NSString *name in [fm contentsOfDirectoryAtPath:par_dir() error:nil] ?: @[]) if ([name hasSuffix:@".metalarchive"]) {
            [g_par_have addObject:name.stringByDeletingPathExtension];
            bytes += [[fm attributesOfItemAtPath:[par_dir() stringByAppendingPathComponent:name] error:nil] fileSize];
        }
        g_par_on = 1; g_par_valid = g_par_have.count > 0;
        if (g_par_valid) MLOG("管线存档：%lu 条管线各有一个文件（共 %.1f MB），用到哪条才打开哪条", (unsigned long)g_par_have.count, bytes / 1048576.0);
        else MLOG("管线存档：还没有，这次%s", par_fill_light() ? "在后台把管线清单收进存档（不常驻）" : "边玩边收（游戏空闲时在后台写）");
    });
}
// The archive with this pipeline's code, or nil (no file yet; off).
static id<MTLBinaryArchive> par_archive_for(id<MTLDevice> dev, NSString *key) {
    par_open_dir(dev);
    if (!g_par_on || !key) return nil;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_par_mu);
    id<MTLBinaryArchive> a = g_par_open[key];
    if (!a && [g_par_have containsObject:key]) {
        MTLBinaryArchiveDescriptor *d = [MTLBinaryArchiveDescriptor new]; d.url = [NSURL fileURLWithPath:par_file(key)];
        NSError *e = nil; a = [dev newBinaryArchiveWithDescriptor:d error:&e];
        if (a) g_par_open[key] = a;
        else { [g_par_have removeObject:key]; [NSFileManager.defaultManager removeItemAtPath:par_file(key) error:nil]; }
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_par_mu);
    return a;
}
// One pipeline as its own file (a temporary name, then renamed). Adding compiles the pipeline once more, through the
// compiler service the game uses too, so outside the fill this runs only while the game is idle (par_drain).
static void par_write(id<MTLDevice> dev, NSString *key, id desc) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_par_mu); BOOL have = [g_par_have containsObject:key]; pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_par_mu);
    if (have) return;   // another variant under the same key: keep the first
    NSError *e = nil; BOOL ok;
    NSString *path = par_file(key), *temp = [path stringByAppendingString:@".tmp"];
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_par_wmu);
    NSSet<NSString *> *before = par_ga_list(0);
    @autoreleasepool {
        id<MTLBinaryArchive> a = [dev newBinaryArchiveWithDescriptor:[MTLBinaryArchiveDescriptor new] error:&e];
        ok = a && ([desc isKindOfClass:MTLRenderPipelineDescriptor.class] ? [a addRenderPipelineFunctionsWithDescriptor:desc error:&e]
                                                                          : [a addComputePipelineFunctionsWithDescriptor:desc error:&e]);
        if (ok) ok = [a serializeToURL:[NSURL fileURLWithPath:temp] error:&e] && rename(temp.fileSystemRepresentation, path.fileSystemRepresentation) == 0;
    }
    par_ga_remove_new(before);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_par_wmu);
    if (!ok) { unlink(temp.fileSystemRepresentation);
               if (atomic_fetch_add(&g_par_write_failed, 1) < 4) MLOG("【红】管线存档：写不了（%s）", e ? e.localizedDescription.UTF8String : "改名失败"); return; }
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_par_mu); [g_par_have addObject:key]; pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_par_mu);
    uint64_t n = atomic_fetch_add(&g_par_written, 1) + 1;
    if (n % 500 == 0) MLOG("管线存档：这次已写 %llu 条（删掉 Metal 留下的工作目录 %llu 个）", (unsigned long long)n, (unsigned long long)atomic_load(&g_par_ga_removed));
}
enum { PAR_IDLE_NS = 3000000000u };
static _Atomic uint64_t g_par_last_compile_ns;   // set by pso_new / cs_new when they compiled
static int par_game_idle(void);                  // nvn_mtl.m: in the world, warm-up done, no compile for PAR_IDLE_NS
static NSMutableArray *g_par_pending;             // @[key, descriptor copy] waiting for an idle moment
static _Atomic int g_par_draining;
static dispatch_queue_t par_queue(void) {
    static dispatch_queue_t q; static dispatch_once_t once;
    dispatch_once(&once, ^{ q = dispatch_queue_create("dm.nvn.pipeline-archive", dispatch_queue_attr_make_with_qos_class(DISPATCH_QUEUE_SERIAL, QOS_CLASS_BACKGROUND, 0)); });
    return q;
}
// Every second while pipelines wait: when the game is idle, write one, then look again at once.
static void par_drain(id<MTLDevice> dev) {
    dispatch_after(dispatch_time(DISPATCH_TIME_NOW, (int64_t)NSEC_PER_SEC), par_queue(), ^{
        for (;;) {
            if (!par_game_idle()) { par_drain(dev); return; }
            NSArray *job = nil;
            pthread_mutex_lock(&g_par_mu);
            if (g_par_pending.count) { job = g_par_pending.firstObject; [g_par_pending removeObjectAtIndex:0]; }
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_par_mu);
            if (!job) { atomic_store(&g_par_draining, 0); return; }
            @autoreleasepool { par_write(dev, job[0], job[1]); }
        }
    });
}
// Called after a pipeline the archive did not have was compiled.
static void par_add(id<MTLDevice> dev, NSString *key, id desc) {
    if (!g_par_on || !key) return;
    if (par_on_fill_thread) { par_write(dev, key, desc); return; }
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_par_mu);
    if (!g_par_pending) g_par_pending = [NSMutableArray array];
    [g_par_pending addObject:@[key, [desc copy]]];
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_par_mu);
    if (!atomic_exchange(&g_par_draining, 1)) par_drain(dev);
}

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/totk_serial_set.h`:

```h
// Exact, append-only serial membership without an O(number of serials) rehash.
// The caller provides synchronization, just as for nvn_hmap. A serial is cleared (totk_serial_del) only once no
// texture-pool slot and no deferred recording refers to it any more (nvn_mtl.m serial_forget_if_unreferenced).
#pragma once
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#ifndef TOTK_SERIAL_SET_FAIL   // out of memory; nvn_mtl.m logs it as FATAL first
#define TOTK_SERIAL_SET_FAIL() abort()
#endif
#define TOTK_SERIAL_PAGE_BITS 16
#define TOTK_SERIAL_WORDS (1u << (TOTK_SERIAL_PAGE_BITS - 6))
typedef struct totk_serial_node { void *child[256]; } totk_serial_node;
typedef struct {
    totk_serial_node *root;
    struct { uint64_t key; uint64_t *bits; int valid; } cache[16];
    uint64_t n, pages, nodes, bytes;
} totk_serial_set;

static inline uint64_t *totk_serial_page(totk_serial_set *s, uint64_t key, int create) {
    unsigned ci = (unsigned)(key ^ (key >> 16) ^ (key >> 32)) & 15;
    if (s->cache[ci].valid && s->cache[ci].key == key && (!create || s->cache[ci].bits))
        return s->cache[ci].bits;
    uint64_t *bits = NULL;
    if (!s->root && create) {
        s->root = calloc(1, sizeof *s->root); if (!s->root) TOTK_SERIAL_SET_FAIL();
        s->nodes++; s->bytes += sizeof *s->root;
    }
    totk_serial_node *node = s->root;
    // key is the upper 48 bits of the serial. Six byte-wide levels support the
    // entire uint64_t domain; each allocation is at most one fixed-size page.
    for (int shift = 40; shift >= 0 && node; shift -= 8) {
        unsigned idx = (key >> shift) & 255;
        if (!node->child[idx] && create) {
            size_t bytes = shift ? sizeof *node : TOTK_SERIAL_WORDS * sizeof(uint64_t);
            node->child[idx] = calloc(1, bytes); if (!node->child[idx]) TOTK_SERIAL_SET_FAIL();
            s->bytes += bytes; if (shift) s->nodes++; else s->pages++;
        }
        if (shift) node = node->child[idx];
        else bits = node->child[idx];
    }
    s->cache[ci].key = key; s->cache[ci].bits = bits; s->cache[ci].valid = 1;
    return bits;
}
static inline int totk_serial_has(totk_serial_set *s, uint64_t serial) {
    uint64_t *p = totk_serial_page(s, serial >> TOTK_SERIAL_PAGE_BITS, 0);
    return p && !!(p[(serial & 65535) >> 6] & (UINT64_C(1) << (serial & 63)));
}
// Returns 1 only for the first insertion. No key or bitmap is ever relocated.
static inline int totk_serial_add(totk_serial_set *s, uint64_t serial) {
    uint64_t *p = totk_serial_page(s, serial >> TOTK_SERIAL_PAGE_BITS, 1);
    uint64_t mask = UINT64_C(1) << (serial & 63); unsigned word = (serial & 65535) >> 6;
    if (p[word] & mask) return 0;
    p[word] |= mask; s->n++; return 1;
}
// Returns 1 when the serial was in the set. The page stays (no bitmap is ever relocated or freed while in use).
static inline int totk_serial_del(totk_serial_set *s, uint64_t serial) {
    uint64_t *p = totk_serial_page(s, serial >> TOTK_SERIAL_PAGE_BITS, 0);
    if (!p) return 0;
    uint64_t mask = UINT64_C(1) << (serial & 63); unsigned word = (serial & 65535) >> 6;
    if (!(p[word] & mask)) return 0;
    p[word] &= ~mask; s->n--; return 1;
}
// Only at teardown or in isolated CPU tests; never used as live history GC.
static inline void totk_serial_free_node(totk_serial_node *p, int level) {
    if (!p) return;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 256; i++) if (level == 1) free(p->child[i]);
        else totk_serial_free_node(p->child[i], level - 1);
    free(p);
}
static inline void totk_serial_destroy(totk_serial_set *s) {
    totk_serial_free_node(s->root, 6); memset(s, 0, sizeof *s);
}

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/totk_shader_contrib.h`:

```h
// TOTK: what a player's game adds to the shared shader list (docs/shader-list.md).
// The prepared seed holds every variant the list names, so a variant the Mac has to translate while playing, or that an
// iPhone / iPad misses, is one the list does not have yet. Such a variant is written once to the player's contribution
// file (TOTK_SHADER_CONTRIB, set by app/launcher.m and ios/Sources/main.m; unset in development runs, which then write
// nothing) as a shader-list V row: the shader key and the bind state, no game data. Every TOTK_CONTRIB_STEP new rows the
// Mac launcher asks the player, before the game starts, to send the file in a GitHub issue (an iPhone / iPad never asks
// during play: while it is connected, ios/tools/shader_contrib_watch.py asks on the Mac); scripts/collect_shader_issues.py
// merges what arrives. Header-only: the runtime and the Mac launcher share it.
#pragma once
#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#define TOTK_CONTRIB_STEP 500
#ifndef GAME_CONTRIB_TEMPLATE   /* the issue form, label and title prefix of this game's list (runtime/game_version.h sets Breath of the Wild's) */
#define GAME_CONTRIB_TEMPLATE "shader-list.yml"
#define GAME_CONTRIB_TITLE "Shader list:"   /* what the Mac reminder's automatic submission titles its issue with; collect_shader_issues.py finds it by this */
#endif
#define TOTK_CONTRIB_REPO "ly05010419/MacNativeGames"   // the Mac reminder's "Submit automatically" (gh issue create)
#define TOTK_CONTRIB_ISSUE_URL "https://github.com/ly05010419/MacNativeGames/issues/new?template=" GAME_CONTRIB_TEMPLATE

static inline NSString *totk_contrib_path(void) {
    const char *e = getenv("TOTK_SHADER_CONTRIB");
    return e && *e ? @(e) : nil;
}

/* The rows already in the file: "<shader>\t<deps>", one per shader and bind state. */
static inline NSMutableSet<NSString *> *totk_contrib_read(NSString *path) {
    NSMutableSet *rows = [NSMutableSet set];
    NSString *text = path ? [NSString stringWithContentsOfFile:path encoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding error:nil] : nil;
    for (NSString *line in [text componentsSeparatedByString:@"\n"])
        if ([line hasPrefix:@"V\t"]) [rows addObject:[line substringFromIndex:2]];
    return rows;
}

/* The reminder is due when the file holds TOTK_CONTRIB_STEP rows more than at the last one (<file>.reminded), unless the
   player chose "Don't remind me again" ("never" there). Returns the row count then, else 0. */
static inline NSUInteger totk_contrib_due(NSString *path) {
    if (!path) return 0;
    NSString *last = [NSString stringWithContentsOfFile:[path stringByAppendingString:@".reminded"] encoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding error:nil];
    if ([last hasPrefix:@"never"]) return 0;
    NSUInteger rows = totk_contrib_read(path).count;
    NSUInteger at = last ? (NSUInteger)strtoull(last.UTF8String, NULL, 10) : 0;
    return rows >= at + TOTK_CONTRIB_STEP ? rows : 0;
}
static inline void totk_contrib_reminded(NSString *path, NSUInteger rows) {
    [[NSString stringWithFormat:@"%lu\n", (unsigned long)rows] writeToFile:[path stringByAppendingString:@".reminded"]
                                                                 atomically:YES encoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding error:nil];
}
/* "Don't remind me again": no more reminders for this file. The game still notes the shaders. */
static inline void totk_contrib_never(NSString *path) {
    [@"never\n" writeToFile:[path stringByAppendingString:@".reminded"] atomically:YES encoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding error:nil];
}

/* Compact JSON with keys in code-point order, as scripts/shader_list.py canonical() writes it (Python's json.dumps with
   sort_keys; NSJSONWritingSortedKeys would put "9" before "10"). Deps hold only dictionaries and strings. */
static inline void totk_contrib_json(NSMutableString *out, id value) {
    if ([value isKindOfClass:[NSDictionary class]]) {
        NSArray *keys = [[value allKeys] sortedArrayUsingComparator:^NSComparisonResult(NSString *a, NSString *b) { return [a compare:b options:NSLiteralSearch]; }];
        [out appendString:@"{"];
        for (NSUInteger i = 0; i < keys.count; i++) {
            if (i) [out appendString:@","];
            totk_contrib_json(out, keys[i]); [out appendString:@":"]; totk_contrib_json(out, value[keys[i]]);
        }
        [out appendString:@"}"];
        return;
    }
    NSString *text = [value description];
    [out appendString:@"\""];
    for (NSUInteger i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
        unichar c = [text characterAtIndex:i];
        if (c == '"' || c == '\\') [out appendFormat:@"\\%C", c];
        else if (c < 0x20 || c > 0x7f) [out appendFormat:@"\\u%04x", c];
        else [out appendFormat:@"%C", c];
    }
    [out appendString:@"\""];
}

/* Adds the shader with these bind-state answers or translator deps (only tex / img / attr / fout are kept), once.
   Not thread-safe: the runtime calls it under its translation lock. */
static inline void totk_contrib_add(NSString *shader, NSDictionary *deps) {
    static NSString *path; static NSMutableSet<NSString *> *rows; static int off;
    if (off) return;
    if (!rows) {
        path = totk_contrib_path();
        if (!path) { off = 1; return; }
        rows = totk_contrib_read(path);
    }
    NSMutableDictionary *kept = [NSMutableDictionary dictionary];
    for (NSString *kind in @[@"tex", @"img", @"attr", @"fout"])
        if ([deps[kind] isKindOfClass:[NSDictionary class]]) kept[kind] = deps[kind];
    NSMutableString *row = [NSMutableString stringWithFormat:@"%@\t", shader];
    totk_contrib_json(row, kept);
    if ([rows containsObject:row]) return;
    FILE *f = fopen(path.fileSystemRepresentation, "a");
    if (!f) return;
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    if (ftell(f) == 0)
        fputs("# Shaders this game met that the shared shader list does not have yet (docs/shader-list.md).\n"
              "# Only shader keys and bind states: no game data, saves or personal information.\n"
              "# Send it in a GitHub issue: " TOTK_CONTRIB_ISSUE_URL "\n", f);
    fprintf(f, "V\t%s\n", row.UTF8String);
    fclose(f);
    [rows addObject:row];
}
