```m
// TOTK: runtime shader translation. A shader is identified by SHA-256(control section + code area) (nvn_mtl.m ctl_key_len: 0x880 of control, or its own smaller size); each
// translation ("variant") also records the translator answers it depended on (texture slot types, vertex
// input and colour output component types). A variant is reused only when those answers match the current
// bound state; otherwise a new one is produced by the translation service and cached on disk: the native program
// build/shader-service/totk_xlate --service when it is there (tools/totk_xlate/Service.cs, NativeAOT: no Python, no .NET
// runtime; 2026-10-17), else scripts/shader_service.py with the .NET translator. Same requests, replies and cache files.
#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>
#include "totk_ui_lang.h"
#include <TargetConditionals.h>
#include "totk_shader_rt.h"
#include "dm_signpost.h"
#include "dmsh_chain.h"
#include "../../host/hle.h"
#include <CommonCrypto/CommonDigest.h>
#include <mach-o/dyld.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <spawn.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <dirent.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include "totk_shader_seed.h"
#include "totk_shader_contrib.h"
extern void runtime_boot_status(const char *,const char *) __attribute__((weak_import));
extern void runtime_boot_count(const char *,uint64_t,uint64_t) __attribute__((weak_import));
static void seed_progress(int pass, NSUInteger done, NSUInteger total) {   // the bar under "Checking the shader cache"
    if (runtime_boot_count) runtime_boot_count(pass ? TOTK_UI("导入随 App 准备的着色器","Importing the app's shaders")
                                                    : TOTK_UI("校验随 App 准备的着色器","Verifying the app's shaders"), done, total);
}
int totk_depth_near_minus_w(void);   // hle_nvn.c: 1 when the game selected NVN_DEPTH_MODE_NEAR_IS_MINUS_W
uint64_t dm_nvn_frame_count(void);

extern char **environ;
static pthread_mutex_t g_rt_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static NSMutableDictionary<NSString *, NSMutableArray<NSDictionary *> *> *g_variants;
static NSMutableSet<NSString *> *g_msl_checked;
static FILE *g_svc_in, *g_svc_out;
static NSString *g_root, *g_dir;
static uint64_t g_translated;
/* The bottom-left box (nvn_mtl.m shader_overlay_prepare): variants new to the cache this run, when the last one came,
   and the variants in the cache (counted once in the background, plus the new ones since). */
static _Atomic uint64_t g_new_variants, g_new_variant_ns, g_new_at_count;
static _Atomic int64_t g_cached_variants = -1;

static NSString *root_dir(void) {   // native-port/ (the executable lives in native-port/build/)
    if (g_root) return g_root;
    char path[4096]; uint32_t n = sizeof path;
    if (_NSGetExecutablePath(path, &n)) die("executable path too long");
    g_root = [[[@(path) stringByResolvingSymlinksInPath] stringByDeletingLastPathComponent] stringByDeletingLastPathComponent];
    return g_root;
}
NSString *totk_rt_dir(void) {
    static dispatch_once_t once;
    dispatch_once(&once, ^{
        const char *e = getenv("TOTK_SHADER_CACHE");
#if TARGET_OS_IPHONE
        g_dir = e ? @(e) : [NSString stringWithFormat:@"shader-cache/rt-%s", DMSH_CHAIN];   // in Documents (the app's working directory)
#else
        g_dir = e ? @(e) : [root_dir() stringByAppendingFormat:@"/build/shader-cache/rt-%s", DMSH_CHAIN];
#endif
        [NSFileManager.defaultManager createDirectoryAtPath:g_dir withIntermediateDirectories:YES attributes:nil error:nil];
        const char *seedMode = getenv("TOTK_SHADER_SEED");
        if (!(seedMode && !strcmp(seedMode, "off"))) {
            NSError *error = nil;
            if (runtime_boot_status) runtime_boot_status(TOTK_UI("检查着色器缓存","Checking the shader cache"),TOTK_UI("校验 App 附带的着色器，并按需导入本机缓存","Verifying the shaders bundled with the app and importing them into the local cache if needed"));
            const char *seedPath = getenv("TOTK_SHADER_SEED_DIR");
            NSString *source = seedPath ? @(seedPath) : [root_dir() stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"build/shader-seed"];
            totk_seed_progress = seed_progress;
            NSDictionary *seed = totk_seed_import(source, g_dir, &error);
            totk_seed_progress = NULL;
            if (!seed) {   // 2026-10-18: a damaged bundle or a full disk used to end the game here with nothing on screen. The
                           // cache stays usable (totk_seed_import writes shader files before the indexes that name them),
                           // so play on and translate shaders as they first appear, as before the prepared shaders existed.
                LOG("[shader-seed] 【红】导入 App 附带的着色器失败：%s；改为边玩边翻译",
                    error ? error.localizedDescription.UTF8String : "unknown error");
                if (runtime_boot_status) runtime_boot_status(TOTK_UI("着色器缓存未就绪","Shader cache not ready"),TOTK_UI("App 附带的着色器导入失败，改为边玩边翻译","Could not import the shaders bundled with the app; shaders are translated during play"));
                seed = @{@"available": @NO, @"failed": @YES};
            }
            if ([seed[@"available"] boolValue]) {
                unsigned long long imported=[seed[@"imported_files"] unsignedLongLongValue];
                LOG("[shader-seed] 发现随 App 准备的着色器 %llu 个，导入 %llu 个文件；首次启动即可预热",
                    [seed[@"shaders"] unsignedLongLongValue], imported);
                if (runtime_boot_status) runtime_boot_status(TOTK_UI("着色器缓存已就绪","Shader cache ready"),imported
                    ? [NSString stringWithFormat:@(TOTK_UI("已导入 %llu 个预置文件，开始预热","Imported %llu prepared files; starting warm-up")),imported].UTF8String
                    : TOTK_UI("本机缓存已存在，无需重新导入；开始预热","Local cache already present, nothing to import; starting warm-up"));
            } else if (runtime_boot_status && ![seed[@"failed"] boolValue]) runtime_boot_status(TOTK_UI("着色器缓存已就绪","Shader cache ready"),TOTK_UI("没有内置着色器种子，继续初始化图形","No bundled shader seed; continuing graphics setup"));
        }
#if TARGET_OS_IPHONE
        // Variants that ios/tools/fill_shaders.py translated on the Mac for this device's earlier misses (shader-requests/).
        NSDictionary *fill = totk_fill_import(@"shader-fill", g_dir);
        if ([fill[@"packs"] unsignedIntegerValue]) LOG("[shader-fill] 合并 Mac 补译的着色器包 %lu 个，导入 %lu 个文件",
            (unsigned long)[fill[@"packs"] unsignedIntegerValue], (unsigned long)[fill[@"imported_files"] unsignedIntegerValue]);
        for (NSString *why in fill[@"rejected"]) LOG("【红】[shader-fill] 丢弃不完整的着色器包 %s（请在 Mac 上重新运行 fill_shaders.py）", why.UTF8String);
#endif
    });
    return g_dir;
}

static void service_spawn(FILE **svc_in, FILE **svc_out) {
    NSString *r = root_dir();
    int to[2], from[2];
    if (pipe(to) || pipe(from)) die("shader service pipes");
    posix_spawn_file_actions_t fa; posix_spawn_file_actions_init(&fa);
    posix_spawn_file_actions_adddup2(&fa, to[0], 0); posix_spawn_file_actions_adddup2(&fa, from[1], 1);
    posix_spawn_file_actions_addclose(&fa, to[1]); posix_spawn_file_actions_addclose(&fa, from[0]);
    /* Only stdin / stdout (its own pipes) and stderr reach the service. Without this every worker inherited the earlier
       workers' pipe ends, so after the game exited each kept another's stdin open, never read EOF and lived on (35
       orphaned translators by 22 October 08:20, all holding Metal's shader cache open). */
    posix_spawn_file_actions_addinherit_np(&fa, 2);
    posix_spawnattr_t sa; posix_spawnattr_init(&sa); sigset_t none; sigemptyset(&none); posix_spawnattr_setsigmask(&sa, &none);
    // From games/totk: a service started from a GCD thread would inherit its blocked SIGCHLD and wait for spirv-cross for ever
    posix_spawnattr_setflags(&sa, POSIX_SPAWN_CLOEXEC_DEFAULT | POSIX_SPAWN_SETSIGMASK);
    NSString *sc = [r stringByAppendingString:@"/build/spirv-cross/spirv-cross"];
    // TOTK_SHADER_XLATE=<totk_xlate.dll> runs a trial translator build (e.g. build/totk_xlate-opt) without replacing the
    // shared one (through shader_service.py); TOTK_SHADER_DEBUGMODE=0|1 reaches either service through the environment.
    // TOTK_SHADER_SERVICE=python | native picks the service (default: native when build/shader-service/totk_xlate is there).
    const char *xe = getenv("TOTK_SHADER_XLATE"), *want = getenv("TOTK_SHADER_SERVICE"), *dm = getenv("TOTK_SHADER_DEBUGMODE");
    NSString *native = [r stringByAppendingString:@"/build/shader-service/totk_xlate"];
    int have_native = access(native.fileSystemRepresentation, X_OK) == 0;
    int use_native = have_native && !(xe && *xe) && !(want && !strcmp(want, "python"));
    if (want && !strcmp(want, "native") && !use_native) die("TOTK_SHADER_SERVICE=native but %s is not there (make shader-service)", native.UTF8String);
    pid_t pid;
    if (use_native) {
        const char *argv[] = {native.UTF8String, "--service", "--spirv-cross", sc.UTF8String, "--out", totk_rt_dir().UTF8String,
                              "--chain", DMSH_CHAIN, NULL};
        if (posix_spawn(&pid, argv[0], &fa, &sa, (char *const *)argv, environ)) die("start shader service %s", argv[0]);
        if (dm) LOG("[shader] native translator, DebugMode %s", dm);
    } else {
        NSString *script = [r stringByAppendingString:@"/scripts/shader_service.py"], *dotnet = [r stringByAppendingString:@"/tooling/dotnet/dotnet"];
        NSString *xlate = xe && *xe ? @(xe) : [r stringByAppendingString:@"/build/totk_xlate/totk_xlate.dll"];
        const char *argv[] = {"python3", "-I", script.UTF8String, "--dotnet", dotnet.UTF8String, "--xlate", xlate.UTF8String,
                              "--spirv-cross", sc.UTF8String, "--out", totk_rt_dir().UTF8String, "--chain", DMSH_CHAIN, NULL};
        if (posix_spawnp(&pid, "python3", &fa, &sa, (char *const *)argv, environ)) die("start shader service");
        if (xe || dm) LOG("[shader] translator %s, DebugMode %s", xlate.UTF8String, dm ? dm : "default");
    }
    posix_spawn_file_actions_destroy(&fa); posix_spawnattr_destroy(&sa);
    close(to[0]); close(from[1]);
    *svc_in = fdopen(to[1], "w"); *svc_out = fdopen(from[0], "r");
    if (!*svc_in || !*svc_out) die("shader service streams");
    LOG("[shader] runtime translation service started (pid %d, %s), cache %s", pid,
        use_native ? "native build/shader-service/totk_xlate" : "python3 scripts/shader_service.py + .NET", totk_rt_dir().UTF8String);
}
static void service_start(void) { if (!g_svc_in) service_spawn(&g_svc_in, &g_svc_out); }


static NSString *hex(const uint8_t *p, size_t n) {
    NSMutableString *s = [NSMutableString stringWithCapacity:n * 2];
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) [s appendFormat:@"%02x", p[i]];
    return s;
}
static NSString *json_string(id obj) {
    NSData *d = [NSJSONSerialization dataWithJSONObject:obj options:NSJSONWritingSortedKeys error:nil];
    if (!d) die("shader request JSON");
    return [[NSString alloc] initWithData:d encoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding];
}
static NSString *index_path(NSString *shader) { return [totk_rt_dir() stringByAppendingFormat:@"/%@.variants", shader]; }
/* Keep one record per variant. Last record wins: it contains the newest dependency metadata. */
static NSMutableArray *unique_variants(NSArray *records) {
    NSMutableArray *out = [NSMutableArray array]; NSMutableDictionary *positions = [NSMutableDictionary dictionary];
    for (id record in records) {
        if (![record isKindOfClass:NSDictionary.class]) continue;
        id key = record[@"variant"]; if (![key isKindOfClass:NSString.class] || ![key length]) continue;
        NSNumber *position = positions[key];
        if (position) out[position.unsignedIntegerValue] = record;
        else { positions[key] = @(out.count); [out addObject:record]; }
    }
    return out;
}
static void variant_put(NSMutableArray *records, NSDictionary *record) {
    for (NSUInteger i = 0; i < records.count; i++) if ([records[i][@"variant"] isEqual:record[@"variant"]]) { records[i] = record; return; }
    [records addObject:record];
}
static NSMutableArray *variants_of(NSString *shader) {
    if (!g_variants) g_variants = [NSMutableDictionary dictionary];
    NSMutableArray *v = g_variants[shader];
    if (v) return v;
    NSData *d = [NSData dataWithContentsOfFile:index_path(shader)];
    NSArray *a = d ? [NSJSONSerialization JSONObjectWithData:d options:0 error:nil] : nil;
    v = unique_variants([a isKindOfClass:NSArray.class] ? a : @[]);
    if ([a isKindOfClass:NSArray.class] && v.count != a.count)
        [[json_string(v) dataUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding] writeToFile:index_path(shader) atomically:YES];
    g_variants[shader] = v;
    return v;
}
static int deps_match(NSDictionary *deps, NSDictionary *ans) {
    NSDictionary *defaults = @{@"tex": @"2d", @"img": @{}, @"attr": @"float", @"fout": @"float"};
    for (NSString *kind in defaults) {
        NSDictionary *want = deps[kind], *have = ans[kind];
        for (NSString *slot in want) {
            id w = want[slot], h = have[slot];
            if (!h && [kind isEqualToString:@"attr"]) continue;
            if (!h) h = defaults[kind];
            if ([w isEqual:@"*"] || [w isEqual:@"*_depth"]) {
                if (![h isKindOfClass:NSString.class] || [h hasSuffix:@"_depth"] != [w isEqual:@"*_depth"]) return 0;
                continue;
            }
            if (![h isEqual:w]) return 0;
        }
    }
    return 1;
}

/* No translator: the iPhone / iPad, or TOTK_SHADER_NO_TRANSLATE=1 on the Mac (tests: what a device with only the prepared
   shaders would skip, with the same miss records and skipped draws). */
static int no_translator(void) {
#if TARGET_OS_IPHONE
    return 1;
#else
    static int v = -1;
    if (v < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_SHADER_NO_TRANSLATE"); v = e && !strcmp(e, "1"); }
    return v;
#endif
}
/* Odyssey (2026-10-22): TOTK_SHADER_ASYNC=1 translates a variant that is not in the cache on background services instead
   of the submit thread, which otherwise stops presenting for ~0.3 s per new variant (a scene load needed 100+). Default on
   for Odyssey builds. Only a caller that may skip its draw (may_defer: nvn_mtl.m draw_may_skip) gets nil while the job
   runs; it looks again whenever totk_rt_completed() has moved. A caller whose result outlives the frame takes a queued job
   back and translates it in place, or waits for a running one (upstream bfdd085; without this a cold cache left Cap
   Kingdom black: a cube map drawn once at load was skipped and never redrawn). TOTK_SHADER_WORKERS services (default 4).
   A failed variant stays skipped. */
static int rt_async(void) {
#if TARGET_OS_IPHONE
    return 0;
#else
    static int v = -1;
#ifdef GAME_ODYSSEY   /* default on: without it the post-intro load stops presenting (22 October); TOTK_SHADER_ASYNC=0 for the old path */
    if (v < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_SHADER_ASYNC"); v = !e || atoi(e) > 0; }
#else
    if (v < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_SHADER_ASYNC"); v = e && atoi(e) > 0; }
#endif
    return v;
#endif
}
static NSMutableSet<NSString *> *g_pending, *g_failed;   // variants queued or being translated / that failed (g_rt_lock)
static NSMutableArray<NSDictionary *> *g_jobs;            // g_job_lock
static pthread_mutex_t g_job_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static pthread_cond_t g_job_cond = PTHREAD_COND_INITIALIZER;
static pthread_cond_t g_done_cond = PTHREAD_COND_INITIALIZER;   // signalled (with g_rt_lock) when a background job has been recorded
static _Atomic uint64_t g_completed;
uint64_t totk_rt_completed(void) { return atomic_load(&g_completed); }
int totk_rt_async_on(void) { return rt_async(); }
static NSDictionary *variant_record(NSString *variant, BOOL depth_minus_w) {   // after a translation: its index entry
    NSData *jd = [NSData dataWithContentsOfFile:[totk_rt_dir() stringByAppendingFormat:@"/%@_b.json", variant]];
    NSDictionary *refl = jd ? [NSJSONSerialization JSONObjectWithData:jd options:0 error:nil] : nil;
    if (![refl isKindOfClass:[NSDictionary class]]) die("shader %s: reflection missing", variant.UTF8String);
    return @{@"variant": variant, @"deps": refl[@"deps"] ?: @{}, @"depth_minus_w": @(depth_minus_w)};
}
static void *async_worker(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    FILE *in, *out; service_spawn(&in, &out);
    for (;;) @autoreleasepool {
        pthread_mutex_lock(&g_job_lock);
        while (!g_jobs.count) pthread_cond_wait(&g_job_cond, &g_job_lock);
        NSDictionary *job = g_jobs.firstObject; [g_jobs removeObjectAtIndex:0];
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_job_lock);
        NSDictionary *rq = job[@"rq"]; NSString *variant = rq[@"variant"], *shader = job[@"shader"];
        uint64_t started = clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW);
        fprintf(in, "%s\n", json_string(rq).UTF8String); fflush(in);
        char line[2048];
        if (!fgets(line, sizeof line, out)) die("shader service exited while translating %s", variant.UTF8String);
        NSDictionary *reply = [NSJSONSerialization JSONObjectWithData:[NSData dataWithBytes:line length:strlen(line)] options:0 error:nil];
        BOOL ok = [reply[@"ok"] boolValue];
        NSDictionary *rec = ok ? variant_record(variant, [rq[@"depth_minus_w"] boolValue]) : nil;
        pthread_mutex_lock(&g_rt_lock);
        [g_pending removeObject:variant];
        if (ok) {
            NSMutableArray *vs = variants_of(shader);
            variant_put(vs, rec);
            [g_msl_checked addObject:variant];
            [[json_string(vs) dataUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding] writeToFile:index_path(shader) atomically:YES];
            g_translated++;
            if (![job[@"existed"] boolValue]) {
                atomic_fetch_add(&g_new_variants, 1); atomic_store(&g_new_variant_ns, clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW));
                totk_contrib_add(shader, rec[@"deps"]);
            }
            if (g_translated <= 8 || g_translated % 100 == 0)
                LOG("[shader] translated %llu (async, %.0f ms, %lu queued): %s %s", (unsigned long long)g_translated,
                    (clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW) - started) / 1e6, (unsigned long)g_pending.count,
                    [rq[@"stage"] UTF8String], variant.UTF8String);
        } else {
            [g_failed addObject:variant];
            LOG("【红】[shader] async translation FAILED %s %s: %s (its draws stay skipped)", [rq[@"stage"] UTF8String],
                variant.UTF8String, [[reply[@"error"] description] UTF8String]);
        }
        atomic_fetch_add(&g_completed, 1);
        pthread_cond_broadcast(&g_done_cond);
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_rt_lock);
    }
    return NULL;
}
static int async_take_back(NSString *variant) {   // called with g_rt_lock held: 1 when the job had not started and is removed
    int taken = 0;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_job_lock);
    for (NSUInteger i = 0; i < g_jobs.count; i++)
        if ([g_jobs[i][@"rq"][@"variant"] isEqualToString:variant]) { [g_jobs removeObjectAtIndex:i]; taken = 1; break; }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_job_lock);
    return taken;
}
static void async_enqueue(NSDictionary *job) {   // called with g_rt_lock held
    static dispatch_once_t once;
    dispatch_once(&once, ^{
        g_jobs = [NSMutableArray array];
        const char *e = getenv("TOTK_SHADER_WORKERS"); int n = e ? atoi(e) : 4; if (n < 1) n = 1; if (n > 16) n = 16;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { pthread_t th; if (pthread_create(&th, NULL, async_worker, NULL)) die("shader worker thread"); pthread_detach(th); }
        LOG("[shader] async translation: %d background services", n);
    });
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_job_lock); [g_jobs addObject:job]; pthread_cond_signal(&g_job_cond); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_job_lock);
}
NSString *totk_rt_variant(NSString *shader, int stage, const uint8_t *control, const uint8_t *code, NSDictionary *answers, NSArray *local, int may_defer) {
    uint64_t started = clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_rt_lock);
    NSMutableArray *vs = variants_of(shader);
    BOOL depth_minus_w = stage == 0 && totk_depth_near_minus_w();
    for (NSUInteger i = 0; i < vs.count; i++) {
        NSDictionary *v = vs[i];
        if (stage == 0 && [v[@"depth_minus_w"] boolValue] != depth_minus_w) continue;
        if (!deps_match(v[@"deps"], answers)) continue;
        NSString *found = v[@"variant"];
        if (!g_msl_checked) g_msl_checked = [NSMutableSet set];
        BOOL checked = [g_msl_checked containsObject:found];
        NSString *msl = checked ? nil :
            [NSString stringWithContentsOfFile:[totk_rt_dir() stringByAppendingFormat:@"/%@_b.metal", found]
                                             encoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding error:nil];
        if (!checked && (!msl || [msl containsString:@"double "] || [msl containsString:@"unsupported_GLSLstd450"])) {
            [vs removeObjectAtIndex:i];  /* regenerate missing or previously un-compilable Metal variant */
            break;
        }
        [g_msl_checked addObject:found];
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_rt_lock);
        return found;
    }
    uint32_t c1o, c1t; memcpy(&c1o, control + 0x700, 4); memcpy(&c1t, control + 0x704, 4);
    if (!c1t || c1t > 16u << 20 || c1o > c1t || (stage != 5 && c1o < 0x30)) die("shader %s: code area %#x / c1 %#x", shader.UTF8String, c1t, c1o);
    NSString *stage_name = stage == 0 ? @"vs" : stage == 1 ? @"ps" : stage == 5 ? @"cs" : nil;
    if (!stage_name) die("shader %s: NVN stage %d has no translation chain (tessellation/geometry)", shader.UTF8String, stage);
    uint8_t md[32]; NSMutableDictionary *key = [answers mutableCopy];
    if (stage == 0) key[@"depth_minus_w"] = @(depth_minus_w);
    NSData *ad = [json_string(key) dataUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding]; CC_SHA256(ad.bytes, (CC_LONG)ad.length, md);
    NSString *variant = [NSString stringWithFormat:@"%@-%@", shader, hex(md, 6)];
    if (rt_async() && [g_failed containsObject:variant]) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_rt_lock); return nil; }
    if (rt_async() && [g_pending containsObject:variant]) {
        if (may_defer) { pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_rt_lock); return nil; }
        if (async_take_back(variant)) [g_pending removeObject:variant];   // not started: translate it here, now
        else {   // running: wait until it is recorded, then look it up again
            while ([g_pending containsObject:variant]) pthread_cond_wait(&g_done_cond, &g_rt_lock);
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_rt_lock);
            return totk_rt_variant(shader, stage, control, code, answers, local, may_defer);
        }
    }
    NSString *code_path = [totk_rt_dir() stringByAppendingFormat:@"/%@.code", variant];
    // Graphics code drops the 0x30-byte NVN header (the translator wants SPH + instructions); compute keeps it, as in D2R's build.
    size_t skip = stage == 5 ? 0 : 0x30;
    if (![[NSData dataWithBytes:code + skip length:c1t - skip] writeToFile:code_path atomically:YES]) die("write shader code %s", code_path.UTF8String);
    NSMutableDictionary *rq = [NSMutableDictionary dictionaryWithDictionary:@{@"variant": variant, @"stage": stage_name, @"code": code_path, @"c1": hex(code + c1o, c1t - c1o)}];
    [rq addEntriesFromDictionary:answers];
    if (local) rq[@"local"] = local;
    rq[@"depth_minus_w"] = depth_minus_w ? @YES : @NO;   // nvnDeviceSetDepthMode: NEAR_IS_MINUS_W needs the GL -> Metal clip-z conversion in every vertex shader
    if (no_translator()) {
    // No translator on the phone (Python + .NET + SPIRV-Cross): the variant cache is translated on the Mac and copied over.
    // A miss records the complete request (with the guest code bytes) under shader-requests/ for ios/tools/fill_shaders.py.
    rq[@"code_hex"] = hex(code + skip, c1t - skip);
    [NSFileManager.defaultManager createDirectoryAtPath:@"shader-requests" withIntermediateDirectories:YES attributes:nil error:nil];
    /* A miss no longer stops the game: the caller skips the draws / dispatches that need this variant (draw-skip reason
       "shader-missing"). The request is written once per variant; after fill_shaders.py pushed the translation, the next
       start compiles it in the background (totk_rt_warm_filled) and moves the request to shader-requests/done/. */
    static NSMutableSet<NSString *> *missed; if (!missed) missed = [NSMutableSet set];
    if (![missed containsObject:variant]) {
        [missed addObject:variant];
        [[json_string(rq) dataUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding] writeToFile:[NSString stringWithFormat:@"shader-requests/%@.json", variant] atomically:YES];
        totk_contrib_add(shader, answers);   // not in the prepared seed, so not in the shared shader list yet
        LOG("[shader-miss] %s %s 不在手机的翻译缓存里：跳过用到它的绘制，请求已存 shader-requests/（第 %lu 个；在 Mac 上 ios/tools/fill_shaders.py 补上后下次启动预热）",
            stage_name.UTF8String, variant.UTF8String, (unsigned long)missed.count);
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_rt_lock);
    return nil;
    }
    BOOL existed = [NSFileManager.defaultManager fileExistsAtPath:[totk_rt_dir() stringByAppendingFormat:@"/%@_b.metal", variant]];   // a re-translation of a broken variant is not a new one
    if (rt_async() && may_defer) {
        if (!g_pending) { g_pending = [NSMutableSet set]; g_failed = [NSMutableSet set]; }
        if (!g_msl_checked) g_msl_checked = [NSMutableSet set];
        [g_pending addObject:variant];
        async_enqueue(@{@"rq": rq, @"shader": shader, @"existed": @(existed)});
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_rt_lock);
        return nil;
    }
    service_start();
    DM_SP_BEGIN(sp, "shader-translate", "%{public}s %{public}s", stage_name.UTF8String, variant.UTF8String);   // Odyssey: synchronous translation on the calling thread
    fprintf(g_svc_in, "%s\n", json_string(rq).UTF8String); fflush(g_svc_in);
    char line[2048];
    if (!fgets(line, sizeof line, g_svc_out)) die("shader service exited while translating %s", variant.UTF8String);
    DM_SP_END(sp, "shader-translate");
    NSDictionary *reply = [NSJSONSerialization JSONObjectWithData:[NSData dataWithBytes:line length:strlen(line)] options:0 error:nil];
    if (![reply[@"ok"] boolValue]) {
        LOG("[survey-shader] frame %llu translation FAILED %s %s after %.2f ms: %s",
            (unsigned long long)dm_nvn_frame_count(), stage_name.UTF8String, variant.UTF8String,
            (clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW) - started) / 1e6, [[reply[@"error"] description] UTF8String]);
        die("shader %s (%s) translation failed: %s", variant.UTF8String, stage_name.UTF8String, [[reply[@"error"] description] UTF8String]);
    }
    NSData *jd = [NSData dataWithContentsOfFile:[totk_rt_dir() stringByAppendingFormat:@"/%@_b.json", variant]];
    NSDictionary *refl = jd ? [NSJSONSerialization JSONObjectWithData:jd options:0 error:nil] : nil;
    if (![refl isKindOfClass:[NSDictionary class]]) die("shader %s: reflection missing", variant.UTF8String);
    variant_put(vs, @{@"variant": variant, @"deps": refl[@"deps"] ?: @{}, @"depth_minus_w": @(depth_minus_w)});
    [g_msl_checked addObject:variant];
    [[json_string(vs) dataUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding] writeToFile:index_path(shader) atomically:YES];
    g_translated++;
    if (!existed) { atomic_fetch_add(&g_new_variants, 1); atomic_store(&g_new_variant_ns, clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW)); }   // discovered, translated, in the cache
    if (!existed) totk_contrib_add(shader, refl[@"deps"] ?: @{});   // the seed would have had it if the shared list named it
    if (getenv("TOTK_SURVEY_SHADER_LOG")) LOG("[survey-shader] frame %llu translated %s %s in %.2f ms%s",
        (unsigned long long)dm_nvn_frame_count(), stage_name.UTF8String, variant.UTF8String,
        (clock_gettime_nsec_np(CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW) - started) / 1e6,
        [refl[@"softfloat64"] boolValue] ? " (FP64 fallback)" : "");
    if (g_translated <= 8 || g_translated % 100 == 0) LOG("[shader] translated %llu: %s %s", (unsigned long long)g_translated, stage_name.UTF8String, variant.UTF8String);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_rt_lock);
    return variant;
}

NSArray<NSString *> *totk_rt_known_variants(NSString *shader) {
    NSMutableArray<NSString *> *out = [NSMutableArray array];
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_rt_lock);
    for (NSDictionary *v in variants_of(shader))
        if ([v isKindOfClass:NSDictionary.class] && [v[@"variant"] isKindOfClass:NSString.class]) [out addObject:v[@"variant"]];
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_rt_lock);
    return out;
}

void totk_rt_counts(uint64_t *fresh, int64_t *total, uint64_t *last_new_ns) {
    static dispatch_once_t once;
    dispatch_once(&once, ^{
        NSString *dir = totk_rt_dir();
        atomic_store(&g_new_at_count, atomic_load(&g_new_variants));
        dispatch_async(dispatch_get_global_queue(QOS_CLASS_UTILITY, 0), ^{   // ~45,000 directory entries: not on the present thread
            int64_t n = 0; DIR *d = opendir(dir.fileSystemRepresentation); struct dirent *e;
            if (d) { while ((e = readdir(d))) { size_t l = strlen(e->d_name); if (l > 8 && !strcmp(e->d_name + l - 8, "_b.metal")) n++; } closedir(d); }
            atomic_store(&g_cached_variants, n);
        });
    });
    uint64_t f = atomic_load(&g_new_variants); int64_t t = atomic_load(&g_cached_variants);
    if (fresh) *fresh = f;
    if (total) *total = t < 0 ? -1 : t + (int64_t)(f - atomic_load(&g_new_at_count));
    if (last_new_ns) *last_new_ns = atomic_load(&g_new_variant_ns);
}

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/totk_shader_seed.h`:

```h
// Import the app's game-derived startup shaders into writable user storage.
// Kept independent of the renderer so validation can run without a GPU/game.
#pragma once
#import <Foundation/Foundation.h>
#include <dirent.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <sys/clonefile.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <CommonCrypto/CommonDigest.h>
#include "dmsh_chain.h"

static NSString *totk_seed_hash(NSData *data) {
    unsigned char bytes[CC_SHA256_DIGEST_LENGTH];
    CC_SHA256(data.bytes, (CC_LONG)data.length, bytes);
    NSMutableString *s = [NSMutableString stringWithCapacity:64];
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof bytes; i++) [s appendFormat:@"%02x", bytes[i]];
    return s;
}

// What the cache receipt names: the translation chain, the shader count and the file table (name -> SHA-256) the cache got.
// The preparation's own fields (how long it took, the preparing script's hash) change with every packaging; a hash of the
// raw manifest made a repackaged app with the same shaders check all 24,871 files again on its first start (10-18 s, 2026-10-18).
static NSString *totk_seed_fingerprint(NSDictionary *m, NSArray<NSString *> *names) {
    NSDictionary *files = m[@"files"];
    NSMutableString *s = [NSMutableString stringWithFormat:@"chain %@\nschema %@\nshaders %@\n", m[@"chain"], m[@"schema"], m[@"shaders"]];
    for (NSString *name in names) [s appendFormat:@"%@ %@\n", name, files[name]];
    return totk_seed_hash([s dataUsingEncoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding]);
}

// Progress of a running import, pass 0 checking the source, pass 1 copying it (tens of thousands of files: minutes on a
// phone); set by the runtime (totk_shader_rt.m), nil in tests.
static void (*totk_seed_progress)(int pass, NSUInteger done, NSUInteger total);

// Odyssey (22 October 2026, after upstream 8e53dc5): the first start after packaging spent 32 s hashing and 80 s cloning
// the 129,602 seed files one by one. The hashes are now checked on every core (blocks of 4,096 files, progress between
// blocks), and the import is one clone of the whole seed folder into a sibling of the cache. The entries already in the
// cache are cloned over it (.variants merged, the cache's other files and folders winning over the seed's, except a
// different .metallib, as in the per-file path) and the two folders are swapped atomically (renamex_np RENAME_SWAP), so
// the cache is never missing or half merged. Upstream clones only into an empty cache. NO: nothing changed (another
// volume, a failed clone or merge); the caller imports file by file.
// The names in a folder. readdir, not NSFileManager: listing the 134k entries of a seeded cache took 7.7 s with
// contentsOfDirectoryAtPath and 0.9 s with readdir (22 October 2026).
static NSMutableSet<NSString *> *totk_seed_list(NSString *dir) {
    NSMutableSet<NSString *> *out = [NSMutableSet set];
    DIR *d = opendir(dir.fileSystemRepresentation); if (!d) return out;
    for (struct dirent *e; (e = readdir(d));) {
        if (!strcmp(e->d_name, ".") || !strcmp(e->d_name, "..")) continue;
        NSString *n = [[NSString alloc] initWithBytes:e->d_name length:e->d_namlen encoding:NSUTF8StringEncoding]; if (n) [out addObject:n];
    }
    closedir(d); return out;
}
static BOOL totk_seed_verify(NSString *source, NSArray<NSString *> *names, NSDictionary *files) {
    __block _Atomic int bad = 0; const NSUInteger block = 4096;
    for (NSUInteger start = 0; start < names.count && !atomic_load(&bad); start += block) {
        NSUInteger n = MIN(block, names.count - start);
        dispatch_apply(n, DISPATCH_APPLY_AUTO, ^(size_t i) { @autoreleasepool {
            if (atomic_load(&bad)) return;
            NSString *name = names[start + i];
            NSData *data = [NSData dataWithContentsOfFile:[source stringByAppendingPathComponent:name] options:NSDataReadingMappedIfSafe error:nil];
            if (!data || ![totk_seed_hash(data) isEqual:files[name]]) atomic_store(&bad, 1);
        } });
        if (totk_seed_progress) totk_seed_progress(0, start + n, names.count);
    }
    return !atomic_load(&bad);
}
static BOOL totk_seed_merge_variants(NSString *userPath, NSString *seedPath) {   // user rows first, then the seed's new ones
    NSData *u = [NSData dataWithContentsOfFile:userPath], *s = [NSData dataWithContentsOfFile:seedPath];
    id user = u ? [NSJSONSerialization JSONObjectWithData:u options:NSJSONReadingMutableContainers error:nil] : nil;
    id seed = s ? [NSJSONSerialization JSONObjectWithData:s options:0 error:nil] : nil;
    if (![user isKindOfClass:NSArray.class] || ![seed isKindOfClass:NSArray.class]) return NO;
    NSMutableArray *merged = user; NSMutableSet *known = [NSMutableSet set];
    for (id row in merged) if ([row isKindOfClass:NSDictionary.class] && row[@"variant"]) [known addObject:row[@"variant"]];
    for (id row in seed) {
        if (![row isKindOfClass:NSDictionary.class] || ![row[@"variant"] isKindOfClass:NSString.class] || ![row[@"deps"] isKindOfClass:NSDictionary.class]) return NO;
        if (![known containsObject:row[@"variant"]]) { [merged addObject:row]; [known addObject:row[@"variant"]]; }
    }
    NSData *out = [NSJSONSerialization dataWithJSONObject:merged options:NSJSONWritingSortedKeys error:nil];
    return out && [out writeToFile:seedPath options:NSDataWritingAtomic error:nil];
}
// `next`: the seed folder already cloned next to the cache (totk_seed_import_into starts that clone while the hashes
// are checked: 12.5 s of APFS metadata for 129,602 files, about as long as the checking).
static BOOL totk_seed_clone_merge(NSString *source, NSString *cache, NSString *next, NSSet<NSString *> *keep, NSUInteger *merged_out) {
    NSFileManager *fm = NSFileManager.defaultManager;
    chmod(next.fileSystemRepresentation, 0755);
    for (NSString *name in totk_seed_list(source))
        if (![keep containsObject:name]) [fm removeItemAtPath:[next stringByAppendingPathComponent:name] error:nil];
    NSUInteger merged = 0;
    for (NSString *name in totk_seed_list(cache)) {
        if ([name hasSuffix:@".import"] || [name hasPrefix:@"."]) continue;   // a per-file import's temporary leftover
        NSString *from = [cache stringByAppendingPathComponent:name], *to = [next stringByAppendingPathComponent:name];
        BOOL there = [fm fileExistsAtPath:to];
        if (there && [name hasSuffix:@".variants"]) {
            if (!totk_seed_merge_variants(from, to)) { [fm removeItemAtPath:next error:nil]; return NO; }
            merged++; continue;
        }
        if (there && [name hasSuffix:@".metallib"] && ![[NSData dataWithContentsOfFile:from] isEqualToData:[NSData dataWithContentsOfFile:to]]) continue;
        if (there) [fm removeItemAtPath:to error:nil];
        if (clonefile(from.fileSystemRepresentation, to.fileSystemRepresentation, CLONE_NOOWNERCOPY) && ![fm copyItemAtPath:from toPath:to error:nil]) {
            [fm removeItemAtPath:next error:nil]; return NO;
        }
        merged++;
    }
    if (renamex_np(next.fileSystemRepresentation, cache.fileSystemRepresentation, RENAME_SWAP)) { [fm removeItemAtPath:next error:nil]; return NO; }
    // `next` now holds the previous cache; everything in it was cloned over, so it goes in the background.
    dispatch_async(dispatch_get_global_queue(QOS_CLASS_UTILITY, 0), ^{ [NSFileManager.defaultManager removeItemAtPath:next error:nil]; });
    if (merged_out) *merged_out = merged;
    return YES;
}
// marker: a receipt in the cache that skips re-importing the same files; nil imports every time (fill packs).
static NSDictionary *totk_seed_import_into(NSString *source, NSString *cache, NSString *marker, NSError **error) {
    NSFileManager *fm = NSFileManager.defaultManager;
    NSString *manifestPath = [source stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"seed-manifest.json"];
    if (![fm fileExistsAtPath:manifestPath]) return @{@"available": @NO}; // development/older bundles
    NSData *raw = [NSData dataWithContentsOfFile:manifestPath options:0 error:error];
    NSDictionary *m = raw ? [NSJSONSerialization JSONObjectWithData:raw options:0 error:error] : nil;
    NSString *problem = nil;
    if (![m isKindOfClass:NSDictionary.class] || ![m[@"chain"] isEqual:@DMSH_CHAIN] ||
        ![m[@"schema"] isEqual:@1] || ![m[@"shaders"] isKindOfClass:NSNumber.class] || [m[@"shaders"] unsignedLongLongValue] == 0 ||
        ![m[@"files"] isKindOfClass:NSDictionary.class] || ![m[@"files"] count]) problem = @"Startup shader seed identity is invalid";
    if (problem) goto fail;
    {
        NSDictionary *files = m[@"files"];
        NSArray<NSString *> *names = [files.allKeys sortedArrayUsingSelector:@selector(compare:)];
        NSString *fingerprint = totk_seed_fingerprint(m, names);
        NSData *oldData = marker ? [NSData dataWithContentsOfFile:marker] : nil;
        NSDictionary *old = oldData ? [NSJSONSerialization JSONObjectWithData:oldData options:0 error:nil] : nil;
        NSRegularExpression *safe = [NSRegularExpression regularExpressionWithPattern:
            @"^(?:[0-9a-f]{64}\\.variants|[0-9a-f]{64}-[0-9a-f]{12}_b\\.(?:metal|json|metallib)|pso_manifest\\.tsv)$" options:0 error:nil];
        BOOL installed = [old isKindOfClass:NSDictionary.class] && [old[@"files_sha256"] isEqual:fingerprint];   // receipts from before 2026-10-18 (manifest_sha256) are checked once more
        // One listing of the cache instead of a stat per name: 129,602 fileExistsAtPath calls in a folder of 134k entries
        // took 16.5 s on every start (Odyssey, 22 October 2026); the listing takes well under a second.
        NSSet<NSString *> *present = installed ? totk_seed_list(cache) : nil;
        for (id name in names) {
            if (![name isKindOfClass:NSString.class] || ![safe numberOfMatchesInString:name options:0 range:NSMakeRange(0, [name length])]) {
                problem = @"Unsafe startup shader seed filename"; goto fail;
            }
            if (installed && ![present containsObject:name]) installed = NO;
        }
        if (installed) return @{@"available": @YES, @"shaders": m[@"shaders"], @"imported_files": @0};
        // Validate the complete source before changing any existing cache entry. The folder clone goes into a sibling of
        // the cache at the same time; it touches nothing the game uses and is discarded if a hash does not match.
        NSString *next = [cache stringByAppendingFormat:@".import-%d", getpid()];
        __block BOOL cloned = NO;
        dispatch_group_t cloning = dispatch_group_create();
        if (marker) {
            // Folders a previous start left (the old cache is removed in the background after the swap; quitting first leaves it).
            NSString *parent = cache.stringByDeletingLastPathComponent, *prefix = [cache.lastPathComponent stringByAppendingString:@".import-"];
            for (NSString *name in totk_seed_list(parent))
                if ([name hasPrefix:prefix]) [fm removeItemAtPath:[parent stringByAppendingPathComponent:name] error:nil];
            dispatch_group_async(cloning, dispatch_get_global_queue(QOS_CLASS_USER_INITIATED, 0), ^{
                cloned = !clonefile(source.fileSystemRepresentation, next.fileSystemRepresentation, CLONE_NOOWNERCOPY);
            });
        }
        BOOL verified = totk_seed_verify(source, names, files);
        dispatch_group_wait(cloning, DISPATCH_TIME_FOREVER);
        if (!verified) {
            if (cloned) [fm removeItemAtPath:next error:nil];
            problem = @"Startup shader seed integrity check failed"; goto fail;
        }
        if (![fm createDirectoryAtPath:cache withIntermediateDirectories:YES attributes:nil error:error]) return nil;
        NSUInteger kept = 0;
        if (cloned && totk_seed_clone_merge(source, cache, next, [NSSet setWithArray:names], &kept)) {
            NSData *receipt = [NSJSONSerialization dataWithJSONObject:@{@"files_sha256": fingerprint} options:0 error:error];
            if (!receipt || ![receipt writeToFile:marker options:NSDataWritingAtomic error:error]) return nil;
            if (totk_seed_progress) totk_seed_progress(1, names.count, names.count);
            return @{@"available": @YES, @"shaders": m[@"shaders"], @"imported_files": @(names.count), @"cloned_folder": @YES,
                     @"cache_entries_kept": @(kept)};
        }
        NSUInteger imported = 0, copied = 0;
        // Make shader files available before publishing their variant indexes.
        for (NSNumber *indexes in @[@NO, @YES]) for (NSString *name in names) {
            BOOL isIndex = [name hasSuffix:@".variants"];
            if (isIndex != indexes.boolValue) continue;
            if (totk_seed_progress && (++copied % 256 == 0 || copied == names.count)) totk_seed_progress(1, copied, names.count);
            NSString *target = [cache stringByAppendingPathComponent:name], *from = [source stringByAppendingPathComponent:name];
            if (!isIndex) {
                if ([fm fileExistsAtPath:target]) {
                    // Preserve shaders collected on this Mac. A device library (iOS) is only ever made from its source on
                    // the Mac, so a different one is a rebuild, e.g. with safe math instead of Metal's default fast math.
                    if (![name hasSuffix:@".metallib"]) continue;
                    NSData *data = [NSData dataWithContentsOfFile:from options:0 error:error];
                    if (!data) return nil;
                    if ([[NSData dataWithContentsOfFile:target] isEqualToData:data]) continue;
                }
                // Clone, not read and write: the app bundle and the cache share an APFS volume, so tens of thousands of
                // files cost metadata only (2026-10-19: reading and writing 44,744 took 59 s on an M4, two minutes on a
                // phone). Another volume falls back to a copy. A temporary name and a rename keep a half-written file
                // out of the cache.
                NSString *temp = [target stringByAppendingFormat:@".%d.import", getpid()];
                unlink(temp.fileSystemRepresentation);
                if (clonefile(from.fileSystemRepresentation, temp.fileSystemRepresentation, 0) &&
                    ![fm copyItemAtPath:from toPath:temp error:error]) return nil;
                if (rename(temp.fileSystemRepresentation, target.fileSystemRepresentation)) {
                    if (error) *error = [NSError errorWithDomain:NSPOSIXErrorDomain code:errno userInfo:nil];
                    unlink(temp.fileSystemRepresentation);
                    return nil;
                }
                imported++;
                continue;
            }
            NSData *data = [NSData dataWithContentsOfFile:from options:0 error:error];
            if (!data) return nil;
            {
                id seed = [NSJSONSerialization JSONObjectWithData:data options:NSJSONReadingMutableContainers error:error];
                NSData *existing = [NSData dataWithContentsOfFile:target];
                id user = existing ? [NSJSONSerialization JSONObjectWithData:existing options:NSJSONReadingMutableContainers error:error] : nil;
                if (![seed isKindOfClass:NSArray.class] || (existing && ![user isKindOfClass:NSArray.class])) {
                    problem = @"Invalid startup shader variant index"; goto fail;
                }
                NSMutableArray *merged = user ?: [NSMutableArray array];
                NSMutableSet *known = [NSMutableSet set];
                for (id row in merged) if ([row isKindOfClass:NSDictionary.class] && row[@"variant"]) [known addObject:row[@"variant"]];
                BOOL changed = !existing;
                for (id row in seed) {
                    if (![row isKindOfClass:NSDictionary.class] || ![row[@"variant"] isKindOfClass:NSString.class] ||
                        ![row[@"deps"] isKindOfClass:NSDictionary.class]) { problem = @"Invalid prepared shader dependencies"; goto fail; }
                    if (![known containsObject:row[@"variant"]]) { [merged addObject:row]; [known addObject:row[@"variant"]]; changed = YES; }
                }
                if (!changed) continue;
                data = [NSJSONSerialization dataWithJSONObject:merged options:NSJSONWritingSortedKeys error:error];
                if (!data) return nil;
            }
            if (![data writeToFile:target options:NSDataWritingAtomic error:error]) return nil;
            imported++;
        }
        NSData *receipt = [NSJSONSerialization dataWithJSONObject:@{@"files_sha256": fingerprint} options:0 error:error];
        if (marker && (!receipt || ![receipt writeToFile:marker options:NSDataWritingAtomic error:error])) return nil;
        return @{@"available": @YES, @"shaders": m[@"shaders"], @"imported_files": @(imported)};
    }
fail:
    if (error) *error = [NSError errorWithDomain:@"MacNativeGames.ShaderSeed" code:1
        userInfo:@{NSLocalizedDescriptionKey: problem ?: @"Cannot import startup shaders"}];
    return nil;
}

static NSDictionary *totk_seed_import(NSString *source, NSString *cache, NSError **error) {
    return totk_seed_import_into(source, cache, [cache stringByAppendingPathComponent:@"seed-installed.json"], error);
}

// iOS has no translator: ios/tools/fill_shaders.py translates the variants a device missed and pushes them as packs
// (directories in the seed format) under root. Each pack is checked and merged like the seed, then deleted; a rejected
// one (an interrupted push) is deleted too, and its variants stay requested until the tool runs again.
static NSDictionary *totk_fill_import(NSString *root, NSString *cache) {
    NSFileManager *fm = NSFileManager.defaultManager;
    NSArray<NSString *> *packs = [[fm contentsOfDirectoryAtPath:root error:nil] ?: @[] sortedArrayUsingSelector:@selector(compare:)];
    NSUInteger merged = 0, imported = 0; NSMutableArray<NSString *> *rejected = [NSMutableArray array];
    for (NSString *name in packs) {
        NSString *pack = [root stringByAppendingPathComponent:name]; BOOL dir = NO;
        if (![fm fileExistsAtPath:pack isDirectory:&dir] || !dir) continue;
        NSError *error = nil;
        NSDictionary *r = totk_seed_import_into(pack, cache, nil, &error);
        if (r && [r[@"available"] boolValue]) { merged++; imported += [r[@"imported_files"] unsignedIntegerValue]; }
        else [rejected addObject:[NSString stringWithFormat:@"%@: %@", name, error ? error.localizedDescription : @"no manifest"]];
        [fm removeItemAtPath:pack error:nil];
    }
    return @{@"packs": @(merged), @"imported_files": @(imported), @"rejected": rejected};
}

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/totk_sysload.c`:

```c
// TOTK: system load sampled for the bottom-right line (user, 2026-10-16 night). A background thread reads every 0.5 s:
// - per-core CPU load: host_processor_info(PROCESSOR_CPU_LOAD_INFO) tick deltas; performance / efficiency cores from the
//   device tree's "cluster-type" (E cores have the lowest logical ids on Apple silicon; that is the fallback);
// - the GPU's own utilisation: IOAccelerator PerformanceStatistics "Device Utilization %" (what Activity Monitor's GPU
//   history shows; our keep-alive fills the GPU's idle gaps, so it reads near 100 % while the game runs);
// - the game's GPU share: the union of our command buffers' GPU intervals (sysload_note_gpu) per wall time.
// It never touches the game threads; reading the device tree / IOKit happens on its own thread.
#include "totk_sysload.h"
#include <TargetConditionals.h>
#include <mach/mach.h>
#include <mach/mach_time.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/sysctl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#if TARGET_OS_OSX
#include <CoreFoundation/CoreFoundation.h>
#include <IOKit/IOKitLib.h>
#endif

static pthread_mutex_t g_mu = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static sysload_info g_cur;
static int g_have;
static sysload_busy g_busy;   // under g_mu (GPU completion handlers)

int sysload_enabled(void) {
    static int on = -1;
#if TARGET_OS_IPHONE
    const int def = 0;   // no IOKit on iOS; the phone shows only the FPS counter
#else
    const int def = 1;
#endif
    if (on < 0) { const char *e = getenv("TOTK_LOAD_OVERLAY"); on = e ? strcmp(e, "0") != 0 : def; }
    return on;
}

double sysload_busy_add(sysload_busy *b, double s, double e) {
    if (!(e > s)) return 0;
    double from = s > b->last_end ? s : b->last_end, add = e > from ? e - from : 0;
    if (e > b->last_end) b->last_end = e;
    b->busy += add;
    return add;
}
void sysload_note_gpu(double s, double e) { pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mu); sysload_busy_add(&g_busy, s, e); pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mu); }

void sysload_text(char *out, size_t n, const sysload_info *in) {
    size_t o = 0;
    #define PUT(...) do { int k = snprintf(out + o, o < n ? n - o : 0, __VA_ARGS__); if (k > 0) o += (size_t)k; } while (0)
    PUT("P"); for (int i = 0; i < in->np; i++) PUT(" %2d%%", in->p[i]);   // every value with % (user, 2026-10-16 night)
    PUT("  E"); for (int i = 0; i < in->ne; i++) PUT(" %2d%%", in->e[i]);
    if (in->thread_max >= 0) PUT("  T %d%%", in->thread_max);   // the busiest thread (user, 2026-10-16 night)
    if (in->gpu_sys >= 0) PUT("  GPU %d%%", in->gpu_sys); else PUT("  GPU --");
    if (in->gpu_game >= 0) PUT(" (%d%%)", in->gpu_game);
    #undef PUT
    if (n) out[n - 1 < o ? n - 1 : o] = 0;
}

int sysload_get(sysload_info *out) {
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mu); int have = g_have; if (have) *out = g_cur; pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mu);
    return have;
}

static double now_s(void) {
    static mach_timebase_info_data_t tb; if (!tb.denom) mach_timebase_info(&tb);
    return (double)mach_absolute_time() * tb.numer / tb.denom / 1e9;   // the clock of CACurrentMediaTime and GPUStartTime
}

/* 'P' or 'E' per logical CPU id. */
static void classify(int ncpu, char *kind) {
    int ne = 0; size_t sz = sizeof ne;
    if (sysctlbyname("hw.perflevel1.logicalcpu", &ne, &sz, NULL, 0) || ne < 0 || ne > ncpu) ne = 0;   // perflevel1 = efficiency
    for (int i = 0; i < ncpu; i++) kind[i] = i < ne ? 'E' : 'P';
#if TARGET_OS_OSX
    io_registry_entry_t cpus = IORegistryEntryFromPath(kIOMainPortDefault, "IODeviceTree:/cpus");
    io_iterator_t it = 0;
    if (cpus && IORegistryEntryGetChildIterator(cpus, kIODeviceTreePlane, &it) == KERN_SUCCESS) {
        io_object_t c;
        while ((c = IOIteratorNext(it))) {
            CFTypeRef id = IORegistryEntryCreateCFProperty(c, CFSTR("logical-cpu-id"), kCFAllocatorDefault, 0);
            CFTypeRef ct = IORegistryEntryCreateCFProperty(c, CFSTR("cluster-type"), kCFAllocatorDefault, 0);
            int lid = -1;
            if (id && CFGetTypeID(id) == CFNumberGetTypeID()) CFNumberGetValue((CFNumberRef)id, kCFNumberIntType, &lid);
            if (lid >= 0 && lid < ncpu && ct && CFGetTypeID(ct) == CFDataGetTypeID() && CFDataGetLength((CFDataRef)ct) > 0) {
                char k = (char)CFDataGetBytePtr((CFDataRef)ct)[0]; if (k == 'P' || k == 'E') kind[lid] = k;
            }
            if (id) CFRelease(id);
            if (ct) CFRelease(ct);
            IOObjectRelease(c);
        }
        IOObjectRelease(it);
    }
    if (cpus) IOObjectRelease(cpus);
#endif
}

#if TARGET_OS_OSX
static io_object_t g_accel;
static int gpu_util(void) {
    if (!g_accel) {
        io_iterator_t it;
        if (IOServiceGetMatchingServices(kIOMainPortDefault, IOServiceMatching("IOAccelerator"), &it) != KERN_SUCCESS) return -1;
        io_object_t s;
        while ((s = IOIteratorNext(it))) {
            CFTypeRef ps = IORegistryEntryCreateCFProperty(s, CFSTR("PerformanceStatistics"), kCFAllocatorDefault, 0);
            int ok = ps && CFGetTypeID(ps) == CFDictionaryGetTypeID() && CFDictionaryContainsKey((CFDictionaryRef)ps, CFSTR("Device Utilization %"));
            if (ps) CFRelease(ps);
            if (ok && !g_accel) g_accel = s; else IOObjectRelease(s);
        }
        IOObjectRelease(it);
        if (!g_accel) return -1;
    }
    int v = -1;
    CFTypeRef ps = IORegistryEntryCreateCFProperty(g_accel, CFSTR("PerformanceStatistics"), kCFAllocatorDefault, 0);
    if (ps && CFGetTypeID(ps) == CFDictionaryGetTypeID()) {
        CFTypeRef n = CFDictionaryGetValue((CFDictionaryRef)ps, CFSTR("Device Utilization %"));
        if (n && CFGetTypeID(n) == CFNumberGetTypeID()) CFNumberGetValue((CFNumberRef)n, kCFNumberIntType, &v);
    }
    if (ps) CFRelease(ps);
    return v < 0 ? -1 : v > 100 ? 100 : v;
}
#else
static int gpu_util(void) { return -1; }
#endif

/* The busiest thread of this process over the last interval: CPU time (user + system) per thread from thread_info, kept by
   thread id between samples; % of one core. Threads seen for the first time are skipped (no earlier time). */
enum { MAX_THREADS = 512 };
typedef struct { uint64_t id, us; } thread_time;
static thread_time g_tt[MAX_THREADS]; static int g_ntt;
static int busiest_thread(double wall_us, char name[32]) {
    thread_act_array_t th = NULL; mach_msg_type_number_t nth = 0;
    if (task_threads(mach_task_self(), &th, &nth) != KERN_SUCCESS || !th) return -1;
    static thread_time cur[MAX_THREADS]; int ncur = 0; double best = -1; name[0] = 0;
    for (mach_msg_type_number_t i = 0; i < nth; i++) {
        thread_identifier_info_data_t idi; mach_msg_type_number_t c1 = THREAD_IDENTIFIER_INFO_COUNT;
        thread_basic_info_data_t bi; mach_msg_type_number_t c2 = THREAD_BASIC_INFO_COUNT;
        if (thread_info(th[i], THREAD_IDENTIFIER_INFO, (thread_info_t)&idi, &c1) == KERN_SUCCESS &&
            thread_info(th[i], THREAD_BASIC_INFO, (thread_info_t)&bi, &c2) == KERN_SUCCESS && ncur < MAX_THREADS) {
            uint64_t us = (uint64_t)bi.user_time.seconds * 1000000 + (uint64_t)bi.user_time.microseconds +
                          (uint64_t)bi.system_time.seconds * 1000000 + (uint64_t)bi.system_time.microseconds;
            cur[ncur++] = (thread_time){idi.thread_id, us};
            for (int k = 0; k < g_ntt; k++) if (g_tt[k].id == idi.thread_id) {
                double pct = us >= g_tt[k].us && wall_us > 0 ? (us - g_tt[k].us) / wall_us * 100 : 0;
                if (pct > best) { best = pct; pthread_t pt = pthread_from_mach_thread_np(th[i]); name[0] = 0; if (pt) pthread_getname_np(pt, name, 32); if (!name[0]) snprintf(name, 32, "thread %llu", (unsigned long long)idi.thread_id); }
                break;
            }
        }
        mach_port_deallocate(mach_task_self(), th[i]);
    }
    vm_deallocate(mach_task_self(), (vm_address_t)th, nth * sizeof *th);
    memcpy(g_tt, cur, (size_t)ncur * sizeof *cur); g_ntt = ncur;
    return best < 0 ? -1 : best > 100 ? 100 : (int)(best + 0.5);
}

/* Ticks (user + system + nice, total) per CPU; returns the CPU count, 0 on failure. */
static int cpu_ticks(uint64_t busy[SYSLOAD_MAX_CORES], uint64_t total[SYSLOAD_MAX_CORES]) {
    static host_t host; if (!host) host = mach_host_self();
    natural_t n = 0; processor_info_array_t info = NULL; mach_msg_type_number_t cnt = 0;
    if (host_processor_info(host, PROCESSOR_CPU_LOAD_INFO, &n, &info, &cnt) != KERN_SUCCESS || !info) return 0;
    int nc = (int)n < SYSLOAD_MAX_CORES ? (int)n : SYSLOAD_MAX_CORES;
    for (int i = 0; i < nc; i++) {
        const integer_t *t = info + i * CPU_STATE_MAX;
        busy[i] = (uint64_t)(uint32_t)t[CPU_STATE_USER] + (uint32_t)t[CPU_STATE_SYSTEM] + (uint32_t)t[CPU_STATE_NICE];
        total[i] = busy[i] + (uint32_t)t[CPU_STATE_IDLE];
    }
    vm_deallocate(mach_task_self(), (vm_address_t)info, cnt * sizeof(integer_t));
    return nc;
}

static void *sampler(void *arg) {
    (void)arg;
    pthread_setname_np("totk-sysload");
    uint64_t b0[SYSLOAD_MAX_CORES], t0[SYSLOAD_MAX_CORES], b1[SYSLOAD_MAX_CORES], t1[SYSLOAD_MAX_CORES];
    int ncpu = cpu_ticks(b0, t0); char kind[SYSLOAD_MAX_CORES]; classify(ncpu, kind);
    char tname[32]; (void)busiest_thread(0, tname);   // the first thread times
    double w0 = now_s(), g0; pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mu); g0 = g_busy.busy; pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mu);
    for (unsigned k = 1;; k++) {
        usleep(500000);
        int nc = cpu_ticks(b1, t1);
        sysload_info s = {0}; s.gpu_sys = gpu_util();
        double w1 = now_s(), g1; pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mu); g1 = g_busy.busy; pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mu);
        s.thread_max = busiest_thread((w1 - w0) * 1e6, s.thread_name);
        double gp = w1 > w0 ? (g1 - g0) / (w1 - w0) * 100 : -1;
        s.gpu_game = gp < 0 ? -1 : gp > 100 ? 100 : (int)(gp + 0.5);
        for (int i = 0; i < nc && i < ncpu; i++) {
            uint64_t db = b1[i] - b0[i], dt = t1[i] - t0[i]; int v = dt ? (int)((db * 100 + dt / 2) / dt) : 0;
            if (kind[i] == 'P' && s.np < SYSLOAD_MAX_CORES) s.p[s.np++] = v; else if (s.ne < SYSLOAD_MAX_CORES) s.e[s.ne++] = v;
        }
        pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mu); g_cur = s; g_have = nc > 0; pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mu);
        memcpy(b0, b1, sizeof b0); memcpy(t0, t1, sizeof t0); w0 = w1; g0 = g1;
        if (k % 60 == 0) { char t[128]; sysload_text(t, sizeof t, &s); fprintf(stderr, "[totk-gfx] [负载] %s（T 是最忙的线程：%s；括号里是游戏自己的 GPU 工作，不算保活）\n", t, s.thread_name); }   // every 30 s
    }
    return NULL;
}
static void start_once(void) { pthread_t th; if (!pthread_create(&th, NULL, sampler, NULL)) pthread_detach(th); }
void sysload_start(void) { static pthread_once_t once = PTHREAD_ONCE_INIT; pthread_once(&once, start_once); }

```h
// TOTK: system load for the bottom-right line (user, 2026-10-16 night: the load of every CPU core and of the GPU, on one
// line like the FPS counter). See totk_sysload.c.
#pragma once
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

enum { SYSLOAD_MAX_CORES = 32 };
/* Percentages, -1 = not known. p / e: every performance / efficiency core in logical-CPU order. gpu_sys: the GPU's own
   utilisation as macOS reports it (the whole GPU: other apps and our keep-alive spin kernels included, so near 100 % while
   the game runs). gpu_game: the share of time the GPU spent on our command buffers (the game's rendering, MetalFX; not the
   keep-alive). */
/* thread_max: the busiest thread of this process, % of one core (-1 = not known yet); thread_name: its name (for the log). */
typedef struct { int np, ne, p[SYSLOAD_MAX_CORES], e[SYSLOAD_MAX_CORES], gpu_sys, gpu_game, thread_max; char thread_name[32]; } sysload_info;

int sysload_enabled(void);                       // TOTK_LOAD_OVERLAY=0 hides the line (Mac default on, iOS off)
void sysload_start(void);                        // starts the sampler thread once (every 0.5 s)
int sysload_get(sysload_info *out);              // 0 before the first sample
void sysload_note_gpu(double start_s, double end_s);   // one of our command buffers ran on the GPU (CACurrentMediaTime seconds)
/* "P 55% 56% 55% 53%  E 43% 29% 20% 12%  9%  7%  T 47%  GPU 99% (70%)" (T: the busiest thread) */
void sysload_text(char *out, size_t n, const sysload_info *in);
/* Busy time of command buffers that complete in order: the union of their [start, end) intervals. Returns what was added. */
typedef struct { double last_end, busy; } sysload_busy;
double sysload_busy_add(sysload_busy *b, double start_s, double end_s);

`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/cpp/third_party/d2r_gfx/gfx/nvn/totk_taa.m`:

```m
// TOTK: MetalFX temporal anti-aliasing (TOTK_TAA=1; not in D2R).
// The game renders without anti-aliasing of its own beyond FXAA after tone mapping, so edges stair-step at the scene
// size. A MetalFX temporal scaler at 1:1 (input and output the scene size) runs on the linear HDR scene just before the
// game's compose shader 0ac9a549 (tone mapping and bloom) samples it; the replay then binds our output instead (as
// MFXUP_SCENE does with the spatial scaler).
//  - Jitter: every frame the geometry drawn into the G-buffer depth has its viewport moved by a sub-pixel offset
//    (Halton 2, 3; no shader changes; full-screen triangles and quads stay put). MetalFX gets the same offset.
//  - Key 5 turns it on and off while playing (runtime/input.c); TOTK_TAA=1 starts it on.
//  - Motion vectors: from the camera only, as for frame interpolation (totk_mfx.m): the G-buffer depth reprojected with
//    this and the previous frame's view-projection. What moves on its own (Link, enemies) gets the camera's motion;
//    MetalFX rejects what does not match, at the cost of less smoothing there.
//  - Reset: the first frame, a size change and a camera cut (odyssey_mfx_cut, as frame interpolation: Odyssey's
//    positions are centimetres, more than 800 or 25 degrees in one frame).
//  - Odyssey: the compose draw is 1068aa25 (TAA_COMPOSE, nvn_obj.h), the camera comes from odyssey_mfx_camera.
#import <MetalFX/MetalFX.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "odyssey_mfx.h"
#include "totk_taa.h"

#define TLOG(...) do { fprintf(stderr, "[dm] [nvn-mtl] [taa] " __VA_ARGS__); fputc('\n', stderr); } while (0)
/* Per-frame parameter buffers and argument tables: the replay can encode several frames before the GPU runs the first
   one, and a slot rewritten too early gives MetalFX the wrong camera for that frame (the history then lands beside
   itself; it showed as a purple shimmer on hazy rocks that faded whenever a screenshot waited for the GPU). */
#define TAA_SLOTS 16
#define TAA_OLD TAA_SLOTS   // replaced scalers and textures are kept as long (Metal 4 command buffers do not retain)

static struct {
    id<MTLDevice> dev; id<MTL4Compiler> comp; id<MTLResidencySet> rs; id<MTLFence> fence;
    id<MTL4FXTemporalScaler> sc; NSUInteger w, h; MTLPixelFormat fmt;
    id<MTLTexture> out, mv;
    id<MTLComputePipelineState> mv_ps; id<MTL4ArgumentTable> args[TAA_SLOTS]; id<MTLBuffer> par[TAA_SLOTS]; int slot;
    __unsafe_unretained id<MTLTexture> depth;   // this frame's G-buffer depth (the game's texture, alive for the frame)
    double cam[84], prev[84]; int cam_ok, prev_ok, jit_pass, failed;
    int active, jit_ok, jit_used;   // active: latched from key 5 at frame end; jit_ok: this frame may jitter (see taa_frame_end)
    uint64_t retry_at;              // a scaler that could not be built is tried again from this frame on
    unsigned jit_i; double jx, jy;
    __unsafe_unretained id<MTLTexture> last_src; uint64_t frame, encoded_frame;
    uint64_t done, resets, missing;
    struct { id obj; uint64_t frame; } old[TAA_OLD * 3]; int nold;
} g;
static void keep_old(id obj) {   // released (and dropped from the residency set) TAA_OLD frames later, when the GPU is done with it
    if (!obj) return;
    int dropped = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < g.nold; i++) if (g.frame - g.old[i].frame >= TAA_OLD) {
        if ([g.old[i].obj conformsToProtocol:@protocol(MTLAllocation)]) { [g.rs removeAllocation:g.old[i].obj]; dropped = 1; }
        g.old[i] = g.old[--g.nold]; i--;
    }
    if (dropped) [g.rs commit];
    if (g.nold < (int)(sizeof g.old / sizeof *g.old)) g.old[g.nold++] = (__typeof__(g.old[0])){obj, g.frame};
}

static _Atomic int g_on = -1;
int taa_enabled(void) {
    int on = atomic_load_explicit(&g_on, memory_order_relaxed);
    if (on < 0) {
        const char *e = getenv("TOTK_TAA"); on = e && strcmp(e, "0");
        atomic_store(&g_on, on);
        TLOG("MetalFX temporal anti-aliasing (TOTK_TAA, key 5): %s", on ? "on" : "off");
    }
    return on;
}
/* Key 5: on / off while playing (the input thread). The replay takes it at the next frame end, so a frame is either
   jittered in every pass on the G-buffer depth or in none (foliage drawn twice with an equal depth test needs both alike). */
void taa_toggle(void) {
    int on = !taa_enabled();
    atomic_store(&g_on, on);
    TLOG("key 5: temporal anti-aliasing %s", on ? "on" : "off");
}
int taa_active(void) { return g.active; }
int taa_ready(void) { return g.active && !g.failed && g.frame >= g.retry_at && g.depth && g.cam_ok; }
static double halton(unsigned i, unsigned b) { double f = 1, r = 0; while (i) { f /= b; r += f * (i % b); i /= b; } return r; }

int taa_pass(MTL4RenderPassDescriptor *pd) {
    if (!g.active) return 0;
    id<MTLTexture> c0 = pd.colorAttachments[0].texture, dt = pd.depthAttachment.texture;
    if (!g.depth && dt && c0 && dt.pixelFormat == MTLPixelFormatDepth32Float && dt.textureType == MTLTextureType2D &&
        dt.width == c0.width && dt.height == c0.height && dt.width >= 320) {
        int nc = 0; for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) nc += pd.colorAttachments[i].texture != nil;
        if (nc >= 3) { g.depth = dt; g.jit_pass = g.jit_ok; return 2; }
    }
    g.jit_pass = g.jit_ok && dt && dt == g.depth;
    return g.jit_pass;
}
int taa_jittered(void) { return g.jit_pass; }
void taa_jitter(double *x, double *y) { *x = g.jx; *y = g.jy; g.jit_used = 1; }
void taa_note_camera(const float *c, int n) {
    if (n < 84) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < 84; i++) g.cam[i] = c[i];
    g.cam_ok = c[56] > 0 && c[57] > c[56] && c[62] > 0 && c[70] > 0;
}
id<MTLResidencySet> taa_residency(void) { return g.rs; }

static int setup(id<MTLDevice> dev) {
    if (g.dev) return 1;
    if (g.failed) return 0;
    NSError *e = nil;
    g.comp = [dev newCompilerWithDescriptor:[MTL4CompilerDescriptor new] error:&e];
    MTLResidencySetDescriptor *rd = [MTLResidencySetDescriptor new]; rd.label = @"TOTK TAA";
    g.rs = [dev newResidencySetWithDescriptor:rd error:&e];
    static const char *src =
        "#include <metal_stdlib>\nusing namespace metal;\n"
        "struct P { float4x4 reproj; float2 size; float2 inv_size; };\n"
        // camera motion of each depth pixel: where it was in the previous frame, in pixels of this texture
        "kernel void taa_mv(depth2d<float, access::read> d [[texture(0)]], texture2d<float, access::write> mv [[texture(1)]],\n"
        "                   constant P &p [[buffer(0)]], uint2 g [[thread_position_in_grid]]) {\n"
        "  if (g.x >= uint(p.size.x) || g.y >= uint(p.size.y)) return;\n"
        "  float2 uv = (float2(g) + 0.5) * p.inv_size;\n"
        "  float4 c = p.reproj * float4(uv.x * 2.0 - 1.0, 1.0 - uv.y * 2.0, d.read(g) * 2.0 - 1.0, 1.0);\n"
        "  float2 m = 0.0;\n"
        "  if (c.w > 1e-7) { float2 n = c.xy / c.w; m = (float2(n.x * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.5 - 0.5 * n.y) - uv) * p.size; }\n"
        "  if (any(isnan(m)) || any(isinf(m))) m = 0.0;\n"
        "  mv.write(float4(m, 0.0, 0.0), g);\n"
        "}\n";
    MTLCompileOptions *o = [MTLCompileOptions new]; o.mathMode = MTLMathModeSafe;
    id<MTLLibrary> lib = [dev newLibraryWithSource:@(src) options:o error:&e];
    id<MTLFunction> fn = lib ? [lib newFunctionWithName:@"taa_mv"] : nil;
    g.mv_ps = fn ? [dev newComputePipelineStateWithFunction:fn error:&e] : nil;
    MTL4ArgumentTableDescriptor *ad = [MTL4ArgumentTableDescriptor new]; ad.maxBufferBindCount = 1; ad.maxTextureBindCount = 2;
    for (int i = 0; i < TAA_SLOTS && g.rs; i++) {
        g.args[i] = [dev newArgumentTableWithDescriptor:ad error:&e];
        g.par[i] = [dev newBufferWithLength:256 options:MTLResourceStorageModeShared];
        if (g.par[i]) [g.rs addAllocation:g.par[i]];
    }
    if (!g.comp || !g.rs || !g.mv_ps || !g.args[TAA_SLOTS - 1] || !g.par[TAA_SLOTS - 1]) {
        TLOG("not available: %s", e ? e.localizedDescription.UTF8String : "MetalFX / Metal 4 objects");
        g.failed = 1; return 0;
    }
    [g.rs commit];
    g.fence = [dev newFence];
    g.dev = dev;
    return 1;
}
static id<MTLTexture> mk(MTLPixelFormat f, NSUInteger w, NSUInteger h, MTLTextureUsage u) {
    MTLTextureDescriptor *d = [MTLTextureDescriptor texture2DDescriptorWithPixelFormat:f width:w height:h mipmapped:NO];
    d.usage = u; d.storageMode = MTLStorageModePrivate;
    id<MTLTexture> t = [g.dev newTextureWithDescriptor:d];
    if (t) [g.rs addAllocation:t];
    return t;
}
static int ensure_scaler(id<MTLTexture> src) {
    if (g.sc && g.w == src.width && g.h == src.height && g.fmt == src.pixelFormat) return 1;
    if (![MTLFXTemporalScalerDescriptor supportsMetal4FX:g.dev]) { g.failed = 1; TLOG("this GPU has no Metal 4 MetalFX temporal scaler"); return 0; }
    MTLFXTemporalScalerDescriptor *d = [MTLFXTemporalScalerDescriptor new];
    /* The output is RGBA16Float, not the scene's RG11B10Float: written back into 11 / 11 / 10 bits, red and blue rounded
       differently from frame to frame (the hazy distance flickered purple: red / blue flicker 3.9 / 4.0 against green 3.0;
       with RGBA16Float 3.1 / 2.9 against 2.6, below the game's own 3.8 / 3.2 / 3.0 without anti-aliasing). */
    MTLPixelFormat of = MTLPixelFormatRGBA16Float;
    d.colorTextureFormat = src.pixelFormat; d.outputTextureFormat = of;
    d.depthTextureFormat = MTLPixelFormatDepth32Float; d.motionTextureFormat = MTLPixelFormatRG16Float;
    d.inputWidth = d.outputWidth = src.width; d.inputHeight = d.outputHeight = src.height;
    /* No auto exposure: MetalFX's own estimate jumped now and then (after a few minutes of play, worst at dusk and at
       night), and the game's tone mapping turned that into a different tint of the whole frame for a moment: the sky
       went from (28, 98, 122) to (46, 83, 76) between two captures and hazy rocks seemed to glow. With the exposure
       left at 1 the same five minutes stayed smooth and flickered less than without anti-aliasing. */
    d.autoExposureEnabled = NO;
    id<MTL4FXTemporalScaler> sc = [d newTemporalScalerWithDevice:g.dev compiler:g.comp];
    if (!sc) { g.retry_at = g.frame + 300; TLOG("temporal scaler %lux%lu (format %lu) not created; trying again in 300 frames", (unsigned long)src.width, (unsigned long)src.height, (unsigned long)src.pixelFormat); return 0; }
    keep_old(g.out); keep_old(g.mv);
    keep_old(g.sc);
    g.out = mk(of, src.width, src.height, sc.outputTextureUsage | MTLTextureUsageShaderRead);
    g.mv = mk(MTLPixelFormatRG16Float, src.width, src.height, sc.motionTextureUsage | MTLTextureUsageShaderWrite | MTLTextureUsageShaderRead);
    [g.rs commit];
    if (!g.out || !g.mv) { g.sc = nil; g.retry_at = g.frame + 300; TLOG("textures for %lux%lu not created; trying again in 300 frames", (unsigned long)src.width, (unsigned long)src.height); return 0; }
    g.sc = sc; g.w = src.width; g.h = src.height; g.fmt = src.pixelFormat; g.prev_ok = 0;
    TLOG("temporal scaler %lux%lu, scene format %lu, output RGBA16Float, 1:1 with jitter", (unsigned long)g.w, (unsigned long)g.h, (unsigned long)g.fmt);
    return 1;
}
// 4x4 inverse (Gauss-Jordan, partial pivoting) and product, row-major, in double (world coordinates in the thousands).
static int inv4(const double a_[16], double r[16]) {
    double a[16]; memcpy(a, a_, sizeof a);
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) r[i] = i % 5 == 0;
    for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
        int p = c; for (int k = c + 1; k < 4; k++) if (fabs(a[k * 4 + c]) > fabs(a[p * 4 + c])) p = k;
        if (fabs(a[p * 4 + c]) < 1e-12) return 0;
        if (p != c) for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) { double t = a[c * 4 + k]; a[c * 4 + k] = a[p * 4 + k]; a[p * 4 + k] = t; t = r[c * 4 + k]; r[c * 4 + k] = r[p * 4 + k]; r[p * 4 + k] = t; }
        double s = 1.0 / a[c * 4 + c];
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) { a[c * 4 + k] *= s; r[c * 4 + k] *= s; }
        for (int q = 0; q < 4; q++) if (q != c) { double f = a[q * 4 + c]; if (f != 0) for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) { a[q * 4 + k] -= f * a[c * 4 + k]; r[q * 4 + k] -= f * r[c * 4 + k]; } }
    }
    return 1;
}
static void mul4(const double a[16], const double b[16], double r[16]) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) { double s = 0; for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) s += a[i * 4 + k] * b[k * 4 + j]; r[i * 4 + j] = s; }
}
/* TOTK's 8 units are metres there; Odyssey's are centimetres, where 8 is ordinary camera follow motion: the first 30 s
   after Resume reset the history 124 times with 8, 3 times with this cut (the one frame interpolation uses). */
static int camera_cut(void) { return odyssey_mfx_cut(g.cam, g.prev); }

id<MTLTexture> taa_encode(id<MTL4CommandBuffer> cb, id<MTLTexture> src) {
    if (!g.active || g.frame < g.retry_at || !cb || !src || src.textureType != MTLTextureType2D) return nil;
    if (g.encoded_frame == g.frame + 1 && src == g.last_src) return g.out;   // the compose shader again in the same frame
    id<MTLTexture> depth = g.depth;
    if (!depth || !g.cam_ok || depth.width != src.width || depth.height != src.height) { g.missing++; g.prev_ok = 0; return nil; }
    if (!setup(src.device) || !ensure_scaler(src)) return nil;
    int reset = !g.prev_ok || g.encoded_frame != g.frame || camera_cut();   // also after a frame without anti-aliasing (menus, loading)
    double vc[16], vp[16], ic[16], m[16];
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) { vc[i] = g.cam[12 + i]; vp[i] = reset ? g.cam[12 + i] : g.prev[12 + i]; }
    if (!inv4(vc, ic)) { g.missing++; g.prev_ok = 0; return nil; }
    mul4(vp, ic, m);
    int s = g.slot = (g.slot + 1) % TAA_SLOTS;
    float *par = g.par[s].contents;
    for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) for (int r = 0; r < 4; r++) par[c * 4 + r] = (float)m[r * 4 + c];   // float4x4 is column-major
    par[16] = (float)src.width; par[17] = (float)src.height; par[18] = 1.0f / src.width; par[19] = 1.0f / src.height;
    [g.args[s] setTexture:depth.gpuResourceID atIndex:0]; [g.args[s] setTexture:g.mv.gpuResourceID atIndex:1]; [g.args[s] setAddress:g.par[s].gpuAddress atIndex:0];
    id<MTL4ComputeCommandEncoder> e = [cb computeCommandEncoder];
    [e barrierAfterQueueStages:MTLStageAll beforeStages:MTLStageDispatch visibilityOptions:MTL4VisibilityOptionDevice];   // the scene and depth are done
    [e setComputePipelineState:g.mv_ps]; [e setArgumentTable:g.args[s]];
    [e dispatchThreads:MTLSizeMake(src.width, src.height, 1) threadsPerThreadgroup:MTLSizeMake(16, 16, 1)];
    [e updateFence:g.fence afterEncoderStages:MTLStageDispatch];
    [e endEncoding];
    g.sc.colorTexture = src; g.sc.depthTexture = depth; g.sc.motionTexture = g.mv; g.sc.outputTexture = g.out;
    g.sc.inputContentWidth = src.width; g.sc.inputContentHeight = src.height;
    g.sc.jitterOffsetX = g.jit_used ? (float)g.jx : 0; g.sc.jitterOffsetY = g.jit_used ? (float)g.jy : 0;   // what the geometry got
    g.sc.motionVectorScaleX = 1; g.sc.motionVectorScaleY = 1; g.sc.depthReversed = NO; g.sc.reset = reset; g.sc.fence = g.fence;
    [g.sc encodeToCommandBuffer:cb];
    g.sc.colorTexture = nil; g.sc.depthTexture = nil; g.sc.motionTexture = nil; g.sc.outputTexture = nil;
    memcpy(g.prev, g.cam, sizeof g.cam); g.prev_ok = 1;
    g.resets += reset; g.done++;
    g.last_src = src; g.encoded_frame = g.frame + 1;
    return g.out;
}
void taa_frame_end(void) {
    int want = taa_enabled(); if (want != g.active) { g.active = want; g.prev_ok = 0; }
    g.frame++; g.depth = nil; g.cam_ok = 0; g.jit_pass = 0; g.jit_used = 0;
    /* The geometry is jittered only after a frame MetalFX took: when it cannot run (no Metal 4 temporal scaler, a scaler
       not built yet, no camera), a moved picture with nothing to smooth it would shake. */
    g.jit_ok = g.active && !g.failed && g.frame >= g.retry_at && g.encoded_frame == g.frame;
    g.jit_i = g.jit_i % 16 + 1;   // Halton 2, 3 over 16 frames, centred on the pixel
    g.jx = halton(g.jit_i, 2) - 0.5; g.jy = halton(g.jit_i, 3) - 0.5;
    if (g.frame % 1800 == 0 && taa_enabled()) { char b[200]; taa_stats(b, sizeof b); TLOG("%s", b); }
}
void taa_stats(char *out, size_t n) {
    snprintf(out, n, "frame %llu: anti-aliased %llu, history resets %llu, without depth or camera %llu",
             (unsigned long long)g.frame, (unsigned long long)g.done, (unsigned long long)g.resets, (unsigned long long)g.missing);
}
