`nxnative-ohos/template/entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets`:

```ets
import game from 'libgame.so';
import { fileIo, fileUri, picker } from '@kit.CoreFileKit';
import { http } from '@kit.NetworkKit';
import { BusinessError } from '@kit.BasicServicesKit';

// {{...}} 占位由 scripts/build_hap_from_profile.py 从 games/<titleID>/game.tsv 实例化：
//   GAME_ID_DIR    游戏沙箱目录名（title_id）；与 cpp/game_id.h 的 GAME_ID_DIR 同值
//   ROMFS_VOLUMES  RomFS 分卷数（make_romfs_runtime 按 romfs_volume_mib 切卷，smo=6）
//   HAP_LABEL      应用名（hap_label 键，页面标题）
const GAME_ID_DIR = '{{GAME_ID_DIR}}';
const ROMFS_VOLUMES = {{ROMFS_VOLUMES}};
const GAME_LABEL = '{{HAP_LABEL}}';

// RomFS 就绪清单：runtime-index.bin + N 个分卷（卷号 3 位补零，末卷短）
function romfsFileList(): string[] {
  const all: string[] = ['runtime-index.bin'];
  for (let i = 0; i < ROMFS_VOLUMES; i++) {
    all.push(`romfs.bin.${i.toString().padStart(3, '0')}`);
  }
  return all;
}

@Entry
@Component
struct Index {
  @StorageLink('filesDir') filesDir: string = '';
  @StorageLink('gameReady') gameReady: boolean = false;
  @StorageLink('gameErr') gameErr: string = '';
  @State status: string = '就绪';
  @State started: boolean = false;
  @State surfaceReady: boolean = false;
  @State importing: string = '';
  @State romfsReady: boolean = false;
  @State pulling: string = '';
  @State pcAddr: string = '192.168.0.110:8000';
  private timerId: number = -1;
  private statusTimerId: number = -1;

  aboutToAppear() {
    this.checkRomfs();
    // autopath=1（aa start 带参）且 RomFS 未就绪时自动开拉，配合锁屏/无人值守传输
    if (AppStorage.get<string>('autopath') === '1' && !this.romfsReady) {
      setTimeout(() => { this.pullFromPc(); }, 800);
    }
    // boot=1（aa start 带参）：等游戏镜像解包完 + RomFS 就绪后自动点「启动游戏」
    if (AppStorage.get<string>('boot') === '1') {
      this.timerId = setInterval(() => {
        if (this.gameReady && this.romfsReady && !this.started) {
          clearInterval(this.timerId);
          this.timerId = -1;
          this.startGame();
        }
      }, 2000) as number;
    }
  }

  aboutToDisappear() {
    if (this.timerId >= 0) clearInterval(this.timerId);
    if (this.statusTimerId >= 0) clearInterval(this.statusTimerId);
  }

  // RomFS 就绪判定（boot 门禁用）：7 件齐全才放行点火，缺任何一件都算未就绪
  private checkRomfs(): void {
    try {
      const dir = `${this.filesDir}/${GAME_ID_DIR}/romfs`;
      let n = 0;
      const all: string[] = romfsFileList();
      for (let i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
        if (fileIo.accessSync(`${dir}/${all[i]}`)) { n++; }
      }
      this.romfsReady = n === all.length;
    } catch (e) {
      this.romfsReady = false;
    }
  }

  // 导入游戏资源：选手机上放着 runtime-index.bin + romfs.bin.000…00N 的文件夹（PC 侧 game-work/romfs_parts
  // 经 USB/MTP 拷到手机），整包拷入 files/<游戏id>/romfs。模式抄 jhaizhou d2r-mobile 的 DocumentViewPicker FOLDER。
  private async importResources(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.importing !== '') { return; }
    try {
      const opts = new picker.DocumentSelectOptions();
      opts.selectMode = picker.DocumentSelectMode.FOLDER;
      opts.maxSelectNumber = 1;
      const p = new picker.DocumentViewPicker();
      const uris: string[] = await p.select(opts);
      if (!uris || uris.length === 0) { return; }
      const root: string = uris[0];
      const dst = `${this.filesDir}/${GAME_ID_DIR}/romfs`;
      if (!fileIo.accessSync(dst)) { fileIo.mkdirSync(dst, true); }
      const wanted: string[] = romfsFileList();
      let copied = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < wanted.length; i++) {
        const name = wanted[i];
        const src = `${root}/${name}`;
        const target = `${dst}/${name}`;
        this.importing = `正在导入 ${name} …`;
        try { fileIo.unlinkSync(target); } catch (e) { }
        try {
          await fileIo.copy(src, fileUri.getUriFromPath(target), {
            progressListener: (pr: fileIo.Progress) => {
              this.importing = `${name}：${Math.floor(pr.processedSize / 1048576)} / ${Math.floor(pr.totalSize / 1048576)} MB`;
            }
          });
          copied++;
        } catch (e) {
          const code = (e as BusinessError).code;
          if (code !== 13900002) {   // 13900002 = 选中的文件夹里没有这一项（允许缺卷）
            this.importing = `导入失败：${name} (code ${code})，请重试`;
            return;
          }
        }
      }
      if (copied < 2) {
        this.importing = '这个文件夹里没有资源（需要 runtime-index.bin 和 romfs.bin 分卷）';
        return;
      }
      this.checkRomfs();
      this.importing = this.romfsReady ? '导入完成 ✓' : '导入不完整（缺 runtime-index.bin 或首卷）';
    } catch (e) {
      this.importing = `导入失败：${JSON.stringify(e)}`;
    }
  }

  // 从电脑拉取：HTTP 分块下载直写沙箱。两条路：
  //  1) 直连：电脑上 romfs_parts 目录起 `python -m http.server 8000`，此处填电脑局域网 IP:8000（需防火墙放行）
  //  2) 隧道：PC 侧 `hdc rport tcp:8000 tcp:8000` 后填 127.0.0.1:8000（走 hdc 反向转发，免防火墙）
  private async pullFromPc(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.pulling !== '' || this.pcAddr === '') { return; }
    const dst = `${this.filesDir}/${GAME_ID_DIR}/romfs`;
    const wanted: string[] = ['runtime-index.bin', ...romfsFileList()];
    try {
      if (!fileIo.accessSync(dst)) { fileIo.mkdirSync(dst, true); }
      for (let i = 0; i < wanted.length; i++) {
        const name = wanted[i];
        this.pulling = `拉取 ${name} …`;
        await this.downloadOne(`http://${this.pcAddr}/${name}`, `${dst}/${name}`, name);
      }
      this.checkRomfs();
      this.pulling = this.romfsReady ? '拉取完成 ✓' : '拉取不完整（缺 runtime-index.bin 或首卷）';
    } catch (e) {
      // 直连失败（多半是 PC 防火墙）→ 自动改走 hdc rport 隧道（127.0.0.1:8000）重试一次
      if (this.pcAddr !== '127.0.0.1:8000') {
        this.pcAddr = '127.0.0.1:8000';
        this.pulling = '直连失败，改走 hdc 隧道重试…';
        setTimeout(() => { this.pulling = ''; this.pullFromPc(); }, 500);
        return;
      }
      this.pulling = `拉取失败：${(e as BusinessError).message ?? JSON.stringify(e)} · 检查电脑侧服务/地址`;
    }
  }

  // 单文件流式下载：requestInStream → dataReceive 顺序写 .part → dataEnd 校验 200 后 moveFile 成品
  private downloadOne(url: string, target: string, name: string): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      const part = `${target}.part`;
      const session = http.createHttp();
      let fd = -1;
      let received = 0;
      let total = 0;
      let respCode = 0;
      let settled = false;
      const fail = (msg: string): void => {
        if (settled) { return; }
        settled = true;
        if (fd >= 0) { try { fileIo.closeSync(fd); } catch (e) { } }
        try { fileIo.unlinkSync(part); } catch (e) { }
        session.destroy();
        reject(new Error(msg));
      };
      try { fileIo.unlinkSync(part); } catch (e) { }
      fd = fileIo.openSync(part,
        fileIo.OpenMode.READ_WRITE | fileIo.OpenMode.CREATE | fileIo.OpenMode.TRUNC).fd;
      session.on('headersReceive', (h: Object) => {
        const rec = h as Record<string, string>;
        const cl = rec['content-length'];
        if (cl) { total = parseInt(cl, 10); }
      });
      session.on('dataReceive', (chunk: ArrayBuffer) => {
        if (fd < 0) { return; }
        fileIo.writeSync(fd, chunk);
        received += chunk.byteLength;
        this.pulling = total > 0
          ? `${name}：${Math.floor(received / 1048576)} / ${Math.floor(total / 1048576)} MB`
          : `${name}：${Math.floor(received / 1048576)} MB`;
      });
      session.on('dataEnd', () => {
        if (settled) { return; }
        // requestInStream 的回调（err, code）可能比 dataEnd 晚到：快响应下 code 还没落地，
        // dataEnd 先按 respCode===0 误杀成「HTTP 0」。dataEnd 后轮询最多 2s 等回调补码再裁决。
        let waits = 0;
        const judge = (): void => {
          if (respCode === 0 && waits < 20) { waits++; setTimeout(judge, 100); return; }
          if (settled) { return; }
          settled = true;
          if (fd >= 0) { try { fileIo.closeSync(fd); } catch (e) { } }
          session.destroy();
          if (respCode !== 200) {
            try { fileIo.unlinkSync(part); } catch (e) { }
            reject(new Error(`HTTP ${respCode}（地址/服务不对？）`));
            return;
          }
          try { fileIo.unlinkSync(target); } catch (e) { }
          fileIo.moveFileSync(part, target);
          resolve();
        };
        judge();
      });
      const opts: http.HttpRequestOptions = {
        usingCache: false, connectTimeout: 15000, readTimeout: 300000
      };
      session.requestInStream(url, opts, (err: BusinessError, code: number) => {
        if (err) { fail(`连接失败：${err.message}`); return; }
        respCode = code;
      });
    });
  }

  // 启动游戏（CPU boot）：按钮与 boot=1 无人值守共用
  private startGame(): void {
    if (this.started) { return; }
    const dir = `${this.filesDir}/${GAME_ID_DIR}`;
    const rc: number = game.start(dir);
    this.status = rc === 0 ? 'boot 线程已启动，看日志推进' : `启动失败 rc=${rc}`;
    this.started = true;
    this.statusTimerId = setInterval(() => {
      const s: number = game.status();
      if (s === 2) {
        this.status = 'boot 线程已退出（看 hilog 定位卡点）';
        this.started = false;
        clearInterval(this.statusTimerId);
        this.statusTimerId = -1;
      }
    }, 1000) as number;
  }

  build() {
    Column({ space: 12 }) {
      Text(`${GAME_LABEL} · 鸿蒙版`)
        .fontSize(24)
        .fontWeight(FontWeight.Bold)
      Text(this.status).fontSize(14).fontColor('#4fc3f7')
      if (this.gameErr !== '') {
        Text(this.gameErr).fontSize(12).fontColor('#ff5252')
      }

      // 游戏画面：XComponent(surface) 承载，native 侧收窗口句柄（后续接 Vulkan swapchain）
      XComponent({ id: 'game', type: XComponentType.SURFACE, libraryname: 'game' })
        .width('100%')
        .height(420)
        .backgroundColor('#000000')
        .onLoad(() => {
          this.surfaceReady = game.surfaceProbe() === 1;
          this.status = this.surfaceReady ? 'surface 已就绪' : 'surface 未上报';
        })

      Button(this.importing !== '' ? this.importing : `导入游戏资源（${ROMFS_VOLUMES} 分卷文件夹）`)
        .width(300).height(44)
        .fontSize(14)
        .enabled(this.importing === '')
        .onClick(() => {
          this.importResources();
        })

      Row({ space: 8 }) {
        Text('电脑').fontSize(12).opacity(0.6)
        TextInput({ text: this.pcAddr, placeholder: '电脑地址 ip:8000' })
          .fontSize(12).height(40).layoutWeight(1)
          .onChange((v: string) => { this.pcAddr = v.trim(); })
      }
      .width(300)

      Button(this.pulling !== '' ? this.pulling : '从电脑拉取（HTTP）')
        .width(300).height(44)
        .fontSize(14)
        .enabled(this.pulling === '')
        .onClick(() => {
          this.pullFromPc();
        })

      Button(this.started ? '停止' : (this.gameReady ? '启动游戏（CPU boot）' : '游戏镜像解包中…'))
        .width(300).height(48)
        .enabled(this.gameReady && !this.started)
        .onClick(() => {
          if (!this.started) {
            this.startGame();
          } else {
            game.stop();
            this.status = '已停止';
            this.started = false;
            if (this.statusTimerId >= 0) { clearInterval(this.statusTimerId); this.statusTimerId = -1; }
          }
        })

      Text(`画面区域：XComponent surface（Vulkan swapchain 周末接入）· surface=${this.surfaceReady ? 'OK' : '...'} · RomFS=${this.romfsReady ? 'OK' : '未导入'}`)
        .fontSize(11).opacity(0.55)
    }
    .width('100%').height('100%')
    .justifyContent(FlexAlign.Center)
    .backgroundColor('#101014')
  }
}
```

`nxnative-ohos/tools/make_romfs_runtime.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""make_romfs_runtime.py —— 档案驱动的 RomFS 运行时资产生成（game-work/make_romfs_runtime.py 泛化版）。

DMROMFS1（nxnative dm 工具链提取产物）→ 宿主 romfs.c 消费的 TOTKRFS1 索引 + 等大分卷。
两种容器的文件 offset 都是「镜像内绝对偏移」，无需搬数据，只做索引转换 + 分卷。

档案键（games/<titleID>/game.tsv，键表 ../games/README.md）：
  title_id          RomFS.img 自动搜索（--work 同级 *<titleID>/RomFS.img）
  romfs_volume_mib  单卷大小（MiB，缺省 1024；卷数 = ceil(镜像大小/单卷)）
  romfs_marker      归属校验（--verify-marker 时确认该路径在索引里）

用法（totk M3：17,045,762,015 B → 16 卷 @1GiB）：
  python tools/make_romfs_runtime.py --archive games/0100F2C0115B6000 \
      --romfs ../game-work/totk_0100F2C0115B6000/RomFS.img --verify-marker
输出（缺省 .build/<titleID>/romfs_parts/，大文件不入库红线）：
  runtime-index.bin + romfs.bin.000…00N（末卷短）
分卷幂等：已存在且字节数与该卷期望一致的卷跳过重写（断点续跑；不做逐卷哈希，改动镜像后请清空输出区重跑）。
romfs_config.h 由 tools/prepare_runtime.py 生成（吃本工具的 runtime-index.bin 算 INDEX_SHA256）。
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import math
import struct
import sys
from pathlib import Path

NXN = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

ENT = struct.Struct('<QQIHBB')  # DMROMFS1 entry: a,b,name_off,name_len,type,pad


def parse_game_tsv(path: Path) -> dict:
    keys = {}
    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        if not line or line.startswith("#"):
            continue
        parts = line.split("\t")
        if len(parts) >= 2:
            keys[parts[0]] = parts[1]
    return keys


def parse_dmromfs1(path):
    """按 infra/nxnative/dm/host/romfs_image.h 的校验逻辑解析，返回 [(相对路径, offset, size), ...] 全局排序。"""
    size = path.stat().st_size
    with path.open('rb') as f:
        magic, ioff, isz, n = struct.unpack('<8sQQQ', f.read(32))
        if magic != b'DMROMFS1':
            raise SystemExit(f'魔数 {magic!r} 不是 DMROMFS1')
        if not 0 < n <= 0xffffffff or ioff < 32 or ioff > size or isz != size - ioff:
            raise SystemExit('DMROMFS1 头部不合法')
        f.seek(ioff)
        index = f.read(isz)
        if len(index) != isz:
            raise SystemExit('索引读取不完整')
    ents = [ENT.unpack_from(index, k * ENT.size) for k in range(n)]
    pool = isz - n * ENT.size

    def name_of(k):
        a, b, no, nl, t, pad = ents[k]
        if no + nl > pool:
            raise SystemExit(f'条目 {k} 名字越界')
        return index[n * ENT.size + no:n * ENT.size + no + nl].decode('utf-8')

    # 广度优先展开目录树（a=首孩子 b=孩子数；文件 a=offset b=size）——结构与已验证的诊断版一致
    files = []

    def walk(k, prefix):
        a, b, no, nl, t, pad = ents[k]
        if t:
            files.append((prefix, a, b))
            return
        if a + b > n:
            raise SystemExit(f'目录 {k}({prefix}) 孩子区间越界 a={a} b={b} n={n}')
        for j in range(a, a + b):
            ja, jb, jno, jnl, jt, jpad = ents[j]
            child = name_of(j)
            if jt:
                files.append((prefix + child, ja, jb))
            else:
                walk(j, prefix + child + '/')

    walk(0, '')
    files.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
    if len(files) != sum(1 for e in ents if e[4]):
        raise SystemExit(f'文件数不吻合：走到 {len(files)}，索引说 {sum(1 for e in ents if e[4])}')
    return files, size


def sha256_file(path):
    d = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as f:
        while True:
            b = f.read(8 << 20)
            if not b:
                break
            d.update(b)
    return d.hexdigest()


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--archive", required=True, help="游戏档案目录 games/<titleID>/（含 game.tsv）")
    ap.add_argument("--romfs", help="RomFS.img 路径（缺省在 --work 同级按 *<titleID>/RomFS.img 搜索）")
    ap.add_argument("--work", help="<titleID>_build 工作区根（仅供缺省搜索 RomFS.img；本工具不写 work 区）")
    ap.add_argument("--out", help="分卷输出目录（缺省 nxnative-ohos/.build/<titleID>/romfs_parts/）")
    ap.add_argument("--volume-mib", type=int, help="覆盖 romfs_volume_mib（调试用）")
    ap.add_argument("--verify-marker", action="store_true", help="确认 game.tsv 的 romfs_marker 在索引内（归属校验）")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    archive = Path(args.archive).resolve()
    if archive.name == "game.tsv":
        archive = archive.parent
    tsv = parse_game_tsv(archive / "game.tsv")
    for need in ("title_id", "romfs_volume_mib"):
        if need not in tsv:
            sys.exit(f"make_romfs_runtime: game.tsv missing key {need}")
    title_id = tsv["title_id"]
    if archive.name != title_id:
        sys.exit(f"make_romfs_runtime: 档案目录名 {archive.name} != title_id {title_id}")

    img = Path(args.romfs) if args.romfs else None
    if img is None and args.work:
        work = Path(args.work).resolve()
        for p in sorted(work.parent.glob(f"*{title_id}/RomFS.img")):
            img = p
            break
    if not img or not img.is_file():
        sys.exit("make_romfs_runtime: RomFS.img not found (--romfs 或 --work 供搜索)")

    vol_mib = args.volume_mib or int(tsv["romfs_volume_mib"])
    chunk = vol_mib * 1024 * 1024
    image_size = img.stat().st_size
    volumes = max(1, math.ceil(image_size / chunk))
    out = Path(args.out).resolve() if args.out else NXN / ".build" / title_id / "romfs_parts"
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    print(f"[1/4] 解析 DMROMFS1 {img.name} …")
    files, _ = parse_dmromfs1(img)
    data_bytes = sum(f[2] for f in files)
    print(f"    文件 {len(files)} 个，镜像 {image_size:,} 字节，文件数据 {data_bytes:,} 字节")
    if args.verify_marker:
        marker = tsv.get("romfs_marker", "")
        if marker and marker not in {f[0] for f in files}:
            sys.exit(f"make_romfs_runtime: romfs_marker {marker} 不在镜像索引内（归属校验失败）")
        print(f"    romfs_marker {marker} in index OK")

    print('[2/4] 生成 TOTKRFS1 runtime-index.bin …')
    strings, rows = bytearray(), bytearray()
    for path_s, off, size in files:
        nb = path_s.encode() + b'\0'
        rows.extend(struct.pack('<QQII', off, size, len(strings), len(nb)))
        strings.extend(nb)
    index = struct.pack('<8sQQ', b'TOTKRFS1', len(files), 24 + len(rows)) + bytes(rows) + bytes(strings)
    (out / 'runtime-index.bin').write_bytes(index)
    index_sha = hashlib.sha256(index).hexdigest()
    print(f'    index {len(index):,} 字节 sha256={index_sha}')

    print('[3/4] 全镜像 SHA256 …')
    image_sha = sha256_file(img)
    print(f'    image sha256={image_sha}')

    print(f'[4/4] 分卷 {vol_mib} MiB × {volumes}（末卷短）→ {out} …')
    written = skipped = 0
    with img.open('rb') as f:
        k = 0
        while True:
            b = f.read(chunk)
            if not b:
                break
            vol = out / f'romfs.bin.{k:03d}'
            if vol.is_file() and vol.stat().st_size == len(b):
                skipped += 1                       # 幂等：同大小分卷跳过（断点续跑）
            else:
                vol.write_bytes(b)
                written += 1
            if (k + 1) % 4 == 0 or k + 1 == volumes:
                print(f'    卷 {k + 1}/{volumes}')
            k += 1
    print(f'    {k} 卷（重写 {written}，跳过 {skipped}）')
    print('DONE')
    print(f'parts_dir: {out}')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

```

`nxnative-ohos/tools/prepare_runtime.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""prepare_runtime.py —— 用 nxnative 转译产物生成鸿蒙宿主的绑定头（泛化版）。

从 game-work/prepare_runtime_ohos.py 泛化：路径全走 CLI 参数 + 游戏档案，去硬编码
（nxnative-ohos 设计 §4.3）。档案（games/<titleID>/game.tsv）只消费两键：
  modules   → runtime_tables.h 的模块表（rtld 由宿主替换，不列）
  title_id  → RomFS.img 自动搜索兜底（<work> 同级 *<titleID>/RomFS.img）

输入：<work>/patched/<模块>/（patched.bin + fixups.tsv + gates.tsv）
输出：<out>/{runtime_tables.h, romfs_config.h, shared_fonts_config.h}

与 Mac 原版 prepare_runtime.py 的差异（沿袭 game-work 版）：跳过 expected 哈希校验
（nxnative 重写器产物，M2 恢复该纪律）、接受 spin 类 gate、共享字体守卫——
shared_fonts_config.h 已存在（make_shared_fonts.py 内嵌了伪造字体）则不动。
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import struct
import sys
from pathlib import Path


def parse_game_tsv(path: Path) -> dict:
    """game.tsv：每行 key<TAB>value，# 开头注释行。返回单值键表（build/shader_groups 等原样字符串）。"""
    keys = {}
    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        if not line or line.startswith("#"):
            continue
        parts = line.split("\t")
        if len(parts) >= 2:
            keys[parts[0]] = parts[1]
    return keys


def find_d2r(override: str) -> Path:
    """relr.py 所在 d2r 目录：--d2r > $D2R_PATH > 仓库内 infra/MacNativeGames/games/by3/third_party/d2r。"""
    cands = []
    if override:
        cands.append(Path(override))
    if os.environ.get("D2R_PATH"):
        cands.append(Path(os.environ["D2R_PATH"]))
    cands.append(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "infra" / "MacNativeGames" / "games" / "by3" / "third_party" / "d2r")
    for c in cands:
        if (c / "relr.py").is_file():
            return c
    sys.exit(f"prepare_runtime: relr.py not found (tried: {[str(c) for c in cands]}); pass --d2r <dir>")


def find_romfs(explicit: str, work: Path, title_id: str) -> Path:
    """RomFS.img：--romfs > <work> 同级的 *<titleID>/RomFS.img（game-work 抽取目录命名 <短名>_<titleID>）。"""
    if explicit:
        p = Path(explicit)
        if p.is_file():
            return p
        sys.exit(f"prepare_runtime: --romfs {explicit} not found")
    for p in sorted(work.parent.glob(f"*{title_id}/RomFS.img")):
        return p
    sys.exit(f"prepare_runtime: RomFS.img not found next to {work} (pattern *{title_id}/RomFS.img); pass --romfs")


def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as f:
        for block in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
            h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()


class Runtime:  # ---- 以下逻辑与 game-work/prepare_runtime_ohos.py 逐行同源（只参数化路径/模块表） ----
    def __init__(self, patched: Path, out: Path, d2r: Path):
        self.PATCHED = patched
        self.OUT = out
        sys.path.insert(0, str(d2r))
        global decode_relr
        from relr import decode_relr  # noqa: F401  (infra/MacNativeGames …/d2r/relr.py)
        self.OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    def layout_of(self, name):
        lay = {}
        for line in (self.PATCHED / name / f"{name}.fixups.tsv").read_text().splitlines():
            parts = line.split()
            if len(parts) == 3 and parts[1].isupper():
                try:
                    lay[parts[1]] = int(parts[2], 0)
                except ValueError:
                    pass  # BUILD_ID 等非数值行
        need = ["PATCH_OFF", "KEY_PAGE_OFF", "TEXT_END", "RO_OFF", "DATA_OFF"]
        missing = [k for k in need if k not in lay]
        assert not missing, f"{name} fixups missing {missing}: {list(lay)}"
        return lay

    def module_table(self, name):
        path = self.PATCHED / name / f"{name}.patched.bin"
        image = path.read_bytes()
        digest = hashlib.sha256(image).hexdigest()
        layout = self.layout_of(name)
        mod0 = struct.unpack_from("<I", image, 4)[0]
        assert image[mod0:mod0 + 4] == b"MOD0"
        dyn = mod0 + struct.unpack_from("<i", image, mod0 + 4)[0]
        tags = {}
        for off in range(dyn, dyn + 4096 * 16, 16):
            tag, value = struct.unpack_from("<qQ", image, off)
            if tag == 0:
                break
            tags[tag] = value
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"{name}: unterminated dynamic table")
        assert tags[11] == 24 and tags[9] == 24 and tags[20] == 7, f"{name}: dynamic layout {tags}"
        nsym = struct.unpack_from("<I", image, tags[4] + 4)[0] if 4 in tags else 0
        symbols = []
        for i in range(nsym):
            no, info, other, section, value, size = struct.unpack_from("<IBBHQQ", image, tags[6] + 24 * i)
            end = image.index(0, tags[5] + no, tags[5] + tags[10])
            symbols.append(dict(name=image[tags[5] + no:end].decode(), value=value, size=size,
                                defined=bool(section), binding=info >> 4, type=info & 15))
        relocs = [dict(where=w, kind=1027, symbol=0, addend=a)
                  for w, a in decode_relr(image, tags, layout["DATA_OFF"], layout["KEY_PAGE_OFF"])]
        relocated = {r["where"] for r in relocs}
        for address, size in [(tags[7], tags[8]), (tags[23], tags[2])]:
            if not size:
                continue
            assert size % 24 == 0
            for off in range(address, address + size, 24):
                where, info, addend = struct.unpack_from("<QQq", image, off)
                kind, si = info & 0xFFFFFFFF, info >> 32
                assert kind in (257, 1025, 1026, 1027) and si < nsym, f"{name}: reloc kind {kind} at {where:#x}"
                assert layout["DATA_OFF"] <= where <= layout["KEY_PAGE_OFF"] - 8
                assert where not in relocated, f"{name}: duplicate RELR/RELA at {where:#x}"
                relocated.add(where)
                relocs.append(dict(where=where, kind=kind, symbol=si, addend=addend))
        gates = []
        for line in (self.PATCHED / name / f"{name}.gates.tsv").read_text().splitlines():
            ret, kind, arg, original = line.split()
            assert kind in ("cntpct", "cntvct", "svc", "spin"), f"{name}: gate kind {kind}"
            gates.append(dict(ret=int(ret, 0), timer=kind != "svc", arg=int(arg), original=int(original, 0)))
        # ctor state word：DT_INIT 里 adrp+ldr 对（照抄原版逻辑）
        init = tags[12]
        words = [struct.unpack_from("<I", image, init + 4 * i)[0] for i in range(16)]
        ctor_flag = 0
        for i, a in enumerate(words):
            if a & 0x9F000000 != 0x90000000:
                continue
            reg = a & 31
            for j in range(i + 1, len(words)):
                w = words[j]
                if w & 0xFFC00000 == 0xB9400000 and (w >> 5) & 31 == reg:
                    imm = ((a >> 29) & 3) | (((a >> 5) & 0x7FFFF) << 2)
                    imm = (imm ^ (1 << 20)) - (1 << 20)
                    ctor_flag = ((init + 4 * i) & ~4095) + (imm << 12) + ((w >> 10) & 0xFFF) * 4
                    break
            if ctor_flag:
                break
        assert ctor_flag, f"{name}: no constructor-state load in DT_INIT"
        return dict(name=name, sha256=digest, size=len(image), layout=layout, tags=tags, symbols=symbols,
                    relocs=relocs, gates=gates, ctor_flag=ctor_flag)

    def runtime_tables(self, module_names):
        modules = [self.module_table(n) for n in module_names]
        main = modules[0]
        target = "_ZN2nn2os13GetSystemTickEv"
        sym_index = {s["name"]: i for i, s in enumerate(main["symbols"])}
        slot = next(r["where"] for r in main["relocs"] if r["kind"] == 1026 and r["symbol"] == sym_index[target])
        image = (self.PATCHED / module_names[0] / f"{module_names[0]}.patched.bin").read_bytes()
        plt = []
        for address in range(main["layout"]["TEXT_END"] - 0x10000, main["layout"]["TEXT_END"] - 12, 4):
            a, b, c, d = struct.unpack_from("<IIII", image, address)
            if a & 0x9F00001F != 0x90000010 or b & 0xFFC003FF != 0xF9400211 or d != 0xD61F0220:
                continue
            imm = ((a >> 29) & 3) | (((a >> 5) & 0x7FFFF) << 2)
            imm = (imm ^ (1 << 20)) - (1 << 20)
            if (address & ~4095) + (imm << 12) + ((b >> 10) & 0xFFF) * 8 == slot:
                plt.append(address)
        assert len(plt) == 1, f"PLT matches {plt}"
        lines = ["/* Generated by nxnative-ohos/tools/prepare_runtime.py from nxnative rewrite products. */"]
        for n, m in enumerate(modules):
            lines.append(f"static const Reloc reloc_{n}[] = {{")
            lines.extend(f"{{{r['where']}ULL,{r['kind']},{r['symbol']},{r['addend']}LL}}," for r in m["relocs"])
            lines.append("};")
            lines.append(f"static const Symbol symbol_{n}[] = {{")
            lines.extend("{" + f"{json.dumps(s['name'])},{s['value']}ULL,{s['size']}ULL,{int(s['defined'])},{s['binding']},{s['type']}" + "}," for s in m["symbols"])
            lines.append("};")
            lines.append(f"static const Gate gate_{n}[] = {{")
            lines.extend(f"{{{g['ret']}ULL,{g['original']}ULL,{int(g['timer'])},{g['arg']}}}," for g in m["gates"])
            if not m["gates"]:
                lines.append("{0,0,0,0},")
            lines.append("};")
        lines.append("static Module modules[] = {")
        for n, m in enumerate(modules):
            l = m["layout"]
            lines.append("{" + f".name={json.dumps(m['name'])},.digest={json.dumps(m['sha256'])},.file_size={m['size']}ULL,.text_end={l['TEXT_END']}ULL,.ro_off={l['RO_OFF']}ULL,.data_off={l['DATA_OFF']}ULL,.patch_off={l['PATCH_OFF']}ULL,.key_off={l['KEY_PAGE_OFF']}ULL,.symbols=symbol_{n},.nsym={len(m['symbols'])},.relocs=reloc_{n},.nreloc={len(m['relocs'])},.gates=gate_{n},.ngate={len(m['gates'])},.init={m['tags'].get(12,0)}ULL,.ctor_flag={m['ctor_flag']}ULL,.init_array={m['tags'].get(25,0)}ULL,.init_size={m['tags'].get(27,0)}ULL" + "},")
        lines.append("};")
        lines.append(f"#define PROBE_PLT {plt[0]}ULL\n#define PROBE_SLOT {slot}ULL")
        (self.OUT / "runtime_tables.h").write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
        return dict(modules=len(modules), relocations=sum(len(m["relocs"]) for m in modules))

    def romfs_config(self, img: Path, index_hint: Path | None):
        size = img.stat().st_size
        image_sha = sha256_file(img)
        # runtime-index.bin：make_romfs_runtime 的分卷输出区（game-work 布局在 <work> 同级 romfs_parts/），
        # 找到才算真 INDEX SHA，找不到记 "0"（运行时侧 romfs 校验会失败，应尽早补分卷区）
        index_sha = "0"
        cands = ([index_hint] if index_hint else
                 [self.PATCHED.parent.parent / "romfs_parts" / "runtime-index.bin",
                  self.PATCHED.parent / "romfs_parts" / "runtime-index.bin",
                  self.PATCHED.parent / "runtime-index.bin",
                  img.parent / "runtime-index.bin"])
        for c in cands:
            if c and c.is_file():
                index_sha = sha256_file(c)
                break
        (self.OUT / "romfs_config.h").write_text(
            f"#define ROMFS_IMAGE_SIZE {size}ULL\n"
            f'#define ROMFS_IMAGE_SHA256 "{image_sha}"\n'
            f'#define ROMFS_INDEX_SHA256 "{index_sha}"\n')
        return dict(size=size, image_sha=image_sha, index_sha=index_sha)

    def shared_fonts_config(self):
        out = self.OUT / "shared_fonts_config.h"
        if out.exists():  # make_shared_fonts.py 内嵌了伪造字体，别踩掉（守卫逻辑沿袭 game-work 版）
            return "kept"
        rows = ['{"",0ULL,0ULL,""}'] * 6
        out.write_text(
            "#define SHARED_FONT_COUNT 6\n#define SHARED_FONT_ROWS " + ",".join(rows) + "\n")
        return "empty"


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--archive", required=True, help="游戏档案目录 games/<titleID>/（含 game.tsv）")
    ap.add_argument("--work", required=True, help="<titleID>_build 工作区根（含 patched/<模块>/）")
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True, help="生成头输出目录（实例化工程的 entry/src/main/cpp/generated）")
    ap.add_argument("--romfs", help="RomFS.img 路径（缺省在 work 同级按 *<titleID>/RomFS.img 搜索）")
    ap.add_argument("--romfs-index", help="runtime-index.bin 路径（缺省在 work 区搜索，找不到 INDEX SHA 记 \"0\"）")
    ap.add_argument("--d2r", help="d2r 目录（含 relr.py；缺省 $D2R_PATH 或仓库 infra/MacNativeGames/…/d2r）")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    archive = Path(args.archive).resolve()
    work = Path(args.work).resolve()
    out = Path(args.out).resolve()
    tsv = parse_game_tsv(archive / "game.tsv")
    for need in ("title_id", "modules"):
        if need not in tsv:
            sys.exit(f"prepare_runtime: game.tsv missing key {need}")
    modules = tsv["modules"].split()          # 加载序（rtld 不列，宿主替换）
    img = find_romfs(args.romfs, work, tsv["title_id"])
    rt = Runtime(work / "patched", out, find_d2r(args.d2r))
    print("runtime_tables:", rt.runtime_tables(modules))
    print("romfs:", rt.romfs_config(img, Path(args.romfs_index) if args.romfs_index else None))
    print("shared_fonts:", rt.shared_fonts_config())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```diff
+/* ---- M39A（2026-11-09）：guest 720x405 场景 RT 直送**转正为默认 present 源** ----
+   M38H 用 `smo_m38h_present=<slot>` 强制后画面通了（logs/m38h_b1/screen_198.png 人眼=礼帽角色/
+   帽子/面部）⇒「present 时刻活图已被清、只能送我们自己的 m7h-world 快照」这条绕法的前提至少不全面。
+   本轮把它变成**不需要任何环境变量**的默认行为：
+   · 槽号**不硬编码**：每 64 次 present（与 p_slot_override 同节奏）在本 boot 的槽表里重扫一次，

+   · 逃生阀：`smo_m39a_off`。**只有显式 1 才是关**（缺省文件由 p_file_seed 种成 -1 = 直送）；

+     `[m39a] fallback why=uniform_white slot=<n>`。目的：转正不能把画面变成纯白，同时把
+     「哪些帧本来就白」如实暴露出来。
+   不改 selector 语义、不动深度挂载、不动纹理身份（那三件是后续轮次的事）。
+   缩放不在这里做：源按原尺寸拷进 staging，win_fill.c 的最近邻等比 fit 铺满呈现面
+   （720x405 -> 800x450 时 dw=800/dh=450）。 */
+#define M39A_A  "/data/storage/el2/base/files/smo_m39a_off"
+#define M39A_B  "/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files/smo_m39a_off"
+#define M39A_W  720u
+#define M39A_H  405u
+static int g_m39a_dbg = -1;   /* 已打过日志的槽号（-2 = 打过一次 fallback）；只做去重 */
+/* 1 = 直送关（退回 m7h-world）。只有文件里显式 1 才算关：缺省 -1 / 0 都 = 直送。 */
+static int m39a_off(void)
+{
+    static int cached = -2; static unsigned long long last;
+    if (cached == -2) { p_file_seed(M39A_A, M39A_B); cached = p_file_int(M39A_A, M39A_B, -1); last = g_p_calls; }
+    else if (g_p_calls - last >= 64) { cached = p_file_int(M39A_A, M39A_B, -1); last = g_p_calls; }
+    return cached == 1;
 }
+/* 扫槽表选「本帧写得最多的 720x405 槽」。返回槽号（-1 = 本帧没有候选）；*dwo = 该槽本帧 dw_frm，
+   *alo = 该槽整 boot 累计 dw_all（只用于日志判读）。平手时优先上一次选中的槽，防每 64 拍跳槽。 */
+static int m39a_pick(unsigned *dwo, unsigned *alo)
+{
+    const int ns = (int)(sizeof g_rt_tab / sizeof *g_rt_tab);
```

```patch
+/* round13b 修复（崩溃定因）：四字门的重放字里出现 PC 相对指令时不能原样重放——adrp/分支族
+   会按 stub 的 PC 计算目标。13b 首跑即崩：round12e cell2 门（0x9b9bc4）重放首字 adrp x8，
+   以 stub 页（main+0x14d4xxx）算出 main 尾后地址，w16 读回垃圾 0x540007017100051f，w17
+   ldr x8,[x8] SEGV@0x000007017100051f（fault log：pc=stub+0x44 即 w17、x8=该垃圾、
+   lr=main+0x9b9bac 恰为门上游，三者互证）。修法：adrp 在安装期把 imm 重算到『stub 内该字
+   位置』仍指向原绝对页（同语义）；其余 PC 相对字形（b/bl/b.cond/cbz/cbnz/tbz/tbnz/adr/
+   ldr-literal）本机制不支持，直接拒装该门（fail-soft）。E1/E2/kick1 等四字门经此扫描
+   全为寄存器+立即数字形，不受影响。w[4] 为 4 个重放字（就地改写）；off=门在 main 的偏移，
+   stub_off=stub 在 main 的偏移。返回 0=拒装（why 填原因）。 */
+static int smo_obs_replay_fix(uint32_t w[4], uint32_t off, uint64_t stub_off, char *why, size_t whyn) {
+    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
+        uint32_t v = w[i];
+        uint64_t wo = stub_off + (15 + i) * 4;              /* 该字在 stub 内的 main 相对地址 */
+        if ((v & 0x9f000000u) == 0x90000000u) {             /* adrp：重算 imm（同绝对页） */
+            int64_t imm = (int64_t)((v >> 29) & 3) | ((int64_t)((v >> 5) & 0x7ffff) << 2);
+            if (imm & (1 << 20)) imm -= 1 << 21;
+            uint64_t page_abs = (off & ~0xfffu) + ((uint64_t)imm << 12);   /* 原绝对页 */
+            int64_t want = (int64_t)(page_abs - (wo & ~0xfffu)) >> 12;
+            if (want < -(1 << 20) || want >= (1 << 20)) {
+                snprintf(why, whyn, "adrp relocation out of range (%+lld pages)", (long long)want);
+                return 0;
+            }
+            w[i] = (v & 0x9f00001fu) | ((uint32_t)(want & 3) << 29) | ((uint32_t)((want >> 2) & 0x7ffff) << 5);
+        } else if ((v >> 26) == 0x05 || (v >> 26) == 0x25   /* b / bl */
+                   || (v & 0xff000000u) == 0x54000000u      /* b.cond */
+                   || (v & 0x7f000000u) >= 0x34000000u && (v & 0x7f000000u) <= 0x37000000u   /* cbz/cbnz/tbz/tbnz（含 sf 位屏蔽） */
+                   || (v & 0x9f000000u) == 0x10000000u      /* adr */
+                   || (v & 0xbf000000u) == 0x18000000u) {   /* ldr-literal */
+            snprintf(why, whyn, "PC-relative word %#x at slot %d unsupported", v, i);
+            return 0;
+        }
+    }
+    return 1;
+}
```

```patch
+static void nvn_rcpt_map(uint64_t h,cmd_h *c){   /* EndRecording：句柄→CB 对象（submit 侧回执反查） */

+static cmd_h *nvn_rcpt_lookup(uint64_t h){

+static void nvn_rcpt_submit(int n,const uint64_t *hs){

+ }

+}
```

```patch
+    {0x587ea8, SMO_OBS_ALKICK,  1, {0x140c94d2, 0xd65f03c0, 0, 0}},                     /* b 0x8ad1f0（后继 0x587eac ret） */
+    {0x8ad318, SMO_OBS_KICK3,   1, {0x14000002, 0x00000000, 0, 0}},                     /* b 0x8ad320（后继 0x8ad31c udf 填充） */
+    /* round15 排空路径门（0x8abf70 反汇编实测字，main.patched.bin 校验一致）： */
+    {0x8abf70, SMO_OBS_DRAIN_ENTER, 0, {0xf81d0ff5, 0xa9014ff4, 0xa9027bfd, 0x910083fd}}, /* str x21,[sp,#-0x30]!; stp x20,x19; stp x29,x30; add x29,sp,#0x20 */
+    /* round16b 排空循环块门：循环头=b.ne(0x8abfac) 回边落点=bl(0x8abfa0) 所在块入口。
+       第 4 字 bl 0x8ad1f0 经 smo_obs_replay_fix 的 bl 重定位原义重放（同绝对目标）。 */
+    {0x8abf94, SMO_OBS_DRAIN_LOOP, 0, {0xf9400515, 0xd1070100, 0x2a1303e1, 0x94000494}}, /* ldr x21,[x8,#8]; sub x0,x8,#0x1c0; mov w1,w19; bl 0x8ad1f0 */
+    /* round17 ②③：donor 广播调用点入口 + kick 虚调尾取数点（字取自 main.patched.bin 实测反汇编）。 */
+    {0x954310, SMO_OBS_BC310,   0, {0xd10203ff, 0xf9001bf9, 0xa9045ff8, 0xa90557f6}}, /* sub sp,sp,#0x80; str x25,[sp,#0x30]; stp x24,x23,[sp,#0x40]; stp x22,x21,[sp,#0x50] */
+    {0x8ad214, SMO_OBS_KICKVT,  0, {0xf9400268, 0xf9401101, 0xaa1303e0, 0xa9417bfd}}, /* ldr x8,[x19]; ldr x1,[x8,#0x20]; mov x0,x19; ldp x29,x30,[sp,#0x10] */
+};
+#define SMO_OBS_E1_CAP 128
+static struct {
+    _Atomic uint64_t seq;                       /* 偶=稳定，奇=写入中（g_spin_cap 范式） */
+    _Atomic uint64_t hits; _Atomic uint64_t last_x0;
+    unsigned n, truncated; uint64_t obj, arr;
+    uint64_t el[SMO_OBS_E1_CAP], thiz[SMO_OBS_E1_CAP];
+} g_e1;
+/* round15 变迁史（末三注册分析建议②）：E1 快照只存末值（threads.c 旧 1385-1401），count 从 N
+   缩到 2 的时刻无从对账。观察器在 26k/s 洪流里只在 count/arr 变化时记一笔 {E1 hits, count, arr}
+   （hits 单调，两次 dump 的 hits 差≈耗时 → 缩点时刻可换算），64 槽环形覆盖保最旧 64 条之外
+   的最近 64 条；写入仍是纯定长拷贝+原子头指针（观察器无锁无 I/O 红线不变）。
+   round16b：条目改 {hits,count,arr,ts}——ts=CNTVCT_EL0 裸读（mrs，非 libc，红线不破；观测器
+   若用 clock_gettime 即引 vDSO/libc）。环改 32 条（最近 32 次变迁），另存单调汇总标量 max_cnt
+   （曾否>2 一目了然，环覆盖也不丢）与缩点 tick（lastc>2 → n≤2 的首个变迁，prev→cur 值随行）。
+   tick→ns 换算在 dump 侧：安装时与 dump 时各取一对 {tick, runtime_now_ns()}，两点连线内插
+   （免读 CNTFRQ_EL0——EL0 可读性平台不一，内插自校准）。 */
+#define SMO_OBS_E1_HIST 32
+static struct {
+    _Atomic unsigned head;                      /* 已记录变迁总数（环覆盖） */
+    uint32_t lastc; uint64_t lastarr;           /* 上次记录值（去重；E1 单线程调用，无竞争） */
+    struct { uint64_t hits, arr, tick; uint32_t cnt; } e[SMO_OBS_E1_HIST];
+    uint32_t max_cnt, shrink_from, shrink_to, shrunk;   /* 汇总标量（E1 单线程，无竞争） */
+    uint64_t max_tick, shrink_tick;
+} g_e1h;
+/* round16b tick 基准对（安装时取；dump 侧配第二点做内插换算） */
+static uint64_t g_obs_tick0, g_obs_ns0; static int g_obs_tick0_set;
+static inline uint64_t smo_obs_tick(void) { uint64_t t; __asm__ volatile("mrs %0, cntvct_el0" : "=r"(t)); return t; }
+/* round16b DRAIN-LOOP 首见快照：kick 三条件值（w1 / [this+0xf9] / [this+0x20]，this=x8-0x1c0）
+   + 节点 x8 + tick。首见一次即定格（set=1），此后每命中只加 hits——快照读仅首见一次，
+   新解引用面=每 boot 至多 3 个字（对象本体是游戏下一拍 0x8ad208/0x8ad278 就要读的字段）。 */
+static struct { _Atomic unsigned set; uint64_t node, this, w1, f9, o20, tick; } g_dl;
+/* round17 ①：KICK1 门（0x8ad1f4）加挂 kick 三条件快照——DRAIN-LOOP 门随排空函数 0x8abf70
+   永不被调（round16 ENTER=LOOP=0）而永不命中，三条件改在 kick 真入口取：门点原参
+   x0=kick this（0x8ad1fc mov x19,x0 的原值）、原 x1=w1（stub 参4 抄走，movz 覆盖前）。
+   [this+0xf9]（1B）+[this+0x20]（8B）＝kick 0x8ad208/0x8ad278 自己要读的字段（护栏
+   <2^32 拒读 + 指针域 0x1_0000_0000..0x8000_0000_0000，DRAIN-LOOP 快照同款范式）。
+   分布标量按 kick 三分支交叉计数（0x8ad200 cmp w1,#1 / b.lt；0x8ad208 ldrb+cmp #2）：
+   n_lt1=w1<1 直虚调、n_ge1_f9eq2=w1≥1∧f9==2 直虚调、n_ge1_f9ne2=w1≥1∧f9≠2 动画路径、
+   n_o20z=[this+0x20]==0（动画路径 0x8ad28c cbz 跳过 bl 0x8ac800 的条件）。首见一次定格
+   {this,w1,f9,o20,tick}，末见逐字段原子覆盖 {w1,f9,o20}——216 次真 kick 的分支去向
+   一屏可读。多线程 kick 并发：标量全原子 fetch_add；首见幂等竞争下良性覆盖（观测用途）。 */
+static struct {
+    _Atomic unsigned set;
+    uint64_t this_, w1, f9, o20, tick;                         /* 首见（set=1 定格） */
+    _Atomic uint64_t last_w1, last_f9, last_o20;               /* 末见（逐字段原子） */
+    _Atomic uint64_t n_lt1, n_ge1_f9eq2, n_ge1_f9ne2, n_o20z;  /* 三分支交叉分布 */
+} g_k1;
+/* round17 ②：BC310 门首见 {x0, tick}（末见 x0 走既有 g_obs_x0[gate]）；③：KICKVT 8 槽
+   去重目标分布——tgt==0（虚表槽空，游戏自己 br x1 到 0 必崩，只计数不入表）＋
+   over=8 槽满后的溢出计数。CAS 占位是原子原语非锁，观察器红线（无锁/无 I/O/无 libc）不破。 */
+static struct { _Atomic unsigned set; uint64_t x0, tick; } g_bc;
+static struct {
+    _Atomic uint64_t val[8], cnt[8];
+    _Atomic uint64_t over, n_zero, first_vt, first_tgt, last_tgt;
+    _Atomic unsigned set;
+} g_vt;
+static _Atomic uint64_t g_obs_hits[SMO_OBS_N], g_obs_x0[SMO_OBS_N];
+/* round12e cell 链一次性快照（SMO_OBS_CELL2）：{cell1,table1,fn1, cell2,table2,fn2}
+   对应 cell 0x1363dc8（=Map，验证链条读法）与 cell 0x136deb8（待定名）。 */
+static _Atomic uint64_t g_cell2[6]; static _Atomic unsigned g_cell2_set;
+static uint64_t g_obs_main_base;   /* 安装期在宿主侧写好（main 模块基址），观察器只读 */
+static uint64_t g_obs_rx_lo, g_obs_rx_hi;   /* 尾部 stub 页的 RX 区间（安装成功后填；check_permissions 查询） */
+/* 客体小栈上被 veneer 调进来的观察器：只做原子计数与定长拷贝，无锁/无 I/O/无 libc。
+   gate=x1（stub 里 movz 立即数），x0=入口原参；round16b 起 x2=门点原 x8（caller-saved，
+   stub 里显式保存/传递——DRAIN-LOOP 的节点指针在 x8）、x3=门点原 x1（被 movz gate 覆盖前的
+   原值；DRAIN-LOOP 循环头处恒=w19=排空参数 w1）。其余门不读 x2/x3，传了也是废参。 */
+static void smo_obs_observer(uint64_t x0, uint64_t gate, uint64_t x2, uint64_t x3) {
+    if (gate >= SMO_OBS_N) return;
+    atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_obs_hits[gate], 1, memory_order_relaxed);
+    atomic_store_explicit(&g_obs_x0[gate], x0, memory_order_relaxed);
+    (void)g_cell2; (void)g_cell2_set; (void)g_obs_main_base;   /* round12e（本门无 E1 快照路径） */
+    if (gate != SMO_OBS_E1) {
+        /* round12e 定名打点：首命中时快照两条 cell→table→fn 链。只读 main 数据段里
+           游戏 0x9b9b9c-0x9b9bd0 自己刚读过的同一批地址（护栏只挡 <2^32 的明显非指针），
+           无 I/O/无 libc——符号化留给 dump 侧。 */
+        if (gate == SMO_OBS_CELL2 && !atomic_load_explicit(&g_cell2_set, memory_order_relaxed) && g_obs_main_base) {
+            uint64_t c[2] = {0, 0}, t[2] = {0, 0}, f[2] = {0, 0};
+            c[0] = *(const volatile uint64_t *)(const void *)(uintptr_t)(g_obs_main_base + 0x1363dc8);
+            c[1] = *(const volatile uint64_t *)(const void *)(uintptr_t)(g_obs_main_base + 0x136deb8);
+            for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
+                if (c[k] > 0x100000000ULL) t[k] = *(const volatile uint64_t *)(const void *)(uintptr_t)c[k];
+                if (t[k] > 0x100000000ULL) f[k] = *(const volatile uint64_t *)(const void *)(uintptr_t)t[k];
+            }
+            for (int k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
+                atomic_store_explicit(&g_cell2[k*3+0], c[k], memory_order_relaxed);
+                atomic_store_explicit(&g_cell2[k*3+1], t[k], memory_order_relaxed);
+                atomic_store_explicit(&g_cell2[k*3+2], f[k], memory_order_relaxed);
+            }
+            atomic_store_explicit(&g_cell2_set, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
+        }
+        /* round16b DRAIN-LOOP 首见快照：kick 三条件值。this=x8-0x1c0（0x8abf98 sub 的原义），
+           字段护栏同全局范式（<2^32 拒读）；[this+0xf9] 1 字节 + [this+0x20] 8 字节——
+           kick 0x8ad208/0x8ad278 就要读的字段，首见一次定格。 */
+        if (gate == SMO_OBS_DRAIN_LOOP && !atomic_load_explicit(&g_dl.set, memory_order_relaxed)) {
+            uint64_t this_ = x2 > 0x1c0 ? x2 - 0x1c0 : 0;
+            g_dl.node = x2; g_dl.this = this_; g_dl.w1 = x3; g_dl.tick = smo_obs_tick();
+            if (this_ > 0x100000000ULL && this_ < 0x800000000000ULL) {
+                g_dl.f9 = *(const volatile uint8_t *)(const void *)(uintptr_t)(this_ + 0xf9);
+                g_dl.o20 = *(const volatile uint64_t *)(const void *)(uintptr_t)(this_ + 0x20);
+            }
+            atomic_store_explicit(&g_dl.set, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
+        }
+        /* round17 ①：KICK1 门每次命中记 kick 三条件（this=x0、w1=x3）＋三分支交叉分布。
+           首见一次定格，末见逐字段原子覆盖。kick 可多线程并发（thunk 路径多调用方）：
+           标量全原子，首见 set 检查非原子但幂等（良性覆盖，观测用途）。 */
+        if (gate == SMO_OBS_KICK1) {
+            uint64_t f9 = 0, o20 = 0;
+            int rd = x0 > 0x100000000ULL && x0 < 0x800000000000ULL;
+            if (rd) {
+                f9 = *(const volatile uint8_t *)(const void *)(uintptr_t)(x0 + 0xf9);
+                o20 = *(const volatile uint64_t *)(const void *)(uintptr_t)(x0 + 0x20);
+            }
+            if ((uint32_t)x3 < 1) atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_k1.n_lt1, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
+            else if (f9 == 2)     atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_k1.n_ge1_f9eq2, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
+            else                  atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_k1.n_ge1_f9ne2, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
+            if (o20 == 0) atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_k1.n_o20z, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
+            if (!atomic_load_explicit(&g_k1.set, memory_order_relaxed)) {
+                g_k1.this_ = x0; g_k1.w1 = x3; g_k1.f9 = f9; g_k1.o20 = o20; g_k1.tick = smo_obs_tick();
+                atomic_store_explicit(&g_k1.set, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
+            }
+            atomic_store_explicit(&g_k1.last_w1, x3, memory_order_relaxed);
+            atomic_store_explicit(&g_k1.last_f9, f9, memory_order_relaxed);
+            atomic_store_explicit(&g_k1.last_o20, o20, memory_order_relaxed);
+        }
+        /* round17 ②：BC310 首见 {x0, tick}（末见 x0 走 g_obs_x0[gate]）。 */
+        if (gate == SMO_OBS_BC310 && !atomic_load_explicit(&g_bc.set, memory_order_relaxed)) {
+            g_bc.x0 = x0; g_bc.tick = smo_obs_tick();
+            atomic_store_explicit(&g_bc.set, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
+        }
+        /* round17 ③：KICKVT 虚调目标分布——vt=[x0]（=kick this 的 vtable，游戏 0x8ad214
+           下一拍就读）、tgt=[vt+0x20]（0x8ad218 下一拍就读，br x1(0x8ad228) 的目标）。
+           8 槽去重：命中即计数，空槽 CAS 占位，满则 over。tgt==0 只计数（不入表）。 */
+        if (gate == SMO_OBS_KICKVT) {
+            uint64_t vt = 0, tgt = 0;
+            if (x0 > 0x100000000ULL && x0 < 0x800000000000ULL)
+                vt = *(const volatile uint64_t *)(const void *)(uintptr_t)x0;
+            if (vt > 0x100000000ULL && vt < 0x800000000000ULL)
+                tgt = *(const volatile uint64_t *)(const void *)(uintptr_t)(vt + 0x20);
+            atomic_store_explicit(&g_vt.last_tgt, tgt, memory_order_relaxed);
+            if (!atomic_load_explicit(&g_vt.set, memory_order_relaxed)) {
+                g_vt.first_vt = vt; g_vt.first_tgt = tgt;
+                atomic_store_explicit(&g_vt.set, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
+            }
+            if (tgt == 0) { atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_vt.n_zero, 1, memory_order_relaxed); return; }
+            for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
+                uint64_t v = atomic_load_explicit(&g_vt.val[i], memory_order_relaxed);
+                if (v == tgt) { atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_vt.cnt[i], 1, memory_order_relaxed); return; }
+                if (v == 0) {
+                    uint64_t exp = 0;
+                    if (atomic_compare_exchange_strong_explicit(&g_vt.val[i], &exp, tgt, memory_order_relaxed, memory_order_relaxed)) {
+                        atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_vt.cnt[i], 1, memory_order_relaxed); return;
+                    }
+                    if (exp == tgt) { atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_vt.cnt[i], 1, memory_order_relaxed); return; }
+                }
+            }
+            atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_vt.over, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
+        }
+        return;
+    }
+    /* 与随后游戏自己同一地址集合的读：hv=[x0+8]（指向 {u32 count@+0, el* arr@+8}），
+       再 count=[hv]、arr=[hv+8]、el=arr[i]、this=[el+0x10]（0x57f95c-0x57f97c 反汇编）。
+       hv/arr/el 护栏只挡明显非指针值（<2^32），此后每一读都是游戏下一步也要读的地址。 */
+    uint64_t hv = *(const volatile uint64_t *)(const void *)(uintptr_t)(x0 + 8);
+    if (hv < 0x100000000ULL) return;
+    const volatile uint64_t *hdr = (const volatile uint64_t *)(const void *)(uintptr_t)hv;
+    uint64_t h0 = hdr[0], arr = hdr[1];
+    if (arr < 0x100000000ULL) return;
+    unsigned n = (unsigned)(uint32_t)h0;
+    /* round15 变迁史：count/arr 变化才记（同一值洪流不刷环）。hits 用本门单调计数对账时刻。
+       round16b：每条带 CNTVCT tick；max_cnt/缩点标量在此一并维护（lastc>2→n≤2 首变迁）。 */
+    if (n != g_e1h.lastc || arr != g_e1h.lastarr) {
+        uint64_t tk = smo_obs_tick();
+        if (n > g_e1h.max_cnt) { g_e1h.max_cnt = n; g_e1h.max_tick = tk; }
+        if (!g_e1h.shrunk && g_e1h.lastc > 2 && n <= 2) {
+            g_e1h.shrunk = 1; g_e1h.shrink_from = g_e1h.lastc; g_e1h.shrink_to = n; g_e1h.shrink_tick = tk;
+        }
+        g_e1h.lastc = n; g_e1h.lastarr = arr;
+        unsigned k = atomic_load_explicit(&g_e1h.head, memory_order_relaxed);
+        g_e1h.e[k % SMO_OBS_E1_HIST].hits = atomic_load_explicit(&g_obs_hits[SMO_OBS_E1], memory_order_relaxed);
+        g_e1h.e[k % SMO_OBS_E1_HIST].cnt = n;
+        g_e1h.e[k % SMO_OBS_E1_HIST].arr = arr;
+        g_e1h.e[k % SMO_OBS_E1_HIST].tick = tk;
+        atomic_store_explicit(&g_e1h.head, k + 1, memory_order_relaxed);
+    }
+    unsigned m = n > SMO_OBS_E1_CAP ? SMO_OBS_E1_CAP : n;
+    unsigned s = (unsigned)atomic_load_explicit(&g_e1.seq, memory_order_relaxed);
+    atomic_store_explicit(&g_e1.seq, s + 1, memory_order_relaxed);           /* 奇=写入中 */
+    g_e1.obj = x0; g_e1.arr = arr; g_e1.truncated = n > m ? n : 0; g_e1.n = m;
+    const volatile uint64_t *a = (const volatile uint64_t *)(const void *)(uintptr_t)arr;
+    for (unsigned i = 0; i < m; i++) {
+        uint64_t el = a[i], th = 0;
+        if (el > 0x10000) th = *(const volatile uint64_t *)(const void *)(uintptr_t)(el + 0x10);
+        g_e1.el[i] = el; g_e1.thiz[i] = th;
+    }
+    atomic_store_explicit(&g_e1.seq, s + 2, memory_order_relaxed);           /* 偶=稳定 */
+    atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_e1.hits, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
+    atomic_store_explicit(&g_e1.last_x0, x0, memory_order_relaxed);
+}
+/* stub 骨架字（gen_obs_stub.py capstone 校验过）：w0-w18 固定，w9 随 gate 变，
+   w19-w22=被换出的 4 条原指令，w23=b 入口+0x10（安装时算），w24/w25=.quad 观察器。
+   x18（合成 TCB，OHOS 载体方案）与 entry.S 的 runtime_gate 同样进栈保存。
+   round16b：新增 w6 str x8（caller-saved，DRAIN-LOOP 的重放字 ldr x21,[x8,#8]/sub x0,x8
+   要读它，必须横跨观察器保存）+ w7 mov x2,x8 / w8 mov x3,x1（观察器第 3/4 参=门点原
+   x8/x1——movz gate 会覆盖 x1，先抄走）+ w13 复原 x8。x19-x28 是 callee-saved，C 观察
+   器按 ABI 自存自复（DRAIN_ENTER 门重放 stp x20,x19 即依赖此，既有先例）。 */
+static const uint32_t smo_obs_prologue[19] = {
+    0xa9ba7bfd,   /* stp x29, x30, [sp, #-0x60]!      */
+    0xa90107e0,   /* stp x0, x1, [sp, #0x10]          */
+    0xa9020fe2,   /* stp x2, x3, [sp, #0x20]          */
+    0xa90317e4,   /* stp x4, x5, [sp, #0x30]          */
+    0xa9041fe6,   /* stp x6, x7, [sp, #0x40]          */
+    0xf9002bf2,   /* str x18, [sp, #0x50]             */
+    0xf9002fe8,   /* str x8, [sp, #0x58]（round16b）  */
+    0xaa0803e2,   /* mov x2, x8（round16b：参3）      */
+    0xaa0103e3,   /* mov x3, x1（round16b：参4）      */
+    0,            /* movz x1, #<gate>（按门填）       */
+    0x580001d0,   /* ldr x16, #0x38 → w24 字面量      */
+    0xd63f0200,   /* blr x16                          */
+    0xf9402bf2,   /* ldr x18, [sp, #0x50]             */
+    0xf9402fe8,   /* ldr x8, [sp, #0x58]（round16b）  */
+    0xa9441fe6,   /* ldp x6, x7, [sp, #0x40]          */
+    0xa94317e4,   /* ldp x4, x5, [sp, #0x30]          */
+    0xa9420fe2,   /* ldp x2, x3, [sp, #0x20]          */
+    0xa94107e0,   /* ldp x0, x1, [sp, #0x10]          */
+    0xa8c67bfd,   /* ldp x29, x30, [sp], #0x60        */
+};
+/* round13b 修复（崩溃定因）：四字门的重放字里出现 PC 相对指令时不能原样重放——adrp/分支族
+   会按 stub 的 PC 计算目标。13b 首跑即崩：round12e cell2 门（0x9b9bc4）重放首字 adrp x8，
+   以 stub 页（main+0x14d4xxx）算出 main 尾后地址，w16 读回垃圾 0x540007017100051f，w17
+   ldr x8,[x8] SEGV@0x000007017100051f（fault log：pc=stub+0x44 即 w17、x8=该垃圾、
+   lr=main+0x9b9bac 恰为门上游，三者互证）。修法：adrp 在安装期把 imm 重算到『stub 内该字
+   位置』仍指向原绝对页（同语义）；其余 PC 相对字形（b/bl/b.cond/cbz/cbnz/tbz/tbnz/adr/
+   ldr-literal）本机制不支持，直接拒装该门（fail-soft）。E1/E2/kick1 等四字门经此扫描
+   全为寄存器+立即数字形，不受影响。w[4] 为 4 个重放字（就地改写）；off=门在 main 的偏移，
+   stub_off=stub 在 main 的偏移。返回 0=拒装（why 填原因）。
+   round16b：bl 加入重定位（DRAIN-LOOP 窗口第 4 字就是 bl 0x8ad1f0）——同绝对目标重算
+   imm26（±128MiB；stub 页与 main 代码最远 ~21MiB，足够）。返回地址语义原样：重放 bl 的
+   lr=下一重放字，bl 在末字时 lr=&w[23]=b 回入口+0x10，kick（含 0x8ad228 br x1 尾调链）
+   最终都回到原 bl 的后继 0x8abfa4。b/b.cond/cbz 族仍拒装（cbz imm19 仅 ±1MiB，stub 页
+   距代码 ~16MiB，物理不可重定位）。 */
+static int smo_obs_replay_fix(uint32_t w[4], uint32_t off, uint64_t stub_off, char *why, size_t whyn) {
+    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
+        uint32_t v = w[i];
+        uint64_t wo = stub_off + (19 + i) * 4;              /* 该字在 stub 内的 main 相对地址 */
+        if ((v & 0x9f000000u) == 0x90000000u) {             /* adrp：重算 imm（同绝对页） */
+            int64_t imm = (int64_t)((v >> 29) & 3) | ((int64_t)((v >> 5) & 0x7ffff) << 2);
+            if (imm & (1 << 20)) imm -= 1 << 21;
+            uint64_t page_abs = (off & ~0xfffu) + ((uint64_t)imm << 12);   /* 原绝对页 */
+            int64_t want = (int64_t)(page_abs - (wo & ~0xfffu)) >> 12;
+            if (want < -(1 << 20) || want >= (1 << 20)) {
+                snprintf(why, whyn, "adrp relocation out of range (%+lld pages)", (long long)want);
+                return 0;
+            }
+            w[i] = (v & 0x9f00001fu) | ((uint32_t)(want & 3) << 29) | ((uint32_t)((want >> 2) & 0x7ffff) << 5);
+        } else if ((v >> 26) == 0x25u) {                    /* bl（round16b）：重算 imm26（同绝对目标） */
+            uint32_t imm26 = v & 0x3ffffffu;
+            int64_t disp = (imm26 & (1u << 25)) ? (int64_t)imm26 - (1 << 26) : (int64_t)imm26;
+            int64_t tgt = (int64_t)off + 4 * i + (disp << 2);   /* 原 target（main 相对） */
+            int64_t want = tgt - (int64_t)wo;
+            if (want < -(1 << 27) || want >= (1 << 27) || want & 3) {
+                snprintf(why, whyn, "bl relocation out of range (%+#llx)", (long long)want);
+                return 0;
+            }
+            w[i] = (v & 0xfc000000u) | (((uint64_t)want >> 2) & 0x3ffffff);
+        } else if ((v >> 26) == 0x05 || (v >> 26) == 0x25   /* b / bl */
+                   || (v & 0xff000000u) == 0x54000000u      /* b.cond */
+                   || (v & 0x7f000000u) >= 0x34000000u && (v & 0x7f000000u) <= 0x37000000u   /* cbz/cbnz/tbz/tbnz（含 sf 位屏蔽） */
+                   || (v & 0x9f000000u) == 0x10000000u      /* adr */
+                   || (v & 0xbf000000u) == 0x18000000u) {   /* ldr-literal */
+            snprintf(why, whyn, "PC-relative word %#x at slot %d unsupported", v, i);
+            return 0;
+        }
+    }
+    return 1;
+}
+static void smo_obs_gates_install(const Module *m) {
+    if (strcmp(m->name, "main")) return;
+    g_obs_main_base = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)m->base;   /* round12e：cell 链快照用（任何 veneer 生效前已就位） */
+    {   /* round16b：tick→ns 换算基准点（安装时刻；dump 侧取第二点内插） */
+        extern uint64_t runtime_now_ns(void);
+        g_obs_tick0 = smo_obs_tick(); g_obs_ns0 = runtime_now_ns(); g_obs_tick0_set = 1;
+    }
+    uint64_t tail = (m->file_size + 0x3fff) & ~0x3fffULL;   /* main 的尾部保留页（loader.c:184 特批的 +0x4000） */
+    if (m->size < tail + 0x4000) { fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] obs gates: no tail page (size=%#llx)\n", (unsigned long long)m->size); return; }
+    uint8_t *page = m->base + tail;
+    uint8_t *p = page + 0x100;
+    unsigned installed = 0;
+    for (size_t s = 0; s < sizeof smo_obs_site / sizeof *smo_obs_site; s++) {
+        const smo_obs_site_t *site = &smo_obs_site[s];
+        uint32_t have[4]; memcpy(have, m->base + site->off, sizeof have);
+        /* 单字门（tail=1）只占 1 条 b：校验该字与其后继原字（word[1]），不碰再后指令。 */
+        int ok = site->tail ? (have[0] == site->word[0] && have[1] == site->word[1])
+                            : (have[0] == site->word[0] && have[1] == site->word[1] &&
+                               have[2] == site->word[2] && have[3] == site->word[3]);
+        if (!ok) {
+            fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] obs gate %#x: found %08x %08x %08x %08x, expected the four shipped words — NOT installed\n",
+                    site->off, have[0], have[1], have[2], have[3]);
+            continue;
+        }
+        uint8_t *stub = p; p += 26 * 4;
+        uint32_t w[26];
+        memcpy(w, smo_obs_prologue, sizeof smo_obs_prologue);
+        w[9] = 0xd2800000u | ((uint32_t)site->gate << 5) | 1;                /* movz x1, #gate */
+        uint64_t fn = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)&smo_obs_observer;
+        memcpy(w + 24, &fn, 8);                                             /* .quad 观察器地址 */
+        if (site->tail) {
+            /* 单字尾跳门：出厂 word[0] 必是无条件 b；解出其目标，stub 末尾原义重定向。
+               veneer 只换这 1 个字（b→stub），相邻 thunk 的指令一个不动。 */
+            uint32_t imm26 = site->word[0] & 0x3ffffffu;
+            int64_t disp = (imm26 & (1u << 25)) ? (int64_t)imm26 - (1 << 26) : (int64_t)imm26;
+            int64_t tofs = (int64_t)site->off + (disp << 2);                /* 原目标（main 相对） */
+            if (disp == 0 || tofs <= 0 || (uint64_t)tofs >= m->file_size) {
+                fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] obs gate %#x: tail word not an in-module b (target main+%#llx) — NOT installed\n",
+                        site->off, (unsigned long long)tofs);
+                continue;
+            }
+            uint64_t dst = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(m->base + tofs);           /* 原目标绝对地址 */
+            int64_t branch = (int64_t)dst - (int64_t)(stub + 19 * 4);        /* stub 尾 b 原目标 */
+            if (branch < -(1 << 27) || branch >= (1 << 27) || branch & 3) {
+                fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] obs gate %#x: stub tail branch out of range (%+#llx) — NOT installed\n", site->off, (long long)branch);
+                continue;
+            }
+            w[19] = 0x14000000u | (((uint64_t)branch >> 2) & 0x3ffffff);
+            for (int i = 20; i <= 23; i++) w[i] = 0xd503201fu;              /* nop 填充（永不执行） */
+            memcpy(stub, w, sizeof w);
+            int64_t vb = (int64_t)(uintptr_t)stub - (int64_t)(uintptr_t)(m->base + site->off);
+            if (vb < -(1 << 27) || vb >= (1 << 27) || vb & 3) {
+                fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] obs gate %#x: veneer branch out of range (%+#llx) — NOT installed\n", site->off, (long long)vb);
+                continue;
+            }
+            uint32_t veneer1 = 0x14000000u | (((uint64_t)vb >> 2) & 0x3ffffff);   /* 单字 b→stub */
+            memcpy(m->base + site->off, &veneer1, 4);
+            installed++;
+            fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] obs gate main+%#x (id %u, tail b->main+%#llx) installed, stub at main+%#llx\n",
+                    site->off, site->gate, (unsigned long long)(dst - (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)m->base),
+                    (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)(stub - m->base));
+            continue;
+        }
+        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) w[19 + i] = site->word[i];               /* 原样重放被换出的 4 条指令（PC 相对字见下方修正/拒装） */
+        {   /* round13b：重放字 PC 相对指令修正/拒装（cell2 门 adrp 13b 首跑即崩，见 smo_obs_replay_fix 注） */
+            char why[96];
+            if (!smo_obs_replay_fix(&w[19], site->off, (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(stub - m->base), why, sizeof why)) {
+                fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] obs gate %#x: replay %s — NOT installed\n", site->off, why);
+                continue;
+            }
+        }
+        int64_t branch = (int64_t)(m->base + site->off + 0x10) - (int64_t)(stub + 23 * 4);
+        if (branch < -(1 << 27) || branch >= (1 << 27) || branch & 3) {
+            fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] obs gate %#x: branch out of range (%+#llx) — NOT installed\n", site->off, (long long)branch);
+            continue;
+        }
+        w[23] = 0x14000000u | (((uint64_t)branch >> 2) & 0x3ffffff);         /* b 入口+0x10 */
+        memcpy(stub, w, sizeof w);
+        uint32_t veneer[2] = {0x58000051, 0xd61f0220};                      /* ldr x17,#8; br x17（patch_scene_pick 同款） */
+        uint64_t target = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)stub;
+        memcpy(m->base + site->off, veneer, 8);
+        memcpy(m->base + site->off + 8, &target, 8);
+        installed++;
+        fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] obs gate main+%#x (id %u) installed, stub at main+%#llx\n",
+                site->off, site->gate, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)(stub - m->base));
+    }
+    if (!installed) return;
+    size_t used = (size_t)(p - page);
+    __builtin___clear_cache((char *)page, (char *)p);                       /* 新 stub 指令进 icache（文本侧 veneer 由 seal() 的 sys_icache_invalidate 覆盖） */
+    if (mprotect(page, 0x4000, PROT_READ | PROT_EXEC) != 0) {               /* 与 seal() 给补丁区的权限一致；check_permissions 经 smo_obs_rx_range 认得此页 */
+        fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] obs gates: tail page mprotect RX FAILED (gates dead: veneer will fault)\n");
+        /* 装不上就把 veneer 撤掉：留一个跳进不可执行页的 veneer 必崩，回退到原指令才安全 */
+        for (size_t s = 0; s < sizeof smo_obs_site / sizeof *smo_obs_site; s++) {
+            const smo_obs_site_t *site = &smo_obs_site[s];
+            uint32_t have[4]; memcpy(have, m->base + site->off, sizeof have);
+            if (site->tail) {
+                /* 单字门：have[0]=我们写的 veneer b、have[1] 仍为出厂后继字 → 只回写 word[0]。 */
+                if (have[0] == site->word[0] || have[1] != site->word[1]) continue;
+                uint32_t imm26 = have[0] & 0x3ffffffu;
+                int64_t disp = (imm26 & (1u << 25)) ? (int64_t)imm26 - (1 << 26) : (int64_t)imm26;
+                uint64_t t = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(m->base + site->off) + ((uint64_t)disp << 2);
+                if (t < (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)page || t >= (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)(page + 0x4000)) continue;   /* 非 ours */
+                memcpy(m->base + site->off, &site->word[0], 4);
+                continue;
+            }
+            int ok = 1; for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) ok &= have[i] == site->word[i];
+            if (ok) continue;   /* 没装上这门（字不符或分支越界），veneer 也没写 */
+            uint32_t veneer[2] = {0x58000051, 0xd61f0220};
+            uint32_t now[2]; memcpy(now, m->base + site->off, sizeof now);
+            if (now[0] == veneer[0] && now[1] == veneer[1])
+                memcpy(m->base + site->off, site->word, sizeof site->word);   /* 原样写回 4 条出厂指令 */
+        }
+        return;
+    }
+    g_obs_rx_lo = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)page; g_obs_rx_hi = g_obs_rx_lo + 0x4000;
+    fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] obs gates: %u gate(s), tail page main+%#llx RX, %zu bytes used\n",
+            installed, (unsigned long long)tail, used);
+}
+/* ---- dump 侧访问器（threads.c 的 dump_threads 调；偶 seq 才返回数据） ---- */
+uint64_t smo_obs_hits(int gate) { return gate >= 0 && gate < SMO_OBS_N ? atomic_load_explicit(&g_obs_hits[gate], memory_order_relaxed) : 0; }
+uint64_t smo_obs_last_x0(int gate) { return gate >= 0 && gate < SMO_OBS_N ? atomic_load_explicit(&g_obs_x0[gate], memory_order_relaxed) : 0; }
+/* round12e：cell 链快照读取（dump 侧符号化用）。out={cell1,table1,fn1,cell2,table2,fn2}；
+   cell1=0x1363dc8（已知=Map，作链条读法验证位），cell2=0x136deb8（待定名）。 */
+int smo_obs_cell2_snapshot(uint64_t out[6]) {
+    if (!atomic_load_explicit(&g_cell2_set, memory_order_relaxed)) return 0;
+    for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) out[i] = atomic_load_explicit(&g_cell2[i], memory_order_relaxed);
+    return 1;
+}
+/* loader.c 的 check_permissions 用：尾部页里被本模块 mprotect 成 RX 的绝对地址区间
+   （未安装时 hi=0）。check_permissions 对 ≥page_up(file_size) 的页缺省期待 RW，
+   仅此区间期待 RX——权限巡检的「不期即报」语义保持不变。 */
+void smo_obs_rx_range(uint64_t *lo, uint64_t *hi) { *lo = g_obs_rx_lo; *hi = g_obs_rx_hi; }
+unsigned smo_obs_e1_snapshot(uint64_t *el, uint64_t *thiz, unsigned cap, uint64_t *obj, uint64_t *arr, unsigned *truncated) {
+    unsigned s0 = (unsigned)atomic_load_explicit(&g_e1.seq, memory_order_relaxed);
+    if (s0 & 1) return 0;                                                   /* 正在写：放弃本次（下一分钟 dump 再看） */
+    unsigned n = g_e1.n < cap ? g_e1.n : cap;
+    for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; i++) { el[i] = g_e1.el[i]; thiz[i] = g_e1.thiz[i]; }
+    if (obj) *obj = g_e1.obj; if (arr) *arr = g_e1.arr; if (truncated) *truncated = g_e1.truncated;
+    unsigned s1 = (unsigned)atomic_load_explicit(&g_e1.seq, memory_order_relaxed);
+    return s0 == s1 ? n : 0;                                                /* 读期间又写入：作废 */
+}
+/* round15：E1 count 变迁史（dump 侧）。返回本次可读条数（≤cap），按时间序填
+   hits[]/cnt[]/arrp[]；*total_out=全部变迁数（>32 时环已覆盖最旧）。
+   round16b：条目加 tsns[]——tick 经两点内插换算成自安装起的 ns（安装对 g_obs_{tick0,ns0}
+   + 本调用现取一对；CNTFRQ 不读，两点自校准；timer 停走/未设基准时原样给 tick 且 *raw=1）。 */
+unsigned smo_obs_e1_hist(uint64_t *hits, uint32_t *cnt, uint64_t *arrp, uint64_t *tsns, unsigned cap, unsigned *total_out, int *raw) {
+    extern uint64_t runtime_now_ns(void);
+    unsigned total = atomic_load_explicit(&g_e1h.head, memory_order_relaxed);
+    if (total_out) *total_out = total;
+    unsigned n = total > SMO_OBS_E1_HIST ? SMO_OBS_E1_HIST : total;
+    if (n > cap) n = cap;
+    unsigned start = total > SMO_OBS_E1_HIST ? total - SMO_OBS_E1_HIST : 0;
+    uint64_t t1 = 0, ns1 = 0; double npt = 0; int is_raw = 0;
+    if (g_obs_tick0_set) {
+        t1 = smo_obs_tick(); ns1 = runtime_now_ns();
+        if (t1 > g_obs_tick0) npt = (double)(ns1 - g_obs_ns0) / (double)(t1 - g_obs_tick0);
+        else is_raw = 1;
+    } else is_raw = 1;
+    if (raw) *raw = is_raw;
+    for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; i++) {
+        unsigned k = (start + i) % SMO_OBS_E1_HIST;
+        hits[i] = g_e1h.e[k].hits; cnt[i] = g_e1h.e[k].cnt; arrp[i] = g_e1h.e[k].arr;
+        tsns[i] = is_raw ? g_e1h.e[k].tick
+                         : g_obs_ns0 + (uint64_t)((double)(g_e1h.e[k].tick - g_obs_tick0) * npt + 0.5);
+    }
+    return n;
+}
+/* round16b：E1 汇总标量（dump 侧）——max_cnt=自启动最大 count（「曾否>2」环覆盖也不丢），
+   shrink=lastc>2→n≤2 的首个变迁（缩点时刻+前后值；shrunk=0=从未发生>2→≤2 缩点）。
+   tsns 同上换算（raw=1 时给裸 tick）。 */
+void smo_obs_e1_summary(uint32_t *max_cnt, uint64_t *max_ns, uint32_t *shrink_from, uint32_t *shrink_to,
+                        uint64_t *shrink_ns, uint32_t *shrunk, int *raw) {
+    extern uint64_t runtime_now_ns(void);
+    *max_cnt = g_e1h.max_cnt;
+    *shrink_from = g_e1h.shrink_from; *shrink_to = g_e1h.shrink_to; *shrunk = g_e1h.shrunk;
+    int is_raw = 0; double npt = 0; uint64_t t1 = 0;
+    if (g_obs_tick0_set) {
+        uint64_t ns1; t1 = smo_obs_tick(); ns1 = runtime_now_ns();
+        if (t1 > g_obs_tick0) npt = (double)(ns1 - g_obs_ns0) / (double)(t1 - g_obs_tick0);
+        else is_raw = 1;
+    } else is_raw = 1;
+    if (raw) *raw = is_raw;
+    *max_ns = is_raw || !g_e1h.max_tick ? g_e1h.max_tick
+              : g_obs_ns0 + (uint64_t)((double)(g_e1h.max_tick - g_obs_tick0) * npt + 0.5);
+    *shrink_ns = is_raw || !g_e1h.shrink_tick ? g_e1h.shrink_tick
+                 : g_obs_ns0 + (uint64_t)((double)(g_e1h.shrink_tick - g_obs_tick0) * npt + 0.5);
+}
+/* round16b：DRAIN-LOOP 首见快照（dump 侧）。未命中返回 0。ts_ns 同上换算。 */
+int smo_obs_dl_snapshot(uint64_t *node, uint64_t *this_, uint64_t *w1, uint64_t *f9, uint64_t *o20, uint64_t *ts_ns, int *raw) {
+    if (!atomic_load_explicit(&g_dl.set, memory_order_relaxed)) return 0;
+    *node = g_dl.node; *this_ = g_dl.this; *w1 = g_dl.w1; *f9 = g_dl.f9; *o20 = g_dl.o20;
+    extern uint64_t runtime_now_ns(void);
+    int is_raw = 0; double npt = 0;
+    if (g_obs_tick0_set) {
+        uint64_t t1 = smo_obs_tick(), ns1 = runtime_now_ns();
+        if (t1 > g_obs_tick0) npt = (double)(ns1 - g_obs_ns0) / (double)(t1 - g_obs_tick0);
+        else is_raw = 1;
+    } else is_raw = 1;
+    if (raw) *raw = is_raw;
+    *ts_ns = is_raw ? g_dl.tick : g_obs_ns0 + (uint64_t)((double)(g_dl.tick - g_obs_tick0) * npt + 0.5);
+    return 1;
+}
+/* round17 ①（dump 侧）：KICK1 三条件首/末见 + 三分支交叉分布。
+   first_out={this,w1,f9,o20,tsns}（set=0 时全 0 返回 0）；last_out={w1,f9,o20}；
+   dist_out={n_lt1, n_ge1_f9eq2, n_ge1_f9ne2, n_o20z}。 */
+int smo_obs_k1_stats(uint64_t first_out[5], uint64_t last_out[3], uint64_t dist_out[4]) {
+    extern uint64_t runtime_now_ns(void);
+    if (!atomic_load_explicit(&g_k1.set, memory_order_relaxed)) return 0;

+int smo_obs_bc_snapshot(uint64_t *x0, uint64_t *ts_ns) {

+/* round17 ③（dump 侧）：KICKVT 目标分布。vals/cnts 各 8 槽（val==0 的槽未用）、
+   over=溢出、n_zero=空槽、first={vt,tgt}、last_tgt。返回 set（0=门未命中）。 */
+int smo_obs_kickvt_dist(uint64_t vals[8], uint64_t cnts[8], uint64_t *over, uint64_t *n_zero,

+    *last_tgt = atomic_load_explicit(&g_vt.last_tgt, memory_order_relaxed);
+    return 1;
+}
```

```patch
+/* ---------- round3-B 自旋期取证：SIGUSR2 pc 链采样器 ----------
+   背景：mprotect 型 READ watch 在本 OHOS 镜像不可用——DFX sigchain 截获 SIGSEGV，首个页面 fault 即判死
+   整进程（emu_round3.log + cppcrash-9776，fault=0x6e459931b0 屏障同页越窗写）。改用信号采样：
+   对「已启动、未退出、不在任何宿主等待（wkind==0）」的客体线程 pthread_kill(SIGUSR2)，handler 只把
+   ucontext 的 pc/lr/fp 抓进全局槽（async-signal-safe：仅读寄存器+两次 store），采样线程在普通上下文
+   里走帧链——每帧先 mincore 验映射再读（OHOS 上 mach_vm_read_overwrite=裸 memcpy，ohos_compat.h:235，
+   野指针即 SEGV 即死，不能裸走）。样本即「自旋线程此刻的 pc 链」，洪流期/静默期都持续输出，
+   与 hang watchdog 的 60s 全景 dump 互补。 */
+static struct { _Atomic unsigned seq; volatile uint64_t pc, lr, fp, x19, x20, x21; } g_spin_cap;
+static void spin_cap_handler(int num, siginfo_t *si, void *ctx) {
+    (void)num; (void)si;
+    unsigned s = atomic_load_explicit(&g_spin_cap.seq, memory_order_relaxed);
+    if (!(s & 1)) return;   // 无采样请求
+    ucontext_t *u = ctx;
+#ifdef __MUSL__
+    g_spin_cap.pc = u->uc_mcontext.pc; g_spin_cap.lr = u->uc_mcontext.regs[30]; g_spin_cap.fp = u->uc_mcontext.regs[29];
+    g_spin_cap.x19 = u->uc_mcontext.regs[19]; g_spin_cap.x20 = u->uc_mcontext.regs[20]; g_spin_cap.x21 = u->uc_mcontext.regs[21];
+#else
+    g_spin_cap.pc = u->uc_mcontext->__ss.__pc; g_spin_cap.lr = u->uc_mcontext->__ss.__lr; g_spin_cap.fp = u->uc_mcontext->__ss.__fp;
+    g_spin_cap.x19 = u->uc_mcontext->__ss.__x[19]; g_spin_cap.x20 = u->uc_mcontext->__ss.__x[20]; g_spin_cap.x21 = u->uc_mcontext->__ss.__x[21];
+#endif
+    atomic_store_explicit(&g_spin_cap.seq, s + 1, memory_order_release);   // 奇→偶：完成
+}
+#ifdef __MUSL__
+#include <sys/syscall.h>
+#include <sys/uio.h>
+/* round3 第二次崩溃（SEGV_ACCERR@0x6e03a47ffc，采样器启动 100ms）：mincore 对 PROT_NONE 映射页返回 0
+   （只查映射不查权限），帧读 memcpy 裸读保护页即死。改 process_vm_readv 自进程读——对 PROT_NONE/未映射
+   一律返回 EFAULT 而不 fault，读自身 pid 永远合法（不受 yama 限制）。 */
+static int spin_read16(uint64_t a, uint64_t out[2]) {
+    if (a < 0x100000000ULL || a >= 0x800000000000ULL || (a & 15)) return 0;
+    struct iovec l = { out, 16 }, r = { (void *)(uintptr_t)a, 16 };
+    return syscall(__NR_process_vm_readv, getpid(), &l, 1ul, &r, 1ul, 0ul) == 16;
+}
+#else
+static int spin_read16(uint64_t a, uint64_t out[2]) {
+    if (a < 0x100000000ULL || a >= 0x800000000000ULL || (a & 15)) return 0;
+    unsigned char v; uintptr_t p = (uintptr_t)(a & ~0xfffull);
+    if (mincore((void *)p, 4096, &v) != 0) return 0;
+    if (((a + 15) & ~0xfffull) != p && mincore((void *)(uintptr_t)((a + 15) & ~0xfffull), 4096, &v) != 0) return 0;
+    memcpy(out, (const void *)(uintptr_t)a, 16); return 1;
+}
+#endif
+static void *spin_sampler(void *arg) {
+    (void)arg;
+    unsigned ticks = 0, tot_ok = 0, tot_fail = 0;
+    for (;;) {
+        usleep(200000);   // 5Hz：静默期每线程每秒 5 条 pc 链，洪流期也照采
+        ticks++;
+        /* round3 第五跑定谳：采样器 0.4s 后必停 = 持 G 做 I/O 的连锁死等——fprintf 要 stderr 的 FILE 锁、
+           OH_LOG_Print 要 hilog 客户端锁（与 stderr→hilog 转发线程共享），hilogd 对进程限流后转发线程
+           阻塞在 OH_LOG_Print 持客户端锁，采样器持 G 等它 → 全模拟器 SVC(G) 冻结（洪流不需 G 照跑，
+           dump 也不出——round3 第三跑 7 分钟活体+零 dump/零样本同证）。
+           第六跑定谳：等 handler 期间也不能持 G——目标线程被 G 闸住难以及时应答，kill 全超时
+           （124 心跳 cand=3..5 却只 4 样本）。改：持 G 只做「选人+pin」，放锁后 kill/等/取帧（20ms
+           预算），再回锁 unpin。pin 住 thr_free 不回收（泄露=取证可接受）。 */
+        char buf[4096]; int bn = 0;
+        int cand_n = 0, ok = 0, fail = 0;
+        pthread_mutex_lock(&G);
+        thr_t *cand[32]; int nc = 0;

+void spin_sampler_start(void) {
```

```patch
+    return 1;
```

```patch
+    void *h = dlopen("libqos.so", RTLD_NOW | RTLD_LOCAL);
+    if (h) {
+        qos_set = (qos_set_fn)dlsym(h, "OH_QoS_SetThreadQoS");
+        qos_reset = (qos_reset_fn)dlsym(h, "OH_QoS_ResetThreadQoS");
+        qos_get = (qos_get_fn)dlsym(h, "OH_QoS_GetThreadQoS");
+    }
+    if (!h || !qos_set || !qos_reset || !qos_get)
+        fprintf(stderr, "[qos] libqos.so unavailable (dlopen/dlsym failed): thread QoS degrades to no-op\n");
+}
+int pthread_set_qos_class_self_np(int cls, int rel) {
+    static pthread_once_t once = PTHREAD_ONCE_INIT;
+    pthread_once(&once, qos_lib_init);
+    (void)rel;
+    if (!qos_set) return -1;
+    switch (cls) {
+    case QOS_CLASS_USER_INTERACTIVE: return qos_set(QOS_USER_INTERACTIVE);
+    case QOS_CLASS_USER_INITIATED:   return qos_set(QOS_USER_INITIATED);
+    case QOS_CLASS_DEFAULT:          return qos_set(QOS_DEFAULT);
+    case QOS_CLASS_UTILITY:          return qos_set(QOS_UTILITY);
+    case QOS_CLASS_UNSPECIFIED:      return qos_reset();
+    default: return -1;
+    }
+}
+int pthread_get_qos_class_np(void *tid, qos_class_t *cls, int *rel) {
+    static pthread_once_t once = PTHREAD_ONCE_INIT;
+    pthread_once(&once, qos_lib_init);
+    if (rel) *rel = 0;
+    if (cls) *cls = QOS_CLASS_UNSPECIFIED;
+    if (!qos_get || (tid && tid != (void *)pthread_self())) return 0;
+    QoS_Level l;
+    if (qos_get(&l) != 0) return 0;   /* 未设级（GetThreadQoS 返 -1）：按 UNSPECIFIED 报 */
+    if (cls) switch (l) {
+    case QOS_USER_INTERACTIVE: *cls = QOS_CLASS_USER_INTERACTIVE; break;
+    case QOS_USER_INITIATED:   *cls = QOS_CLASS_USER_INITIATED; break;
+    case QOS_DEFAULT:          *cls = QOS_CLASS_DEFAULT; break;
+    case QOS_UTILITY:          *cls = QOS_CLASS_UTILITY; break;
+    case QOS_BACKGROUND:       *cls = QOS_CLASS_UTILITY; break;   /* Apple 侧无 BACKGROUND 宏，就近代入 */
+    default:                   *cls = QOS_CLASS_USER_INTERACTIVE; break;   /* QOS_DEADLINE_REQUEST：高于 interactive 的请求级 */
+    }
+    return 0;
+}
```

```patch
+static void sigaddr_note(int is35, uint64_t addr, uint32_t caller) {   // 调用方持 G
+    if (is35) atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_n35, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
+    else      atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_n34, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
+    for (unsigned i = 0; i < g_sigaddr_n; i++) if (g_sigaddr[i].addr == addr) {
+        if (is35) { g_sigaddr[i].n35++; if (!g_sigaddr[i].caller) g_sigaddr[i].caller = caller; }   // 首位 0x35 调用者=释放者画像
+        else g_sigaddr[i].n34++;
+        return;
+    }
+    if (g_sigaddr_n < SIGADDR_TOP) {   // 首见地址入表（16 槽后计入溢出桶：客体地址型对象本就寥寥）
+        g_sigaddr[g_sigaddr_n].addr = addr; g_sigaddr[g_sigaddr_n].n34 = !is35; g_sigaddr[g_sigaddr_n].n35 = !!is35;
+        g_sigaddr[g_sigaddr_n].caller = is35 ? caller : 0; g_sigaddr_n++;
+        return;
+    }
+    if (is35) g_ovf35++; else g_ovf34++;

+    }
```

```patch
+   同法）、HAL 写回调消费，饥饿喂零（声卡侧静音，不动 mixer 侧计量）；模拟器/无 HAL 丢弃（null sink）。
+   设备时钟独立于游戏线程、宁可静音不欠采样，与 Ryujinx SoundIoDevice / SDL audio device 同构。 */

+/* ticker → 二级环 → HAL 写回调（null sink 即直接丢弃，mixer 侧计量不受影响） */
+static void au_sink_push(struct OpaqueAudioComponentInstance *u, const float *lr, UInt32 frames) {
+    if (!u->renderer) return;   /* 模拟器/无 HAL：null sink */
+    uint64_t wr = atomic_load_explicit(&u->swr, memory_order_relaxed);
+    uint64_t rd = atomic_load_explicit(&u->srd, memory_order_acquire);
+    if (wr + frames - rd > AU_SINK_FRAMES) { rd = wr + frames - AU_SINK_FRAMES; atomic_store_explicit(&u->srd, rd, memory_order_release); }   /* 溢出丢最旧 */
+    for (UInt32 i = 0; i < frames; i++) { uint64_t k = (wr + i) % AU_SINK_FRAMES; u->sink_ring[2 * k] = lr[2 * i]; u->sink_ring[2 * k + 1] = lr[2 * i + 1]; }
+    atomic_store_explicit(&u->swr, wr + frames, memory_order_release);
+}
+static OH_AudioData_Callback_Result au_hal_write(OH_AudioRenderer *renderer, void *userData,
+                                                 void *audioData, int32_t audioDataSize) {
+    (void)renderer;
+    struct OpaqueAudioComponentInstance *u = userData;
+    float *out = audioData;
+    if (!u || audioDataSize <= 0 || audioDataSize % (int32_t)(2 * sizeof(float))) {
+        memset(audioData, 0, audioDataSize > 0 ? (size_t)audioDataSize : 0);
+        return AUDIO_DATA_CALLBACK_RESULT_INVALID;
+    }
+    int32_t frames = audioDataSize / (int32_t)(2 * sizeof(float));
+    uint64_t rd = atomic_load_explicit(&u->srd, memory_order_acquire);
+    uint64_t wr = atomic_load_explicit(&u->swr, memory_order_acquire);
+    uint64_t have = wr - rd, n = (uint64_t)frames < have ? (uint64_t)frames : have;
+    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < n; i++) { uint64_t k = (rd + i) % AU_SINK_FRAMES; out[2 * i] = u->sink_ring[2 * k]; out[2 * i + 1] = u->sink_ring[2 * k + 1]; }
+    if (n < (uint64_t)frames) memset(out + 2 * n, 0, (size_t)(frames - n) * 2 * sizeof(float));   /* 二级环饥饿：声卡侧静音 */
+    atomic_store_explicit(&u->srd, rd + n, memory_order_release);
+    return AUDIO_DATA_CALLBACK_RESULT_VALID;
 }
+static void au_sink_open(struct OpaqueAudioComponentInstance *u) {
+    OH_AudioStreamBuilder *b = NULL;
+    if (OH_AudioStreamBuilder_Create(&b, AUDIOSTREAM_TYPE_RENDERER) != AUDIOSTREAM_SUCCESS || !b) goto none;
+    int32_t rate = u->fmt.mSampleRate > 0 ? (int32_t)(u->fmt.mSampleRate + 0.5) : 48000;
+    OH_AudioStreamBuilder_SetSamplingRate(b, rate);
+    OH_AudioStreamBuilder_SetChannelCount(b, 2);   /* 主环/pull 固定立体声（audio_mixer.c:148） */
+    OH_AudioStreamBuilder_SetSampleFormat(b, AUDIOSTREAM_SAMPLE_F32LE);
+    OH_AudioStreamBuilder_SetLatencyMode(b, AUDIOSTREAM_LATENCY_MODE_FAST);
+    OH_AudioStreamBuilder_SetRendererInfo(b, AUDIOSTREAM_USAGE_GAME);
+    if (OH_AudioStreamBuilder_SetRendererWriteDataCallback(b, au_hal_write, u) != AUDIOSTREAM_SUCCESS) { OH_AudioStreamBuilder_Destroy(b); goto none; }
+    OH_AudioRenderer *r = NULL;
+    if (OH_AudioStreamBuilder_GenerateRenderer(b, &r) == AUDIOSTREAM_SUCCESS && r &&
+        OH_AudioRenderer_Start(r) == AUDIOSTREAM_SUCCESS) {
+        u->builder = b; u->renderer = r;
+        fprintf(stderr, "[ohos-audio] OHAudio renderer %d Hz stereo (game/fast)\n", rate);
+        return;
+    }
+    if (r) OH_AudioRenderer_Release(r);
+    OH_AudioStreamBuilder_Destroy(b);
+none:
+    fprintf(stderr, "[ohos-audio] no OHAudio output: null sink (emulator / no audio HAL)\n");
+}
+static void *au_ticker(void *arg) {
+    struct OpaqueAudioComponentInstance *u = arg;
+    pthread_setname_np(pthread_self(), "au-ticker");
+    double rate = u->fmt.mSampleRate > 0 ? u->fmt.mSampleRate : 48000.0;
+    uint64_t irate = rate >= 1 ? (uint64_t)(rate + 0.5) : 48000;
+    float *scratch = malloc(AU_PERIOD_FRAMES * 2 * sizeof(float));
+    if (!scratch) return NULL;
+    AudioBufferList io = {1, {{2, AU_PERIOD_FRAMES * 2 * (UInt32)sizeof(float), scratch}, {0, 0, NULL}}};
+    AURenderCb fn = (AURenderCb)u->cb.input;
+    struct timespec base; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &base);
+    uint64_t consumed = 0;   /* 分子=已回调帧数×1e9，有理数时钟：48000 帧精确 1 秒，无长期漂移 */
+    while (atomic_load_explicit(&u->running, memory_order_acquire)) {
+        consumed += (uint64_t)AU_PERIOD_FRAMES * 1000000000ull;
+        uint64_t at = consumed / irate;
+        struct timespec dl = { base.tv_sec + (time_t)(at / 1000000000ull), base.tv_nsec + (long)(at % 1000000000ull) };
+        if (dl.tv_nsec >= 1000000000L) { dl.tv_nsec -= 1000000000L; dl.tv_sec++; }
+        struct timespec now; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &now);
+        if (now.tv_sec > dl.tv_sec || (now.tv_sec == dl.tv_sec && now.tv_nsec > dl.tv_nsec)) {
+            base = now; consumed = 0; continue;   /* 宿主卡顿落后：跳过本周期并重同步，不追赶洪泛 */
+        }
+        while (clock_nanosleep(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, TIMER_ABSTIME, &dl, NULL) == EINTR) {}
+        if (!atomic_load_explicit(&u->running, memory_order_acquire)) break;
+        AudioTimeStamp ts = {0}; AudioUnitRenderActionFlags flags = 0;
+        if (fn) fn(u->cb.proc, &flags, &ts, 0, AU_PERIOD_FRAMES, &io);   /* =audio_mixer.c:109 的 pull */
+        au_sink_push(u, scratch, AU_PERIOD_FRAMES);
+    }
+    free(scratch);
+    return NULL;
+}
+OSStatus AudioOutputUnitStart(AudioComponentInstance inst) {
+    struct OpaqueAudioComponentInstance *u = (struct OpaqueAudioComponentInstance *)inst;
+    if (!u) return kAudioUnitErr_InvalidProperty;
+    if (u->started) return noErr;
+    au_sink_open(u);
+    atomic_store_explicit(&u->running, 1, memory_order_release);
+    if (pthread_create(&u->thread, NULL, au_ticker, u)) {
+        atomic_store_explicit(&u->running, 0, memory_order_release);
+        return kAudioUnitErr_InvalidProperty;
+    }
+    u->started = 1;
+    return noErr;
+}
+OSStatus AudioOutputUnitStop(AudioComponentInstance inst) {
+    struct OpaqueAudioComponentInstance *u = (struct OpaqueAudioComponentInstance *)inst;
+    if (!u) return kAudioUnitErr_InvalidProperty;
+    if (u->started) {
+        atomic_store_explicit(&u->running, 0, memory_order_release);
+        pthread_join(u->thread, NULL);   /* 周期 ~10.67ms，join 快 */
+        u->started = 0;
+    }
+    if (u->renderer) { OH_AudioRenderer_Stop(u->renderer); OH_AudioRenderer_Release(u->renderer); u->renderer = NULL; }
+    if (u->builder) { OH_AudioStreamBuilder_Destroy(u->builder); u->builder = NULL; }
+    return 0;
+}
```
