+ *   this+0x58 发 SignalProcessWideKey。门在入口把 {el,this} 快照进静态缓冲——多读的
+ *   地址恰是被换出的第 4 条指令（ldr x8,[x0,#8]）之后游戏自己立刻要读的同一批地址
+ *   （count/arr/el/[el+0x10]，见 0x57f95c-0x57f97c 反汇编），不新增任何解引用面。
+ *   dump 时打表与 threads.c 的 pkey/pkey2 发 key 族对照，验证两族是否同一数组算出。
+ * E2a main+0x8aef34、E2b main+0x8af418（两个 stage 排空方法，收 MQ@+0x168 完成包）：
+ *   命中计数 + 末次 x0。pkey2 发 key 族 wait(0x1C)=0 + 本门 0 命中 ⇒ 该池消费者线程
+ *   从未运行；与 threads.c 的 CreateThread/StartThread 账本（svc 0x08/0x09）对照区分
+ *   「从未创建」与「创建失败」。
+ * 机制：入口 16 字节换成 veneer（ldr x17,#8; br x17; .quad stub），stub 落在 main 镜像
+ *   尾部保留页 [page_up(file_size), +0x4000)（本移植 frame-step 空置；loader.c "Main's
+ *   extra private page … stays plain zero-filled memory" 即此页）。stub 保存
+ *   x0-x7/x29/x30 → 调 C 观察器（无锁、无 I/O、无 libc 调用）→ 恢复 → 原样重放被换的
+ *   4 条出厂指令 → b 回入口+0x10。编码字全部经 scripts_round9b/gen_obs_stub.py 的
+ *   capstone 往返校验；安装时先逐一比对 4 条出厂指令字，不符即不装该门（fail-soft）。 */
+enum { SMO_OBS_E1 = 0, SMO_OBS_DRAIN_A = 1, SMO_OBS_DRAIN_B = 2, SMO_OBS_N = 3 };
+typedef struct { uint32_t off, gate; uint32_t word[4]; } smo_obs_site_t;
+static const smo_obs_site_t smo_obs_site[] = {
+    {0x57f950, SMO_OBS_E1,      {0xa9be4ff4, 0xa9017bfd, 0x910043fd, 0xf9400408}},   /* stp x20,x19; stp x29,x30; add x29,sp,#0x10; ldr x8,[x0,#8] */
+    {0x8aef34, SMO_OBS_DRAIN_A, {0xa9057bfd, 0x910143fd, 0x394c0008, 0xaa0103f5}},   /* stp x29,x30,[sp,#0x50]; add x29,sp,#0x50; ldrb w8,[x0,#0x300]; mov x21,x1 */
+    {0x8af418, SMO_OBS_DRAIN_B, {0xa9027bfd, 0x910083fd, 0x2a0103f3, 0xaa0003f4}},   /* stp x29,x30,[sp,#0x20]; add x29,sp,#0x20; mov w19,w1; mov x20,x0 */
+};
+#define SMO_OBS_E1_CAP 128
+static struct {
+    _Atomic uint64_t seq;                       /* 偶=稳定，奇=写入中（g_spin_cap 范式） */
+    _Atomic uint64_t hits; _Atomic uint64_t last_x0;
+    unsigned n, truncated; uint64_t obj, arr;
+    uint64_t el[SMO_OBS_E1_CAP], thiz[SMO_OBS_E1_CAP];
+} g_e1;
+static _Atomic uint64_t g_obs_hits[SMO_OBS_N], g_obs_x0[SMO_OBS_N];
+static uint64_t g_obs_rx_lo, g_obs_rx_hi;   /* 尾部 stub 页的 RX 区间（安装成功后填；check_permissions 查询） */
+/* 客体小栈上被 veneer 调进来的观察器：只做原子计数与定长拷贝，无锁/无 I/O/无 libc。
+   gate=x1（stub 里 movz 立即数），x0=入口原参。 */
+static void smo_obs_observer(uint64_t x0, uint64_t gate) {
+    if (gate >= SMO_OBS_N) return;
+    atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_obs_hits[gate], 1, memory_order_relaxed);
+    atomic_store_explicit(&g_obs_x0[gate], x0, memory_order_relaxed);
+    if (gate != SMO_OBS_E1) return;
+    /* 与随后游戏自己同一地址集合的读：hv=[x0+8]（指向 {u32 count@+0, el* arr@+8}），
+       再 count=[hv]、arr=[hv+8]、el=arr[i]、this=[el+0x10]（0x57f95c-0x57f97c 反汇编）。
+       hv/arr/el 护栏只挡明显非指针值（<2^32），此后每一读都是游戏下一步也要读的地址。 */
+    uint64_t hv = *(const volatile uint64_t *)(const void *)(uintptr_t)(x0 + 8);
+    if (hv < 0x100000000ULL) return;
+    const volatile uint64_t *hdr = (const volatile uint64_t *)(const void *)(uintptr_t)hv;
+    uint64_t h0 = hdr[0], arr = hdr[1];
+    if (arr < 0x100000000ULL) return;
+    unsigned n = (unsigned)(uint32_t)h0;
+    unsigned m = n > SMO_OBS_E1_CAP ? SMO_OBS_E1_CAP : n;
+    unsigned s = (unsigned)atomic_load_explicit(&g_e1.seq, memory_order_relaxed);
+    atomic_store_explicit(&g_e1.seq, s + 1, memory_order_relaxed);           /* 奇=写入中 */
+    g_e1.obj = x0; g_e1.arr = arr; g_e1.truncated = n > m ? n : 0; g_e1.n = m;
+    const volatile uint64_t *a = (const volatile uint64_t *)(const void *)(uintptr_t)arr;
+    for (unsigned i = 0; i < m; i++) {
+        uint64_t el = a[i], th = 0;
+        if (el > 0x10000) th = *(const volatile uint64_t *)(const void *)(uintptr_t)(el + 0x10);
+        g_e1.el[i] = el; g_e1.thiz[i] = th;
+    }
+    atomic_store_explicit(&g_e1.seq, s + 2, memory_order_relaxed);           /* 偶=稳定 */
+    atomic_fetch_add_explicit(&g_e1.hits, 1, memory_order_relaxed);
+    atomic_store_explicit(&g_e1.last_x0, x0, memory_order_relaxed);
+}
+/* stub 骨架字（gen_obs_stub.py capstone 校验过）：w0-w14 固定，w6 随 gate 变，
+   w15-w18=被换出的 4 条原指令，w19=b 入口+0x10（安装时算），w20/w21=.quad 观察器。
+   x18（合成 TCB，OHOS 载体方案）与 entry.S 的 runtime_gate 同样进栈保存。 */
+static const uint32_t smo_obs_prologue[15] = {
+    0xa9ba7bfd,   /* stp x29, x30, [sp, #-0x60]!      */
+    0xa90107e0,   /* stp x0, x1, [sp, #0x10]          */
+    0xa9020fe2,   /* stp x2, x3, [sp, #0x20]          */
+    0xa90317e4,   /* stp x4, x5, [sp, #0x30]          */
+    0xa9041fe6,   /* stp x6, x7, [sp, #0x40]          */
+    0xf9002bf2,   /* str x18, [sp, #0x50]             */
+    0,            /* movz x1, #<gate>（按门填）       */
+    0x580001b0,   /* ldr x16, #0x50 → w20 字面量      */
+    0xd63f0200,   /* blr x16                          */
+    0xf9402bf2,   /* ldr x18, [sp, #0x50]             */
+    0xa9441fe6,   /* ldp x6, x7, [sp, #0x40]          */
+    0xa94317e4,   /* ldp x4, x5, [sp, #0x30]          */
+    0xa9420fe2,   /* ldp x2, x3, [sp, #0x20]          */
+    0xa94107e0,   /* ldp x0, x1, [sp, #0x10]          */
+    0xa8c67bfd,   /* ldp x29, x30, [sp], #0x60        */
+};
+static void smo_obs_gates_install(const Module *m) {
+    if (strcmp(m->name, "main")) return;
+    uint64_t tail = (m->file_size + 0x3fff) & ~0x3fffULL;   /* main 的尾部保留页（loader.c:184 特批的 +0x4000） */
+    if (m->size < tail + 0x4000) { fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] obs gates: no tail page (size=%#llx)\n", (unsigned long long)m->size); return; }
+    uint8_t *page = m->base + tail;
+    uint8_t *p = page + 0x100;
+    unsigned installed = 0;
+    for (size_t s = 0; s < sizeof smo_obs_site / sizeof *smo_obs_site; s++) {
+        const smo_obs_site_t *site = &smo_obs_site[s];
+        uint32_t have[4]; memcpy(have, m->base + site->off, sizeof have);
+        int ok = 1; for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) ok &= have[i] == site->word[i];
+        if (!ok) {
+            fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] obs gate %#x: found %08x %08x %08x %08x, expected the four shipped words — NOT installed\n",
+                    site->off, have[0], have[1], have[2], have[3]);
+            continue;
+        }
+        uint8_t *stub = p; p += 22 * 4;
+        uint32_t w[22];
+        memcpy(w, smo_obs_prologue, sizeof smo_obs_prologue);
+        w[6] = 0xd2800000u | ((uint32_t)site->gate << 5) | 1;                /* movz x1, #gate */
+        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) w[15 + i] = site->word[i];               /* 原样重放被换出的 4 条指令 */
+        int64_t branch = (int64_t)(m->base + site->off + 0x10) - (int64_t)(stub + 19 * 4);
+        if (branch < -(1 << 27) || branch >= (1 << 27) || branch & 3) {
+            fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] obs gate %#x: branch out of range (%+#llx) — NOT installed\n", site->off, (long long)branch);
+            continue;
+        }
+        w[19] = 0x14000000u | (((uint64_t)branch >> 2) & 0x3ffffff);         /* b 入口+0x10 */
+        uint64_t fn = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)&smo_obs_observer;
+        memcpy(w + 20, &fn, 8);                                             /* .quad 观察器地址 */
+        memcpy(stub, w, sizeof w);
+        uint32_t veneer[2] = {0x58000051, 0xd61f0220};                      /* ldr x17,#8; br x17（patch_scene_pick 同款） */
+        uint64_t target = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)stub;
+        memcpy(m->base + site->off, veneer, 8);
+        memcpy(m->base + site->off + 8, &target, 8);
+        installed++;
+        fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] obs gate main+%#x (id %u) installed, stub at main+%#llx\n",
+                site->off, site->gate, (unsigned long long)(uintptr_t)(stub - m->base));
+    }
+    if (!installed) return;
+    size_t used = (size_t)(p - page);
+    __builtin___clear_cache((char *)page, (char *)p);                       /* 新 stub 指令进 icache（文本侧 veneer 由 seal() 的 sys_icache_invalidate 覆盖） */
+    if (mprotect(page, 0x4000, PROT_READ | PROT_EXEC) != 0) {               /* 与 seal() 给补丁区的权限一致；check_permissions 经 smo_obs_rx_range 认得此页 */
+        fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] obs gates: tail page mprotect RX FAILED (gates dead: veneer will fault)\n");
+        /* 装不上就把 veneer 撤掉：留一个跳进不可执行页的 veneer 必崩，回退到原指令才安全 */
+        for (size_t s = 0; s < sizeof smo_obs_site / sizeof *smo_obs_site; s++) {
+            const smo_obs_site_t *site = &smo_obs_site[s];
+            uint32_t have[4]; memcpy(have, m->base + site->off, sizeof have);
+            int ok = 1; for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) ok &= have[i] == site->word[i];
+            if (ok) continue;   /* 没装上这门（字不符或分支越界），veneer 也没写 */
+            uint32_t veneer[2] = {0x58000051, 0xd61f0220};
+            uint32_t now[2]; memcpy(now, m->base + site->off, sizeof now);
+            if (now[0] == veneer[0] && now[1] == veneer[1])
+                memcpy(m->base + site->off, site->word, sizeof site->word);   /* 原样写回 4 条出厂指令 */
+        }
+        return;
+    }
+    g_obs_rx_lo = (uint64_t)(uintptr_t)page; g_obs_rx_hi = g_obs_rx_lo + 0x4000;
+    fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] obs gates: %u gate(s), tail page main+%#llx RX, %zu bytes used\n",
+            installed, (unsigned long long)tail, used);
+}
+/* ---- dump 侧访问器（threads.c 的 dump_threads 调；偶 seq 才返回数据） ---- */
+uint64_t smo_obs_hits(int gate) { return gate >= 0 && gate < SMO_OBS_N ? atomic_load_explicit(&g_obs_hits[gate], memory_order_relaxed) : 0; }
+uint64_t smo_obs_last_x0(int gate) { return gate >= 0 && gate < SMO_OBS_N ? atomic_load_explicit(&g_obs_x0[gate], memory_order_relaxed) : 0; }
+/* loader.c 的 check_permissions 用：尾部页里被本模块 mprotect 成 RX 的绝对地址区间
+   （未安装时 hi=0）。check_permissions 对 ≥page_up(file_size) 的页缺省期待 RW，
+   仅此区间期待 RX——权限巡检的「不期即报」语义保持不变。 */
+void smo_obs_rx_range(uint64_t *lo, uint64_t *hi) { *lo = g_obs_rx_lo; *hi = g_obs_rx_hi; }
+unsigned smo_obs_e1_snapshot(uint64_t *el, uint64_t *thiz, unsigned cap, uint64_t *obj, uint64_t *arr, unsigned *truncated) {
+    unsigned s0 = (unsigned)atomic_load_explicit(&g_e1.seq, memory_order_relaxed);
+    if (s0 & 1) return 0;                                                   /* 正在写：放弃本次（下一分钟 dump 再看） */
+    unsigned n = g_e1.n < cap ? g_e1.n : cap;
+    for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; i++) { el[i] = g_e1.el[i]; thiz[i] = g_e1.thiz[i]; }
+    if (obj) *obj = g_e1.obj; if (arr) *arr = g_e1.arr; if (truncated) *truncated = g_e1.truncated;
+    unsigned s1 = (unsigned)atomic_load_explicit(&g_e1.seq, memory_order_relaxed);
+    return s0 == s1 ? n : 0;                                                /* 读期间又写入：作废 */
+}
+
 void runtime_game_patches(Module *main_module) {
     patch_render_res(main_module);
     if (g_render_w) { patch_scene_pick(main_module); patch_rt_pool(main_module); }
     fprintf(stderr, "[odyssey] game patches: %s\n", g_render_w ? "docked render size, key 3 scene size" : "none");
     odyssey_aspect_install(main_module);
+    smo_obs_gates_install(main_module);
 }
 void runtime_frame_step_pin(double ms) { (void)ms; }
 void runtime_frame_step_update(uint64_t now_ns) { (void)now_ns; odyssey_aspect_present(); scene_log(); }   /* key 4, every present */

```

# SMO 移植 round 流水 notes（构建留存等）

## 构建留存（HAP 备份）

| round | HAP 备份路径 | 状态 |
|---|---|---|
| round16 | ——（无备份） | **找不到**：构建输出 `mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap` 每轮被覆盖，round16 产物已被 round17/round18 构建逐轮覆盖。round19 查证时全项目 `*.hap` 仅剩 build outputs 内 signed/unsigned 两份（mtime 2026-11-01 11:32，与 round18 patch 生成时间一致 ⇒ round18 产物），logs/emu_round16*.log 仅运行日志不含 HAP。时间戳不可辨回 round16。 |
| round19 | `hap-archive/entry-default-signed.round19.hap`（构建 2026-11-01 12:03，63,478,052 B） | 本轮构建后归档（round19 = thunk 双门×2 + BC310 first16 x0 环观测，见 `patches/round19-thunk2gates-bc310x0ring-*.patch`；装机后 hilog 实证 16 门全装：`0x587da4 tail b->main+0x587ea0` / `0x587eac tail ret replayed` / `0x587db4 tail b->main+0x587eb0` / `0x587ec4 tail ret replayed`，tail page 1920 bytes used）。 |

> 惯例：round19 起新建 `hap-archive/`，每轮构建后把 signed HAP 归档一份（`entry-default-signed.round<N>.hap`），避免再出现无法回溯的覆盖。

`scripts/README.md`:

```md
# scripts/ —— switch2hos 取证与构建脚本

只保留**可复用的三件套 + 两个分析器 + 两个构建脚本**。历史上每轮一份的
`mNNx_boot_run.sh`（共 180+ 个，2.7 MB，全部绑定本机路径）属于排查过程存档，
不放进本仓库（留在本地工作区与 notes 仓库）。

## 目录

| 路径 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `lib/common.sh` | 公共函数：hdc 封装、日志、截图、开关读写、日志回拉与按标签切分 |
| `boot/latest.sh` | 最新一版 boot 取证流程（装 HAP → 写开关 → 起应用 → 定时连拍 → 定点 PAM 回读 → 收数） |
| `boot/template.sh` | 新轮次脚本模板（含三条踩坑约定，见文件头注释） |
| `analysis/red_pct.py` | 逐张截图算 red%（`r>=90 & r>=1.8g & r>=1.8b`）与均值，找首次 red%>12 的时刻 |
| `analysis/three_way_compare.py` | 三方像素对照：A=gameRT PAM、B=present 源图 PAM、C=屏幕截图（red_strict/red_dom/mean/distinct + 相关系数） |
| `build_tools/build_hap_mac.sh` | macOS 上构建 HAP |
| `build_tools/deploy_emu.sh` | 部署到模拟器 |

## 用法

```bash
# 跑一次取证 boot（模拟器）
HAP=/tmp/xxx_build/entry.hap bash scripts/boot/latest.sh b1 127.0.0.1:5555 275 5

# 分析截图
python3 scripts/analysis/red_pct.py logs/b1-1109-1830

# 三方对照
python3 scripts/analysis/three_way_compare.py A.png B.png C_screen.png
```

## 三条硬约定（都是踩过的坑）

1. **开关文件必须由 app 的 `p_file_seed` 建出**：`hdc shell`（uid=2000）只能改写已存在的
   `smo_*`，`echo` 新建会 `Permission denied`，`hdc file send` 同样被拒。
2. **开关读取要周期性重读**（例如每 16/64 次检查一次）：只在 init 缓存一次的话，
   启动后再写入的门槛值永远不会生效。
3. **探针可用性核查**：新增探针前先确认它在 release 里被编译进去——
   看触发点是否在 `#if` 内、该宏是否有 `-D`，或 `strings libgame.so | grep -c <探针串>`。
   （`SMO_TRI_DRAW` 就属于缺省 0 的宏，包在它里面的 one-shot 回读在 release 里是死代码。）

```

`scripts/analysis/pam2png.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""PAM(P7) -> PNG，纯标准库（zlib/struct），不依赖 PIL/ffmpeg。
用法: python3 -I m4n_pam2png.py <in.pam> [<in.pam> ...]
每个文件输出一行统计：WxH depth 每通道 mean/min/max、是否整幅同色(uniform)，
并在同目录写出同名 .png（RGB，filter=0，zlib 压缩）。
"""
import sys, os, zlib, struct

def read_pam(path):
    with open(path, 'rb') as f:
        meta = {}
        magic = f.readline()
        if not magic.startswith(b'P7'):
            raise ValueError('not P7 PAM')
        while True:
            ln = f.readline()
            if not ln:
                raise ValueError('no ENDHDR')
            parts = ln.split()
            if parts and parts[0] == b'ENDHDR':
                break          # readline 已吃掉行尾 '\n'，数据从下一字节开始
            if len(parts) == 2 and parts[0] in (b'WIDTH', b'HEIGHT', b'DEPTH', b'MAXVAL'):
                meta[parts[0].decode()] = int(parts[1])
        w, h, d = meta['WIDTH'], meta['HEIGHT'], meta['DEPTH']
        if meta.get('MAXVAL', 255) != 255:
            raise ValueError('MAXVAL != 255: %s' % meta.get('MAXVAL'))
        data = f.read(w * h * d)
    if len(data) != w * h * d:
        raise ValueError('short data: %d != %d' % (len(data), w * h * d))
    return w, h, d, data

def to_rgb_rows(w, h, d, data):
    if d == 3:
        rgb = data
    elif d == 4:
        mv = memoryview(data)
        rgb = bytearray(w * h * 3)
        rgb[0::3] = mv[0::4]
        rgb[1::3] = mv[1::4]
        rgb[2::3] = mv[2::4]
        rgb = bytes(rgb)
    elif d == 1:
        rgb = bytes(b for b in data for _ in range(3))
    else:
        raise ValueError('depth %d unsupported' % d)
    stride = w * 3
    rows = [b'\x00' + rgb[y * stride:(y + 1) * stride] for y in range(h)]
    return b''.join(rows)

def write_png(path, w, h, raw):
    def chunk(t, d):
        return struct.pack('>I', len(d)) + t + d + struct.pack('>I', zlib.crc32(t + d) & 0xffffffff)
    ihdr = struct.pack('>IIBBBBB', w, h, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0)  # 8bit RGB
    with open(path, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n')
        f.write(chunk(b'IHDR', ihdr))
        f.write(chunk(b'IDAT', zlib.compress(raw, 6)))
        f.write(chunk(b'IEND', b''))

def stats(w, h, d, data):
    parts = []
    uniform = True
    for i, name in enumerate('RGBA'[:d]):
        ch = data[i::d]
        mn, mx = min(ch), max(ch)
        if mn != mx:
            uniform = False
        parts.append('%s mean=%.1f min=%d max=%d' % (name, sum(ch) / len(ch), mn, mx))
    return ' '.join(parts), uniform

def main(paths):
    rc = 0
    for p in paths:
        try:
            w, h, d, data = read_pam(p)
            st, uni = stats(w, h, d, data)
            out = os.path.splitext(p)[0] + '.png'
            write_png(out, w, h, to_rgb_rows(w, h, d, data))
            print('PAM2PNG %s %dx%d depth=%d uniform=%s %s -> %s (%d bytes)' % (
                os.path.basename(p), w, h, d, 'YES' if uni else 'no', st, os.path.basename(out),
                os.path.getsize(out)))
        except Exception as e:
            print('PAM2PNG FAIL %s: %s' % (os.path.basename(p), e))
            rc = 1
    return rc

if __name__ == '__main__':
    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
        print('usage: m4n_pam2png.py <in.pam> [...]')
        sys.exit(2)
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

```

```py
import glob, re, sys
from PIL import Image
OUT = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "logs/m39k_b1"
rows=[]
paths = glob.glob(OUT.rstrip('/')+"/screen_*.png")
def key(p):
    m = re.search(r'screen_(\d+)', p)
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else 9999
for p in sorted(paths, key=key):
    m = re.search(r'screen_(\d+)', p)
    t = int(m.group(1)) if m else -1
    im = Image.open(p).convert("RGB"); w,h = im.size
    px = list(im.resize((w//4, h//4)).getdata()); n = len(px)
    red = sum(1 for r,g,b in px if r >= 90 and r >= g*1.8 and r >= b*1.8)
    mean = tuple(round(sum(c[i] for c in px)/n,1) for i in range(3))
    rows.append((t, round(100.0*red/n,2), mean))
for r in rows: print("t=%4d red%%=%5.2f mean=%s" % r)
first = next((r for r in rows if r[1] > 12), None)
print("FIRST_RED>12:", first)
print("N_IMAGES=%d RED_MAX=%s" % (len(rows), max((r[1] for r in rows), default=None)))

`scripts/analysis/three_way_compare.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""M39N: 3-way compare (A=gameRT PAM png, B=present-source PAM png, C=screen shot).
Single consistent pixel definitions for all three:
  red_strict% : r>150 & g<90 & b<90            (M39M's PAM definition)
  red_dom%    : r>90 & r>g*2+20 & r>b*2+20     (M39J's screen definition)
  mean        : channel means (0-255)
  distinct    : number of unique RGB triples
Usage: python3 m39n_cmp.py <A.png> <B.png> <C.png> [...more C]
"""
import sys, numpy as np
from PIL import Image

def stats(path):
    im = Image.open(path).convert('RGB')
    a = np.asarray(im).reshape(-1, 3).astype(np.int32)
    r, g, b = a[:, 0], a[:, 1], a[:, 2]
    red_s = (r > 150) & (g < 90) & (b < 90)
    red_d = (r > 90) & (r > g * 2 + 20) & (r > b * 2 + 20)
    uniq = np.unique(a[:, 0].astype(np.uint32) * 65536 + a[:, 1] * 256 + a[:, 2]).size
    return dict(w=im.size[0], h=im.size[1], reds=100.0 * red_s.mean(), redd=100.0 * red_d.mean(),
                mean=(r.mean(), g.mean(), b.mean()), distinct=uniq, n=a.shape[0])

def main():
    A, B = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
    Cs = sys.argv[3:]
    rows = [('A gameRT ', A), ('B presentsrc', B)] + [('C screen:%s' % p.split('/')[-1], p) for p in Cs]
    print("%-26s %5s %5s %7s %7s %-18s %8s" % ("image", "w", "h", "redS%", "redD%", "mean r/g/b", "distinct"))
    for tag, p in rows:
        s = stats(p)
        print("%-26s %5d %5d %7.2f %7.2f %6.1f/%-5.1f/%-5.1f %8d" % (
            tag, s['w'], s['h'], s['reds'], s['redd'], s['mean'][0], s['mean'][1], s['mean'][2], s['distinct']))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

```

#!/bin/bash
# 最新一版 boot 取证脚本（M39N 形态）：装 HAP → 写开关 → 起应用 → 5 s 连拍 → 定点 PAM 回读 → 收数
#
# usage: bash scripts/boot/latest.sh <tag> [target] [dur] [plan_step]
#   tag        本次输出目录后缀（logs/<tag>-<时间>）
#   target     hdc 目标，缺省 127.0.0.1:5555（模拟器）
#   dur        运行秒数，缺省 275
#   plan_step  截图间隔秒，缺省 5
#
# 环境变量：
#   HAP         要安装的 hap（缺省 /tmp/m39n_build/entry.hap）
#   SKIP_INSTALL=1  跳过安装（复用设备上已装的包）
#   W2_PRES     定点回读门槛（draws，缺省 135000；0=关）
#   M39A_OFF    1 = 关闭直送、退回 m7h 快照
set -u
TAG="${1:?usage: bash scripts/boot/latest.sh <tag> [target] [dur] [step]}"
export TGT="${2:-127.0.0.1:5555}"
DUR="${3:-275}"
STEP="${4:-5}"
ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)"
export OUT="$ROOT/logs/${TAG}-$(date '+%m%d-%H%M')"
HAP="${HAP:-/tmp/m39n_build/entry.hap}"
SKIP_INSTALL="${SKIP_INSTALL:-0}"
W2_PRES="${W2_PRES:-135000}"
M39A_OFF="${M39A_OFF:-0}"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
. "$ROOT/scripts/lib/common.sh"

log "=== boot tag=$TAG target=$TGT dur=${DUR}s step=${STEP}s hap=$HAP m39a_off=$M39A_OFF w2_pres=$W2_PRES"
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target offline"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$HAP" ] || { log "X hap missing: $HAP"; exit 1; }
log "hap=$(stat -f%z "$HAP") md5=$(md5 -q "$HAP")"

P0=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
[ -n "$P0" ] && { log "X foreign pid=$P0 alive -> ABORT"; exit 3; }
stopapp || { log "X pid refused to die"; exit 1; }

if [ "$SKIP_INSTALL" = "1" ]; then
  log "install SKIPPED"
else
  T0=$(date +%s); OUTI=$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1); INST_S=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))
  log "install(${INST_S}s): $(echo "$OUTI" | tr '\n' ' ' | tail -c 160)"
  grep -qi "successfully" <<<"$OUTI" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }
fi

# app 的 p_file_seed 才会建开关文件（hdc 无权新建）——没有就先起一次让它 seed
if ! sw_exists smo_m38h_present; then
  log "seed launch（开关文件不存在）"
  h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
  sw_wait smo_m38h_present 60 || { log "X seed 后开关仍不存在"; stopapp; exit 1; }
  stopapp || { log "X seed pid refused to die"; exit 1; }
  log "seeded ok"
fi

# 常用开关：默认全 0；摁住三条基础探针
for s in smo_m38c smo_m38c_pad smo_m38d smo_m38g smo_m25a_c1 smo_m25a_c2 smo_m26a smo_m30a_q smo_m30a_b \
         smo_m33a smo_m34a smo_m35a smo_m36a smo_m36a_fix smo_m37a smo_gpu_write smo_m17a smo_gdump_sec \
         smo_m39e_pair smo_m6q_sched smo_m20a smo_tri_rb; do
  sw_write "$s" 0
done
sw_write smo_m27a 1; sw_write smo_m38e 1; sw_write smo_m38f 1
sw_write smo_m38h_present -1
sw_write smo_m39a_off "$M39A_OFF"
log "switches: m27a=$(sw_read smo_m27a) m38e=$(sw_read smo_m38e) m38f=$(sw_read smo_m38f) m39a_off=$(sw_read smo_m39a_off)"

h shell "printf '' > $FILES/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 3600000" >/dev/null 2>&1

STARTOUT=$(h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" 2>&1 | tr -d '\r')
case "$STARTOUT" in *10106102*) log "X aa start blocked 10106102（锁屏？）"; exit 2;; esac
START=$(date +%s)
for i in $(seq 1 15); do P=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]'); [ -n "$P" ] && break; sleep 1; done
log "boot pid=${P:-<none>} at t=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

# 定点回读门槛：app seed 出 smo_w2_pres 后再写（值 = draws 门槛）
if [ "$W2_PRES" != "0" ]; then
  if sw_wait smo_w2_pres 30; then
    sw_write smo_w2_pres "$W2_PRES"
    log "smo_w2_pres=$(sw_read smo_w2_pres) at t=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"
  else
    log "WARN smo_w2_pres 30s 未出现 -> 本轮没有 present 源图 dump"
  fi
fi

PLAN="$(seq -s ' ' 30 "$STEP" "$DUR")"
LASTSHOT=0; PROGLAST=0
while :; do
  EL=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))
  h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
  PP=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
  if [ -z "$PP" ]; then DEADN=$(( ${DEADN:-0} + 1 )); else DEADN=0; fi
  if [ "${DEADN:-0}" -ge 2 ]; then log "t=${EL}s pid dead -> app died"; shot "$EL"; break; fi
  for T in $PLAN; do if [ "$LASTSHOT" -lt "$T" ] && [ "$EL" -ge "$T" ]; then LASTSHOT=$T; shot "$EL"; fi; done
  [ "$EL" -ge "$DUR" ] && break
  if [ $(( EL - PROGLAST )) -ge 30 ]; then PROGLAST=$EL; log "running t=${EL}s pid=${PP:-?} shots=$NSHOT"; fi
  sleep 2
done
shot "fin"
log "alive at end: $(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]' || echo '<dead>') dur=$(( $(date +%s) - START ))s"

pull_log || exit 8
grep_tag '[d] rb W2pres' w2pres
grep_tag '[p] sig' p_sig
grep_tag '[p] sel ' p_sel
grep_tag '[m39a] gate' m39a_gate
grep_tag '[m39e] pres ' m39e_pres
grep_tag '[beat]' beat
log "shots=$NSHOT distinct=$(md5 -q "$OUT"/screen_*.png 2>/dev/null | sort -u | wc -l | tr -d ' ') out=$OUT"
stopapp
log "=== done tag=$TAG"

`scripts/build_tools/deploy_emu.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# deploy_emu.sh —— SMO 模拟器装机 + RomFS 资产灌入（幂等，可重复执行）
#
# 用法: ./deploy_emu.sh   [环境变量可覆盖: HDC_TARGET / HTTP_PORT / POLL_TIMEOUT]
#
# 流程:
#   1) 安装 entry-default-signed.hap（已装则 -r 原地升级保数据；签名不一致才卸载重装）
#   2) 确保应用至少启动过一次（生成 el2 沙箱 haps/entry/files）
#   3) 校验沙箱 smo/romfs 下 7 件资产字节数；全齐则直接跳过（0 字节重传）
#   4) 缺件 → Mac lo0 挂 192.168.0.110 别名（应用 pcAddr 默认直连地址）+ 起http.server(0.0.0.0)
#      → aa start --ps autopath 1 触发应用自带的 pullFromPc 把整包拉进 files/smo/romfs
#      → 应用直连 192.168.0.110:8000 → 模拟器NAT → 宿主lo0别名（本机发起连接，不受App防火墙限制）
#      （备胎: hdc rport 反向隧道——实测 ~543MB 后中继停摆，仅小文件可用，不作主通道）
#   5) 轮询逐件校验字节数，全部一致才算成功
#
# 为什么不用 hdc file send 直灌沙箱（2026-10-31 实测）:
#   模拟器镜像无 root：hdcd 以 uid2000(shell) 运行，setenforce 被拒（SELinux Enforcing），
#   shell/hdcd 对 /data/app/el2/*/haps/** 的写入被 DAC+SELinux 双拦
#   （cache/ 即便 0777 也 mkdir Permission denied）。
#   唯一合法写入者是应用本身，故走应用源码自带的 HTTP 拉取通道
#   （entry/src/main/ets/pages/Index.ets pullFromPc，注释即设计此用法）。
#
# 幂等性说明（受应用代码约束）:
#   pullFromPc 的下载循环包在单个 try 里，任一分卷非 200 会中止整个循环
#   （Index.ets:118-135），无法"只补缺件"。因此本脚本的幂等策略是:
#   - 7 件全齐且字节数一致 → 完全跳过传输（重复执行 0 开销）
#   - 缺任何一件 → 整包重拉（应用会覆盖重写全部 7 件，结果仍正确）

set -uo pipefail

HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
TARGET="${HDC_TARGET:-127.0.0.1:5555}"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
HAP="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
PARTS_DIR="/Users/zpp/ZCodeProject/switch2mac/switch2hos/game-work/romfs_parts"
HTTP_PORT="${HTTP_PORT:-8000}"
POLL_TIMEOUT="${POLL_TIMEOUT:-3600}"   # 秒；5.68GB 全量重拉的宽裕上限
POLL_INTERVAL="${POLL_INTERVAL:-5}"

# 应用 context.filesDir = /data/storage/el2/base/haps/entry/files（进程内挂载视图）
# 其磁盘真实路径（宿主/shell 视角）如下：
SANDBOX_FILES="/data/app/el2/100/base/${BUNDLE}/haps/entry/files"
DST="${SANDBOX_FILES}/smo/romfs"
FILES=(runtime-index.bin romfs.bin.000 romfs.bin.001 romfs.bin.002 romfs.bin.003 romfs.bin.004 romfs.bin.005)

log()  { printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*"; }
die()  { log "✗ $*"; exit 1; }
h()    { "$HDC" -t "$TARGET" "$@"; }

SRV_PID=""
RPORT_ADDED=0
cleanup() {
  if [ -n "$SRV_PID" ]; then
    kill "$SRV_PID" 2>/dev/null; wait "$SRV_PID" 2>/dev/null
    log "http.server($SRV_PID) 已停止"
  fi
  if [ "$RPORT_ADDED" -eq 1 ]; then
    "$HDC" -t "$TARGET" rport rm "tcp:${HTTP_PORT}" "tcp:${HTTP_PORT}" 2>/dev/null \
      || "$HDC" -t "$TARGET" fport rm "tcp:${HTTP_PORT}" "tcp:${HTTP_PORT}" 2>/dev/null \
      || true
    log "rport 隧道已清理（尽力而为）"
  fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT

# ---------- 0. 前置检查 ----------
[ -x "$HDC" ] || die "hdc 不存在: $HDC"
[ -f "$HAP" ] || die "HAP 不存在: $HAP"
for f in "${FILES[@]}"; do
  [ -f "$PARTS_DIR/$f" ] || die "分卷缺失: $PARTS_DIR/$f"
done
h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "目标不在线: $TARGET（hdc list targets 检查）"
log "目标在线: $TARGET"

# 远端文件字节数（失败输出空）
remote_size() { h shell "ls -l '$1' 2>/dev/null" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $5}' | tail -1; }

# ---------- 1. 安装/升级 HAP（幂等） ----------
if h shell "bm dump -n ${BUNDLE}" >/dev/null 2>&1 && \
   [ -n "$(h shell "bm dump -n ${BUNDLE}" 2>/dev/null | grep '"name"')" ]; then
  log "步骤1: 已安装，尝试 -r 原地升级（保沙箱数据）…"
  OUT="$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1)"
  log "$OUT"
  if ! grep -q "install bundle successfully" <<<"$OUT"; then
    if grep -q "sign info inconsistent" <<<"$OUT"; then
      log "签名不一致 → 卸载旧包重装（会清空沙箱，romfs 需重灌）"
      h uninstall "$BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
      OUT="$(h install "$HAP" 2>&1)"; log "$OUT"
    fi
  fi
else
  log "步骤1: 未安装，直接安装…"
  OUT="$(h install "$HAP" 2>&1)"; log "$OUT"
fi
grep -q "install bundle successfully" <<<"$OUT" || die "HAP 安装失败（见上）"
h shell "bm dump -n ${BUNDLE}" 2>/dev/null | grep -q '"name"' || die "安装后 bm dump 仍查不到包"

# ---------- 2. 确保沙箱已生成（应用至少跑过一次） ----------
if ! h shell "ls '${SANDBOX_FILES}/smo' " >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  log "步骤2: 沙箱未生成，启动应用一次…"
  h shell "aa start -b ${BUNDLE} -a EntryAbility" >/dev/null 2>&1
  for i in $(seq 1 30); do
    h shell "ls '${SANDBOX_FILES}/smo' " >/dev/null 2>&1 && break
    sleep 1
  done
fi
h shell "ls '${SANDBOX_FILES}/smo' " >/dev/null 2>&1 \
  || die "沙箱 smo 目录未出现（应用首启解包失败？看 hilog SmoEntry）"
log "步骤2: 沙箱就绪 → ${SANDBOX_FILES}/smo"

# ---------- 3. 校验已就位件（幂等跳过） ----------
MISSING=()
TOTAL_LOCAL=0; TOTAL_REMOTE_OK=0
for f in "${FILES[@]}"; do
  L=$(stat -f%z "$PARTS_DIR/$f"); TOTAL_LOCAL=$((TOTAL_LOCAL+L))
  R="$(remote_size "${DST}/${f}")"
  if [ -n "$R" ] && [ "$R" = "$L" ]; then
    TOTAL_REMOTE_OK=$((TOTAL_REMOTE_OK+L))
    log "  ✓ $f 已就位 ($L B)，跳过"
  else
    MISSING+=("$f")
    log "  ✗ $f 缺失/不符 (本地 $L B, 远端 ${R:-无})"
  fi
done
if [ "${#MISSING[@]}" -eq 0 ]; then
  log "全部 7 件已就位，无需传输。沙箱: ${DST}"
  exit 0
fi
log "步骤3: 缺 ${#MISSING[@]} 件（${MISSING[*]}）→ 整包重拉（应用下载循环遇 404 即中止，无法逐件补）"

# ---------- 4. 直连通道：lo0 别名 + http.server ----------
# 应用 pcAddr 默认 192.168.0.110:8000（Index.ets @State 初值），先直连失败才回落 rport 隧道；
# 把该 IP 挂到本机 lo0，让"直连"落在宿主本地环回（NAT 代理发起，绕开 App 防火墙），
# 且避开 rport 中继 ~543MB 停摆的坑（2026-10-31 实测）。
APP_DIRECT_IP="192.168.0.110"
if ! ifconfig lo0 2>/dev/null | grep -q "inet ${APP_DIRECT_IP} "; then
  log "步骤4: lo0 缺 ${APP_DIRECT_IP} 别名，尝试添加（需要 sudo）…"
  if [ -f /tmp/.zcode-sudo-pw ]; then
    sudo -S ifconfig lo0 alias "${APP_DIRECT_IP}" up < /tmp/.zcode-sudo-pw 2>/dev/null \
      && log "  别名已添加" || log "  别名添加失败（若无 sudo 通道可手动: sudo ifconfig lo0 alias ${APP_DIRECT_IP}）"
  else
    log "  无 sudo 通道，请手动执行: sudo ifconfig lo0 alias ${APP_DIRECT_IP} up"
  fi
fi
ifconfig lo0 2>/dev/null | grep -q "inet ${APP_DIRECT_IP} " \
  || die "lo0 别名 ${APP_DIRECT_IP} 不存在，应用直连无法落到本机"

log "步骤4: 本机 ${HTTP_PORT} 端口起 http.server（目录 ${PARTS_DIR}，绑 0.0.0.0）…"
python3 -m http.server "${HTTP_PORT}" --bind 0.0.0.0 --directory "$PARTS_DIR" \
  > /tmp/smo_http_server.log 2>&1 &
SRV_PID=$!
for i in $(seq 1 20); do
  CODE="$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "http://${APP_DIRECT_IP}:${HTTP_PORT}/runtime-index.bin" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  [ "$CODE" = "200" ] && break
  sleep 1
done
[ "$CODE" = "200" ] || { cat /tmp/smo_http_server.log; die "http.server 未就绪(${APP_DIRECT_IP}:${HTTP_PORT})"; }
log "  http.server 就绪 (pid $SRV_PID)，直连地址 http://${APP_DIRECT_IP}:${HTTP_PORT}/"

# 备胎通道：rport 隧道（应用直连失败时自动回落用；大文件会停摆，仅供灾备）
OUT="$(h rport "tcp:${HTTP_PORT}" "tcp:${HTTP_PORT}" 2>&1 || true)"
grep -q "OK" <<<"$OUT" && RPORT_ADDED=1
log "  rport 隧道(备胎): $OUT"

# ---------- 5. 触发应用自拉（autopath=1） ----------
log "步骤5: 重启应用并带 autopath=1 自动拉取…"
h shell "aa force-stop ${BUNDLE}" >/dev/null 2>&1
sleep 1
h shell "aa start -b ${BUNDLE} -a EntryAbility --ps autopath 1" 2>&1 | sed 's/^/    /'

# ---------- 6. 轮询校验 ----------
log "步骤6: 轮询传输进度（每 ${POLL_INTERVAL}s，超时 ${POLL_TIMEOUT}s）…"
DEADLINE=$((SECONDS + POLL_TIMEOUT))
LAST_BYTES=-1; LAST_T=$SECONDS; STALL_LIMIT=420
while :; do
  DONE_BYTES=0; INFLIGHT=0; ALL_OK=1
  for f in "${FILES[@]}"; do
    L=$(stat -f%z "$PARTS_DIR/$f")
    R="$(remote_size "${DST}/${f}")"
    if [ -n "$R" ] && [ "$R" = "$L" ]; then
      DONE_BYTES=$((DONE_BYTES+L))
    else
      ALL_OK=0
      P="$(remote_size "${DST}/${f}.part")"
      [ -n "$P" ] && INFLIGHT=$((INFLIGHT+P))
    fi
  done
  CUR=$((DONE_BYTES+INFLIGHT))
  PCT=$((CUR*100/TOTAL_LOCAL))
  log "  进度: ${PCT}%  完成 $((DONE_BYTES/1048576))MB + 传输中 $((INFLIGHT/1048576))MB / 共 $((TOTAL_LOCAL/1048576))MB"
  if [ "$ALL_OK" -eq 1 ]; then log "  7 件全部就位 ✓"; break; fi
  if [ "$SECONDS" -ge "$DEADLINE" ]; then
    die "超时未完成（已完成 $((DONE_BYTES/1048576))MB）。重跑本脚本将从缺件起整包重拉"
  fi
  if [ "$CUR" -gt "$LAST_BYTES" ]; then LAST_BYTES=$CUR; LAST_T=$SECONDS
  elif [ $((SECONDS - LAST_T)) -ge "$STALL_LIMIT" ]; then
    die "传输停滞 ${STALL_LIMIT}s（应用侧拉取失败？看 hilog / 界面提示）。重跑本脚本重试"
  fi
  sleep "$POLL_INTERVAL"
done

# ---------- 7. 终验 + 汇总 ----------
sleep 2
log "步骤7: 终验（逐件比对字节数）…"
FINAL_OK=0
for f in "${FILES[@]}"; do
  L=$(stat -f%z "$PARTS_DIR/$f"); R="$(remote_size "${DST}/${f}")"
  if [ -n "$R" ] && [ "$R" = "$L" ]; then
    FINAL_OK=$((FINAL_OK+1)); log "  ✓ $f  $R B"
  else
    log "  ✗ $f  本地 $L B / 远端 ${R:-无}"
  fi
done
h shell "ls -l '${DST}'" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/    /'
log "======================================"
log "就位: ${FINAL_OK}/7 件"
log "沙箱: ${DST}"
[ "$FINAL_OK" -eq 7 ] || die "终验未过"
log "部署完成 ✓（重复执行将直接跳过传输）"

```

#!/bin/bash
# switch2hos 通用取证库：hdc 封装 / 日志 / 截图 / 开关读写 / 日志回拉
# 用法：在 boot 脚本里 `source "$(dirname "$0")/../lib/common.sh"`
#
# 可用环境变量覆盖：HDC / TGT / BUNDLE / FILES / OUT
: "${HDC:=/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc}"
: "${TGT:=127.0.0.1:5555}"          # 模拟器；真机地址请显式传入，勿写死
: "${BUNDLE:=com.vibecc.smo}"
: "${FILES:=/data/app/el2/100/base/com.vibecc.smo/files}"
: "${OUT:?OUT 未设置（boot 脚本应先 mkdir -p 输出目录）}"

h(){ "$HDC" -t "$TGT" "$@"; }
log(){ printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*" | tee -a "$OUT/run.log"; }

stopapp(){
  local i p
  for i in 1 2 3; do
    p=$(h shell "pidof $BUNDLE" | tr -d '[:space:]')
    [ -z "$p" ] && return 0
    h shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
    sleep 3
  done
  return 1
}

# 开关：hdc/shell(uid=2000) **不能新建**文件，只能改写 app 已 seed 出来的 smo_*
sw_write(){ local k="$1" v="$2"; h shell "[ -f $FILES/$k ] && echo $v > $FILES/$k" >/dev/null 2>&1; }
sw_read(){ h shell "cat $FILES/$k 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r\n'; }
sw_exists(){ [ -n "$(h shell "ls $FILES/$1 2>/dev/null" | tr -d '\r')" ]; }

# 等某个开关文件被 app 的 p_file_seed 建出来（最多 $2 秒）
sw_wait(){ local k="$1" secs="${2:-30}" i; for i in $(seq 1 "$secs"); do sw_exists "$k" && return 0; sleep 1; done; return 1; }

# 截图：设备 snapshot_display -> jpeg -> 本地 png，打 md5
NSHOT=0
shot(){
  local t="$1" k
  for k in 1 2 3; do
    h shell "rm -f /data/local/tmp/$TAG-$t.jpeg; snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/$TAG-$t.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
    h file recv "/data/local/tmp/$TAG-$t.jpeg" "$OUT/screen_$t.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
    [ -s "$OUT/screen_$t.jpeg" ] && break
    log "shot retry $k @$t"; sleep 2
  done
  if [ -s "$OUT/screen_$t.jpeg" ] && sips -s format png "$OUT/screen_$t.jpeg" --out "$OUT/screen_$t.png" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    NSHOT=$((NSHOT + 1))
    log "screen_$t md5=$(md5 -q "$OUT/screen_$t.png") bytes=$(stat -f%z "$OUT/screen_$t.png") @t=${t}s"
  else
    log "X screen_$t capture failed"
  fi
}

# 回拉 vk_boot.log 并按标签切分（大文件只 grep，不整读）
pull_log(){
  local log_path="$FILES/vk_boot.log" i
  for i in 1 2; do h file recv "$log_path" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 2; done
  [ -f "$OUT/vk_boot.log" ] || { log "X vk_boot.log 回拉失败"; return 1; }
  log "log lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/vk_boot.log" | tr -d ' ') bytes=$(wc -c < "$OUT/vk_boot.log" | tr -d ' ')"
}
# 提取某个标签的行到文件：grep_tag '[m39a]' m39a
grep_tag(){ grep -a -- "$1" "$OUT/vk_boot.log" > "$OUT/${2:-grep}.txt" 2>/dev/null; log "$1 lines=$(wc -l < "$OUT/${2:-grep}.txt" | tr -d ' ')"; }

#!/bin/bash
# round24 E1E2 探针 boot：一次安装 + 一次点火 + hilog 流式捕获 + SIGUSR1 dump 触发
# 日志 logs/round24_fp_boot.log
set -uo pipefail
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
TARGET="127.0.0.1:5555"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
ROOT="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos"
HAP="$ROOT/mario-odessy-harmony/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap"
LOG="$ROOT/logs/round24_fp_boot.log"
RUN_S=420          # 点火后先跑 300s（TP 门命中窗口）
POST_S=40          # USR1 后再捕 40s 等 dump 输出

log() { printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$*"; }
h()   { "$HDC" -t "$TARGET" "$@"; }

h shell "echo ok" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "X target offline"; exit 1; }
log "target online"

# ---------- 1) 安装（唯一一次） ----------
log "step1 install (only once): h install -r"
OUT="$(h install -r "$HAP" 2>&1)"; log "$OUT"
grep -q "install bundle successfully" <<<"$OUT" || { log "X install failed"; exit 1; }

# ---------- 2) cleanup ----------
for i in 1 2 3; do
  PID=$(h shell "pidof ${BUNDLE}" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]')
  [ -z "$PID" ] && break
  h shell "aa force-stop ${BUNDLE}" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 2
done
h shell "hilog -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell wakeup" >/dev/null 2>&1
h shell "power-shell timeout -o 600000" >/dev/null 2>&1

# ---------- 3) 点火 ----------
log "step2 ignite: aa start (plain)"
h shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b ${BUNDLE}"
sleep 1

# ---------- 4) 流式捕获 ----------
log "step3 capture ${RUN_S}s -> $LOG"
: > "$LOG"
"$HDC" -t "$TARGET" shell hilog > "$LOG" 2>&1 &
SPID=$!
trap 'kill -9 "$SPID" 2>/dev/null' EXIT
sleep "$RUN_S"

# ---------- 5) SIGUSR1 dump 触发（同一次 boot 内） ----------
PID=$(h shell "pidof ${BUNDLE}" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]')
log "step4 SIGUSR1 to pid=$PID"
[ -n "$PID" ] && h shell "kill -USR1 $PID"
sleep "$POST_S"
kill -9 "$SPID" 2>/dev/null; wait "$SPID" 2>/dev/null
trap - EXIT
h shell "power-shell timeout -r" >/dev/null 2>&1
log "done: $(wc -c < "$LOG" | tr -d ' ') bytes / $(wc -l < "$LOG" | tr -d ' ') lines"

`tools/g1_check.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# g1_check.sh — G1 判据的自动验证（设备侧帧缓冲截图 + 三重防伪）
#
# 用法: tools/g1_check.sh [等待秒数=25] [采样张数=3]
#
# 为什么用 snapshot_display 而不是桌面 screencapture：
#   桌面截图要裁模拟器窗口，机身边框/工具栏/背景窗口会混进来——实测同一块黑屏，
#   桌面截图算 10.37%，设备侧只有 0.33%。差 30 倍。
#
# 为什么还要三重防伪（血泪教训）：
#   第一次真机验收时，应用中途退出、屏幕回到桌面壁纸，工具报出「100.00% 非黑 = 达标」。
#   壁纸也有大量像素，只看非黑比例必然被骗。所以每一帧必须同时满足：
#     1) 应用进程在场（pidof 非空）        —— 排除「应用已退出」
#     2) 画面为横屏（W > H）                —— 排除「桌面/锁屏是竖屏」
#     3) 颜色种类少（< 300 桶）             —— 我们的填色是纯色；壁纸通常上千种
#   任一不满足 → 该帧作废，不计入达标判断。
#
# 判据: 任一**有效帧**非黑 > 5% 视为达标
# 退出码: 0=达标 1=未达标 2=环境问题（无采样/全部作废）
set -u
WAIT="${1:-25}"; SHOTS="${2:-3}"
BUNDLE="com.vibecc.smo"
HDC="/Applications/DevEco-Studio.app/Contents/sdk/default/openharmony/toolchains/hdc"
OUT="/tmp/g1_$(date +%H%M%S)"; mkdir -p "$OUT"

"$HDC" shell "aa force-stop $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 2
"$HDC" shell "aa start -a EntryAbility -b $BUNDLE" >/dev/null 2>&1
echo "[g1] started $BUNDLE, waiting ${WAIT}s"
sleep "$WAIT"

BEST=0; VALID=0
for i in $(seq 1 "$SHOTS"); do
  ALIVE=$("$HDC" shell "pidof $BUNDLE" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[:space:]')
  "$HDC" shell "snapshot_display -f /data/local/tmp/g1_$i.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  "$HDC" file recv "/data/local/tmp/g1_$i.jpeg" "$OUT/shot$i.jpeg" >/dev/null 2>&1
  R=$(python3 - "$OUT/shot$i.jpeg" <<'PY'
import sys
from PIL import Image
im = Image.open(sys.argv[1]).convert('RGB'); px = im.load(); W, H = im.size
tot = nb = 0; buckets = set()
for y in range(0, H, 4):
    for x in range(0, W, 4):
        r, g, b = px[x, y]; tot += 1
        if r + g + b > 30:
            nb += 1
            if len(buckets) < 8000: buckets.add((r//16, g//16, b//16))
print("%.2f %d %d %d" % (100.0*nb/max(tot,1), len(buckets), W, H))
PY
)
  RATIO=$(echo "$R"|cut -d' ' -f1); NB=$(echo "$R"|cut -d' ' -f2); W=$(echo "$R"|cut -d' ' -f3); H=$(echo "$R"|cut -d' ' -f4)
  WHY=""
  [ -z "$ALIVE" ] && WHY="app not running"
  [ -z "$WHY" ] && [ "$W" -le "$H" ] && WHY="portrait ${W}x${H} (launcher/lock screen, not our landscape surface)"
  [ -z "$WHY" ] && [ "$NB" -ge 300 ] && WHY="${NB} colour buckets (looks like a photo/wallpaper, not a solid fill)"
  if [ -n "$WHY" ]; then
    echo "[g1] shot$i ${W}x${H} nonblack=${RATIO}% colors=${NB}  VOID: $WHY"
  else
    VALID=$((VALID+1))
    echo "[g1] shot$i ${W}x${H} nonblack=${RATIO}% colors=${NB}  valid (app pid=$ALIVE)"
    BEST=$(python3 -c "print(max($BEST,$RATIO))")
  fi
  sleep 2
done

echo "[g1] valid frames=$VALID/$SHOTS  best nonblack=${BEST}% (threshold 5%)  artifacts: $OUT"
[ "$VALID" -eq 0 ] && { echo "[g1] no valid frame — cannot judge"; exit 2; }
python3 -c "import sys; sys.exit(0 if $BEST > 5.0 else 1)"

```

`tools/m27a_add_units.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""M28A 前置工具（M27A 报告 §P4-1）：给 index.json 的**键层**补 "units" 字段。

背景（M27A 已钉死，不要重新论证）：
  语料里 `binding = 32 + 稠密序号`，而 guest 真正的 NVN texture unit 是
      unit = (handle_offset - 0x20) / 8
  该字段 `_index[<key>][stageN].tex[].handle_offset` 每张图都有，运行时从来没读。
  地表那 10 个 FS 键的真实 unit 集合是 {0,1,2,3,4,9,13,22}（不含 5、6），我们按稠密序号
  去读 unit 5/6 ⇒ 永远没绑过 ⇒ 1x1 占位 ⇒ 整片平涂。

产出（**原语料只读**，绝不原地改）：
  <out>/index.json      = 原 index.json 每个键层多一个 "units":"1,9,2,22,3,0,13"（按 slot 升序，
                          第 i 个元素 = 稠密序号 i 的真实 unit），紧凑 JSON。
用法：
  python3 tools/m27a_add_units.py --src <原始 index.json> --out <工作副本 index.json> [--check key]
"""
import argparse
import json
import os
import sys

HANDLE_BASE = 0x20
HANDLE_STRIDE = 8


def units_for(entry):
    """返回 (units 列表, 说明)。取 entry['stage'] 指向的 stageN.tex[]（无则另一阶段）。"""
    st = entry.get("stage")
    order = []
    if st == 1:
        order = ["stage1", "stage0"]
    elif st == 0:
        order = ["stage0", "stage1"]
    else:
        order = ["stage1", "stage0"]
    for name in order:
        sub = entry.get(name)
        if not isinstance(sub, dict):
            continue
        tex = sub.get("tex")
        if not isinstance(tex, list):
            continue
        pairs = []
        for t in tex:
            ho = t.get("handle_offset")
            sl = t.get("slot")
            if ho is None or sl is None:
                continue
            pairs.append((int(sl), (int(ho) - HANDLE_BASE) // HANDLE_STRIDE))
        pairs.sort()
        return [u for _, u in pairs], order[0]
    return [], None


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--src", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--check", default=None, help="打印该 key 的 units 供人工核对")
    a = ap.parse_args()

    with open(a.src, "r") as f:
        doc = json.load(f)
    idx = doc["_index"]

    n_keys = n_units = 0
    n_pairs = n_same = 0
    n_empty_ctx = n_empty_slots = 0
    umax = -1
    slot_gap = []
    stage_pick = {"stage1": 0, "stage0": 0, None: 0}
    for k, e in idx.items():
        n_keys += 1
        us, which = units_for(e)
        stage_pick[which] = stage_pick.get(which, 0) + 1
        if not us:
            # 无 unit 信息：写空串。两种情形必须分开计数（否则统计会骗人）：
            #   (a) ntex==0 —— 本键不采样纹理，空串合理；
            #   (b) ntex>0 但语料的 stageN.tex[] 是空数组 —— 该键**没有** handle_offset 可用，
            #       运行时只能回落到"稠密序号当 unit"的旧行为（属本轮覆盖不到的残余）。
            e["units"] = ""
            n_units += 1
            if int(e.get("ntex") or 0) > 0:
                n_empty_ctx += 1
                n_empty_slots += int(e.get("ntex") or 0)
            continue
        e["units"] = ",".join(str(u) for u in us)
        n_units += 1
        for i, u in enumerate(us):
            n_pairs += 1
            if u == i:
                n_same += 1
            if u > umax:
                umax = u
        if len(us) != int(e.get("ntex") or 0):
            slot_gap.append((k, len(us), e.get("ntex")))

    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(a.out)), exist_ok=True)
    with open(a.out, "w") as f:
        json.dump(doc, f, separators=(",", ":"))

    print("[m27a] keys=%d with_units_field=%d" % (n_keys, n_units))
    print("[m27a] pairs=%d dense_eq_unit=%d (%.1f%%) mismatched=%d"
          % (n_pairs, n_same, (100.0 * n_same / n_pairs) if n_pairs else 0.0, n_pairs - n_same))
    print("[m27a] unit_max=%d stage_pick=%s" % (umax, stage_pick))
    print("[m27a] len(units)!=ntex keys=%d" % len(slot_gap))
    for k, a1, b1 in slot_gap[:8]:
        print("        %s units=%d ntex=%s" % (k, a1, b1))
    print("[m27a] keys_with_ntex_but_no_units=%d of %d (%.1f%%); uncovered (key,slot)=%d (%.1f%% of %d)"
          % (n_empty_ctx, n_keys,
             100.0 * n_empty_ctx / n_keys, n_empty_slots,
             100.0 * n_empty_slots / max(1, n_pairs + n_empty_slots), n_pairs + n_empty_slots))
    print("[m27a] src=%s (%d B) -> out=%s (%d B)"
          % (a.src, os.path.getsize(a.src), a.out, os.path.getsize(a.out)))
    if a.check:
        e = idx.get(a.check)
        print("[m27a] check %s stage=%s ntex=%s units=%r"
              % (a.check, e and e.get("stage"), e and e.get("ntex"), e and e.get("units")))
        if e:
            for name in ("stage1", "stage0"):
                sub = e.get(name) or {}
                for t in sub.get("tex", []) or []:
                    print("        %s slot=%s handle_offset=%s -> unit=%s type=%s"
                          % (name, t.get("slot"), t.get("handle_offset"),
                             (t.get("handle_offset") - HANDLE_BASE) // HANDLE_STRIDE, t.get("type")))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

`tools/m3q/m3q_batch.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""M3q 批量驱动：翻译结果(trans.tsv) -> glslangValidator 编译 -> index.json + 统计。

成功判定严格：glslangValidator 返回 0 **且** .spv 前 4 字节为 03 02 23 07。
所有产物写在 --out 下（默认 /tmp/m3q），不放进 git 仓库。
"""
import argparse, hashlib, json, os, re, struct, subprocess, sys, time

CXX = "/opt/homebrew/bin/glslangValidator"
STAGE_EXT = {0: ("vert", "-S", "vert"), 1: ("frag", "-S", "frag"), 5: ("comp", "-S", "comp")}


def parse_tsv(path):
    rows = []
    for line in open(path):
        f = line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
        if len(f) < 4 or f[0] != "T":
            continue
        r = {"key": f[1], "stage": int(f[2]), "t_ok": f[3] == "1",
             "err": "", "raw": line.rstrip("\n")}
        if r["t_ok"]:
            for tok in f[4].split():
                if "=" not in tok:
                    continue
                k, v = tok.split("=", 1)
                if k == "stage":
                    continue          # C 侧打的 "stage=vert" 别覆盖第 3 列的数字 stage
                r[k] = v
        else:
            err = f[4][4:] if f[4].startswith("err=") else f[4]
            r["err"] = re.sub(r"\s+stage=\S+\s+path=\S+$", "", err)
        rows.append(r)
    return rows


def fail_sites(translate_c):
    """提取 translate.c 里所有 fail(c, "fmt", ...) 的 (行号, 骨架)。"""
    sites = []
    src = open(translate_c, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read().splitlines()
    for i, line in enumerate(src, 1):
        m = re.search(r'fail\(c,\s*"((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)"', line)
        if not m:
            continue
        fmt = m.group(1).replace('\\"', '"')
        skel = re.sub(r"%[-#0-9.*hljztL]*[diouxXscfeEgG]", "*", fmt)
        sites.append((i, skel, fmt))
    return sites


def match_site(err, sites):
    skel = re.sub(r"%[-#0-9.*hljztL]*[diouxXscfeEgG]", "*", err)
    # 精确骨架匹配；"unknown instruction" 这类带多个参数也能对上
    for ln, s, fmt in sites:
        if s == skel:
            return ln, fmt
    # 退一步：前缀匹配（值里可能含 %）
    for ln, s, fmt in sites:
        pre = s.split("*")[0]
        if pre and skel.startswith(pre):
            return ln, fmt
    return None, None


def key_recompute(corpus, key, stage):
    """svr: 实测重算 sha256(ctl||code)[:8] -> 16 hex，对照文件名。"""
    ctl = open(os.path.join(corpus, f"{key}.{stage}.ctl"), "rb").read()
    code = open(os.path.join(corpus, f"{key}.{stage}.code"), "rb").read()
    return hashlib.sha256(ctl + code).hexdigest()[:16]


def compile_one(glsl, spv, stage, timeout=180):
    ext, flag, name = STAGE_EXT[stage]
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    p = subprocess.run([CXX, "-V", "--target-env", "vulkan1.3", flag, name, "-o", spv, glsl],
                       capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout)
    dt = time.perf_counter() - t0
    out = (p.stdout + p.stderr).strip()
    ok_magic, nbytes, sha = False, 0, ""
    if os.path.exists(spv):
        b = open(spv, "rb").read()
        nbytes = len(b)
        ok_magic = len(b) >= 4 and struct.unpack_from("<I", b, 0)[0] == 0x07230203
        sha = hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()[:16]
    diagnostics = [l for l in out.splitlines() if "ERROR" in l or "error" in l][:6]
    return {
        "rc": p.returncode, "t": round(dt, 3),
        "ok": p.returncode == 0 and ok_magic,
        "spv_bytes": nbytes, "spv_sha256_16": sha if ok_magic else "",
        "diagnostics": diagnostics, "raw": out[-2000:],
    }


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--corpus", default="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos/logs/m3p_shaderdump/shaderdump")
    ap.add_argument("--out", default="/tmp/m3q")
    ap.add_argument("--tsv", default="/tmp/m3q/trans.tsv")
    ap.add_argument("--translate-c", default="/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos/mario-odessy-harmony/"
                    "entry/src/main/cpp/platform/nvn_replay/maxwell/translate.c")
    ap.add_argument("--no-compile", action="store_true")
    a = ap.parse_args()

    os.makedirs(os.path.join(a.out, "out"), exist_ok=True)
    rows = parse_tsv(a.tsv)
    sites = fail_sites(a.translate_c)
    results = {}
    for r in rows:
        k, st = r["key"], r["stage"]
        ent = {"key": k, "stage": st, "translate_ok": r["t_ok"], "translate_error": r["err"],
               "t_translate": None, "compile": None}
        if r["t_ok"]:
            for fld in ("attr", "out", "cbuf", "cbdyn", "cbwin", "ntex", "lmem", "ninst", "wdepth",
                        "disc", "wps", "gmem", "gmemst", "tint", "rscale", "glsl", "cbsz", "tex", "path"):
                ent[fld] = r.get(fld, "")
            if not a.no_compile:
                glsl = r.get("path", "")
                spv = os.path.join(a.out, "out", f"{k}.{st}.spv")
                ent["compile"] = compile_one(glsl, spv, st)
                ent["spv_path"] = spv
        else:
            ln, fmt = match_site(r["err"], sites)
            ent["fail_line"] = ln
            ent["fail_fmt"] = fmt
        results[f"{k}.{st}"] = ent

    # ---- 统计
    n = len(results)
    t_ok = sum(1 for e in results.values() if e["translate_ok"])
    c_ok = sum(1 for e in results.values() if e.get("compile", {}) and e["compile"]["ok"])
    per_stage = {}
    for e in results.values():
        s = per_stage.setdefault(e["stage"], {"n": 0, "translate_ok": 0, "spv_ok": 0})
        s["n"] += 1
        s["translate_ok"] += e["translate_ok"]
        s["spv_ok"] += bool(e.get("compile", {}) and e["compile"]["ok"])

    tax = {}
    for e in results.values():
        if e.get("compile", {}) and e["compile"]["ok"]:
            continue
        if not e["translate_ok"]:
            k = f"translate: {e['translate_error']}"
            k = re.sub(r"at 0x[0-9a-f]+", "at <pc>", k)
            k = re.sub(r"instruction [0-9a-f]+", "instruction <word>", k)
            src = f"translate.c:{e['fail_line']}" if e["fail_line"] else "translate.c:?"
        else:
            diags = e["compile"]["diagnostics"] or ["exit %d" % e["compile"]["rc"]]
            k = "glslang: " + diags[0][:160]
            src = "glsl 生成/编译期"
        d = tax.setdefault(k, {"n": 0, "line": src, "keys": [], "diag": e["compile"]["diagnostics"] if e.get("compile") else []})
        d["n"] += 1
        if len(d["keys"]) < 3:
            d["keys"].append(f"{e['key']}.{e['stage']}")

    # ---- 查表口径实测：全部 200 条重算 sha256(ctl||code)[:16] 对照文件名
    keycheck_all = []
    for e in results.values():
        recomputed = key_recompute(a.corpus, e["key"], e["stage"])
        keycheck_all.append({"key": e["key"], "stage": e["stage"], "recomputed": recomputed,
                             "filename": e["key"], "match": recomputed == e["key"]})
    keycheck = keycheck_all[:3]          # 报告里给 3 个例子（派活单要求）
    keycheck_summary = {"checked": len(keycheck_all),
                        "match": sum(1 for x in keycheck_all if x["match"])}

    # ---- index.json（key 口径 = sha256(ctl||code)[:16]，与 shader_dump.c 一致）
    index = {}
    for e in results.values():
        k = e["key"]
        node = index.setdefault(k, {"key": k})
        st = f"stage{e['stage']}"
        if e["translate_ok"] and e.get("compile", {}) and e["compile"]["ok"]:
            node[st] = {
                "status": "ok",
                "spv": e["spv_path"], "spv_bytes": e["compile"]["spv_bytes"],
                "spv_sha256_16": e["compile"]["spv_sha256_16"],
                "glsl": e.get("path", ""), "glsl_bytes": int(e.get("glsl", 0)),
                "stage": e["stage"],
                "attr_mask": int(e.get("attr", 0), 0), "out_mask": int(e.get("out", 0), 0),
                "cbuf_mask": int(e.get("cbuf", 0), 0), "cbuf_dynamic": int(e.get("cbdyn", 0), 0),
                "cbwin_mask": int(e.get("cbwin", 0), 0), "ntex": int(e.get("ntex", 0)),
                "local_mem": int(e.get("lmem", 0)), "num_insts": int(e.get("ninst", 0)),
                "writes_depth": bool(int(e.get("wdepth", 0))), "uses_discard": bool(int(e.get("disc", 0))),
                "writes_point_size": bool(int(e.get("wps", 0))), "uses_gmem": bool(int(e.get("gmem", 0))),
                "uses_gmem_store": bool(int(e.get("gmemst", 0))), "uses_tint": bool(int(e.get("tint", 0))),
                "uses_rscale": bool(int(e.get("rscale", 0))),
                "cbuf_size": {int(x.split(":")[0]): int(x.split(":")[1])
                              for x in e.get("cbsz", "").split(",") if ":" in x},
                "tex": parse_tex(e.get("tex", "")),
            }
            # 便捷镜像（派活单口径：顶层 attr_mask/ntex/cbuf_mask）
            node["stage"] = e["stage"]
            node["attr_mask"] = node[st]["attr_mask"]
            node["ntex"] = node[st]["ntex"]
            node["cbuf_mask"] = node[st]["cbuf_mask"]
        else:
            node[st] = {"status": "failed", "stage": e["stage"],
                        "translate_ok": e["translate_ok"],
                        "error": e["translate_error"] or (e["compile"]["diagnostics"][:2] if e.get("compile") else ""),
                        "fail_line": e.get("fail_line")}

    meta = {
        "generated": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
        "corpus": a.corpus, "out_dir": a.out,
        "key_scheme": "sha256(ctl_bytes || code_bytes)[:16] (16 hex) - same as shader_dump.c sd_one()",
        "entries": n, "translate_ok": t_ok, "spv_ok": c_ok,
        "per_stage": per_stage,
        "compile_flags": f"{CXX} -V --target-env vulkan1.3 -S <stage>",
        "key_verification": keycheck, "key_verification_summary": keycheck_summary,
        "baked_with": {
            "glsl": 1, "attr_kind": "all float (0) - corpus carries no NVN vertex format",
            "depth_minus_one": not os.environ.get("M3Q_NO_ZREMAP"),
            "flip_y": not os.environ.get("M3Q_NO_FLIP"), "flip_x": False, "no_ds_write": False,
            "maxwell_no_int64": False, "maxwell_gmem_base": "0x80000000", "maxwell_gmem_size": "0x40000000",
            "note": "runtime must use the same ShaderKey flags for these .spv to match the baked clip/I-O convention",
        },
        "note": "corpus keys are unique per shader; no key has both stage0 and stage1",
    }

    # 可选：把“截掉尾部常量池”实验的成功结果作为 alt 挂上（不影响严格统计）
    tr = os.path.join(a.out, "trim_report.json")
    if os.path.exists(tr):
        trim = json.load(open(tr))
        meta["trim_experiment"] = {"cases": len(trim),
                                   "ok_after_trim": sum(1 for v in trim.values() if v.get("spv_ok")),
                                   "what": "cut .code at last EXIT+8 (trailing float constant pool is not code)"}
        for ent, v in trim.items():
            k, st = ent.rsplit(".", 1)
            st = f"stage{st}"
            if k in index and st in index[k] and v.get("spv_ok"):
                index[k][st]["alt"] = {
                    "status": "ok_with_trim", "spv": v.get("spv_path"),
                    "spv_bytes": v.get("spv_bytes"),
                    "dropped_bytes": v.get("dropped_bytes"),
                }
    with open(os.path.join(a.out, "index.json"), "w") as f:
        json.dump({"meta": meta, "_index": index}, f, indent=1, sort_keys=True)
    with open(os.path.join(a.out, "results.json"), "w") as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=1)

    print(json.dumps({"entries": n, "translate_ok": t_ok, "spv_ok": c_ok,
                      "per_stage": per_stage, "taxonomy": tax,
                      "key_verification": keycheck}, indent=2))


def parse_tex(s):
    out = []
    for x in s.split(","):
        if not x:
            continue
        idx, rest = x.split(":", 1)
        t, flags, hoff, bcb, boff = rest.split("/")
        out.append({"slot": int(idx), "type": int(t),
                    "shadow": flags[0] == "1", "array": flags[1] == "1",
                    "image": flags[2] == "1", "bindless": flags[3] == "1",
                    "handle_offset": int(hoff), "bindless_cbuf": int(bcb),
                    "bindless_offset": int(boff)})
    return out


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

`tools/m3q/m3q_pack.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""M3w：把 index.json + out/*.spv 打成运行时容器 spv.bin，并（可选）拷进 HAP rawfile。

容器格式（必须与 nvn_vk.c r_bin_load() 逐字节一致）：
  magic "SMO1"=0x534D4F31 | u32 count | u32 hdr_size(=12+28*count)
  count × {char key[16]; u32 stage; u32 bytes; u32 off;} = 28B
  之后各 .spv 原始字节（4 字节对齐）。
"""
import argparse, json, os, struct, sys

MAGIC = 0x534D4F31


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--bake", default="/tmp/m3w", help="烘焙目录（含 index.json 与 out/）")
    ap.add_argument("--rawfile", default="", help="拷贝目标目录（HAP 的 rawfile/shadercache）")
    a = ap.parse_args()

    idx = json.load(open(os.path.join(a.bake, "index.json")))["_index"]
    ents = []
    for key, node in sorted(idx.items()):
        for st in (0, 1, 5):
            e = node.get(f"stage{st}")
            if not e or e.get("status") != "ok":
                continue
            path = os.path.join(a.bake, "out", f"{key}.{st}.spv")
            if not os.path.exists(path):
                sys.exit(f"MISSING {path}")
            ents.append((key, st, path))
    if not ents:
        sys.exit("no ok entries")

    hdr = 12 + 28 * len(ents)
    off = (hdr + 3) & ~3
    body = bytearray()
    table = bytearray()
    for key, st, path in ents:
        b = open(path, "rb").read()
        assert len(b) % 4 == 0 and b[:4] == b"\x03\x02\x23\x07", (key, st, len(b))
        pad = (-off) % 4
        body += b"\0" * pad
        table += struct.pack("<16sIII", key.encode()[:16].ljust(16, b"\0"), st, len(b), off)
        body += b
        off += pad + len(b)
    out = struct.pack("<III", MAGIC, len(ents), hdr) + bytes(table) + bytes(body)

    dst = os.path.join(a.bake, "spv.bin")
    open(dst, "wb").write(out)
    print(f"packed {len(ents)} entries bytes={len(out)} hdr={hdr} -> {dst}")

    if a.rawfile:
        os.makedirs(a.rawfile, exist_ok=True)
        for name in ("index.json", "spv.bin"):
            src = os.path.join(a.bake, name)
            with open(src, "rb") as f, open(os.path.join(a.rawfile, name), "wb") as g:
                g.write(f.read())
        print(f"copied index.json + spv.bin -> {a.rawfile}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

`tools/m3q/m3q_translate.c`:

```c
// M3q：离线把 m3p 落盘的真实 NVN shader 用 nvn_replay/maxwell/translate.c 翻成 Vulkan GLSL。
//
// 输入 .code 已经去掉 NVN 的 0x30 字节头（文件首字 = SPH magic 0x12345678），
// 而 maxwell_translate_bounded() 期望 blob = NVN 头(0x30) + SPH(0x50) + 指令，
// 所以这里补 0x30 字节零头，max_size = 0x30 + code_len。
//
// 输出：每行一条 TSV（字段见下），GLSL 写到 <out>/<key>.<stage>.glsl。
// 不做任何语义修改；失败原因原样带出 info->error（后续按 translate.c 的 fail() 站点归类）。
//
// usage: m3q_translate <corpus_dir> <out_dir> [key]
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#include "platform/nvn_replay/maxwell/shader.h"

static uint32_t rd32(const void *p) { uint32_t v; memcpy(&v, p, 4); return v; }

static uint8_t *slurp(const char *path, size_t *len) {
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) return NULL;
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    long n = ftell(f);
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    uint8_t *p = malloc((size_t)n + 1);
    if (!p) { fclose(f); return NULL; }
    if (fread(p, 1, (size_t)n, f) != (size_t)n) { free(p); fclose(f); return NULL; }
    fclose(f);
    *len = (size_t)n;
    return p;
}

// 错误串里的 %u/%d/%016llx 等替换成 *，便于和源码里的格式串对齐（失败归类用）。
static void skeleton(const char *in, char *out, size_t cap) {
    size_t o = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; in[i] && o + 2 < cap; i++) {
        if (in[i] == '%' && in[i + 1]) {
            const char *p = in + i + 1;
            while (*p && !strchr("diouxXscfeEgG", *p)) p++;
            if (*p) p++;
            out[o++] = '*';
            i = (size_t)(p - in) - 1;
        } else {
            out[o++] = in[i];
        }
    }
    out[o] = 0;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    if (argc < 3) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: %s <corpus_dir> <out_dir> [key]\n", argv[0]); return 2; }
    const char *dir = argv[1], *out = argv[2], *only = argc > 3 ? argv[3] : NULL;
    char path[1024], indexPath[1100];
    snprintf(indexPath, sizeof indexPath, "%s/index.txt", dir);

    FILE *ix = fopen(indexPath, "r");
    if (!ix) { perror(indexPath); return 2; }

    maxwell_gmem_base = 0x80000000ull;
    maxwell_gmem_size = 0x40000000ull;   // 1 GiB：不触发 translate.c:1861 的 4GiB 断言
    if (getenv("M3Q_NO_INT64")) maxwell_no_int64 = true;   // 复测无 shaderInt64 设备的退路

    char key[64]; unsigned stage; unsigned ctl_claim, code_claim;
    char line[512];
    unsigned n_done = 0;
    while (fgets(line, sizeof line, ix)) {
        if (sscanf(line, "%63s %u ctl=%u code=%u", key, &stage, &ctl_claim, &code_claim) != 4) continue;
        if (only && strcmp(only, key)) continue;

        size_t ctl_len = 0, code_len = 0;
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/%s.%u.ctl", dir, key, stage);
        uint8_t *ctl = slurp(path, &ctl_len);
        snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/%s.%u.code", dir, key, stage);
        uint8_t *code = slurp(path, &code_len);
        if (!ctl || !code) { fprintf(stderr, "B\t%s\t%u\tread failed\n", key, stage); free(ctl); free(code); continue; }

        // 现场复核 dump 口径（与 shader_dump.c:97-105 一致），不符直接拒收而不是猜
        if (rd32(ctl) != 0x98761234u || stage > 5 || code_len < 0x80) {
            fprintf(stderr, "B\t%s\t%u\tlayout mismatch magic=%08x stage=%u code=%zu\n",
                    key, stage, rd32(ctl), stage, code_len);
            free(ctl); free(code);
            continue;
        }

        // .code 就是 NVN 二进制（0x30 NVN 头 + 0x50 SPH + 指令），首字 0x12345678；无需补头。
        // translate.c:3053-3067 取 blob+0x30=SPH、blob+0x80=指令，正好对上。
        size_t blob_len = code_len;
        uint8_t *blob = code;

        ShaderKey k;
        memset(&k, 0, sizeof k);
        k.glsl = 1;            // Vulkan GLSL 输出
        k.attr_kind[0] = 0;    // 全部按 float 顶点输入（只影响声明类型，不影响能否编译）
        // M3w：NVN 的 clip space 与 GL 同口径（y 向上、z ∈ [-1,1]），Vulkan 是 y 向下、z ∈ [0,1]。
        // 本机 Android/HarmonyOS 后端用的是**正高度** viewport（nvn_vk.c 的
        // VkViewport{0,0,H_OFF_W,H_OFF_H}），不像桌面后端那样靠负高度 viewport 抵消，
        // 所以两项都要在烘焙期补：z=(z+w)*0.5 把 [-1,1] 压进 [0,1]，y 取反。
        // 环境变量留退路用于对照烘焙（M3Q_NO_ZREMAP / M3Q_NO_FLIP）。
        k.depth_minus_one = getenv("M3Q_NO_ZREMAP") == NULL;
        k.flip_y = getenv("M3Q_NO_FLIP") == NULL;
        /* M5u P1：`M3Q_STRUCTURED=1` 打开 translate.c 的结构化控制流（if/else/for），
           关掉默认的 `switch (pc)` 状态机 + 100000 次 guard 循环。
           背景（M5u boot#1 实测）：状态机 GLSL 每个片元要"解释执行"整段 Maxwell 指令，
           1600x900 的一次全屏 FS 在 SwiftShader 上直接把 boot 卡死（guest 线程停在 op=29，
           10 分钟无进展；同样的二进制 + 旧语料 A/B 正常）。结构化后同 key 的 GLSL 里
           `switch (pc)` 与 guard 循环都消失，只剩真循环。
           两个全局都由「Android 后端」设置（translate.c 注释），离线烘焙同样适用。 */
        /* M5v P1：结构化控制流改为**默认开**（M5u 只在显式 `M3Q_STRUCTURED=1` 下烘过，
           设备上那份合并语料必须与开关一致，否则下一次重烘又会引入 park）。
           `M3Q_NO_STRUCTURED=1` 保留为回退到 `switch (pc)` 状态机的 A/B 开关。 */
        if (getenv("M3Q_NO_STRUCTURED") == NULL) {
            extern bool maxwell_static_stacks, maxwell_structured;
            maxwell_static_stacks = true;
            maxwell_structured = true;
        }

        ShaderInfo *si = maxwell_translate_bounded(blob, blob_len, 0, (int)stage, &k);
        char gpath[1200];
        const char *stage_name = stage == 0 ? "vert" : stage == 1 ? "frag" : "comp";
        snprintf(gpath, sizeof gpath, "%s/%s.%u.glsl", out, key, stage);

        char skel[256] = "";
        if (si && si->msl) {
            FILE *g = fopen(gpath, "wb");
            if (g) { fwrite(si->msl, 1, strlen(si->msl), g); fclose(g); }
            // 反射：非零 cbuf 尺寸、贴图槽（运行时要靠它建描述符布局）
            static char cbsz[512], texbuf[4096];
            size_t co = 0, to = 0;
            cbsz[0] = texbuf[0] = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 18; i++)
                if (si->cbuf_size[i] && co < sizeof cbsz - 32)
                    co += (size_t)snprintf(cbsz + co, sizeof cbsz - co, "%s%d:%u", co ? "," : "", i, si->cbuf_size[i]);
            for (int i = 0; i < si->ntex && i < 64 && to < sizeof texbuf - 96; i++) {
                ShaderTexture *t = &si->tex[i];
                to += (size_t)snprintf(texbuf + to, sizeof texbuf - to,
                                       "%s%d:%u/%d%d%d%d/%u/%u/%u", to ? "," : "", i, t->type, (int)t->shadow,
                                       (int)t->is_array, (int)t->is_image, (int)t->bindless, t->handle_offset,
                                       t->bindless_cbuf, t->bindless_offset);
            }
            fprintf(stdout,
                    "T\t%s\t%u\t1\tattr=%u out=%u cbuf=%u cbdyn=%u cbwin=%u ntex=%d lmem=%u ninst=%u"
                    " wdepth=%d disc=%d wps=%d gmem=%d gmemst=%d tint=%d rscale=%d glsl=%zu"
                    " cbsz=%s tex=%s stage=%s zremap=%d flipy=%d path=%s\n",
                    key, stage, si->attr_mask, si->out_mask, si->cbuf_mask, si->cbuf_dynamic, si->cbwin_mask,
                    si->ntex, si->local_mem, si->num_insts,
                    (int)si->writes_depth, (int)si->uses_discard, (int)si->writes_point_size,
                    (int)si->uses_gmem, (int)si->uses_gmem_store, (int)si->uses_tint, (int)si->uses_rscale,
                    strlen(si->msl), cbsz, texbuf, stage_name,
                    (int)k.depth_minus_one, (int)k.flip_y, gpath);
        } else {
            const char *err = (si && si->error[0]) ? si->error : "no output";
            skeleton(err, skel, sizeof skel);
            fprintf(stdout, "T\t%s\t%u\t0\terr=%s stage=%s path=-\n", key, stage, err, stage_name);
            fprintf(stderr, "F\t%s\t%u\t%s\t%s\n", key, stage, skel, err);   // 归类骨架
        }
        maxwell_free(si);   // 也负责 free(si->msl)

        free(ctl);
        free(code);
        n_done++;
    }
    fclose(ix);
    fprintf(stderr, "DONE %u entries\n", n_done);
    return 0;
}

```

`tools/m3q/m3q_trim_test.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""M3q 验证实验：5 个 "unknown instruction" 失败是否只是尾部浮点常量池被当成指令。

做法：把 .code 截到最后一条 EXIT（含）+8 字节，重跑翻译器 + glslang。
不改 translate.c；只改喂给它的字节范围（运行时按 code 指令区长度喂同样可以）。
"""
import json, os, shutil, struct, subprocess, sys

CORPUS = "/Users/zpp/VibeCoding/switch2hos/logs/m3p_shaderdump/shaderdump"
TOOL = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "m3q_translate")
BASE = "/tmp/m3q"
TRIM = os.path.join(BASE, "trim")
GLSL = os.path.join(TRIM, "glsl")
SPV = os.path.join(TRIM, "out")

res = json.load(open(os.path.join(BASE, "results.json")))
fails = [k for k, e in res.items() if not e["translate_ok"] and "unknown instruction" in e["translate_error"]]

os.makedirs(GLSL, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(SPV, exist_ok=True)
index = []
report = {}
for ent in fails:
    key, stage = ent.rsplit(".", 1)
    stage = int(stage)
    src = os.path.join(CORPUS, f"{key}.{stage}.code")
    data = open(src, "rb").read()
    code = data[0x80:]
    last = None
    for i in range(len(code) // 8):
        w = struct.unpack_from("<Q", code, i * 8)[0]
        if (w >> 52) == 0xE30:
            last = i * 8
    cut = 0x80 + last + 8
    dst = os.path.join(TRIM, f"{key}.{stage}.code")
    open(dst, "wb").write(data[:cut])
    shutil.copyfile(os.path.join(CORPUS, f"{key}.{stage}.ctl"), os.path.join(TRIM, f"{key}.{stage}.ctl"))
    index.append(f"{key} {stage} ctl={0} code={cut} magic=98761234 hdr=12345678")
    report[ent] = {"orig_bytes": len(data), "trim_bytes": cut,
                   "last_exit_rel": hex(last), "dropped_bytes": len(data) - cut}

open(os.path.join(TRIM, "index.txt"), "w").write("\n".join(index) + "\n")

p = subprocess.run([TOOL, TRIM, GLSL], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("translate rc", p.returncode)
print(p.stdout)
for ent in fails:
    key, stage = ent.rsplit(".", 1)
    stage = int(stage)
    g = os.path.join(GLSL, f"{key}.{stage}.glsl")
    if not os.path.exists(g):
        report[ent]["spv_ok"] = False
        report[ent]["why"] = "translate failed again"
        continue
    spv = os.path.join(SPV, f"{key}.{stage}.spv")
    name = "vert" if stage == 0 else "frag"
    c = subprocess.run(["/opt/homebrew/bin/glslangValidator", "-V", "--target-env", "vulkan1.3",
                        "-S", name, "-o", spv, g], capture_output=True, text=True)
    b = open(spv, "rb").read() if os.path.exists(spv) else b""
    report[ent]["spv_ok"] = c.returncode == 0 and len(b) >= 4 and struct.unpack_from("<I", b)[0] == 0x07230203
    report[ent]["spv_bytes"] = len(b)
    report[ent]["spv_path"] = spv
    report[ent]["diag"] = [l for l in (c.stdout + c.stderr).splitlines() if "ERROR" in l][:3]

print(json.dumps(report, indent=1))
json.dump(report, open(os.path.join(BASE, "trim_report.json"), "w"), indent=1)

`tools/m4b/pairbake.c`:

```c
// M4b：按 (vs_key, fs_key) 配对重烘。与 m3q_translate.c 的唯一差别在 FS：
// 先把配对的 VS 翻出来，取它的 out_mask 填进 ShaderKey.vs_out_mask，再翻 FS。
// translate.c:313-314 的规则不改（不在 mask 里的属性发 0u），这样 FS 声明的 varying
// 才与 VS 实际输出一致 —— 原烘焙器的 vs_out_mask 恒 0，全部 FS 的 attr_mask 被折成 0。
//
// 输入 pair 文件每行：<vs_key|-> <fs_key|-> [nreg] [ndraw] [mask=0x..]
// 输出与 m3q_translate.c 完全相同的 TSV（交给 m3q_batch.py 编译）+ <out>/<key>.<stage>.glsl。
//
// usage: pairbake <corpus_dir> <out_dir> <pairs_file>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <strings.h>

#include "platform/nvn_replay/maxwell/shader.h"

static uint32_t rd32(const void *p) { uint32_t v; memcpy(&v, p, 4); return v; }

static uint8_t *slurp(const char *path, size_t *len) {
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "rb");
    if (!f) return NULL;
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_END);
    long n = ftell(f);
    fseek(f, 0, SEEK_SET);
    uint8_t *p = malloc((size_t)n + 1);
    if (!p) { fclose(f); return NULL; }
    if (fread(p, 1, (size_t)n, f) != (size_t)n) { free(p); fclose(f); return NULL; }
    fclose(f);
    *len = (size_t)n;
    return p;
}

static void skeleton(const char *in, char *out, size_t cap) {
    size_t o = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; in[i] && o + 2 < cap; i++) {
        if (in[i] == '%' && in[i + 1]) {
            const char *p = in + i + 1;
            while (*p && !strchr("diouxXscfeEgG", *p)) p++;
            if (*p) p++;
            out[o++] = '*';
            i = (size_t)(p - in) - 1;
        } else {
            out[o++] = in[i];
        }
    }
    out[o] = 0;
}

/* 已翻过的键：key+stage -> out_mask（VS）/ 用过的 vs_out_mask（FS）。表小，线性找。 */
typedef struct { char key[32]; int stage; uint32_t mask; int ok; } Done;
/* M4h P2：全量 A 类补烘的 (key,stage) 去重表会到 ~11k 条，8192 会静默丢表项
   （done_add 失败 ⇒ vs_known=0 ⇒ 后续 FS 全被 skip，表现为「烘了 VS 没烘 FS」）。 */
static Done g_done[32768];
static int g_done_n;
static Done *done_find(const char *key, int stage) {
    for (int i = 0; i < g_done_n; i++)
        if (g_done[i].stage == stage && !strcmp(g_done[i].key, key)) return &g_done[i];
    return NULL;
}
static Done *done_add(const char *key, int stage, uint32_t mask, int ok) {
    if (g_done_n >= 32768) return NULL;
    Done *d = &g_done[g_done_n++];
    snprintf(d->key, sizeof d->key, "%s", key);
    d->stage = stage; d->mask = mask; d->ok = ok;
    return d;
}

/* 翻一条并打 TSV（字段与 m3q_translate.c 一致）。返回 out_mask，失败返回 ~0u。 */
static uint32_t translate_emit(const char *dir, const char *out, const char *key, unsigned stage,
                               uint32_t vs_out_mask)
{
    char path[1024], gpath[1200];
    size_t ctl_len = 0, code_len = 0;
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/%s.%u.ctl", dir, key, stage);
    uint8_t *ctl = slurp(path, &ctl_len);
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/%s.%u.code", dir, key, stage);
    uint8_t *code = slurp(path, &code_len);
    const char *stage_name = stage == 0 ? "vert" : stage == 1 ? "frag" : "comp";
    snprintf(gpath, sizeof gpath, "%s/%s.%u.glsl", out, key, stage);
    char skel[256] = "";

    if (!ctl || !code) {
        fprintf(stdout, "T\t%s\t%u\t0\terr=not in corpus stage=%s path=-\n", key, stage, stage_name);
        fprintf(stderr, "F\t%s\t%u\tnot in corpus\tnot in corpus\n", key, stage);
        free(ctl); free(code);
        return ~0u;
    }
    if (rd32(ctl) != 0x98761234u || stage > 5 || code_len < 0x80) {
        fprintf(stdout, "T\t%s\t%u\t0\terr=layout mismatch stage=%s path=-\n", key, stage, stage_name);
        fprintf(stderr, "F\t%s\t%u\tlayout mismatch\tlayout mismatch\n", key, stage);
        free(ctl); free(code);
        return ~0u;
    }

    ShaderKey k;
    memset(&k, 0, sizeof k);
    k.glsl = 1;
    k.attr_kind[0] = 0;
    k.depth_minus_one = getenv("M3Q_NO_ZREMAP") == NULL;
    k.flip_y = getenv("M3Q_NO_FLIP") == NULL;
    k.vs_out_mask = vs_out_mask;

    ShaderInfo *si = maxwell_translate_bounded(code, code_len, 0, (int)stage, &k);
    uint32_t out_mask = ~0u;
    if (si && si->msl) {
        FILE *g = fopen(gpath, "wb");
        if (g) { fwrite(si->msl, 1, strlen(si->msl), g); fclose(g); }
        static char cbsz[512], texbuf[4096];
        size_t co = 0, to = 0;
        cbsz[0] = texbuf[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 18; i++)
            if (si->cbuf_size[i] && co < sizeof cbsz - 32)
                co += (size_t)snprintf(cbsz + co, sizeof cbsz - co, "%s%d:%u", co ? "," : "", i, si->cbuf_size[i]);
        for (int i = 0; i < si->ntex && i < 64 && to < sizeof texbuf - 96; i++) {
            ShaderTexture *t = &si->tex[i];
            to += (size_t)snprintf(texbuf + to, sizeof texbuf - to,
                                   "%s%d:%u/%d%d%d%d/%u/%u/%u", to ? "," : "", i, t->type, (int)t->shadow,
                                   (int)t->is_array, (int)t->is_image, (int)t->bindless, t->handle_offset,
                                   t->bindless_cbuf, t->bindless_offset);
        }
        fprintf(stdout,
                "T\t%s\t%u\t1\tattr=%u out=%u cbuf=%u cbdyn=%u cbwin=%u ntex=%d lmem=%u ninst=%u"
                " wdepth=%d disc=%d wps=%d gmem=%d gmemst=%d tint=%d rscale=%d glsl=%zu"
                " cbsz=%s tex=%s stage=%s zremap=%d flipy=%d path=%s\n",
                key, stage, si->attr_mask, si->out_mask, si->cbuf_mask, si->cbuf_dynamic, si->cbwin_mask,
                si->ntex, si->local_mem, si->num_insts,
                (int)si->writes_depth, (int)si->uses_discard, (int)si->writes_point_size,
                (int)si->uses_gmem, (int)si->uses_gmem_store, (int)si->uses_tint, (int)si->uses_rscale,
                strlen(si->msl), cbsz, texbuf, stage_name,
                (int)k.depth_minus_one, (int)k.flip_y, gpath);
        out_mask = si->out_mask;
    } else {
        const char *err = (si && si->error[0]) ? si->error : "no output";
        skeleton(err, skel, sizeof skel);
        fprintf(stdout, "T\t%s\t%u\t0\terr=%s stage=%s path=-\n", key, stage, err, stage_name);
        fprintf(stderr, "F\t%s\t%u\t%s\t%s\n", key, stage, skel, err);
    }
    maxwell_free(si);
    free(ctl);
    free(code);
    return out_mask;
}

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    if (argc < 4) { fprintf(stderr, "usage: %s <corpus_dir> <out_dir> <pairs_file>\n", argv[0]); return 2; }
    const char *dir = argv[1], *out = argv[2];
    FILE *pf = fopen(argv[3], "r");
    if (!pf) { perror(argv[3]); return 2; }

    maxwell_gmem_base = 0x80000000ull;
    maxwell_gmem_size = 0x40000000ull;
    if (getenv("M3Q_NO_INT64")) maxwell_no_int64 = true;

    unsigned n_pair = 0, n_vs = 0, n_fs = 0, n_fs_skip_nomask = 0, n_conflict = 0, n_fail = 0;
    char line[512];
    while (fgets(line, sizeof line, pf)) {
        if (line[0] == '#' || line[0] == '\n') continue;
        char vs[64] = "", fs[64] = "", tok[64];
        unsigned long nreg = 0, ndraw = 0, mask_env = 0; int have_mask = 0;
        int nf = sscanf(line, "%63s %63s %lu %lu %63s", vs, fs, &nreg, &ndraw, tok);
        if (nf < 2) continue;
        if (nf >= 5 && !strncmp(tok, "mask=0x", 7)) { mask_env = (unsigned)strtoul(tok + 7, NULL, 16); have_mask = 1; }
        if (!strcmp(vs, "-")) vs[0] = 0;
        if (!strcmp(fs, "-")) fs[0] = 0;
        if (!vs[0] && !fs[0]) continue;
        n_pair++;

        uint32_t vs_mask = 0; int vs_known = 0;
        if (vs[0]) {
            Done *d = done_find(vs, 0);
            if (d && d->ok) { vs_mask = d->mask; vs_known = 1; }
            else if (!d) {
                uint32_t m = translate_emit(dir, out, vs, 0, 0);
                d = done_add(vs, 0, m, m != ~0u);
                n_vs++;
                if (d && d->ok) { vs_mask = d->mask; vs_known = 1; } else n_fail++;
            }
        }
        if (!fs[0]) continue;
        if (!vs_known && have_mask) { vs_mask = mask_env; vs_known = 1; }
        if (!vs_known) {
            /* VS 未知/翻转失败：不能猜 mask（猜错等于又回到 attr_mask=0 或建管线失败），留缺口报出来 */
            n_fs_skip_nomask++;
            fprintf(stderr, "S\t%s\tvs=%s\tno vs_out_mask (skipped)\n", fs, vs[0] ? vs : "-");
            continue;
        }
        Done *d = done_find(fs, 1);
        if (d) {
            if (d->mask != vs_mask) {
                n_conflict++;
                fprintf(stderr, "C\t%s\tmask %#x != %#x (kept first)\n", fs, d->mask, vs_mask);
            }
            continue;
        }
        uint32_t m = translate_emit(dir, out, fs, 1, vs_mask);
        done_add(fs, 1, vs_mask, m != ~0u);
        n_fs++;
        if (m == ~0u) n_fail++;
    }
    fclose(pf);
    fprintf(stderr, "PAIRBAKE pairs=%u vs=%u fs=%u fs_skip_nomask=%u conflict=%u fail=%u\n",
            n_pair, n_vs, n_fs, n_fs_skip_nomask, n_conflict, n_fail);
    return 0;
}
